english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ji ngo kɛ ha adesahi tsuo. Se ke ngo nya nyu gbo ɔ, mɛni a kɛ maa wo lɛ ngo ekohu? E he be senami hu, ja a tsɛ pue he nɛ nimli naa nɔ.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ hu, nɔ ko su we kane kɛ mɛ́ sowe sisi: se mohu e kɛ maa kane tso nɔ, nɛ e tsoo haa nihi nɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi tsuo kulaa.

english_verse: Don't suppose I came to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I did not come to do away with them, but to give them their full meaning.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko susu kaa imi Yesu i ba Mose mlaa aloo gbali ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ gumi; i bɛ mɛ gumi, se i ba nɛ ma ba gbe nya.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: “Tse nyɛ nu kaa a de blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke: ‘koo gbe nɔmlɔ, se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ maa ba kojolɔ ɔ hɛ mi.’

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ muklii mi fuɔ e nyɛmi , a kɛ lɛ maa ba kojolɔ ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ deɔ e nyɛmi ke: ‘Yaka nɔmlɔ’ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ maa ba gua ngua a hɛ mi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɛɛ e nyɛmi ke kuasia nɛ he be senami ɔ, e maa ye abosiami a je la a mi yami fɔ?

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: si o nike ni ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ o ya nɔuu nɛ o kɛ o nyɛmi ɔ ya kpata lolo, konɛ o kpale ba nɛ o kɛ o nike ni ɔ ba ha Mawu.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: “O kɛ o pɛbilɔ ɔ nɛ tsa mla benɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, ke pi ja a, nyɛ lejɛ ɔ sumi nɔuu ɔ e maa ngɔ mo ngɔ ha kojolɔ ɔ, nɛ lɛ hu e maa ngɔ mo ngɔ ha tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ a maa wo mo tsu mi.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ke: O be lejɛ ɔ jee kɛ yaa si o maa wo nyagbe pɛsɛwa a.” Gbapuɛmi he nitsɔɔmi

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: “A de hulɔ ke: ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ fieɔ e yo ɔ, sa nɛ e ha lɛ hemi womi.’

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: “Tse nyɛ nu hulɔ kaa a de blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke: ‘Ko ka kita gu, se mohu ye o kita amɛ a nɔ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: When you make a promise, say only “Yes” or “No.” Anything else comes from the devil. Revenge (Luke
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ke: ‘Ee’ ɔ, e pee: ‘Ee;’ nɛ ke nyɛ ke: ‘Dɛbi’ ɔ, e pee: ‘Dɛbi’; nɔ́ kpa ko nɛ pe enɛ ɔ ɔ, je abosiami dɛ mi.” Peemi kɛ nanemitomi he nitsɔɔmi (Luka

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: “Tse nyɛ nu nɛ a de ke: ‘Hɛngmɛ ngɛ hɛngmɛ nane mi,’ ‘lungu ngɛ lungu nane mi.’

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nɔ nɛ maa pee nyɛ yayami ɔ, nyɛ ko pee lɛ ngɔ to nane mi; se ke nɔ ko gba o hiɛ ɔ nɔ tue mi ɔ, plɛ kake ɔ hu ha lɛ.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nɔ ko nyɛ o nɔ ke o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya si tomi nya kake ɔ, o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya enyɔ.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ mo nɔ́ bae ɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ o pa lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, koo nyɛ lɛ he.” Henyɛli a suɔmi (Luka

english_verse: You have heard people say, “Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.”
translation_verse: “Tse nyɛ nu nɛ a de ke: ‘Suɔ o huɛ nɛ o nyɛ o henyɛlɔ.’

english_verse: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ henyɛli, nyɛɛ sɔle ha nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ,

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: enɛ ɔ ma ha nyɛ ma plɛ nyɛ tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ bimɛ, ejakaa e haa e pu jee ngɛ nimli yayamihi kɛ nimli kpakpahi a nɔ, nɛ e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ haa dali kɛ yayami peeli.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ suɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ suɔ nyɛ ɔ, mɛni hiɔwo nyɛ ngɛ? Anɛ to tsuli ɔmɛ tete pee we ja nɔuu lo?

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nyɛ ngaa nyɛ nyɛmimɛ kɛkɛ ɔ, anɛ nyɛ pee nɔ́ ko tsɔ pe bɔ nɛ sa peemi lo? Anɛ wɔ jali ɔmɛ tete pee we ja nɔuu lo?

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ nyɛ ko pee nyɛ dami nihi ngɛ ma hɛ mi, ke nyɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ be hiɔwo ko ngɛ nyɛ tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: When you give to the poor, don't let anyone know about it.
translation_verse: Se mo o lɛɛ, ke o ngɛ kpakpa pee ɔ, ko ha o muɔ nine nɛ le nɔ nɛ o hiɛ ɔ nine peɔ.

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: “Nɛ ke nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, nyɛ ko pee kaa osatotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, se a suɔ kaa a da kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a kɔ nyahi kɛ sɔle konɛ nihi nɛ na mɛ. Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: A nine su a hiɔwo nɔ mo.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Se ke o ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, sɛ o se tsu mi, nɛ po nga sinya a nɛ o sɔle ngɔ ha o tsɛ ngɛ laami mi, nɛ o tsɛ nɛ naa laami mi nihi ɔ maa wo mo hiɔ.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ nyɛ ko tu munyu fuu kaa wɔ jali ɔmɛ; se a susuu kaa a munyu fuu ɔ he a maa bu mɛ tue.

english_verse: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko pee kaa mɛ; se nyɛ tsɛ ɔ le nihi nɛ hiaa nyɛ loko nyɛ biɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ sɔle kikɛ: ‘Wa tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, O biɛ ɔ he nɛ tsɔ;

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.
translation_verse: O matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ ba; A pee nɔ nɛ o suɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kaa a peɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi a tɔmihi pa mɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ kɛ maa pa nyɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi a tɔmihi pɛ́ mɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ ɔ hu kɛ nyɛ tɔmi ɔmɛ be nyɛ pae.” Hwɔhami he nitsɔɔmi

english_verse: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: konɛ ni kpahi ko na kaa o ngɛ hwɔ hae, ja o tsɛ nɛ ngɛ laami mi ɔ; nɛ o tsɛ nɛ naa laami mi ni ɔ maa wo mo hiɔ.” Hiɔwe juetli (Luka

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hla Mɛwu matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ e dami kekle, nɛ akɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa piɛ he ngɔ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he ngɔ to hwɔɔ; ejakaa hwɔɔ nitse maa hao ngɛ lɛ nitse e he. Ligbi tsuaa ligbi nɔ yayami ɔ hiɛ ha lɛ.”

english_verse: Don't store up treasures on earth! Moths and rust can destroy them, and thieves can break in and steal them.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko to juetli ha nyɛ he ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, he nɛ wɔyewɔye kɛ kana puɛɔ nihi nɛ juli guu kɛ sɛɛ mi ya juɔ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ to juetli ha nyɛ he ngɛ hiɔwe he nɛ wɔyewɔye kɛ kana puɛ we nihi nɛ juli gui kɛ sɛ we mi yajui ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: Ejakaa he nɛ o juetli ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ o tsui maa hi.” Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ la (Luka

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: se ke o hɛngmɛ nɔ tsɔ we ɔ, o nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ tsuo maa wo diblii. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke la nɛ ngɛ o mi ɔ ji diblii ɔ, kɛ jamɛ a diblii ɔ mi ma ti kɛɛ!” Mawu kɛ ninami (Luka

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: “Nɔ ko be nyɔmtsɛmɛ enyɔ nyɛe ma sɔmɔ; ejakaa eko ɔ e maa nyɛ nɔ kake nɛ e maa suɔ nɔ kpa a; aloo e maa pɛtɛ nɔ kake he, nɛ e maa gbe nɔ kpa a he guɛ. Nyɛ be Mawu kɛ mamona nyɛe ma sɔmɔ.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ de ke: ‘Mɛni wa maa ye, aloo mɛni wa maa nu, mɛni hu wa ma ngɔ ha wa he?’

english_verse: I tell you not to worry about your life. Don't worry about having something to eat, drink, or wear. Isn't life more than food or clothing?
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛ ko hao ngɛ nyɛ wami he, nɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ye kɛ nɔ nɛ nyɛ maa nu, aloo nɔ nɛ nyɛ maa wo ngɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he. Anɛ wami pa we ngma, nɛ nɔmlɔ tso pa we tade lo?

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ; a du we ni nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu a kpɔ we, pohu a bua we nya ngɔ wui ngma gba mi; se nyɛ tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ lɛɛ mɛ kɛ̃. Anɛ nyɛ he jua wɛ́ hluu pi mɛ lo?

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: “Nɛ mɛ he je nɛ nyɛ peɔ yeyeeye ngɛ tade he? Nyɛ susu nga nɔ mɔmɔ ɔmɛ a he, bɔ nɛ a puɛɛ ɔ: atsu we ni, jeha nɔ hu a tsɛ̃ we kpa.

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Salmo kɛ e nyami ɔ tsuo tete mia we kaa enɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kake.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ ke nga nɔ hu nɛ mwɔnɛ e ngɛ nɛ hwɔ nɛ a kɛ woɔ abolo tsu mi nɛ Mawu miaa lɛ kikɛ ɔ, anɛ e be nɔ́ nɛ pe enɛ pee ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi pi ɔ lo?

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ le kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he ngɛ nyɛ hiae.

english_verse: Don't condemn others, and God won't condemn you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko kojo konɛ a ko kojo nyɛ?

english_verse: God will be as hard on you as you are on others! He will treat you exactly as you treat them.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kojomi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ kojoɔ ɔ, a kɛ maa kojo nyɛ, nɛ susumi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ susuu ɔ, a kɛ ma susu ha nyɛ.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Se mɛni he je o naa ngu nyafii nɛ ngɛ o nyɛmi hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ, nɛ mo nitse o hɛngmɛ nɔ plai ɔ lɛɛ o nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye?
translation_verse: Aloo kɛ maa pee kɛ nɛ o ma de o nyɛmi ke: ‘Ha ma je ngu nyafii ɔ ngɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ,’ be mi nɛ plai ngɛ mo nitse o hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ?

english_verse: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.
translation_verse: Osatotsɛ, je plai ɔ ngɛ mo nitse o hɛngmɛ nɔ kekle, nɛ lɔ ɔ loko o maa hyɛ nɔ paa nɛ o ma je ngu nyafii ɔ ngɛ o nyɛmi ɔ hɛngmɛ nɔ.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ ke nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ji nimli yayamihi ɔ nyɛ le bɔ nɛ nyɛ peɔ ngɔɔ ni kpakpahi ngɔ haa nyɛ bimɛ ɔ, enyɛmɛ nɔuu nɛ nyɛ tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ be ni kpakpahi ngɔe kɛ ha nihi nɛ biɔ lɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ nɛ ke e bi bi lɛ abolo nɛ e ma ha lɛ tɛ?

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ bi, nɛ a ma ha nyɛ; nyɛ hla nɛ nyɛ maa na; nyɛ si, nɛ a ma bli ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ biɔ ɔ, e nine suu nɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ hlaa a, e naa; nɛ nɔ nɛ siɔ ɔ, a bliɔ haa lɛ.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Aloo ke e bi lɛ wo mi lo, nɛ e ma ha lɛ sinɔ?

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nihi nɛ pee ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ja nɔuu ngɔ ha mɛ, ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji mlaa a kɛ gbali ɔmɛ.” Agbo tokofii ɔ (Luka

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ ye munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e yeɔ nɔ ɔ, ma ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to ga lelɔ nɛ ma e tsu ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: But the gate to life is very narrow. The road that leads there is so hard to follow that only a few people find it. A Tree and Its Fruit (Luke
translation_verse: Se agbo tokofii kɛ blɔ nɛ hɛ ji nɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi ɔ nɛ, nɛ nihi bɔɔ ji nihi nɛ naa kɔlɔ ɔ.” Tso kɛ e yiblii (Luka

english_verse: Watch out for false prophets! They dress up like sheep, but inside they are wolves who have come to attack you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ osato gbali ɔmɛ a he, ejakaa a ngɔɔ to he womi ngɔ haa a he kɛ baa nyɛ ngɔ, se a mi mi je ɔ ogbetee ni hali ji mɛ.

english_verse: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.
translation_verse: A yiblii ɔmɛ nyɛ ma kɛ le mɛ. Anɛ a tsɔɔ wai yiblii ngɛ mio tsohi a nɔ, aloo a tsɔɔ ngmɔkɔ ngɛ sezlehi anɔ?

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu tso tsuaa tso nɛ ji tso kpakpa a woɔ yiblii kpakpahi; se tso yaya woɔ yiblii yayahi.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Tso kpakpa be yiblii yaya nyɛe maa wo nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu tso yaya be yiblii kpakpahi nyɛe maa wo.

english_verse: Every tree producing bad fruit will be chopped down and burned.
translation_verse: Tso tsuaa tso nɛ wui yiblii kpakpahi ɔ, a maa hɛ nɛ a maa ngɔ ngɔ wo la mi?

english_verse: You can tell who the false prophets are by their deeds. A Warning (Luke
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a yiblii ɔmɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa le mɛ.” I li nyɛ kulaa (Luka

english_verse: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ ye munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, a maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to nyumu kuasia nɛ ma e tsu ngɛ zia nɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔmi nɛ, nɛ pahi hia, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ fia, nɛ a si tsuɔ ɔ, nɛ e hule, nɛ e hulemi ɔ kle.” He blɔ nɛ Yesu ngɛ

english_verse: Not everyone who calls me their Lord will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only the ones who obey my Father in heaven will get in.
translation_verse: “Pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ deɔ mi ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ’ ɔ nɛ maa sɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi; se mohu nɔ nɛ peɔ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ suɔmi nya ni ɔ.

english_verse: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, “We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.”
translation_verse: Nihi fuu ma de mi ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ, anɛ pi mo o biɛ ɔ mi nɛ wa gba ngɛ, nɛ o biɛ ɔ mi wa hia numi yayamihi ngɛ, nɛ o biɛ ɔ mi wa pee he wami nihi fuu ngɛ lo?’

english_verse: But I will tell them, “I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people!” Two Builders (Luke

english_verse: Brothers and sisters will betray one another and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.
translation_verse: “Nyɛmi maa ngɔ nyɛmi ngɔ ha gbenɔ, nɛ tsɛ maa ngɔ bi ngɔ ha, nɛ bimɛ maa te si ngɔ wo a fɔli nɛ a ma ha nɛ a gbe mɛ.

english_verse: Watch out for people who will take you to court and have you beaten in their synagogues.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ nimli a he; ejakaa a maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ maa ya guahi a mi nɛ a maa fia nyɛ kpa ngɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ;

english_verse: Because of me, you will be dragged before rulers and kings to tell them and the Gentiles about your faith.
translation_verse: nɛ ganɔhi kɛ matsɛmɛ a hɛ mi tete po a kɛ nyɛ maa ya ngɛ ye he, konɛ a kɛ ye odase ha mɛ kɛ majeli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: But you will not really be the one speaking. The Spirit from your Father will tell you what to say.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi nyɛ ji ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, se mohu nyɛ tsɛ ɔ mumi ɔ lɛ ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ nyɛ mi.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you remain faithful until the end, you will be saved.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi tsuo maa nyɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he; se nɔ nɛ hɛɔ mi kɛ pii si ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ a ma he e yi wami?

english_verse: When people mistreat you in one town, hurry to another one. I promise you before you have gone to all the towns of Israel, the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Se ke a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ ya ekpa mi; se niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛ be Israel ma amɛ tsuo nya gbee loko Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba.

english_verse: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.
translation_verse: “Kaselɔ pa we e tsɔɔlɔ, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu nyɔguɛ pa we e nyɔmtsɛ.

english_verse: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family? The One To Fear (Luke
translation_verse: E hiɛ kaa kaselɔ maa pee kaa e tsɔɔlɔ, nɛ nyɔguɛ hu maa pee kaa e nyɔmtsɛ. Ke a tsɛ wetsɛ ɔ Beelzebul ɔ, e webi ɔmɛ lɛɛ si enyɛmɛ a be mɛ tsɛe ja?” Nɔ nɛ sa gbeyeyemi (Luka

english_verse: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ ko ye ninɛmɛ nɛ gbee nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ a nyɛ we klaa a nɛ a gbe ɔ gbeye; se mohu nyɛɛ ye nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ klaa a kɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo hɛ mi kpataa ngɛ gehena mi ɔ gbeye.

english_verse: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.
translation_verse: Anɛ otokliihi enyɔ ɔ pi pɛsɛwa nɛ a juaa nɛ a heɔ lo? Se a ti nɔ kake be zugba nɔe, ja e je nyɛ tsɛ ɔ dɛ mi.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ yi bwɔmi po ɔ a kane kulaa.

english_verse: So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Luke
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko ye gbeye; nyɛ he jua wa hluu pe otokliihi babauu.” Kristo biɛtawomi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi (Luka

english_verse: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbaa mi woɔ ye ta ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, imi hu ma gba mi ma mo e ta ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me. Not Peace, but Trouble (Luke
translation_verse: Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuaa mi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, imi hu ma kua lɛ ngɛ ye tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi.” Pi hejɔmi se klaate (Luka

english_verse: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko susu kaa i ba nɛ ma ba ha he jɔmi nɛ ba zugba a nɔ; pi he jɔmi hami nɛ i ba, se klaate mohu.

english_verse: I came to turn sons against their fathers, daughters against their mothers, and daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i ba nɛ ma ba ha bi nɛ te si kɛ si e tsɛ, kɛ bi yo hu kɛ si e nyɛ, kɛ nganyɛ hu kɛ si e nganyɛ.

english_verse: Your worst enemies will be in your own family.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ nitse we mi bimɛ ma plɛ e henyɛli.

english_verse: If you love your father or mother or even your sons and daughters more than me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ dɔɔ e tsɛ loo e nyɛ he pe mi ɔ, e sɛ́ mi; nɛ nɔ nɛ dɔɔ binyumu loo biyo he pe mi ɔ e se sɛ́ mi.

english_verse: And unless you are willing to take up your cross and follow me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ wo we e seumi tso kɛ nyɛɛ we ye se ɔ, e sɛ mi?

english_verse: If you try to save your life, you will lose it. But if you give it up for me, you will surely find it. Rewards (Mark
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ laa e klaa ngɛ ye he ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ.” Hiɔwomi (Marko

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes a prophet, just because that person is a prophet, will be given the same reward as a prophet. Anyone who welcomes a good person, just because that person is good, will be given the same reward as a good person.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ heɔ gbalɔ ngɛ gbalɔ biɛ mi ɔ, gbalɔ hiɔwo e ma na; nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ dalɔ ngɛ dalɔ biɛ mi ɔ, dalɔ hiɔwo e ma na.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ heɔ nyɛ ɔ, e heɔ mi; nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ mi ɔ, e heɔ nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: And anyone who gives one of my most humble followers a cup of cool water, just because that person is my follower, will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ha ni tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nyu hɔ tsimi kake pɛ nɛ e nu ngɛ kaselɔ biɛ mi ɔ, niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke e hiɔwo be lɛ fɔe gblegbleegblee.”

english_verse: As John's followers were going away, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What sort of person did you go out into the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Benɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ yaa a, Yesu bɔni Yohane he munyu tumi kɛ ngɛ nihi babauu ɔ tsɔɔe ke: “Mɛni nyɛ ho hyemi ya ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ? Gla nɛ kɔɔhiɔ mimiɛɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “That man has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yohane ba nɛz e yi ni nɛ pohu e nui nɔ́ ko, nɛ a de ke: ‘Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi.’

english_verse: After Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he left and began teaching and preaching in the towns.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ba mi kaa, benɛ Yesu to e kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ blɔ nya ta a, e je lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ni nɛ e fiɛ ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi.

english_verse: John was in prison when he heard what Christ was doing. So John sent some of his followers
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yohane nu Kristo ni tsumi ɔmɛ a he ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ e tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ ekomɛ,

english_verse: to ask Jesus, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke: “Anɛ mo ji nɔ nɛ ma a, aloo waa hyɛ nɔ kpa ko blɔ?”

english_verse: The blind are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People with leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: hɛyuyuili ngɛ nɔ hyɛe, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a hule ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe; tsitsɛmɛ a he ngɛ tsɔe, nɛ otokuli ngɛ nɔ nue; ni gbogboehi ngɛ si tee, nɛ ohiafo ɔmɛ ɔ, a ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a fiee kɛ ngɛ mɛ tsɔɔe?

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye he sane be e nane kpatae.” Yesu ye Yohane he odase (Luka

english_verse: What kind of man did you go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who dress like that live in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Aloo mɛni nyɛ ho hyɛmi ya? Nɔmlɔ nɛ woɔ tade bɔdɔɔ? Oʼɛ, nimli nɛ woɔ tade bɔdɔɔ ɔ, matsɛmɛ a wehi a mi a hii.

english_verse: What did you really go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was. I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Aloo mɛni nyɛ ho hyemi ya? Gbalɔ? Ee, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ nɛ pe gbalɔ tete.

english_verse: I tell you no one ever born on this earth is greater than John the Baptist. But whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than John.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nihi nɛ yihi fɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, nɔ ko ti si hyɛ nɛ pe Yohane, Baptisilɔ ɔ; se kɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji nyafii kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ pe lɛ.

english_verse: From the time of John the Baptist until now, violent people have been trying to take over the kingdom of heaven by force.
translation_verse: Se kɛ je Yohane Baptisilɔ ɔ yi nɔ kɛ ma nɛ ɔ, pani nya a ngɔɔ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ, nɛ hewali sãa lɛ he wami nya.

english_verse: And if you believe them, John is Elijah, the prophet you are waiting for.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa hɛɛ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ ɔ ji Elia nɛ maa ba a nɛ.

english_verse: “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not mourn!”
translation_verse: ‘Wa kpã bɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ dui; wa je ya ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ fo we.’

english_verse: But the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, and you say, “That man eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.” Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what it does. The Unbelieving Towns (Luke
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba nɛ e yeɔ ni nɛ jeha nɛ e nuu nɔ ko ɔ, a de ke: ‘Oʼɛ, nyumu jiklɔɔtsɛ kɛ da nulɔ onia tsuli kɛ yayami peeli a huɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ Nɛ a bu Nawu ni lemi ɔ bemi ngɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ a nya.” Mahi nɛ he we yi ɔ (Luka

english_verse: In the towns where Jesus had worked most of his miracles, the people refused to turn to God. So Jesus was upset with them and said:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e bɔni mahi, hehi nɛ e tsu e he wami ni tsumihi babauu titli ngɛ ɔ a hɛ mi kami akɛnɛ a tsakee we a tsui ɔ, nɛ e ke:

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? You will go down to hell! If the miracles that took place in your town had happened in Sodom, it would still be standing.
translation_verse: Nɛ mo Kapernaum, pi hiɔwe lokoo nɛ a wo o nɔ kɛ su? Gbeje lokoo a maa ba mo si kɛ maa ya; ejakaa he wami ni tsumihi nɛ a tsu ngɛ o mi ɔ, a na nɛ a tsu ngɛ Sodom jinɛ e maa si kɛ ba su mwɔ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: So I tell you on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than you. Come to Me and Rest (Luke
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, e be wae ha Sodom zugba a ngɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ nɔ kaa mo Kapernaum.” Nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ ma ha nyɛɛ jɔɔ hyɛ he (Luka

english_verse: At that moment Jesus said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de ke: “I ngɛ o yi jee, Tsaatsɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba nyɔmtsɛ, kaa o ngɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ laa ga leli kɛ ni leli, nɛ o je tsɔɔ bimwɔwi;

english_verse: Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Ee, Tsaatsɛ, bɔ nɛ sa o hɛ mi ji ja.

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who truly knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: “Tsaatsɛ tu nihi kulaa ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko li Bi ɔ, kaa ja Tsɛ ɔ kɛkɛ; jeha nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko li Tsɛ ɔ, kaa ja Bi ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ Bi ɔ suɔ kaa e je lɛ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If you are tired from carrying heavy burdens, come to me and I will give you rest.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ, nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ pɔ tɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tlomihi pã nyɛ ɔ, nɛ ma ha nyɛ he jɔmi?

english_verse: Take the yoke I give you. Put it on your shoulders and learn from me. I am gentle and humble, and you will find rest.
translation_verse: Nyɛ wo ye kuɛpã tso ɔ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kase mi; se ye he jɔ, nɛ i baa ye he si kɛ jee ye tsui mi; nɛ nyɛ ma na he jɔmi ngɔ ha nyɛ klaa amɛ.

english_verse: This yoke is easy to bear, and this burden is light.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ye kuɛpa tso ɔ tloomi wɛ, nɛ ye tlomi ɔ hu jii we.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees noticed this and said to Jesus, “Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do this!”
translation_verse: Se benɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ na a, a de lɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, o kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa a peɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ pee.”

english_verse: The crowds were so amazed they asked, “Could Jesus be the Son of David?”
translation_verse: Nɛ asafo ɔ tsuo nyɛ kpɛ a he nɛ a de ke: “Anɛ pi David bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: But when I force out demons by the power of God's Spirit, it proves that God's kingdom has already come to you.
translation_verse: Se ke imi lɛɛ, Mawu Mumi ɔ nya i hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ pe Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ na nyɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Haven't you read in the Law of Moses that the priests are allowed to work in the temple on the Sabbath? But no one says they are guilty of breaking the law of the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Aloo nyɛ kane we ngɛ Mlaa a mi kaa Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, osɔfohi bleɔ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ a yi fɔ ɔ?

english_verse: He went into the house of God, and then they ate the sacred loaves of bread that only priests are supposed to eat.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ e sɛ Mawu we ɔ nɛ e ya ye hɛ mi mami abolo nɛ e dɛ blɔ kaa lɛ loo nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ yeɔ ɔ, kaa ja osɔfɔ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know what the Scriptures mean when they say, “Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others?” If you knew what this means, you would not condemn these innocent disciples of mine.
translation_verse: Se kaa nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ji: ‘Mɔbɔ nami i hlaa se pi bɔ’ ɔ sisi jinɛ, nyɛ be ninɛmɛ nɛ yi fɔ ɔ fɔ bue.

english_verse: Jesus left and went into one of their synagogues,
translation_verse: Nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ya sɛ a kpe he ɔ.

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “Hold out your hand.” The man did, and it became as healthy as the other one.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de nyumu ɔ ke: “Kpa o nine ɔ mi!” Nɛ e kpa mi, nɛ e kɛ kake ɔ sɔ.

english_verse: When Jesus found out what was happening, he left there and large crowds followed him. He healed all of their sick,
translation_verse: Se benɛ Yesu kpa enɛ ɔ si ɔ, e sa e he si kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ nihi babauu nyɛɛ e se, nɛ e tsa mɛ tsuo,

english_verse: but warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: nɛ e bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko ha nɛ a nu e he;

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as Isaiah the prophet had said,
translation_verse: benɛ pee nɛ nɔ nɛ gbalɔ “Yesaia de ɔ nɛ ba mi ke:

english_verse: “Here is my chosen servant! I love him, and he pleases me. I will give him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: “Oʼɛ, ye tsɔlɔ nɛ i hla a, Ye suɔlɔ nɛ ye klaa naa e he tsui ɔ, I kɛ ye mumi ɔ maa to e nɔ, Nɛ e maa fiɛ kojomi ngɔ tsɔɔ majeli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: If you are not on my side, you are against me. If you don't gather in the harvest with me, you scatter it.
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ be ye blɔfami ɔ, e te si ngɔ wo mi; nɛ nɔ nɛ kɛ mi bua we nya a, e ngɛ gbɛe kɛ ngɛ fiae.

english_verse: Some people brought to Jesus a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon in him. Jesus healed the man, and then he was able to talk and see.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ nɔ ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi nɛ ji hɛ yuyuilɔ kɛ amuɛti tsuo ɔ ba e ngɔ; nɛ e tsa lɛ, nɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ nɛ ji amuɛti hulɔ ɔ tu munyu nɛ e hyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them: Any kingdom where people fight each other will end up ruined. And a town or family that fights will soon destroy itself.
translation_verse: Se nɛ Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ, e de mɛ ke: “Matsɛ yemi tsuaa matsɛ yemi nɛ gbaa woɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ, e ywia; nɛ ma tsuaa ma aloo we tsuaa we nɛ gbaa woɔ lɛ nitse e he ɔ, e dɛ si.

english_verse: If I use the power of Beelzebul to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? Your followers are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke imi ɔ, Beelzebul he wami nya i hiaa mumi yayamihi ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ bimɛ nyumu ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ he wami nya a hiaa mɛ ngɛ? Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mɛ nɔuu a maa kojo nyɛ.

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when the demon doesn't find a place,
translation_verse: “Se mumi yayami ɔ, ke e je nɔmlɔ mi ɔ, e ya nyɛɛ he gbigblihi hlaa he jɔɔmi, se e nɛ́ eko.

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and the person ends up in worse shape than before. That's how it will be with you evil people of today. Jesus' Mother and Brothers (Mark
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, e yaa nɛ e ya ngɔɔ mumi kpahi kpaago nɛ ji mumi yayamihi pe lɛ kɛ piɛɛ e he; nɛ a baa ba hii lejɛ ɔ; nɛ jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ nyagbe si himi ɔ plɛɔ yayami pe kekle nɔ ɔ. Ja nɔuu e maa ba mi ngɛ yi nɔ yaya nɛ ɔ hu he.” Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛ nyumu ɔmɛ (Marko

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit. You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ha tso ɔ nɛ pee kpakpa nɛ e wo yiblii kpakpahi; aloo nyɛ ha tso ɔ nɛ pee tso yaya nɛ e wo yiblii yayahi; ejakaa tso yiblii a kɛ leɔ tso.

english_verse: You are a bunch of evil snakes, so how can you say anything good? Your words show what is in your hearts.
translation_verse: Nyɛ sinɔhi a nina! Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ji nimli yayamihi ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ munyu kpakpa maa tu? Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ hyi tsui kɛ be nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu nya deɔ.

english_verse: I promise you on the day of judgment, everyone will have to account for every careless word they have spoken.
translation_verse: “Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, yaka munyu tsuaa yaka munyu nɛ nimli tuɔ ɔ, a maa bu he akɔɔtaa ngɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: On that day they will be told they are either innocent or guilty because of the things they have said. A Sign from Heaven (Mark
translation_verse: Ejakaa o munyu ɔmɛ a mi a maa je kɛ wo mo nguɔ, nɛ o munyu ɔmɛ a mi a maa je kɛ bu mo fɔ.” Farisifo ɔmɛ ngɛ okadi hlae (Marko

translation_verse: Se Petro he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, ke mo ʼi ɔ, fa mi konɛ ma nyɛɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ba o ngɔ,”

english_verse: At once, Jesus reached out his hand. He helped Peter up and said, “You surely don't have much faith. Why do you doubt?”
translation_verse: Nɛ amlɔ ɔ Yesu kpa e nine mi nɛ e pɛtɛ e he, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Mo nɛ o hemi kɛ yemi pi, mɛni he je o je nguane?”

english_verse: When Jesus and Peter got into the boat, the wind died down.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a sɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ, kɔɔhiɔ ɔ jɔɔ fiami.

english_verse: The men in the boat worshiped Jesus and said, “You really are the Son of God!” Jesus Heals Sick People in Gennesaret (Mark
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ba ba ja lɛ de ke: “Niinɛ, Mawu bi ji mo!” Yesu tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ Genesarɛt (Marko

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed the lake and came to shore near the town of Gennesaret.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a po wo ɔ, a ba Genesarɛt zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: The people found out he was there, and they sent word to everyone who lived in this part of the country. So they brought all the sick people to Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ lejɛ ɔ tsɛmɛ na kaa Yesu ʼi ɔ, a tsɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi tsuo, nɛ a ya ngɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ;

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Every plant that my Father in heaven did not plant will be pulled up by the roots.
translation_verse: Se e he nɔ ke: “Tso tsuaa tso nɛ pi ye hiɔwe Tsɛ ɔ nɛ ma a, a maa hia.

english_verse: “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? They don't even wash their hands before they eat.”
translation_verse: “Mɛni he je nɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ tɔɔ nikɔtɔmɛ amɛ a kɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ? Ejakaa a fɔ we a dɛ loko a yeɔ ni.”

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they have has been offered to God.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ deɔ ke: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma de e tsɛ loo e nyɛ ke: ‘Nɔ́ nɛ jinɛ o ma na ngɛ ye dɛ mi ɔ, i kɛ ke Mawu’ ɔ, lɛɛ e ko pa bu e tsɛ loo e nyɛ hu.

english_verse: Is this any way to show respect to your parents? You ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ blema kɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, nyɛ kua Mawu kita a.

english_verse: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.” What Really Makes People Unclean (Mark
translation_verse: Se yakatsuaa a jaa mi ɔ nɛ, Ejakaa a tsɔɔ tsɔɔmihi nɛ ji nimli a kitahi.’ ” Nihi nɛ bleɔ nɔmlɔ (Marko

english_verse: Stay away from those Pharisees! They are like blind people leading other blind people, and all of them will fall into a ditch.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko di a se! Hɛ yuyuili nɛ tsɔɔ hɛ yuyuili a blɔ ji mɛ; nɛ ke hɛ yuyuilɔ ngɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ blɔ tsɔe ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔ tsuo a maa nɔ muɔ mi.”

english_verse: Jesus did not say a word. But the woman kept following along and shouting, so his disciples came up and asked him to send her away.
translation_verse: Se e pui e nya mi. Nɛ ekaseli ɔmɛ ba ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Wo lɛ blɔ nɛ e ho, se e ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ wa se nyɛɛ!”

english_verse: The food you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.”
translation_verse: Pi nɔ́ nɛ yaa nɔ nya mi ɔ nɛ bleɔ nɔmlɔ; se mohu nɔ nɛ jee nɔ nya mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛ bleɔ nɔmlɔ.”

english_verse: Then his disciples came over to him and asked, “Do you know you insulted the Pharisees by what you said?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke: “O le kaa benɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ ɔ, e pee mɛ tai ɔ?”

english_verse: Peter replied, “What did you mean when you talked about the things that make people unclean?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Petro he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔ wɔ abɛ nɛ ɔ sisi!”

english_verse: Jesus then said: Don't any of you know by now what I am talking about?
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu ke: “Anɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ li ni kɛ mwɔɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know that the food you put into your mouth goes into your stomach and then out of your body?
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ kpa we si kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ yaa nɔ nya mi ɔ, muklii mi e sɛɛ nɛ a jeɔ woɔ agbotso mi lo?

english_verse: But the words that come out of your mouth come from your heart. And they are what make you unfit to worship God.
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ jee nya mi jee kpo ɔ, tsui mi a jee nɛ kɔlɔ ɔmɛ lɛ bleɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Out of your heart come evil thoughts, murder, unfaithfulness in marriage, vulgar deeds, stealing, telling lies, and insulting others.
translation_verse: Ejakaa tsui mi nɛ susumi yayahi, nɔmlɔ gbemi, gba puɛmihi, ajuama bɔmihi, jumihi, lakpa odase yemihi kɛ musu bɔmihi jee.

english_verse: These are what make you unclean. Eating without washing your hands will not make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Mark
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ bleɔ nɔmlɔ; se dɛ nɛ a fɔ we loko a yeɔ ni ɔ, lɔ ɔ ble we nɔ.” Yo ko hemi kɛ yemi (Marko

english_verse: Jesus said, “I was sent only to the people of Israel! They are like a flock of lost sheep.”
translation_verse: Se e he nɔ ke: “Israel we tohi nɛ laa amɛ a ngɔ kɛkɛ a tsɔ mi.”

english_verse: Large crowds came and brought many people who were paralyzed or blind or lame or unable to talk. They placed them, and many others, in front of Jesus, and he healed them all.
translation_verse: Nɛ asafo babauu ba e ngɔ nɛ a hɛɛ nihi nɛ a hule kɛ hɛ yuyuili kɛ amuɛtihi kɛ glɔtsɛmɛ kɛ ni kpahi fuu; nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba pue Yesu nane nya; nɛ e tsa mɛ.

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the territory near the towns of Tyre and Sidon.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Tiro kɛ Zidon ni ɔmɛ a mi ya.

english_verse: Suddenly a Canaanite woman from there came out shouting, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on me! My daughter is full of demons.”
translation_verse: Nɛ oʼɛ, Kanaanyo ko nɛ je lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi nɔuu ɔ ba kpa ngmlaa wo lɛ ke: “Naa mi mɔbɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ, David Bi; ye bi yo ngɛ nɔ nae kɛ mumi yayami.”

english_verse: The woman came closer. Then she knelt down and begged, “Please help me, Lord!”
translation_verse: Se yo ɔ ba ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi nɛ e ke: “Mawetsɛ, pee he eko ha mi!”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “It isn't right to take food away from children and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Se e he nɔ ke: “E dɛ kaa a ngɔɔ bimɛ abolo ɔ sakee fɔɔ he haa gbehi a bimɛ.”

english_verse: “Lord, this is true,” the woman said, “but even puppies get the crumbs that fall from their owner's table.”
translation_verse: Se e ke: “Mawetsɛ, e ngɛ mi ja mohu; se tse gbehi a bimɛ ɔmɛ hu yeɔ bibli nɛ pueɔ a nyɔmtsɛ ɔmɛ a kplɔɔ ɔ sisi ɔ eko!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Dear woman, you really do have a lot of faith, and you will be given what you want.” At that moment her daughter was healed. Jesus Heals Many People
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Oo, yo, o hemi kɛ yemi kle! A pee ha mo kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ!” Nɛ a tsa e bi yo ɔ ngɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu. Yesu tsa nihi fuu

english_verse: From there, Jesus went along Lake Galilee. Then he climbed a hill and sat down.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba Galilea Wo ɔ nya. Nɛ e kuɔ kɛ ya yoku ɔ nɔ nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at what they saw and heard. People who had never spoken could now speak. The lame were healed, the paralyzed could walk, and the blind were able to see. Everyone was praising the God of Israel. Jesus Feeds Four Thousand (Mark
translation_verse: Nɛ asafo ɔmɛ a nya kpɛ a he, benɛ a na kaa amuɛti ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue, nɛ glɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he mi wa mɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ a hule ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛ, nɛ hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ hyɛe ɔ, nɛ a wo Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami. Yesu ha nimli akpe eywiɛ niyeni (Marko

english_verse: Jesus called his disciples together and told them, “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry. They might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Yesu tsɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ba nɛ e ke: “Ye muklii mi ngɛ mi sae ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a he, kaa mwɔnɛ ji ligbi etɛ nɛ a kɛ mi hi si, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɛ a maa ye; nɛ i sume kaa ma wo mɛ blɔ kɛ hwɔ nɛ eko ɔ klibi ya po mɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: His disciples said, “This place is like a desert. Where can we find enough food to feed such a crowd?”
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke: “Jije wa ma na abolo nɛ hiɛ fuu ngɛ ngɛ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ, bɔ nɛ maa su asafo babauu nɛ ɔ nya?”

english_verse: Jesus asked them how much food they had. They replied, “Seven small loaves of bread and a few little fish.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu bi mɛ ke: “Abolo enyɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ?” A de lɛ ke: “Kpaago, kɛ lo tsɔwi bɔɔ ko.”

english_verse: After Jesus had told the people to sit down,
translation_verse: Nɛ e fa asafo ɔmɛ ke a hi si ngɛ zugba mi.

english_verse: he took the seven loaves of bread and the fish and gave thanks. He then broke them and handed them to his disciples, who passed them around to the crowds.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kukuɔ abolo kpaago ɔ kɛ lo ɔmɛ, nɛ e na si, nɛ e kuɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ha asafo ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone ate all they wanted, and the leftovers filled seven large baskets.
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛ tsuo a ye nɛ a tɔ; nɛ a kukuɔ bibli nɛ piɛ ɔ kusii kpaago nɛ a hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ.

english_verse: After Jesus had sent the crowds away, he got into a boat and sailed across the lake. He came to shore near the town of Magadan.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e wo asafo ɔ blɔ ɔ, e sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ e ba Magdala ni ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: Don't you know by now that I am not talking to you about bread? Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees!
translation_verse: Kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ ne nyɛ nɛ́ nya kaa pi abolo he je nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisifohi kɛ Sadukifo ɔmɛ a ma sasɛ ɔ he ɔ?”

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were near the town of Caesarea Philippi, he asked them, “What do people say about the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Se benɛ Yesu ba Kaisaria Filipi ni ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, e bi e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ nihi deɔ ke Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ji?”

english_verse: Finally, the disciples understood that Jesus wasn't talking about the yeast used to make bread, but about the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees. Who Is Jesus? (Mark
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ a kɔ se kaa pi abolo ma sasɛ ɔ he je nɛ e ke, a hɛ nɛ hi a he nɔ ɔ, se mohu Farisifohi kɛ Sadukifo ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ he je. Petro ye Yesu he odase (Marko

english_verse: He told them: If the sky is red in the evening, you say the weather will be good.
translation_verse: Se e he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Gbɔkuɛ mi ɔ nyɛ deɔ ke: ‘Je mi ma tsɔ, ejakaa hiɔwe tsu.’

english_verse: But if the sky is red and gloomy in the morning, you say it is going to rain. You can tell what the weather will be like by looking at the sky. But you don't understand what is happening now.
translation_verse: Nɛ mɔtu ɔ nyɛ deɔ ke: ‘Mwɔnɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ; ejakaa hiɔwe tsu nɛ e hɛ mi ha.’ Osatotsɛmɛ, nyɛ le hiɔwe je nihi a mi bumi, se yi nɔ omɛ a he okadi ɔmɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ bu lo?

english_verse: The disciples answered, “Some people say you are John the Baptist or maybe Elijah or Jeremiah or some other prophet.”
translation_verse: Se a de lɛ ke: “Ni komɛ deɔ ke Yohane, Baptisilɔ ɔ ʼi, nɛ ni komɛ hu deɔ ke Elia ʼi, nɛ ni kpahi komɛ deɔ ke Yeremia aloo gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ʼi.”

english_verse: From then on, Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “I must go to Jerusalem. There the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make me suffer terribly. I will be killed, but three days later I will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ, nɛ Yesu bɔni e kaseli ɔmɛ tsɔɔmi kaa ja e ya Yerusalem nɛ e ya na amanehlu babauu ngɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a gbe lɛ, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ nɛ a tle lɛ si ekohu.

english_verse: Jesus then warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ hɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisifohi kɛ Sadukifo ɔmɛ a mɛ sasɛ ɔ he!”

english_verse: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, “He must be saying this because we didn't bring along any bread.”
translation_verse: Se a tu he munyu ngɛ a kpɛti ke: “Abolo nɛ wa hɛɛ we ɔ he je!”

english_verse: The Son of Man will soon come in the glory of his Father and with his angels to reward all people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba ngɛ e tsɛ nyami ɔ mi kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ; nɛ lɛ be ɔ mi ɔ, e maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ e ni tsumi nya.

english_verse: So I will call you Peter, which means “a rock.” On this rock I will build my church, and death itself will not have any power over it.
translation_verse: Nɛ imi hu i ngɛ mo dee ke: Mo ji Petro ɔ nɛ, nɛ kikɛmɛ a tɛ sa nɛ ɔ nɔ ma fia ye safo ɔ ngɔ ma, nɛ gbeje agbo ɔmɛ be nyɛe e nɔ maa ye.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?”
translation_verse: E bi mɛ ke: “Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ mɛnɔ nyɛ deɔ ke i ji?”

english_verse: Simon Peter spoke up, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
translation_verse: Petro he nɔ ke: “Mo ji Kristo ɔ, Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ, bi ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus told him: Simon, son of Jonah, you are blessed! You didn't discover this on your own. It was shown to you by my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “A gbaa mo, Simon, Yona bi; ejakaa pi he lo kɛ muɔ nɛ je enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mo, se mohu Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ʼi.

english_verse: I will give you the keys to the kingdom of heaven, and God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth. But he will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma ngɔ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nya safe ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mo; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa fi ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa fi ngɛ hiɔwe; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa pɛne ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa pɛne ngɛ hiɔwe.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples not to tell anyone he was the Messiah. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Mark
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo e kaseli ɔmɛ si veveeve ke a ko de nɔ ko ke lɛ ji Yesu, Kristo ɔ. Yesu tu e gbenɔ kɛ e sitemi he munyu (Marko

english_verse: Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that. He said, “God would never let this happen to you, Lord!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Petro tsɛ lɛ kɛ ya se nɛ e bɔni lɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi ke: “Mawu nɛ ko ha nɛ enɛ ɔ nɛ ba o nɔ, Mawetsɛ, enɛ ɔ ya je ngɛ se lokoo!”

english_verse: Jesus turned to Peter and said, “Satan, get away from me! You're in my way because you think like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Se Yesu plɛ e he nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Jee ye nɔ, Satan! O ngɛ ye nane kpatae; ejakaa o susuu we Mawu nihi a he, se nimli a nihi a he mohu o susuu.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e kua e he nɛ e wo e sɛumi tso ɔ nɛ e nyɛɛ ye se?

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will find it.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ laa e klaa ngɛ ye he ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself? What would you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Ejakaa mɛni se nɔmlɔ ma na, ke e nine su je mluku ɔ tsuo nɔ, se e laa e klaa a? Aloo mɛni nɔmlɔ ma ngɔ ha nɛ e kɛ kpɔ e klaa?

english_verse: I promise you some of those standing here will not die before they see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Ni kome ngɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ a kpɛti nɛ a be gboe kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ e ma ngɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.”

english_verse: There in front of the disciples, Jesus was completely changed. His face was shining like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.
translation_verse: Nɛ e nɔmlɔ tso su tsake ngɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e hɛ mi kpɛ kaa pu, nɛ e tade ɔmɛ hiɛ kaa pu la.

english_verse: Then the disciples understood Jesus was talking to them about John the Baptist. Jesus Heals a Boy (Mark
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ kɔ se kaa Yohane, baptisilɔ ɔ, he munyu e kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ. Yesu tsa jokuɛ nyumuyo ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi (Marko

english_verse: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the brothers James and John with him. They went up on a very high mountain where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Ligbi ekpa se ɔ, Yesu ngɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ e nyɛmi Yohane, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya yoku nɛ ya hiɔwe ko nɔ, mɛ pɛ.

english_verse: All at once Moses and Elijah were there talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ oʼɛ, Mose kɛ Elia ba je a he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ngɛ munyu tue.

english_verse: So Peter said to him, “Lord, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Nɛ maa je Petro nya a, e de Yesu ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, e hi ha wɔ kaa waa hi hiɛ ɔ; ke o suɔ ɔ, ma pee bo tsuhi etɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, o nɔ kake, kɛ Mose nɔ kake, kɛ Elia nɔ kake.”

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the shadow of a bright cloud passed over them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, oʼɛ, bɔku hleii ko ba ha a nɔ, nɛ oʼɛ, gbi je bɔku ɔ mi de ke: “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji ye suɔmi bi nɛ i naa e he tsui ɔ nɛ; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue!”

english_verse: When the disciples heard the voice, they were so afraid they fell flat on the ground.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ nu ɔ, a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si, nɛ a ye gbeye wawɛɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus came over and touched them. He said, “Get up and don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu ba nɛ e ba pɛtɛ a he nɛ e ke: “Nyɛɛ te si, nyɛ ko ye gbeye!”

english_verse: When they opened their eyes, they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Se benɛ a wo a hɛ nɔ ɔ, a nɛ́ nɔ ko kaa ja Yesu nɔ kake pɛ.

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke: “Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ deɔ ke, ja Elia ba lolo ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Elijah certainly will come and get everything ready.
translation_verse: Se Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Elia ma niinɛ, nɛ e maa to nihi tsuo blɔ nɔ ekohu.

english_verse: In fact, he has already come. But the people did not recognize him and treated him just as they wanted to. They will soon make the Son of Man suffer in the same way.”

english_verse: The chief priests and leaders answered, “He will kill them in some horrible way. Then he will rent out his vineyard to people who will give him his share of grapes at harvest time.”
translation_verse: A de lɛ ke: “E ma kpata kikɛmɛ a nimli yayami nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi butuu, nɛ e maa ngɔ wain ngmɔ ɔ ngɔ ha huli kpahi apaa humi, nihi nɛ kɛ yiblii ma ba ha lɛ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You surely know that the Scriptures say, ‘The stone the builders tossed aside is now the most important stone of all. This is something the Lord has done, and it is amazing to us.’
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke: “Anɛ nyɛ kane we gblee ngɛ ngami ɔmɛ a mi ke: ‘Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsufiali ɔmɛ sake fɔ he ɔ, Kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ plɛ kɔ nya tɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi enɛ ɔ je, Nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ ngɛ wa hɛngmɛ mi.’

english_verse: I tell you God's kingdom will be taken from you and given to people who will do what he demands.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he je ɔ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: A ma kpɔ Mɛwu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ; nɛ a ma ngɔ ha majeli a ma ko nɛ woɔ yiblii. [

english_verse: Anyone who stumbles over this stone will be crushed, and anyone it falls on will be smashed to pieces.”
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nɔ tɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e mi ma tsɔtslɔɔ; se nɔ nɔ nɛ tɛ ɔ maa nɔ ɔ, e maa gblɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ.]”

english_verse: So they looked for a way to arrest Jesus. But they were afraid to, because the people thought he was a prophet.
translation_verse: Nɛ jinɛ a ngɛ hlae kaa a nu lɛ; se a ya ye asafo ɔmɛ gbeye ejakaa a buu lɛ gbalɔ.

translation_verse: Ejakaa a tsɛ nihi fuu mohu, se nihi bɔɔ ahla.” Oniatsumi he sane (Marko

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya da, bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a wo e nya tso kpɛ.

english_verse: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.
translation_verse: “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose de ke: ‘Ke nɔ ko gbo nɛ e be bimɛ ɔ, e nyɛmi nɛ ngɔ e yo ɔ, konɛ e wo nina ngɔ ha e nyɛmi ɔ.’

english_verse: Once again Jesus used stories to teach the people:
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu wo e nya nɔ nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu ekohu ngɛ abɛhi a mi ke:

english_verse: The kingdom of heaven is like what happened when a king gave a wedding banquet for his son.
translation_verse: “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa matsɛ ko nɛ ngmɛ yo kpeemi okplɔɔ ha e bi.

english_verse: The king sent some servants to tell the invited guests to come to the banquet, but the guests refused.
translation_verse: Nɛ e tsɔ e tsɔli ke a ya tsɛ nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ kɛ ba yo kpeemi ɔ he; se a mi bami.

english_verse: He sent other servants to say to the guests, “The banquet is ready! My cattle and prize calves have all been prepared. Everything is ready. Come to the banquet!”
translation_verse: E kpale tsɔ tsɔli kpahi nɛ e ke: ‘Nyɛ ya de nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ ke: oʼɛ, i gbe ye niyeni ɔmɛ a nya; a gbe ye na amɛ kɛ ye lohwe lɛlɛɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a gbe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya; nyɛɛ ba yo kpeemi ɔ he!’

english_verse: But the guests did not pay any attention. Some of them left for their farms, and some went to their places of business.
translation_verse: Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a bui po, nɛ a ngɔ a blɔhi, nɔ kake ho e ngmɔ mi ya, nɛ nɔ kpa hu ho e guɛyemi ya.

english_verse: Others grabbed the servants, then beat them up and killed them.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ nu e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a gbe mɛ.

english_verse: This made the king so furious that he sent an army to kill those murderers and burn down their city.
translation_verse: Se benɛ matsɛ ɔ nu ɔ, e mi mi fu, nɛ e tsɔ e aslaafohi, nɛ a ya gbe kikɛmɛ a awiyeli nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a sã a ma a.

english_verse: Then he said to the servants, “It is time for the wedding banquet, and the invited guests don't deserve to come.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke: ‘A to yo kpeemi ɔ he ni gbe nyɛ mohu, se nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ, a sɛ́.’

english_verse: Go out to the street corners and tell everyone you meet to come to the banquet.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ ya magbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na a, nyɛɛ kpee mɛ kɛ ba yo kpeemi ɔ he.

english_verse: When the king went in to meet the guests, he found that one of them wasn't wearing the right kind of clothes for the wedding.
translation_verse: “Se benɛ matsɛ ɔ ba ni ɔmɛ a hyɛmi ɔ, e ba na nɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ wui yo kpeemi tade;

english_verse: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers and finally to all seven of them.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu e tsa nɔ kɛ gu nɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya su nɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: They sent some of their followers and some of Herod's followers to say to him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest. You teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Nɛ a tsɔ a kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ Herodebi ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa le kaa anɔkualetsɛ ji mo, nɛ o tsɔɔ Mawu blɔ ɔ ngɛ anɔkuale mi, nɛ o hlɛ́ nimli a mi; ejakaa o hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi;

english_verse: Let me see one of the coins used for paying taxes.” They brought him a silver coin,
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ onia tsumi sika a nɛ tsɔɔ mi!” Nɛ a kɛ denario tsɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: “The Emperor's,” they answered. Then Jesus told them, “Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.”
translation_verse: A de lɛ ke: “Kaisare nɔ ʼi.” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Lɛɛ, ynyɛɛ ngɔ Kaisare nihi ngɔ ha Kaisare, nɛ Mawu ni ɔmɛ nyɛ ngɔ ha Mawu!”

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe people would rise to life after death. So that same day some of the Sadducees came to Jesus and said:
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ nɔuu ɔ, Sadukifohi nɛ deɔ ke ni gbogboehi a si temi ko be ɔ hu ba e ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke:

translation_verse: Se Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ngɛ tɔe, ejakaa nyɛ li ngmami ɔmɛ aloo Mawu he wami ɔ,

translation_verse: ejakaa ni gbogboehi a si temi ɔ mi ɔ a ngɔɛ yo, nɛ a kɛ yi ha we gba hulɔ; se mohu a ngɛ kaa Mawu bɔfohi ngɛ hiɔwe.

english_verse: And as for people being raised to life, God was speaking to you when he said,
translation_verse: Se ngɛ ni gbogboehi a si temi ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kane we nɔ nɛ Mawu de nyɛ ke:

english_verse: “I am the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” He isn't the God of the dead, but of the living.
translation_verse: ‘Imi lɛɛ, Abraham Mawu kɛ Isak Mawu kɛ Yakob Mawu ji mi’ ɔ? Mawu ɔ pi ni gbogboehi a Mawu, se mohu hɛkali a Mawu ʼi.”

translation_verse: Se benɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ nu kaa e ku Sadukifo ɔmɛ a nya a, a ba bua a he nya ngɛ he kake;

english_verse: “Teacher, what is the most important commandment in the Law?”
translation_verse: “Tsɔɔlɔ, te nɔ nɛ ji mlaa a mi kita ngua a nɛɛ?

english_verse: This is the first and most important commandment.
translation_verse: Kita amɛ a mi kekleekle nɔ kɛ ngua ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The second most important commandment is like this one. And it is, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ ngɛ kaa kɔlɔ ɔ ke: ‘Suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.’

english_verse: While the Pharisees were still there, Jesus asked them,
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a nya ba bua a, Yesu bi mɛ ke:

english_verse: ‘The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.’
translation_verse: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: Hii ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ Kɛ maa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o henyɛli ɔmɛ Ngɔ wo o nane si’ ɔ’?

english_verse: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose family will he come from?” They answered, “He will be a son of King David.”
translation_verse: “Kɛ nyɛ susuu ngɛ Kristo ɔ he kɛɛ? Mɛnɔ bi ji lɛ?” A de lɛ ke “David bi ʼi.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “How then could the Spirit lead David to call the Messiah his Lord? David said,
translation_verse: E bi mɛ ke “Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ David, ngɛ mumi ɔ nya a, tsɛɛ lɛ ‘Nyɔmtsɛ’ nɛ e deɔ ke:

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be a son of King David?”
translation_verse: “Jeha nɛ ɔ ke David tsɛ lɛ ‘Nyɔmtsɛ’ ɔ, kɛ peɔ kɛɛ nɛ e pa peɔ e bi mɔ?”

english_verse: No one was able to give Jesus an answer, and from that day on, no one dared ask him any more questions.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ ko nyɛ we lɛ heto ko nɛ e ha, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko kɛ́ lɛ nɔ́ ko bimi hu.

english_verse: And now your temple will be deserted.
translation_verse: oʼɛ, a ma si nyɛ we ɔ we doku ha nyɛ!

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: “Oo Yerusalem, Yerusalem, mo nɛ o gbee gbali ɔmɛ nɛ o fiaa nihi nɛ a tsɔ mɛ o ngɔ ɔ tɛ; si nyɛmɛ i hla kaa jinɛ i buaa o bimɛ a nya kaa bɔ nɛ kungwɔ buaa e bimɛ a nya woɔ e pɛlihi a sisi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kplɛɛ we!

english_verse: Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu tu munyu tsɔɔ asafo ɔmɛ kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke:

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law are experts in the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: “Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ ɔ, Mose sɛ ɔ nɔ a hii si ngɛ ɔ nɛ;

english_verse: So obey everything they teach you, but don't do as they do. After all, they say one thing and do something else.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ma de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ ye nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee; se a ni peemi ni ɔmɛ ɔ nyɛ ko pee; ejakaa a deɔ mohu se a pee we.

english_verse: They pile heavy burdens on people's shoulders and won't lift a finger to help.
translation_verse: Se a boɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ nɛ tloomi wa kɛ pueɔ nimli a konɔ; se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ, a sume kaa a kɛ a nguɛ kake tsɛɛ.

english_verse: Everything they do is just to show off in front of others. They even make a big show of wearing Scripture verses on their foreheads and arms, and they wear big tassels for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Se a nihi tsuo ɔ a peɔ konɛ nihi nɛ na. Ejakaa a haa a kaimi sɛbɛ ɔmɛ bliɔ nɛ a peɔ a tade nya fiami ɔmɛ nguahi;

english_verse: They love the best seats at banquets and the front seats in the synagogues.
translation_verse: nɛ a suɔ okplɔɔ yi himi ngɛ niyeni si, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi hehi ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ,

english_verse: And when they are in the market, they like to have people greet them as their teachers.
translation_verse: kɛ jua nɔ ngamihi, nɛ a suɔ nɛ nihi nɛ tsɛ mɛ: ‘Rabi, Rabi.’

english_verse: But none of you should be called a teacher. You have only one teacher, and all of you are like brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, a ko tsɛ nyɛ ‘Rabi’; ejakaa nɔ kake ji nyɛ tsɔɔlɔ, se nyɛ tsuo kulaa a nyɛmimɛ ji nyɛ.

english_verse: Don't call anyone on earth your father. All of you have the same Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ ko tsɛ nɔ ko nyɛ tsɛ hulɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ; ejakaa nɔ kake ji nyɛ tsɛ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.

english_verse: None of you should be called the leader. The Messiah is your only leader.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ a ko tsɛ nyɛ tsɔɔli hulɔ; ejakaa nɔ kake ji nyɛ tsɔɔlɔ, lɛ ji Kristo.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You lock people out of the kingdom of heaven. You won't go in yourselves, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: “Musu tloo nyɛ, mlaa tsɔɔli kɛ Farisifohi osatotsɛmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ guu sɔlemi gagahi a he lakpa tomi nɔ nyɛ mii yalɔyi a we ɔmɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ kojomi maa pe nine!]

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
translation_verse: “Musu tloo nyɛ, mlaa tsɔɔli kɛ Farisifohi, osatotsɛmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ bɔlee wo kɛ zugba kɛ kpee, konɛ nyɛ na nɔ kake ne e plɛ Yudafono; nɛ benɛ nɔ ɔ plɛ ja a, nyɛ peɔ lɛ abosiami bi si enyɔ pe nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.
translation_verse: “Musu tloo nyɛ, blɔt sɔɔli hɛ yuyuili, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke: ‘Nɔ nɛ ma ka sɔlemi tsu ɔ kita a, lɔ ɔ pi nɔ ko; se nɔ nɛ ma ka sɔlemi tsu ɔ he sika a kita a, e tloo musu?

english_verse: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
translation_verse: Kuasiahi kɛ hɛ yuyuili, te nɔ nɛ pe nɛɛ, sika a, aloo sɔlemi tsu ɔ nɛ haa sika a peɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ?

english_verse: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu: ‘Nɔ nɛ ma ka bɔ sami latɛ ɔ kita a, lɔ ɔ pi nɔ ko, se nɔ nɛ ma ka enɔ bɔ ɔ kita a, e tloo musu?

english_verse: Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
translation_verse: Hɛ yuyuili, te nɔ nɛ pe nɛɛ, bɔ ɔ, aloo bɔ sami latɛ ɔ nɛ haa bɔ ɔ peɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ?

english_verse: And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ nɛ kaa sɔlemi tsu ɔ kita a, e ka kɔlɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ hii mi ɔ kita.

english_verse: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ nɛ kaa hiɔwe kita a, e ka Mawu sɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ hu kita?

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your garden, such as mint, dill, and cumin. translation_verse: “Musu tloo nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli kɛ Farisifohi, osatotsɛmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ haa kowɛ kɛ anisi kɛ kumino mi dlami nyɔngma-nyɔngma se Mlaa a mi nihi nɛ he hia nɛ ji dami kojomi kɛ mɔbɔ nami kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mohu ɔ nyɛ siɔ; se jinɛ e da kaa nyɛ peɔ enɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ nyɛ ko si ekpa amɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: You blind leaders! You strain out a small fly but swallow a camel.

translation_verse: “Musu tloo nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli kɛ Farisifohi osatotsɛmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ ngɛ kaa yɔkɔhi nɛ a sa he nɛ a he pee fɛu mohu, sɛ a mi hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ ni gbogboehi a wuhi kɛ mu slɔɔtohi tsuo.

translation_verse: Ja nɔuu a naa nyɛ hu ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi kaa dali, se osato kɛ mlaa tɔmi hyi nyɛ mi tɔ.” Yesu gba Farisifo ɔmɛ a tuegblami (Luka

translation_verse: “Musu tloo nyɛ, mlaa tsɔɔli kɛ Farisifohi osatotsɛmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ maa gbali ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ dlaa dali ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ,

translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke: ‘E ji wa tsɛmɛ a yi nɔ ɔ wa ngɛ je mi jinɛ, wa be a he piɛe nɛ a pue gbali ɔmɛ a muɔ si.’

english_verse: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.

translation_verse: Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ wo nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a tsimi ɔ fuu tɔ mɔ!

translation_verse: Sinɔhi kɛ si kpali a nina! Kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ tu abosiami a je fɔbu ɔ nya fo kɛɛ?

translation_verse: Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Suɔmi nɛ Yesu ngɛ kɛ ha Yerusalem (Luka

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, benɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ tu munyu se ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya nɛ we ya hi si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ.

translation_verse: Pee se ɔ e je e he kpo tsɔɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ nitsɛ, benɛ a hii si ngɛ niye ni he ɔ, nɛ e ka a hɛ mi ngɛ hemi nɛ a he we yi kɛ a tsui wami ɔ he, ejakaa a he we nihi nɛ na lɛ ngɛ e sitemi ɔ se ɔ yi.

translation_verse: Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ya je ɔ tsuo kulaa mi nɛ nyɛ ya fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a bɔ ɔ.

translation_verse: Se okadihi nɛ maa nyɛɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔmɛ a se ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Ye biɛ mi ɔ, sa maa hia mumi yayamihi; a maa tu munyu hehi;

translation_verse: Akɛnɛ nihi fuu kɔ fɔ a nɔ kaa a maa ngma sanehi nɛ ba mi ngɛ wa kpɛti ɔ,
