translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ na kɛ a hɛngmɛ kɛ je sisije nɛ a ji munyu ɔ he sɔmɔli ɔmɛ fie tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ,

english_verse: So I made a careful study of everything and then decided to write and tell you exactly what took place. Honorable Theophilus,
translation_verse: e sa ye hɛ mi kaa imi hu, nɛ i hla lɛ tsuo mi fitsofitso kɛ je sisije ɔ, ma ngma pɛpeepɛ ha mo, Teofilo kpakpa;

english_verse: I have done this to let you know the truth about what you have heard. An Angel Tells about the Birth of John
translation_verse: kone o na munyuhi nɛ a tsɔɔ mo ɔ mi anɔkuale. Yohane Baptisilɔ ɔ fɔmi he siwomi

english_verse: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest by the name of Zechariah from the priestly group of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was from the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ Herode yinɔ ɔ, osɔfo ko hi si nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zakaria nɛ je Abia osɔfohi a weku ɔ mi; nɛ e yo ɔ je Aaron bimɛ yi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e biɛ ji Elisabet.

english_verse: Both of them were good people and pleased the Lord God by obeying all that he had commanded.
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔ tsuo ɔ dali ji mɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a yeɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kitahi kɛ e mlaa amɛ kulaa nɔ, nɛ piami ko be a he.

english_verse: But they did not have children. Elizabeth could not have any, and both Zechariah and Elizabeth were already old.
translation_verse: Se a be bi, ejakaa Elisabet ɔ yosa ʼi, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔ tsuo a bwɔ.

english_verse: One day Zechariah's group of priests were on duty, and he was serving God as a priest.
translation_verse: Bene Zakaria ngɛ ni tsue kaa osɔfo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi

english_verse: According to the custom of the priests, he had been chosen to go into the Lord's temple that day and to burn incense,
translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ osɔfo yemi blɔnya tomi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, e ba mi kaa a hla lɛ kaa e ya Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi nɛ e ya sa tsopa kɛ e he via,

english_verse: All at once an angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah at the right side of the altar.
translation_verse: Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e daa si ngɛ tsopa kɛ e he via sami latɛ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Zechariah was confused and afraid when he saw the angel.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Zakaria na lɛ ɔ, e tsui po nɛ e ye gbeye.

english_verse: But the angel told him: Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayers. Your wife Elizabeth will have a son, and you must name him John.
translation_verse: Se bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Koo ye gbeye, Zakaria, ejakaa a bu o pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue, nɛ o yo Elisabet ma fɔ bi nyumu ha mo, nɛ o wo lɛ biɛ Yohane.

english_verse: His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad.
translation_verse: E maa pee mo buajɔmi kɛ nyami, nɛ nihi fuu ma nya e fɔmi ɔ he.

english_verse: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e maa pee nɔ ngua ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ e be wai loo da nɛ nya wa ko nue, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ma hyi lɛ tɔ kɛ maa je e nyɛ muklii mi lokoo.

english_verse: John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Nɛ e maa kpale Israelbi ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu kɛ maa ba Nyɔmtsɛ, a Mawu ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: He will go ahead of the Lord with the same power and spirit that Elijah had. And because of John, parents will be more thoughtful of their children. And people who now disobey God will begin to think as they ought to. This is how John will get people ready for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ e maa sɛ e hlami ngɛ Elia mumi kɛ e hewami mi, nɛ e ya dɔ tsɛmɛ a tsui kɛ ba a bimɛ a he, kɛ tue gboli kɛ ba dali a ni lemi mi, nɛ e dla ma a ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Zechariah said to the angel, “How will I know this is going to happen? My wife and I are both very old.”
translation_verse: Zakaria de bɔfo ɔ ke: “Mɛni i kɛ maa le enɛ ɔ? Ejakaa imi lɛɛ nɔmoyo ji mi, nɛ ye yo hu bwɔ.”

english_verse: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔfo ɔ ha lɛ heto ke: “Imi ji Gabriel nɛ daa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ nɛ, nɛ a tsɔ mi ke ma ba de mo nɛ ma sɛɛ Sane Kpakpa nɛ ɔ ha mo.

english_verse: You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.”
translation_verse: Nɛ oʼɛ, o nya ma ma nɛ o be nyɛe munyu tumi kɛ maa su ligbi nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi, ejakaa o he we munyu ɔmɛ nɛ maa ba mi ngɛ a be mi ɔ yi.”

english_verse: The crowd was waiting for Zechariah and kept wondering why he was staying in the temple so long.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma a ngɛ Zakaria mlɛe, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa akɛnɛ e se ya kɛ ngɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.
translation_verse: Se bene e je kpo e nyɛ we nɛ e kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu, nɛ a kɔ se kaa e ya na nɔ́ ko ngɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi. E fɔ mɛ nine se e nyɛ we munyu nɛ e tu.

english_verse: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e sɔmɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ a nya ta a, e je kɛ ho lɛ nitse e we ɔ mi ya.

english_verse: Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself,
translation_verse: Nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a se ɔ, e yo Elisabet ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e laa e he hlami enuɔ nɛ e ke:

english_verse: “What the Lord has done for me will keep people from looking down on me.” An Angel Tells about the Birth of Jesus
translation_verse: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ je ye zo ɔ ngɛ nimli a kpɛti.” Yesu fɔmi he gbami

english_verse: One month later God sent the angel Gabriel to the town of Nazareth in Galilee
translation_verse: Hlami nɛ ji ekpa a nɔ ɔ, Mawu tsɔ bɔfo Gabriel kɛ ya Galilea ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Nazaret ɔ mi,

english_verse: with a message for a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to Joseph from the family of King David.
translation_verse: ngɛ zangmayo ko nɛ a bi e si ha nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yosef nɛ je David weku ɔ mi ɔ ngɔ. Zangmayo ɔ biɛ ji Maria.

english_verse: The angel greeted Mary and said, “You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.”
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔfo ɔ ba e ngɔ nɛ e ke: “Mo he manye, mo nɔ nɛ a dloo mo, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ mo ngɛ!”

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Se benɛ e nu ɔ, e tsui po, nɛ e susu ke mɛni ngami ji nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Se bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Koo ye gbeye, Maria, ejakaa o hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.
translation_verse: Bu tue, lo ma na muklii nɛ o ma fɔ bi nyumu, nɛ o wo lɛ biɛ Yesu.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: E maa pee nɔmlɔ ngua, nɛ a ma tsɛ lɛ Hiɔweno ɔ bi, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu maa ngɔ e tsɛ David matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e maa ye Yakob we ɔ nɔ matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe.”

english_verse: Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
translation_verse: Maria bi bɔfo ɔ ke: “Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ enɛ ɔ maa ba mi? I li nyumu.”

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔfo ɔ ha lɛ heto ke: “Mumi Klɔuklɔu maa ba o nɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ jamɛ a bi klɔuklɔu ɔ hu nɛ o ma fɔ ɔ, a ma tsɛ lɛ Mawu bi.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Nɛ oʼɛ, o wekuno Elisabet ɔ hu ngɔ bi nyumu hɔ ngɛ e bwɔmi si, nɛ nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ yosa a na hlami ekpa.

english_verse: Nothing is impossible for God!”
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko wɛ́ hi Mawu.”

english_verse: Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
translation_verse: Nɛ Maria ke: “Oʼɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ weyo ji mi, e ba mi ngɛ o munyu ɔ nya!” Nɛ bɔfo ɔ si lɛ. Maria ya slaa Elisabet

english_verse: A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea.
translation_verse: Nɛ Maria te si ngɛ lɛ jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ e pue nɔ oya kɛ ho Yudea ma ko ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ mi ya,

english_verse: She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth.
translation_verse: nɛ e ya sɛ Zakaria we ɔ mi nɛ e nga Elisabet.

english_verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ Elisabet nu Maria ngami ɔ, bimwɔyo ɔ hua ngɛ e mi mi; nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hyi Elisabet tɔ.

english_verse: Then in a loud voice she said to Mary: God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke: “A gbaa mo ngɛ yihi a ti, nɛ a gbaa o mi mi bi ɔ!

english_verse: Why should the mother of my Lord come to me?
translation_verse: Nɛ jije enɛ ɔ je kɛ ba ha mi nɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ nyɛ ma ye ngɔ nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.
translation_verse: Se oʼɛ, amlɔ pɛ nɛ o ngami ɔ pɛ ngɛ ye tue mi ɔ, bimwɔyo ɔ kɛ nyami hua ngɛ ye muklii mi.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Nɛ sa gbaa mo, mo nɔ nɛ o he ye kaa munyuhi nɛ a je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ba de ɔ maa ba mi ɔ.” Maria yijemi la

english_verse: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Nɛ Maria ke: “Ye klaa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ agboje ɔ fiɛe,

english_verse: and I am glad because of God my Savior.
translation_verse: Nɛ ye mumi ngɛ Mawu ye yiwami-helɔ ɔ yi jee,

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: Kaa e kai e weyo humi nɛ e ji ɔ, Ejakaa oʼɛ, kɛ je mwɔ nɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, yi nɔhi kulaa maa gbaa mi.

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Ope ɔ pee ni nguahi ha mi; Nɛ klɔuklɔu ji e biɛ ɔ,

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: E kɛ e nine tsu hewami ni tsumi; Nihi nɛ woɔ a he ngɛ a tsui mi susumi mi ɔ, e gbɛ mɛ fia.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: E kpa hewali kɛ je a sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, Nɛ e wo nihi nɛ ji humi ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: E ha hwɔ hwɔli tɔ kɛ ni kpakpahi, Nɛ he nali ɔmɛ ɔ, e fie mɛ kɛ ho dɛ gu.

english_verse: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.
translation_verse: E ye bua e wenyumu Israel, Konɛ e kai e mɔbɔ nami ɔmɛ,

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ e de wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, Kɛ ha Abraham kɛ e nina kɛ yaa neneene ɔ.”

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Nɛ Maria kɛ Elisabet hi si maa pee hlami ete, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho e ma a mi ya. Yohane Baptisilɔ ɔ fɔmi

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e pakabi kɛ e wekuli nu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na lɛ mɔbɔ babauu ɔ, a kɛ lɛ nya.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ, a ba bimwɔyɔ ɔ pomi, nɛ jinɛ a kɛ e tsɛ biɛ Zakaria a yaa wo lɛ.

english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: Se e nyɛ he nɔ nɛ e de ke: “Dɛbi, se a wo lɛ Yohane mohu!”

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Nɔ ko be o weku ɔ mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ja!”

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Nɛ a kɛ a nine pee okadi kɛ bi e tsɛ bɔ nɛ e suɔ nɛ a tsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed.
translation_verse: Nɛ e bi tso sleeti ko, nɛ e ngma ngɛ nɔ ke: “Yohane ji e biɛ.” Nɛ e pee mɛ tsuo nyakpɛ.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Nɛ gbeye nu e pakabi ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a tu ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo he munyu ngɛ Yudea yoku ɔmɛ kulaa nɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nu ɔ ngɔ to a yi mi nɛ a ke: “Mɛni po jokuɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee? Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nine ngɛ e nɔ. Zakaria gbami

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Nɛ e tsɛ Zakaria hyi gbagbaagba kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu, nɛ e gba de ke:

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: “A gbaa Nyɔmtsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, Kaa de ba slaa e ma a, nɛ e tsu Kpɔmi nihi ha mɛ,

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: Nɛ e tle yi wami hemi koli si Ngɔ ha wɔ ngɛ e wenyumu David we ɔ,

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ e de kɛ je blema lokoo ngɛ e gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nya a;

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: Ke e ma he wa yi wami kɛ maa je Wa henyɛli kɛ nihi nɛ wa he tsɛɛ mɛ ɔ a dɛ mi;

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: Nɛ e na wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ. Nɛ e kai e somi klɔuklɔu ɔ,

english_verse: He told our ancestor Abraham
translation_verse: Kita nɛ e ka wa tsɛ Abraham ɔ,

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: Ke e ma ha a je wɔ kɛ je wa henyɛli a dɛ mi, Nɛ wa sɔmɔ lɛ nɛ gbeye yemi ko ko hi mi,

english_verse: by being holy and good as long as we live.
translation_verse: Ngɛ he tsɔmi kɛ dami mi Ngɛ e hɛ mi wa ligbihi abɔ tsuo

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Nɛ mo, jokuɛ nɛ ɔ, A ma tsɛ mo hiɔwe lokoono ɔ gbalɔ; Ejakaa o maa sɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hlami Nɛ o ya dla e blɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ to lɛ,

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Konɛ o ngɔ yi wami hemi he ni lemi Ngɔ ha e ma a ngɛ a he yayami mi,

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: Ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ mɔbɔ nami Nɛ haa e mi mi saa lɛ ɔ nya, Nɔ́ nɛ ha je nami nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ ba slaa wɔ nɛ ɔ,

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: Konɛ je mi nɛ tsɔ ha nihi Nɛ hii si ngɛ diblii gbenɔ hɔ mi ɔ, Nɛ e plɛ wa nane kɛ ya he jɔmi blɔ ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɛ jokuɛ ɔ ba wa, nɛ e he wa ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ e hi nga a nɔ kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Israel.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e ba mi kaa hiɔngɔ ko je Kaisare Augusto ngɔ ba ke a kane je ɔ tsuo nɛ a ngma.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ nyumu ko ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simeon; nɛ lɛ nyumu ɔ dalɔ ji lɛ nɛ e yee Mawu gbeye; e ngɛ Israel bua jɔmi ɔ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ngɛ e nɔ.

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji kekleekle nɔ kanemi nɛ ba nɔ be mi nɛ Kirenio ngɛ amlaalo yee ngɛ Siria a.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke: Ke a ji hiɔwe fɔ we nɔ ko ɔ, e be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nae.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke: “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuɛle mi ke: Ke a ji nyu kɛ Mumi mi fɔ we nɔ ko ɔ, e be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi nyɛe maa sɛ.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ a je he lo mi fɔ ɔ, he lo ʼi; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a je Mumi mi fɔ ɔ, Mumi ʼi.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: O hɛ mi ko pee mo yaa kaa i de mo enɛ ɔ ke: ‘Ja a je hiɔwe fɔ nyɛ’ ɔ.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, he nɛ e suɔ e fiaa kɛ yaa, nɛ e fiami o nuɔ, se o li he nɛ e jee kɛ he nɛ e yaa: ja ji nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a je Mumi mi fɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Tse Israel tsɔɔlɔ ji mo nɛ o li enɛ ɔmɛ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ́ nɛ wa le ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ wa deɔ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa na a, kɔlɔ ɔ he odase wa yeɔ, se nyɛ ngɔɛ wa odase ɔ.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Ke i de nyɛ zugba nɔ nihi nɛ nyɛ he we yi ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ ke ide nyɛ hiɔwe nihi ɔ nɛ nyɛ ma he ye?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko kue kɛ yɛ hiɔwe, kaa ja nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kple si ɔ, Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.”

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔ nɛ Mose wo sinɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu sa kaa a wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ hɛ mi ko kpata, se mohu e na neneene wami.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu suɔ je ɔ saminya, nɛ e ngɔ e bi kake ɔ ngɔ ha, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ hɛ mi ko kpata, se mohu e na neneene wami.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu tsɔɛ e bi ɔ kɛ bɛ je ɔ mi konɛ e ba kojo je ɔ, se mohu konɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ he je ɔ yi wami.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ, a kojo we lɛ, se nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ, a kojo lɛ momo, ejakaa e he we Mawu bi kake ɔ nɔ yi.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Se kojomi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa la a ba je ɔ mi, nɛ nimli suɔ diblii ɔ mohu pe la a, ejakaa a ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ yayami ʼi;

translation_verse: Nɛ a ba Yohane ngɔ nɛ a ba de lɛ ke: “Rabi, nɔ nɛ kɛ mo hi Yordan se nɛ o ye e he odase ɔ, oʼɛ, lɛ nitse e ngɛ baptisie, nɛ nihi tsuo ngɛ e ngɔ yae.”

translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ji ayɛflo ɔ, lɛ ji ayɛflo huno; se ayɛflo huno ɔ huɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lɛ tue bue ɔ, nya e nyaa ngɛ ayɛflo huno ɔ gbi he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ye kikɛmɛ a nyami nɛ ɔ ba mi.

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e na nɛ e nu ɔ, lɔ ɔ he odase e yeɔ; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔɛ e odase ɔ.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e odase ɔ yeɔ ɔ maa nɔ mi kaa anɔkualetsɛ ji Mawu.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ ɔ, Mawu munyu e tuɔ; ejakaa Mawu haa lɛ e Mumi ɔ faa.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Tsɛ ɔ suɔ Bi ɔ, nɛ e tu nihi kulaa ngɔ wo e dɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ heɔ Bi ɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ, e ngɛ neneene wami; se nɔ nɛ bui Bi ɔ tue ɔ, e be wami nae, se mohu Mawu mi mi fumi hii e nɔ.

english_verse: Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again.
translation_verse: e je Yudea nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ yaa Galilea ekohu.

translation_verse: Se ja e gu Samaria.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Samaria yo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ mo Yudano ɔ, o ngɛ mi Samariano ɔ nyu bae nɛ o nu ɔ?”

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Yo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, o be nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ maa yɛ, nɛ vu ɔ hu mi kuɔ; jije o ma na wami nyu ɔ kɛ je mɔ?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Anɛ o pe wa tsɛ Yakob nɛ ha wɔ vu nɛ ɔ, nɛ lɛ nitse e nu mi nyu, kɛ e bimɛ kɛ e lohwe ɔmɛ ɔ lo?”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: se nɔ nɛ nuu nyu nɛ imi ma ha lɛ ɔ, kuma be lɛ yee gblee kɛ maa ya neneene; se mohu nyu nɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ ma plɛ nyu hɛngmɛ nɛ baa kɛ yaa neneene wami mi ngɛ e mi.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Yo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha mi nyu ɔ eko kone kuma ko ye mi, nɛ i ba hiɛ ɔ ba yɛ nyu hu.”

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: ejakaa o hi hunomɛ enuɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ o kɛ ngɛ piɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, pi o huno; enɛ ɔ lɛɛ o tu anɔkuale.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, i na kaa gbalɔ ji mo.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Yoku nɛ ɔ nɔ wa tsɛmɛ sɔle ngɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ke Yerusalem ji he nɛ sa kaa a sɔle ngɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke: “Maa, he mi ngɔ ye kaa ngmlɛfia a ma nɛ pi yoku nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ pohu pi Yerusalem nɛ nyɛ ma ja Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ li nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ jae ɔ; wɔɔ lɛɛ, wa le nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ jae ɔ, ejakaa yi wami hemi ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ a ngɔ e je.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Se ngmlɛfia a ma nɛ e su momo benɛ anɔkuale jali ɔmɛ ma ja Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi kɛ anɔkuale mi, ejakaa nihi nɛ jaa lɛ kikɛ ɔ Tsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ hlae.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Mawu ɔ Mumi ji lɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, ja a ja lɛ ngɛ mumi kɛ anɔkuale mi.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Yo ɔ de lɛ ke: “I le kaa Mesia nɛ e tsɛɛ lɛ Kristo ɔ ma; nɛ ke e ba a, e maa sɛɛ wɔ nihi tsuo kulaa.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke: “Imi nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ munyu tue nɛ ɔ, ami ʼi.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa kaa e kɛ yo ngɛ munyu tue; se kɛ ɔ nɔ ko bi we lɛ ke: “Mɛni o ngɛ lɛ bie ɔ?” loo “Mɛni munyu o kɛ lɛ ngɛ tue ɔ?”

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ si e paya buɛ ɔ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho ma a mi ya, nɛ e ya de ni ɔmɛ ke:

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ nyumu ko nɛ jaje nihi tsuo nɛ i pee ɔ ngɔ ha mi, kaa pi Kristo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?”

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a je ma a mi nɛ a ba e ngɔ.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Lɛ be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke: “Rabi, ye nɔ́ ko.”

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Se e de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ ngma nɛ i yeɔ nɛ nyɛ li.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ bi a he ke: “Anɛ nɔ ko ba ha lɛ nɔ́ ko ye lo?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke: “Ye ngma ji kaa ma pee nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ni, nɛ ma gbe e ni tsumi ɔ nya.”

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: “Anɛ nyɛ de we ke: ‘Epiɛ hlami eywiɛ nɛ blɛfo kpɔmi be maa su’? oʼɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛ wo nyɛ hɛ nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ a gba futaa momo ha ni kpami.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kpaa a naa e hiɔwo, nɛ e kpaneɔ yiblii ɔmɛ a nya ngɔ toɔ neneene wami, konɛ nɔ nɛ duɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ kpaa a tsuo a nya si kake.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”

translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i tsɔ nyɛ konɛ nyɛ yakpa nɔ́ nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ gbo he dengme; ni kpahi tsu ni ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba ye mi ni.”

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”

translation_verse: Matsɛ wenyumu ɔ de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ba loko ye bi ɔ nɛ gbo.”

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɛ ɔ kɛ na kaa lɛ ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “O bi ɔ he mi wa lɛ” ɔ; nɛ e kɛ e we ɔ tsuo he ye.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Yesu na lɛ nɛ e fɔɔ si, nɛ e le kaa e se kɛ hluu ɔ, e bi lɛ ke: “O suɔ kaa o na he wami lo?”

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Hiɔtsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke: “Mawetsɛ, i be nɔ ko nɛ ke a ba klɛ nyu ɔ mi nɛ e ma wo mi ya fɔ taku ɔ mi; se ke i yaa a, nɔ kpa sɛɛ ye hlami ya nɔɔ mi.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke: “Tee si, wo o sa a nɛ o nyɛɛ!”

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ he mi wa lɛ, nɛ e wo e sa a, nɛ e nyɛɛ. Se lɛ ligbi ɔ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ʼi.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ de nɔ nɛ a tsa a ke: “Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; o be he blɔ kaa o tloɔ o sa.”

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: E he nɔ ke: “Nɔ nɛ tsa mi ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ de mi ke: ‘Wo o sa a nɛ o nyɛɛ.’ ”

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ a bi lɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ de mo ke: ‘Wo o sa a nɛ o nyɛɛ’ ɔ?”

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ a tsa a li nɔ nɛ ji, ejakaa nihi fuu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he je ɔ Yesu sã e he si.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ Yesu ya na lɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, o na he wami; koo pee yayami hu, kone nɔ́ ko yaya nɛ pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ ko ba o nɔ.”

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya sɛɛ ha Yudafo ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji nɔ nɛ tsa lɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ je a hɛ ka Yesu, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe, ejakaa Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ e pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Se Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛ ngɛ ni tsue kɛ mwɔɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ ni tsue.”

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he titli Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ nɛ, ejaksaa pi Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e ble, se mohu e tsɛ Mawu ke lɛ nitse e tsɛ, nɛ e kɛ Mawu sɔ. Bi ɔ he blɔ nɛ e ngɛ

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Bi ɔ nitse be e yi mi nyɛe maa to kɛ pee nɔ ko, ja nɔ nɛ se naa kaa Tsɛ ɔ peɔ ɔ; ejakaa nihi tsuo nɛ Tsɛ ɔ peɔ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu Bi ɔ hu peɔ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ suɔ Bi ɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ lɛ nihi kulaa nɛ lɛ nitse e peɔ ɔ, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ lɛ ni tsumi nguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ tete, nɛ nyɛ nya maa kpɛ nyɛ he.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Ejakaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tleɔ ni gbogboehi a si nɛ e haa mɛ wami ɔ, ja kɛ̃ Bi ɔ hu haa nihi nɛ e suɔ ɔ wami.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ kojo we nɔ ko, se e tu kojomi ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo Bi ɔ dɛ;

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: konɛ nihi tsuo bu Bi ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a buu Tsɛ ɔ. Nɔ nɛ bui Bi ɔ, e bui Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ nɛ nuɔ ye munyu nɛ e heɔ nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, e ngɛ neneene wami, nɛ e be kojomi mi yae, se mohu e po mi ngɛ gbenɔ mi kɛ ho wami mi ya.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Ngmlɛfia a ma, nɛ e su ta, nɛ ni gbogboe ɔmɛ maa nu Mawu Bi ɔ gbi, nɛ nihi nɛ nuɔ ɔ yi ma na wa.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Ejakaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ wami ngɛ lɛ nitse e mi ɔ, ja kɛ̃ e ha Bi ɔ hu ke e hi wami ngɛ lɛ nitse e mi.

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ha lɛ he blɔ kaa e kojo hulɔ, ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ji lɛ.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ko pee nyɛ nyakpɛ; ejakaa ngmlɛfia a ma, nɔ́ mi nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ maa nu e gbi,

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
translation_verse: nɛ a maa je kpo, nihi nɛ pee kpakpa a maa te si kɛ maa ya wami mi, nɛ nihi nɛ tsu ni yayahi ɔ maa te si kɛ maa ya kojomi mi.” Yesu he odasefohi

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: “Imi nitse i be ye yi mi nyɛe maa to kɛ pee nɔ ko; bɔ nɛ i nuɔ ɔ, ja i kojoɔ, nɛ ye kojomi ɔ dami kojomi ʼi, ejakaa i hia we nɔ́ nɛ imi nitsɛ i suɔ, se mohu nɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔ?

english_verse: If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Ke imi nitsɛ ye he odase i yeɔ ɔ, ye odase ɔ pi anɔkuale.

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: Nɔ kpa ko ngɛ nɛ yeɔ ye he odase, nɛ i le kaa e odase nɛ e yeɔ ngɛ ye he ɔ anɔkuale ʼi!

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsɔ kɛ ya Yohane ngɔ, nɛ e ye anɔkuale ɔ he odase.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i ngɔɛ nɔmlɔ ko odase; se benɛ pee nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami he je i ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ dee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Yohane ji kane nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ ngɛ kpee ɔ nɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ be kpiti kɛkɛ ngɛ e la a mi.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ, i ngɛ odase nɛ pe Yohane nɔ ɔ, ejakaa ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi kaa ma gbe nya a, lɛ ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ nɔuu yeɔ ye he odase kaa Tsɛ ɔ lɛ tsɔ mi.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ye ye he odase. Nyɛ nui e gbi hyɛ ɔ, pohu nyɛ nɛ e subai hyɛ;

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,
translation_verse: Nyɛ hla ngmami ɔmɛ a mi; ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ susuu kaa kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a mi nyɛ naa neneene wami ngɛ, nɛ kɔlɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu ji nihi nɛ yeɔ ye he odase ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ baa ye ngɔ nɛ nyɛ na wami.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
translation_verse: “I hla we nimli a hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: but I do know that none of you love God.
translation_verse: Se mohu i kpa nyɛ si kaa nyɛ be Mawu suɔmi ngɛ nyɛ mi.

english_verse: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i ba ngɛ Tsaatsɛ biɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ he we mi; ke nɔ kpa ko ba ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ma he lɛ.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hɛ mi nyɛmi he hae ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, se hɛ mi nyami nɛ jee Mawu kake too ɔ ngɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ di se ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ he ye mɔ?

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko susu kaa ma po nyɛ nya ngɔ ha Tsɛ ɔ; nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ nya poe, lɛ ji Mose, nɔ nɛ nɔ nɔuu nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Se kaa nya he Mose ye jinɛ, imi hu nyɛ ma he mi ye; ejakaa ye he sane e ngma a nɛ.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ he we e ngmami ɔmɛ yi ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma he ye munyu ɔmɛ maa ye mɔ?”

english_verse: The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a bua ngma abolo enuɔ bibli nɛ a ye piɛ ɔ nya wo kusii nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi tɔtɔɔtɔ.

english_verse: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed. The Bread That Gives Life
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a suɔ kaa a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba lɛ ɔ mi; nɛ amlɔ ɔ, lɛ ɔ ya kple ngɛ he nɛ a yaa a. Ni ɔmɛ hla Yesu

english_verse: They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a bi lɛ ke: “Lɛɛ mɛni okadi o peɔ nɛ waa na konɛ wa he mo ngɔ ye? Mɛni o tsuɔ?

english_verse: No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e maa ba ye ngɔ, kaa ja Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ gbla lɛ lolo, nɛ imi lɛɛ ma tle lɛ si ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: “There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
translation_verse: “Jokuɛ nyumuyo ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ngma abolo enuɔ kɛ lo tsɔwi enyɔ; se nihi fuu nɛ ɔ, jije enɛ ɔ maa su ha mɛ?”

english_verse: The ground was covered with grass, and Jesus told his disciples to tell everyone to sit down. About
translation_verse: Se Yesu ke: “Nyɛ ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ a hi si.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumuhi nɛ a yibɔ maa su akpe enuɔ ɔ be ya hi si.

english_verse: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them,
translation_verse: nɛ a ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ a ngɛ wo ɔ poe kɛ yaa Kapernaum. Se nɛ diblii wo nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, Yesu bɛ́ a ngɔ.

english_verse: Jesus crossed Lake Galilee, which was also known as Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho Galilea Wo nɛ ji Tiberia Wo ɔ se ya.

english_verse: A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi fuu nyɛɛ e se, ejakaa a na okadihi nɛ e pee ngɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Jewish festival of Passover, and Jesus went up on a mountain with his disciples and sat down.
translation_verse: Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a nyami ligbi ɔ su ta.

english_verse: Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
translation_verse: Filipo he nɔ ke: “Cedi lafa enyɔ nya abolo be mɛ sue, bɔ nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na nyamiwo bɔ kakaaka po.”

english_verse: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said,
translation_verse: E kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, Andrea, nɛ ji Simon Petro nyɛmi ɔ, de lɛ ke:

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kukuɔ abolo ɔmɛ, nɛ benɛ e na si ɔ, e dla ngɔ ha nihi nɛ hii si ɔmɛ kɛ lo ɔ hu eko, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae.

english_verse: The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted.
translation_verse: Benɛ a tɔ ɔ, ɔ de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ bua bibli nɛ piɛ ɔ nya konɛ nɔ́ ko ko laa.”

english_verse: Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone. Jesus Walks on the Water (Matthew
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu yo kaa a maa ba nɛ a ba nu lɛ ka nya nɛ a ya wo lɛ matsɛ ɔ, e nɔ kake e sã e he si kɛ ho yoku ɔ nɔ ya ekohu? Yesu nyɛɛ nyu hɛ mi (Mateo

english_verse: The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day
translation_verse: Je na nɔ ɔ, asafo nɛ daa si ngɛ wo ɔ se ɔ na kaa lɛ kpa ko be lejɛ ɔ hu, nɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ sɛ we lɛ ɔ mi, se mohu e kaseli ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho.

english_verse: Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko tsu ngma nɛ puɛɛ ɔ he ni, se mohu nyɛ tsu ngma nɛ hii si kɛ yaa neneene wami mi nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma ha nyɛ ɔ he ni, ejakaa lɛ e nya Tsɛ Mawu ɔ sɔu.”

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: A ngma ngɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔ mi ke: ‘Mɛ tsuo kulaa a maa pee nihi nɛ Mawu tsɔɔ mɛ ni.’ Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ Tsɛ ɔ munyu nɛ e kaseɔ hulɔ ɔ, baa ye ngɔ.

english_verse: They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ sa nya ngɛ a kpɛti ke: “Kɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ ngɔ e he lo ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ waa ye ɔ?”

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Benɛ su gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho wo ɔ nya ya;

english_verse: and a strong wind was making the water rough.
translation_verse: Nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngua ko ba fia he je ɔ wo ɔ puɛ.

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ hlui lɛ ɔ maa pee si tomi nya etɛ loo eywiɛ ɔ, a na Yesu nɛ nyɛɛ wo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma nɛ e miɔ nɛ e maa su lɛ ɔ he, nɛ a ye gbeye.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Se e de mɛ ke: “Ami ʼi, nyɛ ko ye gbeye.”

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.
translation_verse: Lɛ kpa kome je Tiberia ba he nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na si nɛ a ye abolo ɔ ngɛ ɔ kasa nya.

english_verse: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ benɛ asafo ɔ nɛ kaa Yesu loo e kaseli ɔmɛ be lejɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a sɛ lɛhi a mi, nɛ a ba Kapernaum ba ngɛ Yesu hlae. Yesu ji wami ngma

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a ba na lɛ ngɛ wo ɔ se ɔ, a bi lɛ ke: “Rabi, mɛni be o ba hiɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Tsa pi okadihi nɛ nyɛ na a he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ ɔ, se mohu akɛnɛ nyɛ ye abolo ɔ eko nɛ nyɛ tɔ ɔ he je.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a bi lɛ ke: “Kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ nɛ wa ma tsu Mawu ni tsumi ɔmɛ?”

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Wa tsɛmɛ ye mana ngɛ nga a nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: ‘E ha mɛ abolo kɛ je hiɔwe nɛ a ye’ ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Pi Mose ji nɔ nɛ ha nyɛ abolo ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ se Tsaatsɛ mohu lɛ haa nyɛ abolo nɛ jee hiɔwe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu abolo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ jee hiɔwe kpleɔ si nɛ ngɔɔ wami ngɔ haa je ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ a de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha wɔ abolo nɛ ɔ daa.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Se Yesu de mɛ ke: “Imi ji wami ngma a nɛ; nɔ nɛ baa ye ngɔ ɔ, hwɔ be lɛ yee gblegbleegblee, nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, kuma be lɛ tɔe gblegbleegblee.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: “Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ na mi se kɛ ɔ nyɛ he we yi.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi ɔ maa ba ye ngɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ baa ye ngɔ ɔ, i be lɛ fiee kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi imi nitsɛ ye suɔmi nya ni peemi he nɛ i je hiɔwe kɛ ba ngɛ se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ni peemi he.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Nɛ enɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ni ɔ nɛ, kaa nihi tsuo nɛ e ngɔ ha mi ɔ, ma ko ha nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɛ laa, se mohu ma tle lɛ si ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji Tsaatsɛ suɔmi nya ni ɔ nɛ, kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ Bi ɔ nɛ e heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ, e na neneene wami, nɛ imi ɔ, ma tle lɛ si ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ tu e he munyu huhuuhu ke e de ke: “Imi ji abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ nɛ;”

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: nɛ a ke: “Anɛ pi Yosef bi Yesu ɔ nɛ wa le e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo? Kɛ pee kɛɛ mɔ nɛ e deɔ ke: ‘I je hiɔwe’ ɔ?”

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Tsa pi kaa nɔ ko na Tsɛ ɔ hyɛ, ja nɔ nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, lɛ lɛ e na Tsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, e ngɛ neneene wami.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Imi ji wami abolo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsɛmɛ ye mana ngɛ nga a nɔ nɛ a gbo?

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji abolo nɛ jee hiɔwe baa a nɛ, konɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ye nɛ e ko gbo.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Imi ji abolo nɛ hɛ̃ ngɛ nɛ je hiɔwe ba a nɛ; ke nɔ ko ye abolo nɛ ɔ eko ɔ, e maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene. Se abolo nɛ i kɛ ma ha a ji ye he lo nɛ i kɛ ma ha ngɛ je ɔ wami he ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Ke nyɛ yi Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ he lo nɛ nyɛɛ nu e muɔ ɔ, nyɛ be wami ngɛ nyɛ mi.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye he lo nɛ e nuu ye muɔ ɔ, e ngɛ neneene wami, nɛ imi lɛɛ ma tle lɛ si ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ye he lo ɔ ngma nitsɛ ʼi, nɛ ye muɔ ɔ nunui nɔ́ nitsɛ ʼi.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye he lo nɛ e nuu ye muɔ ɔ, e hii ye mi nɛ imi hu i hii e mi.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Tsɛ, hɛ kalɔ, ɔ tsɔ mi, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ he nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu nɔ nɛ yeɔ mi ɔ hu maa hi si ngɛ ye he.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ba nɛ ɔ, e be kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye nɛ a gbo ɔ; nɔ nɛ yeɔ abolo nɛ ɔ ɔ, e maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.”

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Yesu de ni nɛ ɔmɛ benɛ e ngɛ ni tsɔɔe ngɛ kpe he ko ngɛ Kapernaum ɔ. Neneene wami munyuhi

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, benɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, a ke: “Munyu nɛ he wa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; mɛnɔ ma nyɛ tue bu?”

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ yaa hiɔwe he nɛ e ngɛ sa a, kɔlɔ ɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ haa wami ɔ nɛ; he lo ɔ he be se nami ko. Munyuhi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, mumi ʼi, nɛ wami ʼi.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ ti ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ a he we yi.” Ejakaa Yesu le kɛ je sisije ɔ nihi nɛ he we yi ɔ kɛ nɔ hu nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e ke: “Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i de nyɛ ke: Nɔ ko be ye ngɔ nyɛe maa ba, ja Tsɛ ɔ ha lɛ he blo ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Kɛ je enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu kpale a se nɛ a kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ we hu.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ ke: “Nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa je lo?”

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Simon Petro he nɔ ke: “Mawetsɛ, mɛnɔ ngɔ wa maa ya? Mo lɛ o ngɛ neneene wami munyu ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ;

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa he ye, nɛ wa na le hulɔ kaa mo ji Mawu nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Anɛ pi nyɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ i hla lo? Se nyɛ kpɛti nɔ kake ɔ abosiami ʼi.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi ɔ, he munyu e ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ; ejakaa lɛ ji ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kpa si ngɛ Galilea, se e sume kaa e ya kpaa si ngɛ Yudea ejakaa Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ a ba tsuhi nyami ligbi ɔ su ta.

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yesu nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: “Jee hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ya Yudea, konɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ hu a na nihi nɛ o tsuo ɔmɛ.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa a le lɛ ɔ pee we nɔ́ ko ngɛ laami mi. Ke ni nɛ ɔmɛ o peɔ ɔ, je o he si ngɔ tsɔɔ je ɔ.”

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Se e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tete he we e nɔ yi.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Ye be sui lolo, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be ɔ daa nɛ ɔ e su.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Je ɔ be nyɛe nyɛ maa nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ e nyɛɛ mi, ejakaa i yeɔ e he odase kaa e ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ ni tsumi yayamihi ʼi.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ya nyami ligbi nɛ ɔ yemi se imi lɛɛ i na we ma ya, ejakaa ye be ɔ sui lolo.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Benɛ e de mɛ ja a, e hi si bɔɔ ko ngɛ Galilea. Yesu ya ba tsuhi nyami ligbi ɔ yemi

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ bɔni lɛ hlami ngɛ nyami ligbi ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ke: “Jije e ngɛ?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Nɛ munyu kusikusi fuu ba asafo ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Yesu he. Ni komɛ de ke: “Nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ;” nɛ ni komɛ hu ke: “Dɛbi, blɔ mohu e haa asafo ɔ tlaa.”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Pohu nɔ ko ji paa tui e he munyu ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a gbeye yemi he.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Benɛ e su nyami ligbi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ni.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a nyɛ kpɛ a he nɛ a de ke: “Kɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ kase we ni ɔ pee kɛɛ nɛ e le womihi a mi nihi nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ye ni tsumi ɔ, tsa pi ye nɔ, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e pee e suɔmi nya ni ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma yo ngɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ he kaa Mawu dɛ mi e je aloo imi nitsɛ ye yi mi i toɔ nɛ i tuɔ munyu.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ toɔ lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi nɛ e tuɔ munyu ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi nyami e ngɛ hlae, se nɔ nɛ hlaa nɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, lɛɛ anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ ko be e mi.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Anɛ pi Mose nɛ ha nyɛ Mlaa a lo? Nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko yi Mlaa a nɔ. Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ nyɛ maa gbe ɔ?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Asafo ɔ he nɔ nɛ a ke: “Mumi yayami ngɛ o mi; mɛnɔ ngɛ mo hlae nɛ e gbe?”

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Mose lɛ ngɔ nɔ pomi ha nyɛ , nɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ poo nɔ.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Ke Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ a poo nɔ benɛ pee nɛ a ko tɔ Mose Mlaa a, mɛni he ne nyɛ mi mi fuɔ mi kaa i tsa nɔmlɔ mluku ɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yerusalembi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ke: “Anɛ pi nɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Nɛ oʼɛ, munyu e ngɛ tue pãa nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ a de we lɛ nɔ ko. Eko ɔ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nikɔtɔma amɛ ba na le kaa Kristo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ ɔ niinɛ.

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa le he nɛ e je; se Kristo ɔ lɛɛ, benɛ e maa ba a, nɔ ko be lee he nɛ e je.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu ngɛ ni tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke: “Nyɛ le mi, nɛ nyɛ le he nɛ i je hulɔ; i tui imi nitsɛ ye yi mi kɛ bɛ́, se mohu anɔkualetsɛ ji nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi nɛ nyɛ li ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i le lɛ, ejakaa e ngɔ i je nɛ lɛ lɛ tsɔ mi.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a nu, se nɔ ko tɛ́ e he, ejakaa e ngmlɛfia a sui lolo.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Se asafo ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu he e nɔ ye, nɛ a ke: “Benɛ Kristo maa ba a, anɛ e maa pee okadihi fuu pe nihi nɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔmɛ lo?” A tsɔ nɛ a ya nu Yesu

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Farisifo ɔmɛ nu kaa asafo ɔ ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ dee kusikusi ngɛ e he; nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɔ tsɔli konɛ a ya nu lɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Be bɔɔ ko pɛ e piɛ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si, nɛ ma ya nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma hia mi, se nyɛ be mi nae, nɛ he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ be lejɛ ɔ nyɛe maa ba.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ bi a he ke: “Jije nɔ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɛ wa be lɛ nae? Anɛ nihi nɛ gbɛ fia Helabi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ngɔ e maa ya nɛ e ya tsɔɔ Helabi ɔmɛ a ni lo?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: Mɛni munyu e tu nɛ ɔ: ‘Nyɛ ma hla mi nɛ nyɛ be mi nae, nɛ he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ be lejɛ ɔ nyɛe maa ba’ a?” Wami pa

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Nyagbe ligbi nɛ ji nyami ligbi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ligbi ngua a nɔ ɔ, Yesu ya da si nɛ e wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke: “Ke kuma ngɛ nɔ ko tɔe ɔ, e ba ye ngɔ nɛ e ba nu nyu;

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, — bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ, wami pahi maa je e muklii mi kɛ be.

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ nɛ nihi nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ ma na a he nɛ e de enɛ ɔ ɔ nɛ; se Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ na we nɛ e ba, ejakaa a na we nɛ a wo Yesu hɛ mi nyami. Ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti gba

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Benɛ asafo ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ ɔ, a ke: “Gbalɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ niinɛ.”

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ni komɛ ke: “Kristo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Se ni kpa komɛ hu ke: “Anɛ Kristo ɔ, Galilea e maa je lo?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Anɛ ngmami ɔ de we ke: ‘David powu ɔ mi kɛ Betlehem ma, he nɛ David hi ɔ, lejɛ ɔ Kristo ɔ maa je’ lo?”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ migbami ba asafo ɔ mi ngɛ e he.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Se jinɛ a ti ni komɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a nu lɛ, se kɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nyɛ we e he nɛ e ta. Yudafo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔmahi nɛ he we yi ɔ

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya, nɛ a bi mɛ ke: “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ bɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Tsɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke: “Bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ nɔ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, nɔ ko tui munyu ja gblee.”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ he nɔ ke: “Anɛ nyɛ hu a mlɔɔ nyɛ?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ na nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ loo Farisifo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko he e nɔ ye?”

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Se asafo nɛ li mlaa nɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Nikodemo, a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ ba Yesu ngɔ be ko ɔ, he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke:

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Ke a nui nɔ ko nya mi gbi nɛ a le nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ, wa Mlaa a buu lɛ fɔ lo?”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
