translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a bi hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ ke: “Mo hu kɛ o ngɛ dee ngɛ e he kɛɛ, akɛnɛ e bli o hɛngmɛ ɔ?” Nɛ e ke: “Gbalɔ ji lɛ.”

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders would not believe that the man had once been blind. They sent for his parents
translation_verse: Se Yudafo ɔmɛ he we yi kaa hɛ yuyuilɔ ji lɛ sa loko e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe nɛ ɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ a ya tsɛ nɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ ɔ fɔli,

english_verse: and asked them, “Is this the son that you said was born blind? How can he now see?”
translation_verse: nɛ a bi mɛ ke: “Anɛ nyɛ bi ɔ nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo? Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: The man's parents answered, “We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.
translation_verse: E fɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke: “Wa le kaa wa bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; wa le kaa a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ;

english_verse: But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.”
translation_verse: se bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe jeha nɛ ɔ ɔ, lɛɛ wa li; jeha nɛ ɔ hu, nɔ nɛ bli e hɛngmɛ ɔ, wa li; nyɛ bi lɛ, e wa, lɛ nitsɛ e maa tu munyu ha e he.”

english_verse: The man's parents said this because they were afraid of their leaders. The leaders had already agreed that no one was to have anything to do with anyone who said Jesus was the Messiah.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he nɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ de ke: “E wa, nyɛ bi lɛ nitsɛ” ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The leaders called the man back and said, “Swear by God to tell the truth! We know that Jesus is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɛ nyumu nɛ sa nɛ e ji hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ji si enyɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Ngɔɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha Mawu; se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa le kaa nɔmlɔ nɔ yayami peelɔ ji lɛ.”

english_verse: The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Yayami peelɔ ji lɛ jio, i li; nɔ́ kake i le, kaa jinɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ ji mi, se jeha nɛ ɔ i ngɛ nɔ hyɛe.”

english_verse: “What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he heal your eyes?”
translation_verse: Nɛ a bi lɛ ekohu ke: “Mɛni e pee mo? Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ e bli o hɛngmɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
translation_verse: E he nɔ nɛ e ke: “I de nyɛ momo, nɛ nyɛ nui; mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ bu tue ekohu? Anɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ ma plɛ e kaseli lo?”

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: A je lɛ ke: “Mo ji e kaselɔ, se wɔɔ lɛɛ Mose kaseli ji wɔ.

english_verse: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Mawu kɛ Mose tu munyu; se nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, wa li he nɛ e je.”

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ei, enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa nyɛ li he nɛ e je, nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ e bli ye hɛngmɛ!

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Mawu bui yayami peeli tue; se ke nɔ ko yee lɛ gbeye nɛ e peɔ e suɔmi nya ni ɔ, e buɔ lɛ tue.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.
translation_verse: Kɛ je nɛ a bɔ je ɔ nɛ ɔ, a nui hyɛ kaa nɔ ko bli nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ hɛngmɛ gblee.

english_verse: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
translation_verse: Kãa nɔ nɛ ɔ ji Mawu ngɔ ɔ, jinɛ e be nyɛe nɔ́ ko maa pee.”

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
translation_verse: A he nɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke “Moo lɛɛ, yayami mi nitsɛ a fɔ mo ngɛ, nɛ mo mohu o ngɛ wɔ ni tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ?” Nɛ a fie lɛ kɛ je kpe he ɔ. Mumi mi hɛyumi

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Yesu nu kaa a fie lɛ; nɛ benɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e bi lɛ ke: “O heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ nɔ yeɔ lo?”

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: E he nɔ ke: “Mɛnɔ ji lɛ, Mawetsɛ, konɛ ma he e nɔ ma ye?”

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke: “O na lɛ momo, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, lɛ nɔuu ʼi.”

english_verse: The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ke: “I heɔ yeɔ, Mawetsɛ;” nɛ e ja lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu ke: “Kojomi he nɛ i ba je nɛ ɔ mi ngɛ, konɛ nihi nɛ hyɛ we nɔ ɔ, a hyɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ, a plɛ hɛ yuyuli.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.”
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ Ke: “Kaa nyɛ hɛ yu mohu ɔ, jinɛ yayami be nyɛ he; se jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ deɔ ke: ‘Wa ngɛ nɔ hyɛe;’ lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔ ngɛ nyɛ he kɛ mwɔɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain only thieves and robbers climb over the fence instead of going in through the gate to the sheep pen.
translation_verse: “Anɔkuale mi i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nɔ nɛ gui sinya a nya nɛ e kɛ se to ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ mi se mohu e guu he kpa kɛ kuɔ ɔ, juɔ kɛ ojofialɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
translation_verse: Lɛ, sinya nya hyɛlɔ ɔ bliɔ haa, nɛ to ɔmɛ nuɔ e gbi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e to ɔmɛ a biɛ tsɛɛ mɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ jee kpo.

english_verse: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke e bli e to ɔmɛ ɔ, e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ to ɔmɛ nyɛɛ e se, ejakaa a le e gbi.

english_verse: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
translation_verse: Se nɔ kpa a, a be e se nyɛɛe, se mohu a maa tu fo kɛ je e ngɔ, ejakaa a li ni kpahi a gbi.”

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about. Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Yesu bu mɛ abɛ nɛ ɔ, se mɛɛ lɛɛ a nui munyu nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ sisi. Yesu ji tohyɛlɔ kpakpa

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu kpale de mɛ ekohu ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Imi ji to ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ nya sinya a nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ sɛ ye hlami kɛ ba a, juɔhi kɛ ojo fiali ji mɛ; se to ɔmɛ bui mɛ tue hulɔ.

english_verse: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
translation_verse: Imi ji sinya a nɛ. Imi lɛɛ, ke nɔ ko gu ye mi kɛ sɛ mi ɔ, a ma he e yi wami, nɛ e maa sɛ mi nɛ e maa je kpo, nɛ e ma na niyeni.

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Juɔ bɛ gu, se jumi kɛ nɔ gbemi kɛ hɛmi kpatami he e baa ngɛ; imi lɛɛ i ba benɛ pee nɛ a na wami nɛ a na nɛ e be nɔ.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.
translation_verse: “Imi ji to hyɛlɔ kpakpa a nɛ. To hyɛlɔ kpakpa a ngɔɔ e klaa ngɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ e to ɔmɛ a nane mi.

english_verse: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ ji apafono nɛ e pi to ɔmɛ a hyɛlɔ, nɔ nɛ to ɔmɛ pi e nihi ɔ, naa kaa ogbetee ma, nɛ e siɔ to ɔmɛ nɛ e tuu fo, nɛ ogbetee, ɔ ba nuu mɛ nɛ e gbɛɛ to ɔmɛ fiaa.

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
translation_verse: Apafono ɔ tuu fo, ejakaa apafono ji lɛ, nɛ to ɔmɛ a he nɔ dɔɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me.
translation_verse: Imi ji tohyɛlɔ kpakpa a nɛ, nɛ i le ye tohi, nɛ ye to ɔmɛ hu le mi,

english_verse: Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep.
translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ le mi, nɛ imi hu i le Tsɛ ɔ; nɛ i ngɔɔ ye wami ngɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ to ɔmɛ a nane mi.

english_verse: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
translation_verse: I ngɛ to kpa komɛ nɛ ji to tsu nɛ ɔ mi; nɛ kɔlɔ ɔmɛ hu, ja i ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a ba nu ye gbi, nɛ to ɔmɛ pee kuu kake kɛ hyɛlɔ kake.

english_verse: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.
translation_verse: “Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔ mi ɔ nɛ, ejakaa i ngɔɔ ye wami ngɔ fɔɔ si, konɛ ma kpale ngɔ.

english_verse: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko kpɔ we ngɛ ye dɛ, se mohu imi nitsɛ lɛ i ngɔ fɔɔ si. I ngɛ he wami kaa i kɛ haa, nɛ i ngɛ he wami kaa i ngɔɔ ekohu; bɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ de mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, mi gbami kpale ba Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpɛti ekohu.

english_verse: Many of them said, “He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him?”
translation_verse: Nɛ a ti nihi fuu ke: “Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi, nɛ e nu godo; mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ lɛ tue bue?”

english_verse: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
translation_verse: Ni komɛ hu ke: “Nɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi nya mi munyuhi ji nɛ ɔ lo? Anɛ mumi yayami ma nyɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ hɛngmɛ ma bli lo?” Yudafo ɔmɛ kua Yesu

english_verse: That winter, Jesus was in Jerusalem for the Temple Festival.
translation_verse: Be su nɛ a ngɛ sɔlemi tsu he tsukɔmi kaimi nyami ligbi yee ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ fiɛ be ʼi.

english_verse: One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch,
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu ngɛ si slae ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ Salomo ablanaa a nɔ.

english_verse: and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ba bua wo e he, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Kɛ yaa su mɛni be o ma ha wa yi mi maa jɔɔ wɔ kɔsikɔsi peemi ngɛ o he? Ke mo ji Kristo ɔ de wɔ paa.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke: “I de nyɛ nɛ nyɛ he we yi. Ni tsumihi nɛ i tsuɔ ngɛ Tsaatsɛ biɛ mi ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ lɛ ngɛ ye he odase yee; se nyɛ he we yi,

english_verse: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.
translation_verse: mɛni he je ɔ, nyɛ pi ye to ɔmɛ eko.

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: Ye to ɔmɛ nuɔ ye gbi, nɛ i le mɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛ ye se,

english_verse: and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.
translation_verse: nɛ imi nɔuu lɛ i haa mɛ neneene wami, nɛ a hɛ mi be kpatae kɛ maa ya neneene nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu, nɔ ko be mɛ kpɔe ngɛ ye dɛ.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɔ mɛ ha mi ɔ pe nihi tsuo, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e ma kpɔ mɛ ngɛ Tsaatsɛ dɛ.

english_verse: and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Imi kɛ Tsaatsɛ tsuo ɔ, kake ʼi.”

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kukuɔ tɛ ekohu nɛ a maa fia lɛ.

english_verse: But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke: “I tsɔɔ nyɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi fuu nɛ je Tsaatsɛ ngɔ. Te jamɛ a ni tsumi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ nyɛ maa fia mi tɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ?”

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Yudafo ɔmɛ he nɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Tsa pi ni tsumi kpakpa ko he nɛ wa maa fia mo tɛ ngɛ ɔ, se mohu musu bɔmi he je, ejakaa mo nɛ nɔmlɔ ji mo ɔ, o tsɛɔ o he ke Mawu.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: In your Scriptures doesn't God say, “You are gods”?
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke: “Anɛ a ngmɛ́ ngɛ nyɛ Mlaa mi ke: ‘I ke, mawuhi ji nyɛ’ ɔ lo?

english_verse: You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods.
translation_verse: Ke e tsɛ nihi nɛ Mawu munyu ɔ ba a ngɔ ɔ tete ke mawuhi, nɛ ngmami ɔ yi lakpa a,

english_verse: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.
translation_verse: nyɛ ngɛ dee ngɛ nɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ pee lɛ klɔuklɔu nɛ e tsɔ lɛ kɛ ba je ɔ mi ɔ he ke: ‘O bɔ musu;’ mɛni he je ɔ, i de ke: Mawu bi ji mi ɔ lo?

english_verse: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
translation_verse: Ke i tsu we Tsaatsɛ ni tsumihi ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ko he mi ye;

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: se ke i tsuɔ ɔ, nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ nyɛ he we mi yi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ he ni tsumi ɔmɛ ye mɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ le nɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi, nɛ imi hu i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Again they wanted to arrest Jesus. But he escaped
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɛ hlae ekohu nɛ a nu lɛ, se e je a dɛ.

english_verse: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there,
translation_verse: Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho Yordan se ya ekohu, he nɛ Yohane baptisi ngɛ kekle ɔ, nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.”
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi fuu ba e ngɔ nɛ a ke: “Yohane pee we okadi ko mohu, se nihi tsuo nɛ Yohane de ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ he ji anɔkuale.”

english_verse: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi fuu he e nɔ ye ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e nyɛmi yi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ba de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, oʼɛ, nɔ nɛ o suɔ ɔ ngɛ gboe.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”
translation_verse: Se benɛ Yesu nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, e ke: “Kikɛmɛ a hiɔ nɛ ɔ pi gbenɔ hiɔ, se mohu Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ he je, benɛ pee nɛ a wo Mawu Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami.”

english_verse: But he stayed where he was for two more days.
translation_verse: Benɛ e nu e hiɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hi si ngɛ he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ ligbi enyɔ.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
translation_verse: Nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ ha waa ya Yudea ekohu.”

english_verse: “Teacher,” they said, “the people there want to stone you to death! Why do you want to go back?”
translation_verse: Kaseli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: “Rabi, e sui be ko nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a fia mo tɛ, nɛ o yaa lejɛ ɔ ekohu nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke: “Anɛ pi ngmlɛfia nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ ngɛ ligbi kake mi lo? Ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ piani ɔ, e tɛ we si, mɛni he je ɔ, e naa je nɛ ɔ mi la a.

english_verse: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.”
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ nyɔ mi ɔ e tɛɔ si, ejakaa la be e mi.”

english_verse: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ e de mɛ ke: “Wa huɛ Lazaro hwɔ mahɛ; se i yaa nɛ ma ya tsɛ̃ɛ lɛ ngɛ mahɛ ɔ mi.”

english_verse: They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mahɛ e ngɛ hwɔeɔ, lɛɛ e ma na he wami mɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
translation_verse: Se e gbenɔ he munyu Yesu tu ɔ nɛ; se mɛɛ lɛɛ a susu kaa mahɛ nitsɛ he munyu e ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ he ɔ e ngɔ ye nya kaa i be lejɛ ɔ, benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ he ye. Nyɛ ha waa ya e ngɔ.”

english_verse: Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.” Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Toma, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Didimo ɔ, de e nyamimɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ ha wɔ hu waa ya nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ya gbo.” Yesu ji sitemi ɔ kɛ wami ɔ

english_verse: When Jesus got to Bethany, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu su lejɛ ɔ, e ba na kaa Lazaro ye ligbi eywiɛ momo ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Bethany was less than three kilometers from Jerusalem,

translation_verse: Yesu de boboobo ke: “Nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, pi ye nɔ nɛ e heɔ yeɔ, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ nɛ naa mi ɔ naa nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i ba je ɔ mi kaa la, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, e ko hi diblii ɔ mi.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nɔ ko nu ye munyu nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, tsa pi imi nɛ ma kojo lɛ, ejakaa i bɛ nɛ ma ba kojo je ɔ, se mohu i ba nɛ ma ba he je ɔ yi wami.

english_verse: But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kuaa mi nɛ e pɛtɛ we ye munyu ɔ he ɔ, e ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ kojo lɛ; munyu nɛ i tu ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu maa kojo lɛ ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.
translation_verse: Ejakaa imi lɛɛ i to we imi nitsɛ ye yi mi i tu we munyu; se Tsɛ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, lɛ mohu e wo mi kita, nɔ́ nɛ ma de kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma tu.

english_verse: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_verse: Nɛ i le kaa e kita a neneene wami ʼi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ de mi ɔ, ja i deɔ.”

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Loko Hetsɔmi nyami ligbi ɔ maa su ɔ, akɛnɛ Yesu le kaa e ngmlɛfia nɛ e kɛ maa je je ɔ mi kɛ ya Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ɔ su he je ɔ, bɔ nɛ e suɔ e nihi nɛ ngɛ je nɔ mi ɔ, ja e suɔ mɛ kɛ pi si.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a ngɛ ni yee ɔ, blɔɔ abosiami ngɔ wo Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi ɔ, tsui mi momo kaa e tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ.

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu le kaa Tsɛ ɔ tu nihi tsuo kulaa ngɔ wo e dɛ, nɛ kaa Mawu ngɔ e je nɛ e kpale yaa Mawu ngɔ ɔ,

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: e te si ngɛ niyeni ɔ si, nɛ e je e tade ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si, nɛ e ngɔ papahu ngɔ muɔ e mlɛ mi.

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e plɛ nyu ngɔ wo tsɛsi mi, nɛ e bɔni e kaseli ɔmɛ a nane he fɔmi, nɛ e kɛ papahu nɛ muɔ e mlɛ mi ɔ tsu.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e ba su Simon Petro nɔ, nɛ lɛɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo lɛ o ngɛ ye nane he fɔe nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ o li, se ke pee se ɔ o maa le.”

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Petro de lɛ ke: “Ko fɔ ye nane he kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Ke i fɔ we o he ɔ, o be blɔfami nɔ́ ko ngɛ ye ngɔ.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, lɛɛ pi ye nane he kɛkɛ, se mohu ye nine kɛ ye yi mi hulɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke: “Nɔ nɛ a du e he ɔ, e hia we lɛ he fɔmi, ja e nane he kɛkɛ, se e he je kɛ pi si. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he je mohu, se pi nyɛ tsuo.”

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa e le nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he nɛ e de ke: ‘Tsa pi nyɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ he je’ ɔ.

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ, benɛ e fɔ a nane ɔmɛ a he nɛ e kukuɔ e tade ɔmɛ nɛ e ya hi si ekohu ɔ, e ke: “Nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ i pee ha nyɛ nɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsɛɛ mi tsɔɔlɔ kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, na nyɛ tɔ we, ejakaa ja ji mi.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: Se okadi i to nyɛ, konɛ bɔ nɛ i pee ha nyɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ja.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nyɔguɛ pa we e nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu tsɔlɔ pa we nɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: “Pi nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he munyu nɛ i ngɛ tue ɔ; imi lɛɛ i le nihi nɛ i hla; se mohu benɛ pee nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a nɛ ba mi ke: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye dɛ mi abolo ɔ, e wo e nane seja nɔ ngɔ si mi.

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ngɔ to loko e ba mi, konɛ ke e ba mi ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa ami ʼi.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Se lɛɛ e be nɔ Yesu gugue mi nɛ e bi lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, mɛnɔ ʼi?

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Benɛ e de ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hao ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ e gba mi kpoo nɛ e de ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nyɛ ti nɔ kake maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Se kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ Yesu suɔ ɔ kpasa e gugue.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Simon Petro ma lɛ hɛ̃ ke e bi lɛ nɔ he munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: A ti ni komɛ susu kaa, akɛnɛ Yuda lɛ toɔ sika kpɛɛ ɔ he nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ya he nihi nɛ he hia wɔ ngɔ to nyami ligbi ɔ,” aloo kaa e ngɔ nɔ ko ngɔ ha ohiafohi.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ benɛ e he nyamiwo bɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e je kpo. Se je jɔ. Kita he ɔ

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Ke a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ e mi ɔ, Mawu hu maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi, nɛ e maa wo e hɛ mi nyami oya.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Bimɛ tsɔwi, be bɔɔ kɛkɛ e piɛ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si; nyɛ ma hla mi, nɛ bɔ nɛ i de Yudafo ɔmɛ ke: ‘He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be lejɛ ɔ nyɛe maa bɛ’ a, jã i ngɛ nyɛ hu dee jeha nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro bi lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, jije o yaa?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “He nɛ i yaa a, o be nyɛe ye se maa nyɛɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, se o maa nyɛɛ ye se hwɔɔ se ko.”

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Petro de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, mɛni he je i be o se nyɛe ma nyɛɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ? Ye wami tete ma ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ o he.”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke: “O maa ngɔ o wami ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ ye he lo? I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke: Kungwɔ be nɔ kpae nɛ o ma kpa ngɛ ye se si etɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui; nyɛ he Mawu nɔ nyɛɛ ye, nɛ imi hu nyɛ he ye nɔ nyɛɛ ye.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Sihi hehi fuu ngɛ Tsaatsɛ we ɔ; ke pi ja jinɛ, i de nyɛ momo; ejakaa i yaa nɛ ma ya dla blɔ he ngɔ to nyɛ.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Nɛ he nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ le, nɛ blɔ ɔ hu, nyɛ le.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Toma de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, wa li he nɛ o yaa, nɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ nɛ wa maa le blɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ami ji blɔ ɔ kɛ anɔkuale ɔ kɛ wami ɔ; nɔ ko bɛ́ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, kaa ja e gu ye nɔ.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Kaa nyɛ le mi jinɛ, nyɛ ko le Tsaatsɛ hulɔ; nɛ kɛ je mwɔnɛ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ le lɛ, ejakaa nyɛ na lɛ.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Filipo de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, tsɔɔ wɔ Tsɛ ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ hiɛ ha wɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke: “Pi mwɔnɛ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, o li mi lolo lo, Filipo? Nɔ nɛ na mi ɔ, e na Tsɛ ɔ, nɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o deɔ ke: ‘Tsɔɔ wɔ Tsɛ ɔ?’

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Anɛ o he we yi kaa i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi nɛ Tsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ ye mi lo? Munyu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tuɔ, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i toɔ nɛ i deɔ; se Tsɛ ɔ nɛ hii ye mi ɔ, lɛ lɛ e tsuɔ ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Nyɛ he mi nyɛɛ ye kaa i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi nɛ Tsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ ye mi; se ke pi ja a, nyɛ he mi nyɛɛ ye ngɛ jamɛ a ni tsumi ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ a he.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale mi, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, ni tsumihi nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ, lɛ hu e ma tsu, nɛ e ma tsu nihi nɛ pe kɔlɔ ɔmɛ tete, ejakaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ ma pee, konɛ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami ngɛ Bi ɔ mi.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ kpa nɔ ko he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, ma pee.” Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he siwomi

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ suɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye ye kita amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Nɛ imi lɛɛ ma bi Tsɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ Hepiɛlɔ kpa, konɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si kɛ ya neneene;

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: anɔkuale mumi ɔ nɛ je ɔ nyɛ we lɛ nɛ e ngɔ ɔ, mɛni he je ɔ, e nɛ́ lɛ, nɛ pohu e li lɛ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ le lɛ, ejakaa e kɛ nyɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e maa hi nyɛ mi.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: “I be nyɛ sie ahusa, i ma nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: E piɛ bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ je ɔ be mi nae hu; se nyɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ mi nae, ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ hɛ maa hi ngmengmle.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ maa le kaa i ngɛ ye tsɛ mi nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ ye mi nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ mi.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ ye kita amɛ nɛ e yeɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ suɔ mi; nɛ nɔ nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa suɔ lɛ, nɛ imi hu ma suɔ lɛ, nɛ ma je ye he si ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Yuda, pi Iskariot ɔ, bi lɛ ke “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni ba he je nɛ wɔ kɛkɛ o ma je o he si ngɔ tsɔɔ nɛ o be jee ngɔ tsɔɔ je ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Ke nɔ ko suɔ mi ɔ, e maa ye ye munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ Tsaatsɛ maa suɔ lɛ, nɛ wa maa ba e ngɔ, nɛ waa kɛ e ngɔ maa pee wa sihi he.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ sume mi ɔ, e yi ye munyu nɔ. Nɛ munyu nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue ɔ, pi ye nɔ, se mohu Tsɛ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɔ ʼi.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: “I de nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ be mi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Se Hepiɛlɔ ɔ nɛ ji Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ maa tsɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, lɛ e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ nihi kulaa, nɛ e ma kai nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: “Hejɔmi i ngɛ sie ha nyɛ; hejɔmi nɛ ji ye nɔ ɔ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae, pi bɔ nɛ je ɔ haa a nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu nyɛ ko ye gbeye.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nu kaa i de nyɛ ke: ‘I yaa, nɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ.’ Nyɛ suɔ mi jinɛ nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi kaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, ejakaa Tsaatsɛ kle pe mi.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, i de nyɛ loko e ba mi, konɛ ke e ba mi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ he nyɛɛ ye.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: I kɛ nyɛ be munyu tue fuu hu, ejakaa je ɔ mi matsɛ ɔ ma, se e be he wami ko nyɛ nyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: I peɔ bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ fa mi ɔ konɛ je ɔ nɛ na le kaa i suɔ Tsɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ te si, nyɛɛ ba waa je hiɛ ɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: “Imi ji wai tso nitsɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ Tsaatsɛ ji ngmɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Ye he kɔni tsuaa kɔni nɛ wui yiblii ɔ, e poo, nɛ eko tsuaa eko nɛ woɔ yiblii ɔ, e sãa he, benɛ pee nɛ e wo yiblii pe kekle ɔ.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ he je momo ngɛ munyu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ he.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hi ye mi, nɛ imi hu ma hi nyɛ mi. Kaa bɔ nɛ tso kɔni be nyɛe maa je lɛ nitsɛ e mi nɛ e wo yiblii kaa ja e ma wai tso ɔ he ɔ, ja nyɛ hu nyɛ be nyɛe kaa ja nyɛ hi ye mi.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: “Imi ji wai tsɔ ɔ, nyɛ ji kɔni ɔmɛ. Nɔ nɛ hii ye mi nɛ imi hu i hii e mi ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e woɔ yiblii fuu; ejakaa ke pi imi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ be nɔ ko nyɛe maa pee.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko hi ye mi ɔ, a sakee lɛ fɔɔ he kaa tso kɔni, nɛ e gbliɔ, nɛ a buaa nya ngɔ woɔ la mi, nɛ a sãa.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ hi ye mi nɛ ye munyu ɔ hi nyɛ mi ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ɔ, a maa pee ha nyɛ.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ a kɛ woɔ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi nyami, ke nyɛ wo yiblii fuu, nɛ nyɛ plɛ ye kaseli ɔ.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔ mi ɔ, ja imi hu i suɔ nyɛ; nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ ye suɔmi ɔ mi.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ye ye kita amɛ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa hi ye suɔmi ɔ mi; kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ye Tsaatsɛ kita amɛ a nɔ nɛ i ngɛ e suɔmi ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: “I de nyɛ enɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ ye bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hi nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hyi.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji ye kita a, kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi kaa bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko be suɔmi nɛ kle pe enɛ ɔ, kaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ e wami ngɔ fɔ si ha e huɛmɛ.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ pee nihi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ he kita woe nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ ye huɛmɛ ji nyɛ.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: I tsɛ we nyɛ nyɔguɛhi hu, ejakaa nyɔguɛ li nɔ nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ peɔ; se mohu huɛmɛ i tsɛ nyɛ, ejakaa nihi tsuo nɛ i nu ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nya a, i wo nɔ ta de nyɛ.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Tsa pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hla mi, se imi mohu lɛ i hla nyɛ, nɛ i to nyɛ konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya wo yiblii, nɛ nyɛ yiblii ɔ nɛ hi si; konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, e ngɔ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi.” Je ɔ nyɛmi

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: “Ke je ɔ nyɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi kekle e nyɛ.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Kaa je ɔ mi nyɛ je jinɛ, je ɔ maa suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nihi, se akɛnɛ nyɛ ji je ɔ mi se imi mohu lɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ he nɛ je ɔ nyɛɛ nyɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi munyu nɛ i tu nyɛ ɔ nɔ ke: ‘Nyɔguɛ pa we e nyɔmtsɛ.’ Ke a wa mi yi mi ɔ, a maa wa nyɛ hu yi mi; ke a ye ye munyu ɔ nɔ ɔ, a maa ye nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: A maa ngɔ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pee nyɛ ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he, mɛni he je ɔ, a li nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: I bɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ba tu munyu jinɛ, yayami ko be a he; se enɛ ɔ ɔ, a be a he yayami ɔ he nya jemi ko.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ mi ɔ, e ngɛ Tsaatsɛ hu nyɛe.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Kaa i tsu we ni tsumihi nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko tsu we eko hyɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti jinɛ, yayami ko be a he; se enɛ ɔ lɛɛ a na nɛ kɛ ɔ, a ngɛ mi nyɛe kɛ Tsaatsɛ tsuo.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Sa nɛ e ba jã benɛ pee nɛ munyu nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mlaa a mi ɔ nɛ ba mi ke: ‘A nyɛ mi gu!’

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: “Se Hepiɛlɔ ɔ, nɛ ma tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ kɛ je Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji anɔkuale Mumi ɔ nɛ jee Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ baa a, lɛ nɛ ke e ba a, e maa ye ye he odase;

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa ye odase, ejakaa nyɛɛ kɛ mi lɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije.”

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: I de nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ nane nɛ ko kpata. O

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: A maa fie nyɛ kɛ maa je kpe he ɔmɛ. Nɛ be maa ba tete nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbee nyɛ ɔ a ma susu kaa e kɛ ngɛ Mawu jae.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Nɛ a maa pee enɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa a li Tsɛ ɔ loo imi hulɔ.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Se i de nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ ke be ɔ su ɔ nɛ nyɛ kai kaa i wo nɔ ta de nyɛ, se kɛ je sisije ɔ i de we nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ lɛ ngɛ. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nitsumi

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: “Se jeha nɛ ɔ ɔ, fi yaa nɔ nɛ tso mi ɔ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko bi we mi ke: ‘Jije o yaa?’

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ anɔkuale dee: e hi ha nyɛ kaa ma je; mɛni he je ɔ, ke i ji ɔ, Hepiɛlɔ ɔ be nyɛ ngɔ bae; se ke i je ɔ, ma ha e ba nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: Nɛ lɛɛ, ke e ba a, e ma kã je ɔ ngɛ yayami he kɛ dami he kɛ kojomi he:

english_verse: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
translation_verse: Yayami he, ejakaa a he we ye nɔ yi;

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: dami he, ejakaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu;

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: kojomi he, ejakaa a kojo je ɔ mi matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: “I ngɛ nihi fuu nɛ piɛ nɛ ma de nyɛ; se nyɛ be nyɛe he maa pɛtɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ;

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: se ke anɔkuale Mumi ɔ na ba a, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ anɔkuale ɔ kulaa mi blɔ; ejakaa e be lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi toe kɛ tu munyu, se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa nu ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ e ma de, nɛ nihi nɛ ma a, e maa wo nɔ ta de nyɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: Lɛ e maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami, ejakaa e maa ngɔ ye nɔ ɔ eko nɛ e maa wo nɔ ta de nyɛ.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ye nɔ ʼi; lɔ ɔ he nɛ i de ke: ‘E maa ngɔ ye nɔ ɔ eko nɛ e wo nɔ ta de nyɛ’ ɔ nɛ.” Kɔmɔ kɛ buajɔmi

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: “E piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na mi; ejakaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.”

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ bi a he ke: “Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ wɔ dee nɛ ɔ: ‘Epiɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu, e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na mi,’ nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu; ‘I yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ’?

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a ke: “Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ: ‘E piɛ bɔɔ’? Wa li nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ Yesu na kaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a bi lɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nɛ i ke e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he bie nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma fo nɛ nyɛ maa wo ya, se je ɔ ma nya. Nyɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ, se nyɛ kɔmɔ yemi ɔ ma plɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Ke yo nu kɔɔmi ɔ, e haoɔ, ejakaa e ngmlɛfia a su. Se benɛ e fɔ bi ɔ se ɔ, e kai we dengme ɔ hu ngɛ bua jɔmi nɛ e naa kaa e fɔ nɔmlɔ kɛ ba je ɔ mi ɔ he.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ hu, jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee mohu, se ma na nyɛ ekohu, nɛ nyɛ tsui maa nɔ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ, na ko be kpɔe ngɛ nyɛ dɛ.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: “Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ be mi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ bie. I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, e ma ha nyɛ.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ kpa we nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi; nyɛ kpa pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma na, konɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hyi.” Je ɔ nɔ kunimiyemi

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, abɛhi a mi i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue ngɛ ɔ nɛ; se be ma nɛ i kɛ nyɛ be munyu tue ngɛ abɛhi a mi hu, se mohu paa ma jaje tsɛ ɔ he sane ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma kpa pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi, se i de we nyɛ ke imi lɛ ma bi Tsɛ ɔ ha nyɛ,

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ suɔ nyɛ, mɛni he je ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Mawu ngɔ i je.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ i je kɛ ba je ɔ mi, jeha nɛ ɔ hu, i ngɛ je ɔ mi jee kɛ yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.”

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Ekaseli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, jeha nɛ ɔ o tu munyu faii nɛ o tu we munyu ngɛ abɛhi a mi.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ wa kɔ se kaa o le nihi tsuo nɛ e hia we kaa nɔ ko nɛ bi mo sane ko. Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu ngɔ o je.”

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: oʼɛ, ngmlɛfia a ma, nɛ e su po, nɛ nyɛ maa gbɛ fia nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ngɔ e blɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa je ye nɔ kake he; se pi ye nɔ kake ʼi, ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: I de nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ wo nyɛ bua ngɛ ye mi. Je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he hiami nyɛ ma na, se kɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsui nɛ nɔ nyɛ mi. I ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi!”

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu de ni nɛ ɔmɛ se ɔ, e wo e hɛ nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛ, ngmlɛfia a su. Wo o bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami, konɛ o bi ɔ hu nɛ wo o hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o ha lɛ he blɔ ngɛ he lo tsuo nɔ, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ o ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ, e ha mɛ neene wami.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Se enɛ ɔ ji neneene wami ɔ nɛ, kaa a le mo, anɔkuale Mawu kake ɔ, kɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ o tsɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i wo o hɛ mi nyami ngɛ zugba a nɔ, akɛnɛ ni tsumi ɔ nɛ o ha mi tsumi ɔ i gbe nya a.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, Tsaatsɛ, ngɔɔ hɛ mi nyami nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ o ngɔ loko a bɔ je ɔ ngɔ wo ye hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: “I je o biɛ ɔ si ngɔ tsɔɔ nimli nɛ o ngɔ kɛ je je ɔ mi ha mi ɔ. O nihi ji mɛ, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha mi, nɛ a ye o munyu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ a le kaa nihi kulaa nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, o ngɔ a je,

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: ejakaa munyu ɔmɛ nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi ɔ, i ngɔ ha mɛ; nɛ a he, nɛ a na le faii kaa o ngɔ i je, nɛ a he ye kaa mo lɛ o tsɔ mi.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ, mɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ hae; tsa pi je ɔ nɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ hae, se mohu nihi nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, ejakaa o nihi ji mɛ;

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: nɛ ye nihi tsuo kulaa a, o nɔ ʼi, nɛ o nɔ hu ɔ, ye nɔ ʼi, nɛ ye hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ a mi.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Nɛ i be je ɔ mi hu, se ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ imi lɛɛ i ma o ngɔ. Tsaatsɛ klɔuklɔu, nihi nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, to mɛ ngɛ o biɛ ɔ mi, benɛ pee nɛ a pee kake kaa wɔ.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Benɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, i to mɛ ngɛ o biɛ ɔ mi; nihi nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, i bu a he, nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko laa we, ja laami bi ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a nɛ ba mi.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Se jeha nɛ ɔ ɔ, i ma o ngɔ, nɛ i ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ dee ngɛ je ɔ mi, konɛ a na ye bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ e nu si ngɛ a mi?

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: I ngɔ o munyu ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ, nɛ je ɔ ngɛ mɛ nyɛe, ejakaa a ji je ɔ mi, kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ji je ɔ mi ɔ?

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: I bi we kaa o je mɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi, se mohu kaa o bu a he kɛ je nɛ ɔ yayami ɔ dɛ mi.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: A ji je ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ji je ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi; o munyu ɔ anɔkuale ʼi.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ o tsɔ mi je ɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ mɛ je ɔ mi tsɔe.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Nɛ a he nɛ imi nitsɛ i peɔ ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ, konɛ mɛ hu a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ anɔkuale mi.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: “Se pi ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ngɛ ɔ, se nihi nɛ ma he ye nɔ maa ye ngɛ a munyu ɔ nya a hulɔ.

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: Konɛ mɛ tsuo a pee kake, kaa bɔ nɛ mo, Tsaatsɛ, o ngɛ ye mi nɛ imi hu i ngɛ o mi ɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a pee kake ngɛ wa mi, konɛ je ɔ nɛ he ye kaa mo lɛ o tsɔ mi.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: Nɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, i ngɔ ha mɛ, konɛ sa pee kake, kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ kake ɔ.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: I ngɛ a mi, nɛ mo hu o ngɛ yɛ mi, konɛ a pee kake kɛ pi si, nɛ je ɔ nɛ le kaa mo lɛ o tsɔ mi, nɛ o suɔ mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: “Tsaatsɛ, nihi nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ i suɔ kaa he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ mɛ hu a kɛ mi ba hi lejɛ ɔ, konɛ a na ye hɛ mi nyami nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, ejakaa o suɔ mi loko a to je ɔ sisi.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Tsaatsɛ dalɔ, je ɔ li mo, se imi lɛɛ i le mo, nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ le kaa mo lɛ o tsɔ mi;

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: nɛ i je o biɛ ɔ si ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ ma kpale je lɛ si ngɔ tsɔɔ, konɛ suɔmi nɛ o kɛ suɔ mi ɔ nɛ hi a mi nɛ imi hu ma hi a mi.”

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ ji nɔ nɛ Petro po e tue ɔ wekuno ɔ, ke: “Anɛ i nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi lo?”

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale bi mɛ ekohu ke: “Mɛnɔ nyɛ ngɛ hlae?” Nɛ a ke: “Yesu, Nazareno ɔ.”

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “I de nyɛ ke: Ami ʼi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke imi nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ha ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya.”

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon Petro nɛ hɛɛ klaate ɔ hia nɛ e kɛ ja osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a nyɔguɛ ɔ nɛ e po e hiɛ ɔ nɔ tue; se nyɔguɛ ɔ biɛ ji Malko.

english_verse: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ kɛ asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a tsɔli ɔmɛ nu Yesu nɛ a fi lɛ,

english_verse: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,
translation_verse: se Petro daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ se. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jamɛ a kaselɔ kpã a nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a le ɔ je kpo, nɛ e ya de yo nɛ ngɛ sinya a nya bue ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ Petro kɛ ba we ɔ mi.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ yiheyo ɔ nɛ ngɛ sinya a nya bue ɔ de Petro ke: “Tse mo hu nyumu nɛ ɔ kaseli ɔmɛ eko ji mo?” E ke: “Dɛbi.”

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Se nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a kɛ hã slɛ la, ejakaa fiɛ ngɛ, nɛ a ngɛ la hluee; nɛ Petro hu kɛ mɛ daa si ngɛ la a eko hluee. Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a bi Yesu sane (Mateo

english_verse: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a bi Yesu e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ e tsɔɔmi ɔ he munyu.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Mɛni he je o ngɛ imi mohu bie? Bi ninɛmɛ nɛ ba buɔ mi tue ɔ nɔ́n ɛ i deɔ mɛ; oʼɛ, ni nɛ ɔmɛ le nihi nɛ i deɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest. Peter Again Denies that He Knows Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɛ Hana ha a kɛ lɛ ya osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Kaiafa ngɔ ngɛ kpa mi. Petro kua Yesu ekohu (Mateo

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpaka Yesu kɛ je Kaiafa ngɔ kɛ ho kojomi he ɔ ya. Nɛ e su makɛ. Mɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ lɛɛ a sɛ we kojomi he ɔ, konɛ a ko ble a he, benɛ pee nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ.

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ Pilato je kpo kɛ ba a ngɔ nɛ e ke: “Mɛni sane nyɛɛ kɛ ba ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ nɔ fɔe?”

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: A he nɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Pi yayami peelɔ ji lɛ jinɛ waa kɛ lɛ ba be mo hae.”

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato kpale sɛ kojomi he ɔ ekohu, nɛ e tsɛ Yesu nɛ e bi lɛ ke: “Anɛ mo ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ lo?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke: “Mo nitsɛ o yi mi o to ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee nɛ ɔ, aloo ni komɛ lɛ a de mo ja ngɛ ye he?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Pilato he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Anɛ Yuda no ji mi lo? Mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ lɛ a ngɔ mo ha mi. Mɛni o pee?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke: “Ye matsɛ yemi ɔ ji je nɛ ɔ mi; ye matsɛ yemi ɔ je je nɛ ɔ mi jinɛ, ye sɔmɔli ɔmɛ maa plee he, konɛ a ko ngɔ mi ngɔ ha Yudafo ɔmɛ; se enɛ ɔ ɔ, ye matsɛ yemi ɔ ji hiɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Pilato bi lɛ ke: “Lɛɛ matsɛ ji mo kɛ̃ lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Jã o de ɔ nɛ; ejakaa matsɛ ji mi. Imi lɛɛ enɛ ɔ he a fɔ mi, nɛ enɛ ɔ he nɔuu i ba je ɔ mi ngɛ, konɛ ma ba ye anɔkuale ɔ he odase. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je anɔkuale ɔ mi ɔ nuɔ ye gbi.”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Pilato bi lɛ ke: “Mɛni ji anɔkuale?” A bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ (Mateo

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Se nyɛ ngɛ blɔ nya ko kaa i ngmɛɔ nɔ kake he haa nyɛ ngɛ Hetsɔmi nyami ligbi ɔ nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ suɔ nɛ ma ngmɛɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ he ha nyɛ lo?”

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa ekohu ke: “Tsa pi nɔ nɛ ɔ, se Baraba mohu!” Kpahu Baraba a ojo fialɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato ngɔ Yesu nɛ e fia lɛ kplibi,

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ ngɔ mio kɛ pee jlasi nɛ a kɛ fi e yi, nɛ a wo lɛ tade tsutsu ko,

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: nɛ a ba e ngɔ ba de ke: “Wa nga mo oo, Yudafohi a matsɛ!” Nɛ a gba e hɛ mi ma.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato je kpo ekohu nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, i kɛ lɛ ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ma nyɛ ngɔ, konɛ nyɛ na le kaa i nɛ fɔbumi sane ko ngɛ e he.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ Yesu je kpo nɛ mio jlasi ɔ fi e yi nɛ e wo tade tsutsu ɔ. Nɛ Pilato de mɛ ke: “Ne nɔmlɔ ɔ!”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ na lɛ ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Sɛu lɛ, sɛu lɛ!” Pilato de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ nɛ nyɛ ya sɛu mɔ, ejakaa imi lɛɛ i nɛ fɔ bumi sane ko ngɛ e he.”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Yudafo ɔmɛ he nɔ ke: “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ngɛ Mlaa, nɛ wa Mlaa a nya a, e sa gbenɔ, ejakaa e pee e he Mawu bi.”

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: nɛ e sɛ kojomi he ɔ ekohu, nɛ e bi Yesu ke: “Jije o je?” Se Yesu pui e nya mi.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pilato de lɛ ke: “O be ye nya mi poe? Anɛ o li kaa i ngɛ he blɔ kaa i sɛuu mo, nɛ i ngɛ he blɔ hulɔ kaa i ngmɛɔ o he lo?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ke pi hiɔwe nɛ a je ngɔ ha mo ɔ, jinɛ o be he wami ko nae ngɛ ye nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ nɔ nɛ je mi wo o dɛ mi ɔ he yayami ɔ kle pe o nɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Kɛ je lɔ ɔ se ɔ Pilato hla kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e he; se Yudafo ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa ke: “Ke o ngmɛɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ he ɔ, o pi Kaisare huɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peɔ e he matsɛ ɔ, e te si ngɔ wo Kaisare.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Pilato nu kekɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ ɔ, e kɛ Yesu je kpo, nɛ e ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ, ngɛ he nɛ a ka tɛ ngɛ, nɛ Hebri mi ɔ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gabata a.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Se Hetsɔmi ɔ dlami kɛ tomi ligbi ʼi, nɛ maa pee piani ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi. Nɛ Pilato de Yudafo ɔmɛ ke: “Ne nyɛ matsɛ ɔ!”

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha mɛ nɛ a ya sɛu. Nɛ a ngo Yesu kɛ ho.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ a osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ de Pilato ke: “Koo ngma ke: ‘Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ’ se mohu kaa lɛ lɛ e de ke: ‘Ami ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Nɛ, benɛ Yesu na e nyɛ kɛ kaselɔ nɛ e suɔ ɔ daa si ɔ, e de e nyɛ ke: “Maa, o bi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: Nɛ lɛ nitse e tloo e seumi tso ɔ kɛ ya he nɛ a tsɛɛ Yikoklodonya, nɛ Hebri mi ɔ a tsɛɛ lɛ Golgota a.

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ a ya sɛu lɛ ngɛ; nɛ a kɛ ni kpahi enyɔ piɛ e he, nɔ kake ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ kɛke hu ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ Yesu ngɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pilato ngma womi ko ngɔ mɛtɛ e seumi tso ɔ yi mi; bɔ nɛ e ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yesu, Nazareno, Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Womi nɛ ɔ ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu kane, ejakaa he nɛ a sɛu Yesu ngɛ ɔ kɛ ma a mi kɛ we; nɛ a ngma ngɛ Hebri kɛ Hela kɛ Roma gbi mi.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Pilato he nɔ ke: “Nɔ nɛ i ngma a, i ngma.”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a de ngɛ a kpɛti ke: “Nyɛ ko ha nɛ wa gba kɔlɔ ɔ, se nyɛ ha waa fɔ nɔ sɔ, konɛ waa na nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee.” Benɛ pee nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ de ke: ‘A dla ye tade ɔmɛ ngɔ ha a he, Nɛ ye he bo ɔ a fɔ́ nɔ sɔ’ ɔ nɛ ba mi. Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ pee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Se Yesu nyɛ kɛ e nyɛ nyɛmi yo, Maria, Klopa yo ɔ, kɛ Maria Magdalena daa si ngɛ Yesu sɛumi tso ɔ kasa nya.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Se benɛ a su Yesu nɔ nɛ a na kaa e gbo momo ɔ, lɛɛ a kuɔ we e nanehi;

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Se he nɛ a sɛu Yesu ngɛ ɔ, abɔɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ yɔkɔ he ko ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi nɛ a tui no ko ngɛ mi hyɛ;

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Nɛ enɛ ɔ se ɔ, akɛnɛ Yesu le kaa a gbe nihi kulaa nya momo ɔ, benɛ pee nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ na ba mi ɔ, e ke: “Kuma ngɛ mi yee.”

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ nɔ́ maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke e mi da nɛ kuã tɔtɔɔtɔ; nɛ a ngɔ wosuma ngɔ sɔ da nɛ kua a mi, nɛ a ngɔ ma paploo nya, nɛ a ngɔ to e nya he.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu he da nɛ kuã a, e ke: “A gbe nya!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ma e yi si, nɛ e ngɔ e nya. A gbɔ Yesu kasa mi nɔ́

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ya kpa Pilato pɛɛ ke a kuɔ a nanehi nɛ a je mɛ, benɛ pee nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ko hi seumi tso ɔ nɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ, ejakaa he dlami kɛ tomi ligbi ʼi, nɛ jamɛ a Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ ji ligbi ngua.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: se mohu aslaafo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake kɛ blɔ gbɔ e kasa mi, nɛ amlɔ ɔ muɔ kɛ nyu be kɛ je mi.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ nɛ na a, lɛ e ye he odase nɛ ɔ nɛ, e odase ɔ anɔkuale ʼi, nɛ e le kaa anɔkuale e ngɛ tue, konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ he ye.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Ejakaa a pee ni nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ke: “A be e wu ko kue” ɔ nɛ ba mi.

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu, ngmami kpa ko ke: “A maa hyɛ nɔ nɛ a gbɔ lɛ nɔ ɔ.” Yesu pumi (Mateo

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya dla Yesu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a he dlami kɛ tomi ligbi ɔ he, ejakaa yɔkɔ ɔ he kɛ we.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yosef nɛ je Arimatia nɛ ji Yesu kaselɔ, se Yudafo ɔmɛ a he gbeye he ɔ e je we e he si ɔ, ya bi Pilato, konɛ e ha nɛ e ya je Yesu gbogboe ɔ; nɛ Pilato ha lɛ he blɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya je Yesu gebogboe ɔ kɛ ho.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.

translation_verse: Yesu bi lɛ ke: “Maa, mɛni he je o ngɛ ya foe? Mɛnɔ o ngɛ hlae?” Maria susu kaa be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ abɔɔ mi dlalɔ ɔ ʼi, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Etsɛ ke mo lɛ o wo lɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ ɔ, tsɔɔ mi he nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya fɔ̃, konɛ ma ya wo lɛ.”

translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke: “Koo ta ye he; ejakaa i na we ma ya hiɔwe ngɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɔ lolo; se yaa ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ o ya de mɛ ke: I yaa hiɔwe ngɛ Tsaatsɛ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ tsɛ kɛ ye Mawu kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ.”

translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ ji otsi ɔ mi kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ gbɔkuɛ ɔ nɔuu, benɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a he gbeye he je ɔ a nga he nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ bua a he nya ɔ sinya amɛ ɔ, Yesu ba nɛ e ba da a kpɛti nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ he manye!”

translation_verse: Nihi a he yayami nɛ nyɛ ma ngɔ pa a, a ngɔ pa; nɛ nihi a he yayami nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa to ɔ, a ngɔ to.” Yesu kɛ Toma

translation_verse: Nɛ ligbi kpaanyɔ se ekohu ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ tsu mi, nɛ Toma hu piɛ a he. Nɛ a nga sinya amɛ, nɛ Yesu ba, nɛ e ba da a kpɛti nɛ e ke: “Nyɛ he manye!”

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de Toma ke: “O kɛ o nine nguɛ nɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ba hyɛ ye dɛ mi ɔ, nɛ o kɛ o nine ba hɔ ye kasa mi ɔ, nɛ o ko je nɔ́, se mohu o he ye.”

translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ okadi kpahi fuu hu ngɛ nɛ Yesu pee ngɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ a ngmɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi;

translation_verse: Simon Petro de mɛ ke: “I yaa wo.” A de lɛ ke: “Wɔ hu waa kɛ mo maa ya.” A pue nɔ nɛ a ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ lɛ nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ a gbi nɔ́ ko.

translation_verse: Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ fɔ ya a ngɛ lɛ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ je, nɛ nyɛ ma na nɔ́ ko.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a fɔ ya a, nɛ lo ɔmɛ a hiemi nya a, a nyɛ we ya a nɛ a sã?

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ kaselɔ n Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ de Petro ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ʼi.” Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Simon Petro nu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ʼi ɔ, e kɛ e tade ɔ muɔ e mlɛ mi, ejakaa e hii si kɛ e he gu, nɛ e tu nɔ wo ɔ mi.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a ba kple ɔ, a na hã kɛ la ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ lo pueɔ si ngɛ nɔ, kɛ abolo.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ kɛ lo nɛ nyɛ gbe piɔ ɔ eko nɛ ba.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ba wo nyɛ nya mi nɔ́ ko.” Kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ́ lɛ bimi ke: “Mɛnɔ ji mo?” Ejakaa a le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji si etɛ nɛ Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ ekaseli ɔmɛ, benɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ. Yesu kɛ Petro

translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ a ye ni ɔ ta a, Yesu bi Simon Petro ke: “Simon, Yona bi, o suɔ mi pe ni nɛ ɔmɛ lo?” Simon de lɛ ke: “Ee, Mawetsɛ, o le kaa i suɔ mo.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Lɛɛ ye to bi ɔmɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: Yesu kpale bi lɛ nɔ nɛ ji si enyɔ ke: “Simon, Yona bi, o suɔ mi lo?” E he nɔ ke: “Ee, Mawetsɛ, o le kaa i suɔ mo.” E de lɛ ke: “Hyɛ ye to ɔmɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Yesu bi lɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji si etɛ ke: “Simon, Yona bi, o suɔ mi lo?” E dɔ Petro kaa e bi lɛ si etɛ sɔuu ke: ‘O suɔ mo lo?’ ɔ; nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, o le nihi kulaa, o le kas i suɔ mo.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Lɛɛ ye to omɛ!

translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e de lɛ enɛ ɔ ɔ, e de lɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ye se.” Yesu kɛ kaselɔ kpa a

translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ke i suɔ kaa e hi si kɛ ya su ye bami be ɔ, o he sane mɛni ji kɔlɔ ɔ? Moo lɛɛ nyɛɛ ye se!”

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ munyu nɛ ɔ gbɛ fia ngɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ke jamɛ a kaselɔ ɔ be gboe. Kpahu Yesu de we ke e be gboe, se mohu e ke: “Ke i suɔ kaa e hi si kɛ ya su ye bami be ɔ, o he sane mɛni ji kɔlɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
