english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: “Ejakaa a ngma ngɛ Lahi a womi ɔ mi ke: ‘Ha e sihi he ɔ nɛ plɛ we doku, Nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ko hi mi,’ kɛ; jeha nɛ ɔ hu: ‘Nɛ e sɔmɔmi ni tsumi ɔ ha nɔ kpa nɛ ngɔ.’

english_verse: So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
translation_verse: kɛ je Yohane baptisimi ɔ nɔ kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ je wa ngɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a, a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ plɛ e si temi ɔ he odase yelɔ ngɔ piɛ wa he.”

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Nɛ a hla ni enyɔ, Yosef nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Barsaba nɛ a wo lɛ Yusto hulɔ ɔ, kɛ Maria ngɔ da si.

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: Nɛ a sɔle ke: “Mo, Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ o le nimli kulaa a tsui mi, tsɔɔ ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ nɛ o hla,

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: kone e ngɔ kikɛmɛ a sɔmɔmi kɛ bɔfo ni tsumi nɛ Yuda je mi ngɔ lɛ nitse e blɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Nɛ pa fɔ́ a nɔ sɔ, nɛ sɔ ɔ ya nɔ Maria nɔ, nɛ a bu lɛ ngɔ si bɔfo nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.
translation_verse: Benɛ Pentekoste ligbi su ɔ, mɛ tsuo a nya ba bua kɛ juɛmi kake ngɛ he kake.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Nɛ si kake ɔ, pɛmi ko nɛ ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ko je hiɔwe ba, nɛ e ba hyi we he nɛ a hii si ngɛ ɔ tɔtɔɔtɔ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ba hyi mɛ tsuo kulaa tɔtɔɔtɔ, nɛ a bɔni gbi slɔɔto slɔɔtohi tumi, kaa bɔ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɔ wo a nya a.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Se Yudafohi Mawu gbeye yeli kome ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ je majemaje kulaa nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Se benɛ a nu kikɛmɛ a pɛmi nɛ ɔ ɔ, nihi babauu ba bua a he nya nɛ a he mi po ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nu kaa a ngɛ lɛ nitse e ma mi gbi tue.

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Partiabihi kɛ Mediabihi kɛ Elambihi, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Mesopotamia kɛ Yudea kɛ Kapadokia, Ponto kɛ Asia,

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: Kretabihi kɛ Arabiabihi: Wa ngɛ nue kaa a ngɛ Mawu ni ngua amɛ jajee ngɛ wa je gbihi a mi.”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he nɛ a dɛ yaa, nɛ nɔ nɛ de nɔ nɛ ke: “Kɛ ji enɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Se ni kome hu ye fɛu ke: “A de dã.” Petro munyu nɛ e tu

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro kɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ te si da si, nɛ e wo e nya nɔ nɛ e tu munyu tsɔɔ asafo ɔ ke: “Yuda nyumuhi kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le enɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu ye munyu ɔ tue:

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Tsa pi dã nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ de kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ susue ɔ, ejakaa mɔtu ngmlɛ nɛɛ kɛkɛ́ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ;

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: se mohu enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ Yoel de ɔ ke:

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: ‘Nɛ e maa ba mi ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, Kaa ma nɛ ye mumi ɔ ngɔ pue he lo kulaa nɔ, Nɛ nyɛ bimɛ nyumu ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ yi ɔmɛ maa gba, Nɛ nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ maa na ninamihi, Nɛ nyɛ nikɔtɔma a mɛ maa nla nlamihi,

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Nɛ, ye tsɔli nyumuhi kɛ yi ɔmɛ hu a nɔ Ma nɛ ye mumi ɔ ngɔ pue Ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a maa gba.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma pee nyakpɛ nihi ngɛ hiɔwe Kɛ okadihi hu ngɛ zugba a nɔ, Muɔ kɛ la kɛ lakusu.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Pu maa tsɔ diblii Nɛ nyɔhiɔ ma plɛ muɔ Loko Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ngua nɛ ngɛ nyami ɔ maa ba

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: “Tsaatsɛmɛ Israelbihi, nyɛɛ bu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ tue. Yesu Nazare no ɔ ji nyumu nɛ Mawu kɛ he wami ni tsumihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi kɛ okadihi nɛ e gu e nɔ kɛ pee ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ ye e he odase ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le ɔ.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Yesu nɛ ɔ nɛ a je lɛ ngɛ Mawu yi mi tomi kɛ e ni nɛ e le ngɔ to ɔ nya ngɔ ha a, nyɛ gu nihi nɛ li mlaa amɛ a nine nɔ nyɛ sɛu lɛ nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔuu si Mawu tle nɛ e pɛne gbenɔ piimi kpa amɛ, ejakaa gbenɔ be nyɛe e nya tsimi.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Ejakaa David de ngɛ e he ke: ‘I naa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye hɛ mi daa, Ejakaa e ngɛ ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ, kone ma ko dede.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ye tsui nɔ ye mi, Nɛ ye lilɛ ngɛ nyae, Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ ye he lo hu maa jɔɔ e he ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi,

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o be ye klaa sie ngɛ gbeje, Nɛ o be hae nɛ o nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ puɛ.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: O ha i le wami blɔ ɔ, Nɛ o ma ha ye tsui maa nɔ ye mi faa ngɛ o hɛ mi.’

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, nyɛ ha ma tu munyu faii ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ blemano David he, kaa e gbo nɛ a pu lɛ, nɛ e yɔkɔ ngɛ wa kpɛti kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ nɛ e le kaa Mawu ka lɛ kita ke e mi mi bimɛ ɔmɛ eko maa hi e sɛ̃ ɔ nɔ he je ɔ,

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: e na ngɔ to nɛ e tu Kristo si temi ɔ he munyu, kaa a be e klaa sie ngɛ gbeje nɛ e he lo hu be puee.

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a Yesu nɛ ɔ Mawu tle lɛ si; lɔ ɔ he odase yeli ji wɔ kulaa.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ akɛnɛ a wo e nɔ kɛ ho Mawu hiɛ ɔ nine nɔ ya nɛ e na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he si womi ɔ kɛ je Tsɛ ɔ dɛ he je ɔ, e nɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ ngɔ pue si.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Ejakaa David yɛ hiɔwe, cse lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: Hii ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: Kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o henyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ pee o nane si maangoo.’

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha Israel we ɔ kulaa nɛ le tutuutu kaa Mawu ngɔ kikɛmɛ a Yesu nɛ nyɛ sɛu lɛ nɛ ɔ ngɔ pee Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo.”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ, e gbɔ a tsui mi, nɛ a de Petro kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Petro de mɛ ke: Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha a baptisi lɛ ngɔ wo Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, konɛ a ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma na Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɔke nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa si womi ɔ nyɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ se lokoo, nihi abɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ wa Mawu ɔ ma tsɛ kɛ maa ba a, a nɔ ʼi.”

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e tu munyu kpahi fuu e kɛ ye odase nɛ e kɛ wo mɛ ga ke: “Nyɛ ha a he nyɛ yi wami kɛ je yi nɔ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃e nɛ ɔ mi.”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Nɛ a hɛɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ kɛ huɛ bɔmi ɔ kɛ abolo mi kumi ɔ kɛ sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami ɔmɛ a mi. Ninɛmɛ nɛ he ye ɔmɛ a sihimi

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Nɛ gbeye nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nɛ a gu bɔfo ɔmɛ a nine nɔ kɛ pee nyakpɛ ni kɛ okadihi fuu.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi nɛ he ye ɔ kulaa ngɛ he kake, nɛ a pee a nihi tsuo kulaa kake.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Nɛ a jua a zugba amɛ kɛ a he ni ɔmɛ, nɛ a dla ngɔ ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo bɔ nɛ he hia nɔ tsuaa nɔ.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Nɛ daa ligbi ɔ, a kɛ juɛmi kake yaa sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ a kuɔ abolo ngɛ wehi a mi, nɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ tsui klɔuu yeɔ ni,

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: nɛ a jeɔ Mawu yi, nɛ a hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ ma mluku ɔ kulaa hɛ mi. Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔɔ nihi nɛ a he a yi wami ɔ ngɔ piɛɛ asafo ɔ he daa ligbi.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ etɛ, sɔlemi yami be ɔ, Petro kɛ Yohane nyɛɛ kɛ yaa sɔlemi we ɔ.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Nyumu ko ngɛ nɛ ji akpaketsɛ kɛ je e nyɛ muklii mi, nɛ a woɔ lɛ daa kɛ ba hii si ngɛ sɔlemi we sinya nɛ a tsɛɛ sinya saminyayoo ɔ nya, konɛ e ba ni ngɛ nihi nɛ yaa sɔlemi we ɔmɛ a dɛ.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Benɛ e na Petro kɛ Yohane nɛ a yaa sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e ba mɛ nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Se Petro kɛ Yohane hyɛ lɛ too, nɛ Petro de lɛ ke: “Hyɛ wa hɛ mi.”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: E dɔ e hɛngmɛ to a nɔ, e hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e ma na nɔ́ ko kɛ je a dɛ.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Se Petro ke: “Sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu ɔ, i be eko; se nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ i kɛ ngɛ mɔ hae nɛ ɔ nɛ: Ngɛ Yesu Kristo, Nazare no ɔ, biɛ mi ɔ, tee si nɛ o nyɛɛ!”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Nɛ e pɛtɛ e hiɛ ɔ nine mi nɛ e wo e nɔ da si; nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e nane kɛ e kpɔji nya amɛ a mi wa lɛ;

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: nɛ e hlu da si nɛ e bɔni nyɛɛmi, nɛ e kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ hlumi kɛ Mawu yi jemi.

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: Benɛ a kpa si kaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ sinya saminyayoo ɔ nya nɛ e hii nɔ bae ɔ, a he mi po nɛ a nya kpɛ a he babauu ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee ha lɛ ɔ he. Petro fiɛmi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ akpaketsɛ nɛ a tsa a ngɛ Petro kɛ Yohane bɛbɛ mi he je ɔ, ma a kulaa bu kɛ ba bua a he nyɛ ngɛ a ngɔ ngɛ ablanaa nɛ a tsɛɛ Salomo nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a he mi po.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Se benɛ Petro na enɛ ɔ ɔ, e de ma a ke: “Nyɛ Israel nyumuhi, mɛ he je nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ yaa pee ngɛ enɛ ɔ he? Aloo mɛ he je nyɛ ngɛ wɔ hyɛe too kikɛ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wami loo wa Mawu jami nya waa kɛ ha nɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ nɛ ji wa tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ wo e tsɔlɔ Yesu hɛ mi nyami; nɔ nɛ nyɛ je lɛ ngɔ ha nɛ nyɛ kua lɛ ngɛ Pontio Pilato hɛ mi, benɛ lɛɛ e pee e juɛmi kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e he ɔ.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kua nɔ klɔuklɔu kɛ dalɔ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ke a ngmɛɛ nɔmlɔ awi yelɔ mohu he ngɔ ha nyɛ,

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: nɛ Wami Matsɛ ɔ, nyɛ gbe lɛ. Se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu he odaseyeli ji wɔ.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Nɛ e biɛ ɔ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nya nɛ a tsa nɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ nyɛ le ɔ; nɛ e nɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ha e pee kpitikplii ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: “Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, mamimɛ, i le kaa fimi nɛ nyɛ li he je nɛ nyɛ pee kaa nyɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ̃.

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ Mawu de ngɔ to momo ngɛ we gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, kaa Kristo maa na amanehlu ɔ, e ha e ba mi ja.

english_verse: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui nɛ nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se, kone a gbe nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ,

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: benɛ pee nɛ he jɔmi be nɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ba, konɛ e tsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ e je ngɔ to nyɛ momo ɔ;

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ sa kaa e ya hi hiɔwe kɛ ya su nihi kulaa a blɔnya tomi be nɛ Mawu tu he munyu ngɛ e gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nya kɛ je blema a.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mose de tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ, ma tle gbalɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa imi si kɛ maa je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɔ ha nyɛ. Nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue ngɛ nihi kulaa nɛ e ma de ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ gbali tsuo nɛ tu munyu kɛ je Samuel kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ nɔ ɔ, wo kikɛmɛ a ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ hu tã ngɔ to.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ kɛ somi ɔ bimɛ, somi nɛ Mawu kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ so, benɛ e de Abraham ke: ‘O nina mi nɛ a maa gbaa zugba a nɔ wekuhi kulaa ngɛ’ ɔ.

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu tle e tsɔlɔ Yesu si ɔ, nyɛ kekle nyɛ ngɔ e tsɔ lɛ nɛ e ba gbaa nyɛ nɛ e kpale nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ je e ni yayami ɔmɛ a he.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Petro kɛ Yohane ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ ngɛ ma a tsɔɔe ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ Sadukifo ɔmɛ ba pue a nɔ,

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: ejakaa a muklii mi fu kaa a ngɛ ma a ni tsɔɔe, nɛ a ngɛ jajee ngɛ tsɔɔe ke Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Nɛ a nu mɛ, nɛ a wo mɛ tsu mi kɛ ya su e nɔ je na, ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ je jɔ.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ nu munyu ɔ a kpɛti nihi fuu he ye, nɛ nyumu ɔmɛ a yibɔ maa su akpe enyɔ.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ, e ba mi kaa e nɔ je na a, a ganɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem,

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Hana, kɛ Kaiafa kɛ Yohane kɛ Aleksandro kɛ nihi abɔ nɛ je osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a weku ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Nɛ a ya ngɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba da kpɛti, nɛ a bi mɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ he wami nya, aloo mɛnɔ biɛ mi nyɛ pee enɛ ɔ ngɛ?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hyi lɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ, de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ma mi ganɔ ɔmɛ kɛ Israel nikɔtɔmahi!

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: Ke a kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu yee mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpakpa nɛ a pee kikɛmɛ a hiɔtsɛ nɛ ɔ he kaa mɛnɔ nɔ a gu kɛ tsa lɛ ɔ,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ tsuo kɛ Israel ma mluku ɔ kulaa a na nɛ a le kaa, Yesu Kristo, Nazare no ɔ, nɛ nyɛ sɛu, nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e biɛ mi nɔ nɛ ɔ daa si ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ e he mi wa lɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔuu ji tɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ji tsu fiali ɔmɛ gbe he guɛ, nɛ e ba plɛ kɔ nya tɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Ejakaa yi wami hemi be nɔ ko nɔ ko mi; nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu, biɛ kpã ko be hiɔwe sisi nɛ a ngɔ ha nimli nɛ sa kaa a gu nɔ kɛ he wa yi wami.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ a na Petro kɛ Yohane kã a nɛ a kpa si kaa pi womi mi leli kɛ ni leli kome ji mɛ ɔ, e pee a hɛ mi yaa, nɛ a kɔ se kaa a kɛ Yesu hi si.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu, akɛnɛ a na nɔmlɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ daa si he je ɔ, a nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a de.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a fa mɛ ke a je gua a mi kɛ je kpo bɔɔ. A ya dami

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: nɛ a ke: “Kɛ wa maa pee nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛɛ? ejakaa okadi ngua nɛ a pee ɔ ngɛ pãa ngɛ ni ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ wa be nyɛe ma kua.

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ a tsɛ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a wo mɛ kita kadikadi ke a ko wo nɔ tã, nɛ a ko tsɔɔ ni ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi kulaa hu.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Se Petro kɛ Yohane he nɔ nɛ a de mɛ ke: “Ke e da blɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa a bu nyɛ mohu tue pe Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ kojo.

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be nyɛe kaa ja wa de nihi nɛ wa na kɛ nihi nɛ wa nu ɔ.”

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: ejakaa nɔmlɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ nyakpɛ tsami nɛ ɔ ye pe jeha nyingmi eywiɛ. Asafo ɔ kpa pɛɛ kɛ bi hewamiwomi

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Se benɛ a ngmɛɛ a he ɔ, a ba a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a ba sɛɛ nihi kulaa nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ de mɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Benɛ a nu ɔ, a kɛ juɛmi kake wo a gbi nɔ ha Mawu nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba kɛ wo kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ:

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: “Mo nɔ nɛ o gu wa tsɛ David, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, nya de ke: ‘Mɛni he je je ma amɛ ngɛ hoo pee, Nɛ ma a hu ngɛ yaka nihi susue nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ te da si, Nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ hu a nya ba bua Ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, Herode kɛ Pontio Pilato kɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ kɛ Israel ma amɛ hu ba bua a he nya ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi ngɔ wo o tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu Yesu, nɔ nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ,

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: konɛ a pee nihi tsuo nɛ o nine kɛ o yi mi tomi ɔ to ngɔ fɔ si ke a pee ɔ.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu Nyɔmtsɛ, hyɛ a he gbeye nɛ a ngɛ woe ɔ, nɛ o ha o sɔmɔli ɔmɛ kɛ kã fuu nɛ jaje o munyu ɔ,

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: nɛ o kpã o nine mi nɛ o ha a tsa nihi, nɛ a gu o tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu Yesu ɔ biɛ mi kɛ pee okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi.”

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Benɛ a sɔle ɔ, he nɛ a nya ba bua ngɛ ɔ mimiɛ, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hyi mɛ tsuo tɔtɔɔtɔ, nɛ a kɛ kã jaje Mawu munyu ɔ. Asafo ɔ pee a nihi kulaa kake

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Nihi babauu nɛ he ye ɔ kulaa hɛɛ tsui kake kɛ mumi kake, nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko tsɛ we e nihi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ mi eko ke lɛ nitse e nɔ, se mohu a ngɔ kulaa ngɔ pee kake.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: He wami kpetekpleenyɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu sitemi ɔ he odase nɛ dloomi kpetekpleenyɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo kulaa a nɔ.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be a kpɛti nɛ e fiɔ lɛ, ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ ngɛ zugbahi loo wehi ɔ juaa, nɛ a kɛ nihi nɛ a jua amɛ a nya sika a baa,

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ ba pueɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ a nane nya, nɛ a dlaa ngɔ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ bɔ nɛ he hiaa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Joseph was one of the followers who had sold a piece of property and brought the money to the apostles. He was a Levite from Cyprus, and the apostles called him Barnabas, which means “one who encourages others.”
translation_verse: ngɛ zugba ko, nɛ e jua, nɛ e kɛ sika a ba nɛ e kɛ ba pue bɔfo ɔmɛ a nane nya.

english_verse: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.
translation_verse: Se nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania nɛ a tsɛɛ e yo hu ke Safira a ya jua zugba ko,

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: nɛ e kɛ yi ni ɔ fã ko to se, nɛ e yo ɔ hu le he nɔ́ ko. Nɛ e kɛ fã ko ba nɛ e kɛ ba pue bɔfo ɔmɛ a nane nya.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Se Petro ke: “Anania, mɛni he je Satan hyi o tsui mi tɔ, nɛ o ye lakpa ngɔ tsɔɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ o kɛ zugba a yi ni ɔ fã ko to se?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Benɛ e ngɛ ɔ, pi o nɔ ʼi, nɛ benɛ o jua hu ɔ, sika a pi mo nitse o nɔ lo? Mɛni he je o susu kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ ko ngɛ o tsui mi? Tsa pi nimli nɛ o ye lakpa ngɔ tsɔɔ nɛ ɔ, se Mawu mohu ʼi.”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Anania nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e nɔ si nɛ e gbo. Nɛ gbeye ngua nu ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Nihewi ɔmɛ te si, nɛ a ba dla gbogboe ɔ, nɛ a wo lɛ kɛ je kpo nɛ a ya pu.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Nɛ maa pee ngmlɛfia etɛ se ɔ, e ba mi kaa e yo ɔ hu nɛ li sane nɛ ba a ba lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Petro bi lɛ ke: “De mi, anɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ jua zugba a ha ji nɛ ɔ lo?” Nɛ Safira ke: “Ee ja ʼi.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de lɛ ke: “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ pee kake nɛ nyɛ ka Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ nɛ ɔ? Oʼɛ, nihi nɛ ho ya pu o huno ɔ a nanehi a nya lɛ ngɛ sinya a nya a nɛ, nɛ a ma wo mo hu kɛ ho.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ e nɔ si ngɛ e nane nya nɛ e gbo. Nɛ benɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba na kaa e gbo ɔ, a wo lɛ kɛ ho nɛ a ya pu ngɛ e huno ɔ kasa nya.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Nɛ gbeye kpetekpleenyɛ nu asafo mluku ɔ tsuo kɛ nihi nɛ nu ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ. Okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: A gu bɔfo ɔmɛ a nine nɔ kɛ pee okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi fuu ngɛ ma a mi; nɛ mɛ tsuo a kɛ juɛmi kake hi Salomo ablanaa a nɔ.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ́ kaa e kɛ yi flɛflɛ ma ya bɔ a he, se maa buu mɛ saminya.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: hluu tete po nɛ a woɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ kɛ baa blɔ ɔmɛ a he ba pueɔ sahi kɛ sa tsohi a nɔ, konɛ ke Petro bee ɔ, e nini kɛkɛ nɛ pue a ti ni kome a nɔ.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi fuu je mahi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ mi ba bua a he nya, nɛ a hɛɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ mɛ haoe ɔ kɛ ba nɛ a tsa mɛ kulaa. A wa bɔfo ɔmɛ yi mi

english_verse: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a te si kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ nɛ ji Sadukifo ɔmɛ a ku ɔ, nɛ a hɛ̃ dɔ wawɛɛ.

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ba nuu bɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ a ya wo mɛ tsu mi.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Se nyɔmi ɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ba bli tsu ɔ sinya amɛ nɛ e je mɛ, nɛ e ke:

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ya sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ nyɛ ya da si nɛ nyɛɛ jaje kikɛmɛ a wami he nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ kulaa ngɔ tsɔɔ maa.”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Nɛ a pee bɔ nɛ a de mɛ ɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ mɔtu mla kɛ ho sɔlemi we ɔ ya nɛ a ya tsɔɔ ni. Jeha nɛ ɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ ba, nɛ a ba tsɛ gua ngua a kɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo kɛ kpe, nɛ a tsɔ kɛ ya tsu ɔ mi konɛ a ya je bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Se benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba lejɛ ɔ, a nɛ mɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a kpale a se ba sɛɛ ke:

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “Tsu ɔ wa na kaa a nga nya kpɛii, nɛ buli ɔmɛ hu daa si ngɛ sinya amɛ a nya; se benɛ wa bli ɔ, wa nɛ́ nɔ ko ngɛ mi.”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Se benɛ osɔfo ɔ kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ ɔ, a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa kaa kɛ enɛ ɔ nyagbeni ma ya ba ha kɛɛ?

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ ko ba ba sɛɛ ha mɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ wo tsu ɔ mi ɔ daa si ngɛ sɔlemi we ngɛ ma a ni tsɔɔe.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya kpaka mɛ kɛ ba, pi kã nya, ejakaa a ngɛ ma a gbeye yee nɛ a ko ba fia mɛ tɛ.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a kɛ mɛ ba a, a kɛ mɛ ba da gua ngua a hɛ mi; nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a bi mɛ ke:

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: “Pi kita nɛ wa wo nyɛ kadikadi ke nyɛ ko tsɔɔ ni ngɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ? Oʼɛ, nyɛ ha Yerusalem hyi tɔ kɛ nyɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae kaa nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ muɔ baa wa nɔ.”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Se Petro kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ he nɔ nɛ a ke: “E sa kaa a buɔ Mawu mohu tue pe nimli.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Yesu nɛ nyɛ sɛu ngɛ tso nɔ nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ ɔ, wa tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ tle lɛ si.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Lɛ e nɔ Mawu wo kɛ ho e hiɛ ɔ nɔ ya, nɛ e wo lɛ ganɔ kɛ yi wami helɔ, konɛ e ha Israel nɛ na tsui tsakemi kɛ yayami pami.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Nɛ wɔ ji kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase yeli, ja nɔuu ji Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Benɛ a nu ɔ, e gbɔ a tsui mi, nɛ a to a yi mi ke a maa gbe mɛ.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Se Farisifono ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gamaliel, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ ma a kulaa buu lɛ ɔ, te si da si ngɛ gua ngua a kpɛti, nɛ efa ke a kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ je kpo bɔɔ,

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ Israelbi, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he, bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ maa ye ha.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ɔ se ɔ Yuda, Galilea no ɔ te si ngɛ nihi a kanemi ligbi ɔmɛ ami, nɛ e muɔ asafo babauu ngɔ pue e se. Lɛ hu e hɛ mi kpata, nɛ nihi nɛ bu lɛ tue ɔ tsuo hu gbɛ fia.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ nyɛ ko di a se, ejakaa ke nimli a dɛ mi kikɛmɛ a yi mi tomi nɛ ɔ loo kikɛmɛ a ni tsumi nɛ ɔ je ɔ, e ma puɛ.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Se ke Mawu dɛ mi e je ɔ, nyɛ be nyɛe ma puɛ; konɛ nyɛ ko ba pee nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ a kɛ Mawu ngɛ ta hwue.”

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Nɛ a bu lɛ tue; nɛ a tsɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a fia mɛ kpa nɛ a wo mɛ kita ke a ko tu munyu ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi hu, nɛ a ngmɛɛ a he.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a je gua ngua a hɛ mi kɛ ho kɛ bua jɔmi kaa e biɛ ɔ he ɔ, a bu mɛ nihi nɛ sa kaa a bɔ mɛ ahlua.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Nɛ daa ligbi ɔ, a jɔɔ we ni tsɔɔmi kɛ Yesu Kristo fiɛmi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ wehi a mi.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi, benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ hiɛe ɔ, munyu huitihuiti ko ba te si ngɛ Helenibi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Hebribi ɔmɛ a he, ejakaa hɛ jee a yalɔyi ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ a daa hyemi ɔ blɔfami.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ tsɛ kaseli asafo ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ a de mɛ ke: “E sɛ kaa wa siɔ Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ wa ya sɔmɔɔ ngɛ okplɔɔ he.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ hla nyɛ kpɛti ni kpaago nɛ ngɛ biɛ kpakpa nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu kɛ ni lemi hyi mɛ tɔ, konɛ waa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to kikɛmɛ a ni tsumi nɛ he hia nɔ nya.

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: Wɔɔ lɛɛ, wa maa hɛɛ sɔlemi kɛ munyu ɔ he sɔmɔmi ɔ mi.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Munyu ɔ sa asafo mluku ɔ tsuo hɛ mi; nɛ a hia Stefano, nyumu ko nɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hyi lɛ tɔ ɔ, kɛ Filipo kɛ Prokoro kɛ Nikanora kɛ Timon kɛ Parmena kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a he piɛlɔ Nikolao nɛ je Antiokia a,

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ba da bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; nɛ a sɔle nɛ a kɛ a ninehi pue a nɔ.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu munyu ɔ blɛke, nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a he ba hiɛ babauu ngɛ Yerusalem; nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ tete po a kpɛti nihi fuu buɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tue. A nu Stefano

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Nɛ Stefano, nɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ he wami hyi lɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ, pee nyakpɛ nihi kɛ okadi nguahi ngɛ ma a mi.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Se ni kome nɛ je kpe he nɛ a tsɛɛ Nihi nɛ ye a he ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔ, kɛ Kireenebi kɛ Aleksandriabi kɛ nihi nɛ je Kilikia kɛ Asia a, a ti ni kome te si nɛ a kɛ Stefano sa nya.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Se a nyɛ we ni lemi kɛ mumi nɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ nya nɛ a da.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, a ya wo ni komɛ yi nɛ a ba de ke: “Wa nu kaa e tuɔ Mose kɛ Mawu he musu bɔmi munyuhi.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Nɛ a wo ma bi ɔmɛ kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli amɛ yi, nɛ a te si kɛ ba pue e nɔ nɛ a ba nu lɛ, nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ya gua ngua a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Nɛ a kɛ lakpa odase yeli ba da si, nɛ a de ke: “Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ jɔɔ we munyu tumi kɛ He Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ Mlaa a simi gblee;

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: ejakaa wa nu kaa e de ke: ‘Yesu Nazare no ɔ, ma puɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma tsake blɔnyahi nɛ Mose ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ gua ngua a mi ɔ tsuo dɔ a hɛngmɛ ngɔ to e nɔ, nɛ a na e hɛ mi kaa Mawu bɔfo ko hɛ mi.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a bi Stefano ke: “Anɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ja lo?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Nɛ Stefano ke: “Mamimɛ kɛ Tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue. Hɛ mi nyami Mawu ɔ je e he kpo tsɔɔ wa tsɛ Abraham, benɛ e ngɛ Mesopotamia, nɛ e na we nɛ e ba hi Haran ɔ,

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Jee o zugba a nɔ kɛ o weku mi kɛ ya zugba niɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ.’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e je Kaldeabi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ya hi Haran. Nɛ benɛ e tsɛ gbo se ɔ, Mawu ha e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba kikɛmɛ a zugba nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ;

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: nɛ e hi lɛ zugba ko, bɔ nɛ a kɛ nane maa nɔ tete. Se e wo lɛ si kaa e ma ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ e nina nɛ ma ngɛ e se ɔ kaa a nɔ́, pohu jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e be bi po.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Se bɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ tu munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘E nina ma ya to nibwɔ ngɛ ma se zugba ko nɔ, nɛ a maa ye mɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ a maa wa mɛ yi mi jeha lafa eywiɛ.’

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu ke: ‘Ma kojo jamɛ a ma nɛ a ma ya sɔmɔ ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ a maa je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba ja mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu ngɔ nɔ pomi he somi ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ. Nɛ somi nɛ ɔ mi e fɔ Isak ngɛ, nɛ e po lɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ. Nɛ Isak fɔ Yakob, nɛ Yakob fɔ blematsɛmɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: nɛ e je lɛ ngɛ dengmehi kulaa mi, nɛ e ha e hɛ mi ba nyami, nɛ e ha e le ni ngɛ Mizraim matsɛ Farao hɛ mi, nɛ e wo lɛ ganɔ ngɛ Mizraim kɛ lɛ nitse e we ɔ kulaa nɔ.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Se hwɔ kɛ dengme kpetekpleenyɛ ba Mizraim ke Kanaan zugba a tsuo kulaa nɔ, nɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ́ ni nɛ a ye.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Yakob nu kaa blɛfo ngɛ Mizraim ɔ, kekleekle ɔ, e tsɔ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji si enyɔ ɔ, Yosef ha e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ yo lɛ, nɛ Farao hu ba le Yosef weku ɔ.

english_verse: Joseph sent for his father and his relatives. In all, there were
translation_verse: Nɛ Yosef tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ Yakob kɛ e weku ɔ tsuo kɛ ba, a yi bɔ ji nyingmi kpaago kɛ enuɔ.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Yakob pue nɔ kɛ ho Mizraim ya, nɛ lɛ kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ba Shekem, nɛ a ba pu mɛ ngɛ gɔ nɛ Abraham je sika kɛ he ngɛ Shekem tsɛ Hemor bi ɔmɛ a dɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: “Se benɛ si womi be ɔ nɛ Mawu ka Abraham he kita a su ɔ, ma a ba kle, nɛ a he ba hiɛ ngɛ Mizraim zugba a nɔ,

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: kɛ ya su be nɛ matsɛ kpa nɛ li Yosef ɔ ba ye Mizraim nɔ.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi si ngɛ sisimi blɔ nɔ nɛ e pee mɛ yayami, kaa e ha a sake a bimɛ bimwɔwi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he, benɛ pee nɛ a ko hi je mi.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu a fɔ Mose. E he ngɛ fɛu ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a lɛ lɛ ngɛ e tsɛ we ɔ hlami etɛ.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ he ɔ, Farao biyo ɔ ya wo lɛ, nɛ e lɛ lɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ pee lɛ nitse e bi.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: A tsɔɔ Mose Mizraim nile tsuo, nɛ e na he wami ngɛ munyuhi kɛ ni tsumihi a mi.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e na kaa a ngɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake yayami pee ɔ, e fã e he, nɛ e to Mizraim no nɛ a ngɛ lɛ yayami pee ɔ nane mi, nɛ e gbe Mizraim no ɔ.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: E nɔ je na a, e ba na nyɛmimɛ enyɔ komɛ nɛ a ngɛ kunɔ nɔe, nɛ e kpata mɛ ke: ‘Tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛmimɛ ji nyɛ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he yayami pee nɛ ɔ?’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ pee e nyɛmi yayami ɔ tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ ya se nɛ e ke: ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ wo mo wa nɔ ganɔ kɛ kojolɔ?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o gbe mi kaa bɔ nɛ o gbe Mizraim no ɔ hiɛ ɔ?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ ɔ he ɔ Mose tu fo nɛ e ya to nibwɔ ngɛ Midian zugba a nɔ, nɛ e fɔ bimɛ nyumuhi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ se ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ Sinai yoku ɔ he nga a nɔ ngɛ la lilɛ mi ngɛ pu ko mi.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Mose na a, e hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa ngɛ ni nami ɔ he. Nɛ benɛ e ngɛ lɛ hɛe kɛ ngɛ he sue konɛ e hyɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbi de lɛ ke:

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‘Imi ji o tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ, Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ.’ Nɛ Mose he do blibliibli nɛ e ka kaa e ma ya hyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke: ‘Je o tokota amɛ ngɛ o nane, ejakaa he nɛ o daa si ngɛ ɔ, zugba klɔuklɔu ʼi.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: I na ye ma nɛ ngɛ Mizraim ɔ a dengme ɔ, nɛ a zanuelami ɔ hu i nu, nɛ i kple si kɛ ma mɛ jemi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ba nɛ ma tsɔ mo Mizraim.’

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: “Jamɛ a Mose ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ a kua nɛ a de ke: ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ wo mo wa nɔ ganɔ kɛ kojolɔ’ ɔ, lɛ kɛ̃ Mawu gu bɔfo ɔ nɛ je e he kpo tsɔɔ le ngɛ pu ɔ mi ɔ nɔ tsɔ lɛ kaa ganɔ kɛ kpɔlɔ.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e kpaka mɛ ke je kpo, nɛ e pee nyakpɛ nihi kɛ okadihi ngɛ Mizraim zugba a nɔ kɛ Wotsu ɔ mi kɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Lɛ ji jamɛ a Mose nɛ de Israelbi ɔmɛ ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma tle gbalɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa imi si kɛ maa je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɔ ha nyɛ; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue.’

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Mose ji nɔ nɛ kɛ asafo ɔ hi nga a nɔ nɛ e da bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ Sinai yoku ɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ e he wami munyu ɔmɛ ba ha wɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ɔ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we nɛ a bu lɛ tue se mohu a hɛɛ lɛ soisoi, nɛ a tsui kpale kɛ ho Mizraim ya ekohu,

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Nɛ jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a pee na bi, nɛ a sa bɔ ngɔ ha amaga a, nɛ a na mɛ nitse a nine nya ni tsumi ɔmɛ a he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Se Mawu plɛ e he nɛ e ngmɛɛ a he kaa a ja hiɔwe nihi, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔ mi ke: ‘Nyɛ Israel we, Anɛ imi nɛ nyɛ sã lohwehi kɛ ni yeni bɔ ɔ ngɔ ha Ngɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Molok bo tsu mohu nyɛ wo tloo Kɛ nyɛ Mawu Remfan ɔ dodoe ɔ nɛ ji amagahi Nɛ nyɛ puɛ nɛ nyɛ jaa mɛ ɔ; Nɛ Babilon se ma muɔ nyɛ kɛ maa ho.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: “Watsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛ odase Bo Tsu ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ. A pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ke e pee lɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji kaa bɔ nɛ e na a.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Benɛ watsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nine su nɔ ɔ, a kɛ Yosua hɛɛ kɛ ba majeli nɛ Mawu fie ngɛ watsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ a zugba a nɔ. Hiɛ ɔ e hi kɛ ba su David be ɔ mi.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Lɛ e hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi nɛ e kpa pɛɛ ke e maa pee sihi he ko ngɔ ha Yakob Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Se Salomo ma tsu ha lɛ.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,

translation_verse: Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu, e fiɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji Mawu bi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi kulaa nɛ nu ɔ nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a ke: “Anɛ pi nɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ kpataa nihi nɛ tɛliɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a hɛ mi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo? Nɛ hiɛ ɔ hu tete, lɔ ɔ nɔuu he e ba ngɛ, konɛ e ba fi mɛ nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ ya osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ?”

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Be saii se ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ ya sae yi nɔ ke a maa gbe lɛ.

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: Se Saulo ba nu a somi ɔ he. Nɛ a buu ma a agbo ɔmɛ a nya daa nyɔ kɛ pia benɛ pee nɛ a gbe lɛ.

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Se kaseli ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ wo kusii mi nyɔ mi, nɛ a siu lɛ kɛ gu gli ɔ nɔ kɛ ya ma si. Saulo ngɛ Yerusalem

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Se Barnaba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya bɔfo ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya sɛɛ ha mɛ bɔ nɛ Paulo na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ tu munyu, kɛ bɔ nɛ e pee kã ngɛ Yesu biɛ ɔ mi ngɛ Damasko.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kɛ mɛ yaa baa ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ e pee kã ngɛ Yesu biɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kɛ Helenebi ɔmɛ tu munyu nɛ e kɛ mɛ hla nihi a nya; se mɛɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nu he ɔ, a ya sɛ lɛ Kaisarea, nɛ a ha e ho Tarso ya.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ asafo ɔ na he jɔmi ngɛ Yudea kɛ Galilea kɛ Samaria tsuo, nɛ a nane nu si, nɛ a nyɛɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye yemi mi, nɛ a he sange mɛ ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ bua womi mi. Petro ngɛ Lida kɛ Yopa

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: E ba mi kaa benɛ Petro ya kpa he ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, e ba ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ Lida a hu a ngɔ.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ba na nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ainea nɛ e fɔɔ si ngɛ sa nɔ kɛ kuɔmi hiɔ jeha kpaanyɔ sɔuu.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Nɛ Petro de lɛ ke: “Ainea, Yesu Kristo ngɛ mo tsae; tee si nɛ mo nitsɛ o dla o sa a!” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ, e te si.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Lida kɛ Saron ɔ na lɛ, nɛ a tsake kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Se yo kaselɔ ko ngɛ Yopa nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tabita, e sisi ji Dorka . Lɛɛ e hyi tɔ kɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi kɛ ohiafohi a hyemi.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Se e ba mi kaa jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, e ba nu hiɔ nɛ e gbo. A du ha lɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ hiɔwe tsu ko mi.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ Lida kɛ Yopa kɛ we, nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ nu kaa Patro ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a tsɔ nyumuhi enyɔ kɛ ya e ngɔ ya kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e ko hlua si, se e ba a ngɔ oya.

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Petro te si nɛ e kɛ mɛ ho. Nɛ benɛ e su lejɛ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ ya hiɔwe tsu ɔ mi, nɛ yaloyi ɔmɛ tsuo ba daa si ngɛ e kasa nya ngɛ ya foe, nɛ a kɛ gugue tadehi kɛ tadehi nɛ Dorka pee benɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ ngɛ lɛ tsɔɔe.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Nɛ Petro fie mɛ kulaa kɛ je kpo, nɛ e kpla si nɛ e sɔle, nɛ e plɛ e he kɛ ya nɔ gbogboe ɔ ngɔ nɛ e ke: “Tabita, tee si!” Nɛ e bli e hɛngmɛ, nɛ benɛ e na Petro ɔ, e te si hi si.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Nɛ Petro nu e nine si, nɛ e wo e nɔ; nɛ e tsɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba da a hɛ mi hɛkalɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ a nu he ngɛ Yopa tsuo, nɛ nihi fuu he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ ye.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Nɛ Petro hi Yopa be saii ngɛ Simon, lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Nyumu ko ngɛ Kaisarea nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kornelio nɛ ji Italia aslaafo ɔmɛ a nɔ Sasafoatsɛ.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: Mawu jalɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e kɛ e we ɔ tsuo yee Mawu gbeye, nɛ e peɔ ma mi bi ɔmɛ kpakpahi fuu, nɛ e kpaa Mawu pɛɛ daa.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko gbɔkuɛ maa pee ngmlɛ etɛ mi ɔ, e na ngɛ ninami mi paa kaa Mawu bɔfo ko ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke: “Kornelio!”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Nɛ e hyɛ lɛ too, nɛ e ye gbeye nɛ e ke: “Mo mɛnɔ ʼi, Nyɔmtsɛ?” Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke: “O sɔlemihi kɛ ni kpakpahi nɛ o peɔ ɔ ba su hiɔwe nɛ, e pee kaimi nɔ́ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa nɛ o ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: E ya to Simon lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ɔ nɛ we ngɛ wo ɔ nya a ngɔ.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Benɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ lɛ ba tu munyu ɔ je ɔ, e tsɛ e webi ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ kɛ aslaafono ko nɛ yee Mawu gbeye nɛ ji nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake,

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: nɛ e sɛɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ ha mɛ, nɛ e tsɔ mɛ Yopa.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Enɔ je na a, benɛ a nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a maa su ma a mi ɔ, Petro ho sɔlemi ya ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi, maa pee ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Hwɔ ye lɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ ko hlae nɛ e ye. Se benɛ a ngɛ niyeni ɔ pee ɔ, e pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ́ nɔ e nɔ,

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: nɛ e na kaa hiɔwe nya bli, nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ si kplee kaa bo ngua nɛ a hɛɛ e kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔ mi nɛ a ngɛ siue kɛ ma zugba.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Zugba nɔ lohwe nane eywiɛeywiɛtsɛmɛ kɛ waami lohwehi, kɛ hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsmɛ slɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo eko ngɛ mi.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Nɛ gbi ko de lɛ ke: “Petro, tee si, gbee nɛ o ye!”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Se Petro ke: “Dɛbi, Nyɔmtsɛ, ejakaa i yi yakayaka nɔ́ ko loo nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we hyɛ.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Nɛ gbi ɔ kpale de lɛ nɔ nɛ ji si enyɔ ke: “Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu tsukɔ he ɔ, koo bu lɛ kaa yakayaka nɔ́ ko.”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: A pee ja si etɛ, nɛ a wo nɔ́ ɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ekohu.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Petro dɛ yaa kaa kɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ e na nɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ ɔ, oʼɛ, nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ Kornelio tsɔ ɔ ngɛ Simon we ɔ si bie, nɛ a ba da agbo ɔ nya.

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Petro ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e na a he susue ɔ, Mumi ɔ de lɛ ke: “Oʼɛ nyumuhi etɛ komɛ ngɛ mo hlae.

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro kple si, nɛ e ya de nyumu ɔmɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ nɛ; mɛni sane he nyɛ ba ngɛ?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Nɛ a ke: “Asafoatsɛ Kornelio, nɛ ji nyumu dalɔ kɛ Mawu gbeye yelɔ nɛ Yudafohi a ma mluku ɔ kulaa tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa a, lɛ hiɔwe bɔfo klɔuklɔu ko de lɛ ke e tsɔ nɛ a ba kpee mo kɛ ba e we ɔ mi, konɛ e bu o nya munyu tue.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro tsɛ mɛ kɛ ba we ɔ mi nɛ e ba pee mɛ nibwɔ. Nɛ e nɔ je na a, Petro kɛ mɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Yopa a a ti ni komɛ piɛ e he.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: E nɔ je na ekohu ɔ, a ya su Kaisarea. Kornelio ngɛ mɛ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ e tsɛ e wekuli kɛ e huɛmɛ kpakpahi kɛ ba kpe.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ Petro ngɛ we ɔ mi sɛe ɔ, Kornelio kɛ lɛ ba kpe, nɛ e ba bu si ngɛ e nane nya nɛ e ja lɛ.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Se Petro wo e nɔ, nɛ e ke: “Tee si, se imi hu nɔmlɔ ji mi.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Nɛ e kɛ lɛ ngɛ ni sɛɛe kɛ ya sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ eya na nihi babauu nɛ ba bua a he nya a.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Nɛ Petro de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le bɔ nɛ Yuda no be he blɔ kaa e kɛ nɔ ko nɛ ji ma kpã mi no bɔɔ aloo e baa e ngɔ. Se imi lɛɛ, Mawu tsɔɔ mi ke ma ko tsɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yaka nɔmlɔ, loo nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we.

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Kornelio ha heto ke: “Mwɔnɔ ji ligbi eywiɛ ɔ, i ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ ye we ɔ mi maa pee gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ etɛ mi; nɛ oʼɛ, nyumu ko nɛ wo tade klaiklai ba da ye hɛ mi,

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: nɛ e ke: ‘Kornelio, a bu o sɔlemi ɔ tue, nɛ o ni kpakpahi nɛ o peɔ ɔ hu a kai ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa, nɛ a ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba. E ya to Simon lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ɔ nɛ we ngɛ wo ɔ nya a ngɔ.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ i tsɔ o ngɔ, nɛ o pee saminya kaa o ba. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ ɔ wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, konɛ waa bu nihi tsuo kulaa nɛ Mawu de mo ngɔ to ɔ tue.” Petro munyu nɛ e tu

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro pa e nya mi nɛ e ke: “Niinɛ, i kpa si kaa Mawu pi nimli a hɛ mi hyɛlɔ;

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: se mohu ma tsuaa ma mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ yee lɛ gbeye nɛ e tsuɔ dami nihi ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ saa e hɛ mi.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔ nɛ a kɛ munyu ɔ ya ha Israelbi, nɛ a gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ jaje he jɔmi sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, lɛ ji nihi tsuo a Nyɔmtsɛ.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le sane ɔ nɛ ba ngɛ Yudea tsuo, nɛ e je sisi kɛ je Galilea, ngɛ baptisimi nɛ Yohane fiɛ ɔ se ɔ,

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu kɛ he wami ngɔ pɔ Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ nu, nɛ e kpaa si peɔ kpakpa, nɛ e tsaa nihi kulaa nɛ abosiami haoɔ mɛ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu kɛ lɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Nɛ wɔ ji nihi tsuo kulaa nɛ e pee ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ Yerusalem ɔ he odase yeli; nɔ nɛ a sɛu ngɛ tso nɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔuu Mawu tle si ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ paa,

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: tsa pi ma mluku ɔ tsuo, se mohu odase yeli nɛ Mawu hla ngɔ to momo ɔ, nɛ ji wɔ nihi nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ye ni nɛ waa kɛ lɛ nu, benɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ se ɔ.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Nɛ e wo wɔ kita ke waa fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a nɛ waa ye odase kaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ Mawu je ngɔ to nɛ e kojo hɛ kali kɛ ni gbogboehi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Lɛ e he odase gbali ɔmɛ kulaa yeɔ, kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ ma na e he yayami pami ngɛ e biɛ ɔ he.” Majemajeli ɔmɛ na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Benɛ Petro ngɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue nɔuu ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba nihi tsuo nɛ nu munyu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yudafohi nɛ he ye nɛ a kɛ Petro ba a nya kpɛ a he kaa a nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɔke nɔ ɔ ngɔ pue majemajeli ɔmɛ hu a nɔ.

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: Ejakaa a nu kaa a ngɛ ma se munyuhi slɔɔtohi tue, nɛ a ngɛ Mawu yi jee. Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro he nɔ ke:

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: “Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ nyu nya maa tsi, nɛ a ko baptisi ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ka wɔ kɛ̃ ɔ lo?”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Nɛ e fa ke a baptisi mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ ɔ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si be bɔɔ ko.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a tsuo nu kaa majeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ hu pɛtɛ Mawu munyu ɔ he.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Petro ba Yerusalem ɔ, nihi nɛ je ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ kɛ lɛ na,

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: a ke: “O ya mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ a ngɔ nɛ o kɛ mɛ ya ye ni.”

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Se Petro je sisi nɛ e bɔ mɛ amaniɛ ɔ tsuo ke:

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: “I ngɛ Yopa ma a mi i ngɛ sɔlee, nɛ e pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ nɔ ye nɔ, nɛ i na ninami ko kaa nɔ́ ko je hiɔwe kaa bo ngua ko nɛ a hɛɛ e kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a ngɛ siue kɛ ma zugba, nɛ e ba ye ngɔ tataata.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Se benɛ i hyɛ mi too ɔ, i na zugba lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛmɛ kɛ nga mi lohwehi kɛ waami nihi kɛ hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ngɛ mi.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Nɛ i nu gbi ko hu nɛ de mi ke: ‘Petro, tee si, gbee nɛ o ye!’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Se i de ke: ‘Dɛbi, Nyɔmtsɛ, ejakaa i yi yakayaka nɔ́ ko loo nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we hyɛ.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Se gbi nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ he nɔ nɔ́ nɛ ji si enyɔ ke: ‘Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu tsukɔ he ɔ, mo ko bu lɛ yakayaka nɔ́ ko.’

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: A pee jã si etɛ, nɛ a sa kulaa kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ekohu,

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ nyumuhi etɛ ba da we he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ agbo ɔ nya; a tsɔ mɛ kɛ je Kaisarea kɛ ba ye ngɔ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Nɛ mumi ɔ de mi ke i kɛ mɛ nɛ ya nɛ ma ko to tslee. Nyɛmimɛ ekpa nɛ ɔmɛ hu kɛ mi ya; nɛ wa ya sɛ nyumu ɔ we ɔ mi.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Nɛ e sɛɛ wɔ bɔ nɛ e na bɔfo ɔ ngɛ e we ɔ mi nɛ e daa si nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa nɛ o ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba,

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: lɛ e ma de mo munyuhi nɛ a maa gu nɔ kɛ he mo kɛ o we ɔ kulaa yi wami.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: Se benɛ i bɔni munyu ɔ tumi ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba ma a nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ e ba ma wɔ hu wa nɔ kekle ɔ.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Nɛ i kai Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ nɛ e tu ke: ‘Yohane ɔ, e kɛ nyu baptisi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ a maa baptisi nyɛ kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu’ ɔ.

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ ke Mawu ha mɛ jamɛ a nɔke nɔ́ ɔ nɔuu nɛ e ha wɔ nɛ wa heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu nɔ yeɔ hulɔ ɔ, imi lɛɛ, mɛnɔ ji mi nɛ ma nyɛ Mawu nya ma tsi?”

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Se benɛ a nu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ma a nya, nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami de ke: ‘Lɛɛ majeli ɔmɛ hu Mawu ha mɛ tsui tsakemi nɛ a kɛ he a yi wami!’ Antiokia asafo ɔ

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ nihi nɛ gbɛ fia ngɛ Stefano amanenlu ɔ mi ɔ po mi kɛ ya Foinike kɛ Kipro kɛ Antiokia lokoo, se a fiɛ we munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ we nɔ ko nɔ ko kaa ja Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Se a ti ni komɛ ɔ, Kiprobihi kɛ Kireenebihi ji mɛ, nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ba Antiokia ba tu munyu tsɔɔ Helabi ɔmɛ hulɔ, nɛ a fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu he sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ a he, nɛ nihi babauu he ye, nɛ a tsake kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
