english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Nɛ a he sane nɛ ɔ ba su Yerusalem asafo ɔ tue mi, nɛ a tsɔ Barnaba Antiokia.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e su lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ba na Mawu dloomi ɔ, e bua jɔ e he, nɛ e tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ tsuo ke a kɛ tsui nɛ fi si nɛ pɛtɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ nɛ e hyi tɔ kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu kɛ hemi kɛ yemi. Nɛ a ngɔ nihi babauu kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ba mi kaa a kɛ asafo ɔ hi si jeha mluku, nɛ a tsɔɔ nihi babauu ni, nɛ Antiokia ji he nɛ a wo kaseli ɔmɛ biɛ kekleekle ngɛ ke Kristofohi.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Se kikɛmɛ a be nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, gbali komɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ba Antiokia.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Nɛ a kpɛti nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Agabo ɔ te si, nɛ e tsɔɔ ngɛ Mumi ɔ nya kaa hwɔ kpetekpleenyɛ maa ba je mi tsuo kulaa, nɛ e ba mi ja ngɛ Kaisare Klaudio yi nɔ.

english_verse: The followers in Antioch decided to send whatever help they could to the followers in Judea.
translation_verse: Kaseli ɔmɛ kpɛ mi kaa a ma tsu nɔ́ ko ngɔ mane nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a nɛ a kɛ ya pɛne mɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ bɔ nɛ o ma nyɛ.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɛ a pee ja, nɛ a ngɔ mane nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ gu Barnaba kɛ Saulo nɔ.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, matsɛ Herode wo e nine nɔ, konɛ e pee asafo ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ yayami.

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: E kɛ klaate gbe Yohane nyɛmi Yakobo.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e na kaa e ngɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ a nya a, e ya nɔ nɛ e nu Petro hulɔ. Se akpiti ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ʼi.

english_verse: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e nu lɛ ɔ, e wo lɛ tsu mi, nɛ e tu lɛ ngɔ wo aslaafohi eywiɛeywiɛ kuhi eywiɛ dɛ mi nɛ a bu e he. E susu kaa Hetsɔmi ɔ se ɔ e kɛ lɛ maa ba ma a hɛ mi.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a tsi Petro nya ngɛ tsu ɔ mi mohu, se asafo ɔ hɛɛ sɔlemi mi kɛ ha lɛ wawɛɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. A je Petro ngɛ tsu mi

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Herode ke e kɛ lɛ maa ba ma a hɛ mi ɔ, jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Petro hwɔɔ si ngɛ aslaafohi enyɔ a kpɛti, nɛ a wo lɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔhi enyɔ, nɛ buli hu daa si ngɛ sinya a nya ngɛ tsu ɔ he bue.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Nɛ oʼɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba da e kasa nya, nɛ la kpɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi. Bɔfo ɔ gba Petro kasa ma nɛ e tsɛ̃ɛ lɛ ke: “Tee si esɔesɔ!” Nɛ e kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kplɔ ngɛ e nine.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Mia nɛ o fi o tokota amɛ!” Nɛ Petro pee ja. Nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Haa o bo ɔ nɛ o nyɛɛ ye se!”

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: Se benɛ a be kekle buli ɔmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ji enyɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a su dade agbo nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa ma a mi ɔ he nɛ lɛ nitse e bli ha mɛ, nɛ a je kpo kɛ po gbɛjegbɛ kake mi, kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ si lɛ.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Petro hɛ mi tsɔ lɛ ɔ, e ke: “Kpaako i na le tutuutu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔ e bɔfo kɛ ba nɛ e ba je mi ngɛ Herode dɛ mi kɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a ma a ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ kulaa mi.”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e yo enɛ ɔ ɔ, e ba Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ nyɛ Maria we ɔ mi, he nɛ nihi fuu ba bua a he nya ngɛ nɛ a ngɛ sɔlee ɔ.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Petro si agbo ɔ, yiheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Rode ɔ ba tue bumi.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: Benɛ e yo Petro gbi ɔ, bua jɔmi sɔuu nya a, e bli we agbo ɔ, se mohu e tu fo kɛ ho ya de ke Petro daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ se.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Se a de lɛ ke: “O nu godo.” Se e ma nɔ mi ke e ngɛ mi ja. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ke: “Lɛɛ e dbɔfo ʼi.”

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Se Petro ngɛ nɔ ngɛ sie, nɛ benɛ a bli ɔ, a na lɛ, nɛ a nya kpɛ a he.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: Se e wo mɛ nine ke a pee kɔ, nɛ e bɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je lɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ; nɛ e ke: “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya sɛɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha Yakobo kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.” Nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho he kpa ya.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Benɛ je na a, pi haomi bi nɛ ba aslaafo ɔmɛ a kpɛti akɛnɛ a li nɔ́ nɛ ba Petro nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Se benɛ Herode hla lɛ nɛ e nɛ́ lɛ ɔ, e kojo buli ɔmɛ nɛ e fa ke a gbe mɛ. Nɛ Herode si Yudea kɛ ho Kaisarea ya nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Herode gbenɔ

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ Herode muklii mi fu Tirobi ɔmɛ kɛ Zidonbi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ; nɛ a kɛ juɛmi kake ba e ngɔ. A ba hla matsɛ ɔ sɔmɔlɔ Blasto ɔ he blɔ nɛ a ba kpa pɛɛ, ejakaa matsɛ ɔ zugba nɔ ni a yeɔ.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Se ligbi nɛ a to ko nɔ ɔ, Herode wo e matsɛ tade ɔ, nɛ e ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Nɛ ni ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa ke: “Mawu gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, se tsa pi nɔmlɔ gbi ʼi.”

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo fia lɛ nɔ, ejakaa e kɛ nyami ɔ ha we Mawu, nɛ e wo gɔgɔ, nɛ e gbo.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Benɛ Barnaba kɛ Saulo gbe a sɔmɔmi ɔ nya a, a kpale a se kɛ je Yerusalem, nɛ a ngɔ Yohane, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ ngɔ piɛ a he.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Gbali kɛ tsɔɔli komɛ ngɛ Antiokia asafo ɔ mi, mɛ ji Barnaba kɛ Simeon, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Niger ɔ, kɛ Lukio Kireene no ɔ, kɛ Manahen, nɔ nɛ a lɛ lɛ kɛ amlalo Herode ɔ, kɛ Saulo.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ jae nɛ a ngɛ hwɔ hae ɔ. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ke: “Nyɛ je Barnaba kɛ Saulo ngɔ ha mi kɛ ha ni tsumi nɛ i tsɛ mɛ ngɛ he ɔ.”

english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a ha hwɔ nɛ a sɔle, nɛ a kɛ a ninehi pue a nɔ nɛ a wo mɛ blɔ. Saulo kɛ Barnaba ngɛ Kipro

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsɔ mɛ ke a ya he je ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho Seleukia ya, nɛ a sɛ lɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a hia kɛ ho Kipro ya.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Benɛ a su Salami ɔ, a fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ. Nɛ a kɛ Yohane hu nyɛɛ kaa a sɔmɔlɔ.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a po mi ngɛ zugba kpɔ nɛ nyu bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ba su Pafo ɔ, a na Yuda no kunya yelɔ kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Bar-yesu ɔ,

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ ngɛ amlaalo Sergio Paulo ngɔ lɛ be ɔ mi ɔ. Sergio Paulo ji nyumu hɛ si kalɔ ko; lɛ nɛ e tsɛ Barnaba kɛ Saulo kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ngɛ hlae nɛ e bu Mawu munyu ɔ tue.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Se Elima, kunya yelɔ ɔ ka nɛ e tsi a nya, nɛ e ngɛ hlae nɛ e kpale amlaalo ɔ kɛ je hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Nɛ Saulo, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Paulo hulɔ, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hyi lɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ, hyɛ lɛ too,

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: nɛ e ke: “Oo, abosiami bi nɛ sisimi kɛ kutupɔ tsuo hyi mo tɔtɔɔtɔ, mo dami kulaa henyɛlɔ; anɛ o be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ tlɔmɔɔ ɔmɛ a kpemi jɔɔe?

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ oʼɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nine fɔɔ si ngɛ o nɔ, nɛ o hɛ ma yu, nɛ o be pu hyɛe kɛ yaa su be ko.” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ afua kɛ diblii wo lɛ, nɛ e lilaa si ngɛ nihi hlae nɛ a ta e dɛ mi nɛ a ya je lɛ blɔ.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ amlaalo ɔ, benɛ e na nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ, e he ye, nɛ e he nya si lɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔɔmi ɔ he. Paulo ba Antiokia nɛ ngɛ Pisidia a

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Benɛ Paulo kɛ e nimli ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Pafo ɔ, a ba Perge ngɛ Pamfilia; nɛ Yohane kpale ngɛ a se, snɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho Yerusalem ya ekohu.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a je Perge nɛ a po mi kɛ ba Antiokia ngɛ Pisidia. A ya kpe he ɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ nɛ a ya hi si.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a kane a Mlaa a kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔ se ɔ, kpe he ɔ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɔ ba de mɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, ke nyɛ ngɛ munyu kɛ tsɔɔmi ko nɛ nyɛ maa tu ngɔ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ tu.”

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo te si da si, nɛ e fɔ e nine nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ Israel nyumuhi kɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yee Mawu gbeye, nyɛɛ bu tue!

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a Israel ma nɛ ɔ Mawu lɛ hla wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ benɛ a ya to nibwɔ ngɛ Mizraim zugba a nɔ ɔ, e wo ma a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e nine nɛ e wo nɔ ɔ je mɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ bɔ nɛ gbali ɔmɛ de ɔ ko ba nyɛ nɔ ke:

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: nɛ e kpata majemaje ma kpaago hɛ mi ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ, nɛ ye dla a zugba a mi ngɔ ha mɛ, konɛ e plɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e kpa lɛ ɔ, e wo David nɔ, nɛ e wo lɛ a nɔ matsɛ, nɔ nɛ he odase nɛ e ye ke: ‘I na David, Ishai bi ɔ, nyumu nɛ i ngɛ e he tsui, nɔ nɛ maa pee ye suɔmi nya ni ɔmɛ kulaa.’

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ɔ nina mi Mawu je Yesu kɛ je, dngɛ si womi ɔ nya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ pee Israel yi wami helɔ.

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: Yohane sɛ hlami ba fiɛ baptisimi nɛ a kɛ naa tsui tsakemi ngɔ tsɔɔ Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo kulaa.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Nɛ loko Yohane maa gbe e nitsumi ɔ nya a, e ke: ‘Mɛnɔ nyɛ susuu kaa i ji? Tsa pi imi ji nɔ nɛ blɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ. Se oʼɛ, nɔ ko ma ngɛ ye se, nɛ i sɛ́ nɔ nɛ pɛneɔ e tokota ngɛ e nane.’

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, Abraham nina kɛ nyɛ kpɛti nihi nɛ yee Mawu gbeye, nyɛ a kɛ kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi muyu nɛ ɔ ba ha.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ kɛ a ma a mi nikɔtɔma amɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ a li Yesu, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu anui gbali ɔmɛ a munyu nɛ a kaneɔ daa Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a bu lɛ fɔ nɛ lɔ ɔ ha gbali ɔmɛ a gbami ɔmɛ ba mi.

english_verse: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a ha nihi kulaa nɛ a ngma ngɛ e he ɔ ba mi ɔ, a je lɛ ngɛ tso ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ya to lɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ ko mi.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje;

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: nɛ e je e he kpo ligbihi fuu kɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ je Galilea kɛ ba Yerusalem ɔ, nihi nɛ ji e odase yeli ha ma a.

english_verse: God made a promise to our ancestors. And we are here to tell you the good news
translation_verse: Nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ, si nɛ e wo wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ he sane kpakpa a wa ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ nɛ,

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: kaa kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu Mawu ha e ba mi ha wɔ nɛ wa ji a bimɛ ɔ, kaa nɛ e tle Yesu si kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ La nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi hu ke: ‘Ye bi ji mo, mwɔnɛ i fɔ mo’ ɔ.

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: “Se akɛnɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje nɛ e be e se kpalee kɛ ya puɛmi mi hu he je ɔ, e de kikɛ: ‘Ma ngɔ David dloomi nihi nɛ maa si kpɛii ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he hu nɛ e de ngɛ he kpa ke: ‘O be hae nɛ o nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ na puɛmi’ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: Ejakaa David ɔ, benɛ e tsu Mawu yi mi tomi nya ni ngɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, e gbo nɛ a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ piɛ e tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ e puɛ.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si ɔ puɛ we.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɔ a guu kɛ jajeɔ yayamipami ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa nihi kulaa nɛ a be nyɛ nguɔ nyɛe maa wo ngɛ he ngɛ Mose Mlaa a nya a,

english_verse: But everyone who has faith in Jesus is set free.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, a woɔ lɛ nguɔ.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: ‘Nyɛ he guɛ gbeli, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ pee nyɛ yaa, nɛ nyɛɛ laa; Ejakaa ma tsu ni tsumi ko ngɛ nyɛ yi nɔ, Ni tsumi ko nɛ ke nɔ ko sɛɛ ha nyɛ tete po ɔ, Nyɛ be hee maa ye kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ ”

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Paulomɛ je Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔ, majeli ɔmɛ kpa mɛ pɛɛ ke a ba jaje kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ekohu ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi nɛ ma a nɔ.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Se benɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ kpa a, Yudafohi kɛ nihi nɛ a tsake mɛ ngɔ pee Yudafohi nɛ a yee Mawu gbeye ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu nyɛɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba se, nɛ a tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ a wo mɛ ga ke a pɛtɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ he.

english_verse: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ nɔ ɔ, e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ ma mluku ɔ kulaa ba bua a he nya nɛ a ba bu Mawu munyu ɔ tue.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ na asafo ɔmɛ ɔ, hunga jemi babauu te si ngɛ a mi, nɛ a kɛ munyu tumi-kɛ-simi kɛ musu bɔmi munyu ku nihi nɛ Paulo ngɛ dee ɔ nya.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Nɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba tu munyu kɛ kã ke: “Nyɛ kekle e sa kaa a jajeɔ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ, se akɛnɛ nyɛ kua munyu ɔ nɛ nyɛ bui nyɛ he kaa nyɛ sa neneene wami ɔ he je ɔ, oʼɛ, wa dɔ wa yi kɛ yaa majeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa jã Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo wɔ kita ke: ‘I ngɔ mo ngɔ to kaa majeli ɔmɛ a la, Konɛ o plɛ yi wami hemi kɛ ya su zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Benɛ majeli ɔmɛ nu e nɛ ɔ ɔ, a na bua jɔmi, nɛ a wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ a je ngɔ to neneene wami ɔ he ye.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ gbɛ fia ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi tsuo.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Se Yudafo ɔmɛ wo yihi Mawu gbeye yeli nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ kɛ ma a mi nihi nɛ hɛ mi ka si ɔmɛ a yi mi, nɛ a ha yi mi wami te si ngɔ wo Paulo kɛ Barnaba, nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je a kpo ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a blɛ a nane he bunyuku ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Ikoniom ya.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: E ba mi kaa benɛ a ngɛ Ikoniom ɔ, Paulo kɛ Barnaba ya Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔ nɛ a ya tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ saminya, nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛ Helabi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu he ye.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Se Yudafohi tue gboli ɔmɛ puɛ majeli ɔmɛ a tue, nɛ a ha a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ wo nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a se kɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ kã tu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he munyu, nɛ lɛ hu e ye e dloomi munyu ɔ he odase nɛ e ha a gu a nine nɔ pee okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi fuu.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Se ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a mi gba enyɔ: Fã piɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a he, nɛ fã hu piɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Se benɛ majeli ɔmɛ kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ bu kɛ ba nɛ a ba pee mɛ hãihãi nɛ a fia mɛ tɛ ɔ;

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Nyumu ko ngɛ Listra nɛ e nyɛ we si nɛ e da, se si e hii nɛ e ji nɔ nɛ hule kɛ je e nyɛ muklii mi lokoo nɛ e nyɛɛ we gblee.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Paulo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, e bu lɛ tue. Nɛ benɛ Paulo hyɛ lɛ too nɛ e na kaa e ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kaa a ma tsa lɛ ɔ,

english_verse: and shouted, “Stand up!” The man jumped up and started walking around.
translation_verse: e kɛ gbi wawɛɛ de lɛ ke: “Tee si nɛ o da o nane nɔ tlɔmɔɔ!” Nɛ e hlu ma si nɛ e nyɛɛ.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ ni ɔmɛ na nɔ́ nɛ Paulo pee ɔ, a de ngɛ Likaonia gbi mi ke: “Mawu ɔmɛ plɛ a he kaa nimli kɛ kple si kɛ ba wa ngɔ.”

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Nɛ a tsɛ Barnaba ke Dio, kɛ Paulo hu ke Herme, ejakaa lɛ titli lɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Se Dio osɔfo nɛ ngɛ a ma a agbo ɔ nya a hɛɛ nakuhi kɛ nyinyla kɛ ba agbo ɔ nya, konɛ lɛ kɛ asafo ɔ kɛ sa bɔ.

english_verse: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:
translation_verse: Se benɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Barnaba kɛ Paulo nu he ɔ, a gba a tadehi nɛ a sa fo kɛ ya sɛ asafo ɔ kpɛti kɛ ngmlaa

english_verse: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ, mɛni nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ? wɔ hu nimli adesahi ji wɔ kaa nyɛ nɔuu, nɛ wa ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe, konɛ nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se kɛ je kikɛmɛ a yakayaka ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛ ba Mawu hɛkalɔ ɔ ngɔ, nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba kɛ wo kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ;

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e jɔɔ we lɛ nitsɛ e he odase yemi, se mohu e peɔ kpakpa nɛ e haa hiɔmi jee hiɔwe nɛɛ haa nyɛ, kɛ jehahi nɛ baa ni fuu hulɔ, e kɛ ngma kɛ bua jɔmi woɔ nyɛ tsuihi a mi tɔ.”

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Nɛ a gbo dengme loko a kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsi bɔ nɛ jinɛ ni ɔmɛ maa sã ha mɛ ɔ nya.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Se Yudafohi komɛ je Antiokia kɛ Ikoniom ba lejɛ ɔ ba wo asafo ɔmɛ a yi mi; a fia Paulo tɛ, nɛ a sã lɛ si kɛ je ma a mi, a susu kaa e gbo.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Se benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, e te si nɛ e ho ma a mi ya. Nɛ e nɔ je na a, e kɛ Barnaba pue nɔ kɛ ho Derbe ya. Paulo kɛ Barnaba ba Antiokia ekohu

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Benɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ ma a, nɛ a ha nihi fuu tsake pee kaseli ɔ, a kpale a se kɛ ho Listra kɛ Ikoniom kɛ Antiokia ya.

english_verse: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, “We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: A kpale wo kaseli ɔmɛ a mumi mi wami ɔ he wami, nɛ a tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ ke a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu e sa kaa wa guu dengme fuu mi kɛ sɛɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ a hia nikɔtɔmahi ngɔ to asafo tsuaa asafo nya, nɛ a kɛ sɔlemi kɛ hwɔ hami tu mɛ ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ nɔ nɛ a he ye ɔ dɛ mi.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Nɛ a po mi ngɛ Pisidia nɛ a ba Pamfilia.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a fiɛ munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ Perge ɔ, a ngɔ pue nɔ kɛ ba Atalia.

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: Nɛ a sɛ lɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a hia kɛ ba Antiokia, ngɛ he nɛ a tu mɛ ngɔ wo Mawu dloomi ɔ dɛ mi kɛ ha ni tsumi nɛ a tsu gbe nya a ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ba lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ba bua asafo ɔ nya a, a sɛɛ mɛ nihi nɛ Mawu kɛ mɛ ya tsu ɔ kulaa, kɛ bɔ nɛ e bli blɔ ngɔ ha majeli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Nɛ a kɛ kaseli ɔmɛ hi si be saii.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ je Yudea kɛ ba nɛ a ba tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke: “Ke a pui nyɛ ngɛ Mose Mlaa a nya a, a be nyɛ yiwami nyɛe ma he.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ mɛ sa nya nɛ a kɛ mɛ je nɔ hluu ɔ, a to kaa Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ a ti ni komɛ hu nɛ ya bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔmɛ a ngɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ benɛ asafo ɔ ba je mɛ blɔ ɔ, a gu Foinike kɛ Samaria nɛ a sɛɛ majeli ɔmɛ a tsakemi ɔ he sane ha mɛ, nɛ a kɛ ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo na bua jɔmi wawɛɛ.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a su Yerusalem ɔ, asafo ɔ kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ he mɛ hɛmuɔ, nɛ a sɛɛ nihi kulaa nɛ Mawu kɛ mɛ tsu ɔ ha mɛ.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Se ni komɛ nɛ je Farisifo ɔmɛ a ku ɔ mi nɛ he ye ɔ te si nɛ a de ke: “Ja a po mɛ nɛ a wo mɛ kita ke a ye Mose Mlaa a nɔ.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ba bua a he nya konɛ a hla kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Se benɛ a sa nya hluu ɔ, Petro te si da si, nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa kɛ je lokoo nɛ Mawu hla mi kaa majeli ɔmɛ a nu sane kpakpa a kɛ je ye nya, nɛ a he ye.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu nɛ le tsui mi nihi ɔ ye mɛ odase nɛ e ha mɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ha wɔ ɔ nɔuu,

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: nɛ e hlɛ́ nimli a mi ngɛ waa kɛ mɛ kpɛti, nɛ e kɛ hemi kɛ yemi tsukɔ a tsuihi a he.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jeha nɛ ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ Mawu kae nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ pã tso nɛ waa kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kulaa nyɛ we tloomi fɔ́ɔ kaseli ɔmɛ a ko nɔ?

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Se wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ mohu nɔ a maa gu kɛ he waa kɛ mɛ tsuo yiwami.”

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma a nya nɛ a bu Barnaba kɛ Paulo nɛ sɛɛ mɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi abɔ nɛ Mawu gu a nine nɔ kɛ pee ngɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ tue.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Benɛ a tu munyu ɔta a, Yakobo he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Simeon sɛɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu ba slaa majemajeli ɔmɛ kekle, nɛ e hla a kpɛti ma ko ngɔ ha e biɛ ɔ.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: ‘Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, ma kpale ye se kɛ ba, Nɛ ma dla David bo tsu nɛ ku ɔ ma ma; Nɛ o tsu kokue ɔmɛ hu ma fia ekohu, Nɛ ma tle lɛ si ngɔ ma si;

english_verse: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.
translation_verse: Benɛ pee nɛ nimli nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ kulaa hu Nɛ a kɛ ye biɛ wo mɛ ɔ A hla Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se blɔ.’

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji kaa a ko doo nihi nɛ kpale a se kɛ je majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ ɔ nya tsɔ.

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ejakaa kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ Mose ngɛ nihi nɛ fiɛɔ lɛ ngɛ ma tsuaa ma nɔ, nɛ daa Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ a kaneɔ e womi ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ.” Womi nɛ a ngma mane mejeli nɛ he ye ɔ

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ asafo mluku ɔ kulaa ma nya si kaa a hia nyumuhi komɛ kɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a tsɔ mɛ kɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ ya Antiokia. Mɛ ji Yuda, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Barsaba hulɔ ɔ, kɛ Sila, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nikɔtɔma amɛ.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ngma womi ngɔ ha mɛ ke: “Bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ biɔ nyɛmimɛ nɛ je majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Antiokia kɛ Siria kɛ Kilikia a saminya.

english_verse: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.
translation_verse: e sa wa hɛ mi kaa, nɛ wa nya pee kake nɛ ɔ ɔ, waa hia nihi ngɔ piɛ Barnaba kɛ Paulo nɛ wa suɔ ɔ he

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa tsɛ Yuda kɛ Sila, konɛ mɛ hu a kɛ a nya mi munyu ba jaje kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: Kaa nyɛɛ nyɛ lo nɛ a gbe ha wɔhi kɛ muɔ kɛ lohwehi nɛ a kika a kuɛ kɛ ajuama bɔmi. Ke nyɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ pee saminya. Nyɛɛ hi si saminya!”

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ, benɛ a wo bɔfo ɔmɛ blɔ ɔ, a ba Antiokia, nɛ a ba bua asafo ɔ nya nɛ a je womi ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a kane ɔ, a bua jɔ a he ngɛ a bua womi munyu ɔ he.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Se Yuda kɛ Sila a, akɛnɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu gbali ji mɛ he je ɔ, a kɛ munyuhi babauu jɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a bua nɛ a wo mɛ he wami.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a se kɛ bɔɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ wo mɛ blɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi kɛ ho nihi nɛ tsɔ mɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya. [

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Barnaba hi Antiokia nɛ a tsɔɔ ni nɛ a fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he sane kpakpa a, nɛ ni kpa komɛ fuu hu pee ja. Paulo kɛ Barnaba gba a mi

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: Be ko se ɔ Paulo de Barnaba ke: “Ha waa kpale wa se ya slaa wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ma tsuaa ma nɛ wa fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ, nɛ waa hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ.”

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Barnaba hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa a maa ngɔ Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko ɔ ngɔ piɛ a he.

english_verse: But Paul did not want to, because Mark had left them in Pamphylia and had stopped working with them.
translation_verse: Se Paulo lɛɛ, e susu kaa e sɛ́ kaa a ngɔ nɔ nɛ kpale ngɛ a se ngɛ Pamfilia nɛ e kɛ mɛ yɛ́ ni tsumi ɔ ngɔ piɛ a he.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, enɛ ɔ pee mɛ nya sami babauu nɛ e ha a gba a mi, nɛ Barnaba ngɔ Marko ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ a gu lɛ mi kɛ ho Kipro ya.

english_verse: but Paul took Silas and left after the followers had placed them in God's care.
translation_verse: Se Paulo lɛɛ, e hia Sila ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tu lɛ ngɔ wo Mawu dloomi ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho.

english_verse: They traveled through Syria and Cilicia, encouraging the churches.
translation_verse: Nɛ e gu Siria kɛ Kilikia ya wo asafo ɔmɛ he wami.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo ba Derbe kɛ Listra. Nɛ oʼɛ, kaselɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Timoteo, Yudayo ko nɛ he ye ɔ bi, se e tsɛ ɔ Helano ʼi.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Listra kɛ Ikoniom ɔ yeɔ e he odase kpakpa.

english_verse: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.
translation_verse: Paulo hla kaa e kɛ Timoteo nɛ ya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ e ngɔ lɛ nɛ e po lɛ ngɛ Yudafohi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi ɔ he; ejakaa mɛ kulaa a le kaa e tsɛ ɔ Helano ʼi.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Se benɛ a ngɛ ma amɛ a nɔ kpae ɔ, a kɛ mlaahi nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ wo ɔ ha mɛ, konɛ a ye nɔ.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ asafo ɔ na he wami ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, nɛ a he hiɛɛ daa ligbi. Paulo ninami ngɛ Troia

english_verse: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsi mɛ blɔ ke a ko fiɛ munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ Asia he je ɔ, a po mi ngɛ Frigia kɛ Galatia zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: A ba Misia ni ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a ka kaa a maa ya Bitinia, se Yesu Mumi ɔ ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ.

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a gu Misia nɛ a ba Troia.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ Paulo na ni, kaa nyumu Makedonia no ko daa si ngɛ lɛ pɛɛ kpae ke: “Ba Makedonia nɛ o ba ye bua wɔ!”

english_verse: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there. Lydia Becomes a Follower of the Lord
translation_verse: Se benɛ e na ni ɔ pɛ ɔ, amlɔ ɔ wa hla kaa waa ya Makedonia, ejakaa wa na le tutuutu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɛ wɔ kɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ, konɛ wa ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ. Lidia tsakemi ngɛ Filipi

english_verse: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa hia kɛ lɛ kɛ je Troia nɛ wa nyɛɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛ ya Samotrake, nɛ e nɔ je na a wa ba Neapoli.

english_verse: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.
translation_verse: Nɛ wa je lejɛ ɔ, wa ya Filipi nɛ ji Makedonia zugba a nɔ ma ngua kɛ Romabi a nɔ yemi he. Wa hi ma nɛ ɔ mi be saii.

english_verse: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.
translation_verse: Nɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa je ma a mi kɛ ya pa nya he nɛ wa juɛmi de wɔ ke a pɔɔ sɔlemi ngɛ ɔ, nɛ wa hi si nɛ waa kɛ yihi nɛ ba bua a he nyɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tu munyu.

english_verse: One of them was Lydia, who was from the city of Thyatira and sold expensive purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the Lord God, and he made her willing to accept what Paul was saying.
translation_verse: Nɛ yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Lidia nɛ ji kɔjai jualɔ ko nɛ je Tiatira ma a mi nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ɔ hu nu. Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bli e tsui nya, kaa e bu nihi nɛ Paulo ngɛ dee ɔ tue.

english_verse: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, “If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home.” Finally, we accepted her invitation. Paul and Silas Are Put in Jail
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a baptisi lɛ kɛ e we ɔ, e kpa wɔ pɛɛ ke: “Ke nyɛ bu mi kaa i he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye anɔkuale mi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ba ye we ɔ nɛ nyɛ ba hi lejɛ ɔ.” Nɛ e hɛɛ wɔ hluu nɛ wa kplɛɛ nɔ. A wo Paulo kɛ Sila tsu mi

english_verse: One day on our way to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell the future. By doing this she made a lot of money for her owners.
translation_verse: E ba mi kaa ligbi ko benɛ wa yaa he nɛ a sɔlee ngɛ ɔ, tsɔlɔyo ko nɛ klaami mumi ngɛ e mi kɛ wɔ ba kpe; e kɛ e klaami ɔ haa e nyɔmtsɛmɛ naa ni fuu.

english_verse: The girl followed Paul and the rest of us, and she kept yelling, “These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how to be saved.”
translation_verse: E nyɛɛ waa kɛ Paulo se, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ke: “Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ tsɔli ji mɛ, nɛ a ngɛ yi wami hemi blɔ ɔ jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe.”

english_verse: This went on for several days. Finally, Paul got so upset that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ, I order you to leave this girl alone!” At once the evil spirit left her.
translation_verse: Nɛ e pee ja ligbihi fuu. Se e dɔ Paulo wawɛɛ, nɛ e plɛ e he nɛ e de mumi ɔ ke: “I ngɛ mo fae ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa o je e mi.” Nɛ e je kpo ngɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: When the girl's owners realized they had lost all chances for making more money, they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them into court.
translation_verse: Se benɛ e nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ na kaa a ni nami hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ be hu ɔ, a nu Paulo kɛ Sila nɛ a sã mɛ kɛ ya ganɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ jua a nɔ.

english_verse: They are telling us to do things we Romans are not allowed to do.”
translation_verse: Nɛ a ngɛ kusumihi komɛ tsɔɔe nɛ wa be he blɔ ka wa pɛtɛɛ he loo wa yeɔ nɔ, ejakaa Romabi ji wɔ.”

english_verse: The crowd joined in the attack on Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off the two men and ordered them to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ hu te si wo mɛ nɛ a po klaangma wo a he, nɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ha a je a tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ a fa ke a fia mɛ kpa.

english_verse: After they had been badly beaten, they were put in jail, and the jailer was told to guard them carefully.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a fia mɛ kpa saminya a, a wo mɛ tsu mi, nɛ a wo pa mi tsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ kita ke e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to sɔkee.

english_verse: The jailer did as he was told. He put them deep inside the jail and chained their feet to heavy blocks of wood.
translation_verse: Nɛ akɛnɛ a wo lɛ kikɛmɛ a kita he je ɔ, e kɛ mɛ ya wo tsu nɛ ngɛ se je ɔ mi, nɛ e bɔ a nanehi pa.

english_verse: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing praises to God, while the other prisoners listened.
translation_verse: Se nyɔ mi kpɛti ɔ Paulo kɛ Sila ngɛ sɔlee nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ Mawu yi jee; nɛ pa mi tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ tue bue.

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the jail to its foundations. The doors opened, and the chains fell from all the prisoners.
translation_verse: Nɛ tlukaa a, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ; nɛ tsu ɔ fanesi ɔmɛ mimiɛ, nɛ amlɔ ɔ sinya amɛ kulaa bli, nɛ mɛ tsuo a kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kplɔ ngɛ a he.

english_verse: When the jailer woke up and saw that the doors were open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped. He pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.
translation_verse: Se benɛ pa mi tsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ hɛli si kɛ je mahɛ mi nɛ e na kaa tsu ɔ sinya amɛ kulaa a nya fɔɔ si ɔ, e hia klaate nɛ jinɛ e maa gbe e he, ejakaa e susu kaa pa mi tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu fo.

english_verse: But Paul shouted, “Don't harm yourself! No one has escaped.”
translation_verse: Se Paulo nga ke: “Koo pee o he yayami ko, se wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The jailer asked for a torch and went into the jail. He was shaking all over as he knelt down in front of Paul and Silas.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ pã mi tsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ tsɛ nɛ a ba ha lɛ la, nɛ e sa fo kɛ sɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ hedomi be nɔ Paulo kɛ Sila hɛ mi;

english_verse: After he had led them out of the jail, he asked, “What must I do to be saved?”
translation_verse: nɛ e kɛ mɛ je kpo nɛ e ke: “Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma na yi wami hemi?”

english_verse: They replied, “Have faith in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved! This is also true for everyone who lives in your home.”
translation_verse: Nɛ a ke: “He Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ ngɔ ye, nɛ a ma he o kɛ o we ɔ kulaa yi wami.”

english_verse: Then Paul and Silas told him and everyone else in his house about the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ a jaje Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: While it was still night, the jailer took them to a place where he could wash their cuts and bruises. Then he and everyone in his home were baptized.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ngɔ mɛ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ngmlɛfia a nɔuu, nɛ e fɔ a kpa amɛ a nya ha mɛ, nɛ a baptisi lɛ kɛ e we ɔ mi bimɛ kulaa amlɔ ɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: They were very glad they had put their faith in God. After this, the jailer took Paul and Silas to his home and gave them something to eat.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya e we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya ngmɛ mɛ okplɔɔ, nɛ e kɛ e we ɔ kulaa nya kaa e he Mawu ye.

english_verse: The next morning the officials sent some police with orders for the jailer to let Paul and Silas go.
translation_verse: Se benɛ je na a, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔ aslaafohi ba de ke: “Ngmɛɛ nimli ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ho”.

english_verse: But Paul told the police, “We are Roman citizens, and the Roman officials had us beaten in public without giving us a trial. They threw us into jail. Now do they think they can secretly send us away? No, they cannot! They will have to come here themselves and let us out.”
translation_verse: Se Paulo de mɛ ke: “Wɔ nɛ Romabi ji wɔ nɛ a bui wɔ fɔ ɔ, a fia wɔ kpa, nɛ a wo wɔ tsu mi hulɔ, nɛ kpaako a ngɛ wɔ fiee zaa lo? Dɛbi, se mohu ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ba nɛ a ba je wɔ.”

english_verse: When the police told the officials that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, the officials were afraid.
translation_verse: Nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ ya jaje kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ. Nɛ benɛ a nu kaa Romabi ji mɛ ɔ, a ye gbeye.

english_verse: So they came and apologized. They led them out of the jail and asked them to please leave town.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ba ba kpa mɛ pɛɛ, nɛ benɛ a je mɛ ɔ, a kpa mɛ pɛɛ ke a je ma a mi.

english_verse: But Paul and Silas went straight to the home of Lydia, where they saw the Lord's followers and encouraged them. Then they left.
translation_verse: Se benɛ a je tsu ɔ mi ɔ, a ho Lidia we ɔ mi ya. Nɛ benɛ a na nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a jɔɔ a bua a, a pue nɔ kɛ ho.

english_verse: After Paul and his friends had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they went on to Thessalonica. A synagogue was in that city.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ a gu Amfipoli kɛ Apolonia, nɛ a ba Tesalonika, he nɛ Yudafohi a kpe he ko ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: So as usual, Paul went there to worship, and on three Sabbaths he spoke to the people. He used the Scriptures
translation_verse: Nɛ Paulo ya a ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pɔɔ peemi ɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya sa nya Hejɔɔmi Ligbi etɛ sɔuu ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: to show them that the Messiah had to suffer, but that he would rise from death. Paul also told them that Jesus is the Messiah he was preaching about.
translation_verse: E blɛke munyu ɔ mi tsɔɔ mɛ faii kaa ja Kristo ɔ na amanehlu nɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ kaa “kikɛmɛ a Yesu, nɛ i ngɛ e he sane jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ, ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Some of them believed what Paul had said, and they became followers with Paul and Silas. Some Gentiles and many important women also believed the message.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ti ni komɛ kplɛɛ nɛ a kɛ a he bɔ Paulo kɛ Sila he, kɛ Helabi Mawu gbeye yeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi babauu, kɛ yihi nɛ a buu mɛ hu fuu.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders were jealous and got some troublemakers who hung around the marketplace to start a riot in the city. They wanted to drag Paul and Silas out to the mob, and so they went straight to Jason's home.
translation_verse: Se e pee Yudafo ɔmɛ tai, nɛ a ya kpaka yakayaka nimli ɔmɛ a kpɛti dikali komɛ ngɔ piɛ a he, nɛ benɛ a nya ba kpane fuu ɔ, a wo ma a mi hliihlii. A ya tua Yason we ɔ, nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a kpaka Paulo kɛ Sila ya ha ma a.

english_verse: But when they did not find them there, they dragged out Jason and some of the Lord's followers. They took them to the city authorities and shouted, “Paul and Silas have been upsetting things everywhere. Now they have come here,
translation_verse: Se benɛ a nɛ́ mɛ ɔ, a kpaka Yason kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ kɛ ya ma a mi nikɔtɔma amɛ a hɛ mi nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ plɛ je mi hɛ mi ngɔ bu si nɛ ɔ ba hiɛ ɔ hulɔ,

english_verse: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. All of them break the laws of the Roman Emperor by claiming that someone named Jesus is king.”
translation_verse: nɛ Yason he mɛ to. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kuɔ Kaisare mlaa a nya deɔ ke matsɛ kpa ko ngɛ nɛ ji Yesu ko.”

english_verse: The officials and the people were upset when they heard this.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ha ma a mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo nu sawale kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: So they made Jason and the other followers pay bail before letting them go. People in Berea Welcome the Message
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a he se dami ni ngɛ Yason kɛ ni kpa amɛ a dɛ ɔ, a ngmɛɛ a he. Paulo kɛ Sila ngɛ Beroia

english_verse: That same night the Lord's followers sent Paul and Silas on to Berea, and after they arrived, they went to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ je Paulo kɛ Sila blɔ nyɔ mi kɛ ho Beroia ya. Nɛ benɛ a su lejɛ ɔ a ya sɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔ.

english_verse: The people in Berea were much nicer than those in Thessalonica, and they gladly accepted the message. Day after day they studied the Scriptures to see if these things were true.
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a su hi pe ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Tesalonika a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a je a yi mi pɛtɛ munyu ɔ he, nɛ daa a kpaa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi hyɛɛ kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ja lo?

english_verse: Many of them put their faith in the Lord, including some important Greek women and several men.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a ti nihi fuu he ye, kɛ Helayi nɛ ngɛ biɛ kɛ nyumuhi hu fuu.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders in Thessalonica heard that Paul had been preaching God's message in Berea, they went there and caused trouble by turning the crowds against Paul.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Yudafohi nɛ ngɛ Tesalonika a nu he kaa Paulo ya jaje Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ Beroia hulɔ ɔ, a ba lejɛ ɔ hu nɛ a ba wo ni ɔmɛ yi, nɛ a pee basabasa.

english_verse: At once the followers sent Paul down to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ amlɔ ɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ya je Paulo blɔ nɛ e ya gu wo hɛ mi; se Sila kɛ Timoteo hi lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Some men went with Paul as far as Athens, and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible. Paul in Athens
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ ya sɛ Paulo ɔ kɛ lɛ ya su Atene tɔɔ. Akɛnɛ Paulo sɛ mɛ ke a ha Sila kɛ Timoteo nɛ a ba e ngɔ oya he je ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho. Paulo ngɛ Atene

english_verse: While Paul was waiting in Athens, he was upset to see all the idols in the city.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Paulo ngɛ mɛ mlɛe ngɛ Atene ɔ, e mumi mi wo la ngɛ e mi, benɛ e na ma a nɛ mi hyi tɔ kɛ amagahi sɔuu ɔ.

english_verse: He went to the synagogue to speak to the Jews and to anyone who worshiped with them. Day after day he also spoke to everyone he met in the market.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ e kɛ Yudafohi nɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ kɛ Mawu gbeye yeli ɔmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ kpee daa nɛ ɔ ngɛ jua a nɔ ɔ saa nya.

english_verse: Some of them were Epicureans and some were Stoics, and they started arguing with him. People were asking, “What is this know-it-all trying to say?” Some even said, “Paul must be preaching about foreign gods! That's what he means when he talks about Jesus and about people rising from death.”
translation_verse: Se ni leli nɛ je Epikurotsɛmɛ kɛ Stoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ kɛ lɛ sa nya; nɛ ni komɛ ke: “Mɛni nyapuutsɛ nɛ ɔ ma de po?” Ni komɛ hu ke: “E ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ jajeɔ ma se wɔhi a he sane tsɔɔ;” ejakaa e jaje Yesu kɛ e si temi he sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: They brought Paul before a council called the Areopagus, and said, “Tell us what your new teaching is all about.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Areopago ɔ, nɛ a ke: “Anɛ o ma ha waa le tsɔɔmi he nɛ o ngɛ he munyu tue nɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: We have heard you say some strange things, and we want to know what you mean.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa o ha wa tue nu ma se sanehi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa ngɛ sisi hlae nɛ waa le.”

english_verse: More than anything else the people of Athens and the foreigners living there loved to hear and to talk about anything new.
translation_verse: Se Atenebihi tsuo kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ piɛ mɛ pɛ ji sane he ko sɛɛmi kɛ tue bumi.

english_verse: So Paul stood up in front of the council and said: People of Athens, I see that you are very religious.
translation_verse: Paulo ya da Areopago ɔ kpɛti nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ Atenebihi, i naa ngɛ nihi kulaa mi kaa nyɛ jaa wɔhi pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: As I was going through your city and looking at the things you worship, I found an altar with the words, “To an Unknown God.” You worship this God, but you don't really know him. So I want to tell you about him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa benɛ i bee nɛ i hyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ jae ɔ, i na bɔ sami latɛ ko hu nɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ke: ‘Mawu nɛ a li ɔ nɔ ʼi.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ nyɛ li lɛ se kɛ̃ ɔ nyɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e he sane i ngɛ jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: This God made the world and everything in it. He is Lord of heaven and earth, and he doesn't live in temples built by human hands.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ pee je ɔ kɛ e mi nihi kulaa, nɛ ji hiɔwe kɛ zugba nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, e hi sɔlemi tsuhi nɛ a kɛ nine pee mi,

english_verse: From one person God made all nations who live on earth, and he decided when and where every nation would be.
translation_verse: Muɔ kake e kɛ pee nimli adesahi kulaa nɛ a hi zugba a tsuo hɛ mi, nɛ yinɔhi nɛ e to ɔ kɛ a sihi he ɔmɛ a huzu ɔmɛ ɔ, e kpɛ mi ngɔ to momo,

english_verse: God has done all this, so that we will look for him and reach out and find him. He isn't far from any of us,
translation_verse: konɛ a hla Mawu se blɔ, kaa eko ɔ ke a lilaa si ɔ, a maa na lɛ lo; pohu e kɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpɛti kɛ we.

english_verse: and he gives us the power to live, to move, and to be who we are. “We are his children,” just as some of your poets have said.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ‘E mi nɔuu wa hɛ ngɛ ngɛ, nɛ wa tsɛ̃ɛ wa he, nɛ wa ngɛ ngɛ.’ Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ latsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu de ɔ ke: ‘Se lɛ nɔuu e nina ji wɔ hulɔ’ ɔ.

english_verse: Since we are God's children, we must not think that he is like an idol made out of gold or silver or stone. He isn't like anything that humans have thought up and made.
translation_verse: Se ke Mawu nina ji wɔ ɔ, e sɛ kaa wa susuu kaa Mawu su ɔ ngɛ kaa sika tsu loo sika hiɔ loo tɛ ko nɛ nɔmlɔ kɛ e ga kɛ e juɛmi pee.

english_verse: In the past, God forgave all this because people did not know what they were doing. But now he says that everyone everywhere must turn to him.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be nɛ a li ɔ Mawu ku e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ, se jeha nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ nimli kulaa nɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he ɔ kita woe kaa a tsake a tsui.

english_verse: He has set a day when he will judge the world's people with fairness. And he has chosen the man Jesus to do the judging for him. God has given proof of this to all of us by raising Jesus from death.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e to ligbi ko nɛ e maa gu nyumu ko nɛ e to ɔ nɔ kɛ kojo je mluku ɔ tsuo ngɛ dami nya; e ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ le enɛ ɔ, ejakaa e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje.”

english_verse: As soon as the people heard Paul say a man had been raised from death, some of them started laughing. Others said, “We will hear you talk about this some other time.”
translation_verse: Se benɛ a nu ni gbogboehi a si temi he ɔ, ni komɛ ye e he fɛu, nɛ ni komɛ hu ke: “Wa maa kpale bu mo tue ekohu ngɛ enɛ ɔ he.”

english_verse: When Paul left the council meeting,
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Paulo je a kpɛti ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: some of the men put their faith in the Lord and went with Paul. One of them was a council member named Dionysius. A woman named Damaris and several others also put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Se nyumuhi komɛ kɛ a he bɔ e he nɛ a he ye. A kpɛti ni komɛ ji Dionisio, Areopagono ɔ, kɛ yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Damari ɔ, kɛ ni kpa komɛ nɛ piɛ a he.

english_verse: where he met Aquila, a Jewish man from Pontus. Not long before this, Aquila had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Emperor Claudius had ordered the Jewish people to leave Rome. Paul went to see Aquila and Priscilla
translation_verse: Nɛ e ya na Yudano ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Akwila nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ Ponto nɛ e je Italia kɛ ba kɛ we, kɛ e yo Priskila , nɛ e ya a ngɔ.

english_verse: and found out they were tent makers. Paul was also a tent maker, so he stayed with them, and they worked together.
translation_verse: Nɛ akɛnɛ e kɛ mɛ tsuo tsuɔ ni tsumi kake he je ɔ, e kɛ mɛ hi si, nɛ a tsuɔ ni; a ni tsumi ji bo tsu peemi.

english_verse: Every Sabbath, Paul went to the synagogue. He spoke to Jews and Gentiles and tried to win them over.
translation_verse: Se daa Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ya tuɔ munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi ngɛ kpe he ɔ, nɛ e bɔɔ mɔde kaa e tsake Yudafohi kɛ Helabi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: But after Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, he spent all his time preaching to the Jews about Jesus the Messiah.
translation_verse: Benɛ Sila kɛ Timoteo je Makedonia ba a, munyu ɔ nyɛ Paulo nɔ, nɛ e ye odase veveeve ngɔ tsɔɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, they turned against him and insulted him. So he shook the dust from his clothes and told them, “Whatever happens to you will be your own fault! I am not to blame. From now on I am going to preach to the Gentiles.”
translation_verse: Benɛ a ku e nya nɛ a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si lɛ ɔ, e huanya e tade ɔ mi nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ muɔ nɛ tloo nyɛ. Imi lɛɛ musu ko be ye nɔ, kɛ je be nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, ma ya majemajeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ.”

english_verse: Paul then moved into the house of a man named Titius Justus, who worshiped God and lived next door to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ho Mawujalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Titio Yusto nɛ e we tsa kpe he ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɔ ya.

english_verse: Crispus was the leader of the synagogue. He and everyone in his family put their faith in the Lord. Many others in Corinth also heard the message, and all the people who had faith in the Lord were baptized.
translation_verse: Se kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma Krispo ɔ kɛ e we mluku ɔ kulaa he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ ye, nɛ Korintobi ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu hu nɛ nu ɔ, a he ye, nɛ a baptisi mɛ.

english_verse: One night, Paul had a vision, and in it the Lord said, “Don't be afraid to keep on preaching. Don't stop!
translation_verse: Nyɔ ko mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de Paulo ngɛ ninami mi ke: “Koo ye gbeye, se mohu de, nɛ o ko ma o nya,

english_verse: I am with you, and you won't be harmed. Many people in this city belong to me.”
translation_verse: ejakaa i kɛ mo ngɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be o he tae, nɛ e be mo yayami ko pee; ejakaa yi ngɛ nihi fuu ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Paul stayed on in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching God's message to the people.
translation_verse: Nɛ Paulo hi akpɛti jeha kake kɛ hlami ekpa, nɛ e tsɔɔ Mawu munyu ɔ.

english_verse: While Gallio was governor of Achaia, some of the Jewish leaders got together and grabbed Paul. They brought him into court
translation_verse: Benɛ Galio ngɛ amlaalo yee ngɛ Akaia a, Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛ juɛmi kake te si wo Paulo, nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ya kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi;

english_verse: and said, “This man is trying to make our people worship God in a way that is against our Law!”
translation_verse: a ya de ke: “Nyumu nɛ ɔ woɔ ni ɔmɛ a yi mi nɛ a je mlaa a se kɛ ja Mawu.”

english_verse: Even before Paul could speak, Gallio said, “If you were charging this man with a crime or some other wrong, I would have to listen to you.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Paulo ma bli e nya pɛ ɔ, Galio de Yudafo ɔmɛ ke: “Yudafohi, e ji ju kɛ fɔ̃ sane ko ʼi jinɛ, e sa kaa ma bu nyɛ tue.

english_verse: But since this concerns only words, names, and your own law, you will have to take care of it yourselves. I refuse to judge such matters.”
translation_verse: Se ke munyu loo biɛhi loo nyɛ mlaa a he sane komɛ ʼi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ; ejakaa i sume kaa i kojoɔ kikɛmɛ a sanehi.”

english_verse: Then he sent them out of the court.
translation_verse: Nɛ e fie mɛ kɛ je kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: The crowd grabbed Sosthenes, the Jewish leader, and beat him up in front of the court. But none of this mattered to Gallio. Paul Returns to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Helabi ɔmɛ tsuo nu kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma Sostene ɔ, nɛ a fia lɛ ni ngɛ kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, se enɛ ɔmɛ eko eko dɔɛ Galio. Paulo kpale kɛ ba Antiokia

english_verse: After Paul had stayed for a while with the Lord's followers in Corinth, he told them goodbye and sailed on to Syria with Aquila and Priscilla. But before he left, he had his head shaved at Cenchreae because he had made a promise to God.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Paulo hi lejɛ ɔ be saii se ɔ, e sɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e sɛ lɛ mi kɛ yaa Siria; nɛ Priskila kɛ Akwila kɛ lɛ ho. Nɛ e ya sɛ e yi ngɛ Kenkrea, ngɛ e si womi ko nya.

english_verse: The three of them arrived in Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He then went into the synagogue to talk with the people there.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ba Efeso, nɛ e si mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Se lɛ nitse lɛɛ e ya kpe he ɔ, nɛ e kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ya sa nya.

english_verse: They asked him to stay longer, but he refused.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e kɛ ngɛ a ngɔ bɔɔ ɔ, e kplɛɛ we.

english_verse: Paul sailed to Caesarea, where he greeted the church. Then he went on to Antioch.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ya kple ngɛ Kaisarea a, e ya Yerusalem nɛ e ya nga asafo ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Antiokia ya.

english_verse: After staying there for a while, he left and visited several places in Galatia and Phrygia. He helped the followers there to become stronger in their faith. Apollos in Ephesus
translation_verse: E hi lejɛ ɔ bɔɔ, nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ se ɔ, e pue nɔ ekohu nɛ e ya kpa Galatia kɛ Frigia zugba amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ e wo kaseli ɔmɛ kulaa he wami. Apolo ngɛ Efeso kɛ Korinto

english_verse: A Jewish man named Apollos came to Ephesus. Apollos had been born in the city of Alexandria. He was a very good speaker and knew a lot about the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Yudano ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Apolo nɛ e se je Aleksandria nɛ ji nyumu nya mi tsɔlɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi hulɔ ɔ ba Efeso.

english_verse: He also knew much about the Lord's Way, and he spoke about it with great excitement. What he taught about Jesus was right, but all he knew was John's message about baptism.
translation_verse: A tsɔɔ nyumu nɛ ɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ he ni, nɛ e ngɛ kã ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ e tsɔɔ Yesu he ni fitsofitso, pohu Yohane baptisimi ɔ kɛkɛ e le.

english_verse: Apollos started speaking bravely in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him to their home and helped him understand God's Way even better.
translation_verse: Nɛ e bɔni kã nya munyu tumi ngɛ kpe he ɔ. Se benɛ Akwila kɛ Priskila nu e he ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba a ngɔ, nɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ Mawu blɔ ɔ fitsofitso.

english_verse: Apollos decided to travel through Achaia. So the Lord's followers wrote letters, encouraging the followers there to welcome him. After Apollos arrived in Achaia, he was a great help to everyone who had put their faith in the Lord Jesus because of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Benɛ Apolo susu kaa e maa po mi kɛ ya Akaia a, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ na kã nɛ a ngma womi ya ha kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ wo mɛ ga ke a he lɛ hɛmuɔ. Benɛ e ba lejɛ ɔ, e ye bua nihi nɛ gu dloomi ɔ nɔ he ye ɔ babauu.

english_verse: He got into fierce arguments with the Jewish people, and in public he used the Scriptures to prove that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e kɛ he wami ku Yudafo ɔmɛ a nya nɛ e kɛ ngmami ɔmɛ tsɔɔ mɛ faii kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul traveled across the hill country to Ephesus, where he met some of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Benɛ Apolo ngɛ Korinto ɔ, Paulo ya kpa mahi nɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a ɔ nɔ mi kɛ ba je Efeso. Nɛ e ba na kaseli komɛ,

english_verse: He asked them, “When you put your faith in Jesus, were you given the Holy Spirit?” “No!” they answered. “We have never even heard of the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Benɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ nyɛ na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lo?” Nɛ a de lɛ ke Mumi Klɔuklɔu ko ngɛ he ko jio, wa nui tete.”

english_verse: “Then why were you baptized?” Paul asked. They answered, “Because of what John taught.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Lɛɛ mɛni mi a baptisi nyɛ ngɔ wo mɔ?” Nɛ a ke: “Yohane baptisimi ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Paul replied, “John baptized people so they would turn to God. But he also told them someone else was coming, and they should put their faith in him. Jesus is the one that John was talking about.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Paulo ke: “Yohane ɔ, tsuitsakemi baptisimi e kɛ baptisi, se e de ma a ke, a he nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ e se ɔ mohu nɔ ngɔ ye, lɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: After the people heard Paul say this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, a ha a baptisi mɛ ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi.

english_verse: Then Paul placed his hands on them. The Holy Spirit was given to them, and they spoke unknown languages and prophesied.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Paulo kɛ e ninehi pue a nɔ ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kple a nɔ, nɛ a tu munyu slɔɔtohi nɛ a gba.

english_verse: There were about twelve men in this group.
translation_verse: Se nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.

english_verse: For three months Paul went to the synagogue and talked bravely with the people about God's kingdom. He tried to win them over,
translation_verse: Paulo ya kpe he ɔ, nɛ e ya tu munyu kɛ kã, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ ni hlami etɛ sɔuu, nɛ e bɔ mɔde nɛ e ha a le Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ.

english_verse: but some of them were stubborn and refused to believe. In front of everyone they said terrible things about God's Way. Paul left and took the followers with him to the lecture hall of Tyrannus. He spoke there every day
translation_verse: Se benɛ ni komɛ wlua a tsui nɛ a bui tue nɛ a tu tsɔɔmi ɔ he munyu yaya ngɛ asafo ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, e je a ngɔ nɛ e je kaseli ɔmɛ hu kɛ je a kpɛti, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ e ya tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tirano ɔ ni kasemi he ɔ.

english_verse: for two years, until every Jew and Gentile in Asia had heard the Lord's message. The Sons of Sceva
translation_verse: Nɛ e pee enɛ ɔ jeha enyɔ sɔuu, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Asia, Yudafohi nɛ Helabi kulaa, nu Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu munyu ɔ. Skeva bimɛ ɔmɛ

english_verse: God gave Paul the power to work great miracles.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu gu Paulo nine nɔ e kɛ tsu he wami ni tsumihi hulɔ nɛ pɔɛ he,

english_verse: People even took handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched Paul's body, and they carried them to everyone who was sick. All of the sick people were healed, and the evil spirits went out.
translation_verse: hluu po nɛ a ngɔɔ e dukuhi kɛ e tade hɛ mi hami bohi tete ya haa hiɔtsɛmɛ a nɔ nɛ a hiɔ ɔmɛ jɔɔ, nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ hu jee a mi.

english_verse: Some Jewish men started going around trying to force out evil spirits by using the name of the Lord Jesus. They said to the spirits, “Come out in the name of that same Jesus that Paul preaches about!”
translation_verse: Se Yudafohi klaali nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ kpaa si ɔ, a ti ni komɛ hu ka nɛ a kɛ Yesu biɛ nɛ ke nihi nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi ɔmɛ a yi ke: “I na Yesu nɛ Paulo ngɛ fiɛɛe ɔ.”

english_verse: Seven sons of a high priest named Sceva were doing this,
translation_verse: Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Skeva, Yuda no ɔ, bimɛ nyumuhi kpaago ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ peɔ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: when an evil spirit said to them, “I know Jesus! And I have heard about Paul. But who are you?”
translation_verse: Se mumi yayami ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Yesu ɔ, i le lɛ, nɛ Paulo hu i le lɛ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ mɛnɔmɛ ji nyɛ?”

english_verse: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and beat them up. They ran out of the house, naked and bruised.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi ɔ tua mɛ, nɛ e nine gu a nɔ nɛ e pee mɛ pasaa, nɛ a kɛ a he gu kɛ plaamihi tu fo kɛ je jamɛ a we ɔ mi.

english_verse: When the Jews and Gentiles in Ephesus heard about this, they were so frightened that they praised the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Yudafohi kɛ Helabihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, gbeye nu mɛ, nɛ a wo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami nitsɛnitsɛ.

english_verse: Many who were followers now started telling everyone about the evil things they had been doing.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi nɛ he ye ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi fuu hu ba nɛ a ba jaje a ni peemi ni ɔmɛ paa ngɔ tsɔɔ.

english_verse: So the Lord's message spread and became even more powerful. The Riot in Ephesus
translation_verse: Blɔ nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ gu nɛ e kɛ wa nɛ e kɛ ye kunimi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Basabasapeemi ba te si ngɛ Efeso

english_verse: After all this had happened, Paul decided to visit Macedonia and Achaia on his way to Jerusalem. Paul had said, “From there I will go on to Rome.”
translation_verse: Benɛ a gbe ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nya a, Paulo to e yi mi ngɛ mumi ɔ nya kaa e ma ya gu Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛ ya Yerusalem, nɛ e ke: “Ke i su lejɛ ɔ, ja i ya slaa Roma hulɔ.”

english_verse: So he sent his two helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia. But he stayed on in Asia for a while.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ a ti nihi enyɔ, Timoteo kɛ “Erasto, Makedonia, se lɛ nitse lɛɛ e hi Asia be bɔɔ.

english_verse: At that time there was serious trouble because of the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: Se jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, basabasa peemi wawɛɛ ko ba te si ngɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ he.

english_verse: A silversmith named Demetrius had a business that made silver models of the temple of the goddess Artemis. Those who worked for him earned a lot of money.
translation_verse: Sika hiɔ galɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Demetrio ɔ kɛ sika hiɔ peɔ Artemi sɔlemi tsuhi nɛ haa jamɛ a gali ɔmɛ naa ni fuu ngɛ mi.

english_verse: Demetrius brought together everyone who was in the same business and said: Friends, you know we make a good living at this.
translation_verse: E tsɛ ni ɔmɛ kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ni ɔ eko ɔ kɛ ba kpe, nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛ le kaa kikɛmɛ a ga nɛ ɔ waa kɛ naa wa ni fuu ɔ,

english_verse: But you have surely seen and heard how this man Paul is upsetting a lot of people, not only in Ephesus, but almost everywhere in Asia. He claims that the gods we humans make are not really gods at all.
translation_verse: nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue kaa, pi Efeso nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu piɛ bɔɔ nɛ e su Asia kulaa nɛ kikɛmɛ a Paulo nɛ ɔ plɛ nihi babauu yi mi nɛ e deɔ ke: ‘Nihi nɛ a kɛ nine pee ɔ pi mawuhi ji mɛ’.

english_verse: Everyone will start saying terrible things about our business. They will stop respecting the temple of the goddess Artemis, who is worshiped in Asia and all over the world. Our great goddess will be forgotten!
translation_verse: Nɛ pi wa ni tsumi nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ he guɛ nɛ ma gbo, se mohu mawuyo Artemi ngua a sɔlemi we ɔ hu a be lɛ bue ha nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, nɛ e nyami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ Asia kɛ je mluku ɔ hu jaa a nya maa ba si.”

english_verse: When the workers heard this, they got angry and started shouting, “Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians!”
translation_verse: Benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, a mi mi wo la saminya nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Efesobi Artemi ɔ, he walɔ ngua ʼi!”

english_verse: Soon the whole city was in a riot, and some men grabbed Gaius and Aristarchus, who had come from Macedonia with Paul. Then everyone in the crowd rushed to the place where the town meetings were held.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma a mi kulaa pee basabasa; nɛ a kɛ juɛmi kake sa kɛ ho ni hyemi he ɔ ya, nɛ a ya nuu Gaio kɛ Aristarko nɛ ji Makedoniabi nɛ piɛ Paulo he kɛ hia blɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Paul wanted to go out and speak to the people, but the Lord's followers would not let him.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Paulo susu kaa e maa ya ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we lɛ;

english_verse: A few of the local officials were friendly to Paul, and they sent someone to warn him not to go.
translation_verse: nɛ Asia ganɔ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ hu nɛ ji Paulo huɛmɛ ɔ tsɔ e ngɔ ba wo lɛ ga ke e ko ka kãa e maa ya ni hyemi he ɔ.

english_verse: Some of the people in the meeting were shouting one thing, and others were shouting something else. Everyone was completely confused, and most of them did not even know why they were there.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ ni komɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kikɛ ɔ, ni komɛ hu ngɛ ekpã dee; ejakaa ni ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ gidigidi pee, se a ti nihi fuu li nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ a ba kpe ɔ tete.

english_verse: Several of the Jewish leaders pushed a man named Alexander to the front of the crowd and started telling him what to say. He motioned with his hand and tried to explain what was going on.
translation_verse: Nɛ a sã Aleksandro kɛ je ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, ejakaa Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ e kuɛ se tsitsɛe kɛ ma hɛ kpɛ. Se Aleksandro fɔ̃ e nine; e ngɛ hlae nɛ e je e nya kɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ.

english_verse: But when the crowd saw that he was Jewish, they all shouted for two hours, “Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians!”
translation_verse: Se benɛ a kpa si kaa Yudano ji lɛ ɔ, mɛ kulaa a kɛ gbi kake kpa ngmlaa maa pee ngmlɛfia enyɔ sɔuu ke: “Efesobi Artemi ɔ he walɔ ngua ʼi!”

english_verse: Finally, a town official made the crowd be quiet. Then he said: People of Ephesus, who in the world doesn't know that our city is the center for worshiping the great goddess Artemis? Who doesn't know that her image which fell from heaven is right here?
translation_verse: Se benɛ ma a mi womi ngmalɔ ɔ kpata ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ Efesobi, mɛnɔ po lɛ li kaa Artemi ngua a kɛ amaga nɛ kple si kɛ je Dio ngɔ ɔ Efesobi a ma nɛ ɔ mi nɛ e wɔnɔ ɔ ngɛ?

english_verse: No one can deny this, and so you should calm down and not do anything foolish.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ akɛnɛ enɛ ɔ he be nɔ́jemi ko he je ɔ e sa kaa nyɛɛ pee kɔ dii, nɛ nyɛ ko pee gidigidi ko.

english_verse: You have brought men in here who have not robbed temples or spoken against our goddess.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔmɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɔ; a pi sɔlemi we ɔ ni juli ɔ, a pi nyɛ mawuyo ɔ he musu bɔli hulɔ.

english_verse: If Demetrius and his workers have a case against these men, we have courts and judges. Let them take their complaints there.
