translation_verse: Benɛ wa ba su Roma a, asafoatsɛ ɔ je pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a, se Paulo lɛɛ, a ngmɛ lɛ blɔ kaa e hi he nɛ e suɔ, se aslaafono ko buu e he.

english_verse: Three days after we got there, Paul called together some of the Jewish leaders and said: My friends, I have never done anything to hurt our people, and I have never gone against the customs of our ancestors. But in Jerusalem I was handed over as a prisoner to the Romans.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ba mi kaa ligbi etɛ se ɔ Paulo ha a tsɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ ɔ kɛ ba kpe; nɛ benɛ a nya ba bua a, e de mɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, i tɔ̃ we ma a loo wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ blɔ nya ni ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ̃ ɔ, a ngɔ mi ngɔ wo Romabi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ngɛ Yerusalem kaa pamino.

english_verse: They looked into the charges against me and wanted to release me. They found that I had not done anything deserving death.
translation_verse: Benɛ a hla ye sane ɔ mi ɔ, a suɔ kaa a ngmɛɛ ye he, ejakaa gbenɔ sane ko be ye he kulaa.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders disagreed, so I asked to be tried by the Emperor. But I don't have anything to say against my own nation.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we he je ɔ, e fi mi kaa ma ngɔ ye sane ɔ ngɔ ha Kaisare yemi, se pi kaa i ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ i kɛ maa po yema a nya.

english_verse: I am bound by these chains because of what we people of Israel hope for. This is why I have called you here to talk about this hope of ours.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ he je nɛ i tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ ma na nyɛ nɛ ma kɛ nyɛ nɛ tu munyu; ejakaa Israel hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ he je nɛ a wo mi kikɛmɛ a kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: The leaders replied, “No one from Judea has written us a letter about you. And not one of them has come here to report on you or to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa na we womi komɛ kɛ ji Yudea ngɛ o he, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko bɛ́ hiɛ ɔ ba sɛɛ we o he sane ko aloo o he munyu yaya ko.

english_verse: But we would like to hear what you have to say. We understand that people everywhere are against this new group.”
translation_verse: Se wa suɔ kaa wa maa bu o juɛmi ɔ tue; ejakaa kikɛmɛ a kuu nɛ ɔ wa le kaa a tuɔ e he munyu yaya ngɛ he tsuaa he.”

english_verse: They agreed on a time to meet with Paul, and many of them came to his house. From early morning until late in the afternoon, Paul talked to them about God's kingdom. He used the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets to try to win them over to Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ a to lɛ ligbi ɔ, a ti nihi fuu ba e ngɔ ngɛ e to he ɔ, nɛ e jaje Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ e ye he odase faii, nɛ e je Mose Mlaa a kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a mi hla konɛ a yi mi nɛ plɛ̃ kɛ ba Yesu blɔfami kɛ je mɔtu kɛ ya su gbɔkuɛ.

english_verse: Some of the leaders agreed with what Paul said, but others did not.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ he e munyuhi nɛ e tu ɔmɛ ye, se ni komɛ hu he we yi.

english_verse: Since they could not agree among themselves, they started leaving. But Paul said, “The Holy Spirit said the right thing when he sent Isaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Nɛ akɛnɛ a nya ya pee we kake he je ɔ, a je benɛ Paulo tu nyagbe munyu kake nɛ ɔ: “Niinɛ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu de ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaia nya tsɔɔ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke:

english_verse: to tell our ancestors, ‘Go to these people and tell them: You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.
translation_verse: ‘‘Yaa ma nɔ ngɔ nɛ o ya de ke: Numi ɔ nyɛ maa nu lɛɛ, se nyɛ be sisi nue, Nɛ nami ɔ nyɛ maa na lɛɛ, se nyɛ be se kɔe.

english_verse: All of you have stubborn hearts. Your ears are stopped up, and your eyes are covered. You cannot see or hear or understand. If you could, you would turn to me, and I would heal you.’ ”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ma nɛ ɔ tsui ti, Nɛ a tue wa kɛ nɔ numi, Nɛ a mia a hɛngmɛ Konɛ a ko na kɛ a hɛngmɛ Nɛ a ko nu kɛ a tue, Nɛ a tsui hu ko na sisi, Nɛ a kpale nɛ i tsa mɛ.’

english_verse: Paul said, “You may be sure that God wants to save the Gentiles! And they will listen.”
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Paulo tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ je, nɛ a je nɔ babauu ngɛ a kpɛti.]

english_verse: For two years Paul stayed in a rented house and welcomed everyone who came to see him.
translation_verse: Nɛ Paulo hi we nɛ a ba ha lɛ ɔ mi jeha mluku enyɔ, nɛ e heɔ nihi kulaa nɛ baa e ngɔ ɔ,

english_verse: He bravely preached about God's kingdom and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ, and no one tried to stop him.
translation_verse: nɛ e fiɛɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kã babauu jajeɔ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo he sane ɔmɛ tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko tsi lɛ blɔ.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus. God chose me to be an apostle, and he appointed me to preach the good news
translation_verse: Womi nɛ ɔ je Paulo, nɛ ji Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kɛ bɔfo nɛ a tsɛ lɛ nɛ a je lɛ ngɔ to kɛ ha Sane Kpakpa a fiɛmi ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: that he promised long ago by what his prophets said in the holy Scriptures.
translation_verse: Sane Kpakpa nɛ ɔ ɔ, Mawu wo he si ngɔ to momo kɛ gu e gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Ngmami Klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: This good news is about his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ! As a human, he was from the family of David. But the Holy Spirit proved that Jesus is the powerful Son of God, because he was raised from death.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ ngɛ he tsɔmi mumi ɔ nya a, a gu ni gbogboehi a si temi nɔ je lɛ tsɔɔ ngɛ he wami mi kaa Mawu bi, Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Jesus was kind to me and chose me to be an apostle, so that people of all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: E nɔ i gu nɛ i na dloomi kɛ bɔfo ni tsumi ɔ kone ma ha majemaje ɔ kulaa nɛ bu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tue, ngɛ e biɛ ɔ he:

english_verse: This letter is to all of you in Rome. God loves you and has chosen you to be his very own people. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: I ngɛ enɛ ɔ ngmae ya ha nihi nɛ Mawu suɔ nɛ ji ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ a tsɛ mɛ nɛ a ngɛ Roma a kulaa: Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! Sina sɔlemi

english_verse: First, I thank God in the name of Jesus Christ for all of you. I do this because people everywhere in the world are talking about your faith.
translation_verse: Kekleekle ɔ, i ngɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ gue kɛ ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ si nae ngɛ nyɛ kulaa nyɛ he, ejakaa a gbaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he sane ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: God has seen how I never stop praying for you, while I serve him with all my heart and tell the good news about his Son.
translation_verse: Ye dase ji Mawu, nɔ nɛ i sɔmɔɔ ngɛ ye mumi mi ngɛ e Bi ɔ Sane Kpakpa a mi ɔ, kaa i jɔɔ we nyɛ kaimi ligbi ko ligbi ko.

english_verse: In all my prayers, I ask God to make it possible for me to visit you.
translation_verse: I kpaa pɛɛ daa ngɛ ye sɔlemihi a mi, kaa alinɔ Mawu suɔmi nya a, hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, blɔ ma bli ha mi nɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ lo.

english_verse: I want to see you and share with you the same blessings that God's Spirit has given me. Then you will grow stronger in your faith.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ nyɛ he, konɛ ikɛ mumi mi dloomi nike ni ɔ eko ba ha nyɛ, bene pee nɛ a kɛ wo nyɛ he wami.

english_verse: What I am saying is that we can encourage each other by the faith that is ours.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ ji kaa, konɛ a wo i kɛ nyɛ tsuo he wami ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ngɛ i kɛ nyɛ tsuo wa mi ɔ mi.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that I have often planned to come for a visit. But something has always kept me from doing it. I want to win followers to Christ in Rome, as I have done in many other places.
translation_verse: Se mamimɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le kaa i pɔɔ ye yi mi tomi kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ kone ma ba na yiblii komɛ ngɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɛ i na ke je majeli kpa amɛ a kpɛti ɔ, se a tsi ye nya kɛ ba ta piɔ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if people are civilized and educated, or if they are uncivilized and uneducated. I must tell the good news to everyone. That's why I am eager to visit all of you in Rome. The Power of the Good News
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ka ye nɔ kake ye he ɔ, i ko suɔ kaa nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Roma a hulɔ ɔ, ma ba fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ. Sane Kpakpa a hewami

english_verse: I am proud of the good news! It is God's powerful way of saving all people who have faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo Sane Kpakpa a he zo pee we mi, mɛni he je ɔ, e ji Mawu he wami nɛ a kɛ heɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ yi wami, Yuda no kekle kɛ Hela no hulɔ.

english_verse: The good news tells how God accepts everyone who has faith, but only those who have faith. It is just as the Scriptures say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.” Everyone Is Guilty
translation_verse: Ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔ mi a jeɔ Mawu dami kpo ngɛ, kɛ jee hemi kɛ yemi mi kɛ yaa hemi kɛ yemi mi; kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ke: “Dalɔ nɛ guu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ɔ yi ma na wa.” Adesahi a fɔyemi

english_verse: From heaven God shows how angry he is with all the wicked and evil things that sinful people do to crush the truth.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a jeɔ Mawu mi mi fumi kpo kɛ jee hiɔwe kɛ baa nimli nɛ kɛ ni yayamihi kɛ musu bɔmi tsiɔ anɔkuale ɔ blɔ ɔ kulaa nɔ,

english_verse: They know everything that can be known about God, because God has shown it all to them.
translation_verse: ejakaa Mawu he nihi nɛ a ma nyɛ le ɔ jee kpo paa ngɛ a mi, ejakaa Mawu je tsɔɔ mɛ paa.

english_verse: God's eternal power and character cannot be seen. But from the beginning of creation, God has shown what these are like by all he has made. That's why those people don't have any excuse.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je ɔ, e he nihi nɛ a nɛ́ nɛ ji e neneene hewami kɛ e Mawu nɛ e ji ɔ kulaa a, kɛ je adebɔ sisije lokoo ɔ, a guu e nihi nɛ e pee ɔmɛ a nɔ yɔseɔ nɛ a naa paa, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a be nya jemi ko.

english_verse: They know about God, but they don't honor him or even thank him. Their thoughts are useless, and their stupid minds are in the dark.
translation_verse: A le Mawu lɛɛ, se a wui e hɛ mi nyami kaa Mawu nɛ a nɛ lɛ si hulɔ, se a epe posoposo ngɛ a juɛmihi a mi, nɛ a tsui nɛ kɔ we sane se ɔ mi wo diblii.

english_verse: They claim to be wise, but they are fools.
translation_verse: A tsɛɛ a he ni leli, se a plɛ kuasiahi.

english_verse: They don't worship the glorious and eternal God. Instead, they worship idols that are made to look like humans who cannot live forever, and like birds, animals, and reptiles.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ puɛ we ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ a tsake ngɔ ha nɔmlɔ nɛ puɛɛ ɔ subai henɔ ko kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ kɛ lohwe nane eywiɛ eywiɛtsɛmɛ kɛ waami nihi anɔ.

english_verse: So God let these people go their own way. They did what they wanted to do, and their filthy thoughts made them do shameful things with their bodies.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ kuasiahi ji mɛ he je ɔ Mawu ngmɛɛ a he ngɛ a kɔnɔhi nɛ ngɛ tai ɔ mi, nɛ a kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he peɔ zo nihi.

english_verse: They gave up the truth about God for a lie, and they worshiped God's creation instead of God, who will be praised forever. Amen.
translation_verse: A ngɔɔ Mawu anɔkuale ɔ kɛ tsakee lakpa, nɛ a jaa nɛ a sɔmɔɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ pe Bɔlɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ a gbaa kɛ yaa neneene ɔ! Amen.

english_verse: God let them follow their own evil desires. Women no longer wanted to have sex in a natural way, and they did things with each other that were not natural.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Mawu ngmɛɛ a he ngɔ ha zo nihi a he hɛdɔmi ɔ nɛ; ejakaa nɔ nɛ a to nɛ a peɔ ɔ, a yi ɔmɛ tsake hɛ mi ngɔ ha nɔ nɛ a pee we.

english_verse: Men behaved in the same way. They stopped wanting to have sex with women and had strong desires for sex with other men. They did shameful things with each other, and what has happened to them is punishment for their foolish deeds.
translation_verse: Nɛ ja nɔuu a nyumu ɔmɛ hu jɔɔ yo he nɔ nɛ a to nɛ a peɔ ɔ peemi nɛ a hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ a kɔnɔ yayami ɔ mi kɛ nyɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a se, nɛ nyumuhi kɛ nyumuhi tsuɔ zo ni, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ a na a tɔmi ɔ he hiɔwo nɛ sa ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he.

english_verse: Since these people refused even to think about God, he let their useless minds rule over them. That's why they do all sorts of indecent things.
translation_verse: Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a bui kaa e sa kaa a leɔ Mawu ngɛ a ni lemi mi ɔ, Mawu hu ngmɛɛ a he ha juɛmi nɛ sɛ, konɛ a pee nihi nɛ sɛ.

english_verse: They are evil, wicked, and greedy, as well as mean in every possible way. They want what others have, and they murder, argue, cheat, and are hard to get along with. They gossip,
translation_verse: A hyi tɔ kɛ ni yayamihi, yiwitso, hɛ tsumi, yayami; a hyi tɔ kɛ nyɛmi, awi yemi, pɛ, sisimi, nihi a he munyu tumi;

english_verse: say cruel things about others, and hate God. They are proud, conceited, and boastful, always thinking up new ways to do evil. These people don't respect their parents.
translation_verse: sieku yeli, Mawu nyɛli, nɔ buili, he tsɔɔli, fiali, nɔ́ yayami he ga tsɔli, fɔli a nɔ tue gboli,

english_verse: They are stupid, unreliable, and don't have any love or pity for others.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ be yi mi, kutupɔtsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ nɛ mɔbɔ;

english_verse: They know God has said that anyone who acts this way deserves to die. But they keep on doing evil things, and they even encourage others to do them.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ le Mawu mlaa a tutuutu, kaa nihi nɛ tsuɔ lɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a sa gbenɔ, nɛ kɛ ɔ pi peemi kɛkɛ nɛ a peɔ, se mohu a naa ni nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he tsui hulɔ.

english_verse: Some of you accuse others of doing wrong. But there is no excuse for what you do. When you judge others, you condemn yourselves, because you are guilty of doing the very same things.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mo, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ o kojoɔ ɔ, o be nya jemi ko; ejakaa nɔ he nɛ o kojoɔ nɔ kpa ngɛ ɔ, o kɛ buu mo nitsɛ o he fɔ; ejakaa mo nɛ o kojoɔ nihi ɔ, jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ nɔuu o tsuɔ.

english_verse: We know that God is right to judge everyone who behaves in this way.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Mawu fɔ bumi ɔ sa nihi nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ pɛ.

english_verse: You surely don't think much of God's wonderful goodness or of his patience and willingness to put up with you. Don't you know that the reason God is good to you is because he wants you to turn to him?
translation_verse: Aloo pe o ngɛ e mi mi himi kɛ e nɔ he tsui nami kɛ e tsui si tomi babauu ɔ he guɛ gbee, se o li kaa Mawu mi mi jɔmi ɔ pe e ngɛ o he piɛe nɛ o pia o he lo?

english_verse: But you are stubborn and refuse to turn to God. So you are making things even worse for yourselves on that day when he will show how angry he is and will judge the world with fairness.
translation_verse: Se o kɛ o tsui wami kɛ o he nɛ o pia we ɔ ngɛ mi mi fumi nyɛ buae ngɔ ha mo nitsɛ o he ngɔ to mi mi fumi kɛ Mawu dami kojomi kpo jemi ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: God will reward each of us for what we have done.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa e ni tsumi ɔmɛ:

english_verse: He will give eternal life to everyone who has patiently done what is good in the hope of receiving glory, honor, and life that lasts forever.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ kɛ kpakpa peemi kɛ tsui si tomi hlaa hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu kɛ si himi nɛ puɛ we ɔ, Mawu ma ha mɛ neneene wami.

english_verse: But he will show how angry and furious he can be with every selfish person who rejects the truth and wants to do evil.
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ suɔ pɛ nɛ a bui anɔkuale ɔ tue, se a buɔ ni yayahi mohu tue ɔ, a nɔ ji mi mi fumi kɛ mi mi la.

english_verse: All who are wicked will be punished with trouble and suffering. It doesn't matter if they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Dengme kɛ he hiami maa ba nɔmlɔ tsuaa nɔmlɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni yaya nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, Yuda no nɔ kekle kɛ Hela no hu nɔ.

english_verse: But all who do right will be rewarded with glory, honor, and peace, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Se hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu kɛ he jɔmi maa ba nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni kpakpahi ɔ nɔ, Yuda no kekle kɛ Hela no hulɔ.

english_verse: God doesn't have any favorites!
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu hlɛ nimli a mi.

english_verse: Those people who don't know about God's Law will still be punished for what they do wrong. And the Law will be used to judge everyone who knows what it says.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ be Mlaa nɛ a pee yayami ɔ, a maa laa hulɔ nɛ a be mlaa; nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ gu mlaa a nɔ pee yayami ɔ, Mlaa a nɔuu a kɛ maa kojo mɛ.

english_verse: God accepts those who obey his Law, but not those who simply hear it.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi mlaa nuli ɔmɛ ji dali ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, se mlaa nɔ yeli mohu ji ninɛmɛ nɛ a maa bu kaa dali.

english_verse: This proves that the conscience is like a law written in the human heart. And it will show whether we are forgiven or condemned,
translation_verse: kɔlɔ ɔ a kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ngma Mlaa a ni tsumi ɔ ngɛ a tsui mi, nɛ a he nile hu yeɔ odase, nɛ a susumi ɔmɛ poo a nya aloo a jeɔ a nya

english_verse: when God appoints Jesus Christ to judge everyone's secret thoughts, just as my message says. The Jews and the Law
translation_verse: ngɛ ligbi nɛ Mawu maa gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ kojo nimli a laami mi ni ɔmɛ ngɛ ye Sane Kpakpa a nya a. Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛ Mlaa a

english_verse: Some of you call yourselves Jews. You trust in the Law and take pride in God.
translation_verse: Se ke moo lɛɛ a tsɛɛ mo Yuda no, nɛ o hɛ ngɛ Mlaa a nɔ, nɛ o fiaa fɔɔ Mawu nɔ,

english_verse: By reading the Scriptures you learn how God wants you to behave, and you discover what is right.
translation_verse: nɛ o le e suɔmi nya ni ɔmɛ, nɛ o le nihi nɛ hi, ejakaa a je Mlaa a mi kɛ tsɔɔ mo,

english_verse: You are sure that you are a guide for the blind and a light for all who are in the dark.
translation_verse: nɛ o buu o he kaa o ji hɛ yuyuili a blɔ tsɔɔlɔ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi ɔmɛ a la,

english_verse: And since there is knowledge and truth in God's Law, you think you can instruct fools and teach young people.
translation_verse: kɛ nihi nɛ li ni a tsɔselɔ, kɛ bimwɔwi a tsɔɔlɔ, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ nile kɛ anɔkuale nɛ ngɛ Mlaa a mi ɔ su ɔ,

english_verse: But how can you teach others when you refuse to learn? You preach it is wrong to steal. But do you steal?
translation_verse: jeha nɛ ɔ mo nɛ o tsɔɔ ni kpahi a ni ɔ, o tsɔɔ we mo nitsɛ o he lo? O fiɛɔ ke “a ko ju,” se o ju we lo?

english_verse: You say people should be faithful in marriage. But are you faithful? You hate idols, yet you rob their temples.
translation_verse: O deɔ ke “a ko bɔ ajuama,” se o bɔɛ ajuama lo? O nyɛɛ amagahi, se o ju we a sɔlemi we nihi lo?

english_verse: You take pride in the Law, but you disobey the Law and bring shame to God.
translation_verse: Mo nɛ o kɛ Mlaa a fia a, o kɛ Mlaa a nɔ tɔmi ɔ gbee Mawu he guɛ.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures tell us, “You have made foreigners say insulting things about God.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ he ɔ, a tuɔ Mawu biɛ ɔ he musu bɔmi munyuhi ngɛ majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a.

english_verse: Being circumcised is worthwhile, if you obey the Law. But if you don't obey the Law, you are no better off than people who are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Se ke o yeɔ Mlaa a nɔ ɔ, jinɛ nɔ pomi he ngɛ se nami; se ke o pee o he Mlaa a nɔ tɔlɔ ɔ, o pomi ɔ plɛ mɔmlɔtɔ.

english_verse: In fact, if they obey the Law, they are as good as anyone who is circumcised.
translation_verse: Se ke mɔmlɔtɔsɛ yeɔ Mlaa a blɔnya amɛ a nɔ ɔ, anɛ a be e mɔmlɔtɔ ɔ bue kaa pomi lo?

english_verse: So everyone who obeys the Law, but has never been circumcised, will condemn you. Even though you are circumcised and have the Law, you still don't obey its teachings.
translation_verse: Fɔmi mi mɔmlɔtɔsɛ nɛ yeɔ Mlaa a nɔ ɔ maa kojo mo nɛ o gu ngmami okadi kɛ nɔ pomi nɔ kɛ pee o he mlaa nɔ tɔlɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Just because you live like a Jew and are circumcised doesn't make you a real Jew.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi nɔ nɛ a naa lɛ kaa Yuda no kɛkɛɛkɛ ɔ ji Yuda no, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu pi kpo nɔ nɔ nɛ ngɛ he lo mi ɔ ji pomi;

english_verse: To be a real Jew you must obey the Law. True circumcision is something that happens deep in your heart, not something done to your body. And besides, you should want praise from God and not from humans.
translation_verse: se mohu nɔ nɛ ji Yudafo no ngɛ mi mi je ɔ lɛ ji Yuda no; nɛ tsui mi nɔ pomi nɛ ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ pi ngmami okadi mi ɔ, ji nɔ pomi nɛ e yi jemi ɔ ji nimli a ngɔ, se mohu Mawu ngɔ e jee.

english_verse: What good is it to be a Jew? What good is it to be circumcised?
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ mɛni ji Yuda no ni nɛ e na kɛ be nɔ mɔ? Aloo mɛni se nami lɛ ngɛ nɔ pomi mi?

english_verse: It is good in a lot of ways! First of all, God's messages were spoken to the Jews.
translation_verse: E hiɛ ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ. Kekleekle nɔ ji kaa a tu Mawu munyu ɔ ngɔ wo Yudafo ɔmɛ a dɛ.

english_verse: It is true that some of them did not believe the message. But does this mean that God cannot be trusted, just because they did not have faith?
translation_verse: Se ke ni komɛ he we yi ɔ, mɛni ʼi? A he nɛ a he we yi ɔ ma ha Mawu anɔkuale yemi ɔ maa pee yaka lo?

english_verse: No, indeed! God tells the truth, even if everyone else is a liar. The Scriptures say about God, “Your words will be proven true, and in court you will win your case.”
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Mawu ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ʼi, se snɔmlɔ tsuaa nɔmlɔ ɔ, nya ngɔlɔ ʼi, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Bene pee nɛ o ye manye ngɛ o munyu ɔmɛ a mi, Nɛ o ye nguɔ ngɛ o kojomi ɔ mi.”

english_verse: If our evil deeds show how right God is, then what can we say? Is it wrong for God to become angry and punish us? What a foolish thing to ask.
translation_verse: Se ke wa ni yayami ɔmɛ haa Mawu dami ɔ jee kpo ɔ, kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Anɛ Mawu tɔ ke e kɛ mimifumi ba wa nɔ ɔ lo?

english_verse: But the answer is, “No.” Otherwise, how could God judge the world?
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Ejakaa ke ja a, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ Mawu maa kojo je ɔ?

english_verse: Since your lies bring great honor to God by showing how truthful he is, you may ask why God still says you are a sinner.
translation_verse: Se ke ye nya ngɔmi ɔ haa Mawu anɔkuale hiɛɛ kɛ bee nɔ ha e hɛ mi nyami ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a yaa nɔ kojoɔ mi kaa yayami peelɔ?

english_verse: You might as well say, “Let's do something evil, so that something good will come of it!” Some people even claim that we are saying this. But God is fair and will judge them as well. No One Is Good
translation_verse: Mɛni he je nɛ e sɛ kaa waa pee yayami konɛ nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ ba? Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ ni komɛ poo ngɔ fɔɔ wa nɔ ke wa deɔ. Jamɛ a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a fɔ bumi ɔ da pɛ. Nɔ ko be nɛ da

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean that we Jews are better off than the Gentiles? No, it doesn't! Jews, as well as Gentiles, are ruled by sin, just as I have said.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ? Anɛ wɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ wa hi pe ni kpa amɛ lo? Tsa pi ja kulaa; ejakaa wa po Yudafohi kɛ Helabi tsuo a nya momo kaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ yayami sisi;

english_verse: The Scriptures tell us, “No one is acceptable to God!
translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ wa ngma a ke: “Dalɔ ko be, nɔ kake ngmelu be;

english_verse: Not one of them understands or even searches for God.
translation_verse: Ni lelɔ ko be, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ hlaa Mawu se blɔ.

english_verse: They have all turned away and are worthless. There isn't one person who does right.
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo kulaa a tla blɔ, Mɛ tsuo kulaa a puɛ; Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peɔ nɔ kpakpa, Nɔ kake po be.

english_verse: Their words are like an open pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies. Each word is as deadly as the fangs of a snake,
translation_verse: Yɔkɔ nɛ a bli nya ji a kuɔ si; A kɛ a lilɛ sisiɔ nɔ, Sinɔ duɔ ngɛ a nya mi.

english_verse: and they say nothing but bitter curses.
translation_verse: Gbiɛmi kɛ doomi hyi a nya mi tɔ.

english_verse: These people quickly become violent.
translation_verse: A he sɔɔ ke muɔ si puemi.

english_verse: Wherever they go, they leave ruin and destruction.
translation_verse: Hɛ mi kpatami kɛ kɔmɔ yemi ngɛ a blɔhi a nɔ,

english_verse: They don't know how to live in peace.
translation_verse: Nɛ he jɔmi blɔ ɔ a li.

english_verse: They don't even fear God.”
translation_verse: Mawu gbeye yemi ko be a hɛ mi.”

english_verse: We know that everything in the Law was written for those who are under its power. The Law says these things to stop anyone from making excuses and to let God show that the whole world is guilty.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ wa le kaa nihi kulaa nɛ Mlaa a deɔ ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Mlaa a sisi ɔ e ngɛ dee, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ko na nya, nɛ je mluku ɔ tsuo nɛ ye fɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: God doesn't accept people simply because they obey the Law. No, indeed! All the Law does is to point out our sin. God's Way of Accepting People
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a be mlaa ni tsumi nɔ gue kɛ wo he lo ko he lo ko nguɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi; ejakaa mlaa a nɔ a guu kɛ leɔ yayami. Yayamipami nɛ jee Kristo nɔhemikɛyemi mi

english_verse: Now we see how God does make us acceptable to him. The Law and the Prophets tell how we become acceptable, and it isn't by obeying the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Se jeha nɛ ɔ, a si Mlaa a se nɛ a je Mawu dami ɔ kpo paa, nɛ lɔ ɔ he odase Mlaa a kɛ gbali ɔmɛ yeɔ;

english_verse: God treats everyone alike. He accepts people only because they have faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: kɔlɔ ɔ ji Mawu dami nɛ a guu Yesu Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ a kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory.
translation_verse: Ejakaa slɔɔto ko be: ejakaa nihi tsuo peɔ yayami, nɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ bɔ mɛ,

english_verse: But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins.
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ e dloomi ɔ woɔ mɛ nguɔ yaka kɛ guu kpɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: God sent Christ to be our sacrifice. Christ offered his life's blood, so by faith in him we could come to God. And God did this to show that in the past he was right to be patient and forgive sinners. This also shows that God is right when he accepts people who have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: konɛ e je e dami ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ be nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e ye nguɔ nɛ e wo nɔ nɛ heɔ Yesu nɔ yeɔ ɔ hu nguɔ.

english_verse: What is left for us to brag about? Not a thing! Is it because we obeyed some law? No! It is because of faith.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ jije fiami ɔ ngɛ? A je lɛ kɛ je. Mɛni mlaa nɔ a gu? Ni tsumi hi a nɔ lo? Dɛbi, hemi kɛ yemi mlaa nɔ mohu a gu.

english_verse: We see that people are acceptable to God because they have faith, and not because they obey the Law.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa ngɔɔ lɛ kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɔ a guu kɛ woɔ nɔmlɔ nguɔ, se pi mlaa ni tsumihi a nɔ.

english_verse: Does God belong only to the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is!
translation_verse: Anɛ Mawu ɔ, e ji Yudafohi kɛkɛ a Mawu lo? Anɛ pi majeli ɔmɛ hu a Mawu lo? Ee, majeli ɔmɛ hu a nɔ ʼi.

english_verse: There is only one God, and he accepts Gentiles as well as Jews, simply because of their faith.
translation_verse: Ke e ngɛ mi kaa Mawu ɔ Mawu kake ʼi, nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nya e buu nɔ pomi bemi, nɛ e kpale guu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ buu mɔmlɔtɔ bemi ɔ,

english_verse: Do we destroy the Law by our faith? Not at all! We make it even more powerful.
translation_verse: lɛɛ wa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ gue nɛ wa ha Mlaa a nɛ pee yaka lo? Dɛbi, waa kɛ ngɛ Mlaa a nɔ mi mae mohu.

english_verse: Well then, what can we say about our ancestor Abraham?
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛni wa ma de ke wa tsɛ Abraham na ngɛ he lo blɔfami mɔ?

english_verse: If he became acceptable to God because of what he did, then he would have something to brag about. But he would never be able to brag about it to God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke ni tsumihi a nɔ a gu kɛ wo Abraham nguɔ ɔ, jinɛ e ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ e maa fia ngɔ fɔ nɔ, se lɛɛ pi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.”
translation_verse: Se kɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ kɛɛ? “Abraham he Mawu ye, Nɛ a bu kɔlɔ ɔ dami ha lɛ.”

english_verse: Money paid to workers isn't a gift. It is something they earn by working.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni ɔ, a bui e hiɔwo ɔ kaa dloomi nɔ ko, se mohu e blɔ nya ʼi.

english_verse: But you cannot make God accept you because of something you do. God accepts sinners only because they have faith in him.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ tsu we ni, se e heɔ nɔ nɛ woɔ yayami peelɔ nguɔ ɔ yeɔ ɔ, a buu e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kaa dami kɛ haa lɛ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ David hu deɔ ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ Mawu siɔ ni tsumihi a se nɛ e buu dami haa lɛ ɔ he ke:

english_verse: “What a blessing when God forgives our sins and our evil deeds. What a blessing when the Lord erases our sins from his book.”
translation_verse: A gbaa nyumu nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bui e he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ hi lɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ kikɛmɛ a gbaami nɛ ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔ kɛkɛ a kɛ gbaa aloo mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ? Ejakaa wa deɔ ke a bu Abraham hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kaa dami ngɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Nɛ be mi nɛ a po lɛ ɔ, e nine su nɔ pomi he okadi ɔ nɔ kaa dami nya sɔumi nɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu he nɛ e he ye be mi nɛ e ji mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ lokoo ɔ nya, konɛ e pee tsɛ kɛ ha nihi kulaa nɛ heɔ yeɔ benɛ a ji mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ɔ nɛ a bu dami ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ hulɔ,

english_verse: This also makes Abraham the father of everyone who is circumcised and has faith in God, as Abraham did before he was circumcised. The Promise Is for All Who Have Faith
translation_verse: nɛ jeha nɛ e pee ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔ a tsɛ hulɔ kɛ ha nihi nɛ a pui mɛ se mohu a ngɔ wa tsɛ Abraham nane ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ e ngɛ be mi nɛ e ji mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ lokoo ɔ. Mawu siwomi nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Pi mlaa nɔ nɛ Mawu gu kɛ wo Abraham loo e nina si kaa e maa ye je ɔ nɔ ɔ, se mohu hemi kɛ yemi dami nɔ a gu.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke mlaa sisibi ɔmɛ ji ni yeli ɔ, lɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ pee yaka, nɛ si womi ɔ hu be nɔ hu.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Se Mlaa a tsɛɔ Mawu mi mi fumi kɛ baa, mɛni he je ɔ, he nɛ mlaa be ɔ, mlaa nɔ tɔmi hu be.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Se enɛ ɔ he je nɛ e je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ nɛ, benɛ pee nɛ e pee dloomi sane, konɛ si womi ɔ nɛ ma si kpɛii ngɔ ha e nina tsuo, pi Mlaa sisibi ɔmɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu nihi nɛ je Abraham, nɛ ji wɔ tsuo wa tsɛ ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ hulɔ,

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “I ngɔ mo ngɔ pee majeli fuu a tsɛ,” ngɛ Mawu nɔ nɛ e he yeɔ ɔ hɛ mi, nɔ nɛ tsɛɛ ni gbogboehi a hɛ, nɛ e tsɛɔ nihi nɛ be ɔ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ momo ɔ.

english_verse: God promised Abraham a lot of descendants. And when it all seemed hopeless, Abraham still had faith in God and became the ancestor of many nations.
translation_verse: Nɛ jinɛ he nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko be ɔ, Abraham hɛ ngɛ nɔ kɛ̃ nɛ e he ye, konɛ e plɛ majeli fuu a tsɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Ja o nina maa hi” ɔ.

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: E yi mi pee we lɛ enyɔ enyɔ ngɛ Mawu si womi ɔ he kaa nɔ nɛ e he we yi, se mohu e na he wami ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, nɛ e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami,

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: nɛ e ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ saminya kaa nɔ nɛ e wo he si ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa pee hulɔ.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: Se pi lɛ kɛkɛ e he nɛ a ngma ke, “a bu dami ngɔ ha lɛ” ɔ,

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: se mohu wɔ nihi nɛ a maa bu ngɔ ha a hu wa he, wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa heɔ nɔ nɛ tle wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si kɛ je gbeje ɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: A ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha ngɛ wa tɔmi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a tle lɛ si ekohu ngɛ wa nguɔ womi ɔ he.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ɔ akɛnɛ a gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ wo wɔ nguɔ he je ɔ, waa kɛ Mawu kpɛti ngɛ he jɔmi ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: Lɛ e nɔ wa gu nɛ waa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ na blɔ kɛ ba dloomi nɛ wa daa si ngɛ mi ɔ mi, nɛ wa fiaa fɔɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: But that's not all! We gladly suffer, because we know that suffering helps us to endure.
translation_verse: Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu wa fiaa ngɛ dengme gbomihi a mi hulɔ, ejakaa wa le kaa dengme gbomi ɔ tsɛɛ tsui si tomi kɛ baa,

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ gbi nɔ zo, ejakaa a gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ a ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ nɔ plɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ ngɔ wo wa tsui mi.

english_verse: Christ died for us at a time when we were helpless and sinful.
translation_verse: Ejakaa be mi nɛ wa he wɛ ɔ lokoo nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ha yayami peeli.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e maa wa loko nɔ ko ma gbo ha dalɔ ko; se nɔ́ kpakpa ko he ɔ, eko ɔ, nɔ ko ma si e gugue kaa e maa gbo.

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: Se Mawu jeɔ e suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ wɔ kpo tsɔɔ, kaa be mi nɛ wa ji yayami peeli lokoo nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ wa nane mi.

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ ɔ, nɛ a wo wɔ nguɔ ngɛ e muɔ ɔ he he je ɔ, a maa gu e nɔ kɛ he wa yi wami hluu kɛ je mi mi fumi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke be mi nɛ wa ji henyɛli ɔ nɛ a kɛ Mawu bi ɔ gbenɔ ba kpata waa kɛ Mawu kpɛti ɔ, jeha nɛ nɛ a kpata nɛ ɔ, a ma he wa yi wami hluu ngɛ e wami ɔ mi.

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: Pi lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu wa fiaa fɔɔ Mawu nɔ hulɔ ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he, nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ wa gu jeha nɛ kɛ na kpatami ɔ. Adam kɛ Yesu Kristo

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Yayami ngɛ je ɔ mi loko a ha Mlaa a; se akɛnɛ Mlaa be he je ɔ a bui yayami ɔ.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ gbenɔ ye tsɛ kɛ je Adam yi nɔ kɛ ba su Mose yi nɔ ngɛ nihi po nɛ pee we yayami nɛ ngɛ kaa Adam tɔmi ɔ nɔ, nɛ Adam ji nɔ nɛ maa ba a he okadi.

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: Se bɔ nɛ si gbeemi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, pi ja nɛ dloomi nɔke nɔ ɔ hu ngɛ. Ejakaa ke nɔ kake si gbeemi he je nɛ nihi fuu gbo ɔ, Mawu dloomi kɛ nɔke nɔ nɛ gu nɔmlɔ kake nɛ ji Yesu Kristo ɔ dloomi nɔ kɛ ba a hiɛ kɛ be nɔ babauu ha nihi fuu.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ si gbeemi ɔ gu nɔ kake nɛ pee yayami ɔ nɔ kɛ ba a, pi ja nɛ dloomi ɔ ngɛ: ejakaa kojomi ɔ je nɔ kake mi nɛ e plɛ fɔ bumi, se dloomi nɔke nɔ ɔ je si gbeemihi fuu a mi nɛ e plɛ nyɔguɛ yemi.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nɔ kake si gbeemi ɔ he je nɛ gbenɔ gu lɛ nɔ kake ɔ nɔ ye tsɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nihi nɛ na dloomi kɛ dami nɔke nɔ nɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ ɔ maa gu nɔ kake nɛ ji Yesu Kristo ɔ nɔ maa ye tsɛ ngɛ wami mi.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a gu nɔ kake si gbeemi nɔ bu nimli tsuo fɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ a gu nɔ kake dami nɔ wo nimli kulaa wami nguɔ.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ a gu nɔmlɔ kake tue gbomi ɔ nɔ ha nihi fuu plɛ yayami peeli ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ a maa gu nɔ kake ɔ tue bumi ɔ nɔ a ma ha, nihi fuu hu ma plɛ dali.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Se Mlaa a ba hɔ kpɛ konɛ si gbeemi ɔ nɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ. Se he nɛ yayami hiɛ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ Mawu dloomi ɔ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ babauu ngɛ;

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: konɛ bɔ nɛ yayami ɔ ye tsɛ ngɛ gbenɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu dloomi ɔ maa gu dami nɔ kɛ ye tsɛ hulɔ kɛ maa ya neneene wami mi ngɛ Yesu Kristo wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Waa hi yayami ɔ mi konɛ Mawu dloomi nɛ hiɛ lo?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Wɔ nɛ wa gbo ngɔ ha yayami ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ wa hɛ maa tsa nɔ hi ngmengmle ngɛ e mi?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Aloo nyɛ li kaa wa ti nihi abɔ nɛ a baptisi ngɔ wo Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, e gbenɔ ɔ mi a baptisi wɔ ngɔ wo lo?

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kɛ baptisimi nɛ a baptisi wɔ ngɔ wo e gbenɔ ɔ mi ɔ pu waa kɛ lɛ tsuo, konɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a tle Yesu si kɛ je gbeje ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyɛmi nya a, ja nɔuu kɛ wɔ hu waa nyɛɛ ngɛ wami nɛ plɛ ehe mi.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke waa kɛ lɛ pee kake ngɛ e gbenɔ nɛ e gbo ɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ waa kɛ lɛ maa pee kake ngɛ e si temi ɔ mi hulɔ.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Wa le enɛ ɔ kaa a sɛu wa nɔmlɔ tso momo ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he konɛ yayami nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hɛ mi nɛ kpata nɛ wa ko sɔmɔ yayami hu.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, e kɛ yayami gba mi.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Ke waa kɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa waa kɛ lɛ ma na wami hulɔ,

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: ejakaa wa le kaa nɛ a tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje nɛ ɔ ɔ, e be gboe hu; gbenɔ be e nɔ nyɔmtsɛ yee hu.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɛ e gbo ɔ, yayami e gbo ha si kake pɛ; se nɛ e hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ ɔ, Mawu e hɛ ngɛ ha.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Ja nyɛ hu nyɛɛ bu nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ a gbo ha yayami nɛ a hɛ ngɛ kɛ ha Mawu ngɛ Yesu Kristo wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko ha yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ ma gbo ɔ nɔ tsɛ nɛ nyɛ bu lɛ tue ngɛ e kɔnɔ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ he ni ɔmɛ ngɔ ha yayami kaa ni yayami ɔmɛ a tahwumi nihi, se mohu nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Mawu kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ tsɛ kɛ je gbeje, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ni ɔmɛ nɛ pee dami tahwumi nihi ngɔ ha Mawu.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Ejakaa yayami be nyɛ nɔ he wami nae, ejakaa pi mlaa sisi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ, se mohu dloomi sisi nyɛ ngɛ. Dami mi nyɔguɛhi

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ? Waa pee yayami akɛnɛ wa be Mlaa sisi se dloomi mohu sisi wa ngɛ ɔ lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ he ngɔ peɔ nyɔguɛhi haa nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e nyɔguɛhi ji nyɛ nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ lo? — yayami nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi ɔ jio, loo tuebumi nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa dami mi ɔ jio.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Se sina ha Mawu kaa jinɛ sa a yayami nyɔguɛhi ji nyɛ, se jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ je nyɛ tsui tsuo mi kɛ bu kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ ngɔ wo mi nɛ ɔ tue.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: A kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je yayami dɛ mi nɛ nyɛ ye nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ plɛ dami nyɔguɛhi.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ tuɔ munyu i ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ nɛ, ngɛ nyɛ he lo gbedemi ɔ he. Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pee hiemi nihi kɛ mlaa tɔmi nyɔguɛhi kɛ sɛ mlaa tɔmi mi ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pee dami nyɔguɛhi kɛ ha klɔuklɔu peemi.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ nyɛ ji yayami nyɔguɛhi ɔ, nyɛ ye nyɛ he kɛ je dami ɔ dɛ mi.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛni yiblii nyɛ wo ngɛ lɛ be ɔ mi? Yiblii nɛ zo gbe nyɛ ngɛ he jeha nɛ; ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji gbenɔ.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Se jeha nɛ ɔ, nɛ a kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je yayami dɛ mi nɛ nyɛ plɛ Mawu nyɔguɛhi nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ wo yiblii ha klɔuklɔu peemi nɛ we nyagbe ji neneene wami ɔ.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Ejakaa yayami dɛ mi hiɔwe ɔ gbenɔ ʼi; se Mawu dloomi nike ni ɔ neneene wami ʼi ngɛ Kristo Yesu wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, tse nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ le Mlaa a le kaa Mlaa a yeɔ nɔmlɔ nɔ ngɛ e wami be ɔ kulaa mi lo?

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Ejakaa yo nɛ ngɛ huno ɔ, mlaa fi lɛ ngɔ mɛtɛ e huno nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ he; se ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, e kɛ e huno ɔ mlaa a be sane ko hu.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, ja nɔuu nyɛ hu a kɛ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gbe nyɛ ngɔ ha Mlaa a, konɛ nyɛ plɛ nɔ kpa na ji nɔ nɛ a tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ nihi, konɛ waa wo yiblii ha Mawu.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Ejakaa bene wa ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, yayamihi a he hɛdɔ ɔmɛ guu mlaa a nɔ tsuɔ ni ngɛ wa he ni ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ waa kɛ wo yiblii ha gbenɔ.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Se jeha nɛ waa kɛ Mlaa a be sane ko hu, ejakaa wa gbo ngɔ ha nɔ nɛ hɛɛ wami ɔ, bene pee nɛ wa sɔmɔ ngɛ mumi nɛ plɛ ehe ɔ mi, se pi ngɛ Mlaa momo ɔ nya. Mlaa kɛ yayami

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Anɛ Mlaa a yayami ʼi lo? Dɛbi! Se mohu ke pi Mlaa a he jinɛ i li yayami. Ejakaa jinɛ i li nɔ́ nɛ ji hɛ̃kɔ, ke pi Mlaa a nɛ de ke: “O hɛ ko kɔ nihi a nɔ.”

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Se kita a nɔ yayami gu kɛ na he blɔ nɛ e kɛ tsɛ akɔnɔ nihi tsuo wo ye mi; ejakaa ke Mlaa be ɔ, yayami hu gbo.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: I hi si hyɛ nɛ i be mlaa, se bene kita a ba a, yayami ɔ hɛ tsɛ ekohu.

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i gbo, nɛ i na kaa kita a nɛ a kɛ ha mi ngɛ wami he ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ tsɛ gbenɔ ngɔ ha mi.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Ejakaa yayami gu kita a nɔ na he blɔ nɛ e kɛ sisi mi nɛ e kɛ lɔ ɔ nɔuu gbe mi.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mlaa a ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ Kita a hu ngɛ klɔuklɔu nɛ e da nɛ e hi.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ nɔ́ kpakpa a plɛ gbenɔ ha mi lo? Dɛbi! Se mohu bene pee nɛ yayami ɔ nɛ je si kaa yayami he ɔ, e kɛ nɔ́ kpakpa a nɔuu tsɛ gbenɔ ngɔ ha mi, konɛ yayami ɔ nɛ gu kita a nɔ nɛ e plɛ yayami nɛ be nɔ. Nɔmlɔ mi suhi enyɔ

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Mlaa a mumi mi nɔ́ ʼi; se imi lɛɛ he lo nɔmlɔ ji mi, nɛ a jua mi ngɔ ha yayami.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ i li; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, pi lɔ ɔ nɛ i peɔ, se nɔ́ nɛ i nyɛɛ mohu ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ i peɔ.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ́ nɛ i sume ɔ nɔuu i peɔ ɔ, i kplɛɔ kaa Mlaa a hi.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ jeha nɛ pi imi nɛ i tsuɔ kɔlɔ ɔ hu, se mohu yayami nɛ hii ye mi ɔ lɛ tsuɔ.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i le kaa ye mi, lɔ ɔ ji ye he lo ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ ko kpakpa ko be lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa suɔmi ɔ i ngɛ eko mohu, se kpakpa peemi lɛ bɔ mi.

english_verse: Instead of doing what I know is right, I do wrong.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ i suɔ ɔ, i pee we, se nɔ́ yayami nɛ i sume ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ mohu i peɔ.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ́ nɛ i sume ɔ kɛ̃ i peɔ ɔ, lɛɛ tsa pi imi nɛ i peɔ kɔlɔ ɔ hu, se mohu yayami nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ lɛ peɔ.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ i naa mlaa nɛ ɔ kaa imi nɛ i suɔ kaa ma pee nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, yayami mohu mɛtɛ ye he.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ye mi blɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ bua jɔɔ ngɛ Mawu Mlaa a he.

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: Se i naa mlaa muno ko ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso he ni ɔmɛ a mi nɛ kɛ ye juɛmi mlaa a hwuɔ ta, nɛ e ngɔɔ mi nyɔguɛ ngɔ haa yayami mlaa a nɛ ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso he ni ɔmɛ a mi ɔ.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ ni ngɛ mɔbɔ ji mi; mɛnɔ lɛ ma je mi kɛ maa je kikɛmɛ a gbenɔ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ ɔ dɛ mi?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Sina ha Mawu kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ. Jeha nɛ imi nɔuu i kɛ ye juɛmi sɔmɔɔ Mawu mlaa a lɛɛ, se i kɛ ye he lo sɔmɔɔ yayami mlaa.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mlaa nɛ ji wami kɛ mumi mlaa a nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ kpɔ mi ngɛ yayami kɛ gbenɔ mlaa a dɛ mi.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a nyɛ we nɛ e pee ngɛ gbedemi nɛ he lo ɔ gbede he je ɔ, Mawu tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e bi ɔ ngɛ su nɛ ngɛ kaa yayami he lo su mi, nɛ ngɛ yayami he hulɔ, konɛ e bu yayami ɔ fɔ ngɛ he lo ɔ mi,

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: konɛ a gbe mlaa a dami ɔ nya ngɛ wa mi, wɔ nihi nɛ wa nyɛɛ we ngɛ he lo nya, se mohu mumi nya wa nyɛɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ he lo nya a, he lo nihi a he a susuu, se nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ mumi nya a susuu mumi mi nihi a he.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Ejakaa he lo juɛmi ɔ lɛɛ gbenɔ ʼi, se mumi juɛmi ɔ, wami kɛ he jɔmi ʼi.

english_verse: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.
translation_verse: Ejakaa he lo juɛmi ɔ Mawu nyɛmi ʼi, ejakaa e bɛ e he si ha we Mawu mlaa a, nɛ pohu e be nyɛe tete.

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ he lo mi ɔ be nyɛe nɛ a sa Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Se ke e ngɛ mi kaa Mawu Mumi hii nyɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ be he lo ɔ sisi, se mohu mumi ɔ sisi nyɛ ngɛ. Ke nɔ ko be Kristo Mumi ɔ, lɛɛ tsa pi Kristo nɔ́ ji lɛ.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Se ke Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gbo ngɛ yayami he lɛɛ, se mumi ɔ ji wami ngɛ dami he.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke he lo nya nyɛ hii si ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma gbo. Se ke nyɛɛ kɛ Mumi ɔ gbee he lo ɔ ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ yi ma na wa.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ Mawu Mumi ɔ kpakaa mɛ ɔ, mɛ ji Mawu bimɛ.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi nyɔguɛ yemi mumi nɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛ ma pa ye gbeye, se mohu nyɛ na bimɛ a plɛmi mumi, nɔ́ mi nɛ wa kpaa ngmlaa ngɛ ke: “Abba,” Tsaatsɛ! ɔ.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Mawu Mumi ɔ nitsɛ kɛ wa mumi ɔ yeɔ odase kaa Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Nɛ ke bimɛ ji wɔ ɔ, lɛɛ we ni yeli hu ji wɔ, Mawu we ni yeli kɛ Kristo nyɛmimɛ we ni yeli, ke e ngɛ mi kaa waa kɛ lɛ naa amanehlu ɔ, konɛ a wo waa kɛ lɛ hɛ mi nyami hulɔ. Hwɔɔ se nyami

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i susuu kaa mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ nyami nɛ hwɔɔ se a ma je kpo ha wɔ ɔ sɔɛ.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Ejakaa adebɔ ni ɔmɛ a blɔ hyemi kpikpimaa a ngɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ wa kpo jemi ɔ mlɛe.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Ejakaa a ngɔ adebɔ ni ɔmɛ ngɔ wo yakayaka ni a sisi, pi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya, se mohu ngɛ nɔ nɛ ba mɛ si ɔ he, ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi,

english_verse: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.
translation_verse: ejakaa adebɔ ni ɔmɛ hu maa ye a he kɛ maa je puemi nyɔguɛ yemi ɔ mi kɛ maa ya Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ a nyami he yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa le kaa adebɔ ni ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ wɔ ngɛ kɛmɛe nɛ a kɛ wɔ ngɛ kɔɔe kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Nɛ tsa pi mɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu wɔ nitsɛmɛ tete, wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa na Mumi ɔ kekle yiblii ɔmɛ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu wa laa zanue ngɛ wa mi, nɛ wa hyɛɛ bimɛ a plɛmi nɛ ji wa nɔmlɔ tso kpɔmi ɔ blɔ.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Ejakaa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nya a he wa yi wami ngɛ. Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ a naa a, e pi hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi. Ejakaa mɛnɔ hɛ hii nɔ́ nɛ a naa a nɔ?

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ́ nɛ wa nɛ́ ɔ nɔ wa hɛ ngɛ ɔ, lɛɛ wa kɛ tsui si tomi hyɛɛ lɛ blɔ.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu Mumi ɔ hu yeɔ buaa wa gbedemi ɔ; ejakaa bɔ nɛ sa kaa wa ko sɔle kɛ bi nɔ nɛ da a, wa li; se Mumi ɔ nitsɛ kɛ kɔmɔ yemi nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale daa mi haa wɔ.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Se Mawu nɛ hlaa tsuihi a mi ɔ le nɔ́ nɛ ji Mumi ɔ juɛmi ɔ, ejakaa e daa mi haa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Se wa le kaa, nihi tsuo mi ɔ, Mawu yeɔ buaa nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ konɛ e hi ha mɛ, mɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a tsɛ mɛ ngɛ e yi mi tomi nya a.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ e le mɛ momo ɔ, mɛ e je ngɔ to konɛ a subai nɛ hi kaa e bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, konɛ Bi ɔ e pee nyɛmimɛ fuu a kpɛti bi nɔkɔtɔma.

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he mɔ? Ke Mawu ngɛ wa se ɔ, mɛnɔ maa te si ngɔ wo wɔ?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ kamaa we wɔ elɛ nitsɛ e Bi ɔ, se mohu e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha ngɛ wɔ tsuo wa nane mi ɔ, anɛ e be nihi tsuo kulaa ngɔe ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ke wɔ lo?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ maa po nihi nɛ Mawu hla amɛ a nya? Mawu ji nɔ nɛ woɔ nguɔ.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ buu fɔ ɔ? Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ e gbo, se nɔ́ nɛ pe kɔlɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ a tle lɛ si hulɔ, nɛ e ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e pa daa mi haa wɔ.

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ma gba waa kɛ Kristo suɔmi ɔ mi? Amanehlu loo tsui pomi loo yi wami loo hwɔ loo he gu nyɛɛmi loo he gbeye womi loo klaate?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ke: “O he ɔ, a gbee wɔ hluu je nami kɛ ya siɔ du bubui, A buu wɔ kaa tohi nɛ a yaa gbe mɛ.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa mi ɔ, wa guu nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ nɔ yeɔ kunimi babauu.

english_verse: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future,
translation_verse: Ejakaa i ngɛ nɔ mi mami kaa gbenɔ jio, wami jio, hiɔwe bɔfohi jio, nɔ yeli jio, he wamihi jio, nihi nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔmɛ jio, nihi nɛ maa ba amɛ jio,

english_verse: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!
translation_verse: hiɔwe jio, sisi jio, aloo nihi nɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ a mi nɔ́ kpa ko jio, a be nyɛe ma gba waa kɛ Mawu suɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, mi ɔ mi.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Anɔkuale i ngɛ dee ngɛ Kristo mi, i yi lakpa, nɛ ye he ni lemi hu yeɔ mi odase ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi,

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.

translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ ji kaa, tsa pi he lo nya bimɛ ɔmɛ ji Mawu bimɛ, se si womi bimɛ ɔmɛ mohu a buu kaa nina.

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.

translation_verse: Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yesaia de ngɔ to momo ɔ ke: “E ji e ya pee kaa tahi a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ́ nina ko ngɔ hi wɔ jinɛ, wa ngɛ kaa Sodoma, nɛ wa plɛ kaa Gomora pɛ.” Israel kɛ Sane Kpakpa a

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Lɔ ɔ ji majeli a bimɛ nɛ di dami se ɔ na dami nɛ ji dami nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ;

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: Mɛni he je? Ejakaa a gui hemi kɛ yemi nɔ kɛ hla we, se mohu kaa nihi nɛ guu ni tsumihi a nɔ kɛ hlaa.

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa a tɛ tɛmi tɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Oʼɛ, i kɛ tɛ kɛ nane kpatami tɛ sa ko Ngɛ si mae ngɛ Zion, Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ, Zo be lɛ gbee.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo ji Mlaa a nyagbe, nɛ lɛ ji dami kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ. Yiwamihemi ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ

translation_verse: Ejakaa Mose ngma ngɛ dami nɛ je Mlaa mi ɔ he ke: “Nɔmlɔ nɛ yeɔ enɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ yi ma na wa ngɛ mi.”

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Se mohu kɛ e deɔ kɛɛ? Mawu munyu ɔ na mo ngɛ o nya mi kɛ o tsui mi tsuo; .

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Ke o kɛ o nya jaje ke Yesu ji Nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ o he ye ngɛ o tsui mi kaa Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, a ma he o yi wami.

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,

translation_verse: Ha a hɛ mi nɛ wo diblii, nɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ́, Nɛ daa nɛ ɔ o ha a dɔ kɔmɔɔ.”

translation_verse: Se nyɛ majeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Be abɔ nɛ imi ji maje li ɔmɛ a bɔfo nɛ ɔ ɔ, ma wo ye sɔmɔmi ɔ hɛ mi nyami,

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Ke ma nɛ a sa a ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, lɛɛ jã ma mluku ɔ kulaa hu ngɛ; nɛ ke tso sipoku ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, lɛɛ jã kɔni ɔmɛ hu ngɛ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Ke a po tso kɔni ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nɛ a ngɔ mo nɛ o ji nga mi nu tso ɔ ngɔ ta he, nɛ o na nu tso ɔ poku ɔ kɛ e mi nyu ɔ eko ɔ,

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: koo fia ngɛ kɔni ɔmɛ a nɔ; ke o fia ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, oʼɛ, tsa pi mo nɛ o hɛɛ poku ɔ, se poku ɔ mohu lɛ hɛɛ mo.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Saminya; hemi nɛ a he we yi he je nɛ a po mɛ; nɛ moo lɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi o kɛ daa si nɛ ɔ nɛ. O yi ko fu, se mohu yee o he gbeye.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Ejakaa, ke Mawu baa we tso ɔ nitsɛ kɔni ɔmɛ a yi ɔ, eko ɔ, mo hu e be o yi baae.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hyɛ Mawu mi mi himi kɛ e sane wami ɔ tsuo. E sane wa ngɛ nihi nɛ gbee si ɔmɛ a nɔ, se moo lɛɛ e mi mi hi ngɛ o nɔ, ke o hi e mi mi himi ɔ mi ɔ; ke pi ja a, a maa po mo ngɔ sake ngɔ fɔ he.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛ hu, ke a ngmɛɛ hemi nɛ a he we yi ɔ he ɔ, a maa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ta he; ejakaa Mawu ma nyɛ maa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ta he.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Nɛ ke moo lɛɛ pe a po mo ngɛ tso nɛ ji nga mi nu tso ngɛ bɔ su nya a he, nɛ a ngɔ mo ngɔ ta nu tso kpakpa a he, nɔ́ ko nɛ a pɔɛ peemi ɔ, nihi nɛ a ji tso ɔ nitsɛ kɔni ɔmɛ ɔ, a nɛ a be mɛ ngɔe ngɔ ta mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nu tso ɔ he hluu lo? Mawu mɔbɔnami kɛ ha nimli

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: I sume kaa ma laa nyɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ nɔ, mamimɛ, konɛ nyɛ ko bu nyɛ he ni leli, ke: Pe a wlua Israel tsui fa kɛ fa kɛ yaa si be nɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ a hiɛmi ɔ maa su,

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: nɛ lɔ ɔ loko a ma he Israel tsuo yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Jelɔ ɔ maa je Zion kɛ maa ba, Nɛ e ma ba je Yakob he nɔ yayami peemi ɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ,

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Nɛ enɛ ɔ ji i kɛ mɛ wa kpɛti somi ɔ, Kaa ma je a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ho.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a blɔfami ɔ, he nyɛli ji mɛ ngɛ nyɛ he. Se ngɛ hlami ɔ blɔfami ɔ, a suɔ mɛ ngɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu pia we e he ngɛ e dloomi ni ɔmɛ kɛ e tsɛmi ɔ he.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ sa a nyɛ hu nyɛ bui Mawu tue, se jeha nɛ a na nyɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ a tuegbenɔ ɔ he ɔ,

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: ja nɔuu kɛ̃ mɛ hu a tue gbo, konɛ bɔ nɛ a na nyɛ mɔbɔ ɔ mɛ hu a na mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu nga nihi kulaa a yi ngɔ wo tuegbenɔ mi, benɛ pee nɛ e na mɛ kulaa mɔbɔ. Mawu yijemi

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Oo, bɔ nɛ Mawu Ni hiɛhiɛ kɛ ga kɛ ni lemi mi kuɔ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! E kojomi ɔmɛ ɔ, a nyɛ we sisi nami, nɛ e blɔ ɔmɛ bu, a nyɛ we hiɔmi!

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: “Ejakaa mɛnɔ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ juɛmi ɔ, Aloo mɛnɔ wo lɛ ga hyɛ?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Aloo mɛnɔ sɛ hlami ha lɛ nɔ́ ko, Nɛ jinɛ a ko to lɛ nane mi?”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e dɛ mi nihi tsuo je, nɛ e nɔ a gu kɛ ba, nɛ lɛ nɔuu a ngɛ kɛ ha. A ngɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ ya neneene! Amen.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, i kɛ Mawu mɔbɔ nami ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae, kaa nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ ngɔ da si kaa bɔ klɔuklɔu nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ he tsɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi nɛ nyɛ jami ɔ nɛ pee mumi mi jami.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ je mi bami ko pee kaa je mi bihi a je mi bami, se mohu nyɛ ha Mawu nɛ tsake nyɛ juɛmi, konɛ nyɛ yɔse nihi nɛ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ni kpakpahi nɛ sa e hɛ mi saminya nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Se i kɛ dloomi nɛ a kɛ dloo mi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ dee ke e ko bu lɛ nitsɛ e he babauu tsɔ pe bɔ nɛ sa kaa e buu e he, se mohu e susu hɛ si kami susumi, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu kale hemi kɛ yemi kalemi ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake he ɔ wa ngɛ he nihi fuu, se he ni ɔmɛ tsuo tsu we ni tsumi kake ɔ,

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: ja nɔuu wɔ fuu nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ tso kake ji wɔ ngɛ Kristo mi, nɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, e nyɛmi he nɔ́ ji lɛ.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Nɛ ngɛ dloomi nɛ a ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ nya a, wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ dloomi ke ni slɔɔtohi slɔɔtohi: Ke gbami ʼi ɔ, waa gba ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kalemi ɔ nya.

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: Ke sɔmɔmi ʼi ɔ, waa hɛɛ sɔmɔmi ɔ nɔuu mi; ke ni tsɔɔmi ɔ, wa hɛɛ ni tsɔɔmi ɔ mi;

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi ɔ, e hɛɛ munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ mi; nɔ nɛ dlaa ni ngɔ haa nihi ɔ, e pee kɛ tsui jɔjɔɛ. Nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔkɔtɔma a, e bɔ mɔde. Nɔ nɛ naa mɔbɔ ɔ, e pee kɛ tsui mi jɔmi.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Suɔmi ɔ, osato ko hi mi. Nyɛɛ nyɛ yayami kulaa; nyɛɛ pɛtɛ nɔ kpakpa he.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛ a suɔmi nɛ suɔ nyɛ he; nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ bu nɛ ha e nyɛmi kekle.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ mɔde bɔmi ɔ nya ko ba si; nyɛ mumi ɔ he nɛ dɔ la; nyɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nya ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi; nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ dengme gbomi mi; nyɛɛ hɛɛ sɔlemi mi daa.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kɔmɔ ɔ e pee nyɛ kɔmɔ; nyɛɛ bɔ nibwɔ peemi he mɔde.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ gbaa nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ, nyɛɛ gbaa nɛ nyɛ ko gbiɛ.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ nɛ nya, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ya foe ɔ nɛ fo.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Nyɛ susu nɔ́ kake; nyɛ ko susu ni nguahi, se mohu nyɛɛ kɛ he si bali ɔmɛ nɛ bɔ. Nyɛ ko bu nyɛ he nileli.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ngɔ yayami ngɔ ma nɔ ko nɔ ko yayami nane mi. Nyɛ susu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ fɛu ngɛ nimli kulaa a hɛ mi ɔ he.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Ke e maa hi ɔ, nyɛ blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nimli tsuo nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: Suɔli, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he lue, se mohu nyɛɛ ngmɛ mi mi fumi ɔ blɔ; ejakaa a ngma ke: “Ye nɔ ji lue yemi, Imi ma to nane mi, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke hwɔ ngɛ o he nyɛlɔ yee ɔ, ha lɛ ni nɛ e ye. Ke kuma ngɛ lɛ tɔe ɔ, ha lɛ nyu nɛ e nu; ejakaa ke o pee ja a, o ma kpane hã kɛ la nya ngɔ pue e yi kpɛti.

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Ko ha yayami nɛ ye o nɔ, se mohu o kɛ kpakpa peemi nɛ ye yayami nɔ.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba e he si ngɔ ha nɔ yeli nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ. Ejakaa he blɔ ko be nɛ e ji Mawu ngɔ; se he blɔhi nɛ ngɛ ɔ Mawu nɛ to.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ɔ tsa pi tsumi kpakpahi a he gbeye nɛ a woɔ, se ni tsumi yayahi mohu. Anɛ o suɔ nɛ o ko ye nɔ yelɔ ɔ gbeye lo? Lɛɛ pee nɔ kpakpa, nɛ o ma na yi jemi kɛ maa je e dɛ mi;

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: ejakaa Mawu sɔmɔlɔ ji lɛ ngɛ o he, konɛ e hi ha mo. Se ke o pee nɔ́ nɛ ji nɔ́ yayami ɔ, yee gbeye! Ejakaa tsa pi yaka nɛ e hɛɛ hiɔ ɔ; se e ji Mawu sɔmɔlɔ nɛ kɛ mi mi fumi yeɔ lue ngɛ nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni yayahi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa a baa he si, pi ngɛ Mawu abofu ɔ kɛkɛ he, se mohu ngɛ he ni lemi he hulɔ.
