english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Enɛ he je hulɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuɔ onia a nɛ. Ejakaa Mawu tsɔli ji mɛ, nɛ kikɛmɛ a sɔmɔmi nɛ ɔ nɔuu he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko hɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hiɔ, kaa ja suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa suɔ nyɛ sibi ɔ. Ejakaa nɔ nɛ suɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ye Mlaa a nɔ ta.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ a de ke: “Koo bɔ ajuama! Koo gbe nɔmlɔ! Koo ju! Koo ye lakpa odase! O hɛ ko kɔ nɔ́ ko nɔ!” ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa, kɛ ekpa komɛ hu nɛ ngɛ ɔ, hɔ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ji: “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he” ɔ mi.

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Suɔmi pee we e nyɛmi nɔ yayami ko, lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, suɔmi pɛ ji Mlaa a nɔ yemi.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ wa le be ɔ kaa jeha nɛ ngmlɛfia nɛ waa kɛ maa te si kɛ je mahɛ mi ɔ su; ejakaa jeha nɛ wa yi wami hemi ɔ na wɔ pe kekle benɛ wa he ye ɔ.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Nyɔ ɔ be ta, na je nami na wɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ha nɛ waa ngmɛɛ diblii mi ni tsumi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ waa wo la ta hwumi ni ɔmɛ.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ba wa je mi saminya bɔ nɛ sa piani, pi ngɛ yakayaka fiɛmi kɛ da demi mi; pi ngɛ ajuama bɔmi kɛ ya homi mi; pi ngɛ pɛ kɛ hunga jemi mi;

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: se mohu nyɛɛ wo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo, nɛ nyɛ ko ha he lo ɔ he susumi ɔ ba plɛ he lo ɔ se dimi.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ gbɔjɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ atuu, se nyɛ ko kojo e susumi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ e kɛ yeɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ; se nɔ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, pui kɛkɛ e yeɔ.

english_verse: But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ɔ, e ko gbe nɔ nɛ yi ɔ he guɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ yi ɔ, e ko kojo nɔ nɛ yeɔ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu ngɔ lɛ.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Moo lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o kojoɔ nɔ kpa sɔmɔlɔ? Lɛ nitsɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ e daa si aloo e nɔɔ si haa; se a ma ha e maa da si, ejakaa Mawu ngɛ he wami nɛ e ma ha e da si.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko buu ligbi ko pe eko, nɛ nɔ ko hu buu ligbi tsuaa ligbi pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na lɛ nitsɛ e juɛmi ɔ nɔ he wami.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ buu ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ e buu haa; nɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ ni ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ eyeɔ haa, ejakaa e naa Mawu si. Nɛ nɔ nɛ yi ni ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ e yi ha, nɛ e naa Mawu si hulɔ.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa ti nɔ ko hɛ ka we hi lɛ nitsɛ e he.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Se ke wa hɛ ngɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wa hɛ ngɛ kɛ ha; nɛ ke wa gbo hu, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wa gbo kɛ ha. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nihi ji wɔ.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Ejakaa enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Kristo gbo nɛ e te si nɛ e hɛ ngɛ benɛ pee nɛ e plɛ ni gbogboehi kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ ngɛ kulaa a Nyɔmtsɛ.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ mɛni he je nɛ o kojoɔ o nyɛmi? Aloo mo hu mɛni he je nɛ o gbee o nyɛmi he guɛ? Ejakaa wɔ tsuo kulaa wa maa da Kristo kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Ejakaa a ngma ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: Akɛnɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ ɔ, Nakutso tsuaa nakutso ma kpla si ha mi; Nɛ lilɛ tsuaa lilɛ maa jaje Mawu ngɔ tsɔɔ.”

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Lɛɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu lɛ nitsɛ e he akɔtaa ngɛ ha Mawu. Ko ha nɛ onyɛmi nɛ gbee si

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ waa kojo wa he hu; se enɛ ɔ mohu nyɛɛ kojo, kaa nɔ ko ko to tɛmi nɔ́ loo kpangmi ko ngɔ ha e nyɛmi.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: I le, nɛ jeha nɛ hu i ngɛ nɔ he wami ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu mi, kaa nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛl ɛ nitsɛ e ji he blemi nɔ́ ja nɔ nɛ buu nɔ́ ko kaa he blemi nɔ́ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e plɛɛ he blemi nɔ́ kɛ haa.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Se ke niyeni ko he je nɛ o haa o nyɛmi yeɔ kɔmɔ ɔɔ lɛɛ tsa pi suɔmi nya nɛ o ngɛ o je mi bae ngɛ ɔ hu. O kɛ o niyeni ɔ ko kpata nɔ nɛ Kristo ba gbo ha lɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ a tu nyɛ nɔ kpakpa a he munyu yaya.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, e pi ni yemi kɛ ni numi, se mohu e ji dami kɛ he jɔmi kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu mi bua jɔmi.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Kristo ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Mawu naa e he tsui, nɛ e saa nimli a hɛ mi hulɔ.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Ko puɛ Mawu ni tsumi ɔ ngɛ niyeni ko he. Nihi tsuo he tsɔ lɛɛ, se kɛ ɔ, e ji yayami ha nɔ nɛ yeɔ kɛ toɔ kpangmi ɔ.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: E hi kaa o yi lo nɛ jeha nɛ hu o nui wai loo nɔ́ ko nɛ maa to o nyɛmi kpangmi loo nɛ e ma ha e nane ma kpata aloo nɛ e ma ha e kɔni mi maa jɔ.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Moo lɛɛ o ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi. Kɛ to ha mo nitsɛ o he ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. A gbaa nɔ nɛ kojo we lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e buu kaa e hi ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ yi mi tɛ̃ lɛ ɔ, ke e ye ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ, mɛni he je ɔ, e ji hemi kɛ yemi mi; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ji hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ, yayami ʼi.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa ngɛ he wami ɔ, e sa kaa wa kpeɔ ɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ a be he wami ɔ kɛ a gbɔjɔmi ɔmɛ, nɛ wa ko susu wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sa e nyɛmi hɛ mi, konɛ e hi ha lɛ nɛ e nane nɛ nu si.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo hu susu we lɛ nitsɛ e he; se mohu kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a: “Ninɛmɛ nɛ bɔ mo ahlua a, a hlua bɔmi ɔ ba nɔ ye nɔ.”

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Se tsui si tomi kɛ bua jɔmi Mawu ɔ, e ha nɛ nyɛ na juɛmi kake ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa Kristo Yesu;

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi kake kɛ nya kake nɛ wo Mawu kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami. Sane Kpakpa nɛ a kɛ ha majeli ɔmɛ

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ dee ke Yesu Kristo plɛ sɔmɔlɔ kɛ ha Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ Mawu anɔkuale ɔ he, konɛ e kɛ ma si nɛ a wo tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ a nɔ mi,

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: konɛ majeli ɔmɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ mɔbɔ nami he, kaa bɔ nɛ sa ngma a ke: “Enɛ ɔ he ɔ ma je o yi ngɛ majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti, Nɛ ma wo o biɛ ta kɛ la.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e pa de ke: “Nyɛ majeli, nyɛɛ kɛ e ma a nɛ nya!”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu: “Nyɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi, nyɛ majeli kulaa, Nɛ nyɛ je e yi wawɛɛ, nyɛ mahi kulaa!”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ Yesaia de ke: “Isai sipoku ɔ maa ba, Nɔ nɛ maa te si konɛ e baye majeli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ; Lɛ e nɔ majeli ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi Mawu ɔ nɛ ngɔ bua jɔmi kɛ he jɔmi tsuo ngɔ wo nyɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, konɛ nyɛ na hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ be nɔ ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu he wami mi. Nɔ he je nɛ Paulo ngma womi kɛ kã

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Se mamimɛ, imi nitsɛ hu i ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ ngɛ nyɛ he kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ tete nyɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ mi mi himi, nɛ ni lemi kulaa hyi nyɛ tɔ, nɛ nyɛ nyɛɔ tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ he hulɔ.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Se i kɛ kã fuu ngma munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ mane nyɛ, konɛ ma kɛ kai nyɛ ngɛ dloomi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha mi ɔ he,

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: konɛ ma plɛ Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ ha majeli ɔmɛ, nɛ ma tsu Mawu Sane Kpakpa a he osɔfo ni tsumi ɔ, konɛ majeli ɔmɛ nɛ plɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi saminya nɛ a tsukɔ he ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu mi.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ i ngɛ fiami nihi ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ngɛ Mawu blɔfami ni ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i be kae kaa ma de nɔ́ ko kaa ja nɔ́ nɛ Kristo gu ye nɔ tsu ngɔ ha majeli ɔmɛ a tue bumi, ngɛ munyu kɛ ni peemi nihi a mi,

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: ngɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi a he wami mi, ngɛ Mawu Mumi he wami mi; enɛ ɔ he nɛ i je Yerusalem kɛ bɔle si hluu kɛ ya su Ilirikum, nɛ i fiɛ Kristo Sane Kpakpa a kɛ gbe nya a nɛ.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ma ye hɛ mi ji kaa, he nɛ a wui Kristo biɛ ta ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ ma jaje Sane Kpakpa a ngɛ, benɛ pee nɛ ma ko ya fia ngɔ to nɔ kpa sisitomi nɔ.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Se mohu kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Nihi nɛ a jaje we e he sane ko ngɔ tsɔɔ we mɛ ɔ, A maa na, Nɛ nihi nɛ nui ɔ, A maa nu sisi.” Paulo Romayami he blɔnyatomi

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ nɔuu lɛ tsi mi blɔ hluu nɛ i bɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Se jaha nɛ akɛnɛ i be nɔ́ ko peemi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi hu, nɛ jeha nɛ i je jehahi fuu hla kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ he ɔ,

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Makedonia kɛ Akaia tsuo kɛ tsui mi jɔmi tsu onia ko kɛ yaa ha klɔuklɔu bihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a kpɛti ohiafo ɔmɛ.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Tsui mi jɔmi nya a pee ngɛ niinɛ mohu, se jeha nɛ a hɛɛ mɛ hiɔ. Ejakaa ke majeli ɔmɛ na a mumi mi ni kpakpa amɛ eko ɔ, lɛɛ e sa kaa mɛ hu a kɛ he lo mi ni kpakpa amɛ eko nɛ sɔmɔ mɛ.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke i gbe enɛ ɔ nya nɛ i ngɔ nike ni nɛ ɔ kɛ ya ha mɛ ɔ, ma ba gu nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ya Spania.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: I le kaa ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, Kristo gbaami hiɛmi ɔ mi ma ba ngɛ.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Se i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ, ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he kɛ Mumi ɔ suɔmi he, kaa nyɛɛ piɛ ye he kɛ plee ngɛ nyɛ sɔlemihi nɛ nyɛ sɔlee ngɔ haa mi ngɛ Mawu hɛ ni ɔ mi,

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: konɛ a je mi kɛ je tue gboli nɛ ngɛ Yudea amɛ a dɛ mi, konɛ sɔmɔmi nɛ i yaa sɔmɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, e sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi saminya,

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: konɛ ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, i kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ ma ba wo ye tsui ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: He jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: I ngɛ wa nyɛmi yo Foibe nɛ ji Kenkrea asafo ɔ sɔmɔlɔ ɔ yi jee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae,

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛ he lɛ hɛ muɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi bɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ piɛ e he ngɛ ni tsumi tsuaa ni tsumi nɛ nyɛ he maa hia lɛ ngɛ mi ɔ mi; ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ hu, e ji nihi fuu kɛ imi nitsɛ hu ye he piɛlɔ.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga Priska kɛ Akwila, nɛ ji ye huɛmɛ ni tsuli ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ ha mi,

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ kɛ a he wo gbenɔ mi ngɛ ye wami he, nɛ pi imi kɛkɛ nɛ i naa mɛ si, se mohu majeli ɔmɛ a mi asafo ɔmɛ kulaa hu ngɛ mɛ si nae.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga asafo nɛ ngɛ a we ɔ hulɔ. Nyɛ nga ye suɔlɔ Epaineto nɛ ji kekleekle nɔ ngɛ Asia nɛ kɛ e he ha Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga Maria nɛ gbo wa he dengme fuu ɔ.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga Androniko kɛ Yunia, ye wekuli nɛ a wo i kɛ mɛ tsu mi, nɛ a ngɛ biɛ ngɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ akpɛti nɛ a sɛ ye hlami ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga Amplia, nɔ nɛ i suɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga Urbano nɛ ji wa huɛ ni tsulɔ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, kɛ ye suɔlɔ Staki.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga ye wekuno Herodion ɔ. Nyɛ nga nihi nɛ je Marsiko we mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ a ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga Trifaina kɛ Trifosa nɛ bɔɔ mɔde ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ. Nyɛ nga Persi, nɔ nɛ a suɔ nɛ e tsu ni fuu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga Rufo, nɔ nɛ a hla ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ nɛ e nyɛ pee mi bi hulɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga Asinkrito, Felgon, Herma, Patroba, Herme kɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga Filogo kɛ Yulia, Nerea kɛ e nyɛmi yo ɔ, kɛ Olimpa kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ kulaa.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ nya he fiɔmi klɔuu nɛ nga nyɛ he. Kristo asafo ɔ tsuo biɔ nyɛ. Nyagbe nitsɔɔmi

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ, mamimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nihi nɛ jee tsɔɔmi nɛ nyɛ kase ɔ se nɛ a kɛ mi gbamihi kɛ kpangmi tomi nihi baa amɛ a he, nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ he kɛ je a he.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ kikɛ ɔ, pi wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ a sɔmɔɔ, se mohu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a muklii; nɛ a kɛ nya mi dɔkɔɔ kɛ sisimi munyuhi mlɔɔ nihi nɛ li yayami ɔmɛ a tsui.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ tue bumi ɔ nihi tsuo nu he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ i na nyɛ he bua jɔmi. Se i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he ni leli ngɛ nɔ kpakpa blɔfami; se nɔ yayami blɔfami ɔ, nihi nɛ a li nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Se e be kɛe nɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ maa naa Satan nɔ kulaa ngɛ nyɛ nane si. Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Ye huɛ ni tsulɔ Timoteo kɛ ye wekuli Lukio kɛ Yason kɛ Sosipatre biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Imi Tortio hu nɛ i ngma kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ ɔ i biɔ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Gaius welcomes me and the whole church into his home, and he sends his greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, and our dear friend Quartus send their greetings too. Paul's Closing Prayer
translation_verse: [Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo kulaa nɛ hi si! Amen.] Nyagbe yijemi sɔlemi

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛ fi si wawɛɛ ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a kɛ Yesu Kristo fiɛmi ɔ nya, ngɛ laami sane nɛ a ngɔ laa kɛ je neneene lokoo ɔ kpo jemi nya a,

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: nɔ́ nɛ jeha nɛ je ngɔ tsɔɔ paa ngɛ neneene Mawu ɔ kita nya a, nɛ a gu gbali ɔmɛ a ngmami ɔmɛ a nɔ wo nɔ ta tsɔɔ majeli ɔmɛ kulaa konɛ a bu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tue —

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: lɛ Mawu nɛ ji ni lelɔ kake too ɔ, a ngɔ nyami ngɔ ha ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi kɛ ya neneene! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Paulo, Yesu Kristo bɔfo nɛ a tsɛ ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, kɛ wa nyɛmi Sostene

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: ngma ya ha Mawu asafo nɛ ngɛ Korinto ɔ, nihi nɛ a tsukɔ a he ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi nɛ ji ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ a tsɛ mɛ kɛ nihi kula nɛ tsɛɛ waa kɛ mɛ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he ɔ:

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ. Gbaami ngɛ Kristo mi

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: I naa ye Mawu ɔ si daa nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛ he, ngɛ Mawu dloomi nɛ a ngɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ he,

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ a ma Kristo he odase ɔ nɔ mi ngɛ nyɛ mi,

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: nɛ e piɛ́ nyɛ dloomi ke nɔ ko, nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hyɛɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo kpojemi ɔ blɔ ɔ,

english_verse: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
translation_verse: lɛ nɔuu e ma wlua nyɛ kɛ maa ya nyagbe konɛ piami ko ko hi nyɛ he ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Anɔkualetsɛ ji Mawu, nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba e bi Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hue bɔmi ɔ mi ɔ. Migbami ngɛ asafo ɔ mi

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, kaa nyɛ nya nɛ pee kake nɛ mi gbami ko ba nyɛ kpɛti, se mohu nyɛ kulaa nyɛ yi mi kɛ nyɛ juɛmi nɛ pee kake.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mamimɛ, Kloe we mi bi ɔmɛ ba wo ye tue nɔ ke pɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ ji kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ deɔ ke: “Ami lɛɛ, Paulo nɔ ji mi; ami lɛɛ, Apolo nɔ ji mi; ami lɛɛ, Kefa nɔ ji mi, ami lɛɛ Kristo nɔ ji mi.”

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Anɛ a gba Kristo mi lo? Anɛ Paulo a sɛu ha nyɛ ɔ lo? Aloo Paulo biɛ mi a baptisi nyɛ ngɔ wo ɔ lo?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: I naa Mawu si kaa i baptisi we nyɛ ti nɔ ko, kaa ja Krispo kɛ Gaio

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: konɛ nɔ ko ko de ke i baptisi nihi ngɔ wo imi nitsɛ ye biɛ mi.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Nɛ i baptisi Stefana we ɔ se nɛ ɔ ɔ, i li kaa i baptisi nɔ ko piɛ he hu lo.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo tsɔ we mi baptisimi, se mohu sane kpakpa a fiɛmi, nɛ pi ngɛ ni lemi munyuhi a mi tete, kone Kristo seumi tso ɔ nɛ ko pee yaka. Kristo ji Mawu hewami kɛ e nilemi

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Ejakaa seumi tso ɔ he sane ɔ ji kuasiahi a sane ha nihi nɛ hɛ mi kpataa a, se wɔ nihi nɛ a heɔ wa yi wami ɔ, e ji Mawu he wami ha wɔ.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa fa ngma ke: “Ma puɛ ni leli a ni lemi, Nɛ ga leli a ga a hu ma ha e pee yaka.”

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Jije ni lelɔ ngɛ? Jije womi mi lelɔ ngɛ? Jije je nɛ ɔ mi sanemi hlalɔ ngɛ? Anɛ Mawu ha we nɛ je ɔ mi ni lemi ɔ nɛ plɛ kuasiahi a sane lo?

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ je ɔ gui Mawu ni lemi ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ e ni lemi ɔ nɛ le Mawu he je ɔ, e sa Mawu hɛ mi kaa e kɛ kuasiahi a sane ɔ nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ he nihi nɛ heɔ ye ɔ a yi wami.

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yudafo ɔmɛ ɔ, okadihi a si a biɔ, nɛ Helabi hu hlaa ni lemi

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: se wɔɔ lɛɛ, Kristo nɛ a sɛu ɔ wa fiɛɔ, nɔ nɛ plɛ kpangmi ha Yudafohi kɛ kuasiahi a sane ha majemajeli ɔmɛ;

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: se nihi nɛ a tsɛ mɛ ɔ tsuo, Yudafohi jio, Helabihi jio, Kristo nɛ ji Mawu he wami kɛ Mawu ni lemi ɔ wa fiɛɔ ngɔ haa mɛ.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu kuasiahi a sane ɔ mi ngɛ ni lemi pe nimli a ni lemi, nɛ Mawu gbɔjɔmi ɔ he wa pe nimli a he wami.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa nyɛ tsɛmi ɔ, tsa pi he lo blɔfami ni leli fuu nɛ a tsɛ, tsa pi he wali fuu, tsa pi odehehi fuu.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Se mohu je nɛ ɔ mi kuaisa amɛ Mawu hla, kone e kɛ gbe ni leli ɔmɛ zo. Nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi gbɔjɔmi ni ɔmɛ hu Mawu hla konɛ e kɛ gbe nihi nɛ he wa amɛ zo.

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: Nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nihi nɛ a bui kɛ nihi nɛ a gbe he guɛ ɔ Mawu hla, kɛ nihi nɛ pi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ɔ tete, konɛ e ha nihi nɛ ji nɔ́ ko ɔmɛ nɛ pee yaka;

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: benɛ pee nɛ he lo ko he lo ko ko fia ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
translation_verse: Se Mawu lɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, nɔ nɛ plɛ ni lemi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ kɛ dami kɛ he tsukɔmi kɛ kpɔmi ha wɔ ɔ,

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: konɛ: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ fiae ɔ, e fia ngɔ fɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ,” kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a.

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Imi hu, mamimɛ, benɛ i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, pi nyamitsɔmi loo nilemi fuu nɛ i kɛ ba ba jaje Mawu laami sane ɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ;

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: ejakaa i to we imi nitsɛ ye yi mi kaa ma le nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, kaa ja Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ a sɛu ɔ.

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: Nɛ i kɛ nyɛ hi si ngɛ gbɔjɔmi kɛ gbeyeyemi kɛ hedomi babauu mi;

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: nɛ ye munyu kɛ ye sanefiɛmi ɔ hu ji nimli a nilemi munyuhi nɛ plɛɛ nɔ yi mi mi, se mohu e je mumi kɛ hewami tsɔɔmi mi,

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ko da nimli a nilemi nɔ, se mohu e da Mawu hewami nɔ. Mawu nilemi

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ, wa tuɔ nilemi munyu ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a hi kɛ pi si ɔmɛ a kpɛti, se tsa pi je nɔ mi nilemi aloo je nɔ mi nikɔtɔmahi nɛ bee kɛ yaa amɛ a nɔ ʼi;

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: se mohu Mawu nilemi nɛ a kɛ laa ngɛ laami sane mi ɔ wa deɔ, nɔ nɛ Mawu dla to ha wa hɛminyamiwomi loko a bɔ je ɔ,

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ je nɔ mi nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li ɔ; ejakaa a le jinɛ a be hɛminyami Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɛue.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Se kaa bɔ nɛ pa ngma a: “Nihi nɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ, nɛ tue hu nui, Nɛ e bɛ nɔmlɔ ko tsui mi hyɛ Ji nihi nɛ Mawu dla ngɔ to nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, Mawu gu E mumi ɔ nɔ je kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ; ejakaa Mumi ɔ hlaa nihi kulaa mi, Mawu nihi nɛ mi kuɔ tete.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Se nimli a kpɛti mɛnɔ le nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ mi, kaa ja nɔmlɔ ɔ mumi nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ? Ja nɔuu kɛ̃ Mawu mi ni ɔmɛ hu nɔ ko nɔ ko li, kaa ja Mawu mumi ɔ.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Wɔɔ lɛɛ, pi je nɔ mi mumi ɔ nɛ wa na, se mohu mumi nɛ je Mawu mi ɔ, konɛ waa le nihi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Kɔlɔɔmɛ hu wa deɔ, pi nimli a nilemi munyuhi nɛ waa kɛ deɔ, se mohu munyuhi nɛ Mumi ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ, nɛ waa kɛ mumi mi nihi toɔ mumi mi nihi a he.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Se nɔmlɔ su nɛ a kɛ fɔ lɛ ɔ he we Mawu Mumi ɔ ni ɔmɛ; ejakaa e peɔ lɛ kaa kuasiahi a sane ʼi, nɛ e nɛ́ nya, ejaka mumi a kɛ hlaa nya.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Mumi mi nɔmlɔ ɔ kojoɔ nihi kulaa, se lɛɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kojo we lɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: “Ejakaa mɛnɔ lɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ juɛmi, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ lɛ ni?” Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hɛɛ Kristo juɛmi.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, i be nyɛe nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu kaa mumi mi nimli, se mohu kaa he lo mi nimli, kaa bimwɔwi ngɛ Kristo mi.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: Nyɔ i ha nyɛ, se tsa pi ngma nɛ jiɔ, ejakaa nyɛ nyɛ́ we. Nɛ jeha nɛ hu tete nyɛ nyɛ́ we kɛ mwɔɔ,

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: ejakaa he lo mi nimli ji nyɛ kɛ mwɔɔ. Se be abɔ nɛ hungajemi kɛ pɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kɛ mwɔɔ nɛ ɔ, anɛ pi he lo mi nimli ji nyɛ nɛ nimli a je mi nyɛ ngɛ bae ɔ lo?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Ejakaa benɛ nɔ ko ke: “Ami lɛɛ, Paulo nɔ ji mi; nɛ nɔ ko hu ke: Ami lɛɛ, Apolo nɔ ji mi” ɔ, anɛ pi he lo mi nimli ji nyɛ lo?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ Apolo ji mɛnɔ? Paulo ji mɛnɔ? Mɛ ji sɔmɔli nɛ nyɛ gu a nɔ he ye, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ ha lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i ma; Apolo pue nɔ nyu; se Mawu ha e wa.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ ma kɛ nɔ nɛ pue nɔ nyu ɔ tsuo ɔ kake ʼi; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na lɛ nitsɛ e hiɔwo ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ni tsumi nya.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu he piɛli ni tsuli ji wɔ; Mawu cngmɔ, Mawu tsu ji nyɛ.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Mawu dloomi nɛ e kɛ dloo mi ɔ nya a, i to tsu ɔ sisi kaa tsu fialɔ galɔ ko, se nɔ kpa lɛ fia nɔ. Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nɔ fiae ha a konɛ e hi.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: a maa na nɔ tsuaa nɔ ni tsumi ɔ paa, ejakaa ligbi ɔ ma je lɛ kpo, ejakaa la mi e maa je kpo ngɛ, nɛ bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ nɔ ni tsumi ngɛ ɔ, la a nɔuu ma je lɛ si.

english_verse: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ni tsumi nɛ e fia ngɔ ma nɔ ɔ maa da si ɔ, e ma na hiɔwo;

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: se ke nɔ ko ni tsumi maa sã a, e nine maa nyɛ si; se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ, a ma he e yi wami, se kɛ ɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ gu la mi.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa Mawu sɔlemi tsu ji nyɛ nɛ Mawu Mumi ɔ hii nyɛ mi lo?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko puɛ Mawu sɔlemi tsu ɔ, Mawu ma puɛ lɛ. Ejakaa Mawu sɔlemi tsu ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, lɔ ɔ ji nyɛ.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ko mlɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he. Ke nɔ ko susu kaa ni lelɔ ji lɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e pee e he kuasia, konɛ e plɛ ni lelɔ.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa je nɛ ɔ mi ni lemi ɔ ji kuasiahi a sane ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. Ejakaa a ngma ke: “Enuu ni leli ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi temi ɔ mi.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Kɛ jeha nɛ hu: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le ni leli a juɛmi ɔmɛ kaa yaka nihi.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Paulo jio, Apolo jio, Kefa jio, je ɔ jio, wami jio, gbenɔ jio, nihi nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔmɛ jio, nihi nɛ maa ba amɛ jio, kulaa a nyɛ nɔ ʼi;

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, Kristo nihi ji nyɛ, nɛ Kristo ɔ, Mawu nɔ ʼi.”

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Bɔ pɛ nɛ sa nɛ nimli nɛ bu wɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa Kristo sɔmɔli kɛ Mawu laami sane ɔmɛ a nɔ sɔmɔli nikɔtɔmahi.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ piɛ nɛ a hlaa ngɛ sɔmɔli nikɔtɔma amɛ a dɛ ji kaa, a na a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kaa anɔkualetsɛ.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i bui lɛ sane slɔɔto ko kaa nyɛ kojoɔ mi aloo kaa a kɛ nimli a kojomi maa kojo mi; se imi nitsɛ ɔ, i kojo we ye he.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i li nɔ ko yaya ko ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye he mohu, se kɛ ɔ pi lɔ ɔ he nɛ a maa wo mi nguɔ ngɛ; nɔ nɛ kojoɔ mi ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ he nɛ i kɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɔmɛ ngɛ i kɛ Apolo he toeɔ nɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kase wɔ nɛ nɔ ko ko susu pe nɔ nɛ a ngma a, konɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kɛ he nɔ womi ko bu nɔ ko pe nɔ ko.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ha eslo mo? Nɛ jeha nɛ mɛni o ngɛ nɛ pi nɛ a kɛ ha mo? Se ke pe a kɛ ha mo ɔ, mɛ he je o fiaa kaa nɔ nɛ pi nɛ pe a kɛ ha mo ɔ?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tɔ mo, nyɛ na ni mo, nyɛ si wɔ se nɛ nyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee. I na nɛ jinɛ nyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee niinɛ, konɛ wɔ hu waa kɛ nyɛ nɛ ye!

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e peɔ mi kaa Mawu ngɔ wɔ nihi nɛ wa ji bɔfo ɔmɛ mohu ngɔ pee se kpɛli, kaa nihi nɛ a gbaa a nɔ ngɔ ha gbenɔ ejakaa a kɛ wɔ pee hyɛmi nihi ha je ɔ kɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kɛ nimli.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Wɔɔ lɛɛ, kuasiahi ji wɔ ngɛ Kristo he, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ ni leli ji nyɛ ngɛ Kristo mi. Wɔɔ lɛɛ, gbɔjɔli ji wɔ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, he wali ji nyɛ; nyɛ lɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hɛ mi be nyami.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, hwɔ kɛ kuma yee wɔ, nɛ wa nyɛɛ wa he gu, nɛ a gbaa wɔ mahi, nɛ wa be hi he tutuutu ko,

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: nɛ wa gboɔ dengme waa kɛ wa ninehi tsuɔ ni; benɛ a ngɛ wɔ jɛe ɔ, wa ngɛ gbaae; benɛ a ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae ɔ, wa toɔ wa tsui si;

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: benɛ a ngɛ wa biɛ puee ɔ, wa ngɛ pɛɛ kpae. Wa plɛ kaa je ɔ kuku nɔ nihi, nihi kulaa a dwɔmi kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: I ngmɛ́ nyɛ enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ma kɛ gbe nyɛ zo, se mohu i ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe kaa ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nyɛ ngɛ nɔ hyɛli akpe-nyɔngma tete ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, kɛ ɔ pi tsɛmɛ fuu nɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Ejakaa i gu Sane Kpakpa a nɔ kɛ fɔ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpaa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kase mi.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ i tsɔ Timoteo nɛ ji ye suɔmi bi kɛ anɔkualetsɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ; e ma kae nyɛ bɔ nɛ i baa ye je mi haa ngɛ Kristo mi, kaa bɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ ngɛ asafo tsuaa asafo mi, ngɛ he tsuaa he ɔ.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ nyɛ ti ni komɛ susu kaa i be nyɛ ngɔ bae he je ɔ, a wo a he nɔ.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ma ba na ninɛmɛ nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔmɛ a he wami, se pi a munyu.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Ejakaa tsa pi munyu mi nɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ, se mohu he wami mi.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Kɛ nyɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae kɛɛ? Ma hɛɛ tso kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, aloo ma ba ngɛ suɔmi kɛ mi mi jɔmi mumi mi?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Angɛ de ngɛ nyɛ he niinɛ kaa ajuama bɔmi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, ajuama bɔmi nɛ be majemajeli ɔmɛ a mi tete, kaa nɔ ko maa ngɔ e tsɛ yo.

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, mɛni he je nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he? Sa nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ benɛ pee nɛ a je nɔ nɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: I am with you only in my thoughts. But in the name of our Lord Jesus I have already judged this man, as though I were with you in person. So when you meet together and the power of the Lord Jesus is with you, I will be there too.
translation_verse: ke nyɛ kpe ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, nɛ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he wami piɛ nyɛ he ɔ,

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ ngɔ kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔ wo Satan dɛ mi, konɛ e he lo ɔ hɛ mi nɛ kpata, nɛ a he e mumi ɔ yi wami ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Nyɛ fiami ɔ be fɛu. Nyɛ li kaa ma sasɛ nyafii saa ma mluku ɔ kulaa lo?

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ je ma sasɛ momo ɔ, konɛ nyɛ plɛ ma he, kaa bɔ nɛ ma akpiti ji nyɛ ɔ; ejaaa a gbe wa Hetsɔmi To Bi nɛ ji Kristo ɔ ha wɔ.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ha waa ye Hetsɔmi bua jɔmi ligbi ɔ, pi kɛ ma sasɛ momo, nɛ jehanɛ hu pi kɛ yayami loo nɔ yayami peemi ma sasɛ, se mohu kɛ anɔkuale akpiti ngmingmiingmi.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Ye womi nɛ i ngma nyɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i ke nyɛɛ kɛ ajuama bɔli ko bɔ.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Pi je nɛ ɔ mi bimɛ a ti ya holi loo hɛ tsuli loo amim yeli loo wɔ jali a he munyu kulaa nɛ i ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ, ejakaa kaa mɛ jinɛ, ja nyɛ je je ɔ mi.

english_verse: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ, i ngma nyɛ ke ke nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ nyɛmi ɔ ji ajuama bɔlɔ loo hɛ tsulɔ loo wɔ jalɔ loo nɔ jɛlɔ, loo da delɔ loo amim yelɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko ye ni tete.

english_verse: Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members?
translation_verse: Se ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔ, mɛni a kojomi kɔɔ ngɛ ye he? Anɛ pi ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ nɛ nyɛ kojoɔ lo?

english_verse: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
translation_verse: Ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔ, Mawu ji nɔ nɛ kojoɔ mɛ. Nyɛ je nɔ yayami ɔ ke je nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Tse ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi na sane ko ɔ, e jee blɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya yeɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ ja we Mawu ɔ a ngɔ, se e kɛ lɛ yɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a ngɔ lo?

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ji ninɛmɛ nɛ maa kojo je ɔ lo? Nɛ ke nyɛ maa piɛ he nɛ a kojo je ɔ, anɛ nyɛ sɛ́ nihi nɛ kojoɔ munyu tsɔ wi lo?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa wa maa kojo hiɔwe bɔfohi tete po hluu nɛ e ba slɔ je nɛ ɔ mi munyuhi?

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, ke nyɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi munyuhi komɛ a yemi ɔ, mɛ he je nyɛ haa nihi nɛ a bui mɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi yeɔ mɔ?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Zo gbi nyɛ piɔ? Anɛ ni lelɔ kaketoo po be nyɛ kpɛti, nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ e nyɛmimɛ a kpɛti munyu nɛ e tu lo?

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: Se mohu nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi yaa kojomi ngɛ nihi nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ po a ngɔ!

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ gbee si mo, akɛnɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he yeɔ munyu ɔ. Mɛ he je nyɛ ha we nɛ a ye nyɛ amim mohu? Mɛni he je nyɛ ha we nɛ a sisi nyɛ mohu?

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa yayami peeli a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue lo? Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a mlɔɔ nyɛ! Ajuama bɔli loo wɔ jali loo gba puɛli loo nyumuhi nɛ kɛ nyumuhi peɔ yakayakani,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: loo juɔhi loo hɛ dooli loo da deli loo nɔ jɛli loo amim yeli a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue kulaa.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Sa a, nyɛ ti ni komɛ ngɛ kikɛ; se jahanɛ a du nyɛ he, nɛ a kpale tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ a wo nyɛ nguɔ hulɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ kɛ wa Mawu ɔ Mumi ɔ mi. Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nihi kulaa he blɔ mohu, se kɛ ɔ pi nihi kulaa nɛ hi. I ngɛ nihi kulaa he blɔ mohu, se i be hae nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ye ye nɔ.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Ngma ngɛ ha muklii, nɛ muklii hu ngɛ ha ngma, se Mawu ma ha enyɔ ɔ kulaa se maa po. Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, pi ajuama bɔmi he nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ, se mohu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he e ngɛ ngɛ, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ ha nɔmlc tso ɔ.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu tle Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, ja e ma tle wɔ hu si ngɛ e he wami nya.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ ɔ Kristo he nihi ji mɛ lo? Lɛɛ ma ngɔ Kristo he ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pee ajuama he nihi lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Aloo nyɛ li kaa nɔ nɛ kɛ e he ya bɔɔ ajuama he ɔ, e kɛ lɛ plɛ nɔmlɔ tso kɛke lo? Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke: “Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔ kulaa a ma plɛ he lo kake.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ kɛ e he bɔɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ lɛ peɔ mumi kake.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ tu ajuama bɔmi nya fo! Yayami tsuaa yayami nɛ nɔmlɔ peɔ ɔ, pi e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ e ngɛ; se nɔ nɛ bɔɔ ajuama a, e peɔ yayami siɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ sɔlemi tsu ʼi, nɛ nyɛ pi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ lo?

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a he nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, ngɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngma ba ha mi ɔmɛ a he ɔ: E hi ha nyumu kaa e ko ta yo he;

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: se ajuama bɔmi he ɔ, nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e yo, nɛ yo tsuaa yo nɛ gba lɛ nitsɛ e huno.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ be he wami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso nɔ, se mohu e huno ɔ lɛ ngɛ. Ja nɔuu kɛ̃ huno ɔ hu be he wami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso nɔ, se e yo ɔ lɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko kua nyumu kɛ yo buami ja nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔ tsuo nyɛ kplɛɛ kaa nyɛ maa pee ja, kɛ ya su be ko, konɛ nyɛ na deka nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ nyɛɛ pee kake ekohu, konɛ Satan ko tsɔ nyɛ nya ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ nɛ nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ ye ɔ he.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee ngɛ ga womi nya se pi ngɛ kita nya.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Nyumukuyo ɔmɛ kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ ɔ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke: E hi ha mɛ ke a hi si kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Se ke a nyɛ we a he nɔ nɛ a ye ɔ, a sɛ gba si himi mi; ejakaa gba si himi hi pe nɔ́ nɛ akɔnɔ maa hao mo.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Ninɛmɛ nɛ sɛ gba si himi mi ɔ, imi, nɛ tsa pi imi tete, se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mohu lɛ ngɛ mɛ kita woe ke, yo ko je gba.

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke e je gba tete po ɔ, e hi si ja, nɛ e ko gba, aloo e kɛ e huno ɔ ya dla; nɛ yotsɛ ɔ hu e ko ngmɛɛ e yo he.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Se ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, pi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, se imi i ngɛ mɛ dee ke: ke nyɛmi ko ngɛ yo ko nɛ he we yi, nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ yo ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hi si ɔ, e ko ngmɛɛ e he.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke yo ko hu ngɛ huno ko nɛ he we yi, nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ nyumu ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hi si ɔ, e ko kua lɛ gbami.

english_verse: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a tsukɔɔ nyumu nɛ he we yi ɔ hu he ngɛ yo ɔ mi, nɛ a tsukɔɔ yo nɛ he we yi ɔ hu he ngɛ huno ɔ mi. Ejakaa ke pi ja jinɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ hu a he sɛ mu; se jehanɛ ɔ, a he tsɔ.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ ngɛ e he si sae kɛ yaa a, e ya; a yi nyɛmi nyumu lo nyɛmi yo nyɔguɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a mi. He jɔmi mi Mawu tsɛ wɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
translation_verse: Yo, mo o ma he o huno ɔ yi wami jio, o le? Aloo nyumu, mo hu lɛ o ma he o yo ɔ yi wami jio, o le? Hii si bɔ nɛ Mawu tsɛ mo ɔ

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mawu dla ngɔ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ha a, e hi si ja. Ja i to hulɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ kulaa mi.

english_verse: If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised.
translation_verse: Kɛ a po nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e ko pee e he mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ; mɔmlɔtɔ mi a tsɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hu, e ko po e he.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Nɔpomi pi nɔ́ ko, nɛ mɔmlɔtɔ hu pi nɔ́ ko, se Mawu kita amɛ a nɔ yemi mohu ji nɔ́ nɛ he hia.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ tsɛmi nɛ a tsɛ lɛ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ mi nɔuu e hi.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Ke nyɔguɛ ji mo nɛ a tsɛ mo jio, ko ha lɔ ɔ nɛ dɔ mo; se ke o ma nyɛ o he kpɔ ɔ, bɔɔ he mɔde.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ a tsɛ lɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ji nyɔguɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ odehe ʼi. Ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nɔ nɛ a tsɛ lɛ nɛ e ji odehe ɔ, Kristo nyɔguɛ ʼi.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: A he nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ; nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he nimli a nyɔguɛhi.

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ yihewi nɛ gba we ɔ, i be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kita ko ha mɛ, se nɔ́ nɛ wi susuu ɔ i ngɛ dee, kaa nɔ ko nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na lɛ mɔbɔ konɛ e ye anɔkuale.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i susuu kaa e hi ji: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ he hiami nɛ ɔ he ɔ, e hi ha nɔmlɔ kaa e hi si bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Ke a fi mo mɛtɛ yo he jio, ko hia pɛnemi; a pɛne mo kɛ je yo he jio, ko hia yo.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Se ke o ngɔ yo hu ɔ, o pee we yayami; nɛ ke yiheyo hu gba a, e pee we yayami; se he lo blɔfami dengme ni nɛ ɔmɛ ma na, se imi lɛɛ, nyɛ he ya i ngɛ foe.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji kaa, be ɔ pi hu; nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ji kaa, yitsɛmɛ tete a pee kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ be eko;

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ tsuɔ je nɛ ɔ he ni ɔ, a pee kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ tsu we he ni; ejakaa je nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ wa naa a bee kɛ yaa.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Se i suɔ kaa nyɛ ko na haomi. Nɔ nɛ ngɔɛ yo ɔ, e kɛ e he tsuo haa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ni tsumi ɔ, bɔ nɛ e maa pee nɛ e sane nɛ sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo ɔ, haoɔ e he ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nihi a he, bɔ nɛ e maa pee nɛ e sane nɛ sa e yo ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Eslo yogbayo, nɛ jehanɛ hu eslo zangmayo. Nɔ nɛ gba we ɔ kɛ e he tsuo haa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ni tsumi ɔ, konɛ e pee klɔuklɔu ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kɛ mumi tsuo blɔfami. Se nɔ nɛ gba a haoɔ e he ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nihi a he, benɛ pee nɛ e sane nɛ sa e huno hɛ mi.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ kpakpa he i ngɛ dee ngɛ, pi nyɛ kuɛ kpa nɛ i ngɛ woe, se mohu benɛ pee nɛ e pee fɛu, konɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ ko doo nyɛ nya.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko susu kaa e bi yo nɛ nɔ zangma a, e ko wa tsɔ loko e gba, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ e sa nɛ a pee he nɔ́ ko ɔ, e pee bɔ nɛ e suɔ; e pee we yayami ko ke e ya gba.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ ha gba a e pee saminya, se nɔ nɛ kɛ lɛ ha we gba a pee saminya pe nɔ kaketsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ, be abɔ nɛ e huno hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ ɔ, a kɛ mlaa fi lɛ; se ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, e ngɛ he blɔ kaa e gbaa nɔ nɛ e suɔ, se ja a pee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Se ke e hi si bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, ye juɛmi nya a, e ngɛ bua jɔmi babauu; nɛ e peɔ mi kaa imi hu i ngɛ Mawu mumi.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ngɛ wɔhi a nya bɔ sami niyeni ɔmɛ a he ɔ, wa le kaa “wɔ kulaa wa le ni.” Ni lemi haa nɔ woɔ e he nɔ, se suɔmi haa nɔ nane nuu si.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko susu kaa e le nɔ́ ko ɔ, e li nɔ́ ko bɔ nɛ sa kaa e le.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko suɔ Mawu ɔ, lɛ Mawu le.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ngɛ wɔhi a nya bɔ sami niyeni a yemi he ɔ, wa le kaa wɔ ko wɔ ko pi nɔ́ ko ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ jehanɛ mawu ko mawu ko be ja Mawu kake kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ “mawuhi” ɔ, hiɔwe a ngɛ jio, zugba a nɔ a ngɛ jio, kaa bɔ nɛ “mawuhi” pɔ he nɛ “nyɔmtsɛmɛ” hu pɔ he ɔ,

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: kɛ̃ ɔ wɔɔ lɛɛ, Mawu kaketoo wa ngɛ, Tsɛ ɔ, nɔ mi nɛ nihi kulaa je nɛ wa ngɛ ha lɛ ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ kake hu nɛ ji Yesu Kristo ɔ, nɔ nɔ nɛ nihi kulaa gu kɛ ba nɛ wɔ hu wa gu e nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ pi nihi tsuo a mi nɛ kikɛmɛ a ni lemi nɛ ɔ ngɛ. Ni komɛ ngɛ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ nɛ a kɛ wɔhi a nɔ hemi kɛ yemi yeɔ wɔhi a nya bɔ sami niyeni, nɛ akɛnɛ a he ni lemi gbɔjɔ he je ɔ, a bleɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Ngma kɛ wɔ yɛ Mawu hɛ mi; ke wa yeɔ ɔ, e ha we nɛ waa hi pe nine, nɛ jehanɛ ke wa yi hu, wa laa we nɔ ko.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi konɛ nyɛ he blɔ nɛ ɔ ko ba plɛ kpangmi ha nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nɔ ko na mo nɛ ji “ni lelɔ” ɔ kaa o hii si ngɛ wɔ piɛ mi ngɛ ni yee ɔ, anɛ pi he wami nɛ o ngɛ nɔ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ he ni lemi woe konɛ e ya ye wɔhi a nya bɔ sami niyeni ɔmɛ lo?

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ngma ma ha ye nyɛmi nane ma kpata a, lɔɔ lɛɛ i be lo yee gblegbleegblee hu, konɛ ma ko ha ye nyɛmi ɔ nane nɛ kpata.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Anɛ i hɛɛ we ye he lo? Anɛ pi bɔfo ji mi lo? Anɛ i nɛ Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lo? Pi ye nine nya ni tsumi ji nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi lo?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Ke pi bɔfo ji mi kɛ ha ni kpahi ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ i ji kɛ ha nyɛ; ejakaa ye bɔfo ni tsumi ɔ nya sɔumi nɔ ji nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Anɛ wa be he blɔ kaa wa yeɔ ni nɛ wa nuu lo?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Anɛ wa be he blɔ kaa waa kɛ nyɛmi yo nɛ ji wa yo nvɛɛ kaa bɔfo kpa amɛ hu kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ Kefa?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Aloo i kɛ Barnaba kɛkɛ lɛ be he blɔ kaa wa jɔɔ ni tsumi lo?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Aslaafono te nɛɛ nɛ bɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he apaa kɛ ya ta hyɛ? Mɛnɔ lɛ peɔ wai ngmɔ nɛ e yi e mi yiblii ɔ eko? Aloo mɛnɔ lɛ lɛɛ lohwehi a kuu nɛ e nui a nyɔ nyu ɔ eko?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Ejakaa a ngma ngɛ Mose Mlaa a mi ke: “Koo wo na nɛ gblɛɛ blɛfo ɔ nya kotoku.” Anɛ nahi a he nɛ dɔɔ Mawu he je

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: nɛ pi wa he munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ lo? Ejakaa wa he nɔuu nɛ a ngma ke, nɔ nɛ huɔ ɔ, e kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ hu, nɛ nɔ nɛ hluɛɛ blɛfo hu e hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa e maa ye eko.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Ke wɔɔ lɛɛ wa duɔ mumi mi nihi haa nyɛ ɔ, anɛ e ji nɔ ko tsɔ kaa wa ma kpa he lo mi nihi lo?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu ke ni kpahi ngɛ kikɛmɛ a he blɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ɔ, anɛ pi wɔ mohu nɛ wa ngɛ pe mɛ po lo? Se kɛ ɔ, wa pee we kikɛmɛ a he blɔ nɛ ɔ he nɔ ko, se mohu wa to wa tsui si ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi, konɛ wa ko tsi Kristo Sane Kpakpa a blɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nihi nɛ tsuɔ ni ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, sɔlemi we ni ɔmɛ eko nɔuu a yeɔ lo? Nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ sami latɛ ɔ nɔ ni ɔmɛ eko nɔuu a naa lo?

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ to kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ jajeɔ Sane Kpakpa a, a ye sane kpakpa a he ni.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ, i pee we kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ kake po he nɔ ko. Nɛ i ngmɛ́ enɛ ɔ konɛ a pee ja ngɔ ha mi, ejakaa ke ka nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ma ha ye fiami ɔ nɛ pee yaka a, afani nɛ i gbo mohu.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke i jaje sane kpakpa a po hu ɔ, e pee we mi fiami; ejakaa a ngɔ fi ye nɔ kaa ma jaje, ejakaa ke i jaje we sane kpakpa a, kusiɛ ha mi!

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke imi nitsɛ ye suɔmi nya nɛ i tsu enɛ ɔ ɔ, i ngɛ hiɔwo, se ke pi suɔmi nya tete ɔ, a tu sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma yemi ni tsumi ngɔ wo ye dɛ kɛ̃.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ mɛni ji ye hiɔwo mɔ? Lɔ ɔ ji kaa ke i ngɛ sane kpakpa a jajee ɔ, ma jaje lɛ yaka, nɛ i he we nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo Sane Kpakpa a he, benɛ pee nɛ ma ko pee ye he blɔ nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a fiɛmi mi ɔ he nɔ ko tsɔ ko.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: Pohu i hɛɛ ye he nɛ i pi nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɔguɛ, kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ ye he pee nihi tsuo a sɔmɔlɔ, benɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su nihi babauu a nɔ.

english_verse: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
translation_verse: I plɛ Yudafono ha Yudafo ɔmɛ benɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su Yudafohi a nɔ. Ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mlaa sisi hulɔ ɔ, i pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ mlaa sisi ngɔ ha mɛ, pohu imi nitsɛ ɔ, i be mlaa sisi, benɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mlaa sisi ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: I plɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ be mlaa ngɔ ha ninɛmɛ nɛ be mlaa a, pohu i pi nɔ ko nɛ be Mawu mlaa; se mohu i ngɛ Kristo mlaa sisi, benɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su ninɛmɛ nɛ be mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: I plɛ kaa nɔ nɛ gbɔjɔ ha gbɔjɔli ɔmɛ benɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su gbɔjɔli ɔmɛ a nɔ. I plɛ ye he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɔ ha nihi kulaa konɛ bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ ma kɛ he ni komɛ a yi wami.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Sane Kpakpa a he nɛ i peɔ enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ, benɛ pee nɛ imi hu ma na e mi ni ɔmɛ eko.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ tuu fo ɔ, mɛ kulaa a tuu mohu se nɔ kake kɛkɛ nɛ naa ayekoo ni ɔ lo? Nyɛɛ tu fo ɔ ja konɛ nyɛ nine nɛ su nɔ.

english_verse: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ hu nɛ kaa e he mi kɛ kunɔ ɔ, e hɛ kaa si ngɛ nihi kulaa mi. Jehanɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a peɔ ja konɛ a na jlasi nɛ puɛɔ, se wɔɔ lɛɛ konɛ wa na nɔ nɛ puɛ we.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fo nɛ i ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ, i tui lɛ putuputu; kunɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɔe nɛ ɔ, pi kɔɔhiɔ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nɔe;

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: se mohu i gbaa imi nitsɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mahi nɛ i yeɔ lɛ nyɔguɛ, konɛ imi nɛ i fiɛɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ ni kpahi ɔ, imi nitsɛ lɛɛ a ko sake mi ngɔ fɔ he.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛ kai kaa wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hi bɔ ku ɔ sisi, nɛ mɛ tsuo a po wo ɔ,

english_verse: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.
translation_verse: nɛ a baptisi mɛ kulaa ngɔ wo Mose mi ngɛ bɔ ku ɔ kɛ wo ɔ mi,

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: nɛ mɛ kulaa a, mumi mi niyeni kake ɔ nɔuu a ye,

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: nɛ mɛ kulaa a nu mumi mi tɛ sa nɛ kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ ɔ mi nyu, nɛ tɛ sa a ji Kristo?

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ Mawu na we a ti nihi fuu a he tsui, ejakaa a kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Se a kɛ enɛ ɔmɛ to wɔ okadi konɛ wa ko ha ni yayahi nɛ pee wɔ akɔnɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu nyɛ ko plɛ amaga jali kaa a ti ni komɛ pee ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Ma a be hi si, nɛ a ye ni, nɛ a nu da, kɛkɛ nɛ a te si nɛ a bɔni fiɛmi.”

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: “Wa ngɛ nihi tsuo he blɔ,” se pi nihi tsuo nɛ hi. “Wa ngɛ nihi tsuo he blɔ,” se pi nihi tsuo nɛ haa nɔ nane nuu si.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ hu wa ko ka Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ ka lɛ nɛ sinɔhi ba kpata a hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ hu nyɛ ko tu munyu huitihuiti kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ tu munyu huitihuiti nɛ nɔ́ puɛlɔ ɔ ba kpata a hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: A pee mɛ enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ a kɛ to okadi ha ni kpahi; nɛ a ngma kaa kɔkɔ bɔmi nɔ́ kɛ ha wɔ, wɔ nihi nɛ je ɔ nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ na wɔ ɔ;

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: benɛ pee nɛ nɔ nɛ susuu kaa e daa si ɔ, e hyɛ e he nɛ hi konɛ e ko nɔ si.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Ka ko bɛ nyɛ nɔ nɛ pi nɔmlɔ he nɔ́; se anɔkualetsɛ ji Mawu, nɔ nɛ be hae nɛ a ka nyɛ pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ, se mohu e kɛ ka a nɔuu maa je blɔ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ je mi hulɔ, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ nya nɛ nyɛɛ da.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ tu wɔ jami nya fo!

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue kaa a kɛ ni leli tuɔ munyu; nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kɔ nɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ se.

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Gbaami kplu ɔ nɛ wa gbaa a, anɛ pi waa kɛ Kristo kake peemi ngɛ e muɔ ɔ mi lo? Abolo nɛ wa kuɔ ɔ, anɛ pi waa kɛ Kristo kake peemi ngɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi lo?

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa abolo kake ʼi, nɛ wɔ fuu ɔ, nɔmlɔ tso kake ji wɔ, ejakaa wɔ kulaa wa yeɔ abolo kake ɔ eko.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ he lo blɔfami Israel ɔ; anɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ bɔ sami ni ɔmɛ ɔ pi huɛ nɛ a kɛ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ ngɛ bɔe ɔ lo?

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ? Kaa amaga ji nɔ ko, aloo kaa amaga bɔ ji nɔ ko?
