english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Dɛbi, se mohu i ngɛ dee ke bɔ nɛ wɔ jali ɔmɛ saa a, mumi yayamihi a saa ngɔ haa se pi Mawu; se i sume kaa nyɛɛ kɛ mumi yayamihi bɔɔ huɛ.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Nyɛ be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kplu ɔ kɛ mumi yayamihi a kplu ɔ nyɛe maa nu si kake. Nyɛ be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ okplɔɔ ɔ nɔ ni kɛ mumi yayamihi a nɔ ɔ nɔ ni nyɛe maa ye si kake.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Aloo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi la wa ngɛ woe? Anɛ wa he wa pe lɛ lo?

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ juae ngɛ lo jua nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye; se he ni lemi he ɔ, nyɛ ko bi mi;

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: ejakaa “zugba a kɛ e mi ni ɔmɛ kulaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ ʼi.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Ke nihi nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko kpee nyɛ ni yemi nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa ya a, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa ma nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɛ nyɛ ko bi mi, ngɛ he ni lemi he.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Se he ni lemi nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ ɔ, pi mo nitsɛ o nɔ ɔ, se mohu nɔ kpa nɔ ɔ. Se mɛ he je nɔ kpa he ni lemi maa kojo ye he yemi ɔ?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Ke sina i kɛ ye ɔ, mɛ he je a tuɔ ye he munyu yaya ngɛ nihi nɛ i na si ngɛ he ɔmɛ a he?

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko pee kpangmi ngɔ ha Yudafohi kɛ Helabihi kɛ Mawu asafo ɔ kulaa;

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kase mi kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i kaseɔ Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ yi jee kaa nyɛ kaii mi ngɛ nihi tsuo mi, nɛ tsɔɔmihi nɛ i kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ hɛɛ mi bɔ pɛ nɛ i kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Se i suo kaa nyɛɛ le kaa nyumu tsuaa nyumu yi ji Kristo, nɛ yo tsuaa yo hu yi ji nyumu, nɛ Kristo yi ji Mawu.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Nyumu nɛ sɔlee aloo e gbaa nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ ko haa e yi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ e yi ɔ he guɛ gbee.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Se yo tsuaa yo nɛ sɔlee aloo e gbaa nɛ e hɛ̃ɛ e yi ɔ nɔ gu ɔ, lɛ hu e ngɛ e yi ɔ he guɛ gbee; ejakaa e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e sɛ e yi nɔuu kɛ.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke yo hɛ́ e yi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e sã e yi ɔ nɔ mɔ. Se ke e ngɛ lɛ zo pee kaa e ma sã eyi ɔ nɔ loo e maa sɛ e yi ɔ, lɛɛ e ha e yi ɔ nɔ mɔ.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Se nyumu lɛɛ, e sɛ kaa e haa e yi ɔ nɔ, ejakaa Mawu subai kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ji lɛ; se yo lɛɛ, nyumu hɛ mi nyami ji lɛ.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyumu ji yo mi, se yo mohu lɛɛ je nyumu mi.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ hu, a bɔɛ nyumu ngɛ yo he se yo mohu a bɔ ngɛ nyumu he.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e sa nɛ yo nɛ na he wami he okadi ko ngɛ e vi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyumu ko si yo se, nɛ ɔ hu ko si nyumu se.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ yo je nyumu mi ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ nyumu hu gu yo mi kɛ ba; se nihi kulaa je Mawu mi.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hla mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. Anɛ e ngɛ fɛu kaa yo maa sɔle ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi nɛ e hɛ́ e yi nɔ lo?

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e pee e he nya sãlɔ ngɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa pee we ja, nɛ Mawu asafo ɔmɛ hu pee we ja. Nyɔmtsɛ Niyeni ɔ

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Kita nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ, pi nyɛ yi nɛ i kɛ ngɛ jee, ejakaa ke nyɛ kpe ɔ, nɔ́ kpakpa ko ji mi, se mohu nɔ́ yaya lɛ jee mi.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Se kekleekle ɔ, i nuɔ kaa ke nyɛ ya bua nyɛ he nyɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ, mi gbamihi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ i heɔ yeɔ fã kɛ fã;

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: ejakaa e sa kaa migbami nɛ te si ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti konɛ ni kpakpa amɛ a je a he si paa ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: ejakaa kikɛmɛ a nyɛ ni yemi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e ni ye ni nɛ e yeɔ, nɛ benɛ hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee ɔ, blɔɔ nɔ ko de da.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Ejakaa si abɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ kikɛmɛ a bolo nɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ nuu kikɛmɛ a kplu nɛ ɔ hulɔ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbenɔ ɔ jajee kɛ ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛ maa su be nɛ e maa ba.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: ejakaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɛ e nuu bɔ nɛ sɛ́ ɔ, kojomi mohu e yeɔ nɛ e nuu haa e he ejakaa e bui Nyɔmtsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu e wo kplu ɔ hu ngɛ niyeni ɔ se, nɛ e ke: “Kikɛmɛ a kplu nɛ ɔ ji somi he ɔ ngɛ ye muɔ ɔ mi. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ; si abɔ nɛ nyɛ maa nu ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Ejakaa imi nitsɛ nɔ́ nɛ i na kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ dɛ mi nɛ i kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa: Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ɔ, jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ a tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ, e kɛ̃ abolo,

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: nɛ e na si, nɛ e kuɔ mi, nɛ e ke: “Enɛ ɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a kuɔ ngɛ nyɛ ke. Nyɛɛ pee e nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ kikɛmɛ a abolo nɛ ɔ nɛ e nuu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kplu ɔ bɔ nɛ sɛ́ ɔ, e ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ e muɔ ɔ nɔ tɔe.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ ka lɛ nitsɛ e he loko e ye abolo nɛ ɔ eko nɛ e nu kplu nɛ ɔ eko;

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Kɔlɔ ɔ he hu nɛ nyɛ ti nihi fuu ngɛ gboe nɛ a he wɛ mɛ, nɛ nihi babauu hu gbo nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Se e ji wa kaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he hyɛɛ jinɛ a be wɔ kojoe.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Se ke a kojo wɔ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi ʼi, benɛ pee nɛ a ko bu wɔ kɛ je ɔ kulaa fɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, ke nyɛ nya ba bua nɛ nyɛ maa ye ni ɔ, nyɛɛ mlɛ nyɛ sibi.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Se ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee ɔ, e ye ni ngɛ we mi lolo, benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ he nya buami ɔ ko tsɛ kojomi ha nyɛ. Nihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ke i ba a, ma to mɛ blɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le kaa benɛ nyɛ ji wɔ jali ɔ, amaga mumuihi a ngɔ a kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ a kpaka nyɛ ha a.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa, nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu ngɛ Mawu mumi mi ɔ, de we ke Yesu ɔ musutsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma de ke Yesu ji Nyɔmtsɛ hulɔ, kaa ja Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kpaka lɛ.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Dloomi nike nihi slɔɔtohi ngɛ, se mumi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: Sɔmɔmi ni tsumihi slɔɔtohi hu ngɛ, se Nyɔmtsɛ kake ɔ nɔuu a kɛ sɔmɔɔ;

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: nɛ ni tsumihi slɔɔtohi hu ngɛ, se Mawu kake ɔ nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ tsuo kulaa ngɛ nihi kulaa mi.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, a haa Mumi ɔ jeɔ e he kpo ngɛ e mi konɛ e hi ha nihi.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ haa nɔ ko ni lemi munyu; nɛ nɔ ko hu jamɛ a Mumi ɔ nɔuu haa lɛ nihi a sisi nami he ni lemi.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Lɛ Mumi ɔ nɔuu haa nɔ ko hemi kɛ yemi; nɛ nɔ kpa hu tsami dloomi nike nihi,

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko ɔ, he wami nihi a tsumi; nɔ ko ɔ gbami; nɔ ko hu mumihi a si kpami; nɔ ko hu gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi; nɛ nɔ kpa hu munyuhi a sisi tsɔɔmi.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Se kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa a, Mumi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ tsuo, nɛ e dlaa ngɔ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ kakaaka, bɔ nɛ e suɔ. Nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ e he nihi slɔɔtohi

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yudafohi ji wɔ jio, Helabihi ji wɔ jio, nyɔguɛhi jio, he yeli jio, wɔ tsuo ɔ Mumi kake mi a gu a baptisi wɔ ngɔ wo nɔmlɔ tso kake mi; nɛ wɔ tsuo Mumi kake akɛ ha wɔ nɛ waa nu.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hu pi he nɔ kake ʼi, se fuu ʼi.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Ke nane ma de ke: “Akɛnɛ i pi nine he je ɔ, i pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ni ɔmɛ eko” ɔ, anɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ni ɔmɛ eko lo?

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Nɛ ke tue hu ma de ke: “Akɛnɛ i pi hɛngmɛ he je ɔ, i pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ni ɔmɛ eko” ɔ, anɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ni ɔmɛ eko lo?

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Ke nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ kulaa ji hɛngmɛ ɔ, jije nɔ numi ngɛ? Ke nɔ numi sɔuu ʼi ɔ, jije nɔ he fu numi ɔ ngɛ?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ Mawu kɛ he nɔ́ tsuaa he nɔ́ ma nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he bɔ nɛ e suɔ.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Se ke mɛ kulaa ji he nɔ́ kake ɔ, jije nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ngɛ?

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ he nihi fuu ʼi mohu, se nɔmlɔ tso kake ʼi.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Hɛngmɛ be nyɛe ma de nine ke: “I be o he ni tsumi;” nɛ jehanɛ hu yi be nyɛe ma de nanehi ke: “I be nyɛ he ni tsumi.”

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nihi nɛ peɔ wɔ kaa a he wɛ́ kulaa a, mɛ mohu a he hiaa wɔ titli,

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: se wa he nihi nɛ ngɛ fɛu momo ɔ, a hia we hɛ mi nyami womi. Se Mawu tsla nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ngɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ titli e kɛ bu haa;

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: konɛ mi gbami nɛ ko ba nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi, se mohu he ni ɔmɛ nɛ baa a sibi a yi pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke he nɔ kake ngɛ nɔ nae ɔ, he ni ɔmɛ kulaa kɛ lɛ naa nɔ. Nɛ ke he nɔ kake hɛ mi ba nyami hu, he ni ɔmɛ kulaa kɛ lɛ naa bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ nyɛ tsuo ɔ, Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ji nyɛ, nɛ kakaaka a, e he nihi.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Nɛ kekleekle ɔ, Mawu wo ni komɛ bɔfohi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi, nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, gbali, nɔ́ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, tsɔɔli; kɔlɔ ɔ se ɔ he wami ni tsuli, kɔlɔ ɔ se ɔ, hiɔhi a tsami dloomi nike nihi, yemi kɛ buami, nɔyemihi, gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Anɛ nihi tsuo ji bɔfohi lo? Anɛ nihi tsuo ji gbali lo? Anɛ nihi tsuo ji tsɔɔli lo? Anɛ nihi tsuo ji he wami ni tsuli lo?

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Anɛ nihi tsuo lɛ ngɛ hiɔhi a tsami dloomi nike nihi lo? Anɛ nihi tsuo lɛ tuɔ munyu slɔɔtohi lo? Anɛ nihi tsuo lɛ tsɔɔ munyuhi a sisi lo?

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ ngɛ dloomi nike nihi nɛ hi saminya amɛ a he. Nɛ ma kpale tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ nɛ hi pe kulaa.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Ke i kɛ nimli kɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi a lilɛ tuɔ munyu se be suɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ i ngɛ kaa ayawa nɛ jijeɔ loo ngmlɛ nɛ pɛɛ.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke i ngɛ gbami, nɛ i naa laami mi nihi kulaa nya, nɛ i le nihi kulaa, nɛ ke i ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kulaa hulɔ, bɔ nɛ ma nyɛ yokuhi ma hia, se i be suɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ i pi nɔ́ ko?

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke i ngɔ ye nihi kulaa ngɔ ke nihi, nɛ ke i ngɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso ngɔ ha nɛ a sa mi, se i be suɔmi ɔ, i na we se ko.

english_verse: Love is patient and kind, never jealous, boastful, proud, or
translation_verse: Suɔmi toɔ e tsui si, e mi mi hi; suɔmi ji hunga; suɔmi fiɛ̃, e pee we pupuupu,

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: e pee we nihi nɛ sɛ, e plee we lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ he, e mi mi wui la, e kɛ nɔ tɔmi wui e mi.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: E nya we nɔ yayami he, se mohu e nyaa anɔkuale he?

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Suɔmi se pui gblegbleegblee. Se ke gbamihi ʼi ɔ, a se maa po; ke munyuhi slɔɔtohi a tumi ʼi ɔ, a maa jɔɔ; ke ni lemi ʼi ɔ, e se maa po.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa ni nɛ wa le ɔ, fã kɛ fã ʼi, nɛ wa gbami hu fa kɛ fa ʼi.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ́ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ ba a, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji fa kɛ fa a se maa po.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ji bimwɔyo ɔ, i tuɔ munyu kaa bimwɔyo, i juɛɛ ni a he kaa bimwɔyo, i susuu kaa bimwɔyo; se benɛ i ba plɛ nyumu nɔkɔtɔma a, i sake bimwɔwi a ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pue se.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, ahuhuɛ mi wa guu kɛ hyɛɛ nɔ tsuu, se jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi. Mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, i le ni fã kɛ fã, sɛ jamɛ a bɛ ɔ ɔ mi ɔ, ma lɛ ni kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ a le mi kɛ pi si ɔ.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ hemi kɛ yemi, hɛ kɛ nɔ tɔmi, suɔmi, kikɛmɛ a nihi etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ hii si; se suɔmi ji a kpɛti nɔ nɛ pe kulaa.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ di suɔmi se. Nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ ngɛ mumi mi nihi a he, se titli ɔ, gbami.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔto ko ɔ, pi nimli nɛ e kɛ ngɛ tue, se Mawu mohu, ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko nui, se mumi mi e ngɛ laami munyu ɔmɛ tue ngɛ.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ gbaa a, nimli e gbaa ngɔ tsɔɔ konɛ e kɛ ha a nane nɛ nu si nɛ e bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ nɛ e jɔɔ a bua.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔto ko ɔ, yeɔ buaa lɛ nitsɛ e he, se nɔ nɛ gbaa a, e yeɔ buaa asafo ɔ.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: Se i ko suɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ko tu munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔtohi Se nɔ́ nɛ i ko suɔ titli ji kaa nyɛɛ gba, ejakaa nɔ nɛ gbaa a, e pe nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔtohi, ja e tsɔɔ sisi hulɔ konɛ e ye bua asafo ɔ kulaa.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, mamimɛ, ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ba tu munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔtohi nɛ pi kpo jemi loo ni lemi loo gbami loo ni tsɔɔmi ko ɔ, mɛni se i haa nyɛ naa?

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke titimati pɛ́ pɛmi nɛ ngɛ faii ɔ, mɛnɔ ma dla e he ngɔ to ta?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu kɛ nyɛ hu, ngɛ munyu tumi blɔfami ɔ, ke nyɛ tu we munyu nɛ sisi ngɛ faii ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a maa le nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee ɔ? Ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ munyu tue woɔ kɔhiɔ mi.

english_verse: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
translation_verse: Be abɔ nɛ nyɛ hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ mumi mi nihi a he ɔ, ja nɔuu hu nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde konɛ nyɛɛ be nɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ ma ha asafo ɔ maa wa a mi.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔto ko ɔ, e sɔle konɛ e nyɛ sisi hu nɛ e tsɔɔ.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke i sɔlee kɛ lilɛ slɔɔto ɔ, ye mumi ɔ sɔlee lɛɛ, se ye juɛmi ɔ piɛ we he.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ kɛ ma pee kɛɛ? I kɛ mumi maa sɔle, nɛ i kɛ juɛmi hu maa sɔle. Ma fia kɛ mumi, nɛ ma la kɛ juɛmi hulɔ.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke o kɛ mumi ngɛ Mawu yi jee ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ li mi eko ɔmɛ a blɔ he ɔ ma de Amen ngɔ si o sina a nɔ, akɛnɛ e li nɔ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ?

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Moo lɛɛ, o ngɛ si nae saminya mohu, se kɛ ɔ, o yi bua we nɔ kpa a kulaa.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: I naa ye Mawu ɔ si kaa i pe nyɛ tsuo ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi mi.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Se ke ɔ, ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ, i suɔ kaa i kɛ ye juɛmi nɛ tu munyu kakaaka enuɔ, konɛ ma kɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi a ni mohu, pe nɔ nɛ ma tu munyu kakaaka akpe nyɔngma ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a mi.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he jokuɛwi ngɛ juɛmi blɔfami, se yayami blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he bimwɔwi, se juɛmi blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he nihi nɛ a wa.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: A ngma ngɛ Mlaa a mi ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: Gbi slɔɔtohi a mi kɛ nya slɔɔtohi a nɔ Ma gu nɛ i kɛ kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ maa tu munyu, Se lɔ ɔ hu tete a be mi tue bue.”

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ gbi slɔɔtohi ɔmɛ ɔ a pi okadi ha ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ, se mohu a ji okadi ha ninɛmɛ nɛ he we yi. Gbami ɔ, e pi ninɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ a nɔ, se mohu ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ ye ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Se ke ni ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ gbae, nɛ nɔ ko nɛ he we yi aloo e li mi eko ba lejɛ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ tsuo ma kã lɛ, ni ɔmɛ tsuo maa kojo lɛ,

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: a ma je e tsui mi laami nihi a kpo paa nɛ lɔ ɔ ma ha e kɛ e hɛ mi ma bu si nɛ e ja Mawu, nɛ e maa jaje ke Mawu ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti niinɛ. Blɔnyatomi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛni mɔ, mamimɛ? Ke nyɛ nya ba bua, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ la ko, nɔ ko hu ngɛ tsɔɔmi ko, nɔ ko ngɛ gbi slɔɔto ko, nɔ ko ngɛ kpo jemi ko, nɔ ko ngɛ sisi tsɔɔmi ko ɔ, a pee kulaa bɔ nɛ e maa ye bua nihi.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Ke a ngɛ gbi slɔɔto tue ɔ, nyɛ ha ni enyɔ loo ke e hiɛ hluu ɔ, ni etɛ pɛ nɛ tu, kakaaka, nɛ nɔ kake hu nɛ tsɔɔ sisi.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Ke sisi tsɔɔlɔ ko be ɔ, e ma e nya ngɛ asafo ɔ mi, se e tu munyu ha lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛ Mawu.

english_verse: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
translation_verse: Se gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, ni enyɔ loo ni etɛ nɛ tu munyu, nɛ nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ a susu he.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Se ke a je nɔ ko kpo tsɔɔ nɔ ko nɛ hii si ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ e jɔɔ tumi.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa gba, kakaaka, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kase nɔ ko nɛ a tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi kulaa kɛ wo mɛ he wami.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Gbali a mumi baa a he si haa gbali ɔmɛ,

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: ejakaa Mawu ɔ, e pi basabasa peemi Mawu, se mohu he jɔmi Mawu, kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ he tsɔli asafo ɔmɛ kulaa mi ɔ.

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha yi ɔmɛ nɛ pee kɔ ngɛ asafo kpehi a mi, ejakaa a ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a tu munyu, se mohu a ba a he si kaa bɔ nɛ Mlaa a hu deɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Ke a suɔ kaa a kase nɔ ko ɔ, a bi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hunomɛ ngɛ we mi. Ejakaa e ngɛ zo ha yihi kaa a maa tu munyu ngɛ asafo kpehi a mi.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ ngɔ Mawu munyu ɔ je? Aloo nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛ ngɔ e ba?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ke e peɔ nɔ ko kaa gbalɔ loo mumi mi nɔmlɔ ji lɛ ɔ, e sa nɛ e le kaa nɔ nɛ i ngma nyɛ nɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kita ʼi;

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: se ke nɔ ko li enɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko le lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ ngɛ gbami he, nɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi hu nyɛ ko tsi nya.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: A pee nɔ tsuaa nɔ bɔ nɛ ngɛ fɛu ngɛ blɔ nya blɔ nya.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, mamimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ kaie kaa Sane Kpakpa a nɛ i jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ pɛtɛ he hulɔ nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ mi ɔ,

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: kɔlɔ ɔ a kɛ heɔ nyɛ yi wami hulɔ, ke nyɛ pɛtɛ he bɔ nɛ i jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, ke pi ja a lɛɛ nyɛ he ye yaka gu.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Ejakaa sanehi nɛ he hia pe kulaa nɛ a kɛ ha mi nɛ imi hu i kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ ji kaa, Kristo gbo ngɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a nya,

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: kaa a pu lɛ, nɛ a tle lɛ si ekohu ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a nya;

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ pe lafa enuɔ si kake, nihi nɛ a ti nihi fuu ngɛ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ, se ni komɛ hu gbo.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Yakobo, lɔ ɔ se ɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Se mɛ kulaa a se ɔ, e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ imi hulɔ nɛ i ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ a kpatu fɔ lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Ejakaa imi lɛɛ, i ji enɔ wayo kulaa ngɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ i sɛ́ tete kaa a tsɛɛ mi bɔfo po, ejakaa i wa Mawu asafo ɔ yi mi.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Se Mawu dloomi nya i kɛ ji nɔ nɛ i ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ e dloomi nɛ e kɛ dloomi ɔ pee we yaka; se mohu, i tsu ni wawɛɛ pe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, se pi imi tete, se mohu Mawu dloomi nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ, imi jio, mɛ jio, enɛ ɔ ji wa fiɛmi, nɛ enɛ ɔ hu ji nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ he ye. Wa sitemi

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ke a fiɛ ngɛ Kristo he kaa a tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ ti ni komɛ deɔ ke ni gbogboehi a si temi ko be ɔ?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Se ke ni gbogboehi a si temi ko be ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo hu a tle we lɛ si.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke a tle we Kristo si ɔ, lɛɛ wa fiɛmi ɔ pee yaka, nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ hu pee yaka gu.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ a kpa wɔ si kaa Mawu he lakpa odase yeli ji wɔ, ejakaa wa ye Mawu he odase kaa e tle Kristo si, nɔ nɛ, ke e ngɛ mi kaa ni gbogboehi ti si ɔ, lɛɛ e tle we lɛ si?

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke a tle we ni gbogboehi a si ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo hu a tle we lɛ si.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ ke a tle we Kristo si ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ pee yaka nɛ nyɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a mi kɛ mwɔɔ;

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nihi nɛ gbo ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ hu laa.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ke wami nɛ ɔ mi kɛkɛ wa hɛ ngɛ Kristo nɔ ngɛ ɔ, wa ni ngɛ mɔbɔ pe nimli kulaa.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Se anɔkuale ɔ ji kaa, a tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, e pee kekleekle nɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ gbo ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa bɔ nɛ gbenɔ gu nɔmlɔ nɔ kɛ ba a, ja nɔuu si temi ɔ hu gu nɔmlɔ nɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa, kaa bɔ nɛ Adam mi nɛ nihi kulaa gboɔ ngɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ̃ Kristo mi nɛ mɛ kulaa a yi ma na wa ngɛ.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ he: Kekleekle nɔ ji Kristo, lɔ ɔ se ɔ nihi nɛ ji Kristo ni ɔmɛ ngɛ e bami ɔ mi.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se loko nyagbe ɔ maa ba, benɛ e maa ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha Mawu nɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ; nɛ e maa po nɔ yemi kulaa kɛ he blɔ kulaa kɛ he wami kulaa se ɔ.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Ejakaa ja Kristo ye matsɛ kɛ maa su be nɛ Mawu maa ngɔ henyɛli kulaa ngɔ wo e nane si.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Nyagbe henyɛlɔ nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi ji gbenɔ.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke: “Mawu ngɔ nihi tsuo kulaa ngɔ wo e nane si.” Se ke e de ke a ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ wo e sisi ɔ, blɔɔ e ngɛ paa kaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ wo e sisi ɔ be mi.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Se e benɛ a ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ wo Bi ɔ sisi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ Bi ɔ nitsɛ hu maa ngɔ e he ngɔ wo nɔ nɛ ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ wo e sisi ɔ sisi, konɛ Mawu nɛ pee nihi kulaa yi.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Ejakaa, kɛ nihi nɛ haa a baptisii mɛ ngɛ ni gbogboehi a nane mi ɔ maa pee kɛɛ? Ke ni gbogboehi be si tee kulaa a, mɛ he je mɔ nɛ a haa a baptisii mɛ ngɛ ni gbogboehi a nane mi ɔ?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Mɛ he je wɔ hu wa naa amane ngmlɛfia tsuaa ngmlɛfia a?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: I na nyɛ he fiami nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, kaa i gboɔ daa nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
translation_verse: Ke nimli a blɔfami nɛ i kɛ “lohwe dikali” hwu ta ngɛ Efeso ɔ, jinɛ mɛni se i naa? Ke ni gbogboehi ti si ɔ, “Nyɛ ha waa ye ni nɛ waa nu ni, ejakaa hwɔɔ ɔ wa ma gbo!”

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a sisi nyɛ. “Huɛ yaya bɔmi puɛɔ je mi bami kpakpa.”

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ tsɔ nyɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami; ejakaa nyɛ ti ni komɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ Mawu he. I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee nɛ ma kɛ gbe nyɛ zo. Nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a kɛ maa te si

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Se eko ɔ nɔ ko ma bi ke: “Kɛ ni gbogboehi maa pee kɛ te si kɛɛ? Nɛ jehanɛ mɛni nɔmlɔ tso a ma kɛ ba?”

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Lohwe! Nɔ́ nɛ mo nitsɛ o du ɔ, ja e gbo lolo loko e yi ma na wa.

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Mawu haa wu ɔ tso bɔ nɛ e suɔ, nɛ wu tsuaa wu ɔ, e haa lɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tso.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Hiɔwe nɔmlɔ tsohi ngɛ, nɛ zugba nɔ nɔmlɔ tsohi hu ngɛ; se kɛ ɔ eslo hiɔwe nihi a hɛ mi nyami, nɛ eslo zugba nɔ ni ɔmɛ hu a nɔ.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Eslo pu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ eslo hlami hu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ eslo dodoehi a hɛ mi nyami; ejakaa eslo dodoe kake hɛ mi nyami ngɛ dodoe kpa hɛ mi nyami he.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu ji ni gbogboehi a sitemi ɔ hulɔ. A duɔ lɛ ngɛ puemi mi, a tleɔ lɛ si ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we mi;

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: A duɔ klaa nɔmlɔ tso, a tleɔ mumi nɔmlɔ tso si. Ke klaa nɔmlɔ tso ngɛ ɔ, mumi nɔmlɔ tso hu ngɛ.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Jã a ngma hulɔ ke: “Adam nɛ ji kekle nɔmlɔ ɔ plɛ klaa nɛ hɛ ngɛ; nyagbe Adam ɔ plɛ mumi nɛ haa nɔ yi naa wa.”

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Se tsa pi mumi nɔ ɔ ji kekle nɔ, se mohu klaa nɔ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ se ɔ mumi nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Kekle nɔmlɔ nɛ je zugba a mi ɔ, zu ʼi, nɔmlɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ je hiɔwe.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ no ɔ ngɛ ɔ, jã zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ; nɛ bɔ nɛ hiɔwe no ɔ ngɛ ɔ, ja hiɔwe bi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ wa hɛɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ no ɔ subai ɔ, jã nɔuu wa maa hɛɛ hiɔwe no ɔ hu subai.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ji kaa, he lo kɛ muɔ nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue, nɛ jehanɛ puemi hu nine be nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we ɔ nɔ sue.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Oʼɛ, laami sane i ngɛ nyɛ dee nɛ ɔ nɛ: Tsa pi wɔ tsuo kulaa nɛ wa ma gbo ɔ, se a ma tsake wɔ tsuo,

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: tlukaa ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi, benɛ a ma kpa nyagbe titimati ɔ; ejakaa a ma kpa titimati, nɛ a ma tle ni gbogboehi a si nɛ a be puɛe hu, nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ, a ma tsake wɔ.

english_verse: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ja puɛmi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we ɔ, nɛ kikɛmɛ a gbomi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo nɔ́ nɛ gbo we ɔ.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Se benɛ kikɛmɛ a puemi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we ɔ, nɛ kikɛmɛ a gbomi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo nɔ́ nɛ gbo we ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ munyu nɛ a ngma a maa ba mi ke: “A mi gbenɔ ngɛ kunimi yemi mi.

english_verse: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
translation_verse: Mo gbenɔ, jije o kɛ̃ɛ ɔ ngɛ? Mo gbeje, jije o kunimi yemi ɔ ngɛ?”

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Se gbenɔ kɛ̃ɛ ji yayami, nɛ yayami he wami ji Mlaa a.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Se sina ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ guu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ haa wa yeɔ kunimi ɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ fi si nɛ nyɛ ko gbɔle, nɛ nyɛɛ ya nɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ni tsumi ɔ mi daa nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ le kaa nyɛ dengme gbomi ɔ be yaka pee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ngɛ onia nɛ a tsuɔ kɛ haa Mawu webi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ i to ha Galatia asafo ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ja.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Daa otsi kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je nɔ́ ko ngɔ to, ngɛ bɔ nɛ e naa a nya, konɛ ma ko ba loko a tsu onia a.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke i ba a, ma tsɔ nihi nɛ nyɛ buu kaa a sa kɛ womi nɛ a hɛɛ nyɛ nike ni ɔmɛ kɛ ya Yerusalem.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Se ke e sa kaa imi hu ma ya a, i kɛ mɛ maa ya. Paulo yimitomi

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: Se ma ya gu Makedonia loko ma ba nyɛ ngɔ, ejakaa Makedonia ma ya gu.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Eko ɔ ma hi nyɛ gɔ bɔɔ, nɛ eko ɔ ma ye fiɛ̃ be ɔ hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ he tsuaa he nɛ i yaa a nɛ nyɛ ya je mi blɔ.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i sume kaa ma na nyɛ ngɛ blɔ kpɛ kɛkɛ, se ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ngmɛ mi blɔ ɔ, ma kɛ bɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Se ma hi Efeso kɛ maa su Pentekoste ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a bli sinya kpetekpleenyɛ nya ha mi, kɛ ha ni tsumi fuu nɛ maa wo yiblii, se ninɛmɛ nɛ kuɔ nya a hu hiɛ.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Ke Timoteo ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ni tsumi nɔuu e ngɛ tsue kaa imi.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Kɔlɔ ɔ he ɔ nɔ ko ko bu lɛ kaa pi nɔ ko ji lɛ; se nyɛ je lɛ blɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi konɛ e ba ye ngɔ. Ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e kɛ nyamimɛ ɔmɛ maa ba.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Wa nyɛmi Apolo ɔ, i kpa lɛ pɛɛ hluu nɛ e kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, se e kplɛɛ we kulaa kaa e maa ba amlɔ nɛ ɔ, se ke e na e he deka hu e maa ba. Nyagbe munyuhi

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ huɔ, nyɛɛ da si kpɛii ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, nyɛɛ pee nyumu, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ wa!

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ nihi kulaa ngɛ suɔmi mi.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ le Stefana we mi bi ɔmɛ kaa mɛ ji Akaia kekleekle yiblii, nɛ a ngɔ Mawu webi ɔmɛ a sɔmɔmi ɔ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha ni nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ni nɛ e bɔɔ mɔde ɔ.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: I na buajɔmi ngɛ Stefana kɛ Fortunato kɛ Akaiko bami ɔ he, ejakaa nɛ nyɛ be ye ngɔ nɛ ɔ, mɛ lɛ a ba ye nyɛ nɛne mi.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a ba wo ye bua kaa bɔ nɛ a wo nyɛ hu nyɛ bua a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nyɛɛ le mɛ saminya.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asia asafo ɔmɛ biɔ nyɛ. Akwila kɛ Priskila kɛ asafo nɛ ngɛ a we ɔ mi ɔ biɔ nyɛ saminya ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kulaa biɔ nyɛ. Nyɛ nga nyɛ he kɛ nya he fiɔmi klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Ami Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya biɔmi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko sume Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sane ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ e plɛ musutsɛ! Wa Nyɔmtsɛ, ba!

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ye suɔmi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo, nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ɔ ngma ya ha Mawu asafo nɛ ngɛ Korinto kɛ he tsɔli kulaa nɛ ngɛ Akaia tsuo ɔ:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa tsɛ Mawu kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ. Paulo naa Mawu si

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: A gbaa Mawu kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji mi mi sali a tsɛ, kɛ ɛbua womi kulaa Mawu ɔ,

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ jɔɔ wa bua ngɛ wa nɔ nami ɔmɛ kulaa mi, konɛ wɔ hu wa nyɛ nɛ waa kɛ bua womi nɛ Mawu kɛ woɔ wa bua a nɛ wo nihi nɛ naa amanehlu tsuaa amanehlu ɔmɛ a bua.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔ nɛ Kristo amanehlu ɔmɛ baa wa nɔ kɛ bee nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ Kristo he ɔ, wa bua womi ɔ hu hiɛɛ kɛ bee nɔ.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Se ke amanehlu wa naa a, nyɛ bua womi kɛ yi wami hemi he ʼi; nɛ ke wa bua a woɔ hu, e ji nyɛ bua womi nɛ haa nyɛ toɔ nyɛ tsui si kpoo kɛ naa amanehlu nɛ wa naa a nɔuu eko.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Nɛ wa hɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ɔ gbɔle we, ejakaa wa le kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ naa amanehlu ɔ eko ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ nyɛ naa bua womi ɔ hu eko.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, wa sume kaa waa ngɔ wa nɔ́ nɛ wa na ngɛ Asia a kɛ laa nyɛ. Wa na nɔ tsɔ, pe bɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ po, nɛ wa hɛ be je mi himi nɔ tete.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa na ngɛ wa mi paa kaa wa ma gbo, konɛ wa ko ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he nɔ, se mohu wa ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɛ tleɔ ni gbogboehi a si ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ je wɔ kɛ je gbenɔ nɛ ngɛ gbeye nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɛ wɔ jee kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ e nɔ kaa e maa kpale je wɔ kulaa.

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ piɛ wa he kɛ kpa pɛɛ konɛ nihi fuu nɛ na si ha wɔ ngɛ dloomi nike nihi nɛ a kɛ ha wɔ ngɛ nihi fuu a pɛɛ kpami ɔ he. Paulo tsake e yimitomi ɔmɛ

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Se wa fiami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: wa he ni lemi odase nɛ e yeɔ wɔ, kaa Mawu klɔuklɔu peemi kɛ he tsɔmi mi wa ba wa je mi ngɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, titli ɔ, ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ pi he lo mi ni lemi nya, se mohu Mawu dloomi nya.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa ngmɛ́ ni kpahi ha we nyɛ, pe nihi nɛ nyɛ kaneɔ nɛ jehanɛ hu nyɛ le, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa nyɛ maa le kɛ maa ya nyagbe hulɔ ɔ.

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ na le wɔ hulɔ fa kɛ fa, kaa nyɛ fiami nɔ́ ji wɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ji wa nɔ́ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ he je nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ kekle ɔ nɛ, konɛ nyɛ na dloomi si enyɔ.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: Ma ba gu nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ya Makedonia, nɛ jehanɛ hu ma kpale ye se kɛ je Makedonia kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu, konɛ nyɛ ya je mi blɔ kɛ ya Yudea.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Blɔɔ nɛ i to ye yi mi kikɛ ɔ, yi flɛflɛ i kɛ pee lo? Aloo ye yi mi nɛ i to ɔ, he lo nya i to ngɛ konɛ ma de “Ee,” kɛ “Dɛbi,” ngɛ be kake mi lo?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Mawu ji wa odase, kaa wa munyu nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, e pi “Ee” kɛ “Dɛbi” ngɛ be kake mi.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu bi Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ i kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo fiɛ e he sane ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, e pi “Ee” kɛ “Dɛbi” se mohu e ji “Ee”.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu si womihi abɔ nɛ ngɛ ɔ, e mi “Ee” ɔ ngɛ, nɛ e mi nɔuu “Amen” ɔ ngɛ, konɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Se Mawu ji nɔ nɛ haa waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo nane pii si ngɛ Kristo mi, nɛ e pɔ wɔ nu,

english_verse: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
translation_verse: nɛ e sɔu wa nya, nɛ e kɛ Mumi ɔ yi ba pomi nɔ́ ha wɔ ngɛ wa tsui mi hulɔ.

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ Mawu tsɛe nɛ ba ye ye klaa he odase kaa yɛ yi baami he je nɛ i na we ma ba Korinto ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Wa yi nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nyɔguɛ, ejakaa nyɛ daa si tutuutu ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, se mohu wa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ ngɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi he ni tsue.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i pee ye juɛmi kaa i kɛ kɔmɔ yemi be nyɛ ngɔ bae hu.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke i ha nyɛ ye kɔmɔ ɔ, mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ haa ye bua jɔɔ mɔ, kaa ja nɔ nɛ i ha e ye kɔmɔ ɔ nɔuu?

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i ngma nyɛ enɛ ɔ, konɛ, ke i ba a, ma ko ba ye kɔmɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ jinɛ sa kaa i naa a he bua jɔmi ɔmɛ a he, ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nɔ kaa ye bua jɔmi ji nyɛ tsuo nyɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Se tsui yemi kɛ fimi babauu mi i je kɛ ngma nyɛ, kɛ gu vo nyu babauu hu mi, tsa pi nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ he je, se mohu nɛ nyɛɛ na suɔmi babauu nɛ i suɔ nyɛ. Nɔtɔlɔ he yayamipami

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko ha a ye kɔmɔ ɔ, pi imi nɛ e ha i ye kɔmɔ se e ha nyɛ kulaa nyɛ ye kɔmɔ ko kɛ.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ, e hɛ mi nɛ nihi fuu kã a hiɛ ha lɛ,

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ nyɛ kɛ pa lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ e bua mohu, konɛ kɔmɔ yemi fuu tsɔ ɔ ko ba ha e nine mi nɛ wo nyu.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpaa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ha e le kaa nyɛ suɔ lɛ,

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: ejakaa enɛ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ i ngma nyɛ womi ɔ nɛ, konɛ ma kɛ ka nyɛ kaa nyɛ buɔ tue ngɛ nihi kulaa mi lo?

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ́ ko paa lɛ ɔ, imi hu i kɛ paa lɛ, ejakaa imi hu, ke i kɛ nɔ́ ko pa a, nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ pa a, i kɛ pa ngɛ nyɛ he ngɛ Kristo hɛ mi,

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: konɛ Satan nine nɛ ko su wa nɔ, ejakaa e juɛmi ɔmɛ ɔ a kɛ laa wɔ. Paulo tsuiyemi ngɛ Troa

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Bene i ba Troa ngɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a he nɛ ya bli sinya ha mi ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ,

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: i hao ngɛ mumi mi, ejakaa i nɛ́ ye nyɛmi Tito; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i sɛ mɛ nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ ba Makedonia. Kunimiyemi kɛ gu Kristo nɔ

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Se sina ha Mawu, ejakaa ngɛ waa kɛ Kristo kake peemi mi ɔ, e haa wa yeɔ kunimi daa, nɛ e haa e he nilemi he via a guu wa nɔ jee kpo ngɛ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
translation_verse: ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, wa ji gbenɔ via ha mɛ kɛ yaa gbenɔ mi, se ni kpa amɛ ɔ, wa ji wami via ha mɛ kɛ yaa wami mi. Nɛ mɛnɔ lɛ sa ha enɛ ɔmɛ?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa be kaa ni komɛ nɛ juaa Mawu munyu ɔ, se mohu wa tuɔ lɛ ngmingmiingmi bɔ nɛ e je Mawu mi ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, ngɛ Kristo mi.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Anɛ pe wa kpale ngɛ wa he yi jee? Aloo e hia kaa wa hɛɛ yi jemi womi, kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ hɛɛ kɛ ba haa nyɛ loo kɛ jee nyɛ ngɔ ɔ lo?

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ji wa womi nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo wa tsui mi nɛ nihi tsuo le nɛ a kaneɔ.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: A je nyɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ paa kaa nyɛ ji Kristo womi nɛ wa ngma, pi kɛ ni ngmami nyu, se mohu Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ mumi ɔ a kɛ ngma, pi ngɛ tɛ sleetihi a nɔ, se mohu tsui nɛ ji he lo sleeti nɔ.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Kristo he nɛ wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu blɔfami:

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: pi kaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ ɔ wa sa nɛ wa susu kaa nɔ ko je wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa mi, se wa sami ɔ Mawu mi nɛ e je;

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ha wa sa, nɛ wa plɛ Somi He ɔ he sɔmɔli, pi ngmami okadi nɔ́ se mohu mumi nɔ́, ejakaa ngmami okadi ɔ gbee nɔ, se mumi ɔ haa nɔ yi naa wami.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Se ke gbenɔ sɔmɔmi nɛ a kpɛ ngɛ tɛhi a nɔ ɔ hɛ mi ba nyami bɔ nɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ nyɛ we Mose hɛ mi nɛ a hyɛ po ngɛ nyami nɛ se poo ɔ he ɔ,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: anɛ mumi sɔmɔmi ɔ be nyami pee hluu pe kɔlɔ ɔ lo?

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Ejakaa, ke fɔ bumi sɔmɔmi ɔ hɛ mi ba nyami ɔ, anɛ dami sɔmɔmi ɔ hɛ mi be nyami bae kɛ be nɔ lo?

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ hɛ mi nyami sa a, hɛ mi be nyami bae hu ngɛ hɛ mi nyami kpã nɛ pã lɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nɔ́ nɛ se poo ɔ ba kɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ɔ mohu hɛ mi nyami ɔ hiɛ hluu.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: nɛ wa pee we kaa Mose nɛ kɛ hɛ mi hami nɔ ha e hɛ mi, konɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ ko hyɛ nɔ nɛ se poo ɔ nya gbemi ɔ.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Se mohu a nga a juɛmi nya. Ejakaa kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, jamɛ a hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ nɔuu lɛ ha Somi Momo ɔ kanemi ɔ nɔ; ejakaa Kristo mi pɛ nɛ e se poo ngɛ.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: se ke a kpale a se kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ɔ, a ma je hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji Mumi ɔ nɛ; nɛ he nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ he yemi ngɛ.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ wa hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a sɔmɔmi nɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a na wɔ mɔbɔ ɔ, wa ji fɔ́,

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Wa kua zo nihi nɛ a kɛ laa a, nɛ wa bɛ wa je mi ngɛ kutupɔ mi, nɛ jehanɛ hu wa futuu we Mawu munyu ɔ, se mohu waa kɛ anɔkuale ɔ kpo jemi ɔ jeɔ wa he yi ngɔ tsɔɔ ni mli a he nilemi tsuo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Se ke pe a ha wa Sane Kpakpa a nɔ tete po ɔ, nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae ɔmɛ a mi kɛkɛ a ha nɔ ngɛ,

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: nihi a mi nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi mawu ɔ yu nihi nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ a hɛngmɛ ngɛ, konɛ Kristo, nɛ ji Mawu subai ɔ, hɛ mi nyami ɔ sane kpakpa a la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ɔ nɛ ko kpɛ ha mɛ.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he nɛ wa ngɛ fiee, se mohu Kristo Yesu, kaa lɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ, se wɔɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ sɔmɔli ji wɔ ngɛ Yesu he.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu nɛ de ke: “La nɛ je diblii mi nɛ e kpɛ” ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e kpɛ ngɛ wa tsui mi hulɔ, konɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami he ni lemi ɔ nɛ kpɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi.

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: Se wa hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a juetli nɛ ɔ ngɛ zu buɛhi a mi, konɛ he wami nɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ ɔ nɛ pee Mawu nɔ́, se pi wa nɔ́.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: A haoɔ wɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a yi wa nɔ; wa yi mi peɔ wɔ enyɔ enyɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa nine mi wui nyu;

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: a waa wɔ yi mi, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a kua we wɔ; a fiaa wɔ si, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa gbo we;

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wɔ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, a tu wɔ ngɔ wo gbenɔ dɛ mi ngɛ Yesu he, konɛ Yesu wami ɔ hu nɛ je kpo ngɛ wa he lo nɛ ma gbo ɔ mi.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ, gbenɔ tsuɔ ni ngɛ wa mi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, wami tsuɔ ni ngɛ nyɛ mi.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: ejakaa wa le kaa nɔ nɛ tle Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si ɔ, e ma tle waa kɛ Yesu si, nɛ e kɛ waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo ma ba da e hɛ mi.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ he nɛ a ngɛ enɛ ɔ kulaa pee, konɛ dloomi nɛ hiɛ babauu nɛ gu nihi fuu a sina nɔ kɛ be nɔ kɛ ha Mawu hɛ mi nyami womi. Hemi kɛ yemi nya sihimi

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he nɛ wa tsui pui ɔ nɛ, se ke wa kpo nɔ blɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ puɛɔ kulaa tete po ɔ, kɛ̃ ɔ, wa mi nɔmlɔ ɔ plɛɔ ehe daa ligbi.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa nɔ nami nɛ nya wa nɛ se kɛ we nɛ ɔ ngɛ neneene hɛ mi nyami babauu nɛ be nɔ nɛ he jua wa hluu nya buae ha wɔ.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Wɔ nɛ wa pi nihi nɛ hyɛɛ nihi nɛ a naa a, se mohu nihi nɛ a nɛ ɔ wa hyɛɛ ɔ; ejakaa nihi nɛ a naa a hii si be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ, se nihi nɛ a nɛ́ ɔ hii si kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa le kaa, ke a ku wa zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bo tsu nɔ hu, wa ngɛ tsu ko nɛ je Mawu ngɔ, we ko nɛ pi nine nɛ a kɛ pee, nɛ hii si kɛ yaa neneene, ngɛ hiɔwe.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Ejakaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa laa zanue tete ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi, nɛ wa hɛ jaa kaa a ngɔ wa tsu nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ ngɔ wo wɔ,

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: nɛ ke a ngɔ wo wɔ kikɛ ɔ, lɔɔ lɛɛ a be wɔ nae kaa nihi nɛ hɛɛ a he gu.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Ejaka wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ hu, akɛnɛ wa he hiaa wɔ he je ɔ, wa laa zanue, ejakaa wa sume kaa a je wa he nihi, se mohu wa suɔ kaa a wo wɔ ni ngɔ pue nɔ, konɛ wami ɔ nɛ mi nɔ nɛ gboɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ dla wɔ ha tsakemi nɛ ɔ nɔuu ji Mawu, nɔ nɛ ha wɔ Mumi ɔ kaa se dami nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa naa tsui daa, nɛ wa le kaa be abɔ nɛ wa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ ɔ ɔ, wa doma kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: se wa ngɛ tsui, nɛ e sa wa hɛ mi mohu kaa waa doma kɛ je nɔmlɔ tso nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ wa ya hi we ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ oti nɛ wa ngɔ ma wa hɛ mi ji kaa, we wa ngɛ jio, pe wa doma jio, nɛ waa sa e hɛ mi.

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: Ejakaa ja wɔ kulaa wa pue paa ngɛ Kristo kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na nihi nɛ e pee ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi ɔ he hiɔwo, bɔ nɛ e pee ɔ, kpakpa ʼi jio, yaya ʼi jio. Mawu kɛ huɛbɔmi ngɛ Kristo mi

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ wale Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he nɛ ngɛ gbeye he je ɔ, wa tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nimli, se Mawu le bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa nyɛ he ni lemi mi hu ɔ nyɛ le wɔ.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Tsa pi wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa yi nɛ wa ngɛ jee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ekohu, se mohu waa kɛ ngɛ nyɛ blɔ hae konɛ nyɛ kɛ fia ngɔ fɔ wa nɔ, konɛ nyɛ na eko nɛ nyɛ kɛ de ninɛmɛ nɛ fiaa ngɛ hɛ mi se pi tsui mi ɔ.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke godo wa ngɛ nue ɔ, Mawu wa ngɛ nue kɛ ngɛ hae, nɛ ke wa ngɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ hu ɔ, e ngɛ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo suɔmi ɔ nyɛɛ wa nɔ nɛ wa ngɔɔ lɛ kaa ke nɔ kake gbo nihi kulaa a yi gbenɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ni ɔmɛ kulaa gbo.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Nɛ e gbo nihi kulaa a yi gbenɔ, konɛ nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ, a hɛ ko hi ngmengmle ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he hu, se mohu a hɛ nɛ hi ngmengmle ha nɔ nɛ gbo nɛ a tle lɛ si ekohu ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, bɔ nɔ́ he ji lɛ; blema ni ɔmɛ be kɛ ho; oʼɛ, nihi kulaa plɛ ehe.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa je Mawu dɛ mi, nɔ nɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ dla waa kɛ Tsɛ ɔ kpɛti, nɛ e kɛ kpatami sɔmɔmi ɔ ha wɔ ɔ;

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ ji kaa Mawu gu Kristo nɔ nɛ e kɛ je ɔ ngɛ huɛ pee, nɛ e bui a nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ hi mɛ, nɛ e tu huɛ peemi munyu ɔ ngɔ wo wa dɛ.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ji bɔfohi ngɛ Kristo nane mi, kaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu gu wa nɔ nɛ e kɛ nihi ngɛ munyu tue: Wa daa si ngɛ Kristo nane mi ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae ke: Nyɛ ha a dla nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu kpɛti!

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ li yayami ɔ, wa he ɔ Mawu ha e plɛ yayami, konɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa plɛ Mawu dami ngɛ e mi.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ wa ji Mawu hepiɛli ngɛ e ni tsumi ɔ mi he je ɔ, wa tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ konɛ nyɛ ko he Mawu dloomi ɔ yaka;

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: ejakaa e ke: “Be nɛ sa mi i bu mo tue ngɛ, Nɛ yi wami hemi ligbi nɔ hu i ye bua mo ngɛ.” Oʼɛ, be nɛ sa saminya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; oʼɛ, yi wami hemi ligbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, wa pi kpangmi ha nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko mi, konɛ a ko gbe sɔmɔmi ɔ he guɛ,

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, waa kɛ wa he nɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu sɔmɔli ngɛ tsui si tomi babauu mi, ngɛ nɔ namihi a mi, ngɛ fimihi a mi, ngɛ he hiamihi a mi,

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: ngɛ ni fiamihi a mi, ngɛ pamitsɛmɛ a tsuhi a mi, ngɛ hoo peemihi a mi, ngɛ dengme gbomihi a mi, ngɛ nyɔ fɔmihi a mi, ngɛ hwɔ hamihi a mi,

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: ngɛ he tsɔmi mi, ngɛ ni lemi mi, ngɛ juɛmi nɛ se kɛɛ mi, ngɛ mi mi himi mi, ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu mi, ngɛ suɔmi klɔuu mi,

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: ngɛ anɔkuale munyu tumi mi, ngɛ Mawu he wami mi, kɛ gu dami ta hwumi nihi kɛ ha hiɛ ɔ kɛ muɔ,

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: kɛ gu hɛ mi nyami kɛ heguɛ gbemi mi; kɛ gu nɔ he munyu yaya tumi kɛ nɔ he munyu kpakpa tumi mi; kaa nɔ sisili, kɛ̃ ɔ anɔkualetsɛmɛ ji wɔ;

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: kaa nihi nɛ a li mɛ, kɛ̃ ɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ le wɔ; kaa nihi nɛ a gbo, nɛ oʼɛ, wa hɛ ngɛ; kaa nihi nɛ ra gblaa a tue, se kɛ ɔ a gbi wɔ;

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: kaa kɔmɔ yeli, se wa bua jɔɔ daa; kaa ohiafohi, se wa tsakee nihi fuu ngɔ peɔ niatsɛmɛ; kaa nihi nɛ be nɔ́ ko, se kɛ̃ ɔ wa ngɛ nihi kulaa.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Waa kɛ nyɛ tu munyu faii, Korintobi, wa pã wa tsui mi hu ha nyɛ.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Blɔ ngɛ wa mi ha nyɛ, se nyɛ mohu lɛ nyɛ nga nyɛ tsui nya wo wɔ.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu nyɛ ha nyɛ tsui mi nɛ bli ja nɔuu nɛ nyɛ kɛ to wɔ nane mi Wɔjami he kɔkɔbɔmi

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ ko pee kake. Ejakaa mɛni bɔmi dami kɛ mlaatɔmi ngɛ? Aloo mɛni bɔmi la kɛ diblii ngɛ?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛni gbi kake peemi Kristo kɛ Belial ngɛ? Aloo mɛni ni dlami nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ ngɛ?

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ hu, mɛni kake peemi Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ amagahi ngɛ? Ejakaa Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ sɔlemi tsu ji nyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu de ke: “Ma hi a mi, nɛ ma nyɛɛ a kpɛti, Nɛ ma pee a Mawu, nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.”

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Kɔlɔ ɔ he ɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: “Nyɛɛ je a kpɛti, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ he Nɛ nyɛ ko ta mu nɔ́ ko he, Nɛ ma he nyɛ atuu.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ma pee nyɛ tsɛ, Nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa pee ye bimɛ nyumuhi kɛ ye bimɛ yihi, Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, ope ɔ, de ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
