translation_verse: Jehanɛ, mamimɛ nɛ a suɔ, akɛnɛ wa na si womi nɛ ɔmɛ he je ɔ, nyɛ ha wa fɔ wa he kɛ je he lo kɛ mumi mi mu kulaa mi, nɛ waa hi kɛ pi si ngɛ he tsɔmi mi ngɛ Mawu gbeye yemi mi. Paulo bua jɔmi

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha wɔ blɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi! Wa pee we nɔ ko nɔ ko yayami ko; wa puɛ we nɔ́ ko, wa yi nɔ ko amimi.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: I de we enɛ ɔ nɛ ma kɛ bu nyɛ fɔ, ejakaa i de momo ke nyɛ ngɛ wa tsui mi, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ nɛ gbo nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ yi nɛ na wami.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: I ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi babauu ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, i fiaa fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ babauu. I hyi tɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, i hyi tɔ kɛ be nɔ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ wa nɔ nami ɔmɛ kulaa mi ɔ.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Ejakaa bene wa ba Makedonia a hu ɔ, wa nɔmlɔ tso na we he jɔmi kulaa, se mohu he tsuaa he ɔ, nɔ́ sɔuu wa na; wa kpo nɔ blɔ ɔ, pɛ; wa mi blɔ ɔ, gbeye yemi.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Se Mawu, nɔ nɛ jɔɔ nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔmɛ a bua a, e kɛ Tito bami ɔ jɔɔ wa bua.

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: Se pi e bami ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu bua womi nɛ e na kɛ je nyɛ ngɔ ɔ hulɔ, ejakaa e ba bɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛ maa na mi, kɛ nyɛ kɔmɔ yemi ɔ, kɛ ye he mɔde nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bɔe ɔ, enɛ ɔ he ɔ i na bua jɔmi babauu pe keklee ɔ.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Ke ye womi ɔ ha nɔ́ ko dɔ nyɛ po ɔ, kɛ̃ ɔ i pia we ye he. E dɔ mi kɛ̃, ejakaa jamɛ a womi ɔ dɔ nyɛ mohu, se be kpiti kɛkɛ e dɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ ɔ, ye bua jɔ, pi ngɛ dɔmi nɛ e dɔ nyɛ ɔ he, se mohu akɛnɛ e dɔ nyɛ nɛ e ha nyɛ pia nyɛ he ɔ he je. Ejakaa e dɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi konɛ e ko je wɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko laa nyɛ.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Ejakaa dɔmi nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ tsɛɛ he piami nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa yi wami hemi mi kɛ baa, nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko pia we e he ngɛ he ɔ; se je nɛ ɔ mi dɔmi ɔ tsɛɛ gbenɔ kɛ baa.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Ejakaa oʼɛ, kikɛmɛ a dɔmi nɛ e dɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi nɛ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ mɔde bɔmi, nya jemi, tsui la womi, gbeye yemi, hɛja, hɛ dɔmi kɛ lue yemi tete nɛ e tsɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ mi! Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he tsɔɔ wɔ kaa nyɛ he tsɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i ngma nyɛ tete po ɔ, tsa pi nɔ nɛ tɔ ɔ he je, jehanɛ hu tsa pi nɔ nɛ a tɔ e nɔ ɔ he je, se mohu benɛ pee nɛ wa he mɔde nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bɔe ɔ nɛ je kpo paa ha nyɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa bua jɔ. Se wa bua womi ɔ be nɔ babauu kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ wa na ngɛ Tito bua jɔmi ɔ he, ejakaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ha e tsui nɔ e mi.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ fia ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ, nyɛ gbi mi zo. Se kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nihi tsuo ngɛ anɔkuale mi ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ wa fiami hu nɛ wa fia ngɔ tsɔɔ Tito ɔ pee anɔkuale.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ngɛ nyɛ he tsui babauu pe kekle ɔ, ejakaa e kaii nyɛ kulaa nyɛ tue bumi ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ he domi he lɛ hɛmuɔ ɔ.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: I na bua jɔmi kaa ma nyɛ ma ngɔ ye he ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ kulaa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, wa ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le dloomi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha ngɛ Makedonia asafo ɔmɛ a mi ɔ,

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: ejakaa i ngɛ odase yee kaa a ha bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ, nɛ a ha pe bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ tete ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya,

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ hɛdɔ babauu kpa wɔ pɛɛ ke waa kɛ kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ kɛ huɛ bɔmi nɛ ngɛ sɔmɔmi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ya ha klɔuklɔubi ɔmɛ,

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: nɛ pi kaa bɔ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu, ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, a ngɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ngɔ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kekle kɛ wɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ha wa kpa Tito pɛɛ, konɛ bɔ nɛ e je sisi momo sa a, ja nɔuu e gbe kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ hu nya ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ bee nɔ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi: ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ munyu tumi kɛ ni lemi kɛ mɔde bɔmi kulaa kɛ suɔmi nɛ je nyɛ mi nɛ ngɛ wa mi ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ konɛ kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ mi hu ɔ nyɛɛ be nɔ.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Tsa pi mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ hae; se mohu ni kpahi a mɔde bɔmi i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ suɔmi ɔ kae ngɛ hyɛe, kaa e ngɛ klɔuu lo.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Ejaka nyɛ le wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ, kaa lɛ nɛ ji niatsɛ ɔ, e plɛ ohiafo ngɛ nyɛ he, konɛ nyɛɛ gu e hia a nɔ kɛ plɛ niatsɛmɛ.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Ga kɛkɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi, ejakaa enɛ ɔ hi ha nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ gbe nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ je sisi jeha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ nya, tsa pi ngɛ peemi mi kɛkɛ, se mohu ngɛ suɔmi mi hulɔ.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ, nyɛɛ gbe ni tsumi ɔ nya; nyɛɛ kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ gbe nya kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ je sisi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ha bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke tsui ngɛ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ mo nɔ o ngɛ ɔ, maa muɔ Mawu hɛ, pi bɔ nɛ o be.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: I de we enɛ ɔ nɛ ma kɛ ha ni komɛ he jɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hao, se mohu konɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ pee pɛpɛɛpɛ;

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: kikɛmɛ a be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ be nɔ ɔ ya ye bua ninɛmɛ nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a nɔ́ nɛ be nɔ ɔ ba ye bua nyɛ konɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ sɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ pa ngma a ke: “Nɔ nɛ buaa fuu nya, a, E na we eko ngɛ se, Nɔ nɛ buaa bɔɔ nya hu ɔ, E piɛ́ eko hi lɛ.”

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Se sina ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ ngɔ nyɛ he mɔde bɔmi nɛ ɔ ngɔ wo Tito tsui mi ɔ.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: E bu wa pɛɛ nɛ wa kpa lɛ ɔ tue mohu se akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ ɔ mɔde bɔlɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, e ba nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Nyɛmi nɛ wa tsɔ piɛ e he nɛ ɔ, ngɛ yi jemi ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a he ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ kulaa mi.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Nɛ pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se asafo ɔmɛ hia lɛ to hulɔ nɛ e kɛ wɔ nɛ nyɛɛ, nɛ e hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ wa ngɛ sɔmɔe ngɛ he nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ ni tsumi ɔ he suɔmi nɛ wa ngɛ;

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Wa yi mi tomi ji kaa waa pee nɔ́ nɛ da, pi ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛkɛ, se mohu ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi hulɔ.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa tsɔ wa nyɛmi ɔ hu kɛ piɛ a he, nɔ nɛ wa ka lɛ si abɔ ngɛ nihi fuu mi, nɛ wa na kaa e bɔɔ mɔde, se jehanɛ e ngɛ mɔde bɔe pe kekle ɔ ngɛ e hɛ nɛ e kɛ fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ fuu ɔ he,

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Tito ɔ, ye he piɛlɔ kɛ mami ni tsulɔ ji lɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ hu, asafo ɔmɛ a bɔfohi kɛ Kristo hɛ mi nyami ji mɛ.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ je nyɛ suɔmi kɛ fiami nɛ wa fiaa fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: E hia we kaa ma ngma nyɛ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ sɔmɔmi nɛ a kɛ ya sɔmɔɔ klɔuklɔubi ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i le bɔ nɛ nyɛ na he tsui ha, nɛ i fia fɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ he ngɔ tsɔɔ Makedoniabi ɔmɛ kaa Akaiabi dla a he ngɔ to lingmi jeha a lokoo; nɛ nyɛ mɔde bɔmi ɔ wo nihi fuu kã.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsɔe konɛ wa fiami nɛ wa fia ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ ɔ e ko pee yaka ngɛ enɛ ɔ blɔfami, nɛ nyɛ dla nyɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ wa de ɔ;

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: nɛ ke Makedoniabi ɔmɛ ekomɛ kɛ mi ba a, a ko ba na nyɛ kaa nyɛ dla we nyɛ he nɛ wa hɛ mi ba pue si ngɛ kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i susu kaa ma kpa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ pɛɛ nɛ a sɛ ye hlami kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ a ba dla kikɛmɛ a nike ni nɛ nyɛ wo si momo nɔ ngɔ to, konɛ e pee nɔ́ ko nɛ a dla ngɔ to momo kaa jɔɔmi nɔ́ ko se pi nɔ nyɛmi nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai enɛ ɔ kaa, nɔ nɛ luɛɛ nihi a he kɛ duɔ ɔ, e kɛ he luɛmi hu ma kpa; nɛ nɔ nɛ duɔ fuu ɔ, fuu nɔuu e ma kpa.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha bɔ nɛ e ma nya si momo ngɛ e tsui mi nɛ e ko je kɔmɔ yemi loo fimi mi; ejakaa nɔ nɛ haa ngɛ tsui mi jɔmi nya a Mawu suɔ.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Se Mawu ngɛ he wami nɛ e ma ha nyɛ ni kpakpahi kulaa kɛ be nɔ, konɛ nyɛ he nɛ kpe nyɛ kulaa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi daa nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ be nɔ ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa mi,

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “E gbɛɛ fiaa ngɔ haa ohiafo ɔmɛ; E mɔbɔ nami ɔ hii si kɛ yaa neneene.”

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Se, nɔ nɛ kɛ dumi wuhi kee dulɔ nɛ e kɛ abolo hu haa yemi ɔ, e ma ha nyɛ dumi wuhi nɛ hiɛ, nɛ e ma ha dami yiblii ɔmɛ hu maa fu

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi nɛ nyɛɛ pee muklii mi hili kɛ pi si, nɛ a gu wa nɔ nɛ a kɛ sina nɛ ha Mawu.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kikɛmɛ a yemi kɛ buami nɛ ɔ he sɔmɔmi ɔ, tsa pi klɔuklɔubi ɔmɛ a fimi kɛkɛ nɛ e pɛneɔ, se mohu e haa a naa Mawu si babauu kɛ bee nɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kikɛmɛ a sɔmɔmi nɛ ɔ mi yiblii he ɔ, a woɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ tue bumi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ jajeɔ Kristo sane kpakpa a kɛ huɛ bɔmi klɔuu nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ kɛ nihi kulaa bɔɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛ hu a kɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ nyɛ hami tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a suɔ nyɛ ngɛ Mawu dloomi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ kɛ be nɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Se sina ha Mawu ngɛ e nike ni nɛ a be nyɛe he ni maa sɛɛ ɔ he!

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nitsɛ i kɛ Kristo mi mi jɔmi kɛ kpoo peemi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae, imi nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ i ji humi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, se ke i be nyɛ ngɔ ɔ i hiaa kã woɔ nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: I ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kaa, ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko ha ma hia kã ngɔ wo nyɛ ejakaa i le kaa ma nyɛ kã ma hia ngɔ wo nihi nɛ susuu kaa wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ he lo nyɛ a.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa he lo mi wa ngɛ mohu, se wa hwui wa ta a ngɛ he lo nya.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa tahwumi ni ɔmɛ ɔ, tsa pi he lo mi nihi ʼi, se mohu he wami nihi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ kuɔ mɔ nguahi;

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: wa kuɔ susumihi kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ siɔ Mawu ni lemi ɔ, nɛ wa ngɔɔ juɛmi tsuaa juɛmi nyɔguɛ haa Kristo tue bumi;

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: ke nyɛ tue bumi ɔ hyi ɔ, wa dla wa he ngɔ to konɛ waa gbla tuegbenɔ tsuo he tue.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ngɛ nihi hyɛe kaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ. Ke nɔ ko ngɔɔ e hɛ fɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he nɔ kaa Kristo nɔ ji lɛ ɔ, e susu he ekohu, kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ji Kristo nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ wɔ hu wa ji Kristo nihi.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke fiami po ma fia kɛ be nɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ wa kɛ ha nyɛ nane nɛ nu si nɛ pi kaa waa kɛ ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi po he ɔ, zo be mi gbee,—

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: konɛ ma ko pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ woɔ nyɛ he gbeye ngɛ womihi a mi kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa a deɔ ke: “E womi ɔmɛ a mi munyu ɔmɛ jiɔ, nɛ a mi wa mohu, se ke lɛ nɔmlɔ ɔ nitsɛ e ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e he wɛ́, nɛ e munyu ɔ he be akɔnɔ ko.”

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ e le kaa, bɔ nɛ wa munyu ngɛ ngɛ womihi a mi ke wa be ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ, ke wa ngɛ ɔ, wa ni peemi nihi hu ngɛ.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, wa be fiae tsɔ, se mohu ngɛ susumi kpa nɛ Mawu susu ngɔ ha wɔ, nɛ wa kɛ su nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nya.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa kpã we wa mi tsɔ kaa nihi nɛ sui nyɛ ngɔ, ejakaa waa kɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a su nyɛ ngɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Wa fiɛ pe nine ngɛ ni kpahi a nitsumihi a he; se wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa, ke nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ wae ɔ, wa ma plɛ nimli nguahi ngɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa ni tsumi nya, nɛ wa maa be nɔ tete,

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: konɛ wa ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ nyɛ se je ni ɔmɛ a mi nɛ wa ko fia ngɔ fɔ hehi nɛ ni kpahi tsu ni ngɛ momo ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: “Se nɔ nɛ fiaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ e fia ngɔ fɔ!”

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi nɔ nɛ jeɔ e he yi ɔ ji nɔ nɛ sa, se mohu nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ jeɔ e yi ɔ.

english_verse: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
translation_verse: I na nɛ jinɛ nyɛ ko na ha ye biɛmi ɔ bɔɔ, kɛ̃ ɔ nyɛɛ na ha mi.

english_verse: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i jee nyɛ he hunga haa Mawu; ejakaa i bi nyɛ si ha Kristo, konɛ ma ngɔ zangmayo nɛ he tsɔ ya ha nyumu kake.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ gbeye yee kaa alinɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ sinɔ ɔ kɛ e kutupɔ ɔ mlɔɔ Hawa a, ja nɔuu a ma puɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ juɛmi kɛ je klɔu peemi nɛ nyɛ je tsɔɔ Kristo ɔ mi.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nɔ nɛ ma a ba fiɛɛ yesu kpã nɛ wa fiɛ we, aloo mumi kpa ko nɛ nyɛ na we sa, aloo sane kpakpa kpã ko nɛ nyɛ he we ɔ, nyɛ heɔ lɛ saminya.

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i susuu kaa e piɛ́ mi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko loko i kɛ bɔfo ngua amɛ maa sɔ.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Se ke i ji nɔmlɔ ko nɛ li nɔ ko ngɛ munyu tumi blɔfami tete ɔ, i pi ja ngɛ ni lemi blɔfami; se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, wa je enɛ ɔ kpo paa ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ nihi kulaa mi.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: Aloo blɔɔ, nɛ i ba ye he si konɛ a wo nyɛ nɔ, nɛ i fiɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ yaka a, i pee yayami lo?

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ e fi mi tete ɔ, i hɛ wi nɔ ko nɔ ko, ejakaa nihi nɛ hia mi ɔ, nyɛmimɛ nɛ je Makedonia ba a ha su ye dɛ. I le ye he nɔ hyemi konɛ ma ko plɛ tlomi ha nyɛ.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Be abɔ nɛ Kristo anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ ye mi nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be ye fiami nɛ ɔ nya tsie ngɛ Akaia ni ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je? Kaa i sume nyɛ he je loo? Mawu le.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ i ngɛ pee ɔ, ma pee, konɛ ma kɛ tsi nihi nɛ ngɛ ye he sane hlae ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ a ko na he blɔ nɛ a fia kɛ de ke mɛ hu a ngɛ ni nɛ wa ngɛ tsueɔ nɔuu tsue.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji lakpa bɔfohi ni tsuli sisili nɛ tsakee a he peɔ Kristo bɔfohi.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ be nyakpɛ tete; ejakaa Satan nitsɛ tsakee e he peɔ la bɔfo.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ hu tsakee a he peɔ kaa dami sɔmɔli ɔ, e pi nɔ́ ko ngua ko; mɛɛ lɛɛ a nyagbe maa pee bɔ nɛ a ni tsumi ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. Paulo amanehlu nɛ e na kaa bɔfo

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: I ngɛ dee ekohu ke: Nɔ ko ko bu mi kuasia, se ke pi ja a, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ mi kaa kuasia mɔ, konɛ imi hu ma fia bɔɔ ko.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, i de we kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nya mi munyu, se mohu kaa kuasia tuɔ munyu, ngɛ kikɛmɛ a fiami hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ nihi fuu fiaa ngɛ he lo nya he je ɔ, imi hu ma fia eko.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ ni leli ji nyɛ he je ɔ, nyɛ heɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ be yi mi ɔmɛ hɛmuɔ.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Ejakaa, ke nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ yee, ke nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ adufude yee, ke neɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ klama tsɔe, ke nɔ ko ngɛ e he nɔ woe ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma gbae ɔ, nyɛ kplɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: I kɛ zo ngɛ dee ke, wa pee gbedee tsɔ! Se nɔ́ mi nɛ nɔ ko peɔ ka ngɛ ɔ — I ngɛ munyu tue kaa kuasia — imi hu i peɔ ka ngɛ mi.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Hebribi ji mɛ lo? Imi hu eko ji mi. Israelbi ji mɛ lo? Imi hu eko ji mi. Abraham nina ji mɛ lo? Imi hu eko ji mi.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Kristo sɔmɔli ji mɛ lo? — i ngɛ munyu tue kaa nɔ nɛ yi mi puɛ — i pe mɛ; ngɛ pɔtɔ ni tsumihi nɛ be nɔ mi, ngɛ ni fiamihi nɛ hiɛ tsɔ mi, ngɛ tsu mi womi babauu mi, ngɛ gbenɔ muɔ nya kpitikpiti.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: A fia mi tso si etɛ, a fia mi tɛ si kake, i kɛ lɛ butu si etɛ, i ye je nami kɛ je jɔmi ngɛ wo mi;

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: i hia blɔ kpitikpiti, i na nɔ ngɛ pahi a hɛ mi, i na nɔ ngɛ ojo fiali a dɛ mi, i na nɔ ngɛ ye wekubi a dɛ mi, i na nɔ ngɛ majeli a dɛ mi, i na nɔ ngɛ ma mi, i na nɔ ngɛ nga nɔ, i na nɔ ngɛ wo hɛ mi, i na nɔ ngɛ lakpa nyɛmimɛ a kpɛti;

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: ngɛ ni tsumi kɛ pɔtɔ mi, ngɛ nyɔ fɔmihi a mi kpitikpiti, ngɛ hwɔ kɛ kuma mi, ngɛ hwɔ hamihi a mi kpitikpiti, ngɛ fiɛ̃ kɛ he gu nyɛɛmi mi?

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: e slo nihi nɛ ngɛ se; kɛ jehanɛ hu haomi nɛ i naa daa kɛ asafo ɔmɛ kulaa a he susumi.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ gbɔleɔ, nɛ i mi lɛɛ i gbɔle we? Mɛnɔ nane a kpataa, nɛ ye mi mi sɛ̃ mi ha lɛ?

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Ke e hia kaa ma fia kɛ ɔ, ma fia ngɔ fo ye gbɔlemi nihi a nɔ.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Mawu kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Tsɛ, nɔ nɛ a gbaa kɛ ya siɔ neneene ɔ, le kaa i yi lakpa.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ Damasko ɔ, ganɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ Areta sisi ɔ ha a huɔ ngɛ Damaskobi ɔmɛ a ma a mi ngɛ mi hlae nɛ e nu,

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ mi gu saflɛ mi ngɛ plɔ mi kɛ kple si ngɛ gli ɔ nɔ, nɛ i tu fo kɛ je e dɛ.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: E hia kaa ma fia, se se nami ko be he; kɛ̃ ɔ ma sɛɛ ni namihi kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpo jemihi a he ni.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Oʼɛ enɛ ɔ ji si etɛ nɛ i dla ye he kaa i ma nyɛ ngɔ, se i kɛ ye he ba be nyɛ nɔ fɔe; ejakaa tsa pi nyɛ sika nɛ i ngɛ hlae, se mohu nyɛ nitsɛmɛ. Ejakaa e sɛ́ kaa bimɛ buaa nihi a nya ngɔ toɔ a fɔli, se mohu fɔli lɛ buaa nihi a nya ngɔ toɔ a bimɛ.

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: I le kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ — e ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, e be nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, i li, Mawu lɛ le —

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: kaa a sa lɛ kɛ ho Paradeiso ya nɛ e ya nu munyuhi nɛ a be nyɛe maa tu nɛ nɔmlɔ ko be he blɔ kaa e woɔ ta.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he ma fia ngɛ, se i be fiae ha imi nitsɛ ye he, kaa ja ngɛ ye gbɔlemi ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma fia a, i be kuasia ejakaa ma tu anɔkuale; se ye hɛ i ngɛ kue kɛ ngɛ nɔ fɔe, konɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko bu mi pe bɔ nɛ e naa mi ɔ aloo nɔ́ nɛ e ko ɔ e nuɔ ngɛ ye nya a.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Se benɛ pee nɛ ma ko wo ye he nɔ tsɔ ko ngɛ kpo jemihi nɛ kle saminya nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a ha mi mio ko ngɛ ye he womi mi, nɛ ji Satan bɔfo, konɛ e gba mi mahi, nɛ ma ko wo ye he nɔ tsɔ.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i kpa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pɛɛ si etɛ sɔuu konɛ e je ye nɔ;

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: nɛ e de mi ke: “Ye dloomi ɔ hiɛ ha mo, ejakaa ye he wami ɔ gbedee peemi mi e pii si ngɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i suɔ saminya kaa ma fia ngɔ fɔ ye gbɔlemi ɔmɛ a nɔ mohu, konɛ Kristo he wami ɔ nɛ bu ye he.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ngɛ Kristo he ɔ, ye bua jɔɔ ngɛ gbedee peemihi a mi, ngɛ hɛdo nihi a nami mi, ngɛ haomihi a mi, ngɛ yi wamihi a mi, ngɛ fimihi a mi; ejakaa ke i pee gbedee ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ mohu i naa he wami. Paulo ye Korintobi ɔmɛ a he kɔmɔ

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: I ye kuasiahi a sane kɛ fiami nɛ ɔ; nyɛ lɛ nyɛ nyɛ ye nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa sa nɛ nyɛ mohu lɛ nyɛ jeɔ ye yi; ejakaa e piɛ́ mi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ i kɛ bɔfo ngua amɛ nɛ sɔ, pohu i pi nɔ ko tete.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Bɔfo peemi he okadi ɔmɛ mohu ɔ, a pee ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ tsui si tomi tsuo mi, ngɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi kɛ he wami ni tsumihi a mi.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ kpɛ asafohi nɛ piɛ omɛ a se, kaa ja yemi kɛ buami nɛ i kɛ doo we nyɛ nya kɛkɛ ɔ? Nyɛɛ ngɔ kikɛmɛ yayami nɛ ɔ ngɔ pa mi!

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Se i suɔ babauu kaa ma puɛ nihi kulaa nɛ i ngɛ kɛ imi nitsɛ ye he tete ngɛ nyɛ klaa amɛ a he. Ke i suɔ nyɛ babauu kikɛ ɔ, e sɛ́ kaa nyɛ hu nyɛɛ suɔ mi ja lo?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ i kɛ ye he fɔɛ nyɛ nɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ma de ke i nu nyɛ ngɛ ga mi; ejakaa ye hɛ mi tɛ̃ pe nyɛ.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Anɛ i gu nihi nɛ i tsɔɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ eko nɔ ye nyɛ amimi lo?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: I kpa Tito pɛɛ nɛ i tsɔ lɛ kɛ wa nyɛmi ɔ; anɛ Tito ba ye nyɛ amimi lo? Anɛ pi lɛ mumi ɔ nɔuu nɛ waa kɛ nyɛɛ? Pi kɔlɔ ɔ nanema he ɔmɛ a mi nɔuu nɛ wa nyɛɛ?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Nyɛ susuu kaa wa nya sɔuu wa ngɛ jee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ ɔ lo? Pi ja, Mawu hɛ mi wa ngɛ dee ngɛ, ngɛ Kristo mi, se, mamimɛ, ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa a, nyɛ nane si numi he je nɛ wa ngɛ dee.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i ngɛ gbeye yee kaa alinɔ ke i ba a, i ba be nyɛ nae bɔ nɛ i ko suɔ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ be mi nae bɔ nɛ nyɛ ko suɔ; kaa eko ɔ pɛ, hunga jemi, mi mi la, huhui, sieku yemi, munyu huitihuiti tumi, he nɔ womi, basabasa peemi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa ke i ba a, ye Mawu ɔ maa ba mi si ekohu ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ ma ye kɔmɔ ha nihi nɛ pee yayami sa nɛ a tsakee we a tsui ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu, ngɛ a mu nihi kɛ ajuama bɔmi kɛ ya homi ɔ he.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji si etɛ nɛ i ma nyɛ ngɔ. Odase yeli enyɔ loo etɛ nya a, sane tsuaa sane nya nɛ ma si.

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: akɛnɛ nyɛ ngɛ okadi ko hlae nɛ nyɛ kɛ na kaa Kristo lɛ ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ ye mi, nɔ nɛ gbɔle we ngɛ nyɛ mi, se mohu e he waa ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ;

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: ejakaa gbedemi he a sɛu lɛ ɔ nɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ Mawu he wami nya a, e hɛ ngɛ; nɛ wɔ hu wa gbɔleɔ ngɛ e mi; se Mawu he wami nɛ ngɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nya a, waa kɛ lɛ hɛ maa hi ngmengmle.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ka nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he hyɛ kaa nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi lo. Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he nɛ hi. Aloo nyɛ li nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he kaa Yesu Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi lo? Ke pi ja a, lɛɛ nihi nɛ sɛ kulaa ji nyɛ.

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Se ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa nyɛ maa le kaa, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa pi nihi nɛ sɛ́.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae, konɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami ko kulaa, tsa pi kaa konɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ waa pee kaa nihi nɛ sa he je, se mohu konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da, ke po a maa ngɔ lɛ kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nyɛ we.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Wa naa bua jɔmi ke wa pee gbedee, nɛ nyɛ mohu nyɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he pɛɛ hu wa kpaa, kɔlɔ ɔ ji nyɛ himi kɛ si pimi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Kɔlɔ ɔ he hu nɛ i ngma enɛ ɔ benɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ, konɛ ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ko ye wawɛɛ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha mi ngɛ dlami se pi puemi he ɔ nya.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si, nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi ga, nyɛ juɛmi nɛ pee kake, nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ suɔmi kɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga nyɛ he kɛ nya he fiɔmi klɔuklɔu. Ni Klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ, kɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ, kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu huɛ bɔmi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ;

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he, konɛ e je wɔ kɛ je je yaya nɛ ngɛ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ mi ngɛ Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya;

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene ɔ! Amen. Sane Kpakpa kake ɔ

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Ye hɛ mi pee mi yaa kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu ɔ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he tsɔe kɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo dloomi ɔ nya a he jee kɛ yaa sane kpakpa kpa ko he;

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: nɛ kɛ ɔ, ekpa ko be, mohu ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi puee, nɛ a ngɛ hlae kaa a plɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Se ke wɔ po, loo bɔfo nɛ je hiɔwe tete, ba ba jaje sane kpakpa kpa ko tsɔɔ nyɛ, ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ ɔ se ɔ, jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ e pee musutsɛ!

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ wa de momo ɔ, ja nɔuu i ngɛ dee ekohu ke: Ke nɔ ko ba ba jaje sane kpakpa kpa ko tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ he nɛ ɔ se ɔ, jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ e pee musutsɛ!

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Blɔɔ jehanɛ nimli a hɛ mi i ngɛ hlɛe nɛ ma sa loo Mawu? Aloo i ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi hlae ma sa? Ejakaa ke i ngɛ nɔ ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi sae kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ pi Kristo tsɔlɔ ji mi. Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Paulo plɛ bɔfo

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le, mamimɛ, kaa sane kpakpa nɛ i jaje ɔ, pi nimli a nya nɛ e je.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi nɔmlɔ ko dɛ mi nɛ i na kɛ je, nɛ pi tsɔɔmi hu nɛ a tsɔɔ mi; se mohu Yesu Kristo kpo jemi nya i na ngɛ.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ nu ye sa je mi bami he ngɛ Yudafohi a jami ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ i wa Mawu asafo ɔ yi mi babauu nɛ i kpata e hɛ mi,

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: nɛ i pã wa juahi fuu ngɛ Yudafohi a jami ɔ mi ngɛ ye wɛli a kpɛti, nɛ ye hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ wa tsɛmɛ a blema sanehi nɛ a kɛ ha wɔ ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: kaa e ma je lɛ nitsɛ e bi ɔ kpo ngɛ ye mi, konɛ ma jaje e he sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, amlɔ ɔ, i kɛ he lo kɛ muɔ yɛ he dami,

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: nɛ jehanɛ i yɛ́ Yerusalem hu ngɛ nihi nɛ ji bɔfohi loko ji imi hu i ba plɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a ngɔ, se mohu i pue nɔ kɛ ho Arabia ya, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i kpale ye se kɛ ba Damasko ekohu.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ lɔ ɔ se jeha etɛ ɔ, i ya Yerusalem nɛ i kɛ Petro ya sɛɛ ni, nɛ i hi e ngɔ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: I nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kpa ko kaa ja Yakobo, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛmi ɔ.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, oʼɛ, Mawu hɛ mi i ngɛ dee ngɛ, i yi lakpa.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i ba Siria kɛ Kilikia ni ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Se nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ, a li ye hɛ mi ngɛ Yudea Kristo asafo ɔmɛ a mi;

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: se mohu a nuɔ kɛkɛ kaa nɔ nɛ wa wɔ yi mi sa a, jehanɛ e ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ sa nɛ e kpata hɛ mi ɔ he sane kpakpa a jajee kɛ ngɛ tsɔɔe;

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ ye he.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ, lɔ ɔ se jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ sɔuu ɔ, i kɛ Barnaba kpale kɛ ya Yerusalem, nɛ i ngɔ Tito hu ngɔ piɛ ye he.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: I ya ngɛ kpo jemi ko nya, nɛ i kɛ sane kpakpa nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ngɛ majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ya fɔ a hɛ mi, se titli ɔ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ a hɛ mi, benɛ pee nɛ fo nɛ i tuu ɔ aloo i ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ e ko pee yaka.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Se Tito tete nɛ e kɛ mi ngɛ nɛ e ji Hela no ɔ, a nyɛ́ we enɔ kaa a po lɛ,

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: ejakaa lakpa nyɛmimɛ komɛ ju si sɛ asafo ɔ mi kulɔɔ, konɛ a ba huɔ wa he nɛ wa ye ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, konɛ a ye wɔ nyɔguɛ;

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: se mɛɛ lɛɛ wa kplɛɛ we nɛ waa bu mɛ tue ngmlɛfia kake tete, konɛ sane kpakpa a anɔkuale ɔ nɛ e hi si sɔkee ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Se ninɛmɛ nɛ a buu mɛ kaa a ngɛ biɛ ɔ, — bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ sa a, pi ye he sane ko, Mawu hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi, — ejakaa imi lɛɛ, ninɛmɛ nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we mi nɔ́ ko ngɔ piɛ we he;

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: se mohu, a na kaa a tu mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ a kpɛti sane kpakpa a fiɛmi ngɔ wo ye dɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a tu nɔ poli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɔ wo Petro dɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsu ni ngɛ Petro mi nɛ e ha e ye bɔfo ngɛ nɔ poli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e tsu ni ngɛ imi hu ye mi ngɛ majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Benɛ a yo dloomi nɛ a kɛ ha mi ɔ, Yakobo kɛ Kefa kɛ Yohane nɛ a buu mɛ kaa titimahi ɔ, kɛ huɛ bɔmi hiɛ ɔ nine sa i kɛ Barnaba dɛ, konɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ waa ya majeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ya nɔ poli ɔmɛ a kpɛti;

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: se ohiafohi kɛkɛ a ke wa kai, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu he mɔde i bɔ kaa ma pee. Paulo kã Kefa hɛ mi ngɛ Antiokia

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Kefa ba Antiokia a, i da e hɛ mi nɛ i kã e hɛ mi, ejakaa e nɔ be mi.

english_verse: He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ejakaa loko ni komɛ maa je Yakobo ngɔ kɛ ba a, e kɛ majeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ ni; se benɛ a ba a, e sã e he si, nɛ e tsɔ e he, ejakaa e ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ je nɔ poli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ gbeye yee.

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yudafohi nɛ piɛ ɔ hu kɛ lɛ pee jamɛ a osato ɔ, nɛ a gbla Barnaba tete ngɔ wo a sato peemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Se benɛ i na kaa a nyɛɛ we tutuutu ngɛ sane kpakpa a mi anɔkuale ɔ nya a, i de Kefa ngɛ mɛ kulaa a hɛ mi ke: “Ke mo nɛ o ji Yuda no ɔ, o peɔ o nihi kaa maje no se pi kaa Yuda no ɔ, mɛni he je o nyɛɛ majeli ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa a pee a nihi kaa Yudafohi ɔ?” Hemi kɛ yemi a kɛ he Yudafohi kɛ majeli a yiwami

english_verse: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
translation_verse: A fɔ wɔ Yudafohi, nɛ wa pi yayami peeli nɛ je majeli ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, ke wɔ nɛ wa hlaa kaa a wo wɔ nguɔ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, a na wɔ kaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu yayami peeli ji wɔ ɔ, blɔɔ lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Kristo fiɔ yayami se lo? Pi ja!

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nihi nɛ i kuɔ pueɔ si ɔ i kpaleɔ maa ekohu ɔ, blɔɔ i tsɔɔ ye he kaa nɔ tɔlɔ ji mi.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa imi lɛɛ i gu mlaa a nɔ kɛ gbo ha mlaa a, konɛ ye hɛ nɛ hi ngmengmle ha Mawu.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: I kua we Mawu dloomi ɔ, ejakaa, ke mlaa nɔ dami guu kɛ baa a, lɛɛ Kristo gbo yaka gu.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Oo, Galatabi nɛ be yi mi! Mɛnɔ gbiɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ ko bu anɔkuale ɔ tue — nihi a hɛ mi nɛ a tɛni Yesu Kristo ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ a sɛu.

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha ma bi nyɛ nɔ́ kake: Mlaa ni tsumihi a mi nyɛ na Mumi ɔ kɛ je, aloo hemi kɛ yemi tue bumi mi?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Anɛ kikɛ nyɛ be yi mi lo? Nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Mumi je sisi ɔ, jehanɛ he lo nyɛɛ kɛ maa gbe nya lo?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Nɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ na nɛ ɔ, yaka gu nyɛ na lo? Ke yaka gu hu po ʼi ɔ,

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: blɔɔ Mawu nɛ kɛ Mumi ɔ kee nyɛ nɛ e tsuɔ he wami nihi ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, mlaa ni tsumihi a mi e tsuɔ ngɛ aloo hemi kɛ yemi tue bumi mi?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith.
translation_verse: A ngma ke: “Abraham he Mawu ye, nɛ a bu enɛ ɔ dami ngɔ ha lɛ.”

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nihi nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, mɛ nɔuu ji Abraham bimɛ.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ ngmami ɔ na momo kaa hemi kɛ yemi mi Mawu maa wo majeli ɔmɛ nguɔ ngɛ he je ɔ, e jaje sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ Abraham ngɔ to kaa: “O mi a maa gbaa majemaje li ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ.”

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ, a gbaa mɛ kɛ Abraham nɛ he ye ɔ.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ je mlaa ni tsumihi a mi ɔ, gbiɛmi ngɛ a nɔ; ejakaa a ngma ke: “A gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hi si ngɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mlaa Womi ɔ mi ɔ nɛ e ye nɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ e ngɛ paa kaa mlaa a mi ɔ, a be nɔ ko nɔ ko nguɔ woe ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, ejakaa dalɔ ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi mi e yi ma na wami ngɛ.

english_verse: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
translation_verse: Se mlaa a, pi hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ e je, se mohu nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ yi ma na wami ngɛ mi.

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Kristo kpɔ wɔ kɛ je mlaa a gbiɛmi ɔ mi, akɛnɛ e plɛ gbiɛmi ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ, ejakaa a ngma ke: “A gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kplaa si ngɛ tso nɔ” ɔ;

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: konɛ Abraham gbaami ɔ nɛ ba maje li ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, nɛ waa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ na Mumi ɔ si womi ɔ. Mlaa a kɛ si womi ɔ

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ ha ma ngɔ nimli a si himi mi nɔ ko kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ nya. Nɔmlɔ si womi tete ɔ, ke a ma nɔ mi ɔ, nɔ ko kua we, nɛ jehanɛ hu nɔ ko piɛ we he nɔ ko.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Abraham ɔ, a tu si womi munyu ɔmɛ ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ e nina a. E de we ke: “Kɛ e nina amɛ,” kaa nɔ nɛ nihi fuu a nɔ ʼi, se mohu kaa nɔ kake nɔ, ke: “Kɛ o nina a,” nɔ nɛ ji Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Se ke gbo si ni ɔ je mlaa a mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ tsa pi si womi ɔ mi nɛ e je mɔ; se Mawu kɛ ke Abraham kɛ gu si womi nɔ.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ mɛni ji mlaa a mɔ? Nɔ tɔmihi a he nɛ a kɛ piɛ he, kɛ maa su be nɛ Abraham nina nɛ a wo si ngɔ ha a maa ba; Hiɔwe bɔfohi a nɔ a gu kɛ wo si kɛ gu mi dalɔ nɔ.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Se mi dalɔ he hia we ha nɔ kake, nɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ kake ʼi. Nɔ́ nɛ mlaa tsuɔ

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Anɛ mlaa a kuɔ Mawu si womi ɔmɛ a nya lo? Dɛbi! Ejakaa e ji a wo mlaa ko nɛ ma nyɛ wami ma ha jinɛ e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa mlaa mi dami ɔ je.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Se mohu ngmami ɔ ngɔ je ɔ kulaa ngɔ wo yayami sisi, konɛ a gu Yesu Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ nɛ a kɛ si womi ɔ nɛ ha nihi nɛ he yeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Se loko hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ba a, a kɛ wɔ wo mlaa sisi, nɛ a nga wa yi ngɔ to hemi kɛ yemi nɛ a ma je kpo ɔ.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mlaa a plɛ wa tsɔselɔ kɛ yaa Kristo ngɔ, konɛ a wo wɔ nguɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Se nɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ba nɛ ɔ, wa be tsɔselɔ ɔ sisi hu.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo ɔ Mawu bimɛ ji nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ;

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: ejakaa nyɛ nihi abɔ nɛ a baptisi nyɛ ngɔ wo Kristo mi ɔ, nyɛ wo Kristo.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Yudano be ɔ, Helano hu bé hu; nyɔguɛ bé ɔ, odehe hu bé hu; nyumu be ɔ, yo hu be hu; ejakaa nyɛ tuso ɔ, nɔ kake ji nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Se ke Kristo nihi ji nyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Abraham nina ji nyɛ, kɛ gbo si ni yeli hulɔ ngɛ si womi ɔ nya.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji, be abɔ nɛ gbo si ni yelɔ ɔ ji bimwɔyo ɔ slɔɔto ko be e kɛ sɔmɔlɔ kpɛti, kpahu lɛ ji ni ɔmɛ tsuo a tsɛ;

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: se e ngɛ nɔ hyɛli kɛ sɔmɔli nikɔtɔmahi a sisi kɛ yaa su be nɛ Tsɛ ɔ to ɔ.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu kɛ̃ wɔ hu, benɛ wa ji bimwɔwi ɔ, a kɛ wɔ wo je nɛ ɔ mi adebɔ mumihi a nyɔguɛ yemi ɔ sisi.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Se benɛ be nɛ a to ɔ su ɔ, Mawu tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e bi ɔ kɛ ba, yo ko ba fɔ lɛ, e ba mlaa sisi,

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: konɛ e ba kpɔ nihi nɛ ngɛ mlaa sisi ɔ, nɛ wa na bi peemi he blɔ.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ bimɛ ji nyɛ he je ɔ, Mawu tsɔ e bi ɔ Mumi ɔ kɛ ba nyɛ tsui mi, nɔ nɛ kpaa ngmlaa ke: “Abba, Tsaatsɛ!”

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o pi sɔmɔlɔ hu, se mohu bi ji mo. Nɛ ke bi ji mo ɔ, lɛɛ Mawu ni yelɔ hu ji mo ngɛ Kristo he. Paulo ye Galatabi ɔmɛ a he kɔmɔ

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Nyɛ buu ligbihi kɛ hlamihi kɛ behi kɛ jehahi a he akɔɔtaa fitso-fitso.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: I ngɛ gbeye yee, kaa nyɛ ma ha ma gbo nyɛ he yaka dengme.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ pee kaa imi, ejakaa imi hu i ngɛ kaa nyɛ. Nyɛ pee we mi yayami ko;

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: se nyɛ le kaa he lo gbedemi mi i je kɛ jaje sane kpakpa a ngɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ kekle ɔ,

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji nya tsɔmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, nyɛ gbi he guɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu nyɛ nyangee we mi; se mohu nyɛ he mi kaa Mawu bɔfo, kaa Kristo Yesu nitsɛ.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ jije nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ ngɛ? Ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ he odase yee kaa, e maa hi jinɛ, nyɛ ko hia nyɛ hɛngmɛhi tete ha mi.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Nɛ i tuɔ anɔkuale tsɔɔ nyɛ he je ɔ, blɔɔ i plɛ nyɛ henyɛlɔ lo?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Pi nyɛ he dengme kpakpa ko nɛ ni kpa amɛ ngɛ gboe nɛ ɔ; se mohu a ngɛ hlae nɛ a tsi nyɛ wa ngɔ blɔ, konɛ nyɛ gbo mɛ mohu a he dengme.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: E sa kaa nyɛ gbo dengme ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ fɛu he daa; nɛ pi benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
translation_verse: Ye bimɛ kpakpahi, i nu kɔɔmi ngɛ nyɛ fɔmi he ekohu kɛ maa su be nɛ a maa bɔ Kristo subai ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: I na nɛ jinɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kasa nya amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsake blɔ nɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tuɔ munyu ngɛ, ejakaa i ngɛ haoe ngɛ nyɛ he! Hagar kɛ Sara kaa nɔhyɛmi nɔ

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Nyɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nyɛɛ hi mlaa sisi ɔ, nyɛ de mi, anɛ nyɛ nui nɔ nɛ mlaa a de ɔ lo?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: A ngma ke Abraham ngɛ bimɛ enyɔ, nɔ kake ɔ, e kɛ sɔmɔlɔyo ɔ lɛ fɔ; nɔ kake hu e kɛ odehe ɔ lɛ fɔ.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ e kɛ sɔmɔlɔyo ɔ fɔ ɔ, a fɔ lɛ ngɛ he lo nya; se nɔ nɛ e kɛ odehe ɔ fɔ ɔ, a fɔ lɛ ngɛ si womi ɔ nya.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a kɛ buu abɛ. Yi nɛ ɔmɛ ji somi enyɔ ɔ nɛ; kake ɔ je Sinai yoku ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi e fɔɔ woɔ; lɛ ji Hagar.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: Hagar ji Sinai yoku ɔ ngɛ Arabia; se e kɛ mwɔnɔmwɔnɔ Yerusalem ɔ tsa we nɔ, ejakaa e kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ji nyɔguɛhi.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Se hiɔwe Yerusalem ɔ ji odehe ɔ nɛ, nɔ nɛ ji wɔ kulaa wa nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa sa ngma ke: “La nyami la, mo yosa nɛ o fɔ we; Nɛ o hwɔ lele kɛ bua jɔmi, mo nɛ o kɔɔ we; Ejakaa nɔ nɛ a kua lɛ ɔ mohu bimɛ maa hiɛ pe nɔ nɛ ngɛ huno ɔ po!”

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, mamimɛ, wɔɔ lɛɛ Si womi ɔ bimɛ ji wɔ kaa Isak.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Se kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ be ɔ mi hu, nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ he lo nya a waa nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ mumi nya a yi mi ɔ, jã nɔuu kɛ̃ e ngɛ mwɔnɔmwɔnɔ hu.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Se kɛ ngmami ɔ de kɛɛ? “Fie sɔmɔlɔyo ɔ kɛ e bi ɔ, ejakaa e sɛ́ kaa nyɔguɛyo ɔ bi ɔ kɛ odehe ɔ bi ɔ nɛ ye gbo si ni ɔ.”

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, wa pi sɔmɔlɔyo ɔ bimɛ, se mohu odehe ɔ bimɛ ji wɔ.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Kristo pee wɔ odehehi, nɛ e ha wa ye wa he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii nɛ nyɛ ko ha a bɔ nyɛ nyɔguɛ yemi pã a hu.

english_verse: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
translation_verse: Oʼɛ, imi Paulo, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ ha a po nyɛ ɔ Kristo he be se nami ko ha nyɛ.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa a wo nyɛ nguɔ ngɛ mlaa mi ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo be sane ko; nyɛ gbee si kɛ je dloomi ɔ mi.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ, Mumi ɔ nɔ wa guu waa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi mlɛɛ dami hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, pi nɔ pomi nɛ nyɛɔ nɔ́ ko peɔ, nɛ pi mɔmlɔtɔ hulɔ, se mohu hemi kɛ yemi nɛ guu suɔmi nɔ tsuɔ ni ɔ ʼi.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ngɛ mɔde bɔe saminya; mɛnɔ po lɛ tsi nyɛ blɔ kaa nyɛ ko bu anɔkuale ɔ tue?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Juɛmi tsakemi nɛ ɔ ɔ, tsa pi Mawu nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ mi nɛ e je.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Ma sasɛ nyafii saa ma mluku ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi, kaa nyɛ be juɛmi kpa ko juɛe, se nɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ puee ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e ji ɔ, e musu maa tloo lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ, mamimɛ, ke nɔ pomi i ngɛ fiee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kɛ mwɔɔ? Ke ja a, lɛɛ seumi tso ɔ he sane ɔ, e pi nya tsɔmi nɔ́ hu.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: Oo, i na jinɛ nihi nɛ woɔ nyɛ yi mi ɔ puɛ̃ loo ta mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he.

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Ejakaa he yemi mi a tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ngɛ, mamimɛ; se nyɛ he yemi ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ ko ha e plɛ he blɔ ha he lo ɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ gu suɔmi mi kɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ he.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mlaa mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ yemi ngɛ munyu kake nɛ ɔ mi ke: “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.”

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ kɔɔ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ plaa nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ ko puɛ nyɛ he! Mumi ɔ kɛ nɔmlɔ su

english_verse: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Se i ke: Ke nyɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ mumi nya a, nyɛ be he lo akɔnɔ ɔmɛ a nya ni pee.

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ he lo ɔ dii se ɔ kɛ mumi ɔ yi, nɛ nihi nɛ mumi ɔ hu dii se ɔ kɛ he lo ɔ yi. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he yi, konɛ nyɛ ko pee nihi nɛ nyɛ suɔ.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Se ke mumi ɔ lɛ kpakpaa nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ be mlaa sisi.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Se he lo ɔ ni tsumi ɔmɛ jee kpo paa, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ ji gba puemi, ajuama bɔmi, mu ni tsumi, ya homi

english_verse: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
translation_verse: wɔ jami, nyuami, nyɛmi, pɛ, hunga jemi, mi mi la womi, ngmlaa kpami, atua tsɔmi, mi gbami, hɛ tsumi,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: da demi, fiɛmi yaya kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛkaa enɛ ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ i de nyɛ ngɔ to, kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momoɔ, ke: nihi nɛ peɔ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful,
translation_verse: Se Mumi ɔ yiblii ji suɔmi, bua jɔmi, he jɔmi, tsui si tomi, mi mi himi, kpakpa peemi, hemi kɛ yemi,

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: he si bami, hɛ si kami; enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ mlaa ko gui.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ ji Kristo Yesu nihi ɔ, a sɛu he lo ɔ kɛ e he numi nihi kɛ e kɔnɔ ɔmɛ kulaa.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Ke wa hɛ ngɛ ngmengmle ngɛ Mumi ɔ mi ɔ, nya ha waa nyɛɛ ngɛ Mumi ɔ nya hulɔ.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Wa hɛ ko kɔ yakayaka hɛ mi nyami nɔ, nɛ wa ko wo wa sibi a muklii mi la nɛ wa he ba tsɛ̃ wa sibi.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, ke tlukaa nɛ nɔ ko tɔ ɔ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ji mumi mi nimli ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ dla jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ekohu ngɛ mi mi jɔmi mumi mi; nɛ o le o he nɔ hyemi konɛ mo hu a ko ka mo.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tlomi ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kpee nyɛ he kɛ tloo, nɛ lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa ye Kristo mlaa a nɔ.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke e peɔ nɔ ko kaa nɔ ko ji lɛ nɛ e pi nɔ ko ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he e ngɛ sisie.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ka lɛ nitsɛ e ni tsumi nɛ e hyɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ loko e maa na nɔ́ ko ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi nɛ e fia ngɔ fɔ nɔ, se pi nɔ kpa nɔ́ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa tloo lɛ nitsɛ e tlomi.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ a ngɛ lɛ Mawu munyu ɔ tsɔɔe ɔ, e kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ dla ni kpakpahi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko mlɔɔ nyɛ he: Mawu ɔ, a yi e he fɛu yaka. Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ duɔ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu e ma kpa hulɔ.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ pɔ nɛ tɔ nyɛ kɛ kpakpa peemi, ejakaa ke wa nine mi wui nyu ɔ, wa ma kpa hulɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ womi sɔuu nɛ i kɛ imi nitsɛ ye nine ngma nyɛ ngɛ ningma nguahi a mi.

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, mɛ lɛ a nyɛɛ nyɛ nɔ kaa a po nyɛ, benɛ pee nɛ a ko wa mɛ yi mi ngɛ Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ he.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ nitsɛmɛ tete yi mlaa a nɔ; se mohu a ngɛ hlae nɛ a po nyɛ, konɛ a fia ngɔ fɔ nyɛ he lo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ e ya je ngɛ se lokoo kaa ma fia ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ ko nɔ kaa ja wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu nɔ a gu kɛ sɛu je ɔ ha mi, nɛ imi hu a sɛu mi ha je ɔ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo mi ɔ, nɔ pomi pi nɔ́ ko, nɛ mɔmlɔtɔ hu pi nɔ́ ko, se mohu bɔmi he kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔ nya a, he jɔmi kɛ mɔbɔnami nɛ ba mɛ kɛ Mawu webi kulaa a nɔ!

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nɔ ko ko doo ye nya hu; ejakaa i hɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu plaami okadi ɔmɛ ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ mumi ɔ nɛ hi si, mamimɛ! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Paulo, nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, ngma ya ha ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ Kristo Yesu nɔ yeɔ ɔ:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! Mumi mi gbaami ngɛ Kristo mi

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: A gbaa Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ kɛ mumi mi gbaami tsuaa mumi mi gbaami gbaa wɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nihi a mi ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ.

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: E hla wɔ ngɛ Kristo mi loko a to je ɔ sisi, konɛ waa pee klɔuklɔu nɛ piami ko ko hi wa he ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: E je wɔ ngɛ suɔmi mi ngɔ to ha e he nɛ waa pee e bimɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo he, kaa bɔ nɛ sa e hɛ mi ngɛ e suɔmi nya a,

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: konɛ a kɛ je e dloomi hɛ mi nyami ɔ yi, nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ dloo wɔ ngɛ nɔ nɛ a suɔ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Christ sacrificed his life's blood to set us free, which means our sins are now forgiven. Christ did this because of God's gift of undeserved grace to us. God has great wisdom and understanding,
translation_verse: nɔ́ nɛ e ha kɛ be nɔ ha wɔ ngɛ ni lemi kɛ nɔ sisi numi kulaa mi.

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: E ha wa le e yi mi tomi ɔ mi laami sane nɛ e to kaa e maa gbe nya ngɛ Kristo mi,

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: ha be ɔmɛ a yinɔ ɔ blɔ nya tomi, konɛ e ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ to yi kake sisi ngɛ Kristo mi, nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ke nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kulaa.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: benɛ pee nɛ wɔ nihi nɛ wa sɛ hlami ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Kristo nɔ ɔ, wa plɛ e he mi nyami ɔ yi jemi.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Kristo ɔ nɔuu nɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ, benɛ nyɛ nu anɔkuale munyu ɔ nɛ ji nyɛ yi wami hemi ɔ he sane kpakpa a; lɛ nɔuu e mi a kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ a wo he si ɔ sɔu nyɛ nya ngɛ benɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ,

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ ji wa gbo si ni ɔmɛ a yi ba pomi nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ kpɔ e nihi nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e ni ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ je e hɛ mi nyami ɔ yi. Paulo pɛɛ kpami

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: i jɔɔ we si nami ngɛ nyɛ he, se i kaii nyɛ ngɛ ye pɛɛ kpamihi a mi.

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: I kpaa pɛɛ konɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Mawu nɛ ji hɛ mi nyami Tsɛ ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ ni lemi kɛ nɔ kpo jemi mumi ngɛ lemi nɛ nyɛ maa le lɛ saminya a mi,

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
