translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ mi hɛngmɛ ɔ nɛ bli, konɛ nyɛɛ le nɔ nɛ ji e tsɛmi ɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ, kɛ e weye ni ɔ hiɛmi ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi,

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji e he wami ɔ klemi nɛ be nɔ babauu ha wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ ngɛ e nyɛmi ɔ he wami ni tsumi ɔ nya,

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: nɔ́ nɛ e tsu ngɛ Kristo mi benɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje nɛ e kɛ lɛ hi e hiɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nihi a mi,

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: ngɛ nɔkɔtɔma yemi kɛ he blɔ kɛ he wami kɛ nɔ yemi tsuo kɛ biɛ tsuaa biɛ nɛ a wo, pi ngɛ be nɛ ɔ mi kɛkɛ, se be nɛ maa ba a mi hulɔ ɔ;

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ to Kristo nane si, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to nihi kulaa yi ngɔ ha asafo ɔ.

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: Asafo ɔ ji Kristo nɔmlɔ tso kɛ nɔ nɛ woɔ nihi tsuo tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ nihi kulaa mi ɔ.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Sa a, nyɛ ji ni gbogboehi ngɛ tue gbomi kɛ yayamihi a mi.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi kɔɔhiɔ mi he wami ɔ nɔ yelɔ, nɛ ji mumi nɛ tsuɔ ni mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ngɛ tuegbenɔ bihi a mi ɔ su ɔ nya;

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a mi wɔ tsuo hu wa ba wa je mi ngɛ sa ngɛ wa he lo akɔnɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ wa tsu nihi nɛ he lo kɛ juɛmi suɔ ɔ, nɛ wa ji Mawu muklii mi fumi bimɛ ngɛ wa fɔmi su ɔ nya kaa nihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: nɛ wɔ nɛ wa ji ni gbogboehi ngɛ tuegbenɔ mi ɔ, e tsɛ̃ɛ waa kɛ Kristo tsuo hɛ; dloomi a kɛ he nyɛ yi wami!

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: E tle waa kɛ lɛ si, nɛ e ngɔ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo ngɔ hi hiɔwe nihi a mi ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi,

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: konɛ be nɛ maa ba a mi ɔ, e je lɛ nitsɛ e dloomi ɔ hiɛmi nɛ be nɔ ɔ kpo, kɛ e mi mi himi nɛ e ngɛ ha wɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Ejakaa dloomi a kɛ he nyɛ yi wami kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ, nɛ enɛ ɔ lɛɛ, pi nyɛ mi nɛ e je, Mawu nɔke nɔ ʼi,

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: pi ni tsumihi a mi nɛ e je, konɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko fia.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Mawu nine nya ni tsumi nihi ji wɔ, a bɔ wɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi kɛ ha ni tsumi kpakpahi nɛ Mawu dla ngɔ to konɛ waa nyɛɛ ngɛ mi ɔ. Kakepeemi ngɛ Kristo mi

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kai kaa nyɛ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ ji wɔ jali ngɛ he lo blɔfami nɛ nihi nɛ a po mɛ ngɛ he lo mi ɔ tsɛɛ nyɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ɔ,

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ nyɛ be Kristo, nɛ nyɛ ji ni kpahi ngɛ Israel kɛ nibwɔhi ngɛ si womi somi ɔmɛ a blɔfami hulɔ; nyɛ be hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko, nɛ nyɛ be Mawu tete ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ, Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, nyɛ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ lokoo ɔ, nyɛ gu Kristo muɔ ɔ nɔ hɛ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Ejakaa lɛ ji wa he jɔmi, nɔ nɛ ngɔ wɔ majeli kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kulaa ngɔ pee kake, nɛ e ku gli piɛ nɛ ngɛ kpɛti nɛ ji ninye ɔ,

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he lo gu Mlaa a nɛ ngɛ kita amɛ a mi ɔ, konɛ e kɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ bɔ nɔmlɔ he kake ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi nɛ e ha he jɔmi nɛ ba,

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: nɛ e gu sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ kɛ dla mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kulaa a kɛ Mawu kpɛti ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake mi, nɛ e gbe ninye ɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: E ba ba jaje he jɔmi sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ lokoo ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ hɛ mɛ kɛ ba a hulɔ;

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: ejakaa e nɔ wɔ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kulaa guu kɛ naa blɔ ngɛ mumi kake mi kɛ yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ, nyɛ pi nibwɔhi kɛ ni kpahi hu, se mohu nyɛ ji ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a huɛmɛ ma mi bi kɛ Mawu we bi

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: nɛ a fia nyɛ ngɔ ma bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a sisi tomi ɔ nɛ e kɔ nya tɛ ji Kristo Yesu ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ tsɛ̃ tsu mluku ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo mi pee kake, nɛ e ngɛ klee ngɛ sɔlemi tsu klɔuklɔu pee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi,

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ mi nɛ a fia nyɛ hu ngɔ wo ngɔ pee Mawu sihi he ngɛ Mumi ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Paulo, nɛ ji Kristo Yesu pa mi no ha nyɛ maje li a bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ,

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: eko ɔ nyɛ maa nu Mawu dloomi nɛ a ngɔ ha mi ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ blɔ nya tomi ɔ he,

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: kaa kpo jemi nɔ Mawu gu kɛ ha i kɛ le laami sane ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ i ngma nyɛ bɔɔ ko momo ɔ,

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: nɔ́ nɛ ke nyɛ kane ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ nyɛ kɛ na bɔ nɛ i nu Kristo laami sane ɔ sisi ha.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: kaa maje li a bimɛ ɔmɛ hu ji ni yeli ɔmɛ ekomɛ, kɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ni ɔmɛ ekomɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a wo mɛ si ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ hu ekomɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a he.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ he sɔmɔlɔ ji mi ngɛ Mawu dloomi nike nihi nɛ a gu e he wami ni tsumi nɔ ngɔ ha mi ɔ nya.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Imi nɛ i ji nɔ wayo pe he tsɔli ɔmɛ kulaa a, a ngɔ kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi, kaa ma jaje Kristo nihiɛmi nɛ a be sisi nyɛe maa na kɛ gbe nya a he sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ maje li ɔmɛ,

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: nɛ ma ha nihi kulaa a hɛ mi nɛ tsɔ mɛ nɛ a le nɔ́ nɛ ji laami sane nɛ a ngɔ laa ngɛ Mawu nɔ nɛ bɔ nihi kulaa a blɔ nya tomi ɔ mi,

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: konɛ jehanɛ a gu asafo ɔ nɔ nɛ a ha nikɔtɔmahi kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ he blɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nihi a mi ɔ nɛ a le Mawu ni lemi nɛ hiɛ babauu ɔ,

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: ngɛ neneene yi mi nɛ e to ngɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, mi ɔ nya,

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi wa gu kɛ na kã kɛ he blɔ ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi ɔ.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae, konɛ nyɛ tsui ko po ngɛ ye nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nae ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ he, ejakaa nyɛ hɛ mi nyami ʼi. Kristo suɔmi

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i kplaa si haa Tsɛ ɔ,

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: nɔ mi nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ naa e biɛ nitsɛ ɔ,

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: konɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi nyɛmi hiɛmi ɔ nya a, e ha nyɛɛ gu e Mumi ɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ he nɛ wa kpitikplii ngɛ nyɛ mi nɔmlɔ ɔ blɔfami,

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: nɛ a gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ nɛ Kristo nɛ hi si ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi nɛ nyɛ sipoku nɛ pi si nɛ nyɛɛ ma si gbugbuugbu ngɛ suɔmi mi,

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛ na he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ yɔse nɔ́ nɛ ji blimi kɛ kami kɛ mi kuɔmi kɛ hiɔwe yami ɔ,

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ le Kristo suɔmi nɛ pa ni lemi tsuo ɔ, konɛ Mawu himi kɛ si pimi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ tsuo tɔtɔɔtɔ.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: lɛ a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha ngɛ asafo nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ngɛ yi nɔhi kulaa mi kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene! Amen.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Imi nɛ i ji pa mi no ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae kaa nyɛɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nɛ sa tsɛmi nɛ a kɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: ngɛ he si bami kɛ humi peemi tsuo mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tsui si tomi nɛ suɔ nyɛ he,

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ to mumi kake peemi ɔ ngɛ he jɔmi kpa nɛ fi nyɛ ɔ mi,

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: kaa nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ mumi kake, kaa bɔ nɔuu nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ hulɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsɛmi hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kake ɔ mi ɔ:

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ kake, hemi kɛ yemi kake, baptisimi kake,

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Mawu kɛ nihi kulaa a Tsɛ kake nɛ ngɛ nihi kulaa nɔ, nɛ e guu nihi tsuo mi nɛ e ngɛ nihi tsuo mi ɔ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Ngmami ɔ ke: “E kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya Nɛ e ngɔ nyɔguɛhi fuu ngɔ piɛ e he, Nɛ e kɛ nike nihi ha nimli.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Se nɛ a ke “E kuɔ” ɔ, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ? E sisi ji e kple si kɛ ya zugba a sisi ni ɔmɛ a mi kekle.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kple si ɔ, lɛ nɔuu hu ji nɔ nɛ kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwehi kulaa a yi mi, konɛ e hyi je ɔ kulaa tɔtɔɔtɔ.

english_verse: Christ chose some of us to be apostles, prophets, missionaries, pastors, and teachers,
translation_verse: Nɛ lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ha ni komɛ plɛ bɔfohi, ni komɛ gbali, ni komɛ hu sane kpakpa fiɛli, nɛ ni komɛhu nɔ hyɛli kɛ tsɔɔli,

english_verse: so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong.
translation_verse: konɛ a kɛ gla he tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ ha sɔmɔmi ni tsumi ɔ, kɛ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ fiami,

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: kɛ maa su be nɛ wɔ kulaa wa maa su Mawu Bi ɔ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ e he ni lemi kake peemi ɔ he nɛ waa pee nyumu nɛ su kɛ pi si ngɛ Kristo klemi muzaamu ɔ susumi nya;

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: konɛ wa ko ya nɔ nɛ waa pee bimwɔwi nɛ tsɔɔmi kɔɔhiɔ tsuaa tsɔɔmi kɔɔhiɔ mimiɛɛ mɛ, nɛ a kpakaa mɛ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ nimli a ga yaya tomi mi, ngɛ sisimi ga kɛ kutupɔ nya.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Se mohu waa pee anɔkualetsɛmɛ ngɛ suɔmi mi, nɛ waa wa ngɛ nihi kulaa blɔfami, ngɛ lɛ Kristo ɔ nɔuu nɛ ji yi ɔ he;

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: lɛ e mi nɛ nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ tsuo nuu e he siɔ nɔ, nɛ kpɔ nya tsuaa kpɔ nya tsuɔ ni kaa bɔ nɛ a to ha lɛ ɔ, nɛ e haa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ waa nɛ e heɔ si ngɛ suɔmi mi. Wami he ngɛ Kristo mi

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: ejakaa a juɛmi ɔ mi wo diblii, nɛ nibwɔhi ji mɛ ngɛ wami nɛ Mawu haa a blɔfami, akɛnɛ nɔ lemi bɔ́ mɛ nɛ a tsui hu ti ɔ.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: ke e ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ nu e he, nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ e mi hulɔ, bɔ nɛ ji anɔkuale ngɛ Yesu mi ɔ,

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: nyɛ sake nyɛ sa je mi bami ɔ nya nɔmlɔ momo nɛ puɛ ngɛ sisimi se dimi ɔmɛ a nya a ngɔ fɔ he,

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ plɛ nimli hehi ngɛ nyɛ juɛmi kɛ mumi mi,

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ wo nɔmlɔ he nɛ a bɔ ngɛ Mawu subai nɔ ngɛ anɔkuale dami kɛ he tsɔmi mi ɔ.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ sake lakpa ngɔ fɔ he nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi nɛ tu anɔkuale, ejakaa nɔmlɔ tso kake he nihi ji wɔ.

english_verse: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
translation_verse: Nyɛ muklii mi nɛ fu, se nyɛ ko pee yayami; pu ko nɔ si ngɛ nyɛ mi mi fumi ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: nɛ jehanɛ hu, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ko fɔ si ha Abosiami.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Juɔ ɔ, e ko ju hu, se mohu e bɔ mɔde nɛ e kɛ e ninehi nɛ tsu ni tsumi kpakpa, konɛ e na nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ha nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Munyu yaya ko nɛ ko je nyɛ nya kulaa; se mohu munyu nɛ hi nɛ e hia, konɛ e ha nɔ nane nɛ pi si, konɛ a kɛ dloo nihi nɛ nuɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ ko pee Mawu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔdɔ nɔ́, nɔ mi nɛ pa sɔu nyɛ nya ngɛ ngɔ to kpɔmi ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha mi mi doomi kɛ mi mi la kɛ muklii mi fumi kɛ huhui kɛ musu bɔmi kulaa se nɛ po ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, kɛ yayami tsuaa yayami.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee Mawu kaseli kaa bimɛ nɛ e suɔ,

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ suɔmi mi kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu suɔ wɔ nɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he kaa nɔ́ke nɔ́ kɛ bɔ nɛ he via nɛ a kɛ ha Mawu.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Se ajuama bɔmi kɛ mu ni tsumi tsuo loo he tsemi ɔ, a ko wo ta tete ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔuhi,

english_verse: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
translation_verse: kɛ zo ni tsumi kɛ yakayaka munyu kɛ fɛu yemi hu nɛ sɛ́ ɔ; se mohu sina.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ le enɛ ɔ momo kaa, ajuama bɔlɔ ko ajuama bɔlɔ ko loo mu ni tsulɔ ko loo hɛ tsulɔ ko nɛ ji wɔ jalɔ be blɔ nya ngɛ Kristo kɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko kɛ munyu gu nɛ mlɔɔ nyɛ; ejakaa jamɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ Mawu muklii mi fumi baa tuegbenɔ bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ko bɔ a he.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Ejakaa sa a diblii ji nyɛ, se jahanɛ ɔ nyɛ plɛ la ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi. Lɛɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ kaa la bimɛ mɔ.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Ejakaa la a yiblii ji mi mi himi kɛ dami kɛ anɔkuale tsuo.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ka nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hyɛ kaa e sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi lo.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ diblii ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ wui yiblii ɔ ko bɔ, se mohu nyɛ je mɛ si.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ a juɔ si peɔ ɔ ngɛ zo kaa a maa wo ta tete.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he nɛ a de ke: “O hɛ nɛ tsɛ, mo nɔ nɛ o ngɛ mahɛ hwɔe ɔ, Nɛ o te si kɛ je gbeje, Nɛ Kristo maa tso ha mo” ɔ, nɛ!

english_verse: These are evil times, so make every minute count.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ tsuɔ a deka he ni, ejakaa yi nɔ nɛ ɔ, yi nɔ yaya ʼi.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko de da, nɔ́ mi nɛ sakasaka peemi ngɛ ɔ, se mohu nyɛ hyi tɔ kɛ Mumi ɔ.

english_verse: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he nɛ tu munyu ngɛ saku fiami kɛ yi jemi lahi kɛ mumi mi lahi a mi; nyɛ la nɛ nyɛɛ fia saku ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ na Mawu kɛ Tsɛ ɔ si daa ngɛ nihi kulaa he ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi. Yigbayi kɛ a hunomɛ

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yigbayi ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hunomɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ peɔ ngɔ haa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Ejakaa huno ɔ ji yo ɔ yi, kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ji asafo ɔ yi, nɛ lɛ nɔuu ji nɔmlɔ tso ɔ yi wami helɔ ɔ.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Nyɛ, hunomɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ yihi, kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu suɔ asafo ɔ nɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ e he ɔ,

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: konɛ e kɛ nyu he dumi ɔ nɛ tsukɔ e he ngɛ munyu mi nɛ e ha e pee klɔuklɔu,

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: konɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ da si ha lɛ nitsɛ e he kaa hɛ mi nyami asafo nɛ he be piami ko loo hɛ mi kuami ko loo jamɛ a nɔ́ ko, se mohu e pee klɔuklɔu nɛ piami ko ko hi e he.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Jã sa kaa hunomɛ hu nɛ suɔ a yihi kaa bɔ nɛ a suɔ mɛ nitsɛ a nɔmlɔ tsohi. Nɔ nɛ suɔ e yo ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he e suɔ.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ ko nyɛ́ lɛ nitsɛ e he lo hyɛ, se mohu e lɛɛ lɛ, nɛ e hɛɛ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛɛ asafo ɔ;

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he nɛ nyumu ma si e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e maa mɛtɛ e yo he, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kulaa a ma plɛ he lo kake.

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a laami sane nɛ ɔ mi jiɔ, se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee kɛ ngɛ Kristo kɛ asafo ɔ he toe.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: E sa kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ e yo ja, kaa lɛ nitsɛ e he, konɛ yo ɔ hu nɛ bu e huno ɔ.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ fɔli ɔmɛ tue ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi; ejakaa enɛ ɔ da.

english_verse: and you will have a long and happy life.”
translation_verse: “Konɛ e hi ha mo, nɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.”

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a mi mi la, se mohu nyɛɛ lɛ mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi kɛ ga womi mi. Sɔmɔli kɛ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ he lo blɔfami nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tue kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ he domi ngɛ tsui klɔu peemi mi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ peɔ ngɔ haa Kristo ɔ;

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: pi kɛ hɛ mi hɛ mi sɔmɔmi kaa nihi nɛ hlaa nimli a hɛ mi nyami, se mohu kaa Kristo tsɔli nɛ jee a tsui mi peɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ni,

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi sɔmɔɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ʼi, se tsa pi nimli,

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ kai kaa nɔ́ ko kpakpa nɛ mo nɔ o peɔ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu he hiɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa wo mo, sɔmɔlɔ jio, odehe jio.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee mɛ ja nɔuu, nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ mɛ haihai hɛɛmi, nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ kulaa ngɛ nyɔmtsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi. Mawu ta hwumi ni ɔmɛ kulaa

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ he nɛ wa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e he wami nyɛmi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ wo Mawu ta hwumi ni ɔmɛ kulaa, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ Abosiami ga tsɔmi ɔmɛ a nya nɛ nyɛɛ da.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Ejakaa tsa pi he lo kɛ muɔ nɛ waa kɛ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ, se mohu waa kɛ nɔkɔtɔma yemihi kɛ he blɔhi kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ yemihi nɛ ngɛ mwɔnɔmwɔnɔ diblii ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ mumi yayami asafo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe nihi a mi ɔ.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ Mawu ta hwumi ni ɔmɛ kulaa mi konɛ nyɛ nyɛ ligbi yaya a nya nɛ nyɛɛ da, nɛ benɛ nyɛ gbe kulaa nya a nɛ nyɛ nyɛ si nɛ nyɛɛ da.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ da si, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ anɔkuale nɛ fi nyɛ mlɛ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ wo dami dama a,

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ he jɔmi sane kpakpa a fiɛmi he nyami nɛ wo nyɛ nane.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Lɛ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi tsɛi ɔ mi, nɔ nɛ nyɛ ma kɛ nyɛ nɔ yayami kɛɛ mi bihi nɛ tsoo ɔ kulaa gbe ɔ.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɛ yi wami hemi dade pɛɛ ɔ hu nyɛ bu kɛ mumi mi klaate nɛ ji Mawu munyu ɔ;

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami tsuo sɔle daa ha klɔuklɔubi ɔmɛ kulaa

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: kɛ imi hulɔ, konɛ, ke i bli ye nya a, a ha mi munyu nɛ ma kɛ ka nɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a mi laami sane ɔ,

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: nɔ he nɛ i ngɛ bɔfo yee ngɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ mi nɛ ɔ, konɛ ma tu munyu kɛ ka ngɛ mi, bɔ nɛ sa kaa ma tu ɔ. Nyagbe sɛyemi

english_verse: I want you to know how I am getting along and what I am doing. This is why I am sending Tychicus to you. He is a dear friend, as well as a faithful servant of the Lord. He will tell you how I am doing, and he will cheer you up.
translation_verse: ejakaa enɛ ɔ nɔuu he nɛ i tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ, benɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ha, nɛ e wo nyɛ bua.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Hejɔmi, kɛ suɔmi kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ!

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Dloomi nɛ je wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ suɔ le kɛ pii si ɔ nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Timoteo, Yesu Kristo sɔmɔli ɔmɛ, ngma ya ha ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi ngɛ Filipi kɛ a nɔ hyɛli kɛ a sɔmɔli ɔmɛ kulaa:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! Paulo pɛɛ kpami kɛ ha e womi ɔ kaneli

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: I naa ye Mawu ɔ si be tsuaa be nɛ e kaii nyɛ,

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: ngɛ ye daa pɛɛ kpamihi tsuo nɛ i kpaa ngɔ haa nyɛ kulaa a mi, nɛ i kɛ bua jɔmi kpaa pɛɛ

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: ngɛ wa he nɛ nyɛ piɛɔ ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi mi kɛ je kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ kɛ ba su amlɔ nɛ ɔ he;

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ enɛ ɔ nɔuu nɔ, kaa nɔ nɛ bɔni ni tsumi kpakpa ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e ma tsa nɔ kɛ maa su e maa gbe nya ngɛ Yesu Kristo ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: E sa kaa ma susu enɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ kulaa nyɛ he, ejakaa i suɔ nyɛ, ejakaa benɛ a wo mi tsu mi ngɛ sane kpakpa a he ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ tsuo na Mawu dloomi ɔ eko.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Mawu ji ye dase kaa ye hɛ jaa ngɛ nyɛ kulaa nyɛ he ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi mi sami ɔ nya.

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛɛ hi klɔuu nɛ piami ko ko hi nyɛ blɔfami kɛ yaa su Kristo ligbi ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: nɛ dami yiblii nɛ a woɔ ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ ha Mawu hɛ mi nyami womi kɛ yi jemi. Kristo ji wami

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le kaa sanehi nɛ ba ye nɔ ɔ ha sane kpakpa a ya nɔ mohu,

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: nɛ e ha ye tsu mi womi ngɛ Pretorio ɔ mi ngɛ Kristo he ɔ pee nɔ́ nɛ nihi kulaa le.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ lɛɛ ninye kɛ hluɛnu he a fiɛɔ Kristo ɔ nɛ; se ni komɛ hu kɛ juɛmi kpakpa fiɛɔ.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ jee suɔmi mi kɛ fiɛɔ, ejakaa a le kaa sane kpakpa a he fami he je nɛ i fɔɔ si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ;

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: se ni kpa komɛ ɔ, hluɛnu mi a jee kɛ fiɛɔ Kristo, nɛ pi fiɛmi nitsɛ ʼi, se mohu a juɛmi ji kaa a kɛ dengme maa piɛ ye tsu mi womi ɔ he.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mɛni? Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, lakpa tomi nya jio, anɔkuale nya jio, Kristo kɛ̃ a ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ; nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ngɛ bua jɔmi. Nɛ jehanɛ hu ma na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i le kaa enɛ ɔ ma plɛ ye yi wami hemi ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ Yesu Kristo Mumi ɔ yemi kɛ buami nya,

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: ngɛ ye blɔ hyemi kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ nya, kaa zo be mi gbee ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko mi, se mohu, bɔ nɛ a peɔ daa a, jã jehanɛ hu a kɛ kã tsuo maa wo Kristo hɛ mi nyami ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso mi, ngɛ wami mi jio, gbenɔ mi jio.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Ejakaa imi lɛɛ Kristo ji ye wami, nɛ gbenɔ ɔ ye se nami ʼi.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Se ke he lo mi wami nɛ ɔ nɔuu haa ye ni tsumi woɔ yiblii ɔ, lɛɛ i li e mi nɔ́ nɛ ma ngɔ;

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: i ngɛ haoe ngɛ ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a he: I ngɛ hlae nɛ ma je je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ i kɛ Kristo ya hi si, ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔ hi hluu.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: I ngɛ enɛ ɔ nɔ mi mami kaa i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si nɛ ma piɛ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ ya hɛ mi, konɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ fu, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi ngɛ mi,

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛ mimifliimi ɔ nɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, ngɛ ye he, ngɛ kpe nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa kpe ekohu ɔ he.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma sane blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi sbɔ nɛ sa Kristo sane kpakpa a kɛkɛ, konɛ, ke i ba ba na nyɛ jio, i kɛ nyɛ be jio, ma nu nyɛ he kaa nyɛ daa si ngɛ mumi kake mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi kake ngɛ sane kpakpa a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he plee.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ ko ha nɛ henyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ wo nyɛ he gbeye ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko mi, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu ji hɛ mi kpatami okadi ha mɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, e ji yi wami hemi okadi ha nyɛ, nɛ enɛ ɔ je Mawu dɛ mi.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ a dloo nyɛ ngɛ Kristo he, pi ngɛ e nɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi kɛkɛ, se mohu kaa nyɛ na nɔ ngɛ e he hulɔ,

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: nɛ jamɛ a pleemi kake ɔ nɔuu nɛ nyɛ na ngɛ ye he nɛ jehanɛ hu nyɛ nuɔ ngɛ ye he ɔ mi i ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Kristo mi munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi ko ngɛ ke suɔmi bua womi ko ngɛ, ke mumi mi huɛ bɔmi ko ngɛ, ke muklii mi sami kɛ mɔbɔ nami ko ngɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: nyɛ ha ye bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hyi tɔ, kaa nyɛ hɛɛ susumi kake, nyɛ hɛɛ suɔmi kake, klaa kake, juɛmi kake.

english_verse: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ngmɛ mi gbami loo yaka hɛ mi nyami hlami blɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ kɛ he si bami juɛmi nɛ bu nyɛ sibi pe nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he;

english_verse: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
translation_verse: nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ko fo e nɔ mi, se e fo e nyɛmi nɔ mi.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Juɛmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ pee nyɛ hu nyɛ juɛmi,

english_verse: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
translation_verse: E ba e he si nɛ e bu tue kɛ ya gbenɔ mi, kɛ ya sɛumi tso nɔ gbenɔ mi tete.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ Mawu wo e nɔ gojoo nɛ e dloo lɛ biɛ nɛ pa biɛ tsuaa biɛ,

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: konɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a sisi ɔ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nakutso nɛ kpla si ha Yesu biɛ ɔ,

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: nɛ lilɛ tsuaa lilɛ nɛ jaje paa ke Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wo Tsɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami. Lakpɛmi ngɛ je ɔ mi

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ buɔ tue daa nɛ ɔ, pi benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu titli ɔ, jehanɛ nɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ɔ hu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ he domi nɛ tsu nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ yi wami hemi ɔ he ni,

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: ejakaa suɔmi nɛ a maa suɔ jio, peemi nɛ a maa pee jio, Mawu ji nɔ nɛ tsuɔ lɛ tsuo ngɛ nyɛ mi ngɛ e suɔmi nya.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛ he ko hi piami, nɛ nyɛɛ pee he tsɔli, Mawu bimɛ nɛ a he be piami ko ngɛ yi nɔ kpɛkpɛɛ nɛ be e jebo nɔ nɛ ɔ mi, nihi a kpɛti nɛ nyɛ tsoo kaa kane ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi,

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ wami munyu ɔ mi, konɛ e plɛ fiami nɔ ha mi ngɛ Kristo ligbi ɔ nɔ, kaa ye fotumi ɔ pee we yaka, nɛ ye dengme gbomi ɔ hu pee we gu.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Se ke a plɛ ye muɔ ngɔ pue nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi bɔ kɛ jami ɔ nɔ po ɔ, i ngɛ he tsui nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tsuo ma na bua jɔmi;

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: ja nɔuu kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ na bua jɔmi. Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ ngɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu mi kaa e be kɛe nɛ ma tsɔ Timoteo kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, konɛ ke i nu bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ imi hu ma na tsui.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i be nɔ ko nɛ e juɛmi kɛ ye juɛmi sɔ nɛ nyɛ he sane dɔɔ lɛ nitsɛnitsɛ kaa lɛ;

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: ejakaa ni ɔmɛ kulaa a, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nihi a he a pleɔ, se pi Kristo Yesu nihi.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ le e ni tsumi, kaa e kɛ mi sɔmɔɔ ngɛ sane kpakpa a he kaa bi kɛ e tsɛ.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa ke i na ye sane ɔ nya pɛ ɔ, ma tsɔ lɛ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Se ye hɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ, kaa imi nitsɛ hu, e be kɛe nɛ ma ba.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ, i susu kaa e hia kaa ma tsɔ wa nyɛmi Epafrodito, nɛ ji ye huɛ ni tsulɔ kɛ ta bulɔ kɛ nyɛ tsɔlɔ kɛ ye hia a he sɔmɔlɔ ɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ,

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: ejakaa e hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he, nɛ akɛnɛ nyɛ nu kaa e be he wami he je ɔ, e ngɛ haoe.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa e nu hiɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ piɛ bɔɔ nɛ e ko gbo, se kɛ ɔ Mawu na lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ pi lɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu imi hu, konɛ ma ko ye kɔmɔ ngɔ to kɔmɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he titli nɛ i bɔ mɔde tsɔ lɛ ɔ nɛ, konɛ ke nyɛ na lɛ ekohu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi nɛ imi hu ma ko ye kɔmɔ tsɔ.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi, kɛ bua jɔmi babauu, nɛ nyɛɛ bu kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kaa nihi nɛ sa bumi;

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: ejakaa Kristo ni tsumi ɔ he ɔ, e su gbenɔ he tataata, nɛ e sake e wami ngɔ fɔ he, konɛ e kɛ gbe nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ha nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma sɔmɔ mi ɔ nya.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi! Pɔ tɔɛ ye he kaa ma ngma nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ekohu, ejakaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ e haa nyɛ fiɔɔ si.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ gbe ɔmɛ a he. Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ ni tsuli yaya amɛ a he, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ nɔ pomi he!

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Ejakaa wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa jaa Mawu ngɛ mumi nya, nɛ waa kɛ wa hɛ fɔɛ he lo nɔ, se Kristo Yesu nɔ mohu wa fiaa ngɔ fɔɔ ɔ, wɔ mohu ji ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ligbi nɛ ji ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ nɔ a po mi, Israel fɔfɔɛ kɛ Benyamin wetso ɔ mi no ji mi, Hebri no mi Hebri no, nɛ Mlaa a nya a Farisifo no hulɔ,

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: mɔde bɔmi blɔfami ɔ, asafo ɔ yi mi walɔ ji mi, nɛ dami ngɛ Mlaa a nya a, piami ko be ye he.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ji senami ha mi sa a, i bu kɔlɔ ɔmɛ kaa nihi nɛ laa ngɛ Kristo he.

english_verse: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
translation_verse: Niinɛ kaa i buu lɛ tsuo kaa nihi nɛ laa ngɛ Kristo Yesu, ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, he ni lemi nɛ pe kulaa a he, lɛ e he nɛ nihi kulaa bɔ mi, nɛ i buu mɛ kaa kuku nɔ nihi, konɛ Kristo mohu nɛ pee ye nɔ,

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: nɛ a na mi ngɛ e mi kaa i be imi nitsɛ ye dami nɛ je Mlaa mi, se mohu nɔ́ nɛ gu Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ nɛ ji dami nɛ je Mawu dɛ mi ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nya a i ngɛ,

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: nɛ ma le lɛ kɛ e si temi ɔ he wami ɔ kɛ e manehlu ɔmɛ a mi huɛ bɔmi ɔ, nɛ ma pee kaa lɛ ngɛ e gbenɔ ɔ blɔfami,

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: kaa alinɔ, ye nine maa su ni gbogboehi a si temi ɔ nɔ lo. Paulo kunimi yemi

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: Pi kaa ye nine su nɔ momo aloo i hi kɛ pi si mo, se mohu i ngɛ fo tue konɛ ye nine nɛ su nɔ, ligbi abɔ nɛ Kristo Yesu nine su imi hu ye nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, i bui ye he kaa ye nine su nɔ, se nɔ́ nɛ ma de ji: nihi nɛ ngɛ se blɔ ɔ, i ngɛ ye hɛ jee ngɛ nɔ, se nihi nɛ ngɛ hɛ kpɛ ɔ a he mohu i ngɛ plee,

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: nɛ i ngɛ fo tue kɛ yaa hɛ kpɛ kɛ maa su Mawu tsɛmi nɛ je hiɔwe ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ jlasi ɔ he.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpɛti nihi abɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ, nyɛ ha waa hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a juɛmi nɛ ɔ; nɛ ke nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ susuu lɛ ekpa a, Mawu ma je kɔlɔ ɔ hu kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛɛ kase mi, nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nɛ wa toɔ nyɛ okadi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: I de nyɛ enɛ ɔ si abɔ, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu i kɛ vo nyu ngɛ dee, ke Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ henyɛli ji mɛ.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛɛ a nyagbe ji hɛ mi kpatami, nɛ a muklii ji a mawu, nɛ a zo nihi a mi a hɛ mi nyami ngɛ, nɛ je mi nihi a he kɛkɛ a susuu.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma a hiɔwe e ngɛ, he nɛ wa hyɛɛ yi wami helɔ nɛ ji Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ blɔ kɛ jee ɔ,

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ nɛ i suɔ nɛ ye hɛ jaa ngɛ nyɛ he, ye bua jɔmi kɛ ye jlasi, nyɛɛ da si ja ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi, nyɛ nihi nɛ i suɔ.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: I ngɛ Evodia ga woe, nɛ i ngɛ Sintika hu ga woe kaa a juɛmi nɛ pee kake ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Nɛ mo hu, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ye huɛ sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa, kaa o ye bua yi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ mi tsu sane kpakpa a he ni ɔ, kɛ Klemente hu kɛ ye huɛmɛ ni tsuli kpahi nɛ a biɛ ngɛ wami womi ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi daa! Nɛ ma de ekohu ke: Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ!

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Nyɛ mi mi jɔmi ɔ nyɛ ha nimli kulaa nɛ le! Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ su si ta.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko hao ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he, se mohu nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ sina nɛ wo nyɛ hiami ni ɔmɛ a ta ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi;

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: nɛ Mawu he jɔmi nɛ pe juɛmi kulaa a maa bu nyɛ tsuihi kɛ nyɛ juɛmi ɔmɛ a he ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi!

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nihi nɛ da, nihi nɛ sa bu, nihi nɛ hi, nihi nɛ he tsɔ, nihi nɛ a suɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ biɛ kpakpa amɛ kulaa, ke je mi bami kpakpa ko ngɛ, ke yi jemi ko hu ngɛ ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu!

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Nihi hu nɛ nyɛ kase nɛ nyɛ pɛtɛ he nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ nyɛ na ngɛ ye he ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu nyɛɛ pee, nɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si. Nike ni he sina

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: I na bua jɔmi babauu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kaa jehanɛ nyɛ ya nɔ ekohu ngɛ ye he susumi mi; nyɛ susu ye he lɛɛ, se he blɔ nɛ nyɛ ya na we.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: Pi kaa fimi nya nɛ i ngɛ munyu tue nɛ ɔ, ejakaa imi lɛɛ i kase kaa si himi tsuaa si himi nɛ i ngɛ mi ɔ ye bua nɛ jɔ ye he.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: I le ohia mi si himi, nɛ i le ni kpɔtɔɔ mi si himi hulɔ; i gblee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ nihi kulaa mi, tɔ jio, huɔ jio, ni nami jio, ohia jio,

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: I nyɛɔ nihi kulaa peɔ ngɛ kristo, nɔ nɛ woɔ ni he wami ɔ mi.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ nyɛ pee saminya kaa nyɛ ba ye bua mi ngɛ ye nɔ nami ɔ mi.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ nyɛ Filipibi ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ hu ɔ, nyɛ le kaa sane kpakpa a sisi jemi mi, benɛ i pue nɔ kɛ je Makedonia a, asafo ko be nɛ kɛ mi bɔɔ huɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hami kɛ hemi blɔfami kaa ja nyɛ kɛkɛ;

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: ejakaa benɛ i ngɛ Tesalonika a hu ɔ, nyɛ mane mi nihi nɛ hiaa mi ɔmɛ si kake kɛ si enyɔ kulaa.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Pi kaa nike ni i ngɛ hlae, se mohu i ngɛ se nami nɛ ma ha nyɛ kɔtaa a maa su kɛ be nɔ ha nyɛ ɔ hlae.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: I na nihi kulaa kɛ be nɔ, i tɔ kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mane Epafrodito kɛ ba ha mi ɔ nɛ ji via jemi kpakpa kɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Ye Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ nihi kulaa nɛ hiaa nyɛ ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi nyami hiɛmi ɔ nya, ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Anuminyami ha wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neene. Amen. Nyagbe sɛyemi

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga he tsɔlɔ tsuaa he tsɔlɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi. Nyɛmimɛ nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: He tsɔli ɔmɛ kulaa, se titli ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ je Kaisare we ɔ, ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ mumi ɔ nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Paulo nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya, kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ɔ,

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: ngma ya ha he tsɔli nɛ ngɛ Kolose ɔ kɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ he ye nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ: Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ. Sina sɔlemi

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Wa naa Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ, si daa nɛ ngɛ nyɛ he ngɛ wa sɔlemihi a mi,

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: ejakaa wa nu nyɛ Kristo Yesu nɔ hemi kɛyemi kɛ nyɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ he tsɔli ɔmɛ kulaa a he,

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ a ngɔ to ha nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ he. Nyɛ nu momo ngɛ sane kpakpa a anɔkuale munyu ɔ mi,

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: nɔ́ nɛ su nyɛ ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ je mluku ɔ kulaa mi, nɛ e woɔ yiblii nɛ e kekee kaa bɔ nɛ e peɔ ngɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ kpɛti kɛ je ligbi nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ nyɛ na le Mawu dloomi ɔ ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ:

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ kase hulɔ ngɛ Epafra, nɔ nɛ ji wa huɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɛ wa suɔ, nɛ ji Kristo anɔkuale sɔmɔlɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nya a,

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: lɛ nɔuu e ba bɔ wɔ nyɛ Mumi ɔ mi suɔmi he sane.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ wɔ hu, kɛ je ligbi nɛ wa nu ɔ, wa jɔɔ we sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ nyɛ hami, konɛ nyɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ e suɔmi nya nihi a lemi ngɛ mumi mi ni lemi kɛ sisinami tsuo mi;

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nɛ sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ e sa e hɛ mi saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yiblii ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa mi;

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ na Tsɛ ɔ si, nɔ nɛ ha wa sa nihi nɛ yeɔ klɔuklɔu bimɛ a gbo si ni ɔ eko ngɛ la mi,

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: nɛ e je wɔ kɛ je diblii he wami ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ wɔ ba to e suɔmi bi ɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ,

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Kristo ji Mawu nɛ a nɛ́ ɔ subai, bɔ nihi kulaa a kpɛti tete ɔ;

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: ejakaa e mi a bɔ nihi tsuo kulaa ngɛ, nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nihi nɛ a naa kɛ nihi nɛ a nɛ́, matsɛ sɛhi jio, nɔ yemihi jio, nɔkɔtɔma yemihi jio, he blɔhi jio, ni ɔmɛ kulaa a, e nɔ a gu nɛ a bɔ, nɛ lɛ nɔuu a bɔ ha.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔuu lɛ ngɛ loko nihi tsuo kulaa ngɛ, nɛ nihi tsuo kulaa a, e mi a ngɛ.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔuu ji nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ ji asafo ɔ yi, nɔ nɛ ji sisije ɔ, ni gbogboehi a kpɛti tete ɔ, konɛ lɛ e pee kekleekle nɔ ngɛ nihi tsuo kulaa mi.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e sa Mawu hɛ mi kaa fuu hyimi kulaa nɛ hi e mi;

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: nɛ e gu lɛ nɔuu e nɔ kɛ dla e kɛ nihi tsuo kulaa a kpɛti, nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gu e sɛumi tso nɔ gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ha he jɔmi ba a.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ jir ni kpahi kɛ shenyɛli ngɛ nyɛ juɛmi kɛ ni tsumi yaya amɛ a mi ɔ,

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: jehanɛ, e kɛ e he lo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gu gbenɔ mi kɛ kpata ha nyɛ, konɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɛ da si kaa ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ he be piami ko loo nya pomi ko ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii, nɛ nyɛ ko sã nyɛ he kɛ je sane kpakpa a nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ a fiɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe sisi, nɛ imi Paulo hu i sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he ɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ he. Paulo sɔmɔmi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ye bua jɔɔ ngɛ ye nɔ namihi nɛ i naa ngɛ nyɛ he ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ i haa nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ Kristo amanehulu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ hyiɔ tɔ ngɛ ye he lo ɔ mi ha e nɔmlɔ tso nɛ ji asafo ɔ.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: A pee mi sɔmɔlɔ ngɛ Mawu blɔ nya tomi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ blɔfami ɔ nya, kaa ma ha Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ ba mi,

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: nɔ́ nɛ ji laami sane nɛ a ngɔ laa kɛ je blema lokoo kɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, se jehanɛ a je kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ,

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa a ha a le nɔ́ nɛ ji kikɛmɛ a laami sane nɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami hiɛmi ɔ ngɛ ma jeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ ji Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ ji hɛ mi nyami hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Lɛ e he sane wa fiɛɔ, nɛ wa woɔ nɔmlɔ tsuaa nɔmlɔ ga, nɛ wa tsɔɔ nɔmlɔ ni ngɛ ni lemi tsuaa ni lemi mi, konɛ waa kɛ nɔmlɔ tsuaa nɔmlɔ nɛ da si kaa nɔ́ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Kɔlɔ ɔ he dengme i ngɛ gboe nɛ i ngɛ plee ngɛ ni tsumi nɛ a kɛ he wami tsuɔ ngɛ ye mi ɔ nya.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: I suɔ kaa ma ha nyɛɛ le nyɛ he dengme babauu nɛ i ngɛ gboe ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea kɛ nihi abɔ nɛ nɛ́ ye hɛ mi ngɛ he lo mi ɔmɛ a he,

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: konɛ a na tsui, nɛ a pee kake ngɛ suɔmi mi kɛ pɛtɛ sisi numi nɛ mi kuɔ nɛ a ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ ɔ kulaa mi, nɛ a le Mawu kɛ Kristo laami sane ɔ,

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: nɔ́ mi nɛ a ngɔ ga kɛ ni lemi juetli ɔ kulaa ngɔ laa ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee konɛ nɔ ko kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyu ko ko sisi nyɛ.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke i kɛ nyɛ be ngɛ he lo blɔfami hu, mumi blɔfami ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ ye bua jɔɔ, nɛ i naa nyɛ blɔ nya tomi kɛ si fimi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ daa si ngɛ Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ. Kristo mi wami hiɛmi

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ nyɛ he Kristo Yesu, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, atuu nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ e mi, nɛ nyɛ sipoku nɛ pi si,

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: nɛ a ma nyɛ ngɛ e nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ du si ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, kaa bɔ nɔuu nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ tsui nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ sina.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nɔ ko kɛ je mi ni lemi kɛ yaka sisimi ko ngɔ nyɛ nyɔgue, ngɛ nimli a blema sanehi kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi mumihi nɛ ji Kristo mi ɔ nya.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ e mi, lɛ nɔ nɛ ji nɔkɔtɔma yemi kɛ he blɔ tsuo yi ɔ,

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: ejakaa a pu nyɛ ngɔ piɛ e he ngɛ baptisimi ɔ mi, nɔ mi hu nɛ a tle nyɛ si ngɛ, ngɛ Mawu nɛ tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ he wami ni tsumi ɔ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nya a.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ji ni gbogboehi ngɛ nyɛ nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ he lo mɔmlɔtɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e ha nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ tsuo wami, nɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ kulaa pa nyɛ;

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: nɛ e gba wa he womi nɛ a ngma, nɛ ngɛ Mlaa amɛ a mi nɛ da si si wɔ ɔ, nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu e je ngɛ kpɛti kɛ ho, nɛ e ka ngɔ mɛtɛ sɛumi tso ɔ he.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: E kplɔ nɔkɔtɔma yemihi kɛ he blɔ ɔmɛ a he nihi, nɛ e bɔ mɛ ahlua pãa, nɛ e sã mɛ kɛ nyɛɛ e se ngɛ e kunimi yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ kojo nyɛ ngɛ ni yeni, loo ni numi, loo nyami ligbi, loo hluami he, loo Hejɔɔmi Ligbihi a blɔfami,

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: ejakaa nihi nɛ maa ba amɛ a he nini kɛkɛ ʼi, se nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ji Kristo nɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ buu e he kaa e pe nihi kulaa ngɛ ni nami ko he ɔ nɛ bu nyɛ fɔ nɛ e fi nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hlami nya kaa a kɛ he si bami juɛmi nɛ ja hiɔwe bɔfohi; e he lo juɛmi ɔ hãa e woɔ e he nɔ yakatsuaa;

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ, e hɛɛ we Kristo nɛ ji yi ɔ mi, nɔ mi nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa naa nihi nɛ hiaa lɛ, kɛ guu kpɔjihi kɛ panihi a nɔ kɛ waa bɔ nɛ Mawu to ɔ. Gbomi kɛ wami ngɛ Kristo mi

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo gbo kɛ ha je nɛ ɔ mi sisije ni ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ haa a woɔ nyɛ mlaa kɛ mwɔɔ ke:

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: “Koo pɛtɛ he, nɛ koo sa o nya, nɛ koo ta he tete” ɔ?

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ kulaa a, a he ni tsumi mi nɔuu a hɛ mi kpataa ngɛ, ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nimli a kitahi kɛ tsɔɔmihi,

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: nɛ a ji nihi nɛ hɛɛ ni lemi munyu ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya jami kɛ he si bami juɛmi kɛ nɔmlɔ tso yi mi wami mi mohu, se a pi nihi nɛ he ngɛ se nami nɛ kuɔ he lo ɔ he numi nihi a nya.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke a tle nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo si ɔ, nyɛ hla nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, he nɛ Kristo ngɛ nɛ e hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu, pi nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ gbo nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ wami ɔ kɛ Kristo tsuo ngɔ laa ngɛ Mawu mi.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Benɛ Kristo, nɔ nɛ ji wa wami ɔ ma pue ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ma pue ngɛ anuminyami mi. Wami momo kɛ ehe ɔ

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ gbe nyɛ he nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ: ajuama bɔmi, mu ni tsumi, mi mi la, akɔnɔ yaya, kɛ hɛ tsumi nɛ ji wɔ jami ɔ,

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: nihi a he nɛ Mawu muklii mi fumi baa tuegbenɔ bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: nihi a mi nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ nyɛɛ sa, benɛ nyɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ peɔ ja amɛ a kpɛti ɔ.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ ɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ sake kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa ngɔ pue he, nihi nɛ ji muklii mi fumi, mi mi la, hetsɛ, musu bɔmi munyu, zo munyu ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nya mi.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi lakpa, ejakaa nyɛ je nɔmlɔ momo ɔ kɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he;

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ wo nɔmlɔ he nɛ plɛɔ ehe ekohu kɛ yaa ni lemi mi ngɛ nɔ nɛ bɔ lɛ ɔ subai ɔ nya;

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: he nɛ Hela no kɛ Yuda no, nɔ nɛ a po lɛ kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ, jekɔno kɛ Skite no, nyɔguɛ kɛ odehe ko be hu, se mohu Kristo ji nihi kulaa ngɛ nihi kulaa mi ɔ.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ bimɛ nɛ Mawu hia, ni klɔuklɔuhi kɛ suɔli ji nyɛ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ wo mi mi jɔmi, mɔbɔ nami, he si bami, kpoo peemi, tsui si tomi kaa tade,

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: nɛ ke nɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko na sane ko ɔ, nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi nɛ nyɛ kɛ pa nyɛ he, kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu kɛ pa nyɛ ɔ, ja nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛɛ wo suɔmi nɛ ji kpa nɛ fiɔ nihi kulaa peɔ kake ɔ kaa tade.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ ha Mawu he jɔmi ɔ nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake mi ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ le si nami.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha Kristo munyu ɔ nɛ hi nyɛ mi babauu ngɛ ni lemi tsuaa ni lemi mi; nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ni nɛ nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ngɛ saku fiamihi kɛ yi jemi lahi kɛ mumi mi lahi a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sina nɛ la ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ha Mawu.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ngɛ munyu tumi loo ni tsumi blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kulaa ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ gu e nɔ kɛ na Mawu kɛ Tsɛ ɔ si. Wami he ɔ mi sihimi

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yigbayi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɔ ha nyɛ hunomɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Hunomɛ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ yihi, nɛ nyɛ yi mi ko wa ngɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Tsɛmɛ, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bihi a muklii mi la, konɛ a nine mi nɛ ko wo nyu.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Sɔmɔli, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ he lo blɔfami nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a tue ngɛ nihi kulaa mi, pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi, kaa nihi nɛ hlaa nimli a hɛ mi nyami, se mohu ngɛ tsui kpakpa mi kaa nihi nɛ yee Mawu gbeye.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kɛ pee, kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ hae se pi nimli,

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nyɛ nine maa su gbo si ni ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ kaa nyɛ hiɔwo, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peɔ nihi nɛ dɛ́ blɔ ɔ ma na nihi nɛ dɛ́ blɔ ɔ he hiɔwo, nɛ hɛ mi hyemi ko be mi.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa pɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ nyɔmtsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe. Nyagbe gawomi

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sɔle daa, nyɛɛ fɔ nyɔ ngɛ mi kɛ sina;

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: nɛ jehanɛ snyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ hulɔ, konɛ Mawu nɛ bli munyu ɔ sinya a ha wɔ nɛ wa kɛ fiɛ Kristo laami sane ɔ, nɔ́ he nɛ i fɔɔ si ngɛ kpa mi nɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: konɛ ma je kɔlɔ ɔ si paa bɔ nɛ da kaa ma de ɔ.

english_verse: When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ ni lemi nya, ngɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ se ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ tsu nyɛ deka a he ni.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nyɛ munyu he nɛ tsɔ daa, nɛ ngo nɛ hi mi, nɛ nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ heto. Nyagbe sɛyemi

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Tihiko, nɛ ji suɔmi nyɛmi kɛ anɔkuale sɔmɔlɔ kɛ huɛ tsɔlɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, maa bɔ nyɛ ye he sane ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he nɔuu nɛ i tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ, konɛ ma nu nyɛ he, nɛ e wo nyɛ bua,

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: nɛ i ngɔ Onesimo nɛ ji anɔkualetsɛ kɛ nyɛmi nɛ a suɔ nɛ je nyɛ kpɛti ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he; a ma ba bɔ nyɛ hiɛ ɔ sanehi kulaa.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Aristarko, ye huɛ pa mi no ɔ, kɛ Marko nɛ ji Barnaba nyɛmi bi ɔ, ,

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: kɛ Yesu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yusto ɔ, nihi nɛ je ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, ke a biɔ nyɛ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ ji ye huɛmɛ ni tsuli ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he; a ji bua womi kɛ ha mi.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Epafra nɛ je nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ji Kristo sɔmɔlɔ nɛ daa nɛ ɔ e kaii nyɛ ngɛ e sɔlemihi a mi, konɛ nyɛɛ da si nɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ nyɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nihi kulaa mi ɔ, ke e biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: I ngɛ e he odase yee kaa e gboɔ dengme wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Laodikea kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Hierapoli ɔmɛ a he.
