english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luka, tsopatsɛ nɛ a suɔ ɔ, kɛ Dema ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Wa biɔ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea a, kɛ Nimfa kɛ asafo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke a kane womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha a kane ngɛ Laodikea asafo ɔ mi hulɔ, nɛ a ha nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kane Laodikea nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya womi nɛ i ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ kai ye kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ! Dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ngma ya ha Tesalonika asafo nɛ ngɛ Mawu, Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! Tesalonikabi ɔmɛ a sihihii kɛ a hemi kɛ yemi

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Wa naa Mawu si daa ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he, nɛ wa woɔ nyɛ ta ngɛ wa pɛɛ kpamihi a mi, nɛ wa jɔɔ we.

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: Wa kaii nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ni tsumi ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ suɔmi mɔde bɔmi ɔ kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi tsui si tomi ɔ ngɛ Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mamimɛ nɛ Mawu suɔ, wa le hlami nɛ a hla nyɛ ɔ,

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: kaa wa sane kpakpa a bɛ́ nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ munyu tumi mi kɛkɛ, se mohu ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami kɛ nɔ mi mami babauu mi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le, bɔ nɛ wa plɛ ba wa je mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ plɛ waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kaseli, akɛnɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu mi bua jɔmi he munyu ɔ ngɛ dengme babauu mi ɔ,

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: nɛ e ha nyɛ plɛ okadi ha nihi kulaa nɛ he ye ngɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia a.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ munyu ɔ je nɛ e gbɛ fia, pi ngɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛkɛ, se mohu nyɛ hemi nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu nɔ yeɔ ɔ jije kɛ ho he tsuaa he ya, nɛ e hia we wɔ nɔ́ ko demi tete.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbɛ wa slaami ɔ he munyu ɔ fia kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ kpale kɛ je amagahi a he kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ba sɔmɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ,

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ ngɛ e bi ɔ nɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ blɔ hyɛe kɛ je hiɔwe, Yesu ne je wɔ kɛ je mi mi fumi nɛ maa ba a mi ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa slaami nɛ wa ba slaa nyɛ ɔ pee we yaka,

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: se mohu wa na ka ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ mi, nɛ waa kɛ fiɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ nya tsimi babauu mi; pohu wa na nɔ kɛ be, nɛ a wa wɔ yi mi hulɔ ngɛ Filipi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ, pi sisimi loo mu ni tsumi loo lakpa mi nɛ e je;

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa tu we nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyu ko hyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, nɛ wa to we hɛ tsumi he lakpa ko hulɔ, Mawu ji odase;

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: jehanɛ wa hla we nimli a hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ aloo ni kpa komɛ a ngɔ,

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: pohu wa ngɛ he blɔ kaa waa kɛ wa he fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ, akɛnɛ Kristo bɔfohi ji wɔ ɔ. Se mohu wa mi mi jɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɛ bimɛ a nyɛ hɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e bimɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ ɔ.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ wa suɔ nyɛ saminya he je ɔ, wa ngɛ he tsui kaa pi Mawu sane kpakpa a kɛkɛ nɛ waa kɛ ma ha nyɛ, se mohu wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa wami tete, ejakaa wa suɔ nyɛ wawɛɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ hɛ ngɛ wa pɔtɔ kɛ wa dengme gbomi ɔ nɔ, kaa benɛ pee nɛ wa ko pee tlomi ngɔ ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko he je ɔ, nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo wa ngɛ ni tsue, nɛ wa pa ngɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ kɛ Mawu ji odase yeli kaa wa je mi nɛ wa ba ngɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he yeɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ngɛ klɔuu, e da, nɛ piami ko be he.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ wa hɛɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ ko hɛɛ e bimɛ.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: Wa wo nyɛ he wami, wa wo nyɛ bua, nɛ wa su nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e matsɛ yemi kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ mi ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ, mamimɛ, nyɛ plɛ Mawu asafo nɛ ngɛ Yudea a kaseli ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, ejakaa dengme nɛ nyɛ na ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu mɛ hu a na ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a dɛ mi,

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ gbe Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbali ɔmɛ hulɔ, nɛ a waa wɔ hu yi mi, nɛ a sɛ́ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ nimli tsuo yi,

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: nihi nɛ tsiɔ wɔ blɔ hulɔ kaa wa ko tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ maje li ɔmɛ konɛ a he a yi wami. Enɛ ɔ a kɛ woɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ fuu tɔ daa nɔ; se jehanɛ Mawu mi mi fumi na mɛ. Paulo suɔ nɛ e ya slaa Tesalonikabi ɔmɛ ekohu

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, mamimɛ, akɛnɛ waa kɛ nyɛ mi gba be kpiti ko ngɛ he lo mi se pi tsui mi he je ɔ, waa kɛ hɛja babauu bɔ mɔde nitsɛ konɛ waa na nyɛ hɛ mi ekohu.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa hla kaa waa ba nyɛ ngɔ — imi, Paulo ɔ, i hla si kake kɛ si enyɔ sɔuu — se Satan tsi wɔ blɔ.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Ejakaa mɛni ji wa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi loo wa bua jɔmi loo wa fiami jlasi ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi ngɛ e bami be ɔ mi ɔ? Anɛ pi nyɛ nɔuu lo?

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ nyɛ ji wa hɛ mi nyami kɛ wa bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ wa nyɛ we hu ɔ, wa kplɛɛ kaa a je wa he kɛkɛ ngɛ Ateene,

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: nɛ wa tsɔ wa nyɛmi Timoteo, nɛ ji Mawu sɔmɔlɔ kɛ wa huɛ ni tsulɔ ngɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a mi ɔ, konɛ e ba wo nyɛ he wami nɛ e ha nyɛ fi si ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi,

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: konɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔ nami nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nane nɛ kpata. Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si ha wɔ nɔuu ji kɔlɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa de nyɛ ngɔ to ke wa maa na nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ba mi nɛ nyɛ le ɔ.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ imi hu, benɛ i nyɛ we hu ɔ, i tsɔ konɛ ma kɛ le nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, kaa alinɔ nɔ kalɔ ɔ ba ka nyɛ nɛ e ha wa dengme nɛ wa gbo ɔ pee yaka lo?

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ nɛ Timoteo je nyɛ ngɔ ba wa ngɔ nɛ e ba bɔ wɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kɛ nyɛ suɔmi kɛ kaimi kpakpa nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ kaii wɔ daa a, kɛ nyɛ hɛ̃ nɛ ngɛ jae kaa nyɛ ma na wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa hɛ̃ jaa ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ,

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: e nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mamimɛ, wa nɔ nami kɛ wa haomi ɔmɛ kulaa mi ɔ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ha wa bua jɔ ngɛ nyɛ he.

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ wa na he wami he, akɛnɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Kɛ wa maa na Mawu si ngɛ nyɛ he ngɛ bua jɔmi tsuo nɛ wa na ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ɔ he kɛɛ?

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Nyɔ kɛ pia kulaa wa kpaa pɛɛ babauu, konɛ waa na nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ wa ha nyɛ nɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ ha wa blɔ ɔ nɛ da kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ, nɛ e ha nyɛɛ be nɔ kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ nyɛ he kɛ nihi kulaa a, kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa suɔ nyɛ ɔ;

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: benɛ pee nɛ e ha nyɛ tsui nɛ pi si ngɛ klɔuklɔu peemi mi nɛ piami ko ko hi nyɛ he, ngɛ Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa a bami be ɔ mi.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ga woe ngɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu mi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ kase kɛ je wa ngɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi ha ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee hulɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ ja.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ le kita nɛ wa wo nyɛ ngɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ni kaa nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ, lɔ ɔ ji kaa nyɛɛ tsi nyɛ he nya kɛ je ajuama bɔmi he,

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: pi ngɛ akɔnɔ hɛ dɔmi mi, kaa bɔ nɛ maje li a bimɛ nɛ li Mawu ɔ peɔ ɔ;

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: konɛ nɔ ko ko ye e nyɛmi amimi nɛ e sisi lɛ ngɛ sane ko mi ejakaa enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he tue gblalɔ ji Mawetsɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nyɛ ngɔ to nɛ wa ye he odase ɔ.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu tsɛ we wɔ ngɔ hi mu ni tsumi, se mohu he tsɔmi.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ, nɔ nɛ bui tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ ko nɛ e bui ɔ, se mohu Mawu nɔ nɛ ngɔ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ wo nyɛ mi ɔ ʼi.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: E hia we kaa ma ngma nyɛ ngɛ nyɛmimɛ a suɔmi he, ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ, Mawu tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he;

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: ejakaa nyɛ peɔ ja hulɔ haa nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia tsuo kulaa a. Se wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ, kaa nyɛɛ ya nɔ pe kekle ɔ,

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ hi si kpoo nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ko wo ni kpahi a sane mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nine nɛ tsu ni, kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nyɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ ngɛ fɛu ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ko hia nyɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, wa suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le ninɛmɛ nɛ a gbo ɔmɛ a he sane, konɛ nyɛ ko ye kɔmɔ kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ be hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko ɔ.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu gbo nɛ e te si ɔ, ja nɔuu Mawu maa gu Yesu nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔmɛ hu ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ba.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ko nya, kaa wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa hɛ maa hi ngmengmle nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami be ɔ mi ɔ, be ninɛmɛ nɛ a gbo ɔmɛ a hlami sɛe.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Ejakaa lɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kɛ ose hemi kɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma gbi kɛ Mawu titimati maa je hiɔwe kɛ kple si, nɛ ni gbogboehi nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ kekle maa te si,

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ma sa waa kɛ mɛ kulaa ngɛ bɔkuhi a mi kɛ maa ya Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpeemi ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi, nɛ jã waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa hi si daa.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Se be kɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, mamimɛ, e hia we kaa waa ngma nyɛ.

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le tutuutu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ maa ba kaa juɔ baa nyɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Ejakaa be mi nɛ a ma de ke: “He jɔmi ngɛ, nɛ wa ngɛ sɔkee!” ɔ, lɛ be ɔ mi nɔuu hɛ mi kpatami ma ba tua mɛ si kake too, kaa kɔɔmi tuaa yo nɛ muklii wa a, nɛ a be mi jee gblegbleegblee.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be diblii mi nɛ ligbi ɔ ma ba ti nyɛ si kaa juɔ.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo ɔ la bimɛ ji nyɛ kɛ piani bimɛ hulɔ; wa pi nyɔ loo diblii bimɛ.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ hwɔɔ mahɛ ɔ, nyɔ mi a hwɔɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ deɔ da a, nyɔ mi a deɔ.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ akɛnɛ piani bimɛ ji wɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ha wa hɛ nɛ ka si, nɛ waa wo hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi dama a, nɛ wa bu dade pɛɛ nɛ ji yi wami hemi hɛ kɛ nɔfɔmi ɔ.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu to we wɔ ha mi mi fumi, se mohu e to wɔ nɛ wa na yi wami hemi ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo mi,

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ gbo wa yi gbenɔ konɛ wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, waa kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ ye bua mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ. Nyagbe gawomi kɛ sɛyemi

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ kaa znyɛɛ le nihi nɛ tsuɔ ni ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ a ji nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi nɛ a tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ bu mɛ saminya ngɛ suɔmi mi ngɛ a ni tsumi ɔ he. Nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ he jɔli ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ wo ninɛmɛ nɛ fɔɔ ɔmɛ he wami; nyɛɛ ye bua ninɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ha nihi kulaa.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi konɛ nɔ ko ko ngɔ yayami ngɔ to yayami nane mi, se mohu daa nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ di kpakpa peemi se ngɔ ha nyɛ he kɛ nihi kulaa.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ daa;

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ sɔle be tsuaa be;

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ na si ngɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mi; ejakaa lɔ ɔ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ni ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ngɛ nyɛ blɔfami.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko gbe Mumi ɔ;

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ka nihi kulaa hyɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he.

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sa nyɛ he kɛ je nɔ́ fɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ hɛɛ yayami su ɔ he.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: He jɔmi Mawu ɔ nitsɛ nɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he kulaa kɛ pi si, nɛ e hyɛ nyɛ mumi kɛ nyɛ klaa kɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa nɔ nɛ piami ko ko hi he ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bami be ɔ mi.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Anɔkualetsɛ ji Mawu nɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ lɛ nɔuu e maa pee hulɔ.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha wɔ.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ nya he fiɔmi klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ kita kae ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi kaa nyɛ ha a kane kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛmimɛ klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa!

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ngma ya ha Tesalonika asafo nɛ ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! Kojomi ngɛ Kristo bami be ɔ mi

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: E sa kaa wa naa Mawu si daa ngɛ nyɛ he bɔ nɛ sa, mamimɛ, ejakaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ klee wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ e nyɛmimɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɛe kɛ ngɛ nɔ yae hulɔ,

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ tete wa fiaa ngɔ fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Mawu asafo ɔmɛ a mi, ngɛ nyɛ tsui si tomi kɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi nɛ a waa kɛ nyɛ nɔ namihi nɛ nyɛ miaa nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ mi ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji Mawu kojomi nɛ da a he okadi nɛ a naa paa, konɛ a bu nyɛ kaa nyɛ sa Mawu matsɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ nae ngɛ he ɔ.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: E da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ haoe ɔ, e maa hao mɛ ngɔ to nane mi;

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ haoe ɔ, e ma ha waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo he jɔɔmi, benɛ a ma je Mawetsɛ Yesu kpo kɛ maa je hiɔwe kɛ e he wami bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ,

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe maa gbla nihi nɛ li Mawu kɛ nihi nɛ bui wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo sane kpakpa a tue ɔmɛ a tue.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: A ma na hiɔwo nɛ ji neneene hɛ mi kpatami kɛ maa je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ e he wami ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ he,

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: benɛ e maa ba nɛ a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a maa na e nyakpɛ nihi ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ he e nɔ ye ɔ kulaa mi ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, ejakaa a he wa dase nɛ wa ye ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ ye.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je hu nɛ wa kpaa pɛɛ daa haa nyɛ ɔ nɛ, konɛ wa Mawu ɔ nɛ ha nyɛɛ sa tsɛmi ɔ, nɛ ngɛ e he wami nya a, e ha nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa tsuaa nɔ́ kpakpa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi,

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: benɛ pee nɛ a wo wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami ngɛ e mi, ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nya.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ kɛ wa nya nɛ a ma bua ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ,

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: kaa nyɛ ko ha nɛ a kɛ mumi ko loo munyu ko loo womi ko nɛ a ma de ke e je wa ngɔ ɔ nɛ puɛ nyɛ juɛmi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Ligbi ɔ ba momo.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɔ ko nɛ e sisi nyɛ ngɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko nɔ, ejakaa ja Mawu jami kuami ɔ ba lolo, nɛ a je dikalɔ nɛ ji hɛ mi kpatami bi ɔ kpo,

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai we kaa, benɛ i kɛ nyɛ̃ ngɛ ɔ, i de nyɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ lo?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ e kpo jemi ɔ blɔ tsie ɔ.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mlaa kuami laami sane ɔ ngɛ ni tsue momo; se ja a je nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ ngɛ blɔ tsie ɔ kɛ je blɔ mi lolo.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Nɛ lɔ ɔ loko a ma je dikalɔ ɔ kpo paa, nɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu kɛ e nya mi mumi ɔ maa gbe lɛ, nɛ e kɛ e bami ɔ kpɛmi ɔ ma kpata e hɛ mi.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Dikalɔ ɔ maa be kɛ Satan ni tsumi nɛ mi wa ngɛ lakpa he wami kɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi tsuo mi,

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: kɛ nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ kulaa nɛ a kɛ mlɔɔ nihi nɛ laa amɛ, ejakaa a pɛtɛ we anɔkuale suɔmi ɔ he konɛ a kɛ he a yi wami.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Mawu maa tsɔ sisimi nɛ nya wa kɛ maa ba a ngɔ konɛ a he lakpa a nɛ a ye,

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: konɛ a kojo nihi kulaa nɛ he we anɔkuale ɔ yi, se a naa nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔmɛ mohu a he tsui ɔ. A hla nyɛ ha yi wami hemi

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, e sa kaa wa naa Mawu si daa ngɛ nyɛ he, mamimɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ, ejakaa Mawu hla nyɛ kɛ je sisije ngɔ ha yi wami hemi ngɛ mumi ɔ klɔuklɔu peemi kɛ anɔkuale ɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi,

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: enɛ ɔ he nɛ e gu wa sane kpakpa a nɔ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ nyɛ na wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ da si, nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ nihi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ munyu mi loo womi mi ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Se lɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu nɛ suɔ wɔ nɛ e kɛ neneene bua womi kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kpakpa ha wɔ ngɛ dloomi nya a,

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: lɛ nɔuu e maa wo nyɛ bua, nɛ e maa wo nyɛ he wami ngɛ munyu kpakpa kɛ ni tsumi kpakpa tsuo mi.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha wɔ, konɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ nɛ gbɛ fia kɛ fo kɛ ya nɔ, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami, kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ hulɔ ɔ;

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: nyɛ kpa pɛɛ nɛ a je wɔ kɛ je yi mi wali kɛ nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi, ejakaa pi nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Se anɔkualetsɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e maa bu nyɛ he kɛ maa je dikalɔ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Se wa hɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kaa, nihi nɛ wa wo nyɛ he kita a, nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ nyɛ maa pee hulɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ plɛ nyɛ tsui kɛ ya Mawu suɔmi kɛ Kristo tsui si tomi ɔ he. Bɔ nɛ e hia kaa a tsu ni

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, wa ngɛ nyɛ fae ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛmi tsuaa nyɛmi nɛ tsu we ni nɛ nyɛɛ we ngɛ nihi nɛ wa tu ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi ɔ nya a ko bɔ.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa e sa kaa nyɛ kaseɔ wɔ; ejakaa wa pee we hejɔ benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ,

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: nɛ jehanɛ hu wa yi nɔ ko ku yaka, se mohu waa kɛ mɔde bɔmi kɛ pɔtɔ tsuɔ ni nyɔ kɛ pia, benɛ pee nɛ wa ko pee tlomi ngɔ ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: Tsa pi kaa wa be jamɛ a he blɔ, se mohu, konɛ waa ngɔ wa he ngɔ pee nɔ hyemi nɔ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa nuɔ kaa ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ peɔ hejɔ nɛ a tsu we ni se mohu a ngɔɔ a nya ngɔ woɔ nihi a sanehi a mi.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, wa ngɛ mɛ fae nɛ wa ngɛ mɛ ga woe ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo mi kaa a tsu ni kpoo nɛ a ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a dɛ mi ngma.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ ko ha pɔ nɛ tɔ nyɛ kɛ kpakpa peemi.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko bui wa munyu nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ tue ɔ, nyɛ kadi lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko bɔ, konɛ zo nɛ gbe lɛ.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko bu lɛ kaa henyɛlɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa nyɛmi. Nyagbe sɛyemi

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Lɛ he jɔmi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ nɛ ha nyɛ he jɔmi daa ngɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mi. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si!

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Paulo nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu, wa yi wami helɔ ɔ, kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo, wa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ, kita nya a,

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: ngma ya ha Timoteo nɛ ji e bi nitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ: Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu kɛ Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, dɛ mi ɔ ha mo! Tsɔɔmi yaya he kɔkɔbɔmi

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ benɛ i yaa Makedonia nɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ ke o hi si ngɛ Efeso konɛ o bɔ ni komɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko tsɔɔ tsɔɔmi kpahi,

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: nɛ jehanɛ hu a ko di nyaziahi kɛ weku sisi tsɔɔmi tslalaa se, ejakaa enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ nɔ jemi baa mohu pe Mawu blɔ nya tomi nɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ, jamɛ a pɛɛ ɔ i ngɛ mo kpae ekohu.

english_verse: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
translation_verse: Kita a nya gbemi ji suɔmi nɛ je tsui nɛ mi tsɔ kɛ he nile kpakpa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ lakpa ko be mi ɔ mi,

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ ni komɛ je se, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho yaka munyu he ya.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: A ngɛ hlae nɛ a pee a he mlaa tsɔɔli, pohu a nɛ nihi nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ loo nihi nɛ a ngɛ nɔ mi mae tutuutu ɔmɛ a sisi.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa mlaa a hi ha nɔ nɛ tsuɔ he ni bɔ nɛ sa mlaa,

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: nɛ e le enɛ ɔ, kaa dalɔ ɔ a wui lɛ mlaa, se mohu mlaa nɔ tɔli kɛ tue gboli, mlaa a woɔ: nihi nɛ ja we Mawu kɛ yayami peeli, nihi nɛ hɛ mi be nyami kɛ he bleli, tsɛ gbeli kɛ nyɛ gbeli, awi yeli,

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: ajuama bɔli, nyumuhi nɛ kɛ nyumuhi hwɔɔ si, nɔmlɔ juli, nya ngɔli, kita mi kuli kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ kɛ tsɔɔmi kpakpa yi ɔ,

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: ngɛ Mawu nɛ a gbaa lɛ ɔ nyami sane kpakpa nɛ a tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ nya. Mawu mɔbɔnami he sina

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: I naa wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ wo mi he wami ɔ si, kaa e bu mi anɔkualetsɛ nɛ e ngɔ mi ngɔ wo sɔmɔmi ɔ mi,

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: imi nɛ kekle ɔ i ji musu bɔlɔ kɛ yi mi walɔ kɛ nɔ builɔ; se kɛ ɔ, a na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa i li nɛ i pee, ngɛ hemi nɛ i he we yi ɔ he.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Se wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ plɛ e dloomi nɛ hiɛ babauu kɛ be nɔ ɔ pue ye nɔ, nɛ e ha i hyi kɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: E ji anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a pɛtɛ he kulaa, kaa Kristo Yesu ba je nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e ba he yayami peeli a yi wami, nihi a kpɛti nɛ imi ji titima a;

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: se kɛ ɔ, enɛ ɔ he nɛ a na mi mɔbɔ ɔ nɛ, konɛ imi kekle ye mi nɛ Kristo nɛ je e tsui si tomi ɔ kulaa kpo ngɛ, nɛ a kɛ to okadi ha nihi nɛ ma he e nɔ ngɔ ye, nɛ a na neneene wami.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Neneene Matsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ gbo we, nɔ nɛ ji Mawu kake ɔ, a ngɔ bu kɛ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene! Amen.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Ye bi Timoteo, i ngɛ mo kita nɛ ɔ woe, ngɛ gbamihi nɛ a gba sa ngɛ o he ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ o kɛ hwu ta kpakpa a,

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: nɛ o hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ he ni lemi kpakpa, nɔ́ nɛ ni komɛ sake fɔ he nɛ a kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ya sa si ɔ;

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: a ti ni komɛ ji Himeneo kɛ Aleksandro, nihi nɛ i tu ngɔ wo Satan dɛ mi, konɛ a gbla a tue nɛ a ko tu musu bɔmi munyuhi hu ɔ.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Kekleekle ɔ, nɔ nɛ i ngɛ he ga woe ji kaa a hɛɛ spɛɛ kpamihi, sɔlemihi, mi damihi, sinamihi a mi ha nimli kulaa,

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: ngɔ ha matsɛmɛ kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya, konɛ waa hi si kpoo ngɛ he jɔmi mi, ngɛ Mawu jami kɛ je mi bami kpakpa nɛ sa mi.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Ejakaa enɛ ɔ hi nɛ e ngɔɔ Mawu nɛ ji wa yi wami helɔ ɔ nya,

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e he nimli tsuo a yi wami, konɛ a le anɔkuale ɔ.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu kake lɛ ngɛ, kɛ Mawu kɛ nimli a mi dalɔ kake hu nɛ ji nɔmlɔ Kristo Yesu ɔ,

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: enɛ ɔ he nɛ a wo mi fiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo , maje li a tsɔɔlɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ hlae kaa nyumuhi nɛ a sɔle ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ a wo a ninehi nɛ he tsɔ nɔ nɛ mi mi fumi loo nya sami ko hi mi.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu yihi hu, a kɛ tade nɛ sa kɛ humipeemi kɛ juɛmi nɛ mi tsɔ nɛ dla a he, pi kɛ yi hɔɔmi slɔɔto ko loo sika loo adiagba loo tade nɛ he jua wa

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: se mohu kɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi nɛ sa yihi nɛ tsɔɔ a he kaa Mawu jali ji mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: Yo nɛ pee kpoo nɛ e kase ni ngɛ tue bumi tsuo mi.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: I ngmɛ́ yo blɔ kaa e tsɔɔ ni aloo e ye nyumu nɔ, se mohu e pee kpoo.

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: Ejakaa Adam kekle a bɔ, lɔ ɔ se ɔ Hawa.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Nɛ pi Adam nɛ a sisi ɔ, se yo ɔ a sisi, nɛ e sɛ tɔmi mi.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke nɔ ko ngɛ nɔ hyɛmi ni tsumi hlae ɔ, e ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpa hlae.”

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: Se e sa kaa nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ hi si bɔ nɛ a be e he sane ko nae, nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo kake, hɛ si kalɔ, nɔ nɛ juɛmi mi tsɔ, nɔ nɛ baa e je mi saminya, nibwɔ peelɔ, nɔ nɛ le ni tsɔɔmi;

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: pi da delɔ, pi nine kpokpookpo tsɛ, se mohu nɔ nɛ he jɔ, nɔ nɛ pɛ́, nɔ nɛ hɛ kɔɛ sika nɔ;

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ saminya, nɛ e bimɛ buɔ lɛ tue nɛ a buu lɛ.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko li lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ hyɛmi ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛ hyɛ Mawu asafo ɔ nɔ kɛɛ?

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ pi nɔ nɛ sɛ Mawu jami mi kɛ we, konɛ e ko wo e he nɔ nɛ e nɔ abosiami kojomi mi.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: E sa kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔ hu a ye e he odase kpakpa, konɛ e ko na biɛ yaya nɛ e sɛ abosiami klama mi. Asafo mi sɔmɔli a hepiɛli

english_verse: Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.
translation_verse: Asafo mi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ hu, e sa kaa a pee nimli nɛ a hɛ mi jiɔ, pi nya enyɔenyɔtsɛmɛ, pi da deli, pi hɛ tsuli,

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: se nihi nɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ laami sane ɔ ngɛ he nile nɛ he tsɔ mi.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ hu a ka mɛ nɛ a hyɛ lolo; lɔ ɔ se ke sane ko be a he ɔ, a sɔmɔ.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Yi ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu; a pee nihi nɛ a hɛ mi jiɔ, pi sieku yeli, se a hɛ nɛ ka si, a ye anɔkuale ngɛ́ nihi kulaa mi.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Asafo mi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ nɛ pee yo kakaakatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ yeɔ a bimɛ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nihi a nɔ saminya.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ saminya a, a naa bu, kɛ kã babauu ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ mi. Laami sane ngua a

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo enɛ ɔmɛ ngmae, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e be kɛe nɛ ma ba o ngɔ.

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: Se ke ye se ya kɛ ɔ nɛ o le bɔ nɛ sa nɛ nihi nɛ a ba je mi ha ngɛ Mawu we, nɛ ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ asafo ɔ anɔkuale ɔ titima kɛ e sepimi nɔ́ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Nɔ jemi be he kaa Mawu jami laami sane ɔ, e mi kuɔ. Mawu je e he si paa ngɛ he lo mi, E ye nguɔ ngɛ mumi mi, E je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ bɔfohi, A fiɛ lɛ ngɛ majeli a kpɛti, A he e nɔ ye ngɛ je mi, A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ nyami mi.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ deɔ paa ke, nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ni komɛ ma kua hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, nɛ a ma ya nyɛɛ sisimi mumihi kɛ mumi yayamihi a tsɔɔmihi a se,

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: ngɛ nya ngɔli a sato peemi mi, nihi nɛ a he nile gbo kaa nɔ nɛ a sã kɛ dade kɛ la,

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: nɛ a tsiɔ yo ngɔmi blɔ, nɛ a deɔ ke a nyɛ ngma nɛ Mawu bɔ kaa nihi nɛ heɔ yeɔ nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ kɛ sina nɛ ye ɔ.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ e hi, nɛ a nyɛ́ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ sina yeɔ ɔ,

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: ejakaa a kɛ Mawu munyu kɛ sɔlemi tsukɔɔ he. Kristo Yesu sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Ke o tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, o maa pee o he Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa, nɔ nɛ lɛɛ e he kɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ tsɔɔmi kpakpa nɛ o nyɛɛ se ɔ.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Se yimowi a yakayaka nyazia amɛ ɔ guu. Bɔɔ Mawu jami mohu he mɔde.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ wa gboɔ dengme nɛ wa haa a jɛɛ wɔ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ, nɔ nɛ ji nimli kulaa a yi wami helɔ, titli ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Wo ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he kita nɛ o tsɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Ko ha nɔ ko nɛ gbe o he guɛ ngɛ niheyo nɛ o ji ɔ he, se mohu o kɛ o he nɛ pee nɔ hyemi nɔ ngɔ ha ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, ngɛ munyu tutui mi, ngɛ jemi bami mi, ngɛ suɔmi mi, ngɛ mumi, mi ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, ngɛ he tsɔmi mi.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Hii womi kanee kɛ ga womi kɛ ni tsɔɔmi kɛ ya su be nɛ ma ba.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Koo ngmɛɛ o dloomi ke nɔ nɛ a ngɔ ha mo kɛ gu gbami kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ninehi nɛ a kɛ pue o nɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Mo gbo ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he dengme, o kɛ ohe nɛ wo mi kulaa, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ na o nɔ yami paa.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: O hɛ nɛ hi o he nɔ kɛ o tsɔɔmi ɔ, hii si ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a mi; ejakaa ke o pee enɛ ɔ ɔ, o ma he mo nitsɛ kɛ nihi nɛ buɔ mo tue ɔ kulaa yi wami.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Koo tu nɔkɔtɔma ko hɛ mi munyu wawɛɛ, se mohu o tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa o tsɛ; nihewi hu kaa nyɛmimɛ;

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: yi nikɔtɔma amɛ kaa nyɛmɛ; yihewi ɔmɛ hu kaa nyɛmimɛ yihi ngɛ he tsɔmi tsuo mi.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Yalɔyi nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, buu mɛ.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Ke yalɔyo ko ngɛ bimɛ loo bibimɛ ɔ, a kase Mawu gbeye yemi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a we mi kekle, nɛ a to a fɔli ɔmɛ nane mi pɛpɛɛpɛ, ejakaa enɛ ɔ ngɛ fɛu nɛ e sa Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ji yalɔyo niinɛ nɛ e piɛ e nɔ kake too ɔ, ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ e hɛɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ sɔlemi mi nyɔ kɛ pia.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Se yo nɛ fiɛɛ nyumu fiɛmi ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ mohu se e gbo.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Wo mɛ mlaa ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ a he konɛ a ko na a he munyu ko nɛ a tu.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko hyɛ we lɛ nitsɛ e nihi, titli ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e we mi bimɛ ɔ, e kpa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ se, nɛ afani nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ ngɛ e he.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: Koo ngɔ yalɔyo nɛ na we nɛ e ye jeha nyingmi ekpa ngɔ wo sɔmɔmi ɔ mi, ja nɔ nɛ gba nyumu kake,

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ a tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa kaa e tsu ni kpakpahi, lɔ ɔ ji: ke e lɛ bimɛ, ke e pee nihi nibwɔ, ke e fɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nane he, ke e ye bua nihi nɛ naa amanehlu ɔ, ke e di ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa nitsumi kpakpa se ɔ.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Se yalɔyi nɛ wɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, koo ngɔ mɛ, ejakaa ke nyumu sumi sɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, a jee Kristo se ya hlaa gba;

english_verse: and become guilty of breaking their promise to him.
translation_verse: nɛ a naa kojomi ejakaa a ngmɛɛ a kekle hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Nɛ enɛ ɔ se ɔ a kaseɔ hejɔ peemi kɛ si pomi ngɛ wehi a mi, nɛ pi hejɔ kɛkɛ nɛ a peɔ, se a peɔ a he sieku yeli, kɛ si jeli nɛ tuɔ munyu nɛ sɛ.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i suɔ kaa yalɔyihi nɛ wɛ́ lolo ɔ a gba, nɛ a fɔ bimɛ, nɛ a ye a we nɔ, nɛ a ko ha he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ na sane ko nɛ e kɛ jɛ wɔ;

english_verse: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
translation_verse: ejakaa ni komɛ kpale ya nyɛɛ Satan se momo.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Se ke nyumu lo yo nɛ heɔ yeɔ ngɛ yalɔyihi ɔ, e hyɛ mɛ nɛ e ko pee tlomi kɛ ha asafo ɔ, konɛ asafo ɔ nɛ hyɛ yalɔyihi nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Nikɔtɔmahi nɛ tsuɔ a ni saminya a, e sa kaa a ngɔ bu totoe enyɔ ngɔ ha mɛ, titli ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ bɔɔ munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi he mɔde ɔ.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke: “Koo wo na nɛ gblɛɔ blɛfo ɔ nya kotoku;” kɛ: “Nitsulɔ ɔ, e hiɔwo sa lɛ.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Ke a po nɔkɔtɔma ko nya a, ko he kplɛɛ kaa ja ngɛ odasefohi enyɔ loo etɛ nya lolo.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Ninɛmɛ nɛ peɔ yayami ɔ, ka mɛ ngɛ nihi kulaa a hɛ mi, konɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ hu nɛ ye gbeye.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo mlaa woe ngɛ Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ e bɔfohi nɛ e hia amɛ a hɛ mi, kaa o ye ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ o ko hyɛ nihi a hɛ mi kɛ kojo, nɛ jehanɛ hu, o ko hia nɔ mi.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Koo ngɔ po nine ngɔ pue nɔ ko nɔ oya, nɛ jehanɛ hu, koo ngɔ o he ngɔ futu ni kpahi a he yayamihi a mi. To o he nyaii.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Koo nu nyu sɔuu, se nuu wai bɔɔ ngɛ o muklii kɛ o hiɔhi nɛ nuu mo kpitikpiti ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ a he yayamihi jee kpo paa mla, nɛ a sɛɛ a hlami kɛ yaa kojomi mi, se ni komɛ a nɔ hu kpɛɛ se.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu ni tsumi kpakpahi hu jee kpo paa, nɛ nihi nɛ ji kpo paa a hu a be nyɛe nɛ a kɛ maa laa.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Sɔmɔli tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ, a bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kaa nihi nɛ bu tsuo sa mɛ, konɛ a ko tu Mawu biɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ he musu bɔmi munyu.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Se nyɔguɛhi nɛ ngɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ nɛ he ye ɔ, a ko gbe a he guɛ, se mohu a sɔmɔ mɛ saminya akɛnɛ nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ he je ɔ, ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ naa ni tsumi ɔ mi nihi ɔ, nihi nɛ he ye kɛ suɔli ʼi. Tsɔɔ mɛ enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o wo mɛ ga ngɛ he. Lakpa tsɔɔmi kɛ ninami nitsɛ

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko tsɔɔ tsɔɔmi kpa ko, nɛ e ngɔɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo munyuhi nɛ tsaa nɔ ɔ kɛ Mawu jami nya tsɔɔmi ɔ,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e wo e he nɔ, nɛ e li nɔ ko, se mohu e ngɛ gboe kɛ nɔ jemi kɛ nya sami nɛ hɛkɔ, pɛ, musu bɔmi munyuhi, nihi a he susumi yaya jee mi ɔ,

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: nɛ ji yakayaka ngmlaa kpami nɛ nimli nɛ a juɛmi puɛ nɛ a kpɔ anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ a dɛ nɛ a susuɔ kaa Mawu jami ji ni nami ɔ.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Se niinɛ, ni nami agbo ji Mawu jami, ke nɔ ko bua jɔ e nihi a he ɔ.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Ejakaa waa kɛ nɔ ko nɔ́ ko bɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ e fɔɔ si paa kaa wa be nyɛe waa kɛ nɔ ko maa ya hulɔ.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Se ke wa ngɛ ngma kɛ he hami nihi kɛkɛ ɔ, e sa kaa wa bua nɛ jɔ he.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ hlaa nɛ a na ni fuu ɔ, nɔɔ ka kɛ klama kɛ kuasiahi akɔnɔhi fuu nɛ puɛɔ nɔ nɛ tsɛɛ nihi ngɔ woɔ hɛ mi kpatami kɛ laami mi ɔ mi.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Ejakaa ni yayahi kulaa sipoku ji sika suɔmi nɛ ni komɛ di se nɛ a tla blɔ kɛ je hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, nɛ a kɛ piimi babauu gbɔ a tsui mi ɔ. Nitsɔɔmi kɛ ha Timoteo nitsɛ

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ, oo Mawu nɔmlɔ, tuu ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nya fo, nɛ o nyɛɛ dami, Mawu jami, hemi kɛ yemi, suɔmi, tsui sitomi kɛ mi mi jɔmi se.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Hwu hemi kɛ yemi ta kpakpa a, pɛtɛ neneene wami ɔ he, nɔ́ he hulɔ nɛ a tsɛ mo kɛ ba benɛ o jaje jajemi kpakpa ngɛ odasefohi fuu a hɛ mi, ɔ.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo kita woe ngɛ Mawu nɛ haa nihi tsuo kulaa wami ɔ kɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ ye jajemi kpakpa a he odase ngɛ Pontio Pilato yi nɔ ɔ hɛ mi,

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: kaa o ye kita a nɔ, nɛ kpa ko loo piami ko ko hi he kɛ yaa su wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ mi.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ hewami nɔyelɔ kake nɛ da gbaa, matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, kɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa je kpo ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e be mi ɔ;

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ lɛ e nɔ kake lɛ ngɛ neneene si himi nɛ gbenɔ be mi, nɛ e hii la nɛ a be nyɛemaa su he ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ ko nɔmlɔ ko nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ, nɛ e be lɛ nyɛe maa na hulɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji neneene bu kɛ he wami ɔ. Amen.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, wo mɛ kita konɛ a ko susu ni nguahi, nɛ a ko ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ni nami nɛ be sɔkee ɔ nɔ, se mohu Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ haa wɔ babauu ke waa ye mi ngɔmi ɔ.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: A pee kpakpa, nɛ a plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ kpakpa peemi blɔfami, a suɔ nɔ hami, a ko pee kpɛle,

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: a to juetli ngɔ ha a he, nɛ e pee sisi tomi kpakpa ha be nɛ maa ba a, konɛ a pɛtɛ anɔkuale wami ɔ he.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Oo Timoteo! nihi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ mi ɔ baa yi, nɛ o kua yakayaka ni sɛɛmi nɛ bleɔ nɔ kɛ nɔ jemi munyu nɛ je lakpa ni lemi mi ɔ,

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: nɔ́ nɛ ni komɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ngɛ nɛ a tla blɔ kɛ je hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he ɔ. Dloomi ɔ kɛ mo nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Paulo nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya kɛ wami nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ he si womi nya a,

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: ngma ya ha e suɔmi bi Timoteo ɔ: Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu dɛ mi ɔ ha mo! Sinami kɛ he wami womi

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: I naa Mawu nɛ i kɛ ye nimeli jaa ngɛ he nile klɔuu mi ɔ si, kaa i jɔɔ we mo kaimi gblee ngɛ ye pɛɛ kpamihi a mi nyɔ kɛ pia,

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: nɛ ke i kai o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ, i hlaa kaa ma na mo, konɛ ye bua nɛ jɔ.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: Ye hɛ ngɛ o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ lakpa be mi ɔ nɔ, nɔ́ nɛ kekle nɛ e ngɛ o na Loise kɛ o nyɛ Eunike mi, nɛ i ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ kaa e ngɛ mo hu o mi ɔ.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo kaie kaa, Mawu dloomi ke nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o mi ngɛ ye nine nɛ i kɛ pue o nɔ ɔ nya a, tle lɛ si nɛ e tso,

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: ejakaa Mawu hi wɔ gbeye yemi mumi, se mohu he wami kɛ suɔmi kɛ juɛmi nɛ sa mumi ekɛ ha wɔ.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zo ko pee mo ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he odase yemi ɔ he aloo ngɛ imi nɛ i ji e pa mi no ɔ he, se mohu o kɛ mi gbo dengme ngɛ sane kpakpa a he ngɛ Mawu he wami nya.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ he wa yi wami nɛ e kɛ tsɛmi klɔuklɔu tsɛ wɔ, pi ngɛ wa ni tsumihi a nya, se mohu ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi kɛ e dloomi nya, nɔ́ nɛ e ngɔ ha wɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi loko a bɔ je ɔ,

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: nɛ jehanɛ a gu wa yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo he kpo jemi ɔ nɔ je lɛ si paa a; nɔ nɛ po gbenɔ se nɛ e je wami kɛ neneene si himi kpo tsɔɔ wɔ ngɛ sane kpakpa a mi,

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: nɔ́ he nɛ a wo mi fiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo kɛ maje li ɔmɛ a tsɔɔlɔ ɔ,

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu he nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ nae nɔ nɛ. Se kɛ ɔ, e pee we mi zo, ejakaa i le nɔ nɛ i he ye ɔ, nɛ i ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ kaa e ma nyɛ nihi nɛ e to ha mi ɔmɛ a he maa bu kɛ ya si jamɛ a Ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Pɛtɛ tsami munyu nɛ o nu kɛ je ye nya a nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ɔ he ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ mi.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Ni kpakpahi nɛ a tu wo o dɛ ɔ buu he ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ hii wa mi ɔ he wami nya!

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: O le enɛ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Asia a tsuo kpa ngɛ ye se, a ti ni komɛ ji Fegelo kɛ Hermogene.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ na Onesiforo we ɔ mɔbɔ, ejakaa e baa kpitikpiti, ba haa mi tsui, nɛ zo pee we lɛ ngɛ ye tsu mi womi ɔ he;

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: se benɛ e ba Roma a e bɔ mɔde ba hla mi nɛ e na mi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha e na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi mɔbɔnami ngɛ jamɛ a Ligbi ɔ nɔ. Nɛ bɔ nɛ e plɛ kɛ sɔmɔ mi ngɛ Efeso ɔ, o le pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ moo lɛɛ, ye bi, o he nɛ wa ngɛ dloomi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ mi.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ o nu ngɛ ye nya ngɛ odasefohi fuu a nya a, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu o tu ngɔ wo nimli anɔkualetsɛmɛ a dɛ, nihi nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a ma kɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi hulɔ.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Mia o hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ nami mi, kaa Yesu Kristo ta bulɔ kpakpa ko.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nyɛɛ we ta blɔ nɛ e kɛ e he wo we mi munyuhi a mi, ejakaa e suɔ kaa e sa e tatsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni ɔ, lɛ kekle sa kaa e ye ngmɔ ni ɔ eko. Susuu nɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ha o na nihi kulaa sisi.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: O hɛ nɛ hi Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ te si kɛ je gbeje nɛ je David nina mi ɔ nɔ, bɔ nɛ i fiɛ ngɛ ye sane kpakpa a mi ɔ,

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: nɔ́ nɛ he amane nɛ i ngɛ nae, kɛ yaa su kpa mi tete, kaa yayami peelɔ ko; se kɛ ɔ, Mawu munyu ɔ, a wui lɛ kpa

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ i miaa ye hɛ mi ngɛ sanehi kulaa mi ngɛ nihi nɛ ahla mɛ ɔ a he, konɛ mɛ hu a nine nɛ su yi wami hemi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ kɛ neneene hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke waa kɛ lɛ gbo ɔ, waa kɛ lɛ ma na wami hulɔ.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Ke wa mia wa hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ nami mi ɔ, waa kɛ lɛ maa ye matsɛ hulɔ; Ke wa kpa ngɛ e se ɔ, lɛ hu e ma kpa ngɛ wa se.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Ke wa pee we wa he anɔkualetsɛmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e maa hi si anɔkualetsɛ, ejakaa e be nyɛe ma je lɛ nitsɛ e he se.” Nitsulɔ kpakpa

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Kaii mɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o ma nɔ mi ha mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, ykonɛ a ko hwu lilɛ ta nɛ se nami ko be he, se e butuu nihi nɛ nuɔ ɔ mohu ɔ.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o da si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa znɔ ko nɛ sa, ni tsulɔ nɛ gbo we zo nɛ tsɔɔ anɔkuale munyu ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Se yakayaka ni sɛɛmi nɛ bleɔ nɔ ɔ, sã o he kɛ je he; ejakaa e fieɔ nihi kɛ jee Mawu he kɛ yaa lokoo,

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: nɛ a munyu ɔ ma sã nɔ kaa hiɔ yaya sãa nɔ ɔ: a ti ni komɛ ji Himeneo kɛ Fileto,

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ tla blɔ kɛ je anɔkuale ɔ he, nɛ a deɔ ke si temi ɔ be momo, nɛ a butuu ni komɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Se Mawu sisi tomi tɛ na he wa a maa si kpɛii, nɛ e hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a nyasɔomi nɔ nɛ ɔ: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le lɛ nitsɛ e ni ɔmɛ,” kɛ: “Ha nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ Kristo biɛ ɔ ta a nɛ sã e he kɛ je nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a he.”

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: We ngua ko mi ɔ pi sika tsu nihi kɛ sika hiɔ nihi kɛkɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se mohu tso nihi kɛ zu nihi hu ngɛ mi, ekomɛ ɔ a buo, se ekomɛ hu a bui.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ke nɔ ko tsukɔ e he kɛ je kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e ma plɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a buu nɛ a tsukɔ he klɔuu nɛ hi ha wetsɛ ɔ saminya nɛ a dla lɛ kɛ ha ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Se nihewi a kɔnɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, tuu nya fo, nɛ o kɛ nihi nɛ tsɛɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ jee tsui nɛ mi tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ dami, hemi kɛ yemi, suɔmi kɛ he jɔmi se.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Se kuasiahi a nɔ jemi nɛ a kɛ kase we nɔ ko ɔ guu, ejakaa o le kaa e kɛ pɛ baa.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, e sɛ kaa e pɛɛ, se mohu e mi nɛ jɔ ha nihi kulaa, nɔ nɛ le ni tsɔɔmi, nɔ nɛ toɔ e tsui si haa yayami,

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ kɛ mi mi jɔmi tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi nɛ tee si siɔ lɛ ɔ, kaa alinɔ Mawu ma ha mɛ tsui tsakemi nɛ a le anɔkuale ɔ lo?

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ tsɔ mɛ kɛ je abosiami klama a mi, ejakaa e kɛ du mɛ nɛ a pee e suɔmi nya ni.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Se na nɛ o le kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, he hiami be maa ba.

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: Ejakaa nimli ma plɛ a he hesuɔli, sikasuɔli, fiali, he woli, musu bɔli, fɔli a nɔ tue gboli, otlumuhi, nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we,

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ plee we nɔ he, somi mi kuli, sieku yeli, nihi nɛ nyɛ we a kɔnɔ nɔ nɛ a ye, nihi nɛ a hɛ jɔɛ, nihi nɛ sume nɔ́ kpakpa,

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: nɔ se blɔ tsɔɔli, yi mi wali, he nɔ woli, nihi nɛ suɔ fiɛmi nɛ ngɔɔ pe Mawu,

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ hɛɛ Mawu jami su, se a kua e mi he wami ɔ. Sã o he kɛ je kikɛmɛ a nimli a he?

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ ji nihi nɛ juɔ si sɛɛ wehi a mi nɛ a ya ngɔɔ yihi nɛ be yi mi nɛ yayami ye a nɔ nɛ akɔnɔ slɔɔtohi kpakaa mɛ

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: nɛ a hlaa ni kasemi, se kɛ ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a le anɔkuale ɔ.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Se kaa bɔ nɛ Yane kɛ Yambre te si si Mose ɔ, ja nɔuu kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kuɔ anɔkuale ɔ nya, nihi nɛ a yi mi puɛ, nihi nɛ pi ni komɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ blɔfami.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: A be a hɛ mi yae tsɔ ko, ejakaa a kuasia peemi ɔ maa je kpo paa ngɛ nihi tsuo a hɛ mi, kaa bɔ nɛ Yane kɛ Yambremɛ a nɔ ɔ hu je kpo ɔ. Nyagbe ni tsɔɔmi

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ, o le ye tsɔɔmi, ye je mi bami, ye yi mi tomi, ye hemi kɛ yemi, ye tsui si tomi, ye suɔmi, ye hɛ mi miami,

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: ye nɔ namihi, ye omane hluhi nɛ i na ngɛ Antiokia kɛ Ikonium kɛ Listra a; yi mi wamihi abɔ nɛ i na nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je mi kɛ je kulaa mi ɔ.
