english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nihi kulaa hu nɛ hlaa kaa a hi si ngɛ Mawu jami nya ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, a maa wa mɛ yi mi.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Se nimli yayamihi kɛ sisili maa ya hɛ mi ngɛ yayami peemi mi; a sisiɔ nihi, nɛ mɛ hu a sisiɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ hii si ngɛ nihi nɛ o kase nɛ o ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ ɔmɛ a mi, ejakaa o le nɔ nɛ nya nɛ o kase kɛ je,

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: nɛ o jokuɛwi a si o je nɛ o le ngmami klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ ma nyɛ ma ha o le nihi nɛ maa gu Kristo Yesu nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ kɛ ya yi wami hemi mi ɔ.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Ngmami tsuaa ngmami nɛ je Mawu mumi mi ɔ, e hi ha ni tsɔɔmi kɛ hɛ mi kami kɛ nɔ dlami kɛ tsɔsemi nɛ ngɛ dami mi ɔ,

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: konɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si, nɛ a dla lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ha ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo dee faii ngɛ Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ maa ba ba kojo hɛ kali kɛ ni gbogboehi ngɛ e bami kɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ hɛ mi ke:

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: Fiɛ munyu ɔ, koo jɔɔ, deka ngɛ jio, deka be jio, ka hɛ mi, wo ga, bɔɔ kɔkɔ ngɛ tsui si tomi kɛ ni tsɔɔmi kulaa mi.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Ejakaa be ko maa ba nɛ a be anɔkuale tsɔɔmi ɔ tue bue hu, ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɔnɔ ɔmɛ a nya, se mohu a ma bua tsɔɔli a nya ngɔ wo a he, ninɛmɛ nɛ ma de mɛ nihi nɛ a suɔ kaa a nu.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: A ma blɛ anɔkuale ɔ ngɔ pue a tue se, nɛ a maa kpale ya bu nyaziahi mohu tue.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ, o hɛ nɛ ka si ngɛ nihi kulaa mi, mia o hɛ mi ngɛ dengme gbomihi a mi, tsu sane kpakpa jajelɔ ni tsumi ɔ, nɛ gbee o sɔmɔmi ni tsumi ɔ nya kulaa!

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ami lɛɛ, a ngɛ ye muɔ plee kɛ ngɛ si puee mo kaa bɔ, nɛ ye jemi be ɔ su.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: Ta kpakpa a, i hwu; fo ɔ, i tu gbe nya; hemi kɛ yemi ɔ i hɛɛ mi;

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ piɛ nɛ fɔɔ si ha mi ji dami jlasi ɔ, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ ji dami kojolɔ ɔ ma ha mi ngɛ jamɛ a Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ pi ye nɔ kake nɛ e ma ha, se mohu nihi kulaa nɛ suɔ e bami ɔ hulɔ ɔ. Slɔmi ha Timoteo nitsɛ

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba ye ngɔ mla.

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɛ Dema suɔ amlɔ amlɔ je nɛ ɔ mi he je ɔ, e je ye he kɛ ho Tesalonika ya; Kreske ho Galata ya, Tito ho Dalmatia ya;

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luka pɛ lɛ e kɛ mi ngɛ. Ngɔɔ Marko nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba, ejakaa e hi ha mi ngɛ sɔmɔmi ɔ he.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: Tihiko ɔ lɛɛ i tsɔ lɛ Efeso.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Kotoku ɔ nɛ i je he ngɛ Troia ngɛ Karpo ngɔ ɔ, o kɛ ba, kɛ womi ɔmɛ hulɔ, se titli ɔ lohwehi a he womi nɛ a ngmaa ni ngɛ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Aleksandro, sɔlɔ ɔ, peemi yayami wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ to lɛ nane mi ngɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ a nya.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Mo hu hyɛ o he nɔ nɛ hi ngɛ e he, ejakaa e te si ngɔ si wa munyu ɔmɛ wawɛɛ.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Ngɛ ye kekle nya jemi ɔ mi ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ya sɛ mi, se mohu mɛ kulaa a si mi, a ko bu enɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ fi ye se nɛ e wo mi he wami, konɛ a gu ye nɔ kɛ ma fiɛmi ɔ nɔ mi, nɛ maje li ɔmɛ kulaa a nu, nɛ a je mi kɛ je jata a nya mi.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma je mi kokooko kɛ maa je ni yayahi kulaa mi, nɛ e ma he ye yi wami kɛ maa ya e hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi: Lɛ a ngɔ anuminyami ngɔ ha kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene! Amen. Nyagbe sɛyemi

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: I biɔ Priska kɛ Akwila kɛ Onesiforo we ɔ.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Erasto ngɛ Korinto; se Trofimo ɔ, i si lɛ ngɛ Mileto nɛ e ngɛ gboe.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba loko fiɛ be ɔ nɛ su. Eubulo kɛ Pude kɛ Lino kɛ Klaudia kɛ nyamimɛ ɔmɛ kulaa ke a biɔ mo.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ o mumi ɔ nɛ hi si! Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Paulo, Mawu sɔmɔlɔ, kɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo. Ahla mi nɛ a tsɔ mi nɛ ma ya ye bua ninɛmɛ nɛ Mawu hla amɛ a hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ ma kɛ mɛ nɛ ba anɔkuale nɛ wa jami ɔ tsɔɔ,

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: nɛ maa si ngɛ neneene wami ɔ he hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ mi. Mawu nɛ yi lakpa a wo wɔ kikɛmɛ a wami nɛ ɔ he si loko a bɔ je mi be ɔmɛ,

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: nɛ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ, e je lɛ si ngɛ e munyu ɔ mi. Fiɛmi sane nɛ ɔ a tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ ngɛ Mawu nɛ ji wa yi wami helɔ ɔ fami nya.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: I ngma ya ha Tito nɛ ji ye bi nitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ nɔuu blɔfami ɔ: Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo, wa yiwami helɔ ɔ, dɛ mi ɔ ha mo! Tito nitsumi ngɛ Kreta

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ i si mo ngɛ Kreta a ji konɛ o to nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ blɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ o wo nikɔtɔmahi ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi, kaa bɔ nɛ i de mo momo ɔ:

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ ji, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee nɔ ko nɛ piami ko be e he, nɛ e ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo kake, nɛ e ngɛ bimɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ nɛ a tui a he munyu yaya kaa yaholi loo tuegboli ji mɛ.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, e sɛ kaa piami ko hii e he, akɛnɛ Mawu we mi sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma ji lɛ he je ɔ; pi nɔ nɛ peɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tsui nya ni, pi mi mi latsɛ, pi da nulɔ, pi nine kpokpookpotsɛ, pi kpɛletsɛ,

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: se mohu nibwɔ peelɔ, nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔ́ nɛ hi, nɔ nɛ juɛmi ka si, dalɔ, nɔ nɛ he tsɔ, nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ka si,

english_verse: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ hɛɛ anɔkuale tsɔɔmi ɔ mi, konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi ngɛ ni tsɔɔmi nɛ tsaa nɔ ɔ mi, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ tee si siɔ munyu ɔ hu, e ka a hɛ mi.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi fuu ngɛ nɛ ji atua tsɔli kɛ yakayaka munyu tuli nɛ sisiɔ nɔ, titli ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ je nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ;

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ sa kaa a ku a nya, ejakaa a butuu we mlukuhi kulaa, nɛ zo nihi a se nami he ɔ a tsɔɔ tsɔɔmihi nɛ dɛ.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: A ti nɔ ko nɛ ji mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbalɔ ɔ de ke: “Kretabi yeɔ lakpa daa; lohwe yayamihi kɛ jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ kɛ hejɔli.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Odase nɛ ɔ ɔ anɔkuale ʼi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kã a hɛ mi veveeve, konɛ a he nɛ wa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi,

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: nɛ a ko bu Yudafohi a nyazia amɛ kɛ nimli nɛ kpaleɔ kɛ jee anɔkuale ɔ mi ɔ a kita amɛ tue.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, nihi kulaa he tsɔ ha mɛ; se nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we kɛ nihi nɛ he we yi ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ he tsɔ ha mɛ, se mohu a yi mi kɛ a he nile kulaa mi sɛ mu.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: A deɔ ke a le Mawu, se a kɛ a ni tsumihi kuaa lɛ, nɛ a ji musutsɛmɛ, kɛ tue gboli, nihi nɛ hi ha ni tsumi kpakpa ko kulaa.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ tsɔɔ tsɔɔmi kpakpa a.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Nimowi ɔmɛ ɔ, kãa a hɛ nɛ ka si, a pee nihi nɛ a hɛ mi jiɔ, a juɛmi nɛ ka si, a he nɛ wa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi kɛ tsui si tomi mi.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Yimowi hu ja nɔuu kãa a ba a je mi bɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. A ko tu nihi a he munyu a ko pee dadeli, a pee nihi nɛ tsɔɔ ni kpakpahi,

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: konɛ a tsɔɔ yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ a suɔ a hunomɛ, a suɔ a bimɛ,

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: a hɛ nɛ ka si, a he nɛ tsɔ, a baa a we yi saminya, a mi mi nɛ jɔ, a ba a he si ha a hunomɛ, konɛ a ko tu Mawu munyu ɔ he musu bɔmi munyu.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Nihewi hu ja nɔuu, tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ konɛ a juɛmi nɛ ka si.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: munyu kpakpa nɛ a be he nɔ yaya ko nae nɛ a ma de, benɛ pee nɛ zo nɛ gbe nɔ nɛ kɛ wɔ yi ɔ, ejakaa e be wa he nɔ́ yaya ko nɛ e ma de.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, de mɛ ke a ba a he si ngɔ ha a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, a sa a hɛ mi ngɛ nihi tsuo mi, a ko je munyu nya,

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: a ko ju, se mohu a kɛ anɔkuale yemi nitsɛ nɛ tsɔɔ mɛ, konɛ a kɛ wo Mawu nɛ ji wa yi wami helɔ ɔ tsɔɔmi ɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nihi kulaa mi.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu dloomi nɛ a kɛ heɔ nimli kulaa a yi wami ɔ je kpo,

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: nɛ e tsɔseɔ wɔ konɛ wa kua nɔ yaya peemi kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ waa kɛ juɛmi kpakpa kɛ dami kɛ Mawu gbeye yemi nɛ hi si ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi,

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: nɛ waa hyɛ Mawu Ope ɔ kɛ wa yiwami helɔ Yesu Kristo gbaami nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ he kpo jemi ɔ blɔ;

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ ngɔ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ wa nane mi, konɛ e kpɔ wɔ kɛ je nɔ tɔmi kulaa mi, nɛ e tsukɔ wa he ngɔ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma klɔuu nɛ hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi a he.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: De mɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o wo mɛ ga ngɛ he, nɛ o kã a hɛ mi ngɛ he kɛ he wami tsuo. Ko ha nɔ ko nɛ ngɔ mo kaa nɔ nɛ sɛ bumi.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Kaii mɛ nɛ a ba a he si ngɔ ha nikɔtɔmahi kɛ nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, a bu mɛ tue, a dla a he kɛ ha ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa,

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Ejakaa sa a wɔ hu wa li nɔ́ ko, tue gboli, blɔ dali, nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ akɔnɔ ni kɛ helo se di ni slɔɔtohi fuu, nɛ wa baa wa je mi ngɛ ni yayahi kɛ he tsɛmi mi, wa he ngɛ tai, nɛ wa nyɛɛ wa he.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Mawu nɛ ji yi wami helɔ ɔ mi mi jɔmi kɛ e nimli a he dɔmi ɔ je kpo ɔ,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ lɛɛ pi dami ni tsumihi nɛ wa tsu nya, se mohu lɛ nitsɛ e mɔbɔ nami nya, kɛ gu ehe fɔmi, he dumi kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ehe peemi ɔ nɔ he wa yiwami,

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ gu Yesu Kristo wa yi wami helɔ ɔ nɔ plɛ pue wa nɔ babauu ɔ,

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: konɛ bɔ nɛ a wo wɔ nguɔ ngɛ lɛ nɔuu e dloomi nya a, a ha waa pee neneene wami ɔ yeli ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ nya.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ mi i ngɛ hlae kaa o ma, konɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a he Mawu nɔ ye ɔ, a bɔ nitsumi kpakpahi a he mɔde. Enɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ ngɛ fɛu nɛ hi ha nimli.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Se kuasiahi a nɔ jemi kɛ weku sisi tsɔɔmi kɛ pɛ kɛ mlaa he kunɔ nɔmi ɔ, sã o he kɛ je he, ejakaa a he be senami nɛ a pi nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɛ kɛ mi gbami baa a, ke o bɔ lɛ kɔkɔ si kake kɛ si enyɔ ɔ, kua lɛ;

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: ejakaa o le kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ ja a e je e glɔ nɔ, nɛ e he yayami ɔ buu lɛ fɔ. Nyagbe nitsɔɔmi

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Ke i tsɔ Artema loo Tihiko kɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba ye ngɔ ngɛ Nikopoli, ejakaa lejɛ ɔ i to kaa ma ya ye fiɛ be ɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔɔde nɛ o wo Zena, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ kɛ Apolo blɔ saminya nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he ko hia mɛ.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Ninɛmɛ nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ kulaa ke a biɔ mo. Wa biɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ suɔ wɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ. Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Paulo nɛ ji Kristo Yesu opa mi no ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ngma ya ha Filemon, wa suɔlɔ kɛ wa huɛ ni tsulɔ ɔ, kɛ asafo nɛ kpee ngɛ o we ɔ tsuo

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: kɛ wa nyɛmi yo Apia, kɛ Arkipo nɛ ji wa huɛ ta bu lɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! Filemon suɔmi kɛ hemi kɛ yemi

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: I naa ye Mawu ɔ si daa, nɛ i woɔ o ta ngɛ ye pɛɛ kpamihi a mi,

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: akɛnɛ i nuɔ o suɔmi kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o hɛɛ ngɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ;

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: nɛ i kpaa pɛɛ kaa kikɛmɛ a huɛ bɔmi nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ nɛ ha mo sisi numi ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa nɛ wa nyɛɔ tsuɔ ha Kristo Yesu ɔ mi.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Ejakaa i na bua jɔmi babauu kɛ tsui ngɛ o suɔmi ɔ he, mami, akɛnɛ o ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a tsui nɔ a mi ɔ. Pɛɛkpami ha Onesimo

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: kɛ̃ ɔ, suɔmi he ɔ, pɛɛ mohu i ngɛ mo kpae. Hyɛ imi nɔmoyo Paulo bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu i ji Yesu Kristo pa mi no nɛ ɔ;

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: i kpa mo pɛɛ ngɛ yebi Onesimo nɛ i fɔ ngɛ ye tsu mi womi ɔ mi ɔ he,

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ sa a e he be se nami ko ha mo, se jeha nɛ ɔ e he ngɛ se nami saminya ha i kɛ mo tsuo ɔ.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: I ko suɔ kaa e kɛ mi nɛ hi si konɛ e sɔmɔ mi ngɛ o nane mi ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi mi.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Se i sume kaa ma je o se kɛ pee nɔ́ ko, benɛ pee nɛ nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ o maa pee ɔ e ko ba pee nɔ nyɛmi nya ni, se mohu tsui mi jɔmi nya ni.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Ejakaa eko ɔ enɛ ɔ he nɛ nyɛ kpɛti gba bɔɔ ɔ nɛ, konɛ jehanɛ e hi o ngɔ kulaa,

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: pi kaa sɔmɔlɔ hu, se mohu nɔ nɛ pe sɔmɔlɔ tete, nɔ nɛ ji suɔmi nyɛmi, nɛ i fiɛ we e he, nɛ mo mohu e ji o nɔ kulaa ngɛ he lo kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔfami ɔ.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ ke o buu mi kaa o nyɛmi ɔ, he lɛ kaa o ma he imi nitsɛ.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Ke e ye mo sane yaya ko aloo ke e hɛɛ mo hiɔ ko ɔ, buu jamɛ a akɔtaa a ba ha mi.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nitsɛ, i ngɛ enɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ye nine kaa, ma wo mo hiɔ

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Ee, mami, ha ma na o he se ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi; ha ye tsui nɛ nɔ ye mi ngɛ Kristo mi.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ dla he ko ngɔ to mi, ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa nyɛ pɛɛ kpami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a maa ngmɛɛ ye he ha nyɛ ekohu. Nyagbe sɛyemi

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafra, nɛ ji ye huɛ pa mi no ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ ke e biɔ mo,

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: kɛ Marko hulɔ kɛ Aristarko kɛ Dema kɛ Luka, nihi nɛ ji ye huɛmɛ ni tsuli.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ mumi ɔ nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Blema be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Mawu kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu munyu kɛ gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ, ngɛ blɔ slɔɔtohi a nɔ,

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: se ngɛ nyagbe ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, e Bi ɔ nya e kɛ wɔ tu munyu ngɛ, nɔ nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee nihi kulaa yelɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ nɔ hu nɛ e gu kɛ bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi ni ɔmɛ;

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: nɔ hu nɛ ji e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kpɛmi ɔ su ɔ henɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami munyu ɔ hɛɔ nihi kulaa a, benɛ e tsukɔ wa he kɛ je wa he yayami ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, e ho ya hi si ngɛ hɛ mi nyamitsɛ agbo ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe. Bi ɔ kle pe hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ Bi ɔ kle pe hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ akɛnɛ biɛ nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ kle pe a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Ejakaa te bɔfo nɛ Mawu de lɛ hyɛ ke: “Ye bi ji mo, Mwɔnɛ i fɔ mo?” Loo, “Ma pee e tsɛ, Nɛ lɛ hu e maa pe ye bi?” ɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ e kɛ e bi Tete ɔ ma je ɔ mi ɔ, e kpale de ke: “Ha Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ a ja lɛ.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ, e de ngɛ a he ke: “Nɔ nɛ plɛɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ peɔ kɔɔhiɔhi, Nɛ e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ hu e peɔ mɛ la lilɛhi” ɔ.

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Se Bi ɔ lɛɛ e de ngɛ e he ke: “Oo Mawu, o matsɛ sɛ ɔ maa si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene Nɛ o matsɛ yemi tso ɔ, dami matsɛ yemi tso ʼi,

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: O suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, o nyɛɛ nɔ́ yaya peemi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Mawu nɛ ji o Mawu ɔ Kɛ bua jɔmi nu ɔ pɔ mo pe o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Kɛ jehanɛ: “Nyɔmtsɛ, sisije ɔ, Mo lɛ o to zugba a sisi, Nɛ hiɔwe ɔ, o nine nya ni tsumi ʼi.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata, se moo lɛɛ, o ngɛ daa, nɛ mɛ tsuo a maa bwɔ kaa tade;

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Nɛ o ma koklo mɛ kaa bo, nɛ a ma tsake; Se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ nɔuu, nɛ o jeha amɛ tɛ̃.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Se hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ po nɛ e de ngɛ e he hyɛ ke: “Hii ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ Kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ O he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ pee o nane si sɛ?” ɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Anɛ mɛ kulaa a, pi mumihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ ji mɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ ma na yi wami hemi ɔ a sɔmɔmi he je nɛ a tsɔ mɛ?

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ e sa kaa waa pɛtɛ nihi nɛ wa nu ɔmɛ a he wawɛɛ konɛ wa ko tsɔ kɛ je he.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke munyu nɛ a tu ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi a nya a maa si kpɛii, nɛ a wo nɔ tɔmi tsuaa nɔ tɔmi kɛ tuegbenɔ tsuaa tuegbenɔ he hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa a,

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: kɛ wa maa pee kɛ tu nya fo kɛɛ, ke wa bui kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ? Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ji nɔ nɛ tu he munyu kekle, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ nu ɔ hu ma nɔ mi ha wɔ,

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: nɛ Mawu nitsɛ hu kɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi kɛ hewami nihi slɔɔtohi kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hami ɔ ngɛ he odase yee kɛ ngɛ nɔ sie, ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya. Yi wami hemi mi hɛminyɛɛlɔ

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi hiɔwe bɔfohi a sisi nɛ e kɛ je nɛ maa ba nɛ wa ngɛ he munyu tue ɔ wo.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Nɔ ko ye he odase faii ngɛ he ko ke: “Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ o kaii lɛ? Loo nɔmlɔ bi hu nɛ o hɛ ngɛ e he nɔ?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Piɛ bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ o ha e kɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi nɛ sɔ; O kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu fi lɛ jlasi.”

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: O ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ woʼe nane si. Ejakaa ke e kɛ nihi kulaa wo e nane si ɔ, e piɛ́ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ wui e sisi. Jehanɛ wa na we nɛ waa na kaa a kɛ nihi tsuo wo e sisi.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ a ha nɛ piɛ bɔɔ nɛ e kɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔ ɔ, wa na kaa Yesu ʼi, nɔ nɛ gbenɔ mi amanehlu ɔ he nɛ a kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu fi lɛ jlasi ɔ, benɛ pee nɛ Mawu dloomi nya a e sa e nya gbenɔ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e sa lɛ, nɔ nɛ he nɛ nihi kulaa ngɛ kɛ nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ a gu nɛ nihi kulaa ngɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ bimɛ babauu kɛ baa hɛ mi nyami mi ɔ, kaa e ha a yi wami hemi tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a nɛ gu amanehluhi a mi nɛ e hi kɛ pi si.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsukɔɔ nihi a he kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a tsukɔɔ a he ɔ kulaa je nɔ kake mi, lɔɔ he je nɛ zo pee we lɛ kaa e ma tsɛ mɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Nɛ eke: “Ma wo o biɛ ɔ tã ngɔ tsɔɔ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ; Asafo kpɛti hu ma la kɛ je o yi ngɛ.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Kɛ jehanɛ hu: “Ma ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.” Kɛ jehanɛ: “Oʼɛ mi kɛ bimɛ nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha mi ɔ.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ akɛnɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛ he lo kɛ muɔ he je ɔ, lɛ hu e ngɔ kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu eko kaa mɛ, konɛ e gu gbenɔ nɔ kɛ kpata nɔ nɛ ngɛ gbenɔ nɔ he wami nɛ ji abosiami ɔ hɛ mi,

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: nɛ e kpɔ nihi nɛ gbenɔ gbeye yemi he ɔ a plɛ pee nyɔguɛhi ngɛ a wami be kulaa mi ɔ.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e fɔɔ si faii kaa, tsa pi hiɔwe bɔfohi nɛ e yeɔ buaa, se mohu Abraham nina e yeɔ buaa.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nihi kulaa blɔfami ɔ, e sa kaa e hi kaa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ e plɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ kɛ anɔkuale osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, konɛ e kpa ma a yi musu.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Ejakaa akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ ɔ e na amanehlu nɛ a ka lɛ he je ɔ, e nyɛɔ e yeɔ buaa ninɛmɛ nɛ a kaa mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ tɛ̃tɛ̃ nyɛ hɛ mi, nyɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ na hiɔwe tsemi ɔ eko, nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ Yesu wa hemi kɛ yemi jajemi ɔ he bɔfo kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a;

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ nɛ hla lɛ ɔ anɔkuale, kaa bɔ nɛ Mose hu ye Mawu we ɔ kulaa nɔ anɔkuale ɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ bɔɔ we ko ɔ bu hiɛ pe we ɔ nɔ́ ɔ, ja nɔuu Yesu hu hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe Mose.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: We tsuaa we ɔ nɔ ko kɛ̃ lɛ bɔɔ, se nɔ nɛ bɔɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ji Mawu.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Mose ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ kaa sɔmɔlɔ, konɛ e ye nihi nɛ a ma de ɔmɛ a he odase;

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: se Kristo ɔ e ye anɔkuale kaa bi ngɛ Mawu we ɔ nɔ; lɛ e we ji wɔ, ke wa hɛɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kã kɛ fiami ɔ mi kpɛii kɛ ya su nyagbe ɔ. Hejɔɔmi ha Mawu webi

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de ɔ: “Mwɔnɛ, ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko wlua nyɛ tsui, Kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ngɛ mi mi la womi ɔ mi, Ngɛ nyatsɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: He nɛ nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔ ye nya nɛ a ka mi, Nɛ a na ye ni tsumi ɔmɛ ngɛ, jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu ɔ.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ye mi mi fu jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ Nɛ i ke: ‘Daa nɛ ɔ a tlaa blɔ ngɛ a juɛmi mi, Nɛ a li ye blɔ ɔmɛ.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ ha ye mi mi fu nɛ i ka kita Ke: ‘Ke a sɛ ye he jɔɔmi ɔ mi fii!’ ”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, mamimɛ, konɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko ko hi tsui nɛ he we yi nɛ e kpale kɛ je Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ he;

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: se mohu nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ligbi tsuaa ligbi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ “mwɔnɛ” ɔ, konɛ yayami ko sisi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ wlua nyɛ tsui.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo he piɛli ji wɔ ke wa hɛɛ wa he nɛ waa kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ kɛ je sisije ɔ mi kpɛii kɛ ya su nyagbe ɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ de ke: “Mwɔnɛ ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ, Nyɛ ko wlua nyɛ tsui Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee Benɛ nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atua a.”

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ nu ɔ a ti mɛnɔmɛ lɛ a wo e mi mi la a? Anɛ pi ninɛmɛ nɛ kɛ Mose je Mizraim ɔ tsuo ʼi?

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛnɔmɛ a nɔ e kã kita ngɔ fɔ kaa a be e he jɔɔmi ɔ mi sɛe ɔ? Anɛ pi tuegboli ɔmɛ lo?

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Nɛ wa naa kaa hemi nɛ a he we yi ɔ he nɛ a nyɛ we mi nɛ a sɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu si e he jɔɔmi ɔ mi sɛmi he si womi ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha waa hyɛ nɛ hi konɛ alinɔ e ko ba mi kaa e fɔ wa ti nɔ ko.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wɔ hu a fiɛ Sane kpakpa a ngɔ ha wɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a fiɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ nɔuu; se kɛ̃ ɔ munyu nɛ a nu ɔ he ya bɛ́ se nami ha mɛ, ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ nu ɔ kɛ hemi kɛ yemi pɛtɛ we he.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa he ye ɔ wa ngɛ jamɛ a he jɔɔmi ɔ mi sɛe, kaa bɔ nɛ e de ɔ ke: “Lɔ ɔ ha i kɛ mi mi fumi ka kita ke: ‘Ke a sɛ ye he jɔɔmi ɔ mi fii!’ ” pohu a gbe Mawu ni tsumi ɔmɛ a nya kɛ je je mi sisije lokoo.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Ejakaa bɔ nɛ e de ngɛ he ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi kpaago ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nɛ Mawu jɔɔ e he ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi kpaago ɔ nɔ ngɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ kulaa mi;”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: nɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ e kpale de ke: “Ke a sɛ ye he jɔɔmi ɔ mi fii!”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ akɛnɛ e fɔɔ si kaa ni komɛ maa sɛ mi, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a fiɛ Sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ kekle ɔ sɛ we mi ngɛ hemi nɛ a he we yi ɔ he je ɔ,

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Mawu kpale to ligbi kpa ko ekohu, nɛ e de ngɛ David nya, ngɛ be babauu nɛ ɔ se ke, Mwɔnɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ la de sa a, “Mwɔnɛ ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ, Nyɛ ko wlua nyɛ tsui.’ ”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa Yosua na ha mɛ he jɔɔmi jinɛ, pee se ɔ Mawu ko tu we ligbi kpa ko he munyu hu.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ he jɔɔmi ligbi yemi ko fɔɔ si kɛ ha Mawu ma a.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Lɔɔ he ɔ nyɛ ha waa bɔ mɔde, konɛ waa sɛ jamɛ a he jɔɔmi ɔ mi, nɛ nɔ ko ko nyɛɛ jamɛ a tue gbomi blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e laa.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu munyu hɛ ngɛ nɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e nya ba pe klaate nya enyɔtsɛ, nɛ e gbuu kɛ sɛɛ mi kɛ ya suu be nɛ e gbaa klaa kɛ mumi ɔ kɛ kpɔji nya amɛ kɛ wu mi zɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e ji tsui mi susumihi kɛ juɛmi ɔmɛ a kojolɔ.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: A laa we bɔ nɔ́ ko ngɛ e hɛ mi, se nihi kulaa ngɛ paa nɛ a bli nɔ ngɛ lɛ nɔ nɛ waa kɛ ngɛ sane ɔ hɛngmɛ mi. Yesu osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma ngua a

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, akɛnɛ wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma ngua nɛ po mi kɛ gu hiɔwe nihi a mi, nɛ ji Yesu, Mawu bi ɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha waa pɛtɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he wawɛɛ.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ha waa kɛ kã nɛ hɛ wɔ kɛ su dloomi sɛ ɔ he, konɛ wa nine nɛ su mɔbɔ nami nɔ nɛ wa na dloomi nɛ maa ye bua wɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: kaa nɔ ko nɛ nyɛɔ e nuɔ nɔ́ he haa nihi nɛ li ni kɛ nihi nɛ tla blɔ ɔ, akɛ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu ɔ gbedemi bɔle e he kɛ kpe ɔ.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Nɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa, kaa bɔ nɛ e peɔ haa ma a, e pee ja nɔuu ngɔ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ e sa yayamihi a he bɔ.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ ko ngɔɛ hɛ mi nyami nɔ ha we lɛ nitsɛ e he, kaa ja Mawu tsɛ lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ Aaron hu ɔ.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu Kristo hu, pi lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma yemi mi, se mohu Mawu nɛ de lɛ ke: “Ye bi ji mo, mwɔnɛ i fɔ mo” ɔ, lɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ e de ngɛ he kpa hu ke: “Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene Ngɛ Melkizedek blɔ ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Ngɛ Yesu he lo be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, e ngɔ sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami nɛ ngmlaa kpami nɛ nya wa kɛ vo nyu piɛ he sa bɔ ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ma he lɛ kɛ je gbenɔ mi ɔ, nɛ a bu lɛ tue hulɔ, ejakaa e buu Mawu.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Nɛ pohu Mawu bi ji lɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ e kase tue bumi ngɛ amanehluhi nɛ e na amɛ a mi,

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: ejakaa Mawu wo lɛ osɔfo kaa Melkizedek. Sigbeemi he kɔkɔbɔmi

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ munyuhi fuu nɛ wa maa tu ngɛ enɛ ɔ he, se a sisi tsɔɔmi hu wa, ejakaa nyɛ tue mi ti;

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: ejakaa nyɛ nɛ jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛ plɛ tsɔɔli mohu ngɛ be ɔ nya a, e hia kaa a tsɔɔ nyɛ Mawu munyu ɔ mi sisije ni ɔmɛ ekohu, nɛ nyɛ plɛ nihi nɛ nyɔ nyu hia mɛ, se pi niyeni nitsɛ.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pupɔɔ nyɔ ɔ li nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ, ejakaa bimwɔyo ji lɛ.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Se ninɛmɛ nɛ wa a, a nɔ ji niyeni nitsɛ, nihi nɛ tsɔse a he numi ni ɔmɛ le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ kpakpa kɛ yayami kpɛti.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ha wa si Kristo he sisije ni tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ, nɛ waa po mi kɛ ya tsɔɔmihi nɛ sa kɛ ha nikɔtɔmahi a he; nɛ wa ko kpale to nitsumihi nɛ gbo a he tsui tsakemi kɛ Mawu nɔ hemi kɛ yemi,

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: kɛ baptisimihi a he ni tsɔɔmi kɛ ninehi kɛ nɔ nɔ puemi, kɛ gbogboehi a si temi kɛ neneene kojomi he sane ɔmɛ a sisi ekohu.

english_verse: Let's grow up, if God is willing.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ wa maa pee ke Mawu ngmɛ blɔ.

english_verse: But what about people who turn away after they have already seen the light and have received the gift from heaven and have shared in the Holy Spirit? What about those who turn away after they have received the good message of God and the powers of the future world? There is no way to bring them back. What they are doing is the same as nailing the Son of God to a cross and insulting him in public!
translation_verse: nɛ lɔ ɔ se nɛ a gbee si ɔ, a be nyɛe ma tsake mɛ ngɔ pee ni hehi ekohu ha tsui tsakemi, akɛnɛ a ngɛ Mawu bi ɔ sɛue ekohu kɛ ngɛ a he hae nɛ a ngɛ lɛ ahlua bɔe he ɔ.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ mii nyu nɛ nɛɛ pueɔ e nɔ kpitikpiti nɛ baa ni nɛ hi ha ninɛmɛ nɛ huɔ nɔ ɔ naa Mawu gbaami ɔ eko;

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: se ke mio kɛ hu e puɛɛ ɔ, a kuaa lɛ, nɛ Mawu gbiɛmi baa e nɔ, nɛ e nyagbe ji a kɛ la maa sa.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Se mamimɛ, wa ngɛ kikɛ dee mohu, se kɛ̃ ɔ wa hɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ kaa nyɛ sane hi pe ja, nɛ yi wami hemi maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu pi nɔ nɛ yeɔ sane nɛ dɛ́ nɛ e hɛ maa je nyɛ ni tsumi ɔ nɔ kɛ suɔmi he dengme nɛ nyɛ gbo ngɛ e biɛ ɔ he, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sɔmɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ pa kɛ ngɛ mɛ sɔmɔe kɛ mwɔ ɔ.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ hlae kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ kikɛmɛ a mɔde bɔmi nɛ ɔ nɔuu, konɛ a ma hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ nɔ mi kɛ ya su nyagbe,

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛ ko pee hejɔ se mohu nyɛɛ kase ninɛmɛ nɛ guu hemi kɛ yemi kɛ tsui si tomi nɔ naa si womi ɔ. Mawu siwomi nɛ tsakee we

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu wo Abraham si ɔ, akɛnɛ e be nɔ ko nɛ pe lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e ma kã lɛ kita he je ɔ, e ka lɛ nitsɛ e he kita,

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: nɛ e ke: Niinɛ, ma gbaa mo, nɛ ma ha o nina maa hiɛ.

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Nɛ akɛnɛ Abraham to e tsui si he je ɔ, e nine su si womi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nimli ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ pe mɛ ɔ kita a kaa, nɛ a nya sami nyagbe tsuo ji kita kami nɛ a kɛ maa sane tsuaa sane nɔ mi.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ benɛ Mawu hia kaa e tsɔɔ si womi ɔ yeli ɔmɛ kaa e yi mi tomi ɔ tsakee we kulaa a, e kɛ kita ma nɔ mi,

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: konɛ waa gu sanehi enyɔ nɛ tsakee we nɛ Mawu be nyɛe maa ngɔ nya ngɛ mi ɔ nɔ kɛ na bua womi nɛ wa, konɛ wɔ nihi nɛ wa ya sawe ɔ, wa kɛ hɛɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ngɛ wa hɛ mi ɔ mi;

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: wa hɛɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɔ kaa wa klaa sɛkɛ nɛ tsɔ we nɛ pi si kpɛii kɛ sɛ mi kɛ ho tsu mi pomi bo ɔ se ya tɔɔ,

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: he nɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ ji Yesu, nɔ nɛ plɛ neneene osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma kaa Melkizedek ɔ sɛ ha wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Se Melkizedek nɛ ɔ ɔ, lɛ ji Salem matsɛ, Mawu ope ɔ, osɔfo nɛ kɛ Abraham ya kpe benɛ e kpale e se kɛ je matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a gbemi mi ngɛ ta mi nɛ e gbaa lɛ,

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: nɛ Abraham ha lɛ ni ɔmɛ kulaa mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ nɛ. Melkizedek biɛ ɔ, e kekle sisi tsɔɔmi ji “Dami Matsɛ” nɛ jehanɛ hu e ji “Salem Matsɛ,” nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ sisi hu ji “Hejɔmi Matsɛ.”

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: E be tsɛ, e be nyɛ, e be weku kpa, nɛ e be ligbihi a sisije loo wami nyagbe tete, e ngɛ kaa Mawu Bi ɔ; e hii si kaa osɔfo kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ nyɛ susu he, bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ agbo jemi ngɛ ha: Blemano Abraham ɔ tete ngɔ ta yi bu ni kpakpa amɛ a mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ngɔ ha lɛ!

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Levibi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi nɛ tsuɔ osɔfo ni tsumi ɔ hu ngɛ kita ko ngɛ Mlaa a nya, kaa a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ngɛ ma a dɛ, lɔ ɔ ji ngɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ, pohu mɛ hu a je Abraham mi.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Se Melkizedek nɛ be weku sisi tsɔɔmi ko ngɛ Levibi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ ɔ ɔ, e he midlami mi nyɔngma a mi kake ngɛ Abraham po dɛ, nɛ e gbaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ si womi ɔmɛ tete.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Nguane jemi ko be he kulaa kaa nɔ nɛ kle pe e nyɛmi ɔ lɛ e gbaa nɔ nɛ klee we ɔ.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ hiɛ ɔ, nimli nɛ gboɔ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ heɔ mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ, se lejɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ ngmami ɔ ye e he odase kaa e hɛ ngɛ ngmengmle ɔ lɛ he.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Nɛ, ke ma de jã a, kɛ gu Abraham nɔ ɔ, a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ ngɛ Levi nɛ heɔ lɔ ɔ hu dɛ;

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: ejakaa e ngɛ e tsɛ Abraham ɔ mi mi momo bene Melkizedek kɛ lɛ ba kpe ɔ.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ke himi kɛ si pimi gu Levi osɔfo yemi ɔ nɔ kɛ ba a , lɛɛ mɛni he je e hia kɛ̃ kaa osɔfo kpa ko nɛ te si nɛ ngɛ kaa Melkizedek, nɛ pi kaa Aaron ɔ mɔ?

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke a tsake osɔfo yemi ɔ, lɛɛ e hia kaa a tsake Mlaa a hulɔ.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ he nɛ a de ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, je wɛtso kpa ko mi, nɔ mi nɛ nɔ ko ji kɛ ba tsu we bɔ sami latɛ ɔ he ni hyɛ.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ le kaa Yuda mi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je, jamɛ a wetso ɔ Mose de we he nɔ́ ko ngɛ osɔfo yemi he. Osɔfo kpã ko kaa Melkizedek

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ haa sane ɔ jee kpo paa a ji kaa osɔfo kpã ko te si nɛ ngɛ kaa Melkizedek,

english_verse: That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ pi he lo kita mlaa nya nɛ a wo lɛ osɔfo ngɛ, se mohu wami nɛ puɛ we ɔ he wami nya.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ yeɔ odase ke: Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek.

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Ejakaa kita nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ, akɛnɛ e be he wami nɛ e he be se nami ko he ɔ a gu,

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: ejakaa Mlaa ha we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ hi kɛ pi si, se jehanɛ a kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ hi pe lɔ ɔ nɛ waa kɛ suu Mawu he ɔ ba je mi.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Se Yesu lɛɛ, kita kami a kɛ wo lɛ, benɛ Mawu de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ka kita Nɛ e be e he piae: Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene” ɔ.

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ somi nɛ Yesu daa si ngɛ mi ɔ hi pe kulaa.

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Slɔɔto kpa ko hu ji, mɛɛ lɛɛ, akɛnɛ gbenɔ ha we nɛ a se nɛ kɛ he je ɔ, mɛ fuu a ye osɔfo;

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: se Yesu lɛɛ, akɛnɛ e hii si kɛ yaa neneene he je ɔ, e sɔfo yemi ɔ se pui.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he hu ɔ e nyɛɔ nihi nɛ guu e nɔ kɛ baa Mawu ngɔ ɔmɛ a yi wami heɔ, ejakaa e ngɛ daa konɛ e da mi ha mɛ.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Yesu ji Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma nɛ sa wɔ pɛ: nɔ nɛ he tsɔ, nɛ yayami ko be e he, nɛ e he be piami ko, nɛ e tsɔ e he kɛ je yayami peeli a he, nɛ a wo e nɔ kɛ be hiɔwe, he;

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ e hia we lɛ, kaa osɔfo nikɔtɔma kpa amɛ, kaa daa ligbi ɔ e sã lɛ nitsɛ e he yayami ɔmɛ a he bɔ kekle loko e sã ma a hu nɔ; ejakaa e pee enɛ ɔ si kake nyɔngloo, benɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ sã bɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mose Mlaa a, nimli gbɔjɔli e ngɔ woɔ osɔfo nikɔtɔmahi ɔ nɛ, se Mawu kita nɛ ba ngɛ Mlaa a se ɔ he munyu ɔ wo Bi nɛ hi kɛ pi si kɛ yaa neneene ɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ wa ngɛ dee ɔ kulaa yi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma, nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ he walɔ ngua a matsɛ sɛ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe,

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: kaa he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ anɔkuale bo tsu nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ ma nɛ pi nɔmlɔ ko nɛ ma a mi sɔmɔlɔ.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Se kaa zugba a nɔ e ngɛ jinɛ, e be osɔfo tete pee, ejakaa osɔfohi nɛ kɛ nike nihi ya haa ngɛ Mlaa nya a ngɛ;

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: nihi nɛ hiɔwe ni ɔmɛ a henɔ kɛ a nini kɛkɛ a sɔmɔɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a tu munyu tsɔɔ Mose, benɛ e maa ma bo tsu ɔ ke: “Hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ o pee ni ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ henɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ ɔ nya.”

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu na osɔfo yemi nɛ hi pe kekle nɔ ɔ, ejakaa somi nɛ hi pe kekle nɔ ɔ nɛ a da si womihi nɛ hi pe kekle ni ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ kã kita a mi dalɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa kekle somi ɔ hi kɛ pi si jinɛ a be blɔ hlae ngɔ ha nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu piaa mɛ: E ke: “Oʼɛ, ligbihi ma, Nɛ i kɛ Israel we ɔ kɛ Yuda we ɔ Maa so somi he ko,

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Pi kaa somi nɛ i kɛ a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ so Benɛ i pɛtɛ a nine mi nɛ i kɛ mɛ je Mizraim zugba a nɔ ɔ; Ejakaa a yi ye somi ɔ nɔ Nɛ imi hu i bui a he akɔtaa, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji somi nɛ i kɛ Israel we ɔ maa so Ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a se ɔ nɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ke: I kɛ ye mlaahi maa wo a juɛmi mi, Nɛ ma ngma ngɔ wo a tsui mi, Nɛ ma pee a Mawu Nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ti nɔ ko be e huɛ loo e nyɛmi tsɔɔe ke: ‘Le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.’ Ejakaa mɛ kulaa a maa le mi, Kɛ maa je a kpɛti nɔ nyafii nɔ Kɛ yaa su nɔ ngua nɔ.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ma na mɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ a nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ a he, Nɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ hu i be kaie ligbi ko ligbi ko.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Somi he nɛ ɔ he munyu ɔ, ha kekle nɔ ɔ pee momo. Se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ pee momo kɛ nɔ́ nɛ bwɔ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ e maa laa.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ kekle somi ɔ hu ngɛ Mawu jami blɔ nya nihi kɛ He klɔuklɔu nɛ ji je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: A ma bo tsu ko ngɔ ma si, nɛ e kpo nɔ je ɔ, kane tso kɛ okplɔɔ kɛ hɛ mi mami abolohi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; a tsɛɛ lejɛ ɔ ke He klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ tsopa kɛ e he via sami nɔ́ kɛ somi daka nɛ a kɛ sika ha he kulaa a ngɛ, lɔ ɔ mi sika kplu kɛ mana a kɛ Aaron tso nɛ su ba a kɛ somi tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɛ;

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: nɛ lɔ ɔ nɔ nyami kerubim nɛ ha kpatami sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ, nihi nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ wa be nyɛe a he munyu tumi kakaaka a.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a dlaa kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ haa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: osɔfo ɔmɛ yaa kekle bo tsu ɔ mi daa ligbi ya tsuɔ Mawu jami he ni;

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: se bo tsu nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a kɛkɛ lɛ yaa mi si kake daa jeha, nɛ e si we muɔ nɛ e ya, nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ ya haa ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ kɛ ma a tɔmihi nɛ a li ɔmɛ a he ɔ.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ pãa kaa be abɔ nɛ kekle bo tsu ɔ maa si kɛ mwɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, lɛɛ blɔ nɛ a kɛ yaa he klɔuklɔu ɔ a na we nɛ a bli.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ kɔɔ niye ni kɛ numi nihi kɛ he dumi slɔɔtohi nɛ ji he lo blɔ nya nihi a he nɛ a to ke a pee kɛ ya su ehe peemi be ɔ.

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Se Kristo nɛ ba ba ye ni kpakpahi nɛ maa ba amɛ a he osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a, gu bo tsu nɛ kle nɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ pi nine nɛ a kɛ pee, lɔ ɔ ji kaa pi je nɛ ɔ mi bɔ nihi a mi nɛ e je ɔ mi,

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: nɛ pohu, pi tokuhi loo na bimɛ a muɔ, se mohu lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ ɔ e kɛ sɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ mi si kake nyɔngloo, nɛ e kɛ na neneene kpɔmi ɔ.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nahi kɛ tokui a muɔ kɛ na bimɛ a lazu nɛ a kɛ fiãa nihi nɛ bleɔ a he ɔ nɔ ɔ fɔɔ a he nɛ a he tsɔɔ ngɛ he lo blɔfami ɔ,

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: si nyɛmɛ nɔuu nɛ Kristo, nɛ gu neneene mumi ɔ nɔ ngɔ e he nɛ piami ko be he ngɔ ha Mawu ɔ muɔ be wa he ni lemi he fɔe kɛ je ni tsumi gbogboehi a mi, konɛ wa sɔmɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Christ died to rescue those who had sinned and broken the old agreement. Now he brings his chosen ones a new agreement with its guarantee of God's eternal blessings!
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ nɔuu he je nɛ e ji somi he ɔ mi dalɔ ɔ nɛ, benɛ pee nɛ e gu gbenɔ nɔ kɛ kpata kekle somi ɔ nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ, konɛ nihi nɛ a tsɛ ɔmɛ a nine nɛ su neneene gbo si ni ɔmɛ a he si womi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Ejakaa he nɛ si womi nɛ haa a yeɔ gbo si ni ngɛ ɔ, e hia kaa nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ e gbo lolo,

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: ejakaa si womi nɛ haa a yeɔ gbo si ni ɔ, ja si wolɔ ɔ gbo loko e naa he wami, se ke e hɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔ ɔ, e be he wami.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he nɛ kekle nɔ́ ɔ hu a si we muɔ se kɛ wui ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Ejakaa benɛ Mose fiɛ kita amɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ ma mluku ɔ kulaa ngɛ mlaa a nya a, e ngɔ na bimɛ kɛ tokuhi a muɔ kɛ nyu kɛ jijɔ he bwɔmi tsutsu kɛ hisopo, nɛ e kɛ fia womi ɔ nitsɛ kɛ ma mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ,

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: e ke: “Oʼɛ, somi ɔ nɛ Mawu kã nyɛ he kita a muɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Nɛ bo tsu ɔ hu kɛ Mawu jami he ni ɔmɛ kulaa, e kɛ muɔ ɔ fia nɔ ja nɔuu.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Nɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ, e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a kɛ muɔ tsukɔɔ nihi kulaa he ngɛ mlaa a nya; nɛ ke a pue we muɔ si ɔ, a kɛ pɛ́. Kristo bɔsami ɔ jeɔ yayami

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ e hia kaa nihi nɛ ji hiɔwe ni ɔmɛ a henɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ngɔ enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsukɔ he; se hiɔwe ni ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ, bɔhi nɛ hi pe kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ tsukɔɔ he.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi he klɔuklɔu nɛ a kɛ ninehi pee nɛ ji nɔ́ ɔ nitsɛ henɔ kɛkɛ mi nɛ Kristo ya sɛ ɔ, se mohu hiɔwe nitsɛ e ya sɛ, konɛ jehanɛ ya je e he kpo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ha wɔ.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Pohu e ya sɛ we lejɛ ɔ konɛ e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha daa daa, kaa bɔ nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a ya sɛɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ daa jeha kɛ muɔ nɛ pi lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ ɔ;

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: ejakaa ke ja a, jinɛ sa kaa e na amanehlu kpiti kpiti kɛ je je mi siiije lokoo; se jehanɛ ɔ, si kake kɛkɛ a je lɛ kpo ngɛ je mi be ɔmɛ a nyagbe mi, konɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he nɛ e kɛ sa bɔ ɔ kɛ je yayami ɔ.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: ja nɔuu Kristo hu, a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha si kake, konɛ e tloo nihi fuu a he yayami kɛ ho. E ma je e he kpo nɔ́ nɛ ji si enyɔ, pi ngɛ yayami he, se mohu konɛ e ba he ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ a yi wami.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ni kpakpahi nɛ maa ba amɛ a nini kɛkɛ Mlaa a hɛɛ, se pi ni ɔmɛ a subai nitsɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be nyɛe nɛ e kɛ daa jeha bɔhi nɛ a saa nɔtonɔto ɔ nɛ ha nihi nɛ baa Mawu ngɔ ɔ nɛ a hi kɛ pi si.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Jinɛ a ko jɔɔ bɔ ɔmɛ sami, ejakaa nihi nɛ ba jaa Mawu ɔ, ke a tsukɔ a he si kake pɛ ɔ, a be fɔ ko nɛ a yeɔ ngɛ a he yayamihi a he kulaa hu.

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: ejakaa a be nyɛe maa ngɔ nahi kɛ tokuhi a muɔ kɛ je yayamihi.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Kristo ma je nɔ mi ɔ, ye de Mawu ke: “Bɔ kɛ nike ni ɔmɛ ɔ, o sume, Se nɔmlɔ tso o dla ha mi

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a kɛ lohwehi saa kɛ yayami he bɔ ɔmɛ Sɛ́ o hɛ mi.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke: ‘Oʼɛ, i ba, Oo Mawu, Nɛ ma ba pee o suɔmi nya ni Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ ye he ngɛ Mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Kekle ɔ e ke: “Bɔ kɛ nike nihi kɛ lohwehi a bɔhi kɛ yayami he bɔ ɔmɛ ɔ o sume, nɛ e sɛ́ o hɛ mi hulɔ,” ;

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: kɛkɛ nɛ e ke: “Oʼɛ, i ba nɛ ma ba pee mo, Mawu, o suɔmi nya ni.” Lɔ ɔ Mawu jeɔ kekle bɔ sami ni ɔmɛ konɛ e ngɔ Kristo nɔ ɔ ngɔ ma nane mi.

english_verse: So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.
translation_verse: A kɛnɛ Yesu Kristo pee Mawu suɔmi nya ni he je ɔ, a tsukɔ wa he kɛ gu e nɔmlɔ tso nɛ e kɛ ha si kake nyɔngloo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo ɔ, ligbi tsuaa ligbi ɔ, e daa si nɛ e sɔmɔɔ, nɛ e saa jamɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu kpitikpiti, nihi nɛ nyɛ we yayami nɛ a je ligbi ko ligbi ko ɔ.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Kristo lɛɛ e sa yayamihi a he bɔ si kake nyɔngloo, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ;

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa bɔ kake nɛ e sa a, e kɛ ha nihi nɛ a tsukɔ a he ɔ hi kɛ pi si nyɔngloo.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu yeɔ wɔ odase. Kekleekle ɔ, e ke:

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Enɛ ɔ ji somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa so Ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a se, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de: I kɛ ye mlaa amɛ maa wo a tsui mi, Nɛ ma ngma ngɔ wo a juɛmi mi

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Nɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ a nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ ɔ, i be kaie kulaa hu.”

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Nɛ he nɛ a kɛ enɔmɛ pa ngɛ ɔ, yayami he bɔ sami ko be hu. Nyɛ ha waa hɛ kɛ su Mawu he

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, akɛnɛ wa ngɛ he blɔ ngɛ Yesu muɔ ɔ nya nɛ wa kɛ maa sɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: ngɛ blɔ he nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ e je ha wɔ ɔ kɛ gu tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e he lo ɔ mi,

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: nɛ jehanɛ wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma ngua nɛ yeɔ Mawu we ɔ nɔ he je ɔ,

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: nyɛ ha waa hɛ kɛ su Mawu he kɛ tsui klɔuu ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ ɔ mi, kɛ tsui hu nɛ a tsukɔ he nɛ e be he ni lemi yaya ko hulɔ, kɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a kɛ nyu nɛ mi tsɔ du he.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha waa pɛtɛ wa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ wa jaje ɔ mi wawɛɛ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha wa susu wa sibi a he, konɛ wa hɛ nɛ e dɔ ngɛ suɔmi kɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi a he.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha waa jɔɔ wa he nya buami, kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ pɔɔ peemi ɔ, se mohu waa wo wa he ga, nɛ titli ɔ, akɛnɛ nyɛ na kaa Ligbi ɔ ngɛ sue nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke wa bua nɛ wa peɔ yayami ngɛ benɛ wa le anɔkuale ɔ se ɔ, lɛɛ yayamihi a he bɔsami ko be hu,

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: kojomi blɔ hyemi nɛ ngɛ gbeye kɛkɛ, kɛ la gligli nɛ maa sa nihi nɛ nyɛɛ Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuaa Mose Mlaa a, a gbee lɛ, nɛ a nɛ́ lɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ ni enyɔ loo ni etɛ a dase yemi nya.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: Mɛni tuegblami nɛ nya wa po nyɛ susu kaa e sa nɔmlɔ ko nɛ bui Mawu Bi ɔ, nɛ e bu somi muɔ nɛ a kɛ tsukɔ e he ɔ kaa yaka nɔ ko, nɛ e pee dloomi mumi ɔ nidɔ ni ɔ?

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa le nɔ nɛ de ke: “Ye nɔ ji tue gblami, imi ma wo he hiɔ” ɔ. Nɛ jehanɛ: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa kojo lɛ nitsɛ e ma a.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ dɛ mi nɔmi ngɛ gbeye pam.

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ kai kekle be ɔmɛ, benɛ Mawu la a tso ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ amanehlu babauu mi.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Be komɛ ɔ jemi kɛ amanehlu sɔuu ha nyɛ plɛ hyemi nihi, nɛ be komɛ hu nyɛ plɛ nihi nɛ a pee mɛ ja amɛ a huɛmɛ nɔnali.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Nyɛ muklii mi sa nyɛ ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a bɔ mɛ pa amɛ a he, nɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ a ha amɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi kplɛɛ, akɛnɛ nyɛ le kaa nyɛ ngɛ juetli nɛ hi pe kɔlɔ ɔ babauu nɛ hii si daa ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ nyɛ mi kã a he, ejakaa e ngɛ hiɔwo ngua.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: Tsui si tomi he hia nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ni, nɛ nyɛ nine nɛ e su siwomi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ: “E piɛ bɔɔ kɛkɛ Nɛ nɔ nɛ ma a maa ba, Nɛ e be kɛe kulaa;

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Se zdalɔ nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ Yi ma na wa; Nɛ ke e kpale kɛ je ye se ɔ Ye klaa be e he buajɔmi nae.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
