translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ tsa pi nihi nɛ kpaleɔ kɛ yaa hɛ mi patami mi mi ɔ a ti nikomɛ ji wɔ se mohu wɔ ji nihi nɛ kɛ hemi kɛ yemi naa a klaa yi wami hemi ɔ a ti ni komɛ.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi ji nihi nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ he waminami kɛ nihi nɛ a nɛ́ ɔmɛ a nɔ mi mami.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa lɔ ɔ mi a ye blemabi ɔmɛ a he odase kpakpa ngɛ.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi waa kɛ yoɔ kaa Mawu munyu a kɛ bɔ je ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ nihi nɛ a naa amɛ a mi a je kɛ pee nihi nɛ a nɛ́ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Habel kɛ sa bɔ nɛ pe Kain nɔ ɔ ha Mawu, nɛ lɔ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ a ye e he odase kaa dalɔ ji lɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa Mawu he e nike ni ɔmɛ; nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɔ mwɔ pohu e gbo.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi he a ngɔ Henok kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, konɛ e ko gbo, nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu, ejakaa Mawu ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho. Ngmami ɔ ye e he odase kaa loko a maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho ɔ, Henok sa Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Ke hemi kɛ yemi be ɔ, a be Mawu hɛ mi nyɛe maa sa, ejakaa nɔ nɛ baa Mawu ngɔ ɔ, ja e he ye kaa e ngɛ, nɛ e ji ninɛmɛ nɛ hlaa e se blɔ ɔ a hiɔ wolɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Noa hu kɛ bu Mawu tue, benɛ e fa lɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ a nɛ́ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, nɛ e kɛ dla daka kɛ ha e we ɔ yi wami hemi; e hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ɔ nɔ hu e gu nɛ e bu je ɔ fɔ, nɛ e kɛ na dami nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Abraham kɛ bu tue, benɛ a tsɛ lɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho he nɛ Mawu wo lɛ si ke e ma ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ ya; nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho, pohu e li he nɛ e yaa.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi e kɛ ya to nibwɔ ngɛ si womi zugba a nɔ kaa nɔ kpa, nɛ e kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob nɛ e kɛ mɛ ji jamɛ a si womi ɔ nɔuu yeli ɔ hi si ngɛ bo tsuhi a mi;

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: ejakaa Abraham ngɛ ma nɛ ngɛ sisi tomi nɛ he wa nɛ e tolɔ kɛ e malɔ ji Mawu ɔ blɔ hyɛe.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Sara hu kɛ na he wami nɛ e kɛ na muklii, nɛ lɛ nɛ e bwɔ tsɔ kɛ be nɔ ɔ fɔ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ, e bu lɛ anɔkualetsɛ.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ a je nɔ kake nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ gbo mo ɔ mi nɛ a fɔ nihi nɛ hiɛ babauu kaa hiɔwe dodoehi loo wo nya zia nɛ a be nyɛe maa kane ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi mi ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa gbo ngɛ. Lokoo kɛkɛ a na nihi nɛ a wo he si ɔmɛ ngɛ, nɛ a nya he, pohu a nine sui nɔ, nɛ a ye odase kaa nibwɔhi kɛ masetsɛmɛ ji mɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ?

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ deɔ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsɔɔ faii kaa a ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma hlae.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Nɛ kaa a hɛ ngɛ ma nɛ a je mi ɔ nɔ jinɛ, a ko na he blɔ kɛ ko kpale a se kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya ekohu.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ, a ngɛ ma ko nɛ hi pe lɔ ɔ nɛ ji hiɔwe nɔ ɔ hlae. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee we Mawu zo kaa a ma tsɛ lɛ a Mawu, ejakaa e dla ma ngɔ to mɛ.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: lɛ nɔ nɛ Mawu de lɛ ke: “Isak mi a maa je kɛ tsɛ o nina,” a.

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Abraham ngɔ lɛ kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ma tle Isak si kɛ je gbeje tete, nɛ niinɛ, ke a ma de ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e nine su e nɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Isak kɛ gbaa Yakob kɛ Esau ngɛ nihi nɛ maa ba amɛ a he.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Yakob kɛ gbaa Yosef bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ benɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ, nɛ e ma e yi si ngɛ e dɛma tso ɔ nɔ nɛ e sɔle.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Yosef hu kɛ wo Israelbi ɔmɛ a Mizraim jemi ɔ nɔ ta benɛ e su e gbenɔ be ɔ, nɛ e wo lɛ nitsɛ e wu ɔmɛ a he kita a.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Mose fɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ ngɔ laa hlami etɛ, benɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ, ejakaa a na kaa jokuɛ ɔ he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ a yi matsɛ hiɔngɔ nɛ e wo ɔ gbeye.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi he nɛ Mose nitsɛ, benɛ e wa a, e kua ke a ko tsɛ lɛ Farao biyo ɔ bi,

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: e suɔ mohu kaa e kɛ Mawu ma a nɛ na amanehlu, pe nɔ́ nɛ e maa ye yayami mi ngɔmi be bɔɔ ko.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: E bu Kristo ahluabɔmi ɔ kaa ni babauu pe Mizraim juetli, ejakaa e ngɛ hiɔwo ɔ hyɛe.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Mose kɛ je Mizraim nɛ e yi matsɛ ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ gbeye; e kpale we e se, kaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu nɛ a nɛ́ lɛ ɔ hyɛe.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Mose kɛ to Hetsɔmi ɔ kɛ muɔ dikimi ɔ sisi, konɛ bɔfo nɔ hɛ mi kpatalɔ ɔ ko ba gbe Israelbi ɔmɛ a bi tete ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi Israelbi ɔmɛ kɛ po Wo Tsu ɔ kaa zugba gbligbli, nɔ́ nɛ Mizraimbi ɔmɛ hu ka peemi se wo ɔ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho ɔ.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi nya Yeriko gli ɔmɛ kuɔ pue si, benɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ bɔle lɛ ligbi kpaago ɔ.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi he nɛ Rahab, yaholɔ ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ gbo we ɔ nɛ, ejakaa e he slaali ɔmɛ kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛni ma de ekohu? Ejakaa i be ye he deka nae bɔ nɛ ma kɛ sɛɛ Gideon kɛ Barak, Samson kɛ Yefta, David kɛ Samuel, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ hulɔ a he sane,

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: nihi nɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ye matsɛ yemihi a nɔ kunimi, a tsu dami nihi, a nine su si womihi a nɔ, a tsi jatahi a nya,

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: a gbe la he wami, a je klaatehi a nya, a na he wami kɛ je gbɔlemi mi, a he wa ngɛ ta mi, a bu masetsɛmɛ a ta a.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Yihi a nine su a nihi nɛ gbo ɔmɛ a nɔ ekohu kɛ gu si temi nɔ. Se ni kpa komɛ hu, a kɛ piimi gbe mɛ, akɛnɛ a kplɛɛ we kpɔmi, konɛ a te si kɛ ya wami kpakpa mi ɔ.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ hu a ye a he fɛu nɛ a fia mɛ kplibi. Nɛ a bɔ mɛ pa nɛ a wo mɛ tsu mi;

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: a fia mɛ tɛ, a kɛ sau poo a mi, a kɛ klaate gbe mɛ; a ha a wo jijɔhi kɛ apletsihi a he womi kɛ nyɛɛ, ohia hia mɛ, a wa mɛ yi mi, a pee mɛ ni yeyee;

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: je ɔ hi ha mɛ. A wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kɛ yokuhi a nɔ kɛ tɛ puɔhi kɛ zugba puɔhi a mi.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, a ye a he odase kpakpa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he mohu, se a nine sui si womi ni ɔmɛ a nɔ,

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: ejakaa Mawu dla nɔ́ ko kpakpa ngɔ to wɔ, konɛ a ko hi kɛ pi si si wɔ.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ wɔ hu, be abɔ nɛ wa ngɛ odase yeli babauu nɛ mimla wɔ kaa bɔku nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha wa je nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ tsiɔ wa nya kɛ yayami nɛ fi wɔ ɔ, nɛ waa kɛ hɛ mi miami nɛ tu fo nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ wa hɛ mi ɔ,

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: nɛ waa hyɛ hemi kɛ yemi sisi jelɔ kɛ nya gbelɔ nɛ ji Yesu ɔ, nɔ nɛ nyami nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ he ɔ, e mia e hɛ mi ngɛ seumi tso ɔ he amanehlu ɔ mi, nɛ e bui zo ɔ, nɛ e kɛ ya hi si ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ susu nɔ mi nɛ e gblee, bɔ nɛ e to e tsui si ngɛ si nɛ yayami peeli te ngɔ si lɛ ɔ mi, konɛ nyɛ nine mi ko wo nyu nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɛ he.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ yayami ta nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ sui he nɛ a ma pue nyɛ muɔ si ngɛ ɔ lolo.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ hɛ je bua womi munyu nɛ kɛ nyɛ tuɔ munyu kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ bimɛ tuɔ munyu ɔ nɔ? ke: “Ye bi, koo ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi ɔ kaa nɔ ko nyafii, Nɛ jehanɛ ke e ka o hɛ mi ɔ, ko ha o nine mi nɛ wo nyu;

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ, lɛ e tsɔseɔ, Nɛ e fiaa bi tsuaa bi nɛ e ngɔ peɔ e nɔ ɔ kpa.”

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae ɔ mi kaa e ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi; ejakaa te bi nɛ ngɛ nɛ e tsɛ tsɔse we lɛ nɛɛ?

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ na we tsɔsemi nɛ nihi tsuo naa a eko ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ajuama bimɛ ji nyɛ, se pi bimɛ nitsɛmɛ.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Jehanɛ wa ngɛ he lo blɔfami tsɛmɛ nɛ tsɔseɔ wɔ nɛ wa buu mɛ; anɛ e sɛ́ kaa waa ba wa he si ngɔ ha mumihi a tsɛ ɔ mohu babauu konɛ wa yi nɛ e na wa?

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Ejaka mɛɛ lɛɛ, be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ a tsɔseɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ sa a hɛ mi; se Mawu lɛɛ, e tsɔseɔ wɔ, konɛ e hi ha wɔ konɛ wa na e klɔuklɔu peemi ɔ eko.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Se tsɔsemi tsuaa tsɔsemi ɔ, a mlɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, e pee we nɔ kaa bua jɔmi nɔ́, se dɔmi nɔ́ mohu; se ke pee se ɔ, e woɔ he jɔmi yiblii nɛ ji dami ɔ haa nihi nɛ gu nɔ kase nɔ́ ko ɔ. Nitsɔɔmi kɛ kɔkɔbɔmi

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ, konɛ pɔtsɛ ko nɛ ko sane si, se mohu a tsa lɛ.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, kɛ he tsɔmi nɛ ke nɔ ko si nɛ e be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nae ɔ.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nɔ ko ko ngmɛɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ he, konɛ poku kɛ doomi ko ko puɛ nɛ e hao nyɛ nɛ e ble nihi fuu kɛ e duɔ ɔ;

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: konɛ nɔ ko ko pee e he ajuama bɔlɔ, loo yaka nɔmlɔ kaa Esau nɛ jua e bi tete blɔ nya a kɛ he si kake niye ni ɔ.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ le kaa, benɛ pee se nɛ e hla kaa e na gbaami ɔ, a kua lɛ; ejakaa e na we tsui tsakemi he blɔ, pohu e kɛ vo nyu hla se blɔ.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ bɛ yoku nɛ a taa he nɛ ngɛ sae kɛ la, kɛ bɔku kɛ diblii kɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngua,

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: kɛ titimati pɛmi, kɛ gbi pɛmi nɛ nihi nɛ nu ɔ kpa pɛɛ ke a ko tu e ko piɛ he hu ɔ he;

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: ejakaa mlaa nɛ a wo ke: “Ke lohwe ko tete ta yoku ɔ he ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ” ɔ, a nyɛ we nɔ nɛ a ye;

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e na a ngɛ gbeye babauu tsɔ nɛ Mose ke: “I ngɛ gbeye yee, nɛ i he ngɛ doe blibliibli.”

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Se mohu, Zion yoku ɔ he nyɛ ba, kɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ma nɛ ji hiɔwe Yerusalem ɔ, kɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi akpe akpehi abɔ,

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: kɛ kekleekle bimɛ nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ Mawu nɛ ji nihi kulaa a kojolɔ ɔ, kɛ dali nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔmɛ a mumi ɔmɛ,

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: kɛ Yesu nɛ ji somi he midalɔ ɔ, kɛ muɔ nɛ a kɛ fia nɛ tuɔ munyu kpakpa pe Habel nɔ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi konɛ nyɛ ko kua nɔ nɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ munyu ɔ, ejakaa ke nihi nɛ kua nɔ nɛ tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ munyu ɔ a he ji mi ɔ, lɛɛ ke wa kpale kɛ je nɔ nɛ jee hiɔwe tuɔ munyu ɔ se ɔ, wɔ mohu wa he be mi jee kɔkɔɔkɔ;

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: nɔ gbi nɛ mimiɛ zugba a ngɛ lɛ be ɔ mi ɔ, se jehanɛ e wo si ke: “E piɛ si kake nɛ ma mimiɛ, pi zugba a kɛkɛ, se hiɔwe hulɔ,” ɔ.

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ ke: “E piɛ si kake” ɔ, e kɛ tsɔɔ faii kaa, nihi nɛ a mimiɛ ɔmɛ ma tsake, ejakaa nihi nɛ a bɔ ʼi, konɛ nihi nɛ be mimiɛe ɔmɛ nɛ hi si.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ wa na matsɛ yemi nɛ a be nyɛe ma mimiɛ nɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha waa na si, nɛ wa kɛ sɔmɔ Mawu bɔ nɛ sa e hɛ mi kɛ bu kɛ gbeye yemi;

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: ejakaa wa Mawu ɔ la nɛ puɛɔ nɔ hu ji lɛ.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he daa kaa nyɛmimɛ.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Nibwɔ peemi hu, nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ, ejakaa lɔɔ nɔ ni komɛ gu kɛ pee hiɔwe bɔfohi nibwɔ, nɛ a li.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai ninɛmɛ nɛ a wo mɛ tsu mi ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ lɛ ngɛ tsuɔ mi, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ nae ɔ, akɛnɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi kɛ mwɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: A wo gba hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nyɛ kulaa nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ a ko ble gba sa a hulɔ; se ajuama bɔli kɛ gba puɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu maa kojo mɛ.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Sika suɔmi nɛ ko sɛ nyɛ si himi mi, nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ he, ejakaa Mawu ke: “I be mo sie, nɛ jehanɛ hu i be mo kuae ligbi ko ligbi ko.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ma de kɛ kã ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji ye he piɛlɔ, I be gbeye yee; Mɛni nɔmlɔ ma nyɛ mi pee?”

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli, nihi nɛ tu Mawu munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ hyɛ a je mi si himi ɔ nyagbe, nɛ nyɛɛ kase a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hiɛ̃ kɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Tsɔɔmi slɔɔtohi kɛ tsɔɔmi kpahi kɛ nyɛ nɛ lilaa si; ejakaa e hi kaa a kɛ Mawu dloomi nɛ wo wa tsui he wami, se pi niye ni nɛ ha we nɛ nihi nɛ tsuɔ he ni ɔmɛ a na se ko ɔ.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ bɔ sami latɛ ko nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ be he blɔ kaa a yeɔ e nɔ ni;

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: ejakaa lohwehi nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔɔ a muɔ kɛ yaa he klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ yayami he ɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ɔ, a ya sãa ngɛ sada a se.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jeha nɛ, nyɛ ha waa je kpo kɛ ya e ngɔ ngɛ sada a se nɛ wa ya tloo e ahlua bɔmi ɔ.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa be ma nɛ ngɛ daa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, se ma nɛ maa ba a mohu se blɔ wa ngɛ hlae.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ ko je kpakpa peemi kɛ ni kemi nɔ, ejakaa jamɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ saa Mawu hɛ mi saminya.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu nyɛ tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tue nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɔ ha mɛ; ejakaa mɛ lɛ a buu nyɛ klaa amɛ a he kaa nihi nɛ maa bu he akɔtaa, konɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ pee ni nɛ ɔmɛ, se pi kɛ zanue lami, ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔ hi ha nyɛ.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Nɛ i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ babauu kaa nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha mi, konɛ a kpale mi ha nyɛ mla. Sɔlemi

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: He jɔmi Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ je to ɔmɛ a hyɛlɔ ngua nɛ ji wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ je gbeje ngɛ neneene somi ɔ muɔ ɔ mi ɔ,

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: lɛ e dla nyɛ ngɔ ha ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ pee e suɔmi nya ni, nɛ e gu Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ mi; lɛ a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha kɛ ya si neneene kɛ neneene ɔ! Amen. Nyagbe sɛyemi

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pɛtɛ munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ he, ejakaa munyu kpiti i ngma mane nyɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: I ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa a ngmɛɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo he, nɛ ke e ba mla a, i kɛ lɛ maa ba ba na nyɛ.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Wa biɔ nyɛ tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kulaa kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpe. Ninɛmɛ nɛ je Italia a ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Yakobo, nɛ ji Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, ngma ya ha wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ gbɛ fia a: Nyɛ he manye! Hemi kɛ yemi kɛ nilemi

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, ke nyɛ sɛ ka slɔɔtohi fuu a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ bu lɛ kaa bua jɔmi sɔuu;

english_verse: You know you learn to endure by having your faith tested.
translation_verse: ejakaa nyɛ le kaa kami nɛ a kaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tsɛɛ tsui si tomi kɛ baa.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha tsui si tomi ɔ nɛ gbe e nitsumi nya kɛ pi si, konɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si, nɛ nyɛɛ su, nɛ e ko piɛ nyɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Se ke e hia nyɛ ti nɔ ko ni lemi ɔ, e kpa Mawu nɛ haa nihi kulaa faa kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ e ka we nɔ hɛ mi ɔ pɛɛ, nɛ e ma ngɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Se e kpa pɛɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, nɛ e ko je nɔ́, ejakaa nɔ jelɔ ɔ e ngɛ kaa oslɔke nɛ kɔɔhiɔ fiaa kɛ yaa kɛ baa.

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Nyɛmi nɛ ji ohiafo ɔ, e fia ke Mawu wo e nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: nɛ niatsɛ ɔ, e fia ke Mawu ba lɛ si, ejakaa e ma ngla kaa nga mi mɔmɔ.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Ejakaa pu tee si nɛ e tsoo nɛ e gbliɔ nga a, nɛ e mɔmɔ ɔmɛ wɔleɔ pueɔ si nɛ e fɛu ɔ puɛɔ. Ja nɔuu niatsɛ hu hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ e blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Kami

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Agbaa nyumu nɛ toɔ e tsui si ngɛ ka mi, ejakaa ke a ka lɛ nɛ e nyɛ nya da a, e ma na wami jlasi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo he si ha ninɛmɛ nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Ke a ka nɔ ko ɔ, e ko de ke: ‘Mawu ngɔ a je kɛ ka mi.’ Ejakaa Mawu ɔ a kɛ́ lɛ ngɛ ni yayamihi a mi, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e kɛ́ nɔ ko.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e kɔnɔ nɛ gblaa lɛ nɛ mlɔɔ lɛ ɔ lɛ kaa lɛ.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ akɔnɔ ɔ, ke e ngɔ ho ɔ, e fɔɔ yayami, nɛ yayami hu, ke e wa a, e fɔɔ gbenɔ.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a mlɔɔ nyɛ, mamimɛ nɛ i suɔ.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Dloomi ni kpakpahi kulaa kɛ nike ni nɛ hi kɛ pi si kulaa a, hiɔwe e jee kɛ kpleɔ si, kɛ jee Mawu nɛ ji lahi a tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɔ nɛ mi nɛ su tsakemi kɛ plɛmi ko be ɔ.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya a kɛ anɔkuale munyu ɔ fɔ wɔ, konɛ waa pee e nibɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi kekleekle yiblii. Numi kɛ peemi

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyumu muklii mi fumi tsu we Mawu dami nya ni.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee munyu ɔ nɔ yeli, se pi munyu ɔ nuli kɛkɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mlɔɔ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nɔ ko ji munyu ɔ nulɔ kɛkɛ se pi e nɔ yelɔ hulɔ ɔ, kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nyumu ko nɛ hyɛɛ e hɛ mi su ɔ ngɛ ahuhuɛ mi;

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ he yemi mlaa nɛ hi kɛ pi si kãii, nɛ e hɛ hii he be tsuaa be, nɛ e pi nɔ nɛ nuɔ nɛ e hɛ jee nɔ, se mohu e ji e nɔ yelɔ nɛ tsuɔ he ni ɔ, jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ Mawu maa gbaa lɛ ngɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi mi.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Se ke e peɔ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kaa Mawu jalɔ ji lɛ nɛ e kɔɛ e lilɛ mi ɔ, e ngɛ e he sisie, nɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɔ jami ɔ ji yaka.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Mawu jami nɛ he tsɔ nɛ he be mu ko ngɛ Mawu tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa a slaa ahusahi kɛ yalɔyi ngɛ a hiamihi a mi, nɛ e to e he nɛ je ɔ ko wo e he mu.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛɛ kɛ nihi a hɛ mi hyɛmi ko futu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ ji hɛ mi nyami Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nyumu ko nɛ wo sika ga kɛ tade nɛ ngɛ fɛu ba sɛ nyɛ kpe he ɔ, nɛ ohiafo ko hu nɛ wo tade yaya ba sɛ mi,

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ bu nɔ nɛ wo tade nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ de lɛ ke: “Moo lɛɛ ba hi he kpakpa nɛ ɔ;” nɛ ohiafo ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ de lɛ ke: “Moo lɛɛ da lejɛ ɔ,” aloo “Ba hi ye nane nya ngɛ hiɛ ɔ” ɔ,

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: anɛ pi nihi a mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi yayami ngɛ kojoe nɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue! Anɛ pi je nɛ ɔ mi ohiafohi nɛ ji niatsɛmɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi blɔfami ɔ nɛ Mawu hla, konɛ matsɛyemi nɛ e wo he si ngɔ ha ninɛmɛ nɛ a suɔ lɛ ɔ nɛ e pee a nɔ lo?

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ gbee ohiafo ɔ he guɛ. Anɛ pi niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ yeɔ nyɛ nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ mɛ nɔuu lɛ a kpakaa nyɛ kɛ yaa kojomi he ɔmɛ?

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Anɛ pi mɛ nɔuu nɛ a gbee biɛ kpakpa nɛ a kɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ ɔ he guɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ ye kita nɛ ji Mlaa a mi go nɛ deɔ ke: “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he” ɔ nɔ ngɛ ngmami ɔ nya a, lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee saminya.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Se ke nihi a hɛ mi nyɛ hyɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ yayami pee nɛ Mlaa a buu nyɛ fɔ kaa mlaa tɔli.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ maa ye Mlaa mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ tete, se e ma tɔ ngɛ kake mi ɔ, e tɔ kulaa nɔ.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ de ke: “Koo bɔ ajuama” a, lɛ nɔuu lɛ de ke: “Koo gbe nɔmlɔ.” Nɛ ke o bɔɛ ajuama, se o gbee nɔmlɔ ɔ, mlaa tɔlɔ ji mo.

english_verse: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ tu munyu nɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ nihi kaa nihi nɛ he yemi mlaa a kɛ maa kojo mɛ.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Ejakaa kojomi mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ nɛ́ mɔbɔ ɔ, a be lɛ mɔbɔ nae; mɔbɔ nalɔ yi kojomi gbeye. Hemi kɛ yemi kɛ ni tsumi

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, ke nɔ ko ke e ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi, se e be ni tsumihi ɔ mɛni se nami lɛ ngɛ mi? Anɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ma nyɛ e yi wami ma he lo?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Ke nyɛmi nyumu ko loo nyɛmi yo ko hɛɛ e he gu nɛ e nɛ e nya mi ngma,

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko ya de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ya ngɛ he jɔmi mi; nyɛ ya hlue la, nɛ nyɛ ya ye ni nɛ nyɛɛ tɔ” — se e ha we mɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hiae ɔ, mɛni se nami lɛ ngɛ mi?

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu hemi kɛ yemi hu, ke ni tsumihi be he ɔ, e ji hemi kɛ yemi gbogboe.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Se nɔ ko ma de ke: “Moo lɛɛ o ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ imi lɛɛ, i ngɛ ni tsumihi;” tsɔɔ mi o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ni tsumihi be he ɔ, nɛ imi hu ma je ye ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi ma tsɔɔ mo ye hemi kɛ yemi ɔ.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Moo lɛɛ o heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu ɔ nɔ kake ʼi. O pee saminya! Mumi yayami ɔmɛ hu heɔ yee ja, nɛ a he doo kɛ gbeye yemi.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Oo, kuasia, o ngɛ hlaɔ nɛ o le kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ni tsumihi be he ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi gbogboe ʼi lo?

english_verse: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
translation_verse: Wa tsɛ Abraham ɔ, anɛ pi ni tsumihi a nɔ nɛ a da kɛ wo lɛ nguɔ, benɛ e kɛ e bi Isak ya fɔ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ lo?

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Tse o na kaa hemi kɛ yemi kɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ, nɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi e je nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ hi kɛ pi si ɔ nɛ,

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke: “Nɛ Abraham he Mawu nɛ ɔ ye nɛ a bu enɛ ɔ dami ha lɛ” ɔ ba mi, nɛ a tsɛ lɛ ke “Mawu huɛ.”

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ na kaa ni tsumihi a mi a jee kɛ woɔ nɔmlɔ nguɔ, se pi hemi kɛ yemi kɛkɛ mi.

english_verse: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu Rahab, ajuama a hu, anɛ pi ni tsumihi a nɔ nɛ a da kɛ wo lɛ nguɔ, benɛ e he bɔfo ɔmɛ atuu nɛ e je mɛ blɔ kɛ gu blɔ kpa nɔ ɔ lo?

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ mumi be mi ɔ ji gbogboe ɔ, ja nɔuu hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ni tsumihi be he ɔ ji hemi kɛ yemi gbogboe.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ fuu nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he tsɔɔli, ejakaa nyɛ le kaa wɔ tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, wa kojomi nya maa wa.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wɔ tsuo kulaa wa tɔɔ fuu. Ke nɔ ko tɔ we ngɛ munyu mi ɔ, lɛɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ji lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ maa ye e nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Ke waa kɛ okpɔngɔ nya mi dade woɔ a nya mi konɛ a bu wɔ tue ɔ, wa ma nyɛ kpaka mɛ kɛ ya he nɛ wa suɔ.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Oʼɛ, lɛhi hu, e ngɛ mi kaa a kle hluu, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa kpakaa mɛ, se kudɔɔ nyafii ko kɛkɛ a kɛ kudɔɔ mɛ kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ lɛ kudɔɔtsɛ ɔ suɔ.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu lilɛ hu, e ji nɔmlɔ tso he nɔ ko nyafii, se efiãa ni nguahi, oʼɛ, la nyafii hu, nyɛɛ hyɛ hue abɔ sɔuu nɛ e saa!

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Nɛ lilɛ ɔ hu la ʼi, wa he ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, lilɛ ji ni yayahi a je nɛ bleɔ nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ kulaa. E maa ma je mi si himi kulaa nya la kɛ la nɛ jee abosiami a je nitsɛ.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nyɛɔ jɔɔ nga mi lohwehi kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ waa kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ wo mi ɔmɛ a su tsuaa su he;

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: se lilɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ ko nɔmlɔ ko nyɛ we e he jɔɔmi; nɔ́ yayami nɛ plegeje nɛ e hyi tɔ kɛ duɔ nɛ gbee nɔ ʼi.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Nya kake ɔ nɔuu mi gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi jee. Mamimɛ, enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e sɛ́ nɛ e baa ja.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Anɛ nyu hɛngmɛ baa nyu mua kɛ ngo nyu kɛ jee e hɛngmɛ kake ɔ nɔuu mi lo?

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, anɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ma nyɛ nu tso yiblii maa wo, aloo wai tso maa wo ngmɔkɔ? Ja nɔuu kɛ́ ngo nyu ko be nyu mua nyɛe maa pee. Ni lemi nɛ je hiɔwe

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ji ni lelɔ kɛ sane se kɔlɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti? Ha nɛ e kɛ je mi bami kpakpa nɛ tsɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nitsumi ɔmɛ ngɛ kpoo peemi kɛ ni lemi mi.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Se ke hunga jemi yaya kɛ pɛ, kɛ he suɔmi ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko fia nɛ nyɛɛ ye lakpa ngɔ si anɔkuale ɔ.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a ni lemi nɛ ɔ, pi hiɔwe nɛ e je, se mohu zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɔ́ ʼi, he lo nya nɔ́ ʼi, mumi yayamihi a nɔ́ ʼi.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Ejakaa he nɛ hunga jemi kɛ pɛ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ sakasaka peemi kɛ ni yayahi kulaa ngɛ.

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Dami yiblii ɔ, nihi nɛ peɔ he jɔmi nihi ɔ, mɛ lɛ a duɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Jije tahi kɛ kunɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ je? Anɛ pi nyɛ kɔnɔhi nɛ hwuɔ ta ngɛ nyɛ he ni ɔmɛ a mi ɔ mi nɛ a je lo?

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Nihi peɔ nyɛ akɔnɔ, se nyɛ na we; lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ gbee nɔ; nyɛ jee hunga, se nyɛ nine nyɛ we nɔ nɛ e su; lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ nɔɔ kunɔ nɛ nyɛ pɛɛ; nyɛ na we nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ kpa we he pɛɛ.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpaa pɛɛ, nɛ nyɛ na we, ejakaa nyɛ kpaa pɛɛ yaya konɛ nyɛ kpata ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ kɔnɔ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Gbapuɛli! Nyɛ li kaa je nɛ ɔ kɛ huɛbɔmi ɔ Mawu nyɛmi ʼi lo? Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɛ e kɛ je ɔ nɛ bɔ huɛ ɔ, e ji Mawu henyɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Aloo nyɛ susu kaa yaka nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ke: “Hunga jemi se mumi nɛ hii wa mi ɔ dii” ɔ?

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Se Mawu dloɔ nɔ babauu. Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke: “Mawu ɔ, e kuɔ he woli a nya, se he si bali e dloɔ.”

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha Mawu; nyɛɛ te si ngɔ wo Abosiami, nɛ e maa tu nyɛ nya fo.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ su Mawu he, nɛ e maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su nyɛ he Nyɛ fɔ nyɛ dɛ, nyɛ yayami peeli, nɛ nyɛ ha nyɛ tsui he nɛ tsɔ, nyɛ juɛmi enyɔenyɔtsɛmɛ.

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ, nyɛɛ wo ya nɛ nyɛ fo; nyɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ plɛ kɔmɔ yemi, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ hu nɛ plɛ hɛ mi si puemi.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e ma wo nyɛ nɔ. Nyɛmi kojomi he kɔkɔbɔmi

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi a he sieku, mamimɛ. Nɔ nɛ tuɔ e nyɛmi he munyu aloo e kojoɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, Mlaa a e ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ sie, nɛ Mlaa a e ngɛ kojoe ɔ nɛ. Ke o ngɛ Mlaa a kojoe, ɔ pi Mlaa a nɔ yelɔ ji mo, se Mlaa a kojolɔ mohu ji mo.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Nɔ kake ji mlaa wolɔ kɛ kojolɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami nɛ e kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi hulɔ; se moo lɛɛ, mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o kojoɔ o nyɛmi? Fiami he kɔkɔbɔmi

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nyɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke: “Mwɔnɛ loo hwɔɔ ɔ wa maa ya kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ loo kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ wa ya ye jeha kake ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ wa ya ye jua, nɛ wa na se,”

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: kpahu nyɛ li hwɔɔ sane. Ejakaa mɛni ji nyɛ wami ɔ? E ji afua nɛ woɔ be bɔɔ ko, nɛ ke pee se ɔ e laa.

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ nyɛ fiaa ngɛ nyɛ he womi ɔmɛ a mi; kikɛmɛ a fiami nɛ ɔ kulaa a yayami ʼi.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ le kpakpa peemi nɛ e pee we ɔ, e ji yayami ha lɛ.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nyɛ niatsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue, nyɛ fo ya nɛ nyɛ wɔ lele ngɛ dengmehi nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔmɛ a he!

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ni babauu ɔ sa, nɛ nyɛ tade ɔmɛ hu wɔyewɔyehi ye.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Nyɛ sika tsu kɛ nyɛ sika hiɔ ɔmɛ nɔ kana, nɛ a he kana amɛ maa ye nyɛ he odase, nɛ e maa sã nyɛ he womi mi kaa la. Nyɛ bua juetli nya ngɔ to ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Oʼɛ, ni tsuli nɛ kpa nyɛ ngmɔ ni nɛ nyɛ wui mɛ hiɔ ngɛ sisimi nya a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae, nɛ nihi nɛ bua nyɛ ni ɔmɛ a nya amɛ a ngmlaa a sɛ Asafo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tue mi.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ye nyɛ nya ni ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ho ya. Nyɛ lɛ nyɛ tsui hluu kɛ ya su gbemi ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Nyɛ bu dalɔ ɔ fɔ, nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ, nɛ e tsi we nyɛ nya. Tsuisitomi kɛ sɔlemi

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mamimɛ, nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si, kɛ ya su Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami be ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ hulɔ ɔ mlɛɔ zugba a ni bami nɛ he jua wa, nɛ e toɔ e tsui si ngɛ he kɛ ya suu be nɛ gbo kɛ gbiɛ nyu nɛɛ ɔ;

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: nyɛ hu nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si; nyɛɛ da si tutuutu, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami be ɔ su ta.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ ko pia nyɛ sibi konɛ Mawu ko kojo nyɛ. Oʼɛ, kojolɔ ɔ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ gbali nɛ tu munyu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ ngɔ pee amanehlu kɛ tsui si tomi nɔ hyɛmi nɔ.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Wa tsɛɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ toɔ a tsui si ɔ ke nihi nɛ a gbaa. Nyɛ nu Hiob tsui si tomi ɔ he, nɛ nyɛ na bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ to lɛ ha ngɛ nyagbe mi ɔ, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi saa lɛ babauu nɛ e muklii mi jɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: Se titli ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ ko ka kita, hiɔwe jio, zugba jio, aloo kita kpa ko jio; nyɛ “Ee” nɛ pee ee, nɛ “Dɛbi” nɛ pee dɛbi, konɛ nyɛ ko sɛ kojomi mi.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ, e sɔle; kɛ nɔ ko bua jɔ ɔ, e la yi jemi la.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko be he wami ɔ, e tsɛ asafo ɔ mi nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi nɛ a sɔle ha lɛ,

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: nɛ hemi kɛ yemi sɔlemi nɛ ɔ ma he hiɔtsɛ ɔ yi wami, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma tle lɛ si, nɛ ke e pee yayami ɔ, a kɛ maa pa lɛ.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ jaje nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle ngɔ ha nyɛ he, konɛ a tsa nyɛ. Dalɔ sɔlemi nɛ mi wa a nyɛɔ nihi babauu tsuɔ.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Elia ji nɔmlɔ adesa kaa wɔ nɔuu, nɛ e sɔle sɔlemi ko konɛ hiɔmi ko nɛ, nɛ e nɛ́ ngɛ zugba a nɔ jeha etɛ kɛ hlami ekpa sɔuu.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kpale sɔle, nɛ Mawu ha hiɔmi nɛ, nɛ zugba a ba ni.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko tla blɔ kɛ je anɔkuale ɔ mi nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ lɛ kpalee ekohu ɔ,

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: ha nɛ e le kaa nɔ nɛ kpaleɔ yayami peelɔ kɛ jee e blɔ tlami mi ɔ ma he yayami peelɔ ɔ klaa yi wami kɛ je gbenɔ mi, nɛ e maa ha yayamihi fuu nɔ.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Petro nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ, ngma ya ha nibwɔhi nɛ gbɛ fia Ponto, Kapodokia, Asia kɛ Bitinia a.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a hla, ngɛ Tsɛ Mawu ɔ yi mi tomi nya, ngɛ Mumi ɔ he tsukɔmi mi, kɛ ha Yesu Kristo tue bumi kɛ he fɔmi ngɛ e muɔ ɔ mi. Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ e hiɛ fuu ha nyɛ! Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ hɛ ngɛ

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: A gbaa Mawu kɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ fɔ wɔ ehe ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mɔbɔnami babauu ɔ nya, ngɔ ha hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ Yesu Kristo si nɛ ete kɛ je gbeje ɔ he.

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ haa wɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ gbo si ni nɛ puɛ we, nɛ mu be he, nɛ kpa we, nɛ a ngɔ to ngɛ hiɔwe ha nyɛ ɔ he,

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: nyɛ nihi nɛ a gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ buu nyɛ he ngɛ Mawu he wami nya ngɔ toɔ yi wami hemi nɛ a dla ngɔ to nɛ a ma je kpo ngɛ nyagbe be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ ngɛ enɛ ɔ he, pohu e maa hia kaa nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ bɔɔ ko amlɔ nɛ ngɛ kahi slɔɔtohi a mi;

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: konɛ a na nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi sami ɔ kaa e he jua wa babauu. Sika tsu po nɛ puɛɛ ɔ, a kaa ngɛ la mi; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ he jua wa pe sika tsu ɔ hu sa nɛ a ka lɛ konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e hi si. Lɛɛ, nyɛ nine maa su yi jemi kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu nɔ ngɛ Yesu Kristo kpo jemi ɔ mi,

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ mohu, se nyɛ suɔ lɛ, nɔ nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu nyɛ nɛ lɛ mohu, se nyɛ he e nɔ ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ mi mi fliɔ nyɛ kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ nyami babauu nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale,

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: ejakaa nyɛ nine maa su hemi kɛ yemi nyagbe nɛ ji nyɛ klaa amɛ a yi wami hemi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi nɛ ɔ gbali nɛ gba ngɛ dloomi nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ he ɔ hla se blɔ, nɛ a bi si;

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: nɛ a kpale bi be ɔ si, be nɛ kɛ bɔ nɛ Kristo Mumi nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ je tsɔɔ, benɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ amanehlu nɛ maa ba Kristo nɔ kɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ maa ba ngɛ kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a se ɔ he odase yee kɛ ngɛ toe ɔ.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ gbali ɔmɛ ke, tsa pi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ʼi, se nyɛ mohu nyɛ he nɛ a sɔmɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nihi nɛ jehanɛ nihi nɛ jaje sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ a tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi tete hɛ jaa ngɛ he kaa a ko na mi. Sihimi klɔuklɔu

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ dla nyɛ juɛmi kɛ ha ni tsumi, nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ dloomi nɛ a kɛ ma ha nyɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo kpo jemi ɔ mi ɔ nɔ kulaa.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he kaa bimɛ tue buli, nɛ nyɛ ko ba nyɛ je mi ngɛ sa benɛ nyɛ li nɔ́ ko ɔ mi akɔnɔ ɔmɛ a nya hu,

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: se mohu ɔ, bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu ngɛ nyɛ je mi bami tsuo mi.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa pa ngma ke: “Nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu ejakaa klɔuklɔu ji mi.”

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nyɛ tsɛɔ nɔ nɛ hyɛ we nihi a hɛ mi se e kojoɔ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ni tsumi nya a ke nyɛ tsɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi nɛ ba nyɛ je mi ngɛ nyɛ wami be nɛ piɛ nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le kaa pi nihi nɛ puɛɔ, kaa juɛtɛɛ loo sika tsu, a kɛ kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ yakayaka je mi bami nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ mi,

english_verse: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
translation_verse: se mohu, Kristo, nɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa to bi nɛ he be piami loo mu ko ɔ muɔ nɛ he jua wa a.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: A hla lɛ momo sa loko a to je ɔ sisi, se e a je lɛ kpo ngɛ be ɔmɛ a nyagbe mi ngɛ nyɛ he.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ gu e nɔ he Mawu, nɔ nɛ tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje nɛ e wo e hɛ mi nyami ɔ ye, benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ nyɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ hi Mawu nɔ.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, akɛnɛ nyɛ tsukɔ nyɛ klaa amɛ a he ngɛ anɔkuale tue bumi mi ha nyɛmimɛ a he dɔmi nɛ lakpa be mi he je ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ tsui klɔuu nɛ suɔ nyɛ he saminya.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Ejakaa “He lo kulaa ngɛ kaa nga. Nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kulaa ngɛ kaa nga mi mɔmɔ. Nga gbliɔ nɛ e mi mɔmɔ ɔmɛ wɔleɔ;

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ hii si kɛ yaa neneene.” Enɛ ɔ ji munyu nɛ a jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ ke Sane Kpakpa a nɛ.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ sake yayami tsuo kɛ kutupɔ tsuo kɛ osato kɛ ninyɛ kɛ nihi a he munyu tumi kulaa ngɔ pue he.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee kaa bimwɔwi nɛ a fɔ he nɛ ngɛ mumi mi nyɔ nyu klɔuu hlae nɛ a nu, konɛ nyɛɛ wa kɛ na yi wami hemi.

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ: “Nyɛ sa nyɛ nya Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mimijɔmi ɔ.”

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ kaa tɛ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ nimli kua lɛ mohu, se Mawu lɛɛ, e hla lɛ nɛ e he jua wa ngɛ e hɛ mi,

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ hu, nyɛ ha a ngɔ nyɛ kaa tɛ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ a kɛ fia mumi mi sɔlemi tsu nɛ nyɛɛ pee osɔfohi a weku konɛ nyɛɛ sã mumi mi bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa e ngɛ ngmami ɔ mi ke: “Oʼɛ, i kɛ kɔ nya tɛ ngɛ si mae ngɛ Zion, Tɛ nɛ a hla nɛ he jua wa, Nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, tɛ nɛ ɔ he jua wa ha nyɛ; se ninɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ, “tɛ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ kua a, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ plɛ kɔ nya tɛ kɛ si tɛmi tɛ kɛ nane kpatami tɛ sa ha mɛ.”

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, weku nɛ a hla ji nyɛ, matsɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ osɔlohi, je ma klɔuklɔu, ma nɛ e ngɔ pee e nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ jaje nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ je diblii ɔ mi kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e nyakpɛ la a he ɔ agbo jemi ɔ.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Sa a, nyɛ pi ma, se jehanɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ji nyɛ; sa a, a nɛ nyɛ mɔbɔ, se jehanɛ ɔ, a na nyɛ mɔbɔ. Mawu nyɔguɛhi

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, i ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe kaa nibwɔhi kɛ blɔ hiali kaa nyɛɛ nyɛ he lo se dimi nihi nɛ kɛ klaa hwuɔ ta,

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya ngɛ maje li a bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, konɛ nɔ́ mi nɛ a tuɔ nyɛ he munyu ngɛ kaa yayami peeli ɔ, nyɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi nɛ a naa a, a kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ e bami ligbi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nimli a blɔ nya tomi tsuaa blɔ nya tomi, ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he, matsɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ jio,

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: amlaalofohi nɛ e tsɔ ngɛ yayami peeli a tue gblami he kɛ kpakpa peeli a yi jemi he ɔ jio.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Kaa sodehehi, se pi ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ odehe yemi nɛ ɔ kɛ peɔ yayami nɔ hami nɔ, se mohu kaa Mawu sɔmɔli.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu nɔ tsuaa nɔ; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ; nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye; nyɛɛ bu matsɛ. Kristo amanehlu ɔ kaa nɔhyɛmi nɔ́

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Sɔmɔli, nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi tsuo nɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ, pi nimli kpakpahi kɛ mi mi hili kɛkɛ, se mohu nimli yayamihi hulɔ.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji dloomi ke Mawu he nilemi he je nɛ nɔ ko nyɛɔ nidɔ ni nya daa, nɛ e naa amanehlu nɛ sɛ ɔ.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Enɛ nɔuu he nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ, ejakaa Kristo hu na amanehlu ha nyɛ nɛ e kɛ to okadi kɛ fɔ̃ si ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e nane ma he ɔmɛ a se,

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: lɛ nɔ nɛ e pee we yayami nɛ jeha nɛ hu lakpa ko ji e nya mi ɔ,

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ benɛ a ngɛ lɛ jɛe ɔ, e jɛ we nɔ ko tui nane mi, benɛ e ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, e gbiɛ́ nɔ ko, se mohu e tu e sane ngɔ wo nɔ nɛ kojoɔ dami nya a dɛ mi.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Yesu nitsɛ tloo wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hi kɛ ya sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ, konɛ wa gbo ha yayami nɛ wa hɛ hi ngmengmle ha dami, nɔ nɛ he pahi nɛ a kɛ tsa nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Ejakaa jinɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ laa, se jeha-nɛ ɔ, nyɛ kpale kɛ ba nyɛ klaa amɛ a lɛlɔ kɛ nɔhyɛlɔ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ yigbayi ɔmɛ hu, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hunomɛ, konɛ ke ni komɛ he we munyu ɔ yi tete po ɔ, a si munyu ɔ se nɛ a gu yi ɔmɛ a je mi bami nɔ nɛ nine nɛ su a nɔ,

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: ejakaa a naa nyɛ je mi bami nɛ he tsɔmi kɛ gbeye yemi ngɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ yi gbɔmi kɛ sika ni womi kɛ tade womi nɛ ko lua nyɛ he,

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: se mohu nyɛ he fɛu ɔ, a na ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, ngɛ mumi nɛ he jɔ nɛ ngɛ kpoo nɛ puɛ we ɔ mi, kɔlɔ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ he jua wa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Ejakaa sa a, jã yi klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hu nɛ hɛ ngɛ Mawu nɔ ɔ dla a he, nɛ a ba a he si ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hunomɛ;

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ Sara bu Abraham tue nɛ e tsɛ lɛ e nyɔmtsɛ tete ɔ; Sara bi yihi ji nyɛ ke nyɛ peɔ kpakpa nɛ nyɛ yi haomi ko gbeye ɔ.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Nyɛ, hunomɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ nɛ hi si ngɛ ni lemi nyɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bu nɛ bu yo ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ he wɛ tsɔ ko, akɛnɛ a kɛ nyɛ tsuo ji wami dloomi ɔ ni yeli ɔ, konɛ a ko tsi nyɛ sɔlemi ɔmɛ a blɔ. Kpakpapeemi he nɔnami

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he kaa nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ mi mi nɛ jɔ ha nyɛ sibi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ yayami ko ma yayami nane mi aloo jɛmi ngɛ jɛmi nane mi, se mohu nyɛɛ gbaa, ejakaa nyɛ le kaa enɛ ɔ he nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ nine nɛ su gbaami ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ e na wami Nɛ e na ligbi kpakpahi ɔ, E kɔ e lilɛ mi Nɛ e ko ye lakpa.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: E sa e he kɛ je yayami he nɛ e pee kpakpa. E hla he jɔmi nɛ e nyɛɛ kɔlɔ ɔ se.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛngmɛ ngɛ dali a he, Nɛ e buɔ a pɛɛ kpamihi tue; Se nihi nɛ peɔ ni yayamihi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je e hɛ̃ ka mɛ.”

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nyɛ bɔɔ nɔ kpakpa peemi he mɔde ɔ, mɛnɔ maa pee nyɛ yayami?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Se ke dami he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu nae tete po ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ! Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ ko hao hulɔ,

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hɛɛ he nile kpakpa, konɛ nɔ mi nɛ a tu nyɛ he munyu ngɛ kaa yayami peeli ɔ, zo nɛ gbe nihi nɛ gbe nyɛ je mi bami kpakpa nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ he guɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ na amanehlu ɔ, e hi mohu kaa nyɛ maa na kaa kpakpa peeli pe nɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na kaa yayami peeli.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo nitsɛ hu na amanehlu si kake nyɔngloo ngɛ yayamihi a he, lɛ dalɔ ɔ, ngɛ nihi nɛ dɛ ɔmɛ a nane mi, konɛ e kɛ wɔ nɛ ya Mawu ngɔ. A gbe lɛ ngɛ he lo blɔfami mohu, se a ha lɛ wami ngɛ mumi blɔfami.

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ blema a, a bui Mawu tue benɛ e to e tsui si nɛ e mlɛ mɛ hluu ngɛ Noa be ɔmɛ a mi, benɛ a ngɛ daka ngua a kpɛe ɔ. Nihi bɔɔ nɛ ngɛ deka a mi — nihi kpaanyɔ — aklaahi a yi wami a he kɛ gu nyu mi.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Enɛ ji baptisimi nyu ɔ he okadi nɛ a kɛ heɔ wa yi wami, nɔ́ nɛ pi he womi nɔ mu jemi, se mohu e ji he nile kpakpa somi nɛ e kɛ Mawu soɔ, kɛ guu Yesu Kristo si temi ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ ho hiɔwe ya nɛ e hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ a ngɔ hiɔwe bɔfohi kɛ he blɔhi kɛ he wamihi ngɔ wo e sisi ɔ.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Kristo na amanehlu ha wɔ ngɛ he lo mi he je ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ jamɛ a juɛmi ɔ nɔuu nɛ mia kaa ta hwumi nihi, ejakaa nɔ nɛ na amanehlu ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, e jɔɔ yayami peemi,

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: konɛ be nɛ piɛ ha lɛ ngɛ he lo mi si himi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e ko hi si ngɛ nimli a kɔnɔhi a nya, se mohu ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nihi a nya.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa puɛ be babauu ngɛ be nɛ be momo ɔ mi kɛ pee nihi nɛ wɔ jali ɔmɛ peɔ, nɛ wa ba wa je mi ngɛ ya homi, akɔnɔhi, da demi, fiɛmi sakasakahi, jiklɔɔ kɛ wɔ jami ninyɛ nihi a mi.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: E peɔ wɔ jali ɔmɛ nyakpɛ kaa nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ yɛ́ kikɛmɛ a sakasaka peemi titãa nɛ ɔ nɔuu mi nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tuɔ nyɛ he munyu yaya;

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: se a maa bu akɔtaa ngɔ ha nɔ nɛ dla e he ngɔ to nɛ e maa kojo hɛ kãli kɛ ni gbogboehi tsuo ɔ.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa enɛ he je nɛ a jaje sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ni gbogboehi tete hu, ninɛmɛ nɛ a kojo mɛ ngɛ nimli a kojomi nya ngɛ he lo blɔfami mohu, se a hɛ maa hi ngmengmle kaa Mawu ngɛ mumi blɔfami. Mawu nike nihi a nɔ hyɛli kpakpahi

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo a nyagbe ɔ su ta; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ juɛmi mi nɛ tsɔ nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si kɛ ha sɔlemi.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Se titli ɔ, suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ nyɛ he ɔ mi nɛ wa, ejakaa suɔmi haa yayamihi babauu nɔ.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ sibi nibwɔ nɛ zanue lami ko hi mi.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ na dloomi ke ni ɔ, nyɛ kɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ he, kaa Mawu dloomi nihi slɔɔto ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli kpakpahi.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Ke munyu nɔ ko ngɛ tue ɔ, e tu lɛ kaa Mawu munyu; ke sɔmɔmi nɔ ko ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, e je he wami nɛ Mawu dloo lɛ ɔ mi; konɛ a gu Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nihi kulaa mi, nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji nyami ɔ, kɛ he wami ɔ, kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene ɔ! Amen. Kristofono nɔnami

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: Suɔli, nyɛ ko ha amanehlu la nɛ a kɛ ngɛ nyɛ kae ɔ nɛ pee nyɛ sane slɔɔto ko, kaa nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko slɔɔto ko lɛ ngɛ nyɛ pee ɔ,

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: se mohu si abɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo amanehlu ɔ eko nae ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, konɛ e hɛ mi nyami kpo jemi ɔ mi hu nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nɛ nyɛ mi nɛ flii nyɛ.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Ke Kristo biɛ ɔ he nihi jɛɛ nyɛ ɔ, da gbaa nyɛ, ejakaa hɛ mi nyami Mumi kɛ Mawu Mumi ɔ kpleɔ si kɛ baa nyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ko na amanehlu kaa awiyelɔ loo juɔ loo yayami peelɔ aloo nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ e he woɔ ni kpahi a sanehi a mi.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko ngɛ amanehlu nae kaa Kristofono ɔ, zo ko pee lɛ, se mohu e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ejakaa be nɛ a maa je kojomi sisi kɛ maa je Mawu we ɔ su ta. Ke wa nɔ kekle e je ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ bui Mawu sane kpakpa a tue ɔ, kɛ a nyagbe maa pee kɛɛ?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ, “Ke dengme loko a ma he dalɔ yi wami ɔ, Lɛɛ, nɔ nɛ yi Mawu gbeye kɛ yayami peelɔ ɔ, jije e maa da?”

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ naa amanehlu ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a hu a tu a klaahi ngɔ wo bɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nɛ a ya nɔ ngɛ kpakpa peemi mi.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, imi nɛ ji nyɛ nyɛmi nɔkɔtɔma kɛ Kristo amanehlu ɔmɛ a he odase yelɔ nɛ ma na hɛ mi nyami nɛ a ma je kpo ɔ hu eko ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke:

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ lɛ Mawu asafo nɛ a ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ, pi ngɛ nɔ nyɛmi nya, se mohu ngɛ suɔmi nya; jehanɛ hu, pi ngɛ se nami nɛ ngɛ zo he, se mohu tsui mi jɔmi nya;

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: jehanɛ hu, pi kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ asafo ɔmɛ a nɔ nyɔmtsɛmɛ a sane, se mohu nihi nɛ toɔ okadi haa asafo kuu ɔ.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ to hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ma je e he kpo ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su hɛ mi nyami jlasi nɛ ngla we ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
