translation_verse: Ja nɔuu nyɛ, jokuɛwi ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nikɔtɔma amɛ. Nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɔ ha nyɛ sibi nɛ nyɛɛ wo he si bami kaa tade, ejakaa “Mawu kuɔ he woli a nya, se e dloɔ he si bali.”

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɛ Mawu nine nɛ he wa a sisi, konɛ e wo nyɛ nɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ haomi kulaa ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, ejakaa lɛ lɛ juɛii nyɛ he.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si, nyɛɛ huɔ; ejakaa nyɛ he nyɛlɔ, abosiami ɔ, ngɛ si poe kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae ngɛ nɔ nɛ e maa mi hlae.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛɛ tsi lɛ blɔ, ejakaa nyɛ le kaa jamɛ a amanehlu ɔmɛ nɔuu nyɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi hu ngɛ nae.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Se dloomi tsuo kulaa Mawu nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba e neneene hɛ mi nyami ɔ mi ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, ke nyɛ na amanehlu bɔɔ nɔ tã a, lɛ nitsɛ e ma dla nyɛ pɛ, nɛ e maa waje nyɛ, nɛ e maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ maa pi si.

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: I gu wa nyɛmi Silvano nɛ ji anɔkualetsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i buu lɛ ɔ nɔ ngma nyɛ bɔɔ nɛ ɔ i kɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe, nɛ i ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ se fiee kaa enɛ ɔ ji Mawu anɔkuale dloomi ɔ nɛ; nyɛɛ da si ngɛ mi.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Asafo nɛ a hla ngɛ Babilon ngɔ piɛ wa he ɔ kɛ ye bi Marko hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga nyɛ sibi kɛ suɔmi nya he fiɔmi. Nyɛ he manye, nyɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ! Amen.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Simon Petro nɛ ji Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kɛ bɔfo ɔ, ngma ya ha nihi nɛ nine su hemi kɛ yemi nɛ he jua wa kaa wa nɔ ɔ nɔuu nɔ, ngɛ wa Mawu kɛ wa yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo dami ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ ha nyɛ ngɛ Mawu kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he ni lemi ɔ mi! Mawu nɔtsɛmi kɛ nɔhlami

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: E mawu he wami ɔ ngɔ nihi kulaa nɛ hi ha wami kɛ Mawu jami ngɔ ke wɔ ngɛ nɔ nɛ gu lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi nyami kɛ e himi nɔ kɛ tsɛ wɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ a gu nɛ a ngɔ si womi nguahi nguahi nɛ a he jua wa amɛ ngɔ ke wɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ gu kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ nyɛ na Mawu fɔmi su ɔ eko nɛ nyɛɛ tu je nɛ ɔ mi puɛmi nɛ ngɛ akɔnɔ mi ɔ nya fo.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ hiɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, e be hae nɛ nyɛ maa pee hejɔli aloo nihi nɛ wui yiblii ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he ni lemi ɔ blɔfami.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ be kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ hɛyuyuilɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e nɛ́ tsitsaa ni, akɛnɛ e hɛ je nɔ kaa a fɔ e sa yayami ɔmɛ pue he ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ wa je nyɛ tsɛmi kɛ nyɛ hlami ɔ, ejakaa ke nyɛ pee enɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ be si gbee gblegbleegblee.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kikɛmɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ a maa gu kɛ ngmɛ nyɛ blɔ kɛ sɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo neneene matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma kai nyɛ daa nɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he, pohu nyɛ le momo nɛ nyɛ nane pi si ngɛ anɔkuale nɛ ngɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Se be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ kikɛmɛ a bo tsu nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ɔ, i buu lɛ kaa e da kaa i kɛ kaimi nɛ tsɛ̃ɛ nyɛ hɛ;

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: ejakaa i le ka aye bo tsu nɛ ɔ kpami maa pee oya, kaa bɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo hu je kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Se ma bɔ he mɔde konɛ ye je mi jemi se ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ be tsuaa be. Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ he odase yeli

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi nyaziahi nɛ a sia ngɛ ga mi ɔ, se wa nyɛɛ kɛ jaje wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he wami kɛ e bami ɔ he sane tsɔɔ nyɛ, se mohu wɔ ji odase yeli nɛ na e hɛ mi nyami kpete-kpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ wa hɛngmɛ.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa e na bu kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ, benɛ jamɛ a gbi ɔ je hɛ mi nyami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi ba e ngɔ ke: “Nɔ nɛ ji ye suɔmi bi nɛ i naa e he tsui ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛ kikɛmɛ a gbi nɛ ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu kaa hiɔwe e je, benɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa na gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ mi mami. E maa hi ha nyɛ ke nyɛ bu tue, ejakaa e ngɛ kaa la ko nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ he ko nɛ wo diblii, kɛ maa su be nɛ je maa na nɛ nɔkɔ ɔ maa te si ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Kekleekle ɔ, nyɛɛ le enɛ kaa nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e maa tsɔɔ ngmami ɔ mi gbami ko sisi kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e sisi tsɔɔmi.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa gbami ko bɛ́ ngɛ nɔmlɔ suɔmi nya hyɛ, se mohu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ kpleɔ Mawu nimli klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a tuɔ munyu.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Lakpa gbali te si hyɛ ngɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɔuu nɛ lakpa tsɔɔli maa ba nyɛ hu nyɛ kpɛti ɔ. A kɛ hɛ mi kpatami tsɔɔmihi ma ba hɔ mi zaa, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ kpɔ mɛ ɔ po, a ma kua lɛ, nɛ a kɛ hɛ mi kpatami nɛ he ngɛ oya maa ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi fuu maa nyɛɛ a ya homi ɔ se, nɛ a he ɔ, a maa tu anɔkuale blɔ ɔ he munyu yaya.

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
translation_verse: Nɛ a kɛ kutupɔ munyuhi maa jua nyɛ ngɛ hɛ tsumi mi, nihi nɛ kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, a kojomi hlua we si, nɛ a hɛ mi kpatami ɔ hu be mahɛ hwɔe.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu ngɔɛ bɔfohi nɛ pee yayami ɔmɛ a he ngɔ ki mɛ, se mohu e tsitsɛɛ mɛ wo gbeje muɔ mi, he nɛ a fi mɛ kɛ diblii kpa ngɔ to ha kojomi.

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔɛ blema je ɔ he ngɔ ki lɛ; se mohu Noa nɛ fiɛ dami sane ɔ kɛ ni kpaago ɔ kɛkɛ yi e baa; nɛ e kɛ nyu afua a ba nihi nɛ kua Mawu ɔmɛ a je ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: Mawu puɛ Sodom kɛ Gomora ma amɛ, nɛ e sa mɛ kɛ la kɛ to odadi ha nihi nɛ ma kua Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: ejakaa a mlaa tɔmi ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ dalɔ ɔ na nɛ e nu, benɛ e ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, pii e tsui nɛ da a daa nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le bɔ nɛ e peɔ nɛ e jeɔ dali ngɛ ka mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e peɔ nɛ e haa nimli yayamihi hii piimi mi kɛ maa su kojomi ligbi ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: se titli ɔ, nihi nɛ nyɛɛ he lo se ngɛ he blemi akɔnɔ mi, nɛ a gbee Mawu nɔ yemi he guɛ ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsui wa, nɛ a woɔ a he, nɛ a bui hiɔwe bɔfohi tete, nɛ a tuɔ a he munyu yaya.

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Pohu hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ po nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kle pe kikɛmɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ kojo we mɛ kɛ he guɛ gbemi ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Se kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa lohwehi nɛ be juɛmi nɛ a fɔ mɛ ha numi kɛ gbemi. A tuɔ nihi nɛ a li he nɔ́ ko ɔmɛ a he munyu yaya, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata kaa nga mi lohwehi;

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: a kɛ nɔ nami maa wo mɛ nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a he hiɔ. A buu kpo nɔ ya homi kaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɔ; mutsɛmɛ nɛ he ngɛ tai ji mɛ, a hoɔ ya ngɛ a blɔ laami ɔmɛ a mi benɛ a kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ni yee ɔ.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: A hyɛ we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kaa ja yi ya holi, nɛ a hɛ jɔɛ kɛ yayami peemi; a mlɔɔ nihi nɛ nane pi si ɔmɛ; a ngɛ hɛ tsumi tsui; musu bimɛ ji mɛ.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: A je blɔ nɛ da a nɔ, nɛ a tla blɔ kɛ ya nyɛɛ Bosor bi Bileam, nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔ yayami peemi mi hiɔwo ɔ, blɔ ɔ nɔ;

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: se lɛɛ, a kã e hɛ mi ngɛ e mlaa tɔmi ɔ he; teji nɛ tu we munyu ɔ kɛ nɔmlɔ gbi tu munyu, nɛ e tsi gbalɔ ɔ kuasia peemi ɔ nya.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa nyu vuhi nɛ nyu be a mi, bɔkuhi nɛ kɔɔhiɔ fiaa kɛ yaa, nihi nɛ a kɛ diblii tsitsliitsli ɔ to ha mɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ nya puu munyu nguahi jee a nya mi he je ɔ, a guu he lo akɔnɔhi a nɔ nɛ a kɛ ya homi mlɔɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ je wɔ jami mi kɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: A woɔ mɛ si ke a maa ye a he, pohu mɛ nitsɛ mɛ ɔ puemi nyɔguɛhi ji mɛ, ejakaa nɔmlɔ peɔ nyɔguɛ ngɔ haa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ yeɔ e nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke a gu Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo he ni lemi ɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ tu je nɛ ɔ mi mu ni ɔmɛ a nya fo, nɛ lɔ ɔ ɔmɛ ami nɔuu a kpale du mɛ ngɛ, nɛ a ye a nɔ ekohu ɔ, a nyagbe si himi ɔ peɔ yayami pe kekle ɔ.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Ejakaa afani nɛ a na we nɛ a le dami blɔ ɔ pe nɛ a le nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ, a kpale kɛ je kita klɔuklɔu nɛ a tu ngɔ wo a dɛ mi ɔ he.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Abɛ ɔ ba mi niinɛ ngɛ a he ke: “Gbe kpaleɔ e se kɛ yaa lɛ nitsɛ e vie he, nɛ kpotoo nɛ a du ha lɛ ɔ ya wuɔ mɔsɔ.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: I suɔ kaa nyɛ kai gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a munyuhi nɛ a tu sa a, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ yi wami helɔ ɔ kita nɛ bɔfohi nɛ a tsɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Kekleekle ɔ, nyɛɛ le enɛ ɔ kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nɔ he fɛu yeli maa ba kɛ he fɛu yemi, nihi nɛ maa nyɛɛ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɔnɔ ɔmɛ a nya,

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: nɛ a ma de ke: “Jije e bami ɔ he si womi ɔ ngɛ? Ejakaa kɛ je be nɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbo nɛ ɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ nihi ngɛ kɛ je je ɔ bɔmi sisije mi ɔ, ja nɔuu a ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Pe a bua nɛ a jeɔ a hɛ ngɛ enɛ nɔ kaa hiɔwe ngɛ kɛ je blema lokoo, nɛ zugba hu je nyu mi, nɛ e gu nyu mi kɛ ba ma si ngɛ Mawu munyu nya;

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Se hiɔwe kɛ zugba nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e munyu lɛ hɛɛ mɛ kɛ to ha la, nɛ a kɛ mɛ to kɛ yaa su kojomi kɛ nimli nɛ kua Mawu ɔ a hɛ mi kpatami ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Tsa pi kɛmi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha e si womi ɔ se ngɛ kɛe, kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ buu kaa e se ngɛ kɛe ɔ, se mohu e tsui si e ngɛ toe kɛ ngɛ wɔ hae, ejakaa e sume kaa ni komɛ nɛ laa, se mohu kaa nihi tsuo a tsake a tsui.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ maa ba ka juɔ baa nyɔ mi, nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ, hiɔwe maa be kɛ ho kɛ huami wawɛɛ, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi sisije ni ɔmɛ maa sle ngɛ la mi, nɛ je ɔ kɛ e mi ni tsumi ɔmɛ maa sã.

english_verse: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, akɛnɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata he je ɔ, mɛni nimli sa kaa nyɛ pee ngɛ je mi bami klɔuklɔu kɛ Mawu jami mi?

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: Sa nɛ nyɛɛ pee nihi nɛ hyɛɛ Mawu ligbi ɔ bami ɔ blɔ, lɛ be ɔ mi nɛ hiɔwe ma mle kɛ la nɛ e maa sã, nɛ je mi sisije nihi hu maa sle ngɛ la mi.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Se ngɛ e si womi ɔ nya a, wa ngɛ hiɔwe he ko kɛ zugba he nɛ dami hii mi ɔ blɔ hyɛe.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu wa Nyɔmtsɛ tsui si tomi ɔ kaa yi wami hemi, kaa bɔ nɛ wa suɔmi nyɛmi Paulo ɔ hu ngma nyɛ ngɛ ni lemi nɛ a kɛ ha lɛ ɔ nya a.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: E tuɔ enɛ ɔmɛ a he munyu ngɛ e womi ɔmɛ tsuo a mi. E womi ɔmɛ a mi ni komɛ a sisi numi yee, nɛ nihi nɛ kase we nɔ́ ko kɛ nihi nɛ a nane pi si ɔ tsɔɔ sisi kpa, kaa bɔ nɛ a peɔ ngmamihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ hu, kɛ kpataa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, mamimɛ, akɛnɛ nyɛ le momosa he je ɔ, nyɛɛ huɔ, konɛ a kɛ nimli yayamihi a sisimi sane ɔ ko ba gbla nyɛ hu, nɛ nyɛ ba gbee si kɛ je nyɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ keke ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo dloomi kɛ ni lemi ɔ mi. Lɛ nɔuu a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha jehanɛ kɛ daa. Amen.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Wa ngma nyɛ Wami Munyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ; nɔ́ nɛ wa nu nɛ wa na kɛ wa hɛngmɛ; nɔ́ nɛ wa hyɛ nɛ wa nine ta he.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Nɛ wami ɔ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ: nɛ wa na, nɛ wa yeɔ he odase, nɛ wa jajeɔ neneene wami ɔ, nɔ nɛ kɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ nɛ e je e he kpo tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ he sane ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ wa na nɛ wa nu ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa jajeɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ nɛ bɔ huɛ. Se oʼɛ, wa huɛ bɔmi ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ ke e Bi Yesu Kristo ɔ waa kɛ bɔɔ.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae konɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si. Mawu ji la

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji bɔfo sane nɛ wa nu kɛ je e ngɔ nɛ wa kpale ngɛ jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ, kaa Mawu ɔ la ji lɛ, nɛ diblii ko be e mi kulaa.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Ke wa de ke waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ huɛ bɔe, se wa nyɛɛ diblii ɔ mi ɔ, wa ngɛ lakpa yee nɛ wa tu we anɔkuale.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Se ke wa nyɛɛ ngɛ la a mi, kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɛ la a mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ waa kɛ wa he ngɛ huɛ bɔe, nɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo muɔ ɔ tsukɔɔ wa he kɛ jee yayami tsuaa yayami mi.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ke wa de ke yayami ko be wa he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wa ngɛ sisie, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ be wa mi.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Ke wa jaje wa he yayami ɔmɛ ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ kɛ dalɔ ji Mawu, e kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa wɔ, nɛ e maa tsukɔ wa he kɛ maa je nihi, nɛ dɛ blɔ kulaa mi.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ke wa ke wa pee we yayami ɔ, lɛɛ wa ngɛ Mawu lakpatsɛ bue, nɛ e munyu ɔ be wa mi.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae, konɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami. Se ke nɔ ko pee yayami po hu ɔ, wa ngɛ mi dalɔ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, Yesu Kristo, dalɔ ɔ;

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: iɛ ji wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he kpatami nɔ́; se pi ngɛ wa nɔ́ ɔ kɛkɛ he, se mohu je mluku ɔ tsuo nɔ́ ɔ he hulɔ.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ deɔ ke: “I le lɛ,” nɛ e yi e kita amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ be e mi.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ e munyu ɔ nɔ ɔ, niinɛ, lɛ e mi Mawu suɔmi ɔ pi si ngɛ. Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ leɔ kaa wa ngɛ e mi.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ deɔ ke e ngɛ Mawu mi ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo nyɛɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e nyɛɛ ja nɔuu. Kita he ɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, pi kita he ko nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, se mohu kita momo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ: Kita momo ɔ ji munyu nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ kita he i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, nɔ́ nɛ ji anɔkuale ngɛ Kristo mi kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ mi ɔ, ejakaa diblii ɔ ngɛ bee, nɛ anɔkuale la a ngɛ tsoe jehanɛ.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ deɔ ke e ngɛ la a mi nɛ e nyɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyami ɔ, diblii ɔ mi e ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ suɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, e hii la a mi, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nane kpatami nɔ́ ko be e mi;

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: se nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, diblii ɔ mi e ngɛ, nɛ diblii ɔ mi e nyɛɛ, nɛ e li he nɛ e yaa, ejakaa diblii ɔ yu e hɛ.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, bimɛ tsɔwi, ejakaa a ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ ngɛ Kristo biɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ ngmɛe, tsaatsɛmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. I ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, nihewi, ejakaa nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi. I ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, jokuɛwi, ejakaa nyɛ le Tsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, tsaatsɛmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. I ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, nihewi, ejakaa nyɛ he wa, nɛ Mawu munyu ɔ hii nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko suɔ je ɔ aloo nihi hu nɛ ngɛ je ɔmi ɔ. Ke nɔ ko suɔ je ɔ, lɛɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔmi ɔ be e mi.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, he lo ɔ se dimi ni ɔmɛ kɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ se dimi ni ɔmɛ kɛ si himi ɔ mi he womi ɔ, ji Tsɛ ɔ mi, se mohu je ɔ mi e je.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Je ɔ bee kɛ yaa kɛ e mi se dimi ni ɔmɛ, se nɔ nɛ peɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e hii si kɛ yaa neneene. Lakpa kristo

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Ye bimɛ, nyagbe ngmlɛfia a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ nu kaa lakpa kristo ɔ ma, nɛ jehanɛ lakpa kristohi fuu ba, he je ɔ, wa le kaa nyagbe ngmlɛfia a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Wa kpɛti a je kɛ ho, se kɛ ɔ, pi wa ti ni komɛ ji mɛ, ejakaa wa ti ni komɛ ji mɛ jinɛ a kɛ wɔ ko hi si; se a je benɛ pee nɛ a je a he si kaa tsa pi mɛ tsuo ji wa kpɛti nihi.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ na nu pɔmi kɛ je Nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ le anɔkuale ɔ.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Tsa pi kaa nyɛ li anɔkuale ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, se mohu kaa nyɛ le, nɛ nyɛ le kaa lakpa ko lakpa ko ji anɔkuale ɔ mi.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji lakpatsɛ? Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ deɔ ke pi Yesu ji Kristo ɔ. Nɔ nɛ kuaa Tsɛ ɔ kɛ Bi ɔ, lɛ ji lakpa kristo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuaa Bi ɔ, e kuaa Tsɛ ɔ hulɔ. Se nɔ nɛ heɔ Bi ɔ, e ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: The Son has promised us eternal life.
translation_verse: Nɛ enɛ ɔ ji si nɛ Kristo wo wɔ ɔ nɛ; neneene wami ɔ.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ ngmae ngɛ nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a puɛ nyɛ tue ɔ he.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nu pɔmi nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je e ngɔ ɔ hii nyɛ mi, nɛ e hia we nyɛ nɔ ko nɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ni, se mohu bɔ nɛ e nu pɔmi ɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nihi kulaa, nɛ e ji anɔkuale se pi lakpa a, he je ɔ, bɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hi e mi.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ, bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ hi e mi, konɛ e puemi ɔ mi ɔ, wa na kã nɛ zo ko gbe wɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ e bami ɔ mi.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ le kaa dalɔ ji Kristo ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ytsuɔ dami ni ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ suɔmi abɔ sɔuu nɛ Tsɛ ɔ kɛ suɔ nyɛ, kaa a tsɛ wɔ Mawu bimɛ nɛ wa ji nɛ! Enɛ he ɔ, je ɔ li wɔ, ejakaa e li lɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, jehanɛ ɔ, Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ, nɛ a na we nɛ a je bɔ nɛ wa maa hi ha a si; se wa le kaa benɛ Kristo ma pue ɔ, wa maa hi kaa lɛ, ejakaa wa maa na lɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peɔ yayami ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu mlaa nɔ tɔe, ejakaa yayami ji mlaa nɔ tɔmi.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ le kaa Kristo je e he kpo konɛ e wo wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ho, nɛ yayami ko be e mi.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hii Kristo mi ɔ, e pee we yayami. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peɔ yayami ɔ, e nɛ lɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu e li lɛ.

english_verse: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
translation_verse: Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ mlɔɔ nyɛ. Nɔ nɛ tsuɔ dami nihi ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ji dalɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peɔ yayami ɔ, e je abosiami mi, ejakaa kɛ je sisije lokoo nɛ abosiami pee yayami. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu Bi ɔ je e he kpo konɛ e puɛ abosiami ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e pee we yayami, ejakaa Mawu su ngɛ e mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be yayami nyɛe maa pee, ejakaa Mawu bi ji lɛ.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Enɔ mi nɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ Mawu bimɛ kɛ abosiami bimɛ a kpɛti ɔ jeɔ e he si paa ngɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsu we dami nihi ɔ, nɛ e sume e nyɛmi hulɔ ɔ, pi Mawu bi ji lɛ. Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji fiɛmi nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ kaa waa suɔ wa sibi;

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: wa ko pee kaa Kain nɔ nɛ je nɔ yayami ɔ mi nɛ e gbe e nyɛmi ɔ. Mɛni he je nɛ e gbe e nyɛmi ɔ? Ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ yayami ʼi, se e nyɛmi ɔ nɔ ɔ da.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, ke je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ko pee nyɛ yaa.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa wa po mi kɛ je gbenɔ mi kɛ ho wami mi ya, ejakaa wa suɔ wa nyɛmimɛ. Nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi ɔ, e hii gbenɔ mi.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko be neneene wami ngɛ e mi.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ mi wa naa suɔmi ngɛ, kaa Kristo ngɔ e wami ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ wa he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ e sa kaa wɔ hu waa kɛ wa wami fɔɔ si ngɛ wa nyɛmimɛ a he.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko na je nɔ mi ni, nɛ e na kaa e fi nyɛmi, nɛ e nga e tsui nyɛ wo lɛ ɔ, kɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ maa pee kɛ hi e mi kɛɛ?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛ ko ha waa suɔ nimli ngɛ munyu tutui mi loo ngɛ lilɛ nɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu ngɛ ni tsumi kɛ anɔkuale mi. Mawu hɛ mi kãpeemi

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Enɛ waa kɛ maa le kaa anɔkuale ɔ mi wa je, nɛ wa ma tsɔ wa tsui ngɔ fɔ wa mi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: Ke wa tsui buu wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa le kaa Mawu kle pe wa tsui, nɛ e le nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, ke wa tsui bui wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa ngɛ ka ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Nɛ enɛ ji e kitaa a nɛ, kaa wa he e Bi Yesu Kristo biɛ ɔ nɔ ngɔ ye, nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo wɔ kita a.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ e kita amɛ a nɔ ɔ hii Mawu mi, nɛ Mawu hu hii emi. Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ waa kɛ leɔ kaa e hii wa mi ji mumi nɛ e ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: Suɔli, nyɛ ko he mumi tsuaa mumi ngɔ ye, se mohu nyɛɛ ka mumi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa Mawu mi a je lo; ejakaa lakpa gbali fuu je kpo kɛ ba je ɔ mi.

english_verse: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
translation_verse: Enɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma yo Mawu mumi ɔ: Mumi tsuaa mumi nɛ jajeɔ paa kaa Yesu Kristo ba ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, e je Mawu mi.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Nɛ mumi tsuaa mumi nɛ jaje we kaa Yesu Kristo ba ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, pi Mawu mi nɛ e je, se mohu e ji lakpa kristo mumi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nu e he kaa e ma a, nɛ jehanɛ tete e ngɛ je ɔ mi momo.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ je Mawu mi, nɛ nyɛ ye lakpa gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi; ejakaa mumi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ kle pe mumi nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛɛ je ɔ mi a je, lɔ ɔ he ɔ a tuɔ munyu kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ je je ɔ mi, nɛ je ɔ buɔ mɛ tue.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu mi wa je; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le Mawu ɔ, e buɔ wɔ tue; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e ji Mawu mi ɔ e bui wɔ tue. Lɔ ɔ waa kɛ naa anɔkuale mumi ɔ kɛ lakpa mumi ɔ. Mawu Suɔmi

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, nyɛ ha waa suɔ wa sibi, ejakaa suɔmi ɔ Mawu mi e je, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ, nɛ e le Mawu.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ sume nɔ ɔ, e li Mawu; ejakaa Mawu ɔ suɔmi ji lɛ.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ mi Mawu suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ jee kpo ngɛ, kaa Mawu tsɔ iɛ nitsɛ e Bi kake ɔ kɛ ba je ɔ mi, konɛ waa gu e nɔ nɛ wa na wami.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ mi suɔmi ɔ ngɛ: pi kaa wɔ iɛ wa suɔ Mawu se mohu kaa lɛ nɛ e suɔ wɔ, nɛ e tsɔ e Bi ɔ ke e ba pee wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he kpatami nɔ.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, ke Mawu suɔ wɔ kikɛ ɔ, esa kaa wɔ hu waa suɔ wa sibi.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ. Ke wa suɔ wa he ɔ, Mawu hii wa mi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ hii kɛ pii si ngɛ wa mi.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ leɔ kaa wa hii Mawu mi nɛ lɛ hu e hii wa mi, ejakaa e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e Mumi ɔ eko ngɔ ha wɔ.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa na, nɛ wa ngɛ odase yee kaa Tsɛ ɔ tsɔ e Bi ɔ kaa je ɔ yi wami helɔ.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jajeɔ paa kaa Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ, Mawu hii e mi, nɛ lɛ hu e hii Mawu mi.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa le, nɛ wa he Mawu suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ ye. Mawu ɔ suɔmi ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ nɛ hii suɔmi mi ɔ, e hii Mawu mi, nɛ Mawu hu hii e mi.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ mi suɔmi ɔ hi kɛ pi si ngɛ ngɛ wa mi, konɛ wa na kã ngɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ nɔ; ejakaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, jã wɔ hu wa ngɛ ngɛ je nɛ mi.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Gbeye be suɔmi mi, se mohu suɔmi nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ fieɔ gbeye, ejakaa piimi ngɛ gbeye yemi mi, se nɔ nɛ yee gbeye ɔ, e na we nɛ e hi kɛ pi si ngɛ suɔmi mi.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Wa suɔ lɛ ejakaa lɛ kekle e suɔ wɔ.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko de ke: “I suɔ Mawu,” nɛ e nyɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ. Ejakaa nɔ nɛ sume lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi nɛ e naa a, Mawu nɛ e nɛ́ ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ lɛ maa suɔ?

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Kita nɛ ji nɔ nɛ waa kɛ je Kristo ngɔ, konɛ nɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu ɔ, e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi hulɔ.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ. Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ fɔlɔ ɔ, suɔ bi ɔ nɛ e fɔ ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Enɛ waa kɛ leɔ kaa wa suɔ Mawu bimɛ, ke wa suɔ Mawu nɛ wa yeɔ e kita amɛ a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Ejakaa enɛ ji suɔmi nɛ wa suɔ Mawu kaa waa ye e kita amɛ a nɔ; nɛ e kita amɛ a nya wɛ́,

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ kunimi ɔ, kaa ja nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ? Yesu Kristo he odaseyemi

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo ji nɔ nɛ gu nyu kɛ muɔ mi kɛ ba a nɛ; pi nyu ɔ mi kɛkɛ se mohu ngɛ nyu kɛ muɔ ɔ mi. Nɛ Mumi ɔ ji nɔ nɛ yeɔ odase, ejakaa Mumi ɔ ji anɔkuale ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Odase yeli etɛ lɛ ngɛ,

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ, kɛ Nyu ɔ, kɛ Muɔ ɔ; nɛ mɛ ni etɛ ɔ tsuo kake ʼi.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Ke wa he nimli a odase ɔ, Mawu odase ɔ kle pe kɔlɔ ɔ; nɛ enɛ ji odase nɛ Mawu ye ngɛ e Bi ɔ he.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ, e ngɛ odase ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tsui mi; se nɔ nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ, ha e plɛ lakpatsɛ, ejakaa e he we odase nɛ Mawu ye ngɛ e Bi ɔ he ɔ yi.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji odase ɔ, kaa Mawu ngɔ neneene wami ngɔ ha wɔ, nɛ kikɛmɛ a wami nɛ ɔ peɔ wa nɔ ngɛ e Bi ɔ mi.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Bi ɔ, e ngɛ wami; nɔ nɛ be Bi ɔ e be wami hulɔ. Neneene wami

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae konɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ biɛ ɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ ngɛ neneene wami.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Nɛ enɛ ɔ ji ka nɛ wa ngɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ, kaa, ke wa ba nɔ́ ko ngɛ e suɔmi nya a, e buɔ wɔ tue.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke wa le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ wa baa lɛ ɔ e buɔ wɔ tue ɔ, blɔɔ wa le kaa nihi nɛ wa baa lɛ ɔ, wa nine su nɔ.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko na e nyɛmi nɛ e ngɛ yayami pee nɛ pi gbenɔ yayami ɔ, e bi Mawu, nɛ e ma ha lɛ wami, enɛ kɔɔ nihi nɛ peɔ yayami nɛ pi gbenɔ yayami ɔmɛ a he. Gbenɔ yayami ko ngɛ, se pi enɛ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ dee ke e bi ɔ.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔ yayami ʼi, se yayami ko ngɛ nɛ pi gbenɔ yayami.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e pee we yayami; se mohu Mawu Bi ɔ buu e he, nɛ nɔ yayami ɔ tɛ e he.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa wa je Mawu mi nɛ je mluku ɔ tsuo ngɛ nɔ yayami ɔ sisi.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Mawu Bi ɔ ba, nɛ e ba ha wɔ juɛmi konɛ waa le anɔkualetsɛ ɔ. Wa ngɛ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ mi, ngɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo mi; lɛ ji anɔkuale Mawu ɔ kɛ neneene wami ɔ.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɛ hi ngɛ wɔhi a he.

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: Nɔkɔtɔma a ngma ya ha Awula nɛ a hia lɛ kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ i suɔ ngɛ anɔkuale mi, nɛ pi ye nɔ kake kɛkɛ, se nihi kulaa nɛ a le anɔkuale ɔ,

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: ngɛ anɔkuale nɛ hii wa mi nɛ e kɛ wɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ he.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je tsɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ jehanɛ e je Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo, Tsɛ ɔ Bi ɔ, dɛ mi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si ngɛ anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi mi. Anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: I na bua jɔmi babauu kaa i na o bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ kaa a nyɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi, kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ wo wɔ kita a.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ i ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae, Awula, pi kita he ko nɛ i ngɛ mo ngmae, se mohu nɔ nɛ wa ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ: kaa waa suɔ wa he.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa sisili tuu ba je ɔ mi, nihi nɛ jaje we kaa Yesu Kristo ba ngɛ he lo mi; nɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ji sisilɔ kɛ lakpa kristo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he saminya, konɛ nyɛ ko laa nihi nɛ wa tsu ɔ, se mohu nyɛ na hiɔwo nɛ sa.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jee nɛ e hi si ngɛ Kristo tsɔɔmi ɔ mi ɔ, e be Mawu. Nɔ nɛ hii Kristo tsɔɔmi ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ lɛ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ kɛ Bi ɔ.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ e hɛɛ we kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko he lɛ kɛ ba nyɛ we mi, nɛ nyɛ ko fɔ lɛ tete;

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: ejakaa nɔ nɛ fɔɔ lɛ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ pe ɔ kake ngɛ e ni tsumi yaya amɛ ami. Nyagbe sɛyemi

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nihi fuu nɛ ma ngma nyɛ mohu, se i sume kaa i kɛ womi kɛ ningma nyu ngmaa, se mohu ye he ngɛ nɔ kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ba tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, konɛ wa bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hyi.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: O nyɛmi yo nɛ a hia a bimɛ ɔmɛ ke a biɔ mo.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Nɔkɔtɔma a ngma ya ha Gaio nɛ a suɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ imi hu i suɔ ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: Mami nɛ i suɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ kaa o ya nɔ ngɛ nihi kulaa mi nɛ o he nɛ wa mo kaa bɔ nɛ i le nɛ o klaa hu ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i na bua jɔmi babauu benɛ nyɛmimɛ komɛ ba nɛ a ba ye o nɔkuale ɔ he odase, bɔ nɛ o nyɛɛ ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Nɔ ko pee we mi bua jɔmi pe enɛ kaa ma nu kaa ye bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi. A je Gaio yi

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Mami nɛ i suɔ, nɔ nɛ o tsuɔ kɛ haa nyɛmimɛ nɛ ji nibwɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, anɔkuale mi o peɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: A ba ye o suɔmi ɔ he odase ngɛ asafo ɔ hɛ mi. O maa pee saminya ke ɔ wo mɛ blɔ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo biɛ ɔ he ɔ, a je kpo kɛ ho, nɛ da he we nɔ ko ngɛ maje li ɔmɛ a dɛ.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa wɔ Kristofo ɔmɛ wa he kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ atuu, konɛ waa kɛ mɛ nɛ dla anɔkuale ɔ he ni tsumi ɔ. Diotrefe kɛ Demetrio

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: I ngma womi kpiti ko ngɔ mane asafo ɔ, se Diotrefe nɔ nɛ hlaa nɔkɔtɔma yemi ɔ bui nɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke i ba hu, ma wo e ni tsumi ɔmɛ a he sane nɔ, bɔ nɛ e tuɔ wa he munyu yaya, nɛ enɛ ɔmɛ tete pi ha lɛ. Lɛ nitsɛ ɔ, e he we nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu nihi nɛ suɔ kaa a pee ja a, e tsiɔ mɛ blɔ, nɛ e fieɔ mɛ kɛ jee asafo ɔ mi.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Mami nɛ i suɔ, koo kase nɔ yaya, se moo kase nɔ kpakpa mohu. Nɔ nɛ peɔ nɔ kpakpa a, e je Mawu mi; nɔ nɛ peɔ nɔ yaya a, e nɛ Mawu.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Demetrio ɔ lɛɛ, nihi tsuo kɛ anɔkuale ɔ nitsɛ tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa, nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ e he odase yee, nɛ nyɛ le kaa wa odase ɔ anɔkuale ʼi. Nyagbe sɛyemi

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nihi fuu nɛ ma ngma, se i sume kaa i kɛ ningma nyu kɛ ningma tso ngmaa.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: Ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e piɛ bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ ma na mo, nɛ wa maa tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: He manye! O huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ke a biɔ mo. Nga wa huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kakaaka ha wɔ.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Yuda, nɛ ji Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kɛ Yakobo nyɛmi ɔ ngma ya ha nihi nɛ a tsɛ mɛ nɛ a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ Tsɛ Mawu ɔ mi nɛ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to ha Yesu Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Mɔbɔ nami kɛ he jɔmi kɛ suɔmi babauu ha nyɛ! Lakpa tsɔɔli

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: Mamimɛ, akɛnɛ i ngɛ mɔde bɔe nitsɛ nɛ ma ngma nyɛ wɔ tsuo wa yi wami hemi ɔ he sane ɔ he je ɔ, i na kaa e sa nɛ ma ngma nɛ ma kɛ wo nyɛ he wami konɛ nyɛɛ plee hemi kɛ yemi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi si kake nyɔngloo ɔ he.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ni komɛ ju si kɛ sɛ mi, nihi nɛ blema lokoo a je nɛ a ngma a he sane ngɔ fɔ si ha kikɛmɛ a fɔ bumi nɛ, nɔ yaya peeli nɛ ngɔɔ wa dloomi ɔ kɛ bɔɔ ajuama, nɛ a kuaa Mawu nɛ ji nɔ yelɔ kake pɛ ɔ, kɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le enɛ lɛɛ, se i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma kai nyɛ, kaa benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ je e ma a kɛ je Mizraim ɔ, lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kpata nihɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi hu nɛ hɛɛ we mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma yemi ɔ mi, se mohu a je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a si himi he ɔ, e kɛ neneene kpahi fi mɛ ngɔ to diblii tsitsliitsli mi ha Ligbi ngua a nɔ kojomi ɔ.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai Sodoma kɛ Gomora kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle mɛ nɛ a bɔ ajuama nɛ a nyɛɛ he lo se hluu kaa bɔfo ɔmɛ nɔuu ɔ; a neneene la ami hiɔwo nɛ a naa a ngɛ kaa okadi ko kɛ ha nihi tsuo.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu ni nɛ ɔmɛ hu bleɔ he lo ɔ ngɛ a nlamihi a mi, nɛ a gbee Mawu nɔ yemi ɔ he guɛ, nɛ a tuɔ bɔfohi a he munyu yaya.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Se bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Mikael tete po, pee we enɛ. E kɛ abosiami pɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ sa nya ngɛ Mose flu ɔ he. Mikael gbiɛ́ abosiami kɛ musu bɔmi munyu ko, se mohu e ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ kã o hɛ mi!”

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ tuɔ munyu siɔ nihi kulaa nɛ a li, se nihi nɛ a le ngɛ a fɔmi su ɔ nya kaa lohwehi nɛ li ni ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu lɛ kpataa a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Musu tloo mɛ! a ngɔ Kain blɔ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ a he ya wo Bileam sisimi he hiɔwo ɔ mi, nɛ Kora atua tsɔmi ɔ mi a hɛ mi kpata ngɛ.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ woɔ nyɛ suɔmi niye ni ɔ he mu, ejakaa a kɛ nyɛ yeɔ ni nɛ zo pee we mɛ; a lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he. A ngɛ kaa bɔku nɛ nyu be mi nɛ kɔɔhiɔ kpakaa kɛ bɔleɔ si, tsohi nɛ a yi ba amɛ wɔle nɛ a wui yiblii; a gbo si enyɔ nɛ a hia mɛ kɛ a sipokuhi.

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: A ngɛ kaa wo mi oslɔkehi hulɔ nɛ ngɛ hamahama nɛ jeɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zo ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pueɔ he. A ngɛ ka dodoehi nɛ laa blɔ, nihi nɛ Mawu dla diblii tsitsliitsli ɔ ngɔ to kɛ yaa neneene ɔ.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ Henok nɔ nɛ ji nɔ kapaago kɛ je Adam nɔ ɔ gba ngɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma kɛ e klɔuklɔu bihi akpe nyɔngma nyɔngmahi abɔ,

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: nɛ e maa kojo nimli tsuo, nɛ e ma ka nɔ yayami peeli ngɛ a ni yayami hi tsuo nɛ a tsu ɔ kɛ musu bɔmi munyu tsuo nɛ yayami peeli Mawu kuali tu ngɛ Mawu he ɔ he.”

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu yaya, sieku yeli kɛ nɔ piali nɛ nɔ muɛ́ a hɛ nɛ a nyɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɔnɔ yayahi a se; a peɔ nya puu, nɛ a gbee nimli a yi mi ngɛ se nami he. Kɔkɔbɔmi kɛ nitsɔɔmi

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kai munyuhi nɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔmɛ tu sa a;

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: ejakaa a de nyɛ ke: “Nyagbe be ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ he fɛu yeli nɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɔnɔ yaya amɛ a nya a maa ba.”

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ kɛ mi gbami baa a nɛ, he lo mi nimli nɛ be mumi.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Se, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ ha nyɛ nane nɛ pi si ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi,

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ he ngɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu mɔbɔ nami ɔ blɔ, konɛ nyɛ na neneene wami.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ na ninɛmɛ nɛ a yi mi peɔ mɛ kɔsikɔsi ɔ mɔbɔ:

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: nyɛ je mɛ kɛ je la a mi. Nyɛɛ na ni kpahi hu mɔbɔ kɛ mɔbɔ nami nɛ gbeye yemi ngɛ mi; se nyɛɛ hie sa tade nɛ a kɛ he lo akɔnɔ wo lɛ mu ɔ. Yijemi sɔlemi

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ ji ni lelɔ kake kɛ wa yi wami helɔ ngɛ Yesu Kristo wa Mawetsɛ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje, nɔ yemi kɛ he blɔ kulaa ngɔ ha jehanɛ kɛ daa. Amen.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo kpo jemi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha lɛ nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ nihi nɛ sa kaa e ba mi ngɛ be kpiti mi, nɛ e kɛ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ nɛ e kɛ ba tsɔɔ e sɔmɔlɔ Yohane,

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ ye Mawu munyu ɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo odase ɔ he odase ngɛ nihi tsuo nɛ e na a he ɔ.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ kaneɔ ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ nuɔ gbami munyu ɔmɛ ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔɔ nihi nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi ɔ ngɔ toɔ ɔ, ejakaa be ɔ su ta. Munyuhi nɛ a kɛ nga Asafohi kpaago ɔ

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Yohane ngma ya ha asafohi kpaago nɛ ngɛ Asia a: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi ha nyɛ, kɛ je nɔ nɛ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ hi si sa a, kɛ nɔ nɛ maa ba a dɛ mi, nɛ kɛ je mumihi kpaago nɛ ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ ngɔ,

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: nɛ kɛ je Yesu Kristo, nɛ ji odaseyelɔ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ, ni gbogboehi a kpɛti kekleekle bi kɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔyelɔ ɔ dɛ mi. Nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ tsukɔ wa he kɛ je wa he yayami ɔmɛ a mi,

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: nɛ e ngɔ wɔ pee matsɛmɛ a weku [kɛ] osɔfohi ngɔ ha e Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami kɛ nɔ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene! Amen.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Oʼɛ, e ma kɛ bɔku ɔmɛ, nɛ hɛngmɛ tsuaa hɛngmɛ maa na lɛ kɛ nihi nɛ gbɔɔ lɛ ni ɔ hulɔ, nɛ zugba a nɔ weku ɔmɛ kulaa maa wo ya ngɛ e he. Ee, Amen.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ hi si sa a, kɛ nɔ nɛ maa ba, nɛ ji ope ɔ, ke: “Ami ji Alfa a kɛ Omega a” . Kristo he ninami

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Imi Yohane nɛ ji nyɛ nyɛmi kɛ nyɛ huɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo amanehlu ɔ kɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ e tsui si tomi ɔ mi ɔ, i ngɛ zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Patmo ɔ nɔ ngɛ Mawu munyu ɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo he odase yemi he.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ nɔ, nɛ i nu gbi ngua ko ngɛ ye se kaa titimati

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: nɛ de mi ke: “Ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ nae ɔ ngɔ wo womi mi, nɛ o kɛ mane asafohi kpaago nɛ ngɛ Efeso, kɛ Smirna, kɛ Pergami, kɛ Tiatira kɛ Sarde, kɛ kɛ Filadelfia, kɛ Laodikea a.

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: I plɛ ye he kone ma hyɛ gbi nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ. Nɛ bene i plɛ ye he ɔ, i na sika kane tsohi kpaago,

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: kɛ nɔ ko ngɛ kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ sa kpɛti nɛ ngɛ kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi, nɛ e wo tade klɔii nɛ e kɛ sika kpa fi e gugue;

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: nɛ e yi kɛ e yi bwɔmi hiɛɛ kaa to he bwɔmi hiɔ, kaa snoo, nɛ e hɛngmɛhi ngɛ kaa la lilɛhi,

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa ayawa klaiklai nɛ tsu ngɛ flɔnɔɔ mi, nɛ e gbi ngɛ kaa nyu babauu pɛmi.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: Nɛ e hɛɛ dodoehi kpaago ngɛ e hiɛ ɔ nine mi, nɛ hiɔ kɛ e nya enyɔ nɛ nya mi ba je kpo ngɛ e nya mi, nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ kaa pu nɛ ngɛ tsoe wawɛɛ.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ i na lɛ ɔ, i nɔ si ngɛ e nane nyɛ kaa nɔ gbogboe; nɛ e kɛ e hiɛ ɔ nine fɔ ye nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke: “Koo ye gbeye; ami ji kekleekle nɔ ɔ kɛ nyagbe nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: kɛ hɛkalɔ. I gbo, nɛ oʼɛ, ye hɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene, nɛ i hɛɛ gbeje kɛ gbenɔ nya safe ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ngmaa nihi nɛ o na a, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ maa ba ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ:

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: dodoehi kpaago nɛ o na ngɛ ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ laami sane ɔ, kɛ sika kane tsohi kpaago ɔ. Dodoehi kpaago ɔ ji asafohi kpaago ɔmɛ a bɔfohi, kɛ kane tsohi kpaago nɛ o na a ji asafohi kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ngmaa ya ha Efeso asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ke: “Nihi nɛ nɔ nɛ hɛɛ dodoehi kpaago ɔ ngɛ e hiɛ ɔ nine mi nɛ e nyɛɛ sika kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: I le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ kɛ o dengme gbomi ɔ, kɛ o tsui si tomi ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ o kplɛɛ we nimli yayami ɔmɛ a ni peepee ɔmɛ a nɔ, se ɛo ka nihi nɛ deɔ ke bɔfohi ji mɛ se a pi ja a, nɛ o na kaa lakpatsɛmɛ ji mɛ.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: Nɛ o hɛɛ mi, nɛ o toɔ o tsui si, nɛ ye biɛ ɔ he ɔ, o bɔɔ mɔde, nɛ pɔ tɔɛ mo.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane ko, lɔ ɔ ji kaa, o sume mi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi sa a.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ kaii he nɛ o je kɛ nɔ si ɔ, nɛ o tsake o tsui, nɛ o tsu kekle ni tsumi ɔmɛ; se ke pi ja a, ma ba o ngɔ oya, nɛ ma je o kane tso ɔ kɛ maa je e ma he ɔ, ja o pia o he.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ, o ngɛ enɛ, kaa o nyɛɛ Nikolaimɛ a ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ imi hu i nyɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ. “Nɔ nɛ yeɔ kunimi ɔ, ma ha lɛ wami tso ɔ nɛ ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ Paradeiso ɔ mi ɔ nɔ yiblii ɔ eko nɛ e ye.” Sɛ kɛ ha Smirna asafo ɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Nɛ Smirna asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa ya ha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ kekleekleno ɔ kɛ nyagbeno ɔ, nɔ nɛ gbo nɛ e hɛ ngɛ ekohu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: I le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ kɛ o dengme gbomi ɔmɛ kɛ o hia a, — se kɛ ɔ niatsɛ ji mo — nɛ i le ni yayahi nɛ nihi nɛ deɔ ke Yudafohi ji mɛ se a pi ja se mohu a ji Satan kpe mi bimɛ ɔ deɔ ngɛ o he ɔ.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Koo ye amanehlu nɛ o maa na eko eko gbeye, oʼɛ, abosiami maa ngɔ nyɛ ti ni komɛ ngɔ wo tsu mi, kone a kɛ ka nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa na amanehlu ligbi nyɔngma. Pee anɔkualetsɛ kɛ ya su gbenɔ mi, nɛ ma ha mo wami jlasi ɔ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ. “Kunimi yelɔ ɔ, a be lɛ nɔ ko yaya ko pee ngɛ gbenɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi.” Sɛ kɛ ha Pergamo asafo ɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Nɛ Pergamo asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa yaha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ snɔ nɛ hɛɛ hiɔ kɛ e nya mi enyɔ nɛ nya ba a de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: I le he nɛ o hii ɔ, he nɛ Satan matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. O hɛɛ ye biɛ ɔ mi, nɛ o kua we o hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a mi po, bene a gbe Antipa, ye o daseyelɔ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, he nɛ Satan hii ɔ.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane bɔɔ ko: ejakaa o ngɛ nihi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ hɛɛ Bileam nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ Balak kaa e tsɔ Israelbi ɔmɛ klama nɛ a ye nihi nɛ a kɛ sa bɔ ha wɔhi nɛ a bɔ ajuama a tsɔɔmi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu hu o ngɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛ Nikolaibihi a tsɔɔmi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ tsakee o tsui; se ke pi ja a, ma ba o ngɔ mla, nɛ i kɛ ye nya mi hiɔ́ ɔ kɛ mɛ ma ba hwu ta.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ. “Nɔ nɛ yeɔ kunimi ɔ, ma ha lɛ mana nɛ a kɛ laa a eko nɛ e ye, nɛ ma ha lɛ tɛ hiɔ, nɛ tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a ngma biɛ he nɛ nɔ ko li ja nɔ nɛ naa a.” Sɛ kɛ ha Tiatira asafo ɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Nɛ Tiatira asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa ya ha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ e hɛngmɛ ngɛ kaa la lilɛ nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa ayawa nɛ kpɛɔ nylamnylam ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: I le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ kɛ o suɔmi ɔ kɛ o sɔmɔmi ɔ kɛ o hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kɛ o tsui si tomi ɔ, nɛ i le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ kaa sekpɛ ni ɔmɛ pe kekle ni ɔmɛ tete.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane ko, kaa o ngmɛ yo Yesabel nɛ tsɛɛ e he gbalɔ ɔ blɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ ye sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ni, nɛ e mlɔɔ mɛ, nɛ a bɔ ajuama, nɛ a ye ni nɛ a kɛ sa bɔ ha wɔhi.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: I ha lɛ be konɛ e kɛ tsake e tsui, se e sume nɛ e tsake kɛ je ajuama bɔmi ɔ mi.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Oʼɛ, i kɛ lɛ maa fɔ sa nɔ, nɛ i kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ puɛ gba a hu maa wo nɔ nami kpatekpleenyɛ mi, ja a tsake a tsui kɛ je e ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ma gbe e bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ asafo ɔmɛ kulaa ma na maa le kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ leɔ juɛmi kɛ tsui mi susumihi, nɛ ma wo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: “Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee, nyɛ nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ Tiatira a, nihi abɔ nɛ hɛɛ we tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ li ‘Satan muɔhi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ’ I kɛ tlomi kpã ko be nyɛ nɔ fɔe.

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Se nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ nyɛɛ hɛɛ mi ka ya su be nɛ ma ba.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Nɛ kunimi yelɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ hɛɔ ye ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya suu nyagbe ɔ, ma ha lɛ he wami ngɛ je ma amɛ a nɔ,

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ.”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: “Nɛ Sarde asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa ya ha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu mumihi kpaago ɔ kɛ dodoehi kpaago ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: I le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ kaa o hɛɛ biɛ kaa o hɛ ngɛ, se o gbo.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fo hɛ nɛ tsɛ, nɛ o waje nihi nɛ piɛ nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbo ɔ. Ejakaa i nɛ o ni tsumi ɔmɛ eko nɛ hi kɛ pi si ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Lɔɔ he ɔ kaii nɔ́ nɛ a tsɔɔ mo kɛ bɔ nɛ o nu ɔ nɛ o kɛ to, nɛ o tsake o tsui. Se jehanɛ ke o hɛ tsɛ́ ɔ, ma tua mo kaa juɔ, nɛ o be lee ngmlɛfia nɔ nɛ ma ba a kulaa.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ, o ngɛ nihi bɔɔ ko ngɛ Sarde, nihi nɛ wui a tade ɔmɛ mu; a kɛ mi maa nyɛɛ ngɛ tade hiɔhi a mi, ejakaa a sa ja.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Kunimi yelɔ ɔ, a maa wo lɛ tade hiɔ, nɛ i be e biɛ gbee ngɛ wami womi ɔ mi gblegbleegblee, nɛ ma wo e biɛ ta ngɛ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
