translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ deɔ ɔ. Sɛ kɛ ha Filadelfia asafo ɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Nɛ Filadelfia asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa ya ha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ David safe ɔ, nɔ nɛ bliɔ nɛ nɔ ko nga we, nɛ e ngaa hulɔ nɛ nɔ ko bli we ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: I le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ; nɛ oʼɛ, i bi sinya ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ o hɛ kpɛ, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga, ejakaa he wami bɔɔ ngɛ, se o ye ye munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ o kua we ye biɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Oʼɛ, i kɛ ni komɛ nɛ je Satan kpe he ɔ nɛ deɔ ke Yudafohi ji mɛ se e be mi ja, se mohu lakpa mohu a ngɛ yee ɔ maa ba o hɛ mi; oʼɛ, ma ha nɛ a ba nɛ a ba nu o nane nɛ a ja mo, konɛ a le kaa imi lɛɛ i suɔ mo.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o ye ye munyu nɛ deɔ ke o to o tsui si ɔ nɔ he je ɔ, ma baa o yi ngɛ ka ngmlɛfia nɛ maa ba je mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ nɛ a kɛ maa ka nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: Oʼɛ, i ma oya; pɛtɛ nɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ he nɛ wa, konɛ nɔ ko ko kpɔ o jlasi ɔ!

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Kunim yelɔ ɔ, ma ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee Titima ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e be kpo jee hu, nɛ ma ngma ye Mawu ɔ biɛ, kɛ ye Mawu ɔ ma nɛ ji Yerusalem he nɛ jee ye Mawu ngɔ ɔ biɛ, kɛ mi nitsɛ ye biɛ he ɔ ngɛ e nɔ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ!” Sɛ kɛ ha Laodikea asafo ɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Nɛ Laodikea asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa ya ha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ Amen ɔ nɛ ji odase yelɔ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ kɛ anɔkua leyelɔ ɔ kɛ Mawu adebɔ ɔ sisije ɔ de ji nɛɔ nɛ:

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: I le oni tsumi ɔmɛ kaa o be yluduu nɛ o be kɛlakɛla hulɔ. Oo, jinɛ o ko pee yluduu loo o ko pee kɛlakɛla!

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Se kikɛ nɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ o ngɛ kulɔkulɔ nɛ o be yluduu nɛ o be kɛlakɛla hulɔ he je ɔ, ma la mo ngɛ ye nya mi ngɔ pue he.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o deɔ ke: ‘Niatsɛ ji mi nɛ i ngɛ ni, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi,’ nɛ o li kaa o ngɛ dengme mi nɛ o ni hu ngɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ ohiafo kɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ kɛ hegutsɛ ji mo,

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: i ngɛ mo ga woe ke o he sika nɛ a tsu he ngɛ la mi kɛ je ye ngɔ, kone o na ni, kɛ tade hiɔ, kone o wo nɛ o he gu nɛ ngɛ zo ɔ nɛ ko fɔ si, kɛ hɛngmɛ tsopa nɛ o kɛ nga o hɛngmɛ nɔ, kone o hyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ, nihi abɔ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, i kãa mɛ nɛ i gblaa a tue; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o hɛ nɛ dɔ nɛ o tsake o tsui!

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Oʼɛ i daa si ngɛ sinya a se nɛ i ngɛ sie; ke nɔ ko nu ye gbi nɛ e bli sinya a, ma ba e ngɔ nɛ i kɛ lɛ ma ba ye ni nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ mi maa ye.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Kunimi yelɔ ɔ, ma ha lɛ blɔ nɛ e kɛ mi nɛ hi ye matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ye kunimi nɛ i kɛ Tsaatsɛ hii si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee o.”

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ i hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, sinya ko nɛ a bli ngɛ hiɔwe. Kekleekle gbi nɛ i nu nɛ ngɛ kaa titimati nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ ke: “Kuɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nihi nɛ maa ba mi ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Nɛ amlɔ ɔ Mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ oʼɛ, matsɛ sɛ ko maa si ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ nɔ ko hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ, ke o hyɛ lɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa kaa yaspi kɛ sardi, nɛ alale bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ he, nɛ ke o hyɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa smaragde tɛ.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Nɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ sɛhi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ hii si ngɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; sa wo tade hiɔhi, nɛ sika jlasi fi a yi.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Nɛ oslaba gbami kɛ gbi kɛ hiɔwe simi je matsɛ sɛ ɔ mi, nɛ la hahi kpaago nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ ji Mawu mumihi kpaago ɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ́ ko kaa ahuhuɛ wo nɛ hɛ mi tsɔ kaa kristolo ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ nɛ hɛngmɛhi hyi a hɛ mi kɛ a se tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kpɛti kɛ e he kulaa.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Kekleekle hɛ kalɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa jata, nɛ hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa na, ne hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ, nɛ hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa kɔle nɛ e ngɛ tee.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Nɛ hɛkali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ ple ekpa ekpa, nɛ a he kɛ a mi tsuo hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ hɛngmɛ sɔuu, nɛ a jɔɔ we lami nyɔ kɛ pia ke: “Klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu ji Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, Nɔ nɛ ngɛ sa a, kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ maa ba a.”

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ ngɔ nyami kɛ agboje kɛ sina kɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene ɔ hae ɔ,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “Wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wa Mawu, mo ji nɔ nɛ sa kaa O ngɔ hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje kɛ he wami ɔ Ejakaa mo lɛ ɔ bɔ nihi kulaa, Nɛ o suɔmi nya a ngɛ nɛ a bɔ mɛ ngɛ.”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: I na womi kpo ko ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngma ni ngɛ e mi kɛ e se tsuo, nɛ a sɔu nya kɛ nya sɔumi ni kpaago.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Nɛ i na bɔfo ngua ko nɛ e ngɛ fiɛe kɛ gbi ngua ke: “Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ sa kaa e bli womi ɔ nya nɛ e tsɔ e nya sɔumi ni ɔmɛ?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Se nɔ ko nɔ ko be hiɔwe loo zugba a nɔ loo zugba a sisi nɛ ma nyɛ womi ɔ nya nɛ e bli loo nɛ e hyɛ mi.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Nɛ i fo ya hluu, ejakaa a nɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ sa kaa e bli womi ɔ nya nɛ e kane loo nɛ e hyɛ mi.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake de mi ke: “Ko fo ya! oʼɛ jata a nɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji David nina a, ye kunimi, nɛ e bli womi ɔ nya, nɛ e tsɔ e nya sɔumi ni kpaago ɔ.”

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Nɛ i hyɛ nɛ oʼɛ, matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, Tobi ko daa si kaa nɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ koli kpaago kɛ hɛngmɛ kpaago nɛ ji Mawu mumi kpaago ɔ nɛ a tsɔ kɛ ya zugba a tsuo nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Nɛ Tobi ɔ ba, nɛ e ba he womi kpo ɔ kɛ je nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nine mi.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Nɛ a la la he ko de ke: “Mo lɛ sa kaa o heɔ womi ɔ Nɛ o tsɔɔ e nya sɔumi ɔmɛ, Ejakaa a gbe mo, Nɛ o kɛ o muɔ ɔ kpɔ wɔ ha Mawu Kɛ je wetso tsuaa wetso kɛ munyu tsuaa munyu Kɛ ma tsuaa ma kɛ je ma tsuaa je ma mi.

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ɔ ngɔ wɔ ngɔ pee matsɛmɛ kɛ osɔfohi Ha wa Mawu ɔ, Nɛ wa maa ye matsɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.”

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Nɛ i hyɛ, nɛ i nu bɔfohi fuu nɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a he kɛ kpe ɔmɛ a gbi, nɛ a nya ji akpe nyɔngma totoe akpe nyɔngma kɛ akpe totoe akpe,

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ gbi ngua de ke: “Tobi nɛ a gbe ɔ, Sa nɛ e ngɔ he wami kɛ ni nami Kɛ ni lemi kɛ nyɛmi kɛ agboje kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ gbaami.”

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Nɛ i nu kaa bɔ ni ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ zugba a sisi kɛ wo hɛ mi kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ ke: “A ngɔ gbaami kɛ agboje kɛ hɛ mi nyami Kɛ nɔ yemi ngɔ ha nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ Kɛ Tobi ɔ kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene!”

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔ ke: “Amen.” Nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ bu si, nɛ a ja nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene ɔ.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na kaa Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi kpaago ɔ kake; nɛ i nu kaa hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake kɛ gbi nɛ ngɛ kaa hiɔwe simi de ke: “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!”

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: I hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, okpɔngɔ hiɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ e nɔ ɔ hɛɛ kɛɛ, nɛ a ha lɛ jlasi, nɛ e je kpo kaa kunimi yelɔ, konɛ e ya ye kunimi.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ de ke: “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!”

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Nɛ okpɔngɔ kpa ko nɛ tsuɔ je kpo, nɛ a ha nɔ nɛ hi e nɔ ɔ he blɔ ke e je he jɔmi kɛ je zugba a nɔ, konɛ nimli nɛ a gbe a he, nɛ a ha lɛ klaate ngua ko.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ de ke: “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!” I hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, okpɔngɔ yumu, nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ e nɔ ɔ hɛɛ sɛni ngɛ e dɛ mi.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Nɛ i nu gbi ko kɛ je hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ke: “Ngma susumi nɔ́ kake ligbi kake hiɔwo, blɛfo susumi nihi etɛ ligbi kake hiɔwo, se nu kɛ wai ɔ lɛɛ koo ta he!”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Benɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, i nu hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ gbi ke: “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!”

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: I hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, okpɔngɔ lazu lazu; nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ e nɔ ɔ biɛ ji Gbenɔ, nɛ Gbeje nyɛɛ e se; nɛ a ha mɛ he blɔ konɛ a kɛ klaate kɛ hwɔ kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kɛ zugba a nɔ awi yemi lohewehi nɛ gbe zugba a mi dlami eywiɛ mi kake.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ, nɛ i na nihi nɛ a gbe ngɛ Mawu munyu ɔ kɛ odase nɛ a ye ɔ he ɔ a klaahi ngɛ bɔsami latɛ ɔ sisi;

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: nɛ a kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ Klɔuklɔu kɛ Anɔkuayelɔ, mɛni be o maa kojo nɛ o maa gbla nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ nɛ gbe wɔ ɔmɛ a tue?”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: A hã a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ tade hiɔ klɔii, nɛ a de mɛ ke a jɔɔ a he be bɔɔ ko lolo kɛ ya su be nɛ a nyɛmimɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ kɛ anyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ hu nɛ a maa gbe mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a gbe mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu ɔ a hiemi maa sɔ.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Nɛ i na benɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji ekpa a, nɛ oʼɛ, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ pu plɛ kaa kpekpe kotoku yumu, nɛ nyɔhiɔ mluku ɔ plɛ kaa muɔ,

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: nɛ hiɔwe dodoehi tsɔ fia si kaa bɔ nɛ ngmɔkɔ tso yiblii ngmlikiti wɔleɔ pueɔ si benɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngua ngɛ fiae ɔ.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe hɛ lɛ kɛ ho kaa womi nɛ a hluɛ; nɛ a tsitsɛɛ yoku tsuaa yoku kɛ wo kpɔ tsuaa wo kpɔ kɛ je e blɔ he.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ nimli ngua amɛ kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ he wali ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɔguɛ tsuaa nyɔguɛ kɛ odehe tsuaa odehe ya laa a he ngɛ muɔhi a mi kɛ tɛkplohi a mi,

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: nɛ fa de yoku ɔmɛ kɛ tɛ sa amɛ ke: “Nyɛ ba nɔ wa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ laa wɔ kɛ je nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ Tobi ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ nya.

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Ejakaa e mi mi fumi ligbi ngua a su, nɛ mɛnɔ ma nyɛ si maa da?”

english_verse: After this I saw four angels. Each one was standing on one of the earth's four corners. The angels held back the four winds, so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree. These angels had also been given the power to harm the earth and the sea. Then I saw another angel come up from where the sun rises in the east, and he was ready to put the mark of the living God on people. He shouted to the four angels,
translation_verse: Nɛ i na bɔfo kpa ko nɛ e ngɛ kuɔe kɛ ngɛ pu site he jee kɛ ma, nɛ e hɛɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nya sɔumi nɔ. E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ kɛ de bɔfohi eywiɛ nɛ a ha mɛ he wami kaa a pee zugba a kɛ wo ɔ yayami ɔ

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: ke: “Nyɛ ko pee zugba a loo wo ɔ loo tso ɔmɛ yayami ko kɛ maa su be nɛ waa kɛ nya sɔumi nɔ ma kadi wa Mawu ɔ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ a hɛ nya lolo.”

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: ke: “Amen! Gbaami kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ ni lemi kɛ sina kɛ agboje kɛ he wami kɛ nyami ha wa Mawu ɔ kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene! Amen!”

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ i hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, nimli asafo nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane nɛ je je mi ma tsuaa je mi ma kɛ wɛtsohi kɛ mahi kɛ mahi a nɔ gbihi a mi nɛ a daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ Tobi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a wo tade hiɔ, nɛ a hɛɛ tã kuɔmihi ngɛ a dɛ,

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: nɛ a kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke: “Yi wami hemi ɔ ji wa Mawu nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ Tobi ɔ nɔ́!”

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ nikɔtɔmahi hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe, nɛ a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a ja Mawu

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake he nɔ nɛ e bi mi ke: “Ninɛmɛ nɛ a wo tade hiɔ nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ ʼi, nɛ jije a je?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Nɛ i de lɛ ke: “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ, mo lɛ o le.” Nɛ e de mi ke: “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a je nɔ nami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi ɔ nɛ; nɛ a fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a ha a hiɛ futaa ngɛ Tobi ɔ muɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he nɛ a ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a jaa lɛ nyɔ kɛ pia ngɛ se sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ maa ma e bo tsu ɔ ngɔ to anɔ.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Hwɔ be mɛ yee hu, nɛ kuma hu be mɛ tɔe hu, nɛ jeha nɛ hu, pu loo latsa ko be a he sae hu;

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: ejakaa Tobi ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kpɛti ɔ maa lɛ mɛ, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ kɛ maa ya wami nyu vuhi a he, nɛ Mawu ma tsu a hɛ mi vo nyu kulaa.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Benɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, a pee dii ngɛ hiɔwe maa pee ngmlɛfia fa.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Nɛ i na hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ, nɛ a ngɔ Titimati kpaago ngɔ ha mɛ.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo kpa ko ba nɛ e ba da bɔ sami latɛ ɔ he, nɛ e hɛɛ sika tsopa ke e he via sami nɔ́, nɛ a ha lɛ tsopa kɛ e he via fuu konɛ e kɛ piɛ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ kulaa a sɔlemi ɔmɛ a he ngɛ sika bɔ sami latɛ nɛ maa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a lasuku ɔ te si kɛ je hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ dɛ mi kɛ ya piɛ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔmɛ a he kɛ ho Mawu hɛ mi ya.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ wo tsopa kɛ e he via sami nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e je bɔ sami latɛ ɔ nɔ la a eko ngɔ wo mi tɔtɔɔtɔ, nɛ e ngɔ hɛ pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ hiɔwe simi kɛ gbihi kɛ oslaba gbami kɛ zugba mimiɛmi ba. Titimati ɔmɛ

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ nɛ hɛɛ titimati kpaago ɔ dla a he konɛ a ma kpa.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Kekleekle hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ kpa, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu loo hiɔmi tɛ kɛ la nɛ muɔ futu mi ba nɛ e ba pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ zugba a mi dlami etɛ mi kake sã, nɛ ba mumuhi tsuo sã.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ kpa, nɛ a sake nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa yoku nɛ ngɛ tsoe kɛ la ngɔ fɔ wo mi, nɛ wo ɔ midlami etɛ mi kake plɛ muɔ,

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: nɛ wo ɔ mi nihi nɛ a bɔ nɛ ngɛ wami ɔ a midlami etɛ mi kake gbo, nɛ lɛhi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake hɛ mi kpata.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji etɛ ɔ kpa, nɛ dodoe ngua nɛ ngɛ tsoe kaa ha tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ si, nɛ e nɔ pa amɛ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake kɛ nyu hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Dodoe ɔ biɛ ji Doodoomi, nɛ nyu ɔmɛ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake plɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ duɔ, nɛ nimli babauu nɛ nu ɔ gbo, ejakaa e duɔ.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ kpa, nɛ a fia pu mi dlami etɛ mi kake kɛ nyɔhiɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake kɛ dodoehi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake nɔ́, nɛ a mi dlami etɛ mi kakaaka a wo diblii, nɛ piani mi dlami etɛ mi kake ɔ, je mi tsɔ we nɛ nyɔ mi hu ja kɛ.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Nɛ i na, nɛ i nu kɔle ko he nɛ ngɛ tee ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ngɛ dee ke: “Musu tloo, musu tloo, musu tloo nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ,” benɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi etɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ma kpa a titimati ɔmɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i na dodoe ko je hiɔwe ba nɔ zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ muɔ voo ɔ nya safe ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Nɛ e bli muɔ voo ɔ nya, nɛ lasuku te si kɛ je muɔ ɔ mi kaa abolo tsu ngua mi lasuku, nɛ pu kɛ hiɔwe wo diblii ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi lasuku ɔ he.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Nɛ baalɛhi je lasuku ɔ mi kɛ ba zugba a nɔ; nɛ a ha mɛ he wami kaa he wami nɛ nyingmogblakotohi hɛɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: Nɛ a de mɛ ke a ko pee zugba a nɔ nga loo ba mumu loo tso ko yayami ko, kaa ja nimli nɛ be Mawu nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ okadi ngɛ a hɛ nya a kɛkɛ.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Nɛ a tsi a nya kaa a ko gbe nimli ɔmɛ, se mohu a pii mɛ hlami enuɔ. Nɛ a nya yeyee ɔ ngɛ kaa nyingmogblakoto nɛ tsɛ̃ɔ nɔ nya yemi.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Lɛ hlami enuɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nimli ma hia gbenɔ, se a be nae, nɛ a maa suɔ kaa a ko gbo, se gbenɔ maa tu a nya fo.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Baalɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa okpɔngɔhi nɛ a dla mɛ kɛ yaa ta, nɛ ni komɛ fi a yi kaa sika jlasi, nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ kaa nimli a hɛ mi;

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: nɛ a yi bwɔmi ngɛ kaa yihi a yi bwɔmi, nɛ a lunguhi ngɛ kaa jatahi a nɔ.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: A wo damihi kaa dade demahi, nɛ a plehi a mi pɛmi ngɛ kaa okpɔngɔhi babauu kɛ zugba lɛhi nɛ hɛɛ fo kɛ yaa ta;

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: nɛ a ngɛ hlemi kaa nyingmogblakotohi, nɛ kɛ̃ɛ ngɛ a hlemi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a ngɛ he wami kaa a pee nimli yayami hlami enuɔ.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Nɛ a matsɛ ji muɔ woo ɔ mi bɔfo ɔ, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke Abadon, nɛ ngɛ Hela gbi mi ɔ, a tsɛɛ lɛ Apolion .

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Kekleekle musu ɔ be; oʼɛ, musuhi enyɔ ma ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji ekpa a kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i nu gbi ko kɛ je sika tsu bɔ sami latɛ nɛ maa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ kolohi eywiɛ ɔmɛ a mi

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: de hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji ekpa a nɛ hɛɛ titimati ɔ ke: “Pɛne hiɔwe bɔfohi eywiɛ nɛ a fi mɛ ngɛ Eufrate pa ngua a nya a!”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: A pɛne hiɔwe bɔfohi eywiɛ ɔ nɛ a dla to ngmlɛfia a kɛ ligbi ɔ kɛ hlami ɔ kɛ jeha a, konɛ a gbe nimli a mi dlami etɛ mi kake.

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔ nɛ i na okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a nɔ hili ɔmɛ ngɛ ni nami ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: A damahi nɛ a wo ɔ su ngɛ kaa la kɛ alamua yumu kɛ kungwɔ zɔ; nɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a yihi ngɛ kaa jatahi a yi, nɛ la kɛ lasuku kɛ suɔɔ ngɛ hiae kɛ ngɛ a nya mi jee.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a haomi etɛ nɛ ji la kɛ lasuku kɛ suɔɔ nɛ ngɛ hiae kɛ ngɛ a nya mi jee nɛ ɔ, a kɛ gbe nimli a mi dlami etɛ mi kake.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Nɛ nimli nɛ piɛ nɛ a gbi mɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a haomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a tsakee we a tsui kɛ ji a nine nya ni tsumi ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a jɔɔ mumi yayamihi kɛ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ ayawa kɛ tɛ kɛ tso amagahi nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ nɛ a nui nɔ́ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a nyɛɛ ɔ jami.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, a tsake we a tsui kɛ ji a awi yemi kɛ a nyuami kɛ ajuama bɔmi kɛ a jumi ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na hiɔwe bɔfo kpa ko nɛ he wa nɛ e je hiɔwe kɛ ngɛ si kplee, nɛ e ha bɔku, nɛ alale ngɛ e yi kpɛti, nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ kaa pu, nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa la titimahi.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: Nɛ e hɛɛ womi kpo wayo ko nɛ a bli nya ngɛ e dɛ mi; nɛ e kɛ e hiɛ ɔ nane ma wo nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e muɔ nane hu ma zugba nɔ.

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ kaa jata huaa; nɛ benɛ e ngɛ huae ɔ, hiɔwe simi kpaago ɔ wo a gbi mi.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Benɛ hiɔwe simi kpaago ɔ wo a gbi mi ɔ, jinɛ i miɔ nɛ ma ngma; nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ je hiɔwe de mi ke: “Sɔuu nihi nɛ hiɔwe simi kpaago ɔ de ɔ nya, nɛ o ko ngma.”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ nɛ i na kaa e daa si ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ wo e hiɛ ɔ nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe,

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: nɛ e tsɛ nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ zugba kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ wo kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ nɛ e kɛ ka kita ke: “Be ko be ko be hu!

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Se mohu ke hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji kpaago ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, kɛkɛ lɛɛ a gbe Mawu laami sane ɔ hu nya, bɔ nɛ e jaje Sane Kpakpa a tsɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Nɛ gbi nɛ i nu kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e ke: “Yaa nɛ o ya he womi ɔ nɛ a bli nya a ngɛ bɔfo nɛ daa si ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ dɛ.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: I ya bɔfo ɔ ngɔ, nɛ i ya de lɛ ke: “Ngɔɔ womi kpo wayo ɔ ngɔ ha mi.” Nɛ e de mi ke: “He nɛ o ye; e maa duɔ ngɛ o mi mi, se e maa ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ ngɛ o nya mi kaa hwo.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i he womi kpo wayo ɔ ngɛ bɔfo ɔ dɛ nɛ i ye, nɛ e ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ ngɛ ye nya mi kaa hwo, nɛ benɛ i ye ɔ, e duɔ ngɛ ye mi mi.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e de mi ke: “E sa kaa o gba ekohu ngɛ nimli kɛ majamaje kɛ mahi a nɔ gbihi kɛ matsɛmɛ fuu a he.”

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: se kpo nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ agbo ɔ nya a, si kɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ o ko kale, ejakaa a kɛ ha majemaje li ɔmɛ konɛ a naa ma klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ hlami nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ.

english_verse: My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for
translation_verse: Nɛ ma ha ye odaseyeli enyɔ ɔ ma bu kpekpe nɛ a maa gba ligbihi akpe kɛ lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi ekpa.”

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Odaseyeli enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ji nu tsohi enyɔ ɔ kɛ kane tsohi enyɔ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ zugba a nɔ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ he blɔ kaa sa ngaa hiɔwe nya konɛ hiɔmi ko nɛ ngɛ a gbami ligbi ɔmɛ a mi; nɛ a ngɛ he blɔ hulɔ ngɛ nyu ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa a haa a plɛɔ peɔ muɔ, nɛ a kɛ haomi haoɔ zugba a si abɔ nɛ a suɔ.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke a gbe a odaseyemi ɔ nya a, lohwe ɔ nɛ je muɔ voo ɔ mi ɔ kɛ mɛ maa hwu ta, nɛ e maa ye a nɔ, nɛ e maa gbe mɛ;

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ma pue si ngɛ ma ngua nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ngɛ mumi mi ke Sodoma kɛ Mizraim ɔ, he nɛ a sɛu a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ magbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma amɛ kɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ kɛ gbihi slɔɔto ɔmɛ kɛ majemaje li ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ maa hyɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ligbi etɛ̃ kɛ fa, nɛ a be kplɛe nɛ a pu mɛ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ma nya ngɛ a gbenɔ ɔ he, nɛ a mi mi maa flii mɛ, nɛ a maa ke a he nihi, ejakaa kikɛmɛ a gbali enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ hao ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Nɛ ligbi etɛ kɛ fa a se ɔ, wami mumi je Mawu ngɔ ba a mi, nɛ a te si da a nane nɔ, nɛ gbeye nɛ nya wa nu nihi nɛ na mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Nɛ gbali enyɔ ɔmɛ nu gbi kpetekpleenyɛ je hiɔwe de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ kuɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ!” Nɛ a kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ bɔku ɔ mi, nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ na mɛ.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛ lɛ ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu ɔ, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ ma a mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake hule, nɛ zugba mimiɛmi ɔ mi ɔ, a gbe nimli akpe kpaago. Ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha hiɔwe Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Musu nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ be; nɛ oʼɛ musu nɛ ji etɛ ɔ ma oya. Titimati nɛ ji kpaago ɔ

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji kpaago ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ a nu gbi nguahi ngɛ hiɔwe ke: “Je nɛ mi matsɛ yemi ɔ plɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e Kristo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene kɛ neneene!”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: de ke: “Wa naa mo si, mo Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, Mo nɔ nɛ o ngɛ nɛ o hi si ɔ, Kaa o ngɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ Nɛ o bɔni matsɛyemi,

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Nɛ majemaje li ɔmɛ a mi mi fu, Ejakaa o mi mi fumi be ɔ su Nɛ a maa kojo ni gbogboe ɔmɛ Nɛ a maa wo o sɔmɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ Kɛ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ hiɔ, nimli wawi kɛ nimli nguahi Nɛ yee o biɛ ɔ gbeye ɔ. Be su nɛ a ma puɛ nihi nɛ puɛɔ zugba a.”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Nɛ a bli Mawu sɔlemi tsu ɔ nya ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ a na e somi daka a ngɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi, nɛ oslaba, kɛ gbi kɛ hiɔwe simi kɛ zugba mimiɛmi kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu loo hiɔmi tɛ babauu ba.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: nɛ e mi wa, nɛ e ngɛ ngmlaa kpae, nɛ e ngɛ kɔɔe, nɛ e ngɛ nɔ nae nɛ e ma fɔ.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Nɛ a na okadi kpa ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ oʼɛ, sinɔ ngua tsutsuutsu kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ngɛ yi kpaago kɛ koli nyɔngma, nɛ matsɛ pɛɛ kpaago bu e yi ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Nɛ ehlemi ngɛ hiɔwe dodoehi a midlami etɛ mi kake gblae, nɛ e tsɔ mɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ. Nɛ sinɔ ngua a ba da yo nɛ ma fɔ ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ, ke e fɔ ɔ nɛ e mi e bi ɔ.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Nɛ yo ɔ fɔ bi nyumu nɔ nɛ kɛ dade tso ma kpaka maje li ɔmɛ kulaa a; nɛ a sa e bi ɔ kɛ ho Mawu ngɔ ya ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ kasa nya.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Nɛ yo ɔ tu fo kɛ ho nga nɔ he ko ya, he nɛ Mawu dla to ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ, konɛ a ya lɛ lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ligbihi akpe kɛ lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi ekpa.

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Nɛ ta te si ngɛ hiɔwe: Mikael kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ hia sinɔ ngua a yi nɔ ta. Nɛ sinɔ ngua a bɔfo ɔmɛ piɛ e he kɛ hwu,

translation_verse: se a ye a nɔ, nɛ a nɛ blɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ha mɛ hu.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Nɛ a sake sinɔ ngua kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji blema sinɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nyapolɔ loo Abosiami nɛ sisiɔ je mluku ɔ tsuo ɔ, ngɔ fɔ zugba a nɔ, nɛ a sake e bɔfo ɔmɛ hu ngɔ fɔ zugba a nɔ ngɔ piɛ e he.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Nɛ i nu gbi ngua ko ngɛ hiɔwe ke: “Jehanɛ yi wami hemi ɔ kɛ he wami ɔ kɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ plɛ wa Mawu ɔ nɔ, nɛ a kɛ he blɔ ɔ ha e Kristo ɔ, ejakaa a sake wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nya polɔ ɔ nɛ poo a nya ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyɔ kɛ pia a ngɔ fɔ he.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ, Tobi ɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a odase yemi munyu ɔ, a kɛ ye e nɔ, nɛ a klɔɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a wami he kɛ ya su gbenɔ mi tete.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hiɔwe kɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nyɛ na bua jɔmi! Musu tloo je ɔ kɛ wo! Ejakaa Abosiami kple si kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, e gli wawɛɛ, ejakaa e le kaa be bɔɔ kɛkɛ e piɛ ha lɛ.”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Nɛ benɛ sinɔ ngua a na kaa a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ zugba a nɔ ɔ, e tiu yo ɔ nɛ fɔ bi nyumu ɔ.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Se a ngɔ kɔle ngua a ple enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha yo ɔ, konɛ e te kɛ ya nga a nɔ ngɛ e blɔ he ɔ, he nɛ a maa lɛ lɛ ngɛ jeha etɛ kɛ fa nɛ sinɔ ɔ be lɛ nae hu ɔ.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Nɛ sinɔ ɔ su nyu nɛ ngɛ kaa pa kɛ je e nya mi kɛ pue yo ɔ se, konɛ nyu ɔ nɛ sa lɛ kɛ ho.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ sinɔ ngua a mi mi fu yo ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho konɛ e kɛ yo ɔ nina nɛ piɛ nɛ yeɔ Mawu kita amɛ a nɔ nɛ a hɛɛ Yesu Kristo he odase yemi ɔ mi ɔ ya hwu ta.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ya da wo nya zia a nɔ.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na lohwe ko nɛ e ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi jee kɛ ma, nɛ e ngɛ koli nyɔngma kɛ e yi kpaago, nɛ matsɛ pɛɛhi nyɔngma bu e koli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ musubɔmi biɛhi ngɛ e yi ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Nɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ i na a ngɛ kaa ogbetee, nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa osisibliisii nanehi, nɛ e nya ngɛ kaa jata nya. Nɛ sinɔ ngua a ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami ɔ kɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ he blɔ ngua a ngɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Nɛ i na e yi ɔmɛ a kpɛti kake nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ a plaa lɛ gbenɔ plaami, se a tsa e gbenɔ plaami ɔ, nɛ je mluku ɔ kulaa nya kpɛ a he ngɛ lohwe ɔ he.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo ja sinɔ ngua a nɛ ngɔ he blɔ ɔ ngɔ ha lohwe ɔ, nɛ a ke: “Mɛnɔ ngɛ kaa lohwe, ɔ nɛ mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ maa hwu ta?”

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Nɛ e pã e nya mi nɛ e tu musu bɔmi munyui kɛ si Mawu, nɛ etu e biɛ ɔ kɛ he nɛ e hii ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ hii hiɔwe ɔ a he musu bɔmi munyuhi.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ha lɛ he blɔ nɛ e kɛ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ nɛ hwu ta nɛ e ye a nɔ, nɛ a ha lɛ he blɔ ngɛ wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso kɛ ma tsuaa ma kɛ mahi a nɔ gbihi tsuo kɛ je ma tsuaa je ma nɔ.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ma ja lɛ, nihi nɛ a ngmɛ́ a biɛ ngɛ Tobi nɛ a gbe ɔ wami womi ɔ mi kɛ je je mi sisije ɔ.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: “Ke nɔ ko ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu!

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na lohwe kpa ko nɛ e ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ngɛ zugba a mi jee, nɛ e ngɛ koli enyɔ kaa to bi, nɛ e tuɔ munyu kaa sinɔ ngua.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Nɛ e tsuɔ kekle lohwe ɔ he blɔ ɔmɛ kulaa he ni ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e haa zugba a kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ jaa kekle lohwe ɔ nɛ a tsa e gbenɔ plaami ɔ.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Nɛ e peɔ okadi nguahi, nɛ e haa la po jee hiɔwe baa zugba a nɔ ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kɛ nyakpɛ nihi nɛ e na he blɔ kaa e pee ngɛ lohwe ɔ hɛ mi ɔ sisiɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, nɛ e deɔ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ke, a pee amaga ngɔ ha lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ klaate plaa lɛ nɛ e hɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ mumi nɛ ha lohwe ɔ amaga a, konɛ lohwe ɔ amaga a nɛ tu munyu nɛ e ha a gbe nimli kulaa nɛ ja we lohwe ɔ amaga a.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.

translation_verse: Hiɛ ɔ nilemi ɔ ngɛ. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, e bu lohwe ɔ yibɔ ɔ he akaɔtaa, ejakaa yibɔ ɔ daa si ha nɔmlɔ biɛ; nɛ yibɔ ɔ ji lafa ekpa kɛ nyingmi ekpa kɛ ekpa.

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Nɛ i nu gbi ko kɛ je hiɔwe kaa nyu babauu pɛmi, nɛ jehanɛ hu kaa hiɔwe simi wawɛɛ pɛmi. Gbi nɛ i nu ɔ ngɛ kaa sakufiali nɛ hɛɛ a sakuhi nɛ a ngɛ fiae ɔ a gbi.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Nɛ a ngɛ Ta he ko lae ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a hɛ mi; nɛ nɔ ko nyɛ we la a nɛ e kase, ja nimli akpe lafa nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɛ a kpɔ kɛ je zugba a nɔ ɔ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ kɛ yihi ble we a he, ejakaa nihewi nɛ ngɔɛ yihi ji mɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛ Tobi ɔ se kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ e yaa a. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a kpɔ kɛ je nimli a kpɛti nɛ a plɛ kekleekle yiblii ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ Tobi ɔ.

translation_verse: A nɛ́ lakpa ko ngɛ a nya mi, ejakaa piami ko be a he. Hiɔwe bɔfohi etɛ ɔ

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na hiɔwe bɔfo kpa ko nɛ e ngɛ tee ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi, nɛ e hɛɛ neneene Sane Kpakpa nɛ e yaa jaje ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ je ma tsuaa je ma kɛ wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso kɛ mahi a nɔ gbi slɔɔtohi kɛ ma tsuaa ma a, nɛ e kɛ gbi ngua de ke:

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ ha lɛ, ejakaa e kojomi ngmlɛfia a su. Nyɛ ja nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba kɛ wo kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi nɛ baa a.”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo kpa nɛ ji enyɔ nyɛɛ se nɛ e ke: “E ywia, Babilon ma ngua a ywia, ejakaa e ha majemaje ɔ kulaa nu e ajuama bɔmi ɔ he mi mi fumi da a eko.”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo kpa nɛ ji etɛ nyɛɛ a se, nɛ e kɛ gbi ngua de ke: “Ke nɔ ko ja lohwe ɔ kɛ e maga a, nɛ e heɔ e kadi ɔ ngɛ e hɛ nya loo e nine nɔ ɔ,

translation_verse: lɛ hu e maa nu Mawu cmi mi fumi da nɛ a tsa we mi nɛ ngɛ e mi mi fumi kplu ɔ mi ɔ eko, nɛ a ma pii lɛ ngɛ la gligliigli ɔ mi ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ Tobi ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Nɛ a plaami ɔ lasuku ɔ tee si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene; nɛ nihi nɛ ja lohwe ɔ kɛ e maga, a kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he e biɛ ɔ okadi ɔ na we he jɔmi nyɔ kɛ pia.

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Hiɛ ɔ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ nɛ yeɔ Mawu kita amɛ kɛ Yesu nɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ ɔ a tsui si tomi ɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Nɛ i nu gbi kɛ je hiɔwe ngɛ dee ke: “Ngmaa: A gbaa ni gbogboehi nɛ gboɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ. Ee, Mumi ɔ ke, konɛ a jɔɔ a he kɛ je a haomi ɔmɛ a mi; se a ni tsumi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se.” Ngma kpami ngɛ je ɔ mi

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, bɔku hiɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hii si ngɛ bɔku ɔ nɔ kaa Nɔmlɔbi ɔ, nɛ e kle e yi si kɛ sika jlasi, nɛ e hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba ngɛ e dɛ mi.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔfo kpa ko je kpo kɛ je bɔ sami latɛ ɔ mi, nɔ nɛ ngɛ la nɔ he wami, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ nɔ nɛ hɛɛ ha nɛ nya ba a ke: “O kɛ o ha nɛ nya ba a nɛ wo mi nɛ o poo nɛ o bua zugba a nɔ wai yiblii sawe ɔmɛ a nya, ejakaa wai yiblii ɔ fu.”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔfo ɔ sake e ha a ngɔ fɔ zugba a nɔ, nɛ e bua zugba a nɔ wai yiblii ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ e kɛ wo Mawu mi mi la wai ngami nɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi.

translation_verse: Nɛ a naa wai ngami nɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ ma a se, nɛ muɔ je wai ngami nɔ ɔ mi kɛ kuɔ kɛ ya su okpɔngɔhi a nya mi dade ɔmɛ a he maa pee si tomi lafa enyɔ.

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na okadi kpa ko ngɛ hiɔwe; e kle nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ: hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago nɛ a hɛɛ haomi kpaago nɛ ji nyagbe ni ɔmɛ, ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ maa gbe Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ nya.

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa wo nɛ ngɛ kaa ahuhuɛ nɛ a kɛ la futu mi, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ye lohwe ɔ kɛ e maga a kɛ e kadi ɔ kɛ e biɛ ɔ yibɔ ɔ nɔ kunimi ɔ daa si ngɛ wo nɛ ngɛ kaa ahuhuɛ ɔ nya, nɛ a hɛɛ Mawu saku ɔmɛ.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Nɛ a la Mawu tsɔlɔ Mose la a kɛ Tobi ɔ la a ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, O ni tsumi ɔmɛ kle, nɛ a ngɛ nyakpɛ! Mo je ma amɛ a nɔ matsɛ, O blɔ ɔmɛ da, nɛ anɔkuale ji mɛ.

translation_verse: nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ nɛ hɛɛ haomi kpaago ɔ je kpo kɛ je sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a wo kploba nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe, nɛ a fi a gugue kɛ sika kpɛti fimi nihi.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ngɔ sika tsinesa kpaago nɛ a hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ Mawu nɛ hɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene ɔ mi mi la a ngɔ ha hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Nɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi hyi tɔ kɛ lasuku nɛ je Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ e he wami ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nyɛ we sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi nɛ e sɛ kɛ maa su be nɛ a maa gbe hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔmɛ a haomi kpaago ɔmɛ a nya.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ngua ko nɛ je sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi nɛ e ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ dee ke: “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya plɛ Mawu mi mi fumi tsinesa kpaago ɔmɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ!”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Nɛ kekleekle nɔ ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e ya plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ; nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ lohwe ɔ okadi ɔ ngɛ a he ɔ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ jaa e maga a hia pa yayahi nɛ yee nɔ.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ wo wo mi, nɛ e plɛ muɔ kaa nɔ gbogboe nɔ́, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ gbo.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji etɛ ɔ plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ wo pahi kɛ nyu hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ nyu ɔ plɛ muɔ.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Nɛ i nu nɛ nyu ɔmɛ a nɔ bɔfo ɔ ngɛ dee ke: “Dalɔ ji mo, Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ nɔ nɛ hi si sa kɛ nɔ nɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ejakaa o nɔ da ngɛ o kojomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: A pue klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a muɔ si, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ muɔ nɔuu o ha mɛ nɛ a nu, ejakaa e sa mɛ ja.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ke: “Ee, Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, anɔkuale kɛ dami ji o kojomi ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pue pu ɔ nɔ; nɛ a ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ la nɛ sa nimli.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Nɛ e la dɔmi babauu ɔ sa nimli nɛ tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ kikɛmɛ a haomi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ biɛ ɔ, se a tsakee we a tsui nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pue lohwe ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ e matsɛ yemi he ɔ wo diblii, nɛ nimli ta a lilɛ ngɛ nɔ nami he,

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: nɛ a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɛ a nɔ nami kɛ a pa amɛ a he, se a tsakee we a tsui kɛ ji a ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji ekpa a plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ wo Eufrate pa ngua a mi, nɛ e mi nyu ɔ mii, konɛ a kɛ dla blɔ ngɔ ha matsɛmɛ nɛ je puje he ɔ.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na mumi yayami etɛ nɛ ngɛ kaa ovɔnɔhi loo kuɔwihi ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ngɛ sinɔ ngua a nya mi kɛ lohwe ɔ nya mi kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ nya mi jee;

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: ejakaa mumi yayamihi a mumi ji mɛ, nɛ a peɔ nyakpɛ nihi, nɛ a yaa matsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ je mluku ɔ kulaa mi ɔ ngɔ, konɛ a ya bua a nya kɛ ya Mawu Ope ɔ ligbi ngua a nɔ ta a.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: “Oʼɛ i ma kaa juɔ. A gbaa nɔ nɛ huɔɔ nɛ e hyɛɛ e tade ɔmɛ a nɔ saminya a, konɛ e ko nyɛɛ he gu nɛ e zo ba je kpo.”

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji kpaago ɔ plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ wo kɔɔhiɔ mi; nɛ gbi ngua ko je hiɔwe sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi kɛ je matɛ sɛ ɔ mi de ke: “A gbe nya!”

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma ngua a mi gba etɛ, nɛ maje li ɔmɛ a ma amɛ hule, nɛ a kai Babilon kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, konɛ a ngɔ e mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a kplu ɔ mi da a ngɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ nɛ a hɛɛ tsinesa kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ba nɛ e kɛ mi ba tu munyu ke: “Ba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ajuama kpanaaku ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nyu babauu ɔ nɔ ɔ kojomi ɔ,

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ bɔ ajuama, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ de da kɛ e ajuama bɔmi da a.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kpaka mi kɛ ho nga nɔ ya ngɛ mumi mi; nɛ i na yo ko nɛ hii si ngɛ lohwe nɛ tsuɔ kaa muɔ ko nɔ nɛ musu bɔmi biɛhi kpe e he, nɛ e ngɛ yi kpaago kɛ koli nyɔngma.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Nɛ yo ɔ wo tade nɛ hɛɛ alamua yumu su kɛ tade nɛ tsuɔ kaa muɔ, nɛ a kɛ sika kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa kɛ adiagba wo lɛ, nɛ e hɛɛ sika kplu nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ e ajuama bɔmi ɔ mi ninye nihi kɛ mu ni ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi;

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: nɛ a ngma biɛ ko ngɛ e hɛ nya nɛ ji laami sane ke: “Babilon ngua a, zugba a nɔ ajuama a kɛ ninye ni ɔmɛ a nyɛ.”

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Nɛ i na yo ɔ kaa klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ a muɔ ɔ kɛ Yesu he odase yeli ɔmɛ a muɔ ɔ de lɛ da. Benɛ i na lɛ ɔ ye nya kpɛ ye he wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ de mi ke: “Mɛni he je o nya ngɛ o he kpɛe? Ma sɛɛ mo yo ɔ kɛ lohwe nɛ e hii si ngɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ yi kpaago kɛ koli nyɔngma a he laami sane ɔ.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Lohwe ɔ nɛ o na a hi si hyɛ, se e be hu. E maa je muɔ voo ɔ mi kɛ je kpo kɛ ba be kɛ ho hɛ mi kpatami mi ya; nɛ nihi nɛ a ngɛ zugba a nɔ nɛ a ngmɛ́ a biɛ ngɛ wami womi ɔ mi kɛ je je mi sisije ɔ nya maa kpɛ a he, ke a na lohwe ɔ nɛ hi si hyɛ nɛ e be hu nɛ e maa ba a.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: “Hiɛ ɔ juɛmi nɛ ni lemi ngɛ mi ɔ ngɛ. Yi kpaago ɔ ji yoku kpaago nɛ yo ɔ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ, nɛ matsɛmɛ kpaago hu ji mɛ:

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: nihi enuɔ ɔ gbee si, nɛ nɔ kake ngɛ, nɛ nɔ kpa a na we nɛ e ba, nɛ ke e ba a, ja e hi si bɔɔ.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ hi si sa nɛ e be ɔ ji matsɛ nɛ ji kpaanyɔ, nɛ e je kpaago ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e yaa shɛ mi kpatami mi.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: “Koli nyɔngma nɛ o na a, matsɛmɛ nyɔngma ʼi, nihi nɛ matsɛ yemi ko sui a dɛ, se kɛ ɔ, a kɛ lohwe ɔ na he blɔ kaa matsɛmɛ ngmlɛfia kake.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ a kɛ a he wami kɛ a blɔ nya a ha lohwe ɔ kulaa.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ Tobi ɔ maa huw ta, nɛ Tobi ɔ maa ye a nɔ, ejakaa lɛ ji nyɔmtsɛmɛ a Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ matsɛmɛ a Matsɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ a kɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ ji ninɛmɛ nɛ a tsɛ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a hia kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ de mi ke: “Nyu ɔ nɛ o na nɛ yo ajuama a hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ ji mahi kɛ asafohi kɛ je mahi kɛ mahi a nɔ gbihi.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Nɛ koli nyɔngma nɛ o na a, kɛ lohwe ɔ, maa nyɛ ajuama a, nɛ a ma kpɔ e nihi kulaa nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma kpa e he bo, nɛ a maa ye e he lo, nɛ a kɛ la maa sa lɛ.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu kɛ wo a tsui mi konɛ a pee e yi mi tomi ni ɔmɛ, nɛ a hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ a kɛ a matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ ha lohwe ɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ a maa gbe nihi nɛ Mawu de ɔmɛ a nya.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: “Nɛ yo ɔ nɛ o na a ji ma ngua nɛ yeɔ je ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, i na hiɔwe bɔfo kpa ko nɛ e ngɛ si kplee kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe jee, nɛ e ngɛ he blɔ ngua, nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ hã je ɔ mi kulaa tsɔ.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: E kɛ̃ e he nɛ e kpa ngmlaa kɛ gbi ngua ke: “E ywia, Babilon ngua a ywia, nɛ e plɛ mumi yayamihi a si himi he, kɛ mumi yayamihi kulaa a tsu, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ tsuaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ he tsɔ we nɛ he ngɛ tai ɔ hu tsu.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa e ha je ma amɛ kulaa nu e ajuama bɔmi he mi mi fumi da a eko, nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama, nɛ zugba a nɔ jua yeli ɔmɛ plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ e ya homi ɔ he wami ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi kpa ko kɛ je hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ dee ke: “Nyɛɛ je e mi, ye ma, Konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko pee kake ngɛ e he yayami ɔmɛ a mi, Nɛ nyɛ ko na e haomi ɔ eko.

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e he yayami ɔmɛ su hiɔwe lokoo, Nɛ Mawu kai e ni yayami ɔmɛ

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ wo lɛ hiɔ kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ hu e wo nyɛ hiɔ ɔ, Nɛ nyɛɛ ku ngɔ bɔ he totoe enyɔ ha lɛ. Kaa bɔ nɛ sa e ni tsumi ɔmɛ; Kplu ɔ nɛ e futu ha nyɛ ɔ, Nyɛ futu lɛ totoe enyɔ ngɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Nyɛ pii lɛ nɛ nyɛɛ wo lɛ aywlɛho Kaa bɔ nɛ e wo lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi nyami kɛ ya homi ɔ Ja nɔuu nyɛ ha e piimi kɛ e ywlɛho ɔ nɛ pee. Ejakaa e deɔ ngɛ e tsui mi ke: ‘I hii si kaa manye! I pi yalɔyo, Nɛ i be aywlɛho ko nae!’

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi kake nɔ e haomi ɔmɛ maa ba, Gbenɔ kɛ aywlɛho kɛ hwɔ, Nɛ a kɛ la maa sa lɛ, Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu nɛ kojoɔ ɔ he wa.”

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama nɛ a kɛ lɛ ho ya a ma fo lɛ, nɛ a maa wo ya ngɛ e he, benɛ a maa na e sami ɔ lasuku ɔ.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: A maa da se lokoo ngɛ e piimi ɔ he gbeye yemi ɔ he, nɛ a ma de ke: “Musu tloo, musu tloo, ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, Babilon, ma nɛ he wa a! ejakaa ngmlɛfia kake mi nɛ o kojomi ɔ ba nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Zugba a nɔ jua yeli ɔmɛ ma fo lɛ nɛ a maa ye lɛ kɔmɔ, ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko he we a jua yemi ni ɔmɛ hu:

english_verse: There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble.
translation_verse: Sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa, kɛ adiagba, kɛ kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu kɛ bo nɛ ngɛ kaa alamua yumu, kɛ seda kɛ bo nɛ tsuɔ tsutsuutsu, kɛ tso tsuaa tso nɛ jee via, kɛ suɔ wu nihi tsuo, kɛ tso nɛ he jua wa nitsɛnitsɛ, kɛ akɔblee kɛ dade marmara tɛ nihi tsuo,

english_verse: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
translation_verse: kɛ sinamon kɛ amomon kɛ tsopahi kɛ a he viahi kɛ mimɛ kɛ ohɛ nɛ jee via, kɛ da kɛ nu, kɛ sikisiai kɛ ngma, kɛ nahi kɛ tohi, kɛ okpɔngɔhi kɛ zugba lɛhi, kɛ nyɔguɛhi kɛ nimli a klaahi.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: Nɛ yiblii nɛ jloɔ mo ɔ je o nya mi, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kɛ nihi nɛ kpɛɔ nylamnylam ɔ bɔ mo, nɛ o be mɛ nae kulaa hu.

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Jua yeli nɛ plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ maa da se lokoo ngɛ e nɔ nami ɔ gbeye yemi ɔ he, nɛ a ma fo ya nɛ a maa ye kɔmɔ;

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
translation_verse: Nɛ lɛ kudɔlɔ tsuaa lɛ kudɔlɔ kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hii lɛ mi kɛ yaa he ko, kɛ lɛ mi bi kɛ nihi abɔ nɛ tsuɔ wo nɔ ni ɔ da si ngɛ se lokoo,

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: nɛ benɛ a na e sami ɔ lasuku ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Te ma nɛ ngɛ kaa ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Nɛ a kɛ bunyuku wo a yi mi, nɛ a kɛ ya kɛ kɔmɔyemi kpa ngmlaa ke: “Musu tloo, musu tloo ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nɛ nihi kulaa nɛ a ngɛ lɛhi ngɛ wo hɛ mi ɔ plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ e mi jua yemi nihi nɛ a he jua wa a he; ejakaa ngmlɛfia kake pɛ mi nɛ e plɛ ma doku nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
