translation_verse: nɔ́ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ sardoniki, nɔ́ nɛ ji ekpa a sadio, nɔ́ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ krisolito, nɔ́ nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ berilo, nɔ́ nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ topasion, nɔ́ nɛ ji nyɔngma a krisopraso, nɔ́ nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ hiakinto, nɔ́ nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ ametisto.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Nɛ agbohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, adiagba nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ʼi, nɛ agbo kake ɔ adiagba kake a kɛ pee. Nɛ ma a mi blɔ ɔ sika tsu nitsɛ ʼi, nɛ e mi tsɔ kaa ahuhuɛ.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: I nɛ sɔlemi tsu ko ngɛ ma a mi, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope ɔ kɛ Tobi ɔ ji e sɔlemi tsu.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: Nɛ pu loo nyɔhiɔ kpemi hia we ngɛ ma a mi, ejakaa Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsoo ngɛ mi, nɛ Tobi ɔ ji la nɛ kpɛɛ ngɛ mi.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Nɛ maje li ɔmɛ maa nyɛɛ ngɛ e la a mi, nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ mi nyami kɛ ba mi.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Nɛ e gbo ɔmɛ ɔ, a be ngae ligbi ko ligbi ko; ejakaa nyɔ be lejɛ ɔ;

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ je mi ma amɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ a bu ɔ maa ba mi.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ nɔ nɛ peɔ ninyɛ nihi kɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ lakpa be mi sɛe kulaa, kaa ja ninɛmɛ nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ Tobi ɔ wami womi ɔ mi ɔ?

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ tsɔɔ mi wami nyu pa klɔuu nɛ mi tsɔ kaa kristalo ahuhuɛ nɛ ngɛ Mawu kɛ Tobi ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ mi jee kɛ ngɛ ma a gbejegbɛ ɔ mi gue,

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: nɛ ma a kpɛti kɛ pa a tue hiɛ ɔ kɛ hiɛ ɔ kulaa a wami tso ɔ maa si, nɛ e woɔ yiblii si nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, hlami tsuaa hlami ɔ, e woɔ yiblii si kake, nɛ tso ɔ yi ba amɛ ɔ, a kɛ tsaa je ma amɛ.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Nɛ musu ko musu ko be lejɛ ɔ hu. Mawu kɛ Tobi ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ maa ma si ngɛ e mi, nɛ e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ma sɔmɔ lɛ,

english_verse: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.
translation_verse: nɛ a maa na e hɛ mi, nɛ e biɛ ɔ maa hi a hɛ nya.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɔ be lejɛ ɔ hie, nɛ kane loo pu kpemi he be mɛ hiae, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ɔ ma kpɛ ha mɛ, nɛ a maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene kɛ neneene. Yesu bami

english_verse: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ de mi ke: “Anɔkuale munyu nɛ maa si pim ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ a mumi ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ konɛ e ba tsɔɔ e sɔmɔli nihi nɛ sa kaa a ba nɔuu ɔ.”

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: “Oʼɛ i ma nɔuu. A gbaa nɔ nɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ mi gbami munyu ɔmɛ toɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Nɛ imi, Yohane, ji nɔ nɛ na nɛ e nu ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɛ benɛ i nu nɛ i na a, i bu si nɛ ma ja ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ mi ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nane nya.

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: Nɛ e de mi ke: “Koo pee! ejakaa o nyɛmi sɔmɔlɔ kɛ gbali kɛ nihi nɛ toɔ kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ mi munyu ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ ko ji mi; ja Mawu mohu!”

english_verse: Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Nɛ e de mi ke: “Koo sɔu kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ mi gbami munyu ɔmɛ a nya, ejakaa be ɔ su.

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ dɛ ɔ, ha e ya nɔ nɛ e pee nihi nɛ dɛ ɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ ji mutsɛ ɔ, ha e ya nɔ nɛ e wo e he mu; nɛ nɔ nɛ ji dalɔ ɔ, ha e ya nɔ nɛ e tsu dami ni ɔmɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ha e ya nɔ nɛ e hi klɔuklɔu.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: “Oʼɛ, i ma nɔuu, nɛ i hɛɛ ye hiɔwo ɔ kɛ ma, nɛ ma wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ e ni tsumi ɔ nya.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Ami ji Alfa a kɛ omega a nɛ, sisije ɔ kɛ nyagbe ɔ, kekleekle nɔ ɔ kɛ nyagbe nɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: A gbaa nihi nɛ fɔɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he ɔ, konɛ a na wami tso ɔ nɔ yiblii ɔ yemi he blɔ, nɛ a gu a gbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ sɛ ma a mi.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Se ma a se ɔ, gbe ɔmɛ kɛ nyuali ɔmɛ kɛ ya holi ɔmɛ kɛ awi yeli ɔmɛ kɛ amaga jali ɔmɛ kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ lakpa nɛ ngɔɔ nya a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: “Imi Yesu, i tsɔ ye bɔfo ɔ konɛ e ba ye ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi. Ami ji David sipoku ɔ kɛ e nina a, nɔkɔ nɛ ngɛ kpee ɔ.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ kɛ Ayɛflo ɔ ke: “Ba!” Nɛ nɔ nɛ nuɔ ɔ, e de ke: “Ba!” Nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ tɔe ɔ, e ba, nɛ nɔ nɛ suɔ ɔ, e ba nɛ e ba yɛ wami nyu ɔ yaka gu. Nyagbe

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Imi Yohane i ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ mi gbami munyu ɔmɛ kɔkɔ bɔe ke: Ke nɔ ko kɛ nɔ́ ko piɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, Mawu maa ngɔ haomihi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ mi ɔ ngɔ piɛ he ngɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nɔ ko je nɔ́ ko kɛ je kikɛmɛ a gbami womi nɛ mi munyu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Mawu ma je e blɔ nya kɛ maa je wami tso ɔ yiblii ɔ yemi kɛ ma klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ mi ɔ mi.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase ɔ ngɛ dee ke: “Ee, i ma nɔuu.” Amen. Ee, ba, Mawetsɛ Yesu!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_verse: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: Sisije ɔ, benɛ Mawu bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a,

english_verse: The earth was barren, with no form of life; it was under a roaring ocean covered with darkness. But the Spirit of God was moving over the water. The First Day
translation_verse: je ɔ be su pɔtɛɛ ko; e fɔɔ si gu. Diblii kpii ha muɔ voo kɛ e mi nyu babauu ɔ nya, nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ si bɔlee ngɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: God said, “I command light to shine!” And light started shining.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu fa ke, “La nɛ ba”; nɛ la ba.

english_verse: God looked at the light and saw that it was good. He separated light from darkness
translation_verse: Mawu na la a, nɛ la a muɔ e hɛ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mawu je la a kɛ je diblii ɔ he.

english_verse: and named the light “Day” and the darkness “Night.” Evening came, then morning—that was the first day. The Second Day
translation_verse: E wo la a biɛ ke “Piani” nɛ e tsɛ diblii ɔ ke “Nyɔ.” Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee kekleekle ligbi.

english_verse: and named it “Sky.” Evening came, then morning—that was the second day. The Third Day
translation_verse: Mawu wo nɔ́ ɔ biɛ ke “Hiɔwe”. Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee ligbi nɛ ji enyɔ.

english_verse: God said, “I command the water under the sky to come together in one place, so there will be dry ground.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mawu fa ke, “Nyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ sisi ɔ nɛ bua e he nya ngɛ he kake, konɛ zugba gbigbli nɛ je kpo.” Nɛ e ba mi ja.

english_verse: God named the dry ground “Land,” and he named the water “Ocean.” God looked at what he had done and saw that it was good.
translation_verse: Mawu wo he nɛ gbli ɔ biɛ ke “Zugba”, nɛ nyu ɔ nɛ bua e he nya a, e tsɛ lɛ ke “Wo”. Mawu na, nɛ e muɔ e hɛ.

english_verse: God said, “I command the earth to produce all kinds of plants, including fruit trees and grain.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Mawu fa ke, “Tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a puɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ: tsohi nɛ woɔ ngma loo wu, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ yiblii.” Nɛ e ba mi ja.

english_verse: The earth produced all kinds of vegetation. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Ba kɛ tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi puɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, eko tsuaa eko kɛ e yiblii. Mawu na ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a muɔ e hɛ.

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the third day. The Fourth Day
translation_verse: Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee ligbi nɛ ji etɛ.

english_verse: God said, “I command lights to appear in the sky and to separate day from night and to show the time for seasons, special days, and years.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ Mawu fa ke, “Kanehi nɛ a ba hiɔwe konɛ a kɛ na slɔɔto ngɛ piani kɛ nyɔ a kpɛti, nɛ́ a tsɔɔ jeha mi gbamihi jehahi, kɛ be nɛ a kɛ yeɔ nyami ligbihi pɔtɛɛ komɛ.

english_verse: I command them to shine on the earth.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Kane ɔmɛ nɛ a tso ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ a la a nɛ kpɛ kɛ hyɛ zugba a nɔ.” Nɛ e ba mi ja.

english_verse: God made two powerful lights, the brighter one to rule the day and the other to rule the night. He also made the stars.
translation_verse: Mawu pee kane ngua enyɔ: e pee kane nɛ tsoɔ wawɛɛ pe kulaa a nɛ e ye piani nɔ, kɛ kaketsɛ ɔ hu nɛ e ye nyɔ nɔ. E pee dodoehi hulɔ.

english_verse: Then God put these lights in the sky to shine on the earth,
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ kane ɔmɛ ngɔ to hiɔwe, konɛ a tso kɛ hyɛ zugba a nɔ,

english_verse: to rule day and night, and to separate light from darkness. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: nɛ́ a ye piani kɛ nyɔ a nɔ, nɛ́ a gba la kɛ diblii a mi. Mawu na ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a muɔ e hɛ.

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the fourth day. The Fifth Day
translation_verse: Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee ligbi nɛ ji eywiɛ.

english_verse: God said, “I command the ocean to be full of living creatures, and I command birds to fly above the earth.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Mawu fa ke, “Nyu ɔ nɛ wo lo slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi babauu, nɛ́ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a hi tee ngɛ hiɔwe.”

english_verse: So God made the giant sea monsters and all the living creatures that swim in the ocean. He also made every kind of bird. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bɔ wo mi lohwe nguanguahi, pa mi lo munomunohi, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi. Mawu na ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a muɔ e hɛ.

english_verse: Then he gave the living creatures his blessing—he told the ocean creatures to increase and live everywhere in the ocean and the birds to increase everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Mawu gbaa mɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ fɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ he nɛ hiɛ; nyɛ hyi wo ɔ mi, konɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ hu nɛ a hiɛ babauu ngɛ zugba a nɔ.”

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the fifth day. The Sixth Day
translation_verse: Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee ligbi nɛ ji enuɔ.

english_verse: God said, “I command the earth to give life to all kinds of tame animals, wild animals, and reptiles.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mawu fa ke, “Lohwe slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a ba zugba a nɔ: we mi lohwehi kɛ pu mi lohwehi, lohwe agboagbohi kɛ lohwe wawihi.” Nɛ e ba mi ja.

english_verse: God made every one of them. Then he looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Mawu bɔ lohwe tsuaa lohwe: pu mi lohwehi, we mi lohwehi, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si. Mawu na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a muɔ e hɛ.

english_verse: God said, “Now we will make humans, and they will be like us. We will let them rule the fish, the birds, and all other living creatures.”
translation_verse: Mawu de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ waa pee nɔmlɔ adesa; a maa hi kaa bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a maa je wɔ. A maa ye lo ɔmɛ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, we mi lohwe ɔmɛ, pu mi lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si ngɛ zugba a tsuo a nɔ.”

english_verse: So God created humans to be like himself; he made men and women.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bɔ nɔmlɔ, nɛ e pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɛ ɔ; e bɔ nyumu kɛ yo.

english_verse: God gave them his blessing and said: Have a lot of children! Fill the earth with people and bring it under your control. Rule over the fish in the ocean, the birds in the sky, and every animal on the earth.
translation_verse: Mawu gbaa mɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ fɔ babauu nɛ nyɛɛ hiɛ; nyɛɛ hyi zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ nyɛɛ ye zugba a tsuo nɔ. Nyɛɛ ye lo ɔmɛ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ zugba a nɔ lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.”

english_verse: And I have given the green plants as food for everything else that breathes, including animals, both wild and tame, and birds. And so it was.
translation_verse: Se pu mi lohwe ɔmɛ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kɛ lohwe kpa amɛ tsuo lɛɛ i ha mɛ nga nɛ a kpe, kɛ ba mumu nɛ a ye.” Nɛ e ba mi ja.

english_verse: God looked at what he had done. All of it was very good! Evening came, then morning—that was the sixth day.
translation_verse: Mawu na nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ, nɛ a muɔ e hɛ saminya. Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee ligbi nɛ ji ekpa.

english_verse: So the heavens and the earth and everything else were created. The Seventh Day
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mawu pee nɛ e kɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: By the seventh day God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Mawu tsu ní ligbi ekpa, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e jɔɔ e he.

english_verse: That's how God created the heavens and the earth. The Garden of Eden When the Lord God made the heavens and the earth,
translation_verse: Sane nɛ ɔ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu bɔ je ɔ. Ngmɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Eden ɔ Benɛ Yawɛ Mawu bɔ je ɔ,

english_verse: no grass or plants were growing anywhere. God had not yet sent any rain, and there was no one to work the land.
translation_verse: tso ko tso ko be zugba a nɔ, nɛ nga ko hu puɛ́ ngɛ nɔ; ejakaa e ha we nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ lolo; nɛ nɔ ko hu be nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ hue.

english_verse: But streams came up from the ground and watered the earth.
translation_verse: Se ke pee ɔ, nyu jeɔ zugba a mi kɛ ba pɔɔ zugba a hɛ mi tsuo.

english_verse: The Lord God took some soil from the ground and made a man. God breathed life into the man, and the man started breathing.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu ngɔ zugba zu kɛ puɛ nɔmlɔ, nɛ e mu mumi nɛ haa nɔ wami ngɔ wo nɔmlɔ gugwɔ puɔ mi; nɛ nɔmlɔ pee adesa hɛngmengmletsɛ.

english_verse: The Lord made a garden in a place called Eden, which was in the east, and he put the man there.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu pee ngmɔ ko ngɛ Eden, ngɛ beleku je, nɛ lejɛ ɔ e ngɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ e puɛ ɔ ngɔ to.

english_verse: The Lord God filled the garden with all kinds of beautiful trees and fruit trees. Two other trees were in the middle of the garden. One of these gave life—the other gave the wisdom to know the difference between right and wrong.
translation_verse: E ha tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi puɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi: tsohi nɛ ngɛ fɛu, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ yiblii nɛ a yeɔ. Tso nɛ haa nɔ wami, kɛ tso nɛ haa nɔ leɔ kpakpa kɛ yayami maa si ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ kpɛti tutuutu.

english_verse: From Eden a river flowed out to water the garden, then it divided into four rivers.
translation_verse: Pa ko je Eden kɛ ba gu ngmɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e haa ngmɔ ɔ nyu. Kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, pa a gba kɔni eywiɛ.

english_verse: The first one is the Pishon River that flows through the land of Havilah,
translation_verse: A tsɛɛ kekleekle kɔni ɔ ke Pishon. Lɛ ji pa nɛ bɔle Havila zugba a tsuo, he nɛ a naa sika tsu ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: where pure gold, rare perfumes, and precious stones are found.
translation_verse: A naa sika tsu ngmingmiingmi, nu kɛ e he via, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The second is the Gihon River that winds through Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Pa kɔni enyɔne ɔ biɛ ji Gihon; lɛ ji pa nɛ bɔle Kush zugba a tsuo.

english_verse: But the Lord told him, “You may eat fruit from any tree in the garden,
translation_verse: E wo lɛ mlaa ke, “Tso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ye eko tsuaa eko yiblii faa,

english_verse: The Lord God said, “It isn't good for the man to live alone. I will make a suitable partner for him.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu de ke, “E hí kaa nyumu ɔ nɔ kake too nɛ hi si; ma ha lɛ he piɛlɔ nɛ sa lɛ.”

english_verse: So the Lord took some soil and made animals and birds. He brought them to the man to see what names he would give each of them. Then the man named the tame animals and the birds and the wild animals. That's how they got their names. None of these was the right kind of partner for the man.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu de nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa benɛ e ngɔ zugba zu kɛ puɛ je nɛ ɔ mi lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo gbe nya a, ekoeko be nɛ sa nɔmlɔ kaa e he piɛlɔ. Nɔmlɔ ɔ wo lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo biɛ: we mi lohwehi, pu mi lohwehi, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ. Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ eko ɔ, jã pee e biɛ. Se lɛ nɔmlɔ ɔ nitsɛ lɛɛ a na we he piɛlɔ nɛ sa we lɛ lolo.

english_verse: So the Lord God made him fall into a deep sleep, and he took out one of the man's ribs. Then after closing the man's side,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu ha mahe vii ko ba nɔ nyumu ɔ nɔ, nɛ benɛ e ngɛ mahe ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Mawu je nyumu ɔ kasa wu kake nɛ e kɛ he lo tsi lejɛ ɔ.

translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu ngɔ kasa wu ɔ nɛ e je ngɛ nyumu ɔ he ɔ kɛ pee yo, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ba ha nyumu ɔ.

english_verse: and the man exclaimed, “Here is someone like me! She is part of my body, my own flesh and bones. She came from me, a man. So I will name her Woman!”
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ de ke, “Ɛhɛɛ! Jehanɛ lɛɛ i na ye henɔ tutuutu: imi nitsɛ ye muɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. A je lɛ kɛ je nyumu mi; a ma tsɛ lɛ yo.”

english_verse: That's why a man will leave his own father and mother. He marries a woman, and the two of them become like one person.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ nyumu siɔ e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e ngɔɔ e he ya mɛtɛɛ e yo he nɛ a peeɔ nɔ kake ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Although the man and his wife were both naked, they were not ashamed.
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ kɛ e yo ɔ tsuo hɛɛ a he gu, se zo pee we mɛ.

english_verse: The snake was sneakier than any of the other wild animals that the Lord God had made. One day it came to the woman and asked, “Did God tell you not to eat fruit from any tree in the garden?”
translation_verse: Nga mi lohwehi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ Mawu pee ɔ, sinɔ ji gatsɛ pe mɛ tsuo. Sinɔ bi yo ɔ ke, “Anɛ Mawu de nyɛ niinɛ ke tso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye ekoeko nɔ yiblii lo?”

english_verse: The woman answered, “God said we could eat fruit from any tree in the garden,
translation_verse: Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Wa ma nyɛ maa ye tso yiblii tsuaa tso yiblii,

english_verse: except the one in the middle. He told us not to eat fruit from that tree or even to touch it. If we do, we will die.”
translation_verse: ja tso ɔ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ kpɛti tutuutu ɔ pɛ. Mawu ke wa ko ye jamɛ a tso ɔ yiblii, nɛ wa ko ta he hulɔ; ke wa pee ja a, wa ma gbo.”

english_verse: “No, you won't!” the snake replied.
translation_verse: Sinɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Oo, nyɛ be gboe!

english_verse: “God understands what will happen on the day you eat fruit from that tree. You will see what you have done, and you will know the difference between right and wrong, just as God does.”
translation_verse: Mawu de ja, ejakaa e le kaa ke nyɛ ye jamɛ a tso ɔ yiblii ɔ, nyɛ hɛngmɛ ma bli, nɛ nyɛ maa hi kaa lɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ; nyɛ maa le kpakpa kɛ yayami.”

english_verse: The woman stared at the fruit. It looked beautiful and tasty. She wanted the wisdom that it would give her, and she ate some of the fruit. Her husband was there with her, so she gave some to him, and he ate it too.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ na kaa tso ɔ ngɛ fɛu; e na kaa tso ɔ yiblii ɔ maa ngɔ, nɛ e ma ha nɛ nɔ maa le ní. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ eko nɛ e ye, nɛ e ha e huno ɔ hu eko nɛ e ye.

english_verse: At once they saw what they had done, and they realized they were naked. Then they sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ye tso yiblii ɔ pɛ nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a na anɔkuale ɔ; a na kaa a hɛɛ a he gu, nɛ a kpɛ ba kɛ pee bo nɛ a kɛ ha a mlɛ mi.

english_verse: Late in the afternoon, when the breeze began to blow, the man and woman heard the Lord God walking in the garden. So they hid behind some trees. Sin Brings a Curse
translation_verse: Jamɛ a gbɔkuɛ ɔ, benɛ kɔɔhiɔ yluduu ko ngɛ fiae ɔ, nyumu ɔ kɛ e yo ɔ nu Yawɛ Mawu he nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya laa a he ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: The Lord God called out to the man and asked, “Where are you?”
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu tsɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Jije o ngɛ?”

english_verse: The man answered, “I was naked, and when I heard you walking through the garden, I was frightened and hid!”
translation_verse: E he nɔ ke, “I nu o he ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi; ye tsui po, nɛ i ya laa ye he, ejakaa i hɛɛ ye he gu.”

english_verse: “How did you know you were naked?” God asked. “Did you eat any fruit from that tree in the middle of the garden?”
translation_verse: Mawu bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ de mo ke o hɛɛ o he gu ɔ? Tso yiblii ɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ko ye ɔ, tse o ya ye eko?”

english_verse: “It was the woman you put here with me,” the man said. “She gave me some of the fruit, and I ate it.”
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Yo ɔ nɛ o ngɔ ba piɛ ye he ɔ, lɛ nɛ ha mi tso ɔ yiblii ɔ eko nɛ i ye.”

english_verse: The Lord God then asked the woman, “What have you done?” “The snake tricked me,” she answered, “and I ate some of that fruit.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu bi yo ɔ ke, “Mɛni ha nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Sinɔ ɔ lɛ mlɔɔ mi; enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i ye ɔ nɛ.” Mawu gbla a tue

english_verse: So the Lord God said to the snake: “Because of what you have done, you will be the only animal to suffer this curse— For as long as you live, you will crawl on your stomach and eat dirt.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu de sinɔ ɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a gbiɛ mo pe je mi lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo. Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, o maa sã si ngɛ o muklii mi nɔ; nɛ o maa ye zu o wami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: You and this woman will hate each other; your descendants and hers will always be enemies. One of hers will strike you on the head, and you will strike him on the heel.”
translation_verse: Ma pee o kɛ yo ɔ he nyɛli; o nina kɛ lɛ hu e nina maa pee he nyɛli. A maa fia o yi nɔ́, nɛ mo hu o maa kɔ a nane se ja.”

english_verse: Then the Lord God said to the woman, “You will suffer terribly when you give birth. But you will still desire your husband, and he will rule over you.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e de yo ɔ ke, “Ma ha nɛ o maa na nɔ́ ngɛ o hɔ ngɔmi kɛ o bi fɔmi mi. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o maa suɔ o huno ɔ, nɛ lɛ nɛ e maa ye o nɔ.”

english_verse: The man Adam named his wife Eve because she would become the mother of all who live.
translation_verse: Adam wo e yo ɔ biɛ ke Hawa, nɛ e de ke, “I wo mo kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nimli adesahi tsuo a nyɛ ji mo.”

english_verse: Then the Lord God made clothes out of animal skins for the man and his wife.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yawɛ Mawu ngɔ lohwehi a he womi kɛ kpɛ tade ngɔ wo Adam kɛ e yo ɔ. A fie Adam kɛ Hawa kɛ je ngmɔ ɔ mi

english_verse: The Lord said, “They now know the difference between right and wrong, just as we do. But they must not be allowed to eat fruit from the tree that lets them live forever.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyumu ɔ ngɛ kaa wa ti nɔ kake pɛ, nɛ e le kpakpa kɛ yayami. Ma hyɛ nɛ e ko ya tsɔ tso ɔ nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ e yiblii nɛ e ye, nɛ e ba hi je mi kɛ ya neneene.”

english_verse: So the Lord God sent them out of the Garden of Eden, where they would have to work the ground from which the man had been made.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu je Adam we; e fie lɛ kɛ je Eden ngmɔ ɔ mi, konɛ e ya hu zugba zu ɔ nɛ a kɛ puɛ lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Later she had another son and named him Abel. Abel became a sheep farmer, but Cain farmed the land.
translation_verse: Kain se ɔ, Hawa fɔ binyumu ekohu nɛ e wo lɛ Habel. Habel ní tsumi ji to hyɛmi, se Kain lɛɛ ngmɔ hulɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: One day, Cain gave part of his harvest to the Lord,
translation_verse: Be ko ɔ, Kain ngɔ e ngmɔ mi ní ɔmɛ eko kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: and Abel also gave an offering to the Lord. He killed the first-born lamb from one of his sheep and gave the Lord the best parts of it. The Lord was pleased with Abel and his offering,
translation_verse: Habel hu ngɔ kekleekle bi nɛ e jijɔ ɔmɛ eko fɔ ɔ kɛ ba. E gbe lɛ, nɛ e kɛ lo ɔ hehi nɛ wo zɔ ɔ sã bɔ. Yawɛ bua jɔ Habel kɛ e bɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: but not with Cain and his offering. This made Cain so angry that he could not hide his feelings.
translation_verse: Se Kain lɛɛ Yawɛ na we e he bua jɔmi; e bɔ ɔ hu Yawɛ he we. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Kain mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e hɛ dɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Cain: What's wrong with you? Why do you look so angry?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bi Kain ke, “Mɛni he je o mi mi fu nɛ o tu o hɛ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: If you had done the right thing, you would be smiling. But you did the wrong thing, and now sin is waiting to attack you like a lion. Sin wants to destroy you, but don't let it!
translation_verse: E ji o pee nɔ́ nɛ hi jinɛ i ko na o he bua jɔmi. Se akɛnɛ o ya pee we nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, yayami buu si ngɛ o sinya a nya kaa lohwe dikalɔ nɛ e miɔ nɛ e maa tu mla mo. Se, hyɛ nɛ o ye yayami ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let's go for a walk.” And when they were out in a field, Cain attacked and killed him.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Kain de e senɔ Habel ke, “Ha nɛ waa ho nga nɔ ya.” Benɛ a ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, Kain nu e senɔ ɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ.

english_verse: Afterwards the Lord asked Cain, “Where is Abel?” “How should I know?” he answered. “Am I supposed to look after my brother?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bi Kain ke, “Jije o senɔ Habel ngɛ?” E he nɔ ke, “I li; imi lɛ i hyɛɛ ye senɔ ɔ nɔ lo?”

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Why have you done this terrible thing? You killed your own brother, and his blood flowed onto the ground. Now his blood is calling out for me to punish you.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ?” E ya nɔ nɛ e de Kain ke, “O senɔ ɔ muɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ, e hia kaa ma ye e he lue.

english_verse: And so, I'll put you under a curse. Because you killed Abel and made his blood run out on the ground, you will never be able to farm it again.
translation_verse: Zugba a mii o senɔ ɔ nɛ o gbe ɔ e muɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbiɛ mo.

english_verse: When you try to farm the land, it won't produce anything for you. From now on, you'll be without a home, and you'll spend the rest of your life wandering from place to place.
translation_verse: Ke o hu ɔ, zugba a be ní bae ha mo hu; o maa bɔ kó, nɛ o maa wo lalaalo ngɛ je ɔ mi.”

english_verse: “No!” the Lord answered. “Anyone who kills you will be punished seven times worse than I am punishing you.” So the Lord put a mark on Cain to warn everyone not to kill him.
