translation_verse: Tera ngɔ e binyumu Abram, kɛ e bibi Lot, Haran binyumu ɔ, kɛ e nganyɛ Sarai, Abram yo ɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ je Ur ngɛ Babilonia kɛ yaa Kanaan. Se benɛ a su ma a nɛ a tsɛɛ Haran ɔ, a ya to lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Abram: Leave your country, your family, and your relatives and go to the land that I will show you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Abram ke, “Jee o zugba a nɔ, kɛ o ma a mi, kɛ o weku li a ngɔ kɛ ya zugba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I will bless you and make your descendants into a great nation. You will become famous and be a blessing to others.
translation_verse: Ma ha mo nina babauu, nɛ a maa pee je ma agbo. Ma gbaa mo, nɛ ma ha o ma he biɛ, nɛ a maa gu o nɔ kɛ gbaa nihi babauu.

english_verse: I will bless those who bless you, but I will put a curse on anyone who puts a curse on you. Everyone on earth will be blessed because of you.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ gbaa mo ɔ, ma gbaa mɛ. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbiɛɛ mo ɔ, imi hu ma gbiɛ mɛ. O nɔ ma gu kɛ gbaa je ma amɛ tsuo.”

english_verse: Abram went as far as the sacred tree of Moreh in a place called Shechem. The Canaanites were still living in the land at that time,
translation_verse: Abram nyɛɛ kɛ be ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ ya su tso ngua a nɛ ngɛ More ngɛ Shekem ɔ he. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: The crops failed, and there was no food anywhere in Canaan. So Abram and his wife Sarai went to live in Egypt for a while. But just before they got there, Abram said, “Sarai, you are really beautiful!
translation_verse: Benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a maa su Egipt ɔ, e de e yo Sarai ke, “Sarai, i le kaa yo nɛ he ngɛ fɛu ji mo.

english_verse: When the Egyptians see you, they will murder me because I am your husband. But they won't kill you.
translation_verse: Ke Egipt bi ɔmɛ na mo ɔ, a ma de ke, ‘E yo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ’; kɛkɛ a maa gbe mi, se moo lɛɛ a be mo nɔ́ ko pee.

english_verse: As soon as Abram and Sarai arrived in Egypt, the Egyptians noticed how beautiful she was.
translation_verse: Benɛ Abram ba su Egipt ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ na kaa e yo e he ngɛ fɛu saminya.

english_verse: The king was good to Abram because of Sarai, and Abram was given sheep, cattle, donkeys, slaves, and camels.
translation_verse: Sarai he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ hyɛ Abram nɔ saminya; Abram na jijɔhi, nahi, tejihi, nyɔguɛhi nyumuhi kɛ yihi, kɛ afukpɔngɔhi babauu.

english_verse: Because of Sarai, the Lord struck the king and everyone in his palace with terrible diseases.
translation_verse: Abram yo Sarai he je ɔ, Yawɛ ha hiɔ nɛ nya wa ko ba sɛ Farao ɔ kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Finally, the king sent for Abram and said to him, “What have you done to me? Why didn't you tell me Sarai was your wife?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ tsɔ ya tsɛ Abram kɛ ba, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o pee mi nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je o de we mi ke o yo ji yo ɔ?

english_verse: Why did you make me believe she was your sister? Now I've married her. Take her and go! She's your wife.”
translation_verse: Mɛni he je o de mi ke o nyɛmiyo ji lɛ, nɛ i ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee ye yo ɔ? Hyɛ, o yo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ngɔɔ lɛ, nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ je hiɛ ɔ!”

english_verse: So the king told his men to let Abram and Sarai take their possessions and leave.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ fa e we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ha nɛ Abram, kɛ e yo ɔ, kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ je ma a mi kɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.

english_verse: Abram and Sarai took everything they owned and went to the Southern Desert. Lot went with them.
translation_verse: Abram kɛ e yo kɛ Lot hia kɛ gu Egipt omleyi je kɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ a ba pa si ngɛ Kanaan leneyi je.

english_verse: Abram was very rich. He owned many cattle, sheep, and goats, and had a lot of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Abram na ní kpɔtɔɔ; e ngɛ jijɔ, apletsi, na, sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu.

english_verse: Abram moved from place to place in the Southern Desert. And finally, he went north and set up his tents between Bethel and Ai,
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Betel ya. Ke e nyɛɛ bɔɔ, e to si bɔɔ. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ e pee hluu kɛ ya su Betel kɛ Ai a kpɛti he nɛ e to si ngɛ kekle ɔ

english_verse: where he had earlier camped and built an altar. There he worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: nɛ e ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ lɛ e ja Yawɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: Lot, who was traveling with him, also had sheep, goats, and cattle, as well as his own family and slaves.
translation_verse: Lot, nɛ e kɛ Abram ho ɔ, lɛ hu e ngɛ jijɔ, apletsi, na, kɛ we bi babauu.

english_verse: At this time the Canaanites and the Perizzites were still living in the same area, and so there wasn't enough pastureland left for Abram and Lot with all of their animals. Besides this, the men who took care of Abram's animals and the ones who took care of Lot's animals started quarreling.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, pɛ ba sɛ Abram lohwe nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ Lot lohwe nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Periz bi ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: Abram said to Lot, “We are close relatives. We shouldn't argue, and our men shouldn't be fighting one another.
translation_verse: Abram de Lot ke, “Nyɛmimɛ ji wɔ; wa ko pɛ, nɛ wa ko ha nɛ pɛ ba sɛ wa lohwe nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ hu a kpɛti.

english_verse: There is plenty of land for you to choose from. Let's separate. If you go north, I'll go south; if you go south, I'll go north.”
translation_verse: Zugba a tsuo ji tilaa ngɛ o hɛ mi nɛ ɔ nɛ. Moo po zugba a he nɛ o suɔ, konɛ o hi o dɛ he; ke o ngɔ muɔ nɔ je ɔ, ma ngɔ hiɔ nɔ je. Ke hiɔ nɔ je o suɔ jio, imi hu ma ngɔ muɔ nɔ je.”

english_verse: This happened before the Lord had destroyed the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. And when Lot looked around, he saw there was plenty of water in the Jordan Valley. All the way to Zoar the valley was as green as the garden of the Lord or the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Lot hyɛ zugba a tsuo kɛ kpe, nɛ e na kaa nyu ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi tsuo babauu kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Ngmɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ, aloo kaa bɔ nɛ Egipt zugba a ngɛ kɛ ma Zoar blɔ ɔ. Sane nɛ ɔ ba loko Yawɛ kpata Sodom kɛ Gomora hɛ mi.

english_verse: So Lot chose the whole Jordan Valley for himself, and as he started out toward the east, he and Abram separated.
translation_verse: Lot ngɔ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ tsuo, nɛ e hia kɛ ho beleku je ya. Bɔ nɛ ba nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi gba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Abram stayed in the land of Canaan. But Lot settled near the cities of the valley and put up his tents not far from Sodom,
translation_verse: Abram hi Kanaan zugba a nɔ, se Lot lɛɛ e hi ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ a mi, nɛ e ma e bo tsu ɔ ngɛ Sodom.

english_verse: where the people were evil and sinned terribly against the Lord. Abram Moves to Hebron
translation_verse: Sodom ma a, yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. Abram hia kɛ ho Hebron ya

english_verse: After Abram and Lot had gone their separate ways, the Lord said to Abram: Look around to the north, south, east, and west.
translation_verse: Benɛ Lot je Abram he ɔ, Yawɛ de Abram ke, “Kɛ je he nɛ o daa si ngɛ ɔ, moo hyɛ kɛ bɔle si, kɛ je omleyi kɛ ya leneyi, kɛ je beleku kɛ ya bonyoku.

english_verse: I will give you and your family all the land you can see. It will be theirs forever!
translation_verse: Zugba a nɛ o ngɛ hyɛe ɔ, ma ngɔ lɛ tsuo kɛ ha mo, kɛ o nina, nɛ e maa pee nyɛ nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: I will give you more descendants than there are specks of dust on the earth, and someday it will be easier to count those specks of dust than to count your descendants.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ o nina maa hiɛ babauu kaa tabo zu, nɛ e be hie kanemi; ke nɔ ko nyɛ kane tabo zu ɔ, lɛɛ e ma nyɛ kane o nina.

english_verse: Now walk back and forth across the land, because I am going to give it to you.
translation_verse: Yaa nɛ o ya kpa zugba a tsuo nɔ, ejakaa ma ngɔ kɛ wo o dɛ mi.”

english_verse: Abram took down his tents and went to live near the sacred trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abram gbɛ e bo tsu ɔ, nɛ e ba hi tso ngua amɛ a kasa nya ngɛ Mamre, ngɛ Hebron. Nɛ e ma bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e ja lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: About this time, King Amraphel of Babylonia, King Arioch of Ellasar, King Chedorlaomer of Elam, and King Tidal of Goiim
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Amrafel; Elasar matsɛ, Ariok; Elam matsɛ, Kedorlaomer; kɛ Goim matsɛ, Tidal

english_verse: attacked King Bera of Sodom, King Birsha of Gomorrah, King Shinab of Admah, King Shemeber of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, a city also known as Zoar.
translation_verse: gba ta wo matsɛmɛ enuɔ komɛ: mɛ ji Sodom matsɛ, Bera; Gomora matsɛ, Birsha; Adma matsɛ, Shina; Zeboiim matsɛ, Shemeber; kɛ Bela matsɛ.

english_verse: King Chedorlaomer and his allies had ruled these last five kings for twelve years, but in the thirteenth year the kings rebelled and joined forces in Siddim Valley, which is now covered by the southern part of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Jinɛ a sɔmɔ Kedorlaomer jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, se jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a tsɔ atuã.

english_verse: A year later King Chedorlaomer and his allies attacked and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, and the Emites in Shaveh-Kiriathaim.
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Kedorlaomer kɛ matsɛmɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ba nɛ a ba gbe Refa bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Ashterot Kiriataim, Zuz bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Ham, kɛ Em bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Kiriataim nga a nɔ.

english_verse: They also defeated the Horites in the hill country of Edom, as far as El-Paran, near the desert.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, a gbe Hor bi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ Edom yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a nyɛɛ a se hluu kɛ ya si Elparan ngɛ nga a nya.

english_verse: They went back to the city of Enmishpat, better known as Kadesh. Then they captured all the land that belonged to the Amalekites, and they defeated the Amorites who were living in Hazazon-Tamar.
translation_verse: A kpale a se kɛ ba Kadesh nɛ sa a a tsɛɛ Enmishpat ɔ. A ye Amalek zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ a gbe Amor bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Hazazon Tamar a.

english_verse: At Siddim Valley, the armies of the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela fought the armies of King Chedorlaomer of Elam, King Tidal of Goiim, King Amraphel of Babylonia, and King Arioch of Ellasar. The valley
translation_verse: nɛ a gba ta wo Elam matsɛ, Kedorlaomer; Goim matsɛ, Tidal; Babilonia matsɛ, Amrafel; kɛ Elasar matsɛ, Ariok. Matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛmɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ hwu ta.

english_verse: was full of tar pits, and when the troops from Sodom and Gomorrah started running away, some of them fell into the pits. Others escaped to the hill country.
translation_verse: Muɔhi nɛ amã ngɛ a mi babauu ngɛ Sidim Kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ Sodom kɛ Gomora matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ fo tue ngɛ ta a nya a, a nɔɔ muɔ ɔmɛ a mi; se matsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛ lɛɛ a tu fo kɛ ho yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ya.

english_verse: Their enemies took everything of value from Sodom and Gomorrah, including their food supplies.
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, kɛ niye ní tsuaa niye ní ngɛ Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ je.

english_verse: They also captured Abram's nephew Lot, who lived in Sodom. They took him and his possessions and then left.
translation_verse: Abram wɔfase Lot ngɛ Sodom jamɛ a be ɔ mi; nɛ a ngɔ lɛ hu kɛ e níhi tsuo kɛ je.

english_verse: At this time Abram the Hebrew was living near the oaks that belonged to Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his brothers Eshcol and Aner were Abram's friends. Someone who had escaped from the battle told Abram
translation_verse: Se nyumu ko nɛ tu fo kɛ je ta a mi ba bɔ Abram, Hebri no ɔ amaniɛ ngɛ e sihi he ɔ, ngɛ Amor no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mamre ɔ e tso ngua amɛ a kasa nya. Mamre kɛ e nyɛminyumuhi Eshkol kɛ Aner ɔ, huɛ bɔmi ko ngɛ a kɛ Abram a kpɛti.

english_verse: that his nephew Lot had been taken away. Three hundred and eighteen of Abram's servants were fighting men, so he took them and followed the enemy as far north as the city of Dan.
translation_verse: Benɛ Abram nu kaa a ba nu e wɔfase Lot kɛ ho ɔ, e kɛ e tsɔli lafa etɛ kɛ nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ nɛ a le ta hwumi hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ matsɛmɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ a se kɛ ya su Dan tɔɔ.

english_verse: That night, Abram divided up his troops, attacked from all sides, and won a great victory. But some of the enemy escaped to the town of Hobah north of Damascus,
translation_verse: E dla e we bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo kuuhi a mi, nɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, a ya tua a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe mɛ basabasa. A fie mɛ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ya si Hoba, ngɛ Damasko omleyi je.

english_verse: and Abram went after them. He brought back his nephew Lot, together with Lot's possessions and the women and everyone else who had been captured. Abram Is Blessed by Melchizedek
translation_verse: Abram kpɔ ní ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ha a tsuo ngɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ. Jehanɛ, e wɔfase Lot, kɛ e ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e yi ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ nɛ a ba nuu ɔ hu, e nine su mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ. Melkizedek gbaa Abram

english_verse: Abram returned after he had defeated King Chedorlaomer and the other kings. Then the king of Sodom went to meet Abram in Shaveh Valley, which is also known as King's Valley.
translation_verse: Benɛ Abram ya ye Kedorlaomer kɛ matsɛmɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ a nɔ kunimi nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ma a, Sodom matsɛ ba kpee lɛ ngɛ Shave Kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ e biɛ kpa ji Matsɛ Kɔ̃ ɔ mi.

english_verse: King Melchizedek of Salem was a priest of God Most High. He brought out some bread and wine
translation_verse: Salem matsɛ, Melkizedek, nɛ lɛ kɛ̃ ji Mawu Hiɔwe No ɔ we osɔfo ɔ, ngɔ abolo kɛ wai ba ha Abram,

english_verse: and said to Abram: “I bless you in the name of God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.
translation_verse: nɛ e gbaa lɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu Hiɔwe No, Hiɔwe kɛ zugba bɔlɔ ɔ nɛ gbaa Abram!

english_verse: All praise belongs to God Most High for helping you defeat your enemies.” Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
translation_verse: Mawu Hiɔwe No nɛ ha o ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a je e yi!” Abram ha Melkizedek niha ní nɛ e ya kpɔ ɔ tsuo mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake.

english_verse: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “All I want are my people. You can keep everything else.”
translation_verse: Sodom matsɛ ɔ de Abram ke, “Ngɔɔ ta yibu ní ɔmɛ, se ye we bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ o kɛ mɛ tsuo ba ha mi.”

english_verse: Abram answered: The Lord God Most High made the heavens and the earth. And I have promised him
translation_verse: Abram he nɔ ke, “I na Mawu Hiɔwe No ɔ, nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a,

english_verse: that I won't keep anything of yours, not even a sandal strap or a piece of thread. Then you can never say that you are the one who made me rich.
translation_verse: kaa i be o nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɔe, kpa jio, tokota nya fimi nɔ́ jio; konɛ o ko ba de hwɔɔ se ko ke, ‘Imi lɛ i pee Abram niatsɛ.’

english_verse: Let my share be the food that my men have eaten. But Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre went with me, so give them their share of what we brought back.
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ i be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɔe; nɔ́ nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ye ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ. Se nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ mi ya a, mɛɛ lɛɛ ha mɛ a blɔ fa mi ní. Mɛ ji Aner, Eshkol, kɛ Mamre.”

english_verse: Later the Lord spoke to Abram in a vision, “Abram, don't be afraid! I will protect you and reward you greatly.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Abram tu munyu ngɛ nina mi ke, “Abram, koo ye gbeye. Ma bu o he, nɛ ma gbaa mo babauu.”

english_verse: But Abram answered, “Lord All-Powerful, you have given me everything I could ask for, except children. And when I die, Eliezer of Damascus will get all I own.
translation_verse: Se Abram he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ Mawu, o gbaami ɔ, mɛni he se ma na, imi nɛ i be bi ɔ? Nɔ pɛ nɛ yeɔ ye ní ji Eliezer nɛ je Damasko ɔ.

english_verse: You have not given me any children, and this servant of mine will inherit everything.”
translation_verse: O ha we mi bi; lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, ye nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ma ba ye ye gbosi ní.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “No, he won't! You will have a son of your own, and everything you have will be his.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Abram ekohu ke, “Kikɛmɛ a nyɔguɛ Eliezer nɛ ɔ be o ní yee; mo nitsɛ o bi tutuutu ji nɔ nɛ ma ba ye o gbosi ní ɔ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord took Abram outside and said, “Look at the sky and see if you can count the stars. That's how many descendants you will have.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ Abram kɛ je kpo nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ hiɔwe nɛ o ka kaa o ma nyɛ maa kane dodoe ɔmɛ lo; bɔ nɛ dodoe ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu ɔ, ja o nina hu maa hiɛ.”

english_verse: Abram believed the Lord, so the Lord was pleased with him and accepted him. The Lord Makes Another Promise to Abram
translation_verse: Abram he Yawɛ ye; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ bu lɛ nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: The Lord said to Abram, “I brought you here from Ur in Chaldea, and I gave you this land.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yawɛ de Abram ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ e kɛ mo je Ur ngɛ Babilonia kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, konɛ ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Abram asked, “Lord God, how can I know the land will be mine?”
translation_verse: Abram bi lɛ ke, “Oo Yawɛ Mawu, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma le kaa zugba nɛ ɔ ma ba pee ye nɔ́?”

english_verse: Then the Lord told him, “Bring me a three-year-old cow, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a dove, and a young pigeon.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ngɔɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha mi: na yo nɛ ye jeha etɛ, apletsi yo nɛ ye jeha etɛ, agbosu nɛ ye jeha etɛ, beleku lahuɛ, kɛ okpo zaa.”

english_verse: Abram obeyed the Lord. Then he cut the animals in half and laid the two halves of each animal opposite each other on the ground. But he did not cut the doves and pigeons in half.
translation_verse: Abram ngɔ lohwe ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Mawu. E poo a mi fiee enyɔɔnyɔ; e to fa kake ngɛ zã kake mi ngɛ hiɛ, nɛ e to fa kaketsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ zã kake mi ngɛ a sibi a hanɔ. Se lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ e poo we a mi.

english_verse: And when birds came down to eat the animals, Abram chased them away.
translation_verse: Okpokuhi ba sɔ̃ lohwe gbogboe ɔmɛ a nɔ, se Abram fie mɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and everything became dark and frightening.
translation_verse: Benɛ pu maa ho si nɔmi ya a, mahe vii ko ba nɔ Abram nɔ, nɛ gbeye kɛ sawale nu lɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Abram, you will live to an old age and die in peace. But I solemnly promise that your descendants will live as foreigners in a land that doesn't belong to them. They will be forced into slavery and abused for
translation_verse: Mo nitsɛ lɛɛ o maa hi si kɛ yaa si o maa bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ o ma gbo ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ a maa pu mo.

english_verse: Four generations later, your descendants will return here and take this land, because only then will the people who live here be so sinful that they deserve to be punished.
translation_verse: Yi nɔ eywiɛ se ɔ, o nina maa kpale kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ekohu; ejakaa i be Amor bi ɔmɛ fiee kɛ je zugba a nɔ kɛ yaa si jamɛ a be ɔ mi. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a yi mi wami ɔ nya maa wa, nɛ ma gbla a tue.”

english_verse: Sometime after sunset, when it was very dark, a smoking cooking pot and a flaming fire passed between the two halves of each animal.
translation_verse: Benɛ pu nɔ si nɛ du bu ɔ, ngɛyu kɛ e mi la su ku, kɛ la lilɛ ba, nɛ e gu lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a poo a mi ɔ a kpɛti kɛ be.

english_verse: At that time the Lord made an agreement with Abram and told him: I will give your descendants the land east of the Shihor River on the border of Egypt as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Abram so, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ ha o nina, kɛ maa je Egipt pa a nya kɛ yaa si Yufrate pa a nya.

english_verse: They will possess the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
translation_verse: Ken bi, Keniz bi, Kadmon bi,

english_verse: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaites,
translation_verse: Hit bi, Periz bi, Refaim bi,

english_verse: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Amor bi, Kanaan bi, Girgash bi, kɛ Yebus bi a zugba a i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Abram's wife Sarai had not been able to have any children. But she owned a young Egyptian slave woman named Hagar,
translation_verse: Abram yo Sarai ɔ fɔ we ha lɛ. Se e ngɛ mawayo ko nɛ je Egipt. A tsɛɛ lɛ Hagar.

english_verse: and Sarai said to Abram, “The Lord has not given me any children. Sleep with my slave, and if she has a child, it will be mine.” Abram agreed,
translation_verse: Sarai de Abram ke, “Yawɛ tsi ye fɔmi nya. Ngɔɔ ye mawayo nɛ ɔ nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ hwɔ; alini e ma fɔ bimɛ ha mi.” Abram kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de lɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: and Sarai gave him Hagar to be his wife. This happened after Abram had lived in the land of Canaan for ten years.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Sarai ngɔ e mawayo Hagar, Egipt no ɔ ngɔ ha e huno Abram kaa e yo. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Abram na jeha nyɔngma momo ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Later, when Hagar knew she was going to have a baby, she became proud and treated Sarai hatefully.
translation_verse: Abram kɛ Hagar na bɔmi, nɛ e ngɔ hɔ. Benɛ Hagar na kaa mi ba e he pɛ, e bɔni e he nɔ womi ngɛ Sarai nɔ, nɛ e bui lɛ hu.

english_verse: Then Sarai said to Abram, “It's all your fault! I gave you my slave woman, but she has been hateful to me ever since she found out she was pregnant. You have done me wrong, and you will have to answer to the Lord for this.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Sarai de Abram ke, “Mo lɛ o pee loko Hagar ngɛ e he nɔ woe ngɛ ye nɔ, nɛ e pa bui mi hu ɔ nɛ. Imi nitsɛ lɛ i ngɔ lɛ kɛ ha mo. Se kɛ je benɛ e na kaa mi ba e he ɔ, e bɔni e he nɔ womi ngɛ ye nɔ, nɛ e bui mi hu. Yawɛ nɛ kojo wɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da, mo jio, imi jio!”

english_verse: Abram said, “All right! She's your slave—do whatever you want with her.” Then Sarai began treating Hagar so harshly that she finally ran away.
translation_verse: Abram he nɔ ke, “Saminya! O mawayo ji lɛ; e ngɛ o dɛ mi. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ kaa o maa pee lɛ ɔ, pee lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Sarai doo Hagar nya wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ Hagar tu fo kɛ je e he.

english_verse: Hagar stopped to rest at a spring in the desert on the road to Shur. While she was there, the angel of the Lord came to her
translation_verse: Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ kɛ Hagar kpe ngɛ pa ko nya, ngɛ Shur blɔ ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: and asked, “Hagar, where have you come from, and where are you going?” She answered, “I'm running away from Sarai, my owner.”
translation_verse: nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Hagar, Sarai mawayo, jije o je, nɛ jije o yaa?” E he nɔ ke, “I tu fo kɛ je ye nyɛ Sarai he.”

english_verse: The angel said, “Go back to Sarai and be her slave.
translation_verse: Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Kpale o se kɛ ya e ngɔ, nɛ o ya ba o he si ha lɛ.”

english_verse: I will give you a son, who will be called Ishmael, because I have heard your cry for help. And someday I will give you so many descendants that no one will be able to count them all.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, mi ngɛ o he; o ma fɔ binyumu, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Ishmael, ejakaa Yawɛ nu o we amanehlu kue fami ɔ.

english_verse: Hagar thought, “Have I really seen God and lived to tell about it?” So from then on she called him, “The God Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Hagar bi e he ke, “Anɛ i na Mawu niinɛ, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ lo?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ Yawɛ nɛ kɛ lɛ ba tu munyu ɔ ke, “Mawu nɛ hyɛɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: That's why people call the well between Kadesh and Bered, “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a tsɛɛ vu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Kadesh kɛ Bered a kpɛti ɔ ke “Hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ mi ɔ vu” ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I will keep my solemn promise to you and give you more descendants than can be counted.”
translation_verse: I kɛ mo maa so, nɛ ma ha o nina maa hiɛ babauu nitsɛ.”

english_verse: Abram bowed with his face to the ground, and God said:
translation_verse: Abram kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si; nɛ Mawu de lɛ ke,

english_verse: I promise that you will be the father of many nations. So now I'm changing your name from Abram to Abraham.
translation_verse: A be mo tsɛe ke Abram hu; jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma tsɛ mo Abraham, ejakaa i pee mo je mahi babauu a tsɛ.

english_verse: I will give you a lot of descendants, and they will become great nations. Some of them will even be kings.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ o nina maa hiɛ babauu, nɛ a ma ba pee je mahi, nɛ matsɛmɛ po maa je a mi.

english_verse: I will always keep the promise I have made to you and your descendants, because I am your God and their God.
translation_verse: “Si nɛ i wo mo nɛ ɔ maa pee neneene somi; ma ye nɔ ha mo kɛ yaa si yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ o se ɔ a nɔ. Ma pee o Mawu kɛ o nina hu a Mawu.

english_verse: I will give you and them the land in which you are now a foreigner. I will give the whole land of Canaan to your family forever, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ o ba to nubwɔ ngɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ ha mo, kɛ o nina. Kanaan zugba a tsuo maa pee o nina nɔ́ kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ ma pee a Mawu.”

english_verse: Abraham, you and all future members of your family must promise to obey me.
translation_verse: Mawu de Abraham ekohu ke, “Moo lɛɛ o kɛ o nina nɛ maa ba ngɛ o se ɔ, nyɛɛ ye somi nɛ i kɛ mo so ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Any man who isn't circumcised hasn't kept his part of the promise and cannot be one of my people.
translation_verse: Nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ a pui lɛ ɔ, a je lɛ we nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ piɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he hu, ejakaa e yi ye somi ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: Abraham, from now on your wife's name will be Sarah instead of Sarai.
translation_verse: Mawu de Abraham ekohu ke, “O yo ɔ, ko tsɛ lɛ Sarai hu; kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, e biɛ ji Sara,

english_verse: I will bless her, and you will have a son by her. She will become the mother of nations, and some of her descendants will even be kings.
translation_verse: Ma gbaa lɛ, nɛ ma ha e ma fɔ binyumu ha mo. Ma gbaa lɛ nɛ e maa pee je mahi a nyɛ, nɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ma ba pee matsɛmɛ.”

english_verse: Then he asked God, “Why not let Ishmael inherit what you have promised me?”
translation_verse: Abraham de Mawu ke, “I na nɛ o ha Ishmael ba pee nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye ní!”

english_verse: But God answered: No! You and Sarah will have a son. His name will be Isaac, and I will make an everlasting promise to him and his descendants.
translation_verse: Se Mawu he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, o yo Sara ma fɔ binyumu ha mo, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Isak. Ma ye ye somi ɔ nɔ kɛ ha lɛ kɛ e nina kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: However, I have heard what you asked me to do for Ishmael, and so I will also bless him with many descendants. He will be the father of twelve princes, and I will make his family a great nation.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ o bi kɛ ha Ishmael ɔ hu i nu; ma gbaa lɛ, nɛ ma ha e ma fɔ bimɛ, nɛ e ma na nina babauu nitsɛ. E maa pee matsɛbinyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ a tsɛ, nɛ ma ha e nina ma ba pee je ma agbo.

english_verse: But your son Isaac will be born about this time next year, and the promise I am making to you and your family will be for him and his descendants forever.
translation_verse: Se o binyumu Isak nɛ Sara ma fɔ ha mo hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha a, ma ma ye somi ɔ nɔ mi ha lɛ.”

english_verse: God finished speaking to Abraham and then left.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu kɛ Abraham tu munyu ta a, Mawu je e he.

english_verse: On that same day Abraham obeyed God by circumcising Ishmael. Abraham was also circumcised, and so were all the other men and boys in his household, including his servants and slaves. He was
translation_verse: kɛ nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ; nyɔguɛhi nɛ a fɔ ngɛ we ɔ mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he ngɛ nibwɔhi a dɛ tsuo a po mɛ tsuo kulaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: One hot summer afternoon while Abraham was sitting by the entrance to his tent near the sacred trees of Mamre, the Lord appeared to him.
translation_verse: Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Abraham ngɛ Mamre tso ngua amɛ a he. Bɔ nɛ e ba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ligbi ko benɛ pu nya wa ngmangmaangma nɛ Abraham hii si ngɛ e bo tsu sinya a nya,

english_verse: Abraham went quickly to his tent and said to Sarah, “Hurry! Get a large sack of flour and make some bread.”
translation_verse: Abraham he sɔ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho bo tsu ɔ mi ya. E ya de Sara ke, “Ngɔɔ o mamu kpakpa a; pɔtɔ lɛ nɛ o kɛ sã abolo ha ni etɛ esɔ!”

english_verse: After saying this, he rushed off to his herd of cattle and picked out one of the best calves, which his servant quickly prepared.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Abraham sa fo kɛ ya sɛ na amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e nu na bɔbɔyoo ko nɛ wo zɔ. E kɛ lɛ ha e tsɔlɔ ko, nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ hu kɛ na a ya pee niye ní nɔuu.

english_verse: He then served his guests some yogurt and milk together with the meat. While they were eating, he stood near them under the tree,
translation_verse: Abraham ngɔ nyami, kɛ na nyɔ nyu kɛ piɛ niye ní nɛ e kɛ na bi ɔ pee ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ ya ma nyumu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ tso ɔ sisi; nɛ e da si ngɛ a kasa nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ye.

english_verse: and they asked, “Where's your wife Sarah?” “She is right there in the tent,” Abraham answered.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyumu ɔmɛ bi Abraham ke, “Jije o yo Sara ngɛ?” E he nɔ ke, “E ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Abraham and Sarah were very old, and Sarah was well past the age for having children.
translation_verse: Abraham kɛ Sara tsuo bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ Sara nine kumi se po.

english_verse: So she laughed and said to herself, “Now that I am worn out and my husband is old, will I really know such happiness?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Sara muɔ nɛ e bi e he ke, “Be nɛ ɔ mi nɛ i bwɔ, nɛ ye huno hu bwɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma pa na ngɔɔmi ko ngɛ yo kɛ nyumu a buami mi lo?”

english_verse: The Lord asked Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh? Does she doubt that she can have a child in her old age?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bi Abraham ke, “Mɛni he je Sara muɔ nɛ e bi ke, ‘Anɛ imi yomoyo nɛ ɔ, ma fɔ niinɛ lo?’ ɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord! There is nothing too difficult for me. I'll come back next year at the time I promised, and Sarah will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Anɛ nɔ́ ko peemi wa ha Yawɛ lo? Kaa bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha a, ma kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu; nɛ o yo Sara ma fɔ binyumu.”

english_verse: Sarah was so frightened that she lied and said, “I didn't laugh.” “Yes, you did!” he answered. Abraham Prays for Sodom
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Sara ngɛ gbeye yee he je ɔ, e ye lakpa ke, “I muɛ”. Se Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “O muɔ!” Abraham kpa pɛɛ ha Sodom

english_verse: When the three men got ready to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked part of the way with them.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nyumu ɔmɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ yaa Sodom blɔ. Abraham kɛ mɛ ho konɛ e ya je mɛ blɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to himself, “I should tell Abraham what I am going to do,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de e he ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i yaa pee nɛ ɔ, i kɛ be Abraham laae.

english_verse: since his family will become a great and powerful nation that will be a blessing to all the other nations on earth.
translation_verse: E nina ma ba pee je ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ a he maa wa, nɛ ma gu e nɔ kɛ gbaa je ma amɛ tsuo.

english_verse: I have chosen him to teach his family to obey me forever and to do what is right and fair. If they do, I will give Abraham many descendants, just as I promised.”
translation_verse: I hla Abraham, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e fa e bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ e nina a nɛ a bu mi tue, nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ nɛ hi. Ke a pee ja a, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i wo lɛ si kaa ma pee ha lɛ ɔ, ma pee.”

english_verse: ?” “Because of them, I won't destroy the city,” was the Lord's answer.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Abraham ke, “I nu Sodom kɛ Gomora he sane yaya babauu nitsɛ, kaa a yayami ɔ nya wa.

english_verse: Now I am going down to see for myself if those people really are that bad. If they aren't, I would like to know.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma ya hyɛ kaa níhi nɛ i nu ngɛ a he ɔ, e ngɛ mi ja, loo e be mi.”

english_verse: And Abraham asked him, “Lord, when you destroy the evil people, are you also going to destroy those who are good?
translation_verse: Abraham hɛ lɛ kɛ su Yawɛ he, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o ma kpata dali kɛ nimli yayamihi tsuo a hɛ mi kɛ bla niinɛ lo?

english_verse: Abraham answered, “I am nothing more than the dust of the earth. Please forgive me, Lord, for daring to speak to you like this.
translation_verse: Abraham tu munyu ekohu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ kɛ pa mi kaa ma da o hɛ mi kɛ tu munyu. Zu kɛ la zu kɛkɛ ji mi, nɛ i be he blɔ nɛ i deɔ nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: After speaking with Abraham, the Lord left, and Abraham went back home.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yawɛ kɛ Abraham tu munyu gbe nya a, Yawɛ je e he, nɛ Abraham hu kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.

english_verse: That evening, while Lot was sitting near the city gate, the two angels arrived in Sodom. When Lot saw them, he got up, bowed down low,
translation_verse: Benɛ Yawɛ bɔfo enyɔ ɔmɛ ba su Sodom jamɛ a gbɔkuɛ ɔ, Lot hii si ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ nya. Benɛ e na mɛ pɛ, e te si nɛ e ya kpee mɛ. E kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si,

english_verse: and said, “Gentlemen, I am your servant. Please come to my home. You can wash your feet, spend the night, and be on your way in the morning.” They told him, “No, we'll spend the night in the city square.”
translation_verse: nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛmɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ gba ye we ɔ mi nɛ nyɛ ba to mi. Nyɛ ba fɔ nyɛ nanehi a he nɛ nyɛɛ hwɔ hiɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ te si makɛ nɛ nyɛ tsa nyɛ nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ.” Se a he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, wa maa hwɔ ma nɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: But Lot kept insisting, until they finally agreed and went home with him. He quickly baked some bread, cooked a meal, and they ate.
translation_verse: Lot kɛ mɛ tu munyu hluu kɛ ya si a kplɛɛ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ho e we ɔ mi ya. Lot ha a sã abolo kplolo nɛ a kɛ pee niye ní ha nibwɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ a ye.

english_verse: Before Lot and his guests could go to bed, every man in Sodom, young and old, came and stood outside his house
translation_verse: Benɛ nibwɔ ɔmɛ na we nɛ a hwɔ si lolo ɔ, Sodom nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo, nihewi, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi ba bɔle we ɔ kɛ kpe.

english_verse: and started shouting, “Where are your visitors? Send them out, so we can have sex with them!”
translation_verse: A tsɛ Lot nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ba to mo gbɔkuɛ nɛ ɔ, jije a ngɛ? Je mɛ kpo ha wɔ nɛ waa kɛ mɛ nɛ hwɔ!”

english_verse: Lot went outside and shut the door behind him.
translation_verse: Lot je kpo kɛ ba a ngɔ, nɛ e ngmɛ sinya a mi,

english_verse: Then he said, “Friends, please don't do such a terrible thing!
translation_verse: nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ ko pee nɔ́ yayami ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ!

english_verse: I have two daughters who have never had sex. I'll bring them out, and you can do what you want with them. But don't harm these men. They are guests in my home.”
translation_verse: I ngɛ biyihi enyɔ nɛ li nyumu. Ma je mɛ kpo ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pee mɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ. Nyumu nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ko pee mɛ nɔ́ ko; ye nibwɔhi ji mɛ, nɛ e sa kaa ma baa a yi.”

english_verse: “Don't get in our way,” the crowd answered. “You're a foreigner. What right do you have to order us around? We'll do worse things to you than we're going to do to them.” The crowd kept arguing with Lot. Finally, they rushed toward the door to break it down.
translation_verse: Se a de ke, “Moo je lejɛ! Mo nubwɔ ɔ, mo lɛ o maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ peemi lo? Ke o ha we wɔ blɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wa maa pee mo ɔ nya maa wa pe a nɔ́ ɔ po!” A tsitsɛɛ Lot kɛ ya se, nɛ a hɛ mɛ kɛ ba a hɛ mi, konɛ a ba ywia sinya a.

english_verse: But the two angels in the house reached out and pulled Lot safely inside.
translation_verse: Se nyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ gbla Lot kɛ wo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a ngmɛ sinya a mi.

english_verse: Then they struck blind everyone in the crowd, and none of them could even find the door.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya a tsuo a hɛ yu, nɛ a nɛ tsu ɔ nya blɔ hu. Lot je Sodom

english_verse: The two angels said to Lot, “The Lord has heard many terrible things about the people of Sodom, and he has sent us here to destroy the city. Take your family and leave. Take every relative you have in the city, as well as the men your daughters are going to marry.”
translation_verse: ejakaa wa yaa kpata ma a hɛ mi. Yawɛ nu ma nɛ ɔ mi a he sane yayamihi babauu nitsɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ wɔ konɛ wa ba kpata Sodom hɛ mi.”

english_verse: Lot went to the men who were engaged to his daughters and said, “Hurry up and get out of here! The Lord is going to destroy this city.” But they thought he was joking, and they laughed at him.
translation_verse: Lot je kpo nɛ e ya de e ngatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ba bi e biyi ɔmɛ a si ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ pee esɔ nɛ nyɛɛ je hiɛ ɔ; Yawɛ yaa kpata ma a hɛ mi.” Se e pee e ngatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe e kɛ mɛ ngɛ fiɛe.

english_verse: Early the next morning the two angels tried to make Lot hurry and leave. They said, “Take your wife and your two daughters and get away from here as fast as you can! If you don't, every one of you will be killed when the Lord destroys the city.”
translation_verse: Makɛ ɔ, bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ he hiami de Lot ke, “Tee si esɔ, nɛ o kɛ o yo ɔ, kɛ o biyihi enyɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ je hiɛ ɔ; ke nyɛ pee we ja, nɛ a gbla ma a tue ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.”

english_verse: At first, Lot just stood there. But the Lord wanted to save him. So the angels took Lot, his wife, and his two daughters by the hand and led them out of the city.
translation_verse: Lot bɔni tsle tomi. Se akɛnɛ Yawɛ na lɛ mɔbɔ he je ɔ, nyumu ɔmɛ ya nu e kɛ e yo ɔ, kɛ e biyi ɔmɛ a nine si pani nya, nɛ a gbla mɛ kɛ je ma a mi.

english_verse: When they were outside, one of the angels said, “Run for your lives! Don't even look back. And don't stop in the valley. Run to the hills, where you'll be safe.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de ke, “Nyɛɛ tu fo esɔesɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ he nyɛ yi wami! Nyɛ ko plɛ nyɛ se, nɛ nyɛ ko da si ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi he ko he ko. Nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ ho yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ko kpata.”

english_verse: Lot answered, “You have done us a great favor, sir. You have saved our lives, but please don't make us go to the hills. That's too far away. The city will be destroyed before we can get there, and we will be killed when it happens.
translation_verse: O na mi mɔbɔ agbo, nɛ o he ye yi wami. Se yoku ɔmɛ a he kɛ tsɔ; sane yobu ma ya ye mi, nɛ ye yi maa ta ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ loko ma su lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: There's a town near here. It's only a small place, but my family and I will be safe, if you let us go there.”
translation_verse: O nɛ, ma bɔbɔyoo ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, e kɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ we kulaa. Ha ma tu fo ya sa we ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E ji ma bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ, nɛ ye yi ma na wami ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: “All right, go there,” he answered. “I won't destroy that town.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Saminya, i kplɛɛ. I be jamɛ a ma a hɛ mi kpatae.

english_verse: Hurry! Run! I can't do anything until you are safely there.” The town was later called Zoar because Lot had said it was small. Sodom and Gomorrah Are Destroyed
translation_verse: Tuu fo kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ esɔ! I be nɔ́ ko pee kaa ja o ya su lejɛ ɔ lolo.” Akɛnɛ Lot de ke ma bɔbɔyoo ji ma a he je ɔ, a wo ma a biɛ ke Zoar. A kpata Sodom kɛ Gomora a hɛ mi

english_verse: The sun was coming up as Lot reached the town of Zoar,
translation_verse: Benɛ Lot su Zoar a, pu gba.

english_verse: and the Lord sent burning sulfur down like rain on Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, Yawɛ ha nɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege je hiɔwe pue Sodom kɛ Gomora a nɔ.

english_verse: He destroyed those cities and everyone who lived in them, as well as their land and the trees and grass that grew there.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yawɛ kpata ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔ, kɛ nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ puɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: On the way, Lot's wife looked back and was turned into a block of salt.
translation_verse: Se Lot yo ɔ plɛ hyɛ e se, nɛ e plɛ pee ngo kpɔ.

english_verse: That same morning Abraham got up and went to the place where he had stood and spoken with the Lord.
translation_verse: E nɔ jena mɔtu kpla a, Abraham kpale kɛ ho he nɛ e da si ngɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ ya.

english_verse: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and saw smoke rising from all over the land—it was like a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: E hyɛ Sodom kɛ Gomora, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ e na la su ku nɛ ngɛ zugba a jee kaa flɔɔnɔɔ nguaa ko mi la su ku.

english_verse: Lot was afraid to stay on in Zoar. So he took his two daughters and moved to a cave in the hill country.
translation_verse: Lot ye gbeye kaa e maa hi Zoar, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ e biyi enyɔ ɔmɛ hia kɛ ho yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ya nɛ a ya hi tɛ puɔ ko mi.

english_verse: One day his older daughter said to her sister, “Our father is old, and there are no men anywhere for us to marry.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e bi Dede ɔ de e senɔ ɔ ke, “Wa tsɛ bwɔ, nɛ nyumuhi be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ wɔ konɛ wa fɔ bimɛ.

english_verse: The next day the older daughter said to her sister, “I slept with my father last night. We'll get him drunk again tonight, so you can sleep with him, and we can each have a child.”
translation_verse: E nɔ jena a, Dede ɔ de e senɔ ɔ ke, “Hiɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, i kɛ tsaatsɛ ya hwɔ. Ha nɛ wa ha lɛ dã ekohu nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ mo hu o kɛ lɛ ya hwɔ, konɛ wɔ tsuo waa kɛ wa tsɛ nɛ fɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ weku kpa a se ko po.”

english_verse: The older daughter named her son Moab, and he is the ancestor of the Moabites.
translation_verse: Dede ɔ ba fɔ binyumu, nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Moab. Lɛ ji mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ Moab bi ɔmɛ a nɛ̃.

english_verse: The younger daughter named her son Benammi, and he is the ancestor of the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Kɔkɔ ɔ hu ba fɔ binyumu, nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Benami. Lɛ ji mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ Amon bi ɔmɛ a nɛ̃.

english_verse: he told everyone that his wife Sarah was his sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
translation_verse: nɛ lej ɔ, Abrahamde ke e nyɛmiyo ji e yo Sara a nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Gerar matsɛ, Abimelek tsɔ nɛ a ya tsɛ Sara ba ha lɛ.

english_verse: But God came to Abimelech in a dream and said, “You have taken a married woman into your home, and for this you will die!”
translation_verse: Ligbi ko nyɔ mi ɔ, Mawu je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Abimelek ngɛ nlami mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Akɛnɛ o ya ngɔ yo nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o ma gbo; nɔ ko yo ji lɛ.”

english_verse: Abimelech said to the Lord, “Don't kill me! I haven't slept with Sarah. Didn't they say they were brother and sister? I am completely innocent.”
translation_verse: Abraham nitsɛ nɛ e de ke e nyɛmiyo ji yo ɔ. Yo ɔ nitsɛ hu de ke e nyɛminyumu ji Abraham. Nɔ́ nɛ i pee nɛ ɔ je ye tsui mi faa, nɛ ye he nile bui mi fɔ.”

english_verse: Her husband is a prophet. Let her go back to him, and his prayers will save you from death. But if you don't return her, you and all your people will die.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, ngɔɔ yo ɔ kɛ ya ha e huno. E huno ɔ, gbalɔ ji lɛ; e ma kpa pɛɛ ha mo, konɛ o ko gbo. Se ke o kpale we yo ɔ kɛ ya ha we e huno ɔ, lɛɛ i ngɛ mo dee ke, o kɛ o weku li tsuo nyɛ ma gbo!”

english_verse: Early the next morning Abimelech sent for his officials, and when he told them what had happened, they were frightened.
translation_verse: Abimelek te si mɔtu kpla, nɛ e tsɔ ya kpee e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ. E bɔ mɛ amaniɛ ngɛ e nlami ɔ he, nɛ mɛ tsuo a nu sawale.

english_verse: Abimelech then called in Abraham and said: Look what you've done to us! What have I ever done to you? Why did you make me and my nation guilty of such a terrible sin?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Abimelek tsɔ ya tsɛ Abraham kɛ ba, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o pee wɔ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni yayami i pee mo loko o ha amanehlu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba i kɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ wa nɔ ɔ? Nɔ́ nɛ a pee we nɔ nɛ o pee mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: What were you thinking when you did this?
translation_verse: Mɛni o susu loko o pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Abraham answered: I did it because I didn't think any of you respected God, and I was sure that someone would kill me to get my wife.
translation_verse: Abraham he nɔ ke, “Jinɛ i susu kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye; i susu kaa ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa gbe mi, nɛ a ma kpɔ ye yo ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ.

english_verse: Besides, she is my half sister. We have the same father, but different mothers.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ye yo ɔ, imi nitsɛ ye nyɛmi ji lɛ. Tsaatsɛ bi ji lɛ, se pi maa bi, nɛ e ba pee ye yo.

english_verse: After Abimelech had given Abraham some sheep, cattle, and slaves, he sent Sarah back
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abimelek kpale Sara ya ha Abraham ekohu, nɛ e ke lɛ tohi, nahi, kɛ nyɔguɛhi nyumuhi kɛ yihi ngɔ piɛ he.

english_verse: The Lord was good to Sarah and kept his promise.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbaa Sara kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ.

english_verse: Although Abraham was very old, Sarah had a son exactly at the time God had said.
translation_verse: Sara ba na mi, nɛ e fɔ binyumuyo ha Abraham benɛ Abraham bwɔ ɔ, ngɛ be nɛ Mawu de to ɔ mi.

english_verse: Abraham named his son Isaac,
translation_verse: Abraham wo lɛ biɛ ke Isak,

english_verse: and when the boy was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, just as God had commanded.
translation_verse: nɛ benɛ Isak ye ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ, Abraham po lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu fa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. And now everyone will laugh with me.
translation_verse: Sara de ke, “Mawu ha nɛ muɔ ba ye nya he jehanɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu he ɔ, e kɛ mi maa muɔ.

english_verse: Who would have dared to tell Abraham that someday I would have a child? But in his old age, I have given him a son.”
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ma de Abraham, be ko nɛ be ɔ, ke Sara ma ba ha bi nyɔ? Se i fɔ binyumu ha lɛ ngɛ e bwɔmi be mi.”

english_verse: The time came when Sarah no longer had to nurse Isaac, and on that day Abraham gave a big feast. Hagar and Ishmael Are Sent Away
translation_verse: Jokuɛ ɔ ba wa, nɛ a tsɔ lɛ nyɔ. Ligbi ɔ nɛ a tsɔ Isak nyɔ ɔ, Abraham ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngua ko. Abraham wo Hagar kɛ Ishmael blɔ

english_verse: One day, Sarah noticed Hagar's son Ishmael playing, and she said to Abraham, “Get rid of that Egyptian slave woman and her son! I don't want him to inherit anything. It should all go to my son.”
translation_verse: Sara de Abraham ke, “Fie nyɔguɛ yo nɛ ɔ kɛ e binyumu ɔ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ. Yo nɛ ɔ binyumu ɔ kɛ ye bi Isak be ní dlae.”

english_verse: But God said, “Abraham, don't worry about your slave woman and the boy. Just do what Sarah tells you. Isaac will inherit your family name,
translation_verse: Se Mawu de Abraham ke, “Koo hao o he ngɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ kɛ o nyɔguɛ yo Hagar a he. Pee kaa bɔ nɛ Sara de mo ɔ, ejakaa Isak nɔ lɛ nina nɛ i wo mo si ke ma ha mo ɔ maa gu kɛ ba.

english_verse: but the son of the slave woman is also your son, and I will make his descendants into a great nation.”
translation_verse: Nyɔguɛ yo ɔ binyumu ɔ, lɛ hu ma ha lɛ bimɛ babauu nɛ a ma ba pee ma; ejakaa lɛ hu o bi ji lɛ.”

english_verse: Early the next morning Abraham gave Hagar an animal skin full of water and some bread. Then he put the boy on her shoulder and sent them away. They wandered around in the desert near Beersheba,
translation_verse: E nɔ jena mɔtu kpla a, Abraham ha Hagar niye ní, kɛ lohwe he womi tɔ nɛ nyu hyi lɛ. E ngɔ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ kɛ wo Hagar se mi, nɛ e wo lɛ blɔ. Hagar je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ya wo lalaalo ngɛ Beersheba nga a nɔ.

english_verse: and after they had run out of water, Hagar put her son under a bush.
translation_verse: Benɛ nyu ɔ ta tɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Hagar ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ ya fɔ tso ko sisi,

english_verse: When God heard the boy crying, the angel of God called out to Hagar from heaven and said, “Hagar, why are you worried? Don't be afraid. I have heard your son crying.
translation_verse: Mawu nu nɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ ngɛ ya foe, nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ kɛ Hagar tu munyu kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ e de ke, “Hagar, mɛni sane? Koo ye gbeye. Mawu nu nɛ jokuɛyo ɔ ngɛ ya foe ngɛ he nɛ e hwɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Help him up and hold his hand, because I will make him the father of a great nation.”
translation_verse: Tee si nɛ o ya wo lɛ kɛ fɔ o gugue mi, ejakaa ma ha nɛ e nina ma ba pee ma agbo.”

english_verse: Then God let her see a well. So she went to the well and filled the skin with water, then gave some to her son.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bli Hagar hɛngmɛ nɛ e na vu ko. E ho nɛ e ya yɛ nyu kɛ wo lohwe he womi tɔ ɔ mi nɛ e hyi, nɛ e ha e bi ɔ nyu ɔ eko nɛ e nu.

english_verse: God blessed Ishmael, and as the boy grew older, he became an expert at hunting with his bow and arrows. He lived in the Paran Desert, and his mother chose an Egyptian woman for him to marry. A Peace Treaty
translation_verse: Mawu gbaa jokuɛ ɔ nɛ e ba wa. E hi Paran nga a nɔ, nɛ e ba pee detsɛ kpanaa. E nyɛ hla yo ha lɛ kɛ je Egipt, nɛ e ngɔ. Abraham kɛ Abimelek ka a he kita

english_verse: About this time Abimelech and his army commander Phicol said to Abraham, “God blesses everything you do!
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Abimelek kɛ e tatsɛ Fikol ba Abraham ngɔ. Abimelek de Abraham ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, Mawu piɛɔ o he.

english_verse: Now I want you to promise in the name of God that you will always be loyal to me and my descendants, just as I have always been loyal to you in this land where you have lived as a foreigner.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ka mi kita ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa o be imi, aloo ye bimɛ, aloo ye nina sisie kɔkɔɔkɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ mo hi si saminya a, mo hu o kɛ imi, kɛ zugba a nɛ o ba to nubwɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ hi si ja nɔuu.”

english_verse: And so, Abraham promised he would.
translation_verse: Abraham he nɔ ke, “I ka kita kaa ma pee ja.”

english_verse: One day, Abraham told Abimelech, “Some of your servants have taken over one of my wells.”
translation_verse: Abraham kɛ Abimelek tu munyu ngɛ vu ko nɛ lɛ Abimelek ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba kpɔ pani nya a he.

english_verse: “This is the first I've heard about it,” Abimelech replied. “Why haven't you said something before? I don't have any idea who did it.”
translation_verse: Abimelek de lɛ ke, “I li nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. O wui nɔ ta hyɛ nɛ ma nu; kekleekle nɛ i ngɛ nue ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham gave Abimelech some sheep and cattle, then the two men made a peace treaty.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abraham ke Abimelek to kɛ na, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ ka a he kita.

english_verse: Abraham separated seven female lambs from his flock of sheep,
translation_verse: Abraham je jijɔ kpaago ngɛ e to ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to he kake.

english_verse: Abraham replied, “I want you to accept these seven lambs as proof that I dug this well.”
translation_verse: Abraham he nɔ ke, “Mo he jijɔ kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ye dɛ, nɛ e pee odase kaa imi nɛ i je vu nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: When the treaty was completed, Abimelech and his army commander Phicol went back to the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Benɛ Abraham kɛ Abimelek ka a he kita ngɛ Beersheba gbe nya a, Abimelek kɛ e tatsɛ Fikol kpale a se kɛ ho Filistia ya.

english_verse: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and worshiped the eternal Lord God.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abraham du tso ngua ko ngɛ Beersheba, nɛ e ja Yawɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ daa a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Some years later God decided to test Abraham, so he spoke to him. Abraham answered, “Here I am, Lord.”
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Mawu ka Abraham. Mawu tsɛ Abraham ke, “Abraham!” Nɛ Abraham he nɔ ke, “Ne mi!”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Go get Isaac, your only son, the one you dearly love! Take him to the land of Moriah, and I will show you a mountain where you must sacrifice him to me on the fires of an altar.”
translation_verse: Mawu de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ o binyumu Isak, o bi kake too ɔ nɛ o suɔ lɛ saminya a, nɛ o ya Moria zugba a nɔ. Ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ ya sã sami bɔ ha mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ yo ko nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: So Abraham got up early the next morning and chopped wood for the fire. He put a saddle on his donkey and set out with Isaac and two servants for the place where God had told him to go.
translation_verse: Abraham te si mɔtu kpla nɛ e poo lɛ́ nɛ e kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ. E wo e teji ɔ nɔ ní, nɛ e ngɔ Isak kɛ tsɔli enyɔ ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ e kɛ mɛ pue blɔ kɛ ho he nɛ Mawu tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ ya.

english_verse: Three days later Abraham looked off in the distance and saw the place.
translation_verse: Ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Abraham na lejɛ ɔ mane jee.

english_verse: He told his servants, “Stay here with the donkey, while my son and I go over there to worship. We will come back.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kɛ teji ɔ nɛ mlɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. I kɛ jokuɛ ɔ yaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ wa ya ja Mawu, lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wa maa kpale ba na nyɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ekohu.”

english_verse: Abraham put the wood on Isaac's shoulder, but he carried the hot coals and the knife. As the two of them walked along,
translation_verse: Abraham ngɔ lɛ́ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ ngɔ tloo Isak, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e hɛɛ ha kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma slɛ la a. Benɛ a nyɛɛ kɛ yaa a,

english_verse: Isaac said, “Father, we have the coals and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice?” “My son,” Abraham answered, “God will provide the lamb.” The two of them walked on, and
translation_verse: Abraham he nɔ ke, “Ye bi, Mawu nitsɛ ma je jijɔ ha wɔ nɛ wa kɛ sã sami bɔ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a tsa nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ kɛ ho.

english_verse: when they reached the place that God had told him about, Abraham built an altar and placed the wood on it. Next, he tied up his son and put him on the wood.
translation_verse: Benɛ a su he nɛ Mawu tsɔɔ Abraham ɔ, Abraham ma bɔ sami la tɛ, nɛ e to lɛ́ ɔ ngɔ pue nɔ. E fi e bi Isak, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ lɛ́ ɔ nɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: He then took the knife and got ready to kill his son.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ̃ ha a konɛ e kɛ gbe e bi ɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord's angel shouted from heaven, “Abraham! Abraham!” “Here I am!” he answered.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ tsɛ lɛ kɛ je hiɔwe ke, “Abraham! Abraham!” Abraham he nɔ ke, “Ne mi.”

english_verse: “Don't hurt the boy or harm him in any way!” the angel said. “Now I know that you truly obey God, because you were willing to offer him your only son.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “O nine nɛ ko sa niheyo ɔ he; koo pee lɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. Jehanɛ lɛɛ i na kaa o yeɔ Mawu gbeye, ejakaa o bi kake too ɔ he nɔ́ dɔɛ mo kaa o kɛ lɛ ma ha Mawu.”

english_verse: Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught by its horns in the bushes. So he took the ram and sacrificed it instead of his son.
translation_verse: Benɛ Abraham po e hɛ nɛ e hyɛ ɔ, agbosu ko ji nɛ ɔ ngɛ e se, nɛ e koli lata tso komɛ ngɛ pu ɔ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ e ya nu agbosu ɔ, nɛ e kɛ sã sami bɔ ngɛ e bi ɔ nane mi.

english_verse: Abraham named that place “The Lord Will Provide.” And even now people say, “On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.”
translation_verse: Abraham wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke, “Yawɛ ha.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nihi deɔ ke, “Yawɛ haa nɔ nɔ́ ngɛ e yo ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord's angel called out from heaven a second time:
translation_verse: Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ tsɛ Abraham ekohu si enyɔne ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe,

english_verse: “I will bless you and give you such a large family, that someday your descendants will be more numerous than the stars in the sky or the grains of sand along the seashore. They will defeat their enemies and take over the cities where their enemies live.
translation_verse: imi hu ma gbaa mo, nɛ ma ha o nina maa hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe, loo wo nya zia. O nina maa ye a he nyɛli a nɔ.

english_verse: You have obeyed me, and so you and your descendants will be a blessing to all nations on earth.”
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ tsuo ma bi ke ma gbaa mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i gbaa o nina a, ejakaa o bu mi tue.”

english_verse: Abraham and Isaac went back to the servants who had come with him, and they returned to Abraham's home in Beersheba. The Children of Nahor
translation_verse: Abraham kpale e se kɛ ba e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a pue nɔ kɛ ho Beersheba ya. Nɛ Abraham ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Nahor nina

english_verse: Nahor also had another wife. Her name was Reumah, and she had four sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
translation_verse: Nahor kɛ e plã ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Reuma hu fɔ binyumuhi eywiɛ. A biɛhi ji Teba, Gaham Tahash, kɛ Maaka.

english_verse: “I live as a foreigner in your land, and I don't own any property where I can bury my wife. Please let me buy a piece of land.”
translation_verse: “Nubwɔ ji mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; nyɛ ha mi nyɛ zugba a eko nɛ ma kɛ pee gɔ, konɛ ma pu ye yo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: and replied, “If you are willing to let me bury my wife here, please ask Zohar's son Ephron
translation_verse: nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ suɔ kaa ma pu ye yo ɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Zohar binyumu Efron nɛ tu ha mi,

english_verse: to sell me Machpelah Cave at the end of his field. I'll pay what it's worth, and all of you can be witnesses.”
translation_verse: konɛ e ngɔ Makpela tɛ puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ e zugba a nya a kɛ ha mi. Nyɛ de lɛ nɛ e jua zugba a kɛ ha mi sisiisi ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ ma he nɛ ma kɛ pee gɔ.”

english_verse: “Sir, the whole field, including the cave, is yours. With my own people as witnesses, I freely give it to you as a burial place for your dead.”
translation_verse: “Bu tue, ye nyɔmtsɛ! I ngɔ zugba a tsuo, kɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ kɛ ke mo. I ngɔ kɛ ha mo ngɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ o pu o yo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: So Abraham buried his wife Sarah in Machpelah Cave that was in the field
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abraham ya pu e yo Sara ngɛ jamɛ a tɛ puɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Abraham was now a very old man. The Lord had made him rich, and he was successful in everything he did.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ Abraham bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ Yawɛ gbaa lɛ, nɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ya nɔ.

english_verse: in the name of the Lord, who rules heaven and earth, that you won't choose a wife for my son Isaac from the people here in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: ngɛ Yawɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba Mawu ɔ biɛ mi, kaa o be yo hlae kɛ ha ye binyumu Isak kɛ je Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for him from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, o maa kpale o se kɛ ya zugba nɔ he nɛ a fɔ mi ngɛ ɔ, nɛ o ya hla yo ngɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ba ha ye bi Isak.”

english_verse: But the servant asked, “What if the young woman I choose refuses to leave home and come here with me? Should I send Isaac there to look for a wife?”
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ ɔ bi ke, “Eko ɔ, yo ɔ be kplɛɛe kaa e maa nyɛɛ ye se kɛ ba zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ. Ke e ba mi ja a, lɛɛ ma ngɔ o binyumu ɔ kɛ ya zugba a nɔ he nɛ o je ɔ lo?”

english_verse: “No!” Abraham answered. “Don't ever do that, no matter what.
translation_verse: Abraham he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi! Koo ngɔ ye bi ɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ!

english_verse: The Lord who rules heaven brought me here from the land where I was born and promised that he would give this land to my descendants forever. When you go back there, the Lord will send his angel ahead of you to help you find a wife for my son.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, ngɔ mi kɛ je tsaatsɛ we mi, kɛ ye weku li a zugba nɔ, nɛ e wo mi si ke e kɛ zugba nɛ ɔ ma ha ye nina. Yawɛ nitsɛ maa tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ kɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi nɛ o ma ya hla yo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ba ha ye bi ɔ.

english_verse: If the woman refuses to come along, you don't have to keep this promise. But don't ever take my son back there.”
translation_verse: Ke yo ɔ kplɛɛ we kaa e kɛ mo maa ba a, lɛɛ o tɔ we ye kita nɛ ɔ nɔ. Se ye bi ɔ lɛɛ o kɛ lɛ ko ya lejɛ ɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

english_verse: So the servant gave Abraham his word that he would do everything he had been told to do.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ e nine kɛ wo e nyɔmtsɛ Abraham fiɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛ, nɛ e ka kita kaa e maa pee bɔ nɛ Abraham de lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Soon after that, the servant loaded ten of Abraham's camels with valuable gifts. Then he set out for the city in northern Syria, where Abraham's brother Nahor lived.
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ Abraham weto níhi a nɔ ɔ, ngɔ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we afukpɔngɔ nyɔngma, nɛ e mia mɛ kɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nike ní kpakpa, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Nahor e ma a mi ya, ngɛ Mesopotamia.

english_verse: When he got there, he let the camels rest near the well outside the city. It was late afternoon, the time when the women came out for water.
translation_verse: Gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, e ha afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ bu si ngɛ vu ko he ngɛ ma a nya. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi lɛ yihi jeɔ kpo kɛ ba yɛɔ nyu.

english_verse: The servant prayed: You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships. Please keep your promise to him and let me find a wife for Isaac today.
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ ɔ fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham Mawu! I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ ma ye manye mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ o je o suɔmi kpo ha ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham.

english_verse: and I'll ask one of them for a drink. If she gives me a drink and then offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen and that you have kept your promise to my master.
translation_verse: Ma de a ti nɔ kake ke, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ, moo ba o buɛ ɔ nya si nɛ o ha mi nyu ma nu’. Ke e de mi ke ‘He nyu nɛ o nu, nɛ ma ya yɛ eko ba ha o we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu nɛ a nu’ ɔ, ha jamɛ a yiheyo ɔ nɛ e pee nɔ nɛ o hla kɛ ha o tsɔlɔ Isak. Ke e ba mi ja a, ma le kaa o suɔ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: While he was still praying, a beautiful unmarried young woman came by with a water jar on her shoulder. She was Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his wife Milcah. Rebekah walked past Abraham's servant, then went over to the well, and filled her water jar. When she started back,
translation_verse: Rebeka he ngɛ fɛu saminya. Yomiyo ji lɛ; e li nyumu. E be kɛ ho vu ɔ nya ya ya yɛ nyu kɛ wo e buɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ma.

english_verse: “I'll be glad to,” she answered. Then she quickly took the jar from her shoulder and held it while he drank.
translation_verse: Rebeka he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, mo he nyu nɛ o nu.” Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e ba e buɛ ɔ nya si, nɛ e ha lɛ nyu ɔ eko nɛ e nu.

english_verse: After he had finished, she said, “Now I'll give your camels all the water they want.” She quickly poured out water for them, and she kept going back for more, until his camels had drunk all they wanted.
translation_verse: E he sɔ kɛ plɛ nyu nɛ ngɛ buɛ ɔ mi ɔ kɛ wo lohwe ɔmɛ a nyu numi nɔ́ ɔ mi, nɛ e tu fo kɛ ho vu ɔ he ya ya yɛ nyu kɛ ba ha afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a nu.

english_verse: Abraham's servant did not say a word, but he watched everything Rebekah did, because he wanted to know for certain if this was the woman the Lord had chosen.
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ pee dii kɛ ngɛ lɛ hyɛe kaa e maa na kaa Yawɛ gbaa e blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ye manye lo.

english_verse: The servant had brought along an expensive gold ring and two large gold bracelets. When Rebekah had finished bringing the water, he gave her the ring for her nose and the bracelets for her arms.
translation_verse: Benɛ afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nu nyu ɔ ta a, nyumu ɔ je sika tsu ga ko nɛ he jua wa kpo, nɛ e kɛ wo Rebeka gugwɔ mi. E kɛ sika tsu kɔni si ga agboagbo enyɔ hu wo Rebeka kɔni si.

english_verse: Then he said, “Please tell me who your father is. Does he have room in his house for me and my men to spend the night?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mɛnɔ bi ji mo? Anɛ i kɛ ye we bi ɔmɛ ma na blɔ ngɛ o tsɛ we ɔ mi nɛ waa to lejɛ ɔ lo?”

english_verse: She answered, “My father is Bethuel, the son of Nahor and Milcah.
translation_verse: Rebeka he nɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛ biɛ ji Betuel; Nahor kɛ e yo Milka a bi ji lɛ.

english_verse: We have a place where you and your men can stay, and we also have enough straw and feed for your camels.”
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ nga kɛ lohwehi a niye ní babauu, nɛ he ko hu ngɛ nɛ nyɛ maa to.”

english_verse: Then the servant bowed his head and prayed,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ kpla si nɛ e ja Yawɛ.

english_verse: “I thank you, Lord God of my master Abraham! You have led me to his relatives and kept your promise to him.”
translation_verse: E de ke, “A je Yawɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham Mawu ɔ yi, kaa e na ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ye si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ nɔ. Yawɛ kpaka mi tɛɛ kɛ ba ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ weku li a ngɔ.”

english_verse: Her brother Laban heard her tell what the servant had said, and he saw the ring and the bracelets she was wearing. So Laban ran out to Abraham's servant, who was standing by his camels at the well.
translation_verse: Rebeka ngɛ nyɛminyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Laban. Benɛ Laban na gugwɔ mi ga a, kɛ kɔni si ga amɛ ngɛ e nyɛmiyo ɔ kɔni si, nɛ e nu nɔ́ nɛ nyumu ɔ de lɛ ɔ, e gbɔ fo kɛ ya na nyumu ɔ ngɛ vu ɔ he. Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ daa si ngɛ e we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: Then Laban said, “The Lord has brought you safely here. Come home with me. There's no need for you to keep on standing outside. I have a room ready for you in our house, and there's also a place for your camels.”
translation_verse: Laban de lɛ ke, “Ba nɛ waa ho we mi ya, mo nyumu nɛ Yawɛ gbaa mo! Mɛni he je o daa si ngɛ magbɛ nɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ? I dla tsu ko mi ha mo ngɛ we ɔ mi. O we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu blɔ ngɛ kɛ ha mɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham's servant went home with Laban, where Laban's servants unloaded his camels and gave them straw and feed. Then they brought water into the house, so Abraham's servant and his men could wash their feet.
translation_verse: Laban kɛ nyumu ɔ ba we ɔ mi; e je tlomi ɔmɛ ngɛ afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a se mi, nɛ e ha mɛ nga kɛ niye ni kpa komɛ. E ya yɛ nyu kɛ ba ha Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a fɔ a nanehi a he.

english_verse: After that, they brought in food. But the servant said, “Before I eat, I must tell you why I have come.” “Go ahead and tell us,” Laban answered.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, a kɛ niye ní ba ma Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ hɛ mi. Se e de ke, “I be ní yee; ja i bɔ nyɛ ye nyɛɛmi mi amaniɛ loko ma ye ní.” Laban de lɛ ke, “Yoo, wa hiɛ jɔ.”

english_verse: The servant explained: I am Abraham's servant.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “Abraham tsɔlɔ ji mi.

english_verse: The Lord has been good to my master and has made him very rich. He has given him many sheep, goats, cattle, camels, and donkeys, as well as a lot of silver and gold, and many slaves.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbaa ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ saminya, nɛ e pee lɛ niatsɛ. Yawɛ ha lɛ tohi, nahi, sika hiɔ, sika tsu, kɛ nyɔguɛhi nyumuhi kɛ yihi, afukpɔngɔhi, kɛ tejihi.

english_verse: Sarah, my master's wife, didn't have any children until she was very old. Then she had a son, and my master has given him everything.
translation_verse: Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yo Sara fɔ binyumu ha lɛ benɛ lɛ Sara a bwɔ, nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham ngɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ kɛ ha bi nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I solemnly promised my master that I would do what he said. And he told me, “Don't choose a wife for my son from the women in this land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha nɛ i ka lɛ kita. E de mi ke, ‘Ko hla yo ha ye bi ɔ kɛ je Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for my son from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, yaa tsaatsɛ weku li, kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ o ya hla yo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ha ye bi ɔ.’

english_verse: I asked my master, “What if the young woman refuses to come with me?”
translation_verse: I bi ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, ‘Ke yo ɔ kplɛɛ we kaa e maa nyɛɛ ye se kɛ ba a nɛɛ?’

english_verse: But if they refuse to let her come back with you, then you are freed from your promise.”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ kita nɛ o ka mi ɔ he ɔ, ke o ya ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ a he we mo ɔ, o tɔ we kita.’

english_verse: When I came to the well today, I silently prayed, “You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships, so please lead me to a wife for his son
translation_verse: “Benɛ i ba su vu ɔ he mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham Mawu, ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o ha nɛ ye blɔ nyɛɛmi ɔ nɛ da mi ɔ,

english_verse: while I am here at the well. When a young woman comes out to get water, I'll ask her to give me a drink.
translation_verse: lɛɛ ha nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ i daa si ngɛ vu nɛ ɔ he ɔ, yiheyo ko nɛ ba yɛ nyu. Ke yiheyo ɔ ba a, ma de lɛ ke e ha mi e buɛ ɔ mi nyu ɔ bɔɔ nɛ ma nu.

english_verse: If she gives me a drink and offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen.”
translation_verse: Ke e kplɛɛ, nɛ jehanɛ se hu e de mi ke e maa yɛ nyu ha ye afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a nu ɔ, ha nɛ e pee yo nɛ mo nitsɛ o hla kɛ ha ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔ.’

english_verse: Even before I had finished praying, Rebekah came by with a water jar on her shoulder. When she had filled the jar, I asked her for a drink.
translation_verse: Benɛ i na we nɛ ma gbe ye kue fami nɛ ɔ nya a, Rebeka ba hia kpo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ buɛ ngɛ e konɔ. E be kɛ ho vu ɔ he ya ya yɛ nyu. I de lɛ ke, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha mi nyu bɔɔ nɛ ma nu.’

english_verse: She quickly lowered the jar from her shoulder and said, “Have a drink. Then I'll get water for your camels.” So I drank, and after that she got some water for my camels.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, e ba e buɛ ɔ nya si nɛ e de ke, ‘Ba he nyu nɛ o nu konɛ ma yɛ eko ba ha o we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu nɛ a nu.’ I nu nyu ɔ, nɛ e ya yɛ eko ba ha afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu nɛ a nu.

english_verse: I asked her who her father was, and she answered, “My father is Bethuel the son of Nahor and Milcah.” At once I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms.
translation_verse: I bi lɛ ke, ‘Mɛnɔ bi ji mo?’ Nɛ e he nɔ ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ biɛ ji Betuel, Nahor kɛ e yo Milka a bi ɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i kɛ ga wo e gugwɔ mi nɛ i kɛ kɔni si gahi hu wo e kɔni si.

english_verse: Then I bowed my head and gave thanks to the God my master Abraham worships. The Lord had led me straight to my master's relatives, and I had found a wife for his son.
translation_verse: I kpla si nɛ i ja Yawɛ. I je Yawɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham Mawu ɔ yi kaa e kpaka mi tɛɛ kɛ ba ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ weku no ɔ ngɔ, nɛ i ba na e biyo ɔ nɛ ma ba pee ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔ yo ɔ.

english_verse: Now please tell me if you are willing to do the right thing for my master. Will you treat him fairly, or do I have to look for another young woman?
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ bie ke, anɛ nyɛ ma je nyɛ suɔmi kpo kɛ ha ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lo? Ke nyɛ maa pee ja jio, nyɛ be ja pee jio, nyɛ de mi, konɛ ma na he nɛ ma gu.”

english_verse: Laban and Bethuel answered, “The Lord has done this. We have no choice in the matter.
translation_verse: Laban kɛ Betuel he nɔ ke, “Akɛnɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi sane nɛ ɔ je he je ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be nyɛe ma de he nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Take Rebekah with you; she can marry your master's son, just as the Lord has said.”
translation_verse: O nɛ, Rebeka a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ ho nɛ e ya pee o nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔ yo, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ de ɔ.”

english_verse: Then he gave clothing, as well as silver and gold jewelry, to Rebekah. He also gave expensive gifts to her brother and her mother.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je sika hiɔ, sika tsu, june níhi, kɛ tadehi kpo, nɛ e kɛ ha Rebeka. Jehanɛ, e ha Rebeka nyɛminyumu ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ hu nike níhi nɛ a he jua wa.

english_verse: Abraham's servant and the men with him ate and drank, then spent the night there. The next morning they got up, and the servant told Rebekah's mother and brother, “I would like to go back to my master now.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ye ní nɛ a nu nɔ́ ko, nɛ a hwɔ lejɛ ɔ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi. Mɔtu benɛ a te si ɔ, e de ke, “Nyɛɛ wo mi blɔ nɛ ma kpale kɛ ho ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya.”

english_verse: “Let Rebekah stay with us for a week or ten days,” they answered. “Then she may go.”
translation_verse: Se Rebeka nyɛminyumu ɔ kɛ e nyɛ de ke, “Ha nɛ yiheyo ɔ kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si be bɔɔ, kaa ligbi nyɔngma, loko e ho.”

english_verse: But he said, “Don't make me stay any longer. The Lord has already helped me find a wife for my master's son. Now let us return.”
translation_verse: Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ko tsi ye nya. Yawɛ ha nɛ ye blɔ ɔ da mi; nyɛɛ wo mi blɔ nɛ ma kpale kɛ ho ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya.”

english_verse: They answered, “Let's ask Rebekah what she wants to do.”
translation_verse: A de lɛ ke, “Wa ma tsɛ yiheyo ɔ nɛ wa bi lɛ bɔ nɛ e ma de.”

english_verse: They called her and asked, “Are you willing to leave with this man at once?” “Yes,” she answered.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɛ Rebeka nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o suɔ kaa o kɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ maa ya lo?” E he nɔ ke, “Ee, i suɔ.”

english_verse: So they agreed to let Rebekah and an old family servant woman leave immediately with Abraham's servant and his men.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a wo Rebeka, kɛ bimɛanyɛ ɔ nɛ hyɛ e nɔ kɛ je e jokuɛ mi ɔ, kɛ Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa blɔ.

english_verse: They gave Rebekah their blessing and said, “We pray that God will give you many children and grandchildren and that he will help them defeat their enemies.”
translation_verse: A gbaa Rebeka, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Wa nyɛmiyo! Mo fɔ bimɛ akpeakpe babauu; nɛ o nina ba kpɔ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ma amɛ.”

english_verse: Afterwards, Rebekah and the young women who were to travel with her prepared to leave. Then they got on camels and left with Abraham's servant and his men.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Rebeka kɛ e mawayi ɔmɛ dla, nɛ a kuɔ afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ ho. Bɔ nɛ Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ ba ngɔ Rebeka kɛ ho ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: At that time Isaac was living in the southern part of Canaan near a place called “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Isak ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ Kanaan leneyi je ngɛ he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ ke, “Hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ naa mi ɔ vu ɔ.”

english_verse: One evening he was walking out in the fields, when suddenly he saw a group of people approaching on camels. So he started toward them. Rebekah saw him coming; she got down from her camel, and asked, “Who is that man?” “He is my master Isaac,” the servant answered. Then Rebekah covered her face with her veil.
translation_verse: nɛ e bi Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nga a nɔ jii kɛ ma wa ngɔ nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ ji lɛ?” Tsɔlɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Rebeka ngɔ e hɛ mi hami bo ɔ kɛ ha e hɛ mi.

english_verse: The servant told Isaac everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ ɔ bɔ Isak e blɔ hiami mi amaniɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Isaac took Rebekah into the tent where his mother had lived before she died, and Rebekah became his wife. He loved her and was comforted over the loss of his mother.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Isak ngɔ Rebeka kɛ ho bo tsu ɔ nɛ e nyɛ Sara hi mi ɔ mi ya. E kɛ lɛ hi si kaa e yo, nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya. Rebeka ba pee bua womi nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ ko kɛ ha Isak ngɛ e nyɛ gbenɔ se.

english_verse: and they had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
translation_verse: Abraham kɛ lɛ fɔ Zimran, Yokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, kɛ Shua.

english_verse: Later, Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan, and when Dedan grew up, he had three sons: Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
translation_verse: Yokshan fɔ Sheba kɛ Dedan. Dedan nina ji Ashur bi, Letush bi, kɛ Leum bi.
