translation_verse: Mose ngma níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ. E nɔ jena makɛ ɔ, e ya puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ yo ɔ sisi, nɛ e ma titima nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nya.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɔ nihewi ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ a kɛ nahi ya sã sami bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Mose kɛ muɔ ɔ fa wo kahi a mi; nɛ fa a nɛ piɛ ɔ, e tsɛ̃ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ somi womi ɔ, nɛ e kane kɛ ha ma a tsuo. Ma a he nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Wa maa bu Yawɛ tue; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e fa wɔ ke wa pee ɔ, wa maa pee.”

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Mose ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ fĩa ma a nɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Somi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, e nya sɔumi muɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, kɛ Israel ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ kuɔ yo ɔ,

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: nɛ a na Israel Mawu ɔ. Ngɛ e nane si ɔ, a na nɔ́ ko kaa kpoku nɛ e mi tɛ̃ heii kaa hiɔwe, kaa nɔ́ nɛ tɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ safiro ɔ nɛ a kɛ pee lɛ.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Israel ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ na Mawu, se mohu Mawu kpataa we a hɛ mi. Nɛ a bla kɛ ye ní nɛ a nu ní. Mose ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ o ba mlɛ, nɛ ma ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a nɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngma nɛ a kɛ tsɔse ma a ngɔ ha mo.”

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Mose kɛ e tsɔlɔ Yoshua dla a he, konɛ a kuɔ Mawu yo ɔ.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Mose de nikɔtɔma amɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ mlɛ wɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si wa maa kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu. Aaron kɛ Hur kɛ nyɛ maa hi hiɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ sane ko ɔ, e ya na mɛ.”

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ bɔku ko ba ha yo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ba ke mi ní. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e tsui ma gbo nɔ kaa e maa ke nɔ́ ko ɔ, nyɛ he.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Nike ní ɔmɛ nɛ a pee sika tsu, sika hiɔ kɛ akɔblee;

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices to mix with the incense and with the oil for dedicating the tent and ordaining the priests;
translation_verse: nu nɛ a kɛ woɔ kane mi, tsopa nɛ a kɛ peeɔ nɔ pɔmi nu kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via,

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ a ma he klɔuklɔu ko ha mi, konɛ ma hi a kpɛti.

english_verse: The lamp on the top and those at the end of each of its six branches must be made so as to shine toward the front of the lampstand.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, moo pee kane kpaago kɛ ma kane tso ɔ nɔ, konɛ a la a nɛ kpɛ kɛ ya hlami.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha daka a mi, kɛ e he tsuo, nɛ o kɛ sika tsu ɔ eko nɛ wo zã kɛ bɔle e he ɔ kulaa.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Moo pee sika tsu ga eywiɛ, nɛ o ka kɛ wo daka a nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he; ga enyɔ nɛ hi kasa hiɛ, nɛ enyɔ hu nɛ hi kasa hiɛ.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Moo hlɔ akasia tsohi nɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ tso ɔmɛ kɛ hɔ ga amɛ a mi ngɛ daka a he, nɛ́ a pɛtɛ a he kɛ hɛɛ daka a.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Kerub kake nɛ hi hiɛ, nɛ kake hu nɛ hi hiɛ. Moo pee kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ nɛ tsa.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ somi womi ɔ nɛ ma ha mo ɔ kɛ wo daka a mi, nɛ o ngɔ nya nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ bu nya.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i kɛ mo maa kpe ngɛ; nɛ mlaahi tsuo nɛ ma wo Israel ma a kɛ gu o nɔ ɔ, ma da kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛ kɛ de mo. Okplɔɔ ɔ nɛ Mawu we abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ maa ma nɔ ɔ (Mose II,

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Moo pee kla maa pee dɛ mi blimi kake kɛ wo okplɔɔ ɔ he kɛ kpe. Ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ wo zã dɛɛ kɛ bɔle kla a.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Moo pee sika tsu ga eywiɛ ngɔ mɛtɛ okplɔɔ ɔ nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Moo hlɔ akasia tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he.

english_verse: The table is to be kept in the holy place, and the sacred loaves of bread must always be on it. All bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings are to be made of pure gold and set on this table. The Lampstand (Exodus
translation_verse: Nɛ o ngɔ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa ma ye hɛ mi daa a kɛ ma okplɔɔ ɔ nɔ. Kane tso ɔ (Mose II,

english_verse: with three branches on each of its two sides.
translation_verse: Kɔni ekpa nɛ hi kane tso ɔ he; etɛ ngɛ kasa hiɛ, kɛ etɛ hu ngɛ kasa hiɛ.

english_verse: There are to be three decorative almond blossoms on each branch
translation_verse: Kane tso ɔ he kɔni ekpa amɛ ɔ, mɔmɔ etɛ kɛ a yi pɛɛ nɛ hi eko tsuaa eko nɔ.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɔmɛ, tso gblaa amɛ, kɛ kpɛti kane tso ɔ tsuo nɛ tsa; a ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee lɛ tsuo.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Kane ɔ sumi kɛ e gbemi nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa muɔ la zu ɔ hu a ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Hyɛ nɛ o pee mɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa henɔhi nɛ i ngɛ mo tsɔɔe ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: “Kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya bo ɔ, ngɔɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo; nɛ a kɛ abui nɛ kadi ní kɛ wo mi.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, kpe he bo tsu ɔ, ngɔɔ bo popoe nyɔngma kɛ pee; a ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo bo nɛ ɔ, nɛ a kadi kerub saminyawiiwi kɛ wo mi.

english_verse: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.
translation_verse: Moo kpɛ bo ɔ enuɔ kɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ o kpɛ enuɔ kpa amɛ hu ja nɔuu.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Moo kpɛ bo ɔ enuɔ kɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ o kpɛ ekpa nɛ piɛ ɔ hu kɛ tsa a sibi a nya. Bo ekpane ɔ nɛ maa ha bo tsu ɔ nya a lɛɛ dɔɔ mi enyɔ.

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ, ngɔɔ e nya nɔ́ ɔ kɛ bu daka a nya ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: “Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ pee sima tso ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: kɛ mɛ hu a sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi eywiɛ; nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Kpe he bo tsu ɔ se ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ, sima tso ekpa nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ,

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Kɔ nya sima tso nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsa mɛ ngɛ yi kpɛti ɔ ngɛ kekleekle ga a he; sisi ɔ lɛɛ a ko ngɔ kɛ tsa. A pee kɔ nya sima tso ɔmɛ tsuo kikɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ ha sima tso ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o pee sika tsu gahi kɛ wo a he, konɛ a kɛ mani ɔmɛ nɛ hɔɔ a mi. Mani ɔmɛ nitsɛ hu, ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: O pee kpe he bo tsu nɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa henɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ ma tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ we omleyi je, konɛ kane tso ɔ lɛɛ e ya je leneyi je, ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ hanɔ tutuutu.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ kɛ bɛ gbowe ɔmɛ a nya kɛ kpla si, nɛ o ngɔ daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ ba ma e se blɔ, konɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ po he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a kpɛti ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ akasia tso enuɔ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ha a he, kɛ a nya sika tsu gbowehi, nɛ o kɛ pee titimahi ha tsu nya bo ɔ. Jehanɛ hu, moo sɔ̃ akɔblee nɔ dami nɔ́ enuɔ ha tso ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Á kɛ tso ɔmɛ nɛ hɔɔ ga amɛ a mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa enyɔ ɔmɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ nɛ a kɛ hɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Moo pee e he ngɛyuhi nɛ a kɛ muɔ la zu, sofihi, kahi, gbowehi, kɛ la jemi ngɛyuhi. Ngɔɔ akɔblee kɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Halfway up the altar build a ledge around it, and cover the bottom half of the altar with a decorative bronze grating. Then attach a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners of the altar.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ ya a kɛ bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ngɛ e sisi je, konɛ e hiɔwe yami nɛ ya ta bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kpɛti tutuutu.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ gbegbeli kɛ kpɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ; nɛ o ha blɔ nɛ hi mi kaa bɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he piɛ ɔ (Mose II,

english_verse: Command the people of Israel to supply you with the purest olive oil. Do this so the lamp will keep burning
translation_verse: “Fa Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ha mo oliv nu kpakpa nɛ mi tsɔ ngleinglei nɛ o kɛ wo kane ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a su kane ɔ daa.

english_verse: for the west. Then hang a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. Place three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hang a curtain
translation_verse: Akɔblee titima nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ nɛ hi piɛ ɔ he; se e he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ pee mɛ.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Piɛ ɔ nya nitsɛ nya bo ɔ lɛɛ e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi eywiɛ. Á ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo; nɛ a kɛ abui nɛ kadi ní saminyayoo ngɔ wo mi. Titima eywiɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ eywiɛ nɛ hi he.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ ma sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, kpe he bo tsu ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ piɛ ɔ hu he plɛɛko ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, a ngɔ akɔblee kɛ pee. Kane ɔ nɔ hyɛmi (Mose III,

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: Aaron kɛ kane ɔ nɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ haa somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi. Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a hyɛ kane ɔ nɔ ngɛ ye hɛ mi daa kɛ je gbɔkuɛ kɛ yaa si mɔtu. Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a nina tsuo.

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: “Moo tsɔ ya ngɔ o nyɛminyumu Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ji Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar kɛ ba. Mo ha nɛ a tsɔ a he kɛ je Israel bi kpa amɛ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ba sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Mo tsɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i kɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi dloo mɛ ɔ, nɛ o ha a kpɛ Aaron tade ɔmɛ kɛ pee lɛ klɔuklɔu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ye osɔfo kɛ sɔmɔ mi.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Tadehi nɛ á kpɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: gugue tade, efɔd, tade klɔii, hiɔwe tade nɛ a lo, pɛɛ, kɛ mi mi fimi nɔ́. Á kpɛ tade klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha o nyɛminyumu Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ a maa ngɔ kɛ kpɛ tade ɔmɛ ji sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ.

english_verse: Put two onyx stones in gold settings, then attach one to each of the shoulder straps. On one of these stones engrave the names of Israel's first six sons in the order of their birth. And do the same with his remaining six sons on the other stone. In this way Aaron will always carry the names of the tribes of Israel when he enters the holy place, and I will never forget my people.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, moo fi tɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ konɔ kpa amɛ a he, konɛ a pee tɛhi nɛ a kɛ ma kai Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ; Aaron ma kpla biɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e konɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ imi Yawɛ, ma kai ye ma a daa.

english_verse: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold. The Breastpiece for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ nɛ a tslɔ mɛ kaa kpa. Ngɔɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ kpa amɛ kɛ la he bɔlemi ní ɔmɛ a mi. Gugue tade ɔ (Mose II,

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Moo ma tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa kɛ wo zã eywiɛ mi; zã tsuaa zã a, tɛ etɛ nɛ hi mi. Kekleekle zã a mi tɛ ɔmɛ ji sardio, topasion, kɛ smaragdo.

english_verse: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
translation_verse: Zã nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji karfungkle, safiro, kɛ sardoniki.

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: Zã etɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji hiakinto, agate, kɛ ametisto.

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: Zã eywiɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji krisolito, shoham, kɛ yaspi. A sile sika tsu kɛ bɔle tɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tslɔ kaa kpa a, mɛ hu a nya enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ la nɔ́ mi hɔmi nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ o fi kɛ wo efɔd ɔ konɔ kpa amɛ a he ngɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi gugue tade ɔ he ga amɛ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ he ga amɛ a he ngɛ mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hiɔwe je, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gugue tade ɔ nɛ ko kpɔ kɛ je efɔd ɔ he.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: “Tade klɔii ɔ nɛ a woɔ ngɛ efɔd ɔ sisi ɔ, a lo lɛ kɛ kpa bluu sɔuu.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: A je kuɛ mi puɔ ngɛ he, nɛ a fia nya nɛ e ti kɛ kpe, konɛ e ko hía.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Ke Aaron ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, e wo tade nɛ ɔ, konɛ a nu ngmlɛ ɔmɛ a pɛmi be mi nɛ e ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ sɛe kɛ ba ye hɛ mi, kɛ be mi nɛ e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ sie konɛ e ko gbo.

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi lɛ kɛ wo pɛɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: E hi Aaron hɛ nya daa, kɛkɛ ɔ, ke Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ a nike ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha mi, nɛ tɔmi ko ba ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi mi po ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i be nike ní ɔmɛ kuae, se mohu ma ngɔ.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ hu o kpɛ hiɔwe tadehi, kɛ mi mi fimi níhi, kɛ pɛɛhi ha mɛ nɛ e sa mɛ, nɛ bu nɛ hi a he.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ tade nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo o nyɛminyumu Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ o pɔ mɛ nu, nɛ o wo mɛ osɔfo, nɛ o tsukɔ a he, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ bo nɛ a ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa kɛ lo kɛ kpɛ fiɔ mi tade ha mɛ, nɛ a wo kɛ ha a he kɛ je a mlɛ mi kɛ yaa si a fiɔ mi.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a wo fiɔ mi tade nɛ ɔmɛ be tsuaa be nɛ a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, aloo ke a ma sɔmɔmi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ. Ke pi ja a, musu maa tloo mɛ nɛ a ma gbo. Enɛ ɔ nɛ pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ ha Aaron kɛ e weku kɛ nina.

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Daa ligbi ɔ, o maa ngɔ na ku kake kɛ sã bɔ kɛ ha yayami pami. Enɛ ɔ maa tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ́ e pee klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ ngma mamu nɛ masa be mi kɛ pee nɔ́ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ: abolo kplolo nɛ zɔ ngɛ mi, abolo kplolo nɛ a wui mi zɔ, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a kɛ nu kpa hɛ mi,

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: nɛ o ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo kusii mi nɛ o hɛɛ kɛ ba, kɛ na a, kɛ agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: “Ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ o ngɔ nyu kɛ du a he ha mɛ.

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Ngɔɔ na ku ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pue e yi mi.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ na muɔ ɔ eko nɛ o ngɔ o nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ mi nɛ o kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, mo plɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Se na lo ɔ, e he womi ɔ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ lɛɛ o sã ngɛ sito he ɔ se; ejakaa bɔ nɛ a sãã kɛ jeɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ a he yayami ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, yaa nu agbosu ɔ kake, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pue e yi mi.

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo gbe to ɔ, nɛ o tsɛ̃ e muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Moo po to ɔ mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ o fɔ e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e se nane ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o kɛ pue e yi ɔ, kɛ lo kpɔ nya kpɔ nya amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo sã to ɔ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. E ji sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ sa imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, yaa nu agbosu kaketsɛ ɔ hulɔ, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pue e yi mi.

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo gbe to ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ e muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo ɔmɛ, a hiɔ nine gɔleku ɔmɛ, kɛ a hiɔ nane gɔleku ɔmɛ a he. Muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ mo kpa kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ muɔ nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ eko, kɛ nu nɛ a kɛ pɔɔ nɔ ɔ hu eko, nɛ o fĩa kɛ pue Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a tade ɔmɛ a nɔ. Enɛ ɔ maa pee Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a tade ɔmɛ tsuo klɔuklɔu ha mi.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: “Akɛnɛ osɔfo womi bɔ sami to ji agbosu ɔ he je ɔ, mo je e he zɔ ɔ, e hlemi nɛ wo zɔ ɔ, kɛ zɔ nɛ ha e mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ha e ko ɔ he ɔ, se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ e hiɔ fiɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ a fɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ ye hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsukɔ a he kɛ ha imi Yawɛ.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, hé ní ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ o sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ piɛ sami bɔ ɔ he. E ji sami bɔ nɛ jee via, nɛ sa imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Aaron binyumu nɛ maa ye osɔfo ngɛ e tsɛ se, nɔ nɛ maa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ e ya sɔmɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, e wo tade ɔmɛ ligbi kpaago.

english_verse: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place,
translation_verse: “Osɔfo womi bɔ sami agbosu ɔ, moo hoo lo ɔ ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ye lo ɔ, kɛ niye ní ɔ nɛ ngɛ kusii ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Mɛ pɛ lɛ á ye osɔfo womi kusumi kpatami ní nɛ ɔ; nɔ ko nɛ pi osɔfo ji lɛ ɔ, e ko ye eko, ejakaa e ji ní klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: If any of the sacred food is left until morning, it must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Ke osɔfo womi bɔ sami lo ɔ, aloo abolo ɔ eko piɛ nɛ je na yi ɔ, sãã; a ko ye ejakaa e ji nɔ́ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: “Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a osɔfo womi kusumi ɔ, moo pee lɛ ligbi kpaago kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ jijɔ kake kɛ sã bɔ mɔtu, nɛ o kɛ kake hu nɛ sã bɔ gbɔkuɛ.

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ jijɔ enyɔne ɔ kɛ sã bɔ, konɛ o ngɔ mamu kɛ wai nɛ a kɛ maa sã wai bɔ ɔ hu kɛ piɛ he kaa mɔtu nɔ́ ɔ kɛ̃. E ji sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya nɛ sa imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: You and your descendants must always offer this sacrifice on the altar at the entrance to the sacred tent. People of Israel, I will meet and speak with you there, and my shining glory will make the place holy.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i kɛ Israel ma a maa kpe ngɛ, nɛ ye hɛ mi nyami kpɛmi maa pee lejɛ ɔ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Ma tsukɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ hu ma tsukɔ a he, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: Ma hi Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ ma pee a Mawu.

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: A ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, konɛ ma hi a kpɛti. Imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Mix four liters of olive oil with the following costly spices: six kilograms of myrrh, three kilograms of cinnamon, three kilograms of cane, and six kilograms of cassia. Measure these according to the official standards. Then use this sacred mixture
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ tsopa nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu, nɛ e hi kaa nɔ́ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via he ní tsulɔ nitsɛ pee. E maa pee nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: “Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ pee bɔ sami la tɛ, nɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ hlɔ tso nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ma tsu mi pomi bo ɔ se ngɛ daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi. Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa kpe ngɛ.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko sã tsopa kɛ e he via kpa ko, aloo sami bɔ, aloo niye ní bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ; nyɛ ko sã wai bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Daa jeha a, Aaron nɛ pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. Lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, e ngɔ e muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli eywiɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ daa jeha, yi nɔ tsuaa yi nɔ. Bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ kɛ ha imi Yawɛ.” Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he tó tsumi

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: “Ke o kane Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ o na a hiɛmi ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ ma kpɔ e klaa kɛ ba ha mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kó ba sɛ a kpɛti be mi nɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ kanee.

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Mo he sika nɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ o kɛ wo kpe he bo tsu ɔ sɔmɔmi kpɛɛ ɔ mi. Tó nɛ ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma kpɔ a klaa, konɛ imi Yawɛ, ma kai nɛ ma bu a he.” Akɔblee kã a

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee nu nɛ ɔ eko nɛ e ma kpa a, a je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: Make a large bronze bowl and a bronze stand for it. Then put them between the altar for sacrifice and the sacred tent, so the priests can wash their hands and feet before entering the tent or offering a sacrifice on the altar. Each priest in every generation must wash himself in this way, or else he will die right there. The Oil for Dedication and Ordination (Exodus
translation_verse: Ke Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ maa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, a ngɔ nyu ɔ kɛ fɔ a dɛ kɛ a nane he, konɛ a ko gbo. Ja nɔuu a fɔ a dɛ kɛ a nane he loko a ya bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he nɛ a ya sã bɔ ha imi Yawɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko gbo. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha Aaron kɛ e nina kɛ yaa neneene.” Nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ

english_verse: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.
translation_verse: Moo tsukɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he, kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa pee klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ, aloo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa sa a he ɔ hu maa pee klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ekohu ke,

english_verse: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils,
translation_verse: okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kane tso ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ, la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ moo pɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nu, nɛ o tsukɔ a he, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.

english_verse: and say to the people of Israel: “This oil must always be used in the ordination service of a priest. It is holy because it is dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ‘Enɛ ɔ maa pee ye nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu nɛ a kɛ ma tsu kusumi ní yi nɔ tsuaa yi nɔ.

english_verse: So treat it as holy! Don't ever use it for everyday purposes or mix any for yourselves.
translation_verse: A ko ngɔ kɛ pɔ nɔ saisaa, nɛ a ko pee nu ɔ ekpa ko nɛ ngɛ kaa jã kɛ̃. E ji nɔ klɔuklɔu, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ e hi klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee tsopa kɛ e he via kpakpa. E hi kaa nɔ́ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via he ní tsulɔ nitsɛ pee, nɛ o ngɔ ngo kɛ wo mi, konɛ e mi nɛ tsɔ, nɛ e pee klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.
translation_verse: Moo wɛɛ eko nɛ e pee bukɔbukɔ kaa mamu, nɛ o ngɔ eko kɛ ya ma daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi he nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa kpe ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hɛɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ kaa nɔ́ ko klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.
translation_verse: “Hyɛ, i je blɔ hla Uri binyumu Bezalel, Hur bibi ɔ kɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi,

english_verse: Not only have I filled him with my Spirit, but I have given him wisdom and made him a skilled craftsman who can create objects of art with gold, silver, bronze, precious stones, and wood.
translation_verse: nɛ e nine nya da kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa a he ní tsumi, tso hlɔmi, kɛ ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tsumi.

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: Nɛ hyɛ, i hla Ahisamak bi Oholiab kɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi, konɛ e piɛ e he kɛ tsu ní ɔ. Jehanɛ, gali kpa amɛ hu i dloo mɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi klɛdɛɛ, konɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i fa mo ke o pee ɔ, a nyɛ nɛ a pee:

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: nɛ e fa lɛ nɛ e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ye ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ; ejakaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ ji neneene somi nɛ ngɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti ɔ he okadi, konɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi Yawɛ, lɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ pee ye ma.

english_verse: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ligbi ekpa a kɛ tsu ní; se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ e ji imi Yawɛ, ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsu ní ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: E ji okadi ngɛ i kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ wa kpɛti kɛ yaa neneene; ejakaa imi Yawɛ, i ngɔ ligbi ekpa kɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, i kpa ní tsumi, nɛ i jɔɔ ye he.”

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu kɛ Mose tu munyu gbe nya ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ha Mose.

english_verse: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.
translation_verse: E nɔ jena makɛ mla a, ma a te si nɛ a sã sami bɔhi, nɛ a kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi hu ba. Ma a pue si, nɛ a ye ní, nɛ a nu ní; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a fiɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmihi.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Mose de mɛ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ je nyɛ he ngɔ to kaa Yawɛ sɔmɔli, ejakaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ gbe lɛ nitsɛ e binyumu, kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛminyumu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ hu maa gbaa nyɛ.” He piami

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Benɛ ma a na kaa Mose se ya fia si ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kple we si kɛ bɛ ɔ, ma a bua a he nya kɛ ba na Aaron, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ je wɔ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, wa li sane nɛ ya ba e nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo pee mawu ha wɔ nɛ e nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi.”

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Aaron de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ je sika tsu tue nya ní ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ a tue mi kɛ ba ha mi.”

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: E he tue nya ní ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ nɛ e sile, nɛ e plɛ sika tsu nyu ɔ kɛ wo tso nɛ a kpɛ́ mi, nɛ e kɛ pee sika tsu na bi. Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a de ke, “Israel, o mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Aaron na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ sika tsu na bi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e fiɛ ke, “Hwɔɔ ɔ, a maa ye nyami ligbi ha Yawɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo kple si esɔesɔ; ejakaa o ma nɛ ji ni ɔmɛ nɛ o kpaka kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba a, a ble a he.

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɛ i fa mɛ ke a nyɛɛ nɔ ɔ, a gba kɛ je nɔ momo; a puɛ na bi amaga nɛ a ja lɛ, nɛ a sã bɔ ha lɛ nɛ a de ke, ‘Israel, o mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ ”

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hɛ mo kɛ ya se; i kɛ mɛ maa to ní nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi; se moo lɛɛ ma ha o kɛ o weku kɛ nina maa bɔ kɛ pee ma kpetekpleenyɛ.”

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Se Mose kpa Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ pɛɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, mɛni he je o mi mi fu o ma a nɛ o kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ kɔni si wami kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Mo kai o tsɔli Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob. Mo kai mo nitsɛ o kita nɛ o ka ke, ‘Ma ha nɛ nyɛ nina maa hiɛ babauu kaa hiɔwe dodoehi, nɛ ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ e he si ɔ kɛ ha mɛ, nɛ e maa pee a nɔ kɛ ya neneene ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kpale e nya se, nɛ yayami nɛ jinɛ e to kaa e maa ba ma a nɔ ɔ bɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: Moses went back down the mountain with the two flat stones on which God had written all of his laws with his own hand, using both sides of the stones.
translation_verse: Mawu nitsɛ nɛ kpɛ́ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ mlaa amɛ nɛ a ngma ngɛ a nɔ ɔ hu, Mawu nitsɛ nɛ ngma.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Benɛ ma a hwɔ lele nɛ Yoshua nu he ɔ, e de Mose ke, “Moo bu tue! A ngɛ ta hwue ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ.”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Se Mose he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Dɛbi, pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye manye ngɛ ta mi a lele hwɔmi, nɛ pohu pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ye a nɔ a bubuubui, kɛ ngmlaa ji nɛ ɔ; se mohu lali a gbi i ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mose miɔ nɛ e maa su ma a sito he ɔ, nɛ́ e na na bi ɔ, kɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ doe ɔ, e mi mi fu; nɛ e kɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ fia si ngɛ yo ɔ sisi, nɛ e ywia mɛ.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: E wo na bi ɔ nɛ a pee ɔ, nɛ e mɛ he la, nɛ e sile. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e wɛɛ lɛ nɛ e pee mamu bukɔbukɔ, nɛ e ngɔ fĩa nyu hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nu.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Mose bi Aaron ke, “Mɛni ma nɛ ɔ pee mo loko o ha nɛ a pee yayami agbo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Aaron he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, o mi mi nɛ ko fu mi. Mo nitsɛ o le nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kaa nɔ́ yaya peemi he a nyaa.

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ba de mi ke, ‘Moo pee mawu ha wɔ nɛ e nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi; ejakaa kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ je wɔ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, wa li nɔ́ nɛ ya ba e nɔ.’

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: I de mɛ ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ sika tsu ɔ, e ngɔ kɛ ba.’ A ngɔ kɛ ba, nɛ i sake kɛ fɔ la mi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba ji kikɛmɛ a na bi nɛ ɔ nɛ!”

english_verse: Moses knew that the people were out of control and that it was Aaron's fault. And now they had made fools of themselves in front of their enemies.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mose na kaa Aaron nine kpi ma a he, nɛ ma a ngɛ basabasa pee kɛ ngɛ a hɛ mi si puee ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ,

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: e ho nɛ e ya da si ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ se ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ ba ye ngɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo bua a he nya ngɛ he kake, nɛ a bu kɛ ba e ngɔ.

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Levi bi ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa mɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a gbe nimli maa pee akpe etɛ.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: E nɔ jena a, Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛ pee yayami agbo. Se kɛ̃, ma kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ya Yawɛ ngɔ, kaa alini e maa nu ye gbi, nɛ e maa ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa nyɛ lo.”

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose kpale e se kɛ ho Yawɛ ngɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Anɔkuale, ma nɛ ɔ pee yayami agbo kaa a ngɔ sika tsu kɛ pee mawu kɛ ha a he.

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Nihi nɛ pee yayami kɛ si mi ɔ, mɛ pɛ a biɛ ma gbe ngɛ ye womi ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: Moo lɛɛ yaa nɛ o ya kpaka ye ma a kɛ ya he nɛ i de mo ɔ. Ye bɔfo ɔ maa nyɛɛ o hɛ mi. Se be ma nɛ ma wo ma a hiɔ ngɛ a he yayami ɔ he.”

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ gbla ma a tue; ejakaa a nyɛ Aaron nɔ nɛ e pee sika tsu na bi ha mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ma a nɛ o kpaka kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, o kɛ mɛ nɛ je hiɛ ɔ kɛ ho zugba a nɛ i wo Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke ma ngɔ kɛ ha a nina a nɔ ya.

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: nɛ bɔfo ɔ ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní saminya hulɔ ɔ nɔ. Imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i kɛ nyɛ be yae, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma ko ya kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, ejakaa ma nɛ kuɛ wa ji nyɛ.”

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de ma a ke, “Ma nɛ kuɛ wa ji nyɛ; ke i kɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ hɛngmɛfia po, ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ je nyɛ june ní ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ he, konɛ ma hyɛ bɔ nɛ ma pee nyɛ ha.”

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ Mose maa tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ kɛ e huɛ tuɔ munyu ɔ. Ke Mose kpale e se kɛ ba ma a sito he ɔ, e tsɔlɔ niheyo wayoo nɛ ji Nun binyumu Yoshua lɛɛ e ji kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. Yawɛ wo e ma a si

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Mose de Yawɛ ke, “Mo kai kaa o de mi ke ma kpaka ma a kɛ ho, se o tsɔɔ we mi nɔ nɛ o maa tsɔ kɛ piɛ ye he. Mo nɔuu nɛ o de ke o le mi saminya, nɛ o bua jɔ ye he.

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ke niinɛ nɛ o ngɛ ye he bua jɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ moo tsɔɔ mi o blɔ ɔ, konɛ ma le mo saminya, nɛ ma pee o suɔmi nya ní. Mo kai hu kaa kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mo nitsɛ o ma ji mɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Imi nitsɛ i kɛ mo maa nyɛɛ kɛ ya fiafiaafia.”

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Mose de lɛ ke, “Ke mo nitsɛ o kɛ wɔ be yae ɔ, lɛɛ mo ko ha nɛ waa je hiɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: Ke o kɛ wɔ yɛ ɔ nɛɛ, kɛ a maa pee kɛ na kaa o ngɛ i kɛ o ma a wa he suɔmi kɛɛ? Ke o kɛ wɔ nyɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko i kɛ o ma a maa je muno ngɛ zugba a nɔ je ma amɛ tsuo a he.”

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o bi nɛ ɔ hu ma pee ha mo; ejakaa i le mo saminya, nɛ i ngɛ o he bua jɔmi.”

english_verse: Then Moses said, “I pray that you will let me see you in all of your glory.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose de ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha ma na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord, and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name,
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ma ha ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo maa be ngɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ ye biɛ nɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ hu ma wo nɔ ta ngɛ o hɛ mi. Nihi nɛ sa dloomi ɔ, ma dloo mɛ; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ sa mɔbɔ nami ɔ, ma na mɛ mɔbɔ.”

english_verse: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it,
translation_verse: Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, blɔ ngɛ ye kasa nya ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ o maa da tɛ sa nɔ.

english_verse: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.
translation_verse: Ke be nɛ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ bee ɔ, ma ngɔ mo ngɔ wo tɛ puɔ mi ngɛ tɛ sa nɛ ɔ mi. I kɛ ye nine maa ha o nɔ kɛ yaa si ma be.

english_verse: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma je ye nine ngɛ o nɔ, nɛ o maa na ye kuɛ se, se pi ye hɛ mi.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I promise to perform miracles for you that have never been seen anywhere on earth. Neighboring nations will stand in fear and know that I was the one who did these marvelous things.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke “Hyɛ i kɛ Israel ma a ngɛ soe. Ma pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ a kpɛti nɛ eko bɛ hyɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi he ko he ko, aloo ngɛ ma ko ma ko mi. Je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle mo ɔ maa na ní nguahi nɛ imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ tsue; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ i yaa pee ha mo ɔ he ngɛ gbeye.

english_verse: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.
translation_verse: Dla o he nɛ hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ o kuɔ Sinai yo ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ o kɛ mi ba kpe ngɛ yo ɔ yi mi.

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: “Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko piɛ o he kɛ ba; a ko na nɔ ko ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ he ko, nɛ to, loo na kó ba ye ní ngɛ yo ɔ sisi.”

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ. E te si mɔtu mla, nɛ e ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ ma e dɛ, nɛ e kuɔ kɛ ho Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Benɛ e yaa a, e hɛɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi.

english_verse: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, “I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ ba be ngɛ Mose hɛ mi, nɛ e de kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Imi Yawɛ ɔ, Mawu mɔbɔ nalɔ, kɛ dloolɔ ji mi; ye mi mi fu we mla, nɛ ye suɔmi kɛ anɔkuale yemi hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose kɛ he sɔmi kpla si nɛ e ja Mawu.

english_verse: He prayed, “Lord, if you really are pleased with me, I pray that you will go with us. It is true that these people are sinful and rebellious, but forgive our sin and let us be your people.” A Promise and Its Demands (Exodus
translation_verse: E de ke, “Yawɛ, ke niinɛ nɛ o ngɛ ye he bua jɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kɛ wɔ nɛ ya. E ngɛ mi kaa ma nɛ ɔ kuɛ wa mohu, se moo ngɔ wa tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa wɔ, nɛ o ngɔ wɔ kɛ pee mo nitsɛ o ma.” A pee somi ɔ ehe ekohu (Mose II,

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: “Daa jeha a, o ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba bua si etɛ ngɛ imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: I demand your complete loyalty—you must not worship any other god!
translation_verse: “Mo ko ja mawu kpa ko, ejakaa imi Yawɛ Mawu ɔ, a kɛ mi plee we nɔ́ he.

english_verse: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.
translation_verse: “Bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte, kɛ o we mi lohwehi a kpɛti kekleekle eku tsuaa eku ɔ, ye nɔ ji lɛ; na jio, to jio.

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ mo woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, moo ye nɔ. Ma fie Amor bi, Kanaan bi, Hit bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ kɛ je blɔ mi ha mo.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Hyɛ saminya nɛ o kɛ ma he nɛ nyɛ yaa a mi bi ɔmɛ kó so somi ko, nɛ lɔ ɔ ba plɛ klama nɛ a tsɔ mo.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Dɛbi, nyɛɛ hule a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ gbɛ a wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ywia a yo wɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ashera a we amaga amɛ.

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: “Moo ye Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ, moo ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago ngɛ Abib nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi be nɛ a to ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; ejakaa Abib nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi o je Egipt kɛ ba a nɛ.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: O teji kekleekle bi ɔ, o maa ngɔ jijɔ kɛ dani lɛ. Ke o be suɔe nɛ o dani lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ o maa ku e kuɛ. O ma dani o bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte. Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ba ye hɛ mi kɛ e dɛ gu.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: “Mo tsu ní ligbi ekpa, se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ moo jɔɔ o he; ní gbami be tete jio, ní kpami be tete jio.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Moo ye Ngmakpami be ɔ be mi nɛ a ngɛ kpokploku kpɔe; nɛ o ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ jeha a nyagbe.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.

translation_verse: E kɛ akɔblee pee titima nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ; se titima amɛ a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee.

english_verse: Bezalel had worked closely with Oholiab, who was an expert at designing and engraving, and at embroidering blue, purple, and red wool. The two of them completed the work that the Lord had commanded to be done. Moses put Aaron's son Ithamar in charge of the Levites who kept record of the metals used for the sacred tent.
translation_verse: E he piɛlɔ ji Ahisamak nɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ bi Oholiab. Oholiab nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ mi kpɛ́lɔ, galɔ, kɛ bo lolɔ ji lɛ; nɛ e ngɔɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kɛ loɔ bo.

english_verse: Two thousand four hundred and twenty-five kilograms of bronze were given.
translation_verse: Akɔblee ɔ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba ke Yawɛ ɔ, e nya ji kilo

english_verse: the stands for the posts that surrounded the courtyard, including those at the entrance to the courtyard, and the pegs for the tent and the courtyard.
translation_verse: nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle piɛ ɔ kɛ piɛ ɔ we agbo ɔ nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, kpe he bo tsu ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ piɛ nɛ bɔle kpe he bo tsu ɔ hu he plɛɛko ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Beautiful priestly clothes were made of blue, purple, and red wool for Aaron to wear when he performed his duties in the holy place. This was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: A ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu kɛ kpɛ tade saminyawiiwi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ maa wo kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ. A kpɛ tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ ha Aaron kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. Efɔd ɔ peemi

english_verse: The entire priestly vest was made of fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Thin sheets of gold were hammered out and cut into threads that were skillfully woven into the vest.
translation_verse: A si sika tsu ɔ nɔ tɛtlɛɛ, nɛ a poo lɛ dlɛɛdlɛɛ kaa kpa loko a ngɔ kɛ futu kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Then these were attached to the shoulder straps of the vest, so the Lord would never forget his people. Everything was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Breastpiece (Exodus
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, a fi mɛ kɛ wo efɔd konɔ kpa amɛ a he kaa kaimi tɛhi nɛ daa si kɛ ha Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ. Gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ peemi (Mose II,

english_verse: a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond were in the second row;
translation_verse: Zã nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji karfungkle, safiro, kɛ sardoniki.

english_verse: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst were in the third row;
translation_verse: Zã etɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji hiakinto, agate, kɛ ametisto.

english_verse: and a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper were in the fourth row. They were mounted in a delicate gold setting,
translation_verse: Zã eywiɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji krisolito, shoham, kɛ yaspi. A sile sika tsu kɛ bɔle tɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Two gold rings were attached to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fastened with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: A ngɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nya enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ la nɔ́ mi hɔmi nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a fi kɛ wo efɔd ɔ konɔ kpa amɛ a he ngɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: To keep the breastpiece in place, a blue cord was used to tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Clothes for the Priests (Exodus
translation_verse: Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, a ngɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ he ga amɛ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ he ga amɛ a he ngɛ mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hiɔwe je, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ nɛ kó kpɔ kɛ je efɔd ɔ he. Osɔfo ɔmɛ a tade kpa amɛ a kpɛmi (Mose II,

english_verse: which was fastened to Aaron's turban. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Work Is Completed (Exodus
translation_verse: Nɛ a kɛ kpa bluu fi lɛ kɛ wo pɛɛ nguaa a he kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. A gbe ní tsumi ɔ nya (Mose II,

english_verse: When Moses saw that the people had done everything exactly as the Lord had commanded, he gave them his blessing.
translation_verse: Mose ya nɛ e ya hyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e na kaa a tsu ní ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Nɛ Mose gbaa mɛ.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for the head. The material around the collar was bound so as to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: A je kuɛ mi puɔ ngɛ he, nɛ a fia nya nɛ e ti kɛ kpe konɛ e ko hía.

english_verse: Everything that Aaron and his sons wore was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, including their robes and turbans, their fancy caps and underwear, and even their sashes that were embroidered with needlework.
translation_verse: Mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hu, a ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ, kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu kɛ pee, nɛ a kadi ní wo mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy;
translation_verse: somi daka a nɛ mlaa amɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, e he tso ɔmɛ kɛ e nya nɔ́ ɔ;

english_verse: So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, a gbe kpe he bo tsu ɔ he ní tsumi ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nya. Israel bi ɔmɛ tsu ní ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.

english_verse: Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands;
translation_verse: Nɛ a ngɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Mose ngɔ; e he gbowe ɔmɛ, sima tso ɔmɛ, mani tso ɔmɛ, titima amɛ, kɛ nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ;

english_verse: the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: okplɔɔ ɔ, e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ;

english_verse: the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
translation_verse: sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ; nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ; tsopa kɛ e he via a; kpe he bo tsu ɔ nya bo ɔ;

english_verse: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, e he akɔblee ya a, e he tso ɔmɛ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo; nyu kã a kɛ e he kla a;

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: Set up my tent on the first day of the year
translation_verse: “Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ ma si.

english_verse: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ ba ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ o to ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ma nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ kane tso ɔ hu kɛ ba mi, nɛ o ngɔ kane ɔmɛ kɛ ma nɔ.

english_verse: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via a kɛ ma somi daka a hɛ mi, nɛ o wo bo ngɔ kpla si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ nyu kã a kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti, nɛ o yɛ nyu kɛ wo mi.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: Moo po piɛ kɛ bɔle he klɔuklɔu, nɛ o wo bo ngɔ kpla si ngɛ piɛ ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ o ngɔ nyu kɛ fɔ a he.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ wo Aaron, nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu, nɛ o julaa lɛ, nɛ e sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfo.

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ e binyumu ɔmɛ hu kɛ ba, nɛ o wo mɛ hiɔwe tade ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Moses followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a we Egipt jemi jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ si.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: E ngɔ mlaa amɛ kɛ wo somi daka a mi. E kɛ tso ɔmɛ hɔɔ daka a he ga amɛ a mi, nɛ e ngɔ daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ bu nya.

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ daka a ba ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ kpla si, nɛ e kɛ tsi somi daka a nɛ mlaa amɛ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ, Mose ɔ.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Mose kɛ okplɔɔ ɔ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ we omleyi je, ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi,

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: nɛ e su kane ɔmɛ kɛ ma nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: nɛ e sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Mose kɛ bo ɔ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: E ngɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: E kɛ nyu kã a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti, nɛ e yɛ nyu kɛ wo mi.

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ lɛ, Mose ɔ, kɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ maa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, aloo a maa ya bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, a kɛ nyu ɔ ma fɔ a dɛ kɛ a nane he.

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔku ɔ ba ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ nɔ, nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami hyi lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: Ke bɔku ɔ wo we e he nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ a hiɛ blɔ kɛ yaa si ligbi nɛ e ma wo e he nɔ.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Ngɛ Israel ma a blɔ nyɛɛmi ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, Yawɛ jeɔ e he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ yi mi; piani ɔ, a naa lɛ kaa bɔku, nɛ nyɔ mi lɛɛ a naa lɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi. A maa ngɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nane mi kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ kpata Yawɛ.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e gbe na ku ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ ba; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a he kɛ kpe.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: E saa lohwe ɔ, nɛ e poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya;

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a to lɛ́ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a slɛ la.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: se e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e nane ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ nɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ nɛ fɔ a he; nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa sami bɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: Se ke to nɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma sami bɔ sami ɔ, é pee agbosu, aloo akpakpo nɛ kpa ko be e he.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: É gbe lɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ we omleyi je, konɛ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: E mi ní ɔ kɛ e nane ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ nɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ nɛ fɔ a he, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji sami bɔ, bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: Ke lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma sami bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, e pee lahuɛ, loo beleku lahuɛ.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ dɛ kɛ ba bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. É kika lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔ kuɛ, nɛ e tsɔ e yi ngɛ nya; e sã yi ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ e tsle muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: É je lohwe ɔ kã a kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ, nɛ́ e sake mɛ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ beleku je, he nɛ a ngɔɔ la zu ngɔ pueɔ ɔ.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɔ niye ní kɛ ma bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, é wɛɛ lɛ bukɔbukɔ kɛ pee mamu. E pue nɔ oliv nu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via,

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ha Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ piti mamu bukɔbukɔ kɛ e nɔ nu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a tsuo e dɛ kɔkɔ kake, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ daa si kaa okadi ngɛ bɔ ɔ nɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ba a tsuo nane mi kɛ ha Yawɛ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: Ke niye ní nɛ a sã ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi nɔ ko ngɔ kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, é pee keeki nɛ a kɛ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a wo mi nu sã, loo e pee akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a pɔ he nu.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Ke niye ní nɛ a sã ngɛ ngɛyu mi nɔ ko kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, é pee nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kplolo mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu mi lɛ pee.

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: É ku niye ní ɔ mi tsɔwitsɔwi, nɛ́ e plɛ nu ngɔ pue nɔ; niye ní bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, ke niye ní nɛ a hoo ngɛ buɛ mi nɔ ko ngɔ kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, e pee mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a wo mi nu.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: A sã jio, a si jio, e ngɔ kɛ ba kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ ma ha Yawɛ. É ngɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, konɛ osɔfo ɔ hu nɛ ngɔ kɛ ya bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ bɔbɔyoo ko kɛkɛ kaa okadi ngɛ niye ní ɔ tsuo nane mi. É sã nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ se ɔ peeɔ osɔfo Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́; ejakaa bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: A kɛ masa nɔ́ ko kó pee niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ ba haa Yawɛ ɔ eko; nyɛ ko sã masa nɔ́ ko loo hwo kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ngɔ masa, loo hwo kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa ngmɔ nɔ kekleekle niba ní, se nyɛ ko sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ jee via.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e ngmɔ nɔ kekleekle niba ní kɛ ma bɔ sami ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kaa niye ní bɔ ɔ, é pee kpokploku nɛ a hluɛ, nɛ a sĩ, loo blɛfo nɛ a wɛɛ kplolo.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: A wo mi nu, nɛ a kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ pue nɔ. Niye ní bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ ɔ bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ kaa okadi ngɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ tsuo nane mi. É sã nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɔ na kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, eku jio, eyo jio, e pee na nɛ kpa ko be e he.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, konɛ Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: lohwe ɔ se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a sã ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ sami bɔ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɔ jijɔ, loo apletsi kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, eku jio, eyo jio, e pee lohwe nɛ kpa ko be e he.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: é ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi. Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: e se tso mi ngmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo nɛ ngɛ ní tsue jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ nɛ sã enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko kɛ apletsi ba bɔ sami ɔ,

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: é ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi. Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a sã enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via. Zɔ ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, Yawɛ nɔ́.
