english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Israel fɔfɔɛ ko nɛ kó ye zɔ, loo muɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene ha nyɛ yi nɔhi tsuo ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ.

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: É ngɔ e nine nguɛ ngɔ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ é fĩa ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi si kpaago.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: É ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ akpakpo ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ he nɛ a gbee lohwe nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ, ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. E ji yayami pami bɔ.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ́ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke a ti nɔ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ a nyɛ nɛ e kɛ tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ, nɛ pi kaa nɔ ɔ je blɔ tɔ̃ ɔ, a ye blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ke osɔfo nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu nɛ tɔ̃, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e gbla musu kɛ ba ma a nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ na ku nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: É ngɔ na ku ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. É tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya nya a sisi.

english_verse: The priest will remove the fat from the bull, just as he does when he sacrifices a bull to ask my blessing. This includes the fat on the insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat. He will then send it all up in smoke.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã zɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ. Ke a gbe lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu osɔfo ɔ jeɔ e mi ní ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: é ngɔ lɛ tsuo kɛ je ma sito he ɔ kɛ ya he ko nɛ tsɔ, he nɛ a plɛɔ la zu ngɔ pueɔ ɔ. É ngɔ mɛ kɛ pue lɛ́ nɔ nɛ e sã ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi kaa Israel ma a tsuo tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa a eko nɔ, nɛ pi kaa a je blɔ tɔ̃ ɔ,

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: ke a na le kaa a tɔ̃ ɔ, ma a nɛ ngɔ na ku kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ. Á ngɔ lohwe ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ á ngɔ a nine ngɔ pue lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ á gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Osɔfo nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ nɛ ngɔ na ku nɛ ɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: É ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e fĩa si kpaago ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, é ngɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. Muɔ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, é tsɛ̃ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a sisi.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven. When a Tribal Leader Sins The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, é ngɔ na ku nɛ ɔ hu kɛ je ma sito he ɔ, nɛ é ya sã lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ kaa a pee kaketsɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha ma a tsuo.

english_verse: Any tribal leader who disobeys me without knowing it is still guilty.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ yelɔ ko li e he be nɛ e tɔ̃ Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ,

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: nɛ a ha nɛ e na e tɔmi ɔ, é ngɔ akpakpo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã bɔ.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he. É tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Se e zɔ ɔ tsuo lɛɛ, é sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Lohwehi nɛ a gbee nɛ a kɛ sãã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɛ a sãã a zɔ ɔ nɛ. Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ yelɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ kpɛti nɔ gu ko tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ, nɛ pi e yi mi nɛ e to kɛ pee yayami ɔ,

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ke a ha e na kaa e tɔ̃ ɔ, é ngɔ apletsi yo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: É ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ é gbe lɛ ngɛ he nɛ a gbee lohwehi nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: É je zɔ ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a jeɔ zɔ ngɛ lohwe nɛ a gbe kɛ ha tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ɔ mi pɛpɛɛpɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ́ é je via ha Yawɛ. Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ e kɛ ma kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ke jijɔ nɔ ko kɛ ma yayami pami bɔ sami ɔ, e ngɔ jijɔ yo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba.

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: É ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ é gbe lɛ ngɛ he nɛ a gbee lohwehi nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: É je e zɔ ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a jeɔ zɔ ngɛ jijɔ nɛ a gbee kɛ sãã tue mi jɔmi bɔ he ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã zɔ ɔ kɛ piɛ bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ he. Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ka kita nya mi gu kaa e maa pee nɔ́ ko, kpakpa jio, yaya jio, nɛ e li e he be ɔ, ke e ba na le ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko na le kaa e ye fɔ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi ɔ, é jaje e tɔmi ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ;

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: nɛ é ngɔ jijɔ yo, loo apletsi yo kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ha Yawɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã bɔ ɔ ha lɛ ngɛ e yayami ɔ he.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ lahuɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ; nɛ lɛ hu e tsu yayami pami bɔ ɔ he ní kekle. É ku lahuɛ ɔ kuɛ, se e ko tsɔ e yi ngɛ nya,

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: nɛ é ngɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ fia bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. É tsle muɔ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi. Yayami pami bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ɔ be nyɛe ma ha lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ ɔ, lɛɛ é ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake kɛ ba kaa yayami pami bɔ. E ko ngɔ nu, loo tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pue nɔ, ejakaa e ji yayami pami bɔ.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: E ngɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ mamu ɔ e dɛ kɔkɔ kake kaa bɔ ɔ tsuo nane mi dami okadi. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã enɛ ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Yayami pami bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Mamu nɛ piɛ ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔ nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ niye ní bɔ sami he ɔ. Fɔ yemi bɔ sami

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: ke nɔ ko li e he be nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Mawu, lɔ ɔ ji kaa e ha we Yawɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ sa nɛ e ha lɛ sisiisi ɔ, é ngɔ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba. Lohwe ɔ jua nɛ pee bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Fɔ yemi bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ wo e yi nɔ tade ɔ, kɛ e sisi tade ɔ nɛ a kɛ kploba kpɛ ɔ, konɛ e je la zu ɔ kɛ ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord: You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃, ke nɔ́ ko laa, nɛ nɔ ko na, se e to lakpa, nɛ e ka kita ke e nɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: bɔ nɛ a maa wo Aaron binyumu ko osɔfo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Ligbi ɔ nɛ a maa wo lɛ osɔfo ɔ, e ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake kaa daa ligbi niye ní bɔ kɛ ba. É ngɔ fa kɛ sã bɔ mɔtu, nɛ é ngɔ fa hu kɛ sã bɔ gbɔkuɛ.

english_verse: In addition, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven for what you did wrong. Daily Sacrifices (Exodus
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ maa sã bɔ ɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ, nɛ a kɛ e he yayami tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ maa pa lɛ. Bɔhi nɛ a sãã lohwe ɔ tsuo kulaa

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a weku ɔ mi ma nyɛ maa ye bɔ nɛ ɔ eko; e ji bɔ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Á ywia buɛ tsuaa buɛ nɛ a hoo lo nɛ ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ; se ke akɔblee nɔ́ mi nɛ a hoo ngɛ ɔ, lɛɛ a sa mi saminya, nɛ a kɛ nyu nɛ jale mi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: e de Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ke, mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ sami bɔ he ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Sami bɔ ɔ nɛ hi bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si mɔtu; la a nɛ ko gbo ngɛ sisi.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je e tade ɔmɛ, nɛ e wo tade kpahi, konɛ e ngɔ la zu ɔ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ kɛ ya pue he ko nɛ tsɔ.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Á ha nɛ la a nɛ hi tsoe ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ko gbo. Daa mɔtu ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ to lɛ́ kɛ wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ mi. É to sami bɔ ɔ ngɔ pue lɛ́ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e sa zɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ɔ.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: La nɛ hi bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ daa; e ko gbo gblegbleegble. Niye ní bɔ sami

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: Niye ní bɔ sami he mlaahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ ji osɔfo nɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: É piti mamu bukɔbukɔ, kɛ nu ɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ngɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ tsuo e dɛ kɔkɔ kake, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, konɛ e je via liliili, nɛ e pee kaimi nɔ ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Mamu nɛ piɛ ɔ peeɔ Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́. A kɛ sã abolo kplolo nɛ a ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ mi. Bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ haa Yawɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ fa nɛ ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ kaa a blɔ fa mi nɔ́. E ngɛ klɔuklɔu saminya kaa bɔ nɛ yayami pami, kɛ fɔ yemi bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a yeɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ eko kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, mɛɛ a blɔ fa mi nɔ́.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose, nɛ kɔɔ

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: E kɛ nu nɛ si ngɛ ngɛyu mi, nɛ nu nɛ sɛ mi saminya, nɛ e ku mi tsɔwitsɔwi, konɛ e kɛ ba sã bɔ kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: Each of Aaron's descendants who is ordained as a priest must perform this ceremony and make sure that the bread is completely burned on the altar. None of it may be eaten! Sacrifices for Sin (Leviticus
translation_verse: Niye ní bɔ tsuaa niye ní bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa sã a, a ko ye ekoeko; a sã lɛ tsuo. Yayami pami bɔhi

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ fa Mose ke

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: e wo Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɔɔ yayami pami bɔ he. Lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, á gbe lɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ he nɛ a gbeɔ lohwehi nɛ a kɛ sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ. Bɔ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ maa sã lohwe ɔ, e ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ mi.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa sa lo nɛ ɔ he ɔ ma plɛ pee nɔ́ klɔuklɔu; ke e muɔ nɛ a fĩa a eko sɛ tade mi ɔ, a fɔ tade ɔ he ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Se lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ e muɔ maa ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi kɛ ba pee kpatami ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, a ko ye e lo ɔ; a sã.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ha Yawɛ; fɔ yemi bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ a kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, e je mi kakaaka kɛ pee nike ní pɔtɛɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ maa tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ, enɛ ɔ maa pee e nɔ́.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he sa lo nɛ ɔ he ɔ, á ko ye; á sã. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he tsɔ ngɛ he blɔ kaa e maa ye lo nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ eko.

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: Fɔ yemi bɔ sami he mlaahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. E ji bɔ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: He nɛ a gbee lohwe nɛ a kɛ sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ, á gbe lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ̃. A tsɛ̃ e muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he tsuo.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: A ngɔ e zɔ ɔ tsuo kɛ sã bɔ ɔ: e hlemi ɔ, zɔ nɛ ngɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: e se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ nɛ ngɛ e mi si ɔ, kɛ e fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a.

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a weku ɔ mi ma nyɛ maa ye. Se a ye lɛ ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ejakaa e ji bɔ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: Yayami pami bɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ kɛ̃. Mlaa kake lɛ ngɛ ha mɛ tsuo; osɔfo nɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ kɛ pee kpatami ɔ, e nɔ́ ji lo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Lohwe nɛ a kɛ sã sami bɔ ɔ he womi ɔ peeɔ osɔfo nɛ sã bɔ ɔ nɔ́.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Se niye ní bɔ saisaa nɛ a futu mi nu, loo a futuu we mi nu ɔ, osɔfo Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ; a dla lɛ fiee. Tue mi jɔmi bɔhi

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: Tue mi jɔmi bɔhi nɛ a kɛ ba haa Yawɛ ɔ a he mlaahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ma bɔ ɔ sami nɛ e kɛ na Yawɛ si ɔ, e ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ e lohwe nɛ e kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ he kɛ ba: abolo kplolo nɛ a wo mi nu, akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a kɛ kplolo sã nɛ a kpa he nu, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a kɛ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a wo mi nu saminya sã.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: A ye lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu; a ko si eko nɛ je nɛ e na yi.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ; nɔ́ ko nɛ e wo he si jio, nɔ́ nɛ je e tsui mi faa jio, a ma nyɛ ye lo ɔ ligbi ɔ nɛ e kɛ ba a. Ke eko piɛ ɔ, a ye e nɔ jena.

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ye lo nɛ ye ligbi etɛ ɔ eko ɔ, Mawu be e bɔ sami ɔ he tsui nae, nɛ a be bue ha lɛ kaa e sã bɔ hulɔ. A hiɔ; nɔ nɛ maa ye eko ɔ, e musu maa tloo lɛ.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he, nɔmlɔ jio, lohwe jio, bɔ nɔ́ ko jio, nɛ e maa ye lo nɛ a kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, á je lɛ we, á ko bu lɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ wo Mose mlaa nɛ ɔ ke

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, á ko ye zɔ, na zɔ jio, jijɔ zɔ jio, apletsi zɔ jio.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Ke lohwe ko gbo lɛ nitsɛ e gbenɔ, aloo lohwe awi yelɔ ko tsɔtslɔɔ e mi ɔ, a ko ye e zɔ ɔ; a ma nyɛ kɛ tsu nɔ́ kpa ko.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke a kɛ lohwe ko ba sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye e zɔ ɔ, á je lɛ we, nɛ á ko bu lɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ye lohwe pɛlitsɛ, loo nane eywiɛtsɛ ko muɔ ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Lɛ nitsɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ha Yawɛ. É ngɔ zɔ ɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔ gugue ɔ he kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ á fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã zɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, se gugue ɔ lɛɛ, e maa pee Aaron, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Á ngɔ lohwe ɔ hiɔ fiɔ ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ muɔ kɛ zɔ ɔ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ kaa nike ní pɔtɛɛ ko. E blɔ nya nɔ́ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Lohwe ɔ gugue, kɛ e hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ji nike ní pɔtɛɛ nɛ Yawɛ he ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a dɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ. Nike ní nɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ be tsuaa be.

english_verse: These are the ceremonies for sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessing or his forgiveness, as well as the ceremonies for those sacrifices that demand a payment and for the sacrifices that are offered when priests are ordained.
translation_verse: Mlaahi nɛ ngɛ kɛ ha sami bɔ, niye ní bɔ, yayami pami bɔ, fɔ yemi bɔ, osɔfo womi bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Yawɛ wo Mose mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ a nike ní kɛ ba ha lɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Mose wo agbosu ɔ gugue ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, ke a gbe agbosu kɛ pee kusumi kɛ wo osɔfo ɔ, Mose lɛɛ e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, a tade ɔmɛ, nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ, na ku ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ kusii kɛ e mi abolo kplolo ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya;

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: nɛ o kpee ma a tsuo kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord, and when everyone had come together,
translation_verse: Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ, nɛ benɛ ma a tsuo ba kpe ɔ,

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: e de mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Mose ngɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba nɛ e ba du a he ha mɛ.

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: E ngɔ yi nɔ tade ɔ ngɔ wo Aaron, nɛ e kɛ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ fi e mlɛ mi, nɛ e wo lɛ tade klɔii ɔ. Jehanɛ e ngɔ tade nɛ a tsɛɛ efɔd ɔ ngɔ wo lɛ, nɛ e kɛ efɔd ɔ he kpa nɛ a lo lɛ saminyayoo ɔ fi efɔd ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ hiɔwe tade ɔ nɛ Urim kɛ Tumim ngɛ mi ɔ ngɔ wo lɛ.

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: E bu lɛ pɛɛ kɛ e hɛ mi sika tsu june nɛ ji jlasi klɔuklɔu kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ Mose ɔ.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ kɛ pɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ pee mɛ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: E kɛ nu ɔ eko fĩa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ si kpaago kɛ pɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ kã a kɛ e sisi kla a nu, nɛ e kɛ tsukɔ a he.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: E plɛ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ eko kɛ pue Aaron yi mi kɛ pɔ lɛ nu kɛ tsukɔ e he.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e ngɔ hiɔwe tadehi kɛ wo mɛ, nɛ e kɛ mlɛ mi fimi níhi fi a mlɛ mi ha mɛ, nɛ e bu mɛ pɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Mose ngɔ na ku ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ a nine kɛ pue lohwe ɔ yi mi.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Mose gbe lohwe ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he. Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi. Blɔ nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Mose ngɔ zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a, kɛ se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a he zɔ ɔ tsuo, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Se lohwe ɔ he womi ɔ, e lo ɔ, kɛ e mi fĩ ɔmɛ lɛɛ, e ya sã ngɛ ma si tomi he ɔ se kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ a nine ngɔ pue lohwe ɔ yi mi.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Mose gbe lohwe ɔ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e saa agbosu ɔ, nɛ e poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ e fɔ e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e nane ɔmɛ a he. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a, Mose sã e yi ɔ, zɔ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Niye ní bɔ nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ agbosu enyɔne ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi kɛ wo osɔfo ɔ hu kɛ ba, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ a nine ngɔ pue e yi mi.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Mose gbe lɛ, nɛ e ngɔ e muɔ ɔ eko kɛ sa Aaron hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ eko sa e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku ɔ kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku ɔ he.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e ngɔ zɔ ɔ kɛ e hlemi ɔ, kɛ zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a, se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: E je abolo kplolo kake, kɛ abolo nɛ a futu mi nu, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ kake kɛ je abolo kplolo nɛ ngɛ kusii nɛ maa si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ mi kɛ pue zɔ ɔ, kɛ hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: E ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a wo nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Mose he ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ e sã mɛ kɛ piɛ sami bɔ ɔ he ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Osɔfo womi bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Mose ngɔ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ eko, kɛ muɔ nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hu eko, nɛ e kɛ fĩa Aaron kɛ e tade ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a tade ɔmɛ a nɔ. Mose pee enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsukɔ Aaron kɛ e tade ɔmɛ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a tade ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Burn what is left over
translation_verse: Lo, loo abolo nɛ maa piɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ sã.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ a pee mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, ja nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a pee, konɛ a kɛ je nyɛ he yayami.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hi kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi kpaago kɛ tsu ní tsumi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ wo nyɛ dɛ ɔ; ke pi ja a, nyɛ ma gbo. Bɔ nɛ a fa mi ke ma de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke a pee ɔ.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mose tsɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ,

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: nɛ e de Aaron ke, “Ngɔɔ na niheyo, kɛ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ. Ngɔɔ na niheyo ɔ kɛ sa yayami pami bɔ, nɛ o ngɔ agbosu ɔ kɛ sã sami bɔ.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ akpakpo kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a ngɔ na bi nɛ ye jeha kake, kɛ jijɔ nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sa sami bɔ.

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: Á ngɔ na ku, kɛ agbosu kɛ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha Yawɛ kɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ nɛ a futu mi nu ɔ he. Á pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ ma je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: A ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa mɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mose de mɛ ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa ke nyɛɛ pee konɛ nyɛɛ na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose de Aaron ke, “Yaa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ o ya sã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ sami bɔ kɛ je o kɛ ma a tsuo nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ. Sãã bɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ o kɛ je ma a he yayami ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a.”

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Aaron hɛ lɛ kɛ su bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e gbe na niheyo ɔ nɛ e kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: E binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ya ha lɛ, nɛ e ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e sã zɔ ɔ kɛ se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Se lohwe ɔ lo ɔ kɛ e he womi ɔ lɛɛ e ya sã mɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e gbe lohwe ɔ nɛ e kɛ maa sã sami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ. E binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: A ngɔ lohwe ɔ yi ɔ, kɛ lo ɔ nɛ a poo kpɔ nya kpɔ nya a kɛ ha lɛ, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e sã niye ní bɔ ɔ. E piti ngma a e dɛ kɔkɔ kake, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ piɛ mɔtu sami bɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: E gbe na ku ɔ, kɛ agbosu ɔ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ kɛ ha ma a. E binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Na ku ɔ zɔ ɔ, agbosu ɔ zɔ ɔ, kɛ hlemi ɔ, kɛ se tso mi ngmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a,

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa ke a pee ɔ, gugue ɔmɛ, kɛ hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ɔ lɛɛ Aaron wo a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Mose kɛ Aaron sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ a je kpo ɔ, a gbaa ma a. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je kpo, nɛ ma a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ na.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, Yawɛ ha nɛ la ba, nɛ e ba sã sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ zɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ. Benɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a he ose, nɛ a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Aaron binyumuhi, Nadab kɛ Abihu a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e ngɛyu, nɛ e je la ngɔ wo mi, nɛ e ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɔ pue nɔ, nɛ e kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi; se la nɛ ɔ he tsɔ we, ejakaa Yawɛ fa we mɛ ke a pee ja.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, la je Yawɛ ngɔ ba sã mɛ, nɛ a gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose de Aaron ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ nɛ. E ke, ‘Nihi nɛ hɛ mɛ kɛ su ye he ɔ, ma tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ i ngɛ klɔuklɔu ha, nɛ a maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami ngɛ ma a tsuo hɛ mi.’ ” Se Aaron de we nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Mose tsɛ Aaron tsɛ nyɛminyumu Uziel bimɛ, Mishael kɛ Elzafan kɛ ba, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ba muɔ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ho ma a sito he ɔ se ya.”

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose de Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, Eleazar kɛ Itamar ke, “Nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ nyɛ yi bwɔmi he kɛ pue nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko hía nyɛ tadehi ngɛ nyɛ he hulɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma gbo, nɛ Yawɛ mi mi ma fu ma a tsuo. Se nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel we ɔ tsuo kulaa ma nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ nɛ a nyɛ ya ha gbogboe ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ la sã a.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko je kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya kɛ ya he ko. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma gbo; ejakaa a kɛ Yawɛ nu pɔ nyɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de ɔ. Mlaa nɛ a wo osɔfo ɔmɛ

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ Aaron tu munyu, nɛ e de lɛ ke,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “O kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó nu wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa kɛ ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma gbo. Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha nyɛ kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu, kɛ nɔ́ gu a kpɛti, nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ we.

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo kulaa nɛ́ imi Yawɛ, i wo mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Mose de Aaron kɛ e binyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ, nɛ ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar ke, “Niye ní bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ; nyɛ ko wo mi masa nɛ nyɛɛ ye ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya, ejakaa e he tsɔ saminya.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, ejakaa bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ haa Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ nyɛ blɔ fami nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ to ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Fiɔ ɔ, kɛ gugue ɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, á ngɔ kɛ piɛ zɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã a he kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Fiɔ ɔ, kɛ gugue ɔ maa pee o kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ nyɛ nɔ́ kɛ yaa neneene kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, Mose hla mi fitsofitso konɛ e le nɔ́ ko ngɛ apletsi ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ he. Benɛ e na le kaa a sã lɛ momo ɔ, e mi mi fu Eleazar kɛ Itamar, Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke,

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ yi yayami pami bɔ ɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ? Nyɛ li kaa e ji nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ Mawu kɛ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ je ma a he yayami kɛ kpata Yawɛ kɛ ha mɛ lo?

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ ngɔɛ e muɔ ɔ kɛ yɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ ye bɔ sami ní ɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛkɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa nyɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Aaron he nɔ ke, “O nɛ, mwɔnɛ ɔ, ma a ngɔ a he yayami pami bɔ ɔ, kɛ a sami bɔ ɔ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba ye nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Kaa i ye yayami pami bɔ nɛ ɔ eko mwɔnɛ ɔ, e ko sa Yawɛ hɛ mi lo?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mose nu munyu nɛ ɔ, munyu ɔ da ha lɛ.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ. Lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You may eat anything that lives in water and has fins and scales. But it would be disgusting for you to eat anything else that lives in water, and you must not even touch their dead bodies.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyu mi nɛ wami ngɛ e mi, se e be se ngmo kɛ toto ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; a he tsɔ we.

english_verse: Eagles, vultures, buzzards, crows, ostriches, hawks, sea gulls, owls, pelicans, storks, herons, hoopoes, and bats are also disgusting, and you are forbidden to eat any of them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ye lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ kɛ a henɔ nɛ ɔmɛ: kɔle, okpoku, pa nɔ kɔle, kayo, kɔɔkɔmite, duguma, anuma, nyɔ mi kayo, klomi, nga mi kpakpahe, pa nɔ kayo, omiɔhɔɔ, kpokukpoku, godo, kɔne, loo apani.

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Se lohwe tsɔwi nane eywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ tee kpahi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; a he tsɔ we.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: tsunyɛ, nyaka, akɔtɔku, angmlɔ, kɛ akpasi.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: A he tsɔ we, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta eko gbogboe he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ke lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe ko ya nɔ buɛ mi ɔ, e bleɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ buɛ ɔ mi ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, á ywia buɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ke buɛ nɛ ɔ mi nyu ɔ eko pue niye ní ko nɔ ɔ, niye ní ɔ he be tsɔe. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a nuu nɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a buɛ ɔ mi ɔ he be tsɔe.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ kikɛmɛ a lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe maa nɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he be tsɔe, la tɛ jio, flɔɔnɔɔ jio, á ywia nɔ́ ɔ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ke lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe ya nɔ nyu hɛngmɛ, loo nyu nɔ́ ko mi ɔ, nyu ɔ he tsɔ; se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa sa a gbogboe he ɔ he tsɔ we.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Ke lohwe gbogboe ɔ he ko nɔ wu nɛ a yaa du nɔ ɔ, e be wu ɔ blee,

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: se ke a wo wu ɔ nyu nɛ lohwe gbogboe nɔ nɔ ɔ, e bleɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, ke lohwehi nɛ a yeɔ ɔ eko gbo ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa ta e gbogboe ɔ he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: Don't eat any of those disgusting little creatures that crawl or walk close to the ground.
translation_verse: Ke a sãã si ngɛ a mi nɔ jio, a nane eywiɛ nɔ jio, a nane babauu nɔ jio, nyɛ ko ye; a he tsɔ we.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ta lohwehi nɛ sãã si ɔ eko he. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ bleɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ he tsɔ we.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu; ejakaa Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ji mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lohwehi nɛ sãã si ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ ekoeko kɛ ble nyɛ he.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Imi ji Yawɛ. Imi nɛ I je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ ma ba pee nyɛ Mawu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu; ejakaa Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ji mi.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ, kɛ lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ we a kpɛti, kɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ lohwehi nɛ a yeɔ, kɛ lohwehi nɛ a yi a kpɛti.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Ke yo ko ngɔ hɔ nɛ e fɔ binyumu ɔ, e he be tsɔe ligbi kpaago, kaa bɔ nɛ e he be tsɔe, ke e ku nine ɔ.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Ke binyumu ɔ ye ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ, á po lɛ.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: Se ke biyo e fɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e he be tsɔe otsi enyɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ e he be tsɔe, ke e ku nine ɔ. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si ligbi nyingmi ekpa kɛ ekpa nɛ e maa tsukɔ e he kɛ gbe nya.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ke yo ɔ gbe e he tsukɔmi ɔ nya ngɛ binyumu, loo biyo fɔmi se ɔ, e ngɔ jijɔ nɛ ye jeha kake, kɛ lahuɛ, loo beleku lahuɛ kake kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ jijɔ ɔ kɛ sã sami bɔ. Lahuɛ, loo beleku lahuɛ ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ e pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ yo ɔ he; kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha yihi tsuo nɛ ma fɔ binyumu, loo biyo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Yawɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: Ke nɔfu nɔ́ ko, aloo pa, loo loholoho ba nɔ ko he, nɛ́ ma nyɛ maa pee he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a, a ngɔ hiɔtsɛ ɔ kɛ ba osɔfo ɔ, nɛ ji Aaron nina a ngɔ.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ e he womi ɔ he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Ke bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsake pee futaa, nɛ lejɛ ɔ lo ɔ hu nɔ mi ɔ, lɛɛ e ji he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya. Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ ta a, e ma ha nɛ a le kaa nɔ ɔ he tsɔ we.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Se ke he womi ɔ nɔ he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ ngɛ futaa, nɛ ke a hyɛ ɔ, e nɔɛ lo mi, nɛ pohu bwɔmi ɔ be futaa hulɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Ligbi kpaagone ɔ nɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu. Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ nɛ e na kaa hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si, se he kake ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, e tsi e nya ligbi kpaago ekohu.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ, nɛ e na kaa nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ ha si ɔ, e ha nɛ a le kaa e he tsɔ we; he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ,

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: nɛ e hyɛ lɛ. Ke e na nɔfu nɔ́ ko ngɛ e he womi nɔ, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee futaa, nɛ bua ba nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ,

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu. Ke e na kaa hiɔtsɛ ɔ he womi ɔ pee futaa a, e ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ. E he tsɔ niinɛ.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: nɛ nɔfu nɔ́ futaa, loo nɔ́ futaa nɛ tsutsuu su bɔɔ ngɛ mi je kpo ngɛ pa doku ɔ mi ɔ, e kɛ ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ, nɛ e na kaa lejɛ ɔ nɔ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee futaa a, e ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we; he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ́ je kpo ngɛ tslɔɔ mi nɔ ɔ ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Se ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ, nɛ e na kaa bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee we futaa, nɛ e nɔɛ lo mi hulɔ, se nɔ́ ɔ fani ɔ, lɛɛ e tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Ke nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ ha si ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ hiɔ ɔ e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ; osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Se ke nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ he kake, nɛ e hɛ́ si ɔ, lɛɛ e ji tslɔɔ pa doku kɛkɛ; osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: Ke la sã nɔ ko nɛ e pee pa, nɛ pa a pee loholoho futaa, loo futaa nɛ tsutsuu bɔɔ ngɛ mi ɔ,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ. Ke e na kaa lejɛ ɔ nɔ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ loholoho ɔ mi ɔ pee futaa a, lɛɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ je e he kpo ngɛ la pa a mi ɔ nɛ; osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ nɔ ɔ, nɛ e na kaa bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee we futaa, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔɛ lo mi hulɔ, se e fani ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi e nya ligbi kpaago.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nɛ ke e na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ si hae ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we; ejakaa he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Ke nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ he kake, nɛ e hɛ́ si ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ, se e fani mohu ɔ, lɛɛ nɔfu nɔ́ nɛ je kpo ngɛ pa a mi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ, ejakaa e ji la pa doku kɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: Ke nɔ́ ko pue nyumu ko, loo yo ko yi mi, loo e kpɛni he ɔ,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ. Ke he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ nɔ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hɛɛ kungwɔ zɔ su, nɛ e pee dleledlele ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa yi mi, loo kpɛni mi he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ plɛɛ nɔ e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ; e he tsɔ we.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Se ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ hiɔ ɔ, nɛ e na kaa lejɛ ɔ nɔɛ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi yumu hu be mi ɔ, lɛɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e hyɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ ekohu. Ke hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ hɛɛ kungwɔ zɔ su be mi, nɛ lejɛ ɔ hu nɔɛ lo mi ɔ,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: lɛɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ sɛ lejɛ ɔ bwɔmi ɔ pɛ kɛ bɔle nɔ́ ɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ plɛe ɔ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago ekohu.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ hiɔ ɔ ekohu. Ke hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si, nɛ e nɔɛ lo mi hulɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ. Hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ.

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ. Ke ngmo ɔ su ngɛ kaa la zu huataa a, lɛɛ e ji kó kɛkɛ nɛ je kpo ngɛ e he womi nɔ; nɔ ɔ he tsɔ.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ. Ke e na kaa nɔ́ nɛ pue nɔ ɔ yi mi, loo e hɛ nya a ngɛ futaa nɛ tsutsuu bɔɔ fia mi ɔ,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ɔ, é wo tade gbagbɛ, é ngmɛɛ e yi bwɔmi he kɛ pue e nɔ, e ha e nya nɔ, nɛ e hi ngmlaa kpae ke, “Ye he tsɔ we oo, ye he tsɔ we!”

english_verse: because the mildew has spread.” Then he will burn the clothing or the piece of leather.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã he hami nɔ́ ɔ. Hiɔ yaya ji nɔ́ nɛ sɛ nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ nɛ; e hia kaa a sã.

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: e ha nɛ a fɔ he, nɛ e tsi nya ligbi kpaago ekohu.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ; ke nɔ́ fu ja a su tsakee we, nɛ e hɛ́ si hulɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he tsɔ we; nyɛɛ sã. Nɔ́ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ fu ja a jio, e se mi jio, á sã.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, ke nɔtsɛ ɔ na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ ja fue kɛ ngɛ si hae ngɛ he hami nɔ́, loo lohwe he womi ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a sã nɔ́ ɔ.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Ke e fɔ nɔ́ ɔ he, nɛ e na kaa nɔ́ yaya a je mi pɛsɛɛ ɔ, e fɔ he ekohu si enyɔne, kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he ma tsɔ kulaa.

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: e fa nɛ a kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ enyɔ, seda tso, kɔjai, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ nɛ ba.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ fa nɛ a gbe lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔ kake ngɛ zu buɛ nɛ nyu mua ngɛ mi nɔ,

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: konɛ e ngɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ, seda tso ɔ, kɔjai ɔ, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ sɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ a gbe ɔ ngɛ nyu mua nɔ ɔ muɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, é fĩa muɔ ɔ si kpaago kɛ pue nɔ nɛ nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ nɔ, nɛ é ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, é ngmɛɛ lohwe hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ he nɛ é te kɛ ho nga mi ya.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é sɛ e he bwɔmi tsuo, nɛ é du e he; kɛkɛ e he ma tsɔ. E ma nyɛ maa ba ma sito he ɔ, se e be e bo tsu ɔ mi hwɔe; e maa hi e bo tsu ɔ se ligbi kpaago.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ sɛ e yi kpalokpalo; é sɛ e kpɛni kɛ e hɛngmɛ se bwɔmi, kɛ e he bwɔmi tsuo kulaa. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he, kɛkɛ e he ma tsɔ.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, é ngɔ agbosu enyɔ nɛ kpa ko be a he, kɛ jijɔ yo nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ lɛ hu kpa ko be e he, kɛ níye ní bɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu mi, kɛ nu lita fa kɛ ba.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ maa tsukɔ nɔ ɔ he ha lɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ, kɛ e ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti kake kɛ piɛ nu lita fa a he kɛ ba kaa fɔ yemi bɔ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: É gbe agbosu ɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, he nɛ a gbee lohwe nɛ a kɛ sãã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ. Ejakaa yayami pami bɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ; e ngɛ klɔuklɔu saminya.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ a kɛ ba sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ e muɔ eko kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, kɛ e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku he.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ plɛ nu ɔ eko kɛ wo lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ dɛ kɔkɔ mi.

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: É kɛ e hiɔ nine nguɛ kake nɛ sɔ nu ɔ mi, nɛ é fĩa si kpaago ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: É ngɔ nu ɔ nɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ eko nɛ e kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku he. E ngɔ lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ hu muɔ kɛ pee ja nɔuu.

english_verse: and he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then he will offer the other two animals—one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ, nɛ e sã mɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ.

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: kɛ lahuɛ enyɔ, aloo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ. Kake maa pee yayami pami bɔ, nɛ kake hu maa pee sami bɔ.

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: E he tsukɔmi be ɔ, ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, é gbe agbosu ɔ, nɛ é ngɔ e muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, kɛ e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku he.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ plɛ nu ɔ eko kɛ wo lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ nine dɛ kɔkɔ mi,

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: nɛ e ngɔ e hiɔ nine nguɛ kake kɛ sɔ nu ɔ mi nɛ e fĩa si kpaago ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ nu nɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ eko kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ muɔ ɔ pee ɔ.

english_verse: And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ kake ɔ hu nɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ he. Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue, nɛ be nyɛe ma ha ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ e he ɔ, mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Wehi nɛ a he fu ja

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɔɔ wehi nɛ a he fu ja a he. Ke Israel bi ɔmɛ ya su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mɛ kaa a weto ní ɔ nɔ ɔ, mlaa nɛ sa kaa a ye nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na nɔ́ ko nɛ fu ja ngɛ e we he ɔ, e ha nɛ osɔfo nɛ le.

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: nɛ e ya hyɛ he nɛ fu ja a. Ke e na nɔ́ tsu, loo nɔ́ nɛ hɛɛ ba mumu su nɛ ha si ngɛ gli ɔ he ɔ,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: osɔfo ɔ nɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ a nga we ɔ nya ligbi kpaago.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ kpale ya hyɛ ekohu. Ke e na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ha si ngɛ gli ɔ he ɔ,

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ a ngmla gli ɔ tsuo he ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a bua zu ɔ nya kɛ ya pue he ngɛ kuku nɔ ngɛ ma a se.

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, á ngɔ tɛ kpahi kɛ tsi puɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ́ a ngɔ zu kpa kɛ kã gli ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: osɔfo ɔ nɛ kpale ya hyɛ ekohu. Ke e na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ha si ngɛ gli ɔ he ɔ, lɛɛ e ji nɔ́ yaya nɛ maa ye awi; we ɔ he tsɔ we.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ a ku we ɔ kɛ pue si nɛ a muɔ tɛ ɔmɛ, tso ɔmɛ, kɛ zu ɔ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ya pue kuku nɔ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa sɛ we ɔ mi, be mi nɛ a nga we ɔ nya a, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hwɔ we ɔ mi, loo e maa ye ní ngɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: Se ke a kɛ zu kpa kã gli ɔ he, nɛ lɔ ɔ se osɔfo ɔ ba hyɛ, nɛ e nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ he ɔ, e ha nɛ a le kaa we ɔ he tsɔ; ejakaa a je nɔ́ nɛ fu ja a tsuo kɛ je gli ɔ mi.

english_verse: Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ enyɔ, seda tso, kɔjai, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ kɛ ba, konɛ a kɛ julaa we ɔ.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: É gbe lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔmɛ a ti kake ngɛ zu buɛ nɛ nyu mua ngɛ mi nɔ.

english_verse: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ e kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔ muɔ, nyu mua a, lohwe pɛlitsɛ hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ, seda tso ɔ, nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ ɔ, kɛ kɔjai ɔ maa julaa we ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ be mi nɛ nɔ́ ko he tsɔ we kɛ be mi nɛ nɔ́ ɔ he tsɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean,
translation_verse: kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Ke nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ nyumu ko he ɔ, nyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ bee ɔ ha nyumu ɔ he tsɔ we.

english_verse: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ nɛ nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e nyumu tso mi ɔ he ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ nɛ nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ la lada pue nɔ ko nɛ he tsɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ́ ko nɛ nɔ ɔ hi nɔ he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa tloo jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ke nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ nɔ ko he, nɛ e fɔ we e dɛ, nɛ e ta nɔ ko he ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ e ta e he ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Zu buɛ saisaa nɛ nɔ nɛ nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ maa ta he ɔ, a ywia lɛ, se tso sowe nɛ e maa ta he lɛɛ a fɔ he.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, e ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔ.

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ kake hu kɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ ngɛ nyu yaya nɛ be ngɛ e he ɔ he.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ke nyumu ko he nyu be ngɛ e he ɔ, e du e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Sa nɔ bo, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ lohwe he womi pee, nɛ nyumu ɔ he nyu nɛ ɔ ma pue nɔ ɔ, á fɔ he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
