english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ke nyumu kɛ yo na bɔmi nɛ nyumu ɔ he nyu be ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a du a he. A he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ke yo ko ku nine ɔ, e he be tsɔe ligbi kpaago; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta e he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta sa, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ yo nɛ ɔ hi nɔ ɔ he ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Ke nyumu ko kɛ yo nɛ ɔ na bɔmi be mi nɛ e ku nine ɔ, jamɛ a nyumu ɔ ble e he, nɛ e he be tsɔe ligbi kpaago. Sa tsuaa sa nɛ e maa hwɔ nɔ ɔ hu he be tsɔe.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Sa tsuaa sa nɛ e maa hwɔ nɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa hi nɔ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he be tsɔe.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e he be tsɔe. Nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ, yo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ kake ɔ hu kɛ sã sami bɔ. Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha yo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke e slɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he nɛ tsɔ we ɔ he, konɛ a ko ble Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ. Ke pi ja a, a ma gbo.

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: E de lɛ ke, “De o nyɛminyumu Aaron ke e ko ya he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ se be saisaa, konɛ e ko gbo. Ejakaa lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i jeɔ ye he kpo ngɛ ngɛ bɔku mi, ngɛ somi daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: E ma nyɛ maa ya he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ke e hɛɛ na niheyo kɛ ha yayami pami bɔ sami, nɛ e hɛɛ agbosu hu kɛ ha sami bɔ.”

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Aaron nɛ he akpakpo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ agbosu kake nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo dɛ.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: É sã na ku ɔ kaa yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ é kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ kɛ e we ɔ.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, é ngɔ akpakpo enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ sɔ ɔ je ɔ, a kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Azazel nɔ́ ɔ je ɔ, a kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi hɛ ngmengmle, nɛ a kɛ ba kpata Yawɛ ha ma a. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a je lɛ we kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya kɛ ya ha Azazel.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Ke Aaron maa sã na ku ɔ kaa yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛ e we ɔ,

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: e ngɔ ngɛyu kɛ je la ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e piti tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a wɛɛ lɛ bukɔbukɔ dɛ kɔkɔ enyɔ, nɛ e kɛ sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: E ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via a ngɔ pue la a mi ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e wo la su ku nɛ mi ti kɛ tsi somi daka nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Aaron ko na somi daka nya nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e ba gbo.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: É ngɔ na ku ɔ muɔ eko, nɛ e kɛ e nine nguɛ nɛ sɔ mi nɛ e kɛ fĩa somi daka nya nɔ ɔ hɛ mi. É kɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ fĩa somi daka nitsɛ hu hɛ mi si kpaago.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, é gbe akpakpo ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma yayami pami bɔ sami ha ma a. É ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ba he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, nɛ e ya fĩa kɛ pue somi daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, kɛ somi daka a he kɛ kpe kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ na ku ɔ muɔ ɔ pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: É pee kusumi nɛ ɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a musuhi nɛ a bɔ, mlaahi a nɔ nɛ a tɔ, kɛ yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ tsuo kulaa he. É pee kusumi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ hulɔ; ejakaa e ngɛ ma sito he ɔ he nɛ a ble ɔ.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: é je kpo kɛ ya bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ he, nɛ e ya kpata Yawɛ kɛ ha la tɛ ɔ. É ngɔ na ku ɔ muɔ ɔ eko, kɛ akpakpo ɔ hu muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: É ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ fĩa muɔ ɔ eko kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ si kpaago. É tsukɔ he, nɛ é pee lɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ yayamihi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee kɛ ble la tɛ ɔ he. Musu kpami to

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Ke Aaron pee kusumi ɔ kɛ tsukɔ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he gbe nya a, é ngɔ akpakpo hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Akpakpo ɔ maa tloo Israel bi ɔmɛ a he musu tsuo kɛ maa ho zugba nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ ɔ nɔ ya.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: É du e he ngɛ he ko nɛ tsɔ, nɛ é wo lɛ nitsɛ e tade ɔmɛ. Jehanɛ, é je kpo nɛ e ya sã sami bɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, kɛ ma a hulɔ.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma yayami pami bɔ ɔ sami ɔ, e sã e zɔ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Nɔ ɔ nɛ fie to ɔ kɛ ya ha Azazel ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ nɛ e wo ɔ a he, nɛ e du e he loko e ba ma sito he ɔ.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ maa sã ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he loko é ba ma sito he ɔ. Kpatami ligbi ɔ yemi

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene. Nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a, Israel fɔfɔɛ, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ a kpɛti tsuo maa ha hwɔ, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko tsue.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a maa pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha mɛ kɛ tsukɔ a he kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa mi, konɛ a he nɛ tsɔ.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ maa pee Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko tsue; nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ha hwɔ. Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ fɔɔ si ha mɛ kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: E maa tsukɔ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, kpe he bo tsu ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a he.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Á ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya neneene. Daa jeha a, a maa pee kusumi nɛ ɔ si kake kɛ kpata Mawu ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he. Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko gbe na, loo jijɔ, loo apletsi ngɛ he kpa ko nɛ pi kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, e tɔ mlaa. Jamɛatsɛ ɔ pue muɔ si. Á je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ fĩa muɔ ɔ kɛ pue Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, konɛ é sã zɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ jee via ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, a je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo nɔ ko nɛ ba to mɛ nubwɔ ya da de nɛ e gbe lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ, loo pɛlitsɛ nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, é dɛ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue si, nɛ e ngɔ zu ngɔ pue nɔ.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa muɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ haa he lo tsuaa he lo wami. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ Yawɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ko ye muɔ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee ja a, á je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Ke e fɔ we e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ́ e du e he ɔ, e musu maa tloo lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Imi ji, Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Egipt bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ hi a zugba a nɔ ɔ, kɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ yaa a zugba a a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko pee a kusumi níhi.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: O kɛ o tsɛ e yo kpa ko kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ o ba pue o tsɛ hɛ mi si.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: O kɛ yo kɛ e biyo tsuo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi. O kɛ yo ɔ e bibi hu kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, e binyumu biyo jio, e biyo ɔ biyo jio. Ke o pee ja a, o bɔ musu, ejakaa nyɛmimɛ tutuutu ji mɛ.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Koo ngɔ nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi nɛ a ba pee huno yihi, be mi nɛ e nyɛmi ɔ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: “O kɛ yo nɛ ku nine kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa e he tsɔ we.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: O kɛ o nyɛmi e yo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ o kó ba ble o he.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Koo ngɔ o bimɛ ɔmɛ eko kɛ ha nɛ a sã ha mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Molek ɔ. Ke o pee ja a, o gbe Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ he guɛ.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Nyumu kɛ nyumu kó na bɔmi kaa yo kɛ nyumu; a hĩɔ.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: “Je ma amɛ nɛ i ngɛ fiee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ blɔ mi jee ɔ, níhi nɛ a pee nɛ a kɛ ble a he,

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ ble zugba a hulɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ zugba a tue gblae, nɛ zugba a hu ngɛ ni ɔmɛ fiee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ loko nyɛ ba a bɔ musu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ble zugba a.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ hu nyɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ble zugba a, zugba a maa fie nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e fie nihi nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ loko nyɛ ba a.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Musu bɔmi níhi nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hi zugba a nɔ kekle ɔ pee ɔ, nyɛ ko pee nɛ nyɛ ba ble nyɛ he. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: e de Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, ejakaa imi Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko je ye se nɛ nyɛ ya ja amagahi; nɛ nyɛ ko pee dade mawuhi ha nyɛ he. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Á ye lo ɔ ligbi nɛ a maa gbe lohwe ɔ, aloo e nɔ jena. Ke eko piɛ nɛ ye ligbi etɛ ɔ, á sã,

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Ke kaa nɔ ko ye eko ligbi etɛne ɔ, i be e bɔ ngɔe, ejakaa a hĩɔ.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye eko ɔ, a gbla e tue, ejakaa e ble Yawɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu ɔ. A ma je lɛ we, nɛ a be lɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ní kpae ɔ, nyɛ ko kpa ní ɔ kɛ ya su ngmɔ ɔ tue haa. Nyɛ ko muɔ nɔ́ nɛ ma pue si ngɛ ní kpami ɔ se hulɔ.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Wai ngmɔtsɛ kó kpa wai yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ e wai tso ɔmɛ a nɔ. Wai yiblii nɛ maa nɔɔ si ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ hu e ko ya kukuɔ. E si ha ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nibwɔhi. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko ju; nyɛ ko sisi nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi lakpa.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko ngɔ ye biɛ kɛ ka lakpa kita kɛ wo ye biɛ he mu. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: “Koo fia o nyɛmi ojo, nɛ koo ju e nɔ́ ko hulɔ. Ke o ya bɔ nɔ ko apaa ke e ba tsu ní ha mo ɔ, wo lɛ hiɔ loko je nɛ na nɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Koo gbiɛ tue kpokutsɛ, nɛ koo fɔ hɛ yuyuilɔ blɔ mi tso. Ye o Mawu ɔ gbeye. Imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ye dami sane ngɛ kojomi mi; nyɛ ko hyɛ nɔ ko hɛ mi, ohiatsɛ ji lɛ jio, niatsɛ ji lɛ jio.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Koo pee o he sieku yelɔ kɛ hi yae kɛ hi bae ngɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Koo ye lakpa odase kɛ si o nyɛmi, nɛ́ a pue e muɔ si yaka gu. Imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: “Koo nyɛ o nyɛmi ngɛ o tsui mi. Ke sane ko ba a, o kɛ lɛ nɛ hla mi, konɛ e he ɔ, mo mohu o ko ba pee yayami.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Koo ye mo nitsɛ o he lue, nɛ koo nyɛ o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko; se mohu, moo suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi nɛ kuɔ henɔ kpahi nɛ a kɛ mɛ nɛ fɔ. Nyɛ ko du wu munomuno enyɔ ngɛ ngmɔ kake mi; nɛ nyɛ ko wo tade nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ slɔɔto enyɔ lo bo ɔ.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: “Ke nyumu ko kɛ nyɔguɛ yo ko nɛ a bi e si ha nyumu kpa na bɔmi be mi nɛ a kpɔ̃ we lɛ, loo e yi e he lolo ɔ, a hla munyu ɔ mi. A ko gbe mɛ, ejakaa nyɔguɛ ɔ yi e he lolo.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ sami ɔ kɛ ya Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ ya pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ngɛ yayami nɛ nɔ ɔ pee ɔ he, nɛ Mawu kɛ maa pa lɛ.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ ya su Kanaan zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ du tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ woɔ yiblii slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu a yiblii ɔmɛ kaa níhi nɛ a tsi nya kekleekle jeha etɛ ɔmɛ; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye eko.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Jeha eywiɛne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pee sina bɔ klɛdɛɛ ha imi Yawɛ.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Jeha enuɔne ɔ mi lɛɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye a yiblii ɔmɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, tso ɔmɛ maa wo yiblii babauu ha nyɛ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko ye lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ. Nyɛ ko klaa, nɛ nyɛ ko ye kunya hulɔ.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, nyɛ ko po nyɛ he ha, nɛ nyɛ ko ngmaangmaa nyɛ he kɛ ye kɔmɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: “Ko ha nɛ o biyo nɛ pee e he yaholɔ, nɛ e ba puɛ. Ke e pee ja a, yahomi kɛ musu bɔmi ma ba hiɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ bu kɛ ha ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ; imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko ya bi ní ngɛ klaali, kɛ kunya yeli a ngɔ; ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma ble nyɛ he. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: “Buu nɔkɔtɔma, nɛ o wo e hɛ mi nyami. Ye mi gbeye. Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: “Ke nɔ ko ba to nyɛ nubwɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko pee lɛ yayami.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ba to nyɛ nubwɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu lɛ kaa ma a mi no nɔuu. Moo suɔ lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he ɔ; ejakaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ya to nubwɔ hyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ sɛnihi, sɛni tɛhi, kɛ susumi níhi nɛ da kɛ tsu ní. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko, loo nubwɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɔ e bi kɛ ha nɛ a kɛ ja mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Molek ɔ, ma a tsuo nɛ fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e bi kɛ ha Molek, nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ble ye bo tsu klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ e kɛ puɛ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, nɛ ma je lɛ we; a be lɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: imi nitsɛ ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, kɛ e weku li, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ piɛ e he kɛ ya sɔmɔ Molek ɔ. Ma je mɛ we, nɛ a be mɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: “Ke nɔ ko je ye se nɛ e ya bi ní ngɛ klaali, kɛ kunya yeli a ngɔ ɔ, imi Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo lɛ, nɛ ma je lɛ we; a be lɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu, ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ peeɔ nyɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Yawɛ wo mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbiɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, á gbe lɛ; e gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ke Israel no ko kɛ e nyɛmi Israel no e yo na bɔmi ɔ, a puɛ gba; á gbe nyumu ɔ kɛ yo ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko kɛ e tsɛ e yo na bɔmi ɔ, e pue e tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi si. Á gbe nyumu ɔ kɛ yo ɔ tsuo. A gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ke nyumu ko kɛ e binyumu e yo na bɔmi ɔ, á gbe mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo. A bɔ musu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ a gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ke nyumu kɛ nyumu na bɔmi kaa nyumu kɛ yo bɔɔ ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a bɔ musu. Á gbe mɛ; a gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ke nyumu ko ngɔ nɔ kɛ e bi tsuo ɔ, e bɔ musu; a sã mɛ ni etɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ ko kó tsu musu ní nɛ ɔ eko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti hu.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ke yo ko ngɔ e he ngɔ ha lohwe ko, nɛ e kɛ lɛ na bɔmi ɔ, á gbe yo ɔ kɛ lohwe ɔ tsuo. A gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Ke nyumu ko kɛ e nyɛ nyɛmiyo, loo e tsɛ nyɛmiyo na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi ɔ, musu tloo mɛ, ejakaa nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ i wo nyɛ si ke, ma ngɔ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛ e pee nyɛ weto ní. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ; imi nɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi kɛ to ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, ejakaa imi Yawɛ ɔ, i ngɛ klɔuklɔu. I hla nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ pee ye ma.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: “Nyumu tsuaa nyumu, loo yo tsuaa yo nɛ hiaa, loo a biɔ ní ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo; e gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ma a mi bi ko gbo ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ya gbogboe ɔ he nɛ́ e ba ble e he,

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: loo e nyɛmiyo nɛ li nyumu. Akɛnɛ e nyɛmiyo ɔ be huno ɔ, e ma nyɛ ble e he ngɛ e he.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ko kó ble e he ngɛ e yo weku no ko nɛ gbo ɔ he.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: “Osɔfo ko po huɛ ngɛ e yi kpɛti, loo e sua e kpɛni he. E ko po e he ha, loo e ngmaa e he kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo nɛ pee e he klɔuklɔu, nɛ e ko pue ye hɛ mi si; ejakaa lɛ nɛ sãã niye ní bɔ ɔ haa imi Yawɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Osɔfo ko kó ngɔ yo yaholɔ, aloo yo nɛ nɔ ko puɛ lɛ. E ko ngɔ yo nɛ e kɛ e huno be hu, ejakaa lɛ osɔfo ɔ, nɔ klɔuklɔu ji lɛ.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Ma a nɛ bu osɔfo kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu, ejakaa lɛ nɛ e ngɔɔ niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba haa mi ɔ nɛ. Imi ji Yawɛ; i ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ i peeɔ ye ma a klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ke osɔfo ko biyo pee e he yaholɔ ɔ, e pue e tsɛ hɛ mi si. A sã lɛ nɛ e gbo.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Osɔfo nɛ ngɔ yo nɛ li nyumu.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: E ko ngɔ yalɔyo, aloo yo nɛ e kɛ e huno be hu, loo yo nɛ nɔ ko puɛ lɛ, loo yaholɔ. É ngɔ yo nɛ li nyumu kɛ je lɛ nitsɛ e weku mi.

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: Ke pi ja a, e bimɛ nɛ sa kaa a peeɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ, a he be tsɔe. Imi ji Yawɛ; imi nɛ i hla lɛ ngɔ to kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ ya nɔ nɛ e fa Mose ke

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he be he blɔ kaa e baa e Mawu ɔ hɛ mi haa, hɛ yuyuilɔ ji lɛ jio, libɔɔ ji lɛ jio, nɔ nɛ hɛ mi plaa hyɛ jio, nɔ nɛ kpa ko ngɛ e nane he jio,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: nɔ ko nɛ e nine, loo e nane ku jio,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: kpotsɛ jio, akɔtia jio, nɔ nɛ hɛngmɛ hiɔ ngɛ e he jio, nɔ nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ e he jio, nɔ nɛ sungmɛ mi wu ywia jio.

english_verse: These men may not serve as my priests and burn sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo Aaron nina ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he be he blɔ kaa e ngɔɔ niye ní bɔ kɛ ba haa Yawɛ.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ kpa ngɛ e he he je ɔ, e ko hɛ lɛ kɛ su tsu mi pomi bo ɔ, loo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. E ko ba ble ní klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ. Imi ji Yawɛ; imi nɛ i peeɔ mɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ Mose de Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ fa Mose ke

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: e de Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Ní klɔuklɔuhi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsukɔ he kɛ ha mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ a nɔ saminya, konɛ nyɛ ko pue ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi si. Imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: “Aaron nina ko nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue, aloo nɔ ko nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ, e ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko kɛ yaa si be nɛ e he ma tsɔ. Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo nɛ maa ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he ɔ, nɔ gbogboe he jio, nyumu nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he he jio,

english_verse: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.
translation_verse: nɔ́ ko nɛ sãã si nɛ he tsɔ we he jio, loo nɔmlɔ nɛ he tsɔ we he jio, e he be tsɔe.

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Ke pu nɔ si kɛkɛ e he tsɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko, ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ e yeɔ.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: E ko ye lohwe ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo, loo lohwe ko nɛ lohwe kpa ko tsɔtslɔɔ e mi; ke e ye ɔ, e ble e he. Imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: “Osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ye ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ. A ko ble a he. Ke a pee ja a, a pee yayami, nɛ a ma gbo. Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ tsukɔɔ a he ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: “Nɔ ko nɛ ji osɔfo weku mi ɔ, e ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko. Osɔfo we nubwɔ, loo e we apaatsɛ po e ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Ke osɔfo biyo ya gba nɔ ko nɛ pi osɔfo ji lɛ ɔ, biyo nɛ ɔ ko ye bɔ sami ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Se ke osɔfo ɔ biyo ya pee yalɔyo, loo e gba puɛ nɛ e be bi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ba e tsɛ we mi, nɛ e tsɛ ɔ ngɛ e nɔ hyɛe kaa sa a, e ma nyɛ maa ye e tsɛ ní ɔ eko. Nɔ ko nɛ ji osɔfo weku mi be he blɔ nɛ e yeɔ eko.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: A ko ngɔ lohwe ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he kɛ ba, ejakaa imi Yawɛ, i be ngɔe.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko ko ble ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ;

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: a ko ha nɔ ko nɛ sɛ́ nɛ ye eko. Ke a pee ja a, nɔ ɔ tɔ, nɛ a maa gbla e tue. Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ tsukɔɔ bɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ fa Mose ke,

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: e de Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ke, “Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo nubwɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti maa sã sami bɔ ha imi Yawɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e wo he si jio, bɔ nɛ je tsui mi faa jio,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha imi Yawɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e wo he si jio, bɔ nɛ je tsui mi faa jio, lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ, e pee lohwe nɛ kpa ko be e he, na jio, to jio.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Na ku, loo jijɔ bi nɛ e nine, loo e nane ka tsɔ ɔ, a ma nyɛ kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ je tsui mi faa. Se ke a kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a wo he si ɔ, lɛɛ a be ngɔe.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko he kikɛmɛ a lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko kɛ je nibwɔhi a dɛ kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ ha nyɛ Mawu ɔ; akɛnɛ kpa ngɛ a he ɔ, a be mɛ ngɔe.

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Ke a fɔ na, loo jijɔ, loo apletsi ɔ, e hi e nyɛ ɔ ngɔ ligbi kpaago. Kɛ je ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ kɛ yaa a, a ma nyɛ kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko gbe na kɛ e bi, loo to kɛ e bi tsuo ligbi kake.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sã sina bɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ mlaa a nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he nyɛ bɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye ní ɔ ligbi ɔ kɛ̃; je nɛ ko na yi. Imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, nyami behi nɛ a maa ye kɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsu ní ligbi ekpa, se ligbi kpaagone ɔ ji Hejɔɔmi ligbi. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ maa jɔɔ nyɛ he. Nyɛ ma bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ma ja Mawu. Nɔ ko nɛ ko tsu ní jamɛ a ligbi ɔ; ejakaa e ji he jɔɔmi ligbi ha Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ sihi he ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa.

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko tsu nɔ́ ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ, ejakaa e ji ligbi nɛ a maa pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: The first day of the seventh month must be a day of complete rest. Then at the sound of the trumpets, you will come together to worship and to offer sacrifices on the altar. The Great Day of Forgiveness (Numbers
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko. Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ba ha Yawɛ. Kpatami ligbi ɔ (Mose IV,

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ gbɔkuɛ ji Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ a kɛ woɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ sisije.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ligbi kpaago. Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ekohu nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ba su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ kpa ní ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ niba ní ɔ kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ bua nya kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a futu mi nu kilo enyɔ hu kɛ piɛ he kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi. Á ngɔ wai lita kake ngɔ piɛ he.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ye blɛfo kpokploku, loo blɛfo nɛ a sã, loo abolo kɛ yaa si be nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ Mawu ɔ bɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ maa fɔ si kɛ ha nyɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ yaa neneene. Ngmakpami nyami be ɔ (Mose IV,

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko tsu nɔ́ ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ we jena a nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa a kɛ ba a we otsi kpaago,

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: We puɔ nya tsuaa we puɔ nya nɛ ngɔ abolo bɔbɔɛ enyɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa. Abolo bɔbɔɛ tsuaa abolo bɔbɔɛ ɔ, a ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a wo mi masa kɛ pee. A ngɔ enɛ ɔ kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ kaa kekleekle niba ní bɔ.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, kɛ na niheyo kake, kɛ agbosu enyɔ nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ piɛ abolo ɔ he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ. Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ hu kɛ piɛ he. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku enyɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka kɛ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ abolo ɔ, kɛ jijɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa. Bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ kpa nyɛ zugba a nɔ ní ɔ, nyɛ ko kpa ngmɔ ɔ mi kɛ ngmɔ ɔ nya ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pi si; nɔ́ nɛ ma pue si, loo e maa piɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ ko kpale nyɛ se kɛ ya kpɛte. Nyɛ si ha ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ nibwɔhi. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. Jehahe nyami be (Mose IV,

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a ji kpatami ligbi ɔ nɛ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu. Nyɛɛ ha hwɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Kɛ je nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ we gbɔkuɛ ke pu nɔ si, kɛ yaa si ligbi nyɔngmane ɔ we gbɔkuɛ ke pu nɔ si ekohu ɔ nɛ pee he jɔɔmi be pɔtɛɛ kɛ ha nyɛ; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ha hwɔ. Gbasisihimi nyami be (Mose IV,

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tso yiblii kpakpahi, tã bahi, kɛ tso kusuuhi a kɔnihi kɛ a he ba nɛ nyɛ kɛ nya ligbi kpaago kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ligbi kpaago. Nyɛɛ je sisi ngɛ nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu. Nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Daa ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ sã niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago. Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ekohu nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ba ha Yawɛ. E ji jami ligbi; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Nyami be nɛ ɔmɛ piɛ Yawɛ daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he. Nike ní, kɛ bɔhi nɛ a maa sã kɛ piɛ nyɛ bɔhi nɛ nyɛ wo he si ɔ, kɛ bɔhi nɛ je tsui mi faa a a he ɔ, nyɛɛ sã mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ kpa nyɛ ngmɔ ní ɔmɛ gbe nya a, nyɛɛ ye nyami be ha Yawɛ ligbi kpaago, kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ. Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, kɛ ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ nɛ a pee he jɔɔmi ligbihi ha nyɛ.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nya ligbi kpaago ngɛ nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ mi; enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha nyɛ nina kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Israel fɔfɔɛ tsuo nɛ hi gbahi a sisi ligbi kpaago,

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛ nina nɛ na nɛ a le kaa gbahi a sisi nɛ Yawɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hi, benɛ i kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mose wo Israel ma a mlaa kaa a ye nyami behi kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko gbe lohwe ko ɔ, e to nane mi. Se ke e gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ, lɛ hu a gbe lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ fa Mose ke

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: e de Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ oliv nu nɛ a si mi nɛ e mi tsɔ ngleinglei kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ ba wo kane ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, konɛ la nɛ hi tsoe be tsuaa be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change. The Sacred Bread The Lord said:
translation_verse: Aaron nɛ to kane ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ kane tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha he ɔ nɔ, nɛ e hyɛ nɛ a hi tsoe daa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Abolo nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ sã abolo bɔbɔɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ to abolo ɔmɛ ngɛ za enyɔ mi kɛ pue okplɔɔ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha he ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Abolo ɔ ekpa nɛ hi za kake mi.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɔ pue abolo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ za enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, konɛ e pee abolo ɔ nane mi okadi kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, Aaron nɛ da Israel bi ɔmɛ a nane mi, nɛ e ngɔ abolo ɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ hɛ mi. Enɛ ɔ maa pee Israel bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Abolo nɛ ɔ maa pee Aaron kɛ e nina a nɔ́. A ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, ejakaa niye ní nɛ a kɛ ba sãã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́; e ji nɔ́ klɔuklɔu. Tue gblami nɛ da

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Nyumu ko hi si nɛ e tsɛ ɔ Egipt no, se e nyɛ lɛɛ Israel no. E nyɛ ɔ, Dibri nɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ biyo ji lɛ; nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shelomit. Nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ Israel no ko pɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ. Benɛ a ngɛ pɛe ɔ, nyumu ɔ gbiɛ Mawu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nu lɛ kɛ ya ha Mose.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Mose ha a tsi e nya kɛ yaa si be nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Jé nyumu ɔ nɛ bɔ musu ɔ kpo kɛ je ma sito he ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu e musu bɔmi munyu ɔ, é ngɔ e nine ngɔ pue nyumu ɔ yi mi, konɛ ma a tsuo nɛ fia lɛ tɛ.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: e sa nɛ a gbe lɛ. Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo nubwɔ nɛ maa bɔ musu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma a tsuo nɛ fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ, lɛ hu a gbe lɛ.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko gbe nɔ ko lohwe ɔ, e to nane mi. A ngɔ wami kɛ to wami nane mi.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: “Ke nɔ ko plaa nɔ ko ɔ, a pee lɛ ja kɛ to nane mi.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Nubwɔ jio, ma a mi no jio, mlaa kake nɛ ngɛ ha nyɛ tsuo. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mose kɛ Israel ma a tu munyu nɛ ɔ gbe nya a, a ngɔ nyumu ɔ nɛ bɔ musu ɔ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ, nɛ a ya fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Israel ma a pee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Ke o maa wo zugba ko he jua ha o nyɛmi ɔ, moo kane jeha abɔ nɛ piɛ nɛ a ma du ní ngɛ zugba a nɔ loko a maa ye Heyemi jeha a.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e fa lɛ

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: ke e wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ. Ke nyɛ su zugba nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ zugba a nɛ jɔɔ e he kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: nyɛ we mi lohwehi kɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo. Zugba a mi niba ní tsuo maa pee niye ní ha nyɛ. Ngwɔhe tomi jeha

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: loo e tsɛ nyɛminyumu, loo e tsɛ nyɛminyumu bi, loo e weku no pɔtɛɛ ko ma nyɛ ma kpɔ lɛ. Ke lɛ nitsɛ po e he ba hi ekohu ɔ, e ma nyɛ ma kpɔ e he.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nyɔhiɔ kpaago ɔ nɔ ligbi nyɔngma a nɛ ji kpatami ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ tsɔ nɛ a ya kpa titimati wawɛɛ kɛ kpa zugba a tsuo nɔ.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Jeha a tsuo maa pee klɔuklɔu ha nyɛ. Nyɛɛ ye niba ní nɛ nyɛ ma na ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ pɛ.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: Heyemi jeha nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, weto ní tsuo nɛ a jua a, a kpale kɛ ha nɔtsɛ.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Ke jeha nɛ piɛ ɔ hiɛ fuu ɔ, lɛɛ jua a maa ya hiɔwe, se ke jeha nɛ piɛ ɔ pi ɔ, lɛɛ jua a maa ba si; ejakaa niba ní nɛ a ma na kɛ maa je ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ a ngɛ juae ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ sibi Israel fɔfɔɛhi, se mohu nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye. Jeha kpaagone ɔ mi haomi komɛ

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Zugba a maa ba ní, nɛ nyɛ maa ye ní nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ; nɛ nyɛ maa hi zugba a nɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko ma bi ke, “Jeha kpaagone ɔ nɛ wa du we ní, nɛ wa kpa we ní hulɔ ɔ, mɛni wa maa ye mɔ.”

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa gbaa zugba a, nɛ niye ní babauu maa ba ngɛ jeha ekpane ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ ma na jeha etɛ nya niye ní jamɛ a jeha a.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní due ngɛ jeha kpaanyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa hi ngmɔ niba ní momo ɔ yee kɛ yaa si nyɛ ma kpa ní nɛ nyɛ du jamɛ a jeha a. Weto ní se kpalemi

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Zugba a, nyɛ ko jua nɛ e ba plɛ pee nɔ ko nɔ́ kulaa. Zugba a, Mawu nɔ́, pi nyɛ nɔ́. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu nibwɔhi nɛ ba ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛkɛ ji nyɛ.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Zugba a nɔ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ maa hi ɔ, ke a jua zugba a, a to blɔ nya kɛ ha zugba a kpɔmi hwɔɔ se.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Ke e fi Israel fɔfɔɛ ko nɛ e jua e zugba ko ɔ, e nyɛmi tutuutu nɛ yeɔ e ní ɔ nɛ kpɔ zugba a.

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi ja a, e bu akɔtaa; jeha abɔ nɛ e jua zugba a, kɛ jeha nɛ piɛ loko jeha a nɛ a maa kpale weto ní se kɛ ha nɔtsɛmɛ ɔ maa su, konɛ e wo jeha abɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ he hiɔ nɛ e ya ngɔ e ní.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ nɛ jua zugba a be nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ma kpɔ e weto ní nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ he zugba a maa pee nɔtsɛ kɛ yaa si weto ní se kpalemi jeha kpa maa su. Jamɛ a jeha a loko a maa kpale zugba a kɛ ha zugbatsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ke e nyɛ we nɛ e kpɔ ngɛ jeha kake mi ɔ, we ɔ maa pee nɔ nɛ he ɔ, kɛ e nina a nɔ́ kulaa. Weto ní se kpalemi jeha a mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ he we ɔ be he ngmɛɛe.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Se wehi nɛ ngɛ kɔpehi nɛ gbogbo be a he ɔ a mi ɔ lɛɛ a bu mɛ kaa ngmɔ kɛkɛ. A ma nyɛ ma kpɔ mɛ; ke weto ní se kpalemi jeha a su ɔ, nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ a he ha nitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a wehi nɛ ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi ɔ, a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a kpɔɔ mɛ be tsuaa be.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke Levi no ko jua e we ngɛ ma ko mi, nɛ e kpɔ we e we ɔ kɛ ya su weto ní se kpalemi jeha a mi po ɔ, a kpale e we ɔ kɛ ha lɛ; ejakaa Levi bi ɔmɛ a we ɔmɛ peeɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a weto ní kulaa ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Lohwe lɛmi zugbahi nɛ bɔle Levi bi ɔmɛ a ma amɛ hu peeɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a weto ní; a ko jua eko. Sika nɛ a paa ha ohiatsɛmɛ

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Ke e fi o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ, nɛ e dɛ mi ta, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e hyɛ e he nɔ hu ɔ, moo hyɛ e nɔ. O kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si kaa nubwɔ nɛ ba to mo, konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e hi o ngɔ.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Ke o pa lɛ sika a, ko he hekpa. Ke niye ní nɛ o jua ha lɛ ɔ, jua a nɛ ko pe niye ní ɔ jua.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ woe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ e ngɔ Kanaan zugba a ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e pee nyɛ Mawu. Nyɔguɛhi a he ngmɛɛmi

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: Ke e fi o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ ko nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e jua e he ha mo ɔ, ko ha nɛ e sɔmɔ mo kaa nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: Ha nɛ e hi o ngɔ kaa apaa yelɔ, loo nubwɔ, nɛ e tsu ní ha mo kɛ yaa si Heyemi jeha a maa su.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, Yawɛ tsɔli ji mɛ. Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ko jua mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko wa mɛ yi mi, se mohu nyɛɛ ye nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma nyɛ ma si mɛ kaa gbosi ní ha nyɛ bimɛ, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ mɛ a wami be ɔ tsuo. Se nyɛ sɔuu nyɛ kpɛti kaa Israel fɔfɔɛhi ɔ, nyɛ ko wa nyɛ sibi yi mi.

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: Ke e jua e he se ɔ, he blɔ ngɛ kaa e kpɔ e he ekohu. E nyɛminyumu ko,

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: E kɛ hiɔ̃tsɛ ɔ si himi ɔ nɛ pee kaa nyɔmtsɛ kɛ apaa yelɔ si himi; nɛ e wo lɛ hiɔ daa jeha. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ko wa lɛ yi mi.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ke a nyɛ we nɛ a kpɔ lɛ kɛ gu blɔ nɛ ɔmɛ eko nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ja Heyemi jeha kpa su loko a maa ngmɛɛ e kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Israel fɔfɔɛ be nyɛe maa pee nɔ ko nyɔguɛ daa, ejakaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ nyɔguɛhi ji mɛ. Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ. Lɛ ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, he nɛ a jaa mi ngɛ ɔ; imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ e be mi; zugba a maa ba ní babauu, nɛ tso ɔmɛ maa wo yiblii.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: “Ma ha nyɛ tue mi maa jɔ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ. Nyɛ maa hwɔ mahe fuaa, nɛ nyɛ be nɔ ko gbeye yee. Ma je lohwe dikali kɛ je zugba a nɔ, nɛ a be ta hwue ngɛ zugba a nɔ hu.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Nyɛ maa fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa gbe mɛ.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Ma gbaa nyɛ, nɛ ma ha nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ babauu. Somi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, ma ye nɔ.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Ma pee ye sihi he ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; i be nyɛ siee.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: I kɛ nyɛ maa hi si. Ma pee nyɛ Mawu, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa pee ye ma.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ ko pee nyɔguɛhi hu ɔ nɛ. I je nyɛ kɛ je yi mi wami sisi, nɛ i ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he.” Tue gbomi he tue gblami (Mose V,

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: ke nyɛ be ye mlaa amɛ, blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ somi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ a nɔ yee ɔ,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: lɛɛ ma ngɔ amanehlu gbeyegbeye nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ gbla nyɛ tue: hiɔ nɛ be tsa ba, kɛ asla nɛ puɛɔ nɔ hɛngmɛ, nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ hiɔtsɛ kulaa. Nyɛ ma du ní, se nɔ́ kpakpa ko be mi jee; ejakaa nyɛ he nyɛli maa ye nyɛ nɔ, nɛ mɛ mohu a ma ba ye ní ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ du ɔ.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa fia nyɛ ní nɛ a gbe; a maa ye nyɛ nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ we nyɛ se po nyɛ maa hi fo nɔ pulɛpulɛ.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: “Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo na ba mi, se nyɛ bui ye munyu ɔ kɛ sa a, ma gbla nyɛ tue kɛ bɔ he si kpaago ngɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: Ma ku nyɛ he nɔ womi, kɛ kuɛ mi timi ɔ nya; hiɔmi be nɛe; nyɛ zugba a ma gbli, nɛ e he maa wa kaa dade.

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma gbo yaka dengme; ejakaa nyɛ zugba a be ní bae, nɛ e nɔ tso ɔmɛ hu be yiblii woe.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã, nɛ nyɛ bui mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, ma kpale gbla nyɛ tue totoe kpaago ekohu.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Ma ngmɛɛ pu mi lohwe dikali a he ngɔ pue nyɛ nɔ, nɛ a maa gbe nyɛ bimɛ; a ma kpata nyɛ we mi lohwehi a hɛ mi, nɛ ma ha nyɛ nɔ ma gbɔ, nɛ nimli be hiɛe ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Ma ha ta ma ba tua nyɛ; ma ngɔ ta a kɛ gbla nyɛ tue. Ke nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ laa nyɛ he ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ, ma ha hiɔ nɛ be tsa ba maa sɛ nyɛ kpɛti; ma ngɔ nyɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ nyɛ niye ní se maa po kulaa. Niye ní he maa hia bɔ nɛ abolo tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa ye ɔ, yihi nyɔngma pɛ maa sã ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ kake mi. A maa ngmɛ abolo ɔ ngɛ sɛni tɛ nɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ ke nyɛ ye ɔ nyɛ be tɔe.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Hwɔ maa ye nyɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ e maa ba mi kaa nyɛ maa ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ bimɛ.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Ma puɛ nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ ma ywia nyɛ tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; ma ngɔ nyɛ gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɔ pue nyɛ we amaga amɛ nɛ i ywia a a nɔ. Nyɛ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ a hiee ha mi.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ma kpata nyɛ ma nguangua amɛ a hɛ mi kɛ yaa si a ma plɛ pee ma dokuhi. Nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ hu ma puɛ mɛ, nɛ i be nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ hee hu.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Ma kpata nyɛ zugba a hɛ mi bɔ nɛ ke nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ na a, a he mi maa po.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Ma ha ta maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se, nɛ ma gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ tsuo a mi. Nyɛ maa je zugba a nɔ, nɛ ma amɛ ma plɛ ma dokuhi.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Zugba a maa fɔ si gu, nɛ e maa jɔɔ e he, be mi nɛ nyɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ya je nyɛ he nyɛli a zugba nɔ.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maa nɔɔ nyɛ sibi a nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ ta nya fo nyɛ ngɛ tue, pohu nɔ ko nyɛɛ we nyɛ se. Nyɛ be nyɛe maa da nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nya.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi bɔɔ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ maa ta he lo ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ imi hu i je a se, nɛ i ngmɛɛ a he kɛ ha a he nyɛli, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ho ma se ya a nɛ. Se ke jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nina tsake a tsui, nɛ a ba a he si, nɛ a kpa yayami peemi ɔ,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: lɛɛ imi hu ma kai somi ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ Yakob, Isak, kɛ Abraham so ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, si nɛ i wo kaa ma ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha ye ma a, ma ti mi ekohu.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Kekleekle ɔ, ja a je zugba a nɔ, nɛ zugba a jɔɔ e he kulaa. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ja a kplɛ, nɛ a gbla a tue saminya kaa a kua ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, be mi nɛ a ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a zugba nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ po, i be mɛ kuae, nɛ i be a hɛ mi kpatae pɛsɛpɛsɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ se ko po. Imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: A he ɔ, ma kai somi nɛ i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so, benɛ i je ye he wami kpo kɛ tsɔɔ je ma amɛ, benɛ i je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ ma pee a Mawu ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Mlaahi, kɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha Mose ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ ha Israel ma a ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nɔ ko wo si kaa e maa ngɔ nɔ ko ngɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, blɔ nɔ nɛ a maa gu kɛ kpɔ nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: Zugba a nɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake, wu nɛ a ma du jio, tso yiblii jio, peeɔ Yawɛ nɔ́; e ngɛ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ ya pee ohiatsɛ nɛ be nyɛe nɛ e ma ha sika a kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ wo jua bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ ma nyɛ ma ha.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: Ke lohwe nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ɔ wo si kaa e ma ha Yawɛ ɔ, lɛɛ lohwe tsuaa lohwe kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a wo si ɔ peeɔ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Ke lohwe ɔ he tsɔ we kaa lohwe nɛ a ngmɛ blɔ kaa a kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ kɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ ba osɔfo ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko gbaa e zugba mi fa ko nɛ ji e weto ní nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, a da ní abɔ nɛ a duɔ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ hiɛmi nɔ, konɛ a kɛ wo he jua. Ngma nɛ maa su kilo nyingmi enyɔ ɔ, a he sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma ngɛ he.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Ke Heyemi jeha a se pɛ nɛ nɔ ko gbaa e zugba nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ e wo jua nɛ a tsɔɔ ɔ sisiisi.

english_verse: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Se ke e ngɔ e zugba a kɛ ha pee se ɔ, lɛɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ bu be nɛ piɛ loko Heyemi jeha kpa a maa su, konɛ e je nɔ.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Se ke a ngmɛɛ zugba a he ngɛ Heyemi jeha kpa a mi ɔ, e peeɔ klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ kaa zugba nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ke; zugba nɛ ɔ maa pee osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ kulaa.

english_verse: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko he zugba, se pi lɛ nitsɛ e weto ní, nɛ e gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ,

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: osɔfo ɔ nɛ bu e he jua a kɛ ya si Heyemi jeha a, konɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ wo hiɔ ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu; sika a peeɔ Yawɛ nɔ́.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Ke Heyemi jeha a su ɔ, a kpale zugba a ngɔ ha nɔtsɛ ɔ, loo e nina.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Jua amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a maa wo ɔ, a pee kaa bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: Lohwe tsuaa lohwe ɔ, e kekleekle bi ɔ, e ji Yawɛ nɔ́ momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko kó ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ je nɔ tsui mi faa, na jio, jijɔ jio.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ, nɛ a je he gbi kaa a kpata e hɛ mi kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ jio, lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ jio, aloo gbosi ní kaa zugba a peeɔ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ; a ko jua, nɛ a ko kpɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Ke a je nɔmlɔ adesa he gbi kaa á kpata e hɛ mi ɔ, á ko kpɔ lɛ, á gbe lɛ.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e ma kpɔ eko ɔ, é wo hiɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ ɔ, nɛ é ngɔ jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake ngɔ piɛ he.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a peeɔ Yawɛ níhi. Ke a ngɛ lohwe ɔmɛ kanee ɔ, kake ngɛ nyɔngma tsuaa nyɔngma mi peeɔ Yawɛ nɔ́.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko kó bi kaa lohwe ɔ hi, loo e hí; nɛ a ko tsake eko hulɔ. Ke a ma tsake eko ɔ, lohwe nɛ a tsake ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ngɛ tsakee ɔ tsuo maa pee klɔuklɔu; a be kpɔe.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha Mose ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ ha Israel ma a ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ se jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke,

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: Nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa ya ta a, nyɛɛ ngma e biɛ, nɛ nyɛ gba mɛ tabo nya tabo nya.
