english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: Mose kɛ Aaron fɔ̃ nihi nɛ a tsɔɔ a biɛ nɛ ɔ nine. Nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a bua Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nya nɛ a kane mɛ kakaaka, weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya. A kane nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye pe ja kakaaka,

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Israel ma a pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e pee ɔ.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Se Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ma pue si kɛ bɔle kpe he ɔ, nɛ a maa bu he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ imi Yawɛ, ye we abofu nɛ ko kple Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: ejakaa Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Levi wɛtso ɔ pɛ lɛɛ koo kane mɛ, nɛ koo bu a hiɛmi ngɔ piɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship. They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa hia a, Levi bi ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa gbɛ bo tsu ɔ. Nɛ ke a maa ma lɛ ekohu ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ nɔuu lɛ a maa ma. Ke nɔ kpa ko hɛ lɛ kɛ su he ɔ, a gbe lɛ.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo maa to si ngɛ a tabo ɔmɛ a nya, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e wɛtso aflaangaa sisi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke,

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: “Be tsuaa be nɛ Israel ma a maa to si ngɛ he ko ɔ, á pue si weku nya weku nya ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ weku aflaangaa sisi kɛ bɔle kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ kpe, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ kpe he ɔ.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the east side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: “Yuda wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa beleku je tabo nya tabo nya. A nyatsɛ ji Aminadab bi Nashon, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi kpaago kɛ eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa.

english_verse: On one side of Judah will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel son of Zuar as the leader of its
translation_verse: “Isakar wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Yuda nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Zuar bi Netanel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: “Zebulun wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Isakar nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Helon bi Eliab, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ kpaago kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the south side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: “Ruben wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa leneyi je, tabo nya tabo nya. A nyatsɛ ji Shedeur bi Elizur, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ekpa kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.

english_verse: On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its
translation_verse: “Simeon wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Ruben nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Zurishadai bi Shelumiel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ nɛɛ kɛ e nya lafa etɛ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: “Gad wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Simeon nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Deuel bi Eliasaf, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enuɔ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ maa tloo kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ maa hia; mɛ ji Israel ta a tsuo a kpɛti tabo. Bɔ nɛ ma a to si ɔ, ja a maa nyɛɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e ngwɔhe, kɛ e we aflaangaa sisi.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the west side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: “Efraim wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa bonyoku je, tabo nya tabo nya. A nyatsɛ ji Amihud bi Elishama, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.

english_verse: On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its
translation_verse: “Manase wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Efraim nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Pedazur bi Gamaliel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Israel ma a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a kane mɛ weku nya weku nya kɛ tabo nya tabo nya ngɛ ta amɛ a mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa ekpa kɛ etɛ kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its
translation_verse: “Benyamin wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Manase nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Gideoni bi Abidan, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the north side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: “Dan wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa omleyi je, tabo nya tabo nya. A nyatsɛ ji Amishadai bi Ahiezer, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi ekpa kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa kpaago.

english_verse: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its
translation_verse: “Asher wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Dan nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Okran bi Pagiel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kake kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its
translation_verse: “Naftali wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Asher nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Enan bi Ahira, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ etɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Se kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kane we mɛ kɛ piɛ we Israel bi ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee. Ke ma a to si ɔ, a pueɔ si tabo nya tabo nya ngɛ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya; nɛ ke a hia a, a nyɛɔ ja nɔuu.

english_verse: were the ones to be ordained as priests.
translation_verse: A pɔ mɛ nu, nɛ Aaron ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo osɔfo yemi ní tsumi ɔ mi.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Se Nadab, kɛ Abihu lɛɛ a gbo benɛ a ngɔ la nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ɔ. Akɛnɛ mɛɛ a be bimɛ he je ɔ, Eleazar kɛ Itamar pɛ lɛ a sɔmɔ kaa osɔfohi ngɛ a tsɛ Aaron wami be mi. A hla Levi bi ɔmɛ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ osɔfo ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ wo Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ pɛ a dɛ mi; nɔ kpa ko nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ní tsumi nɛ ɔ he ɔ, a gbe lɛ.”

english_verse: Moses, I have chosen these Levites from all Israel, and they will belong to me in a special way. When I killed the first-born sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in every Israelite family and the first-born males of their flocks and herds would be mine. But now I accept these Levites in place of the first-born sons of the Israelites. The Levites Are Counted
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ maa pee ye níhi. Benɛ i gbe Egipt bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, i tsukɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte, kɛ a lohwehi hu a kekleekle bihi a he kɛ pee ye níhi. Jehanɛ lɛɛ i hla Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ to Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ a nane mi; a maa pee ye níhi. Imi ji Yawɛ.” Levi bi ɔmɛ a kanemi

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ke,

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: “Moo kane Levi bi ɔmɛ weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ o ngma nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a e biɛ.”

english_verse: So Moses obeyed and counted them.
translation_verse: Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Levi ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Gershon, Kohat, kɛ Merari. Mɛ ji a we puɔ nyatsɛmɛ. Gershon ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Libni, kɛ Shimei. Kohat ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, kɛ Uziel. Merari ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Mahli, kɛ Mushi. Mɛ ji a weku ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Wekuhi nɛ peeɔ Gershon we puɔ nya ji Libni kɛ Shimei.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he níhi nɛ a tu kɛ wo a dɛ mi ji: kpe he ɔ, bo tsu ɔ kɛ e nɔ hami nɔ́ ɔ, bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya bo ɔ,

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: kue ɔ nɛ bɔle kpe he ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he bo ɔmɛ, kɛ kue ɔ nitsɛ nya bo ɔ kɛ e he tangme kpa amɛ. Ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi nɛ kɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, mɛ lɛ a ma tsu.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Wekuhi nɛ peeɔ Kohat we puɔ nya ji Amram, Izhar, kɛ Hebron, kɛ Uziel.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Ní tsumi nɛ a tu kɛ wo a dɛ mi ji: ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi nɛ kɔɔ somi daka a he, okplɔɔ ɔ, kane tso ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, níhi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Levi bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Eleazar. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Wekuhi nɛ peeɔ Merari we puɔ nya a ji Mahli, kɛ Mushi.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: A nyatsɛ ji Abihail bi Zuriel. Mɛɛ a maa to si ngɛ kpe he ɔ we omleyi je.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa to si ngɛ kpe he ɔ hɛ mi kɛ yaa beleku je ji Mose, Aaron, kɛ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ. Mɛ ji nihi nɛ ma tsu kusumi ní tsumihi tsuo ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a nɛ. Nɔ kpa ko nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ní tsumi nɛ ɔ he ɔ, a gbe lɛ.

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons;
translation_verse: Mose kane Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, moo hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ to ha mi ngɛ Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo a nane mi, kɛ a we mi lohwehi hu ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a we mi lohwehi tsuo a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ a nane mi. Imi ji Yawɛ!

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Bi tsuaa bi ɔ, á ngɔ sika hiɔ yi enuɔ kɛ kpɔ lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu jua nɛ a po ɔ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ sika nɛ a kɛ ba kpɔ nihi nɛ be nɔ ɔ kɛ ha Aaron, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Mose ngɔ kpɔmi sika a kɛ ha Aaron, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke,

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kohat bi ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma tsu níhi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ a he ní.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: “Ke be nɛ ma a maa hia kɛ je a sito he ɔ, Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a je tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ ngɛ somi daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi ɔ kɛ ha daka a he.

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha he, nɛ a ngɔ bo bluu hu kɛ ha lɔ ɔ nɔ, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ daka a kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: “Okplɔɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ maa nɔ ɔ, á ngɔ bo bluu kɛ ha nɔ loko a ngɔ plɛɛtehi, kahi nɛ a kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ bɔhi woɔ a mi ɔ, kɛ kpluhi nɛ a kɛ wai bɔhi woɔ a mi ɔ kɛ ma nɔ.

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: “Kane tso ɔ kɛ e he kane ɔmɛ, abɛɛle ɔmɛ, kɛ nu tɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ nu woɔ a mi ɔ, a ngɔ bo bluu kɛ ha a he.

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: A ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha kane tso ɔ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he, nɛ a ngɔ kɛ wo tlɔɔke mi.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: “Sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hu a ngɔ bo bluu kɛ ha he, nɛ a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha lɔ ɔ hu nɔ, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ lɛ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, a je mɛ nɛ a fi kɛ wo bo bluu mi, nɛ a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha a he, loko a kɛ wo tlɔɔke ɔ mi.

english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: A muɔ la zu ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ ha he.

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, a ngɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ma nɔ: ngɛyuhi, sofihi, gbowehi, kɛ kahi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha he, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ lɛ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Ke be nɛ ma a maa hia kɛ je a sito he ɔ, Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ha ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ a he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he, loko Kohat bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba nɛ a ba tloo kɛ ho. Kohat bi ɔmɛ kó ta ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a ko gbo. Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he níhi nɛ Kohat bi ɔmɛ maa tloo be tsuaa be nɛ ma a maa hia ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: “Osɔfo Aaron bi Eleazar lɛɛ e ní tsumi ji kaa e hyɛ kane mi nu ɔ, tsopa kɛ e he via a, daa niye ní bɔ sami ɔ, kɛ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ a nɔ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ kpe he ɔ, e mi ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.”

english_verse: The Kohathites must not go near or even look at the sacred objects until Aaron and his sons have covered those objects. If they do, their entire clan will be wiped out. So make sure that Aaron and his sons go into the tent with them and tell them what to carry. The Duties of the Gershonite Clans
translation_verse: Kohat bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ ke a sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, a ko hyɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hɛngmɛfia po. Ke a pee ja a, a ma gbo.” Gershon bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: The Gershonites will be responsible
translation_verse: Gershon bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ji

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: kue ɔ nɛ bɔle kpe he ɔ he bo ɔmɛ, kue ɔ nya bo ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ a he tangme kpa amɛ, kɛ a he ní tsumi ní ɔmɛ tsuo. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ní tsumi tsuo nɛ sa tsumi ɔ, a tsu.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Ní tsumihi nɛ Gershon bi ɔmɛ ma tsu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ, nɛ nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar. Merari bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Ní tsumi nɛ mɛɛ a ma tsu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ji a maa muɔ kpe he ɔ he plai ɔmɛ, mani ɔmɛ, titima amɛ kɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ,

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: kue ɔ nɛ bɔle si ɔ mi tso ɔmɛ, a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, kɛ plɛɛko ɔmɛ kɛ a he tangme kpa amɛ, kɛ a he ní ɔmɛ tsuo. Moo dla tlomihi nɛ a maa tloo ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ kakaaka.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: A ngma nɔ tsuaa nɔ biɛ kakaaka kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, nɛ a dla ní tsumi slɔɔto ɔmɛ, kɛ tlomi ɔmɛ a tloomi ngɔ ha mɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e nɔ́. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Merarites, making a total of
translation_verse: Lɛ tsuo peeɔ

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ je nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti, nyumuhi jio, yihi jio, konɛ a ko ble ma sito he ɔ, he nɛ i hii ngɛ ye ma a a kpɛti ɔ.”

english_verse: The Israelites obeyed the Lord's instructions. The Penalty for Committing a Crime (Leviticus
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, nɛ a fie jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ. Yayami nane mi tomi

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyumu ko, loo yo ko pee nɔ ko yayami nɛ e kɛ tɔ Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ ɔ,

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: e jaje yayami nɛ e pee ɔ, nɛ e to e yayami ɔ nane mi sisiisi. Jehanɛ, e ngɔ nane mi tomi nɔ́ ɔ mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ bɔ he ha nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ e tɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ be je mi, nɛ e be weku no pɔtɛɛ ko nɛ a kɛ nane mi tomi ní ɔmɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nane mi tomi ní ɔmɛ maa pee Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ a kɛ ma ha osɔfo ɔ. Slo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ peeɔ kusumi kɛ tsukɔɔ nɔ ko nɛ tɔ ɔ he ɔ.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko maa ngɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ko ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ maa pee osɔfo ɔ nɔ.” Nyumuhi nɛ a yi mi tɛ̃ mɛ ngɛ a yihi a he

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: aloo ke hunga jemi mumi te si ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e yi mi tɛ̃ lɛ ngɛ e yo nɛ ya ble e he niinɛ, aloo nɔ nɛ ya pee we ja po he ɔ,

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: “Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ yɛ nyu klɔuklɔu ɔ eko kɛ wo buɛ mi, nɛ e piti tabo zu ngɛ kpe he ɔ kɛ wo nyu ɔ mi.

english_verse: Next, he will remove her veil, then hand her the barley offering, and say, “If you have been faithful to your husband, this water won't harm you. But if you have been unfaithful, it will bring down the Lord's curse—you will never be able to give birth to a child, and everyone will curse your name.” Then the woman will answer, “If I am guilty, let it happen just as you say.”
translation_verse: Nyu nɛ ɔ nɛ kɛ gbiɛmi baa nɔ nɔ ɔ, e sɛ o mi mi, nɛ e ha nɛ o mi nɛ fu, nɛ o mi si nɛ nɔ mi.’ Kɛkɛ, yo ɔ ma he nɔ ke, ‘E ba mi! E ba mi!’

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngma gbiɛmi ɔ kɛ wo womi mi, nɛ e fɔ kɛ wo nyu nɛ dooɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ti niye ní bɔ ɔ dɛ mamɛ kake kɛkɛ kaa okadi, nɛ e sã lɔ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Se ke yo ɔ ya ble we e he, nɛ e he tsɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e maa ye e he, nɛ e ma nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: aloo ke hunga jemi mumi te si ngɛ nyumu ko mi, nɛ e yi mi tɛ̃ lɛ ngɛ e yo he ɔ, nyumu ɔ nɛ ngɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi, konɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ pee kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔ he kusumi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ha lɛ.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: A be nyumu ɔ fɔ ko bue; se ke yo ɔ ye fɔ ɔ, sɔ̃ ɔ maa tloo lɛ yo ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: “Mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyumu ko, loo yo ko je blɔ ka Nazir no peemi kita, nɛ e wo si kaa e maa ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: e yu e he kɛ je wai, kɛ dã nɛ nya wa a he. E ko nu wai, aloo dã kpa ko nɛ kuã. E ko nu nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ wai yiblii pee; wai yiblii mumu, loo gbigbli hu e ko ye.

english_verse: The hair of a Nazirite is sacred to me, and as long as you are a Nazirite, you must never cut your hair.
translation_verse: “Ligbi abɔ nɛ e ngɛ Nazir no si womi nɛ ɔ sisi ɔ, e ko sã e yi nɔ. E ngmɛɛ e yi bwɔmi he nɛ e ka gagaaga; nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: not even that of your father, mother, brother, or sister. That would make you unclean. Your hair is the sign that you are dedicated to me, so remain holy.
translation_verse: Ligbi abɔ nɛ Nazir no ji lɛ ɔ, a tsukɔ e he kɛ ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: “Ke e ba mi kaa nɔ ko gbo tlukaa ngɛ e kasa nya, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ble e yi bwɔmi ɔ nɛ a tsukɔ he kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, e sɛ e yi ɔ kpalokpalo ngɛ e he tsukɔmi ligbi ɔ we ligbi kpaago se.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ, e ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, aloo beleku lahuɛ tsɔwi enyɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ kake hu kɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ tsukɔ nɔ ɔ he; ejakaa e pee yayami kaa e hyɛ nɔ gbogboe hɛ mi. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyumu nɛ ɔ maa tsukɔ e yi bwɔmi ɔ he ekohu,

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: nɛ e maa kpale je sisi maa ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Yawɛ ekohu kaa Nazir no. Be nɛ be ɔ pee yaka, ejakaa e ble e yi bwɔmi nɛ a tsukɔ he ɔ. E maa ngɔ jijɔ bi kake nɛ ye jeha kake kɛ ba sã bɔ kaa e tɔ.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: “Ke Nazir no ko si womi ligbi ɔmɛ a nya ta a, á ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya,

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: nɛ e ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. É ngɔ jijɔ ku kake nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ. É ngɔ jijɔ yo kake nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ; nɛ e ngɔ agbosu kake hu nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ.

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ se hu, e ngɔ abolo kplolo kusii kake, kɛ keeki nɛ a kɛ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a futu mi nu pee, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a wui mi masa, se a ngɔ nu kɛ kpa hɛ mi kɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ, kɛ dã nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ a he kɛ ba.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ́ e sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, kɛ sami bɔ ɔ.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Nazir no ɔ nɛ sɛ e yi ɔ kpalokpalo ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. E muɔ e yi bwɔmi ɔ kɛ wo la a nɛ a kɛ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ sãe ɔ mi.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: “Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ je keeki nɛ a wui mi masa kake, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a wui mi masa kake ngɛ kusii ɔ mi kɛ piɛ agbosu ɔ nɛ a hoo ɔ kɔni kake he, nɛ e kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ha Nazir no ɔ.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ fɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa. Mlaa nya a, ní nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ agbosu ɔ gugue, kɛ fiɔ ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔ nike ní klɔuklɔu. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Nazir no ɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e nuɔ dã faa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: “De Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ gbaa Israel ma a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ de ke,

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: Yawɛ nɛ gbaa nyɛ, nɛ e hyɛ nyɛ;

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nɛ ha e hɛ mi nɛ kpɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ e dloo nyɛ;

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ nɛ wo e hɛ mi nɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ e ha nyɛ he jɔmi.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: “Ke a tsɛ ye biɛ ngɔ pue Israel ma a nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma gbaa mɛ.”

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Ligbi ɔ nɛ Mose gbe kpe he ɔ mami nya a, e pɔ kpe he ɔ nu, nɛ e tsukɔ he kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel wɛtso nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ da wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya, be mi nɛ a kane ni ɔmɛ ɔ,

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: “Mo he nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a kɛ tsu kpe he bo tsu ɔ he ní; moo dla ngɔ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi nya.”

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Mose he ní ɔmɛ, nɛ e ngɔ tlɔɔke ɔmɛ, kɛ na ku ɔmɛ ngɔ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: nɛ e ha Merari bi ɔmɛ tlɔɔke eywiɛ, kɛ na kpaanyɔ ngɛ mɛ hu a ní tsumi nya. Mɛ tsuo a nɔ hyɛlɔ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Se Kohat bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ Mose ha we mɛ nɔ́ ko; ejakaa ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ha mɛ nɛ a hyɛ nɔ ɔ, a konɔ a kɛ maa fɔ.

english_verse: So each leader brought the following gifts: a silver bowl that weighed one and a half kilograms and a silver sprinkling bowl weighing almost a kilogram, both of them filled with flour and olive oil as grain sacrifices and weighed according to the official standards; a small gold dish filled with incense; a young bull, a full-grown ram, and a year-old ram as sacrifices to please the Lord; a goat as a sacrifice for sin; and two bulls, five full-grown rams, five goats, and five rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing. The tribal leaders brought their gifts and offerings in the following order: On the first day Nahshon from Judah, on the second day Nethanel from Issachar, on the third day Eliab from Zebulun, on the fourth day Elizur from Reuben, on the fifth day Shelumiel from Simeon, on the sixth day Eliasaph from Gad, on the seventh day Elishama from Ephraim, on the eighth day Gamaliel from Manasseh, on the ninth day Abidan from Benjamin, on the tenth day Ahiezer from Dan, on the eleventh day Pagiel from Asher, on the twelfth day Ahira from Naphtali.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a ngɔ nike ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: LIGBI WƐTSO WƐTSO NƆKƆTƆMA Kekleekle Yuda Nashon, Aminadab bi ɔ Enyɔne Isakar Netanel, Zuar bi ɔ Etɛne Zebulun Eliab, Helon bi ɔ Eywiɛne Ruben Elizur, Shedeur bi ɔ Enuɔne Simeon Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi ɔ Ekpane Gad Eliasaf, Deuel bi ɔ Kpaagone Efraim Elishama, Amihud bi ɔ Kpaanyɔne Manase Gamaliel, Pedazur bi ɔ Nɛɛne Benyamin Abidan, Gideoni bi ɔ Nyɔngmane Dan Ahiezer, Amishadai bi ɔ Nyɔngma kɛ Asher Pagiel, Okran bi ɔ kakene Nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne Naftali Ahira, Enan bi ɔ. Nike ní mi mi kake too nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ kɛ ba. Nike ní ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: sika hiɔ plɛɛte kake nɛ e jiimi ji kilo kake kɛ fa, kɛ sika hiɔ kã kake nɛ e jiimi ji gram lafa kpaanyɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ jiimi nya. Ní enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a ngɔ nu kɛ futu mi kɛ ha niye ní bɔ sami. Enɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he: sika tsu kã kake nɛ e jiimi ji gram lafa kɛ nyɔngma nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a sãã hyi lɛ tɔ, na niheyo kake, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kake nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ, kɛ akpakpo kake nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ. Enɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ: na ku enyɔ, agbosu enyɔ, akpakpo enuɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku enuɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mose ya sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, konɛ e kɛ Yawɛ nɛ ya tu munyu ɔ, e nu Yawɛ gbi nɛ e kɛ lɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ je somi daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ yi mi, ngɛ kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: “Mo de Aaron ke, ke e ngɔ kane kpaago ɔmɛ kɛ ma si mami ɔ, e hyɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a tso kɛ ya kane tso ɔ hɛ mi.”

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a pee kane tso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a ngɔ sika tsu nɛ a fia nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee kane tso ɔ kɛ je e nane kɛ ya si e mɔmɔ ɔmɛ a he, kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Mose ɔ ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. A hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ to

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ekohu ke,

english_verse: The Levites must be acceptable to me before they begin working at the sacred tent. So separate them from the rest of the Israelites
translation_verse: “Je Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ o tsukɔ a he.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, ha nɛ a ngɔ na niheyo kake, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ, nɛ ji mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a futu mi nu ɔ kɛ ba. Ngɔɔ na niheyo kpa nɛ o kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o maa kpee Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ o kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ma ba da si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ Aaron maa pee kusumi klɛdɛɛ ko kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a hla Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ha imi Yawɛ, kaa Israel ma mluku ɔ a nike ní klɛdɛɛ, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a nine kɛ pue na ku enyɔ ɔmɛ a yi mi. O kɛ kake maa sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ o maa ngɔ kake hu kɛ sã sami bɔ, nɛ o kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: “Ngɔɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mi kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ, konɛ a hi Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nine nɔ.

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: O maa pee enɛ ɔ kɛ je Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel ma a he nɛ a ba pee ye níhi.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ke o tsukɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o hla mɛ ngɔ to ɔ, lɔ ɔ se loko a ma nyɛ maa ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ a ya sɔmɔ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They are mine and will take the place of the first-born Israelite sons.
translation_verse: I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to bitɛtehi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ Israel ɔ a nane mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Ligbi ɔ nɛ i kpata Egipt bi ɔmɛ a kekleekle bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, i tsukɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ hu a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ i kɛ mɛ pee imi nitsɛ ye níhi.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: I hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Israel bitɛtehi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nane mi.

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ kaa Israel ma a tsuo a nike ní. A ma sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a ma kpata Yawɛ ha ma a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke alini ma a hɛ mɛ kɛ su he klɔuklɔu ɔ he tsɔ ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ kó sɛ a kpɛti.”

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Mose kɛ Aaron, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsukɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a hla mɛ ngɔ to kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Benɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsukɔ a he kɛ je a yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he ta a, Aaron ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ. E pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha mɛ nɛ e kɛ tsukɔ a he.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ se jeha enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke,

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ gbɔkuɛ nya si ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Se ni komɛ ngɛ a kpɛti nɛ a ble a he, ejakaa a ta nɔ gbogboe he; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba Mose kɛ Aaron a ngɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu,

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Mose de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si ma nu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma fa mi ke ma de nyɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko, aloo nyɛ nina ko ya ta nɔ gbogboe he nɛ e kɛ ble e he, aloo e hia blɔ kɛ ho ma se lokoo ya a, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ma nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ Hetsɔmi ɔ faa.

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: Se mohu ɔ, e ye lɛ gbɔkuɛ nya si nyɔhiɔ kake se, ngɛ nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɔ. A ngɔ abolo kplolo, kɛ pui doodooe kɛ ye.

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: A ko si eko nɛ je nɛ na yi, nɛ á ko ywia lohwe ɔ wu ko hulɔ; a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Se nɔmlɔ nɛ he tsɔ, nɛ e hiɛ blɔ hulɔ, nɛ e kua Hetsɔmi ɔ yemi ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ lɛɛ a je lɛ we kɛ je e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti; ejakaa e kɛ Yawɛ nike ní ɔ bɛ be nɛ a to ɔ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e musu maa tloo lɛ.

english_verse: As soon as the sacred tent was set up, a thick cloud appeared and covered it. The cloud was there each day, and during the night, a fire could be seen in it.
translation_verse: Ligbi ɔ nɛ a ma kpe he ɔ, bɔku ɔ ba ha he. Kɛ je gbɔkuɛ kɛ ya si je na a, bɔku ɔ ngɛ kpɛe kaa la.

english_verse: The Lord used this cloud to tell the Israelites when to move their camp and where to set it up again. As long as the cloud covered the tent, the Israelites did not break camp. But when the cloud moved, they followed it, and wherever it stopped, they camped and stayed there,
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi kaa bɔku ɔ se kɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ yi mi ligbi babauu po ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ buɔ Yawɛ tue, nɛ a hiɛ blɔ.

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ke ligbi enyɔ, aloo nyɔhiɔ kake, aloo be nɛ kɛ pe ja po nɛ bɔku ɔ daa si ngɛ kpe he ɔ yi mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hii sito he ɔ nɛ a hiɛ blɔ; ja bɔku ɔ wo e he nɔ loko a maa hia blɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke,

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: “Ngɔɔ sika hiɔ nɛ a fia nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee titimati enyɔ, konɛ ke a ma bua ma kpekpemi ɔ nya, aloo ke ma a maa hia blɔ ɔ, a kpa.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ke a kpa titimati enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo kɛ mo ma ba kpe ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Se ke a kpa kake pɛ lɛɛ Israel ma nimeli, nɛ ji wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a kɛ mo ma ba kpe.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: Ke titimati ɔ pɛ, nɛ a he ose si enyɔne ɔ, ma a nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ maa hia. Be tsuaa be nɛ a maa hia blɔ ɔ, a kpa titimati ɔ, nɛ a he ose.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Ke a ma bua ma kpekpemi ɔ nya a, lɛɛ a kpa titimati ɔ kɛkɛ, se a ko he ose.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma kpa titimati ɔmɛ. “Mlaa nɛ maa fɔ si kɛ ha yi nɔhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ yaa neneene ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Ke he nyɛli ba tua nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ, nɛ e ba mi kaa nyɛ gba ta kɛ fa nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa titimati ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ he ose. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kai nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, ngɛ nyɛ nyami ligbihi, kɛ ligbi kpahi nɛ a to ɔ, kɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔmɛ hu nyɛ kpa titimati ɔmɛ be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ sãe. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kai nyɛ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.” Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Sinai

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ a tsa a nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ hluu kɛ ya si bɔku ɔ ya da si ngɛ Paran nga a nɔ.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ, nɛ a maa hia nyɛɛmi kekleekle ɔ,

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa a hia kekle tabo nya tabo nya. A nyatsɛ ji Aminadab bi Nashon.

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: Zuar bi Netanel ji Isakar bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: Zebulun bi ɔmɛ hu a nyatsɛ ji Helon bi Eliab.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a gbɛ bo tsu ɔ; nɛ Gershon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Merari bi ɔmɛ nɛ tloo bo tsu ɔ hia nyɛɛmi.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Ruben bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se tabo nya tabo nya kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa. A nyatsɛ ji Shedeur bi Elizur.

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: Zurishadai bi Shelumiel ji Simeon bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Deuel bi Eliasaf hu ji Gad bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Kohat bi ɔmɛ nɛ tloo ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hu hia; nɛ benɛ a ke a suu sito he kpa a, a na kaa a kɛ bo tsu ɔ ma si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ momo.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Efraim bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ Kohat bi ɔmɛ a se tabo nya tabo nya kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa. A nyatsɛ ji Amihud bi Elishama.

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: Pedazur bi Gamaliel ji Manase bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: Gideoni bi Abidan hu ji Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, Dan bi ɔmɛ hia tabo nya tabo nya kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa. Mɛ ji Israel ta a tsuo a se tabo, nɛ a nyatsɛ ji Amishadai bi Ahiezer.

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: Okran bi Pagiel ji Asher bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: Enan bi Ahira hu ji Naftali bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Ke Israel ma a maa hia blɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a plɛɔ kɛ nyɛɛɔ tabo nya tabo nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose de e ngatsɛ Yetro, Midian no ɔ bi Hobab ke, “Wa ngɛ hiae kɛ yaa he nɛ Yawɛ de to ke e ma ha wɔ ɔ. Yawɛ nitsɛ wo Israel ní kpakpahi a he si. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha waa ho nɛ waa kɛ mo ya ye wa kplɔkɔtɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Se Hobab de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi; i be yae; ma kpale kɛ ya imi nitsɛ ye ma mi, kɛ imi nitsɛ ye nyɛmimɛ a ngɔ mohu.”

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Mose ya nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ko si wɔ. Mo lɛ o le nga a nɔ hehi nɛ hi nɛ wa maa to si ngɛ; mo ji nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Ke o kɛ wɔ ya a, nɔ́ kpakpa tsuaa nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ kɛ maa gbaa wɔ ɔ, waa kɛ mo maa dla.”

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a hia kɛ je Yawɛ yo ɔ he, nɛ a nyɛɛ ligbi etɛ. Yawɛ somi daka a nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ hla sito he ha mɛ.

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be nɛ somi daka a maa da si ɔ, e ma de ke, “Yawɛ, kpale o se! Kpale kɛ ba Israel bi akpeakpe abɔ ɔ a ngɔ!”

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Ma a tu munyu huitihuiti ngɛ a haomihi a he. Benɛ Yawɛ nu ɔ, e mi mi fu, nɛ e ha la tso ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɛ la a kpata níhi a hɛ mi ngɛ a sito he ɔ kasa fa kake.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Ma a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Mose, nɛ Mose hu kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ la a gbo.

english_verse: They named the place “Burning,” because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire. The People Grumble about Being Hungry
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Tabera, nɛ a de ke, “Wa wo kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ la sã ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Mose hla nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi kpaago

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: E ba mi kaa de lo ba bɔni futufututsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ jlomi. Israel bi ɔmɛ nitsɛ hu wo yana ekohu nɛ a bi ke, “Ao, wa be de lo nae maa ye lo?

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ lo pueɔ si ngɛ Egipt nɛ a pee we he nɔ́ ko, nɛ wa yeɔ bɔ nɛ wa suɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ jamatlɛ ɔmɛ, atlɛ ɔmɛ, pui ɔ, kɛ sabola amɛ!

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ lɛɛ wa he wami nɔ gbɔ, nɛ wa na we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kulaa kaa ja mana nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: Mose bi Yawɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o ye imi, o tsɔlɔ sane yayami kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je nɛ o ná ye he abofu, nɛ o ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ tsuo yi tlomi ngɔ tloo mi ɔ?

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: Imi nɔ kake too pɛ i be nyɛe ma hɛɛ ma nɛ ɔ; tlomi ɔ jiɔ tsɔ ha mi.

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ o kɛ mi maa ye ɔ, lɛɛ ke o ngɛ ye he suɔmi ɔ, gbee mi amlɔ mohu, konɛ ma ko na nɔ́ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ o dɛ mi ekohu.”

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: Ma kple si, nɛ i kɛ mo ma ba tu munyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma je mumi nɛ ngɛ o mi ɔ eko kɛ ha mɛ. A maa kpee mo kɛ tloo ma a tlomi ɔ, nɛ mo nɔ kake too pɛ o be tlooe hu.

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, mo de ma a ke, ‘Nyɛɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he kɛ ha hwɔɔ; ejakaa nyɛ maa ye de lo. Benɛ de lo jlo nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ fo he ya, nɛ nyɛ de ke nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ mohu ɔ, Yawɛ nu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ de lo nɛ nyɛɛ ye.

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”
translation_verse: Anɛ a ma na tohi kɛ nahi maa gbe nɛ maa su mɛ? Aloo ke a bua wo mi lohi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nya a, e maa su mɛ?”

english_verse: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ niheyo ko gbɔ fo ya de Mose ke, “Eldad kɛ Medad ngɛ gbae ngɛ sito he ɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
