translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ Esau nina a nɛ ngɛ Edom yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ hu nɛ ngɛ Ar ɔ pee ha wɔ ɔ, mo hu ngmɛɛ wɔ blɔ kɛ ya si wa ma ya po Yordan pa a, kɛ ya zugba nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ha wɔ ɔ nɔ.’

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Hyɛ, i jɔɔ Matsɛ Sihon kɛ e zugba a he ha nyɛ. Nyɛ ya ngɔ e zugba a, nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ.’

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Sihon kɛ e ma a tsuo je kpo nɛ a kɛ wɔ ba hwu ta ngɛ Yahaz.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ lɛ wo wa dɛ, nɛ wa gbe e kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Wa ngɔ we mi lohwe ɔmɛ, nɛ wa ha níhi ngɛ ma amɛ a mi.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Kɛ je Aroer nɛ ngɛ Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ nya kɛ ya su Gilead ɔ, ma ko ma ko be nɛ wa nyɛ we lɛ; Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ mɛ tsuo wo wa dɛ.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Hehi nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ke wa ko ya a pɛ nɛ wa yɛ; mɛ ji Amon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a, Yabok pa a nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, kɛ a ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ yo nɔ ɔ, kɛ he kpa komɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Koo ye lɛ gbeye, ejakaa i ngɔ e kɛ e ma a, kɛ e zugba a tsuo ngɔ wo o dɛ nɛ o pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ hi Heshbon ɔ.’

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Wa kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi. Bɔ nɛ wa pee Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon ɔ, ja nɔuu wa pee ma tsuaa ma kɛ e mi nyumu ɔmɛ, yi ɔmɛ, kɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Se lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo lɛɛ wa ngɔ, nɛ wa ha níhi ngɛ ma amɛ a mi.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi kɛ̃ ɔ, wa kpɔ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ kɛ je matsɛmɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ, kɛ je Arnon pa a nya kɛ ya si Hermon yo ɔ he.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Wa ngɔ Matsɛ Og nɛ je Bashan ɔ e zugba a tsuo, mahi nɛ ngɛ yo nɔ zugba kpataa a, kɛ Gilead, kɛ Bashan zugba amɛ a nɔ ɔ, hluu kɛ ya su Saleka kɛ Edrei nɛ ji mahi nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ.”

english_verse: King Og was the last of the Rephaim, and his coffin is in the town of Rabbah in Ammon. It is made of hard black rock and is four meters long and almost two meters wide. The Land East of the Jordan River Is Divided (Numbers
translation_verse: Bashan matsɛ, Og pɛ ji oblaihi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Refaim ɔ a ti nɔ nɛ piɛ. E dade sa tso ngɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a ma nɛ a tsɛɔ Raba a kɛ mwɔɔ. Sa tso ɔ kami ji gugue enyɔ kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e blimi ji gugue kake kaa bɔ nɛ níhi a susumi mlaa a ngɛ ɔ. Wɛtsohi nɛ hi Yordan pa a beleku je (Mose IV,

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ piɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ ya si a maa ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ hae ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je ɔ; nɛ Yawɛ ma ha mɛ hu a maa hi nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se loko nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.’

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lee, i le kaa ní nguanguahi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o maa pee ɔ a sisije kɛkɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa mawu ko mawu ko be hiɔwe, loo zugba a nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ o tsu nɛ ɔ ma tsu!

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ ma po Yordan pa a, nɛ ma ya na zugba kpakpa nɛ ngɛ pa a se ɔ, yo zugba nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ, kɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ!’

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu mi, nɛ e bui mi tue. Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘E hiɛ! Koo wo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ ta hu!

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Kuɔ ɔ kɛ ya Pisga yo ɔ yi mi, konɛ o hyɛ kɛ o hɛngmɛ kɛkɛ, kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya bonyoku je, jehanɛ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya leneyi je. Hyɛ he tsuaa he saminya; ejakaa o be Yordan pa nɛ ɔ poe kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Wo Yoshua mlaa, nɛ o wo lɛ kã kɛ he wami; ejakaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ po pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ o ngɛ hyɛe ɔ.’

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tlɔ kɔ̃ nɛ ngɛ Betpeor ma a hanɔ ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Mose de Israel ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ bu mlaa amɛ nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami, nɛ́ nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ he; nɛ nyɛ ko je nɔ́ ko kɛ je mi; nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ nyɛ mɛtɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya! Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ a he. Nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ ligbi ko ligbi ko nyɛ wami be tsuo. Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ bibimɛ nɛ a le,

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: kaa ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ da si ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Bua ma a nya. Ha nɛ a bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mɛ ɔ tue, konɛ a ye mi gbeye a wami be tsuo; nɛ a tsɔɔ a bimɛ, nɛ mɛ hu a ye mi gbeye.’

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: “Nyɛ de nyɛ bimɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ba da si ngɛ yo ɔ sisi, kɛ bɔ nɛ yo ɔ ngɛ tsoe, nɛ la a ya hiɔwe ploplooplo, nɛ bɔku wo diblii kpii kɛ bɔle yo ɔ.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nyɛ de mɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ je la a mi. Nyɛ nu munyu ɔmɛ, se nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ nitsɛ e su ko kulaa; gbi ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ ngɛ munyu ɔmɛ tue.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: E tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ ye somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ so ɔ nɔ; lɔ ɔ ji kaa nyɛ maa ye mlaa nyɔngma amɛ nɛ e ngma ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi jamɛ a be ɔ mi ke ma tsɔɔ nyɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa ye a nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ. A bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ngɛ amaga jami he

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛ ko ya ye sane yaya, nɛ nyɛ ya pee amaga ko ha nyɛ he, nɛ ngɛ kaa nyumu, loo yo,

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi babauu nɛ ha si ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ ɔ nɛ gbla nyɛ juɛmi kɛ ya ja mɛ, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ. Ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ he ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mi mi fu mi, nɛ e ka kita ke i be Yordan pa a poe kɛ ya zugba kpakpa a nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ ma gbo ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ i be Yordan pa a poe; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa po pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba kpakpa a.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je somi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ so ɔ nɔ. Mlaa nɛ e wo nyɛ ke nyɛ ko pee amaga ko ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam; a kɛ lɛ plee we nɔ́ he.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River and settle down in the land. Then in the years to come, you will have children, and they will give you grandchildren. After many years, you might lose your sense of right and wrong and make idols, even though the Lord your God hates them. So I am giving you fair warning today, and I call the earth and the sky as witnesses. If you ever make idols, the Lord will be angry, and you won't have long to live, because the Lord will let you be wiped out.
translation_verse: I tsɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba odase kaa ke nyɛ bui mi tue ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Lɛɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ, nyɛ se be kɛe ngɛ nɔ. A ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma kpa amɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛ ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma ya sɔmɔ mawuhi nɛ a kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nine pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tso pee, mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tɛ pee, mawuhi nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́, nɛ a nui nɔ́, kɛ mawuhi nɛ a yi ní, nɛ a nui nɔ́ he fu.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu mi, nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa bu lɛ tue.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, e be nyɛ kuae, nɛ e be nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae; e hɛ be somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ nɔ jee.

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Anɛ mawu ko ka hyɛ kaa e ma ya je je ma ko kɛ je je ma kpa ko mi kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee ha nyɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ lo? Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ, bɔ nɛ e je e he wami, kɛ e nyɛmi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kpo; e kɛ gbenɔ hiɔhi, kɛ ta ba; e pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi; nɛ e ha gbeye ní nguanguahi ba.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: E ha nyɛ nu e gbi kɛ je hiɔwe, konɛ e kɛ tsɔse nyɛ; nyɛ na e la klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ je mi.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ e suɔ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ he je ɔ, e hla nyɛ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: E fie je mahi nɛ a he wa kɛ je nyɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ a zugba a ngɔ ha nyɛ. Lejɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ na nyɛɛ le, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ gblegbleegble kaa Yawɛ ji Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba; e se ɔ, nɔ ko be.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, konɛ e hi ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina. Ke nyɛ ye a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa hi zugba nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ daa.” A to wesa he mahi ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt, nɛ a ba su kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ngɛ Betpeor hanɔ ɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ. Sa a, Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ je Heshbon ɔ nɛ ye zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ. Se Mose kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba ye e nɔ, benɛ a je Egipt kɛ ma a.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: A ngɔ e zugba a, kɛ Amor matsɛ kpa ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Og nɛ hi Bashan nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ hu e zugba a.

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ ɔ huzu ji kɛ je Aroer ma a mi kɛ ya su Arnon pa a nya, kɛ ya na Sirion yo ɔ ngɛ leneyi je; lɔ ɔ ji Hermon yo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: Zugba tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je kɛ ya su Ngo wo ɔ nya, kɛ Pisga yo ɔ sisi hu piɛ he.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Mose bua Israel ma a tsuo nya, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ tue. Nyɛɛ kase mɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: “ ‘Koo gbe nɔmlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ kɛ wɔ so ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Pi e kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ, se wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ wa ngɛ je mi mwɔnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi kɛ je la mi, ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: I da si ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Yawɛ nyɛ kpɛti jamɛ a be ɔ, konɛ ma de nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ ngɛ la a gbeye yee. “Nɛ nyɛ kuɛ yo ɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ko ja mawu ko kɛ piɛ ye he.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: “ ‘Koo puɛ amaga ko, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, loo nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nyu mi ngɛ zugba a sisi.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Ko kpla si ha mɛ, nɛ ko ja mɛ hulɔ; ejakaa imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, a kɛ mi plee we nɔ́ he. I gblaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛɔ mi ɔ, kɛ a bimɛ, kɛ a bibimɛ a tue hluu kɛ ya siɔ yi nɔ etɛne kɛ eywiɛne bimɛ a nɔ;

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: se nihi akpe abɔ nɛ suɔ mi, nɛ a yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ i naa mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ko tsɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ biɛ yaka gu, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ ja a, Yawɛ kɛ e he be lɛ kee.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ ligbi ekpa kɛ tsu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsumi.

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ko tsu nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kulaa, mo nitsɛ jio, o binyumu jio, o biyo jio, o tsɔlɔ nyumu jio, o mawayo jio, o lohwe jio, nubwɔ nɛ ngɛ o ma a mi jio. Ha o tsɔlɔ nyumu, kɛ o mawayo hu nɛ a jɔɔ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mo hu o maa jɔɔ o he ɔ.

english_verse: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Kai kaa mo hu o ya ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt, nɛ imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ kɔni si wami, kɛ nyɛmi kpɔ mo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i wo mo mlaa ke o ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: “ ‘Moo bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ fa mo ɔ, konɛ e hi ha mo, nɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: “ ‘Koo ju.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: “Benɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ yo ɔ he ɔ, mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Benɛ e wo gbi kɛ je la, kɛ bɔku kpii ɔ mi ɔ, jamɛ be ɔ mi nɛ e ha nyɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ekpa ko piɛ we he. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngma mɛ ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha mi. Israel bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye (Mose II,

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: “Benɛ yo ɔ tsuo ngɛ tsoe kɛ la, nɛ nyɛ nu gbi ɔ kɛ je diblii ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ nyɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ba ye ngɔ, ba de ke,

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: ‘Hyɛ kaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ha nɛ wa na e we agboje, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ, benɛ wa nu e gbi nɛ e tu munyu kɛ je la a mi ɔ! Mwɔnɛ ɔ, wa na kaa ke Mawu kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tu munyu po nɔmlɔ adesa ma nyɛ maa hi je mi hɛ ngmengmle.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je e sa nɛ wa wo wa he kɛ wo gbenɔ mi ekohu? La gegeege ɔ ma ngla wɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Ke wa nu Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ gbi ekohu ɔ, wa ma gbo.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko kɛ Mawu tu munyu kɛ je la mi nɛ e hi je mi hɛ ngmengmle hyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ wa na nɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Mose, moo kpale kɛ ho nɛ o ya bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de mo ɔ tue, konɛ o ba de wɔ nɔ́ nɛ e de mo ɔ. Wa maa bu mo tue, nɛ wa maa ye nɔ.’

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ nu munyu ɔmɛ, benɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi ngɛ munyu ɔmɛ tsuo tue ɔ; nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘I nu munyu ɔmɛ nɛ ma a de mo ɔ; anɔkuale ɔ sisiisi a de ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: I ná nɛ ma a na juɛmi daa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a wo ye hɛ mi nyami be tsuaa be, nɛ a ye ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ, konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hi ha mɛ kɛ a nina kɛ ya neneene!’

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Se mo Mose lɛɛ, hii hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye ngɔ, nɛ ma ha mo mlaa amɛ, kɛ fami ɔmɛ tsuo. O tsɔɔ ma a, nɛ a ye nɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ i ngɛ mɛ hae ɔ nɔ.’

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa nyɛ ɔ tsuo nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ hi je mi, nɛ níhi a mi nɛ hi ha nyɛ; lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ se maa kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: “Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ fa mi ke ma tsɔɔ nyɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Nyɛɛ ye a nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Israel ma, nyɛɛ bu tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Lɔ ɔ loko níhi a mi maa hi ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa pee ma ngua, nɛ nyɛ maa hi zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní ɔ nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ wo si ɔ.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: “Israel ma, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ, lɛ pɛ ji Mawu.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, kɛ nyɛ klaa tsuo, kɛ nyɛ he wami tsuo.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ. Nyɛɛ sɛɛ he ní be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ we mi, be nɛ nyɛ hia blɔ, be nɛ nyɛ hwɔɔ si, kɛ be nɛ nyɛ te si.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ fi kɛ wo nyɛ kɔni si, kɛ nyɛ hɛ nya kaa kaimi nɔ́.

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngma ngɔ wo nyɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a he, kɛ nyɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya. Tue gbomi he kɔkɔ bɔmi

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: “Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke e ma ha nyɛ zugba ko kɛ e nɔ mahi nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ po,

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: wehi kɛ a mi ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ wo a mi ní ɔmɛ, nyu vuhi nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tsua, wai ngmɔhi, kɛ oliv tsohi nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ du ɔ, ke nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ye, nɛ nyɛ tɔ ɔ,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je Yawɛ nɔ. Ejakaa lɛ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, he nɛ a ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye; nyɛ ja lɛ pɛ; nɛ e biɛ nyɛ kɛ ka kita.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ a mawu ɔmɛ a se.

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ plee we nɔ́ he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ ya nyɛɛ mawu kpahi a se ɔ, e mi mi ma fu nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã nɔ́ ɔ.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko ka Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee ngɛ Masa a.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: Mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ a ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: and live in a way that pleases him. Then you will be able to go in and take this good land from your enemies, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: e maa fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je nyɛ blɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: “Hwɔɔ se ko ke nyɛ bimɛ bi nyɛ ke, ‘Mɛni he je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ke waa ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ?’

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: nyɛ de mɛ ke, ‘Sa a, Egipt matsɛ nyɔguɛhi ji wɔ, nɛ Yawɛ kɛ kɔni si wami je wɔ kɛ je Egipt.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ ngɛ gbeye ba Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e we ɔ tsuo nɔ ngɛ wɔ tsuo wa hɛ mi.

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ e je wɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ zugba nɛ e ka wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ngɛ he ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Ke wa ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, e bua maa jɔ wa he.’

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye níhi nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ a nɔ; nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Gbaami jeɔ tue bumi mi (Mose V,

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Ma tsuaa ma nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma je ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ ɔ, nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi; nyɛ ko na mɛ mɔbɔ. Nyɛ ko ja a mawu ɔmɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Ke be ɔ su nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ je mɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Nyɛɛ kɛ ma ko ma ko kó so nɛ nyɛɛ pee kake; nyɛ ko na mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a ma kpaka nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Yawɛ he kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi. Ke e ba mi ja a, Yawɛ mi mi ma fu, nɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi amlɔ.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee mohu ji kaa nyɛɛ ku a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ ywia mɛ dukuduku, nɛ nyɛɛ ywia a yo mawu nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a we amaga a, nɛ nyɛɛ sã wɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee ja, ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hla nyɛ kɛ je nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a kpɛti, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma pɔtɛɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Suɔmi mohu Yawɛ suɔ nyɛ; nɛ kita nɛ e ka nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e suɔ kaa e maa ye nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Yawɛ kɛ kɔni si wami je nyɛ, nɛ e kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi kɛ je Egipt matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ pɛ ji Mawu, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale. E maa ye e somi nɔ, nɛ e ma je e suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ yi nɔhi akpe abɔ nɛ suɔ lɛ, nɛ a yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: se ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume lɛ ɔ, e maa gbla a tue amlɔ.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ngɔ amaga nɛ ɔ eko kɛ ba nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi; ke nyɛ pee ja a, gbiɛmi nɛ ngɛ amaga amɛ a nɔ ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ. Nyɛɛ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ hie amaga amɛ, ejakaa Yawɛ gbiɛmi ngɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: e maa suɔ nyɛ, nɛ e maa gbaa nyɛ. E ma ha nyɛ he maa hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ babauu. E maa gbaa nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma na blɛfo, wai, kɛ oliv nu. E maa gbaa nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ na amɛ kɛ to ɔmɛ maa bɔ. Gbaami nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo e kɛ maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ e ka nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ bu mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa ye somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ so ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ma je e suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ;

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yawɛ be hae nɛ hiɔ nɛ nu nyɛ; nɛ Egipt hiɔ yaya amɛ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ ekoeko be nyɛ he sae; nyɛ he nyɛli mohu lɛ a maa nu hiɔ yaya nɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko de nyɛ he ke, ‘Ni ɔmɛ a he hiɛ pe wɔ, nɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛ fie mɛ kɛɛ?’

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye; nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai gbenɔ hiɔhi nɛ a nya wa nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ. Nyɛ kai okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ kɔni si wami pee kɛ kpɔ̃ nyɛ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kpata Egipt bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e maa pee je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mɛ gbeye yee ɔ.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha sawale maa nu mɛ; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ tu fo ngɛ nyɛ nya ya laa a he ɔ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbeye. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ; e ji Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ sa nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maa na kaa bɔɔbɔɔ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa fie je ma amɛ kɛ maa je nyɛ blɔ nɔ ha nyɛ. Nyɛ be mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nyɛe ma kpata si kake too; ke nyɛ pee ja a, nga mi lohwe awi yeli ɔmɛ maa hiɛ tsɔ, nɛ a maa hao nyɛ.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: E maa ngɔ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ. Nyɛɛ gbe mɛ nɛ a biɛ nɛ laa kulaa. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛe maa da; nyɛ ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sã a we amaga amɛ. Nyɛ hɛ ko kɔ̃ a sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu nɔ; nyɛ ko ngɔ ekoeko. Ke nyɛ ngɔ eko ɔ, e maa pee gbenɔ ha nyɛ; ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ sume amaga jami.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: E ha hwɔ ye nyɛ, nɛ e ha nyɛ abolo nɛ je hiɔwe nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ nɛ hyɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ye. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa pi abolo pɛ nɛ haa nɔmlɔ yi naa wami, se mohu munyu tsuaa munyu nɛ jeɔ Yawɛ nya mi ɔ nɛ haa nɔ yi naa wami.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ tsɔseɔ e bi ɔ, ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔsee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ fa nyɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ gbeye.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ yaa zugba nɛ baa ní saminya ko nɔ. Pahi, kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi ngɛ nɔ, nɛ jehanɛ nyu pãã si kɛ jee zu mi nɛ e suɔ kɛ pueɔ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Hwɔ be nyɛ yee, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛ hiae. Tɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ, dade ngɛ mi. Yo ɔmɛ a mi hu akɔblee ngɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa tsua.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ. Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ná ngma nɛ nyɛ ye nɛ nyɛ tɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma tsuhi nɛ ngɛ fɛu nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi;

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: jehanɛ, ke nyɛ na amɛ kɛ to ɔmɛ, nyɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu, kɛ ní kpa amɛ tsuo ba hiɛ babauu ɔ,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ko wo nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ba je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ. Lɛ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt, he nɛ a ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ kpaka nyɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa gbajaa nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeye ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ a naa sinɔhi nɛ a duɔ nya wa, kɛ nyingmogblakotohi ngɛ ɔ nɛ. Jehanɛ, ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ he nɛ nyu be ɔ, e je nyu kɛ je tslɛbo tɛ sa mi ha nyɛ.

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: Ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, e ha nyɛ mana, niye ní nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ yi hyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye. E ha nyɛ na hɛdo ní, nɛ e kɛ ka nyɛ hyɛ, konɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e gbaa nyɛ kɛ ní kpakpahi.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: E pee ja, konɛ nyɛ ko susu kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he wami nya nɛ nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ haa nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ kɛ naa ní. E ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ pee, ejakaa e ngɛ anɔkuale yee kɛ mwɔɔ ngɛ somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ he.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue ɔ, lɛɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi kpatae ngɛ nyɛ blɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ bu tue, Israel bi; mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa po Yordan pa a, konɛ nyɛ ya fie je ma amɛ nɛ kle, nɛ a he wa pe nyɛ ɔ. A fia gbogbo nɛ ya hiɔwe ploplooplo ngɔ wo a ma amɛ a he.

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: Oblaihi gojogojoo nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ a de ke nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we mɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Se mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na maa le kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ yaa kaa bɔ nɛ la tsoɔ gegeege kɛ sãã nɔ́ ɔ nɛ. E maa ye a nɔ ha nyɛ; e ma ha nyɛ maa fie mɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi amlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ wo nyɛ si ɔ.

english_verse: After the Lord helps you wipe out these nations and conquer their land, don't think he did it because you are such good people. You aren't good—you are stubborn! No, the Lord is going to help you, because the nations that live there are evil, and because he wants to keep the promise he made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. When Israel Made an Idol (Exodus
translation_verse: Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, pi nyɛ dami nɛ nyɛ da he je nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ zugba nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae. Dɛbi, ma nɛ kuɛ wa ji nyɛ.

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mi mi la ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ. Kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba si be nɛ nyɛ ba su hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã sɔuu nyɛ ngɛ tsɔe.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he po nyɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la; nɛ bɔ nɛ e mi mi fu ha a, e sa nɛ e kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘I le kaa ma nɛ ɔ kuɛ wa.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Ha mi blɔ nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó kai mɛ gblegbleegble hu. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma pee mo tsɛ ha ma ko nɛ kle, nɛ e he wa pe mɛ.’

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: I na kaa mlaa a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ tɔ̃ nɔ mo. Nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ. Nyɛ ngɔ dade kɛ ya sɔ̃ amaga nɛ ngɛ kaa na bi.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi nɔuu nɛ i ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ i hɛɛ ɔ ngɔ fia si nɛ a ywia wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Aaron hu Yawɛ mi mi fu lɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ e piɛ bɔɔ pɛ nɛ e ko gbe lɛ; se i kpa pɛɛ ha Aaron hu jamɛ a be ɔ mi kɛ̃.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, jamɛ a nɔ́ yaya a nɛ nyɛ sɔ̃, nɛ ji na bi ɔ, i ngɔ, nɛ i sã ngɛ la mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i ywia lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ nɛ i wɛɛ lɛ bɔdɔbɔdɔ; e pee kaa tabo zu, nɛ i ya hɛ lɛ ngɔ pue pa a nɛ je yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ngɛ bee ɔ mi.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mi mi la ngɛ Tabera, Masa, kɛ Kibrot hulɔ.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, benɛ e wo nyɛ blɔ kɛ je Kadesh Barnea, nɛ e fa nyɛ ke nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba nɛ e kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae kaa nyɛ weto ní ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi po, nyɛ tsɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã: nyɛ he we lɛ yi, nɛ nyɛ bui lɛ tue.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Kɛ je be nɛ i le nyɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã sɔuu nyɛ ngɛ tsɔe.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ya kpla si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu kɛ kpa pɛɛ ha nyɛ; ejakaa i le kaa Yawɛ to kaa e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: I kpa pɛɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, mo ko kpata mo nitsɛ o ma a hɛ mi; ma nɛ ɔ, mo nitsɛ lɛ o kpɔ̃ mɛ, nɛ o je mɛ kɛ je Egipt kɛ o kɔni si wami.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Mo kai Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob, o sɔmɔli ɔmɛ; nɛ o ko di ma nɛ ɔ tue wami, a yi mi wami, kɛ yayami ɔmɛ.’

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: Ke pi ja a, Egipt bi ɔmɛ ma de ke, ‘Nyɛɛ hyɛ, a Mawu ɔ nyɛ we nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya su zugba nɛ e wo si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ. A ma de ke o je o ma a kɛ ho nga kplanaa a nɔ ya, nɛ o ya gbe mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa o sume a sane.

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: O le kaa ma nɛ mo nitsɛ o hla ha o he, nɛ o kɛ kɔni si wami kpetekpleenyɛ je kɛ je Egipt ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ, nɛ o kpɛ tso daka nɛ a kɛ tɛ ɔmɛ maa wo mi. Ngɔɔ kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ,

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: konɛ ma ngma munyu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kekle tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o ywia a a nɔ ɔ kɛ wo tɛ tɛtlɛɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, konɛ o ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo daka a mi.’

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ akasia tso kɛ kpɛ daka, nɛ i kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ, nɛ i hɛɛ mɛ ngɛ ye dɛ mi kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ ngma munyu ɔmɛ nɛ e ngma ngɛ kekle tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɔ wo tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ehe nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ji mlaa nyɔngma amɛ nɛ a ngma ha nyɛ, benɛ e tu munyu kɛ je la a mi ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ yo ɔ he ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mi;

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: nɛ i kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ. Jehanɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mi ɔ, i ngɔ tɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo daka nɛ i kpɛ ɔ mi; tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ daka a mi kɛ mwɔɔ.”

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue, nɛ nyɛ ja lɛ nɔ kake pɛ. Nyɛɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale, nɛ nyɛɛ wo si ngɛ e biɛ mi pɛ.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: (Israel ma a hia kɛ je Yaakan bi ɔmɛ a nyu vu ɔmɛ a he kɛ ho Mosera ya. Lejɛ ɔ Aaron gbo ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ̃ a pu lɛ ngɛ; nɛ e binyumu Eleazar ye e se kaa osɔfo.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: A je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Gudgoda ya; nɛ a tsa nɔ kɛ ho he ko nɛ nyu hiɛ saminya ngɛ ya; a tsɛɛ lejɛ ɔ Yotbata.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ yoku ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ hla Levi wɛtso ɔ mi nyumuhi, konɛ a hyɛ somi daka a nɔ, nɛ a sɔmɔ kaa osɔfohi, nɛ́ a ngɔ Yawɛ biɛ kɛ gbaa ma a. A blɔ nya ní tsumihi ji enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Yaa nɛ o ya nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ i ka a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ngɛ he ke ma ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ.’ Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke Israel ma a nɛ pee

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ hlae kaa nyɛɛ pee ɔ tue. Nyɛ ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛɛ suɔ lɛ, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, kɛ nyɛ klaa tsuo.

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, konɛ e hi ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ́ ji hiɔwe ploplooplo ɔ tsuo, zugba a, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ suɔmi nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nya wa wawɛɛ he je ɔ, e hla nyɛ nɛ ji a nina a mohu ngɛ je ma kpa amɛ a mi; nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ ji e ma nɛ e hla.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ ko wa tue hu.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji Mawu nɛ pe mawuhi tsuo kulaa, nɛ e he wami se be. E ji Mawu nɛ kle, nɛ e he wa; nɛ e sa nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye. E hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e he we nyɔ mi ní.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: E hyɛɛ kaa a ye awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi a sane pɛpɛɛpɛ ha mɛ. E suɔ nihi nɛ ba to wɔ nibwɔ ɔ, nɛ e haa mɛ a niye ní, kɛ a heha ní.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ suɔ nibwɔ ɔmɛ a sane; ejakaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ya to nubwɔ hyɛ ngɛ Egipt.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je e yi; lɛ ji nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ tsu ní nguanguahi nɛ ngɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ daa.

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: kɛ nyakpɛ níhi hulɔ. Nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ e pee Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e zugba a tsuo kulaa a.

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kpata Egipt ta a, kɛ a okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ɔ. E ha Wo Tsu ɔ mi nyu ɔ mii Egipt ta a tsuo, benɛ a nyɛɛ nyɛ se ɔ.

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le níhi nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ba su hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ e pee Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi no Eliab binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Datan kɛ Abiram ɔ. Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ zugba a mi gba nɛ e mii mɛ kɛ a weku li, kɛ a lohwehi tsuo.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na ní nguanguahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ tsu ɔ kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ. Gbaamihi nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ a wo he si ɔ nɔ

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ a nɔ. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ ma nyɛ maa po pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa sɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ se maa kɛ ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ Yawɛ wo si ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a nina a nɔ.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: se zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ nɛ ɔ, e ji yo nɔ zugba kɛ e mi kɔ̃hi. Hiɔmi nɛɛ saminya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ baa zugba nɛ ɔ yi, nɛ e buu he jeha a mi tsuo.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ; nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ja lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.

english_verse: he will send rain at the right seasons, so you will have more than enough food, wine, and olive oil, and there will be plenty of grass for your cattle.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma na nga hu kɛ ha nyɛ na amɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye ní nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ.

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi kɛkɛ, konɛ a ko mlɔɔ nyɛ kɛ je Yawɛ he kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ pee ja a, Yawɛ mi mi ma fu nyɛ. E be hae nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ hu, nɛ zugba a ma gbli, nɛ e be ní bae hu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ hwɔ ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ susu a he saminya. Nyɛɛ fi kɛ wo nyɛ kɔni si, kɛ nyɛ hɛ nya kaa kaimi nɔ́.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ. Nyɛɛ sɛɛ he ní be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ we mi, be nɛ nyɛ hia blɔ, be nɛ nyɛ hwɔɔ si, kɛ be nɛ nyɛ te si.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngma ngɔ wo nyɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a he, kɛ nyɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya.

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ se maa kɛ ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ wo si ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ. Nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ daa kɛ yaa si je mi nyagbe.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale.

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa fie jamɛ a je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a he wa pe nyɛ ɔ kɛ je zugba amɛ a nɔ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: He tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ maa ya ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha ni ɔmɛ maa ye nyɛ gbeye kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ nyɛe.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i ngɔ gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe konɛ nyɛɛ hla nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: E maa pee gbaami ha nyɛ, ke nyɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ;

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: se e maa pee gbiɛmi, ke nyɛ yi mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpale kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ ja we mɛ hyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ ya su zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ de gbaami munyu ɔmɛ kɛ je Gerizim yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ gbiɛmi munyu ɔmɛ hu kɛ je Ebal yo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: E su be nɛ nyɛ maa po Yordan pa a, nɛ nyɛ ma ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ. Ke nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya konɛ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye mɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: “Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ nyɛ wami be tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa hi zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Hehi nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ nyɛ yaa fie ɔ jaa a mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ, ngɛ yo gaga amɛ a nɔ, yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ tso kusuu ɔmɛ a sisi ɔ, nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ku a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ywia a wɔ titima amɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ. Nyɛɛ sã a yo wɔ Ashera a, nɛ nyɛɛ poo a mawu ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ pue he. Nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, konɛ a ko ja mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ hu.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ he saisaa kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Se ke he nɛ a to kaa a ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa gbe nyɛ na, loo to nɛ Yawɛ kɛ dloo nyɛ ɔ eko, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɔ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ we mi kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momo ɔ.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e yeɔ lo ɔ eko; nɔ ɔ he tsɔ jio, nɔ ɔ he tsɔ we jio, e ye kaa bɔ nɛ e maa ye bayelɔ, loo avugbɛ lo ɔ.

english_verse: But don't eat the blood. It is the life of the animal, so let it drain out on the ground before you eat the meat.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ngɔ muɔ kɛ pee niye ní; mohu nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ pue zugba kaa nyu.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ye mlaa nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ bua maa jɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa hi ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina tsuo.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sã nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, lo kɛ muɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Nyɛ bɔ kpa amɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kpa muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lo ɔ.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee, nɛ i wo nyɛ mlaa ngɛ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ fitsofitso; kɛkɛ ɔ, níhi a mi maa hi ha nyɛ kɛ nyɛ nia tsuo kɛ maa ya neneene; ejakaa ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ saa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi pee. Amaga jami he kɔkɔ bɔmi

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kpata je ma amɛ nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ a zugba a a hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ kulaa.

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kaa a jaa a mawu ɔmɛ; ejakaa ngɛ a mawu ɔmɛ a jami mi ɔ, a peeɔ níhi nɛ a hĩɔ, nɛ́ Yawɛ sume ɔ tsuo. A bimɛ po a sãã ngɛ la mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya ja Mawu kpahi, nɛ pohu nyɛ ja we mɛ hyɛ ɔ, ke kaa níhi nɛ e wo a he si ɔ ba mi tete po ɔ,

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: nyɛ ko bu lɛ tue fɛɛ. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ kae nɛ e hyɛ kaa nyɛ suɔ lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ saminya ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi lo.

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ se, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ pɛ gbeye; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ; nyɛ ja lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi ja a, Israel ma a tsuo maa nu sane ɔ he; a maa ye gbeye, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ́ yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ pee hu.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ ngɛ ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ ɔ a mi, nɛ nyɛ nu kaa

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: yakayaka nimli komɛ nɛ ji Israel fɔfɔɛhi puɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a tue nɛ a ya ja mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ ja we hyɛ ɔ,

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: nyɛ bi nɛ nyɛɛ na nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nu ɔ mi fitsofitso. Ke sane ɔ ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa a pee nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: lɛɛ nyɛɛ gbe jamɛ a ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo. Nyɛɛ ngɔ klaate kɛ kpata ma a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ngɔ níhi nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi ɔ eko kɛ to ha nyɛ he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi nɛ fu nyɛ wawɛɛ ɔ nya maa ba si, nɛ e maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ. E maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ he maa hiɛ babauu kaa bɔ nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ.

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ, Yawɛ maa pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ níhi ji nyɛ. E hla nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a mi kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma. Lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we (Mose III,

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ye lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye lohwe tsuaa lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ nɛ a gba e nane kokloto mi, nɛ e gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ e yeɔ, nɛ e kpale taa ekohu.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ye kpotoo. E he tsɔ we; ejakaa a gba e nane kokloto mi lɛɛ, se e gɔle we nɔ́ nɛ e yeɔ nɛ e taa ekohu. Nyɛ ko ye lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ a lo, nɛ nyɛ ko ta a gbogboe he hulɔ.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ye nyu mi lo nɛ ngɛ se mi mio, nɛ toto ha e he,

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: se nyu mi lo nɛ be se mi mio, nɛ toto hɛ e he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; e he tsɔ we.

english_verse: But don't eat the meat of any of the following birds: eagles, vultures, falcons, kites, ravens, ostriches, owls, sea gulls, hawks, pelicans, ospreys, cormorants, storks, herons, and hoopoes. You must not eat bats.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ ko ye lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a henɔ ɔmɛ: kɔle, klomi, kayo, osansa, alɔɔ, okpoku, kɔɔkɔmite, duguma, anuma, nyɔ mi kayo, nga mi kpakpahe, omiɔhɔɔ, pa nɔ kayo, kpokukpoku, godo, kɔne, kɛ apani.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: “Lohwe tsɔwi nɛ tee ɔ tsuo a he tsɔ we; nyɛ ko ye.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye lohwe tsɔwi nɛ a he tsɔ.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko ye lohwe ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo. Nyɛ kɛ ha nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ɔ nɛ a ye, loo nyɛɛ jua ha ni kpahi. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nihi ji nyɛ; nyɛ ji e ma. Nyɛ ko hoo jijɔ bi, loo apletsi bi ngɛ e nyɛ nyɔ nyu mi. Mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake he mlaa

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ je nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní mi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake kɛ to daa jeha.

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ya he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ye nyɛ blɛfo, wai, kɛ oliv nu mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a, kɛ nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ kase bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye nyɛ wami be tsuo.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ we mi kɛ jami he ɔ kɛ tsɔ, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa tloo ní ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a kɛ ya a,

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ sika a kɛ he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ, na, wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ weku li nɛ ye ní, nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he saminya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko si Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ se; mɛɛ lɛɛ a be weto ní ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Jeha etɛ tsuaa jeha etɛ nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a tsuo nya kɛ ba to ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Levi bi ɔmɛ a niye ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a be weto ní ko. Nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi hu nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a ye eko nɛ a tɔ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue ɔ mi.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: “Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko dɛ mi ba ta ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ ɔ, koo pee kpɛle nɛ o nyɛ lɛ nɔ́ he.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ o maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pa Israel fɔfɔɛ ko sika a, e kɛ ke lɛ; e ko je hiɔ ɔ hu. Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ de ke a kɛ hiɔ ɔ nɛ ke.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Ke nubwɔ ɔ, lɛɛ jee lɛ hiɔ; se mo nitsɛ o ma mi no lɛɛ koo je lɛ hiɔ ɔ.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa gbaa mo kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. O maa pa sika kɛ ha mahi babauu, se moo lɛɛ o be sika pae ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɛ; o maa ye je mahi babauu a nɔ, se moo lɛɛ je ma ko je ma ko be o nɔ yee.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Ke jeha nɛ a kɛ hiɔ kee nɔ ɔ su ta po, ko kua kaa o maa pa lɛ nɔ́ ko. Ko ha susumi yaya kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ba o yi mi. Ke o kua lɛ nɔ́ nɛ hia lɛ ɔ hami, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ kɛ si mo ɔ, a maa bu mo fɔ.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ha lɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ hiae ɔ faa nɛ kpɛle peemi be mi. Ke o pee ja a, Yawɛ maa gbaa mo ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ mi.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ke lohwe ɔmɛ a nane kplɔ ngɛ a sisi, loo a hɛngmɛ yu, loo sakpa ko ngɛ a he ɔ, koo ngɔ mɛ kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Se ke o ngmɛɛ e he ɔ, ko ha nɛ e ya dɛ gu.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ níhi nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ gbaa mo ɔ, to, blɛfo, kɛ wai ɔ eko kɛ ha lɛ faa, nɛ o kɛ wo lɛ blɔ.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: “Se ke nyɔguɛ ɔ sume nɛ e si mo, akɛnɛ e suɔ o kɛ o we ɔ nyɛ sane ngɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ lɛ hi si saminya a he je ɔ,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: lɛɛ ngɔɔ tue gbumi nɔ́ kɛ gbu e tue ngɛ o we ɔ sinya a he; kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee o nyɔguɛ e wami be tsuo. Ke yo ji lɛ hu, o pee lɛ jã kɛ̃.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: “Moo hla o na amɛ, kɛ o to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ku ɔmɛ nɛ a ma fɔ ɔ ngɔ to ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ; koo ngɔ na nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsu nɔ́ ko, nɛ jijɔ bi ɔmɛ hu ko sã a he bwɔmi.

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: Daa jeha a, o kɛ o weku li nɛ ye mɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ he nɛ e to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: O ma nyɛ maa ye mɛ ngɛ we mi. Nyɛ tsuo, ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we ma nyɛ maa ye kaa bɔ nɛ a yeɔ batslɔɔ, loo nga mi gbe ɔ.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Se a muɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ko ye; nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ ngɔ pue si kaa nyu.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ye Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Abib ɔ mi kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami. Nyɔ ko mi ngɛ jamɛ a nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi nɛ e kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee nɔ nɛ sa, nɛ nyɛɛ ye dami sane daa. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ maa su zugba nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ daa.
