translation_verse: Se ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha nɔ nɛ pi Israel no ji lɛ ɔ, o ma nyɛ ma he lɛ hekpa. Ke o ye mlaa nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma tsu ngɛ zugba a nɛ o yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ha mo.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: “Ke o wo Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ si ɔ, ye nɔ; koo to tsle. Yawɛ hyɛɛ blɔ kaa o ye o siwo ɔ nɔ; nɛ ke o pee we ja a, e ji tɔmi.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Ke o wui Yawɛ si kulaa a, e pi tɔmi.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Se ke o je mo nitsɛ o tsui mi nɛ o wo si ɔ, ye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: “Ke o ya sɛ o nyɛmi wai ngmɔ mi ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ye wai yiblii ɔ bɔ nɛ o suɔ nɛ o tɔ; se koo ngɔ eko kɛ wo o níhi a mi kɛ je.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Ke o ya sɛ o nyɛmi ngma ngmɔ mi ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ku eko nɛ o kpe; se koo dɔ ngma kpami ha ngɔ fɔ o nyɛmi ɔ ngma a nɔ.

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko ngɔ yo, nɛ pee se ɔ, e sume lɛ hu; ejakaa e na nɔ́ yayami ko ngɛ yo ɔ he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngma gba mi pomi womi nɛ e ngɔ wo e dɛ; nɛ e ha e je e we ɔ mi.

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi ja a, nyumu nɛ e kɛ hi si kekleekle ɔ ko kpale ngɔ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ; ejakaa yo ɔ ble e he. Yawɛ hiɔ kaa e maa kpale ngɔ lɛ ekohu. Ko tsu musu ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ. Mlaa munomunohi

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Ke nyumu ko kpee yo he ɔ, a ko ha nɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ ya ta, nɛ a ko ha lɛ ma ní tsumi ko hu nɛ e tsu. A ha nɛ e hi si gu jeha kake, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e hi we mi, nɛ e kɛ e yo ɔ tsuo a bua nɛ jɔ a he.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that they will pay back the loan. But don't take one or both of their millstones, or else they may starve. They need these stones for grinding grain into flour to make bread. Kidnapping Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha nɔ ko ɔ, koo ngɔ e wɛ, kɛ e wɛ mi bi nɛ e kɛ gblɛɔ blɛfo ɔ kɛ to awaba. Ke o pee ja a, níhi nɛ e kɛ ma na e nya mi ngma nɛ o kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ju e nyɛmi Israel no, nɛ e maa pee lɛ nyɔguɛ, aloo e maa jua lɛ ɔ, á gbe lɛ. Bɔ nɛ o maa pee kɛ je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.
translation_verse: “Ke o ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ko nue ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o pee bɔ nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ma de mo ke o pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kai nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ pee Miriam ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, benɛ nyɛ je Egipt kɛ ma a.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.
translation_verse: “Ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha nɔ ko ɔ, koo nyɛɛ e se kɛ ya e we mi ke e ha mo e bo nɛ e ma kɛ to awaba ha mo ɔ.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: Dá si ngɛ e we ɔ se, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ha mo.

english_verse: Suppose someone is so poor that a coat is the only thing that can be offered as a guarantee on a loan. Don't keep the coat overnight.
translation_verse: Ke ohiatsɛ ji nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ ba to awaba a, je ko jɔ yi ngɛ o ngɔ.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Daa gbɔkuɛ ɔ, kpale kɛ ha lɛ, konɛ e kɛ hwɔ si. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa na mo si, nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ bua maa jɔ o he.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: “Koo sisi apaatsɛ ohiatsɛ nɛ e fi lɛ ɔ, o nyɛmi Israel no jio, nubwɔ nɛ ngɛ o ma amɛ eko mi jio.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Daa ligbi, loko pu maa nɔ si ɔ, wo lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu jamɛ a ligbi ɔ he hiɔ. Sika a he ngɛ lɛ hiae, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ. Ke o wui lɛ hiɔ ɔ, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ he ɔ, a maa bu mo fɔ kaa o pee yayami.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “A ko gbe fɔli ngɛ a bimɛ a tɔmihi a he; nɛ á ko gbe bimɛ hu ngɛ a fɔli a tɔmihi a he. A gbe nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tɔmi he pɛ.

english_verse: Make sure that orphans and foreigners are treated fairly. And if you lend money to a widow and want to keep something of hers to guarantee that she will pay you back, don't take any of her clothes.
translation_verse: “Ko plɛ nubwɔ nɛ ba ngɛ o ma a mi, kɛ awusa a sane hɛ mi kɛ bu si; nɛ ko he yalɔyo he ha nɔ́ kaa awaba tomi nɔ́.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mo kai kaa o ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt, nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ha o ye o he, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ mo mlaa nɛ ɔ woe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: “Ke o bua o ngmɔ niba ní nya, nɛ e piɛ blɛfo nɛ o kpɔ pue si ɔ eko nɛ o ngɔɛ kɛ bɛ we mi ɔ, koo kpale ya kukuɔ; mo si ha nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi, konɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ gbaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsue nɔ ha mo.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Ke o bua o wai yiblii ɔmɛ a nya si kake ɔ, koo kpale o se nɛ o ya bua nya si enyɔne ngɛ he kake ɔ kɛ̃; si wai yiblii nɛ piɛ ɔ ha nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: O hɛ ko je nɔ gblegbleegble kaa o ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i wo mo mlaa nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ nɛ ye fɔ ɔ sa kpa a, kojolɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɛ a bu lɛ si, nɛ á fia lɛ kpa. Kpa abɔ nɛ a maa fia lɛ ɔ maa je bɔ nɛ e tɔmi ɔ kle ha.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: A ko fia nɔ kpa nɛ pe si nyingmi eywiɛ; ke e pe ja a, lɛɛ o pue o nyɛmi ɔ hɛ mi si ngɛ ma hɛ mi.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Na nɛ ngɛ ngma gblɛe ha mo ɔ, koo fi e nya. Nyɛminyumu nɛ gbo e yalɔyo ngɔmi

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Se ke nyumu ɔ sume kaa e maa ngɔ e nyɛminyumu ɔ yalɔyo ɔ, lɛɛ yo ɔ nɛ e ya ma agbo ɔ nya, nɛ ya de ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Ye huno ɔ nyɛminyumu ɔ kplɛɛ we kaa e ma tsu e blɔ nya ní: e sume kaa e ma ha e nyɛminyumu ɔ ma na ngmɛdu ngɛ Israel.’

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi ja a, ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ nyumu ɔ, nɛ á tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ. Ke e ma nɔ mi kaa e be yo ɔ ngɔe ɔ,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: lɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ yalɔyo ɔ nɛ ya nyumu ɔ ngɔ ngɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. A je nyumu ɔ tokota kake ngɛ e nane, nɛ e su lada kɛ pue nyumu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ é de ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ nɔ nɛ sume nɛ e wo nina ha e nyɛminyumu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’

english_verse: From then on, that man's family will be known as “the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.” When Two Men Fight Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Biɛ nɛ a ma kɛ tsɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ weku ngɛ Israel ji, ‘Nɔ nɛ a je e tokota ngɛ e nane ɔ weku.’ Mlaa kpahi

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: “Ke nyumuhi enyɔ ngɛ kunɔ nɔe, nɛ nɔ kake e yo ba piɛ e huno ɔ he, nɛ e nu nɔ kpa a nyumu tso kɛ e sungmɛ ɔ,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: poo yo ɔ nine; koo na lɛ mɔbɔ kulaa.

english_verse: Don't try to cheat people by having two sets of weights or measures, one to get more when you are buying, and the other to give less when you are selling.
translation_verse: “Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ jiimi ngmɛe, loo o ngɛ nɔ́ kami susue ɔ, koo sisi nɔ.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: O sɛni tɛhi, kɛ susumi kpa tsuo nɛ su pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ sume nihi nɛ sisiɔ nɔ. A fa ke á gbe Amalek bi ɔmɛ

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: “Mo kai nɔ́ nɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ pee mo ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, benɛ o je Egipt kɛ ma a.

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ a yi Mawu gbeye he je ɔ, a tua o se ta a, benɛ pɔ tɔ ta buli ɔmɛ, nɛ peepee ta a he ɔ; nɛ a gbe ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ didaae ngɛ se ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha mo, nɛ e je mo kɛ je o he nyɛli tsuo nɛ bɔle mo kɛ kpe ɔ a dɛ mi ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o gbe Amalek bi ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ ko kó kai mɛ hu. O hɛ ko je nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ!

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: “Ke e ba mi kaa o ya su zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e pee o nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ kekleekle niba ní nɛ e kpa ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ eko kɛ wo kusii mi, nɛ é ngɔ kɛ ya he nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ kɛ ya osɔfo nɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe jamɛ a be ɔ ngɔ, nɛ o de lɛ ke, ‘Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i ngɛ odase yee ngɛ Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi kaa i ba su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo wa nɛmɛ si ke e kɛ ma ha wɔ ɔ nɔ.’

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ he kusii ɔ ngɛ o dɛ kɛ ma Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: Mo de ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ke, ‘Aram no si kpalɔ ji ye nɛ̃. E kɛ nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ ho Egipt ya; e ya to nubwɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se a ba pee ma agbo nɛ he wa saminya.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Egipt bi ɔmɛ pee wɔ yayami; a wa wɔ yi mi, nɛ a ye wɔ nyɔguɛ wawɛɛ.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ wa fa kue kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ, nɛ e bu wa gbi tue. E na wa haomi kɛ dengme gbomi, kɛ yi mi nɛ a ngɛ wɔ wae ɔ.

english_verse: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɔ e he wami kɛ kɔni si wami nɛ ngɛ gbeye kɛ je wɔ kɛ je Egipt. E pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi babauu.

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e kɛ wɔ ba su hiɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha wɔ zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ zugba nɛ mo, Yawɛ ngɔ ha mi ɔ mi kekleekle niba ní ɔ eko kɛ ba.’ “Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ kusii ɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ o ja Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mo nya ngɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ Yawɛ ha o kɛ o we ɔ he. Ha nɛ Levi no, kɛ nubwɔ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ nɛ a piɛ o he kɛ nya.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: “Jeha etɛ tsuaa jeha etɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ o niba ní mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake kɛ ha Levi bi, nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi, konɛ mɛ tsuo a na niye ní nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ ngɛ ma a mi he tsuaa he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ,

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: de Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ke, ‘I je ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je ye we ɔ mi, nɛ i ngɔ ha Levi bi, nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi ngɛ mlaa nɛ o wo mi ɔ nya; i tɔ̃ we ekoeko, nɛ ye hɛ ji eko nɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ɔ, i yi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ eko; benɛ ye he tsɔ we ɔ, i ngɔɛ eko kɛ ji ye we ɔ mi; jehanɛ hu, i kɛ eko sɛ̃ bɔ ha gbogboe ko. Niinɛ, Yawɛ, ye Mawu, i bu mo tue. Mlaahi tsuo nɛ o wo mi nɛ kɔɔ mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ he ɔ, i ye nɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Moo je o hi he klɔuklɔu ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ o hyɛ, nɛ o gbaa o ma Israel. Moo gbaa zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní saminya, nɛ o ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o wo wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ.’ Yawɛ nitsɛ e ma

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo fae ke o ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ o tsui tsuo.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, e je o nya mi nɛ o de ke Yawɛ ji o Mawu. O wo si kaa o maa bu lɛ tue; o wo si kaa o maa ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ; nɛ o wo si hu kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e fa mo ke o pee ɔ, o maa pee.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hu he mo atuu kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. E ngɛ mo fae ke o ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: E ma ha nɛ o pee ma ngua a pe ma amɛ tsuo. O ma je e yi, nɛ o maa wo e hɛ mi nyami. Nɛ o maa pee lɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nitsɛ, e ma kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Mose kɛ Israel ma a tu munyu, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo fi e se. Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ bu níhi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ tue.

english_verse: Soon you will enter the land that the Lord your God is giving to you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped, and he has promised that this land is rich with milk and honey. After you cross the Jordan River, go to Mount Ebal. Set up large slabs of stone, then cover them with white plaster and write on them a copy of these laws.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ su zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si ngɛ Ebal yo ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ fae mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpa a he kalo.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛhi nɛ a kɛ dade kó we nɛ ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ maa ma bɔ sami la tɛ ko ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛhi nɛ a kɛ dade kó we nɛ ma. Nyɛɛ sã nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, nyɛɛ sã nyɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ bla nyɛɛ ye ní. Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't forget to write out a copy of these laws on the stone slabs that you are going to set up. Make sure that the writing is easy to read. Curses on Those Who Disobey
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngma mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ kalo kpa a he ɔ a nɔ; nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ ningma a nɛ je si paa.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Levi bi ɔmɛ tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ pee dii nɛ nyɛɛ bu mi tue. Israel bi, mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ pee Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma.

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Mose de Israel ma a ke,

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ ma amɛ, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ babauu; nyɛ zugba a maa ba ní, nɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi, nɛ ji nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ nyɛ to ɔmɛ hu maa bɔ.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ niba ní, kɛ niye ní nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kɛ jeɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ, nyɛ ba we mi jio, nyɛ hia blɔ jio.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nyɛ ní tsumi nɔ, nɛ nyɛ gba amɛ ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ. E maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ e kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ loko je ma amɛ tsuo maa na kaa Yawɛ hla nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ gbeye.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ bimɛ, we mi lohwehi, kɛ ngmɔ niba ní babauu ngɛ zugba nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke e maa ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ e be mi; e maa gbaa nyɛ ní tsumi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. Mahi babauu ma ba pa ní ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e be nyɛ hiae kaa nyɛ ya pa nɔ́ ko ngɛ ma ko ma ko dɛ.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa pee nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ; ma amɛ maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se; pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ maa hi se. Ke nyɛ maa bu Mawu mlaa amɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ maa ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa pee bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ fae mwɔnɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ maa ya nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, nɛ nyɛ be se yae kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ gbo ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ma ba ye nyɛ, nɛ a be nɔ ko nae nɛ maa fie mɛ ngɛ nyɛ gbogboe ɔ he.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Haomi ɔmɛ maa pee okadi, kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: “Se ke nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ yi e fami ɔmɛ, kɛ e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Your businesses and farms will fail.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ ma amɛ, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ bimɛ, nɛ a he be hiɛe. E maa gbiɛ nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ; a be bɔe, nɛ nyɛ zugba a hu ma gbo; nyɛ be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nae ngɛ mi.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ, nyɛ ba we mi jio, nyɛ hia blɔ jio.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ kua Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya pee yayami ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ: nyɛ ma didaa; nyɛ maa pee basaa, nɛ nyɛ maa bɔ ahlua ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma tsu mi. E ma tsa nɔ ja kɛ yaa si nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma ha bunyuku, kɛ zia maa je hiɔwe kɛ ba pue nyɛ nɔ kɛ yaa si nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: “Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa ye nyɛ nɔ. Nyɛ maa gu he kake kɛ ya tua mɛ, se a maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa basaa, nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye gbeye ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma ha tslɔɔ maa fuu nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Egipt bi ɔmɛ ɔ. Nyɛ maa hia pa, nɛ sakpa kɛ ngmo nɛ be tsa ba ma pue nyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ maa fo godo, nyɛ hɛngmɛhi ma yu, nɛ nyɛ juɛmi maa pee basaa.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maa hi si tataae piani katakata kaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́, nɛ nyɛ be blɔ nae. Nyɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɔ yae? A maa wa nyɛ yi mi, nɛ a maa fia nyɛ ojo be tsuaa be; se nyɛ be nɔ ko nae nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha nyɛ.

english_verse: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ma bi yo si, se nyumu kpa maa ngɔ lɛ; nyɛ maa ma tsu, se nyɛ be mi hie; nyɛ ma hu wai ngmɔ, se nyɛ be e mi wai yiblii ɔ eko yee.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: A maa gbe nyɛ na ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi paa, se nyɛ be e lo ɔ eko nae maa ye. Nyɛ hɛ mi paa nɛ a ma kpɔ̃ nyɛ tejihi pani nya kɛ je kɛ ho, nɛ a be kpalee kɛ ba ha nyɛ hu. A maa ngɔ nyɛ tohi kɛ ha nyɛ he nyɛli, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be ngmlaa jee ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ mi paa nɛ a maa ngɔ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ yi ɔmɛ kɛ ha ma je li. Daa ligbi ɔ, nyɛ maa hi nyɛ bimɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ kaa a maa kpale kɛ ba lo, se lɛ tsuo maa pee yaka.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Nyɛ zugba a nɔ niba ní nɛ nyɛ gbo he dengme ɔ hu, je ma ko nɛ nyɛ li ma ba ye lɛ tsuo; nyɛ be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nae, se a maa wa nyɛ yi mi, nɛ a maa pee nyɛ posoo kaa zugba zu.

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: Hɛdo ní nɛ nyɛ maa na a, ma ha nyɛ maa fo godo.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ, kɛ nyɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ ya ma se he nɛ nyɛ li, he nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ tete hí hyɛ; nyɛ ma ya sɔmɔ mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tso kɛ tɛ pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Ma amɛ, he nɛ Yawɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya a, a mi bi ɔmɛ maa ye gbeye ngɛ nyakpɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ he; a maa muɔ nyɛ, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ he fɛu.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ma du ní babauu ngɛ nyɛ ngmɔ mi, se ní bɔɔ pɛ nyɛ ma kpa; ejakaa baalɛ maa ye nyɛ niba ní ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maa pee wai ngmɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma gbo dengme kɛ hyɛ nɔ saminya, se nyɛ be wai yiblii ɔ kpae, nɛ nyɛ be wai ɔ hu eko nae maa nu; ejakaa gɔgɔ maa ye wai tso ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Oliv tsohi maa puɛ ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ he tsuaa he, se nyɛ be nu ɔ eko nae; ejakaa oliv tso ɔmɛ a yiblii ɔ ma kplɔ pue si.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Baalɛ maa sɛ nyɛ tso ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a ma puɛ niba ní ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa ya nɔ ma plɔke; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ si kɛkɛ nyɛ maa hi gbee.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: A ma na ní, nɛ a maa pa nyɛ eko, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be ní nae nɛ nyɛ maa pa mɛ eko. Nyagbe mi ɔ, mɛ lɛ a maa ye nyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: “Haomi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ e ma tsa nɔ jã kɛ̃ kɛ yaa su be nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ; ejakaa nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ yi e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbaa nyɛ ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ, se nyɛ sume nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ nyami nɛ je tsui mi.

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ma sɔmɔ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nɛ a te si kɛ wo nyɛ ɔ. Hwɔ kɛ kuma maa ye nyɛ; nyɛ maa hɛɛ nyɛ he gu, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa hia nyɛ. Nyɛ he nyɛli maa wa nyɛ yi mi wawɛɛ kɛ yaa si a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma ha je ma ko nɛ nyɛ nui a gbi maa je zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ nyɛ ba hwu. A ma ba tua nyɛ tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ kɔle gblɔɔ nɔ́ ɔ.

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ ɔ yi mi maa wa; a be nɔkɔtɔma bue, nɛ jokuɛyo hu a be lɛ mɔbɔ nae.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: A ma ba tua nyɛ ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ, hluu kɛ yaa si be nɛ gbogbo gojogojoo ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ tsuo maa hule pue si.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yo odehe mi odehe nɛ na ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ e hia we lɛ kaa e nyɛɛ kɛ ya he ko po maa pee jã kɛ̃. Ke he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba sá ma a yi ɔ, lɛ hu e yi ma fi ngɛ niye ní blɔ fa mi; e maa ye bimwɔyo he nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e fɔ ɔ ngɛ laami mi, nɛ e maa ye fɔmi se ɔ hulɔ. Lɛ nɔ kake e maa laa maa ye, nɛ e be e huno nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya a, loo e bimɛ ɔmɛ eko hae.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e ma ha hiɔ munomunohi, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ yayamihi nɛ a wui a nɔ ta ngɛ Mawu womi ɔ nɛ a ngma mlaa amɛ, kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ ma ba fɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ he maa hiɛ kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe lɛɛ, se nyɛ ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami; ejakaa nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ bua jɔ nyɛ he, nɛ e ha nyɛ plɔke, nɛ nyɛ he hiɛ babauu ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e bua maa jɔ e he, nɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. A maa fie nyɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ tsuo a mi, kɛ maa je je ɔ nyagbe he kake kɛ maa ya nyagbe he kake, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tso kɛ tɛ pee, mawuhi nɛ nyɛ, loo nyɛ nɛmɛ ja we hyɛ.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ maa na a maa wo nyɛ he gbeye, nɛ nyɛ tsui maa po.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa Yawɛ de ke nyɛ be kpalee kɛ ya Egipt gblegbleegble lɛɛ, se e maa wo nyɛ lɛ, nɛ e maa kpale nyɛ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ma hla kaa nyɛ maa jua nyɛ he kaa nyɔguɛ ha nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se a be nɔ ko nae nɛ ma he nyɛ.”

english_verse: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai. The Third Speech: Israel Must Keep Its Agreement with the Lord The Lord Is Your God
translation_verse: Somi nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a so ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ mi munyu komɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. E slo somi nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ kɛ Israel ma a so ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he ɔ.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, benɛ wa ba su hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon, kɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og hia ta kɛ kpee wɔ. Se wa ye a nɔ,

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: nɛ wa ngɔ a zugba a, nɛ wa dla mi ngɔ ha Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye somi ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ ye manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa pee mi.

english_verse: Today everyone in our nation is standing here in the Lord's presence, including leaders and officials, parents and children, and even those foreigners who cut wood and carry water for us. We are at this place of worship to promise that we will keep our part of the agreement with the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ fua ngɔ fɔ somi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ soe ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pɛtɛ níhi nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ tsu ngɛ mi ɔ a he.

english_verse: In this agreement, the Lord promised that you would be his people and that he would be your God. He first made this promise to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and today the Lord is making this same promise to you. But it isn't just for you; it is also for your descendants.
translation_verse: Se e kɛ wɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ soe ɔ nɛ; wɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi mwɔnɛ ɔ, kɛ wa nina nɛ a fɔ we mɛ lolo ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Nyɛ na a musu ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ, amagahi nɛ a kɛ tso, kɛ tɛ, kɛ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ se kɛ ya ja ma je li a mawu ɔmɛ, nyumu jio, yo jio, weku jio, wɛtso jio. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa tso sipoku nɛ maa wa, nɛ maa ngɔ e duɔ kɛ gbla haomi kɛ ba nyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ somi munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nue mwɔnɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó mlɔɔ e he kaa ke e pee lɛ nitsɛ e tsui wami nya ní ɔ, e maa hi ha lɛ ligbi ko. Ke nɔ ko pee ja a, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata, nɔ kpakpa, kɛ nɔ yayami tsuo nɛ slɔɔto ko be mi.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma je e hɛ kɛ pi lɛ, nɛ e maa gbla e tue. Gbiɛmihi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ Yawɛ mlaa womi nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a to kɛ ha nihi nɛ ma tɔ̃ somi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ maa ba e nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: “Hwɔɔ se yi nɔ bi nɛ ji nyɛ nina, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ je ma se zugbahi a nɔ tsuo maa na haomihi, kɛ amanehluhi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ba nyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: La zu, kɛ ngo maa ha ngmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be hie dumi ngɛ nɔ hu, nɛ nga po be puɛe ngɛ nɔ. Nyɛ zugba a maa pee kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora, kɛ Adma kɛ Zeboiim nɛ Yawɛ kpata a hɛ mi benɛ e mi mi fu wawɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi ja a, je ɔ tsuo ma bi si ke, ‘Mɛni he je nɛ Yawɛ pee e zugba a kikɛ nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Mɛni he je e mi mi fu wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?’ Heto nɛ a ma na ji, ‘Nɔ́ he je nɛ e ba ja a ji kaa Yawɛ ma a yi somi nɛ a kɛ lɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ so ɔ nɔ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: A ya sɔmɔ mawu kpahi nɛ a ja we hyɛ, mawuhi nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ mlaa ke a ko ja kɔkɔɔkɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Yawɛ mi mi wo la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e kɛ mi mi la nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ hia mɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ, nɛ e sake mɛ ngɔ pue ma se zugba ko nɔ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.’

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: “Laami ní komɛ ngɛ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ je we kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ, se e je e mlaa a kpo ngɔ ha wɔ kɛ wa nina, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa ye nɔ kɛ ya neneene.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, i ngɔ gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi ngɔ pue nyɛ hɛ mi, nɛ́ nyɛɛ hla mi nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ. Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya je ma je li a kpɛti, he nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a, nyɛ ma kai níhi nɛ i ngɔ pue nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Ke kaa je ɔ nyagbe he tɔɔ po nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a, e ma bua nyɛ nya, nɛ e maa kpale nyɛ kɛ ba,

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛ ba ngɔ zugba a he nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi ɔ, nɛ e pee nyɛ nɔ́ ekohu. Jehanɛ, e ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma na ní, nɛ nyɛ he maa hiɛ babauu pe nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ po.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina tsui kpakpa nɛ buɔ tue, konɛ nyɛɛ suɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, nɛ nyɛɛ hi jamɛ a zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ he nyɛli nɛ sume nyɛ, nɛ a waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa ye manye ngɛ nyɛ nine nya ní tsumihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ mi. Nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi maa hiɛ babauu, nɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ maa ba ní saminya. Yawɛ bua maa jɔ nyɛ he, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ ma plɔke kaa bɔ nɛ e pee nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ hia ji kaa nyɛ maa bu e gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ maa ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ mlaa womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a nɔ. E hia kaa nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: “Mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, a he wɛ tsɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e be tsitsaa he ko hulɔ.

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: E be hiɔwe, nɛ́ nyɛ ma bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ maa kuɔ kɛ ya nɛ e ya ngɔ kɛ ba ha wɔ, konɛ waa nu nɛ waa ye nɔ?’

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: E be wo se hulɔ nɛ nyɛ ma bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ maa po wo, nɛ e ya ngɔ kɛ ba, konɛ waa nu, nɛ waa ye nɔ?’

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Dɛbi, e ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ le, nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ ma de, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ, ye nɔ.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i ngɔ kpakpa kɛ yayami ngɔ fɔ nyɛ hɛ mi; nyɛɛ ngɔ wami, aloo gbenɔ.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ wami kɛ gbenɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe; i ngɔ Mawu gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi hu kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe; nɛ i ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba odase tsɛe ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa hla a he. Nyɛɛ ngɔ wami.

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ pee e suɔmi nya ní pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, zugba a nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke e kɛ ma ha mɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina maa hi nɔ.”

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Mose tsa e munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ e de Israel ma a ke,

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ he nɛ wa nɛ nyɛɛ pee kã. Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si. E be nyɛ sie, nɛ e be nyɛ kuae hulɔ.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Mose tsɛ Yoshua nɛ e de lɛ ngɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi ke, “O he nɛ wa, nɛ o pee kã; mo ji nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo a nɛmɛ si ke e kɛ ma ha mɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Yawɛ nitsɛ ma kpaka mo, nɛ e kɛ mo maa hi si. E be mo sie, nɛ e be mo kuae hulɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo nu sawale; nɛ koo ye gbeye.” A kane mlaa a daa jeha kpaago

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose ngma Mawu mlaa a ngɔ wo womi mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ hyɛɛ somi daka a nɔ ɔ, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Moses told these priests and leaders: Each year the Israelites must come together to celebrate the Festival of Shelters at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. You must read these laws and teachings to the people at the festival every seventh year, the year when loans do not need to be repaid.
translation_verse: Ke Israel ma a tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ he nɛ a to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kane mlaa nɛ ɔ nɛ a nu.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Ke e pee ja a, nyɛ bimɛ nɛ nui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa a hyɛ ɔ maa nu, nɛ a maa bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; nɛ a maa ye lɛ gbeye a wami ligbi tsuo nɛ́ a maa hi zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ nɔ.” Nyagbe munyu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, “O gbenɔ be su ta. Mo tsɛ Yoshua nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba bo tsu ɔ mi, konɛ ma tsɔɔ lɛ bɔ nɛ e pee.” Mose kɛ Yoshua ya bo tsu ɔ mi.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ bɔku titima nɛ ba da bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a mi.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Mose ke, “E be kɛe nɛ o ma gbo; nɛ o gbenɔ se ɔ, Israel ma a be mi anɔkuale yee hu; a be somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ nɔ yee. A maa je ye se ya ja ma se mawuhi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ he nɛ a yaa a.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi ja a, ye mi mi ma fu. I ma kua mɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata. Haomihi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye maa ba a nɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ loko a ma kpa si kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a nɔ bae, ejakaa imi a Mawu ɔ, i kua mɛ.

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, i be a he piɛe hu; ejakaa a pee yayami kaa a ya ja mawu kpahi.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: I ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ya zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ. A ma na niye ní bɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A maa ye ní nɛ a maa tɔ, nɛ a ma na bua jɔmi. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a maa je ye se kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi. A ma kua mi, nɛ a be somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ nɔ yee,

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: nɛ haomi gbeyegbeye babauu maa ba a nɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a maa hi la nɛ ɔ lae, nɛ e maa pee odase kɛ si mɛ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po nɛ i kɛ mɛ sui zugba nɛ i wo si ke ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ lolo ɔ, i le a yi mi.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Mose ngma la a, nɛ e tsɔɔ Israel ma a jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ to Nun bi Yoshua si, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Pee kã, nɛ o he nɛ wa. Mo nɛ o ma kpaka Israel ma a kɛ ya zugba a nɛ i wo mɛ e he si ɔ nɔ. I kɛ mo maa hi si.”

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Mose ngma Mawu mlaa a fitsofitso kɛ wo womi ko mi; e si we nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Benɛ e gbe nya a, e de Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ hyɛɛ Yawɛ somi daka a nɔ ke,

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ngɔ Mawu mlaa womi nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ to Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ somi daka a kasa nya, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ye odase kɛ si ma a.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: I le kaa a kuɛ wa, nɛ a tsɔɔ atuã. Be mi nɛ i ngɛ je mi ɔ, a tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã, nɛ ke i gbo lɛɛ kɛ e ma ba hi kɛɛ?

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kpee nyɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kɛ ba, konɛ ma de mɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ. I ma tsɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba nɛ a ye odase kɛ si mɛ.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: I le paa kaa ye gbenɔ se ɔ, nyɛ ma puɛ nyɛ he kulaa, nɛ nyɛ maa je blɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ nyɛ maa na amanehlu; ejakaa nyɛ maa pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. Nyɛ ní peepee maa wo e mi mi la.” Mose la a

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kane la a mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a, nɛ mɛ tsuo a bu tue kɛ ya si nyagbe:

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ma wo Yawɛ biɛ ta kɛ je e yi, nɛ e ma a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ yi nyɛ siwo nɔ, nɛ nyɛ sɛ kulaa kaa nyɛ peeɔ e ma. Ma nɛ peeɔ yayami, nɛ sisiɔ nɔ ji nyɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛ peeɔ Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ lo, ma kuasia nɛ be juɛmi? Lɛ ji nyɛ tsɛ kɛ nyɛ bɔlɔ; lɛ nɛ e ha nyɛ pee e ma.

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: “Nyɛ susu blema lokoo ɔ he; nyɛ bi nyɛ nɛmɛ, kɛ nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a gba nyɛ blema sane.

english_verse: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them,
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ, nɔ nɛ dla zugba a ha je ma amɛ, nɛ e to ma tsuaa ma hi he ɔ, lɛ nɛ e ha je ma tsuaa je ma e mawu.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: Se Yakob nina lɛɛ, Yawɛ hla lɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: “E na lɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ, he nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be. E bu e he, nɛ e hyɛ e nɔ saminya kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ hyɛɛ e bi kpakpa nɛ e suɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ kɔle buu e tsu he, nɛ e tee kɛ bɔleɔ e bimɛ, nɛ e bliɔ e pɛli mi, nɛ e ngɔɔ e bimɛ ngɔ fɔɔ nɔ kɛ tee kɛ yaa hiɔwe ɔ, ja Yawɛ hɛɛ Israel.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: Yawɛ, lɛ nɔ kake lɛ e kpaka e ma a; ma se mawu ko piɛ we e he.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: “E ha e ma a ye yo nɔ zugba amɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ye ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi niba ní. E ma a ná hwo kɛ je tɛ sa mi; nɛ oliv tso ɔmɛ hu plɔke ngɛ zugba nɛ tɛ ngɛ mi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: Na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ ha nyɔ nyu babauu; e ha ma a jijɔ, apletsi, kɛ na kpakpahi; a ye ní kpakpa, nɛ a nu dã kpakpa.

english_verse: Israel, you grew fat and rebelled against God, your Creator you rejected the Mighty Rock, your only place of safety.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ ma a na ní kpɔtɔɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɔ atuã; a ye ní kpakpa nɛ a tɔ saminya. Se a je Mawu nɛ ji a bɔlɔ ɔ he, nɛ a kua a yi wami helɔ nɛ se be ɔ.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: A kɛ mawuhi nɛ a li ye e tsui, nɛ a ngɔ ní hiemi nihi kɛ wo e mi mi la.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Ma a sã bɔ kɛ ha mumi yayamihi, kɛ mawuhi nɛ a he be se nami, mawuhi nɛ a nɛmɛ po li, mawuhi nɛ Israel sɔmɔ we hyɛ.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: A Mawu ɔ nɛ baa a yi, nɛ́ he a yi wami ɔ, a hɛ je a nɔ.

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: E de ke, ‘Jehanɛ, i be a he piɛe hu; ma hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ; nihi nɛ a tue mi ti, nɛ a yi a siwo nɔ.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: A kɛ a we amagahi wo ye mi mi la. A kɛ a yaka mawu ɔmɛ ye ye tsui. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ ma gu ko kɛ wo a mi mi la; ma ngɔ ma kɛ e mi kuasiahi sɔuu kɛ ye a tsui.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Ye mi mi fumi nya maa wa wawɛɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe; e maa sã nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je ɔ mi kɛ ya su gbeje tɔɔ; e maa sã yo ɔmɛ a sisi tomi ɔmɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ma ha haomihi maa ba a nɔ nɔtonɔto; ma tsɛ̃ mɛ ye kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Hwɔ kɛ aslã maa gbe mɛ, nɛ hiɔhi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye ma kpata a hɛ mi. Ma ha nga mi lohwe awi yeli ma ba tua mɛ, nɛ sinɔ duɔtsɛmɛ maa kɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: Jinɛ i ko kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mɛ kaie hu.

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: Se i be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a fĩa ke mɛ lɛ a ye ye ma a nɔ, be mi nɛ imi, Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ i kpata a hɛ mi.’

english_verse: People of Israel, that's what the Lord has said to you. But you don't have good sense, and you never listen to advice.
translation_verse: “Ma ko nɛ be juɛmi ji Israel; a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nɔ kake maa fie nihi akpe? Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nihi enyɔ pɛ maa wo nihi akpe nyɔngma fo? Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ kua mɛ; a Mawu ngua a ngmɛɛ a he.

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: He nyɛli ɔmɛ le kaa a mawu ɔmɛ be he wami ko kaa Israel Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: He nyɛli ɔmɛ puɛ kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora; a ngɛ kaa wai tso nɛ woɔ yiblii doodooe nɛ gbee nɔ,

english_verse: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.
translation_verse: aloo wai nɛ a wo mi sinɔ duɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: “Ke he nyɛli ɔmɛ pee Israel nɔ́ ko ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ ji nɔ; e mlɛɛ blɛuu kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ sa loko e gblaa a tue.

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa ye lue kokooko. E maa gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue. A maa sane nɔ si amlɔ nɔuu. E be kɛe kulaa nɛ e ma kpata a hɛ mi. A nyagbe ma tlukaa.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma kpɔ e ma a kɛ je he nyɛli a dɛ mi be mi nɛ e na kaa a he wami tsuo ta. Nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ lɛɛ ke e na bɔ nɛ peepee ta a he ha a, e maa na mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ma bi e ma a ke, ‘Mawu ngua amɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ, jije a ngɛ?

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: “Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa, ‘Imi nɔ kake too ji Mawu; ye se ɔ, mawu ko mawu ko be! Imi nɛ i gbee nɔ, imi kɛ̃ nɛ i haa nɔ wami; imi nɛ i plaa nɔ, nɛ imi nɛ i tsaa nɔ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa tsi ye nya.

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: ma duɔ ye klaate nɛ kpɛɔ nylamnylam ɔ nya, nɛ ma hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane. Ma ye lue ngɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ; nihi nɛ sume mi ɔ, ma gbla a tue.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: Muɔ ma tsle ngɛ ye kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ pue si; nɛ ye klaate ɔ maa gbe nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ mi ɔ. Nihi nɛ kɛ mi na ta a, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be e he yee; nihi nɛ plaa, kɛ nihi nɛ a nuu ngɛ ta mi po, ma gbe mɛ!’

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: “Je mahi lee, nyɛ je Yawɛ ma a yi; nihi tsuo nɛ gbee e ma a, Yawɛ gblaa a tue. E yeɔ lue ngɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e ma a he yayami paa mɛ.”

english_verse: Moses spoke the words of the song so that all the Israelites could hear, and Joshua helped him. When Moses had finished,
translation_verse: Benɛ Mose kane Mawu mlaa amɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a gbe nya a,

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: e slɔ mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ. Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ a ye Mawu mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ pi munyu guhi; nyɛ wami daa si ngɛ a nɔ. Nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yordan se nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ̃, nɛ e de lɛ ke,

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: “Yaa Abarim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Moab zugba a mi, ngɛ Yeriko ma a hanɔ; kuɔɔ Nebo yo ɔ, nɛ o hyɛ Kanaan zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ Israel ma a hae ɔ.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: O ma gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o nyɛminyumu Aaron hu gbo ngɛ Hor yo ɔ nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: ejakaa nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ bui mi tue; nyɛ pue ye hɛ mi si ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Nyɛ pue ye hɛ mi si ngɛ Meriba pa a nya, ngɛ Kadesh ma a kasa nya, ngɛ Zin nga kplanaa a nɔ. Nyɛ bui mi kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ngɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: O maa na zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ Israel ma a hae ɔ ngɛ se lokoo; se zugba a nitsɛ lɛɛ o be nɔ yae.”

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Gbaami munyuhi nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ, Mose kɛ gbaa Israel bi ɔmɛ loko e gbo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kple si kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ kaa pu nɛ gba ngɛ Edom yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tso ha e ma a kɛ je Paran yo ɔ he. Mawu bɔfohi akpe nyɔngma piɛ e he; a ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Yawɛ suɔ e ma a; nihi nɛ ji e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ, e baa a yi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kplaa si ngɛ e nane nya; wa jaa lɛ, nɛ wa yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: Wa yeɔ mlaa nɛ Mose wo wɔ ɔ nɔ; ejakaa wa ma a weto ní nitsɛnitsɛ ji Mawu mlaa a nɛ.

english_verse: Then you and your leaders made the Lord your king.
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo ba bua a he nya a, Yawɛ ba pee a matsɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ e gbaa Yuda wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yawɛ, moo bu Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kue fami tue. Mo bua a kɛ wɛtso kpa amɛ a nya, nɛ o pee mɛ kake. Yawɛ, moo hwu a ta a ha mɛ, nɛ a ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.”

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: A ngmɛɛ we o he, se mohu a kua a fɔli, kɛ a nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ. A bu o gbi tue, nɛ a ye o somi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: A maa tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ o mlaa a, konɛ a ye nɔ. A maa sã bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Benyamin wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yawɛ suɔ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a sane, nɛ e baa a yi. E buu a he daa ligbi, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ.”

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ e gbaa Yosef wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Mawu nɛ gbaa a zugba a; hiɔmi nɛ nɛ kɛ pue nɔ, nɛ a ná nyu kɛ je zugba a mi hulɔ.

english_verse: Month by month, your fruit will ripen in the sunshine.
translation_verse: A gbaa zugba a; tso yiblii nɛ fu ngɛ nɔ; tso yiblii kpakpahi babauu nɛ ba ngɛ a be mi.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: Tso yiblii ngɔngɔɛhi nɛ ha blema yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: A na ní kpakpahi ngɛ a zugba a nɔ. Yawɛ nɛ gbaa ní ɔmɛ a nɔ. Lɛ nɔ nɛ e tu munyu kɛ je mio tso nɛ ngɛ tsoe mi ɔ, é gbaa Yosef wɛtso ɔ kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Ejakaa lɛ ji e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛngmɛ.

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: A maa kpee nibwɔhi kɛ ba a yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a maa sã bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A ma na ní kɛ je wo mi, nɛ a ma na ní kɛ je wo nya zia hu mi.”

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Gad wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Á je Mawu yi; lɛ nɛ bli Gad zugba a huzu mi. Gad woɔ ká kaa jata nɛ kplɔ lohwe ko kɔni, loo e tsɔ e yi ngɛ nya.

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Dan wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Dan ngɛ kaa jata bi; e hii tuue ngɛ Bashan yo ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Naftali wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yawɛ mi mi jɔ ha Naftali bi ɔmɛ; e ha mɛ ní kpakpahi; e ha mɛ zugba kɛ je wo ɔ nya kɛ ya su leneyi je.”

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Asher wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Asher ji wɛtso nɛ a gbaa pe kulaa ngɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Asher nɛ ba pee kaa bi nɛ a suɔ lɛ pe bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ́ oliv tso babauu nɛ ba a zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Á ma a ma amɛ a nya dade agbohi, konɛ a na he wami daa.”

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Israel ma a tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Israel ma, mawu ko mawu ko be kaa nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ agboje kɛ jee hiɔwe kɛ ba jee ngmlaa ha nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ ji nyɛ wesa he. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ baa nyɛ yi daa. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e de nyɛ ke nyɛ kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yakob nina maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi; a nine maa su zugba kpakpa nɔ, he nɛ bɔ́ nɛɔ ngɛ, nɛ́ blɛfo kɛ wai baa saminya ngɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: A gbaa nyɛ, Israel ma. Ma ko ma ko be kaa nyɛ ma nɛ Yawɛ he nyɛ yi wami. Yawɛ ji nyɛ tsɛ̃i kɛ klaate. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ faa nyɛ he. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa nyɛ yeɔ kunimi. Nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba kpa nyɛ pɛɛ ke nyɛɛ na mɛ mɔbɔ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa naa a nɔ.”

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose je Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, nɛ e ya kuɔ Nebo yo ɔ kɛ ho Pisga yo ɔ yi mi ya, ngɛ Yordan beleku je. Yawɛ kɛ zugba a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ: Gilead zugba muza a tsuo, kɛ ya muɔ Dan ma a ngɛ omleyi je,

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Naftali zugba muza a tsuo, Efraim kɛ Manase zugba amɛ, Yuda zugba a tsuo, kɛ ya su bonyoku je ngɛ Mediterenia wo nya tɔɔ,

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: Yuda zugba a leneyi je, kɛ nga kplanaa a nɛ ngɛ kɛ je Zoar kɛ ya su ma ngua a nɛ tã ngɛ mi, nɛ e biɛ ji Yeriko ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Zugba a nɛ i wo Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke ma ngɔ ha a nina a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. I ha nɛ o na zugba a kɛ o hɛngmɛ lɛɛ, se be o lejɛ ɔ yae.”

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: Yawɛ pu lɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ko mi, ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Betpeor ma a hanɔ; se nɔ ko nɔ ko li he tutuutu nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Israel ma a nyɛ ya ha lɛ ligbi nyingmi etɛ ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo nyɛe o wami be ɔ tsuo. Bɔ nɛ i kɛ Mose hi si ɔ, jã kɛ̃ i kɛ mo, Yoshua hu maa hi si. I be mo sie, nɛ i be mo kuae hulɔ.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. translation_verse: Moo kane mlaa womi nɛ ɔ daa. Mo susu he nyɔ kɛ pia; nɛ o ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi ɔ nɔ; ja jã loko níhi a mi maa hi ha mo, nɛ o maa ye manye.

translation_verse: Ná nɛ o le kaa imi nitsɛ nɛ i ngɛ mo fae ke o he nɛ wa, nɛ o pee kã a nɛ. Koo nu sawale, nɛ o nine mi ko je wu. He tsuaa he nɛ o maa ya a, imi, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, ma piɛ o he kɛ ya.” Yoshua fa ma a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ

translation_verse: Nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, nyɛ bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ we mi lohwe ɔmɛ maa hi hiɛ ɔ, se nyɛ kpɛti nyumuhi nɛ su ta yami nya a tsuo maa mia kɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a maa piɛ a he

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Nun bi Yoshua tsɔ slaali enyɔ kɛ je Shitim nigii; nɛ e fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ya slaa Kanaan zugba a saminya, titli ɔ Yeriko.” Benɛ slaali ɔmɛ ya su ma a mi ɔ, a ya to yo ajuama ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Rahab ɔ we mi.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Wa nu bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ha Wo Tsu ɔ mii ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi be nɛ nyɛ je Egipt ɔ. Jehanɛ hu wa nu nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ pee Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yordan ɔ se ɔ. Wa nu bɔ nɛ nyɛ kpata Sihon kɛ Og a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ha.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Benɛ wa nu sane nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, wa tsui po, nɛ nyumu ɔmɛ a kã nya ta; ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pɛ ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ka mi kita ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ i pee nyɛ kpakpa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ maa pee ye weku li kpakpa ja nɔuu, nɛ nyɛ maa to mi okadi ko.
