translation_verse: Nyɛɛ wo mi si kaa nyɛ ma he ye tsɛ kɛ ye nyɛ, ye nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ, ye nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ, kɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a weku kɛ nina a yi wami, nɛ nyɛ be hae nɛ a gbe wɔ!”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Slaali ɔmɛ de yo ɔ ke, “Wa ngɛ mo kita kae kaa ke o ya tsɔɔ we wa se blɔ, nɛ Yawɛ ha wa nine su zugba a nɔ ɔ, wa maa na mo mɔbɔ, nɛ wa maa ye wa si womi ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Gbogbo nɛ bɔle ma a, e mi nɛ Rahab we ɔ ngɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ kpa ko kple slaali ɔmɛ si kɛ gu saflɛ mi.

translation_verse: E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kó na nyɛ. Nyɛ ya laa nyɛ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ kɛ yaa si be nɛ a maa kpale a se kɛ ba, loko nyɛ pue blɔ.”

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”

translation_verse: Ligbi etɛ se ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya kpa ma a sito he ɔ,

translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, blɔ maa pee gugue lafa enuɔ loo nɔ nɛ hi nyɛɛ kɛ daka a nyɛ kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ na he nɛ nyɛ maa gu; ejakaa nyɛ gui hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛ.”

english_verse: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, “Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.”
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Ngɔɔ tɛ nɛ o kɛ pee ha, nɛ o po Israel bi ɔmɛ si enyɔne.”

english_verse: Joshua made the knives, then circumcised those men and boys at Haaraloth Hill.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua pee tɛ hahi, nɛ e kɛ po Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Gibeat Haaralot nɛ sisi ji “Nɔ Pomi Yoku ɔ”.

english_verse: This had to be done, because none of Israel's baby boys had been circumcised during the
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a pui mɛ, nɛ mɛ ji yi nɔ he nɛ Yoshua po mɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who had been circumcised needed time to heal, and they stayed in camp.
translation_verse: Benɛ a po ni ɔmɛ tsuo ta a, ma a tsuo hi a sito he ɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ pa amɛ gbo ta.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace.” So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i jé Egipt nyɔguɛ peemi zo ɔ kɛ je nyɛ nɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Gilgal, nɛ jã nɛ a tsɛɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel ma a pueɔ si ngɛ Gilgal ngɛ Yeriko nga a nɔ ɔ, a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields. Israel Captures Jericho
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, niye ní nɛ nɛɛ kɛ jee hiɔwe ɔ se po, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ́ eko hu. Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, zugba a nɔ niba ní ji nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ. Yoshua kɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ hɛɛ klaate ɔ

english_verse: One day, Joshua was near Jericho when he saw a man standing some distance in front of him. The man was holding a sword, so Joshua walked up to him and asked, “Are you on our side or on our enemies' side?”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yoshua su Yeriko haa nɛ e wo e yi nɔ ɔ, e na nyumu ko nɛ hɛɛ klaate kɛ daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi. Yoshua ya e ngɔ nɛ e ya bi lɛ ke, “Wa nɔ ji mo, loo wa he nyɛlɔ ji mo?”

english_verse: “Neither,” he answered. “I am here because I am the commander of the Lord's army.” Joshua fell to his knees and bowed down to the ground. “I am your servant,” he said. “Tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, mohu ɔ, i ba kaa Yawɛ tabo ɔ nyatsɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua ngɔ e hɛ mi ngɔ bu zugba nɛ e ja lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, o tsɔlɔ ji mi. Mɛni o ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha mo?”

english_verse: “Take off your sandals,” the commander answered. “This is a holy place.” So Joshua took off his sandals.
translation_verse: Yawɛ tabo ɔ nyatsɛ ɔ de Yoshua ke, “Je o tokota a; zugba klɔuklɔu nɔ o daa si ngɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ Yoshua pee ja.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Jericho had been locking the gates in their town wall because they were afraid of the Israelites. No one could go out or come in.
translation_verse: A ngmɛ Yeriko agbo ɔmɛ a mi kpɛii, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ko na blɔ kɛ sɛ ma a mi. Nɔ ko nɔ ko ji kpo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ mi.

english_verse: Take along the sacred chest and tell seven priests to walk in front of it, carrying trumpets. But on the seventh day, march slowly around the town seven times while the priests blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Osɔfohi kpaago nɛ a hɛɛ titimati kpaago nɛ a kɛ agbosu koli pee kɛ nyɛɛ somi daka a hɛ mi. Ligbi kpaagone ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔle ma a si kpaago, nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a hi titimati ɔmɛ kpae.

english_verse: Then the priests will blast on their trumpets, and everyone else will shout. The wall will fall down, and your soldiers can go straight in from every side.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ nu nɛ a kpa bɛ ɔ nɛ e se kɛ ɔ, Israel ma a tsuo nɛ he ose wawɛɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, Yeriko gbogbo ɔmɛ maa hule pue si tɛtlɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma bu kɛ sɛ ma a mi.”

english_verse: Joshua called the priests together and said, “Take the chest and tell seven priests to carry trumpets and march ahead of it.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Nun bi Yoshua tsɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ wo somi daka a, nɛ nyɛ ti nihi kpaago nɛ a hɛɛ titimati kɛ nyɛɛ daka a hɛ mi.”

english_verse: They obeyed Joshua's orders and carried the chest once around the town before returning to camp for the night.
translation_verse: E ha a kɛ Yawɛ daka a ya bɔle ma a si kake pɛ nɛ a kpale kɛ ba ma sito he ɔ ekohu nɛ a ba hwɔ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.
translation_verse: Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, a te si makɛ mla, nɛ a bɔle ma a jã kɛ̃ si kpaago sɔuu. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ pɛ nɛ a bɔle ma a si kpaago.

english_verse: Then the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua yelled: Get ready to shout! The Lord will let you capture this town.
translation_verse: Si kpaagone ɔ, benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ma bɔni titimati ɔmɛ kpami pɛ nɛ Yoshua fa ma a ke, “Nyɛ he ose, ejakaa Yawɛ ngɔ ma a ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ!

english_verse: But you must destroy it and everything in it, to show that it now belongs to the Lord. The woman Rahab helped the spies we sent, so protect her and the others who are inside her house. But kill everyone else in the town.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpata ma a kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ha Yawɛ; Rahab, yo ajuama a, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ, mɛ pɛ a yi nɛ na wami; ejakaa e ngɔ slaali ɔmɛ nɛ wa tsɔ ɔ kɛ laa.

english_verse: The silver and gold and everything made of bronze and iron belong to the Lord and must be put in his treasury. Be careful to follow these instructions, because if you see something you want and take it, the Lord will destroy Israel. And it will be all your fault.
translation_verse: Sika hiɔ, sika tsu, akɔblee, kɛ dade níhi tsuo lɛɛ a hla kɛ to ha Yawɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ nito he ɔ.”

english_verse: The priests blew their trumpets again, and the soldiers shouted as loud as they could. The walls of Jericho fell flat. Then the soldiers rushed up the hill, went straight into the town, and captured it.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ bɔni titimati ɔmɛ kpami. Benɛ ma a nu titimati pɛmi ɔ, a he ose wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yeriko gbogbo ɔ hule pue si. Tabo ɔ tsuo bu kɛ sɛ ma a mi; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nyɛɛ kɛ ya e hɛ mi tɛɛ; nɛ a ya ngɔ ma a.

english_verse: After Jericho was destroyed, Joshua warned the people, “Someday a man will rebuild Jericho, but the Lord will put a curse on him, and the man's oldest son will die when he starts to build the town wall. And by the time he finishes the wall and puts gates in it, all his children will be dead.”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yoshua ka kita ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ka kaa e maa ma Yeriko ekohu ɔ, Yawɛ nɛ gbiɛ lɛ. Nɔ nɛ maa to sisi ɔ, e bitɛte nɛ gbo, nɔ nɛ maa gbe nya nɛ a maa ma nya agbo ɔ, e binakutso nɛ gbo.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Joshua in everything he did, and Joshua was famous everywhere in Canaan.
translation_verse: Yawɛ piɛ Yoshua he, nɛ e he biɛ kpakpa ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Joshua and the leaders of Israel tore their clothes and put dirt on their heads to show their sorrow. They lay facedown on the ground in front of the sacred chest until sunset.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ aywilɛho hía a tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ a ya bu si ngɛ Yawɛ somi daka a hɛ mi kɛ a yi mi zu kɛ ye kɔmɔ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ.

english_verse: Then Joshua said: Our Lord, did you bring us across the Jordan River just so the Amorites could destroy us? This wouldn't have happened if we had agreed to stay on the other side of the Jordan.
translation_verse: Yoshua de ke, “Aa, Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, mɛni he je o kɛ ma a po Yordan pa a kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ kulaa lɛɛ? O kɛ wɔ ba ha Amor bi ɔmɛ nɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi lo? Mɛni he je wa hí Yordan pa a se kɛkɛ?

english_verse: I don't even know what to say to you, since Israel's army has turned and run from the enemy.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ Israel ngɛ fo tue ngɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ ɔ, kɛ ma de kɛɛ?

english_verse: Everyone will think you weren't strong enough to protect your people. Now the Canaanites and everyone else who lives in the land will surround us and wipe us out.
translation_verse: Kanaan bi ɔmɛ, kɛ zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa nu he. A ma ba sa wa yi, nɛ a ma kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. O biɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, o maa hi hyɛe nɛ e puɛ lo?”

english_verse: The Lord answered: Stop lying there on the ground! Get up!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Tee si koo! Mɛni he je o kɛ o hɛ mi bu zugba kikɛ nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: I said everything in Jericho belonged to me and had to be destroyed. But the Israelites have kept some of the things for themselves. They stole from me and hid what they took. Then they lied about it.
translation_verse: Israel pee yayami! A yi somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ nɔ; a ngɔ ní ɔmɛ nɛ i ke a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ ekomɛ kɛ piɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a níhi a he; a ju, nɛ a to lakpa.

english_verse: What they stole was supposed to be destroyed, and now Israel itself must be destroyed. I cannot help you anymore until you do exactly what I have said. That's why Israel turns and runs from its enemies instead of standing up to them.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛ we a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ; a ngɛ fo tue ngɛ a nya, ejakaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu a plɛ pee níhi nɛ sa nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi! I kɛ nyɛ be si hie hu; ja nyɛ kpata níhi nɛ i wo nyɛ mlaa ke nyɛ ko ta he ɔ a hɛ mi!

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel, “Tomorrow you will meet with the Lord your God, so make yourselves acceptable to worship him. The Lord says that you have taken things that should have been destroyed. You won't be able to stand up to your enemies until you get rid of those things.
translation_verse: Tee si, nɛ o tsukɔ ma a he, nɛ o ha a pee a he klɔuklɔu ngɛ ye hɛ mi. De mɛ ke hwɔɔ je nɛ maa na a, a dla a he; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Níhi nɛ i wo nyɛ mlaa ke nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi ɔ ekomɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ! Nyɛ be he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nya nyɛe maa da, ja nyɛ je musu ní ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti!’

english_verse: “Tomorrow morning everyone must gather near the place of worship. You will come forward tribe by tribe, and the Lord will show which tribe is guilty. Next, the clans in that tribe must come forward, and the Lord will show which clan is guilty. The families in that clan must come, and the Lord will point out the guilty family. Finally, the men in that family must come,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de ma a ke hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, a kɛ mɛ maa ba hiɛ ɔ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya. Wɛtso nɛ imi Yawɛ, ma tsɔɔ ɔ, a maa ba we puɔ nya we puɔ nya. We puɔ nya nɛ ma tsɔɔ ɔ, a maa ba weku nya weku nya. Weku nɛ ma tsɔɔ ɔ mi nyumu ɔmɛ maa ba kakaaka.

english_verse: and the Lord will show who stole what should have been destroyed. That man must be put to death, his body burned, and his possessions thrown into the fire. He has done a terrible thing by breaking the sacred agreement that the Lord made with Israel.”
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ a maa na musu ní ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, a kɛ la maa sã lɛ, kɛ e weku li, kɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́. Ejakaa e tsu zo ní ngɛ Israel, nɛ imi Yawɛ, ye somi ɔ hu e yi nɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua got up early the next morning and brought each tribe to the place of worship, where the Lord showed that the Judah tribe was guilty.
translation_verse: Yoshua te si makɛ mla, nɛ e ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ba wɛtso nya wɛtso nya, nɛ a nu Yuda wɛtso ɔ.

english_verse: Then Joshua brought the clans of Judah to the Lord, and the Lord showed that the Zerah clan was guilty. One by one he brought the leader of each family in the Zerah clan to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Zabdi's family was guilty.
translation_verse: E ha Yuda wɛtso ɔ ba we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ a nu Zera we puɔ nya. Jehanɛ, e ha Zera we puɔ nya a ba weku nya weku nya, nɛ a nu Zabdi weku ɔ.

english_verse: Finally, Joshua brought each man in Zabdi's family to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Achan was the guilty one.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ha Zabdi we ɔ mi nyumu ɔmɛ ba kakaaka, nɛ a nu Karmi bi Akan, Zabdi bibi ɔ.

english_verse: “Achan,” Joshua said, “the Lord God of Israel has decided that you are guilty. So tell me what you did, and don't try to hide anything.”
translation_verse: Yoshua de Akan ke, “Ye bi, tu mi anɔkuale, nɛ o de mi nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi. Mo de mi koo; mɛni o pee? Koo laa mi ba.”

english_verse: “It's true,” Achan answered. “I sinned and disobeyed the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Akan he nɔ nɛ e de Yoshua ke, “Niinɛ, i pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ; nɔ́ nɛ i pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: They brought them back and put them in front of the sacred chest, so Joshua and the rest of the Israelites could see them.
translation_verse: A muɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ je bo tsu ɔ mi kɛ ba Yoshua kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo a ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ ba pue si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Joshua said, “Achan, you caused us a lot of trouble. Now the Lord is paying you back with the same kind of trouble.” The people of Israel then stoned to death Achan and his family. They made a fire and burned the bodies, together with what Achan had stolen, and all his possessions.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yoshua bi Akan ke, “Mɛni he je o hao wɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hu maa hao mo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsuo fia Akan tɛ nɛ e gbo; a fia e weku li ɔmɛ hu tɛ, nɛ a kɛ la sã lɛ, kɛ e weku li, kɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.

english_verse: They covered the remains with a big pile of rocks, which is still there. Then the Lord stopped being angry with Israel. That's how the place came to be called Trouble Valley.
translation_verse: A bua tɛ ɔmɛ a nya glekuu ngɔ pue e nɔ, nɛ tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Haomi Kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se po.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua: Don't be afraid, and don't be discouraged by what happened at the town of Ai. Take the army and attack again. But first, order part of the army to set up an ambush on the other side of the town. I will help you defeat the king of Ai and his army, and you will capture the town and the land around it. Destroy Ai and kill its king as you did at Jericho. But you may keep the livestock and everything else you want.
translation_verse: Ó pee Ai kɛ e matsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Yeriko kɛ e matsɛ ɔ; se ta yibu ní ɔmɛ, kɛ we mi lohwe ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ha ha nyɛ he. Nyɛ ya wo ma a he ka, nɛ nyɛ tua lɛ kɛ je e se je.”

english_verse: you come out of hiding. The Lord our God will help you capture the town.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ka woli ɔmɛ nyɛ maa je se je ɔ kɛ ba tua ma a; ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa ngɔ ma a ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ.

english_verse: Then set it on fire, as the Lord has told us to do. Those are your orders,
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ngɔ ma a, nyɛɛ mɛ he la kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa nyɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pee ja pɛpɛɛpɛ.”

english_verse: Early the next morning he got his troops ready to move out, and he and the other leaders of Israel led them to Ai.
translation_verse: Makɛ mla a, Yoshua te si nɛ e bua ma a nya. E kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ ho Ai ya.

english_verse: Now all his troops were in place. Part of the army was in the camp to the north of Ai, and the others were hiding to the west, ready to make a surprise attack. That night, Joshua went into the valley.
translation_verse: A gba ta a: ta ngua a ya je Ai omleyi je, nɛ se ta a ya je bonyoku je. Yoshua hwɔ kɔ̃ ɔ mi jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord told Joshua, “Point your sword at the town of Ai, because now I am going to help you defeat it!” As soon as Joshua pointed his sword at the town,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Wo akplɔ nɛ o hɛɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ Ai; ejakaa ma ngɔ ma a ngɔ wo o dɛ.” Yoshua pee kaa bɔ nɛ a de lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: the soldiers who had been hiding jumped up and ran into the town. They captured it and set it on fire.
translation_verse: Benɛ ka woli ɔmɛ na okadi nɛ ɔ, a te si esɔesɔ kɛ je a laami he ɔ, nɛ a kɛ fo sɛ ma a mi. A ngɔ ma a, nɛ a mɛ he la nɔuu.

english_verse: When Joshua and his troops saw smoke rising from the town, they knew that the other part of their army had captured it. So they turned and attacked. The men of Ai looked back and saw smoke rising from their town. But they could not escape, because the soldiers they had been chasing had suddenly turned and started fighting.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yoshua kɛ ma a kulaa na kaa ka woli ɔmɛ a nine su ma a nɔ, nɛ ma a mle kɛ la a, a kpale a se, nɛ a ba gbe Ai bi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the other Israelite soldiers had come from the town and attacked the men of Ai from the rear. The Israelites captured the king of Ai and brought him to Joshua. They also chased the rest of the men of Ai into the desert and killed them. The Israelite army went back to Ai and killed everyone there.
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe Ai bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba Ai ma a mi, nɛ a gbe nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Joshua made sure every building in Ai was burned to the ground. He told his men to kill the king of Ai and hang his body on a tree. Then at sunset he told the Israelites to take down the body, throw it in the gateway of the town, and cover it with a big pile of rocks. translation_verse: Se Ai matsɛ ɔ lɛɛ Yoshua sɛu lɛ ngɛ tso nɔ, nɛ e si e gbogboe ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ nya si. Benɛ pu nɔ si ɔ, Yoshua fa nɛ a ya je gbogboe ɔ kɛ je tso ɔ nɔ. english_verse: So they decided that some of their men should pretend to be messengers to Israel from a faraway country. The men put worn-out bags on their donkeys and found some old wineskins that had cracked and had been sewn back together.
translation_verse: a to ga kaa a maa sisi Yoshua. A ya hla niye ní, nɛ a muɔ kotoku momohi, kɛ lohwe he womi tɔ momohi nɛ gba nɛ a kpɛ, nɛ a to ngɔ pue a teji ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Their sandals were old and patched, and their clothes were worn out. They even took along some dry and crumbly bread.
translation_verse: A wo tade gbagbɛhi, kɛ tokota momohi nɛ́ a tsla; abolo nɛ a hɛɛ kɛ to a dɛ ɔ gbli nɛ e fu ja.

english_verse: Then they went to the Israelite camp at Gilgal, where they said to Joshua and the men of Israel, “We have come from a country that is far from here. Please make a peace treaty with us.”
translation_verse: A ba na Yoshua kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Gilgal, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Wa je he kɛ. Wa suɔ nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ nɛ so.”

english_verse: We are your servants, and we live far from here. We came because the Lord your God is so famous. We heard what the Lord did in Egypt
translation_verse: A de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, wa je ma se tsitsaa he ko; nɛ wa nu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ he. Níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ngɛ Egipt ɔ, wa nu he,

english_verse: and what he did to those two Amorite kings on the other side of the Jordan: King Og of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth, and King Sihon of Heshbon.
translation_verse: kɛ bɔ nɛ e pee Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ Yordan beleku je ɔ: Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon, kɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og nɛ hi Ashtarot ɔ.

english_verse: Our leaders and everyone who lives in our country told us to meet with you and tell you that all of us are your servants. They said to ask you to make a peace treaty with our people. They told us to be sure and take along enough food for our journey.
translation_verse: Wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ wa zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo de wɔ ke wa hla niye ní kɛ to wa dɛ, nɛ waa hia blɔ kɛ ba nɛ wa ba na nyɛ. A de wɔ ke, ke wa ba a, wa ba de nyɛ ke wa ma sɔmɔ nyɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, waa kɛ nyɛ maa so.

english_verse: See this dry, crumbly bread of ours? It was hot out of the oven when we packed the food on the day we left our homes.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ wa niye ní ɔ ha! Benɛ waa kɛ maa hia blɔ ɔ, la ngɛ he. Se piɔ lɛɛ, e gbli nɛ e fu ja.

english_verse: These cracked wineskins were new when we filled them, and our clothes and sandals are worn out because we have traveled so far.
translation_verse: Lohwe he womi tɔ ɔmɛ nɛ wa wo a mi dã kɛ hia blɔ ɔ, ní hehi, se piɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ, a gba. Wa tade ɔmɛ, kɛ wa tokota amɛ hu wo momo ngɛ blɔ ɔ kɛmi sɔuu he.”

english_verse: The Israelites tried some of the food, but they did not ask the Lord if he wanted them to make a treaty.
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ bi we Yawɛ ga womi kulaa, kɛkɛ nɛ a he ni ɔmɛ a dɛ mi niye ní ɔ.

english_verse: So Joshua made a peace treaty with the messengers and promised that Israel would not kill their people. Israel's leaders swore that Israel would keep this promise.
translation_verse: Yoshua he Gibeon bi ɔmɛ atuu, nɛ e kɛ mɛ so kaa a be mɛ gbee. Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu ka kita ngɔ fɔ nɔ.

english_verse: A couple of days later, the Israelites found out that these people actually lived in the nearby towns of Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-Jearim. So the Israelites left the place where they had camped and arrived at the four towns two days later.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, nɛ ligbi etɛ se ɔ, a ba su ma amɛ a mi he nɛ ni ɔmɛ je kɛ ba na mɛ ɔ. Ma amɛ ji Gibeon, Kefira, Beerot, kɛ Kiriat Yearim.

english_verse: But they did not attack the towns, because the Israelite leaders had sworn in the name of the Lord that they would let these people live. The Israelites complained about their leaders' decision not to attack,
translation_verse: Se Israel bi ɔmɛ gbi ni ɔmɛ; ejakaa Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ka mɛ kita ngɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi kaa a be mɛ gbee. Enɛ ɔ ha ma kpekpemi ɔ tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si ma nimeli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Joshua told some of his soldiers, “I want to meet with the Gibeonite leaders. Bring them here.” When the Gibeonites came, Joshua said, “You live close to us. Why did you lie by claiming you lived far away?
translation_verse: Yoshua fa nɛ a kɛ Gibeon bi ɔmɛ ba e hɛ mi, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ sisi wɔ ke nyɛ je he kɛ, be mi nɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu nyɛ je ɔ?

english_verse: So now you are under a curse, and from now on your people will have to send workers to cut wood and carry water for the place of worship.”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ pee nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mawu gbiɛ nyɛ. Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina maa pee nyɔguɛhi; nyɛ ma gba lɛ́, nɛ nyɛ maa ya pa kɛ ba ye Mawu ɔ we ɔ.”

english_verse: The Gibeonites answered, “The Lord your God told his servant Moses that you were to kill everyone who lives here and take their land for yourselves. We were afraid you would kill us, and so we tricked you into making a peace treaty. But we agreed to be your servants,
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, wa pee ja niinɛ. Wa na le kaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ fa e tsɔlɔ Mose ke e ngɔ zugba a tsuo ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e kpata ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ blɔ mi. Wa ye gbeye wawɛɛ kaa nyɛ ma ba gbe wɔ; lɔ ɔ he nɛ wa to ga nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: and you are strong enough to do anything to us that you want. We just ask you to do what seems right.”
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ nyɛ dɛ mi. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ sa o hɛ mi kaa o pee wɔ ɔ, moo pee wɔ.”

english_verse: but he did tell the Gibeonites that they would have to be servants of the nation of Israel. They would have to cut firewood and bring it for the priests to use for burning sacrifices on the Lord's altar, wherever the Lord decided the altar would be. The Gibeonites would also have to carry water for the priests. And that is still the work of the Gibeonites.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e pee mɛ nyɔguɛhi, nɛ a lɛɔ lɛ́, nɛ a yaa pa kɛ haa Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ. Kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, mɛ nɛ a tsuɔ ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ngɛ he nɛ Yawɛ hla ke a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: King Adonizedek of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured and destroyed the town of Ai, and then killed its king as he had done at Jericho. He also learned that the Gibeonites had signed a peace treaty with Israel.
translation_verse: Yerusalem matsɛ, Adonizedek nu kaa Yoshua ngɔ Ai ma a, nɛ e kpata ma a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. E nu kaa Yoshua gbe matsɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Yeriko ma a, kɛ matsɛ ɔ. E nu hu kaa Gibeon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba pee huɛmɛ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: This frightened Adonizedek and his people. They knew that Gibeon was a large town, as big as the towns that had kings, and even bigger than the town of Ai had been. And all of the men of Gibeon were warriors.
translation_verse: Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye wawɛɛ, ejakaa ma ngua ji Gibeon. Gibeon ngɛ kaa matsɛ ma; e kle pe Ai, nɛ nyumuhi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, katsɛmɛ sɔuu.

english_verse: So Adonizedek sent messages to the kings of four other towns: King Hoham of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King Debir of Eglon. The messages said,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yerusalem matsɛ, Adonizedek tsɔ kɛ ya de Hebron matsɛ, Hoham; Yarmut matsɛ, Piram, Lakish matsɛ, Yafia; kɛ Eglon matsɛ, Debir ke,

english_verse: “The Gibeonites have signed a peace treaty with Joshua and the Israelites. Come and help me attack Gibeon!”
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba piɛ ye he, konɛ wa ya kpata Gibeon bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; ejakaa a kɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya tsɔ huɛ.”

english_verse: the Gibeonites sent a message to the Israelite camp at Gilgal: “Joshua, please come and rescue us! The Amorite kings from the hill country have joined together and are attacking us. We are your servants, so don't let us down. Please hurry!”
translation_verse: Gibeon bi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba Yoshua ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Gilgal, ba de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, koo ngmɛɛ wa he; ba esɔesɔ nɛ o ba piɛ wa he. Ba kpɔ wɔ! Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ bua a ta amɛ a nya kɛ je yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ba tua wɔ!”

english_verse: Joshua and his army, including his best warriors, left Gilgal.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo, kɛ e katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Gilgal.

english_verse: “Joshua,” the Lord said, “don't be afraid of the Amorites. They will run away when you attack, and I will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Koo ye mɛ gbeye. I ha o ye a nɔ momo. A ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo nyɛe.”

english_verse: Joshua marched all night from Gilgal to Gibeon and made a surprise attack on the Amorite camp.
translation_verse: Yoshua kɛ e tabo ɔ nyɛɛ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ je Gilgal kɛ ho Gibeon ya ya tua Amor bi ɔmɛ, be mi nɛ a hɛ be a he nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord made the enemy panic, and the Israelites started killing them right and left. They chased the Amorite troops up the road to Beth-Horon and kept on killing them, until they reached the towns of Azekah and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha sawale nu Amor bi ɔmɛ benɛ a na Israel ta a. Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe mɛ ngɔ pue si ngɛ Gibeon, nɛ a nyɛɛ a se kɛ fo kɛ ya gu yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ ngɛ Bet Horon, kɛ ya su Azeka kɛ Makeda tɔɔ ngɛ leneyi je.

english_verse: And while these troops were going down through Beth-Horon Pass, the Lord made huge hailstones fall on them all the way to Azekah. More of the enemy soldiers died from the hail than from the Israelite weapons.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ ngɛ fo tue ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a ta a nya kɛ gu yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ kɛ yaa a, Yawɛ ha gbiɛ ngo ngu nguahi je hiɔwe ba nɔɔ a nɔ. Nihi nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔ gbe ɔ hiɛ kulaa pe nihi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ klaate gbe.

english_verse: The Lord was helping the Israelites defeat the Amorites that day. So about noon, Joshua prayed to the Lord loud enough for the Israelites to hear: “Our Lord, make the sun stop in the sky over Gibeon, and the moon stand still over Aijalon Valley.” So the sun and the moon stopped and stood still until Israel defeated its enemies. This poem can be found in The Book of Jashar. The sun stood still and didn't go down for about a whole day.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ pu ɔ da si, nɛ nyɔhiɔ ɔ hu mimiɛ we e he kɛ ya su be nɛ Israel ma a ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ. A ngma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yashar Womi ɔ mi. Pu ɔ da si ngɛ hiɔwe ligbi mluku kake, nɛ e ya nɔɛ si.

english_verse: Never before and never since has the Lord done anything like that for someone who prayed. The Lord was really fighting for Israel.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ba nɛ ɔ, kaa Yawɛ bu nɔmlɔ kake kue fami tue, nɛ e ha pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ nyɛ da si nɛ a nyɛɛ we ɔ, eko bɛ hyɛ. Yawɛ hwu ta ha Israel!

english_verse: After the battle, Joshua and the Israelites went back to their camp at Gilgal. Joshua Kills the Five Enemy Kings
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo kpale a se kɛ ba ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Gilgal. Yoshua nuu Amor matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ

english_verse: While the enemy soldiers were running from the Israelites, the five enemy kings ran away and hid in a cave near Makkedah.
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ enuɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ma fo nɛ a ya laa a he ngɛ Makeda tɛ puɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Joshua's soldiers told him, “The five kings have been found in a cave near Makkedah.”
translation_verse: Nɔ ko ya na mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ba bɔ Yoshua he nɛ matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ ya laa a he ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Joshua answered, “Roll some big stones over the mouth of the cave and leave a few soldiers to guard it.
translation_verse: Yoshua fa ke, “Nyɛ ya kpɛne tɛ agbo komɛ kɛ tsi tɛ puɔ ɔ nya, nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ nihi nɛ bu he;

english_verse: But you and everyone else must keep going after the enemy troops, because they will be safe if they reach their walled towns. Don't let them get away! The Lord our God is helping us get rid of them.”
translation_verse: nyɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ko tlɔ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a se, nɛ nyɛ tua mɛ kɛ je a se je; nyɛ ko ha nɛ a sɛ a ma amɛ a mi; ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi.”

english_verse: So Joshua and the Israelites almost wiped out the enemy soldiers. Only a few safely reached their walled towns.
translation_verse: Yoshua kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe nihi babauu nitsɛ; nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ ná blɔ ya sɛ a ma amɛ nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he ɔ mi.

english_verse: The Israelite army returned to their camp at Makkedah, where Joshua was waiting for them. No one around there dared say anything bad about the Israelites.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo kpale kɛ ba Yoshua ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Makeda; nɔ kake po nɔɛ ngɛ ta a mi. Kɛ je enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko hla we munyu ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he hu.

english_verse: Joshua told his soldiers, “Now, move the rocks from the entrance to the cave and bring those five kings to me.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yoshua de ke, “Nyɛ bli tɛ puɔ ɔ nya, nɛ nyɛ je jamɛ a matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ kpo kɛ ba ha mi.”

english_verse: The soldiers opened the entrance to the cave and brought out the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a bli tɛ puɔ ɔ nya, nɛ a je matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Yoshua. Mɛ ji: Yerusalem matsɛ, Hebron matsɛ, Yarmut matsɛ, Lakish matsɛ, kɛ Eglon matsɛ.

english_verse: After Joshua had called the army together, he forced the five kings to lie down on the ground. Then he called his officers forward and told them, “You fought these kings along with me, so put your feet on their necks.” The officers did this,
translation_verse: Benɛ a kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba Yoshua ngɔ ɔ, Yoshua kpee Israel ma a tsuo kɛ ba; nɛ e de asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya ta a ke, “Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nanehi ba ma matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a kuɛhi a nɔ!” Asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ja.

english_verse: and Joshua continued, “Don't ever be afraid or discouraged. Be brave and strong. This is what the Lord will do to all your enemies.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yoshua de ma a ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ ko nu sawale hulɔ. Nyɛ he nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛɛ pee kã; ejakaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ Yawɛ maa pee nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo!”

english_verse: Joshua killed the five kings and told his men to hang each body on a tree. Then at sunset
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua gbe matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ kpla si ngɛ tsohi a nɔ. A hi tso ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ nya si.

english_verse: he told some of his troops, “Take the bodies down and throw them into the cave where the kings were found. Cover the entrance to the cave with big rocks.” Joshua's troops obeyed his orders, and those rocks are still there. Joshua Continues the Fighting
translation_verse: Benɛ pu yaa nɔ si ɔ, Yoshua fa nɛ a ya je mɛ kɛ je tso ɔmɛ a nɔ. A ya hɛɛ mɛ ngɔ pue tɛ puɔ ɔ nɛ a ya laa a he ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ̃ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɔ tɛ agboagbohi kɛ tsi tɛ puɔ ɔ nya; nɛ tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Yoshua kpɔ Amor bi ɔmɛ a zugba kpahi

english_verse: Later that day, Joshua captured Makkedah and killed its king and everyone else in the town, just as he had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: Yoshua ye Makeda nɔ kunimi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. E gbe ma a mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ; e kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ kake po píɛ. Bɔ nɛ e pee Yeriko matsɛ ɔ, jã pɛpɛɛpɛ e pee Makeda matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Makkedah and attacked the town of Libnah.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo hia kɛ je Makeda kɛ ho Libna ya, nɛ e ya tua Libna.

english_verse: The Lord let them capture the town and its king, and they killed the king and everyone else, just as they had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɔ wo a dɛ nɛ a gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ; a kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ kake po píɛ. Bɔ nɛ Yoshua pee Yeriko matsɛ ɔ, jã pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ e pee Libna matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Joshua then led his army to Lachish, and they set up camp around the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ je Libna kɛ ho Lakish ya. A ya sá ma a yi, nɛ a tua ma a.

english_verse: King Horam of Gezer arrived to help Lachish, but Joshua and his troops attacked and destroyed him and his army.
translation_verse: Gezer matsɛ, Horam, kɛ e ta a ba konɛ a ba piɛ Lakish he. Se Yoshua gbe matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ta a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ; nɔ kake po píɛ.

english_verse: From Lachish, Joshua took his troops to Eglon, where they set up camp surrounding the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo je Lakish kɛ ho Eglon ya. A ya sá ma a yi, nɛ a tua ma a.

english_verse: captured it that same day, then killed everyone, as they had done at Lachish.
translation_verse: A ngɔ ma a jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ngɛ Lakish ɔ.

english_verse: They captured the town, and its nearby villages. Then they destroyed Debir and killed its king, together with everyone else, just as they had done with Hebron and Libnah.
translation_verse: E ngɔ ma a, matsɛ ɔ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma a. A gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nɛ nɔ kake po píɛ. Bɔ nɛ Yoshua pee Hebron, kɛ Libna, kɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu e pee Debir, kɛ Debir matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Joshua captured towns everywhere in the land: In the central hill country and the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert and the region that slopes down toward the Dead Sea. Whenever he captured a town, he would kill the king and everyone else, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded.
translation_verse: Yoshua ye zugba a tsuo nɔ: yo nɔ zugba a, leneyi je zugba a, nga nɔ zugba a, kɛ kɔ̃ mi zugba a, kɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. E kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ kake po píɛ. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ fa ke a pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Joshua wiped out towns from Kadesh-Barnea to Gaza, everywhere in the region of Goshen, and as far north as Gibeon.
translation_verse: Yoshua ye zugba a tsuo nɔ, kɛ je Kadesh Barnea kɛ ya su Gaza tɔɔ, kɛ Goshen zugba a, kɛ ya su Gibeon tɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord fought on Israel's side, so Joshua and the Israelite army were able to capture these kings and take their land. They fought one battle after another, then they went back to their camp at Gilgal after capturing all that land.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo kpale a se kɛ ba ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Gilgal.

english_verse: King Jabin of Hazor heard about Joshua's victories, so he sent messages to many nearby kings and asked them to join him in fighting Israel. He sent these messages to King Jobab of Madon, the kings of Shimron and Achshaph,
translation_verse: Benɛ Hazor matsɛ, Yabin nu Israel kunimi yemi ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ ya de Madon matsɛ, Yobab; Shimron matsɛ, Akshaf matsɛ,

english_verse: the kings in the northern hill country and in the Jordan River valley south of Lake Galilee, and the kings in the foothills and in Naphath-Dor to the west.
translation_verse: kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi ngɛ Galilea wo ɔ leneyi je, kɛ nga kpataa a nɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nya ngɛ Dor kasa nya a.

english_verse: He sent messages to the Canaanite kings in the east and the west, to the Amorite, Hittite, Perizzite, and Jebusite kings in the hill country, and to the Hivite kings in the region of Mizpah, near the foot of Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e tsɔ ya de Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a kpo he hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, kɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ, Hit bi ɔmɛ, Periz bi ɔmɛ, Yebus bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, kɛ Hiv bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Hermon yo ɔ sisi ngɛ Mizpa zugba a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The kings and their armies went to Merom Pond, where they set up camp, and got ready to fight Israel. It seemed as though there were more soldiers and horses and chariots than there are grains of sand on a beach.
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo bua a tabo ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ he kake, nɛ a gba ta ngɔ wo Israel he ngɛ Merom pa a nya.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua: Don't let them frighten you! I'll help you defeat them, and by this time tomorrow they will be dead. When you attack, the first thing you have to do is to cripple their horses. Then after the battle is over, burn their chariots.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Koo ye mɛ gbeye. Hwɔɔ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ha Israel momo. O maa poo a we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nane se pani, nɛ o maa sã a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army made a surprise attack against the enemy camp at Merom Pond
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo ya tua Yabin ta a ngɛ Merom pa a nya, be mi nɛ a hɛ be a he nɔ.

english_verse: Up to this time, the king of Hazor had controlled the kingdoms that had joined together to attack Israel, so Joshua led his army back and captured Hazor. They killed its king
translation_verse: Yoshua kpale e se jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu, nɛ e ya ngɔ Hazor, nɛ e gbe matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and everyone else, then they set the town on fire.
translation_verse: A kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɔ kake po píɛ. Nɛ a sã Hazor ma a.

english_verse: Joshua captured all the towns where the enemy kings had ruled. These towns were built on small hills, and Joshua did not set fire to any of these towns, except Hazor. The Israelites kept the animals and everything of value from these towns, but they killed everyone who lived in them, including their kings. That's what the Lord had told his servant Moses to do, that's what Moses had told Joshua to do, and that's exactly what Joshua did.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa e tsɔlɔ Mose ɔ, jã kɛ̃ Mose fa Yoshua, nɛ ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Yoshua pee ɔ nɛ. E si we níhi nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke a pee ɔ ekoeko nɛ e pee we. Zugba nɛ Yoshua ngɔ ɔ

english_verse: Joshua and his army took control of the northern and southern hill country, the foothills to the west, the Southern Desert, the whole region of Goshen, and the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Yoshua ngɔ zugba a tsuo: yo nɔ kɛ kɔ̃ mi zugba a ngɛ leneyi je kɛ omleyi je tsuo, Goshen zugba a, Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ, kɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ kɛ a he nga kplanaa a.

english_verse: They took control of the land from Mount Halak near the country of Edom in the south to Baal-Gad in Lebanon Valley at the foot of Mount Hermon in the north. Joshua and his army were at war with the kings in this region for a long time, but finally they captured and put to death the last king.
translation_verse: Zugba a fia si kɛ je Halak yo ɔ he ngɛ leneyi je ngɛ Edom kasa nya, kɛ kuɔ kɛ ya si Baalgad ngɛ omleyi je, ngɛ Lebanon kɔ̃ ɔ mi, ngɛ Hermon yo ɔ leneyi je. Yoshua kɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hwu ta be saii. Nyagbe ɔ, e nuu mɛ nɛ e kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he wanted the towns in this region destroyed and their people killed without mercy. That's why the Lord made the people in the towns stubborn and determined to fight Israel. The only town that signed a peace treaty with Israel was the Hivite town of Gibeon. The Israelite army captured the rest of the towns in battle.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha a kplii a tsui kaa a kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa hwu ta, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a ko na mɛ mɔbɔ. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: During this same time, Joshua and his army killed the Anakim from the northern and southern hill country. They also destroyed the towns where the Anakim had lived, including Hebron, Debir, and Anab.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yoshua ya kpata oblaihi a nina komɛ a hɛ mi. A tsɛɛ mɛ ke Anak bi. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hii Hebron, Debir, Anab, Yuda, kɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. Yoshua kpata ni ɔmɛ kɛ a ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: There were not any Anakim left in the regions where the Israelites lived, although there were still some in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.
translation_verse: Anak bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake po píɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ; ja Gaza, Gat, kɛ Ashdod pɛ nɛ ni komɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: That's how Joshua captured the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses, and Joshua divided it up among the tribes. Finally, there was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Yoshua ngɔ zugba mluku ɔ tsuo, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke a pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Yoshua dla zugba a ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya kaa a weto ní. Kɛkɛ nɛ ta a se po, nɛ zugba a nɔ jɔ.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he and the people of Israel had defeated two kings east of the Jordan River. These kings had ruled the region from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, including the eastern side of the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ ye matsɛmɛ enyɔ komɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ a zugba a ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je. Zugba a ngɛ kɛ je Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ya su Hermon yo ɔ he tɔɔ.

english_verse: The first king that Moses and the Israelites defeated was an Amorite, King Sihon of Heshbon. The southern border of his kingdom ran down the middle of the Arnon River gorge, taking in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the gorge. The Jabbok River separated Sihon's kingdom from the Ammonites on the east. Then the Jabbok turned west and became his northern border, so his kingdom included the southern half of the region of Gilead.
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji Amor bi ɔmɛ a Matsɛ Sihon nɛ hi Heshbon ɔ. E nɔ yemi hehi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Gilead fa a, kɛ je Aroer ngɛ Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ nya kɛ gu kɔ̃ ɔ mi, kɛ ya su Yabok pa a nya ngɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya.

english_verse: Sihon also controlled the eastern side of the Jordan River valley from Lake Galilee south to Beth-Jeshimoth and the Dead Sea. In addition to these regions, he ruled the town called Slopes of Mount Pisgah and the land south of there at the foot of the hill.
translation_verse: E nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ, kɛ je Galilea wo ɔ nya ngɛ omleyi je kɛ ya su Bet Yeshimot ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ beleku je hluu kɛ ya su Pisga yo ɔ sisi.

english_verse: Next, Moses and the Israelites defeated King Og of Bashan, who lived in the town of Ashtaroth part of each year and in Edrei the rest of the year. Og was one of the last of the Rephaim.
translation_verse: Matsɛ enyɔne ɔ ji Bashan matsɛ, Og. Lɛ ji Refaim nina nɛ piɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake nɛ hi Ashtarot kɛ Edrei.

english_verse: His kingdom stretched north to Mount Hermon, east to the town of Salecah, and included the land of Bashan as far west as the borders of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah. He also ruled the northern half of Gilead.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Og nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: kɛ je Hermon yo ɔ nɔ, Saleka, kɛ Bashan tsuo, kɛ ya su Geshur bi ɔmɛ kɛ Maaka bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔmɛ a nya. Jehanɛ, kɛ je Gilead bi ɔmɛ a zugba a fa kɛ ya ta Heshbon huzu ɔ nya.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, had led the people of Israel in defeating Sihon and Og. Then Moses gave their land to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh.
translation_verse: Mose kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kpata matsɛmɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose ngɔ a zugba a ngɔ ha Ruben kɛ Gad, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a kaa a weto ní. Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Yoshua ye a nɔ ɔ

english_verse: Many years later, the Lord told Joshua: Now you are very old, but there is still a lot of land that Israel has not yet taken.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, benɛ Yoshua ba bwɔ kotokoto ɔ, Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “O bwɔ lɛɛ, se zugba nɛ piɛ nɛ o maa ngɔ ɔ hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: Moses had already given land east of the Jordan River to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose ha Manase wɛtso fa a nɛ piɛ ɔ, Ruben wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Gad wɛtso ɔ a weto ní ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je momo.

english_verse: This region stretched north from the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, and included the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley. It covered the flatlands of Medeba north of Dibon,
translation_verse: A zugba a fɔ si kɛ je Aroer, ngɛ Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ nya, kɛ be ma nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ he, kɛ muɔ zugba kpataa a nɛ ngɛ Medeba kɛ Dibon a kpɛti ɔ.

english_verse: and took in the towns that had belonged to Sihon, the Amorite king of Heshbon. Some of these towns were as far east as the Ammonite border.
translation_verse: A kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ wo huzu. Amor bi a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ Heshbon ɔ, e ma amɛ tsuo ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Geshur and Maacah were part of this region, and so was the whole territory that King Og had ruled, that is, Gilead, Mount Hermon, and all of Bashan as far east as Salecah. Og had lived in Ashtaroth part of each year, and he had lived in Edrei the rest of the year. Og had been one of the last of the Rephaim, but Moses had defeated Sihon and Og and their people and had forced them to leave their land.
translation_verse: Bashan matsɛ, Og nɔ yemi he ɔ hu piɛ zugba nɛ ɔ he. Og ye matsɛ ngɛ Ashtarot kɛ Edrei; nɛ lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ji nɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ oblaihi a nina nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Refaim ɔ a kpɛti; ejakaa Mose ya tua mɛ, nɛ e fie mɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: However, the Israelites did not force the people of Geshur and Maacah to leave, and they still live there among the Israelites. Why Moses Did Not Give Land to the Levi Tribe
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ fie we Geshur bi ɔmɛ kɛ Maaka bi ɔmɛ; mohu ɔ, a kɛ mɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord God of Israel had told them, “Instead of land, you will receive the sacrifices offered at my altar.” The Land Moses Gave to the Reuben Tribe
translation_verse: Levi bi ɔmɛ pɛ ji wɛtso nɛ Mose ha we mɛ zugba a eko. Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a blɔ nya ní ji bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ haa Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ. Zugba nɛ a ha Ruben wɛtso ɔ

english_verse: Moses gave land to each of the clans in the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Mose ha Ruben wɛtso ɔ zugba kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.

english_verse: Their land started in the south at the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, took in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley, and went as far north as the flatlands around Medeba.
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ ɔ huzu je Aroer pa a nya ngɛ Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ nya, kɛ ma nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ kpɛti ɔ, kɛ zugba kpataa a tsuo nɛ bɔle Medeba a.

english_verse: The Amorite King Sihon had lived in Heshbon and had ruled the towns in the flatlands. Now Heshbon belonged to Reuben, and so did the following towns in the flatlands: Dibon, Bamoth-Baal, Beth-Baal-Meon, Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath, Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-Shahar on the hill in the valley, Beth-Peor, Slopes of Mount Pisgah, and Beth-Jeshimoth. Moses defeated Sihon and killed him and the Midianite chiefs who ruled parts of his kingdom for him. Their names were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ ji ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba kpataa a nɔ, kɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ Heshbon ɔ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo. Mose ye e nɔ kunimi, kɛ Midian ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, kɛ Reba. Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon ganɔhi ji mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: The Israelites also killed Balaam the son of Beor, who had been a fortuneteller.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe ɔ, a ti nɔ kake ji klamɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Balaam ɔ. Beor binyumu ji lɛ.

english_verse: This region with its towns and villages was the land for the Reuben tribe, and the Jordan River was its western border. The Land Moses Gave to the Gad Tribe
translation_verse: Ruben bi ɔmɛ a huzu ngɛ bonyoku je ji Yordan pa a. Mahi kɛ a he kɔpehi nɛ a ha Ruben bi ɔmɛ kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Zugba nɛ a ha Gad wɛtso ɔ

english_verse: Moses also gave land to each of the clans in the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Mose ha Gad wɛtso ɔ hu zugba a eko kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.

english_verse: It included the town of Jazer, and in the Gilead region their territory took in the land and towns as far east as the town of Aroer just west of Rabbah. This was about half of the land that had once belonged to the Ammonites.
translation_verse: A zugba ji Yazer kɛ Gilead ma amɛ tsuo, kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a fa, kɛ ya su Aroer ngɛ Raba beleku je.

english_verse: The land given to Gad stretched from Heshbon in the south to Ramath-Mizpeh and Betonim in the north, and even further north to Mahanaim and Lidebor.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, a zugba a tsa nɔ kɛ je Heshbon kɛ ya su Ramat Mizpa kɛ Betonim, nɛ e je Mahanaim kɛ ya su Lodebar huzu ɔ nya.

english_verse: Gad also received the eastern half of the Jordan River valley, which had been ruled by King Sihon of Heshbon. This territory stretched as far north as Lake Galilee, and included the towns of Beth-Haram, Beth-Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon.
translation_verse: Ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ, mahi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ji Bet Haram, Betnimra, Sukot, Safon, kɛ Heshbon nɛ ji Matsɛ Sihon nɔ yemi he nɛ piɛ ɔ. Bonyoku je huzu ɔ je Yordan pa a nya kɛ ya su Galilea wo ɔ nya tɔɔ ngɛ omleyi je.

english_verse: These regions with their towns and villages were given to the Gad tribe. The Land Moses Gave to Half the Manasseh Tribe
translation_verse: Mahi kɛ a he kɔpehi nɛ a ha Gad wɛtso ɔ kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Zugba nɛ a ha Manase wɛtso fa a

english_verse: Moses gave land east of the Jordan River to half of the clans from the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Manase wɛtso fa a hu Mose ha mɛ zugba kaa a weto ní, we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.

english_verse: Their land started at Mahanaim and took in the region that King Og of Bashan had ruled, including Ashtaroth and Edrei, the two towns where he had lived. The villages where the Jair clan settled were part of Manasseh's land, and so was the northern half of the region of Gilead. The clans of this half of Manasseh had
translation_verse: Gilead ma a fa, kɛ Ashtarot kɛ Adrei ngɛ zugba nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ha Manase wɛtso fa a mi. Ma nguahi nɛ ngɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og nɔ yemi he ɔ ji ma nɛ ɔmɛ. A ngɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ ha Manase binyumu Makir nina fa a we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.

english_verse: That was how Moses divided up the Moab Plains to the east of Jericho on the other side of the Jordan River, so these two and a half tribes would have land of their own.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mose dla zugba a nɛ ngɛ Moab nga a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan se pa a ngɛ Yeriko beleku je ɔ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord had promised that he would always provide for them.
translation_verse: Levi wɛtso ɔ lɛɛ Mose ha we mɛ zugba a eko. E de mɛ ke mɛɛ a weto ní ji Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: One day while the Israelites were still camped at Gilgal, Caleb the son of Jephunneh went to talk with Joshua. Caleb belonged to the Kenaz clan, and many other people from the Judah tribe went with Caleb. He told Joshua: You know that back in Kadesh-Barnea the Lord talked to his prophet Moses about you and me.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko ɔ, Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi ni komɛ ba Yoshua ngɔ ngɛ Gilgal. A ti nɔ kake ji Yefune nɛ je Keniz ɔ binyumu Kaleb. E ba bɔ Yoshua amaniɛ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o le munyu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ Mose tu nɛ kɔɔ i kɛ mo wa he ngɛ Kadesh Barnea.

english_verse: The other spies said things that made our people afraid, but I completely trusted the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ mi ya a ha ma a tsui po; se imi lɛɛ i bu Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ tue kɛ pi si.

english_verse: The same day I came back, Moses told me, “Since you were faithful to the Lord God, I promise that the places where you went as a spy will belong to you and your descendants forever.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose ka mi kita jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ke, zugba a he nɛ i ya nyɛɛ ɔ ma ba pee i kɛ ye nina wa weto ní daa; ejakaa i bu Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ tue kɛ pi si.

english_verse: So I'm asking you for the hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You were there. You heard the other spies talk about that part of the hill country and the large, walled towns where the Anakim live. But maybe the Lord will help me take their land, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo mi he si jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ngɔɔ ha mi. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, wa ba bɔ nyɛ amaniɛ ke oblai komɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ ke Anak bi ɔ ngɛ ma ngua komɛ nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Se i de ke, eko ɔ, Yawɛ maa piɛ ye he nɛ ma fie mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua prayed that God would help Caleb, then he gave Hebron to Caleb and his descendants.
translation_verse: Yoshua gbaa Yefune binyumu Kaleb, nɛ e ngɔ Hebron ma a ngɔ ha lɛ kaa e weto ní.

english_verse: And Hebron still belongs to Caleb's descendants, because he was faithful to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hebron ba pee Yefune nɛ je Keniz ɔ binyumu Kaleb weto ní kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ; ejakaa e bu Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ tue kɛ pi si.

english_verse: Hebron used to be called Arba's Town, because Arba had been one of the greatest of the Anakim. There was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Sa a, Hebron biɛ ji Kiriat Arba . Arba nɛ ɔ ji Anak bi ɔmɛ a nɔmlɔ agbo pe kulaa. Jehanɛ ɔ, ta a se po, nɛ zugba a nɔ jɔ.

english_verse: Judah's southern border started at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je nɛ ɔ je Ngo wo ɔ leneyi je,

english_verse: As it went west from there, it ran south of Scorpion Pass to Zin, and then came up from the south to Kadesh-Barnea. It continued past Hezron up to Addar, turned toward Karka,
translation_verse: nɛ e tsa nɔ ja kɛ kuɔ Akrabim yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ, kɛ ya su Zin. E kuɔ kɛ ya je Kadesh Barnea leneyi je, kɛ ya gu Hezron kasa nya, kɛ ya su Adar, nɛ e lɔgɔ kɛ ya gu Karka.

english_verse: and ran along to Azmon. After that, it followed the Egyptian Gorge and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was also Israel's southern border.
translation_verse: E tsa nɔ kɛ ho Azmon ya, kɛ ya gu Egipt pa a nya, hluu kɛ ya pi Mediterenia wo ɔ, nɛ e nya ya ta ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yuda huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: From there it went west up to Beth-Hoglah, continued north of Beth-Arabah, and went up to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: su Bet Hogla, nɛ e ya be ngɛ kpongu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ he ɔ omleyi je. E kuɔ kɛ ya gu Bohan tɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: From there, it went to Trouble Valley and Debir, then turned north and went to Gilgal, which is on the north side of the valley across from Adummim Pass. It continued on to Enshemesh, Enrogel,
translation_verse: Kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, huzu ɔ ya gu Haomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ya su Debir, nɛ e lɔgɔ kɛ gu Gilgal ngɛ Adumim yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ leneyi je. Huzu ɔ tsa nɔ kɛ ya gu Enshemesh pa a nya kɛ ya su Enrogel.

english_verse: and up through Hinnom Valley on the land sloping south from Jerusalem. The city of Jerusalem itself belonged to the Jebusites. Next, the border went up to the top of the mountain on the west side of Hinnom Valley and at the north end of Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ nyɛɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ ngɛ leneyi je, he nɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ ma Yerusalem ngɛ ɔ. Huzu ɔ kuɔ yo ɔ ngɛ bonyoku je, kɛ ya gu Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ we omleyi je.

english_verse: At the top of the mountain it turned and went to Nephtoah Spring and then to the ruins on Mount Ephron. From there, it went to Baalah, which is now called Kiriath-Jearim.
translation_verse: Huzu ɔ kple si kɛ ba Neftoa pa a nya, nɛ e tsa nɔ kɛ ya na ma nɛ ngɛ Efron yo ɔ kasa nya a, nɛ e lɔgɔ kɛ ho Baala ya.

english_verse: From Baalah the northern border curved west to Mount Seir and then ran along the northern ridge of Mount Jearim, where Chesalon is located. Then it went down to Beth-Shemesh and over to Timnah.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ lɔgɔ Baala bonyoku je kɛ ho Seir yo ɔ he ya, nɛ e bɔle Yearim yo ɔ, . Huzu ɔ kple si kɛ ya su Bet Shemesh, kɛ ya gu Timna.

english_verse: Next, Caleb started a war with the town of Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.
translation_verse: Benɛ Kaleb je lejɛ ɔ, e ya tua Debir, nɛ sa a, a tsɛɛ lɛ Kiriat Sefer ɔ.

english_verse: Joshua gave Caleb some land among the people of Judah, as God had told him to do. Caleb's share was Hebron, which at that time was known as Arba's Town, because Arba was the famous ancestor of the Anakim.
translation_verse: Yoshua ha Yefune binyumu Kaleb zugba a eko ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ mi, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. A ha lɛ Kiriat Arba nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hebron, ma nɛ a kɛ Anak binyumu Arba biɛ wo lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah, Zanoah, En-Gannim, Tappuah, Enam, Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah, Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim.
translation_verse: Kaleb fie Anak binyumu etɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je ma a mi. Mɛ ji Sheshai, Ahiman, kɛ Talmai.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdalgad, Dilan, Mizpeh, Joktheel, Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon, Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish, Gederoth, Beth-Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Kaleb de ke, “Nɔ nɛ ma tua Kiriat Sefer nɛ e maa ngɔ ma a, ma ha lɛ ye biyo Aksa nɛ e ngɔ.”

english_verse: Caleb's nephew Othniel captured Kiriath-Sepher, and Caleb let him marry Achsah.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Otniel nɛ ji Kaleb nyɛminyumu Kenaz bi ɔ, ya ngɔ ma a, nɛ Kaleb kɛ e biyo Aksa ha lɛ.

english_verse: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What's bothering you?”
translation_verse: Benɛ a kpee Aksa a, e wo e huno ɔ yi mi ke e bi e ngatsɛ ɔ ngmɔ zugba ko; Aksa kple si kɛ je e teji ɔ nɔ, nɛ Kaleb bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha mo?”

english_verse: She answered, “I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so I really need some spring-fed ponds for a water supply.” Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds, named Higher Pond and Lower Pond. Towns in Judah's Land
translation_verse: E de e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Moo ke mi nɔ́ ko. O ha mi zugba ngɛ leneyi je he nɛ nyu be momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, nɛ o ha mi he ko nɛ nyu ngɛ hu ngɔ piɛ he.” Kaleb ha lɛ hehi nɛ nyu ngɛ, ngɛ yo nɔ kɛ kɔ̃ mi. Yuda ma amɛ

english_verse: The following is a list of the towns in each region given to the Judah clans:
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ ná kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The first region was located in the Southern Desert along the border with Edom, and it had the following
translation_verse: Lebaot, Shilhim, Ain, Rimon. Ma amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a yibɔ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ nɛɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.

english_verse: The second region was located in the northern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: Shaaraim, Aditaim, Gedera, Gederotaim. E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.

english_verse: The third region was located in the southern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: Gederot, Betdagon, Naama, Makeda. E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ ekpa kɛ a he kɔpehi.

english_verse: The fifth region was located along the Mediterranean seacoast, and it had the following towns with their surrounding settlements and villages: Ekron and the towns between there and the coast, Ashdod and the larger towns nearby, Gaza, the towns from Gaza to the Egyptian Gorge, and the towns along the coast of the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ekomɛ ji Ashdod, kɛ Gaza, kɛ a he mahi kɛ kɔpehi, hluu kɛ ya su pa a he ngɛ Egipt huzu ɔ nya, kɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ hu nya.

english_verse: The eleventh region was located in the northern part of Judah's hill country, and it had the following two towns with their surrounding villages: Rabbah, and Kiriath-Baal, which is also called Kiriath-Jearim.
translation_verse: Ekomɛ hu ji Kiriat Baal , kɛ Raba. E peeɔ ma enyɔ kɛ a he kɔpehi.

english_verse: The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem, and the people of the Judah tribe could not capture the city and get rid of them. That's why Jebusites still live in Jerusalem along with the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a fie Yebus bi ɔmɛ nɛ hi Yerusalem ɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yebus bi ɔmɛ kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: The following is a description of the land that was divided among the clans of the Ephraim tribe. Their southern border started at Ataroth-Addar and went west to Upper Beth-Horon
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a dla zugba a ngɔ ha Efraim bi ɔmɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ngɛ beleku je ɔ, a zugba a huzu ɔ je Atarot Adar kɛ ya su Bet Horon ngɛ yiti je ɔ tɔɔ.

english_verse: and the Mediterranean Sea. Their northern border started on the east at Janoah, curved a little to the north, then came back south to Michmethath and Tappuah, where it followed the Kanah Gorge west to the Mediterranean Sea. The eastern border started on the north near Janoah and went between Janoah on the southwest and Taanath-Shiloh on the northeast. Then it went south to Ataroth, Naarah, and on as far as the edge of the land that belonged to Jericho. At that point it turned east and went to the Jordan River. The clans of Ephraim received this region as their tribal land.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ huzu ɔ je Tapua, kɛ gu bonyoku je kɛ ya na Kana pa a, nɛ e ya gbe nya ngɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ nya. Zugba nɛ a ha Efraim wɛtso ɔ kaa a weto ní nɛ a dla ngɔ ha mɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Ephraim also had some towns and villages that were inside Manasseh's tribal land.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se hu, a ha Efraim bi ɔmɛ ma komɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi ngɛ Manase bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ mi.

english_verse: Ephraim could not force the Canaanites out of Gezer, so there are still some Canaanites who live there among the Israelites. But now these Canaanites have to work as slaves for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Efraim bi ɔmɛ fie we Kanaan bi ɔmɛ kɛ ji Gezer; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Efraim bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ; se a plɛ pee Efraim bi ɔmɛ a nyɔguɛhi, nɛ a sɔmɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: The land of the Manasseh tribe went from its northern border with the Asher tribe south to Michmethath, which is to the east of Shechem. The southern border started there, but curved even farther south to include the people who lived around Tappuah Spring.
translation_verse: Manase huzu ɔ je Asher kɛ gu Mikmetat ngɛ Shekem beleku je. Huzu ɔ tsa nɔ kɛ gu leneyi je kɛ ya ná Entapua bi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The town of Tappuah was on Manasseh's border with Ephraim. Although the land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, the town itself belonged to Ephraim.
translation_verse: Tapua zugba a peeɔ Manase nɔ́; se Tapua ma nɛ ngɛ Manase huzu ɔ nya a lɛɛ e peeɔ Efraim nina a a nɔ́.

english_verse: Manasseh was supposed to have the following towns with their surrounding villages inside the borders of Issachar's and Asher's tribal lands: Beth-Shan, Ibleam, Endor, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, which is also called Naphath.
translation_verse: A ha Manase ma nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ kaa a weto ní ngɛ Isakar bi ɔmɛ kɛ Asher bi ɔmɛ a zugba a mi. Mɛ ji Bet Shan, Ibleam, Dor, Endor, Taanak, Megido, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But the people of Manasseh could not capture these towns, so the Canaanites kept on living in them.
translation_verse: Manase bi ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a fie ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ hi lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When the Israelites grew stronger, they made the Canaanites in these towns work as their slaves, though they never did force them to leave. Joseph's Descendants Ask for More Land
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he ba wa pe kekle ɔ po, a fie we Kanaan bi ɔmɛ tsuo, se mohu a nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a tsu ní ha mɛ. Efraim kɛ Manase fa a bi zugba nɛ kle

english_verse: One day the Joseph tribes came to Joshua and asked, “Why didn't you give us more land? The Lord has always been kind to us, and we have too many people for this small region.”
translation_verse: Yosef nina a ba de Yoshua ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o ha wɔ zugba a mi dlami kake pɛ kaa wa weto ní ɔ? O le kaa Yawɛ gbaa wɔ, nɛ wa he hiɛ babauu.”

english_verse: Joshua replied, “If there's not enough room for you in the hill country of Ephraim, then go into the forest that belonged to the Perizzites and the Rephaim. Clear out the trees and make more room for yourselves there.”
translation_verse: Yoshua he nɔ ke, “Ke nyɛ he hiɛ babauu nɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ be nyɛ kpee ɔ, nyɛ ya gba hue ɔ ngɛ Periz bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Refaim bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ hi lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: “Even if we do that,” they answered, “there still won't be enough land for us in the hill country. And we can't move down into Jezreel Valley, because the Canaanites who live in Beth-Shan and in other parts of the valley have iron chariots.”
translation_verse: A je nya ke, “Yo nɔ zugba a klee we ha wɔ. Jehanɛ hu, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ Bet Shan kɛ a he kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yezreel kɔ̃ ɔ mi tsuo ngɛ dade ta zugba lɛhi.”

english_verse: “Your tribes do have a lot of people,” Joshua admitted. “I'll give you more land. Your tribes are powerful,
translation_verse: Yoshua de Yosef we ɔ nɛ ji Efraim kɛ Manase fa a ke, “Niinɛ, nyɛ he hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ he wa saminya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, pi zugba a mi dlami kake pɛ nɛ nyɛ ma na.

english_verse: so you can have the rest of the hill country, but it's a forest, and you'll have to cut down the trees and clear the land. You can also have Jezreel Valley. Even though the Canaanites there are strong and have iron chariots, you can force them to leave the valley.”
translation_verse: Yo nɔ zugba a maa pee nyɛ nɔ́. Akɛnɛ hue ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ gba hue ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ, kɛ zugba nɛ tsa nɔ kɛ yaa a tsuo. E ngɛ mi kaa Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ngɛ dade ta zugba lɛhi nɛ a he wa mohu, se nyɛ maa fie mɛ kɛ̃.”

english_verse: After Israel had captured the land, they met at Shiloh and set up the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ zugba a ta a, ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Shilo, nɛ a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The men left and went across the land, dividing it into seven regions. They wrote down a description of each region, town by town, and returned to Joshua at the camp at Shiloh.
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya kpa zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ a pee zugba a he womi, nɛ a tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a gba mi kpaago ha, kɛ mahi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba Yoshua ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Shilo.

english_verse: Joshua found out from the Lord how to divide the land, and he told the tribes what the Lord had decided. Benjamin's Land
translation_verse: Yoshua fɔ sɔ kɛ bi Yawɛ ga womi ha mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e dla zugba a ngɔ ha Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ. Zugba nɛ a ha Benyamin wɛtso ɔ

english_verse: Benjamin was the first tribe chosen to receive land. The region for its clans lay between the Judah tribe on the south and the Joseph tribes on the north.
translation_verse: Sɔ nɛ a fɔ ɔ je Benyamin bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a we puɔ nya amɛ ji kekleekle nihi nɛ a ha mɛ zugba. A zugba a ngɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ kɛ Yosef wɛtso ɔ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Benjamin's northern border started at the Jordan River and went up the ridge north of Jericho, then on west into the hill country as far as the Beth-Aven Desert.
translation_verse: A huzu nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ je Yordan pa a nya, nɛ e kuɔ kɛ ya gu Yeriko kasa nya, ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ nyɛɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ho bonyoku je ya; nɛ e ya gbe nya ngɛ Betaven zugba kplanaa a nɔ.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth, Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah, Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah, Zelah, Haeleph, Gibeah, Kiriath-Jearim, and Jerusalem, which is also called Jebusite Town. These regions are the tribal lands of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Kɛ je yo ɔ beleku je ɔ, huzu ɔ gba kɛ gu he kpa. E ka e yi si kɛ ya gu leneyi je hluu kɛ ya su Kiriat Baal ngɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ nɔ́ ɔ mi. Kiriat Baal biɛ kpa ji Kiriat Yearim. Bonyoku je huzu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Benjamin's southern border started at the edge of Kiriath-Jearim and went east to the ruins and on to Nephtoah Spring.
translation_verse: Leneyi je huzu ɔ je Kiriat Yearim ma a nya, nɛ e ma e yi si kɛ ho Neftoa pa a nya ya.

english_verse: From there it went to the bottom of the hill at the northern end of Rephaim Valley. The other side of this hill faces Hinnom Valley, which is on the land that slopes south from Jerusalem. The border went down through Hinnom Valley until it reached Enrogel.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ kple si kɛ ho yo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ kuɔ si ya, ngɛ Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ omleyi je. E gu Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi, ngɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ a yoku ɔ leneyi je, kɛ ho Enrogel ya.

english_verse: At Enrogel the border curved north and went to Enshemesh and on east to Geliloth, which is across the valley from Adummim Pass. Then it went down to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Huzu ɔ gba kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya Enshemesh, nɛ e tsa nɔ kɛ ya su Gelilot ngɛ Adumim yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ hanɔ. Jehanɛ e kple si kɛ ya su Bohan tɛ ɔ he. .

english_verse: The border ran along the hillside north of Beth-Arabah, then down into the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Huzu ɔ ya be ngɛ kpongu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ he ɔ we omleyi je, nɛ e kple si kɛ sɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.

english_verse: Inside the valley it went south as far as the northern hillside of Beth-Hoglah. The last section of the border went from there to the northern end of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Huzu ɔ plɛ kɛ ya gu Bet Hogla kasa nya ngɛ omleyi je, nɛ e ya gbe nya ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ kɔ̃tɔ̃ ɔ mi, he nɛ Yordan pa a ya sɛ Ngo wo ɔ mi ngɛ ɔ. Huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The Jordan River itself was Benjamin's eastern border. These were the borders of Benjamin's tribal land, where the clans of Benjamin lived.
translation_verse: Yordan pa a ji huzu ɔ ngɛ beleku je. Huzuhi nɛ bɔle zugba a nɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔ ná kaa a weto ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Simeon was the second tribe chosen to receive land, and the region for its clans was inside Judah's borders.
translation_verse: Sɔ enyɔne ɔ je Simeon wɛtso ɔ, nɛ Simeon bi ɔmɛ ná a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya. A zugba a ya je Yuda wɛtso ɔ nɔ́ ɔ mi.

english_verse: In one region of Simeon's tribal land there were the following
translation_verse: Bet Lebaot, Sharuhen. E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ etɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.

english_verse: In another region, Simeon had the following four towns with their surrounding villages: Enrimmon, Tachan, Ether, and Ashan.
translation_verse: Ekpahi ji Ain, Rimon, Eter, Ashan. E peeɔ ma eywiɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.

english_verse: Simeon's land also included all the other towns and villages as far south as Baalath-Beer, which is also called Ramah of the South.
translation_verse: A kɛ kɔpehi tsuo nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya si Baalat Beer ngɛ leneyi je tɔɔ ɔ piɛ he. Zugba nɛ Simeon bi ɔmɛ ná kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Simeon's tribal land was actually inside Judah's territory. Judah had received too much land for the number of people in its tribe, so part of Judah's land was given to Simeon. Zebulun's Land
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ zugba a kle tsɔ ha mɛ he je ɔ, a po fa ngɔ ha Simeon wɛtso ɔ. Zugba nɛ a ha Zebulun wɛtso ɔ

english_verse: and became the northern border. Then it curved south around Hannathon and went as far west as Iphtahel Valley.
translation_verse: Huzu ɔ lɔgɔ si ngɛ omleyi je kɛ ya Hanaton, nɛ e ya gbe nya ngɛ Iftahel kɔ̃ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Zebulun had twelve towns with their surrounding villages. Some of these were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Jiralah, and Bethlehem.
translation_verse: Mahi nɛ ngɛ a huzu ɔ mi ji Kata, kɛ Nahalal, Shimron, Idala, kɛ Betlehem. E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ a he kɔpehi.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath, Debirath, Kishion, Ebez, Remeth, En-Gannim, Enhaddah, Beth-Pazzez, Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth-Shemesh. Asher's Land
translation_verse: Weto ní nɛ Zebulun wɛtso ɔ ná we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji ma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi. Zugba nɛ a ha Isakar wɛtso ɔ

english_verse: Issachar was the fourth tribe chosen to receive land. The northern border for its clans went from Mount Tabor east to the Jordan River. Their land included the following
translation_verse: Weto ní nɛ Isakar bi ɔmɛ na we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji ma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi. Zugba nɛ a ha Asher wɛtso ɔ

english_verse: then east to Beth-Dagon. On the southeast, Asher shared a border with Zebulun along the Iphtahel Valley. On the eastern side their border ran north to Beth-Emek, went east of Cabul, and then on to Neiel,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e lɔgɔ kɛ ho beleku je ya, kɛ ya su Betdagon, ya be ngɛ Zebulun, kɛ Iftahel kɔ̃ ɔ mi, kɛ gu omleyi je, kɛ ho Betemek, kɛ Neyel ya, nɛ e tsa nɔ ja kɛ ya gu Kabul,

english_verse: Abdon, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, and as far north as the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: Ebron, Rehob, Hamon, kɛ Kana kɛ ya su Sidon tɔɔ.

english_verse: Then it turned west to become the northern border and went to Ramah and the fortress-city of Tyre. Near Tyre it turned toward Hosah and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Weto ní nɛ Asher bi ɔmɛ ná we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji ma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi. Zugba nɛ a ha Naftali wɛtso ɔ

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages, including Mahalab, Achzib, Acco, Aphek, and Rehob. Naphtali's Land
translation_verse: Huzu ɔ ya su Tabor, Shahazuma, Bet Shemesh, kɛ ya pi Yordan pa a. E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ ekpa kɛ a he kɔpehi.

english_verse: The Israelites were still gathered in Shiloh in front of the sacred tent, when Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the family leaders of Israel finished giving out the land to the tribes. The Lord had told the people to give Joshua whatever town he wanted. So Joshua chose Timnath-Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, and the people gave it to him. Joshua went to Timnath-Serah, rebuilt it, and lived there.
translation_verse: Weto ní nɛ osɔfo Eleazar, Nun bi Yoshua, kɛ Israel wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ dla kɛ ha ma a ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. A fɔ sɔ kɛ bi Yawɛ ga womi, nɛ a dla weto ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Shilo kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. Bɔ nɛ a dla zugba a ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: These Safe Towns were set up, so that if Israelites or even foreigners who lived in Israel accidentally killed someone, they could run to one of these towns. There they would be safe until a trial could be held, even if one of the victim's relatives came looking for revenge.
translation_verse: Wesa he mahi nɛ a hla kɛ ha Israel ma a tsuo, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to mɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Ke e ba mi kaa nɔ ko nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi kɛ he e yi wami kɛ je lue yelɔ ɔ dɛ mi. A be nɔ nɛ ya sa we nɛ ɔ gbee, ja a kojo lɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi lolo.

english_verse: One day the Lord told Joshua:
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke

english_verse: When Moses was still alive, I commanded him to tell the Israelites about the Safe Towns. Now you tell them that it is time to set up these towns.
translation_verse: e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hla wesa he mahi nyɛɛ to kaa bɔ nɛ i fa Mose ke e de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ.

english_verse: If a person accidentally kills someone and the victim's relatives say it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of the Safe Towns and be safe from the victim's relatives. The one needing protection will stand at the entrance to the town gate and explain to the town leaders what happened. Then the leaders will bring that person in and provide a place to live in their town.
translation_verse: E tu fo kɛ ya ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi, nɛ e ya da si ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e jaje bɔ nɛ e ba lɛ ha ngɔ tsɔɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ maa ba ma a mi, nɛ a ma ha lɛ he ko nɛ e hi.

english_verse: One of the victim's relatives might come to the town, looking for revenge. But the town leaders must not simply hand over the person accused of murder. After all, the accused and the victim had been neighbors, not enemies.
translation_verse: Ke lue yelɔ ɔ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ kó ngmɛɛ e he kɛ ha lɛ. A baa e yi, ejakaa pi abofu nya nɛ e gbe nɔ ɔ, se mohu e nine nɛ ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: The citizens of that Safe Town must come together and hold a trial. They may decide that the victim was killed accidentally and that the accused is not guilty of murder. Everyone found not guilty must still live in the Safe Town until the high priest dies. Then they can go back to their own towns and their homes that they had to leave behind.
translation_verse: É hi ma nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya su be nɛ a maa kojo lɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi; jehanɛ hu, kɛ ya su be nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ ma gbo. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ ɔ ma nyɛ kpale kɛ ya lɛ nitsɛ e ma a mi, he nɛ e tu fo kɛ je ɔ.”

english_verse: The Israelites decided that the following three towns west of the Jordan River would be Safe Towns: Kedesh in Galilee in Naphtali's hill country, Shechem in Ephraim's hill country, and Kiriath-Arba in Judah's hill country. Kiriath-Arba is now called Hebron.
