translation_verse: “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ye e siwo ɔ nɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ e de to ɔ, i ba ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Israel ngɛ tsaatsɛ David se, nɛ we ɔ he nɛ a ma ja Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ, i po.

english_verse: I've also made a place in the temple for the sacred chest. And in that chest are the two flat stones on which is written the solemn agreement the Lord made with our ancestors when he led them out of Egypt. Solomon Prays at the Temple (
translation_verse: Jehanɛ se hu, i hla he ko ngɔ to ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, he nɛ a kɛ somi daka a maa to. Benɛ Yawɛ jé wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, somi nɛ e kɛ mɛ so ɔ ngɛ daka nɛ ɔ mi.” Salomo fa kue ha Yawɛ (Kronika II,

english_verse: Foreigners will hear about you and your mighty power, and some of them will come to live among your people Israel. If any of them pray toward this temple,
translation_verse: “Jã kɛ̃, ke nubwɔ ko nɛ je ma se lokoo nu o biɛ, kɛ ní nguahi nɛ o pee ha o ma, Israel ɔ, nɛ e ba we nɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ba ja mo, nɛ e sɔle ɔ,

english_verse: and prayed: Lord God of Israel, no other god in heaven or on earth is like you! You never forget the agreement you made with your people, and you are loyal to anyone who faithfully obeys your teachings.
translation_verse: nɛ e sɔle ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu lee, mawu ko mawu ko be hiɔwe, loo zugba nɛ ngɛ kaa mo! Somi nɛ o kɛ o ma a so ɔ, o yeɔ nɔ; nɛ ke a bu mo tue kɛ a tsui tsuo ɔ, o jeɔ o suɔmi nɛ se pui ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: My father David was your servant, and today you have kept every promise you made to him.
translation_verse: Si ko nɛ o wo tsaatsɛ David ɔ, o ye nɔ; nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o de to ɔ ba mi.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you promised my father that someone from his family would always be king of Israel, if they do their best to obey you, just as he did.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, Israel Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ, si nɛ o wo tsaatsɛ benɛ o de lɛ ke ke e binyumu ɔmɛ maa bu mo tue kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ɔ, a maa ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ, ha jamɛ a siwo ɔ hu nɛ ba mi.

english_verse: Please keep this promise you made to your servant David.
translation_verse: Israel Mawu lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ, níhi tsuo nɛ o de tsaatsɛ David ɔ, ha nɛ a ba mi.

english_verse: There's not enough room in all of heaven for you, Lord God. How could you possibly live on earth in this temple I have built?
translation_verse: “Se anɛ mo Mawu, o ma nyɛ maa hi zugba a nɔ niinɛ lo? Mo nɛ hiɔwe, kɛ hiɔwe se lokoo po kpi mo ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ we nɛ i po nɛ ɔ maa kpe mo?

english_verse: This is the temple where you have chosen to be worshiped. Please watch over it day and night and listen when I turn toward it and pray.
translation_verse: We nɛ ɔ, he nɛ o hla ngɔ to kaa a ja mo ngɛ ɔ, moo bu he nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ ke i ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ba sɔle ɔ, o nu.

english_verse: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you. So whenever any of us look toward this temple and pray, answer from your home in heaven and forgive our sins.
translation_verse: Ke o tsɔlɔ, aloo o ma, Israel ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ba kpa pɛɛ ɔ, o nu ngɛ o hi he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o ngɔ pa wɔ.

english_verse: Suppose someone accuses a person of a crime, and the accused has to stand in front of the altar in your temple and say, “I swear I am innocent!”
translation_verse: “Ke a po nɔ ko nya kaa e tɔ e nyɛmi nɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba da o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ we nɛ ɔ mi ke e ka kita nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e pee we yayami ko ɔ,

english_verse: Listen from heaven and decide who is right. Then punish the guilty person and let the innocent one go free.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo bu tue ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ o kojo o tsɔli ɔmɛ. Nɔ nɛ ye fɔ ɔ, gbla e tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ lɛɛ o wo lɛ nguɔ.

english_verse: Suppose your people Israel sin against you, and then an enemy defeats them. If they come to this temple and beg for forgiveness,
translation_verse: “Ke o ma, Israel a he nyɛli ba ye a nɔ ngɛ yayami ko nɛ a pee kɛ si mo he, nɛ a pia a he, nɛ a ba we nɛ ɔ mi ba kpa mo pɛɛ kɛ he si bami ɔ,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven. Forgive them and bring them back to the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: moo bu mɛ tue ngɛ hiɔwe. Ngɔɔ yayami nɛ o ma a pee ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ o kpale mɛ kɛ ba zugba a nɛ o ngɔ kɛ ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu.

english_verse: Suppose your people sin against you, and you punish them by holding back the rain. If they turn toward this temple and pray in your name and stop sinning,
translation_verse: “Ke o tsi hiɔmi nya ngɛ yayami ko nɛ o ma, Israel pee kɛ si mo he, nɛ pee se ɔ, a tsake a tsui nɛ a ba we nɛ ɔ mi ba kpa mo pɛɛ kɛ he si bami ɔ,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and forgive them. The people of Israel are your servants, so teach them to live right. And please send rain on the land you gave them to be theirs forever.
translation_verse: moo bu mɛ tue ngɛ hiɔwe. Ngɔɔ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Israel ma a a he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ. Tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ, ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛ ngɛ o zugba a nɛ o ngɔ kɛ ha o ma a kaa a weto ní kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Sometimes the crops may dry up or rot or be eaten by locusts or grasshoppers, and your people will be starving. Sometimes enemies may surround their towns, or your people will become sick with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: “Ke hwɔ, loo gbenɔ hiɔ, loo tsohi a he hiɔ, loo baalɛ ba zugba a nɔ, aloo ke he nyɛli ba sa o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a yi ngɔ wo a ma amɛ eko mi ɔ, haomi tsuaa haomi, aloo hiɔ tsuaa hiɔ nɛ ji ɔ,

english_verse: You know what is in everyone's heart. So from your home in heaven answer their prayers, according to the way they live and what is in their hearts.
translation_verse: moo nu a pɛɛ kpami ɔ. Moo bu mɛ tue ngɛ o hi he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe; ngɔɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ o ye kɛ bua mɛ. Mo pɛ lɛ o le nɔmlɔ adesa tsui mi. Moo pee nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiami ní ha lɛ,

english_verse: Then your people will worship and obey you for as long as they live in the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a bu mo ligbi abɔ nɛ a ngɛ zugba a nɛ o ngɔ ha wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, sometimes you will order your people to attack their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, and they will pray to you.
translation_verse: “Ke o fa o ma a ke a kɛ a he nyɛli ya hwu, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee ma nɛ ɔ nɛ o hla ngɔ to, kɛ we nɛ ɔ nɛ i po ha mo ɔ, nɛ a fa kue ha mo ɔ,

english_verse: Answer their prayers from heaven and give them victory.
translation_verse: moo bu mɛ tue. Moo nu ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o ha nɛ a ye kunimi.

english_verse: Forgive your people no matter how much they have sinned against you. Make the enemies who defeated them be kind to them.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ o hɛ mi atuã nɛ a tsɔ ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ o ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ nɛ a na mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Remember, they are the people you chose and rescued from Egypt that was like a blazing fire to them.
translation_verse: Mo nitsɛ o ma ji mɛ; mo lɛ o je mɛ kɛ je Egipt, jamɛ a zugba a nɛ a hi mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ dade flɔɔnɔɔ mi lɛ a kɛ mɛ wo ɔ.

english_verse: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you. So listen when any of us pray and cry out for your help.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ Mawu lee, moo hyɛ o ma Israel, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ, nɛ o na mɛ mɔbɔ; be tsuaa be nɛ a maa fa kue ha mo ɔ, moo bu mɛ tue.

english_verse: When you brought our ancestors out of Egypt, you told your servant Moses to say to them, “From all people on earth, the Lord God has chosen you to be his very own.” Solomon Blesses the People
translation_verse: Mo lɛ o hla mɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti, nɛ o kɛ mɛ ba pee mo nitsɛ o ma kaa bɔ nɛ o gu o tsɔlɔ, Mose nɔ de mɛ, benɛ o je wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ.” Salomo gbaa ma a

english_verse: When Solomon finished his prayer at the altar, he was kneeling with his arms lifted toward heaven. He stood up,
translation_verse: Benɛ Salomo fa kue ha Yawɛ gbe nya a, e te da si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi he nɛ e kpla si ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e wo e nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe.

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He has kept his promise and given us peace. Every good thing he promised to his servant Moses has happened.
translation_verse: “A je Yawɛ yi; ejakaa e ha e ma a tue mi jɔmi kaa bɔ nɛ e de to ke e maa pee ɔ. Ní kpakpahi nɛ e wo si kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ, Mose nɔ kaa e maa pee ɔ, e pee mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: The Lord our God was with our ancestors to help them, and I pray that he will be with us and never abandon us.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi si ɔ; e ko si wɔ, nɛ e ko kua wɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord our God will remember my prayer day and night. May he help everyone in Israel each day, in whatever way we need it.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ kai kue nɛ i fa ha lɛ, kɛ pɛɛ nɛ i kpa lɛ nɛ ɔ be tsuaa be. É na e ma, Israel, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ e pee a hiami níhi ha mɛ daa ligbi,

english_verse: Then every nation will know that the Lord is the only true God.
translation_verse: bɔ nɛ pee nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a le kaa Yawɛ pɛ ji Mawu; e se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu.

english_verse: On that day, Solomon dedicated the courtyard in front of the temple and made it acceptable for worship. He offered the sacrifices there because the bronze altar in front of the temple was too small.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Salomo pee kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we kpɛti ɔ klɔuklɔu, nɛ e sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; e ngɔ lohwe ɔmɛ a zɔ ɔ hu kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ. E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ klee we bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Solomon and the huge crowd celebrated the Festival of Shelters at the temple for seven days. There were people from as far away as the Egyptian Gorge in the south and Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Salomo kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ otsi. Nimli babauu nitsɛ ba nyami be nɛ ɔ; a je tsitsaa Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ ya si Egipt huzu ɔ he ngɛ leneyi je.

english_verse: Then on the eighth day, he sent everyone home. They said goodbye and left, very happy, because of all the good things the Lord had done for his servant David and his people Israel.
translation_verse: Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, Salomo ha ma a nane. Mɛ tsuo a je e yi saminya, nɛ a ho a wehi a mi ya kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ pee ha e tsɔlɔ, David, kɛ e ma, Israel ɔ he.

english_verse: I will no longer let my people Israel live in this land I gave them. I will desert this temple where I said I would be worshiped. Then people everywhere will think this nation is only a joke and will make fun of it.
translation_verse: lɛɛ ma je ye ma, Israel kɛ je zugba a nɛ i ha mɛ ɔ nɔ. We nɛ ɔ hu nɛ i pee klɔuklɔu nɛ a ja mi ngɛ mi ɔ, ma je ye nine ngɛ he. Je ma amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ maa wo Israel la, nɛ a maa ye e he fɛu.

english_verse: Solomon did not force the Israelites to do his work. They were his soldiers, officials, leaders, commanders, chariot captains, and chariot drivers. But he did make slaves of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who were living in Israel. translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ Salomo ngɔɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ pee we nyɔguɛ; mɛɛ a tsu ní kaa e ta buli, tsɔli, asafoatsɛmɛ, ta zugba lɛ nyatsɛmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli.

english_verse: Hadad and his wife had a son named Genubath, and the queen let the boy grow up in the palace with her own children.

english_verse: “Solomon and the Israelites are not like their ancestor David. They will not listen to me, obey me, or do what is right. They have turned from me to worship Astarte the goddess of Sidon, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of Ammon.
translation_verse: I ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Salomo kua mi, nɛ e ya ja Astarte, Sidon yo mawu ɔ; Kemosh, Moab mawu ɔ; kɛ Milkom, Amon mawu ɔ. Salomo gbo tue; e pee yayami, nɛ e yi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ David pee ɔ.

english_verse: Then I will give you ten tribes to rule,

english_verse: “You will be king of Israel and will rule every nation you want.

translation_verse: Yeroboam de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Bɔ nɛ níhi ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ke e ba mi kaa ma nɛ ɔ ho ya sã bɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, a yi mi ma plɛ; a maa kpale ya sɔmɔ a nyɔmtsɛ nɛ ji Yuda matsɛ, Rehoboam ekohu, nɛ a maa gbe mi.”
