translation_verse: Gbalɔ nɛ je Betel ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ha waa ho we mi ya nɛ o ya wo o nya mi nɔ́ ko.”

english_verse: The old prophet said, “I'm a prophet too. One of the Lord's angels told me to take you to my house and give you something to eat and drink.” The prophet from Judah did not know that the old prophet was lying,
translation_verse: Gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ nɛ je Betel ɔ de lɛ ke, “Imi hu gbalɔ ji mi kaa mo. Yawɛ fa bɔfo ko ke e ba de mi ke ma ba ngɔ mo kɛ ba we mi nɛ o ba ye ní, nɛ o nu nyu.” Se gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ sisi lɛ.

english_verse: During the meal the Lord gave the old prophet
translation_verse: Benɛ a hii si ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ tu munyu,

english_verse: a message for the prophet from Judah: Listen to the Lord's message. You have disobeyed the Lord your God.
translation_verse: nɛ e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de gbalɔ nɛ je Yuda a ke, “Yawɛ ke ma de mo ke o gbo tue, nɛ o yi mlaa nɛ e wo mo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: He told you not to eat or drink anything here, but you came home and ate with me. And so, when you die, your body won't be buried in your family tomb.
translation_verse: He nɛ Yawɛ de mo ke o ko ya ye ní, nɛ o nu nyu hu ngɛ ɔ, o kpale o se ya ye ní, nɛ o nu nyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o ma gbo, nɛ a be mo pue ngɛ o weku li a yɔkɔ mi.”

english_verse: After the meal the old prophet got a donkey ready,
translation_verse: Benɛ a ye ní ɔ ta a, gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ mia teji ɔ ha gbalɔ nɛ je Yuda a,

english_verse: and the prophet from Judah left. Along the way, a lion attacked and killed him, and the donkey and the lion stood there beside his dead body.
translation_verse: nɛ e kuɔ. Benɛ e ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, e kɛ jata ya kpe, nɛ jata a gbe lɛ. E gbogboe ɔ tlɔ blɔ ɔ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ teji ɔ kɛ jata a daa si ngɛ he.

english_verse: Some people walked by and saw the body with the lion standing there. They ran into Bethel, telling everyone what they had seen.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ ba be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a na gbogboe ɔ ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi nɛ jata a daa si ngɛ he. Nɛ a ho ya sɛɛ ní nɛ ɔ ngɛ Betel, he nɛ gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When the old prophet heard the news, he said, “That must be the prophet from Judah. The Lord warned him, but he disobeyed. So the Lord sent a lion to kill him.”
translation_verse: Benɛ gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ nu sane nɛ ɔ, e de ke, “Gbalɔ ɔ nɛ gbo Yawɛ fami ɔ tue ɔ, lɛ! Lɛɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ je lɛ ngɔ wo jata a dɛ mi, nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ e mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ke e maa pee ɔ.”

english_verse: The old prophet told his sons to saddle his donkey, and when it was ready,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ mia ye teji ɔ ha mi.” A pee ja,

english_verse: he left. He found the body lying on the road, with the donkey and lion standing there. The lion had not eaten the body or attacked the donkey.
translation_verse: nɛ e kuɔ teji ɔ kɛ ho. E ya na gbalɔ kaketsɛ ɔ gbogboe ɔ nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ teji ɔ kɛ jata a daa si ngɛ he kɛ mwɔɔ. Jata a yi nɔ gbogboe ɔ, nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ we teji ɔ mi hulɔ.

english_verse: The old prophet picked up the body, put it on his own donkey, and took it back to Bethel, so he could bury it and mourn for the prophet from Judah.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ wo nɔ gbogboe ɔ ngɔ fɔ teji ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ kpale kɛ ba Betel ba nyɛ ya ha lɛ; nɛ e pu lɛ.

english_verse: He buried the body in his own family tomb and cried for the prophet.
translation_verse: E pu lɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yɔkɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ye lɛ kɔmɔ ke, “Ye nyɛmi, due! Ye nyɛmi, due!”

english_verse: But Jeroboam kept on doing evil things. He appointed men to be priests at the local shrines, even if they were not Levites. In fact, anyone who wanted to be a priest could be one.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa a se ɔ, Matsɛ Yeroboam kpale we kɛ ji e blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ; se mohu e hlaa nihi kɛ jeɔ ma a mi he tsuaa he, nɛ e woɔ mɛ osɔfohi kɛ haa ní tsumi ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e maa ye osɔfo ɔ, kɛkɛ Yeroboam wo lɛ osɔfo.

english_verse: About the same time, Abijah son of Jeroboam got sick.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Matsɛ Yeroboam binyumu Abiya ba nu hiɔ.

english_verse: She got ready and left for Ahijah's house in Shiloh. Ahijah was now old and blind,
translation_verse: Yeroboam yo ɔ pee kaa bɔ nɛ e huno ɔ de lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ho Abiya we ɔ mi ya ngɛ Shilo. Abiya bwɔ, nɛ e hɛngmɛ yu.

english_verse: But when Ahijah heard her walking up to the door, he said: Come in! I know you're Jeroboam's wife—why are you pretending to be someone else? I have some bad news for you.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Abiya nu e nane si pɛmi ngɛ sinya a nya kɛ ma a, e de lɛ ke, “Yeroboam yo, moo ba! Mɛni he je o tsake o he kaa nɔ kpa nɛ ɔ? I ngɛ sane yobu ko nɛ ma de mo.

english_verse: Give your husband this message from the Lord God of Israel: “Jeroboam, you know that I, the Lord, chose you over anyone else to be the leader of my people Israel.
translation_verse: Yaa nɛ o ya de Yeroboam ke bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Imi lɛ i hla mo kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ i wo mo ye ma, Israel nɔ matsɛ.

english_verse: I even took David's kingdom away from his family and gave it to you. But you are not like my servant David. He always obeyed me and did what was right.
translation_verse: I kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ David nina dɛ ngɔ ha mo. Se o be kaa ye tsɔlɔ David. Lɛɛ e nyɛɛ ye se kɛ e tsui tsuo; e ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ e pee ye suɔmi nya ní.

english_verse: “You have made me very angry by rejecting me and making idols out of gold. Jeroboam, you have done more evil things than any king before you.
translation_verse: O pee yayami kulaa pe ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye tsɛ kɛ sɛ o hlami ɔ. O kua mi; O ya pee mawu kpa komɛ, nɛ o puɛ amagahi, nɛ o kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo ye mi mi la.

english_verse: “Because of this, I will destroy your family by killing every man and boy in it, whether slave or free. I will wipe out your family, just as fire burns up trash.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i kɛ haomi maa ba o we ɔ nɔ, nɛ ma gbe nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ we ɔ mi, nyɔguɛ jio, odehe jio. Ma kpata o we ɔ hɛ mi; a maa bɛɛ mɛ kɛ ho kaa a bɛɛɔ na fi.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel will mourn at his funeral. But he will be the last one from Jeroboam's family to receive a proper burial, because he's the only one the Lord God of Israel is pleased with.
translation_verse: Israel ma a tsuo maa nyɛ ya ha lɛ, nɛ a maa pu lɛ. Lɛ pɛ ji Yeroboam we ɔ mi bi nɛ a maa pu lɛ saminya, ejakaa lɛ pɛ ji nɔmlɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ná e he tsui ngɛ Yeroboam we ɔ mi.

english_verse: The Lord will soon choose a new king of Israel, who will destroy Jeroboam's family. And I mean very soon.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa wo matsɛ ko ngɛ Israel, nɛ e ma kpata Yeroboam we ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem, the city where the Lord had chosen to be worshiped. His mother Naamah was from Ammon.
translation_verse: Yeroboam yo ɔ kpale e se kɛ ho Tirza ya. Benɛ e sɛ we ɔ mi pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ jokuɛ ɔ gbo.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel came and mourned at his funeral, just as the Lord's servant Ahijah had said. Jeroboam Dies
translation_verse: Israel ma a nyɛ ya ha lɛ, nɛ a pu lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ, gbalɔ Ahiya nɔ ɔ. Yeroboam gbenɔ

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including the battles he won, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Yeroboam he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, tahi nɛ e hwu, kɛ bɔ nɛ e ye tsɛ ha a, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: The people of Judah disobeyed the Lord and made him even angrier than their ancestors had.
translation_verse: Yuda ma a pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ a pee níhi babauu kɛ wo e mi mi la pe bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pee ɔ po.

english_verse: They also built their own local shrines and stone images of foreign gods, and they set up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Mɛ hu a po piɛhi, nɛ a puɛ amagahi ngɛ ma a mi, ngɛ yokuhi a nɔ, kɛ tsohi nɛ bɔ kusuu a sisi; amaga amɛ ekomɛ daa si ha a yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ashera a.

english_verse: After Rehoboam had been king for four years, King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Rehoboam yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ, Egipt matsɛ, Shishak ba tua Yerusalem,

english_verse: He took everything of value from the temple and the palace, including Solomon's gold shields.
translation_verse: nɛ e muɔ june níhi nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ sika tsu tsɛ̃ihi nɛ Salomo pee ɔ kɛ ho.

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Rehoboam pee akɔblee tsɛ̃ihi kɛ to a nane mi, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo matsɛ we agbo nya buli ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he was finished.
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be nɛ matsɛ ɔ maa ya Yawɛ we ɔ, buli ɔmɛ maa hɛɛ tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a maa kpale mɛ ya to buli ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ mi ekohu.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Rehoboam he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: He and Jeroboam were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Rehoboam kɛ Yeroboam kpɛti jɔɛ; daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ ta nɔ.

english_verse: Rehoboam's mother Naamah was from Ammon, but when Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Abijam then became king.
translation_verse: Rehoboam ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Abiya ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: His own grandmother Maacah had made an idol of Asherah, and Asa took it and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: E na, Maaka po e kpa lɛ manyɛ yemi, ejakaa e puɛ amaga ko nɛ a hiee kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a. Asa ywia amaga nɛ ɔ, nɛ e sã lɛ ngɛ Kidron pa a nya.

english_verse: Abijam became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ, Abiya ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to strengthen the town of Ramah. Then he used these same stones and wood to fortify the town of Geba in the territory of Benjamin and the town of Mizpah.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Matsɛ Asa ha a fiɛ ngɛ Yuda tsuo ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba, konɛ ma a tsuo ba bua kɛ muɔ tɛhi, kɛ tsohi nɛ Baasha kɛ ba ngɛ Rama mae ɔ kɛ ho. Matsɛ Asa ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ po Geba ma a ngɛ Benyamin, kɛ Mizpa ma a hulɔ.

english_verse: Abijam did not truly obey the Lord his God as his ancestor David had done. Instead, he was sinful just like his father Rehoboam.
translation_verse: E ya wo e tsɛ nane, nɛ e pee yayami nɛ e tsɛ pee ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. E ya nyɛɛ we Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ se kaa bɔ nɛ e nɛnɛkasowa David pee ɔ.

english_verse: David had always obeyed the Lord's commands by doing right, except in the case of Uriah. And since Abijam was David's great-grandson, the Lord kept Jerusalem safe and let Abijam have a son who would be the next king.
translation_verse: Yawɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa David wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ, e pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní. Mlaa amɛ nɛ Yawɛ wo lɛ ɔ, e tɔ we ekoeko pe sane ɔ nɛ ya ba ngɛ e kɛ Hit no Uria a kpɛti ɔ pɛ.

english_verse: The war that had broken out between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continued during the time that Abijam was king. Everything else Abijam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Abiya he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Abijam died and was buried in Jerusalem, and his son Asa became king. King Asa of Judah (
translation_verse: Abiya ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Asa ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se. Yuda matsɛ, Asa (Kronika II,

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: E ya ngɔ níhi nɛ e tsɛ pee klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, kɛ sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ níhi; nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e pee mɛ klɔuklɔu kɛ ba ma Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord, as David had done.
translation_verse: Asa pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní kaa bɔ nɛ e nɛ, David pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Asa became king of Judah in the twentieth year of Jeroboam's rule in Israel,
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam yi nɔ jeha nyingmi enyɔ ɔ, Asa ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.

english_verse: He forced the prostitutes at the shrines to leave the country, and he got rid of the idols his ancestors had made.
translation_verse: E fie nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha ajuama bɔmi ngɛ jami kusumi ko nya a kɛ je zugba a nɔ, nɛ e je amaga amɛ tsuo nɛ e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ puɛ ɔ.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was completely faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa Asa puɛ we wɔ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo lɛɛ, se e nyɛɛ Yawɛ se kɛ pi si e wami be ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: One time, Baasha invaded Judah and captured the town of Ramah. He started making the town stronger, so he could put troops there to stop people from going in and out of Judah.
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Baasha ba tua Yuda, nɛ e dla po Rama, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó nyɛ nɛ e je Israel kɛ ya Yuda, loo Yuda kɛ ba Israel.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. He gave it to some of his officials and sent them to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Matsɛ Asa ya muɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu tsuo nɛ piɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ, nɛ e tsɔ e tsɔli ɔmɛ ekomɛ Damasko, nɛ e kɛ ní ɔmɛ ya ha Siria matsɛ, Benhadad, Hezio binyumu Tabrimon bi ɔ. Sɛ gbi nɛ piɛ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: “Our fathers signed a peace treaty. Why don't we do the same thing? This silver and gold is a present for you. So, would you please break your treaty with Baasha and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: “Ha nɛ i kɛ mo waa so kaa bɔ nɛ tsaatsɛ kɛ o tsɛ so ɔ. I ngɛ mo sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu nike ní manee. Yaa nɛ o kɛ Israel matsɛ, Baasha ya po somi nɛ o kɛ lɛ so ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e je e ta buli ɔmɛ kɛ je ye zugba a nɔ kɛ ho.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, and Abel-Bethmaacah, and the territories of Chinneroth and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Benhadad kplɛɛ Asa munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tsɔ e tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya tua Israel ma amɛ. A ngɔ Iyon, Dan, Abel Bet Maaka, Kinerot, kɛ Naftali zugba amɛ tsuo.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he left Ramah and went back to Tirzah.
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Baasha nu sane nɛ ba a, e jɔɔ Rama ma a dlami, nɛ e je kɛ ho Tirza ya.

english_verse: Everything else Asa did while he was king, including his victories and the towns he rebuilt, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. When he got older, he had a foot disease.
translation_verse: Asa he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ; kã nɛ e pee, kɛ mahi nɛ e po ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi. Se e bwɔbwɔɛ si ɔ, e nu nane hiɔ.

english_verse: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Asa's second year as king of Judah, and he ruled two years.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, Matsɛ Yeroboam binyumu Nadab ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ. E ye matsɛ jeha enyɔ.

english_verse: Nadab disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of his father, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: E ya wo e tsɛ nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ e ha Israel hu pee yayami.

english_verse: Baasha son of Ahijah was from the tribe of Issachar, and he made plans to kill Nadab. When Nadab and his army went to attack the town of Gibbethon in Philistia, Baasha killed Nadab there. So in the third year of Asa's rule, Baasha became king of Israel.
translation_verse: Sane nɛ ɔ ba ngɛ Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi; nɛ Baasha ba ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel ngɛ Nadab se.

english_verse: The Lord's prophet Ahijah had earlier said, “Not one man or boy in Jeroboam's family will be left alive.” And, as soon as Baasha became king, he killed everyone in Jeroboam's family,
translation_verse: Benɛ Baasha bɔni matsɛ yemi pɛ nɛ e gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Yeroboam we ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ, gbalɔ Ahiya, Shilo no ɔ nɔ ɔ. A gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Yeroboam we ɔ mi; nɔ kake po piɛ.

english_verse: because Jeroboam had made the Lord God of Israel angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yeroboam wo Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ mi mi la; Yeroboam pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, e ha nɛ Israel hu pee yayami.

english_verse: Everything else Nadab did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Nadab he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: King Asa of Judah and King Baasha of Israel were always at war. King Baasha of Israel
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Asa, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Baasha a kpɛti jɔɛ a wami be ɔ tsuo; daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ ta nɔ. Israel matsɛ, Baasha

english_verse: Baasha son of Ahijah became king of Israel in Asa's third year as king of Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, Ahiya binyumu Baasha ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo nɔ. E hi Tirza kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ.

english_verse: Baasha also disobeyed the Lord by acting like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: E ya wo e nɛ Yeroboam nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ e ha Israel hu pee yayami.

english_verse: The Lord sent Jehu son of Hanani to say to Baasha:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ gbalɔ Yehu, Hanani binyumu ɔ tu munyu, nɛ e kɛ sɛ gbi ha lɛ nɛ e ya de Baasha ke,

english_verse: Nobody knew who you were until I, the Lord, chose you to be the leader of my people Israel. And now you're acting exactly like Jeroboam by causing the Israelites to sin. What you've done has made me so angry
translation_verse: “Jinɛ pi nɔ ko kulaa ji mo, nɛ i wo o nɔ, nɛ i pee mo ye ma, Israel nyatsɛ. Se o ya wo Yeroboam nane, nɛ o ha ye ma, Israel pee yayami nɛ a kɛ wo ye mi mi la.

english_verse: that I will destroy you and your family, just as I did the family of Jeroboam.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma kpata o kɛ o we ɔ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ɔ.

english_verse: Dogs will eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.
translation_verse: Ke o he nɔ ko gbo ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, gbehi maa ye lɛ; nɛ ke o he nɔ ko gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ maa ye lɛ.”

english_verse: Baasha made the Lord very angry, and that's why the Lord gave Jehu this message for Baasha and his family. Baasha constantly disobeyed the Lord by following Jeroboam's sinful example—but even worse, he killed everyone in Jeroboam's family! Everything else Baasha did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah became king. King Elah of Israel
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ gu gbalɔ Yehu, Hanani binyumu ɔ nɔ ya ha Baasha kɛ e we ɔ, ejakaa Baasha pee yayami kɛ si lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ. Pi yayami nɛ Baasha pee kɛ si Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Yeroboam hu pee be ko ɔ kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la a, gbemi nɛ Baasha gbe Yeroboam we mi bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ hu piɛ he. Israel matsɛ, Ela

english_verse: Omri did more evil things than any king before him.
translation_verse: Omri pee yayami babauu kɛ si Yawɛ pe ni nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: As soon as Zimri became king, he killed everyone in Baasha's family. Not one man or boy in his family was left alive—even his close friends were killed.
translation_verse: Benɛ Zimri bɔni matsɛ yemi pɛ nɛ e gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Baasha we ɔ mi; nyumu kake too po píɛ. E gbe Baasha weku li, kɛ e huɛmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Baasha's family was completely wiped out, just as the Lord's prophet Jehu had warned.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to kɛ gu gbalɔ Yehu nɔ ɔ, Zimri kpata Baasha we ɔ tsuo hɛ mi.

english_verse: Baasha and Elah sinned and caused the Israelites to sin, and they made the Lord angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Baasha, kɛ e binyumu Ela pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. A ha nɛ Israel ya ja amagahi, nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ mi mi la.

english_verse: Everything else Elah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Zimri of Israel
translation_verse: Ela he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi. Israel matsɛ, Zimri

english_verse: Zimri became king of Israel in Asa's twenty-seventh year as king of Judah, but he ruled only seven days from Tirzah. Israel's army was camped near Gibbethon in Philistia under the command of Omri. The soldiers heard that Zimri had killed Elah, and they made Omri their king that same day.
translation_verse: nɛ benɛ a nu kaa Zimri so matsɛ ɔ yi nɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ ɔ, Israel tsuo wo Omri, nɛ ji tabo ɔ nyatsɛ ɔ matsɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ngɛ a sito he ɔ.

english_verse: At once, Omri and his army marched to Tirzah and attacked.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Omri kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ je Gibeton kɛ ho nɛ a ya sa Tirza yi.

english_verse: When Zimri saw that the town was captured, he ran into the strongest part of the palace and killed himself by setting it on fire.
translation_verse: Benɛ Zimri na kaa a ngɔ ma a, e ho ya sɛ mɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi. E mɛ matsɛ we ɔ he la, nɛ la a sã lɛ nɛ e gbo.

english_verse: Everything else Zimri did while he was king, including his rebellion against Elah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Omri of Israel
translation_verse: Zimri he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, kɛ Ela yi nɔ nɛ e so ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi. Israel matsɛ, Omri

english_verse: After Zimri died, some of the Israelites wanted Tibni son of Ginath to be king, but others wanted Omri.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Israel ma a mi ba gba enyɔ; fa ya nyɛɛ Ginat binyumu Tibni se, nɛ a hla kaa a maa wo lɛ matsɛ; nɛ fa hu ya nyɛɛ Omri se.

english_verse: in the thirty-first year of Asa's rule in Judah. Omri ruled Israel for twelve years. The first six years he ruled from Tirzah,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ kake ɔ, Omri ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel. E ye matsɛ ɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ; e hi Tirza kɛ ye matsɛ jeha ekpa.

english_verse: He acted just like Jeroboam and made the Lord God of Israel angry by causing the Israelites to sin and to worship idols.
translation_verse: E ya wo Nebat binyumu Yeroboam nane, nɛ e pee yayami. E ja amaga, nɛ e ha Israel hu ya pee yayami nɛ ɔ; nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi wo Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ mi mi la.

english_verse: Everything else Omri did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Omri he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, kɛ kã nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Omri died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Ahab became king. King Ahab of Israel
translation_verse: Omri ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Samaria, nɛ e binyumu Ahab ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se. Israel matsɛ, Ahab

english_verse: Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Asa's rule in Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ, Omri binyumu Ahab ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ. E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.

english_verse: Ahab did more things to disobey the Lord than any king before him.
translation_verse: E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ pe ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: He acted just like Jeroboam. Even worse, he married Jezebel the daughter of King Ethbaal of Sidon and started worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: E pi ha Ahab kaa e maa pee yayami kaa bɔ nɛ Yeroboam pee ɔ kɛkɛ, se e ya nɔ pee yayami kɛ be nɔ. E ya ngɔ Sidon matsɛ, Etbaal biyo Yezebel, nɛ e ya ja Baal.

english_verse: Ahab built an altar and temple for Baal in Samaria
translation_verse: E po piɛ ha Baal ngɛ Samaria, nɛ e puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɔ ma mi.

english_verse: and set up a sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. Ahab did more to make the Lord God of Israel angry than any king of Israel before him.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e puɛ amaga kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a. Ahab pee yayami kɛ wo Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ mi mi la pe Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: While Ahab was king, a man from Bethel named Hiel rebuilt the town of Jericho. But while Hiel was laying the foundation for the town wall, his oldest son Abiram died. And while he was finishing the gates, his youngest son Segub died. This happened just as the Lord had told Joshua to say many years ago.
translation_verse: E yi nɔ ɔ, Hiel nɛ je Betel ɔ ya kpale ma Yeriko ma a ekohu. Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ gu Nun binyumu Yoshua nɔ de to ɔ, benɛ Hiel to Yeriko ma a sisi pɛ nɛ e bitɛte nɛ a tsɛɛ Abiram ɔ gbo, nɛ benɛ e ma agbo ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ e sekpɛ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Segub ɔ hu gbo.

english_verse: Elijah was a prophet from Tishbe in Gilead. One day he went to King Ahab and said, “I'm a servant of the living Lord, the God of Israel. And I swear in his name that it won't rain until I say so. There won't even be any dew on the ground.”
translation_verse: Gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Eliya, nɛ je Tishbe ngɛ Gilead ɔ de Matsɛ Ahab ke, “Ina Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ i jaa lɛ ɔ kaa bɔ́, aloo hiɔmi be nɛe ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha enyɔ, loo etɛ kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma tsɔɔ.”

english_verse: Later, the Lord said to Elijah,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Eliya ke,

english_verse: “Leave and go across the Jordan River so you can hide near Cherith Creek.
translation_verse: “Jee hiɛ ɔ nɛ o gu beleku blɔ, nɛ o ya laa o he ngɛ Kerit pa a nya ngɛ Yordan beleku je.

english_verse: You can drink water from the creek, and eat the food I've told the ravens to bring you.”
translation_verse: O maa nu pa a mi nyu, nɛ niye ní nɛ kuakualabitehi kɛ maa ba a, o maa ye; ejakaa i fa mɛ ke a ngɔ niye ní ba ha mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Elijah obeyed the Lord and went to live near Cherith Creek.
translation_verse: Eliya bu Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue, nɛ e ho ya hi Kerit pa a nya.

english_verse: Ravens brought him bread and meat twice a day, and he drank water from the creek.
translation_verse: E nuɔ pa a mi nyu ɔ, nɛ kuakualabitehi ba haa lɛ abolo, kɛ lo daa mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ.

english_verse: But after a while, it dried up because there was no rain. Elijah Helps a Widow in Zarephath
translation_verse: Be bɔɔ se ɔ, nyu ɔ ta pa a mi, ejakaa hiɔmi kpa nɛmi. Eliya kɛ yalɔyo ɔ nɛ je Zarefat ɔ

english_verse: The Lord told Elijah,
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Yawɛ de Eliya ke,

english_verse: “Go to the town of Zarephath in Sidon and live there. I've told a widow in that town to give you food.”
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ lɛɛ, yaa Zarefat nɛ ngɛ Sidon kasa nya a, nɛ o ya hi lejɛ ɔ. I fa yalɔyo ko nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke e hyɛ o nɔ.”

english_verse: When Elijah came near the town gate of Zarephath, he saw a widow gathering sticks for a fire. “Would you please bring me a cup of water?” he asked.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliya pue nɔ kɛ ho Zarefat ya, nɛ benɛ e ya su ma a we agbo ɔ nya a, e na yalɔyo ko nɛ ngɛ lɛ́ nya buae. Eliya de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, yaa yɛ nyu bɔɔ ba ha mi nɛ ma nu.”

english_verse: The widow answered, “In the name of the living Lord your God, I swear that I don't have any bread. All I have is a handful of flour and a little olive oil. I'm on my way home now with these few sticks to cook what I have for my son and me. After that, we will starve to death.”
translation_verse: Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I na Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kaa i be abolo. Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pɛ ji mamu dɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ buɛ mi, kɛ nu bɔbɔyoo ko ngɛ tɔ mi. I ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ma ba bua lɛ́ bɔɔ ko nya kɛ ya we mi, nɛ ma kɛ ya sã abolo, nɛ i kɛ ye binyumu waa ye. Lɔ ɔ se lɛɛ wa ma gbo kɛ hwɔ.”

english_verse: Elijah said, “Everything will be fine. Do what you said. Go home and fix something for you and your son. But first, please make a small piece of bread and bring it to me.
translation_verse: Se Eliya de lɛ ke, “Koo ye tsui! Yaa nɛ o ya pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ. Ngɔɔ mamu ɔ eko kɛ pee abolo nɛ o ngɔ kɛ ba ha mi kekle; lɔ ɔ se loko o pee o kɛ o binyumu ɔ nyɛ nɔ́.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has promised that your jar of flour won't run out and your bottle of oil won't dry up before he sends rain for the crops.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mamu ɔ be buɛ ɔ mi tae, nɛ nu ɔ hu be tɔ ɔ mi tae kɛ yaa si ligbi ɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, ma ha nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The widow went home and did exactly what Elijah had told her. She and Elijah and her family had enough food for a long time.
translation_verse: Yalɔyo ɔ ya pee kaa bɔ nɛ Eliya de lɛ ɔ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a ye ní nɛ a tɔ ligbi babauu.

english_verse: The Lord kept the promise that his prophet Elijah had made, and she did not run out of flour or oil. Elijah Brings a Boy Back to Life
translation_verse: Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to kɛ gu Eliya nɔ ɔ, mamu ɔ tɛ buɛ ɔ mi, nɛ nu ɔ hu tɛ tɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Several days later, the son of the woman who owned the house got sick, and he kept getting worse, until finally he died.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, yalɔyo ɔ binyumu ɔ ba nu hiɔ wawɛɛ kɛ ya si e gbo.

english_verse: The woman shouted at Elijah, “What have I done to you? I thought you were God's prophet. Did you come here to cause the death of my son as a reminder that I've sinned against God?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ de Eliya ke, “Mawu nɔmlɔ, mɛni he je o pee mi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ? Pe o ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ba kai Mawu ye he yayami ɔmɛ, konɛ ye binyumu ɔ nɛ gbo lo?”

english_verse: “Bring me your son,” Elijah said. Then he took the boy from her arms and carried him upstairs to the room where he was staying. Elijah laid the boy on his bed
translation_verse: Eliya de lɛ ke, “Wo o bi ɔ kɛ ba!” E he jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ ngɛ yo ɔ dɛ, nɛ e wo lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe tsu ɔ mi he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ ya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya fɔ lɛ nitsɛ e sa a nɔ.

english_verse: and prayed, “Lord God, why did you do such a terrible thing to this woman? She's letting me stay here, and now you've let her son die.”
translation_verse: Eliya fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, ye Mawu lee! Mɛni he je nɛ o kɛ yalɔyo nɛ i ba to lɛ nɛ ɔ ye sane yaya kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je nɛ o gbe e binyumu ɔ?”

english_verse: The Lord answered Elijah's prayer, and the boy started breathing again.
translation_verse: Yawɛ bu Eliya kue fami ɔ tue; jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ bɔni mumi womi ekohu, nɛ e hɛ tsɛ̃.

english_verse: Elijah picked him up and carried him downstairs. He gave the boy to his mother and said, “Look, your son is alive.”
translation_verse: Eliya wo jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ kɛ kple si, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya ha e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, o binyumu ɔ yi na wami!”

english_verse: “You are God's prophet!” the woman replied. “Now I know that you really do speak for the Lord.”
translation_verse: Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Kpaako loko i na kaa Mawu nɔmlɔ ji mo, nɛ Yawɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ guɔ o nɔ niinɛ!”

english_verse: At that time Obadiah was in charge of Ahab's palace, but he faithfully worshiped the Lord. In fact, when Jezebel was trying to kill the Lord's prophets, Obadiah hid
translation_verse: Benɛ Yezebel ngɛ Yawɛ gbali ɔmɛ gbee ɔ, Obadia ngɔ gbali lafa ngɔ laa ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi, nɛ e ha mɛ niye ní kɛ nyu; gbali nyingmi enuɔ ngɛ kuu kake mi, nɛ nyingmi enuɔ hu ngɛ kuu kake mi).

english_verse: and said, “We have to find something for our horses and mules to eat. If we don't, we will have to kill them. Let's look around every creek and spring in the country for some grass.
translation_verse: Ahab de Obadia ke, “Ha nɛ wa ya kpa zugba a nɔ nɛ waa hyɛ kaa wa ma na nga ngɛ pa amɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi ba ha wa okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ teji okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kpe, konɛ wa ko ba gbe wa lohwe ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: You go one way, and I'll go the other.” Then they left in separate directions.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a dla zugba a he nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma ya kpa; Ahab gu he kake, nɛ Obadia hu gu he kake.

english_verse: As Obadiah was walking along, he met Elijah. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down, and asked, “Elijah, is it really you?”
translation_verse: Benɛ Obadia ngɛ e blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, e kɛ Eliya ya kpe tlukaa. Obadia le Eliya mi tso, nɛ e kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e bi ke, “Anɛ mo tutuutu lo, ye nyɔmtsɛ Eliya?”

english_verse: Obadiah replied: King Ahab would kill me if I told him that. And I haven't even done anything wrong.
translation_verse: Obadia he nɔ ke, “Mɛni yayami i pee loko o ngɛ hlae nɛ o ngɔ mi kɛ wo Matsɛ Ahab dɛ mi nɛ e gbe mi ɔ?

english_verse: I swear to you in the name of the living Lord your God that the king has looked everywhere for you. He sent people to look in every country, and when they couldn't find you, he made the leader of each country swear that you were not in that country.
translation_verse: I na Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kaa e píɛ ma ko, loo zugba ko nɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɔɛ kɛ yɛ nɛ a ya hla mo. Be tsuaa be nɛ matsɛ, aloo zugba a nɔ yelɔ ngɛ he nɛ a tsɔ kɛ ya a ha a nu sisi kaa o be lejɛ ɔ, Ahab ha nɛ jamɛ a matsɛ ɔ, aloo zugba a nɔ yelɔ ɔ ka kita ke o be lejɛ ɔ niinɛ.

english_verse: Do you really want me to tell him you're here?
translation_verse: Nɛ moo o deɔ mi ke ma ya nɛ ma ya de ye nyɔmtsɛ Ahab ke o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!

english_verse: What if the Lord's Spirit takes you away as soon as I leave? When Ahab comes to get you, he won't find you. Then he will surely kill me. I have worshiped the Lord since I was a boy.
translation_verse: Ke i je o ngɔ kɛ ho piɔ ɔ, Yawɛ mumi ɔ ma ba ngɔ mo kɛ ho he ko ya nɛ i li. Nɛ e maa ba mi kaa ke i ya de Ahab ke o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ e ba, nɛ e ba nɛ mo ɔ, e maa gbe mi. Mo kai kaa kɛ je ye jokuɛ mi tɔɔ ɔ, i yee Yawɛ gbeye.

english_verse: Elijah said, “I'm a servant of the living Lord All-Powerful, and I swear in his name that I will meet with Ahab today.”
translation_verse: Eliya he nɔ ke, “I na Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɛ i sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ, kaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ ye he kɛ tsɔɔ matsɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Obadiah left and told Ahab where to find Elijah. Ahab went to meet Elijah,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Obadia ho nɛ e ya bɔ Ahab amaniɛ, nɛ Ahab hu ho ya na Eliya.

english_verse: and when he saw him, Ahab shouted, “There you are, the biggest troublemaker in Israel!”
translation_verse: Benɛ Ahab na lɛ ɔ, e bi ke, “Mo, Israel nya doolɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Elijah answered: You're the troublemaker—not me! You and your family have disobeyed the Lord's commands by worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Eliya he nɔ ke, “O kɛ o tsɛ we ɔ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ Israel haoe, se pi imi. Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tɔ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya ja Baalhi.

english_verse: Ahab got everyone together, then they went to meet Elijah on Mount Carmel.
translation_verse: Ahab tsɔ ya kpee Israel ma a, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Karmel yo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Elijah stood in front of them and said, “How much longer will you try to have things both ways? If the Lord is God, worship him! But if Baal is God, worship him!” The people did not say a word.
translation_verse: Eliya hɛ lɛ kɛ su ma a he, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ yaa si mɛni be loko nyɛ maa pee nyɛ juɛmi ngɛ nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a he? Ke Yawɛ ji Mawu ɔ, nyɛ ja lɛ; ke Baal ji Mawu ɔ, nyɛ ja lɛ.” Se ma a ha we lɛ heto.

english_verse: Bring us two bulls. Baal's prophets can take one of them, kill it, and cut it into pieces. Then they can put the meat on the wood without lighting the fire. I will do the same thing with the other bull, and I won't light a fire under it either.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ a ba ha wɔ na ku enyɔ. Baal gbali ɔmɛ nɛ a hla kake ha a he nɛ a gbe. A poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ a to ngɔ pue lɛ́ nɔ, se a ko wo sisi la. Imi hu ma ngɔ na ku kake ɔ, nɛ ma pee ja nɔuu.

english_verse: The prophets of Baal will pray to their god, and I will pray to the Lord. The one who answers by starting the fire is God. “That's a good idea,” everyone agreed.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Baal gbali ɔmɛ nɛ a fa kue ha a mawu ɔ, konɛ imi hu ma fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ mawu nɛ ma ha la maa ba a, lɛ ji Mawu.” Ma a tsuo he nɔ ke, “Saminya!”

english_verse: Elijah said to Baal's prophets, “There are more of you, so you go first. Pick out a bull and get it ready, but don't light the fire. Then pray to your god.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Eliya de Baal gbali ɔmɛ ke, “Akɛnɛ nyɛ he hiɛ he je ɔ, nyɛ kekle nyɛɛ hla na ku ɔ kake nyɛɛ gbe, nɛ nyɛɛ poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ nyɛɛ to ngɔ pue lɛ́ nɔ. Nyɛɛ fa kue ha nyɛ mawu ɔ, se nyɛ ko wo sisi la.”

english_verse: They chose their bull, then they got it ready and prayed to Baal all morning, asking him to start the fire. They danced around the altar and shouted, “Answer us, Baal!” But there was no answer.
translation_verse: A nu na ku ɔ nɛ a ha mɛ ɔ, nɛ a pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Eliya de mɛ ɔ; a fa kue ha Baal kɛ je mɔtu kɛ ya si piani. A kpa huhui ke, “Baal lee, moo bu wɔ tue oo!” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a ngɛ hlue kɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a puɛ ɔ bɔlee. Se nɔ ko he we nɔ.

english_verse: At noon, Elijah began making fun of them. “Pray louder!” he said. “Baal must be a god. Maybe he's daydreaming or using the toilet or traveling somewhere. Or maybe he's asleep, and you have to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Piani ɔ, Eliya ye a he fɛu nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ kpa wawɛɛ, ejakaa mawu ji lɛ! Eko piɔ, e ngɛ e yi mi susue, aloo e te si bɔɔ, aloo e hia blɔ, aloo be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e hwɔ mahe, konɛ nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ!”

english_verse: The prophets kept shouting louder and louder, and they cut themselves with swords and knives until they were bleeding. This was the way they worshiped,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Baal gbali ɔmɛ kpa huhui wawɛɛ pe kekle ɔ. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a kusumi ngɛ ɔ, a ngɔ ha kɛ klaate kɛ poo a he kɛ ya si muɔ bɔni bemi.

english_verse: and they kept it up until time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no answer of any kind.
translation_verse: A hɛɛ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ munyu tumi basabasa hluu kɛ ya si pu plɛplɛ; se heto ko bɛ, nɛ gbi ko hu pɛ́.

english_verse: Then he used twelve stones to build an altar in honor of the Lord. Each stone stood for one of the tribes of Israel, which was the name the Lord had given to their ancestor Jacob. Elijah dug a ditch around the altar, large enough to hold about
translation_verse: E kɛ tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ dla puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ. E tsua muɔ kɛ bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, nɛ e mi kuɔ bɔ nɛ nyu lita nyɔnyma kɛ eywiɛ, loo nɔ maa ya mi.

english_verse: He placed the wood on the altar, then they cut the bull into pieces and laid the meat on the wood. He told the people, “Fill four large jars with water and pour it over the meat and the wood.” After they did this,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e to lɛ́ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ e poo na ku ɔ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ e to ngɔ pue lɛ́ ɔ nɔ. Nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ ya yɛ nyu buɛ eywiɛ ba pue sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ lɛ́ ɔ nɔ.” A pee ja,

english_verse: he told them to do it two more times. They did exactly as he said
translation_verse: nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ pee ja ekohu si enyɔne”, nɛ a pee ja. E kpale de ke, “Nyɛɛ pee ja ekohu si etɛne”; nɛ a pee.

english_verse: until finally, the water ran down the altar and filled the ditch.
translation_verse: Nyu ɔ nyɛɛ kɛ bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ ya pue muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ muɔ ɔ hyi.

english_verse: When it was time for the evening sacrifice, Elijah prayed: Our Lord, you are the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel. Now, prove that you are the God of this nation, and that I, your servant, have done this at your command.
translation_verse: Gbɔkuɛ bɔ sami be ɔ, gbalɔ Eliya hɛ lɛ kɛ ba bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e sɔle ke, “Yawɛ, Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu lee, ha nɛ a le mwɔnɛ ɔ kaa mo ji Israel Mawu, nɛ o tsɔlɔ ji mi, nɛ i pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ o fami nya.

english_verse: Please answer me, so these people will know that you are the Lord God, and that you will turn their hearts back to you.
translation_verse: Moo bu mi tue, Yawɛ; moo bu mi tue, konɛ ma nɛ ɔ nɛ ná nɛ a le kaa mo, Yawɛ ji Mawu, nɛ o kpale ngɔ mɛ kɛ ma o ngɔ ekohu.”

english_verse: The Lord immediately sent fire, and it burned up the sacrifice, the wood, and the stones. It scorched the ground everywhere around the altar and dried up every drop of water in the ditch.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ha la je hiɔwe ba sã sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ lɛ́ ɔ, kɛ tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ tabo zu ɔ, nɛ e mii nyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what had happened, they all bowed down and shouted, “The Lord is God! The Lord is God!”
translation_verse: Benɛ ma a tsuo na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ a de ke, “Yawɛ ji Mawu! Yawɛ ji Mawu!”

english_verse: Just then, Elijah said, “Grab the prophets of Baal! Don't let any of them get away.” So the people captured the prophets and took them to Kishon River, where Elijah killed every one of them. It Starts To Rain
translation_verse: Eliya fa ke, “Nyɛɛ nuu Baal gbali ɔmɛ; nyɛ ko ha nɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu nɛ tu fo!” Ma a nuu mɛ tsuo, nɛ Eliya nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ kple yoku ɔ kɛ ho Kishon pa a nya ya, nɛ e ya gbe mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyu hwɔ ɔ se po

english_verse: Elijah told Ahab, “Get something to eat and drink. I hear a heavy rain coming.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Eliya de Matsɛ Ahab ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ, yaa nɛ o ya ye ní nɛ o nu ní, ejakaa i nu nɛ hiɔmi ngɛ sie kɛ ma.”

english_verse: Ahab left, but Elijah climbed back to the top of Mount Carmel. Then he stooped down with his face almost to the ground
translation_verse: Benɛ Ahab ho nɛ́ e ya ye ní ɔ, Eliya kuɔ Karmel yo ɔ kɛ ho e yi mi ya ya kpla si ngɛ zugba, nɛ e kɛ e yi wo e nakutso kpɛ.

english_verse: and said to his servant, “Look toward the sea.” The servant left. And when he came back, he said, “I looked, but I didn't see anything.” Elijah told him to look seven more times.
translation_verse: E de e tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya hyɛ wo mi blɔ ha.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ ya, nɛ e kpale ba de ke, “I nɛ nɔ́ ko”. Eliya de tsɔlɔ ɔ si kpaago sɔuu ke e ya nɛ e ya hyɛ.

english_verse: After the seventh time the servant replied, “I see a small cloud coming this way. But it's no bigger than a fist.” Elijah told him, “Tell Ahab to get his chariot ready and start home now. Otherwise, the rain will stop him.”
translation_verse: Benɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ya hyɛ si kpaagone ɔ, e ba ba de Eliya ke, “I na bɔku nyafii kaa nɔmlɔ nine nɛ te si kɛ je wo ɔ mi kɛ ma.” Eliya fa e tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Yaa Matsɛ Ahab ngɔ nɛ o ya de lɛ ke e sɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya esɔ; ke pi ja a, hiɔmi ɔ maa tsi e nya.”

english_verse: A few minutes later, it got very cloudy and windy, and rain started pouring down. So Elijah wrapped his coat around himself, and the Lord gave him strength to run all the way to Jezreel. Ahab followed in his chariot.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha Eliya he wami; e fi e tade ɔ ngɔ wo e mlɛ mi, nɛ e gbɔ fo kɛ ya be Ahab he kɛ ho Yezreel ya tɔɔ.

english_verse: Ahab told his wife Jezebel what Elijah had done and that he had killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Ahab ya bɔ e yo Yezebel níhi tsuo nɛ Eliya pee ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e gbe Baal gbali ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: She sent a message to Elijah: “You killed my prophets. Now I'm going to kill you! I pray that the gods will punish me even more severely if I don't do it by this time tomorrow.”
translation_verse: Yezebel tsɔ ya de Eliya ke, “Hwɔɔ be nɛ ɔ mi ke i pee we mo kaa bɔ nɛ o pee ye gbali ɔmɛ fii, lɛɛ mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a fia mi nɔ́ nɛ a gbe.”

english_verse: Elijah was afraid when he got her message, and he ran to the town of Beersheba in Judah. He left his servant there,
translation_verse: Eliya tsui po, nɛ e kɛ gbenɔ kɛ kã tu fo kɛ ho Beersheba ya ngɛ Yuda. E kɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ ho. E ya si e tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: then walked another whole day into the desert. Finally, he came to a large bush and sat down in its shade. He begged the Lord, “I've had enough. Just let me die! I'm no better off than my ancestors.”
translation_verse: Se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e nyɛɛ ligbi mluku kake kɛ ya nga a nɔ, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ tso ko sisi, nɛ e ná nɛ e gbo. E sɔle ke, “Yawɛ, e hiɛ; moo gbe mi jehanɛ. E hi kaa ma gbo mohu; ejakaa ye nɛmɛ nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ, i hí pi mɛ.”

english_verse: Then he lay down in the shade and fell asleep. Suddenly an angel woke him up and said, “Get up and eat.”
translation_verse: Eliya hwɔ si ngɛ tso ɔ sisi, nɛ e hwɔ mahe. Tlukaa a, hiɔwe bɔfo ko ba ta e he, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Wlua mo nɛ o ye ní!”

english_verse: Elijah looked around, and by his head was a jar of water and some baked bread. He sat up, ate and drank, then lay down and went back to sleep.
translation_verse: Benɛ e hyɛ e he kɛ be ɔ, e na abolo, kɛ kplu kɛ e mi nyu nɛ maa si ngɛ e yi tetle mi. E ye ní, nɛ e nu nyu, nɛ e hwɔ si ekohu.

english_verse: So Elijah sat up and ate and drank. The food and water made him strong enough to walk
translation_verse: Eliya te si, nɛ e ye ní, nɛ e nu nyu; nɛ niye ní ɔ ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ nyɛɛ nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ya Sinai, yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: and he spent the night there in a cave. The Lord Appears to Elijah While Elijah was on Mount Sinai, the Lord asked, “Elijah, why are you here?”
translation_verse: E ya sɛ tɛ puɔ ko mi, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ. Tlukaa a, Yawɛ kɛ lɛ tu munyu, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Eliya, mɛni o ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: He answered, “Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me!”
translation_verse: E he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu, i sɔmɔɔ mo daa be tsuaa bekɛ hɛdɔ. Se Israel ma a lɛɛ somi nɛ o kɛ mɛ so ɔ, a yi nɔ; a hule o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ pue si, nɛ a gbe o gbali ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. Imi nɔ kake too pɛ nɛ i piɛ, nɛ a ngɛ mi hlae nɛ a gbe!”

english_verse: “Go out and stand on the mountain,” the Lord replied. “I want you to be there when I pass by.” All at once, a strong wind shook the mountain and shattered the rocks. But the Lord was not in the wind. Next, there was an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Jee kpo nɛ o ya da si ngɛ ye hɛ mi ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ba be kɛ ho, nɛ e ha kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ba fia yo ɔ, nɛ e ywia tɛ sa amɛ, se Yawɛ be kɔɔhiɔ ɔ mi. Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ kpa fiami, nɛ zugba mimiɛ; se Yawɛ be zugba mimiɛmi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Then there was a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. Finally, there was a gentle breeze,
translation_verse: Zugba mimiɛmi ɔ se ɔ, la ba, se Yawɛ be la a mi. La a se ɔ, gbi ko nɛ he jɔ pɛ blɛuu.

english_verse: and when Elijah heard it, he covered his face with his coat. He went out and stood at the entrance to the cave. A voice asked, “Elijah, why are you here?”
translation_verse: Benɛ Eliya nu gbi nɛ ɔ, e kɛ e tade klɔii ɔ ha e hɛ mi, nɛ e je kpo ya da si ngɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ nya. Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko bi lɛ ke, “Eliya, mɛni o ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Elijah answered, “Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me!”
translation_verse: E he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ Mawu Ope, i sɔmɔɔ mo daa be tsuaa be kɛ hɛdɔ. Se Israel ma a lɛɛ somi nɛ o kɛ mɛ so ɔ, a yi nɔ; a hule o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ pue si, nɛ a gbe o gbali ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. Imi nɔ kake too pɛ nɛ i piɛ, nɛ a ngɛ mi hlae nɛ a gbe.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Elijah, you can go back to the desert near Damascus. And when you get there, appoint Hazael to be king of Syria.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Kpale o se kɛ ya nga a nɔ ngɛ Damasko kasa nya. Yaa ma a mi, nɛ o ya pɔ Hazael nu, nɛ e ye tsɛ ngɛ Siria;

english_verse: Then appoint Jehu son of Nimshi to be king of Israel, and Elisha son of Shaphat to take your place as my prophet.
translation_verse: pɔɔ Nimshi binyumu Yehu nu, nɛ e ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel, nɛ o pɔ Shafat binyumu Elisha nɛ je Abel Mehola hu nu, nɛ e ye gbalɔ ngɛ o se.

english_verse: Hazael will start killing the people who worship Baal. Jehu will kill those who escape from Hazael, and Elisha will kill those who escape from Jehu.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa tu fo kɛ je Hazael klaate nya a, Yehu maa gbe lɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ maa tu fo kɛ maa je Yehu klaate nya a, Elisha maa gbe lɛ.

english_verse: Elijah left and found Elisha plowing a field with a pair of oxen. There were eleven other men in front of him, and each one was also plowing with a pair of oxen. Elijah went over and put his own coat on Elisha.
translation_verse: Eliya je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ya na Elisha nɛ e kɛ na blablɛhi ngɛ hue; na blablɛ nyɔngma kɛ kake ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e kɛ na blablɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ngɛ hue. Eliya je tade klɔii ɔ ngɛ e he, nɛ e ngɔ wo Elisha.

english_verse: Elisha stopped plowing and ran after him. “Let me kiss my parents goodbye, then I'll go with you,” he said. “You can go,” Elijah said. “But remember what I've done for you.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha je e na amɛ a he, nɛ e tu fo kɛ nyɛɛ Eliya se; nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ i kɛ tsaatsɛ, kɛ maa ya ye sɛ, konɛ ma ba nyɛɛ o se.” Eliya he nɔ ke, “Yoo, moo ya. I tsi we o nya!”

english_verse: Elisha left and took his oxen with him. He killed them and boiled them over a fire he had made with the wood from his plow. He gave the meat to the people who were with him, and they ate it. Then he left with Elijah and became his assistant.
translation_verse: Elisha kpale e se kɛ ho e na blablɛ ɔmɛ a he ya, nɛ e ya gbe mɛ, nɛ e ngɔ tso nɛ a kɛ fi na amɛ kɛ bla a ngɔ pee lɛ́, nɛ e kɛ hoo lo ɔ. E ngɔ lo ɔ ngɔ ha ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ye. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya nyɛɛ Eliya se, nɛ e sɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: They dressed in sackcloth and put ropes on their heads, then they went to Ahab and said, “Your servant Benhadad asks you to let him live.” “Is he still alive?” Ahab asked. “Benhadad is like a brother to me.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ kpekpe ya bo muɔ a mlɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ tangme hu wo a kuɛ, nɛ a ya Ahab ngɔ ya de lɛ ke, “O tsɔlɔ, Benhadad ke e kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ e he ngɔ ke lɛ.” Ahab bi ke, “Benhadad ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ lo? Ye nyɛmi ji lɛ!”

english_verse: Benhadad sent a messenger to tell King Ahab of Israel,
translation_verse: E tsɔ ya de Israel matsɛ, Ahab ngɛ ma a mi ke, “Imi Matsɛ Benhadad, i fa ke

english_verse: Later, Benhadad sent another messenger to say to Ahab, “I already told you to give me your silver and gold, your wives, and your children.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi kpa kɛ je Benhadad ngɔ ba ha Ahab ke, “I tsɔ ba de mo ke o ngɔ o sika hiɔ, o sika tsu, o yi ɔmɛ, kɛ o bimɛ kpakpa amɛ kɛ ba ha mi lɛɛ,

english_verse: But tomorrow at this time, I will send my officials into your city to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will take everything else that you own.”
translation_verse: se hwɔɔ maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma tsɔ nihi o ngɔ. Tsɔli ɔmɛ ma ba kpa o we ɔ mi, kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ a wehi a mi, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa muɔ a hɛ ɔ, a maa ngɔ kɛ je.”

english_verse: “Don't listen to him!” they answered. “You don't have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo de lɛ ke, “Koo po e nya mi; koo kplɛɛ.”

english_verse: So Ahab sent someone to tell Benhadad, “Your Majesty, I'll give you my silver and gold, and even my wives and children. But I won't let you have anything else.” When Benhadad got his answer,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Ahab de Benhadad tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ya de ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ ɔ ke ní ɔmɛ nɛ e bi mi kekle ɔ, i kplɛɛ kaa ma pee; se enɛ ɔ lɛɛ i be nyɛe ma pee.” Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ho.

english_verse: he replied, “I'll completely destroy Samaria! There won't even be enough of it left for my soldiers to carry back in their hands. If I don't do it, I pray that the gods will punish me terribly.”
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Benhadad kpale tsɔ mɛ Ahab ngɔ ekohu nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Ma ngɔ nimli nɛ a he hiɛ babauu pe Samaria tabo zu kɛ ba kpata o ma a hɛ mi. Ke i nyɛ we ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a fia mi nɔ nɛ a gbe!”

english_verse: Ahab then answered, “Benhadad, don't brag before the fighting even begins. Wait and see if you live through it.”
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Ahab he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ya de Matsɛ Benhadad ke, ta bulɔ kpakpa a, ta nyagbe e fĩaa ngɛ, se pi ta sisije.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, Benhadad and the other kings had been drinking in their tents. But when Ahab's reply came, he ordered his soldiers to prepare to attack Samaria, and they all got ready.
translation_verse: Benhadad kɛ matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ngɛ dã nue ngɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi benɛ a ngɔ Ahab sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ɔ. E fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ gba ngɔ wo ma a he!” Nɛ a pee ja.

english_verse: At that very moment, a prophet ran up to Ahab and said, “You can see that Benhadad's army is very strong. But the Lord has promised to help you defeat them today. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, gbalɔ ko ba Israel matsɛ Ahab ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ ke, ‘Koo ye tabo agbo nɛ ɔ gbeye! Mwɔnɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo o dɛ mi, konɛ o na nɛ o le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.’ ”

english_verse: “Who will fight the battle?” Ahab asked. The prophet answered, “The young bodyguards who serve the district officials.” “But who will lead them into battle?” Ahab asked. “You will!” the prophet replied.
translation_verse: Ahab bi ke, “Mɛnɔmɛ maa nyɛɛ ta a hɛ mi?” Gbalɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Amlaalo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a nya a a ta buli nihewi ɔmɛ maa nyɛɛ ta a hɛ mi.” Jehanɛ, matsɛ ɔ bi ke, “Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ ma gba ta a?” Gbalɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Mo.”

english_verse: At noon, King Ahab and his Israelite army marched out of Samaria, with the young soldiers in front. King Benhadad of Syria and the
translation_verse: Ta buli nihewi ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ hia kekle. Slaali nɛ Benhadad tsɔ ɔ ya bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ke ta buli komɛ je Samaria kɛ ma.

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Benhadad ordered. “I don't care if they have come out to fight or to surrender.”
translation_verse: Benhadad fa ke, “Ke a ma nɛ a ba ha yi jio, ta hwumi nɛ a ma jio, nyɛɛ nuu mɛ hɛ ngmengmle!”

english_verse: The young soldiers led Israel's troops into battle,
translation_verse: Ta buli nihewi ɔmɛ hia kɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi, nɛ Israel tabo ɔ nyɛɛ a se,

english_verse: and each of them attacked and killed an enemy soldier. The rest of the Syrian army turned and ran, and the Israelites went after them. Benhadad and some others escaped on horses,
translation_verse: nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ gbe nɔ nɛ e kɛ kpe ɔ. Siria bi ɔmɛ tu fo, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se. Se Siria matsɛ, Benhadad kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli komɛ hi okpɔngɔ nɔ kɛ tu fo kɛ je.

english_verse: but Ahab and his soldiers followed them and captured their horses and chariots. Ahab and Israel's army crushed the Syrians.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Ahab nyɛɛ a se nɛ e kpata okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e pee Siria bi ɔmɛ butuu.

english_verse: Later, the prophet went back and warned Ahab, “Benhadad will attack you again next spring. Build up your troops and make sure you have some good plans.” Syria Attacks Israel Again
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, gbalɔ ɔ ba Matsɛ Ahab ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Kpale o se nɛ o ya dla o he saminya, nɛ o hyɛ bɔ nɛ o maa pee ha; ejakaa hwɔɔ se jeha be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Siria matsɛ ɔ ma ba tua mo ekohu.” Siria ba tua Israel ekohu

english_verse: Meanwhile, Benhadad's officials went to him and explained: Israel's gods are mountain gods. We fought Israel's army in the hills, and that's why they defeated us. But if we fight them on flat land, there's no way we can lose.
translation_verse: Siria matsɛ, Benhadad tsɔli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Israel bi ɔmɛ a mawu ɔmɛ ɔ, mawuhi nɛ hii yokuhi a nɔ ji mɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔ he je nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ye wa nɔ kunimi ɔ nɛ. Se ke waa kɛ mɛ hwu ngɛ nga nɔ ɔ, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, wa maa ye a nɔ.

english_verse: Then get more soldiers, horses, and chariots, so your army will be as strong as it was before. We'll fight Israel's army on flat land and wipe them out. Benhadad agreed and did what they suggested.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, bua tabo agbo ko nya kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ tu fo kɛ je o he ɔ. Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a hiɛ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ kɛ̃. Waa kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa hwu ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ wa maa ye a nɔ kunimi.” Matsɛ Benhadad bu a ga womi ɔ tue, nɛ e pee kaa bɔ nɛ a de ɔ.

english_verse: In the spring, Benhadad got his army together, and they marched to the town of Aphek to attack Israel.
translation_verse: Jeha kake se ɔ, e bua Siria bi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ e kɛ mɛ hia kɛ ba Afek, konɛ e kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba hwu ta.

english_verse: The prophet went to Ahab and said, “The Syrians think the Lord is a god of the hills and not of the valleys. So he has promised to help you defeat their powerful army. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.”
translation_verse: Gbalɔ ko ba Matsɛ Ahab ngɔ nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Akɛnɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ de ke Yawɛ ɔ, mawu nɛ hii yokuhi a nɔ ji lɛ, se pi mawu nɛ hii nga nɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, ma ngɔ nimli kpekpemi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ wo o dɛ mi, nɛ o kɛ o ma a ma ná maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.’ ”

english_verse: For seven days the two armies stayed in their camps, facing each other. Then on the seventh day the fighting broke out, and before sunset the Israelites had killed
translation_verse: Siria ta a, kɛ Israel ta a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee a sibi ligbi kpaago. Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, a bɔni ta hwumi, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe Siria bi akpe lafa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: His officials said, “Your Majesty, we've heard that Israel's kings keep their agreements. We will wrap sackcloth around our waists, put ropes around our heads, and ask Ahab to let you live.”
translation_verse: E tsɔli ɔmɛ ya de lɛ ke, “Wa nu kaa Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ naa mɔbɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ waa ngɔ kpekpe ya bo kɛ muɔ wa mlɛ mi, nɛ waa ngɔ tangme ngɔ wo wa kuɛ, nɛ waa ya Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɔ kaa, alini e ma he o yi wami lo.”

english_verse: Benhadad's officials were trying to figure out what Ahab was thinking, and when he said “brother,” they quickly replied, “You're right! You and Benhadad are like brothers.” “Go get him,” Ahab said. When Benhadad came out, Ahab had him climb up into his chariot.
translation_verse: Benhadad tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɛ hyɛe kaa a maa na manye okadi ko lo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Ahab de ja a, a nya sɔ nɛ a de ke, “Ee, o nyɛmi ji Benhadad!” Ahab fa ke, “Nyɛ ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba!” Benɛ Benhadad ba a, Ahab de lɛ ke e kuɔ ta zugba lɛ ɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ.

english_verse: Benhadad said, “I'll give back the towns my father took from your father. And you can have shops in Damascus, just as my father had in Samaria.” Ahab replied, “If you do these things, I'll let you go free.” Then they signed a peace treaty, and Ahab let Benhadad go. A Prophet Condemns Ahab
translation_verse: Benhadad de lɛ ke, “Mahi nɛ tsaatsɛ kpɔ ngɛ o tsɛ dɛ ɔ, ma kpale ngɔ ha mo ekohu. O ma nyɛ maa ma jua yemi hehi ngɛ Damasko kaa bɔ nɛ tsaatsɛ hu pee ngɛ Samaria a.” Ahab he nɔ ke, “Ngɛ o siwo nɛ ɔ nya a, ma ha o ye o he.” Nɛ Ahab kɛ lɛ so, nɛ e ngmɛɛ e he. Gbalɔ ko bu Ahab fɔ

english_verse: About this time the Lord commanded a prophet to say to a friend, “Hit me!” But the friend refused,
translation_verse: Ngɛ Yawɛ fami nya a, gbali a kuu ɔ mi no ko de e nyɛmi gbalɔ ko ke e fia lɛ nɔ. Se e nyɛmi ɔ kua.

english_verse: and the prophet told him, “You disobeyed the Lord, and as soon as you walk away, a lion will kill you.” The friend left, and suddenly a lion killed him.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbalɔ ɔ de e nyɛmi ɔ ke, “Akɛnɛ o bui Yawɛ fami ɔ tue he je ɔ, ke o je ye ngɔ pɛ kɛkɛ jata ko maa gbe mo.” Nɛ benɛ e je e ngɔ pɛ jata ko ya na lɛ nɛ jata a gbe lɛ.

english_verse: The prophet left and put a bandage over his face to disguise himself. Then he went and stood beside the road, waiting for Ahab to pass by.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ ngɔ bo ngɔ fi e hɛ mi kɛ tsake e he, nɛ e ho ya da blɔ ɔ tue kɛ ngɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ mlɛe nɛ e ba be.

english_verse: When Ahab went by, the prophet shouted, “Your Majesty, right in the heat of battle, someone brought a prisoner to me and told me to guard him. He said if the prisoner got away, I would either be killed or forced to pay
translation_verse: Benɛ matsɛ ɔ bee ɔ, gbalɔ ɔ tsɛ lɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Nɛnɛ, i ngɛ ta nga nɔ, nɛ ta bulɔ ko ngɔ nyumu ko nɛ a nu lɛ ba ha mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘Ngɔɔ nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ to; ke e tu fo ɔ, o kɛ o wami ma dani lɛ, aloo a ma he mo sika hiɔ yi akpe etɛ.’

english_verse: But I got busy doing other things, and the prisoner escaped.” Ahab answered, “You will be punished just as you have said.”
translation_verse: Se benɛ ye hɛ dɔ, nɛ i ngɛ ní kpahi pee ɔ, nyumu ɔ tu fo.” Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o bu o he fɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ja a gbla o tue.”

english_verse: The man quickly tore the bandage off his face, and Ahab saw that he was one of the prophets.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ je bo ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ amlɔ nɔuu matsɛ ɔ yo lɛ kaa gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.

english_verse: The prophet said, “The Lord told you to kill Benhadad, but you let him go. Now you will die in his place, and your people will die in place of his people.”
translation_verse: Gbalɔ ɔ de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Akɛnɛ o ngmɛɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ i fa mo ke o gbe lɛ ɔ he he je ɔ, o maa ngɔ o he kɛ dani lɛ. Jehanɛ, a ma kpata o ta buli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, ejakaa mɛ hu a ngmɛ blɔ nɛ Benhadad ta buli ɔmɛ tu fo.’ ”

english_verse: One day, Ahab said, “Naboth, your vineyard is near my palace. Give it to me so I can turn it into a vegetable garden. I'll give you a better vineyard or pay whatever you want for yours.”
translation_verse: Ligbi ko ɔ, Ahab de lɛ ke, “O wai ngmɔ ɔ ngɛ ye we ɔ kasa nya haa. Ngɔɔ kɛ ha mi nɛ ma kɛ pee pui ngmɔ. I kɛ wai ngmɔ kpa nɛ hi pe o nɔ́ ɔ ma tsake ha mo; aloo ke o suɔ ɔ, ma wo mo e he hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa.”

english_verse: Naboth answered, “This vineyard has always been in my family. I won't let you have it.”
translation_verse: Se Nabot de Ahab ke, “Yawɛ ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa ma ngɔ ye nɛmɛ a gbosi ní ɔ ngɔ ha mo.”

english_verse: So Ahab went home, angry and depressed because of what Naboth had told him. He lay on his bed, just staring at the wall and refusing to eat a thing.
translation_verse: Ahab je kɛ ho we mi ya kɛ mi mi la, kɛ aywilɛho; ejakaa Nabot de lɛ ke e nɛmɛ a gbosi ní ɔ, e be ngɔe kɛ ha lɛ. E ho ya hwɔ si ngɛ e sa nɔ, nɛ e plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ kpee gbogbo, nɛ e kua ní yemi.

english_verse: “Aren't you the king of Israel?” Jezebel asked. “Get out of bed and eat something! Don't worry, I'll get Naboth's vineyard for you.”
translation_verse: Ahab yo Yezebel bi lɛ ke, “Mo ji Israel matsɛ ɔ, aloo pi mo?” E ya nɔ de lɛ ke, “Tee si nɛ o ye ní, nɛ o ná bua jɔmi; ma ngɔ Yezreel no, Nabot wai ngmɔ ɔ kɛ ha mo!”

english_verse: Jezebel wrote a letter to each of the leaders of the town where Naboth lived. In the letters she said: Call everyone together and tell them to go without eating today. When they come together, give Naboth a seat at the front. Get two liars to sit facing him and swear that Naboth has cursed God and the king. Then take Naboth outside and stone him to death! She signed Ahab's name to the letters and sealed them with his seal. Then she sent them to the town leaders.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha yaka nimli enyɔ nɛ a da e hɛ mi paa nɛ a ye odase ngɔ si lɛ ke e jɛ Mawu, kɛ matsɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ nyɛ ya fia lɛ tɛ nɛ nyɛɛ gbe.”

english_verse: They told the people that it was a day to go without eating, and when they all came together, they seated Naboth at the front.
translation_verse: a fiɛ ke a ha hwɔ ligbi mluku, nɛ a bua ma a nya, nɛ a ha Nabot blɔ he nguaa ko.

english_verse: The two liars came in and sat across from Naboth. Then they accused him of cursing God and the king, so the people dragged Naboth outside and stoned him to death.
translation_verse: Yaka nimli enyɔ ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba po Nabot nya ngɛ ma a hɛ mi ke e jɛ Mawu, kɛ matsɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a ya fia lɛ tɛ nɛ a gbe.

english_verse: The leaders of Jezreel sent a message back to Jezebel that said, “Naboth is dead.”
translation_verse: Nɛ a tsɔ ya de Yezebel ke, “A gbe Nabot.”

english_verse: As soon as Jezebel got their message, she told Ahab, “Now you can have the vineyard Naboth refused to sell. He's dead.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yezebel nu kaa Nabot gbo ɔ, e de Ahab ke, “Nabot gbo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tee si nɛ o ya ngɔ e wai ngmɔ ɔ nɛ e kua juami ha mo ɔ.”

english_verse: Ahab got up and went to take over the vineyard. Elijah Condemns Ahab
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Ahab ho nɛ e ya ngɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Elijah the prophet,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de gbalɔ Eliya nɛ je Tishbe ɔ ke,

english_verse: Go tell him that I say, ‘Ahab, you murdered Naboth and took his property. And so, in the very spot where dogs licked up Naboth's blood, they will lick up your blood.’ ” When Elijah found him,
translation_verse: De lɛ ke imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ lɛ bie ke, ‘Nɛ o gbe nyumu ɔ, o ma pa ngɔ e weto ní ɔ kɛ pee o nɔ lo?’ De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ i de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘He nɛ gbe ɔmɛ lɔ Nabot muɔ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ma lɔ mo hu o muɔ ngɛ!’ ”

english_verse: Ahab said, “So, my enemy, you found me at last.” Elijah answered: Yes, I did! Ahab, you have managed to do everything the Lord hates.
translation_verse: Benɛ Ahab na Eliya a, e bi lɛ ke, “Ye he nyɛlɔ, pe o nuu mi nɛ ɔ?” Eliya he nɔ ke, “Ee, i nuu mo. O ngɔ o he ngɔ ha yayami peemi, nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Now you will be punished. You and every man and boy in your family will die, whether slave or free.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ngɛ mo dee ke, ‘I kɛ haomi maa ba o nɔ. Ma kpata o hɛ mi, nɛ ma gbe nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ o we ɔ mi, nyɔguɛ jio, odehe jio.

english_verse: Your whole family will be wiped out, just like the families of King Jeroboam and King Baasha. You've made the Lord very angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ma pee o we ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Nebat binyumu Yeroboam, kɛ Abiya binyumu Baasha a we ɔmɛ ɔ, ejakaa o wo ye mi mi la kaa o ha Israel ya pee yayami.’

english_verse: And as for Jezebel, dogs will eat her body there in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yezebel hu, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Gbehi maa ye Yezebel ngɛ Yezreel ma a mi.’

english_verse: Dogs will also eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.
translation_verse: Ke o he nɔ ko gbo ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, gbehi maa ye lɛ; nɛ ke o he nɔ ko gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ maa ye lɛ.”

english_verse: When Ahab heard this, he tore his clothes in sorrow and wore sackcloth day and night. He was depressed and refused to eat. Some time later, the Lord said, “Elijah, do you see how sorry Ahab is for what he did? I won't punish his family while he is still alive. I'll wait until his son is king.” No one was more determined than Ahab to disobey the Lord. And Jezebel encouraged him. Worst of all, he had worshiped idols, just as the Amorites had done before the Lord forced them out of the land and gave it to Israel.
translation_verse: “O na bɔ nɛ Ahab ba e he si ha mi ɔ? Akɛnɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i be hae nɛ haomi ɔ nɛ ba e nɔ ngɛ e wami be mi; e binyumu ɔ yi nɔ nɛ ma ngɔ haomi kɛ ba Ahab we ɔ nɔ!”

english_verse: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.”
translation_verse: De mɛ ke i ke a wo lɛ tsu, nɛ a ha lɛ abolo, kɛ nyu bɔbɔyoo pɛ kɛ yaa si ma kpale kɛ ba kɛ manye.”

english_verse: Ahab asked his officials, “Why haven't we tried to get Ramoth in Gilead back from the Syrians? It belongs to us.”
translation_verse: Ahab de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ le kaa wa ma ji Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ! Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ wa bɔɛ mɔde nɛ wa ya kpɔ lɛ ngɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ dɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Then he asked Jehoshaphat, “Would you go to Ramoth with me and attack the Syrians?” “Just tell me what to do,” Jehoshaphat answered. “My army and horses are at your command.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Ahab bi Yehoshafat ke, “Anɛ o kɛ mi maa ya nɛ wa ya tua Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ lo?” Yehoshafat he nɔ ke, “Imi kɛ mo ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ji wɔ; ye ma a, o ma, nɛ ye okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu o níhi.

english_verse: But first, let's ask the Lord.”
translation_verse: Se kekleekle ɔ, ha nɛ wa bi Yawɛ ga womi.”

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Se Yehoshafat bi ke, “Anɛ gbalɔ kpa ko be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ wa ma bi lɛ Yawɛ ga womi lo?”

english_verse: “We could ask Micaiah son of Imlah,” Ahab said. “But I hate Micaiah. He always has bad news for me.” “Don't say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.
translation_verse: Ahab he nɔ ke, “Nɔ kake ngɛ; lɛ ji Imla binyumu Mikaya. Se i sume lɛ, ejakaa e gbɛ manye nɔ́ ko ha we mi hyɛ gblee, ja nɔ́ yayami pɛ.” Yehoshafat de lɛ ke, “Mo ko de ja!”

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria. They were listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ wo ablade tade kɛ hii si ngɛ a matsɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ngma mi sami he ɔ nɛ ngɛ Samaria ma agbo ɔ nya a, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ gbae ngɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zedekia, Kenaana binyumu ɔ, pee dade kolihi, nɛ e de Ahab ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Enɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ o kɛ ma tsitsɛɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya se kɛ yaa si o ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.’ ”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth, and they promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Gbali kpa amɛ tsuo gba kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a de ke, “Yawɛ maa ngɔ Ramot Gilead kɛ wo o dɛ mi; yaa nɛ o ya tua ma a, nɛ o maa ye kunimi.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ho Mikaya tsɛmi ya a de lɛ ke, “O nɛ, gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a nya sɔ nɛ a gba ke matsɛ ɔ maa ye kunimi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo hu gbaa ja nɔuu.”

english_verse: “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth!” Ahab shouted. “What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Se Ahab de lɛ ke, “Ke o kɛ mi ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ɔ, tuu anɔkuale! Si enyɛmɛ ma de mo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: He answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers walking around in the hills like sheep without a shepherd to guide them. The Lord said, ‘This army has no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Mikaya he nɔ ke, “I na Israel tabo ɔ tsuo nɛ a gbɛ fĩa ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa tohi nɛ be hyɛlɔ. Nɛ Yawɛ de ke, ‘Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ be tsɛ; ha nɛ a kpale kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.’ ”

english_verse: Micaiah replied: Listen to this! I also saw the Lord seated on his throne with every creature in heaven gathered around him.
translation_verse: Mikaya ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ tue! I na Yawɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo daa si kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.

english_verse: This is exactly what has happened, Ahab. The Lord made all your prophets lie to you, and he knows you will soon be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, Mikaya de ke, “Bɔ nɛ níhi ya ba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yawɛ ha nɛ o gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ye mo lakpa. Se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e de to kaa sane yaya maa ye mo!”

english_verse: Zedekiah walked up to Micaiah and slapped him on the face. Then he asked, “Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Zedekia, Kenaana binyumu ɔ ho nɛ e ya gba Mikaya hɛ mi ma, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni be Yawɛ mumi ɔ je ye nɔ nɛ e kɛ mo ba tu munyu?”

english_verse: However, during the fighting a soldier shot an arrow without even aiming, and it hit Ahab where two pieces of his armor joined. He shouted to his chariot driver, “I've been hit! Get me out of here!”
translation_verse: Se e ba mi kaa Siria ta buli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ tlukaa nɛ e hɛ be nɔ. Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ ya gbɔ Ahab ngɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ a tsami he ɔ. Ahab de e ta zugba lɛ kudɔlɔ ɔ ke, “I plaa! Plɛ o he nɛ o kɛ mi nɛ je ta a nya!”

english_verse: Ahab and Jehoshaphat led their armies to Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Ahab, kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat ho ya tua Ramot Gilead.

english_verse: Before they went into battle, Ahab said, “Jehoshaphat, I'll disguise myself, but you wear your royal robe.” Then Ahab disguised himself and went into battle.
translation_verse: Ahab de Yehoshafat ke, “Ma tsake ye he kɛ ya ta nga a nɔ, se moo lɛɛ moo wo o we ablade tade ɔmɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ tsake e he kɛ ho ta nga a nɔ ya.

english_verse: So when they saw Jehoshaphat in his robe, they thought he was Ahab and started to attack him. But when Jehoshaphat shouted out to them,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a na Yehoshafat ɔ, a susu kaa Israel matsɛ ɔ ji lɛ, nɛ a plɛ ngɔ kpee lɛ. Se benɛ a kpa ngmlaa a,

english_verse: they realized he wasn't Ahab, and they left him alone.
translation_verse: a na kaa tsa pi Israel matsɛ ɔ ji lɛ, nɛ a kpale ngɛ e se.

english_verse: As the sun was going down, someone in Israel's army shouted to the others, “Retreat! Go back home!”
translation_verse: Pu si nɔmi be ɔ, a fiɛ ngɛ Israel ta a mi ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ho e zugba nɔ, kɛ e ma mi ya!”

english_verse: Some workers washed his chariot near a spring in Samaria, and prostitutes washed themselves in his blood. Dogs licked Ahab's blood off the ground, just as the Lord had warned.
translation_verse: A ya fɔ ta zugba lɛ ɔ he ngɛ Samaria taku ɔ mi; nɛ yaholi ya du ngɛ mi, nɛ gbehi ya lɔ Ahab muɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ.

english_verse: Everything else Ahab did while he was king, including the towns he strengthened and the palace he built and furnished with ivory, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Ahab he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, we ɔ nɛ e kɛ suɔ wu ma a, kɛ ma kpahi nɛ e po ɔ, a ngma tsuo ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Ahab died, and his son Ahaziah became king. King Jehoshaphat of Judah (

translation_verse: Elisha plɛ hyɛ mɛ, nɛ e tsɛ Yawɛ biɛ kɛ gbiɛ mɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ osisiblisi eyo enyɔ je nga mi kɛ ba, nɛ a ba tsɔtslɔɔ jokuɛwi nyumuwi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nimli nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ a mi.

translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Ahab binyumu Yehoram ba ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ. E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.

translation_verse: Moab matsɛ, Mesha a, to lɛlɔ ji lɛ; nɛ daa jeha a, e ya haa Israel matsɛ jijɔ akpe lafa, kɛ agbosuhi a he bwɔmi akpe lafa.

english_verse: So Joram, Jehoshaphat, and the king of Edom led their troops out. But seven days later, there was no drinking water left for them or their animals.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat said, “Which of the Lord's prophets is with us? We can find out from him what the Lord wants us to do.” One of Joram's officers answered, “Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He was one of Elijah's closest followers.”
