english_verse: Jehoshaphat replied, “He can give us the Lord's message.” The three kings went over to Elisha,
translation_verse: Yehoshafat de ke, “Gbalɔ kpakpa ji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Elisha ngɔ ya.

english_verse: and he asked Joram, “Why did you come to me? Go talk to the prophets of the foreign gods your parents worshiped.” “No,” Joram answered. “It was the Lord who led us out here, so that Moab's army could capture us.”
translation_verse: Elisha de Israel matsɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni sane i kɛ mo ngɛ? Yaa o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ a gbali ɔmɛ a ngɔ.” Israel matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɔ wɔ matsɛmɛ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo Moab matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha said to him, “I serve the Lord All-Powerful, and as surely as he lives, I swear I wouldn't even look at you if I didn't respect King Jehoshaphat.”
translation_verse: Elisha de lɛ ke, “I na Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɛ i sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ, kaa ke pi Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat hɛ mi zo nɛ i gbo ɔ, jinɛ i be mo kpɛe, nɛ ma ba de ke ma hyɛ o hɛ mi po.

english_verse: Then Elisha said, “Send for someone who can play the harp.” The harpist began playing, and the Lord gave Elisha this message for Joram:
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ nyɛ hla saku fialɔ ko ha mi.” Benɛ saku fialɔ ɔ ngɛ e saku ɔ fiae ɔ, Yawɛ he wami ɔ ba Elisha nɔ,

english_verse: The Lord says that this dry riverbed will be filled with water.
translation_verse: nɛ e de ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ma ha nyu ma hyi nyu dɔ nɛ gbli nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You won't feel any wind or see any rain, but there will be plenty of water for you and your animals.
translation_verse: Kɔɔhiɔ be fiae, nɛ hiɔmi hu be nɛe; se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyu dɔ nɛ ɔ ma hyi tɔ kɛ nyu. Nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi, kɛ lohwehi nɛ tlooɔ tlomi ma na nyu maa nu.’ ”

english_verse: That simple thing isn't all the Lord is going to do. He will also help you defeat Moab's army.
translation_verse: Elisha ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi pi nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ he wa ha Yawɛ. Yawɛ maa ngɔ Moab bi ɔmɛ hu kɛ wo nyɛ dɛ mi.

english_verse: You will capture all their walled cities and important towns. You will chop down every good tree and stop up every spring of water, then ruin their fertile fields by covering them with rocks.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maa ngɔ a ma kpakpa amɛ, kɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he ɔ tsuo. Nyɛ maa poo tso kpakpa tsuaa tso kpakpa; nyɛ maa tsi nyu vu ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ tɛ kɛ ha a zugba kpakpa amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.”

english_verse: The next morning, while the sacrifice was being offered, water suddenly started flowing from the direction of Edom, and it flooded the land.
translation_verse: E nɔ jena mɔtu, maa pee bɔ sami be ɔ, nyu je Edom blɔ kɛ ba; nɛ zugba a nɔ hyi tɔ kɛ nyu.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Moab had heard that the three kings were coming to attack them. They had called together all of their fighting men, from the youngest to the oldest, and these troops were now standing at their border, ready for battle.
translation_verse: Benɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ tsuo nu kaa matsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ ma nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba hwu ta a, a ya kpee nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ su ta yami nya kɛ je jokuɛyo pe kulaa nɔ kɛ ya si nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɔ kɛ ba da ma a huzu nya.

english_verse: When they got up that morning, the sun was shining across the water, making it look red. The Moabite troops took one look
translation_verse: Benɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ te si mɔtu kpla a, pu ngɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kpɛe; nɛ a na kaa nyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ a hanɔ ɔ pee tsutsuutsu kaa muɔ.

english_verse: and shouted, “Look at that blood! The armies of those kings must have fought and killed each other. Come on, let's go take what's left in their camp.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a de ke, “Muɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he hwu ta nɛ a gbe a he. Moab bi, nyɛ ha waa ho nɛ wa ya ha ní!”

english_verse: But when they arrived at Israel's camp, the Israelite soldiers came out and attacked them, until they turned and ran away. Israel's army chased them all the way back to Moab, and even there they kept up the attack.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ba su Israel bi ɔmɛ a sito he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ te si nɛ a tua mɛ. Moab bi ɔmɛ tu fo, se Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɔ pue si ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: The Israelites destroyed the Moabite towns. They chopped down the good trees and stopped up the springs of water, then covered the fertile fields with rocks. Finally, the only city left standing was Kir-Hareseth, but soldiers armed with slings surrounded and attacked it.

english_verse: He then grabbed his oldest son who was to be the next king and sacrificed him as an offering on the city wall. The Israelite troops were so horrified that they left the city and went back home.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e nu e bitɛte, nɔ nɛ jinɛ lɛ nɛ e ma ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se ɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ sã sami bɔ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ. Israel bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a je ma a mi, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ya.

english_verse: One day the widow of one of the Lord's prophets said to Elisha, “You know that before my husband died, he was a follower of yours and a worshiper of the Lord. But he owed a man some money, and now that man is on his way to take my two sons as his slaves.”
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ a kuu ɔ mi no ko e yo ya fa kue ha Elisha, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “O tsɔlɔ, nɛ ji imi lɛɛ ye huno ɔ, e gbo. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o le ɔ, o tsɔlɔ ɔ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye. Se nyumu ko nɛ e ya pa sika ngɛ e dɛ ɔ ba nu ye binyumuwi enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ pee e nyɔguɛhi.”

english_verse: “Maybe there's something I can do to help,” Elisha said. “What do you have in your house?” “Sir, I have nothing but a small bottle of olive oil.”
translation_verse: Elisha bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni ma pee ha mo? Mo de mi. Mɛni ngɛ o dɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, i be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ we ɔ mi, ja nu tɔ kake pɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha told her, “Ask your neighbors for their empty jars. And after you've borrowed as many as you can,
translation_verse: Elisha de lɛ ke, “Jee kpo nɛ o ya ba buɛ mi guhi abɔ nɛ o ma na ngɛ o huza nɔ bi ɔmɛ a dɛ kɛ ba.

english_verse: go home and shut the door behind you and your sons. Then begin filling the jars with oil and set each one aside as you fill it.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo sɛ tsu mi nɛ o nga sinya kɛ wo o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ yi. Nyɛ plɛ nu ɔ kɛ wo buɛ ɔmɛ a mi. Ke eko hyi ɔ, a hɛ lɛ kɛ ya se.”

english_verse: The woman left. Later, when she and her sons were back inside their house, the two sons brought her the jars, and she began filling them.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ ho nɛ e kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ya sɛ tsu mi nɛ a nga sinya kɛ wo a yi. Be mi nɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ buɛ ɔmɛ muɔe kɛ ngɛ bae ɔ, yo ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ buɛ ɔmɛ a mi nu woe.

english_verse: At last, she said to one of her sons, “Bring me another jar.” “We don't have any more,” he answered, and the oil stopped flowing from the small bottle.
translation_verse: Benɛ buɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hyi ɔ, yo ɔ tsɛ e binyumu, nɛ e de lɛ ke e ngɔ buɛ ɔ eko kɛ ba. Se e binyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Buɛ kpa ko be hu!” Kɛkɛ nɛ nu ɔ se po.

english_verse: After she told Elisha what had happened, he said, “Sell the oil and use part of the money to pay what you owe the man. You and your sons can live on what is left.” Elisha Brings a Rich Woman's Son Back to Life
translation_verse: Yo ɔ ho nɛ e ya bɔ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ amaniɛ. Nɛ gbalɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya jua nu ɔ nɛ o kɛ wo o he hiɔ ɔmɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ se ɔ, o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ.” Elisha kɛ Shunem yo niatsɛ ɔ

english_verse: Once, while Elisha was in the town of Shunem, he met a rich woman who invited him to her home for dinner. After that, whenever he was in Shunem, he would have a meal there with her and her husband.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko ɔ, Elisha ya Shunem, nɛ e ya na yo niatsɛ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yo ɔ fa kue ha lɛ ke e ye nɔ́ ko doo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ e maa be ngɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ma gba yo ɔ we ɔ mi ya ye ní.

english_verse: Some time later the woman said to her husband, “I'm sure the man who comes here so often is a prophet of God.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ de e huno ke, “Jehanɛ i yɔse kaa nyumu ɔ nɛ pɔɔ wa ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ gumi ɔ, Mawu nɔmlɔ klɔuklɔu ji lɛ.

english_verse: Why don't we build him a small room on the flat roof of our house? We can put a bed, a table and chair, and an oil lamp in it. Then whenever he comes, he can stay with us.”
translation_verse: Ha nɛ waa pee tsu nyafii ko ha lɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi, nɛ waa wo mi sa tso, okplɔɔ, sɛ, kɛ kane, konɛ be tsuaa be nɛ e maa ba wa ngɔ ɔ, e ba hi lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The next time Elisha was in Shunem, he stopped at their house and went up to his room to rest.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko ɔ, Elisha ba Shunem, nɛ e be kɛ ho e tsu ɔ mi ya nɛ́ e ya jɔɔ e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: He said to his servant Gehazi, “This woman has been very helpful. Have her come up here to the roof for a moment.” She came, and Elisha told Gehazi to say to her, “You've gone to a lot of trouble for us, and we want to help you. Is there something we can request the king or army commander to do?” The woman answered, “With my relatives nearby, I have everything I need.”
translation_verse: Elisha de Gehazi ke, “Mo bi yo ɔ ke dengme nɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ e ngɛ gboe ngɛ wa he ɔ, mɛni e suɔ kaa ma pee ha lɛ? Anɛ e ngɛ sane ko nɛ e maa suɔ nɛ ma kɛ ya fɔ matsɛ, loo asafoatsɛ hɛ mi ha lɛ lo?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he hia we mi; imi nitsɛ ye ma mi bi a kpɛti nɛ i ngɛ.”

english_verse: “Then what can we do for her?” Elisha asked Gehazi. Gehazi replied, “I do know that her husband is old, and that she doesn't have a son.”
translation_verse: Elisha bi Gehazi ke, “Lɛɛ mɛni ma pee ha lɛ mɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Anɔkuale mi ɔ, e be binyumu; nɛ e huno ɔ hu bwɔ.”

english_verse: “Ask her to come here again,” Elisha told his servant. He called for her, and she came and stood in the doorway of Elisha's room.
translation_verse: Elisha de Gehazi ke, “De yo ɔ ke e ba.” Yo ɔ ba nɛ e ba da si ngɛ sinya a nya,

english_verse: Elisha said to her, “Next year at this time, you'll be holding your own baby son in your arms.” “You're a man of God,” the woman replied. “Please don't lie to me.”
translation_verse: nɛ Elisha de lɛ ke, “Hwɔɔ se jeha be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, o maa hɛɛ binyumu ngɛ o kɔni bɔkɔ mi.” Yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi! Ye nyɔmtsɛ, koo mlɔɔ mi; Mawu nɔmlɔ ji mo!”

english_verse: But a few months later, the woman got pregnant. She gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had promised.
translation_verse: Se yo ɔ na mi, nɛ benɛ jeha ke e suu ɔ, e fɔ binyumu kaa bɔ nɛ Elisha de lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: One day while the boy was still young, he was out in the fields with his father, where the workers were harvesting the crops.
translation_verse: Jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ ba wa. Ligbi ko benɛ e tsɛ kɛ ngma kpali ɔmɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ ɔ, jokuɛ ɔ ho e tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Suddenly he shouted, “My head hurts. It hurts a lot!” “Carry him back to his mother,” the father said to his servant.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Ye yi! Ye yi!” E tsɛ ɔ de e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ke, “Wo lɛ kɛ ya ha e nyɛ!”

english_verse: loaves of bread made from the first barley that was harvested. Elisha said, “Give it to the people so they can eat.”
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ kɛ ya ha e nyɛ, nɛ e nyɛ ɔ ngɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ e tɛ nɔ hluu kɛ ya si piani, kɛkɛ nɛ e gbo.

english_verse: She carried him upstairs to Elisha's room and laid him across the bed. Then she walked out and shut the door behind her.
translation_verse: E nyɛ ɔ ngɔ lɛ ya fɔ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ sa a nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe tsu ɔ mi. E ngmɛ sinya a mi kɛ wo e yi, nɛ e je kpo.

english_verse: The woman called to her husband, “I need to see the prophet. Let me use one of the donkeys. Send a servant along with me, and let me leave now, so I can get back quickly.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɔ ya de e huno ɔ ke, “Ha nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ ngɔ teji yo kake kɛ ba ha mi nɛ ma sa fo kɛ ya Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɔ nɛ ma ba.”

english_verse: “Why do you need to see him today?” her husband asked. “It's not the Sabbath or time for the New Moon Festival.” “That's all right,” she answered.
translation_verse: E huno ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o yaa Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ? Tsa pi Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be, aloo Hejɔɔmi ligbi ji mwɔnɛ ɔ.” E he nɔ ke, “E pee we nɔ́ ko!”

english_verse: She saddled the donkey and said to her servant, “Let's go. And don't slow down unless I tell you to.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e mia teji yo ɔ, nɛ e de e tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Moo wo lohwe ɔ fo mlamlaamla nɛ waa ho; ko gbɔjɔ mi kɛ yaa si ma de mo loko o pee ja!”

english_verse: She left at once for Mount Carmel to talk with Elisha. When Elisha saw her coming, he said, “Gehazi, look! It's the woman from Shunem.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho Karmel yo ɔ nɔ he nɛ Elisha ngɛ ɔ ya. Benɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ na yo ɔ nɛ ma ngɛ tsitsaa a, e de e tsɔlɔ Gehazi ke, “Hyɛ, Shunem yo ɔ lɛ ma a nɛ!

english_verse: Run and meet her. And ask her if everything is all right with her and her family.” “Everything is fine,” she answered Gehazi.
translation_verse: Tuu fo nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya kpe, nɛ o bi lɛ ke e ngɛ saminya lo. Bi lɛ ke e huno ɔ kɛ e binyumuyo ɔ hu ngɛ saminya lo.” Yo ɔ de Gehazi ke mɛ tsuo a ngɛ saminya,

english_verse: But as soon as she got to the top of the mountain, she went over and grabbed Elisha by the feet. Gehazi started toward her to push her away, when Elisha said, “Leave her alone! Don't you see how sad she is? But the Lord hasn't told me why.”
translation_verse: se benɛ e ba su Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɔ ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, e nu Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ nane. Nɛ jinɛ Gehazi ka kaa e ma tsitsɛɛ lɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, se Elisha de lɛ ke, “Moo ngmɛɛ e he; o nɛ kaa nɔ́ ko ngɛ lɛ haoe lo? Nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ laa mi, nɛ e de we mi.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I begged you not to get my hopes up, and I didn't even ask you for a son.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, anɛ i bi mo ke o ha mi binyumu lo? Anɛ i de we mo ke o ko mlɔɔ mi lo?”

english_verse: “Gehazi, get ready and go to her house,” Elisha said. “Take along my walking stick, and when you get there, lay it on the boy's face. Don't stop to talk to anyone, even if they try to talk to you.”
translation_verse: Elisha de Gehazi ke, “Esɔ! Moo mia! Ngɔɔ ye dɛma tso ɔ nɛ o ho! Ke o kɛ nɔ ko kpe ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ko nga lɛ; ke nɔ ko nga mo ɔ, ko he nɔ. Yaa tɛɛ, nɛ o ya wo ye dɛma tso ɔ nɔ ngɛ jokuɛ ɔ hɛ mi.”

english_verse: But the boy's mother said to Elisha, “I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I won't leave without you.” So Elisha got up and went with them.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ de Elisha ke, “I na Mawu, nɛ i na mo nitsɛ hu o nane kaa i be o he jee.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Elisha te si nɛ e kɛ yo ɔ ho.

english_verse: Gehazi ran on ahead and laid Elisha's walking stick on the boy's face, but the boy didn't move or make a sound. Gehazi ran back to Elisha and said, “The boy didn't wake up.”
translation_verse: Gehazi sɛ a hlami, nɛ e ya wo Elisha dɛma tso ɔ nɔ ngɛ jokuɛ ɔ hɛ mi. Se gbi ko pɛ́, nɛ okadi ko hu be nɛ tsɔɔ kaa jokuɛ ɔ ngɛ wami mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpale e se nɛ e kɛ Elisha ba kpe, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Jokuɛ ɔ ti si.”

english_verse: Elisha arrived at the woman's house and went straight to his room, where he saw the boy's body on his bed.
translation_verse: Benɛ Elisha ya su we ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nɔ kake e ya sɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e na jokuɛ ɔ nɛ gbo kɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ e sa a nɔ.

english_verse: He walked in, shut the door, and prayed to the Lord.
translation_verse: E nga sinya a kɛ wo mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a yi, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ.

english_verse: Then he got on the bed and stretched out over the dead body, with his mouth on the boy's mouth, his eyes on his eyes, and his hand on his hands. As he lay there, the boy's body became warm.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Elisha ya bu jokuɛ ɔ nɔ; e kɛ e nya to jokuɛ ɔ nya he, e hɛngmɛhi ngɛ e hɛngmɛhi a nɔ, nɛ e ninehi pueɔ si ngɛ jokuɛ ɔ hu e ninehi a nɔ. Benɛ e kpã e mi ngɛ jokuɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, jokuɛ ɔ he bɔni la dɔmi.

english_verse: Elisha got up and walked back and forth in the room, then he went back and leaned over the boy's body. The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.
translation_verse: Elisha te si nɛ e nyɛɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ho ya bu jokuɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu. Kɛkɛ nɛ jokuɛ ɔ tsile si kpaago; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e bli e hɛngmɛ.

english_verse: Elisha called out to Gehazi, “Ask the boy's mother to come here.” Gehazi did, and when she was at the door, Elisha said, “You can take your son.”
translation_verse: Elisha tsɛ Gehazi nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya tsɛ Shunem yo ɔ kɛ ba!” Benɛ yo ɔ ba a, e de lɛ ke, “Ba he o binyumu ɔ!”

english_verse: She came in and bowed down at Elisha's feet. Then she picked up her son and left. Elisha Makes Some Stew Taste Better
translation_verse: Yo ɔ kpla si ngɛ Elisha nane nya, nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ e ngɔ e binyumu ɔ kɛ je kpo. Nyakpɛ nɔ́ enyɔ kpa komɛ

english_verse: Later, Elisha went back to Gilgal, where there was almost nothing to eat, because the crops had failed. One day while the prophets who lived there were meeting with Elisha, he said to his servant, “Prepare a big pot of stew for these prophets.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Elisha kpale e se kɛ ba Gilgal ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, hwɔ ba zugba a nɔ. Ligbi ko, benɛ gbali a kuu ɔ hii si ngɛ e hɛ mi nɛ e ngɛ mɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, e de e tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Ngɔɔ pɔ buɛ agbo ɔ kɛ ma la nɔ, nɛ o pee ní ha gbali a kuu ɔ nɛ a ye.”

english_verse: One of them went out into the woods to gather some herbs. He found a wild vine and picked as much of its fruit as he could carry, but he didn't know that the fruit was very sour. When he got back, he cut up the fruit and put it in the stew.
translation_verse: A ti nɔ kake ho nga a nɔ ya nɛ e ya tsɔ pui ba kɛ ba; se e ya tsɔ nga mi atlɛ mohu babauu. Benɛ e ba a, e poo a mi tsɔwitsɔwi kɛ wo pɔ buɛ ɔ mi; se e li nɔ́ nɛ ji.

english_verse: The stew was served, and when the prophets started eating it, they shouted, “Elisha, this stew tastes terrible! We can't eat it.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a plɛ flɔɔ ɔ kɛ ha ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ye. Se benɛ a ngɛ ní ɔ yee ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ke, “Mawu nɔmlɔ, duɔ ngɛ ní ɔ mi!” Nɛ a jɔɔ ní ɔ yemi.

english_verse: “Bring me some flour,” Elisha said. He sprinkled the flour in the stew and said, “Now serve it to them.” And the stew tasted fine. Elisha Feeds One Hundred People
translation_verse: Elisha de ke a ha lɛ mamu; nɛ e kɛ mamu ɔ wo buɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Plɛ flɔɔ ɔ ha ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ye!” Jehanɛ, nɔ́ yobu ko be mi hu.

english_verse: So the servant served the bread and grain to the people. They ate and still had some left over, just as the Lord had promised.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ ní ɔ ya ha mɛ. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ, mɛ tsuo a ye; se kɛ̃ ɔ, eko piɛ.

english_verse: Naaman was the commander of the Syrian army. The Lord had helped him and his troops defeat their enemies, so the king of Syria respected Naaman very much. Naaman was a brave soldier, but he had leprosy.
translation_verse: Siria matsɛ ɔ tatsɛ Naeman ji nɔ ko nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ buu lɛ saminya kaa nɔmlɔ agbo; ejakaa Yawɛ gu Naeman nɔ kɛ ha Siria ye kunimi. Katsɛ kpanaa ji lɛ; se he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ e he.

english_verse: One day while the Syrian troops were raiding Israel, they captured a girl, and she became a servant of Naaman's wife.
translation_verse: Be ko mi nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ ba tua Israel ɔ, a nu Israel yiheyo wayoo ko nyɔguɛ kɛ ho, nɛ e ya sɔmɔ Naeman yo ɔ.

english_verse: He also carried the letter to the king of Israel. It said, “I am sending my servant Naaman to you. Would you cure him of his leprosy?”
translation_verse: Womi ɔ nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ ya ha Israel matsɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi ji, “Ke womi nɛ ɔ su o dɛ ɔ, na nɛ o le kaa i ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ Naeman o ngɔ tsɔe, nɛ o tsa e he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a ha lɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha sent someone outside to say to him, “Go wash seven times in the Jordan River. Then you'll be completely cured.”
translation_verse: Elisha tsɔ ya de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya du o he ngɛ Yordan pa a mi si kpaago, kɛkɛ o he womi maa hi ekohu, nɛ o he ma tsɔ!”

english_verse: When the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes in fear and shouted, “That Syrian king believes I can cure this man of leprosy! Does he think I'm God with power over life and death? He must be trying to pick a fight with me.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ kane womi ɔ, e hao wawɛɛ nɛ e hia e tade ɔ nɛ e de ke, “Anɛ Mawu ji mi? Anɛ i ngɛ gbenɔ kɛ wami nɔ he wami loko nyumu nɛ ɔ maa tsɔ nɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ ma tsa e he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a ha lɛ lo? E fɔɔ si paa kaa munyu kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ hlae ngɛ ye he!”

english_verse: As soon as Elisha the prophet heard what had happened, he sent the Israelite king this message: “Why are you so afraid? Send the man to me, so that he will know there is a prophet in Israel.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ Elisha nu sane nɛ ba a, e tsɔ ya de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni he je o hao kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Ha nɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ e maa na kaa gbalɔ ko ngɛ Israel.”

english_verse: Naaman left with his horses and chariots and stopped at the door of Elisha's house.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Naeman kɛ e we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ zugba lɛ ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya da si ngɛ Elisha we ɔ agbo ɔ nya.

english_verse: But Naaman stormed off, grumbling, “Why couldn't he come out and talk to me? I thought for sure he would stand in front of me and pray to the Lord his God, then wave his hand over my skin and cure me.
translation_verse: Se Naeman mi mi fu, nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ e yaa a, e de ke, “Hyɛ, i susu kaa e ma ba da si ngɛ ye kasa nya nɛ e ma tsɛ Yawɛ e Mawu ɔ biɛ; nɛ e maa fɔ̃ e nine ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ ya kɛ ba, nɛ e ma tsa mi.

english_verse: What about the Abana River or the Pharpar River? Those rivers in Damascus are just as good as any river in Israel. I could have washed in them and been cured.”
translation_verse: Damasko pahi, Abana kɛ Farpar a, anɛ a hí pi pa amɛ tsuo ngɛ Israel lo? Anɛ i ko du we ngɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a mi nɛ ye he nɛ tsɔ lo?”

english_verse: His servants went over to him and said, “Sir, if the prophet had told you to do something difficult, you would have done it. So why don't you do what he said? Go wash and be cured.”
translation_verse: E tsɔli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ! Nɔ́ nguaa ko nɛ gbalɔ ɔ fa mo ke o pee jinɛ o ko pee we lo? Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o be nyɛe nɛ o ya du o he kɛkɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e de ɔ, konɛ a tsa mo ɔ?”

english_verse: Naaman walked down to the Jordan; he waded out into the water and stooped down in it seven times, just as Elisha had told him. At once, he was cured, and his skin became as smooth as a child's.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Naeman pue nɔ kɛ ho Yordan pa a mi ya, nɛ e mu kɛ ya nyu ɔ sisi si kpaago kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ fa lɛ ɔ. Nɛ a tsa lɛ. E he womi tsake nɛ e pee kaa jokuɛyo he womi ekohu.

english_verse: Naaman and his officials went back to Elisha. Naaman stood in front of him and announced, “Now I know that the God of Israel is the only God in the whole world. Sir, would you please accept a gift from me?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo kpale kɛ ho Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Kpaako loko i na kaa Mawu ko Mawu ko be je ɔ mi he ko he ko kaa ja Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, nike ní bɔɔ ko nɛ i hɛɛ kɛ ba ha mo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: “I am a servant of the living Lord,” Elisha answered, “and I swear that I will not take anything from you.” Naaman kept begging, but Elisha kept refusing.
translation_verse: Elisha he nɔ ke, “I na Mawu nɛ i sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ kaa i be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hee!” Naeman nyɛ e nɔ ke e he kɛkɛ; se e kplɛɛ we.

english_verse: Finally Naaman said, “If you won't accept a gift, then please let me take home as much soil as two mules can pull in a wagon. Sir, from now on I will offer sacrifices only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Naeman de ke, “Lɛɛ ke ja a, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ a ha mi tabo zu teji okpɔngɔ enyɔ a yi tlomi nɛ ma kɛ ya. Ejakaa kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, i be sami bɔ, loo bɔ kpa ko sãe ha mawu kpa komɛ hu kaa ja Yawɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: But I pray that the Lord will forgive me when I go into the temple of the god Rimmon and bow down there with the king of Syria.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa ke i nyɛɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ se kɛ ya Siria mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Rimon ɔ we ɔ, nɛ i ya ja lɛ ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pa mi. Niinɛ, Yawɛ kɛ maa pa mi.”

english_verse: “Go on home, and don't worry about that,” Elisha replied. Then Naaman left. Elisha Places a Curse on Gehazi After Naaman had gone only a short distance,
translation_verse: Elisha de lɛ ke, “Yaa ngɛ he jɔmi mi.” Benɛ Naeman je ɔ, e kɛ we kulaa

english_verse: Gehazi said to himself, “Elisha let that Syrian off too easy. He should have taken Naaman's gift. I swear by the living Lord that I will talk to Naaman myself and get something from him.”
translation_verse: nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ Elisha tsɔlɔ Gehazi de ke, “Hyɛ kaa ye nyɔmtsɛ ngɔ Naeman, Siria no nɛ ɔ he ngɔ ke lɛ; nɔ́ nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ ba a hu, e he we ngɛ e dɛ. I na Mawu, ma tu fo kɛ fie e se nɛ ma ya he nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ.”

english_verse: So he hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw Gehazi running after him, he got out of his chariot to meet him. Naaman asked, “Is everything all right?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Gehazi nyɛɛ Naeman se. Benɛ Naeman na kaa nɔ ko ma ngɛ e se kɛ fo ɔ, e kple si kɛ je zugba lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba kpe. E bi lɛ ke, “Sane ko he je lo?”

english_verse: “Yes,” Gehazi answered. “But my master has sent me to tell you about two young prophets from the hills of Ephraim. They came asking for help, and now Elisha wants to know if you would give them
translation_verse: Gehazi he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi! I hɛɛ we sane yobu ko. Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ba de mo ke amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɛ gbali a kuu ɔ mi nihewi enyɔ je Efraim yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ha mɛ sika hiɔ yi akpe etɛ, kɛ he dlami tade saminyawiiwi enyɔ.”

english_verse: “Sure,” Naaman replied. “But why don't you take twice that amount of silver?” He convinced Gehazi to take it all, then put the silver in two bags. He handed the bags and the clothes to his two servants, and they carried them for Gehazi.
translation_verse: Naeman de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mo he sika hiɔ yi akpe ekpa.” E nyɛ e nɔ, nɛ e fi sika hiɔ yi akpe ekpa a kɛ wo kotoku enyɔ a mi; nɛ e ngɔ he dlami tade saminyawiiwi enyɔ ngɔ piɛ he ngɔ tloo e tsɔli enyɔ kɛ nyɛɛ Gehazi hɛ mi.

english_verse: When they reached the hill where Gehazi lived, he took the bags from the servants and placed them in his house, then sent the men away. After they had gone,
translation_verse: Benɛ a ya su yoku ɔ he ɔ, Gehazi he ní ɔmɛ ngɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ kɛ ya to we ɔ mi; nɛ e wo mɛ blɔ.

english_verse: Gehazi went in and stood in front of Elisha, who asked, “Gehazi, where have you been?” “Nowhere, sir,” Gehazi answered.
translation_verse: Benɛ Gehazi kpale kɛ ba we ɔ mi ɔ, e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Jije o je?” Nɛ e he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, i yɛ he ko he ko.”

english_verse: Elisha asked, “Don't you know that my spirit was there when Naaman got out of his chariot to talk with you? Gehazi, you have no right to accept money or clothes, olive orchards or vineyards, sheep or cattle, or servants.
translation_verse: Se Elisha de lɛ ke, “Anɛ benɛ nyumu ɔ kple si kɛ je e zugba lɛ ɔ mi nɛ e kɛ mo ba kpe ɔ, i be lejɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi mi lo? Anɛ be nɛ a kɛ heɔ sika, loo tadehi, loo oliv abɔɔhi, loo wai ngmɔhi, loo tohi, loo nahi, loo mawahi ji nɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: Because of what you've done, Naaman's leprosy will now be on you and your descendants forever!” Suddenly, Gehazi's skin became white with leprosy, and he left.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Naeman he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a ma ba pue o he, nɛ o kɛ o nina maa nu hiɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.” Benɛ Gehazi je lejɛ ɔ, he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya pue e he, nɛ e he womi pee patapata kaa ngo.

english_verse: One day the prophets said to Elisha, “The place where we meet with you is too small.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko ɔ, gbali a kuu ɔ nɛ Elisha ngɛ a nɔ hyɛe ɔ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, he nɛ wa ngɛ nɛ ɔ klee we ha wɔ hu.

english_verse: Why don't we build a new meeting place near the Jordan River? Each of us could get some wood, then we could build it.” “That's a good idea,” Elisha replied, “get started.”
translation_verse: Ha nɛ waa ya Yordan pa a nya nɛ wa ya poo tso kakaaka nɛ wa kɛ pee sihi he ha wa he.” E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya!”

english_verse: “Aren't you going with us?” one of the prophets asked. “Yes, I'll go,” Elisha answered,
translation_verse: A ti nɔ kake kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e kɛ mɛ nɛ ya; nɛ e kplɛɛ nɔ

english_verse: and he left with them. They went to the Jordan River and began chopping down trees.
translation_verse: nɛ e kɛ mɛ ho. Benɛ a ya su Yordan pa a nya a, a bɔni tso ɔmɛ hɛɛmi pue si.

english_verse: “Where did it fall in?” Elisha asked. The prophet pointed to the place, and Elisha cut a stick and threw it into the water at that spot. The ax head floated to the top of the water.
translation_verse: Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Jije e nɔ?” Nyumu ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ he nɛ gbiɛ ɔ nɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha po tso nɛ e sake kɛ fɔ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha dade ɔ ba je nyu hɛ.

english_verse: “Now get it,” Elisha told him. And the prophet reached in and grabbed it. Elisha Stops an Invasion of the Syrian Army
translation_verse: Elisha de nyumu ɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya kɛ̃!” Nɛ e juale e nine nɛ e kɛ̃ dade ɔ. A ye Siria tabo ɔ nɔ kunimi

english_verse: Time after time, when the king of Syria was at war against the Israelites, he met with his officers and announced, “I've decided where we will set up camp.”
translation_verse: Be ko ɔ, Siria matsɛ kɛ Israel na ta, nɛ e kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ so kaa a ma ya bua a he nya ngɛ he ko.

english_verse: Each time, Elisha would send this warning to the king of Israel: “Don't go near there. That's where the Syrian troops have set up camp.”
translation_verse: Se Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ tsɔ ya naa Israel matsɛ ɔ nane nɔ ke e ko ya lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa Siria bi ɔmɛ ma ya wo ka ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The king of Syria was furious when he found out what was happening. He called in his officers and asked, “Which one of you has been telling the king of Israel our plans?”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao Siria matsɛ ɔ juɛmi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ se? Anɛ nyɛ be mi dee lo?”

english_verse: “None of us, Your Majesty,” one of them answered. “It's an Israelite named Elisha. He's a prophet, so he can tell his king everything—even what you say in your own room.”
translation_verse: E tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ! Pi nɔ ko nɔ ko! Gbalɔ Elisha nɛ ngɛ Israel ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ke o tu munyu ngɛ o se tsu mi po nɛ e deɔ Israel matsɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: “Find out where he is!” the king ordered. “I'll send soldiers to bring him here.” They learned that Elisha was in the town of Dothan and reported it to the king.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ fa ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya hla e hi he, konɛ ma tsɔ nɛ a ya nu lɛ kɛ ba!” Benɛ a ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ kaa Elisha ngɛ Dotan ɔ,

english_verse: He ordered his best troops to go there with horses and chariots. They marched out during the night and surrounded the town.
translation_verse: e wo ta buli babauu blɔ, kɛ okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta zugba lɛhi kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya. A ya su lejɛ ɔ nyɔ mi, nɛ a sa ma a yi.

english_verse: When Elisha's servant got up the next morning, he saw that Syrian troops had the town surrounded. “Sir, what are we going to do?” he asked.
translation_verse: Makɛ mla a, Mawu nɔmlɔ Elisha tsɔlɔ ɔ te si momo. Benɛ e je kpo ɔ, e na kaa ta buli, okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta zugba lɛhi bɔle ma a kɛ kpe. Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “Akuanyɛ! Ye nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?”

english_verse: “Don't be afraid,” Elisha answered. “There are more troops on our side than on theirs.”
translation_verse: Elisha de lɛ ke, “Koo ye gbeye! Nimli nɛ ngɛ wa se ɔ, a hiɛ babauu pe ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mɛɛ a se ɔ.”

english_verse: Then he prayed, “Lord, please help him to see.” And the Lord let the servant see that the hill was covered with fiery horses and flaming chariots all around Elisha.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha sɔle nɛ e de ke “Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, bli e hɛngmɛ nɛ e hyɛ nɔ́.” Yawɛ bli niheyo ɔ hɛngmɛ; nɛ benɛ e ke e hyɛɛ ɔ, la okpɔngɔhi, kɛ la ta zugba lɛhi babauu ji nɛ ɔ ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ nɛ bɔle Elisha kɛ kpe.

english_verse: As the Syrian army came closer, Elisha prayed, “Lord, make those soldiers blind!” And the Lord blinded them with a bright light.
translation_verse: Benɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ ba tua Elisha a, e fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ nɛ yu!” Yawɛ bu e kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ e ha a hɛ yu.

english_verse: Elisha told the enemy troops, “You've taken the wrong road and are in the wrong town. Follow me. I'll lead you to the man you're looking for.” Elisha led them straight to the capital city of Samaria.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha de mɛ ke, “Ma a nɛ nyɛ yaa mi ɔ, pi lɛ ji nɛ ɔ; nyɛ tla blɔ. Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ye se, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa ya nyumu ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ ngɔ!” Nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ ho Samaria ya.

english_verse: When all the soldiers were inside the city, Elisha prayed, “Lord, now let them see again.” The Lord let them see that they were standing in the middle of Samaria.
translation_verse: Benɛ a su Samaria a, Elisha sɔle nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, bli nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛngmɛ, nɛ a hyɛ nɔ́!” Yawɛ bli a hɛngmɛ nɛ a na kaa a ngɛ Samaria ma a mi.

english_verse: The king of Israel saw them and asked Elisha, “Should I kill them, sir?”
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ na mɛ ɔ, e bi Elisha ke, “Tsaatsɛ, ma gbe mɛ lo? Ma gbe mɛ lo?”

english_verse: “No!” Elisha answered. “You didn't capture these troops in battle, so you have no right to kill them. Instead, give them something to eat and drink and let them return to their leader.”
translation_verse: E he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi! Koo gbe mɛ! Nimli nɛ o ya nuu nyɔguɛ kɛ o klaate kɛ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ po, anɛ o maa gbe mɛ lo? Ha mɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a ye, nɛ o ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya.”

english_verse: The king ordered a huge meal to be prepared for Syria's army, and when they finished eating, he let them go. For a while, the Syrian troops stopped invading Israel's territory. King Benhadad of Syria Attacks Samaria
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ ngmɛ mɛ okplɔɔ agbo. Benɛ a ye ní nɛ a nu nɔ́ ko ɔ, e wo mɛ blɔ; nɛ a kpale kɛ ho Siria matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya. Kɛ je lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Siria bi ɔmɛ ya tua we Israel zugba a hu. A sa Samaria yi

english_verse: Some time later, King Benhadad of Syria called his entire army together, then they marched to Samaria and attacked.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Siria matsɛ, Benhadad bua e tabo ɔ nya, nɛ e ya sa Samaria yi.

english_verse: They kept up the attack until there was nothing to eat in the city. In fact, a donkey's head cost
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, hwɔ nɛ nya wa ba Samaria hluu kɛ ya si a jua teji yi tɔ kake sika hiɔ yi nyingmi kpaanyɔ. Lahuɛ fĩ hu he jua ji sika hiɔ yi enuɔ.

english_verse: One day as the king of Israel was walking along the top of the city wall, a woman shouted to him, “Please, Your Majesty, help me!”
translation_verse: Ligbi ko, benɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ bɔle ma a nɔ ɔ, yo ko kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ, mo wa mi!”

english_verse: “Let the Lord help you!” the king said. “Do you think I have grain or wine to give you?”
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ke Yawɛ nitsɛ wa we mo ɔ, kɛ imi lɛɛ ma pee kɛ wa mo kɛɛ? Anɛ i ngɛ ngma, aloo wai?

english_verse: Then he asked, “What's the matter anyway?” The woman answered, “Another woman and I were so hungry that we agreed to eat our sons. She said if we ate my son one day, we could eat hers the next day.
translation_verse: Mɛni ji o sane ɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Ligbi ko ɔ, yo nɛ ɔ de mi ke ma ngɔ ye binyumuyo ɔ kɛ ba nɛ waa ye, konɛ e nɔ jena nɛ waa ye lɛ hu e binyumuyo ɔ.

english_verse: So yesterday we cooked my son and ate him. But today when I went to her house to eat her son, she had hidden him.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ wa hoo ye binyumuyo ɔ nɛ wa ye. E nɔ jena a, i de lɛ ke e ngɔ e binyumuyo ɔ kɛ ba nɛ waa ye; se e ngɔ lɛ kɛ laa.”

english_verse: The king tore off his clothes in sorrow, and since he was on top of the city wall, the people saw that he was wearing sackcloth underneath.
translation_verse: Benɛ matsɛ ɔ nu nɔ́ nɛ yo ɔ de ɔ, e hao nɛ e hía e tade ɔmɛ. Nɛ benɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ, ma a na lɛ; nɛ a yɔse kaa e bu kpekpe ngɛ e tade ɔmɛ a sisi.

english_verse: He said, “I pray that God will punish me terribly, if Elisha's head is still on his shoulders by this time tomorrow.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de ke, “Ke i ha we nɛ a po Shafat binyumu Elisha yi mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ fii, Mawu nɛ gbe mi!”

english_verse: Then he sent a messenger to Elisha. Elisha was home at the time, and the important leaders of Israel were meeting with him. Even before the king's messenger arrived, Elisha told the leaders, “That murderer is sending someone to cut off my head. When you see him coming, shut the door and don't let him in. I'm sure the king himself will be right behind him.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e tsɔ nyumu ko ke e ya tsɛ Elisha kɛ ba. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Elisha kɛ ma nimeli komɛ nɛ ma lɛ slaami ɔ hii si ngɛ e we ɔ mi. Benɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ na we nɛ e su we ɔ mi ɔ, Elisha de ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ na kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ nɛ ɔ tsɔ nɛ́ a ba po ye yi! Nyɛ le piɔ, ke tsɔlɔ ɔ ba a, nyɛ nga sinya a, nɛ nyɛ ko ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e sɛ tsu ɔ mi. Matsɛ ɔ nitsɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ma.”

english_verse: Before Elisha finished talking, the messenger came up and said, “The Lord has made all these terrible things happen to us. Why should I think he will help us now?”
translation_verse: Benɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ munyu tue, nɛ e nya na we nɛ e nɔ si ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ba hia kpo; nɛ e de ke, “Haomi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ e je! Lɛɛ mɛni he i pa ngɛ Yawɛ mlɛe ma pee mɔ?”

english_verse: Elisha answered, “I have a message for you. The Lord promises that tomorrow here in Samaria, you will be able to buy a large sack of flour or two large sacks of barley for almost nothing.”
translation_verse: Se Elisha de ke, “Nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ munyu tue! Yawɛ ke, hwɔɔ maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a maa jua ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ, sika hiɔ yi kake; nɛ a ma he blɛfo kilo ekpa hu sika hiɔ yi kake ngɛ Samaria ma a agbo ɔ nya.”

english_verse: The chief officer there with the king replied, “I don't believe it! Even if the Lord sent a rainstorm, it couldn't produce that much grain by tomorrow.” “You will see it happen, but you won't eat any of the food,” Elisha warned him. The Syrian Army Stops Its Attack
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛngua a de Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ke, “Ke Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ tlukaa po, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be mi bae.” Elisha he nɔ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ o hɛngmɛ, se o be ní ɔ eko yee!” Siria tabo ɔ je Samaria

english_verse: About the same time, four men with leprosy were just outside the gate of Samaria. They said to each other, “Why should we sit here, waiting to die?
translation_verse: Nyumuhi eywiɛ komɛ nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ a he hi Samaria ma a agbo ɔ nya. Ligbi ko ɔ, a de a he ke, “Mɛni he je wa maa hi si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si wa ma gbo ɔ?

english_verse: There's nothing to eat in the city, so we would starve if we went inside. But if we stay out here, we will die for sure. Let's sneak over to the Syrian army camp and surrender. They might kill us, but they might not.”
translation_verse: Ke wa ke wa maa sɛ ma a mi ɔ, hwɔ maa gbe wɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke wa hii si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ hu, wa ma gbo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa je kɛ ho Siria bi ɔmɛ a ma sito he ɔ ya. Ke a he wa yi wami ɔ, wa maa tlɔ je mi; ke a gbe wɔ hu gbenɔ kake ɔ kɛ̃.”

english_verse: That evening the four men got up and left for the Syrian camp. As they walked toward the camp, the Lord caused the Syrian troops to hear what sounded like the roar of a huge cavalry. The soldiers said to each other, “Listen! The king of Israel must have hired Hittite and Egyptian troops to attack us. Let's get out of here!” So they ran out of their camp that night, leaving their tents and horses and donkeys. When the four men with leprosy reached the edge of the Syrian camp, no one was there. They walked into one of the tents, where they ate and drank, before carrying off clothes, as well as silver and gold. They hid all this, then walked into another tent; they took what they wanted and hid it too.
translation_verse: Benɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nuli ɔmɛ ba su ma sito he ɔ nya a, a sɛ bo tsu kake mi, nɛ a ya ye ní nɛ a nu ní. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a muɔ sika hiɔ, sika tsu, kɛ bohi kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya to he ko. A kpale a se kɛ ba ekohu ba sɛ bo tsu kpa mi, nɛ a muɔ níhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hulɔ kɛ ya to.

english_verse: They said to each other, “This isn't right. Today is a day to celebrate, and we haven't told anyone else what has happened. If we wait until morning, we will be punished. Let's go to the king's palace at once and tell the good news.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a de a sibi ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ hí! Wa ye manye mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Ke wa pee dii nɛ wa mlɛ kɛ ya si mɔtu loko wa ya de ɔ, a maa gbla wa tue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ho nɛ wa ya bɔ matsɛ we ɔ amaniɛ.”

english_verse: They went back to Samaria and shouted up to the guards at the gate, “We've just come from the Syrian army camp, and all the soldiers are gone! The tents are empty, and the horses and donkeys are still tied up. We didn't see or hear anybody.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a ho nɛ a ya tsɛ ma agbo nya buli ɔmɛ nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Wa ya Siria bi ɔmɛ a ma sito he ɔ, se wa nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; wa nui nɔ ko nɔ ko nya hulɔ. A fi okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ teji ɔmɛ kɛ muɔ si, nɛ bo tsu ɔmɛ fɔɔ si kaa bɔ nɛ a si mɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The guards reported the news to the king's palace.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ agbo nya buli ɔmɛ he ose; nɛ a ho ya bɔ matsɛ we ɔ amaniɛ.

english_verse: The king got out of bed and said to his officers, “I know what those Syrians are doing. They know we're starving, so they're hiding in the fields, hoping we will go out to look for food. When we do, they can capture us and take over our city.”
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ te si nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu, nɛ e de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Ma tsɔɔ nyɛ ga nɛ Siria bi nɛ ɔmɛ to ngɔ wo wa he ɔ. A le kaa hwɔ ngɛ wɔ yee; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a je a ma sito he ɔ nɛ a ya laa a he ngɛ nga a nɔ. A susu kaa ke a pee ja a, wa maa je ma a mi, kɛkɛ a ma ba sɛ ma a mi nɛ a nuu wɔ hɛ ngmengmle.”

english_verse: One of his officers replied, “We have a few horses left—why don't we let some men take five of them and go to the Syrian camp and see what's happening? We're going to die anyway like those who have already died.”
translation_verse: E tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake wo ga ke, “Nimli nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, hɛ nɔ kami ko be ha mɛ; a ngɛ kaa Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ mɛɛ a gbo momo ɔ kɛ̃. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa tsɔ ni komɛ nɛ a ngɔ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a piɛ ɔ enuɔ kɛ ya, nɛ a ya hyɛ kaa mɛni tutuutu lɛ ba Siria ta buli ɔmɛ a nɔ lo.”

english_verse: The men rode as far as the Jordan River. All along the way they saw clothes and equipment that the Syrians had thrown away as they escaped. Then they went back to the king and told him what they had seen.
translation_verse: Tsɔli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ ya su Yordan pa a nya tɔɔ. Benɛ a yaa a, a na tadehi, kɛ ní kpa komɛ nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ sake ngɔ pue blɔ ɔ tue benɛ a ngɛ fo tue esɔesɔ ɔ. Tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ba nɛ a ba bɔ matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ.

english_verse: At once the people went to the Syrian camp and carried off what was left. They took so much that a large sack of flour and two large sacks of barley sold for almost nothing, just as the Lord had promised.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Samaria bi ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya ha ní ngɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ a ma sito he ɔ. Nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ, a jua mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ sika hiɔ yi kake, kɛ blɛfo kilo ekpa hu sika hiɔ yi kake.

english_verse: The king of Israel had put his chief officer in charge of the gate, but he died when the people trampled him as they rushed out of the city.
translation_verse: E ba mi kaa Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɔ e we asafoatsɛngua a kɛ to ma a agbo ɔ nya. Se ma a naa e nɔ ngɛ agbo ɔ nya nɛ e gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ de benɛ matsɛ ɔ ba e ngɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Earlier, when the king was at Elisha's house, Elisha had told him that flour or barley would sell for almost nothing.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Hwɔɔ, maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a maa jua blɛfo kilo ekpa, aloo ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ sika hiɔ yi kake ngɛ Samaria” a,

english_verse: But the officer refused to believe that even the Lord could do that. So Elisha warned him that he would see it happen, but would not eat any of the food.
translation_verse: asafoatsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ke Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ tlukaa po, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be mi bae.” Elisha de lɛ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ o hɛngmɛ, se o be ní ɔ eko yee!”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the king was asking Gehazi the servant of Elisha about the amazing things Elisha had been doing.
translation_verse: E ya na Mawu nɔmlɔ Elisha tsɔlɔ Gehazi nɛ e kɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ ní sɛɛe. Matsɛ ɔ de Gehazi ke, “Moo gba mi nyakpɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Elisha pee ɔ.”

english_verse: Some time later Elisha went to the capital city of Damascus to visit King Benhadad of Syria, who was sick. And when Benhadad was told he was there,
translation_verse: Elisha ya Damasko; nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ, Siria matsɛ, Benhadad be he wami. Benɛ a ya bɔ matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ ke Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ba lejɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Hazael left with forty camel loads of the best things made in Damascus as a gift for Elisha. He found the prophet and said, “Your servant, King Benhadad, wants to know if he will get well.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Hazael pue nɔ kɛ ho Elisha ngɔ ya. E hɛɛ nike níhi nɛ ji Damasko ní kpakpa amɛ tsuo eko tsuaa eko afukpɔngɔ nyingmi eywiɛ yi tlomi kɛ ho. Benɛ e ya na Elisha a, e de lɛ ke, “O binyumu Benhadad, Siria matsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi ke ma ba bi mo ke hiɔ nɛ e ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ, e ma na he wami lo?”

english_verse: “Tell him he will,” Elisha said to Hazael. “But the Lord has already told me that Benhadad will definitely die.”
translation_verse: Elisha de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ je tsɔɔ mi kaa e ma gbo; se kɛ̃ ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya de lɛ ke e ma na he wami.”

english_verse: “Sir, why are you crying?” Hazael asked. Elisha answered, “Because I know the terrible things you will do to the people of Israel. You will burn down their walled cities and slaughter their young men. You will even crush the heads of their babies and rip open their pregnant women.”
translation_verse: Hazael bi lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni he je o ngɛ ya foe ɔ?” Elisha he nɔ ke, “Ejakaa i le ní yayamihi nɛ o maa pee Israel ma a. O maa mɛ a mɔ ɔmɛ a he la; o kɛ klaate maa gbe a nihewi ɔmɛ; o maa ngɔ a bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ kɛ fia si, nɛ a maa ku dukuduku. Yihɔyi ɔmɛ lɛɛ o ma gba a muklii ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: “How could I ever do anything like that?” Hazael replied. “I'm only a servant and don't have that kind of power.” “Hazael, the Lord has told me that you will be the next king of Syria.”
translation_verse: Hazael bi lɛ ke, “Imi o tsɔlɔ nɛ i ngɛ kaa gbe kɛkɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ ji mi nɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nguaa kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Elisha he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ lɛ je tsɔɔ mi kaa mo lɛ o ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ Siria ma a nɔ.”

english_verse: But the very next day, Hazael got a thick blanket; he soaked it in water and held it over Benhadad's face until he died. Hazael then became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Se e nɔ jena a, Hazael ngɔ sa nɔ bo kɛ wo nyu mi nɛ e kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ya si e mumi nya ta nɛ e gbo. Nɛ Hazael ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se. Yuda matsɛ, Yehoram (Kronika II,

english_verse: While Jehoram was king, the people of Edom rebelled and chose their own king.
translation_verse: Yehoram yi nɔ ɔ, Edom tsɔ Yuda hɛ mi atuã, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ya wo matsɛ kɛ ha a he.

english_verse: Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat became king of Judah in Joram's fifth year as king of Israel, while Jehoshaphat was still king of Judah.
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Yoram, Ahab binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha enuɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Yehoshafat binyumu Yehoram ba bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda.

english_verse: Jehoram disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He married Ahab's daughter and was as sinful as Ahab's family and the kings of Israel.
translation_verse: E ngɔ Ahab biyo; nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Ahab we ɔ pee ɔ, lɛ hu e ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord refused to destroy Judah, because he had promised his servant David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ sume kaa e ma kpata Yuda hɛ mi, ejakaa e wo e tsɔlɔ David si kaa e nina maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoram did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Yehoram he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Jehoram died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Ahaziah then became king. King Ahaziah of Judah (
translation_verse: Yehoram ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Ahazia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se. Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia (Kronika II,

english_verse: Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah in the twelfth year of Joram's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Yoram, Ahab binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Yehoram binyumu Ahazia bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda.

english_verse: Since Ahaziah was related to Ahab's family, he acted just like them and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ahazia ngatsɛ ji matsɛ Ahab. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Ahab we ɔ pee ɔ, Ahazia hu ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.

english_verse: Ahaziah went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Matsɛ Ahazia ya piɛ Israel matsɛ, Yoram, Ahab binyumu ɔ he nɛ a kɛ Siria matsɛ, Hazael ya hwu ta ngɛ Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ. Nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ plaa Yoram.

english_verse: so he went to the town of Jezreel to recover. Ahaziah went there to visit him.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Yoram kpale e se kɛ ba Yezreel konɛ e ba tsa e he, nɛ Yuda matsɛ Ahazia, Yehoram binyumu ɔ bu e nɔ nɛ e ya slaa lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: One day, Elisha called for one of the other prophets and said: Take this bottle of olive oil and get ready to go to the town of Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ Elisha tsɛ gbali a kuu ɔ mi no kake, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mo dla o he nɛ o hɛɛ nu kɛ tɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ ya Ramot ngɛ Gilead.

english_verse: When you get there, find Jehu son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi. Take him to a place where the two of you can be alone,
translation_verse: Ke o su lejɛ ɔ, yaa hla Yehoshafat binyumu Yehu, Nimshi bibi ɔ se blɔ. Ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ je e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ya se tsu mi.

english_verse: then pour olive oil on his head to show that he is the new king. Say to him, “The Lord has chosen you to be king of Israel.” Then leave quickly—don't wait around for anything!
translation_verse: Plɛ nu ɔ nɛ ngɛ tɔ ɔ mi ɔ ngɔ pue e yi mi, nɛ o de ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. I ngɛ mo nu pɔe kɛ ngɛ mo matsɛ woe ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, bli sinya a nɛ o je lejɛ ɔ esɔesɔ; koo to tsle.”

english_verse: The young prophet left for Ramoth.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ niheyo ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho Ramot Gilead ya.

english_verse: When he arrived, the army officers were meeting together. “Sir, I have a message for you,” he said. “For which one of us?” Jehu asked. “You, sir,” the prophet answered.
translation_verse: Benɛ e su lejɛ ɔ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe; nɛ e de ke, “Asafoatsɛ, i hɛɛ sɛ kɛ ha mo.” Yehu bi lɛ ke, “Wa ti mɛnɔ?” Nɛ e he nɔ ke, “Mo asafoatsɛ!”

english_verse: So Jehu got up and went inside. The prophet poured olive oil on Jehu's head and told him: The Lord God of Israel has this message for you: “I am the Lord, and I have chosen you to be king of my people Israel.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehu be kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ niheyo ɔ plɛ nu ɔ kɛ pue e yi mi, nɛ e de ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘I ngɛ mo nu pɔe kɛ ngɛ mo Yawɛ ma nɛ ji Israel ɔ nɔ matsɛ woe.

english_verse: I want you to wipe out the family of Ahab, so Jezebel will be punished for killing the prophets and my other servants.
translation_verse: O ma kpata o nyɔmtsɛ Ahab we ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ i kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ye ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ imi Yawɛ, ye tsɔli kpa amɛ tsuo a muɔ nɛ Yezebel pue si ɔ he lue.

english_verse: His whole family must be destroyed, just like the families of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.
translation_verse: Ma pee Ahab we ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Nebat binyumu Yeroboam, kɛ Ahija binyumu Baasha a we ɔmɛ ɔ.

english_verse: As for Jezebel, her body will be eaten by dogs in the town of Jezreel. There won't be enough left of her to bury.” Then the young prophet opened the door and ran out.
translation_verse: Yezebel lɛɛ nɔ ko be lɛ pue; gbehi maa ye lɛ ngɛ Yezreel zugba a nɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ niheyo ɔ bli sinya a, nɛ e tu fo kɛ je.

english_verse: Jehu went back to his officers, and one of them asked, “What did that crazy prophet want? Is everything all right?” “You know him and how he talks,” Jehu answered.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yehu kpale e se kɛ ba e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni kikɛmɛ a godotsɛ nɛ ɔ ba hlami ngɛ o ngɔ? Manye munyu e hɛɛ kɛ ba lo?” E he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le nɔmlɔ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e munyu tumi ngɛ ha.”

english_verse: “No, we don't. What did he say?” they asked. “He had a message from the Lord,” Jehu replied. “He said that the Lord has chosen me to be the next king of Israel.”
translation_verse: A de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi! Mo de wɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e bɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ niheyo ɔ ba de lɛ ɔ. E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘I ngɛ mo nu pɔe kɛ ngɛ mo matsɛ woe ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.’ ”

english_verse: They quickly grabbed their coats and spread them out on the steps where Jehu was standing. Someone blew a trumpet, and everyone shouted, “Jehu is king!” Jehu Kills Joram and Ahaziah
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yehu nyɛmimɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ je a he tade ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ ha kpoku ɔ nɔ ha lɛ nɛ e da nɔ. A kpa titimati nɛ a de ke, “Yehu ji matsɛ!” A gbe Israel matsɛ, Yoram

english_verse: When the guard in the watchtower at Jezreel saw Jehu and his men riding up, he shouted to the king, “I see a large group of men coming this way.” Joram ordered, “Send someone out to ask them if this is a friendly visit.”
translation_verse: Bulɔ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Yezreel mɔ ɔ yi mi ɔ na Yehu kɛ tabo nɛ a ma; nɛ e de ke, “I na tabo ko nɛ ma.” Yoram de lɛ ke, “Moo tsɔ okpɔngɔ ta bulɔ ko nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya kpe, nɛ e bi mɛ ke manye nyɛɛmi nɛ a nyɛɛ lo.”

english_verse: One of the soldiers rode out and said to Jehu, “King Joram wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just stay behind me with the rest of my troops!” About the same time the guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back.”
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ ɔ hi okpɔngɔ nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e kɛ Yehu ya kpe; nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Matsɛ ɔ ke ma bi nyɛ ke manye nyɛɛmi nɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ ɔ lo?” Yehu he nɔ ke, “Mɛni manye munyu kɔɔ ngɛ o he? Bee nɛ o ya nyɛɛ ye se!” Bulɔ ɔ ya bɔ matsɛ ɔ ke, “Tsɔlɔ ɔ ya su a ngɔ, se e kpale we e se kɛ bɛ hu.”

english_verse: So Joram sent out another rider, who rode up to Jehu and said, “The king wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just get behind me with the rest of my troops!”
translation_verse: Yoram tsɔ okpɔngɔ ta bulɔ enyɔne kɛ ho. Benɛ e ya su a ngɔ ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Matsɛ ɔ ke ma bi nyɛ ke, ‘Manye nyɛɛmi nɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ ɔ lo?’ ” Yehu he nɔ ke, “Pi o he sane ko ji lɔ ɔ; bee nɛ o ya nyɛɛ ye se!”

english_verse: The guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back either. Wait a minute! That one man is a reckless chariot driver—it must be Jehu!”
translation_verse: Bulɔ ɔ ya bɔ matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ ekohu ke, “Tsɔlɔ ɔ ya su a ngɔ, se e kpale we e se kɛ bɛ hu. Jehanɛ hu, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔ ngɛ e ní pee gidigidi kaa Nimshi bibi Yehu.”

english_verse: Joram commanded, “Get my chariot ready.” Then he and Ahaziah got in their chariots and rode out to meet Jehu. They all met on the land that had belonged to Naboth.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoram fa ke, “Nyɛɛ mia ye ta zugba lɛ ɔ!” A pee ja; nɛ Israel matsɛ, Yoram kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia je kpo, nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ya hi lɛ nitsɛ e ta zugba lɛ mi, nɛ a ho nɛ a kɛ Yehu ya kpe. A ya na lɛ ngɛ Nabot, Yezreel no ɔ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Joram asked, “Jehu, is this a peaceful visit?” “How can there be peace?” Jehu asked. “Your mother Jezebel has caused everyone to worship idols and practice witchcraft.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yoram na Yehu ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “Yehu, o ba kɛ tue mi jɔmi lo?” Yehu he nɔ ke, “Tue mi jɔmi? Yayami babauu nɛ o nyɛ Yezebel pee, nyuami kɛ amaga jami nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, mɛni tue mi jɔmi ma pa hi si?”

english_verse: Jehu shot an arrow. It hit Joram between his shoulders, then it went through his heart and came out his chest. He fell over dead in his chariot.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehu kɛ e he wami tsuo tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ kɛ gu Yoram kotimi. Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ ya gbɔ e tsui mi; nɛ e gbo kɛ fɔ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Jehu commanded his assistant Bidkar, “Get Joram's body and throw it in the field that Naboth once owned. Do you remember when you and I used to ride side by side behind Joram's father Ahab? translation_verse: ‘Niinɛ, hiɛ benɛ i na Nabot kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a muɔ ɔ nɛ pueɔ si ɔ, i wo si kaa ja i gbla o tue ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɔ. Imi Yawɛ lɛ i de!’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngɔɔ Yoram gbogboe ɔ nɛ o ya sake ngɔ fɔ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ!” A gbe Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia

english_verse: Ahaziah saw all of this happen and tried to escape to the town of Beth-Haggan, but Jehu caught up with him and shouted, “Kill him too!” So his troops shot Ahaziah with an arrow while he was on the road to Gur near Ibleam. He went as far as Megiddo, where he died.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, e tu fo kɛ gu Bet Hagan blɔ. Yehu nyɛɛ e se, nɛ e de ke, “Lɛ hu nyɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ eko!” Nɛ a tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ngɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi ngɛ Gur blɔ ɔ nɔ, ngɛ Ibleam kasa nya. E tu fo kɛ ho Megido ya, nɛ e ya gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Ahaziah's officers put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried him beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: E tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ wo ta zugba lɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ho David ma, Yerusalem ya, nɛ a ya pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

translation_verse: Benɛ Yezebel nu kaa Yehu ba Yezreel ɔ, e kɛ tsopa kpa e hɛngmɛ se, nɛ e hɔɔ e yi saminyayoo, nɛ e ya bu si ngɛ saflɛ nya ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe.

english_verse: As he walked through the city gate, she shouted down to him, “Why did you come here, you murderer? To kill the king? You're no better than Zimri!”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yehu sɛ agbo ɔ mi ɔ, Yezebel bi lɛ ke, “Mo Zimri! Mo nɛ o gbe o nyɔmtsɛ ɔ! O ba kɛ tue mi jɔmi lo?”

english_verse: He looked up toward the window and asked, “Is anyone up there on my side?” A few palace workers stuck their heads out of a window,
translation_verse: Yehu wo e yi nɔ nɛ e hyɛ saflɛ ɔ nya, nɛ e bi ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ ye se? Mɛnɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ manyɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛli, maa pee enyɔ, loo etɛ hyɛ lɛ kɛ gu saflɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: and Jehu shouted, “Throw her out the window!” They threw her down, and her blood splattered on the walls and on the horses that trampled her body.
translation_verse: Yehu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsitsɛɛ lɛ ngɔ fia si!” A pee ja, nɛ Yezebel muɔ fĩa pue gbogbo ɔmɛ a he, kɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ a naa e nɔ kɛ be.

english_verse: Jehu left to get something to eat and drink. Then he told some workers, “Even though she was evil, she was a king's daughter, so make sure she has a proper burial.”
translation_verse: Yehu sɛ we ɔ mi nɛ e ya ye ní nɛ e nu ní. Benɛ e ye ní ta a, e de ke, “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pu yo musutsɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa matsɛ biyo ji lɛ.”

english_verse: The prime minister, the mayor of the city, as well as the other leaders and Ahab's supporters, sent this answer to Jehu, “We are your servants, Your Majesty, and we will do whatever you tell us. But it's not our place to choose someone to be king. You do what you think is best.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ binyumu ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ tsɔ ya de Yehu ke, “O tsɔli ji wɔ; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma de wɔ ke waa pee ɔ, wa maa pee. Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be nɔ ko nɔ ko matsɛ woe; nɔ́ nɛ sa o hɛ mi ɔ, moo pee.”

translation_verse: Yehu ngma mɛ womi enyɔne ke, “Ke nyɛ ngɛ ye se, nɛ nyɛ maa bu mi tue ɔ, lɛɛ hwɔɔ maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔmɛ a yi koklodohi kɛ ba ha mi ngɛ Yezreel.” Matsɛ Ahab binyumu ɔmɛ a hiɛmi ji nyingmi kpaago, nɛ ma nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ a nɔ hyɛe.

translation_verse: E nɔ jena mɔtu ɔ, Yehu ho ya da ma a agbo ɔ nya; nɛ e de ma a tsuo ke, “Imi ji nɔmlɔ nɛ so matsɛ Yoram yi nɔ, nɛ imi nɔuu lɛ i gbe lɛ; nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ yi fɔ. Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ gbe mɛ tsuo?

english_verse: Then Jehu killed the rest of Ahab's relatives living in Jezreel, as well as his highest officials, his priests, and his closest friends. No one in Ahab's family was left alive in Jezreel.

english_verse: Jehu left for Samaria, and along the way, he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah at a place where shepherds meet. He asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered. “We're going to visit his family.”

translation_verse: Yehu de e we bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ nuu mɛ hɛ ngmengmle!” A nuu mɛ hɛ ngmengmle, nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ muɔ ko kasa nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A gbe nimli nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ sɔuu; nɔ kake po píɛ. A gbe Ahab nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ ɔ

translation_verse: Benɛ Yehu je lejɛ ɔ, e kɛ Rekab binyumu Yehonadab ya kpe ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ. translation_verse: nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ha waa ho nɛ o ya hyɛ kɛ o hɛngmɛ níhi nɛ i pee ha Yawɛ.” Nɛ e kɛ lɛ hi ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi kɛ ho Samaria ya.

english_verse: to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah. Jehu Kills All the Worshipers of Baal
translation_verse: Benɛ a ya su lejɛ ɔ, Yehu gbe Ahab nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi; nɔ kake ngmelu po píɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de Eliya ke e maa ba mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. A gbe Baal jali ɔmɛ

english_verse: I'm going to offer a huge sacrifice to him. So invite his prophets and priests, and be sure everyone who worships him is there. Anyone who doesn't come will be killed. But this was a trick—Jehu was really planning to kill the worshipers of Baal.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya kpee Baal gbali ɔmɛ, Baal jali ɔmɛ, kɛ Baal wɔnɔ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ba ha mi; a ko si nɔ ko nɔ ko. I ma nɛ ma ba sã bɔ ngua ko ha Baal; nɔ nɛ bɛ ɔ, a maa gbe lɛ.”

english_verse: As soon as Jehu finished offering the sacrifice, he told the guards and soldiers, “Come in and kill them! Don't let anyone escape.” They slaughtered everyone in the crowd and threw the bodies outside. Then they went back into the temple
translation_verse: Benɛ a dla bɔ sami ní ɔmɛ ta a, Yehu de buli ɔmɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya gbe mɛ tsuo; nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ je kpo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ buli ɔmɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ klaate gbe ni ɔmɛ, nɛ a sake mɛ kɛ pue kpo ɔ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ya sɛ Baal wɔ tsu ɔ mi,
