translation_verse: Jeha nɛ ji kpaago ɔ mi ɔ, osɔfo Yehoyada tsɔ nɛ a ya kpee asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ he buli ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ we bi a tabo ɔ nya a kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ. E kɛ mɛ so nɛ e ha a ka lɛ kita ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ; nɛ e kɛ matsɛ binyumu ɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: and said to them: Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fa mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ma tsu ní Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ mi dlami etɛ mi kake ma ya bu ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ,

english_verse: Another unit will guard Sur Gate, and the third unit will guard the palace gate and relieve the palace guards.
translation_verse: mi dlami etɛ mi kake maa bu Sur agbo ɔ nya; nɛ mi dlami etɛ mi kake hu maa bu agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ buli ɔmɛ a se ɔ hu nya.

english_verse: The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash.
translation_verse: Asafo kuu enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ji nihi tsuo nɛ a be ní tsumi yae Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bu matsɛ ɔ he ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ po klaangma kɛ bɔle Matsɛ Yoash, nɛ́ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hɛɛ e ta hwumi níhi ngɛ e dɛ mi. He tsuaa he nɛ matsɛ ɔ yaa a, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ ya. Ke nɔ ko hɛ lɛ kɛ su nyɛ he haa a, a gbe lɛ.”

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns, which was the usual place for the king. The singers and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the people were celebrating and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: Benɛ e maa hyɛ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ titima a he kaa bɔ nɛ kusumi ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ titimati kpali ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya, nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nyae nɛ a ngɛ titimati kpae. Kɛkɛ nɛ Atalia hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ tsɔ atuã! Nyɛ tsɔ atuã!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Kill her! But don't do it anywhere near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops and kill anyone who is with her!”
translation_verse: Osɔfo Yehoyada sume kaa a gbe Atalia ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fa tabo ɔ nya asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ je lɛ kpo kɛ gu buli ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɔ nɛ maa ka kaa e ma kpɔ lɛ ɔ, a gbe lɛ!”

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest asked King Joash and the people to promise that they would be faithful to each other and to the Lord.
translation_verse: Yehoyada ha Matsɛ Yoash, kɛ ma a kɛ Yawɛ so kaa a maa pee Yawɛ ma. Jehanɛ, e ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ ma a hu so.

english_verse: Then the crowd went to the temple built to honor Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal right in front of the altars. After Jehoiada had placed guards around the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ya sɛ Baal jami he ɔ, nɛ a gbɛ lɛ kɛ pue si. A ku bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ amaga amɛ dukuduku, nɛ a gbe Baal osɔfo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Matan ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Osɔfo Yehoyada ngɔ buli ya to Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: he called together all the commanders, the king's special bodyguards, the palace guards, and the people. They led Joash from the temple, through the Guards' Gate, and into the palace. He took his place on the throne and became king of Judah.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, matsɛ we ɔ buli ɔmɛ, matsɛ he buli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo kpaka matsɛ ɔ kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ ya gu buli agbo ɔ mi kɛ ya sɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi. Nɛ Yoash ya hi matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord.
translation_verse: Yoash pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní e wami be ɔ tsuo, ejakaa osɔfo Yehoyada ji nɔ nɛ tsɔse lɛ.

english_verse: The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.
translation_verse: Fɔ yemi bɔ sika a, kɛ yayami pami bɔ sika a lɛɛ a ngɔɛ kɛ bɛ Yawɛ we ɔ; osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Se wɔ jami he ɔmɛ ɔ, e puɛ we mɛ; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma a sãã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule,
translation_verse: Se kɛ ba si Matsɛ Yoash tsɛ yemi jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ dla we Yawɛ we ɔ he ko he ko.

english_verse: Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why aren't you using the money to repair the temple? Don't take any more money for yourselves. It is only to be used to pay for the repairs.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Matsɛ Yoash tsɛ osɔfo Yehoyada, kɛ osɔfo kpa amɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ dla we Yawɛ we ɔ? Jehanɛ, nyɛ ko ngɔ sika ko ngɛ nyɛ asafo bi ɔmɛ a dɛ hu; sika tsuaa sika nɛ nyɛ nine maa su nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ dla Yawɛ we ɔ.”

english_verse: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔmɛ kplɛɛ kaa a be sika ko ngɔe ngɛ ma a dɛ hu; mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu a be Yawɛ we ɔ dlae.

english_verse: Jehoiada found a wooden box; he cut a hole in the top of it and set it on the right side of the altar where people went into the temple. Whenever someone gave money to the temple, the priests guarding the entrance would put it into this box.
translation_verse: Osɔfo Yehoyada ngɔ daka ko ya ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya, nɛ e gu puɔ ngɛ nya nɔ́ ɔ yi mi. Ke o yaa Yawɛ we ɔ, daka a ngɛ o hiɔ nɔ. Osɔfohi nɛ buɔ agbo ɔ nya a ngɔɔ sika tsuo nɛ ma a kɛ baa Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ woɔ daka nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags.
translation_verse: Ke a na kaa sika a hiɛ ngɛ daka a mi ɔ, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a maa ya Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ a ma ya kane sika nɛ a na ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ a fi kɛ wo kotokuhi a mi.

english_verse: Then they would give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. Some of the money was used to pay the builders, the woodworkers,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a maa tu sika a kɛ wo Yawɛ we ɔ ní tsuli ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ. Mɛ hu a kɛ sika a maa wo tso he ní tsuli, tsu mali,

english_verse: the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.
translation_verse: gbogbo fiali, kɛ tɛ koli nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hiɔ. A kɛ sika nɛ ɔ eko ma he tso kɛ tɛ nɛ a kó, nɛ a kɛ ma dla Yawɛ we ɔ. A kɛ eko hu maa wo Yawɛ we ɔ dlami hiɔ kpahi.

english_verse: While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple.
translation_verse: Sika nɛ a kɛ baa Yawɛ we ɔ, a ngɔɛ eko kɛ pee we sika hiɔ kpluhi, la gbemi níhi, kahi kɛ titimatihi, aloo sika tsu níhi, aloo sika hiɔ ní kpa komɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Siria matsɛ, Hazael ya tua Gat, nɛ e ngɔ ma a; nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e ma ya tua Yerusalem hulɔ.

english_verse: So Joash collected everything he and his ancestors Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, as well as the gold in the storage rooms in the temple and palace. He sent it all to Hazael as a gift, and when Hazael received it, he ordered his troops to leave Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nike ní klɔuklɔuhi tsuo nɛ Yehoshafat, Yehoram, kɛ Ahazia, nɛ ji Yuda matsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ Yoash hɛ mi ɔ gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, Matsɛ Yoash ngɔ. E kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ sika tsuo nɛ a na ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ nito he ɔmɛ piɛ he, nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a ngɔ ya ha Siria matsɛ, Hazael. Kɛkɛ nɛ Hazael kpale e se kɛ je Yerusalem.

english_verse: Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Yoash he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: At the end of his rule, some of his officers rebelled against him. Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer murdered him in a building where the land was filled in on the east side of Jerusalem, near the road to Silla. Joash was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Amaziah became king.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Yoash tsɔli ɔmɛ so e yi nɔ nɛ a ti nihi enyɔ gbe lɛ ngɛ Milo we ɔ, ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɛ a guu kɛ yaa Sila a nɔ. Shimeat binyumu Yozakar, kɛ Shomer binyumu Yehozabad ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbe lɛ ɔ nɛ. A pu Yoash ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Amazia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: and said, “Open the window facing east.” When it was open, Elisha shouted, “Now shoot!” Jehoash shot an arrow and Elisha said, “That arrow is a sign that the Lord will help you completely defeat the Syrian army at Aphek.”
translation_verse: nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Bli saflɛ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ beleku je ɔ!” Nɛ e pee ja. Jehanɛ Elisha de lɛ ke, “Tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ!” Benɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha de ke, “Yawɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ e kɛ maa ye Siria nɔ kunimi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! O kɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ maa hwu ta ngɛ Afek hluu kɛ yaa si o ma kpata a hɛ mi butuu!”

english_verse: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He never stopped following the example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Yehoahaz pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. Yayamihi nɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we he; se e tsa nɔ mohu.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad rule over them for a long time.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Siria matsɛ, Hazael kɛ e binyumu Benhadad a dɛ mi si abɔ.

english_verse: Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord for help, and the Lord saw how terribly Hazael was treating the Israelites. He answered Jehoahaz
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehoahaz fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ bu lɛ tue; ejakaa e na haomi nɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ haoe ɔ.

english_verse: by sending Israel a leader who rescued them from the Syrians, and the Israelites lived in peace as they had before.
translation_verse: Yawɛ je kpɔlɔ ko ha Israel, nɛ e ba kpɔ mɛ kɛ je Siria bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ na he jɔmi, nɛ a hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a wehi a mi ekohu kaa sa a.

english_verse: Jehoash became king of Israel in the thirty-seventh year of Joash's rule in Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Yoash yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaago ɔ, Yehoahaz binyumu Yehoash bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ. E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoahaz did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Yehoahaz he sane kpahi, kã, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Jehoahaz died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoash became king. King Jehoash of Israel
translation_verse: Yehoahaz ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Samaria, nɛ e binyumu Yehoash ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se. Israel matsɛ, Yehoash

english_verse: “Grab a bow and some arrows,” Elisha told him, “and hold them in your hand.” Jehoash grabbed the bow and arrows and held them. Elisha placed his hand on the king's hand
translation_verse: Elisha de lɛ ke e pee kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ klaalo; nɛ e pee ja. Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha nu matsɛ ɔ nine enyɔ ɔmɛ,

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by doing just like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Lɛ hu e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. Yayamihi tsuo nɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, Yehoash ngmɛɛ we he; se mohu e tsa nɔ.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his war against King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Yehoash he sane kpahi, kã nɛ e pee benɛ e kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Amazia hwu ta, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king. Elisha the Prophet Dies
translation_verse: Yehoash ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Samaria, nɛ Yeroboam ba ye e se. Elisha gbenɔ

english_verse: Some time before the death of King Jehoash, Elisha the prophet was very sick and about to die. Jehoash went in and stood beside him, crying. He said, “Master, what will Israel's chariots and cavalry be able to do without you?”
translation_verse: Ligbi ko, benɛ gbalɔ Elisha fɔɔ si kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Yehoash ba slaa lɛ, nɛ e fo ya pue e nɔ; nɛ e de ke, “Tsaatsɛ! Tsaatsɛ! Mo ji Israel he falɔ kpanaa!”

english_verse: Elisha said, “Pick up the arrows and hit the ground with them.” Jehoash grabbed the arrows and hit the ground three times, then stopped.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Elisha de Israel matsɛ ɔ ke e kukuɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kpa amɛ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ mɛ kɛ wo zu mi. Matsɛ ɔ tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ kɛ wo zu mi si etɛ, nɛ e kpa.

english_verse: Elisha became angry with the king and exclaimed, “If you had struck it five or six times, you would completely wipe out the Syrians. Now you will defeat them only three times.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ mi mi fu lɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Kaa o tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ si enuɔ, loo si ekpa jinɛ o maa fia Siria bi ɔmɛ ní hluu kɛ yaa si o ma kpata a hɛ mi butuu. Bɔ nɛ e ba nɛ ɔ lɛɛ si etɛ pɛ o maa ye Siria nɔ kunimi.”

english_verse: Elisha died and was buried. Every year in the spring, Moab's leaders sent raiding parties into Israel.
translation_verse: Elisha ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ. Daa jeha sisije ɔ, Moab ojo fiali baa nɛ a ba tuaa Israel zugba a.

english_verse: Once, while some Israelites were burying a man's body, they saw a group of Moabites. The Israelites quickly threw the body into Elisha's tomb and ran away. As soon as the man's body touched the bones of Elisha, the man came back to life and stood up. Israel Defeats Syria
translation_verse: Ligbi ko, benɛ a yaa nɛ a ya pu nyumu ko ɔ, a na ojo fiali a kuu nɛ ɔ nɛ ma. Kɛkɛ nɛ a sake gbogboe ɔ ngɔ fɔ Elisha yɔkɔ ɔ mi. Benɛ gbogboe ɔ he ya sa Elisha wuhi a he pɛ, nɔ ɔ hɛ tsɛ, nɛ e te da si. Israel kɛ Siria hwu ta

english_verse: Israel was under the power of King Hazael of Syria during the entire rule of Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Siria matsɛ, Hazael wa Israel bi ɔmɛ yi mi Yehoahaz matsɛ yemi be ɔ tsuo;

english_verse: But the Lord was kind to the Israelites and showed them mercy because of his solemn agreement with their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. In fact, he has never turned his back on them or let them be completely destroyed.
translation_verse: se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ dloomi kɛ e mɔbɔ nami ngɛ a nɔ. Somi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Abraham, kɛ Isak, kɛ Yakob so ɔ he je ɔ, e piɛ a he, nɛ e ha we nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata; nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ hu e hɛ ji e ma a nɔ.

english_verse: Hazael died, and his son Benhadad then became king of Syria.
translation_verse: Benɛ Siria matsɛ, Hazael gbo ɔ, e binyumu Benhadad ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: King Jehoash of Israel attacked and defeated the Syrian army three times. He took back from Benhadad all the towns Hazael had captured in battle from his father Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Yehoash ye Benhadad nɔ kunimi si etɛ, nɛ e kpɔ mahi nɛ Benhadad ngɔ benɛ lɛ, Yehoash ɔ tsɛ, Yehoahaz ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Israel ɔ.

english_verse: Jeroboam extended the boundaries of Israel from Lebo-Hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south, just as the Lord had promised his servant Jonah son of Amittai, who was a prophet from Gath-Hepher.
translation_verse: Yeroboam kpɔ Israel zugba amɛ nɛ je a dɛ ɔ ekohu, kɛ je Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ nya, ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ ya si Ngo wo ɔ nya, ngɛ leneyi je. Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ wo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he si kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ, gbalɔ Yona, Amitai binyumu ɔ nɛ je Gat Hefer ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Yehoash, Yehoahaz binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, Amazia, Yoash binyumu ɔ ba ye matsɛ ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. Yayamihi tsuo nɛ Yeroboam, Nebat binyumu ɔ ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we he.

english_verse: Amaziah followed the example of his father Joash by obeying the Lord and doing right. But he was not as faithful as his ancestor David.
translation_verse: E pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi, se e be kaa e nɛ̃ David; e ya wo e tsɛ Yoash nane.

english_verse: Amaziah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Wɔ jami he ɔmɛ lɛɛ e puɛ we mɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a ya nɔ sã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father.
translation_verse: Benɛ Amazia matsɛ yemi ɔ ba da si ɔ, e gbe e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ gbe matsɛ ɔ nɛ ji e tsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: One day, Amaziah sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
translation_verse: Ligbi ko ɔ, Amazia tsɔ ya de Israel matsɛ, Yehoash, Yehu bi Yehoahaz bi ɔ ke e ba nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba kpe ngɛ ta nga nɔ.

english_verse: Jehoash sent back this reply: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon announced that his son was going to marry the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Yehoash hu tsɔ ya de Yuda matsɛ, Amazia ke, “Be ko ɔ, Lebanon mio tso tsɔ ke a ya de Lebanon seda ke, ‘Ngɔɔ o biyo ɔ ngɔ ha ye binyumu ɔ nɛ e ngɔ.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ Lebanon pu mi lohwe ko ba be, nɛ e naa mio tso ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: But Amaziah refused to listen. So Jehoash and his troops marched to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Se Amazia tsi e tue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Yehoash hia nɛ e kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Amazia ya kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi ngɛ ta nga nɔ, ngɛ Yuda ma a nɛ a tsɛɛ Bet Shemesh ɔ.

english_verse: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home,
translation_verse: Israel ye Yuda nɔ kunimi, nɛ Yuda ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya.

english_verse: and Jehoash captured Amaziah. Jehoash then marched to Jerusalem and broke down the city wall from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate, a section nearly
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Yehoash nu Yuda matsɛ, Amazia nyɔguɛ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho Yerusalem ya nɛ e ya ku Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ gugue lafa, kɛ je Efraim agbo ɔ nya kɛ ya si kɔ nya agbo ɔ nya.

english_verse: He took the gold and silver, as well as everything of value from the Lord's temple and the king's treasury. He took hostages, then returned to Samaria.
translation_verse: E muɔ níhi tsuo nɛ e na ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ junehi kɛ je. E muɔ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ tsuo, nɛ e nuu ta nyɔguɛhi hulɔ kɛ ho Samaria ya.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he defeated King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Yehoash he sane kpahi, kã nɛ e pee benɛ e kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Amazia hwu ta, kɛ ní kpahi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: After his death the people of Judah made his son Azariah king, even though he was only
translation_verse: Yuda ma a tsuo wo Uzia matsɛ ngɛ e tsɛ Amazia se. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.

english_verse: Azariah was the one who later recaptured and rebuilt the town of Elath. King Jeroboam the Second of Israel
translation_verse: Benɛ Uzia tsɛ gbo se ɔ, Uzia kpɔ Elat kɛ ha Yuda ekohu, nɛ e dla po ma a. Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam nɛ ji enyɔ

english_verse: The Lord helped Jeroboam do this because he had seen how terribly the Israelites were suffering, whether slave or free, and no one was left to help them.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ba na kaa amanehlu nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nae ɔ nya wa tsɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko na we he jɔmi, nɛ balɔ ko hu be.

english_verse: And since the Lord had promised that he would not let Israel be completely destroyed, he helped Jeroboam rescue them.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ Yawɛ to we kaa e ma kpata Israel hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ he je ɔ, e gu Yehoash binyumu Yeroboam nɔ nɛ e kɛ he a yi wami.

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he recaptured the towns of Damascus and Hamath, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Yeroboam he sane kpahi, kã nɛ e pee, ta nɛ e hwu, bɔ nɛ e kpɔ Damasko kɛ Hamat kɛ je Yuda dɛ ngɔ ha Israel, kɛ ní kpahi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Everything else Pekahiah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Pekah of Israel
translation_verse: Pekahia he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi. Israel matsɛ, Peka

english_verse: Pekahiah became king of Israel in the fiftieth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enuɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Menahem binyumu Pekahia ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ. E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha enyɔ.

english_verse: Azariah obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: E pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ Amazia pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: But Azariah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Se mohu wɔ jami he ɔmɛ lɛɛ e puɛ we mɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a sã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord punished Azariah with leprosy for the rest of his life. He wasn't allowed to live in the royal palace, so his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya; nɛ hiɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ e he kɛ ya si e gbenɔ ligbi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e klɛ̃ kɛ ya hi we kpa mi, nɛ e binyumu Yotam ba hi matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ e kɛ hyɛ ma a nɔ.

english_verse: Everything else Azariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Uzia he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Azariah died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Jotham then became king. King Zechariah of Israel
translation_verse: Uzia ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi; nɛ e binyumu Yotam ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se. Israel matsɛ, Zakaria

english_verse: Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, but he ruled only six months from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ, jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Yeroboam binyumu Zakaria ba ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ. E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa.

english_verse: Shallum son of Jabesh plotted against Zechariah and killed him in public. Shallum then became king.
translation_verse: Yabesh binyumu Shalum so Matsɛ Zakaria yi nɔ, nɛ e fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e gbe ngɛ Ibleam; nɛ e ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: So the Lord had kept his promise to Jehu that the next four kings of Israel would come from his family. Everything else Zechariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Shallum of Israel
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, si nɛ Yawɛ wo Matsɛ Yehu ɔ ba mi. Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “O bimɛ maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ yaa si yi nɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ.” Israel matsɛ, Shalum

english_verse: Shallum became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah's rule in Judah. But only one month after Shallum became king,
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Yabesh binyumu Shalum ba ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ. E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ nyɔhiɔ kake.

english_verse: Menahem became king of Israel in Azariah's thirty-ninth year as king of Judah, and he ruled Israel ten years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Gadi binyumu Menahem bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ. E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma.

english_verse: He constantly disobeyed the Lord by following the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. E wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ, yayamihi nɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we a he.

english_verse: During Menahem's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria invaded Israel. He agreed to help Menahem keep control of his kingdom, if Menahem would pay him over
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ, Tiglat Pileser ba tua Israel; nɛ Menahem ha lɛ sika hiɔ kilo akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ eywiɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Tiglat Pileser nɛ e piɛ e he, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ da si.

english_verse: Jotham followed the example of his father by obeying the Lord and doing right.
translation_verse: E ya wo e tsɛ nane, nɛ e pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní.

english_verse: Everything else Menahem did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Menahem he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Menahem died, and his son Pekahiah became king. King Pekahiah of Israel
translation_verse: Menahem ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ, nɛ e binyumu Pekahia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se. Israel matsɛ, Pekahia

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and caused the Israelites to sin, just as Jeroboam son of Nebat had done.
translation_verse: E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. Yayamihi nɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we he.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and followed the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. Yayamihi tsuo nɛ Yeroboam, Nebat binyumu ɔ ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we he.

english_verse: During Pekah's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria marched into Israel. He captured the territories of Gilead and Galilee, including the towns of Ijon, Abel-Bethmaacah, Janoah, Kedesh, and Hazor, as well as the entire territory of Naphtali. Then he took Israelites from those regions to Assyria as prisoners.
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Peka yi nɔ ɔ, Asiria matsɛ, Tiglat Pileser ba ngɔ Iyon, Abel Bet Maaka, Yanoa, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, kɛ Galilea-Naftali zugba a tsuo; nɛ e ngɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Asiria ya.

english_verse: In the twentieth year of Jotham's rule in Judah, Hoshea son of Elah plotted against Pekah and murdered him. Hoshea then became king of Israel.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Yotam, Uzia binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Ela binyumu Hoshea so Matsɛ Peka yi nɔ nɛ e fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e gbe; nɛ e ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: Everything else Pekah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Jotham of Judah (
translation_verse: Peka he sanehi kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi. Yuda matsɛ, Yotam (Kronika II,

english_verse: Jotham son of Azariah became king of Judah in the second year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Peka, Remalia binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, Uzia binyumu Yotam ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.

english_verse: It was Jotham who rebuilt the Upper Gate that led into the court around the Lord's temple. But the local shrines were not destroyed, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Se jami he ɔmɛ lɛɛ e puɛ we mɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a ya nɔ sã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mwɔɔ. Yotam ji nɔ nɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ omleyi je agbo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Yotam he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: During his rule, the Lord let King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel start attacking Judah.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yotam ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ ji be nɛ Yawɛ bɔni Siria matsɛ, Rezin, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Peka tsɔmi ke a ya tua Yuda.

english_verse: Jotham died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.
translation_verse: Yotam ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi; nɛ e binyumu Ahaz ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah in the seventeenth year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ Peka, Remalia binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaago ɔ mi ɔ, Yuda matsɛ, Yotam binyumu Ahaz ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Hezekiah became king.
translation_verse: Ahaz ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi; nɛ e binyumu Hezekia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: and was even more sinful than the kings of Israel. He sacrificed his own son, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: se mohu e ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane. E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e binyumu po kɛ sã sami bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ a kusumi yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Ahaz sã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ, ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ tsohi nɛ bɔ kusuu ɔ a sisi.

english_verse: While Ahaz was ruling Judah, the king of Edom recaptured the town of Elath from Judah and forced out the people of Judah. Edomites then moved into Elath, and they still live there. About the same time, King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel marched to Jerusalem and attacked, but they could not capture it.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Edom matsɛ ɔ ya kpɔ Elat kɛ ha Edom, nɛ e fie Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Elat ma a mi. Edom bi ɔmɛ ba dumɔ Elat, nɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria that said, “Your Majesty, King Rezin and King Pekah are attacking me, your loyal servant. Please come and rescue me.”
translation_verse: Ahaz tsɔ ya de Asiria matsɛ, Tiglat Pileser ke, “O tsɔlɔ kɛ o binyumu ji mi. Siria matsɛ, kɛ Israel matsɛ ba tua mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ba nɛ o ba je ngmlaa ha mi.”

english_verse: Along with the message, Ahaz sent silver and gold from the Lord's temple and from the palace treasury as a gift for the Assyrian king.
translation_verse: Ahaz ya ngɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we nito he ɔmɛ; nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a kɛ ya ke Asiria matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: As soon as Tiglath Pileser received the message, he and his troops marched to Syria. He captured the capital city of Damascus, then he took the people living there to the town of Kir as prisoners and killed King Rezin.
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ ɔ bu lɛ tue, nɛ e hia kɛ ya tua Damasko. E ngɔ ma a, nɛ e gbe Matsɛ Rezin; se ma a mi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ e nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Kir ya.

english_verse: Later, Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser. And while Ahaz was there, he saw an altar and sent a model of it back to Uriah the priest, along with the plans for building one.
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Ahaz, kɛ Asiria matsɛ, Tiglat Pileser ya kpe ngɛ Damasko ɔ, e na bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Matsɛ Ahaz ngɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ henɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ mane osɔfo Uria.

english_verse: Uriah followed the plans and built an altar exactly like the one in Damascus, finishing it just before Ahaz came back.
translation_verse: Nɛ loko Matsɛ Ahaz je Damasko kɛ ba a, osɔfo Uria puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ henɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz ngɔ kɛ mane lɛ kɛ je Damasko ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: When Ahaz returned, he went to see the altar and to offer sacrifices on it. He walked up to the altar
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Ahaz je Damasko kɛ ba a, e na kaa a puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ta.

english_verse: and poured wine over it. Then he offered sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessings.
translation_verse: E sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ngɛ nɔ. E sã wai bɔ, nɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ e kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, e fĩa e muɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: He told Uriah the priest: From now on, the morning and evening sacrifices as well as all gifts of grain and wine are to be offered on this altar. The sacrifices for the people and for the king must also be offered here. Sprinkle the blood from all the sacrifices on it, but leave the bronze altar for me to use for prayer and finding out what God wants me to do.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz fa osɔfo Uria ke, “Moo sã mɔtu sami bɔ, gbɔkuɛ niye ní bɔ, matsɛ sami bɔ, e niye ní bɔ, kɛ zugba a nɔ bimɛ tsuo a sami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngua nɛ ɔ nɔ. Moo sã wai bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ lohwehi nɛ a kɛ ba sã sami bɔ, kɛ bɔ kpa amɛ a muɔ kɛ fĩa nɔ. Se akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ lɛɛ mo si ha mi nɛ ma bi ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Ahaz also had the side panels and the small bowls taken off the movable stands in the Lord's temple. He had the large bronze bowl, called the Sea, removed from the bronze bulls on which it rested and had it placed on a stand made of stone.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Ahaz pee sisi daka amɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, nɛ e je tsesi ɔmɛ ngɛ a nɔ. Jehanɛ, e je akɔblee nyu nɔ́ ngua a kɛ je akɔblee na ku ɔmɛ a se mi kɛ ma tɛ nɔ ngɛ zugba.

english_verse: He took down the special tent that was used for worship on the Sabbath and closed up the private entrance that the kings of Judah used for going into the temple. He did all these things to please Tiglath Pileser.
translation_verse: Ahaz je nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a kɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ maa nɔ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hulɔ. E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ sa Asiria matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Ahaz he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in the twelfth year of Ahaz's rule in Judah, and he ruled nine years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Ahaz yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, Ela binyumu Hoshea ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ. E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nɛɛ.

english_verse: Hoshea disobeyed the Lord and sinned, but not as much as the earlier Israelite kings had done.
translation_verse: E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, se e yayami ɔ sui Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ a nɔ́ ɔ.

english_verse: During Hoshea's rule, King Shalmaneser of Assyria invaded Israel; he took control of the country and made Hoshea pay taxes.
translation_verse: E ba mi kaa Asiria matsɛ, Shalmaneser ba tua lɛ, nɛ Hoshea ba pee e sɔmɔlɔ, nɛ e tsuɔ tó kɛ haa lɛ.

english_verse: But later, Hoshea refused to pay the taxes and asked King So of Egypt to help him rebel. When Shalmaneser found out, he arrested Hoshea and put him in prison. Samaria Is Destroyed and the Israelites Are Taken to Assyria
translation_verse: Jeha ko mi ɔ, Hoshea tsu we tó kɛ ha Asiria matsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ daa jeha a; mohu ɔ, e tsɔ ya bi yemi kɛ buami ngɛ Egipt matsɛ, So ngɔ. Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kaa atuã tsɔmi, nɛ e nu Hoshea ngɔ wo tsu. A ye Samaria nɔ kunimi

english_verse: before capturing it in the ninth year of Hoshea's rule. The Assyrian king took the Israelites away to Assyria as prisoners. He forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: Hoshea yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɔ Samaria, nɛ e muɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ho Asiria ya. E ngɔ ni komɛ ya to Hala, e ngɔ ni komɛ ya to Habor pa a nya ngɛ Gozan zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ni komɛ hu ya to Media bi ɔmɛ a ma amɛ a mi.

english_verse: All of this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had rescued them from Egypt, where they had been slaves. They worshiped foreign gods,
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba ji, Israel ma a pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ kpɔ mɛ ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dɛ, nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ. A ya ja mawu kpahi.

english_verse: followed the customs of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel, and were just as sinful as the Israelite kings.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je a blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ bɔni a kusumi níhi peemi; slo ma se kusumi kpahi nɛ Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ kɛ ba a hulɔ.

english_verse: Even worse, the Israelites tried to hide their sins from the Lord their God. They built their own local shrines everywhere in Israel—from small towns to large, walled cities.
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ pee níhi nɛ dɛ blɔ ngɛ laami mi kɛ si Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ. A ma jami hehi ngɔ ha a he ngɛ kɔpekɔpe ɔmɛ, kɛ ma ngua amɛ tsuo a mi.

english_verse: They also built stone images of foreign gods and set up sacred poles for the worship of Asherah on every hill and under every shady tree.
translation_verse: A puɛ amagahi kɛ ha yo mawu Ashera a ngɛ yokuhi tsuo a nɔ, kɛ tsohi nɛ bɔ kusuu tsuo a sisi;

english_verse: They offered sacrifices at the shrines, just as the foreign nations had done before the Lord forced them out of Israel. They did sinful things that made the Lord very angry.
translation_verse: nɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo, kaa bɔ nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je a blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. A pee ní yayamihi kɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la.

english_verse: Even though the Lord had commanded the Israelites not to worship idols, they did it anyway.
translation_verse: A ja amagahi nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ mlaa ke a ko ja mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: So the Lord made sure that every prophet warned Israel and Judah with these words: “I, the Lord, command you to stop doing sinful things and start obeying my laws and teachings! I gave them to your ancestors, and I told my servants the prophets to repeat them to you.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ gu gbali, kɛ ní nali a nɔ nɛ e kɛ slɔ Israel kɛ Yuda ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ je nyɛ blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ. Nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ nɛ i wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ. I ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ kɛ gu ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ.”

english_verse: But the Israelites would not listen; they were as stubborn as their ancestors who had refused to worship the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Se a bui tete; a kuɛ wa kaa a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ he we Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ yi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: They ignored the Lord's warnings and commands, and they rejected the solemn agreement he had made with their ancestors. They worshiped worthless idols and became worthless themselves. The Lord had told the Israelites not to do the things that the foreign nations around them were doing, but Israel became just like them.
translation_verse: A kua e blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ somi nɛ e kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ, kɛ slɔmihi nɛ e slɔ mɛ ɔ. A ya nyɛɛ yakayaka amagahi a se, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a plɛ pee yakayaka nimli. Je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ mlaa ngɛ a he ke a ko pee a níhi kaa mɛ ɔ, a ya nyɛɛ jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ mohu a se.

english_verse: The people of Israel disobeyed all the commands of the Lord their God. They made two gold statues of calves and set up a sacred pole for Asherah; they also worshiped the stars and the god Baal.
translation_verse: Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ wo mɛ ɔ, a yi ekoeko nɔ; se mohu a ngɔ dade nɛ a sle kɛ pee na bi enyɔ kɛ ha a he. A pee Ashera, nɛ a ja hiɔwe níhi tsuo; a ja Baal hulɔ.

english_verse: They used magic and witchcraft and even sacrificed their own children. The Israelites were determined to do whatever the Lord hated.
translation_verse: A ngɔ a binyumuhi, kɛ a biyihi kɛ sã sami bɔhi, kɛ ha wɔhi. A kla, a ye kunya, nɛ a je blɔ pee yayami nɛ a kɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la.

english_verse: The Lord became so furious with the people of Israel that he allowed them to be carried away as prisoners. Only the people living in Judah were left,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e je e hɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ, ja Yuda wɛtso ɔ pɛ.

english_verse: So the Lord turned his back on everyone in Israel and let them be punished and defeated until no one was left.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kua Israel nina amɛ tsuo. E ha nɛ a na amanehlu, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo ní hali a dɛ mi kɛ ya si e je e hɛ ngɛ a nɔ kulaa.

english_verse: Earlier, when the Lord took the northern tribes away from David's family, the people living in northern Israel chose Jeroboam son of Nebat as their king. Jeroboam caused the Israelites to sin and to stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yawɛ tsɔ́ Israel kɛ je David we ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ wo Nebat binyumu Yeroboam matsɛ. Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel kpa Yawɛ se nyɛɛmi, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ya wo yayami agbo mi.

english_verse: until the Lord got rid of them, just as he had warned his servants the prophets. That's why the people of Israel were taken away as prisoners to Assyria, and that's where they remained. Foreigners Are Resettled in Israel
translation_verse: kɛ ya si Yawɛ je e hɛ ngɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ e de to kɛ gu e tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ho Asiria ya; nɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Asiria bi ɔmɛ ba hi Israel

english_verse: The king of Assyria took people who were living in the cities of Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and forced them to move to Israel. They took over the towns where the Israelites had lived, including the capital city of Samaria.
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ ɔ ya ngɔ nihi kɛ je Babilon, Kut, Ava, Hamat, kɛ Sefarvaim kɛ ba wo Samaria ma amɛ a mi ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a nane mi. Mɛ hu a ngɔ Samaria ngɔ pee a nɔ, nɛ a hi ma amɛ a mi.

english_verse: At first these people did not worship the Lord, so he sent lions to attack them, and the lions killed some of them.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ba lejɛ ɔ kekleekle ɔ, a ja we Yawɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ jatahi ba sɛ a kpɛti, nɛ jata amɛ gbe a ti ni komɛ.

english_verse: A messenger told the king of Assyria, “The people you moved to Israel don't know how to worship the god of that country. So he sent lions that have attacked and killed some of them.”
translation_verse: A ya bɔ Asiria matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ ke, “Je ma amɛ nɛ o ya ngɔ kɛ ba wo Samaria ma amɛ a mi ɔ, a li zugba a nɔ mawu ɔ kɔhi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, zugba a nɔ mawu ɔ hu ha nɛ jatahi ba sɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ a ngɛ mɛ gbee.”

english_verse: The king replied, “Get one of the Israelite priests we brought here and send him back to Israel. He can live there and teach them about the god of that country.”
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ ɔ fa ke, “Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ya nuu kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba a, nyɛ ha nɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ e kpale kɛ ho, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ zugba a nɔ mawu ɔ kɔhi.”

english_verse: One of the Israelite priests was chosen to go back to Israel. He lived in Bethel and taught the people how to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a wo Israel osɔfo kake blɔ kɛ je Samaria kɛ ho Betel ya, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ a ma ja Yawɛ ha.

english_verse: The people from Babylonia made the god Succoth-Benoth; those from Cuthah made the god Nergal; those from Hamath made Ashima;
translation_verse: Babilon bi ɔmɛ puɛ amaga kɛ ha mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sukot Benot ɔ; Kut bi ɔmɛ puɛ amaga kɛ ha Nergal; Hamat bi ɔmɛ puɛ amaga kɛ ha Ashima;

english_verse: those from Avva made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the people from Sepharvaim sacrificed their children to their own gods Adrammelech and Anammelech.
translation_verse: Ava bi ɔmɛ puɛ amaga kɛ ha Nibhaz, kɛ Tartak. Sefarvaim bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngɔ a bimɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ ha mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Adramelek kɛ Anamelek ɔ.

english_verse: They worshiped their own gods, just as they had before they were taken away to Israel. They also worshiped the Lord, but they chose their own people to be priests at the shrines.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ, nɛ a jaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a mawu ɔmɛ hulɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ hehi nɛ a je kɛ ba a.

english_verse: Everyone followed their old customs. None of them worshiped only the Lord, and they refused to obey the laws and commands that the Lord had given to the descendants of Jacob, the man he named Israel.
translation_verse: A hɛɛ a blema kusumi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. A ja we Yawɛ, nɛ mlaa slɔɔtohi nɛ e wo Yakob nɛ e tsake e biɛ kɛ pee Israel ɔ nina a hu, a yi nɔ.

english_verse: At the time when the Lord had made his solemn agreement with the people of Israel, he told them: Do not worship any other gods! Do not bow down to them or offer them a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ mɛ so, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ja mawu kpahi, nyɛ ko sɔmɔ mɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko sã bɔ ha mɛ!

english_verse: Worship only me! I am the one who rescued you from Egypt with my mighty power. Bow down to me and offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye imi Yawɛ mohu gbeye; ejakaa imi nɛ i kɛ he wami kɛ kɔni si wami je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ. Nyɛ ja mi, nɛ nyɛɛ sã bɔ kɛ ha mi.

english_verse: Never worship any other god, always obey my laws and teachings,
translation_verse: Mlaa slɔɔtohi nɛ i ngma ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye a nɔ daa. Nyɛ ko ja mawu kpahi;

english_verse: and remember the solemn agreement between us. I will say it again: Do not worship any god
translation_verse: somi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ hu nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ.

english_verse: except me. I am the Lord your God, and I will rescue you from all your enemies.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye imi Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye; nɛ ma je nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a dɛ mi.”

english_verse: But the people living in Israel ignored that command and kept on following their old customs.
translation_verse: Se ni ɔmɛ bui Mawu tue, nɛ a ya nɔ kɛ a blema kusumi ní ɔmɛ a peemi.

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord, just as his ancestor David had done.
translation_verse: Hezekia ya wo e nɛ̃ David nane, nɛ e ní peepee sa Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines, then tore down the images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. He also smashed the bronze snake Moses had made. The people had named it Nehushtan and had been offering sacrifices to it.
translation_verse: E gbɛ jami he ɔmɛ, nɛ e ywia amaga a nɛ a puɛ kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a, kɛ amaga kpa amɛ tsuo. Akɔblee sinɔ ɔ nɛ Mose pee, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nehushtan ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu e ywia lɛ tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ; ejakaa kɛ ba si jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ jɔɔ we tsopa kɛ e he via sami kɛ ha akɔblee sinɔ ɔ.

english_verse: He was completely faithful to the Lord and obeyed the laws the Lord had given to Moses for the people.
translation_verse: E ngɔ e he ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ; e ye lɛ anɔkuale, nɛ mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose ɔ, e ye lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord helped Hezekiah, so he was successful in everything he did. He even rebelled against the king of Assyria, refusing to be his servant.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ hu piɛ e he, nɛ e yeɔ manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi. E tsɔ́ Asiria matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi atuã, nɛ e kua lɛ sɔmɔmi.

english_verse: Hezekiah defeated the Philistine towns as far away as Gaza—from the smallest towns to the large, walled cities.
translation_verse: E gbe Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya pue Gaza kɛ e huza amɛ a nɔ tɔɔ, nɛ e kpata ma wawihi, kɛ ma nguahi tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: During the fourth year of Hezekiah's rule, which was the seventh year of Hoshea's rule in Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria led his troops to Samaria, the capital city of Israel. They attacked
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia yi nɔ jeha eywiɛne nɛ ji Israel matsɛ, Hoshea, Ela binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji kpaago ɔ mi ɔ, Asiria matsɛ, Shalmaneser ba tua Samaria, nɛ e sa ma a yi.

english_verse: and captured it three years later, in the sixth year of Hezekiah's rule and the ninth year of Hoshea's rule.
translation_verse: Jeha etɛ se ɔ, e ngɔ ma a. Benɛ a ngɔ Samaria a, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Hezekia ná jeha ekpa momo ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ Israel matsɛ, Hoshea hu na jeha nɛɛ.

english_verse: The king of Assyria took the Israelites away as prisoners; he forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ ɔ nuu Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Asiria ya. E ngɔ ni komɛ ya to Hala, e ngɔ ni komɛ ya to Habor pa a nya ngɛ Gozan zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ni komɛ hu ya to Media bi ɔmɛ a ma amɛ a mi.

english_verse: All of that happened because the people of Israel had not obeyed the Lord their God. They rejected the solemn agreement he had made with them, and they ignored everything that the Lord's servant Moses had told them. King Sennacherib of Assyria Invades Judah (
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ha nɛ a ngɔ Samaria ji, Israel bi ɔmɛ bui Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ tue. Somi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mɛ so, kɛ mlaahi nɛ e tsɔlɔ Mose wo mɛ ɔ, a tɔ lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. A bui Mawu tue, nɛ e mlaa amɛ hu a yi nɔ. Asiria wo Yerusalem he gbeye (Kronika II,

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards, raise your own grain, and have plenty of olive oil and honey. Believe me, you won't starve there. Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him.
translation_verse: kɛ yaa si be nɛ matsɛ ngua a ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya zugba ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ. Wai ngmɔhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee wai; blɛfo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee abolo; oliv tsohi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee nu; hwo gbakuhi hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee hwo. Ke Hezekia mlɔɔ nyɛ nɛ e de nyɛ ke Yawɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami ɔ, nyɛ ko bu lɛ tue.

english_verse: One of the Assyrian commanders told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Asiria asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de mɛ ke matsɛ ngua nɛ ji Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e le nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ Matsɛ Hezekia heɔ e he yeɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Asiria asafoatsɛ ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Aloo o ma de mi ke o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɔ? Anɛ pi Yawɛ jami he ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Hezekia ywia, benɛ e de Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ke a ya ja Mawu ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ pɛ e hɛ mi ɔ lo?

english_verse: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah's rule in Judah, King Sennacherib of Assyria invaded the country and captured every walled city, except Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Hezekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib ba tua Yuda mahi tsuo nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ma amɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah sent this message to Sennacherib, who was in the town of Lachish: “I know I am guilty of rebellion. But I will pay you whatever you want, if you stop your attack.” Sennacherib told Hezekiah to pay ten tons of silver and one ton of gold.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia tsɔ ya de Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Lakish ke, “I tɔ o nɔ. I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o je ye zugba a nɔ; tue gblami saisaa nɛ o ma ha mi ɔ, ma pee.” Asiria matsɛ ɔ sɛ ke a ya de Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia ke e ba ha lɛ sika hiɔ kilo akpe nyɔngma, kɛ sika tsu kilo akpe.

english_verse: So Hezekiah collected all the silver from the Lord's temple and the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Hezekia ngɔ sika hiɔ nɛ e na ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e na ngɛ matsɛ we nito he ɔ tsuo kɛ mane lɛ.

english_verse: He even stripped the gold that he had used to cover the doors and doorposts in the temple. He gave it all to Sennacherib.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ se hu, Hezekia kplɔ sika tsu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ sinya amɛ a he, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ lɛ Matsɛ Hezekia nitsɛ ngɔ kɛ ha sinya tso ɔmɛ a he ɔ, nɛ e kɛ mane Asiria matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The king of Assyria ordered his three highest military officers to leave Lachish and take a large army to Jerusalem. When they arrived, the officers stood on the road near the cloth makers' shops along the canal from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ ɔ wo ta buli babauu blɔ kɛ je Lakish kɛ ya tua Hezekia ngɛ Yerusalem. Senakerib we asafoatsɛmɛ kpanakpanaa etɛ ji a nyatsɛmɛ. Benɛ a su Yerusalem ɔ, a ya da si ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ he nɛ bo loli ɔmɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ ɔ. Nyu dɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e mi lɛ nyu nɛ jee taku ɔ mi ngɛ yiti je ɔ guɔ.

english_verse: They called out to Hezekiah, and three of his highest officials came out to meet them. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Benɛ a bi Matsɛ Hezekia si ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɔli etɛ je kpo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba kpe. Mɛ ji Eliakim, Hilkia binyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ, Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf binyumu ɔ nɛ ngmaa sanehi kɛ too ɔ.

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: E bi ke, “O susu kaa nya puu nɛ a kɛ peeɔ ga kɛ hwuu ta lo? Mɛnɔ nɔ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ loko o tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã a?

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: O ngɛ blɔ hyɛe nɛ Egipt ba ha mo ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ okpɔngɔ tatsɛmɛ, be mi nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ nyafii pe kulaa a po o be lɛ nyɛe.

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliakim, Hilkia binyumu ɔ, kɛ Shebna, kɛ Yoa de Asiria matsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ ɔ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kɛ wɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ tu Aram gbi, ejakaa wa nuɔ. O kɛ wɔ ko tu Hebri gbi, ejakaa ma a nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ yi mi ɔ ngɛ wɔ tue bue.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you.”
translation_verse: Se asafoatsɛ ɔ de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔɛ mi nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛkɛ nyɛ ngɔ kɛ munyu nɛ ɔ. Nimli nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu munyu nɛ ɔ kɔɔ a he; ejakaa a maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a fĩ, nɛ a maa nu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zami kaa nyɛ nɔuu.”

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ te da si, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke, “Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ, nɛ ji Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ɔ tue!

english_verse: Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Anɛ je ma amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ eko nyɛ kpɔ e ma kɛ je Asiria dɛ mi hyɛ lo?

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath and Arpad? What about the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Jije Hamat kɛ Arpad mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ? Jije Sefarvaim, Hena, kɛ Iva mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ? Anɛ a nyɛ kpɔ Samaria lo?

english_verse: None of these gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord your God can do any better?
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ tsuo a mawu ɔmɛ eko nyɛ kpɔ e ma kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi hyɛ lo? Lɛɛ mɛni haa nɛ o susuɔ kaa Yawɛ ma nyɛ ma kpɔ Yerusalem mɔ?”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliakim, Hilkia binyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ, kɛ Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf binyumu ɔ nɛ ji sanehi ngmalɔ ɔ kɛ aywilɛho hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he; nɛ a ho ya bɔ Matsɛ Hezekia níhi tsuo nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ ɔ de ɔ.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko ɔ, benɛ e ngɛ e mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Nisrok ɔ jae ngɛ e mawu ɔ we ɔ, e binyumuhi enyɔ, Adramelek kɛ Sharezer ya gbe lɛ kɛ klaate, nɛ a tu fo kɛ ho Ararat zugba a nɔ ya. E binyumu kpa nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Esarhadon ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Hezekia nu amaniɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho hía e tade ɔmɛ. E bu kpekpe ya bo, nɛ e ho Yawɛ we ɔ mi ya.

translation_verse: Jije Hamat, Arpad, Sefarvaim, Hena, kɛ Iva matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ?”

english_verse: He told Prime Minister Eliakim, Assistant Prime Minister Shebna, and the senior priests to dress in sackcloth and tell the prophet Isaiah:
translation_verse: E tsɔ Eliakim, matsɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, kɛ Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ya gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz binyumu ɔ ngɔ. Mɛ hu a bu kpekpe ya bo.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ ɔ tsɔ e we asafoatsɛngua a kɛ ba jɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ. Wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nu jɛmi munyu ɔmɛ, nɛ e maa gbla nihi nɛ tu munyu ɔmɛ a tue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo fa kue ha Yawɛ kɛ ha wa ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: When these leaders went to Isaiah,
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Hezekia tsɔli ɔmɛ kɛ sɛ ɔ ya ha Yesaya a,

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma ha nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ maa nu akeake munyu ko, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi ya, nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Asiria bi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba ekohu (Yesaya

english_verse: Meanwhile, the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Asiria asafoatsɛngua a nu kaa Asiria matsɛ ɔ hia kɛ je Lakish nɛ e kɛ Libna bi ya ngɛ ta hwue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya ná lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: About this same time the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko ba su Asiria matsɛ ɔ kaa Sudan matsɛ, Tirhaka hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ Egipt tabo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma nɛ e ba tua lɛ. Benɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ nu sane nɛ ɔ, e ngma womi nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya ha Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Mo nitsɛ o nu níhi nɛ Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee zugba amɛ, bɔ nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi butuu. Nɛ moo lɛɛ o susuɔ kaa o maa ye o he lo?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Benɛ nɛnɛmɛ kpata Gozan, Haran, kɛ Rezef ma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a gbe Beteden bi nɛ ngɛ Telasar a, anɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nyɛ a yi wami he lo?

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Hezekia he womi ɔ ngɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ nɛ e kane. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho Yawɛ we ɔ mi ya nɛ e ya bli womi ɔ mi ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi,

english_verse: Isaiah went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, I heard your prayer about King Sennacherib of Assyria.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Amoz binyumu Yesaya tsɔ ke a ya de Hezekia ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke, kue nɛ o fa ha lɛ ngɛ Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib he ɔ, e nu.

english_verse: He prayed: Lord God of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu lee, mo nɛ o hii si ngɛ o matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a yi mi lokoo. Mo nɔ kake too ji Mawu, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ o sisi. Mo lɛ o bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wɔ tsuo wa le kaa Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kpata je mahi, kɛ a zugbahi babauu a hɛ mi,

english_verse: They destroyed the idols of wood and stone that the people of those nations had made and worshiped.
translation_verse: nɛ a sã a mawu ɔmɛ. A kpata a hɛ mi, ejakaa tsa pi mawu nitsɛnitsɛhi ji mɛ; nimlihi a nine nya ní tsumihi, kɛ tsohi kɛ tɛhi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.

english_verse: But you are our Lord and our God! We ask you to keep us safe from the Assyrian king. Then everyone in every kingdom on earth will know that you are the only God. The Lord's Answer to Hezekiah (Isaiah
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, wa Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kpɔ wɔ kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, konɛ je ma amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a le kaa mo Yawɛ, mo nɔ kake too ji Mawu.” Yesaya kɛ sɛ gbi mane Matsɛ Hezekia (Yesaya

english_verse: Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Asiria matsɛ, Zion biyo yomiyo ɔ ngɛ mo muɔe oo! E ngɛ o he fɛu yee. Yerusalem biyo ɔ ngɛ e yi mimiɛe ngɛ o se.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And this is how you bragged about yourself: “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: O tsɔ o tsɔli kɛ ba ye Yawɛ he fɛu nɛ o de ke, ‘I ngɔ ye ta zugba lɛhi babauu kɛ kuɔ yoku ɔmɛ kɛ ya su Lebanon tɔɔ. I poo Lebanon seda tso gagaá amɛ, kɛ sɛsɛo saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si. I sɛ Lebanon hue kusuu ɔ mi kɛ ya tsitsaa lokoo.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: I tsua vuhi, nɛ i nu ma se zugba nɔ nyu; i ngɔ ye nane sisi kɛ hlui Egipt pa amɛ tsuo a mi nyu ngɔ pue he.’

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all this long ago. And you don't even realize that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: Anɛ o nui kaa i bɔni nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ní tsumi kɛ je kɛ lo? Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, i to he ga kɛ je blema lokoo, konɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee mɛ ma dokuhi.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or tender young grass growing on a flat roof, scorched before it matures.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ lɛɛ a he wami nɔ gbɔ. A tsui po, nɛ gbigbi gbe mɛ; a pee kaa nga mumu; a pee kaa nga nɔ tsohi, loo nga nɛ pu sãã lɛ nɛ e ngla ngɛ tsu yi kpɛti.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: I le o he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; o kpo jemi kɛ o mi bami, kɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ mi tuɔ munyu basabasa.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ o kɛ mi tuɔ munyu basabasa, nɛ i nu o he nɔ womi hu he he je ɔ, ma ngɔ gbowe kɛ wo o gugwɔ mi, ma wo o nya mi dade; nɛ ma kpale mo kɛ maa gu blɔ nɛ o gu nɔ kɛ ba a nɔ.”

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yesaya de Matsɛ Hezekia ke, “Enɛ ɔ maa pee okadi ha mo: jeha nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a puɛ, níhi nɛ nɔ ko du we. Jeha enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye níhi nɛ puɛ ngɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a se. Jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ma du ní nɛ nyɛ ma kpa ní; nyɛ maa pee wai ngmɔhi nɛ nyɛ maa ye a yiblii ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Yuda we ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, a ma plɔke kaa tsohi; a ma tsɛ̃ sipoku kɛ ya zu mi ekohu, nɛ a maa wo yiblii.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ maa piɛ kɛ̃, nɛ a maa je Yerusalem kɛ Zion yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ba; ejakaa Yawɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ hɛdɔ.

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɛ e gu kɛ ba a, jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ e maa gu kɛ kpale kɛ ho; se ma nɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ e be sɛe. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: I will protect it for myself and for my servant David. The Death of King Sennacherib (Isaiah
translation_verse: Ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he, kɛ si nɛ i wo ye tsɔlɔ David he je ɔ, ma bu ma nɛ ɔ he; nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be a he sae.’ ”

english_verse: After this King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho Nineve ya.

english_verse: Hezekiah died, and his son Manasseh became king.
translation_verse: Hezekia ba gbo, nɛ e binyumu Manase ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried bitterly.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kai bɔ nɛ i ba ye je mi ngɛ o hɛ mi, bɔ nɛ i ye mo anɔkuale, bɔ nɛ i sɔmɔ mo kɛ ye tsui tsuo, kɛ bɔ nɛ i pee o suɔmi nya ní.” Nɛ Hezekia fo ya kɛ he hiami.

english_verse: the Lord sent him back to Hezekiah with this message: Hezekiah, you are the ruler of my people, and I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will heal you, so that three days from now you will be able to worship in my temple.
translation_verse: e kpale e se nɛ e ya de Hezekia, Yawɛ ma a ganɔ ɔ ke, “Imi Yawɛ, o nɛ̃ David Mawu ɔ, i nu o kue fami ɔ, nɛ i na o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ. Hyɛ, ma tsa mo, nɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, o maa nyɛɛ kɛ ya Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: Then Isaiah said to the king's servants, “Bring some mashed figs and place them on the king's open sore. He will then get well.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesaya de matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wɛɛ ngmɔkɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ya to e tslɔ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ e ma na he wami.”

english_verse: Isaiah replied, “The Lord will prove to you that he will keep his promise. Will the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway go forward ten steps or back ten steps?”
translation_verse: Yesaya he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ ma ha mo okadi nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ kaa si nɛ e wo mo ɔ, e maa ye nɔ. Anɛ o suɔ kaa nini ɔ nɛ ngɛ pu ngmlɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ ya e hɛ mi nane hiami nyɔngma, aloo e ba se nane hiami nyɔngma lo?”

english_verse: “It's normal for the sun to go forward,” Hezekiah answered. “But how can it go back?”
translation_verse: Hezekia he nɔ ke, “E wɛ kulaa kaa o ma ha nɛ nini ɔ nɛ ya e hɛ mi nane hiami nyɔngma; ha nɛ e ba se nane hiami nyɔngma.”

english_verse: Isaiah prayed, and the Lord made the shadow go back ten steps on the stairway built for King Ahaz. The Lord Is Still with Hezekiah (Isaiah
translation_verse: Gbalɔ Yesaya fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ nini ɔ nɛ ngɛ pu ngmlɛ ɔ nɛ Matsɛ Ahab pee ɔ nɔ ɔ kpale kɛ ba se nane hiami nyɔngma. Tsɔli nɛ je Babilonia (Yesaya

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah had been sick, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Merodak Baladan, Baladan binyumu ɔ nu kaa Hezekia be he wami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngma womi ngɔ piɛ nike ní he nɛ e tsɔ ke a ngɔ ya ha lɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Hezekia he tsɔli ɔmɛ atuu, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a he jua wa ngɛ e nito he ɔmɛ, sika hiɔ, sika tsu, tsopa kɛ e he via, nu nɛ he jua wa, kɛ e ta hwumi níhi a tsu ɔ. Nɔ́ ko be e we ɔ mi, aloo e nɔ yemi he ɔ tsuo nɛ e tsɔɔ we mɛ.

english_verse: Isaiah asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya ba Matsɛ Hezekia ngɔ nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, jije a je, nɛ mɛni a ba de mo?” Hezekia he nɔ ke, “A je Babilonia zugba a nɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.”

english_verse: Then Isaiah told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yesaya de Hezekia ke, “Yawɛ ke,

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: be ma nɛ a ma ba muɔ o we ɔ mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ o nɛmɛ bua nya ngɔ to kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya; a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sie. Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: A maa nuu mo nitsɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ po kɛ ya Babilonia; a maa puɛ mɛ, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ ngɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi. Yawɛ lɛ de.”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told Isaiah, “The message you brought me from the Lord is good.” Hezekiah Dies (
translation_verse: Se Matsɛ Hezekia susu kaa munyu nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa he jɔmi kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba ngɛ lɛɛ e yi nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Yesaya ke, “Yawɛ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ o ngɔ ba ha mi ɔ hi.” Hezekia matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe (Kronika II,

english_verse: Everything else Hezekiah did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he made the upper pool and tunnel bring water into Jerusalem, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Hezekia he sane kpahi, kã nɛ e pee, kɛ taku nɛ e tsua, kɛ e he nyu dɔ nɛ e gba nɛ e kɛ tsɛ nyu kɛ ba ma a mi ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Amon disobeyed the Lord, just as his father Manasseh had done.
translation_verse: Amon pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ Manase pee ɔ.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord God of Israel, will destroy both Jerusalem and Judah! People will hear about it but won't believe it.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i kɛ amanehlu agbo ko maa ba Yerusalem kɛ Yuda a nɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu he ɔ, e he mi maa po.

english_verse: He rebuilt the local shrines that his father Hezekiah had torn down. He built altars for the god Baal and set up a sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah, just as King Ahab of Israel had done. And he faithfully worshiped the stars in heaven.
translation_verse: Jami hehi nɛ e tsɛ Hezekia gbɛ ɔ, e kpale dla mɛ ekohu. E ma bɔ sami la tɛhi kɛ ha Baal, nɛ e puɛ amaga kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a kaa bɔ nɛ Israel matsɛ, Ahab pee ɔ. E ja dodoehi hulɔ.

english_verse: In the temple, where only the Lord was supposed to be worshiped, Manasseh built altars for the worship of pagan gods
translation_verse: Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, he nɛ Yawɛ ke a ja lɛ pɛ ngɛ ɔ, Manase puɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and the stars. He placed these altars in both courts of the temple,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e puɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi ngɔ ma kue enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a mi, konɛ a ja dodoehi ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: and even set up the pole for Asherah there. Manasseh practiced magic and witchcraft; he asked fortunetellers for advice and sacrificed his own son. He did many sinful things and made the Lord very angry. Years ago the Lord had told David and his son Solomon: Jerusalem is the place I prefer above all others in Israel. It belongs to me, and there I will be worshiped forever.
translation_verse: Ashera amaga a nɛ e pee ɔ, e ngɔ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ. Yawɛ kɛ David, kɛ e binyumu Salomo tu we nɛ ɔ he munyu hyɛ, nɛ e de ke, “I hla we nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ je Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ngɔ to kaa he nɛ sa nɛ a ja mi ngɛ daa.

english_verse: But the people of Judah disobeyed the Lord. They listened to Manasseh and did even more sinful things than the nations the Lord had wiped out.
translation_verse: Se Yuda ma a bui Yawɛ tue, nɛ Manase mlɔɔ mɛ nɛ a ya pee yayami nɛ kle kulaa pe yayami nɛ je ma amɛ pee loko Yawɛ kpata a hɛ mi kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ mi ɔ po.

english_verse: One day the Lord said to some of his prophets:
translation_verse: Yawɛ tu munyu kɛ gu e tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e de ke,

english_verse: King Manasseh has done more disgusting things than the Amorites, and he has led my people to sin by forcing them to worship his idols.
