translation_verse: a ywia gbogbo ɔ nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia bi ɔmɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe mohu, se matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo nyɔ ɔ mi. A gu matsɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi kɛ ya be ngɛ agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ nya; nɛ a ngɔ a yi ngɔ ka Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi blɔ.

english_verse: but the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. They arrested Zedekiah, but his soldiers scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Babilonia tabo ɔ nyɛɛ Zedekia se nɛ a ya nu lɛ ngɛ Yeriko nga a nɔ; e ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛ fĩa kɛ je e he.

english_verse: Zedekiah was taken to Riblah, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty.
translation_verse: A ngɔ Zedekia ya ha Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɛ Ribla; nɛ lejɛ ɔ Nebukadnezar kojo lɛ nɛ e bu lɛ fɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: About a month later, in Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king, Nebuzaradan, who was his official in charge of the guards, arrived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ nɛɛ ɔ mi, nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ nɔ ɔ, Nebukadnezar tatsɛ kɛ tsɔlɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nebuzaradan ya Yerusalem.

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: nɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ hule gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ.

english_verse: He led away as prisoners the people left in the city, including those who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ kú nigii kɛ ho Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya a, Nebuzaradan ngɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho Babilonia ya.

english_verse: Only some of the poorest people were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.
translation_verse: Se e si nimli gu komɛ nɛ be nɔ́ ko mi ɔ ngɛ Yuda, konɛ a hu ngmɔ, nɛ a tsu ní ngɛ wai abɔɔ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: The Babylonian soldiers took the two bronze columns that stood in front of the temple, the ten movable bronze stands, and the large bronze bowl called the Sea. They broke them into pieces so they could take the bronze to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ywia akɔblee titima amɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ akɔblee nyu nɔ́ agbo ɔ kɛ e sisi daka amɛ; nɛ a muɔ akɔblee ɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya.

english_verse: They carried off the bronze things used for worship at the temple, including the pans for hot ashes, and the shovels, snuffers, and also the dishes for incense,
translation_verse: A muɔ buɛ ɔmɛ, sofi ɔmɛ, la gbemi ní ɔmɛ, tsopa kɛ e he via kã amɛ, kɛ akɔblee ní ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hu kɛ ho.

english_verse: as well as the fire pans and the sprinkling bowls. Nebuzaradan ordered his soldiers to take everything made of gold or silver.
translation_verse: A muɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ pee ɔ, ngɛyu ɔmɛ, kɛ kã wawi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The pile of bronze from the columns, the stands, and the large bowl that Solomon had made for the temple was too large to be weighed.
translation_verse: Akɔblee níhi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo pee kɛ wo Yawɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ ji titima enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyu nɔ́ agbo ɔ kɛ e sisi daka amɛ lɛɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a ngmɛ, ejakaa akɔblee ɔ jiɔ tsɔ.

english_verse: Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials.
translation_verse: Tatsɛ ɔ ngɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Seraya kɛ e setsɔ, nɛ ji osɔfo Zefania, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ buli etɛ ɔmɛ hu nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: Nebuzaradan led them all to Riblah
translation_verse: Nebuzaradan ngɔ mɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Ribla.

english_verse: When the army officers and troops heard that Gedaliah was their ruler, the officers met with him at Mizpah. These men were Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth from Netophah, and Jaazaniah from Maacah.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yuda asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ nɛ mɛɛ a ngɔɛ a he ngɔ ha we ɔ nu kaa Babilonia matsɛ ɔ wo Gedalia amlaalo ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ba nɛ a ba piɛ Gedalia he ngɛ Mizpa. Mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Netania binyumu Ishmael, Karea binyumu Yohanan, Tanhumet binyumu Seraya nɛ je Netofa a, kɛ Yezania nɛ je Maaka a.

english_verse: Gedaliah said to them, “Everything will be fine, I promise. We don't need to be afraid of the Babylonian rulers, if we live here peacefully and do what Nebuchadnezzar says.”
translation_verse: Gedalia ka asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a we bi ɔmɛ kita, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye Babilonia bi ɔmɛ gbeye. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ba hi zugba a nɔ nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa hi ha nyɛ.”

english_verse: Ishmael was from the royal family. And about two months after Gedaliah began his rule, Ishmael and ten other men went to Mizpah. They killed Gedaliah and his officials, including those from Judah and those from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Se nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, Netania binyumu Ishmael, Elishama bibi ɔ nɛ je matsɛ weku ɔ mi ɔ, ngɔ nyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ ho ya tua Gedalia ngɛ Mizpa; nɛ a gbe lɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Israel bi, kɛ Babilonia bi tsuo.

english_verse: After that, the army officers and all the people in Mizpah, whether important or not, were afraid of what the Babylonians might do. So they left Judah and went to Egypt. Jehoiachin Is Set Free (Jeremiah
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo, ohiatsɛmɛ, niatsɛmɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ je kɛ ho Egipt ya; ejakaa a ngɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ gbeye yee. A je Yehoyakin (Yeremia

english_verse: Evil-Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: Evilmerodak kɛ Yehoyakin hi si saminya, nɛ e ha lɛ blɔ nya nɛ pe bɔ nɛ e pee matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ nɛ a ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ piɛ e he ngɛ Babilonia a.

english_verse: Abraham and his slave woman Keturah had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan.
translation_verse: Abraham ngɛ plã ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ketura. E kɛ lɛ fɔ bimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ: Zimran, Yokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, kɛ Shua. Yoshan bimɛ ji Sheba kɛ Dedan.

english_verse: Ethiopia was also the father of Nimrod, the world's first mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Kush bi ji Nimrod; lɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ he biɛ kaa nɔmlɔ ngua ngɛ je ɔ mi.

english_verse: Egypt was the ancestor of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
translation_verse: Egipt nina ji Lidia bi, Anam bi, Lehab bi, Naftu bi,

english_verse: Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
translation_verse: Gomer nina ji Ashkenaz bi, Rifat bi, kɛ Togarma bi.

english_verse: Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
translation_verse: Yavan nina ji Elisha bi, Spania bi, Kipro bi, kɛ Roda bi.

english_verse: Ethiopia was the ancestor of Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamah was the ancestor of Sheba and Dedan.
translation_verse: Kush nina ji Seba bi, Havila bi, Sabta bi, Raama bi, kɛ Sabteka bi. Raama nina ji Sheba bi, kɛ Dedan bi.

english_verse: Canaan's oldest son was Sidon; his other son was Heth.
translation_verse: Kanaan bimɛ ji Sidon , kɛ Het,

english_verse: Shem was the ancestor of Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech; they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Shem bimɛ ji Elam, Ashur, Arpakshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Geter, kɛ Meshek.

english_verse: Arpachshad was Shelah's father and Eber's grandfather.
translation_verse: Arpakshad bi ji Shela, nɛ Shela bi ji Eber.

english_verse: Shem's descendants included Arpachshad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram, later renamed Abraham. Abraham's Family (Genesis
translation_verse: Abram nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abraham hulɔ ɔ. Ishmael nina (Mose I,

english_verse: Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.
translation_verse: Abraham bimɛ ji Isak kɛ Ishmael.

english_verse: Midian was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. Esau's Family (Genesis
translation_verse: Midian hu bimɛ ji Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida, kɛ Eldaa. Esau nina (Mose I,

english_verse: Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob.
translation_verse: Abraham bi ji Isak, nɛ Isak bimɛ ji Esau kɛ Yakob.

english_verse: Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
translation_verse: Esau bimɛ ji Elifaz, Reuel, Yeush, Yalam, kɛ Kora.

english_verse: Reuel was the father of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. The First Edomites and Their Kings (Genesis
translation_verse: nɛ Reuel bimɛ ji Nahat, Zera, Shama, kɛ Miza. Edom zugba a nɔ kekleekle bi (Mose I,

english_verse: Jacob was the father of twelve sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
translation_verse: Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Yuda, Isakar, Zebulun, Dan, Yosef, Benyamin, Naftali, Gad, kɛ Asher.

english_verse: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Yuda bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, mɛ ni enuɔ. E kɛ e yo Batshua, Kanaan no ɔ fɔ binyumuhi etɛ. Mɛ ji Er, Onan, kɛ Shela. Er bitɛte ɔ, nɔmlɔ yayami ji lɛ; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ gbe lɛ.

english_verse: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
translation_verse: Yuda kɛ e nganyɛ Tamar hu fɔ binyumuhi enyɔ, Perez, kɛ Zera.

english_verse: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.
translation_verse: Perez bimɛ ji Hezron, kɛ Hamul.

english_verse: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.
translation_verse: E nyɛminyumu Zera ngɛ bimɛ enuɔ. Mɛ ji Zimri, Etan, Heman, Kalkol, kɛ Darda.

english_verse: Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Karmi bi Akan, Zera nina a kake ya ngɔ níhi nɛ a tsu he ngɔ ha Mawu ɔ eko; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ amanehlu ba Israel ma a nɔ.

english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Etan ngɛ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Azaria. Matsɛ David weku kpa

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Hezron bimɛ ji Yerameel, Ram, kɛ Kaleb.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ weku kpa a ngɛ ha kɛ je Ram nɔ kɛ ya si Ishai nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Ram, Aminadab, Nashon

english_verse: Obed, and Jesse.
translation_verse: Obed, kɛ Ishai.

english_verse: Jesse had seven sons, who were born in the following order: Eliab, Abinadab, Shimea, Nethanel, Raddai, Ozem, and David.
translation_verse: Ishai ngɛ binyumuhi kpaago. A biɛhi ngɛ a wami nya ji Eliab, Abinadab, Shama, Netanel, Radai, Ozem, kɛ David.

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: A nyɛmimɛ yihi ji Zeruya, kɛ Abigail. Ishai biyo Zeruya ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Abishai, Yoab, kɛ Asahel.

english_verse: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa. The Descendants of Hezron
translation_verse: Abigail gba Yeter nɛ ji Ishmael nina a, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Amasa. Hezron nina

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Hezron binyumu Kaleb ngɔ Azuba. E kɛ lɛ fɔ biyo, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Yeriot. Binyumuhi nɛ Azuba fɔ ji Yesher, Shobab, kɛ Ardon.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: Benɛ Azuba gbo ɔ, Kaleb ngɔ Efrat, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hur.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Hur bi ji Uri, nɛ e bibi ji Bezalel.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Benɛ Hezron gbo ɔ, e binyumu Kaleb ngɔ e tsɛ Hezron yalɔyo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Efrat ɔ. E kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Ashur. Ashur ji nɔ nɛ po Tekoa ma a. Yerameel nina

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Yerameel, Hezron bitɛte ɔ ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Ram, e kekleekle bi ɔ, Buna, Oren, Ozem, kɛ Ahiya.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Onam binyumuhi ji Shamai, kɛ Yuda. Shamai hu ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Nadab kɛ Abishur.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Abishur ngɔ yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abihail, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Aban, kɛ Molid.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Abishur nyɛminyumu Nadab ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Seled, kɛ Apaim; se Seled na we bi nɛ e kɛ gbo.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Apaim bi ji Ishi, Ishi bi ji Sheshan, nɛ Sheshan bi ji Ahlai.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Yada, Shamai nyɛminyumu ɔ, e binyumuhi ji Yeter, kɛ Yonatan; se Yeter na we bi nɛ e kɛ gbo.

english_verse: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
translation_verse: Yonatan ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ, Pelet kɛ Zaza. Yerameel nina ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: nɛ e kɛ e biyo kake ha lɛ. Yarha kɛ Sheshan biyo nɛ ɔ fɔ binyumu, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Atai.

english_verse: Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron,
translation_verse: Yerameel nyɛminyumu Kaleb bitɛte ji Mesha. Mesha bi ji Zif, Zif bi ji Maresha, nɛ Maresha bi ji Hebron.

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Hebron ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Kora, Tapua, Rekem, kɛ Shema.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Shema bi ji Raham, nɛ Raham bi ji Yorkeam. Shema nyɛminyumu Rekem bi ji Shamai.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Shamai bi ji Maon, nɛ Maon bi ji Betzur.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Kaleb ngɛ plã ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Efa. Binyumuhi nɛ Efa fɔ ha lɛ ji Haran, Moza, kɛ Gazez. Haran hu ngɛ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gazez.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Kaleb ngɛ plã kpa ko hu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Maaka. Binyumuhi nɛ e kɛ lɛ hu fɔ ɔ, a biɛhi ji Sheber kɛ Tirhana.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Maaka fɔ binyumu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ a he: Shaaf kɛ Sheva. Shaaf ji nɔ nɛ to Madmana ma a sisi, nɛ Sheva hu to Makbena kɛ Gibea ma amɛ sisi. Kaleb ngɛ biyo hulɔ; a tsɛɛ lɛ Aksa.

english_verse: All of these were Caleb's descendants. Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader.
translation_verse: E bi Salma ji nɔ nɛ to Betlehem ma a sisi. E bi hu ji Haref, nɔ nɛ to Betgader ma a sisi ɔ.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Shobal nɛ to Kiriat Yearim ma a sisi ɔ, e nina ji Haroe bi, kɛ Menuhot ma a fa.

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: E nina hu ji Kiriat Yearim weku nɛ ɔmɛ: Itri, Put, Shumat, kɛ Mishrait.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Salma nɛ to Betlehem ma a sisi ɔ, e nina ji Netofat bi, Atrot Bet Yoab bi, kɛ Zori bi. Zori bi nɛ ɔmɛ ji Manahat weku ɔ fa.

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: Womi ngmali a nina nɛ hi Yabez ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Tirat bi, Shimeat bi, kɛ Sukat bi. Mɛ ji Ken bi nɛ a kɛ Rekab bi ha a sibi gba.

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: David binyumuhi ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; slo e plã amɛ hu a bimɛ. A ngɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tamar. Matsɛ Salomo nina

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Yehoyakim ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Yehoyakin kɛ Zedekia. Matsɛ Yehoyakin nina

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Matsɛ Yehoyakin nɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho ɔ, e nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Yehoyakin ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Shealtiel,

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: Malkiram, Pedaya, Shenazar, Yekamia, Hoshama, kɛ Nedabia.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Pedaya binyumuhi ji Zerubabel kɛ Shimei. Zerubabel ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Meshulam kɛ Hanania. A ngɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shelomit.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Zerubabel ngɛ binyumu kpahi enuɔ. A biɛhi ji Hashuba, Ohel, Berekia, Hasadia, kɛ Yushab Hesed.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Shekania ngɛ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shemaya, kɛ bibimɛ nɛ a biɛhi ji Hatush, Igal, Baria, Nearia, kɛ Shafat.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Nearia ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Elioenai, Hizkia, kɛ Azrikam.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Elioenai ngɛ binyumuhi kpaago. A biɛhi ji Hodavia, Eliashib, Pelaya, Akub, Yohanan, Delaya, kɛ Anani.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Yuda binyumuhi ji Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur, kɛ Shobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Shobal bi ji Reaya, Reaya bi ji Yahat, Yahat bimɛ ji Ahumai, kɛ Lahad. Zorat bi a nɛmɛ ji mɛ.

english_verse: Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
translation_verse: Kaleb yo Efrat bitɛte ji Hur. Hur nina ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ to Betlehem ma a sisi. Hur ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Etam, Penuel, kɛ Ezer. Etam binyumuhi a biɛhi ji Yezreel, Ishma, kɛ Idbash. A ngɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hazelelponi. Penuel to Gedor ma a sisi, nɛ Ezer hu to Husha ma a sisi.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Ashur nɛ to Tekoa ma a sisi ɔ ngɛ yihi enyɔ; nɔ kake biɛ ji Hela, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Ashur kɛ Naara fɔ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Ahuzam, Hefer, Temeni, kɛ Haahashtari.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Ashur kɛ Hela hu fɔ binyumuhi. A biɛhi ji Zeret, Izhar, kɛ Etnan.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: Koz bimɛ ji Anub kɛ Zobeba; nɛ e nina ji weku ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ Harum binyumu Aharhel biɛ wo mɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yabez ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ a buu pe e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. E nyɛ wo lɛ biɛ Yabez nɛ ɔ, ejakaa e fɔmi he ya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Se Yabez fa kue ha Israel Mawu ɔ ke, “Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbaa mi, nɛ o ha mi zugba nɛ kle. O kɛ mi nɛ hi si, nɛ o je ní yayamihi nɛ maa pee haomi kɛ je ye blɔ mi.” Nɛ Mawu ha lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e bi lɛ ɔ. Wɛtso kpa komɛ

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Shuha nyɛminyumu Kaleb bi ji Mehir, nɛ Mehir hu bi ji Eshton.

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: Eshton ngɛ binyumuhi. A biɛhi ji Betrafa, Pasea, kɛ Tehina. Tehina ji nɔ nɛ to Nahash ma a sisi. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nina hi Reka.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Kenaz ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Otniel, kɛ Seraya. Otniel bimɛ ji Hatat, kɛ Meonotai,

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: nɛ Meonotai bi ji Ofra. Seraya bi ji Yoab. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ to ga ní tsuli a kɔ̃ ɔ sisi; ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ga ní tsuli kpanakpanaa ji mɛ.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Yefune bi Kaleb ngɛ binyumuhi. A biɛhi ji Iru, Ela, kɛ Naam. Ela bi ji Kenaz.

english_verse: Ezrah was the father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. Mered was married to Bithiah the daughter of the king of Egypt. They had a daughter named Miriam and two sons: Shammai and Ishbah. It was Ishbah who settled the town of Eshtemoa. Mered was also married to a woman from the tribe of Judah, and their sons were Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel. Jered settled the town of Gedor; Heber settled the town of Soco; and Jekuthiel settled the town of Zanoah.
translation_verse: Ezra binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji Yeter, Mered, Efer, kɛ Yalon. Mered ngɔ Egipt matsɛ biyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Bitia, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ Miriam. Mered kɛ Bitia fɔ binyumuhi hulɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Shamai, kɛ Ishba. Ishba ji nɔ nɛ to Eshtemoa ma a sisi. Jehanɛ, Mered ngɔ yo ko hu nɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Yered, Heber, kɛ Yekutiel. Yered ji nɔ nɛ to Gedor ma a sisi. Heber lɛɛ e to Soko ma a sisi, nɛ Yekutiel to Zanoa ma a sisi.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Hodia ngɔ Naham nyɛmiyo. A nina ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ to Garm kɛ Maakat weku ɔmɛ sisi. Garm weku ɔ hi Keila ma a mi, nɛ Maakat weku ɔ hi Eshtemoa ma a mi.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Shimon ngɛ binyumuhi. A biɛhi ji Amnon, Rina, Benhanan, kɛ Tilon. Ishi hu ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Zohet, kɛ Benzohet. Shela nina

english_verse: Judah also had a son named Shelah, whose descendants included Jokim and the people of the town of Cozeba, as well as Er who settled the town of Lecah and Laadah who settled the town of Mareshah. The people who lived in Beth-Ashbea were also descendants of Shelah, and they were experts in weaving cloth. Shelah was the ancestor of Joash and Saraph, two men who married Moabite women and then settled near Bethlehem—but these family records are very old.
translation_verse: Shela ji Yuda binyumu ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake. E nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Er, nɔ nɛ to Leka ma a sisi ɔ, Laada, nɔ nɛ to Meresha ma a sisi ɔ, kploba loli a weku ɔ nɛ hi Bet Ashbea a, Yokim, Kozeba weku ɔmɛ, Yoash kɛ Saraf, nɔ nɛ ngɔ Moab yihi nɛ e ye tsɛ ngɛ Moab, nɛ lɔ ɔ se loko e ba hi Betlehem ɔ.

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, buɛ puɛli ji mɛ, nɛ a tsuɔ ní ha matsɛ ɔ. A hi Netaim kɛ Gedera ma amɛ a mi. Simeon nina

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Simeon ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Nemuel, Yamin, Yarib, Zera, kɛ Shaul.

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: Shaul bi ji Shalum, e bibi ji Mibsam, nɛ e bibimibi ji Mishma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Mishma nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: e bi Hamuel, e bibi Zakur, kɛ e bibimibi Shimei.

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: A hi ma kpa enuɔ komɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ hu a mi. Ma amɛ ji Etam, Ain, Rimon, Token, kɛ Ashan. Ni komɛ hu hi Baalat tɔɔ. Sanehi nɛ a ngma kɛ to nɛ kɔɔ a weku ɔmɛ a he, kɛ he slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a hi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.
translation_verse: A weku nikɔtɔmahi ji: Meshobab, Yamlek, Amazia bi Yosha, Yoel, Yehu , Elioenai, Yaakoba, Yeshohaya, Asaya, Adiel, Yesimiel, Benaya, kɛ Ziza . Akɛnɛ a weku ɔmɛ a he ba bɔni hiɛmi he je ɔ,

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: a hia nyɛɛmi kɛ gu bonyoku je kɛ ya si Gerar, nɛ a ya hla niye ní kɛ ha a lohwe ɔmɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ beleku je.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Ruben, Yakob bitɛte ɔ ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Hanok, Palu, Hezron, kɛ Karmi.

english_verse: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon,
translation_verse: Bela . A hi Aroer, nɛ a zugba a fɔ si kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si Nebo kɛ Baal Meon tɔɔ.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: A ngɛ lohwe babauu ngɛ Gilead zugba a nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hi Gilead beleku je ɔ kɛ ya si nga a nɔ, kɛ Yufrate pa a nya.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Matsɛ Saul yi nɔ ɔ, Ruben bi ɔmɛ ya tua Hagri bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ hwu ta. A gbe Hagri bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpɔ a zugba a nɛ ngɛ Gilead beleku je ɔ, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ. Gad nina

english_verse: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.
translation_verse: Gad wɛtso ɔ hi Ruben wɛtso ɔ we omleyi je, kɛ je Bashan zugba a nɔ kɛ ya si Saleka ngɛ beleku je.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji Huri bi Abihail nina, nɛ a nɛmɛ ji Abihail, Huri, Yaroa, Gilead, Mikael, Yeshishai, Yaroa, kɛ Buz.

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Abdiel binyumu Ahi, Guni bibi ɔ ji weku nɛ ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: A hi Bashan zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Gilead, kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle Gilead, kɛ kɔpehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Sharon.

english_verse: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
translation_verse: A bua sane nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nya ngɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yotam, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam a be ɔmɛ a mi. Beleku je wɛtso ɔmɛ a tabo

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: A kɛ Hagri bi, nɛ ji Yetur, Nafish, kɛ Nodab wɛtso ɔmɛ ya hwu ta.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: A ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ a fa kue ha lɛ ke e piɛ a he. Mawu bu a kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ e ha nɛ a ye Hagri bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a he piɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: A gbe he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu, ejakaa ta a, Mawu nine ngɛ mi. Nɛ a hi jamɛ a zugba a nɔ hluu kɛ ya si be nɛ a je Asiria nɛ a ba nuu mɛ kɛ ho. Manase wɛtso fa a

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Manase wɛtso fa a hi zugba a nɔ, kɛ je Bashan kɛ ya si Baal Hermon, Senir, kɛ Hermon yo ɔ he tɔɔ ngɛ omleyi je. A he hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: A weku ɔmɛ a nya dali ji Efer, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Yeremia, Hodavia, kɛ Yadiel. Ta buli katsɛmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi nɛ a le mɛ saminya ngɛ weku ɔmɛ a mi ji mɛ tsuo. A nuu beleku je wɛtso ɔmɛ

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Se Manase wɛtso fa a ya yi a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ anɔkuale. A je a Mawu ɔ se, nɛ a ya ja je ma amɛ nɛ Mawu fie kɛ je a blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ mohu a mawu ɔmɛ.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Israel Mawu ɔ ha nɛ Asiria matsɛ, Pul ba tua a ma a. Tiglat Pileser nuu Ruben, Gad, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya to Hala, Habor, Hara, kɛ Gozan pa a nya. Nɛ lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a ngɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohat binyumuhi ji Amram, Izhar, Hebron, kɛ Uziel.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Amram binyumuhi ji Aaron kɛ Mose. E ngɛ biyo hu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Miriam. Aaron binyumuhi ji Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ Nebukadnezar ba nuu nihi nɛ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem kɛ ho ɔ, Yehozadak hu piɛ a he. Levi nina kpahi

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Levi binyumuhi ji Gershon, Kohat, kɛ Merari.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gershon bimɛ ji Libni kɛ Shimei.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohat bimɛ ji Amram, Izhar, Hebron, kɛ Uziel.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Elkana ngɛ bimɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Amasai kɛ Ahimot.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Samuel bimɛ ji Yoel, e bitɛte ɔ, kɛ e senɔ Abiya.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: Shimea, Hagai, kɛ Asaya. Yawɛ we ɔ mi lali

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ David ngɔ la he blɔ nya tomi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ngɔ wo a dɛ, benɛ a kɛ somi daka a ya su lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: A nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a dla ní tsumi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ ha. Aaron nina

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Aaron kɛ e nina lɛɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a sã sami bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a to blɔ nya kɛ ha jami ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. Mɛ nɔuu ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ daa Israel ma a tsuo nane mi kɛ sãã kpatami bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔlɔ Mose fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ.

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: A ha mɛ Hebron ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ ji lohwe lɛmi hehi nɛ bɔle ma a.

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: Se ngmɔhi, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ ngɛ Hebron ɔ, a kɛ lɔ ɔmɛ ha Yefune bi Kaleb.

english_verse: So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh.
translation_verse: Mahi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ha Aaron nina kɛ piɛ Hebron he ji wesa he ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ: Libna, Yatir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, kɛ Bet Shemesh.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: A ha Kohat weku ɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma amɛ kɛ je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ zugba mi: Geba, Alemet, kɛ Anatot. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mahi tsuo nɛ a ha Kohat weku ɔ nɛ a hi mi ji nyɔngma kɛ etɛ.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, a fɔ sɔ kɛ dla zugba kɛ ha Kohat bi nɛ piɛ ɔ, nɛ a na ma nyɔngma kɛ je Manase wɛtso fa a zugba mi.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: A ha Gershon weku ɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ etɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ngɛ Bashan zugba a nɔ kɛ je wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ a zugba mi: Isakar, Asher, Naftali, kɛ Manase fa a.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Merari weku ɔ hu, a ha mɛ ma nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya kɛ je wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ a zugba mi: Ruben, Gad, kɛ Zebulun.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gu kɛ dla mahi, kɛ a he kɔpehi kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a hi mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon.
translation_verse: Efraim wɛtso ɔ ha Kohat bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ wesa he ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma amɛ: Shekem ngɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ, Gezer, Yokmeam, Bet Horon, Aiyalon, kɛ Gat Rimon.

english_verse: And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Manase wɛtso fa a nɛ piɛ ɔ hu ha Kohat bi ɔmɛ Aner, Bileam kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Wesa he mahi, kɛ a he kɔpehi nɛ Manase wɛtso fa a ha Gershon weku ɔ ji Golan ngɛ Bashan, kɛ Ashtarot.

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Naftali wɛtso ɔ ha mɛ Kedesh ngɛ Galilea, Hamon, Kiriataim, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Zebulun wɛtso ɔ ha Merari bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma amɛ: Rimono, kɛ Tabor.

english_verse: They also received four towns east of the Jordan River from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the flatlands, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, including the pastures around them.
translation_verse: Ruben wɛtso ɔ ha mɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a he kɔpehi ngɛ Yordan pa a se ngɛ Yeriko Bezer ngɛ nga a nɔ: Yaza, Kedemot, kɛ Mefaat.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Isakar ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ. A biɛhi ji Tola, Pua, Yashub, kɛ Shimron.

english_verse: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were
translation_verse: Tola ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Uzi, Refaya, Yeriel, Yamai, Ibsam, kɛ Shemuel. Ta buli katsɛmɛ, kɛ we puɔ nya dali ji mɛ ngɛ Tola weku ɔ mi. Matsɛ David yi nɔ ɔ, a hiɛmi ji akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: A tsɛ Efraim nyɛ ya ha mɛ ligbi babauu, nɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba jɔɔ e bua.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Uzi binyumu ji Izrahia. Izrahia binyumuhi ji Mikael, Obadia, Yoel, kɛ Ishia. We puɔ nya dali ji mɛ ni enuɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Zofa nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Sua, Harnefer, Shual, Beri, Imra,

translation_verse: Benyamin ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ. A biɛhi ji Bela, Beker, kɛ Yediael.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Bela ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Ezbon, Uzi, Uziel, Yerimot, kɛ Iri. We puɔ nya dali, kɛ ta buli katsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo ngɛ weku ɔ mi. A nina nɛ a kane ɔ, a hiɛmi ji akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya nyingmi etɛ kɛ eywiɛ.

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Beker ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Zemira, Yoash, Eliezer, Eleoenai, Omri, Yeremot, Abiya, Anatot, kɛ Alemet. Beker bimɛ ji mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,

translation_verse: Yediael bi ji Bilhan. Bilhan ngɛ binyumuhi kpaago. A biɛhi ji Yeush, Benyamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Zetan kɛ Tarshish, kɛ Ahishahar.

translation_verse: Naftali ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Yaziel, Guni, Yezer, kɛ Shalum. Bilha nina ji mɛ. Manase nina

translation_verse: Zabad, nɛ Zabad fɔ Shutela. Efraim ngɛ binyumu kpahi kɛ piɛ Shutela he; nɔ kake biɛ ji Ezer, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Elead. Be ko mi ɔ, Ezer kɛ Elead ka kaa a maa ju Gat bi a na, nɛ Gat bi ɔmɛ gbe mɛ.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, e kɛ e yo ɔ na bɔmi ekohu; yo ɔ ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e fɔ binyumu. A wo lɛ biɛ ke Beria, ngɛ haomi nɛ ba a nɔ ɔ he.

translation_verse: Efraim ngɛ biyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sheera. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ to ma nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi: yiti je Bet Horon, dɔ si je Bet Horon, kɛ Uzen Sheera.

translation_verse: Mahi, kɛ a he kɔpehi nɛ Manase nina a na ji Bet Shan, Taanak, Megido, kɛ Dor. Yakob binyumu Yosef nina ji nihi nɛ hi ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi. Asher nina

translation_verse: Asher nina ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Asher ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi, kɛ Beria. E ngɛ biyo kake hulɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sera.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Beria ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Heber, kɛ Malkiel. Malkiel ji nɔ nɛ to Birzait ma a sisi.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Heber ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Yaflet, Shomer, kɛ Hotam; a ngɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Yaflet hu ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Pasak, Bimhal, kɛ Ashvat.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Yaflet nyɛminyumu Shomer binyumuhi ji Roga, Yehuba, kɛ Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Shomer nyɛminyumu Hotam hu ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Zofa, Imna, Shelesh, kɛ Amal.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

translation_verse: Yeter nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Yefune, Pispa, kɛ Ara.

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: Ula nina ji Ara, Haniel, kɛ Rizia.

translation_verse: Asher nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. We puɔ nya dali, ta buli katsɛmɛ, kɛ ganɔhi nɛ ngɛ biɛ ji mɛ tsuo. Nyumuhi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ ekpa nɛ le ta hwumi piɛ Asher nina a he.

translation_verse: Ehud nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Naaman, Ahiya, kɛ Gera. We puɔ nya dali ji mɛ ngɛ Geba. Se a nuu mɛ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho Manahat ya. Gera ji nɔ nɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho. E binyumuhi ji Uza kɛ Ahihud.

translation_verse: Elpaal ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Eber, Misham, kɛ Shemed. Shemed ji nɔ nɛ to Ono kɛ Lod ma amɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma amɛ ɔ sisi. Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Gat kɛ Aiyalon

translation_verse: Beria kɛ Shema ji we puɔ nya dali komɛ. A hi Aiyalon, nɛ a fie Gat bi ɔmɛ kɛ je a ma a mi.

english_verse: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.

translation_verse: Yeyel ji nɔ nɛ to Gibeon ma a sisi, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ. E yo biɛ ji Maaka,

translation_verse: Ner bi ji Kish, nɛ Kish bi ji Matsɛ Saul. Saul ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Yonatan, Malkishua, Abinadab, kɛ Eshbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Yonatan bi ji Meribaal, nɛ Meribaal bi ji Mika.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Mika ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Piton, Melek, Tarea, kɛ Ahaz.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Ahaz bi ji Yehoada. Yehoada ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Alemet, Azmavet, kɛ Zimri. Zimri bi ji Moza.

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Azel ngɛ binyumuhi ekpa. A biɛhi ji Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Shearia, Obadia, kɛ Hanan.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Azel nyɛminyumu Eshek ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Ulam, Yeush, kɛ Elifelet.

english_verse: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of
translation_verse: Ulam binyumu ɔmɛ ɔ, ta buli katsɛmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a nine nya da kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃mi. E bimɛ kɛ e bibimɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ. Mɛ tsuo a je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ, Benyamin bi ɔmɛ, Efraim bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Manase bi ɔmɛ ya hi Yerusalem.

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.

translation_verse: Levi bi nɛ ba hi Yerusalem ji: Shemaya, Hashub bi ɔ. E nɛmɛ ji Azrikam kɛ Hashabia nɛ a je Merari weku ɔ mi ɔ Bakbakar, Heresh, ke Galal Matania, Mika bi ɔ. english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Yawɛ we ɔ he buli nɛ ba hi Yerusalem ji Shalum, Akub, Talmon, kɛ Ahiman. Shalum ji a nya dalɔ.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kore bi Shalum, Ebiasaf bibi ɔ, e kɛ e nyɛmimɛ Kora bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ji a bu Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee benɛ a hyɛ Yawɛ ma sito he ɔ nɔ ɔ.

translation_verse: Agbo nya buli nikɔtɔma eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Levi bi ji mɛ, nɛ a dɛ mi nɛ a to ní tsumi ɔ kɛ wo. Mɛ nɔuu nɛ a hyɛɛ tsuhi kɛ níhi nɛ a to ngɛ a mi ɔ a nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.

translation_verse: Levi no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Matitia, nɛ ji Shalum nɛ je Kora weku ɔ mi ɔ bitɛte ɔ, e ní tsumi ji e sã keeki nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
translation_verse: David kɛ Israel ma a ho Yuda zugba a nɔ ya konɛ a ya ngɔ Mawu somi daka a ngɛ Baala nɛ e biɛ kpa ji Kiriat Yearim ɔ. Somi daka nɛ ɔ, a kɛ Yawɛ nɛ hii kerub ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ biɛ tsɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Some time later, David talked with his army commanders,
translation_verse: Matsɛ David kɛ e we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji ta buli akpehi kɛ lafahi a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kpe.

english_verse: David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, “Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest?”
translation_verse: David ye Mawu gbeye jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɛ e bi ke, “Lɛɛ kɛ ma pee kɛ ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ya we mi kɛɛ?”

english_verse: The people agreed this was the right thing to do.
translation_verse: Ga nɛ David wo nɛ ɔ sa ma a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kplɛɛ kaa a pee ja.

english_verse: The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart,
translation_verse: A ya ngɔ Mawu somi daka a ngɛ Abinadab we ɔ mi, nɛ a kɛ ma tlɔɔke he mi. Uza kɛ Ahio ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ tlɔɔke ɔ blɔ tsɔɔe.

english_verse: while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, David kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ngɛ lae nɛ a ngɛ doe kɛ a he wami tsuo kɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami woe. A la, nɛ a fiɛ do, nɛ a fia saku slɔɔtohi, kpa sakuhi, ngmlɛhi, kɛ gɔgɔhi; nɛ a kpa titimatihi.

english_verse: But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling.
translation_verse: Benɛ a su Kidon ngma mi sami he ɔ, na amɛ nɛ ngɛ tlɔɔke ɔ gblae ɔ a nane tɛ si, nɛ daka a mimiɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Uza nu daka a kɛ da si.

english_verse: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ mi mi fu Uza, nɛ e fia lɛ nɔ nɛ e gbe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa e nine ta daka a he. Uza gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Perez Uza, nɛ ja a tsɛɔ lɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. E dɔ David kaa Yawɛ ngɔ abofu kɛ gbla Uza tue.

english_verse: So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, David kɛ somi daka a yɛ Yerusalem. Mohu ɔ, e kɛ somi daka a ya ma Obed Edom nɛ je Gat ɔ we mi.

english_verse: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_verse: Mawu somi daka a hi Obed Edom we ɔ mi nyɔhiɔ etɛ; nɛ Yawɛ gbaa Obed Edom kɛ e we ɔ, kɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.

english_verse: David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ David ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Baal Perazim, nɛ e ye a nɔ kunimi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E de ke, “Mawu ngɔ mi kɛ gba blɔ kɛ gblee he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a mi kaa pa nɛ hia lalaala kɛ bee.” Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Baal Perazim ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
translation_verse: David pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu fa lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kpata Filisti bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ je Gibeon hluu kɛ ya si Gezer tɔɔ.

english_verse: David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?” The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
translation_verse: David bi Mawu ke, “Ma ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ lo? O ma je mɛ kɛ wo ye dɛ mi lo?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, moo ya! Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ma je Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo o dɛ mi.”

english_verse: Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
translation_verse: Filisti bi ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ je a mawu ɔmɛ a he, nɛ David ha nɛ a sã mɛ.

english_verse: Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
translation_verse: Ke o nu nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a yi mi kaa ta buli nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ; ejakaa imi Mawu i nyɛɛ o hɛ mi kɛ yaa nɛ ma ya gbe Filisti ta buli ɔmɛ.”

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ya tsu a he, konɛ a ya ngɔ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ somi daka a kɛ ba.

translation_verse: A gbe na ku kpaago, kɛ jijɔ kpaago kɛ sã bɔ, ejakaa Mawu piɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ somi daka a a he.

english_verse: While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsuo ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ba Yerusalem. Benɛ a ma a tsuo a ngɛ titimati kɛ koli kpae, nɛ a ngɛ ngmlɛ kɛ kpa saku hu fiae kɛ ngmlaa.

translation_verse: Benɛ daka a ba su David ma a mi ɔ, Mikal, Saul biyo ɔ je e hɛ mi kpo ngɛ saflɛ mi, nɛ e na Matsɛ David nɛ ngɛ tuue nɛ e ngɛ doe, nɛ David he pee lɛ tai.

translation_verse: nɛ osɔfohi enyɔ ma kpa titimati ngɛ somi daka a hɛ mi daa. Nɔ kake biɛ ji Benaya, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Yahaziel.

translation_verse: Se Yawɛ ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ nɔ ko nɛ wa mɛ yi mi; e bɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ a he.

translation_verse: Osɔfo Zadok, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ e ha mɛ ní tsumi ngɛ Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Gibeon ɔ mi.

english_verse: They were to offer sacrifices on the altar every morning and evening, just as the Lord had commanded in the Law he gave Israel.
translation_verse: Daa mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a ní tsumi ji a sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mlaa a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha Israel ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were their assistants, as well as the other men who had been chosen to praise the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛɔ a he kɛ tsuɔ ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ji Heman, Yedutun, kɛ ni komɛ nɛ a je blɔ hla mɛ ke a la kɛ je Yawɛ yi ngɛ e suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were also responsible for blowing the trumpets, and for playing the cymbals and other instruments during worship at the tent. The Levites in Jeduthun's clan were the guards at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Heman kɛ Yedutun a ní tsumi kpa hu ji a hyɛ titimati kpami, kɛ ngmlɛ kɛ saku fiami ɔ nɔ be mi nɛ a ngɛ yi jemi la amɛ lae ɔ. Agbo nya bumi ní tsumi ɔ, a kɛ ha Yedutun weku ɔ.

english_verse: Soon after David moved into his new palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest is kept in a tent.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ David ba je matsɛ we ɔ mi. Ligbi ko ɔ, e tsɔ ya tsɛ gbalɔ Natan kɛ ba, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ kaa imi i ngɛ we nɛ a ma kɛ seda mi, be mi nɛ Yawɛ somi daka a lɛɛ e ngɛ bo tsu mi!”

english_verse: and yet you have promised to do even more for my descendants. You are treating me as if I am a very important person.
translation_verse: Se Mawu lee, enɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ji nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi. O wo si kaa o tsɔlɔ ɔ nina maa hiɛ babauu hwɔɔ se, nɛ mo Yawɛ Mawu, o je sisi bɔni mi hɛɛmi momo kaa nɔmlɔ ngua.

english_verse: That night, the Lord told Nathan
translation_verse: Se jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu de Natan ke,

english_verse: to go to David and tell him: David, you are my servant, so listen carefully: You are not the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: “Yaa nɛ o ya de ye tsɔlɔ David ke, Yawɛ ke, ‘Pi mo ji nɔ nɛ maa po we ha mi nɛ ma hi mi.’

english_verse: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.
translation_verse: Kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ i ya kpɔ Israel ma a kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i hí we ko mi hyɛ; bo tsu ji we nɛ i hii mi ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ i yaa.

english_verse: I chose special leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?
translation_verse: Kɛ je be nɛ i kɛ Israel ma a bɔni si kpami nɛ ɔ, i bi we ma nya dali nɛ i hla nɛ a hyɛ ye ma a nɔ ɔ a ti nɔ ko hyɛ ke, ‘Mɛni he je o kɛ seda ma we tsu ha mi?’

english_verse: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.
translation_verse: Imi lɛ i kɛ mo nyɛɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba, nɛ imi nɔuu lɛ i kpata o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ o blɔ ɔ nɔ. Ma ha nɛ o ma na biɛ kaa nimli nguanguahi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a ti nɔ ko.

english_verse: I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried beside your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler,
translation_verse: Ke o gbo, nɛ a ya dla mo ngɛ o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hwɔ he ɔ, ma wo mo nitsɛ o mi mi bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake matsɛ ngɛ o se, nɛ ma ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa ya nɔ.

english_verse: and no one will be able to take his kingdom away from him. He will be the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma ba po we ha mi, nɛ ma ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: I will be like a father to him, and he will be like a son to me. I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you.
translation_verse: Ma pee e tsɛ, nɛ e maa pee ye bi. Ye suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a, i be hae nɛ jamɛ a suɔmi ɔ se nɛ po ngɛ e nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: I will make sure that your son and his descendants will rule my people and my kingdom forever.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to ye ma a nya, nɛ e maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene. E matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble.’ ”

english_verse: Nathan told David exactly what the Lord had said. David Gives Thanks to the Lord (
translation_verse: Natan ya bɔ David níhi nɛ a de lɛ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a je ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ. David sina sɔlemi (Samuel II,

english_verse: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts. What else can I say, except that you have honored me?
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛni pa ngɛ imi David, ye nya nɛ ma de mo? O le imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ saminya, se kɛ̃ ɔ, o wo ye hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. He sat there and prayed: Lord God, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ David ya sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e sɔle ke, “Yawɛ Mawu, mɛnɔ ji mi, nɛ ye we ɔ hu mɛnɔmɛ ji mɛ, loko o hɛɛ mi kɛ ba su he nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: No other god is like you, Lord—you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nɔ ko be nɛ kɛ mo sɔ; wa le kɛ je blema, kaa mo pɛ ji Mawu.

english_verse: And there is no other nation on earth like Israel, the nation you rescued from slavery in Egypt to be your own. You became famous by using great and wonderful miracles to force other nations and their gods out of your land, so that your people could live here.
translation_verse: Ma ko be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ pe o ma Israel nɛ mo Mawu o ya kpɔ kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi kɛ ba pee mo nitsɛ o ma a. Ní nguanguahi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o tsu ha o ma a, ha o biɛ pɛ kɛ kpe je ɔ mi tsuo. Benɛ o ma a nɛ o kpɔ kɛ je Egipt ɔ hia kɛ ma a, o fie je ma kpa amɛ kɛ je a blɔ mi.

english_verse: You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.
translation_verse: O ngɔ o ma, Israel ngɔ pee mo nitsɛ o ma kɛ yaa neneene. Nɛ mo, Yawɛ o ba pee a Mawu.

english_verse: Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, “The Lord All-Powerful rules Israel and is their God.” My kingdom will be strong,
translation_verse: O biɛ maa jije kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ nihi ma de ke, ‘Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ji Israel Mawu’. Nɛ o ma ha imi, o tsɔlɔ David, ye matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: because you are my God, and you have promised that my descendants will be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.
translation_verse: Ye Mawu, o je ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ o de mi ke o maa bɔ we ha mi; lɔ ɔ he nɛ ye nɔ gbagba te, nɛ i ngɛ kue nɛ ɔ fae ha mo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You are the Lord God, and you have made this good promise to me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lee, Mawu ji mo; mo ji nɔ nɛ o wo mi nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ ɔ he si.

english_verse: Now please bless my descendants forever, and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already blessed my family, and I know you will bless us forever.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ya nɔ nɛ o gbaa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, ye nina daa. Yawɛ lee, o gbaa mɛ momo, nɛ o gbaami ɔ maa hi a nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.”

english_verse: While King Hadadezer of Zobah was trying to gain control of the territory near the Euphrates River, David met him in battle at Hamath and defeated him.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, David ye Zoba matsɛ, Hadadezer nɔ kunimi ngɛ Hamat zugba a kasa nya; ejakaa Hadadezer ngɛ hlae nɛ e ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a he ɔ.

english_verse: Hadadezer's officers had carried gold shields, but David took these shields and brought them back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: David kpɔ sika tsu tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ nɛ Hadadezer tsɔli ɔmɛ hɛɛ ɔ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ e kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.

english_verse: Then David stationed some of his troops in Damascus, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him. Everywhere David went, the Lord helped him win battles.
translation_verse: David to ta buli a hi hehi ngɛ Damasko. Siria bi ɔmɛ ba plɛ pee e sɔmɔli, nɛ a tsuɔ tó kɛ haa lɛ. Yawɛ haa nɛ David yeɔ kunimi ngɛ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: King Tou of Hamath and King Hadadezer had been enemies. So when Tou heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sent his son Hadoram to congratulate David on his victory. Hadoram also brought him gifts made of gold, silver, and bronze.
translation_verse: e tsɔ e binyumu Yoram ya nga David, nɛ e ha lɛ ayekoo kaa e kɛ Hadadezer hwu ta nɛ e ye e nɔ kunimi, ejakaa lɛ Toi ɔ nitsɛ e kɛ Hadadezer hwu ta hluu. Yoram hɛɛ nike ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ akɔblee pee kɛ ya ha David.

english_verse: David gave these gifts to the Lord, just as he had done with the silver and gold he had captured from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.
translation_verse: Matsɛ David gbaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu nɛ e kpɔ ngɛ je mahi nɛ e ye a nɔ ɔ a dɛ ɔ. Je ma nɛ ɔmɛ ji Edom, Moab, Amon, Filistia, kɛ Amalek.

english_verse: Then he stationed troops in Edom, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler. Everywhere David went, the Lord gave him victory in war. A List of David's Officials (
translation_verse: Abishai to ta buli a hi hehi ngɛ Edom, nɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ba plɛ pee Matsɛ David sɔmɔli. Yawɛ haa nɛ David yeɔ kunimi ngɛ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah was the commander in chief of the army. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept the government records.
translation_verse: Zeruya binyumu Yoab ji tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma; Ahilud binyumu Yehoshafat ji sanehi ngmalɔ;

english_verse: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests. Shavsha was the secretary.
translation_verse: Ahitub binyumu Zadok kɛ Abiatar binyumu Ahimelek ji osɔfohi, nɛ Seraya ji David nitsɛ e pɛdiyo.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was the commander of David's bodyguard. David's sons were his highest-ranking officials.
translation_verse: Yehoyada binyumu Benaya ji Keret kɛ Pelet bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji David we bi a tabo. David binyumu ɔmɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya nguanguahi ngɛ matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: David said, “Nahash was kind to me, so I will be kind to his son.” He sent some officials to Ammon to tell Hanun how sorry he was that his father had died. But when David's officials arrived at Ammon,
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Amon bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nahash ɔ ba gbo; nɛ e binyumu Hanun ba ye e se. David de ke, “I kɛ Hanun maa hi si saminya kaa nɔ kɛ e huɛ, ejakaa e tsɛ Nahash kɛ mi hi si saminya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David tsɔ ya ha Hanun lakpoo, benɛ Nahash gbo ɔ. Se benɛ David tsɔli ɔmɛ ya su Amon nɛ a ya nga matsɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Joab saw that the enemy troops were lined up on both sides of him. So he picked some of the best Israelite soldiers to fight the Syrians.
translation_verse: Yoab na bɔ nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ gba ta a ha, kaa a ma lɛ tuami kɛ je hɛ mi kɛ se blɔ tsuo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hla Israel ta buli komɛ nɛ a kɔni si wa, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ kpee Siria bi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: When the kings who had been under Hadadezer's rule saw that Israel had defeated them, they made peace with David and accepted him as their new ruler. The Syrians never helped the Ammonites again.
translation_verse: Benɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Hadadezer sɔmɔe ɔ ná le kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ye a nɔ ɔ, a kɛ David ya kpata, nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Siria bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye, nɛ a ya ji ngmlaa ha we Amon bi ɔmɛ hu.

english_verse: the Ammonite leaders said to Hanun, “Do you really believe King David is honoring your father by sending these men to comfort you? He probably sent them to spy on our country, so he can come and destroy it.”
translation_verse: Amon ganɔ ɔmɛ bi a matsɛ ɔ ke, “O susu kaa David tsɔ nihi ba ha mo lakpoo konɛ e kɛ wo o tsɛ hɛ mi nyami lo? Dɛbida! Ni ɔmɛ nɛ David tsɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, pe a ba nɛ a ba slaa ma a, nɛ a kɛ kpa níhi si loko a ba tua wɔ.”

english_verse: Hanun arrested David's officials and had their beards shaved off and their robes cut off just below the waist, and then he sent them away.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Hanun nuu David tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ e sɛ a kpɛni nɛ e hia a tade ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ kpɛti kɛ ba su a mlɛ mi, nɛ e ngmɛɛ a he nɛ a ho.

english_verse: They were terribly ashamed. When David found out what had happened to his officials, he sent a message that told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back. Then you can come home.”
translation_verse: Benɛ David nu nɔ́ nɛ ba a, e tsɔ ya de mɛ ke a mlɛ ngɛ Yeriko kɛ yaa si a kpɛni ɔmɛ maa hɛ loko a ba, ejakaa e ngɛ mɛ zo pee kaa a maa kpale kɛ ba bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: David heard what was happening, and he sent out Joab with his army.
translation_verse: Benɛ David nu he ɔ, e wo Yoab kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo blɔ nɛ a kɛ mɛ ya kpe.

english_verse: The Ammonite troops marched to the entrance of the city and prepared for battle, while the Syrian troops took their positions in the open fields.
translation_verse: Amon bi ɔmɛ hia nɛ a ya gba ta ngɛ a ma nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Raba a we agbo ɔ nya. Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ je ngmlaa ha mɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a gba ta kɛ gu nga a nɔ je.

english_verse: Then he put his brother Abishai in command of the rest of the army and told them to fight against the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo e nyɛminyumu Abishai dɛ mi, konɛ mɛ hu a kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ nɛ ya kpe.

english_verse: Joab told his brother, “If the Syrians are too much for me to handle, come and help me. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I'll come and help you.
translation_verse: Yoab de lɛ ke, “Ke e ba mi kaa i ya nyɛ we Siria bi ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ o ba nɛ o ba piɛ ye he. Se ke Amon bi ɔmɛ ngɛ mo gbee ɔ, lɛɛ imi hu ma ba piɛ o he.

english_verse: Be brave and fight hard to protect our people and the towns of our Lord God. I pray he will do whatever pleases him.”
translation_verse: Moo pee kã, nɛ o ha nɛ waa da si kaa nyumuhi kɛ ha wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wa Mawu ɔ ma amɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, e pee.”

english_verse: Joab and his soldiers attacked the Syrians, and the Syrians ran from them.
translation_verse: Yoab kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ ba na Siria bi ɔmɛ konɛ a kɛ mɛ ba hwu, se Siria bi ɔmɛ tu fo.

english_verse: When the Ammonite troops saw that the Syrians had run away, they ran from Abishai's soldiers and went back into their own city. Joab then returned to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Benɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ na kaa Siria bi ɔmɛ tu fo ɔ, mɛ hu a tu fo kɛ je ta nɛ a kɛ Abishai ngɛ hwue ɔ nya kɛ ho ma a mi ya. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yoab kpa Amon bi ɔmɛ a se nyɛɛmi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.

english_verse: As soon as the Syrians realized they had been defeated, they sent for their troops that were stationed on the other side of the Euphrates River. Shophach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, led these troops to Ammon.
translation_verse: Siria bi ɔmɛ na kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ye a nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya ngɔ Siria tabohi nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a beleku je ɔ kɛ ba. A kɛ tabo nɛ ɔmɛ ba ha Zoba matsɛ, Hadadezer we asafoatsɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shobak ɔ; nɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ hwu ta.

english_verse: David found out what the Syrians were doing, and he brought Israel's entire army together. They crossed the Jordan River, and he commanded them to take their positions facing the Syrian troops. Soon after the fighting began,
translation_verse: Benɛ David nu he ɔ, e bua Israel tabo ɔmɛ tsuo a nya. E kɛ mɛ po Yordan pa a, nɛ e kɛ mɛ gba ta kɛ kpee Siria bi ɔmɛ. Benɛ a bɔni ta a hwumi ɔ,

english_verse: The next spring, the time when kings go to war, Joab marched out in command of the Israelite army and destroyed towns all over the country of Ammon. He attacked the capital city of Rabbah and left it in ruins. But David stayed in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Gbo, be mi nɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pɔɔ ta gbami ɔ, Yoab ngɔ tabo ɔ tsuo kɛ ya tua Amon zugba a. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Matsɛ David lɛɛ e ngɛ Yerusalem. A ya sa ma a nɛ a tsɛɛ Raba a yi; a tua ma a, nɛ a kpata ma a hɛ mi.

english_verse: He forced the people of Rabbah to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. He also did the same thing with the people in all the other Ammonite towns. David then led Israel's army back to Jerusalem. The Descendants of the Rephaim (
translation_verse: Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ David muɔ mɛ kɛ ba nɛ e ba ha mɛ ní tsumi kpakpataa komɛ nɛ a kɛ sau, dade kpakplaa kɛ gbiɛ slɔɔtohi tsuɔ. David pee Amon bi ɔmɛ a ma kpa amɛ tsuo kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem. Tahi nɛ a kɛ Filisti oblai komɛ hwu (Samuel II,

english_verse: Some time later, Israel fought a battle against the Philistines at Gezer. During this battle, Sibbecai from Hushah killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim, and the Philistines were defeated.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ hwu ta ekohu ngɛ Gezer. Benɛ a ngɛ ta nɛ ɔ hwue ɔ, Israel no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sibekai gbe Filisti oblai ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sipai. Nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ha yi.

english_verse: In another battle against the Philistines, Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam.
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ hwu ta ekohu. Ngɛ ta nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Yair binyumu Elhanan gbe Goliat nɛ je Gat ɔ nyɛminyumu Lami. Lami we akplɔ ɔ nya tso ti kaa bo lolɔ gba tso.

english_verse: Another one of the Philistine soldiers who was a descendant of the Rephaim was as big as a giant and had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. During a battle at Gath,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, a hwu ta ekohu ngɛ Gat, he nɛ nyumu oblai ko ngɛ ɔ. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, nine nguɛ ekpatsɛ kɛ nane nguɛ ekpatsɛ ji lɛ. Blema oblai ɔmɛ a nina ji lɛ.

english_verse: he made fun of Israel, so David's nephew Jonathan killed him.
translation_verse: Nyumu nɛ ɔ bɔ Israel ma a ahlua, nɛ Yonatan nɛ ji David nyɛminyumu Shama binyumu ɔ gbe lɛ.

english_verse: David and his soldiers killed these three men from Gath who were descendants of the Rephaim.
translation_verse: Ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ gbe ɔ, Gat oblai ɔmɛ a nina ji mɛ.

english_verse: But David replied, “No! I want to pay you what they're worth. I can't just take something from you and then offer the Lord a sacrifice that cost me nothing.”
translation_verse: Se matsɛ ɔ de Arauna ke, “Dɛbi, ma wo mo hiɔ sisiisi. I be níhi ngɔe ngɛ o dɛ gu kɛ ha Yawɛ. Jehanɛ se hu, i kɛ níhi nɛ i ná yaka be sami bɔ sãe ha Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Gad, one of David's prophets,

english_verse: Joab answered, “Your Majesty, even if the Lord made your kingdom a hundred times larger, you would still rule everyone in it. Why do you need to know how many soldiers there are? Don't you think that would make the whole nation angry?”
translation_verse: Yoab de matsɛ ɔ ke, “I ná nɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ ma a hiɛmi ba pee nimli nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ a yibɔ totoe lafa! Nɛ ke e ba ja a, pi mo nɛnɛ, o tsɔli ji mɛ tsuo lo? Mɛni he je o ngɛ hlae nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ? O li kaa o kɛ haomi maa ba ma a tsuo nɔ lo?”

english_verse: But David would not change his mind. And so Joab went everywhere in Israel and Judah and counted the people. He returned to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Se matsɛ ɔ nyɛ Yoab nɔ nɛ e bu e fami ɔ tue. Yoab ho, nɛ e ya kpa Israel zugba a tsuo nɔ; nɛ e kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem.

english_verse: Joab refused to include anyone from the tribes of Levi and Benjamin, because he still disagreed with David's orders. God Punishes Israel (

english_verse: and David prayed, “It's my fault! I sinned by ordering the people to be counted. They have done nothing wrong—they are innocent sheep. Lord God, please punish me and my family. Don't let the disease wipe out your people.” David Buys Araunah's Threshing Place (
translation_verse: David sɔle ke, “Mawu lee, imi lɛ i pee yayami ɔ nɛ; imi lɛ i tɔ̃. Imi ji nɔ nɛ fa ke a kane ma a nɛ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ kaa jijɔhi ɔ lɛɛ mɛni a pee? Yawɛ, ye Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbla i kɛ ye tsɛ we ɔ kɛkɛ wa tue; o ma a lɛɛ ha nɛ a ye a he.”

english_verse: David's order to count the people made God angry, and he punished Israel.
translation_verse: Sane nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ Mawu nya; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e gbla Israel ma a tue.

english_verse: David prayed, “I am your servant. But what I did was stupid and terribly wrong. Please forgive me.”
translation_verse: David de Mawu ke, “I pee yayami agbo kaa i tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ. I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ kɛ pa mi. I je kuasia.”

english_verse: Gad went to David and told him: You must choose how the Lord will punish you:
translation_verse: Gad ba David ngɔ nɛ e ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Te nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: Will there be three years when the land won't grow enough food for its people? Or will your enemies constantly defeat you for three months? translation_verse: Hwɔ nɛ ba o zugba a nɔ jeha etɛ? Aloo o hi fo tue ngɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tabo ɔmɛ a nya hlami etɛ? Aloo Yawɛ nɛ ngɔ e klaate ɔ kɛ fia mo ní, nɛ e tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ nɛ e kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ ba Israel zugba a nɔ tsuo ligbi etɛ? Mɛni heto ma ngɔ kɛ ya ha nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ?”

english_verse: David was miserable and said, “It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.”
translation_verse: David de Gad ke, “Sane nɛ ɔ he wa ha mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ! Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i be suɔe nɛ nimli adesahi nɛ a gbla ye tue. Ha nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ gbla ye tue, ejakaa e mɔbɔ nami ɔ hiɛ babauu.”

english_verse: So the Lord sent a horrible disease on Israel, and
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ha gbenɔ hiɔ ba Israel ma a nɔ, nɛ nihi akpe nyingmi kpaago gbo.

english_verse: Then he sent an angel to destroy the city of Jerusalem. But just as the angel was about to do that, the Lord felt sorry for all the suffering he had caused the people, and he told the angel, “Stop! They have suffered enough.” This happened at the threshing place that belonged to Araunah the Jebusite.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ, konɛ e ya kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi. Se benɛ bɔfo ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma puɛ ní ɔ, Yawɛ tsake e yi mi tomi ɔ, nɛ e de bɔfo ɔ ke, “Mo kpa! E hiɛ!” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ daa si ngɛ Yebus no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Arauna a ngma mi sami he ɔ.

english_verse: David saw the Lord's angel in the air, holding a sword over Jerusalem. He and the leaders of Israel, who were all wearing sackcloth, bowed with their faces to the ground,
translation_verse: David na Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpɛti. E hɛɛ e klaate ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ David kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo kpla si, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si. Mɛ tsuo a bu kpekpe.

english_verse: The Lord's angel told the prophet Gad to tell David that he must go to Araunah's threshing place and build an altar in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de Gad ke e fa David nɛ e ya ma bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ ngɛ Arauna ngma mi sami he ɔ.

english_verse: Just then, David arrived, and when Araunah saw him, he stopped his work and bowed down.
translation_verse: Benɛ Arauna na Matsɛ David nɛ ma ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e je ngma mi sami he ɔ nɛ e ya kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si.

english_verse: David said, “Would you sell me your threshing place, so I can build an altar on it to the Lord? Then this disease will stop killing the people. I'm willing to pay whatever you say it's worth.”
translation_verse: David de lɛ ke, “Moo jua o ngma mi sami he ɔ ha mi nɛ ma ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ konɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se nɛ po. Ma wo mo hiɔ sisiisi.”

english_verse: Araunah answered, “Take it, Your Majesty, and do whatever you want with it. I'll even give you the oxen for the sacrifice and the wheat for the grain sacrifice. And you can use the threshing-boards for the fire. It's all yours!”
translation_verse: Arauna de David ke, “Nɛnɛ, ngɔɔ nɛ o kɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ. Nahi nɛ o kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Jehanɛ, tsohi nɛ a saa ngma mi ngɛ a nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o kɛ pee lɛ́. Ngma hu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ o kɛ pee niye ní bɔ. I ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ke mo.”

english_verse: David built an altar and offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. David prayed, and the Lord answered him by sending fire down on the altar.
translation_verse: E ma bɔ sami la tɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e sã sami bɔhi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi. E fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ bu e kue fami ɔ tue. Yawɛ ha nɛ la je hiɔwe ba sã ní ɔmɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: because he was afraid of the angel's sword and did not want to go all the way to Gibeon. That's where the sacred tent that Moses had made in the desert was kept, as well as the altar where sacrifices were offered to the Lord.

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ David de ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu we ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ Israel ma a maa sã sami bɔhi ngɛ nɔ ɔ maa hi ɔ nɛ.” A dla ní kɛ ha Yawɛ we ɔ mami

english_verse: He said, “The temple for the Lord must be great, so that everyone in the world will know about it. David Instructs Solomon To Build the Temple
translation_verse: David de e he ke, “We ɔ nɛ ye bi Salomo ma ba ma ha Yawɛ ɔ, e sa nɛ e kle agbo, nɛ́ e he biɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo. Se ye bi ɔ, jokuɛyo ji lɛ, nɛ e hɛ mi fa we lolo. english_verse: David sent for his son Solomon and told him to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: E tsɛ e bi Salomo, nɛ e fa lɛ ke e po we ha Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: He said: My son, I wanted to build a temple where the Lord my God would be worshiped.
translation_verse: David de lɛ ke, “Ye bi, jinɛ imi nitsɛ i hla kaa ma po we kɛ wo Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: But some time ago, he told me, “David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ de mi ke i pue muɔ si tsɔ, nɛ jehanɛ se hu, i hwu ta babauu tsɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ke e be hae nɛ ma po we ha lɛ.

english_verse: Solomon will build my temple. He will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. In fact, one of his descendants will always rule in Israel.”
translation_verse: Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma ba po we ha mi. E maa pee ye bi, nɛ imi hu ma pee e tsɛ. E nina maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ maa ya neneene.’ ”

english_verse: Solomon, my son, I now pray that the Lord your God will be with you and keep his promise to help you build a temple for him.
translation_verse: David ya nɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bi, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ mo nɛ hi si. Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ ye e si womi ɔ nɔ, konɛ o nyɛ nɛ o po we ha lɛ.

english_verse: May he give you wisdom and knowledge, so that you can rule Israel according to his Law.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ ha mo nile kɛ juɛmi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ye Israel nɔ ngɛ e mlaa a nya.

translation_verse: Mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ wo Israel ma a kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ, ke o ye a nɔ ɔ, e maa hi ha mo. O he nɛ wa nɛ o pee kã; koo ye nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko gbeye!
