english_verse: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.

translation_verse: E de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si, nɛ e ha nyɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ loko wa ba hiɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ mɛ tsuo ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi. I ye a nɔ kunimi, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ba pee nyɛɛ kɛ Yawɛ nyɛ sɔmɔli.

translation_verse: Ladan ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ. A biɛhi ji Yehiel, Zetam, kɛ Yoel.

translation_verse: Kohat bitɛte nɛ ji Amram ɔ lɛɛ e binyumuhi ji Aaron kɛ Mose. Aaron kɛ e nina lɛɛ a hla mɛ ngɔ to, nɛ a ngɔ Yawɛ we ɔ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɔ wo a dɛ. A ní tsumi ji a sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha Yawɛ, á sɔmɔ Yawɛ, nɛ á kɛ Yawɛ biɛ nɛ gbaa ma a.

translation_verse: Eliezer ngɛ binyumu kake pɛ; a tsɛɛ lɛ Rehabia. Se Rehabia lɛɛ e ngɛ nina babauu.

english_verse: Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
translation_verse: Merari binyumu enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mushi ɔ ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Mahli, Eder, kɛ Yeremot.

translation_verse: Mushi ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ. A biɛhi ji Mahli, Eder, kɛ Yeremot. Levi bi ɔmɛ a wekuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a nyɛmimɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Aaron nina a pee ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ hu fɔ sɔ kɛ dla ní tsumi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha a he. Weku ɔmɛ a nya dali, kɛ a senihi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ fɔ sɔ ɔ. A fɔ sɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Matsɛ David, Zadok, Ahimelek, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: There were
translation_verse: . Asharela

english_verse: The musicians were divided into
translation_verse: A dla nimli

english_verse: Elam, Jehohanan, and Eliehoenai.
translation_verse: Elam, Yehohanan, kɛ Eliehoenai.

english_verse: Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.
translation_verse: Meshelemia we ɔ ha nyumuhi katsɛmɛ nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ.

english_verse: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
translation_verse: Nyumu ko ngɛ Merari weku ɔ mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hosa. E ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ; a biɛhi ji Shimri, Hilkia, Tebalia, kɛ Zakaria. Hosa wo e bi Shimri nɔkɔtɔma, pohu pi lɛ ji bitɛte. Hosa weku li tsuo nɛ buu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ji nyɔngma kɛ etɛ.

english_verse: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.
translation_verse: A dla Yawɛ we ɔ buli ɔmɛ kɛ wo kuuhi a mi ngɛ a weku ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Levi bi kpa amɛ peeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
translation_verse: A fɔ sɔ kɛ dla agbo ɔmɛ nɛ a maa bu a he ɔ kɛ ha we puɔ nya tsuaa we puɔ nya; a hyɛ we we puɔ nya ko klemi kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate.
translation_verse: Nɛ́ a fɔ sɔ ɔ, a kɛ agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ ha Shelamia, nɛ a kɛ omleyi je nɔ́ ɔ ha e bi Zakaria. Zakaria nɛ ɔ, a tsɔɔ kaa e woɔ ga kpakpa.

english_verse: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.
translation_verse: A kɛ agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ ha Obed Edom, nɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngɔ nito he ɔmɛ ngɔ wo a dɛ nɛ a bu he.

english_verse: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. The guards were assigned the following work schedule:
translation_verse: Shupim kɛ Hosa nɔ́ ji agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ, kɛ Shaleket agbo ɔ, ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɛ ngɛ yiti je ɔ he.

english_verse: Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms,
translation_verse: Daa ligbi ɔ, buli ekpa ya buu agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ nya; ni eywiɛ ya buu omleyi je nɔ́ ɔ nya, nɛ ni eywiɛ hu ya buu leneyi je nɔ́ ɔ nya. Buli eywiɛ ya buu nito he ɔmɛ daa ligbi; ni enyɔ buu kake he, nɛ ni enyɔ hu buu kake he.

english_verse: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
translation_verse: Tsu nguaa a nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ, buli eywiɛ buu gbɛjegbɛ ɔ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ ni enyɔ buu tsu nguaa a nitsɛ he.

english_verse: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari. Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a dla bumi ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ ha Kora kɛ Merari weku ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yawɛ we ɔ he ní tsumi kpa komɛ

english_verse: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Ahiya nɛ je Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ hyɛɛ Mawu we ɔ nito he ɔmɛ, kɛ nito hehi he nɛ a toɔ nike níhi nɛ a gbaa nɔ ngɔ to ha Yawɛ ngɛ ɔ hu a nɔ.

english_verse: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.
translation_verse: Ladan nɛ ji Gershon bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ɔ, e bi ji Yahiel. Yahiel we puɔ nya amɛ, kɛ we puɔ nya kpahi babauu a nɛ̃ ji lɛ.

english_verse: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
translation_verse: Ladan bimɛ kpahi nɛ ji Zetam, kɛ Yoel ɔ, mɛɛ a ní tsumi ji a hyɛ Yawɛ nito he ɔ, kɛ nito he kpa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: A dla ní tsumi ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɔ ha Amram, Izhar, Hebron kɛ Uziel nina a hulɔ.

english_verse: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.
translation_verse: Yawɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ji Shebuel. E je Mose bi Gershom weku ɔ mi.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.
translation_verse: Nike ní tsuo nɛ Matsɛ David, we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ, wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ, kɛ tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbaa nɔ kɛ to ha Mawu ɔ, Shelomit kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ lɛ a hyɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.
translation_verse: Ta yibu ní nɛ a ha ngɛ ta mi ɔ, a hla ekomɛ ngɔ to nɛ a gbaa nɔ, konɛ a ngɔ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ to konɛ a kɛ tsu ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, Shelomit kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hyɛɛ nɔ. Ní ɔmɛ ekomɛ ji nike ní nɛ gbalɔ Samuel, Matsɛ Saul, Kish bi ɔ, Ner bi Abner, kɛ Zeruya bi Yoab ngɔ kɛ ba. Levi bi kpa komɛ a ní tsumi

english_verse: Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
translation_verse: A hla Kenania kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Izhar nina a kpɛti, nɛ a pee mɛ Israel ma a nɔ hyɛli kɛ kojoli.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records. Officials in Charge of the King's Property
translation_verse: Yoab nɛ a tsɛɛ e nyɛ ke Zeruya a ba bɔni ma a kanemi, se e gbi nya. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mawu gbla Israel ma a tue, nɛ e ngmɛ́ nihi nɛ a kane mɛ ɔ a hiɛmi kɛ wui David yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔ mi. Matsɛ weto níhi a nɔ hyɛli

english_verse: Here is a list of the leaders of each tribe in Israel: Eliezer son of Zichri was over Reuben; Shephatiah son of Maacah was over Simeon; Hashabiah son of Kemuel was over the Levites, and Zadok the priest was over the descendants of Aaron; Elihu the brother of David was over Judah; Omri son of Michael was over Issachar; Ishmaiah son of Obadiah was over Zebulun; Jerimoth son of Azriel was over Naphtali; Hoshea son of Azaziah was over Ephraim; Joel son of Pedaiah was over West Manasseh; Iddo son of Zechariah was over East Manasseh; Jaasiel son of Abner was over Benjamin; Azarel son of Jeroham was over Dan.
translation_verse: Israel wɛtsoyihi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Wɛtso Wɛtsoyi Ruben Eliezer, Zikri bi ɔ Simeon Shefatia, Maaka bi ɔ Levi Hashabia, Kemuel bi ɔ Aaron Zadok Yuda Elihu, Matsɛ David nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake Isakar Omri, Mikael bi ɔ Zebulun Ishmaya, Obadia bi ɔ Naftali Yeremot, Azriel bi ɔ Efraim Hoshea, Azazia bi ɔ Manase fa a Yoel, Pedaya bi ɔ Manase fa a Ido, Zakaria bi ɔ Benyamin Yaasiel, Abner bi ɔ Dan Azarel, Yeroham bi ɔ.

english_verse: When David decided to count the people of Israel, he gave orders not to count anyone under
translation_verse: Matsɛ David kane we nihi nɛ a jeha sui nyingmi enyɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ wo si kaa e ma ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he maa hiɛ kaa hiɔwe dodoehi.

english_verse: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.
translation_verse: Matsɛ David tsɛko Yonatan ji ga wolɔ. E ngɛ juɛmi saminya, nɛ e le womi mi hulɔ. E kɛ Hakmoni bi Yehiel ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hyɛɛ matsɛbimɛ ɔmɛ a ní kasemi nɔ.

english_verse: Ahithophel and Hushai the Archite were two of David's advisors.
translation_verse: Ahitofel ji matsɛ ɔ ga wolɔ, nɛ Ark no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hushai ɔ ji matsɛ ɔ huɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.
translation_verse: Benɛ Ahitofel gbo ɔ, Benaya bi Yehoyada, kɛ Abiatar ba pee ga woli. Yoab ji matsɛ tabo ɔ nyatsɛ.

english_verse: David called a meeting in Jerusalem for all of Israel's leaders, including the tribal leaders, the government officials, the army commanders, the officials in charge of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, and the brave warriors.
translation_verse: Matsɛ David kpee Israel ma ní tsuli nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yerusalem: wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ, asafo kuu ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a weto ní, kɛ a lohwehi a nɔ. Jehanɛ hu, matsɛ we mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ, ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ tabo ɔ tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem.

english_verse: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ David ba da si ngɛ ma a hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ, kɛ ye ma, nyɛɛ bu mi tue! Jinɛ i to nɛ ma po we nitsɛ nɛ a to somi daka a, he nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ hii ɔ ngɛ mi. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa hia kɛ ha we nɛ ɔ pomi ɔ, i bua nya.

english_verse: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
translation_verse: Se Mawu de mi ke, ‘Pi mo nɛ o maa po we kɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami; ejakaa ta bulɔ ji mo, nɛ o pue muɔ si.’

english_verse: The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hla imi, kɛ ye nina kaa waa ye Israel nɔ matsɛ kɛ ya neneene. Yawɛ hla Yuda wɛtso ɔ, nɛ e pee mɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli. Jehanɛ, e hla tsaatsɛ we ɔ, nɛ ngɛ tsaatsɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, e ná ye he bua jɔmi, nɛ e wo mi Israel tsuo nɔ matsɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel.
translation_verse: E ha mi bimɛ babauu, nɛ e hla Salomo kɛ je ye binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ke e ba hi matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ e ye Yawɛ nitsɛ ma, Israel ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘O bi Salomo ji nɔ nɛ maa ma ye we ɔ; ejakaa i hla lɛ kɛ pee ye bi, nɛ imi hu ma pee e tsɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ nɛ ji Yawɛ ma a hɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ wo wɔ ɔ a nɔ fitsofitso. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, zugba kpakpa nɛ ɔ maa pee nyɛ nɔ daa, nɛ nyɛ ma si kɛ ha nyɛ bimɛ nɛ maa ba ngɛ nyɛ se ɔ kaa gbosi ní kɛ maa ya neneene.”

english_verse: Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, David de Salomo ke, “Ye bi Salomo, i ngɛ mo dee ke ó le o tsɛ e Mawu ɔ, nɛ o sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ o tsui tsuo, kɛ o juɛmi tsuo; ejakaa Yawɛ le wa susumi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa suɔmi nya ní ɔmɛ tsuo. Ke o hla e se blɔ ɔ, e ma he mo; se ke o kua lɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e maa je o se kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
translation_verse: Ná nɛ o le kaa Yawɛ hla mo konɛ o ma e we klɔuklɔu ɔ. Pee kã nɛ o kɛ tsu ní tsumi nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ David ngɔ foni ɔ nɛ a maa hyɛ nɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ e mi tsu ɔmɛ ɔ, nito he ɔmɛ, hiɔwe tsu ɔmɛ, se tsu ɔmɛ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, he nɛ a kɛ yayami paa ngɛ ɔ ngɔ ha Salomo.

english_verse: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: David ha Salomo fonihi nɛ a maa hyɛ a nɔ kɛ ma níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e juɛmi mi, Yawɛ we ɔ he kue ɔmɛ, tsuhi nɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, níhi nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ nike níhi nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ a to hehi.

english_verse: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, David ha Salomo fonihi nɛ a maa hyɛ nɔ kɛ dla ní tsumi ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ a maa hyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a nɔ ha.

english_verse: He told Solomon how much gold and silver was to be used in making the sacred objects,
translation_verse: E tsɔɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu hiɛmi nɛ á ngmɛ kɛ pee níhi nɛ a kɛ ma sɔmɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ,

english_verse: the gold table which held the sacred loaves of bread, the tables made of silver,
translation_verse: sika hiɔ okplɔɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ sika tsu okplɔɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔɔ abolo kɛ maa nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, Matsɛ David de e bi Salomo ke, “Wlua mo, nɛ o pee kã, nɛ o tsu ní ɔ. Koo ye gbeye, nɛ o tsui ko po; ejakaa Yawɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ i sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ kɛ mo ngɛ. E be mo kuae, nɛ e be mo sie kɛ yaa si o maa gbe e we ɔ he ní tsumi ɔmɛ tsuo nya.

english_verse: The priests and Levites have been assigned their duties, and all the skilled workers are prepared to do their work. The people and their leaders will do anything you tell them.
translation_verse: A dla ní tsumi ngɔ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ma tsu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Ní tsuli nɛ le ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi pee klaalo nɛ a maa piɛ o he. Jehanɛ se hu, ma a, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ mlɛe nɛ o wo gbi, konɛ a ba piɛ o he.”

english_verse: That's why I have done my best to get everything Solomon will need to build it—gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, onyx, turquoise, colored gems, all kinds of precious stones, and marble.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ a kɛ maa ma ye Mawu ɔ we ɔ, i bɔ mɔde bua nya: sika tsu, sika hiɔ, akɔblee, dade, tso, tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa, tɛhi nɛ kpɛɔ, tɛhi nɛ a kɛ maa níhi a mi, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa kpa komɛ.

english_verse: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ pee níhi tsuo nɛ ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ maa pee ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ bie ke nyɛ ti mɛnɔ suɔ kaa e maa je e tsui mi faa nɛ e ke Yawɛ nɔ́ ko lo?”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, the family leaders, the tribal leaders, the army commanders, and the government officials voluntarily gave gifts
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ, wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ ní tsumihi nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ si a gugue ke a ma ha

english_verse: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa ngɛ a dɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ. Nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔ ji Yehiel nɛ je Levi we puɔ nya nɛ a tsɛɛ Gershon ɔ.

english_verse: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated. David Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Ma a ke Yawɛ ní kɛ je a tsui mi faa, nɛ a nya nɛ a bua jɔ a he kaa a nyɛ pee nɔ́ ko kaa ja. Matsɛ David hu bua jɔ e he saminya, nɛ e nya. David je Mawu yi

english_verse: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord: I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ David je Yawɛ yi ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, wa nɛ̃ Yakob Mawu, a je o yi kɛ ya neneene!

english_verse: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world,
translation_verse: O kle, o ngɛ he wami, kɛ hɛ mi nyami; o yeɔ kunimi, nɛ o yeɔ matsɛ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, o nɔ́. Matsɛ ji mo, nɛ o yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ.

english_verse: and you rule with strength and power. You make people rich and powerful and famous.
translation_verse: Ní nami, kɛ hɛ mi nyami tsuo jee o dɛ mi. O kɛ o he wami yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ; mo lɛ o haa nɔ biɛ, kɛ he wami.

english_verse: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.
translation_verse: “I kɛ ye ma a, mɛnɔmɛ ji wɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ je wa tsui mi faa kɛ ke mo ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ, mo lɛ o ke wɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo nitsɛ o níhi wa ngɔ ba ha mo nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lee, o le kaa wa ngɛ kaa nibwɔhi, kɛ blɔ nyɛɛli kaa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pɛ. Wa wami ligbi ɔmɛ bee kɛ yaa kaa hɔ̃, nɛ wa be nyɛe maa tu gbenɔ nya fo.

english_verse: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.

translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu lee, ha nɛ suɔmi nɛ o ma a ngɛ kɛ ha mo ɔ nɛ tsa nɔ; ha nɛ a bu mo tue kɛ ya neneene.

english_verse: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.

translation_verse: Jehanɛ, David de ma kpekpemi ɔ ke, “Nyɛ je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ yi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo je Yawɛ a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ yi. A kpla si nɛ a ja Yawɛ, nɛ a wo matsɛ ɔ hu hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: The people were very happy, and they ate and drank there at the Lord's altar. That same day, Solomon was again crowned king. english_verse: Every official and every soldier, as well as all of David's other sons, were loyal to him.

english_verse: The Lord made Solomon a great king, and the whole nation was amazed at how famous he was. In fact, no other king of Israel was as great as Solomon. David Dies

english_verse: But Rehoboam refused their advice and went to the younger men who had grown up with him and were now his officials.
translation_verse: Se Rehoboam kua ga nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ wo lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ho ya bi e juã nihewi nɛ e kɛ mɛ je nɔ ɔ mohu ga womi ke,

english_verse: He asked, “What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier?”
translation_verse: “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba de mi ke ma ha nɛ a tlomi ɔ nɔ nɛ gbɔ bɔɔ ha mɛ. Mɛni ga nyɛ ngɛ mi woe? Kɛ ma ya de mɛ kɛɛ?”

english_verse: His younger advisors said: Here's what we think you should say to them: “Compared to me, my father was weak.
translation_verse: Nihewi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ o ma de mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ye sekpɛ nguɛ kle pe tsaatsɛ mlɛ mi.

english_verse: He made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: Tsaatsɛ ngɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ ngɔ tloo nyɛ; imi lɛɛ i kɛ tlomi ɔ eko ma pa piɛ he ha nyɛ. Tsaatsɛ ngɔ kpa gu kɛ fia nyɛ; imi lɛɛ i kɛ okpɔngɔ kpa maa fia nyɛ!’ ”

english_verse: Rehoboam ignored the advice of the older advisors. He spoke bluntly
translation_verse: Rehoboam kua nikɔtɔma amɛ a ga womi ɔ, nɛ e kɛ ma a tu munyu basabasa

english_verse: and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested. He said: “My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ wo lɛ ga ke e pee ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ ngɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ ngɔ tloo nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ i kɛ tlomi ɔ eko ma pa piɛ he ha nyɛ. Tsaatsɛ kɛ kpa gu fia nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ i kɛ okpɔngɔ kpa maa fia nyɛ!”

english_verse: as well as with shields and spears. He used these fortified cities to keep control of Judah and Benjamin. The Priests and the Levites Support Rehoboam
translation_verse: E to tsɛ̃ihi, kɛ akplɔhi hu ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi. Bɔ nɛ e pee nɛ e kɛ ye Yuda kɛ Benyamin nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Osɔfohi kɛ Levi bi ba Yuda

english_verse: Meanwhile, the Lord had told Shemaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha gbalɔ Shemaya ke,

english_verse: “The Lord warns you not to go to war against the people from the northern tribes—they are your relatives. Go home! The Lord is the one who made these things happen.” Rehoboam and his army obeyed the Lord's message and did not attack Jeroboam and his troops. Rehoboam Fortifies Cities in Judah
translation_verse: ‘Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ko hwu ta. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ho e we mi ya; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ ba nɛ ɔ, ye he ngɛ mi.’ ” A bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ. Rehoboam fia gbogbo ngɔ wo ma amɛ a he

english_verse: Rehoboam ruled from Jerusalem, and he had several cities in Judah turned into fortresses so he could use them to defend his country. These cities included
translation_verse: Rehoboam hi Yerusalem, nɛ e fia gbogbo ngɔ wo Yuda kɛ Benyamin ma nɛ ɔmɛ a he:

english_verse: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
translation_verse: Betlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

english_verse: Beth-Zur, Soco, Adullam,
translation_verse: Betzur, Soko, Adulam,

english_verse: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
translation_verse: Gat, Maresha, Zif,

english_verse: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
translation_verse: Adoraim, Lakish, Azeka,

english_verse: he assigned an army commander to each of them and stocked them with supplies of food, olive oil, and wine,
translation_verse: Rehoboam fia gbogbo ngɔ wo ma nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e hla asafoatsɛmɛ kɛ to ma amɛ a nya. E to niye ní, oliv nu, kɛ wai ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi.

english_verse: The priests and Levites from the northern tribes of Israel gave their support to King Rehoboam.
translation_verse: Osɔfohi kɛ Levi bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ ɔ je a hi he ɔmɛ kɛ ba Rehoboam ngɔ ngɛ Yuda.

english_verse: And since Jeroboam and the kings of Israel that followed him would not allow any Levites to serve as priests, most Levites left their towns and pasturelands in Israel and moved to Jerusalem and other towns in Judah.
translation_verse: Levi bi ɔmɛ je a kɔpe ɔmɛ, kɛ a zugba kpa amɛ a he, nɛ a ba Yuda kɛ Yerusalem, ejakaa Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam kɛ e se yeli ɔmɛ ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a tsu ní kaa Yawɛ we osɔfohi.

english_verse: Jeroboam chose his own priests to serve at the local shrines in Israel and at the places of worship where he had set up statues of goat-demons and of calves.
translation_verse: Yeroboam wo osɔfohi nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ a sɔmɔ ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ; a ja wɔhi, kɛ amagahi nɛ ngɛ kaa na bi nɛ lɛ Yeroboam ɔ puɛ.

english_verse: But some of the people from Israel wanted to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done. So they followed the priests and Levites to Jerusalem, where they could offer sacrifices to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛ je Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, nihi nɛ suɔ kaa a ma ja Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo ɔ, nyɛɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ ba Yerusalem. A ba Yerusalem konɛ a ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: For the next three years, they lived in Judah and were loyal to Rehoboam and his kingdom, just as they had been loyal to David and Solomon. Rehoboam's Family
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo Yuda matsɛ yemi ɔ mi he wami, nɛ ma a piɛ Salomo bi Rehoboam he jeha etɛ sɔuu; a kɛ lɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ Matsɛ David, kɛ Matsɛ Salomo hi si ɔ. Rehoboam weku

english_verse: Rehoboam and Mahalath had three sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
translation_verse: Rehoboam kɛ e yo ɔ fɔ binyumuhi etɛ: Yeush, Shemaria, kɛ Zaham.

english_verse: Then Rehoboam married Maacah the daughter of Absalom. Their sons were Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Rehoboam ngɔ Maaka, Absalom biyo ɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumuhi eywiɛ: Abiya, Atai, Ziza, kɛ Shelomit.

english_verse: Rehoboam was wise enough to put one of his sons in charge of each fortified city in his kingdom. He gave them all the supplies they needed and found wives for every one of them.
translation_verse: Rehoboam to blɔ nya kpakpa; e ha e binyumu ɔmɛ blɔ nya ngɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ tsuo a mi ngɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin. E ha mɛ niye ní babauu, nɛ e hla yihi fuu ha mɛ nɛ a ngɔ.

english_verse: but he still did wrong and refused to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Rehoboam pee yayami, ejakaa e pee we Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní.

english_verse: So in the fifth year of Rehoboam's rule, the Lord punished them for their unfaithfulness and allowed King Shishak of Egypt to invade Judah.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ gbla e tue. Matsɛ Rehoboam yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Egipt matsɛ, Shishak ba tua Yerusalem.

english_verse: He captured every one of the fortified cities in Judah and then marched to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Shishak ngɔ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ngɛ Yuda a, nɛ e ba su Yerusalem tɔɔ.

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah had gone to Jerusalem to escape Shishak's invasion. And while they were there, Shemaiah the prophet told them, “The Lord says that because you have disobeyed him, he has now abandoned you. The Lord will not help you against Shishak!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Shemaya ba Rehoboam, kɛ Yuda ganɔ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. Blɔɔ Yuda ganɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ya ye Shishak gbeye, nɛ a tu fo kɛ je a ma amɛ a mi ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem. Shemaya de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nyɛ kua mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ngmɛɛ nyɛ he kɛ wo Shishak dɛ mi.’ ”

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders were sorry for what they had done and admitted, “The Lord is right. We have deserted him.”
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Israel ganɔ ɔmɛ kplɛɛ kaa a pee yayami, nɛ a kɛ he si bami de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ da.”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he told Shemaiah: The people of Judah are truly sorry for their sins, and so I won't let Shishak completely destroy them. But because I am still angry,
translation_verse: Benɛ Yawɛ na kaa a pia a he ɔ, e de Shemaya ekohu ke, “Akɛnɛ a pia a he he je ɔ, i be a hɛ mi kpatae; ma he a yi wami ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ. Ye mi mi fu Yerusalem, se i be Shishak nɔ gue kɛ gbla ma a tue.

english_verse: he will conquer and rule them. Then my people will know what it's like to serve a foreign king instead of serving me.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ma ba sɔmɔ Shishak, konɛ a na slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ ye sɔmɔmi, kɛ je ma amɛ a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ a sɔmɔmi ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Shishak attacked Jerusalem and took all the valuable things from the temple and from the palace, including Solomon's gold shields.
translation_verse: Egipt matsɛ, Shishak ba tua Yerusalem niinɛ, nɛ e ngɔ ma a. E muɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ je, june nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, june nɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ sika tsu tsɛ̃ihi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo pee ɔ.

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Rehoboam ha nɛ a pee akɔblee tsɛ̃ihi kɛ to sika tsu tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ a nane mi, nɛ e to mɛ ngɔ wo tsɔli nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ agbo nya buli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he had finished worshiping.
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be nɛ matsɛ ɔ maa ya Yawɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, buli ɔmɛ hu maa hɛɛ tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ kɛ ba sɛ mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a maa kpale mɛ ya to ngɛ buli ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ mi ekohu.

english_verse: Rehoboam turned back to the Lord, and so the Lord did not let Judah be completely destroyed, and Judah was prosperous again. Rehoboam's Rule in Judah (
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Rehoboam ba e he si he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ tsuo bɛ e nɔ, nɛ a kpataa we e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Niinɛ, pee se ɔ, níhi a mi ba hi ha Yuda ekohu. Rehoboam matsɛ yemi he sane kuku

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king, including a history of his family, is written in the records of the two prophets, Shemaiah and Iddo. During Rehoboam's rule, he and King Jeroboam of Israel were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Rehoboam he sane kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, a ngma lɛ tsuo ngɛ gbalɔ Shemaya blema sanehi womi ɔ, kɛ gbalɔ Ido blema sanehi womi ɔ a mi. Daa nɛ ɔ, Rehoboam kɛ Yeroboam ngɛ ta nɔ.

english_verse: When Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Abijah became king.
translation_verse: Rehoboam ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi; nɛ e binyumu Abiya ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: Abijah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam yi nɔ, jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ, Abiya ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.

english_verse: and the troops let out a battle cry. Then with Abijah leading them into battle, God defeated Jeroboam and Israel's army.
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ he ose, nɛ Abiya nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ya tua Israel bi ɔmɛ. Mawu ye Yeroboam kɛ Israel ma a tsuo a nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: Now you and your powerful army think you can stand up to the kingdom that the Lord has given to David's descendants. The only gods you have are those gold statues of calves that Jeroboam made for you.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ, he wami ɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha David nina kaa mɛ lɛ a yeɔ matsɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ te si kɛ si jamɛ a he wami ɔ. Nyɛ he hiɛ babauu, nɛ sika tsu na bihi, nɛ ji mawuhi nɛ Yeroboam pee kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ hu ngɛ nyɛ dɛ.

english_verse: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Some time later, Abijah and King Jeroboam of Israel went to war against each other.
translation_verse: E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha etɛ. E nyɛ biɛ ji Mikaya. Uriel nɛ je Gibea a bi ji lɛ. Ta ba te si ngɛ Abiya kɛ Yeroboam a kpɛti.

english_verse: Abijah went to the top of Mount Zemaraim in the hills of Ephraim and shouted: Listen, Jeroboam and all you Israelites!
translation_verse: Tabo ɔmɛ ya bua ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. Matsɛ Abiya ya kuɔ Zemaraim yo ɔ, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa de ke, “Yeroboam kɛ Israel ma a tsuo, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has made a solemn promise that every king of Israel will be from David's family.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, kɛ David so somi ko nɛ a be se kpalee gblegbleegble, kaa David kɛ e nina maa ye Israel nɔ matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene lo?

english_verse: But Jeroboam, you were King Solomon's official, and you rebelled.
translation_verse: Nebat binyumu Yeroboam te si ngɔ wo Salomo, e matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then right after Rehoboam became king, you and your bunch of worthless followers challenged Rehoboam, who was too young to know how to stop you.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, e bua yaka nimli komɛ a nya, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya na Salomo binyumu Rehoboam. A nyɛ e nɔ nɛ e pee a suɔmi nya ní. Rehoboam nyɛ we mɛ, ejakaa e wɛ, nɛ e kpa we je mi si lolo.

english_verse: You don't even have descendants of Aaron on your side, because you forced out the Lord's priests and Levites. In their place, you appoint ordinary people to be priests, just as the foreign nations do. In fact, anyone who brings a bull and seven rams to the altar can become a priest of your so-called gods.
translation_verse: Nyɛ fie Yawɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Aaron nina a; nyɛ fie Levi bi ɔmɛ hulɔ. A nane mi ɔ, nyɛ wo osɔfohi kaa bɔ nɛ je ma amɛ peeɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hɛɛ na ku kake, loo agbosu kpaago kɛ ba tsukɔ e he ɔ, kɛkɛ e plɛ pee osɔfo kɛ ha nyɛ yaka mawu ɔmɛ.

english_verse: But we have not turned our backs on the Lord God! Aaron's own descendants serve as our priests, and the Levites are their assistants.
translation_verse: “Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ ji wa Mawu; wa kua we lɛ. Wa ngɛ osɔfohi nɛ ji Aaron nina nɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ, kɛ Levi bi nɛ piɛɔ a he kɛ tsuɔ ní.

english_verse: Two times every day they offer sacrifices and burn incense to the Lord. They set out the sacred loaves of bread on a table that has been purified, and they light the lamps in the gold lampstand every day at sunset. We follow the commands of the Lord our God—you have rejected him!
translation_verse: Daa mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a sãã sami bɔhi, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa Yawɛ. A toɔ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔɔ okplɔɔ nɛ he tsɔ ko nɔ kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ daa gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a suɔ kane ɔmɛ ngɛ sika tsu kane tso ɔmɛ a nɔ. Wɔɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ke waa pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa peeɔ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kua lɛ.

english_verse: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Mawu nitsɛ ji wa hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ. E we osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ a titimati ɔmɛ. Ke a kpa titimati ɔmɛ pɛ kɛkɛ pe wa he ose kɛ gba ta kɛ wo nyɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛ ko gba ta kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ! Nyɛ be kunimi yee!”

english_verse: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yeroboam tsɔ e ta buli ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ a ya wo ka ngɛ Yuda tabo ɔmɛ a se je. Tabo ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee Yuda tabo ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.
translation_verse: Abiya nyɛɛ Yeroboam se, nɛ e ya kpɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ: Betel, Yeshana, Efron, kɛ a he kɔpe ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.
translation_verse: Yeroboam pa na we he wami ko hu ngɛ Abiya be ɔ mi. Nyagbenyagbe ɔ, Yawɛ fia lɛ nɔ nɛ e gbo.

english_verse: Everything Abijah said and did while he was king is written in the records of Iddo the prophet.
translation_verse: Abiya he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, níhi nɛ e de, kɛ níhi nɛ e pee tsuo ɔ, a ngma ngɛ gbalɔ Ido blema sanehi womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: E jé ma se bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ. E gbɛ jami he ɔmɛ; e ku amaga amɛ, kɛ amaga a nɛ a puɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a.

english_verse: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: E fa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke a pee Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a ye e tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord blessed Judah with peace while Asa was king, and so during that time, Asa fortified many of the towns.
translation_verse: E fia gbogbo kɛ wo Yuda ma amɛ a he jamɛ a be ɔ mi. E kɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hwui ta jehahi babauu, ejakaa Yawɛ ha lɛ tue mi jɔmi.

english_verse: He said to the people, “Let's build walls and defense towers for these towns, and put in gates that can be locked with bars. This land still belongs to us, because we have obeyed the Lord our God. He has given us peace from all our enemies.” The people did everything Asa had suggested.
translation_verse: Asa de e ma Yuda ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa fia gbogbo kɛ wo ma nɛ ɔmɛ a he. Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ma mɔhi, kɛ a nya agbohi kɛ a se lami dade. Zugba a fɔɔ si ha wɔ, ejakaa wa pee Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ suɔmi nya ní. Yawɛ ha wɔ he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ he tsuaa he kɛ bɔle si.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a po ma amɛ, nɛ níhi a mi hi ha mɛ saminya.

english_verse: Asa met him there, and the two armies prepared for battle in Zephathah Valley.
translation_verse: Asa hia nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe, nɛ tabo enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ya bua ngɛ Zefata kɔ̃ ɔ mi, ngɛ Maresha kasa nya.

english_verse: Asa prayed: Lord God, only you can help a powerless army defeat a stronger one. So we depend on you to help us. We will fight against this powerful army to honor your name, and we know that you won't be defeated. You are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Asa fa kue ha Yawɛ e Mawu ɔ ke, “Yawɛ lee, mo nɛ o piɛɔ nihi nɛ a he wa, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he wɛ tsuo a he! Yawɛ, wa Mawu, moo piɛ wa he koo! Ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ. Wa ba ngɛ o biɛ mi, konɛ waa kɛ asafo babauu nɛ ɔ ba kpe. Yawɛ, mo ji wa Mawu; ko ha nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ ye o nɔ kunimi.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Asa and his army defeat the Ethiopians. The enemy soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Benɛ Asa kɛ Yuda tabo ɔ ya tua Sudan tabo ɔ, Yawɛ ye Sudan tabo ɔ nɔ kunimi. A tu fo,

english_verse: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.
translation_verse: nɛ Asa kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ ya su Gerar tɔɔ. A gbe Sudan bi ɔmɛ basabasa nɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po piɛ. Yawɛ kɛ e tabo ɔ pee mɛ butuu, nɛ Yuda tabo ɔ ha ta yibu ní babauu.

english_verse: The people who lived in the villages around Gerar learned what had happened and were afraid of the Lord. So Judah's army easily defeated them and carried off everything of value that they wanted from these towns.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a kpata mahi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ bɔle Gerar kɛ kpe ɔ a hɛ mi, ejakaa ni ɔmɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye. A ha ta yibu ní babauu ngɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.

english_verse: They also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took a lot of sheep, goats, and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: A ya tua lohwehi a lɛmi he komɛ hulɔ, nɛ a ha tohi kɛ afukpɔngɔhi babauu. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem.

english_verse: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.
translation_verse: Be ko ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ ba Oded binyumu Azaria nɔ,

english_verse: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.
translation_verse: nɛ e ho nɛ e kɛ Asa ya kpe, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Matsɛ Asa, kɛ Yuda, kɛ Benyamin bi tsuo, nyɛɛ bu mi tue! Be abɔ nɛ nyɛ pɛtɛ Yawɛ he nɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e kɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Ke nyɛ hla e se blɔ ɔ, e ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ na lɛ. Se ke nyɛ kpale ngɛ e se ɔ, lɛ hu e ma kua nyɛ.

english_verse: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.
translation_verse: Be saii ji nɛ ɔ nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ kɛkɛ, nɛ a ja we anɔkuale Mawu ɔ; osɔfohi be nɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ ní ɔ, mlaa ko hu be.

english_verse: But whenever trouble came, Israel turned back to the Lord their God and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Se benɛ haomi ba a nɔ ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ ngɔ. A hla lɛ, nɛ a na lɛ.

english_verse: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.
translation_verse: Je ma kɛ je ma ngɛ ta nɔ; ma kɛ ma hu ja nɔuu, ejakaa Mawu kɛ haomi slɔɔtohi ba a nɔ.

english_verse: As soon as Asa heard what Azariah the prophet said, he gave orders for all the idols in Judah and Benjamin to be destroyed, including those in the towns he had captured in the territory of Ephraim. He also repaired the Lord's altar that was in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Asa nu gba gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ je Oded binyumu Azaria nya a, e nɔ gbagba te. E je amagahi tsuo kɛ je Yuda kɛ Benyamin zugba a nɔ. E je amagahi tsuo kɛ je mahi nɛ e ya kpɔ ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ hu a mi, nɛ e dla Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Asa called together the people from Judah and Benjamin, as well as the people from the territories of Ephraim, West Manasseh, and Simeon who were living in Judah. Many of these people were now loyal to Asa, because they had seen that the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Nihi babauu ku kɛ je Efraim, Manase, kɛ Simeon ngɛ Israel kɛ ba Asa ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba hi si; ejakaa a nu kaa Yawɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ. Asa kpee mɛ tsuo kulaa kɛ piɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin he.

english_verse: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: A ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem, ngɛ Asa matsɛ yemi jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ we nyɔhiɔ etɛne ɔ mi.

english_verse: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped,
translation_verse: A so, nɛ a kplɛɛ kaa a ma ja Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo, kɛ a klaa tsuo.

english_verse: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord, then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.
translation_verse: A kɛ ngmlaa ka kita ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ke a maa ye somi ɔ nɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ a he ose, nɛ a kpa titimatihi, kɛ kolihi.

english_verse: Everyone was happy because they had made this solemn promise, and in return, the Lord blessed them with peace from all their enemies.
translation_verse: Yuda ma a tsuo nya, ejakaa a so somi nɛ ɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo. A bua jɔ Yawɛ jami ɔ he, nɛ Yawɛ hu he mɛ, nɛ e ha mɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: Asa's grandmother Maacah had made a disgusting idol of the goddess Asherah, so he cut it down, crushed it, and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Asa kpa e nyɛ Maaka tete po manyɛ yemi, ejakaa e pee amaga ko nɛ a hiee kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a. Asa ku amaga a ngɔ pue si. E wɛɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, nɛ e ya sã lɛ ngɛ Kidron kɔ̃ ɔ mi.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines in Israel.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa Asa gbɛ́ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Israel zugba a mi lɛɛ, se e ye Yawɛ anɔkuale e wami be ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Matsɛ Asa ya muɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ. E tsɔ e tsɔli ɔmɛ ekomɛ Damasko nɛ a kɛ ní ɔmɛ ya ha Siria matsɛ, Benhadad. Sɛ gbi nɛ piɛ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: “I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: “Ha nɛ i kɛ mo waa so kaa bɔ nɛ tsaatsɛ kɛ o tsɛ so ɔ. I ngɛ mo sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu nike ní manee. Yaa nɛ o kɛ Israel matsɛ, Baasha ya po somi nɛ o kɛ lɛ so ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e je e ta buli ɔmɛ kɛ je ye zugba a nɔ kɛ ho.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.
translation_verse: Benhadad kplɛɛ Asa munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tsɔ e tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya tua Israel ma amɛ. A ngɔ Iyon, Dan, Abel Bet Maaka, kɛ Naftali nito he ma amɛ tsuo.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped his work on the town of Ramah.
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Baasha nu sane nɛ ba a, e kpa Rama ma a dlami, nɛ e je ní tsumi ɔ he.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood. Hanani the Prophet Condemns Asa
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Matsɛ Asa bua nihi a nya kɛ je Yuda tsuo, nɛ a ya muɔ tɛhi, kɛ tsohi nɛ Baasha kɛ ba ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ Rama a. Asa ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya po Geba kɛ Mizpa ma amɛ. Gbalɔ Hanani

english_verse: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, gbalɔ Hanani ba Yuda matsɛ, Asa ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Akɛnɛ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Siria matsɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ o ngɔɛ o hɛ ngɔ fɔɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɔ he je ɔ, Siria matsɛ tabo ɔ tu fo kɛ je o he.

english_verse: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.
translation_verse: Tse Sudan bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Libia bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ta buli, ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli babauu? Se akɛnɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ he je ɔ, e ha nɛ nyɛ ye a nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ je ɔ tsuo he; nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale ɔ, e woɔ mɛ he wami. O je kuasia. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, ta maa nyɛɛ o se daa nɛ.”

translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Asa mi mi fu gbalɔ ɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e wo lɛ tsu. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Asa bɔni ma mi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ yi mi wami. Asa matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe (Matsɛmɛ I,

english_verse: Everything Asa did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Asa he sanehi kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda kɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, he got a very bad foot disease, but he relied on doctors and refused to ask the Lord for help.
translation_verse: Benɛ Asa ye jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ nɛɛ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nane hiɔ nɛ nya wa wawɛɛ ko ba bu lɛ si. Se e kɛ e kɔmɔ ɔ yɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; tsopa peeli mohu a ngɔ lɛ e ya.

english_verse: Earlier, Asa had his own tomb cut out of a rock hill in Jerusalem. So he was buried there, and the tomb was filled with spices and sweet-smelling oils. Then the people built a bonfire in his honor.
translation_verse: nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi, ngɛ tɛ sa yɔkɔ ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e kpɛ ngɔ to ɔ mi. A ngɔ lɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ gbogboe sa ko nɔ. A kɛ tsopahi kɛ a he via nɛ a je blɔ futu slɔɔtoslɔɔto dla sa nɛ ɔ, nɛ a slɛ la ko nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege kɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king and strengthened his defenses against Israel.
translation_verse: Yehoshafat ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e tsɛ Asa se, nɛ e dla konɛ e kɛ Israel nɛ kpe.

english_verse: He assigned troops to the fortified cities in Judah, as well as to other towns in Judah and to those towns in Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
translation_verse: E ngɔ ta buli ngɔ to Yuda mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ, kɛ Efraim mahi nɛ e tsɛ Asa kpɔ ɔ a mi.

english_verse: When Jehoshaphat's father had first become king of Judah, he was faithful to the Lord and refused to worship the god Baal as the kings of Israel did. Jehoshaphat followed his father's example and obeyed and worshiped the Lord. And so the Lord blessed Jehoshaphat
translation_verse: E sɔmɔ e tsɛ Mawu ɔ; e ye Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ e pee we e ní kaa Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: and helped him keep firm control of his kingdom. The people of Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, but even after he became very rich and respected,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ da si, nɛ Yuda ma a tsuo wo tó ha lɛ. E na ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ e hɛ mi ba nyami.

english_verse: he remained completely faithful to the Lord. He destroyed all the local shrines in Judah, including the places where the goddess Asherah was worshiped.
translation_verse: E sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ e he wami tsuo. E gbɛ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ amaga a nɛ a puɛ kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yuda nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a hu e ku lɛ pue si.

english_verse: Their assistants were the following nine Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-Adonijah. Two priests, Elishama and Jehoram, also went along.
translation_verse: Levi bi nɛɛ, kɛ osɔfohi enyɔ piɛ a he kɛ ho. Levi bi nɛ ya a ji Shemaya, Netania, Zebadia, Asahel, Shemiramot, Yehonatan, Adoniya, Tobiya, kɛ Tobadoniya; nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ji Elishama, kɛ Yehoram.

english_verse: They carried with them a copy of the Lord's Law wherever they went and taught the people from it.
translation_verse: A hɛɛ Yawɛ mlaa womi ɔ kɛ ya kpa Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ a tsɔɔ ma a mlaa a. Yehoshafat ba pee nɔmlɔ agbo

english_verse: The nations around Judah were afraid of the Lord's power, so none of them attacked Jehoshaphat.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha nɛ sawale nu matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle Yuda a, nɛ a ti nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e kɛ Matsɛ Yehoshafat nɛ hwu ta.

english_verse: from the Judah and Benjamin tribes. These soldiers were grouped according to their clans. Adnah was the commander of the troops from Judah, and he had
translation_verse: we puɔ nya we puɔ nya. Ta buli nɛ je Yuda a, a nyatsɛ ji Adna. E we bi ɔmɛ a hiɛmi ji akpe lafa etɛ.

english_verse: These were the troops who protected the king in Jerusalem, not counting those he had assigned to the fortified cities throughout the country.
translation_verse: Ta buli nɛ sɔmɔ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; slo ni nɛmɛ nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to Yuda ma kpahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi.

english_verse: Ahab and Jehoshaphat led their armies to Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Ahab kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat ho ya tua Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ.

english_verse: One day, Jehoshaphat went to visit Ahab in his capital city of Samaria. Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle and prepared a big feast to honor Jehoshaphat and the officials with him. Ahab talked about attacking the city of Ramoth in Gilead,
translation_verse: Jeha komɛ a se ɔ, Yehoshafat ya Samaria ma a mi ya slaa Ahab. Ahab gbe tohi kɛ nahi babauu kɛ nya Yehoshafat, kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ ɔ a he; nɛ e wo Yehoshafat yi mi ke e piɛ e he nɛ a kɛ Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ ya hwu ta.

english_verse: But first let's ask the Lord what to do.”
translation_verse: Se mohu ɔ, ha nɛ wa bi Yawɛ ga womi lolo.”

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Se Yehoshafat bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ gbalɔ kpa ko be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ wa ma bi lɛ Yawɛ ga womi lo?”

english_verse: “We could ask Micaiah son of Imlah,” Ahab said. “But I hate Micaiah. He always has bad news for me.” “Don't say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.
translation_verse: Ahab he nɔ ke, “Nɔ kake ngɛ; lɛ ji Imla binyumu Mikaya. Se i sume lɛ, ejakaa e gbɛ manye nɔ́ ko ha we mi hyɛ gblee, kaa ja nɔ́ yaya pɛ lɛ e gbaa.” Yehoshafat de lɛ ke, “Mo ko de ja!”

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria, listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ wo ablade tade kɛ hii si ngɛ a matsɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ngma mi sami he ɔ nɛ ngɛ Samaria ma agbo ɔ nya a, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ gbae ngɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zedekia, Kenaana binyumu ɔ pee dade kolihi, nɛ e de Ahab ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ o kɛ maa gbe Siria bi ɔmɛ kɛ yaa si o ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.’ ”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth and promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Gbali kpa amɛ tsuo gba kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a de ke, “Yawɛ maa ngɔ Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ kɛ wo o dɛ mi. Yaa nɛ o ya tua ma a; o maa ye kunimi.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ho Mikaya tsɛmi ya a de Mikaya ke, “O nɛ, gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a nya sɔ nɛ a gba ke matsɛ ɔ maa ye kunimi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo hu moo gba ja nɔuu.”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth! What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Se Ahab de lɛ ke, “Ke o kɛ mi ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ɔ, tu anɔkuale! Si enyɛmɛ ma de mo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers wandering around, lost in the hills like sheep without a shepherd. The Lord said, ‘These troops have no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Mikaya he nɔ ke, “I na Israel tabo ɔ tsuo nɛ a gbɛ ngɔ fĩa ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa tohi nɛ be hyɛlɔ. Nɛ Yawɛ de ke, ‘Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ be nyatsɛ; ha nɛ a kpale kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.’ ”

english_verse: Ahab turned to Jehoshaphat and said, “I told you he would bring me bad news!”
translation_verse: Ahab de Yehoshafat ke, “Anɛ i de we mo ke Mikaya gbɛ manye nɔ́ ko ha we mi hyɛ gblee, kaa nɔ́ yaya pɛ e gbaa lo?”

english_verse: The Lord asked, “Who can trick Ahab and make him go to Ramoth where he will be killed?” They talked about it for a while,
translation_verse: Yawɛ bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ ma ya mlɔɔ Ahab ha mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ya tua Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ?’ Bɔfo ɔmɛ ekomɛ de kikɛ, nɛ ekomɛ hu de kikɛ.

english_verse: then finally a spirit came forward and said to the Lord, “I can trick Ahab.” “How?” the Lord asked.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, mumi ko je kpo ba da si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘Ma mlɔɔ lɛ.’ Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, ‘Kɛ o maa pee kɛ mlɔɔ lɛ kɛɛ?’

english_verse: “I'll make Ahab's prophets lie to him.” “Good!” the Lord replied. “Now go and do it. You will be successful.”
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ he nɔ ke, ‘Ke i ya a, ma ha nɛ Ahab gbali ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye lakpa.’ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, ‘Yaa nɛ o ya mlɔɔ lɛ; o maa ye manye.’ ”

english_verse: Zedekiah walked over and slapped Micaiah on the face. Then he asked, “Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Zedekia, Kenaana binyumu ɔ ho nɛ e ya gba Mikaya hɛ mi ma, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni be nɛ Yawɛ mumi ɔ je ye nɔ nɛ e kɛ mo ba tu munyu?”

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “You'll find out on the day you have to hide in the back room of some house.”
translation_verse: Mikaya he nɔ ke, “Ke be nɛ o ya sɛ se tsu mi nɛ o laa o he ɔ, kɛkɛ o maa le mo.”

english_verse: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.”

english_verse: Before they went into battle, Ahab said, “Jehoshaphat, I'll disguise myself, but you wear your royal robe.” Ahab disguised himself and went into battle.

english_verse: So when they saw Jehoshaphat in his robe, they thought he was Ahab and started to attack him. But Jehoshaphat prayed, and the Lord made the Syrian soldiers stop.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a na Yehoshafat ɔ, a susu kaa Israel matsɛ ɔ ji lɛ, nɛ a plɛ ngɔ kpee lɛ. Se Yehoshafat kpa huhui, nɛ Yawɛ Mawu he e yi wami, nɛ e ha nɛ ta a kpale ngɛ e se.

english_verse: And when they realized he wasn't Ahab, they left him alone.
translation_verse: Ta zugba lɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ na kaa tsa pi Israel matsɛ ɔ ji lɛ, kɛkɛ nɛ a jɔɔ e se nyɛɛmi.

english_verse: However, during the fighting a soldier shot an arrow without even aiming, and it hit Ahab between two pieces of his armor. He shouted to his chariot driver, “I've been hit! Get me out of here!”
translation_verse: Se tlukaa a, Siria ta buli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ nɛ e li e he be. Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ ya gbɔ Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ a tsami he ɔ. Ahab de e ta zugba lɛ kudɔlɔ ɔ ke, “I plaa! Plɛ o he nɛ o kɛ mi nɛ je ta a nya!”

english_verse: The fighting lasted all day, with Ahab propped up in his chariot so he could see the Syrian troops. He stayed there until evening, and by sundown he was dead.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ ta a hwue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a hɛɛ Matsɛ Ahab kɛ daa si ngɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi kɛ kpee Siria bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ. Benɛ pu ke e nɔɔ si ɔ, e gbo.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat kpale kɛ ba e we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem fiafiaafia.

english_verse: But the prophet Jehu son of Hanani met him and said: By helping that wicked Ahab, you have made friends with someone who hates the Lord. Now the Lord God is angry with you!
translation_verse: Gbalɔ Yehu, Hanani binyumu ɔ ba kpee matsɛ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Anɛ e da ha mo kaa o ya piɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a he, nɛ o kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a sume Yawɛ nɛ bɔ lo? Nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ ha nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu mo.

english_verse: But not everything about you is bad. You destroyed the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah—that shows you have tried to obey the Lord. Jehoshaphat Appoints Judges To Settle Cases
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, su kpakpa komɛ ngɛ o mi; o je yo mawu Ashera amaga amɛ tsuo kɛ je zugba a nɔ, nɛ o bɔ mɔde kaa o maa pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní.” Yehoshafat tsake níhi

english_verse: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but he often traveled through his kingdom, from Beersheba in the south to the edge of the hill country of Ephraim in the north. He talked with the people and convinced them to turn back to the Lord God and worship him, just as their ancestors had done.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Yehoshafat hi Yerusalem, se e pɔɔ blɔ hiami kɛ ya slaa e ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ je Beersheba ngɛ leneyi je kɛ ya si Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ omleyi je. Ke e ya a, e kɛ ni ɔmɛ tuɔ munyu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpale ba nyɛɛ Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ se ekohu.

english_verse: He assigned judges to each of the fortified cities in Judah
translation_verse: E to kojoli ngɛ Yuda mahi tsuo nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi,

english_verse: and told them: Be careful when you make your decisions in court, because you are judging by the Lord's standards and not by human standards, and he will know what you decide.
translation_verse: nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya loko nyɛɛ bu nɔ ko fɔ, loo bemi. Tsa pi nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní ɔ tsue ha, se mohu Mawu. Ke nyɛ maa buá sane ko he ɔ, Yawɛ maa piɛ nyɛ he.

english_verse: So do your work in honor of him and know that he won't allow you to be unfair to anyone or to take bribes.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ níhi ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ; ejakaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ sume kaa a plɛ dami sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, aloo a hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi, aloo a he nyɔ mi ní.”

english_verse: The people of Judah will bring you legal cases that involve every type of crime, including murder. You must settle these cases and warn the people to stop sinning against the Lord, so that he won't get angry and punish Judah. english_verse: Messengers told Jehoshaphat, “A large army from Edom east of the Dead Sea has invaded our country. They have already reached En-Gedi.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ ni komɛ ba bɔ Yehoshafat amaniɛ ke, “Ta babauu je Edom, ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ se kɛ ba tua mo. Niinɛ, a ngɔ Hazazon Tamar nɛ e biɛ kpa ji Engedi ɔ momo.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat was afraid, so he asked the Lord what to do. He then told the people of Judah to go without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Yehoshafat tsui po, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ e bi lɛ ga womi. Yehoshafat ha nɛ a fiɛ ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha hwɔ ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: They immediately left for Jerusalem to ask for the Lord's help.
translation_verse: Nihi je Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ba Yerusalem, konɛ a ba bi Yawɛ ga womi.

english_verse: After everyone from Judah and Jerusalem had come together at the Lord's temple, Jehoshaphat stood in front of the new courtyard
translation_verse: A kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ tsuo ya bua a he nya ngɛ kue he ɔ mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Yehoshafat ho ya da si ngɛ a kpɛti,

english_verse: and prayed: You, Lord, are the God our ancestors worshiped, and from heaven you rule every nation in the world. You are so powerful that no one can defeat you.
translation_verse: nɛ e fa kue ke, “Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu lee, mo pɛ ji Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o yeɔ je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ. O kle agbo; o ngɛ he wami, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa da o hɛ mi.

english_verse: Our God, you forced out the nations who lived in this land before your people Israel came here, and you gave it to the descendants of your friend Abraham forever.
translation_verse: Anɛ pi mo, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ o fie zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bi ɔmɛ kɛ je hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ benɛ o ma, Israel ma a lo? Anɛ pi mo nɛ o ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ kɛ ha o huɛ Abraham nina, konɛ e pee a nɔ́ kɛ ya neneene lo?

english_verse: Our ancestors lived in this land and built a temple to honor you.
translation_verse: O ma a ba hi zugba a nɔ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ a po we kɛ wo o hɛ mi nyami. A le

english_verse: They believed that whenever this land is struck by war or disease or famine, your people can pray to you at the temple, and you will hear their prayer and save them.
translation_verse: kaa ke amanehlu ko ba a nɔ ɔ, ta jio, gbenɔ hiɔ jio, hwɔ jio, a ma ba da si ngɛ we nɛ ɔ hɛ mi, he nɛ a jaa mo ngɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke a fa kue ha mo ngɛ a haomi ɔ mi ɔ, o maa nu, nɛ o ma he a yi wami.

english_verse: You can see that the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Edom are attacking us! Those are the nations you would not let our ancestors invade on their way from Egypt, so these nations were not destroyed.
translation_verse: “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Amon bi, Moab bi, kɛ Edom bi ba tua wɔ. Benɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je Egipt kɛ ma a, o kplɛɛ we nɛ a ya gu jamɛ a zugba amɛ a nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya lɔgɔ mɛ, nɛ a kpataa we a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Aren't you going to punish them? We won't stand a chance when this army attacks. We don't know what to do—we are begging for your help.
translation_verse: Mo ji wa Mawu! Moo gbla a tue ha wɔ, ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ ta babauu nɛ ba tua wɔ nɛ ɔ, wa be nyɛe maa da nya. Wa li bɔ nɛ wa maa pee ha; mo lɛ wa ngɛ hyɛe.”

english_verse: While every man, woman, and child of Judah was standing there at the temple,
translation_verse: Yuda nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Then Jahaziel said: Your Majesty and everyone from Judah and Jerusalem, the Lord says that you don't need to be afraid or let this powerful army discourage you. God will fight on your side!
translation_verse: Yahaziel de ke, “Nɛnɛ Yehoshafat, nyɛ Yuda bi, kɛ Yerusalem bi tsuo, nyɛɛ bu tue! Yawɛ ke nyɛ tsui nɛ ko po, nɛ nyɛ ko ye gbeye kaa nyɛɛ kɛ ta babauu nɛ ɔ ma ya kpe, ejakaa ta a, tsa pi nyɛ nɔ́; Mawu nitsɛ ta ji ta a!

english_verse: So here's what you must do. Tomorrow the enemy armies will march through the desert around the town of Jeruel. March down and meet them at the town of Ziz as they come up the valley.
translation_verse: Hwɔɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hia nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ya kpe; a gu Ziz yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ma; nyɛ ma ya na mɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ nya ngɛ Yeruel nga a hɛ mi.

english_verse: You won't even have to fight. Just take your positions and watch the Lord rescue you from your enemy. Don't be afraid. Just do as you're told. And as you march out tomorrow, the Lord will be there with you.
translation_verse: Pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ maa hwu ta nɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ya da nyɛ blɔ hehi ngɛ nyɛ ta a nya, nɛ nyɛɛ mlɛ; nyɛ maa na kunimi nɛ Yawɛ maa ye ha nyɛ. Nyɛ Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem bi, nyɛ ko ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ tsui ko po. Hwɔɔmɛ a je hwɔɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ya kpe, ejakaa Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ!”

english_verse: Then some Levites from the Kohath and Korah clans stood up and shouted praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Levi bi nɛ je Kohat, kɛ Kora we puɔ nya amɛ ɔ te da si, nɛ a he ose kɛ je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi.

english_verse: Early the next morning, as everyone got ready to leave for the desert near Tekoa, Jehoshaphat stood up and said, “Listen my friends, if we trust the Lord God and believe what these prophets have told us, the Lord will help us, and we will be successful.”
translation_verse: E nɔ jena mɔtu kpla a, ma a hia kɛ ho Tekoa nga a nɔ ya. Benɛ a yaa a, Yehoshafat de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem bi! Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye manye. Nyɛ he nɔ́ nɛ e gbali ɔmɛ deɔ nyɛ ɔ nyɛɛ ye, nɛ nyɛ maa ye kunimi.”

english_verse: Then he explained his plan and appointed men to march in front of the army and praise the Lord for his holy power by singing: “Praise the Lord! His love never ends.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ kɛ ma a kpe yi, nɛ e fa lali ɔmɛ ke a wo a tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛ tabo ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a hi lae ke, “Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa!”

english_verse: so that the Ammonite and Moabite troops attacked and completely destroyed those from Edom. Then they turned against each other and fought until the entire camp was wiped out!
translation_verse: Amon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ ya tua Edom bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi. Benɛ a gbe Edom bi ɔmɛ se ɔ, a plɛ ngɔ kpee a he kɛ ya si a kpata a sibi a hɛ mi.

english_verse: When Judah's army reached the tower that overlooked the desert, they saw that every soldier in the enemy's army was lying dead on the ground.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yuda ta buli ɔmɛ ba su buli a mɔ ɔ he ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, a plɛ hyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ a na kaa mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a gbo kɛ pueɔ si. Nɔ kake ngmelu ji mi.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day, everyone came together in Beracah Valley and sang praises to the Lord. That's why that place was called Praise Valley.
translation_verse: Ligbi nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, a ya bua a he nya ngɛ Beraka kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ a je Yawɛ yi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu ha mɛ ɔ he. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a tsɛɛ jamɛ a kɔ̃ ɔ ke “Beraka” a nɛ.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat led the crowd back to Jerusalem. And as they marched, they played harps and blew trumpets. They were very happy because the Lord had given them victory over their enemies, so when they reached the city, they went straight to the temple.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ba su ma a mi ɔ, a fia saku, nɛ a kpa bɛ, kɛ titimati kɛ ya sɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi.

english_verse: When the other nations heard how the Lord had fought against Judah's enemies, they were too afraid
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ tsuo nu kaa Yawɛ ye Israel he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi, nɛ a ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: While Jehoshaphat was king, he signed a peace treaty with Ahaziah the wicked king of Israel.
translation_verse: Be ko ɔ, Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Ahazia ya pee huɛ. Ahazia nɛ ɔ, yiwutsotsɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat obeyed the Lord, just as his father Asa had done,
translation_verse: Yehoshafat ya wo e tsɛ Asa nane, nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e hule we jami he ɔmɛ, nɛ ma a kpale we nɛ a ba nyɛɛ Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ se kɛ a tsui tsuo.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Ní kpahi tsuo nɛ Yehoshafat pee kɛ je e matsɛ yemi ɔ sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Hanani binyumu Yehu Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi. Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi fa ji womi nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They agreed to build several seagoing ships at Ezion-Geber.
translation_verse: Yehoshafat kɛ Ahazia kpɛ jua yemi lɛhi ngɛ Eziongeber.

translation_verse: Yehoshafat ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a gɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Yehoram ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se. Yuda matsɛ, Yehoram (Matsɛmɛ II,

translation_verse: Yehoram yi nɔ ɔ, Edom tsɔ Yuda hɛ mi atuã, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ya wo matsɛ kɛ ha a he.

english_verse: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ sú Filisti bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Arabia bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ Sudan bi ɔmɛ a kasa nya a kɛ wo Yehoram he.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.
translation_verse: A tsɛ ha mɛ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ ní kpa komɛ nɛ a he jua wa babauu nitsɛ; nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to Yuda mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi kakaaka. Se Yehoram lɛɛ akɛnɛ lɛ ji bitɛte he je ɔ, Yehoshafat ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee nɔ nɛ maa ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yehoram ba hi sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ e tsɛ se, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ ba da si ɔ, e gbe e nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ Israel ganɔ komɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong,
translation_verse: Lɛ hu e ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane kaa bɔ nɛ Ahab pee ɔ, ejakaa e ngɔ Ahab biyo. E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.

english_verse: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ sume kaa e ma kpata David we ɔ hɛ mi, ejakaa e kɛ David so, nɛ e wo si ke e kɛ e nina maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Edom tsɔ e he kɛ je Yuda nɔ yemi ɔ sisi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Libna ma a hu tsɔ atuã, ejakaa Yehoram je Yawɛ, e nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ se.

english_verse: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ se hu, Yehoram po jami hehi ngɛ Yuda yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem tsuo pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.

english_verse: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ Eliya ngma Yehoram womi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yawɛ, o nɛ̃ David Mawu ɔ bu mo fɔ; ejakaa o ya nyɛɛ we o tsɛ Yehoshafat, aloo Yuda matsɛ, Asa blɔ kpakpa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord, just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, o ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane, nɛ o ha nɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem tsuo ja amagahi kaa bɔ nɛ Ahab, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ ha nɛ Israel ma a pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. O nyɛminyumuhi nɛ a hi pe mo ɔ hu, o gbe mɛ.

english_verse: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ a he je ɔ, Yawɛ maa gbla o ma a, kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ o yi ɔmɛ a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ e ma kpata o níhi nɛ o ngɛ ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: They invaded Judah and stole the royal property from the palace, and they led Jehoram's wives and sons away as prisoners. The only one left behind was Ahaziah, his youngest son.
translation_verse: A ba tua Yuda, nɛ a ha ní ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ. A nuu matsɛ ɔ yi ɔmɛ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nyɔguɛ kɛ je. Matsɛ ɔ binyumu sekpɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ahazia a pɛ ji nɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ se.
