translation_verse: Nɛnɛ, ná nɛ o le kaa ke a po ma a gbe nya a, a be tó, loo sika ko woe hu, nɛ sika be matsɛ nito he ɔ bae bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.
translation_verse: Nɛnɛ, akɛnɛ wa ngɛ o nɔ yemi ɔ sisi, nɛ wa sume kaa o hɛ mi nɛ pue si he je ɔ, wa ngɛ hae nɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ a hyɛ o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔmɛ a mi fitsofitso. Ke o pee ja a, o maa na kaa ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ je blema a, atuã pɛ a tsɔɔ; a nɔ yemi yee. A matsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ kpokpa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, a dooɔ a nya. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a kpata ma a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: King Artaxerxes answered: Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ ha mɛ womi ɔ heto ke, “Amlaalo Rehum, ma pɛdiyo Shimshai, kɛ nyɛ huɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Samaria, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ kpokpa amɛ a nɔ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se, nyɛ he manye!

english_verse: After your letter was translated and read to me,
translation_verse: Womi nɛ nyɛ ngma a, a kane ha mi, nɛ i nu sisi saminya.

english_verse: I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations.
translation_verse: I fa, nɛ a hla níhi a mi fitsofitso. I ná le kaa kɛ je blema a, Yerusalem ma teɔ si kɛ woɔ matsɛmɛ. Niinɛ, a tsɔɔ atuã, nɛ a puɛɔ ma mi bi a tue.

english_verse: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ fa nimli ɔmɛ nɛ a kpa ma a pomi kɛ yaa si be nɛ gbi maa je imi nitsɛ ye nya.

english_verse: Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ tsi a nya esɔ nɛ a ko ba puɛ ní ha mi.”

english_verse: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city. Work on the Temple Starts Again
translation_verse: Benɛ Rehum, Shimshai, kɛ a huɛmɛ ɔmɛ nu womi nɛ Artaherhes ngma a mi munyu ɔ, a pue nɔ amlɔ nɔuu kɛ ho Yerusalem ya, nɛ a ya nyɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a kpa ní tsumi ɔ. A je Mawu we ɔ mami sisi ekohu

english_verse: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu we ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem he ní tsumi ɔ tlɔ fã jã hluu kɛ ya su Persia matsɛ, Darius yi nɔ jeha enyɔne ɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ gbali enyɔ, Hagai kɛ Ido bi Zakaria ba bɔni fiɛmi ngɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ngɛ Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ hyɛɔ a nɔ ɔ biɛ mi.

english_verse: So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Shealtiel bi Zerubabel, kɛ Yehozadak bi Yoshua ya bɔni Mawu we ɔ mami ekohu, nɛ Mawu gbali ɔmɛ piɛ a he kɛ tsu ní ɔ.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple?
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi kɛ̃ ɔ, amlaalo Tatenai nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ, kɛ Sheta Bozenai, kɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba Yerusalem, nɛ a ba bi ke, “Mɛnɔ ha nyɛ he wami ke nyɛɛ ma Mawu we ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ fia gbogbo ɔ?”

english_verse: But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
translation_verse: Se Mawu piɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ Persia bi ɔmɛ tsi we ní tsumi ɔ nya ha mɛ. Mohu ɔ, Persia bi ɔmɛ to a yi mi kaa a maa ngma womi ya ha Darius, nɛ a maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si a nine maa su heto nɔ.

english_verse: which said: King Darius, we wish you the best!
translation_verse: “Matsɛ Darius, o yi nɔ nɛ jɔ!

english_verse: We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
translation_verse: “Nɛnɛ, wa ngɛ hae nɛ o le kaa wa ya Yuda, he nɛ Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ we ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Wa na kaa a ngɔ tɛ agboagbohi kɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ fiae, nɛ a ngɛ tso toe kɛ ngɛ nɔ puee. Ni ɔmɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ tsue kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ nɔ yae bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple.
translation_verse: “Wa bi Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke a tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ nɛ ha mɛ he wami kaa a ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu, nɛ a fia gbogbo ɔ.

english_verse: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
translation_verse: Wa bi a biɛhi hulɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa ha nɛ o le ní tsumi ɔ nya dali.

english_verse: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
translation_verse: “Heto nɛ a ha wɔ ji, ‘Hiɔwe kɛ zugba Mawu ɔ tsɔli ji wɔ. We nɛ Israel matsɛ nguaa ko ma nɛ e gbe nya blema lokoo ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa ngɛ mae ekohu.

english_verse: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple,
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ wo hiɔwe Mawu ɔ mi mi la he je ɔ, e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezer, Kaldea no ɔ dɛ mi. Nebukadnezer ba ku Mawu we ɔ ngɔ pue si, nɛ e nuu ni ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya.

english_verse: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_verse: “Nɛnɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o suɔ ɔ, ha nɛ a hyɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Babilon kaa e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa Matsɛ Sirus fa ke a ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu ngɛ Yerusalem lo. Ke o na anɔkuale ɔ, konɛ o ha nɛ waa le bɔ nɛ o susu ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ he.”

english_verse: King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Darius fa, nɛ a ya kpa matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ sanehi womihi nɛ ngɛ Babilon ɔ a mi fitsofitso.

english_verse: Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said: This official record will show
translation_verse: Se Ekbatana nɛ ji ma ngua nɛ ngɛ Media kpokpa a nɔ ɔ loko a ya na womi kpo ko ngɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi ji, “Sane ko nɛ ba!

english_verse: that in the first year Cyrus was king, he gave orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem, so that sacrifices and offerings could be presented there. It is to be built
translation_verse: “Benɛ Matsɛ Sirus ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, kekleekle jeha a mi ɔ, e fa ke a ya ma Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ekohu, konɛ a sã bɔhi, kɛ sami bɔhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Mawu we ɔ hiɔwe yami nɛ pee gugue nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e blimi hu nɛ pee gugue nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ.

english_verse: with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything.
translation_verse: Ke a ngɔ tɛ agboagbohi kɛ wo zã etɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ á ngɔ tso hu kɛ wo zã kake hu kɛ fɔ nɔ. Á ngɔ sika ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nito he ɔ kɛ wo ní tsumi ɔ tsuo he hiɔ.

english_verse: Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places. King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ níhi nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezer ya muɔ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ ba Babilon ɔ, á ngɔ ya to a blɔ hehi pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.” Darius fa ke a tsa ní tsumi ɔ nɔ

english_verse: King Darius sent this message: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Darius tsɔ kɛ heto nɛ ɔ kɛ mane ke, “Mo amlaalo Tatenai, kɛ Sheta Bozenai, kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ tsɔli nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se! “Nyɛ je nyɛ nine ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ he.

english_verse: Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko tsi Mawu we ɔ mami nya. Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ Yuda amlaalo ɔ, kɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ma Mawu we ɔ ngɛ he nɛ e hi sa a.

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Níhi tsuo nɛ maa hia nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ ma bi kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ha hiɔwe Mawu ɔ, na kuyo, agbosu, jijɔ, ngma, ngo, dã, loo oliv nu ɔ, nyɛ ha mɛ daa ligbi nɛ nyɛ ko po mi.

english_verse: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee jã, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a sã bɔhi nɛ maa sa Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a kpa pɛɛ ha imi nitsɛ, kɛ ye bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wa yi nɛ na wami.

english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: I ngɛ fae hulɔ ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tɔ̃ mlaa nɛ ɔ, a hia e tsu yi mi plai kake kɛ ma si nɛ a sɛu lɛ ngɛ nɔ; nɛ e we ɔ hu nɛ plɛ pee kuku.

english_verse: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully. The Temple Is Dedicated
translation_verse: Matsɛ tsuaa matsɛ, loo ma tsuaa ma nɛ maa te si kɛ si mlaa nɛ ɔ, nɛ́ ma hla kaa a kpata Mawu we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, Mawu ɔ nɛ hla Yerusalem ngɔ to kaa e hi he ɔ nɛ kpata a hɛ mi. Imi Darius nɛ i ngɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ woe. Á ye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.” A bli Mawu we ɔ nya

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Munyuhi nɛ gbalɔ Hagai kɛ Zakaria, Ido bi ɔ tu ɔ, wo Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ tsa ní tsumi ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si a gbe nya. A ma Mawu we ɔ gbe nya pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Israel Mawu ɔ, kɛ Persia matsɛmɛ, Sirus, Darius, kɛ Artaherhes fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Darius ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, jeha ekpane ɔ we nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a, jamɛ a be ɔ nɛ a gbe Mawu we ɔ mami nya.

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsuo, osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, ye Mawu we ɔ nya blimi nyami ligbi ɔ kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ Mawu we ɔ nya blie ɔ, Israel ma a ngɔ na ku lafa, agbosu lafa enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ lafa eywiɛ kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Mawu. A ngɔ akpakpo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ hu kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ngɛ Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nya.

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: A to osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a we asafo kuu ɔmɛ a nya kɛ ha Mawu we ɔ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ. Hetsɔmi nyami ligbi ɔ

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Ma a tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, ye Hetsɔmi ɔ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ.

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo tsukɔ a he nɛ mɛ tsuo a he tsɔ. Lohwehi nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi kɛ ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛ a gbe. A gbe lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha ma a tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ye ní nɛ ɔ ji Israel bi tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kpa wɔ jami, kɛ lejɛ ɔ zugba a mi bi ɔmɛ a kusumi yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ́ ba, konɛ a ba ja Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: A kɛ bua jɔmi ye Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ ligbi kpaago. A bua jɔ saminya kaa Yawɛ ha Asiria matsɛ ɔ ná a he bua jɔmi, nɛ e piɛ a he nɛ a kɛ ma Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ we ɔ.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: A je Babilonia kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekle ligbi ɔ, nɛ Mawu dloomi nya a, a ba su Yerusalem nyɔhiɔ enuɔne ɔ we kekle ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Womi nɛ Matsɛ Artaherhes ngɔ ha Ezra nɛ ji osɔfo, kɛ womi ngmalɔ nɛ le Yawɛ mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ fitsofitso kɛ ha Israel ma a ní tsɔɔmi ɔ mi munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: “Osɔfo Ezra, mo womi ngmalɔ nɛ o le Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ mlaa a saminya; imi Matsɛ Artaherhes nɛ i ngɛ mo womi nɛ ɔ ngmae. Mo he manye!

english_verse: Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
translation_verse: I kɛ ye ga woli kpaago ɔmɛ wa ngɛ mo tsɔe kɛ yaa Yerusalem kɛ Yuda nɛ o ya slaa lejɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ o Mawu ɔ mlaa nɛ ngɛ o dɛ ɔ, o hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ nɔ yee ha.

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ ya. Nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, i kɛ ye ga woli ɔmɛ wa je wa tsui mi faa wa ngɔ ke Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ e hi he ji Yerusalem ɔ.

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ hu kɛ piɛ he: sika hiɔ, sika tsu tsuo nɛ o ma bua nya ngɛ Babilonia zugba a nɔ, kɛ nike níhi nɛ Israel ma a, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ wo si kaa a ma ha kɛ je a tsui mi faa a; nɛ o ngɔ lɛ tsuo kɛ ya Mawu we ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ.

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Hyɛ sika nɛ ɔ nɔ saminya, konɛ o kɛ he na kuhi, agbosuhi, jijɔhi, blɛfo, kɛ wai, nɛ o kɛ ya sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple.
translation_verse: Níhi tsuo nɛ a ngɔ ha mo nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ O Mawu we ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ ya ha Mawu ngɛ Yerusalem.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ke ní kpa komɛ a he maa hia nɛ a kɛ ma tsu ní ngɛ o Mawu ɔ we ɔ, yaa ngɔ sika ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nito he ɔ nɛ a kɛ pee.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: “Imi Matsɛ Artaherhes, i ngɛ nyɛ matsɛ nito he ɔ nɔ hyɛli tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ mlaa woe ke nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ osɔfo Ezra, Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ma bi nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ esɔ.

english_verse: liters of olive oil, and all the salt you need.
translation_verse: ; wai tɔ nyingmi enuɔ oliv nu tɔ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ngo bɔ tsuaa bɔ.

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ma fa nyɛ ke nyɛ tsu ngɛ we ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e mi mi ko ba fu imi, loo nihi nɛ ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ ye se ɔ.

english_verse: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
translation_verse: I ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le hu kaa mlaa ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa nyɛ heɔ tó ko kulaa ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ: osɔfohi, Levi bi, Mawu we ɔ lali, agbo nya buli, sɔmɔli ngɛ Mawu we ɔ, loo tsɔli kpahi ngɛ Mawu we ɔ.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: “Mo Ezra, ngɔɔ nile nɛ Mawu ha mo ɔ kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ; moo hla ma a nɔ hyɛli, kɛ kojoli, nihi nɛ le o Mawu ɔ mlaa a, nɛ́ a hyɛ ye nɔ yemi he ɔ nɔ ngɛ pa a se. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ li mlaa a, tsɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tɔ̃ o Mawu ɔ mlaa a, aloo imi matsɛ, ye mlaa a, a gbla e tue nɔuu; a gbe lɛ, loo a je lɛ we, loo a kpɔ e níhi ngɛ e dɛ, aloo a wo lɛ tsu.” Ezra je Mawu yi

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ezra la kɛ je Mawu yi ke, “Á je Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ yi. Lɛ nɛ e kɛ susumi kpakpa wo matsɛ ɔ yi mi kaa e pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Mawu we ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mawu dloomi nya a, matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ga woli ɔmɛ, kɛ e ma ní tsuli kpanaa amɛ tsuo ná ye he bua jɔmi. Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ wo mi kã, nɛ i bua Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ i kɛ mɛ tsuo waa kpale kɛ ya Yerusalem.”

english_verse: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: We puɔ nya dali nɛ kɛ Ezra kpale kɛ je Babilonia kɛ ba Yerusalem ngɛ Matsɛ Artaherhes yi nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:

english_verse: Gershom of the Phinehas family; Daniel of the Ithamar family; Hattush son of Shecaniah of the David family; Zechariah and
translation_verse: Gershom, Finehas we puɔ nya. Daniel, Itama we puɔ nya. Shekania bi Hatush, David we puɔ nya. Zakaria, kɛ nihi

english_verse: other men of the Parosh family, who had family records; Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah with
translation_verse: , Parosh we puɔ nya . Zerahia bi Eliehoenai, kɛ nihi

english_verse: men of the Pahath Moab family; Shecaniah son of Jahaziel with
translation_verse: , Pahat Moab we puɔ nya. Yahaziel bi Shekania kɛ nihi

english_verse: men of the Zattu family; Ebed son of Jonathan with
translation_verse: , Zatu we puɔ nya. Yonatan Ebed, kɛ nihi

english_verse: men of the Adin family; Jeshaiah son of Athaliah with
translation_verse: , Adin we puɔ nya. Atalia bi Yeshaya, kɛ nihi

english_verse: men of the Shephatiah family; Obadiah son of Jehiel with
translation_verse: , Shefatia we puɔ nya. Yehiel bi Obadia, kɛ nihi

english_verse: men of the Joab family; Shelomith son of Josiphiah with
translation_verse: , Yoab we puɔ nya. Yosifia bi Shelomit, kɛ nihi

english_verse: men of the Bani family; Zechariah son of Bebai with
translation_verse: , Bani we puɔ nya. Bebai bi Zakaria, kɛ nihi

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: I de nihi nɛ i hla a ke, “Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ nimli klɔuklɔuhi ji nyɛ. Sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ kpluhi nɛ ma a kɛ ba ha Mawu kaa nike ní nɛ je a tsui mi faa a, lɔ ɔmɛ hu ngɛ klɔuklɔu jã nɔuu.

english_verse: men of the Azgad family; Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah who returned sometime later with
translation_verse: , Azgad we puɔ nya Elifelet, Yeuel, Shemaya, kɛ nihi

english_verse: men of the Adonikam family; Uthai and Zaccur with
translation_verse: , Adonikan we puɔ nya . Utai, Zakur, kɛ nihi

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: I bua ni ɔmɛ tsuo a nya kɛ ho pa nɛ bee kɛ yaa Ahava ma a mi ɔ nya ya. Wa hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ. I na osɔfohi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be a kpɛti.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i tsɔ nɛ a ya tsɛ ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba: Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaya, Elnatan, Yarib, Elnatan, Natan, Zakaria, kɛ Meshulam. Yoyarib kɛ Elnatan nɛ a juɛmi mi kuɔ saminya a hu piɛ a he.

english_verse: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.
translation_verse: I tsɔ mɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ Ido ngɔ ngɛ Kasifia ma a mi. Sɛ gbi nɛ i ha mɛ kɛ ho ji kaa a ya de lɛ, Ido ɔ, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ke a ha wɔ sɔmɔli nɛ a ba tsu ní ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.

english_verse: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.
translation_verse: Mawu dloomi nya a, a ha wɔ Sherebia, nyumu ko nɛ hɛ mi ka si. E je Mahli we puɔ nya. E tsɛ ji Levi, nɛ e nɛ̃ biɛ ji Israel. E kɛ e binyumuhi, kɛ e nyɛminyumuhi nɛ piɛ e he kɛ ba a, a yibɔ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ.

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: A ha wɔ Hashabia, kɛ jehanɛ Yeshaya nɛ je Merari we puɔ nya a hulɔ, nɛ a nyɛmimɛ kɛ a bimɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ mɛ ba.

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: Benɛ wa ngɛ Ahava pa a nya a, i fa ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha hwɔ, nɛ́ wɔ tsuo waa ba wa he si ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ waa fa kue ha lɛ ke e fia blɔ mi tso ha wɔ, nɛ́ e baa wɔ, wa bimɛ, kɛ wa weto ní tsuo yi.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ha hwɔ, nɛ wa fa kue kɛ tsɛ wa Mawu ɔ ke e bu wa he, nɛ niinɛ, e bu wa kue fami ɔ tue. Níhi nɛ a kɛ ke Mawu we ɔ

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: I hla Sherebia, Hashabia, kɛ a nyɛmimɛ nyɔngma kɛ je osɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ ní ɔmɛ a nɔ saminya kɛ ya su Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. Ke nyɛ su lejɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngmɛ ní ɔmɛ ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ mi ngɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, konɛ nyɛɛ tu ngɔ wo a dɛ.”

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ muɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɔ wo wa dɛ mi ɔ, konɛ a hyɛ nɔ kɛ ya su Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. Wa kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, wa je Ahava pa a nya, nɛ wa pue nɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem. Wa Mawu ɔ piɛ wa he, nɛ he nyɛli, kɛ nihi nɛ wo wɔ ká tsuo nyɛ we nɛ a pee wɔ nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: Benɛ wa ba su Yerusalem ɔ, wa jɔɔ wa he ligbi etɛ.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Ligbi eywiɛne ɔ, wa ya Mawu we ɔ, nɛ wa ya ngmɛ sika tsu ɔ, sika hiɔ ɔ, kɛ ní kpa amɛ; nɛ wa tu mɛ kɛ wo osɔfo Meremot, Uria bi ɔ dɛ. Nihi nɛ piɛ e he ji Finehas bi Eleazar, kɛ Levi bi enyɔ, Yozabad, Yeshua bi ɔ, kɛ Noadia, Binui bi ɔ.

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ se hu, a ngɔ matsɛ ɔ nine nya womi ba ha amlaalo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli nɛ a ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ. Nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a piɛ ma a he, nɛ a tsu Mawu we ɔ ní tsumi hulɔ.

english_verse: Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said: Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ a ba de mi ke, “Israel ma a, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsɔ we a he kɛ ji nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a he. Ní hiemi níhi nɛ a ngɛ peeɔ, a kɛ mɛ lɛ peeɔ. Kikɛmɛ a zugba amɛ, kɛ ma amɛ ji Kanaan, Hit, Periz, Yebus, Amon, Moab, Egipt, kɛ Amor.

english_verse: Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
translation_verse: Yuda nyumuhi kɛ a binyumuhi tsuo ya ngɔ zugba a nɔ yihi; nɛ Mawu ma klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ble a he. Ma tsɔli kɛ ma ní tsuli titli ji nihi nɛ yeɔ fɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ mi.”

english_verse: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock
translation_verse: Benɛ i nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, i hía ye he tade sisi nɔ́, kɛ nɔha nɔ́ ɔ tsuo. I bɔni ye yi bwɔmi, kɛ ye kpɛni fami, nɛ i pee basaa kɛ hii si.

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Israel Mawu ɔ de ngɛ yayami nɛ nihi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a pee ɔ he ɔ, nihi babauu nu he. A kɛ he domi blibliibli ba bɔle mi kɛ kpe be mi nɛ i pee basaa kɛ hii si ɔ, hluu kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ nya si bɔ sami be.

english_verse: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms,
translation_verse: Gbɔkuɛ bɔ sami be ɔ, i gbe ye hwɔ hami ɔ nya, nɛ i te si ngɛ zugba kɛ ye he tade sisi nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ nɔha nɔ́ ɔ nɛ i hía a. I kplã si, nɛ i wo ye nine nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.
translation_verse: I fa kue ke, “Ye Mawu lee, ye hɛ mi pue si; e ngɛ mi zo pee kaa ma wo ye yi nɔ nɛ ma hyɛ mo. Wa he yayami pee kaa tlomi nɛ a to glegleegle kɛ be wa yi he kɛ ya su hiɔwe lokoo.

english_verse: Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
translation_verse: Kɛ je wa nɛmɛ a yi nɔ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ, wɔ o ma a, wa pee yayami gbegbeegbe. Wa yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba nuu wɔ, wa matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wa osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo. A gbe wɔ, a kpɔ wa níhi ngɛ wa dɛ, nɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya ngɛ pã mi kaa nyɔguɛhi. A ha wa hɛ mi pue si kulaa; nɛ wa ngɛ zo ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu, pee se ɔ, o na wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ wa ti ni komɛ kɛ̃ ngɛ je mi, nɛ o ha wa ba ngɛ o ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi, konɛ wa hɛ mi nɛ tsɔ wɔ nɛ waa ye wa he kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi.

english_verse: We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: A pee wɔ nyɔguɛhi, se ngɛ wa nyɔguɛ si himi ɔ mi ɔ, o je o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ. O ngmɛɛ we wa he, nɛ o ha Persia matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ na wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ a ha wa nɔ gbagba te ekohu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Mawu we ɔ nɛ ku kɛ pue si ɔ, waa ma lɛ ekohu, nɛ waa hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: “Mawu, jehanɛ lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, mɛni ma kpale de? Mlaahi nɛ o wo wɔ ɔ, wa tɔ̃ lɛ tsuo.

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kó ha wa biyi ɔmɛ ya gba ma je li ɔmɛ a binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ wa kó ngɔ a biyi ɔmɛ kɛ ha wa binyumu ɔmɛ. Wa ko ha mɛ tue mi jɔmi, nɛ wa ko ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a plɔke kɔkɔɔkɔ. Kɛkɛ wa ma na he wami; wa maa ye zugba a nɔ niba ní, nɛ wa ma si ha wa nina kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ ba wa nɔ ɔ ji yayami nɛ wa pee, kɛ tɔmihi nɛ wa tɔ̃ ɔ a he tue gblami. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa na kaa o na wɔ mɔbɔ; o gbla we wa tue bɔ nɛ sa wɔ, nɛ o ha wa ti ni komɛ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: Anɛ wa ma gbo tue ekohu nɛ waa kɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ musu bɔmi ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ sɛ gba si himi mi lo? Anɛ o mi mi be la woe wawɛɛ kɛ yaa si o ma kpata wɔ tsuo wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ nɛ nɔ kake po be piɛe lo?

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, Israel Mawu, moo lɛɛ dalɔ ji mo, se kɛ̃, o ha wa yi na wami kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Wa ngɛ jajee ngɛ o hɛ mi kaa wa yeɔ fɔ, nɛ e sɛ́ kulaa kaa waa ba o hɛ mi.”

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Ezra ya Mawu we ɔ hɛ mi. E fa kue ha Mawu, nɛ e jaje Israel ma a he yayami. Jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo ɔ, e ngɛ ya foe, nɛ e ngɔ e he kɛ ngɛ si fiae. Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi babauu, nyumihi, yihi, kɛ jokuɛwi ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a wo yana.

english_verse: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Elam we puɔ nya no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yehiel ɔ bi Shekania de Ezra ke, “Niinɛ, wa ya ngɔ ma se yihi, nɛ wa yi wa Mawu ɔ anɔkuale, se kɛ̃, hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha Israel.

english_verse: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ, nyɛ ha wa ka wa Mawu ɔ kita kaa wa maa wo kikɛmɛ a yi nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ blɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ mo, ye nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa a gbeye ma de ɔ, wa maa pee. Ee, wa maa ye Mawu mlaa a nɔ.

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Tee si; o ní tsumi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; wa ngɛ o se kpɛii. Pee kã, nɛ o tsu.”

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Ezra te si, nɛ e ha nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ka kita kaa a maa pee nɔ́ nɛ Shekania de ɔ.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Ezra je Mawu we ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e ya sɛ Eliashib bi Yehohanan se tsu mi. E hi lejɛ ɔ nyɔ mi tsuo; e yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, nɛ e nui nyu hulɔ; kɔmɔ sɔuu e ngɛ yee, ejakaa Israel bi nɛ je ma se kɛ ba a yi Mawu anɔkuale.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ligbi etɛ se, ke nɔ ko bɛ́ kaa bɔ nɛ ma tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ fa ke a pee ɔ, á kpɔ e níhi tsuo ngɛ e dɛ; lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
translation_verse: Ligbi etɛne ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, Yuda, kɛ Benyamin bi tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem. Nyɔhiɔ nɛɛne ɔ we ligbi nyingmi enyɔ ji jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ. Ma a tsuo ba pue si ngɛ magbɛ mi ngɛ Mawu we ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ, kɛ jehanɛ hiɔmi nɛ ngɛ nɛe wawɛɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo Ezra te da si, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tɔ̃; ejakaa nyɛ ya ngɔ ma se yihi; nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ Israel he yayami ɔ ba hiɛ pe sa a.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ jaje nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ sa e hɛ mi. Nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ he kɛ je nibwɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ wa zugba a nɔ ɔ a he; nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ nyɛ ma se yi ɔmɛ a he.”

english_verse: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo he nɔ kɛ ngmlaa ke “Saminya! Bɔ nɛ o de ɔ, wa maa pee jã.”

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: A ya nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Ni ɔmɛ a he hiɛ tsɔ, nɛ hiɔmi hu lɛ ngɛ nɛe wawɛɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ. Wa be nyɛe maa da si ngɛ magbɛ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Sane nɛ ɔ, pi nɔ́ nɛ a ma nyɛ maa gbe nya ligbi kake, loo ligbi enyɔ pɛ; ejakaa wɔ nihi nɛ wa he ngɛ sane yobu nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, wa he hiɛ.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ wa ma tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a da ma a tsuo nane mi ngɛ Yerusalem hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ ma se yo ɔ, ha nɛ e ba hiɛ ɔ be nɛ a maa to lɛ ɔ. E kɛ e ma mi he nɛ e je ɔ ma nimeli, kɛ kojoli nɛ ba. A pee enɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si Mawu mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ he je ɔ se maa po ngɛ wa nɔ.”

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Asahel bi Yonatan, kɛ Tikva bi Yazeya pɛ lɛ a te si kɛ si blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔ; nɛ Meshulam, kɛ Levi no, Shabetai pi a se.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ je ma se kɛ ba a kplɛɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔ, nɛ osɔfo Ezra hla nihi kɛ je we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ a kpɛti we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ngɛ a biɛhi a nya. Nyɔhiɔ nyɔngmane ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a he sɛ, nɛ a bɔni sane ɔmɛ a mi hyɛmi;

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: nɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a hyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɔ ma se yihi a sane ɔmɛ a mi kɛ gbe nya. Nihi nɛ ngɔ ma se yihi

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers;
translation_verse: A wo si ke a maa ngmɛɛ a yi ɔmɛ a he; nɛ a ngɔ agbosu kake kɛ sã bɔ, konɛ a ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ.

english_verse: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;
translation_verse: Imer we puɔ nya: Hanani kɛ Zebadia.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Harim we puɔ nya: Maaseya, Eliya, Shemaya, Yehiel, kɛ Uzia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
translation_verse: Pashur we puɔ nya: Elioenai, Maaseya, Ishmael, Netanel, Yozabad, kɛ Elasa.

english_verse: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation_verse: Levi bi ɔmɛ: Yozabad, Shimei, Kelaya , Petahia, Yuda, kɛ Eliezer.

english_verse: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation_verse: Mawu we ɔ lali: Eliashib Mawu we ɔ buli: Shalum, Telem, kɛ Uri

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Ni kpahi: Parosh we puɔ nya: Ramia, Izia, Malkiya, Miyamim, Eleazar, Malkiya, kɛ Benaya.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Elam we puɔ nya: Matania, Zakaria, Yehiel, Abdi, Zeremot, kɛ Eliya.

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Zatu we puɔ nya: Elioenai, Eliashib, Matania, Yeremot, Zabad, kɛ Aziza.

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Bebal we puɔ nya Yehohanan, Hanania, Zabai, kɛ Atlai.

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Bani we puɔ nya: Meshulam, Maluk, Adaya, Yashub, Sheal, kɛ Yeremot.

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Pahat Moab we puɔ nya: Adna, Kelai, Benaya, Maaseya, Matania, Bezalel, Binui, kɛ Manase.

english_verse: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon, Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Harim we puɔ nya: Eliezer, Ishiya, Malkiya, Shemaya, Shimeon, Benyamin, Maluk, kɛ Shemaria.

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Hashum we puɔ nya: Matenai, Matata, Zabad, Elifelet, Yeremai, Manase, kɛ Shimei.

english_verse: Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi, Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Bani we puɔ nya: Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaya, Bedeya, Keluhi, Vania, Meremot, Eliashib, Matania, Matenai, kɛ Yaasu.

english_verse: Shimei, Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah, Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah, Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph from the family of Binnui;
translation_verse: Binui we puɔ nya: Shimei, Shelemia, Natan, Adaya, Maknadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemia, Shemaria, Shalum, Amaria, kɛ Yosef.

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Nebo we puɔ nya: Yeyel, Matitia, Zabad, Zebina, Yadai, Yoel, kɛ Benaya.

english_verse: These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ ma se yihi. A wo a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo blɔ.

english_verse: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa,
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Hakalia bi Nehemia tsu he sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yerusalem he sane ha Nehemia hɛ dɔ Benɛ Artaherhes ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Persia a, jeha nyingmi enyɔne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Kislev ɔ mi ɔ, imi Nehemia, i ngɛ matsɛ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Susa a.

english_verse: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Hanani nɛ ji ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake, kɛ ni komɛ nɛ je Yuda zugba a nɔ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. I bi mɛ Yerusalem he sane, kɛ bɔ nɛ wa nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi nɛ a nuu we mɛ kɛ yɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ ngɛ ha.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: A de mi ke nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a nuu we mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, a ngɛ nɔ́ nami, kɛ ahlua bɔmi nguaa mi. A de hu ke Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ nɛ a hule pue si ɔ, kɛ agbo ɔmɛ nɛ a sã a tsuo ngɛ ja.

english_verse: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
translation_verse: Benɛ i nu amaniɛ nɛ ɔ, i hi si nɛ i fo ya. I ye kɔmɔ ligbi babauu, nɛ i ha hwɔ. I sɔle nɛ i tsɛ Mawu ke,

english_verse: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lee! O kle, nɛ o he ngɛ gbeye. O yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ o yeɔ o siwo nɔ. Nihi nɛ suɔ mo, nɛ a peeɔ níhi nɛ o fa ke a pee ɔ, o naa mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo hyɛ mi, nɛ o ba o tue si ha mi. Kue nɛ i ngɛ fae ha mo nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ ha o tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ji Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, moo bu tue. I ngɛ jajee ke wɔ Israel ma a, wa pee yayami. I kɛ ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo wa pee yayami.

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kai nɔ́ nɛ o de Mose ke, ‘Ke nyɛ, Israel ma a, nyɛ yi mi anɔkuale ɔ, ma gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma kpa amɛ a mi.

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, ke je ɔ nyagbe he nɛ a gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa po, ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ ba he nɛ i to nɛ a ja mi ngɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: “Nyɔmtsɛ, o tsɔli ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ, nɛ mo nitsɛ o ma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. O kɛ o he wami nguaa kɛ nyɛmi kpɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: I kpa mo pɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, moo ba o tue si nɛ o nu ye kue fami, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ suɔ kaa a maa wo o biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ a kue fami ɔmɛ. Ha ma ye manye mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ o ha matsɛ ɔ nɛ na mi mɔbɔ.” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, imi ji matsɛ ɔ dã wolɔ.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Nyɔhiɔ eywiɛ se, ligbi ko benɛ Matsɛ Artaherhes ngɛ ní yee ɔ, i ngɔ wai ya ma e hɛ mi, nɛ i wo dã a ha lɛ. E nɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa ja hyɛ,

english_verse: So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.” Even though I was frightened,
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi mi ke, “Mɛni he je o hɛ mi pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Pi hiɔ nɛ o ngɛ nue; i na kaa o bua jɔɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ sawale nu mi,

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: nɛ i he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, o yi nɛ na wa daa! Mɛni he je e sɛ kaa ye hɛ mi nɛ pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ, be mi nɛ ma nɛ a pu ye nɛmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ ku kɛ pueɔ si, nɛ la sã agbo ɔmɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ bi mi ke, “Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae?” I sɔle nɛ i bi Mawunɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ gbi,

english_verse: Then I told the king, “Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.”
translation_verse: kɛkɛ nɛ i de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, ke e sa o hɛ mi, nɛ o suɔ kaa o ma ha mi nɔ́ nɛ ma bi mo ɔ, lɛɛ ha ma ya Yuda zugba a nɔ ngɛ ma mi he nɛ a pu ye nɛmɛ ngɛ ɔ, konɛ ma ya ma ma a ekohu.”

english_verse: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ i bi lɛ ɔ nɔ; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, manyɛ ɔ hii si ngɛ e kasa nya. Matsɛ ɔ bi mi be nɛ ma ya ye, kɛ be nɛ ma kpale kɛ ba; nɛ i de lɛ.

english_verse: Then I asked, “Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah?
translation_verse: Jehanɛ i kpale bi matsɛ ɔ ke e ha mi womi kɛ ya ha amlaalo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a bonyoku je zugba a nɔ ɔ, konɛ a ha mi blɔ kɛ gu a zugba amɛ a nɔ kɛ ya Yuda zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: I bi hu ke a ha mi womi kɛ ya ha Asaf, nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ ɔ hue ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, konɛ e ha mi tso nɛ ma kɛ kpɛ agbohi ha mɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kasa nya a, kɛ gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ bɔle ma a, kɛ imi nitsɛ ye we nɛ ma hi mi ɔ. Mawu ngɛ ye se, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ha mi níhi nɛ i bi lɛ ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ ha mi asafoatsɛmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli komɛ nɛ a bu ye he kɛ hia blɔ kɛ ya Yufrate pa a bonyoku je. Benɛ wa su lejɛ ɔ, i ngɔ matsɛ ɔ womi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha amlaalo ɔmɛ.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Se benɛ Sanbalat nɛ je Bet Horon, kɛ Tobia, ma ní tsulɔ ko nɛ je Amon zugba a nɔ ɔ nu kaa nɔ ko ba nɛ e ba ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa hlae ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, e dɔ mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: I ya su Yerusalem, nɛ i ye ligbi etɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: Se i de we nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ngɔ wo ye mi ke ma pee ɔ. Nyɔ mi kɔ̃kɔ̃ɔ̃kɔ̃ ɔ, i te si, nɛ i kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ bɔɔ pɛ je kpo. Wa ngɔɛ lohwe ko kɛ yɛ, ja teji nɛ i hi nɔ ɔ pɛ.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Nyɔ mi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, i gu Kɔ̃ Agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ mi kɛ je kpo kɛ gu Ogbetee Vu ɔ nya kɛ ya su Dwɔmi Agbo ɔ he. I hyɛ bɔ nɛ Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɛ ha, bɔ nɛ a ku kɛ pueɔ si, kɛ bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sã agbo ɔmɛ.

english_verse: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i po mi kɛ je ma a beleku je kɛ gu omleyi je ngɛ he nɛ Nyu Vu Agbo ɔ, kɛ Matsɛ Taku ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Akɛnɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ i hi nɔ ɔ nɛ́ blɔ nɛ e kɛ be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he je ɔ,

english_verse: So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.
translation_verse: i gu Kidron pa a kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ya hyɛ ma a gbogbo ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ i kpale ye se kɛ gu jamɛ a blɔ ɔ kɛ̃ kɛ gu Kɔ̃ Agbo ɔ mi kɛ ba ma a mi.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ ekoeko li kaa i je kpo kɛ ya pee nɔ́ ko. Kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, i de we nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ́ ko. Ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ ma tsu ní ɔ li nɔ́ nɛ ya nɔ nɛ ɔ he nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ i de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na haomi mi nɛ wa ngɛ, bɔ nɛ Yerusalem pee ma doku, nɛ a sã agbo ɔmɛ! Nyɛ ha nɛ waa fia Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ ekohu, konɛ wa zo ɔ nɛ je.”

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i sɛɛ mɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu nyɛɛ ye se, nɛ́ e piɛ ye he, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de mi ɔ. A he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ wa bɔni gbogbo ɔ fiami!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a je ní tsumi kpakpa nɛ ɔ sisi nɔuu.

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Se benɛ Sanbalat nɛ je Bet Horon, Tobia, ma ní tsulɔ ɔ nɛ je Amon zugba a nɔ, kɛ Arabia no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Geshem ɔ nu he ɔ, a muɔ wɔ, nɛ a ye wa he fɛu, nɛ a de ke, “Mɛni sane nyɛ ngɛ yee nɛ ɔ? Nyɛ ma tsɔ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi atuã lo?”

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: I he nɔ ke, “Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ma ha wa maa ye manye. E tsɔli ji wɔ, nɛ wa ma bɔni gbogbo ɔ fiami. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be blɔ nya ko, loo weto ní, loo kaimi nɔ́ ko ngɛ Yerusalem.”

english_verse: These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem: The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a pee kɛ fia Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ ekohu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Eliashib, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ya ma To Agbo ɔ ekohu, nɛ a tsukɔ he; nɛ a ma agbo ɔmɛ ngɛ a blɔ hehi. A tsukɔ gbogbo ɔ he kɛ ya su Lafa Mɔ ɔ kɛ Hananel Mɔ ɔ a he.

english_verse: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Yeriko nyumu ɔmɛ fia kɛ tsa nɔ, nɛ Imri binyumu Zakur hu fia kɛ tsa a nɔ́ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Hasenaa binyumu ɔmɛ ma Lo Agbo ɔ, nɛ a kɛ tso sɛu nɔ, nɛ a ma sinya amɛ, nɛ a dadehi kɛ a se lami níhi wo a nya.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: Hakoz binyumu Uria binyumu Meremot ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ. Nɔ nɛ fia kɛ tsa nɔ ji Meshezabel binyumu Berekia e binyumu Meshulam. Baana binyumu Zadok ji nɔ nɛ fia kɛ tsa nɔ.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: Gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, Tekoa bi nɛ fia. Se Tekoa ma nimeli ɔmɛ lɛɛ, ní tsumi nɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ ha mɛ ke a tsu ɔ, a kua tsumi.

english_verse: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Pasea binyumu Yoyada, kɛ Besodeya binyumu Meshulam dla agbo nɛ a tsɛɛ Agbo Momo ɔ. A kɛ tso sɛu nɔ, nɛ a ma sinya amɛ nɛ a wo dadehi a nya nihi kɛ a se lami.

english_verse: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
translation_verse: Melatia nɛ je Gibeon, Yadon nɛ je Meronot, Gibeon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Mizpa bi ɔmɛ fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ. A fia kɛ ya su he nɛ amlaalo ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ Yufrate pa a bonyoku je ɔ hii ɔ.

english_verse: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
translation_verse: Harhaya binyumu Uziel, sika tsu ga ní tsulɔ ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ nɔ tsami ɔ. Hanania, nu kɛ e he via peelɔ ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ kɛ ya su he nɛ a tsɛɛ Gbogbo Gbajaa a he.

english_verse: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Hur bi Refaya nɛ hyɛɛ Yerusalem zugba a mi dlami fa nɔ ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Harumaf binyumu Yedaya fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ ngɛ e we ɔ kasa nya. Hashabneya binyumu Hatush fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
translation_verse: Harim binyumu Malkiya, kɛ Pahat Moab binyumu Hashub fia gbogbo ɔ fa a nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, kɛ Flɔɔnɔɔ Mɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Halohesh binyumu Shalum, Yerusalem zugba a mi dlami fa nɔ yelɔ ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ.

english_verse: Hanun and the people who lived in the town of Zanoah rebuilt Valley Gate. They hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. They also rebuilt the wall for
translation_verse: Hanun kɛ Zanoa ma mi bi ɔmɛ dla Kɔ̃ Agbo ɔ. A ma sinya amɛ, nɛ a wo a nya dadehi kɛ a se lami níhi dadehi. A fia gbogbo ɔ gugue lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ya su Dwɔmi Agbo ɔ he tɔɔ.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Rekab binyumu Malkiya nɛ yeɔ Bet Hakerem zugba a nɔ ɔ dla Dwɔmi Agbo ɔ. E fia ekohu, nɛ e ma sinya amɛ, nɛ e wo a nya dadehi kɛ a se lami níhi.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Kolhoze binyumu Shalum, Mizpa zugba a nɔ yelɔ ɔ dla Nyu Vu Agbo ɔ. E fia ekohu, nɛ e tsi e yi mi ɔ. E ma sinya amɛ, nɛ e wo a nya dadehi kɛ a se lami níhi. Gbogbo ɔ nɛ tsa matsɛ abɔɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Shela Taku ɔ he ɔ, lɛ kɛ̃ nɛ e fia jamɛ a gbogbo ɔ kɛ ya su kpoku ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ kpleɔ si kɛ jee David ma a mi ɔ a he.

english_verse: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks. Levites Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Azbuk binyumu Nehemia, Betzur zugba a kasa fa nɔ yelɔ ɔ fia gbogbo nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ kɛ je David yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a hanɔ kɛ ya na taku ɔ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ. Levi bi nɛ fia gbogbo ɔ

english_verse: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;
translation_verse: Levi bi nɛ fia gbogbo ɔ hehi babauu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Bani binyumu Rehum fia fa ko nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ. Hashabia, Keila zugba a mi dlami fa nɔ yelɔ ɔ da e nɔ yemi he ɔ nane mi, nɛ e fia gbogbo ɔ eko kɛ tsa nɔ.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah;
translation_verse: Henadad binyumu Bavai, Keila zugba a mi dlami fa nɛ piɛ ɔ nɔ yelɔ ɔ hu fia gbogbo ɔ nɔ tsami ɔ.

english_verse: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;
translation_verse: Yeshua binyumu Ezer, Mizpa zugba a nɔ yelɔ ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ fa nɛ ngɛ he nɛ a guu kɛ kuɔɔ kɛ yaa ta hwumi níhi a to he ɔ hanɔ ɔ; e fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ ya su kɔ̃ ɔ nya.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Zabai binyumu Baruk fia gbogbo ɔ nɔ tsami ɔ kɛ ya su osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Eliashib we ɔ nya blɔ tɔɔ.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Uria binyumu Meremot, Hakoz bibi ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ kɛ ya su osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Eliashib we ɔ nyagbe he ɔ tɔɔ. Osɔfohi nɛ fia gbogbo ɔ

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Osɔfohi nɛ fia gbogbo ɔ mi dlami slɔɔtohi nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Osɔfohi nɛ je hehi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ fa ko.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Benyamin kɛ Hashub fia e nɔ tsami ɔ nɛ ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a hanɔ ɔ. Jehanɛ Anania binyumu Maaseya bi Azaria fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Henadad binyumu Binui fia he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, kɛ je Azaria we ɔ nya kɛ ya su gbogbo ɔ kɔ nya.

english_verse: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived. Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Uzai binyumu Palal fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, kɛ je gbogbo ɔ kɔ nya kɛ yiti mɔ yi mi pinoo ɔ nɛ ngɛ buli ɔmɛ a kue ɔ hanɔ ɔ. Parosh binyumu Pedaya fia kɛ tsa nɔ kɛ ya ta he ko ngɛ Nyu Agbo ɔ, kɛ mɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ a hanɔ ɔ. Ni kpahi nɛ fia gbogbo ɔ

english_verse: The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.
translation_verse: Tekoa bi ɔmɛ fia gbogbo ɔ fa ko nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ. A fia fa enyɔne ɔ nɛ a ha mɛ ɔ, kɛ je mɔ ngua a nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hanɔ ɔ he, kɛ ya gbogbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Ofel kasa nya a tɔɔ.

english_verse: Some priests rebuilt the next section of the wall. They began working north of Horse Gate, and each one worked on a section in front of his own house.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔmɛ a kuu ko fia gbogbo ɔ nɔ tsami ɔ, kɛ je Okpɔngɔ Agbo ɔ nya kɛ ya omleyi je; nɔ tsuaa nɔ fia gbogbo nɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we hanɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Imer binyumu Zadok fia gbogbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ hanɔ ɔ. Shekania binyumu Shemaya nɛ buu Beleku Agbo ɔ nya a fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Shelemia binyumu Hanania, kɛ Zalaf binyumu ekpane ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Hanun ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ; enɛ ɔ ji he enyɔne nɛ a fia. Berekia binyumu Meshulam fia e nɔ tsami nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ hanɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: Sika tsu ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Malkiya hu fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ. E fia kɛ ya gu ɔmɛ, kɛ jua yeli ɔmɛ hii ngɛ Buli Agbo ɔ hanɔ hluu kɛ ya su hiɔwe tsu ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ kɔ nya a he.

english_verse: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_verse: Sika tsu ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ kɛ jua yeli ɔmɛ fia gbogbo ɔ nyagbe mi dlami ɔ; a fia kɛ je hiɔwe tsu ɔ nɛ ngɛ kɔ nya a he kɛ ya su To Agbo ɔ nya tɔɔ.

english_verse: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.
translation_verse: Benɛ Sanbalat nu kaa wɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ, wa bɔni gbogbo ɔmɛ fiami ɔ, e mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e ye wa he fɛu.

english_verse: In front of his friends and the Samaritan army he said, “What is this feeble bunch of Jews trying to do? Are they going to rebuild the wall and offer sacrifices all in one day? Do they think they can make something out of this pile of scorched stones?”
translation_verse: E de ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ, ɔmɛ kɛ Samaria ta buli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ke, “Mɛni Yuda bi wudɔwudɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ? Ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ nɛ a to a yi mi kaa a maa fia ekohu lo? Anɛ a susu kaa bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ sãe ɔ ma ha a maa ngɔ ligbi kake pɛ kɛ gbe ní tsumi ɔ nya lo? Anɛ a ma nyɛ ma ha gli kokoehi nɛ sã pueɔ si nɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee tsu mami tɛhi lo?”

english_verse: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, “Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.”
translation_verse: Amon no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Tobia, nɛ daa si ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ hu bi ke, “Mɛni gbogbo a ma nyɛ maa fia?” E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Tsia, kɔkɔbo tete po ma nyɛ ma tsitsɛɛ a gbogbo ɔ ngɔ ko si!”

english_verse: But I prayed, “Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: I sɔle ke, “Wa Mawu lee, moo bu bɔ nɛ a ngɛ wa he fɛu yee ɔ tue. Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ he. Ha nɛ a kpɔ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ a dɛ; nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ya ma se.

english_verse: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry
translation_verse: Sanbalat, Tobia, Arabia bi ɔmɛ, Amon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ashdod bi ɔmɛ nu kaa wa ngɛ Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ fiae mlamlaamla, nɛ wa ngɛ puɔ ɔmɛ tsie. Kɛkɛ nɛ a mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: and decided to stir up trouble, and to fight against the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ tsuo a so kaa a kɛ Yerusalem maa hwu ta nɛ a gudu lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa sɔle nɛ wa tsɛ wa Mawu ɔ, nɛ wa ha nihi bu nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ huɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Judah were singing a sorrowful song: “So much rubble for us to haul! Worn out and weary, will we ever finish this wall?”
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nya nygɛ nɔ ngɛ dee ke, “Pɔ tɔ wɔ kɛ nɔ́ tloomi. Ní kokoe ɔmɛ nɛ wa ma je ɔ hiɛ tsɔ. Kɛ wa ma pee kɛ fia gbogbo ɔ kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Our enemies were saying, “Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.”
translation_verse: Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ susu kaa wa be mɛ nae, loo wa be nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ lee kɛ yaa si be nɛ a ma ba tua wɔ tlukaa, nɛ a maa gbe wɔ, konɛ ní tsumi ɔ se nɛ po.

english_verse: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side,
translation_verse: Se be tsuaa be ɔ, Yuda bi nɛ kɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ he kake ɔ ba woɔ wa tue nɔ ngɛ gahi nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ toe ɔ a he.

english_verse: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ nihi nɛ hɛɛ klaatehi, akplɔhi, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃hi ngɔ to gbogbo ɔmɛ a se hehi nɛ a gbi a fiami nya lolo ɔ. I ha buli nɛ ɔmɛ ya da si weku nya weku nya.

english_verse: Then I looked things over and told the leaders, the officials, and the rest of the people, “Don't be afraid of your enemies! The Lord is great and fearsome. So think of him and fight for your relatives and children, your wives and homes!”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i na kaa ni ɔmɛ hao; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i de ma nimeli ɔmɛ, ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo ke, “Nyɛ ko ye wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbeye. Nyɛ kai kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kle, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye, konɛ nyɛɛ hwu ha nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.
translation_verse: Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba na kaa wa le nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ susue kaa a maa pee ɔ; a kpá si kaa Mawu puɛ a yi mi tomi ɔmɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ wɔ tsuo wa kpale kɛ ya tsa gbogbo ɔ fiami ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: From then on, I let half of the young men work while the other half stood guard. They wore armor and had spears and shields, as well as bows and arrows. The leaders helped the workers
translation_verse: Kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ yaa a, i dla ye we bi ɔmɛ a mi enyɔ; be nɛ ni fa ngɛ gbogbo ɔ fiae ɔ, ni fa hu mia kɛ gbaja, nɛ a hɛɛ akplɔhi, tsɛ̃ihi, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃hi kɛ daa si, ngɛ bue. Wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo fí Yuda ma a se kpɛii.

english_verse: Even the workers who were rebuilding the wall strapped on a sword. The worker who was to blow the signal trumpet stayed with me.
translation_verse: Ní tsuli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he ní tsue ɔ fi klaate ngɛ a mlɛ mi. Titimati kpalɔ ɔ ngɛ ye kasa nya.

english_verse: I told the people and their officials and leaders, “Our work is so spread out, that we are a long way from one another.
translation_verse: I de ni ɔmɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ ke, “Ní tsumi ɔ yi bli kɛ ya se lokoo, nɛ e ha waa kɛ wa sibi wa kpɛti kɛ tsɔ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: If you hear the sound of the trumpet, come quickly and gather around me. Our God will help us fight.”
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ nu titimati ɔ pɛmi pɛ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ ba wa ngɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Wa Mawu ɔ maa hwu ha wɔ.”

english_verse: I asked the men in charge and their workers to stay inside Jerusalem and stand guard at night. So they guarded the city at night and worked during the day.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, i de ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ ke a kɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba hi Yerusalem, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa bu ma a he nyɔ mi, nɛ ke je na a, wa tsu ní.

english_verse: I even slept in my work clothes at night; my relatives, the workers, and the guards slept in theirs as well. And we always kept our weapons close by.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, ye we bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ye he buli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ye se ɔ, wa je we wa tade ɔmɛ ngɛ wa he; mohu nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ e tahwu ní ngɛ e dɛ.

english_verse: Some of the men and their wives complained about the Jews in power
translation_verse: Be ko se ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo ba bɔni ngmlaa kpami kɛ ngɛ a nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ woe.

english_verse: Others said, “During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.”
translation_verse: Ni komɛ hu de ke, “Hwɔ nɛ ba a he je ɔ, wa ngɔ wa zugba amɛ, wa wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wa we ɔmɛ kɛ to awaba, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa na blɛfo nɛ waa ye.”

english_verse: Then others said, “We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ hu ke, “Wa pa sika kɛ wo wa zugba amɛ, kɛ wa wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a he tó ha nɔ yeli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: We are Jews just as they are, and our children are as good as theirs. But we still have to sell our children as slaves, and some of our daughters have already been raped. We are completely helpless; our fields and vineyards have even been taken from us.”
translation_verse: Waa kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, ni kake ji wɔ. Anɛ wa bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ sɔɛ lo? Se fimi nya a, e hia kaa waa jua wa bimɛ ɔmɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi. Wa jua wa biyi ɔmɛ ekomɛ momo kaa nyɔguɛhi, nɛ wa be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hu; ejakaa a kpɔ wa zugba amɛ, kɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ wa dɛ.”

english_verse: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.
translation_verse: Benɛ i nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ mɛ pee ɔ, ye mi mi fu wawɛɛ,

english_verse: So I thought it over and said to the leaders and officials, “How can you charge your own people interest?” Then I called a public meeting and accused the leaders
translation_verse: nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma pee he nɔ́ ko amlɔ. I kuɛ wo ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, nɛ i kã a hɛ mi ke, “Nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ yi mi wae!” Jehanɛ i tsɛ ma a kpe, konɛ waa hyɛ munyu nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: by saying, “We have tried to buy back all of our people who were sold into exile. But here you are, selling more of them for us to buy back!” The officials and leaders did not say a word, because they knew this was true.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
