translation_verse: I na kaa nɔ́ ko daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; i hyɛ, se i li nɔ́ nɛ ji. Lejɛ ɔ pee dii; kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ gbi ko pɛ ke,

english_verse: Your tent pegs are pulled up, and you leave this life, having gained no wisdom.”
translation_verse: Ke a he e he wami tsuo ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, e gbo be mi nɛ e li nɔ́ ko.”

english_verse: Job, call out for help and see if an angel comes!
translation_verse: Hiob, mo kpa kuu kaa nɔ ko ma he nɔ lo! Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ ngɔ o maa ya?

english_verse: Envy and jealousy will kill a stupid fool.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, mi mi la gbeɔ kuasia. Nɔ nɛ hɛ mi tɛ̃ ɔ, hunga gbeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I have seen fools take root. But God sends a curse, suddenly uprooting them
translation_verse: I na kuasiahi nɛ a pee kaa a na a he; kɛkɛ nɛ i gbiɛ a hi he amlɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: Our suffering isn't caused by the failure of crops;
translation_verse: Amanehlu ɔ, pi bunyuku mi nɛ e jeɔ; haomi hu pi zu mi nɛ e puɛɔ kɛ jeɔ.

english_verse: Job, if I were you, I would ask God for help.
translation_verse: Imi ji mo jinɛ i ko hla Mawu se blɔ, nɛ ma tu ye sane ɔ kɛ wo e dɛ mi.

english_verse: His miracles are marvelous, more than we can count.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ peeɔ ní nguanguahi nɛ wa juɛmi sui he, kɛ nyakpɛ ní hu babauu.

english_verse: God sends showers on earth and waters the fields.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e haa nɛ hiɔmi nɛɔ kɛ pueɔ zugba; nɛ e haa nɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ naa nyu.

english_verse: He protects the sorrowful and lifts up those who have been disgraced. *
translation_verse: Ee, nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ, Mawu woɔ a nɔ; lɛ nɛ e woɔ kɔmɔ yeli a bua.

english_verse: Darkness is their only companion, hiding their path at noon.
translation_verse: Piani nɛ la ngɛ po, a hii si tataae kaa nɔ́ nɛ diblii mi lɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe.

english_verse: God rescues the needy from the words of the wicked and the fist of the mighty.
translation_verse: Se Mawu heɔ ohiatsɛ yi wami kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ mi. E jeɔ nɔ nɛ e fí lɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ yiwutsotsɛ dɛ mi.

english_verse: The poor are filled with hope, and injustice is silenced. Consider Yourself Fortunate
translation_verse: E haa ohiatsɛ hɛ nɔ kami, nɛ yiwutsotsɛ maa e nya.

english_verse: He may cause injury and pain, but he will bandage and heal your cuts and bruises.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu plaa mo ɔ, e fiɔ pa a nɔ; ke e fia mo nɔ́ ɔ, e tsaa mo.

english_verse: God will protect you from harm, no matter how often trouble may strike.
translation_verse: E ma je mo kɛ je haomihi tsuo a mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko be o he sae.

english_verse: In times of war and famine, God will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Hwɔ be mi, kɛ ta be mi tsuo e ma he o yi wami.

english_verse: You will be sheltered, without fear of hurtful words or any other weapon.
translation_verse: Mawu ma je mo kɛ je he guɛ gbeli a dɛ mi; ke hɛ mi kpatami ma a, e ma he o yi wami.

english_verse: You will laugh at the threat of destruction and famine. And you won't be afraid of wild animals—
translation_verse: Hɛ mi kpatami kɛ hwɔ a he maa pee mo muɔ, nɛ o be pu mi lohwehi hu gbeye yee.

english_verse: they will no longer be fierce, and your rocky fields will become friendly.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmɔhi nɛ o ma hu ɔ, tɛ be a nɔ hie; pu mi lohwehi hu be mo haoe.

english_verse: You will have more descendants than there are blades of grass on the face of the earth.
translation_verse: O bimɛ maa hiɛ babauu kaa nga ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: You will live a very long life, and your body will be strong until the day you die.
translation_verse: O maa bwɔ kotokoto loko o ma gbo, kaa bɔ nɛ ngma waa saminya loko a kpaa a.

english_verse: It's impossible to weigh my misery and grief!
translation_verse: I ná nɛ a ngmɛ ye haomi ɔ, kɛ ye aywilɛho ɔ ngɛ sɛni nɔ,

english_verse: They outweigh the sand along the beach, and that's why I have spoken without thinking first.
translation_verse: jinɛ a ko jiɔ pe wo nya zia. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ munyu tue basabasa a nɛ.

english_verse: The fearsome arrows of God All-Powerful have filled my soul with their poison.
translation_verse: Mawu Ope ɔ tsɛ̃ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃, nɛ duɔ ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ ye he womi mi tsuo. Mawu ní gbeyegbeye ɔmɛ gba ta kɛ wo mi.

english_verse: What is food without salt? What is more tasteless than the white of an egg?
translation_verse: Anɛ a yeɔ ní muɛtɛ nɛ a nɛ ngo lo? Kungwɔ hlui mi ehiɔ ɔ, mɛni ngɔmi lɛ ngɛ mi?

english_verse: That's how my food tastes, and my appetite is gone. *
translation_verse: Niye ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ jlo we mi; ke i ye kɛkɛ e peeɔ mi kaa ma vie.

english_verse: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.
translation_verse: Jinɛ ma hlu kɛ bua jɔmi, nɛ i be haomi ɔ nitsɛ po he nue. Mawu Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa amɛ ɔ, i tɔ̃ we a nɔ hyɛ.

english_verse: I am not strong as stone or bronze,
translation_verse: Anɛ tɛ ji mi nɛ i nui nɔ́ he lo? Ye he womi ɔ, akɔblee lo?

english_verse: and I have finally reached the end of my rope. My Friends, I Am Desperate
translation_verse: Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ye he wami ta! He ko he ko be nɛ ma na yemi kɛ buami kɛ je.

english_verse: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *
translation_verse: I kua Mawu jio, i kua we lɛ jio, ngɛ haomi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e hia mi huɛmɛ nɛ ma he mɛ ma ye.

english_verse: like streams that swell with melting snow,
translation_verse: Snoo kɛ nyu tɛ hyiɔ pa tɔtɔɔtɔ,

english_verse: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared. What Have I Done Wrong?
translation_verse: Nyɛ ngɛ kaa jamɛ a pa a nɛ e mi nyu mii ta a pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛ ba na mi ngɛ haomi si himi mi, kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ ye gbeye.

english_verse: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift
translation_verse: Anɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ba ke mi ní, aloo nyɛ ya ha nɔ ko nyɔ mi ní ha mi lo?

english_verse: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Yoo, nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ tu munyu. Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ i pee nɛ dɛ; ma pee dii nɛ ma bu nyɛ tue.

english_verse: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale munyuhi gbɔɔ nɔ tsui mi; se ye hɛ mi nɛ nyɛ ba ngɛ kae nɛ ɔ lɛɛ yaka kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Here I am desperate, and you consider my words as worthless as wind.
translation_verse: Nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ juɛmi munyuhi tue, se imi nɛ ye nine mi je wu ɔ, ye munyu ɔmɛ peeɔ kɔɔhiɔ; pi ja?

english_verse: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ ye hɛ mi saminya! Anɛ ma nyɛ ma ye nyɛ lakpa lo?

english_verse: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ susuu kaa i ngɛ lakpa yee. Nyɛ susuu kaa i li kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti slɔɔto lo?

english_verse: Why is life so hard? Why do we suffer?
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa wami si himi ngɛ kaa ta; nɔmlɔ ngɛ kaa apaa yelɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ ngɛ kaa nyɔguɛ nɛ ngɛ hɔ̃ hlae nɛ e hi mi. E ngɛ kaa apaa yelɔ nɛ ngɛ e hiɔwo blɔ hyɛe.

english_verse: My parched skin is covered with worms, dirt, and sores,
translation_verse: Ye he womi pɔtɔ, nɛ e wo gɔgɔ. Ye he tsuo pee pa, nɛ e foɔ nyu.

english_verse: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle. Don't Forget!
translation_verse: Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee mlamlaamla; a he ngɛ sɔe kulaa pe bo lolɔ kplɛ. Ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ tae, se i be hɛ nɔ kami ko.

english_verse: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai kaa ye wami ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ; ye bua jɔmi ɔ se po.

english_verse: I will vanish from sight, and no one, including you, will ever see me again.
translation_verse: Nɛ́ nyɛ ngɛ mi hyɛe nɛ ɔ, nyɛ be mi nae hu. Nyɛ maa hi mi hyɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ i si nyɛ.

english_verse: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko gbo nɛ e ho gbeje ya a, e kpale we kɛ bɛ hu kaa bɔ nɛ bɔku laa nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu ɔ.

english_verse: And so, I cry out to you in agony and distress.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i be ye nya mae. I hao, nɛ aywilɛho nu mi. Ja i tu munyu kɛ̃!

english_verse: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?
translation_verse: Mɛni he je nyɛ ba ngɛ ye he bue? Anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa wo mi lohwe ngua a ji mi lo?

english_verse: but you torture me with terrible dreams. *
translation_verse: nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nlamihi, kɛ ninahi woɔ ye he gbeye.

english_verse: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?
translation_verse: O ba slaa lɛ daa mɔtu, nɛ o kaa lɛ kpitikpiti.

english_verse: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?
translation_verse: O be o hɛ jee kɛ je ye he bɔɔ nɛ ma mi ye kuɔ mi nyu po lo?

english_verse: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?
translation_verse: Ke i pee yayami ɔ, i plaa mo lo? Mo nɛ o hyɛɛ nimli adesahi a tsui mi ɔ, mɛni he je o je hɛ ngɔ pi mi ɔ? Anɛ i plɛ pee tlomi nɛ jiɔ tsɔ ha mo lo?

english_verse: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.
translation_verse: Ke o he tsɔ, nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu ma tsɔ e hɛ mi ha mo, nɛ e ma ha mo sihi he kpakpa.

english_verse: Your future will be brighter by far than your past. Our Ancestors Were Wise
translation_verse: Hwɔɔ se ɔ, Mawu ma ha mo ní babauu nɛ maa hiɛ kulaa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ.

english_verse: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.
translation_verse: Wa wami be ɔ ngɛ kpiti; wa li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; wa ngɛ kaa nini kɛkɛ nɛ bee ngɛ je ɔ mi.

english_verse: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.
translation_verse: Nimli yayamihi bɔɔ kaa nga ngɛ pu nɔ; a bɔɔ kaa nga nɛ ha ngmɔ nɔ.

english_verse: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;
translation_verse: Se ke a hɛ mi kpata kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be lee kaa a hi lejɛ ɔ hyɛ po.

english_verse: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu be lɛ kuae. Mawu be nimli yayamihi a he piɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: And so, he will make you happy and give you something to smile about.
translation_verse: Mawu ma ha nɛ o maa muɔ, nɛ o ma hwɔ lele ekohu.

english_verse: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ mo ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ; yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a wehi maa laa.

english_verse: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i le kaa e ngɛ mi ja. Se kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e maa ye nguɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi?

english_verse: Not once in a thousand times could we win our case if we took him to court.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ Mawu maa hua nɔ́ he? Ke Mawu bi lɛ munyu akpe ɔ, anɛ e ma nyɛ kake po heto ma ha lo?

english_verse: God is wise and powerful— who could possibly oppose him and win?
translation_verse: Mawu ɔ, e le ní, nɛ e he wa. Mɛnɔ lɛ te si kɛ si Mawu hyɛ nɛ e hi ha lɛ?

english_verse: When God becomes angry, he can move mountains before they even know it.
translation_verse: E hiaa yohi tlukaa nɛ e wui nɔ ko si; nɛ ke e mi mi fu ɔ, e kpataa a hɛ mi.

english_verse: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations
translation_verse: E haa nɛ zugba mimiɛɔ, nɛ titimahi nɛ hɛɛ zugba a mimiɛɔ.

english_verse: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.
translation_verse: E nyɛɔ faa nɛ pu ti si, nɛ dodoehi hu kpɛ we.

english_verse: and set the stars in place— the Big Dipper and Orion, the Pleiades and the stars in the southern sky.
translation_verse: Dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe: Je kpaago, Huɛ etɛ, Kungwɔ kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ leneyi je dodoe ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu lɛ pee mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.
translation_verse: E peeɔ ní nguahi nɛ nimli adesahi a juɛmi sui he. E nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu nɛ a li nya.

english_verse: God walks right past me, without making a sound.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, Mawu bee ngɛ ye hɛ mi kɛ yaa kɛ baa, se i nɛ lɛ.

english_verse: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God? Though I Am Innocent
translation_verse: Lɛɛ jije ma na munyu ngɛ kɛ ha Mawu heto nɛ sa?

english_verse: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
translation_verse: Ke i tsɛ lɛ nɛ e he nɔ pohu, i he we yi kaa ke i tu munyu nɛ e maa bu mi tue.

english_verse: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
translation_verse: E haa nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa fiaa mi basabasa yaka gu, nɛ i plaa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
translation_verse: E ha we nɛ ma wo mumi kulaa; ye wami si himi ɔ, doomi sɔuu.

english_verse: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
translation_verse: Ke a ngɛ nɔ nɛ he wa hlae ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ke e ba lɛ dami sane yemi hu, mɛnɔ kɛ lɛ maa ba kojomi he ɔ?

english_verse: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
translation_verse: Ke i yeɔ nguɔ kulaa po, e hia we kaa ma susu lɔ ɔ he; ye wami si himi pee we mi akɔnɔ hu.

english_verse: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.
translation_verse: O yeɔ fɔ jio, o yeɔ nguɔ jio, lɛ tsuo nɔ́ kake too. Mawu ma kpata wɔ tsuo wa hɛ mi.

english_verse: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ nɛ pee we yayami gbo tlukaa a, Mawu muɔɔ.

english_verse: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ je ɔ kɛ wo nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi. E ngɔ nɔ́ ngɔ ha kojoli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Ke pi Mawu nɛ pee ɔ, lɛɛ mɛnɔ lɛ pee?

english_verse: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee kɛ fo kaa lɛ nɛ he sɔɔ saminya; aloo kaa kɔle nɛ maa ho lohwe sami ya.

english_verse: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
translation_verse: A maa bu mi fɔ kɛ̃; mɛni he je mɔ lɛ ma gbo dengme yaka?

english_verse: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
translation_verse: Jale ko jale ko be nɛ ma nyɛ ma fɔ ye he yayami ɔmɛ.

english_verse: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
translation_verse: Mawu ma sake mi kɛ wo muɔ mi, nɛ ye he zo maa pee imi nitsɛ ye tadehi.

english_verse: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
translation_verse: Se sane he buálɔ ko be; nɔ ko be nɛ maa kojo Mawu kɛ nɔmlɔ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ jɔɔ ye tue gblami; e kpa ye he gbeye womi.

english_verse: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
translation_verse: I yi lɛ gbeye. Ma tu munyu, ejakaa i le bɔ nɛ ye tsui mi ngɛ.

english_verse: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
translation_verse: Je mi himi ba gbe ye nya; jehanɛ, bu ye sane ɔ tue.

english_verse: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
translation_verse: Anɛ nimli adesahi a hɛngmɛ lɛ ngɛ o dɛ? Anɛ o hyɛɛ nɔ́ kaa nɔmlɔ lo?

english_verse: Is your life as short as ours?
translation_verse: Anɛ o wami be ɔ ngɛ kpiti kaa nɔmlɔ nɔ́ lo?

english_verse: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
translation_verse: Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o ngɛ ye tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ ye yayami ɔmɛ a se die kikɛ nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
translation_verse: O le kaa i yi fɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hu be nɛ ma kpɔ mi kɛ je o dɛ mi.

english_verse: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
translation_verse: Kai kaa tabo zu lɛ o kɛ bɔ mi. Anɛ o ma ha nɛ ma plɛ pee zu ekohu lo?

english_verse: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
translation_verse: O ha tsaatsɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ fɔ mi; o ha nɛ i wa ngɛ maa mi mi.

english_verse: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
translation_verse: O kɛ wu kɛ pani pee ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ lo, kɛ he womi kɛ ha he.

english_verse: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
translation_verse: O dloo mi wami, o hyɛɛ ye nɔ daa, nɛ o suɔmi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble.

english_verse: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
translation_verse: Ke i pee yayami ko ɔ, kɛkɛ o ngma kɛ to, nɛ o kɛ be mi pae kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: Ke níhi a mi hi ha mi bɔɔ ɔ, o nyɛɛɔ ye se kaa jata. O guu nyakpɛ blɔhi a nɔ, nɛ o kɛ yeɔ mi awi.

english_verse: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
translation_verse: Mawu, mɛni he je kulaa lɛ o ha nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ? I na nɛ i plɛ ye se ngɛ muɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
translation_verse: Ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ ɔ, pi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ piɛ lo? Ngmɛɛ ye he nɛ ma na bua jɔmi bɔɔ!

english_verse: of darkness and despair, the place of no return.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ ngɛ gbeyegbeye, kɛ basabasa; nɛ piani po woɔ diblii kaa nyɔ mi.

english_verse: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
translation_verse: Hiob, munyuhi nɛ o ngɛ tue putɛputɛɛ ɔ, o susu kaa jamɛ munyu ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ wa ma wa nya lo? Ke o ngɛ nihi a he fɛu yee ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ ko pue o hɛ mi si lo?

english_verse: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
translation_verse: O deɔ ke anɔkuale munyuhi o ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ; o deɔ ke dalɔ ji mo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe se lokoo, se moo lɛɛ hiɔwe ɔ po o juɛmi sui he. Mawu le gbogboehi a je, se moo lɛɛ o li lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
translation_verse: Ke Mawu ba nu mo nɛ e kɛ mo ba kojomi he ɔ, mɛnɔ maa tsi e nya?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
translation_verse: Mawu le yaka nimli. Ke e na ní yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ, anɛ e be a tue gblae lo?

english_verse: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
translation_verse: Ke nga mi tejihi a hɛ mi ba si ɔ, kuasiahi maa le nɔ.

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: Hiob, tsake o tsui, nɛ o bua o nine nya nɛ o fa kue ha Mawu.

english_verse: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
translation_verse: Mo nitsɛ mo kpa yayami peemi, nɛ o hyɛ nɛ a ko pee yi wu tso ní ngɛ o we ɔ mi.

english_verse: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
translation_verse: O wami he ma tsɔ heii pe piani; diblii be po maa hi kaa mɔtu.

english_verse: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.
translation_verse: O maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ hɛ nɔ kami mi; Mawu maa baa o yi, nɛ e ma ha mo he jɔmi.

english_verse: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
translation_verse: Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a maa na kaa a yi ta pɛ; he ko he ko be nɛ a maa tu fo kɛ ya. Nɔ́ nɛ blɔ nɛ a maa hyɛ kɛkɛ ji gbenɔ.

english_verse: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, nyɛ ji ma a nɛ. Ke nyɛ gbo kɛkɛ nile hu gbo.

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Ojo fiali, kɛ nihi nɛ woɔ Mawu mi mi la a, a ngɛ tue mi jɔmi si himi mi; mɛ po nɛ a he wami ji a mawu ɔ.

english_verse: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ya lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ a ngɔ; nyɛɛ ya lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ní.

english_verse: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ti mɛnɔ lɛ li kaa Mawu lɛ pee enɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
translation_verse: Se kaa bɔ nɛ tue hyɛɛ munyu mi, nɛ lilɛ hu saa niye ní nya hyɛɛ ɔ,

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: nimeli ngɛ nile; nihi nɛ a wami se kɛ ɔ, a ngɛ juɛmi.

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: Se Mawu lɛɛ e nɔ́ ji nile, kɛ he wami; e ngɛ juɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi.

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Mawu he wa, nɛ e le ní; nɔ sisilɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ a sisi lɛ tsuo e níhi ji mɛ.

english_verse: God removes priests and others who have great power—
translation_verse: E baa osɔfohi si, nɛ e butuu ni nɛmɛ nɛ he wami ngɛ a dɛ.

english_verse: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
translation_verse: E pueɔ ganɔhi a hɛ mi si, nɛ e haa a he wami ɔ se poɔ.

english_verse: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
translation_verse: E haa je ma amɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli jeɔ kuasia, nɛ a ya woɔ lalaalo ngɛ nga nɔ he nɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko be.

english_verse: lost in the dark, staggering like someone drunk.
translation_verse: A hii dedee, nɛ a hii si tataae ngɛ diblii mi kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ pe nyɛ poɔ sane deɔ; nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ kaa tsopatsɛmɛ nɛ a he be se nami.

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: I na nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ nya mohu, jinɛ a ko tsɛ nyɛ ní leli.

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Mawu he lɛ nyɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ? Nyɛ maa ye e sane ɔ ha lɛ lo?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ hyɛɛ nimli a hɛ mi ngɛ laami mi ɔ, e ma ka nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ̃.

english_verse: and his glorious splendor would make you terrified.
translation_verse: E he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ maa wo nyɛ he gbeye, nɛ sawale maa nu nyɛ.

english_verse: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
translation_verse: Abɛhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bue ɔ, a he be se nami ko; munyuhi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ Mawu he fae ɔ ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee dii nɛ ma tu munyu, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ye nɔ nɛ ba.

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: E wɛ ha mi kaa ma ngɔ ye wami kɛ ha ngɛ enɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, e maa gbe mi sa; i be hɛ nɔ kami ko. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma fa ye he ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ nɔuu ma he ye yi wami, ejakaa yayami peelɔ ko be nyɛe maa ba Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i dla ye he konɛ ma jaje ye sane ɔ, ejakaa i le kaa i yeɔ nguɔ.

english_verse: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ ma ye nya pomi ɔ? Mo Mawu lo? Ke ja a, lɛɛ ma pee dii nɛ ma gbo mohu.

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: Ha nɛ ma bi mo nɔ́ enyɔ pɛ, nɛ o ha mi, kɛkɛ i be ye he laae ngɛ o hɛ mi.

english_verse: stop punishing and terrifying me!
translation_verse: Kpa ye tue gblami, kɛ ye he gbeye womi.

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: Mawu, moo tu munyu kekle, konɛ ma he nɔ; aloo ke o suɔ ɔ, imi ma de kekle, konɛ moo o he nɔ.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: Mɛni ji ye he yayami ɔmɛ? Mɛni tɔmihi nɛ i pee? Tsɔɔ mi ye yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ ye tɔmi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: O po ye nya wawɛɛ nitsɛ; yayamihi nɛ i pee ye nihe be mi hu o ngɔ kɛ piɛ he.

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: I pee kaa tso nɛ sa, nɛ hule nɔ si, aloo bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye.

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa wami be ngɛ kpiti kɛkɛ, se e mi haomi hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: And so, I ask you, God, why pick on me?
translation_verse: Anɛ o kɛ imi, nɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ maa ye sane lo?

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko ngɛ nɛ he tsɔ kɛ pi si lo? Dɛbi! Nɔ ko be.

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je o hɛ ngɛ e he nɛ e na he jɔmi. Ha nɛ e na bua jɔmi bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ ngɛ e si himi nɛ he wa nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: Ke a po tso ngɔ fɔ si ɔ, hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ kaa e ma tsɛ̃ ekohu; ejakaa e hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a gbo we.

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ taku mi nyu taa, nɛ pa mi nyu miiɔ nɛ e gbliɔ ɔ,

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: I na nɛ o ngɔ mi ya laa ngɛ gbeje kɛ yaa si o mi mi fumi ɔ se maa po; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o maa to be nɛ a kɛ ma kai mi.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Jinɛ o ma tsɛ mi, nɛ ma he nɔ, nɛ o ma na imi, nɔmlɔ nɛ o bɔ ɔ, ye he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Jinɛ o maa hyɛ ye nyɛɛmi, nɛ o be ye he yayami ɔmɛ a se die.

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: O kɛ ye he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa mi, nɛ o maa ngmɛɛ he kulaa. Tɔmihi babauu nɛ i pee ɔ, o maa gbe lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: Se, kaa bɔ nɛ yohi tete po huleɔ kɛ nɔɔ si, nɛ tɛ sahi jeɔ a blɔ hehi;

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Ke o fia lɛ nɔ́, kɛkɛ e hɛ mi tsake; kɛkɛ a wo lɛ blɔ, nɛ e be bae hu gblegbleegble.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Ke e gbo ɔ, e bimɛ a hɛ mi ba nyami jio, e bimɛ a hɛ mi pue si jio, e li.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Lɛ nitsɛ e he lo ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e nuu he kaa e ngɛ lɛ yee; nɛ e yeɔ kɔmɔ.

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: E je mo nɔ kake o he jinɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be Mawu gbeye yee hu; jinɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be kue fae ha lɛ hu.

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ yeɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ a he odase; lakpa sɔuu lɛ o ngɛ yee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: Mo nitsɛ o nya mi munyu ngɛ mo fɔ bue; mo nitsɛ o lilɛ ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ mo sie, se pi imi.

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: Mo ji kekleekle nɔmlɔ nɛ a fɔ lo? A fɔ mo loko Mawu pee yoku ɔmɛ lo?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: O nu Mawu laami sanehi hyɛ lo? Mo pɛ ji ní lelɔ lo?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a yi mi je mua, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi ngɛ wa kpɛti nɛ a wa kulaa pe o tsɛ.

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Mɛni he je o mi mi fu kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je o hɛ dɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Hyɛ, Mawu bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ po e kɛ e hɛ fɔ we a nɔ; mɛ nitsɛmɛ tete po a he tsɔ we ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: Nɛ mo, nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ o sa, nɛ se nami be o he ɔ! Mo nɛ o peeɔ yayami kaa bɔ nɛ a nuu nyu kumakuma a, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ moo o he ma tsɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi?

english_verse: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
translation_verse: Mɛ pɛ lɛ a ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha; nubwɔ ko nubwɔ ko be a kpɛti.

english_verse: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛ, nɔ nɛ waa nihi yi mi ɔ, e maa na nɔ́ e wami be ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: nɛ okpokuhi hu ngɛ mlɛe nɛ a ye lɛ. Nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ le kaa e hɛ mi kpatami be ɔ su ta.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Fimi kɛ amanehlu woɔ e he gbeye. E le kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba e nɔ tlukaa kaa matsɛ ngua ko nɛ mia kɛ ha ta.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: nɛ diblii maa wo lɛ. E maa pee kaa tso nɛ la sã e kɔnihi, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ e mɔmɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: E maa pee kaa wai tso nɛ e yi mi wai yiblii ngmlikiti kplɔ pue si, aloo oliv tso nɛ e mɔmɔhi kplɔ pue si.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ li Mawu ɔ, a be ngmɛdu woe. Wehi nɛ a he nyɔ mi ní nɛ a kɛ ma mɛ ɔ, la maa sã mɛ pue si.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ toɔ ga yaya, nɛ a peeɔ yayami; sisimi hyi a tsui mi tɔtɔɔtɔ.

english_verse: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, imi hu i ko de ja nɔuu. I ko mimiɛ ye yi, nɛ ma ha nyɛ munyu nguahi.

english_verse: But I would offer hope and comfort instead.
translation_verse: Jinɛ ma wo nyɛ ga, nɛ ma tu munyu kɛ wo nyɛ bua.

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i tu munyu jio, i ma ye nya jio, haomi kake too ɔ mi lɛ i ngɛ kpamisa.

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Mawu, jehanɛ lɛɛ o ha nɛ pɔ tɔ mi; o gbe ye he nihi tsuo ta.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ mi ngɔ ha nihi nɛ li Mawu; e ngɔ mi ngɔ wo yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: Jinɛ i ngɛ he mi jɔmi, se Mawu tsɔtslɔɔ ye mi. Mawu nu ye kuɛ, nɛ e ku mi dukuduku. E je hɛ pi mi kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ maa kase dɛ nya dami.

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: E tsɛ̃ɔ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ jeɔ he tsuaa he. Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ sɛɛ ye he womi mi, nɛ a plaa mi; se Mawu nɛ mi mɔbɔ.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: I kpɛ kpekpe ngɔ ha ye he, nɛ i hii si ngɛ zugba kɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: I fo ya hluu kɛ ya si ye hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ fuu nɛ a pee kɔu kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ́ ko ha a nɔ.

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Se i yi nɔ ko amimi; i faa kue haa Mawu kɛ jeɔ ye tsui mi.

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete po, ye we odase ngɛ hiɔwe; nɔ nɛ ma fa ye he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu, se i faa kue haa Mawu kɛ vo nyu.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: Jehahi bɔɔ komɛ a se ɔ, ma hia blɔ kɛ ya he ko nɛ i be kpalee kɛ ba hu.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Ye wami be ɔ ta; i nyɛ we nɛ i ngɛ mumi woe. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi mlɛe ji yɔkɔ.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: He fɛu yeli bɔle mi kɛ kpe; niinɛ, i naa mɛ nɛ a hii ye he fɛu yee.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: Mawu, anɔkualetsɛ ji mi; mo he mi nɛ o ye. Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, nɔ kpa ko be nɛ ma fi se.

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: O ha nɛ nimli adesahi biɛ, nɛ a susuu we a yi mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko ha nɛ a ye ye nɔ.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i plɛ pee abɛ bumi nɔ́ ha nihi, nɛ a laa lada kɛ pueɔ ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Aywilɛho sɔuu ha nɛ ye hɛngmɛ nɔ pee kɔu, nɛ ye kɔnihi, kɛ ye nanehi pee legelege kaa nini.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Ke dali na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a he mi jɔ̃ɔ̃, nɛ a tuɔ a hɛ mi kɛ woɔ nihi nɛ li Mawu.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Se bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, dalɔ hii e blɔ nɔ kɛ̃. Nɔmlɔ nɛ yayami ko be e he ɔ, e naa he wami he ekohu.

english_verse: But none of my friends show any sense.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, i nɛ ní lelɔ kake ngmelu ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ta; ye yi mi tomi ɔmɛ puɛ; ye hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ ta.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Se ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔɔ nyɔ kɛ peeɔ piani. La a nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ hu ngɛ kaa diblii.

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Ye hɛ nɔ kami kɛkɛ ji gbeje; lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ ma hwɔ ngɛ diblii mi.

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: Ma tsɛ yɔkɔ ɔ ke tsaatsɛ; gɔgɔhi nɛ maa ye mi ɔ, ma tsɛ mɛ maa, kɛ ye nyɛmiyihi.

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Anɛ hɛ nɔ kami kɛ mi maa ya gbeje lo? Anɛ e kɛ mi maa ya zu mi lo?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: Ee, yayami peelɔ kane ɔ ma gbo, nɛ e la a be kpɛe hu gblegbleegble.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: E bo tsu ɔ nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, a maa gbla lɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba he ko nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: E sipoku ma gbli ngɛ e sisi, nɛ e kɔnihi maa ylɔ.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: A maa fie lɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi, kɛ je la he kɛ ya diblii mi.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ, aloo nɔmlɔ nɛ li Mawu ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: Mɛni be nyɛ maa ngɔ munyuhi kɛ hao mi kɛ yaa si?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Kpamisa nɛ ɔ, jɛmi kɛkɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi jɛe. Anɛ e pee we nyɛ zo kaa nyɛ ngɛ mi nisɛ ní pee lo?

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Ke e ngɛ mi tete po kaa i pee yayami ɔ, mɛni enɛ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ he?

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ li kaa Mawu lɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ lo? Lɛ nɛ tsɔ klama kɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Mawu mi mi fu mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e buɔ mi e he nyɛlɔ.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: E ta buli babauu ba tua mi; a bɔle mi kɛ kpe, nɛ a sa ye yi kɛ wo ye sihi he ɔ.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: Ke i tsɛ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ, e he we nɔ; ke i kpa lɛ pɛɛ tete po, e bui.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: Ye nya mi mumi jeɔ fu kɛ haa ye yo; imi nitsɛ ye nyɛ mi mi bimɛ bɛ ye kasa nya.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Jokuɛwi tete po hiee mi; ke a na mi pɛ, kɛkɛ a bɔni ye he munyu tumi.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: Ye huɛmɛ kpakpahi tsuo ngɛ mi hiee; ni nɛmɛ nɛ i suɔ mɛ saminya po te si wo mi.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: I ta he lo nɛ i pee kanyakanya; i kɛ gbenɔ wa kpɛti kɛ we kulaa.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ na mi mɔbɔ; ye huɛmɛ nyɛɛ na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa Mawu nine sa ye he.

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i le kaa nɔ ko ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ nyagbenyagbe ɔ, e ma ba kpɔ mi.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Ke ye he womi hɛ mi kpata kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ he lo ko be ye he po, ma na Mawu.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ na lɛ paa kɛ ye hɛngmɛ. Imi nitsɛnitsɛ, se pi nɔ kpa ko. Ye tsui ta!

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Benɛ nyɛ bi ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ kɛ wa lɛ yi mi?” ɔ, nyɛ hla nɔ ko nyɛ da nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba tua mi.

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Jɛmi munyuhi lɛ o tu ɔ nɛ, se mumi ɔ tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ ma ha mo heto ha.

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Ke e nɔ kuɔ kɛ ya su hiɔwe, nɛ e yi ya pi bɔku po,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: e hɛ mi ma kpata kɛ maa ya neneene kaa lɛ nitsɛ e fĩ. Nihi nɛ le lɛ ɔ ma bi ke, “Jije e ngɛ?”

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be lɛ nae hu; e sihi he ɔ maa fɔ si gu.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ e ju ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a dɛ ɔ, e bimɛ maa kpale kɛ ha mɛ ekohu.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ tso kɛ e he nihe nyu tsuaa a ma plɛ pee zu.

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: Se niye ní nɛ ɔ plɛɔ peeɔ sinɔ duɔ nɛ nya wa ngɛ e mi mi.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: E be je mi hie nɛ́ e maa na nyɔ nyu, kɛ hwo nɛ ngɛ bee kaa paa.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Ke e ye ní ɔ, eko kulaa píɛ ngɛ se. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ní nami ɔ se maa po.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ e na e he ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, haomi nɛ nya wa maa ba e nɔ tlukaa.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Ke e ka kaa e maa tu fo kɛ je dade nya a, a ma tsɛ̃ lɛ akɔblee kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ fɔ si.

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: E juetli tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata. La, nɛ pi nɔmlɔ nɛ slɛ maa sã lɛ, nɛ e we mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Hiɔwe ma je nyumu nɛ ɔ yayami ɔ kpo, nɛ zugba maa ye odase kɛ si lɛ.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji yayami peelɔ blɔ fa mi nɔ́; gbosi ní nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha yayami peelɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: A hii je mi kɛ ya siɔ a bimɛ, kɛ a bibimɛ waa ba naa mɛ.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔɛ haomi ko kɛ bɛ a wehi a mi; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko wui a he gbeye.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: A bi tsɔwitsɔwihi jeɔ kpo babauu nɛ a hii hlue kaa to bihi.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: A fiɛɔ do, a fiaa saku, nɛ a laa kɛ toɔ he; nɛ a naa bua jɔmi bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: A yeɔ a be ɔ ngɛ kplɔkɔtɔ mi, nɛ a gboɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Yayami peeli deɔ Mawu ke e je a nɔ, ejakaa a hla we e blɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a le.

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: A deɔ ke, “Tsa pi nɔ ko nɛ wo wɔ ní; wɔ nitsɛmɛ lɛ wa tsu nɛ wa na.” Se a susumi nɛ ɔ, imi i ngɔɛ.

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Anɛ Mawu muɔ yayami peeli kɛ ho hyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ bunyuku, aloo bɔ nɛ ahumi muɔɔ tsakati kɛ yaa a lo?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Nyɛ deɔ ke Mawu gblaa bimɛ a tue ngɛ a tsɛmɛ a he yayamihi a he. Dɛbi! Ha nɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ gbla yayami peeli ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ a tue, konɛ a na kaa a he yayami ɔmɛ a he lɛ a ngɛ a tue gblae ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ yayami peeli ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ná a tue gblami ɔ. Ha nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ we abofu ɔ nɛ kple mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, anɛ e pa susuɔ bimɛ nɛ e si ngɛ se ɔ a he lo?

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ tsɔɔ nimli nguahi po nile ɔ, anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa kojo lɛ lo?

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ hu gboɔ kɛ aywilɛho nɛ a na we bua jɔmi ko hyɛ.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo gboɔ, nɛ a puɔ mɛ ngɛ zu mi, nɛ gɔgɔ ba haa mɛ tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Nyɛ biɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ jije ganɔ ɔ we ɔ ngɛ? Jije yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a sihi he ɔmɛ ngɛ?”

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke amanehlu ba a, yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ a jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ mi, nɛ a yeɔ a he lo?

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko he ngɛ se nami ha Mawu lo? Ní lelɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e nile ɔ he se lɛ e naa.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: O fieɔ yalɔyihi kɛ jeɔ o ngɔ kɛ a dɛ mi gu, nɛ awusahi hu o waa mɛ yi mi.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: Diblii kpii wo mo, nɛ o hyɛ we nɔ́ hu; nyu kpekpemi bɔle mo kɛ kpe.

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: O susuɔ kaa ke Mawu ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ je ɔ, kɛ hiɔwe a kpe he ɔ, e hyɛ we nɔ́ ngɛ bɔku kpii ɔ mi lo?

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Se Mawu ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa a wehi hyi ɔ kɛ ní kpakpahi. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ, imi lɛɛ i sume saasaa!

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ a níhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi kpataa, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ, la ba sãã.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Ee, ba o he si nɛ o kpale kɛ ya Mawu ngɔ. Yayamihi tsuo nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ o we ɔ mi ɔ, a kpa peemi.

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: Mo sake o sika tsu ngɔ fɔ he; o sika tsu kpakpa a, hɛɛ ngɔ pue pa mi, ngɛ tɛhi a kpɛ.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Ke o fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e ma he nɔ, nɛ o maa ye o siwo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, Mawu baa lɛ si, se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, Mawu heɔ e yi wami.

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: Mwɔnɛ ɔ hu i kɛ Mawu na ekohu; i ngɛ kɛmɛe, se e ngɛ ye tue gblae kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Anɛ Mawu kɛ mi maa to ní ngɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya lo? Dɛbi, e maa bu mi tue kɛ̃.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Anɔkualetsɛ ji mi; i kɛ Mawu ma hla níhi a nya; nyagbe ɔ, e maa wo mi nguɔ kɛ̃.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: I hla Mawu ngɛ beleku je, se e be lejɛ ɔ; i ba bonyoku je hu, i nɛ lɛ.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: I hla lɛ ngɛ omleyi je, se i nɛ lɛ; i kpale kɛ ba leneyi je hu, i nɛ lɛ ja nɔuu.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Se Mawu le blɔ nɛ i nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ; ke e ka mi ɔ, e maa na kaa ye he tsɔ kaa sika tsu.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Mawu blɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔ i nyɛɛɔ daa nɛ; i gba we kɛ yɛ muɔ nɔ, loo hiɔ nɔ.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Ejakaa diblii bɔle mi kɛ kpe; diblii kpii ha ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: Mɛni he je lɛ Ope ɔ to we be nɛ a kɛ maa kojo nihi? Mɛni he je lɛ e ngɔ be ɔ kɛ laa nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ po?

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: A kpɔɔ awusahi a tejihi ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ yalɔyihi lɛɛ a ngɔɔ a na amɛ kɛ toɔ awaba.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Ke nihi kpa ní ta a, ohiatsɛmɛ ya kukuɔɔ bibliwi ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ. A ya kukuɔɔ wai yiblii ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ po a wai ngmɔhi a nɔ.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Nimli yayami komɛ kpɔɔ bimwɔwi nɛ be tsɛmɛ pani nya ngɛ a nyɛmɛ a nyɔ nya. A kɛ bimwɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ toɔ a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hiɔhi a nya.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ haa nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛɔ a he gu nɛ bo be a he; a haa nɛ a kɛ mi mi hwɔ tsuɔ ní ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: A naa nu kɛ jeɔ oliv tso mi, nɛ a ngaa wai kɛ jeɔ wai yiblii mi. Se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ kuma yeɔ mɛ.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: O maa nu nɛ nihi ngɛ kɛmɛe ngɛ ma a mi; o maa nu nɛ nihi nɛ plaa a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae, nɛ a ngɛ yemi kɛ buami hlae. Se Mawu bui mɛ tue fɛɛ.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Awi yelɔ teɔ si mɔtu kpla konɛ e gbe ohiatsɛ, aloo nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko. Nyɔ mi kɛkɛ e pee e he julɔ.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Gba puɛlɔ hu hii mlɛe konɛ du nɛ bu. E deɔ e he ke, “Nɔ ko be mi nae,” kɛkɛ e ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha e hɛ mi.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Ke diblii wo ɔ, juli ya sɛɛ nihi a wehi a mi ya juɔ. Piani lɛɛ a laa a he, nɛ a sume nɛ a baa la hɛ mi.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Ejakaa a yeɔ piani la a gbeye; diblii kpii ɔ mohu wui a he gbeye. Zofar

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛ ɔ, pa nɛ hia ba ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ yaa. A gbiɛ e weto ní nɛ ji e zugba a, nɛ e be ní tsue ngɛ e wai ngmɔ ɔ mi hu.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Gbeje ngɔɔ yayami peelɔ kɛ yaa kaa bɔ nɛ sapu kɛ latsa miiɔ nyu ɔ.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Mawu kɛ e he wami haa nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ he wa a yaa nɔ. E tee si be mi nɛ e hɛ be wami ko nɔ hu.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Mawu ma ha nɛ e maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi, se daa nɛ ɔ, e hɛngmɛ ngɛ e he.

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: Mawu kle, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye. E hiɔwe ma a lɛɛ tue mi jɔmi sɔuu ji lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Bɔfohi nɛ sɔmɔɔ Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa kane mɛ lo? E la a nɛ́, ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ e tsui ha mɛ lo?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Nyɔhiɔ tete kpɛ we ha Mawu, nɛ dodoehi po a hɛ mi tsɔ we ha lɛ.

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa aklɔku, aloo gɔgɔ ɔ, kɛ lɛɛ e maa pee kɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi kɛɛ?

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: Balɔ kpakpa! Mo lɛ o piɛ ye he. Imi nɛ i gbɔjɔ! Imi nɛ ye he wami ta!

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Imi kuasia nɛ i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ɔ, o wo mi ga, nɛ o tu nile munyu kpakpahi kɛ tsɔɔ mi!

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Kpade ɔmɛ a he mi ngɛ mɛ hiae ngɛ zu mi ngɛ nyu ɔ sisi.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Gbeje fɔɔ si paa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. He hami nɔ́ be he nɛ maa tsi lɛ blɔ.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Mawu gbla omleyi je hiɔwe ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ kpla si nɛ nɔ́ ko hɛɛ we lɛ.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Mawu lɛ e ngɔɔ nyɔhiɔ kɛ laa ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a se.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: E po huzu ngɛ wo hɛ mi kɛ gba piani kɛ nyɔ a kpɛti.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Ke e kuɛ́ ɔ, titimahi nɛ hɛɛ hiɔwe ɔ hosoɔ, nɛ a he wami taa.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: E kɛ e he wami jɔɔ wo ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ juɛmi kpata wo mi lohwe ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Rahab ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: E mumi ɔ lɛ ha nɛ hiɔwe tsɔ, nɛ e pee saminyayoo. E nine lɛ e kɛ tsɔtslɔɔ wo mi lohwe ngua a mi.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Mawu blɔ ɔmɛ a he níhi bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ́ wa nu kɛ wa tue ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. E he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ lɛɛ mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa le?

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: I na Mawu Ope nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ kua dami sane yemi ha mi, nɛ e ha nɛ i na amanehlu kikɛ nɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: I be kplɛɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee ɔ ngɛ mi; kɛ yaa si ye gbenɔ ligbi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛkɛ ji i yi fɔ.

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Ke yayami peelɔ be su, nɛ Mawu ba ngɔ lɛ ɔ, mɛni hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi pa ngɛ ha lɛ?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Anɛ e náá Ope ɔ he bua jɔmi lo? Anɛ e faa kue kɛ haa lɛ daa lo?

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Se tse nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ momo kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ. Lɛɛ mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ munyuhi nɛ a he be se nami tue kikɛ nɛ ɔ mɔ? Zofar

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: E ma fɔ bimɛ babauu, se mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ma gbo ngɛ ta mi; e bimɛ na we niye ní nɛ suu a nya gblegbleegble.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a he maa je mi ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe mɛ, nɛ a yalɔyi ɔmɛ be ya nyɛe ha mɛ.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ ma bua sika hiɔ babauu nya kaa bunyuku nɛ be hie kanemi; e ma bua he hami níhi babauu nya kaa tabo zu.

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: Se nɔmlɔ kpakpa ko lɛ ma ba ha bo ɔmɛ; nɔ kpakpa ko lɛ ma ba wo tade ɔmɛ, nɛ e maa ngɔ sika hiɔ ɔ.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ we nɛ e po ɔ ngɛ kaa anani ya, aloo tsu wayoo nɛ bulɔ pee.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: E ma ya hwɔ si kaa niatsɛ; se ke e te si ɔ, e maa na kaa e sika a tsuo ta.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Sawale maa nu lɛ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee. Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa maa fia lɛ kɛ ho nyɔ mi.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Niye ní jeɔ zu mi, se zu ɔ sisi lɛɛ e pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ la sã.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Jata, loo lohwe awi yelɔ ko bi ngɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Nimli adesahi tsuaa tɛ sahi nɛ a he wa, a hiaa yokuhi kɛ jeɔ a hi hehi.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Ke a ngɛ tɛ sa amɛ a mi kpɛe ɔ, a naa tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: A tsuaa pa mi kɛ yaa pa a je he tɔɔ, nɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ laa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a ngɔɔ kɛ baa la hɛ mi.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ ke nile be a ngɔ; wo hu ja nɔuu lɛ e ngɛ dee.

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Nile ɔ, a ngɔɛ sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ kɛ he we.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: E he jua wa pe sika tsu, e he jua wa pe sika tsu kplu, aloo ahuhuɛ kpakpa.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Nile he jua wa pe huazi, loo kɔli, loo adiagba.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Etiopia topasion tɛ, aloo sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ nile sɔɛ.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Gbenɔ kɛ hɛ mi kpatami po de ke, “Oo, e biɛ kɛkɛ lɛ wa nu kɛ wa tue.”

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: He nɛ nile ngɛ, kɛ blɔ nɛ a maa gu kɛ ya na lɛ ɔ, Mawu pɛ lɛ le.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu susu kɔɔhiɔ jiimi, kɛ he nɛ wo ɔ yi ma bli kɛ ya su ɔ,

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: benɛ Mawu to he nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ, kɛ he nɛ hiɔwe ma si kɛ ya be ngɛ ɔ,

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Mawu de nɔmlɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye yemi ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nile; yayami he jemi ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji juɛmi.”

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: I na nɛ i ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ sa a nɛ Mawu buɔ ye he ɔ.

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi ngɛ saminya, nɛ ke i ngɛ diblii mi nyɛɛe ɔ, e haa mi la.

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, ye he hi, nɛ Mawu kɛ mi ngɛ kaa nɔ kɛ e huɛ.

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, ye na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ haa mi nyɔ nyu babauu; nɛ hehi nɛ tɛ sa hiɛ ngɛ po, i naa oliv tsohi babauu nɛ haa mi nu bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke ohiatsɛmɛ kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ balɔ ɔ, i jeɔ mɛ; awusahi hu i piɛɔ a he ja nɔuu.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: I je nihi kɛ je haomi mi, nɛ a gbaa mi; nɛ i ha nɛ yalɔyihi na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be ɔ, i yeɔ dami sane, nɛ i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: I plɛ pee hɛngmɛ ha hɛ yuyuili, kɛ nane ha glɔtsɛmɛ.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: I pee kaa tsɛ kɛ ha dɛgutsɛmɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ i li mɛ po, i ye a sane ha mɛ.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: I ku yiwutsotsɛmɛ a tsitsa, nɛ i kpɔ nihi nɛ a ngɛ yi mi wae ɔ kɛ je a nya mi.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: I hyɛ blɔ kaa ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ maa hiɛ babauu kaa zia, nɛ ma gbo ngɛ we, ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: I ngɛ kaa tso nɛ sipoku naa nyu be tsuaa be, nɛ bɔ́ pɔɔ e kɔnihi a he daa.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ a he wami tsuo ta nɛ ɔ, mɛni se ma na ngɛ a he?

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Ohia kɛ hwɔ ha nɛ a ta he lo, nɛ a pee kanyakanya; sa a, tso sipoku gbigbli lɛ a kpeɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Tso sipoku, kɛ ba ji a niye ní.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: A fie mɛ kɛ je nimli a kpɛti; a huɔ mɛ kaa a huɔɔ julɔ.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: A hi hehi ji muɔhi, tɛ sahi, kɛ dɔhi a mi.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Yakayaka nimli, kɛ ni guhi ji mɛ tsuo, nihi nɛ a fia a nane si tu kɛ je ma a mi.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ba konɛ a ba muɔ mi; i plɛ pee a nya mi la.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: A hɛ mɛ kɛ je ye kasa nya; a hiee mi. Ke a hyɛ mi kɛkɛ a la lada pue ye nɔ.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Mawu gbla ye tue nɛ i gbɔjɔ he je ɔ, a bui mi fɛɛ; nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ lɛ a peeɔ mi.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Yakayaka nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba tuaa mi basabasa, nɛ a hlaa kaa a ma kpata ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Sawale nu mi; ye hɛ mi nyami laa mi kaa kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ ní kɛ yaa. Ye ní nami ɔ se po kaa bɔku.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye gbenɔ be su ta; jehanɛ lɛɛ, ye haomi ɔ nya ba wa tsɔ.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Nyɔ mi ɔ, ye wuhi a mi kpeɔ mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ nɛ he jɔmi be mi.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Mawu tsitsɛɛ mi kɛ wo mɔsɔ mi, nɛ i pee kaa tabo zu, aloo la zu.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: Mawu, ke i tsɛ mo ɔ, o he we nɔ; ke i fa kue ha mo ɔ, o bui mi tue.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i le kaa o ngɔ mi kɛ yaa gbeje, he nɛ a to kɛ ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Se benɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa blɔ hyɛe ɔ, nɔ́ yayami mohu lɛ ba na mi. Benɛ i ngɛ la blɔ hyɛe ɔ, diblii mohu lɛ ba.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Ye tsui ngɛ fiae wawɛɛ ngɛ ye mi mi; ye haomi ligbi ɔmɛ hiɛ tsɔ.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: I ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ diblii mi nyɛɛe nɛ e nɛ pu hɛ mi. I teɔ si ngɛ gua mi, nɛ i biɔ yemi kɛ buami.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: I plɛ pee nga mi gbehi a nyɛmi, kɛ klomihi a huɛ.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Ye he womi pee tuu, nɛ ye wuhi a he dɔ la.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: I ka kita kaa i kɛ akɔnɔ hɛngmɛ be zangmayo ko hyɛe gblegbleegble.

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Anɛ e kpataa we yiwutsotsɛmɛ a hɛ mi lo? Anɛ e gbla we yayami peeli a tue lo?

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Mawu le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i peeɔ; e le ye blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: lɛɛ níhi nɛ i du ɔ, ni kpahi nɛ a ba ye; aloo ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata.

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: lɛɛ ye yo nɛ e hoo gba ní ha nɔ kpa, nɛ nyumu kpa kɛ lɛ nɛ hwɔ.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e ji zo; e sa kaa kojoli nɛ a gbla nɔ tue ngɛ he.

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: E ngɛ kaa la nɛ sãã nɔ́ kɛ yaa tsitsaa; e ma kpata ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi.

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: Ke ye tsɔlɔ nyumu, aloo ye mawayo ko kɛ mi na sane ɔ, i yeɔ sane ɔ ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ.

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Mawu ɔ nɛ bɔ mi ɔ, lɛ kɛ̃ lɛ e bɔ ye tsɔli nyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ ye mawayi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: Ke i ngɛ ní yee ɔ, i ha we nɛ hwɔ yeɔ awusahi.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: I hyɛɔ awusahi a nɔ kaa a tsɛ ye wami be ɔ tsuo. I ye bua yalɔyihi kɛ je ye nihe mi.

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: Ke i ya ye awusa ko amimi, ejakaa i le kaa bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, a maa wo mi nguɔ ngɛ kojomi he ɔ,

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: lɛɛ ye nine nɛ ku; ye kɔni nɛ kplɔ kɛ je kɔni wu ɔ he.

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ i yeɔ Mawu Hewamitsɛ ɔ tue gblami ɔ gbeye he je ɔ, i be nyɛe ma pee nɔ́ ko kaa ja.

english_verse: I have never trusted the power of wealth,
translation_verse: I ngɔɛ ye hɛ fɔ we sika nɔ.

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: Ní babauu nɛ i na a, i fĩa we ngɔ fɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: Ke haomi ba ye he nyɛlɔ nɔ, aloo ye he nyɛlɔ hɛ mi kpata a, i nya we.

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: I sɔle we hyɛ ke ye he nyɛli nɛ a gbo, nɛ́ enɛ ɔ ba pee yayami ha mi.

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: I laa we ye yayamihi a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Adam pee ɔ.

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: I yi nihi babauu a hɛ mi gbeye. Ke ye weku li muɔ mi ɔ, e pee we mi nɔ́ ko nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma pee dii nɛ ma ko je kpo.

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: i kɛ maa fɔ ye konɔ, nɛ ma fi kɛ wo ye yi kaa jlasi.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Jinɛ ma nyɛɛ kam kam kaa ganɔ kɛ ya Mawu ngɔ, nɛ ma ya bɔ lɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i pee ɔ.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: Ke ye zugba a, aloo ngmɔ nɛ i pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa po ye nya

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: lɛɛ ngma nane mi ɔ, mio nɛ puɛ; akoko nane mi ɔ, nga nɛ puɛ. Hiob munyu ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyumuhi etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ha we Hiob e munyu ɔmɛ a heto hu, ejakaa a na kaa e buu e he kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ da.

english_verse: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Elihu mi mi fu Hiob wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa e pia Mawu, nɛ e wo lɛ nitsɛ e he nguɔ.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: Elihu mi mi fu Hiob huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ, ejakaa a bu Hiob fɔ, be mi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɛ heto kpakpa ko nɛ a ha lɛ.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: nɛ e tu munyu. Elihu Niheyo kɛkɛ ji mi; nyɛɛ lɛɛ nikɔtɔmahi ji nyɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ya ye gbeye, nɛ i nyɛ we nɛ ma de nyɛ bɔ nɛ imi hu i susu ha.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ bu mi tue, konɛ imi hu ma je ye juɛmi kpo.

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ e ko pee nyɛ kaa nyɛ le ní. Mawu lɛ maa bu Hiob fɔ, se pi nɔmlɔ adesa.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: Hiob hyɛ, ní leli ɔmɛ pee yaa; a pee dii, a pa be nɔ́ ko nɛ a ma de hu.

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: I ngɛ níhi babauu nɛ ma de. Mumi nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ ngɛ ye yi se tsitsɛɛe.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: I be nɔ ko hɛ mi hyɛe kɛ tu munyu; nɛ i be munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ tue ngɛ nɔ ko he.

english_verse: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!
translation_verse: I li munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ tumi. Ke i pee ja a, ye bɔlɔ ɔ maa gbla ye tue amlɔ.

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Mawu mumi ɔ lɛ pee mi; Ope ɔ mumi ɔ lɛ ha mi wami.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo ye mi gbeye; pi nɔmlɔ nɛ ke e daa si ngɛ o hɛ mi nɛ o tsui maa po ji mi.

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃, Mawu bu mi kaa e he nyɛlɔ, nɛ e ngɛ tɔmihi hlae ngɛ ye he.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: E bɔ ye nane pã, nɛ e hɛ ngɛ ye he be tsuaa be.”

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ji o nɔ́ be mi; Mawu kle pe nɔmlɔ adesa.

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Mawu ngɛ munyu tue daa be tsuaa be, se nɔmlɔ adesa bui nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ tue.

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: Mawu kɛ nimli adesahi tuɔ munyu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpa yayami peemi, nɛ a ko wo a he nɔ.

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: E hla we kaa a hɛ mi nɛ kpata; e heɔ a yi wami kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ mi tete.

english_verse: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kaseɔ ní ngɛ hiɔ sa nɔ, be mi nɛ e wuhi a mi ngɛ lɛ kpee nɛ he jɔmi be mi.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ ji e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: Alini, Mawu bɔfo akpe ɔmɛ nɛ tsɔɔ nimli adesahi nɔ́ nɛ da a, a ti nɔ kake ma ba je lɛ.

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: Ke e fa kue ha Mawu ɔ, Mawu ma he nɔ. E ma sɔmɔ Mawu kɛ bua jɔmi, nɛ Mawu ma ha nɛ níhi a mi maa hi ha lɛ ekohu.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: E kɛ bua jɔmi ma de ngɛ ma hɛ mi ke, “I pee yayami. I pee we nɔ́ nɛ da blɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, Mawu na mi mɔbɔ.

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: Mawu kplɛɛ we nɛ ma ya gbeje, nɛ i ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ.”

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu peeɔ ha nɔmlɔ si abɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: e heɔ nɔmlɔ yi wami, nɛ e haa lɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ je mi.

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ o ma de ɔ, de nɛ ma nu; ma suɔ kaa ma wo mo nguɔ.

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: Nyɛ ní leli, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hyɛ sane ɔ mi, nɛ waa na anɔkuale ɔ.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Hiob ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa dalɔ ji lɛ, se Mawu mohu lɛ yi dami sane ha lɛ.

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: E ke e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ blɔ, se a bu lɛ lakpatsɛ. E ngɛ mi kaa a plaa lɛ yeyee mohu, se e le kaa e pee we yayami ko.

english_verse: He spends his time with sinners,
translation_verse: E kɛ nimli yayamihi lɛ bɔɔ.

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: E deɔ ke e he be se nami kaa nɔ ko nɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní.

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue, nyɛ juɛmitsɛmɛ! Anɛ Mawu maa pee yi wu tso ní lo? Anɛ Ope ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ lo?

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ nɛ ha Mawu e he wami ɔ? Mɛnɔ nɛ tu je ɔ tsuo kɛ wo e dɛ mi?

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Ke Mawu kpɔ mumi nɛ haa nɔ wami ngɛ nɔmlɔ dɛ ɔ,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: nimli adesahi tsuo ma gbo, nɛ a ma plɛ pee tabo zu ekohu.

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ he wa nɛ e yeɔ dami sane ɔ, o maa bu lɛ fɔ, konɛ nɔ nɛ sume dami sane yemi ɔ mohu nɛ ye tsɛ lo?

english_verse: Indeed, God is the one who condemns unfair rulers.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ deɔ matsɛ ke, “Yaka nɔmlɔ ji mo!” Mɛnɔ lɛ deɔ odehehi ke, “Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji nyɛ!”

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: Mawu hyɛ we ganɔhi a hɛ mi. E bui niatsɛmɛ pe ohiatsɛmɛ; ejakaa lɛ nɛ e bɔ mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ gboɔ tlukaa, Mawu fiaa nimli adesahi nɔ́ nyɔ mi kɛkɛ a hɛ mi kpata. Nimli nguahi po Mawu gbeɔ mɛ nɛ adesa nine be mi.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Diblii ko be nɛ nya tsa bɔ nɛ yayami peeli maa laa a he ngɛ mi.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: E hia we kaa Mawu nɛ to be ha nimli adesahi nɛ a ba e ngɔ loko e kojo mɛ.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Mawu le nɔ́ nɛ a tsuɔ he je ɔ, e ba tuaa mɛ nyɔ mi, nɛ e kpataa a hɛ mi.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: Mawu gblaa yayami peeli a tue ngɛ ma hɛ mi,

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: A ha nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ kpa ngmlaa kɛ ba Mawu yemi kɛ buami, nɛ Mawu nu nɔ́ nali ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: Hiob, anɛ o jaje o yayami ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Mawu lo? Anɛ o wo lɛ si kaa o be yayami pee hu lo?

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: Anɛ o fa kue ha Mawu ke e tsɔɔ mo o tɔmi ɔmɛ lo? Anɛ o kplɛɛ kaa o ma kpa yayami peemi lo?

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: Nɛ́ o kua Mawu ɔ, o ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa e pee moo o suɔmi nya ní ha mo lo? Mo lɛ o ma ha munyu nɛ ɔ heto; pi imi. Kɛ o susuɔ kɛɛ?

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: “Munyuhi nɛ Hiob ngɛ tue ɔ, juɛmi be mi; e li nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ.”

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: E je imi nɔ kake ye he jinɛ a ko gbla Hiob tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ ngɛ munyu yayahi nɛ e tu kɛ si Mawu ɔ he.

english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: Hiob tsɔ atuã kɛ piɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e tu munyuhi babauu ngɛ wa hɛ mi kɛ si Mawu.

english_verse: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: Hiob, e sɛ kaa o deɔ ke o pee we yayami ko ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: Ma ha mo heto, mo kɛ o huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: Ke a ngɛ nimli adesahi yi mi wae ɔ, a kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ balɔ.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Se Mawu nɛ bɔ mɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ baa a yi nyɔ mi tete po ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ ko hla we e se blɔ.

english_verse: though he makes us wiser than animals or birds.
translation_verse: Mawu ɔ nɛ pee wɔ ní leli pe lohwehi tsuo ɔ, a hla we e se blɔ.

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: A kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ balɔ, se Mawu bui mɛ tue; ejakaa he nɔ woli, kɛ yayami peeli ji mɛ.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Niinɛ, Mawu bui yaka ngmlaa tue; Mawu Ope ɔ bui he akɔtaa.

english_verse: he will surely deny your impatient request to face him in court.
translation_verse: Hiob, mo lɛ o ke o be Mawu nae ɔ? O sane ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi; moo hyɛ lɛ blɔ.

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: Moo to o tsui si nɛ o bu mi tue! Níhi nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ngɛ Mawu nane mi ɔ, i gbi nya lolo.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ ye nile nɛ hiɛ babauu ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ mo kaa Mawu nɛ bɔ mi ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale i ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ, pi lakpa; ní lelɔ kpanaa lɛ daa si ngɛ o hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
translation_verse: Mawu kle! E nyɛ́ nɔ. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ e juɛmi sui he.
