english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: E ha we nɛ yayami peeli a se kɛɛ ngɛ je mi; e yeɔ ohiatsɛmɛ a sane kɛ haa mɛ.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Mawu hɛngmɛ ngɛ dali a he be tsuaa be. E hyɛɛ a nɔ kaa matsɛmɛ, nɛ e woɔ a hɛ mi nyami daa.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Se ke a bɔ nihi pã, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a pee he ɔ,

english_verse: then he warns them to turn back to him.
translation_verse: E kaa a hɛ mi saminya, nɛ e deɔ mɛ ke a kpa yayami peemi.

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Ke a bu Mawu tue nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ ɔ, a ma na tue mi jɔmi, kɛ kplɔkɔtɔ.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Se ke a bui tue ɔ, lɛɛ a ma gbo ngɛ klaate nya kaa nihi nɛ li nɔ́.

english_verse: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔɔ nihi ní kɛ guu nɔ́ nami mi; e ngɔɔ amanehlu kɛ bliɔ nihi a hɛngmɛ.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Mawu je mo kɛ je amanehlu mi, nɛ e ha mo tue mi jɔmi, kɛ niye ní kpakpa.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Se, jehanɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ o tue gblae bɔ nɛ sa mo.

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Ko de ke o na nɛ e su nyɔ mi, be mi nɛ nihi a hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Hyɛ saminya nɛ o ko ya nyɛɛ yayami se. A kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔ ba o nɔ, konɛ o ko pee yayami.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Na nɛ o le kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami; e kle pe tsɔɔli tsuo.

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Nihi ngɛ Mawu yi jee ngɛ e ní tsumi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔmɛ a he; mo hu mo je e yi koo.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ Mawu tsuɔ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ naa, se nɔ ko nɔ ko nui sisi.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Hyɛ, Mawu kle! Wa li lɛ kulaa; jeha nɛ e ye hu wa juɛmi sui he.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ bɔku haa si, kɛ bɔ nɛ hiɔwe siɔ ngɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ e hi he ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ le?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: E haa nɛ oslabai gbaa ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ tsuo, se wo ɔ sisi lɛɛ e ngɛ diblii mi.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mawu peeɔ kɛ hyɛɛ e ma a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: e haa mɛ niye ní babauu.

english_verse: I am frightened and tremble all over,
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha ye tsui po, nɛ e ngɛ fiae kplakplaakpla.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu tue! Mawu wo gbi, nyɛɛ bu tue; nyɛɛ bu hoo nɛ ngɛ pɛe kɛ je e nya mi ɔ tue.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: E haa oslabai gbaa ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e kpɛɔ ngɛ je ɔ kɔ nya he tsuaa he.

english_verse: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu wo gbi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e peeɔ ní nguahi nɛ wa juɛmi sui he.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nga mi lohwehi beɔ kɛ yaa a hi hehi.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Mumi nɛ jeɔ Mawu gugwɔ mi ɔ haa nɛ nyu babauu ɔ wluaa gaganii kaa tɛ.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Mawu haa bɔku ɔmɛ hyi ɔ kɛ nyu. Oslabai hii la pae ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a mi,

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: Hiob, bu tue! Da si dii nɛ o susu Mawu nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: Anɛ o le bɔ nɛ Mawu faa, nɛ e haa oslabai gbaa kɛ jeɔ bɔku mi lo?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Ke leneyi je kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ fiae, nɛ je mi ngmɛ dii ɔ, anɛ o le bɔ nɛ peeɔ loko moo o he mi dɔɔ la lo?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: Hiob, moo tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ wa ma de Mawu. Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa juɛmi mi wo diblii, nɛ nɔ́ ko be wa nya mi nɛ wa ma de.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: I be suɔe nɛ i kɛ Mawu nɛ tu munyu. Ke i pee ja a, ye hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, la nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam nɛ e hi hyɛmi, ejakaa kɔɔhiɔ muɔ bɔku ɔmɛ kɛ ho.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Je mi tsɔ hleii kaa sika tsu ngɛ omleyi je; Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ gbeye.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: Mawu Ope ɔ loo, wa be nyɛe maa su e he. E ngɛ he wami, e yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nihi tsuo yeɔ lɛ gbeye; ni nɛmɛ nɛ mɛɛ a buɔ a he ní leli ɔ, Mawu lɛɛ e bui mɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Hiob tu munyu kɛ je kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa mi. Yawɛ

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o kɛ munyu puu nɛ juɛmi be mi biɔ mi ye nile he sane?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Da si kaa nyumu, nɛ o ha mi sanehi nɛ ma bi mo ɔ a heto.

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: Benɛ i to je ɔ sisi ɔ, jije o ngɛ? Ke o le ɔ, ha mi heto.

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: Imi lɛ i po huzu kɛ wo wo ɔ he, nɛ i ma nya agbo kɛ e se dade.

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: I de wo ɔ ke, “Moo fia kɛ ba su hiɛ ɔ pɛ; koo be he! O we oslɔke ngua amɛ ɔ, he nɛ a ma ba ta ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: Hiob, o wami be ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, anɛ o fa hyɛ ke je nɛ na, nɛ je na lo?

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: Anɛ o fa hyɛ ke mɔtu la a nɛ nu je ɔ kɛ yaa si a ma huanya yiwutsotsɛmɛ kɛ je a laami hehi lo?

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Piani la nya wa tsɔ ha yayami peeli. E tsiɔ mɛ blɔ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a tsuɔ yi wu tso ní.

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Anɛ o le je ɔ blimi lo? Ke o le ɔ, ha mi heto.

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: Jije a guu kɛ yaa la hi he? Diblii hu jije e hi he ngɛ?

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Ee, o ma nyɛ; nɔkɔtɔma ji mo. Jamɛ a be ɔ, tse a fɔ mo!

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: Hehi nɛ i toɔ snoo, kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ngɛ ɔ, o ya lejɛ ɔmɛ hyɛ lo?

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to lejɛ ɔ ngɛ haomi, loo ta nɛ maa ba he.

english_verse: From where does lightning leap, or the east wind blow?
translation_verse: Jije a guu kɛ yaa he nɛ pu jeɔ kɛ baa, aloo he nɛ beleku kɔɔhiɔ fiaa kɛ jeɔ?

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ gba nyu dɔ kɛ ha hiɔmi nɛ nɛɛ piapiaapia a? Mɛnɔ lɛ je blɔ ha hiɔwe simi, kɛ oslabai gbami?

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ gbo, aloo zugba nɛ pee nga kplanaa a, mɛnɔ lɛ haa lɛ nyu loko nga puɛɔ ngɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Hiɔmi nɛ nɛɛ ɔ, e ngɛ tsɛ lo? Bɔ́ hu, mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ muklii mi nyu tɛ je? Hiɔwe bɔ́ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ lɛ?

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Nyu ɔ wluaa gaganii, nɛ e he waa kaa tɛ.

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ dodoehi blɔ ngɛ a be mi lo? O ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ Je kpaago kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ blɔ lo?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Anɛ o le mlaahi nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ hiɔwe lo? O ma nyɛ ma ha jamɛ a mlaa amɛ nɛ tsu ní ngɛ zugba a nɔ lo?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ ha nɔmlɔ adesa nile? Mɛnɔ kɛ juɛmi wo nɔmlɔ yi mi?

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: Anɛ o le be nɛ pu mi apletsihi fɔɔ lo? O na odabɔ nɛ ngɛ fɔe hyɛ lo?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: A bimɛ ɔmɛ waa saminya ngɛ nga a nɔ; a jeɔ a nyɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a kpale we kɛ bɛ hu.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: Anɛ pu mi okpɔngɔ maa suɔ nɛ e tsu ní ha mo lo? Anɛ e maa suɔ nɛ e hwɔ o lohwehi a ní yemi he lo?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa wo pu mi okpɔngɔ kpa nɛ e hu ha mo lo? Anɛ o ma nyɛ ma ha nɛ e gbla dade kpakplaa kɛ hu o ngmɔ mi lo?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Anɛ o maa ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ e he wami ɔ nɔ, konɛ e tsu o ní tsumi kpakpataa a ha mo lo?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Anɛ o heɔ yeɔ kaa e ma kpa ní ha mo, nɛ e kɛ o blɛfo ɔ ma ba wo blɛfo gba mi ha mo lo?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: Mo lɛ o ha pu mi klakumi e pɛli saminyayoo ɔ lo? Duguma tsɛli, kɛ e pɛli ɔmɛ nɛɛ, mo lɛ o ha lɛ?

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Duguma siɔ e hluihi ngɛ zugba, konɛ la nɛ jeɔ zu mi ɔ nɛ ha a he nɛ dɔ la.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: E hɛ jeɔ nɔ kaa nane ko ma nyɛ maa ywia mɛ, loo pu mi lohwe ko ma ba naa nɔ.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: E waa e bimɛ ɔmɛ yi mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ pi e bimɛ ji mɛ. E hia we lɛ tete kaa e gbo yaka dengme.

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Imi Mawu lɛ i pee lɛ kuasia, nɛ i ha nɛ nile bɔ lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Se ke e bɔni fo tumi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e muɔɔ okpɔngɔ kɛ e nɔ hilɔ.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: Mo Hiob lɛ o ha okpɔngɔ e he wami ɔ lo? Mo lɛ o ha lɛ bwɔmi gagaa ngɛ e kuɛ he ɔ lo?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Mo lɛ o haa nɛ e tuɔ kaa baalɛ ɔ lo? Mo lɛ o haa nɛ e fliɔ e gugwɔ mi wawɛɛ kɛ woɔ nɔ he gbeye ɔ lo?

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: E kɛ bua jɔmi siɔ si glɛi glɛi glɛi ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ e he wami tsuo gbɔɔ fo kɛ yaa ta.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: E li nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke fɔ̃; e tui klaate nya fo.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi hii a sibi a he hae ngɛ e se mi; akplɔ kɛ tsɛ̃i hii kpɛe nylamnylam.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: Mo lɛ o tsɔɔ kayo temi loko e gbɛɛ e pɛlihi a mi, nɛ e teɔ kɛ yaa leneyi je ɔ lo?

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: Hiob, o ke o kɛ Mawu Ope ɔ maa hua munyu he. Anɛ o ma ha yi, aloo o maa ya nɔ? Ha mi heto! Hiob

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: I tu munyu pe bɔ nɛ sa nɛ ma tu; i pa be nɔ́ ko dee hu.

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Hiob tu munyu ekohu kɛ je kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa mi. Yawɛ

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, da si kaa nyumu! Ma bi mo sane, nɛ o ha mi heto.

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o bu mi fɔ kaa i yi dami sane, konɛ moo lɛɛ o wo o he nguɔ kaa o nɔ́ da lo?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Anɛ o ngɛ he wami kaa imi Mawu ɔ lo? Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa wo gbi kaa imi lo?

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Hyɛ he woli! O mi mi nɛ fu mɛ nɛ o ba mɛ si.

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Moo pu mɛ tsuo ngɛ tabo zu mi, nɛ o fi a hɛ mi ngɛ gbeje.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Ke o pee ja a, lɛɛ imi hu ma je o yi, nɛ ma de ke o ma nyɛ ma he mo nitsɛ o yi wami.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: Hyɛ pa mi suɔ! I bɔ lɛ, kɛ mo tsuo. E kpeɔ nga kaa na.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: E hlemi ngɛ tlɔmɔɔ kaa seda tso. Panihi nɛ hɛɛ e fiɔ ɔmɛ ɔ a he wa saminya.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: E wuhi a he wa kaa akɔblee, nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa dade.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji ye nibɔ ní ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ pe mɛ tsuo. E bɔlɔ ɔ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ maa ye e nɔ.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: E naa niye ní ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; lejɛ ɔ lɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo ya fiɛɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: E buɔ si ngɛ mio tsohi a sisi, nɛ e laa e he ngɛ ngɔwuhi a kpɛti ngɛ pa mi.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Ke pa a he wa tete po, e yi gbeye. Ke Yordan pa a nitsɛ fia kɛ ba pue e hɛ mi pohu, e bui tete.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa nu lɛ kɛ gbowe lo? Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa wo e gugwɔ mi ga lo?

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: Anɛ o ma nyɛ ma sá nyaka kɛ gbowe lo? Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ kpa kɛ fi e lilɛ kɛ muɔ si lo?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ tangme kɛ wo e gugwɔ mi lo? Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ gbowe kɛ wo e tsitsa mi lo?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: Anɛ e kɛ mo maa so kaa e ma sɔmɔ mo daa lo?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Anɛ o kɛ lɛ ma fiɛ kaa a kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ fiɛɔ, aloo o maa fi lɛ ha o mawayi ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ fiɛ lo?

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Katsɛ ko katsɛ ko be nɛ ma nyɛ maa wo e hɛ mi la. Ke ja a, lɛɛ mɛnɔ lɛ ma nyɛ maa da imi ye hɛ mi?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ e kɛ nyaka ya kpe kunɔ hyɛ nɛ e he je mi? Dɛbi! Je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be!

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: E nya kɛ e mi lunguhi gbeyegbeye ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma bli?

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Ke e tsile kɛkɛ la kpɛ; e hɛngmɛhi ngɛ hleii kaa mɔtu pu la.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: La hii tsoe ngɛ e nya mi, nɛ la lilɛhi tuɔ kɛ jeɔ mi pueɔ si.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: La su ku jeɔ e gugwɔ puɔhi a mi kaa lamuɔ nɛ jeɔ buɛ, loo kutu nɛ ngɛ fiae mi.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: E kuɛ ngɛ kpakpataa; ke o kɛ lɛ kpe ɔ, ja sawale nu mo.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: E he womi he wa kpɛkpɛtɛɛ; e be bɔdɔbɔdɔ, nɛ e be tsuãã hulɔ.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Ke e wó e he nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, katsɛmɛ tete po yeɔ gbeye; sawale nuɔ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Dade ngɛ kaa nga ha lɛ; akɔblee hu ngɛ kaa tso nɛ sa kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ko be nyɛe maa wo lɛ fo; amlami tɛ ngɛ kaa nga ha lɛ.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Tsokpoti ngɛ kaa nga ha lɛ, nɛ ke akplɔ ngɛ pɛe kɛ ma a, e muɔɔ.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: Totohi nɛ ngɛ e mi si ɔ ngɛ kaa buɛ kokoehi nɛ a nya ba. E ngmlãã si ngɛ mɔsɔ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ blɛfo lɛ e ngɛ gblɛe.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: E haa nɛ wo fiaa kaa nyu ngɛ buɛ mi, nɛ e fiaa hwɔli kaa nu ngɛ tɔ mi.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: E bui lohwe ko lohwe ko; lohwe nɛ kle kaa mɛni po, e bui. Lohwehi nɛ a he ngɛ gbeye tsuo a matsɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i le kaa he walɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ji mo; o nyɛɔ nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: O bi ke kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ i biɔ sane nɛ kɔɔ mo o nile he, be mi nɛ imi lɛɛ i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ɔ? I tu níhi nɛ i nui sisi a he munyu; nyakpɛ níhi nɛ ye juɛmi sui a he.

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, níhi nɛ nihi de mi ngɛ o he kɛkɛ lɛ i le, se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ i na mo paa kɛ imi nitsɛ ye hɛngmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yawɛ kɛ Hiob tu munyu ta a, Yawɛ de Elifaz, Teman no ɔ ke, “Ye mi mi fu o kɛ o huɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo; ejakaa nyɛ tu we ye he anɔkuale munyu kaa bɔ nɛ ye tsɔlɔ Hiob pee ɔ.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku kpaago, kɛ agbosu kpaago kɛ ya ye tsɔlɔ Hiob ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya sã sami bɔ ha nyɛ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Hiob maa fa kue ha nyɛ. Ma bu e kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ i be nyɛ tue gblae bɔ nɛ sa nyɛ kaa nyɛ je kuasia. Ee, nyɛ tu we ye he anɔkuale munyu kaa bɔ nɛ ye tsɔlɔ Hiob pee ɔ.”

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, benɛ Hiob fa kue ha Yawɛ ngɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ a he se ɔ, Yawɛ wo lɛ ní ekohu. Níhi tsuo nɛ Hiob hi sa a, Yawɛ bɔ he totoe enyɔɔnyɔ kɛ ha lɛ.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Hiob nyɛminyumuhi, e nyɛmiyihi, kɛ nihi nɛ le lɛ sa a tsuo ba slaa lɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba ye ní ngɛ e we ɔ mi. A ye lɛ kɔmɔ nɛ a jɔɔ e bua ngɛ haomihi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ba e nɔ ɔ a he. A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ke lɛ sika, kɛ sika tsu ga.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ e kpale fɔ binyumuhi kpaago kɛ biyihi etɛ.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a nɛ yihi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu kaa Hiob biyi ɔmɛ. A tsɛ ɔ ha mɛ weto ní kaa bɔ nɛ e ha a nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: loko e gbo. Jamɛ a be ɔ, e bwɔ kotokoto.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ bui nimli yayamihi a ga womi tue, nɔ nɛ kɛ yayami peeli bɔɛ, nɛ e hí he fɛu yeli a hi he;

english_verse: ) The Way to Happiness
translation_verse: ) Bua jɔmi kpakpa

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: se mohu e bua jɔɔ Yawɛ mlaa a he, nɛ e susuɔ he nyɔ kɛ pia.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: E ngɛ kaa tso nɛ a du ngɛ pa tue, nɛ woɔ yiblii ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. E bahi gbli we gblegbleegble. E yeɔ manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Se yayami peeli lɛɛ pi ja nɛ a ngɛ; mɛɛ a ngɛ kaa jakati nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ kɛ yaa.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a maa gbla yayami peeli a tue, nɛ a kɛ mɛ be dali futue.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ buu dali a he, se yayami peeli lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Mɛni ba nɛ je ma amɛ ngɛ basabasa pee? Mɛni he je lɛ a ngɛ soe yaka gu kikɛ nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee kake. Nɔ yeli ɔmɛ so ngɔ wo Yawɛ, kɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ e hla a a he.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: A ke, “Nyɛ ha wa kpɔ wa he kɛ je a dɛ mi nɛ waa ye wa he.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ ngɛ mɛ muɔe. Ee, Yawɛ ngɛ a he fɛu yee.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ kɛ abofu ma kple a nɔ. E hɛ maa dɔ;

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ɔ, ma sɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ nu. Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Ye bi ji mo; mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fɔ mo.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Bi mi, nɛ ma ha mo je ma amɛ tsuo; zugba a tsuo ma ba pee o weto ní.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: O kɛ dade tso maa gbla a tue. O maa ywia mɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ kaa a ywiaa buɛ?’ ”

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Nyɛ sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ gbeye yemi.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli, nɛ nyɛ kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi. Ke pi jã a, e mi mi ma fu nyɛ si kake too, nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata. Nihi tsuo nɛ ba saa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ɔ ma na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: Yawɛ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye he nyɛli hiɛ ha! Hyɛ kaa nihi babauu te si kɛ wo mi!

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ji, “Oo, Mawu be e he piɛe fɛɛ!”

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Se mo Yawɛ, o ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃i nɛ buɔ ye he daa. O woɔ mi mumi mi he wami, nɛ o woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Ke i kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ ɔ, e heɔ nɔ ngɛ e yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: I hwɔɔ si nɛ i hwɔɔ mahe, nɛ i teɔ si ekohu, ejakaa Yawɛ buɔ ye he.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Ke nimli akpeakpe abɔ ba sa ye yi kɛ kpe po, i yi mɛ gbeye.

english_verse: because you protect and bless your people.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo ji wa yi wami helɔ; moo gbaa o ma a koo!

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Ye Mawu nɛ faa ye he, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue koo! Be ko nɛ ye yi fi ɔ, mo lɛ o ba je mi. Naa mi mɔbɔ koo, nɛ o bu ye pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Yawɛ hla nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da kɛ ha e he; nɛ ke i tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e nuɔ.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ mi mi fu ɔ, nyɛ ko pee yayami. Ke nyɛ hwɔɔ si ɔ, nyɛɛ pee dii, nɛ nyɛɛ ya nyɛ yi mi.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ sa ha Yawɛ; nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Nihi babauu biɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ po maa dloo wɔ nɔ́ ko? Yawɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ koo!”

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ma hwɔ si nɛ ma hwɔ mahe ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. Ejakaa mo, Yawɛ pɛ lɛ o haa nɛ ye he mi jɔɔ mi.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ huu nɛ i ngɛ faeɔ, o pee he nɔ́ ko ha mi.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Ye matsɛ kɛ ye Mawu! I ngɛ mo tsɛe! Bu mi tue koo!

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mɔtu ɔ, o nuɔ ye gbi. Ee, mɔtu ɔ, i faa kue kɛ haa mo, nɛ i mlɛɔ, konɛ o he nɔ.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi Mawu nɛ náa nɔ́ yayami he tsui ji mo; yayami kɛ mo hí si.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: He nɔ woli be nyɛe maa ba o hɛ mi; o sume nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Mo Yawɛ, o kpataa lakpatsɛmɛ a hɛ mi. Muɔ si pueli, kɛ nɔ sisili lɛɛ o hiee mɛ kulaa.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ, o mɔbɔ nami, kɛ o dloomi ɔ he je ɔ, ma nyɛ ma ba o we klɔuklɔu ɔ; ma ja mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ gbeye yemi.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, piɛ ye he, konɛ ma pee nɔ nɛ da. Tsɔɔ mi o blɔ ɔ saminya nɛ ma nyɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tu we anɔkuale; yayami hyi a tsui mi tɔ. A tuɔ munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ, se lɛ tsuo kɛ gbenɔ ba a.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Se nihi tsuo nɛ ba saa we ngɛ o ngɔ ɔ, ha nɛ a nya, nɛ a la kɛ bua jɔmi daa. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ mo ɔ, buu a he, konɛ a na bua jɔmi ngɛ o mi.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o gbaa nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ o kɛ o suɔmi ɔ buu a he kaa tsɛ̃i.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Yawɛ, koo ngɔ abofu kɛ ka ye hɛ mi; koo ngɔ mi mi la kɛ gbla ye tue.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Yawɛ naa mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa ye he wami ta. Yawɛ, tsa mi koo, ejakaa i be he wami,

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: nɛ imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo i hao. Yawɛ, mɛni be o maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si loko o ma ba he mi?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ba he ye yi wami koo! Naa mi mɔbɔ nɛ o kpɔ mi, ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko kaii we mo ngɛ gbeje; mɛnɔ lɛ ma je o yi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu ha nɛ i gbɔjɔ; daa nyɔ mi ɔ, ye sa pɔɔ kɛ vo nyu sɔuu; daa nyɔ mi ɔ, i foɔ ya kɛ pɔɔ ye sɔne.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ haoɔ mi. Kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu puɛ ye hɛngmɛ, nɛ i hyɛ we nɔ́ kpakpa ko hu.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yayami peeli, nyɛɛ je ye nɔ kɛ ya se, ejakaa Yawɛ nu ye ya fomi ɔ.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nu ye kue fami ɔ; Yawɛ maa pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Ha nɛ a kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ho esɔ!

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ye Mawu! I ba sa we ngɛ o ngɔ. Mo kpɔ mi kɛ je nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ a dɛ mi, nɛ o he ye yi wami.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Ke pi ja a, a maa gbla mi kɛ ya he nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mi. Lejɛ ɔ lɛ a ma ya tsɔtslɔɔ mi ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ jata peeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ye Mawu! Ke i pee nɔ ko yayami, aloo i wa ye he nyɛlɔ yi mi yaka gu, ke i pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a nyɛɛ ye se nɛ a nu mi. Ha nɛ a fia mi nɔ nɛ a gbe mi, nɛ a si mi ngɛ zugba.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ a bua je ma amɛ tsuo a nya kɛ bɔle mo, nɛ o je hiɔwe kɛ ye a nɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo ji je ɔ tsuo kojolɔ. Moo ye ye sane ha mi; o le kaa i pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ yeɔ dami sane ji mo; o le nimli a tsui mi, kɛ a juɛmi mi. Ha nɛ nimli yayamihi nɛ jɔɔ yayami peemi, konɛ nimli kpakpahi lɛɛ o pee mɛ bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Mawu ji ye he bulɔ. Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e heɔ a yi wami.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Mawu ji kojolɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane; daa nɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu yayami peeli.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Ke a tsakee we a tsui ɔ, Mawu maa duɔ e klaate ɔ nya. E pee e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ klaalo momo,

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Ke yiwutsotsɛ ngɛ nɔ́ yayami susue ɔ, e hii nɔ́ ɔ plɛe ngɛ e yi mi kpamisa kaa bɔ nɛ bimwɔyo hii plɛe ngɛ yohɔyo mi mi ɔ. Nyagbe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ kpo ji lakpa.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: E tsuaa muɔ kɛ haa ni kpahi; se muɔ ɔ nɛ e tsua a, lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e maa nɔ mi.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: E musu maa tloo lɛ nitsɛ; lɛ nitsɛ e yayami ɔ maa ye lɛ awi.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Ma na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e yeɔ dami sane. Ma la kɛ je Yawɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ yi.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ! Hyɛ kaa o biɛ pɛɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ a woɔ o hɛ mi nyami ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: O haa jokuɛwi, kɛ bimwɔwi he wami nɛ a laa kɛ jeɔ o yi. O he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa a nya, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Ke i susu níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe a he, nyɔhiɔ kɛ dodoehi, ke i hyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o kɛ o nine pee ɔ,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: i biɔ ke, “Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ adesa, nɛ o susuɔ e he? Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ bi, nɛ o hyɛɛ e nɔ?”

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Nɛ́ o bɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ lɛ mo, Mawu ɔ o ngɔ kɛ pe lɛ. Se o wo e hɛ mi nyami babauu.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: O pee lɛ níhi tsuo nɛ o bɔ ɔ a nɔ yelɔ. O ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo e dɛ mi:

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: tohi, nahi, pu mi lohwehi,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, lohi, kɛ nibɔ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo mi.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ! Hyɛ kaa o biɛ pɛɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ma na mo si kɛ ye tsui tsuo; ma sɛɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Mawu Ope, o he ɔ, ma la kɛ bua jɔmi; ma la kɛ je o yi.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Benɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpale a se ɔ, a nɔɔ si nɛ a gbo ngɛ o hɛ mi.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o kojoɔ ngɛ dami kɛ anɔkuale nya; o ye ye sane ɔ ha mi, nɛ o wo mi nguɔ.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: O ka je ma amɛ a hɛ mi. O kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi, nɛ a biɛ laa pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata; a ma amɛ hu a hɛ mi kpata, nɛ nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ ma kai mɛ hu.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ daa; e hii si ngɛ e kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kɛ anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane yemi maa kojo je ɔ, kɛ e mi nimli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji wesa he kɛ ha nihi nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi. Haomi be mi ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ a naa he jɔmi ngɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nihi nɛ le mo ɔ, a ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ. Ejakaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ hla o se blɔ ɔ, mo Yawɛ, o kua we mɛ.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi; Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ Zion ɔ, nyɛ je e yi. Nyɛɛ sɛɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ kɛ ha je ma amɛ tsuo.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Mawu kaiɔ nɔ́ nali, nɛ e yeɔ a he lue. Ke nɔ́ nali fa kue ha Mawu ɔ, e nuɔ; e hɛ ji a nɔ.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo nɛ o jeɔ mi kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ dɛ mi. Hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye he nyɛli ngɛ mi haoe ha nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ,

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: konɛ ma na bua jɔmi nɛ ma je o yi ngɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; nɛ ma nya kɛ tsɔɔ kaa o he ye yi wami.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Muɔ ɔ nɛ je ma amɛ tsua a, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ mi. Klama a nɛ a tsɔ kɛ laa a, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nane ya du lɛ.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Yawɛ je e he kpo; e ye dami sane, nɛ yayami peeli a nane ya du klama a nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Nimli yayamihi, kɛ mahi tsuo nɛ a hɛ je Mawu nɔ ɔ, a nyagbe ji gbenɔ.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi daa nɛ hɛ maa je dɛgutsɛmɛ a nɔ; ohiatsɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi be yaka pee.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, tee si; ko ha nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ ye o nɔ! Ha nɛ a kojo je ma amɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wo je ma amɛ a he gbeye, konɛ a le kaa nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mɛni hɛ mo kɛ ya se tsitsaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je o ya laa o he ngɛ wa haomi be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Yayami peeli ngɛ a he nɔ woe, nɛ a ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi wae. Ha nɛ ga yayamihi nɛ a to ɔ nɛ kpa bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ níhi nɛ e tsui suɔ a nɔ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ hɛ kɔɔ nɔ́ nɔ ɔ, e gbiɛɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e kuaa lɛ.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ ɔ he nɔ womi ha we nɛ e hlaa Mawu se blɔ. E susumi tsuo ji “Mawu ko be.”

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ yeɔ manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi. E nɛ kaa Mawu tue gblami ko ngɛ ha lɛ. E he nyɛli lɛɛ, pe e yeɔ a he fɛu.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: E deɔ ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi pee; haomi ko be ye nɔ bae gblegbleegble.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Munyuhi nɛ jeɔ e nya ji gbiɛmi kɛ sisimi, kɛ níhi nɛ woɔ nɔ susuma he gbeye. E he sɔɔ kɛ tuɔ yakayaka munyuhi, kɛ munyuhi nɛ kɛ nɔ woɔ haomi mi.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: E buɔ si ngɛ e laami he ɔ kaa jata ngɛ e muɔ mi. E woɔ ka nɛ e nuu nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ. Ke e nine su a nɔ kɛkɛ e gbla mɛ kɛ ho.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: E kɛ e he wami tsuo fiaa nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔɔ si.

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu, gbla yayami peeli a tue, nɛ o hɛ ko je nɔ́ nali a nɔ.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Moo ku yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli a he wami nya, nɛ o gbla a tue kɛ yaa si yayami peemi se maa po.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji matsɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene. Je ma amɛ gbo ta e zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, hiami níhi nɛ nɔ́ nali kɛ ba fɔ o hɛ mi ɔ, o le. Moo pee a hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mɛ, konɛ a ná he wami he.

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: Moo ye awusahi, kɛ nɔ́ nali a sane ha mɛ, konɛ nɔmlɔ adesa kó wo a he gbeye hu.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: I ba sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ. Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ deɔ mi ke, “Tee kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, yayami peeli dɔ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ; a pee a kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ klaalo nɛ́ a ma tsɛ̃ dali ngɛ diblii mi.

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ e we klɔuklɔu ɔ; e matsɛ sɛ ɔ, hiɔwe lɛ e ngɛ. E hɛngmɛ ngɛ nimli adesahi hyɛe ngɛ he tsuaa he; e le níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kaa dali. Se yayami peeli, kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e sume mɛ kulaa.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma ha la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege maa je hiɔwe ba pue yayami peeli a nɔ; nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ mi dɔ la maa fia kɛ wo mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ; e suɔ kaa a pee níhi nɛ da. Dali maa na e hɛ mi.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo piɛ wa he, ejakaa nɔmlɔ kpakpa be hu; anɔkualetsɛmɛ ta zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ fĩaa a, mo kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ ke, “Akɛnɛ a ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi wae, nɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe he je ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ ma te si, nɛ ma ha mɛ he jɔmi nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Yawɛ siwo ɔmɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu. A ngɛ kaa sika hiɔ nɛ a tsu he si kpaago ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: Yawɛ, kɛ yaa si mɛni be nɛ o hɛ maa je ye nɔ? Kɛ yaa neneene lo? Mɛni be o maa laa mi kɛ yaa si?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Mɛni be ma na nɔ́ kɛ yaa si? Aywilɛho ma hyi ye tsui mi daa ligbi kɛ yaa si mɛni be? Ye he nyɛli ma ná ye he blɔ daa nɛ kɛ yaa si mɛni be?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ye Mawu! Moo hyɛ mi, nɛ o ha mi heto. Ha mi nɔmlɔ tso he wami, konɛ ma ko gbo.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Ke pi ja a, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma de ke, “Wa ye e nɔ.” A ma nya kaa a nine su ye nɔ.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Ma la kɛ je mo Yawɛ o yi, ejakaa o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Kuasiahi a susumi ji, “Mawu ko be.” Mɛ tsuo a puɛ; ní yayamihi sɔuu lɛ a peeɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hyɛɛ nimli adesahi ngɛ zugba kɛ jeɔ hiɔwe. E hyɛɛ kaa e maa na nɔ ko nɛ le nɔ́, nɛ hlaa lɛ Mawu ɔ se blɔ lo.

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Sawale nɛ nya wa maa nu mɛ; ejakaa nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu kɛ mɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Ke yayami peeli ha nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a yi mi tomi pee basaa a, a ma ya sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ̃.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ maa je Zion ba he Israel yi wami? Yawɛ ma a nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ɔ, ke lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ kpale mɛ kɛ ba ekohu ɔ, Israel ma na bua jɔmi, nɛ Yakob ma nya.

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mɛnɔ maa hi o bo tsu ɔ mi? O yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛnɔ maa hi lejɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ piami ko be e he, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da. Nɔ nɛ tuɔ anɔkuale sisiisi,

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: nɛ e yi nɔ he sieku. Nɔ nɛ tu we nɔ he munyu, nɛ e pee we e nyɛmi yayami.

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ yayami peeli, nɛ e woɔ nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ a hɛ mi nyami. Nɔ nɛ ke e ka kita, nɛ e kpale we e nya se, ke ji kaa lɔ ɔ maa pee haomi ha lɛ po.

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ke e pa sika ha nihi ɔ, e he we hekpa. Nɔ nɛ he we nyɔ mi ní nɛ e kɛ ye odase ngɔ si nihi nɛ yi fɔ. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e he sae.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: Mawu, moo bu ye he, ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: I de Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, ye Nyɔmtsɛ ji mo; o se ɔ, i pa be nɔ́ kpakpa ko hu.”

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a he sɔɔ kɛ ya nyɛɛɔ mawu kpahi a se ɔ, a haomi maa hiɛ babauu. I be mɛ futue kɛ pee a tɛlimi kusumi ɔmɛ; i be a biɛ ta woe tete.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: O ke mi ní kpakpahi babauu; niinɛ, i ngɛ weto ní kpakpahi.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Ma je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa e ha mi juɛmi. Nyɔ mi po, ye he nile kɛ mi tuɔ munyu.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: I susuɔ Yawɛ he daa. Nɛ́ Yawɛ ngɛ ye kasa nya nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi pee.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo, i na bua jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o maa bu ye he, nɛ gbenɔ he wami be ye he blɔ nae. Nɔ nɛ o suɔ lɛ ɔ, o be e he ngmɛɛe nɛ e hɛ mi nɛ kpata.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: O maa tsɔɔ mi blɔ ɔ nɛ yaa wami mi ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ o hɛ mi ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi nitsɛnitsɛ, bua jɔmi nɛ se be poe kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo piɛ ye he koo! Hyɛ kaa i yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ i sisi we nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu kue nɛ i ngɛ fae kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ ɔ tue.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Mo nɛ́ o yeɔ dami sane, moo wo mi nguɔ koo!

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Ke o hyɛ ye tsui mi, ke o ba slaa mi nyɔ mi nɛ o ka mi ɔ, o be yayami ko nae ngɛ ye he. Ye munyu peeɔ anɔkuale; nɔ́ ko piɛ we he.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ i kɛ basabasa peeli bɔɛ.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Moo baa ye yi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ baa lɛ nitsɛ e hɛngmɛ yi ɔ. Ngɔɔ mi kɛ laa ngɛ o pɛli hɔ̃ ɔ sisi,

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Mɔbɔ nami ko be a mi; he nɔ womi munyuhi lɛ jeɔ a nya.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ a sa ye yi; a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ ká mi, konɛ a tsɛ̃ mi kɛ fɔ si.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: A ngɛ kaa jatahi nɛ ya wo mi ká; a ngɛ mlɛe nɛ a tsɔtslɔɔ mi.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, yaa nɛ o kɛ mɛ ya kpe nɛ o ye a nɔ. Ngɔɔ o klaate ɔ kɛ kpɔ mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛi.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Jé mi kɛ je nihi nɛ ná je nɛ ɔ mi níhi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ a dɛ mi. Ngɔɔ haomihi nɛ o ngɔ to ha mɛ ɔ kɛ gbla a tue. Ha nɛ a bimɛ ba na haomi ɔ bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ eko nɛ piɛ ha a bibimɛ.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ ma na o hɛ mi, ejakaa i pee we yayami ko. Nɛ ke ye hɛ tsɛ ɔ, ma ná bua jɔmi babauu kaa i na mo hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i suɔ mo! Mo ji ye yi baalɔ.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ heɔ ye yi wami; ye tɛ sa, kɛ ye mɔ nguaa. Lɛ ji ye Mawu, kɛ ye wesa he. Yawɛ ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃i kɛ ha mi; e buɔ ye he, nɛ e haa nɛ i yeɔ ye he.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Ma tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e ma je mi kɛ maa je ye he nyɛli a dɛ mi. A je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Gbenɔ oslaa bɔle mi kɛ kpe; niinɛ, nimli yayamihi babauu bɔle mi kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Gbeje kpa amɛ fi mi, nɛ gbenɔ tsɔ mi klama.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Ngɛ ye haomi be ɔ mi ɔ, i tsɛ Yawɛ. I tsɛ ye Mawu, nɛ i de lɛ ke e piɛ ye he. E nu ye gbi ngɛ e we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ e bu ye kue fami ɔ tue.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ zugba mimiɛ, nɛ yo ɔmɛ a sisi tomi ɔmɛ hɛ mɛ kɛ je a blɔ hehi, nɛ a mimiɛ, ejakaa Yawɛ mi mi fu.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: La su ku hia kɛ je e gugwɔ puɔhi a mi; la nɛ ngɛ tsoe je e nya mi, nɛ hã nɛ tsɛ̃ je e mi.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ hiɔwe nya ba si, nɛ e kple si; nɛ diblii kpii ngɛ e nane sisi.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: E hi kerub nɔ kɛ te; e he sɔ kɛ nyɛɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ ba.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: E ngɔ diblii kɛ ha e he kaa bo, nɛ bɔku kpii kɛ e mi nyu gbagbaagba ha e yi nɔ.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Gbiɛ ngo ngu, kɛ la je oslabai mi ngɛ e hɛ mi kɛ gblee bɔku kpii ɔ mi kɛ be.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yawɛ ha hiɔwe si; Hiɔwe No ɔ wo gbi; gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ, nɛ oslabai gba.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, benɛ o ké o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a yi, nɛ o kɛ abofu wo gbi ɔ, nyu dɔ ɔmɛ je kpo, nɛ je ɔ sisi tomi ɔmɛ fɔɔ si paa.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Yawɛ sɔ́le e nine kɛ je hiɔwe; e nu mi, nɛ e gbla mi kɛ je nyu babauu ɔ mi.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: A ba tua mi ngɛ ye haomi ligbi ɔ nɔ, se Yawɛ hede ha mi.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: E ngɔ mi kɛ ba he nɛ he jɔmi ngɛ. E he ye yi wami, ejakaa e suɔ mi.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Yawɛ wo mi hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa, ejakaa i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da. Yawɛ gbaa mi, ejakaa ye he tsɔ.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: I ye Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ i pee we yayami ko kɛ puɛ i kɛ ye Mawu ɔ wa kpɛti.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: I ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ; i tɔ̃ we ekoeko.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Yayami ko yayami ko be ye he; i yi fɔ ngɛ nɔ́ ko mi.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ gbaa mi; ejakaa ye he tsɔ, nɛ i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, o jeɔ o he si kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa o he tsɔ. Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ o ha we mɛ hɛ mi kulaa.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mo Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ, mo lɛ o haa mi la. Mo lɛ o fieɔ diblii kɛ jeɔ ye he.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ ɔ loo! E ní peemi níhi hi kɛ pi si. Ke e wo si ɔ, e baa mi. Nihi tsuo nɛ ya saa we ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ, e buu a he.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Se mɛnɔ ji Mawu ngɛ Yawɛ se? Mɛnɔ ji tɛ sa? Pi wa Mawu ɔ lo?

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji Mawu nɛ haa mi he wami; lɛ nɛ haa ye blɔ daa mi.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ haa nɛ ye nane nya sɔɔ kaa odabɔ nane nya. E ngɔ mi ngɔ to yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: E tsɔɔ mi ta hwumi níhi a he ní tsumi; akɔblee kɛ̃ɛ̃ po ma nyɛ ma tsɛ̃.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o bu ye he, nɛ o he ye yi wami; o hyɛ ye nɔ saminya, nɛ i pee nɔmlɔ. O pɛtɛ ye he wawɛɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ ha nɛ i ye ye he.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: O ha we nɛ ye he nyɛli a nine nɛ su ye nɔ; i nɔɛ si hyɛ gblegbleegble.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: I fia mɛ ní, nɛ a nɔɔ si ngɛ ye nane nya; a be nyɛe maa te si hu.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Mo lɛ o ha mi he wami nɛ i kɛ hwu ta; mo lɛ o ha nɛ i ye ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: A kpa ngmlaa kaa nɔ ko ma ba piɛ a he lo, se nɔ ko ji ngmlaa ha mɛ. A tsɛ Yawɛ, se e pui a nya mi.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: I wɛɛ mɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ kaa bunyuku nɛ kɔɔhiɔ sɛ mi. I naa a nɔ kaa blɔ nɔ mɔsɔ.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: O je mi kɛ je atuã tsɔli a dɛ mi, nɛ o pee mi je ma amɛ a nyatsɛ. Ma nɛ i li mɛ po ma ba sɔmɔ mi.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Nibwɔ ɔmɛ a tsui maa po, nɛ a kɛ he domi maa je a mɔ nguangua amɛ a mi kɛ ba.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hɛ ngɛ! A je ye he bulɔ ɔ yi! Mawu ɔ nɛ heɔ ye yi wami ɔ, a wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ ɔ lɛ gbla ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue; lɛ nɛ ngɔ je ma amɛ kɛ wo ye sisi,

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma je o yi ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi; ma la kɛ je mo, Yawɛ o yi.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Mawu haa nɛ David yeɔ kunimi daa. Matsɛ ɔ nɛ lɛ, Mawu ɔ pɔ nu ɔ, e naa lɛ mɔbɔ daa; lɛ, kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ e nina tsuo.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Mawu nibɔ níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ngɛ e yi jee, nɛ a ngɛ e nine nya ní tsumi kpo jee.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Daa ligbi ɔ, mɔtu jio, gbɔkuɛ jio, nibɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Mawu he ní sɛɛe.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Munyu ko ji a nya a, nɔ ko nɔ ko nui a gbi hulɔ.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nuɔ a he ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo; a munyu ɔ pɛɛ kɛ yaa je mi nyagbe he tɔɔ. Mawu pee sihi he ha pu ngɛ hiɔwe.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Yawɛ mlaa a hi kɛ pi si; e haa nɔ naa he wami he. Yawɛ mlaa a, anɔkuale sɔuu, e haa nɛ kuasia leɔ ní.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Yawɛ mlaa amɛ da pɛpɛɛpɛ; nihi nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ, a naa bua jɔmi. Yawɛ mlaa a he tsɔ; e haa nɛ nɔ nuɔ níhi a sisi.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbeye yemi ɔ hi; e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene. Ke Yawɛ kojo ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu; niinɛ, e yeɔ dami sane be tsuaa be.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: A he ngɛ akɔnɔ pe sika tsu ngmingmiingmi; a ngɔɔ pe hwo, hwo nɛ je hwo gbaku mi pue si.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Ke i ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, imi o tsɔlɔ ɔ, i naa nile, kɛ se nami kpahi babauu.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa na lɛ nitsɛ e tɔmihi? Yawɛ, tɔmihi nɛ i pee ngɛ laami mi ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ pa mi!

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo bu ye he, nɛ ma ko jé ye hɛ mi paa kɛ pee yayami; ko ha nɛ jamɛ a yayami ɔmɛ nɛ a ye ye nɔ. Ja jã loko ye he ma tsɔ kɛ pi si, nɛ i be ye he ngɔe kɛ wo yayami nguahi a mi.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ye wesa he, kɛ ye kpɔlɔ! Ha nɛ ye nya mi munyu, kɛ ye tsui mi susumi nɛ sa o hɛ mi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Ke o ngɛ haomi mi, nɛ o tsɛ Yawɛ ɔ, Yawɛ nɛ bu mo tue. Yakob Mawu ɔ nɛ bu o he.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: É je e we klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ e piɛ o he; é wo mo he wami kɛ je Zion yo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma kai o nike ní ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ e ma he o sami bɔ ɔmɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: E ma ha mo níhi nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ, nɛ níhi tsuo nɛ o to ke o maa pee ɔ maa ba mi.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Ke o ye kunimi ɔ, wa ma hwɔ lele. Wa ma wo aflangaa nɔ ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa wa bua jɔ. Yawɛ nɛ ha mo níhi tsuo nɛ o fa a he kue ɔ.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ i le kaa Yawɛ ma he nɔ nɛ e pɔ lɛ nu ɔ yi wami. E maa bu lɛ tue kɛ maa je e hiɔwe klɔuklɔu ɔ; e maa piɛ e he kɛ ye kunimi nguanguahi.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ a ma tɛ nɔ, nɛ a maa nɔɔ si, se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa te kɛ da si kɛ he wami.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo he matsɛ ɔ yi wami; ke wa tsɛ mo ɔ, bu wɔ tue.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, matsɛ ɔ bua jɔ e he, ejakaa o ha lɛ he wami. Matsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyae, ejakaa o ha nɛ e ye kunimi.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: O ha lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ; nɔ́ nɛ e bi mo ɔ hu, o kua we.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: O gbaa lɛ kɛ ní kpakpahi babauu; o fi lɛ jlasi nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: E bi mo ke o ha nɛ e wami se nɛ kɛ, nɛ o kplɛɛ nɔ ha lɛ. O ha lɛ be babauu nitsɛ nɛ nyagbe be he.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: O piɛ e he, nɛ e hɛ mi ba nyami; o ha nɛ e ná biɛ, kɛ agboje.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, o gbaa lɛ saminya kɛ yaa neneene; o haa nɛ e naa bua jɔmi ngɛ o hɛ mi.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Matsɛ, o nine maa su o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. Nihi tsuo nɛ sume mo ɔ, o nine maa su a nɔ.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: A bimɛ, loo a nina ko he be mi jee; matsɛ ɔ ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: E ma ka mɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma tsɛ̃ mɛ, nɛ a maa kpale a se kɛ fo.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa ngɛ o yi jee ngɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ he. Wa ma la kɛ je o yi, ejakaa o he wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ!

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Ye Mawu, ye Mawu, mɛni he je o kua mi? Mɛni he je i ngɛ awe nyae nɛ o daa si ngɛ se, nɛ o bɛ nɛ o ba je ngmlaa ha mi ɔ?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: Ye Mawu, ke i tsɛ mo piani ɔ, o he we mi nɔ. Ke i tsɛ mo nyɔ mi hu, ja nɔuu. Mɛni he je?

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, mo ji Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ. Mo, o yi lɛ Israel jeɔ.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: A fa kue ha mo, nɛ o he a yi wami. A ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ, nɛ a pia we a he kaa a pee ja.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ, pi nɔmlɔ ji mi hu; i ngɛ kaa gɔgɔ. Nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ hiee mi, nɛ a bɔɔ mi ahlua.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na mi ɔ, e yeɔ ye he fɛu. A plɛɔ a nya, nɛ a mimiɛɔ a yi.

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: A deɔ ke, “Tse e ke e ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ? Yawɛ nɛ he e yi wami koo? Ke Yawɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ, mɛni he je e ba píɛ we e he?”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Se, mo lɛ o je mi kɛ je maa muklii mi; nɛ o hyɛ ye nɔ kɛ je be mi nɛ i ngɛ nyɔ nya tɔɔ.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Kɛ je be mi nɛ maa fɔ mi tɔɔ lɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ. Mo nɔ kake too ji ye Mawu.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Koo je ye he; ejakaa i miɔ nɛ ma sɛ haomi mi, nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mi.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: He nyɛli kpanakuhi babauu bɔle mi kɛ kpe; a he ngɛ gbeye kaa na kuhi nɛ je Bashan zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: A gbɛɔ a nya mi hatoo kɛ woɔ mi kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huãe nɛ e hɛ mi pee klamaklama.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Ye he wami ta kaa nyu nɛ kpa pue si. Ye wuhi je a blɔ hehi, nɛ ye tsui pee kaa hwo gbaku nɛ sile.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ye kuɔ si gbli kaa ngɛyu kokoe mi, nɛ ye lilɛ mɛtɛ ye nya mi. O si mi ngɛ tabo zu mi kaa nɔ nɛ gbo.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Nimli yayamihi ba bɔle mi kɛ kpe kaa gbehi, nɛ a ngɛ ye nine kɛ ye nane tsɔtslɔɔe.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Ye wuhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ je kpo. Nimli yayami ɔmɛ muɔ a hɛngmɛ ngɔ pue ye nɔ, nɛ a ngɛ ye he fɛu yee.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, koo je ye he! Ba esɔ nɛ o ba piɛ ye he, ejakaa mo lɛ o haa mi he wami.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Mo je mi kɛ je klaate nya. Mo he ye yi wami kɛ je gbe nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Mo je mi kɛ je jata nɛ ɔmɛ a nya mi; i be pu mi na ku nɛ ɔmɛ a nya nyɛe ma da.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nyɛ je e yi. Nyɛ Yakob nina tsuo, nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami. Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛɛ ye lɛ gbeye.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Ejakaa, e kua we nɔ́ nali; e hɛ ji a nɔ hulɔ. Ke a fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e nuɔ; e laa we mɛ.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Ma je o yi ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ a hɛ mi. Ma ye ye siwo ɔ nɔ ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ mo gbeye ɔ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Ohiatsɛmɛ maa ye ní nɛ a maa tɔ. Nihi nɛ hlaa Yawɛ se blɔ ɔ ma je e yi; a bua maa jɔ a he kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Je mahi tsuo ma kai Yawɛ; a maa je he tsuaa he kɛ ba e ngɔ ba ja lɛ.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji matsɛ; lɛ nɛ e yeɔ je ma amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: He nɔ woli tsuo ma ba kpla si ha lɛ. Niinɛ, nimli adesahi tsuo ma ba kpla si ngɛ e nane nya.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ ma sɔmɔ lɛ. Nihi maa sɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ní kɛ ha hwɔɔ se bimɛ.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Bimɛ nɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mɛ lolo po, a maa sɛɛ ha mɛ ke, “Yawɛ he e ma a yi wami.”

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji ye hyɛlɔ; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he hia we mi.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: E haa nɛ i jɔɔ ye he ngɛ nga mumu nɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ mi kɛ yaa takuhi kɛ a mi nyu jɔjɔɛ he.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: E haa nɛ i naa he wami he. E ngɔɔ mi kɛ guu blɔhi nɛ da a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ke e maa pee ɔ.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Ke i nyɛɛ diblii kpii mi po, i yi gbeye; ejakaa mo Yawɛ, o ngɛ ye kasa nya haa. O to tsɔ̃mi tso ɔ, kɛ o dɛma tso ɔ ji níhi nɛ woɔ mi he wami.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: O ngmɛɔ mi okplɔɔ ngɛ he nɛ ye he nyɛli tsuo maa na mi. O pɔɔ ye yi mi nu, nɛ o woɔ ye kplu ɔ nɛ e hyiɔ banebane.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i le kaa ye wami be ɔ tsuo o maa na mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o maa pee mi kpakpa sɔuu. Nɛ mo Yawɛ, o we ɔ ji he nɛ ma hi daa.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Je ɔ, Yawɛ nɔ́. Zugba a, kɛ e mi ní, kɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ níhi ji mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ bɔ je ɔ kɛ fɔ wo ɔ nɔ; lɛ nɛ to je ɔ sisi ngɛ pahi a nɔ.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e kuɔɔ Yawɛ yoku ɔ? Mɛnɔ maa ya e we klɔuklɔu ɔ?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ pee we yayami, nɛ e tsui mi tsɔ. Nɔ nɛ ja we yakayaka níhi, nɛ e ka we kita kɛ sisi nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa gbaa kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ. Mawu maa wo lɛ nguɔ, nɛ e ma he e yi wami.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Nyɛ bli agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ si gbajaa. Nyɛ bli blema agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ si, konɛ matsɛ ngua a nɛ ba.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ji matsɛ ngua nɛ ɔ? Lɛ ji Yawɛ; e ngɛ he wami. Katsɛ kɛ tatsɛ kpanaa ji lɛ.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Nyɛ bli agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ si gbajaa. Nyɛ bli blema agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ si, konɛ matsɛ ngua a nɛ ba.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ji kikɛmɛ a matsɛ ngua nɛ ɔ? Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, lɛ tutuutu ji matsɛ ngua a nɛ!

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo lɛ i ngɛ kue fae kɛ ngɛ hae.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi o blɔ ɔmɛ; Yawɛ, ha nɛ ma le o blɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Tsɔɔ mi nɛ ma hi si ngɛ o we anɔkuale ɔ nya, ejakaa mo Mawu ɔ ji ye yi wami helɔ. Daa nɛ ɔ, o nɔ lɛ i ngɔɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔɔ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, kai kaa o mɔbɔ nami, kɛ o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ ngɛ kɛ je blema lokoo.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Yawɛ hi, nɛ e da he je ɔ, e tsɔɔ yayami peeli blɔ nɛ sa kaa a nyɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ, Yawɛ tsɔɔ mɛ e blɔ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ sa kaa a ba a je mi ha.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ somi ɔ, kɛ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ naa mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e yeɔ mɛ anɔkuale.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ye o siwo ɔ nɔ, nɛ o ngɔ ye yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mi; ejakaa ye yayami ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
