translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, Yawɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ nɛ a nyɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: A he mi maa jɔ mɛ, nɛ a nina maa ngɔ zugba a kaa a weto ní.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mɛ maa nu huɛ; nɛ si nɛ e wo ɔ, e ma je kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: I hyɛɛ Yawɛ yemi kɛ buami blɔ daa; ejakaa lɛ nɛ jeɔ mi kɛ jeɔ haomi mi.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ba nɛ o ba na mi mɔbɔ; ejakaa nɔ ko be mi, nɛ ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Mo je mi kɛ je ye haomi ɔmɛ a mi; ha nɛ ma jɔɔ tsui yemi.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Hyɛ ye he nyɛli a hiɛmi babauu! Hyɛ kaa a ngɛ mi nyɛe kadikadi.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Bu ye he, nɛ o he ye yi wami. Ko ha nɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ pue si, ejakaa o ngɔ nɛ i ba sa we ngɛ.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ, nɛ́ o bu ye he. Ha nɛ ye he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ ma ye anɔkuale kɛ pi si.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Mawu, mo je o ma Israel kɛ je a haomi ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wo mi nguɔ, ejakaa i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ kulaa.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, kaa mi nɛ o hyɛ; hyɛ ye tsui mi, nɛ o hyɛ ye juɛmi mi.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a lɛ kpakaa mi; o we anɔkuale ɔ lɛ tsɔɔ mi blɔ.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: I kɛ yakayaka nimli bɔɛ; i kɛ osatotsɛmɛ pee we nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ma fɔ ye dɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa yayami ko be ye he; konɛ ma bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i suɔ o hi he ɔ. I suɔ o we ɔ, he nɛ o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Ko kpata ye hɛ mi kɛ piɛ yayami peeli a he; koo gbe mi kɛ piɛ muɔ si pueli a he.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ i peeɔ. Naa mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o he ye yi wami.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ma je Yawɛ yi ngɛ ma a tsuo hɛ mi; ejakaa i ye ye he kɛ je amanehluhi tsuo a mi.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji ye la; lɛ ji ye yi wami helɔ. lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yi nɔ ko nɔ ko gbeye. Yawɛ ji ye he wami nɛ buu ye he; mɛnɔ gbeye ma ye mɔ?

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Ke ye he nyɛli, yayami peeli ba tua mi nɛ́ a gbe mi ɔ, a ma tɛ nɔ, nɛ a maa nɔɔ si.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Ke ta ba tua mi, nɛ tabohi ba sa ye yi po, i be gbeye yee. Mawu nɔ kɛkɛ lɛ ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ kake kɛkɛ lɛ i bi Yawɛ; nɔ́ kake pɛ lɛ i ngɛ hlae ngɛ e dɛ. Lɔ ɔ ji kaa ma hi Yawɛ we ɔ ye wami be ɔ tsuo; ma na Yawɛ he fɛu ɔ, nɛ ma fa kue ngɛ e we ɔ.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Haomi be mi ɔ, e maa ngɔ mi kɛ laa ngɛ laami he ɔ, ngɛ e we ɔ; e maa ngɔ mi kɛ da tɛ sa nɔ.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Kikɛ nɛ ɔ ma pee kɛ ye ye he nyɛli tsuo nɛ bɔle mi ɔ a nɔ kunimi. I kɛ bua jɔmi maa sã bɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ ma la kɛ je e yi.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lee, ke i tsɛ mo ɔ, moo bu tue. Naa mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o he mi nɔ.

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: O de ke, “Nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ.” Imi hu i kɛ bua jɔmi he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ, i ma;

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: koo laa mi.” Koo ngɔ abofu kɛ fie imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ. Mawu, mo ji ye yi wami helɔ; mo lɛ o piɛɔ ye he. Koo je ye he; ko kua mi.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Ke tsaatsɛ kɛ maa kua mi po, Yawɛ maa hyɛ ye nɔ.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee, nɛ o kpaka mi kɛ gu blɔ nɛ da nɔ, ejakaa i ngɛ he nyɛli babauu.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Koo ngmɛɛ ye he kɛ ha ye he nyɛli, ejakaa lakpa odasehi, kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ te si kɛ wo mi.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: I heɔ yeɔ kaa ma hi je mi kɛ yaa si ma na Yawɛ mi mi himi ɔ ngɛ wami nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo nɛ o faa ye he; i ngɛ mo tsɛe, moo bu mi tue koo! Ke o pui ye nya mi ɔ, lɛɛ ma pee kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ gbeje ɔ a ti nɔ kake.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Ke i wo ye nine nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ o we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ i fa kue kɛ bi mo yemi kɛ buami ɔ, moo bu mi tue.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Koo bu mi fɔ kɛ si yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli a nɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a nyɛmimɛ tuɔ munyu ngɛ he jɔmi mi. Se a tsui mi hyi kɛ yayami.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ a bui níhi nɛ Yawɛ tsu, kɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ e be mɛ mɔbɔ nae hu.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: A je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa e bu ye kue fami ɔ tue.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji ye he bulɔ, kɛ ye yi baalɔ; e nɔ lɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ. E piɛɔ ye he, nɛ e haa mi bua jɔmi. Ma la kɛ je e yi.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Yawɛ buɔ e ma a he. Nɔ nɛ e pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, e faa e he, nɛ e baa e yi.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, he o ma a yi wami; moo gbaa o nina a. Moo hyɛ mɛ kɛ ya neneene kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ hyɛɛ e tohi.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ, Mawu bimɛ, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi, nɛ nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami bɔ nɛ sa lɛ. Nyɛ ja Yawɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu peemi mi.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbi ngɛ pɛe ngɛ wo ɔ mi. Mawu nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ wo gbi, nɛ e pɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbi ɔ kuɔ seda tsohi. Ee, Lebanon seda tsohi po Yawɛ kuɔ mɛ.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Yawɛ haa nɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ tuɔ kaa na bihi, nɛ e haa nɛ Hermon yo ɔ tuɔ kaa na ku bi.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbi ɔ haa nɛ oslabai gbaa.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbi ɔ haa nɛ nga mimiɛɔ; e gbi ɔ haa nɛ Kadesh nga a mimiɛɔ.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbi ɔ haa nɛ odabɔ fɔɔ bi; e haa nɛ ba kplɔɔ ngɛ tsohi a yi. Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ deɔ ke, “Hɛ mi nyami ha Mawu!”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ nyu babauu ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nɛ́ ha e ma a he wami. Yawɛ nɛ́ gbaa e ma a, nɛ́ e ha mɛ tue mi jɔmi.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: Ma je o yi Yawɛ, ejakaa o he ye yi wami. O ha we nɛ ye he nyɛli nɛ nya; o ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a ye ye he fɛu.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ye Mawu, i fa kue ha mo, nɛ o tsa mi.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Nyɛ, Yawɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi, nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi. Nyɛ kai níhi nɛ nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ tsu, nɛ nyɛɛ na lɛ si.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: E mi mi fuɔ be kuku kɛkɛ; se e mɔbɔ nami lɛɛ e ngɛ daa. O maa wo ya nyɔ mi, se ke je na pɛ bua jɔmi ba.

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o na mi mɔbɔ nɛ o bu ye he kaa yo nguaa ko. Se o ba laa mi, nɛ i ye gbeye.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i fa kue ha mo; i kpa mo pɛɛ ke o na mi mɔbɔ.

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: Ke i gbo nɛ a pu mi ɔ, mɛni se o ma na? Anɛ zu ma nyɛ ma je o yi lo? O we anɔkuale yemi ɔ, anɛ zu ma nyɛ maa ye he odase lo?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: O ha nɛ i kpa kɔmɔ yemi nɛ i bɔni domi. O je kpekpe ya bo ɔ ngɛ ye he, nɛ o ha mi bua jɔmi.

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i be ye nya mae; se mohu ma la kɛ je o yi. Yawɛ, ye Mawu, ma na mo si daa.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i ba sa we ngɛ o ngɔ; ko ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mi. Mo he ye yi wami, ejakaa dalɔ ji mo.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Moo bu mi tue koo! Mo he ye yi wami esɔ! Moo pee ye tɛ sa, nɛ o bu ye he! Moo pee ye mɔ, nɛ o he ye yi wami!

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Ee, ye wesa he, kɛ ye mɔ ji mo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo nyɛɛ ye hɛ mi, nɛ o tsɔɔ mi blɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Mo ji ye wesa he; jé mi kɛ je klama nɛ a tsɔ mi ɔ mi.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, Mawu anɔkualetsɛ; i ngɔ ye he kɛ ha mo. Mo lɛ o ma he ye yi wami.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o sume nihi nɛ jaa lakpa mawuhi saasaa; se imi lɛɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Ma nya, nɛ ma na bua jɔmi ngɛ o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ he. O na ye nɔ́ nami ɔ; benɛ i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, o hyɛ ye nɔ.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: O ngɔɛ mi kɛ wui he nyɛli a dɛ mi; o ha mi he jɔmi, nɛ i yaa he tsuaa he nɛ i suɔ.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa i ngɛ haomi mi. Aywilɛho sɔuu ha nɛ ye hɛngmɛhi fuu; ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hu gbɔjɔ.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Kɔmɔ yemi babauu ha nɛ ye he wami ta. Ya fomi po ye wami be ɔ nɔ kpiti. Ye he yayami ɔmɛ ha nɛ i gbɔjɔ, nɛ ye wuhi tete po pee hiɔ.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: I plɛ pee ahlua nɔ́ ko kɛ ha ye he nyɛli; i pee muɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha ye nyɛmimɛ, nɛ ye huɛmɛ lɛɛ i plɛ pee gbeye lohwe ha mɛ. Ke nihi na mi ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ kɛkɛ pui a tu fo!

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ je ye nɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko kaii we mi hu. I pee kaa nɔ nɛ gbo, aloo buɛ nɛ ywia.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: I nu nɛ nihi babauu ngɛ ye biɛ puɛe; gbeye níhi bɔle mi kɛ kpe. A ngɛ ye yi nɔ soe, konɛ a gbe mi.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ mo, Yawɛ o nɔ. I de ke, “Mo pɛ ji ye Mawu”.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Naa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ mɔbɔ! Mo he ye yi wami ngɛ o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo tsɛe; ko ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mi. Ha nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ mohu a hɛ mi nɛ pue si, nɛ a ma a nya kɛ ya gbeje.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: A je Yawɛ yi! Ejakaa benɛ he nyɛli, nɛ a sa ba tua mi ye yi ɔ, e je e suɔmi ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi ngɛ nyakpɛ blɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Ye tsui po, nɛ i susu kaa e je e juɛmi kɛ je ye nɔ. Se benɛ i fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e bu mi tue.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ e ni klɔuklɔuhi tsuo! Yawɛ baa nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale ɔ a yi, se he nɔ woli lɛɛ e gblaa a tue bɔ nɛ sa mɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ a ngɔ e tɔmihi, kɛ e he yayamihi ngɔ pa lɛ.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ Yawɛ nɛ yayami ko ngɛ e he; nɔ nɛ sisi we nɔ.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Mo Yawɛ, o gbla ye tue nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ ye he wami tsuo ta kaa bɔ nɛ nyu taa pa mi latsa be mi ɔ.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i jaje ye he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ha mo; i laa we ye tɔmi ɔmɛ a nɔ. I de ke, “Ma jaje ye tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ”, nɛ mo hu o ngɔ ye he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mi.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a fa kue ha mo ngɛ a fimi behi a mi. Ke haomi ba babauu kaa nyu nɛ ywia nga po, e be a he sae.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Mo ji ye laami he; o jeɔ mi kɛ jeɔ haomi mi. Mo lɛ o po piɛ kɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe, nɛ o ha nɛ i ye ye he.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ma tsɔɔ mo blɔ nɛ o nyɛɛ nɔ. Ma tsɔɔ mo ní, nɛ ma wo mo ga.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he kaa okpɔngɔ, aloo teji nɛ ja a ngɔ dade kɛ e he kpa wo e nya mi loko a ma nyɛ maa hɛɛ lɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Yayami peeli maa na nɔ́ wawɛɛ. Se nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ maa na mɛ mɔbɔ daa.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ fia saku kɛ je Yawɛ yi. Nyɛɛ fia kpa saku, nɛ nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi.

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ munyu ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu; e peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; e yeɔ dami sane. E suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ hyi zugba a nɔ tɔ.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Fami kɛkɛ lɛ Yawɛ fa nɛ e kɛ pee hiɔwe. Munyu kɛkɛ lɛ je e nya nɛ pu, kɛ nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi ba.

english_verse: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
translation_verse: E bua wo nyu ɔ nya glekugleku; nɛ e ngɔ nyu babauu ɔ kɛ to ngɛ nito hehi.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Je ɔ tsuo, nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye! Nyɛ nimli adesahi tsuo, nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami!

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Ejakaa munyu kɛkɛ lɛ e tu nɛ e kɛ bɔ je ɔ. Fami kɛkɛ lɛ e fa nɛ níhi tsuo ba.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Ke je ma amɛ so kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ tsakeɔ a yi mi tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ yi mi tomi ɔmɛ ngɛ daa; e susumi ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: A gbaa ma nɛ a Mawu ji Yawɛ. A gbaa ma nɛ Yawɛ hla kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma a.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Yawɛ jeɔ hiɔwe kɛ hyɛɛ nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ zugba.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hyɛɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ jeɔ he nɛ e kojoɔ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ haa nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ susuɔ e yi mi; e le nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ pee.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Pi ta buli babauu nɛ haa matsɛ yeɔ kunimi; ta bulɔ be nyɛe maa ngɔ e kã kɛ he lɛ nitsɛ e yi wami.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Ke o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ ta okpɔngɔ nɔ ɔ, e maa pee yaka. Ta okpɔngɔ kɛ e he wami babauu ɔ be nyɛe ma he o yi wami.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye; nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ e nɔ kaa e na mɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, Yawɛ buu a he.

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ; lɛ ji wa yi baalɔ nɛ piɛɔ wa he.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, wa bua jɔ wa he, ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Ma fĩa kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ; nɔ́ nali maa nu he, nɛ a ma nya.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ wɔ tsuo waa wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ wa je e yi.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: I fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ e bu mi tue; e ha nɛ i jɔɔ gbeye yemi.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ ɔ, a naa bua jɔmi; zo gbi mɛ gblegbleegble.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nalɔ nɛ ɔ fa kue ha Yawɛ; Yawɛ bu lɛ tue, nɛ e je lɛ kɛ je e haomi ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ buɔ nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ a he, nɛ e heɔ a yi wami.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ka Yawɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa na kaa e hi. A gbaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Nyɛ, Yawɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi, nyɛɛ ye lɛ gbeye. Ejakaa nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mɛ.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Jata bihi po e fiɔ mɛ nɛ hwɔ yee mɛ. Se nihi nɛ hlaa Yawɛ se blɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mɛ.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bu mi tue, nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye.

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: Hyɛ nɛ o ko tu munyu nɛ sɛ́! Hyɛ nɛ o ko ye lakpa!

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Jɔɔ yayami peemi, nɛ o pee kpakpa. Hla tue mi jɔmi, nɛ o nyɛɛ se.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ dali a he, nɛ e buɔ a kue fami tue.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Yayami peeli lɛɛ Yawɛ jeɔ e hɛ kɛ piɔ mɛ, nɛ ke a gbo ɔ, e kɛ we kɛkɛ hɛ je a nɔ.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Ke dali fa kue ha Yawɛ ɔ, e nuɔ, nɛ e jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ a haomihi tsuo a mi.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a kɔni mi jɔ̃, kɛ nihi nɛ a be hɛ nɔ kami ɔ, Yawɛ hii a kasa nya, konɛ e wo mɛ he wami.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, haomi babauu baa e nɔ; se Yawɛ jeɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ lɛ tsuo mi.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ ɔ, yayami kɛ̃ lɛ maa gbe lɛ. Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ dali ɔ, a maa gbla a tue.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma he e sɔmɔli a yi wami. Nihi nɛ ba saa we ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko hɛ mi be kpatae.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Moo gbla akplɔ, kɛ gbiɛ kɛ wo nihi nɛ ngɛ ye se nyɛɛe ɔ a he. De mi ke o ma he ye yi wami.

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe mi ɔ, ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ, nɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ nɛ bɔ mɛ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ye yi nɔ soe ɔ, ha nɛ basabasa nɛ sɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a kpale a se.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ a pee kaa tsakati ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ nya. Ha nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ fie mɛ kɛ ho.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ wo diblii, nɛ e sane. Ha nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ a se.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a tsɔ mi klama, nɛ a tsua muɔ ngɔ to ha mi yaka gu.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ he ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi. Ye bua maa jɔ, ejakaa e he ye yi wami.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Ma de kɛ je ye tsui mi tɔɔ ke, “Yawɛ, mɛnɔ lɛ e kɛ mo sɔ? Mo lɛ o jeɔ nɔ nɛ he wɛ kɛ jeɔ nɔ nɛ he wa pe lɛ ɔ dɛ mi. Mo lɛ o jeɔ dɛgutsɛ kɛ jeɔ nɔ nɛ waa lɛ yi mi ɔ dɛ mi.”

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: A peeɔ mi yayami kɛ toɔ kpakpa nane mi, nɛ a woɔ mi ka, konɛ a gbe mi.

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ ma fa kue ha ye huɛ, aloo ye nyɛmi. I ma ye yi si dii, nɛ i ye kɔmɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e nyɛ gbo nɛ e ngɛ ya nyɛe.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o maa hi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hyɛe kɛ yaa si mɛni be! Jé mi kɛ je kikɛmɛ a ogbetee nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi! Ko ha nɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi!

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Ma na mo si, nɛ ma je o yi ngɛ o ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Ko ha nɛ ye he nyɛli lakpatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a nya. Nihi nɛ nyɛɔ mi yaka gu ɔ, ko ha nɛ a kpɛ mi.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: A tu we he jɔmi munyu gblegbleegble. Nɔ́ nɛ a peeɔ ji nihi nɛ suɔ tue mi jɔmi ɔ, lakpa sɔuu a yeɔ ngɛ a he.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: A gbɛɔ a nya mi hatoo kɛ woɔ mi, nɛ a deɔ ke, “Ɛhɛɛ, wa na lɛ paa kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa hɛngmɛ.”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, tse o ngɛ hyɛe? Ko ma o nya! Nyɔmtsɛ, koo je ye he!

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ye Mawu, mo nɛ o yeɔ dami sane. Moo wo mi nguɔ koo! Ko ha nɛ ye he nyɛli nɛ muɔ mi.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Ko ha nɛ a de ke, “Ɛhɛɛ, wa nine gbe lɛ! Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ hlae ɔ pɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ hii nyae be mi nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ, nɛ a pee basabasa. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ susuɔ kaa mɛɛ a hi pe mi ɔ, ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ pue si.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Se nihi tsuo nɛ maa suɔ kaa a wo mi nguɔ ɔ, ha nɛ a hwɔ lele, nɛ a de si abɔ ke, “Yawɛ kle! E bua jɔ e he kaa e tsɔlɔ ɔ ye manye.”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Ma jaje kaa Mawu nɛ yeɔ dami sane ji mo, nɛ ma je o yi daa.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Yayami kɛ yiwutsotsɛ tuɔ munyu ngɛ e tsui mi tɔɔ. Mawu gbeye yemi ko kulaa be e mi.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: E buɔ e he ní lelɔ, nɛ e susuɔ kaa a be e he yayami ɔ nae, nɛ a be e tue gblae hulɔ.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Munyu yaya, kɛ lakpa sɔuu lɛ jeɔ e nya mi. E li nɔ́ hu; e pa pee we kpakpa hu.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ke e hwɔ si ɔ, nɔ́ yayami he ga lɛ e toɔ. E kpa we yayami peemi ɔ, e pee we nɔ́ kpakpa hulɔ. Mawu mi mi himi

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ kle agbo kaa hiɔwe ɔ tsuo. O we anɔkuale yemi ɔ ya suu bɔku ɔmɛ a he tɔɔ.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: O kpakpa peemi ɔ kle kaa yo nguangua amɛ; o dami sane yemi mi kuɔ kaa wo. Yawɛ, mo lɛ o baa nimli, kɛ lohwehi tsuo a yi.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ o mɔbɔ nami ɔ he jua wa ha! Adesahi tsuo ba saa we ngɛ o pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: O lɛɔ wɔ kɛ o we ɔ ní kpakpahi. O haa wɔ nyu kɛ jeɔ o pa nɛ ngɛ akɔnɔ ɔ mi lɛ wa nuɔ.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: O mi lɛ wami tsuo jeɔ kɛ baa. O la a lɛ haa wɔ la.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ le mo ɔ, naa mɛ mɔbɔ daa. Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mo hu moo pee mɛ kpakpa daa.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Ko ha nɛ he nɔ woli nɛ naa ye nɔ; ko ha nɛ yayami peeli nɛ nyɛɛ ye se kɛ fo.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, yayami peeli ɔmɛ nɔ si! A tsɛ̃ mɛ ngɔ ko si, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a te si hu.

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Koo ye o tsui ngɛ yayami peeli a he; o hɛ ko kɔ nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami a nɔ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ nɛ o pee kpakpa, konɛ o hi zugba a nɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Mo na Yawɛ he bua jɔmi, nɛ e ma ha mo níhi nɛ o tsui suɔ.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ o he kɛ ha Yawɛ; ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ, nɛ e maa piɛ o he.

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: E maa ye dami sane ha mo; e maa wo mo nguɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa je kpo paa kaa pu la, nɛ nihi tsuo maa na.

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: O mi mi ko fu hu; koo ye o tsui hu. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ haa nɛ nɔ peeɔ yayami.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a ma kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nine maa su zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a he jɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a maa hi zugba a nɔ ngɛ kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ soɔ kpakpa peelɔ yi nɔ; e hyɛɛ lɛ too kɛ ninyɛ hɛngmɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ lɛɛ e muɔɔ yayami peeli, ejakaa e le kaa e be kɛe nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Yayami peeli hiaa klaate, nɛ a dɔɔ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ, konɛ a gbe ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ; konɛ a kpata nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a a hɛ mi.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Se a kɛ a klaate ɔmɛ maa gbe mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he, nɛ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ku.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo nɛ ngɛ dalɔ dɛ ɔ hi pe yayami peeli babauu a ní nɛ a na.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ ma ha nɛ yayami peeli a he wami maa ta. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ e maa bu a he.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Yawɛ maa bu a he daa; nɛ a maa hi zugba a nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Ke haomi ba a, a hɛ mi be si puee. Hwɔ be mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa tɔ.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata. Yawɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa pee kaa nga nɔ mɔmɔ. A maa ta si kake too kaa bɔ nɛ la su ku se poo ɔ.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Ke nɔmlɔ yayami pa sika a, e wui hiɔ; dalɔ lɛɛ e naa mɔbɔ, nɛ e haa nɔ nɔ́.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ Yawɛ gbaa mɛ ɔ, a nine maa su zugba a nɔ. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ e gbiɛ mɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lɛ tsɔɔ nɔ blɔ nɛ sa nɛ e nyɛɛ nɔ. Nɛ ke o pee saminya a, e naa o he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Ke o nɔ si tete po, o be zugba tlɔe; ejakaa Yawɛ ma wo o nɔ ekohu.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Kɛ je ye nihe be mi kɛ ba si ye wami si nɛ ɔ, i nɛ kaa Yawɛ kua nɔ ko nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da. E bimɛ hu, i nɛ kaa a ngɛ ní bae.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Kpa yayami peemi, nɛ o pee kpakpa, kɛkɛ ɔ, o nina maa hi zugba a nɔ daa;

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: ejakaa Yawɛ suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale ɔ, e kua we mɛ. Yawɛ maa bu dali a he daa; se yayami peeli a nina lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, zugba a maa pee a nɔ́ nɛ a maa hi nɔ daa.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Dalɔ nya mi munyu ɔ, nile sɔuu; daa nɛ ɔ, e suɔ kaa a ye dami sane.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: E ngɔɔ e Mawu ɔ mlaa a kɛ toɔ e tsui mi, nɛ e si we se gblegbleegble.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ hii nɔmlɔ kpakpa dae, nɛ e hlaa kaa e maa gbe lɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ be dalɔ he ngmɛɛe kɛ wo yayami peelɔ dɛ mi kɔkɔɔkɔ. Ke a ngɔ dalɔ kɛ ba kojomi he hu, Yawɛ be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛ kpanaku ko hi si; i le lɛ. E nɔ kuɔ kaa Lebanon seda tso.

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: Be ko se ɔ, i ya gu he nɛ e hii ɔ, se e be lejɛ ɔ. I hla lɛ, se i nɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Moo to nɔmlɔ kpakpa he hɛ; hyɛ dalɔ saminya, nɔmlɔ nɛ he jɔ ɔ, hwɔɔ se ɔ, e maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a ma kpata a kɛ a nina tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Yawɛ heɔ dali a yi wami; e buɔ a he ngɛ amanehlu be mi.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Yawɛ piɛɔ a he; e jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ yayami peeli a dɛ mi, nɛ e heɔ a yi wami. Ejakaa a ba saa we ngɛ e ngɔ.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, koo ngɔ abofu kɛ ka ye hɛ mi! Koo gbla ye tue kɛ mi mi fumi.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: O ngɔ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ plaa mi; o tsɛ̃ mi ngɔ fɔ si.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ o mi mi fu mi he je ɔ, i na we he jɔmi ko kulaa. Ye yayami ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, ye he mi tsɔ we mi.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Ye pa amɛ sa, nɛ a he fu; ejakaa i je kuasia.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Ye mi dɔ kɔmɔɔ, nɛ i ma ye yi si; daa nɛ ɔ, kɔmɔ kɛkɛ i ngɛ yee.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Ye se fɛ, nɛ e ngɛ mi sããe hɛii kaa la; ye he mi tsuo puɛ.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo i gbɔjɔ, nɛ i ku; ye tsui ngɛ fiae, nɛ i ngɛ kɛmɛe.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, o le ye hiami ní ɔmɛ tsuo; ye kɛmɛmi ɔ hu o le.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: Ye tsui ngɛ fiae kpla, kpla! Ye he wami ta, nɛ ye hɛngmɛ hu miɔ nɛ e ma yu.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: Ye hiɔ ɔ he je ɔ, ye suɔli, kɛ ye huɛmɛ bɛ ye kasa nya. Ye nyɛmimɛ tete po, se lokoo a daa.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ tsɔɔ mi klama. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ hlaa kaa a ye mi awi ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ lakpa yee, nɛ a ngɛ ye he guɛ gbee kɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i pee kaa otokuno; i nui nɔ́! I pee kaa mumui, i tu we munyu.

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: I miɔ nɛ ma nɔ si, ejakaa daa nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ kɛkɛ i ngɛ nae.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: I ngɛ jajee kaa i pee yayami; ye he yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ mi dɔe.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ko kua mi; ye Mawu, koo je ye he.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, ye yi wami helɔ, ba esɔ nɛ o ba piɛ ye he.

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: I de ke, “Ma hyɛ ye he nɔ saminya, konɛ i kɛ ye lilɛ ko pee yayami. Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ yayami peeli a kpɛti ɔ, ma ma ye nya.”

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: kɛ ya si i pa li bɔ nɛ ma pee ha. Si abɔ nɛ i ngɛ ye yi mi susue ɔ, si abɔ nɛ i ngɛ haoe. Jehanɛ lɛɛ i ba tu munyu nɛ i de ke,

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Hyɛ kaa o pee ye wami be ɔ kpiti! Ye wami be ɔ tsuo pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ o hɛ mi. Niinɛ, adesa tsuo ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ!

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Ee, nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa nini; yaka dengme kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ gboe. E buaa níhi a nya, se e li nɔ nɛ ma ba ye.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, lɛɛ mɛni i pa ngɛ blɔe mɔ? Mo, o nɔ lɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Jé mi kɛ je ye yayami ɔmɛ tsuo a mi; ko ha nɛ kuasiahi nɛ a muɔ mi.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Ma ma ye nya nɛ ma pee dii, ejakaa mo lɛ o ha nɛ i na nɔ́ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Koo gbla ye tue hu; ye he wami ta! Bɔ nɛ o fiaa mi ní ɔ, e hiɛ!

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Ke o ka adesa hɛ mi, nɛ o gbla e tue ngɛ e he yayamihi a he pɛ o kpata e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye. Niinɛ, nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i ngɛ kue fae kɛ ngɛ mo hae; i ngɛ mo tsɛe kɛ ngmlaa, kɛ ya; moo bu mi tue koo! Imi hu pe i ba to nubwɔ be kpiti kɛkɛ kaa ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Ngmɛɛ ye he nɛ ma na bua jɔmi, loko ma je hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ i pa be wami nɛ ɔ mi hie hu ɔ.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: E gbla mi kɛ je muɔ nɛ mi ngɛ gbeye ɔ mi; e je mi kɛ je mɔsɔ nɛ mi ti ɔ mi. E ngɔ mi kɛ ma tɛ sa nɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ ye nane ma si ekohu.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: E tsɔɔ mi la he nɛ ma la kɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi. Nihi babauu maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ; a maa ye gbeye, nɛ a maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ, nɔ nɛ ya nyɛɛ we he nɔ woli a se, nɔ nɛ ya piɛ we amaga jali a he kɛ ja we lakpa mawuhi.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ye Mawu! O tsu nyakpɛ ní babauu ha wɔ; o to yi mi kpakpa babauu ngɛ wa he; mɛnɔ po kɛ mo sɔ? Ke i ke ma tu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he munyu ɔ, i be nyɛe; ejakaa a he hiɛ tsɔ.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: O hla we bɔ, nɛ o hla we nike ní hulɔ. O bi we ke a sã sami bɔ, loo yayami pami bɔ ha mo. Mohu ɔ, o bli ye tue, konɛ ma nu o gbi.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “O nɛ mi; i ba; a ngma ye he sane ngɛ womi kpo ɔ mi.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: Ye Mawu, i suɔ kaa ma pee o suɔmi nya ní; o mlaa a, a ngma ngɛ ye tsui mi.”

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i gba kɛ tsɔɔ o ma a tsuo kaa o he wa yi wami. O le kaa i be ye nya mae kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ daa; o kɛ o suɔmi ɔ, kɛ o we anɔkuale ɔ nɛ bu ye he. Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami (La

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Haomi babauu nɛ hí kaiemi bɔle mi kɛ kpe. Ye yayami ɔmɛ ba pe mi, nɛ i pa hyɛ we nɔ́ hu. Ye yayami ɔmɛ hiɛ kulaa pe ye yi bwɔmi; ye mumi nya ta!

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami koo! Yawɛ, ba piɛ ye he esɔ!

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Se nihi tsuo nɛ hlaa o se blɔ ɔ, ha nɛ a nya, nɛ a na bua jɔmi. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ kaa o he a yi wami ɔ, ha nɛ a de daa ke, “Yawɛ kle!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: E fi mi, nɛ ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ; se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ ngɛ ye nɔ. Ye Mawu, mo ji ye he piɛlɔ; mo ji ye kpɔlɔ. Moo ba ye ngɔ esɔ, koo to tsle!

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ susuɔ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ a he; ke haomi ba e nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ maa piɛ e he.

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa bu e he, nɛ e yi ma na wami. Yawɛ maa gbaa lɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ e be e he ngmɛɛe kɛ ha e he nyɛli.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Ke e be he wami ɔ, Yawɛ maa piɛ e he, nɛ e ma tle lɛ si ngɛ e hiɔ sa nɔ.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: I de ke, “Yawɛ, i pee mo yayami; naa mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o tsa mi.”

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tuɔ ye he munyu yaya. A deɔ ke, “Mɛni be po e ma gbo nɛ e biɛ maa laa?”

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: A deɔ ke, “Hiɔ yaya ko nu lɛ; si nɛ e nɔ nɛ ɔ, e pa be si tee hu.”

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Ye huɛ nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ i heɔ lɛ yeɔ, nɛ i kɛ lɛ yeɔ ní ɔ, lɛ po e te si wo mi.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ be ye nɔ yee; nɛ enɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mi kaa o ngɛ ye he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: O maa piɛ ye he, ejakaa i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da. O kɛ mi maa hi si daa.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: A je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi! A je e yi mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ; a je e yi daa. Amen!

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Mawu lee, ye tsui ngɛ sue kɛ ngɛ mo hlae wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ odabɔ tsui suu kɛ hlaa nyu ɔ.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Mawu hɛngmengmletsɛ, o he kuma ngɛ mi yee. Mɛni be po ma ba su o ngɔ nɛ ma ja mo?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Ya sɔuu i ngɛ foe nyɔ kɛ pia. Ye vo nyu ba pee ye niye ní; ejakaa nihi ngɛ mi bie kpamisa ke, “Jije o Mawu ɔ ngɛ?”

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Mɛni he je i pee vii kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je i ngɛ haoe kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ ma je e yi ekohu; lɛ ji ye kpɔlɔ; lɛ ji ye Mawu.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Piani ɔ, Yawɛ maa na mi mɔbɔ, konɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, ma la nɛ ma fa kue ha lɛ Mawu, ye yi baalɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu nɛ a biɔ mi daa ke, “Jije o Mawu ɔ ngɛ?” I nuɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ngɛ ye mi kaa pa nɛ miɔ nɛ maa gbe mi.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je nɛ i pee vii kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je nɛ i ngɛ haoe kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ ma je e yi ekohu; lɛ ji ye kpɔlɔ kɛ ye Mawu.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Mawu lee! Hyɛ ye sane ɔ mi ha mi, nɛ o wo mi nguɔ. Jé mi kɛ je ma nɛ li mo ɔ a dɛ mi. Kpɔ mi kɛ je lakpatsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli a dɛ mi oo!

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Ejakaa mo Mawu ji ye wesa he. Mɛni he je nɛ o kua mi? Mɛni he je nɛ yayami peeli maa hi mi yi mi wae, nɛ ma hi kɔmɔ yee kpamisa?

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma ya su o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, ngɛ mo Mawu, ye bua wolɔ nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ o ngɔ. Ma fia kpa saku kɛ je o yi, mo Mawu, ye Mawu.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je nɛ i pee vii kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je nɛ i ngɛ haoe kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ! Ma je e yi ekohu. Lɛ ji ye kpɔlɔ; lɛ ji ye Mawu.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi a klaate nɛ a kɛ ngɔ zugba a; pi a he wami nya nɛ a ye kunimi ɔ, se o he wami, kɛ o mɔbɔ nami nya; ejakaa o ngɛ o ma a he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Mo ji ye matsɛ kɛ ye Mawu; mo lɛ o haa nɛ o ma a yeɔ kunimi.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i ngɔɛ ye hɛ kɛ fɔɛ ye kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɔ; klaate be ye yi wami nyɛe ma he.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Mawu, mo o nɔ wa fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ daa. Wa maa na mo si kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ lɛɛ o kua wɔ; o ha wa he guɛ gbo, nɛ o piɛ we wa he kɛ yɛ ta hu.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: O ha wa tu fo ngɛ ta nya, nɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ha wa níhi.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: O ngɔ wɔ ngɔ ha kaa tohi nɛ a yaa gbe. O gbɛ wɔ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ a mi.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: O jua o ma a, nɛ o he nɔ́ ko nyafii kɛkɛ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma a he be se nami ko kulaa.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: O ha nihi nɛ bɔle wɔ kɛ kpe ɔ na wa we ahlua a; a ye wa he fɛu, nɛ a muɔ wɔ.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba wa nɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa hɛ ji o nɔ, nɛ somi nɛ o kɛ wɔ so ɔ hu wa tɔ̃ we nɔ.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Wa kua we mo, nɛ o mlaa a hu, wa tɔ̃ we nɔ.

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: Se o ngmɛɛ wa he ngɔ wo lohwe dikali a dɛ mi, nɛ wa tlɔ diblii kpii mi.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Kaa pe wa hɛ je mo, wa Mawu ɔ o nɔ, nɛ wa ya ja ma se mawu ko ɔ,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: anɛ mo, Mawu ɔ, o ko nɛ lo? Ejakaa o le níhi tsuo nɛ nɔmlɔ ngɔɔ kɛ laa ngɛ e tsui mi.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: O he ɔ, a gbeɔ wɔ be tsuaa be; a buɔ wɔ kaa tohi nɛ a yaa gbe.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, o hɛ nɛ tsɛ! Tee si nɛ o hyɛ wɔ; ko kua wɔ kulaa!

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Hyɛ kaa wa hule kɛ pue si, nɛ wa tlɔ zugba.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, tee si nɛ o ba piɛ wa he; ba nɛ o ba he wa yi wami. Ejakaa o mɔbɔ nami ɔ ngɛ daa.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ la nɛ ɔ poe kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ, munyu kpakpa sɔuu lɛ ba ye yi mi. La a ba ye nya amlɔ nɔuu kaa bɔ nɛ ní ngmalɔ kpakpa ngɔɔ e ningma tso kɛ ngmaa ni esɔesɔ ɔ.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: O he ngɛ fɛu pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ. O nya mi tsɔ kɛ munyu tumi. Mawu gbaa mo kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Yaa! Hii okpɔngɔ nɔ kɛ ya ye kunimi, nɛ o kɔsɔ. Yaa nɛ o ya fa anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane he! Ngɔɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ tsu nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi!

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: O kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ a nya ba; a guu o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tsui mi kɛ yeɔ je ma amɛ a nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Matsɛ sɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene. O matsɛ tso ɔ ji dami sane yemi he okadi.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: O suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, se yayami lɛɛ o hĩɔ; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o Mawu ɔ wo mo matsɛ, nɛ e ha mo bua jɔmi pe matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: O tadehi a mi jeɔ via liliili kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via: mire, aloe, kɛ kasia. Kpa sakuhi a fiaa kɛ haa o bua jɔɔ o he ngɛ o mɔ ɔmɛ a mi; suɔ wu a kɛ ma mɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: O yi kpakpa amɛ ɔ, matsɛmɛ a bimɛ ngɛ mi; manyɛ ɔ dla e he kɛ sika tsu kpakpa kɛ daa si ngɛ o hiɔ nine nɔ.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: Biyo, bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo nɛ ɔ tue; o hɛ nɛ je mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ o weku li ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ;

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: kɛkɛ o he fɛu ɔ maa pee matsɛ ɔ akɔnɔ; lɛ ji o nyɔmtsɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ba o he si ha lɛ.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Tiro ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba sa o hɛ mi.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Niatsɛmɛ tete po maa ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba. A wo matsɛ biyo ɔ ní saminyayoo ngɛ e tsu ɔ mi. Bo nɛ e bu ɔ, sika tsu kpa a kɛ lo.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: A ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba matsɛ we ɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ nyami.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Mo matsɛ, o ma na nina babauu nɛ ma ba ye ganɔ ngɛ o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane mi, nɛ o ma ha a maa ye tsɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ a ma kai mo yi nɔhi tsuo, nɛ ma amɛ tsuo ma je o yi daa kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Mawu ji wa wesa he, kɛ wa he wami. Wa fimi behi tsuo a mi ɔ, e ngɛ wa kasa nya.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke zugba mimiɛ, nɛ yohi hia kɛ ya pue wo mi po, wa be gbeye yee.

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: Ke wo ɔ gli, nɛ oslɔke ɔmɛ ku kɛ ngmlaa hoo, nɛ e ha yo ɔmɛ mimiɛ po, wa be gbeye yee.

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Pa ko ngɛ nɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ haa Mawu ma a bua jɔɔ a he. Hiɔwe no ɔ hi he ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a hɛ mi be kpatae kɔkɔɔkɔ. Loko haomi maa ba a nɔ ɔ, Mawu je ngmlaa ha mɛ momo.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ a mi mi fuɔ, nɛ a peeɔ hoo; se ke Mawu wo gbi ɔ, zugba a he jɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ wɔ ngɛ; Yakob Mawu ɔ ji wa wesa he.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ níhi nɛ Yawɛ tsu, bɔ nɛ e kpata níhi a hɛ mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: E haa ta se poɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo; e kuɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃hi, kɛ akplɔhi a mi, nɛ e kɛ la sãã ta zugba lɛhi!

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ wɔ ngɛ; Yakob Mawu ɔ ji wa wesa he.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛɛ fia nyɛ dɛ mi! Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ he ose kɛ je Mawu yi!

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ he ngɛ gbeye. Matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ yeɔ je ɔ tsuo nɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: E jɔɔ ma amɛ a he ha wɔ, konɛ waa ye a nɔ.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Mawu ho hiɔwe ya, nɛ a he ose! Yawɛ ho hiɔwe ya, nɛ titimati pɛ, benɛ e yaa hi e sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ!

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu ji matsɛ nɛ yeɔ je ɔ tsuo nɔ. Nyɛ la yi jemi la ha lɛ.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ a ganɔ ɔmɛ bua a he nya kɛ ba, konɛ a ba pee Abraham Mawu ɔ ma. E he wa pe je nɛ ɔ mi tabo ɔmɛ tsuo. Matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: Yawɛ kle, nɛ e sa kaa a je e yi saminya. A je e yi ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ ma a mi ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Zion yo ɔ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je lokoo ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ma. Yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ maa si glouu kɛ e he fɛu ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛ haa je ɔ tsuo bua jɔmi.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Mawu je e he kpo ngɛ e mɔ ɔmɛ a mi kaa wesa he nitsɛnitsɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ bua a he nya babauu, konɛ a ba tua Zion yo ɔ.

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: Se benɛ a ba na a, a nya kpɛ a he; sawale nu mɛ, nɛ a wo fo pulɛpulɛ kɛ je.

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: O ha beleku kɔɔhiɔ fia huu! Nɛ e ywia Spania lɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: Wa nu kaa Mawu tsu nyakpɛ níhi ba be; jehanɛ lɛɛ wa na nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ma a mi. E ma ha ma a maa ma si kpɛii kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: Mawu, ngɛ o we ɔ, wa susu o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Mawu, dami sane pɛ o yeɔ; nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o biɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ, a ngɛ o yi jee ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ Zion ma a nɛ nya, nɛ Yuda ma amɛ a bua nɛ jɔ; ejakaa o kojoɔ bɔ nɛ sa pɛ.

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: nyɛɛ slaa gbogbo ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ to mɔ ɔmɛ a he hɛ saminya; bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ sɛɛ ha yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ se ɔ ke,

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Je ɔ mi nihi tsuo, nyɛɛ bu mi tue. Nyɛ ta tue saminya ha mi!

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: Ni nguahi kɛ ni wawi, niatsɛmɛ kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ta tue!

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ maa je ye nya a, nile munyu sɔuu. Munyuhi nɛ a mi kuɔ saminya a he ma susu.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Ma bu tue nɛ ma nu abɛ ko, nɛ ma fia kpa saku kɛ tsɔɔ nya.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Ke he nyɛli bɔle mi kɛ kpe, nɛ a ngɛ mi nisɛ ní pee po, mɛni he je ma ye gbeye?

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa wami he jua wa saminya, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be Mawu hiɔ nyɛe maa wo nɛ maa su nya,

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: konɛ e hi je mi daa, nɛ e ko gbo.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ: ni lelɔ po gboɔ, nɛ kuasia nɛ be juɛmi hu gboɔ ja nɔuu. Mɛ tsuo a siɔ a ní ɔmɛ kɛ haa ni kpahi.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: a ma gbo kaa to gboɔ; gbenɔ maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ ya gbeje tɔɔ. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a maa ye yayami peeli a nɔ; yayami peeli a nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ma puɛ kulaa, nɛ gbeje maa pee a hi he.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ Mawu ma kpɔ mi kɛ je gbenɔ dɛ mi. E maa ngɔ mi kɛ ba e ngɔ.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Ke yayami peelɔ ná ní babauu kɛ be nɔ, nɛ e we mi hyi tɔ kɛ afɛu níhi ɔ, koo ye o tsui ngɛ he.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke e gbo ɔ, e be ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko ngɔe kɛ ya gbeje.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Ke e na bua jɔmi saminya, benɛ e na ní, nɛ nihi je e yi kaa e bɔ mɔde tete po ɔ,

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: e ma ya piɛ e nɛmɛ nɛ gbo blema a a he; nɛ lejɛ ɔ, e be la nae gblegbleegble hu.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu Ope ɔ ngɛ munyu tue. E ngɛ je ɔ tsuo tsɛe; e ke a je beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je kɛ ba.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Wa Mawu ɔ ma oo, e pee we di, se mohu la gegeege nɛ puɛɔ nɔ́ ngɛ e hɛ mi kɛ ma, nɛ ahumi ngɛ fiae kɛ ngɛ lɛ bɔlee.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: E maa kojo e ma a; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba odase tsɛe.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Hiɔwe tsuo ngɛ dee ke Mawu ɔ, dalɔ kɛ kojolɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: “Ye ma, nyɛ ta tue saminya, konɛ nyɛɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ma de kɛ si nyɛ, Israel ma. Imi ji nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pu mi lohwehi, kɛ lohwehi nɛ ngɛ yokuhi tsuo a nɔ ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: I le nga mi lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ tsuo, pu mi lohwehi hu ye níhi.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: “Ke hwɔ ngɛ mi yee ɔ, i be nyɛ dee, ejakaa ye nɔ́ ji je ɔ kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Anɛ i yeɔ na lo, aloo i nuɔ to akpakpo muɔ?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ na Mawu si, konɛ si nɛ nyɛ wo Hiɔwe No ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ yi fi ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ mi; ma je nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami.”

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Se yayami peelɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ lɛ dee ji, “Mɛnɔ ha mo he blɔ ke o kane ye mlaa amɛ blɛblɛɛblɛ, loo o tu ye somi ɔ he munyu?

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: O sume tsɔsemi, nɛ ye munyu hu o sake ngɔ fɔ o tue se.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Ke o na julɔ ɔ, o kɛ lɛ tsɔɔ huɛ, nɛ gba puɛli o kɛ bɔɔ.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: “O he sɔɔ kɛ tuɔ munyu yaya be tsuaa be; nɛ lakpa jeɔ o nya puu.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: O yeɔ o nyɛmimɛ a he sieku, nɛ o nyɛbi po o puɛɔ e biɛ.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: O pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; se akɛnɛ i de we nɔ́ ko he je ɔ, o susu kaa i ngɛ kaa mo. Jehanɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ o hɛ mi kae; i ngɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi mae paa.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ hɛ je imi Mawu, ye nɔ ɔ, nyɛ susu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he saminya. Ke pi ja a, ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma kpɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ba sãã bɔ kɛ naa mi si ɔ, e ngɛ ye hɛ mi nyami woe. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, imi Mawu hu ma he e yi wami.”

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: Mawu, naa mi mɔbɔ ngɛ o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he; nɛ ngɛ o mɔbɔ nami nɛ be nyagbe ɔ he ɔ, tsu ye he yayami ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Du ha mi konɛ ye mu ní ɔmɛ, kɛ yayami ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je ye he kulaa.

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Ye tɔmi ɔmɛ ɔ, imi nitsɛ i le, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ ye yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ daa.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Mo, o nɔ nɛ i tɔ̃, mo pɛ nɛ i pee yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ si. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fɔ nɛ o bu mi ɔ, e sa mi. Piami ko piami ko be o he.

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Kɛ je be nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ, yayami peelɔ ji mi. Loko ye nyɛ ngɔ mi hɔ po, yayami ngɛ ye he.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Ha ma nu lele hwɔmi, kɛ bua jɔmi he. E ngɛ mi kaa a gbla ye tue wawɛɛ lɛɛ, se ha nɛ ma na bua jɔmi ekohu.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Koo hyɛ ye yayami ɔmɛ, se mohu tsu mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Mawu, bɔɔ tsui nɛ he tsɔ ha mi; ngɔɔ mumi nɛ yeɔ mo anɔkuale kɛ wo ye mi.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Koo fie mi kɛ je o hɛ mi, nɛ ko je o Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ je ye mi.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Ha ma na bua jɔmi ekohu kaa mo ji ye yi wami helɔ; nɛ́ o ha nɛ ma bu mo tue daa.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma tsɔɔ yayami peeli o mlaa a, konɛ a kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Mawu, koo bu mi fɔ kaa muɔ si puelɔ, konɛ ma la kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ je o yi.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, bli ye nya, konɛ ma la kɛ je o yi.

english_verse: Offerings and sacrifices are not what you want.
translation_verse: O hla we bɔhi, jinɛ ma ngɔ kɛ ba; sami bɔ hu, o sume.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ saa mo Mawu o hɛ mi ji he piami. Ke nɔ ko pia e he, nɛ e tsake e tsui ɔ, o kua we lɛ.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Mawu, naa Zion mɔbɔ, nɛ o piɛ e he koo; nɛ o fia Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ ekohu.

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ loko o bua maa jɔ bɔhi nɛ sa a he; sami bɔ ɔ, o bua maa jɔ he; a maa sã na kuhi ngɛ o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Mo katsɛ, o ngɛ dalɔ yayami pee nɛ o ngɛ fĩae. Mɛni he je? Mawu suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Nihi a hɛ mi kpatami he sɔuu o ngɛ soe be tsuaa be. O lilɛ ngɛ kaa asoyi nɛ nya ba, mo lakpatsɛ, nɔ sisilɔ.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: O suɔ yayami pe kpakpa, nɛ o suɔ lakpa munyu hu pe anɔkuale.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Munyuhi nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi sɔuu he o susuɔ; lakpatsɛ nitsɛnitsɛ ji mo.

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Mawu hu maa ngɔ mo ngɔ fia si ja nɔuu kɛ maa ya neneene. E ma sá mo kɛ je o we ɔ mi; e ma je mo kɛ je hɛ kali a zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ yeɔ dami sane maa na o nyagbe ɔ, nɛ a maa ye gbeye. A maa muɔ mo, nɛ a ma de ke,

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ kaa oliv tso ngɛ Mawu we ɔ. I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu mɔbɔ nami nɔ; e mɔbɔ nami ɔ be nyagbe.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Kuasia lɛ deɔ ke, “Mawu ko be.” Mɛni he je ɔ mɛ tsuo a puɛ. Yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ ngɛ he mi nyɛɛmi saminya. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɛ nimli adesahi tsuo hyɛe; e ngɛ hyɛe kaa e maa na nɔ ko nɛ le nɔ́; nɔ ko nɛ jaa lɛ Mawu ɔ lo.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Se mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tla blɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a puɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da; dɛbi; nɔ kake ngmelu po be!

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Hyɛ mɛ nɛ sawale nu mɛ momo; nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ bɛ hyɛ. Ejakaa Mawu ma sake yayami peeli a wuhi kɛ pue he, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ. Mawu ma kua mɛ;

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: I ná nɛ a je Zion ba he Israel yi wami. Ke Mawu ha nɛ a kpale na a he ekohu ɔ, Yakob ma na bua jɔmi, nɛ Israel ma nya!

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Mawu, ngɔɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ kpɔ mi. Ngɔɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ wo mi nguɔ!

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: Mawu, bu ye kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ o nu ye munyu ɔmɛ!

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ma je li ma mi tuami. Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi; mɛɛ lɛɛ pi a he sane ko ji mo Mawu.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Se mo Mawu ji ye he piɛlɔ; Yawɛ, mo ji ye yi baalɔ.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Ma je ye tsui mi faa ma sã bɔ ha mo Yawɛ; ejakaa e hi kaa ma pee ja kɛ na mo si.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: O je mi kɛ je ye haomi ɔ tsuo mi, nɛ i na bɔ nɛ o ye ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Bu mi tue koo, nɛ o he nɔ ha mi; ye haomi ɔmɛ ba pe mi.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: I ngɛ gbeye yee wawɛɛ. Gbenɔ he fɔ̃ nu mi.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Gbeye sɔuu ha ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli, nɛ tsuipo ha sawale nu mi.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji, “I na nɛ i ngɛ pɛli kaa lahuɛ, jinɛ i ko te kɛ je nɛ i ya jɔɔ ye he.

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i ko te kɛ ya tsitsaa, nɛ i ko ya hi nga kplanaa a nɔ tɔɔ.

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: I ko te mla kɛ ya laa ye he kɛ je kɔɔhiɔ vuduvudu, kɛ ahumi nɛ ɔ nya.”

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo gbogbo ɔmɛ a nɔ ma mi bi ɔmɛ hii nyɛɛe kɛ hii ma a bɔlee, nɛ a ha yayami peemi, kɛ haomi sɔuu hyi ma a mi.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Kaa ye he nyɛlɔ nɛ ngɛ mi ahlua nɛ ɔ bɔe ɔ, i ko de we nɔ́ ko; nɛ kaa ye futsɛ lɛ ngɛ e he nɔ woe ngɛ ye nɔ ɔ, i ko ngɔ ye he kɛ laa lɛ.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Se e ya pee mo, ye juã, ye he nɔ, kɛ ye huɛ kpakpa.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: Wa sɛɛɔ wa yi mi ní ngɔngɔɛ kɛ haa wa sibi, nɛ wa blaa kɛ ya jaa Mawu ngɛ e we ɔ.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
