translation_verse: Ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a gbo tlukaa; ha nɛ a hi a nane nya kɛ ya gbeje! Ejakaa yayami ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ a tsui mi.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ Yawɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ i ngɛ tsɛe, nɛ e ma he ye yi wami.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Mɔtu, piani, kɛ nyɔ mi tsuo i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee, nɛ i ngɛ kɛmɛe; e maa bu mi tue kɛ̃.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Ta nɛ i kɛ ye he nyɛli babauu ɔ ngɛ hwue ɔ, e ma kpɔ mi kɛ je mi, nɛ ma ye ye he.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee kɛ je teteete ɔ maa nu ye kue fami ɔ; e maa ye a nɔ kunimi ejakaa a kua a tsui tsakemi, nɛ a yi Mawu gbeye.

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: Ye he nɔ ya tua e huɛ; somi nɛ e kɛ mi so ɔ, e yi nɔ.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: E tuɔ munyu dɔkɔbii, se ta mohu he e ngɛ susue. E munyuhi a he jɔ bɔdɔɔ pe nu po, se afani klaatehi nɛ a hia kɛ je kpo mi.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ o haomi ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e maa bu o he. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu be blɔ ngmɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ nɛ he nyɛlɔ nɛ ye e nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Se mo Mawu, o ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ muɔ voo ɔ mi; muɔ si pueli, kɛ lakpatsɛmɛ be a wami be ɔ fa tete po yee ngɛ je mi. Se imi lɛɛ ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: Mawu lee, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa nimli adesahi ngɛ mi yi mi wae; ye futsɛmɛ ngɛ mi haoe daa ligbi.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Ke i ngɛ gbeye yee kikɛ nɛ ɔ, mo Hiɔwe no ɔ pɛ o nɔ i ngɔɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔɔ.

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Daa nɛ ɔ, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ ye munyu hɛ mi tsakee; yayami pɛ lɛ a hii susue ha mi.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: A buaa a he nya, nɛ a huɔɔ mi, kɛ ye ní peepee, konɛ a na ye he blɔ nɛ a gbe mi.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Mawu, ngɔɔ o mi mi la kɛ gbla kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tue ngɛ a yi wu tso ní ɔmɛ a he!

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: O le bɔ nɛ i ngɛ haoe ha; ye vo nyu ma hyi o tɔ ɔ. Tse o kadi lɛ tsuo ngɔ wo o womi ɔ mi?

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Ligbi ɔ nɛ ma fa kue ha mo pɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa kpale a se. I le kaa Mawu kɛ mi ngɛ.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yi gbeye. Mɛni nɔmlɔ adesa ma nyɛ maa pee mi?

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: Mawu, si nɛ i wo mo ɔ, ma ye nɔ; ma ngɔ sina bɔ kɛ ba ha mo.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o he ye yi wami kɛ je gbenɔ mi. O ha we nɛ ma tɛ nɔ nɛ ma nɔ si, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma nyɛɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi he nɛ o la kpɛɔ ngɛ kɛ haa hɛ kali ɔ.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Mawu, naa mi mɔbɔ oo, naa mi mɔbɔ! Ejakaa o ngɔ lɛ i saa we ngɛ. Ma laa ye he ngɛ o pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi ngɛ hɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ yaa si hɛ mi kpatami nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ se maa po.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: E maa tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba he ye yi wami; nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ. Mawu, o maa tsɔɔ mi kaa o mɔbɔ nami ngɛ daa kɛ ha mi, nɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale daa jã kɛ̃.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: He nyɛli bɔle mi kɛ kpe kaa jatahi nɛ yeɔ nɔmlɔ lo; a lunguhi ngɛ kaa akplɔhi, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi; a lilɛhi a nya ba kaa klaate nɛ a duɔ nya saminya.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Mawu, ha nɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ, konɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsɔ mi klama; nɛ ye ní pee mɔbɔ kulaa. A tsua muɔ ngɛ ye blɔ ɔ mi, se mɛ nitsɛmɛ mohu a ya nɔ mi.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Mawu, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ mo pɛ o nɔ; ma la kɛ je o yi!

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Makɛ mla a, ma te si, nɛ ma fia saku, kɛ kpa saku.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, ma na mo si ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi. Ma la kɛ je o yi ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kle kɛ su hiɔwe lokoo, nɛ o we anɔkuale yemi ya su bɔku mi tɔɔ.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Mawu, ha nɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo, konɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Nyɛ, hɛ mi nyɛɛli, anɛ nyɛ woɔ mlaahi nɛ da lo? Anɛ nyɛ kojoɔ nimli adesahi bɔ nɛ sa lo?

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ peeɔ yayami a wami be tsuo; kɛ je a fɔmi be ɔ, lakpa sɔuu a yeɔ.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Duɔ nɛ hyi a mi ɔ ngɛ kaa sinɔ duɔ. A tsiɔ a tue kaa sanga tuekpokutsɛ

english_verse: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
translation_verse: nɛ nui kunya yelɔ ɔ gbi, loo e la ngɔngɔɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa jata awi yeli pɛ; ku a nya mi lungu ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue he.

english_verse: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ a laa kaa pa nɛ ngɛ fae; ha nɛ a naa a nɔ kaa a naa nga gbigbli nɔ.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ a gbo kaa ahua nɛ ngɛ mɔsɔ wue kɛ bee. Ha nɛ a gbo kaa bi nɛ e fɔmi be sui nɛ a fɔ lɛ, nɛ e nɛ pu hɛ mi.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Ke a gbla yayami peelɔ tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ ɔ, ndalɔ a ma nya, nɛ e maa nyɛɛ yayami peelɔ ɔ muɔ mi kɛ be.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ nimli adesahi ma de ji, “Niinɛ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a naa hiɔwo kpakpa. Niinɛ, Mawu ngɛ, nɛ e kojoɔ je ɔ tsuo.”

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Je mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi; ko ha nɛ muɔ si pueli a nine nɛ su ye nɔ.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, hyɛ kaa dikali bua a he nya, konɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi, pohu i pee we yayami ko.

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: A he sɔ, nɛ a dla kɛ wo ye he, pohu i pee we mɛ yayami ko. Tee si, ba piɛ ye he. Hyɛ kaa ye yi fi.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu, mo ji Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ! Tee si nɛ o ba gbla je ma amɛ a tue. Yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ yi mi yaya toe ɔ, koo na mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Daa gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a kpaleɔ kɛ baa kɛ ngmlaa kaa gbehi kɛ ba kpaa ma a mi tsuo.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Mɛ lɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae hoo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ; a ngɛ huãe kɛ ngɛ pɛe ke, “Mɛnɔ maa nu wa he?”

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Se mo Yawɛ, o ngɛ mɛ muɔe; o ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a he fɛu yee.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: Ma la kɛ je o yi, mo ji ye he wami; mo Mawu ji ye wesa he.

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Daa gbɔkuɛ ɔ, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpaleɔ kɛ baa kɛ ngmlaa kaa gbehi, nɛ a ba kpaa ma a mi tsuo.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: A kpaa si kɛ hlaa niye ní; nɛ ke a na we ní nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ ɔ, a kpaa ngmlaa kaa gbehi.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ ma la kɛ je o yi, ejakaa o he wa. Daa mɔtu ɔ, ma la wawɛɛ kɛ je o yi, ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa. Be nɛ i ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ, mo lɛ o bu ye he, nɛ o baa ye yi.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: Mawu lee, o sake wɔ kɛ pue he. O mi mi fu wɔ, nɛ o gbɛ wɔ ngɔ fĩa. Se kpale wɔ kɛ ba wa glɛ nɔ ekohu koo!

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: O ha zugba a mimiɛ, nɛ e mi gba hatoo; moo tsi e hehi nɛ wo muɔ ɔ, ejakaa e ngɛ gbɛe kulaa.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: O ha o ma a na amanehlu nɛ nya wa; wa ngɛ didaae kaa nihi nɛ de dã.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: O si aflangaa ko ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ, konɛ a bua a he nya kɛ ba o ngɔ nɛ a hɛ mi ko kpata.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ he wa yi wami. Bu wa kue fami ɔ tue, konɛ ma nɛ mo nitsɛ o suɔ ɔ yi nɛ na wami.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Mawu de ngɛ e he klɔuklɔu ɔ ke, “Ma hwɔ lele kɛ gba Shekem mi; nɛ ma dla Sukot kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ha ye ma a.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Ye mahi ji Gilead, kɛ Manase. Efraim ji ye dade pɛɛ, nɛ Yuda ji ye matsɛ tso.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab ji ye hedu buɛ. Ma sake ye tokota kɛ pue Edom nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye e nɔ. Ma he ose kɛ ye Filistia nɔ kunimi.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ maa ngɔ mi kɛ ya ma nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo he ɔ mi? Mɛnɔ ma ya sɛ mi Edom?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Piɛ wa he, konɛ waa kɛ he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ kpe. Ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa he wami pí nɔ́ ko!

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Mawu, bu ye ngmlaa a tue; moo nu ye kue fami ɔ.

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: Ye mumi nya ngɛ tae. I ngɛ mo tsɛe kɛ je tsitsaa lokoo ngɛ je ɔ nyagbe he ɔ tɔɔ. Ngɔɔ mi kɛ ba mo, Mawu ɔ o ngɔ, konɛ ma na he jɔmi.

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mo ji ye wesa he, ye mɔ nɛ he wa, he nɛ he nyɛlɔ ɔ nine be ye nɔ sue ngɛ.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: Mawu, si nɛ i wo mo ɔ, nu, nɛ nihi nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ a weto ní ɔ, o ngɔ kɛ ha mi.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ e ye tsɛ ngɛ mo Mawu ɔ o hɛ mi daa. Ngɔɔ o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ, kɛ o we anɔkuale ɔ kɛ bu e he daa.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, imi hu ma la kɛ je o biɛ ɔ yi daa, nɛ ma ye ye siwo ɔmɛ a nɔ daa ligbi.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Lɛ pɛ ji ye wesa he, ye yi wami helɔ, kɛ ye he bulɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi nyɛe.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Kɛ yaa su mɛni be nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma bla kɛ hao nɔ kake too kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa gbogbo nɛ ku, nɛ miɔ nɛ e maa nɔ si ɔ?

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: E yi nɔ sɔuu a ngɛ soe, konɛ a gbla lɛ kɛ je e blɔ he nguaa a kɛ ba nɔ si. Munyu kpakpa jeɔ a nya, se a tsui mi hyi kɛ yayami sɔuu.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Lɛ pɛ ji ye wesa he, ye yi wami helɔ, kɛ ye he bulɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi nyɛe.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Mawu pɛ ji nɔ nɛ he ye yi wami. Lɛ pɛ lɛ e maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami. Mawu ji ye he wami kpetekpleenyɛ. Lɛ ji ye wesa he.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo. Mawu ji wɔ tsuo wa wesa he.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ kaa mumi nɛ a woɔ; nimli nguahi jio, nimli wawi jio, mɛ tsuo a pi nɔ́ ko kulaa. Ke a ngmɛ mɛ ngɛ sɛni mi ɔ, a ngɛ wojowojo kulaa, nɛ a jiimi sui mumi nɛ a woɔ.

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: E de hu ke lɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa. Ee, mo Nyɔmtsɛ nitsɛ lɛ o woɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa e ní tsumi.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Mawu lee, niinɛ, mo ji ye Mawu; i ngɛ mo hlae kɛ ye tsui tsuo nɛ ma na; o he kuma ngɛ mi yee kaa zugba nɛ gbli kadokado nɛ ngɛ nyu hlae!

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he i ngɛ mo blɔ hyɛe ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kaa ma na o he wami ɔ, kɛ o hɛ mi nyami ɔ!

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: O suɔmi nɛ se pui gblegbleegble ɔ hi pe wami nitsɛnitsɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma je o yi.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Ma na mo si ye wami be ɔ tsuo; ma wo ye nine nɔ, nɛ ma fa kue ha mo.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Ma ná bua jɔmi kaa nɔ nɛ ye niye ní kpakpa, kɛkɛ ɔ, ma la kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ je o yi.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Ke i kai mo ngɛ ye sa nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, o he sɔuu i susuɔ nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be ɔ, mo nɔuu lɛ o piɛɔ ye he; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma la kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ hɔ̃ mi ngɛ o pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: I mɛtɛ o he kpɛii, ejakaa o kɛ kɔni si wami hɛɛ mi.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi ɔ ma ya su tsitsaa gbeje tɔɔ.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: A maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ nga mi gbehi maa ye a gbogboe.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Se matsɛ ɔ ma nya saminya; ejakaa Mawu haa e yeɔ kunimi. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ Mawu biɛ kaa kita a ma je Mawu yi boboobo, se lakpatsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ma ma a nya.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ ye yi nɔ soe. Kpɔ mi kɛ je yayami peeli babauu ɔ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: A duɔ a lilɛhi a nya kaa klaate; a munyu yaya amɛ ngɛ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: A peeɔ yi wu tso ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ laami mi; a tsɔɔ klamahi babauu; a woɔ a sibi he wami, nɛ a deɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ maa na wɔ?”

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Se Mawu ma tsɛ̃ mɛ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ, nɛ e maa plaa mɛ tlukaa.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: E ma kpata a hɛ mi tlukaa ngɛ munyuhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tu ɔ he. Nihi tsuo nɛ maa na mɛ ɔ ma mimiɛ a yi.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ye gbeye. A maa sɛɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Mawu tsu, nɛ a ma susu a he saminya.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: Mawu, e sa kaa a je o yi ngɛ Zion, nɛ sihi nɛ a wo mo ɔ, a ye nɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: Ee, mo pɛ lɛ o buɔ kue fami tue. O ngɔ adesahi tsuo maa ba,

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o hla lɛ, nɛ o ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba o we ɔ. Wa ma na ní kpakpahi nɛ ngɛ o we klɔuklɔu ɔ a he bua jɔmi. O bu wa kue fami ɔ tue.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: O pee ní gbeyegbeyehi kɛ he wa yi wami. Niinɛ, Mawu, mo ji wa yi wami helɔ. Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he, zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ, kɛ wo se tsitsaa lokoo ɔ tsuo, mo o nɔ a ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: Mo nɔuu nɛ o ngɔ yo gojogojoo ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si kpɛii ngɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ, ha je ɔ tsuo ngɛ gbeye yee. A hwɔɔ lele kɛ jeɔ zugba a nyagbe he kake kɛ ya siɔ nyagbe he kake.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: O slaa zugba a, o haa lɛ nyu, nɛ e baa ní babauu. Ke o ha pa a hyi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ngmɔ ɔmɛ baa ní saminya. Bɔ nɛ o peeɔ lɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: O haa hiɔmi nɛɛ babauu kɛ pueɔ ngmɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a hu ɔ mi. Ngmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi hyiɔ kɛ nyu ɔ. Zu ɔ mi jɔɔ ha ní ɔmɛ nɛ a du ɔ, nɛ o haa ní ɔmɛ baa saminya.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: O ha ní kpakpahi babauu baa ngɛ jeha a mi. He tsuaa he nɛ o be ngɛ ɔ kɛkɛ ní ba babauu.

english_verse: Desert pastures blossom, and mountains celebrate.
translation_verse: Lohwehi babauu ngɛ lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Nga a nɔ pee fɛu kɛ tohi babauu, nɛ dɔ ɔmɛ a mi hyi kpɛkpɛɛkpɛ kɛ blɛfo; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ lele hwɔe, nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ hwɔ lele kɛ je Mawu yi!

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Nyɛ la kɛ je e yi. Nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami saminya!

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Nyɛ de Mawu ke, “Bɔ nɛ o peeɔ níhi ɔ ngɛ gbeye loo! O he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya a, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba a he si ha mo.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi jaa mo, a laa kɛ jeɔ o yi, a jeɔ o biɛ ɔ yi!”

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba, nyɛ ba hyɛ níhi nɛ Mawu pee, nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu kɛ ha nimli adesahi.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: E ha wo ɔ plɛ pee zugba gbigbli; nɛ nimli adesahi kɛ a nane po wo ɔ. Wa nyá ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ha wɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: E ngɛ tsɛ yee kɛ he wami kɛ yaa neneene. E hɛngmɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a he; atuã tsɔli kó wo a he nɔ.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi! Nyɛ je e yi wawɛɛ nɛ a nu;

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: lɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa wa yi naa wami, nɛ e ha we nɛ waa sane nɔ si.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Mo Mawu, o ka wɔ hyɛ ha, o tsu wa he kaa bɔ nɛ a tsuɔ sika hiɔ he ɔ.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: O ngɔ wɔ ya wo klama mi, nɛ wa du. O ngɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ ngɔ tloo wɔ.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: O ha wa he nyɛli ye wa nɔ; wa gu la mi, nɛ wa gu nyu mi hulɔ, se o je wɔ slɔkee kɛ ba he nɛ kplɔkɔtɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ sami bɔ kɛ ba o we ɔ, ma ye ye siwo ɔmɛ a nɔ ha mo.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ yee Mawu gbeye, nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bu tue, nɛ ma gba nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee ha mi.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: I kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ lɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ i la kɛ je e yi.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Kaa pe i suɔ yayami, nɛ i ngɔ kɛ laa ngɛ ye tsui mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ko bui mi tue.

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Mawu, naa wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ o gbaa wɔ, nɛ o na wa he bua jɔmi,

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: konɛ je ɔ nɛ le o suɔmi nya ní, nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a yo o he wami nɛ o kɛ heɔ yi wami ɔ.

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Zugba a ba ní saminya. Mawu gbaa wɔ, wa Mawu ɔ gbaa wɔ.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Mawu gbaa wɔ; je ɔ tsuo nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye!

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nya, nɛ a la kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ la ha Mawu; nyɛ la kɛ je e biɛ ɔ yi. Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, nyɛ la kɛ je e yi. Yawɛ ji e biɛ; nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Awusahi a tsɛ, kɛ yalɔyihi a he bulɔ ɔ, lɛ ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ e he klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ nɔ ko be mɛ ɔ, Mawu haa mɛ we nɛ a hii mi. E jeɔ pamitsɛmɛ kɛ jeɔ tsu mi, nɛ e haa a bɔɔ. Se atuã tsɔli lɛɛ e haa a hii zugba gbogboe nɛ bɛ ní nɔ.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: Mawu, be nɛ o nyɛɛ o ma a hɛ mi, be nɛ o kɛ mɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: mo Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ, o ha zugba mimiɛ, nɛ hiɔmi nɛ ngɛ mo Mawu ɔ o hɛ mi. Sinai yo ɔ tete mimiɛ ngɛ mo Mawu, Israel Mawu ɔ, o hɛ mi.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: Mawu, o ha hiɔmi nɛ babaaba kɛ ha zugba a tsuo nɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ zugba nɛ gbo ɔ ba ní saminya ekohu.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: O ha o ni ɔmɛ po ma ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Mawu, mɔbɔ nalɔ, o haa nɔ́ nali a hiami níhi.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo gbi, nɛ nihi babauu ngɔ sɛ gbi ɔ kɛ ho ke,

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛɛ to tsu ɔmɛ a kasa nya kɛkɛ a ngɛ, se a he pee fɛu kaa lahuɛhi nɛ sika hiɔ ha a he, kaa lahuɛ tsɛlihi kɛ a he sika tsu ngmingmiingmi.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu Ope ɔ gbɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa a, e pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ snoo ngɛ nɛe ngɛ Zalmon yo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Mo Bashan yo, yo kpetekpleenyɛ, mo Bashan yo, yo gojogojoohi nɛ tsa!

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kple si kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ba e he klɔuklɔu ɔ. E kɛ e ta zugba lɛ babauu nitsɛ lɛ ba.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: O kuɔ yo gagaa a, nɛ o kpaka nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ ta nyɔguɛ kɛ nyɛɛ o se yuu. O he nike ní kɛ je nimli adesahi tsuo a dɛ; o he ngɛ atuã tsɔli tete po a dɛ, konɛ mo Yawɛ ɔ o hi a kpɛti ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi. Daa nɛ ɔ, e yeɔ wa sane haa wɔ. Lɛ Mawu ɔ nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ heɔ wa yi wami.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Mawu maa ywia e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a yi; níhi nɛ ji yayami peeli a hɛ mi nyami ɔ, Mawu ma kpata lɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: konɛ o nane nɛ naa muɔ mi kɛ be, nɛ o gbe ɔmɛ hu a lilɛ nɛ na o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he nɔ́ ko nɛ a lɔ.”

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Lali nyɛɛ hɛ mi, yihewi fao fiali nyɛɛ a se, nɛ saku fiali gbe nya. A ngɛ dee ke,

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ, nyɛ je Mawu yi! Nyɛ Yakob nina tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!”

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Benyamin, wɛtso ɔmɛ a kpɛti wayoo pe kulaa a, lɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi ha mɛ. Yuda ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ e we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ se; Zebulun ganɔ ɔmɛ tsa nɔ, nɛ Naftali ganɔ ɔmɛ gbe nya.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o we ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem he je ɔ, matsɛmɛ ngɔɔ nike ní kɛ ba haa mo.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Egipt, lohwe dikalɔ nɛ hii gla mi ɔ, ka e hɛ mi; je ma amɛ, na kuhi, kɛ a na bihi tsuo, ka a hɛ mi hluu kɛ yaa si mɛ tsuo a ma ba kpla si, nɛ a maa ngɔ a sika kɛ ba ha mo. Mahi nɛ ta pɛ a suɔ ɔ, gbɛɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ a ngɔ akɔblee kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba, nɛ Sudan bi a he nɛ sɔ kɛ wo a nine nɔ kɛ ha mo Mawu.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemihi tsuo, nyɛ la kɛ ha Mawu. Nyɛ la kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi;

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo kɛ je blema teteete ɔ, nyɛ je e yi. Nyɛɛ bu e gbi nguaa nɛ ngɛ pɛe hoo ɔ tue.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ fiɛ Mawu he wami ɔ; e ngɛ he wami ngɛ Israel nɔ; e ngɛ hiɔwe nɔ he wami hulɔ.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Mawu, Israel Mawu ɔ he ngɛ gbeye ngɛ e hi he klɔuklɔu ɔ. E haa e ma a he wami, kɛ nyɛmi. A je Mawu yi.

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: Mawu, mo he ye yi wami! Nyu ɔ ba su ye kuɛ mi;

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: i ngɛ pue ngɛ mɔsɔ nɛ mi kuɔ mi, nɛ si dami he ko kulaa be ha mi. I ya su nyu nɛ mi kuɔ mi, nɛ nyu ɔ miɔ nɛ e laa ye yi.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: I kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ balɔ hluu nɛ pɔ tɔ mi, nɛ ye kuɔ si kpɔ; i hyɛ blɔ hluu kɛ ya si ye hɛngmɛ se gbo.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ye he ngɛ mɛ tsɛ̃e yaka gu ɔ, a he hiɛ babauu pe ye yi bwɔmi. Ye he nyɛli lakpatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ye hɛ mi hlae nɛ a kpata a, yiwutsotsɛmɛ kpanakuhi ji mɛ. Anɛ níhi nɛ pi ojo nɛ i ye kɛ na a, lɔ ɔmɛ hu ma ngɔ kɛ ha lo?

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: Mawu, o le kaa i je kuasia, nɛ ye tɔmi ɔmɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi paa.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o he ɔ, a ngɛ mi ahlua bɔe, nɛ zo gbe mi kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: I plɛ pee nubwɔ ha ye nyɛmimɛ; i plɛ pee nɔ kpa ngɛ ye weku li a kpɛti.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ye hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ o we ɔ he; nɛ ahlua nɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ mo bɔe ɔ ba pue ye nɔ.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Ke i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee nɛ i ngɛ hwɔ hae ɔ, ahlua mohu nɛ nihi bɔɔ mi.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: Ke i ha kpekpe ya bo ɔ, kɛkɛ i plɛ pee blakpa fiami nɔ́ ha mɛ.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ agbo nya a, ye he munyu sɔuu a hii tue, nɛ dã deli ɔmɛ hu imi la a hii woe.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu, imi lɛɛ pɛɛ i ngɛ mo kpae; be nɛ sa o hɛ mi ɔ, he mi nɔ ngɛ o suɔmi babauu nɛ be nyagbe ɔ he.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Ko ha nɛ nyu kpekpemi ɔ nɛ sa mi kɛ ho, loo ma tlɔ nyu ɔ sisi, loo ma ya sɛ muɔ voo ɔ mi, nɛ e ba ma e nya nɛ e mi mi.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, he mi nɔ koo; ejakaa o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a hi saminya; o mɔbɔ nami nɛ hiɛ babauu ɔ he ɔ, mo plɛ nɛ o hyɛ mi.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Koo ngɔ o hɛ mi kɛ laa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ; ejakaa i ngɛ haomi mi; pee esɔ nɛ o ba je mi.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: O le bɔ nɛ a bɔ mi ahlua, bɔ nɛ a gbe mi zo, kɛ bɔ nɛ a ha ye hɛ mi pue si. O le ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: A ha mi duɔ ngɛ niye ní nane mi; nɛ benɛ kuma ngɛ mi yee ɔ, a ha mi dã nɛ kuã ke ma nu.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: O mi mi nɛ fu mɛ wawɛɛ; o mi mi la nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ nɛ ba a nɔ tlukaa.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ a hi he nɛ pee ma doku; nɔ ko nɔ ko kó hi a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi hu.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ o gbla a tue ɔ, a waa mɛ yi mi; nihi nɛ o plaa mɛ ɔ, a pa amɛ a he ní a sɛɛɔ.

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: Gbla a tue sisiisi ngɛ a tɔmi ɔmɛ a he; koo ngɔ ekoeko kɛ pa mɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ; i ngɛ nɔ́ nae. Mawu, wo ye nɔ, nɛ o he ye yi wami!

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Ma la kɛ je Mawu yi, ma na lɛ si, nɛ ma tsɔɔ kaa lɛ ji ngua.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ maa sa Yawɛ hɛ mi pe na niheyo, loo na ku a tsɛ nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ́ nali na a, a bua maa jɔ. Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Mawu se blɔ hlae ɔ, nyɛ nɔ gbagba nɛ te.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ buɔ dɛgutsɛmɛ tue, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ, e hɛ ji a nɔ.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Hiɔwe kɛ zugba, nyɛ je Mawu yi. Wo kɛ e mi nibɔ níhi tsuo, nyɛ je Mawu yi!

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu ma he Yerusalem yi wami, e maa pee Yuda ma amɛ ehe ekohu. E tsɔli ɔmɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ, nɛ zugba a maa pee a nɔ́.

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: E tsɔli ɔmɛ a nina maa ngɔ zugba a kɛ pee a gbosi ní, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ maa hi lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Mawu, mo he ye yi wami koo! Yawɛ, ba piɛ ye he esɔ!

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Se nihi tsuo nɛ hlaa o se blɔ ɔ, ha nɛ a nya, nɛ a na bua jɔmi. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ kaa o he a yi wami ɔ, ha nɛ a de daa ke, “Mawu kle!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Ye yi fi nɛ ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ. Mawu, moo ba ye ngɔ esɔ! Yawɛ, mo ji ye he piɛlɔ; mo ji ye kpɔlɔ. Koo to tsle!

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Mawu, mo he ye yi wami koo! Yawɛ, ba piɛ ye he esɔ!

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Se nihi tsuo nɛ hlaa o se blɔ ɔ, ha nɛ a nya, nɛ a na bua jɔmi. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ kaa o he a yi wami ɔ, ha nɛ a de daa ke, “Mawu kle!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Ye yi fi nɛ ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ. Mawu, moo ba ye ngɔ esɔ! Yawɛ, mo ji ye he piɛlɔ; mo ji ye kpɔlɔ. Koo to tsle!

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ dalɔ ji mo he je ɔ, je mi kɛ je haomi mi; kpɔ mi kɛ je he nyɛli a dɛ mi. I kpa mo pɛɛ, bu mi tue, nɛ o he ye yi wami.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Ye wesa he, kɛ ye he falɔ, moo bu ye he daa kaa tɛ sa, kɛ mɔ nɛ he wa.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: Ye Mawu, mo kpɔ mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi; mo he mi kɛ je yayami peeli, kɛ yi mi wali a dɛ mi.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ. Yawɛ, kɛ je ye nihe mi tɔɔ ɔ, mo, o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Kɛ je be nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ, mo, o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ. Mo lɛ o je mi kpo kɛ je ye nyɛ mi mi tɔɔ. Ma je o yi daa.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Mo ji ye wesa he nɛ he wa; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ba pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ kɛ ha nihi babauu.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Ma je o yi, nɛ ma wo o hɛ mi nyami ligbi ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Ko sake mi kɛ fɔ he ngɛ ye bwɔmi mi, be nɛ ye he wami ta nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
translation_verse: Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tuɔ ye he munyu yaya, a ya kpee nɛ a soɔ ye yi nɔ;

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: a deɔ ke, “Mawu je e se; waa fie lɛ nɛ waa nu lɛ, ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma kpɔ lɛ ngɛ wa dɛ.”

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Ligbi mluku ɔ tsuo ma wo o ta kaa o yeɔ dami sane; ma de daa ke yi wami helɔ ji mo. Pohu níhi nɛ o peeɔ ɔ hiɛ babauu pe bɔ nɛ ye juɛmi maa su he hulɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: He wami ní nguanguahi nɛ mo, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ o tsu ɔ, ma gba kɛ tsɔɔ. Ma je o yi ke mo pɛ lɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Mawu, kɛ je ye nihe mi tɔɔ nɛ o tsɔɔ mi ní, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu i ngɛ o nyakpɛ ní tsumi ɔmɛ a he odase yee.

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Mo lɛ o ha nɛ i na amanehlu babauu, mo nɔuu lɛ o ma ha ye yi ma na wami ekohu. O maa kpale mi kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba je mi ekohu.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: O maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami babauu, nɛ o ma ha ye bua maa jɔ ekohu.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Mawu, imi hu ma fia kpa saku kɛ je o yi ngɛ anɔkuale nɛ o yeɔ daa a he. Ma la kɛ to saku ɔ he kɛ je o yi, kɛ je mo, Israel Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ o yi.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Ma hwɔ lele, nɛ ma la kɛ je o yi; ma je o yi, ejakaa o he ye yi wami.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Ma ye odase daa ke o yeɔ dami sane. Ejakaa nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa gbe mi ɔ, zo gbe mɛ, nɛ ahlua hu bɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: Mawu, ngɔɔ o dami sane yemi mumi kɛ wo matsɛ ɔ mi, konɛ o bi, odehe ɔ nɛ kojo pɛpɛɛpɛ!

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: É ngɔ dami sane yemi kɛ hyɛ o ma a nɔ; nɛ é ye nɔ́ nali a sane ha mɛ!

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Zugba a nɛ ba ní saminya, nɛ á ye dami sane ngɛ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ nɛ ye ohiatsɛmɛ a sane ha mɛ. E piɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ a he, se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e kɛ mɛ nɛ to ní.

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Be abɔ nɛ pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ yi nɛ na wami kɛ ya neneene.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ yi nɔ nɛ jɔ kaa hiɔmi nɛ nɛɛ pueɔ ngmɔ nɔ nɛ haa zugba a nyu ɔ.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Á ye dami sane saminya ngɛ e yi nɔ; e yi nɔ nɛ jɔ kulaa ngɛ he tsuaa he hluu kɛ yaa su be nɛ nyɔhiɔ be hu!

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: É ye tsɛ kɛ je wo nya hiɛ kɛ ya su wo nya hiɛ, kɛ je Yufrate pa a nya kɛ ya su je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ!

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Nga kplanaa a nɔ bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ bu si.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ nɛ je Spania, kɛ zugbahi nɛ wo bɔle mɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ, á tsu to kɛ ba ha lɛ, nɛ Sheba, kɛ Seba matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ke lɛ ní!

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Ke ohiatsɛ, loo nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ, loo nɔ nɛ be nɔ ko tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e buɔ lɛ tue.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, e naa mɛ mɔbɔ. Nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, e heɔ a yi wami.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: E heɔ a yi wami kɛ jeɔ yi mi wami, kɛ awi yemi mi; ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ muɔ he jua wa ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ yi nɛ na wami! Á ngɔ Arabia sika tsu kɛ ba ha lɛ! A kpa Mawu pɛɛ kɛ ha lɛ be tsuaa be, nɛ a bi gbaami ha lɛ daa ligbi!

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Zugba a nɛ ba ní saminya, nɛ a na blɛfo babauu ngɛ yo ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ. Á na tso yiblii saminya kaa bɔ nɛ a naa ngɛ Lebanon ɔ. Ma amɛ a mi nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ nimli adesahi kaa nga.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ biɛ nɛ hi si kɛ ya neneene. E biɛ nɛ pɛ be abɔ nɛ pu ngɛ nɛ ɔ. Mawu nɛ gbaa je ma amɛ tsuo, nɛ a ha matsɛ ɔ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: A je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi; lɛ nɔ kake too lɛ e peeɔ nyakpɛ níhi!

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: A je e biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi kɛ ya neneene! A wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo! Amen! Amen!

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: David, Isai bi ɔ kue fami ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: ) God Is Good
translation_verse: ) Mawu yeɔ dami sane

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, Mawu hi ha Israel; e hi ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a tsui mi tsɔ.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ye hɛ kɔ he nɔ woli, kɛ yayami peeli a nɔ benɛ i na kaa a ngɛ nɔ yae ngɛ je mi ɔ.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: A he ko he ko yi mɛ ɔ, a ngɛ he wami; a ngɛ kpakpataa.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, he womi ji kuɛ ní nɛ a kɛ fɔ a kuɛ. Yi mi wami ji bo nɛ mɛɛ a haa.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Yayami hyi a tsui mi; daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ ga yaya toe.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: A yeɔ nɔ he fɛu, nɛ a tuɔ nɔ he munyu yaya. A woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a toɔ gahi nɛ a kɛ waa nihi yi mi.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a ya nyɛɛ a se, ejakaa a nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ngɛ a he.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ a deɔ ji, “Oo, Mawu be lee! Hiɔwe No ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛ le kɛɛ?”

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Hyɛ kaa i tsu ye he nɛ mu ko be ye he! Hyɛ kaa i pee ye he klɔuklɔu! Lɛɛ tse enɛ ɔ tsuo peeɔ yaka?

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Mawu, o haa nɛ i naa nɔ́ ligbi ɔ tsuo; o gblaa ye tue daa mɔtu.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Se ke i de nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ i tɔ, nɛ i pee we ye ní kaa o ma mi no.

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i ya mo Mawu ɔ, o we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ i ya na bɔ nɛ yayami peeli a nyagbe maa ba ha ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Ee, a hɛ mi ma kpata si kake too; a nyagbe maa pee gbeye.

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: A ngɛ kaa nlami nɛ nɔ ko nla; mɔtu kɛkɛ e se po. Nyɔmtsɛ, ke o te si ɔ, a maa laa.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Benɛ i hao, nɛ i ngɛ tsui yee ɔ,

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: i je kuasia; i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; i pee kaa lohwe ngɛ o hɛ mi.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma hi o kasa nya daa; o maa pɛtɛ ye he.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: O maa wo mi ga, nɛ o maa tsɔɔ mi blɔ. Nyagbe ɔ, o ma he mi atuu, nɛ o maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ i pa ngɛ ngɛ hiɔwe pe mo? O se ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ hu.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ kua mo ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ yi mo anɔkuale ɔ, o ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ e hi kaa ma hɛ mi kɛ su Mawu he. Ma ya sa we ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɔ, nɛ ma sɛɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: Mawu, mɛni he je lɛ o hɛ wɔ ngɔ fɔ he ɔ? Anɛ o mi mi ma fu mo nitsɛ o ma a daa kikɛ nɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Moo nyɛɛ kɛ ya he nɛ plɛ pee we doku ɔ; he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpata níhi tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ o we ɔ.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: O he nyɛli ɔmɛ ya he ose ngɛ o he klɔuklɔu ɔ. A ngɔ a we aflangaa amɛ ya to lejɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye kunimi.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: A ngɛ kaa ni komɛ nɛ ngɔ gbiɛ kɛ ngɛ tso hɛɛe ngɛ pu mi.

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: A ngɔ gbiɛ kɛ hamle kɛ ku tsohi nɛ a kpɛ ɔ tsuo a mi dukuduku.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: A to kaa a ma kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Zugba a nɔ hehi nɛ a kpee ngɛ nɛ a jaa Mawu ɔ, a mɛ lɛ tsuo he la.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Wa pa nɛ okadi ko hu; gbalɔ ko gbalɔ ko be hu. Nɔ ko nɔ ko hu li be nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se maa po.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: Mawu, kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa muɔ mo? Anɛ a maa gbe o biɛ ɔ he guɛ kɛ maa ya neneene lo?

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Se Mawu, kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, mo ji wa matsɛ; o he wa yi wami be babauu.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: O kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ gba wo ɔ mi, nɛ o ywia wo mi lohwe gbeyegbeye ɔmɛ a yi.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Lohwe ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Leviatan ɔ, mo lɛ o ywia e yi, nɛ o ngɔ e he lo ɔ ngɔ ha nga nɔ lohwehi nɛ a ye.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: O ha nɛ pa tsɔwitsɔwihi hia kɛ be, nɛ pa nguahi lɛɛ a mi nyu mii ta.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Mo lɛ o bɔ nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ o ngɔ pu kɛ hlami ngɔ to a blɔ hehi.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Mo lɛ o to huzu kɛ ha je ɔ; o pee latsa be kɛ fĩɛ be.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ mo kai kaa o he nyɛli ɔmɛ muɔɔ mo; nimli nɛ li Mawu ngɛ o biɛ he guɛ gbee.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Koo ngmɛɛ o ma nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ he kɛ ha a he nyɛli yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ. O ma nɛ a ngɛ yi mi wae ɔ, o hɛ ko je a nɔ.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Mo kai somi nɛ o kɛ wɔ so ɔ. Zugba a nɔ hehi nɛ wo diblii ɔ, yi wu tso níhi lɛ a peeɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ, ko ha zo nɛ gbe mɛ. Ha nɛ nɔ́ nali, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ a je o yi.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Mawu lee, wa naa mo si. Wa naa mo si! Wa ngɛ o biɛ ta woe, nɛ wa ngɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ jajee.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Je ɔ kɛ e mi níhi tsuo ma mimiɛ; se imi ma ha je ɔ sisi tomi ɔmɛ maa ma si kpɛii.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: I ngɛ he nɔ woli dee ke, ‘Nyɛ ko fĩa!’ I ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ dee ke, ‘Nyɛ ko wo nyɛ he nɔ!’

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Ejakaa, ke a ma ha nɔ ko blɔ nya, aloo a ma wo e nɔ ɔ, he wami nɛ ɔ, pi beleku je, loo bonyoku je, loo omleyi je nɛ e je.

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Mawu ji kojolɔ; e woɔ ni komɛ a nɔ, nɛ e baa ni komɛ si.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hɛɛ kplu ko ngɛ e dɛ mi, nɛ dã kpakpa nɛ nya wa hyi lɛ tɔ. E maa po dã nɛ ɔ ha nimli yayamihi tsuo, nɛ a maa hi nue hluu kɛ yaa si dã a sisi tɔɔ.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ ma ye Yakob Mawu ɔ he odase kɛ maa ya neneene; ma la kɛ je e yi daa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: E maa ba nimli yayamihi a he wami ɔ si; se nimli kpakpahi lɛɛ e ma ha nɛ a na he wami kɛ bɔ he.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: A le Mawu ngɛ Yuda, a woɔ e biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ Israel.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: E we ngɛ Yerusalem, Zion ji he nɛ e hii.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ lɛ e ku he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta hwumi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ: kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi, kɛ tsɛ̃i, kɛ klaate.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: He nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a da ta a nya kulaa. A gbo kɛ pueɔ si kaa nihi nɛ hwɔ mahe nɛ a kpakpaa a he níhi tsuo.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Benɛ mo Yakob Mawu ɔ wo gbi ɔ, okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ tsuo gbo kɛ pue si.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, o he ngɛ gbeye! Ke o mi mi fu ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ o hɛ mi maa da?

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: O kojo, nɛ a nu he kɛ je hiɔwe tɔɔ; je ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ e pee dii.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ si, nɛ nyɛɛ ye siwo ɔmɛ a nɔ. Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ bɔle Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nike ní ba ha lɛ.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Ganɔhi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, e baa mɛ si; e woɔ matsɛmɛ nguanguahi hu a he gbeye.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: I fa kue boboobo ha Mawu; i fa kue ha Mawu, nɛ e nu ye gbi.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, i hla Nyɔmtsɛ se blɔ. Nyɔ mi ɔ, i wo ye nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ i sɔle nɛ ye kɔni gbo we. I na we bua jɔmi ko kulaa.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo i hwɔ we mahe, kikɛ nɛ ɔ ye hɛngmɛ fɔɔ si paa. I hao tsɔ, nɛ i nyɛ we ma tu munyu.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Ye juɛmi ya su blema lokoo, nɛ i kai jehahi nɛ be kɛ ho.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “Anɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma kua wɔ daa nɛ lo? Anɛ e pa be wa he bua jɔmi nae hu lo?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Anɛ Mawu hɛ je nɔ kaa e maa na mɔbɔ lo? Anɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ abofu ba da mɔbɔ nami nane mi lo?”

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i kɛ hɛdɔ bi ke, “Anɛ Mawu hiɔ nine ɔ tsu we ní hu lo? Anɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ pa be he wami ko hu lo?”

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃, Yawɛ, i kai níhi nɛ o tsu blema a; ee, i kai nyakpɛ ní nguahi nɛ o pee ɔ.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Ma susu níhi tsuo nɛ o pee ɔ a he; nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee blema a, ma kai.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: Mawu, o níhi tsuo ngɛ klɔuklɔu! Te Mawu nɔ́ nɛ pa kle kaa mo, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ?

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ní ji mo; o je o he wami kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ je ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: O ngɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ he o ma a yi wami; ee, o he Yakob kɛ Yosef a bimɛ ɔmɛ a yi wami.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: Mawu, benɛ pa a na mo ɔ, e ye gbeye, nɛ wo ɔ sisi mimiɛ.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Hiɔmi nɛ kɛ je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi pue si. Hiɔwe si, nɛ oslabai gba kɛ bɔle si.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Hiɔwe si kplala-la-la kɛ po si kaa lasiogblee nɛ bee. Oslabai la a ha nɛ je ɔ mi pee heii, nɛ zugba a mimiɛ.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: O nyɛɛ kɛ gu wo ɔ mi; o po wo nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ kɛ be, se o nane mami he ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko li.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: O ngɔ Mose kɛ Aaron ngɔ to o ma a nya, nɛ o kpaka mɛ kaa to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: Ye ma, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ ɔ tue; nyɛɛ bu ye nya mi munyu ɔmɛ tue.

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Ma tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi; ma gba nyɛ blema nyakpɛ sanehi:

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: níhi nɛ wa le, nɛ wa nu, níhi nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ de wɔ.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Wa be ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔe kɛ laa wa bimɛ. Yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ, ní nguanguahi nɛ Yawɛ tsu, nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e pee, kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, wa maa gba mɛ.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: E ha Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa; ee, e ngɔ e munyu ɔ kɛ ha Yakob nina a. E fa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke a tsɔɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ mlaa a,

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: konɛ yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ nɛ kase, nɛ mɛ hu a tsɔɔ a bimɛ.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Efraim bi ɔmɛ mia, nɛ a hɛɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃, se benɛ ta hwumi be ɔ su ɔ, a ma fo kɛ je ta a nya.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Somi nɛ Mawu kɛ mɛ so ɔ, a yi nɔ; e mlaa a hu a kua nɔ yemi.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: E gba wo ɔ mi, nɛ nyu ɔ da si glekugleku ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ; nɛ e ha nɛ e ma a gu mi kɛ be.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Piani ɔ, e kɛ bɔku tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ, nyɔ mi lɛɛ e haa mɛ la nɛ hii kpɛe.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: E gba tɛ sahi a mi ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ nyu babauu nɛ a nu.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ nyu je tɛ sa mi babaaba kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃, a ya nɔ pee yayami kɛ si Mawu; a tsɔ atuã kɛ si Hiɔwe No ɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: A bi Mawu ke e ha mɛ niye ní nɛ mɛɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ, nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi ka Mawu.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: A tu munyu kɛ si Mawu, nɛ a bi ke, “Anɛ Mawu ma nyɛ ma ha wɔ niye ní ngɛ nga a nɔ lo?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Niinɛ, e fia tɛ sa a nɔ́ nɛ nyu je mi kɛ be babaaba kaa pa nɛ hia. Se anɛ e ma nyɛ ma ha e ma a abolo, kɛ lo hu lo?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yawɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ. E ngɔ la kɛ gbla e ma a tue; e mi mi fumi ɔ nya bɛ si kulaa.

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a ngɔɛ a hɛ kɛ fɔɛ Mawu nɔ; a he we yi kaa e ma he a yi wami.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃, e fa, nɛ hiɔwe sinya amɛ bli.

english_verse: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
translation_verse: E ha mɛ ngma kɛ je hiɔwe; ee, e ha mɛ mana nɛ a ye.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Mawu ha mɛ niye ní babauu; ee, adesahi na Mawu bɔfohi a niye ní lɛ a ye.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: E ha nɛ beleku kɔɔhiɔ fia ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ e he wami kpaka leneyi kɔɔhiɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ je hiɔwe ba, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Lohwe ɔmɛ ba nɔɔ si ngɛ ma sito he ɔ, ngɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a he kɛ bɔle lejɛ ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Mawu ha ma a niye ní nɛ a tsui suɔ, nɛ a ye, nɛ a tɔ saminya.

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: Mawu mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e gbe a kpɛti katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji Israel nihewi kpakpa amɛ.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: A ma kai kaa Mawu ji a he bulɔ; a ma kai kaa Mawu, Hiɔwe No ɔ ji nɔ nɛ heɔ a yi wami.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Se munyuhi nɛ jeɔ a nya a, lakpa sɔuu; a de we nɔ́ ko kɛ ji a tsui mi.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ ji Mawu he je ɔ, e ngɔ a he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ e kpataa we a hɛ mi. Behi fuu ke e mi mi miɔ nɛ e ma fu, kɛkɛ e tsi nya amlɔ.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: E kaiɔ kaa adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ; a ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ fia kɛ be nɛ kpale we e se kɛ bɛ hu.

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: A ka Mawu nɔtonɔto; a wo Israel nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ mi mi la.

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, e pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ Zoan nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ Egipt.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ pa amɛ plɛ pee muɔ, nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyu nɛ a nu.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ pwɔlwɔɛ ba babauu, nɛ a ba hao ma mi bi ɔmɛ. Ovɔnɔhi babauu hu ba jã kɛ̃, nɛ a ba puɛ ní ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: E kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu gbe a wai tso ɔmɛ; a ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ lɛɛ, e kɛ fiɛ nɛ nya wa gbe mɛ.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: E kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu gbe a na amɛ; a to ɔmɛ lɛɛ e kɛ oslabai gbe mɛ.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: E mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ abofu nɛ ɔ ngɔ haomi babauu kɛ ba a nɔ kaa Mawu bɔfohi kpataa nɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: E gbe bitɛtehi tsuo ngɛ we tsuaa we mi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Se lɛ nitsɛ e ma a lɛɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ kaa to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: E hɛɛ mɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ nɛ a yi gbeye. Se a he nyɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ wo ɔ ku kɛ pue a nɔ.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: E ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba e yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ. E kɛ mɛ ba yo ɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ e he wami kɛ kpɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: E fie ma je li ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ mi. E dla a zugba a ngɔ ha e ma a, nɛ lejɛ ɔ ba pee a weto ní, kɛ a hi he.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Se a ka Mawu, Hiɔwe No ɔ; a tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã, nɛ a yi e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: A kɛ a jami he ɔmɛ wo e mi mi la, nɛ a we amaga amɛ ha nɛ e pee kaa hunga jelɔ.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu, nɛ e kua e ma a pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: E si e sihi he ɔ nɛ ngɛ Shilo ɔ, bo tsu ɔ nɛ e hi mi ngɛ e ma a kpɛti ɔ.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: E mi mi fu lɛ nitsɛ e ma a wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha a he nyɛli nɛ a gbe mɛ kɛ klaate.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: La kpata nihewi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ nyumuhi nɛ a gba.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔmɛ gbo ngɛ klaate nya, nɛ a yalɔyi ɔmɛ yi kɔmɔ ha mɛ.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ te si pam kaa nɔ ko nɛ je mahe mi, aloo oblai nɛ nu dã, nɛ ngɛ huhui kpae.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: E wo e he nyɛli ɔmɛ fo kɛ ho kɛ zo; e bɔ mɛ ahlua kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: E kua Yosef nina a; e hlɛ Efraim wɛtso ɔ.

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, e hla Yuda wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Zion yo ɔ nɛ e suɔ saminya a.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ lɛ e ma e we klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ. We nɛ ɔ ngɛ he wami, nɛ e maa hi si daa kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba ngɛ ɔ pɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: E hla e tsɔlɔ David hulɔ; e je lɛ kɛ je to lɛmi he ɔ.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: Mawu, ma je li ɔmɛ ba tua o zugba a. A ble o we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ a pee Yerusalem ma doku.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: A ngɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a ye. A ngɔ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he lo kɛ ha pu mi lohwehi.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: A pue o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a muɔ si babauu; muɔ be ngɛ Yerusalem kaa nyu, nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa pu gbogboe ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Je mahi nɛ li mo, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ja we mo ɔ, o mi mi nɛ fu mɛ.

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a gbe o ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpata o zugba a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Koo ngɔ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ gbla wa tue. Pee esɔ nɛ o na wɔ mɔbɔ, ejakaa wa kɔni mi jɔ̃.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: Mawu, piɛ wa he nɛ o he wa yi wami. Mo he wɔ, nɛ o ngɔ wa he yayami kɛ pa wɔ kɛ wo mo nitsɛ o biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je lɛ je ma amɛ ma bi wɔ ke, “Jije nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ?” Je mahi nɛ pue o tsɔli ɔmɛ a muɔ si ɔ, gbla a tue nɛ waa na kɛ wa hɛngmɛ.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe; bu tue! Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi ɔ, ngɔɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ kpɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, je mahi tsuo nɛ ye o he fɛu ɔ, gbla a tue si kpaago kɛ to nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ nya.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Ke o pee ja a, wɔ, o ma a, o to kuu ɔ, wa maa na mo si, nɛ wa ma je o yi daa.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Israel to hyɛlɔ, mo nɛ o nyɛɛɔ Israel hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to ɔ, moo bu wɔ tue koo! Mo nɛ o hii si ngɛ hɛ kali a nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Mawu, kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu. Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu! O ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ maa wo o mi mi la kɛ yaa si mɛni be?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Ngma nɛ o haa wɔ nɛ wa yeɔ wa tɔɔ, kɛ nyu hu nɛ wa nuɔ kɛkɛ ji vo nyu.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Mawu Tabohiatsɛ, kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu. Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: O ngɔ wai tso kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba. O fie je ma amɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ, nɛ o ma wai tso ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: O dla zugba a saminyayoo; o ha nɛ tso ɔ tsɛ̃ sipoku kɛ ya zu mi tsitsaa, nɛ wai tso ɔ ha zugba a nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: E hɔ̃ ɔ ha yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ hu ha seda tso nguangua amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: E gba kɔni kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ, ee, kɛ ya su Yufrate pa a he tɔɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o gbɛ piɛ ɔ ngɛ e he? Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ gbaa ya tsɔɔ wai yiblii ɔ eko.

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Nga mi kpotoohi ngɛ wai yiblii ɔ hɛ mi kpatae, nɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo ngɛ yee.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Mawu Tabohiatsɛ! Wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kpale kɛ ba wa ngɔ ekohu. Moo ma o yi si ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o hyɛ! Moo hyɛ wai tso bɔbɔyoo nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: Wai tso bɔbɔyoo ɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o ma, nɛ o hyɛ nɔ saminya kɛ ya si e bɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ba nɛ o ba he e yi wami.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ mɛ wai tso ɔ he la nɛ a po lɛ ngɔ fɔ si. O mi mi nɛ fu mɛ, nɛ o kpata a hɛ mi.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ mo nitsɛ o je blɔ hla mɛ, nɛ o ha nɛ a he wa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, moo bu a he, nɛ o baa a yi.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Wa be o se jee hu kɔkɔɔkɔ. Ha nɛ wa yi nɛ na wami, nɛ wa ma je o yi daa.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu! Moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu. Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami!

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Nyɛ wo nyɛ gbi nɔ kɛ la ha Mawu, wa he bulɔ ɔ. Nyɛ hwɔ lele kɛ je Yakob Mawu ɔ yi.

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je la, nɛ nyɛɛ fia gɔgɔ. Nyɛɛ fia saku nɛ gbi ngɔɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ fia miɛ kɛ piɛ he.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpa titimati wa nyami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo, be mi nɛ nyɔhiɔ da, kɛ be mi nɛ nyɔhiɔ ɔ wa.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ ngɛ Israel ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; Yakob Mawu ɔ lɛ wo.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Mawu wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ, benɛ e ya puɛ ní ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ. I nu nɛ nɔ ko nɛ i li lɛ ngɛ dee ke,

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: “I je nyɛ tlomi ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nɔ; i ha nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɛ nyɛ kusii ɔmɛ a he.
