english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ mi. I he nɔ kɛ je ye laami he ɔ, he nɛ hiɔwe siɔ kɛ jee ɔ, nɛ i he nyɛ yi wami. Jehanɛ se hu, i ka nyɛ ngɛ Meriba nyu ɔ he.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Ye ma, nyɛɛ bu tue nɛ ma wo nyɛ ga. Israel bi, i na nɛ nyɛ bu mi tue!

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a na mawu kpahi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; nyɛ ko ja ma se mawuhi.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ pa nyɛ nya mi hatoo, nɛ ma lɛ nyɛ.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: “Se ye ma a bui mi tue; Israel bi ɔmɛ bui mi.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ngmɛɛ a je mi he ngɔ ha mɛ, konɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsui suɔ.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: I na nɛ ye ma a bu mi tue; i na nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ye se!

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: Jinɛ i ba a he nyɛli ɔmɛ si momoomo; jinɛ i kpata a hɛ mi kɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Jinɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume imi, Yawɛ ɔ, a kpla si ngɛ ye hɛ mi, nɛ a ngɛ a tue gblae kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ ma lɛ nyɛ kɛ ngma kpakpa. Ma ha nyɛ hwo babauu kɛ je tɛ sa mi nɛ nyɛ maa ye.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Mawu daa si ngɛ hiɔwe gua nguaa a mi. E ngɛ kojoli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kae ke,

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ awusahi a sane ha mɛ. Nyɛɛ tu munyu ha nɔ́ nali, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ be nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ kɛ je nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ! Nyɛ be juɛmi! Diblii mi kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe. Dami sane yemi se po ngɛ je ɔ mi.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: I ke, ‘Mawuhi ji nyɛ; nyɛ tsuo Hiɔwe No ɔ bimɛ ji nyɛ.’

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Mawu, ba nɛ o ba kojo je ɔ, ejakaa je ma amɛ tsuo o níhi ji mɛ.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: Mawu, ko ma o nya; koo pee dii, koo pee kɔ̃!

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ basabasa pee; nihi nɛ sume mo ɔ tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: A ngɛ dee ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ wa kpata ma a hɛ mi, konɛ biɛ Israel ɔ, nɔ ko kó kai hu.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Ee, a pee kake kɛ wo o he; mɛ tsuo a so kɛ wo o he:

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Edom bi, kɛ Ishmael bi; Moab bi, kɛ Hagrit bi;

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Gebal bi, Amon bi, Amalek bi, Filistia bi, kɛ Tiro bi.

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Asiria hu ba piɛ a he. Lot bimɛ ɔmɛ a kɔni nguaa kake ji mɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Midian bi ɔmɛ. Pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Sisera kɛ Yabin ngɛ Kishon pa a nya a.

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: O kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ Endor, nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ sa ngɛ zugba.

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: Mɛ lɛ a de ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ngɔ Mawu zugba a kɛ pee wa nɔ.”

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Ye Mawu, gbɛɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa kaa bunyuku nɛ lasiogblee muɔ kɛ bee, aloo jakati nɛ kɔɔhiɔ sɛ mi.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã hue, nɛ la lilɛ haa yokuhi sãã a,

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ kɛ yaa si a maa na o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ pue si nɛ a ye gbeye daa. Ha nɛ a hao, nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata,

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: konɛ a le kaa mo Yawɛ, mo nɔ kake too lɛ o ngɛ he wami pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, i suɔ o we ɔ saminya!

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: I na nɛ i ba lejɛ ɔ! Ye hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ mo Yawɛ o we ɔ he. Imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo i ngɛ lae kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ ngɛ Yawɛ yi jee.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, ye matsɛ, kɛ ye Mawu! Otokliihi, kɛ mawubitɛtehi po maa tsu ngɛ o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya, nɛ a lɛɛ a bimɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ hii o we ɔ mi, nɛ laa daa kɛ jeɔ o yi ɔ, a gbaa mɛ.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ naa a he wami kɛ jeɔ o mi, nɛ a hlaa kaa a maa hia blɔ kɛ ya Zion yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, a gbaa mɛ.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Ke a ya gu ya fomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ be kɛkɛ lejɛ ɔ plɛ pee pa nɛ gbiɛ nyu hyi lɛ tɔ.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Pɔ tɔɛ mɛ; mohu ɔ, a naa he wami he, nɛ a nyɛɛɔ kɛ ya suu Mawu hɛ mi tɔɔ ngɛ Zion.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu, bu ye kue fami ɔ tue! Yakob Mawu, moo bu mi tue koo!

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Mawu, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbaa wa matsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ligbi kake nɛ nɔ ko maa ye ngɛ o we ɔ hi pe ligbi akpe nɛ e maa ye ngɛ he kpa ko. Ma suɔ nɛ ma pee agbo nya bulɔ ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ we ɔ mohu, pe kaa ma hi yayami peeli a we mi.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu ji wa pu kɛ wa tsɛ̃i. E naa wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ e woɔ wa hɛ mi nyami. Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e ha we nɛ nɔ́ ko hiaa mɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ lee, nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ ɔ, a gbaa mɛ!

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o na wa zugba a mɔbɔ, nɛ o ha nɛ Israel ná e he ekohu.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: O ngɔ o ma a tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pa mɛ.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: O mi mi la nɛ nya wa a se po, nɛ o mi mi fu we wɔ hu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: Mawu, wa yi wami helɔ, kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu. O mi mi ko fu wɔ hu!

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Ha nɛ waa ba nɔ ekohu, konɛ wɔ, o ma a, wa je o yi.

english_verse: Show us your love and save us!
translation_verse: Yawɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ nɛ o he wa yi wami.

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu ngɛ dee ɔ, i nu. E ngɛ wɔ, e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ dee ke e ma ha wɔ tue mi jɔmi, se wa ko kpale ya je kuasia hu.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, Mawu pee klaalo kɛ ma he nihi nɛ jaa lɛ ɔ a yi wami; konɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ hi wa zugba a mi.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Mɔbɔ nami, kɛ anɔkuale kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi; dami kɛ tue mi jɔmi fua a sibi atuu.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Adesa we anɔkuale ɔ maa je zugba kɛ ya hiɔwe; nɛ Mawu dami ɔ maa hyɛ zugba a kɛ je hiɔwe.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, Yawɛ ma ha wɔ ní kpakpahi, nɛ wa zugba a maa ba ní bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Dami maa nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e ma dla blɔ ngɔ to lɛ.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi; ejakaa ye yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Mo he ye yi wami, ejakaa i yeɔ mo anɔkuale. Ye Mawu, mo he mi; ejakaa o tsɔlɔ ji mi, nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ; ejakaa mo lɛ i faa kue kɛ haa daa ligbi.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, ha nɛ o tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ na bua jɔmi, ejakaa mo lɛ i faa kue kɛ haa.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, o hi, nɛ o kɛ yayami paa nɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ faa kue kɛ haa mo ɔ, o naa lɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ o bɔ ɔ ma ba kpla si ngɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ a ma je o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ yi.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o kle, nɛ o tsuɔ nyakpɛ níhi. Mo nɔ kake too ji Mawu.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ kaa ma pee, nɛ ma ye mo anɔkuale sisiisi. Ha nɛ ma ngɔ ye he wami tsuo kɛ sɔmɔ mo.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, ye Mawu, ma je o yi kɛ ye tsui tsuo, nɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, ma wo ta daa.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: O na mi mɔbɔ be babauu; gbeje tete po lɛ o je mi kɛ je.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Mawu, he woli, yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ li mo te si wo mi, nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe mi.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Se mo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, Mawu mɔbɔ nalɔ, kɛ Mawu nɛ suɔ nɔ ji mo. O toɔ o tsui si ha wɔ; o dlooɔ nɔ, nɛ o yeɔ nɔ anɔkuale daa.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Plɛ o hɛ mi ha mi, nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ. Wo imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ he wami, nɛ o kpɔ mi. Ejakaa bɔ nɛ maa, o mawayo ɔ sɔmɔ mo ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ i ngɛ mo sɔmɔe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi o mɔbɔ nami ɔ he okadi ko, konɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a na, nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ kaa o piɛ ye he, nɛ o jɔɔ ye bua.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Yawɛ to e ma a sisi kɛ ma e yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: E suɔ Yerusalem pe hehi tsuo ngɛ Israel.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Mawu ma, bu tue! Yawɛ ngɛ ní kpakpahi dee ngɛ o he:

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: “Ma tsɛ Egipt, kɛ Babilonia kɛ piɛ ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he. Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ hu ma tsɛ Filistia, Tiro, kɛ Sudan kɛ piɛ a he.”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: A ma tsɛ Zion ke je ma amɛ tsuo a nyɛ, ejakaa Hiɔwe No ɔ nitsɛ maa to lɛ si.

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa ngma ni ɔmɛ tsuo a biɛ, nɛ a ma tsɛ mɛ ke Yerusalem ma a mi bi.

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: A maa do, nɛ a ma la ke, “Zion lɛ wa gbaami ɔmɛ tsuo jeɔ.”

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu, ye yi wami helɔ! Nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo i foɔ ya ngɛ o hɛ mi.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Haomi babauu ba ye nɔ, nɛ i kɛ gbenɔ he kɛ we saasaa.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: O ha nɛ ye huɛmɛ kua mi; o ha nɛ ye he tsɛ̃ mɛ. I pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ a sa e yi, nɛ e li he nɛ e maa ya.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Aywilɛho sɔuu ha nɛ ye hɛngmɛ nɔ ha. Yawɛ, i tsɛɔ mo daa nɛ; i woɔ ye nine nɔ, nɛ i faa kue kɛ haa mo daa.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Anɛ ni gbogboehi lɛ o peeɔ nyakpɛ ni kɛ haa lo? Anɛ gbogboehi maa te si, nɛ a ma je o yi lo?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: O nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ ɔ, anɛ diblii mi lɛ a maa na ngɛ lo? Zugba a, he nɛ nihi a hɛ jee níhi a nɔ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ lɛ a maa na o dami ɔ ngɛ lo?

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mɛni he je lɛ o kua mi? Mɛni he je lɛ o ngɔ o hɛ mi kɛ laa mi?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Kɛ je ye nihe mi hluu kɛ ba si piɔ ɔ, amanehlu sɔuu lɛ i ngɛ nae, nɛ i miɔ nɛ ma gbo. O gbla ye tue nɛ ye he wami ta.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: O mi mi fu mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ; o wo ye he gbeye hluu kɛ ya si ye hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: O ha nɛ ye huɛmɛ kpakpahi tsuo kua mi, nɛ diblii ba pee ye huɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ma la daa kɛ tsɔɔ kaa o suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe. Ma sɛɛ ha yi nɔhi tsuo ke anɔkuale yelɔ ji mo.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: I le kaa o suɔmi ɔ maa hi si daa. O we anɔkuale yemi ɔ hu be nyagbe; e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: O de ke, “I kɛ nɔ nɛ i hla lɛ ɔ so somi ko. I ka ye tsɔlɔ David kita ke,

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, hiɔwe ma je nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ a yi; a ma la kɛ je o yi kaa o yeɔ anɔkuale.

english_verse: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ kaa mo? Hiɔwe nibɔ ní ɔmɛ te nɔ́ nɛ kɛ mo sɔ?

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: A buu mo ngɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi a kpe ɔ mi; mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a yeɔ mo gbeye.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu! Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ he wami kaa mo Yawɛ? O yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.

english_verse: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
translation_verse: Ke wo gli, nɛ oslɔke ngɛ fiae ɔ, mo lɛ o jɔɔ he.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: O níhi ji hiɔwe ɔ kɛ zugba a tsuo; mo lɛ o bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi níhi tsuo.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: O bɔ omleyi je, kɛ leneyi je. Tabor yo ɔ, kɛ Hermon yo ɔ ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ o yi jee.

english_verse: You are strong and mighty!
translation_verse: He walɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ji mo; o he wami ɔ kle!

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: O matsɛ yemi ɔ, dami sane yemi nɔ a to lɛ sisi kɛ fɔ. Suɔmi kɛ anɔkuale yemi jeɔ kpo ngɛ o nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi mi.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: A gbaa nihi nɛ le bɔ nɛ a laa kɛ jaa mo. Mo Yawɛ, o maa na mɛ mɔbɔ daa.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Mo o he ɔ, a bua jɔɔ a he daa nɛ; a jeɔ o yi, ejakaa o hi.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Mo lɛ o haa nɛ a yeɔ kunimi nguahi. Mo lɛ o naa wɔ mɔbɔ loko wa yeɔ manye.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo lɛ o hla wa he falɔ ɔ kɛ ha wɔ; mo, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, mo lɛ o ha wɔ wa matsɛ. Mawu wo David si

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Be ko ɔ, o kɛ o tsɔli klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tu munyu ngɛ nina mi, nɛ o de mɛ ke, “I fi katsɛ ko jlasi. I ngɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ ha nɔ ko nɛ i hla kɛ je ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: I ngɔ ye nu klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ pɔ ye tsɔlɔ David, nɛ i wo lɛ matsɛ.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: Ye nine maa hi e he be tsuaa be, nɛ ma wo lɛ he wami.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: E he nyɛli a nine be e nɔ sue; yayami peeli be nyɛe maa ye e nɔ.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Ma kpata e he nyɛli a hɛ mi; ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɔ lɛ ɔ, ma gbe mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Ma suɔ lɛ, ma ye lɛ anɔkuale, nɛ ma ha e maa ye kunimi daa.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ ma blɛke kɛ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ ya su Yufrate pa a he.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: E ma tsɛ mi ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ, ye Mawu, ye he bulɔ, kɛ ye yi wami helɔ.’

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Imi hu ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ pee ye bitɛte; ma pee lɛ matsɛ nɛ kle pe je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Ma suɔ lɛ, nɛ ma na lɛ mɔbɔ daa; somi nɛ i kɛ lɛ so ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: E weku kpa se be poe gblegbleegble; e maa hi kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Daa nɛ ɔ, e nina ko maa hi sɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: ke a kua ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ a yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: lɛɛ ma gbla a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ ma ha a maa na nɔ́.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Somi ɔ nɛ i kɛ lɛ so ɔ, i be se jee; si nɛ i wo lɛ ɔ, i be tsakee.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: “I kɛ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ wo si kaa i be David lakpa yee gblegbleegble.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: E nina maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene. Ma bu e matsɛ yemi ɔ he be abɔ nɛ pu ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, o mi mi fu lɛ; o kua lɛ, nɛ o hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ he.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Somi nɛ o kɛ o tsɔlɔ ɔ so ɔ, o je se; o sake e matsɛ pɛɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ zugba, nɛ o ble lɛ.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ, o ku lɛ tsuo pue si, nɛ mɔ ɔmɛ plɛ pee ní kokoehi.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ guu lejɛ ɔ, juɔ e níhi; e plɛ pee muɔ nɔ́ ha e he nihi po.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: O ha nɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye kunimi, nɛ mɛ tsuo a na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Ee, o ha nɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ pee yaka, nɛ e nyɛ we ta a nya nɛ e da.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: O he e hiɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ o sake e matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ zugba.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: O po e nihe mi be ɔ nɔ kpiti, nɛ o ha nɛ e hɛ mi pue si. Kue fami

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Mo kai kaa ye wami be ɔ ngɛ kuku. Mɛni he je lɛ o bɔ nɔmlɔ adesa yaka gu ɔ?

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, suɔmi nɛ o je kpo blema a, jije jamɛ a suɔmi ɔ ngɛ? Níhi nɛ o wo David si ke o maa pee ɔ, jije ní ɔmɛ ngɛ?

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: A je Yawɛ yi daa. Amen! Amen!

english_verse: ) God Is Eternal
translation_verse: ) Mawu kɛ adesa

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, mo ji wa wesa he ngɛ yi nɔhi tsuo a mi.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Benɛ o na we nɛ o bɔ yo ɔmɛ; benɛ o na we nɛ o bɔ je ɔ, mo ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa si neneene.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: O deɔ adesa ke, “Kpale kɛ ya o je he!” Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ plɛɔ peeɔ tabo zu.

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Moo lɛɛ jeha akpe ngɛ kaa ligbi kake ha mo; e ngɛ kaa hiɛmɛ a je hiɛ nɛ be momo, aloo be bɔɔ kɛkɛ ngɛ nyɔ mi.

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: Mɔtu ɔ, e blɛkeɔ saminyayoo, se gbɔkuɛ ɔ, e nglaa, nɛ e gboɔ.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: O ngɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pue o hɛ mi; wa diblii mi yayami ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ o hɛ mi paa.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Ke o mi mi fu wɔ ɔ, o poɔ wa wami be ɔ nɔ kpiti kaa a woɔ mumi.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Wa wami be ɔ tsuo ji jeha nyingmi kpaago. Ke wa ngɛ he wami ɔ, wa naa nyingmi kpaanyɔ, se lɛ tsuo peeɔ haomi kɛ aywilɛho sɔuu. Wa wami se poɔ tlukaa; nɛ wa bee kɛ yaa kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ te kɛ bee.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ le bɔ nɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ nya wa ha? Bɔ nɛ o he ngɛ gbeye ɔ, ja lɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ waa na kaa wa wami se kɛ we kulaa, konɛ waa le ní.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Naa wɔ mɔbɔ daa mɔtu, konɛ wa na bua jɔmi wa wami be ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ wɔ, o tsɔli ɔmɛ, waa na o ní tsumi ɔmɛ. Ha nɛ wa bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu, naa wɔ mɔbɔ! Ha nɛ wa ní tsumi nɛ ya nɔ! Ee, ha nɛ wa ní tsumi nɛ ya nɔ!

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ hii Hiɔwe No ɔ laami he ɔ, Ope ɔ nitsɛ maa baa e yi.

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: E ma de Yawɛ ke, “Mo ji ye wesa he, kɛ ye he bulɔ. Mo ji ye Mawu; i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.”

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: E maa bu o he, nɛ o yi ma na wami kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ bi ngɛ e nyɛ pɛli sisi. Si nɛ e wo ke e maa ye mo anɔkuale ɔ maa pee kaa tsɛ̃i, kɛ dama nɛ ma fa o he.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: O be nyɔ mi ní yayamihi, loo piani oslaa kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kikɛ nɛ ɔ gbeye yee.

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: Gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ puɛɔ ní ngɛ diblii mi ɔ, o be lɛ gbeye yee. Piani hu o be hiɔ nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi gbeye yee.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: O hɛngmɛ kɛkɛ lɛ o kɛ maa hyɛ bɔ nɛ a maa gbla yayami peeli a tue ha.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ o ngɔ Yawɛ, Hiɔwe No ɔ kɛ pee o he bulɔ, kɛ o wesa he he je ɔ,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be o he sae; o we ɔ mi hu, haomi ko be lejɛ ɔ bae.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Mawu ma ha nɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ maa bu o he ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ o maa ya.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: A maa hɛɛ mo ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ko tɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: O maa naa jata, kɛ sanga nɔ; o maa naa jata bi kɛ sinɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nɔ nɛ suɔ mi, nɛ e le ye biɛ Yawɛ ɔ, ma he e yi wami, nɛ ma bu e he.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Ke e tsɛ mi ɔ, ma he nɔ; ke haomi ba e nɔ ɔ, ma piɛ e he. Ma je lɛ, nɛ ma wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Kpakpa nɛ ma pee lɛ ji, ma ha nɛ e wami se maa kɛ, nɛ ma he e yi wami.”

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Yawɛ, e hi kaa a na mo si. E hi kaa a la kɛ je mo, Hiɔwe No ɔ o yi.

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Daa mɔtu ɔ, á tu o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he munyu; daa nyɔ mi hu, á fiɛ kaa o yeɔ anɔkuale.

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: A fia kpa saku, kɛ saku kpahi nɛ a la kɛ to he.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o ní tsumi ɔmɛ haa mi bua jɔmi; Ma la kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ o nine nya ní tsumi ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: Yawɛ, bɔ nɛ o ní tsumi ɔmɛ kle ɔ, ja nɔuu o juɛmi hu mi kuɔ.

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ biɛ be enɛ ɔ lee; kuasia hu be sisi nue.

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ maa bɔ flɔflɔɔflɔ kaa nga; yayami peeli ma plɔke, nɛ a ma na a he, se nyagbe ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata kɛ̃.

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: Se mo Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ o maa ye tsɛ daa.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: O ha nɛ i na he wami kaa pu mi na. O gbaa mi kɛ bua jɔmi babauu.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata, nɛ i na kɛ ye hɛngmɛ. I nu hulɔ kɛ ye tue kaa nihi nɛ te si wo mi ɔ nɔ si.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Dali ma plɔke kaa tã; a maa wa kaa seda tso ngɛ Lebanon.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: A ngɛ kaa tsohi nɛ a du ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, tsohi nɛ bɔ ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ kue ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: A ngɛ kaa tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii ngɛ a bwɔmi be mi tete po, tsohi nɛ ngɛ flɔflɔɔflɔ, nɛ́ nyu tɛ a mi gblegbleegble.

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Yawɛ da. Nɔ nɛ buɔ ye he ɔ, yayami ko be e he.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee. E mia kɛ agboje, kɛ he wami. Ee, e ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ ma si kpɛii, nɛ a be nyɛe ma je kɛ je e blɔ he.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wo ɔ ngɛ gbi woe; ee, wo ɔ ngɛ pɛe; oslɔke ɔmɛ ngɛ kue kɛ ngmlaa.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ he wa kulaa pe wo ɔ nɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ; Yawɛ he wa kulaa pe wo nɔ oslɔke ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o mlaa amɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene; klɔuklɔu peemi sa o we ɔ daa.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo Mawu nɛ o yeɔ lue, mo je o he kpo koo!

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Mo je ɔ tsuo kojolɔ, tee si nɛ o wo he nɔ woli hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa mɛ.

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ a deɔ ji, “Oo, Yawɛ tsa nɛ wɔ! Israel Mawu ɔ hyɛ we!”

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ pee wa tue ɔmɛ ɔ, e nui nɔ́ lo? Nɔ nɛ pee hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hyɛ we nɔ́ lo?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tsɔseɔ je ma amɛ ɔ, anɛ e be a tue gblae lo? Nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ adesahi tsuo ní ɔ, anɛ e be juɛmi lo?

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Yawɛ le bɔ nɛ adesa susuɔ e yi mi. E le kaa nɔmlɔ juɛmi sui he ko kulaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ o tsɔseɔ lɛ, nɛ o tsɔɔ lɛ o mlaa a, a gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: Haomi be mi tete po, o haa lɛ he jɔmi hluu kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ o tsuaa muɔ ha yayami peelɔ nɛ e ba nɔ mi.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: A maa ye dami sane ngɛ kojomi he ɔmɛ ekohu; nɛ dali tsuo ma nya he.

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ ye he ɔ, jinɛ be nɛ ɔ mi i su gbeje momo.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Benɛ i de ke, “I miɔ nɛ ma sane nɔ si ɔ,” mo Yawɛ, o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ wo ye nɔ.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Ke yi mi susumi tsɔ ha nɛ i pee basaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, mo lɛ o haa mi bua jɔmi, nɛ ye nɔ gbagba tee ekohu.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ faa ye he; ee, ye Mawu ɔ buu ye he.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba nɛ wa la kɛ je Yawɛ yi; nyɛ ha nɛ wa he ose kɛ ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ buu wa he ɔ.

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ba e hɛ mi kɛ sina, nɛ wa he ose, nɛ wa la yi jemi lahi.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ ɔ, Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ji lɛ; lɛ ji mawu ɔmɛ tsuo a matsɛ nguaa.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: E yeɔ je ɔ tsuo nɔ, kɛ je je ɔ sisi he nɛ kuɔ pe kulaa kɛ ya siɔ yohi a yi mi piɔpiɔɔpiɔ.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: E níhi ji wo ɔ, kɛ zugba a tsuo; ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ lɛ e pee mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa Mawu ji lɛ! Wɔ ji e ma a nɛ; lɛ nɛ hyɛɛ wa nɔ; wa ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ e ngɛ tsɔe. Mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu e gbi ɔ tue:

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko kplii nyɛ tsui kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ligbi ko ngɛ Masa nga a nɔ ngɛ Meriba a.

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ na níhi nɛ i pee ha mɛ. Se kɛ̃ a tsɔ̃ ye nya, nɛ a ka mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: I ná yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ a he abofu jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu. I de ke, ‘Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je ye se; a kua ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi’

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Ye mi mi wo la, nɛ i ka kita ke, ‘He nɛ i to nɛ a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ, ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii!’ ”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Nyɛ la la he ha Yawɛ! Nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ la ha Yawɛ!

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Nyɛ la ha Yawɛ; nyɛ je e yi! Nyɛɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a daa ligbi ke Yawɛ he wa yi wami.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ fiɛ nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a nu kaa Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, kaa e tsuɔ ní nguanguahi.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kle agbo; e sa nɛ a je e yi wawɛɛ nitsɛ. E sa nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Je ma kpa amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ ɔ, amagahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ. Yawɛ lɛɛ lɛ nɛ e bɔ hiɔwe.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe; he wami, kɛ afɛu ní hyi e we ɔ.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi. Nyɛ je e hɛ mi nyami, kɛ e he wami ɔ yi.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi; nyɛɛ ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba e we ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu nɛ nyɛ ja Yawɛ; nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ de je ma amɛ tsuo ke, “Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee! A ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ ma si ngɛ e hi he, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma mimiɛ lɛ. E maa kojo je ma amɛ ngɛ dami nya.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Hiɔwe, kɛ zugba, nyɛ nya! Wo, kɛ o mi níhi tsuo, nyɛɛ wo gbi.

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Ngmɔhi, kɛ nyɛ a nɔ níhi tsuo, nyɛ nya! Pu mi tsohi tsuo ma hwɔ lele

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, ejakaa e ma! Ee, Yawɛ ma nɛ e ba kojo je ɔ. Yawɛ maa kojo je ɔ ngɛ dami kɛ anɔkuale nya.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee! Mo je, mo nya koo! Nyɛ zugbahi tsuo nɛ wo bɔle nyɛ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛ nya!

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Bɔku kɛ diblii kpii bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. Matsɛ ji lɛ; anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane e yeɔ.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: La jeɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e sãã e he nyɛli nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: E we oslabai ɔ haa nɛ je mi tsɔɔ. Je ɔ naa, nɛ e hosoɔ.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Yohi sileɔ kaa wo gbaku ngɛ Yawɛ, je ɔ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Hiɔwe ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Yawɛ ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ!” Je ma amɛ tsuo na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Amaga jali, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ yakayaka wɔhi a nɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi pue si pɛ! Nyɛ mawuhi tsuo, nyɛ kpla si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Mawu, Zion ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda ma amɛ nu o dami sane yemi ɔ he, nɛ a bua jɔ a he, nɛ a nya.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, je ɔ tsuo nɔ yelɔ ji mo; o kle; mawu ko mawu ko kɛ mo sɔɛ.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Yawɛ suɔ nihi tsuo nɛ hiee yayami. E baa e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a yi, nɛ e jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: La kpɛɔ kɛ haa dali; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a naa bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Nyɛ la la he ha Yawɛ, ejakaa e pee nyakpɛ níhi. E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ye kunimi ha e he.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Yawɛ je e he kpo kaa Mawu nɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami. E ha nɛ je ma amɛ le faii kaa dami sane yelɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Si ko nɛ e wo Israel ma a, e ye nɔ; e ye mɛ anɔkuale, nɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ babauu. Nihi ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he na kaa wa Mawu ɔ ye kunimi.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ hwɔ lele kɛ ha Yawɛ. Nyɛ he ose, nɛ nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ je e yi.

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Nyɛ la, nɛ nyɛɛ fia kpa saku kɛ to he nɛ nyɛ kɛ je Yawɛ yi.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpa titimati, kɛ koli, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi hwɔ lele kɛ ha Yawɛ, wa matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Wo, kɛ o mi níhi tsuo, nyɛɛ wo gbi! Je ɔ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi, nyɛ la!

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Nyɛ pahi, nyɛɛ fia nyɛ dɛ! Nyɛ yokuhi tsuo, nyɛ nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi,

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: ejakaa e ma nɛ e ba kojo je ɔ. Yawɛ maa kojo je ɔ ngɛ dami, kɛ anɔkuale nya.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee; je ma amɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli. E hii si ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ zugba ngɛ mimiɛe.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Yawɛ he biɛ ngɛ Zion wawɛɛ nitsɛ; e kle pe je ma amɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo ma je e biɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ yi; a ma je e biɛ nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ yi. E ngɛ klɔuklɔu!

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ, mo nɛ o suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da! O to anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane yemi si ngɛ Israel.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ yi! Nyɛ kpla si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ nyɛ ja lɛ. Mawu klɔuklɔu ji lɛ!

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: E we osɔfohi ji Mose, kɛ Aaron. Nihi nɛ fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, Samuel piɛ a he. Mɛ tsuo a fa kue ha lɛ, nɛ e bu mɛ tue.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: E kɛ mɛ tu munyu ngɛ bɔku titima mi. A ye mlaahi nɛ e wo mɛ, kɛ famihi nɛ e fa mɛ ɔ tsuo nɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa Mawu! O ma a fa kue ha mo, nɛ o bu mɛ tue. O kɛ mɛ hi si kaa Mawu nɛ ngɔɔ a he yayami kɛ paa mɛ; se ke a tɔ̃ ɔ, o gblaa a tue kɛ̃.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ yi; nyɛ ja lɛ ngɛ e yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ. Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ hwɔ lele ha Yawɛ!

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ bua jɔmi; nyɛɛ ba e hɛ mi kɛ bua jɔmi lahi!

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa Yawɛ ji Mawu. Lɛ nɛ e bɔ wɔ; e níhi ji wɔ. E ma ji wɔ; wa ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ e ngɛ lɛe.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hi; e naa wɔ mɔbɔ daa, nɛ e we anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ma la kɛ je o yi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa mɔbɔ nalɔ, kɛ dami sane yelɔ ji mo.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Ma ba ye je mi saminya, konɛ a ko na piami ko ngɛ ye he. Mɛni be po lɛ o maa ba ye ngɔ? Ma hi si ngɛ mumi mi he tsɔmi mi ngɛ ye we ɔ mi.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: I be amimi yee, nɛ i kɛ yayami peeli hu be bɔe.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e nyɛmi he guɛ ngɛ laami mi ɔ, ma kpata e hɛ mi. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ gegeege, nɛ e woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, i kɛ lɛ be bɔe.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu anɔkuale ɔ, ma ná a he bua jɔmi, nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa hi si. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛ lɛ a ma sɔmɔ mi.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Nɔ sisilɔ ko be ye we mi hie; lakpatsɛ ko hu be ye hɛ mi bae.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: I kɛ yayami peeli be bɔe kɔkɔɔkɔ kɛ yaa si ma fie mɛ tsuo kɛ je Yawɛ ma a mi.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Ke i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, koo je ye he. Ke i tsɛ mo ɔ, he nɔ esɔ, nɛ o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee kaa la su ku, nɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ dɔ la hɛii kaa flɔɔnɔɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: I pee kaa nga gbigbli nɛ a gbee nɔ, nɛ niye ní pa jlo we mi hu.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Daa nɛ ɔ, kɛmɛmi kɛkɛ lɛ i ngɛ kɛmɛe. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ ye wuhi tsuo je kpo, nɛ i pee kanyakanya.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: I pee kaa okpoku ngɛ nga nɔ, loo klomi ngɛ we doku mi.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Daa ligbi ɔ, jɛmi kɛkɛ ye he nyɛli hii mi jɛe. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu ɔ ngɔɔ ye biɛ kɛ gbiɛɛ ni kpahi.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Ye niye ní ɔ, la zu sɔuu; nɔ nɛ i nuɔ ɔ, vo nyu futu mi,

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa hɔhɔmi nɛ bee kɛ yaa. I pee kaa nga gbigbli.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Se mo Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ matsɛ ji mo kɛ yaa neneene; yi nɔhi tsuo ma kai mo.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o tsɔli ɔmɛ suɔ Zion tɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ zu ɔ po, a mi mi sãã mɛ ngɛ he.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ tsuo maa ye Yawɛ gbeye. Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye e hɛ mi nyami ɔ gbeye.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Yawɛ kpale ma Zion ekohu; e ma je e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hyɛ zugba a kɛ je e he klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo. E hyɛ zugba a kɛ je hiɔwe,

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: konɛ e nu pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kɛmɛmi ɔ he, nɛ nihi nɛ a bu mɛ gbenɔ fɔ ɔ, e ha nɛ a ye a he.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha nɛ i gbɔjɔ be mi nɛ i ngɛ he wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ. E po ye wami be ɔ nɔ kpiti.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Ye Mawu, mo nɛ o ngɛ daa! Koo ngɔ mi kɛ ho amlɔ nɛ ɔ, be mi nɛ i wɛ lolo.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Blema lokoo nɛ o bɔ je ɔ; mo nitsɛ o nine o kɛ pee hiɔwe ɔ.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ, bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, ja ko lɛ o ngɛ. O wami be ɔ be nyagbe.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Wɔ, o tsɔli ɔmɛ, wa bimɛ ɔmɛ a yi ma na wami, nɛ a nina kɛ mo maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Ma je Yawɛ yi! Ma je e biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi kɛ ye tsui tsuo.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Ma je Yawɛ yi! Ní kpakpahi nɛ e peeɔ ha mi ɔ, ye hɛ be nɔ jee gblegbleegble.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: E kɛ ye he yayamihi tsuo paa mi, nɛ e tsaa ye he hiɔhi tsuo.

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: E heɔ ye yi wami, konɛ ye hɛ mi ko kpata. E jeɔ e suɔmi ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi, nɛ e naa mi mɔbɔ daa.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: E haa mi ní kpakpahi babauu, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, i naa he wami he kaa kɔle.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ a yeɔ mɛ amimi ɔ, Yawɛ yeɔ a sane kɛ haa mɛ.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: E tsɔɔ Mose e blɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu na ní nguanguahi nɛ e pee ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Yawɛ naa mɔbɔ; e mi mi hi. E muklii mi fu we mla, se e mɔbɔ nami ɔ mohu hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Se mohu ɔ, nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ, e naa mɛ mɔbɔ babauu nɛ hi kalemi kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpɛti blɔ ɔ hí kalemi ɔ.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: E jeɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ yaa tsitsaa lokoo kaa bɔ nɛ beleku kɛ bonyoku a kpɛti blɔ ɔ kɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ tsɛ mi mi sãã lɛ ngɛ e bimɛ a he ɔ, ja lɛ Yawɛ hu mi mi sãã lɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ a he.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e le wa bɔ su; e le kaa zu kɛkɛ ji wɔ.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa nga pɛ; e bɔɔ saminyayoo kaa nga nɔ mɔmɔ.

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: Ke kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ e hɛ mi kpata nɛ nɔ ko pa li lɛ hu.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye. A weku kɛ nina hu Yawɛ maa pee mɛ kpakpa daa,

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɔ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ ma si ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ je ɔ tsuo nɔ.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ, Yawɛ Mawu bɔfohi, nyɛ katsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ, nɛ nyɛ yaa tsɔmi ha lɛ; nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ, Yawɛ tabo ɔ tsuo, nyɛ, e sɔmɔli tsuo nɛ nyɛ peeɔ e suɔmi nya ní, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ, Yawɛ nibɔ níhi ngɛ hehi nɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ ɔ tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! Imi nitsɛ hu ma je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Ma je Yawɛ yi! Yawɛ ye Mawu, o kle! O hɛ mi nyami, kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa bo nɛ o kɛ ha o he.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: O ngɔ la kɛ ha o he kaa bo; o blɛke hiɔwe mi kaa bo tsu.

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: O ma o we ɔ ngɔ fɔ nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɔ. O ngɔ bɔku kɛ pee o lɛ, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi o nyɛɛɔ.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: O ngɔ kɔɔhiɔ kɛ pee o tsɔlɔ, nɛ oslabai la a pee o sɔmɔlɔ.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: O ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ ma e sisi tomi ɔ nɔ kpɛii, nɛ a be jee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ gblegbleegble.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: O ngɔ nyu kɛ ha je ɔ he kaa bo; nyu ha yo ɔmɛ a yi mi tsuo.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Benɛ o wo gbi, nɛ hiɔwe si ɔ, a he sɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: Nyu ɔ hia kɛ be ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya pue kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi he nɛ o to ha mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: O to huzu ha nyu ɔ nɛ e ko be he, konɛ e ko kpale ba ha je ɔ nɔ hu.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: O haa nɛ pahi hiaa ngɛ kɔ̃hi a mi, nɛ a mi nyu ɔ ya guu yohi a kpɛ.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: Pu mi lohwehi tsuo náa nyu nɛ a nuɔ. Nga mi tejihi nuɔ nyu hluu kɛ ya siɔ kuma yi mɛ hu.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ peeɔ a tsuhi ngɛ tso kɔnihi a nɔ ngɛ pa tue, nɛ a hii lae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: O haa nɛ nyu nɛɛ kɛ jeɔ hiɔwe kɛ pueɔ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ je ɔ mi hyi tɔ kɛ o gbaami sɔuu.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: O haa nɛ nga puɛɔ ha lohwehi; o haa nɔmlɔ adesa tsohi nɛ e du, konɛ e ná niye ní kɛ je zu mi.

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: O haa lɛ dã nɛ ma ha lɛ bua jɔmi, nu nɛ ma ha nɛ e he womi nɔ ma tsɔ, kɛ niye ní nɛ maa wo lɛ he wami.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Lebanon seda tso ɔmɛ naa nyu babaaba. Yawɛ nitsɛ e tsohi nɛ e du ji lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ lɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ peeɔ a tsuhi ngɛ; sɛsɛo ɔ mi lɛ aklawa peeɔ e tsu ngɛ.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Yo gaga amɛ a nɔ lɛ pu mi apletsihi hiɔ; nyu mi kpihi lɛɛ a hi he ji tɛ sahi a kpɛ.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: O pee nyɔhiɔ, nɛ o kɛ tsɔɔ be slɔɔtohi; pu hu le be nɛ e kɛ nɔɔ si.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: O haa nɛ je jɔɔ, kɛkɛ ke diblii wo ɔ, pu mi lohwehi tsuo jeɔ kpo.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Jata bimɛ huãã nɛ a daa de ke a ngɛ niye ní hlae kɛ je mo Mawu o dɛ mi.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Ke pu te si ɔ, a kpaleɔ a se ya buɔ si ngɛ a laami he ɔmɛ.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nimlihi jeɔ kpo kɛ yaa a ní tsumi hehi ya tsuɔ ní kɛ ya siɔ gbɔkuɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, hyɛ kaa o pee níhi babauu! Nile o kɛ pee lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. O nibɔ níhi hyi je ɔ mi tɔ.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Wo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; e kle nɛ e bli, kɛ e mi lohwe nguanguahi kɛ wawi nɛ a be nyɛe maa kane.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Lɛ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ. Nɛ wo nɛ ɔ mi nɛ lohwe kɛ e he gbeyegbeye nɛ o bɔ ɔ fiɛɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hyɛɛ mo blɔ kaa o ma ha mɛ a niye ní ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Ke o ha mɛ niye ní ɔ, a yeɔ; o lɛɔ mɛ nɛ a tɔɔ kɛ ní kpakpahi sɔuu.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Ke o kua mɛ ɔ, a haoɔ. Ke o ngɔ a mumi ɔ, a gboɔ nɛ a kpaleɔ kɛ yaa zu mi he nɛ a je ɔ.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: O ngɔɔ o mumi ngɔ woɔ a mi, nɛ a peeɔ nibɔ níhi. Kɛkɛ o haa je ɔ peeɔ ehe ekohu.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa hi si daa! Níhi nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ, e ma na a he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: Ke Yawɛ hyɛ je ɔ, kɛkɛ je ɔ mimiɛ. Ke e ta yo ɔmɛ a he kɛkɛ a je la su ku.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Susumi kpakpa nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ e he ɔ, i na nɛ lɛ tsuo sa e hɛ mi, ejakaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa mi bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Yayami peeli tsuo a hɛ mi nɛ kpata, konɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ ko hi je ɔ mi hu. Ma je Yawɛ yi. Ee, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si; nyɛɛ wo e biɛ ta; nyɛ ha je ma amɛ nɛ a le e ní peemi ní ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi, nyɛɛ sɛɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ.

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Nyɛ, Mawu tsɔlɔ Abraham nina! Yakob nina, nyɛ nɛ Mawu hla! Nyɛ kai nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Mawu pee, kɛ bɔ nɛ e kojo je ma amɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji wa Mawu; e woɔ e mlaa kɛ haa je ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: E kaiɔ e somi ɔ daa. Si ko nɛ e wo ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ yi nɔhi tsuo.

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: E ke, “Ma ngɔ Kanaan zugba a kɛ ha mo, nɛ zugba a ma ba pee o weto ní.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ a he pi; a be blɔ nya ko kulaa, nɛ nibwɔhi ji mɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Se Mawu ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ nɔ ko nɛ hao mɛ; a he ɔ, e je blɔ de matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke,

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ ha nɛ hwɔ ba zugba a nɔ, nɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a niye ní tsuo ta.

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: Se e tsɔ nɔ ko kɛ nyɛɛ a hɛ mi momo; lɛ ji Yosef nɛ a jua lɛ kaa nyɔguɛ ɔ.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: A wo e nane kɔsɔkɔsɔ, nɛ a kɛ e kuɛ wo dade pã mi

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: kɛ ya si nɔ́ nɛ e de to ɔ ba mi. Yawɛ munyu ɔ wo lɛ nguɔ.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ pee lɛ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ e we ɔ, kɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔ tsuo nɔ yelɔ,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: konɛ e tsɔse e ganɔ ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ e tsɔɔ e ma nimeli ɔmɛ nile.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob pue nɔ kɛ ho Egipt ya ya to nubwɔ ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha nɛ e ma a bɔ, nɛ a he hiɛ babauu. E ha a he hu wa kulaa pe a he nyɛli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: E puɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a juɛmi ngɛ Israel he; a nyɛ mɛ, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ níhi.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɔ e tsɔlɔ Mose, kɛ Aaron nɛ e hla mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Mawu ha nɛ a pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Mawu ha nɛ diblii wo ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Se nɔ́ nɛ e fa Egipt bi ɔmɛ ke a pee ɔ, a bui fɛɛ.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ a pa amɛ tsuo plɛ pee muɔ, nɛ a mi lo ɔmɛ tsuo gbo.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ovɔnɔhi babauu ba zugba a nɔ; matsɛ we ɔ mi pohu ovɔnɔhi hyi lejɛ ɔ tɔtɔɔtɔ.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Mawu tu munyu, nɛ pwɔlwɔɛ munomunohi babauu ba zugba a tsuo nɔ.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ ngɛ hiɔmi nane mi, nɛ oslabai gba ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: E kpata wai tsohi, ngmɔkɔ tsohi, kɛ tso kpahi tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: E tu munyu, nɛ baalɛhi ba babauu, baalɛ nguahi kɛ wawi nɛ hí kanemi.

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Baalɛ ɔmɛ ye ngmɔ si níhi, kɛ ba mumu tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e gbe bitɛtehi nɛ ji Egipt nyumuhi a kekleekle ngmɛduhi tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpaka Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je; nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be a kpɛti nɛ ji hiɔtsɛ; mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ngɛ kpakpataa.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Mawu ha nɛ bɔku ba ha Israel bi ɔmɛ a he; e ha mɛ la, nɛ a kɛ hyɛ nɔ́ nyɔ mi.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: A bi lɛ niye ní, nɛ e ha mɛ hɔne. E ha mɛ niye ní kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: E bli tɛ sa nya, nɛ nyu je mi pue si; nyu ɔ be lalaala ngɛ nga a nɔ kaa pa.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: E kai e tsɔlɔ Abraham, kɛ si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpaka e ma nɛ e hla a kɛ je; a la, nɛ a hwɔ lele.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ ma je li ɔmɛ a zugba a kɛ ha mɛ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ni kpahi gbo he dengme ɔ ba plɛ pee a nɔ́.

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ a kai e mlaa amɛ, nɛ a ye nɔ. A je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e hi; e naa mɔbɔ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Ní nguanguahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de? Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma je e yi bɔ nɛ sa?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: A gbaa nihi nɛ yeɔ dami sane, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da be tsuaa be.

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ ma na bɔ nɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he mi jɔ mɛ ha, konɛ bua jɔmi nɛ ba ma a mi ɔ, imi hu ma piɛ a he kɛ nya.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ pee ngɛ Egipt ɔ, wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nui sisi. Suɔmi babauu nɛ e je kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ, a kaii we. Mohu ɔ, a te si wo lɛ ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e he a yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ; nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: E nga Wo Tsu ɔ yi, nɛ nyu ɔ mii, nɛ e kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ kɛ be kaa nɔ́ nɛ nga nɔ lɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e ma a he e munyu ɔmɛ ye, nɛ a la kɛ je e yi.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: A ya di jiklɔɔ níhi a se ngɛ nga a nɔ; a pee enɛ ɔ kɛ ka Mawu.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Mawu ha mɛ níhi nɛ a bi lɛ ɔ tsuo; se e ngɔ hiɔ nɛ haa nɛ nɔ flaa kɛ gbla a tue.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ a hɛ kɔ̃ Mose nɔ, kɛ jehanɛ Aaron, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ zugba a gba, nɛ e mii Datan; e mii Abiram, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: La je ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e sã yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: A pee na bi ngɛ Horeb, nɛ a sɔmɔ jamɛ a amaga a nɛ a puɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Mawu, a kpɔlɔ ɔ nɛ tsu ní tsumi nguanguahi ngɛ Egipt ɔ, a hɛ je e nɔ.

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Hyɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ! Hyɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ e pee ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya!

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu we zugba saminyayoo ɔ he munyu kpakpa, ejakaa si nɛ Mawu wo mɛ ɔ, a he we yi.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: A tu munyu huitihuiti ngɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi; nɛ a bui Yawɛ tue.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e wo e nine nɔ nɛ e ka mɛ kita kaa e ma kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ,

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Mawu ma a ya piɛ je ma amɛ a he nɛ a kɛ mɛ ja Baal nɛ ngɛ Peor ɔ. Bɔhi nɛ a sã ha a ni gbogboe ɔmɛ hu a kɛ mɛ ye.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: A kɛ a ní peemi ní ɔmɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la, nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ba sɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: Mose mi mi fu ma a wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e tu munyu basabasa.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: A kpataa we je ma amɛ a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ.

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, a ya futu je ma amɛ, nɛ a kase a ní peemi ní ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: A sɔmɔ a we amaga amɛ, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a kpa Mawu se nyɛɛmi.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: A kɛ a binyumuhi, kɛ a biyihi sã bɔ ha wɔhi.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: A pue nihi nɛ pee we yayami a muɔ si; mɛ nitsɛmɛ a binyumuhi, kɛ a biyihi po a ngɔ mɛ kɛ sã bɔ ha Kanaan wɔhi; nɛ a kɛ muɔ ble zugba a.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: A kɛ a ní peemi ble mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he, nɛ Mawu hu a yi lɛ anɔkuale.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu lɛ nitsɛ e ma a, nɛ e kua mɛ.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: E ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo je mahi a dɛ mi; nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye a nɔ.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Yawɛ je e ma a kɛ je a haomihi a mi si abɔ. Se pee se ɔ, a tsɔɔ e hɛ mi atuã nɛ a ya peeɔ yayamihi nɛ pe kekle ní ɔmɛ po.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃, benɛ e nu nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ɔ a ní pee lɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ a ní pee nihi tsuo nɛ nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Yawɛ wa Mawu! Mo kpɔ wɔ kɛ je je ma amɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ o kpale wɔ kɛ ba ekohu, konɛ waa na mo si, nɛ wa je o biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi; nyɛ je e yi kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene. Nyɛ ha nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ de ke, “Amen!” Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.

english_verse: ) The Lord Is Good to His People
translation_verse: ) A je Mawu yi, ejakaa e hi

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e hi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!”

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: E ngɔ nyɛ kɛ je ma se kɛ ba kɛ je beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je, kɛ je omleyi je, kɛ leneyi je.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Hwɔ ye mɛ, nɛ kuma ye mɛ hluu kɛ ya si a mumu nya ta.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ; e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ kuma ye mɛ ɔ, e ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu; ni nɛmɛ nɛ hwɔ ye mɛ ɔ, e ha mɛ ní nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Ni komɛ hi si ngɛ diblii, kɛ mɔbɔ si himi mi; a wo mɛ tsu; a kpla mɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ, nɛ a na nɔ́;

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: ejakaa a tsɔ Hiɔwe No Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã, nɛ a bui e munyu, kɛ e ga womi ɔmɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: A tsu ní kpakpataa hluu kɛ ya si pɔ tɔ mɛ. Ke a nɔ si ɔ, nɔ ko be nɛ woɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: E je mɛ kɛ je diblii, kɛ mɔbɔ si himi ɔ mi, nɛ e kplɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ a he ngɔ pue si.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ; e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: E ku akɔblee agbo ɔmɛ, nɛ e poo agbo se lami dade ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ ya je kuasia, nɛ a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ ha nɛ a na nɔ́.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Niye ní ko niye ní ko pee we mɛ akɔnɔ; a su gbenɔ muɔ nya haa.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: E ngɔ e munyu ɔ kɛ tsa mɛ. E je mɛ kɛ je hɛ mi kpatami nɛ ko ba a nɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ; e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: E sa kaa a sã bɔhi kɛ na lɛ si; a kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ la nyami la kɛ gba níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Nihi kɛ lɛ ye jua ngɛ wo hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ na a nya mi ngma.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: A na níhi nɛ Yawɛ tsu; a na nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: E fa nɛ ahumi fia, nɛ wo oslɔkehi te si.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
