translation_verse: Oslɔke ɔmɛ wo lɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe kɛ ba si, kɛ ya wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ. Haomi nɛ ba a nɔ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ha a kã nya ta.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: E tsi ahumi ɔ nya nɛ e kpa fiami; oslɔke ɔmɛ a he jɔ, nɛ wo ɔ ngmɛ dii.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ a bua jɔ a he jehanɛ, ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya ba si. Yawɛ kɛ mɛ ba su lɛsimuɔ he ɔ nɛ a yaa a fiafiaafia.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ; e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha pahi mii kulaa, nɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi tsi, nɛ a bɛ hu.

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a plɛ pee ngo zɔ zugba; ejakaa nihi nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ, yayami sɔuu a pee.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha nga kplanaa plɛ pee taku kɛ e mi nyu babaaba; nɛ zugba gbigbli plɛ pee he nɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi hia si ngɛ.

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ hwɔ ye mɛ ɔ, e ha a to si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a po ma, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: A hu zugba a, nɛ a du wai yiblii ngɛ nɔ; nɛ a kpa ní babauu.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbaa e ma a; e ha nɛ a he ba hiɛ babauu nitsɛ; a lohwehi hu e ha we nɛ a nɔ nɛ gbɔ́.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Benɛ a he nyɛli ba ye Mawu ma a nɔ, nɛ a wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní babauu ɔ,

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: Mawu hu kɛ a ganɔ ɔmɛ to ní saminya, nɛ e ha nɛ a ya wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ he nɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko be.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, e je mɛ kɛ je a haomihi a mi; nɛ e ha a ngmɛdu he ba hiɛ babauu kaa tohi.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a naa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a bua jɔɔ he; se yayami peeli lɛɛ a maa a nya.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: Mawu, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ mo pɛ o nɔ; ma la kɛ je ye tsui mi kɛ je o yi.

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Makɛ mla a, ma te si nɛ ma fia saku kɛ je o yi.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, ma na mo si ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi; ma la kɛ je o yi ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kle kɛ su hiɔwe lokoo, nɛ o we anɔkuale yemi ya su bɔku mi tɔɔ.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Mawu, ha nɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ, konɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ he wa yi wami. Bu wa kue fami ɔ tue, ejakaa mo nitsɛ o ma nɛ o suɔ lɛ ji wɔ.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Mawu de ngɛ e he klɔuklɔu ɔ ke, “Ma hwɔ lele kɛ gba Shekem mi, nɛ ma dla Sukot kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ha ye ma a.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Ye mahi ji Gilead kɛ Manase. Efraim ji ye dade pɛɛ, nɛ Yuda ji ye matsɛ tso.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab ji ye hedu buɛ. Ma sake ye tokota kɛ pue Edom nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye e nɔ. Ma he ose kɛ ye Filistia nɔ kunimi.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ maa ngɔ mi kɛ ya ma nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo he ɔ mi? Mɛnɔ ma ya sɛ mi Edom?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Piɛ wa he, konɛ waa kɛ he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ to ní. Ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa he wami pi nɔ́ ko!

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: Mawu, i ngɛ o yi jee; koo pee dii.

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: A te si kɛ wo mi, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ yayami dee ngɛ ye he kɛkɛ.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: I suɔ mɛ, nɛ i faa kue kɛ haa mɛ, se mɛɛ lɛɛ a poɔ ye nya yaka gu.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: A ngɔɔ yayami kɛ toɔ kpakpa nɛ i peeɔ mɛ ɔ nane mi. A nyɛɛ mi ngɛ suɔmi nɛ i suɔ mɛ ɔ nane mi.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: A deɔ ke, ha nɛ yiwutsotsɛ ko kɛ lɛ nɛ to ní; lɛ nitsɛ e he nyɛlɔ nɛ ya po e nya ngɛ sane yemi he.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Ke a kojo lɛ ɔ, ha nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ; e kue fami ɔ hu, a bu kaa yayami.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: E wami se ko kɛ; e blɔ nya nɛ ba pee nɔ kpa nɔ́!

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: E bimɛ nɛ a ye awusa, nɛ́ e yo ba pee yalɔyo!

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: E hiɔtsɛmɛ nɛ a ba kpɔ e níhi tsuo ngɛ e dɛ; nɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e gbo dengme kɛ na a, nibwɔhi nɛ a ba ha.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko kó na lɛ mɔbɔ; awusa bimɛ nɛ e ma si ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó hyɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: E ngmɛdu hɛ mi nɛ kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ; nɛ yi nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ se ɔ ko le e biɛ tete po.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Yawɛ mo kai yayamihi nɛ e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, nɛ e nyɛ he yayami po a ko ngɔ kɛ pa lɛ.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nɛ kai a he yayami ɔmɛ daa nɛ, se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ko kai mɛ gblegbleegble ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: E suɔ nɔ gbiɛmi, lɛ hu á gbiɛ lɛ ja nɔuu. E sume gbaami, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Gbiɛmi pee e he nɔ́ kaa tade nɛ e woɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e gbiɛmi ɔ nɛ sɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi kaa nyu, kɛ e wuhi a mi kaa nu!

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Gbiɛmi nɛ pee kaa bo nɛ e kɛ haa e he, kɛ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ fii e mlɛ mi daa nɛ.

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ye he nyɛli, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ mi ɔ, wo mɛ hiɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Se mo Yawɛ, ye Nyɔmtsɛ, pee ha mi kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ; he ye yi wami, ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ hi, nɛ e ngɛ daa.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Ohiatsɛ ji mi; ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ ye tsui ngɛ mi yee ngɛ ye mi mi tɔɔ.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: I laa kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ nini laa gbɔkuɛ nya si; a hu mi ngɔ fɔ he kaa a fieɔ baalɛ.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: I ha hwɔ hluu kɛ ya si ye nakutsohi a mi gbɔjɔ, nɛ i ta he lo kanakana.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: I pee ahlua bɔmi nɔ́ ha ye nya poli ɔmɛ. Ke a na mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a mimiɛɔ a yi kɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ye Mawu, ba piɛ ye he koo! He ye yi wami ngɛ o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he!

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a gbiɛ mi faa; moo lɛɛ o maa gbaa mi sa. Nihi nɛ te si kɛ wo mi ɔ, zo nɛ gbe mɛ, konɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Zo nɛ gbe ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpɔtɔɔ. Zo nɛ ha a he kaa bo.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Ma pa ye nya mi ma la kɛ na Yawɛ si saminya. Ma je e yi ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e yeɔ dɛgutsɛ sane ha lɛ. Nihi nɛ buɔ dɛgutsɛ gbenɔ fɔ ɔ, e jeɔ lɛ kɛ jee a dɛ mi.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Hii si ngɛ ye hiɔ nɔ kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma ngɔ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ o nane maa nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma ha mo he wami kpetekpleenyɛ kɛ je Zion. E ma de mo ke, “Ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.”

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Ligbi ɔ nɛ o maa hia ta kɛ wo o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, o ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a he kɛ ha ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya. Nihewi babauu ma ba pue si ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa makɛ bɔ́.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ ka kita nɛ ɔ, nɛ e be e nya se kpalee, “Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ o hiɔ nɔ; ligbi ɔ nɛ e mi mi maa wo la a, e ma kpata matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: E maa gbla je ma amɛ a tue; nɛ ma amɛ a mi ma hyi tɔ kɛ ni gbogboehi. E ma kpata matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ maa nu pa nɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ he ɔ mi nyu, lɔ ɔ maa wo lɛ he wami, nɛ e maa ye kunimi.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: A je Yawɛ yi! Ma na Yawɛ si kɛ ye tsui tsuo ngɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a gua a mi.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Yawɛ tsuɔ ní nguanguahi. Nihi nɛ nyaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ hlaa kaa a maa nu a sisi saminya.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: E tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje. E yeɔ dami sane daa.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Yawɛ haa nɛ a kaiɔ e nyakpɛ ní tsumi ɔmɛ. E mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ, e lɛɔ mɛ. E hɛ ngɛ e somi ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: E ngɔ ma je li a zugba a kɛ ha e ma a kɛ tsɔɔ e ma a kaa e ngɛ he wami.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: E yeɔ anɔkuale kɛ dami sane ngɛ níhi tsuo a mi; nɛ e mlaa amɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Mlaa amɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene; anɔkuale kɛ dami mi a pee mɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: E ha e ma a ye a he, nɛ e kɛ mɛ so somi nɛ ngɛ daa. E he tsɔ, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye!

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o na nile ɔ, ye Yawɛ gbeye. Nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ ja a, a nuɔ nɔ́ sisi saminya. A je Yawɛ yi daa!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: A je Yawɛ yi! A gbaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ e naa e mlaa amɛ a he bua jɔmi saminya a.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: E nina maa pee ni nguanguahi ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a maa gbaa e ngmɛdu.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: E we ɔ maa pee niatsɛ we he nɛ kplɔkɔtɔ ngɛ, nɛ e maa bɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: La kpɛɔ ngɛ diblii mi kɛ haa nimli kpakpahi, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da, nihi nɛ naa mɔbɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ a mi mi jɔ.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ e mi mi jɔ, nɔ nɛ paa nɔ nɔ́, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ e ní tsumi mi ɔ, á gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be lɛ pee; a ma kai lɛ daa.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: E yi tsui, nɛ e yi gbeye hulɔ. E hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e maa ye e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi kɛ̃.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: E keɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ní kɛ jeɔ e tsui mi faa. E naa mɔbɔ daa. E hɛ mi maa ba nyami, nɛ a maa bu lɛ.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Ke yiwutsotsɛ na kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e dɔɔ lɛ; e kpeɔ e lungu nya, nɛ e jeɔ lejɛ ɔ dii. Yiwutsotsɛ yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: A je Yawɛ yi! Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli, nyɛ je e yi; nyɛ je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi!

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: A je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je tsuo, e sa kaa nyɛ je e yi.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lɛ yeɔ je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ, nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kle kɛ be hiɔwe po he.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Nɔ ko be nɛ ngɛ kaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ hiɔwe,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: nɛ e ma e yi si kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba tsuo hyɛe ɔ.

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: E woɔ humi bi nɔ kɛ jeɔ zu mi; e woɔ ohiatsɛ nɔ kɛ jeɔ kuku nɔ,

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: nɛ e haa nɛ a kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma a mi ganɔ ɔmɛ hii si.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: E haa yosa fɔɔ bi; e plɛɔ peeɔ bimɛ a nyɛ, nɛ e bua jɔɔ e he saminya. A je Yawɛ yi.

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt, ee, benɛ Yakob nina a je ma se zugba a nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Yuda ba pee Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma klɔuklɔu, nɛ Israel ba pee e nɔ yemi he.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Wo Tsu ɔ na mɛ, nɛ e tu fo; Yordan pa a hu se po.

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Yo ɔmɛ tuu kaa agbosuhi, yoku ɔmɛ tuu kaa jijɔhi.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Mo wo, mɛni ba nɛ o tu fo ɔ? Yordan, mɛni ha o se po ɔ?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Nyɛ yohi, mɛni ba nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tuue kaa agbosuhi ɔ? Nyɛ yokuhi, mɛni ha nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tuue kaa jijɔhi ɔ?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Zugba lee, mo mimiɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi; mimiɛ ngɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ hɛ mi koo;

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: lɛ nɛ haa tɛ sa plɛɔ peeɔ taku kɛ e mi nyu buɛii, nɛ nyu paa si kɛ jeɔ tslɛbo mi.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, pi wɔ oo, pi wɔ, se mo nɛ o sa hɛ mi nyami; ejakaa o suɔmi ngɛ daa, nɛ o we anɔkuale yemi hu be nyagbe.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Mɛni he je je ma amɛ ma bi ke, “Jije a Mawu ɔ ngɛ” ɔ?

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Wa Mawu ɔ, hiɔwe e ngɛ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e peeɔ.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: A ngɛ nya, se a tu we munyu; a ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: A ngɛ tue, se a nui nɔ́; a ngɛ gugwɔ, se a fu we nɔ́.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: A ngɛ nine, se a pɛtɛ we nɔ́ he; a ngɛ nane, se a nyɛɛ we; a kuɛ si po a kpɛ we.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ pee mɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa amaga amɛ nɔuu. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ a nɔ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ a ngɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Israel ma, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ. Lɛ ji nyɛ he piɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ yi baalɔ.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Aaron nina, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ. Lɛ ji nyɛ he piɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ yi baalɔ.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ. Lɛ ji nyɛ he piɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ yi baalɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hɛ ngɛ wa nɔ, nɛ e maa gbaa wɔ; ee, e maa gbaa Israel ma a; e maa gbaa Israel osɔfo ɔmɛ a nina a.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: E maa gbaa nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ lɛ Yawɛ ɔ gbeye, ni wawihi kɛ ni nguahi tsuo.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nɛ ha nyɛɛ bɔ saminya, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ tsuo.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, é gbaa nyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Hiɔwe ɔ tsuo e nɔ́, se zugba a lɛɛ e ngɔ kɛ ha nimli adesahi.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Ni gbogboehi je we Yawɛ yi; nɔ ko je we Yawɛ yi ngɛ gbeje.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma je Yawɛ yi kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene. A je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: I suɔ Yawɛ, ejakaa e nuɔ ye kue fami ɔ, nɛ e buɔ mi tue.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ e buɔ mi tue he je ɔ, ma tsɛ lɛ ye wami be tsuo.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Gbenɔ klama amɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe, gbeje nɔ́ nami ɔmɛ wo ye he gbeye; ye ní pee mɔbɔ, nɛ i hao wawɛɛ.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, he ye yi wami!”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Dloolɔ, kɛ dalɔ ji Yawɛ; ee, wa Mawu ɔ, mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peepee ta a he ɔ, Yawɛ baa a yi; benɛ i gbɔjɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e he ye yi wami.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Ye nɔ gbagba maa te, nɛ ye bua maa jɔ ekohu; ejakaa Yawɛ dloo mi babauu.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Gbenɔ mi nitsɛ nɛ Yawɛ je mi kɛ je; ye hɛngmɛhi loloo we kɛ vo nyu hu, nɛ ye nanehi tɛ we si hu.

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ba ye je mi bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, ngɛ hɛ kali a zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Mɛni ma kɛ na Yawɛ si ngɛ kpakpa tsuo nɛ e pee mi ɔ he?

english_verse: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ wai kɛ sã bɔ kɛ na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e he ye yi wami.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Ma ye ye siwo nɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo hɛ mi.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a gbenɔ dɔɔ lɛ wawɛɛ.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o tsɔlɔ ji mi; mo lɛ i sɔmɔɔ kaa bɔ nɛ ye nyɛ pee ɔ pɛ. O je mi kɛ je gbenɔ mi.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Ma sã bɔ kɛ na mo si; mo Yawɛ ma fa kue ha.

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je mahi tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi. Nyɛ je ɔ mi nihi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi.

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ejakaa suɔmi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ, suɔmi ɔ kle, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale daa. A je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e hi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Israel ma a nɛ de ke, “E suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Israel osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a de ke, “E suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, a de ke, “E suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ, i tsɛ Yawɛ; Yawɛ he mi nɔ, nɛ e je mi.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi ngɛ nɛ ɔ, i yi gbeye; mɛni adesa ma nyɛ maa pee mi.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: E hi kaa o sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ, pe nɔ́ nɛ o maa ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔmlɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: He nyɛli babauu ba bɔle mi kɛ kpe; se ngɛ Yawɛ he wami nya a, i kpata a hɛ mi!

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: A bɔle mi kɛ kpe; a sa ye yi, se ngɛ Yawɛ he wami nya a, i kpata a hɛ mi!

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: A buble mi kaa hwo; se a ngla kaa mio tso mi la. Yawɛ he wami nya a, i kpata a hɛ mi!

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: A ba tua mi kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ a miɔ nɛ a maa ye ye nɔ, se Yawɛ piɛ ye he.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lɛ woɔ mi he wami; ma la kɛ je e yi, ejakaa e he ye yi wami.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu tue, kunimi la ngɛ pɛe ngɛ dali ɔmɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi ke, “Yawɛ kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ tsu ní nguanguahi!

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Yawɛ nine ho hiɔwe ya; Yawɛ kɛ e hɛ mi nyami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ tsu ní nguanguahi!”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: I be gboe, se mohu ma hi je mi, nɛ ma jaje níhi nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbla ye tue wawɛɛ mohu, se e ha we nɛ ma gbo.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Nyɛ bli Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔmɛ ha mi; ma sɛ mi nɛ ma ya na Yawɛ si!

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Yawɛ we agbo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛ pɛ nɛ a maa sɛ mi.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o nɔ́ ji sina; ejakaa o bu mi tue, nɛ o he ye yi wami.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ sake fɔ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu ba pee kɔ nya tɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Yawɛ dɛ mi enɛ ɔ je; hyɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ ha!

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kunimi yemi ligbi ji mwɔnɛ ɔ; nyɛ ha nɛ wa nya, nɛ wa na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, he wa yi wami koo! Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa ye kunimi koo!

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ɔ! Wa ngɛ mo gbae kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji Mawu; e ha wɔ la. Nyɛɛ hɛɛ tã kuɔmi ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ sala kɛ ya bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Mo ji ye Mawu; ma na mo si. Mo ji ye Mawu; ma wo o hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e mi mi hi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: A gbaa nihi nɛ yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ kɛ a tsui tsuo hlaa e se blɔ,

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o wo o mlaa amɛ, konɛ a ye nɔ sisiisi.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: I na nɛ i nyɛ ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ sisiisi.

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Ke i hyɛ saminya, nɛ i ye o mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ zo be mi gbee.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Ke i kase o mlaa kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ma je o yi kɛ tsui nɛ mi tsɔ.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ; ko kua mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ! Ye Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: I suɔ kaa ma nyɛɛ o se kɛ ye tsui tsuo, ko ha nɛ ma je o mlaa amɛ a he.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: I ngɔ o munyu ɔ kɛ to ye tsui mi tɔɔ, konɛ ma ko pee yayami kɛ si mo.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ma je o yi; tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Mlaahi tsuo nɛ je o nya a, imi hu ma fiɛ.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Ye bua jɔɔ o mlaa amɛ a he pe ní nami babauu.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Ma susu o mlaa amɛ a he, nɛ o blɔ ɔmɛ maa hi ye hɛ mi daa.

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: O tsɔlɔ ji mi, naa mi mɔbɔ; ha nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami, konɛ ma ye o mlaa a nɔ.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Bli ye hɛngmɛ, konɛ ma na nyakpɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ o mlaa a mi.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Nubwɔ ji mi ngɛ je ɔ mi; koo ngɔ o mlaa a kɛ laa mi.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Daa nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ ye tsui yee kaa ma le o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: O kaa he woli a hɛ mi; á gbiɛ nihi nɛ tlaa blɔ kɛ jee o mlaa amɛ a he.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Ke ganɔhi ya kpe nɛ a ngɛ ye yi nɔ soe tete po, imi, o tsɔlɔ lɛɛ o mlaa amɛ a he pɛ ma susu.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: O mlaa amɛ jɔɔ ye bua; mɛ nɔuu ji ye ga woli. Yé Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: I tlɔ zugba mɔbɔmɔbɔ; ha nɛ ma na he wami ekohu kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: I jaje níhi nɛ i pee ɔ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ mo, nɛ o he mi nɔ; tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ ma nu o mlaa amɛ a sisi, konɛ ma susu nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ a he.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu ha nɛ i pee vii. Wó mi he wami ekohu kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Je mi kɛ je yayami peemi mi. Naa mi mɔbɔ, konɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa a.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: I pee ye yi mi ke anɔkuale pɛ ma ye; i ngɔ o mlaa amɛ kɛ to ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i pɛtɛ o mlaa amɛ a he wawɛɛ; ko ha zo nɛ gbe mi.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ kɛ gɛjɛmi; ejakaa o ha nɛ i nu mlaa amɛ a sisi saminya. Ha nɛ ma nu mlaa a sisi

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ a sisi, konɛ ma ye a nɔ sisiisi.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ ma nu mlaa a sisi, konɛ ma ye nɔ kɛ ye tsui tsuo.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ ma ye mlaa a nɔ; ejakaa e haa mi bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ ma suɔ o mlaa amɛ mohu pe kaa ma na ní kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ a he be se nami ɔ, ko ha ma hyɛ. Mo ha ye yi nɛ na wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Si nɛ o wo nihi nɛ buɔ mo tue ɔ, ha nɛ e ba mi ha imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Ahlua nɛ i ngɛ gbeye yee kaa a maa bɔ mi ɔ, ha nɛ e tsɔ ye he kɛ ho, ejakaa o mlaa amɛ hi.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Hyɛ kaa i suɔ o mlaa amɛ; ha mi wami he, ejakaa o peeɔ nɔ nɛ da. Ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma na heto ma ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi ahlua bɔe ɔ, ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o munyu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ ma nyɛ ma tu anɔkuale be tsuaa be; ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ma ye o mlaa a nɔ daa; ma ye nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene;

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: nɛ ma hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi; ejakaa o mlaa nɔ i hlaa kaa ma ye.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ a hɛ mi tete po ma fiɛ o mlaa a, nɛ e be mi zo pee.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: I naa o mlaa amɛ a he bua jɔmi, ejakaa i suɔ o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Mo kai si nɛ o wo imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ; ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ nɔ nae pohu ye bua jɔ, ejakaa o wo mi si ke o ma he ye yi wami.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o tsu blema lokoo ɔ, ke i susu a he ɔ, ye bua jɔɔ saminya.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Se ke i na yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ o mlaa a tɔ̃e ɔ, ye mi mi woɔ la wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: O mlaa amɛ plɛ pee lahi nɛ i laa ngɛ ye wami be kpiti nɛ ɔ mi ngɛ je ɔ mi.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: I kaiɔ mo Yawɛ nyɔ mi, nɛ i susuɔ o mlaa a he.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: I ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ o gbaa mi. Pɛtɛ Yawɛ mlaa a he saminya

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo pɛ i suɔ; i ngɛ si woe ke ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae kɛ ye tsui tsuo ke o na mi mɔbɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: I susu ye je mi bami he, nɛ i ngɛ si woe ke ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: I ngɛ esɔ hee nɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ; tsle tomi be mi ha mi.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsɔ mi klamahi lɛɛ, se ye hɛ ji o mlaa a nɔ.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Nyɔ mi kpɛti i teɔ si nɛ i naa mo si, ejakaa o mlaa amɛ da saminya.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: O tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ mo, kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, ye huɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a hyi je ɔ tɔ; moo tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ. Yawɛ mlaa he jua wa

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o ye o siwo ɔ nɔ, o kɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ ye saminya.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Ha mi juɛmi, kɛ nile; ejakaa i he o mlaa a ye.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Loko o gbla ye tue ɔ, i pɔɔ blɔ tlami, se jehanɛ lɛɛ i yeɔ o munyu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: O hi, nɛ o peeɔ kpakpa saminya! Moo tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ tuɔ lakpa munyuhi kɛ siɔ mi; se imi lɛɛ i kɛ ye tsui tsuo yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛɛ a nui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sisi, se imi lɛɛ i naa o mlaa a he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: E hi ha mi kaa o gbla ye tue, konɛ ma kase o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: O mlaa a nɛ o ha mi ɔ hi ha mi pe je nɛ ɔ mi sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ babauu. Yawɛ mlaa a da

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Mo nitsɛ lɛ o bɔ mi, nɛ o baa ye yi. Ha mi juɛmi nɛ kɔɔ nɔ́ se, konɛ ma kase o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ maa na mi, nɛ a bua maa jɔ a he; ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o munyu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a nɛ jɔɔ ye bua kaa bɔ nɛ o wo imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ si ɔ.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Naa mi mɔbɔ, konɛ ye yi nɛ na wami, ejakaa ye bua jɔɔ o mlaa a he.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, ha zo nɛ gbe mɛ; ejakaa a po ye nya yaka gu; se imi lɛɛ o mlaa amɛ a he pɛ ma susu.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ mo nɛ ɔ a ba ye ngɔ, konɛ a ba kase o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ sisiisi, konɛ zo ko gbe mi! Ba kpɔ mi

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ye he be se nami hu kaa wai tɔ nɛ a je se; se kɛ̃ ɔ, ye hɛ ji o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ tsua muɔhi kɛ tsɔ mi klama, konɛ a nine nɛ su ye nɔ.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: E piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ a ko gbe nya ha mi ngɛ je ɔ mi; se kɛ ɔ, i kua we o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: O naa mɔbɔ; he ye yi wami, konɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Wo hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o munyu ɔ maa hi si daa; e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: O we anɔkuale yemi maa gblee yi nɔhi tsuo a mi. Mo lɛ o ngɔ zugba a kɛ ma si nɛ e maa si kpɛii nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Níhi tsuo ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o fa mɛ ɔ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ, ejakaa o tsɔli ji mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Ke pi o mlaa a nɛ haa mi bua jɔmi ɔ, jinɛ ye hɛ mi kpata momo ngɛ ye amanehlu ɔ mi.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Ye hɛ be o mlaa amɛ a nɔ jee gblegbleegble, ejakaa a nɔ o gu kɛ he ye yi wami.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: O nɔ́ ji mi, he ye yi wami; ejakaa i bɔ mɔde kaa ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Yiwutsosɛmɛ woɔ mi ka nɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi; se imi lɛɛ o mlaa amɛ a he mohu i susuɔ.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: I suɔ o mlaa a kaa nɔ́ ko! Ke je na kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e he pɛ i susuɔ.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: I le ní pe ye he nyɛli tsuo, ejakaa o mlaa a kɛ mi ngɛ daa.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: I nuɔ nɔ́ sisi pe ye tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tsuo, ejakaa o mlaa amɛ a he i susuɔ.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: I kɔɔ munyu se pe nikɔtɔmahi po; ejakaa i yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: I kpa je mi bami yayami ɔmɛ tsuo; ejakaa i suɔ kaa ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: I ji o munyu ɔmɛ a he; ejakaa mo lɛ o tsɔɔ mi ní.

english_verse: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
translation_verse: O mlaa a ngɔɔ loo! E ngɔɔ pe hwo tete po.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: O mlaa amɛ da saminya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ngɛ mo si woe veveeve ke ma ye a nɔ sisiisi.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ, se ye we amanehlu ɔ nya wa nitsɛnitsɛ.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo he ye bɔ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ mo si nae ɔ, nɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsɔɔ mi klama mohu, se i tɔ̃ we o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: O mlaa amɛ ji ye weto ní kɛ yaa neneene. O mlaa amɛ haa ye tsui nɔɔ ye mi fuaa.

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ suɔ mo fa kɛ fa a, i sume mɛ; i suɔ o mlaa amɛ mohu.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Mo ji ye he bulɔ, kɛ ye yi baalɔ; i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o siwo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yayami peeli, nyɛɛ je ye nɔ kɛ ya se! Ye Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ ma ye.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Wo mi he wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo mi si ɔ; ha nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami. I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ kulaa; koo gbe mi zo.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Pɛtɛ ye he, konɛ ye yi nɛ na wami, nɛ ye hɛ maa hi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ daa.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ je mi ɔ, o buu mɛ kaa kuku nɔ dade. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o mlaa amɛ pɛ lɛ i suɔ.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: O he sawale nu mi, nɛ ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli; ejakaa o kojomi ɔmɛ ngɛ gbeye. Bu Yawɛ mlaa a tue

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa lɛ i peeɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo ngmɛɛ ye he ha nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Moo da mi ha o tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e hi ha lɛ. Ko ha nɛ he nɔ woli nɛ wa mi yi mi.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: I hyɛ blɔ hluu kaa o ma ba he ye yi wami, kaa o maa ye o siwo ɔ nɔ; se jehanɛ ye hɛ se gbo.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Mo nɛ o suɔmi be nyagbe, naa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: O tsɔlɔ ji mi, ha mi nile, konɛ ma nu o mlaa amɛ a sisi.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nihi ngɛ o mlaa a tɔ̃e; be su nɛ o maa pee he nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i suɔ o mlaa amɛ pe sika tsu, ee, pe sika tsu ngmingmiingmi.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i buɔ o mlaa amɛ tsuo, se blɔhi nɛ dɛ ɔ lɛɛ i sume. Ye Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: O mlaa amɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yeɔ a nɔ kɛ ye tsui tsuo.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Ke a tsɔɔ o mlaa a sisi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa la, nɛ e haa kuasia po leɔ ní.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Mo plɛ nɛ o hyɛ mi nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o peeɔ kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ mo ɔ.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Moo ye o siwo ɔ nɔ; ko ha nɛ ma nɔ si; ko ha nɛ yayami nɛ ye ye nɔ.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Mo je o he si, nɛ o na imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, dalɔ ji mo, nɛ o mlaa amɛ hu da pɛpɛɛpɛ!

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Mlaa amɛ nɛ o wo ɔ, a da, anɔkuale sɔuu.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe kaa la, ejakaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ bui o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Ke o wo si ɔ, o yeɔ nɔ sisiisi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, i suɔ o siwo ɔ tsɔ!

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Dalɔ ji mo, nɛ ja o ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene; o mlaa a, anɔkuale sɔuu.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: I ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe kɛ ye tsui tsuo. Yawɛ, mo ha nɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Mo i ngɛ tsɛe ɔ nɛ; mo he ye yi wami, nɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: I teɔ si makɛ mla, nɛ i kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ mo ke o ba piɛ ye he. I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o siwo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Nyɔ mi tsuo i hwɔ we mahe; o siwo ɔ he i hii susue.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Bu ye gbi tue koo; ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe. Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ o peeɔ; naa mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o baa ye yi.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae nɛ bui o mlaa a, a ngɛ hɛe kɛ ngɛ ye he sue.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ, o ngɛ ye kasa nya haa, nɛ o mlaa amɛ tsuo maa si kpɛii.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: I le kɛ je blema lokoo kaa o wo mlaa amɛ nɛ a hi si kɛ ya neneene. Ba piɛ ye he

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Hyɛ amanehlu nɛ i ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ, nɛ o ba je mi kɛ je mi, ejakaa ye hɛ ji o mlaa a nɔ.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Ba ye ye sane ɔ ha mi, nɛ o kpɔ mi. He ye yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: A be yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi wami hee; ejakaa a bui o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ, mo nɛ o naa mɔbɔ babauu, nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; mo he ye yi wami.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ waa mi yi mi, kɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu, se kɛ̃ ɔ, ye hɛ ji o mlaa a nɔ.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Ke i na nihi nɛ yi mo anɔkuale kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a he peeɔ mi tãi; ejakaa a yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i suɔ o mlaa amɛ kaa nɔ́ ko! O suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he ɔ, mo he ye yi wami.

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Ganɔhi waa mi yi mi yaka, se kɛ̃ ɔ, i buɔ o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: I sume lakpa kulaa, i hiee lɛ; se o mlaa lɛɛ i suɔ.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: I jeɔ o yi si kpaago daa ligbi, ejakaa o mlaa amɛ da.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ suɔ o mlaa amɛ ɔ, a naa he jɔmi nitsɛnitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be hae nɛ a maa tla blɔ.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo o nɔ ye hɛ ngɛ, ba he ye yi wami; i peeɔ níhi nɛ o mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; i suɔ o mlaa amɛ kɛ ye tsui tsuo.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ; o le ye yami kɛ bami mi fitsofitso. Ba piɛ ye he

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ngmlaa nɛ i ngɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe ɔ, bu tue koo! Ha nɛ ma nu nɔ́ sisi kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ!

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue nɛ o ba kpɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ!

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Ma je o yi daa; ejakaa o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Ma la o mlaa a he la; ejakaa o mlaa amɛ tsuo da saminya.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Pee klaalo nɛ o ba piɛ ye he; ejakaa i yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo blɔ hyɛe; ba he ye yi wami koo! O mlaa a pɛ lɛ haa ye bua jɔɔ ye he.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami, konɛ ma je o yi; ha nɛ o mlaa amɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ mi blɔ.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: I ngɛ lalaalo woe kaa to nɛ laa; mo hla imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ koo! Ejakaa i je we ye hɛ ngɛ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: Yawɛ, je mi kɛ je lakpatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ sisiɔ a sibi a dɛ mi.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Ye yi fi pɛ! Hyɛ kaa i ba to nubwɔ ngɛ Meshek; nɛ i ngɛ Kedar bi a ma mi!

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Ye se ba kɛ tsɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ sume tue mi jɔmi ɔ a kpɛti.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ he jɔmi nɔmlɔ ji mi, se ke i tu munyu kɛkɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a hia ta!

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ ye he.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: E be hae nɛ o sane kɛ nɔ si. O he bulɔ ɔ, e de we kɔnɔɛ gblegbleegble.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: O nɛ, Israel he bulɔ ɔ de we kɔnɔɛ, nɛ e hwɔ we mahe hulɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji o yi baalɔ. E ngɛ o kasa nya, konɛ e bu o he.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Piani ɔ, pu be mo sããe, nɛ nyɔ mi hu nyɔhiɔ be mo nɔ́ ko pee.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa bu o he kɛ je yayami tsuo mi; e maa baa o yi.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Ye bua jɔ ye he wawɛɛ nitsɛ benɛ a de mi ke, “Waa ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, jehanɛ lɛɛ wa ba sɛ o we agbo ɔmɛ a mi!

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Yerusalem ji ma nguaa saminyayoo nɛ a to lɛ si kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ hanɔhanɔ.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ yaa ya naa Yawɛ si kaa bɔ nɛ a fa Israel ma a ke a pee ɔ.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Israel matsɛmɛ nɛ ji David nina a hi kɛ kojo ma a.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ fa kue nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba Yerusalem. Nyɛ de ke, “Nihi nɛ suɔ mo Yerusalem ɔ, níhi a mi nɛ hi ha mɛ oo!

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba ma a mi; he jɔmi nɛ hi mɔ ɔmɛ a mi.”

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, kɛ ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ma de Yerusalem ke, “Tue mi jɔmi nɛ hi o mi!”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Yawɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ he je ɔ, ma hla o nɔ yami.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Yawɛ mo i wo ye yi nɔ kɛ ngɛ hyɛe; mo nɛ́ o hii si ngɛ o matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, mo i ngɛ hyɛe ɔ nɛ!

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Naa wɔ mɔbɔ; Yawɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ; ejakaa a pee wɔ nisɛ ní babauu tsɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ wa he ɔ nɛɛ? Israel ha heto koo!

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: “Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ wa he be mi nɛ wa he nyɛli te si kɛ wo wɔ ɔ,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: jinɛ bɔ nɛ a mi mi fu wɔ wawɛɛ nɛ ɔ, a ko mii wɔ hɛ ngmengmle;

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: jinɛ nyu babauu ɔ ko sá wɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ha wa nɔ;

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: nɛ nyu hamahama a ko kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.”

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha waa na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e ha we nɛ wa plɛ pee wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a lungu nya lo!

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba bɔlɔ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ wa he.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, a ngɛ kaa Zion yo ɔ. E maa si kpɛii kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe ma mimiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ yohi bɔle Yerusalem kɛ kpe ɔ, ja Yawɛ he wami ɔ bɔle e ma a kɛ kpe kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa neneene tsuo.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ be nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a a zugba nɔ yee daa, ke pi ja a, dali po maa pee yayami.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa, kɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ je a tsui mi ɔ, ha nɛ e hi ha mɛ.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a blɔ ɔmɛ dɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa gbla a kɛ yayami peeli tsuo a tue. He jɔmi nɛ hi Israel.

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yawɛ kpale wɔ kɛ je ma se kɛ ba Zion ekohu ɔ, e pee wɔ kaa pe wa ngɛ nlae.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, wa muɔ jɛɛ, nɛ wa la bua jɔmi la boboobo. Je ma amɛ hu de a sibi ke, “Yawɛ tsu ní nguanguahi ha mɛ.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, Yawɛ tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha wɔ, lɔ ɔ he nɛ wa bua jɔ wa he nɛ wa ngɛ nyae ɔ nɛ!

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa zugba nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ nɛ zugba gbigbli naa nyu babaaba ekohu ɔ.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ du ní kɛ vo nyu ɔ ma kpa ní kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ vo nyu hii e hɛ mi kɛ ya duɔ ní ɔ, e maa tloo niba ní kɛ ba we mi kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ maa tsu ɔ, tsu mali gboɔ yaka dengme. Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ buɔ ma he ɔ, bulɔ fɔɔ nyɔ yaka gu kɛ buɔ ma he.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Yaka gu nyɛ teɔ si makɛ mla, nɛ gbɔkuɛ hu nyɛ ya hwɔ we si mla. Nyɛ gboɔ dengme loko nyɛ naa nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ nyɛ yeɔ, se nɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ e sane ɔ, e haa e hwɔɔ mahe bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Bimɛ ji weto ní nɛ Yawɛ haa nɔ; bimɛ ji nike ní nɛ e kɛ dlooɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Nihe mi bimɛ nɛ a fɔɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa ta bulɔ dɛ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kotoku ɔ hyi kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ. Ke e kɛ e he nyɛli kpe ngɛ kojomi he ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yee Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ́ e yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: O yo maa pee kaa wai tso nɛ woɔ yiblii saminyayoo ngɛ o we ɔ mi; nɛ o bimɛ maa bɔle o we okplɔɔ ɔ afɛu mi kaa oliv tsohi nɛ tsɛ̃ kɛ ma.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Nyumu nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, niinɛ, bɔ nɛ a maa gbaa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nɛ gbaa mo kɛ je Zion. O wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ, o na bɔ nɛ Yerusalem ma plɔke ha.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: O wa, nɛ o na o bibimɛ. Tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba Israel ma a mi!

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Israel, jehanɛ de, “Kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si tɔɔ ɔ, ye he nyɛli wa mi yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ!”

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si tɔɔ ɔ, ye he nyɛli wa mi yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nyɛ we mi.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: A plaa ye se mi wawɛɛ, ye se mi pee kaa ngmɔ nɛ a kɛ kpakplaa hu.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ e peeɔ; e je mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.”

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ sume Zion ɔ, zo nɛ gbe mɛ nɛ a kpale a se!

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: A pee kaa nga nɛ ngɛ puɛe ngɛ tsu yi mi; benɛ e na we nɛ e wa, kɛkɛ e gbli momo.

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: Nga nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko fa we, nɛ a fi we nɛ a tloo kɛ je.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ bee ɔ kó de ke, “Yawɛ nɛ gbaa nyɛ! Wa ngɛ nyɛ gbaae ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi!”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i ngɛ kue fae ha mo, ejakaa ye yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, bu mi tue; bu ye pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Ke mo Mawu o ke o maa kane yayamihi ɔ, Yawɛ, mɛnɔ maa ye e he.

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Se o ngɔɔ yayami kɛ paa, konɛ a ye mo gbeye.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: I ngɛ Yawɛ blɔ hyɛe; e munyu ɔ nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: Ee, Yawɛ blɔ pɛ i ngɛ hyɛe. I ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe pe bɔ nɛ ma he buli huɔɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ ya suu mɔtu ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Israel, ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe; lɛ nɛ e heɔ wa yi wami.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ma kpɔ Israel kɛ je a he yayamihi tsuo a mi.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Israel, ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo kai amanehlu tsuo nɛ David na a.

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: E ka mo Yawɛ kita, nɛ e wo mo Yakob Mawu Ope ɔ si ke,

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “I be ye we mi yae, nɛ i ya be si hwɔe hulɔ.

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma na he ko ha mo Yawɛ, Yakob Mawu Ope ɔ, konɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ pee o hi he!”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Wa nu somi daka a he ngɛ Betlehem, nɛ wa ya na ngɛ Yearim ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Wa de ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ya Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ wa ya kpla si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi!”

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo wo o he nɔ, nɛ o ba o he jɔɔmi he ɔ; ngɔɔ somi daka a nɛ ji o he wami okadi ɔ hu kɛ ba.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ o we osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da be tsuaa be, nɛ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a hwɔ lele!

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, kita nɛ o ka David nɛ o be o nya se kpalee ji, “Ma wo o bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake matsɛ, nɛ e maa ye tsɛ ngɛ o se.

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ suɔ nɛ e hla Zion kaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ e maa hi.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Ma ha Zion ma na niye ní babauu, ma a mi ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa ye ní maa tɔ.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Ma gbaa osɔfo ɔmɛ a ní tsumi nɔ, nɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ma hwɔ lele!

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Ma pee David nina kake matsɛ agbo ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; ma to lɛ si kaa nɔ nɛ imi nitsɛ i hla, nɛ i wo lɛ matsɛ.

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e hi, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ fɛu, ke nyɛmimɛ pee kake kɛ hi si!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ a kake peemi ngɛ kaa nu nɛ he jua wa nɛ a kɛ pɔ Aaron yi mi, nɛ ngɛ dɛe kɛ ngɛ e kpɛni mi puee hluu kɛ ba su e tade klɔii ɔ nya tɔɔ!

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ a kake peemi ngɛ kaa bɔ́ ngɛ Hermon yo ɔ nɔ; e ngɛ kaa bɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɛe ngɛ Zion yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo si ngɛ ke e maa gbaa e ma a kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli tsuo, nyɛɛ ba; nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ ngɛ e we ɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, nyɛ je e yi

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ wo nyɛ nine nɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, é gbaa nyɛ kɛ je Zion.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! Nyɛ je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi! Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nyɛ je e yi!

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa Yawɛ hi; nyɛ la kɛ je e biɛ ɔ yi, ejakaa e mi mi hi.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ hla Yakob kɛ ha e he; e hla Israel kɛ pee e ma.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i le kaa Yawɛ kle; Yawɛ kle pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Hiɔwe ɔ jio, zugba a nɔ jio, wo ɔ mi jio, muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ a mi jio, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ́ Yawɛ suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e peeɔ.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e haa bɔku teɔ si ngɛ je ɔ nyagbe he; e pee oslabai kɛ ha hiɔmi, nɛ e jeɔ kɔɔhiɔ kpo kɛ jee e to he ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e gbe kekleekle bimɛ tsuo ngɛ Egipt, nimli adesahi a bimɛ, kɛ lohwehi a bimɛ.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ tsu nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi kɛ gbla Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a tue.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ kpata je mahi babauu a hɛ mi, nɛ e gbe matsɛmɛ nguangua nɛ ɔmɛ:

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Sihon, Amor bi a matsɛ ɔ, Og, Bashan matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Kanaan matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo;

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: nɛ e ngɔ a zugba a kɛ ha e ma, Israel kaa a weto ní.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o biɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene; Yawɛ, yi nɔhi tsuo ma kai mo.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma fa e ma a he; e maa na e tsɔli ɔmɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ a we amaga amɛ ɔ, sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu sɔuu, nimli adesahi a nine nya ní tsumi ji mɛ.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: A ngɛ nya, se a tu we munyu; a ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: I ná nɛ nihi nɛ pee mɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ tsuo pee kaa amaga amɛ nɛ a pee ɔ nɔuu!

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! Nyɛ Mawu we osɔfohi, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Levi bi, nyɛ je e yi; nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ yee Yawɛ gbeye, nyɛ je e yi!

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi ngɛ Zion; nyɛ je e yi ngɛ e we ɔ mi ngɛ Yerusalem. Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si; ejakaa Yawɛ hi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ na mawu ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ si; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ na nyɔmtsɛmɛ a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ si; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔ kake too lɛ e peeɔ nyakpɛ ní; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ nile kɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ zugba a kɛ ha nyu ɔ hɛ mi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e pee kane nguanguahi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e haa nɛ pu tsoɔ piani; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e haa nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi kpɛɔ nyɔ mi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e gbe Egipt bi ɔmɛ a kekleekle bimɛ; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e gba Wo Tsu ɔ mi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ha e ma, Israel nyɛɛ wo ɔ mi kɛ be; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e hɛɛ e ma a kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nɛ e gbe matsɛmɛ nguanguahi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Amor matsɛ, Sihon; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bashan matsɛ, Og; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ zugba amɛ kɛ ha e tsɔlɔ, Israel kaa e weto ní; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Benɛ wa yi fi wawɛɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e kai wɔ; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e haa nibɔ ní tsuo niye ní; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ na Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ si; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Babilon pa amɛ a tue wa hi si ngɛ nɛ wa wo yana, benɛ wa kai Zion ɔ.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Wa ngɔ wa kpa saku ɔmɛ ngɔ kpla tsohi a he ngɛ pa a tue.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a de wɔ ke wa la ha mɛ. Nihi nɛ ngɛ wɔ haoe ɔ suɔ kaa wa je a hɛja; a de wɔ ke, “Nyɛ la Zion la amɛ eko ha wɔ!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
