translation_verse: Mɛni he je wa ma la Yawɛ la ngɛ ma se?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Ke ye hɛ je mo Yerusalem, o nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ye hiɔ nine nɛ gbo.

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Ke i kaii we mo Yerusalem, nɛ ke i bui mo kaa nɔ nɛ haa mi bua jɔmi pe kulaa a, lɛɛ ye lilɛ nɛ mɛtɛ ye nya mi.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo kai nɔ́ nɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ pee Yerusalem ligbi ko ɔ. Edom bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Nyɛɛ ku ma a kɛ pue si; nyɛɛ ku lɛ pue si kɛ ya su e sisi tomi ɔmɛ tɔɔ!”

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Mo Babilon, ja a kpata o hɛ mi kokooko! A gbaa nɔ nɛ maa pee mo kɛ to nane mi kaa bɔ nɛ o pee wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ o bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ kɛ fiaa tɛ sa.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo si nae kɛ ye tsui tsuo. I ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ o yi jee ngɛ Mawu kpa amɛ a hɛ mi po.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: I ngɔ ye hɛ mi kɛ bu si kɛ kpee sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu ɔ; nɛ i ngɛ mo si nae kaa o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa, nɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale jã kɛ̃. Jehanɛ hu o ha nɛ a na kaa o biɛ kle pe biɛ tsuaa biɛ, nɛ o munyu hu he jua wa pe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Ligbi ɔ nɛ i tsɛ mo ɔ, o he nɔ. O wo mi kã, nɛ ye nɔ gbagba te.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ ma je o yi, ejakaa munyu nɛ je o nya a, a nu.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: A ma la kɛ gba nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ; a ma la ma de ke o hɛ mi nyami ɔ kle.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo mohu, se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, e hɛ hii e nɔ; nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ lɛɛ e he sane ko pi Yawɛ sane.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ke i ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ, mo lɛ o jeɔ mi kɛ jeɔ mi. Ke ye he nyɛli kɛ abofu ba na mi ɔ, o kɛ mɛ kpee, nɛ o kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ heɔ ye yi wami.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Yawɛ, yi mi nɛ o to ha mi ɔ, o maa ye nɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ, o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene. Ní tsumi nɛ o je sisi ɔ, koo ngmɛɛ he.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o hyɛ ye mi tsuo, nɛ o le bɔ nɛ i ngɛ.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Ye si himi, kɛ ye si temi tsuo o le, ye yi mi tomi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, o le momo.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Loko ma pa ye nya mi ke ma de nɔ́ ko ɔ, mo Yawɛ, o le lɛ tsuo momo.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: O ngɔ o he wami kɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe, nɛ o buɔ ye he.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ o le mi fitsofitso ɔ ngɛ nyakpɛ tsɔ. Nile nɛ ɔ mi kuɔ pe bɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ma nu sisi.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Jije ma je o mumi ɔ hɛ mi kɛ maa ya? Jije ma ya laa ye he ngɛ nɛ o be mi nae?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: Ke i kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe ɔ, ne mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ ke i ya hwɔ si ngɛ gbeje hu ne mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ ji mi, nɛ i te papaapa kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya ma bonyoku je se lokoo;

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: lejɛ ɔ tete po mo lɛ o maa tsɔɔ mi blɔ, nɛ o hiɔ nine maa su ye nɔ.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Ke i de ke diblii ba ha ye nɔ, loo pu la nɛ bɔle mi ɔ nɛ plɛ pee diblii ɔ,

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ lɛɛ yaka gu, ejakaa diblii pee we diblii ha mo, nɛ nyɔ mi tsɔɔ heii kaa piani nɔuu; diblii jio, la jio, lɛ tsuo kake ha mo.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi níhi tsuo ɔ, mo lɛ o pee. O puɛ mi ngɛ ye nyɛ muklii mi tɔɔ.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: I ngɛ o yi jee, ejakaa bɔ nɛ o plɛ kɛ bɔ mi ɔ, e ngɛ gbeye, nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ hulɔ. Níhi nɛ o pee ɔ ngɛ nyakpɛ loo! O le mi fitsofitso.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ mi puɛe ngɛ laami mi, nɛ wu ɔmɛ ngɛ wae ngɛ ye nyɛ muklii mi tɔɔ ɔ, i fɔɔ si paa ngɛ o hɛ mi.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Benɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mi lolo po ɔ, a ngma ye wami be ɔ tsuo ngɛ o womi ɔ mi momo.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Mawu, yi mi tomi nɛ o ngɛ ha mi ɔ he jua wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Ní kpakpahi nɛ o susuɔ ha mi ɔ, a he hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Ke i ke ma kane mɛ ɔ, i be nyɛe, ejakaa a he hiɛ babauu pe zia. Loko ye hɛ maa tsɛ po o ngɛ ye he susue momo.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Mawu, i na nɛ o gbe yiwusotsɛmɛ, konɛ ma ye ye he kɛ je muɔ si pueli nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tuɔ musu bɔmi munyu, nɛ a teɔ si kɛ woɔ mo.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ bui mo ɔ, anɛ imi lɛɛ i buɔ mɛ lo? Nihi nɛ tsɔɔ o hɛ mi atuã a, anɛ i suɔ mɛ lo?

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Dɛbi, i sume mɛ saasaa; i buɔ mɛ ye he nyɛli.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Mawu, hyɛ ye tsui mi nɛ o le mi. Kaa mi nɛ o hyɛ, nɛ o na níhi nɛ ngɛ ye juɛmi mi.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Hyɛ kaa yayami ko pa ngɛ ye mi lo, nɛ o ngɔ mi kɛ fɔ blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa neneene wami mi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami; jé mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛɛ yayami he pɛ a susuɔ. Daa nɛ ɔ, pɛ kɛkɛ a ngɛ woe.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: A lilɛ ngɛ kaa sinɔ duɔtsɛ nɔ́. A munyu ngɛ kaa sanga duɔ.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, bu ye he; jé mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi; ejakaa a to a yi mi kaa a maa tsɛ̃ mi kɛ fia si.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: He nɔ woli tsɔ klamahi ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a tue. A tsɔ mi klama, konɛ a du mi.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: I deɔ Yawɛ ke, “Mo ji ye Mawu!” Yawɛ, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue!

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Ye Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ye yi wami helɔ kpanaa, ta be mi ɔ, mo nɔuu lɛ o baa ye yi.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, koo ngmɛ yayami peeli blɔ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ; ko ha nɛ a yi mi tomi yaya amɛ nɛ ba mi.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ la ngu hɛuu ba pue a nɔ! A ya nɔ muɔ mi nɛ a ko nyɛ kpo nɛ a je gblegbleegble.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, i le kaa nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, mo lɛ o hyɛɛ a nɔ, nɛ o yeɔ ohiatsɛmɛ a sane ha mɛ.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a maa na mo si; kpakpa peeli kɛ mo maa hi si daa.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo i ngɛ tsɛe; o he nɛ sɔ ha mi; mo i ngɛ tsɛe boboobo ɔ nɛ, bu mi tue koo!

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo to bulɔ nɛ hyɛ ye nya nɔ, konɛ e hyɛ ye munyu tumi nɔ.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Piɛ ye he, konɛ ma ko na yayami peemi he bua jɔmi; piɛ ye he, konɛ i kɛ yayami peeli ko bɔ; nɛ ko ha ma ya ye a niye ní ngɔngɔɛ ɔ eko.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ dalɔ nɛ gba mi ma, nɛ e ngɔ e mi mi himi ɔ kɛ ka ye hɛ mi; se ko ha nɛ yayami peeli nɛ a je ye yi; ejakaa be tsuaa be ɔ, i faa kue kɛ siɔ a yayami ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Ke a ngɔ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo nihi nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi a dɛ mi ɔ, ma a ma na maa le kaa Yawɛ munyu ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Se mo Yawɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ i ngɛ hyɛe; mo ji ye wesa he; koo ngmɛɛ ye he kulaa kɛ fɔ si; bu ye he.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ a ya nɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a klamahi a mi, se imi lɛɛ ha ma je a mi slɔkee.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: I ngɔ ye kɔmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e hɛ mi; i de lɛ ye haomi ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Benɛ ye nine mi miɔ nɛ e wo nyu ɔ, moo lɛɛ o le ye hiami ɔ mo. Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsɔ mi klama ngɛ ye blɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Ke i hyɛ ye hiɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mi; wesa he ko kulaa be ha mi, nɔ ko nɔ ko bui ye he akɔtaa.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo i ngɛ tsɛe ɔ nɛ. I ngɛ dee ke mo pɛ ji ye wesa he ngɛ je ɔ mi.

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Ye yi fi; ejakaa a he wa pe mi. Je mi, konɛ ma na mo si ngɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a hɛ mi; ejakaa kpakpa nitsɛnitsɛ o maa pee mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: O kɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ kó ye sane; ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa ko adesa ko be nguɔ yee ngɛ o hɛ mi.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Ye he nyɛlɔ ɔ nyɛɛ ye se nɛ e ma kpata ye hɛ mi. E fia mi nɔ́ wawɛɛ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ ye yi se ngɔ wo diblii kpii mi; i pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ gbo momoomo.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Ye mumu nya ta jehanɛ, nɛ peepee ta ye he!

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: I kaii sa blema a, nɛ i susuɔ níhi tsuo nɛ o tsu ɔ a he; i susuɔ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ a he.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: I woɔ ye nine nɔ kɛ yaa hiɔwe kɛ faa kue. Bɔ nɛ zugba gbigbli hlaa nyu kɛ jɔɔ e he ɔ, ja o he kuma ngɛ mi yee.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, he mi nɔ esɔ koo! Ye hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo miɔ nɛ e ta. Koo ngɔ o he kɛ laa mi; ke pi ja a, i kɛ gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɛ gbeje maa sɔ.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Mɔtu ɔ, ha ma kai bɔ nɛ o mi mi hi ha; ejakaa o nɔ i ngɔɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔɔ. Ha nɛ ma le he nɛ ma gu; ejakaa mo pɛ o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, jé mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi. O ngɔ i ba sa we ngɛ.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Moo tsɔɔ mi nɛ ma pee nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ; ejakaa mo ji ye Mawu. Ha nɛ o mumi kpakpa a nɛ tsɔɔ mi blɔ nɛ hi, nɛ e nɔ jɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ. O peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo je mi kɛ je haomi mi.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi, lɛ ji ye yi baalɔ. E tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ a gbaa ta, kɛ bɔ nɛ a miaa kɛ hwuu ta.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji ye yi baalɔ, ye wesa he nitsɛnitsɛ, kɛ ye kpɔlɔ; lɛ ji ye tsɛ̃i, nɛ e ngɔ i ya saa we ngɛ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ baa ma a si kɛ woɔ ye sisi.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mɛnɔ kulaa ji nɔmlɔ nɛ o peeɔ e he akɔtaa, loo nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ o susuɔ e he ɔ?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa mumu nɛ a woɔ ɔ; e ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa hɔ̃ nɛ bee kɛ yaa.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ha nɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ ba si, nɛ o kple si kɛ ba. Moo ta yo ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a je la su ku.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ oslabai nɛ gba, nɛ o gbɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa; tsɛ̃ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o wo mɛ fo.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Kpa o nine mi kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ o sá mi; jé mi kɛ je nyu babauu ɔ mi; jé mi kɛ je nibwɔhi a dɛ mi;

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: a nya mi munyu ɔ, lakpa sɔuu, nɛ a yeɔ lakpa kɛ kaa kita po.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Mawu, ma la la he ha mo, ma fia kpa saku nɛ hɛɛ kpa nyɔngma kɛ je o yi.

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: Mo lɛ o haa matsɛmɛ yeɔ kunimi, nɛ o heɔ o tsɔlɔ David yi wami.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ wa binyumuhi nɛ ngɛ nihe mi ɔ, a he nɛ wa kaa tso nɛ maa si saminya. Ha nɛ wa biyihi nɛ a pee kaa tɛ titima kɛ ha matsɛ mɔ fiami.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Wa blɛfo gba amɛ nɛ a hyi tɔ kɛ ngma, nɛ a na niye ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; wa to ɔmɛ hu nɛ a fɔ babauu akpeakpe abɔ ngɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: Wa na amɛ hu nɛ a fɔ babauu ja nɔuu; a mi ko sane; nɛ a ko nu bubuubui ko ngɛ wa gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a gbaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a bua maa jɔ. Nihi nɛ Yawɛ ji a Mawu ɔ, a bua maa jɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Ye Mawu kɛ ye matsɛ, ma wo o hɛ mi nyami, nɛ ma na mo si daa.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Ma na mo si daa ligbi, nɛ ma je o yi kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kle, nɛ e sa kaa a je e yi wawɛɛ nitsɛ. E kle pe bɔ nɛ adesa juɛmi ma nyɛ maa su he.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: O hɛ mi nyami, o we agboje, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ, ma susu a he saminya.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Nihi maa fiɛ nyakpɛ ní, kɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ o pee ɔ, nɛ imi hu ma fiɛ ke o kle niinɛ.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: A ma de ke o mi mi hi saminya. A ma la boboobo ke daa nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ o peeɔ.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Dloolɔ kɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ ji Yawɛ; e mi mi fu we mla, nɛ e suɔmi hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Yawɛ peeɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpakpa, nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ he ha níhi tsuo nɛ e bɔ ɔ.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, níhi nɛ o pee ɔ tsuo maa na mo si, nɛ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ma je o yi!

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo maa le ní nguanguahi nɛ o pee, kɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ we agboje.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: O matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ daa, nɛ o nɔ yemi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene. Yawɛ yeɔ e siwo nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e peeɔ ɔ hi saminya.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Bɔ níhi tsuo nɛ wami ngɛ a mi ɔ, mo pɛ nɛ a ngɛ blɔ hyɛe; ejakaa mo lɛ o haa mɛ a niye ní ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: O bliɔ o dɛ mi, nɛ o haa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle tɔɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ peeɔ ɔ da; e naa mɔbɔ be tsuaa be.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɛɔ Yawɛ ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ, Yawɛ hɛɛ lɛ kɛ suu e he.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ yee lɛ gbeye ɔ, e peeɔ a hiami ní kɛ haa mɛ. E buu a kue fami ɔmɛ hu tue, nɛ e heɔ a yi wami.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ Yawɛ ɔ, e baa a yi; se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e ma kpata a hɛ mi.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Ma je Yawɛ yi, nɛ ma ha nimli adesahi tsuo ma je e yi kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! Imi hu ma je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Ke nɔmlɔ gbo ɔ, e kpaleɔ kɛ yaa zu mi ekohu, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu e yi mi tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a se poɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ ji e he piɛlɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ e Mawu ɔ nɔ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ pee hiɔwe, zugba, wo, kɛ a mi níhi tsuo, nɛ e yeɔ e siwo nɔ daa.

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Yawɛ bliɔ hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ; Yawɛ woɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ si a nɔ; Yawɛ suɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Yawɛ baa nibwɔhi a yi; e yeɔ yalɔyihi, kɛ awusahi a sane kɛ haa mɛ; se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e haa a yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa ye tsɛ daa. Zion, o Mawu ɔ maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene. Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! E hi kaa a la kɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi; ejakaa dloolɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e sa kaa a la kɛ je e yi.

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem sisi toe ekohu; e ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ gbɛ fĩa a a nya buae kɛ ba.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: E le dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo a yibɔ, nɛ e kɛ a biɛhi tsɛɔ mɛ kakaaka.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kle; e ngɛ he wami babauu, nɛ e nile hu a li nya.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Yawɛ piɛɔ nihi nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi a he; se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e sakee mɛ ngɔ fiaa si.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ la sina la ha Yawɛ; nyɛɛ fia saku nɛ nyɛ la kɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi!

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e ngɔɔ bɔku kɛ haa hiɔwe, nɛ e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ kɛ pueɔ zugba a nɔ, nɛ nga mumu puɛɔ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e haa nga mi lohwehi niye ní, nɛ ke kuakualabite bihi ngɛ pɛe hu, lɛ nɛ e haa mɛ ní.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Okpɔngɔ nɛ he wa tete po e bui; fo tulɔ kpanaa hu pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Yerusalem, mo je Yawɛ yi! Zion, mo je o Mawu ɔ yi!

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e peeɔ o we agbo ɔmɛ a se lami ní ɔmɛ kpɛii, nɛ e gbaa o bimɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: E haa tue mi jɔmi baa o zugba a nɔ, nɛ niye ní buu tɔ.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Ke e wo gbi ɔ, a nuɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ a yeɔ nɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: E haa nɛ snoo nɛɔ kaa doti, nɛ e gbɛɔ bɔ́ nɛ fi ɔ kɛ fĩaa kaa la zu.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: E haa gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛɔ kaa dongo tɛ. Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa da e fĩɛ ɔ nya?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Ke e fa a, gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔmɛ sileɔ; e haa kɔɔhiɔ fiaa, kɛkɛ nyu ɔ bɔni nyɛɛmi.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: E wo Israel mlaa, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ a ja Mawu ha.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: E pee we kikɛ nɛ ɔ ha we ma ko ma ko hyɛ, nɛ e mlaa amɛ hu, ma kpa ko li. Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi kɛ je hiɔwe. Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Mawu bɔfohi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi! Nyɛ e ta a tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Pu, kɛ nyɔhiɔ, nyɛ je e yi! Nyɛ dodoehi tsuo nɛ kpɛɔ, nyɛ je e yi!

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hiɔwe tsuo, nyɛ je e yi! Nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe yi mi, mo je e yi!

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je Yawɛ yi; ejakaa lɛ nɛ e fa nɛ a bɔ mɛ.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: E ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ma si kɛ yaa neneene. E wo huzu ha mɛ, nɛ a be hanee.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! Nyɛ wo mi lo nguanguahi, kɛ muɔ voovoohi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: La, gbiɛ ngo ngu, snoo, bɔ nɛ fi, kɛ ahumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yawɛ tsɔmi nɔ, nyɛ je e yi!

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: Yo nguanguahi, kɛ yo wawi tsuo, tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii, kɛ seda tsohi tsuo,

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: nga mi lohwehi, kɛ we mi lohwehi tsuo, lohwehi nɛ sãã si, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, nyɛ je e yi!

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ, kɛ ma amɛ tsuo, ganɔhi, kɛ ma nɔ yeli tsuo,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: nihewi kɛ yihewi tsuo, nikɔtɔmahi kɛ jokuɛwi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, nyɛ je e yi!

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa lɛ nɔ kake too lɛ ngɛ biɛ nɛ kle agbo; e hɛ mi nyami ha zugba a nɔ tsuo kɛ be hiɔwe tete he.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: E to e ma a sisi kɛ he wami saminya. lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ma a tsuo ngɛ e yi jee; e ma a ji Israel, nɛ e he jua wa ha lɛ kaa nɔ́ ko. Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! Nyɛ la la he kɛ ha Yawɛ. Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpe ɔ mi!

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Israel, nya o bɔlɔ ɔ he. Zion bi, nyɛ nya nyɛ matsɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Á do nɛ a kɛ je e yi. Á la nɛ a fiɛ do, nɛ a fia saku kɛ je e yi.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ naa e ma a he bua jɔmi. E haa nihi nɛ baa a he si yeɔ kunimi.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a hwɔ lele kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye kunimi niinɛ, nɛ a la kɛ bua jɔmi nyɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Á la kɛ he wami kɛ je Mawu yi. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, á hɛɛ klaate nya enyɔtsɛ ngɛ a dɛ mi,

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Á wo a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ, nɛ a we ablade ɔmɛ ɔ, a bɔ mɛ dade pã;

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: a gbla je ma amɛ a tue kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma kɛ to ɔ. Mawu ma a tsuo ye kunimi! Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi! Nyɛ je Mawu yi ngɛ e he klɔuklɔu ɔ; nyɛ je e yi ngɛ e bɔku kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi!

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ he wami níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ a he; nyɛ je e yi, ejakaa e kle agbo.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpa titimati kɛ je e yi, nyɛ je e yi kɛ saku, kɛ kpa saku!

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ fia miɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ do kɛ je e yi; nyɛ je e yi kɛ kpa saku, kɛ bɛ!

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ woɔ mumi ɔ, e je Yawɛ yi! Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Israel matsɛ, Salomo, David bi ɔ abɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Abɛ ɔmɛ maa tsɔɔ mo anɔkuale yemi, dami sane yemi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da peemi.

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ li nɔ́ ɔ, abɛ ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ e nɔ bɔ ma tsɔ; se niheyo lɛɛ e ma na juɛmi, kɛ hɛ mi si kami.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Ke ní lelɔ nu abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e nile ɔ maa hiɛ kɛ pue nɔ; juɛmitsɛ hu e juɛmi ɔ mi ma blɛke pe kekle ɔ,

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a nu abɛhi, kɛ ní leli a munyuhi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ a sisi saminya. A wo nihewi ga

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Loko o ma na nile ɔ, ja o ye Yawɛ gbeye. Kuasiahi bui nile, nɛ slɔmi gbi hu a sume.

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: Ejakaa lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ma dla mo nɛ o ba o je mi saminya, kaa bɔ nɛ duku kpakpa, loo kuɛ ní haa nɔ he peeɔ fɛu ɔ.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Ye bi, ke yayami peeli ngɛ mo mlɔɔe ɔ, koo nyɛɛ a se.

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: Waa mii mɛ hɛ ngmengmle kaa a yaa gbeje; waa ngɔ mɛ kaa yɔkɔ ngɔɔ gbogboe, be mi nɛ a ngɛ kpakpataa!

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: Ba piɛ wa he. Ke wa ná nɔ́ ko ɔ, wɔ tsuo wa maa dla lɛ fiee!”

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: Ye bi, o kɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli ko bɔ. Koo nyɛɛ a se.

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: A he sɔɔ kɛ yayami peemi; a he sɔɔ kɛ pueɔ muɔ si.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Ke lohwe pɛlitsɛ ngɛ mo hyɛe nɛ o tsɔ lɛ klama a, o tsu yaka ní.

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Nile ngɛ ngmlaa kpae boboobo ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ, kɛ jua mi.

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: E ngɛ kpae boboobo ngɛ ma agbo ɔmɛ a nya, kɛ hehi tsuo nɛ nihi buaa a he nya ngɛ. E ngɛ dee ke,

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “Kuasiahi! Mɛni be nyɛ maa biɛ kɛ yaa si? Fɛu yeli! Mɛni be nyɛ maa ye fɛu kɛ yaa si? Anɛ nyɛ be ní kasee?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu tue nɛ ma ka nyɛ hɛ mi. Ma wo nyɛ ga kpakpa, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu nile munyu.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Ga tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɔɛ, nɛ nyɛ kplɛɛ we kaa ma kua nɔ́ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: Ke haomi ba nyɛ nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa lɛ ngɛ fiae, nɛ amanehlu ba na nyɛ kaa lasiogblee, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui yee ɔ,

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ma tsɛ mi, se i be nɔ hee. Nyɛ ma hla ye se blɔ kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ nyɛ be mi nae.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ bui nile he akɔtaa; Yawɛ hu, nyɛ yi lɛ gbeye.

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ sume ga womi; nɛ ke i ka nyɛ hɛ mi hu, nyɛ kplɛɛ we.

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tsu ɔ, lɔ ɔ he hiɔwo nyɛ ma na; nyɛ ní yaya amɛ nɔuu maa hao nyɛ.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buɔ mi tue ɔ, e maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ e be gbeye yee kaa haomi ko maa ba e nɔ.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Ye bi, bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ o pɛtɛ ye mlaa amɛ a he saminya.

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: Bu nile munyu tue, nɛ o bɔ mɔde kaa o maa nu sisi lo.

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: Ee, moo fa kue nɛ a ha mo nile; kpa pɛɛ nɛ a ha mo nɔ́ sisi numi.

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: Hla e se blɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a hlaa sika hiɔ, loo juetli nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa.

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ke o pee ja loko o maa nu Yawɛ gbeye yemi sisi, nɛ o maa kase Mawu he nile.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lɛ haa nɔ nile; lɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ nɔ nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, Yawɛ piɛɔ a he, nɛ e baa a yi.

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: Yawɛ buu dami sane yeli a he, nɛ e baa e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a yi.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: O maa le ní, nɛ nile ɔ ma ha mo bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: O he nile, kɛ o nɔ́ sisi numi maa bu o he,

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ gba kɛ je blɔ nɛ da nɔ kɛ ya ngɛ diblii blɔhi a nɔ nyɛɛe,

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ nyaa yayami peemi he, nɛ a naa bua jɔmi ke a ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ pee,

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: kɛ nihi nɛ a blɔhi dɛ, nɛ a kɛ hɛ fɔ we a nɔ.

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: yo nɛ kua e yihe mi huno, nɛ si nɛ e wo e Mawu ɔ hu e yi nɔ.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ke o ya e we mi ɔ, gbenɔ blɔ nɔ o ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ nɛ. Ke o ya lejɛ ɔ lɛɛ o su gbeje ta.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo kase nimli kpakpahi a ní peepee, konɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Dali, kɛ nimli kpakpahi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli lɛɛ Mawu ma kpata a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a hiaa tso ngɛ zu mi kɛ fɔɔ si ɔ.

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: Ke o pee ja a, o wami se maa kɛ, nɛ o ma na he jɔmi, kɛ kplɔkɔtɔ.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Koo ngmɛɛ si himi kpakpa, kɛ anɔkuale yemi he. Fi kɛ wo o kuɛ, nɛ o ngma kɛ fɔ o tsui nɔ.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Ke o pee ja a, o hɛ mi maa ba nyami, nɛ Mawu, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo ma na o he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ kulaa. Koo ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ nɛ moo o susu kaa o le ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, mo kai Yawɛ, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ mo blɔ nɛ da.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Koo bu o he ní lelɔ; moo ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ o tu yayami nya fo.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ o ní babauu ɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami; ngɔɔ o niba ní tsuo mi kekleekle nɔ́ kɛ sã bɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: Ke o pee ja a, o blɛfo gba a ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ blɛfo; o wai hu maa ba babauu nɛ o nine be he kpee.

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ Yawɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi e kaa, kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ peeɔ e bi nɛ e suɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ le ní, nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ sisi ɔ, a gbaa lɛ saminya.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e he ngɛ se nami pe sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Nile he ngɛ se nami kulaa pe june; nɔ́ ko be nɛ o suɔ saminya nɛ a kɛ maa to nile he.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Nile haa nɔ wami se kɛɔ ngɛ je mi; e haa nɔ naa ní, nɛ e haa nɔ hɛ mi baa nyami.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Nile haa nɔ bua jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ le ní ɔ, a naa bua jɔmi; nile haa mɛ wami.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Nile Yawɛ kɛ bɔ je ɔ. Ga lɛ e kɛ ngɔ hiɔwe ngɔ to e blɔ he.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: E nile ɔ nɛ ha nɛ pa amɛ hia; lɛ nɛ ha nyu je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi pue zugba.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Ye bi, ngɔɔ nile nitsɛnitsɛ, kɛ juɛmi ngɔ to saminya; ko ha nɛ a je o dɛ.

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: A ma ha mo he wami, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Ke o hwɔ si ɔ, o be gbeye yee; o maa hwɔ mahe vii nyɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Haomihi nɛ baa yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nɔ tlukaa kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa a, lɔ ɔmɛ be o he gbeye woe.

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa bu o he. E be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ o ya du klama.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: O kɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko pɛ yaka gu be mi nɛ e pee we mo nɔ́ yaya ko.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: O hɛ ko kɔ̃ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nɔ; níhi nɛ a peeɔ hu, ko hla kaa o maa pee.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ sume nimli yayamihi; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ e kɛ bɔɔ.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbiɛmi ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a wehi a nɔ, se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ a hi he ɔ, gbaami sɔuu.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ he nɔ woli bɔɛ; se nihi nɛ baa a he si lɛɛ e naa mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Ní leli a hɛ mi maa ba nyami, se kuasiahi lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: Ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tsɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue saminya, konɛ nyɛɛ le ní.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ kpakpa lɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ; nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ he.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Tsaatsɛ kɛ maa a bi kake too ji mi. Benɛ jokuɛyo bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ ji mi ɔ,

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Moo le ní, nɛ o nu ní a sisi. Níhi nɛ i de mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je a nɔ.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Ko si nile se kɔkɔɔkɔ. Suɔ nile, konɛ e baa o yi, nɛ e bu o he.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Nile ji nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hla nile se blɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma ná a, kɛ hla ní a sisi numi.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Bu nile, nɛ e maa pee mo nɔmlɔ ngua; fua lɛ atuu, nɛ e maa wo o hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: E maa pee kunimi yemi jlasi nɛ a kɛ fi o yi.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Ye bi, bu mi tue. Munyuhi nɛ i tu mo ɔ, moo ngɔ, konɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: I tsɔɔ mo nile, kɛ blɔ nɛ da nɛ sa nɛ o nyɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Ke o ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, o be nɔ́ tɛe; ke o ngɛ fo tue ɔ, o be si nɔe.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Kai slɔmi gbi nɛ a ha mo ɔ daa; koo ngmɛɛ he. Lɔ ɔ ji o wami.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Koo ya he nɛ yayami peeli ngɛ. Ko ya nyɛɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a se.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Ee, moo yu o he; koo ya lejɛ ɔ! Gba blɔ nɛ o be kɛ ho.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Yayami peemi ji abolo nɛ a yeɔ, nɛ basabasa ji wai nɛ a nuɔ.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɛ dali nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa mɔtu pu la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe hluu kɛ yaa si piani.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Yayami peeli lɛɛ a blɔ nɔ woɔ diblii kpii kaa nyɔ mi. A tɛɔ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔɔ si, se a li nɔ́ nɛ ji.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: O hɛ ko je munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ. Ngɔɔ kɛ to o tsui mi tɔɔ.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ nuɔ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi ɔ, e naa wami nɛ e hii nɔmlɔ tso he wami saminya be tsuaa be.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Susu o yi mi saminya loko o pee nɔ́ ko, ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɔ o wami daa si ngɛ.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Hyɛ o hɛ mi tɛɛ. Ko plɛ o yi kɛ ya hiɛ, loo hiɛ.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Ke o maa pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, susu he saminya. Ja o pee ja loko o blɔhi maa da mo.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Koo pee yayami. Ko gba kɛ je blɔ nɛ da nɔ; yaa o hɛ mi tɛɛ.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Ye bi, i kɛ mo maa tu munyu nɛ mi kuɔ; i kɛ mo maa tu juɛmi munyu sɔuu. Bu tue,

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: konɛ o hyɛ o he nɔ saminya, nɛ o munyu tumi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa ní lelɔ ji mo.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Ke yo yaholɔ fiɔ o nya he ɔ, e lilɛ ngɔɔ pe hwo; e nya mi munyu hu ngɛ ngleinglei kaa nu.

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ mi kɛ baa a dooɔ pe agba, nɛ e puɛɔ nɔ́ pe klaate nya enyɔtsɛ.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɔ nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ kɛ nɔ yaa gbeje. E maa ngɔ mo kɛ ya tɔɔ.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi ɔ, e susuu we he; e ya nyɛɛɔ blɔ gɔdɔgɔdɔhi a nɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e li tete.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ mo kɛ je yo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ he; e tsu nya tete po koo ya.

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Ke pi ja a, o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ma ba pee ni kpahi a nɔ, nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ ma kpata o hɛ mi ngɛ nihe mi.

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: Ye mo nitsɛ o yo anɔkuale, nɛ o kɛ o suɔmi tsuo ha lɛ pɛ.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Anɛ e sa kaa o wo ngmɛdu ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo kɛ bɔle si lo?

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Ha o bimɛ nɛ pee mo nɔ kake too o níhi, se pi o kɛ nibwɔhi a bimɛ.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha o yo bua jɔmi. O nihe mi yo kpeekpee ɔ, na e he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: E he ngɛ fɛu saminyayoo kaa odabɔ. Ha e he nɛ pee mo akɔnɔ, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ nɛ fi mo kɛ mɛtɛ e he daa.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ e kplɛɛ we tsɔsemi he je ɔ, e ma gbo; e kuasia jemi ma kpata e hɛ mi.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Ye bi, anɛ o ya da nɔ ko se lo? Anɛ o wo si kaa o maa da nɔ ko nɛ o li lɛ e hiɔ nya ha lɛ lo?

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: Ye bi, ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ o nyɛmi ɔ nine su o nɔ. Bɔ nɛ o maa pee nɛ o maa ye o he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yaa o nyɛmi ɔ ngɔ esɔ. Yaa ba o he si ha lɛ, nɛ o kpa lɛ pɛɛ.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Koo hwɔ mahe; ko de ke o ngɛ o he jɔɔe hulɔ.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Je o he kɛ je sane nɛ ɔ mi esɔ kaa bɔ nɛ odabɔ, aloo lohwe pɛlitsɛ tuɔ detsɛ nya fo ɔ.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Mɛni be mo hejɔtsɛ o maa hwɔ si kɛ yaa si? Mɛni be po o maa te si?

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, ní yaya sɔuu lɛ e hii susue; e hii pɛ woe ngɛ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, haomi maa ba e nɔ tlukaa. Be mi nɛ e li e he be ɔ, e hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Ngmaa kɛ fɔ o tsui nɔ; nɛ o fi kɛ wo o kuɛ.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Ke o hia blɔ ɔ, munyuhi nɛ o fɔli tuɔ kɛ tsɔɔ mo ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo blɔ; nyɔ mi ke o hwɔɔ si ɔ, a maa bu o he, nɛ ke o te si ɔ, a maa wo mo ga.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Ko ya di e he fɛu ɔ se; ko ha nɛ e we ajuama hɛngmɛ ɔ nɛ nu mo.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Nyumu ma nyɛ ma ya su yo yaholɔ, nɛ e ma ha lɛ abolo bɔbɔyoo ko kɛkɛ. Se ke e ya ta yogbayo he ɔ, lɛɛ pe e hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Anɛ nɔ ko maa naa la ngu nɔ, nɛ e nane be sãe lo?

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee, nɛ e ya ju niye ní nɛ e ye ɔ, a gbi e he guɛ.

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Ke a nu lɛ ɔ, e maa ngɔ e weto ní tsuo tete kɛ to nane mi ha nɔtsɛ ɔ totoe kpaago kɛ bɔ he.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Se nyumu nɛ puɛɔ gba a, e be juɛmi; lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi lɛ e ngɛ kpatae.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: E be kpatami nɔ́ ko hee ngɛ o dɛ; ke o ke lɛ ní babauu po, e bua be jɔe.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Ye bi, kai munyuhi nɛ i tu mo ɔ; mlaahi nɛ i wo mo ɔ, o hɛ nɛ hi a nɔ.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Munyuhi nɛ i tu mo ɔ, moo fi kɛ wo o nine nguɛ he; nɛ o ngma kɛ fɔ o tsui nɔ.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Ligbi ko be nɛ i ngɛ saflɛ mi hyɛe ngɛ ye we ɔ mi ɔ,

english_verse: It was late in the evening, sometime after dark.
translation_verse: E nyɛɛ kɛ ya be ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ kɔ nya he ko, he nɛ yo ko hii ɔ.

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, je jɔ, nɛ du bu.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, yo ko kɛ lɛ ba kpe. Yo ɔ dla e he kaa yaholɔ nɛ ngɛ nyumu hlae.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Yo nɛ ɔ, jamɛatsɛ ji lɛ; e ngɛ gegeege, zo ko zo ko be e hɛ mi, nɛ e hí we mi hulɔ.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ nu niheyo ɔ, nɛ e fua lɛ atuu. E hyɛ niheyo ɔ hɛ mi gaa nɛ́ zo pee we lɛ, nɛ e de ke,

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “I wo si ke ma sã bɔ ko; nɛ mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i ye ye siwo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: I ngɔ Egipt kploba kpakpa kɛ ha ye sa a nɔ saminyayoo.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: I kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ɔmɛ wo sa a mi: mimɛ, aloe, kɛ sinamon.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, ye huno be; e hia blɔ kɛ ho tsitsaa ya.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: E hɛɛ sika fuu kɛ to dɛ, nɛ e maa ye otsi enyɔ loko e maa kpale kɛ ba.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Yo nɛ ɔ kɛ e nya mi munyu ngɔngɔɛ ɔ gbe niheyo ɔ yi mi hluu kɛ ya si e nine su niheyo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ niheyo ɔ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ho kaa na nɛ a yaa gbe, aloo odabɔ nɛ hlu kɛ yaa sɛ klama mi,

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: he nɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ma ya gbɔ e tsui mi ngɛ. Ee, niheyo nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ yo ɔ se kɛ ho kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ he sɔ kɛ yaa sɛ klama mi; e li tete kaa e hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ yo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba gbe nyɛ yi mi nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛ e se. Nyɛ ko tla kɛ ya be ngɛ e blɔ mi tete po.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nimli babauu ji nihi nɛ e ye mɛ awi; nimli kpekpemi nitsɛnitsɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ e kpata a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ke o su e we ɔ mi ɔ, lɛɛ blɔ kpiti nɛ a guu kɛ yaa gbeje ɔ, e nɔ lɛ o ngɛ kɛ yaa a nɛ.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu tue! Nile ngɛ ngmlaa kpae. Nyɛɛ bu tue! Juɛmi gbi ngɛ pɛe.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Nile daa si ngɛ blɔ gbla amɛ a nya, ngɛ blɔ he, kɛ yokuhi a yi mi.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: E ngɛ ngmlaa kpae gegeege ngɛ ma a nya; e ngɛ kpae ngɛ ma a agbo ɔmɛ a nya ke,

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “Nyɛ nimli adesahi lee! I ngɛ nyɛ tsɛe oo! Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ be juɛmi ko juɛmi ko, nyɛɛ le ní; nyɛ kuasiahi, nyɛ na juɛmi.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu tue nɛ ma tu nyɛ munyuhi nɛ a he hia.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Ye nya mi munyuhi tsuo da; ekoeko be nɛ kpɛ̃; ekoeko be nɛ ji lakpa.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Ye nya mi munyu ɔmɛ fɔɔ si paa kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi. Munyu ɔmɛ a mi tsɔ heii kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ le ní.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hla ye tsɔsemi ɔ se blɔ pe sika hiɔ; nyɛ hla nile pe sika tsu kpakpa.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: “Nile hi pe june; níhi nɛ adesa suɔ pe kulaa a, ekoeko be nɛ a kɛ maa to nile he.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Imi nile, i ngɛ hɛ mi si kami. I ngɛ juɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi hulɔ.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ke e yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e sa kaa e kua yayami. Hewo, he tsɔɔmi, je mi bami yaya, kɛ lakpa a, i sume.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: I le ní saminya, nɛ i woɔ nɔ ga; i nuɔ nɔ́ sisi, nɛ i ngɛ he wami hulɔ.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: I piɛɔ matsɛmɛ a he kɛ hyɛɛ ma nɔ; i piɛɔ nɔ yeli a he kɛ woɔ mlaa kpakpahi.

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Ganɔhi kɛ odehehi tsuo, imi lɛ i piɛɔ a he kɛ tsuɔ ní.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, imi hu i suɔ mɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa ye se blɔ ɔ, e maa na mi.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ye dɛ nɛ ma dla; sika, hɛ mi nyami, kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ nɔ yami.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ o ma na kɛ je ye dɛ mi ɔ, e hi pe sika tsu ngmingmiingmi; e hi pe sika hiɔ ngmingmiingmi hulɔ.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Dami blɔ nɔ lɛ i nyɛɛɔ; dami sane lɛ i yeɔ.

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, i peeɔ mɛ niatsɛmɛ; i haa a wehi a mi hyiɔ tɔ kɛ june.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: “Imi nile lɛ Yawɛ bɔ kekleekle; e bɔ mi loko e je e ní tsumi ɔmɛ a sisi blema lokoo.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Blema lokoo, benɛ a na we nɛ a bɔ je ɔ, imi lɛ a bɔ kekleekle.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Benɛ wo be, nɛ nyu vuhi hu be ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, imi lɛɛ a fɔ mi momo.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu na we nɛ e pee je ɔ, kɛ nga, kɛ tabo zu ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, imi lɛɛ a fɔ mi momo.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ngɔ hiɔwe kɛ to e blɔ he, nɛ e pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpe he ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ngɔ bɔku ɔmɛ ngɔ to hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ nyu vu ɔmɛ hu to a blɔ hehi ngɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: Benɛ e fa wo ɔ ke wo nyu ɔ ko be e huzu ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ e to je ɔ sisi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: I ngɛ e kasa nya kaa ga ní tsulɔ kpanaa, nɛ e bua jɔɔ ye he daa nɛ; i fiɛɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi be tsuaa be.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: I náá je ɔ nɛ e bɔ ɔ, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo a he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihewi, nyɛɛ bu mi tue! Nyɛɛ pee bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue nɛ nyɛɛ le ní. Nyɛ ko kua tsɔsemi.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ buɔ mi tue, nɛ e hii si ngɛ ye sinya nya daa ligbi, nɛ e hii mlɛe ngɛ ye agbo nya a, e naa bua jɔmi.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ hlaa mi ɔ, e yi ma na wami; nɛ Yawɛ ma na e he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ hla we mi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he awi lɛ e ngɛ yee. Nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛɔ mi ɔ, a suɔ gbenɔ.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Nile ma tsu, nɛ e ma titima kpaago kɛ ha tsu ɔ.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: E gbe lohwe; e futu wai, nɛ e ngmɛ okplɔɔ.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: E tsɔ e mawayi ɔmɛ ke a ya da ma a mi he nɛ ya hiɔwe pe kulaa a, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke,

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Ba nɛ o ba ye ye ní ɔ eko, nɛ o nu wai nɛ i futu ɔ hu eko!

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Kpa bɔmi kɛ nihi nɛ be juɛmi, nɛ o yi nɛ na wami. Hla nile se blɔ!”

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Ko ka he fɛu yelɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e ba nyɛ mo; ka ní lelɔ mohu hɛ mi nɛ e maa suɔ mo.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Tsɔɔ ní lelɔ ní, nɛ e nile ɔ mi ma blɛke kɛ ya nɔ; tsɔɔ dalɔ ní, nɛ e maa kase nɔ́ ko kɛ je mi kɛ piɛ nɔ́ nɛ e le momo ɔ he.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Loko o ma na nile ɔ, ja o ye Yawɛ gbeye; ke o na le Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ pɛ o na juɛmi.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nile ma ha nɛ a fɔ o ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ o wami se maa kɛ.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Ke o le ní ɔ, o le ha o he. Nɛ ke o sake nile ngɔ fɔ he ɔ, mo nitsɛ lɛ o maa na nɔ́.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Daa nɛ ɔ, e hii si ngɛ e sinya nya, loo ma a mi he nɛ ya hiɔwe pe lɛ tsuo.

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ be juɛmi ɔ, e ba hiɛ ɔ!” Nyumu kuasia hu, nɔ́ nɛ e deɔ lɛ ji,

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Nyu jujui ngɔɔ. Niye ní nɛ a ye ngɛ laami mi ɔ, e ngɔɔ.”

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Salomo abɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Bi ní lelɔ haa e tsɛ bua jɔmi; bi kuasia yeɔ e nyɛ tsui.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Ke o gu blɔ yaya nɔ kɛ na ní ɔ, e he be se nami bae ha mo. Se ke o ye anɔkuale ɔ, o yi ma na wami.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Yawɛ be hae nɛ hwɔ nɛ ye nimli kpakpahi; nimli yayamihi lɛɛ e maa tsi mɛ blɔ, konɛ a nine ko su nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ hejɔ ɔ, e yeɔ ohia; se nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní lɛɛ e naa ní.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a maa gbaa lɛ babauu. Se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ e nya mi munyu puɛɔ nɔ́.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: E ji gbaami kaa a ma kai nimli kpakpahi daa; yayami peeli lɛɛ e kɛ we nɛ hɛ jeɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ yeɔ mlaa nɔ; se kuasia nɛ tuɔ munyu puu ɔ, lɛɛ e hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e he mi jɔɔ lɛ. Nɔ nɛ yi anɔkuale lɛɛ nine maa gbe lɛ.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kpakpa nya mi munyu ngɛ kaa nyu vu nɛ haa nɔ wami; nɔmlɔ yayami lɛɛ e nya mi munyu puɛɔ nɔ́.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Ninyɛ woɔ pɛ; se suɔmi haa tɔmihi tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Ní leli tuɔ juɛmi munyu; kuasiahi lɛɛ e sa nɛ a gbla a tue.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Ní leli tu we munyu fuu. Kuasiahi lɛɛ a tuɔ munyu puu, nɛ lɔ ɔ kɛ mɛ woɔ haomi mi.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Niatsɛmɛ a ní nɛ a na a buɔ a he; se ohiatsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ohia a kpataa a hɛ mi.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a, e yi ma na wami. Se nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, yayami ɔ kɛ̃ a kɛ maa wo lɛ hiɔ.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ. Nɔ nɛ tuɔ nihi a he munyu kɛ puɛɔ mɛ ɔ, kuasia ji lɛ.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu babauu ɔ, e kɛ we nɛ e peeɔ yayami. Ní lelɔ lɛɛ e hyɛɛ e lilɛ nɔ saminya.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kpakpa nya mi munyu he jua wa kaa sika hiɔ ngmingmiingmi; se yiwutsotsɛ juɛmi lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Nimli kpakpahi a nya mi munyu he baa se nami ha nihi babauu. Kuasiahi lɛɛ a hɛ mi kpataa, ejakaa a be juɛmi.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Mawu gbaami lɛ peeɔ nɔ niatsɛ; dengme gbomi kɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko piɛ we he ha nɔ.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Kuasia ngɛ nɛ ɔ, yayami peemi peeɔ lɛ bua jɔmi; juɛmitsɛ lɛɛ nile ji nɔ́ nɛ haa lɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ yayami peelɔ ngɛ gbeye yee ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ, lɔ ɔ a ma ha lɛ.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Ke kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa te ɔ, e fiaa yayami peeli kɛ nɔɔ si nɛ a gboɔ. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sɛ a he.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbeye yemi haa nɔ wami se kɛɔ; se yayami peeli lɛɛ a wami se kɛ we kulaa.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a, a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ya peeɔ bua jɔmi. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi maa pee yaka.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Yawɛ buu a he; yayami peeli lɛɛ e kpataa a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a maa ye a he daa, se yayami peeli lɛɛ a yi be wami nae ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a le nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ a de. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ munyu nɛ puɛɔ nɔ́ lɛ a tuɔ.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Susumi ní yayahi nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ sume. Nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ji nɔ́ susumi ní kpakpahi.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Hɛ mi si puemi nyɛɛɔ he nɔ womi se. Nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, e le nɔ́.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ hɛɛɔ nimli kpakpahi, nɛ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ ngɛ je mi ji anɔkuale nɛ a yeɔ ɔ. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ yi anɔkuale lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ní peemi ní yayamihi lɛ kpataa a hɛ mi.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Ní babauu nɛ nɔ ko na a be nyɛe ma he e yi wami ngɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ nɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ma nyɛ he e yi wami ji anɔkuale nɛ e yeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ɔ, anɔkuale nɛ e yeɔ he je ɔ, e je mi si himi daa lɛ. Se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ní yayamihi lɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, a jeɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ haomi mi, nɛ haomi ɔ baa nɔmlɔ yayami mohu nɔ.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ li Mawu ɔ, e kɛ e nya mi munyu puɛɔ e nyɛmi. Se nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e juɛmi ma he e yi wami.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Nimli kpakpahi a ní peemi ní kpakpahi haa ma yaa nɔ. Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nya mi munyu haa ma hɛ mi kpataa.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e nyɛmi he guɛ ɔ, e be juɛmi; ní lelɔ ɔ, pe e maa e nya.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ hii sieku yee kɛ hii bee ɔ, e jeɔ laami sanehi kpo. Se nɔ nɛ heɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ laa nɔ́ nɔ.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ na we ga woli kpakpa a, e ywiaa. Se ma, he nɛ ga woli kpakpa hiɛ ngɛ ɔ, tue mi jɔmi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ daa nubwɔ se ɔ, e piaa e he. Se nɔ nɛ pee we ja lɛɛ e yeɔ e he.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Yo nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ, a buu lɛ, se yo nɛ be subai ɔ lɛɛ hɛ mi si puemi e kɛ baa.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kpamisa nɛ e kpa we ɔ, e yi ma na wami. Se nɔ nɛ dii yayami se ɔ, e ma gbo.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale sane ji kaa yayami peelɔ ɔ, ja a gbla e tue kokooko. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa ye a he.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Yo nɛ e he ngɛ fɛu, se e juɛmi mi kuɔ we ɔ, e ngɛ kaa sika tsu ga ngɛ kpotoo gugwɔ mi.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ haa nɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e bɔɔ; nɔ nɛ haa nɛ nihi tɔɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ hu e tɔɔ.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tsiɔ blɛfo nya a, ma a maa gbiɛ lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ juaa blɛfo lɛɛ a maa gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ hlaa nɔ́ kpakpa se blɔ ɔ, e hɛ mi baa nyami. Nɔ nɛ dii yayami se ɔ, e kɛ yayami kpeɔ.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ ní nami nɔ ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bɔ kaa ba mumu.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ haomi kɛ baa e weku li a nɔ ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, e jeɔ mi dɛ gu. Kuasia ma sɔmɔ ní lelɔ daa.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ da peemi haa nɔ wami; basabasa lɛɛ gbenɔ e kɛ baa.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e naa e hiɔwo ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ tete po. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli hu ja a gbla a tue kɛ̃.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Yawɛ náá nɔmlɔ kpakpa he bua jɔmi. Se nɔ nɛ toɔ ga yaya lɛɛ e buɔ lɛ fɔ.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Yayami peemi ha we nɛ nɔ yaa nɔ. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ e daa si kpɛii.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Yo kpakpa ngɛ kaa jlasi ngɛ e huno yi mi. Yo nɛ pueɔ e huno hɛ mi si lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa hiɔ ngɛ e huno wuhi a mi.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, ní kpakpahi a he a susuɔ. Se ga nɛ yayami peeli toɔ ɔ, sisimi sɔuu.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Yayami peeli a nya mi munyu kpataa nɔ hɛ mi. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ a nya mi munyu heɔ nɔ yi wami.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: A ma kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi, nɛ a be mɛ nae hu. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ a nina maa hi si daa.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Ke o ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, a ma je o yi. Se ke o biɛ lɛɛ a maa gbe o he guɛ.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko be e dɛ, se e tsuɔ ní nɛ e yeɔ ɔ, e hi kulaa pe nɔ nɛ peeɔ e he agbo, nɛ e nya mi ngma po bɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kpakpa hyɛɛ e lohwehi a nɔ saminya. Se nimli yayamihi lɛɛ mɔbɔ nɛ a naa a lohwehi po, yi mi wami sɔuu.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ ɔ ma na niye ní babauu. Se nɔ nɛ ya nyɛɛɔ yakayaka níhi a se lɛɛ kuasia ji lɛ.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Yayami peeli a suɔmi nya ní ji kaa a hi yayami pee kpamisa. Nimli kpakpahi lɛɛ a daa si kpɛii.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ yayami nya mi munyuhi peeɔ klama ha lɛ nɛ e duɔ. Se nɔmlɔ kpakpa lɛɛ e he jee sane mi.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Munyu kpakpahi nɛ jeɔ nɔ ko nya mi, kɛ níhi nɛ e tsuɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he hiɔwo e naa.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Kuasia susuɔ kaa be tsuaa be ɔ, e nɔ́ da. Ní lelɔ lɛɛ e buɔ ga womi tue.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ke anɔkualetsɛ ye odase ɔ, a yeɔ dami sane. Lakpa odase yelɔ lɛɛ nɔ e sisiɔ.
