english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Lakpa hii si be bɔɔ kɛkɛ, se anɔkuale lɛɛ e ngɛ daa.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hiee lakpatsɛmɛ. Se nihi nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ e naa a he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ maa e nya kɛ toɔ e nile nɔ. Kuasia lɛɛ e tuɔ munyu puu, nɛ lɔ ɔ nihi kɛ naa kaa kuasia ji lɛ.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ ɔ, e ma na nɔkɔtɔma blɔ nya; nɔ nɛ peeɔ hejɔ lɛɛ e ma sɔmɔ.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Tsui yemi ha we nɔ bua jɔmi, se munyu kpakpa haa nɔ bua jɔɔ e he.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kpakpa tsɔɔ e nyɛmi blɔ kpakpa. Se nɔmlɔ yayami ní peemi níhi haa mɛ tsuo a laa blɔ.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ da peemi ji blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi. Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ kikɛmɛ a blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e be gboe.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Bi ní lelɔ buɔ e tsɛ tsɔsemi tue. Bi nɔ builɔ lɛɛ e kplɛɛ we nɛ a kaa e hɛ mi.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kpakpa naa munyu nɛ jeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nya mi ɔ he se. Nɔmlɔ yayami lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ kɛkɛ ji yi mi wami.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ e lilɛ nɔ saminya a, e yi naa wami. Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu puu ɔ, e hɛ mi kpataa.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Hejɔtsɛ ma hla kaa e na nɔ́ ko, se e nine be nɔ sue. Se nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní lɛɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ, e naa.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e sume lakpa. Se nɔmlɔ yayami lɛɛ hɛ mi si puemi níhi e peeɔ kɛ bɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ahlua.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a yeɔ dami sane ha lɛ. Se yayami peemi kpataa yiwutsotsɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ peeɔ a he niatsɛmɛ, pohu nɔ́ ko be a dɛ. Ni komɛ hu peeɔ a he ohiatsɛmɛ, se a ngɛ ní babauu.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Niatsɛ kɛ sika faa e he. Ohiatsɛ ɔ, a wui e he gbeye.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a ngɛ kaa kane nɛ ngɛ kpɛe. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a ngɛ kaa kane nɛ miɔ nɛ e ma gbo.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Nɔ buimi ɔ, haomi kɛkɛ e kɛ baa. Ní leli ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ buɔ ga womi tue.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ a naa esɔesɔ ɔ, e taa mla. Nɔ nɛ buaa nɔ́ nya bɔɔbɔɔbɔɔ ɔ, e naa babauu.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ ko blɔ hyɛe, nɛ nɔ́ ɔ se kɛ ɔ, o yeɔ o tsui. Se ke nɔ́ ɔ ba mi ɔ, o naa bua jɔmi babauu.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ bui ga womi tue ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi lɛ ma kpata. Nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa gbeye ɔ, e maa ye e he.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ woɔ nɔ hɛ mi nyami. Nihi nɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ hɛ mi kpatami blɔ nɔ a ngɛ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ peeɔ e ní kɛ juɛmi, se kuasia lɛɛ e jeɔ e biɛmi kpo ngɛ ma hɛ mi.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ nɛ yi anɔkuale kɛ nɔ woɔ haomi mi. Se tsɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ lɛɛ tue mi jɔmi e kɛ baa.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ sume tsɔsemi ɔ, e yeɔ ohia, nɛ e hɛ mi pueɔ si. Se nɔ nɛ kplɛɛɔ nɛ a kaa e hɛ mi ɔ, a buɔ lɛ.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ ko hlae, nɛ o nine su nɔ ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ o bua jɔɔ ha. Kuasia lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e hiɔ ji kaa e kpa yayami peemi.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kɛ ní leli nyɛɛɔ ɔ, e leɔ ní. Se nɔ nɛ kɛ kuasiahi bɔɔ ɔ, haomi lɛ baa e nɔ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Haomi nyɛɛɔ yayami peeli a se. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ a ma na hiɔwo kpakpa.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kpakpa siɔ gbosi ní kɛ haa e bibimɛ. Se yayami peeli a ní ɔ, dali lɛ a bua nya ha.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Ohiatsɛmɛ a zugba nɛ fɔɔ si gu ɔ ma nyɛ ba ní babauu. Se yayami peeli tsiɔ nya.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ sume kaa e maa gbla e bi tue ɔ, e sume e bi ɔ. Nɔ nɛ suɔ e bi ɔ, e tsɔseɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a yeɔ ní nɛ a tɔɔ. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ mi mi hwɔ yeɔ mɛ.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Yo ní lelɔ haa nɛ we bɔɔ, se yo kuasia ní peemi níhi ywiaa we.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Ke o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa o yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye. Se ke o yi anɔkuale ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa o ngɛ e he guɛ gbee.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Kuasia nya mi munyu fiaa lɛ kpa. Ní lelɔ lɛɛ e nya mi munyu jeɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ haomi mi.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: He nɛ na be nɛ a kɛ maa gbla na kpakplaa kɛ hu ɔ, blɛfo gba mi fɔɔ si gu. Ke na ngɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ gba a mi hyiɔ tɔ.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale odase yelɔ ngɔɛ nya. Lakpa odase yelɔ lɛɛ lakpa pɛ e yeɔ.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Nɔ buili hlaa kaa a maa le ní, se nile bɔɔ mɛ. Nihi nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi ɔ, mɛɛ a leɔ ní mla.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: O kɛ kuasia ko bɔ; o be nile munyu ko nue kɛ je e nya mi.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ juɛmi tsɔɔ lɛ blɔ nɛ hi. Kuasiahi lɛɛ a juɛmi sisiɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Yayami gba we kuasia nya kulaa. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ a suɔ kaa a kɛ a he yayami nɛ pa mɛ.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Mo nitsɛ nɛ o le o hɛdɔ be, kɛ be nɛ o naa bua jɔmi; nɔ kpa ko li.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: A maa ku yayami peeli a we kɛ pue si. Se ni kpakpahi lɛɛ a we maa bɔ.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ susuɔ kaa e da a, nyagbe ɔ, e kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Muɔmi haa kɔmɔ yemi nɔ; ke bua jɔmi se po ɔ, aywilɛho lɛɛ e tɛ gblegbleegble.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Kuasia heɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ yeɔ. Ní lelɔ lɛɛ e le e nane nya hyɛmi.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ yeɔ sane gbeye; e hyɛɛ e he nɔ saminya nɛ e ko pee yayami. Kuasia lɛɛ e heɔ e he yeɔ, nɛ e peeɔ e níhi basabasa.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a mi mi kɛ́ fumi peeɔ a níhi basabasa kaa kuasiahi. Se ní leli lɛɛ a toɔ a tsui si.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Ohiatsɛ ɔ, e nyɛmi tete po sume lɛ. Se niatsɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ huɛmɛ babauu.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e nyɛmi he guɛ ɔ, yayami e ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ. Se nɔ nɛ naa ohiatsɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ toɔ ga yayami ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ susuɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, a maa na mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ a blɔ maa da mɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ ɔ, e se nami ji ní nami; kuasia lɛɛ e hiɔwo ji biɛmi.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale odase yelɔ heɔ nɔ yi wami; lakpa odase yelɔ lɛɛ nɔ se blɔ e tsɔɔ.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e kɛ e bimɛ tsuo hiɔ si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbeye yemi ngɛ kaa nyu vu nɛ haa nɔ wami; e jeɔ nɔ kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ mi.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Matsɛ nɛ e we bihi a he hiɛ babauu ɔ, e naa biɛ. Se ganɔ nɛ be nihi ngɛ e sisi ɔ lɛɛ tsa pi nɔ ko kulaa ji lɛ.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ mi mi fu we mla a, ní lelɔ agbo ji lɛ. Nɔ nɛ be tsui ɔ, e jeɔ kuasia.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Tue mi jɔmi haa nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ naa he wami, se kuasia jemi woɔ nɔ hiɔ.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ waa ohiatsɛ yi mi ɔ, Mawu ɔ nɛ bɔ ohiatsɛ ɔ e ngɛ jɛe ɔ nɛ. Se nɔ nɛ naa ni nɛmɛ nɛ e fi mɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami woe.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ní yayamihi nɛ ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ woɔ haomi mi. Se nɔmlɔ kpakpa lɛɛ gbenɔ mi tete po e ngɛ hɛ nɔ kami.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ. Kuasia lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ nile tete e li.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Dami sane yemi haa nɛ ma yaa nɔ; yayami peemi ɔ, ma hɛ mi si e pueɔ.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ nɛ le ní ɔ, matsɛ suɔ lɛ. Se tsɔlɔ nɛ tsuɔ zo ní ɔ, lɛɛ matsɛ gblaa e tue.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Ke o kɛ gbi blɛuu ha munyu heto ɔ, e tsiɔ abofu nya. Se munyu gegeege haa nɔ mi mi woɔ la.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Ní leli a ní sɛɛmi ngɔɔ ngɛ tue mi; kuasiahi lɛɛ munyu nɛ jeɔ a nya mi ɔ, juɛmi be mi.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he; e naa kpakpa peeli, kɛ yayami peeli tsuo.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Munyu blɛuu kɛ he jɔmi baa; se ke sisimi ba je mi pɛ e gbeɔ nɔ mumi.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Kuasia kplɛɛ we nɛ e tsɛ tsɔseɔ lɛ; se bi nɛ baa e he si nɛ a tsɔseɔ lɛ ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kpakpa naa e ní he se babauu. Yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ haomi ji nɔ́ nɛ e ní nɛ e na a kɛ baa e nɔ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Ní leli a nya lɛ gbɛɔ nile kɛ fĩaa; pi kuasiahi a juɛmi.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ bɔ sami ɔ, Yawɛ sume kulaa; se ke nɔmlɔ kpakpa fa kue ɔ, e naa he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ je mi bami sɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kulaa; se nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, Yawɛ suɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ da a, a maa gbla e tue wawɛɛ; nɔ nɛ sume nɛ a ka e hɛ mi ɔ, e ma gbo.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Gbeje kɛ e muɔ voo ɔ po fɔɔ si paa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tsui mi lɛɛ e be nae lo?

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: He fɛu yelɔ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, e sume kaa nɔ ko kaa e hɛ mi; nɛ e ya bi we ga womi ngɛ ní leli a ngɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Happiness makes you smile; sorrow can crush you.
translation_verse: Bua jɔmi haa nɔ tsɔɔ e hɛ mi; tsui yemi haa nɔ peeɔ vii.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Ní leli hlaa kaa a maa hi ní kasee kɛ ya nɔ. Kuasiahi lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ ji a hi biɛmi munyu tue kpamisa.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Ohiatsɛ wami be tsuo ɔ, haomi sɔuu; se nɔ nɛ e tsui nɔɔ e mi ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo nɛ Yawɛ gbeye yemi piɛ he ɔ, e hi hluu pe weto ní babauu kɛ e mi haomi gidiglɛmɛɛ.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: E hi mohu kaa o maa ye ba flɔɔ ngɛ he nɛ suɔmi ngɛ, pe nɛ o maa ye na nɛ tu zɔ ngɛ he nɛ ninyɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Hejɔtsɛ kɛ haomi kpee ngɛ he tsuaa he; se nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e na we nyagba.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Bi ní lelɔ haa e tsɛ naa bua jɔmi. Kuasia lɛɛ e gbeɔ e nyɛ he guɛ.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ be juɛmi nyaa kuasia jemi he; se nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, e baa e je mi saminya.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: He nɛ ga womi be ɔ, yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka; se he nɛ ga woli hiɛ ngɛ ɔ, níhi yaa nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɛ ní lelɔ nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ yaa wami mi. Blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbeje ɔ, e nyɛɛ we nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kuɔɔ he woli a wehi, se e haa yalɔyo e buna maa si kpɛii.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Ke dalɔ ma ha munyu heto ɔ, e susuɔ he saminya. Yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ munyu yaya lɛ jeɔ e nya mi.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ yayami peeli a kpɛti kɛ; se e buɔ dali a kue fami tue.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Hɛ mi muɔ jɛɛ haa nɔ bua jɔɔ; jã kɛ̃ manye munyu haa nɔ nɔ gbagba tee.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ buɔ ga womi tue ɔ, e kɛ ní leli maa hi si.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kplɛɛ we nɛ a tsɔseɔ lɛ ɔ, e ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he awi yee. Se nɔ nɛ buɔ tue ɔ, e naa nile.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbeye yemi ji tsɔsemi nɛ haa nɔ leɔ ní nitsɛnitsɛ. Nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ pee ɔ da ha lɛ; se Yawɛ lɛɛ nɔmlɔ tsui mi lɛ e hyɛɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ, nɔ́ ko he kɛ̃ lɛ e pee ngɛ; yayami peeli tete po, a ngɛ kɛ ha hɛ mi kpatami.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, e he peeɔ Yawɛ tai. Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ja a gbla e tue; e be e he yee.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Naa mɔbɔ nɛ o ye anɔkuale, kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ o he yayami maa pa mo. Ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ yayami ko be o he sae.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: E hi kaa o maa ye anɔkuale nɛ o nine nɛ su nɔ́ bɔbɔyoo nɔ, pe kaa o maa ye amimi kɛ na ní babauu.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa toɔ ga ngɛ e yi mi, se Mawu ji nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa e pee.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Yawɛ suɔ kaa jua yeli nɛ a ngɔ sɛni, kɛ sɛni tɛ kpakpahi kɛ jua ní, konɛ a ko sisi nɔ.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ bɔɔ mɔde kaa e ma ha nɛ matsɛ nɛ na bua jɔmi daa; ke matsɛ mi mi fu ɔ, nɔ ko ma gbo.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ matsɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ, e naa mɛ mɔbɔ. A wami si himi peeɔ kpakpa, kaa bɔ nɛ bɔku haa nɛ gbo nyu nɛɔ pueɔ si ɔ.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Ke o le ní ɔ, e hi hluu pe sika tsu; juɛmi hi pe sika hiɔ.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: E hi kaa o maa pee o he humi nɛ a na mo ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a kpɛti, pe nɔ́ nɛ a maa na mo nɛ o kɛ he nɔ woli ngɛ ní nɛ a ha dlae.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Bu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ mo tsɔɔe ɔ tue, nɛ e maa hi ha mo; ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ. E kɛ munyu blɛuu gblaa nihi a juɛmi se kɛ baa anɔkuale ɔ he.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Juɛmi ngɛ kaa vu nɛ haa nɔ wami kɛ ha ní leli, se kuasia lɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛmi ji nɔ́ nɛ gblaa e tue.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Munyu kpakpa ngɔɔ kaa hwo; e haa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he wami.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɛ moo o susu kaa e da a, nyagbe ɔ, e kɛ mo yaa gbenɔ mi.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Nimli yayamihi woɔ pɛ; siekutsɛmɛ puɛɔ huɛmɛ kpakpahi a kpɛti.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛ sisiɔ e nyɛmi, nɛ e ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ ya woɔ haomi mi.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Yi mi mua ngɛ kaa jlasi nɛ woɔ nɔ hɛ mi nyami; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ a naa lɔ ɔ.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Niye ní nya mi bɔ kake nɛ o maa ye ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ɔ, e hi kulaa pe okplɔɔ nguaa nɛ a tsɛ ngɛ we nɛ pɛ sɔuu lɛ ngɛ mi.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Sɔmɔlɔ nɛ le ní maa ye bi nɛ peeɔ zo ní nɔ; nɛ e kɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ maa dla gbosi ní fiee.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: La a kɛ tsuɔ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ he, se Yawɛ lɛ kaa adesa tsui hyɛɔ.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ohiatsɛ he fɛu ɔ, ohiatsɛ ɔ bɔlɔ e ngɛ jɛe ɔ nɛ. Nɔ nɛ bua jɔɔ nɔ ko amanehlu he ɔ, e be e he yee.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Bibimɛ ji nimowi a hɛ mi nyami, kaa bɔ nɛ bimɛ ngɛ ha fɔli ɔ.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Munyu kpakpa sɛ́ kuasia, kaa bɔ nɛ lakpa sɛ́ ganɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kɛ tɔmi nɛ a tɔ̃ e nɔ paa a, a suɔ e sane; se nɔ nɛ hɛɛɔ yayami nɛ a pee lɛ mi kpamisa a, e kɛ e huɛmɛ a kpɛti puɛɔ.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ yayami tsuɔ kɛkɛ ji kaa e tsɔ atuã. E kɛ tsɔlɔ yiwutsotsɛ lɛ ma ya kpe.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Afani nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ osisiblisi nɛ a nuu e bimɛ maa kpe, pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ kuasia nɛ ngɛ biɛe maa kpe.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ yayami kɛ toɔ kpakpa nane mi ɔ, yayami be e we mi tae gblegbleegble.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Pɛ sisi jemi ngɛ kaa nyu nɛ a bli nya nɛ́ e be; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ nya sami ɔ mi wɛ lolo ɔ, moo ngmɛɛ he.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ woɔ yayami peelɔ nguɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ buɔ dalɔ fɔ ɔ, Yawɛ hiɔ mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Mɛni se kuasia ma na ke e maa hɛɛ sika kɛ ya he nile, be mi nɛ e be juɛmi?

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Huɛmɛ suɔ a he be tsuaa be, se nyɛmimɛ lɛɛ haomi be mi tete po a si we a sibi.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ yayami lɛ e susuɔ ɔ, e yɛ nɔ; nɔ nɛ munyu yaya jeɔ e nya mi ɔ, haomi lɛ baa e nɔ.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Bi nɛ biɛ haa e tsɛ yeɔ e tsui; tsɛ nɛ fɔ bi kuasia a, e na we bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní ngɛ laami mi nɛ́ e kɛ plɛ dami sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ ngɔɔ níhi nɛ a he ngɛ se nami kɛ fɔɔ e hɛ mi; kuasia lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ je ɔ tsuo nɔ kɔe.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Bi kuasia haa e tsɛ yeɔ tsui, nɛ e haa e nyɛ yeɔ kɔmɔ.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ sane da a, e sɛ kaa a bɔɔ lɛ hiɔ. Odehehi hu e sɛ kaa a fiaa mɛ ní yaka.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tu we munyu puu ɔ, juɛmitsɛ ji lɛ. Nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ka si ɔ, e le ní.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ suɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ɔ, a kɛ nɔ kpa pee we nɔ́ ko. Nɔ́ ko nɛ nihi tsuo le kaa e hi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a deɔ ke e hí.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Nile ma nyɛ je nɔmlɔ nya mi munyu mi; e mi kuɔ kaa wo, nɛ e he tsɔ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Kuasia nya mi munyu woɔ pɛ, kunɔ lɛ nyɛɛɔ se.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Sieku yelɔ munyu ngɛ kaa niye ní nɛ ngɔɔ. Nimli adesahi suɔ kaa a maa mi kɛ ya a muklii mi tɔɔ.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Hejɔtsɛ kɛ nɔ́ puɛlɔ ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ kaa mɔ nguaa, he nɛ nimli kpakpahi tuu fo kɛ ya saa we ngɛ nɛ a yi naa wami.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Nike ní bliɔ blɔ ha nɔ kɛ ya suu nimli nguahi a hɛ mi tɔɔ.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke o ngɔ yo kɛkɛ o ná nɔ́ kpakpa, nɛ Yawɛ maa gbaa mo.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ke ohiatsɛ maa tu munyu ɔ, e deɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ.” Se ke niatsɛ ma ha munyu heto ɔ, e kuɛɔ kɛ woɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Huɛ bɔmi komɛ a se kɛ we kulaa. Se huɛmɛ komɛ hu mɛtɛɛ a sibi a he kpɛii pe nyɛmimɛ tete po.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Ohiatsɛ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e hi pe kuasia nɛ yeɔ lakpa.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ li nɔ́ ɔ, e ní ngɛ mɔbɔ. Nɔ nɛ nane nya sɔɔ ɔ, e laa blɔ.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ya biɛ nɛ haomi ba e nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ e ngɔ abofu ɔ ya kple Yawɛ mohu nɔ.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Ohiatsɛ lɛɛ e nyɛmimɛ tete po sume lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be nyakpɛ kaa e huɛmɛ tsɛ̃ɔ a he kɛ jeɔ e he. Ke e hla a se blɔ kaa mɛni po, e nine sui a nɔ.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ hlaa nile se blɔ ɔ, e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he; nɔ nɛ pɛtɛɔ nile he ɔ, e yaa nɔ.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Si himi ngɔngɔɛ sɛ́ kuasia, hluu nɛ a ba de ke nyɔguɛ nɛ ye ganɔhi a nɔ.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Ke matsɛ mi mi wo la a, e ngɛ kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae; se ke e ná nɔ he bua jɔmi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa bɔ́ ngɛ nga nɔ.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Bi kuasia kɛ e tsɛ woɔ haomi mi. Yo nɛ suɔ pɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tsu nya nyu nɛ ngɛ dɛe kɛ ngɛ si puee kɔ, kɔ, kɔ nɛ nyagbe be he.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: We kɛ sika a, tsɛmɛ a dɛ mi nɛ a naa kɛ jeɔ kaa gbosi ní, se yo nɛ le ní ɔ, Yawɛ lɛ haa nɔ.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Pee hejɔ faa, nɛ o wɔ mahe vii bɔ nɛ o suɔ; se hwɔ maa ye mo.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa a nɔ ɔ, e se kɛɔ ngɛ je mi; se nɔ nɛ bui mlaa a, e ma gbo.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Ke o na ohiatsɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa o pa nɔ́ ko ha Yawɛ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ, e maa to nane mi ha mo.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Tsɔse o bi ngɛ be nɛ sa mi, nɛ́ o ko ba ha nɛ e hɛ mi nɛ kpata.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Bu ga womi tue, nɛ o ha a tu mo slɔmi munyu, konɛ o na nile nɛ o kɛ bu o he hwɔɔ se.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa peeɔ e juɛmi ngɛ níhi babauu a he, se Yawɛ yi mi tomi ɔ pɛ lɛ baa mi.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ dɛ ji kaa e ye anɔkuale; dɛgutsɛ hi pe lakpatsɛ.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e wami se kɛɔ; e naa bua jɔmi, nɛ haomi ko haomi ko bɛ e nɔ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Hejɔtsɛ nine tlɔɔ kã mi; dengme loko e kpaleɔ e nine ɔ kɛ baa e nya he ekohu.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Gbla he nɔ wolɔ tue, nɛ ni guhi maa kase nile. Ka ní lelɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e maa kase ní kɛ piɛ he.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Ye bi, ke o sume nɛ a slɔ mo ɔ, nile munyuhi ma bɔ mo.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Lakpa odase yelɔ ɔ, dami sane yemi he fɛu e ngɛ yeɔ nɛ. Yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ munyu yaya sɔuu lɛ jeɔ e nya mi.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Wai sisiɔ nɔ; dã nɛ nya wa haa nɛ nɔ peeɔ basabasa. Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e he kɛ haa dã a, e li nɔ́.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ bu ngɛ e he ɔ, e yuu e he kɛ jee pɛ he. Kuasiahi lɛ a hii pɛe kpamisa.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Juɛmi nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa yi mi ɔ, e mi kuɔ kaa nyu ngɛ vu mi tsitsaa lokoo. Se ní lelɔ jeɔ juɛmi nɛ ɔ kpo ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Nihi babauu maa tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ a mi mi jɔ ha. Se mo hla anɔkualetsɛ kake too ngɛ a kpɛti kaa o maa na lo.

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Bimɛ nɛ a tsɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a gbaa mɛ.

english_verse: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.
translation_verse: Ke matsɛ ngɛ kojoe ɔ, e hɛngmɛ e kɛ dlaa nɔ́ yaya.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de anɔkuale mi ke, “Ye tsui mi tsɔ, nɛ yayami ko pa be ye he hu”?

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ sɛni, kɛ sɛni tɛhi nɛ dɛ kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, Yawɛ sume mɛ.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Jokuɛyo tete po e ní peemi níhi a kɛ yoɔ lɛ kaa e yeɔ anɔkuale, loo e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Koo suɔ mahe hwɔmi nɛ o ba ye ohia. Moo hi hɛ ngmengmle nɛ o hi o he mɔde bɔe, kɛkɛ o ma na ní babauu maa ye.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko wo si ke e maa da nubwɔ nɛ e li lɛ e se ɔ, a ngɔ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ tade kɛ to awaba.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Ke o maa pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, bi ga womi, kɛkɛ e maa hi ha mo. Too ga kpakpa loko o ya hwu ta.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbiɛɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, e nyagbe baa tlukaa kaa kane nɛ a gbe ngɛ diblii kpii mi.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Gbosi ní nɛ o he sɔ kɛ na a, nyagbe ɔ, e pee we gbaami.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Yawɛ hiɔ ní ngmɛmi ní munomunohi; sɛni kɛ e mi tɛ nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, e hí.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Blɔ nɛ nɔ maa nyɛɛ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ lɛ tsɔɔ. Lɛɛ kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛ maa le lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ kɛɛ?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Mo susu o yi mi saminya loko o wo Mawu si, konɛ e ko ba pee klama nɛ maa du mo pee se.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ he nile ngɛ kaa kane nɛ Yawɛ kɛ hyɛɛ nɔmlɔ tsui mi níhi tsuo fitsofitso.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Matsɛ nɛ naa mɔbɔ, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e naa tue mi jɔmi, nɛ e tsɛ yemi ɔ hu yaa nɔ saminya.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Nihewi a hɛ mi nyami ji a he wami; nimowi a he fɛu ji a yi mi mua.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Tue gblami nɛ nya wa tsakeɔ wa ní peemi ní yayamihi.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Matsɛ juɛmi ngɛ kaa nyu dɔ ngɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi. He nɛ lɛɛ e suɔ nɛ e haa e guɔ.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa blɔ tsuo da ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi; se Yawɛ lɛ hyɛɔ nɔ tsui mi.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Pee nɔ́ nɛ sa, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da; lɔ ɔ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi pe nɔ nɛ a maa sã bɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: He nɔ womi, kɛ he womi nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nyaa he ɔ, yayami ji lɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ bɔɔ mɔde kɛ toɔ níhi a blɔ nya saminya a, e naa ní babauu; se nɔ nɛ esɔ kɛkɛ e heɔ ɔ, e be nɔ́ kpakpa ko náe pe ohia.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Basabasa nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi; ejakaa a sume nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ fɔ ɔ, e blɔ ngɛ gɔdɔgɔdɔ, se nɔ nɛ tsui mi tsɔ ɔ, e subai hi.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: E hi kaa o ma ya hi tsu yi mi banee, pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ yo pɛ wolɔ maa hi we kake mi.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ yayami peemi pɛ e suɔ; e nyɛmi ní pee we lɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Ke a gbla he nɔ wolɔ tue ɔ, kuasia po kaseɔ ní kɛ jeɔ mi. Nɛ ke a tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ní ɔ, e leɔ.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɛ yayami peeli tsuo hyɛe ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tsiɔ e tue, konɛ e ko nu ohiatsɛ ngmlaa a, lɛ hu ke e kpa ngmlaa a, a be lɛ tue bue.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Ke a ye dami sane ɔ, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a bua jɔɔ saminya; se yayami peeli lɛɛ sawale nuɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ suɔ fiɛmi maa ye ohia; nɔ nɛ dã, kɛ he dlami e suɔ ɔ, e be ní nae.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Klama nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, nyagbe ɔ, e duɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ mohu.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Afani nɔ́ nɛ o ma ya hi nga kplanaa nɔ pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ yo pɛ wolɔ nɛ hɛ kɔɔ maa hi si.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ buaa níhi nɛ a he jua wa nya ngɔ toɔ; kuasia lɛɛ e kpataa ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi mohu.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ ɔ, e se kɛɛ ngɛ je mi, nɛ a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ e he, nɛ e peeɔ pupuupu ɔ, e bui nɔ́.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ hiaa hejɔtsɛ hluu kɛ ya siɔ e gboɔ, ejakaa e sume nɛ e kɛ e nine tsuɔ ní.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ bɔ ɔ, Yawɛ sume kulaa, hluu nɛ a de ke yi mi tomi yayami piɛ bɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Lakpa odase yelɔ hɛ mi ma kpata. Nɔ nɛ susuɔ munyu he loko e tuɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e munyu ɔ, a ngɔɔ.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛ toɔ e hɛ mi liliili kɛ peeɔ yayami; nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ e susuɔ níhi a he saminya.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Adesa nile, loo nɔ́ sisi numi, loo ga be nyɛe maa da Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Adesa dlaa e we okpɔngɔ he kɛ ha ta hwumi; se kunimi yemi ɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi e ngɛ.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Tsɔse jokuɛyo nɛ e le bɔ nɛ e maa ba e je mi ha, nɛ ke e wa a, e hɛ be nɔ jee.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Niatsɛ nyɔguɛ ji ohiatsɛ. Ke o pa sika ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ kɛkɛ o plɛ pee e nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ mi mi jɔ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ, ejakaa e ngɔɔ e niye ní kɛ haa ohiatsɛmɛ.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ he fɛu ɔ, fie lɛ kɛ je o kasa nya. Kɛkɛ ɔ, huhui, pɛ, kɛ nɔ jɛmi se maa po.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tsui mi tsɔ, nɛ e munyu ngɛ blɛuu ɔ, e kɛ matsɛ maa bɔ.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Yawɛ haa anɔkuale daa si, nɛ yayami peelɔ munyuhi peeɔ yaka.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ hejɔtsɛ deɔ ji, “Jata ngɛ blɔ mi; ke i je kpo ɔ, e maa gbe mi.”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Yo yaholɔ nya mi ngɛ kaa muɔ voo nɛ a tsua kɛ fɔ si. Nihi nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu mɛ lɛ a nɔɔ muɔ nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ jokuɛyo suɔ peemi ji kuasia jemi. Se tsɔsemi tso fieɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ e he.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ waa ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi nɛ e kɛ naa ní, aloo nɔ nɛ keɔ niatsɛmɛ ní ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ma ba ye ohia. Nile munyu nyingmi etɛ

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Bu tue, nɛ o nu munyuhi nɛ ní leli tuɔ, nɛ o kase ní kɛ je mi.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: I ngma nile, kɛ ga womi munyu nyingmi etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha mo,

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: konɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ ji anɔkuale tutuutu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke a tsɔ mo ɔ, o ma na heto kpakpa ba ha nɔ nɛ tsɔ mo ɔ. -

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: Yawɛ nitsɛ maa ye jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a sane ha mɛ. Ke nɔ ko wo a susuma he gbeye ɔ, Yawɛ maa wo lɛ hu e susuma he gbeye ja nɔuu. -

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: Ke o kɛ lɛ bɔ ɔ, o maa kase e ní peemi níhi, nɛ enɛ ɔ maa pee klama nɛ du mo. -

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Koo pee o he nɔmlɔ nɛ daa hiɔ nya ha nihi.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: Ke o nyɛ we nɛ o wo hiɔ ɔ, o sa tete po a ma kpɔ ngɛ o dɛ. -

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Blema buna nɛ o nɛmɛ kɛ kadi zugba a, koo hɛ. -

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Anɛ o le nɔ ko nɛ tsuɔ ní saminya lo? Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, matsɛmɛ nɛ e ma sɔmɔ; pi ni guhi.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Ke kpɛletsɛ ha mo abolo ɔ, koo ye; ko ha nɛ e niye ní ngɔngɔɛ ɔ nɛ jlo mo.

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Ke o kɛ ma nɔ yelɔ yaa ye ní ɔ, susu nɔ nɛ hɛ mi nɛ o hii si ngɛ ɔ he saminya.

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: Ke ngma yelɔ ji mo ɔ, ye o he nɔ, nɛ o ye bɔbɔyoo pɛ.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Ko ha nɛ ma nɔ yelɔ ɔ ní ngɔngɔɛ ɔ nɛ jlo mo; ejakaa pe e kɛ ngɛ mo kae. -

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Jamɛatsɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ buɔ akɔtaa ngɛ e yi mi; e deɔ mo ke, “Ye ní, nuu ní”; se anɔkuale mi ɔ, e tsui be o he.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Hɛngmɛfia pɛ sika a ma nyɛ laa mo; e maa pee kɔɔhiɔ nɛ e maa laa tlukaa kaa kɔle tee kɛ yaa hiɔwe. -

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: E niye ní bɔbɔyoo nɛ o ye ɔ, o maa vie lɛ tsuo, nɛ o munyu ngɔngɔɛ nɛ o tu kɛ je e yi ɔ maa pee yaka. -

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Koo tu munyu kɛ wo kuasia ga; ejakaa nile nɛ ngɛ o munyu ɔ mi ɔ, e maa gbe he guɛ. -

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Koo hɛ blema buna kɛ ya se; nɛ ko ya sɛ awusahi a ngmɔ mi.

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Ye bi, bu tue, nɛ o le ní; hyɛ o je mi bami nɔ saminya.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Ko ya piɛ nihi nɛ nuu wai fuu tsɔ, loo nihi nɛ peeɔ de lo he jiklɔɔ a he.

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: Dã deli, kɛ jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ maa ye ohia; nihi nɛ deɔ kɔnɛɛ be tsuaa be ɔ ma bu bo gbagbɛ. -

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Bu o tsɛ nɛ fɔ mo ɔ tue; nɛ ke o nyɛ bwɔ ɔ, koo gbe e he guɛ.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale yemi, nile, tsɔsemi, kɛ sane se kɔmi a he jua wa saminya; e sa kaa a di se nɛ a ko ngmɛɛ he.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Ye bi, bu mi tue saminya; ha nɛ ye je mi bami nɛ pee nɔhyɛ nɔ́ ha mo!

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: Yo yaholɔ, loo yo nɛ puɛɔ gba ngɛ kaa klama nɛ a tsɔ; e kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: E woɔ ka kaa ojo fialɔ, nɛ e haa nyumuhi babauu puɛɔ gba. -

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ naa nɔ́? Mɛnɔ haoɔ? Mɛnɔ kɛ nihi naa pɛ? Mɛnɔ hii kɔmɔ yee? Mɛnɔ naa pá ngɛ e he yaka gu? Mɛnɔ hɛngmɛhi peeɔ tsutsuutsu kɔlukɔlu?

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Koo hyɛ wai, bɔ nɛ e tsuɔ paa, bɔ nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ fɛu ngɛ kplu mi, bɔ nɛ e bee miaa ngɛ kuɔ si, nɛ e ko ba ka mo.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: O hɛngmɛ maa na nyakpɛ níhi; o yi mi maa pee mo basaa, nɛ o maa hi ní tsuae kɛkɛ.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: O maa pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ tlɔ wo mi, aloo nɔ ko nɛ kplaa si ngɛ abalaa tso he ngɛ lɛ mi.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: O ma de ke, “A fia mi ní, se i nui he fɛɛ; a fia mi kpa, lɔ ɔ hu i nui he! Mɛni be ye hɛ maa tsɛ? Aa, ma hla dã bɔɔ nɛ ma nu ekohu!”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Koo ye o tsui ngɛ yayami peeli a he; o hɛ ko kɔ a nɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: O hɛ ko kɔ yayami peeli a nɔ, nɛ ko hla kaa o kɛ mɛ maa bɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: Basabasa peemi kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ; nɛ munyu yaya nɛ jeɔ a nya mi. -

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: Ejakaa hwɔɔ se ko be ha yayami peeli; a hɛ nɔ kami maa pee yaka. -

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Nile a kɛ poɔ we; e nɔ nɛ a maa we ɔ kɛ fɔɔ.

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: Juɛmi nɛ a kɛ dlaa tsu mi, nɛ a woɔ mi ní kpakpahi, kɛ afɛu níhi. -

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Ye bi, ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ o bu matsɛ. Nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ woɔ mɛ ɔ, o kɛ jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ko bɔ.

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: E sa kaa o toɔ ga saminya loko o yaa ta. Ke o ngɛ ga woli babauu ɔ, o yeɔ kunimi. -

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu, loo matsɛ ɔ maa gbla a tue tlukaa. Nɛ haomi nɛ maa ba a nɔ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ le? Nile munyu kpa komɛ

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Ní leli a munyu komɛ hu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Ke a ngɛ kojoe ɔ, e sɛ kaa a hyɛɔ nɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ma de yayami peelɔ ke e ye nguɔ ɔ, nihi tsuo maa gbiɛ lɛ, nɛ a maa nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Ke haomi ba o nɔ, nɛ o pee gbedee ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa o he wami pi saasaa. -

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ kaa yayami peeli a hɛ mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa gbaa mɛ, nɛ e maa hi ha mɛ.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Ko de ke o li he nɔ́ ko, ejakaa Mawu nɛ naa nɔmlɔ tsui mi ɔ lɛɛ e na, nɛ e le hulɔ. Nɛ e maa wo mo hiɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ he. -

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Ke a bi mo munyu, nɛ o ha heto pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, huɛ bɔmi kpakpa he okadi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Koo pee o ní kaa yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ woɔ nimli kpakpahi ka nɛ a ngɔɔ a níhi, aloo a kpɔɔ a wehi ngɛ a dɛ pani nya.

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kpakpa a, ke e nɔ si nɔtonɔto si kpaago po, e maa te si ekohu. Se nimli yayamihi lɛɛ ke haomi ba a nɔ kɛkɛ a hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ. -

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Koo ye odase kɛ si o nyɛmi yaka gu, nɛ koo ngɔ o nya mi munyu hu kɛ sisi nɔ.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Ke o he nyɛlɔ tɛ nɔ́, loo e nɔ si ɔ, ko nya.

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: Ke o pee ja a, Yawɛ maa na, nɛ e maa dɔ lɛ, nɛ e be o he nyɛlɔ ɔ tue gblae hu. -

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: I nyɛɛ kɛ ya gu hejɔtsɛ ko ngmɔ mi; i ya be ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ be juɛmi e wai ngmɔ mi.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: I hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ too; i susu he, nɛ i kase ní kɛ je mi.

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Salomo abɛ kpahi nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia we bi ɔmɛ bua nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.
translation_verse: Hɛ mi nyami sa Mawu kaa e ngɔɔ níhi kɛ laa wɔ; matsɛmɛ lɛɛ bu sa mɛ, ejakaa a hyɛɔ níhi a mi fitsofitso.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpɛti kɛ ha a, ja lɛ nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ ngɛ susue ngɛ e yi mi ɔ ngɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa le.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Ke sika hiɔ galɔ je sika fĩ kɛ je sika hiɔ mi loko e naa june nɛ e kɛ tsuɔ nɔ́ ko kpakpa.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Koo pee o he nɔ agbo ngɛ matsɛ hɛ mi; nɛ ko ya da si ngɛ nimli nguahi a da he.

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: E hi kaa a ma tsɛ mo kɛ ya yimɛ a je pe nɔ́ nɛ a maa tsɛ̃ mo kɛ ya sisimɛ a je ngɛ ganɔ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Ke o kɛ o nyɛmi ngɛ pɛ ko ɔ, o kɛ lɛ pɛ nyɛ hla nya. Koo wo nɔ kpa laami sane nɔ ta.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ a tu pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa sika tsu akutuhi nɛ a to ngɔ wo sika hiɔ nɔ́ mi.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Ke ní lelɔ ka o hɛ mi nɛ o bu tue ɔ, e ngɛ kaa june kpakpa nɛ e ke mo.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: O nane ko pɔ o huɛ we mi fiɛmi, konɛ o sane ko ba ti lɛ, nɛ́ e ba nyɛ mo.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ lakpa odase ngɛ e nyɛmi he ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tsokpoti, loo klaate, loo kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ nya ba.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Ke hɛdɔ ba, nɛ o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔmlɔ yayami nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ lungu yaya ngɛ nɔ́ tae, loo o kɛ nane nɛ tɔ̃ ngɛ nyɛɛe.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Ke hwɔ ngɛ o he nyɛlɔ yee ɔ, ha lɛ ní nɛ e ye; nɛ ke kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, ha lɛ nyu nɛ e nu.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: Ke o pee ja a, zo kpɔtɔɔ maa gbe lɛ, nɛ Yawɛ maa gbaa mo.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ jeɔ omleyi ɔ, hiɔmi e kɛ baa kaa bɔ nɛ sieku yemi kɛ hɛ mi tumi baa a.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: E hi kaa o ma ya hi tsu yi mi banee, pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ yo pɛ wolɔ maa hi we kake mi.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Dalɔ nɛ ngmɛɛɔ nɔ́ he ha yayami peelɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nyu nɛ a gbidi mi, loo vu nɛ e mi nyu ɔ puɛ.

english_verse: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.
translation_verse: Hwo babauu yemi hí; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko hla yi jemi kɛ be nɔ.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Hɛ mi nyami sɛ kuasia, kaa snoo ngɛ latsa be mi, aloo hiɔmi ngɛ ní kpami be mi.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Gbiɛmi nɛ a gbiɛɛ nɔ yaka gu ɔ, e tsu we nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa otoklii, aloo ngmlebitɛɛnyɛ nɛ ngɛ tee kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae kɛkɛ nɛ si mami be mi.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Okpɔngɔ ɔ, kpa a fiaa lɛ; teji ɔ, a woɔ e nya mi dade, nɛ kuasia lɛɛ e nɔ́ ji tso.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Ke kuasia tu biɛmi munyu ɔ, ha lɛ heto bɔ nɛ sa lɛ pɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa na kaa mamoo e li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Ke o tsɔ kuasia a, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o poo mo nitsɛ o nanehi ngɔ fɔ he, aloo o nu duɔ nɔ́ nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Kuasia nya mi abɛ he be se nami, kaa bɔ nɛ glɔtsɛ nanehi kplaa si gu ngɛ e he ɔ.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ngɛ kuasia hɛ mi nyami woe ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ tɛ fie kɛ ngɛ amlami mi woe.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Ke kuasia ngɛ abɛ bue ɔ, e ngɛ kaa dã delɔ nɛ ngɛ mio hiae ngɛ e dɛ mi.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ bɔɔ dã delɔ, aloo kuasia nɛ bee kɛkɛ apaa a, e ngɛ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃lɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ plaae.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Kuasia nɛ kpaleɔ ya jeɔ kuasia si enyɔne ɔ, e ngɛ kaa gbe nɛ kpaleɔ ya yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e vie ekohu.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko buu e he ní lelɔ, nɛ pohu e li nɔ́ ko ɔ, hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha kuasia po pe lɛ.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ hejɔtsɛ deɔ ji, “Jata ngɛ blɔ mi! Jata ngɛ blɔ kpɛ!”

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Hejɔtsɛ hii plɛe ngɛ sa mi kaa bɔ nɛ sinya plɛɔ e he ngɛ e se asahi a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Hejɔtsɛ nine tlɔɔ ka mi; dengme loko e kpaleɔ e nine ɔ kɛ baa e nya he ekohu.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Hejɔtsɛ buu e he ní lelɔ kulaa pe juɛmitsɛmɛ kpaago.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kɛ e he woɔ pɛ nɛ kɔ we e he mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ na gbe nɛ bee nɛ e nu gbe ɔ tue.

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Ke lɛ́ be la tɛ mi ɔ, la gboɔ; he nɛ siekutsɛ be ɔ, pɛ se poɔ.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Pɛ wolɔ he sɔɔ kɛ woɔ pɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la haa nɛ hã tsɛ̃ɔ ɔ.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Siekutsɛ munyu ngɛ kaa niye ní ngɔngɔɛ nɛ ke o ye ɔ, e yaa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi he tsuaa he.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko nya mi munyu ngɔɔ, se e tsui mi lɛɛ e hí ɔ, e ngɛ kaa zu buɛ nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ ha he.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tsuaa muɔ kɛ fɔɔ si ha nɔ ko ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e maa nɔ mi. Nɔ nɛ kpɛneɔ tɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e nɔ tɛ ɔ maa nɔ.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Lakpatsɛ nyɛɔ nihi nɛ e ye a he lakpa a. Munyu dɔkɔbii tulɔ puɛɔ nɔ́.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Mi mi la puɛɔ ní wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ muklii mi fumi hu nɔ́ pe, se hunga jemi lɛɛ e nɔ nya hi dami.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ke o huɛ plaa mo ɔ, nɔ́ kpakpa ko e ngɛ hlae ha mo; se o he nyɛlɔ lɛɛ pe e maa fua mo babauu kɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tɔ ɔ, ke a ha lɛ hwo po e sume; se nɔ nɛ hwɔ ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, lɛɛ níhi nɛ dooɔ tete po ngɔɔ e nya.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Nyumu nɛ jeɔ e we mi nɛ e ya hii kpae ɔ, e ngɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ e tsu nya blɔ laa lɛ.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Ke haomi ba nɔ nɔ nɛ e ná bua wolɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nu je via nɛ e kpa; nɛ e naa bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: O hɛ ko je mo nitsɛ o huɛ, loo o tsɛ e huɛ nɔ; ke e fi mo ɔ, ko de ke doo o maa ya o nyɛmi ngɔ; o huɛ nɛ ngɛ o kasa nya a hi pe o nyɛmi nɛ ngɛ ma se lokoo.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Ye bi, pee o he ní lelɔ, nɛ ma na bua jɔmi, konɛ ma na nɔ́ kpakpa ko ma de nɔ nɛ ngɛ mi ahlua bɔe ɔ.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ le ní naa yayami nɛ ma, nɛ e ya laa e he; se kuasia lɛɛ e kɛ yayami ɔ ya kpee, nɛ e naa e mi nɔ́.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko wo si kaa e maa da nubwɔ nɛ e li lɛ se ɔ, a ngɔ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ tade kɛ to awaba.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ teɔ si makɛ mla nɛ e ngaa e nyɛmi kɛ ngmlaa boboobo ɔ, a buɔ lɛ kaa pe e ngɛ nɔ ɔ gbiɛe mohu.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Yo nɛ woɔ pɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa hiɔmi nyu nɛ ngɛ dɛe kɔ, kɔ, kɔ kpamisa.

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: O be kikɛmɛ a yo nyɛe ma kpata gblegbleegble, kaa bɔ nɛ o be nyɛe maa tsi kɔɔhiɔ nya, loo o maa yɛ nyu kɛ wo kusii mi ɔ.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ kaseɔ nile kɛ jeɔ e nyɛmi ngɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ dade duɔɔ dade nya a.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ hyɛɔ ngmɔkɔ tso nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e yeɔ ngmɔkɔ yiblii ɔ eko; nɔ nɛ buɔ e nyɔmtsɛ he ɔ, a woɔ e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa nitsɛ lɛ leɔ e tsui mi níhi, kaa bɔ nɛ e naa e hɛ mi foni paa ngɛ nyu hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Ní kpakpahi nɛ a deɔ ngɛ nɔ ko he ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ yoɔ lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la kaa sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu ɔ.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Ke a kongo kuasia kaa bɔ nɛ a gbeeɔ blɛfo ngɛ tso mi po, e biɛmi ɔ be tae.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Hyɛ o to, kɛ o na nɔ saminya;

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Ke nga gbli, nɛ nga mumu kpale puɛ, nɛ a bua lohwehi a niye ní nya ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: jijɔ ɔmɛ a bwɔmi ɔ maa pee bo, nɛ o maa jua apletsi ɔmɛ kɛ he zugba;

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: o ma na apletsi nyɔ nyu bɔ nɛ maa su o kɛ o we ɔ, kɛ o mawayi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ tuɔ fo be mi nɛ nɔ ko nyɛɛ we e se. Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a peeɔ kã kaa jata.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, pe a hii ma nɔ yeli ɔmɛ tsakee nɔtonɔto kpamisa. Se ma nɛ ní leli, kɛ nɔ́ sisi nuli hiɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, e maa si kpɛii.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Ohiatsɛ nɛ waa e nyɛmi ohiatsɛ yi mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa hiɔmi nɛ nɛɔ kpatakpata tlukaa kɛ kpataa niye ní hɛ mi.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Yayami peeli nui dami sane yemi sisi. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nuɔ sisi saminya.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Ohiatsɛ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e hi pe niatsɛ nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ dɛ.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Bi nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ kɛ jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ bɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e woɔ e fɔli zo.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ paa sika ha nɔ nɛ e heɔ hekpa babauu ɔ, pe e ngɛ e juetli ɔ nya buae kɛ ha nɔ nɛ naa ohiatsɛmɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ sume kaa e yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, ke e fa kue ha Mawu po, e bɔ musu.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Niatsɛ buɔ e he ní lelɔ. Se ohiatsɛ nɛ juɛmi ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e le bɔ nɛ niatsɛ ɔ ngɛ ha.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Ke nimli kpakpahi ye manye ɔ, nihi tsuo a bua jɔɔ a he. Se ke nimli yayamihi a nine ya hiɔwe ɔ, nihi tsuo laa a he.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ laa e yayamihi a nɔ ɔ, e yɛ nɔ. Se nɔ nɛ jajeɔ e he yayami, nɛ e kpaa yayami peemi ɔ, a maa na lɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye daa. Se nɔmlɔ nɛ tue wa a, lɛɛ haomi maa ba e nɔ.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Matsɛ yiwutsotsɛ nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ a nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae, aloo osisiblisi nɛ e hɛ mi wo la.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Nɔ yelɔ nɛ be juɛmi ɔ, yiwutsotsɛ kpanaku ji lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ sume níhi nɛ a naa kɛ guu sisimi blɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e se maa kɛ ngɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, a ma he e yi wami. Se nɔ nɛ ní peemi níhi dɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e maa nɔ muɔ mi tlukaa.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ kɔni si wa a ma na niye ní babauu. Se nɔ nɛ ya nyɛɛɔ yakayaka níhi a se ɔ, e we ohia maa kle.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, a maa gbaa lɛ babauu. Se nɔ nɛ he sɔɔ kɛ naa ní ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, ja a gbla e tue kɛ̃.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Nɔ hɛ mi hyɛmi hí. Abolo bɔbɔyoo ko nɛ o kɛ maa wo nɔ ko nya mi ɔ ma ha nɛ nɔ ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ amlɔ.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ hɛ mi sãã lɛ hlaa kaa e he maa sɔ kɛ na ní. Se e li tete kaa hwɔɔ se ɔ, e ma ba ye ohia.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ juɔ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ, nɛ e deɔ ke tsa pi yayami ji lɔ ɔ, e kɛ ojo fialɔ ɔ, slɔɔto be a kpɛti.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ hɛ tsuɔ ɔ, pɛ wolɔ ji lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e he kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, níhi a mi hii ha lɛ.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ heɔ e he yeɔ ɔ, kuasia ji lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ buɔ ní leli a munyu tue ɔ, e maa hi ha lɛ.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kee ohiatsɛmɛ ní ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be lɛ hiae. Nɔ nɛ naa ohiatsɛmɛ nɛ e maa e hɛngmɛ ɔ, nihi babauu maa gbiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Ke yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, nihi laa a he. Ke a kpa mɛ ɔ, ni kpakpahi ba yeɔ tsɛ ekohu.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ke a ka e hɛ mi, nɛ e waa tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e maa ku kɛ pue si tlukaa, nɛ e be hie tsami.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Bi nɛ nyaa nile he ɔ, e haa e fɔli bua jɔmi; se nɔ nɛ kɛ yaholi ya bɔɔ ɔ, e kpataa e weto ní hɛ mi.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ, e ma a yaa nɔ saminya; se nɔ nɛ heɔ nike ní pani nya ngɛ e ma mi bi a dɛ ɔ, e ywiaa ma a.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kɛ e nyɛmi tuɔ munyu dɔkɔbii ɔ, klama e ngɛ lɛ tsɔe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e le ohiatsɛmɛ a hiami níhi, se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ e juɛmi sui ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he kulaa.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ yeɔ nɔ he fɛu woɔ pɛ ngɛ ma mi; se ní leli haa ma mi jɔɔ.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Ke ní lelɔ kɛ kuasia na sane ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ kuasia peeɔ kɛkɛ ji kaa e hii kuɛe, nɛ e hii muɔe, nɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo peeɔ hoo.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Kuasia jeɔ e we abofu tsuo kpo; se ní lelɔ lɛɛ e toɔ e tsui si kɛ tsiɔ abofu nya.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Nɔ yelɔ nɛ lakpa munyu tue e buɔ ɔ, e tsɔli tsuo peeɔ yiwutsotsɛmɛ.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Ohiatsɛ kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae ɔ, a sɔ pɛ; mɛ tsuo ɔ, Yawɛ lɛ ha mɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ a kɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Matsɛ nɛ ngɔɔ anɔkuale yemi kɛ yeɔ dɛgutsɛmɛ a sane ɔ, e tsɛ yemi ɔ se kɛɔ.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Ke a kɛ kpa tsɔse nɔ ɔ, e leɔ ní; se ke a ngmɛɛ jokuɛ je mi he ha lɛ ɔ, e pueɔ e nyɛ hɛ mi si.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Tsɔse o bi saminya, nɛ o ma na yi jemi; nɛ o bua maa jɔ o he.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ kɛ e hɛ fɔɛ Mawu nɔ ɔ, e níhi peeɔ basaa. Nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Munyu babauu kɛkɛ tsɔse we tsɔlɔ; ejakaa e maa nu lɛɛ, se e be he ní tsue.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha kuasia pe nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu puu.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ haa e tsɔlɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e biɔ lɛ be tsuaa be ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, tsɔlɔ ɔ mohu ba peeɔ wetsɛ.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ woɔ e mi mi la a, e woɔ pɛ. Nɔ nɛ naa abofu peeɔ tɔmi babauu.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kɛ julɔ ya dlaa ju ní ɔ, e he mi jɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ; e nuɔ kita nɛ a ka ngɛ nɔ́ ɔ he, se e peeɔ kɔ̃, konɛ a ko nu nɔ́ ko kɛ je e nya.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Ke o ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa gbeye yee ɔ, o naa haomi; se ke o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be o he sae.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nihi babauu buɔ kaa a maa sa nɔ yelɔ hɛ mi; se Yawɛ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ha nɔ.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Yake nɛ je Masa a, e binyumu Agur sɛ gbi nɛ e ngɔ ha Itiel kɛ Ukal ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Nyumu ɔ ke, “Mawu lee! Peepee ta ye he oo, peepee ta ye he! Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: I kase we nile; Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu i li e he nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ ya hiɔwe nɛ e kpale kɛ ba zugba hyɛ? Mɛnɔ lɛ bua kɔɔhiɔ nya kɛ wo e dɛ mi hyɛ? Mɛnɔ lɛ yɛ wo mi nyu ɔ tsuo kɛ wo bo mi, nɛ e fi nya hyɛ? Aloo mɛnɔ lɛ ma buna ngɛ je ɔ mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ? Kɛ a tsɛɔ lɛ kɛɛ? E bi ɔ hu, mɛni ji e biɛ? Tse o le?

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: “Ke Mawu wo si ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ. Mawu ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃i kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ hlaa e se blɔ.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Koo ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ Mawu munyu ɔmɛ a he. Ke o pee ja a, Mawu ma ka o hɛ mi, nɛ nihi tsuo maa na kaa lakpatsɛ ji mo.” Abɛ kpa komɛ

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: Mawu, nɔ enyɔ i ngɛ mo bie nɛ o ha mi loko ma gbo.

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Hyɛ nɛ ma ko ye lakpa. Ko ha nɛ ma ná ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ ko ha nɛ ma ye ohia hulɔ; niye ní nɛ maa su mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ o ha mi.

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: Ke i na ní kpɔtɔɔ ɔ, ma kua mo, nɛ ma de ke, “Mɛnɔ kulaa ji Yawɛ nɛ ɔ?” Jã kɛ̃, ke i ye ohia a, ma ju, nɛ ma wo ye Mawu ɔ he mu.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: Koo gbe tsɔlɔ he guɛ ha e nyɔmtsɛ. Ke o pee ja a, tsɔlɔ ɔ maa gbiɛ mo, nɛ o hɛ mi ma pue si.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: Ni komɛ gbiɛɔ a tsɛmɛ, nɛ a gbaa we a nyɛmɛ.

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ buɔ a he kaa a he tsɔ, be mi nɛ a sɛ mu kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: Ni komɛ woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a susuɔ kaa a hi tsɔ.

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Ni gbogboehi a je, yo nɛ be bi, zugba nɛ hiɔmi nɛ́ ngɛ nɔ, kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ nine kpi he.

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e tsɛ he guɛ, nɛ e bui e nyɛ ɔ, kuakualabitehi nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ma ta e hɛngmɛ, nɛ okpokuhi maa ye lɛ.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Nɔ́ etɛ kɛ yaa eywiɛ komɛ peeɔ mi nyakpɛ nɛ ye juɛmi sui he:

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Kɔle nɛ ngɛ tee ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ bee; sinɔ nɛ ngɛ si sããe ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ, lɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ wo nɔ, kɛ nyumu kɛ yo a bɔmi.

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Nɔ́ etɛ kɛ yaa eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ je ɔ sume saasaa, nɛ e peeɔ je ɔ kaa e mimiɛ:

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Nyɔguɛ nɛ ba ngɛ matsɛ yee, kuasia nɛ ye ngma nɛ e tɔ,

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: yo nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko sume lɛ, nɛ ba na gba, kɛ mawayo nɛ ba kpɔ gba ngɛ e nyɛ dɛ.
