english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Nɔ́ eywiɛ komɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ a klee we saasaa, se a le ní saminya:

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Tatuhi; a he wɛ saasaa, se a buaa niye ní nya kɛ toɔ ngɛ latsa be mi.

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: Nyu mi kpihi; mɛ hu a be he wami ko, se a peeɔ a tsu ngɛ tɛ sahi a kpɛ.

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: Baalɛhi; a be matsɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nyɛɛɔ ngɛ kuuhi a mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: Akɔtɔkuhi: o ma nyɛ nu akɔtɔku kɛ o nine, se kɛ̃ ɔ, matsɛmɛ a mɔhi a mi a naa mɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: Three or four creatures really strut around:
translation_verse: Nɔ́ etɛ kɛ yaa eywiɛ komɛ ngɛ nɛ a nyɛɛmi ngɛ fɛu kɛ akɔnɔ:

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: Kungwɔ ku nɛ ngɛ si sie kɛ bee; to akpakpo, kɛ matsɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e ma hɛ mi kɛ ma.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke o fia nyɔ nyu ɔ, e peeɔ bɔta. Ke o fia nɔ ko gugwɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e jeɔ muɔ. Ke o wo nɔ ko mi mi la a, pɛ lɛ nyɛɛɔ se.

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Munyuhi nɛ Matsɛ Lemuel, Masa matsɛ ɔ nyɛ kɛ tsɔse lɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: Koo ngɔ o he wami kɛ ha yihi. Matsɛmɛ tete po nɛ nyɛɛɔ yihi a se ɔ, a hɛ mi kpataa.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: Lemuel lee, anɔkuale mi ɔ, e sɛ matsɛmɛ, kɛ ma nɔ yeli kaa a nu wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa.

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: Ke a nu ɔ, a hɛ maa je ohia nɔ, nɛ a be kɔmɔ yee hu.

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: “Tu munyu kɛ fa mumui he; ye awusahi tsuo a sane ha mɛ.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Tu munyu kɛ fa a he; ye dami sane. Hyɛ nɔ́ nali, kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ a nɔ saminya.” Yo kpakpa

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Yo kpakpa a, mɛnɔ ma na? E he jua wa kulaa pe june!

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: E huno ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo, nɛ e huno ɔ be ohia yee gblegbleegble.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Yo ɔ peeɔ e huno ɔ suɔmi nya ní; daa nɛ ɔ, e peeɔ lɛ kpakpa, pi yayami.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: E ya ngɔɔ niye ní kɛ jee tsitsaa kɛ baa kaa bɔ nɛ jua yelɔ ya ngɔɔ tlomi kɛ jee ma se lokoo kɛ baa a.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: E teɔ si makɛ mla, nɛ e hlaa niye ní ha e we mi bimɛ, nɛ e gbaa ní tsumi ha e mawayihi.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: E hlaa zugba nɛ e heɔ. E bɔɔ apaa nɛ a peeɔ wai ngmɔ ha lɛ.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: E tsuɔ ní nyɔ mi tsuo; ejakaa e le kaa e ma na he se kokooko.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: E naa ohiatsɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e bɔleɔ nine kɛ haa nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Ke fĩɛ be su ɔ, e yi tsui kaa fĩɛ maa ye e we mi bimɛ, ejakaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ kuutu tade.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: Lɛ nitsɛ e loɔ e sa nɔ bo; nɛ e buɔ kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu, kɛ bo nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Ke ma nimeli kpe ɔ, a toɔ e huno ɔ he hɛ saminya ngɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: Nile munyu sɔuu e tuɔ, nɛ a naa ngɛ e lilɛ nɔ kaa e mi mi jɔ.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: E hyɛɔ nɛ e we mi bimɛ nɛ ba a je mi saminya; nɛ e sume hejɔ.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: E huno, kɛ e bimɛ tsuo buɔ lɛ, nɛ a gbaa lɛ. E huno ɔ jeɔ e yi ke,

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: “Yihi babauu ngɛ nɛ bɔɔ mɔde mohu, se moo lɛɛ, o pe mɛ tsuo!”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Hɛ mi nyami sisiɔ nɔ, nɛ he fɛu hu taa; se yo nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e sa kaa a je e yi.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: David bi, fiɛlɔ nguaa a nɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ Yerusalem munyuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: Ye juɛmi deɔ mi ke, wami nɛ ɔ, se nami ko be he; wami he be se nami. Lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka!

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Dengme tsuo nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa gboɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛni se e naa?

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Pu teɔ si nɛ e nɔɔ si, nɛ e he sɔɔ kɛ yaa he nɛ e te si kɛ je ɔ ekohu.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Pahi tsuo bee kɛ ya sɛɛ wo mi, se wo hyi we gblegbleegble. Pa amɛ kpaleɔ a se kɛ yaa he nɛ a je ɔ, nɛ a bee kɛ yaa wo ɔ mi ekohu.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ peeɔ pɔtɔ kɛ yaka nɛ hi kalemi; nɔ́ hyɛmi kɛ munyu tumi gbi nɔ nya.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Anɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɛ a ma tsɛ lɛ nɔ́ he lo? Dɛbi! Jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ kɛ je blema, loko a fɔ wɔ tete po.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ be ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kaii we hu. Jã kɛ̃, níhi nɛ maa ba kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ, mɛ hu a be kaie. Fiɛlɔ nguaa a kpa je mi níhi si

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Imi fiɛlɔ ɔ, i hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: I bɔ mɔde kaa níhi tsuo nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma ngɔ ye nile ɔ kɛ hla mi fitsofitso. Ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha nɔmlɔ adesa ke e tsu ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, haomi sɔuu; pi ní tsumi nɛ ngɔɔ.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ kpɛ̃ ɔ, e hí dami; nɔ́ nɛ bé ɔ, e hí kanemi.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “I pee nɔmlɔ nguaa. Nihi tsuo nɛ ye Yerusalem ma a nɔ kɛ sɛ ye hlami ɔ, i le ní kulaa pe mɛ. Ee, nile ɔ, i kpa lɛ si saminya.”

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: I bɔ mɔde kaa ma hla slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nile kɛ godo, aloo nile kɛ kuasia jemi a kpɛti. Se i na kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Ní lemi fuu ɔ, haomi sɔuu lɛ ngɛ mi. Ke nɔ ko le ní babauu ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ e haomi hu hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: I kpa si kaa muɔmi ɔ, godo, nɛ bua jɔmi hu se nami be he.

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: Ngɛ ye ní lemi ɔ kulaa se ɔ, i pee ye yi mi kaa ma nu dã, nɛ ma fiɛ, konɛ ye nɔ gbagba nɛ te. I susu kaa nɔ́ nɛ hi, nɛ sa nɔmlɔ adesa peemi ngɛ je mi e wami be ɔ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: I pee ní nguanguahi. I ma tsuhi, nɛ i pee wai ngmɔhi.

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: I pee ngmɔhi kɛ abɔɔhi, nɛ i du tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii slɔɔtohi ngɛ mi.

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: I gba nyu dɔhi nɛ i kɛ haa tso ɔmɛ nyu.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: I he nyɔguɛhi babauu, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo; nɛ a fɔ nyɔguɛhi babauu kɛ wo ye we ɔ mi. Jehanɛ se hu, i ngɛ nahi kɛ tohi babauu pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: I bua sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu nya, nɛ i tsu tó ngɛ matsɛmɛ a dɛ, kɛ ye nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ. Nyumuhi kɛ yihi babauu la kɛ jɔɔ ye bua, nɛ i ngɔ yihi babauu bɔ nɛ ma nyɛ.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i pee nɔmlɔ nguaa, nɛ i he biɛ kulaa pe nihi tsuo nɛ sɛ ye hlami ngɛ Yerusalem; ye nile ɔ hu se pui gblegbleegble.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i susu ye nine nya ní tsumi ɔmɛ tsuo a he, kɛ dengme nɛ i gbo ngɛ a he ɔ, nɛ i na kaa lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka. E ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ; se nami ko be he.

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nihi nɛ sɛ e hlami pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛ hu e maa pee. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i bɔni nile, godo, kɛ kuasia jemi a he susumi saminya.

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na kaa nile hi pe kuasia jemi kaa bɔ nɛ la hi pe diblii ɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ le he nɛ e yaa; kuasia lɛɛ e li. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, amanehlu kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ baa mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Dengme babauu nɛ i gbo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i pa sume hu; ejakaa i le kaa níhi tsuo nɛ i bua nya a, ma si kɛ ha nɔ nɛ ma ba ye ye ní ɔ.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ma ba pee ní lelɔ oo, e ma ba pee kuasia oo, mɛnɔ lɛ le? Se kɛ̃ ɔ, níhi tsuo nɛ i ngɔ nile kɛ gbo a he dengme ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nɛ ma ba ye. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ba pia ye he kaa i tsu ní wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: Ejakaa be komɛ ɔ, nɔ ko maa ngɔ nile, kɛ ga kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma si ha nɔ ko nɛ gbo we nɔ́ ɔ he dengme ko kulaa nɛ e ba ye. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka dengme, kɛ yayami agbo.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Haomi nɛ baa nɔmlɔ nɔ, kɛ dengme babauu nɛ e gboɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛni se lɛ e naa?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tsuɔ e wami be ɔ tsuo peeɔ haomi kɛ kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu. Nyɔ mi po e juɛmi ha we lɛ he jɔmi. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa adesa peemi ji kaa e ye ní, nɛ e nu ní, nɛ e na bua jɔmi kɛ je e dengme gbomi ɔ mi. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i na kaa enɛ ɔ hu je Mawu ngɔ.

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: Ke pi Mawu he ɔ, mɛnɔ maa ye ní, nɛ mɛnɔ ma na bua jɔmi?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, Mawu haa mɛ nile, ga, kɛ bua jɔmi. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ, e haa a tsuɔ ní, nɛ a buaa níhi a nya, konɛ e ngɔ ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ lɛ, Mawu ɔ suɔmi nya ní. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ e be.

english_verse: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping,
translation_verse: Fɔmi be ngɛ, nɛ gbenɔ be ngɛ; ní dumi be ngɛ, nɛ ní kpami be ngɛ.

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: Suɔmi be ngɛ, nɛ nɔ nyɛmi be ngɛ. Ta be ngɛ, nɛ tue mi jɔmi be ngɛ.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Ní tsulɔ ɔ, mɛni se e naa kɛ jee e dengme gbomi ɔ mi?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: Ní tsumi kpakpataa nɛ Mawu ha nɔmlɔ ke e tsu ɔ, i na.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: E peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ saminyayoo ngɛ e be mi. E ha nɔmlɔ juɛmi nɛ e kɛ leɔ níhi nɛ be momo, kɛ níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, lɛ Mawu ɔ ní tsumi kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔmlɔ juɛmi sui he.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: E sa kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye ní, nɛ e nu ní; nɛ e na bua jɔmi kɛ je níhi nɛ e gbo a he dengme ɔ mi. Mawu nike ní ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: I le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu pee ɔ maa hi si kɛ ya neneene; a be nyɛe nɛ a ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ he, loo a je nɔ́ ko ngɛ mi. Mawu lɛ pee jã, konɛ a ye lɛ gbeye.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ba hyɛ; nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ, e ba hyɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ be momo ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu Mawu ngɔɔ kɛ baa ekohu. Amimi yemi ngɛ je mi

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “Mawu maa kojo dalɔ kɛ yayami peelɔ tsuo, ejakaa a to be kɛ ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi.”

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo he kake ɔ lɛ a yaa; mɛ tsuo zu mi lɛ a je, nɛ zu mi lɛ mɛ tsuo a maa kpale kɛ ya.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ le kaa nɔmlɔ adesa mumi ɔ yaa hiɔwe, se lohwe lɛɛ e mumi ɔ, zu mi lɛ e yaa?

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ se hu, i na kaa yi mi sɔuu lɛ a ngɛ wae ngɛ je ɔ mi. Nɔ́ nali ngɛ ya foe, nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa jɔɔ a bua. Bua wolɔ ko be mɛ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ, he wami ngɛ a dɛ.

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: I susu kaa nihi nɛ gbo ɔ, a nɔ́ hi pe ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Se ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ po a se ɔ, nihi nɛ a nɔ́ hi pe kulaa ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a fɔ we mɛ lolo, nɛ mɛɛ a nɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i na kaa nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ nihi gboɔ dengme wawɛɛ konɛ a ya nɔ ɔ ji kaa a hɛ kɔɔ a nyɛmimɛ a nɔ. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Kuasia buaa e ninehi a nya kɛ woɔ e gblɛɛ mi, nɛ e gboɔ kɛ hwɔ.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Se afani nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo nɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ he pe nɛ o kɛ o nine enyɔ ma gbo yaka dengme kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: I na nɔ́ kpa ko hu ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ ji yaka dengme gbomi.

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Hyɛ kaa nɔ ko lɛ ngɛ. E be bi; e be nyɛmi ko; lɛ nɔ kake ngmelu pɛ lɛ ngɛ. Se daa nɛ ɔ, dengme nɔ kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ; e ní nɛ e na a pi ha lɛ. E bi we e he hyɛ ke dengme babauu nɛ e ngɛ gboe nɛ e yi e mi ngɔɔmi ko ɔ, mɛnɔ kulaa lɛ e ngɛ jamɛ a dengme ɔ gboe ha. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ ko; dengme gbomi gu nɛ bua jɔmi be mi.

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Ke ni enyɔ bua kɛ tsu ní ɔ, e hi pe nɔ kake nɛ ma tsu ní; ejakaa a náá a dengme gbomi ɔ he se.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ kake nɔ si ɔ, nɔ kake ma wo e nɔ. Se ke nɔ kake ngmelu lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e nɔ si ɔ, kɛkɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ pee lɛ; ejakaa nɔ ko be nɛ ma wo e nɔ.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, fĩɛ be, ke ni enyɔ hwɔ si ɔ, a he mi dɔɔ la. Se nɔ kake ngmelu ɔ, kɛ lɛɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e he mi maa dɔ la?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ba tua ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ma bla kɛ wo e he, nɛ a maa gbe lɛ. Se ke nɔ kake a ba tua ja a, e be nyɛe ma fa e he. Kpa nɛ a tslɔ hɛ si etɛ ɔ, e tsɔ we mla.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: Niheyo ohiatsɛ nɛ le ní ɔ, e hi hluu pe nɔkɔtɔma kuasia nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee, nɛ́ jehanɛ hu e bui ga womi tue.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: I ba bɔni nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a he susumi, nɛ i ba na niheyo ko ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti nɛ ma ba ye matsɛ ɔ se.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Ke o yaa Mawu we ɔ, hyɛ o he nɔ saminya. E hi kaa o ma ya kase ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, pe nɔ́ nɛ o ma ya sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ kuasiahi peeɔ ɔ; ejakaa a li kaa a ngɛ yayami pee.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Ke o maa tu munyu ko ɔ, mo susu he; o he ko sɔ kɛ wo Mawu si. Mawu ɔ, hiɔwe lɛ e ngɛ; moo lɛɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ o ngɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo tu munyu fuu.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Haomi babauu kɛ dekla, aloo nlami basabasa baa; nɛ munyu fuu a kɛ yoɔ kuasia gbi.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Afani nɛ o wui si kulaa, pe kaa o maa wo si, nɛ o be nɔ yee.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Ko ha nɛ mo nitsɛ o nya mi munyu nɛ bu mo fɔ, nɛ o ba ye pɔpu, nɛ o de Mawu we osɔfo ɔ ke o nɔ́ be mi. Mɛni he je lɛ o ma ha nɛ Mawu mi mi nɛ fu mo? Níhi nɛ o gbo a he dengme ɔ, mɛni he je o ma ha nɛ Mawu nɛ kpata a hɛ mi?

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Zugba a he se nami ɔ tsuo ba peeɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́. Jehanɛ se hu, ngmɔ ko ngmɔ ko be nɛ a tsu we tó ngɛ he.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ suɔ sika a, sika tɔɛ lɛ; nɔ nɛ suɔ nɛ e na ní ɔ, ní babauu gbi e nya. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: He nɛ ní babauu ngɛ ɔ, ní yeli hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɛɛ se nami nɛ niatsɛ ɔ naa pɛ ji kaa e le kaa nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ.

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Apaatsɛ ɔ, e ye ní bɔɔ jio, e ye fuu jio, e hwɔɔ mahe bɔ nɛ sa. Se niatsɛ lɛɛ e ní babauu ɔ ha we nɛ e hwɔɔ mahe.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ yayami ko hu nɛ i na ngɛ je ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nihi buaa sika babauu nya, nɛ e ba peeɔ haomi ha mɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, matahu ba poɔ mɛ, nɛ sika a tsuo hɛ mi kpataa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko pa píɛ nɛ a ma si ha a bimɛ.

english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ nɔ ko je e nyɛ muklii mi kɛ ba dɛ gu ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ e maa kpale kɛ ya. Dengme tsuo nɛ e ba gbo ɔ, e be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hɛɛe ngɛ e dɛ kɛ ya.

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Sane nɛ ɔ he wa! Bɔ nɛ nɔ ko ba a, jã e maa kpale kɛ ya. Lɛɛ mɛni se e na mɔ, kaa e ba gbo yaka dengme?

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ wami be ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa diblii mi nyɛɛmi; kɔmɔ yemi, mi mi fumi, nine mi wu jemi, kɛ hiɔ sɔuu.

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i na kaa e hi, nɛ e sa kɛkɛ ji kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ye ní, nɛ e nu ní, nɛ e na bua jɔmi. Wami be bɔɔ nɛ Mawu ha nɔmlɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, dengme tsuo nɛ e gbo ɔ, e ye e mi ngɔɔmi; e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ Mawu ha lɛ sika, ní babauu, he wami, kɛ bua jɔmi ɔ, e na Mawu si; e na bua jɔmi ngɛ dengme nɛ e ngɛ gboe ɔ he. Mawu nike ní ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Mawu haa lɛ bua jɔmi daa he je ɔ, e pa be e he haoe kɛ kane e wami ligbi ɔmɛ hu.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko nɛ i na nɛ hí, nɛ haoɔ nimli ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Mawu ma ha nɔ ko sika, kɛ ní babauu, hɛ mi nyami, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ɔ tsui suɔ. Se e ha we lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ye ngɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ nɔ kpa mohu ma ba ye. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ji yaka dengme gbomi, kɛ he hiami.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko fɔ bimɛ lafa, nɛ e ye jeha babauu, se e yi je mi ngɔɔmi, nɛ jehanɛ se hu, benɛ e gbo ɔ, a pu we lɛ bɔ nɛ sa a, lɛɛ afani bi nɛ gbo loko a fɔ lɛ ngɛ jamɛatsɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: E nɛ́ pu hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko hu e li. Se e ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: kulaa pe nɔ nɛ ye jeha akpe enyɔ, se je mi ngɔɔmi lɛɛ e yi eko ɔ. Mɛ tsuo pi he kake ɔ ko nɛ a yaa lo?

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Dengme tsuo nɛ nɔmlɔ ngɛ gboe ɔ, e nya mi ngma kɛkɛ he lɛ e ngɛ gboe ngɛ. Se kɛ̃, e tɔɛ gblegbleegble.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Mɛni ní lelɔ kɛ pe kuasia? Ohiatsɛ nɛ le e he nɔ hyɛmi ngɛ je mi ɔ, mɛni se lɛ e naa?

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ba a, a de to momo. Wɔ tsuo wa le kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ he wa pe lɛ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ nɔɛ kunɔ.

english_verse: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ le nɔ́ nɛ hi ha nɔmlɔ ngɛ e wami be bɔɔ nɛ ɔ mi? Nɔmlɔ wami pi nɔ́ ko kulaa; e ngɛ kaa nini nɛ bee kɛ yaa. Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de nɔ ko nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ je ɔ mi ngɛ e gbenɔ se?

english_verse: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.
translation_verse: Biɛ kpakpa hi pe nu je via nɛ he jua wa. Ligbi nɛ o gbo ɔ hi pe ligbi nɛ a fɔ mo.

english_verse: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.
translation_verse: Kɔmɔ yemi hi pe muɔmi. Ke o hɛ mi pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ ɔ, o leɔ ní.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: E hi kaa ní lelɔ ma ka o hɛ mi, pe kaa kuasia ma je o yi.

english_verse: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.
translation_verse: Ke kuasia ngɛ muɔe ɔ, e ngɛ kaa mio nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ la mi. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Corruption makes fools of sensible people, and bribes can ruin you.
translation_verse: Amimi yemi haa ní lelɔ peeɔ kuasia, nɛ nyɔ mi ní hemi puɛɔ nɔ je mi bami.

english_verse: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.
translation_verse: Nyagbe hi pe sisije. Tsui si tomi hi pe he nɔ womi.

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Hyɛ nɛ o mi mi ko fu mlamlaamla, ejakaa kuasia lɛ ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ toɔ e tsui mi.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: Ko bi ke, “Mɛni he je blema ngɔɔ pe mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ?” Tsa pi nile gbi ji lɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you just like money; knowledge with good sense will lead you to life.
translation_verse: kaa bɔ nɛ sika ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nile faa nɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ sika faa nɔ he ɔ. Nile haa nɛ nɔ yeɔ e he.

english_verse: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?
translation_verse: Hyɛ Mawu nine nya ní tsumi! Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ha nɛ e kpɛ̃ ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa pee lɛ nɛ e da?

english_verse: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next. Some of Life's Questions
translation_verse: Ke níhi a mi hi ha mo ɔ, nya. Ke haomi ba hu, kai kaa Mawu lɛ pee bua jɔmi ɔ kɛ haomi ɔ tsuo, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ ko le nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: Ye wami be ɔ he be se nami ko lɛɛ, se níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, i le. E pɔɔ mi bami kaa dalɔ hɛ mi kpataa, be mi nɛ yayami peelɔ mohu wami se kɛɔ.

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o yi mi ko wa tsɔ, nɛ o ko je kuasia hulɔ. Mɛni he je o ma gbo nɛ́ o be sui lolo ɔ?

english_verse: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.
translation_verse: E hi kaa o maa pɛtɛ ga womi nɛ ɔ he nɛ o be he ngmɛɛe. Nɔ nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ɔ, e maa ye manye kɛ̃.

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Nile woɔ ní lelɔ he wami kulaa pe ma nɔ yeli nyɔngma nɛ ngɛ ma ko mi.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Koo bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nihi ngɛ dee ɔ tue, nɛ́ o ko ba nu kaa o tsɔlɔ ngɛ mo gbiɛe.

english_verse: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.
translation_verse: Nile lɛ i kɛ kpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo si. I to ye yi mi kaa ma kase ní, nɛ ma le ní. Se e ya yɛ nya.

english_verse: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i ba bɔni ní kasemi, kɛ níhi a si kpami. I pee ye yi mi kaa ma na nile, nɛ ma na ye ní bimi ɔmɛ a heto. Nɔ́ nɛ i na ji kaa yi mi wami ɔ, e ji kuasia jemi, nɛ biɛmi hu godo.

english_verse: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko hu nɛ i na nɛ dooɔ pe gbenɔ ji yo nɛ e tsui mi ngɛ kaa klama nɛ a tsɔ, aloo ya nɛ a wo nɛ a kɛ maa du nɔ. E nine ngɛ kaa kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ a kɛ maa wo nɔ. Nyumu nɛ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ maa je e dɛ mi. Se yayami peelɔ lɛɛ yo ɔ nine maa su e nɔ.

english_verse: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i na kɛkɛ ji kaa Mawu bɔ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ e hi si saminya, se nɔmlɔ ba kase gɔdɔgɔdɔ si himi.

english_verse: Who is smart enough to explain everything? Wisdom makes you cheerful and gives you a smile. Obey the King
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ kɛ ní lelɔ sɔ? Mɛnɔ lɛ le níhi a sisi tsɔɔmi kɛ lɛ sɔ? Nile haa nɛ nɔ muɔɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ e hɛ mi kɛ haa nɔ. Bu matsɛ tue

english_verse: If you promised God that you would be loyal to the king, I advise you to keep that promise.
translation_verse: Ye matsɛ mlaa a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o ka Mawu kita ke o maa pee ɔ.

english_verse: Don't quickly oppose the king or argue when he has already made up his mind.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ma nyɛ maa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e mi mi fu ɔ, jee e hɛ mi esɔ!

english_verse: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, “Why are you doing this?”
translation_verse: Ke matsɛ tu munyu ɔ, he wami ngɛ se. Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de matsɛ ke, “Mɛni lɛ o pee nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, haomi bɛ e nɔ. Nɔ nɛ le ní ɔ, e le be nɛ sa, kɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ e maa gu kɛ bu tue.

english_verse: We cannot control the wind or determine the day of our death. There is no escape in time of war, and no one can hide behind evil.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa be he wami ngɛ e mumi nɔ; nɛ e be he wami ngɛ e gbenɔ be nɔ. Gbenɔ ngɛ kaa ta; nɔ ko be nyɛe maa tu nya fo. Yi wu tso ní peemi be nyɛe ma he nɔ ko yi wami. Yayami peeli kɛ dali

english_verse: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another? Who Can Understand the Ways of God?
translation_verse: I na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, be mi nɛ i ngɛ níhi nɛ nimli adesahi peeɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a he susue. Ni komɛ ngɔɔ blɔ nya nɛ a na a kɛ yeɔ a nyɛmimɛ awi.

english_verse: When we see criminals commit crime after crime without being punished, it makes us want to start a life of crime.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je lɛ nihi a he sɔɔ kɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ? Ejakaa a gbla we a tue ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

english_verse: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper,
translation_verse: Yayami peelɔ peeɔ yayami si lafa, nɛ e gbo we. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i le kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye anɔkuale mi ɔ, e hii ha mɛ.

english_verse: but no one who sins and rejects God will prosper or live very long.
translation_verse: Yayami peeli lɛɛ e be hie ha mɛ gblegbleegble. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a wami ngɛ kaa nini. A se kɛ we ngɛ je mi, ejakaa a yi Mawu gbeye.

english_verse: There is something else that doesn't make sense to me. Good citizens are treated as criminals, while criminals are honored as though they were good citizens.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ yayami ko nɛ yaa nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Be komɛ ɔ, a ngɔɔ yayami peeli a tue gblami kɛ haa dali, nɛ a kɛ dali a ní kpakpahi a he hiɔwo mohu haa yayami peeli. I ngɛ dee ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu dɛ blɔ.

english_verse: So I think we should get as much out of life as we possibly can. There is nothing better than to enjoy our food and drink and have a good time. Then we can make it through this troublesome life that God has given us here on earth.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na kaa e sa kaa nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ na bua jɔmi; ejakaa nɔ́ ko pa be je nɛ ɔ mi ha lɛ, pe kaa e ye ní, nɛ e nu ní, nɛ e na bua jɔmi. Ke nɔmlɔ ngɛ dengme gboe ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, ngɛ wami bɔɔ nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e ma nyɛ maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I saw everything God does, and I realized no one can really understand what happens. We may be very wise, but no matter how much we try or how much we claim to know, we cannot understand it all.
translation_verse: Se ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ngɛ tsue ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ lɛɛ nɔmlɔ be nya nae gblegbleegble. Ke o gbo dengme hluu po, o be nya nae. Ní leli nɛ e peeɔ mɛ kaa mɛɛ a le ɔ, mɛ po a nɛ nya.

english_verse: I thought about these things. Then I understood that God has power over everyone, even those who are wise and live right. Anything can happen to any one of us, and so we never know if life will be good or bad.
translation_verse: I ba susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he saminya, nɛ i na kaa níhi nɛ dali, kɛ ní leli peeɔ ɔ, Mawu le he nɔ́ ko; suɔmi kɛ nyɛmi po, nɔmlɔ adesa be a nɔ he wami. Nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi kɛ ma.

english_verse: But exactly the same thing will finally happen to all of us, whether we live right and respect God or sin and don't respect God. Yes, the same thing will happen if we offer sacrifices to God or if we don't, if we keep our promises or are afraid to make them.
translation_verse: Sane nɛ maa ba nɔ kake nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ lɛ maa ba nɔ kpa hu nɔ; dalɔ jio, yayami peelɔ jio; nɔmlɔ kpakpa jio, nɔmlɔ yayami jio; nɔ nɛ he tsɔ jio, nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we jio; nɔ nɛ sãã bɔ jio, nɔ nɛ sɛ̃ bɔ jio; nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nɔ kake nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ lɛ maa ba nɔ kpa hu nɔ. Nɔmlɔ kpakpa kɛ yayami peelɔ ɔ, slɔɔto be a kpɛti; kita kalɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ sume kaa e ma ka kita hu, jã nɔuu.

english_verse: It's terribly unfair for the same thing to happen to each of us. We are mean and foolish while we live, and then we die.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ dɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a kpɛti kake ji kaa haomi baa nihi tsuo a nɔ fiee nɛ slɔɔto be mi; dali jio, yayami peeli jio. Daa nɛ ɔ, yayami kɛ godo hyi nimli adesahi a tsui mi ngɛ je ɔ mi. Kɛkɛ a gbo tlukaa.

english_verse: As long as we are alive, we still have hope, just as a live dog is better off than a dead lion.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ piɛɔ hɛ kali a he ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha lɛ. Ejakaa gbe hɛ ngmengmle hi pe jata gbogboe.

english_verse: We know we will die, but the dead don't know a thing. Nothing good will happen to them—they are gone and forgotten.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ le kaa a ma ba gbo; ni gbogboe ɔmɛ lɛɛ a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. Hiɔwo kpa ko hu a be; ejakaa nihi a hɛ je a nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Their loves, their hates, and their jealous feelings have all disappeared with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens on this earth.
translation_verse: A gbo kɛ a suɔmi, ninyɛ, kɛ hɛkɔ ɔ tsuo. Níhi nɛ yaa nɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a pa be mi nɛ a peeɔ hu.

english_verse: So be happy and enjoy eating and drinking! God decided long ago that this is what you should do.
translation_verse: Yaa nɛ o ya ye ní, nɛ o na bua jɔmi. Yaa nu wai, nɛ o tsui nɛ nɔ o mi; o ní tsumi ɔ sa Mawu hɛ mi momo.

english_verse: Dress up, comb your hair, and look your best.
translation_verse: Wo tade hiɔ be tsuaa be, nɛ o ko ha nɛ nu nɛ ta o yi mi.

english_verse: Life is short, and you love your wife, so enjoy being with her. This is what you are supposed to do as you struggle through life on this earth.
translation_verse: Be bɔɔ nɛ Mawu ha mo ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, o kɛ o yo nɛ o suɔ lɛ saminya a, nyɛɛ ye e mi ngɔɔmi. Daa ligbi nɛ nɔ́ ko be mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye mle. Ejakaa dengme tsuo nɛ o ngɛ gboe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ o ma na kɛ je mi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Work hard at whatever you do. You will soon go to the world of the dead, where no one works or thinks or reasons or even knows anything.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ, tsu kɛ o he wami tsuo. Ejakaa gbeje, he nɛ o maa ya hwɔɔ se ɔ, ní tsumi, loo yi mi susumi, loo nile, loo ga be lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Here is something else I have learned: The fastest runners and the greatest heroes don't always win races and battles. Wisdom, intelligence, and skill don't always make you healthy, rich, or popular. We each have our own share of misfortune.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ kake hu nɛ i na ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ji: tsa pi nihi nɛ le fo tumi wawɛɛ ji nihi nɛ yeɔ kekleekle blɔ he be tsuaa be; pi katsɛmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ kunimi ngɛ ta mi daa. Pi ní leli tsuo a dɛ nɛ niye ní ngɛ; pi juɛmitsɛmɛ tsuo ji matsɛmɛ, nɛ gali hu, pi mɛ tsuo nɛ a hɛ mi baa nyami. Haomi baa mɛ tsuo a nɔ fiee.

english_verse: None of us know when we might fall victim to a sudden disaster and find ourselves like fish in a net or birds in a trap. Better To Be Wise than Foolish
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa li e be. Be yayami ba naa nɔ tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ lo duɔ ya, aloo kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ duɔ klama a. Nile kɛ kuasia jemi

english_verse: Once I saw what people really think of wisdom, and it made an impression on me.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko hu nɛ i na ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a buu nile ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: It happened when a powerful ruler surrounded and attacked a small city where only a few people lived. The enemy army was getting ready to break through the city walls.
translation_verse: Ma wayoo ko hi si kɛ e mi nimli bɔɔ pɛ. Be ko ɔ, matsɛ nguaa ko ba tua ma a. E sa ma a yi, nɛ e fia kpoku kɛ bɔle ma a.

english_verse: So I decided that wisdom is better than strength. Yet if you are poor, no one pays any attention to you, no matter how smart you are.
translation_verse: I deɔ daa ke nile hi pe he wami. Se nɔ ko bui ohiatsɛ ní lelɔ; e nya mi munyu po a bui tue.

english_verse: Words of wisdom spoken softly make much more sense than the shouts of a ruler to a crowd of fools.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ munyu blɛuu ngɔɔ ngɛ tue mi pe ngmlaa nɛ nɔ yelɔ ko kpaa ngɛ kuasiahi a kpɛti.

english_verse: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons, yet one mistake can destroy all the good you have done.
translation_verse: Nile hi pe ta hwumi níhi. Se yayami peelɔ kake kpataa ní kpakpahi babauu a hɛ mi.

english_verse: A few dead flies in perfume make all of it stink, and a little foolishness outweighs a lot of wisdom.
translation_verse: Anunu gbogboe haa nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via jeɔ fu. Jã kɛ̃ kuasia jemi bɔɔ gbeɔ nile kɛ hɛ mi nyami a he guɛ.

english_verse: Sensible thoughts lead you to do right; foolish thoughts lead you to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ suɔmi nya ní ji kaa e pee kpakpa daa; se kuasia lɛɛ e suɔ kaa e pee nɔ́ yayami.

english_verse: Fools show their stupidity by the way they live; it's easy to see they have no sense.
translation_verse: Ke kuasia ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ɔ, e ní peepee yeɔ e he odase kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kaa kuasia ji lɛ.

english_verse: Don't give up your job when your boss gets angry. If you stay calm, you'll be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ke o nɔ yelɔ mi mi fu mo ɔ, koo je o ní tsumi he ɔ; he si bami gbeɔ sanehi nɛ he wa a nya la.

english_verse: They honor fools, but dishonor the rich;
translation_verse: a haa kuasiahi blɔ he nguanguahi, nɛ niatsɛmɛ mohu hii sisi je.

english_verse: they let slaves ride on horses, but force slave owners to walk.
translation_verse: I naa tsɔli ngɛ okpɔngɔhi a nɔ, be mi nɛ ganɔhi mohu ngɛ zugba nyɛɛe.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you might fall in; if you break down a wall, a snake might bite you.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tsuaa muɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ maa nɔ mi; nɔ nɛ gbaa piɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ sinɔ maa kɔ.

english_verse: You could even get hurt by chiseling a stone or chopping a log.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ywiaa tɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ tɛ plaa; nɔ nɛ gbaa lɛ́ ɔ, lɛ nɛ lɛ́ plaa.

english_verse: If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do.
translation_verse: Ke o dade nya gbo, nɛ o duɔ we nya a, ja o kɛ o he wami tsu ní wawɛɛ. Se nile haa nɛ nɔ toɔ ga kpakpa.

english_verse: The power to charm a snake does you no good if it bites you anyway.
translation_verse: Ke sinɔ maa kɔ kunya yelɔ kekle loko e maa wo sinɔ ɔ hɛ mi kunya a, mɛni e ma na?

english_verse: If you talk sensibly, you will have friends; if you talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ nya mi munyu haa nɛ e hɛ mi baa nyami. Se kuasia kɛ e munyu kpataa lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: Fools begin with nonsense, and their stupid chatter ends with disaster.
translation_verse: E jeɔ sisi kɛ kuasia munyu tumi, nɛ e gbeɔ nya kɛ godo.

english_verse: They never tire of talking, but none of us really know what the future will bring.
translation_verse: Kuasia tuɔ munyu babauu. Nɔ ko nɔ ko li hwɔɔ se sane; nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ wa gbenɔ se ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de?

english_verse: Fools wear themselves out— they don't know enough to find their way home.
translation_verse: Kuasia gboɔ yaka dengme kɛ woɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he pɔtɔ; ejakaa e li blɔ nɛ a guu nɔ kɛ yaa ma mi.

english_verse: A country is in for trouble when its ruler is childish, and its leaders party all day long.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ jokuɛyo ngɛ a nɔ matsɛ yee, nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ yeɔ ní, nɛ a nuɔ ní kpɔtɔɔ daa mɔtu ɔ, musu tloo mɛ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to fix a leaky roof— then the house collapses.
translation_verse: Hejɔtsɛ tsu yi mi kuɔ kɛ woɔ mi, nɛ tsu ɔ dungɔɔ.

english_verse: Eating and drinking make you feel happy, and money can buy everything you need.
translation_verse: A tsɛɔ ní yemi konɛ a fiɛ nɛ a muɔ; dã haa nɔ bua jɔmi, se sika lɛ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.

english_verse: Don't let yourself think about cursing the king; don't curse the rich, not even in secret. A little bird might hear and tell everything.
translation_verse: Koo gbiɛ matsɛ ngɛ o yi mi po; niatsɛ hu koo gbiɛ lɛ ngɛ o se tsu mi. Lohwe pɛlitsɛ ko maa ngɔ o munyu ɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya de.

english_verse: Share what you have with seven or eight others, because you never know when disaster may strike.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ o ní kpakpahi ngɔ to hehi munomuno; ejakaa o li matahu ko nɛ ma ba po mo ngɛ je mi.

english_verse: If you worry about the weather and don't plant seeds, you won't harvest a crop.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ slaa kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, e du we ní; nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ bɔku mi ɔ, e kpa we ní.

english_verse: No one can explain how a baby breathes before it is born. So how can anyone explain what God does? After all, God created everything.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ Mawu pee ɔ, o juɛmi su a he lo? Ke o juɛmi sui a he ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ o maa pee kɛ le bɔ nɛ wami he jeɔ sisi ngɛ yohɔyo mi mi kɛɛ?

english_verse: Plant your seeds early in the morning and keep working in the field until dark. Who knows? Your work might pay off, and your seeds might produce. Youth and Old Age
translation_verse: Du ní mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ tsuo. O li a kpɛti nɔ́ nɛ maa ba; mɔtu nɔ́ ɔ jio, gbɔkuɛ nɔ́ ɔ jio. Enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa hi jio, o li.

english_verse: Nothing on earth is more beautiful than the morning sun.
translation_verse: La ngɔɔ; ke hɛngmɛ na pu la a, e suɔ.

english_verse: Be cheerful and enjoy life while you are young! Do what you want and find pleasure in what you see. But don't forget that God will judge you for everything you do.
translation_verse: Nihewi, nyɛ fiɛ nyɛ yi nɔ ngɛ nyɛ nihe mi; nyɛɛ pee nyɛ suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi. Se nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Mawu maa kojo nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he.

english_verse: Rid yourself of all worry and pain, because the wonderful moments of youth quickly disappear.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye tsui, nɛ nyɛ ko hao; ejakaa jokuɛwi a si, kɛ nihe be ɔ tsuo yaka.

english_verse: Keep your Creator in mind while you are young! In years to come, you will be burdened down with troubles and say, “I don't enjoy life anymore.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo kai o bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ o nihe mi, be mi nɛ ligbi yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ jeha yayami ɔmɛ na we nɛ a ba, nɛ o ma de ke, “I be bua jɔmi ngɛ je mi.”

english_verse: Someday the light of the sun and the moon and the stars will all seem dim to you. Rain clouds will remain over your head.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi maa pee sulii ngɛ o hɛngmɛ mi. Daa nɛ ɔ, bɔku ɔmɛ maa pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ hiɔmi yaa nɛ.

english_verse: The noisy grinding of grain and the voices of singers will be shut out by your deaf ears, but even the song of a bird will keep you awake.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, huhui nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ blɔ mi ɔ, o tue be nue hu. Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ tae ɔ, o tsitsa be pɛe hu. Ke la ngɛ pɛe ɔ, pe o maa nu fã kɛ fã kɛkɛ. Makɛ, loko kungwɔ ma kpa nɔ́ ɔ, moo o te si momo.

english_verse: You will be afraid to climb up a hill or walk down a road. Your hair will turn as white as almond blossoms. You will feel lifeless and drag along like an old grasshopper. We each go to our eternal home, and the streets here are filled with those who mourn.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ kuɔmi maa wo o he gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛmi maa pee mo ahuto. O yi bwɔmi ma hiɛ futafuta. O maa nyɛɛ blɛuu blɛuu kaa angmɛɛtɛ nɛ ngɛ si sãe, nɛ o he mi akɔnɔ tsuo se maa po. Wa yaa wa nyagbe he jɔɔmi he ɔ, nɛ a maa wo yana ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: The silver cord snaps, the golden bowl breaks; the water pitcher is smashed, and the pulley at the well is shattered.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, sika hiɔ kpa a ma tsɔ. Sika tsu kplu ɔ maa ywia. Buɛ ɔ maa ywia ngɛ pa a nya, nɛ nyu yɛmi klama a maa ku ngɛ vu ɔ he.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense. Respect and Obey God
translation_verse: Ye juɛmi deɔ mi ke wami nɛ ɔ, se nami ko be he; lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka. Nyagbe

english_verse: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.
translation_verse: Fiɛlɔ ɔ, pi kaa e juɛmi mi kuɔ kɛkɛ; e tsɔɔ ma a nile hulɔ. E bua abɛhi a nya. E kase abɛ ɔmɛ saminya, nɛ e hla a mi.

english_verse: Then I tried to explain these things in the best and most accurate way.
translation_verse: E bɔ mɔde kaa e maa ngma munyuhi nɛ ngɔɔ. Nɛ níhi nɛ e ngma a, anɔkuale sɔuu.

english_verse: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.
translation_verse: Ye bi, ha nɛ ma wo mo ga nɛ ɔ hulɔ. Womi ngmami be nyagbe; ni kasemi fuu haa nɛ pɔ tɔɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ.

english_verse: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ma de kɛkɛ ji kaa moo ye Mawu gbeye, nɛ o ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Ní tsumi nɛ ngɛ kɛ ha nimli adesahi tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Mawu maa kojo wɔ ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ wa pee ɔ a he. Níhi nɛ wa pee ngɛ laami mi po, e maa kojo wɔ ngɛ a he; kpakpa jio, yaya jio.

english_verse: Kiss me tenderly! Your love is better than wine,
translation_verse: Mo fiɔ ye nya he si abɔ nɛ o suɔ. O suɔmi ɔ ngɔɔ pe wai dɔkɔdɔkɔ.

english_verse: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *
translation_verse: O he ngɛ via jee kaa nɔ́ ko; ke a wo o biɛ ta pɛ a kaiɔ o he via a; lɔ ɔ he nɛ yi ɔmɛ tsuo suɔ mo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Hurry, my king! Let's hurry. Take me to your home. The Young Women Speak: We are happy for you! And we praise your love even more than wine. She Speaks: Young women of Jerusalem, it is only right that you should adore him.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ mi kɛ ho esɔ. Ye matsɛ, ngɔɔ mi kɛ ya o tsu ɔ mi. I ngɔ ye he kɛ ha mo. Wa bua maa jɔ wa he saminya. O suɔmi ɔ ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ pe wai po. E be nyakpɛ kaa yi ɔmɛ tsuo suɔ mo!

english_verse: Don't stare at me just because the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me work in the vineyard, and so I neglected my complexion.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko hyɛ mi maa ngɛ yumi nɛ i yu ɔ he; pu la nɛ pee ye he womi ja. Ye nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ a mi mi fu mi, nɛ a ha i ya tsu ní ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi. I na we deka ko kulaa kɛ ha ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ.

english_verse: My darling, I love you! Where do you feed your sheep and let them rest at noon? Don't let the other shepherds think badly of me. I'm not one of those women who shamelessly follow after shepherds. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Ye suɔlɔ, mo de mi. Jije o ma tsɔ̃ o to ɔmɛ kɛ ya nɛ a ya ye ní? Ke pu nya wa a, jije o maa jɔɔ o he ngɛ? Mɛni he je nɛ ma hi si kpae kɛ hi mo hlae ngɛ to hyɛli kpa amɛ a to ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ? Nyumu ɔ

english_verse: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.
translation_verse: Mo nɛ o he ngɛ fɛu pe yihi tsuo, o li lejɛ ɔ? Yaa nɛ o ya nyɛɛ to ɔmɛ a se. Yaa ha o to ɔmɛ ní ngɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a kasa nya.

english_verse: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.
translation_verse: Mo, ye afɛu yo nɛ i suɔ, ma ngɔ mo kɛ to okpɔngɔ ku nɛ gblaa Farao ɔ zugba lɛ he.

english_verse: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.
translation_verse: O yi bwɔmi ngɛ fɛu ngɛ o tsitsa he; bwɔmi ɔ kplaa si ngɛ o kuɛ he kaa june.

english_verse: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa maa pee sika tsu ga kɛ e he sika hiɔ níhi ha mo. Yo ɔ

english_verse: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.
translation_verse: Ye matsɛ ɔ kpasa si ngɛ e we akpasa mi, nɛ ye nu kɛ e he via a ngɛ via jee liliili ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: My darling, you are perfume between my breasts;
translation_verse: Ye suɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ ye gugue mi; e he ngɛ via jee kaa mimɛ.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Ye afɛu yo nɛ i suɔ, o he ngɛ fɛu. O hɛngmɛ ngɛ dɔkɔɔ kaa lahuɛ hɛngmɛ! Yo ɔ

english_verse: My love, you are handsome, truly handsome— the fresh green grass will be our wedding bed
translation_verse: Ye suɔlɔ kpakpa pe kulaa, hyɛ bɔ nɛ o he ngɛ bua jɔmi ha! Nga mumu nɔ wa maa hwɔ,

english_verse: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Sharon pú mi mɔmɔ kɛkɛ ji mi; kɔ̃ mi mɔmɔ ko kɛkɛ ji mi. Nyumu ɔ

english_verse: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Ye afɛu yo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya, bɔ nɛ nga nɔ mɔmɔ ngɛ ngɛ miohi a mi ɔ, jã o ngɛ kɛ ha mi ngɛ yihi tsuo a kpɛti. Yo ɔ

english_verse: And you, my love, are an apple tree among trees of the forest. Your shade brought me pleasure; your fruit was sweet.
translation_verse: Ke a ngɔ ye suɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ to nyumu kpa amɛ a he ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tso nɛ yiblii ngɔɔ saminya ngɛ pú mi tsohi a kpɛti. I suɔ nɛ ma hi e hɔ̃ ɔ mi; e yiblii ɔ ngɔɔ ye nya.

english_verse: You led me to your banquet room and showered me with love.
translation_verse: E kɛ mi ba e asa a nɔ niye he ɔ; lejɛ ɔ nɛ e je e suɔmi kpo ngɛ kɛ ha mi.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: Ye yi fɔɔ si ngɛ e muɔ kɔni nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ e hiɔ nine kɛ fua mi.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles never to awaken love before it is ready. Winter Is Past She Speaks:
translation_verse: Yerusalem yihi, nyɛɛ wo mi si; nyɛ ka mi kita kaa nyɛ na odabɔ nɛ he sɔɔ, kɛ batslɔɔ kaa nyɛ be ye suɔlɔ ɔ tsɛe kɛ yaa si be nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa te si. La enyɔne Yo ɔ

english_verse: I hear the voice of the one I love, as he comes leaping over mountains and hills
translation_verse: I nu ye suɔlɔ ɔ gbi. E ngɛ hiie ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma; e ngɛ fo tue ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma ye ngɔ.

english_verse: and speaking to me. He Speaks: My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Ye suɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ mi nɔ́ ko dee. Nyumu ɔ Ye suɔlɔ, ye afɛu yo; ba nɛ waa ho koo!

english_verse: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;
translation_verse: Fĩɛ be ɔ be; hiɔmi hu kpa nɛmi.

english_verse: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.
translation_verse: Mɔmɔ ɔmɛ gba tii ngɛ nga a nɔ. Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ a lami be ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Lahuɛhi a la he wa ngɛ nue ngɛ pú ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Ngmɔkɔ bɔni fumi. Kɔɔhiɔ mi hyi kɛ wai yiblii he via. Ye suɔlɔ, ye afɛu yo; ba nɛ waa ho koo!

english_verse: You are my dove hiding among the rocks on the side of a cliff. Let me see how lovely you are! Let me hear the sound of your melodious voice.
translation_verse: O ngɛ kaa lahuɛ nɛ ya laa e he ngɛ tɛ sa puɔ mi. Ha nɛ ma na o hɛ mi. O he ngɛ fɛu loo. Ha nɛ ma nu o gbi. O gbi ngɔɔ loo!

english_verse: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ nuu kɔkɔbo ɔmɛ ha wɔ. Nyɛɛ nuu kɔkɔbo tsɔwi ɔmɛ nɛ puɛɔ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ ɔ; ejakaa wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ gba mɔmɔ. Yo ɔ

english_verse: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Nyɔ mi, ke i hwɔ si ɔ, i nlaa ye suɔlɔ ɔ. I hla kaa ma na lɛ, se i nɛ́ lɛ.

english_verse: So I searched through the town for the one I love. I looked on every street, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: I hla lɛ kɛ ya kpa ma a mi ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ nane blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ. I hla ye suɔlɔ ɔ hluu, se i nɛ́ lɛ.

english_verse: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, “Have you seen the one I love so much?”
translation_verse: Ma a mi buli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ si poe ngɛ ma a mi ɔ kɛ mi ba kpe. I bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛ na ye suɔlɔ ɔ ha mi lo?”

english_verse: Right after that, I found him. I held him and would not let go until I had taken him to the home of my mother.
translation_verse: Benɛ i be a he bɔɔ pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ i na lɛ, nɛ i fua lɛ atuu; nɛ i ngmɛɛ we e he kɛ ya si i kɛ lɛ ya su ye we ɔ mi, kɛ ya sɛ tsu mi he nɛ a fɔ mi ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles, never to awaken love before it is ready. The Groom and the Wedding Party Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Yerusalem yihi, nyɛɛ wo mi si! Nyɛ ka mi kita kaa nyɛ na odabɔ nɛ he sɔɔ, kɛ batslɔɔ kaa nyɛ be ye suɔlɔ ɔ tsɛe kɛ yaa si be nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa te si. La etɛne Nyumu ɔ

english_verse: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.
translation_verse: Mɛni je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ma nɛ ɔ? Mɛni lɛ ma kaa la su ku kusuu nɛ ɔ? Mɛni ji nɛ ɔ kɛ e he via kaa tsopa kɛ e he via, aloo mimɛ, aloo jua yeli a tsopa kpa komɛ nɛ jee via a?

english_verse: Each of them wears a sword. They are experts at fighting, even in the dark.
translation_verse: A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ mia kɛ klaate nɛ e kɛ ma fa e he ke a ma ba tua mɛ nyɔ mi.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: Ye afɛu yo; o he ngɛ fɛu saminya! Hyɛ bɔ nɛ o hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kpɛe kɛ suɔmi ngɛ o hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ se. O yi bwɔmi ngɛ doe ngɛ o yi nɔ kaa to akpakpo kuu nɛ a ngɛ tuue ngɛ Gilead yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Your neck is more graceful than the tower of David, decorated with thousands of warriors' shields.
translation_verse: O kuɛ ngɛ legelege, nɛ e ngɛ tlotlootlo; kuɛ ní nɛ kplaa si ngɛ he ɔ ngɛ kaa David mɔ ɔ nɛ tsɛ̃i akpe kplaa si ngɛ he kɛ kpe.

english_verse: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.
translation_verse: O nyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa batslɔhi, loo odabɔ hawi enyɔ nɛ a ngɛ ní yee ngɛ nga nɔ mɔmɔhi a mi.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely in every way.
translation_verse: Ye afɛu yo, o he ngɛ fɛu tsɔ; o he ngɛ fɛu kɛ pi si!

english_verse: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.
translation_verse: Ye we ayɛflo, ba nɛ wa kple si kɛ je Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; ha nɛ waa je Lebanon; waa je Amana yo ɔ yi mi; waa je Senir kɛ Hermon yo ɔmɛ a yi mi he nɛ jatahi kɛ ngatsɛhi hii ɔ.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmiyo, ye we ayɛflo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya; hɛngmɛ nɛ o kɛ hyɛ mi, kɛ o kuɛ ní nɛ o wo nɛ ɔ gbe ye tsui kulaa.

english_verse: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ye we ayɛflo nɛ i suɔ, ke a fiɔ o nya he ɔ, e ngɔɔ kaa hwo, o lilɛ ngɛ kaa nyɔ nyu kɛ hwo ha mi; o bo mi he via kaa Lebanon he via.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmiyo, ye we ayɛflo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya, o ngɛ kaa abɔɔ nɛ a ngmɛ nya; o ngɛ kaa nyu vu nɛ a sɔu nya.

english_verse: You are a spring in the garden, a fountain of pure water, and a refreshing stream from Mount Lebanon. She Speaks:
translation_verse: A bɔɔ ɔ naa nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami kɛ jee vuhi, pahi nɛ ngɛ bee, kɛ pa wawi nɛ jee Lebanon yo ɔ nɔ ɔ a mi. Yo ɔ

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmiyo; ye we ayɛflo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya, i ba ye we abɔɔ ɔ mi. I ngɛ ye tsopa kɛ e he via, kɛ mimɛ nya buae. I ngɛ ye hwo kɛ hwo gbaku yee. I ngɛ ye wai kɛ nyɔ nyu nue. Yi ɔmɛ Huɛmɛ, nyɛɛ ye ní nɛ nyɛɛ nu ní. Nyɛ suɔmi ɔ nɛ de nyɛ kaa dã! La eywiɛne Yo ɔ

english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”
translation_verse: I hwɔ mahe, se i hwɔ we mahe kɛ ye tue. Tlukaa a, ye suɔlɔ ɔ ba si sinya a. Nyumu ɔ Agoo, ye tsui kpa, bli sinya a ha mi. Ye nyɛmiyo, ye lahuɛ! Bɔ́ nɛɛ mi, nɛ ye yi, kɛ ye yi bwɔmi tsuo pɔ. Yo ɔ

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: I jé ye tade momo. Mɛni he je ma kpale wo tade? I fɔ ye nane he. Mɛni he je ma wo ye nane he mu ekohu?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: Ye suɔlɔ ɔ kɛ e nine pɛtɛ sinya a he, kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ́ ko pee mi ngɛ ye tsui mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ e su ye he haa.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: I bli sinya a ha ye suɔlɔ ɔ, se e je momo. Ao, nɛ́ i ko nu e gbi kɛkɛ ɔ! I hla lɛ, se i nɛ́ lɛ. I tsɛ lɛ, se i nui e he.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Buli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ si poe ngɛ ma a mi ɔ ba na mi; a fia mi nɔ́, a plaa mi; nɛ buli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ kpɔ ye hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ kɛ je.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Yerusalem yihi, nyɛ ka mi kita kaa ke nyɛ na ye suɔlɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma de lɛ ke e he suɔmi ngɛ mi gbee. Yi ɔmɛ

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel? She Speaks:
translation_verse: Mo nɛ o he ngɛ fɛu pe yihi tsuo, mɛni o suɔlɔ ɔ kɛ pe suɔli kpahi? Mɛni ngɛ nyakpɛ tsɔ ngɛ o suɔlɔ ɔ he, nɛ o deɔ wɔ ke wa ka mo kita a? Yo ɔ

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
