translation_verse: Gbogbo ji mi, ye nyɔ ɔmɛ ji mɔhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ. Ye suɔlɔ ɔ le kaa ye bua jɔɔ ye he, nɛ ye tue mi jɔɔ mi ngɛ e ngɔ. Nyumu ɔ

english_verse: My vineyard is mine alone! Solomon can keep his silver and the others can keep their share of the profits. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Se imi nitsɛ ye wai abɔɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke a kpa ní ɔ, mo Salomo, o ma na sika hiɔ yi akpe, nɛ apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma na lafa enyɔɔnyɔ.

english_verse: You are in the garden with friends all around. Let me hear your voice! She Speaks:
translation_verse: Ye suɔlɔ, ha nɛ ma nu o gbi ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi koo! Ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mo tue bue! Yo ɔ

english_verse: I am Isaiah, the son of Amoz. And this is the message that I was given about Judah and Jerusalem when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah: A Guilty Nation
translation_verse: Sɛ gbihi nɛ kɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem a he nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Mawu je nina nɛ ɔmɛ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Yesaya, Amoz bi ɔ, ngɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ, Uzia, Yotam, Ahaz, kɛ Hezekia a yi nɔ. Mawu ka e ma a hɛ mi

english_verse: The Lord has said, “Listen, heaven and earth! The children I raised have turned against me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Hiɔwe kɛ zugba, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue! Jokuɛwi nɛ i tsɔse nɛ a wa a te si ngɔ si mi.

english_verse: Israel, you are a sinful nation loaded down with guilt. You are wicked and corrupt and have turned from the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Musu tloo nyɛ, nyɛ ma nɛ yayami sɔuu nyɛ peeɔ; nyɛ puɛ kulaa kɛ yayami peemi! Nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ pee tlomi ha nyɛ! Nyɛ kua Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ je e he kɛ ho se ya.

english_verse: Why be punished more? Why not give up your sin? Your head is badly bruised, and you are weak all over.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ atuã tsɔe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ? Nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbla nyɛ tue fuu lo? Israel, o yi tsuo pee pa, nɛ o tsui gbɔjɔ.

english_verse: From your head to your toes there isn't a healthy spot. Bruises, cuts, and open sores go without care or oil to ease the pain. A Country in Ruins
translation_verse: Kɛ je o yi mi kɛ ya su o nane si ɔ, pa sɔuu; he ko he ko be saminya. He komɛ kpɔ, he komɛ pee pa, pa momohi kɛ pa hehi. Pa amɛ ɔ, a tsɔɔ we; a fi we a nɔ, nɛ a to we a nɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Your country lies in ruins; your towns are in ashes. Foreigners and strangers take and destroy your land while you watch.
translation_verse: Nyɛ zugba a hɛ mi kpata; a sã nyɛ ma amɛ. Nibwɔhi ngɛ nyɛ zugba a ngɔe ngɛ nyɛ dɛ pani nya, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi kpatae.

english_verse: Zion would have disappeared like Sodom and Gomorrah, if the Lord All-Powerful had not let a few of its people survive. Justice, Not Sacrifices
translation_verse: Kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ha we nɛ wa ti ni komɛ a yi nɛ na wami ɔ, wa ko pee kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora.

english_verse: You are no better than the leaders and people of Sodom and Gomorrah! So listen to the Lord God:
translation_verse: Yerusalem, nyɛ nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora bi pɛ. Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue saminya.

english_verse: “Your sacrifices mean nothing to me. I am sick of your offerings of rams and choice cattle; I don't like the blood of bulls or lambs or goats.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ kɛ ba haa mi ɔ, anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa i suɔ lo? To ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ ba sãã bɔ, kɛ lohwe kpakpa amɛ a zɔ ɔ hiɛ tsɔ ha mi. Na kuhi, kɛ jijɔhi, kɛ akpakpohi a muɔ ba ti mi.

english_verse: “Who asked you to bring all this when you come to worship me? Stay out of my temple!
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ de nyɛ ke ke nyɛ ma mi jami ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba sã bɔ ha mi? Mɛnɔ de nyɛ ke nyɛ ba nyɛɛ ye sɔlemi we ɔ kpo ɔ nɔ?

english_verse: I hate your New Moon Festivals and all others as well. They are a heavy burden I am tired of carrying.
translation_verse: I sume nyɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔmɛ, kɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ; enɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ haomi kɛ pɔtɔ ha mi.

english_verse: “No matter how much you pray, I won't listen. You are too violent.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ wo nyɛ nine nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, i be nyɛ hyɛe; nyɛ nine he pee kɛ muɔ.

english_verse: and learn to live right. See that justice is done. Defend widows and orphans and help the oppressed.” An Invitation from the Lord
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛɛ kase kpakpa peemi. Nyɛɛ ye dami sane; nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ, nyɛɛ ye a sane ha mɛ; nyɛ ha awusahi a blɔ nya níhi, nɛ nyɛɛ ye yalɔyihi a sane ha mɛ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, invite you to come and talk it over. Your sins are scarlet red, but they will be whiter than snow or wool.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ba nɛ wɔ tsuo wa susu he. Ke nyɛ he yayami ɔ tsu kaa mɛni po, ma ha e ma hiɛ futaa kaa snoo, loo jijɔ he bwɔmi.

english_verse: If you willingly obey me, the best crops in the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ maa bu mi tue ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa ye zugba a mi niba ní kpakpa.

english_verse: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ kpale we, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã a, lɛɛ nyɛ ma gbo ngɛ klaate nya. Imi, Yawɛ, lɛ i de.” Ma nɛ mi hyi kɛ yayami peemi

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ sa a, e yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ hyɛ, e ngɛ e ní pee kaa yaholɔ! Sa be ko ɔ, nimli nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da nɛ a hyi ma a mi tɔ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ awi yeli sɔuu lɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi.

english_verse: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.
translation_verse: Atuã tsɔli ji o ganɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ juli ji o huɛmɛ; be tsuaa be ɔ, nike ní, kɛ nyɔ mi ní a ngɛ hee. A yi awusahi a sane ha we mɛ ngɛ sane yemi he, nɛ a bui yalɔyihi hu a sane tue.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ta tue ha nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu, hewamitsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ɔ: “Ma ye ye he lue ngɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ ko ba gba ye nya hu.

english_verse: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: I kɛ nyɛ maa to ní. Ma tsu nyɛ he kaa a tsuɔ dade he, nɛ ma je nyɛ he mu ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be “Justice and Faithfulness.” The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ma ha nyɛ ma nimeli, kɛ ga woli kpakpahi kaa nihi nɛ hi si blema a. Ke enɛ ɔ ba mi ɔ, a ma tsɛ Yerusalem ke ma nɛ a yeɔ dami sane kɛ anɔkuale ngɛ mi.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ dalɔ ji Yawɛ he je ɔ, e ma he Yerusalem yi wami, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsake e tsui hu, a ma he e yi wami.

english_verse: You will be made ashamed of those groves of trees where you worshiped idols.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma pia nyɛ he kaa nyɛ ya ja tso ngua amɛ, nɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ maa gbe nyɛ ngɛ abɔɔhi nɛ nyɛ po ɔ a he.

english_verse: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a he wa a, a he yayami ɔmɛ ma kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ la nɛ sɛ sulii sãã nga a. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa tsi nya.

english_verse: This is the message I was given about Judah and Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha Yesaya, Amoz bi ɔ, nɛ kɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills; every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, Yawɛ we ɔ maa ma yo gagaa ko yi mi; yo nɛ ya hiɔwe gojoo pe yo ɔmɛ tsuo yi mi e maa ma. Je ma amɛ tsuo ma bu yuu kɛ ba e he,

english_verse: Many people will come and say, “Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: nɛ a ma de ke, “Nyɛ ha wa ya kuɔ Yawɛ yo ɔ kɛ ya Israel Mawu ɔ sɔlemi we ɔ. E maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ kaa waa pee; nɛ wa maa pee bɔ nɛ e maa tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ejakaa Yawɛ ní tsɔɔmi ɔ, Yerusalem e jee; e kɛ e ma a tuɔ munyu kɛ jeɔ Zion yo ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord. Following Sinful Customs
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nyɛ Yakob nina, nyɛ ha waa nyɛɛ ngɛ la nɛ Yawɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi! A ma kpata he nɔ woli a hɛ mi

english_verse: Our Lord, you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.
translation_verse: Mawu lee, o kua o ma, Yakob nina a, ejakaa klaali babauu nɛ je beleku je kɛ Filistia ba futu mɛ. Ma se bi a kusumi níhi o ma a ngɛ pee.

english_verse: Everywhere in the country they worship the idols they have made.
translation_verse: Amagahi hyi a zugba a nɔ; nɛ níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a jaa.

english_verse: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them! A Day of Judgment
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo ba a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ si, nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ. Yawɛ koo ngɔ kɛ pa mɛ!

english_verse: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
translation_verse: A ma ya laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi, aloo a maa tsua muɔhi, konɛ a laa a he kɛ je Yawɛ we abofu nɛ he wa a, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ nya!

english_verse: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.
translation_verse: Be ma nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa he tsɔɔmi, kɛ e he nɔ womi tsuo a se maa po. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma wo Yawɛ pɛ nɔ gojoo.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ba he walɔ tsuaa he walɔ si; e maa ba he wolɔ kɛ he nɔ wolɔ, tsuo si.

english_verse: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan,
translation_verse: E ma kpata Lebanon seda tso gagaa amɛ, kɛ Bashan tso ngua amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: all the seagoing ships, and every beautiful boat.
translation_verse: Spania lɛ nguaa amɛ kɛ a he fɛu ɔ tsuo e ma ha a ma mu.

english_verse: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, ni ɔmɛ ma sake amaga amɛ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ pee nɛ a ma ja a ngɔ hɛ fɔ he ha jesihi kɛ apanihi.

english_verse: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
translation_verse: Ke Yawɛ ba nɛ e ba mimiɛ je ɔ, nimli maa laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi kɛ muɔhi a mi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ je e abofu nɛ he wa a, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ nya.

english_verse: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔmlɔ adesa nɔ. Tlukaa kɛkɛ e mumi je e mi, nɛ e he be se nami hu.

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful is going to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything you need— your bread and water, *
translation_verse: Bu tue! Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ nihi nɛ a ba ye bua Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem hu. E ma ha a niye ní, kɛ nyu maa ta.

english_verse: soldiers and heroes, judges and prophets, leaders and army officers,
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata: katsɛmɛ, ta buli, kojoli, gbali, klaali, ma nimeli,

english_verse: officials and advisors, fortunetellers and others who tell the future.
translation_verse: asafoatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, ma ní tsuli, kɛ kunya yeli kpanakuhi.

english_verse: He will let children and babies become your rulers.
translation_verse: Ma wo jokuɛwi nyumuwi ganɔhi ha mɛ, nɛ bimwɔwi maa ye a nɔ.

english_verse: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
translation_verse: A maa wa a sibi yi mi. Nihewi maa hyɛ nikɔtɔma hɛ mi, nɛ nihi nɛ bu be a he maa wo a he ha nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami.

english_verse: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
translation_verse: Be ma, nɛ we puɔ nya ko bi maa hla a ti nɔ ko, nɛ a ma de lɛ ke, “Wa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi kpata, se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ he ha nɔ́ ko, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ba pee wa tsɛ, nɛ o ye wa nɔ.”

english_verse: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
translation_verse: E ma he nɔ ke, “Kpaoo! I be nyɛe ma pee ja ha nyɛ. Imi hu, i be niye ní, nɛ i be heha ní hulɔ. Nyɛ ko wo mi nyɛ nyatsɛ!”

english_verse: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, musu tloo Yerusalem! Yuda hɛ mi kpata! Ejakaa a deɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ siɔ Yawɛ; a jee blɔ pueɔ Mawu nitsɛ hɛ mi si.

english_verse: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves. The Wrong Kind of Leaders
translation_verse: A ní peepee yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mɛ; ejakaa a jeɔ a hɛ mi paa kɛ peeɔ yayami kaa Sodom bi; a kɛ laa we. Musu tloo mɛ! Mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ye a he awi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a bua maa jɔ, nɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa ya nɔ saminya. A maa ye a dengme gbomi mi ngɔɔmi.

english_verse: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
translation_verse: Se yayami peeli lɛɛ musu tloo mɛ; yayami nɛ a pee ní kpahi ɔ, jehanɛ, a ma ngɔ pee mɛ nitsɛmɛ.

english_verse: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
translation_verse: Jokuɛwi lɛ ngɛ ye ma a haoe, nɛ yihi lɛ ngɛ a nɔ yee. Ye ma, o nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ haa o tlaa blɔ, nɛ a tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ̃ o nane. Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a kojoe

english_verse: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.
translation_verse: Yawɛ pee klaalo kaa e maa jaje e sane ɔ; e pee klaalo kaa e maa kojo e ma a.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nyɛ be he blɔ kulaa kaa nyɛ waa ye ma a yi mi, loo nyɛ yeɔ ohiatsɛmɛ amimi. Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ i de.” A bɔ Yerusalem yi ɔmɛ kɔkɔ

english_verse: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ Yerusalem yi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he tsɔɔe ha! Ke a ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, a woɔ a hɛ mi nɔ kɛ hii kɔɔhiɔ mi fue. Basabasa peemi pɛ a suɔ be tsuaa be. A hiaa a nane bitibiti kɛ kɔsɔɔ, nɛ a nane si ga amɛ hii pɛe ngmleingmlei.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma gbla a tue. Ma ha sakpa ma pue a yi mi, nɛ a maa sɛ a yi ɔ kpalokpalo.”

english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Nu je via be hae nɛ a he maa je via hu, a he maa je fu mohu; tangme kpa titlii a kɛ maa fi a mlɛ mi, pi mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ hu; yi nɛ a hɔɔ saminyayoo ɔ maa pee kpalokpalo; a heha ní kpakpa amɛ ma plɛ pee tako piɛ; a he fɛu ɔ ma plɛ pee zo ha mɛ!

english_verse: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, yihi kpaago ma ya nu nyumu kake nɛ a ma de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa maa lɛ wa he, nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa maa bɔ wa heha ní he mɔde, se ngmɛɛ wɔ blɔ nɛ wa tsɛ mo ke wa huno kɛkɛ, konɛ a ko ba bɔ wɔ ahlua hu.” A maa fia Yerusalem ma a kɛ ma si ekohu

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
translation_verse: Be ma, nɛ Yawɛ ma ha tso tsuaa tso ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa bɔ, nɛ e maa pee fɛu. Israel bi tsuo nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, a bua maa jɔ, nɛ a ma na gɛjɛmi ngɛ niba ní nɛ a ma na ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ he.

english_verse: after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e he wami maa kojo Zion biyi ɔmɛ, nɛ e maa tsu ma a he. E ma fɔ mu níhi, kɛ muɔ nɛ pue si ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa ngɔ bɔku kɛ ba ha Zion yo ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ba kpe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a nɔ; piani ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha bɔku maa wo, nɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, la su ku, kɛ la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe plamplam maa ba. Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa ha ma a tsuo nɔ.

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: E hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa pee hɔ̃ ha ma a piani kɛ tsi pu la a nya, nɛ e maa pee wesa he ngɛ hiɔmi kɛ ahumi be mi.

english_verse: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
translation_verse: E hu zugba a nɔ, e je tɛhi nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ tsuo, nɛ e du wai tso kpakpahi ngɛ mi. E ma mɔ ko nɛ a maa hi mi kɛ bu ngmɔ ɔ he, e tsua muɔ nɛ a maa nga wai yiblii kɛ wo mi. E mlɛ kɛ ya si be nɛ wai yiblii ɔ fu; se wai yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo dooɔ.

english_verse: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
translation_verse: Anɛ nɔ́ ko pa ngɛ nɛ i tsu we ngɛ e he lo? Lɛɛ mɛni he je mɔ nɛ e wo yiblii nɛ dooɔ, se pi wai yiblii kpakpa nɛ i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa e maa wo ɔ?

english_verse: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
translation_verse: “Bɔ nɛ ma pee ye wai ngmɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ma je piɛ ɔ, nɛ́ nga mi lohwehi nɛ ba ye wai yiblii ɔ; ma ku gbogbo nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba naa nɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! Israel is the vineyard, and Judah is the garden I tended with care. I had hoped for honesty and for justice, but dishonesty and cries for mercy were all I found. Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
translation_verse: Israel ma a ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ nɛ; Yuda bi ɔmɛ ji wai tso kpakpa amɛ nɛ e du ɔ nɛ. E hyɛ blɔ kaa a maa ye dami sane, se muɔ si mohu a ngɛ puee. english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Musu tloo nyɛ! Wehi babauu, kɛ zugbahi nyɛ ngɛ hee kɛ ngɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ momo ɔ a he piɛe. E be kɛe kulaa nɛ nɔ kpa ko be he ko nae maa hi hu, nɛ e maa piɛ nyɛ pɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
translation_verse: I nu nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ke, “Wehi nɛ kle, nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu nɛ ɔ tsuo ma ba pee we dokuhi.

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Pɔ tɔɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu tɛ we si. A di kɔnɛɛ, nɛ a hwɔ we mahe. A mlɛ mi fimi níhi gbɔle we, nɛ a nane tokota kpa amɛ hu tsɔ we.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ fi nyɛ kaa kpa nɛ nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ pɛne ngɛ nyɛ he.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
translation_verse: Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ tee si makɛ mla, kɛkɛ nyɛ bɔni dã numi, nɛ gbɔkuɛ hu nyɛ hii si be fuu kɛ tɔɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsɛɔ ní yemi nɛ nyɛ nuɔ dã; nyɛ fiaa saku, nɛ nyɛ nyaa; nyɛ kpaa bɛ, nɛ nyɛ hii miɛ. Se akɛnɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ pee ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ susuu we he kulaa he je ɔ,

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: a maa nuu nyɛ nɛ a maa bɔ nyɛ pã kɛ ho ma se ya. Mi mi hwɔ maa gbe nyɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ kuma maa ye ni gu ɔmɛ kɛ yaa si a ma gbo.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: Hwɔ ngɛ gbeje yee, nɛ e gbɛ e nya mi hatoo nɛ e maa mii mɛ. E ngɛ Yerusalem odehe ɔmɛ, kɛ ni gu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ hoo pee ɔ tsuo miie si kake too.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Zo maa gbe ni ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a maa ba he woli tsuo si.

english_verse: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ e peeɔ kɛ tsɔɔ e we agbo jemi; nɛ e gblaa e ma a tue kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu klɔuklɔu ji lɛ.

english_verse: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
translation_verse: Ke be ɔ su ɔ, jijɔhi ma kpe nga ngɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ to akpakpo bihi hu ma na niye ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
translation_verse: Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kã ngɛ dã tɔmi he! Ke e su dã nɛ nya wa futumi nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ he mi wa nyɛ.

english_verse: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
translation_verse: Nyɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní ngɛ nihi nɛ ye fɔ a dɛ nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɔ a he; se nihi nɛ yi fɔ mohu lɛɛ nyɛ yi a sane ha we mɛ.

english_verse: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel hɛ mi ma ba kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã hu kɛ nga gbigbli ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba a nɔ, ejakaa a kua Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ mlaa amɛ. A yi Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Yawɛ mi mi fu e ma a, nɛ e wo e nine nɔ, konɛ e gbla a tue. Yo ɔmɛ ma mimiɛ, nɛ ni gbogboehi ma pue si ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa dwɔmi. Ke e ba ja po, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe, se e nine nɛ e wo nɔ ɔ, ja e kɛ gbla a tue kokooko.

english_verse: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
translation_verse: Yawɛ pee okadi ko kɛ tsɛ ma ko kɛ je ma se lokoo. E kpa bɛ kɛ tsɛ mɛ kɛ je je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ. O nɛ mɛ nɛ a ma kɛ fo esɔesɔ.

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: A kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ a nya ba, nɛ a dɔ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ a mi, konɛ a tsɛ̃. A we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nane kokloto ɔmɛ a he wa kaa tslɛbo, nɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a nane kla amɛ ngɛ a he poe kɛ fo kaa lasiogblee.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Ta buli ɔmɛ hwɔ hoo kaa jatahi nɛ a gbe lohwe ko nɛ a ngɛ huãe ngɛ he, nɛ a kɛ yaa he nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ ngɛ a dɛ.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a ma hwɔ hoo kɛ wo Israel kaa wo nɛ gli. Ke nɔ ko hyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, e maa na kaa e nɔ wo diblii. E pee gbeye kɛ aywilɛho. E nɔ wo diblii kpii; la ko be.

english_verse: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
translation_verse: Jeha a nɛ Matsɛ Uzia gbo ɔ, i na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ gojoo ko nɔ. E tade klɔii ɔ nya wuyaa a hyi Yawɛ we ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying,
translation_verse: Serafhi bɔle lɛ. A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ pɛli ekpa. Eko tsuaa eko ngɔ pɛli enyɔ ngɔ ha e hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ enyɔ hu ngɔ ha e he, nɛ enyɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ, e kɛ te.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord All-Powerful! The earth is filled with your glory.”
translation_verse: A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e sibi dee boboobo ke, “Klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu! Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu! E hɛ mi nyami ɔ hyi je ɔ tsuo.”

english_verse: As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
translation_verse: A gbi ɔ ha nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ sisi tomi ɔ mimiɛ, nɛ la su ku hyi Yawɛ we ɔ nitsɛ tɔ.

english_verse: Then I cried out, “I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Akuanyɛ! Ye yi ta pɛ! Ejakaa i na matsɛ ɔ nɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ! Ye nya mi munyu he tsɔ we; nɛ nimli nɛ i ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, mɛ hu a nya mi munyu he tsɔ we ja nɔuu!”

english_verse: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, seraf ɔ kake te kɛ ba ye ngɔ kɛ e dɛ mi la ngu hɛuu nɛ e kɛ abɛɛle ya kɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
translation_verse: E ngɔ la ngu hɛuu ɔ ngɔ sa ye nya he nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sa o nya he nɛ ɔ, a ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mo, nɛ piami ko be o he hu.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?” “I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i nu nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bi ke, “Mɛnɔ ma tsɔ? Mɛnɔ maa ya?” I he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, Moo tsɔ mi!”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke ma ya nɛ ma ya de ma a ke, “Nyɛ maa bu tue, se nyɛ be sisi nue; nyɛ maa hyɛ, se nyɛ be se kɔe.”

english_verse: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
translation_verse: Ma ha a maa je zugba a nɔ kɛ ya tsitsaa he ko, nɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ maa je gu.

english_verse: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ kake pɛ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ ni nyɔngma mi po, lɛ hu a ma kpata e hɛ mi; e maa pee kaa tso ngua ko nɛ a po, nɛ e piɛ tso kpɔ ɔ kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yuda matsɛ ɔ nu kaa Siria ta a ba sɛ Israel zugba a mi momo ɔ, e kɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a he do blibliibli kaa tsohi nɛ ngɛ mimiɛe ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ nya.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Yesaya ke, “Yaa nɛ o kɛ Matsɛ Ahaz ya kpe; ngɔɔ o bi Shear Yashub ngɔ piɛ o he kɛ ya. O maa na lɛ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ bo loli a ní tsumi he ɔ, he nɛ nyu dɔ nɛ gblaa nyu kɛ jee pa a nɛ ngɛ yiti je ɔ nya ya ta ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear
translation_verse: De lɛ ke e ko ye Matsɛ Rezin, kɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Matsɛ Peka gbeye. A mi mi fumi ɔ ngɛ kaa la tso enyɔ nɛ a ngɛ tsoe tikɔɔ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen.
translation_verse: “Se imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa enɛ ɔ be mi bae kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Once again the Lord God spoke to King Ahaz. This time he said,
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ sɛ gbi kpa mane Ahaz ke,

english_verse: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
translation_verse: “Bi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ke e ha mo okadi ko. E ma nyɛ maa je gbeje lokoo, loo hiɔwe tsitsaa kɛ ba.”

english_verse: “No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
translation_verse: Se Ahaz he nɔ ke, “I be okadi ko bie. I be Yawɛ kae.”

english_verse: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
translation_verse: Yesaya he nɔ ke, “Matsɛ David nina, jehanɛ bu tue. E ji nɔ́ yayami kaa o maa hao nimli adesahi hluu kɛ yaa si a tsui si tomi maa ta. Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o hao wa Mawu ɔ hu ja kɛ yaa si e tsui si tomi maa ta lo?

english_verse: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.
translation_verse: Yoo, i nu. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma ha nyɛ okadi ko; yiheyo ko maa ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e ma fɔ binyumu, nɛ e maa wo lɛ biɛ ke, ‘Yimanuel’.

english_verse: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ be sue tete po nɛ matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ he gbeye woe ɔ a zugba amɛ a nɔ maa je gu.

english_verse: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
translation_verse: “Yawɛ ma ha haomi be ko ma ba na mo, kɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ weku ɔ tsuo. Kɛ je be nɛ Israel kɛ Yuda mi gba nɛ ɔ, be yaya kaa enɛ ɔ eko bɛ hyɛ. Asiria matsɛ ɔ ji haomi nɛ Yawɛ maa ngɔ kɛ ba a nɛ.

english_verse: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
translation_verse: A ma ba pue si ngɛ kɔ̃ voovoo ɔmɛ, kɛ tɛ puɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a maa ha si ngɛ mio tso ɔmɛ a sisi, kɛ lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
translation_verse: “Jamɛ a be ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ya ba asoyi ngɛ Yufrate pa a se kɛ ba. E kɛ ma ba sɛ nyɛ yi bwɔmi, kɛ nyɛ nane he bwɔmi, nɛ a maa sɛ nyɛ kpɛni hulɔ. Asiria matsɛ ɔ ji asoyi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep,
translation_verse: “Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, ke ngmɔ hulɔ ko ngɛ na yo kake, kɛ to enyɔ pɛ ɔ,

english_verse: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.
translation_verse: Nihi maa hɛɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kɛ ya da de ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Niinɛ, zugba a nɔ tsuo ma hyi kɛ pú, kɛ mio tsohi sɔuu.

english_verse: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
translation_verse: Yo ɔmɛ a nɔ hehi nɛ a huɔ sa a lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ yae, ejakaa hu, kɛ mio maa puɛ ngɛ nɔ. Zugba a maa pee tohi, kɛ nahi a niye he.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Isaiah, get something to write on. Then write in big clear letters the name, MAHER-SHALAL-HASH-BAZ.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa hla nɔ́ nɛ a ngmaa ní ngɛ nɔ agbo ko, nɛ o ngma ní agbohi ngɛ nɔ. Ngmaa ke, ‘Puɛ ní esɔ; haa ní kɛ fo.’

english_verse: I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.”
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ nihi enyɔ nɛ a buu mɛ saminya kɛ pee odase yeli. Mɛ ji Uria, kɛ Zakaria, Yeberekia bi ɔ.”

english_verse: Because before he can say ‘Mommy’ or ‘Daddy,’ the king of Assyria will attack and take everything of value from Damascus and Samaria.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.

english_verse: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.
translation_verse: E ke, “Akɛnɛ ma nɛ ɔ sume Shiloa pa a nɛ mi nyu ɔ bee dii ɔ, se Matsɛ Rezin kɛ Matsɛ Peka mohu he a he ngɛ doe ngɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.
translation_verse: imi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ, ma ngɔ Asiria matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ta a tsuo kɛ ba tua Yuda. Ta a ma ba tua mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yufrate pa a hyiɔ ywiaa nga nɛ e haa zugba a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.
translation_verse: He nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba gu Yuda zugba a nɔ kaa pa nɛ hyi ywia nga kɛ su nɔ konɔ tɔɔ, nɛ e ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ.” Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ! E bli e pɛlihi a mi kɛ ngɛ zugba a he bue.

english_verse: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ hɛdɔ bɔ mi kɔkɔ ke ma ko nyɛɛ ni ɔmɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ. E ke,

english_verse: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.
translation_verse: “Koo piɛ ni ɔmɛ a he kɛ to a ga amɛ, nɛ níhi nɛ mɛɛ a yee gbeye ɔ, koo ye gbeye.

english_verse: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!
translation_verse: O hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ klɔuklɔu; imi ji nɔ nɛ sa kaa o ye gbeye.

english_verse: Run to me for protection. I am a rock that will make both Judah and Israel stumble and break their bones. I am a trap that will catch the people of Jerusalem—they will be captured and dragged away. Isaiah and His Followers
translation_verse: Nihi babauu ma tɛ nɔ nɛ a maa nɔɔ si, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata. A maa tsɔ mɛ klama, nɛ a maa du.” A bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ke a ko tsɛ kpade

english_verse: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.
translation_verse: Sɛ gbihi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha mi ɔ, nyɛ, ye kaseli ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ a nɔ saminya, konɛ a hi si daa.

english_verse: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɔ e hɛ mi ngɔ laa e ma a, se imi lɛɛ i heɔ yeɔ, nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Se ni komɛ de nyɛ ke nyɛ ya bi ní ngɛ klaali, kɛ ní peeli nɛ kpaa nyagba, nɛ a tuɔ gugwɔ mi gbi ɔ a ngɔ. A ma de ke, “E pee we nɔ́ ko; e sa kaa a ya bi ní ngɛ mumihi a ngɔ, nɛ a nu nɔ́ ko nɛ kɔɔ hɛ ngmengmletsɛmɛ a he kɛ je kpadehi a ngɔ.”

english_verse: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
translation_verse: Ni komɛ maa wo lalaalo ngɛ zugba a nɔ; hwɔ maa ye mɛ, nɛ a ní maa pee mɔbɔ. Mi mi fumi, kɛ hwɔ nɛ ngɛ mɛ yee he je ɔ, a maa gbiɛ a matsɛ ɔ, kɛ a mawu ɔmɛ. A ma wo a yi nɔ kɛ hyɛ hiɔwe,

english_verse: But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected. War Is Over
translation_verse: He ko he ko be nɛ a maa gu kɛ je haomi nɛ ɔ mi. Matsɛ nɛ ma hwɔɔ se ɔ Zebulun kɛ Naftali wɛtso ɔmɛ a zugba nɛ be ko mi a pue e hɛ mi si ɔ, hwɔɔ se ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ: kɛ je Mediterenia wo ɔ beleku je kɛ yaa su Yordan pa a se, kɛ yaa su Galilea nitsɛ, he nɛ nibwɔhi hii ɔ.

english_verse: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ hi diblii kpii mi ɔ na la kpetekpleenyɛ ko. A hi zugba ko nɛ nɔ wo diblii kpii nɔ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ la ngɛ kpɛe ha mɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o ha nɛ ma a bɔ, nɛ o ha mɛ bua jɔmi babauu. A ngɛ nyae ngɛ o hɛ mi kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ní kpae, loo nihi nɛ ngɛ ta yibu ní dlae ha a he.

english_verse: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.
translation_verse: Ejakaa lohwe kuɛpã tso nɛ jiɔ kaa tlomi ngɛ a nɔ, kɛ to tsɔ̃mi tso nɛ a kɛ fiaa a konɔ kɛ wa mɛ yi mi ɔ, o ku a mi kaa bɔ nɛ blema a o pee Midian bi ɔmɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
translation_verse: Ta buli nɛ ma wɔ tuami ɔ, a tokota amɛ, kɛ a tade ɔmɛ nɛ muɔ sɛ mi ɔ, a kɛ la maa sã lɛ tsuo, kaa lɛ́ ngɛ la mi.

english_verse: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a fɔ bi ha wɔ! A ha wɔ binyumuyo! Lɛ nɛ e ma ba ye wa nɔ. A ma tsɛ lɛ ke, “Nyakpɛ ga wolɔ,” “Mawu he walɔ,” “Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene,” “Ganɔ nɛ yi nɔ jɔ.”

english_verse: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done. God Will Punish Israel
translation_verse: E nɔ yemi ɔ ma he si, nɛ e maa bɔ; ma a ma na tue mi jɔmi daa, ejakaa e maa ye tsɛ kaa Matsɛ David nitsɛ se yelɔ. E maa pee kpakpa, nɛ e maa ye dami sane, kɛ maa je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa su je mi nyagbe. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ hɛdɔ ma tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Yawɛ maa gbla Israel tue

english_verse: The Lord had warned the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bu Yakob nina, Israel ma a fɔ.

english_verse: “Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.”
translation_verse: “Bliikisi we ɔmɛ ku pue si; wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa ngɔ tɛ nɛ a kó kɛ maa ma ekohu. A poo sikamore tsohi ngɔ pueɔ si; se wɔɔ lɛɛ waa kɛ seda tso kpakpahi ma tsake mɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord made their enemies attack them.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ sú a he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ wo mɛ.

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Siria ngɛ beleku je, nɛ Filistia ngɛ bonyoku je. A pa a nya mi hatoo, konɛ a mii Israel. Enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Israel bi ɔmɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɔ. E ngɛ mi kaa e gbla a tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛɛ,

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi kake too ɔ, Yawɛ gbla Israel ma a tue. E po mɛ ngɔ hɛɛ fɔ, yi kɛ hlemi tsuo.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: Nikɔtɔmahi, kɛ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ji yi ɔ nɛ; nɛ lakpa gbali ɔmɛ ji hlemi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi ɔ ha ma a laa blɔ, nɛ a pee basaa.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na we nihewi ɔmɛ a he bua jɔmi. Yalɔyi ɔmɛ, kɛ awusa amɛ hu e mɛ nɛ mɔbɔ; ejakaa ni ɔmɛ tsuo li Mawu; a pee a he yiwutsotsɛmɛ, nɛ munyu yaya pɛ a tuɔ. Enɛ ɔ tsuo he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ mi mi fu he je ɔ, e tue gblami ɔ nya wa kaa la nɛ ngɛ nimli tsuo a hɛ mi kpatae ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e wami he plee.

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: O maa na nɛ nihi ngɛ ní gblɔe hiɔ kɛ muɔ, nɛ a ngɛ yee tsuatsuaatsua, se a tɔɛ gblee. Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ po, a ngɛ yee!

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: Manase bi, kɛ Efraim bi maa hwu ta, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ma bua kɛ wo Yuda he. Enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ woɔ mlaahi nɛ dɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngmaa mlaahi nɛ nyɛ kɛ waa ye ma a yi mi.

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Ke Mawu bɔni nyɛ tue gblami ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛɛ? Ke e ngɔ haomi kɛ je ma se kɛ ba na nyɛ ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛɛ? Mɛnɔ ngɔ nyɛ ma sa fo kɛ ya ya hla yemi kɛ buami? Jije nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ juetli kɛ to?

english_verse: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Asiria, o ngɛ kaa to tsɔmi tso ko nɛ i kɛ gblaa nihi nɛ woɔ ye mi mi la a a tue.

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: I tsɔ Asiria bi ɔmɛ ke a ya tua ma ko nɛ li Mawu, ma nɛ wo ye mi mi la a. I tsɔ mɛ ke a ya ha ní, nɛ a kpɔ níhi pani nya; nɛ a naa ni ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa mɔsɔ ngɛ blɔ mi.”

english_verse: He has even bigger plans in mind, because he wants to destroy many nations.
translation_verse: Se Asiria matsɛ ɔ lɛɛ e to yi mi kpa mohu. E to kaa e ma kpata je mahi babauu a hɛ mi.

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: E fĩaa nɛ e deɔ ke, “Anɛ ye tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, pi matsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo lo?

english_verse: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ i kpata Samaria, kɛ e we amaga amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, anɛ i be nyɛe ma pee Yerusalem, kɛ amaga amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu jã lo?”

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ ke, “Ke i gbe nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsue ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Yerusalem ɔ nya a, ma gbla Asiria matsɛ ɔ tue ngɛ e he nɔ womi, kɛ e fiami babauu ɔ he.”

english_verse: I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ a juetli ɔ pee kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ tsu nɛ ye nine ya su nɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ a muɔɔ hlui nɛ a je he ɔ, ja i bua je ɔ tsuo nya. Lohwe ko fiɛ pɛli mi ɔ, i nui eko kuɛ si, loo pɛmi po.”

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ hiɔ kɛ gbla ta buli nɛ je oblai ɔ tsuo a tue. A maa ta he lo. La ko ma mle ngɛ a nɔmlɔ tso mi, nɛ la nɛ ɔ maa tso wawɛɛ.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ ji la kɛ ha Israel ɔ ma mle. Mawu klɔuklɔu ha Israel ɔ ma mle kɛ la, nɛ ligbi kake too mi ɔ, e maa sã nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; e maa sã mio ɔmɛ, kɛ mio tso ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Tsohi bɔɔ pɛ maa piɛ ngɛ hue ɔ mi, nɛ jokuɛ nɛ wɛ po ma nyɛ maa kane mɛ. Nihi bɔbɔyoo pɛ maa kpale kɛ ba

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Israel bi nɛ a yi na wami ɔ be a hɛ ngɔe kɛ fɔ ma a nɛ ka a hɛ mi kpatami ɔ nɔ hu. A maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ kulaa.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Israel ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia lɛɛ, se nihi bɔbɔyoo pɛ nɛ maa kpale kɛ ba. A fa nɛ a kpata ma a hɛ mi, nɛ jã pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ e sa mɛ.

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ e ma nɛ ngɛ Zion ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ ko ye Asiria bi ɔmɛ gbeye; ke kaa a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae kaa bɔ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ pee be ko ɔ po, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye.

english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: Ma gbla nyɛ tue be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma kpata a hɛ mi.

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: Imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma fia mɛ kpa kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Midian bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Oreb tɛ sa a he ɔ. Ma gbla Asiria tue kaa bɔ nɛ i gbla Egipt tue ɔ.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma je Asiria tlomi ɔ kɛ je nyɛ nɔ, nɛ ma ku kuɛpã tso ɔ nɛ e kɛ wo nyɛ kuɛ ɔ.” He nyɛlɔ ɔ ba tua ma amɛ

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: He nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a je Rimon ba ngɔ Ai ma a! Ta a ya gu Migron! A kɛ a tlomi ɔmɛ ya to si ngɛ Mikmash!

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: A gu yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ kɛ ya hwɔ Geba nyɔ mi! Nihi nɛ a ngɛ Rama ma a mi ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ Matsɛ Saul ma, Gibea bi ɔmɛ ma fo.

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: Galim bi, nyɛ kpa ngmlaa! Laisha bi, nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛ he nɔ koo, nyɛ Anatot bi!

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: He nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ Nob ma a mi mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma kɔ̃ kɛ ngɛ Zion yo ɔ, kɛ Yerusalem ma a tsɔɔe.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Yawɛ mumi ɔ maa ba e nɔ. E ma ha lɛ sane se kɔmi, nile, kɛ ga nɛ e kɛ maa ye e ma a nɔ. E maa le Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní, nɛ e maa bu lɛ.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: E maa ye Yawɛ gbeye. Pi nɔ́ nɛ e hɛngmɛ na, loo e tue nu ɔ nɛ e kɛ maa kojo.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: Se e kɛ dami sane yemi maa kojo ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ e maa bu nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ a he. Ke e fa ke a gbla nɔ ko tue ɔ, kɛkɛ a maa gbla e tue. Ke e fa ke a gbe yayami peelɔ ko ɔ, kɛkɛ pe a gbe lɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.
translation_verse: Dami sane yemi, kɛ anɔkuale yemi ji níhi nɛ e kɛ maa ye ma a nɔ.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Ogbetee kɛ jijɔ maa hi si ngɛ he kake, nɛ ngatsɛ kɛ apletsi bɔbɔyoo maa bu si ngɛ he kake. Na bi kɛ jata bi ma bla kɛ ye ní, nɛ jokuɛ wayoo pɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Na yo kɛ osisiblisi ma bla kɛ ye ní; a bimɛ maa bu si ngɛ he kake, nɛ jata ma kpe nga kaa na.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Bimwɔyo po ma fiɛ ngɛ sinɔ muɔ nya, nɛ bi nɛ je nyɔ nya kɛ e nine maa wo sinɔ duɔtsɛ muɔ mi.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be e nyɛmi awi yee ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be e nyɛmi hɛ mi kpatae. Ejakaa zugba a tsuo maa le Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ wo hyi tɔ kɛ nyu ɔ. Nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a maa kpale kɛ ba

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, matsɛ he nɛ je Ishai powu ɔ mi ɔ maa da si kaa okadi ko ha je ma amɛ. A ma bua a he nya kɛ maa ba e matsɛ ma a mi, nɛ a ma ba wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma tsu ní kɛ he wami; e maa kpale e ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ kɛ maa ba we ekohu. A maa je Asiria, Egipt, Patros, Sudan, Elam, Babilonia, Hamat, kɛ mahi nɛ ngɛ wo nya a kɛ ba.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa si aflangaa kɛ pee okadi kɛ tsɔɔ je ma amɛ kaa Israel, kɛ Yuda ma amɛ nɛ a gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, e ngɛ a nya buae ekohu, konɛ e kpale mɛ kɛ ba we.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Israel, Efraim nina a kɛ Yuda be nɔ́ he plee hu; nɛ Yuda be Israel nya dooe hu.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ, a maa pee kake kɛ ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ bonyoku je; nɛ a maa ha nihi nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ a níhi. A maa ye Edom kɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi, nɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ hu maa ba a he si ha mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma kpata Egipt pa kɔni nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Suez ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. E ma ha nɛ ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ maa fia ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ pa a ma gba maa pee pa tsɔwi kpaago, bɔ nɛ ke nɔ wo tokota po e ma nyɛ kɛ po.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Gbɛjegbɛ ko maa je Asiria kɛ ha Israel ma a mi bi nɛ a ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, konɛ a nyɛɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ, benɛ a je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ma a.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ ma la ke, “Yawɛ i ngɛ o yi jee! Be ko ɔ, o mi mi fu mi, se jehanɛ lɛɛ mo nitsɛ o ngɛ mi bua woe, ejakaa o mi mi fumi ɔ se po.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Mawu ji ye yi wami helɔ; ma ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, nɛ i be gbeye yee. Yawɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ haa mi he wami kɛ nyɛmi, lɛ nɔuu ji ye yi wami helɔ.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma a ma la nɛ a ma de ke, “Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si! Nyɛɛ wo e biɛ ta! Nyɛ ha je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ le níhi nɛ e pee ɔ! Nyɛ ha nɛ a le kaa Yawɛ kle!

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa e tsu ní nguanguahi. Nyɛ ha je ɔ tsuo nɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Zion, nyɛ hwɔ lele nɛ nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi. Ejakaa Mawu kle, Mawu klɔuklɔu ji Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ si aflangaa ngɛ yo kpataa ko nɔ. Nyɛ kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ ta buli ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ fɔ mɛ nine kɛ pee okadi ha mɛ ke a ya tua odehe ɔmɛ a ma a, nɛ a sɛ agbo ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
translation_verse: Yawɛ tsɛ e ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, konɛ a gbla ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ a he nɔ woe kɛ ngɛ e mi mi la woe ɔ a tue.

english_verse: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu tue, a ngɛ hoo pee ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; nihi babauu lɛ a ngɛ hoo pee nɛ ɔ nɛ. Niinɛ, je mahi, kɛ nɔ yemihi ngɛ a he nya buae. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ e tabo ɔmɛ miae kɛ ha ta.

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: A je tsitsaa je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ma. Yawɛ kɛ e mi mi fumi ɔ ma kpata zugba a tsuo hɛ mi.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpa bubuubui! Yawɛ ligbi ɔ su jehanɛ. Ligbi nɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma kpata níhi a hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ he mi maa po, nɛ sawale maa nu lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: A maa ye gbeye; nɛ a he mi maa hia mɛ kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi. Gbeye ma ha a maa hi a sibi a hɛ mi hyɛe gaa kɛkɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi maa tsu paa kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbeye ɔ ma; a maa na e mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a, kɛ e hɛdɔ ɔ. Je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata; a ma kpata yayami peelɔ tsuaa yayami peelɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Dodoe tsuaa dodoe, kɛ dodoe kuu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ be kpɛe hu. Ke pu je po, diblii maa wo, nɛ nyɔhiɔ hu be kpɛe.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma je ye mi mi fumi ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ɔ, ma ha hiɔwe tsuo ma mimiɛ, nɛ zugba a maa je e blɔ he.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a maa nu ɔ, a kɛ dade maa gbe lɛ.

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Ma ha nɛ Media bi ɔmɛ ma ba tua Babilon. Media bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a bui sika hiɔ, nɛ a hɛ kɔɛ sika tsu nɔ.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: A kɛ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ maa gbe nihewi. Bimwɔwi ngɛ a nyɛmɛ a mi mi po, a be mɛ mɔbɔ nae, nɛ jokuɛwi hu, a be a he bee.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Babilonia nɔ yemi ɔ ji nɔ yemi ko nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe kulaa; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e mi bi ɔmɛ fĩaa. Se imi Yawɛ, ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Sodom kɛ Gomora a!

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa na e ma Israel mɔbɔ ekohu, nɛ e ma ná a he tsui kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma. E maa to mɛ si ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ. Nibwɔhi ma ba to mɛ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ maa hi si.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ maa ngɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba zugba nɛ Yawɛ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu, nɛ a ma ba sɔmɔ mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi. Nihi nɛ nuu Israel nyɔguɛ sa a, jehanɛ lɛɛ Israel hu maa ye a nɔ. Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɛ gbeje

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: Ke Yawɛ pee enɛ ɔ, nyɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu nyɛ maa ye Babilonia matsɛ ɔ he fɛu ke, “Matsɛ yiwutsotsɛ ɔ nɔ si! E be nɔ ko nɔ ko yi mi wae hu.

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ku nɔ yeli yaya amɛ a he wami nya la.

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ je ɔ tsuo na he jɔmi kɛ tue mi jɔmi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lae kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Tso nguaa amɛ, kɛ seda tso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Lebanon ɔ po ngɛ nyae ke, ‘Matsɛ ɔ kpa sɛ; nɛ nɛ́ e be nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko be nɛ ma ha nɛ a poo wɔ hu!’

english_verse: The world of the dead eagerly waits for you. With great excitement, the spirits of ancient rulers hear about your coming.
translation_verse: “Babilonia matsɛ, gbeje pee klaalo nɛ e ma he mo atuu. Ni nguahi nɛ hi je mi hyɛ ɔ a kpade ɔmɛ ngɛ si poe. Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kpade ɔmɛ ngɛ si tee ngɛ a matsɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo a ngɛ mo dee ke, ‘Jehanɛ lɛɛ mo hu o gbɔjɔ kaa wɔ! Waa kɛ mo sɔ!

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: Sa a, kpa sakuhi a kɛ laa kɛ woɔ o hɛ mi nyami; se jehanɛ lɛɛ o su gbeje. Wɔyewɔyehi ji sa nɛ o hwɔɔ si ngɛ nɔ, nɛ gɔgɔhi ji kuutu nɛ ha o nɔ.’

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: “Babilonia matsɛ, mo nɛ́ o ngɛ kaa nɔkɔ nɛ kpɛɔ hleii makɛ ɔ, o je hiɔwe ba nɔ si bum! Be ko nɛ be ɔ, o ye mahi a nɔ kunimi, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a tsɛ̃ mo ko si.

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Se mohu ɔ, a ba mo si kɛ ho gbeje he nɛ mi kuɔ pe kulaa a ya.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: “Ni gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pa a nya mi hatoo maa hi mo hyɛe gaa. A ma bi ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ mimiɛ je ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ nɔ yemihi a he do blibliibli ɔ, anɛ pi lɛ ji nɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ kpata mahi a hɛ mi, nɛ e ha je ɔ he tsuaa he plɛ pee nga kplanaa nɔ ɔ, pi lɛ ji nɛ ɔ lo?’

english_verse: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hwɔɔ si kɛ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ yɔkɔ agbohi a mi,

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: se moo lɛɛ o be yɔkɔ ɔ eko kulaa; a sake o gbogboe ɔ ngɔ fɔ he, konɛ e sa. Nihi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ, a gbogboe ɔmɛ ha o nɔ; a sake o kɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ pue tɛ muɔ ko mi kaa gbogboe nɛ a naa nɔ.

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ o kpata o zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ o gbe mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ he je ɔ, a be mo pue kaa matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ. Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nimli, yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ a nina ko yi nɛ na wami.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Ma ya tua Babilon ma a, nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi. E biɛ maa laa. E ngmɛdu kɛ e nina tsuo a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko yi be wami nae. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ka kita ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i to kaa ma pee ɔ maa ba mi ja. Nɔ́ nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma tsu ɔ, ma tsu kokooko.

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ i to ye yi mi ha je ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ i wo ye kɔni nɔ konɛ ma gbla ma amɛ a tue.”

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Jeha nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz gbo ɔ nɛ a fiɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: Filistia bi, nyɛ bua ko jɔ kulaa kaa tso nɛ a kɛ fiaa nyɛ ɔ mi ku. Ke sinɔ kake gbo ɔ, ekpa nɛ e duɔ nya wa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ ba yeɔ e nane mi. Sinɔ hlui ko ma pɛ, nɛ sinɔ pɛlitsɛ maa je mi.

english_verse: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Filisti ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛ kpa ngmlaa! Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ tsui nɛ po! Ejakaa la su ku ko je omleyi je kɛ ma. Tabo ko nɛ fɔ̃lɔ ko fɔ̃lɔ ko be mi nɛ ma a nɛ.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Mɛni heto wa ma ha tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ je Filistia kɛ ba a? Wa ma de mɛ ke Yawɛ to Zion sisi saminya, nɛ e ma a nɛ ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, a tue mi maa jɔ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Moab he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɔ kake too mi ɔ, a kpata Ar kɛ Kir a hɛ mi, kɛkɛ nɛ Moab zugba a nɔ tsuo jɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Dibon bi ɔmɛ kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ a ya wo yana ngɛ a jami he ɔmɛ. Moab bi ɔmɛ wo yana kɛ nyɛ ya ha Nebo kɛ Medeba. A sɛ a yi, kɛ a kpɛni tsuo kɛ ye kɔmɔ.

english_verse: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
translation_verse: A bu kpekpe ya bo kɛ nyɛɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a wo yana ngɛ ma kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ a tsu ɔmɛ a yi mi.

english_verse: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
translation_verse: Heshbon kɛ Eleale bi ɔmɛ wo yana nɛ a fo boboobo. A nu huhui ɔ ngɛ Yahaz tɔɔ. Sawale nu Moab ta buli ɔmɛ, nɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli.

english_verse: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
translation_verse: Ye tsui ngɛ yee ngɛ Moab he! Ma mi bi ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ ho Zoar, kɛ Eglat Shelishiya ma amɛ a mi ya. Ni komɛ kuɔ yoku ɔ kɛ ho Luhit ya, nɛ ni komɛ hu tu fo kɛ ho Horonaim ya kɛ ya boboobo, kɛ kɔmɔ yemi babauu.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Nimrim pa a mii ta, nɛ nga nɛ ngɛ pa a nya a gbli; nɔ́ mumu ko kulaa be lejɛ ɔ hu.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ ngɔ a weto ní tsuo kɛ tu fo kɛ gu Pamploo kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ho kɔ̃ ɔ se ya.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: A nu yana a boboobo ngɛ Moab huzu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. A nu ngɛ Eglaim kɛ Beerelim ma amɛ a mi hulɔ.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Dibon pa a pee tsutsuu kɛ muɔ sɔuu. Se Mawu to yayami nɛ pe enɛ ɔ po ha nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ a he maa je mi, nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ, haomi maa ba a nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ jata lɛ ba tua mɛ.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Moab bi ɔmɛ tsɔ nihi kɛ je Sela nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ a dɛ mi to ke a kɛ ya ha nɔ yelɔ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.

english_verse: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
translation_verse: Moab bi yi ɔmɛ ya pue si ngɛ Arnon pa a pomi he ɔmɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je a tsuhi a mi.

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: A de Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke, “Wa ngɛ nyɛ dɛ mi; nyɛɛ wo wɔ ga koo. Wa maa hi nyɛ ngɔ nɛ nyɛɛ baa wa yi kaa bɔ nɛ tso woɔ hɔ kudɔɔ ngɛ e sisi piani katakata a. Pe a fie wɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ wɔ ngɔ to; nyɛ ko tsɔɔ wa se blɔ.

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: Jehanɛ David nina ko ma ba ye matsɛ. Anɔkuale yemi kɛ suɔmi e kɛ maa ye ma a nɔ. E maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da; nɛ e maa ye dami sane.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a kpata Heshbon ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ Sibma wai tso ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Je ma amɛ a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ku tso kɔni ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ ya su Yazer, kɛ ya kpa nga kplanaa a nɔ tsuo; kɔni ɔmɛ gba kɛ ya su Ngo wo ɔ se tɔɔ.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bua jɔɛ e he ngɛ ngmɔhi nɛ baa ní saminya a a nɔ hu. Nɔ ko nɔ ko kpa we ngmlaa; nɔ ko nɔ ko la we ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ̃ wai kɛ ji wai yiblii mi hu. Lele hwɔmi ngɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ tsuo se po.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: I ngɛ ya foe kɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ha Moab; nɛ ye tsui ngɛ yee ngɛ Kir Heres he.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha momo nɛ kɔɔ Moab he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha etɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Moab ná, kɛ ma a mi nimli babauu ɔ tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ nihi nɛ a yi ma na wami be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sue; pohu a ma gbɔjɔ.”

english_verse: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Damasko be ma nitsɛ pee hu; e ma ba pee ma doku kulaa.

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Nimli be Siria ma amɛ a mi hie gblegbleegble hu. Lejɛ ɔmɛ maa pee tohi kɛ nahi a ní yemi he; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ fiee.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Israel be lɛ nitsɛ e he nyɛe ma fa hu, nɛ Damasko nɔ yemi ɔ se maa po. Siria bi nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ nɔuu. Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Be ma nɛ Israel hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo maa ta; sa a, a ná ní kpɔtɔɔ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a maa ye ohia.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami. Israel maa pee kaa oliv tso nɛ a kplɔ e nɔ yiblii tsuo: yiti je ɔ, yiblii enyɔ loo etɛ kɛkɛ lɛ maa hi tso kɔni ɔmɛ a he; sisi ɔ hu eywiɛ, loo enuɔ kɛkɛ. Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi maa kpale kɛ ba a bɔlɔ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba hla yemi kɛ buami.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a puɛ ɔ, a be mɛ bue hu. Níhi nɛ a kɛ a nine pee, amagahi nɛ a puɛ ha yo mawu nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a, kɛ la tɛhi nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, a be mɛ hu bue.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ kpɔ mo kɛ je o he nyɛli a dɛ mi, nɛ e pee kaa tɛ sa nguaa ko ha mo ɔ, o hɛ je e nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o ngɛ ngmɔhi nɛ ngɛ fɛu pee, nɛ o ngɛ ma se tsohi due ngɛ a mi.

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: Se ke tso ɔmɛ ma tsɛ̃, nɛ a ma gba mɔmɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ mɔtu ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ o du mɛ ɔ po, o be yiblii ko kulaa náe. Haomi kɛ he hiami nɛ be tsa ba mohu o ma ná. A ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ hia kɛ ma kaa wo oslɔke; se Mawu ku a nya la, nɛ a kpale a se kɛ yaa kaa bunyuku nɛ ngɛ tee puu ngɛ yoku he, loo kaa dwɔmi nɛ ahumi ngɔ kɛ yaa.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: Gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, a woɔ wa he gbeye, se benɛ mɔtu ke e suu ɔ, a be. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba fiaa wɔ ojo, nɛ a kpakpaa wa he ní kɛ yaa a, bɔ nɛ a nyagbe maa ba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
translation_verse: Zugba ko ngɛ Sudan pa amɛ a se kɛ e nɔ abalaa lɛhi babauu.

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: A tsɔ nihi kɛ je jamɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ma. A hi lɛhi nɛ a kɛ ngɔwu pee a mi kɛ gu Nilo pa a nɔ kɛ ma. Nyɛ tsɔli nɛ nyɛ he sɔɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya nyɛ zugba kɛ e mi pahi babauu ɔ nɔ. Nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ya ha nyɛ ma kɛ e mi katsɛmɛ, nimli gagaagahi kɛ a he womi nɔ tlotlootlo nɛ je ɔ tsuo yee mɛ gbeye ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Nyɛ, nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi, nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛ maa na aflangaa ko nɛ a si ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ! Nyɛɛ bu tue; nyɛ maa nu nɛ a ngɛ titimati kpae!

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa Yawɛ de mi ke, “Bɔ nɛ ngma kpami be mi je mi dɔɔ la nyɔ mi nɛ bɔ́ nɛɛ ɔ, loo bɔ nɛ ke pu tso ngmangmaangma nɛ je mi dɔɔ la, nɛ́ kɔɔhiɔ mi peeɔ kom ɔ, ja ma pee dii ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ hyɛ.

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Be ma nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma na nike ní kɛ je zugba kɛ e nɔ pahi babauu ɔ nɔ. E ma na nike ní kɛ je nimli gagaagahi kɛ a he tlotlootlo nɛ je ɔ tsuo yee mɛ gbeye ɔ a dɛ mi. A maa ba Zion yo ɔ nɔ, he nɛ a jaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Egipt he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yawɛ hi bɔku nɔ kɛ fo kɛ ma Egipt. Egipt amaga amɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli kaa Yawɛ ma, nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ hu sawale nu mɛ.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Ma ha ga amɛ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ to ɔ maa pee yaka, nɛ a mumu nya maa ta. A ma de amaga amɛ ke a ba piɛ a he; a ma ya bi ní ngɛ ní peeli a ngɔ, nɛ a ma bi ga womi kɛ je klamɔhi, kɛ kpade tsɛli a ngɔ.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɔ wo matsɛ yiwutsotsɛ ko dɛ mi; e maa ye a nɔ, nɛ a ma tsu ní kpakpataa ha lɛ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ nyu dɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ tae ɔ, a ma bɔni fu jemi. Ngɔwu kɛ go ma gbli;

english_verse: Fields along the Nile will be completely barren; every plant will disappear.
translation_verse: niba ní tsuo nɛ a du ngɛ Nilo pa a tue ɔ ma ngla, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ma kpata a hɛ mi.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Kpa tslɔli, kɛ kploba loli tsuo a nine mi maa je wu.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: A ma kpata ma a mi nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ apaa yeli ɔmɛ maa ye kɔmɔ.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Ganɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ Zoan ɔ, kuasiahi sɔuu ji mɛ! Ga woli nɛ a buu mɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ, ga yaya mohu a woɔ! Kɛ ba kɛɛ nɛ a deɔ matsɛ ɔ ke blema womi mi leli, kɛ matsɛmɛ a bimɛ ji mɛ kɛɛ?

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Egipt matsɛ, jije o ga woli nɛ le ní saminya a ngɛ? Eko ɔ, a ma nyɛ ma de mo yi mi nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ to ngɛ Egipt he.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Zoan kɛ Memfis ganɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, kuasiahi sɔuu ji mɛ. Mɛ nɛ́ a ko tsɔɔ ma a blɔ ɔ, mɛ mohu a ha ma a laa blɔ.

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Be ma nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ maa pee a he fɔ̃li kaa yihi. Ke a na kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ miɔ nɛ e kɛ e he wami ɔ maa gbla a tue ɔ, a he ma bɔni domi blibliibli.
