english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be nɛ a maa wo Yuda ta a, sawale maa nu Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ to nɛ maa ba Egipt nɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, Hebri gbi ji gbi nɛ a maa tu ngɛ Egipt ma ngua enuɔ ɔmɛ a mi. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ biɛ a kɛ ma ka kita. Nɛ a maa wo ma amɛ eko biɛ ke, “Pu ma.”

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a maa ma Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ; nɛ a maa to tɛ titima ko nɛ a gbaa nɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ Egipt huzu ɔ nya.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa da si kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ he okadihi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ yi mi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ wae ɔ he ɔ, e maa tsɔ nɔ ko nɛ e ba kpɔ mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma je e he si kɛ tsɔɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa le lɛ; a ma ja lɛ, nɛ a kɛ sami bɔhi, kɛ nike ní ma ba ha lɛ. A ma ka Yawɛ kita nɛ a maa ye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa fiaa Egipt bi ɔmɛ ní, se lɛ nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ ma tsa mɛ. A maa kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ; e maa bu a kue fami ɔmɛ tue, nɛ e ma tsa mɛ.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a maa je gbɛjegbɛ ko kɛ je Egipt kɛ ya Asiria. Egipt bi ɔmɛ maa ya Asiria bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ hu maa ya Egipt bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a maa pee kake kɛ ja Mawu.

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa gbaa mɛ ke, “A gbaa mo, ye ma, Egipt, kɛ Asiria nɛ i ngɔ ye nine kɛ bɔ, kɛ Israel, ma nɛ i hla ngɔ to kaa ye weto ní.”

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ, Sargon fa Asiria asafoatsɛngua a ke e ya tua Filisti bi a ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashdod ɔ.

english_verse: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
translation_verse: Jeha etɛ loko sane nɛ ɔ maa ba a, Yawɛ de Amoz bi Yesaya ke, “Je kpekpe ɔ ngɛ o mlɛ mi, kɛ tokota nɛ ngɛ o nane ɔ.” E bu tue, nɛ e pee ja; e hɛɛ e he gu, kɛ e nane gu.

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ maa nuu nihi ngɛ ma enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ho kɛ a he gu. Jokuɛwi kɛ nikɔtɔmahi tsuo maa nyɛɛ a nane gu, nɛ a maa hɛɛ a he gu; a supa nya tsuo maa fɔ si gu, nɛ zo maa gbe Egipt.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Filistia wo ɔ nya a ma de ke, ‘Nihi nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ kaa a ma je wɔ kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba! Wɔɔ lɛɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ nɛ wa yi ma na wami?’ ”

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Babilonia he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Kaa bɔ nɛ lasiogblee bee huu ngɛ leneyi je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ puɛɔ ní ɔ, jã kɛ̃ hɛ mi kpatami maa je zugba ko nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeye nɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: I na nina ko nɛ kɔɔ yi wu tso níhi nɛ maa ba a a he; a maa ngɔ nihi kɛ wo amanehlu mi, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata. Elam tabo, tee si nɛ o tua mɛ! Media tabo, wo ma amɛ a he ka! Amanehlu nɛ Babilon kɛ ba a, Mawu ma ha e se maa po.

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i nu nɛ ɔ wo ye he gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ ye he mi hia mi kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi.

english_verse: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
translation_verse: Ke e na okpɔngɔhi, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli nɛ a to enyɔɔnyɔ, loo nihi nɛ a hi tejihi, kɛ afukpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ ma a, e pee klaalo.”

english_verse: Then a guard said, “I have stood day and night on this watchtower, Lord.
translation_verse: Bulɔ ɔ kpa ngmlaa ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i daa si ngɛ ye blɔ he ɔ kɛ ngɛ bue nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo.”

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, ta zugba lɛ kɛ e mi nimli, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli nɛ to enyɔɔnyɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ ba hia kpo. Kɛkɛ nɛ bulɔ ɔ kpa ngmlaa ekohu ke, “Babilon hɛ mi kpata oo, e hɛ mi kpata! Amaga amɛ nɛ a ngɛ jae ɔ tsuo ku pueɔ si!”

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Edom he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ ko ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ je Edom kɛ ngɛ bie ke, “Bulɔ, nyɔ mi mɛni be ji nɛ ɔ? Bulɔ, ngmlɛ nyɛmɛ a fia?”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: I he nɔ ke, “Je na ta, se nyɔ maa kpale ba ekohu. Ke o suɔ kaa o ma ba bi si ekohu ɔ, kpale kɛ ba nɛ o ba bi.” Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Arabia he

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Arabia he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ Dedan blɔ hiali a kuu nɛ nyɛ ba pueɔ si ngɛ Arabia nga kplanaa a nɔ,

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: nibwɔhi nɛ kuma gbe mɛ nɛ a ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu. Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Tema zugba a nɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ ha mɛ nɔ ko nɛ a ye.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha kake pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, Kedar weku ɔmɛ a he wami ɔ se maa po.

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: Kedar kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li ji kã peeli pe kulaa nɛ a le, se a ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ maa piɛ. Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ nina kɔ̃ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Mɛni ba? Mɛni o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo kuɔ kɛ ho a tsuhi a yi mi ya ya ngɛ pee?

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: Ma a mi tsuo pee hoo kɛ ngmlaa kɛ gidigidi sɔuu. O nihi nɛ gbo nɛ ɔ, pi ta nya nɛ a nɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: O we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo kɛ je; a nyɛ we nɛ a tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ kake po, nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nuu mɛ nine nya. Nihi nɛ nine su a nɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ fo tue kɛ yaa tsitsaa loko a nuu mɛ.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ ye he nɛ ma nyɛ ya wawɛɛ ha nihi nɛ gbo ɔ. Nyɛ ko gba nyɛ he nya kaa nyɛ maa jɔɔ ye bua.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.
translation_verse: Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ ba wa nɔ ngɛ nina kɔ̃ ɔ mi ji haomi, basabasa peemi, kɛ gidigidi peemi sɔuu. A ku ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si. Ngmlaa ngɛ pɛe ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo kɛ ngɛ balɔ tsɛe.

english_verse: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hyɛ Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ hehi nɛ hia kaa a dla. Nyɛ hyɛ wehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ku ekomɛ kɛ pue si, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ dla fia gbogbo ɔmɛ. Jehanɛ, nyɛ susu nyu he,

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ pee nyu nɔ́ agbo ko ngɛ ma a mi, konɛ nyu nɛ jee taku momo ɔ mi ɔ nɛ sɛ mi. Nyɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ, se Mawu ɔ nɛ to ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a blɔ nya blema lokoo ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ hla we e se blɔ.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tsɛ ke nyɛ fo ya nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ; nyɛɛ sɛ nyɛ yi kpalokpalo, nɛ nyɛɛ ha kpekpe ya bo,

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: se nyɛ pee we ja; nyɛ muɔ nɛ nyɛ nya mohu. Nyɛ gbe to kɛ na nɛ nyɛ ye ní, nɛ nyɛ nu ní. Bɔ nɛ nyɛ de ji, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ye ní nɛ waa nu ní, ejakaa hwɔɔ pɛ wa ma gbo!”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ de mi ke, “A kɛ yayami nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ be mɛ pae a wami be ɔ tsuo. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.” A bɔ Shebna kɔkɔ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi Shebna, tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɔ ke ma ya de lɛ ke,

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: “Kɛ o susuu ngɛ o he kɛɛ? Mɛnɔ ji mo? Mɛnɔ ha mo he blɔ kaa o kpɛ yɔkɔ ha o he ngɛ tɛ sa mi ngɛ yoku nɛ ɔ he?

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: O susuu kaa nɔ ko nɛ he hia tsɔ ji mo, se bu tue, Yawɛ maa hɛ mo kɛ fɔ he.

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: E ma koklo mo lokotoo kaa bɔɔlu, nɛ e maa hɛ mo ngɔ fɔ zugba agbo gbajaa ko nɔ. Lejɛ ɔ o ma gbo ngɛ ngɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ ɔ a kasa nya. O pue o nyɔmtsɛ we ɔ hɛ mi si, mo zotsɛ!

english_verse: The Lord is going to take away your job!
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa ba mo si; a kpɔ o blɔ nya ngɛ o dɛ.”

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ o ní tsumi tade wuyaa a ngɔ wo lɛ, nɛ ma mia lɛ kɛ o mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ. Nɛ blɔ nya tsuo nɛ o hɛɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ wo e dɛ, nɛ e maa pee kaa tsɛ kɛ ha Yerusalem ma a, kɛ Yuda zugba a tsuo.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: He wami blɔ nya nɛ Matsɛ David sɛ ɔ hɛɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ ha lɛ. He wami blɔ nya nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa safe ko. Ke e bli ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma nga, nɛ ke e nga a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma bli.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Ma to lɛ si saminya, nɛ e he maa wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa tso plɛɛko nɛ e ma ba pee kaa jlasi ko kɛ wo e tsɛ we ɔ tsuo hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: “Se e tsɛ we ɔ, e bimɛ, e nyɛmimɛ, kɛ e nina tsuo ma ba pee tlomi ngɛ e nɔ kaa kutuhi kɛ kãhi nɛ kplaa si ngɛ tso plɛɛko he!

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi ja a, tso plɛɛko ɔ ma gbɔjɔ, nɛ e maa hia kɛ nɔ si. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ kplaa si ngɛ he ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Sidon jua yeli, nyɛ ma nyɛ nya! Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɔɔ nihi

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: kɛ poo wo kɛ ya heɔ blɛfo ngɛ Egipt, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo yeɔ jua a ji nɛ ɔ!

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: Sidon ma, zo gbe mo! Bɔ nɛ wo kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I fɔ we hyɛ, nɛ i lɛ́ binyumuwi kɛ biyiwi hyɛ.”

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Fonisia bi, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ ya Spania!

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ pee. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ a he nɔ womi ɔ se nɛ po, nɛ nimli nguangua amɛ hu a he guɛ nɛ gbo.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Nyɛ Spania bi, nyɛɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya hu. Ejakaa lɛsimuɔ he ko be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hu.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ e he wami kpata nɔ yemi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ wo se tsitsaa lokoo. Yawɛ nɛ ku Sidon mɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: Sidon ma, o bua jɔmi ɔ se po, nɛ a ngɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ yi mi wae. Ke a tu fo kɛ ho Kipro ya tete po, lejɛ ɔ hu, a be he jɔmi nae.

english_verse: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Tsa pi Asiria bi nɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ; Babilonia bi mohu nɛ ha lohwe dikali ba tua Tiro ma a; mɛ nɛ a fia kpoku kɛ wo Tiro ma a he, nɛ a ku mɔ nguangua amɛ kɛ pee lɛ ma doku.

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Spania akua hluili ngɛ wo nɔ, nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ! Ma nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, a kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: Mo, yaholɔ nɛ nihi a hɛ je o nɔ, ngɔɔ o kpa saku ɔ kɛ ya kpa ma a mi! Fiaa saku ɔ, nɛ o la kɛ to he kaa sa be ko ɔ, konɛ nyumuhi nɛ a ba o ngɔ ekohu!

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Sika nɛ e ma na kɛ je e jua yemi ɔ mi ɔ, e maa gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ. E be nya buae kɛ to, se mohu nihi nɛ ma ba ja Yawɛ ɔ, a maa ngɔ sika nɛ ɔ kɛ he niye ní, kɛ heha ní nɛ hia mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ zugba a maa fɔ si gu. E ma plɛ zugba a hɛ mi bu si, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, e maa gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Zugba a kɛ e nɔ níhi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ ble zugba a; nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi tɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ. A tsake blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ somi nɛ ngɛ daa a hu a yi nɔ.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Wai he be hu; ejakaa wai tso ɔmɛ gbli. Nihi tsuo nɛ a bua jɔ be ko ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Saku kɛ miɛ, la kɛ do nɛ a kɛ nyaa a tsuo se po.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Nihi pa nui wai nɛ a la kɛ to he hu; dã nɛ nya wa dooɔ ngɛ a nya mi.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Nihi ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; ejakaa wai ta. Bua jɔmi ta kulaa; bua jɔmi laa kaa nɔ ko nɛ a je lɛ we.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: A ku gbogbo ɔmɛ dukuduku ngɔ pue si, nɛ ma a tsuo plɛ pee ma doku.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a yi na wami ɔ ma la kɛ bua jɔmi. Nihi nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ ma de ke Yawɛ kle,

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ beleku je ma je e yi. Nihi nɛ ngɛ wo nya je ɔ hu ma je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi.

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Wa nu yi jemi lahi nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ je je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ dalɔ ɔ hɛ mi nyami woe. Se imi lɛɛ, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko kulaa be ha mi! He lo kɛkɛ i ngɛ tae. Ye yi ta pɛ! Yi mi sɔuu nɛ nihi ngɛ a sibi wae kpamisa.

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ma fo kɛ je gbeye ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ maa nɔ muɔ voo mi, nɛ nɔ nɛ be muɔ voo ɔ mi nɔe ɔ maa du klama. Hiɔmi maa nɛ piapiaapia, nɛ je ɔ sisi tomi ɔmɛ ma mimiɛ.

english_verse: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
translation_verse: Je ɔ mi ma gba; e maa ku, nɛ e maa gbɛ fĩa.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: E maa hi kpae kɛ hi yae kɛ hi bae kaa dã tɔlɔ, aloo ngmɔ si tsu nɛ kɔɔhiɔ sɛ mi. Yayamihi nɛ je ɔ tloo ɔ ngɛ lɛ gbee; ke e hule pue si ɔ, e be si tee gblegbleegble hu.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: Be ma nɛ Yawɛ maa gbla hiɔwe ta a, kɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a tue.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Mawu ma bua mɛ tsuo a nya kɛ wo muɔ voo mi kaa pamitsɛmɛ. E maa wo mɛ tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa gbla a tue.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Nyɔhiɔ maa wo diblii, nɛ pu be tsoe hu, ejakaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ye matsɛ. E maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ maa na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo ji ye Mawu; ma wo o hɛ mi nyami, nɛ ma je o biɛ ɔ yi; ejakaa o tsu nyakpɛ níhi. O yi mi tomi ɔmɛ nɛ o to blema lokoo ɔ, o ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: O ha mahi plɛ pee ma dokuhi, gbogbohi nɛ a fia wo a he ɔ, lɛ tsuo ku kɛ pueɔ si. Matsɛmɛ a mɔhi nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ ma a, a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, a be ekoeko nae hu gblegbleegble.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: O ngɛ kaa mɔ kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ. O ngɛ kaa mɔ kɛ ha nɔ́ nali. Mo ji a wesa he ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa mi, kɛ hɔ̃ ngɛ pu ngmangmaangma nya. Yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ a yi mi wa kaa ahumi ngɛ fĩɛ be mi po, o jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: Ose nɛ nibwɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ hee ɔ, o ku nya la kaa bɔ nɛ ke je mi dɔ la nɛ bɔku haa zugba jɔɔ ɔ. Nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ kpa a lami ɔ si kake too. Yawɛ maa ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngua

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ nɔ ha je ma amɛ tsuo. A maa ye ní kpakpa: lo nɛ tu zɔ saminya, kɛ zɔ nɛ a je kɛ je wu mi tɔɔ; nɛ a maa nu wai kpakpa.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu maa ye gbenɔ nɔ kunimi; e ma tsu nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi vo nyu, nɛ e ma je zo nɛ gbe e ma a ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ kɛ je. Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa bu Zion yo ɔ he, se Moab bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ, a maa naa a nɔ kaa a naa nga nɔ kɛ woɔ dwɔmi mi kɛ ya pueɔ kuku nɔ.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: Moab mɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a fia gbogbo gojogojoohi ngɔ wo a he ɔ, e maa ku mɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: Be ma nɛ ma a ma la la nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ: Wa ngɛ ma nɛ he wa! Mawu nitsɛ lɛ buu ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ a he!

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ bli agbo ɔmɛ, konɛ je ma amɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, a sɛ mi.

english_verse: The Lord gives perfect peace to those whose faith is firm.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ, nɛ e heɔ mo yeɔ ɔ, o haa lɛ tue mi jɔmi.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ daa; ejakaa Yawɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ kaa tɛ sa ko nɛ ngɛ daa.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a wa mɛ yi mi be ko ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ mɛ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ a ngɛ si sie ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, a blɔ da tlɔmɔɔ; mo lɛ o ha a blɔ da ja a nɛ.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa maa pee o suɔmi nya ní, nɛ wa maa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ; mo pɛ wa suɔ kɛ wa tsui tsuo.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Nyɔ mi ɔ, i hla o se blɔ kɛ ye tsui tsuo; ke o kojo je ɔ kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, loko a maa le nɔ́ nɛ ji dami sane yemi.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o to kaa o maa gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue, se a li tete. Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ, nɛ a na nɔ́. Gbla a tue kaa bɔ nɛ o to ha mɛ ɔ. Ha nɛ a na kaa o suɔ o ma a sane saminya.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo lɛ o haa wɔ tue mi jɔmi; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ pee ɔ, mo lɛ o peeɔ ha wɔ.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o se ɔ, nyɔmtsɛmɛ kpahi ba ye wa nɔ lɛɛ, se mo pɛ nɛ wa le.

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: O ha a gbo pɛsɛɛ, a be je mi hu; a kpadehi tete be si tee, ejakaa o gbla a tue; o kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kaii we mɛ hu.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mo lɛ o ha wa ma a he hiɛ babauu; o bli wa huzu ɔmɛ a mi kɛ kpe, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha o hɛ mi ba nyami.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o gbla o ma a tue; nɛ benɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, a fa kue kɛ tsɛ mo.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o ha nɛ waa kɛ he hiami kpa ngmlaa kaa bɔ nɛ yo nɛ hɛɛ mi nɛ e miɔ nɛ ma fɔ peeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Wɔ hu wa sɛ he hiami, kɛ gbenɔ mi ja, se nɔ́ ko ji mi kɛ bɛ. Wa nyɛ we nɛ wa he wa zugba a yi wami; wa nyɛ we nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ waa pee.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ye ma, nyɛ ya sɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ ngmɛ sinya amɛ a mi ngɔ wo nyɛ yi. Nyɛɛ laa nyɛ he be kpiti ko kɛ yaa si Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ nya maa be.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ e klaate kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ maa gbe wo mi sinɔ agbo langalanga a.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ma de ngɛ e wai ngmɔ saminyayoo ɔ he jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: “Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ i hyɛɛ e nɔ; i pueɔ nɔ nyu be tsuaa be. I buu e he nyɔ kɛ pia, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko ba kpata e hɛ mi.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: Ye wai ngmɔ ɔ he mi mi la ko be ye mi hu. Ke kaa miohi, kɛ mio pu kɛkɛ nɛ i kɛ gba ta a, jinɛ ma ya mɛ a he la, nɛ ma sã mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Se ke ye ma a a he nyɛli ngɛ hlae kaa ma bu a he ɔ, lɛɛ a kɛ mi nɛ ba kpata lolo. Niinɛ, e hia kaa a kɛ mi nɛ ba kpata.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbla we Israel tue wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e gbla a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue ɔ; nɛ Israel bi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ hu, a he híɛ kulaa kaa he nyɛli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.
translation_verse: Tue gblami nɛ Yawɛ ha e ma a ji, e ha a nuu mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya. E ha beleku kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ko ba muɔ mɛ kɛ ho.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Se bɔ nɛ Israel maa pee kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ konɛ a kɛ pa mɛ ji, a maa wɛɛ je ma amɛ a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ bukɔbukɔ kaa ayilɔ, nɛ yo mawu Ashera a tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, loo e we amaga amɛ ekoeko be si hie hu.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Tso kɔni ɔmɛ gbli, nɛ a ku kɛ pueɔ si; yi ɔmɛ ya buaa nya kaa lɛ́ nɛ a ma slɛ, ejakaa ma a nui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sisi. Mawu, a bɔlɔ ɔ mi mi be lɛ sãe ngɛ a he, nɛ e be mɛ mɔbɔ nae hulɔ.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Israel bi, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, kɛ je Yufrate pa a nya kɛ yaa si Egipt huzu ɔ nya a, Yawɛ ma bua e ma a nya kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi kakaaka kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ ngma mi sae, nɛ e ngɛ ngma nitsɛ ɔ hlae kɛ je tsakati ɔ mi.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ke jamɛ a ligbi ɔ su ɔ, a ma kpa titimati nguaa ko kɛ tsɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a kɛ je Asiria kɛ Egipt. A maa ba, nɛ a ma ba ja Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Musu tloo Efraim nina, Israel nɔ yemi ɔ. E hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ tae kaa mɔmɔ jlasi nɛ ma nimeli dã tɔli ngɔ fi a yi. A wo a yi mi nu je via saminya lɛɛ, se hyɛ mɛ nɛ a tɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ kɛ pueɔ si.

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ he walɔ katsɛ ko nɛ ma ba tua mɛ. E maa ba kaa gbiɛ ngo ngu; e maa fo dɔ kaa hiɔmi nyu nɛ bee lalaala, nɛ haa pa hyiɔ kɛ ywiaa nga kɛ haa zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ma nimeli dã tɔli he nɔ woli ɔmɛ ɔ, a maa ba mɛ si kulaa.

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ ke nɔ ko na ngmɔkɔ nɛ fu loko e fumi be su, nɛ e tsɔɔ nɛ e yeɔ tsuatsuaatsua a, ja ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa laa si kake too.

english_verse: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
translation_verse: Be ma nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa pee kaa mɔmɔ jlasi saminyayoo kɛ ha e ma mi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ.

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: E ma ha kojoli maa ye dami sane, nɛ ma a agbo nya buli ɔmɛ ma na he wami, nɛ a kɛ he nyɛli nɛ ma ba tua mɛ ɔ maa kpe. Yesaya bɔ Yuda gbali dã tɔli ɔmɛ kɔkɔ

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: Okplɔɔhi nɛ a hii a he ɔ tsuo peeɔ kpɔtɔɔ kɛ vie sɔuu; he ko he ko be nɛ tsɔ.

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa e maa tsɔɔ wɔ ní nyaa, ngmami okadi kakaaka, zã kakaaka, kɛ munyu tso ɔ hu kakaaka.”

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ be mi tue bue ɔ, lɛɛ Mawu maa gu nibwɔhi nɛ tuɔ ma se gbi nɛ nyɛ nui kulaa nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ní.

english_verse: He promised you perfect peace and rest, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Mawu de nyɛ ke e ma ha nyɛ he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi, se nyɛ bui lɛ tue fɛɛ.

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nyɛ he nɔ woli nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ nɔ yee ngɛ Yerusalem hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ɔ tue.

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Nyɛ ngɛ fĩae ke nyɛɛ kɛ gbenɔ so, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbeje pee kake. Nyɛ hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa ke haomi ba a, e be nyɛ he sae kulaa; ejakaa nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ lakpa, kɛ sisimi nɔ kaa nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he.

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I ngɛ sisi tomi ko nɛ he wa nɛ maa si kpɛii fiae ngɛ Zion; nɛ i ngɔ kɔ nya tɛ agbo ko kɛ ma mi. Nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, e toɔ e tsui si.’

english_verse: Justice and fairness will be the measuring lines that help me build.” Hailstones and floods will destroy and wash away your shelter of lies.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ dami sane yemi kɛ pee susumi kpa.” Ahumi kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu maa bɛɛ lakpa amɛ tsuo kɛ ho, nɛ pahi maa je a hi he ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: E maa ba nyɛ nɔ nɔtonɔto daa mɔtu. Nyɛ maa na amanehlu nyɔ kɛ pia. Sɛ gbi he tsuaa sɛ gbi he nɛ maa je Mawu ngɔ kɛ ba a maa wo nyɛ he gbeye wawɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma je e he wami ɔ kpo kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ngɛ Perazim yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Gibeon kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ, konɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ e to kaa e ma tsu ɔ; níhi nɛ e ma tsu ɔ maa pee nyakpɛ níhi nɛ eko bɛ hyɛ.

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ, e ko pee nyɛ muɔ hu! Ke nyɛ kɛ pee fiɛmi ɔ, nyɛ be nɔ́ nɛ ma a nya fo nyɛe maa tu. I nu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke e ma kpata zugba a tsuo hɛ mi. Mawu nile

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu mi tue; nyɛ ta tue ha nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ.

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: Ke e dla zugba a hɛ mi gbe nya a, anɛ e fĩa we pui wu, kɛ kowɛ lo? Anɛ e du we ngma zã nɔ zã nɔ, kɛ akoko hu ngɛ e blɔ he lo? Anɛ e du we ní kpahi kɛ wui huzu lo?

english_verse: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
translation_verse: Pui wu, kɛ kowɛ ɔ, pi tso kpoti nɛ a kɛ gbeeɔ, se tso zaayo kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Ngma nɛ a kɛ sãã abolo ɔ, a fɛ we mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ngma mi salɔ ɔ peeɔ ji e kɛ ngma mi sami nɔ́ hii ngma a mi sae hluu kɛ ya siɔ e naa ngma a bɔ nɛ sa pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nɛ e je; e woɔ ga nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ, nɛ e nile hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Musu tloo Yerusalem! Yerusalem, Mawu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ musu tloo lɛ! David ma nɛ e hi mi ɔ, musu tloo lɛ. Jeha kake, loo enyɔ komɛ kɛ a mi ní yemi, kɛ nyami ɔmɛ a se ɔ,

english_verse: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.
translation_verse: Yerusalem maa pee kaa kpade ko nɛ ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa e maa tu munyu kɛ je zu mi lokoo; e gbi ɔ maa pee kaa gugwɔ mi gbi.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma he o yi wami. E ma ha hiɔmi ma si, zugba ma mimiɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo maa pee hoo. Lasiogblee, ahumi, kɛ la gegeege maa ba;

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha mahe vii nɔ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ hwɔ mahe kulaa. Nyɛ gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ nɔ́ bu a hɛ mi, nɛ e ha a yi nɔ.

english_verse: Others say, “We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.”
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ya ha nɔ nɛ li womi mi ke e kane ha nyɛ ɔ, e ma de ke e li womi kanemi.

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma pee nyakpɛ níhi, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ekohu. A ní leli ɔmɛ a nile ɔ, kɛ a ga a maa pee yaka.” Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ ha hwɔɔ se

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Musu tloo nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa ngɔ ga nɛ a to ngɛ a yi mi ɔ kɛ laa Yawɛ. A toɔ a ga amɛ ngɛ laami mi, nɛ a susuu kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be mɛ nae, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ hu nɔ ko nɔ ko be lee.

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, tuekpokutsɛ maa nu nɛ a ngɛ womi kanee, nɛ hɛ yuyuili nɛ ngɛ diblii kpii mi ɔ, a hɛngmɛ maa hyɛ nɔ ekohu.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a he jɔ, dɛgutsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, Yawɛ Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ma ha mɛ bua jɔmi ekohu.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ bui Mawu, kɛ yayami peeli tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke o na bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ma ha mo ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi o ma de ke niinɛ, imi ji Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
translation_verse: Kuasiahi maa le ní, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ tuɔ munyu huitihuiti ɔ maa kase ní.”

english_verse: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Musu tloo Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ, ejakaa a kua mi. A toɔ gahi, nɛ a peeɔ níhi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a dɛ he. A kɛ nihi soɔ nɛ pi ye suɔmi nya. Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ kɛ tĩaa yayami ngɔ haa a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: A yaa Egipt nɛ a ya biɔ yemi kɛ buami kɛ jeɔ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, be nɛ imi lɛɛ a bi we mi ga womi.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ya su Egipt mahi nɛ a tsɛɛ Zoan kɛ Hanes momo mohu, se

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Mawu sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɔɔ lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ a he. “Ma tsɔli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ya gu zugba nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeyegbeye ɔ nɔ. Jatahi, sinɔ duɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ nyakahi nɛ tee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A ngɔ nike níhi nɛ a he jua wa ngɔ pue tejihi, kɛ yomahi a nɔ ya ke ma ko nɛ be nyɛe maa piɛ a he.

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Egipt be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nyɛe maa pee. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i wo lɛ se mi biɛ ke, ‘Nyaka nɛ tee, se e he be gbeye.’ ” Ma tue gboli

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Ejakaa ma atuã tsɔli ji mɛ; lakpatsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ bui Yawɛ mlaa a ji mɛ.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: A deɔ gbali ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko na ní; nyɛɛ gba ní kpakpahi mohu ha wɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ nɛ tu munyu nɛ maa ngɔ ngɛ wa tue mi; ke sisimi munyuhi pohu wa suɔ.

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko nyɛɛ Yawɛ se; nyɛɛ gu he kpa! Wa hla we nɛ waa nu nyɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ he sane ko!”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Se bɔ nɛ Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ bui nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ basabasa peemi, kɛ sisimi nɔ.

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: E maa gbɛ tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ kaa zu buɛ; e maa ywia yayaa, bɔ nɛ a be ngɛyu bɔbɔyoo po nae ngɛ mi nɛ a kɛ je la, loo nɛ a kɛ yɛ nyu ngɛ nɔ́ mi.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ ma a dee ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ kpoo. Ja jã loko nyɛ he maa wa, nɛ nyɛ ma na wami.” Se nyɛ kplɛɛ we kaa nyɛ maa pee ja!

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta bulɔ kake too maa wo nyɛ ta buli akpe fo; nɛ a nihi enuɔ pɛ maa wo nyɛ tsuo fo. Nyɛ tabo ɔ tsuo ma wo fo, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ se ji aflangaa tso nɛ maa si ngɛ yoku yi mi!

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɛ mlɛe kaa e maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ e peeɔ daa. Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, a naa bua jɔmi. Mawu maa gbaa e ma a

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yerusalem bi, nyɛ be ya foe hu! Yawɛ ɔ, mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ; ke nyɛ fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e ma he nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ha níhi a mi maa wa ha nyɛ lɛɛ, se lɛ nitsɛ e kɛ nyɛ maa hi si, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ní. E be hiae kaa nyɛ ma de ke nyɛ ma hla lɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa na lɛ hu.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ nyɛ gba kɛ je blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya hiɔ nɔ, loo muɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa nu e gbi ngɛ nyɛ se nɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Blɔ ɔ ji nɛ oo! Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ du ní ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ kɛ pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ niye ní babauu maa ba; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ na amɛ ma na zugba agbo nɛ a maa ye ní ngɛ nɔ.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Ligbi ɔ nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a maa ku a mɔ ɔmɛ kɛ pue si ɔ, nyu maa je yo gaga amɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ be babaaba.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Nyɔhiɔ ma kpɛ kaa pu, nɛ pu la a nya maa wa wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e nya waa daa a totoe si kpaago; e maa pee kaa ligbi kpaago pu tsotsoe tsuo nɛ a bua nya ngɔ ha ligbi kake. Plaami nɛ Yawɛ plaa e ma a, e maa fi pa amɛ a nɔ ha mɛ, nɛ pa amɛ ma gbo. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi jamɛ a be ɔ mi. Mawu maa gbla Asiria tue

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Yawɛ biɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ tsitsaa kɛ ma. E mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa la su ku kpii nɛ ngɛ si tee. Munyuhi nɛ ngɛ e nya mi jee ɔ, abofu sɔuu kaa la nɛ puɛɔ ní.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: Ke e wo mumi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa pa nɛ hia lalaala kɛ bee nɛ hyiɔ kɛ ya taa nɔ kuɛ si tɔɔ, konɛ e sa je ma amɛ a mi nɛ e gbla a tue. Kɛkɛ ɔ, yi mi yaya nɛ a to ɔ tsuo maa pee yaka.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ, Mawu ma a lɛɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma la kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ laa kɛ ngɔɔmi ke nyɛ ngɛ nyami be klɔuklɔu yee ɔ. Nyɛ bua maa jɔ kaa nihi nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ yaa Yawɛ yo ɔ nɛ ji Israel tɛ sa a nɔ kɛ a dɛ mi bɛhi nɛ a ngɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ he toe.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa na e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue, kɛ bɔ nɛ e mi mi fu wawɛɛ ɔ; la nɛ puɛɔ ní maa tso plamplam, nɛ ahumi maa fia; hiɔmi maa nɛ, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ma pue si.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Ke Yawɛ wo gbi ɔ, e maa gbla Asiria bi ɔmɛ a tue, nɛ sawale maa nu mɛ.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Ke Yawɛ nitsɛ ngɛ mɛ ní fiae ɔ, tue gblami tsuaa tue gblami nɛ e ma ha mɛ ɔ, e ma a maa hi miɛ, nɛ a maa fia saku kɛ to he.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Blema lokoo ɔ, a tsua muɔ ko nɛ a maa sã Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ mi. Muɔ ɔ mi kuɔ, nɛ e bli, nɛ a to lɛ́ babauu kɛ wo mi. Yawɛ mumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam ɔ maa sã lɛ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Musu tloo nihi nɛ yaa Egipt ya biɔ yemi kɛ buami ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Musu tloo mɛ, ejakaa a ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Egipt ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli a nɔ; ejakaa a hiɛ babauu, nɛ a he wa hulɔ. Se a ngɔɛ a hɛ kɛ fɔ we Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mohu nɔ; ga womi hu a bi we lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e gblaa nɔ tue. Ke e de nɔ ko ɔ, e kpale we e nya se. E gblaa yayami peeli kɛ a he piɛli tsuo a tue.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Egipt bi ɔmɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ; tsa pi Mawu ji mɛ. A we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, lohwehi kɛkɛ ji mɛ, tsa pi Mawu mumi nɛ ngɛ a mi. Ke Yawɛ gba ta a, je ma ko je ma ko be nya nyɛe maa da; je ma nɛ he wa jio, je ma nɛ a ya je ngmlaa ha lɛ jio, mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Bɔ nɛ to hyɛli kɛ a ngmlaa babauu nyɛ we nɛ a fieɔ jata kɛ jee e de lo he ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe maa tsi imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ye nya kaa ma bu Zion yo ɔ he.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ tee kɛ bɔleɔ e tsu kɛ buu e bimɛ a he ɔ, ja imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma bu Yerusalem he, nɛ ma fa e he.”

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Israel ma, nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si mi, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ!

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Be ma nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma sake amaga amɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ pee yayami ɔ ngɔ pue he. Amaga nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngɔ sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ pee.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: A kɛ ta ma kpata Asiria hɛ mi; se pi nɔmlɔ adesa he wami nya. Asiria bi ɔmɛ maa tu fo ngɛ ta nya, nɛ a nihewi ɔmɛ ma plɛ pee nihi nɛ a nyɛɔ a nɔ kɛ tsuɔ ní tsumi nɛ nya wa.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: A matsɛ ɔ kɛ sawale maa tu fo kɛ je, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu maa ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a maa ma fo kɛ je a ta aflangaa amɛ a he.” Yawɛ lɛ de. Lɛ ji Yawɛ nɛ a jaa lɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ a kɛ la sãã bɔ haa lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee kaa wesa he ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ kɛ ahumi nya, kaa pa nɛ ywia nga ngɛ zugba kpataa nɔ, aloo kaa zugba kplanaa nɔ tɛ sa sisi hɔ̃.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛngmɛ maa hyɛ nɔ́ paa, nɛ e tue hu maa nu nɔ́ saminya.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Tsui hahaahatsɛmɛ maa to a tsui si, nɛ a kɛ juɛmi kpakpa ma tsu ní, nɛ mumu hali a nya mi ma tsɔ.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: A be kuasia hɛ mi nyami woe hu, nɛ nɔ sisilɔ ɔ, a be lɛ tsɛe ke anɔkualetsɛ hu.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kuasia tuɔ munyu basabasa, nɛ e toɔ ga kaa e maa pee yayami. E tuɔ munyu, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ basabasa kɛ siɔ Yawɛ. Nɔ nɛ hwɔ ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, e ha we lɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e yeɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee hu e ha we lɛ nyu tete po nɛ e nuɔ.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Nɔ sisilɔ ɔ, ní yayahi a he ga pɛ e toɔ. E yeɔ lakpa konɛ e kɛ kpata dɛgutsɛmɛ a hɛ mi. Ke a sane da po, bɔ nɛ e peeɔ mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ lɛɛ ní kpakpahi a he e susuɔ, nɛ e yeɔ dami sane. Tue gblami kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba

english_verse: Listen to what I say, you women who are carefree and careless!
translation_verse: Nyɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mle yee, nɛ haomi ko be nyɛ nɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue.

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kpɔtɔɔ mi; se nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa jeha kake kɛ ligbi bɔɔ komɛ a se ɔ, nyɛ maa hao; ejakaa nyɛ be wai yiblii nae ma kpa hu.

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Nyɛ gba nyɛ gugue ma, nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ ngɛ ngmɔ kpakpa amɛ, kɛ wai nɛ baa saminya a he.

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: Se wɔ lɛɛ, Mawu ma ha wɔ e mumi ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ekohu, nɛ wa ma na niye ní babauu kɛ je ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: Honesty and justice will prosper there,
translation_verse: A maa ye dami sane ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Musu tloo he nyɛli ɔmɛ! A fia ojo nɛ a sisi nihi; se mɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko fiɛ mɛ ojo, nɛ nɔ ko sisi we mɛ hulɔ. A we ojo fiami, kɛ nɔ sisimi ɔ se maa po kɛ̃, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu a maa fia mɛ ojo, nɛ a maa sisi mɛ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ. Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ. Buu wa he be tsuaa be; nɛ ke wa ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, kpɔ wɔ.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: A níhi plɛɔ peeɔ ta yibu ní nɛ a haa gidigidi kaa baalɛhi peeɔ a ní.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: Yawɛ kle! E ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ. E ma ha a maa ye dami sane sɔuu; anɔkuale pɛ a maa tu ngɛ Yerusalem be tsuaa be,

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: nɛ ma a maa ya nɔ saminya. E buu e ma a he be tsuaa be; nɛ e haa ma mi bi ɔmɛ juɛmi kɛ nile. Yawɛ gbeye yemi ji nɔ́ ko nɛ he jua wa saminya kaa juetli agbo ha mɛ.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Hyɛ bɔ nɛ katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ha. Hyɛ bɔ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba a wo yana boboobo ha.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ba gbeye, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛɛ we a nɔ hu. A yi somihi a nɔ hu, ma kɛ ma jio, nɔ kɛ nɔ jio. Nɔmlɔ adesa pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Zugba a pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kɛ fɔɔ si. Lebanon hue ɔmɛ ta kulaa; Sharon zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a pee kaa nga kplanaa nɔ; tsohi nɛ ngɛ Bashan kɛ Karmel yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, a yi mi ba tsuo kplɔ kɛ pueɔ si. Yawɛ bɔ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɔkɔ

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ dee ke, “Jehanɛ e su be nɛ ma tsu ní. Ma tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa ye he wa.

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Nyɛ toɔ ga yayahi nɛ a he be se nami. Mumi nɛ nyɛ woɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ma kpata nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lokoo, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nya tsuo, nyɛ ta tue nɛ nyɛɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ i pee ɔ he, konɛ nyɛɛ na kaa ye he wa.”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Ee, nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e tuɔ anɔkuale, nɔ nɛ sume kaa e maa ye nɔ ko awi nɛ e kɛ na ní, nɛ e he we nyɔ mi ní hulɔ, nɔ nɛ tsiɔ e tue nɛ e ko nu muɔ si puemi sane ko, nɛ e kɛ e hɛngmɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ yaya a, e yi ma na wami.

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: Jamɛatsɛ ɔ ma ná he jɔmi kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ mɔ nɛ he wa saminya mi. E ma na ní maa ye, nɛ e ma na nyu maa nu. Be kpakpa maa ba hwɔɔ se

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma ná matsɛ ko nɛ maa ye tsɛ saminyayoo ngɛ zugba a gbo tɛtlɛɛ ko nɔ ekohu.

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma kai gbeye nɛ nyɛ ye blema a ngɛ tó nɛ ma se nɔ yeli tsu ngɛ nyɛ dɛ ɔ he; nɛ nyɛ ma kai nihi nɛ juɔ si ba slaa ma a hulɔ.

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ peeɔ nya puu, nɛ a tuɔ munyu nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nui sisi ɔ, nyɛ be mɛ nae hu.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, Zion, ma nɛ wa yeɔ wa nyami ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Yerusalem, ma nɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Yerusalem ngɛ kaa bo tsu nɛ maa si nɛ be si nɔe gblegbleegble. Tso plɛɛkohi nɛ a ka kɛ wo zu mi ɔ ekoeko be hiae; tangme kpa amɛ hu be tsɔe.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ma puplee maa pee kaa bunyuku. Hiɔwe ma koklo kaa womi kpo; nɛ dodoehi maa hɔle kɛ pue si kaa bɔ nɛ wai, loo ngmɔkɔ tso hɔleɔ ba kɛ pueɔ si ɔ.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: Yawɛ pee e klaate ɔ klaalo ngɛ hiɔwe, konɛ jehanɛ e kɛ gbe Edom bi ɔmɛ nɛ e de ke a ma kpata a hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: E klaate ɔ he maa pee kɛ muɔ kɛ zɔ kaa jijɔhi, kɛ akpakpohi a muɔ kɛ zɔ nɛ a kɛ ngɛ bɔ sãe. Yawɛ maa sã bɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Bozra ma a mi; e ma pue a muɔ si nyamaa ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Nimli ɔmɛ ma gbo kaa pu mi nahi, kɛ na ku katsɛmɛ. Zugba zu ɔ maa pee tsutsuutsu kɛ muɔ, nɛ zɔ ɔ ma futu zu ɔ tsɔfii.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Yawɛ to be ko nɛ e ma he Zion yi wami, nɛ e maa gbla a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Edom pa amɛ ma plɛ pee ama, nɛ zugba a maa pee ama kala. Zugba a tsuo ma mle kɛ la kaa ama nɛ ngɛ tsoe.

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: E maa tso nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ e be gboe. Zugba a nɔ maa je gu yi nɔhi babauu, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ nyɛɛe hu.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Se kayo, kɛ kɔtɔkɔ maa ngɔ lejɛ ɔ ngɔ pee a nɔ́; nɛ klomi kɛ kuakualabite maa hi lejɛ ɔ. Yawɛ ma ha zugba a nɔ maa je gu kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ be nɛ a bɔ je ɔ.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ko be si hie nɛ maa ye ma a nɔ, nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ta.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Mɔhi tsuo nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, pú kɛ mio tso maa puɛ ngɛ a mi, nɛ nga mi gbehi, kɛ dugumahi maa hi lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Nga mi lohwehi, kɛ ogbeteehi ma ba kpe, nɛ nibɔ níhi kɛ a he gbeyegbeye ma ba fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɔ mi kpadehi hu lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ma ba jɔɔ a he ngɛ.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ hla ngɛ Yawɛ womi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛɛ kane. Nyɛ maa na kaa nibɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ekoeko be laae, nɛ e he piɛlɔ be lɛ bɔe. Yawɛ lɛ fa, nɛ e mumi ɔ ha e ba mi ja.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Nga zugba kpataa nɛ gbli ɔ ma na bua jɔmi; zia zugba a ma nya, nɛ mɔmɔhi maa puɛ ngɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Niinɛ mɔmɔ babauu maa puɛ ngɛ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ bua jɔmi ma he ose ngɛ mɔmɔ ɔmɛ a he; e maa pee fɛu kaa Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; e maa ba ní kaa Karmel kɛ Sharon zugba a. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami, kɛ wa Mawu ɔ we agboje, kɛ e he wami ɔ.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Ninehi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ wo mɛ he wami; nɛ nakutsohi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a da si kpɛii.

english_verse: “Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ de nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e tsui ngɛ poe ɔ ke, “Wlua mo, koo ye gbeye! Hyɛ, o Mawu ɔ ma nɛ e ba kpɔ mo! E ma nɛ e ba gbla o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue.”

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: Hɛ yuyuili maa hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu, nɛ tuekpokutsɛmɛ maa nu nɔ́.

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: Glɔtsɛmɛ ma hlu kaa odabɔ, nɛ amuɛtihi ma la kɛ bua jɔmi. Pahi maa hia ngɛ nga kplanaa zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Blesiblesi ma plɛ pee taku, nɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi ma ha zugba gbigbli ɔ maa tɔ nyu. He nɛ nga mi gbehi hi sa a ngɛ nga mlɔmlɔɔmlɔ mi ɔ, ngɔwu, kɛ go maa puɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: A maa je gbɛjegbɛ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma tsɛ lɛ ke “Blɔ klɔuklɔu.” Yayami peelɔ ko yayami peelɔ ko be nyɛe ngɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ gblegbleegble; nɛ blɔ hialɔ kuasia ko be tlae kɛ ba blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Jata ko be lejɛ ɔ hie, lohwe awi yelɔ ko hu be jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ nyɛɛe. Nihi nɛ Yawɛ he a yi wami ɔ, mɛ a maa nyɛɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: A maa kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem; a ma la nɛ a ma hwɔ lele. A be kɔmɔ kɛ aywilɛho yee gblegbleegble hu. A bua maa jɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Hezekia nɛ mlɔɔ nyɛ ke Yawɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami. Anɛ je ma amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ eko nyɛ kpɔ e zugba kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi hyɛ lo?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ te da si nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ngɛ Hebri gbi ɔ mi ke, “Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Asiria matsɛ nguaa ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue.

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Jije Hamat, kɛ Arpad mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ? Nɛ jije Sefarvaim mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ. Anɛ a nyɛ kpɔ Samaria kɛ je ye dɛ mi lo?

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ je kpo nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba kpe: Hilkia bi Eliakim nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ; Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ; kɛ Asaf bi Yoa nɛ ngmaa sanehi kɛ toɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Asiria asafoatsɛ ɔ de mɛ ke Asiria matsɛ nguaa a tsɔ mɛ ke a ba bi Matsɛ Hezekia nɔ́ nɛ ha nɛ e yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko gbeye ɔ.

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: E bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o susuu kaa nya puu peemi ji ga kɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ hwuɔ ta lo? Mɛnɔ nɔ po o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ loko o tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã a?

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Asiria asafoatsɛ ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Aloo o ma de mi ke o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɔ! Anɛ pi Yawɛ jami he ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Hezekia ywia a? Pi lɛ nɛ e de Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem ke a ya ja Mawu ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ pɛ hɛ mi lo?

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: O ngɛ blɔ hyɛe nɛ Egipt ba ha mo ta zugba lɛhi kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli, be mi nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ nyafii pe kulaa a po o be lɛ nyɛe.

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliakim, Shebna, kɛ Yoa de asafoatsɛ ɔ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, kɛ wɔ nɛ tu Aram gbi. Wa nuɔ Aram gbi ɔ. Koo tu Hebri gbi; nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ wɔ tue bue.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Se asafoatsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ susuu kaa nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛkɛ matsɛ nguaa tsɔ mi ke ma ba de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ lo? Nihi nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu munyu nɛ ɔ kɔɔ a he; a maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a fĩ, nɛ a maa nu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zami kaa nyɛ nɔuu.”

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: hluu kɛ yaa si be nɛ matsɛ nguaa a ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya zugba ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ. Wai ngmɔhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee wai; blɛfo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee abolo.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ tsuo a mawu ɔmɛ a ti eko nyɛ kpɔ e ma kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi hyɛ lo? Lɛɛ mɛni haa nɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa Yawɛ ma nyɛ kpɔ Yerusalem ngɛ ye dɛ mɔ?”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliakim, Hilkia binyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ, Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf binyumu ɔ nɛ ji sanehi ngmalɔ ɔ kɛ aywilɛho hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he; nɛ a ho ya bɔ Matsɛ Hezekia níhi tsuo nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ ɔ de ɔ.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Hezekia nu amaniɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho hía e tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he. E ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Hamat matsɛ, Arpad matsɛ, Sefarvaim matsɛ, Hena matsɛ, kɛ Iva matsɛ ɔ, jije a ngɛ?”

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ e ha mɛ kɛ ya ha Yesaya a ji, “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, wa yi fi; a jɛ wɔ, nɛ a pue wa hɛ mi si. Wa pee kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi, se e be he wami nɛ e kɛ maa kɛ̃ bi ɔ kɛ je kpo.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ tsɔ e we asafoatsɛngua a kɛ ba jɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ. Wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nu kikɛmɛ a jɛmi ɔ, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ bɔ musu nɛ ɔ, e maa gbla a tue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo fa kue ha Yawɛ kɛ ha wa ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesaya nine su Matsɛ Hezekia sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ,

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: e ngɔ Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ mane lɛ ke, “Munyuhi nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ Asiria matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba tu kɛ pue ye hɛ mi si ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye ngɛ he.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Hyɛ! Ma ha mumi ko maa ba e nɔ, nɛ e maa nu akeake munyu ko nɛ ma ha e maa kpale kɛ ya lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ, nɛ ma ha e maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Asiria bi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba ekohu (Matsɛmɛ II,

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Asiria asafoatsɛngua a nu kaa Asiria matsɛ ɔ hia kɛ je Lakish, nɛ e kɛ Libna bi ya ngɛ ta hwue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya na lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko ba su Asiria matsɛ ɔ, kaa Sudan matsɛ, Tirhaka hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ Egipt tabo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma nɛ e ba tua lɛ. Benɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ nu sane nɛ ɔ, e ngma womi, nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya ha Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Mo nitsɛ o nu níhi nɛ Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee zugba amɛ; bɔ nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi butuu. Nɛ moo lɛɛ o susu kaa o maa ye o he lo?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Benɛ nɛnɛmɛ kpata Gozan, Haran, kɛ Rezef ma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a gbe Beteden bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Telasa zugba a nɔ ɔ, anɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nyɛ a yi wami he lo?

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Hezekia he womi ɔ ngɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ e kane. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya, nɛ e ya bli womi ɔ mi gbajaa ngɔ pue si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi,

english_verse: Then he prayed:
translation_verse: nɛ e fa kue ke,

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Israel Mawu lee, mo nɛ o hii si ngɛ o matsɛ sɛ nɔ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a yi mi lokoo; mo nɔ kake too pɛ ji Mawu, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ o sisi. Mo lɛ o bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba!

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, wɔ tsuo wa le kaa Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kpata je mahi, kɛ a zugbahi babauu a hɛ mi,

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɛ e gu nɔ kɛ ba a, jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ nɔuu e maa gu kɛ kpale kɛ ho; se ma nɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ e be sɛe. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: O tsɔ o tsɔli kɛ ba ye imi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye he fɛu, nɛ o de ke, ‘I ngɔ ye ta zugba lɛhi kɛ kuɔ yo ɔmɛ kɛ ya su Lebanon tɔɔ. I poo Lebanon seda tso gagaa amɛ, kɛ sɛsɛo saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si. I sɛ Lebanon hue kusuu ɔ mi kɛ ya tsitsaa lokoo.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: I tsua vuhi nɛ i nu ma se zugba nɔ nyu; i ngɔ ye nane sisi kɛ naa Egipt pa amɛ tsuo a mi nɛ nyu ɔ ta!’

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: “Anɛ o nui kaa i bɔni nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ní tsumi kɛ je kɛ lo? Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, i to he ga kɛ je blema lokoo, konɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee mɛ ma dokuhi.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi lɛɛ a he wami nɔ gbɔ. A tsui po, nɛ bibi gbe mɛ. A pee kaa nga mi tsohi. A pee kaa nga mumu, loo nga nɛ pu sã lɛ, nɛ e ngla ngɛ tsu yi mi.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: “I le o he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɔ́ nɛ o peeɔ, he nɛ o yaa, kɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ mi tuɔ munyu basabasa a.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ o kɛ mi tuɔ munyu basabasa, nɛ i nu o he nɔ womi hu he he je ɔ, ma ngɔ gbowe kɛ wo o gugwɔ mi; ma wo o nya mi dade, nɛ ma kpale mo kɛ gu blɔ nɛ o gu kɛ ba a nɔ.”

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yesaya de Matsɛ Hezekia ke, “Enɛ ɔ maa pee okadi ha mo; jeha nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a puɛ, níhi nɛ nɔ ko du we. Jeha enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye níhi nɛ puɛ ngɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a se. Jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ nyɛ ma du ní, nɛ nyɛ ma kpa ní; nyɛ maa pee wai ngmɔhi nɛ nyɛ maa ye a yiblii.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Yuda we ɔ mi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, a ma plɔke kaa tsohi; a ma tsɛ̃ sipoku kɛ ya zu mi ekohu, nɛ a maa wo yiblii.
