english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ maa piɛ kɛ̃, nɛ a maa je Yerusalem kɛ Zion yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya; ejakaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ hɛdɔ.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Asiria matsɛ Senakerib hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho Nineve ya.

english_verse: The Lord sent an angel to the camp of the Assyrians, and he killed
translation_verse: Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ko ya gbe ta buli

english_verse: of them all in one night. The next morning, the camp was full of dead bodies.
translation_verse: ngɛ Asiria ta a mi. E nɔ jena makɛ ɔ, ne mɛ nɛ a gbo kɛ pueɔ si.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko, benɛ e ngɛ e mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Nisrok ɔ jae ngɛ e mawu ɔ we ɔ mi ɔ, e binyumuhi enyɔ, Adramelek kɛ Sharezer kɛ klaate ya gbe lɛ, nɛ a tu fo kɛ ho Ararat zugba a nɔ ya. E bi nyumu kpa nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Esarhadon ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o he ye yi wami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa wami ligbihi tsuo ɔ, wa ma la, nɛ wa maa fia kpa saku kɛ to he kɛ je mo, Yawɛ o yi, ngɛ o we ɔ.

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Matsɛ Hezekia ba nu hiɔ, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo. Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz binyumu ɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Moo to o níhi blɔ nya ngɛ o we ɔ mi, ejakaa o yi be wami nae; o ma gbo!’ ”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: I susu kaa i be Yawɛ nae gblegbleegble ngɛ hɛ kali a zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ. I susu hu kaa i be ye nyɛmimɛ adesahi nae ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi hu.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kai bɔ nɛ i ba ye je mi ngɛ o hɛ mi, bɔ nɛ i ye mo anɔkuale, bɔ nɛ i sɔmɔ mo kɛ ye tsui tsuo, kɛ bɔ nɛ i pee o suɔmi nya ní.” Nɛ Hezekia fo ya kɛ he hiami.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Yesaya

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: ke e ya nɛ e ya de Hezekia ke, “Imi Yawɛ, o nɛ̃ David Mawu ɔ, i nu o kue fami ɔ, nɛ i na o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ. Ma ngɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ngɔ piɛ o wami ligbi ɔmɛ a he ha mo.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Kɛ ma de kɛɛ? Bɔ nɛ e de ɔ, jã e pee ɔ nɛ. Ye tsui ngɛ yee sɔuu, i nyɛ we ma hwɔ mahe.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Ma he o kɛ Yerusalem yi wami kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ ma bu ma a he.”

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: Yesaya he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ ma ha mo okadi nɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa si nɛ e wo mo ɔ, e maa ye nɔ.

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ nini ɔ nɛ ngɛ pu ngmlɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz pee ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ba se nane hiami nyɔngma.” E ba mi ja; niinɛ Yawɛ ha pu ɔ kpale e se, nɛ nini ɔ nɛ ngɛ pu ngmlɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ kpale e se nane hiami nyɔngma nɛ e nyɛɛ momo ɔ.

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Benɛ Yuda matsɛ Hezekia na he wami ɔ, e ngma yi jemi la nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke ye nihe be mi ma gbo ngɛ. Ee, ye wami be nɛ piɛ ɔ, gbeje ma ye lɛ tsuo ngɛ.

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: A po ye wami nɔ kpiti kulaa; ye wami ɔ nya ta. E pee kaa to hyɛlɔ bo tsu nɛ a kpa ngɔ fɔ si, loo kaa bo nɛ bo lolɔ po nɔ ngɛ e bo lomi tso ɔ he. I susu kaa Mawu ha ye wami nyagbe ma amlɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Nyɔ mi tsuo i ngɛ kɛmɛe kaa nɔ́ nɛ jata lɛ ngɛ ye mi wuhi kue. I susu kaa Mawu ha ye wami nyagbe ma amlɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: Ye gbi mia, he wami ko be hu. I ngɛ kɛmɛe kaa beleku lahuɛ. I hyɛ hiɔwe hluu kɛ ya si pɔ tɔ ye hɛngmɛ he. Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, e fi mi; jé mi kɛ je haomi nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, o nɔ ji mi. Ee, mo pɛ o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ. Ha ma na he wami ekohu, nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, kpakpa nɛ o ngɛ hlae ha mi he je nɛ haomi nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ ba ye nɔ ɔ nɛ; se o je mi kɛ je hɛ mi kpatami mi; ejakaa o kɛ ye he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo pa mi.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Ni gbogboehi be nyɛe ma je o yi. Ee, ni gbogboehi be nyɛe maa na mo si. Ni gbogboehi be nyɛe maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ kaa o yeɔ anɔkuale be tsuaa be.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle! Ee, hɛ ngmengmletsɛmɛ nɛ a jeɔ o yi kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ o yi jee mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ. Tsɛmɛ tsɔɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ ke o yeɔ anɔkuale be tsuaa be.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Yesaya de matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wɛɛ ngmɔkɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ya to e tslɔɔ ɔ nɔ, kɛkɛ e ma na he wami.”

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Hezekia hu bi Yesaya ke, “Mɛni okadi o maa to mi kaa niinɛ ma nyɛ ma ya Yawɛ we ɔ?”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Hezekia he tsɔli ɔmɛ atuu, nɛ e ngɔ matsɛ mɔ ɔ mi ní kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ: sika tsu, sika hiɔ, tsopa kɛ e he via, nu kpakpa, e ta níhi tsuo, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ nito he ɔmɛ. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e we ɔ mi, loo e nɔ yemi he nito he tsu ɔmɛ a mi nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ we mɛ.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Merodak Baladan, Baladan bi nyumu ɔ, nu kaa Matsɛ Hezekia ba na we he wami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngma womi, nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a kɛ nike ní piɛ he ya ha lɛ.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya ba Matsɛ Hezekia ngɔ, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, jije a je, nɛ mɛni a ba de mo?” Hezekia he nɔ ke, “A je Babilonia zugba a nɔ, ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.”

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yesaya de Hezekia ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: be ma nɛ a ma ba muɔ o we ɔ mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, kɛ níhi nɛ o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bua nya ngɔ to kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya; a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sie. Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: A maa nuu mo nitsɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ po kɛ ya Babilonia; a maa puɛ mɛ, nɛ a ma ya sɔmɔ ngɛ Babilonia matsɛ we ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Se Matsɛ Hezekia susu kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba ngɛ lɛɛ e yi nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Yesaya ke, “Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ o ngɔ ba ha mi ɔ hi.”

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ wo Yerusalem ma a bua. Nyɛ de nɛ a nu kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ a nɔ́ nami babauu ɔ se po, nɛ a ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ. I gbla a tue saminya ngɛ a tɔmi ɔmɛ tsuo a he.”

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Gbi ko ngɛ pɛe ke, “Nyɛ dla blɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ ha Yawɛ! Nyɛɛ je gbɛjegbɛ tlɔmɔɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ha wa Mawu ɔ!

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa je kpo paa nɛ nimli adesahi tsuo maa na. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: Gbi ko ngɛ pɛe ke, “Moo fiɛ!” I bi ke, “Kɛ ma fiɛ kɛɛ?” Moo fiɛ ke, “Nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ kaa nga, nɛ a he fɛu tsuo ngɛ kaa mɔmɔ ngɛ nga nɔ.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: Ke Yawɛ kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ gu a nɔ pɛ nga a gbli, kɛkɛ mɔmɔ ɔ hu ngla. Niinɛ, nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa nga kɛkɛ!

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Nga gbliɔ, nɛ mɔmɔ hu nglaa; se wa Mawu ɔ munyu ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.” Ne nyɛ Mawu ɔ

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Zion, mo manye munyu fiɛlɔ! Kuɔɔ kɛ ya yo gagaa ko nɔ, nɛ o ya fiɛ manye munyu ɔ kɛ he wami. Yerusalem, mo manye munyu fiɛlɔ, wo o gbi nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ o fiɛ; koo ye gbeye! De Yuda ma amɛ ke, “Ne nyɛ Mawu ɔ!”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ma kɛ he wami; e ngɛ tsɛ yee; e hɛɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a hiɔwo kɛ ma; e maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu he.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: E maa lɛ e to kuu ɔ kaa to hyɛlɔ kpakpa; e ma bua e to bi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ e maa hɛɛ mɛ ngɛ e bɔkɔ mi; to nyɛ ɔmɛ hu e ma tsɔ̃ mɛ blɛuu. Israel Mawu ɔ se be

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ hɛɛ nyu tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo mi ɔ ngɛ e dɛ kɔkɔ mi hyɛ? Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɔ e nine mi blimi kɛ susu hiɔwe hyɛ? Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɔ je nɛ ɔ mi tabo zu tsuo kɛ wo kplu mi hyɛ? Loo e ngmɛ yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ ngɛ sɛni nɔ hyɛ?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ tsɔɔ Yawɛ mumi ɔ nɔ́ nɛ e pee? Mɛnɔ lɛ tsɔɔ lɛ ní, loo e wo lɛ ga hyɛ?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ toɔ ga, nɛ e tsɔɔ Mawu nile, nɔ́ sisi numi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ da?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. A ngɛ kaa nyu kɔyi kake kɛkɛ nɛ dɛ kɛ je goga mi. Zugba kpɔ ɔmɛ nɛ wo bɔle mɛ ɔ hu ngɛ wojowojo ngɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi kaa bunyuku nɛ pue sɛni nɔ.

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Lebanon tso ɔmɛ tsuo a he pi nɛ a kɛ ma slɛ la. Lohwehi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu a he pi nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ.

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Amaga lo? Amaga nɛ tso galɔ kpɛ, nɛ sika galɔ ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha he, nɛ e ngɔ sika hiɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ngɔ kpla lɛ ɔ!

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Dɛgutsɛ lɛɛ bɔ nɛ e peeɔ ji, e ngɔɔ tso kpakpa kɛ haa tso galɔ nɛ le ní tsumi saminya. Tso galɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔɔ tso ɔ kɛ peeɔ amaga ha lɛ, amaga nɛ mimiɛ we e he.

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Mawu ji nɔ nɛ bɔ je ɔ nɛ; e hii si ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo, nɛ je ɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ e sisi. Nimli adesahi ngɛ kaa angmɛɛtɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi. Mawu bli hiɔwe mi kaa bo, nɛ e pee lɛ kaa bo tsu nɛ a hiɔ mi.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: Ganɔhi po e baa mɛ tsuo si, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ yeli posoposo.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: A ngɛ kaa tso tsɔwi nɛ a du kɛ we, nɛ́ a sipokuhi mɛ si kpakpa ko lolo. Ke Yawɛ ha kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ gu a nɔ kɛkɛ a gbliɔ, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ bɛɛɔ mɛ kɛ yaa kaa nga.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ he nyɛ maa ngɔ Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ to? Mɛnɔ kɛ lɛ sɔ?

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Nyɛ wo nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ hiɔwe! Mɛnɔ lɛ bɔ dodoe ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ? Nɔ nɛ jeɔ mɛ kpo kaa ta buli babauu, nɛ e kɛ eko tsuaa eko biɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ɔ! E he wami, kɛ nyɛmi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya a, kake ngmelu po laa we.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Israel, lɛɛ mɛni he je o ngɛ dee ke Yawɛ li kaa o ngɛ nɔ́ nae, nɛ e bui kaa a ngɛ mo amimi yee ɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Anɛ o li lo? Anɛ o nui lolo lo? Yawɛ ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ daa kɛ daa; lɛ ji nɔ nɛ bɔ je ɔ tsuo. Pɔ tɔɛ lɛ, nɛ e gbɔjɔɔ we. Bɔ nɛ e juɛmi mi kuɔ ha a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa nu sisi.

english_verse: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ, nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ, e haa mɛ he wami.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Nihewi kpakpataa po gbɔjɔɔ, nɛ pɔ tɔɔ mɛ; nihewi a he wami taa, nɛ a nɔɔ si.

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, a naa he wami he kaa kɔle nɛ ngɛ tee; a tuɔ fo, nɛ pɔ tɔɛ mɛ, a nyɛɛɔ, nɛ a gbɔjɔɔ we.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: Mawu ke, “Nyɛ, wo nya mahi, nyɛɛ pee dii, nɛ nyɛɛ bu mi tue! Nyɛ dla nyɛ he saminya, konɛ waa hyɛ sane ɔ mi! Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ nyɛ ba je nyɛ nya, nɛ waa hyɛ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: E nyɛɛɔ a se kɛ fo wawɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e nane ma we zugba, nɛ e nine ya suu a nɔ kɛ̃.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ pee enɛ ɔ? Mɛnɔ lɛ tsɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je sisije? Sisije ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ nyagbe ɔ hu, imi Yawɛ nɔuu ma hi lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: “Se mo, ye tsɔlɔ Israel, mo ji ma nɛ i hla, ye huɛ Abraham nina.

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: I ngɔ mo kɛ je je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ kɛ ba; i tsɛ mo kɛ je ma se lokoo, nɛ i de mo ke, ‘Ye tsɔlɔ ji mo.’ I kua we mo, se mohu, i hla mo.

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Koo ye gbeye. I kɛ mo ngɛ! Ko ha nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ wo o he gbeye. Imi ji o Mawu ɔ nɛ! Ma wo mo he wami; ma piɛ o he; Ma bu o he, nɛ ma baa o yi.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ kɛ mo ná a, o be mɛ nae hu; nihi nɛ hia ta wo mo ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ; imi lɛ i ngɛ mo he wami woe ɔ nɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ke, ‘Koo ye gbeye! Ma piɛ o he!’ ”

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Yakob, o ngɛ kaa gɔgɔ kɛkɛ; o Israel, ma nɛ o he wɛ, koo ye gbeye; ma piɛ o he. Imi, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, imi ji o yi wami helɔ.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, ma pee mo kaa ngma mi sami he klama kɛ e lunguhi nɛ a nya ba. O maa ywia yo ɔmɛ, nɛ o maa pee mɛ butuu; o maa pee yoku ɔmɛ kaa jakati.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: O maa fɔ̃ mɛ kɛ ya kɔɔhiɔ mi; nɛ kɔɔhiɔ maa muɔ mɛ kɛ ho. Ahumi maa gbɛ mɛ kɛ fĩa; se moo lɛɛ, o bua maa jɔ saminya; ejakaa imi ji o Mawu ɔ nɛ. O ma je imi! Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ, ye yi.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: “Ke ye ma a ní pee mɔbɔ, nɛ a nɛ nyu nɛ a nu, a kuɔ si tsuo gbli, nɛ kuma ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ, ke a fa kue kɛ tsɛ imi Yawɛ ɔ, ma bu mɛ tue. Imi Israel Mawu ɔ, i be mɛ kuae kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Ma ha pahi maa hia ngɛ yo kpataa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyu maa fo dɔ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi. Ma ha nga kplanaa a nɔ ma plɛ pee taku, nɛ nyu maa ba babaaba ngɛ zugba gbigbli ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Ma ha seda tso, akasia tso, mɔmɔ tso, kɛ oliv tso maa bɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ. Ma ha zugba nɛ nɔ́ ko be nɔ ɔ ma plɛ pee hue nɛ sɛsɛo, papao, kɛ nga mi tsohi ngɛ mi.

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: Mahi tsuo maa na nyakpɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a maa le kaa imi Yawɛ, Israel Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ i tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yawɛ pue lakpa mawu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, Israel matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nyɛ je ma amɛ, nyɛɛ jaje nyɛ sane ɔ nɛ waa nu. Nyɛ je nyɛ we odase ɔmɛ kpo.

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba gba níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se, konɛ ke a ba mi ɔ, waa le kaa ja nyɛ de ɔ nɛ. Níhi nɛ ba momo ɔ, nyɛ gba mi kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ wɔ a sisi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: “I ha nɛ nɔ ko je beleku je kɛ ma nɛ e kɛ nyɛ ba kpe. E maa ba ngɛ ye biɛ mi. E ma ba tua nyɛ kɛ je omleyi je. E maa naa nɔ yeli a nɔ kaa a naa zu, loo kaa buɛ puɛlɔ pɔtɔɔ zu.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Imi Yawɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ bɔ Zion amaniɛ nɛ ɔ. Imi nɛ i tsɔ nɔ Yerusalem kɛ manye munyu ke, ‘O ma mi bi ɔmɛ ma oo! A ma we!’

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ye tsɔlɔ, nɔ nɛ i kplɛɛ we nɔ́ ngɛ e he ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ nɛ i hla nɛ i suɔ e sane ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. I ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo e mi, nɛ e maa ye dami sane kɛ kojo je ma amɛ tsuo.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: E be ngmlaa kpae, nɛ e be munyu tue boboobo nɛ a nu ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: Ngɔwu nɛ mi dɔ momo ɔ, e be mi kue, nɛ kane nɛ ngɛ tsoe sulii ɔ, e be gbee. E maa ye dami sane kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: E kɔni mi be jɔ̃e, nɛ pɔ be lɛ tɔe kɛ yaa si dami sane yemi ma he si ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo. Zugbahi nɛ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo ɔ po maa hyɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ba wo mɛ ga.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe, nɛ e bli mi gbajaa. Lɛ nɛ bɔ zugba a, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ. Lɛ nɔ nɛ ha nimli adesahi tsuo wami kɛ mumi ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: “Imi Yawɛ lɛ i tsɛ mo; i baa o yi, nɛ i ha mo he wami, konɛ o hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane ngɛ je ɔ mi. Ma gu o nɔ nɛ i kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa so, nɛ a ma na la.

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: O ma bli hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu, nɛ a hii si ngɛ diblii mi ɔ, o ma ha a maa ye a he.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: “Ye biɛ ji Yawɛ; imi pɛ ji Mawu. I be ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɔe kɛ ha mawu kpahi, nɛ ye yi jemi ɔ hu i be ngɔe kɛ ha amagahi.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ koo! Níhi nɛ i de to blema a ba mi. Jehanɛ, ma gba nyɛ níhi nɛ maa ba. I ngɛ nyɛ dee loko a ba mi.” Yi jemi la

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Nyɛ la la he ha Yawɛ; nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ la kɛ je e yi! Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ wo hɛ mi, nyɛ je e yi! Nibɔ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi, nyɛ je e yi! Zugbahi ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ a nɔ, nyɛ je e yi!

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: Yawɛ hia kpo kaa ta bulɔ; e hia kpo kaa ta bulɔ nɛ hɛ dɔ. E ngɛ ngmlaa kpae. E ngɛ ose hee kɛ ngɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ woe kaa e kɛ mɛ maa to ní. Mawu wo si kaa e maa piɛ e ma a he

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Mawu ke, “I pee kpoo hluu; i ma ye nya, nɛ i ye ye he nɔ. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su; ma kpa ngmlaa kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi, ma kɛmɛ kaa nɔ nɛ mumi nya ngɛ tae.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: “Ma ngɔ ye hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ kɛ gu hehi nɛ a nyɛɛ we hyɛ. Ma ha a diblii ɔ ma plɛ pee la; nɛ ma ha zugba nɛ nɔ ngɛ googagooga a nɔ maa sɔ tɛtlɛɛ ha mɛ. Níhi nɛ i ngɛ si woe kaa ma pee ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; ma ha a maa ba mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ tuekpokutsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛ hɛ yuyuili, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ na ní!

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a fia e ma a ojo, nɛ a nuu ni ɔmɛ kɛ ya wo tsu. A kpɔ a níhi ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a ha a níhi; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɛ e ba je ngmlaa ha mɛ.

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha wa nu e mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a he, nɛ ta nɛ nya wa ba tua wɔ. E mi mi la a mle kɛ wo Israel he kɛ kpe, se a li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ; wa kase we nɔ́ ko kulaa kɛ ji mi.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Israel, Yawɛ nɛ bɔ mo ɔ ngɛ mo dee ke, “Koo ye gbeye. Imi nitsɛ ma he o yi wami. O biɛ i ngɔ kɛ tsɛ mo ɔ nɛ; ye nɔ́ ji mo.

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: Ke o haomi ɔmɛ pee kaa pa nɛ o ngɛ poe po, ma piɛ o he; o haomi ɔmɛ be nyɛe maa ye o nɔ. Ke o nyɛɛ la mi po, la a be mo sãe. Haomihi tsuo nɛ maa ba o nɔ ɔ, o maa ye a nɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Ejakaa imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, imi Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ he o yi wami ɔ nɛ. Ma ngɔ Egipt ngɔ ha ngɛ o nane mi, konɛ o ye o he. Ma ngmɛɛ Sudan kɛ Seba hu a he.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ o he jua wa ha mi, akɛnɛ o hɛ mi ba nyami, nɛ i suɔ mo he je ɔ, ma ngmɛɛ je mahi kɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ a he ngɔ ha, konɛ ma he o yi wami.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: Koo ye gbeye, imi nitsɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ! “Ma bua o nina nya kɛ maa je beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je kɛ maa ba we.

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ ye ma ji mɛ; nɛ i bɔ mɛ, konɛ a wo ye hɛ mi nyami.’ ” Israel ji Yawɛ we odase

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Mawu ke, “Tsɛ ye ma a kɛ ba nɛ waa kpe. A ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́, a ngɛ tue hulɔ, se a nui nɔ́!

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
translation_verse: Tsɛ je ma amɛ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ a ba bua a he nya. A ti mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa sɛɛ wɔ blema níhi. Ha nɛ a we odase yeli ɔmɛ nɛ a ba, nɛ a ba nu, konɛ a de ke e ngɛ mi, loo e be mi.

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: “Israel ma, mo ji ye we odase. Imi ji nɔ nɛ hla mo, konɛ o pee ye tsɔlɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o le mi, o he ye nɔ nɛ o ye, nɛ o na nɛ o le kaa imi pɛ ji Mawu. Ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu, mawu kpa ko hi si hyɛ, nɛ eko be bae gblegbleegble.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: “Imi nɔ kake pɛ ji Yawɛ, imi pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ma he o yi wami.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ ba a, imi Yawɛ nɔuu lɛ i de to, nɛ i ba piɛ o he. Ma se mawu ko pee we nɔ́ nɛ ɔ eko hyɛ; mo ji ye we odase.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: Imi ji Mawu, nɛ i ngɛ daa. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma je e he kɛ je ye dɛ mi. Ke i pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, mɛnɔ ma tsake?” Israel ma a je Babilon

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, yi wami helɔ, Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ, bɔ nɛ e de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Babilon tɔɔ kɛ he o yi wami. Ma ku agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si, nɛ lele nɛ a ngɛ hwɔe ɔ ma plɛ pee kɔmɔ yemi.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Imi ji Yawɛ Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ. Israel, imi ji o bɔlɔ, kɛ o matsɛ.”

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Blema lokoo ɔ, Yawɛ je blɔ ko kɛ gu wo ɔ mi. Blɔ ɔ gu nyu glegleegle ɔ mi.

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ta nguaa nɛ ngɛ he wami, nɛ je kpo kɛ e ta zugba lɛhi kɛ okpɔngɔhi babauu ɔ, e ha mɛ tsuo a nɔ si nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a te si hu; a la a gbo kaa kane mi tako, loo kaa kane nɛ nu ta mi.

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ he nɛ ma pee ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ lɔ ɔ mohu blɔ; nɔ́ he ɔ je sisi momo; nyɛ bli nyɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ! Ma je gbɛjegbɛ ko kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ, nɛ ma ha pahi maa hia ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Se mo Israel, ye he sane ba ti mo; o ja we mi hu.

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: O ngɔɛ jijɔ kɛ ba sã we sami bɔ ha mi; nɛ o ngɔɛ bɔhi kɛ ba wui ye hɛ mi nyami hulɔ. I gba we o nya ke o ba sã bɔ ha mi, loo o ba ha mi tsopa kɛ e he via.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: O he we tsopa kɛ e he via ha mi, nɛ o ngɔɛ lohwehi a zɔ hu kɛ ba sã we bɔ kɛ sa ye hɛ mi, se mohu, o ngɔ o he yayami kɛ ngɛ mi haoe sɔuu, nɛ pɔ tɔ mi kɛ o tɔmi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: Se imi nɔuu ji Mawu nɛ ngɔɔ o he yayami ngɔ paa mo. I be o he yayami ɔmɛ kaie hu.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: “Mo kai mi, konɛ waa hla mi. Moo jaje o sane ɔ koo, konɛ waa hyɛ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da!

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: O nɛ̃ pee yayami, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu tɔ ye nɔ,

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ hu ble ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ha a kpata Israel hɛ mi; i ha a pue ye ma a hɛ mi si.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ, mo Israel, ye tsɔlɔ, ye ma nɛ i hla, Yakob nina, bu tue.

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ bɔ mo ɔ nɛ; kɛ je be nɛ a fɔ mo kɛ ba su amlɔ nɛ ɔ, imi lɛ i baa o yi. Koo ye gbeye, ye tsɔlɔ ji mo, ye ma nɛ i hla nɛ i suɔ mo.

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: “Nihi nɛ kuma ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ, ma ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu. Ma ha zugba gbigbli ɔ nyu, nɛ pahi maa hia. Ma ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo o bimɛ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ ma gbaa o nina a.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: A ma plɔke kaa nga nɛ na nyu saminya, loo tsohi ngɛ pa tue.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel matsɛ, kɛ e kpɔlɔ, nɛ lɛ ji Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ji, “Imi ji kekleekle no, kɛ nyagbe no. Ye se ɔ, Mawu kpa ko be hu.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ kɛ mi sɔ? Ha nɛ a ha heto. Ha nɛ a je nya nɛ a de ngɛ ye hɛ mi. Níhi nɛ ba blema a, mɛnɔ lɛ de to? Ha nɛ a gba níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ye ma, koo nu sawale! Koo ye gbeye! Ye we odase ji mo. Anɛ i de we enɛ ɔ blema lokoo lo? Anɛ ye se ɔ, Mawu ko pa ngɛ lo? Dɛbi, i li he wami kpa ko ngɛ ye se hu?” A gbe amaga jami he guɛ

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Amaga puɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ji nimli guhi, nɛ amaga amɛ nɛ a buu kaa nɔ́ ko ɔ, a he be se nami ko kulaa. Nihi nɛ jaa kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a hɛngmɛ yu; a li nɔ́ ko fɛɛ; zo maa gbe mɛ.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ puɛɔ amaga nɛ he be se nami, nɛ e jaa lɛ?

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ jaa kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ. Nihi nɛ puɛɔ amaga amɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ kaa nihi nɛ jaa mɛ ɔ kɛ̃. Nyɛ ha amaga puɛli ɔmɛ kɛ e jali ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba. Mɛ tsuo a tsui maa po, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Sɔ̃lɔ ngɔɔ dade kɛ woɔ la mi, nɛ e dɔɔ la. E kɛ e he wami woɔ hamle nɔ kɛ fiaa dade ɔ nɛ e kɛ sɔ̃ɔ̃ nɔ́ ko. Ke e ngɛ nɔ́ ɔ sɔ̃e ɔ, hwɔ kɛ kuma yee lɛ, nɛ pɔ tɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Tso galɔ ngɔɔ kpa kɛ susuu tso, e ngɔɔ kadimi nɔ́ kɛ kadiɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ ga dade kɛ hlɔɔ tso ɔ he kɛ peeɔ nɔ́ ko nɛ je nɔmlɔ; e ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ e he fɛu nɛ ɔ kɛ ya maa we mi.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: E ma nyɛ maa po seda kɛ pee amaga nɛ ɔ, aloo e ma hla odum, loo nga mi tso kpa ko. Ke e suɔ po, e ma du sɛsɛo, nɛ e maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si hiɔmi maa nɛ, nɛ tso ɔ maa wa saminya.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ adesa ngɔɔ tso nɛ ɔ fa ko kɛ peeɔ lɛ́ kɛ slɛɔ la nɛ e hluiɔ; nɛ e kɛ sãã abolo hulɔ. E ngɔɔ tso ɔ fa ko hu kɛ peeɔ amaga. E kplaa si ha lɛ, nɛ e jaa lɛ.

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Amaga peelɔ ɔ be juɛmi, loo e kɔ we nɔ́ se nɛ e ma de ke, “Hyɛ kaa i sã tso ɔ fa kaa lɛ́; i sã abolo ngɛ la a mi; i ngɔ la a kɛ sã de lo, nɛ i ye. Anɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ, ma kɛ puɛ amaga lo? Anɛ ma kpla si ha tso kpoku lo?”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: E ní pee mɔbɔ kaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ la zu yee; a mlɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e laa blɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be nyɛe ma he lɛ nitsɛ e yi wami, loo nɛ e ma de ke, “Anɛ pi yaka nɔ́ nɔ nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɛ ɔ?” Yawɛ, bɔlɔ kɛ yi wami helɔ ɔ

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Israel, o hɛ ko je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ! Kai kaa ye tsɔlɔ ji mo. Imi lɛ i bɔ mo, konɛ o pee ye tsɔlɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye hɛ be o nɔ jee gblegbleegble.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: I je o tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ je o he kɛ ho kaa bɔku. O yayami ɔmɛ laa kaa mɔtu afua. Kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ, imi lɛ i he o yi wami ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Nyɛ hiɔwe tsuo, nyɛ la nɛ nyɛ nya; nyɛ zugba a sisi hehi nɛ kuɔ, nyɛ he ose! Nyɛ yo ɔmɛ, kɛ hue ɔmɛ kɛ a mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo, nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ he ose. A je Yawɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ yi; ejakaa e he e ma Israel yi wami.

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o yi wami helɔ, kɛ o bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ, nihi tsuo kulaa a bɔlɔ ɔ nɛ. Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i bli hiɔwe mi, nɛ i ha zugba a fɔɔ si gbajaa. Mɛnɔ ke e nine ngɛ mi?

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Imi ji nɔ nɛ haa lakpa gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ dodoe mi hyɛli a we okadi ɔmɛ peeɔ yaka. Imi ji nɔ nɛ kuɔ ní leli a nya la, nɛ i haa a nile plɛɔ peeɔ kuasia jemi.

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: I faa, kɛkɛ wo miiɔ, nɛ nyu taa pa amɛ a mi.

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: I deɔ Sirus ke, ‘Mo ji nɔ nɛ maa ye ye ma a nɔ ha mi; nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ sɔuu o maa pee. O ma fa ke a ma Yerusalem ekohu, nɛ́ a to Yawɛ we ɔ sisi.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hla Sirus ke e ye matsɛ! E hla lɛ ke e ye je mahi a nɔ; e tsɔ lɛ, konɛ e ya kpɔ ma amɛ a he wami tsuo ngɛ a dɛ. Yawɛ ma bli ma a we agbo ɔmɛ a nya ha lɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Sirus dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: “Imi nitsɛ ma nyɛɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ ma ba yo ɔmɛ tsuo si. Ma ku akɔblee agbo ɔmɛ, nɛ ma poo a se lami ní ɔmɛ a mi ngɔ pue he.

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: Ma je juetli kpo ha mo kɛ je diblii mi, kɛ je hehi nɛ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ laa ngɛ ɔ, konɛ o na nɛ o le kaa imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i le mo, nɛ i kɛ o biɛ tsɛɔ mo.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: I tsɛ mo, konɛ o piɛ Israel he. Israel nɛ ɔ ji ma nɛ imi nitsɛ i hla. E ngɛ mi kaa o li mi lɛɛ, se i wo o hɛ mi nyami wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: “Imi ji Yawɛ; ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu. O li mi lɛɛ, se he wami nɛ hia mo ɔ, i ngɔ ha mo.

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Musu tloo nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ e kɛ e bɔlɔ ɔ sãã nya. Adesa ngɛ kaa zu buɛ ngɛ buɛ puɛlɔ dɛ mi. Anɛ zu biɔ buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ ke, “Mɛni lɛ o ngɛ puɛe ɔ?” aloo “Nɔ́ nɛ o puɛ ɔ be nine lo?”

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Musu tloo bi muɔloku nɛ deɔ e tsɛ ke, “Mɛni bi a ma fɔ ha mo?” aloo e nyɛ ke, “Kɔɔmi nɛ o nu ɔ, mɛni bi o ma fɔ?”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ je ɔ bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ he blɔ kaa e deɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ siɔ mi lo, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ ye bimɛ ɔmɛ a he jio, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ ye nine nya ní tsumi he jio?

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Imi nɛ i bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi nimli adesahi. I ngɔ ye he wami kɛ bli hiɔwe mi, nɛ i yeɔ pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ nɛ i hla Sirus nɛ i wo lɛ he wami, konɛ e pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ma ha e blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa da tlɔmɔɔ. E maa ma ye ma Yerusalem ɔ ekohu, nɛ e maa ngmɛɛ ye nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ye a he. Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɔɛ lɛ apaa, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu ha we lɛ nyɔ mi ní ke e tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.” Yawɛ, Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Israel ke, “Egipt juetli, kɛ Sudan nijua ní ma ba pee o nɔ́, nɛ Seba bi, nimli gagahi ma ba pee o nyɔguɛhi; a maa bɔ mɛ pã kɛ ba o ngɔ; a ma ba kpla si ha mo, nɛ a ma kpa mo pɛɛ ngɛ he si bami mi ke, ‘Niinɛ, Mawu nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔ kake too ji Mawu; ekpa ko be hu.

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ heɔ e ma a yi wami ɔ, e ji Mawu nɛ laa e he.

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Amaga puɛli a hɛ mi ma pue si; zo maa gbe mɛ tsuo kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Se Israel ma a lɛɛ Yawɛ ma he a yi wami kɛ maa ya neneene; e be hae nɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: I tu we munyu ngɛ laami mi; ye yi mi tomi fɔɔ si paa. I de we Israel ma a ke a ya hla mi ngɛ nga pã. Imi ji Yawɛ, anɔkuale pɛ i tuɔ; nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɔ ɔ pɛ i deɔ.” Yawɛ, je ɔ tsɛ ɔ kɛ Babilon amaga amɛ ná

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sane ɔ nɛ ba nɛ waa hyɛ mi. Nihi nɛ ma je a sane ɔ nya a, nyɛ ha nɛ a ya kpe yi! Nyɛ mawu ɔmɛ a kpɛti mɛnɔ nyɛ́ de nɔ́ ko kɛ to blema lokoo? Nɔ ko nɔ ko be. Anɛ pi imi Yawɛ lo? Anɛ pi imi Mawu nɛ da, nɛ heɔ e ma a yi wami ɔ lo? Ye se ɔ, Mawu kpa ko be hu.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ nimli tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ jehanɛ, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami! Ejakaa imi nɔ kake too ji Mawu; Mawu kpa ko be.

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: “A ma de ke, ‘Yawɛ pɛ lɛ yeɔ dami sane; lɛ pɛ lɛ e ngɛ he wami.’ Se nihi tsuo nɛ sume mi ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha Israel nina tsuo maa ye kunimi, nɛ a maa fĩa kɛ fɔ ye nɔ.

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: “Babilon mawu ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Be ko ɔ, a ja Bel kɛ Nebo. A hɛɛɔ mɛ kɛ hii si poe. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ a plɛ pee tlomi ngɛ tejihi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ a se mi.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Amaga amɛ nyɛ we nɛ a he mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi wami; a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho. Babilon mawu ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ye ma a mi nihi tsuo, Yakob nina nɛ nyɛ ngɛ wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue. Imi ji nɔ nɛ baa nyɛ yi kɛ je nyɛ fɔmi be tɔɔ.

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: Imi nɔuu ji nyɛ Mawu nɛ maa hyɛ nyɛ nɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ nyɛ maa wa nɛ nyɛ maa puɛ mua. Imi lɛ i bɔ nyɛ; ma baa nyɛ yi; ma piɛ nyɛ he, nɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami.

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: A ngɔɔ amaga a ngɔ fɔɔ a konɔ; a kɛ ya maa si ngɛ he ko, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e mimiɛɔ e he po kɛ je he nɛ e maa si ngɛ ɔ! Ke nɔ ko fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e nyɛ we nɛ e haa lɛ heto, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e jeɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ jeɔ haomi mi hulɔ.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: “Nyɛ yayami peeli, nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ susu he.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai níhi nɛ i pee blema lokoo ɔ; ejakaa Mawu kpa ko be nɛ kɛ mi sɔ.

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nɔ ko tsɛe kɛ je beleku je; e he maa sɔ kaa kayo kɛ ba kple si, nɛ e ma ba tsu níhi nɛ i to nɛ ma pee ɔ. Bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ e maa ba mi.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ma nɛ nyɛ tue mi ti, nɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa kunimi yemi ngɛ se lokoo, nyɛɛ bu tue.

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: I ha ye kunimi yemi ligbi ɔ na nyɛ haa; e be tsitsaa lokoo kulaa. Ye kunimi yemi ɔ be se kpɛe. Ma he Yerusalem yi wami, nɛ ma wo Israel hɛ mi nyami.”

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Babilon, mo kple si kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ! Ba hi si ngɛ zugba, ngɛ bunyuku mi! Be ko nɛ be ɔ, o ngɛ kaa yomiyo, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a be mo hɛɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ hu!

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Nihi maa na o he gu ɔ; a maa na o zo kpɔtɔɔ ɔ. Ma ha tue gblami maa ba, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be ye nya tsie.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ha wa ye wa he. E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ Babilon dee ke, “Hii si dii ngɛ diblii mi; a be mo tsɛe ke je ma amɛ a manyɛ hu.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: Ye ma a wo ye mi mi la; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i bui mɛ kaa ye ma hu. I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo o sisi, nɛ o nɛ́ mɛ mɔbɔ ko kulaa; nihi nɛ bwɔ po, o wa mɛ yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: E pee mo kaa o maa ye manyɛ daa, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o susuu we ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he, bɔ nɛ a nyagbe maa ba ha hu, o bui.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ lɛɛ, bu tue; mo nɛ o suɔ je mi ngɔɔmi yemi, nɛ o hii si gbɔjɔɔ kaa nɔ nɛ he mi jɔ lɛ, mo nɛ o fĩaa ke o kle kaa Mawu, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ mo sɔɛ. O susuu hu kaa o be yalɔyo pee gblee, nɛ o bimɛ hu be gboe kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
translation_verse: Se tlukaa, ligbi kake mi ɔ, nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba o nɔ; o maa ye kunya, nɛ o maa fi kablɛ babauu, se o huno, kɛ o bimɛ tsuo maa laa mo.

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: “Yayami nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ peeɔ mo kaa o he mi jɔ mo. O susu kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo nae. O ga, kɛ o nile ɔ ha o laa blɔ, nɛ o de o he ke, ‘Imi ji imi, nɛ ye se ɔ nɔ ko be hu.’

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ le hiɔwe níhi a mi, nihi nɛ kase dodoe ɔmɛ a he ní, kɛ nihi nɛ pee hiɔwe mi dlami ɔmɛ a he foni, nɛ a deɔ mo níhi nɛ maa ba o nɔ nyɔhiɔ tsuaa nyɔhiɔ mi ɔ, ha nɛ a ba nɛ a ba he o yi wami koo! Se pɔ tɔ mo kɛ a ga womi ɔmɛ!

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: “A maa pee kaa nga gbigbli, nɛ la maa sã mɛ! A be nyɛe ma he mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi wami; la lilɛ ɔmɛ maa sã mɛ. Pi la kulɔɔ nɛ a hluiɔ ji nɛ ɔ; pi la nɛ a hii he.

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: Israel ma, Yuda nina, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tue; nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ Yawɛ biɛ kɛ kaa kita, nɛ nyɛ tsiɔ Israel Mawu ɔ ta ke nyɛ ngɛ lɛ jae, pi anɔkuale mi, se nya mi gu.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nyɛ siɔ nyɛ gugue, nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ; nyɛ deɔ hu ke Israel Mawu nɛ e biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɔ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ Israel dee ke, “Níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ, i gba ngɔ to blema lokoo, nɛ tlukaa, i ha a ba mi.

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: Nyɛ nui hyɛ, nɛ nyɛ li lolo; kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, nyɛ tue bli we lolo! Ejakaa i le kaa yi wu tso níhi nyɛ peeɔ; kɛ je nyɛ fɔmi be mi tɔɔ ɔ, atuã tsɔli a tsɛɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: “Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a je ye biɛ yi he je ɔ, i tsi ye mi mi la a nya; i tsi nya, konɛ ma ko kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: I ngɔ amanehlu kɛ ka nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a tsuɔ sika hiɔ he ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi; se i na kaa nyɛ he be se nami ko kulaa.

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Israel, ma nɛ imi nitsɛ i hla, nyɛɛ bu mi tue! Imi ji Mawu, kekleekle nɔ, kɛ nyagbe nɔ; imi nɔ kake too ji Mawu!

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ lɛ i to zugba a sisi, nɛ i bli hiɔwe mluguduu ɔ mi. Benɛ i tsɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, mɛ tsuo a he sɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: “Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛ mawu ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ gba enɛ ɔ kɛ to? Nɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i suɔ lɛ ɔ, ma ba pee nɔ́ nɛ sa imi Yawɛ ye hɛ mi, nɛ e ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi butuu.

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ nɛ i hla lɛ. Imi nɛ i ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba, nɛ ní tsumi nɛ i ha lɛ ɔ, e maa ye manye ngɛ mi.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ba bu mi tue. Kɛ je sisije ɔ tsuo lakpa ko be ye munyu mi, nɛ ye munyu ɔmɛ baa mi sisiisi.” Hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ hla a he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɔ e mumi ɔ ngɔ wo ye mi, nɛ e tsɔ mi.” Yawɛ to yi mi ha e ma a

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɔ nɛ heɔ e ma a yi wami ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. I suɔ kaa ma tsɔse nyɛ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi ha, konɛ e hi ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: “I na nɛ nyɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ! Jinɛ a maa gbaa nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ maa pee kaa pa nɛ nyu tɛ̃ mi gblegbleegble. Nyɛ maa ye kunimi nɔtonɔto kaa bɔ nɛ oslɔke kuɔ kɛ pueɔ wo dɔ mi.

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ngmɛdu ko hiɛ babauu kaa zia, nɛ i ko hyɛ a nɔ saminya, konɛ a hɛ mi ko kpata gblegbleegble.”

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ je Babilon esɔesɔ; nyɛ wo fo! Nyɛ hwɔ lele nɛ a nu ngɛ he tsuaa he ke, “Yawɛ he e tsɔlɔ Israel yi wami!”

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Yayami peeli be he jɔmi nae gblegbleegble.”

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Nyɛ wo nya mahi, nyɛɛ bu tue, Nyɛ je mahi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ se lokoo, nyɛ ta tue! Yawɛ hla mi loko a fɔ mi. Benɛ i ngɛ ye nyɛ mi mi lokoo nɛ e wo ye biɛ ta.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: E ha ye nya mi munyu pee kaa klaate nɛ nya ba. E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nine kɛ bu ye he. E pee mi kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ nya ba, nɛ hɔɔ si ngɛ kotoku mi.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: E de mi ke, “Israel, ye tsɔlɔ ji mo. O he ɔ, nihi maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami.”

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ, i de ke, “I gbo dengme yaka gu; i puɛ ye he wami tsuo yaka; i na we se ko.” Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ maa ye ye sane ɔ ha mi, e maa pee mi kpakpa.

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Loko a fɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ hla mi, nɛ e pee mi e tsɔlɔ, konɛ ma ya kpale e ma a kɛ ba e ngɔ; ma kpale Israel ma a nɛ gbɛ fĩa a kɛ ba ha lɛ. Yawɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa mi he wami.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Ye tsɔlɔ, i ngɛ ní tsumi agbo ko ha mo; pi kaa o ma bua Israel bi nɛ a yi na wami ɔ a nya kɛ pee ma ekohu kaa sa a kɛkɛ, se mohu kaa o maa pee la kɛ ha je ma amɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he je ɔ tsuo yi wami.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ a gbe e he guɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ je ma amɛ sume e sane saasaa a, nɔ yeli ɔmɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Israel yi wami helɔ, kɛ Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ dee ngɛ e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Matsɛmɛ maa na mo, nɛ a maa te si ha mo; ganɔhi maa na, nɛ a ma kpla si ha mo kɛ wo o hɛ mi nyami.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi, ejakaa Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ hla e tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ; Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ yeɔ e siwo nɔ sisiisi. A maa ma Yerusalem ekohu

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, “Ke be su nɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami ɔ, ma na nyɛ mɔbɔ; ngmlaa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kpae ke ma ba piɛ nyɛ he ɔ, ma bu tue. Ma bu nyɛ he, nɛ ma baa nyɛ yi, nɛ ma gu nyɛ nɔ nɛ i kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa so. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɛ hɛ mi kpata a, ma ha nyɛ ma ba hi nɔ ekohu.

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: Ma de nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ je kpo!’ nɛ ma de nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ je kpo kɛ ba la hɛ mi!’ A maa pee kaa tohi nɛ ngɛ ní yee ngɛ blɔ tue. Yo nɔ he nɛ hue be ɔ maa pee a ní yemi he.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Hwɔ be mɛ yee, nɛ kuma be mɛ yee gblegbleegble. Pu la, kɛ nga kplanaa nɔ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ mi dɔ la be mɛ awi yee; ejakaa nɔ nɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ maa piɛ a he. E maa tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ kɛ ya nyu hɛngmɛhi a he.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Ee, ye ma a maa je tsitsaa kɛ maa ba, a maa je omleyi je kɛ bonyoku je, nɛ a maa je Aswan tɔɔ ngɛ leneyi je kɛ maa ba.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hiɔwe níhi, nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi! Zugba, hwɔ lele! Nyɛ yo ɔmɛ hu nyɛ la! Yawɛ maa jɔɔ e ma a bua; nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, e maa na mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Se bɔ nɛ Yerusalem ngɛ dee ji, “Yawɛ ngmɛɛ ye he ngɔ fɔ si! E hɛ po je ye nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Anɛ binyɛ hɛ maa je lɛ nitsɛ e bi nɛ ngɛ nyɔ nya nɔ lo? Anɛ e be suɔmi kpo jee kɛ tsɔɔ e bi ɔ lo? Ke binyɛ hɛ maa je e bi nɔ po, imi lɛɛ ye hɛ be o nɔ jee kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Yerusalem, hyɛ, i ngma o biɛ ngɛ ye dɛ mi, ye hɛ be o nɔ jee gblegbleegble.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: “Nihi nɛ maa fia gbogbo ɔmɛ ɔ ma amlɔ nɔuu, nɛ nihi nɛ ba kpata o hɛ mi ɔ maa je kɛ ho.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Hyɛ o he kɛ kpe, nɛ o maa na nɔ́ ko! O ma mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he nya buae kɛ ma we! Ligbi abɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ma ha o bua maa jɔ o ma a he kaa bɔ nɛ ayɛflo bua jɔɔ june nɛ e wo he ɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: “A kpata o zugba a hɛ mi; a pee o ma a butuu; se jehanɛ lɛɛ, nihi nɛ ma lejɛ ɔ himi ɔ, zugba a be mɛ sue hu. Nihi nɛ ba pee mo butuu ɔ maa je o he kɛ ya se lokoo.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, o bimɛ nɛ o fɔ ngɛ ma se ɔ, hwɔɔ se ɔ, a ma de mo ke, ‘Zugba nɛ ɔ klee we ha wɔ; e hia wɔ zugba nɛ kle nɛ waa hi nɔ.’

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, o ma bi o he ke, ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ bimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ha mi? Nihi gbo ta ye he; i plɛ pee nɔ ko nɛ fɔ we, a nu mi kɛ ho ma se ya. Hyɛ, a si imi nɔ kake too, lɛɛ jije lɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je mɔ? Mɛnɔ nɛ lɛ mɛ?’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma fɔ̃ je ma amɛ nine; ni ɔmɛ tsuo maa na okadi ɔ, nɛ a maa hɛɛ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ a gugue mi, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ maa fɔ a konɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ ma plɛ pee tsɛmɛ kɛ ha mo, nɛ manyɛmɛ ma plɛ pee nyɛmɛ kɛ ha mo. A ma kpla si ha mo, nɛ a maa wo o hɛ mi nyami. A maa ba a he si ha mo, nɛ a maa bu mo. Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ niinɛ. Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ ye nɔ ɔ, zo be mɛ gbee.”

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Ma ha nihi nɛ ngɛ mo haoe ɔ maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he lo awi; mɛ nitsɛmɛ a muɔ maa de mɛ kaa wai. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi tsuo maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. Imi ji nɔ nɛ heɔ o yi wami, nɛ haa nɛ o yeɔ o he. A ma na le kaa imi ji Israel Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Imi lɛ i haa hiɔwe woɔ diblii kpii kaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kpekpe ya bo ha he.” Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ bu lɛ tue

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ bli ye tue; i tsɔ we atuã, i kua we lɛ.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: I ngmɛ blɔ nɛ a fia ye se mi kpa; a jɛ mi; a hia ye kpɛni si bwɔmi, nɛ a su lada ngɔ pue ye hɛ mi kɛ pue ye hɛ mi si.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pee we mi nɔ́ ko, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ɔ piɛ ye he, nɛ zo gbi mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i nu ye tsui, nɛ i wlua mi, ejakaa i le kaa zo be mi gbee.

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ngɛ ye kasa nya, mɛnɔ maa bu mi fɔ mɔ? Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo maa laa, a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ e buɔ e tsɔlɔ ɔ gbi tue? E tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ, ke e nyɛɛ ngɛ diblii kpii mi po, e ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ e he kɛ kpasaa e Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kpe kɛ soɔ nihi a yi nɔ, konɛ nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi, nyɛ yi mi tomi yaya amɛ ma kpata nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi. Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi; nyɛ nyagbe maa pee mɔbɔ.

english_verse: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
translation_verse: Nyɛ susu nyɛ nɛ̃, Abraham, kɛ Sara hu nɛ fɔ nyɛ ɔ a he. Benɛ i tsɛ Abraham ɔ, e be bi ko kulaa, se i gbaa lɛ, nɛ i ha lɛ bimɛ; nɛ i ha e nina hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: “Ma jɔɔ Yerusalem bua; nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem we doku ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ma jɔɔ a bua. E zugba a pee nga kplanaa lɛɛ, se ma ha e ma plɛ pee ngmɔ kaa ngmɔ ɔ nɛ i pee ngɛ Eden ɔ. Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a bua maa jɔ saminya, a ma nya nɛ a ma la yi jemi, kɛ sina lahi.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: “Ye ma, nyɛɛ bu mi tue, nyɛ ta tue ha nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ. Ma ngɔ ye mlaa kɛ ha je ma amɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔ maa pee kaa la ha mɛ.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: Ma ba esɔesɔ, konɛ ma ba he a yi wami. Ye kunimi yemi be ɔ su ta. Imi nitsɛ ma ye je ma amɛ a nɔ. Wo nya zugba amɛ ngɛ mi mlɛe, a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ kɛ ngɛ mi blɔ hyɛe kaa ma ba he a yi wami.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Nyɛ wo nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ nyɛɛ kpale hyɛ zugba mi. Hiɔwe maa laa kaa la su ku nɛ se po; zugba ma puplee kaa tako piɛ, nɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ ma gbo kaa anunuhi. Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami daa; ma ye kunimi ha nyɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ nyɛ suɔ ye mlaa a saminya, nyɛ ko ye gbeye kaa nimli adesahi maa ye nyɛ he fɛu, loo a ma jɛ nyɛ. Ke a ngɛ nyɛ he fɛu yee ɔ, nyɛ ko ye tsui!

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Ejakaa a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye, loo kuutu nɛ gɔgɔ ye. Ma ye dami sane ha nyɛ daa, nɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami be tsuaa be; ma ye kunimi ha nyɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.”

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo te si nɛ o piɛ wa he! Ngɔɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ he wa yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ o pee blema a. Pi mo nɛ o gbɔ Rahab, wo mi lo nguaa a nɔ́, nɛ o poo e mi kpokukpoku ɔ lo?

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: Mo nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ ha wo ɔ mii; o je blɔ kɛ gu nyu ɔ mi, konɛ nihi nɛ o he a yi wami ɔ nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a po wo ɔ.

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ mo Yawɛ, o kpɔ mɛ ɔ, a kɛ bua jɔmi ma la kɛ ba Yerusalem. A bua maa jɔ kɛ maa ya neneene; aywilɛho kɛ kɔmɔ yemi tsuo se maa po.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Imi ji nɔ nɛ woɔ mo he wami. Nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ gboɔ, nɛ e wami se kɛmi pi kaa nga nɔ́ po ɔ, mɛni he je o yeɔ lɛ gbeye?

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: Anɛ Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ bɔ mo, nɛ e pee hiɔwe ploplooplo, nɛ e ngɔ zugba a sisi tomi ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ, o hɛ je e nɔ lo? Nihi nɛ ngɛ mo yi mi wae, nɛ a pee klaalo kaa a ma kpata o hɛ mi ɔ, mɛni he je o ngɛ mɛ mohu gbeye yee ɔ? A be nyɛe maa pee mo nɔ ko hu.

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: E be kɛe kulaa nɛ nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ maa ye a he. A ma na a nya mi ngma bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ a se maa kɛ ngɛ je mi.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: “Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ. Imi nɛ i haa wo gliɔ, nɛ oslɔke ɔmɛ peeɔ hoo. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ji ye biɛ!

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Imi ji nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe ploplooplo ɔ, nɛ i ngɔ zugba a sisi tomi ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si. Bɔ nɛ i ngɛ Yerusalem dee ji, ‘Ye ma ji mo! I wo mo mlaa, nɛ i ngɔ ye he wami kɛ ngɛ o he bue.’ ” Yerusalem amanehlu ɔ se po

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, tee si! O hɛ nɛ tsɛ, nɛ o te si nɛ o da si! Amanehlu nɛ ngɛ kaa kplu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ abofu ngɔ ha mo ke o nu, konɛ e kɛ gbla o tue ɔ, o nu kɛ e sisi ɔ tsuo; nɛ enɛ ɔ ha o ngɛ si tataae.

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: O bimɛ ɔmɛ gbɔjɔ, nɛ a hɛli kɛ pueɔ si ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bayelɔ nɛ du klama. Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ gbla o tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yerusalem, o bimɛ ɔmɛ a ní pee mɔbɔ, nɛ a ngɛ si tataae kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã.

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ faa e ma a he ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Kplu nɛ i ngɔ ha mo ngɛ abofu nya a, i ngɛ hee ngɛ o dɛ. O be dã a nue hu konɛ o ko tataa si kaa dã tɔlɔ hu.

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: O he nyɛli nɛ haoɔ mo, nihi nɛ ha o hwɔɔ si ngɛ zugba mi, nɛ a naa o nɔ kaa a naa gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ɔ, mɛ a dɛ mi ma ngɔ kplu ɔ kɛ wo.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, tee si nɛ o pee ma nguaa ekohu! Mawu ma klɔuklɔu, o hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami, nɛ́ a bu mo saminya! Ma je li be hiɛ ɔ bae hu gblegbleegble.

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Tsa pi sika nɛ a kɛ he nyɛ kɛ pee nyɛ nyɔguɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kɛ sika be nyɛ kpɔe.

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Kekle ɔ, nyɛ ya Egipt, nɛ nyɛ ya to nubwɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; pee se ɔ, Asiria bi ɔmɛ wa nyɛ yi mi yaka gu.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, ngɛ Babilonia hu, jamɛ a amimi ɔ nɔuu a ye nyɛ; a pee nyɛ nyɔguɛhi nɛ a wui hiɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ he. Nihi nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ ɔ fĩa, nɛ a jɛ nyɛ saminya kɛ gbe ye he guɛ.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: Be ma nɛ nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Mawu; nyɛ maa le kaa imi lɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Mɛni ji afɛu! Nyɛɛ hyɛ manye munyu fiɛlɔ ko nyɛɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma; e hɛɛ manye munyu sɔuu; manye munyu ɔ kɔɔ tue mi jɔmi he! E ngɛ fiɛe ke a ye kunimi, nɛ e ngɛ Zion dee ke, “O Mawu ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yee!”

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yerusalem tsu kokoehi, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛ hwɔ lele! Ejakaa Yawɛ ma he e ma a yi wami, nɛ e maa jɔɔ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a bua.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma je e he wami klɔuklɔu ɔ kpo; e ma he e ma a yi wami, nɛ je ɔ tsuo maa na.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ba be kɛ ho; nyɛɛ je Babilonia! Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ Mawu we ɔ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu; nyɛ ko ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ e hia we kaa nyɛ maa ye esɔ kɛ hia blɔ; nyɛ be fo tue kɛ je. Ejakaa Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ maa nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ yaa a, nɛ e maa bu nyɛ he. Tsɔlɔ nɔ́ nalɔ ɔ

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ye tsɔlɔ ɔ maa ye manye ngɛ e ní tsumi mi; a ma wo e nɔ gojoo, nɛ a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami babauu!

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Nihi babauu nɛ na lɛ ɔ, a he mi po; ejakaa a puɛ e nɔmlɔ tso subai ɔ kulaa; ke o hyɛ lɛ ɔ, e slo lɛ kulaa ngɛ adesa he!

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ lɛɛ e he maa pee je mahi babauu nyakpɛ; nɛ matsɛmɛ pohu a nya maa kpɛ a he wawɛɛ. Ejakaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a de we mɛ hyɛ ɔ, a maa na, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a nui hyɛ ɔ, a maa nu sisi jehanɛ.”

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ ma he wa munyu nɛ ɔ maa ye? Mɛnɔ maa le kaa Yawɛ he ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ mi?
