english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa tso wayoo ko nɛ puɛ kɛ je zugba gbigbli mi. Agboje ko be e he ɔ, he fɛu hu bɔ lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa bui lɛ. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e he nɛ maa pee wɔ akɔnɔ.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Wa gbe e he guɛ, nɛ wa kua lɛ. E na nɔ́, nɛ e pi wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko plɛ we nɛ e hyɛ lɛ; wa gbe e he guɛ, nɛ wa bui lɛ saasaa.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ laa blɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ. Se tue gblami nɛ sa wɔ tsuo ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ha lɛ.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: “A wa lɛ yi mi, nɛ a pi lɛ; se e kpɛ we e kuɔ si! A kpaka lɛ kɛ ho kaa to bi nɛ a yaa gbe. Nɛ bɔ nɛ jijɔ peeɔ kpoo ngɛ e he bwɔmi salɔ hɛ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu e kpɛ we e kuɔ si.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: A ye sane yaya kɛ bu lɛ gbenɔ fɔ, nɛ a nu le kɛ ho. Ejakaa a ngɔ e wami kɛ je zugba a nɔ. Tɔmihi nɛ ye ma a tɔ ɔ, a he a gbe lɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: “Se e sa Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa a fiaa lɛ ní; e ha a pi lɛ. Ke e ngɔ e wami kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ yayami he ɔ, e se maa kɛ ngɛ je mi, nɛ e ma na nina babauu. Nɛ Yawɛ maa gu e nɔ kɛ ye manye.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: Ke e na nɔ́ se ɔ, e ma na bua jɔmi ekohu, nɛ e maa na kaa e nɔ́ nami pee we yaka. Ye tsɔlɔ nɛ i suɔ lɛ ɔ, a maa gbla e tue ngɛ nihi babauu a nane mi, se e he ɔ, ma ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma ha lɛ blɔ nya nguaa ko ngɛ ni nguanguahi a kpɛti. E kɛ mɛ maa dla ta yibu ní ɔ. Ejakaa e ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha ngɛ yayami peeli babauu a nane mi; nɛ e kpa pɛɛ nɛ a ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.”

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, jinɛ o ngɛ kaa yosa, se jehanɛ lɛɛ o ma nyɛ ma la nɛ o ma hwɔ lele. Jehanɛ lɛɛ o ma fɔ bimɛ babauu pe yo nɛ e kɛ e huno ngɛ tsu nya daa!

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o he maa hiɛ ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ; zugba a nɛ je ma kpa amɛ ngɛ nɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o nina ma ba kpɔ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a mi ma hyi tɔ kɛ nimli.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Koo ye gbeye, ejakaa zo be mo gbee! O tsui ko po, ejakaa a be o hɛ mi si puee hu. Zo ní nɛ o tsu ngɛ o yihe be mi ɔ, o hɛ maa je nɔ, nɛ si nɛ o hi mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa yalɔyo ɔ, o be kaie hu.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: O bɔlɔ ɔ ma ba pee o huno. E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ. Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ ma he o yi wami; lɛ ji je ɔ tsuo Mawu.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Israel, o ngɛ kaa yo nɛ e huno je e he, yo nɛ a je he ngɛ yihe mi, nɛ e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee wawɛɛ. Se Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo tsɛe kɛ ba e ngɔ ekohu, nɛ e ngɛ dee ke,

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: “Be kpiti ko kɛkɛ nɛ i je o he, se ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe wawɛɛ ngɛ o he; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ mo kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: Ye mi mi fu mo wawɛɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ i je hɛ ngɛ o he be kuku, se jehanɛ lɛɛ ma je ye suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo kɛ maa ya neneene.” Imi Yawɛ yi wami helɔ ɔ, nɛ i de.

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: “Noa be ɔ mi ɔ, i wo si ko; i de ke i be hae nɛ nyu babauu ma ba ha zugba a nɔ hu. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ mo si woe kaa ye mi mi be mo fue hu gblegbleegble.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ maa ywia pue si, se suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha mo ɔ se be poe. Somi nɛ i kɛ mo so kaa ma ha o tue mi nɛ jɔ mo ɔ, ma ye nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.” Imi Yawɛ, o mɔbɔ nalɔ ɔ nɛ i de. Yerusalem he ɔ

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Yerusalem, ma nɛ na amanehlu, mo nɛ nɔ ko piɛ we o he nɛ e wo mo bua. Ma ngɔ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa kɛ fia o sisi tomi ɔ ekohu.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: “Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ, ma tsɔɔ ye ma a ní, nɛ ma ha a ma na ní babauu.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Dami sane yemi, kɛ kpakpa peemi ma ha o ma a he maa wa. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo yi mi wae, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be o he gbeye woe.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ba tua mo ɔ, pi imi nɛ i tsɔ lɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba tua mo ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ be mo nyɛe.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: “Imi ji nɔ nɛ bɔ sɔ̃lɔ nɛ huu la mi, nɛ e sɔ̃ɔ̃ ta hwumi níhi. Imi nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ bɔ ta hwulɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔɔ ta hwumi dade kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Se ta hwumi níhi nɛ a sɔ̃ nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko be nyɛe maa pee mo nɔ́ ko; jehanɛ hu, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ mo ma na sane ɔ, a maa bu lɛ fɔ. Ma bu ye tsɔli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ ma ha a maa ye kunimi.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Kuuwi, nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kuma ngɛ nyɛ yee, nyu babaaba ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ha nyɛ! Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ be sika hu, nyɛɛ ba; nyɛ ba he niye ní nɛ nyɛɛ ye! Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ ba he dã, kɛ na nyɔ nyu e hia we sika; a jua we!

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je nyɛ puɛɔ sika kɛ heɔ nɔ nɛ be nyɛ tɔe? Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ ní tsumi mi hiɔwo kɛ heɔ nɔ́ nɛ tɔɛ nɔ? Nyɛɛ bu mi tue saminya nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ; kɛkɛ nyɛ maa ye ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ nyɛ he.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: I wo lɛ je ma amɛ a nyatsɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛngua, nɛ e nɔ i gu kɛ je ye he wami kpo.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ, o ma tsɛ je mahi nɛ li mo kɛ ba; sa a, a li mo, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma wo fo kɛ ba o ngɔ! Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ma ha ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi.”

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ Yawɛ he kɛ we nɛ ɔ, nyɛ hla e se blɔ nɛ nyɛɛ fa kue ha lɛ.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ, nyɛ kpa awi yemi, nyɛ yayami peeli, nyɛ ko susu nɔ́ yaya hu. Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ. E naa mɔbɔ, nɛ be tsuaa be ɔ, e kɛ nɔ tɔmi paa.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpɛti kɛ ɔ, ja ye blɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ, nɛ ja nɔuu ye susumi ɔmɛ hu pã nyɛ susumi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: “Ye munyu ngɛ kaa snoo kɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛɔ kɛ jeɔ hiɔwe kɛ pueɔ zugba. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ haa dumi níhi puɛɔ. Wa naa wu nɛ wa duɔ, kɛ ngma nɛ wa yeɔ.

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: Munyuhi nɛ i tuɔ ɔ, ja a maa pee. Munyu tsuaa munyu nɛ jeɔ ye nya a, nɔ́ nɛ i ke e pee ɔ, ja e pee loko e maa kpale kɛ ba. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i to ke e ba mi ɔ maa ba mi kokooko.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi maa je lejɛ ɔ. A maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ je ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. Yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ maa hia la, nɛ pu mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo maa fia a dɛ mi.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mio tso nane mi ɔ, sɛsɛo maa puɛ. Tso kpakpa maa puɛ ngɛ mio tso nane mi. E maa pee okadi nɛ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ a kɛ ma kai nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ tsu.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa, ejakaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma ba he nyɛ yi wami.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Nubwɔ nɛ kɛ e he ba mɛtɛ Yawɛ ma a he ɔ, e ko de ke, “Yawɛ be suɔe kaa ma piɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ ja lɛ.” Nyumu nɛ a puɛ lɛ, nɛ e be bi ɔ, e ko susu kaa Mawu be lɛ ngɔe kɛ piɛ e ma a he.

english_verse: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ dee ji, “Ke o yeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ o peeɔ ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ o yeɔ ye somi ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: ye ma a ma kai o biɛ ngɛ ye we ɔ pe binyumuhi, loo biyihi nɛ o ngɛ po. Ma ha mo biɛ kpakpa nɛ a ma kai kɛ maa ya neneene.”

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nibwɔhi nɛ kɛ a he ba mɛtɛ ma a he, nɛ a suɔ Mawu sane, nɛ a jaa lɛ, nɛ a yeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kɛ e somi ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ dee ji,

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: “Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba Zion, ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ; ma ha nyɛ bua maa jɔ ngɛ ye sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa sã ngɛ ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ma he. Ejakaa a ma tsɛ ye we ɔ je mahi tsuo a sɔlemi we.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ e ma Israel nya buae kɛ je ma se kɛ ma we ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ dee ji, “Ma bua ni kpahi a nya kɛ piɛ nihi nɛ a bua a nya momo ɔ a he.” A bu Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ fɔ

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: A ngɛ kaa gbehi nɛ li tɔ biɛ! Ma nɔ yeli nɛ ɔmɛ be juɛmi kokooko! Nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ; mɛ nitsɛmɛ a se nami pɛ a hlaa.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Dã tɔli nɛ ɔmɛ deɔ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ ba nɛ wa ya hla wai nɛ waa nu. Wa maa nu dã bɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ! Hwɔɔ lɛɛ e maa pee gbeye!’ ”

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ baa a je mi saminya, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, ke a gbo ɔ, a naa tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Se, nyɛ yayami peeli nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ní peeli, kɛ gba puɛli, kɛ yi yaholi tsuo sɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ!

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ he fɛu nyɛ ngɛ yee ɔ? Nyɛ lakpatsɛmɛ, yayami peeli a bimɛ, mɛnɔ he nyɛ pa nyɛ nya mi hatoo, nɛ nyɛ je nyɛ lilɛ kpo bilaa kɛ wo ɔ?

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ he mi akɔnɔ teɔ si, nɛ́ nyɛɛ kɛ bɔɔ ajuama ngɛ tso nguanguahi nɛ bɔ kusuu a sisi. Nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ kɛ sãã bɔ ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ya kuɔɔ yo gaga amɛ, ya sãã bɔ; nɛ nyɛ ya bɔɔ ajuama ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: Nyɛ gbaa nyɛ he nya babauu kɛ kpaa si; pɔ hu tɔɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa. Nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ amaga amɛ haa nyɛ he wami, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngmɛɛ we a he.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ gbeye nyɛ ya ye, loko nyɛ ye lakpa, nɛ nyɛ hɛ je ye nɔ pɛsɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Akɛnɛ i pee dii kɛ je blema lokoo he je ɔ, nyɛ bui mi, nɛ nyɛ yi mi gbeye hulɔ, pi jã?

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ balɔ tsɛe ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ amaga babauu ɔmɛ nɛ a je ngmlaa ha nyɛ koo! Kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ po maa bɛɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho; mumi nɛ a woɔ si kake pɛ ma fli mɛ kɛ ho. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ ye nɔ ɔ, a maa hi zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ma ja mi ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.” Mawu wo si ke e maa piɛ e ma a he nɛ e ma tsa mɛ

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: “Imi ji Mawu klɔuklɔu nɛ hii hiɔwe kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɛ. I hii he klɔuklɔu ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo; se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ngɛ e mumi mi, nɛ e tsui mi tsɔ ɔ, i kɛ lɛ hiɔ si; i woɔ e mumi kã, konɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ, nɛ e na wami he.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ nɛ i ha ye ma a wami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ mɛ be pɛe, nɛ ye mi mi hu be mɛ fue kɛ ya neneene.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Ye mi mi fu mɛ, nɛ i gbla a tue, nɛ i kua mɛ; ejakaa a peeɔ yayami, nɛ a hɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃; se kɛ̃ ɔ, a wa tue, nɛ a ya nɔ pee níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: “I na níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ, se ma tsa mɛ. Ma tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ, nɛ ma piɛ a he; nɛ ma wo kɔmɔ yeli ɔmɛ bua!

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a ngɛ kpo nya, kɛ tsitsaa tsuo ma na tue mi jɔmi. Ma tsa ye ma a.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ be he jɔmi nae gblegbleegble.” Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Kpa ngmlaa boboobo bɔ nɛ o ma nyɛ; ha nɛ o nya nɛ wa wawɛɛ kaa titimati! Jaje ye ma Israel tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ!

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: A deɔ ke a jaa mi daa kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a le ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. A deɔ hu ke a ngɛ hlae nɛ ma wo mɛ mlaa kpakpahi, nɛ a suɔ kaa a ma ja mi.”

english_verse: You even get angry and ready to fight. No wonder God won't listen to your prayers!
translation_verse: Nyɛ haa hwɔ, se nyɛ peeɔ basabasa; nyɛ pɛɔ, nɛ nyɛ nɔɔ kunɔ. Nyɛ susuɔ kaa kikɛmɛ a hwɔ hami ɔ ma ha ma bu nyɛ kue fami tue lo?

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Anɛ hwɔ hami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ i ngɛ hlae lo? Anɛ nɔ nitsɛ e he pimi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ i suɔ lo? Ke nɔ ko ma e yi si kudɔɔ kaa ngɔwu, nɛ e ngmɛ kpekpe ngɛ la zu mi nɛ e hwɔ nɔ ɔ, enɛ ɔ nyɛ tsɛɔ hwɔ hami ɔ? Enɛ ɔ maa sa ye hɛ mi lo?

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ fa kue ha mi ɔ, ma he nɔ. Ke nyɛ tsɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa nu ye he. “Ke nyɛ kpa yi wu tso ní peemi, ke nyɛ kpa nɔ nya pomi yaka gu, kɛ munyu yaya tumi;

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: jehanɛ, ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee, nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ ní, loo nɔ́ ko hia nɔ ko, nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ diblii kpii nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe hleii kaa piani.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ, ma tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ daa, nɛ ma ha nyɛ maa ye ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ daa. Ma ha nyɛ ma na nɔmlɔ tso he wami saminya. Nyɛ maa pee kaa abɔɔ kɛ e mi nyu babauu, loo kaa pa ko nɛ nyu tɛ mi gblegbleegble.

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: lɛɛ bua jɔmi nɛ a naa ngɛ imi Yawɛ ye sɔmɔmi mi ɔ, nyɛ ma na. Ma ha je ɔ tsuo maa wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ zugba a nɛ i ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛ̃, Yakob ɔ, ma ha nyɛ maa ye e mi ní kpakpa amɛ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: Mohu nyɛ ná nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ gba nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ nyɛ kpɛti; nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ tsi e hɛ mi; lɔ ɔ he nɛ ke nyɛ fa kue nɛ e nui ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yeɔ fɔ, ejakaa nyɛ pueɔ muɔ si, nɛ nyɛ peeɔ yayamihi babauu. Yi wu tso níhi a he sɔuu nyɛ susuɔ, nɛ munyuhi nɛ jeɔ nyɛ nya a, lakpa sɔuu.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be ɔ, yayami he ga sɔuu nyɛ toɔ. Nɔ nɛ ko ye bemi ɔ, nyɛ he sɔɔ kɛ pueɔ e muɔ si yaka. He tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ gu ɔ, nɔ́ puɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ hɛ mi kpatami sɔuu nyɛ siɔ ngɛ nyɛ se;

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: nɔ ko nɔ ko yi e he ngɛ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ dɛ pɛ nyɛ peeɔ. Nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ gɔdɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ nyɛ se ɔ, e he mi jɔɛ lɛ gblegbleegble. Ma a jaje a he yayami

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ ma a ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa na le nɔ́ he je nɛ Mawu je we wɔ kɛ ji nihi nɛ ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae ɔ a dɛ mi. Wa hyɛɛ blɔ kaa wa ma na la kɛ nyɛɛ, se wa ná we; diblii kpii mi mohu wa nyɛɛɔ;

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: nɛ wa tataa si kɛ yaa gbogbo he kaa hɛ yuyuili. Wa tɛɔ si piani katakata kaa nɔ nɛ nyɔ mi. Wa peeɔ kaa ni gbogboehi ngɛ hɛ ngmengmletsɛmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
translation_verse: Wɔ tsuo wa yeɔ gbeye, nɛ wa ní peeɔ mɔbɔ. Wa hyɛɛ Mawu blɔ kaa e ma ba he wa yi wami kɛ je pimi kɛ amimi mi, se lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ, wa tɔmi ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu ngɛ o hɛ mi. Wa he yayami ɔmɛ yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ wɔ. Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa le wa nisɛ ní a ní ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: Wa tɔ o nɔ; wa wa nihi yi mi, nɛ wa kua mo. Wa ja we mo hu. Ni yayahi a he wa susuɔ, nɛ lakpa pɛ wa yeɔ.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: Wa yi dami sane, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ da hu wa pee we. Wa yi anɔkuale ngɛ sane yemi he; nɛ wa susuu we nɔ́ nɛ da he kulaa.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko yi anɔkuale hu; nɔ nɛ yuɔ e he kɛ jeɔ yayami he ɔ, a haoɔ lɛ kaa lɛ mohu ji yayami peelɔ.” Yawɛ pee klaalo nɛ e ma kpɔ e ma a Yawɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔɛ e nya kaa a yi dami sane.

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: E pee lɛ nyakpɛ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa da mi ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he wami e kɛ ma he e ma a yi wami; nɛ e ma a maa ye kunimi.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: E maa gbla a tue kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ to nane mi; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma se tsitsaa po be a he yee.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa su bonyoku je ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ye Yawɛ gbeye. E maa ba kaa pa nɛ hia; e maa ba kaa ahumi nɛ hia kɛ ma.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, “Ma ba Yerusalem, nɛ nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ kpa yayami peemi ɔ, ma ba he nyɛ yi wami.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: I kɛ nyɛ maa so somi. I ngɔ ye he wami ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ ye mlaa amɛ hu maa pee nyɛ nɔ́ kɛ maa ya neneene. Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nyɛ maa bu mi tue, nɛ nyɛ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ nina tsuo, konɛ a bu mi tue kɛ ya neneene.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, tee si nɛ o tso kaa pu; Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ o nɔ.

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Diblii maa ha zugba a tsuo nɔ, je ma amɛ maa hi diblii kpii mi, se moo lɛɛ Yawɛ ma je e he kpo ha mo; e hɛ mi nyami ɔ ma pue o nɔ.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Je mahi maa nyɛɛ kɛ ba o la a he, nɛ matsɛmɛ maa ba la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ o nɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi ja a, o bua maa jɔ; o maa muɔ jɛɛ, nɛ o ma nya saminya; ejakaa je ma amɛ maa ngɔ a juetli, kɛ sika nɛ a na ngɛ wo se ɔ tsuo kɛ ba o ngɔ.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Afukpɔngɔhi babauu ma ba bua a he nya ngɛ o ngɔ; a maa je Midian kɛ Efa. Sheba bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ sika tsu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ba, nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma ba je Yawɛ yi ngɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ e pee ha mɛ ɔ he!

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: A ma bua Kedar tohi tsuo a nya kɛ ba ha mo, konɛ o kɛ sã bɔ. A kɛ Nebayot agbosuhi ma ba sã bɔ nɛ maa sa Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa wo e we klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi nyami babauu pe daa a.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: Mɛnihi nɛ a ngɛ fo nɔ kɛ ma kaa bɔku, loo kaa lahuɛhi nɛ kpale kɛ ma a saflɛhi a mi nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Spania lɛhi nɛ a nyɛɛ hɛ mi kɛ je tsitsaa wo se zugbahi a nɔ kɛ ma a nɛ. A ngɔ bimɛ kɛ ma we. A hɛɛ sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ ma, konɛ a kɛ ba ha Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ a kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami. Ejakaa e wó e ma a nɔ gojoo ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem dee ke, “Nibwɔhi ma ba fia o ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ ma si ekohu, nɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma sɔmɔ mo. O wo ye mi mi la, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i gbla o tue; se jehanɛ lɛɛ, ma je ye suɔmi kpo ha mo, nɛ ma na mo mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: O ma a agbo ɔmɛ maa hi blibli daa nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a ngɔ a ní tsuo kɛ ba be tsuaa be; a maa nyɛɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ba.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Je ma, loo nɔ yemi nɛ be mo sɔmɔe ɔ, a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: “A maa poo Lebanon tso kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ma Yerusalem ekohu: sɛsɛo, odum kɛ tsohi nɛ da tlɔmɔɔ ɔ tsuo. Enɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ maa pee fɛu, nɛ ye ma a hɛ mi maa ba nyami.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ wa mo yi mi ɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ maa ba, nɛ a ma ba kpla si ha mo. Nihi nɛ gbe o he guɛ be ko ɔ, mɛ hu a ma ba kpla si ngɛ o nane nya. Nɛ a ma tsɛ mo ke, ‘Yawɛ ma,’ ‘Zion, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ma.’

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: “A be mo kuae, nɛ a be mo nyɛe hu kaa sa be ko nɛ o pee ma doku nɛ nɔ ko gui lejɛ ɔ. Ma wo o nɔ gojoo, nɛ o he maa pee fɛu. O maa pee he nɛ bua jɔmi maa hi daa.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Je mahi, kɛ matsɛmɛ maa lɛ mo kaa bɔ nɛ binyɛ haa e bi nyɔ ɔ. O maa le jehanɛ kaa imi Yawɛ nɛ i ha o yi na wami. O maa le kaa imi, Israel Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ i ha o ye o he.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: “Akɔblee nane mi ɔ, ma ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ba, dade nane mi ɔ, sika hiɔ, tso nane mi ɔ, akɔblee, nɛ tɛ nane mi ɔ, dade. O nɔ yeli ɔmɛ be mo yi mi wae hu. Ma ha a maa ngɔ dami sane yemi, kɛ he jɔmi kɛ hyɛ o nɔ.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: A be yi mi wami he nue ngɛ zugba a nɔ hu; a be ní puɛmi, kɛ hɛ mi kpatami he nue ngɛ o huza amɛ a nɔ hu. Ma bu o he, nɛ ma fa o he. Ma pee kaa gbogbo ngɛ o se. Nɛ o ma je ye yi, ejakaa i he o yi wami.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: “Tsa pi pu nɛ maa pee la ha mo piani hu, jehanɛ hu tsa pi nyɔhiɔ nɛ ma ha mo la nyɔ mi. Se mohu imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma pee o la kɛ maa ya neneene. Ye hɛ mi nyami maa pee kaa la nɛ ma kpɛ ha mo.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: O kɔmɔ yemi ligbi ɔmɛ a se maa po. Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma pee la ha mo kɛ maa ya neneene; pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ lɛɛ a se maa po.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: O ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da. A maa hi zugba a nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene. Imi lɛ i to mɛ si. Imi lɛ i pee mɛ jã, konɛ a kɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Wɛtso nyafii pe kulaa ma ba pee ma kpetekpleenyɛ. Ke be ɔ su ɔ, imi nitsɛ ma ha nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi oya. Imi ji Yawɛ!”

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ ye nɔ; Yawɛ pɔ mi nu, nɛ e tsɔ mi, konɛ ma ngɔ manye munyu ya ha nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ; nɛ ma wo kɔmɔ yeli a bua; nɛ ma ya de nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ ke a he yemi be su ta, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ ke a jémi be su ta.

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke ma ya fiɛ ke be ko nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi ma. Be nɛ Mawu maa gbla nihi a tue, kɛ kɔmɔ yeli a bua womi be ɔ su ta.

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ngɛ Zion ɔ, e ma bu mɛ jlasi nɛ a kɛ mɔmɔ pee, se pi la zu; a bua maa jɔ; a ma kpa kɔmɔ yemi, nɛ a ma la yi jemi la. A maa bɔ kaa tso nguaa nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma. Mɛ tsuo a maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a maa wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.
translation_verse: Ma dokuhi tsuo nɛ pueɔ si kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, a maa fia mɛ kɛ ma si ekohu.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ ye ma a, a ma tsɛ nyɛ ke Yawɛ osɔfohi, a ma tsɛ nyɛ Mawu sɔmɔli hulɔ. Je ma amɛ a ní ɔ, nyɛ nyɛ maa ye, nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ kaa lɛ tsuo ba pee nyɛ nɔ́.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: A nina ma na biɛ saminya ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti. Nihi tsuo nɛ maa na mɛ ɔ ma de ke ma nɛ imi Yawɛ nitsɛ i gbaa ji mɛ.”

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: Yerusalem ngɛ nyae ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu pee ha lɛ ɔ he. Yerusalem pee kaa ayɛflo nɛ wo june, loo ayɛflo huno nɛ ngɔ mɔmɔ kɛ dla e he kɛ yaa yo kpeemi. Niinɛ, Mawu he Yerusalem yi wami, nɛ e ye kunimi ha lɛ.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: O maa pee kaa jlasi saminyayoo ngɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ dɛ mi.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ niheyo kpeɔ yomiyo ayɛflo ɔ, ja nɔ nɛ bɔ mo ɔ maa ngɔ mo hulɔ. Bɔ nɛ ayɛflo huno nyaa ayɛflo he ɔ, ja o Mawu ɔ bua maa jɔ o he.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Yerusalem, i ngɔ buli ngɔ to o gbogbo ɔmɛ a nɔ. Nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo, a ko pee dii; se mohu a hi Yawɛ kaie ngɛ si ko nɛ e wo e ma a he, konɛ e hɛ ko je nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ka e he kita, nɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nɔ mi mae ngɛ dee ji, “Ye ma, i be o blɛfo ngɔe kɛ ha o he nyɛli nɛ a ye hu, nɛ o wai nɛ o gbo he dengme ɔ, nibwɔhi ba be nue hu.

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: Se mohu, o nihi nɛ du blɛfo nɛ a kpɔ ɔ, mɛ lɛ a maa ye, nɛ a ma je imi Yawɛ ye yi. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ bua wai yiblii nya a, mɛ lɛ a maa nu dã a ngɛ kue ɔmɛ a mi, ngɛ ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Yerusalem bi, nyɛɛ je kpo; nyɛɛ gu agbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ je kpo! Nyɛɛ je gbɛjegbɛ kɛ ha ma a; nyɛ kukuɔ a nɔ tɛhi tsuo. Nyɛɛ si aflangaa nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a na.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ fiɛe kɛ yaa su je mi nyagbe he ɔ tɔɔ; e ke a de Zion biyo ɔ ke, “Be ɔ su jehanɛ, Yawɛ ma nɛ e ba he o yi wami. E ngɔ nihi nɛ e kpɔ ɔ kɛ ma.”

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: A ma tsɛ nyɛ ke, “Ma klɔuklɔu”, “Ma nɛ Yawɛ kpɔ mɛ.” A ma tsɛ Yerusalem ke, “Ma nɛ a ya hla nɛ a na”, “Ma nɛ Mawu kua we lɛ.”

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: “Mɛnɔ lɛ je Bozra ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ kɛ ma nɛ ɔ? Mɛnɔ lɛ dla e he saminyayoo kɛ tade tsu, nɛ e ngɛ kɔsɔe wawɛɛ kɛ he wami kɛ ma nɛ ɔ?” “Imi Yawɛ, kpɔlɔ nɛ nine si wa a, i ngɛ dee kɛ ngmlaa ke i ye kunimi oo, i ye kunimi.”

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
translation_verse: “Mɛni he je nɛ e tade tsu kikɛ nɛ ɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ wai yiblii ngae kɛ pee dã e tade ɔ?”

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: I pee ye yi mi momo kaa ma gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma he ye ma a yi wami; ejakaa be ɔ su jehanɛ.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: Benɛ i hyɛ ɔ, e pee mi nyakpɛ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɛ e ba je ngmlaa ha mi. Se ye mi mi nɛ fu ɔ wo mi he wami, nɛ imi nɔ kake too i ye kunimi.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: I kɛ mi mi la naa je ma amɛ a nɔ basabasa, nɛ i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa. I tsɛ̃ a muɔ ngɔ pue zugba.” Yawɛ pee Israel kpakpa

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Ma gba Yawɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he sane. Ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ e ha wɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma je e yi. E gbaa Israel ma a babauu; ejakaa Yawɛ mɔbɔ nami, kɛ e suɔmi be nyagbe.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Imi nitsɛ ye ma ji mɛ; a be mi sisie.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha a yi na wami

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: kɛ je a haomi tsuo kulaa mi. Pi bɔfo ko nɛ e tsɔ, se lɛ nitsɛ lɛ e he a yi wami. E suɔmi, kɛ e mɔbɔ nami he je ɔ, e kpɔ mɛ, nɛ e hɛɛ mɛ saminya ngɛ blema be ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a tsɔ atuã; a ha nɛ aywilɛho nu mɛ. Yawɛ ba plɛ pee a he nyɛlɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ hwu.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a kai blema, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose be ɔ, nɛ a bi ke, “Yawɛ nɛ́ je ma a, kɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ kɛ je wo ɔ mi ɔ, jije e ngɛ? Jije nɔ nɛ ngɔ e mumi klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ wo a mi ɔ ngɛ?

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha e ma a he jɔmi. Bɔ nɛ ke a kpaka na kɛ ya kɔ̃ mi nɛ e naa niye ní kpakpa nɛ e yeɔ ɔ, jã Yawɛ kpaka e ma a saminya, nɛ e kɛ na biɛ kpakpa kɛ hɛ mi nyami. Ma a fa kue ha Mawu

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo hyɛ wɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ngɛ o hi he klɔuklɔu he nɛ hɛ mi nyami bɔle mo ngɛ ɔ. O hɛdɔ, kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ? O tsui mi sami, kɛ suɔmi babauu ɔ hu a se po.

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Mo ji wa tsɛ. Wa nɛmɛ Abraham, kɛ Yakob li wɔ, se mo Yawɛ, wa tsɛ, mo ji wa kpɔlɔ kɛ je blema lokoo.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mɛni he je o haa nɛ wa tlaa blɔ kɛ jeɔ o blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ wa kpliiɔ wa tsui, konɛ wa ko ye mo gbeye ɔ? Israel ma a, o nɔ, nɛ o tsɔli ji wɔ tsuo. Mo nitsɛ o nihi ji wɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kpale kɛ ba!

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Wɔ o ma klɔuklɔu ɔ, wa hi o he klɔuklɔu ɔ be bɔɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ wa he nyɛli ba ywia o ma a!

english_verse: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
translation_verse: Wa pee kaa nihi nɛ o hyɛ we a nɔ hyɛ, loo ni komɛ nɛ a kɛ o biɛ tsɛ we mɛ hyɛ!

english_verse: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
translation_verse: I ná nɛ hiɔwe mi gba enyɔ nɛ o kple si kɛ ba!

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: I ná nɛ yo ɔmɛ mimiɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ́ tsɔwi la tsoo nɛ e haa nyu fiaa gudaguda ngɛ la nɔ ɔ. Ke e ba mi ja a, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa nu o he, nɛ je ma amɛ a he maa do blibliibli ngɛ o hɛ mi!

english_verse: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
translation_verse: Blema, benɛ o pee nyakpɛ níhi nɛ wa hyɛ we blɔ ɔ, o kple si kɛ ba; yo ɔmɛ mimiɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi!

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Wɔ tsuo wa pee yayami, nɛ wa plɛ pee nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we. Kpakpa nɛ wa peeɔ ɔ po ngɛ kaa tade sɛmusɛmu ngɛ o hɛ mi. Wa yayami ɔmɛ ha wɔ tsuo wa pee kaa ba gbigbli nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ kɛ yaa.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ faa kue ha mo; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ba bi we yemi kɛ buami kɛ ji o ngɔ. O ngɔ o hɛ mi kɛ laa wɔ. Wa yayami ɔmɛ ha nɛ o kua wɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, mo ji wa tsɛ. Wa ngɛ kaa zu, nɛ moo lɛɛ o ngɛ kaa buɛ puɛlɔ; mo lɛ o bɔ wɔ.

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o mi mi ko fu wɔ tsɔ; ko kai wa yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ya neneene! O ma ji wɔ; naa wɔ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
translation_verse: O ma klɔuklɔu ɔ plɛ pee nga kplanaa. Zion plɛ pee nga nɔ, nɛ Yerusalem pee ma doku.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Wa sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu saminyayoo, he nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je o yi ngɛ ɔ, a kɛ la sã, nɛ a kpata hehi nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “I pee klaalo konɛ nihi nɛ li mi ɔ nɛ a hla ye se blɔ; i pee klaalo konɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ li mi ɔ nɛ a le mi jehanɛ. Daa nɛ ɔ, i pee klaalo nɛ i ngɛ ma a dee ke, ‘I ngɛ hiɛ ɔ oo; nyɛ tsɛ mi nɛ ma piɛ nyɛ he.’

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be ɔ, ma nɛ ɔ jeɔ blɔ paa nɛ a woɔ ye mi mi la; a sãã bɔhi ngɛ abɔɔhi a mi; a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ tɛhi a nɔ;

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: nyɔ mi tsuo a hii yɔkɔhi a mi, kɛ hehi nɛ e sɛ́ nɛ a na mɛ ngɛ; kpotoo lo pohu a yeɔ, kɛ flɔɔ nɛ a ngɔ níhi nɛ a hiee kɛ pee ngɛ a tsesihi a mi.

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: “I pee ye yi mi momo, nɛ i ngma ngɔ fɔ si ke i be ye nya mae hu; ma gbla a tue wawɛɛ kɛ to nane mi sisiisi

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ ko kpataa we e wai yiblii kpakpa hɛ mi; dã mohu e kɛ peeɔ. Jã kɛ̃ i be ye ma a hɛ mi kpatae pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ mi ɔ, ma he a yi wami.

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: Ma ha Yakob nina babauu. Ma ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ ma ba hi yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; lejɛ ɔ tsuo maa pee ye sɔmɔli nɛ i hla nɛ ɔ a nɔ́.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: Ye ma a mi bi nɛ hlaa ye se blɔ ɔ, Sharon nga a nɔ maa pee a to lɛmi he, nɛ Haomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi ji he nɛ a nahi maa jɔɔ a he ngɛ.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: “Se nyɛ nihi nɛ kuaa imi Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ jeɔ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nɔ́ maa slo. Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɔ okplɔɔ kɛ haa mawu nɛ haa nɔ siade, kɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ wai nɛ a futu kɛ sãã bɔ ha mawu nɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ngɛ je mi,

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si ha nyɛ ji klaate. Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa nɔ basabasa ngɛ klaate nya; ejakaa benɛ i tsɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he we nɔ, nɛ benɛ i tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bui tue. Yayami mohu nyɛ pee ngɛ ye hɛ mi; níhi nɛ i sume ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a se nyɛ ya nyɛɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Nyɛ biɛ maa pee nɔ nɛ a kɛ gbiɛɔ ha ye ma nɛ i hla a; ejakaa imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ, ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ jaa mi ɔ lɛɛ ma wo mɛ biɛ he.

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma hla kaa a gbaa lɛ ɔ ma bi Mawu anɔkualetsɛ ɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ ma ka kita ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ hu maa ngɔ Mawu anɔkualetsɛ ɔ biɛ kɛ ka; ejakaa blema haomi ɔmɛ maa be kɛ ho, nɛ a be kaie hu.” Je he ɔ

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he bɔe; nɛ a be blema ní ɔmɛ kaie hu; hɛ maa je a nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ ye bua maa jɔ Yerusalem, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a he. A be ya fomi, loo kɔmɔ yemi he nue ngɛ ma a mi hu.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Ma he nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, bimwɔyo be gboe hu; nɔmoyo hu be gboe loko e be maa su. Ke a fɔ nɔ ko ɔ, ja e ye jeha lafa loko e ma gbo. Yayami peelɔ pɛ nɛ lɛɛ e be nae ja.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: A maa po wehi, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a maa hi mi; a maa pee wai ngmɔhi, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a maa ye a mi yiblii.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: A be yaka dengme gboe; a bimɛ be kpatu gbenɔ gboe; ejakaa nihi nɛ imi Yawɛ i gbaa mɛ a nina ji mɛ; a ngmɛdu maa hi si daa.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ogbetee kɛ jijɔ ma bla kɛ ye ní; jata ma kpe nga kaa na; nɛ sinɔ lɛɛ zu e maa ye. Nɔ ko be e nyɛmi awi yee, nɛ nɔ ko be e nyɛmi hɛ mi kpatae ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Hiɔwe ji ye matsɛ sɛ, nɛ zugba ji nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ye nane maa nɔ. Mɛni tsu nyɛ maa ma ha mi mɔ, nɛ jije ye he jɔɔmi he ngɛ?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Ye nine nya níhi ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ tsuo. Nihi nɛ baa a he si, nɛ a naa a he yayami nɛ a tsakeɔ a tsui, nihi nɛ yeɔ mi gbeye, nɛ a buɔ mi tue ɔ, mɛ ji nihi nɛ i suɔ.

english_verse: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
translation_verse: “Ma mi bi ɔmɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ. E si we mɛ kpu kaa a maa ngɔ na, loo nɔmlɔ adesa kɛ sã bɔ. Slɔɔto ko be mi ke a ngɔ to kɛ sã bɔ, loo a ku gbe kuɛ kɛ pee. Slɔɔto be mi ke a ngɔ ngma kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ, aloo a ngɔ kpotoo muɔ kɛ ba. Tsopa kɛ e he via a ngɛ sãe jio, amaga nɛ a ngɛ jae jio, slɔɔto ko kulaa be mi ha mɛ. Musu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he a nyaa.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu ma ha amanehlu nɛ a ngɛ gbeye yee ɔ maa ba a nɔ. Ejakaa i tsɛ mɛ, se nɔ ko nɔ ko he we nɔ; i tu munyu, se a bui tue fɛɛ. Yayami mohu a pee ngɛ ye hɛ mi; nɛ níhi nɛ sɛ ye hɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a he a nya.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ, nyɛ ta tue, “Akɛnɛ nyɛ yeɔ mi anɔkuale ɔ, nyɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ nyɛɔ nyɛ, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ pee we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, se nyɛ he fɛu mohu a yeɔ. A deɔ ke, ‘Yawɛ nɛ je e he wami kpo nɛ e he nyɛ yi wami, konɛ waa na bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nya ha.’ Se mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi si mohu a ma pue!

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.

translation_verse: A wehi, a zugbahi, kɛ a yihi ma plɛ pee ni kpahi a níhi, ejakaa ma gbla zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bi ɔmɛ a tue.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Anɛ zo gbe mɛ benɛ a tsu musu ní nɛ ɔmɛ lo? Dɛbi, zo gbi mɛ fɛɛ; nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ zo po a li. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mɛ hu a ma gbo kɛ piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a maa gbe ɔ a he. Ke i gbla a tue kɛkɛ a nyagbe ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Israel kua Mawu blɔ ɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de e ma a ke, “Nyɛ ya da blɔ gbla nya nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ. Nyɛ bi nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ blema nane blɔ kpakpa amɛ nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ nɔ. Nyɛɛ pee ja, konɛ nyɛ na tue mi jɔmi.” Se ma a he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, wa be pee fɛɛ!”

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, to Yawɛ buli ngɛ ma a mi konɛ ma a nɛ bu titimati ɔ pɛmi tue. Se a de ke, “Wa be tue bue fɛɛ!”

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Je ɔ, bu tue! Ma ngɔ haomi kɛ ba ma nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa yayamihi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a pee ɔ he tue gblami. Ejakaa a bui ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ ye mlaa a hu a yi nɔ.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: Tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a kɛ jeɔ Sheba kɛ ba haa mi ɔ, mɛni ma pee he? Nu he via nɛ a kɛ jeɔ ma se lokoo kɛ ba haa mi ɔ, i hla we. I be a sami bɔ ɔmɛ ngɔe; bɔ kpa amɛ hu i sume.

english_verse: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma fɔ blɔ mi tso ha mɛ; a ma tɛ nɔ nɛ a maa nɔ si bum. Tsɛmɛ kɛ a bimɛ ma gbo, nɛ nihi kɛ a huɛmɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.” He nyɛli maa je omleyi je kɛ ba

english_verse: The Lord said, “Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ma ko mi bi je omleyi je kɛ ma; je ma ko nɛ a he wa saminya je tsitsaa kɛ ma nɛ a ba tua nyɛ.

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji mɛ; mɔbɔ nami kake too be a mi. A mia kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ akplɔ, nɛ a hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ ma. Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nane si ngɛ pɛe glɛi glɛi glɛi kaa wo nɛ gli. A ma nɛ a ba tua Yerusalem.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke, “Wa nu a he, nɛ wa nine mi je wu! Wa tsui po, nɛ wa pee kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma fɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Wa be nyɛe maa je kpo kɛ ya nga a nɔ, loo waa nyɛɛ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. Ejakaa he nyɛli ɔmɛ hɛɛ klaate, nɛ he tsuaa he pee gbeyegbeye.”

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de e ma a ke, “Nyɛ bu kpekpe ya bo, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ wuwlua si ngɛ la zu mi. Nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ kaa a yeɔ kɔmɔ kɛ haa bi kake too nɛ gbo, ejakaa ta a nɛ ma nyɛ hɛ mi kpatami ɔ ma ba tua nyɛ tlukaa.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ atuã tsɔli, kɛ yakayaka nimli ji mɛ; a tue wa kaa akɔblee kɛ dade. Daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ nihi a sisi nyɛɛe kɛ ngɛ bee.

english_verse: Silver can be purified in a fiery furnace, but my people are too wicked to be made pure, and so I have rejected them.
translation_verse: A ma tsɛ mɛ ke dade fi, ejakaa imi Yawɛ, i kua mɛ.”

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: Se nɔ ko nɔ ko bui mɛ tue; sɛ gbi ɔ hu nyɛ ngɔɛ. Nyɛ wa tue mohu, nɛ nyɛ ya nɔ pee yayami kulaa pe nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to stand by the gate of the temple and tell the people who were going in that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: Pay attention, people of Judah! Change your ways and start living right, then I will let you keep on living in your own country.
translation_verse: Yawɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ya da sɔlemi we ɔ agbo ɔ mi, he nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ guu kɛ ya jaa Yawɛ ɔ. E de mi ke ma ya da lejɛ ɔ, konɛ ma ngɔ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Israel Mawu ɔ sɛ gbi kɛ ha mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ je mi babɛ, kɛ nyɛ ní peepee, konɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ daa.

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ je mi babɛ; kɛ nyɛ ní peepee. Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ hi si saminya.

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ tsake ɔ, zugba nɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ blema ko ɔ, ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa hi nɔ, nɛ e maa pee nyɛ weto ní.

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, lakpa munyuhi nɛ a he be se nami ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ lɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ juɔ, nyɛ pueɔ muɔ si, nyɛ puɛɔ gba, nyɛ kaa lakpa kita, nyɛ sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa Baal, nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛɔ mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ li mɛ a se.

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: E peeɔ nyɛ kaa ye we ɔ, juli a laami he, pi ja? Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, i na kɛ ye hɛngmɛ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ya Shilo, kekleekle ma, he nɛ i hla kaa a ja mi ngɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ya hyɛ bɔ nɛ i pee lejɛ ɔ ngɛ ye ma Israel he yayami ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Nyɛ pee yayami nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ i tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔtonɔto, se nyɛ bui tue fɛɛ. Ke i tsɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ he we nɔ.

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ i pee Shilo ɔ, ja nɔuu ma pee imi nitsɛ ye we nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ nɛ ɔ. Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ, kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ i pee Shilo ɔ, ja ma pee lɛ.

english_verse: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes. Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
translation_verse: Ma fie nyɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i fie nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ ji Efraim nina a. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Ma a gbo tue

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, o hyɛ we lo?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Bimɛ lɛɔ lɛ́, nɛ tsɛmɛ slɛɔ la, nɛ nyɛmɛ pɔtɔɔ ma nɛ a kɛ sãã abolo kɛ haa yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Hiɔwemanyɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, a kɛ wai sãã bɔ kɛ haa mawu kpahi, konɛ a kɛ wo ye mi mi la.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Se anɛ imi ye mi mi la a ngɛ woe ɔ lo? Dɛbi! Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he lɛ a ngɛ pee; a kɛ ma kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ma plɛ ye mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam nɛ hí gbemi ɔ kɛ pue we nɛ ɔ nɔ. Ye mi mi ma fu nimli, lohwehi, tsohi, kɛ ngmɔ niba ní tsuo.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, but I won't accept sacrifices from you. So don't even bother bringing them to me. You might as well just cook the meat for yourselves.
translation_verse: “Ye ma, nyɛ sãã bɔ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya siɔ a nglaa, nɛ ekomɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ. Se nɔ́ nɛ imi Tabohiatsɛ Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ji kaa nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye lɛ tsuo faa.

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Benɛ i je nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, i wui mɛ mlaa ko mlaa ko ngɛ sami bɔ, loo bɔ kpa komɛ a he.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ i wo mɛ ji a bu mi, konɛ ma pee a Mawu, nɛ a pee ye ma. I de mɛ ke mlaa nɛ i wo mɛ ɔ, a ye nɔ, konɛ e hi ha mɛ.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je Egipt hluu kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ kɛ baa nyɛ ngɔ daa be tsuaa be.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: De mɛ ke ma nɛ ɔ bui imi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ; a tue nɛ i gbla a hu a kase we ní kɛ ji mi. Anɔkuale laa pɛsɛpɛsɛ; munyu ‘anɔkuale’ ɔ po nɔ ko pa wui nɔ ta hu. Yakayaka níhi ngɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ sã nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ nyɛ sake bwɔmi ɔ pue he; nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ ngɛ yoku kpataa amɛ a nɔ, ejakaa imi Yawɛ ɔ, ye mi mi fu ye ma a, nɛ i kua mɛ.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: “Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee yayami. A ngɔ a we amagahi nɛ i hiee ɔ ba to ye we ɔ nɛ a kɛ ble we ɔ.

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: A ya ma bɔ sami la tɛ ko ngɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi, konɛ a sã a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ. A wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ biɛ ke Tofet. I wui mɛ mlaa ke a pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ; nɔ́ nɛ ɔ bɛ ye yi mi po hyɛ.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be ma nɛ a be lejɛ ɔ tsɛe ke Tofet, loo Hinom kɔ̃ hu, se mohu Awiyemi kɔ̃. A maa pu nihi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa a be he kpa ko nae hu.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Ni gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pee lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ nga mi lohwehi a niye ní, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mɛ fiee.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Zugba a ma plɛ pee nga kplanaa. Ma ha nɛ nyami, bua jɔmi, kɛ ayɛflo he ní peemi hoo ɔ se maa po ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a maa tsua Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, ganɔ ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ nɛ hi Yerusalem ɔ a wuhi ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: A be wu nɛ ɔmɛ a nya buae, nɛ a be mɛ pue hulɔ; wu ɔmɛ maa pee kaa kuku ngɛ zugba a nɔ. A ma ka wu ɔmɛ ngɔ ha pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ kɛ dodoehi. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ ma a suɔ saminya; ma a sɔmɔ mɛ, nɛ a bi ní ngɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a ja mɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi ja, ma yayami nɛ ɔ mi bi nɛ a yi ma na wami ngɛ hehi nɛ ma sake mɛ ngɔ pue ɔ, a maa suɔ kaa a ma gbo mohu pe nɔ́ nɛ a maa hi je mi. Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.” Yayami kɛ tue gblami

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke ma de ma a ke, “Ke nɔ ko nɔ si ɔ, anɛ e ti si ekohu lo? Ke nɔ ko laa blɔ ɔ, anɛ e kpale we e se lo?

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Godohi tete le be nɛ a kɛ kpaleɔ a se kɛ baa we; lahuɛ, otoklii, kɛ aklawa hu le be nɛ a kɛ jeɔ he kake kɛ yaa he kake. Se ye ma, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ li ye mlaa amɛ.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke ní leli ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ le ye mlaa amɛ, be mi nɛ yakayaka womi ngmali tsake mlaa amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Zo gbe nyɛ ní leli ɔmɛ; bibi gbe mɛ, nɛ a pa li nɔ́ nɛ nɔ nɛ a ngɛ hu. A kua ye munyu ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni ji ní ɔ nɛ a le ɔ mɔ?

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: “I ka kaa ma bua ye ma a nya kaa bɔ nɛ ngmɔ hulɔ buaa e ngmɔ niba ní nya a; se e hí peemi. Ye ma a ngɛ kaa wai tso nɛ wai yiblii be nɔ. A ngɛ kaa ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ ngmɔkɔ be nɔ; ba amɛ tete po ngla. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ha nɛ nibwɔhi ba ngɔ a zugba a.”

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Wa hyɛ tue mi jɔmi blɔ, se tue mi jɔmi bɛ; wa hyɛ tsami be blɔ, se gbeye mohu ji nɔ́ nɛ ba.

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ma tsɔ sinɔhi kɛ ba nyɛ kpɛti, sangahi ma ba kɔɔ nyɛ; kunya yelɔ ko kunya yelɔ ko be nyɛe maa jɔɔ a he.” Yeremia ye kɔmɔ ha e ma a

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu tue! Ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ ɔ, i nu nɛ ye ma a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae nɛ a ngɛ bie ke, “Anɛ Yawɛ be Zion hu lo? Zion matsɛ ɔ be ma a mi hu lo?” Yawɛ bi ke, “Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ ya ja amagahi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi wo ye mi mi la a? Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ ya kpla si ha ma se wohi?”

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: Ma a he nɔ kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Latsa be ɔ se po, nɛ a kpa ní ta, se a he we wa yi wami lolo.”

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Anɛ tsopa be Gilead lo? Tsopatsɛ ko be lejɛ ɔ lo? Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a tsa we ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ lolo ɔ?

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Daa nɛ ɔ, a duɔ a lilɛ nya ngɔ to kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ a dɔ mi nɛ a ma tsɛ̃. Lakpa, kɛ sisimi sɔuu ji zugba a nɔ; anɔkuale be. Yawɛ ke, “Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ peeɔ yayami nɔtonɔto; se imi lɛɛ a li mi kaa a Mawu.”

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: A peeɔ yi wu tso níhi nɔtonɔto; jã kɛ̃ nɛ a sisiɔ nɔ. Yawɛ ke e ma mi bi ɔmɛ kua lɛ.

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: A lilɛ ngɛ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ gbeɔ nɔ; lakpa pɛ a yeɔ. Nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi tuɔ munyu ngɛ he jɔmi mi, se a tsui mi be ja; klama mohu lɛ a hii a sibi tsɔe.

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: Anɛ ma ko gbla a tue ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he lo? Ma nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma ko gbla a tue lo? Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: I de ke, “Ma ye kɔmɔ ha yoku ɔmɛ, nɛ ma fo ya ha lohwehi a lɛmi he ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ. Ejakaa lejɛ ɔmɛ gbli, nɛ a fɔɔ si gu; nɔ ko nɔ ko gui lejɛ ɔmɛ hu. A pa nui kaa na ngɛ pɛe muu muu ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ hu; lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo tu fo kɛ je.”

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ma pee Yerusalem ma doku, kɛ nga mi gbehi a hi he. Yuda ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi hie.”

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: Ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je mahi nɛ a kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nui a he hyɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ ta maa nyɛɛ a se hluu kɛ yaa si ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.” Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ bi yemi kɛ buami

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ke, “Nyɛ susu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae nɛ ɔ he! Nyɛ ya kpee yihi nɛ nyɛɔ ya a kɛ ba; nyɛ ya kpee yihi nɛ a he be ɔ kɛ ba.”

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Ma a de ke, “Nyɛ de mɛ nɛ a pee esɔ nɛ a ba wo yana ha wɔ, kɛ yaa si wa hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ maa tɔ nyu, nɛ wa hɛngmɛ se maa fuu kɛ ya fomi sɔuu.”

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: A wo yana ngɛ Zion, nɛ a ngɛ dee ke, “Wa yi ta oo, wa yi ta! Wa hɛ mi pue si pɛ! Nyɛ ha nɛ waa je wa zugba a nɔ, ejakaa a ku wa we ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: I de ke, “Nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ. Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ kɔmɔ yemi, kɛ nyɛ huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya la lami.

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Gbenɔ kuɔ wa saflɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba sɛ wa mɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e kpata wa nihewi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa yihewi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; jokuɛwi pa fiɛ we ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu, nɛ nihewi kɛ yihewi ta jua amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: A sake ni gbogboehi ngɔ pue he tsuaa he glekugleku kaa kuku ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ, loo blɛfo nɛ ní kpali poo pue si nɛ a je he, blɛfo nɛ nɔ ko bua we nya.” Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mi ke ma de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa fĩa a, e fĩa kaa e le mi saminya; ejakaa ye suɔmi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble; i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ i yeɔ dami sane. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ saa ye hɛ mi. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ ma gbla Egipt bi, Yuda bi, Edom bi, Amon bi, kɛ Moab bi a tue. Nihi nɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ nɛ a poɔ huɛ ngɛ a hɛ se ɔ hu piɛ he. A po nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. Se somi nɛ pomi okadi nɛ ɔ daa si ha a lɛɛ a yi nɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ jio, ye ma Israel ɔ jio, nɔ ko nɔ ko yi ye somi ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ je ma kpa amɛ a blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ; ke nyɛ na okadihi ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye kaa bɔ nɛ je ma kpa amɛ yeɔ gbeye ɔ.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ a kusumi ɔmɛ ɔ, lakpa sɔuu. A ya poɔ tso ngɛ pu mi, nɛ tso kpɛ́lɔ kɛ dade tsuɔ he ní,

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu haa he. A kaa plɛɛko kɛ woɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ a kɛ nuu tso ɔ ngɔ daa si konɛ e ko nɔ si.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Amaga amɛ ngɛ kaa lohwehi a he gbeye womi níhi nɛ maa si ngɛ jamatlɛ ngmɔ mi; a tu we munyu. A nyɛɛ we hulɔ; pe a woɔ a nɔ kɛ jeɔ he kake kɛ yaa he kake. Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye, ejakaa a be nyɛe maa pee nyɛ yayami ko; kpakpa ko hu a be nyɛe maa pee ha nyɛ.”

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: A kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ a si nɔ jeɔ Spania, nɛ a kɛ sika tsu hu jeɔ Ufaz kɛ ba haa sika ga ní tsuli, nɛ a kɛ peeɔ amagahi. A buɔ amaga amɛ bo hiɔ, kɛ bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su nɛ bo loli kpakpahi lo.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Se mo Yawɛ, Mawu nitsɛnitsɛ ji mo; mo ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ; neneene matsɛ ji mo. Ke o mi mi fu ɔ, zugba mimiɛɔ, nɛ je ma amɛ nyɛ we nya dami.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: Nyɛ de mɛ ke, jamɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ jae, nɛ pohu pi mɛ nɛ a pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, a hɛ mi ma kpata. A be mɛ nae ngɛ je ɔ mi he ko he ko hu. Mawu yi jemi la

english_verse: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lɛ bɔ je ɔ ngɛ e he wami nya. Nile lɛ e kɛ bɔ je ɔ, nɛ jamɛ a nile ɔ nɔuu e kɛ bli hiɔwe mi.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Ke e wo gbi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ keɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; Yawɛ lɛ haa afua teɔ si kɛ jeɔ zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ. E haa oslabai gbaa be mi nɛ hiɔmi ngɛ nɛe, nɛ e jeɔ kɔɔhiɔ kpo kɛ jeɔ e nito he ɔ.

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Nimli adesahi tsuo biɛ; a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. Sika gali a hɛ mi pue si pɛ; ejakaa amaga amɛ nɛ a puɛɛ ɔ, ní guhi ji mɛ; wami ko wami ko be a mi.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Yakob Mawu ɔ be kaa mɛ; lɛ ji nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e hla Israel kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma. E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ. A ma ba nuu ni ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: Yerusalem bi, a sa nyɛ ma a yi oo! Nyɛ bua nyɛ níhi a nya.

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ma sake nimli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɔ fɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ tɛ ɔ. Ma hao mɛ kɛ yaa si a maa nu he.”

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ kpa bubuubui ke, “Akuanyɛ! Wa plaa pɛ! Wa pa a be tsa ba. Se wa susu kaa wa ma nyɛ ma mia wa hɛ mi kɛ to nɔ.
