english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: I he nɔ ke, “Wa nɔ yeli ɔmɛ be juɛmi; a bi we Yawɛ ga womi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a yɛ́ nɔ; nɛ wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛ fĩa.

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ nɛ li mo ɔ, o mi mi nɛ fu mɛ; ni nɛmɛ nɛ ja we mo ɔ, gbla a tue. A gbe o ma mi bi nɛ ji Yakob nina a; a kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a pee wa zugba a kaa nga kplanaa nɔ.

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: Benɛ i jé a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ, somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Egipt zugba a ngɛ kaa flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege. I wo mɛ mlaa ke a bu mi tue, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de mɛ ke a pee ɔ, a pee. I de mɛ ke, ke a bu mi tue ɔ, a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.

english_verse: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, si ko nɛ i wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kaa ma ha mɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní ɔ, ma ye nɔ. Jamɛ a zugba a nɔ a ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” I he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ, ha nɛ e ba mi ja.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa fiɛ ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ o de ni ɔmɛ ke a bu somi munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ a ye nɔ.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Benɛ i je a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, i ka a hɛ mi saminya nɛ i de mɛ ke a bu mi tue. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu i ngɛ ma a hɛ mi kae kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Se a bui mi tue fɛɛ; munyu nɛ i kɛ mɛ tu ɔ po, a nui. A wa tue nɛ a pee yayami kaa kekle ɔ mohu. I wo mɛ mlaa ke a ye somi ɔ nɔ, se a kua nɔ yemi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i gbla a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ somi tsɔɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ekohu ke, “Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Yayamihi nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, a kpale ya pee jamɛ a yayami ɔmɛ. A nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we kaa a maa bu mi tue, nɛ a ya ja mawu kpahi. Israel ma a, kɛ Yuda ma a tsuo yi somi nɛ i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke, ma ha nɛ haomi maa ba a nɔ nɛ a he be mi jee. Ke a fa kue ha mi po, i be mɛ tue bue.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yuda ma amɛ hiɛ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ a mawu ɔmɛ hu hiɛ. Bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ma, nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a nɔ kɛ haa yakayaka mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Baal ɔ, jamɛ a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu kaa gbɛjegbɛhi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ kɛ̃.

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yeremia, ko kpa pɛɛ ha kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ; koo da a nane mi nɛ o kɛ fa kue ha mi. Ke amanehlu ba a nɔ nɛ a fa kue ha mi ɔ, i be mɛ tue bue.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nimli nɛ i suɔ saminya a, yayami sɔuu lɛ a ngɛ pee. Anɛ a ngɛ he blɔ kaa a hii ye we ɔ mi lo? Anɛ a susu kaa ke a wo mi si babauu, nɛ a ngɔ lohwehi kɛ sã bɔ ha mi ɔ, haomi ko nɛ maa ba a nɔ ɔ, a kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a peemi maa tsi jamɛ a haomi ɔ nya lo? Ke e ba mi ja a, anɛ a ma na bua jɔmi lo?

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Sa a, bɔ nɛ i tsɛɔ mɛ ji, ‘Oliv tso kɛ e yi mi ba kusuu saminyayoo nɛ woɔ yiblii kpakpa;’ se ma mɛ e ba amɛ a he la, nɛ ma ku tso kɔni ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ahumi tsuɔ ní ɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: “Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, imi lɛ i to Israel kɛ Yuda si kaa bɔ nɛ a duɔ tso; se jehanɛ lɛɛ ma ha nɛ amanehlu maa ba a nɔ. Nɔ nɛ ɔ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ, ejakaa a pee yayami; a ya sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha Baal, nɛ a kɛ wo ye mi mi la.” A so ngɔ wo Yeremia he

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha nɛ i le kaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ so ngɔ wo ye he.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Anatot nyumu ɔmɛ hla kaa a maa gbe mi, nɛ a de mi ke, ke i ya nɔ nɛ i fiɛ ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a maa gbe mi.

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de mi ke, “Ma gbla a tue kokooko! Nihewi ɔmɛ ma gbo ngɛ ta nga nɔ, nɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ hwɔ maa gbe mɛ.

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ke i ke i kɛ mo ma hla níhi a nya a, mo lɛ o nɔ́ da. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ sane nɛ ɔ maa fɔ o hɛ mi. Mɛni he je lɛ nimli yayamihi yaa nɔ ɔ? Mɛni he je lɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a he mi jɔɔ mɛ ɔ?

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: O toɔ mɛ si kaa bɔ nɛ a duɔ ní; a tsɛ̃ɛ̃ sipoku, a waa, nɛ a woɔ yiblii. A woɔ o biɛ ta ji nɛ, se a tsui be o he.

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Wa ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ nga a tsuo gbli. Pu mi lohwehi, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ngɛ tae. Wa zugba a pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ, ejakaa wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayami. Nɔ́ nɛ a deɔ ji, “Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, Mawu tsa nɛ.” Mɛni be nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɔ kɛ yaa si?

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yeremia, ke o kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ka fo nɛ o nyɛ we lɛ ɔ, kɛ o maa pee kɛɛ nɛ o kɛ okpɔngɔ maa ka fo? Ke o ngɛ si tɛe nɛ o ngɛ si nɔe ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɔ ɔ, Yordan hue ɔ mi lɛɛ kɛ o maa pee kɛɛ?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Mo nitsɛ o nyɛmimɛ, kɛ o weku li te si kɛ wo mo; a so o yi nɔ, nɛ a ngɛ o se blɔ hlae kɛ hɛdɔ. Ke a ha mo hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ mo tu munyu ngɛ he jɔmi mi po, koo ngɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ.” Yawɛ ye kɔmɔ ngɛ e ma a he

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “I ngmɛɛ Israel he; ye ma nɛ i je blɔ hla a, i kua mɛ. I ngɔ nimli nɛ i suɔ mɛ saminya a kɛ wo a he nyɛli a dɛ mi.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ i je blɔ hla a, a ngɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ kayohi ba tua kɛ je he slɔɔtohi. Nyɛ yá kpee pu mi lohwehi tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba tsɔtslɔɔ e mi.

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Ma nɔ yeli babauu ba puɛ ye wai ngmɔ ɔ; a ba naa ye ngmɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ye zugba saminyayoo ɔ plɛ pee nga kplanaa.

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Ní hali ba ha ní ngɛ yoku kpataa amɛ tsuo a nɔ. I ha nɛ ta ba kpata zugba a tsuo hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be tue mi jɔmi hu.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ du ngma, se a kpa mio mohu. A gbo dengme, se nɔ́ ko nɔ ko ji mi kɛ bɛ. A ngmɔ ɔmɛ bɛ ní, ejakaa ye mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.” Yawɛ wo Israel huza nɔ bi ɔmɛ si

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Israel huza nɔ bi nɛ a kpata zugba nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha ye ma Israel ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ma de ngɛ a he. Ma je jamɛ a yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je a zugba amɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a hiaa tso kɛ e sipoku ɔ, nɛ ma kpɔ̃ Yuda kɛ je a dɛ mi.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Je ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ye ma a, nɛ a kɛ Baal biɛ kaa kita. Ke a ma kpa a yi mi, nɛ a maa ngɔ mi kɛ pee a Mawu ngɛ Baal nane mi, nɛ a kɛ ye biɛ ma ka kita ja a, lɛɛ a maa bu mɛ ngɔ si ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Se je ma nɛ be mi tue bue ɔ, ma kpata jamɛ a je ma a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke ma ya he kploba bɔjuɛ nɛ ma tsɛ̃, se ma ko ngɔ kɛ wo nyu mi.

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: I ya he bɔjuɛ ɔ nɛ i tsɛ̃ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ.

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Ngɔɔ bɔjuɛ nɛ o ya he, nɛ ngɛ o mlɛ mi ɔ kɛ ya Yufrate pa a nya, nɛ o kɛ ya laa ngɛ tɛ sa amɛ a kpɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.”
translation_verse: Be saii se ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke ma kpale kɛ ya Yufrate pa a nya, nɛ ma ya ngɔ bɔjuɛ ɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke,

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Yuda he nɔ womi, kɛ Yerusalem he nɔ womi babauu ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyagbe ɔ maa ba ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Nimli yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kua mi tue bumi. A wa tue, nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ; a ya ja mawu kpahi, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ. Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, ma ha nɛ a maa pee kaa bɔjuɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ he be se nami ko hu ɔ.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ bɔjuɛ mɛtɛɛ nɔ mlɛ mi kpɛii ɔ, ja i to nɛ Israel ma a, kɛ Yuda ma a tsuo nɛ a mɛtɛ ye he. I pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, konɛ a pee ye ma, nɛ a na biɛ, hɛ mi nyami, kɛ yi jemi kɛ ha mi. Se a bui mi fɛɛ.” Wai tɔ ɔ

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yeremia, de ma a ke imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke a wo wai tɔ tsuaa wai tɔ mi wai nɛ e hyi. Ke o de mɛ ja a, a ma bi mo ke, ‘Anɛ wa li kaa e sa kaa a wo wai tɔ tsuaa wai tɔ mi wai nɛ e hyi lo?’

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, de mɛ ke imi Yawɛ, ma ha nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji David nina a, osɔfo ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ tsuo dã nɛ a nu kɛ yaa si a maa de kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma nuu tsɛmɛ kɛ bimɛ ngɔ fia a sibi, nɛ a ma gbo ngɔ pue si kaa tɔ nɛ ywia. Ma kpata a hɛ mi; ye tsui mi be mi sãe ngɛ a he, nɛ i be mɛ mɔbɔ nae.” Yeremia bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ngɛ he nɔ womi he

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Israel ma, Yawɛ tu munyu! Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si, nɛ nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami be mi nɛ e ha we nɛ diblii nɛ wo nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ba tɛ si ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, be mi nɛ e ha we nɛ la nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ nɛ plɛ pee diblii kpii.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ bui tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ma fo ya ngɛ laami mi ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ womi ɔ he. Ma fo ya hluu kɛ yaa si ye hɛngmɛ maa tɔ nyu, ejakaa a nuu Yawɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “De matsɛ ɔ kɛ e nyɛ ɔ ke, a ba a he si, ejakaa a jlasi saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ je a yi nɔ si.

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: A sa Yuda leneyi je ma amɛ a yi; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mɛ. A nuu Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, hyɛ! O he nyɛli ɔmɛ je omleyi je kɛ ma. O nimli kpakpa amɛ nɛ a ha mo ke o hyɛ a nɔ ɔ, jije a ngɛ?

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ mo nitsɛ o tsɔse mɛ nɛ o kɛ mɛ ngɛ kaa huɛmɛ ɔ, ke a wo mɛ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ o nɔ ɔ, kɛ o ma de kɛɛ? Anɛ o he mi be mo kɔɔe kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma fɔ lo?

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Anɛ nɔmlɔ yumu ma nyɛ ma tsake e he womi su ɔ lo? Anɛ ngatsɛ ma nyɛ ma tsake e he huatahuata a lo? Ke e maa hi peemi ja a, lɛɛ nyɛ nɛ yayami peemi pee nyɛ he nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ ma nyɛ maa pee kpakpa.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa kaa tsakati nɛ ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ muɔ kɛ yaa.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nitsɛ ma kpa nyɛ he bo, nɛ nyɛ we ahlua maa je kpo.

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ha mi nɛ kɔɔ nyu hwɔ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ hiɔmi nɛ́, nɛ zugba a gbli keketee he je ɔ, ngmɔ huli ɔmɛ kɛ nɔ́ haa a hɛ mi kɛ tsiɔ zo.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Odabɔ tete po fɔɔ nɛ e jeɔ e bi he ngɛ nga nɔ, ejakaa nga ko nga ko be lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Nga mi gbe ɔmɛ ya kuɔɔ yoku kpataa amɛ nɛ a hii kɔɔhiɔ mi fue kaa bɔ nɛ ogbeteehi peeɔ ɔ, hluu kɛ ya siɔ a hɛngmɛhi a nɔ peeɔ tsuu, ejakaa niye ní be a dɛ.

english_verse: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
translation_verse: Ye ma a fa kue ha mi ke, ‘Yawɛ, wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ wɔ sie lɛɛ, se kɛ̃, moo piɛ wa he kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ. Wa tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã be babauu; wa pee yayami kɛ si mo.

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Mɛni he je o pee kaa nyumu nɛ nɔ́ ko ti lɛ si tlukaa, loo katsɛ nɛ nyɛ we nɔ yi wami nɛ e he ɔ? Yawɛ, niinɛ o kɛ wɔ ngɛ! O ma ji wɔ; ko kua wɔ.’ ”

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “A suɔ kaa a maa je ye blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya kpa ngɛ he nɛ a suɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i sume mɛ. Ma kai yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ, nɛ ma gbla a tue.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Koo fa kue ha mi ke ma pee ma nɛ ɔ kpakpa.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Ke a ha hwɔ tete po, i be a kue fami ɔ tue bue; nɛ ke a sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ha mi hu, i be hee. Se mohu ɔ, níhi nɛ i kɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi ji ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ.”

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ! Mo nitsɛ o le kaa gbali ɔmɛ deɔ ma a ke ta, loo hwɔ be bae, ejakaa o wo si veveeve kaa tue mi jɔmi pɛ lɛ maa hi zugba a nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Lakpa gbami gbali ɔmɛ ngɛ gbae ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ nɛ; i tsɔ we mɛ, i fa we mɛ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ tu we munyu ko hulɔ. Ninahi nɛ a ngɛ a he munyu tue ɔ, pi ye ngɔ nɛ a je; klaami nɛ a ngɛ klaae ɔ, yakayaka níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a susu ji lɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a gba ní nɛ ɔmɛ ha a hu a hɛ mi ma kpata kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu. A ma sake a gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɔ pue Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a be nɔ ko nɔ ko nae nɛ maa pu mɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ kɛ a yi ɔmɛ, a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a biyi ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. Ma wo mɛ hiɔ ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a he.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: Yawɛ fa mi ke ma de ma a ke, “Ye hɛngmɛ nɛ tɔ nyu nyɔ kɛ pia daa nɛ ɔ nɛ ma ko kpa ya fomi gblegbleegble. Ejakaa a fia ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ ní kɛ pue si nɛ a plaa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Ke i je kpo kɛ ya nga nɔ ɔ, i naa nihi nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ ta mi ngɔ pue si. Ke i ya ma amɛ a mi hu i naa nihi nɛ hwɔ gbe mɛ ngɔ pue si. Se gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ kpami kɛkɛ a hii kpae ngɛ zugba nɛ a li nɔ.” Ma a fa kue ha Yawɛ

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, anɛ o kua Yuda kulaa lo? Anɛ o ngɛ Zion bi ɔmɛ hiee lo? Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o plaa wɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ e hi tsami ɔ? Wa hyɛ blɔ kaa tue mi jɔmi maa ba, se nɔ́ kpakpa ko ji mi kɛ bɛ; wa hyɛ blɔ kaa be maa ba nɛ a ma tsa wɔ, se haomi kɛ gbeye sɔuu lɛ bɔle wɔ.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Kai o siwo ɔmɛ, nɛ o ko kua wɔ. Ko ha nɛ Yerusalem hɛ mi nɛ pue si. Lejɛ ɔ o sɛ saminyayoo ɔ ngɛ. Somi nɛ o kɛ wɔ so ɔ, koo po mi.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ a we amaga amɛ ekoeko be nɛ ma ha nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ ha wɔ; hiɔwe tete po be nyɛe ma ha nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ. Yawɛ, wa Mawu, o nɔ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ, ejakaa mo lɛ o peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Ke Mose kɛ Samuel ba da ye hɛ mi nɛ a fa kue ha mi tete po, i be nimli nɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ nae. Fie mɛ kɛ je ye hɛ mi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a ho.

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Ke a bi mo ke jije a maa ya a, de mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Nihi nɛ hiɔ maa gbe ɔ, ha nɛ hiɔ nɛ gbe mɛ! Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa nɔ ta a, ha nɛ a nɔ ta! Nihi nɛ hwɔ maa gbe ɔ ha nɛ hwɔ nɛ gbe mɛ! Ni nɛmɛ hu nɛ a maa nuu nyɔguɛ ɔ, ha nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho!

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: Imi Yawɛ, i to kaa haomihi nɛ a nya wa eywiɛ maa ba a nɔ; ni komɛ ma gbo ngɛ ta mi; gbehi ma tsɔtslɔɔ ni komɛ; lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ maa ye ni komɛ, nɛ ni komɛ lɛɛ pu mi lohwehi maa ye mɛ.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Manase, Hezekia bi ɔ pee benɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Yerusalem he je ɔ, ma gbla a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa ye gbeye.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Yerusalem bi, mɛnɔ maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ, aloo mɛnɔ maa ye nyɛ kɔmɔ? Mɛnɔ ma gba nɛ e ba bi si ke kɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛɛ lo?

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: I ngɔ nɔ́ mi sami nɔ́ kɛ sa nyɛ mi ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo a mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ. I kpata nyɛ, ye ma a hɛ mi; i gbe nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ kpa we nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ peemi.

english_verse: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
translation_verse: I ha nɛ yalɔyihi a he hiɛ babauu ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ pe wo nya zia. I gbe nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ngɛ a nihe mi, nɛ i ha nɛ a nyɛmɛ ɔmɛ na nɔ́. I ha nɛ haomi nɛ nya wa, kɛ ní gbeyegbeyehi ba a nɔ tlukaa.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Yawɛ, ha nɛ a gbiɛ mi! Anɛ i sɔmɔ we mo saminya lo? Anɛ i fa we kue ha mo ngɛ ye he nyɛli nɛ ɔmɛ a he, benɛ a ngɛ haomi kɛ fimi mi lo?

english_verse: People of Judah, just as you can't break iron mixed with bronze, you can't defeat the enemies that will attack from the north.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ku dade mi. Omleyi je dade nɛ a kɛ akɔblee futu mi ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa ku?

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ a ma sɔmɔ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba ko nɛ a li nɔ; ejakaa ye mi mi fumi ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ a slɛ, nɛ maa tso daa nɛ.”

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Mɛni he je i ngɛ nɔ́ nae kɛ mwɔɔ? Mɛni he je ye pa amɛ be tsa ba a? Mɛni he je a gbo we ɔ? Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o sisi mi kaa pa nɛ gbli latsa be mi lo?”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ke o kpale kɛ ba a, i kɛ o blɔ he ɔ ma ha mo, nɛ o ma ba pee ye tsɔlɔ ekohu. Ke o maa fiɛ fiɛmi kpakpa, nɛ o be munyu gu tue ɔ, lɛɛ o maa pee ye gbalɔ ekohu. Ma a maa kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ, nɛ e be hiae kaa moo o ya a ngɔ.

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ma je mo kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke,

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: “Koo ngɔ yo, nɛ ko fɔ binyumuhi loo biyihi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I'll tell you what's going to happen to children and their parents here.
translation_verse: Bimɛ nɛ a fɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, kɛ a fɔli nɛ fɔ mɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: Hiɔ yaya maa gbe mɛ. Nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee ha mɛ, nɛ nɔ ko be mɛ pue hulɔ; a gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pee kaa kuku ngɛ zugba. Ni komɛ maa nɔ ta, nɛ hwɔ hu maa gbe ni komɛ, nɛ a nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ ma plɛ pee niye ní ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi.

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: “We nɛ ya ngɛ mi ɔ, koo ya lejɛ ɔ. Ko ya ye kɔmɔ ha nɔ ko. I be ye ma a tue mi jɔmi hae hu; ye suɔmi kɛ mɔbɔ nami ɔ hu se po.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Niatsɛmɛ, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ tsuo ma gbo ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ; se nɔ ko be mɛ pue, nɛ nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee ha mɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be blɔ jee nɛ e maa plaa e he, loo e maa po huɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Ke a bi mo ja a, de mɛ ke, Yawɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je ye se nɛ a ya ja mawu kpahi, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ. A kua mi, nɛ ye mlaa amɛ hu a yi nɔ.

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nɔ́ pa pe nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ po. Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ tue wa; nyɛ peeɔ yayami bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ, nɛ nyɛ bui mi fɛɛ.

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma fie nyɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya zugba nɛ nyɛ, loo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ po li nɔ. Nyɛ ma ya sɔmɔ mawu kpahi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ i be nyɛ mɔbɔ nae.’ ” Nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ɔ maa kpale kɛ ba

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ nihi kɛ ye biɛ be kita kae hu kaa Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ jé Israel ma a kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, a kɛ ye biɛ ma ka kita kaa Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ kpale Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a gbɛ fĩa a kɛ je omleyi je zugba kpahi a nɔ kɛ ba we ekohu. Lejɛ ɔmɛ ji hehi nɛ i fie mɛ kɛ ho ɔ nɛ. Ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɛ i ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu. Imi, Yawɛ le i de.” Tue gblami maa ba

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ, i ngɛ hyɛe. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ a ngɛ pee nɛ i nɛ; a ní yayami ɔmɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: Ma gbla a tue si enyɔ ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ a yi wu tso ní ɔmɛ a he. A ngɔ amagahi nɛ ngɛ kaa ni gbogboehi nɛ wami ko be a mi ɔ kɛ ble ye zugba a; nɛ zugba a hyi tɔ kɛ a níhi nɛ a hiee ɔ.” Yeremia fa kue ha Yawɛ

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: Yawɛ mo ji ye he bulɔ; mo lɛ o haa mi he wami. Ke haomi ba ye nɔ hu, mo ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ ye he. Je mahi maa je je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ kɛ ba o ngɔ, nɛ a ma ba de mo ke, “Gbosi ní nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ na pɛ ji lakpa mawuhi, kɛ amagahi nɛ se nami ko be a he.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ ma ha nɛ je ma amɛ maa na ye he wami kɛ ye kɔni si wami; a maa na kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ Yuda bi, nyɛ he yayami ɔ, dade ningma tso a kɛ ngma; a kɛ sika tɛ nya piɔpiɔ ngma ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, nɛ a kpɛ́ ngɛ nyɛ bɔ sami la tɛ koli ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: Nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ jaa amagahi, kɛ yo mawu Ashera amaga amɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ tso kusuu tsuaa tso kusuu sisi, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Zugba a nɛ i ha nyɛ ɔ maa je nyɛ dɛ, nɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ nyɛ he nyɛli ngɛ zugba nɛ nyɛ li nɔ. Ejakaa ye mi mi nɛ fu ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ a slɛ nɛ maa hi tsoe daa.” Munyu slɔɔtohi

english_verse: I, the Lord, have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ nɛ jeɔ ye se nɛ e ngɔɔ e hɛ ya fɔɔ nɔmlɔ nɔ, nɛ e hyɛɛ yemi kɛ buami blɔ kɛ jee adesa dɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ!

english_verse: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
translation_verse: “Se nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ imi Yawɛ ye nɔ ɔ, ma gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: Jamɛatsɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa tso nɛ a du ngɛ pa tue nɛ je sipoku kɛ wo nyu mi. Ke sa pu ba a, e yi gbeye, ejakaa e ba amɛ hii mumumumu flɔflɔɔflɔ kɛ mwɔɔ. Ke nyu hwɔ ba hu, e yi kɔmɔ, ejakaa e woɔ yiblii kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: “Mɛnɔ maa le nɔmlɔ adesa tsui mi? E nɔ nɔ sisilɔ ko be ɔ, e hiɔ ɔ hu be tsa ba.

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Imi Yawɛ, i hlaa nimli a juɛmi, nɛ i kaa a tsui. I woɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ e ní peepee, kɛ e je mi babɛ he.”

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ náá ní ngɛ blɔ nɛ dɛ nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa bebee nɛ ya bu hlui nɔ nɛ e pɛ bi, nɛ pohu pi lɛ nɛ ngmɛ hlui ɔ. E nihe mi ɔ, e dɛ mi ma ba ta; nɛ e nyagbe be mi ɔ, e ma ba pee kuasia.

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: Wa jami he klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ kaa matsɛ sɛ kɛ e hɛ mi nyami saminyayoo nɛ a wo nɔ gojoo kɛ je blema.

english_verse: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, Israel ma a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kua mo ɔ, zo maa gbe lɛ. A maa laa kaa biɛ nɛ a ngma ngɛ zu mi, ejakaa a kua mo Yawɛ, mo wami nyu vu ɔ. Yeremia bi Yawɛ yemi kɛ buami

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, tsa mi, nɛ ye he mi nɛ wa mi kɛ pi si. He mi, konɛ ye yi nɛ na wami, ejakaa mo pɛ o yi i jeɔ.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ma a deɔ mi ji, “Yawɛ munyuhi nɛ o kɛ ngɛ wa he gbeye woe ɔ, ha nɛ a ba mi koo!”

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ, mo nitsɛ o le faii kaa tsa pi imi nɛ i nyɛ o nɔ ke o ha nɛ haomi nɛ ba ma nɛ ɔ nɔ. O le kaa pi imi nɛ i to kaa amanehlu be ko nɛ ba. Nɔ́ nɛ je ye nya nɛ i de ɔ, mo nitsɛ o le.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, koo wo ye he gbeye; mo pɛ ji ye wesa he ngɛ amanehlu be mi.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: De Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ guɔ kikɛmɛ a agbo nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ke a bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue.

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: “De nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ke a ye imi Yawɛ, ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ. A ko tloo tlomi ko kɛ gu agbo ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. A ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kaa ligbi klɔuklɔu, nɛ a ko tsu nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ke a pee ja a, matsɛmɛ, kɛ ganɔhi maa gu Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba nɛ a ma ba hi David matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ. A kɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa hi ta zugba lɛhi a mi, kɛ okpɔngɔhi a nɔ. Nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, Yerusalem ma a ma hyi tɔ kɛ nimli.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Nihi maa je Yuda ma amɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ a mi kɛ ba; a maa je Benyamin zugba a nɔ, nga nɔ, yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ Yuda leneyi je. A maa hɛɛ sami bɔhi, niye ní bɔhi, sina bɔhi, bɔ kpahi, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ba imi Yawɛ, ye we ɔ.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Se e sa kaa a bu mi nɛ a ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kaa ligbi klɔuklɔu. A ko tloo tlomi ko kɛ gu Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a mi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ; ke a pee ja a, ma mɛ Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a he la. La a maa sã Yerusalem mɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa gbe.”

english_verse: The Lord told me,
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: “Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
translation_verse: “Tee si, nɛ o ya buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ we mi, nɛ ma ha mo ye sɛ gbi ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya, nɛ i ya na lɛ ngɛ buɛ puɛmi tɛ ɔ se nɛ e ngɛ ní tsue.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Se buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ na kaa buɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɛ puɛe ɔ pee we kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpale futu zu ɔ nɛ e kɛ puɛ nɔ́ kpa.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation,
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be nɛ ma de ke ma kpata je ma, loo nɔ yemi ko hɛ mi kulaa,

english_verse: If I promise to make a nation strong,
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃, ke i de ke ma pee je ma, loo nɔ yemi ko agbo,

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: se jamɛ a je ma a ya bui mi tue, nɛ a pee yayami kɛ si mi ɔ, ma kpale ye nya se; kpakpa nɛ i to ke ma pee mɛ ɔ, i be pee hu.

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke, i ngɛ a yi nɔ soe, nɛ ma gbla a tue. De mɛ ke a jɔɔ yayami peemi, nɛ a dla a blɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: Ke o de mɛ ja a, a ma he nɔ ke, ‘Dɛbi! Nɔ́ nɛ wa tsui suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa maa pee. Wa maa wa tue, nɛ wa maa pee yayami bɔ nɛ wa suɔ.’ ” Ma a kua Yawɛ

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ bi je ma amɛ tsuo kaa nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba hyɛ lo. Israel ma a pee nɔ́ ko nɛ he wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ!

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: Se ye ma a lɛɛ, a hɛ je ye nɔ; a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa amagahi. A je blema blɔ kpakpa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ya ngɛ lakpa blɔhi a nɔ nyɛɛe. A nyɛɛ we gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu; nane blɔhi a nɔ mohu lɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ bunyuku ɔ, jã pɛ ma gbɛ ye ma a ngɔ fĩa ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Ke haomi ba a nɔ ɔ, ma plɛ ye se ngɔ wo mɛ; i be yee kɛ bua mɛ.” A so Yeremia yi nɔ

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa to Yeremia he ga. Daa nɛ ɔ, wa ma na osɔfohi nɛ maa tsɔɔ wɔ ní. Wa ma na ní leli nɛ maa wo wɔ ga, kɛ gbali nɛ ma ha wɔ Mawu sɛ gbi. Ke wa to ga nɛ ɔ, pi lɔ ɔ nɛ ma ha nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se maa po. Nyɛ ha nɛ waa po sane ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, nɛ waa jɔɔ e munyu ɔmɛ tue bumi.”

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ, jehanɛ lɛɛ, ha nɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbo kɛ hwɔ; ha nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ ta mi. Ha nɛ nyɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee yalɔyihi kɛ yosahi; ha nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ gbe tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nihewi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ ta nga nɔ.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ ta nɛ ba tua mɛ tlukaa, nɛ bubuubui nɛ pɛ ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi. A tsua muɔ ngɔ fɔ si ha mi nɛ ma nɔ mi, nɛ a tsɔ mi klama nɛ ma du.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke ma ya he buɛ nɛ a kɛ zu puɛ. E de mi hu ke ma ngɔ ma a mi nikɔtɔma komɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ hu a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ekomɛ,

english_verse: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
translation_verse: nɛ i kɛ mɛ wa ya gu buɛ sɔli agbo ɔ mi kɛ ya Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi. Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ma ha mi ɔ, ma ya fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke ma de ke, “Yuda matsɛmɛ, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ dee ɔ tue. I kɛ haomi nɛ nya wa maa ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu he ɔ, e he mi maa po.

english_verse: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
translation_verse: nɛ a ma bɔ sami la tɛhi kɛ ha Baal, konɛ a kɛ a bimɛ nɛ sã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ. I wui mɛ mlaa ke a pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ; e bɛ ye juɛmi mi hyɛ po.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be ma nɛ a be hiɛ ɔ tsɛe ke Tofet, loo Hinom kɔ̃ mi hu. Mohu ɔ, biɛ nɛ a kɛ ma tsɛ lɛ ji kɔ̃ nɛ a pueɔ muɔ si ngɛ mi.

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ yi mi nɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ to ɔ maa pee yaka ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Ma ha a he nyɛli maa ye a nɔ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ a maa gbe mɛ; nɛ ma ngɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi nɛ a ye.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ he nyɛli ma ba sa ma a yi, nɛ a maa hao ma mi bi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, hluu kɛ yaa si ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ ma bɔni mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he, kɛ a bimɛ nyumuhi kɛ yihi yemi.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke ma ywia buɛ ɔ ngɛ nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ a hɛ mi,

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: nɛ ma de mɛ ke, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ zu buɛ nɛ ɔ ywia tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ kɛ pueɔ si nɛ e be hie dlami ɔ, ja pɛ ma pee ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ. Ma kpata ma a, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Ni gbogboe ɔmɛ po ja a ya pu mɛ ngɛ Tofet; ejakaa a be blɔ nae ngɛ he kpa ko kɛ pu mɛ.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Ma ble wehi tsuo ngɛ Yerusalem kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Tofet ɔ. Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a mɔhi, kɛ tsu kpahi nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a yi mi kɛ haa dodoehi, nɛ a sãã wai bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ haa mawu kpahi ɔ, ma ble mɛ.”

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i je Tofet, he nɛ Yawɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ya fiɛ e munyu ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ́ i je lejɛ ɔ, i ba da si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kue ɔ mi, nɛ i de ma a tsuo ke,

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Kaa bɔ nɛ i de to ɔ, i kɛ haomi nɛ nya wa maa ba ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ mahi tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ a nɔ. Ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ tue wa, nɛ nyɛ nui ye munyu ɔmɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Osɔfo Pashur, Imer bi ɔ, nɛ ji tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ hyɛɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ nu fiɛmi nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ.

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Pashur ha nɛ a fia mi ní, nɛ a bɔ mi pã ngɛ Benyamin agbo ɔ yiti je ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: E nɔ jena mɔtu, benɛ Pashur je mi ngɛ pã a mi ɔ, i de lɛ ke, “Pi Pashur nɛ Yawɛ wo mo! Biɛ nɛ Yawɛ ha mo ji Magormisabib.

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nitsɛ ke, ‘Ma ha o ma plɛ pee bubui ha mo nitsɛ o he, kɛ o huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. He nyɛli maa gbe o huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si kɛ klaate, nɛ o maa na paa kɛ o hɛngmɛ. Ma ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ; e maa nuu ni komɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho e ma mi ya, nɛ e ma ya gbe mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Nɛ mo Pashur! A maa nuu mo hu o kɛ o we mi bimɛ tsuo nyɔguɛ kɛ ya Babilonia. Lejɛ ɔ o ma ya gbo ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a maa pu mo, kɛ o huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ o gba lakpa gbami ha mɛ ɔ ngɛ.’ ” Yeremia kɛ Yawɛ na

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, o sisi mi pɛ nɛ ye yi mi plɛ. O he wa pe mi nɛ o ye ye nɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ ye he fɛu yee; daa ligbi ɔ, muɔ kɛkɛ a ngɛ mi muɔe.

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Se ke i de ke, “I be Yawɛ biɛ ta woe hu, nɛ i be fiɛe ngɛ e biɛ mi hu” ɔ, o sɛ gbi ɔ peeɔ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ ye tsui mi, kɛ ye wuhi a mi. I bɔɔ mɔde saminya kaa ma tsi nya, se jehanɛ lɛɛ, i pa nyɛ we hu.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: I nuɔ nɛ nihi babauu tuɔ munyu ngɛ a kuɔ si, nɛ a kɛ woɔ ye he gbeye. A deɔ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ wa ya po e nya ha nɔ yeli ɔmɛ!” Ye huɛmɛ kpakpahi tete po hii blɔ hyɛe kaa ye nane ma kpata lo. A deɔ ke, “Alini e maa du klama, kɛkɛ ɔ, wa nine maa su e nɔ nɛ wa maa ye wa he lue.”

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: Se mo, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ! Moo lɛɛ o hyɛɛ nimli a tsui mi kɛ a juɛmi mi; o le nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da. I tu ye sane ɔ kɛ wo o dɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbla ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue ha mi nɛ ma na kɛ ye hɛngmɛ.

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: Á gbiɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ! Ligbi ɔ nɛ maa fɔ mi ɔ, a ko gbaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ!

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ nɛ ba bɔ tsaatsɛ amaniɛ ke, “A fɔ binyumuyo ha mo”, nɛ tsaatsɛ bua jɔ e he ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ!

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Ha nɛ jamɛ a nyumu ɔ nɛ pee kaa jamɛ a ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ kpata a hɛ mi nɛ mɔbɔ nami ko be mi ɔ pɛ. Mɔtu ɔ, ha nɛ bubuubui nɛ pɛ kɛ wo lɛ; piani lɛɛ e nu nɛ a he ose ngɛ ta mi,

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: ejakaa e gbi mi ngɛ maa mi mi. Kaa e pee ja, jinɛ maa mi mi ɔ pee ye yɔkɔ.

english_verse: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
translation_verse: Mɛni he je a fɔ mi kulaa? Pe a fɔ mi nɛ ma ba na nɔ́, nɛ ma hao, nɛ zo nɛ gbe mi ye wami ligbi tsuo lo?

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia tsɔ Pashur, Malkia binyumu ɔ, kɛ osɔfo Zefania, Maaseya binyumu ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ke,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba tua wɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bi Yawɛ ga womi ha wɔ kaa alini Yawɛ ma tsu nyakpɛ ni ha wɔ, nɛ e ma ha nɛ Nebukadnezar maa kpale e se lo.”

english_verse: I told them that the Lord God of Israel had told me to say to King Zedekiah: The Babylonians have surrounded Jerusalem and want to kill you and your people. You are asking me to save you, but you have made me furious. So I will stretch out my mighty arm and fight against you myself. Your army is using spears and swords to fight the Babylonians, but I will make your own weapons turn and attack you. I will send a horrible disease to kill many of the people and animals in Jerusalem, and there will be nothing left to eat. Finally, I will let King Nebuchadnezzar and his army fight their way to the center of Jerusalem and capture everyone who is left alive, including you and your officials. But Nebuchadnezzar won't be kind or show any mercy—he will have you killed! I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Se mo, Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia! Mo, kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a yi ma na wami ngɛ ta, kɛ hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar, kɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ a dɛ mi. Nebukadnezar ma kpata nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ hɛ mi. E be nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he ngmɛɛe, nɛ e be nɔ ko nɔ ko mɔbɔ nae. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke ma de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue! I kɛ nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe nɛ nyɛɛ hla kake, blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi, kɛ blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hi ma nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e yi maa ta; ta, loo hwɔ, loo gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe lɛ. Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa je ma a mi kɛ ya Babilonia bi nɛ ba sa ma a yi ɔ a ngɔ, nɛ e ma ya nu a nane ɔ, e yi ma na wami; nɛ e maa ya we mi hɛ ngmengmle.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: I pee ye juɛmi kaa ja i kpata ma nɛ ɔ hɛ mi kokooko; i be nyɛ mɔbɔ nae. Ma ngɔ ma a kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nɛ e maa mɛ he la. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” A maa gbla Yuda matsɛ we ɔ tue

english_verse: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.

You are asking me to save you, but you have made me furious. So I will stretch out my mighty arm and fight against you myself. Your army is using spears and swords to fight the Babylonians, but I will make your own weapons turn and attack you. I will send a horrible disease to kill many of the people and animals in Jerusalem, and there will be nothing left to eat. Finally, I will let King Nebuchadnezzar and his army fight their way to the center of Jerusalem and capture everyone who is left alive, including you and your officials. But Nebuchadnezzar won't be kind or show any mercy—he will have you killed! I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Se mo, Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia! Mo, kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a yi ma na wami ngɛ ta, kɛ hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar, kɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ a dɛ mi. Nebukadnezar ma kpata nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ hɛ mi. E be nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he ngmɛɛe, nɛ e be nɔ ko nɔ ko mɔbɔ nae. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke ma de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue! I kɛ nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe nɛ nyɛɛ hla kake, blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi, kɛ blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hi ma nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e yi maa ta; ta, loo hwɔ, loo gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe lɛ. Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa je ma a mi kɛ ya Babilonia bi nɛ ba sa ma a yi ɔ a ngɔ, nɛ e ma ya nu a nane ɔ, e yi ma na wami; nɛ e maa ya we mi hɛ ngmengmle.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: I pee ye juɛmi kaa ja i kpata ma nɛ ɔ hɛ mi kokooko; i be nyɛ mɔbɔ nae. Ma ngɔ ma a kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nɛ e maa mɛ he la. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” A maa gbla Yuda matsɛ we ɔ tue

english_verse: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ ma gbla o tue ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ he. Ma mɛ o matsɛ we ɔ he la, nɛ la a maa sa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ bɔle si. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia tsɔ Pashur, Malkia binyumu ɔ, kɛ osɔfo Zefania, Maaseya binyumu ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ke,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba tua wɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bi Yawɛ ga womi ha wɔ kaa alini Yawɛ ma tsu nyakpɛ ni ha wɔ, nɛ e ma ha nɛ Nebukadnezar maa kpale e se lo.”

english_verse: The Lord sent me to the palace of the king of Judah to speak to the king, his officials, and everyone else who was there. The Lord told me to say: I am the Lord, so pay attention! You have been allowing people to cheat, rob, and take advantage of widows, orphans, and foreigners who live here. Innocent people have become victims of injustice, and some of them have even been killed. But now I command you to do what is right and see that justice is done. Rescue everyone who has suffered from injustice.
translation_verse: ‘Imi Yawɛ, i wo nyɛ mlaa ke nyɛɛ ye dami sane, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da. Nyɛ je nɔ nɛ a ngɛ lɛ amimi yee ɔ kɛ je amimi yelɔ ɔ dɛ mi. Nyɛ ko wa nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi yi mi; nɛ nyɛ ko pue nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko ɔ muɔ si ngɛ he klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ maa ye mlaa nɛ i wo nyɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ David nina maa ye matsɛ daa. Nɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, a tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a maa hi ta zugba lɛhi a mi, kɛ okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ be ngɛ matsɛ we agbo nɛ ɔmɛ a mi daa.

english_verse: But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ lɛɛ i ngɛ ye he kita kae kaa ja matsɛ we nɛ ɔ pee we doku kokooko. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.’ ”

english_verse: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
translation_verse: “Yuda matsɛ we ɔ ngɛ fɛu ngɛ ye hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Gilead zugba a, loo Lebanon yo ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma ha lejɛ ɔ maa pee we doku nɛ nɔ ko be mi.

english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
translation_verse: Ma tsɔ nihi nɛ a ma ya puɛ lejɛ ɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa hɛɛ gbiɛ. A maa poo seda titima kpakpa amɛ, nɛ a ma sake kɛ wo la mi.

english_verse: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
translation_verse: “Pee se ɔ, je mahi babauu ma ba gu lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma bi a sibi ke mɛni he je nɛ imi Yawɛ, i pee ma ngua nɛ ɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma he nɔ ke i ye nyɛ sane nɛ ɔ, ejakaa somi nɛ imi, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, nyɛ yi nɔ; nyɛ ya nyɛɛ mawu kpahi mohu a se, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ.” Yeremia sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Yoahaz he

english_verse: Jehoahaz became king of Judah after his father King Josiah died. But Jehoahaz was taken as a prisoner to a foreign country. Now I, the Lord, promise that he will die there without ever seeing his own land again. King Jehoiakim The Lord told me to say: *
translation_verse: He nɛ a nu lɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ɔ, lejɛ ɔ e ma ya gbo ngɛ; zugba nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e be nae hu gblegbleegble.” Yeremia sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Yehoyakim he

english_verse: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ deɔ ke, “Ma ma mɔ nguaa kɛ e mi hiɔwe tsu agboagbohi”; kɛkɛ nɛ e jeɔ saflɛhi ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e kaa seda tso kɛ woɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e saa we ɔ he tsopa tsu saminyayoo ɔ, musu tloo lɛ!

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: E ye ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nɔ́ nali a sane ha mɛ, nɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ya nɔ bɔ nɛ sa. Anɛ pi enɛ ɔ peemi ji Yawɛ lemi lo?

english_verse: You will be given a burial fit for a donkey; your body will be dragged outside the city gates and tossed in the dirt. I, the Lord, have spoken. King Jehoiachin and the People of Jerusalem The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: A maa pu lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a puɔ teji; a maa gbla lɛ kɛ ho, nɛ a ma ya sake lɛ kɛ fɔ Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a se.” Yeremia sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Yerusalem he

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: Yerusalem ma, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya kpa bubuubui ngɛ Lebanon. Nyɛɛ ya Bashan nɛ nyɛ ya kpa bubuubui ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ya kpa kuu ngɛ Moab yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, ejakaa a kpata nyɛ huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.

english_verse: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
translation_verse: Benɛ nyɛ ná nyɛ he ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ tu munyu, se nyɛ kua lɛ tue bumi. Kɛ je nyɛ nihe mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ji kaa nyɛ bui Yawɛ tue.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Kɔɔhiɔ maa muɔɔ nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho; a maa nuu nyɛ huɛmɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ; a maa bɔ nyɛ ma amɛ ahlua ngɛ ní yayamihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ a he.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Matsɛ Yehoyakin, Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim bi ɔ ke, “Ligbi abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ke mo ji womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ ngɛ ye hiɔ nine nguɛ he po, ma je mo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ,

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: nɛ ma ngɔ mo kɛ wo nihi nɛ o ngɛ gbeye yee, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mo hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ a dɛ mi. Ma ngɔ mo kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar, kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ a maa nuu o kɛ o nyɛ nɛ fɔ mo ɔ nyɔguɛ kɛ ya ma ko mi nɛ pi lejɛ ɔ nɛ a fɔ nyɛ ngɛ. Nɛ lejɛ ɔ nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ ma ya gbo ngɛ.

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Zugba lee, zugba! Bu Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue!

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “A gbiɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ gbidigbidi, e be bimɛ nae kɔkɔɔkɔ; e be nɔ yae gblegbleegble e wami be ɔ tsuo. E be nina nae nɛ ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ David se, ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.
translation_verse: Ma nɔ yeli nɛ kpataa Yawɛ ma a hɛ mi, nɛ a gbɛɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩaa a, musu tloo mɛ!

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: Ye ma nɛ piɛ ɔ, ma bua a nya kɛ maa je zugbahi a nɔ hehi nɛ i fie mɛ kɛ ho ɔ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ ekohu. A ma fɔ, nɛ a he maa hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: Ma je nɔ yeli kpakpahi ha mɛ nɛ a hyɛ a nɔ. A be gbeye yee hu; sawale be mɛ nue hu, nɛ i be a tue gblae hu. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: Someday I will appoint an honest king from the family of David, a king who will be wise and rule with justice.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ ma hla dalɔ ko kɛ je David nina a a kpɛti nɛ e ba ye matsɛ. Matsɛ nɛ ɔ maa ye dami sane, nɛ e maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: E yi nɔ ɔ, a ma he Yuda yi wami, nɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba Israel. A ma tsɛ lɛ ke ‘Yawɛ ji wa yi wami hemi.’ ”

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ nihi be kita kae ngɛ ye biɛ mi hu kaa Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ jé Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, a kɛ ye biɛ ma ka kita kaa Mawu hɛ kalɔ nɛ jé Israel nina a kɛ je ma se zugbahi a nɔ, omleyi je zugba a, kɛ hehi tsuo nɛ i fie mɛ kɛ ho ɔ kɛ ba. Nɛ a ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ.” Yeremia sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ gbali ɔmɛ a he

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: I hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli. Yawɛ kɛ e munyu klɔuklɔu ɔ a he je ɔ, i pee kaa nɔ nɛ tɔ dã, loo nɔ nɛ nu dã pe nine.

english_verse: Those unfaithful prophets misuse their power all over the country. So God turned the pasturelands into scorching deserts. The Lord Will Punish Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Zugba a nɔ hyi tɔ kɛ nimli nɛ yi Yawɛ anɔkuale. A peeɔ yayami, nɛ a kɛ a he wami tsu we nɔ́ kpakpa. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mawu gbiɛ zugba a; zugba a bɛ ní hu, nɛ e nɔ pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo li Mawu; nimli yayamihi ji mɛ. I naa mɛ nɛ a ngɛ yayami pee ngɛ ye we ɔ mi tete po.

english_verse: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.
translation_verse: I na Samaria gbali ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔ; a gba ngɛ Baal biɛ mi, nɛ a ha nɛ ye ma, Israel nane kpata.

english_verse: And you prophets in Jerusalem are even worse. You're unfaithful in marriage and never tell the truth. You even lead others to sin instead of helping them turn back to me. You and the people of Jerusalem are evil like Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Se i na kaa Yerusalem gbali ɔmɛ po pe mɛ kɛ yayami peemi; a puɛɔ gba, nɛ a yeɔ lakpa; a ya piɛɔ nihi a he nɛ a kɛ peeɔ yayami; nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nɔ ko kpa we yayami peemi. Ngɛ imi ye hɛ mi ɔ, nimli yayamihi ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora bi.

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko bu munyuhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngɛ tue ɔ tue; sisimi a ngɛ nyɛ sisie ɔ nɛ. Ninahi nɛ a jeɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi mi e je; pi imi Yawɛ ye nya mi munyuhi ji lɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Daa nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a deɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume nɛ a buɔ ye munyu ɔ tue ji, ‘Nyɛ ko ye tsui tete! Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa hi.’ Tue wali ɔmɛ lɛɛ bɔ nɛ a deɔ mɛ ji, ‘Haomi ko haomi ko be nyɛ nɔ bae fɛɛ.’ ”

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ! Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ ngɛ kaa ahumi. E ngɛ kaa lasiogblee nɛ maa fia vuguvugu kɛ bɔle yayami peeli a yi he.

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “I tsɔ we gbali nɛ ɔmɛ, se kɛ̃ a he sɔ kɛ ya fiɛ. I ha we mɛ sɛ gbi ko, se kɛ̃ a gba ngɛ ye biɛ mi.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: A le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ ye yi mi jinɛ a ko fiɛ ha ye ma a. Ke a pee ja a, ye ma a maa je a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ hu a ma kpa peemi.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: Munyuhi nɛ lakpa gbali ɔmɛ tuɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, i nu lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. A deɔ ke imi lɛ i ha mɛ sɛ gbi ngɛ nlami mi.

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Mɛni be gbali nɛ ɔmɛ maa ye lakpa kɛ yaa si? A deɔ níhi nɛ be mi nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ ye ma a.

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: Nlamihi nɛ a sɛɛɔ kɛ haa a sibi ɔ, a susuɔ kaa lɔ ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ ye ma a hɛ maa je ye nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ je ye nɔ nɛ a ya sɔmɔ Baal ɔ.

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Ke gbalɔ ko nla a, e sɛɛ e nlami ɔ. Se ke nɔ ko ná sɛ gbi kɛ je ye ngɔ ɔ, e fiɛ ngɛ anɔkuale mi. Jakati kɛ ngma a, mɛni bɔmi lɛ ngɛ a kpɛti?

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: Ye sɛ gbi ɔ, anɛ e be kaa la lo? Anɛ e be kaa hamle nɛ ywiaa tɛ sa wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ lo?

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ tue! Gbali nɛ sɛɛɔ lakpa nlami ɔ, i kɛ mɛ ná. A sɛɛɔ kikɛmɛ a nlami nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ lakpa yemi, kɛ fiami kpataa ye ma a nane. I tsɔ we mɛ, nɛ i fa we mɛ ke a ya tsu nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ; a he be se nami ko kulaa kɛ ha ma a. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ tlomi

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yeremia, ke ji nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko, aloo gbalɔ ko, aloo osɔfo ko bi mo ke, ‘Mɛni ji Yawɛ sɛ gbi?’ ɔ, de lɛ ke, ‘Mo ji tlomi nɛ Yawɛ tloo ɔ nɛ, nɛ e ma sake mo kɛ fɔ he.’

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: Ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko, aloo gbalɔ ko, aloo osɔfo ko li peemi nɛ e de ke ‘Yawɛ tlomi’ ɔ, ma gbla e kɛ e we mi bimɛ a tue.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ mohu nɛ sa kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bi e nyɛmi, loo e huɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mɛni heto lɛ Yawɛ ha? Kɛ Yawɛ de kɛɛ?’

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Se ‘Yawɛ tlomi’ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ ko wo nɔ ta; nɔ tsuaa nɔ munyu maa pee nɔ ɔ nitsɛ tlomi. Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, wa Mawu ɔ munyu ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsake a hɛ mi.

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Yeremia, bi gbali ɔmɛ ke, ‘Mɛni heto lɛ Yawɛ ha? Kɛ Yawɛ de kɛɛ?’

english_verse: But if you disobey me and say, “Here is news from the Lord,”
translation_verse: Ke a ya yi ye mlaa a nɔ nɛ a de ke ‘Yawɛ tlomi’ ɔ, lɛɛ de mɛ ke,

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: ma wo a nɔ, nɛ ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ he ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo, mɛ, kɛ ma a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha a kɛ a nɛmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Yawɛ je nina ko ngɔ tsɔɔ mi be ko. I na kusii enyɔ kɛ a mi ngmɔkɔ nɛ maa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar nuu nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho Babilonia ya momo: Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin, Yehoyakim bi ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli, ga ní tsuli, kɛ sɔli.

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Ngmɔkɔ kpakpahi ngɛ kekleekle kusii ɔ mi; a ngɛ kaa ngmɔkɔhi nɛ fuu kɛ sɛɛ hlami ɔ. Kusii enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ ngmɔkɔ yayahi nɛ hí yemi lɛ ngɛ mi.

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bi mi ke, “Yeremia, mɛni o na?” I he nɔ ke, “I na ngmɔkɔhi. Ngmɔkɔ kpakpa amɛ hi saminya. Ngmɔkɔ yaya amɛ lɛɛ a hí kulaa; e sɛ nɛ a yeɔ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: Ma bu a he, nɛ ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu. I be hae nɛ a na nɔ, se mohu ma piɛ a he. I be a hɛ mi kpatae, se mohu ma to mɛ si kaa bɔ nɛ a duɔ tso ɔ.

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ a maa nu he ngɛ a tsui mi tɔɔ kaa imi ji Yawɛ. A maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu; ejakaa a maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu kɛ a tsui tsuo.

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: “Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ nɛ a nuu we mɛ kɛ yɛ Babilonia a, bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ngmɔkɔ nɛ sa nɛ hí yemi ɔ, jã pɛ imi, Yawɛ ma pee mɛ. Mɛ ji Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ho Egipt ya a.

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ haomi nɛ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ ba a nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa nu sawale. A maa ye a he fɛu, a maa bɔ mɛ ahlua, nɛ a maa wo mɛ la ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ ma fie mɛ kɛ ya a.

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ma ba sɛ a kpɛti kɛ yaa si a ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po be piɛe ngɛ zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha a kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord has sent prophets to you time after time, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Daa nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ tsɔɔ e tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ kɛ baa nyɛ ngɔ. Se nyɛ bui mɛ tue, nɛ sɛ gbi nɛ a kɛ ba a hu nyɛ bui.

english_verse: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: A de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ kpale kɛ je nyɛ blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpa yayami peemi, konɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ blema kaa nyɛ weto ní ɔ, nyɛɛ hi nɔ daa.

english_verse: But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord, say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did.
