translation_verse: Se Yawɛ nitsɛ de ke nyɛ bui lɛ tue fɛɛ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ we amaga amɛ wo e mi mi la, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he awi.

english_verse: and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: ‘Ma tsɔ nɛ a ya kpee omleyi je ma amɛ tsuo, kɛ Babilonia matsɛ Nebukadnezar, ye tsɔlɔ ɔ kɛ ba. Ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ Yuda zugba a, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ je mahi tsuo nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ ma ba hwu ta. Ma kpata zugba nɛ ɔ, kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; a ma plɛ pee gbeye nɔ́, muɔ nɔ́, kɛ he fɛu yemi nɔ́ kɛ ya neneene. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ nyami, kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ ayɛflo he ní peemi hoo ɔ se maa po. A be nu nae kɛ wo a kane ɔmɛ a mi hu, nɛ blɛfo maa ta.

english_verse: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ ma sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ jeha nyingmi kpaago.

english_verse: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.
translation_verse: Jeha nyingmi kpaago ɔ se ɔ, ma gbla Babilonia matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ma a tue ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a he. Ma kpata Babilonia zugba a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kɛ ya neneene.

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: Níhi tsuo nɛ i de to; haomihi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi nɛ Yeremia fiɛ ke a maa ba je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ, i kɛ maa gbla Babilonia tue.

english_verse: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves. The Cup Full of God's Anger
translation_verse: Ma wo Babilonia bi ɔmɛ hiɔ ngɛ níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he; mɛ hu a ma ba sɔmɔ je mahi babauu, kɛ matsɛmɛ nguanguahi kaa nyɔguɛhi.’ ” Mawu maa gbla je ma amɛ a tue

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de mi ke, “O nɛ wai kplu nɛ ye mi mi la hyi lɛ tɔ. Ngɔɔ kɛ ya ha je mahi tsuo nɛ ma tsɔ mo a ngɔ ɔ nɛ a nu.

english_verse: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
translation_verse: Ke a nu ɔ, a hɛ mi ma tsitsɛɛ mɛ nɛ a fo godo ngɛ ta a nɛ i tsɔ kɛ ma a ngɔ ɔ he.”

english_verse: I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i he kplu ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ dɛ, nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ya ha je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ tsɔ mi a ngɔ ɔ, nɛ a nu.

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: Yerusalem bi, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi, matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nu. Nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ; a plɛ pee he fɛu yemi nɔ́, kɛ gbiɛmi.

english_verse: The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “De ma a ke imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ mɛ fae ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ kplu ɔ mi ɔ kɛ yaa si e maa tɔ dã, nɛ e maa vie, kɛ yaa si e maa nɔ si nɛ e be nyɛe maa te si hu; ejakaa i tsɔ ta nɛ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ ma a ngɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.
translation_verse: Se ke a kplɛɛ we kaa a ma he kplu ɔ ngɛ o dɛ nɛ a nu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, de mɛ ke imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ ji ɔ, ja a nu kɛ̃.

english_verse: My voice will be heard everywhere on earth, accusing nations of their crimes and sentencing the guilty to death. Disaster Is Coming
translation_verse: nɛ huhui maa pɛ kɛ ya je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ tɔɔ. Yawɛ kɛ je ma amɛ ná. E maa kojo nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e maa gbe mɛ. Yawɛ lɛ de.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke haomi maa ba je ma amɛ a nɔ nɔtonɔto, nɛ ahumi nɛ nya wa maa fia kɛ je je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ tɔɔ.

english_verse: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn. The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nihi nɛ Yawɛ maa gbe ɔ, a ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ he kɛ maa je je ɔ nyagbe he kake kɛ maa ya nyagbe he kake. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee ha mɛ, nɛ a be mɛ ngɔe kɛ ho nɛ a ya pu hulɔ; a ma plɛ pee kuku ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma nɔ yeli nɛ nyɛ hyɛɛ ye ma a nɔ, nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛ kpa bubuubui! Nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ wuwlua si ngɛ la zu mi; ejakaa ligbi ɔ nɛ a maa gbe nyɛ ɔ su. A ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔtslɔɔ agbosu mi.

english_verse: You have nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. *
translation_verse: Nyɛ be blɔ nae kɛ tu fo.

english_verse: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.
translation_verse: Nyɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bubuubui kpae kɛ hɛdɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ puɛ nyɛ sihi he ɔmɛ. Yawɛ kɛ abofu kpata nyɛ tue mi jɔmi ma a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Like a lion leaving its den, the Lord has abandoned his people to the destruction of war.
translation_verse: Yawɛ je e ma a he kaa jata nɛ si e muɔ kɛ fɔ si. Ta ní puɛmi ɔ, kɛ Yawɛ abofu nɛ nya wa a ha nɛ zugba a plɛ pee nga kplanaa.

english_verse: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said,
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo nu nɛ i ngɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le ɔ kaa ke nyɛ gbe mi ɔ, nyɛ pue nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko ɔ muɔ si, nɛ musu maa tloo nyɛɛ kɛ ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo. Ejakaa Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ tsɔ mi nyɛ ngɔ ke ma ba tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya da si ngɛ kue ɔ mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Nihi nɛ jeɔ Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi kɛ baa lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ba jaa mi ɔ, de mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ i fa mo ke o fiɛ ha mɛ ɔ. Ko si ekoeko.

english_verse: Maybe the people will listen this time. And if they stop doing wrong, I will change my mind and not punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Alini a maa bu tue nɛ a maa kpale kɛ je a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ. Ke a pee ja a, lɛɛ yi mi nɛ i to kaa ma gbla a tue ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ma tsake jamɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ.”

english_verse: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Yawɛ fa mi ke ma de ni ɔmɛ ke, “Imi Yawɛ, i de ke nyɛɛ bu mi tue nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once,
translation_verse: I de nyɛ ke ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ nɛ i tsɔɔ kɛ baa nyɛ ngɔ be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛɛ bu a munyu ɔmɛ tue. Se nyɛ bui mɛ tue fɛɛ.

english_verse: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name “Jerusalem” as a curse word. Jeremiah on Trial
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ wa tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ma pee we nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Shilo ɔ. Nɛ ma ha nɛ ma nɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee gbiɛmi nɔ́ ko kɛ ha je ma amɛ tsuo.”

english_verse: and as soon as I finished, they all crowded around me and started shouting, “Why did you preach that the Lord will destroy this temple, just as he destroyed Shiloh? Why did you say that Jerusalem will be empty and lie in ruins? You ought to be put to death for saying such things in the Lord's name!” Then they had me arrested.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je lɛ o fiɛ ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ke we nɛ ɔ ma ba pee kaa Shilo ɔ? Mɛni he je lɛ o de ke a ma kpata ma nɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi hie hu ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo ba bua kɛ wo ye he ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nu sane nɛ ba a, a he sɔ kɛ je matsɛ we ɔ mi kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ a ba hi si ngɛ agbo he ɔ nya.

english_verse: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, “All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ, de ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ ma a ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nu kɛ nyɛ tue ɔ, nyumu nɛ ɔ tu munyu kɛ si wa ma a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ja a gbe lɛ!”

english_verse: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord, he will change his mind.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ dla nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ; nyɛ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, lɛɛ yi mi nɛ e to kaa e maa gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e ma tsake jamɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ.

english_verse: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dɛ mi; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ susu kaa e hi, loo e da ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee mi.

english_verse: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, “Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo de osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ wɔ tu munyu ngɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ biɛ mi; e sɛ kaa a gbeɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ ekomɛ te da si, nɛ a de ma a tsuo nɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke,

english_verse: years ago when Hezekiah was king of Judah, a prophet named Micah from the town of Moresheth had said: “I, the Lord All-Powerful, say Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.”
translation_verse: “Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia yi nɔ ɔ, gbalɔ Mika nɛ je Moreshet ɔ de Yuda ma a tsuo ke, ‘A ma hu Zion kaa a huɔ ngmɔ. Yerusalem ma hyi tɔ kɛ ní kokoehi nɛ a bua nya glekugleku, nɛ yoku ɔ nɔ he nɛ we ɔ maa si ngɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee hue.’

english_verse: Then the leaders continued: No one put Micah to death for saying that. Instead, King Hezekiah prayed to the Lord with fear and trembling and asked him to have mercy. Then the Lord decided not to destroy Jerusalem, even though he had already said he would. People of Judah, if Jeremiah is killed, we will bring a terrible disaster on ourselves.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mika de nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, anɛ Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia kɛ ma a tsuo gbe lɛ lo? Dɛbi! Nɔ́ nɛ Hezekia pee mohu ji kaa e ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ e hla e se blɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, yi mi nɛ Yawɛ to kaa e kɛ amanehlu maa ba ma a nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ tsake jamɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ngɛ hlae nɛ waa kɛ amanehlu agbo nɛ ba wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nɔ.”

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me: Jeremiah, make a wooden yoke with leather straps, and place it on your neck.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke ma ya pee kuɛpã tso kɛ e he kpa nɛ a kɛ lohwe he womi pee kɛ kpla ye kuɛ.

english_verse: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: E de mi ke ma fa mɛ nɛ a ya de a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ lɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: and with my power I created the earth, its people, and all animals. I decide who will rule the earth,
translation_verse: “Imi lɛ i kɛ ye he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ kɔni si wami bɔ je ɔ, nimli adesahi, kɛ lohwehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi; nɛ i kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ i suɔ.

english_verse: and I have chosen my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to rule all nations, including yours. I will even let him rule the wild animals. All nations will be slaves of Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson. Then many nations will join together, and their kings will make slaves of the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ tsuo ma sɔmɔ lɛ, kɛ e bi, kɛ e bibi hluu kɛ yaa si be maa su nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma a hɛ mi ma kpata. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ hu e ma ba sɔmɔ je mahi nɛ a he wa, kɛ matsɛmɛ nguanguahi.

english_verse: This yoke stands for the power of King Nebuchadnezzar, and I will destroy any nation that refuses to obey him. Nebuchadnezzar will attack, and many will die in battle or from hunger and disease.
translation_verse: “Se ke je ma ko, aloo nɔ yemi ko kua ke mɛɛ lɛɛ a be kikɛmɛ a Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar nɛ ɔ sɔmɔe ɔ, ma ngɔ ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kɛ gbla a tue hluu kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma ha nɛ Nebukadnezar ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko bu nyɛ gbali ɔmɛ, klaali ɔmɛ, kpade tsɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ kunya yeli ɔmɛ tue. Mɛ tsuo a deɔ nyɛ ke nyɛ ko sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.
translation_verse: Se ke je ma ko maa ba a he si ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ lɛ ɔ, ma ha nɛ a maa hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ; a ma hu zugba a, nɛ a maa hi nɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.
translation_verse: I tu munyu nɛ ɔ kɛ̃ kɛ tsɔɔ Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia ke, “Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ. Nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ e ma a, nɛ nyɛ yi ma na wami.

english_verse: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ deɔ nyɛ ke nyɛ ko sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko bu mɛ tue. Lakpa gbami lɛ a ngɛ gbae kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord, but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Yawɛ nitsɛ de ke pi lɛ nɛ tsɔ mɛ; pe a ngɔ e biɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ sisie kɛkɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ maa fie nyɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɛ lakpa munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.”

english_verse: When I finished talking to the king, I told the priests and everyone else that the Lord had said: Don't listen to the prophets when they say that very soon the Babylonians will return the things they took from my temple. Those prophets are lying!
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i de osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ ke, “Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, e be kɛe kulaa nɛ a maa ngɔ Yawɛ we ɔ juetli ɔ kɛ je Babilonia kɛ ba a, nyɛ ko bu mɛ tue. Lakpa munyu lɛ a ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko bu mɛ tue kulaa! Nyɛ sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami. Mɛni he je lɛ ma nɛ ɔ maa pee ma doku?

english_verse: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ke gbali ji mɛ niinɛ, nɛ a na ye sɛ gbi ɔ, ha nɛ a fa kue ha imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ mohu, konɛ ma ko ngmɛ blɔ nɛ a ba muɔ juetli nɛ piɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ Yuda matsɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ ho Babilonia ya.”

english_verse: will be taken to Babylonia, where they will remain until I decide to bring them back to Jerusalem. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: A maa ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ maa ya Babilonia, ya to ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si ma kai mɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba to a blɔ he ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ekohu. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening,
translation_verse: Jamɛ a jeha a nɔuu mi ɔ, Azur bi Hanania, gbalɔ ɔ nɛ je Gibeon ɔ kɛ mi tu munyu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia yi nɔ jeha eywiɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ mi sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, Hanania de mi ke,

english_verse: he told me that the Lord had said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I will smash the yoke that Nebuchadnezzar put on the necks of the nations to make them his slaves.
translation_verse: “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Babilonia matsɛ ɔ he wami ɔ, i he ngɛ e dɛ.

english_verse: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha enyɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ we ɔ juetli tsuo nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ba muɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya a, ma ngɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ ekohu.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin, Yehoyakim bi ɔ, kɛ Yuda ma a tsuo nɛ a nuu mɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya a, mɛ hu ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ ekohu. Niinɛ, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ he wami ɔ, ma he ngɛ e dɛ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.’ ”

english_verse: The priests and the others were still standing there, so I said:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i de gbalɔ Hanania ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo nɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a hɛ mi ke,

english_verse: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.
translation_verse: “Saminya! Yawɛ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Gbami nɛ o gba a, Yawɛ nɛ ha nɛ e ba mi, konɛ Yawɛ we ɔ juetli tsuo nɛ a muɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ɔ, e kpale mɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ ekohu.

english_verse: But let me remind you and everyone else
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃, moo bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo, kɛ ma a tsuo dee ɔ tue.

english_verse: that long before we were born, prophets were saying powerful kingdoms would be struck by war, disaster, and disease.
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ i kɛ mo tsuo wa hɛ mi blema lokoo ɔ gba ke ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa ba je mahi babauu, kɛ matsɛ yemi nguanguahi a nɔ.

english_verse: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ nɛ gbaa ke tue mi jɔmi maa ba a, ke jamɛ a gbalɔ ɔ munyu ɔ na ba mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa Yawɛ lɛ tsɔ lɛ niinɛ.”

english_verse: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Hanania je kuɛpã tso ɔ kɛ je ye kuɛ, nɛ e ku mi dukuduku.

english_verse: Then he said, “The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years.” I left the temple,
translation_verse: Nɛ e de ngɛ ma a tsuo hɛ mi ke, “Yawɛ ke, kuɛpã tso ɔ nɛ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ngɔ wo je ma amɛ tsuo a kuɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ lɛ Yawɛ ɔ maa ku jamɛ a kuɛpã tso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. E maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha enyɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i je lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: to go back and say to Hananiah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You smashed a wooden yoke, but I will replace it with one made of iron. I will put iron yokes on all the nations, and they will have to do what King Nebuchadnezzar commands. I will even let him rule the wild animals.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke e kɛ dade kuɛpã tso maa fɔ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a kuɛ, nɛ a ma ba sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar. Yawɛ ke e ma ha nɛ pu mi lohwehi po ma sɔmɔ Nebukadnezar.”

english_verse: Hananiah, I have never sent you to speak for me. And yet you have talked my people into believing your lies and rebelling against me. So now I will send you—I'll send you right off the face of the earth! You will die before this year is over.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ ke e ma je mo kɛ je je ɔ mi. O ma gbo jeha nɛ ɔ mi nɔuu, ejakaa o de ma a ke a tsɔ atuã kɛ wo Yawɛ.”

english_verse: I had been left in Jerusalem when King Nebuchadnezzar took many of the people of Jerusalem and Judah to Babylonia as prisoners, including King Jehoiachin, his mother, his officials, and the metal workers and others in Jerusalem who were skilled in making things. So I wrote a letter to the priests, the prophets, the leaders, and the rest of our people in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je Yerusalem momo. Mɛ ji Matsɛ Yehoyakin, e nyɛ, matsɛ we ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem, ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ sɔli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote
translation_verse: I ngɔ womi ɔ kɛ mane Elasa, Shafan bi ɔ, kɛ Gamaria, Hilkia bi ɔ. Mɛ ji nihi nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia tsɔ mɛ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ngɔ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you
translation_verse: “Nihi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ha nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho Babilonia ya a, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.
translation_verse: ‘Nyɛɛ po wehi nɛ nyɛɛ hi a mi. Nyɛɛ pee ngmɔhi nɛ nyɛɛ ye a mi ní.

english_verse: Get married and have children, then help your sons find wives and help your daughters find husbands, so they can have children as well. I want your numbers to grow, not to get smaller.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ yihi nɛ nyɛ fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyihi. Nyɛɛ ngɔ yihi ha nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ha nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ gba, konɛ mɛ hu a fɔ bimɛ. Nyɛɛ bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nyɛ nɔ nɛ ko gbɔ.

english_verse: Pray for peace in Babylonia and work hard to make it prosperous. The more successful that nation is, the better off you will be.
translation_verse: Ma a nɛ i ha nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya mi ɔ, nyɛ hla jamɛ a ma a nɔ yami. Nyɛɛ fa kue ha imi Yawɛ, konɛ ma na mɛ mɔbɔ; ejakaa ke a na a he ɔ, nyɛ hu e maa hi ha nyɛ.

english_verse: You will turn back to me and ask for help, and I will answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, ke nyɛ tsɛ mi nɛ nyɛ fa kue ha mi ɔ, ma bu nyɛ tue.

english_verse: You will worship me with all your heart, and I will be with you
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma hla ye se blɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa na mi. Ke nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ tsui tsuo kɛ hla ye se blɔ ɔ,

english_verse: You feel secure, because you think I have sent prophets to speak for me in Babylonia.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ deɔ ke Yawɛ je gbali ha nyɛ ngɛ Babilonia.

english_verse: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. But you had better listen to me now.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i ha nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho Babilonia ya, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ tue.’

english_verse: You think Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah are prophets because they claim to speak for me. But they are lying! I haven't told them anything. They are also committing other horrible sins in your community, such as sleeping with the wives of their friends. So I will hand them over to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will put them to death while the rest of you watch. And in the future, when you want to put a curse on someone, you will say, “I pray that the Lord will kill you in the same way the king of Babylonia burned Zedekiah and Ahab to death!” A Message for Shemaiah
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa a pee ní yayamihi ngɛ Israel; a puɛ gba, nɛ a tu lakpa munyuhi ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi, pohu e fa we mɛ ke a tu jamɛ a munyu ko. Pi Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní ji nɛ ɔ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ, e na, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa ye he odase. Yawɛ lɛ de.” Womi ɔ nɛ Shemaya ngma a

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me what would happen to Shemaiah, who was one of our people in Babylonia. After my letter reached Babylonia, Shemaiah wrote letters to the people of Jerusalem, including the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and the other priests. The letter to Zephaniah said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ha mi sɛ gbi kɛ ha Shemaya nɛ je Nehelam ɔ. Shemaya nɛ ɔ ngma womi ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ mi kɛ mane osɔfo Zefania, Maaseya bi ɔ, kɛ osɔfo kpa amɛ tsuo, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ. Womi ɔ nɛ Shemaya ngma kɛ mane Zefania a, nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi ji,

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the Lord chose you to be the priest in charge of the temple security force. You know that anyone who acts crazy and pretends to be a prophet should be arrested and put in chains and iron collars.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ wo mo osɔfo ngɛ Yehoyada nane mi konɛ o hyɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nɔ. O blɔ nya ní tsumi ji godotsɛ tsuaa godotsɛ nɛ peeɔ e he gbalɔ ɔ, o hyɛ nɛ a bɔ lɛ pã nɛ a wo e kuɛ dade kɔsɔkɔsɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah from the town of Anathoth is pretending to be a prophet there in Jerusalem, so why haven't you punished him?
translation_verse: Yeremia, Anatot no ɔ nɛ ngɛ lakpa gbami gbae ha ma a, mɛni he je o ka we e hɛ mi mɔ?

english_verse: He even wrote a letter to the people here in Babylonia, saying we would be here a long time. He told us to build homes and to plant gardens and grow our own food.
translation_verse: Yeremia ngma womi ya ha nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho Babilonia ya a ke a se maa kɛ ngɛ ma se. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a po wehi nɛ a hi a mi, nɛ a pee ngmɔhi nɛ a ye a mi ní.”

english_verse: When Zephaniah received Shemaiah's letter, he read it to me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo Zefania kane womi nɛ ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mi.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me what to write in a second letter
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel said, “Jeremiah, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you.
translation_verse: de mi ke, “Ngmaa munyuhi nɛ i kɛ mo tu ɔ tsuo kɛ wo womi mi,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to Israel and Judah: Screams of terror are heard, with no word of peace.
translation_verse: “Wa nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe, sawale kɛ gbeye, se pi tue mi jɔmi.

english_verse: Now you are slaves of other nations, but I will break the chains and smash the yokes that keep you in slavery.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma ku kuɛpã tsohi nɛ ngɛ a kuɛ ɔ, nɛ ma tsɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ. Nɛ a be ni kpahi sɔmɔe hu.

english_verse: Then you will be my servants, and I will choose a king for you from the family of David. *
translation_verse: Se mohu, a ma sɔmɔ imi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, kɛ David nina ko nɛ ma wo matsɛ ha mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you belong to me, so don't be afraid. You deserved to be punished; that's why I scattered you in distant nations. But I am with you, and someday I will destroy those nations.
translation_verse: “Ye ma, nyɛ ko ye gbeye; Israel ma, nyɛ tsui nɛ ko po. Ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je zugba nɔ, he nɛ a nuu nyɛ kɛ ho ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo ɔ. Nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba we, nɛ nyɛ ma ba hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi; nyɛ he mi maa jɔ nyɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ he gbeye woe.

english_verse: Then I will bring you and your descendants back to your land, where I will protect you and give you peace. Then your fears will be gone. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Heal Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ma ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ma ba kpɔ nyɛ. Je ma amɛ nɛ i fie nyɛ kɛ ya a ngɔ ɔ, ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ i be nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae kɛ pi si. I be hae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ he kulaa; se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma gbla nyɛ tue bɔ nɛ sa. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, you are wounded and near death.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ plaa wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nyɛ pa a be tsa ba.

english_verse: You are accused of a crime with no one to defend you, and you are covered with sores that no medicine can cure. *
translation_verse: Nɔ ko be nɛ maa hyɛ nyɛ nɔ, tsopa ko be nɛ a kɛ maa to nyɛ pa amɛ a nɔ; nyɛ be he wami nae.

english_verse: Your friends have forgotten you; they don't care anymore. Even I have acted like an enemy. And because your sins are horrible and countless, I will be cruel as I punish you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ suɔli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ je nyɛ nɔ, a bi we nyɛ si hu. I ba tua nyɛ kaa he nyɛlɔ tuaa nɔ; i gbla nyɛ tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ, ejakaa nyɛ pee yayami nguanguahi babauu.

english_verse: No one wants you as a friend or cares what happens to you. But I will heal your injuries, and you will get well. The Lord Will Rescue Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Nyɛ he nyɛli tsɛɔ nyɛ ke nihi nɛ a fie mɛ; a deɔ ke, ‘Zion nɛ be huɛ.’ Se kɛ̃, ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma na he wami ekohu; ma tsa nyɛ pa amɛ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I will be kind to you and let you come home. Jerusalem now lies in ruins, but you will rebuild it, complete with a new palace.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ma kpale ye ma a kɛ ba a zugba a nɔ ekohu, nɛ ma na we puɔ nya tsuaa we puɔ nya mɔbɔ. A maa ma Yerusalem ekohu ngɛ kpo ɔ nɔ, nɛ matsɛ we ɔ maa ma si ngɛ e ma he.

english_verse: Other nations will respect and honor you. Your homes will be filled with children, and you will celebrate, singing praises to me.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ma la yi jemi la, nɛ a ma hwɔ lele. Ma gbaa mɛ; a maa hiɛ babauu, nɛ ma wo a hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: It will be just like old times. Your nation will worship me, and I will punish anyone who abuses you.
translation_verse: A bimɛ ɔmɛ ma ba hi si kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi si ɔ; nɛ ma to ma a si wawɛɛ ekohu. Nihi tsuo nɛ maa wa mɛ yi mi ɔ, ma gbla a tue.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I promise that someday all your tribes will again be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ ma ba pee Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a Mawu, nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.

english_verse: In the desert I was kind to those who escaped death. I gave them peace, and when the time is right, I'll do the same for you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Rebuild Israel
translation_verse: I na nihi nɛ a he je gbenɔ mi ɔ mɔbɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ. Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a jɔɔ a he ɔ,

english_verse: Some time ago, the Lord appeared to me and told me to say: Israel, I will always love you; that's why I've been so patient and kind.
translation_verse: i je ye he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo. Israel ma, kɛ je blema lɛ i je suɔmi nɛ nya wa kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ. Nɛ kɛ ba si piɔ hu jamɛ a suɔmi ɔ ngɛ; e se pui.

english_verse: You are precious to me, and so I will rebuild your nation. Once again you will dance for joy and play your tambourines.
translation_verse: Ma to nyɛ si ekohu. Nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ fao ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa do kɛ bua jɔmi ekohu.

english_verse: Someday those who guard the hill country of Ephraim will shout, “Let's go to Zion and worship the Lord our God.” Israel Will Return to Its Own Land
translation_verse: Niinɛ, be ma nɛ buli ma kpa ngmlaa ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ma de ke, ‘Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ya Zion, ngɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord says: Celebrate and sing for Israel, the greatest of nations. Offer praises and shout, “Come and rescue your people, Lord! Save what's left of Israel.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ la ha Israel; nyɛ hwɔ lele ha ma nɛ he wa pe je ma amɛ tsuo ɔ. Nyɛ la yi jemi la, nɛ nyɛɛ fiɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ he e ma a yi wami; Yawɛ he nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo a yi wami.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, will bring my people back from Babylonia and everywhere else on earth. The blind and the lame will be there. Expectant mothers and women about to give birth will come and be part of that great crowd.
translation_verse: Ma ya ngɔ mɛ kɛ je omleyi je zugba a nɔ, ma ya bua a nya kɛ je zugba a nyagbe he tɔɔ. Hɛ yuyuili, akpaketsɛmɛ, yihɔyihi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ miɔ nɛ a ma fɔ po maa piɛ a he kɛ ba. Nihi babauu nitsɛ maa kpale kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ ekohu.

english_verse: They will weep and pray as I bring them home. I will lead them to streams of water. They will walk on a level road and not stumble. I am a father to Israel, my favorite children.
translation_verse: Ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba kɛ a hɛ mi ya, kɛ kue fami. Ma kpaka mɛ kɛ nyɛɛ pahi a tue ngɛ blɔ tlɔmɔɔ nɔ, konɛ a ko tɛ nɔ. I ngɛ kaa tsɛ kɛ ha Israel, nɛ Efraim ji ye kekleekle bi.”

english_verse: Listen to me, you nations nearby or across the sea. I scattered the people of Israel, but I will gather them again. I will protect them like a shepherd guarding a flock;
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ je mahi, nyɛɛ bu mi tue nɛ nyɛɛ fiɛ ye munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ wo kpɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ tsitsaa lokoo ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ gbɛ Israel ma a ngɔ fĩa a, lɛ nɔuu e ma bua a nya ekohu, nɛ e maa hyɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ hyɛɛ e tohi ɔ.’

english_verse: My people will come to Mount Zion and celebrate; their faces will glow because of my blessings. I'll give them grain, grapes, and olive oil, as well as sheep and cattle. Israel will be prosperous and grow like a garden with plenty of water.
translation_verse: A ma ba la ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, nɛ a bua maa jɔ ye nike ní ɔmɛ, blɛfo, wai, oliv nu, to, kɛ na a he. A maa pee kaa ngmɔ nɛ a pue e mi ní ɔmɛ a nɔ nyu; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mɛ hiae hu.

english_verse: Young women and young men, together with the elderly, will celebrate and dance, because I will comfort them and turn their sorrow into happiness.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, yihewi ɔmɛ maa do kɛ bua jɔmi, nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ kɛ nimowi ɔmɛ tsuo ma nya. Ma jɔɔ a bua; ma ha nɛ a kɔmɔ yemi ɔ maa plɛ pee bua jɔmi, nɛ a we aywilɛho ɔ ma plɛ pee nyami.

english_verse: I will bless my people with more food than they need, and the priests will enjoy the choice cuts of meat. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Offers Hope
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ maa ye ní kpakpahi nɛ a maa tɔ; ye ma a hu maa ye nɛ a maa tɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ maa na Israel mɔbɔ

english_verse: In Ramah a voice is heard, crying and weeping loudly. Rachel mourns for her children and refuses to be comforted, because they are dead. *
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “A nu gbi ko ngɛ Rama, kɔmɔ yemi kɛ ya fomi nɛ nya wa, Rahel ngɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ foe nɛ e kplɛɛ we kpatami, ejakaa a be hu.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, say to dry your tears. Someday your children will come home from the enemy's land. Then all you have done for them will be greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ jɔɔ ya fomi, nɛ nyɛ tsu vo nyu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi. Níhi tsuo nɛ nyɛ pee kɛ ha nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a maa wo he hiɔ; bimɛ ɔmɛ maa je he nyɛli ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ekohu.

english_verse: The people of Israel moan and say to me, “We were like wild bulls, but you, Lord, broke us, and we learned to obey. You are our God— please let us come home.
translation_verse: “I nu nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ke, ‘Yawɛ, jinɛ wa ngɛ kaa lohwe nɛ hɛ mi jɔɛ; se o tsɔse wɔ nɛ wa he jɔ. Moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu, ejakaa mo ji Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When we were young, we strayed and sinned, but then we realized what we had done. We are ashamed and disgraced and want to return to you.”
translation_verse: Jinɛ wa je o se, se wa pia wa he, nɛ wa tsake wa tsui. Benɛ o gbla wa tue se ɔ, wa ywilɛ ho wa he. Zo gbe wɔ kpɔtɔɔ; ejakaa wa pee yayamihi babauu ngɛ wa nihe mi.’

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my own dear children. Don't I love you best of all? Though I often make threats, I want you to be near me, so I will have mercy on you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Israel, mo ji ye bi nɛ i suɔ saminya; mo ji bi nɛ i suɔ pe bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Be tsuaa be nɛ ma de nɔ́ ko kɛ si mo ɔ, ja i kɛ suɔmi kai mo kɛ̃. Ye hɛ jaa ngɛ o he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma na mo mɔbɔ kɛ̃.

english_verse: With rock piles and signposts, mark the road well, my dear people. The road by which you left by will now lead you home.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ma tsohi ngɛ blɔ he kɛ to blɔ ɔ he so. Blɔ nɛ nyɛ maa nyɛɛ nɔ kɛ ya a, nyɛɛ to blɔ ɔ he hɛ saminya. Israel ma, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba koo! Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi.

english_verse: Will you ever decide to be faithful? I will make sure that someday things will be different, as different as a woman protecting a man. The Lord Will Bring Judah Home
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma nɛ nyɛ be hemi kɛ yemi! Kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ nyɛ yi mi maa pee nyɛ enyɔɔnyɔ? I bɔ nɔ́ he ko kɛ wo je ɔ mi; yo mohu maa bu nyumu he.” Mawu ma a ma ba bɔ hwɔɔ se

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I promise to set the people of Judah free and to lead them back to their hometowns. And when I do, they will once again say, “We pray that the Lord will bless his home, the sacred hill in Jerusalem where his temple stands.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke “Ke i kpale ma a kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ ekohu ɔ, a ma de ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ, kɛ ma amɛ a mi ekohu ke, ‘Yawɛ nɛ gbaa Yerusalem yo klɔuklɔu ɔ, he nɛ lɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ hii ɔ.’

english_verse: The people will live in Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah. Some will be farmers, and others will be shepherds.
translation_verse: Nihi maa pee kake kɛ hi si ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ, kɛ ma amɛ a mi: ngmɔ huli, kɛ to hyɛli kɛ a tohi.

english_verse: and when they sleep, they will wake up refreshed.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ ye hɛ tsɛ̃, nɛ i na kaa i hwɔɛ mahe nɛ ngɔ ye he saminya.

english_verse: Someday, Israel and Judah will be my field where my people and their livestock will grow.
translation_verse: “Imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ke, be ma nɛ ma ha nɛ nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi ma hyi Israel zugba a, kɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ tɔ.

english_verse: In the past, I took care to uproot them, to tear them down, and to destroy them. But when that day comes, I will take care to plant them and help them grow.
translation_verse: Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i gbo dengme nɛ i kɛ hia mɛ, nɛ i ku mɛ pue si, nɛ i butu mɛ, nɛ i kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ i kɛ haomi ba a nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu ma gbo dengme kɛ ma mɛ, nɛ ma to mɛ si ekohu.

english_verse: No longer will anyone go around saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a be dee hu ke, ‘Tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye wai yiblii ngmlikiti nɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a lungu fĩa.’

english_verse: When that day comes, only those who eat sour grapes will get the sour taste, and only those who sin will be put to death. The New Agreement with Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Se mohu ɔ, ke nɔ ko pee yayami ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e yayami ɔ lɛ maa gbe lɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye wai yiblii ngmlikiti ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e lungu lɛ maa fĩa.”

english_verse: The Lord said: The time will surely come when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ i kɛ Israel ma a, kɛ Yuda ma a maa so somi he.

english_verse: Here is the new agreement that I, the Lord, will make with the people of Israel: “I will write my laws on their hearts and minds. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Se somi he ɔ nɛ i kɛ Israel ma a maa so jehanɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ lɛɛ e maa hi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ma ngɔ ye mlaa kɛ wo a mi, nɛ ma ngma ngɛ a tsui nɔ. Ma pee a Mawu, nɛ a maa pee ye ma.

english_verse: “No longer will they have to teach one another to obey me. I, the Lord, promise that all of them will obey me, ordinary people and rulers alike. I will forgive their sins and forget the evil things they have done.”
translation_verse: Nɔ ko pa be e nyɛmi, loo e he nɔ ko tsɔɔe hu ke e le Yawɛ, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le mi, kɛ je jokuɛyo pe kulaa nɔ kɛ yaa si nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɔ. Ma ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ, nɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ hu i be kaie hu. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. I command the sun to give light each day, the moon and stars to shine at night, and ocean waves to roar.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lɛ pee pu, konɛ e tso piani. Lɛ nɛ pee nyɔhiɔ kɛ dodoehi konɛ a kpɛ nyɔ mi. Yawɛ lɛ klɛɔ wo mi, nɛ e haa nɛ oslɔke ɔmɛ gliɔ E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.

english_verse: I will never forget to give those commands, and I will never let Israel stop being a nation. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ si woe ke, be abɔ nɛ adebɔ mlaa nɛ ɔ ngɛ nɛ e se pui ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nɛ Israel ma a hu be gue.

english_verse: Can you measure the heavens? Can you explore the depths of the earth? That's how hard it would be for me to reject Israel forever, even though they have sinned. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt
translation_verse: Ke a ma nyɛ ma susu hiɔwe, nɛ zugba a sisi tomi ɔ hu a ma nyɛ ma hla a, lɛɛ Yawɛ hu ma kua Israel ma a ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ a he. Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: The Lord said: Someday, Jerusalem will truly belong to me. It will be rebuilt with a boundary line running from Hananel Tower to Corner Gate.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ a maa ma Yerusalem ehe ekohu kɛ ha mi, kɛ je Hananel mɔ ɔ bonyoku je, kɛ yaa si kɔ̃ nya agbo ɔ he.

english_verse: From there, the boundary will go in a straight line to Gareb Hill, then turn toward Goah.
translation_verse: Susumi kpa a maa je lejɛ ɔ tɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ ya gu Gareb yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e maa dɔ e yi kɛ ba Goa.

english_verse: Even that disgusting Hinnom Valley will be sacred to me, and so will the eastern slopes that go down from Horse Gate into Kidron Valley. Jerusalem will never again be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nɛ kɔ̃ ɔ tsuo maa pee klɔuklɔu kɛ ha mi: gɔ ɔ, kuku ɔ, kɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Kidron pa a yi mi ɔ, hluu kɛ yaa si okpɔngɔ agbo ɔ beleku je. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be ma a ngɔe hu, nɛ a be e hɛ mi kpatae hu gblegbleegble.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma a mi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar hu na jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ momo ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: At that time, the Babylonian army had surrounded Jerusalem, and I was in the prison at the courtyard of the palace guards.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ tabo ɔ ya sa Yerusalem ma a yi, be mi nɛ imi, Yeremia lɛɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ kue ɔ mi ngɛ Yuda matsɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: Zedekiah had ordered me to be held there because I told everyone that the Lord had said: I am the Lord, and I am about to let the king of Babylonia conquer Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Zedekia wo mi tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e po ye nya ke i kɛ Yawɛ biɛ fiɛ ke, “Ma ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, e maa ngɔ ma a,

english_verse: King Zedekiah will be captured and taken to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will speak with him face to face.
translation_verse: nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia be e he yee. A maa nu lɛ kɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ; e maa na lɛ hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ maa tu munyu.

english_verse: Then Zedekiah will be led away to Babylonia, where he will stay until I am finished with him. So, if you people of Judah fight against the Babylonians, you will lose. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: A maa ngɔ Zedekia kɛ ya Babilonia, nɛ e ma ya hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si i kɛ lɛ maa to ní. Ke e kɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ hwu ta po e be mɛ nyɛe. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, your cousin Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, will visit you. He must sell his field near the town of Anathoth, and because you are his nearest relative, you have the right and the responsibility to buy it and keep it in the family.
translation_verse: ke Hanamel, ye tsɛko Shalum bi ɔ ma ba de mi ke ma he e zugba a nɛ ngɛ Anatot ɔ. Ejakaa ye nyɛmi tutuutu ji lɛ, nɛ i ngɛ he blɔ nɛ i kpɔɔ zugba a.

english_verse: Hanamel came, just as the Lord had promised. And he said, “Please buy my field near Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. You have the right to buy it, and if you do, it will stay in our family.” The Lord had told me to buy it
translation_verse: Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ɔ, Hanamel ba ye ngɔ ngɛ kue ɔ mi nɛ e ba de mi ke ma he e zugba a nɛ ngɛ Anatot ngɛ Benyamin zugba a mi ɔ. Hanamel de mi ke imi lɛ i ngɛ he blɔ nɛ i kpɔɔ zugba a kɛ peeɔ ye weto ní, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma he zugba a. Kɛkɛ nɛ i na kaa Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu niinɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, you stretched out your mighty arm and made the sky and the earth. You can do anything.
translation_verse: “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, mo lɛ o kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko peemi wɛ ha mo.

english_verse: I had two copies of the bill of sale written out: an official copy containing the details of our agreement and another copy, without the details. Some witnesses and I signed the official copy, which was folded and tied, before being sealed shut with hot wax. Then I gave Hanamel the silver.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i kɛ̃ zugba a he womi ɔ nɛ a sɔu nya a, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a sɔu we nya a tsuo. Womi ɔ nɛ a sɔu nya a tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a ye zugba a nya ha, kɛ mlaa nɛ kɔɔ zugba a juami ɔ he.

english_verse: And while he, the witnesses, and all the other Jews sitting in the courtyard were still watching, I gave both copies to Baruch son of Neriah.
translation_verse: I ngɔ womi ɔmɛ kɛ ha Baruk, Maseya bi Neria bi ɔ ngɛ ye tsɛko bi Hanamel, kɛ odase yeli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a nine kɛ wo womi ɔ sisi ɔ, kɛ Yuda bi tsuo nɛ hii si ngɛ kue ɔ mi ɔ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: I told Baruch that the Lord had said: Take both copies of this bill of sale, one sealed shut and the other open, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo fae ke o he zugba juami he womi nɛ ɔmɛ, nɔ́ nɛ a sɔu nya a, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a sɔu we nya a tsuo, nɛ o ngɔ ya wo zu kplu ko mi, konɛ a se nɛ kɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I promise you that people will once again buy and sell houses, farms, and vineyards in this country. Jeremiah Questions the Lord
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ke nihi ma ba he wehi, zugbahi, kɛ wai ngmɔhi ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu.” Yeremia fa kue ha Yawɛ

english_verse: You show kindness for a thousand generations, but you also punish people for the sins of their parents. You are the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: O jeɔ o suɔmi nɛ se pui gblegbleegble ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ ni akpeakpe. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o kɛ tsɛmɛ a tɔmi gblaa bimɛ a tue. Mawu nɛ kle, nɛ ngɛ he wami ji mo; o biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.

english_verse: With great wisdom you make plans, and with your great power you do all the mighty things you planned. Nothing we do is hidden from your eyes, and you reward or punish us as we deserve.
translation_verse: O toɔ nile gahi, nɛ o peeɔ ní nguanguahi. O naa níhi tsuo nɛ nimli adesahi peeɔ, nɛ o woɔ mɛ hiɔ bɔ pɛ nɛ sa mɛ.

english_verse: You are famous because you worked miracles in Egypt, and you are still working them in Israel and in the rest of the world as well.
translation_verse: Blema lokoo ɔ, o pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ. Kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, o ngɛ jamɛ a nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ, kɛ okadi ɔmɛ pee kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ o kɛ he biɛ.

english_verse: You terrified the Egyptians with your miracles, and you reached out your mighty arm and rescued your people Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: O pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi kɛ wo wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he gbeye, nɛ o kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ jé o ma Israel kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: Then you gave Israel this land rich with milk and honey, just as you had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: O ha mɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is under attack, and we suffer from hunger and disease. The Babylonians have already built dirt ramps up to the walls of our city, and you can see that Jerusalem will be captured just as you said.
translation_verse: “Babilonia bi ɔmɛ fia kpoku kɛ wo ma a he konɛ a ngɔ ma a; amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a tua ma a. Ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ma ha nɛ a maa ngɔ ma a. O maa na kaa níhi nɛ o de ɔ tsuo ba mi.

english_verse: So why did you tell me to get some witnesses and buy a field with my silver, when Jerusalem is about to be captured by the Babylonians? The Lord Explains about the Field
translation_verse: Se Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lee, mo lɛ o fa mi ke ma he zugba a ngɛ odase yeli a hɛ mi, be mi nɛ o le paa kaa a ngɔ ma a kɛ wo Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.”

english_verse: The Lord explained:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: Jeremiah, I am the Lord God. I rule the world, and I can do anything!
translation_verse: “Imi ji Yawɛ; nimli adesahi tsuo a Mawu ji mi. Anɛ nɔ́ ko peemi wa ha mi lo?

english_verse: It is true that I am going to let King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar kɛ e tabo ɔ a dɛ mi; a maa ngɔ ma a,

english_verse: The Babylonian army is already attacking, and they will capture the city and set it on fire. The people of Jerusalem have made me angry by going up to the flat roofs of their houses and burning incense to Baal and offering wine sacrifices to other gods. Now these houses will be burned to the ground!
translation_verse: nɛ a maa mɛ ma a he la. A maa sã ma a, kɛ wehi nɛ nihi sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a yi mi kɛ haa Baal, nɛ a ngɔɔ dã kɛ sãã wai bɔ ha mawu kpahi kɛ woɔ ye mi mi la a.

english_verse: The kings and the officials, the priests and the prophets, and everyone else in Israel and Judah have turned from me and made me angry by worshiping idols. Again and again I have tried to teach my people to obey me, but they refuse to be corrected. I am going to get rid of Jerusalem, because its people have done nothing but evil.
translation_verse: A plɛ a se ngɔ wo mi, nɛ a kua a tsui tsakemi. I gbo dengme kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ní be babauu, se a bui tue fɛɛ; nɔ́ ko hu a kase we.

english_verse: They have set up repulsive idols in my temple, and now it isn't a fit place to worship me.
translation_verse: We ɔ nɛ a ma nɛ a ja mi ngɛ mi ɔ tete po a ngɔ a we amagahi nɛ i hiee ɔ ya to lejɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ ble we ɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, what you said is true. The people of Jerusalem are suffering from hunger and disease, and so the king of Babylonia will be able to capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de mi ke, “Yeremia, ni ɔmɛ ngɛ dee ke ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ma ha nɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma ba ye ma nɛ ɔ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛ ngɛ he piɛe ɔ hu tue.

english_verse: I am angry with the people of Jerusalem, and I will scatter them in foreign countries. But someday I will bring them back here and let them live in safety.
translation_verse: Ma bua ma a nya kɛ je zugbahi a nɔ hehi nɛ i fie mɛ kɛ ho, benɛ ye mi mi fu mɛ ɔ, nɛ ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ekohu nɛ a ba hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.

english_verse: Even though I have brought disaster on the people, I will someday do all these good things for them.
translation_verse: “Kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɔ haomi nɛ kle kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ba ma nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ̃ lɛ ma ha mɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ i wo si ɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when you bought the field, you showed that fields will someday be bought and sold again. You say that this land has been conquered by the Babylonians and has become a desert, emptied of people and animals.
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ ngɛ dee ke zugba nɛ ɔ ma ba pee nga kplanaa nɔ, nɛ nimli kɛ lohwehi be nɔ hie hu. A ngɛ dee hu ke a maa ngɔ zugba a kɛ wo Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi. Se, na nɛ o le kaa nihi ma ba he zugba ekohu ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But someday, people will again spend their silver to buy fields everywhere—in the territory of Benjamin, the region around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and in the hill country, the foothills to the west, and the Southern Desert. Buyers and sellers and witnesses will sign and seal the bills of sale for the fields. It will happen, because I will give this land back to my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nihi maa ngɔ a sika kɛ ba he zugba. A kɛ a nine maa wo womihi nɛ a maa pee ngɛ zugba amɛ a he ɔ a sisi; a maa sɔu womi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a ma tsɛ nihi nɛ a ba ye odase. A maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Benyamin zugba a nɔ; a maa pee ngɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ a mi, a maa pee ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi; a maa pee ngɛ yo nɔ ma amɛ a mi; nɛ a maa pee ngɛ nga nɔ ma amɛ, kɛ leneyi je ma amɛ hu a mi. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: I was still being held prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guards when the Lord told me: I am the Lord, and I created the whole world.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ pee je ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ to e blɔ he ɔ kɛ mi tu munyu. Nɔ nɛ e biɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ, de mi ke,

english_verse: Ask me, and I will tell you things that you don't know and can't find out.
translation_verse: “Tsɛ mi, nɛ ma he mo nɔ; ma sɛɛ mo ní nguanguahi a he sane, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o li.

english_verse: Many of the houses in Jerusalem and some of the buildings at the royal palace have been torn down to be used in repairing the walls to keep out the Babylonian attackers. Now there are empty spaces where the buildings once stood. But I am furious, and these spaces will be filled with the bodies of the people I kill. The people of Jerusalem will cry out to me for help, but they are evil, and I will ignore their prayers.
translation_verse: Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke a maa ku Yerusalem we ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda matsɛ we ɔ ngɔ pue si. E he be se nami bae ha nyɛ kaa nyɛ maa je kpo nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta ngɛ kpoku nɛ a fia kɛ bɔle ma a he. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma ha nɛ nihi nɛ i kɛ abofu maa gbe ɔ a gbogboe ma hyi ma a mi tɔ. Ní yayamihi nɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ pee he je ɔ, i kua ma a.

english_verse: Then someday, I will heal this place and my people as well, and let them enjoy unending peace.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, be ma nɛ ma tsa Yerusalem hiɔ ɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ ma na he wami. Ma ha nɛ a ma plɔke, nɛ a ma na he jɔmi.

english_verse: I will give this land to Israel and Judah once again, and I will make them as strong as they were before.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ma na a he ekohu, nɛ ma to mɛ si kaa kekle ko ɔ.

english_verse: When that happens, all nations on earth will see the good things I have done for Jerusalem, and how I have given it complete peace. The nations will celebrate and praise and honor me, but they will also tremble with fear because of the powerful things I have done.
translation_verse: Yerusalem ma ha nɛ ma na biɛ, yi jemi, kɛ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti, ke je ma amɛ nu ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ i pee ha ma a. Ke je ma amɛ nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a na bɔ nɛ kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ he jɔmi ba ma a mi ɔ, a tsui maa po nɛ a he maa do blibliibli.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, you say that this land is a desert without people or animals, and for now, you are right. The towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem are deserted, and people and animals are nowhere to be seen. But someday you will hear
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nihi deɔ ke hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nga kplanaa nɔ, he nɛ nimli loo lohwehi be. Niinɛ, ke a de ja a, a nɔ́ da. Yuda ma amɛ pee ma dokuhi, nɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ hu a nɔ fɔɔ si gu; nɔmlɔ adesa ko, loo lohwe ko be lejɛ ɔmɛ. Se ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu ɔ, nyɛ maa nu

english_verse: happy voices and the sounds of parties and wedding celebrations. And when people come to my temple to offer sacrifices to thank me, you will hear them say: “We praise you, Lord All-Powerful! You are good to us, and your love never fails.” The land will once again be productive.
translation_verse: bua jɔmi, kɛ lele hwɔmi gbi ekohu. Nyɛ maa nu ayɛflo kɛ e huno a gbi, kɛ la nɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ sina bɔhi kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ lae ke, ‘Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ si, ejakaa Yawɛ hi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa!’ Ma ha nɛ kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ he jɔmi maa ba zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa kekle ko ɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: Now it is empty, without people or animals. But when that time comes, shepherds will take care of their flocks in pastures near every town in the hill country, in the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert, in the land of the Benjamin tribe, and around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord's Wonderful Promise
translation_verse: Ngɛ yo nɔ ma amɛ, kɛ nga nɔ ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yuda leneyi je, Benyamin zugba a nɔ, Yerusalem kɔpe ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi ɔ, to hyɛli maa kane a tohi ekohu. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I made a wonderful promise to Israel and Judah, and the days are coming when I will keep it.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ si nɛ i wo Israel bi, kɛ Yuda bi ɔ, ma ye nɔ.

english_verse: I promise that the time will come when I will appoint a king from the family of David, a king who will be honest and rule with justice.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ma hla dalɔ ko kɛ je David nina a a kpɛti nɛ e ye matsɛ. Matsɛ nɛ ɔ maa ye dami sane, nɛ e maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: In those days, Judah will be safe; Jerusalem will have peace and will be named, “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: E yi nɔ ɔ, a ma he Yuda yi wami, nɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba Israel. Nɛ biɛ nɛ a kɛ ma tsɛ lɛ ji, ‘Yawɛ ji wa dami.’

english_verse: The king of Israel will be one of David's descendants,
translation_verse: Imi, Yawɛ, i ngɛ si woe kaa David nina maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ daa.

english_verse: and there will always be priests from the Levi tribe serving at my altar and offering sacrifices to please me and to give thanks.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, a ma na osɔfohi kɛ maa je Levi wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ osɔfo nɛ ɔmɛ maa sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ, kɛ bɔ kpahi ha mi daa be tsuaa be.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: I, the Lord, have an agreement with day and night, so they always come at the right time. You can't break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: “I kɛ piani kɛ nyɔ so somi, nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, piani kɛ nyɔ baa ngɛ a be mi pɛpɛɛpɛ daa ligbi. Jamɛ a somi ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa po mi.

english_verse: and you can't break the agreements I have made with David's family and with the priests from the Levi tribe who serve at my altar. A descendant of David will always rule as king of Israel,
translation_verse: I kɛ ye tsɔlɔ David so somi kaa e nina maa ye matsɛ daa. Jehanɛ se hu, i kɛ osɔfohi nɛ je Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ hu so kaa a ma sɔmɔ mi daa be tsuaa be. Kikɛmɛ a somi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa po a mi.

english_verse: and there will be more descendants of David and of the priests from the Levi tribe than stars in the sky or grains of sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ ye tsɔlɔ David nina, kɛ osɔfohi nɛ je Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ a he maa hiɛ babauu kaa hiɔwe dodoehi, loo wo nya zia; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane mɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord also said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: You've heard foreigners insult my people by saying, “The Lord chose Israel and Judah, but now he has rejected them, and they are no longer a nation.”
translation_verse: “Tse o nu kaa nihi ngɛ dee ke weku enyɔ, Israel kɛ Yuda nɛ i hla a, imi Yawɛ, i kua mɛ! Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a gbeɔ ye ma a he guɛ, nɛ a bui mɛ hu kaa je ma ko ji mɛ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will never break my agreement with the day and the night or let the sky and the earth stop obeying my commands.
translation_verse: Se imi Yawɛ, i kɛ piani kɛ nyɔ so somi, nɛ i pee mlaahi nɛ yeɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: In the same way, I will never reject the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob or break my promise that they will always have a descendant of David as their king. I will be kind to my people Israel, and they will be successful again.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i nyɛ pee he je ɔ, somi nɛ i kɛ Yakob nina, kɛ ye tsɔlɔ David so ɔ hu ma ye nɔ sisiisi. Ma hla David nina ko nɛ e ye Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a nina a nɔ. Ma na ye ma a mɔbɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ a ma ná a he ekohu.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar had a large army made up of people from every kingdom in his empire. He and his army were attacking Jerusalem and all the nearby towns, when the Lord told me
translation_verse: Benɛ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar kɛ e tabo ɔ, kɛ je mahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e sisi ɔ ba tua Yerusalem kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ, i ná sɛ gbi kɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: to say to King Zedekiah: I am the Lord, and I am going to let Nebuchadnezzar capture this city and burn it down.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ fa mi ke ma ya de Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia ke, “Imi Yawɛ, ma ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ e maa sã ma a.

english_verse: You will be taken prisoner and brought to Nebuchadnezzar, and he will speak with you face to face. Then you will be led away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Mo nitsɛ hu o be o he yee; a maa nu mo kɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ. O maa na lɛ hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, nɛ o kɛ lɛ maa tu munyu; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a maa ngɔ mo kɛ ho Babilonia ya.

english_verse: You will die a peaceful death. People will mourn when you die, and they will light bonfires in your honor, just as they did for your ancestors, the kings who ruled before you.
translation_verse: O ma gbo ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pu o nɛmɛ, nɛ ji matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu a maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha mo. A maa wo yana, nɛ a ma de ke, ‘Nɛnɛ! Due! Due!’ Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: I went to Zedekiah and told him what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia ngɛ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the king of Babylonia was trying to break through the walls of Lachish, Azekah, and Jerusalem, the only three towns of Judah that had not been captured. The People Break a Promise
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ tabo ɔ ya tua ma a momo, nɛ a kɛ Lakish kɛ Azeka hu ngɛ ta hwue. Ma nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ ji Yuda mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ nɛ piɛ. Israel yi somi ɔ nɔ

english_verse: King Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Jerusalem made an agreement to free all Hebrew men and women who were slaves. No Jew would keep another as a slave. And so, all the Jewish slaves were given their freedom.
translation_verse: Ma a, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo kplɛɛ kaa a maa ngmɛɛ a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ye a he, konɛ nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi kó pee nyɔguɛ hu. Niinɛ, a pee ja, nɛ a ha nɛ a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ ye a he.

english_verse: I am the Lord God of Israel, and I made an agreement with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, where they had been slaves.
translation_verse: Israel Mawu ɔ de mi ke ma ya de ma a ke, “Benɛ i ya je nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ i ha nɛ a ye a he kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi ɔ, i kɛ mɛ so somi ko. I de mɛ ke

english_verse: As part of this agreement, you must let a Hebrew slave go free after six years of service. Your ancestors did not obey me,
translation_verse: daa jeha kpaago ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nyɛmi Hebri no nyɔguɛ ko nɛ sɔmɔ lɛ jeha ekpa a, e ha nɛ e ye e he. Se nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bui mi tue fɛɛ, nɛ munyu nɛ i kɛ mɛ tu ɔ hu a ngɔɛ.

english_verse: but you decided to obey me and do the right thing by setting your Hebrew slaves completely free. You even went to my temple, and in my name you made an agreement to set them free. But you have abused my name, because you broke that agreement and forced your former slaves back into slavery.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ kpale nyɛ nya se, nɛ nyɛ pue ye hɛ mi si. Nyɛ nyɔguɛhi, nyumuhi kɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ a ye a he ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya a, nyɛ ya ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ nyɛ ba nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a ba pee nyɛ nyɔguɛhi ekohu.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by not giving your slaves their freedom. So I will give you freedom—the freedom to die in battle or from disease or hunger. I will make you disgusting to all other nations on earth.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ gbo tue; nyɛ ha we nɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ, Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ye a he. Saminya! Imi lɛɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he mɔ! Ma ngmɛɛ nyɛ he kɛ wo gbenɔ dɛ mi, nɛ ta, hiɔ, kɛ hwɔ maa gbe nyɛ. Nɛ ma ha nɛ a gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ tsuo a mi.

english_verse: I will let your enemies take all of you prisoner, including the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the royal officials, the priests, and everyone else who walked between the two parts of the calf. These enemies will kill you and leave your bodies lying on the ground as food for birds and wild animals.
translation_verse: Ma je mɛ kɛ wo a he nyɛli, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ, a dɛ mi. A gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pee lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi a niye ní.

english_verse: These enemies are King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia and his army. They have stopped attacking Jerusalem, but they want to kill King Zedekiah and his high officials. So I will command them to return and attack again. This time they will conquer the city and burn it down, and they will capture Zedekiah and his officials. I will also let them destroy the towns of Judah, so that no one can live there any longer.
translation_verse: Ma fa mɛ, nɛ a maa kpale kɛ ba ma nɛ ɔ mi ekohu. A ma ba tua ma a; a maa ngɔ ma a, nɛ a maa sã ma a. Ma ha nɛ Yuda ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be ma amɛ a mi hie hu. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: When Jehoiakim was king of Judah, the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim, Yosia bi ɔ yi nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: “Go to the Rechabite clan and invite them to meet you in one of the side rooms of the temple. When they arrive, offer them a drink of wine.”
translation_verse: “Yaa Rekab bi ɔmɛ a we ɔ mi nɛ o kɛ mɛ ya tu munyu. Ke o kɛ mɛ tu munyu ɔ gbe nya a, ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ba tsu kake mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ o ba ha mɛ wai nɛ a nu.”

english_verse: So I went to Jaazaniah, the leader of the clan, and I invited him and all the men of his clan.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i ya ngɔ Rekab we ɔ tsuo kɛ ba. Mɛ ji Yaazania, Habazinia bi Yeremia bi ɔ, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: I brought them into the temple courtyard and took them upstairs to a room belonging to the prophets who were followers of Hanan son of Igdaliah. It was next to a room belonging to some of the officials, and that room was over the one belonging to Maaseiah, a priest who was one of the high officials in the temple.
translation_verse: I ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ ba wo gbalɔ Hanan, Igdalia bi ɔ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ mi. Tsu nɛ ɔ ngɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ kasa nya, ngɛ Shalum bi Maaseya tsu ɔ yiti je. Maaseya ji agbo nya bulɔ.

english_verse: I set out some large bowls full of wine together with some cups, and then I said to the Rechabites, “Have some wine!”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i ngɔ buɛhi, kɛ kpluhi nɛ wai hyi mɛ tɔ kɛ ma Rekab bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ i de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ nu dã.”

english_verse: But they answered: No! The ancestor of our clan, Jonadab son of Rechab, made a rule that we must obey. He said, “Don't ever drink wine
translation_verse: Se a he nɔ ke, “Wa be wai nue, ejakaa wa nɛ̃, Yonadab wo wɔ mlaa ke wa ko nu wai ligbi ko ligbi ko, wɔ jio, wa nina jio.

english_verse: or build houses or plant crops and vineyards. Instead, you must always live in tents and move from place to place. If you obey this command, you will live a long time.”
translation_verse: E ke wa ko po we, wa ko du ní, wa ko pee wai ngmɔ, nɛ wa ko hi ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko. E wo wɔ mlaa ke waa hi bo tsu mi wa wami be ɔ tsuo, konɛ wa se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ wa ba to nubwɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Our clan has always obeyed Jonadab's command. To this very day, we and our wives and sons and daughters don't drink wine or build houses or plant vineyards or crops. And we have lived in tents,
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃, wa mɛ wehi nɛ waa hi a mi; bo tsuhi a mi wa ngɛ. Wai ngmɔ, loo zugba, loo blɛfo be wa dɛ. Mlaa nɛ wa nɛ̃, Yonadab wo wɔ ɔ, wa ye lɛ tsuo nɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, want you to learn a lesson
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de mi ke ma ya nɛ ma ya de Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke “Imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ bie ke anɛ nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ maa kase ní lo. Mɛni he je nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ maa bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue?

english_verse: from the Rechabite clan. Their ancestor Jonadab told his descendants never to drink wine, and to this very day they have obeyed him. But I have spoken to you over and over, and you haven't obeyed me!
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ Yonadab, Rekab bi ɔ wo e nina ke a ko nu wai ɔ, a ye nɔ. Nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nui dã. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ kpamisa nɛ ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue, se nyɛ bui mi tue fɛɛ.

english_verse: The Rechabites have obeyed the command of their ancestor Jonadab, but you have not obeyed me,
translation_verse: Yonadab nina ye mlaa nɛ a nɛ̃ wo mɛ ɔ nɔ, se nyɛ ma nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ bui mi tue fɛɛ.

english_verse: your God. I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warned you about the terrible things that would happen to you if you did not listen to me. But you have ignored me, so now disaster will strike you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Makes a Promise to the Rechabites
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, bɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ Yuda ma, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi, ní yayamihi tsuo nɛ i wo si ke e maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ ba nyɛ nɔ jehanɛ. Ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu, se nyɛ nui; i tsɛ nyɛ, se nyɛ he we nɔ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the Rechabite clan: “I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You have obeyed your ancestor Jonadab,
translation_verse: Se Rekab we ɔ lɛɛ i de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mlaa nɛ nyɛ nɛ̃, Yonadab wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ye nɔ; blɔ nyahi tsuo nɛ e to, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ pee pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: so I promise that your clan will be my servants and will never die out.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ si woe kaa nyumu nɛ ma sɔmɔ mi be Yonadab, Rekab bi ɔ we mi tae gblegbleegble.’ ”

english_verse: During the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, the Lord said to me, “Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim yi nɔ jeha eywiɛne ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu nɛ e de ke,

english_verse: since the time Josiah was king, I have been speaking to you about Israel, Judah, and the other nations. Now, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you,
translation_verse: “Yaa hla womi kpo nɛ o ngma níhi tsuo nɛ i de mo nɛ kɔɔ Israel, Yuda, kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a he ɔ kɛ wo mi. Ngmaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de mo kɛ je be nɛ i kɛ mo tu munyu kekleekle ngɛ matsɛ, Yosia yi nɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: then read it to the people of Judah. Maybe they will stop sinning when they hear what terrible things I plan for them. And if they turn back to me, I will forgive them.”
translation_verse: Eko piɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ maa nu kaa i to ye yi mi kaa ma kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ a maa kpale kɛ je a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ. Ke a pee ja a, ma ngɔ a tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ.”

english_verse: I sent for Baruch son of Neriah and asked him to help me. I repeated everything the Lord had told me, and Baruch wrote it all down on a scroll.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i tsɛ Baruk, Neria bi ɔ, nɛ munyuhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu ɔ, i tsɛ ha lɛ, nɛ e ngma kɛ wo womi kpo ko mi.

english_verse: Then I said, Baruch, the officials refuse to let me go into the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i de Baruk ke, “A ha we mi blɔ kaa ma ya Yawɛ we ɔ hu.

english_verse: so you must go instead. Wait for the next holy day when the people of Judah come to the temple to pray and to go without eating. Then take this scroll to the temple and read it aloud.
translation_verse: Se ma suɔ nɛ moo lɛɛ o ya lejɛ ɔ be mi nɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ hwɔ hae. Yaa kane womi kpo ɔ, ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ́ ma a tsuo nɛ nu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de mi, nɛ imi hu i tsɛ ha mo nɛ o ngma a. Kane womi kpo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ Yuda bi nɛ je a ma amɛ a mi kɛ ba a, mɛ hu a nu.

english_verse: The Lord is furious, and if the people hear how he is going to punish them, maybe they will ask to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Alini a maa fa kue ha Yawɛ nɛ a maa kpale kɛ je a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ; ejakaa abofu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ tu munyu kɛ si ma nɛ ɔ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.”

english_verse: In the ninth month of the fifth year that Jehoiakim was king, the leaders set a day when everyone who lived in Jerusalem or who was visiting there had to pray and go without eating. So Baruch took the scroll to the upper courtyard of the temple. He went over to the side of the courtyard and stood in a covered area near New Gate, where he read the scroll aloud. This covered area belonged to Gemariah, one of the king's highest officials.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Baruk kane nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ kɛ ha ma a tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi kpo ɔ mi ɔ. E kane womi kpo nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, ngɛ Gemaria, Shafan bi ɔ tsu ɔ mi. Gemaria nɛ ɔ ji matsɛ pɛdiyo, nɛ e tsu ɔ ngɛ yiti je kue ɔ mi, ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ agbo he ɔ sinya a nya. A kane womi kpo ɔ kɛ ha ma nimeli ɔmɛ

english_verse: Gemariah's son Micaiah was there and heard Baruch read what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mikaya, Shafan bi Gemaria bi ɔ nu níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ de, kaa bɔ nɛ a kane kɛ je womi kpo ɔ mi ɔ,

english_verse: When Baruch finished reading, Micaiah went down to the palace. His father Gemariah was in the officials' room, meeting with the rest of the king's officials, including Elishama, Delaiah, Elnathan, and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: e pue nɔ kɛ ho matsɛ we ɔ mi ya, nɛ e ya na ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a bua a he nya ngɛ matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ tsu ɔ mi. Nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ji Elishama, matsɛ pɛdiyo; Delaya, Shemaya bi ɔ; Elnatan, Akbor bi ɔ; Gemaria, Shafan bi ɔ; Zedekia, Hanania bi ɔ, kɛ ma nimeli kpa amɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Micaiah told them what he had heard Baruch read to the people.
translation_verse: Mikaya bɔ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e nu nɛ Baruk kane kɛ je womi kpo ɔ mi kɛ ha ma a.

english_verse: Then the officials sent Jehudi and Shelemiah to tell Baruch, “Bring us that scroll.” When Baruch arrived with the scroll,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo tsɔ Yehudi ke e ya de Baruk nɛ e ngɔ womi kpo ɔ nɛ e kane kɛ ha ma a kɛ ba. Nɛ Neria bi Baruk hɛɛ womi ɔ kɛ ba. .

english_verse: the officials said, “Please sit down and read it to us,” which he did.
translation_verse: Benɛ Baruk ba a, a de lɛ ke, “Hii si, nɛ o kane womi ɔ nɛ waa nu.” Nɛ Baruk pee ja.

english_verse: After they heard what was written on the scroll, they were worried and said to each other, “The king needs to hear this!” Turning to Baruch, they asked,
translation_verse: Benɛ a nu munyu ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, a tsui po. Mɛ tsuo a plɛ hyɛ a sibi a hɛ mi, nɛ a de Baruk ke, “E hia kaa wa ya sɛɛ ní nɛ ɔ ha matsɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The officials put the scroll in Elishama's room and went to see the king, who was in one of the rooms where he lived and worked during the winter. It was the ninth month of the year, so there was a fire burning in the fireplace, and the king was sitting nearby. After the officials told the king about the scroll, he sent Jehudi to get it. Then Jehudi started reading the scroll to the king and his officials.
translation_verse: Nyɔhiɔ nɛɛne, loo fĩɛ be ji jamɛ a be ɔ nɛ; nɛ matsɛ ɔ hii si ngɛ tsu nɛ e yeɔ fĩɛ be ngɛ mi ɔ mi, nɛ ngɛyu kɛ e mi la nɛ tsɛ̃ maa si ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: The king told his son Jerahmeel to take Seraiah and Shelemiah and to go arrest Baruch and me. But the Lord kept them from finding us. Jeremiah's Second Scroll
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa matsɛbinyumu Yerameel, kɛ Seraya, Azriel bi ɔ, kɛ Shelemia, Abdeel bi ɔ ke a nu imi, kɛ ye womi ngmalɔ Baruk ɔ tsuo. Se Yawɛ ngɔ wɔ kɛ laa. Yeremia ngma womi kpo ehe

english_verse: I had told Baruch what to write on that first scroll, but King Jehoiakim had burned it. So the Lord told me
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Yehoyakim sã womi kpo ɔ nɛ i tsɛ munyu ɔmɛ kɛ ha Baruk nɛ e ngma wo mi ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke

english_verse: to get another scroll and write down everything that had been on the first one.
translation_verse: ma kɛ̃ womi kpo kpa, konɛ níhi tsuo nɛ i ngma kɛ wo kekle womi kpo ɔ mi ɔ, ma ngma kɛ wo enɛ ɔ hu mi.

english_verse: Then he told me to say to King Jehoiakim: Not only did you burn Jeremiah's scroll, you had the nerve to ask why he had written that the king of Babylonia would attack and ruin the land, killing all the people and even the animals.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke ma de Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim ke, “O sã womi kpo ɔ, nɛ o bi Yeremia ke mɛni he je e ngma ke Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma ba kpata zugba nɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e maa gbe e mi nimli, kɛ lohwehi tsuo lo.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, promise that you will be killed and your body thrown out on the ground. The sun will beat down on it during the day, and the frost will settle on it at night. And none of your descendants will ever be king of Judah.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo, Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘O nina ko nina ko be Matsɛ David sɛ ɔ nɔ hie gblegbleegble. Ke o gbo ɔ, a ma sake o gbogboe ɔ kɛ fɔ he; piani ɔ, pu maa tsoo lɛ, nɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, kɔɔhiɔ nɛ mi jɔ yluduu maa fia lɛ.

english_verse: You, your children, and your servants are evil, and I will punish everyone of you. I warned you and the people of Judah and Jerusalem that I would bring disaster, but none of you have listened. So now you are doomed!
translation_verse: Ma gbla mo, kɛ o nina, kɛ o ma nimeli ɔmɛ a tue ngɛ nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ a he. Mo jio, Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ jio, Yuda bi ɔmɛ jio, nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko bui ye kɔkɔ bɔmi munyu ɔmɛ tue fɛɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ní yayamihi nɛ i to kaa a maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ ma ha nɛ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ maa ba nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nɔ.’ ”

english_verse: After the Lord finished speaking to me, I got another scroll and gave it to Baruch. Then I told him what to write, so this second scroll would contain even more than was on the scroll Jehoiakim had burned.
