english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at his command. He makes clouds appear; he sends the wind from his storehouse and makes lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Ke e wo gbi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ keɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; Yawɛ haa nɛ afua teɔ si kɛ jeɔ zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ. E haa oslabai gbaa, be mi nɛ hiɔmi ngɛ nɛe, nɛ e jeɔ kɔɔhiɔ kpo kɛ jeɔ e nito he ɔ.

english_verse: God used his wisdom and power to create the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lɛ bɔ je ɔ ngɛ e he wami nya. Nile lɛ e kɛ bɔ je ɔ, nɛ jamɛ a nile ɔ nɔuu e kɛ bli hiɔwe mi.

english_verse: But the Lord, Israel's God, is all-powerful. He created everything, and he chose Israel to be his very own. God's Hammer The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yakob Mawu ɔ be kaa mɛ; lɛ ji nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e hla Israel kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma. E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ. Yawɛ hamle ɔ

english_verse: Babylonia, you were my hammer; I used you to pound nations and break kingdoms,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Babilonia, ye hamle ji mo; o ngɛ kaa ye ta hwumi ní. I ngɔ mo kɛ kpata je mahi, kɛ matsɛ yemihi a hɛ mi.

english_verse: as well as men and women, young and old,
translation_verse: I ngɔ mo kɛ gbe nyumuhi kɛ yihi, nikɔtɔmahi kɛ jokuɛwi, nihewi kɛ yihewi.

english_verse: But now, my people will watch, while I repay you for what you did to Zion.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Yayamihi tsuo nɛ Babilonia kɛ Babilonia ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee Yerusalem he je ɔ, ma gbla a tue nɛ nyɛ maa na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ.

english_verse: You destroyed the nations and seem strong as a mountain, but I am your enemy. I might even grab you and roll you off a cliff. When I am finished, you'll only be a pile of scorched bricks.
translation_verse: Mo Babilonia nɛ o ngɛ kaa yoku, nɛ o ngɛ je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi kpatae, i kɛ mo na! Ma nu mo, nɛ ma kpɛne mo kɛ je tɛ sa amɛ a nɔ ba ko si, nɛ o maa pee kaa yo nɛ sã.

english_verse: Your stone blocks won't be reused for cornerstones or foundations, and I promise that forever you will be a desert. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Nations Will Attack Babylon The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tɛhi nɛ maa je o mi ɔ, a be eko ngɔe kɛ ma tsu; a kɛ be kɔ nya tɛ, loo tsu sisi tomi tɛ pee. Mohu ɔ, o maa pee kaa zugba kplanaa kɛ ya neneene. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: Signal the nations to get ready to attack. Raise a flag and blow a trumpet. Send for the armies of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Choose a commander; let the cavalry attack like a swarm of locusts.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ si aflaangaa. Nyɛ kpa titimati nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a nu! Nyɛ ha nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a mia, nɛ a kɛ Babilonia ya hwu ta! Nyɛ de Ararat, Mini, kɛ Ashkenaz matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ ke a ya tua Babilonia. Nyɛ hla tatsɛ nɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi. Nyɛɛ ngɔ okpɔngɔhi babauu kaa baalɛhi kɛ ba.

english_verse: Tell the kings and governors, the leaders and the people of the kingdoms of the Medes to prepare for war!
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a mia, nɛ a kɛ Babilonia ya hwu ta. Nyɛ ya kpee Media matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, a we amlaalo ɔmɛ, ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ a nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba.

english_verse: The earth twists and turns in torment, because I have decided to make Babylonia a desert where no one can live, and I won't change my mind.
translation_verse: Yawɛ to e yi mi kaa e ma ha nɛ Babilonia zugba a maa pee kaa nga kplanaa nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ hie. Yawɛ yi mi tomi nɛ ɔ ba mi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, zugba ngɛ mimiɛe, nɛ e ngɛ hosoe.

english_verse: The Babylonian soldiers have lost their strength and courage. They stay in their fortresses, unable to fight, while the enemy breaks through the city gates, then sets their homes on fire.
translation_verse: Babilonia ta buli ɔmɛ kpa ta hwumi, nɛ a hii si ngɛ a mɔ ɔmɛ a mi. A kɔni mi jɔ̃, nɛ a pee kaa yihi. Babilonia agbo ɔmɛ ku kɛ pueɔ si, nɛ we ɔmɛ sã.

english_verse: One messenger after another announces to the king, “Babylon has been captured!
translation_verse: Tsɔli babauu ngɛ fo nɔ kɛ yaa nɛ a ya bɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ ke he nyɛli ba ngɔ e ma a tsuo.

english_verse: The enemy now controls the river crossings! The marshes are on fire! Your army has panicked!”
translation_verse: A ngɔ pa pomi he ɔmɛ, a mɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la, nɛ sawale nu Babilonia ta buli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I make this promise— “Soon Babylon will be leveled and packed down like a threshing place at harvest time.” Babylonia Will Pay!
translation_verse: E be kɛe kulaa nɛ a maa poo a mi ngɔ pue si kaa blɛfo ngɛ ngma mi sami he. Imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem say, “King Nebuchadnezzar made us panic. That monster stuffed himself with us and our treasures, leaving us empty— he gobbled up what he wanted and spit out the rest.
translation_verse: Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar poo Yerusalem mi nɛ e ye. E muɔ níhi kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ ma a fɔɔ si kaa buɛ mi gu. E mi ma a kaa bɔ nɛ sinɔ ngua miɔ nɔ́ ɔ. E ye ma a mi ní kpakpa amɛ, nɛ e sake nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue he.

english_verse: My people, I am on your side, and I will take revenge on Babylon. I will cut off its water supply, and its stream will dry up.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ye nyɛ sane ɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ ma gbla nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue ha nyɛ. Ma ha nɛ Babilonia wo ɔ, kɛ pa amɛ ma gbli.

english_verse: The Babylonians roar and growl like young lions.
translation_verse: Babilonia bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa hi huãe kaa jata; a maa hi pɛe kaa jata bimɛ.

english_verse: And since they are hungry, I will give them a banquet. They will celebrate, get drunk, then fall asleep, never to wake up!
translation_verse: Ke a he mi akɔnɔ te si ɔ, ma tsɛ mɛ ní yemi; ma ha mɛ dã nɛ a nu nɛ a de. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa sɛ mahe vii mi, nɛ a be si tee hu.

english_verse: I will lead them away to die, like sheep, lambs, and goats being led to the butcher.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho nɛ a ya gbe mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a gbeɔ jijɔ, loo apletsi, loo agbosu. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Babilon hɛ mi kpata

english_verse: Babylon's enemies will rise like ocean waves and flood the city.
translation_verse: Wo ɔ te si kɛ wo Babilon, nɛ wo oslɔke ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ ha e nɔ.

english_verse: Horrible destruction will strike the nearby towns. The land will become a barren desert, where no one can live or even travel.
translation_verse: Babilon ma amɛ plɛ pee níhi nɛ a hiee; zugba a pee kaa nga kplanaa nɛ nyu be nɔ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hu ba bi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I will punish Marduk, the god of Babylon, and make him vomit out everything he gobbled up. Then nations will no longer bring him gifts, and Babylon's walls will crumble. The Lord Offers Hope to His People
translation_verse: Ma gbla Babilonia mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Bel ɔ tue, nɛ ma je e ju ní ɔmɛ kpo; je ma amɛ be lɛ jae hu. “Babilon gbogbo ɔmɛ ku kɛ pueɔ si.

english_verse: Get out of Babylon, my people, and run for your lives, before I strike the city in my anger!
translation_verse: Ye ma, Israel, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ! Nyɛɛ tu ye mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a nya fo, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he e yi wami.

english_verse: The time will come when I will punish Babylon's false gods. Everyone there will die, and the whole nation will be disgraced,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be ma nɛ i kɛ Babilonia amaga amɛ maa to ní. Babilonia zugba a tsuo hɛ mi ma pue si, nɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: when an army attacks from the north and brings destruction. Then the earth and the heavens and everything in them will celebrate.
translation_verse: Nihi maa je omleyi je kɛ ba kpata Babilonia hɛ mi. Jamɛ a be ɔ, níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ma hwɔ lele.

english_verse: My people, you escaped death when Jerusalem fell. Now you live far from home, but you should trust me and think about Jerusalem. Leave Babylon! Don't stay!
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma a nɛ ngɛ Babilonia a, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ je klaate nya! Nyɛɛ ho esɔesɔ! Nyɛ ko to tsle! Nyɛɛ kɛ we he kɛ mohu lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ susu imi Yawɛ, ye he; nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je Yerusalem nɔ.

english_verse: Although Babylon's walls reach to the sky, the army I send will destroy that city. I, the Lord, have spoken. Babylon Will Be Destroyed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ke Babilon kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya nɛ e ya ma mɔ nɛ he wa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tete po, ma tsɔ nihi kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ya kpata e hɛ mi. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Babilon hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ

english_verse: Listen to the cries for help coming from Babylon. Everywhere in the country the sounds of destruction can be heard.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue! Ngmlaa nɛ nya wa ngɛ pɛe ngɛ Babilon. A wo yana boboobo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa zugba a hɛ mi kpata!

english_verse: An enemy will attack and destroy Babylon. Its soldiers will be captured and their weapons broken, because I am a God who takes revenge against nations for what they do.
translation_verse: A ba kpata Babilon hɛ mi; a nuu Babilon ta buli ɔmɛ, nɛ a ku a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ. Mawu nɛ woɔ yayami he hiɔ ji mi, ma gbla Babilon tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the true King, promise that the officials and advisors, the governors and leaders, and the soldiers of Babylon will get drunk, fall asleep, and never wake up.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ a ma nimeli ɔmɛ, ní leli ɔmɛ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ maa tɔ dã. Ke a hwɔ si ɔ, a be si tee hu. Imi, matsɛ ɔ lɛ i de. Ye biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.

english_verse: The thick walls of that city will be torn down, and its huge gates burned. Everything that nation worked so hard to gain will go up in smoke. Jeremiah Gives Seraiah a Scroll
translation_verse: A maa hule Babilonia gbogbohi kɛ a hɛ mi gbajagbajaa a ngɔ pue si, nɛ a maa mɛ agbo gagaaga amɛ a he la. Je ma amɛ tsu yaka ní pɛ; a gbo dengme kɛ ha la nɛ e ba sã. Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.” Yeremia ngɔ sɛ gbi kɛ mane Babilonia

english_verse: During Zedekiah's fourth year as king of Judah, he went to Babylon. And Baruch's brother Seraiah went along as the officer in charge of arranging for places to stay overnight.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Zedekia tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔkɔtɔma kake ji Neria bi Seraya, Maseya bibi ɔ. Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia yi nɔ jeha eywiɛne ɔ, benɛ lɛ Zedekia a yaa Babilonia a, Seraya kɛ lɛ ya. I ngɔ sɛ gbi kɛ ha Seraya kɛ ho.

english_verse: Before they left, I wrote on a scroll all the terrible things that would happen to Babylon.
translation_verse: I ngma amanehlu tsuo nɛ maa ba Babilonia nɔ, kɛ ní kpahi tsuo nɛ kɔɔ Babilonia he kɛ wo womi mi.

english_verse: I gave the scroll to Seraiah and said: When you get to Babylon, read this scroll aloud,
translation_verse: I de Seraya ke, “Ke o su Babilon ɔ, moo kane níhi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ ha ma a.

english_verse: then pray, “Our Lord, you promised to destroy this place and make it into a desert where no people or animals will ever live.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo sɔle nɛ o de ke, ‘Yawɛ, o de ke o ma kpata hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ nɔmlɔ, loo lohwe be hiɛ ɔ hie hu. O de ke hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee ma doku kɛ ya neneene.’

english_verse: When you finish praying, tie the scroll to a rock and throw it in the Euphrates River. Then say,
translation_verse: Seraya, ke o kane womi nɛ ɔ gbe nya a, o fi tɛ kɛ wo he, nɛ o ya sake kɛ fɔ Yufrate pa a mi,

english_verse: “This is how Babylon will sink when the Lord destroys it. Everyone in the city will die, and it won't have the strength to rise again.” The End of Jeremiah's Writing Jeremiah's writing ends here.
translation_verse: nɛ o de ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ Babilonia ma mu kɛ ya nyu sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Babilonia ma mu, nɛ e be hiae hu, ejakaa Yawɛ ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.’ ” Yeremia sɛ gbi ɔ nya ta ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials.
translation_verse: Nebuzaradan, tatsɛ ɔ ngɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Seraya e se yelɔ, osɔfo Zefania, kɛ Yawɛ we buli etɛ ɔmɛ hu nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: then his eyes were poked out. He was put in chains, then dragged off to Babylon and kept in prison until he died.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ta Zedekia hɛngmɛhi; e bɔ lɛ pã, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Babilon, nɛ e ya wo lɛ tsu. Zedekia hi tsu ɔ mi kɛ ya si e gbenɔ ligbi. A puɛ Yawɛ we ɔ (Matsɛmɛ II,

english_verse: meters around. They were hollow, but the bronze was about
translation_verse: A sa ma a yi hluu kɛ ya si Matsɛ Zedekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ.

english_verse: After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month,
translation_verse: Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ, benɛ hwɔ ɔ nya ba wa, nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ na we ní nɛ a ye ɔ,

english_verse: the Babylonian troops broke through the city wall. That same night, Zedekiah and his soldiers tried to escape through the gate near the royal garden, even though they knew the enemy had the city surrounded. They headed toward the Jordan River valley,
translation_verse: a hule gbogbo ɔ nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia bi ɔmɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe mohu, se matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo nyɔ ɔ mi. A gu matsɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi kɛ ya be ngɛ agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ mi, nɛ a ngɔ a yi ngɔ ka Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi blɔ.

english_verse: Zedekiah was taken to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty.
translation_verse: A ngɔ Zedekia ya ha Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɛ Ribla, ngɛ Hamat zugba a nɔ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ Nebukadnezar kojo lɛ nɛ e bu lɛ fɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: Zedekiah's sons and the officials of Judah were killed while he watched,
translation_verse: Nebukadnezar gbe Zedekia binyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ Zedekia hɛ mi ngɛ Ribla. E gbe Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo hulɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem was captured during Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king of Babylonia. About a month later, Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guards arrived in Jerusalem. His name was Nebuzaradan,
translation_verse: Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ nɛɛ ɔ mi, nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a nɔ ɔ, Nebukadnezar tatsɛ, kɛ tsɔlɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nebuzaradan ɔ ya Yerusalem.

english_verse: and he burned down the Lord's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses.
translation_verse: E sã Yawɛ we ɔ, matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ ni nguahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a wehi,

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: nɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ hule gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ.

english_verse: He led away the people left in the city, including everyone who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar, the rest of the skilled workers, and even some of the poor people of Judah.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ku nigii kɛ ho Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya, kɛ ga ní tsuli nɛ piɛ ɔ, Nebuzaradan ngɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho Babilonia ya.

english_verse: people. So, Nebuchadnezzar took a total of
translation_verse: nyɔguɛ kɛ ho. Ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji

english_verse: Evil Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: Evilmerodak kɛ Yehoyakin hi si saminya, nɛ e ha lɛ blɔ nya nɛ pe bɔ nɛ e pee matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ nɛ e ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ piɛ e he ngɛ Babilonia a.

english_verse: Jehoiachin was allowed to wear regular clothes instead of a prison uniform, and he even ate at the king's table every day.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ngmɛ Yehoyakin blɔ nɛ e je pã mi tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he ngɔ pue si, nɛ e ya yeɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ okplɔɔ he daa ligbi kɛ ya si e gbenɔ be.

english_verse: As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ se hu, matsɛ ɔ haa lɛ yemi kɛ buami sika ko daa ligbi kɛ ya si e gbenɔ be.

english_verse: Jerusalem, once so crowded, lies deserted and lonely. This city that was known all over the world is now like a widow. This queen of the nations has been made a slave.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, ma nɛ sa be ko ɔ, nihi babauu ngɛ mi ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ e mi je gu kɛ fɔɔ si ha! Be ko nɛ be ɔ, je ma amɛ buu lɛ ma nguaa, se jehanɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa yalɔyo. Ma nɛ ngɛ kaa matsɛ biyo ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ ba plɛ pee je ma amɛ a nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: Each night, bitter tears flood her cheeks. None of her former lovers are there to offer comfort; her friends have betrayed her and are now her enemies.
translation_verse: Ya sɔuu e ngɛ foe nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ tsuo; nɛ vo nyu ngɛ e hɛngmɛ mi jee kɛ ngɛ si kplee. E suɔli ɔmɛ hu a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa jɔɔ e bua. E huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kpa ngɛ e se, nɛ a ba pee e he nyɛli.

english_verse: The roads to Zion mourn because no one travels there to celebrate the festivals. The city gates are deserted; priests are weeping. Young women are raped; Zion is in sorrow!
translation_verse: Zion blɔ ɔ nɔ pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ. Nimli a nane po ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ; a bɛ nɛ a ba ye nyami be ɔmɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko ba gui ma a agbo ɔmɛ a mi. Osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe. Yihewi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae. Zion hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: Enemies now rule the city and live as they please. The Lord has punished Jerusalem because of her awful sins; he has let her people be dragged away.
translation_verse: E he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye kunimi; a nine su e nɔ jehanɛ. Yawɛ lɛ ha nɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ yayami babauu nɛ e pee ɔ he. E he nyɛli ɔmɛ nuu e bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared. Her leaders are like deer that cannot find pasture; they are hunted down till their strength is gone.
translation_verse: Yerusalem he fɛu ɔ pee kaa blema nɔ́ ko nɛ be kɛkɛ. E ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa batslɔɔhi nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee, nɛ a pee wudɔwudɔ kɛ ngɛ fo tue ngɛ de dali a nya.

english_verse: Her people recall the good life that once was theirs; now they suffer and are scattered. No one was there to protect them from their enemies who sneered when their city was taken.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yerusalem ngɛ nɔ́ nae wawɛɛ ngɛ ma se ɔ, e kai e blema si himi, kɛ ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ e ná a. Benɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nine su e nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko ba ji ngmlaa ha lɛ. He nyɛli ɔmɛ ye e he fɛu, nɛ a bɔ lɛ ahlua ngɛ si nɛ e nɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: Jerusalem's horrible sins have made the city a joke. Those who once admired her now hate her instead— she has been disgraced; she groans and turns away.
translation_verse: Yerusalem pee yayami wawɛɛ kɛ pue e hɛ mi si. E pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ hɛɛ e he gu; nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ e he akɔtaa a bui lɛ hu. Ee, e ngɛ kɛmɛe, nɛ e ngɛ e hɛ mi laae.

english_verse: Her sins had made her filthy, but she wasn't worried about what could happen. And when Jerusalem fell, it was so tragic. No one gave her comfort when she cried out, “Help! I'm in trouble, Lord! The enemy has won.”
translation_verse: Yerusalem he yayami ɔ ngɛ fu jee gbɛɛ; se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma e nɔ ɔ pee we lɛ kɔmɔ ko kulaa. E si nɔmi ɔ nya wa; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa wo lɛ bua. E jé ngmlaa ke, “Ao! Yawɛ, moo hyɛ nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye kunimi!”

english_verse: Everyone in the city groans while searching for food; they trade their valuables for barely enough scraps to stay alive. Jerusalem Speaks: Jerusalem shouts to the Lord, “Please look and see how miserable I am!”
translation_verse: E we bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe kɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko hlae nɛ a ye. A ngɔ a juetli ɔmɛ kɛ tsake niye ní, konɛ a yi nɛ na wami. Ma a ngɛ kue fae ke, “Yawɛ, moo hyɛ nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa ye he guɛ gbo!”

english_verse: From heaven you sent a fire that burned in my bones; you set a trap for my feet and made me turn back. All day long you leave me in shock from constant pain.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ ha la je hiɔwe ba sɛ ye wuhi a mi. E tsɔ mi klama, nɛ e ha i nɔ si; kɛkɛ nɛ e kua mi, nɛ i ngɛ aywilɛho yee daa.

english_verse: You have tied my sins around my neck, and they weigh so heavily that my strength is gone. You have put me in the power of enemies too strong for me.
translation_verse: “E ngɔ ye he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ to, nɛ e fi kaa tlomi; kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ tloo mi. E jiɔ tsɔ ha mi; e ngɛ mi gbee! Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ wo he nyɛli nɛ a he wa pe mi a dɛ mi, nɛ peepee ko kulaa be ye he.

english_verse: You, Lord, have turned back my warriors and crushed my young heroes. Judah was a woman untouched, but you let her be trampled like grapes in a wine pit.
translation_verse: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kua ye ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ. E tsɔ tabo ko kɛ ba nɛ a ba kpata ye nihewi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ naa Yuda nɛ ngɛ kaa yomiyo ɔ nɔ kaa a ngaa wai ngɛ wai muɔ mi.

english_verse: Because of this, I mourn, and tears flood my eyes. No one is here to comfort or to encourage me; we have lost the war— my people are suffering. The Prophet Speaks:
translation_verse: “Enɛ ɔ he i wo yana, nɛ vo nyu ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi jee kɛ ngɛ si puee. I be bua wolɔ ko nɛ maa wo mi he wami. Peepee ta ye bimɛ ɔmɛ a he, ejakaa he nyɛlɔ ɔ ye ye nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: Zion reaches out her hands, but no one offers comfort. The Lord has turned the neighboring nations against Jacob's descendants. Jerusalem is merely a filthy rag to her neighbors. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: “Imi Zion, i wo ye nine nɔ, konɛ a ye bua mi, se balɔ ko ba ji ngmlaa ha mi. Yawɛ ha nɛ mahi nɛ bɔle imi Yakob, ba pee ye he nyɛli. Yerusalem ba pee nɔ́ nɛ a hiee.

english_verse: The Lord was right, but I refused to obey him. Now I ask all of you to look at my sufferings— even my young people have been dragged away.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ nɔ́ da. Ejakaa imi lɛ i tsɔ atuã, nɛ i bui e munyu ɔ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ nihi tsuo nyɛɛ bu mi tue, konɛ amanehlu nɛ ba ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ na. A nuu ye nihewi ɔmɛ, kɛ yihewi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.

english_verse: Won't you look and see how upset I am, our Lord? My stomach is in knots, and my heart is broken because I betrayed you. In the streets and at home, my people are slaughtered.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ lee, hyɛ bɔ nɛ i ngɛ haoe ha; i ngɛ he hiami mi wawɛɛ, nɛ ye tsui ngɛ mi yee. I tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã. A ngɛ nihi gbee ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; jã kɛ̃ nihi ngɛ gboe ngɛ we ɔmɛ a mi hulɔ.

english_verse: Everyone heard my groaning, but no one offered comfort. My enemies know of the trouble that you have brought on me, and it makes them glad. Hurry and punish them, as you have promised.
translation_verse: “Bu ye kɛmɛmi ɔ tue; nɔ ko be nɛ maa jɔɔ ye bua. Haomi nɛ ba ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nu he, nɛ a bua jɔ kaa o ha sane nɛ ɔ ba ye nɔ. Ligbi nɛ o to ha he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, ha nɛ e ba esɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a pee kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't let their evil deeds escape your sight. Punish them as much as you have punished me because of my sins. I never stop groaning— I've lost all hope!
translation_verse: “Yayami tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ to ní ngɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ o pee imi hu ngɛ ye yayami ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ. Ye kɛmɛmi ɔ nya ba wa tsɔ, nɛ ye he wami ta.”

english_verse: The Lord was angry! So he disgraced Zion though it was Israel's pride and his own place of rest. In his anger he threw Zion down from heaven to earth.
translation_verse: Benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi wo la a, e ha nɛ bɔku ha Zion nɔ. E kpɔ́ Israel he fɛu ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba pue zugba. Ligbi ɔ nɛ e mi mi fu ɔ, e kua lɛ nitsɛ e we pohu.

english_verse: The Lord had no mercy! He destroyed the homes of Jacob's descendants. In his anger he tore down every walled city in Judah; he toppled the nation together with its leaders, leaving them in shame.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpata Israel ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nɛ e nɛ mɔbɔ kulaa. E ngɔ e mi mi la a kɛ ywia Yuda ma a nya mɔ ngua amɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si. E ha zo gbe nɔ yemi ɔ, kɛ e mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was so furiously angry that he wiped out the whole army of Israel by not supporting them when the enemy attacked. He was like a raging fire that swallowed up the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Benɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba tua wɔ ɔ, e piɛ we wa he, mohu ɔ, e kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ nya wa ku Israel he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya la. E gli kɛ wo wɔ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam kɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi kpatae.

english_verse: He attacked like an enemy with a bow and arrows, killing our loved ones. He has burned to the ground the homes on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: E ngɔ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ka wɔ kaa wa he nyɛlɔ. E gbe wa suɔli kpakpa amɛ tsuo. E kɛ e mi mi la nɛ nya wa kaa la a kple Yerusalem nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was like an enemy! He left Israel in ruins with its palaces and fortresses destroyed, and with everyone in Judah moaning and weeping.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpata Israel hɛ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ e he nyɛlɔ ji lɛ. E ywia e mɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si. E ha nɛ Yuda ma a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee babauu.

english_verse: He shattered his temple like a hut in a garden; he completely wiped out his meeting place, and did away with festivals and Sabbaths in the city of Zion. In his fierce anger he rejected our king and priests.
translation_verse: Mawu we ɔ, he nɛ wa jaa lɛ ngɛ ɔ, e ywia lɛ dukuduku ngɔ pue si. E gu nyami be ɔmɛ, kɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Abofu nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ sa matsɛmɛ, kɛ osɔfohi tsuo a he.

english_verse: The Lord abandoned his altar and his temple; he let Zion's enemies capture her fortresses. Noisy shouts were heard from the temple, as if it were a time of celebration.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sume e bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hu, nɛ e kua sɔlemi we ɔ. E ha he nyɛli ku mɔ ɔmɛ kɛ pue si. A hwɔ lele ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ wa peeɔ ke wa ngɛ nyami ligbi yee ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord had decided to tear down the walls of Zion stone by stone. So he started destroying and did not stop until walls and fortresses mourned and trembled.
translation_verse: Yawɛ to e yi mi kaa a ku Zion gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si. E susu a kami kɛ blimi kɛ to, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpata nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, mɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ tsuo ku kɛ pueɔ si.

english_verse: Zion's gates have fallen facedown on the ground; the bars that locked the gates are smashed to pieces. Her king and royal family are prisoners in foreign lands. Her priests don't teach, and her prophets don't have a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Zu ha agbo ɔmɛ a nɔ; a ku a se lami ní ɔmɛ a mi dukuduku. A nuu matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se ya. Nɔ ko tsɔɔ we mlaa a hu. Yawɛ je we nina kɛ ha we gbali ɔmɛ hu.

english_verse: Zion's leaders are silent. They just sit on the ground, tossing dirt on their heads and wearing sackcloth. Her young women can do nothing but stare at the ground.
translation_verse: Yerusalem nimeli ɔmɛ hii si dii ngɛ zugba. A ngɔ bunyuku ngɔ pue a yi mi, nɛ a ha kpekpe ya bo kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a pia a he. Yihewi ɔmɛ ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ bu si.

english_verse: My eyes are red from crying, my stomach is in knots, and I feel sick all over. My people are being wiped out, and children lie helpless in the streets of the city.
translation_verse: I fo ya hluu, nɛ ye hɛngmɛ tsuo fuu. I ngɛ he hiami mi wawɛɛ. Ye tsui ngɛ mi yee, ejakaa a ywia ye we bi ɔmɛ a ma a. Jokuɛwi kɛ bimwɔwi ngɛ hɛlie ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ma a mi.

english_verse: A child begs its mother for food and drink, then blacks out like a wounded soldier lying in the street. The child slowly dies in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ awe nyae, nɛ a ngɛ a nyɛmɛ bie ke, “Jije wa ma na abolo ngɛ; jije wa ma na wai ngɛ ɔ” ɔ, a hɛliɔ kaa nihi nɛ plaa ngɛ ma a mi gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ a gboɔ ngɛ a nyɛmɛ a gugue mi.

english_verse: Zion, how can I comfort you? How great is your pain? Lovely city of Jerusalem, how can I heal your wounds, gaping as wide as the sea?
translation_verse: Yerusalem, i suɔ mo! Yerusalem, mɛni ma de ha mo? Kɛ ma pee kɛ jɔɔ o bua kɛɛ? Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ́ amanehlu hyɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ ba o nɔ nɛ ɔ. O haomi ɔ kle tsɔ, nɛ e nyagbe be. Mɛnɔ ma he o yi wami?

english_verse: Your prophets deceived you with false visions and lying messages— they should have warned you to leave your sins and be saved from disaster.
translation_verse: O gbali ɔmɛ be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nɛ a ma de mo; lakpa pɛ a yeɔ mo. A fiɛɔ kɛ sisiɔ mo. A je we o tɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo. A ha nɛ o susu kaa e hia we nɛ o tsake o tsui.

english_verse: Those who pass by shake their heads and sneer as they make fun and shout, “What a lovely city you were, the happiest on earth, but look at you now!”
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ ba guu ma a nya kɛ bee ɔ, hwɔɔ o yi; a huanyaa a yi, nɛ a yeɔ o he fɛu. A deɔ ke, “Jamɛ a ma kɛ e he fɛu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ? Je ɔ tsuo fiami nɔ́ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?”

english_verse: Zion, your enemies curse you and snarl like wild animals, while shouting, “This is the day we've waited for! At last, we've got you!”
translation_verse: O he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ mo sie; a kɛ ninyɛ hyɛɛ mo gãã. A kpɔɔ nya kɛ woɔ mo. A deɔ ke, “E tsɔɔ mo! Mwɔnɛ ji mwɔnɛ! Wa nine su o nɔ jehanɛ!”

english_verse: Zion, deep in your heart you cried out to the Lord. Now let your tears overflow your walls day and night. Don't ever lose hope or let your tears stop.
translation_verse: Yerusalem lee, moo fa kue boboobo nɛ o tsɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ! Ha nɛ o vo nyu ɔmɛ nɛ a hi bee kaa pa nyɔ kɛ pia. Koo jɔɔ ya fomi, nɛ ko kpa kɔmɔ yemi hulɔ.

english_verse: Get up and pray for help all through the night. Pour out your feelings to the Lord, as you would pour water out of a jug. Beg him to save your people, who are starving to death at every street crossing. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Tee si nɛ o nya awe nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Moo fa kue ha lɛ kɛ o tsui tsuo, nɛ o kpa lɛ pɛɛ nɛ e na o bimɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ. Hyɛ kaa hwɔ ngɛ jokuɛwi gbee ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: Think about it, Lord! Have you ever been this cruel to anyone before? Is it right for mothers to eat their children, or for priests and prophets to be killed in your temple?
translation_verse: Yawɛ lee, hyɛ koo! Moo hyɛ nihi nɛ o ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ! Yihi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a muklii mi bimɛ nɛ a suɔ ɔ yee! Mawu we ɔ nitsɛnitsɛ mi po a ngɛ osɔfohi, kɛ gbalihi gbee!

english_verse: My people, both young and old, lie dead in the streets. Because you were angry, my young men and women were brutally slaughtered.
translation_verse: Jokuɛwi kɛ nikɔtɔmahi tsuo gbo kɛ pueɔ si ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. He nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ klaate gbe nihewi, kɛ yihewi. Ligbi ɔ nɛ o mi mi wo la a, o gbe mɛ tsuo basabasa nɛ o nɛ́ mɔbɔ kulaa.

english_verse: I have suffered much because God was angry.
translation_verse: Ke a ke Mawu gbla nɔ ko tue ɔ, imi lɛɛ i le nɔ́ nɛ ji.

english_verse: He chased me into a dark place, where no light could enter.
translation_verse: E tsɛ̃ mi ngɔ wo diblii kpii mi, nɛ la ko la ko be lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am the only one he punishes over and over again, without ever stopping.
translation_verse: E fiaa mi ní wawɛɛ nɔtonɔto ligbi mluku ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: God caused my skin and flesh to waste away, and he crushed my bones.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ i ta he lo, nɛ ye he womi pee nyamanyama, nɛ e ku ye wuhi a mi.

english_verse: He attacked and surrounded me with hardships and trouble;
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nami, kɛ aywilɛho sa ye yi kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a wo mi tsu.

english_verse: he forced me to sit in the dark like someone long dead.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ i hi diblii kpii mi kaa nihi nɛ gbo blema a a ti nɔ ko.

english_verse: God built a fence around me that I cannot climb over, and he chained me down.
translation_verse: E bɔ mi pã; e po piɛ kɛ wo ye he, konɛ ma ko na blɔ nɛ ma tu fo kɛ je.

english_verse: Even when I shouted and prayed for help, he refused to listen.
translation_verse: I kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Mawu, konɛ e ba je mi, se e bui mi tue.

english_verse: God put big rocks in my way and made me follow a crooked path.
translation_verse: E ngɔ tɛ agbohi kɛ fɔ blɔ mi ha mi, nɛ e ha nɛ ye blɔ ɔ kpɛ̃.

english_verse: God was like a bear or a lion waiting in ambush for me;
translation_verse: E pee kaa osisiblisi nɛ wo ka, loo jata nɛ laa e he, konɛ e nu mi.

english_verse: he dragged me from the road, then tore me to shreds.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ i tla blɔ, nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ ye mi; e pee mi posoposo.

english_verse: I am a joke to everyone— no one ever stops making fun of me.
translation_verse: I plɛ pee muɔ nɔ́ ha nihi tsuo. Be tsuaa be ɔ, imi ji a nya mi la nɛ a ngɛ lae.

english_verse: He made me eat gravel and rubbed me in the dirt.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ i kokloo si ngɛ zugba, nɛ ye lungu kli kaa nɔ nɛ kpe tɛ ngmlitsa.

english_verse: I tell myself, “I am finished! I can't count on the Lord to do anything for me.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i de ke, “Akuanyɛ! Ye he wami, kɛ ye hɛ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ se po.”

english_verse: That's all I ever think about, and I am depressed.
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he susue ɔ, e haa nɛ ye he mi jɔ̃ɔ̃.

english_verse: Then I remember something that fills me with hope.
translation_verse: Se nɔ́ nɛ ke i kai nɛ ye nɔ gbagba tee ji,

english_verse: The Lord's kindness never fails! If he had not been merciful, we would have been destroyed.
translation_verse: kaa Yawɛ suɔmi se pui gblegbleegble; e naa mɔbɔ daa.

english_verse: The Lord can always be trusted to show mercy each morning.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ ehe daa mɔtu. Yawɛ we anɔkuale yemi ɔ kle.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I say, “The Lord is all I need; I can depend on him!”
translation_verse: Yawɛ ji ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ.

english_verse: It is good to wait patiently for the Lord to save us.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa waa to wa tsui si kɛ hyɛ Yawɛ blɔ, konɛ e he wa yi wami.

english_verse: When we are young, it is good to struggle hard
translation_verse: Wa nihe mi ji be nɛ sa kaa waa kase tsui si tomi nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and to sit silently alone, if this is what the Lord intends.
translation_verse: Ke wa ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, e sa kaa waa pee dii, nɛ waa to wa tsui si.

english_verse: Being rubbed in the dirt can teach us a lesson;
translation_verse: Waa ba wa he si, ejakaa ke wa pee ja a, e be yaka pee.

english_verse: The Lord won't always reject us!
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ be wɔ kuae kɛ ya neneene.

english_verse: He causes a lot of suffering, but he also has pity because of his great love.
translation_verse: Eko ɔ, e ma ha nɛ wa maa ye aywilɛho lɛɛ, se kɛ̃, e maa na wɔ mɔbɔ, ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ kle, nɛ e ngɛ daa.

english_verse: or cheat anyone out of what is rightfully theirs. God Most High sees everything,
translation_verse: Blɔ nya nɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ ha wɔ ɔ, ke a he ngɛ wa dɛ ɔ, e le.

english_verse: and he knows when you refuse to give someone a fair trial.
translation_verse: Ke a yi dami sane ngɛ sane yemi he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le.

english_verse: Good and bad each happen at the command of God Most High.
translation_verse: Kpakpa jio, yaya jio, Hiɔwe No ɔ lɛ deɔ loko e baa mi.

english_verse: We're still alive! We shouldn't complain when we are being punished for our sins.
translation_verse: Nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji wɔ. Ke wa pee yayami nɛ a gbla wa tue ɔ, mɛni he je wa hii wa nya jee ɔ?

english_verse: Instead, we should think about the way we are living, and turn back to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hyɛ wa je mi bami mi saminya, nɛ waa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: When we lift our hands in prayer to God in heaven, we should offer him our hearts and say,
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ wa wo wa nine nɔ nɛ waa fa kue kɛ je wa tsui mi tɔɔ kɛ ha Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ke,

english_verse: “We've sinned! We've rebelled against you, and you haven't forgiven us!
translation_verse: “Wa tɔ̃; wa tsɔ atuã, lɔ ɔ he nɛ mo Yawɛ, o kɛ wa yayami ɔmɛ pɛ wɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Anger is written all over you, as you pursue and slaughter us without showing pity.
translation_verse: “O kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa nyɛɛ wa se, nɛ o ba gbe wɔ; o nɛ wɔ mɔbɔ kulaa.

english_verse: You allowed nations to treat us like garbage;
translation_verse: O ha nɛ wa plɛ nɔ́ nɛ a hiee, kɛ dwɔmi ha je ma amɛ tsuo.

english_verse: We are terrified and trapped, caught and crushed.”
translation_verse: Wa hao, nɛ wa nu sawale. Wa na amanehlu, nɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi.

english_verse: until the Lord looks down from heaven and helps.
translation_verse: ma pee jã kɛ yaa si Yawɛ nitsɛ maa na kɛ je hiɔwe.

english_verse: I am horrified when I see what enemies have done to the young women of our city.
translation_verse: Ke i hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba yihewi ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, i haoɔ wawɛɛ.

english_verse: No one had reason to hate me, but I was hunted down like a bird.
translation_verse: “Ye he nyɛli nɛ nyɛɛ mi yaka a tsɔ mi klama, nɛ i du.

english_verse: Then they tried to kill me by tossing me into a pit and throwing stones at me.
translation_verse: A sake mi ngɔ fɔ muɔ mi hɛ ngmengmle, nɛ a ngɔ tɛ kɛ tsi ye yi.

english_verse: Water covered my head— I thought I was gone.
translation_verse: I ho nyu sisi ya, nɛ i de ke, ‘Ye yi ta pɛ!’

english_verse: From the bottom of the pit, I prayed to you, Lord.
translation_verse: “I fa kue ha mo, Yawɛ kɛ je muɔ ɔ sisi tɔɔ.

english_verse: I begged you to listen. “Help!” I shouted. “Save me!” You answered my prayer
translation_verse: Kue nɛ i fa nɛ o nu ji, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ba piɛ ye he; koo tsi o tue.’

english_verse: and came when I was in need. You told me, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Benɛ i tsɛ mo ɔ, o he nɔ, nɛ o de mi ke ma ko ye gbeye.

english_verse: You saw them abuse me, Lord, so make things right.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo ye ye sane ɔ ha mi; yayami tsuo nɛ a pee mi ɔ, o le.

english_verse: Pay them back for everything they have done, Lord!
translation_verse: “Yawɛ lee, gbla a tue ngɛ níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he.

english_verse: Put your curse on them and make them suffer.
translation_verse: Moo gbiɛ mɛ, nɛ o ha a tsui nɛ ye mɛ

english_verse: Get angry and go after them until not a trace is left under the heavens.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lee, o kɛ mi mi la nɛ nyɛɛ a se gidigidi, nɛ o kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi!”

english_verse: The purest gold is ruined and has lost its shine; jewels from the temple lie scattered in the streets.
translation_verse: Hyɛ bɔ nɛ wa sika tsu ɔ pee tuu ha! Hyɛ bɔ nɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ɔ tsake ha. Mawu we ɔ tɛ ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: These are Zion's people, worth more than purest gold; yet they are counted worthless like dishes of clay.
translation_verse: Zion nihewi nɛ a he jua wa ha wɔ kaa sika tsu saminya a, hyɛ, jehanɛ lɛɛ a buu mɛ kaa zu kplu gu komɛ kɛkɛ nɛ buɛ puɛlɔ puɛ.

english_verse: Even jackals nurse their young, but my people are like ostriches that abandon their own.
translation_verse: Nga mi gbe po haa e bimɛ nyɔ nɛ a pupɔɔ, se ye ma a lɛɛ a yi mi wa; a ngɛ kaa dugumahi ngɛ nga nɔ.

english_verse: Babies are so thirsty that their tongues are stuck to the roof of the mouth. Children go begging for food, but no one gives them any.
translation_verse: Kuma gbe bimwɔwi; a ngɛ a nya mi lɔe kɛ ngɛ nyu hlae. Jokuɛwi ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ke a ha mɛ niye ní; se nɔ ko nɔ ko ha we mɛ.

english_verse: My nation was punished worse than the people of Sodom, whose city was destroyed in a flash without the help of human hands.
translation_verse: A gbla ye ma a tue wawɛɛ pe Sodom. Sodom lɛɛ e tue gblami ɔ ba ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi, nɛ adesa nine be mi.

english_verse: The leaders of Jerusalem were purer than snow and whiter than milk; their bodies were healthy and glowed like jewels.
translation_verse: Sa a, wa ganɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyaii, nɛ a he tsɔ pe sinoo. A hiɛɛ pe nyɔ nyu po. A ngɛ he wami saminya kaa kora tɛ; a yi bwɔmi ngɛ kaa safiro.

english_verse: Now they are blacker than tar, and no one recognizes them; their skin clings to their bones and is drier than firewood.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, a hɛ mi yuɔ pe kutu sisi. A yo we mɛ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. A ta he lo; a je wu, nɛ a pee kaa tso gbigbli.

english_verse: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.
translation_verse: Ye ma a hɛ mi kpatami ɔ ngɛ gbeye. Binyɛmɛ nɛ suɔ a bimɛ kaa nɔ́ ko po, hoo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ kaa niye ní nɛ a ye.

english_verse: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.
translation_verse: Yawɛ mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ; e je e we abofu ɔ kpo; e mɛ Zion he la, nɛ e sã ma a sisi tomi ɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ, kɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he we yi kaa he nyɛlɔ ko ma nyɛ ma tua Yerusalem, nɛ e ma nyɛ sɛ ma a agbo ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
translation_verse: Se e ba mi ja, ejakaa gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ pee yayami; a pue nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da ngɛ ma a mi ɔ a muɔ si.

english_verse: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.
translation_verse: A hii nyɛɛe kɛ hii yae kɛ hii bae ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa hɛ yuyuili. A kɛ muɔ ble a he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ta a tade ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Instead, everyone shouted, “Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people!” So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, “You can't stay here!”
translation_verse: Nihi kpaa ngmlaa kɛ woɔ mɛ, nɛ a deɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ je hiɛ ɔ! Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ble nyɛ he! Nyɛ ko ta wa he!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lalaalo kɛ kpa ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ, se ma ko ma ko he we mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hyɛ we a nɔ hu. Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ e gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa. E pee we osɔfo ɔmɛ a he akɔtaa hu, nɛ wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu, e nɛ mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
translation_verse: He nyɛli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ wa se kɛ fo. A he sɔɔ pe kɔlehi ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi. A nyɛɛ wa se kɛ gu yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a wo wɔ ka ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
translation_verse: Wa matsɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ hla lɛ, nɛ woɔ wɔ he wami, nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ kaa e ma ba kpɔ wɔ kɛ je he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ sɛ a kpa mi, nɛ a nu lɛ.

english_verse: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.
translation_verse: A wo Zion he yayami ɔmɛ a he hiɔ ta, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ be hae nɛ a ye wɔ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ma se hu. Se mo Edom lɛɛ Yawɛ maa gbla o tue; e ma ha o he yayami ɔmɛ maa je kpo paa nɛ a na.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.
translation_verse: Yawɛ lee, mo kai amanehlu nɛ wa na a; moo hyɛ bɔ nɛ zo gbe wɔ ha.

english_verse: Foreigners and strangers have taken our land and our homes.
translation_verse: Wa weto ní plɛ pee nibwɔhi a nɔ́. Wa we ɔmɛ hu ma se li lɛ ngɛ a mi.

english_verse: We are like children whose mothers are widows.
translation_verse: Wa pee awusa bimɛ; wa tsɛmɛ be je mi, nɛ wa nyɛmɛ pee yalɔyihi.

english_verse: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
translation_verse: Nyu nɛ wa nuu ɔ po e hia kaa waa wo he hiɔ; nɛ lɛ́ nɛ wa ma slɛ hu ja wa he kɛ sika.

english_verse: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
translation_verse: Wa ngɔ wa he ya bɔ Egipt, kɛ Asiria bi a he, konɛ wa ná ngma nɛ waa ye nɛ waa tɔ.

english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee yayami, se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a be je mi, nɛ wa ba ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Nyɔguɛhi lɛ a ngɛ wa nɔ yee; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je a dɛ mi.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: Wa hɛɛ wa wami ngɛ wa nguɛ nya kɛ ngɛ wa nya mi ngma hlae kɛ bee; ejakaa awi yeli ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ kpae.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: A nuu wa yi ɔmɛ ngɛ Zion; nɛ a nuu wa bimɛ yihewi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, nɛ a pee mɛ basabasa.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: A nuu wa ganɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a sɛu mɛ. Wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu a bui mɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
translation_verse: A nyɛɔ wa nihewi ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa nyɔguɛhi nɛ a gblɛ ngma. Wa binyumuwi ɔmɛ tlooɔ lɛ́ nɛ jiɔ, nɛ a hii si nɔe ngɛ sisi.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Nimowihi hí si ngɛ ma agbo nya hu, nɛ nihewi fiɛ we do hu.

english_verse: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
translation_verse: Bua jɔmi ko be ha wɔ ngɛ je mi hu; wa kpa domi nɛ wa ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Jlasi je wa yi nɔ si. Wa pee yayami, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, musu tloo wɔ.

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: Se mo Yawɛ, mo ji matsɛ kɛ yaa neneene; yi nɔhi tsuo o maa ye tsɛ.

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: Aloo pe o kua wɔ kulaa? Anɛ o we abofu ɔ nyagbe be lo?

english_verse: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,
translation_verse: Ma wo ye yi nɔ ɔ, o nɛ ahumi nguaa ko nɛ hia kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ma. Oslabai ngɛ gbae nɔtonɔto kɛ ngɛ bɔku agbo ko mi jee. Hiɔwe ɔ nɛ bɔle bɔku ɔ tsuo ngɛ la pãe nylamnylam; nɔ́ ko ngɛ kpɛe kaa akɔblee ngɛ la a mi.

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
translation_verse: I na nɔ́ ko kaa hɛ kali eywiɛ ngɛ ahumi ɔ kpɛti; a ngɛ kaa nimli adesahi;

english_verse: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
translation_verse: se a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ hɛ mi eywiɛ kɛ pɛli eywiɛ.

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
translation_verse: A nanehi ngɛ tlɔmɔtlɔmɔ, nɛ a nane si ngɛ kaa na nane si; nɛ a he ngɛ kpɛe hleii kaa akɔblee nɛ́ a sa he.

english_verse: Under each of their wings, these creatures had a human hand.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ ninehi ngɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi kakaaka.

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: A pɛli ɔmɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ ke a ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, a plɛ we a he: a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ yaa e hɛ mi tɛɛ.

english_verse: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
translation_verse: Hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ hɛ mi slɔɔtoslɔɔto eywiɛɛywiɛ. Bɔ nɛ a hɛ mi ɔmɛ ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nɔmlɔ hɛ mi ngɛ hɛ mi, jata hɛ mi ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, na hɛ mi ngɛ muɔ nɔ, nɛ kɔle hɛ mi ngɛ se je.

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: A gbɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a mi; a wo enyɔɔnyɔ nɔ ya bua nya ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ́ kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya a nɔ́ tsa; nɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a kɛ ha a nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nyɛɛɔ kɛ yaa e hɛ kpɛ tɛɛ; he tsuaa he nɛ mumi ɔ suɔ kaa a ya a, mɛ tsuo a yaa kutuu nɛ́ a plɛ we a he.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko ngɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ a kpɛti jee kaa la ngu nɛ ngɛ tsoe. E ngɛ pãe kaa jatɛ kɛ nyɛɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae. La a ngɛ kpɛe, nɛ oslabai ngɛ gbae kɛ ngɛ mi jee.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Hɛ kali ɔmɛ saa fo kɛ yaa kɛ baa kaa oslabai nɛ ngɛ gbae.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ hyɛe ɔ, tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ ba ma si ngɛ a kasa nya kakaaka.

english_verse: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ je a sibi, nɛ a ngɛ kpɛe saminya kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa. Bɔ nɛ a pee mɛ ɔ, tlɔɔke nane kpa hɔɔ si ngɛ eko tsuaa eko mi.

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Gahi nɛ a ka nɛ a he ngɛ gbeye ngɛ tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ hɛngmɛhi bɔle ga amɛ a he tsuo kɛ kpe.

english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, nane ɔmɛ hu ngɛ nyɛɛe; nɛ ke a da si ɔ, mɛ tsuo a da si. Ke hɛ kali ɔmɛ wó a he nɔ kɛ je zugba a, kɛkɛ nane ɔmɛ tsuo hu pee ja, ejakaa hɛ kali ɔmɛ a mumi lɛ hɛɛ nane ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body.
translation_verse: Hɛ kali ɔmɛ bli a pɛli ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya a sibi a ngɔ; nɔ kɛ e sibi nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya a nɔ́ kakaaka tsa. Hɛ kali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ pɛli enyɔ ngɔ ha e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Benɛ a te kɛ yaa a, i nu a pɛli ɔmɛ a he kaa wo nɛ ngɛ fiae gudaguda, loo ta buli a ngmlaa hoo, loo Mawu Ope ɔ nitsɛ e gbi. Benɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ ya da si ɔ, a ba a pɛli ɔmɛ si,

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: se gbi ko pɛ ngɛ nɔ mluguduu ɔ nɛ ngɛ a yi nɔ ɔ yi mi.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Ke o hyɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko kaa matsɛ sɛ nɛ hɛɛ tɛ bluu su ngɛ nɔ́ mluguduu ɔ nɔ́, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: Kɛ je e he ko nɛ a ma tsɛ ke e mlɛ mi kɛ kuɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i na a pee kaa ayawa ngɛ la mi. Kɛ je e mlɛ mi kɛ ya pue sisi ɔ tsuo ngɛ kpɛe kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam.

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: Alale su slɔɔtohi nɛ je kpo ngɛ mi ɔ ngɛ fɛu kaa nɔ́ ko. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kpɛmi nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale ɔ je e he kpo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Mawu tsɛ Ezekiel ke e ba pee gbalɔ Benɛ i na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, i tsɔ fia si, nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu zugba. Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ mi dee ke,

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tee si nɛ o da si nɛ ma de mo nɔ́ ko.”

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Benɛ e kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ba sɛ ye mi, nɛ e wo ye nɔ kɛ da si. Kɛkɛ nɛ i bu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ mi dee ɔ tue.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ma tsɔ mo kɛ ya Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ. A nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔ atuã, nɛ a kua mi; nɛ mɛ hu a pee a he atuã tsɔli, nɛ a ngɛ ye nɔ tɔe kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ e mi bi a tue wa, nɛ a bui mi a ngɔ i ngɛ mo tsɔe ɔ nɛ. Yaa de mɛ nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ mɛ dee ɔ.

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: Ke atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ bu mo tue jio, a bui mo tue jio, a ma na maa le kɛ̃ kaa gbalɔ ko ngɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: “Se mo nɔmlɔ adesa, bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ tue; koo pee o he tue gbolɔ kaa mɛ. Pãã o nya mi, nɛ o ye nɔ́ nɛ ma ha mo nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: I na nine ko nɛ a juale ha mi; e hɛɛ womi kpo ko.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: E bli womi ɔ mi kɛ fɔ si. A ngma ní ngɛ womi ɔ hɛ mi, kɛ e se tsuo. Kɔmɔ yemi, huu fami, kɛ awe nyami munyuhi lɛ ngɛ mi.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yé womi kpo nɛ i ngɔ ha mo nɛ ɔ, nɛ o mi mi nɛ hyi tɔ.” I ye, nɛ e ngɔ ngɛ ye nya mi kaa hwo.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yaa Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ, de mɛ.

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: Ke ma nguahi nɛ tuɔ gbi kpahi nɛ wa, nɛ o nui a gbi ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo tsɔe ɔ, jinɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bu mo tue.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Se Israel ma a be suɔe kaa a maa bu mo tue, ejakaa imi tete po, a sume kaa a maa bu mi tue. Ma a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tue wa, nɛ a tsɔɔ atuã.

english_verse: Listen carefully to everything I say and then think about it.
translation_verse: Mawu de hu ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ta tue saminya, konɛ o kai nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, yaa a ngɔ nɛ o ya tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ. De mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, a bu tue jio, a bui tue jio.”

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ wo ye nɔ, nɛ i nu gbi nguaa ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ ye se je ke, “Á je Yawɛ yi, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo.”

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: Hɛ kali ɔmɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ a sibi a he sae, nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ a kasa nya a ngɛ a ní tsue. Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ pɛe hoo kaa nɔ́ nɛ zugba lɛ ngɛ mimiɛe.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Yawɛ he wami ba ye nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ benɛ mumi ɔ wo mi kɛ yaa a, e dɔ mi, nɛ ye bua jɔɛ kulaa.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i ba su Tel Abib ngɛ Kebar pa a nya. Nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a ngɛ. I hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago sɔuu; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ i na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i nu ɔ wo ye he gbeye, nɛ ye he mi po. Yawɛ pee Ezekiel bulɔ (Ezekiel

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ligbi kpaago ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, i pee mo bulɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bu ye nya mi munyu ɔmɛ tue saminya, konɛ o kɛ bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ha mi.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Ke i de ke yayami peelɔ ko ma gbo, nɛ o bɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔ, nɛ o tui munyu kɛ tsɔɔ we lɛ, konɛ e tsake nɛ e he e yi wami ɔ, jamɛ a yayami peelɔ ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he lɛɛ, se ma bi e muɔ si ngɛ o dɛ.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Se ke o bɔ yayami peelɔ ɔ kɔkɔ, nɛ e kpa we yayami peemi ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he, se moo lɛɛ o ma he o yi wami.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, ke nɔmlɔ kpakpa kpa níhi nɛ da peemi, nɛ e ba bɔni yayami peemi, nɛ i fɔ̃ e blɔ mi tso ɔ, e ma gbo. Akɛnɛ o bɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔ ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔ he. Ma bi e muɔ si ngɛ o dɛ; kpakpa nɛ e pee ɔ tsuo, i be kaie.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: Se ke o bɔ dalɔ ɔ kɔkɔ ke e ko pee yayami, nɛ e bu mo tue, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ɔ, e yi ma na wami, nɛ mo nitsɛ hu a ma he o yi wami.” Ezekiel maa pee mumui

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: I nu Yawɛ he wawɛɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, “Tee si nɛ o ya kɔ̃ ɔ mi; i kɛ mo maa tu munyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ ho kɔ̃ ɔ mi ya. Lejɛ ɔ lɛ i na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i na lɛ ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a. I ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu zugba.

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Se Mawu mumi ɔ ba sɛ ye mi, nɛ e wo ye nɔ kɛ da si. E kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Yaa o we ɔ mi, nɛ o nga sinya kɛ wo o yi.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ o lilɛ maa mɛtɛ o nya mi; o ma pee mumui, nɛ o be nyɛe maa tu munyu kɛ ka atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i kɛ mo maa tu munyu ekohu, nɛ ke i bli o nya a, o ma de mɛ nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i de mo ɔ. A ti ni komɛ maa bu mo tue, nɛ ni komɛ hu be mo tue bue; ejakaa ma atuã tsɔli ji mɛ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yaa ngɔ bliikisi nɛ o kɛ fɔ o hɛ mi; nɛ o tɛni Yerusalem ma a ngɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.
translation_verse: Moo ma mɔ, nɛ o fia gbogbo kɛ kpoku kɛ wo he. Ngɔɔ ta buli kɛ gbogbo kuɔmi níhi kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a sa ma a yi.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: “Ngɔɔ o hɛ mi kɛ ka Yerusalem ma a nɛ a sa yi ɔ. Je o nine kɛ tsɔɔ ma a. Gbaa kɛ si ma a.

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ ngma, akoko, abɔtlamɔ, yɔ, blɛfo akoko, kɛ blɛfo kɛ wo nɔ́ kake mi, nɛ o kɛ pee abolo. Ligbi lafa etɛ kɛ nyingmi nɛɛ ɔ nɛ o maa hwɔ o muɔ kasa nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ o maa ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: and drink only two large cups of water.
translation_verse: Nyu nɛ o maa nu daa ligbi maa pee nyu kɔɔpoo enyɔ.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: O maa ngɔ nɔmlɔ fĩ kɛ slɛ la; o maa sã abolo ngɛ nɔ, nɛ o maa ye ngɛ ma hɛ mi.”

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ye a niye ní nɛ a ble ɔ ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti he nɛ ma fie mɛ kɛ maa ho ɔ.”

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Kpaoo, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ble we ye he; kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si hluu kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo, loo lohwe ko tsɔtslɔɔ mi ɔ, i yi hyɛ; jehanɛ hu, lo nɛ a hiɔ yɛ ye nya mi hyɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Se Mawu de mi ke, “Saminya! Ma ha o maa ngɔ na fĩ kɛ sã abolo ɔ, se pi nɔmlɔ fĩ.”

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: Ma ha a niye ní, kɛ nyu maa ta kulaa, nɛ a maa hi a sibi a hɛ mi hyɛe mɔbɔmɔbɔ. A tue gblami ɔ ma ha a maa ta he lo kanyakanya.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ngɔɔ klaate nɛ nya ba kɛ sɛ o yi bwɔmi, kɛ o kpɛni kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ asoyi ngmlaa yi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngmɛɛ bwɔmi ɔ ngɛ sɛni mi, nɛ o dla mi.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Ke a sa ma a yi se ɔ, ngɔɔ la kɛ sã bwɔmi ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake ngɛ ma a kpɛti. Mi dlami etɛ ɔ mi kake hu ngɔɔ klaate ɔ kɛ poo mi kɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe. Mi dlami etɛ ɔ mi kake nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ fĩa kɔɔhiɔ mi; kɛkɛ ɔ, ma hia klaate ɔ kɛ nyɛɛ a se.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ bwɔmi nɛ ɔ mi bɔɔ ko pɛ kɛ muɔ o tade ɔ nya.

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, je lɔ ɔ mi eko nɛ o sake kɛ pue la a mi nɛ e sã. Enɛ ɔmɛ a mi la maa je kɛ ba ha Israel ma a tsuo.” Nɔ́ he je nɛ a kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, Yerusalem ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; i ngɔ lɛ kɛ ma je ma amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ ma kpahi bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: Se Yerusalem tsɔ atuã; e yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, mohu e pee yayamihi nɛ nya wa babauu pe je ma kpa amɛ nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ. E wa tue, nɛ e bui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. Yerusalem yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yerusalem, bu tue; bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ɔ tue. Akɛnɛ o tue gbo pe je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mo ɔ, nɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa amɛ hu, o yi a nɔ, se mohu je ma amɛ a kusumi níhi o peeɔ ɔ,

english_verse: Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you
translation_verse: imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ hu, i kɛ mo ná. Ma gbla o tue ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi paa.

english_verse: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
translation_verse: Ní hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ o pee he je ɔ, ma gbla o tue wawɛɛ bɔ nɛ i pee we nɔ ko hyɛ, nɛ i be pee gblegbleegble hulɔ.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ e maa ba ji kaa fɔli ngɛ Yerusalem maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ, nɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ hu maa ye a fɔli. Ma gbla o tue wawɛɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be a bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ nɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ o ngɔ tai níhi, kɛ níhi nɛ a hiee tsuo kɛ ble ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, imi Yawɛ hu, i be mo mɔbɔ nae, nɛ i be o yi bae; mohu ma kpata o hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Gbenɔ hiɔ, kɛ hwɔ maa gbe ma mi bi ɔmɛ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake; mi dlami etɛ mi kake maa nɔ ngɛ klaate nya kɛ maa bɔle ma a kɛ kpe, nɛ mi dlami etɛ mi kake ɔ hu, ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo; nɛ ma hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ a se.

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: “Ke ye mi mi fu, nɛ ye hɛ dɔ, nɛ i gbla nyɛ tue kikɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ tsuo maa ye gbeye; a maa hie nyɛ, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ he fɛu.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ hwɔ, kɛ lohwe awi yeli ma kpata nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Ma ha gbenɔ hiɔ, kɛ ta ma ba kpata ma a hɛ mi. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Israel yo ɔmɛ, nɛ o ha mɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: De Israel yo ɔmɛ ke a bu Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue. De mɛ ke a nu nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ yo gagaa amɛ, yoku ɔmɛ, dɔgba amɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ tsuo dee ɔ. Imi nitsɛ ma hia ta kɛ wo nyɛ; ma gbɛ nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Ma ku nyɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pue si. Ma gbe ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɔ pue nyɛ we amaga amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Nihi babauu ma gbo ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: “Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma ha ni komɛ maa piɛ. Nihi nɛ maa tu fo kɛ je gbenɔ nya a,

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: A maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɛ́ i de ke ma gbla a tue ɔ, pi nya mi nɛ i pee.”

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Tsɛ̃ o nguɛ nya! Ngɔɔ o nane kɛ si si! De ke akuanyɛ, musu tloo Israel ma a ngɛ yayamihi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ he. Ta ma kpata ni komɛ a hɛ mi; mi mi hwɔ maa gbe ni komɛ; nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa ngɔ ni komɛ hu kɛ ho!

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ se lokoo ɔ maa nu hiɔ, nɛ a ma gbo; nihi nɛ ngɛ kpo nya a maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi; nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, hwɔ maa gbe mɛ. Bɔ nɛ ye mi mi la nɛ nya wa a ma tsu ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ Israel zugba a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: O gbe nya pɛ! Israel zugba a tsuo, o nyagbe ɔ su jehanɛ!

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: I be o yi bae; i be mo mɔbɔ nae. Se ma gbla o tue mohu ngɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ o ngɛ pee kpamisa a he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

english_verse: There's never been anything like the coming disaster.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Amanehlu nyɛɛ amanehlu se kɛ ma!

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ su oo! E ná mo jehanɛ! O yi ta pɛ!

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: Yi wu tso ní peemi wo wu. Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be je mi hie hu; jã kɛ̃ a níhi nɛ a ngɛ, a juetli, kɛ a hɛ mi nyami tsuo maa laa.

english_verse: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
translation_verse: Jua yelɔ ko jua yelɔ ko be je mi tlɔe nɛ e ma ya bi nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye nya momo ɔ si; ejakaa Mawu mi mi fu ma a tsuo. Yayami peeli a yi be wami nae.

english_verse: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: A ma kpa titimati, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee klaalo kɛ ha ta. Se nɔ ko nɔ ko be ta yae, ejakaa Mawu mi mi fumi maa ba nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ. A maa gbla Israel tue ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: A maa hia klaate kɛ nyɛɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa ba we ɔmɛ a mi. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ ta nga nɔ ɔ maa nɔ ngɛ ta a nya; nɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ, loo hwɔ ma kpata e hɛ mi.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ya hi lejɛ ɔ kaa lahuɛhi nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je a hi he. Mɛ tsuo a maa ye kɔmɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma fo ya ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he yayamihi a he.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nine mi maa je wu, nɛ nakutso tsuaa nakutso mi maa wo nyu.

english_verse: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.
translation_verse: A ma bu kpekpe ya bo; sawale maa nu mɛ. A ma sã mɛ tsuo a yi nɔ ha mɛ, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: A ma sake a sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ ngɔ pue gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa níhi nɛ a he tsɔ we. Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ we abofu maa ba ma a nɔ ɔ, a sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ɔ be nyɛe ma he a yi wami; a be nyɛe maa ye kaa niye ní nɛ a tɔ, konɛ a na bua jɔmi. Ejakaa sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ ji níhi nɛ ha nɛ a pee yayami ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: A ngɔ a he dlami ní saminyawiiwi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee amagahi, níhi nɛ a hiee, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ tai. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ a june ɔmɛ plɛ pee níhi nɛ he tsɔ we ha mɛ.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Ke a ngɛ ye we ɔ june blee po, i be a nya tsie; juli ma nyɛ maa sɛ mi ya ble lejɛ ɔ faa.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa pee basaa; zugba a tsuo nɔ ma hyi kɛ muɔ si puemi, nɛ ma a mi maa pee gidigidi.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: Ma ha je mahi nɛ a yi mi wa wawɛɛ ɔ maa ba, nɛ a ma ba ngɔ nyɛ we ɔmɛ. Kã peeli nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ maa je fɔ̃, nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba ble nyɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nine mi maa je wu. Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ ma hla tue mi jɔmi, se nyɛ be nae.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Amanehlu maa nyɛɛ amanehlu se; nɛ munyu yobu maa nyɛɛ munyu yobu se; nyɛ ma hla nina kɛ je gbali ɔmɛ a ngɔ, se osɔfo ɔmɛ po mlaa maa laa mɛ kulaa; nɛ nyɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu be ga kpakpa ko nyɛe maa wo.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ maa ye kɔmɔ; ganɔ ɔ nine mi maa je wu, sawale maa nu ma a, nɛ mɛ tsuo a he maa do blibliibli. Bɔ nɛ ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Bɔ nɛ nyɛ kojoɔ ni komɛ ɔ, jã imi hu ma kojo nyɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Jeha ekpane ɔ we nyɔhiɔ ekpane ɔ we ligbi enunɔne ɔ, benɛ i kɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ hii si ngɛ ye we ɔ mi ɔ, tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ he wami ba ye nɔ.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: Ma hyɛ ɔ, o nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ. Kɛ je e mlɛ mi kɛ kple si ɔ, la sɔuu; nɛ kɛ je e mlɛ mi kɛ kuɔ ɔ ngɛ kpɛe hleii kaa akɔblee nɛ a sa he.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: E je nɔ́ ko kpo kaa nine kɛ nu ye yi bwɔmi. Kɛkɛ nɛ ngɛ nina a mi ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ wo mi kɛ gu kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ ya su Yerusalem. E ngɔ mi kɛ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ we omleyi je agbo ɔ mi. Amaga ko nɛ Mawu hiee wawɛɛ ɔ maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa nina nɛ i na ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: Mawu kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, hyɛ omleyi je!” I hyɛ, nɛ i na jamɛ a amaga a nɛ a hiee wawɛɛ ɔ maa si ngeɛbɔ sami la tɛ agbo ɔ we omleyi je ngɛ agbo ɔ nya.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse o na ní hiemi ní nguanguahi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ peeɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ; a peeɔ enɛ ɔmɛ konɛ ma je ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ya se lokoo? Se o maa na ní hiemi ní nguangua kpahi pe enɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e kɛ mi ba kpo nɔ je kue ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e tsɔɔ mi puɔ ko ngɛ gbogbo ɔ mi.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ywia gbogbo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” I pee ja, nɛ i na sinya ko.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: E de mi ke, “Sɛ tsu ɔ mi, konɛ o ya na ní hiemi níhi babauu nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ!”

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Benɛ i sɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ, i na nɛ a tɛni ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe: sinɔ slɔɔtohi babauu, lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ a hiee, kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
