translation_verse: Israel ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago, kɛ Yaazania, Shafan bi ɔ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ ngɛyu kɛ e mi tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ la su ku ngɛ mi jee kɛ yaa hiɔwe.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Mawu bi mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse o na nɔ́ nɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ pee ngɛ diblii mi! Tse o na nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ tsue ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we amaga jami he. Se nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ji, ‘Yawɛ nɛ wɔ! Yawɛ si e zugba a ngɔ fɔ si.’ ”

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ mi ba Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ sinya a nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ nya. Lejɛ ɔ hu, ne yihi nɛ ngɛ ya nyɛe ha Tamuz.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ o na enɛ ɔ hu lo? O maa na ní hiemi ní nguanguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse o na enɛ ɔ hulɔ! Anɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ Yuda ma a ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ pi ha mɛ lolo lo? Hyɛ, a ngɛ yi wu tso níhi pee tsɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Anɛ pi ye mi mi la nɛ a ngɛ woe wawɛɛ nɛ ɔ? A ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba sɛ ye we ɔ mi nitsɛ tɔɔ! A ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa a bui mi fɛɛ, pi jã?

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ Mawu wo gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ma kpata ma a hɛ mi. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hɛɛ awi yemi dade ngɛ e dɛ kɛ ba!”

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyumuhi ekpa je yiti je agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ mi kɛ ba kɛ a dɛ mi awi yemi dadehi. Nɔ ko hu nɛ ha kploba, nɛ e kpla womi ngmami nɔ́ ko ngɛ e kasa nya kɛ mɛ ba. A ba da si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee ɔ he.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je kerub ɔ nɔ kɛ ba we ɔ kpoku ɔ nya. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ ha kploba, nɛ e kpla womi ngmami nɔ́ ngɛ e kasa nya a.

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: E de lɛ ke, “Yaa kpa si kɛ gu Yerusalem ma a mi tsuo. Nihi nɛ ngɛ haoe, nɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ngɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ a he ɔ, pee okadi ngɛ a hɛ nya.”

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ gbe ni ɔmɛ tsuo: nikɔtɔmahi, nihewi, yihewi, jokuɛwi, bimwɔwi kɛ a nyɛmɛ. Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ okadi ɔ ngɛ e hɛ nya a lɛɛ nyɛ ko ta e he. Nyɛɛ je sisi kɛ je ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a bɔni ni ɔmɛ gbemi kɛ je ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mawu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ble we ɔ! Nyɛ ha nɛ kue ɔmɛ a mi nɛ a hyi kɛ ni gbogboehi. Nyɛɛ je kpo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a je kpo, nɛ a ya gbe ni ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a mi.

english_verse: I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ gbee ɔ, e ba piɛ imi nɔ kake too nɛ a gbi mi. I ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ i kpa ngmlaa ke, “Ao, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, bɔ nɛ o ngɔ o mi mi la kɛ kple Yerusalem nɔ nɛ ɔ, anɛ o miɔ nɛ o kpata Israel bi nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi lo?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: Mawu he nɔ ke, “Israel kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee yayami agbo; fɔ nɛ a ye ɔ kle tsɔ. Zugba a nɔ tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ muɔ si puemi; nɛ Yerusalem ma a mi hu a yi dami sane. A ngɛ dee ke imi Yawɛ, i kua zugba a, nɛ i nɛ mɛ.

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Se i be mɛ mɔbɔ nae; i be a yi bae. Bɔ nɛ a pee ni kpa amɛ ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ma pee mɛ.”

english_verse: I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne.
translation_verse: Benɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko kaa matsɛ sɛ ba je kpo ngɛ nɔ́ mluguduu ɔ nɔ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a yi mi. Sɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa tɛ kpakpa nɛ hɛɛ bluu su.

english_verse: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu de nyumu ɔ nɛ ha kploba a ke, “Yaa sɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ a kpɛ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a sisi. Ngɔɔ o nine enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ya muɔ la ngu hɛuu ɔ eko nɛ o fĩa ngɔ pue ma a nɔ.” I na nɛ́ nyumu ɔ pee ja niinɛ.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, kerub ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ leneyi je. Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔku ba hyi kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kpɛti ɔ tɔ.

english_verse: and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.
translation_verse: Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ wo e he nɔ kɛ je kerub ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ba da we ɔ agbo ɔ nya. Bɔku ɔ hyi we ɔ mi tɔ, nɛ kue ɔ mi tsuo ngɛ kpɛe hleii kɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: A nu kerub ɔmɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ agbo nya kue ɔ mi tɔɔ kaa Mawu Ope ɔ nitsɛ nɛ ngɛ munyu tue.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ kerub ɔ kake je e nine kpo kɛ ya su la a he ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e muɔ la a eko kɛ wo nɔ nɛ ha kploba a dɛ mi. Nyumu ɔ hɛɛ la a kɛ je kpo.

english_verse: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings,
translation_verse: I na kaa kerub ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko ngɛ nɔ́ ko kaa nɔmlɔ nine ngɛ e pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Tlɔɔke ɔmɛ a he, a se mi, a nine he, a pɛli ɔmɛ a he, kɛ tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ hɛngmɛhi.

english_verse: And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
translation_verse: I nu nɛ a tsɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ ke “Tlɔɔke nanehi nɛ poo a he.”

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Kerub ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko ngɛ hɛ mi eywiɛ. Kekleekle hɛ mi ɔ, na ku hɛ mi; enyɔne ɔ, nɔmlɔ hɛ mi; etɛne ɔ, jata hɛ mi; nɛ eywiɛne ɔ, kɔle hɛ mi.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: Ke kerub ɔ da si, kɛkɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu da si; ke a te si ɔ, kɛkɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ pee ja; ejakaa kerub ɔmɛ lɛ a hɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je we ɔ agbo ɔ nya kɛ ba da kerub ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: Kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi, nɛ a te kɛ je zugba; kɛkɛ nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu pee ja. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ba da si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je agbo ɔ nya, nɛ Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ a yi nɔ.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Kerub ɔmɛ nɛ i na ngɛ nina mi ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a, mɛ tutuutu ji Israel Mawu ɔ kerub nɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: A hɛ mi ngɛ kaa ní nɛmɛ nɛ i na ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a pɛpɛɛpɛ. A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nyɛɛ kɛ ya e hɛ mi tɛɛ.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: Nɛ i de mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ je kpo tsɔɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nihi nɛ susuɔ ní yayahi a he, nɛ a woɔ ga yayahi ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’
translation_verse: A deɔ ke, ‘E sui be nɛ wa maa ma tsuhi lolo. Ma nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa dade kutu agbo ko; nɛ wɔ nimli ɔmɛ wa ngɛ kaa lo ngɛ kutu ɔ mi!’

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke ma de ni nɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ Israel ma, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ susue ji nɛ ɔ? I le níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ susue.

english_verse: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!
translation_verse: Nyɛ gbe nihi babauu, nɛ ma nɛ ɔ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ hyi tɔ kɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ.

english_verse: and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ngɛ klaate gbeye yee; se klaate nɔuu a kɛ ma ba tua nyɛ.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yi be wami nae ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi, kaa lo yi na we wami ngɛ dade kutu mi. He tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ maa gu ngɛ Israel zugba a mi ɔ, ma gbla nyɛ tue.

english_verse: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ; ejakaa nyɛ yi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ; je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, mɛ mohu a mlaahi a nɔ nyɛ yeɔ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, bɔ nɛ a ngɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nyɛ je Yawɛ he kɛ ho se ya tsɔ. Wɔ ji nihi nɛ a ngɔ zugba a kɛ ha kaa wa weto ní.’

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, de o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji, imi nitsɛ nɛ i ha a ho je ma amɛ a zugba amɛ a nɔ ya a nɛ; i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo lɛɛ, se ma bu a he be bɔɔ ko ngɛ hehi nɛ a ho ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: Ke a ba lejɛ ɔ, a ma je ní hiemi níhi, kɛ musu ní ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: Ma ha mɛ tsui he, kɛ juɛmi he. Ma je tsui nɛ wa kaa tɛ ɔ kɛ je a mi, nɛ ma ha mɛ tsui nɛ he jɔ, tsui nɛ buɔ tue;

english_verse: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma plɛ pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ suɔ ní hiemi níhi, kɛ musu níhi, nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a ngɛ pee kpamisa a, mɛɛ lɛɛ ma gbla a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de. Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ je Yerusalem

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi nɛ a te; nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛ a se. Nɛ Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ kpɛe hleii ngɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away,
translation_verse: Ngɛ nina a mi ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ kɛ mi ba Babilonia ekohu ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a a ngɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.
translation_verse: E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nimli nɛ a tue wa a kpɛti o ngɛ ɔ nɛ. A ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́; a ngɛ tue hulɔ, se a nui nɔ́; ejakaa atuã tsɔli ji mɛ.

english_verse: So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo nɔmlɔ adesa, bua blɔ hiami níhi a nya, nɛ o hia blɔ piani katakata, konɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a na mo kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ blɔ hiae kɛ yaa ma se. Eko ɔ, atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ ma kɔ se kaa o kɛ nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa atuã tsɔli ji mɛ.

english_verse: After you have done this, return to your house. Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile.
translation_verse: Je o ní ɔmɛ kpo piani benɛ mɛ tsuo a ngɛ hyɛe, nɛ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, o je ma a mi kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ blɔ hiae kɛ yaa ma se, benɛ a ngɛ mo hyɛe paa.

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ mo hyɛe ɔ, ywia gbogbo ɔ he ko, nɛ o gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo.

english_verse: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: A hɛ mi nɔuu ɔ, benɛ du bu ɔ, ngɔɔ o tlomi ɔ ngɔ fɔ o konɔ kɛ je kpo. Ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha o hɛ mi, konɛ o ko na zugba, he nɛ o ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ yaa a. Nɔ́ nɛ o maa pee nɛ ɔ maa pee okadi kɛ ha Israel ma a.”

english_verse: I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mi ke ma pee ɔ, i pee ja pɛpɛɛpɛ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ piani katakata a, i ngɔ ye ní ɔmɛ kɛ je kpo kaa nɔ ko nɛ miɔ nɛ e hia blɔ. Gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, i ywia he ko ngɛ gbogbo ɔ mi, nɛ i gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo. Benɛ du bu ɔ, i ngɔ ye tlomi ɔ ngɔ fɔ ye konɔ kɛ hia blɔ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi paa.

english_verse: The next morning, the Lord
translation_verse: E nɔ jena a, Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse Israel bi tue gboli ɔmɛ ba bi mo ke mɛni o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ lo?

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: De mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji, nina nɛ ɔ kɔɔ Yerusalem ganɔ ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a he.

english_verse: I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: De mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ i pee nɛ ɔ, e ji okadi nɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ. A maa pee nihi nɛ do ma, nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Ke du bu ɔ, Yerusalem ganɔ ɔ maa fi tlomi kɛ fɔ e konɔ, nɛ e maa ywia gbogbo ɔ he ko, nɛ e maa gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo. E maa ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha e hɛ mi, nɛ he nɛ e yaa a, e hɛngmɛ be hyɛe.

english_verse: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.
translation_verse: Ma tsɔ lɛ klama nɛ ma du lɛ. Ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Babilon ngɛ Kaldea bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ. Se e ma gbo nɛ e li tete po kaa e su lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Ma gbɛ nihi tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, e ga woli ɔmɛ, kɛ tabo ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo; he nyɛli a ta a maa nyɛɛ a se ngɛ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: “Ke i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ, kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma ha a ti nihi bɔɔ ko maa piɛ; mɛɛ lɛɛ ta, kɛ hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ be mɛ gbee. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa jaje ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ nɛ a pee ngɛ je ma amɛ a mi ɔ, nɛ a ma de ke a tɔ̃. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Gbalɔ ɔ he do blibliibli kɛ to okadi

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ke o ngɛ abolo yee ɔ, o he nɛ do blibliibli; nɛ sawale nɛ nu mo ke o ngɛ nyu nue.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: De ma a tsuo ke sɛ gbi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ kɛ ha mɛ Yerusalem bi nɛ a ngɛ Yuda zugba nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ ji, a he maa do bibliibli kɛ ye abolo, nɛ a kɛ he hiami, kɛ tsui yemi maa nu nyu. A ma kpata a zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; ejakaa ma amɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a yi mi wa.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Mahi nɛ nihi ngɛ a mi ɔ tsuo ma plɛ pee ma dokuhi. Lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ!” Abɛ nɛ a le saminya, kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ a sume

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nyɛ buu abɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Israel zugba a he ke, ‘Be babauu ngɛ bee, se nina amɛ ekoeko bɛ mi gblee.’ Kɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Abɛ nɛ ɔ, ma gu, nɛ a be bue hu ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ. A na nɛ a le mohu kaa be ɔ su ta, nɛ nina amɛ tsuo kulaa maa ba mi pɛpɛɛpɛ!

english_verse: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.
translation_verse: “Lakpa nina, loo klaami nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, ekoeko be si hie hu ngɛ Israel ma a mi tsuo.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Ejakaa imi Yawɛ nitsɛ, i kɛ mɛ maa tu munyu, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma de ɔ maa ba mi pɛpɛɛpɛ. A be be ɔ tsɛ̃e kɛ ya se hu. Nyɛ ma tue gboli, nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu lɛ nɔ́ nɛ i de nɛ ɔ maa ba mi. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nɔ́ nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ dee ji, ‘Nina amɛ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ na a be mi bae amlɔ nɛ ɔ; hwɔɔ se lokoo he ninahi sɔuu.’

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si Israel gbali ɔmɛ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi mi kɛkɛ a gbaa a. De mɛ ke a bu Yawɛ tue!”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Musu tloo gbali kuasiahi nɛ peeɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nɛ́ hu a gbaa.

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: Israel ma, o gbali ɔmɛ a he be se nami; a ngɛ kaa kɔkɔbohi ngɛ ma doku mi.

english_verse: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.
translation_verse: Yakayaka ninahi a naa, nɛ lakpa sɔuu a yeɔ. A deɔ ke Yawɛ sɛ gbi a hɛɛ ɔ nɛ, pohu i tsɔ we mɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a hyɛɛ blɔ kaa níhi nɛ a de ɔ maa ba mi.

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Akɛnɛ yakayaka níhi nyɛ gbaa, nɛ lakpa níhi nyɛ naa he je ɔ, niinɛ, i kɛ nyɛ ná! Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ naa yakayaka níhi, nɛ lakpa níhi a klaa a, ma gbla a tue. A be ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti hie hu; a be a biɛhi ngmae ngɛ ye ma Israel womi ɔ mi, nɛ a be Israel zugba a hu nɔ bae gblegbleegble. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.
translation_verse: “Gbali ɔmɛ mlɔɔ ye ma a; a deɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ he manye!’ be mi nɛ tue mi jɔmi ko be kulaa; ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ fia gbogbo ɔ, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ kpa he.

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ye mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ. Ma ha ahumi maa fia, nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ; gbiɛ ngo ngu agbohi ma pue si, nɛ gbogbo ɔ maa hule.

english_verse: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
translation_verse: Gbogbo ɔ nɛ nyɛ kpa he kalo ɔ maa ku kɛ pue si butuu; e sisi tomi ɔ tsuo maa je kpo. Ee, e maa ku kɛ pue nyɛ nɔ haa bum! Nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ!

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead,
translation_verse: “Gbogbo ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ kpa he ɔ tsuo be a he yee kɛ je ye mi mi la a nya. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma de nyɛ ke gbogbo ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ kpa he ɔ tsuo be hu oo!

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:
translation_verse: Jamɛ a gbali ɔmɛ de Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke sane yobu ko kulaa be a nɔ bae; mamoo haomi mohu lɛ ma!” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de. A gba kɛ si yihi lakpa gbali

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, now condemn the women of Israel who preach messages that come from their own imagination.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ, nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si o ma a mi yi ɔmɛ nɛ toɔ a yi mi kɛ deɔ nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ ke a ngɛ gbae ɔ.

english_verse: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
translation_verse: Akoko dɛ kɔkɔ fuu, kɛ abolo nya bɔbɔɛ bɔɔ ko he ɔ, nyɛ gbee nihi yaka gu, nɛ nyɛ heɔ nihi nɛ a sa gbenɔ ɔ mohu a yi wami. Nyɛ yeɔ lakpa kɛ haa ye ma a, nɛ mɛ hu a buɔ nyɛ tue; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye he guɛ gbo ngɛ ye ma a hɛ mi.”

english_verse: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I kɛ nyɛ bo tsɔwi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ fiɔ nine si ɔ na; nyɛɛ kɛ bo nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ klama kɛ duɔ nɔ kaa a duɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ. Ma tsɔ́ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nine si, nɛ ma ngmɛɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ nuu ɔ a he.

english_verse: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ma kpɔ nyɛ nɔ hami bo ɔmɛ hu ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ be nimli ɔmɛ a nɔ he wami nae hu; nyɛ be mɛ klama tsɔe nɛ a maa du hu. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ ma na le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.
translation_verse: “Ejakaa dalɔ nɛ i sume kaa e ye aywilɛho ɔ, nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ lakpa munyu ɔmɛ kɛ yeɔ e tsui. Se nyɛ woɔ yayami peelɔ mohu he wami konɛ e ko kpa yayami peemi, nɛ a ko he e yi wami.

english_verse: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yakayaka nina ko be kpo jee ha nyɛ hu; nɛ nyɛ be klae hu. Ma kpɔ ye ma a kɛ je nyɛ he wami sisi, nɛ nyɛ be he wami hie ngɛ a nɔ; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

english_verse: One day, some of Israel's leaders came to me and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel ma nimeli komɛ ba ye ngɔ. I ha mɛ sɛ, nɛ a hi si.

english_verse: While they were there, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these men have started worshiping idols, though they know it will cause them to sin even more. So I refuse to give them a message!
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ amagahi a nɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami pɛ a peeɔ ɔ, anɛ a susuɔ kaa ma ha a ba bi ní ngɛ ye ngɔ lo?

english_verse: When they hear my message, maybe they will see that they need to turn back to me and stop worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, Israel ma a tsuo nɛ a kɛ amaga jami tsɔ a he kɛ je ye he ɔ, ma ha a maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu kɛ a tsui tsuo.

english_verse: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛɛ kpale kɛ je nyɛ we amaga amɛ a se kɛ ba; nɛ nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ ni hiemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he.

english_verse: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: Ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ wawɛɛ; ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ pee okadi gbeyegbeye, kɛ abɛ nɛ a maa bu. Ma kpata e hɛ mi kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people,
translation_verse: “Se ke a mlɔɔ gbalɔ ko nɛ e de nɔ́ ko ɔ, lɛɛ imi Yawɛ lɛ i mlɔɔ jamɛ a gbalɔ ɔ nɛ. Ma gbla e tue; ma kpata e hɛ mi; ma je lɛ kɛ je ye ma Israel ɔ a kpɛti.

english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ ba bi ní ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ tsuo ma ná tue gblami kake.

english_verse: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise. Judgment on a Sinful Nation
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ be ye se jee kɛ ya pee yayami kɛ ble a he hu. Se mohu a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de. Noa kɛ Daniel kɛ Hiob

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ke ma ko pee yayami, nɛ e yi mi anɔkuale ɔ, tue gblami nɛ e ma na ji, ma ha nɛ e niye ní se maa po, nɛ hwɔ maa ba ma a nɔ; nimlihi kɛ lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.

english_verse: Or suppose I punish a nation by sending wild animals to eat people and scare away every passerby, so that the land becomes a barren desert.

translation_verse: “Kɔle agbo kpa ko hu ngɛ kɛ e pɛli nguanguahi, kɛ e tsɛli fuu. Kikɛmɛ a wai tso nɛ ɔ dɔ e sipoku ɔmɛ, kɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na nyu saminya.

english_verse: But the vine was already growing in fertile soil, where there was plenty of water to produce healthy leaves and large grapes.
translation_verse: Zugba kpakpa nɛ nyu ngɛ mi bɔ nɛ sa nɔ nɛ a ma tso nɛ ɔ ngɛ, konɛ e wo yiblii, nɛ e pee wai tso kɛ e he fɛu.

english_verse: Now tell me, Ezekiel, do you think this grapevine will live? Or will the first eagle pull it up by its roots and pluck off the grapes and let its new leaves die? The eagle could easily kill it without the help of a large and powerful army.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ bie ke tso nɛ ɔ yi ma na wami lo? Anɛ kekle kɔle ɔ be tso ɔ gblae nɛ e hia e sipoku tsuo kɛ fɔ he, nɛ e ku e kɔni ɔmɛ, konɛ a gbli lo? E yi mi ba amɛ tsuo ma gbli. Pi he wami tsɔ ko, loo nihi babauu nɛ a ma na loko a maa hia tso nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The grapevine is strong and healthy, but as soon as the scorching desert wind blows, it will quickly wither. The Lord Explains the Story
translation_verse: A ma tso ɔ lɛɛ, se e yi ma na wami lo? Anɛ ke ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ fia a, tso ɔ be gblie ngɛ he nɛ a ma lɛ ngɛ ɔ lo?” A tsɔɔ abɛ ɔ sisi

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: Ezekiel, ask the rebellious people of Israel if they know what this story means. Tell them that the king of Babylonia came to Jerusalem, then he captured the king of Judah and his officials, and took them back to Babylon as prisoners.
translation_verse: “Bi ma atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ ke a nu abɛ ɔ sisi lo. De mɛ ke Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ba Yerusalem, nɛ e ba nuu ma a mi matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho Babilonia ya.

english_verse: He chose someone from the family of Judah's king and signed a treaty with him, then made him swear to be loyal. He also led away other important citizens,
translation_verse: E ngɔ matsɛ ɔ bi ko, nɛ e kɛ lɛ so; e ha e ka lɛ kita ke e maa ye lɛ anɔkuale. Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ zugba a nɔ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ kɛ ho,

english_verse: so that the rest of the people of Judah would obey only him and never gain control of their own country again.
translation_verse: konɛ matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔ nɛ ba si kulaa, nɛ e ko nyɛ nɛ e te si gblegbleegble kaa bɔ nɛ a so ɔ.

english_verse: But this new king of Judah later rebelled against Babylonia and sent officials to Egypt to get horses and troops. Will this king be successful in breaking the treaty with Babylonia? Or will he be punished for what he's done?
translation_verse: Se Yuda matsɛ ɔ tsɔ atuã; e tsɔ nihi kɛ ho Egipt ya, konɛ a ha lɛ okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta buli nɛ he hiɛ. Anɛ e ma nyɛ maa ye kunimi lo? Anɛ matsɛ nɛ ɔ yi ma na wami lo? Ke e yi somi ɔ nɔ ɔ, anɛ e yi ma na wami lo?”

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I swear that the king of Judah will die in Babylon, because he broke the treaty with the king of Babylonia, who appointed him king.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke Yuda matsɛ nɛ ɔ ma gbo ngɛ Babilonia, akɛnɛ somi nɛ e kɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ so, kɛ si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ, e yi nɔ ɔ. .

english_verse: Even the king of Egypt and his powerful army will be useless to Judah when the Babylonians attack and build towers and dirt ramps to destroy the cities of Judah and its people.
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi kaa Babilonia bi ɔmɛ fia kpokuhi, nɛ a ma mɔhi, konɛ a kɛ kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi tete po, Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɛ e ta babauu ɔ be he nɔ́ ko nyɛe maa pee ha lɛ.

english_verse: The king of Judah broke his own promises and ignored the treaty with Babylonia. And so he will be punished!
translation_verse: Somi nɛ e kɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ so, kɛ si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ, e yi nɔ. Enɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e yi be wami nae kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

english_verse: He made a promise in my name and swore to honor the treaty. And now that he has broken that promise, my name is disgraced. He must pay for what he's done.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I ka ye he kita kaa ligbi abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ somi nɛ e so, kɛ si nɛ e wo ɔ, e yi nɔ fɛɛ he je ɔ, ma gbla e tue kokooko.

english_verse: I will spread out a net to trap him. Then I will drag him to Babylon and see that he is punished for his unfaithfulness to me.
translation_verse: Ma tsɔ lɛ klama nɛ ma du lɛ. Ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Babilonia, nɛ ma ya gbla e tue ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa e yi mi anɔkuale.

english_verse: Someday, I, the Lord, will cut a tender twig from the top of a cedar tree, then plant it on the peak of Israel's tallest mountain,
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Imi nitsɛ ma kplɔ seda tso gagaa a yi mi, nɛ ma ya ma ngɛ he ko. Ma ya ma tso nɛ ɔ ngɛ yo gagaa ko nɔ.

english_verse: where it will grow strong branches and produce large fruit. All kinds of birds will find shelter under the tree, and they will rest in the shade of its branches.
translation_verse: Israel yo gagaa pe kulaa a nɔ ma ma ngɛ. E ma gba kɔnihi, nɛ e maa wo yiblii; e maa pee seda tso agbo kɛ e he fɛu. Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔto tsuo ma ba hi e hɔ̃ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Every tree in the forest will know that I, the Lord, can bring down tall trees and help short ones grow. I dry up green trees and make dry ones green. I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will keep my word.
translation_verse: Zugba a nɔ tso ɔmɛ tsuo maa le kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i haa tso gagaa peeɔ kpiti, nɛ tso kpiti kaa gagaa. Imi lɛ i haa tso mumu gbliɔ, nɛ tso gbigbli peeɔ tso mumu ekohu. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de, nɛ ma pee.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, I hear the people of Israel using the old saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: “Abɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ zugba a he, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ bue kpamisa ke, ‘Tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye wai yiblii ngmlikiti, nɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ mohu a lungu fĩa’ a, kɛ a ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Now tell them that I am the Lord God, and as surely as I live, that saying will no longer be used in Israel.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke, nyɛ be abɛ nɛ ɔ bue ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ hu.

english_verse: The lives of all people belong to me—parents as well as children. However, only those who sin will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ye níhi ji nimli ɔmɛ tsuo, tsɛ ɔ kɛ e bi ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ tsuo; nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ ma gbo.

english_verse: Suppose there is a truly good man who always does what is fair and right.
translation_verse: “Ke nɔ ko ji dalɔ ɔ, e yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: He refuses to eat meat sacrificed to foreign gods at local shrines or to worship Israel's idols. He doesn't have sex with someone else's wife or with a woman having her monthly period.
translation_verse: E ja we Israel amaga amɛ, nɛ e yi ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha mɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. Jehanɛ hu, e nyɛɛ we e nyɛminyumu e yo se nɛ e ble lɛ; nɛ e yɛ yo nɛ ku nine ngɔ.

english_verse: But suppose this good man has an evil son who is violent and commits sins
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ, ke nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ binyumuyo ojo fialɔ nɛ pueɔ muɔ si, nɛ e

english_verse: cheats the poor, and robs people. He keeps what is given to him as security for a loan. He worships idols, does disgusting things,
translation_verse: e waa ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ yi mi, e fiaa nihi ojo, e kpale we nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ba to awaba kɛ ha we nɔtsɛ, e jaa amagahi, e peeɔ ní hiemi níhi,

english_verse: and charges high interest when lending money. An evil man like that will certainly not live. He is the one who has done these horrible sins, so it's his own fault that he will be put to death.
translation_verse: nɛ e paa sika kɛ haa nɔ, nɛ e heɔ hekpa a, anɛ nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ yi nɛ na wami lo? Dɛbi! E yi be wami nae kɔkɔɔkɔ! Ní hiemi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ a he ɔ, e ma gbo. E gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: He doesn't eat meat at local shrines or worship Israel's idols, and he doesn't have sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: E ja we Israel amaga amɛ, nɛ e yi ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha mɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, e nyɛɛ we e nyɛminyumu e yo se nɛ e ble lɛ.

english_verse: and refuses to do anything evil or to charge interest. And he obeys all my laws and teachings. Such a man will live. His own father sinned, but this good man will not be put to death for the sins of his father.
translation_verse: E yɛ he nɛ a ngɛ yayami pee ngɛ, konɛ yayami ko sã lɛ. Ke e pa sika ha nɔ ko ɔ, e he we hekpa. E yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kikɛmɛ a binyumu nɛ ɔ be gboe ngɛ e tsɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he, se mohu, niinɛ, e yi ma na wami.

english_verse: You may wonder why a son isn't punished for the sins of his father. It is because the son does what is right and obeys my laws.
translation_verse: “Se nyɛ biɔ ke, Mɛni he je bi nɛ́ nɔ́ ngɛ e tsɛ yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he ɔ? Ke bi ko yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e yeɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, niinɛ, e yi ma na wami.

english_verse: Only those who sin will be put to death. Children won't suffer for the sins of their parents, and parents won't suffer for the sins of their children. Good people will be rewarded for what they do, and evil people will be punished for what they do.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ ma gbo. Bi be nɔ́ nae ngɛ e tsɛ yayamihi a he, nɛ tsɛ hu be nɔ́ nae ngɛ yayamihi nɛ e bi pee ɔ a he. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a ma na hiɔwo kpakpa, se nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, a maa gbla e tue ngɛ yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he!

english_verse: Suppose wicked people stop sinning and start obeying my laws and doing right. They won't be put to death.
translation_verse: “Ke yayami peelɔ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e yeɔ ye mlaa a nɔ, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e be gboe; niinɛ, e yi ma na wami.

english_verse: All their sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they did right.
translation_verse: A kɛ e yayami ɔmɛ tsuo maa pa lɛ; e yi ma na wami, ejakaa e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, don't like to see wicked people die. I had much rather see them turn back from their sins and live.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ bie ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Anɛ i naa yayami peelɔ ɔ gbenɔ he bua jɔmi lo?” “Dɛbi, nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ mohu ji kaa e maa kpale kɛ je e blɔ yayami ɔ nɔ, nɛ e yi nɛ na wami.

english_verse: But when good people start sinning and doing disgusting things, will they live? No! All their good deeds will be forgotten, and they will be put to death because of their sins.
translation_verse: “Se ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da jɔɔ kpakpa peemi, nɛ e bɔni ní hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ yayami peeli peeɔ peemi ɔ, anɛ e yi ma na wami lo? Dɛbi, kpakpa nɛ e pee sa a tsuo a be ekoeko kaie hu. E ma gbo ngɛ e tɔmi nɛ e tɔ, kɛ yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he.

english_verse: If good people start doing evil, they must be put to death, because they have sinned.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kpa nɔ́ nɛ da peemi, nɛ e ya pee yayami, nɛ e gbo ɔ, e gbo ngɛ e he yayami ɔ mi.

english_verse: They will think about what they've done and stop sinning, and so they won't be put to death.
translation_verse: Ejakaa jamɛatsɛ ɔ pia e he, nɛ e kpale kɛ je e tɔmi ɔmɛ a mi; niinɛ, e yi ma na wami, e be gboe.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and start thinking pure thoughts. And be faithful to me! Do you really want to be put to death for your sins?
translation_verse: Yayamihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ pee kɛ si mi ɔ, nyɛ sake mɛ ngɔ pue he. Nyɛ tsake, nɛ́ nyɛ na juɛmi he, kɛ tsui he. Israel ma, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ kpata a?

english_verse: I, the Lord God, don't want to see that happen to anyone. So stop sinning and live!
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i sume kaa nyɛ gbo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa yayami peemi, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Ezekiel, sing a funeral song for two of Israel's leaders:
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yawɛ de mi ke ma la kɔmɔ yemi la ko ha Israel ma ganɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: When the nations heard of him, they trapped him in a pit, then they used hooks to drag him to Egypt.
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ ba nu jata bi ɔ he. A tsua muɔ kɛ tsɔ lɛ klama; e nɔ mi, nɛ e du. A ngɔ gbowehi kɛ gbla lɛ kɛ ho Egipt zugba a nɔ ya.

english_verse: Nations plotted to kill him, and people came from all over to spread out a net and catch him in a trap.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo tsɔ lɛ klamahi kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. A bli a ya a mi ngɔ pue e nɔ. A tsua muɔ kɛ tsɔ lɛ klama; e nɔ mi, nɛ e du.

english_verse: They put him in a cage and took him to Babylonia. The lion was locked away, so that his mighty roar would never again be heard on Israel's hills.
translation_verse: A ngɔ gbowehi kɛ gbla lɛ kɛ wo daka ko mi, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ. A wo lɛ tsu ngɛ mɔ ɔ mi, konɛ a ko nu e gbi ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.

english_verse: Your mother was a vine like you, growing near a stream. There was plenty of water, so she was filled with branches and with lots of fruit.
translation_verse: O nyɛ ngɛ kaa wai tso ko nɛ a hia ya ma ngɛ pa tue. E ná nyu saminya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e gba kɔnihi, nɛ e wo yiblii kplanyaa.

english_verse: Her strong branches became symbols of authority, and she was taller than all other trees— everyone could see how strong and healthy she was.
translation_verse: E kɔni kake nɛ he wa pe kulaa a ba pee tso nɛ a kɛ peeɔ matsɛ tso; e ka pe tso kɔni kusukusuu ɔmɛ tsuo. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ na kaa tso nɛ ɔ ka saminya, nɛ e pee kusuu kɛ e kɔnihi babauu.

english_verse: But in anger, I pulled her up by the roots and threw her to the ground, where the scorching desert wind dried out her fruit. Her strong branches wilted and burned up.
translation_verse: Se a kɛ abofu hia wai tso nɛ ɔ, nɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ si. Ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ fia, nɛ e ha nɛ tso ɔ gbli, nɛ e yiblii tsuo kplɔ pue si; tso agbo ɔ nitsɛ hu gbli, nɛ a kɛ la sã.

english_verse: where her stem caught fire, and flames burned her branches and fruit. Not one strong branch is left; she is stripped bare. This funeral song must be sung with sorrow.
translation_verse: La ba sɛ tso kɔni ɔmɛ a mi; e sã kɔni ɔmɛ, kɛ e yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo. La a sã tso nɛ he wa a hulɔ. Tso kpakpa nɛ maa si kaa tso nɛ a kɛ peeɔ matsɛ tso ɔ be hu. Kɔmɔ yemi la nɛ a pɔɔ lami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, some of Israel's leaders came to me on the tenth day of the fifth month. They sat down and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a jeha kpaagone ɔ we nyɔhiɔ enuɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma a, Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ ba ye ngɔ. A ba konɛ a ba bi Yawɛ gbi. I ha mɛ sɛ, nɛ a hi si.

english_verse: Just then, the Lord God said:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these leaders have come to find out what I want them to do. As surely as I live, I will not give them an answer of any kind.
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ o de mɛ ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ kaa a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bi nɛ ɔ lo? I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke i be kplɛɛe nɛ nyɛ bi mi ní. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: Are you willing to warn them, Ezekiel? Then remind them of the disgusting sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, o maa kojo mɛ lo? Ke jã a, lɛɛ ha nɛ a le ní hiemi níhi nɛ a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsu.

english_verse: Tell them that long ago I, the Lord God, chose Israel to be my own. I appeared to their ancestors in Egypt and made a solemn promise that I would be their God and the God of their descendants.
translation_verse: De mɛ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ. Benɛ i hla Israel ma a, i wo mɛ si ko. I je ye he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ Egipt, nɛ i de mɛ ke, imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I swore that I would rescue them from Egypt and lead them to a land I had already chosen. This land was rich with milk and honey and was the most splendid land of all.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, i ka mɛ kita ke ma je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ya zugba ko nɛ i hla ha mɛ, zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya, nɛ e ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa nɔ.

english_verse: I told them to get rid of their disgusting idols and not to sin by worshiping the gods of Egypt. I reminded them that I was the Lord their God,
translation_verse: I de mɛ ke yakayaka mawuhi nɛ a suɔ nɛ ɔ, a sake mɛ ngɔ pue he, se a ko ngɔ Egipt amagahi kɛ ble a he; ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: but they still rebelled against me. They refused to listen and kept on worshiping their idols and foreign gods. In my anger, I decided to punish the Israelites in Egypt.
translation_verse: Se a tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã; a kplɛɛ we nɛ a bu mi tue; nɔ ko nɔ ko sakee we yakayaka ní ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he; a hɛɛ Egipt amaga amɛ a mi wawɛɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma ha nɛ a nu ye we abofu gbeyegbeye ɔ he ngɛ Egipt.

english_verse: So I brought them out and led them into the desert.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba nga a nɔ.

english_verse: I gave them my laws and teachings, so they would know how to live right.
translation_verse: I wo mɛ mlaahi, nɛ i tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ ke a ye nɔ ɔ, a yi ma na wami.

english_verse: But the Israelites rebelled against me in the desert. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath like any other day. Then in my anger, I decided to destroy the Israelites in the desert once and for all.
translation_verse: Se Israel ma a tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã ngɛ nga a nɔ. A yi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ; a bui mɛ kaa níhi nɛ ke nɔmlɔ ye a nɔ ɔ, e yi ma na wami. A ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ hu kpɔtɔɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma ha nɛ a nu ye we abofu gbeyegbeye ɔ he ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: But that would have disgraced me, because many other nations had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Se i ha we nɛ e ba mi ja, ejakaa je ma amɛ nɛ na bɔ nɛ i kpaka ye ma a kɛ je Egipt ɔ, ye biɛ he guɛ ma gbo ngɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Instead, I told them in the desert that I would not lead them into the beautiful, fertile land I had promised.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, i ka mɛ kita ngɛ nga a nɔ ke zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya, nɛ e ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa nɛ i ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ, i kɛ mɛ be lejɛ ɔ yae hu,

english_verse: I said this because they had not only ignored my laws and teachings, but had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped idols.
translation_verse: ejakaa a kua ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ a yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. A ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ hu kpɔtɔɔ. Ejakaa a suɔ wawɛɛ kaa a ma ja amaga amɛ mohu.

english_verse: Yet, I felt sorry for them and could not let them die in the desert.
translation_verse: “Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i na mɛ mɔbɔ; i kpataa we a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ.

english_verse: So I warned the children not to act like their parents or follow their evil ways or worship their idols.
translation_verse: Se i bɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ kɔkɔ mohu ke, mlaahi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ wo ɔ, nyɛ ko ye a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko ngɔ a we amaga amɛ kɛ ble nyɛ he.

english_verse: I reminded them that I was the Lord their God and that they should obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: I told them to respect my Sabbath to show that they were my people and that I was the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ a ba pee okadi nɛ ngɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But I did not. That would have disgraced me in front of the nations that had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Se i ha we nɛ e ba mi ja; ejakaa je ma amɛ nɛ na bɔ nɛ i kpaka ye ma a kɛ je Egipt ɔ, ye biɛ he guɛ ma gbo ngɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: because they had disobeyed my laws and ignored my teachings; they had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped the idols their ancestors had made.
translation_verse: I pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa a bui ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ ye mlaa amɛ hu, a yi nɔ; jehanɛ hu, a ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ, nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ mohu a suɔ wawɛɛ.

english_verse: and I let them offer me unacceptable sacrifices, including their first-born sons. I did this to horrify them and to let them know that I, the Lord, was punishing them.
translation_verse: I ha nɛ a ngɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bɔhi kɛ ble a he, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bitɛtehi hu kɛ sã bɔ. I ngɔ enɛ ɔ kɛ gbla a tue, konɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: by offering sacrifices, incense, and wine to gods on every hill and under every large tree. I was very angry, because they did these things in the land I had given them!
translation_verse: I ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba zugba nɛ i wo si kaa ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ. Se he tsuaa he nɛ a na yoku gojoo, aloo tso nɛ bɔ kusuu ngɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ a ya sã bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A sã bɔhi nɛ jee via, kɛ wai bɔ hulɔ; a pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo ye mi mi la.

english_verse: I asked them where they went to worship those gods, and they answered, “At the local shrines.” And those places of worship are still called shrines.
translation_verse: I bi mɛ ke, he gojoohi nɛ nyɛ yaa a, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ? ‘He gojoohi’ nɛ ɔ ba pee biɛ nɛ a kɛ tsɛɔ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: by worshiping idols and by sacrificing their own children as offerings. They commit these sins and still think they can ask me for a message. As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will give them no answer.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po, nyɛ ngɔɔ nike níhi kɛ ya haa amagahi, nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ ngɔ haa nɛ a sã mɛ ngɛ la mi; nyɛ jaa amagahi babauu kɛ bleɔ nyɛ he. Israel bi, enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, nyɛ kpale baa ke a bi mi ní ha nyɛ. I be kplɛɛe nɛ nɔ ko ba bi mi ní ha nyɛ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: They may think they can be like other nations and get away with worshiping idols made of wood and stone. But that will never happen! The Lord Promises To Restore Israel The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Nyɛ pee nyɛ yi mi momo ke nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa pee nyɛ he kaa je ma kpa amɛ. Nyɛ maa pee kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba kpahi a nɔ nɛ a jaa tso kɛ tɛ ɔ. Dɛbi, dɛbi! E be mi bae ja kɔkɔɔkɔ. Mawu gblaa nɔ tue, nɛ Mawu ngɔɔ yayami nɛ nɔ pee kɛ paa

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will rule over you with my powerful arm. You will feel my fierce anger
translation_verse: “Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke i ngɛ nyɛ si woe kaa ma ngɔ abofu, kɛ nine si wami tsuo kɛ ye nyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: and lead you into a desert surrounded by nations. I will meet you there face to face. Then I will pass judgment on you
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya ‘Je ma amɛ a nga a nɔ.’ Ma kojo nyɛ, nɛ ma bu nyɛ fɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: and punish you, just as I punished your ancestors in the desert near Egypt.
translation_verse: Ma kojo nyɛ nɛ ma bu nyɛ fɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: I will force each of you to obey the regulations of our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: “Ye nine si maa wa ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ ma ha nyɛ maa ye ye somi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I will separate the sinful rebels from the rest of you, and even though I will bring them from the nations where they live in exile, they won't be allowed to return to Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ma je atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ tɔ̃ ye nɔ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti. A maa je zugba nɔ he nɛ a ya to nibwɔ ngɛ ɔ mohu, se a be Israel zugba a nɔ bae, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

english_verse: Go ahead and worship your idols for now, you Israelites, because soon I will no longer let you dishonor me by offering gifts to them. You will have no choice but to obey me!
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ Israel bi, nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ya sɔmɔ e we amagahi. Se pee se ɔ, nyɛ maa bu mi tue kɛ̃; nyɛ be nyɛ we amaga amɛ ngɔe kɛ ble ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ hu.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone in Israel will worship me on Mount Zion, my holy mountain in Jerusalem. I will once again call you my own, and I will accept your sacred offerings and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ye yo klɔuklɔu nɛ ji Israel yo gagaa a nɔ nyɛ Israel bi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ma ba ja mi ngɛ. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma ná nyɛ he tsui ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nyɛ maa ngɔ nike ní slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba, sami bɔ ɔmɛ, nike ní kpakpa pe kulaa amɛ, kɛ bɔ klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.

english_verse: When I bring you home from the places where you are now scattered, I will be pleased with you, just as I am pleased with the smell of the smoke from your sacrifices. Every nation on earth will see that I am holy,
translation_verse: Ke i je nyɛ kɛ je je mahi a nɔ hehi nɛ a gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a, nɛ i ba bua nyɛ nya a, ma ná nyɛ he tsui kaa bɔ nɛ he via, nɛ je ma amɛ maa na kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: and you will know that I, the Lord, am the one who brought you back to Israel, the land I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Zugba a nɛ i ka nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ke ma ngɔ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ, ke i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ ma na maa le kaa niinɛ, imi ji Yawɛ.

english_verse: Then you will remember your wicked sins, and you will hate yourselves for doing such horrible things. They have made you unacceptable to me,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma kai nyɛ blɔ yaya amɛ, kɛ nyɛ ní peemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ kɛ ble nyɛ he ɔ. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he maa nyɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ a he.

english_verse: so you deserve to be punished. But I will treat you in a way that will bring honor to my name, and you will know that I am the Lord God. Fire from the South
translation_verse: Nyɛ Israel bi, nyɛ maa na hu kaa ye biɛ Yawɛ ɔ, i sume kaa e puɛ. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i kɛ nyɛ to we ní ngɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ nɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de. La ngɛ tsoe ngɛ leneyi je

english_verse: that I, the Lord God, will start a fire that will burn up every tree, whether green or dry. Nothing will be able to put out the blaze of that fire as it spreads to the north and burns everything in its path.
translation_verse: De leneyi je hue ɔ ke nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ɔ, e bu tue saminya. Hyɛ, ma slɛ la ngɛ o mi, nɛ e maa sã o tso mumu, kɛ tso gbigbli ɔmɛ tsuo. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe maa gbe la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam nɛ ɔ. E maa sã nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ e blɔ ɔ mi kɛ maa je leneyi je kɛ yaa su omleyi je tɔɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will know that I started it, and that it cannot be stopped.”
translation_verse: Nimli adesahi tsuo maa na kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i mɛ hue ɔ he la a nɛ, nɛ a be nyɛe maa gbe.”

english_verse: But I complained, “Lord God, I don't want to do that! People already say I confuse them with my messages.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i kpa pɛɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ko ha nɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ dee ngɛ ye he momo ke, nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ pi abɛ kɛkɛ nɛ e buɔ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the places in Jerusalem where people worship. Warn everyone in Israel
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Yerusalem. Fiɛ tsɔɔ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ o gba kɛ si Israel zugba a ke,

english_verse: that I am about to punish them. I will pull out my sword and have it ready to kill everyone, whether good or evil.
translation_verse: imi Yawɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji i kɛ mo ná. Ma hia ye klaate kɛ je e kpo ɔ mi, nɛ ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi, dalɔ jio, yayami peelɔ jio.

english_verse: When they ask why you are groaning, tell them you have terrifying news that will make them faint and tremble in fear and lose all courage. These things will happen soon. I, the Lord God, make this promise! A Sword Is Ready To Attack Israel
translation_verse: Ke a bi mo nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mo pee loko o ngɛ kɛmɛe kɛ aywilɛho wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, de mɛ ke sane nɛ ma a nya wa tsɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ tsui maa po; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nine mi maa je wu; nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee vii ngɛ e mi; nɛ nakutso tsuaa nakutso mi maa jɔ kaa nyu. Be ɔ ma, e su ta, nɛ e maa ba mi amlɔ nɔuu.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Jerusalem: I have sharpened my sword to slaughter you; it is shiny and will flash like lightning! Don't celebrate— punishment is coming, because everyone has ignored my warnings.
translation_verse: A duɔ klaate ɔ nya, konɛ a kɛ kpata nihi a hɛ mi; a sa he, konɛ e kpɛ nylamnylam kaa oslabai. Ye ma a be nyɛe ma nyá, ejakaa a bui ye munyu ɔmɛ; a tue nɛ i gbla wawɛɛ ɔ tsuo pee yaka.

english_verse: I am testing my people, and they can do nothing to stop me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: I ngɛ ye ma a kae ma hyɛ; ke a kplɛɛ we kaa a tsake ɔ, lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba a nɔ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, warn my people, then celebrate my victory by clapping your hands. My vicious sword will attack again and again, killing my people with every stroke.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa nɛ o fia o dɛ mi. Fɔ̃ klaate ɔ si etɛ. Klaate nɛ gbeɔ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Klaate nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi lɛ ngɛ e he poe kɛ ngɛ ma a bɔlee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They will lose all courage and stumble with fear. My slaughtering sword is waiting at every gate, flashing and ready to kill.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ sawale nɛ nu ye ma a, nɛ nihi fuu a hɛ mi nɛ kpata a, i ngɔ klaate nɛ he ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam kaa oslabai nɛ gbee nɔ hulɔ kɛ tsɔɔ ma a.

english_verse: Then I will stop being angry, and I will clap my hands in victory. I, the Lord, have spoken. The King of Babylonia and His Sword
translation_verse: Imi hu ma fia ye dɛ, nɛ ye we abofu ɔ se maa po. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Babilonia matsɛ ɔ klaate ɔ

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, mark two roads for the king of Babylonia to follow when he comes with his sword. The roads will begin at the same place, but be sure to put up a signpost where the two roads separate and go in different directions.
translation_verse: E de ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tɛni gbɛjegbɛ enyɔ nɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ kɛ e dɛ mi klaate ɔ maa nyɛɛ nɔ kɛ ba. Ha nɛ blɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je zugba kake nɔ kɛ ba. Ngɔɔ okadi kɛ to blɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ a he so ngɛ ma a nya he nɛ blɔ ɔmɛ gba ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Clearly mark where the two roads lead. One goes to Rabbah, the capital of Ammon, and the other goes to Jerusalem, the fortified capital of Judah.
translation_verse: Okadi kake maa tsɔɔ matsɛ ɔ blɔ nɛ yaa Amon bi ɔmɛ a ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Raba a, nɛ kake hu maa tsɔɔ blɔ nɛ yaa Yerusalem, Yuda ma nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he ɔ.

english_verse: When the Babylonian king stands at that signpost, he will decide which way to go by shaking his arrows, by asking his idols, and by carefully looking at the liver of a sacrificed animal.
translation_verse: Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma ba da si ngɛ blɔ gbla a nya, konɛ e kla kɛ hla blɔ nɛ e maa gu. E ma huanya e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ; e ma bi ní ngɛ amaga amɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e maa hyɛ lohwe nɛ a gbe ɔ fafali mi.

english_verse: His right hand will pull out the arrow marked “Jerusalem.” Then he will immediately give the signal to shout the battle cry, to build dirt ramps up to the top of the city walls, to break down its walls and gates with large wooden poles, and to kill the people.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi ɔ maa tsɔɔ Yerusalem. E maa tsɔɔ lɛ kaa e ya fia gbogbo kumi kpoku kɛ wo ma a he; e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e he ose wawɛɛ; e ngɔ gbogbo kumi níhi kɛ to agbo ɔmɛ a nya; e fia kpokuhi, nɛ e ma mɔhi.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem had promised to be loyal to Babylonia, and so none of them will believe that this could happen to them. But Babylonia's king will remind them of their sinful ways and warn them of their coming captivity.
translation_verse: Se enɛ ɔ maa pee kaa yaka gbami ngɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; ejakaa a so nɛ a ka kita ngɔ fɔ nɔ momo kaa huɛmɛ ji mɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, gbami ɔ maa bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a maa le kaa a ma ba nuu mɛ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, tell the people of Jerusalem and their ruler that I, the Lord God, am saying: Everything you do is wicked and shows how sinful you are. You are guilty and will be taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nyɛ ha a kai nyɛ tɔmi ɔmɛ; a je kpo paa ngɛ nihi tsuo a hɛ mi; mɛ tsuo a na kaa nyɛ yeɔ fɔ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, yayami sɔuu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha nyɛ he nyɛli maa nuu nyɛ nine nya.

english_verse: And now, you evil and wicked ruler of Israel, your day of final punishment is almost here.
translation_verse: “Nɛ mo, Israel ganɔ, nɔmlɔ yayami, kɛ yiwutsotsɛ, o nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; be nɛ a maa gbla o tue wawɛɛ ɔ su jehanɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, command you to take off your royal turban and your crown, because everything will be different. Those who had no power will be put in charge, and those who now rule will become nobodies.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Pɛne o yi fimi nɔ́ ɔ, je matsɛ pɛɛ ɔ ngɛ o yi! Níhi ma tsake; bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, a be ja hie hu; nɔ́ nɛ ba si ɔ a ma wo nɔ; nɔ́ nɛ a wo nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si! Wó ni guhi nɔ yeli. Ha nɛ nɔ yeli nɛ ba pee ni guhi!

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, the Ammonites have insulted Israel, so condemn them and tell them I am saying: A sword is drawn, ready to slaughter; it is polished and prepared to kill as fast as lightning.
translation_verse: “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa, nɛ o fiɛ ke Amon bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Israel hɛ mi si puee ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke, ‘A hia klaate ko nɛ a kɛ ma kpata nihi a hɛ mi. A sa klaate ɔ he, nɛ e ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam kaa oslabai, konɛ a kɛ gbe nihi.

english_verse: You wicked Ammonites see false visions and believe untrue messages. But your day of punishment is coming soon, and my sword will slaughter you!
translation_verse: Ninahi nɛ nyɛ na a tsuo, lakpa sɔuu; gbamihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ gbae ɔ hu jã kɛ̃. Nyɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ yayami pɛ nyɛ peeɔ, nyɛ be ɔ su ta; be nɛ a maa gbla nyɛ tue ɔ ma oo! A kɛ klaate ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.’

english_verse: Your days to punish others are over, so put your swords away. You will be punished in the land of your birth.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ke, ‘Kpale klaate ɔ se kɛ wo e kpo ɔ mi! Dɛbi! He nɛ a bɔ nyɛ ade ngɛ, zugba nɔ he nɛ a fɔ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ.

english_verse: My furious anger will scorch you like fire, and I will hand you over to cruel men who are experts in killing.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maa nu ye abofu nɛ nya wa a he, be mi nɛ ma gli kɛ wo nyɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam. Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ wo dikali nɛ le ga nɛ a kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi a dɛ mi.

english_verse: You will be burned and will die in your own land. Then you will be forgotten forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: A kɛ la maa sã nyɛ. A ma pue nyɛ muɔ si ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ kaie gblegbleegble.’ ” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, are you ready to condemn Jerusalem? That city is filled with murderers, so remind the people of their sins
translation_verse: nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ o pee klaalo nɛ o maa kojo ma nɛ muɔ si pɛ a pueɔ ngɛ mi ɔ lo? Ke jã a, lɛɛ ha nɛ e le ní hiemi níhi nɛ e pee ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: and tell them I am saying: Jerusalem, you have murdered many of your own people and have worshiped idols. You will soon be punished!
translation_verse: De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ dee ji, mo ma nɛ o pue muɔ si babauu, nɛ o puɛ amagahi nɛ o ja mɛ kɛ ble o he, o be ɔ su ta.

english_verse: Those crimes have made you guilty, and the idols have made you unacceptable to me. So your final punishment is near. Other nations will laugh at you and make insulting remarks,
translation_verse: O yeɔ fɔ kaa o pue muɔ si, nɛ o puɛ amagahi, nɛ o ja mɛ kɛ ble o he. Hyɛ, o ha nɛ o nyagbe ɔ na mo haa! O be ɔ su. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ha je ma amɛ ngɛ mo ahlua bɔe, nɛ zugba amɛ tsuo ngɛ o he fɛu yee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: None of you honor your parents, and you cheat foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be ma a mi nɛ buɔ e fɔli. O yeɔ nibwɔhi amimi, nɛ o waa awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi hu yi mi.

english_verse: You show no respect for my sacred places and treat the Sabbath just like any other day.
translation_verse: O gbeɔ ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he guɛ, nɛ o bleɔ ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ.

translation_verse: Ni komɛ yeɔ lakpa ngɛ ma a mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpata a nyɛmimɛ a hɛ mi. Ni komɛ ya yeɔ niye ní bɔhi nɛ a sã ngɛ jami hehi; nɛ ni komɛ hu dii he lo akɔnɔ se wawɛɛ.

translation_verse: Nyɛ ti ni komɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní nɛ a kɛ pueɔ muɔ si. Ni komɛ paa sika kɛ haa a nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛhi, nɛ a heɔ hekpa fuu ngɛ a dɛ kɛ naa a he kpɔtɔɔ. Nɛ a hɛ je ye nɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

translation_verse: Ke i kɛ mo ná a, anɛ o ma nyɛ maa to tsui si, nɛ o maa pee kã kɛ ya si nyagbe lo? Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de, nɛ ma pee hulɔ.

translation_verse: O hɛ mi ma pue si ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi; se moo lɛɛ, o ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Mawu maa tsu Israel he ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi

translation_verse: E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, Israel ma a he be se nami ha mi! A ngɛ kaa sika fĩ nɛ jeɔ akɔblee, sika hiɔ, dade, loo sumui mi, ke a tsu he se ɔ.

translation_verse: E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ligbi ɔ nɛ ye mi mi ma fu ɔ, nyɛ maa pee kaa zugba nɛ a hu we, nɛ́ hiɔmi hu nɛ́ ngɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Their leaders are like roaring lions, tearing apart their victims. They put people to death, then steal everything of value. Husbands are killed, and many women are left as widows.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ ya so, nɛ a pee a he kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huãe nɛ ngɛ lohwe nɛ e gbe mi tsɔtslɔɔe. A gbee nihi, nɛ a ngɔɔ a sika, kɛ a weto ní tsuo ngɛ a dɛ. Nyumuhi babauu nɛ a gbe ɔ ha yalɔyihi hu a he ba hiɛ ngɛ ma a mi.

english_verse: The priests of Israel ignore my Law! Not only do they refuse to respect any of my sacred things, but they don't even teach the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary or between what is clean and what is unclean. They treat my Sabbath like any other day, and so my own people no longer honor me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔmɛ plɛɔ ye mlaa a hɛ mi buɔ si, nɛ a bleɔ ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. A li slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu, kɛ nɔ́ gu a kpɛti. A tsɔɔ we ni ɔmɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ we a kpɛti. A kuɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ bui mi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Israel's officials are like ferocious wolves, ripping their victims apart. They make a dishonest living by injuring and killing people.
translation_verse: Ganɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa ogbeteehi nɛ ngɛ a de lo mi tsɔtslɔɔe. A gbeɔ nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na ní yaka.

english_verse: And then the prophets in Israel cover up these sins by giving false visions. I have never spoken to them, but they lie and say they have a message from me.
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ laa yayamihi a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ kalo saa gbogbo he. Lakpa ninahi a naa, nɛ a gbami ɔmɛ hu lakpa sɔuu. A deɔ ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ tsɔ mɛ, be mi nɛ imi Yawɛ, i de we mɛ nɔ́ ko kulaa.

english_verse: The people themselves cheat and rob; they abuse the poor and take advantage of foreigners.
translation_verse: Zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo yeɔ amimi, nɛ a haa níhi; a waa dɛgutsɛ, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi. A yeɔ nubwɔ amimi wawɛɛ nitsɛ nɛ a yɛ se.

english_verse: I looked for someone to defend the city and to protect it from my anger, as well as to stop me from destroying it. But I found no one.
translation_verse: I hla nɔ ko nɛ maa po piɛ kɛ wo a he, loo nɛ e maa tsi puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ mi ɔ ha ma a, konɛ ma ko puɛ zugba a, se i nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish the Israelites for what they have done, and they will know that I am furious. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ abofu nɛ nya wa kɛ gbla a tue. Ye mi mi la a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ a ní yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ a he!” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.

english_verse: The older one was named Oholah, which stands for Samaria; the younger one was Oholibah, which stands for Jerusalem. They became my wives and gave birth to my children.
translation_verse: Nɔkɔtɔma a biɛ ji Ohola, nɛ e senɔ ɔ biɛ ji Oholiba. I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ pee ye yihi, nɛ a fɔ bimɛ nyumuhi kɛ yihi ha mi. Biɛ Ohola a daa si ha Samaria, nɛ Oholiba hu daa si ha Yerusalem.

english_verse: Even though Oholah was my wife, she continued to be a prostitute and chased after Assyrian lovers.
translation_verse: Ohola je ye se ya puɛ gba. E kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ je Asiria mohu ya pee e suɔli.

translation_verse: Ohola kɛ Asiria nyumuhi nɛ ngɛ biɛ bɔ ajuama, nɛ e ja a we amagahi kɛ ble e he.

english_verse: Once she started doing these things in Egypt, she never stopped. Men slept with her, and she was always ready for sex.
translation_verse: Yahomi nɛ e je sisi kɛ je e yihe mi ngɛ Egipt, he nɛ a fiɛ e nyɔ he, nɛ a kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama nɛ a puɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ, e kpa we.

english_verse: So I gave Oholah to the Assyrian lovers she wanted so badly.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo Asiria bi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ e suɔ wawɛɛ ɔ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: They ripped off her clothes, then captured her children and killed her. Women everywhere talked about what had happened to Oholah.
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ kpa e he bo, nɛ a ngɔ e bimɛ nyumu ɔmɛ kɛ yi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ, a kɛ klaate gbe lɛ. E tue gblami nɛ ɔ ba pee fɛu yemi nɔ́ ha yihi tsuo.

english_verse: Oholibah saw all this, but she was more sinful and wanted sex more than her sister Oholah ever did.
translation_verse: “Oholiba na nɔ́ nɛ ba awenyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, se e ya nɔ nɛ e bɔ ajuama kulaa pe lɛ.

english_verse: As soon as she looked at them, she wanted to have sex with them. And so, she sent messengers to bring them to her.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e na a foni ɔmɛ ɔ, a he pee lɛ akɔnɔ, nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya tsɛ mɛ ngɛ Babilonia tɔɔ.

english_verse: Men from Babylonia came and had sex with her so many times that she got disgusted with them.
translation_verse: Babilonia nyumu ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba hwɔ bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ. A pee lɛ basabasa, nɛ a ble lɛ kɛ ya si a he pee lɛ tai.

english_verse: She let everyone see her naked body and didn't care if they knew she was a prostitute. That's why I turned my back on her, just as I had done with her older sister.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ngɛ ajuama bɔe wawɛɛ, nɛ e ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ na le kaa yaholɔ nitsɛnitsɛ ji lɛ ɔ, imi hu e sane ba gbe ye nya jehanɛ; i sume lɛ hu, kaa bɔ nɛ i sume e nyɛmiyo nɔkɔtɔma a.

english_verse: Oholibah didn't stop there, but became even more immoral and acted as she had back in Egypt.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e bɔ ajuama a; e pee e he yaholɔ kulaa. E kai e yihe mi, benɛ e bɔ ajuama basaa ngɛ Egipt ɔ.

english_verse: She eagerly wanted to go to bed with Egyptian men, who were famous for their sexual powers.
translation_verse: E kai e suɔli nɛ a nyumu tso kle kaa tejihi a nɔ́, nɛ a he mi abua nya wa kaa okpɔngɔ kuhi a nɔ́ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord God said: Oholibah, though you no longer want to be around your lovers, they will surround you like enemies, when I turn them against you.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Oholiba, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: O suɔli ɔmɛ a sane ba gbe o nya nɛ o sume mɛ hu; se ma ha a maa te si kɛ wo mo; a ma ba sa o yi.

english_verse: I will gather all the handsome young officials and the high-ranking cavalry officers from Babylonia and Assyria, as well as from the Chaldean tribes of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ Kaldea bi ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ je Pekod, Shoa, kɛ Koa kɛ ba; Asiria bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba. Amlaalohi, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ, mɛ tsuo nihewi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu, tsɔli nikɔtɔmahi, kɛ ta buli, mɛ tsuo a maa hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Their large armies will come from the north with chariots and wagons carrying weapons. They will wear shields and helmets and will surround you, and I will let them judge and sentence you according to their own laws.
translation_verse: Ta buli kɛ a ta zugba lɛhi babauu, kɛ a tlɔɔkehi kɛ a mi tlomi maa je omleyi je kɛ ba tua mo. A kɛ tsɛ̃i agbohi, tsɛ̃i wawi, kɛ dade pɛɛ ma gba ta kɛ wo o he. Ma ha a maa kojo mo ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a mlaa nya.

english_verse: I am angry with you, so I will let them be very cruel. They will cut off your nose and ears; they will kill your children and burn alive anyone in your family who survives.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ o wo ye mi mi la he je ɔ, a kɛ abofu maa gbla o tue. A maa poo o gugwɔ, kɛ o tuehi ngɛ o he; a kɛ klaate maa gbe ni komɛ. Ee, a maa ngɔ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ kɛ ho, nɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, a maa sã mɛ.

english_verse: Your clothes and jewelry will be torn off.
translation_verse: A ma kplɔ o he tade, nɛ a maa ngɔ o june saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: I will stop your wickedness and the prostitution you started back in Egypt. You will never want to think about those days again.
translation_verse: Ma ha o yahomi, kɛ ajuama bɔmi basaa nɛ o hɛɛ mi kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ se maa po kulaa. O be amagahi hyɛe, nɛ o be Egipt bi ɔmɛ kaie gblegbleegble hu.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, am ready to hand you over to those hateful enemies that you find so disgusting.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ngɔ mo ngɔ wo o he nyɛli a dɛ mi, nihi nɛ a he pee mo tai, nɛ o sume mɛ hu ɔ,

english_verse: They will cruelly take away everything you have worked for and strip you naked. Then everyone will see you for the prostitute you really are. Your own vulgar sins
translation_verse: a kɛ mo maa ye kaa a he nyɛlɔ. Níhi babauu nɛ o gbo he dengme ɔ tsuo a maa muɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ma si mo ngɔ fɔ si kɛ o he gu saplapaa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi maa na o yahomi, kɛ ajuama bɔmi basaa a tsuo paa. O pee o he yaholɔ,

english_verse: You have turned out no better than your older sister, and now you must drink from the cup filled with my anger.
translation_verse: O ya wo o nyɛmiyo ɔ nane, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tue gblami kplu ɔ nɛ i ha o nyɛmi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu ma ha mo.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, gave your sister a large, deep cup filled with my anger. And when you drink from that cup, you will be mocked and insulted.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “O nyɛmiyo ɔ kplu ɔ kle; e mi kuɔ hulɔ. O maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ tsuo. A maa muɔ mo, a maa ye o he fɛu, ejakaa kplu ɔ hyi buɛii.

english_verse: You will end up drunk and devastated, because that cup is filled with horror and ruin.
translation_verse: E ma ha o maa pee basaa kaa nɔ nɛ tɔ dã. Gbeye níhi, kɛ he hiami níhi sɔuu lɛ ngɛ o nyɛmiyo Samaria kplu ɔ mi.

english_verse: But you must drink every drop! Then smash the cup and chew on its broken pieces. Use them to cut your breasts in sorrow. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ma ha o maa nu, nɛ o ma lɔ kplu ɔ mi. O kɛ he hiami maa fa o yi bwɔmi, nɛ o kɛ kplu kokoe ɔmɛ maa plaa o nyɔ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

english_verse: You have completely rejected me, and so I promise that you will be punished for the disgusting things you did as a prostitute. The Two Sisters Are Condemned
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “O hɛ je ye nɔ, nɛ o plɛ se ngɔ wo mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o maa na o yahomi, kɛ o we ajuama bɔmi ɔ mi nɔ́.” Mawu gbla nyɛmiyi enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a tue

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, it's time for you to tell Oholah and Oholibah that they are guilty. Remind them of their evil ways!
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ o maa kojo Ohola kɛ Oholiba lo? Lɛɛ, tsɔɔ mɛ ní hiemi níhi gbegbeegbe nɛ a pee ɔ.

english_verse: They have been unfaithful by worshiping idols, and they have committed murder by sacrificing my own children as offerings to idols.
translation_verse: A puɛ gba kɛ a we amaga jami ɔ; a pue muɔ si, nɛ binyumuwi nɛ a fɔ ha mi ɔ po a kɛ mɛ sã bɔ ha amagahi.

english_verse: They came into my temple that same day, and that made it unfit as a place to worship me. They have even stopped respecting the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ejakaa benɛ a gbe ye bimɛ ɔmɛ ha a we amaga amɛ ɔ, a ba ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a ba ble lejɛ ɔ!

english_verse: They sent messengers to attract men from far away. When those men arrived, the two sisters bathed themselves and put on eye shadow and jewelry.
translation_verse: “Be komɛ po ɔ, a maa tsɔ nihi kɛ ya tsitsaa ya tsɛ nyumuhi kɛ ba ha mɛ. Ke a ba a, nyɛmiyi enyɔ ɔmɛ maa du a he; a ma kpa a hɛ se tsopa, nɛ a kɛ june ma dla a he.

english_verse: They sat on a fancy couch, and in front of them was a table for the olive oil and incense that had belonged to me.
