Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ to mɛ setsɔsetsɔ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya pue leneyi je ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Dan Asher Naftali Manase Efraim Ruben Yuda. Zugba a fa ko nɛ a je blɔ si ngɛ kpɛti ɔ

english_verse: South of Judah's territory will be a special section of land. Its length will be twelve and a half kilometers, and its width will run from the eastern border of Israel west to the Mediterranean Sea. My temple will be located in this section of land.
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ tsa Yuda nɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, á si kɛ fɔ si ha ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ ko. E blimi nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa kɛ je omleyi je kɛ yaa si leneyi je. E kami nɛ pee kaa wɛtso kake zugba kami pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya si bonyoku je.

english_verse: An area in the center of this land will belong to me. It will be twelve and a half kilometers long and ten kilometers wide.
translation_verse: Nyɛ susu he ko pɔtɛɛ ngɛ zugba a kpɛti, nɛ nyɛɛ gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ. E kami nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi nɛ pee si tomi ekpa kɛ fa.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give half of my sacred land to the priests. Their share will be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide, and my temple will be right in the middle.
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ ɔ fa ko maa pee osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́. Kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa bonyoku je ɔ, e pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ yaa leneyi je ɔ, e pee si tomi etɛ kɛ fa. Yawɛ we ɔ maa ma zugba a kpɛti.

english_verse: Only priests who are descendants of Zadok will receive a share of this sacred land, because they remained faithful to me when the Levites and the rest of the Israelites started sinning.
translation_verse: Á ngɔ he klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ je Zadok weku ɔ mi ɔ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ benɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a weku ɔ mi ni komɛ ya piɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ pee yayami ɔ, a tsu a blɔ nya ní pɛpɛɛpɛ ha mi.

english_verse: The land belonging to the priests will be the most sacred area and will lie south of the area that belongs to the Levites.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zugba pɔtɛɛ nɛ tsa Levi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ pee Zadok weku ɔ nɔ́. Nɛ zugba nɛ ɔ maa pee he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.

english_verse: I will give the other half of my sacred land to the Levites. Their share will also be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide,
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ zugba ko ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ leneyi je. E kami kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa bonyoku je nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi kɛ je omleyi je kɛ yaa leneyi je nɛ pee si tomi etɛ kɛ fa.

english_verse: South of my sacred land will be a section twelve and a half kilometers long and three kilometers wide. It will not be sacred, but will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem, together with its houses and pastureland.
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ maa piɛ, nɛ e blimi maa pee si tomi kake kɛ fa, kɛ e kami maa pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa a nɛ fɔ si ha ma a tsuo; a maa pee nɔ́ saisaa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; a maa ma a hi hehi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ he komɛ hu maa fɔ si kɛkɛ. A po ma ngɛ lejɛ ɔ;

english_verse: People from the city will farm the land, no matter which tribe they belong to.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je Israel wɛtso ko mi ɔ ma nyɛ maa pee ngmɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And so the center of this special section of land will be for my sacred land, as well as for the city and its property. The land will be a square, twelve and a half kilometers on each side.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zugba nɛ a maa gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, kɛ he nɛ a maa po ma a ngɛ ɔ tsuo a kami kɛ a blimi nɛ sɔ; e kami maa pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi hu ja nɔuu.

english_verse: together with the share belonging to the Levites and the city of Jerusalem. The northern border of the ruler's property will be the land that belongs to Judah, and the southern border will be the land that belongs to Benjamin. The Division of Land among Tribes in the South The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ke a susu zugba a he nɛ a maa ma Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a hi he, kɛ he nɛ a maa po ma a ngɛ ɔ, zugba nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je ɔ tsuo nɛ pee ganɔ ɔ nɔ́. Zugba nɛ ɔ nya ya taa ngɛ beleku je; Mediterenia wo ɔ ji e huzu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yuda zugba a ngɛ omleyi je, nɛ Benyamin nɔ ɔ ngɛ leneyi je. Zugba nɛ a ha wɛtso kpa amɛ

english_verse: South of this special section will be the land that belongs to the rest of Israel's tribes. Each tribe will receive a section of land that runs from the eastern border of Israel west to the Mediterranean Sea. The tribes will receive their share of land in the following order, from north to south: Benjamin, Simeon, Issachar, Zebulun, and Gad.
translation_verse: Nyɛ susu zugba nɛ ngɛ zugba pɔtɛɛ nɛ ɔ leneyi je ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo huzu kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ. Nyɛɛ dla kɛ ha wɛtsohi nɛ piɛ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ to mɛ setsɔsetsɔ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya pue leneyi je ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Benyamin Simeon Isakar Zebulun Gad

english_verse: Gad's southern border is also the southern border of Israel. It will begin at the town of Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Leneyi je huzu ɔ maa je Tamar kɛ ya pi Meriba Kadesh nyu ɔmɛ. Huzu ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ Egipt pa a nya hluu kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ.

english_verse: That's how the land of Israel will be divided among the twelve tribes. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Gates of Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ dla zugba a kɛ ha Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ kakaaka, nɛ e pee a weto ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem will have twelve gates, three on each of the four sides of the city wall. These gates will be named after the twelve tribes of Israel. The gates of Reuben, Judah, and Levi will be in the north; Joseph, Benjamin, and Dan will be in the east; Simeon, Issachar, and Zebulun will be in the south; Gad, Asher, and Naphtali will be in the west. Each side of the city wall will be two kilometers long,
translation_verse: Á fia gbogbo eywiɛ kɛ bɔle Yerusalem ma a. Gbogbo tsuaa gbogbo kami nɛ pee gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ. A je agbo etɛɛtɛ kɛ wo gbogbo ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko mi. Agbo ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko nɛ hɛɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ eko biɛ. Agbohi nɛ maa hi omleyi je ɔ, biɛhi nɛ á wo mɛ ji Ruben, Yuda, kɛ Levi; ní nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi beleku je ɔ, á tsɛ mɛ Yosef, Benyamin, kɛ Dan; agbohi nɛ maa hi leneyi je ɔ, a wo mɛ Simeon, Isakar, kɛ Zebulun, nɛ bonyoku je agbo ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsɛ mɛ Gad, Asher, kɛ Naftali.

english_verse: In the third year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia attacked Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba tua Yerusalem, nɛ e sá ma a yi.

english_verse: The Lord let Nebuchadnezzar capture Jehoiakim and take away some of the things used in God's temple. And when the king returned to Babylonia, he put these things in the temple of his own god.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ Matsɛ Yehoyakim ngɔ wo e dɛ, nɛ Nebukadnezar muɔ june nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ekomɛ kɛ je kɛ ho. Babilon ya. June nɛ e muɔ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ e kɛ ya to e mawu ɔmɛ a nito he ɔ.

english_verse: One day the king ordered Ashpenaz, his highest palace official, to choose some young men from the royal family of Judah and from other leading Jewish families.
translation_verse: Nebukadnezar fa matsɛ we nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ashpenaz ɔ ke e ya hla nihewi komɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ je Israel kɛ ba a a kpɛti kɛ ba. E tsɔɔ nya kaa nihewi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nihi nɛ je matsɛmɛ kɛ odehehi a we mi,

english_verse: Four of the young Jews chosen were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, all from the tribe of Judah.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a hla a, a ti ni komɛ ji Daniel, Hanania, Mishael, kɛ Azaria. Mɛ tsuo a je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi.

english_verse: But the king's chief official gave them Babylonian names: Daniel became Belteshazzar, Hananiah became Shadrach, Mishael became Meshach, and Azariah became Abednego.
translation_verse: Matsɛ we nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ha nihewi ɔmɛ biɛ hehi. E wo Daniel ke Belteshazar; e wo Hanania ke Shadrak; e wo Mishael ke Meshak, nɛ Azaria lɛɛ e wo lɛ Abednego.

english_verse: Daniel made up his mind to eat and drink only what God had approved for his people to eat. And he asked the king's chief official for permission not to eat the food and wine served in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Daniel muɔ e yi mi kpɔ kaa e be matsɛ ɔ niye ní ɔ yee, nɛ wai ɔ hu e be nue, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ko ble e he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpa Ashpenaz pɛɛ ke e ko nyɛ e nɔ ke e ye níhi nɛ a tsɔɔ kaa a ye ɔ doo.

english_verse: God had made the official friendly and kind to Daniel.
translation_verse: Mawu ha nɛ Ashpenaz na lɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: But the man still told him, “The king has decided what you must eat and drink. And I am afraid he will kill me, if you eat something else and end up looking worse than the other young men.”
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ Ashpenaz ngɛ matsɛ ɔ gbeye yee he je ɔ, e de Daniel ke, “Matsɛ ɔ tsɔɔ niye ní nɛ nyɛɛ ye, kɛ dã nɛ nyɛɛ nu. Ke e ba na kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be nɔmlɔ tso he wami kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ juami bi nihewi kpa amɛ ngɛ ɔ, e maa gbe mi.”

english_verse: The king's official had put a guard in charge of Daniel and his three friends. So Daniel said to the guard,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Daniel ho ya na niye ní nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ Ashpenaz ngɔ lɛ Daniel ɔ, kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo e dɛ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke,

english_verse: “For the next ten days, let us have only vegetables and water at mealtime.
translation_verse: “Moo ka wɔ nɛ o hyɛ ligbi nyɔngma. Ha wɔ pui nɛ waa ye, kɛ nyu pɛ nɛ waa nu.

english_verse: When the ten days are up, compare how we look with the other young men, and decide what to do with us.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nihewi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛɛ matsɛ ɔ niye ní a yeɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ wɔ ngɔ to a he nɛ o hyɛ; konɛ nɔ́ nɛ o to kaa o maa pee wɔ ɔ, o pee.”

english_verse: The guard agreed to do what Daniel had asked.
translation_verse: Ashpenaz kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Daniel bi lɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ka mɛ ligbi nyɔngma.

english_verse: Ten days later, Daniel and his friends looked healthier and better than the young men who had been served food from the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ligbi nyɔngma se ɔ, a na kaa Daniel, kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ plɔke, nɛ a wo lo nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ mɛɛ a yeɔ matsɛ ɔ niye ní kpakpa a.

english_verse: God made the four young men smart and wise. They read a lot of books and became well educated. Daniel could also tell the meaning of dreams and visions.
translation_verse: Mawu ha nihewi eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nile, kɛ juɛmi nɛ a kɛ kaseɔ womi, kɛ je mi nile. Daniel lɛɛ Mawu dloo lɛ ninahi kɛ nlamihi a sisi tsɔɔmi ngɔ piɛ he.

english_verse: At the end of the three-year period set by King Nebuchadnezzar, his chief palace official brought all the young men to him.
translation_verse: Jeha etɛ ɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ to ɔ se ɔ, Ashpenaz ngɔ nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Nebukadnezar ngɔ.

english_verse: The king interviewed them and discovered that none of the others were as outstanding as Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they were given positions in the royal court.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ tsuo sɛɛ ní. Se nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ, nihi pɛ nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ná a he bua jɔmi ji Daniel, Hanania, Mishael, kɛ Azaria. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ piɛ matsɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Daniel served there until the first year of King Cyrus.
translation_verse: Daniel tsu ní kaa matsɛ ga wolɔ kɛ ya si be nɛ Persia matsɛ, Sirus ba ye Babilonia nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: and said, “I am disturbed by a dream that I don't understand, and I want you to explain it.”
translation_verse: nɛ e de mɛ ke, “I nla nlami ko, nɛ nlami nɛ ɔ wo ye he gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ. I suɔ nɛ ma le nlami ɔ sisi.”

english_verse: They answered in Aramaic, “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever! We are your servants. Please tell us your dream, and we will explain what it means.”
translation_verse: Nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ matsɛ ɔ tu munyu ngɛ Aram gbi mi ke, “Nɛnɛ, o yi nɛ na wami kɛ ya neneene! Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, moo sɛɛ o nlami ɔ ha wɔ, konɛ waa tsɔɔ mo sisi.”

english_verse: But the king replied, “No! I have made up my mind. If you don't tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be chopped to pieces and your houses will be torn down.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ i to ye yi mi, nɛ́ i be tsakee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nlami nɛ i nla a, nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa sɛɛ ha mi, nɛ nyɛ nɔuu nyɛ maa tsɔɔ sisi. Ke nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ pee ja a, ma ha a ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ maa pee we dokuhi.

english_verse: However, if you do tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be greatly rewarded and highly honored. Now tell me the dream and explain what it means.”
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ sɛɛ nlami ɔ, nɛ nyɛ tsɔɔ sisi ɔ, ma ke nyɛ níhi babauu, nɛ ma wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɛɛ nlami ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi sisi.”

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” they said, “if you will only tell us your dream, we will interpret it for you.”
translation_verse: A he nɔ ekohu nɛ a de ke, “Nɛnɛ, ke o ma nyɛ maa sɛɛ wɔ nlami ɔ, wɔ hu wa maa tsɔɔ mo sisi.”

english_verse: because you know what's going to happen if you don't come up with the answer. You've decided to make up a bunch of lies, hoping I might change my mind. Now tell me the dream, and that will prove that you can interpret it.”
translation_verse: kaa ke nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi nlami ɔ, tue gblami kake ma ha nyɛ tsuo. Nyɛ so kaa nyɛ maa ye mi lakpa hluu kaa alini níhi ma tsake. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɛɛ mi nlami ɔ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, kɛkɛ imi hu ma le kaa nyɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mi sisi.”

english_verse: His advisors explained, “Your Majesty, you are demanding the impossible! No king, not even the most famous and powerful, has ever ordered his advisors, magicians, or wise men to do such a thing.
translation_verse: Nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o le nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mo. Matsɛ ko matsɛ ko hu de we e womi mi leli, aloo klaali, aloo kunya yeli hyɛ ke a tsu kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ ko ha lɛ, matsɛ wayo jio, matsɛ ngua jio.

english_verse: This made the king so angry that he gave orders for every wise man in Babylonia to be put to death, including Daniel and his three friends. God Tells Nebuchadnezzar's Dream to Daniel
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a fa ke a ya nuu ní leli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a gbe mɛ. Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he. Mawu tsɔɔ Daniel nlami ɔ sisi

english_verse: Arioch was the king's official in charge of putting the wise men to death. He was on his way to have it done, when Daniel very wisely went to him
translation_verse: Daniel ho ya na Ariok, matsɛ tabo ɔ we asafoatsɛ ɔ nɛ a fa lɛ ke e ya gbe ni ɔmɛ ɔ. Daniel kɛ he si bami, kɛ ga

english_verse: and asked, “Why did the king give such cruel orders?” After Arioch explained what had happened,
translation_verse: bi Ariok nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo mlaa nɛ he wa kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Ariok ba je munyu ɔ kpo.

english_verse: Daniel rushed off and said to the king, “If you will just give me some time, I'll explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Daniel ho ya kpa matsɛ ɔ pɛɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke e ha lɛ be bɔɔ, konɛ e ba tsɔɔ lɛ nlami nɛ e nla a sisi.

english_verse: Then he said, “Pray that the God who rules from heaven will be merciful and explain this mystery, so that we and the others won't be put to death.”
translation_verse: E de mɛ ke a fa kue ha Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, konɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ nɛ e je laami sane nɛ ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko gbe mɛ, kɛ Babilon ga woli kpa amɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: In a vision one night, Daniel was shown the dream and its meaning. Then he praised the God who rules from heaven:
translation_verse: Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, a je laami sane ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Daniel ngɛ nina mi, nɛ e je Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ yi.

english_verse: “Our God, your name will be praised forever and forever. You are all-powerful, and you know everything.
translation_verse: Daniel de ke, “A je Mawu yi kɛ ya neneene, ejakaa ní lelɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ he wami hulɔ.

english_verse: You control human events— you give rulers their power and take it away, and you are the source of wisdom and knowledge.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e haa be, kɛ yi nɔhi baa; e woɔ matsɛ, nɛ e kpaa matsɛ; lɛ nɛ e haa nɔ nile kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi.

english_verse: You are the God who was worshiped by my ancestors. Now I thank you and praise you for making me wise and telling me the king's dream, together with its meaning.” Daniel Interprets the Dream
translation_verse: Ye nɛmɛ a Mawu, i ngɛ mo si nae, nɛ i ngɛ o yi jee. O ha mi nile kɛ he wami; o bu wa kue fami ɔ tue; nɛ o tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ wa ma de matsɛ ɔ.” Daniel sɛɛ nlami ɔ ngɔ ha matsɛ ɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ sisi

english_verse: Daniel went back to Arioch, the official in charge of executing the wise men. Daniel said, “Don't kill those men! Take me to the king, and I will explain the meaning of his dream.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Daniel ya Ariok ngɔ nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Koo gbe Babilon ga woli ɔmɛ. Ngɔɔ mi kɛ ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ lɛ nlami ɔ sisi.”

english_verse: Arioch rushed Daniel to the king and announced, “Your Majesty, I have found out that one of the men brought here from Judah can explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Ariok ngɔ Daniel kɛ ho Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɔ ya amlɔ nɔuu, nɛ e ya de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i ya na nyumu ko ngɛ nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yuda kɛ ba a a kpɛti nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mo o nlami ɔ sisi.”

english_verse: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, not even the smartest person in all the world can do what you are demanding.
translation_verse: Daniel he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, laami sane nɛ o bi nɛ ɔ, ní lelɔ, aloo klaalɔ, aloo kunya yelɔ, aloo nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛlɔ ko be nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mo.

english_verse: But the God who rules from heaven can explain mysteries. And while you were sleeping, he showed you what will happen in the future.
translation_verse: “Nɛnɛ, benɛ o hwɔɔ si ɔ, o nla nɔ́ ko nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se. Mawu nɛ jeɔ laami sanehi ngɔ tsɔɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ mo nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se dee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: However, you must realize that these mysteries weren't explained to me because I am smarter than everyone else. Instead, it was done so that you would understand what you have seen.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ tsa pi ní nɛ i le tsɔ pe nɔ ko he je nɛ a je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mi. A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nlami nɛ o nla nɛ wo o he gbeye ɔ, a tsɔɔ mo nɛ o nu sisi.

english_verse: Your Majesty, what you saw standing in front of you was a huge and terrifying statue, shining brightly.
translation_verse: “Nɛnɛ, o nla nɛ o na amaga kpetekpleenyɛ ko nɛ daa si ngɛ o hɛ mi. Amaga nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye kaa nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Its head was made of gold, its chest and arms were silver, and from its waist down to its knees, it was bronze.
translation_verse: Amaga nɛ ɔ yi ɔ, sika tsu ngmingmiingmi a kɛ pee; e gugue kɛ e kɔnihi lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee; a kɛ akɔblee pee e mlɛ mi kɛ e fiɔhi;

english_verse: From there to its ankles it was iron, and its feet were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: a kɛ dade pee e nane tsohi; e nanewɛɛ lɛɛ a kɛ dade pee fa, nɛ fa nɛ piɛ ɔ hu a kɛ zu pee.

english_verse: As you watched, a stone was cut from a mountain—but not by human hands. The stone struck the feet, completely shattering the iron and clay.
translation_verse: Benɛ o ngɛ amaga a hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tɛ agbo ko nɛ nɔ ko nine sɛ he, hia kɛ je yo ɔ mi ba fia amaga a nanewɛɛhi nɛ a kɛ dade kɛ zu pee ɔ.

english_verse: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were crushed and blown away without a trace, like husks of wheat at threshing time. But the stone became a tremendous mountain that covered the entire earth.
translation_verse: Amlɔ ɔ, dade ɔ, zu ɔ, akɔblee ɔ, sika hiɔ ɔ, kɛ sika tsu ɔ tsuo ywia wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, nɛ a pee kaa bunyuku nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ ngma mi sami he ngɛ latsa be mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ba muɔ mɛ kɛ je, nɛ a nɛ mɛ ngɛ he ko he ko hu. Se tɛ ɔ nɛ ba fia amaga a lɛɛ e ba pee yo agbo nɛ ha je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: That was the dream, and now I'll tell you what it means.
translation_verse: “Nɛnɛ, nlami ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Jehanɛ, ma tsɔɔ mo nlami ɔ sisi.

english_verse: Your Majesty, you are the greatest of kings, and God has highly honored you with power
translation_verse: Nɛnɛ, mo ji matsɛ nɛ pe matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ wo mo matsɛ, nɛ e ha mo he wami, agboje, kɛ hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: After you are gone, another kingdom will rule, but it won't be as strong. Then it will be followed by a kingdom of bronze that will rule the whole world.
translation_verse: O se ɔ, matsɛ yemi kpa maa ba, se jamɛ a matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ o nɔ́ ɔ be sɔe. Matsɛ yemi etɛne maa ba ngɛ lɔ ɔ se. Lɛ ji amaga a mlɛ mi ɔ nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee ɔ nɛ, nɛ e maa ye je ɔ tsuo nɔ.

english_verse: This fourth kingdom will be divided—it will be both strong and brittle, just as you saw that the feet and toes were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a kɛ dade pee nane nguɛ ɔmɛ fa, nɛ a kɛ zu pee fa hu ɔ, tsɔɔ kaa matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔ he fa mi maa wa kaa dade, nɛ he fa hu ma gbɔjɔ kaa zu.

english_verse: During the time of those kings, the God who rules from heaven will set up an eternal kingdom that will never fall. It will be like the stone that was cut from the mountain, but not by human hands—the stone that crushed the iron, bronze, clay, silver, and gold. Your Majesty, in your dream the great God has told you what is going to happen, and you can trust this interpretation. Daniel Is Promoted
translation_verse: O na hu kaa tɛ ko hia kɛ je yo ɔ mi nɛ nɔ ko nine sɛ́ he; tɛ nɛ ɔ ba fia amaga a nɛ a kɛ dade, akɔblee, zu, sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ. Mawu nɛ kle agbo ɔ je nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ mo. I sɛɛ nlami ɔ kɛ ha mo kaa bɔ nɛ o nla a sisiisi, nɛ i tsɔɔ mo sisi pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ julo Daniel

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar bowed low to the ground and worshiped Daniel. Then he gave orders for incense to be burned and a sacrifice of grain to be offered in honor of Daniel.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar kpla si ngɛ Daniel hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ e fa ke a sã bɔ kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha Daniel.

english_verse: The king said, “Now I know that your God is above all other gods and kings, because he gave you the power to explain this mystery.”
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ de Daniel ke, “Niinɛ, o Mawu ɔ kle pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo; matsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ lɛ ji nɔ nɛ jeɔ laami sanehi kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ nɔ. I na le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa o nyɛ́ tsɔɔ mi laami sane nɛ ɔ sisi.”

english_verse: The king then presented Daniel with a lot of gifts; he promoted him to governor of Babylon Province and put him in charge of the other wise men.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ ha Daniel blɔ nya agbo, nɛ e ke lɛ ní kpakpahi babauu. E wo lɛ Babilon kpokpa a nɔ nɔ yelɔ, kɛ matsɛ ga woli ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔkɔtɔma.

english_verse: At Daniel's request, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to high positions in Babylon Province, and he let Daniel stay on as a palace official.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, matsɛ ɔ ngɔ Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego ngɔ to ma ní tsumihi a nya ngɛ Babilon kpokpa a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Daniel wo lɛ ga ke e pee ɔ. Se Daniel lɛɛ e tsuɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: Then an official stood up and announced: People of every nation and race, now listen to the king's command!
translation_verse: ma fiɛlɔ ko de kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nyɛ, je ma slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi, kɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi! Mlaa nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Trumpets, flutes, harps, and all other kinds of musical instruments will soon start playing. When you hear the music, you must bow down and worship the statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa nu nɛ titimatihi, bɛhi, saku slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi, kɛ miɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ pɛe ɔ, nyɛ kpla si nɛ nyɛ ja sika tsu amaga a nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar puɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ.

english_verse: Some Babylonians used this as a chance to accuse the Jews to King Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Amlɔ ɔ, Babilonia bi komɛ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ a ba po Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nya.

english_verse: They said, “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: A de Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ke, “Nɛnɛ, o yi nɛ na wa kɛ ya neneene!

english_verse: And you said that anyone who did not bow down and worship it would be thrown into a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: O de hu ke nɔ nɛ be si kplae nɛ e ja amaga nɛ ɔ, a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege mi.

english_verse: Sir, you appointed three men to high positions in Babylon Province, but they have disobeyed you. Those Jews, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, refuse to worship your gods and the statue you have set up.”
translation_verse: O ngɔ Yuda bi komɛ ngɔ to ma ní tsumihi a nya ngɛ Babilon kpokpa a nɔ. Mɛ ji Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego. Nɛnɛ, mlaa a nɛ o wo ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ yi nɔ; a ja we o mawu ɔmɛ, nɛ sika tsu amaga a nɛ o puɛ ma si ɔ hu, a kpla we si ha lɛ.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar was furious. So he sent for the three young men and said,
translation_verse: Matsɛ Nebukadnezar mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e fa ke a ya ngɔ Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego kɛ ba. Benɛ a ya ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba a,

english_verse: Now I am going to give you one more chance. If you bow down and worship the statue when you hear the music, everything will be all right. But if you don't, you will at once be thrown into a flaming furnace. No god can save you from me.”
translation_verse: Yoo, nyɛ dla nyɛ he! Titimatihi, bɛhi, saku slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi, kɛ miɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi maa pɛ. Ke nyɛ nu nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ pɛe pɛ, nyɛ kpla si nɛ nyɛ ja amaga a nɛ i puɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, e maa hi ha nyɛ. Se ke nyɛ kpla we si nɛ nyɛ ja amaga a, lɛɛ a ma sake nyɛ ngɔ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege mi jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu. Anɛ nyɛ susu kaa mawu ko ngɛ nɛ ma je nyɛ kɛ je ye dɛ mi lo?”

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's face twisted with anger at the three men. And he ordered the furnace to be heated seven times hotter than usual.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ Nebukadnezar mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e tu e hɛ mi ngɔ wo Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego. E fa ke a wo flɔɔnɔɔ ɔ mi la nɛ e dɔ si kpaago pe bɔ nɛ e dɔɔ daa a.

english_verse: Next, he commanded some of his strongest soldiers to tie up the men and throw them into the flaming furnace.
translation_verse: E fa e ta buli ɔmɛ a kpɛti oblai komɛ ke a fi Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego, nɛ a sake mɛ ngɔ pue flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi.

english_verse: The king wanted it done at that very moment. So the soldiers tied up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego and threw them into the flaming furnace with all of their clothes still on, including their turbans. The fire was so hot that flames leaped out and killed the soldiers.
translation_verse: Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego, ni etɛ ɔmɛ ya nɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a fi mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Suddenly the king jumped up and shouted, “Weren't only three men tied up and thrown into the fire?” “Yes, Your Majesty,” his officers answered.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko pee Matsɛ Nebukadnezar nyakpɛ, nɛ e te da si amlɔ nɔuu. E bi e ga woli ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ pi nihi etɛ nɛ wa fi, nɛ wa sake mɛ ngɔ pue la a mi lo?” A he nɔ ke, “Ee, nɛnɛ, ja wa pee ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar said: Praise their God for sending an angel to rescue his servants! They trusted their God and refused to obey my commands. Yes, they chose to die rather than to worship or serve any god except their own.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Nebukadnezar de ke, “A je Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego mɛ a Mawu ɔ yi! E tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ kɛ ba je nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a sɔmɔɔ lɛ, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ. A kua ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi, nɛ a ngɔ a wami ngɔ ha. A pee enɛ ɔ, ejakaa a sume kaa a ma kpla si nɛ a sɔmɔ mawu kpa ko, pe a Mawu ɔ pɛ.

english_verse: And I won't allow people of any nation or race to say anything against their God. Anyone who does will be chopped up and their houses will be torn down, because no other god has such great power to save.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mlaa woe ke nihi tsuo nɛ je je ma slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi a nɔ, nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ maa tu Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednegomɛ a Mawu ɔ he munyu yaya ko ɔ, a ma tsɔtslɔɔ a mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ a maa pee e we ɔmɛ we doku hi. Ejakaa mawu kpa ko be nɛ ma nyɛ ma he nɔ yi wami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: After this happened, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to even higher positions in Babylon Province.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar wó Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednegomɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ blɔ nya nguahi ngɛ Babilon kpokpa a nɔ.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar sent the following letter to the people of all nations and races on the earth: Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: Matsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ mane je ma amɛ a nɔ bi, kɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Nyɛ he manye!

english_verse: I am glad to tell about the wonderful miracles God Most High has done for me.
translation_verse: I suɔ kaa ma bɔ nyɛ amaniɛ ngɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ pee kɛ tsɔɔ mi ɔ a he.

english_verse: His miracles are mighty and marvelous. He will rule forever, and his kingdom will never end.

english_verse: In order to make sure that his government was run properly, Darius put three other officials in charge of the governors. One of these officials was Daniel.
translation_verse: Darius hla nikɔtɔma etɛ komɛ hulɔ ngɛ amlaalo nɛ ɔmɛ a se; a ti nɔ kake ji Daniel. Nikɔtɔma etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a hyɛ amlaalo ɔmɛ a nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ matsɛ ɔ nɔ́ ko hɛ mi kó kpata.

english_verse: The other men tried to find something wrong with the way Daniel did his work for the king. But they could not accuse him of anything wrong, because he was honest and faithful and did everything he was supposed to do.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma enyɔ ɔmɛ bɔ mɔde hla kaa a maa na tɔmi ko ngɛ Daniel ma nɔ yemi ní tsumi ɔ he lo. Se a nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a maa da nɔ kɛ po e nya. A nɛ tɔmi ko ngɛ e he; ejakaa e yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ.

english_verse: Finally, they said to one another, “We will never be able to bring any charge against Daniel, unless it has to do with his religion.”
translation_verse: A de a he ke, “Wa be nɔ́ kpa ko nae nɛ wa maa da nɔ kɛ po Daniel nya, ja nɔ́ ko nɛ kɔɔ e Mawu jami he pɛ.”

english_verse: They all went to the king and said: “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma enyɔ ɔmɛ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ Darius, o yi nɛ na wami kɛ ya neneene!

english_verse: Order this to be written and then sign it, so it cannot be changed, just as no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛnɛ, moo ngma mlaa nɛ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ o nine kɛ wo sisi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e pee mlaa, Media bi kɛ Persia bi a mlaa nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma tsake.”

english_verse: So King Darius made the law and had it written down.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Darius ngɔ e nine kɛ wo mlaa a sisi.

english_verse: Daniel heard about the law, but when he returned home, he went upstairs and prayed in front of the window that faced Jerusalem. In the same way that he had always done, he knelt down in prayer three times a day, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Benɛ Daniel nu kaa matsɛ ɔ ngɔ e nine kɛ wo mlaa a sisi ɔ, e je kɛ ho e we mi ya. Daniel ngɛ hiɔwe tsu ko ngɛ e we ɔ mi, nɛ o ma nyɛ maa hyɛ Yerusalem kɛ gu saflɛ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Daniel kpla si ngɛ e nakutso nya, ngɛ saflɛ nɛ bli kɛ fɔɔ si ɔ nya, nɛ e sɔle nɛ e na e Mawu ɔ si si etɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ daa a.

english_verse: The men who had spoken to the king watched Daniel and saw him praying to his God for help.
translation_verse: Benɛ Daniel he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba e we ɔ mi nɛ a na kaa e ngɛ kue fae ha e Mawu ɔ,

english_verse: The men then told the king, “That Jew named Daniel, who was brought here as a captive, refuses to obey you or the law that you ordered to be written. And he still prays to his god three times a day.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yuda kɛ ba a, a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ Daniel ɔ, lɛɛ e bui mo nɛnɛ; mlaa a nɛ o wo ɔ hu e yi nɔ fɛɛ. E faa kue kɛ haa e Mawu ɔ si etɛ daa ligbi.”

english_verse: The king was really upset to hear about this, and for the rest of the day he tried to think how he could save Daniel.
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Darius nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e hla kaa e maa gu blɔ ko nɔ nɛ e kɛ he Daniel yi wami. Darius susu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he hluu kɛ ya si pu ba nɔ si.

english_verse: At sunset the men returned and said, “Your Majesty, remember that no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed, not even by the king.”
translation_verse: Saii mi ɔ, amlaalo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kpale ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ekohu ba de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, na nɛ o le kaa ngɛ Media bi kɛ Persia bi a mlaa nya a, ke matsɛ wo mlaa ko ɔ, a tsakee we.”

english_verse: So Darius ordered Daniel to be brought out and thrown into a pit of lions. But he said to Daniel, “You have been faithful to your God, and I pray that he will rescue you.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ a ya nu Daniel, nɛ a sake lɛ kɛ fɔ jatahi a muɔ mi. Matsɛ Darius de Daniel ke, “O Mawu ɔ nɛ o sɔmɔɔ lɛ daa a, e je mo!”

english_verse: A stone was rolled over the pit, and it was sealed. Then Darius and his officials stamped the seal to show that no one should let Daniel out.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a ya ngɔ tɛ kɛ ba fɔ muɔ ɔ nya, nɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́, kɛ e ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu a nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ sɔu muɔ ɔ nya. A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ ko kó ya je Daniel ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: All night long the king could not sleep. He did not eat anything, and he would not let anyone come in to entertain him.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ kpale kɛ ho e we ɔ mi ya. E hwɔ we mahe jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo; e ha hwɔ, nɛ e kplɛɛ we kaa a je e hɛja.

english_verse: At daybreak the king got up and ran to the pit.
translation_verse: Makɛ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ te si momo, nɛ e pee esɔ kɛ ho jatahi a muɔ ɔ he ya.

english_verse: He was anxious and shouted, “Daniel, you were faithful and served your God. Was he able to save you from the lions?”
translation_verse: Benɛ e ya su lejɛ ɔ, e kɛ he hiami kpa ngmlaa tsɛ Daniel ke, “Daniel, mo Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ tsɔlɔ! Anɛ o Mawu ɔ nɛ o sɔmɔɔ lɛ daa a nyɛ́ je mo kɛ je jata amɛ a dɛ mi lo?”

english_verse: Daniel answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Daniel he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, o yi nɛ na wami kɛ ya neneene!

english_verse: My God knew that I was innocent, and he sent an angel to keep the lions from eating me. Your Majesty, I have never done anything to hurt you.”
translation_verse: Ye Mawu ɔ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ, nɛ e ba má jata amɛ a nya, nɛ a yi mi awi. Mawu pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa e le kaa i pee we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ; e le kaa mo nɛnɛ hu, i tɔ we o nɔ.”

english_verse: The king was relieved to hear Daniel's voice, and he gave orders for him to be taken out of the pit. Daniel's faith in his God had kept him from being harmed.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ bua jɔ e he wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e fa ke a je Daniel kɛ je muɔ ɔ mi. Tsɔli ɔmɛ pee ja. Benɛ a je lɛ kɛ je jata amɛ a muɔ ɔ mi ɔ, a nɛ kaa e he ko plaa; ejakaa e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ e Mawu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: And the king ordered the men who had brought charges against Daniel to be thrown into the pit, together with their wives and children. But before they even reached the bottom, the lions ripped them to pieces.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ matsɛ ɔ ha a ya nuu ni ɔmɛ nɛ ba po Daniel nya a kɛ ba. A sake mɛ kɛ wo jatahi a muɔ ɔ mi; mɛ kɛ a yihi, kɛ a bimɛ tsuo. Be nɛ a na we nɛ a su muɔ ɔ sisi tete ɔ, jata amɛ yu a nɔ, nɛ a ku a wuhi tsuo dukuduku.

english_verse: King Darius then sent this message to all people of every nation and race in the world: “Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Matsɛ Darius ngma womi ya ha je ma amɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi ke, “Nyɛ he manye!

english_verse: I command everyone in my kingdom to worship and honor the God of Daniel. He is the living God, the one who lives forever. His power and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: I ngɛ mlaa woe ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye Daniel Mawu ɔ gbeye, nɛ e bu lɛ ngɛ ye matsɛ yemi he ɔ tsuo. “Mawu hɛ kalɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene. E matsɛ yemi ɔ hɛ mi be kpatae kɔkɔɔkɔ, nɛ e he wami ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble.

english_verse: All went well for Daniel while Darius was king, and even when Cyrus the Persian ruled.
translation_verse: Daniel plɔke, nɛ e ya nɔ saminya ngɛ Darius, kɛ Persia matsɛ, Sirus a yi nɔ.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the first year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had some dreams and visions while I was asleep one night, and I wrote them down. The four winds were stirring up the mighty sea,
translation_verse: I na nɛ wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa te ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ fiae kɛ je he tsuaa he.

english_verse: when suddenly four powerful beasts came out of the sea. Each beast was different.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, lohwe nguangua munomuno eywiɛ je wo ɔ mi kɛ ba.

english_verse: The first was like a lion with the wings of an eagle. As I watched, its wings were pulled off. Then it was lifted to an upright position and made to stand on two feet, just like a human, and it was given a human mind.
translation_verse: Kekleekle lohwe ɔ ngɛ kaa jata, se e pɛlihi lɛɛ a ngɛ kaa kɔle pɛlihi. Benɛ i ngɛ lɛ hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a ba kplɔ e pɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ e he. Jehanɛ, a wo lohwe ɔ nɔ ngɛ zugba; a kɛ lɛ da si ngɛ e nanehi a nɔ kaa nɔmlɔ, nɛ a ha lɛ nɔmlɔ juɛmi.

english_verse: The second beast looked like a bear standing on its hind legs. It held three ribs in its teeth, and it was told, “Attack! Eat all the flesh you want.”
translation_verse: Lohwe enyɔne ɔ ngɛ kaa osisiblisi nɛ daa si ngɛ e se nane enyɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Kasa wu etɛ ngɛ e lungu kpɛ ngɛ e nya mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko de lɛ ke, “Tee si, nɛ o ye lo bɔ nɛ o ma nyɛ!”

english_verse: The fourth beast was stronger and more terrifying than the others. Its huge teeth were made of iron, and what it didn't grind with its teeth, it smashed with its feet. It was different from the others, and it had horns on its head—ten of them.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ lɛ hyɛe ɔ, lohwe eywiɛne ba hia si. Lohwe nɛ ɔ he ngɛ gbeye kɛ nyakpɛ, nɛ e ngɛ he wami saminya. E kɛ e dade lungu vamvam ɔmɛ tsɔtslɔɔ lohwehi a mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya nɛ e yeɔ. Ní nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ e naa a nɔ. Slo lɛ ngɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ a he; lohwe nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ koli nyɔngma.

english_verse: Just as I was thinking about these horns, a smaller horn appeared, and three of the other horns were pulled up by the roots to make room for it. This horn had the eyes of a human and a mouth that spoke with great arrogance. Judgment Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ koli ɔmɛ hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tlukaa a, koli wayo ko ba hia kpo ngɛ koli ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Koli wayo nɛ ɔ hia kolihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ momo ɔ etɛ kɛ pue si. Nɔmlɔ adesa hɛngmɛhi ngɛ koli wayo nɛ ɔ he, kɛ nya hu nɛ ngɛ munyu tue putɛputɛɛ. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa a

english_verse: Thrones were set up while I was watching, and the Eternal God took his place. His clothing and his hair were white as snow. His throne was a blazing fire with fiery wheels,
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a kɛ matsɛ sɛhi ba ma si, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa a ba hi si ngɛ kake nɔ. E tade hiɛ futaa kaa snoo, nɛ e yi bwɔmi ngɛ kaa to he bwɔmi ngmingmiingmi. E matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔ nɛ sɛ ɔ maa si ngɛ nɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ tsoe gegeege.

english_verse: and flames were dashing out from all around him. Countless thousands were standing there to serve him. The time of judgment began, and the books were opened.
translation_verse: La ngɛ tsoe gegeege ngɛ e hɛ mi kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee. Nihi akpeakpehi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ lɛ sɔmɔe, nɛ akpe nyɔngma totoe akpe nyɔngma daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi. Kojoli ɔmɛ ba hi si, nɛ a bli womi ɔmɛ a nya.

english_verse: I watched closely to see what would happen to this smaller horn because of the arrogant things it was saying. Then before my very eyes, the fourth beast was killed and its body destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hyɛe ɔ, i nu nɛ koli nyafii ɔ ngɛ munyu tue putɛputɛɛ kɛ mwɔɔ. Tlukaa a, a gbe lohwe eywiɛne ɔ; a tsɔtslɔɔ e mi, nɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ la a mi.

english_verse: The other three beasts had their authority taken from them, but they were allowed to live a while longer.
translation_verse: Lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a kpɔ a he wami ɔ ngɛ a dɛ, se a ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a hi je mi kɛ ya si be ko.

english_verse: As I continued to watch the vision that night, I saw what looked like a son of man coming with the clouds of heaven, and he was presented to the Eternal God.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se, nyɔ mi benɛ i ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, i na nɔ́ ko kaa nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ nyɛɛ bɔku mi kɛ ma ye ngɔ. E be kɛ ho nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa a ngɔ ya, nɛ a kɛ lɛ tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa a.

english_verse: He was crowned king and given power and glory, so that all people of every nation and race would serve him. He will rule forever, and his kingdom is eternal, never to be destroyed. The Meaning of Daniel's Vision
translation_verse: A ngɔ he wami, hɛ mi nyami, kɛ matsɛ yemi ngɔ wo e dɛ, konɛ je ma amɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ. E he wami ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble. A tsɔɔ nina amɛ a sisi

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was terrified by these visions, and I didn't know what to think.
translation_verse: Nina amɛ nɛ i na a wo ye he gbeye, nɛ i hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: But God Most High will give his kingdom to his chosen ones, and it will be theirs forever and ever.”
translation_verse: Se nyagbe ɔ, Hiɔwe No ɔ we ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nine maa su matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ, nɛ a maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.”

english_verse: I wanted to know more about the fourth beast, because it was so different and much more terrifying than the others. What was the meaning of its iron teeth and bronze claws and of its feet that smashed what the teeth and claws had not ground and crushed?
translation_verse: I bi lohwe eywiɛne ɔ he sane pɔtɛɛ. Slo lohwe nɛ ɔ ngɛ ekpa amɛ tsuo a he; lɛɛ e he ngɛ gbeye saminya. Lohwe nɛ ɔ kɛ e dade lungu ɔmɛ, kɛ akɔblee nguɛ ɔmɛ tsɔtslɔɔ lohwehi a mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya nɛ e yeɔ, nɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ e naa a nɔ.

english_verse: I also wanted to know more about all ten of those horns on its head. I especially wanted to know more about the one that took the place of three of the others—the horn that had eyes and spoke with arrogance and seemed greater than the others.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i bi koli nyɔngma amɛ nɛ ngɛ lohwe ɔ yi mi ɔ a he sane. Koli kaketsɛ ɔ nɛ ba pee se, nɛ ha nɛ koli etɛ ɔmɛ hia pue si ɔ, lɛ hu i bi he sane. Koli nɛ ɔ ngɛ hɛngmɛhi, kɛ nya nɛ e ngɛ munyu tue putɛputɛɛ. E he ngɛ gbeye pe koli ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: While I was looking, this horn attacked God's chosen ones and was winning the battle.
translation_verse: I na nɛ jamɛ a koli ɔ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hwu ta, nɛ e ye a nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: Then God Most High, the Eternal God, came and judged in favor of his chosen ones, because the time had arrived for them to be given the kingdom.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa a ba, nɛ e ba wo Hiɔwe No ɔ we ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nguɔ. Be ba su nɛ Mawu ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nine ba su matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Then I was told by the one standing there: “The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom to appear on earth. It will be different from all the others— it will trample the earth and crush it to pieces.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ mi enɛ ɔ sisi ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Lohwe eywiɛne ɔ ji matsɛ yemi eywiɛne ko nɛ maa ba je ɔ mi; e maa slo lɛ ngɛ matsɛ yemi kpa amɛ a he. E ma kpata je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi, nɛ e maa naa e nɔ.

english_verse: All ten of those horns are kings who will come from this kingdom, and one more will follow. This horn will be different from the others, and it will conquer three other kings.
translation_verse: Koli nyɔngma amɛ ji matsɛmɛ nyɔngma komɛ nɛ ma ba te si ngɛ jamɛ a matsɛ yemi ɔ mi. A se ɔ, matsɛ kpa ko maa te si; e maa slo lɛ ngɛ kekleekle ni ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e ma kpata matsɛmɛ etɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: “This king will speak evil of God Most High, and he will be cruel to God's chosen ones. He will try to change God's Law and the sacred seasons. And he will be able to do this for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: E maa tu munyu ngɔ si Hiɔwe No ɔ, nɛ e maa wa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ yi mi. E ma hla kaa e tsake a Mawu jami mlaa amɛ, kɛ a nyami be ɔmɛ; nɛ a maa ngɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ wo e dɛ jeha etɛ kɛ fa.

english_verse: “Then the greatest kingdom of all will be given to the chosen ones of God Most High. His kingdom will be eternal, and all others will serve and obey him.”
translation_verse: A maa ngɔ matsɛ yemihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a he wami, kɛ agboje ngɔ ha Hiɔwe No ɔ we ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a ma a. A matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ma sɔmɔ mɛ, nɛ a maa bu mɛ tue.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the third year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had a second vision
translation_verse: Matsɛ Belshazar yi nɔ jeha etɛne ɔ mi ɔ, i na nina nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw a ram standing there with two horns on its head—both of them were long, but the second one was longer than the first.
translation_verse: Benɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, agbosu ko kɛ e yi mi koli enyɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ pa a tue. Koli ɔmɛ ka gagaaga, se kake ka pe kake, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ka a kpɛ se kɛ ba.

english_verse: The ram went charging toward the west, the north, and the south. No other animals were strong enough to oppose him, and nothing could save them from his power. So he did as he pleased and became even more powerful.
translation_verse: I na nɛ agbosu ɔ ngɔ e koli ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ lohwehi hɛɛe ngɛ e blɔ mi, kɛ je bonyoku, omleyi, kɛ leneyi je. Lohwe ko lohwe ko nyɛ we lɛ, loo e kpɔ e he kɛ je e dɛ mi. Agbosu ɔ bui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ nɛ e peeɔ.

english_verse: I kept on watching and saw a goat come from the west and charge across the entire earth, without even touching the ground. Between his eyes was a powerful horn,
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he susue ɔ, tlukaa a, to akpakpo ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ je bonyoku je kɛ ma kɛ fo nɛ mi wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ. To ɔ ngɛ fo tue wawɛɛ mohu, se e nane mɛ zugba. Jehanɛ hu, koli agbo ko ngɛ e hɛngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: After this, the goat became even more powerful. But at the peak of his power, his mighty horn was broken, and four other mighty horns took its place—one pointing to the north and one to the east, one to the south and one to the west.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, to akpakpo ɔ ba wo e he nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e bui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. Se benɛ e he wami ɔ ba he si ɔ, e koli ɔ ku. Kɛkɛ nɛ koli agboagbo eywiɛ ba puɛ ngɛ lɔ ɔ nane mi; koli ɔmɛ plɛ a nyahi ngɔ kpee he munomunohi.

english_verse: A little horn came from one of these, and its power reached to the south, the east, and even to the holy land.
translation_verse: Koli nyafii ko puɛ kɛ je koli eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti kake mi. E he wami ɔ ya su leneyi je, kɛ beleku je, kɛ zugba a nɛ a wo he si ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: It became so strong that it attacked the stars in the sky, which were heaven's army. Then it threw some of them down to the earth and trampled on them.
translation_verse: E he wami ɔ ba pue nɔ; e kɛ hiɔwe tabo nɛ ji dodoe ɔmɛ nitsɛnitsɛ hwu ta, nɛ e hɛ ekomɛ ngɔ pue zugba, nɛ e naa a nɔ.

english_verse: It humiliated heaven's army and dishonored its leader by keeping him from offering the daily sacrifices. In fact, it was so terrible that it even disgraced the temple and wiped out true worship. It also did everything else it wanted to do.
translation_verse: A pee yayamihi babauu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. A kpa daa ligbi bɔ sami ɔ, nɛ a sake anɔkuale jami ɔ kɛ fɔ he. Koli ɔ ye manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.

english_verse: Then one of the holy angels asked another, “When will the daily sacrifices be offered again? What about this horrible rebellion? When will the temple and heaven's army no longer be trampled in the dust?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ bɔfohi enyɔ ngɛ ní sɛɛe. Bɔfo ɔ kake bi e nyɛmi ɔ ke, “Nina nɛ ɔ, mɛni be e maa hi si kɛ yaa si? Hiɔwe tabo ɔ, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, mɛni be a maa naa a nɔ kɛ yaa si?”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was trying to figure out the meaning of the vision, when someone suddenly appeared there beside me.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa ma hla nina a sisi ɔ, tlukaa a, nɔ ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ ba daa si ngɛ ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: And from beside the Ulai River, a voice like that of a human said, “Gabriel, help him understand the vision.”
translation_verse: I nu nɛ nɔ ko tu munyu ngɛ Ulai pa a mi ke, “Gabriel, tsɔɔ nyumu ɔ nina a sisi.”

english_verse: Gabriel came over, and I fell to the ground in fear. Then he said, “You are merely a human, but you need to understand that this vision is about the end of time.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Gabriel ba da si ngɛ ye kasa nya. Benɛ e ba a, ye tsui po, nɛ i kɛ ye hɛ mi bu si. Gabriel de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, na nɛ o le kaa nina a kɔɔ je mi nyagbe he.”

english_verse: and said: Listen, and I will tell you what will happen at the end of time, when God has chosen to show his anger.
translation_verse: E de mi ke, “Ke Mawu mi mi fu ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa nyɛɛ se ɔ, lɔ ɔ ma tsɔɔ mo nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nina a kɔɔ nyagbe be ɔ he.

english_verse: The two horns of the ram are the kings of Media and Persia,
translation_verse: “Agbosu koli enyɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ o na a daa si ha Media kɛ Persia matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: the goat is the kingdom of Greece, and the powerful horn between his eyes is the first of its kings.
translation_verse: To akpakpo ɔ daa si ha Hela matsɛ ɔ, nɛ koli agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ e hɛngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ji kekleekle matsɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When these rulers have become as evil as possible, their power will end, and then a king who is dangerous and cannot be trusted will appear.
translation_verse: “Ke matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔmɛ a nyagbe be ɔ su ta, nɛ a yayami ɔ mi ba wa bɔ nɛ e sa kaa a gbla a tue ɔ, matsɛ ko ma ba te si. Matsɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee yiwutsotsɛ kɛ nɔ sisilɔ nɛ maa wa tue.

english_verse: His deceitful lies will make him so successful, that he will think he is really great. Suddenly he will kill many people, and he will even attack God, the Supreme Ruler. But God will crush him!
translation_verse: E maa to ga kɛ sisi nihi babauu. E ma wo e he nɔ, nɛ e ma kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi be mi nɛ a hɛ be a he nɔ. Ganɔhi a ganɔ ɔ nitsɛ po, e maa te si ngɔ wo lɛ. Se a ma kpata e hɛ mi; nɛ tsa pi nɔmlɔ adesa he wami nɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: This vision about the evenings and mornings is true, but these things won't happen for a long time, so don't tell it to others.
translation_verse: Nina a nɛ kɔɔ gbɔkuɛ kɛ mɔtu bɔ sami ɔmɛ a he nɛ a tsɔɔ mo sisi ɔ maa ba mi. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ to o yi mi; ejakaa e maa ye be saii loko e maa ba mi.”

english_verse: After this, I was so worn out and weak that it was several days before I could get out of bed and go about my duties for the king. I was disturbed by this vision that made no sense to me.
translation_verse: Imi Daniel ɔ, ye he mi po, nɛ i nu hiɔ ligbi babauu. Pee se ɔ, i te si nɛ i ho ya tsu ní tsumi nɛ matsɛ ɔ ha mi ke ma tsu ɔ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nina a gba ye juɛmi nya, nɛ i nui sisi.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: Some years later, Darius the Mede, who was the son of Xerxes, had become king of Babylonia. And during his first year as king, I found out from studying the writings of the prophets that the Lord had said to Jeremiah, “Jerusalem will lie in ruins for
translation_verse: Benɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ kekleekle jeha a mi ɔ, imi Daniel hu i ya kpa womi klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi. I na ngɛ womi ɔmɛ a mi kaa Yerusalem maa pee ma doku kɛ yaa si jeha nyingmi kpaago. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de gbalɔ Yeremia ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Then, to show my sorrow, I went without eating and dressed in sackcloth and sat in ashes. I confessed my sins and earnestly prayed to the Lord my God: Our Lord, you are a great and fearsome God, and you faithfully keep your agreement with those who love and obey you.
translation_verse: I fa kue ha Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ, nɛ i jaje ye ma a he yayami. I de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, o kle agbo, nɛ o he ngɛ gbeye. O yeɔ o siwo nɔ, nɛ o naa nihi nɛ suɔ mo, nɛ yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: But we have sinned terribly by rebelling against you and rejecting your laws and teachings.
translation_verse: “Wa pee yayami; wa tɔ nɛ wa pee yi wu tso níhi. Wa tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã, nɛ wa yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: We have ignored the message your servants the prophets spoke to our kings, our leaders, our ancestors, and everyone else.
translation_verse: O tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ nɛ o tu munyu kɛ gu a nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ wa matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, wa ganɔ ɔmɛ, wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wa ma a tsuo ɔ, wa bui mɛ tue fɛɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, you are merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against you
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa wa tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã mohu lɛɛ, se mɔbɔ nalɔ ji mo, nɛ o kɛ nɔ he yayami paa nɔ.

english_verse: You warned us and our leaders that Jerusalem would suffer the worst disaster in human history, and you did exactly as you had threatened.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ o de to ke o maa pee wɔ, kɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, ja lɛ o pee wɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ. Haomi nɛ o kɛ ba Yerusalem ɔ, jamɛ a haomi ɔ eko bɛ ma kpa ko nɔ hyɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi.

english_verse: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.
translation_verse: Tue gblami ɔmɛ nɛ a wo a nɔ ta ngɛ Mose mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ tsuo ba wa nɔ. Se Yawɛ, wa Mawu, wa bɔɛ mɔde kaa wa maa pee o suɔmi nya ní; wa ngmɛɛ we wa yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o we anɔkuale ɔ hu wa nyɛɛ we se.

english_verse: And when you finally punished us with this horrible disaster, that was also the right thing to do, because we deserved it so much.
translation_verse: Mo Yawɛ, wa Mawu, o to o yi mi kaa o maa gbla wa tue, nɛ ja ji bɔ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa moo lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ o peeɔ. Se wa bui mo tue.

english_verse: Our Lord God, with your own mighty arm you rescued us from Egypt and made yourself famous to this very day, but we have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu, mo lɛ o kɛ kɔni si wami je o ma a kɛ je Egipt nɛ o he biɛ nɛ ngɛ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ. Wa pee yayami; wa tɔ.

english_verse: In the past, you treated us with such kindness, that we now beg you to stop being so terribly angry with Jerusalem. After all, it is your chosen city built on your holy mountain, even though it has suffered public disgrace because of our sins and those of our ancestors.
translation_verse: Mo ji nɔ nɛ fa wa he be ko nɛ be ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o mi mi ko fu Yerusalem hu. Mo nitsɛ o ma ji lɛ; o yo klɔuklɔu. Wa he yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ nɛ a pee ɔ a he je ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle wɔ ɔ yeɔ Yerusalem kɛ o ma a a he fɛu.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Wa Mawu lee, moo bu ye sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue. O we ɔ nɛ a kpata hɛ mi, nɛ e pee we doku ɔ, to lɛ sisi ekohu, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e na kaa Mawu ji mo.

english_verse: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain,
translation_verse: I ya nɔ nɛ i sɔle. I jaje ye he yayami, kɛ ye ma Israel ɔ hu he yayami, nɛ i kpa Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ pɛɛ ke e to e we klɔuklɔu ɔ si ekohu.

english_verse: when Gabriel suddenly came flying in at the time of the evening sacrifice. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my vision,
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ sɔlee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Gabriel nɛ i na lɛ ngɛ kekleekle nina a mi ɔ te kɛ ba he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi lɛ a sãã gbɔkuɛ bɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.
translation_verse: E ba de mi ke, “Daniel, i ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ma ba tsɔɔ mo gbami ɔ sisi.

english_verse: God thinks highly of you, and at the very moment you started praying, I was sent to give you the answer.
translation_verse: Benɛ o je o kue fami ɔ sisi ɔ, Mawu he nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ba hiɛ ɔ, konɛ ma ba de mo; ejakaa Mawu suɔ o sane saminya. Jehanɛ, bu tue nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nina a sisi.

english_verse: For one week this foreigner will make a firm agreement with many people, and halfway through this week, he will end all sacrifices and offerings. Then the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction will be put there. And it will stay there until the time God has decided to destroy this one who destroys.
translation_verse: Matsɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ nihi babauu maa so, nɛ a ma ka a he kita kɛ yaa si jeha kpaago. Se jeha kpaago ɔ kpɛti ɔ, e maa gu bɔ sami, kɛ nike ní hami. A maa ngɔ amaga ko nɛ he ngɛ gbeye kɛ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ he nɛ ya hiɔwe pe lɛ tsuo ɔ. Nɛ e maa hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si be nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ble Yawɛ we ɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ ma na e tue gblami nɛ Mawu to ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: In the third year of Cyrus the king of Persia, a message came to Daniel from God, and it was explained in a vision. The message was about a dreadful war, and it was true.
translation_verse: Benɛ Sirus ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Persia a, jeha etɛne ɔ mi ɔ, Daniel ná sɛ gbi ko. Daniel biɛ kpa ji Belteshazar. Sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɔɔ sane yaya ko nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se he; e kɔɔ ta ngua ko he. Nɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ sisi kɛ gu nina mi.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: For three weeks I was in sorrow.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, imi Daniel, i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee otsi etɛ.

english_verse: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.
translation_verse: I yi niye ní kpakpa ko, i yi lo; dã yɛ ye nya mi, nɛ i kpa we nu kɛ ya si otsi etɛ ɔ tsuo be.

english_verse: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River,
translation_verse: Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ, i daa si ngɛ Tigris pa ngua a tue.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.
translation_verse: Benɛ i wo ye yi nɔ ma hyɛ ɔ, nyumu ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ ha kploba kɛ e mlɛ mi sika tsu mlɛ mi fimi nɔ.

english_verse: His body was like a precious stone, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming fires, his arms and legs like polished bronze, and his voice like the roar of a crowd.
translation_verse: E nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ngɛ kpɛe kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa. E hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa oslabai nɛ gba, nɛ e hɛngmɛhi ngɛ kaa jatɛ nɛ a su. E kɔnihi kɛ e nanehi ngɛ kpɛe kaa akɔblee nɛ a sa he, nɛ e gbi ngɛ kaa nimli babauu a gbi.

english_verse: Although the people who were with me did not see the vision, they became so frightened that they scattered and hid.
translation_verse: Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i na nina nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyumuhi nɛ piɛ ye he ɔ, mɛɛ a nɛ nina nɛ ɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a tsui po nɛ a tu fo ya laa a he,

english_verse: and at the sound of his voice, I fell facedown in a deep sleep.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e tu munyu. Se benɛ i nu e gbi ɔ, i sɛ diblii mi, nɛ i kɛ ye hɛ mi bu si.

english_verse: and then said, “Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention.” I stood trembling, while the angel said:
translation_verse: Nɔ ɔ de mi ke, “Daniel, Mawu suɔ o sane. Moo te nɛ o da si, nɛ o bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ tue saminya. A tsɔ mi o ngɔ.” Benɛ e kɛ mi tu munyu nɛ ɔ, i te da si nɛ́ ye he ngɛ doe kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.
translation_verse: I ba, konɛ ma ba tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ maa ba o ma a nɔ hwɔɔ se, ejakaa nina a kɔɔ hwɔɔ se níhi a he.”

english_verse: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.
translation_verse: Benɛ e tu munyu nɛ ɔ, i ma ye yi si, nɛ i pee dii.

english_verse: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, “Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ ta ye nya he. Kɛkɛ nɛ i pa ye nya mi nɛ i tu munyu. I de nɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ ye kasa nya a ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, nina nɛ ɔ ha nɛ ye he mi po, nɛ i gbɔjɔ.

english_verse: I am merely your servant. How can I possibly speak with someone so powerful, when I am almost too weak to get my breath?”
translation_verse: I ngɛ kaa nyɔguɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ e nyɔmtsɛ hɛ mi. Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma nyɛ nɛ i kɛ mo nɛ tu munyu? Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye he wami ta, nɛ mumi ko mumi ko be ye mi.”

english_verse: The angel touched me a second time and said, “Don't be frightened! God thinks highly of you, and he intends this for your good, so be brave and strong.” At this, I regained my strength and replied, “Please speak! You have already made me feel much better.”
translation_verse: E de mi ke, “Mo he manye! Mawu suɔ o sane saminya. Koo ye gbeye! Ko ha nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ hao mo!” Benɛ e kɛ mi tu munyu nɛ ɔ, i na he wami he, nɛ i de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ! I kpa mo pɛɛ, nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o nya a, de mi; ejakaa o ha nɛ i na he wami.”

english_verse: What I am going to tell you is certain to happen. Four kings will rule Persia, one after the other, but the fourth one will become much richer than the others. In fact, his wealth will make him so powerful that he will turn everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo nɛ ɔ, e ji anɔkuale.” Egipt kɛ Siria matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ Bɔfo ɔ de ke, “Matsɛmɛ kpahi etɛ ma ba ye Persia nɔ. A se ɔ, matsɛ eywiɛne maa ba, nɛ lɛɛ e ma na ní babauu pe mɛ tsuo kulaa. Nɛ ke be nɛ e ní nami ɔ ba ha nɛ e he wami ba he si ɔ, e maa te si kɛ wo Hela matsɛ yemi ɔ.

english_verse: Then a mighty king will come to power and will be able to do whatever he pleases.
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ ɔ, matsɛ katsɛ ko maa ba. E kɛ he wami nɛ nya wa maa ye tsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e maa pee.

english_verse: But suddenly his kingdom will be crushed and scattered to the four corners of the earth, where four more kingdoms will rise. But these won't be ruled by his descendants or be as powerful as his kingdom.
translation_verse: Se ke be nɛ e he wami ɔ ba he si ɔ, e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa gbɛ. A maa dla matsɛ yemi ɔ mi eywiɛ, nɛ ni kpahi nɛ pi e weku li ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e nane mi. Se a he wami ɔ, kɛ e nɔ́ ɔ be sɔe.

english_verse: The king of the south will grow powerful. Then one of his generals will rebel and will rule an even larger kingdom.
translation_verse: “Egipt matsɛ ɔ he maa wa. Se e ganɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake he maa wa kulaa pe lɛ, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ hu ma blɛke pe e nɔ́ ɔ.

english_verse: Years later the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom will make a treaty, and the daughter of the king of the south will marry the king of the north. But she will lose her power. Then she, her husband, their child, and the servants who came with her will all be killed. After this,
translation_verse: Jeha komɛ a se ɔ, Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ maa pee huɛ, nɛ e kɛ e biyo ma ha Siria matsɛ ɔ. Se huɛ bɔmi nɛ ɔ se be kɛe; nɛ a maa gbe yo ɔ, e huno ɔ, e bi ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya a.

english_verse: one of her relatives will become the ruler of the southern kingdom. He will attack the army of the northern kingdom and capture its fortresses.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, yo ɔ weku no ko ma ba ye matsɛ. E ma tua Siria matsɛ ɔ tabo ɔ, nɛ e maa sɛ a mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e maa ye a nɔ.

english_verse: Then he will carry their idols to Egypt, together with their precious treasures of silver and gold, but it will be a long time before he attacks the northern kingdom again. Some years later
translation_verse: E maa muɔ a mawu ɔmɛ, amaga amɛ, kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu ní kpakpa amɛ kɛ ya Egipt. Nɛ e kɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ be ta hwue hu jeha babauu.

english_verse: the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom, but he will be forced back to his own country.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Siria matsɛ ɔ ma ba tua Egipt. Se e be kɛe nɛ e maa kpale kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ ya ekohu.

english_verse: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.
translation_verse: “Siria matsɛ ɔ bimɛ ma dla kɛ ha ta, nɛ a ma bua tabohi babauu a nya. A maa hia kɛ ya tua a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a mɔ ɔ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.

english_verse: But this will make the king of the south angry, and he will defeat this large army from the north.
translation_verse: Egipt matsɛ ɔ mi mi ma fu. E kɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ ma ya hwu ta, nɛ e maa nuu Siria ta buli babauu nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: The king of the south will feel proud because of the many thousands he has killed. But his victories won't last long,
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e ma wo e he nɔ, nɛ e maa gbe nimli babauu nitsɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e kunimi yemi ɔ se be kɛe.

english_verse: because the king of the north will gather a larger and more powerful army than ever before. Then in a few years, he will start invading other countries.
translation_verse: “Siria matsɛ ɔ maa kpale e se; nɛ e ma ya bua tabohi babauu nɛ a hiɛ pe kekle ni ɔmɛ a nya. Jeha komɛ a se ɔ, Siria matsɛ ɔ maa kpale ba kɛ ta buli babauu nɛ a he hiɛ pe kekle ni ɔmɛ po. A kɛ ta níhi babauu hu maa ba.

english_verse: At this time many of your own people will try to make this vision come true by rebelling against the king of the south, but their rebellion will fail.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi babauu maa te si kɛ wo Egipt matsɛ ɔ. Mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi atuã tsɔli komɛ hu ma tsɔ atuã ngɛ nina ko nɛ a na a he. Se a maa ye a nɔ.

english_verse: Then the army from the north will surround and capture a fortress in the south, and not even the most experienced troops of the southern kingdom will be able to make them retreat.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Siria matsɛ ɔ ma ba sa ma ko nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he ɔ yi, nɛ e maa ngɔ ma a. Egipt tabo ɔmɛ be nya nyɛe maa da; a ta buli kpakpa amɛ po a he wami maa ta.

english_verse: The king who invaded from the north will do as he pleases, and he will even capture and destroy the holy land.
translation_verse: Siria matsɛ ɔ maa pee mɛ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa te si kɛ wo lɛ. E ma ya da si ngɛ zugba a nɛ a wo he si ɔ nɔ, nɛ zugba a tsuo maa pee e nɔ.

english_verse: In fact, he will decide to invade the south with his entire army. Then he will attempt to make peace by giving the king of the south a bride from the northern kingdom, but this won't be successful.
translation_verse: “Siria matsɛ ɔ maa to ga bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e nine nɛ su Egipt tsuo nɔ. Lɛ hu e kɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ maa pee huɛ, nɛ e kɛ e biyo ma ha lɛ. Nɛ yi mi yaya nɛ e to ngɔ wo Egipt matsɛ ɔ he ɔ, e maa gu e biyo nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ tsu he ní. Se e yi mi tomi ɔ maa pee yaka.

english_verse: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e ma ba tua wo nya ma amɛ, nɛ e maa ngɔ mahi babauu. Se tatsɛ ko maa je ma se kɛ ba nɛ e kɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ ma ba kpe. E maa ye Siria matsɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ kɛ zo maa kpale e se kɛ ho.

english_verse: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.
translation_verse: E ma pue blɔ kɛ ya e mɔ ɔ mi ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ. Se haomi maa ba e nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a be lɛ nae hu.

english_verse: The next king of the north will try to collect taxes for the glory of his kingdom. However, he will come to a sudden end in some mysterious way, instead of in battle or because of someone's anger. Part Two: The Evil King from the North
translation_verse: “Matsɛ kpa maa ba ngɛ e se. Matsɛ nɛ ɔ maa tsɔ kɛ ba tsu tó pani nya ngɛ ma a dɛ. E maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, konɛ e na ní babauu. Se be bɔɔ se ɔ, matsɛ nɛ ɔ ma gbo tlukaa nɛ a be lee nɔ́ nɛ gbe lɛ; nɛ pohu pi ta nga nɔ nɛ e ma gbo ngɛ.” Siria matsɛ yaya a

english_verse: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ nɛ ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se ɔ maa pee nɔ ko nɛ bu be e he, nɛ́ e sɛ́ kaa e yeɔ matsɛ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ maa ba tlukaa, nɛ e kɛ sisimi, kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyu tumi ma kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ.

english_verse: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.
translation_verse: E kɛ je ma kpahi maa pee huɛ, nɛ e maa sisi mɛ. Nihi bɔɔ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa nyɛɛ e se; se e he wami maa hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: He will gather a large and powerful army, and with great courage he will attack the king of the south. The king of the south will meet him with a much stronger army, but he will lose the battle, because he will be betrayed
translation_verse: “E maa pee nyumu, nɛ e kɛ tabo babauu ma ya tua Egipt. Egipt matsɛ ɔ hu ma bua tabo babauu nitsɛ a nya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ maa hwu. Se, nɔ se blɔ tsɔɔli komɛ maa so ngɔ wo Egipt matsɛ ɔ he, nɛ e be kunimi yee.

english_verse: by members of the royal court. He will be ruined, and most of his army will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: E ga woli kpakpahi tete ma ha nɛ e nane ma kpata. A maa gbe e ta buli ɔmɛ babauu, nɛ e tabo ɔ maa gbɛ fĩa.

english_verse: The two kings will meet around a table and tell evil lies to each other. But their plans will fail, because God has already decided what will happen.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛmɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ maa hi si ngɛ okplɔɔ kake he, nɛ a maa ye ní. A ma susu ní yayahi a he, nɛ a maa ye a sibi lakpa. Se nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ, a nine be nɔ sue; ejakaa be nɛ a to ɔ, be ɔ sui lolo.

english_verse: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.
translation_verse: Siria matsɛ ɔ maa kpale kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ ya kɛ ta yibu ní babauu ɔ nɛ e na a. E ma hla kaa e gu Mawu ma a a jami ɔ. E maa pee e suɔmi nya ní, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e maa kpale kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ ya.

english_verse: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.
translation_verse: “Pee se ɔ, e maa kpale ba tua Egipt ekohu. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ e be kunimi yee kaa kekle ɔ.

english_verse: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Roma ta lɛhi ma ba tua lɛ, nɛ e tsui maa po. “E kɛ mi mi la maa kpale e se, nɛ e ma hla kaa e gu Mawu ma a a jami ɔ. E maa bu nihi nɛ kua kikɛmɛ a jami ɔ a ga womi tue.

english_verse: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction.
translation_verse: Ta buli nɛ e wo blɔ ɔ ma ya sɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a ma ble lejɛ ɔ. A maa jɔɔ daa ligbi bɔ ɔmɛ sami, nɛ a maa ngɔ amaga ko nɛ he ngɛ gbeye kɛ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyu tumi ma puɛ nihi nɛ kua a jami ɔ a juɛmi, nɛ a ma ba nyɛɛ e se. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ Mawu se anɔkuale mi ɔ maa da si kpɛii, nɛ a kɛ mɛ maa to ní.

english_verse: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.
translation_verse: Ní leli nɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ maa tsɔɔ ma mi bi ɔmɛ babauu ní. Se pee se ɔ, a maa gbe a ti ni komɛ ngɛ ta nga nɔ, nɛ a maa sã ni komɛ. A maa ha ní ngɛ ni komɛ hu a dɛ, nɛ a maa nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ a ngɛ Mawu ma mi bi ɔmɛ gbee ɔ, ni komɛ ma ba je ngmlaa ha mɛ kɛ̃. Se ngmlaa jeli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu maa ba ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a se nami he.

english_verse: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.
translation_verse: A maa gbe ní leli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ. Se se nami mohu maa je mi kɛ ba, ejakaa a maa tsukɔ ma a he. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɔ hluu kɛ yaa si nyagbe be ɔ nɛ Mawu to ɔ maa ba.

english_verse: This king will do as he pleases. He will proudly claim to be greater than any god and will insult the only true God. Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people.
translation_verse: “Siria matsɛ ɔ maa pee e suɔmi nya ní. E ma wo e he nɔ, nɛ e maa pee lɛ kaa e kle pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo. Mawu Ope ɔ nitsɛ po, e maa tu musu munyuhi kɛ si lɛ hluu kɛ yaa si be nɛ Mawu maa gbla e tue. Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to kaa e maa pee ɔ, ja e pee.

english_verse: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ be mawu ɔmɛ nɛ e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ja a bue; mawu ɔ nɛ yihi suɔ ɔ hu, e be lɛ bue. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, e be mawu ko mawu ko bue fɛɛ; ejakaa e ma susu kaa e kle pe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee mohu ji, e maa wo mawu nɛ buu mɔhi a he ɔ hɛ mi nyami. E maa ke mawu ko nɛ e nɛmɛ ja we hyɛ ɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, june, kɛ nike ní kpahi nɛ a he jua wa.

english_verse: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land. Part Three: The Time of the End
translation_verse: E maa ngɔ nihi nɛ jaa ma se mawuhi kɛ bu e mɔ ɔmɛ a he. Nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ ɔ, e maa wo a hɛ mi nyami babauu; e ma ha mɛ blɔ nya nguanguahi, nɛ e maa dla zugba ngɔ ha mɛ.

english_verse: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another,
translation_verse: “Ke be nɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ nyagbe be ɔ su ta a, Egipt matsɛ ɔ ma ba tua lɛ. Se Siria matsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ ta zugba lɛhi, okpɔngɔhi, kɛ lɛhi babauu kɛ ba, nɛ e kɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ ma ba hwu ta wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Kaa bɔ nɛ pa bee ɔ, ja nɛ e maa ngɔ zugba amɛ kakaaka.

english_verse: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
translation_verse: E ma ya tua zugba a nɛ a wo he si ɔ po, nɛ e maa gbe nihi babauu nitsɛ. Se Edom, Moab, kɛ Amon bi nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ e nine be a nɔ sue.

english_verse: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt,
translation_verse: Ke e ba tua ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, Egipt tete he be mi jee.

english_verse: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: E maa ngɔ Egipt june tsuo, sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ a he jua wa. Libia kɛ Sudan ma sɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.
translation_verse: Se e maa nu sane komɛ kɛ je beleku je kɛ omleyi je, nɛ e tsui maa po. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e ma kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi basabasa.

english_verse: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
translation_verse: E maa ma matsɛ bo tsu agboagbohi ngɛ wo ɔ, kɛ yo ɔ nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ maa si ngɛ nɔ ɔ a kpɛti. Se e ma gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko be bae nɛ e ba je ngmlaa ha lɛ.”

english_verse: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo momo nɛ a pu mɛ ɔ, a ti nihi babauu maa te si ekohu: ni komɛ maa ya neneene wami mi, nɛ ni komɛ hu maa ya neneene hɛ mi si puemi mi.

english_verse: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
translation_verse: Ní leli ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi ɔ ma kpɛ kaa pu. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ tsɔɔ nihi babauu blɔ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma kpɛ kaa dodoehi kɛ maa ya neneene.”

english_verse: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it. The End of Time
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ de mi ke, “Daniel, jehanɛ nga womi ɔ nya, nɛ o sɔu nya kɛ yaa si je mi nyagbe. Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa si jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi babauu ma gbo yaka dengme. A maa nyɛɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba, nɛ a ma hla kaa a le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, imi Daniel, i na nyumuhi enyɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ pa ko he; nɔ kake daa si ngɛ pa a se lejɛ, nɛ nɔ kake daa si ngɛ kpo he hiɛmɛ a je.

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ kake bi bɔfo ɔ nɛ wo kploba tade kɛ daa si ngɛ pa a yiti je ɔ ke, “Mɛni be kikɛmɛ a nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si loko a se maa po?”

english_verse: The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ wo e nine enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ hiɔwe, nɛ e ka kita ngɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ daa a biɛ mi. I nu nɛ e de ke, “Kɛ yaa si jeha etɛ kɛ fa nɛ a wa Mawu ma a yi mi ta a, kɛkɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa maa ba mi.”

english_verse: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?” The angel in my vision then replied:
translation_verse: I nu nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ lɛɛ, se i nui sisi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i bi lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nyagbe maa ba kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.
translation_verse: E he nɔ ke, “Daniel, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, yaa. Ejakaa munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a kɛ maa to, nɛ a maa laa nɔ kɛ yaa si nyagbe be ɔ.

english_verse: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.
translation_verse: A maa tsukɔ nihi babauu a he, nɛ a he ma tsɔ. Yiwutsotsɛmɛ be sisi nue; a maa ya nɔ maa pee yayami. Ní leli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a maa nu sisi.

english_verse: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_verse: “Mo Daniel, ye anɔkuale kɛ yaa si nyagbe. O ma ba gbo, se o maa te si ekohu, nɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ, o nine maa su o blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me. Hosea's Family
