translation_verse: Yawɛ ha Beeri bi Hosea sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ, Uzia, Yotam, Ahaz, kɛ Hezekia a yi nɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yohoash bi Yeroboam ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Israel. Hosea yo ɔ kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ

english_verse: So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
translation_verse: Hosea pee bɔ nɛ a de lɛ ɔ. E ya ngɔ Diblaim biyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gomer. E na mi nɛ e fɔ binyumuyo.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom,
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Hosea ke, “Wo bi ɔ biɛ ke ‘Yezreel’; ejakaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma gbla Israel matsɛ ɔ tue ngɛ nihi nɛ e nɛ̃, Yehu kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ Yezreel ɔ a he. Ma ha nɛ Yehu nɔ yemi ɔ se maa po.

english_verse: and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha nɛ a maa ye Israel tabo ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yezreel kɔ̃ ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel.
translation_verse: E na mi ekohu nɛ e fɔ yo. Yawɛ de Hosea ke, “Moo wo lɛ ke, ‘Asumemo’. Ejakaa i be Israel sane suɔe hu, nɛ i be a tɔmi ngɔe kɛ pa mɛ.

english_verse: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
translation_verse: Se Yuda ma a lɛɛ, ma suɔ a sane. Imi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, ma he a yi wami. Pi ta nga nɔ nɛ ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ; pi klaate, loo kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi, loo okpɔngɔhi kɛ a nɔ hili nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.
translation_verse: Benɛ Gomer tsɔ́ e biyo ɔ nyɔ ɔ, e ba na mi ekohu, nɛ e fɔ binyumuyo enyɔne.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.” Hope for Israel
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Hosea ke, “Wo lɛ biɛ ke, ‘Piyema’, ejakaa pi ye ma ji Israel, nɛ pi a Mawu ji mi.” Israel ma ba da e da he ekohu

english_verse: Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called “Not My People,” but in the future they will be called “Children of the Living God.”
translation_verse: Israel bi a he ma ba hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane mɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kale a yibɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu ngɛ mɛ dee ke, “Pi ye ma ji nyɛ”; se be ma nɛ e ma de mɛ ke, “Imi Mawu hɛ ngmengmletsɛ ɔ, ye bimɛ ji nyɛ!”

english_verse: Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.
translation_verse: Yuda bi, kɛ Israel bi ma ba pee kake; a maa hla nɔ kake nɛ da a nya, nɛ a maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Niinɛ, Yezreel ma ba plɔke.

english_verse: So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.” The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Mawu ma”, kɛ “Nihi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ suɔ mɛ.” Israel yi Mawu anɔkuale kaa bɔ nɛ Gomer yi Hosea anɔkuale ɔ

english_verse: Accuse! Accuse your mother! She is no longer my wife, and now I, the Lord, am not her husband. Beg her to give up prostitution and stop being unfaithful,
translation_verse: Israel bi ngɛ kaa imi Mawu, ye bimɛ. E ngɛ mi kaa i kɛ Israel be bɔmi kaa nɔ kɛ e yo hu lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ tu, konɛ e kpa gba puɛmi kɛ yahomi ɔ.

english_verse: or I will strip her naked like the day she was born. I will make her barren like a desert, and she will die of thirst.
translation_verse: Ke pi ja a, ma kpa bo ngɛ e he, nɛ e he maa fɔ si paslapaa kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ. Ma ha e maa pee kaa zugba gbigbli nɛ bɛ ní; nɛ nyu kuma maa gbe lɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will build a fence of thorns to block her path.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ mio tso kɛ tsi lɛ blɔ; ma fia gli kɛ wo e he kɛ tsi lɛ blɔ.

english_verse: She will run after her lovers, but not catch them; she will search, but not find them. Then she will say, “I'll return to my first husband. Life was better then.”
translation_verse: E ma ya hla e pla amɛ a se blɔ, se e nine be a nɔ sue. E ma hla mɛ hluu, se e be mɛ nae. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma de ke, “Ma kpale kɛ ya ye huno momo ɔ ngɔ. Benɛ i kɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ, níhi a mi hi ha mi kulaa pe piɔ.”

english_verse: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: E li tete kaa ngma, dã, kɛ nu ɔ, imi lɛ i ha lɛ. Jehanɛ, sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ní nɛ a kɛ jaa Baal ɔ, e li kaa imi lɛ i kɛ dloo lɛ.

english_verse: So I'll hold back the harvest of grain and grapes. I'll take back my wool and my linen that cover her body.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ní kpami be su ɔ, blɛfo be bae, nɛ wai hu se maa po. Kploba kɛ kuutu nɛ e kɛ maa ha e he hu ma bɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Then I'll strip her naked in the sight of her lovers. No one can rescue her.
translation_verse: Ma kpa bo ngɛ e he ngɛ e pla amɛ a hɛ mi paa; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I'll stop Israel's celebrations— no more New Moon Festivals, Sabbaths, or other feasts.
translation_verse: E nyami be ɔmɛ: Nyɔhiɔhe, Hejɔɔmi, kɛ nyami be kpa amɛ tsuo a se maa po.

english_verse: She said, “My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex.” Now I, the Lord, will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: E wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ ngmɔkɔ ɔ nɛ e ke e pla amɛ lɛ a pee kɛ wo lɛ hiɔ ɔ; ee, ma kpata ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. Ngmɔ ɔ maa hɛ kaa hue, nɛ nga mi lohwehi maa ye e mi ní ɔ.

english_verse: I will return your vineyards, and then Trouble Valley will become Hopeful Valley. You will say “Yes” to me as you did in your youth, when leaving Egypt.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ wai abɔɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ha lɛ ekohu. Haomi Kɔ̃ ɔ ma plɛ pee he ko nɛ e ma ná ní kpakpahi ngɛ. E kɛ mi maa hi si saminya kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ngɛ e yihe mi, benɛ e je Egipt kɛ ba a.

english_verse: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma tsɛ mi ke e huno ekohu; e be mi tsɛe ke e Baal hu.

english_verse: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
translation_verse: Baal biɛ maa laa lɛ pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ e be e ta woe hu.

english_verse: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness,
translation_verse: Israel, i kɛ mo maa hi si kaa ye yo; ma ye mo anɔkuale. Ye suɔmi kɛ mɔbɔ nami nɛ ngɛ daa a, ma je kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo, nɛ ma ngɔ mo kɛ pee ye nɔ́ kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ekohu ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya hla yo gba puɛlɔ, nɛ o suɔ lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i suɔ ye ma Israel ɔ. Ye ma Israel kua mi; a ya ngɛ mawu kpahi a se nyɛɛe, nɛ a kɛ wai yiblii gbigbli sãã bɔ kɛ haa mɛ lɛɛ, se kɛ̃, i suɔ mɛ.”

english_verse: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
translation_verse: I de lɛ ke lɛ nɔ kake too nɛ hi si; e ko pee yakayaka; e ko ya nyɛɛ nyumu kpahi a se. Kɛkɛ ɔ, imi hu i kɛ lɛ maa hi si.

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
translation_verse: Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Israel bi hu maa hi si be babauu nɛ a be matsɛmɛ, loo hɛ mi nyɛɛli. Bɔ sami, kɛ tɛ titimahi a jami se maa po; nɛ amagahi, kɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ klaa a, ekoeko be si hie hu.

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: Se pee se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ maa kpale kɛ ba a ma a mi ekohu; a ma ba hla Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, kɛ David nɛ ji matsɛ ɔ nina se blɔ ekohu. Jamɛ a be ɔ, a maa ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ a ma na nike ní kpakpahi kɛ je e dɛ mi.

english_verse: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ɔ tue. Yawɛ ke Israel ma a tɔ̃ e nɔ. E ke, “Anɔkuale yemi ta zugba a nɔ; suɔmi be, nɛ imi Mawu nitsɛ hu a li mi.

english_verse: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ zugba a pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ ɔ nɛ. Níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nga mi lohwehi kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ tsuo pee gbedee; nɛ pa mi lohi tete ngɛ gboe.” Yawɛ kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ná

english_verse: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ ko kó pia ma a ke ma a lɛ tɔ̃; nɛ nɔ ko kó ka a hɛ mi hulɔ; nyɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ mohu lɛ i kɛ nyɛ ná.

english_verse: You and the prophets will stumble day and night; I'll silence your mothers.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma tɛ si nyɔ kɛ pia; nyɛɛ kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ma tɛ si, nɛ ma kpata nyɛ nyɛ Israel ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.
translation_verse: Ye ma a hɛ mi ma kpata, ejakaa a li nɔ. Ee, nyɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, nyɛ kua nile, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu ma kua nyɛ. Akɛnɛ nyɛ hɛ je ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ he je ɔ, imi hu ye hɛ maa je nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
translation_verse: “Si abɔ nɛ nyɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nyɛ he ngɛ hiɛe ɔ, si abɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ yayami babauu pee kɛ ngɛ mi sie. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i be nyɛ hɛ mi nyami woe; ma pue nyɛ hɛ mi si mohu.

english_verse: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
translation_verse: Ma gbla nyɛ tsuo nyɛ tue: ma mi no gu jio, osɔfo jio, ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ yayami nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: and have been unfaithful to me, their Lord. God Condemns Israel's Idolatry My people, you are foolish because of too much pleasure and too much wine.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Wai he, kɛ wai momo ha nɛ ye ma a ngɛ biɛe! A je ye se kulaa!

english_verse: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
translation_verse: Tso kpoku mohu ngɔ a ya ngɛ ní bie ngɛ. Dɛma tso mohu a bi ɔ ke e tsɔɔ mɛ nile. Kaa bɔ nɛ yo yaholɔ peeɔ ɔ, a je ye se nɛ a kɛ a he ya ha mawu kpahi.

english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ ya pee a he yaholi, nɛ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ a yi ɔmɛ ya puɛ gba a, i be a tue gblae; ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ ya nyɛɛɔ yaholi nɛ ɔmɛ a se, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo nyɛ ya sãã bɔ kɛ haa a wɔ ɔmɛ. Ejakaa ‘Ma nɛ li nɔ́ ɔ, a hɛ mi kpataa.’

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: “Israel, nyɛ yi mi anɔkuale; nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ Yuda ko ba pee kaa nyɛ. Nyɛ ko ya ja Mawu ngɛ Gilgal, loo Betaven; nɛ nyɛ kó ka kita ngɛ Yawɛ, Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ biɛ mi hulɔ.

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Israel ma a tue mi ti kaa bɔ nɛ teji okpɔngɔ tue mi ti ɔ. Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma lɛ mɛ ngɛ nga nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a lɛɛ to ɔ?

english_verse: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
translation_verse: Israel ma a ke e ma ja amaga! É ya nɔ nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ e tsui suɔ.

english_verse: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
translation_verse: Ke Israel bi ya tɔ dã kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a bɔɔ ajuama, nɛ a bua jɔɔ. Zo níhi a he a nyaa, pi níhi nɛ maa wo a hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: A maa be kɛ ho kaa bɔ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ woɔ nɔ́; nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ ngɛ bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a sãã a he.

english_verse: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ osɔfohi, nyɛɛ bu tue! Israel ma nyɛ tã tue! Matsɛ we mi bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛ sa tue gblami! Ejakaa nyɛ pee kaa klama nɛ a tsɔ ngɛ Mizpa, kɛ yá nɛ a wo ngɛ Tabor yo ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: nɛ Akasia ma a hu pee kaa muɔ voo kɛ e mi yayami peeli kpanakuhi sɔuu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma gbla nyɛ tsuo nyɛ tue!

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: Yayami nɛ ma a pee ɔ ha we nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a kpale kɛ ba a Mawu ɔ ngɔ. Amaga jami ngɔ a tsui kulaa, nɛ a li Yawɛ hu.

english_verse: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.
translation_verse: Israel bi a he nɔ womi ɔ yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mɛ. A he yayami ɔ kɛ tue gblami maa ba a nɔ, nɛ Yuda hu be e he yee.

english_verse: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
translation_verse: A maa ngɔ tohi, kɛ nahi kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, se a be lɛ nae; ejakaa Yawɛ je a se.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: A yi Mawu anɔkuale; a kɛ ni kpahi ya fɔ bimɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be kɛe kulaa nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a zugba a tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata. Yuda kɛ Israel hwu ta

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ Betaven! Nyɛ ha nɛ a nu he ngɛ Rama! Nyɛ he ose ngɛ Betel! Nyɛ Benyamin bi, nyɛ gba ta!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Tue gblami be ɔ su ta, nɛ a ma kpata Israel hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Ee, Israel ma, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Israel ngɛ nɔ́ nae; a gbla e tue wawɛɛ, ejakaa e ya nyɛɛ yakayaka níhi a se.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Imi Yawɛ, ma tsɔtslɔɔ Israel kɛ Yuda a mi ngɔ pue si kaa jata peeɔ nɔ́. Ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ mɛ ngɛ ye dɛ.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: “Ma ngmɛɛ ye ma a he, konɛ a na nɔ́ wawɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma pia a he ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a ma hla ye se blɔ. Ke a yi fi ɔ, a ma ba kpa mi pɛɛ.”

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: Ma a ma de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ! E tsɔtslɔɔ wa mi, se e ma tsa wɔ kɛ̃. E plaa wɔ, se lɛ nɔuu lɛ e maa fi pa amɛ a nɔ ha wɔ!

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Ngɛ ligbi enyɔ mi ɔ, e ma ha wa na he wami ekohu; ligbi etɛne ɔ, e ma wo wa nɔ nɛ waa kɛ lɛ maa hi si.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha waa bɔ mɔde nɛ waa le Yawɛ saminya. Kaa bɔ nɛ je naa daa ligbi, nɛ hiɔmi hu nɛɛɔ ngɔ pueɔ zugba daa gbo kɛ gbiɛ ɔ, ke wa hla Yawɛ se blɔ ɔ, lɛ hu e maa ba wa ngɔ.”

english_verse: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ ke, “Israel kɛ Yuda, kɛ ma pee nyɛ kɛɛ? Suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ ha mi ɔ ngɛ kaa afua nɛ wo mɔtu, loo bɔ́ nɛ́ nɛ; bɔɔ kɛkɛ e se po.

english_verse: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i tsɔ ye gbali ɔmɛ nɛ a ba bɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ kaa ma gbla nyɛ tue ɔ nɛ. I ke a maa gbla nyɛ tue kaa bɔ nɛ oslabai gbaa a.

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Yayami peeli, kɛ muɔ si pueli hiɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ Gilead ma a mi.

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔmɛ buaa a he nya kaa bɔ nɛ ojo fiali woɔ ka haa nihi ɔ. Shekem blɔ nɔ po, a poo nɔ nɛ a gbeɔ nɔ basabasa. A peeɔ yiku níhi babauu.

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: I na nɔ́ ko ngɛ Israel nɛ ha nɛ ye he mi po; ye ma a ngɔ yahomi kɛ ble a he.

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: “Yuda bi, nyɛ hu i to be nɛ ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ yayami nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ he.

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nihi toɔ ga yayahi nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ matsɛ ɔ kɛ e nimeli ɔmɛ.

english_verse: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
translation_verse: Ke matsɛ ɔ ngɛ e fɔmi ligbi yee ɔ, e kɛ e ma nimeli ɔmɛ nuɔ dã nɛ a deɔ, kɛkɛ a bɔni biɛmi.

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Israel ma a ngɛ kaa abolo nɛ be fa kɛ fa. Israel ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ mahi nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ a nɔ,

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: nɛ nibwɔ ɔmɛ butu ma a, se e li. Israel li tete kaa e nyagbe su ta.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel ma a yeɔ fɔ kaa a wo a he nɔ kɛ si Mawu, se enɛ ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, a hla we Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ se blɔ nɛ a kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ a yaa a, ma nyɛɛ a se nɛ ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba ekohu, kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ te kɛ bee nɛ a ya du yá. Ma gbla a tue ngɛ a yi wu tso ní ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: “Musu tloo mɛ! Ma kpata a hɛ mi; ejakaa a tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã, nɛ a je ye se. I hla kaa ma he a yi wami; se a ja we mi anɔkuale mi.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Ke a ngɛ kue fae ha mi ɔ, e ji a tsui mi; awe sɔuu a hii nyae ngɛ sa mi. Ke a ngɛ sɔlee nɛ ma ha mɛ blɛfo kɛ dã a, a kɛ nɔ́ poɔ a he basabasa kaa wɔ jali. Atuã tsɔli!

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ nɛ i tsɔse mɛ, nɛ i ha nɛ a he wa, se a soɔ kɛ woɔ ye he.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: A je ye se, nɛ mawu nɛ be he wami ko he wami ko ɔ, lɔ ɔ se a ngɛ nyɛɛe. A ngɛ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ kpɛ̃. A ma kpata a ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, ejakaa a tuɔ munyu puu; nɛ Egipt bi kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ye a he fɛu.”

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: A tsɛɔ mi ke a Mawu; a deɔ ke ye ma ji mɛ, nɛ a le mi.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Sika tsu na ku ɔ nɛ Samaria bi ɔmɛ jaa a peeɔ mi tai. Ye mi mi fu mɛ. Mɛni be po a ma kpa a we amaga nɛ ɔmɛ jami?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Ga ní tsulɔ ko lɛ puɛ amaga a, pi mawu ji lɛ! Sika tsu amaga a nɛ ngɛ Samaria a, ma ku e mi dukuduku!

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke a du kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, a ma kpa lasiogblee! Blɛfo ngmɔ nɛ wui ní ɔ, a be mamu nae kɛ je mi. Ke e wo yiblii po nibwɔhi ma ba ye lɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Israel yi ta pɛ! Israel pee kaa buɛ kokoe ngɛ ma amɛ a kpɛti; e he be se nami.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Israel ma a tue wa kaa nga mi teji nɛ ngɛ si kpae. A ho ya bi Asiria bi yemi kɛ buami, nɛ a ya bɔ ma kpahi hu apaa ke a ba piɛ a he.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: A ya bɔ ma kpahi apaa ke a ba piɛ a he lɛɛ, se e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma gbla a tue. Be kuku pɛ a be matsɛmɛ woe hu, nɛ a be ma nimeli hu hlae.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: “Israel ma a puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ babauu nɛ a kɛ ma je a he yayami, se yayami mohu a ngɛ pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: A gbeɔ lohwehi kɛ sãã bɔ kɛ haa mi, nɛ lo ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yeɔ. Se imi Yawɛ, ye bua jɔɛ a he. Ma kai a he yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ ma gbla a tue kokooko ngɛ he; ma kpale mɛ kɛ ho Egipt ya!

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: “Israel ma a hɛ je a bɔlɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ya ma we nguanguahi. Yuda ma hu po mahi babauu nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he. Se ma ha la maa sã we nguangua amɛ, kɛ ma amɛ nɛ a fia gbogbo wo a he ɔ tsuo.”

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Israel ma, nyɛ kpa nyami kaa bɔ nɛ je ma amɛ peeɔ ɔ. Nyɛ je nyɛ Mawu ɔ se, nɛ nyɛ yi lɛ anɔkuale. Nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ya mɛtɛ mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Baal ɔ he ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo kaa yaholi. Ke blɛfo nya je ɔ, nyɛ ya sãã bɔ ha lɛ, nɛ nyɛ naa lɛ si.

english_verse: But you will run short of grain and wine,
translation_verse: Ngma gbeemi he, kɛ wai muɔ mi ní be nyɛ nya sue. Wai he hu ma bɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Israel be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ hie daa. A maa kpale kɛ ho Egipt ya, nɛ niye ní nɛ he tsɔ we ɔ, lɔ ɔ a ma ya ye ngɛ Asiria.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Israel bi be nyɛe maa ngɔ dã ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ ní nɛ a maa ye ɔ ma ble mɛ kaa ya sisi niye ní. A ma nyɛ maa ye kɛ gbe hwɔ kɛkɛ, pi kaa a maa ngɔ kɛ ya sã bɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ ke nyami be ɔmɛ su ɔ, kɛ Israel ma a maa pee kɛɛ? Yawɛ nyami be ɔ, mɛni a maa pee?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Ke Asiria bi ba nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ nɛ a gbɛ fĩa a, Egipt bi ma bua a nya; ee, a ma bua a nya ya pu mɛ ngɛ Memfis! Mio tso, kɛ pú maa bɔ kɛ pue a wehi, kɛ a sika hiɔ níhi nɛ he jua waa tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Be nɛ a maa gbla Israel ma a tue ɔ su. Be ɔ su nɛ a maa wo mɛ hiɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa hɛli si! Nyɛ deɔ ke, “Gbalɔ nɛ ɔ biɛ lo! Nyumu ɔ nɛ na mumi ɔ nu godo!” Nyɛ deɔ enɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ he yayami hiɛ babauu; nɛ nyɛ sume mi saasaa.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Ma a puɛ kulaa kɛ yayami peemi kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ngɛ Gibea be ko ɔ. Yayami nɛ a pee ɔ, Mawu hɛ be nɔ jee; e maa gbla a tue kokooko. Yawɛ maa gbla Israel ma a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔ he

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Benɛ i na Israel ma a kekleekle ɔ, a ngɛ kaa wai yiblii ngɛ nga nɔ. Benɛ i na nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ngɛ kaa ngmɔkɔ he nɛ fu ngɛ e be mi. Se benɛ a ba su Peor yo ɔ he ɔ, a ba bɔni Baal jami. A kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ble a he, nɛ a he pee tai kaa nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ jae ɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Israel hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa laa mɛ tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ tee. Yi ɔmɛ be fɔe hu; hɔ tete po a be ngɔe.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Ke a fɔ tete po, ma ha a ma gbo bi hluu kɛ yaa si kake ngmelu po be piɛe. Musu tloo mɛ wawɛɛ ke i kua mɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: Imi Hosea, i na ngɛ nina mi nɛ Israel ngɔ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha kaa lohwehi nɛ a maa gbe. Bitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ maa ngɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ ya ha nɔ gbeli.

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ke yi ɔmɛ ngɔ hɔ ɔ, hɔ ɔ nɛ sane, nɛ nyu nɛ ta a nyɔ mi. Yawɛ gbla Israel ma a tue

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Israel ma a je a yayami peemi ɔ tsuo sisi ngɛ Gilgal, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a he bɔni mi tai peemi kɛ je. Yi wu tso níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he ɔ, ma fie mɛ kɛ je zugba a nɔ. I be mɛ suɔe hu; Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Israel ma a, musu tloo mɛ pɛ; a ngɛ kaa tso nɛ e sipoku gbli, nɛ e wui yiblii. A be fɔe; nɛ ke a fɔ tete po, bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a suɔ saminya a, ma kpata a hɛ mi.” Gbalɔ ɔ tu Israel he munyu

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: Ye Mawu ɔ ma kua e ma a; ejakaa a bui lɛ tue. A maa wo lalaalo ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Israel ma a ngɛ kaa wai tso nɛ wo yiblii babauu. Ke a ná ní ɔ, kɛkɛ a puɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi fuu. Titimahi nɛ a puɛ nɛ a jaa a, a dlaa a he nɛ a he peeɔ fɛu.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: A yi Mawu anɔkuale, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a maa gbla a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he. Yawɛ maa ku a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ titima amɛ kɛ pue si.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma de ke, “Wa be matsɛ, ejakaa wa yi Yawɛ gbeye. Ke wa ngɛ matsɛ po, mɛni e ma nyɛ maa pee ha wɔ?”

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Samaria bi maa ye gbeye, nɛ a maa ye kɔmɔ ngɛ sika tsu na ku ɔ nɛ ngɛ Betel nɛ a kpata e hɛ mi ɔ he. A kɛ lakpa osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo ma nya awe kaa amaga a hɛ mi nyami ɔ laa mɛ.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, amaga a nitsɛ lɛɛ a maa ngɔ kɛ ya Asiria kɛ ya ke matsɛ ngua a. Israel bi a hɛ mi ma pue si, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ saminya ngɛ amaga nɛ a puɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Samaria matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata kaa tso kpoku ngɛ pa hɛ mi.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Wɔ piɛhi nɛ ngɛ Aven yoku ɔ nɔ, he nɛ Israel ma a ya jaa amaga amɛ ngɛ ɔ, a ma kpata a hɛ mi. Mio tso, kɛ hu maa bɔ kɛ pue a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Nɛ Israel bi ma kpa ngmlaa ma de yo gagaa amɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba ha wa nɔ!” nɛ a ma de yoku ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba nɔ wa nɔ!” Yawɛ maa gbla Israel tue

english_verse: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Kɛ je be nɛ Israel pee yayami kɛ si mi ngɛ Gibea a, anɛ e sɛ kaa ta ba naa mɛ ngɛ Gibea lo?

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Ma tua ma yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ma gbla a tue. Je mahi maa pee kake kɛ wo mɛ, nɛ a maa gbla a tue ngɛ a yayami babauu ɔ he.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: “Sa a, Israel ngɛ kaa na yiheyo nɛ a tsɔse lɛ saminya. Be tsuaa be ɔ, e suɔ kaa e gblɛ ngma. Se i pee ye yi mi kaa ma wo e kuɛ saminyayoo ɔ kuɛpã tso, konɛ e tsu ní kpakpataa. I ha Yuda gbla na kpakplaa tso ɔ, nɛ Israel hɛɛ ngmɔ nɔ dlami nɔ́ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
translation_verse: I de ke, ‘Nyɛɛ ye dami sane, konɛ ma suɔ nyɛ, nɛ ma gbaa nyɛ. Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui; ejakaa be ɔ su nɛ nyɛ ma hla imi Yawɛ, ye se blɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma ha dami sane yemi ma he si kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: Yayami nɛ nyɛ du ɔ, e yiblii nɛ nyɛ kpa. Lakpa amɛ nɛ nyɛ ye ɔ, a mi nɔ́ nyɛ ngɛ nae ɔ nɛ. “Nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ nyɛ ta buli babauu ɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ta ma ba tua nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ mɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Shalman kpata Betabel hɛ mi ngɛ ta mi ɔ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a nuu nyɛmɛ kɛ a bimɛ tsuo ngɔ fiaa si nɛ a gbe mɛ.

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Betel bi, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa nyɛ pee yayami gbegbeegbe. A ma kpata Israel matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ ta mi.”

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa jokuɛwi ɔ, i suɔ a sane, nɛ i je mɛ kɛ je Egipt.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Se ke i hla kaa ma gbla mɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ, kɛkɛ a tsɔ atuã. A ya sãã bɔ kɛ haa Baalhi, nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via hu kɛ haa amaga kpahi.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Imi nɛ i tsɔse Israel ma a kaa a tsɔɔ jokuɛ nyɛɛmi; nɛ i hɛɛ mɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ kaa jokuɛyo ngɛ ye nine bɔkɔ mi, se a li kaa imi lɛ i baa a yi.

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: “Akɛnɛ a kua ye ngɔ bami ɔ, a maa kpale kɛ ho Egipt ya, nɛ Asiria maa ye a nɔ.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Ye ma a fia pɛɛ si kaa a ma kua mi; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma gbla a tue, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa je ngmlaa ha mɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: “Israel ma, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ ma ngmɛɛ nyɛ he? Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ ma kua nyɛ? Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Adma a? Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ ma wa nyɛ yi mi kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Zeboyim ɔ? Ye tsui be mi blɔ ngmɛe kaa ma pee jã! Suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nya wa tsɔ!

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: I be nyɛ tue gblae ngɛ ye mi mi fumi ɔ nya. I be Israel hɛ mi kpatae hu. Ejakaa Mawu ji mi, pi nɔmlɔ adesa ji mi. Imi Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ. I be nyɛ ngɔ bae kɛ abofu.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: “Ke i huã kikɛ nɛ ɔ kaa jata a, ye ma a maa nyɛɛ ye se. A he maa sɔ kɛ maa je bonyoku je kɛ ba.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: A maa je Egipt kɛ ba kɛ fo kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ. A maa je Asiria kɛ maa ba kaa lahuɛhi. Ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba a we ɔmɛ a mi ekohu. Imi Yawɛ lɛ i de.” A bu Israel kɛ Yuda fɔ

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: “Daa nyɔ kɛ pia a, yi wu tso níhi, kɛ níhi nɛ a he be se nami sɔuu Israel ma a ngɛ pee. A sisiɔ nɔ, nɛ a pueɔ muɔ si. A kɛ Asiria ngɛ huɛ bɔe, nɛ Egipt lɛɛ a kɛ lɛ yeɔ nu jua.”

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ Yuda ma a ná. E maa gbla Israel ma a hu tue ngɛ a je mi bami he. A he yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e maa gbla a tue.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, e kɛ Mawu bɔfo nɔ kunɔ, nɛ e ye e nɔ. E fo ya ngɔ pue bɔfo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke e gbaa lɛ. E kɛ Mawu kpe ngɛ Betel, nɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu; Yawɛ ji e biɛ.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Israel ma a deɔ ji, ‘Niatsɛmɛ ji wɔ. Wa ná ní babauu.’ Se ní nɛ a na babauu ɔ tsuo be nyɛe ma je a he yayami ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. Imi nɛ i je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ. Ma ha nyɛ maa hi bo tsuhi a mi ekohu kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ hi si be ko ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: “Imi lɛ i kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tu munyu. Imi nɛ i je ninahi ha mɛ, nɛ i gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ i kɛ ye ma a tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi.

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃, a ngɛ yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ; a jaa amaga ngɛ Gilead, nɛ a kɛ na ku sãã bɔ ngɛ Gilgal. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma kpata a hɛ mi; bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ hu maa ywia, nɛ tɛ ɔmɛ ma pue si glekuu glekuu ngɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi.”

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ha nɛ gbalɔ ko ya je e ma Israel kɛ je Egipt. Gbalɔ nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ, nɛ e hyɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
translation_verse: Be ko nɛ be ɔ, ke Efraim wɛtso ɔ de nɔ́ ko ɔ, Israel wɛtso kpa amɛ yee gbeye; ejakaa a buu Efraim saminya. Se ma a pee yayami kaa a ya ja Baal; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma gbo.

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata si kake too, nɛ a be mɛ nae hu, kaa mɔtu bɔku, loo bɔ́, loo jakati nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ kɛ je ngma mi sami he, loo la su ku nɛ je la su ku tɔ mi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ. Imi pɛ ji nyɛ Mawu. Imi nɔ kake too pɛ ji nyɛ kpɔlɔ.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: Imi nɛ i hyɛ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ, he nɛ nyu ko nyu ko be.

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: Se benɛ nyɛ ye ní nɛ nyɛ tɔ saminya a, nyɛ wo nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ je ye nɔ.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ba tua nyɛ kaa jata. Ma wo nyɛ ka ngɛ blɔ he kaa ngatsɛ.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: Ma ba tua nyɛ kaa osisiblisi nɛ a nu e bimɛ. Ma fɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ ma ye lo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔuu kaa jata; ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe dikalɔ peeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: “Israel ma, ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ! Nɛ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma kpɔ nyɛ?

english_verse: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
translation_verse: Nyɛ bi ke a to matsɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ bi hu ke a ha nyɛ asafoatsɛmɛ; se nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ma nyɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami lo?

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: I kɛ abofu to matsɛmɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ i kɛ mi mi la kpa mɛ.

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: “Israel ma a pee yayami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a yeɔ fɔ. A kadi enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɔ to.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: Anɛ ma kpɔ mɛ kɛ je gbeje lo? Anɛ ma he mɛ kɛ je gbenɔ dɛ mi lo? Gbenɔ, jije o hiɔ nɛ gbee nɔ ɔ ngɛ? Gbeje, jije nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ ngɛ? I be ma nɛ ɔ mɔbɔ nae hu.

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Ke Israel ma a ngɛ plɔkee, nɛ e pee plɔplɔɔplɔ kaa nga po, ma ha kɔɔhiɔ nɛ mi dɔ la maa fia kɛ je nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ beleku je kɛ ba. Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ nyu maa ta a vu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ pa amɛ maa mii. Ma ha a juetli tsuo maa ta.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: A maa gbla Samaria tue, ejakaa e tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã. Ta ma kpata ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; a maa ngɔ a bimwɔwi ɔmɛ ngɔ fiaa si, nɛ a kɛ klaate ma fɛ yihɔyi ɔmɛ a mi mi.”

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Israel ma, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ. Nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ ha nɛ nyɛ pee kaa ni komɛ nɛ tɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔɔ si.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Asiria be nyɛe ma he wa yi wami. Wa be wa he ngɔe kɛ fɔ ta okpɔngɔhi a nɔ. Wa be wa amaga amɛ dee hu ke mɛ ji wa Mawu. Yawɛ, mo nɛ o naa awusahi mɔbɔ.” Yawɛ wo si ke e ma ha Israel wami he

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha ye ma a maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo, ejakaa ye mi mi nɛ fu mɛ ɔ se po!

english_verse: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
translation_verse: Ma ha Israel ma a ma plɔke plɔplɔɔplɔ kaa zugba gbigbli nɛ hiɔmi nɛ pue nɔ.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: A ma na wami he, nɛ a maa bɔ. A he maa pee fɛu kaa oliv tsohi, nɛ a maa je via kaa seda tsohi ngɛ Lebanon.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: A maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu, nɛ a kɛ mi maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi. A maa bɔ kaa ngmɔ nɛ ba ní saminya, nɛ a ma plɔke kaa wai tso; nɛ a biɛ ma he si kaa Lebanon wai.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Israel ma, mɛni peemi i kɛ amagahi ngɛ? Imi nɛ i buu nyɛ kue fami tue nɛ i hyɛɛ nyɛ nɔ. I ngɛ kaa sɛsɛo tso nɛ ba mumu tɛ̃ e nɔ gblegbleegble. Imi lɛ i haa ma a niye ní.” Nyagbe

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ji ní lelɔ? Ha nɛ e nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi. Mɛnɔ lɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi? Ha nɛ e yɔse. Ejakaa Yawɛ blɔ ɔmɛ da tlɔmɔɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a nyɛɛɔ nɔ tɛɛ. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a tɛɔ nɔ́, nɛ a nɔɔ si.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ e kɛ ha Petuel binyumu Yoel, ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ma a ye kɔmɔ ngɛ ngmɔ ní nɛ hɛ mi kpata a he

english_verse: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
translation_verse: Nyɛ dã deli, nyɛ hɛ nɛ tsɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yana; nyɛ wai dɔkɔdɔkɔ nuli, nyɛ nya awe; ejakaa a je nɔ́ ngɛ nyɛ nya mi.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Baalɛ babauu ba tua zugba a; a ngɛ kaa ta buli pɛ; a he wa, nɛ a he hiɛ; a lungu nya ba kaa jata ku lungu, nɛ a so hu ngɛ kaa jata yo so.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nya awe kaa bɔ nɛ yomiyo nyɛɛ ya kɛ haa nyumu nɛ na we nɛ e kpee lɛ loko e gbo ɔ.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Niye ní kɛ wai nɛ a kɛ ba sãã bɔɔ se po ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.

english_verse: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ngmɔ huli, nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ; nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hyɛɛ wai ngmɔhi a nɔ, nyɛ nya awe; ejakaa ngma, akoko, kɛ ngmɔ nɔ ní tsuo hɛ mi kpata.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Wai tso ɔmɛ, ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ, kɛ tã amɛ ylɔ; nɛ tso kpa amɛ tsuo gbli, nɛ a gbo. Ma a bua jɔmi ɔ se po.

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Nyɛ osɔfohi nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nyɛɛ ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yana! Nyɛɛ ya Mawu we ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ ya ye kɔmɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ tsuo. Ejakaa niye ní be ɔ, wai hu be nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa sã bɔ ha nyɛ Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ wo mlaa nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ ha hwɔ; nɛ a ba bua a he nya. Nyɛ bua Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo a nya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ we ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ fa kue ha lɛ.

english_verse: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ligbi ɔ su ta; ligbi nɛ Ope ɔ ma kpata wa hɛ mi ɔ su. E maa pee gbeye jamɛ a ligbi ɔ!

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Pi wa niba ní nɛ wa ngɛ hyɛe nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae nɛ ɔ? Bua jɔmi, kɛ nyami se po ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ.

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ a du ɔ tsuo gbo ngɛ zu mi. A na we ngma a eko kulaa nɛ a kɛ maa to. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, blɛfo gba amɛ a mi je gu, nɛ a ku kɛ pueɔ si.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Nga mi lohwe ɔmɛ po ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe; ejakaa pa amɛ tsuo gbli, nɛ la hu kpata lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ Zion, ngɛ Mawu yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ. Nyɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ bi tsuo, nyɛɛ ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli! Ejakaa Yawɛ ligbi ɔ su ta.

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, je mi ma yu tuu; nɛ je mi tsuo pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ. Baalɛ maa ha yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tuu kaa ta buli nɛ a he ngɛ gbeye. Enɛ ɔ eko bɛ hyɛ, nɛ eko hu be bae ja gblegbleegble.

english_verse: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.
translation_verse: Baalɛ ɔmɛ maa pee kaa okpɔngɔhi; a maa tu fo kaa ta okpɔngɔhi.

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: nɛ nɔ ko be e nyɛmi hlami poe hulɔ. A maa gblee níhi a mi kɛ be slɔkee, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mɛ blɔ tsie.

english_verse: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
translation_verse: A maa tuu kɛ sɛ ma a mi; a maa ma fo ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a maa kuɔ kɛ gu saflɛhi a mi, kɛ sɛ wehi a mi kaa juli.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: Ke a ma kikɛ nɛ ɔ, zugba ma mimiɛ, nɛ hiɔwe ma si; pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ maa wo diblii, nɛ dodoe be kpɛe hu.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: Yawɛ maa wo gbi kɛ fa e tabo ɔ he. E ta buli ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu; nihi nɛ buɔ Yawɛ tue ɔ, a li a yibɔ. Yawɛ ligbi ɔ maa pee gbeye. Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nya maa da? Yawɛ de ke a tsake a tsui

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui anɔkuale mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɔuu. Nyɛɛ ha hwɔ; nyɛɛ wo yana, nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ.

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ e hao nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi; se pi kaa nyɛ ma hía nyɛ tadehi ngɛ nyɛ he kɛkɛ.” Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ, ejakaa e mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ; e toɔ e tsui si; e yeɔ e siwo nɔ; e mi mi fu we mla, se mohu e kɛ nɔ́ paa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Alini, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, ma tsake e susumi ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ e maa gbaa nyɛ kɛ niba ní babauu. Ke e ba mi ja a, nyɛ maa sã niye ní bɔ ha lɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ wai kɛ piɛ he.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ; nyɛɛ wo mlaa nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ ha hwɔ, nɛ a ba bua a he nya.

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi sinya a nya, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ, a wo yana, nɛ a fa kue ke, “Yawɛ, naa o ma a mɔbɔ. Ko ha nɛ je ma kpa amɛ nɛ a bɔ wɔ ahlua, nɛ a ye wa he fɛu, nɛ a bi wɔ ke, ‘Jije nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ?’ ” Mawu ha zugba a ba ní ekohu

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Yawɛ kai e ma a, nɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de e ma a ke, “Jehanɛ ma ha nyɛ blɛfo, kɛ wai, kɛ oliv nu bɔ nɛ maa su nyɛ nya; je ma kpa amɛ be nyɛ ahlua bɔe hu.

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga mi lohwehi, nyɛ ko ye gbeye. Nga mumu puɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ; tso ɔmɛ ngɛ yiblii woe; ngmɔkɔ kɛ wai ba babauu.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ Zion bi, nyɛ nya nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee ha nyɛ ɔ he. E ha gbo nyu nɛ ha nyɛ babauu; gbiɛ nyu hu nɛ ha nyɛ bɔ nɛ sa, kaa kekle ko ɔ.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Ngma mi sami he ɔmɛ ma hyi tɔ kɛ ngma, nɛ muɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ wai kɛ oliv nu ngami he ɔmɛ ma hyi, nɛ a maa fo dɔ kɛ wai, kɛ oliv nu.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ baalɛ ɔmɛ ba ha nɛ a ye jeha babauu ɔ, ma ha nyɛ ekohu. Imi nitsɛ nɛ i je baalɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi a ta nguaa nɛ ɔ kɛ wo nyɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ maa ye ní nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ. Nyɛ ma je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ yi ngɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ha nyɛ ɔ he. A be ye ma a ahlua bɔe ligbi ko ligbi ko hu.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel ma, jamɛ a be ɔ mi loko nyɛ maa le kaa i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ; ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu. A be ye ma a ahlua bɔe ligbi ko ligbi ko hu. Yawɛ ligbi ɔ

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: “Pee se ɔ, ma plɛ ye mumi ɔ kɛ pue nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ; nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ maa fiɛ ye sɛ gbi ɔ; nyɛ nimowi ɔmɛ maa nla nlamihi, nɛ nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ maa na ninahi.

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ma plɛ ye mumu ɔ kɛ pue tsɔli, kɛ mawayihi po a nɔ.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: “Ma ha a maa na jamɛ a ligbi ɔ he okadi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba a nɔ: muɔ, kɛ la, kɛ la su ku kpii.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
translation_verse: Pu maa wo diblii, nɛ nyɔhiɔ maa pee tsutsuu kaa muɔ. Lɔ ɔ se loko Yawɛ ligbi nguaa nɛ ngɛ gbeye ɔ maa ba.

english_verse: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_verse: Se nihi tsuo nɛ ma sɔmɔ Yawɛ ɔ, a ma he a yi wami. Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ, ‘Nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, a ti ni komɛ a yi ma na wami; mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ i hla a nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ma ha Yuda ma a kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ma na ní kpɔtɔɔ ekohu.

english_verse: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
translation_verse: Ma bua je ma amɛ tsuo a nya, nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa ba Kojomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi. Ma kojo mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ye ma a he. A gbɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ fĩa zugba kpahi a nɔ; nɛ a gbá Israel, ye zugba a mi.

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: A fɔ sɔ kɛ dla nyɔguɛhi nɛ a nuu ngɛ ta mi ɔ ngɔ ha a he. A kɛ nyumuwi ɔmɛ tsake yaholi, nɛ a jua yiwi ɔmɛ kɛ he wai nɛ a nu.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: “Tiro, Sidon, kɛ Filistia zugba a tsuo, mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae kaa nyɛ maa pee mi nɛ ɔ? Nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ he lue lo? Ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ ma ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ yayami ɔ ma kpa bu nyɛ nɔ esɔ.

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: Nyɛ muɔ ye sika tsu, ye sika hiɔ, kɛ ye juetli kpakpa amɛ kɛ ya wo nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ngɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ kɛ je a zugba nɔ kɛ ho ma se lokoo ya, nɛ nyɛ jua mɛ ngɔ ha Hela bi.

english_verse: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ ma kpaka mɛ kɛ je he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ jua mɛ kɛ ho ɔ kɛ ba ekohu. Bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee mɛ ɔ, ja ma pee nyɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: Ma ha a maa jua nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ; nɛ mɛ hu a ma ya jua mɛ kɛ ha Sabea bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ma se tsitsaa. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ fiɛ kɛ ha je ma amɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ dla nyɛ he kɛ ha ta; nyɛ tsɛ nyɛ ta buli ɔmɛ kɛ ba; nyɛ bua nyɛ ta buli ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ nyɛɛ hia ta.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji mɛ; poo mɛ ngɔ pue si kaa bɔ nɛ a pooɔ blɛfo tsohi pueɔ si ngɛ ní kpami be mi ɔ; ngaa a mi kaa bɔ nɛ a ngaa wai yiblii mi ngɛ wai ngami he kɛ ya siɔ e hyiɔ muɔ ɔ, nɛ e pueɔ si ɔ.”

english_verse: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
translation_verse: Pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ maa wo diblii, nɛ dodoe ɔmɛ be kpɛe hu. Mawu maa gbaa e ma a

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: Yawɛ wo gbi kɛ je Zion yo ɔ nɔ; e gbi ɔ ké kɛ je Yerusalem. Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba mimiɛ. se Yawɛ ji wesa he kɛ ha e ma Israel ɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
translation_verse: “Israel, jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ o ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ. I hii Zion yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ. Yerusalem maa pee ma klɔuklɔu; nibwɔhi be nyɛe ma ba tua ma a gblegbleegble hu.

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ma hyi kɛ wai nɛ ngɔɔ, nɛ na nyɔ nyu maa pɔ he ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. Yuda pa amɛ tsuo ma hyi tɔ. Nyu hɛngmɛ maa hia kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ nyu ɔ ma ya pue Akasia kɔ̃ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
translation_verse: “Egipt ma plɛ pee nga kplanaa, nɛ Edom hu maa pee ma doku. Ejakaa a ya tua Yuda zugba a, nɛ a gbe ma a mi bi ɔmɛ yaka be mi nɛ a pee we yayami ko.

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: To hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Amos, nɛ je Tekoa ma a mi ɔ, e munyuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Jeha enyɔ loko zugba mimiɛ ɔ, benɛ Uzia ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ, nɛ Yehoash bi Yeroboam ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ ɔ, Mawu je ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ Amos ngɛ Israel he.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Siria ma ngua Damasko bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu; a wa Gilead bi ɔmɛ yi mi, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní a ní. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Ma mɛ we ɔ nɛ Matsɛ Hazael po ɔ he la, nɛ Matsɛ Benhadad mɔ ɔmɛ maa sã.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ bɔle Damasko ma a, agbohi nɛ a je ngɛ mi ɔ, ma ywia mɛ. Ma gbe nihi nɛ ngɛ Aven kɔ̃ ɔ mi, kɛ Beteden ma nɔ yelɔ ɔ. A maa nuu Siria bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ya Kir zugba a nɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de. Filistia

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Gaza ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu; a nuu kɔpehi fuu a mi bi kɛ ho, nɛ a ya jua mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ ha Edom bi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: Ma mɛ Gaza gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Ma gbe ma nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ngɛ Ashdod kɛ Ashkelon. Ma gbla Ekron ma a tue, nɛ Filisti bi nɛ a he maa je tue gblami nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma gbo.” Yawɛ lɛ de. Tiro

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Tiro ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. A jua kɔpehi babauu a mi bi kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ ha Edom bi, nɛ kake peemi somi nɛ ngɛ nyɛmi kɛ nyɛmi a kpɛti ɔ, a yi nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Ma mɛ Tiro gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.” Edom

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Edom ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. A kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa fie a nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ klaate, nɛ a nɛ mɛ mɔbɔ kulaa.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Ma mɛ Teman ma a, kɛ Bozra mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.” Amon

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Amon ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. Benɛ a ngɛ ta hwue ngɛ Gilead nɛ a kɛ kpɔ nihi a zugba a, a pee yi wu tso níhi fuu; a kɛ klaate tsɔtslɔɔ yihɔyihi po a mi mi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Ma mɛ Raba gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la. A ma he ose hoo ta hwumi ligbi ɔ, nɛ ta a ma puɛ ní kaa lasiogblee.

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Nɛ a maa nuu Amon matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se ya.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Moab ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. A pue Edom matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi si; a sã e wuhi, nɛ a wɛɛ mɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ kɛ pee kalo. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: Ma mɛ Moab zugba a, kɛ Keriot mɔ ɔmɛ a he la. Be mi nɛ ta a pee hoo, nɛ ta buli he ose, nɛ titimatihi ngɛ pɛe ɔ, Moab ma mi bi ɔmɛ ma gbo ngɔ pue si.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Ma gbe Moab matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.” Yuda

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Yuda ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. A yi imi Yawɛ, ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ fɛɛ. Yaka mawuhi nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ sɔmɔ ɔ, jamɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nɔuu a se lɛ a ya nyɛɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Ma mɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.” Mawu maa gbla Israel hu tue

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. Nimli kpakpahi nɛ a hɛɛ hiɔ, kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a wo tokota nane hiɛ kɛ hiɛ he hiɔ ɔ, nyɛ juaa mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi. Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, ja i gbla nyɛ tue.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Nyɛ niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hlaa kaa a ye ohiatsɛmɛ amimi daa; ke ohiatsɛ ngɛ amanehlu mi, kɛkɛ niatsɛ bua jɔ. Nɔ kɛ e tsɛ po kɛ nyɔguɛ yo kake naa bɔmi, nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi bleɔ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Ngɛ nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, bohi nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ ba toɔ nyɛ awaba a, jamɛ a bo ɔmɛ a nɔ nyɛ hwɔɔ. Dã nɛ nyɛ nuɔ ngɛ imi Mawu, ye we ɔ ji dã nɛ nyɛ heɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ bu mɛ fɔ ɔ a dɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nɛ, nyɛ ye ma! Nyɛ he ɔ, i kpata nyɛ he nyɛli nɛ ji Amor bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ka gagaaga kaa seda tsohi, nɛ a he wa kaa tso nguahi.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Imi lɛ i je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ. I kpaka nyɛ kɛ gu nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ i ngɔ Amor bi ɔmɛ a zugba a kɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ e ba pee nyɛ nɔ́.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: I hla nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ i pee mɛ gbali. I pee nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ekomɛ Nazir bi.

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma gbla nyɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ ma kɛmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ tlɔɔke kɛmɛɛ ke a wo lɛ ngma nɛ́ e hyi kɛ be nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpɛti nihi nɛ a he sɔɔ po be nyɛe nɛ a tu fo kɛ je. Nihi nɛ a he wa a ma gbɔjɔ; nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ be nyɛe nɛ a he mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi wami.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li maa gbee senyasenya; ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nane nya sɔɔ a he be mi jee, nɛ ta buli ngɛ ta okpɔngɔhi a nɔ po a yi be wami nae.

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Israel bi! Nyɛ ma a tsuo nɛ Yawɛ je kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ tue.

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ, nyɛ pɛ ji ma nɛ i je blɔ hla, nɛ i ngɛ nɔ hyɛe. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔ kle agbo, nɛ e hia kaa ma gbla nyɛ tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ.” Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu gbalɔ ɔ tsuɔ

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Anɛ jata huãã ngɛ pu mi be mi nɛ e nɛ de lo lo? Anɛ jata bi huãã ngɛ muɔ mi be mi nɛ e nui lohwe ko lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Anɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ duɔ klama nɛ a kɛ lo kɔɛ nya lo? Anɛ klama fɛɔ be mi nɛ nɔ́ ko sɛ he lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Anɛ ta titimati pɛɛ ngɛ ma mi nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a tsui pui lo? Anɛ amanehlu baa ma ko nɔ nɛ pi Yawɛ nɛ pee lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Anɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu pee nɔ́ ko hyɛ nɛ e ha we nɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ nɛ a le lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Ke jata ngɛ huãe ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ e tsui pui? Ke Yawɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, mɛnɔ ma kua ke e be e sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe? Nɔ ko nɔ ko be! A kpata Samaria hɛ mi

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Mawu de gbalɔ ɔ ke e tsɔ nɛ a ya de nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɔ nguanguahi a mi ngɛ Egipt kɛ Ashdod ke, “Nyɛ ya bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ yo ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle Samaria a nɔ, nɛ́ nyɛɛ hyɛ yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ lejɛ ɔ pee basabasa ha.”

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a mɔ ɔmɛ hyi tɔ kɛ níhi nɛ a gu ju kɛ yi mi wami blɔhi a nɔ kpɔ ngɛ nihi a dɛ. Bɔ nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale po, a li.

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, he nyɛli ma ba sa ma a yi. A maa ywia a mɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa ha ní ngɛ a we saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ a mi.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ke jata ye lohwe ko ta a, to hyɛlɔ ɔ ngɔɔ lohwe ɔ nane enyɔ, aloo e tue kake pɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ ba yeɔ odase. Samaria ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ a ngɛ mle yee ngɛ sa tso bɔdɔbɔdɔhi a nɔ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ a ma he a ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ a yi wami.”

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue, konɛ nyɛɛ bɔ Yakob nina a kɔkɔ.

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ligbi ɔ nɛ ma gbla Israel tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ma ywia bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Betel ma a mi. Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a he koli ɔmɛ nɛ a saa we ngɛ a he ɔ, ma ku mɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ma ku wehi nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ngɔ pue si. Wehi nɛ a kɛ suɔ wu dla a mi ɔ maa hule pue si, nɛ wehi babauu a hɛ mi ma kpata.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ka e he kita ke, ‘Be ma, nɛ e be kɛe kulaa, nɛ a kɛ gbowe maa gbla nyɛ kɛ ho; nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee kaa lo ngɛ gbowe nya.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: A maa gbla nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ gu gbogbo puɔ nɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi tɛɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a ma sake nyɛ ngɔ fɔ he.’ ” Yawɛ lɛ de. Israel sume ní kasemi

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Ke nyɛɛ kɛ abolo ma Mawu si nami ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ yayami! Jehanɛ, ke nyɛ je nyɛ tsui mi faa, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ bɔ kpa komɛ kɛ ma po, nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛɛ fĩa! Israel ma, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ peemi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee!

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: “Imi lɛ i ha nɛ hwɔ ba nyɛ ma amɛ tsuo a mi ɔ nɛ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Benɛ e piɛ nyɔhiɔ etɛ nɛ a ma kpa nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní ɔ, i tsi hiɔmi nya. I ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ ngɛ ma ko mi, se ma kpa ko mi lɛɛ e nɛ́. Hiɔmi nɛ ngɔ pue ngmɔ ko nɔ, se ngmɔ ko lɛɛ e nɔ gbli.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Benɛ kuma miɔ nɛ e maa gbe nyɛ ɔ, nihi je ma enyɔ kɛ etɛ a mi kɛ ya ma ko mi, he nɛ a susu kaa a ma na nyu ngɛ nɛ a nu; se nyu ɔ sui mɛ. Loloolo ɔ, nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “I ha nɛ latsa kɛ gɔgɔ kpata nyɛ niba ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Baalɛhi ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ wai abɔɔ ɔmɛ a mi; ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ, kɛ oliv tso ɔmɛ hu a kpe mɛ tsuo. Loloolo ɔ, nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ.

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “I ha nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ba sɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ba Egipt zugba a nɔ be ko ɔ. I ha nɛ nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ gbo ngɛ ta mi, nɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ha nyɛ ta okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ. I ha nɛ nyɛ ni gbogboe ɔmɛ je fu wo nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sito he ɔ. Se loloolo ɔ, nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ.

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “I kpata nyɛ ti ni komɛ a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Sodom kɛ Gomora ma amɛ ɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he je mi ɔ ngɛ kaa la tso nɛ a hia kɛ je la mi. Se loloolo ɔ, nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel ma, ma gbla nyɛ tue. Nyɛ dla nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ imi, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ba kpe!”

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Mawu lɛ puɛ yo ɔmɛ. Lɛ nɛ e pee kɔɔhiɔ, nɛ e haa nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa leɔ e yi mi tomi; Mawu haa nɛ piani peeɔ nyɔ mi. Lɛ nɛ e yeɔ je ɔ tsuo nɔ. E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ!

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: Israel bi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa zangmawi! Nyɛ nɔ ta, nɛ nyɛ be si tee hu. A gbe nyɛ ngɔ pue nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ; Nɛ nɔ ko bɛ nɛ e ba wo nyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ya ja mi ngɛ Beersheba hu. Nyɛ ko ya hla mi ngɛ Betel hu, ejakaa Betel maa pee ma doku, kɛ mumi yayamihi a hi he. Nyɛ ko ya Gilgal, ejakaa a maa nuu Gilgal ma mi bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je.

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ ɔ, ma ba nyɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege. La nɛ ɔ maa sã Betel ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e gbe.” Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a pee, konɛ a yi nɛ na wami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ plɛɔ dami sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si, nɛ nyɛ sisiɔ nihi, musu tloo nyɛ!”

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: Mawu lɛ bɔ dodoehi nɛ́ jeɔ gbo kɛ gbiɛ. E haa nɛ nyɔ mi peeɔ piani, nɛ piani peeɔ nyɔ mi. E yɛɔ nyu kɛ jeɔ wo mi, nɛ e plɛɔ kɛ pueɔ zugba. Lɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mawu he sɔɔ kɛ kpataa matsɛmɛ kɛ a mɔ nguanguahi a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ oslabai gbaa tlukaa a.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ kpakpa, se pi nɔ́ yayami, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si saminya kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ deɔ daa ke e kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hie nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ. Nyɛɛ suɔ nɔ́ kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane ngɛ kojomi he ɔmɛ. Alini, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ maa na Yosef nina nɛ piɛɔ mɔbɔ.
