english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: Nihi maa wo yana ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, se pi kaa a maa muɔ. Ke i ba nɛ ma ba gbla nyɛ tue ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yawɛ tue gblami ligbi ɔ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ e peeɔ nyɛ kaa be ɔ su ta, musu tloo nyɛ! Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, haomi ji nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ ahumi haa nɛ diblii woɔ piani katakata a, se pi manye.

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ sane maa pee kaa nyumu ko nɛ tu fo kɛ je jata nya mi, nɛ e kɛ osisiblisi ya kpe! Aloo nyumu ko nɛ je pu mi kɛ ba we mi kɛ pɔtɔ. Benɛ e kpasa gbogbo nɛ́ e jɔɔ e he ɔ, kɛkɛ sinɔ kɔ lɛ.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ jɔɔ mi haomi kɛ la nɛ nyɛ laa kɛ ngmlaa boboobo ɔ; nyɛ kpa saku ɔmɛ hu, i hla we nɛ ma nu a gbi.

english_verse: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, akɛnɛ nyɛ ya ja amagahi, nɛ nyɛ wo mɛ biɛ ke Sakut kɛ Kaiwan he je ɔ, nyɛ maa tloo jamɛ a amaga amɛ,

english_verse: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: nɛ ma ngɔ nyɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ maa ya Damasko se tsitsaa a.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ ngɛ Zion, kɛ nyɛ Samaria bi nɛ e peeɔ nyɛ kaa nɔ́ ko he hia we nyɛ, musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ Israel ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ mi ganɔhi nɛ ma a mi bi ba biɔ yemi kɛ buami ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ, musu tloo nyɛ!

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ jualeɔ nyɛ se ngɛ sa tso kpakpahi nɛ a he jua wa a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ jijɔ, kɛ na kpakpahi a lo, musu tloo nyɛ!

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: Nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa po lahi kaa bɔ nɛ David pee ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ fia la amɛ ngɛ kpa sakuhi a nɔ.

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nuɔ dã bami ngɛ tsimi agboagbohi a mi, nɛ nyɛ kpaa nu je via kpakpahi. Se nyɛ yi kɔmɔ kaa a ma kpata Israel hɛ mi.

english_verse: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ji kekleekle nihi nɛ a maa nuu nyɔguɛ kɛ ho. Nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ se maa po.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ ka e he kita ke, “Israel bi ɔmɛ a he nɔ womi ɔ, i hiee; a mɔ nguangua amɛ hu, i sume. Ma ngɔ a matsɛ ma a, kɛ e mi níhi tsuo kɛ ha a he nyɛli.”

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Ke nihi nyɔngma ya laa a he ngɛ we ko mi, nɛ a susu kaa a ye a he ɔ, mɛ hu a ma gbo ja nɔuu.

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ke nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ tsɛko, kɛ weku ɔ mi nɔ kpa ko ba nɛ a ba ngɔ gbogboe ɔ, a ma bi nɔ nɛ ya laa e he ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ke, “Anɛ nɔ ko piɛ o he ngɛ tsu ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ lo?” Ke nɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!” ɔ, weku no ɔ nɛ ma gbogboe ɔ ngɔmi ɔ ma de lɛ ke, “Pee dii! Wa ko wo Yawɛ biɛ ta nɛ e ba nu.”

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Yawɛ wo gbi ɔ, a maa ku we nguangua amɛ, kɛ wawi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ, ejakaa nyɛ ngɔ Lodebar ma a. Nyɛ fĩaa nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, “Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wami nya nɛ wa ngɔ Karnaim ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ ke, “Israel bi, ma ha nɛ je ma ko ma ba tua nyɛ zugba a, nɛ a maa hao nyɛ. A maa ngɔ nyɛ zugba a kɛ maa je Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ he, ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ ma ya ta Ngo wo ɔ he, ngɛ leneyi je.”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ je ngɔ tsɔɔ mi ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. I na lɛ nɛ e ngɛ baalɛhi babauu bɔe be mi nɛ a poo nga kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ ta. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu lɛ nga mumu bɔni puɛmi ekohu.

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsake e yi mi tomi ɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Dɛbi, nɔ́ nɛ o na a be mi bae.” La he nina

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsake e yi mi tomi ɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Enɛ ɔ hu be mi bae!” Sumui kɛ e nya kpa a he nina

english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nɔ́ kpa ko hu nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je ngɔ tsɔɔ mi ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. I na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ e hɛɛ sumui kɛ e nya kpa kɛ daa si ngɛ gbogbo ko he.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: E bi mi ke, “Amos, mɛni o na?” I he nɔ ke, “Sumui kɛ e nya kpa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke, “I ngɔ sumui kɛ e nya kpa nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ ye ma Israel ɔ susue kaa a susuɔ gbogbo. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i be ye yi mi tomi ɔ tsakee hu; ja i gbla a tue kokooko!

english_verse: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
translation_verse: A ma kpata hehi tsuo nɛ Isak nina a jaa mi ngɛ ɔ a hɛ mi. Israel he klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ maa pee kaa kuku nɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ Yeroboam matsɛ yemi ɔ se maa po.” Amos kɛ Amazia

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Amos ngɛ dee ji, mo nɛnɛ ɔ, o ma gbo ngɛ ta mi. Se Israel ma a lɛɛ a maa nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ maa je a zugba a nɔ kɛ ho.”

english_verse: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Amazia de Amos ke, “E maa hi kaa o je ma nɛ ɔ mi nɔuu kɛ ho Yuda ya. Yaa nɛ o ya gba ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ o na o nya mi ngma.

english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Amos he nɔ nɛ e de Amazia ke, “Pi gbalɔ ji mi, nɛ pi gbalɔ bi ji mi hulɔ. To hyɛlɔ ji mi, nɛ i tsuɔ ngmɔkɔ tso he ní.

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ je mi kɛ je to ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e tsɔ mi ke ma ngɔ sɛ gbi ya ha e ma Israel.

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Amazia, Yawɛ ngɛ mo dee ke, ‘O bimɛ ma gbo ngɛ ta nga nɔ. He nyɛli ma ba ngɔ o ma a, nɛ o zugba a maa pee ni kpahi a nɔ nɛ a maa dla. O yo maa bɔ ajuama ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ mo nitsɛ lɛɛ a maa ngɔ mo kɛ ho, nɛ o ma ya gbo ngɛ ma se. A maa nuu Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ maa ho.’ ”

english_verse: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, yi ɔmɛ nɛ a hii lae ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi ɔ ma nya awe mohu. A ma sake ni gbogboehi babauu kɛ fɔ he tsuaa he dii, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he nue.” Mawu maa gbla Israel ma a tue

english_verse: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
translation_verse: Nyɛ biɔ nyɛ sibi ke, “Mɛni be Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔ maa ta nɛ waa jua blɛfo? Mɛni be Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ maa be, nɛ wa bɔni ngma juami ekohu?” Nyɛ yaa nɔ nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, “Wa ma tsake wa sɛni tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ní juami ní kpa amɛ, nɛ wa maa sisi ni nɛmɛ nɛ waa kɛ mɛ yeɔ jua a.

english_verse: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
translation_verse: Wa maa jua ngma bibliwi po kɛ he jua wawɛ. Wa ma he ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ pee wa nyɔguɛhi, ejakaa a be nyɛe maa wo a hiɔ ɔmɛ. Ke ohiatsɛ ko hɛɛ hiɔ nɛ e nya maa su kaa tokota nane hiɛ kɛ hiɛ po, e be nyɛe maa wo.” Tue gblami slɔɔtohi

english_verse: I, the Lord, won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ Israel woɔ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ ka kita ke, “Ye hɛ be a ní yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ jee gblegbleegble.

english_verse: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma ha nɛ pu maa nɔ si piani katakata, nɛ je ɔ mi maa wo diblii. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: I, the Lord, also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Be ma, nɛ ma ha nɛ hwɔ maa ba zugba a nɔ; pi mi mi hwɔ, loo kuma. Se sɛ gbi nɛ maa je imi Yawɛ, ye ngɔ ɔ, ma bɔ nyɛ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
translation_verse: Nihi maa wo lalaalo kɛ maa je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ maa ya Wo Ngua a nya; a ma tsa nɔ kɛ maa je omleyi je kɛ maa ya beleku je kaa a maa nu ye sɛ gbi ko lo. Se a be ye nya mi munyu ko nue.

english_verse: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
translation_verse: Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nihewi kɛ yihewi tsuãã po, kuma maa ye mɛ nɛ a ma tsɔ fia si!

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ maa nɔ si, nɛ a be si tee hu gblegbleegble. Ejakaa a jaa mawuhi nɛ ngɛ Samaria, Dan, kɛ Beersheba a, nɛ a kɛ a biɛhi kaa kita.”

english_verse: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
translation_verse: Ke a tsua si kɛ ho gbeje ya tete po, ma ya gbla mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ je kpo. Nɛ ke a kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe po, ma ha a ma kple kɛ ba zugba.

english_verse: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.
translation_verse: Ke a ya laa a he ngɛ Karmel yo ɔ yi mi tete po, ma ya hla mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma nu mɛ. Nɛ ke a ya laa a he ngɛ wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ po, ma fa wo mi sinɔ ɔ nɛ e ma ya kɔɔ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.” His Name Is the Lord
translation_verse: Ke a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba kpaka mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ je ɔ, ma ha nɛ a kɛ klaate maa gbe mɛ. I muɔ ye yi mi kpɔ kaa ja i kpata a hɛ mi kokooko, se pi kaa ma pee mɛ kpakpa.”

english_verse: When the Lord God All-Powerful touches the earth, it melts, and its people mourn. God makes the earth rise and then fall, just like the Nile River.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, ke e ta zugba a he pɛ kɛkɛ zugba a sile, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ye kɔmɔ. Zugba a tsuo maa ya hiɔwe nɛ e maa ba si kaa bɔ nɛ Nilo pa a nɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ hyiɔ nɛ e faa a.

english_verse: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord. The Lord Is God
translation_verse: Yawɛ poɔ e we ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e ngɔɔ hiɔwe nɔ́ mluguduu ɔ kɛ haa zugba a hɛ mi. E yɛɔ nyu kɛ jeɔ wo mi nɛ e plɛɔ kɛ pueɔ zugba. Lɛ ji Yawɛ!

english_verse: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Israel ma, nyɛ ngɛ kaa Sudan bi ɔmɛ nɔuu ha mi; i susuɔ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo nyɛ he fiee. Anɛ pi imi nɛ i je Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Kreta lo? Anɛ pi imi nɛ i je Siria bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Kir kaa bɔ nɛ i kpaka nyɛ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hu kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ lo?

english_verse: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ye hɛngmɛ ngɛ Israel, ma nɛ peeɔ yayami nɛ ɔ hyɛe. Ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ ma bɛɛ nyɛ kɛ maa je je ɔ mi. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i be Yakob nina a tsuo a hɛ mi kpatae. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
translation_verse: “Ma fa he nyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ ma ha nɛ a ma hoso Israel bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa sa a mi ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔnguɛ saa blɛfo mi nɛ kake po nɔɛ si ngɛ zugba a.

english_verse: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
translation_verse: Se ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti yayami peeli nɛ deɔ ke, ‘Mawu be hae nɛ nɔ́ yayami ko maa ba wa nɔ’ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma gbo ngɛ ta nga nɔ.” Israel maa te si ekohu hwɔɔ se

english_verse: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, David matsɛ yemi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ pee kaa we ko nɛ hule ngɔ pue si. Se be ma nɛ ma ha nɛ matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔ maa da si ekohu kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ sa a.

english_verse: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ nyɛ zugba a maa ba ní babauu. Ke nyɛ du ní ɔ, ní kpali a nine be he kpee. Wai yiblii hu maa ba fuu nɛ wai peeli be deka nae kulaa. Wai dɔkɔdɔkɔ ma tsle kɛ je yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ pue si.

english_verse: I'll make Israel prosper again. You will rebuild your towns and live in them. You will drink wine from your own vineyards and eat the fruit you grow.
translation_verse: Ma kpale nyɛ, ye ma a kɛ ba nyɛ zugba a nɔ ekohu. Nyɛ ma ba dla nyɛ ma doku ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa hi a mi. Nyɛ ma du wai yiblii, nɛ nyɛ ma na wai maa nu. Nyɛ ma hu ngmɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye e mi ní.

english_verse: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ma to nyɛ si ngɛ zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ. Nɛ i be hae nɛ nɔ ko ba je nyɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ hu.” Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ Edom dee ke, “Ma ba mo si ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ o he guɛ ma gbo.

english_verse: I will still bring you down, even if you fly higher than an eagle or nest among the stars. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: O ya pee o hi he ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo kaa kɔle tsu, nɛ e peeɔ mo kaa dodoehi a kpɛti nɛ o ngɛ. Se kɛ ɔ, ma gbla mo kɛ ba zugba.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!
translation_verse: “Ke juli ba jumi nyɔ mi ɔ, a muɔɔ níhi bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ. Ke nihi bua wai yiblii nya a, a siɔ bɔɔ ko kɛ̃. Se o he nyɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ, a kpata o nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Everything you treasure most will be taken from you.
translation_verse: Esau nina, a ha o june.

english_verse: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
translation_verse: Sawale maa nu Teman ta hwuli kpanaa amɛ, nɛ a maa gbe Edom ta bulɔ tsuaa ta bulɔ.” Mawu lɛ de. Nɔ́ he je nɛ a maa gbla Edom tue

english_verse: You stood there and watched as foreigners entered Jerusalem and took what they wanted. In fact, you were no better than those foreigners.
translation_verse: “Benɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba ywia agbo ɔmɛ ɔ, o daa si ngɛ se banee. Nihi nɛ ba muɔ Yerusalem june ɔmɛ kɛ ho nɛ a ya dla ngɔ ha a he ɔ, o ngɛ kaa mɛ pɛ.

english_verse: The day is coming when I, the Lord, will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.
translation_verse: “Be ɔ su ta nɛ imi Yawɛ, ma kojo je ma amɛ tsuo. Edom, nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ, a kɛ maa pee mo. O ní peemi ní ɔmɛ maa kpale ba bu o yi mi.” Mawu lɛ de.

english_verse: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
translation_verse: “Ye we bi ɔmɛ na nɔ ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ. Se je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ, maa na nɔ kulaa pe mɛ, nɛ a maa ta zugba a nɔ.” Mawu lɛ de. Israel manye yemi

english_verse: The Lord's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.
translation_verse: “Se a ma he ni komɛ a yi wami ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ maa pee klɔuklɔu. Yakob we ɔ nine maa su a blɔ fa mi ní ɔmɛ a nɔ ekohu.” Mawu lɛ de.

english_verse: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
translation_verse: “Nihi nɛ je Yuda leneyi je ɔ maa ngɔ Edom; ni nɛmɛ nɛ je bonyoku je yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ maa ngɔ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a. A maa ngɔ Efraim kɛ Samaria zugba amɛ; nɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔ maa ngɔ Gilead.” Mawu lɛ de.

english_verse: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: “Israel bi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ɔ maa kpale ba ngɔ Kanaan bi a zugba a kɛ yaa si Zarefat. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho Sefarad ya a maa ngɔ Yuda leneyi je ma amɛ.

english_verse: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Yerusalem manye yeli ɔmɛ ma ya tua Edom, nɛ a maa ye ma a nɔ. Nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa pee a matsɛ.” Mawu lɛ de.

english_verse: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai,
translation_verse: Ligbi ko ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Yona, Amitai bi ɔ tu munyu, nɛ e de lɛ ke,

english_verse: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
translation_verse: “Yaa Nineve ma nguaa a mi nɛ o ya kuɛ wo ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o de mɛ ke, i na paa kaa a yi mi wami ɔ su he ko jehanɛ.” Yona gbo tue

english_verse: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
translation_verse: Se Yona pue he kpa blɔ mohu, konɛ e tu fo kɛ je Yawɛ hɛ mi. E ho Yopa ya nɛ e ya na lɛ ko nɛ yaa Spania. E wo hiɔ, nɛ e sɛ lɛ ɔ mi konɛ e kɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ ya Spania, nɛ e laa Yawɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ ha kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ko hia ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ, nɛ wo kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ he wami ɔ miɔ nɛ e maa ywia lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
translation_verse: Lɛ hluili ɔmɛ ye gbeye, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ e mawu. A je tlomi ɔmɛ kɛ wo wo ɔ mi konɛ lɛ ɔ nɛ pee huyɛhuyɛ ha mɛ. Se Yona lɛɛ e kple si kɛ ho lɛ ɔ sisi ya tɔɔ, nɛ e ya hwɔ si nɛ e hwɔ mahe vii.

english_verse: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
translation_verse: Lɛtsɛ ɔ ba e ngɔ nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Kɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ; mahe lɛ o ngɛ hwɔe? Tee si nɛ o tsɛ o mawu ɔ, kaa alini wa ní maa pee lɛ mɔbɔ nɛ e ma he wa yi wami lo.”

english_verse: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
translation_verse: Lɛ mi bi ɔmɛ de a he ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa fɔ sɔ, nɛ wa kɛ hla nɔ nɛ kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔ ba wa nɔ.” A pee ja, nɛ sɔ ɔ ya nɔ Yona nɔ.

english_verse: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ mo de wɔ! Mɛni kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔ ba wa nɔ ɔ? Mɛni o ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ? Jije zugba nɔ o je? Nɛ jije no ji mo?”

english_verse: Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
translation_verse: Yona ha mɛ heto ke, “Hebri no ji mi, nɛ i jaa Yawɛ, hiɔwe Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ pee wo kɛ zugba a.”

english_verse: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha lɛ mi bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o pee nɛ ɔ?” Ejakaa a le kaa e tu fo kɛ je Yawɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
translation_verse: Se wo kɔɔhiɔ ɔ nya ngɛ wae pe kekle ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee mo kɛɛ nɛ wo ɔ he nɛ jɔ ha wɔ?”

english_verse: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
translation_verse: Yona he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ sake mi ngɔ fɔ wo ɔ mi, kɛkɛ wo ɔ he maa jɔ ha nyɛ; ejakaa i le kaa ye tɔmi he nɛ wo kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ haoe ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpa huhui nɛ a de Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ lee, wa ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae, ko ha wa hɛ mi nɛ kpata ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ wami he, nɛ ko ha waa gbe nɔ ko nɛ yi fɔ, ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa li he nɔ́ ko! Ejakaa mo Yawɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa o hɛ mi nɛ o peeɔ.”

english_verse: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a nu Yona nɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ wo ɔ mi; nɛ wo ɔ ngmɛ dii.

english_verse: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha lɛ mi bi ɔmɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye wawɛɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sã bɔ ha lɛ, nɛ a wo si kaa a ma sɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
translation_verse: Ngɛ Yawɛ fami nya a, lo agbo ko ba mi Yona, nɛ e hi lo ɔ muklii mi nyɔ kɛ pia nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi etɛ.

english_verse: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
translation_verse: Yona sɔle nɛ e kpa Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ pɛɛ ngɛ lo ɔ muklii mi,

english_verse: When I was in trouble, Lord, I prayed to you, and you listened to me. From deep in the world of the dead, I begged for your help, and you answered my prayer.
translation_verse: nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, i tsɛ mo ngɛ ye fimi be mi nɛ o bu mi tue. I fa kue ha mo kɛ je gbeje lokoo nɛ o nu ye gbi.

english_verse: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
translation_verse: O sake mi ngɔ fɔ muɔ voovoohi a mi ngɛ wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ, he nɛ nyu babauu bɔle mi ngɛ, nɛ o we oslɔke ɔmɛ kuɔɔ kɛ pueɔ ye nɔ.

english_verse: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.
translation_verse: E pee mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ a je mi we nɛ i be o sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu ɔ nae hu.

english_verse: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
translation_verse: Nyu ɔ bɔle mi, nɛ i ngɛ nyu miie. Wo ɔ ha ye yi nɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ wosuma blaa ye yi.

english_verse: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
translation_verse: I kple si kɛ ho yo ɔmɛ a sisi tomi he ɔ ya tɔɔ, kɛ ya gbeje, he nɛ a sa ye yi wo kɛ yaa neneene. Se mo Yawɛ, ye Mawu, o je mi kɛ je kikɛmɛ a muɔ nɛ ɔ mi hɛ ngmengmle.

english_verse: When my life was slipping away, I remembered you— and in your holy temple you heard my prayer.
translation_verse: Benɛ ye mumi ngɛ ye mi jee ɔ, i fa kue ha mo Yawɛ ngɛ o we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ o bu mi tue.

english_verse: But with shouts of praise, I will offer a sacrifice to you, my Lord. I will keep my promise, because you are the one with power to save.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ ma la kɛ je o yi, ma sã bɔ ha mo, nɛ ma ye ye siwo ɔ nɔ; ejakaa mo Yawɛ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami.”

english_verse: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ fa lo ɔ ke e ya vie Yona ngɔ fɔ wo ɔ nya; nɛ e pee ja.

english_verse: Once again the Lord told Jonah
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ Yona tu munyu ekohu,

english_verse: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
translation_verse: nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yaa Nineve ma nguaa a mi, nɛ o ya de ni ɔmɛ sɛ nɛ i kɛ ha mo ɔ.”

english_verse: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
translation_verse: Yona bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ e ho Nineve ya. A tsɔɔ kaa Nineve ma a kle saminya, nɛ ligbi etɛ a kɛ ma nyɛ nyɛɛ kɛ po ma a mi.

english_verse: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
translation_verse: Nineve bi ɔmɛ he Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ ye, nɛ a ha hwɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ bu kpekpe ya bo, kɛ je nɔmlɔ ngua nɔ kɛ ya si nɔmlɔ wayo nɔ, nɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsake a tsui.

english_verse: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
translation_verse: Benɛ Nineve matsɛ ɔ nu he ɔ, e te si ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ. E kpa e he ablade bo ɔ, nɛ lɛ hu e bu kpekpe ya bo, nɛ e hi si ngɛ la zu mi ngɛ zugba.

english_verse: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu na nɔ́ nɛ ni ɔmɛ pee, kɛ bɔ nɛ a tsake a je mi babɛ ɔ, e kpale e nya se. Nɛ yi mi nɛ e to kaa e ma kpata a hɛ mi ɔ, e pee we ja hu.

english_verse: So he prayed: Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ hɛdɔ fa kue ha Yawɛ nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, benɛ i na we ma je ye zugba a nɔ lokoo ɔ, enɛ ɔ nɛ i na nɛ i de ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i tu fo kɛ ho Spania ya a nɛ. Ejakaa mo Mawu ɔ, i le kaa o mi mi jɔ, o naa mɔbɔ, o toɔ o tsui si, o suɔmi tsakee we; nɛ o kɛ nɔ he yayami paa nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
translation_verse: Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, “E da ha mo kaa o mi mi fuɔ lo?”

english_verse: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yona je ma a mi kɛ ho beleku je ya nɛ e ya pee gba ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e hi sisi ngɛ hɔ ɔ mi, konɛ e kɛ hyɛ kaa mɛni sane maa ba Nineve nɔ lo.

english_verse: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu ha nɛ tso ko puɛ, nɛ e ha kɛ pee hɔ ngɛ Yona yi nɔ, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha e he mi jɔ lɛ. Yona bua jɔ tso ɔ he saminya.

english_verse: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.
translation_verse: Se benɛ je ke e naa a, Mawu ha gɔgɔ ko ye tso ɔ, nɛ e ngla.

english_verse: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
translation_verse: Benɛ pu te si ɔ, Mawu ha beleku kɔɔhiɔ ko nɛ dɔ la fia, nɛ pu ɔ sãã Yona yi mi, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e maa hɛli. Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “E hi kaa ma gbo mohu pee kaa ma hi je mi.”

english_verse: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
translation_verse: Se Mawu bi Yona ke, “E da ha mo kaa o mi mi fuɔ tso nɛ ɔ lo?” Yona he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ he blɔ kaa ye mi mi fuɔ kɛ ya siɔ gbenɔ mi po.”

english_verse: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Nyɔ kake mi tso nɛ ɔ puɛ, nɛ nyɔ kake mi nɔuu e gbo; o gbo we he dengme ko, nɛ pi mo nɛ o ha e puɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, e gbenɔ dɔ mo.

english_verse: people who cannot tell right from wrong, and many cattle are also there. Don't you think I should be concerned about that big city?
translation_verse: kɛ se, nɛ a li kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti slɔɔto. Lohwehi babauu hu ngɛ ma a mi.”

english_verse: I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah. Judgment on Samaria
translation_verse: Yuda matsɛmɛ, Yotam, Ahaz, kɛ Hezekia a yi nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ha Mika nɛ je Moreshet ɔ. Yawɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɔɔ Samaria kɛ Yerusalem ma amɛ a he ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ Mika. Kɔmɔ yemi la ngɛ Samaria kɛ Yerusalem a he

english_verse: Listen, all of you! Earth and everything on it, pay close attention. The Lord God accuses you from his holy temple.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je mahi tsuo, nyɛɛ bu tue; nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu po nyɛ nya. Nyɛɛ bu tue! E ngɛ munyu tue kɛ je e we klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
translation_verse: Yo ɔmɛ maa sile ngɛ e nane sisi kaa hwo gbaku ngɛ la mi; nɔ́ nɛ sile ɔ ma kpa ngɔ pue kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee ngɛ yoku he kɛ yaa kɔ̃ mi.

english_verse: This will happen because of the terrible sins of Israel, the descendants of Jacob. Samaria has led Israel to sin, and pagan altars at Jerusalem have made Judah sin.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi, ejakaa Israel ma a pee yayami kɛ si Mawu, nɛ a tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã. Israel atuã tsɔmi ɔ, mɛnɔ kɛ ba? Ma nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Samaria a, lɛ! Mɛnɔ yeɔ fɔ kaa e kɛ amaga jami ba Yuda? Yerusalem nitsɛ!

english_verse: So the Lord will leave Samaria in ruins— merely an empty field where vineyards are planted. He will scatter its stones and destroy its foundations.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha nɛ Samaria maa pee kaa kuku ngɛ nga nɔ, he nɛ a ma du wai tsohi ngɛ. Ma kpɛne tɛhi ngɛ ma a mi kɛ wo kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ ma a sisi tomi ɔ maa je kpo.

english_verse: Samaria's idols will be smashed, and the wages of temple prostitutes will be destroyed by fire. Silver and gold from those idols will then be used by foreigners as payment for prostitutes. Judah Is Doomed
translation_verse: A maa ku Samaria amaga amɛ tsuo dukuduku. A kɛ la maa sã ní tsuo nɛ e na kɛ je yahomi mi ɔ. Ma kpata e wɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. Ní nɛ e na a yahomi mi e na kɛ je, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ní ɔ tsuo maa ya pee yahomi mi ní kɛ ha ni kpahi.”

english_verse: Don't tell it in Gath! Don't even cry. Instead, roll in the dust at Beth-Leaphrah.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko sɛɛ ngɛ Gat nɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba nu; nyɛ ko wo yana nɛ a ba na. Bet Leafra bi, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he nɛ wuwlua si!

english_verse: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Marot bi ɔmɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa a ma ba kpɔ mɛ, se Yawɛ ngɔ haomi kɛ ba su Yerusalem agbo ɔ nya haa.

english_verse: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda bi, nyɛɛ kɛ Moreshet Gat ma a nɛ ye sɛ. Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ be yemi kɛ buami ko nae kɛ je Akzib ma a dɛ mi.

english_verse: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
translation_verse: Maresha bi, Yawɛ ma je nyɛ kɛ wo he nyɛli komɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a maa ngɔ nyɛ ma a. Israel ma nimeli kɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ ma ya laa a he ngɛ Adulam tɛ puɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Yuda bi, nyɛ sã nyɛ yi nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ ha nyɛ bimɛ nɛ nyɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ngmla nyɛ yi kaa okpokuhi, ejakaa a ma ba ngɔ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je nyɛ he.

english_verse: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
translation_verse: Musu tloo nihi nɛ soɔ yi wu tso níhi, nɛ a toɔ yayami peemi he ga nyɔ mi ngɛ sa mi. Ke je na nɛ a na he blɔ pɛ, a peeɔ yayami nɛ a to he ga a.

english_verse: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ke, “I to nɛ i kɛ haomi maa ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ he be mi jee. Ke haomi nɛ ɔ na ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ be nyɛ he nɔ woe hu gblegbleegble.

english_verse: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi ma la hɛdo la nɛ ɔ kɛ li nyɛ. A ma nya awe nɛ a maa ye kɔmɔ ke, Wa yi ta pɛ! Yawɛ kpɔ wa zugba a ngɛ wa dɛ Nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ha nihi nɛ nuu wɔ nyɔguɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: “Enough of your preaching!” That's what you tell me. “We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching!”
translation_verse: Ma a de mi ke, “O kɛ wɔ nɛ ko tu munyu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ko de ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ waa nu. Mawu be wa hɛ mi si puee.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
translation_verse: Anɛ o susu kaa a gbiɛ Israel ma a lo? Anɛ Yawɛ tsui si tomi ɔ ta lo? Anɛ e maa pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ niinɛ lo? Anɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e wui mɛ ga kpakpa lo?”

english_verse: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.
translation_verse: Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ te si kɛ wo ye ma a kaa nɔ́ nɛ wa he nyɛli ji nyɛ. Ta buli nɛ je ta kɛ ba, nɛ a susumi ji a ma na tue mi jɔmi ngɛ we ɔ, nyɛ kplɔ a tadehi ngɛ a he.

english_verse: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ fie yi ɔmɛ ngɛ ye ma a mi kɛ je a we kpakpa amɛ a mi, nɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kpɔ ye gbaami ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ a dɛ.

english_verse: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ je hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ho; he jɔɔmi he ko be hiɛ ɔ ha nyɛ. Yayamihi gbegbeegbe nɛ nyɛ pee ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ a he je ɔ, a ma kpata ma nɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: The only prophet you want is a liar who will say, “Drink and get drunk!” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: “Gbalɔ nɛ ma nɛ ɔ suɔ ji lakpatsɛ kɛ nɔ sisilɔ; nɔ nɛ ma de mɛ ke, ‘Ma gba nɛ wai kɛ da nɛ nya wa nɛ ba ha nyɛ.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.
translation_verse: “Se nyɛ Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ, be ma nɛ ma bua nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nya. Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba he kake kaa tohi nɛ kpale ba a tsu mi. Nimli ma ba ha nyɛ zugba a nɔ tɔ ekohu kɛ a he ngmlaa kaa tohi babauu ngɛ a lɛmi he.”

english_verse: Listen to me, you rulers of Israel! You know right from wrong,
translation_verse: Nyɛ Israel ma a nɔ yeli, nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛ blɔ nya ji kaa nyɛɛ ye dami sane,

english_verse: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh,
translation_verse: se nyɛ nyɛɛ nɔ́ kpakpa, nɛ nyɛ suɔ yayami mohu. Nyɛ kpɔɔ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he womi hɛ ngmengmle kɛ jeɔ a wuhi a he.

english_verse: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.
translation_verse: Be ma nɛ nyɛ ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, se e be nyɛ nya mi poe. E be nyɛ kue fami ɔ tue bue, ejakaa nyɛ pee yayami.

english_verse: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
translation_verse: Nyɛ lakpa gbali nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye ma a sisie! Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ gbaa he jɔmi kɛ haa nihi nɛ haa nyɛ ní nɛ nyɛ yeɔ; nɛ nyɛ woɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ha we nyɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ a susuma he gbeye! Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ,

english_verse: “You will live in the dark, far from the sight of the sun, with no message from me.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ligbi ɔ nya ta, nɛ du miɔ nɛ e ma bu nyɛ. Nyɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ be ní nae hu; ke diblii wo ɔ, nyɛ be klaae hu.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ Yawɛ ngɔ e mumi ɔ kɛ wo ye mi tɔ. E ha mi he wami, kɛ dami sane yemi, kɛ kã nɛ ma kɛ jaje Israel ma a he yayami ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: So listen to my message, you rulers of Israel! You hate justice and twist the truth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Israel ma nɔ yeli! Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yi dami sane, nɛ nyɛ plɛɔ dami sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si! Nyɛɛ bu mi tue!

english_verse: You make cruelty and murder a way of life in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mawu ma, Yerusalem ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mae ɔ, muɔ si puemi kɛ yayami peemi lɛ nyɛ kɛ fia.

english_verse: You leaders accept bribes for dishonest decisions. You priests and prophets teach and preach, but only for money. Then you say, “The Lord is on our side. No harm will come to us.”
translation_verse: Ma nimeli ɔmɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní loko a buá sane he; osɔfo ɔmɛ heɔ hiɔwo loko a tsɔɔ mlaa a sisi; gbali ɔmɛ heɔ sika loko a gbaa. Se mɛ tsuo a buɔ Mawu kua pɛɛ nɛ a deɔ ke, “Yawɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ; nɔ́ ko nɔ ko be wɔ pee!”

english_verse: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he ɔ, a maa pee Zion kaa ngmɔ nɛ a hu. Yerusalem maa pee ma doku, nɛ yo ɔ nɔ he nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ maa si ngɛ ɔ maa hɛ, nɛ e maa pee pú.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Nyagbe be ɔ mi ɔ, yo ɔ nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ maa si ngɛ nɔ ɔ ma ba pee yo nɛ he biɛ pe yo ɔmɛ tsuo. Je mahi babauu ma ba hyɛ,

english_verse: People of many nations will come and say, “Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: nɛ a ma de a sibi ke, “Nyɛ ha waa kuɔ Yawɛ ɔ kɛ ya Israel Mawu ɔ we ɔ. E maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ kaa waa pee, nɛ wa maa nyɛɛ e blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Ejakaa Yawɛ mlaa a maa je Zion; e kɛ e ma a maa tu munyu kɛ je Yerusalem.”

english_verse: He will settle arguments between distant and powerful nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never again make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: E ma dla je ma nguanguahi babauu a kpɛti, ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he kɛ we, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo. A kɛ a klaate ɔmɛ maa sɔ̃ kpakplaahi nɛ akplɔ ɔmɛ hu, a kɛ maa sɔ̃ tso he suami hahi. Je ma amɛ be ta hwue hu gblegbleegble; a be dlae kɛ ha ta hu kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi ngɛ e wai tso, loo e ngmɔkɔ tso sisi, nɛ nɔ ko be nɔ ko he gbeye woe. Yawɛ, Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ jaa lɛ nitsɛ e mawu. Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ, ji nɔ nɛ wa ma sɔmɔ kɛ maa ya neneene. Israel maa kpale kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi kɛ ba

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nihi nɛ i gbla a tue, nɛ a na nɔ́ ngɛ nyɔguɛ si himi mi ɔ, be ma, nɛ ma bua jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nya ekohu.

english_verse: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord, will rule them from Mount Zion forever.
translation_verse: Akpaketsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma se lokoo ɔ, ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba we ekohu; nɛ ma pee mɛ ma agbo. Ma hi Zion Yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ a nɔ, kɛ maa je jamɛ a be ɔ mi, kɛ maa ya neneene.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
translation_verse: Mɛni he je o ngɛ ngmlaa kpae wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je o pee kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi ɔ? Anɛ matsɛ be o dɛ lo? Anɛ o ga woli ɔmɛ gbo lo?

english_verse: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he nɛ wuwlua si, nɛ nyɛ kɛmɛ kaa yo nɛ ngɛ kɔe. Ejakaa jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa je ma a mi kɛ ya hi nga nɔ. A maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya Babilon tɔɔ. Se Yawɛ ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
translation_verse: Je mahi babauu ba bua ngɔ wo nyɛ he konɛ a tua nyɛ. A ke, “Ja wa kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi! Wa maa na kɛ wa hɛngmɛ kaa ma nɛ ɔ pee ma doku!”

english_verse: Jerusalem, enemy troops have surrounded you; they have struck Israel's ruler in the face with a stick.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yerusalem bi, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya! A sa ma a yi! A ba tua Israel hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ! Nɔ yelɔ ko maa je Betlehem

english_verse: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Mo Betlehem Efrata, Yuda ma amɛ a kpɛti nyafii kake kɛkɛ ji mo; se ma ha nɔ ko maa je o mi ba ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo nɔ. Matsɛ nɛ ɔ weku kpa ngɛ kɛ je blema be ɔ mi tɔɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
translation_verse: Ke matsɛ nɛ ɔ ba a, e maa ye e ma a nɔ kɛ he wami, kɛ kã nɛ je Yawɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ ngɔ. E ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, ejakaa a maa bu lɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.

english_verse: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
translation_verse: E kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba. Kpɔmi kɛ tue gblami Ke Asiria bi ɔmɛ ba wa zugba a nɔ nɛ a ba tua wa mɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, wa ma ha wa katsɛmɛ kpanaa amɛ nɛ nyɛɛɔ wa hɛ mi ɔ maa ya nɛ a kɛ mɛ ma ya hwu ta.

english_verse: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land. The Survivors Will Be Safe
translation_verse: A kɛ klaate maa ye Asiria bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi, nɛ a ma je wɔ kɛ je Asiria bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, ke a ba tua wa zugba a.

english_verse: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.
translation_verse: Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ je mahi babauu ma na bua jɔmi ekohu kaa bɔ́ nɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ, aloo hiɔmi nɛ́ nɛ ngɔ pue nga nɔ. A maa ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, se pi nɔmlɔ nɔ.

english_verse: At present they are scattered, but later they will attack, as though they were fierce lions pouncing on sheep. Their enemies will be torn to shreds, with no one to save them;
translation_verse: Israel bi nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti ɔ, a he ma ba wa kaa jata ngɛ pu mi lohwehi, loo we mi lohwehi a kpɛti. Ke e sɛ a kpɛti kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e maa naa a nɔ, nɛ e ma tsɔtslɔɔ a mi nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ mɛ.

english_verse: they will be helpless, completely destroyed. Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
translation_verse: Israel maa ye e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi, nɛ e ma kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma kpɔ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, nɛ ma kpata nyɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.
translation_verse: Ma kpata nyɛ kunya yeli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ a be klaalɔ ko nae ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti hu.

english_verse: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them,
translation_verse: Ma ywia nyɛ amaga amɛ, nɛ ma hule nyɛ wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛ be níhi nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ pee kɛ nyɛ nine sɔmɔe hu.

english_verse: I will become furious and take revenge on the nations that refuse to obey me.
translation_verse: I kɛ mi mi la nɛ nya wa maa gbla je mahi tsuo nɛ bui mi ɔ a tue kɛ ye ye he lue.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yohi, nyɛɛ bu munyuhi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ngɛ e ma a nya poe ɔ tue! Nyɛ zugba a sisi tomihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ daa, nyɛ ta tue! Yawɛ kɛ e ma, Israel na, nɛ e maa jaje e sane ɔ.

english_verse: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ye ma, mɛni i pee nyɛ? Anɛ i ha nɛ pɔ tɔ nyɛ lo? Nyɛ ha mi heto.

english_verse: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.
translation_verse: I je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ; i je nyɛ kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi; i tsɔ Mose, Aaron, kɛ Miriam nɛ a ya kpaka nyɛ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Don't forget the evil plans of King Balak of Moab or what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember how I, the Lord, saved you many times on your way from Acacia to Gilgal. True Obedience
translation_verse: Ye ma, nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ Moab matsɛ, Balak to nɛ e maa pee nyɛ, kɛ heto nɛ Beor binyumu Balaam ha lɛ. Nyɛ kai níhi nɛ ba ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ je nyɛ si tomi he ɔ ngɛ Shitim kɛ ya Gilgal ɔ. Nyɛ kai ní nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ na bɔ nɛ i pee kɛ he nyɛ yi wami.” Yawɛ lɛ de. Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ hlae

english_verse: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
translation_verse: Ke i ma nɛ ma ba ja Yawɛ, hiɔwe Mawu ɔ, mɛni ma hɛɛ kɛ ba ha lɛ? Anɛ ma ngɔ na bihi nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka kɛ ba sá sami bɔ ha lɛ lo?

english_verse: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?
translation_verse: Anɛ Yawɛ ma na bua jɔmi, ke i ba ha lɛ agbosu akpehi, loo nu nɛ hiɛ babauu kaa pa nɛ ngɛ bee lo? Anɛ ma ngɔ ye kekleekle bi ba ha lɛ kɛ wo ye yayami ɔmɛ a he hiɔ lo?

english_verse: The Lord God has told us what is right and what he demands: “See that justice is done, let mercy be your first concern, and humbly obey your God.” Cheating and Violence
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Yawɛ tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ hi. Nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ngɛ wa dɛ kɛkɛ ji kaa waa ye dami sane, nɛ waa na mɔbɔ, nɛ waa ba wa he si ha wa Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
translation_verse: E hi kaa a ye Yawɛ gbeye. Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem dee ke, “Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ ma a mi, nyɛɛ bu tue!

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ sɛni yayahi, kɛ sɛni tɛhi nɛ sui kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, anɛ ma ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ lo?

english_verse: You rich people are violent, and everyone tells lies.
translation_verse: Niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ sisiɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, lakpatsɛmɛ ji nyɛ.

english_verse: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i je sisi bɔni nyɛ tue gblami momo; ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord, will let it all be captured in war.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maa ye ní, se nyɛ be tɔe; anɔkuale mi ɔ, hwɔ maa hi nyɛ yee kɛ sa. Nyɛ maa muɔ níhi kɛ ya, se nyɛ be nyɛe kɛ to; ke nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ́ ko to po, ma kpata hɛ mi ngɛ ta mi.

english_verse: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma du ní, se nyɛ be ní kpae. Nyɛ maa nga oliv yiblii kɛ pee nu, se nyɛ be nu kpae. Nyɛ maa pee wai, se nyɛ be nue.

english_verse: No one is loyal to God; no one does right. Everyone is brutal and eager to deceive everyone else.
translation_verse: Anɔkualetsɛmɛ ta zugba a nɔ; dalɔ kake ngmelu po be. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ blɔ ko hlae nɛ e kɛ pue muɔ si; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi klama tsɔe.

english_verse: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko he nyɛ nyɛmimɛ nyɛɛ ye; nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ huɛmɛ a nɔ; yo nɛ o kɛ lɛ hwɔɔ si po, hyɛ o nya nɔ ngɛ e he.

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: Ejakaa be nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, binyumuhi bui a tsɛmɛ hu; biyihi teɔ si kɛ woɔ a nyɛmɛ, nɛ nganyɛmɛ teɔ si kɛ woɔ nganyɛmɛ. Nɔmlɔ adesa he nyɛli ji lɛ nitsɛ e we mi bi.

english_verse: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ, ma hyɛ Yawɛ blɔ. I kɛ ye hɛ maa fɔ Mawu nɔ, ejakaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma he ye yi wami. Ye Mawu ɔ maa bu mi tue. Yawɛ ma he e ma a yi wami

english_verse: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
translation_verse: E sɛ kaa wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ yeɔ wa he fɛu. Wa nɔ si lɛɛ, se wa maa te si ekohu. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ wa ngɛ diblii mi, se Yawɛ ma ha wɔ la.

english_verse: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
translation_verse: Wa pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e mi mi fu wɔ ɔ, wa ma na tsui. Ejakaa e ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ e maa gbla a tue ngɛ yayami nɛ a pee wɔ ɔ he. Yawɛ maa ngɔ wɔ kɛ ba la a he, nɛ wa maa na kaa e ma he wa yi wami.

english_verse: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
translation_verse: Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ. Mɛ lɛ a ye wa he fɛu nɛ a bi wɔ ke, “Jije Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ?” Wa maa na kaa a ye a nɔ kunimi, nɛ a naa a nɔ kaa mɔsɔ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yerusalem bi, be ma nɛ a maa fia gbogbo kɛ wo nyɛ ma a he ekohu. Jamɛ a be ɔ, a maa hɛ nyɛ huzu ɔ mi kɛ maa ya se tsitsaa.

english_verse: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Se zugba a hɛ mi ma kpata; ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji mɛ. A fa kue ha Yawɛ

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo hyɛ o ma a nɛ o hla a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ e tohi. E ngɛ mi kaa a gbɛ ngɔ fia nga a nɔ mohu, se zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní bɔle mɛ. Ha nɛ a ya ye Bashan kɛ Gilead zugba kpakpa amɛ a nɔ ní kaa bɔ nɛ a pee blema a.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, moo pee nyakpɛ níhi ha wɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ o pee be ko benɛ o je wɔ kɛ je Egipt ɔ.

english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: A maa sã si ngɛ tabo zu mi kaa sinɔhi. A kɛ he domi kɛ gbeye yemi maa je a mɔ ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba Yawɛ, wa Mawu ngɔ.

english_verse: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
translation_verse: Yawɛ, mawu kpa ko be nɛ kɛ mo sɔ. O ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ, o kɛ a he yayami paa mɛ. O mi mi fu we kɛ yɛ neneene, se mohu ɔ, o suɔ kaa o je o suɔmi nɛ se pui gblegbleegble ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ.

english_verse: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
translation_verse: O maa na wɔ mɔbɔ ekohu. O kɛ o nane maa naa wa ní yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ o maa muɔ kɛ ya wo wo mi, kɛ yaa su wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ!

english_verse: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
translation_verse: Wɔ o ma, Abraham kɛ Yakob a nina a, o maa gbaa wɔ, nɛ o maa na wɔ mɔbɔ daa kaa bɔ nɛ o wo wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si blema lokoo ɔ.

english_verse: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh. The Fierce Anger of the Lord
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Nineve ma a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nina nɛ Nahum nɛ je Elkosh ɔ na ngɛ Nineve he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yawɛ mi mi fu Nineve

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: Yawɛ mi mi fu we mla, se kɛ̃ ɔ, e we abofu nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ; e ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ nɔ tɔli yeɔ a he kɔkɔɔkɔ. Yawɛ jeɔ e he wami kpo ngɛ lasiogblee kɛ ahumi mi; nɛ bɔku ngɛ kaa e nane se bunyuku!

english_verse: At the Lord's command, oceans and rivers dry up. Bashan, Mount Carmel, and Lebanon wither, and their flowers fade.
translation_verse: Ke Yawɛ wo gbi ɔ, wo miiɔ nɛ e peeɔ zugba gbigbli, nɛ pahi gbliɔ. Lohwehi a ní yemi he kpakpahi nɛ ngɛ Bashan kɛ Karmel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nglaa; nɛ Lebanon mɔmɔ ɔmɛ taa.

english_verse: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
translation_verse: Yoku mimiɛɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; nɛ yokuhi sileɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi. Ke Yawɛ je e he kpo ɔ, zugba a mimiɛɔ; nɛ je ɔ, kɛ e mi nimli ɔmɛ tsuo a he doɔ blibliibli.

english_verse: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
translation_verse: Ke e mi mi fu ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa da nya? Ke e hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ yi ma na wami? Ke e je e mi mi la glegleegle ɔ kpo ɔ, tɛ sahi peeɔ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ kaa bunyuku ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ a buaa mio tsohi, kɛ go gbigbli nya nɛ a sãã a, jã e maa sã nyɛ butuu!

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Mo Nineve, o mi nɛ nɔ ko je, nɛ e to yi mi yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.”
translation_verse: Ma ha nɛ Asiria nɔ yemi ɔ se maa po, nɛ ma kplɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ he.”

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: Kita nɛ Yawɛ ka ngɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “A nina ko be si hie; a biɛ maa laa. Ma poo amaga amɛ nɛ ngɛ a wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ngɔ pue he. I ngɛ yɔkɔ tsuae ngɔ to Asiria bi ɔmɛ, ejakaa e sɛ kaa a hi je mi!”

english_verse: Look toward the mountains, people of Judah! Here comes a messenger with good news of peace. Celebrate your festivals. Keep your promises to God. Your evil enemies are destroyed and will never again invade your country.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, tsɔlɔ ko ma ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ manye munyu. E ngɛ fiɛe ngɛ dee ke wa ye kunimi. Yuda ma, nyɛɛ ye nyami ligbi ɔmɛ. Si nɛ nyɛ wo Mawu veveeve ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ. Yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ be bae nɛ a ba tua nyɛ zugba a hu. Ejakaa a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Nineveh, someone is coming to attack and scatter you. Guard your fortresses! Watch the road! Be brave! Prepare for battle!
translation_verse: Nineve, ta tua mo! Nyɛ ya da nyɛ blɔ hehi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he! Nyɛɛ bu blɔ ɔmɛ a he! Nyɛɛ mia kɛ ha ta!

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: A tsɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ benɛ a hɛɛ fo kitikiti kɛ yaa a, a ngɛ si tɛe. He nyɛli ɔmɛ a he sɔ kɛ ya su gbogbo ɔ he, nɛ a wo tsɛ̃i ɔ nɔ kɛ ma si.

english_verse: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.
translation_verse: A nu manyɛ ɔ kɛ ho; e mawayi ɔmɛ wo yana kɛ gbi nɛ ngɛ kaa lahuɛhi a gbi, nɛ a gba a gugue ma kɛ ye kɔmɔ.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ha sika hiɔ! Nyɛɛ ha sika tsu! Juetli hyi ma a tɔ!

english_verse: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
translation_verse: Jata ku ɔ ya gbe de lo, nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ mi kɛ ha jata yo ɔ, kɛ e bi ɔmɛ; lo ɔ hyi e hi he ɔ tɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “I kɛ mo ná! Ma sã o ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ. Ma kpata o ta buli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ ta mi. Níhi tsuo nɛ o kpɔ ngɛ nihi a dɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ. A be o he wami he nue hu ngɛ je ɔ mi.”

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Nineve, ma gbla o tue! Ma ha nɛ o maa hɛɛ o he gu, nɛ ma ha nɛ je ma amɛ maa na mo paslapaa kɛ o he zo ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na mo ɔ he mi maa po. E ma de ke, ‘Akuanyɛ! Nineve hɛ mi kpata pɛ! Mɛnɔ ma ba ye lɛ kɔmɔ? Mɛnɔ ma ba wo lɛ bua?’ ”

english_verse: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
translation_verse: Nineve, anɛ o hi pe Egipt matsɛ ma Tebes ɔ lo? Lɛ hu tse Nilo pa a bɔle lɛ kaa gbogbo nɛ faa e he lo?

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Tebes nɛ yeɔ Sudan kɛ Egipt tsuo a nɔ; nɛ e he wa kaa nɔ́ ko. Put kɛ Libia piɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛ hwu ta a!

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nuu Tebes bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ma se ya. A fiaa jokuɛwi ɔmɛ ní nɛ a gbe ngɛ ma a mi blɔ ɔmɛ a kɔ nya amɛ tsuo. A nuu a ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ a wo mɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ kɛ ho. A dla mɛ ngɔ ha nihi nɛ ba nuu mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: Nineve, mo hu o maa pee kaa nɔ nɛ tɔ dã! O ma hla kaa o maa je o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
translation_verse: O mɔ nguangua amɛ tsuo maa pee kaa ngmɔkɔ tsohi nɛ a nɔ yiblii fu. Nɔ ko nɛ huanya tso ɔ piɔ kaa yiblii ɔmɛ be tsɔe ba nɔ nɔ ɔ nya mi klom lo!

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: O ta buli ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa yihi pɛ; ke he nyɛli ba tua ma a, nɔ ko be nyɛe maa te si kɛ wo mɛ. La maa sã agbo ɔmɛ a se lami ní ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Your city is under attack. Haul in extra water! Strengthen your defenses! Start making bricks! Stir the mortar!
translation_verse: Yaa yɛ nyu ngɔ to; a ma ba sa ma a yi. Dla o mɔ nguangua amɛ! Moo naa zu nɛ o kɛ maa pee bliikisi, nɛ o dla bliikisi peemi daka amɛ kɛ to si!

english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ja a sã mo, loo ja o nɔ ngɛ ta mi. Kaa bɔ nɛ baalɛ yeɔ ní kɛ pii si ɔ, jã a ma kpata o hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. O fɔ babauu, nɛ o he hiɛ kaa baalɛ!

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: O jua yeli ɔmɛ hiɛ pe hlami dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe! Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, mɛ tsuo a ho kaa baalɛhi nɛ́ bli a pɛli mi, nɛ a te kɛ je.

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: O ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu kaa baalɛhi. Fĩɛ be mi ɔ, a laa a he ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a mi. Se ke pu je pɛ a te, nɛ nɔ ko li he nɛ a yaa!

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Asiria matsɛ, o we amlaalo ɔmɛ gbo, nɛ o ma nimeli ɔmɛ hwɔ mahe kɛ yaa neneene! O we bi ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba we ekohu.

english_verse: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me. Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha gbalɔ Habakuk ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Habakuk bi ke mɛni he je a yi dami sane

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: Yawɛ lee, kɛ yaa su mɛni be ma fa kue kɛ tsɛ mo loko o maa bu mi tue, nɛ o ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je yi wu tso níhi nɛ a ngɛ wɔ pee ɔ mi?

english_verse: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
translation_verse: Mlaa a he wami ɔ ta, nɛ dami sane yemi be hu; yayami peeli ye dali a nɔ, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, a plɛ dami sane yemi hɛ mi ngɔ bu si. Yawɛ ha heto

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Ke a ma kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a he gbeye kɛ sawale nuɔ nihi. A woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, a woɔ fo kɛ jeɔ kaa kɔɔhiɔ; a peeɔ yayami nɛ a yeɔ fɔ; a he wami ji a mawu.” Habakuk bi Yawɛ munyu ekohu

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: A jaa a ya amɛ, nɛ a sãã bɔhi haa mɛ, ejakaa a ya amɛ haa mɛ ní kpakpahi.

english_verse: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.
translation_verse: Ma kuɔ kɛ ya ye bu he ɔ ngɛ mɔ ɔ yi mi, konɛ ma hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e maa bua ye sane ɔ he ha.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
translation_verse: Heto nɛ Yawɛ ha mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ngmaa nina nɛ ma je ngɔ tsɔɔ mo nɛ ɔ saminya ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛhi a nɔ, konɛ ke nɔ ko hɛngmɛ gba nɔ ɔ, e kanemi ko wa ha lɛ.

english_verse: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
translation_verse: Ngmaa kɛ to; ejakaa be nɛ a ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sui lolo. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, be ɔ ma, nɛ e be kɛe, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma je ngɔ tsɔɔ mo ɔ maa ba mi kokooko. E maa pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma blɛuu tsɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, hyɛ́ blɔ. Ejakaa e maa ba mi kokooko, nɛ e be kɛe.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ: ‘Yayami peeli a hɛ mi ma kpata; se dali lɛɛ, akɛnɛ a yeɔ Mawu anɔkuale ɔ, a yi ma na wami.’ ” A ma kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: Ní nami babauu sisiɔ nɔ. Nihi nɛ bua ní nya ha a he ɔ, a woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a he mi jɔɛ mɛ; a ngɛ kaa gbenɔ kɛ gbeje, a tɔɛ gblee. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a kɛ ma tsuaa ma hwuu ta, nɛ a ngɔɔ ma amɛ kakaaka a nɛ.

english_verse: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
translation_verse: Mo nɛ o kɛ yi wu tso kpɔ nihi a níhi kɛ ha o weku li, nɛ o hla kaa haomi kɛ nyagba kó ba o we mi ɔ, musu tloo mo!

english_verse: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
translation_verse: Gahi nɛ o to nɛ ɔ kɛ zo mohu ba o weku li a nɔ. Nɛ́ o kpata je mahi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ, mo nitsɛ o hɛ mi nɛ o kpata a nɛ.

english_verse: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.
translation_verse: Tɛhi nɛ a kɛ fia gbogbo po ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ wo nyɛ, nɛ akpale ɔmɛ hu ma he nɔ.

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Se be ma nɛ je ɔ ma yɔse Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ wo ɔ hyi tɔ kɛ nyu ɔ.

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: O deɔ tso kpoku ke, “O hɛ nɛ tsɛ!” Aloo tɛ nɛ tui munyu ke, “Tee si!” Anɛ amaga ma nyɛ je nina ko ha mo lo? A kɛ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ maa ha he lɛɛ, se wami ko be e mi kulaa. Musu tloo mo!

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ngɛ e we klɔuklɔu ɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, e pee dii ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: This is my prayer:
translation_verse: Gbalɔ Habakuk fa kue ke,

english_verse: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ lee, i nu nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ he, nɛ e ha nɛ i ye mo gbeye. Ní nguanguahi nɛ o tsu blema a, mo tsu ekohu wa yi nɔ nɛ ɔ. Ke o mi mi fu po, moo na mɔbɔ.

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Mawu je Edom kɛ ma ekohu; Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ si kplee ngɛ Paran yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma. E hɛ mi nyami ɔ ha hiɔwe ɔ tsuo; nɛ a ngɛ e yi jee ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: E ma kɛ la nylamnylam kaa oslabai; la ngɛ pae plamplam kɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi jee; lejɛ ɔ e he wami ɔ hɔɔ si ngɛ.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: E haa nɛ hiɔhi baa, nɛ gbenɔ nyɛɛɔ se.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: Ke e da si ɔ, zugba a mimiɛɔ, ke e wo e hɛ mi nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma amɛ a he doɔ blibliibli. E ywia blema yo ɔmɛ; e ba yoku ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ daa a si; yo nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ e nyɛɛ blema a nɛ.

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: I na nɛ sawale nu Kushan bi ɔmɛ, nɛ Midian bi ɔmɛ hu a he ngɛ doe blibliibli.

english_verse: Our Lord, were you angry with the monsters of the deep? You attacked in your chariot and wiped them out.
translation_verse: Yawɛ, anɛ pa amɛ lɛ a wo o mi mi la a lo? Aloo wo ɔ lɛ ha o hɛ dɔ, benɛ o hi bɔku ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ nyɛɛ kaa ta zugba lɛ kɛ ya ye kunimi ɔ?

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: O je o kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ kpo, konɛ o tsɛ̃ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ o ha oslabai gba zugba a mi.

english_verse: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
translation_verse: Benɛ yo ɔmɛ na mo ɔ, a he do blibliibli; hiɔmi nɛ pue si piapiaapia. Muɔ voo ɔ wo gbi, nɛ oslɔke fluku.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: Benɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ hia ta kɛ ma puu kaa ahumi, konɛ a ba gbɛ wɔ ngɔ fĩa, nɛ e pee mɛ kaa peepee ta wa he, nɛ balɔ ko be, lɔ ɔ a nine gbe wɔ ɔ, o tsɛ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya na a tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: O kɛ o we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ wo ɔ nɔ gidigidi, kɛkɛ nɛ nyu babauu ɔ fia hwɔli.

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: I nu sane nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ ye he do blibliibli; fɔ̃ ha ye nya bɔni domi. Ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ pee sikplikpii, nɛ ye nane mi jɔ ngɛ ye sisi. Ma mlɛ dii kɛ yaa su be nɛ Mawu maa gbla nihi nɛ ba tua wɔ ɔ a tue.

english_verse: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
translation_verse: Ke ngmɔkɔ tso gba we mɔmɔ, nɛ wai tso ɔmɛ wui yiblii, ke oliv nu bɛ, nɛ niye ní be ngmɔ ɔ nɔ, ke to ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata, nɛ na amɛ gbo ta tsu ɔ mi, ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi po,

english_verse: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.
translation_verse: ye bua maa jɔ, nɛ ma nya; ejakaa Yawɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ heɔ ye yi wami.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ haa mi he wami. Lɛ nɛ haa ye nane maa si saminya kaa bayelɔ nɔ́; nɛ i naa tue mi jɔmi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.”

english_verse: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ha Zefania, be mi nɛ Amon bi Yosia ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Zefania tsɛ ji Kush, nɛ e nɛmɛ ji Gedalia, Amaria, kɛ Hezekia. Yawɛ tue gblami ligbi ɔ

english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ma kpata nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ngɛ je ɔ mi:

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: nimli adesahi, pu mi lohwehi, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, lohi, kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ma kpata nimli adesahi tsuo kulaa a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ kake ngmelu po be piɛe. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: “Ma gbla nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ma a mi, kɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ tsuo a tue. Baal jali nɛ piɛ ɔ, ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be Baal wɔnɔ ɔmɛ kaie hu.

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma gbla ma tsɔli ɔmɛ, matsɛbimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ ma se kusumi níhi tsuo kulaa a tue.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: “Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a maa wo yana ngɛ Lo Agbo ɔ nya ngɛ Yerusalem; a ma nya awe ngɛ Yerusalem ma he ɔ mi, nɛ a ma he ose ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: A maa ha a níhi, nɛ a we ɔmɛ maa pee we dokuhi. Wehi nɛ a ngɛ poe ɔ, a be a mi hie, nɛ wai ngmɔhi nɛ a ngɛ hue ɔ, a be a mi dã nue.”

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi nguaa a nɛ Yawɛ maa gbla e ma a tue ɔ ma kɛ fo; e su si ta! E maa pee aywilɛho ligbi, ejakaa ta buli katsɛmɛ po a hɛ maa dɔ, nɛ a ma fo ya boboobo.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Mawu mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nihi a yi ma fi, nɛ a maa hao; a ma kpata níhi a hɛ mi basabasa; bɔku yumu tslitsliitsli maa wo, nɛ je ɔ mi maa pee tuu.

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ ma je e mi mi fumi ɔ kpo ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe ma he ma a yi wami: sika hiɔ jio, sika tsu jio. E kɛ e mi mi fumi ɔ ma kpata je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã nɔ́ ɔ. E maa gbe níhi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi si kake too.

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: nɛ nyɛ ko ba ngla nɛ nyɛ gbo kaa dwɔmi nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ mi mi ma fu nyɛ ɔ nɛ e su.

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Nyɛ Filisti bi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ wo nya, kɛ nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ, musu tloo nyɛ! Yawɛ bu nyɛ hu fɔ. Yawɛ ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ kake ngmelu po he be mi jee.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi nihi bɔɔ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, nyɛ zugba a nɔ lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a maa hi. A maa lɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma ya hwɔ we ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Ashkelon. Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ e ma ha nɛ a maa bɔ ekohu.

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Tue gblami nɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ ma na ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa a wo a he nɔ, nɛ a bɔ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma a ahlua.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
translation_verse: Yawɛ hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo mɛ. Yawɛ ma kpata wɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ je ma amɛ, wo kpo ɔ, kɛ zugbahi nɛ wo bɔle mɛ ɔ tsuo ma ja lɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ.

english_verse: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
translation_verse: Sudan bi ɔmɛ hu, Yawɛ kɛ klaate maa gbe mɛ.

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: Nineve ma plɛ pee tohi kɛ pu mi lohwe slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi a hi he. Ablɛgogoe maa pee muɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Okpoku kɛ klomi maa hi hwɔe kɛ je saflɛ mi ngɛ mɔ kokoe ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ kuakualabite maa hi pɛe kuaakuaa ngɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a yi mi. Seda ma kpɔ ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Too bad for that disgusting, corrupt, and lawless city!
