translation_verse: Musu tloo Yerusalem! Ma nɛ́ wo e he mu! Atuã tsɔli kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a ma.

english_verse: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
translation_verse: Tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa jatahi nɛ ngɛ huãe. Kojoli ɔmɛ hu ngɛ kaa ogbeteehi nɛ hwɔ gbe mɛ; gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a yeɔ ní tsuatsuaatsua, nɛ ke je na a, a si we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, biɛ kɛkɛ lɛ tsɛɛ mɛ; lakpatsɛmɛ sɔuu ji mɛ. Osɔfo ɔmɛ plɛɔ mlaa amɛ a hɛ mi kɛ buɔ si bɔ nɛ maa da mɛ, nɛ a bleɔ níhi nɛ a ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.
translation_verse: Se Yawɛ ngɛ ma a mi; lɛɛ dalɔ ji lɛ; e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ. Daa ligbi ɔ, e yeɔ dami sane. Se kɛ ɔ, yayami peeli ɔmɛ yaa nɔ nɛ a peeɔ yayami, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee we mɛ zo.

english_verse: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “I kpata je mahi a hɛ mi; i ku a mɔ nguangua amɛ ngɔ pue si. Ma amɛ pee ma dokuhi; gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ fɔɔ si gu, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a nɔ.

english_verse: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
translation_verse: I de ke, ‘Jehanɛ lɛɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa bu mi tue; jehanɛ lɛɛ ke i bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ɔ, a maa ye gbeye, nɛ e be hiae kaa ma gbla a tue ekohu.’ Se a ya nɔ pee yayami pe kekle ɔ mohu.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Just wait for the day when I accuse you nations. I have decided on a day, when I will bring together every nation and kingdom and punish them all in my fiery anger. I will become furious and destroy the earth.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ mlɛ keii kɛ yaa si ligbi ɔ nɛ ma te si nɛ ma po je ma amɛ a nya. I to ye yi mi kaa ma bua je ma amɛ, kɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ ma je ye mi mi la nɛ nya wa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ. Ejakaa ye mi mi la nɛ ɔ ma kpata je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi.

english_verse: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
translation_verse: “Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha je ma amɛ gbi nɛ he tsɔ. Mɛ tsuo a maa fa kue ha imi Yawɛ, nɛ a maa pee a nya kake kɛ sɔmɔ mi.

english_verse: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
translation_verse: Ye nihi nɛ gbɛ fĩa a maa ngɔ nike ní kɛ je tsitsaa Sudan po kɛ ba ha mi.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, zo be nyɛ pee hu kaa nyɛ ye ma a, nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã. Ma je he woli, kɛ he nɔ woli kɛ maa je nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ nyɛ be ye hɛ mi atuã tsɔe hu gblegbleegble ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: Ma si nihi nɛ peeɔ a he humi, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ a maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ imi Yawɛ ye nɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
translation_verse: Israel bi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, a be nɔ́ yayami pee; a be lakpa yee, nɛ a be nɔ sisie hulɔ. A ma plɔke, nɛ a he mi maa jɔ mɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa wo a he gbeye.” Bua jɔmi la

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem and Judah, celebrate and shout with all your heart!
translation_verse: Yerusalem bi, nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi; Israel ma, nyɛ hwɔ lele. Yerusalem bi, nyɛ nya nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he.

english_verse: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
translation_verse: Yawɛ gbla nyɛ tue ta; e fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ he. Yawɛ, Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; nyɛ be gbeye yee hu.

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
translation_verse: Be ma, nɛ a ma de Yerusalem ke, “Zion, koo ye gbeye! O kɔni nɛ ko gbo!

english_verse: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
translation_verse: Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; e he wami ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa ye kunimi. Yawɛ ma na nyɛ he bua jɔmi; e maa suɔ nyɛ sane, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ wami he. E ma la, nɛ e ma na nyɛ he bua jɔmi

english_verse: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
translation_verse: Be ma! Ma gbla nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ a tue; ma he akpaketsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a yi wami, nɛ ma kpale nihi nɛ a nuu nyɔguɛ ɔ kɛ ba we ekohu. Ma tsake a zo ɔ kɛ pee hɛ mi nyami, nɛ je ɔ tsuo ma je a yi.

english_verse: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Be ma! Ma ngɔ nihi nɛ gbɛ fĩa a kɛ maa ba we ekohu. Ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma he biɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo; je ma amɛ ma je nyɛ yi, nɛ nyɛ ma na ní babauu ekohu.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua
translation_verse: Persia matsɛ, Darius yi nɔ, jeha enyɔne ɔ mi, nyɔhiɔ ekpane ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi kɛ gu gbalɔ Hagai nɔ kɛ ha nimli nɛ ɔmɛ: Sheatiel bi Zerubabel, Yuda amlaalo ɔ, kɛ Yehozadak bi Yoshua, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a.

english_verse: Think about what I have said!
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li nɔ́ nɛ kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ba lo?

english_verse: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ya kuɔ yoku ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ poo tso kɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu; kɛkɛ ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi, nɛ nyɛ ma ja mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ hyɛɛ blɔ kaa ke nyɛ kpa ní ɔ, nyɛ ma na babauu, se bɔbɔyoo pɛ nyɛ naa. Jehanɛ, ke nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ba we mi ɔ, kɛkɛ i ha nɛ e pee kɔɔhiɔ. Mɛni he je i ngɛ ja pee ɔ? Nyɛɛ hyɛ, be mi nɛ ye we ɔ ku kɛ pueɔ si ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we mae.

english_verse: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ hiɔmi nɛ́ hu, nɛ zugba a hu bɛ ní ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
translation_verse: I ha nɛ sapu ye nibɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo; zugba a, yoku ɔmɛ, blɛfo ngmɔ ɔmɛ, wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ, oliv abɔɔ ɔmɛ, nimli adesahi, lohwehi, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a gbo he dengme ɔ, sapu ye mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Ma a bu Yawɛ fami ɔ tue

english_verse: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Shealtiel Zerubabel, kɛ Yehozadak bi Yoshua, kɛ ma a tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se ngɛ Babilonia kɛ ba a, pee nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ de mɛ ke a pee ɔ, nɛ a bu gbalɔ Hagai, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ tue, ejakaa Yawɛ nɛ tsɔ lɛ. Ma a tsuo ye gbeye.

english_verse: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Hagai, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ Yawɛ sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha ma a ke, “I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: And the work began on the twenty-fourth day of that same month.
translation_verse: ngɛ Matsɛ Darius yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ ekpane ɔ we ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛne ɔ.

english_verse: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:
translation_verse: E de Hagai ke e de Sheatiel bi Zerubabel, Yuda ma a amlaalo ɔ, kɛ Yehozadak bi Yoshua, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, kɛ ma a tsuo ke,

english_verse: But cheer up! Because I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be here to help you with the work,
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɔni mi ko wo nyu. Nyɛ tsu ní ɔ, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.
translation_verse: Benɛ nyɛ maa je Egipt ɔ, i wo nyɛ si nɛ ɔ ke ye mumi ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si daa. I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye.

english_verse: Soon I will again shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
translation_verse: “E be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma mimiɛ hiɔwe, zugba, wo, kɛ zugba gbigbli ɔ tsuo ekohu.

english_verse: I will shake the nations, and their treasures will be brought here. Then the brightness of my glory will fill this temple.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ je mahi tsuo ngɔ fia si, nɛ a maa muɔ a juetli babauu ɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, nɛ Mawu we ɔ ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ níhi nɛ a he jua wa.

english_verse: All silver and gold belong to me,
translation_verse: Ye níhi ji je ɔ mi sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ tsuo.

english_verse: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
translation_verse: Mawu we he ɔ maa hi fɛu pe momo ɔ. Ma ha kplɔkɔtɔ maa ba ye ma a nɔ, nɛ ni ɔmɛ maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.” Yawɛ lɛ de. Gbalɔ ɔ ya bi osɔfo ɔmɛ ga womi

english_verse: to ask the priests for their opinion on the following matters:
translation_verse: E de ke, “Bi osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a buá sane nɛ ɔ he ha.

english_verse: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɔ lo kpɔ ko nɛ a gbaa nɔ ha Mawu kɛ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ yaa ngɛ e tade klɔii ɔ mi, ke e ha nɛ e tade ɔ sa niye ní kaa abolo, loo flɔɔ, loo wai, loo nu, loo niye ní saisaa ko he ɔ, anɛ jamɛ a niye ní ɔ hu maa pee nɔ́ nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Mawu lo?” Osɔfo ɔmɛ ha heto ke, “Dɛbi!”

english_verse: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Hagai bi ke, “Ke nɔ ko ya ta gbogboe ko he kɛ ble e he, jehanɛ, ke kaa e ya ta niye ní nɛ ɔmɛ eko he ɔ, anɛ lɔ ɔ hu ma ble jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ hu lo?” Osɔfo ɔmɛ ha heto ke, “Ee, e bleɔ mɛ.”

english_verse: But from now on, things will get better. Before you started laying the foundation for the temple,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ loko nyɛ bɔni Yawɛ we ɔ mami ɔ, nyɛ nɛ́ lo?

english_verse: That same day the Lord spoke to Haggai again and said:
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu nɛ ji nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ha Hagai sɛ gbi enyɔne

english_verse: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ lɛ i ha nyɛ ní ɔmɛ fu ja, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nglaa ní, kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ba kpata nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ gbo he dengme ɔ hɛ mi, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ tsakee we nyɛ tsui.

english_verse: Although you have not yet harvested any grain, grapes, figs, pomegranates, or olives, I will richly bless you in the days ahead. God's Promise to Zerubbabel
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa blɛfo be gba mi, nɛ wai tso ɔmɛ, ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ, tsohi nɛ a yiblii ngɔɔ, kɛ oliv tso ɔmɛ wui yiblii lolo lɛɛ, se kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, ma gbaa nyɛ.” Yawɛ wo Zerubabel si

english_verse: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth
translation_verse: nɛ e ya de Zerubabel, amlaalo nɛ hyɛɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ ke, “Ma mimiɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba,

english_verse: and wipe out kings and their kingdoms. I will overturn war chariots, and then cavalry troops will start slaughtering each other.
translation_verse: nɛ ma ngɔ nɔ yemi ɔmɛ kɛ a he wami ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si. Ma ha ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ maa nɔɔ si kɛ a kudɔli ɔmɛ; okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ma gbo, nɛ a nɔ hili ɔmɛ maa gbe a sibi.

english_verse: But tell my servant Zerubbabel that I, the Lord All-Powerful, have chosen him, and he will rule in my name.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma ngɔ mo, ye tsɔlɔ Zerubabel, Sheatiel bi ɔ, nɛ ma wo mo tsɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi. Mo ji nɔ nɛ i je blɔ hla.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: I am the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo. In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Persia matsɛ, Darius tsɛ yemi be ɔ jeha enyɔne ɔ, nyɔhiɔ kpaanyɔne ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ e sɛ gbi ngɔ ha Ido bibi gbalɔ Zakaria, Berekia bi ɔ ke,

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord All-Powerful, was very angry with your ancestors. But if you people will return to me, I will turn and help you.
translation_verse: se jehanɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ imi hu ma ná nyɛ he tsui ekohu.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. They were warned by the earlier prophets to give up their evil and turn back to me, but they paid no attention.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko pee kaa nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ. Blema lokoo nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngɔ ye sɛ gbi ngɔ ha mɛ ke a kpa yayami peemi, nɛ́ a ba a je mi bɔ nɛ sa; se a bui mi tue fɛɛ, nɛ a yi ye munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Where are your ancestors now? Not even prophets live forever.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, jije nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ? Nɛ gbali ɔmɛ nɛɛ! A ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ?

english_verse: But my warnings and my words spoken by the prophets caught up with your ancestors. So they turned back to me and said, “Lord All-Powerful, you have punished us for our sins, just as you had planned.” First Vision: Horses and Riders
translation_verse: Mlaahi nɛ i wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔkɔ nɛ i bɔ mɛ kɛ gu ye tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, tse a na mi nɔ́! Kɛkɛ nɛ jehanɛ a tsake a tsui, nɛ a de ke, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ gbla a tue bɔ nɛ sa mɛ ngɛ a ní peemi ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ e to e yi mi ke e ma pee ɔ.” Okpɔngɔhi a he nina

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of Shebat, which was the eleventh month of that same year, the Lord spoke to me in a vision during the night: In a valley among myrtle trees, I saw someone on a red horse, with riders on red, brown, and white horses behind him.
translation_verse: Nyɔ mi ɔ, i na Yawɛ bɔfo ko ngɛ okpɔngɔ tsutsuu ko nɔ. E ha e we okpɔngɔ ɔ da si ngɛ mɔmɔ tso komɛ a kpɛti ngɛ kɔ̃ ko mi. Okpɔngɔ kpahi daa si ngɛ a se, okpɔngɔ tsutsuuhi, okpɔngɔ futaahi, kɛ ekomɛ nɛ hɛɛ kɔbɛi su.

english_verse: An angel was there to explain things to me, and I asked, “Sir, who are these riders?” “I'll tell you,” the angel answered.
translation_verse: I bi Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, okpɔngɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛni a tsɔɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Ma tsɔɔ mo.

english_verse: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, “These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, nyumu ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ mɔmɔ tso ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ he nɔ ke, ‘Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ Yawɛ tsɔ mɛ ke a ya slaa je ɔ mi tsuo.’ ”

english_verse: Then the riders spoke to the Lord's angel, who was standing among the myrtle trees, and they said, “We have gone everywhere and have discovered that the whole world is at peace.”
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ kpa amɛ a nɔ ɔ bɔ Yawɛ bɔfo amaniɛ ɔ ke, “Wa ya slaa je ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ wa na kaa tue mi jɔmi ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.”

english_verse: The Lord's answer was kind and comforting.
translation_verse: Yawɛ kɛ bɔfo ɔ tu munyu, nɛ e wo lɛ bua.

english_verse: So the angel told me to announce: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am very protective of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ de mi ke ma fiɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ɔ ke, “Yerusalem, ye ma klɔuklɔu Zion ɔ, i suɔ e sane saminya, nɛ e he nɔ́ dɔɔ mi.

english_verse: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.
translation_verse: Se mahi nɛ a he mi jɔ mɛ, nɛ a tue mi hu jɔ mɛ ɔ, ye mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Ejakaa imi lɛɛ be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ ye mi mi fu ye ma a, se jamɛ a ma kpa amɛ lɛɛ a ha ye ma a nɔ́ nami ɔ ngɛ nɔ yae mohu.

english_verse: And so, I will have pity on Jerusalem. The city will be completely rebuilt, and my temple will stand again.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem, konɛ ma ba na ma a mɔbɔ. A maa ma ye sɔlemi we ɔ ekohu, nɛ a ma dla maa fia Yerusalem ma a hulɔ.”

english_verse: I also promise that my towns will prosper—Jerusalem will once again be my chosen city, and I will comfort the people of Zion. Second Vision: Animal Horns
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ de mi hulɔ ke ma fiɛ ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke e ma amɛ ma ná ní kpɔtɔɔ ekohu. Yawɛ maa kpale ba ngɔ Yerusalem ekohu kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma; nɛ e maa wo Zion bua.” Kolihi a he nina

english_verse: Next, I saw four animal horns.
translation_verse: I na nina kpa; i na lohwe koli eywiɛ.

english_verse: The angel who was sent to explain was there, and so I asked, “What do these mean?” His answer was, “These horns are the nations that scattered the people of Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem, and took away their freedom.” Then the Lord showed me four blacksmiths, and I asked, “What are they going to do?” He replied, “They are going to terrify and crush those horns.”
translation_verse: I bi ke, “Mɛni nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hu ma peemi?” E he nɔ ke, “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ba konɛ koli ɔmɛ nɛ kpata Yuda hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a gbɛ ye ma a ngɔ fĩa a, a ba wo a he gbeye, nɛ́ a kpata a hɛ mi.”

english_verse: and I asked, “Where are you going?” “To measure Jerusalem,” was the answer. “To find out how wide and long it is.”
translation_verse: I bi lɛ ke, “Jije o yaa?” E he nɔ ke, “I yaa susu Yerusalem, nɛ ma na e kami kɛ e blimi.”

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me came toward me, when another angel came up to him
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i na nɛ Mawu bɔfo nɛ kɛ mi ba tu munyu ɔ hɛ lɛ kɛ ba hɛ mi, nɛ Mawu bɔfo kpa kɛ lɛ ba kpe.

english_verse: and said, “Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.
translation_verse: Kekle bɔfo ɔ de e nyɛmi ɔ ke, “Tú fo nɛ o ya de niheyo ɔ nɛ hɛɛ nɔ́ susumi kpa a ke nimlihi kɛ nahi babauu maa ba Yerusalem, nɛ e he be hiae kaa a fia gbogbo kɛ wo ma a he.

english_verse: The Lord himself has promised to be a protective wall of fire surrounding Jerusalem, and he will be its shining glory in the heart of the city.” A Call to Action
translation_verse: Yawɛ wo si kaa lɛ nitsɛ e maa pee gbogbo nɛ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe kɛ bɔle ma a; e maa bu ma a he, nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa bɔle ma a.” A ke ni nɛmɛ nɛ ho ma se ya a nɛ a kpale kɛ ba we

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛ he jua wa ha mi saminya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa ta nyɛ he ɔ, i be lɛ kplɛɛe.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi ke ma ba de je ma amɛ nɛ ba ha e ma a ní ɔ ke,

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ nitsɛ kɛ nyɛ maa to ní, nɛ nyɛ ni tsɛmɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ maa ha nyɛ ní.” Ke nɔ nɛ ɔ ba mi pɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ tsɔ mi.

english_verse: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Yerusalem bi, nyɛ la nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ; ejakaa i ma nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ba hi si.”

english_verse: When he does, many nations will turn to him and become his people. At that time you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, je mahi babauu maa ngɔ a he kɛ ba mɛtɛ Yawɛ he. E kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ nyɛ maa le kaa lɛ nɛ e tsɔ mi nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ maa ngɔ Yuda kaa e nɔ́ nɛ he hia saminya ngɛ e zugba klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ, nɛ Yerusalem maa pee ma nɛ e suɔ pe kulaa ekohu.

english_verse: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ pee dii ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; ejakaa e je e hi he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ma.

english_verse: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.
translation_verse: I na nina kpa ko. Yawɛ ha nɛ i na osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Yoshua nɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ Abosiami ba daa si ngɛ Yoshua hiɔ nɔ, konɛ e po Yoshua nya.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Satan, you are wrong. Jerusalem is my chosen city, and this man was rescued like a stick from a flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ de Abosiami ke, “Abosiami, Yawɛ nɛ wo mo hiɔ! Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ hla Yerusalem kɛ pee e nɔ́ ɔ nɛ wo mo hiɔ. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, anɛ pi la tso nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ a hia kɛ je la nya nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, “This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ ke, “Nyɛ je tade sɛmusɛmu ɔ ngɛ e he.” Jehanɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de Yoshua ke, “I je o he yayami ɔmɛ; ma ha mo tade saminyayoo nɛ o wo.”

english_verse: I spoke up and said, “Also put a clean priestly turban on his head.” Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord's angel stood there watching.
translation_verse: E fa nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ ke a hla yi fimi nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ kɛ fi Yoshua yi ha lɛ, nɛ a wo lɛ tade saminyayoo ɔ. Nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ daa si ngɛ hyɛe.

english_verse: After this, the angel encouraged Joshua by telling him that the Lord All-Powerful had promised:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ de Yoshua ke,

english_verse: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.
translation_verse: bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke o maa ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ o maa hɛɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ma ha nɛ o ye ye we ɔ, kɛ e he kue ɔmɛ a nɔ. Ma ha mo blɔ he ngɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ ye hɛ mi ɔ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Listen carefully, High Priest Joshua and all of you other priests. You are a sign of things to come, because I am going to bring my servant, the Chosen King.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yoshua, mo osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ o hɛ mi, nyɛɛ bu tue. Níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se he okadi ma de nyɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ma ha ye tsɔlɔ nɛ ji Tso Kɔni ɔ maa ba.

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: I ngɔ tɛ kake too kɛ e hɛ mi kpaago kɛ ngɛ Yoshua hɛ mi mae. Ma kpɛ́ ningma ngɛ tɛ ɔ mi, nɛ ma ha yayami maa ta zugba a nɔ ligbi kake too.

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ maa kpee nyɛ sibi kɛ ba nyɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ a sisi. Yawɛ lɛ de.”

english_verse: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ ba ekohu, nɛ e ba hɛli mi si kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɛ̃ɛ̃ɔ nɔ ngɛ mahe mi.

english_verse: Then he asked, “What do you see?” “A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it,” I answered. “On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.
translation_verse: E bi mi ke, “Mɛni o na?” I he nɔ ke, “I na kane tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee. Tɔ maa si ngɛ e yi mi. Kane kpaago ngɛ kane tso ɔ he. Kane ɔmɛ eko fɛɛ eko hɛɛ puɔ kpaago.

english_verse: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.
translation_verse: Oliv tso enyɔ ngɛ kane tso ɔ kasa nya; kake ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ muɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: But, sir, what do these mean?”
translation_verse: I bi bɔfo ɔ ke, “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni enɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ?”

english_verse: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.
translation_verse: Mawu bɔfo ɔ de mi ke ma ngɔ Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya ha Zerubabel: “Pi o nyɛ́mi, loo o he wami nya; se ye mumi ɔ nɛ ma tsu enɛ ɔ. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, “God has been very kind.”
translation_verse: Mo yo gagaa, mɛni kulaa ji mo ngɛ Zerubabel hɛ mi? E maa ba mo si, nɛ o maa pee kaa nga kplanaa. Be nɛ o kɛ nyagbe tɛ ɔ maa ma e blɔ he ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi ɔ, ma a tsuo ma he ose ke, ‘Afɛu nɔ oo, afɛu nɔ!’ ”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu Yawɛ ha mi sɛ gbi kpa ke,

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Zerubabel nɛ fia Mawu we nɛ ɔ sisi tomi ɔ, lɛ nɔuu nɛ maa ma tsu ɔ kɛ gbe nya. Ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi pɛ ye ma a maa le kaa imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ nɛ i tsɔ mo a ngɔ.

english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ ní tsumi ɔ yɛ nɔ kpakpa ko ɔ, nɛ ni ɔmɛ pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɔni mi jɔ̃. Se ke a na Zerubabel nɛ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ mae ekohu ɔ, a bua maa jɔ.”

english_verse: Then I asked the angel, “What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i bi lɛ ke, “Oliv tso enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kane tso ɔ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛni a tsɔɔ?”

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: I bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Oliv tso kɔni enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ sika tsu bɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ nu ngɛ bee ngɛ a mi ɔ kasa nya a, mɛ hu mɛni a tsɔɔ?”

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e bi mi ke, “Anɛ o li?” I he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i li.”

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni enyɔ nɛ a pɔ mɛ nu, nɛ a daa si ngɛ je ɔ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.” Mawu wo Zerubabel si

english_verse: When I looked the next time, I saw a flying scroll,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ i na nina kpa ko. I na womi kpo ko nɛ te kɛ bee.

english_verse: and the angel asked, “What do you see?” “A flying scroll,” I answered. “About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.”
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ bi mi ke, “Mɛni o na?” I he nɔ ke, “I na womi kpo ko nɛ ngɛ tee kɛ bee; e kami maa pee gugue enuɔ, nɛ e blimi maa pee gugue enyɔ kɛ fa.”

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Gbiɛmi nɛ maa ba zugba a tsuo nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. A ngma ngɛ womi ɔ ba fa kake ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ju ɔ, a po lɛ ngɔ fɔ he.’ Nɛ a ngma ngɛ ba fa kake hu ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kãã lakpa kita a, a po lɛ ngɔ fɔ he.’

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke e ma ha gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ we mi he nɛ nɔ ko maa ju ngɛ ɔ, a ma kpata we ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ we tsuaa we nɛ nɔ ko ma kã lakpa kita ngɛ mi ɔ, a ma kpata we ɔ hɛ mi kɛ e mi tso kɛ tɛ tsuo.” Yo nɛ ngɛ kusii mi ɔ he nina

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ ba je e he si tsɔɔ mi ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Wo o hɛ nɔ nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ je kpo kɛ ma nɛ ɔ!”

english_verse: “I don't know what it is,” was my reply. “It's a big basket,” he said. “And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.”
translation_verse: I bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Kusii. Ee, kusii nɛ ɔ daa si ha yayami tsuo nɛ a pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: Sumui a kɛ pee kusii ɔ nya nɔ́ ɔ; a bli kusii ɔ nya, nɛ yo ko hii si ngɛ mi!

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ de ke, “Yo nɛ ɔ daa si ha yi wu tso ní peemi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e nyɛ yo ɔ nɔ kɛ wo kusii ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ nya nɔ́ ɔ kɛ bu nya.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Benɛ ma wo ye hɛ nɔ nɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, ne yi enyɔ komɛ nɛ ngɛ tee kɛ ma ye ngɔ kɛ a pɛlihi kaa pa nɔ kayo pɛli. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ba ngɔ kusii ɔ kɛ ho kɔɔhiɔ mi ya.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: I bi bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ ke, “Jije a ngɔ kusii ɔ kɛ yaa?”

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Okpɔngɔ tsu komɛ ngɛ kekleekle ta zugba lɛ ɔ gblae; enyɔne ɔ, okpɔngɔ yumuhi,

english_verse: the third chariot was pulled by white horses, and the fourth by spotted gray horses.
translation_verse: etɛne ɔ, okpɔngɔ futaahi, nɛ eywiɛne ɔ lɛɛ okpɔngɔ huatahuatahi nɛ a ngɛ lɛ gblae.

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: E he nɔ ke, “Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ngɛ je kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; je ɔ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ a je kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Ta zugba lɛ ɔ nɛ okpɔngɔ yumu ɔmɛ ngɛ gblae ɔ yaa omleyi je, nɛ ta zugba lɛ nɛ okpɔngɔ hiɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ gblae ɔ yaa bonyoku je, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ okpɔngɔ huatahuata amɛ ngɛ gblae ɔ yaa zugba nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, “Start patrolling the earth.” When they had gone on their way,
translation_verse: Benɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ma a, e sɔɛ ha mɛ kulaa kaa a ma ya slaa je ɔ mi. Bɔfo ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya slaa je ɔ mi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya slaa je ɔ mi.

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, bɔfo ɔ de mi kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ya slaa omleyi je ɔ ha Yawɛ abofu ɔ nya ba si.” Yawɛ fa ke á bu Yoshua matsɛ pɛɛ

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yawɛ ha mi sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah have returned from Babylonia. Collect enough silver and gold from them to make a crown. Then go with them to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah and put the crown on the head of the high priest Joshua son of Jehozadak.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu nɛ a kɛ ba ke ɔ kɛ pee matsɛ pɛɛ, nɛ o kɛ bu Yehozadak bi Yoshua, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a.

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e maa ma Yawɛ we ɔ. Osɔfo ko maa piɛ e he kɛ tsu ní ɔ. Tue mi jɔmi maa hi a kpɛti, nɛ a maa nu a sibi sisi saminya.’

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: A kɛ matsɛ pɛɛ nɛ ɔ maa to Yawɛ we ɔ mi kɛ kai Heldai, Tobiya, Yedaya, kɛ Zefania bi Yosia tsuo.”

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ se lokoo maa ba nɛ a ba piɛ nyɛ he kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ nɛ tsɔ mi nyɛ ngɔ. Ke nyɛ maa bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue anɔkuale mi ɔ, lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi.

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Matsɛ Darius yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ nɛɛne nɛ a tsɛɛ Kislev ɔ we ligbi eywiɛne ɔ, Yawɛ ha mi sɛ gbi ko.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, á bi osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ munyu ke, “Jeha babauu nɛ be ɔ, kɔmɔ nɛ wa yeɔ nɛ wa haa hwɔ nyɔhiɔ enuɔne ɔ, anɛ waa ya nɔ waa hi pee kpamisa lo?”

english_verse: It was then that the Lord All-Powerful told me to say to everyone in the country, including the priests: For
translation_verse: “Bi ni ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ke, nɛ a ha hwɔ daa nyɔhiɔ enuɔne ɔ, kɛ kpaanyɔne ɔ jeha nyingmi kpaago ɔ, imi a ha hwɔ ha lo?

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu ji sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ha kɛ gu gbali nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ a nɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yerusalem na ní kpɔtɔɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi babauu ngɛ Yerusalem ma a mi; nɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle ma a, kɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ leneyi je, kɛ yo ɔmɛ a kuɔ si ɔ tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ nimli. Tue gbomi ha a nuu ni ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se ya

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: “Blema lokoo ɔ, i wo ye ma a mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane; nyɛ mi mi nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ na nyɛ sibi mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: Yalɔyihi, awusahi, nibwɔhi, kɛ nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko wa mɛ yi mi. Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ko to nyɛ sibi a he ga yaya.’

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: A kplii a tsui konɛ a ko nu mlaahi, kɛ níhi nɛ i ha gbali ɔmɛ nɛ sɛ a hlami ɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, ye mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ ke i de nɔ́ ko nɛ a bui tue he je ɔ, ke a fa kue ɔ, i he we nɔ.

english_verse: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.
translation_verse: I gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je mahi nɛ a li nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ lasiogblee lɛ muɔ mɛ; nɛ a si zugba a ngɔ fɔ si, nɛ nɔ ko bi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ ɔ ba pee ma doku.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me:
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ha Zakaria sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ke,

english_verse: I love Zion so much that her enemies make me angry.
translation_verse: “I suɔ Zion sane wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Ye suɔmi ɔ ha ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe ngɛ e he.

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Ma kpale kɛ ba Zion, nɛ ma ba hi Yerusalem. Jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma tsɛ ma a ke ma nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale; nɛ a ma tsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ yo ɔ ke yo klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Very old people with walking sticks will once again sit around in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Nimowi, kɛ yimowi nɛ bwɔ kotokoto kɛ a dɛ mi dɛma tso maa hi gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: while boys and girls play in the streets.
translation_verse: Nɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo ma hyi tɔ kɛ nyumuwi, kɛ yiwi nɛ ngɛ fiɛe!

english_verse: This may seem impossible for my people who are left, but it isn't impossible for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Ke e he maa wa ha nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi be nɛ ɔ mi kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ ma nyɛ ba ma a mi ɔ, anɛ imi hu e he maa wa ha mi lo?

english_verse: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west,
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke ma ya kpɔ ye ma a kɛ je beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je ma amɛ a mi.

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: Ma ya kpale mɛ kɛ ba Yerusalem, nɛ a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu. Ma ye mɛ anɔkuale, nɛ ma pee nɔ́ nɛ da.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Munyuhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tu nyɛ benɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye we ɔ sisi tomi ɔ fiae ekohu ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ wlua nyɛ kɛ tsu ní ɔ.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, i kɛ mɛ be ní toe hu kaa sa a. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Ma ha tue mi jɔmi maa ba zugba a tsuo nɔ. Hiɔmi maa nɛ; zugba a maa ba ní, nɛ wai tso ɔmɛ maa wo yiblii. Ma ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ha nihi nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yuda bi, kɛ Israel bi, sa a, nyɛ ngɛ kaa gbiɛmi kɛ ha je ma amɛ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami, nɛ nyɛ maa pee gbaami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ wlua nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ ko ye gbeye!”

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kpakpa nɛ i to kaa ma pee ekohu ji kaa ma gbaa Yerusalem kɛ Yuda tsuo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye.

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ pee ji nɛ ɔmɛ: nyɛɛ ye nyɛ sibi anɔkuale; nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi kpakpa nɛ ye dami sane ngɛ nyɛ kojomi he ɔmɛ, konɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba.

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko so nyɛ sibi a yi nɔ. Nyɛ ko kã lakpa kita. I nyɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ. Yawɛ lɛ de.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ha Zakaria sɛ gbi ekohu ke,

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: “Nyɔhiɔ eywiɛne, enuɔne, kpaagone, kɛ nyɔngmane ɔ nɛ nyɛ haa hwɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ, a ma ba pee bua jɔmi, ní yemi kɛ nyami be ha Yuda ma a. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ suɔ anɔkuale, kɛ tue mi jɔmi.”

english_verse: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Be ma nɛ nihi maa je ma slɔɔtohi babauu a mi kɛ ba.

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: Ma kake mi bi ma ya na ma kpa mi bi nɛ a ma de mɛ ke, ‘Wa yaa nɛ wa ya ja Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ. Wa yaa nɛ wa ya kpa lɛ pɛɛ nɛ e gbaa wɔ. Nyɛɛ ba nɛ waa ho!’

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Nihi babauu maa je ma nguanguahi a mi kɛ ba Yerusalem ba ja Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e gbaa mɛ.

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, nibwɔhi maa je ma slɔɔtohi a mi kɛ ba Yuda; ni nyɔngma ma ba nu Yuda no kake nɛ a maa pɛtɛ e tade he, nɛ a ma de lɛ ke, ‘Waa kɛ mo maa ya, ejakaa wa nu kaa Mawu kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.’ ”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord: His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.
translation_verse: Yawɛ sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yawɛ ke a maa gbla Hadrak zugba a, kɛ Damasko ma a a tue, ejakaa tsa pi Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ pɛ ji Yawɛ níhi; mohu ɔ, Syria matsɛ ma a hu e nɔ́.

english_verse: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃ a maa pee Hamat nɛ e kɛ Hadrak wo huzu ɔ. Tiro kɛ Sidon ma amɛ nɛ le ní kaa nɔ́ ko ɔ, mɛ hu ja nɔuu.

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Tiro fia gbogbo kɛ wo e he kulaa kɛ kpe; e bua sika hiɔ nya glekugleku kaa zu, nɛ e sika tsu hu hiɛ kaa kuku nɔ dwɔmi.

english_verse: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.
translation_verse: Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma kpɔ ní tsuo nɛ Tiro na a ngɛ e dɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma sake ní nɛ e na kpɔtɔɔ ɔ ngɔ pue wo mi, nɛ la maa sã ma a.

english_verse: Both Ashkelon and Gaza will tremble with fear; Ekron will lose all hope. Gaza's king will be killed, and Ashkelon emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Ashkelon maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa ye gbeye. Gaza hu maa na, nɛ e ma kokloo si. Ekron hu ja nɔuu, ejakaa e hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo ta. Gaza matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ Ashkelon maa pee ma doku.

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Nimli tsakatsaka ma ba hi Ashdod ma a mi, nɛ Filistia he nɔ womi ɔ se maa po.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi, kɛ ní hiemi ní kpahi ɔ, ma ha nɛ a kpa yemi. Nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ ma ba pee ye we bi kaa Yuda we puɔ nya amɛ eko. Ma ha Ekron bi ma ba pee ye we bi kaa bɔ nɛ Yebus ba pee ɔ.

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: Ma bu ye zugba a he nɛ nɔ ko kó ba tua mɛ. I be yiwutsotsɛmɛ blɔ ngmɛe hu nɛ a ba ye ye ma a nɔ. Imi nitsɛ i ngɛ hyɛe kɛ ye hɛngmɛ paa. Matsɛ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: Zion, nyá oo, nyá! Yerusalem, mo he ose! Hyɛ, o matsɛ ɔ ma! E ma kɛ agbo jemi kɛ kunimi yemi. E ba e he si, nɛ e hi teji okpɔngɔ nɔ; ee, e hi teji okpɔngɔ bi nɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Ma jé ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel, nɛ ta okpɔngɔhi be Yerusalem hie hu. Kɛ̃ɛ̃hi nɛ a kɛ hwuɔ ta a, ma ku a mi. O matsɛ ɔ ma ha tue mi jɔmi maa ba je ma amɛ a kpɛti. E maa ye tsɛ kɛ maa je wo kpo kɛ yaa su wo kpo; e maa ye tsɛ kɛ maa je Yufrate pa a nya kɛ yaa su zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ tɔɔ.” Mawu ma ha e ma a maa da si ekohu

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Moo lɛɛ i ngɔ muɔ kɛ sã bɔ kɛ ma somi nɛ i kɛ mo so ɔ nɔ mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o bimɛ nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, ma jé mɛ kɛ je ma se he nɛ ngɛ kaa vu nɛ nyu be mi ɔ kɛ ba we.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: Yuda maa pee kaa ta bulɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃, nɛ Israel maa pee kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi. Zion bi maa pee kaa ye dɛ mi klaate nɛ i kɛ ma jé ta kɛ wo Hela bi.

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ma kple a nɔ; e ma tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ kaa oslabai nɛ ngɛ gbae. Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ma ha titimati maa pɛ, nɛ e maa nyɛɛ ngɛ lasiogblee mi kɛ maa je leneyi je kɛ ba.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa bu e ma a he, a maa naa amlami fɔli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi. Muɔ ma pue si kaa wai nɛ hyi kplu. A ma pue a he nyɛli a muɔ si basaa kaa bɔ nɛ a kpaa muɔ kɛ pueɔ bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ ma he a yi wami, ejakaa e tohi ji mɛ. E ma a ma kpɛ́ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ june kpɛɔ ngɛ matsɛ pɛɛ he ɔ.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: E dɛ mi nɛ kpakpa kɛ afɛu tsuo je; nihewi a blɛfo maa ba saminya; yihewi maa nga wai he bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma plɔke.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ fa kue ha Yawɛ, konɛ e ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛ gbo kɛ gbiɛ. Ejakaa Yawɛ lɛ haa bɔku hiaa ngɛ ahumi mi; lɛ nɛ e haa hiɔmi nɛɛɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngmɔ baa ní.

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Amaga amɛ de we nɔ́ ko nɛ juɛmi ngɛ mi; klaali ɔmɛ lɛɛ lakpa munyuhi sɔuu a tuɔ. Ni komɛ hu tsɔɔ nlamihi a sisi, nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nyɛ kɛ woɔ nyɛ bua kɛkɛ. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ ma a tsuo ngɛ lalaalo woe kaa tohi, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ nae, ejakaa a be hyɛlɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Hyɛ, ye mi mi fu to hyɛli ɔmɛ saminya; ma gbla ma nimeli ɔmɛ a tue kokooko. Yuda a, ye ma ji mɛ, nɛ imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ nitsɛ ma hyɛ a nɔ. Ma ha a he maa wa saminya kaa ta okpɔngɔ.

english_verse: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.
translation_verse: A ti ni komɛ maa pee kɔ nya tɛ; ni komɛ maa pee bo tsu plɛɛko, ni komɛ maa pee ta hwumi kɛ̃ɛ̃, nɛ ni komɛ hu maa pee asafoatsɛnguahi.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: “Ma wo Yuda ma a he wami; ma he Yosef we ɔ yi wami. Ma na mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ ma kpale mɛ tsuo kɛ ba we ekohu. A maa pee kaa nihi nɛ i kua we mɛ hyɛ. Imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ; ma he a kue fami ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel bi a he maa wa kaa ta buli, a bua maa jɔ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ wai nue. A nina maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma nya nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i pee ha mɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: “Ma kpee ye ma a; nɛ ma bua mɛ tsuo a nya; ejakaa imi nɛ i kpɔ mɛ. Ma he a yi wami, nɛ ma ha a he maa hiɛ babauu kaa bɔ nɛ a he hiɛ sa a.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: Ma kpale mɛ kɛ maa je Egipt, nɛ ma bua a nya kɛ maa je Asiria kɛ ba we, nɛ a ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ; Gilead kɛ ya pue Lebanon zugba amɛ tsuo po be mɛ kpe.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: Ke haomi yi bli kaa wo ɔ, imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma jɔɔ oslɔke ɔmɛ a he ha mɛ. Nilo pa a tete, nyu maa ta mi. Asiria, he nɔ wolɔ ɔ, ma ba lɛ si, nɛ Egipt tsɛ yemi ɔ hu se maa po.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ma ha ye ma a he wami he; nɛ a maa nyɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: Lebanon, bli o sinya amɛ, konɛ la nɛ sã o seda tso ɔmɛ!

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Nyɛ sɛsɛo tsohi, nyɛ nya awe, ejakaa seda tso ɔmɛ nɔɔ si; a kpata jamɛ a tso kpakpa amɛ a hɛ mi! Nyɛ Bashan tso nguahi, nyɛ nya awe, ejakaa a gba hue kusuu ɔ ngɔ pue si.

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu tue! To hyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ awe nyae, ejakaa a hɛ mi nyami ɔ ta. Jata amɛ ngɛ huãe, ejakaa a kpata hue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a nya a hɛ mi. To hyɛli enyɔ ɔmɛ

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Totsɛmɛ ɔmɛ juaa to ɔmɛ, nɛ a deɔ ke, ‘Wa ná ní. Nyɛ ha wa je Yawɛ yi.’ Nihi nɛ heɔ to ɔmɛ ɔ, ya gbee mɛ nɛ nɔ ko gbla we a tue. To hyɛli ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ, to ɔmɛ a he mɔbɔ ko kulaa pee we mɛ.”

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “I be nɔ ko nɔ ko mɔbɔ nae hu ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Imi nitsɛ ma ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa sɛ e nyɛmi kpá mi. Ee, a maa sɛ matsɛ ɔ kpá mi. A ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko he be mi jee.”

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: To je juali ɔmɛ bɔ mi apaa, nɛ i hyɛ to kuu ɔ nɛ a yaa gbe ɔ nɔ. I ngɔ dɛma tso enyɔ. I wo kake biɛ ke “Dloomi”, nɛ i tsɛ enyɔne ɔ “Kakepeemi”. Nɛ i hyɛ to ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Nyɔhiɔ kake mi ɔ, to hyɛli etɛ komɛ nɛ sume mi ɔ, i ngmɛɛ a he, ejakaa a sane ba gbe ye nya.

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i de to kuu ɔ ke, “Jehanɛ, i be nyɛ nɔ hyɛe hu. Nyɛ ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma gbo ɔ, a gbo. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata a, a hɛ mi nɛ kpata. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, a tsɔtslɔɔ a sibi a mi.”

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i ngɔ dɛma tso nɛ biɛ ji “Dloomi” ɔ, nɛ i ku mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa somi nɛ i kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo so ɔ, a po mi.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: A po somi ɔ mi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, nɛ to je juali ɔmɛ nɛ na nɔ́ nɛ i pee ɔ yɔse kaa Yawɛ sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I told them, “Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it.” So they handed me my wages, a measly
translation_verse: Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa fia sika a ngɔ pue nito he ɔ.” Nɛ i pee ja. Blɔɔ sika nɛ a susu kaa e maa sa mi ji sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, dɛma tso enyɔne ɔ nɛ biɛ ji “Kakepeemi” ɔ, i ku mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Yuda kɛ Israel pi nyɛmimɛ hu.

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ngɔɔ o he ngɔ pee kaa to hyɛlɔ nɛ he be se nami.

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa i ngɛ to hyɛlɔ ko tsɔe kɛ ma zugba a nɔ. Tohi nɛ a hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e kpata a, a nɔ́ pee we lɛ kɔmɔ. Ní nɛmɛ nɛ laa a, e be a se blɔ hlae. Hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu e be mɛ tsae; nɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ hu, e be mɛ ní hae; mohu ɔ, e maa ye ní nɛmɛ nɛ wo zɔ ɔ, nɛ e ma kpɔ a nane kokloto tete.

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ nɛ kɔɔ Israel he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba; lɛ nɛ ha nɔmlɔ adesa wami. Yawɛ ke,

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: “Hyɛ, ma ha Yerusalem maa pee kaa kplu kɛ e mi duɔ ha je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ. Ke he nyɛli ba sá Yerusalem yi ɔ, a ma sá Yuda zugba a hu yi ja nɔuu.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha Yerusalem maa pee tɛ nɛ jiɔ ha je ma amɛ tsuo. Ma tsuaa ma nɛ ma wo tɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e maa ye e he awi. Je ma amɛ tsuo ma bla, nɛ a maa te si kɛ wo Yerusalem.

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha gbeye maa nu okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ maa nu godo. Ma bu Yuda ma a he, se a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ ma ha a hɛ ma yu.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yuda we puɔ nya amɛ ma de a he ke, ‘Nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ woɔ mɛ he wami.’

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: “Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha Yuda we puɔ nya amɛ maa pee kaa buɛ kɛ e he la gegeege nɛ a to lɛ́ ngɔ wo sisi, loo kaa blɛfo nɛ a kpɔ, nɛ a bua nya pue jatɛ kɛ e nya la nɔ. Je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata, se Yerusalem lɛɛ e maa ma e ma he ɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: “Imi Yawɛ, ma ha Yuda bo tsu ɔmɛ maa ye kunimi kekle, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ David nina a, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ ma ná a kó pe Yuda nɔ́ ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Ma bu nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem jamɛ a be ɔ a he. A ti nɔ wudɔwudɔ pe kulaa po maa pee kaa David. David nina maa nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kaa Yawɛ bɔfo, loo imi Mawu nitsɛ.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, je ma tsuaa je ma nɛ maa te si kɛ si Yerusalem ɔ, ma kpata e hɛ mi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: “David nina, kɛ ni kpahi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, ma ngɔ mumi nɛ naa mɔbɔ, kɛ mumi nɛ faa kue ngɔ wo a mi tɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke a na nɔ nɛ a gbɔ lɛ nɔ́ ɔ, a maa nyɛ ya ha lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a nyɛɛ ya ha bi kake too. A ma nya awe kaa nihi nyaa awe ha a bitɛte.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, a maa nyɛ ya wawɛɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ha Hadadrimon ngɛ Magido nga a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha amaga amɛ a biɛ maa laa pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mɛ kaie hu ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Ma je gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ kɛ je zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se, ke nɔ ko maa te si ke gbalɔ ji lɛ ɔ, e nyɛ kɛ e tsɛ nɛ fɔ lɛ ma de lɛ ke, ‘Ja a gbe mo; ejakaa o ngɔ Mawu biɛ kɛ ngɛ lakpa yee.’ Ke e ya nɔ ngɛ gbae ɔ, e nyɛ kɛ e tsɛ nɛ fɔ lɛ ɔ maa fia lɛ nɔ nɛ a gbe.

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ma bi lɛ ke, ‘Mɛni pa dokuhi ngɛ o gugue mi nɛ ɔ?’ e ma he nɔ ke, ‘Ye huɛ ko we mi nɛ i ya ná kɛ je.’ ” A fa ke a gbe Mawu to hyɛlɔ ɔ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Klaate, tee si ngɔ wo ye huɛ to hyɛlɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ha mi ɔ! Moo fia lɛ nɔ konɛ to ɔmɛ nɛ a gbɛ fĩa. I kɛ tsɔwitsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ maa to ní.

english_verse: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.
translation_verse: A maa gbe zugba a tsuo nɔ bi mi dlami etɛ mi enyɔ nɛ a gbo, nɛ e maa piɛ mi dlami etɛ mi kake.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake nɛ ɔ kɛ wo la mi, nɛ ma tsu a he kaa bɔ nɛ a tsuɔ sika hiɔ he ɔ. Ma tsu a he kaa bɔ nɛ a tsuɔ sika tsu he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa fa kue ma tsɛ mi, nɛ ma he nɔ. Ma de mɛ ke, ‘Ye ma ji nyɛ,’ nɛ a ma de ke, ‘Yawɛ ji wa Mawu.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, be ko ma ha Yawɛ! Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ níhi nɛ a ha a, a maa dla ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi paa.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yawɛ kɛ je ma amɛ maa to ní kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ ngɛ ta nga nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yawɛ maa da si ngɛ Oliv yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yerusalem beleku je. Kɛkɛ ɔ, kɔ̃ agbo ko ma gba Oliv yo ɔ mi enyɔ kɛ maa je beleku je kɛ yaa si bonyoku je. Yo ɔ kasa fa ma ya je omleyi je, nɛ kasa fa hu ma ya je leneyi je.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ maa gu kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ gba yo ɔ mi enyɔ ɔ mi, ejakaa kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ gba Yawɛ yo ɔ mi enyɔ ɔ ma ya su Azal tɔɔ. Nyɛ maa tu fo kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee blema ngɛ Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ, benɛ zugba mimiɛ ɔ. Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ maa ba kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, fĩɛ nɛ nya wa

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyu nɛ haa wami maa je Yerusalem kɛ be; fa ma ya sɛ Ngo wo ɔ mi, nɛ fa hu ma ya sɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ mi. Nyu ɔ maa hi bee daa, sapu, kɛ hiɔmi nɛmi be mi tsuo.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yawɛ maa ye tsɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma ja Mawu kake too ɔ, nɛ e biɛ pɛ a ma tsɛ.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ma je ta kɛ wo Yerusalem ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ maa pee mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: be mi nɛ a ngɛ a nane nya a, a he lo ma pɔtɔ; a hɛngmɛ ma pɔtɔ ngɛ to puɔ mi, nɛ a lilɛ ma pɔtɔ ngɛ a nya mi.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Mahi tsuo nɛ te si kɛ wo Yerusalem ɔ, a mi nihi nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, daa jeha a, a maa ya Yerusalem nɛ a ya ja Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kaa matsɛ, nɛ a maa ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Je ma ko nɛ be yae nɛ a ya ja Yawɛ Tahohiatsɛ ɔ kaa lɛ ji matsɛ ɔ, hiɔmi be nɛe ha mɛ.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Egipt bi, kɛ je ma kpahi tsuo nɛ ma kua ke a be yae nɛ a ya ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ, bɔ nɛ a maa gbla mɛ tsuo a tue ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Buɛhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, kɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ maa pee klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ ma ba sã bɔ ɔ, ma ba ngɔ buɛ nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa hoo lohwe nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ɔ ngɛ mi. Jamɛ a be ɔ, jua yelɔ ko jua yelɔ ko be Yawɛ, Tabohiatsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi hie hu.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ha Malaki, nɛ e ya de Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yawɛ suɔ Israel

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I suɔ nyɛ sane saminya.” Se a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni lɛ o peeɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa o suɔ wɔ?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Anɛ Esau kɛ Yakob ɔ, pi nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ lo? Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i je suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Yakob kɛ e nina,

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: nɛ Esau kɛ e nina lɛɛ i nyɛ mɛ. I kpata Esau yo nɔ zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ i ngɔ e weto ní ɔ kɛ ha nga mi gbehi.”

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Ke Esau nina Edom bi ma de ke, “A ywia wa ma amɛ lɛɛ, se wa maa ma mɛ ekohu” ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma he nɔ ke, “Ha nɛ a dla nɛ a ma; ke a ma a, ma ku ngɔ pue si ekohu kɛ yaa si a maa wo mɛ biɛ ke ‘Zugba nɛ a peeɔ yi wu tso ní ngɛ nɔ, kɛ ma nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu mɛ kɛ yaa neneene.’ ”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Bi buu e tsɛ, nɛ tsɔlɔ hu buu e nyɔmtsɛ. Ke tsɛ ji mi ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ bui mi mɔ? Nɛ ke nyɔmtsɛ ji mi ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ yi mi gbeye? Nyɛ gbeɔ ye he guɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ biɔ ke, ‘Kɛ wa plɛ kɛ gbe o he guɛ kɛɛ?’

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ pee ji kaa nyɛ ngɔ niye ní nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ ba ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. Nɛ nyɛ biɔ mi ke, ‘Mɛni be wa pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?’ Ma de nyɛ! Nyɛ ble ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ osɔfohi, nyɛɛ ka kaa nyɛ maa fa kue ha Mawu, konɛ e na wɔ mɔbɔ. Ke nyɛ hɛɛ nike ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ba a, anɛ Mawu maa bu nyɛ kue fami ɔ tue lo?

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “I ná nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko ya nga ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko ya slɛ la ngɛ ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ yaka gu hu. I be nyɛ he bua jɔmi; nyɛ nike ní ɔmɛ hu, i be ngɔe.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ deɔ ke ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he be se nami ko. Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ngɔɔ niye ní nɛ a hiee kɛ ba sãã bɔ ngɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Mɛni haomi po ji nɛ ɔ!’ Nɛ nyɛ gbeɔ ye he guɛ. Lohwe nɛ nyɛ kɛ ba sãã bɔ ha mi ji lohwe jujui, loo akpaketsɛ, loo hiɔtsɛ. Anɛ ma he bɔhi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ lo?

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ to ku ngɛ e to tsu mi, nɛ e wo si ke e kɛ lɔ ɔ maa sã bɔ ha mi, se mohu e ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ kpa ngɛ he kɛ ba a, musu tloo kikɛmɛ a sisilɔ nɛ ɔ! Ejakaa matsɛ nguaa ji mi, nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo yeɔ mi gbeye.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ji kaa

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da nɛ nyɛ kɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami. Ke nyɛ bui nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue ɔ, ma gbiɛ nyɛ; nɛ gbaami nɛ i ko gbaa nyɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee tue gblami mohu. Niinɛ, i gbiɛ nyɛ momo, ejakaa nyɛ yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: Ma gbla nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a tue. Lohwehi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ba sãã bɔ ha mi ɔ, ma ngɔ a fĩ kɛ kpa nyɛ hɛ mi. Nɛ a maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya pue kuku nɔ.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: “I wo mɛ si ke ma ha mɛ wami, kɛ tue mi jɔmi, nɛ i pee ja konɛ a bu mi. Niinɛ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a buu mi, nɛ a yeɔ mi gbeye.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: A tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ ji anɔkuale ɔ, se pi nɔ́ nɛ dɛ. A kɛ mi hi si saminya. Pi kaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kɛkɛ, se a ha nɛ nihi babauu hu kpa yayami peemi.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: E sa kaa osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ ma a ní, nɛ a le Mawu anɔkuale mi. E sa kaa ma a nɛ ya a ngɔ nɛ a ya kase ye suɔmi nya ní. Ejakaa imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, ye tsɔli ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: “Se, nyɛ osɔfohi! Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ gba kɛ je blɔ nɛ da a nɔ. Nyɛ ní tsɔɔmi ɔ ha nɛ nihi fuu a nane kpata. Somi ɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, nyɛ yi nɔ.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi hu ma ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa hie nyɛ, ejakaa nyɛ pee we ye suɔmi nya ní; mlaa a hu, nihi a hɛ mi lɛ nyɛ hyɛɛ kɛ tsɔɔ.” Ma a yi Mawu anɔkuale

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Anɛ pi tsɛ kake too nɛ wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ lo? Anɛ pi Mawu kake too ɔ nɛ bɔ wɔ tsuo lo? Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ wa yi wa nyɛmimɛ anɔkuale ɔ? Somi ɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ, mɛni he je wa yi nɔ ɔ?

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Si nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ wo Mawu ɔ, a yi nɔ; mohu ɔ, a tsu musu ní ngɛ Yerusalem, kɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ. A ble Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ e suɔ saminya a. Nyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ yihi nɛ jaa ma se mawuhi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ nɛ je lɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. A ko ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ hɛ mi hu gblegbleegble.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ kake hu nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ji kaa nyɛ nyaa awe, nyɛ woɔ yana, nɛ nyɛ foɔ vo nyu kɛ pueɔ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ; ejakaa nike ní nɛ nyɛ kɛ baa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, e he we hu.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Nyɛ biɔ ke, “Mɛni he je Yawɛ he we wa nike ní ɔmɛ ngɛ wa dɛ hu?” Ɛ̃ɛ̃, ma tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ he je! Yawɛ le kaa si ko nɛ o wo o nihe mi yo kpeekpee ɔ, o yi nɔ hu. Yo nɛ o wo si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ke o kɛ lɛ maa hi si saminya a, o yi lɛ anɔkuale.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: O kɛ o yo ɔ, anɛ Mawu pee we nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kake lo? Mɛni he je lɛ Mawu pee ja a? Mawu pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ fɔ bimɛ nɛ ma ba pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, si nɛ nyɛ wo nyɛ nihe mi yi kpeekpee ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó je se kɛ ya pee nɔ́ kpa.

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ munyu babauu ɔ woɔ Yawɛ pɔtɔ. Se nyɛ biɔ ke, “Kɛ wa peeɔ kɛ woɔ lɛ pɔtɔ kɛɛ?” Ɛ̃ɛ̃, bɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ji kaa nyɛ deɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e hi, nɛ Yawɛ suɔ lɛ.” Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ biɔ ke, “Jije Mawu nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ ngɛ?”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Ma tsɔ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e ma ya dla blɔ ngɔ to mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ maa ba e we ɔ tlukaa. Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ nyɛ hla kaa nyɛ maa na a maa ba, nɛ e ma ba fiɛ ye somi ɔ.”

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Se, ligbi ɔ nɛ e maa ba a, mɛnɔ lɛ ma nyɛ maa da si? Ligbi ɔ nɛ e ma ba hia si ɔ, mɛnɔ yi ma na wami? E maa ba kaa jale nɛ nya wa, aloo la nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ dade he.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: Nike ní nɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ma ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, ja jã loko nike ní ɔ maa sa e hɛ mi kaa sa a.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Ma ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ma ba kojo, nɛ ma gbla nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tue amlɔ: kunya yeli, gba puɛli, lakpa odase yeli, nihi nɛ sisiɔ ní tsuli nɛ a wui mɛ hiɔ susui, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ waa yalɔyihi, awusahi, kɛ nibwɔhi yi mi. Ee, ma gbla nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui mi ɔ tue.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de. Mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka hami

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: “Imi ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ; i tsakee we. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ nyɛ, Yakob nina a, nyɛ hɛ mi kpataa we lolo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ ngmɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ a he kɛ fɔ si, nɛ nyɛ yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa nyɛ. Se nyɛ biɔ ke, ‘Kɛ wa maa pee kɛ kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ kɛɛ?’

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: I ngɛ bie ke, Mawu ɔ, anɛ nɔmlɔ sisiɔ lɛ lo? Dɛbi! Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi sisie. Nyɛ biɔ mi ke, ‘Kɛ wa plɛ kɛ ngɛ mo sisie kɛɛ?’ Mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka, kɛ nike ní nɛ ma a ba haa mi ɔ, nyɛ sisiɔ mi ngɛ mi.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Gbiɛmi ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nɔ, ejakaa ma a tsuo ngɛ mi sisie.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
