translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ tsuo kɛ ba nito he ɔ, konɛ niye ní nɛ hiɛ ngɛ ye we ɔ. Nyɛɛ ka mi nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa i be hiɔwe saflɛhi blie nɛ ma ha nɛ ní kpakpa babauu maa nɛ ngɔ pue nyɛ nɔ babaaba kaa hiɔmi lo?

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo maa na kaa a gbaa nyɛ niinɛ, ejakaa zugba a tsuo maa pee kɛ bua jɔmi sɔuu.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de. Mawu wo si ke e maa na mɔbɔ

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ tuɔ munyuhi nɛ a he wa kɛ siɔ mi. Se nyɛ biɔ ke, ‘Kɛ wa plɛ kɛ tu munyu kɛ si mo kɛɛ?’

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: Ɛ̃ɛ̃, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Mawu jami he be se nami; ke wa ye Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ wa pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa nihi nɛ a he yayami ngɛ mɛ dɔe ɔ, mɛni se wa ma na?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa naa paa kaa he woli ji nihi nɛ a gbaa mɛ saminya; yayami peeli ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ plɔkee ngɛ je mi; a kaa Mawu, se nɔ́ ko pee we mɛ.’ ”

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ kɛ a sibi tu munyu, nɛ Yawɛ bu tue nɛ e nu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ. Ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ, a ngma nihi tsuo nɛ a yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ a buɔ lɛ ɔ a biɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ke, “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee imi nitsɛ ye ma. Ligbi ɔ nɛ ma tsu ní ɔ, a maa pee ye nihi pɔtɛɛ. Ma na mɛ mɔbɔ kaa tsɛ naa lɛ nitsɛ e bi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ye ma a maa na slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ dalɔ kɛ yayami peelɔ a kpɛti; nyɛ maa na slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ sɔmɔɔ mi, kɛ nɔ nɛ sɔmɔ we mi ɔ a kpɛti.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: The day of judgment is certain to come. And it will be like a red-hot furnace with flames that burn up proud and sinful people, as though they were straw. Not a branch or a root will be left. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Be ma nɛ he woli, kɛ yayami peeli tsuo maa sã kaa bɔ nɛ nga sãã ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, a maa sã pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a he nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be piɛe.

english_verse: When I come to bring justice, you will trample those who are evil, as though they were ashes under your feet. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ligbi ɔ nɛ ma tsu ní nɛ ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ maa pee kaa la zu ngɛ nyɛ nane sisi, nɛ nyɛ maa naa a nɔ.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: Don't ever forget the laws and teachings I gave my servant Moses on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Mlaa slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ kɛ gu ye tsɔlɔ Mose nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kai nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to send the prophet Elijah before that great and terrible day comes.
translation_verse: “Se loko Yawɛ ligbi nguaa a nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ maa su ɔ, ma tsɔ gbalɔ Eliya kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: “Hyɛ, yiheyo ko ma na muklii, nɛ e ma fɔ binyumu; a ma tsɛ lɛ ke Yimanuel” nɛ sisi ji, “Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ.”

english_verse: From David to the time of the exile in Babylonia, the ancestors of Jesus were: David, Solomon , Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram; Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, Josiah, and Jehoiachin and his brothers.
translation_verse: Yosia fɔ Yehoyakin, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, be mi nɛ a ba ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Babilon ya a.

english_verse: more to the birth of the Messiah. The Birth of Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Azor fɔ Zadok, nɛ Zadok fɔ Akim, nɛ Akim fɔ Eliud.

english_verse: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo fɔmi ɔ ba ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yosef ya bi Yesu nyɛ Maria si, se e na we nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba hi si lolo nɛ a na kaa Maria hɛɛ hɔ kɛ je Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: E huno Yosef ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da ji lɛ, nɛ e hla we kaa e ma pue Maria hɛ mi si. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e to kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e he kpoo.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Yosef ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he susue ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ nlami mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yosef, David nina, koo ye gbeye kaa o kɛ Maria maa hi si kaa o yo; hɔ nɛ e hɛɛ nɛ ɔ je Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi.

english_verse: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
translation_verse: E ma fɔ binyumu, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Yesu, ejakaa e ma he e ma a yi wami kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ a mi.”

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: A pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de kɛ gu gbalɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ ba mi. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke,

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Yosef hɛ tsɛ̃ kɛ je mahe ɔ mi ɔ, e pee bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ e yo ɔ.

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: Se e kɛ lɛ na we nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi hluu kɛ ya su be nɛ Maria fɔ binyumu. Nɛ Yosef wo lɛ biɛ ke Yesu.

english_verse: When Jesus was born in the village of Bethlehem in Judea, Herod was king. During this time some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Benɛ a fɔ Yesu ngɛ Betlehem nɛ ngɛ Yudea, ngɛ Matsɛ Herode yi nɔ ɔ, ní leli komɛ je beleku kɛ ba Yerusalem ba bi ke,

english_verse: and said, “Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.”
translation_verse: “Bimwɔyo ɔ nɛ a fɔ nɛ e ba ye Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nɔ matsɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ? Wa na e dodoe ngɛ beleku, nɛ wa ba, konɛ wa ba ja lɛ.”

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Benɛ Matsɛ Herode nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e hao, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem hu hao ja nɔuu.

english_verse: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, “Where will the Messiah be born?”
translation_verse: E tsɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli tsuo nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ kpe, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Jije a ma fɔ Kristo ɔ ngɛ?”

english_verse: They told him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote,
translation_verse: A he nɔ ke, “Ngɛ Betlehem nɛ ngɛ Yudea a. Ejakaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: ‘Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel.’ ”
translation_verse: ‘Mo Betlehem ma, ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ, mo ji ma nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a kpɛti; se o mi lɛ matsɛ maa je kɛ ba ye ye ma Israel ɔ nɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Herode tsɛ ní leli ɔmɛ zaa, nɛ e bi mɛ fitsofitso be mi nɛ dodoe ɔ je.

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho Betlehem ya kɛ sɛ gbi ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya hla bimwɔyo ɔ fitsofitso. Ke nyɛ na lɛ ɔ, nyɛ ba de mi, konɛ imi hu ma ya nɛ ma ya ja lɛ.”

english_verse: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
translation_verse: Benɛ a nu matsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho. Nɛ ɛ dodoe ɔ nɛ a na ngɛ beleku ɔ nyɛɛ a hɛ mi hluu kɛ ya si dodoe ɔ ya da he nɛ bimwɔyo ɔ ngɛ ɔ yi mi.

english_verse: They were thrilled and excited to see the star.
translation_verse: Benɛ a na dodoe ɔ, a na bua jɔmi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: When the men went into the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother, they knelt down and worshiped him. They took out their gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh and gave them to him.
translation_verse: A sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ a na bimwɔyo ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ Maria a, a kpla si nɛ a ja bimwɔyo ɔ. A pɛne a kotoku ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a ke lɛ ní: sika tsu, mimɛ, kɛ mire.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ nlami mi ke a ko kpale a se kɛ ya Herode ngɔ hu he je ɔ, a gu blɔ kpa kɛ ho a ma mi ya. A kɛ bimwɔyo ɔ tu fo kɛ ya Egipt

english_verse: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.”
translation_verse: Benɛ ní leli ɔmɛ je ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko je e he kpo tsɔɔ Yosef ngɛ nlami mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Herode ma ba hla bimwɔyo ɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tee si! Ngɔɔ bimwɔyo ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ tu fo kɛ ya Egipt. Nyɛ ya hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma to mo.”

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Yosef te si, nɛ e ngɔ bimwɔyo ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ nyɔ mi kɛ ho Egipt ya

english_verse: where they stayed until Herod died. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “I called my son out of Egypt.” The Killing of the Children
translation_verse: ya hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ Herode gbo. A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de kɛ gu gbalɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ ba mi ke, “Egipt nɛ i tsɛ ye bi ɔ kɛ je.” A gbe Betlehem jokuɛwi

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Benɛ Herode na kaa ní leli ɔmɛ sisi lɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu wawɛɛ. E tsɔ nɛ a ya gbe jokuɛ nyumuwi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Betlehem, kɛ lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi; a gbe kɛ je muɔloku nɔ kɛ ya si ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye jeha enyɔɔnyɔ a nɔ. Herode kale kɛ je be nɛ ní leli ɔmɛ tsɔɔ kaa dodoe ɔ je ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ Yeremia de ɔ ba mi ke,

translation_verse: “A nu gbi ko ngɛ Rama, kɔmɔ yemi kɛ ya boboobo. Rahel ngɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ foe, nɛ e kplɛɛ we kpatami, ejakaa e bimɛ ɔmɛ gbo.” A kpale kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba Galilea

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.
translation_verse: Herode gbenɔ se ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko je e he kpo tsɔɔ Yosef ngɛ nlami mi ngɛ Egipt,

translation_verse: nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Tee si! Ngɔɔ bimwɔyo ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ o kpale o se kɛ ya Israel zugba a nɔ. Ejakaa nihi nɛ hla kaa a gbe bimwɔyo ɔ, a gbo.”

english_verse: But when he heard that Herod's son Archelaus was now ruler of Judea, he was afraid to go there. Then in a dream he was told to go to Galilee,
translation_verse: Se benɛ Yosef nu kaa Arkelao ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ e tsɛ Herode se ngɛ Yudea a, e ye gbeye kaa e maa ya lejɛ ɔ. A kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ nlami mi, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ e je kɛ ho Galilea kpokpa a nɔ ya,

english_verse: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
translation_verse: nɛ e ya hi ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Nazaret ɔ. Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbali ɔmɛ de to ɔ ba mi ke, “A ma tsɛ lɛ Nazaret no.”

english_verse: Do something to show you have really given up your sins.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee níhi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui.

english_verse: He said, “Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui, ejakaa hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ su si ta.”

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Yohane ɔ, afukpɔngɔ he womi a kɛ lo e tade; lohwe he womi kpa fi e mlɛ mi, nɛ e niye ní ji baalɛ kɛ nga nɔ hwo.

english_verse: From Jerusalem and all Judea and from the Jordan River Valley crowds of people went to John.
translation_verse: Nihi je Yerusalem, Yudea, kɛ Yordan kpokpa a nɔ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ.

english_verse: They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the river.
translation_verse: A ba jaje a he yayamihi, nɛ e sɔle mɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a mi.

english_verse: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. But John said to them: You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Benɛ Yohane na kaa Farisi bi, kɛ Saduki bi babauu ma e ngɔ nɛ e sɔle mɛ ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ sinɔhi a nina, mɛnɔ wo nyɛ ga ke nyɛɛ tu fo ngɛ tue gblami nɛ Mawu kɛ ma nyɛ nɔ ɔ nya.

english_verse: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into a fire.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, gbiɛ ɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ tso sipoku ɔmɛ a nɔ momo; tso tsuaa tso nɛ wui yiblii kpakpa a, a maa po, nɛ a ma sake ngɔ fɔ la mi.

english_verse: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out. The Baptism of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: E hɛɛ e ngma mi sami tsimi ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e kɛ maa sa e ngma a tsuo mi. E ma bua e ngma a nya kɛ wo gba mi, se tsakati ɔ lɛɛ e maa sã ngɛ la nɛ gbo we gblegbleegble mi.” A sɔle Yesu (Marko

english_verse: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yesu je Galilea kɛ ba Yohane ngɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a nya, konɛ Yohane nɛ sɔle lɛ.

english_verse: But John kept objecting and said, “I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me?”
translation_verse: Jinɛ Yohane ka lɛ blɔ tsimi; e de Yesu ke, “Imi mohu nɛ e hia kaa o sɔle mi ɔ, nɛ moo o ma ye ngɔ nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do.” Then John agreed.
translation_verse: Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Oo, moo kplɛɛ kɛkɛ, ejakaa kikɛmɛ a blɔ nɔ nɛ wa maa gu kɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yohane kplɛɛ.

english_verse: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.
translation_verse: Benɛ a sɔle Yesu ɔ, e je kpo amlɔ kɛ je pa a mi. A bli hiɔwe nya ha lɛ, nɛ e na Mawu Mumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ si kplee kaa okpo nɛ ma e nɔ mami.

english_verse: Then a voice from heaven said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke, “Imi nitsɛ ye bi nɛ i suɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Ee, i ngɛ e he bua jɔmi saminya.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu nu kaa a nu Yohane ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Galilea ya.

english_verse: But instead of staying in Nazareth, Jesus moved to Capernaum. This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: E je Nazaret kɛ ba hi Kapernaum, wo nya ma a nɛ ngɛ Zebulun kɛ Naftali kpokpa a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Then the devil came to him and said, “If you are God's Son, tell these stones to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Abosiami ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Ke Mawu Bi ji mo ɔ, fa tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a plɛ abolo.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The Scriptures also say, ‘Don't try to test the Lord your God!’ ”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ngmami ɔ de ekohu ke, ‘Koo ka Nyɔmtsɛ, o Mawu ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus up on a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms on earth and their power.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ Abosiami ngɔ Yesu kɛ ya yo gagaaga ko nɔ. E tsɔɔ Yesu matsɛ yemihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ha,

english_verse: The devil said to him, “I will give all this to you, if you will bow down and worship me.”
translation_verse: nɛ e de Yesu ke, “Ke o kpla si nɛ o ja mi ɔ, ma ngɔ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ha mo.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go away Satan! The Scriptures say: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ ”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke, “Satan, jee hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ! Ngmami ɔ ke, ‘Ja Nyɔmtsɛ o Mawu ɔ, nɛ o sɔmɔ lɛ pɛ!’ ”

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said,

english_verse: “Listen, lands of Zebulun and Naphtali, lands along the road to the sea and across the Jordan. Listen Galilee, land of the Gentiles!
translation_verse: “Zebulun zugba, kɛ Naftali zugba nɛ ngɛ wo nya blɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se! Galilea, ma je li a zugba!

translation_verse: Amlɔ ɔ, a si a ya amɛ, nɛ a ba nyɛɛ e se.

english_verse: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu ngɛ si kpae ngɛ Galilea wo ɔ nya a, e na nyɛmimɛ hɛli enyɔ nɛ a ngɛ ya fɔe ngɛ wo ɔ mi. Mɛ ji Simon, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ, kɛ Andrea.

english_verse: Jesus walked on until he saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat with their father, mending their nets. Jesus asked them to come with him.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, e na nyɛmimɛ enyɔ kpa komɛ ngɛ lɛ mi nɛ a kɛ a tsɛ Zebedeo ngɛ ya kpɛe, nɛ e tsɛ mɛ. Mɛ ji Yakobo kɛ Yohane.

translation_verse: Amlɔ ɔ, mɛ hu a si a lɛ ɔ, kɛ a tsɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba nyɛɛ Yesu se. Yesu tsɔɔ ní, e fiɛ, nɛ e tsa nihi (Luka

translation_verse: Yesu kpa Galilea tsuo; e tsɔɔ ní ngɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ e fiɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane kpakpa a, nɛ e tsa hiɔhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: News about him spread all over Syria, and people with every kind of sickness or disease were brought to him. Some of them had a lot of demons in them, others were thought to be crazy, and still others could not walk. But Jesus healed them all.
translation_verse: Yesu he sane gbɛ fĩa Siria zugba a tsuo nɔ; nɛ a ngɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ haomi slɔɔtohi a mi kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e tsa mɛ: kɔkɔtsɛmɛ, hulemi hiɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi.

translation_verse: Nihi babauu je Galilea, Ma Nyɔngma amɛ, Yerusalem, Yudea, kɛ mahi nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ba nyɛɛ Yesu se.

translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu na ma kpekpemi ɔ, e kuɔ yoku ɔ, nɛ e ya hi si. E kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ,

translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke loko nyɛ maa sɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, ja nyɛ ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ pee ɔ mi pe mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ. Ní tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ mi mi fumi he

english_verse: So if you are about to place your gift on the altar and remember that someone is angry with you,

translation_verse: “A gbaa nihi nɛ le kaa mumi mi ohiatsɛmɛ ji mɛ, ejakaa a nɔ́ ji hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.

translation_verse: “A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ naa mɔbɔ, ejakaa a maa na mɛ mɔbɔ.

translation_verse: “A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ a tsui mi tsɔ, ejakaa a maa na Mawu.

english_verse: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden,
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ngɛ kaa la kɛ ha je ɔ. Ma nɛ a bɔ ngɛ yoku nɔ ɔ, e be nyɛe maa laa.

translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ ko ka kita kulaa! Nyɛ ko ka hiɔwe, ejakaa Mawu matsɛ sɛ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ;

translation_verse: nyɛ ko ka zugba, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu kɛ e nane maa nɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ; loo Yerusalem, ejakaa Matsɛ ngua a ma ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ngɛ kaa ngo kɛ ha je ɔ. Se ke ngo nya nyu gbo ɔ, mɛni a kɛ ma futu lɛ, nɛ e maa dooɔ ekohu? E he be se nami hu kaa ja a tsɛ̃ pue he, nɛ nimli naa nɔ.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ se hu, nɔ ko su we kane kɛ ma sowe sisi; mohu e kɛ maa kane tso nɔ, nɛ́ e tso ha nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi.

english_verse: Don't suppose I came to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I did not come to do away with them, but to give them their full meaning.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko susu kaa i ba nɛ ma ba gu Mose mlaa a, kɛ níhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ɔ. Dɛbi! I bɛ mɛ gumi; se mohu, i ba, konɛ ma ba tsɔɔ a sisi saminya.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: “Tse nyɛ nu kaa a de blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, ‘Koo gbe nɔmlɔ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ, a kojo lɛ.’

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ mi mi fuɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, a maa kojo lɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jɛɔ e nyɛmi ke, ‘Yaka nɔmlɔ’ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ maa ba kpe ngua a hɛ mi; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jɛɔ e nyɛmi ke, ‘Kuasia’ a, e maa ya Abosiami a je la a mi.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: si o nike ní ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi. Yaa esɔ, nɛ o kɛ o nyɛmi ɔ ya kpata lolo, konɛ o kpale kɛ ba nɛ o kɛ o nike ní ɔ ba ha Mawu.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: “Ke nɔ ko sama mo, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa kojomi he ɔ, o kɛ lɛ nɛ tsa mla. Ke pi ja a, o pɛbilɔ ɔ maa ngɔ mo ya wo kojolɔ ɔ dɛ mi; kojolɔ hu maa ngɔ mo ya wo tsɔlɔ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ a maa wo mo tsu.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ke o be lejɛ ɔ jee kɛ yaa si o maa wo hiɔ nɛ o ye ɔ sisiisi. Ní tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ gba puɛmi he

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: “A de hulɔ ke, ‘Ke nɔ ko maa fie e yo ɔ, e ha lɛ fiemi womi.’

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: “Tse nyɛ nu hulɔ kaa a de blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, ‘Ko ka kita yaka gu, se o ye si nɛ o wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ.’

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: “Tse nyɛ nu nɛ a de ke, ‘A pɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ hɛngmɛ nane mi, nɛ a ku lungu ngɛ lungu nane mi.’

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke ke nɔ ko pee nyɛ yayami ɔ, nyɛ ko pee lɛ yayami ngɔ to nane mi. Ke nɔ ko gba o hiɔ ɔ nɔ tue mi ɔ, plɛ kake ɔ hu ha lɛ.

english_verse: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ya sama mo ngɛ o hiɔwe tade he ɔ, ha nɛ e ngɔ o tade klɔii ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nɔ ko nyɛ o nɔ ke o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya si tomi kake ɔ, o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya si tomi enyɔ.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ba mo nɔ́ ɔ, ha lɛ; ke nɔ ko ke o pa lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, ko kua. Suɔ o he nyɛli (Luka

english_verse: You have heard people say, “Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.”
translation_verse: “Tse nyɛ nu nɛ a de ke, ‘Suɔ o huɛ, nɛ o nyɛ o he nyɛlɔ.’

english_verse: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he nyɛli, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle ha nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi,

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ bimɛ. Ejakaa e haa e pu ɔ jee ngɛ nimli yayamihi, kɛ nimli kpakpahi a nɔ; nɛ e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ ha nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ dɛ tsuo.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ suɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ nyɛ ɔ pɛ ɔ, mɛni hiɔwo pa ngɛ ha nyɛ? Anɛ tó tsuli ɔmɛ tete pee we ja nɔuu lo?

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nyɛ ngaa nyɛ huɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ ɔ, mɛni tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee pe ni kpahi? Anɛ ma je li ɔmɛ tete pee we ja nɔuu lo?

english_verse: When you give to the poor, don't let anyone know about it.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ ke o maa ke nɔ́ ɔ, ko ha nɛ o huɛ nitsɛnitsɛ tete po nɛ le;

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, nyɛ ko pee nyɛ ní kaa osatotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ! A suɔ kaa a da kpe he ɔmɛ, kɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a kɔ nya kɛ sɔle, konɛ nihi nɛ na mɛ. Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke a nine su a hiɔwo nɔ momo.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ ke o maa sɔle ɔ, yaa sɛ o tsu mi, nɛ o nga sinya a, nɛ o sɔle ngɔ ha o Tsɛ nɛ a nɛ lɛ ɔ. Nɛ o Tsɛ nɛ naa níhi nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ maa wo mo hiɔ.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, nyɛ ko tu munyu putɛputɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ jali peeɔ ɔ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a susuu kaa ke a tu munyu fuu loko Mawu maa bu mɛ tue.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɔle kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: ‘Wa Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe; O biɛ ɔ he nɛ tsɔ.

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.
translation_verse: O Matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ ba; a pee nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi a tɔmihi pa mɛ ɔ, nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ tɔmihi maa pa nyɛ.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi a tɔmihi pɛ mɛ ɔ, nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ hu kɛ nyɛ tɔmihi be nyɛ pae. Ní tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ hwɔ hami he

english_verse: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: Ni kpahi nɛ a ko na kaa nyɛ ngɛ hwɔ hae, ja nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ a nɛ lɛ ɔ pɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɛ naa nɔ́ nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ ma ha nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hiae ɔ. Hiɔwe juetli (Luka

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ hla Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ níhi nɛ da ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ kekle, nɛ a kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa piɛ he ngɔ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Don't store up treasures on earth! Moths and rust can destroy them, and thieves can break in and steal them.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko to juetli ha nyɛ he ngɛ je ɔ mi he nɛ wɔyewɔye, kɛ kana puɛɔ ní, nɛ juli juɔ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Se mohu nyɛɛ to juetli ha nyɛ he ngɛ hiɔwe, he nɛ wɔyewɔye, kɛ kana puɛ we ní ngɛ, nɛ juli hu ju we ɔ.

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: Ejakaa he nɛ o juetli ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ o tsui hu maa hi. Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ la (Luka

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: Se ke o hɛngmɛ nɔ tsɔ we ɔ, lɛɛ o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo maa wo diblii. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke la nɛ ngɛ o mi ji diblii ɔ, lɛɛ jamɛ a diblii ɔ mi ma ti wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Mawu kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ní (Luka

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: “Nɔ ko be nyɛe ma sɔmɔ nyɔmtsɛmɛ enyɔ; eko ɔ, e maa nyɛ nɔ kake, nɛ e maa suɔ nɔ kake; aloo e maa pee nɔ kake suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nɔ kake ɔ lɛɛ e be lɛ bue fɛɛ. O be nyɛe ma sɔmɔ Mawu kɛ sika tsuo.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ bi ke, ‘Mɛni wa maa ye? Aloo mɛni wa maa nu? Aloo mɛni wa maa ngɔ kɛ ha wa he?’

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ha; a du we ní, nɛ a kpa we ní; jehanɛ hu, a bua we ní nya kɛ wui ngma gba mi. Se nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ lɛɔ mɛ. Anɛ nyɛ he jua wɛ hluu pi mɛ lo?

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: “Lɛɛ mɛni he je nyɛ peeɔ yeyeeye ngɛ heha nɔ́ he? Nyɛɛ hyɛ mɔmɔhi nɛ ngɛ puɛe ngɛ nga nɔ; a tsu we ní, nɛ a tsɛ̃ we kpa.

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, Matsɛ Salomo kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo tete sui enɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kake he fɛu.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Nga, nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ e bɔ, nɛ hwɔɔ kɛkɛ a sake kɛ fɔ la mi ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu mia lɛ saminyayoo ha! Anɛ Mawu be nyɛe nɛ e pee enɛ ɔ kɛ be nɔ ha nyɛ lo! Oo, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi pi saasaa!

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ ma je li dii se ji enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ le kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he hia nyɛ.

english_verse: Don't condemn others, and God won't condemn you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ kó kojo nihi, konɛ Mawu hu kó kojo nyɛ.

english_verse: God will be as hard on you as you are on others! He will treat you exactly as you treat them.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ nyɛ kojoɔ nihi ɔ, jã Mawu hu maa kojo nyɛ. Susumi nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ susuu ha nihi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu a kɛ ma susu ha nyɛ.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je nɛ o naa ngu nyafii nɛ ngɛ o nyɛmi hɛngmɛ nɔ nɛ plai nɛ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ lɛɛ o nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye?
translation_verse: Kɛ o ma plɛ kɛ de o nyɛmi ke, ‘Ha ma je ngu nyafii ɔ ngɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ;’ be mi nɛ plai ngɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ?

english_verse: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.
translation_verse: Osatotsɛ! Je plai ɔ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ kekle. Ke o pee jã loko o maa hyɛ nɔ́ saminya, nɛ o ma je ngu nyafii ɔ ngɛ o nyɛmi ɔ hɛngmɛ nɔ.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ yayami po, tse nyɛ le bɔ nɛ nyɛ haa nyɛ bimɛ ní kpakpahi! Nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, anɛ lɛɛ e be nyɛe ma ha nihi nɛ biɔ lɛ ɔ ní kpakpahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ lo?

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ nɛ ke e bi bi lɛ abolo nɛ e ma ha lɛ tɛ?

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ bi, nɛ a ma ha nyɛ; nyɛ hla, nɛ nyɛ maa na; nyɛ si, nɛ a ma bli sinya a ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ biɔ ɔ, a haa lɛ; nɔ nɛ hlaa a, e naa; nɛ nɔ nɛ siɔ sinya a, a bliɔ kɛ haa lɛ.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Aloo mɛnɔ lɛ ke e bi bi lɛ pa mi lo nɛ e ma ha lɛ sinɔ?

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nihi nɛ pee ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ja nɔuu ngɔ ha mɛ. Mose mlaa a, kɛ ní nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ɔ sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Agbo tokofii ɔ (Luka

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ ye munyu nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e yeɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa ní lelɔ ko nɛ ma e tsu ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ.

english_verse: But the gate to life is very narrow. The road that leads there is so hard to follow that only a few people find it. A Tree and Its Fruit (Luke
translation_verse: Se agbo nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi ɔ ngɛ tokofii; blɔ ɔ hu hí, nɛ nihi bɔɔ pɛ lɛ naa blɔ ɔ. Tso kɛ e yiblii (Luka

english_verse: Watch out for false prophets! They dress up like sheep, but inside they are wolves who have come to attack you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ lakpa gbali a he. Ke a ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, a naa mɛ kaa jijɔ, se anɔkuale mi ɔ, a ngɛ kaa ogbeteehi;

english_verse: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.
translation_verse: a ní peemi níhi nyɛɛ kɛ maa le mɛ. Mio tso wui wai yiblii, nɛ zezle hu wui ngmɔkɔ.

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Tso kpakpa a, yiblii kpakpa nɛ e woɔ, nɛ tso yaya hu woɔ yiblii yaya.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Tso kpakpa be nyɛe maa wo yiblii yaya, nɛ tso yaya hu be nyɛe maa wo yiblii kpakpa.

english_verse: Every tree producing bad fruit will be chopped down and burned.
translation_verse: Tso tsuaa tso nɛ wui yiblii kpakpa a, a hɛɛ, nɛ a sakeɔ kɛ fɔɔ la mi.

english_verse: You can tell who the false prophets are by their deeds. A Warning (Luke
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, níhi nɛ lakpa gbali ɔmɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa le mɛ. I li nyɛ kulaa (Luka

english_verse: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.
translation_verse: “Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ ye munyu nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nyumu kuasia nɛ ma e tsu ngɛ zia nɔ.

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.
translation_verse: Hiɔmi ba nɛ, nɛ pahi hia, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ fia wawɛɛ kɛ si tsu ɔ. Nɛ e hule kɛ pue si butuu nɛ nɔ́ ko piɛ.” He blɔ nɛ Yesu ngɛ

english_verse: Not everyone who calls me their Lord will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only the ones who obey my Father in heaven will get in.
translation_verse: “Pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɛɔ mi ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ’ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ maa sɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi; se mohu nɔ nɛ peeɔ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ suɔmi nya ní.

english_verse: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, “We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.”
translation_verse: Kojomi ligbi ɔ, nihi babauu ma bi mi ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ! Pi o biɛ mi nɛ wa fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ lo? Pi o biɛ mi nɛ wa hia mumi yayamihi ngɛ lo? Nɛ pi mo o biɛ mi nɛ wa pee nyakpɛ ní fuu ngɛ lo?’

english_verse: But I will tell them, “I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people!” Two Builders (Luke
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, imi hu ma de mɛ ke, ‘I li nyɛ! Nyɛɛ je ye nɔ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ dɛ blɔ!’ Tsu mali enyɔ ɔmɛ (Luka

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and winds beat against that house. But it was built on solid rock, and so it did not fall.
translation_verse: Hiɔmi ba nɛ, nɛ pahi hia, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ fia wawɛɛ kɛ si tsu ɔ. Se tsu ɔ hule we, ejakaa a to sisi ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ.

english_verse: He taught them like someone with authority, and not like their teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: E tsɔɔ mɛ ní kaa nɔ ko nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya, se pi kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ní ɔ.

english_verse: But the ones who should have been in the kingdom will be thrown out into the dark. They will cry and grit their teeth in pain.”

english_verse: Watch out for people who will take you to court and have you beaten in their synagogues.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ; ejakaa nihi maa nuu nyɛ, nɛ a maa kojo nyɛ, nɛ a maa fia nyɛ kpa ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Because of me, you will be dragged before rulers and kings to tell them and the Gentiles about your faith.
translation_verse: Ye he ɔ, a maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya ganɔhi, kɛ matsɛmɛ a hɛ mi. A ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ ye sane kpakpa a he odase ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, kɛ ma je li tsuo.

english_verse: But you will not really be the one speaking. The Spirit from your Father will tell you what to say.
translation_verse: Ejakaa pi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu ɔ, se mohu nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ nɛ maa tu munyu kɛ gu nyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you remain faithful until the end, you will be saved.
translation_verse: Ye he ɔ, nihi tsuo maa nyɛ nyɛ. Se nɔ nɛ ma wlua lɛ kɛ yaa si nyagbe ɔ, a ma he e yi wami.

english_verse: When people mistreat you in one town, hurry to another one. I promise you before you have gone to all the towns of Israel, the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Ke a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ngɛ ma ko mi ɔ, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ ya ma kpa mi. Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ be nyɛ ní tsumi ɔ nya gbee ngɛ Israel ma amɛ tsuo a mi, loko Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba.

english_verse: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.
translation_verse: “Kaselɔ pã we e tsɔɔlɔ, nɛ nyɔguɛ hu pã we e nyɔmtsɛ.

english_verse: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family? The One To Fear (Luke
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke kaselɔ, kɛ e tsɔɔlɔ ba sɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ ha lɛ. Nyɔguɛ hu, ke e kɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ba sɔ ɔ, lɛ hu lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ ha lɛ. Ke a tsɛ wetsɛ ɔ Beelzebul ɔ, e we mi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ma tsɛ mɛ biɛ yaya pe jã po! Nɔ nɛ sa nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye (Luka

english_verse: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ gbeɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, se klaa a lɛɛ a nyɛ we lɛ gbemi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye. Mawu nɛ nyɛɔ kpataa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, kɛ klaa a tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ Abosiami a je la a mi ɔ, lɛ mohu nyɛɛ ye gbeye.

english_verse: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.
translation_verse: Otoklii enyɔ ɔ, anɛ pi sika nɛ a yeɔ ɔ mi nyafii pe kulaa kake pɛ nɛ a juaa mɛ lo? Se a ti nɔ kake nɔɛ zugba nɛ pi nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ yi bwɔmi tete po a kane lɛ tsuo.

english_verse: So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Luke
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye; nyɛ he jua wa hluu pe otokliihi babauu. Kristo biɛ ta womi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi (Luka

english_verse: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa wo ye ta ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, imi hu ma wo e ta ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me. Not Peace, but Trouble (Luke
translation_verse: Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kua mi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, imi hu ma kua lɛ ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi. Pi he jɔmi se klaate (Luka

english_verse: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko susu kaa i ba, konɛ ma ha nɛ he jɔmi nɛ ba je ɔ mi. Dɛbi, pi he jɔmi hami nɛ i ba; se klaate mohu i kɛ ba.

english_verse: I came to turn sons against their fathers, daughters against their mothers, and daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law.
translation_verse: I ba nɛ ma ba ha nɛ binyumuhi nɛ a te si kɛ wo a tsɛmɛ, biyihi nɛ a te si kɛ wo a nyɛmɛ, nɛ nganyɛmɛ nɛ a te si kɛ wo nganyɛmɛ.

english_verse: Your worst enemies will be in your own family.
translation_verse: Nɔ nitsɛ e we mi bimɛ ma plɛ e he nyɛli.

english_verse: If you love your father or mother or even your sons and daughters more than me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ suɔ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ pe imi ɔ, e sɛ kaa e ba peeɔ ye kaselɔ. Nɔ nɛ suɔ e binyumu, loo e biyo pe imi ɔ, e sɛ kaa e ba peeɔ ye kaselɔ.

english_verse: And unless you are willing to take up your cross and follow me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ wo we e sɛumi tso kɛ nyɛɛ we ye se ɔ, e sɛ kaa e ba peeɔ ye kaselɔ.

english_verse: If you try to save your life, you will lose it. But if you give it up for me, you will surely find it. Rewards (Mark
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ laa e klaa ngɛ ye he ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ. Hiɔwo kpakpa (Marko

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes a prophet, just because that person is a prophet, will be given the same reward as a prophet. Anyone who welcomes a good person, just because that person is good, will be given the same reward as a good person.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ gbalɔ akɛnɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, gbalɔ hiɔwo lɛ e ma na. Nɔ nɛ heɔ dalɔ akɛnɛ dalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, dalɔ hiɔwo lɛ e ma na.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.
translation_verse: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ nyɛ ɔ, imi e ngɛ hee ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ e ngɛ hee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: And anyone who gives one of my most humble followers a cup of cool water, just because that person is my follower, will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ha ni tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nyu nɛ mi jɔ nɛ e nu akɛnɛ ye kaselɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, e hiɔwo be lɛ bɔe gblegbleegble.”

english_verse: As John's followers were going away, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What sort of person did you go out into the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Benɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ yaa a, Yesu tu Yohane he munyu kɛ tsɔɔ ma kpekpemi ɔ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ho nga a nɔ ya nɛ nyɛ yaa hyɛ? Ngɔwu nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ mimiɛe lo?

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “That man has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yohane ba a, e yi ní, nɛ e nui nɔ́ ko hulɔ. Se nɔ́ nɛ nihi tsuo de ngɛ e he ji, ‘Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi!’

english_verse: to ask Jesus, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: ke, “Anɛ mo ji nɔ nɛ ma a, aloo waa hyɛ nɔ kpa blɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go and tell John what you have heard and seen.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya de Yohane níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue, kɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The blind are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People with leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: Hɛ yuyuili ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe, glɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ɔ, a he ngɛ tsɔe; amuɛtihi ngɛ nɔ́ nue, gbogboehi ngɛ si tee, nɛ a ngɛ sane kpakpa fiɛe ha ohiatsɛmɛ.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ mi mi fu we ngɛ ye he.” Yesu ye Yohane he odase (Luka

english_verse: What kind of man did you go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who dress like that live in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Mɛni nyɛ ho hyɛmi ya? Nɔmlɔ nɛ wo tade bɔdɔɔ lo? Hyɛ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ tade bɔdɔɔ ɔ, matsɛmɛ a we mi nɛ a hii.

english_verse: What did you really go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was. I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Nyɛ de mi koo! Mɛni he je nyɛ ho ɔ? Nɛ́ nyɛ ya hyɛ gbalɔ, pi ja? Ee! Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ nɛ nyɛ ya na a pe gbalɔ tete.

english_verse: I tell you no one ever born on this earth is greater than John the Baptist. But whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than John.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa ko hí si hyɛ nɛ pe lɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ pe Yohane.

english_verse: From the time of John the Baptist until now, violent people have been trying to take over the kingdom of heaven by force.
translation_verse: Kɛ je be mi nɛ Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ bɔni fiɛmi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ na nɔ́ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ hlaa kaa a maa ngɔ pani nya.

english_verse: And if you believe them, John is Elijah, the prophet you are waiting for.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ ma he a sɛ gbi ɔ nyɛɛ ye ɔ, Yohane ɔ ji Eliya nɛ maa ba a nɛ.

english_verse: “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not mourn!”
translation_verse: ‘Wa kpã bɛ ha nyɛ, se nyɛ dui; wa nya awe, se nyɛ yi kɔmɔ.’

english_verse: But the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, and you say, “That man eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.” Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what it does. The Unbelieving Towns (Luke
translation_verse: Benɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba a, lɛɛ e yeɔ ní, nɛ e nuɔ wai. Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ nihi deɔ ji, ‘Hyɛ, jiklɔɔtsɛ, kɛ dã nulɔ; tó tsuli, kɛ yayami peeli a huɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ Mawu nile ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ e tsuɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ woɔ lɛ nguɔ.” Nihi nɛ he we yi (Luka

english_verse: In the towns where Jesus had worked most of his miracles, the people refused to turn to God. So Jesus was upset with them and said:
translation_verse: Mahi nɛ Yesu tsu nyakpɛ ní babauu ngɛ a mi ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a ma amɛ a mi ɔ tsakee we a tsui. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yesu ka a hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke,

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? You will go down to hell! If the miracles that took place in your town had happened in Sodom, it would still be standing.
translation_verse: Nɛ mo, Kapernaum, tse o ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa a ma wo o nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe lokoo? Siu! Dla o he! Abosiami la a mi mohu a ma sake mo kɛ fɔ! Nyakpɛ ní babauu nɛ a pee ngɛ o mi ɔ, a ya pee ngɛ Sodom jinɛ e ko hi si kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: So I tell you on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than you. Come to Me and Rest (Luke
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo dee ke kojomi ligbi ɔ, Mawu maa na Sodom mɔbɔ kulaa pe mo.” Nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ba jɔɔ nyɛ he (Luka

english_verse: At that moment Jesus said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Tsaatsɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba Nyɔmtsɛ! I naa mo si, ejakaa níhi nɛ o ngɔ kɛ laa ní leli, kɛ ga leli ɔ, o je kɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Ee, Tsaatsɛ, bɔ nɛ o suɔ kaa e ba mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who truly knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: “Tsaatsɛ tu níhi tsuo ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi. Nɔ ko nɔ ko li Bi ɔ, ja Tsɛ ɔ pɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko li Tsɛ ɔ, ja Bi ɔ kɛkɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ Bi ɔ suɔ kaa e maa tsɔɔ mɛ Tsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you are tired from carrying heavy burdens, come to me and I will give you rest.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ tloo tlomi nɛ pɔ tɔ nyɛ, nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ nyɛ he.

english_verse: Take the yoke I give you. Put it on your shoulders and learn from me. I am gentle and humble, and you will find rest.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ ye kuɛpã tso ɔ ngɔɔ tloo, nɛ nyɛɛ kase mi; ejakaa ye he jɔ, nɛ i baa ye he si kɛ jee ye tsui mi. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma na he jɔmi;

english_verse: This yoke is easy to bear, and this burden is light.
translation_verse: ejakaa ye kuɛpã tso ɔ tloomi wɛ, nɛ ye tlomi ɔ hu jiɔ we.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees noticed this and said to Jesus, “Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do this!”
translation_verse: Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ na a, a de Yesu ke, “Hyɛ, nɔ́ nɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa a peeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.”

english_verse: The crowds were so amazed they asked, “Could Jesus be the Son of David?”
translation_verse: Nimli kpekpemi ɔ a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a bi ke, “David Bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: But when I force out demons by the power of God's Spirit, it proves that God's kingdom has already come to you.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ ke Mawu Mumi ɔ lɛ haa mi he wami nɛ i kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ba na nyɛ momo.

english_verse: Haven't you read in the Law of Moses that the priests are allowed to work in the temple on the Sabbath? But no one says they are guilty of breaking the law of the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Aloo nyɛ kane we ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi kaa daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, osɔfohi nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ bleɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, se kɛ̃ a yi fɔ lo?

english_verse: Don't you know what the Scriptures mean when they say, “Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others?” If you knew what this means, you would not condemn these innocent disciples of mine.
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ ke, ‘Mɔbɔ nami i ngɛ hlae, se pi bɔ.’ Nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi jinɛ nihi nɛ yi fɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko bui mɛ fɔ.

english_verse: Jesus left and went into one of their synagogues,
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, e ya sɛ a kpe he ɔ,

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “Hold out your hand.” The man did, and it became as healthy as the other one.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de nyumu ɔ nɛ nine kake gbo ɔ ke, “Kpã o nine ɔ mi!” Nyumu ɔ kpã e nine ɔ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ nine ɔ tsa, nɛ e kɛ kake ɔ sɔ.

english_verse: When Jesus found out what was happening, he left there and large crowds followed him. He healed all of their sick,
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu nu kaa a so e yi nɔ ɔ, e sã e he si kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, se nihi babauu nyɛɛ e se. E tsa nihi tsuo nɛ be he wami ɔ,

english_verse: but warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: nɛ e bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko tu e he munyu nɛ nihi ba nu e he.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as Isaiah the prophet had said,
translation_verse: E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de kɛ gu gbalɔ Yesaya nɔ ɔ nɛ ba mi ke,

english_verse: “Here is my chosen servant! I love him, and he pleases me. I will give him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: “Hyɛ, ye tsɔlɔ nɛ i hla a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; i suɔ lɛ, nɛ i naa e he tsui. Ma ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo e mi, nɛ tue gblami nɛ i to ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ, e maa fiɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: If you are not on my side, you are against me. If you don't gather in the harvest with me, you scatter it.
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɛ be ye blɔ fa mi ɔ, e te si ngɔ wo mi, ne nɔ nɛ kɛ mi bua we nɔ́ nya a, e ngɛ gbɛe kɛ ngɛ fĩae.

english_verse: Some people brought to Jesus a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon in him. Jesus healed the man, and then he was able to talk and see.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, ni komɛ ngɔ nyumu ko nɛ hɛ yu, nɛ e tu we munyu hulɔ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ; nyumu nɛ ɔ, mumi yayami ngɛ e mi. Yesu tsa lɛ, nɛ e tu munyu, nɛ e hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them: Any kingdom where people fight each other will end up ruined. And a town or family that fights will soon destroy itself.
translation_verse: Yesu le nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ susue ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Matsɛ yemi tsuaa matsɛ yemi nɛ mi ma gba, nɛ a kɛ a he maa hi ta hwue ɔ, e se kɛ we. Jã kɛ̃, ma tsuaa ma, aloo we tsuaa we nɛ e mi ma gba, nɛ a kɛ a he maa hi ta hwue ɔ, e dɛ si.

english_verse: If I use the power of Beelzebul to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? Your followers are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Yoo, ke Beelzebul he wami lɛ i kɛ ngɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ hiae ɔ, nyɛ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ mɛnɔ he wami nya nɛ mɛɛ a ngɛ mɛ hiae ngɛ mɔ? Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ pee ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ yeɔ fɔ!

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when the demon doesn't find a place,
translation_verse: “Ke mumi yayami je nɔ ko mi ɔ, e ya kpaa si ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ nɛ e hlaa he nɛ e maa jɔɔ e he ngɛ. Ke e nɛ́ he ko ɔ,

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and the person ends up in worse shape than before. That's how it will be with you evil people of today. Jesus' Mother and Brothers (Mark
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, e yaa nɛ e ya ngɔɔ mumi kpa kpaago kɛ baa, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba hii lejɛ ɔ. Mumi yayamihi nɛ pe lɛ nitsɛ po ji mumi nɛ ɔmɛ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ nyagbe si himi ɔ ba peeɔ haomi kulaa pe sisije ɔ po. Yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba mɛ hu a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yesu nyɛ kɛ e nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ (Marko

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit. You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces.
translation_verse: “Ke o du tso kpakpa a, e maa wo yiblii kpakpa; ke tso ɔ hí ɔ, e maa wo yiblii yaya. Tso yiblii nɛ a kɛ leɔ tso.

english_verse: You are a bunch of evil snakes, so how can you say anything good? Your words show what is in your hearts.
translation_verse: Nyɛ sinɔhi a nina! Nyɛ nimli yayamihi! Kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ tu munyu kpakpa kɛɛ? Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ hyi tsui mi tɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nya deɔ.

english_verse: I promise you on the day of judgment, everyone will have to account for every careless word they have spoken.
