translation_verse: Benɛ e wo ni ɔmɛ blɔ se ɔ, lɛ nɔ kake e kuɔ yoku ɔ, nɛ e ya sɔle. Benɛ je jɔ ɔ, Yesu nɔ kake too nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: By this time the boat was a long way from the shore. It was going against the wind and was being tossed around by the waves.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ ɔ su wo ɔ kpɛti momo. Oslɔke ngɛ kue kɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi woe, ejakaa a ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ kpee.

english_verse: A little while before morning, Jesus came walking on the water toward his disciples.
translation_verse: Makɛ maa pee ngmlɛ eywiɛ mi ɔ, Yesu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ wo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ.

english_verse: At once, Jesus said to them, “Don't worry! I am Jesus. Don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Se amlɔ ɔ, Yesu wo e nya nɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ na tsui, imi! Nyɛ ko ye gbeye!”

english_verse: Peter replied, “Lord, if it really is you, tell me to come to you on the water.”
translation_verse: Petro he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mo ɔ, lɛɛ ha nɛ ma nyɛɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ba o ngɔ.”

english_verse: At once, Jesus reached out his hand. He helped Peter up and said, “You surely don't have much faith. Why do you doubt?”
translation_verse: Amlɔ ɔ, Yesu kpã e nine mi, nɛ e pɛtɛ e he, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mo nɛ o hemi kɛ yemi pi! Mɛni he je nɛ o je nɔ́?”

english_verse: When Jesus and Peter got into the boat, the wind died down.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ kpa fiami.

english_verse: The men in the boat worshiped Jesus and said, “You really are the Son of God!” Jesus Heals Sick People in Gennesaret (Mark
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ja Yesu, nɛ a de ke, “Niinɛ, Mawu Bi ji mo!” Yesu tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ Genesaret (Marko

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed the lake and came to shore near the town of Gennesaret.
translation_verse: A po wo ɔ, nɛ a ba Genesaret zugba a nɔ,

english_verse: The people found out he was there, and they sent word to everyone who lived in this part of the country. So they brought all the sick people to Jesus.
translation_verse: nɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ yo Yesu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ kɛ ya kpa lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi tsuo, nɛ a ya ngɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ.

english_verse: They begged him just to let them touch his clothes, and everyone who did was healed.
translation_verse: A kpa lɛ pɛɛ wawɛɛ ke e ha nɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ta e tade ɔ nya a he kɛkɛ. Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ta he ɔ na he wami.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Every plant that my Father in heaven did not plant will be pulled up by the roots.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tso tsuaa tso nɛ pi Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ ma a, a maa hia.

english_verse: “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? They don't even wash their hands before they eat.”
translation_verse: “Kusumi nɛ wa nimeli to sisi blema a, mɛni he je nɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ bui ɔ? A fɔ we a dɛ loko a yeɔ ní!”

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they have has been offered to God.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma de e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ke, ‘Nɔ́ ko nɛ jinɛ o ko ná ngɛ ye dɛ mi ɔ, i ngɔ kɛ ke Mawu’ ɔ, lɛɛ e hia we kaa e bu e tsɛ loo e nyɛ hu.

english_verse: Is this any way to show respect to your parents? You ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching.
translation_verse: Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ peeɔ, nɛ nyɛ siɔ Mawu mlaa a, nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛɔ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kusumihi a se.

english_verse: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.” What Really Makes People Unclean (Mark
translation_verse: Yaka gu a jaa mi, ejakaa tsɔɔmihi nɛ a tsɔɔ ji mlaahi nɛ nimli pee.’ ” Níhi nɛ bleɔ nɔ (Marko

english_verse: Stay away from those Pharisees! They are like blind people leading other blind people, and all of them will fall into a ditch.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he ngɛ a he kulaa! Hɛ yuyuili nɛ ngɛ hɛ yuyuili blɔ tsɔɔe ji mɛ. Ke hɛ yuyuilɔ ngɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ blɔ tsɔɔe ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a maa nɔ muɔ mi.”

english_verse: Jesus did not say a word. But the woman kept following along and shouting, so his disciples came up and asked him to send her away.
translation_verse: Se Yesu pui e nya mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke, “Yo nɛ ɔ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ nyɛɛ wa se! Wo lɛ blɔ nɛ e ho!”

english_verse: The food you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.”
translation_verse: Pi nɔ́ nɛ yaa nɔ nya mi ɔ nɛ bleɔ nɔ; mohu ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ jee nɔ nya a lɛ bleɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: Then his disciples came over to him and asked, “Do you know you insulted the Pharisees by what you said?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “O le kaa benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ, e dɔ mɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Peter replied, “What did you mean when you talked about the things that make people unclean?”
translation_verse: Petro de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔ wɔ abɛ ɔ sisi!”

english_verse: Jesus then said: Don't any of you know by now what I am talking about?
translation_verse: Yesu ke, “Anɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ li ní kɛ mwɔɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know that the food you put into your mouth goes into your stomach and then out of your body?
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ yaa nɔ nya mi ɔ, muklii mi e sɛɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e jeɔ kpo lo?

english_verse: But the words that come out of your mouth come from your heart. And they are what make you unfit to worship God.
translation_verse: Se níhi nɛ jee nɔ nya a, tsui mi a jee; nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ bleɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Out of your heart come evil thoughts, murder, unfaithfulness in marriage, vulgar deeds, stealing, telling lies, and insulting others.
translation_verse: Ejakaa tsui mi nɛ susumi yayami nɛ ɔmɛ jeɔ: nɔmlɔ gbemi, gba puɛmi, ajuama bɔmi, jumi, lakpa odase yemi, kɛ nɔ biɛ puɛmi.

english_verse: These are what make you unclean. Eating without washing your hands will not make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Mark
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ bleɔ nɔ; se ke nɔ ko fɔ we e dɛ loko e ye ní ɔ, lɔ ɔ ble we nɔ.” Yo ko hemi kɛ yemi (Marko

english_verse: Jesus said, “I was sent only to the people of Israel! They are like a flock of lost sheep.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Israel ma nɛ ngɛ kaa to nɛ laa a, mɛ pɛ a ngɔ nɛ a tsɔ mi.”

english_verse: Large crowds came and brought many people who were paralyzed or blind or lame or unable to talk. They placed them, and many others, in front of Jesus, and he healed them all.
translation_verse: Ma kpekpemi nitsɛ ba e ngɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A kɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ slɔɔto babauu ba pue Yesu nane nya, nɛ e tsa mɛ. Hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ji nihi nɛ hule, hɛ yuyuili, amuɛtihi, glɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ kpahi fuu.

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the territory near the towns of Tyre and Sidon.
translation_verse: Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Tiro, kɛ Sidon zugba a nɔ ya.

english_verse: Suddenly a Canaanite woman from there came out shouting, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on me! My daughter is full of demons.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Kanaan yo ko nɛ je lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ba kpa ngmlaa ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ! Ye biyo ngɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi, nɛ e ngɛ lɛ haoe wawɛɛ nitsɛ.”

english_verse: The woman came closer. Then she knelt down and begged, “Please help me, Lord!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ ba kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “It isn't right to take food away from children and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “E dɛ kaa a ngɔɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ a niye ní ɔ nɛ a sakee kɛ fɔɔ si ha gbehi.”

english_verse: “Lord, this is true,” the woman said, “but even puppies get the crumbs that fall from their owner's table.”
translation_verse: Yo ɔ de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, e ngɛ mi ja mohu, se tse gbe ɔmɛ hu yeɔ bibliwi nɛ jeɔ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ nɔ pueɔ si ɔ eko!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Dear woman, you really do have a lot of faith, and you will be given what you want.” At that moment her daughter was healed. Jesus Heals Many People
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yo, o hemi kɛ yemi kle! Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ, a pee ha mo!” Nɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu ɔ, a tsa e biyo ɔ. Yesu tsa nihi babauu

english_verse: From there, Jesus went along Lake Galilee. Then he climbed a hill and sat down.
translation_verse: Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ya gu Galilea wo ɔ nya. E kuɔ yo ɔ nɛ e ya hi si.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at what they saw and heard. People who had never spoken could now speak. The lame were healed, the paralyzed could walk, and the blind were able to see. Everyone was praising the God of Israel. Jesus Feeds Four Thousand (Mark
translation_verse: Benɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ na nɛ amuɛti ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue, nɛ glɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he mi wa mɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ hule ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he. Nɛ a je Israel Mawu ɔ yi. Yesu ha nyumuhi akpe eywiɛ niye ní (Marko

english_verse: Jesus called his disciples together and told them, “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry. They might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Yesu tsɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe ngɛ nimli kpekpemi nɛ ɔmɛ a he. Ligbi etɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ mi ngɛ, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɛ a maa ye. I sume kaa ma wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho kɛ hwɔ; eko piɔ klibi ma ya po mɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: His disciples said, “This place is like a desert. Where can we find enough food to feed such a crowd?”
translation_verse: Kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Nga nɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, jije wa ma na niye ní ngɛ bɔ nɛ sa nɛ maa su ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ nya?”

english_verse: Jesus asked them how much food they had. They replied, “Seven small loaves of bread and a few little fish.”
translation_verse: Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Abolo enyɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Kpaago, kɛ lo tsɔwi bɔɔ ko.”

english_verse: After Jesus had told the people to sit down,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu fa ma kpekpemi ɔ ke a hi si ngɛ zugba.

english_verse: he took the seven loaves of bread and the fish and gave thanks. He then broke them and handed them to his disciples, who passed them around to the crowds.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e kukuɔ abolo kpaago ɔ, kɛ lo ɔ, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ. Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu dla ngɔ ha ma a.

english_verse: After Jesus had sent the crowds away, he got into a boat and sailed across the lake. He came to shore near the town of Magadan.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu wo ma kpekpemi ɔ blɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e sɛ lɛ mi kɛ ho Magadan zugba a nɔ ya.

english_verse: Don't you know by now that I am not talking to you about bread? Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees!
translation_verse: Mɛni he je nyɛ nui sisi kaa pi abolo he munyu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue ɔ? Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a masa a he!”

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were near the town of Caesarea Philippi, he asked them, “What do people say about the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu ba Kaisarea Filipi kpokpa a nɔ ɔ, e bi e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ nihi deɔ ke Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ji?”

english_verse: Finally, the disciples understood that Jesus wasn't talking about the yeast used to make bread, but about the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees. Who Is Jesus? (Mark
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba kɔ se kaa pi masa nɛ a kɛ woɔ abolo mi ɔ he nɛ e de mɛ ke a hɛ nɛ hi a he nɔ ɔ, se mohu, Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ he. Petro ye Yesu he odase (Marko

english_verse: He told them: If the sky is red in the evening, you say the weather will be good.
translation_verse: Se e he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, [“Ke pu yaa nɔ si ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Je mi ma tsɔ, ejakaa hiɔwe pee tsutsuu.’

english_verse: But if the sky is red and gloomy in the morning, you say it is going to rain. You can tell what the weather will be like by looking at the sky. But you don't understand what is happening now.
translation_verse: Mɔtu ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Hiɔmi maa nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, ejakaa hiɔwe pee tsutsuu, nɛ je ɔ mi pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ.’ Niinɛ, ke nyɛ hyɛ hiɔwe pɛ nyɛ le kaa je mi ma tsɔ, loo hiɔmi maa nɛ. Se okadihi nɛ kɔɔ yi nɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a he lɛɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa tsɔɔ sisi!]

english_verse: The disciples answered, “Some people say you are John the Baptist or maybe Elijah or Jeremiah or some other prophet.”
translation_verse: A he nɔ ke, “Ni komɛ ke Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ; ni komɛ ke Eliya, nɛ ni kpa komɛ deɔ ke Yeremia, aloo gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.”

english_verse: From then on, Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “I must go to Jerusalem. There the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make me suffer terribly. I will be killed, but three days later I will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ, Yesu bɔni e kaseli ɔmɛ demi paa ke ja e ya Yerusalem, nɛ e ya na amanehlu babauu ngɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi. A maa gbe lɛ, se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Mawu ma tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.

english_verse: Jesus then warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya! Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a masa a he!”

english_verse: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, “He must be saying this because we didn't bring along any bread.”
translation_verse: Se a tu he munyu ngɛ a kpɛti ke, “E de jã, ejakaa wa hɛɛ we niye ní kɛ bɛ!”

english_verse: The Son of Man will soon come in the glory of his Father and with his angels to reward all people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba ngɛ e tsɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ mi, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, e maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ e ní tsumi nya.

english_verse: So I will call you Peter, which means “a rock.” On this rock I will build my church, and death itself will not have any power over it.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Petro, i ngɛ mo dee ke tɛ sa ji mo, nɛ kikɛmɛ a tɛ sa nɛ ɔ nɔ ma ma ye asafo ɔ ngɛ. Nɛ gbenɔ tete po be nyɛe maa ye e nɔ.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?”
translation_verse: E bi mɛ ke, “Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ nyɛ deɔ kɛɛ? Mɛnɔ ji mi?”

english_verse: Simon Peter spoke up, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro he nɔ ke, “Mo ji Kristo ɔ, Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ Bi ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus told him: Simon, son of Jonah, you are blessed! You didn't discover this on your own. It was shown to you by my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “Simon, Yona bi, a gbaa mo! Ejakaa pi nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ je enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mo; se Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.

english_verse: I will give you the keys to the kingdom of heaven, and God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth. But he will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Ma ngɔ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nya safe ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mo. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa tsi nya ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa tsi nya ngɛ hiɔwe; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa ngmɛ blɔ ke a pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa ngmɛ blɔ ngɛ hiɔwe.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples not to tell anyone he was the Messiah. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Mark
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ka e kaseli ɔmɛ kita ke a ko de nɔ ko nɔ ko ke lɛ ji Kristo ɔ. Yesu tu e we amanehlu, kɛ e gbenɔ he munyu (Marko

english_verse: Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that. He said, “God would never let this happen to you, Lord!”
translation_verse: Petro tsɛ lɛ kɛ ya se, nɛ e bɔni e hɛ mi kami ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, enɛ ɔ ya je ngɛ se lokoo! Mawu ko ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ ba o nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus turned to Peter and said, “Satan, get away from me! You're in my way because you think like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Se Yesu plɛ e he nɛ e de Petro ke, “Jee ye nɔ kɛ ya se, Satan! O ngɛ ye nane kpatae. Ejakaa juɛmi nɛ ngɛ o yi mi ɔ, pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je, se nɔmlɔ adesa.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e kua e he, nɛ e wo e sɛumi tso ɔ, nɛ e nyɛɛ ye se.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will find it.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e wami ngɔ fɔɔ he ngɛ ye he ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ ekohu.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself? What would you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Mɛni se nɔ ko ma na ke e nine su je ɔ tsuo nɔ, se e laa e klaa? Dɛbi! Nɔ́ ko be nɛ e ma ngɔ ha nɛ e kɛ kpɔ e klaa a.

english_verse: I promise you some of those standing here will not die before they see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke ni komɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a be gboe kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ ma kaa matsɛ.”

english_verse: There in front of the disciples, Jesus was completely changed. His face was shining like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ lɛ hyɛe ɔ, e nɔmlɔ tso su tsake; e hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa pu, nɛ e tade ɔmɛ hiɛ futaa.

english_verse: Then the disciples understood Jesus was talking to them about John the Baptist. Jesus Heals a Boy (Mark
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ kɔ se kaa Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ he munyu e kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ. Yesu tsa jokuɛ nyumuyo ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi (Marko

english_verse: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the brothers James and John with him. They went up on a very high mountain where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Ligbi ekpa se ɔ, Yesu ngɔ Petro, kɛ Yakobo kɛ e nyɛmi Yohane, nɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ya yo gagaa ko nɔ ngɛ he ko banee.

english_verse: All at once Moses and Elijah were there talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, kaseli ɔmɛ na Mose, kɛ Eliya ba je a he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ a kɛ Yesu bɔni munyu tumi.

english_verse: So Peter said to him, “Lord, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, e hi kaa wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ! Ke o suɔ ɔ, ma pee bo tsu etɛ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, o nɔ kake, Mose nɔ́ kake, kɛ Eliya hu nɔ́ kake.”

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the shadow of a bright cloud passed over them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Benɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, bɔku hleii ko ba ha a nɔ, nɛ gbi je bɔku ɔ mi de ke, “Ye Bi nɛ i suɔ lɛ, nɛ i naa e he tsui ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue.”

english_verse: When the disciples heard the voice, they were so afraid they fell flat on the ground.
translation_verse: Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ nu gbi ɔ, a ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.

english_verse: But Jesus came over and touched them. He said, “Get up and don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ba a ngɔ, nɛ e ba ta a he, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ te si; nyɛ ko ye gbeye!”

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ deɔ ke ja Eliya ba lolo ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Elijah certainly will come and get everything ready.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Niinɛ, Eliya ma, nɛ e ma ba to níhi tsuo blɔ nɔ ekohu.

english_verse: In fact, he has already come. But the people did not recognize him and treated him just as they wanted to. They will soon make the Son of Man suffer in the same way.”
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Eliya ba momo, se nihi li lɛ, nɛ a pee lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ. Ja nɔuu Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hu maa na amanehlu ngɛ a dɛ mi.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples returned to the crowd. A man knelt in front of him
translation_verse: Benɛ a kpale kɛ ba nimli kpekpemi ɔ a ngɔ ɔ, nyumu ko ba Yesu ngɔ ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi,

english_verse: and said, “Lord, have pity on my son! He has a bad case of epilepsy and often falls into a fire or into water.
translation_verse: nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, naa ye binyumu ɔ mɔbɔ! Kɔkɔtsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ hiɔ ɔ deɔ nɔ́ ha lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Bɔɔ kɛkɛ e ya nɔ la mi; bɔɔ kɛkɛ e ya nɔ nyu mi.

english_verse: I brought him to your disciples, but none of them could heal him.”
translation_verse: I ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba o kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, se a nyɛ we nɛ a tsa lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people are too stubborn to have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy here.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ yi nɔ yayami bi nɛ nyɛ be hemi kɛ yemi! Mɛni be i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si? Mɛni be ma to ye tsui si ha nyɛ kɛ yaa si? Nyɛɛ ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Jesus spoke sternly to the demon. It went out of the boy, and right then he was healed.
translation_verse: Yesu nga mumi yayami ɔ yi nɛ e je e mi, nɛ a tsa lɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu.

english_verse: Later the disciples went to Jesus in private and asked him, “Why couldn't we force out the demon?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nigii, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nyɛ we nɛ waa hia mumi yayami ɔ?”

english_verse: While Jesus and his disciples were going from place to place in Galilee, he told them, “The Son of Man will be handed over to people
translation_verse: Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ tsuo a nya ba bua ngɛ Galilea a, Yesu de mɛ ke, “A miɔ nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kɛ wo nimli adesahi a dɛ mi

english_verse: who will kill him. But three days later he will rise to life.” All of this made the disciples very sad. Paying the Temple Tax
translation_verse: nɛ a gbe lɛ. Se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Mawu ma tle lɛ si.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao kaseli ɔmɛ wawɛɛ. Sɔlemi we ɔ he tó tsumi

english_verse: When Jesus and the others arrived in Capernaum, the collectors for the temple tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your teacher pay the temple tax?”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba Kapernaum ɔ, sɔlemi tsu ɔ he tó tsuli ɔmɛ ba Petro ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ tsɔɔlɔ ɔ woɔ tó ɔ lo?”

english_verse: “Yes, he does,” Peter answered. After they had returned home, Jesus went up to Peter and asked him, “Simon, what do you think? Do the kings of this earth collect taxes and fees from their own people or from foreigners?”
translation_verse: Petro he nɔ ke, “Ee, e woɔ.” Benɛ Petro ba we ɔ mi ɔ, Yesu sɛ hlami bi lɛ ke, “Simon, kɛ o susuɔ kɛɛ? Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ a dɛ a heɔ tó ngɛ? Ma mi bi a dɛ, aloo ma se bi a dɛ?”

english_verse: Peter answered, “From foreigners.” Jesus replied, “Then their own people don't have to pay.
translation_verse: Petro de lɛ ke, “Ma se bi a dɛ nɛ a heɔ ngɛ.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Saminya! Lɛɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ yeɔ a he mɔ!

english_verse: But we don't want to cause trouble. So go cast a line into the lake and pull out the first fish you hook. Open its mouth, and you will find a coin. Use it to pay your taxes and mine.”
translation_verse: Se bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa ko tsɔ̃ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nya a, yaa wo ɔ nya nɛ o ya fɔ gbowe. Kekleekle lo nɛ ma ba mi gbowe ɔ, sá lɛ. Hyɛ lo ɔ nya mi, nɛ o maa na sika nɛ maa su i kɛ mo tsuo wa sɔlemi we ɔ he tó ɔ nya. Ngɔɔ nɛ o kɛ wo wa tó ɔ.”

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, poke it out and get rid of it. You would be better off to go into life with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fires of hell. The Lost Sheep (Luke
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃, ke o hɛngmɛ haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, hiaa nɛ o sake ngɔ fɔ he! Afani nɛ o kɛ hɛngmɛ kake sɛ wami mi pe nɛ o ngɛ hɛngmɛ enyɔ, nɛ a ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ Abosiami a je la a mi. Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ to nɛ laa a he (Luka

english_verse: Don't you think you should show pity to someone else, as I did to you?”
translation_verse: Anɛ mo hu e sɛ kaa o naa o nyɛmi tsɔlɔ mɔbɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i na mo mɔbɔ ɔ lo?’

english_verse: But if you are as humble as this child, you are the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa e he si kaa jokuɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: And when you welcome one of these children because of me, you welcome me. Temptations To Sin (Mark
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ jokuɛyo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, imi e he ɔ nɛ. Kami nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami (Marko

english_verse: If the follower refuses to listen to them, report the matter to the church. Anyone who refuses to listen to the church must be treated like an unbeliever or a tax collector. Allowing and Not Allowing
translation_verse: Se ke e bui mɛ hu tue ɔ, yaa sɛɛ ha asafo ɔ. Ke e bɛɛe bui asafo ɔ hu tue ɔ, buu lɛ kaa wɔ jalɔ, loo tó tsulɔ. Nya tsimi kɛ blɔ ngmɛmi

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the deepest part of the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks!
translation_verse: “Hemi kɛ yemi nɛ jokuɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ, ke nɔ ko ha nɛ a ti nɔ kake hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ta a, afani nɛ a kɛ teji wɛ muɔ nɔ ɔ kuɛ, nɛ a sake lɛ kɛ fɔ wo mi he nɛ kuɔ.

english_verse: If your hand or foot causes you to sin, chop it off and throw it away! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed or lame than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: “Ke o nine, loo o nane haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, poo nɛ o sake ngɔ fɔ he! Afani nɛ o kɛ nine popoe, loo nane popoe sɛ wami mi pe nɛ o ngɛ nine enyɔ, loo nane enyɔ, nɛ a ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ neneene la a mi.

english_verse: If one of my followers sins against you, go and point out what was wrong. But do it in private, just between the two of you. If that person listens, you have won back a follower.
translation_verse: “Ke o nyɛmi pee mo yayami ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya tsɔɔ lɛ e tɔmi ɔ, o kɛ lɛ ni enyɔ kɛkɛ. Ke e bu mo tue ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛmi pee nyɛmi.

english_verse: Don't be cruel to any of these little ones! I promise you their angels are always with my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Se Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba nɛ e ba he nihi nɛ laa a a yi wami.]

english_verse: That's how it is with your Father in heaven. He doesn't want any of these little ones to be lost. When Someone Sins (Luke
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ sume kaa bimɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ laa. Nyɛmi nɛ peeɔ yayami

english_verse: But if that one refuses to listen, take along one or two others. The Scriptures teach that every complaint must be proven true by two or more witnesses.
translation_verse: Se ke e bui mo tue ɔ, ngɔɔ nɔ kake, loo ni enyɔ ngɔ piɛ o he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ni enyɔ, loo etɛ ɔmɛ maa pee odase yeli kɛ ma munyu ɔ nɔ mi.

english_verse: I promise that when any two of you on earth agree about something you are praying for, my Father in heaven will do it for you.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ ɔ hu, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ kpɛti ni enyɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ maa pee nyɛ nya kake kɛ kpa nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ ɔ, Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ maa pee ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Whenever two or three of you come together in my name, I am there with you. An Official Who Refused To Forgive
translation_verse: Ejakaa he nɛ ni enyɔ, loo ni etɛ bua a he nya ngɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ a kpɛti ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ́ ki ɔ he

english_verse: Peter came up to the Lord and asked, “How many times should I forgive someone who does something wrong to me? Is seven times enough?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, si enyɛmɛ ke ye nyɛmi tɔ ye nɔ nɛ ma kɛ pa lɛ? Si kpaago lo?”

english_verse: This story will show you what the kingdom of heaven is like: One day a king decided to call in his officials and ask them to give an account of what they owed him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Be ko ɔ, matsɛ ko hi si, nɛ e to kaa e maa hyɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a we akɔtaa mi.

english_verse: As he was doing this, one official was brought in who owed him
translation_verse: Benɛ e bɔni akɔtaa a mi hyɛmi ɔ, a kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ hɛɛ lɛ hiɔ sika fuu nitsɛ ba.

english_verse: But he didn't have any money to pay what he owed. The king ordered him to be sold, along with his wife and children and all he owned, in order to pay the debt.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e wo hiɔ ɔ, e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ fa ke a jua lɛ, kɛ e yo, kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ wo hiɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The official got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you every cent I owe!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ kpla si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, na tsui ha mi nɛ ma wo mo hiɔ ɔ tsuo!’

english_verse: The king felt sorry for him and let him go free. He even told the official that he did not have to pay back the money.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ hiɔ ɔ tsuo ke lɛ, nɛ e ngmɛɛ e he.

english_verse: The man got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you back.”
translation_verse: E nyɛmi tsɔlɔ ɔ kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ, na tsui ha mi nɛ ma wo mo hiɔ ɔ tsuo!’

english_verse: But the first official refused to have pity. Instead, he went and had the other official put in jail until he could pay what he owed.
translation_verse: Se lɛɛ e kplɛɛ we; mohu ɔ, e ya wo lɛ tsu kɛ yaa si e maa wo lɛ hiɔ ɔ.

english_verse: When some other officials found out what had happened, they felt sorry for the man who had been put in jail. Then they told the king what had happened.
translation_verse: Benɛ tsɔli kpa amɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, a hao wawɛɛ, nɛ a ho matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ a ya bɔ lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ba.

english_verse: The king called the first official back in and said, “You're an evil man! When you begged for mercy, I said you did not have to pay back a cent.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ ha nɛ a ya tsɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ e de lɛ ke, ‘Mo tsɔlɔ yiwutsotsɛ! Akɛnɛ o kpa mi pɛɛ he je ɔ, i ngɔ hiɔ nɛ ɔ tsuo ngɔ ke mo.

english_verse: The king was so angry that he ordered the official to be tortured until he could pay back everything he owed.
translation_verse: Matsɛ ɔ mi mi fu, nɛ e wo tsɔlɔ ɔ tsu, nɛ́ a gbla e tue hluu kɛ yaa si e maa wo hiɔ ɔ tsuo.”

english_verse: That is how my Father in heaven will treat you, if you don't forgive each of my followers with all your heart.
translation_verse: Yesu de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Ke nyɛ ngɔɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ a tɔmi ngɔ pɛ mɛ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi ɔ, bɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ maa pee nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus finished teaching, he left Galilee and went to the part of Judea east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ gbe nya a, e je Galilea kɛ ba Yudea kpokpa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se.

english_verse: Some people are unable to marry because of birth defects or because of what someone has done to their bodies. Others stay single in order to serve God better. Anyone who can accept this teaching should do so.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Mark
translation_verse: Ejakaa ní komɛ a he je nɛ nyumuhi ngɔɛ yo; ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ ja lɛ a fɔ mɛ; ni komɛ lɛɛ adesa lɛ pee mɛ ja; ni komɛ hu ngɔɛ yo ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ he. Tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ maa pɛtɛ he ɔ, e pee ja.” Yesu gbaa jokuɛwi (Marko

english_verse: Large crowds followed him, and he healed their sick.
translation_verse: Nihi fuu nyɛɛ e se, nɛ e tsa mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. They came up to him and asked, “Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for just any reason?”
translation_verse: Farisi bi komɛ ba e ngɔ ba ka lɛ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ wa mlaa a ngmɛɛ blɔ kaa nyumu fieɔ e yo ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ko he lo?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Don't you know in the beginning the Creator made a man and a woman?
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ kane we ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke sisije ɔ, bɔlɔ ɔ bɔ adesa nyumu kɛ yo lo?

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married. He becomes like one person with his wife.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu de ke, ‘Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyumu ma si e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e maa mɛtɛ e yo he, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a ma plɛ pee nɔ kake.’

english_verse: Then they are no longer two people, but one. And no one should separate a couple God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛ a pi nimli enyɔ hu, se mohu he lo kake. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ngɔ tsa a, nɔmlɔ kó gba mi.”

english_verse: The Pharisees asked Jesus, “Why did Moses say a man could write out divorce papers and send his wife away?”
translation_verse: Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je Mose wo mlaa ke nyumu nɛ ha yo fiemi womi nɛ e ngmɛɛ e he mɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You are so heartless! That's why Moses allowed you to divorce your wife. But from the beginning God did not intend it to be that way.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Mose ha nyɛ he blɔ ke nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ nyɛ yihi a he, ejakaa nyɛ tue wa; pi ja ji sane ɔ kɛ je sisije.

english_verse: I say if your wife has not committed some terrible sexual sin, you must not divorce her to marry someone else. If you do, you are unfaithful.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ngmɛɛ e yo he, nɛ pi kaa yo ɔ ya bɔ ajuama, nɛ e ma ya ngɔ yo kpa a, e puɛ gba.”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Only those people who have been given the gift of staying single can accept this teaching.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha a, mɛ pɛ a he e kɔɔ; pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ.

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus, so he could place his hands on them and pray for them. His disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, ni komɛ ngɔ jokuɛ tsɔwi kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ nɛ e ngɔ e nine ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ e sɔle ha mɛ. Se e kaseli ɔmɛ kuɛ wo ni ɔmɛ.

english_verse: A man came to Jesus and asked, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Ligbi ko ɔ, nyumu ko ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni nɔ́ kpakpa po ma pee nɛ ma na neneene wami?”

english_verse: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “Do not murder. Be faithful in marriage. Do not steal. Do not tell lies about others.
translation_verse: Niheyo ɔ bi ke, “Mɛni mlaahi?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Koo gbe nɔmlɔ; ko puɛ gba; koo ju; koo ye lakpa odase;

english_verse: After Jesus had placed his hands on the children, he left. A Rich Young Man (Mark
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ e nine ngɔ pue jokuɛwi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ. Niheyo niatsɛ ɔ (Marko

english_verse: Jesus said to him, “Why do you ask me about what is good? Only God is good. If you want to have eternal life, you must obey his commandments.”
translation_verse: Yesu hu bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ mi nɔ́ kpakpa he sane bie? Nɔ kake pɛ ji nɔ kpakpa. Ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o sɛ wami mi ɔ, ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.”

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Let the children come to me, and don't try to stop them! People who are like these children belong to God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ye ngɔ; nyɛ ko tsi mɛ blɔ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ji hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: But many who are now first will be last, and many who are last will be first.
translation_verse: Se nihi fuu nɛ sɛ hlami amlɔ nɛ ɔ ma ba pee sekpɛli, nɛ sekpɛli ma ba pee hlami sɛli.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother. And love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ; suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.”

english_verse: The young man said, “I have obeyed all of these. What else must I do?”
translation_verse: Niheyo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ; mɛni pa piɛ mi mɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If you want to be perfect, go sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o hi kɛ pi si ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya jua níhi nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ sika a kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ o ma na juetli ngɛ hiɔwe. Kɛkɛ ɔ, kpale kɛ ba nɛ o ba nyɛɛ ye se.”

english_verse: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Benɛ niheyo ɔ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho je lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa e ngɛ ní babauu.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “I tell you, it's terribly hard for rich people to get into the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, e maa wa ha niatsɛ kaa e maa sɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee ekohu ke e wa ha niatsɛ kaa e maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi pe kaa afukpɔngɔ maa gu abui hɛngmɛ mi.”

english_verse: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly surprised and asked, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ nu enɛ ɔ, a he mi po, nɛ a bi ke, “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ po yi wami a ma nyɛ he mɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus looked straight at them and said, “There are some things people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Yesu hyɛ mɛ too, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nimli be nyɛe maa pee enɛ ɔ; se Mawu lɛɛ e nyɛɔ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ!”

english_verse: Peter replied, “Remember, we have left everything to be your followers! What will we get?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro tu munyu nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa si nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ wa ba nyɛɛ o se. Mɛni wa ma na mɔ?”

translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, je he ɔ mi, benɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa hi e nyami sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ maa hi matsɛ sɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa kojo Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ.

translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma si wehi, loo nyɛminyumuhi, loo nyɛmiyihi, loo e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ, loo bimɛ, loo zugba ngɛ ye he ɔ, a maa to lɛ nane mi totoe lafa, nɛ a ma ha lɛ neneene wami.

english_verse: As Jesus was telling what the kingdom of heaven would be like, he said: Early one morning a man went out to hire some workers for his vineyard.
translation_verse: “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Ligbi ko ɔ, nyumu ko je kpo makɛ mla ya bɔ nihi apaa nɛ a ba tsu ní ngɛ e wai ngmɔ mi.

translation_verse: E kɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ ye nya kaa e ma ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika hiɔ yi kake nɛ ji apaatsɛ ligbi kake hiɔwo ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho e wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ya.

english_verse: About nine that morning, the man saw some other people standing in the market with nothing to do.

english_verse: He promised to pay them what was fair, if they would work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: E de mɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya tsu ní ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔ mi, nɛ ma wo nyɛ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa.’

english_verse: So they went. At noon and again about three in the afternoon he returned to the market. And each time he made the same agreement with others who were loafing around with nothing to do.

english_verse: Finally, about five in the afternoon the man went back and found some others standing there. He asked them, “Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?”

english_verse: “Because no one has hired us,” they answered. Then he told them to go work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: A he nɔ ke, ‘Nɔ ko ba bɔɛ wɔ apaa.’ E de mɛ ke, ‘Yoo, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya tsu ní ngɛ ye wai ngmɔ ɔ mi.’

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ! Osatotsɛmɛ! Nyɛ kuɔɔ wo, nɛ nyɛ kpaa zugbahi a nɔ kaa nyɛ maa na nɔ kake pɛ nɛ tsake pee Yuda no lo. Ke nyɛ na nɔ ko kaa ja a, nyɛ peeɔ lɛ nɔ nɛ sa Abosiami a je la a mi yami si enyɔ nɛ bla mohu pe nyɛ nitsɛmɛ po!

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.

english_verse: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
translation_verse: Hɛ yuyuili kuasiahi! Te nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa nɛɛ? Sika tsu ɔ, aloo sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ haa sika tsu ɔ peeɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ?

english_verse: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Ke nɔ ko kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ka kita a, lɔ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa. Se ke e kɛ nike ní nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ka kita nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ musu tloo lɛ.’

english_verse: Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
translation_verse: Hɛ yuyuili! Te nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa nɛɛ? Nike ní ɔ, aloo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ haa nike ní ɔ peeɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ?

translation_verse: “Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli kɛ Farisi bi! Musu tloo nyɛ! Osatotsɛmɛ! translation_verse: Se Mawu po ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ kpiti momo; kaa e pee we jã jinɛ adesa ko adesa ko yi be wami nae. Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e hla a a he je ɔ, a maa po jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ kpiti.

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come.
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu, ke nyɛ hu nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, nyɛɛ le kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ su si ta; e ngɛ agbo ɔ nya haa kɛ ma.

translation_verse: “Se jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, kɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a, nɔ ko nɔ ko li. Hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ li ɔ, Bi ɔ tete li; Tsɛ ɔ nɔ kake too lɛ le.

english_verse: They didn't know anything was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. This is how it will be when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae kɛ ya si nyu kpekpemi ɔ ba muɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho. Ligbi ɔ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba a, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu níhi maa ya nɔ.

translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyumuhi enyɔ maa hi ní tsue ngɛ ngmɔ si, nɛ a ma ba ngɔ nɔ kake, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake.

english_verse: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ; ejakaa nyɛ li ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma.

english_verse: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji tsɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ, kɛ ní lelɔ mɔ? Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to tsɔli kpa amɛ a nya, konɛ e ha mɛ a nya mi ngma ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma bɔni nyɛmimɛ tsɔli kpa amɛ kpa fiami, nɛ e kɛ dã tɔli ma ya ye ní, nɛ a maa nu ní.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will surely come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ, e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba ligbi nɛ e hyɛ we lɛ blɔ, kɛ ngmlɛfia nɛ e li.

translation_verse: E nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Ayekoo, tsɔlɔ kpakpa, kɛ anɔkualetsɛ! O ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ ko bɔɔ mi; ma ngɔ mo ngɔ to níhi fuu a nya. Ba nɛ o kɛ mi ba na bua jɔmi!’

translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he e sika a ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ sika tsu yi akpe nyɔngma a.

english_verse: When I was hungry, you gave me something to eat, and when I was thirsty, you gave me something to drink. When I was a stranger, you welcomed me,

translation_verse: Mɛni be wa na kaa nubwɔ ji mo, nɛ wa ha o ba to wɔ, aloo kaa o hɛɛ o he gu, nɛ wa wo mo tade?

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his left, “Get away from me! You are under God's curse. Go into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels!
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma de ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ e muɔ nɔ ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ nihi nɛ Mawu gbiɛ nyɛ, nyɛɛ je ye nɔ! Neneene la nɛ a dla ngɔ to Abosiami, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ ya sɛ mi!

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “Those people will be punished forever. But the ones who pleased God will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ maa ya neneene he hiami mi; se dali ɔmɛ lɛɛ a maa ya neneene wami mi.”

english_verse: “You know two days from now will be Passover. This is when the Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies and nailed to a cross.”
translation_verse: “Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, e piɛ ligbi enyɔ pɛ nɛ a maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɔ ha nɛ a ya sɛu lɛ.”

english_verse: Finally, Jesus returned to his disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ e kpale kɛ ba e kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ba de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mahe hwɔe kɛ mwɔɔ? Hyɛ! Ngmlɛfia a su ta, nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kɛ wo yayami peeli a dɛ mi.

translation_verse: He dlami ligbi nɛ nyɛɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ hɛ mi ji jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ. Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, Yosef nɛ je Arimatia pee kã nɛ e ya Pilato ngɔ ya bi lɛ Yesu gbogboe ɔ. Yosef nɛ ɔ, kpe ngua a mi no nɛ a buu saminya ji lɛ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ blɔ hyɛe.

english_verse: Some of the people standing there heard Jesus and said, “He is calling for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Benɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ nu ɔ, a de ke, “Hyɛ, e ngɛ Eliya tsɛe.”

english_verse: One of them ran and grabbed a sponge. After he had soaked it in wine, he put it on a stick and held it up to Jesus. He said, “Let's wait and see if Elijah will come and take him down!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a ti nɔ ko sa fo nɛ e ya ngɔ wo mi kutsa kɛ sɔ dã nɛ kuã mi, nɛ e kɛ ma tso nya ha lɛ ke e nu; nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ mlɛ! Wa maa hyɛ kaa Eliya maa ba ba je lɛ lo!”

translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ benɛ a hii si nɛ a ngɛ ní yee. E ka a hɛ mi, ejakaa nihi nɛ na lɛ benɛ e te si ɔ, a he we mɛ yi, nɛ a wa tue hulɔ.

english_verse: Then he told them: Go and preach the good news to everyone in the world.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya je ɔ mi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nimli adesahi tsuo.

english_verse: Everyone who believes me will be able to do wonderful things. By using my name they will force out demons, and they will speak new languages.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma he ye ɔ, a ma ha mɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ maa pee nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ: a maa hia mumi yayamihi ngɛ ye biɛ mi; a maa tu munyu ngɛ gbi kpahi a mi;

english_verse: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest by the name of Zechariah from the priestly group of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was from the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Benɛ Herode ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Yudea a, osɔfo ko hi si nɛ e biɛ ji Zakaria. Osɔfohi a kuu nɛ a tsɛɛ Abiya a mi no ji lɛ. E yo biɛ ji Elizabet, nɛ lɛ hu Aaron nina ji lɛ.

english_verse: Both of them were good people and pleased the Lord God by obeying all that he had commanded.
translation_verse: Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a yeɔ e mlaa amɛ, kɛ e fami ɔmɛ a nɔ́ sisiisi.

english_verse: But they did not have children. Elizabeth could not have any, and both Zechariah and Elizabeth were already old.
translation_verse: Se a be bi; ejakaa Elizabet ɔ yosa ji lɛ, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a bwɔ.

english_verse: One day Zechariah's group of priests were on duty, and he was serving God as a priest.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko ɔ, Zakaria ya ngɛ osɔfo ní tsumi tsue ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, e su a we osɔfo kuu ɔ nɔ kaa mɛ lɛ a ma sɔmɔ.

english_verse: All at once an angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah at the right side of the altar.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba da si ngɛ tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Zakaria.

english_verse: Zechariah was confused and afraid when he saw the angel.
translation_verse: Benɛ Zakaria na bɔfo ɔ, e tsui po, nɛ e ye gbeye.

english_verse: But the angel told him: Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayers. Your wife Elizabeth will have a son, and you must name him John.
translation_verse: Se bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Zakaria, koo ye gbeye! Mawu nu o kue fami ɔ. O yo Elizabet ma fɔ binyumu ha mo, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Yohane.

english_verse: His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad.
translation_verse: Ke a fɔ lɛ ɔ, o ma nya, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi, nɛ nihi babauu ma nya ja nɔuu.

english_verse: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
translation_verse: E ma ba pee nɔmlɔ nguaa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. E be wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa nue. Ke a fɔ lɛ pɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa ba e nɔ,

english_verse: John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: nɛ e ma ha nɛ Israel bi babauu maa kpale kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ, a Mawu ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: He will go ahead of the Lord with the same power and spirit that Elijah had. And because of John, parents will be more thoughtful of their children. And people who now disobey God will begin to think as they ought to. This is how John will get people ready for the Lord.
translation_verse: E maa sɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hlami kɛ he wami, kɛ kã kaa gbalɔ Eliya. E maa pee tsɛmɛ kɛ a bimɛ kake ekohu. E ma ha nihi nɛ bui Mawu tue ɔ maa kpale ba nyɛɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ a blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Nɛ nihi nɛ Mawu nitsɛ hla a, e ma dla mɛ ngɔ to lɛ.”

english_verse: Zechariah said to the angel, “How will I know this is going to happen? My wife and I are both very old.”
translation_verse: Zakaria bi bɔfo ɔ ke, “Kɛ ma pee kɛ le enɛ ɔ kɛɛ? Hyɛ, nɔmoyo ji mi, nɛ ye yo hu bwɔ!”

english_verse: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Imi ji Gabriel, nɛ i daa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. A tsɔ mi ke i kɛ mo ba sɛɛ ní, nɛ́ ma ngɔ manye munyu nɛ ɔ ba ha mo.

english_verse: You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.”
translation_verse: O he we ye sɛ gbi ɔ yi; se kɛ̃ e maa ba mi ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. Akɛnɛ o he we yi he je ɔ, o nya ma ma, nɛ o be nyɛe maa tu munyu hu kɛ yaa su ligbi ɔ nɛ si nɛ i wo mo ɔ maa ba mi.”

english_verse: The crowd was waiting for Zechariah and kept wondering why he was staying in the temple so long.
translation_verse: Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, ma a ngɛ Zakaria blɔe, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa kaa e ya kɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ.

english_verse: When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.
translation_verse: Benɛ e je kpo ɔ, e nyɛ we nɛ e kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kɔ se kaa Mawu ya je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Akɛnɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e tu munyu he je ɔ, e kɛ e nine pee okadi kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.
translation_verse: Be nɛ Zakaria sɔmɔmi be ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nya ta a, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.

translation_verse: Be bɔɔ se ɔ, e yo Elizabet ba ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e laa e he nyɔhiɔ enuɔ.

english_verse: “What the Lord has done for me will keep people from looking down on me.” An Angel Tells about the Birth of Jesus
translation_verse: E de ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ ye he! Ye hɛ mi nɛ pue si ngɛ ma hɛ mi ɔ, e ha nɛ e se po.” A gba kaa a ma fɔ Yesu

translation_verse: Benɛ Elizabet hɔ ɔ ye nyɔhiɔ ekpa a, Mawu tsɔ bɔfo Gabriel ɔ kɛ ya Galilea ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Nazaret ɔ.

translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Mo he manye! Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ mo ngɛ, nɛ e gbaa mo babauu!”

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Maria hao ngɛ ngami nɛ bɔfo ɔ nga lɛ ɔ he, nɛ e ná nɛ e nu sisi.

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Se bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Maria, koo ye gbeye; Mawu na o he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, o ma na mi, nɛ o ma fɔ binyumu, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Yesu.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: E ma ba pee nɔmlɔ nguaa, nɛ a ma tsɛ lɛ ke Hiɔwe No ɔ Bi. Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu maa pee lɛ matsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee e nɛ̃ David ɔ.

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: E maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene; e matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble!”

english_verse: Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
translation_verse: Maria de bɔfo ɔ ke, “I li nyumu. Lɛ kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ enɛ ɔ maa ba mi?”

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa ba o nɔ; Hiɔwe No ɔ he wami ɔ maa ba o nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, bi klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ o ma fɔ ɔ, a ma tsɛ lɛ Mawu Bi.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Na nɛ o le kaa o weku no Elizabet, nɛ bwɔ ɔ hu hɛɛ hɔ. Sa a, a le lɛ kaa yosa; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hɛɛ mi nyɔhiɔ ekpa.

translation_verse: Maria de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mawayo ji mi; bɔ nɛ o de ɔ, e ba mi ja.” Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ si lɛ. Maria ya slaa Elizabet

translation_verse: E kɛ we nɛ Maria dla e he, nɛ e pue nɔ esɔ kɛ ho ma ko mi ya ngɛ Yudea yo nɔ zugba a mi.

english_verse: She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth.

translation_verse: Benɛ Elizabet nu nɛ Maria nga lɛ ɔ, bimwɔyo ɔ hua ngɛ e mi mi. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba Elizabet nɔ,

translation_verse: Benɛ i nu o ngami ɔ pɛ bimwɔyo ɔ hua ngɛ ye mi mi kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: A gbaa mo kaa o he ye kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi nɛ a de mo ɔ maa ba mi!” Maria la kɛ je Mawu yi

translation_verse: Maria ke, “I ngɔ ye tsui tsuo kɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi jee.

translation_verse: Ye bua jɔ, kaa Mawu ji ye yi wami helɔ,

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: ejakaa e kai imi, e mawayo humi ɔ! Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nihi tsuo ma tsɛ mi yo nɛ a gbaa lɛ,

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: ejakaa Mawu Ope ɔ pee ní nguanguahi ha mi. E biɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.
translation_verse: E naa nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ ɔ mɔbɔ yi nɔhi tsuo.

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: E kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ gbɛ he nɔ woli, kɛ a juɛmi yaya a tsuo ngɔ fĩa.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: E kpa matsɛmɛ nguanguahi kɛ je a sɛhi a nɔ, nɛ e wó humihi a nɔ.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: E ha hwɔ hwɔli ní kpakpahi nɛ a ye, nɛ a tɔ; se niatsɛmɛ lɛɛ e fie mɛ kɛ ho kɛ a dɛ gu.

english_verse: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.
translation_verse: Si nɛ e wo wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e ye nɔ; nɛ e ba piɛ e tsɔlɔ Israel he.

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: E kai Abraham, nɛ e na lɛ, kɛ e nina tsuo mɔbɔ kɛ yaa neneene!”

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Maria hi Elizabet ngɔ maa pee nyɔhiɔ etɛ loko e kpale kɛ ho e ma mi ya. A fɔ Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ

english_verse: When Elizabeth's son was born,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Elizabet fɔmi be su, nɛ e fɔ binyumu.

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: E paka bi, kɛ e weku li nu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbaa lɛ babauu, nɛ a ba nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba nya.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Benɛ bimwɔyo ɔ na otsi ɔ, a ba, konɛ a ba po lɛ, nɛ jinɛ a hla kaa a kɛ e tsɛ Zakaria biɛ maa wo lɛ.

english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: Se e nyɛ de ke, “Dɛbi! A ma tsɛ lɛ Yohane.”

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: A de lɛ ke, “Nɔ ko tsa be o weku ɔ mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ja!”

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a pee okadi kɛ bi bimwɔyo ɔ tsɛ ɔ biɛ nɛ e suɔ nɛ a tsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed.
translation_verse: Zakaria bi ke a ha lɛ tso sleeti, nɛ e ngma ngɛ nɔ ke, “E biɛ ji Yohane.” Enɛ ɔ pee ni ɔmɛ tsuo nyakpɛ.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Gbeye nu e paka bi ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ sane nɛ ba nɛ ɔ gbɛ fĩa Yudea yoku zugba a tsuo.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ nu ɔ susu he saminya, nɛ a bi ke, “Mɛni nɔmlɔ po jokuɛ nɛ ɔ ma ba pee?” Ejakaa e fɔɔ si paa kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he wami ɔ ngɛ e nɔ. Zakaria gbami

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba Yohane tsɛ Zakaria nɔ, nɛ e gba ke,

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ha wa je Nyɔmtsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi. Ejakaa e ba piɛ e ma a he, nɛ e ha nɛ a ye a he.

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: E je kpɔlɔ kpanaa nɛ ji e tsɔlɔ David nina ha wɔ.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: E wo si blema lokoo kɛ gu e gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: ke e ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je wa he nyɛli, kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ wɔ ɔ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: E de ke e maa na wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e maa ye e somi klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: by being holy and good as long as we live.
translation_verse: nɛ waa hi klɔuklɔu, nɛ waa pee nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ e hɛ mi wa wami be ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: “Nɛ mo, ye bi, a ma tsɛ mo Hiɔwe No ɔ gbalɔ. O maa sɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hlami, nɛ o ma dla e blɔ ɔ kɛ to lɛ.

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: O ma de e ma a ke Mawu maa ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ, nɛ e ma he a yi wami.

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: Wa Mawu ɔ mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ. E ma kpɔ wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mɔtu pu la fieɔ diblii kɛ yaa se ɔ.

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: E ma kpɛ kɛ je hiɔwe ha nihi tsuo nɛ hii si ngɛ gbenɔ hɔ̃ diblii mi, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ kɛ ba he jɔmi blɔ ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Jokuɛ ɔ ba wa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso, kɛ mumi mi tsuo, nɛ e hi nga a nɔ kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Israel.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Kaisare Augusto fa ke a kane nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Roma nɔ yemi he ɔ, nɛ a ngma a biɛ.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyumu ko ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simeon. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ; e yeɔ Mawu gbeye, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ blɔ hyɛe nɛ Mawu ba he Israel yi wami. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ e mi.

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji kekleekle nɛ a kane nɔ be mi nɛ Kerinio ngɛ amlaalo yee ngɛ Siria.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi ya, konɛ a ya ngma e biɛ.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Yosef je Nazaret ma a mi ngɛ Galilea, nɛ e ya Betlehem ngɛ Yudea, he nɛ a fɔ Matsɛ David ngɛ ɔ. Yosef ya lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa David nina ji lɛ.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: E ya, konɛ e kɛ Maria, yo nɛ a bi si ha lɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ a ya ngma a biɛ.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: E fɔ e kekleekle bi, nɛ e ngɔ bo kɛ blaa lɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ lohwehi a niye ní daka mi; ejakaa a nɛ blɔ ngɛ nibwɔhi a to he ɔ. To hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: To hyɛli komɛ ngɛ a tohi a he bue nyɔ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi nɔuu.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami kpɛ kɛ bɔle mɛ, nɛ a ye gbeye wawɛɛ.

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: Se bɔfo ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye! I hɛɛ manye munyu nɛ ma ha Israel ma a tsuo ma na bua jɔmi babauu kɛ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, a fɔ nyɛ yi wami helɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo ɔ ngɛ David ma a mi!

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa le kaa ye sane ɔ ngɛ mi ji nyɛ maa na bimwɔyo nɛ a kɛ bo blaa lɛ, nɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ lohwehi a niye ní daka mi.”

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Si kake too ɔ, hiɔwe bɔfohi a ta nguaa ba piɛ bɔfo ɔ he, nɛ a la kɛ je Mawu yi ke,

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Benɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ si to hyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a, to hyɛli ɔmɛ de a he ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ya Betlehem, nɛ wa ya hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je tsɔɔ wɔ nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a ho nɔuu, nɛ a ya na Maria, kɛ Yosef, kɛ bimwɔyo ɔ hu nɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ lohwehi a niye ní daka a mi.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Benɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ na bimwɔyo ɔ, a de fɔli ɔmɛ nɔ́ nɛ a sɛɛ ha mɛ nɛ kɔɔ bimwɔyo ɔ he ɔ.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Maria kɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ to e yi mi, nɛ e susuɔ he be tsuaa be.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: To hyɛli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho. Benɛ a yaa a tsuo a ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ Mawu yi jee ngɛ níhi nɛ a nu, kɛ níhi nɛ a na a he. Nɔ́ nɛ bɔfo ɔ sɛɛ ha mɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ tutuutu nɛ a ya na a nɛ. A wo Yesu biɛ

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Otsi se, benɛ jokuɛ ɔ pomi be su ɔ, a wo lɛ biɛ ke Yesu, biɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ ha lɛ loko Maria ngɔ e hɔ ɔ. Maria kɛ Yosef ngɔ Yesu kɛ ya sɔlemi we ɔ

english_verse: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, be ba su nɛ a maa pee kusumi nɛ a kɛ tsukɔ a he kaa bɔ nɛ Mose mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ bimwɔyo ɔ kɛ ya Yerusalem, konɛ a kɛ lɛ ya tsɔɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ

english_verse: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ya sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mlaa a mi ke, “A ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ tsɔwi enyɔ kɛ sã bɔ” ɔ.

english_verse: and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ je tsɔɔ lɛ ke e be gboe kɛ yaa si e maa na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ ngɔ Simeon kɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ. Yesu fɔli ɔmɛ hu ngɔ bimwɔyo ɔ kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ, konɛ a ba pee kusumi ha lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Simeon he bimwɔyo ɔ ngɔ fɔ e kɔni bɔkɔ mi, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e de ke,

english_verse: “Lord, I am your servant, and now I can die in peace, because you have kept your promise to me.
translation_verse: “Nyɔmtsɛ, jehanɛ lɛɛ o ye o siwo ɔ nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ ma gbo ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.

english_verse: Your mighty power is a light for all nations, and it will bring honor to your people Israel.”
translation_verse: Lɛ ji la nɛ maa tsɔɔ ma je li ɔmɛ blɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ; nɛ e maa wo o ma Israel hɛ mi nyami.”

english_verse: Then he blessed them and told Mary, “This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him,
translation_verse: Simeon gbaa mɛ, nɛ e de bimwɔyo ɔ nyɛ Maria ke, “Mawu hla jokuɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ha nihi babauu a hɛ mi kpatami, kɛ nihi babauu hu a yi wami hemi ngɛ Israel. E maa pee okadi ko nɛ je Mawu ngɔ, nɛ́ nimli babauu maa tu munyu kɛ si;

english_verse: and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.” Anna Speaks about the Child Jesus
translation_verse: nɛ e ma je a tsui mi laami sanehi kpo. Nɛ mo nitsɛ hu o maa ye kɔmɔ wawɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ ha gbɔ o mi mi.”

english_verse: The prophet Anna was also there in the temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. In her youth she had been married for seven years, but her husband died.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ yo yomoyo kotokoto ko hi si nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ana. E tsɛ biɛ ji Fanuel, nɛ e je Asher wɛtso ɔ mi. E kɛ e huno hi si jeha kpaago pɛ ngɛ e yihe mi,

english_verse: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free. The Return to Nazareth
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu ɔ, Ana hu ba lejɛ ɔ. E ba je Mawu yi, nɛ e tu bimwɔyo ɔ he munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Mawu blɔ hyɛe nɛ e kpɔ Yerusalem ma a. A kpale kɛ ho Nazaret ya

english_verse: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yosef kɛ Maria pee kusumi ɔmɛ tsuo gbe nya kaa bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ, a kpale a se kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma Nazaret, nɛ ngɛ Galilea a ya.

english_verse: The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him. The Boy Jesus in the Temple
translation_verse: Jokuɛ ɔ ba wa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi; e le ní hulɔ, nɛ Mawu gbaa lɛ babauu. Yesu ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ

english_verse: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover.
translation_verse: Daa jeha a, Yesu fɔli ɔmɛ yaa Yerusalem ya yeɔ Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ.

english_verse: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, a ya Yerusalem kaa bɔ nɛ kusumi ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.
translation_verse: Benɛ nyami be ɔ nya ta, nɛ Yosef, kɛ Maria kpale a se kɛ yaa Nazaret ɔ, a li tete kaa jokuɛ Yesu ɔ tlɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him.
translation_verse: A susu kaa e kɛ ni komɛ sɛ hlami kɛ ho, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nyɛɛ ligbi mluku, nɛ jehanɛ a bɔni lɛ hlami ngɛ a weku li, kɛ a huɛmɛ a ngɔ.

english_verse: When they could not find him with their relatives and friends, they went back to Jerusalem and started looking for him there.
translation_verse: Se a ya nɛ lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpale a se kɛ ba Yerusalem ekohu ba hla lɛ.

english_verse: Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.
translation_verse: Ligbi etɛne ɔ, a ya na lɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ e hii si ngɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti; e ngɛ mɛ tue bue, nɛ e ngɛ mɛ ní bie.

english_verse: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lɛ tue bue ɔ a nya kpɛ a he; ejakaa a na kaa e juɛmi mi kuɔ, nɛ e ngɛ níhi a heto hae pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
translation_verse: Benɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ na lɛ ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he; nɛ e nyɛ bi lɛ ke, “Ye bi, mɛni he je nɛ o pee wɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Hyɛ, i kɛ o tsɛ kpa si hla mo kɛ hɛdɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?”
translation_verse: E bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae? Anɛ nyɛ li kaa e sa kaa ma hi Tsaatsɛ we ɔ lo?”

english_verse: But they did not understand what he meant.
translation_verse: Se mɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de mɛ ɔ, a nui sisi.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
translation_verse: Yesu kɛ mɛ kpale a se kɛ ho Nazaret ya, nɛ e ba e he si ha mɛ. E nyɛ kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo to e yi mi, nɛ e susuɔ he be tsuaa be.

english_verse: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_verse: Yesu ba wa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi, nɛ e le ní kɛ ya nɔ. Nɛ Mawu kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo ná e he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Tó tsuli komɛ hu ba nɛ e sɔle mɛ. A bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni sa wɔ peemi?”

english_verse: Do something to show that you really have given up your sins. Don't start saying you belong to Abraham's family. God can turn these stones into children for Abraham.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee níhi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui. Nyɛ ko susu kaa ke nyɛ de ke nyɛ nɛ̃ ji Abraham ɔ kɛkɛ tue gblami ko be nyɛ nɔ bae. I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Mawu ma nyɛ ngɔ tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee Abraham nina!

english_verse: But to Herod the ruler, he said, “It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife.” John also said Herod had done many other bad things.
translation_verse: Se Yohane kã amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma Herode hɛ mi, ejakaa Herode ya ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi Filipo e yo Herodia; Herode pee yayami kpahi fuu hu ngɔ piɛ he.

english_verse: Annas and Caiaphas were the Jewish high priests. At that time God spoke to Zechariah's son John, who was living in the desert.
translation_verse: Ana kɛ Kayafa hu ngɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma pe kulaa yee. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu kɛ sɛ gbi ha Zakaria bi Yohane ngɛ nga a nɔ.

english_verse: Isaiah the prophet wrote about John when he said, “In the desert someone is shouting, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaya womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. “Nɔ ko ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ nga a nɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ dla blɔ ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ je blɔ tlɔmɔɔ ha lɛ, nɛ e nyɛɛ nɔ!

translation_verse: Nihi babauu ba Yohane ngɔ, konɛ e sɔle mɛ. Nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ sinɔhi a nina, mɛnɔ wo nyɛ ga ke nyɛɛ tu tue gblami nɛ Mawu kɛ ma nyɛ nɔ ɔ nya fo?

english_verse: The crowds asked John, “What should we do?”
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Some soldiers asked him, “And what about us? What do we have to do?” John told them, “Don't force people to pay money to make you leave them alone. Be satisfied with your pay.”
translation_verse: Ta buli komɛ hu ba bi lɛ ke, “Wɔ hu mɛni sa wɔ peemi?” E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko fia ojo! Nyɛ ko po sane ngɔ fɔ nɔ ko nɔ yaka gu nɛ nyɛ kpɔ sika ngɛ e dɛ! Nyɛ hiɔwo nɛ sa nyɛ hɛ mi!”

english_verse: John said, “I am just baptizing with water. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yohane de mɛ ke, “Imi lɛɛ nyu nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ sɔlee, se nɔ ko ma ngɛ ye se nɛ pe mi, nɛ i sɛ kaa i pɛneɔ e tokota nya kpa po. Lɛɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu, kɛ la nɛ e kɛ maa sɔle nyɛ.

english_verse: In many different ways John preached the good news to the people.
translation_verse: Yohane gu blɔ slɔɔtohi a nɔ nɛ e kɛ wo ni ɔmɛ he wami benɛ e ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛe ɔ.

english_verse: Finally, Herod put John in jail, and this was the worst thing he had done. The Baptism of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Se nɔ́ nɛ pe lɛ tsuo ji kaa e nu Yohane ngɔ wo tsu mi. A sɔle Yesu (Mateo

translation_verse: nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kple si kɛ ba e nɔ kɛ su nɛ ngɛ kaa lahuɛ. Nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke, “Mo ji ye bi nɛ i suɔ; i naa o he bua jɔmi saminya.” Yesu weku kpa (Mateo

translation_verse: A ngma hulɔ ke, ‘A maa hɛɛ mo dɔdɔɔdɔ ngɛ a dɛ mi, konɛ o nane ko tɛ nɔ́.’ ”

english_verse: After the sun had set, people with all kinds of diseases were brought to Jesus. He put his hands on each one of them and healed them.
translation_verse: Benɛ pu nɔ si ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ hiɔ slɔɔtohi ngɛ a he ɔ, ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ. Yesu ngɔ e nine pue a nɔ kakaaka, nɛ e tsa mɛ tsuo.

english_verse: The devil said to Jesus, “If you are God's Son, tell this stone to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Abosiami de lɛ ke, “Ke Mawu Bi ji mo ɔ, ha nɛ tɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ plɛ abolo.”

english_verse: Then the devil led Jesus up to a high place and quickly showed him all the nations on earth.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Abosiami ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo tsɔɔ lɛ hɛngmɛfia.

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus to Jerusalem and had him stand on top of the temple. The devil said, “If you are God's Son, jump off.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Abosiami ngɔ Yesu kɛ ba Yerusalem, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba da sɔlemi we ɔ yi mi ploplooplo ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ke Mawu Bi ji mo ɔ, sake o he ngɔ fia si.

english_verse: He taught in the Jewish synagogues, and everyone praised him. The People of Nazareth Turn against Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: E tsɔɔ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ nihi tsuo je e yi. A kua Yesu ngɛ Nazaret (Mateo

translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ba Nazaret, he nɛ a lɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, e ya kpe he ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pɔɔ peemi ɔ. E te si, konɛ e kane ngmami ɔ,

english_verse: “The Lord's Spirit has come to me, because he has chosen me to tell the good news to the poor. The Lord has sent me to announce freedom for prisoners, to give sight to the blind, to free everyone who suffers,
translation_verse: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ ngɛ ye nɔ; Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hla mi ke ma ngɔ sane kpakpa a ba ha nihi nɛ a ni ngɛ mɔbɔ. E tsɔ mi ke ma ba fiɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ nyɔguɛhi, nyɛ ye nyɛ he oo nyɛ ye nyɛ he! Hɛ yuyuili, nyɛ maa hyɛ nɔ́ oo nyɛ maa hyɛ nɔ!’ E tsɔ mi ke ma ba kpɔ nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ,
