translation_verse: nɛ ma de ke, be ɔ su nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma he e ma a yi wami.”

english_verse: Jesus closed the book, then handed it back to the man in charge and sat down. Everyone in the synagogue looked straight at Jesus.
translation_verse: Yesu nga womi ɔ, nɛ e kpale ngɔ ha sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e ho ya hi si. Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ bɔni lɛ hyɛmi too.

english_verse: All the people started talking about Jesus and were amazed at the wonderful things he said. They kept on asking, “Isn't he Joseph's son?”
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ tsuo tu e he munyu kpakpa, nɛ munyuhi nɛ a he jua wa nɛ je e nya a ha a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a bi ke, “Anɛ pi Yosef bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: You will certainly want to tell me this saying, “Doctor, first make yourself well.” You will tell me to do the same things here in my own hometown that you heard I did in Capernaum.
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “I heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ maa bu mi abɛ nɛ ɔ ke, ‘Tsopatsɛ, tsa mo nitsɛ o he.’ Nyɛ ma de mi hulɔ ke nihi nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ i pee ngɛ Kapernaum ɔ, ma pee ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye ma mi.”

english_verse: But you can be sure that no prophets are liked by the people of their own hometown.
translation_verse: Yesu ya nɔ de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke a bui gbalɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi.

english_verse: Once during the time of Elijah there was no rain for three and a half years, and people everywhere were starving. There were many widows in Israel,
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ bu tue! Niinɛ, gbalɔ Eliya be ɔ mi ɔ, yalɔyihi babauu ngɛ Israel. Hiɔmi nɛ́ jeha etɛ kɛ fa sɔuu, nɛ hwɔ nɛ nya wa ba zugba a tsuo nɔ.

english_verse: but Elijah was sent only to a widow in the town of Zarephath near the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: Se a tsɔ we Eliya kɛ yɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔ, pe yalɔyo ɔ nɛ hi Zarefat ngɛ Sidon ɔ pɛ e ngɔ.

english_verse: During the time of the prophet Elisha, many men in Israel had leprosy. But no one was healed, except Naaman who lived in Syria.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ se hu, gbalɔ Elisha be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi fuu ngɛ Israel nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ a he. Se a tsa we a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko, pe Naeman, Siria no ɔ pɛ.”

english_verse: But Jesus slipped through the crowd and got away. A Man with an Evil Spirit (Mark
translation_verse: se e nyɛɛ kɛ gu a kpɛti kɛ je. Nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi (Marko

english_verse: Jesus went to the town of Capernaum in Galilee and taught the people on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu ba Kapernaum ma a mi ngɛ Galilea, nɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, e ya kpe he ɔ ya tsɔɔ ní.

english_verse: There in the synagogue was a man with an evil spirit. He yelled out,
translation_verse: Nyumu ko ngɛ kpe he ɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi. E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke,

english_verse: They all were amazed and kept saying to each other, “What kind of teaching is this? He has power to order evil spirits out of people!”
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ tsuo a he mi po, nɛ a bi a he ke, “Mɛni nyakpɛ munyu po ji nɛ ɔ? Nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ he wami ngaa mumi yayamihi a yi, kɛkɛ a jeɔ kpo!”

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Many People (Matthew
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu he sane gbɛ fĩa lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi tsuo. Yesu tsa nihi fuu (Mateo

english_verse: Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simon's home. When Jesus got there, he was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick with a high fever.
translation_verse: Yesu je kpe he ɔ, nɛ e ya sɛ Simon we ɔ mi. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Simon nganyɛ fɔɔ si kɛ asla nɛ nya wa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke e ba hyɛ yo ɔ.

english_verse: Demons went out of many people and shouted, “You are the Son of God!” But Jesus ordered the demons not to speak because they knew he was the Messiah.
translation_verse: Mumi yayamihi hu je nihi fuu a mi, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke, “Mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ!” Se Yesu nga mumi yayami ɔmɛ a yi, nɛ e ha we nɛ a tu munyu, ejakaa a le kaa lɛ ji Kristo ɔ. Yesu fiɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ (Marko

english_verse: The next morning Jesus went out to a place where he could be alone, and crowds came looking for him. When they found him, they tried to stop him from leaving.
translation_verse: E nɔ jena a, Yesu je ma a mi, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho he ko banee ya. Ni ɔmɛ bɔni lɛ hlami, nɛ benɛ a na lɛ ɔ, a ka kaa a maa tsi e nya, konɛ e ko je a ngɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “People in other towns must hear the good news about God's kingdom. This is why I was sent.”
translation_verse: Se e de mɛ ke, “E hia kaa ma ya fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane kpakpa a ngɛ ma kpa amɛ a mi hulɔ, ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ mi ke ma ba tsu.”

english_verse: So he kept on preaching in the synagogues in Judea.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fiɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ kpa zugba a nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: But Jesus would often go to some place where he could be alone and pray. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Walk (Matthew
translation_verse: Se ke pee ɔ, e gblaa e he si kɛ yaa nga a nɔ he ko banee, nɛ e ya sɔleɔ. Yesu tsa nyumu ko nɛ hule pue si (Mateo

translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu na hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ni ɔmɛ kɛ tsu ní ɔ, e de hiɔtsɛ ɔ ke, “Maminyumu! A kɛ o he yayami ɔmɛ pa mo.”

english_verse: Jesus got into the boat that belonged to Simon and asked him to row it out a little way from the shore. Then Jesus sat down in the boat to teach the crowd.
translation_verse: Yesu ya sɛ lɛ ɔ kake mi, nɛ e de Simon nɛ ji lɛtsɛ ɔ ke e tsɛ̃ lɛ ɔ yi se bɔɔ kɛ wo pa a mi. Yesu hi si ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi jehanɛ, nɛ e bɔni ma kpekpemi ɔ ní tsɔɔmi.

english_verse: “Master,” Simon answered, “we have worked hard all night long and have not caught a thing. But if you tell me to, I will let the nets down.”
translation_verse: Simon he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa tsu ní wawɛɛ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ wa nɛ nɔ́ ko. Se kɛ̃, akɛnɛ mo lɛ o de ɔ, ma pue ya a.”

english_verse: They did this and caught so many fish that their nets began ripping apart.
translation_verse: A hlui kɛ ya he nɛ pa a mi kuɔ ngɛ, nɛ a pue ya a. A gbe lo babauu, nɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ ya a hía.

english_verse: Then they signaled for their partners in the other boat to come and help them. The men came, and together they filled the two boats so full that they both began to sink.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a fɔ a huɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ kpa a mi ɔ nine ke a ba piɛ a he. A ba, nɛ a ba wo lɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi lo tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ ya si lɛ ɔmɛ miɔ nɛ a ma mu.

english_verse: His partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were surprised too. Jesus told Simon, “Don't be afraid! From now on you will bring in people instead of fish.”
translation_verse: Simon huɛmɛ, Yakobo, kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ hu a he mi po ja nɔuu. Jehanɛ Yesu de Simon ke, “Koo ye gbeye! Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, o maa hɛ nimli ha mi kaa bɔ nɛ a hɛɛ lo.”

translation_verse: A sã lɛ ɔmɛ kɛ fɔ kpo, nɛ a si a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ Yesu se. Yesu tsa nyumu ko (Mateo

translation_verse: Se Yesu he sane gbɛ fĩa he tsuaa he mohu. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nimli babauu baa e ngɔ, konɛ a ba bu lɛ tue, nɛ a tsa a hiɔhi ha mɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they went up on the roof, where they removed some tiles and let the mat down in the middle of the room.
translation_verse: Se nimli kpekpemi ɔ a he je ɔ, a nɛ blɔ nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kuɔ kɛ ya tsu ɔ yi mi, nɛ a ya kpɔ zu longo ɔ eko, nɛ a siu hiɔtsɛ ɔ, kɛ e sa a kɛ gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ ya fɔ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, ngɛ Yesu hɛ mi.

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?
translation_verse: Ke a de ke, ‘A ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mo’ ɔ, tse lɔ ɔ demi wa pe kaa a ma de ke, ‘Tee si nɛ o nyɛɛ lo?’

english_verse: But now you will see that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” Jesus then said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk home.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɛ he blɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi kaa e ngɔɔ yayamihi kɛ paa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de nyumu ɔ nɛ hule ɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee ke tee si! Ngɔɔ o sa a, nɛ o ho we mi ya!”

english_verse: At once the man stood up in front of everyone. He picked up his mat and went home, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Amlɔ ɔ, nyumu ɔ te si ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi; e ngɔ sa a nɛ e hwɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ e je kɛ ho we mi ya. Benɛ e yaa a tsuo e ngɛ Mawu yi jee.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed and praised God. What they saw surprised them, and they said, “We have seen a great miracle today!” Jesus Chooses Levi (Matthew
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo a he mi po, nɛ a ye gbeye, nɛ a je Mawu yi, nɛ a de ke, “Wa na nyakpɛ ní mwɔnɛ ɔ!” Yesu tsɛ Levi (Mateo

english_verse: Later, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu je kpo, nɛ e ya na tó tsulɔ ko nɛ hii si ngɛ tó tsumi he ɔ; e biɛ ji Levi. Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ba nyɛɛ ye se!”

english_verse: In his home Levi gave a big dinner for Jesus. Many tax collectors and other guests were also there.
translation_verse: Levi ngmɛ okplɔɔ nguaa ngɛ e we ɔ mi kɛ wo Yesu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ tó tsuli, kɛ ni kpahi fuu kɛ mɛ ba ye ní.

english_verse: The Pharisees and some of their teachers of the Law of Moses grumbled to Jesus' disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with these tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisi bi komɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli komɛ tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tó tsuli, kɛ yayami peeli ngɛ ní yee, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ní nue ɔ?”

english_verse: I didn't come to invite good people to turn to God. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Matthew
translation_verse: I bɛ dali tsɛmi; mohu ɔ, i ba nɛ ma ba tsɛ yayami peeli, konɛ a tsake a tsui.” Hwɔ hami (Mateo

english_verse: Some people said to Jesus, “John's followers often pray and go without eating, and so do the followers of the Pharisees. But your disciples never go without eating or drinking.”
translation_verse: Ni komɛ ba de Yesu ke, “Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ pɔɔ hwɔ hami kɛ sɔlemi, nɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a kaseli ɔmɛ hu peeɔ ja nɔuu; se moo lɛɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ yeɔ ní, nɛ a nuɔ ní.”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.
translation_verse: Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Ke nɔ ko kpee yo, nɛ e huɛmɛ ba e he nyami ɔ, anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa e maa ha mɛ hwɔ be mi nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.”
translation_verse: Se be ma, nɛ a maa ngɔ ayɛflo huno ɔ kɛ je a he kɛ ho; nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ loko a maa ha hwɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus then told them these sayings: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and make the hole even bigger.
translation_verse: Yesu bu mɛ abɛ nɛ ɔ hu ke, “Nɔ ko gba we tade he nya kɛ ta we tade momo mi. Ke e pee ja kɛkɛ e hia tade he ɔ, nɛ tade he ɔ nya nɛ a je ɔ, kɛ tade momo ɔ hu be yae fiee.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The new wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃ nɔ ko ngɔɛ wai he wui lohwe he womi tɔ momohi a mi. Ke e pee ja a, wai he ɔ ma pɛ lohwe he womi tɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ e ma pue si, nɛ lohwe he womi tɔ ɔmɛ hu ma puɛ.

english_verse: New wine must be put only into new wineskins.
translation_verse: Wai he ɔ, lohwe he womi tɔ hehi a mi nɛ e sa kaa a kɛ woɔ!

english_verse: No one wants new wine after drinking old wine. They say, “The old wine is better.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ hu, nɔ ko nui wai momo, nɛ e ya hlaa wai he se blɔ amlɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ e deɔ ji, ‘Momo ɔ hi!’ ”

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he told the man to stand up where everyone could see him. And the man stood up.
translation_verse: Se Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ momo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de nyumu ɔ nɛ nine gbo ɔ ke, “Tee si nɛ o ba da si ngɛ hɛ mi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!” Nyumu ɔ te da si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Some Pharisees said, “Why are you picking grain on the Sabbath? You're not supposed to do that!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisi bi komɛ bi mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa a peeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ pee?”

english_verse: Long ago your own people did these same things to the prophets. So when this happens to you, be happy and jump for joy! You will have a great reward in heaven.
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi ja a, nyɛ nya, nɛ nyɛ hlu kɛ bua jɔmi, ejakaa Mawu ngɔ hiɔwo agbo ngɔ to ha nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe. Nyɛ kai kaa ja nɔuu a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee gbali ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Ask God to bless anyone who curses you, and pray for everyone who is cruel to you.

translation_verse: Ke nyɛ nimli yayamihi po nyɛ le bɔ nɛ nyɛ haa nyɛ bimɛ ní kpakpahi ɔ, nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ lɛɛ e maa ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ha nihi nɛ biɔ lɛ ɔ kulaa pe kikɛ nɛ ɔ po!” Yesu kɛ Beelzebul (Mateo

english_verse: And suppose your friend answers, “Don't bother me! The door is bolted, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you something.”
translation_verse: Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ ma he nɔ ke, ‘Koo doo ye nya! A nga sinya a momo, nɛ i kɛ ye bimɛ hwɔ si; i be nyɛe ma te si ba ha mo nɔ́ ko hu.’

english_verse: Which one of you fathers would give your hungry child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Tsɛ te nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ ke e bi bi lɛ abolo nɛ e ma ha lɛ tɛ? Aloo ke e bi lɛ lo, nɛ e maa ngɔ sinɔ ngɔ pee lo ngɔ ha lɛ?

english_verse: So Jesus told them, “Pray in this way: ‘Father, help us to honor your name. Come and set up your kingdom.
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, nyɛ de ke, ‘Wa Tsɛ, O biɛ ɔ he nɛ tsɔ; O matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ ba.

english_verse: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted.’ ”
translation_verse: Kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ nɛ pa wɔ; ejakaa wɔ hu waa kɛ paa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tɔɔ wa nɔ. Nɛ ko ha nɛ a ka wɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive, everyone who searches will find, and the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ biɔ ɔ, a haa lɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa a, e naa, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma si sinya a, a ma bli ha lɛ.

english_verse: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ gbalɔ Yona plɛ okadi ha Nineve bi ɔ, ja Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma plɛ okadi kɛ ha kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, “The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed!”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ, yo ko wo e gbi nɔ kɛ je nimli babauu ɔ a kpɛti, nɛ e de ke, “A gbaa yo nɛ fɔ mo, nɛ e lɛ mo ɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus forced a demon out of a man who could not talk. And after the demon had gone out, the man started speaking, and the crowds were amazed.
translation_verse: Be ko ɔ, Yesu ngɛ mumi yayami nɛ tu we munyu hiae ngɛ nyumu ko mi. Benɛ mumi yayami ɔ je kpo ɔ, nyumu ɔ bɔni munyu tumi, nɛ nimli babauu ɔ a he mi po.

english_verse: Others wanted to put Jesus to the test. So they asked him to show them a sign from God.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ hu hla kaa a maa ka Yesu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a de lɛ ke, “Moo pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ kaa niinɛ, Mawu he wami nya ní o ngɛ tsue.”

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.
translation_verse: Se Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Ma tsuaa ma nɛ e mi bi gbaa ta kɛ woɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ɔ, jamɛ a ma a ywiaa; we nɛ mi gbami ngɛ mi ɔ, we ɔ ywiaa.

english_verse: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Satan matsɛ yemi ɔ gba ta ngɔ wo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ɔ, kɛ jamɛ a matsɛ yemi ɔ maa pee kɛ da si kɛɛ? Nyɛ ke Beelzebul lɛ haa mi he wami nɛ i kɛ hiaa mumi yayamihi.

english_verse: If I use his power to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? They are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Yoo, ke Beelzebul lɛ ha mi he wami lɛ i kɛ ngɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ hiae ɔ, nyɛ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ mɛni a kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ? Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɔuu maa tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ nɔ́ be mi.

english_verse: When a strong man arms himself and guards his home, everything he owns is safe.
translation_verse: “Ke katsɛ ko hɛɛ e dade mi kɛ ngɛ e we he bue ɔ, e níhi tsuo a yi naa wami.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ suɔ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi hehi ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ suɔ hu nɛ nihi nɛ kpla si kɛ nga nyɛ ngɛ jua nɔ.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, “Teacher, you said cruel things about us.”
translation_verse: Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, ke o de enɛ ɔ, wɔ lɛ o ngɛ jɛe ɔ nɛ!”

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, “I will go back to the home I left.”
translation_verse: “Ke mumi yayami je nɔ ko mi ɔ, e ya nyɛɛɔ zugba gbigbli nɔ kɛ hlaa he nɛ e maa jɔɔ e he ngɛ. Ke e nɛ he ko ɔ, e deɔ e he ke, ‘Ma kpale ye se kɛ ya ye we ɔ mi he nɛ i je ɔ.’

english_verse: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up,
translation_verse: Ke e ba a, e ba naa kaa a bɛɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ a dla mi.

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before. Being Really Blessed
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, e yaa nɛ e ya ngɔɔ mumi yayami kpahi kpaago nɛ a nya wa pe lɛ nitsɛ kɛ baa, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba hii lejɛ ɔ. Nyagbe ɔ, kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ si himi ba peeɔ haomi kulaa pe kekle ɔ.” Bua jɔmi nitsɛ

english_verse: Jesus replied, “That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message!” A Sign from God (Matthew
translation_verse: Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ nuɔ Mawu munyu ɔ, nɛ a yeɔ nɔ ɔ mohu!” Farisi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ okadi hlae (Mateo

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Farisi no ɔ na kaa Yesu fɔ we e he loko e maa ye ní ɔ, e hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ haa Mawu kowɛ, kɛ pui, kɛ ba slɔɔtohi tsuo mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka, se dami sane yemi, kɛ Mawu suɔmi lɛɛ nyɛ si se. E sa kaa nyɛ peeɔ enɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ekpa amɛ hu nyɛ ko si se.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Benɛ ni ɔmɛ a he ba bɔni hiɛmi fuu ɔ, Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e de ke. “Yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nimli yayamihi ji mɛ! A ngɛ okadi hlae, se a be mɛ eko hae, kaa ja gbalɔ Yona okadi ɔ.

english_verse: When the judgment comes, the Queen of the South will stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something far greater than Solomon.
translation_verse: Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Sheba manyɛ ɔ maa da si, nɛ e maa ye odase kɛ si yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Ejakaa e hia blɔ kɛ je e zugba nɔ tsitsaa kɛ ba bu Matsɛ Salomo nile munyuhi tue. Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ́ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ pe Salomo tete.

english_verse: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah. Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Nineve bi maa da si, nɛ a maa ye odase ngɔ si nyɛ. Ejakaa benɛ a nu Yona fiɛmi ɔ, a tsake a tsui. Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ́ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ pe Yona tete! Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kane (Mateo

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: “Nɔ ko su we kane ngɔ mɛ́ kɔkɔɔ mi, loo sowe sisi. Mohu ɔ, e ngɔɔ kɛ maa kane tso nɔ, konɛ ke nihi ma we ɔ mi ɔ, a na la a.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Hɛngmɛ ji nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kane. Ke o hɛngmɛ nɔ tsɔ ɔ, e haa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo kpɛɔ kɛ la; se ke o hɛngmɛ hí ɔ, o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ woɔ diblii.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Kuasiahi! Mawu nɛ pee kpo nɔ je ɔ, pi lɛ nɔuu nɛ pee mi mi je ɔ hulɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ fiaa yɔkɔhi kɛ haa gbali ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbe ɔ.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu tu munyu gbe nya a, Farisi no ko tsɛ lɛ ní yemi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ya we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya hi si, konɛ e kɛ lɛ nɛ ye ní ɔ.

english_verse: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, nyɛ Farisi bi, nyɛ fɔɔ nyɛ kplu kɛ kã he, se nyɛ mi lɛɛ e hyi tɔ kɛ ojo fiami, kɛ yi wu tso ní peemi.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ níhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kplu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ kã amɛ a mi ngɔ ha ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ he ma tsɔ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ ngɛ kaa yɔkɔhi nɛ a tui a he so, nɛ nihi nyɛɛɔ a nɔ nɛ a li.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ hu, musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ boɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ ngɔ pueɔ nihi a konɔ. Se nyɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ be nyɛ nine nguɛ kake po mi kpae kɛ piɛ a he kɛ tloo tlomi ɔ.

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ní peemi níhi tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ ngɔ nyɛ nya; mɛɛ a gbe gbali ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ fia a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu nile ɔ de ke, ‘Ma tsɔ gbali, kɛ tsɔli kɛ ya a ngɔ; a maa gbe a ti ni komɛ, nɛ a maa wa a ti ni komɛ yi mi.’

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbali tsuo nɛ a gbe kɛ je je mi sisije ɔ, a ma bi a muɔ si ngɛ yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ dɛ.

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: Kɛ je Habel nɔ kɛ yaa su Zakaria nɛ a gbe ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ a kpɛti ɔ nɔ ɔ, ee, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke a ma bi a muɔ si ngɛ yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ!

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, musu tloo nyɛ! Safe nɛ bliɔ sinya nɛ yaa nile we ɔ, nyɛ ngɔ kɛ to; nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ yɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa ya hu nyɛ tsiɔ mɛ blɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ je a hɛ ngɔ pi lɛ. A bɔni e nya munyu womi babauu,

english_verse: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.
translation_verse: Benɛ nimli akpe abɔ akpe ba bua a he nya, nɛ a ngɛ a sibi a nɔ nae ɔ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ zaa ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a masa a he; a we osato peemi ɔ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: Hu, nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ e ngɛ, nɛ hwɔɔ kɛkɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ mi nɛ e ngla a, Mawu lɛ wo lɛ tade saminyayoo ɔ nɛ. Ke Mawu mia hu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, anɛ e be nyɛ miae hluu pe ja lo? Nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi pi pɛ!

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Nyɛ hla Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mohu, nɛ a maa ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ piɛ he ha nyɛ. Hiɔwe juetli (Mateo

english_verse: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.
translation_verse: “Ye huɛmɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nihi nɛ gbeɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ ko hu ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
translation_verse: Yi bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi tete po Mawu le lɛ tsuo nya. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye; nyɛ he jua wa kulaa pe otokliihi babauu! Odase yemi ha Kristo (Mateo

english_verse: My little group of disciples, don't be afraid! Your Father wants to give you the kingdom.
translation_verse: “Kuu nyafii, nyɛ ko ye gbeye; ejakaa nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ he tsui kaa e maa ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ jua níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ tsuo, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ sika a kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ. Nyɛ hla sika kpɛɛhi nɛ be momo pee, nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ juetli ngɛ hiɔwe he nɛ e be tae ngɛ. Ejakaa julɔ ko julɔ ko be he sue, nɛ wɔyewɔye hu be nyɛe ma kpata hɛ mi.

english_verse: At that time the Holy Spirit will tell you what to say. A Rich Fool
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa nyɛ de ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a mi nɔuu.” Niatsɛ kuasia a he abɛ

english_verse: But God said to him, “You fool! Tonight you will die. Then who will get what you have stored up?”
translation_verse: Se Mawu de lɛ ke, ‘Kuasia! Nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi nɔuu i ngɛ o wami ɔ hee ngɛ o dɛ. Lɛɛ níhi nɛ o bua nya ngɔ to ɔ, mɛnɔ níhi nɛ a maa pee?’ ”

english_verse: If you tell others that you belong to me, the Son of Man will tell God's angels that you are my followers.
translation_verse: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa jaje ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi kaa e ngɛ ye blɔ fa mi ɔ, Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hu maa pee ja ha lɛ ngɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: But if you reject me, you will be rejected in front of them.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ kuaa mi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hu ma kua lɛ ngɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: When you are brought to trial in the synagogues or before rulers or officials, don't worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say.
translation_verse: “Ke a ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba kpe he ɔmɛ, loo matsɛmɛ, loo ganɔhi a hɛ mi ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma plɛ kɛ fa nyɛ he, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma de ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɛ ko hao nyɛ kulaa.

english_verse: A man in a crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, tell my brother to give me my share of what our father left us when he died.”
translation_verse: Nimli kpekpemi ɔ a ti nɔ kake de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, de ye nyɛmi ɔ nɛ e kɛ mi nɛ dla gbosi ní ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who gave me the right to settle arguments between you and your brother?”
translation_verse: Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Maminyumu, mɛnɔ wo mi kojolɔ, loo ní dlalɔ ha nyɛ?”

english_verse: Then he said to the crowd, “Don't be greedy! Owning a lot of things won't make your life safe.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, e de ni ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko kɔ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɔ; ejakaa pi ní babauu nɛ adesa na a mi nɛ e wami ngɛ.”

english_verse: and he said to himself, “What can I do? I don't have a place large enough to store everything.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e bɔni susumi ngɛ e yi mi ke, ‘I be he ko nɛ i kɛ ye ngmɔ mi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa to. Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?’

english_verse: Later, he said, “Now I know what I'll do. I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones, where I can store all my grain and other goods.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ ma pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ma ku ye gba amɛ ngɔ pue si, nɛ ma ma nguanguahi, nɛ ma to blɛfo, kɛ ní kpahi ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I tell you not to worry about your life! Don't worry about having something to eat or wear.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ye, aloo tade nɛ nyɛ maa wo he susumi nɛ hao nyɛ.

english_verse: Life is more than food or clothing.
translation_verse: Wami pe ngma, nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hu pe tade.

english_verse: Look how the wild flowers grow! They don't work hard to make their clothes. But I tell you Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of these flowers.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ mɔmɔhi nɛ ngɛ puɛe ha; a tsu we ní, nɛ a kpɛ we tade hulɔ. Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, Matsɛ Salomo kɛ e ní babauu ɔ, lɛ tete po e be miaa we kaa mɔmɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kake.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father knows what you need.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se nɛ a dii. Nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ le kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he hia nyɛ.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks that the master won't return until late. Suppose that servant starts beating all the other servants and eats and drinks and gets drunk.

translation_verse: kpale bi lɛ ke, “Ke pi mo ji Kristo ɔ, pi Eliya ji mo, nɛ pi mo ji gbalɔ ɔ hulɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he nɛ o ngɛ nihi sɔlee mɔ?”

english_verse: John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.
translation_verse: Yohane he nɔ ke, “Imi lɛɛ nyu i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ sɔlee; se nɔ ko daa si ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ li lɛ.

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: I sɛ e hlami kɛ ba mohu, se i sɛ nɔ nɛ pɛneɔ e tokota nya kpa tete po.”

english_verse: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany. The Lamb of God
translation_verse: A pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Betania, ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je, he nɛ Yohane ngɛ nihi sɔlee ngɛ ɔ. Mawu To Bi ɔ

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: E nɔ jena a, Yohane na Yesu nɛ ma e ngɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, Mawu To Bi ɔ nɛ woɔ je ɔ he yayami kɛ yaa a, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he nɛ i de ngɛ ke, ‘Nɔ ko ma ngɛ ye se, se e pe mi, ejakaa e ngɛ loko i ngɛ’ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ i li lɛ, se i kɛ nyu ba ngɛ nihi sɔlee, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel ma a nɛ le lɛ.”

english_verse: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Yohane tu munyu kɛ ye Yesu he odase ke, “I na Mumi ɔ nɛ kple si kɛ je hiɔwe kaa lahuɛ ba ma e nɔ.

english_verse: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Imi hu jinɛ i li lɛ, se Mawu, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ba sɔle nihi ngɛ nyu mi ɔ lɛ de mi ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ Mumi ɔ ma ba ma a, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ sɔle nihi.’

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi jã pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ i na, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ odase yee ke Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ.” Yesu tsɛ kekleekle kaseli

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: E nɔ jena benɛ Yohane kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ daa si ekohu ɔ,

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: e na Yesu nɛ bee. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yohane de ke, “Ne Mawu To Bi ɔ!”

english_verse: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ kaseli enyɔ ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, a ya nyɛɛ Yesu se kɛ yaa.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu plɛ e he, nɛ e na kaa kaseli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae?” A he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, jije o hii?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ.” . Kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya na e hi he ɔ; nɛ a kɛ lɛ hi si kɛ ya si du bu.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Kaseli enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake biɛ ji Andrea, Simon Petro nyɛmi ɔ.

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: E kɛ we kulaa nɛ Andrea kɛ e nyɛmi Simon ba kpe. Andrea de Simon ke, “Wa na Mesia a.” .

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ Simon kɛ ya Yesu ngɔ. Yesu hyɛ Simon too, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Tse mo ji Yohane bi Simon ɔ. Jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma tsɛ mo Kefa.” Yesu tsɛ Filipo kɛ Natanael

english_verse: Philip then found Nathanael and said, “We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Filipo hu kɛ Natanael ya kpe ɔ, Filipo de lɛ ke, “Natanael, hyɛ, nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ Mose ngma e he sane ngɛ mlaa womi ɔ mi, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ hu tu e he munyu ɔ, wa na lɛ. Lɛ ji Yosef bi Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ.”

english_verse: Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip answered, “Come and see.”
translation_verse: Se Natanael bi Filipo ke, “Anɛ nɔ́ kpakpa ko maa je Nazaret lo?” Filipo he nɔ ke, “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!”

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu na Natanael nɛ ma e ngɔ ɔ, e de ke, “Israel no ngmingmiingmi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; sé ko be e he.”

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Natanael bi Yesu ke, “Jije o le mi ngɛ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “I na mo pi mwɔnɛ; i na mo ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ sisi tɔɔ loko Filipo tsɛ mo.”

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Natanael kpale he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, niinɛ, mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ! Mo ji Israel matsɛ ɔ nɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu bi Natanael ke, “Akɛnɛ i de mo ke i na mo ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ sisi ɔ, lɔ ɔ he nɛ o he ye ɔ? O maa na ní nguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke hiɔwe nya ma bli, nɛ nyɛ maa na Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ kuɔe kɛ ngɛ imi Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ye ngɔ bae, nɛ a ngɛ kpalee kɛ ngɛ yae.”

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: E nɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, a kpee yo ngɛ Galilea ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Kana a. Yesu nyɛ ya lejɛ ɔ;

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: nɛ a fɔ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu nine kɛ ya yo kpeemi ɔ.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: Be saii mi ɔ, wai nɛ a ngɛ nue ɔ ta; nɛ Yesu nyɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Ni ɔmɛ a wai ɔ ta.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Maa, mɛni he je o ngɛ ye nya dooe? Be nɛ ma tsu ní ɔ sui lolo.”

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ Yesu nyɛ de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma de nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee.”

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Yuda bi a kusumi ji a fɔ a he nɛ a kɛ tsú a he. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, didɔ ekpa maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Didɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, eko tsuaa eko yeɔ nyu lita lafa.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Yesu de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wo didɔ ɔmɛ a mi nyu nɛ a hyi.” A pee jã.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, e de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ yɛ eko ya ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛe ɔ.” A yɛ nyu

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: nɛ plɛ pee wai ɔ ya ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛe ɔ, nɛ e sa e nya. Tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ wo didɔ ɔmɛ a mi nyu ɔ le he nɛ wai nɛ ɔ je; se ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ lɛɛ e li. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ ayɛflo huno ɔ,

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ke a tsɛ ní yemi ɔ, wai kpakpa a kɛ ba maa si kekle; nɛ ke ni ɔmɛ nu bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ ɔ loko a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɛ ɔ baa. Se moo lɛɛ o ngɔ wai kpakpa a ngɔ to kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ su ɔ, Yesu ya Yerusalem.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ngɔ tangme tsɔwi kɛ pee kpa, nɛ e fie jua yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ a to ɔmɛ, kɛ na amɛ tsuo kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ. E tsitsɛɛ sika tsakeli ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si, nɛ e plɛ a sika amɛ ngɔ pue si.

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: E kaseli ɔmɛ kai kaa a ngma ke, “Ye hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ o we ɔ he.”

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ku sɔlemi we nɛ ɔ, nɛ ligbi etɛ se ɔ, ma ma lɛ ekohu.”

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: E ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e ya na nihi babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ nahi, tohi, kɛ lahuɛhi juae. Ni komɛ hu hii si ngɛ a we okplɔɔhi a se ngɛ sika tsakee.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ lahuɛhi juae ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ esɔ! Tsaatsɛ we ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ kɛ pee jua nɔ.”

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Mɛni okadi o maa to wɔ kɛ ma nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ nɔ mi?”

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: nɛ a he ngmami ɔ, kɛ munyu nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ tu ɔ tsuo ye. Yesu le adesa su

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Yesu hi Yerusalem Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ tsuo. E pee okadihi babauu, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ na a, a he lɛ ye.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Se Yesu lɛɛ e le mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ e hɛ fɔɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: E hia we pohu nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ye nɔmlɔ adesa he odase kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ, ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e le nɔmlɔ yi mi.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nikodemo. Farisi no ji lɛ.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: Nyumu nɛ ɔ ba Yesu ngɔ nyɔ mi, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa le kaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ kɛ ba ji mo. Níhi tsuo nɛ o peeɔ ɔ kɛ toɔ okadi ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa pee, ja Mawu piɛ e he.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke a ji hiɔwe fɔ we nɔ ko ɔ e be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi sɛe.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke a ji nyu kɛ mumi mi fɔ we nɔ ko ɔ, e be nyɛe maa sɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Adesa lɛɛ adesa kɛkɛ e fɔɔ, se Mumi Klɔuklɔu lɛɛ e fɔɔ nɔ ehe.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: O hɛ mi ko pee mo yaa kaa i de mo ke e hia nɛ a dla fɔ mo ehe.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, e fiaa kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ e suɔ; o nuɔ e fiami ɔ, se he nɛ e je, kɛ he nɛ e yaa lɛɛ o li. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a je Mumi mi fɔ lɛ ɔ ngɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tse tsɔɔlɔ nguaa ji mo ngɛ Israel! Nɛ o li enɛ ɔ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke wɔɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa le ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa deɔ, nɛ wa yeɔ nɔ́ nɛ wa na a he odase. Se nyɛ sume nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ munyu nɛ wa fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Ke i de nyɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ níhi nɛ nyɛ he we yi ɔ, lɛɛ ke i de nyɛ hiɔwe níhi ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ he ye kɛɛ?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko yɛ hiɔwe gblee kaa ja Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kple si kɛ ba a.”

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mose wo sinɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, jã nɔuu nɛ e sa kaa a wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, e na neneene wami.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu suɔ je ɔ saminya, nɛ e ngɔ e Bi kake ɔ ngɔ ha, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, e hɛ mi ko kpata, se mohu e na neneene wami.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔ we e Bi ɔ kɛ bɛ je ɔ mi nɛ e ba kojo; se mohu e ba, konɛ e ba he nihi a yi wami.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, a be lɛ fɔ bue; se nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ, a bu lɛ fɔ momo; ejakaa e he we Mawu Bi kake too ɔ yi.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ nɔ nɛ a da kɛ bu mɛ fɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: la a ba je ɔ mi, se adesa suɔ diblii ɔ mohu pe la a, ejakaa a peeɔ yayami.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e nyɛɔ la a; nɛ e sume nɛ e baa la a nya, ejakaa e sume nɛ a naa e ní yayami ɔmɛ.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ anɔkuale se ɔ, e baa la a nya, konɛ la a nɛ tsɔɔ kaa e peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní. Yesu kɛ Yohane

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya Yudea. A hi lejɛ ɔ be bɔɔ, nɛ e sɔle nihi.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, kusumi nɛ a peeɔ kɛ tsuɔ nɔ he ɔ, Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ ekomɛ, kɛ Yuda bi komɛ sã nya ngɛ he.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ba Yohane ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, nyumu ɔ nɛ e kɛ mo hi Yordan pa a beleku je nɛ o tu e he munyu ɔ, o kai lɛ lo? Hyɛ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nihi babauu ngɛ e ngɔ yae, nɛ e ngɛ mɛ sɔlee.”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Yohane he nɔ ke, “Nɔ ko be nyɛe ma na nɔ́ ko kaa ja Mawu ha lɛ.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nu nɛ i de paa ke, ‘Pi imi ji Kristo ɔ, se mohu a tsɔ mi kɛ sɛ e hlami’.

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Ayɛflo huno ɔ, e nɔ ji ayɛflo ɔ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ayɛflo huno ɔ huɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a, ke e nu ayɛflo huno ɔ gbi kɛkɛ e bua jɔ. Enɛ ɔ nɛ haa imi hu i naa bua jɔmi babauu.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: E sa kaa e ya nɔ, konɛ imi lɛɛ ma ba si.” Nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a pe nihi tsuo. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, je mi no ji lɛ, nɛ je mi níhi a he munyu e tuɔ. Se nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ e na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e nu ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he odase e yeɔ, pohu nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔɛ e munyu ɔ.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e munyu ɔ yeɔ ɔ, yeɔ odase kaa Mawu tuɔ anɔkuale.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ ɔ, Mawu munyu e tuɔ, ejakaa Mawu Mumi hyi lɛ tɔ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Tsɛ ɔ suɔ e Bi ɔ, nɛ e tu nihi tsuo ngɔ wo e dɛ mi.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ heɔ Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, e nine su neneene wami ɔ nɔ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui Bi ɔ tue ɔ, e be neneene wami nae. Mawu maa gbla e tue mohu.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Benɛ e yaa a, e hia kaa e gu Samaria.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Yo ɔ bi Yesu ke, “Pi Yuda no ji mo lo? Nɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o ngɛ imi Samaria no nyu bae nɛ o nu ɔ?”

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, vu ɔ mi kuɔ, nɛ o be nɔ́ ko hulɔ nɛ o kɛ maa yɛ nyu ɔ. Nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ, jije o ma ná kɛ je?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Wa nɛ̃ Yakob nɛ ha wɔ kikɛmɛ a vu nɛ ɔ; nɛ lɛ nitsɛ, kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ e lohwehi tsuo nu e mi nyu. Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o tsɔɔ kaa moo o pe Yakob ɔ lo?”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: se nɔ nɛ maa nu nyu nɛ imi ma ha lɛ ɔ, kuma be lɛ yee hu gblegbleegble. Ejakaa nyu nɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ ma plɛ nyu hɛngmɛ nɛ baa nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami kɛ yaa neneene ngɛ e mi.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, yo ɔ de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha mi kikɛmɛ a nyu nɛ ɔ mɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, kuma be mi yee hu, nɛ e be hiae po kaa ma ba hiɛ ɔ ba yɛ nyu.”

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: O gba nyumuhi enuɔ momo, nɛ nyumu nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ piɔ hu, pi o huno nitsɛnitsɛ ji lɛ. O tu anɔkuale sisiisi.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i na kaa gbalɔ ji mo.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Wa nɛmɛ ja Mawu ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ nɔ, se nyɛ Yuda bi lɛɛ nyɛ ke Yerusalem ji he nɛ sa kaa wa ja Mawu ngɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “Maa, he mi nɛ o ye kaa be ma nɛ nyɛ ma ja Tsɛ ɔ, pi yo nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ pi Yerusalem hulɔ.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Samaria bi, nyɛ li nɔ tutuutu nɛ nyɛ jaa a; se wɔ Yuda bi lɛɛ nɔ nɛ wa jaa a, wa le lɛ; ejakaa wɔ nɛ wa ngɔ yi wami hemi kɛ ba.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, be ɔ ma, nɛ Mawu ma ha nihi he wami, konɛ a ja Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi mi kɛ anɔkuale mi kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ suɔ. Pohu be ɔ su momo.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Mawu ɔ, Mumi ji lɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, ja a ja lɛ ngɛ mumi kɛ anɔkuale mi.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “I le kaa Mesia a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kristo ɔ ma, nɛ ke e ba a, e maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Imi nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, imi ji Mesia a nɛ.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba je kpo, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa kaa e kɛ yo ngɛ ní sɛɛe. Se a ti nɔ ko bi we yo ɔ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae; nɛ a bi we Yesu hu nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ yo ɔ ngɛ sɛɛe.

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ si e paya buɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho ma a mi ya; nɛ e ya de ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke,

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ba! Nyɛ ba hyɛ nyumu ko nɛ de mi níhi tsuo nɛ i pee hyɛ. Anɛ pi lɛ ji Kristo ɔ lo?”

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo bu kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ bɔni Yesu pɛɛ kpami ke e ba wo e nya mi nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Se e he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ ngma nɛ i yeɔ, se nyɛ li.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ bi a he ke, “Anɛ nɔ ko ba ha lɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye lo?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ye niye ní ji kaa ma pee nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ní; nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ e tsɔ mi tsumi ɔ, ma gbe nya.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Tse nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘E piɛ hlami eywiɛ nɛ a ma kpa ní.’ Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛɛ hyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ kpe, nɛ nyɛ maa na kaa ní ba, nɛ e kpami be su nɛ a ma bua nya.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po ní kpalɔ ɔ ngɛ e hiɔwo nae; e ngɛ ngmɔ ní nya buae kɛ ngɛ wami nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ toe, konɛ ní dulɔ ɔ, kɛ ní kpalɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ a bla kɛ nya.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a deɔ ke, ‘Nɔ ko duɔ ní, nɛ nɔ ko hu kpaa’ a ngɛ mi niinɛ.

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: I tsɔ nyɛ ní kpami ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ he nɛ nyɛ du we nɔ́ ko ngɛ. Ni kpahi tsu ní ɔ, se nyɛ mohu lɛ nyɛ ba na he se.”

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Samaria bi babauu nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi ɔ he Yesu ye, ejakaa yo ɔ de mɛ ke, “E de mi níhi tsuo nɛ i pee.”

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Samaria bi ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e hi a ngɔ. Nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi enyɔ.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu fiɛ munyu ɔ, nihi babauu pe kekle ɔ he ye.

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a de yo ɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ pi o munyu ɔ nya hu nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ji je ɔ yi wami helɔ ɔ, se mohu nɔ́ nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu kɛ wa tue kɛ je lɛ nitsɛ e nya a he.” Yesu tsa amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma ko binyumu

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e ye odase ke, “A bui gbalɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi.”

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ba su Galilea a, ma a tsuo he lɛ atuu, ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ngɛ Yerusalem Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ya lejɛ ɔ nɛ a na paa.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kpale kɛ ba Kana ngɛ Galilea, he nɛ e ha nyu plɛ pee wai ngɛ be ko ɔ ekohu. Tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma ko ngɛ Kapernaum nɛ e bi be he wami.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ná le kaa Yesu je Yudea kɛ ba Galilea a, e ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e binyumu miɔ nɛ e ma gbo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ho Kapernaum ya nɛ e ya tsa lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Blɔɔ ke nyɛ nɛ okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ be hee maa ye!”

english_verse: The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha waa ho esɔ, ke pi ja a, ye bi ɔ ma gbo.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yaa, o bi ɔ yi na wami.” Munyu ɔ nɛ Yesu tu nyumu ɔ, e he ye, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: Benɛ e ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa we mi ɔ, e sɔmɔli kɛ lɛ ba kpe; nɛ a de lɛ ke, “O bi ɔ yi na wami.”

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: Tsɔlɔ ɔ bi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni be hiɔ ɔ fani ha lɛ ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Hiɛ̃ piani ngmlɛ kake be mi nɛ aslã a po ngɛ e nɔ.”

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ bitsɛ ɔ kai kaa jamɛ a be ɔ tutuutu nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke e ya, se e bi ɔ yi na wami ɔ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ e we ɔ tsuo he Yesu ye.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji okadi enyɔne nɛ Yesu pee benɛ e je Yudea kɛ ba Galilea a.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nyami ligbi yee ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ Yesu ya lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
translation_verse: Taku ko kɛ e he kue enuɔ ngɛ To Agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ kasa nya. Hebri gbi mi ɔ, a tsɛɛ taku nɛ ɔ Betesda.

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔ nue jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ sɔuu.

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: Nyɛ bui e munyu ɔ, ejakaa imi nɔmlɔ nɛ e tsɔ ɔ, nyɛ he we mi yi.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Yesu na lɛ nɛ hwɔɔ si, nɛ e le kaa nyumu ɔ na we he wami be babauu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “O suɔ nɛ a tsa mo lo?”

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Hiɔtsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke a ba klɛ nyu ɔ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i be nɔ ko nɛ ma wo mi ya fɔ taku ɔ mi. Be tsuaa be ɔ, ke ma su lejɛ ɔ, nɔ kpa sɛ ye hlami ya nɔ mi momo.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “Tee si, wo o sa a nɛ o nyɛɛ.”

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyumu ɔ he mi wa lɛ; e wo e sa a, nɛ e bɔni nyɛɛmi. Se Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ a tsa hiɔtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ de nɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi; wa mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa o hɛɛɔ o sa.”

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: E he nɔ ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ tsa mi ɔ lɛ de mi ke ma wo ye sa a nɛ ma nyɛɛ.”

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ de mo ke o pee jã a?”

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ li Yesu; nɛ pohu nihi babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu sã e he nɛ e je.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Yesu ya na nyumu ɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Bu tue, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ o na he wami nɛ ɔ, koo pee yayami hu. Ke pi jã a, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba o nɔ ɔ maa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ.”

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, nyumu ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya de Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji nɔ nɛ tsa lɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ je hɛ pi Yesu nɛ a bɔni e nya doomi, ejakaa e tsa hiɔtsɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ ngɛ ní tsue be tsuaa be, nɛ imi hu i ngɛ ní tsue.”

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ e de nɛ ɔ mohu ha Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ dɔ pe kekle ɔ po, nɛ a to kaa ja a gbe lɛ. Ejakaa pi mlaa a nɛ kɔɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e tɔ̃; se e de hu ke e tsɛ ji Mawu, nɛ́ tsɔɔ kaa e kɛ Mawu sɔ. Bi ɔ ngɛ he blɔ

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke Bi ɔ pee we nɔ́ ko ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi nya. Nɔ́ nɛ e na nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɛ e peeɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ peeɔ ɔ, Bi ɔ hu peeɔ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ suɔ Bi ɔ saminya, nɛ e tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e peeɔ. Jehanɛ ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ Bi ɔ ní nguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ tete, nɛ e maa pee nyɛ nyakpɛ.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tleɔ gbogboe si, nɛ e ngɔɔ wami woɔ mi ɔ, jã nɔuu Bi ɔ hu haa níhi nɛ e suɔ mɛ ɔ wami.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kojo we nɔ ko. E ngɔ jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ tsuo kɛ ha Bi ɔ, konɛ Bi ɔ nɛ kojo nihi.

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo maa wo Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami kaa bɔ nɛ a woɔ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ wui imi Bi ɔ, ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hɛ mi nyami e wui ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buɔ ye munyu tue, nɛ e heɔ nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, e nine su neneene wami nɔ. A be lɛ fɔ bue, ejakaa e po mi ngɛ gbenɔ mi kɛ ho wami mi ya.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke be ma, pohu e su ta, nɛ gbogboehi maa nu Mawu Bi ɔ gbi, nɛ a maa ba wami mi ekohu.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ wami ngɛ e mi ɔ, ja nɔuu e ha e Bi ɔ hu wami.

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Tsɛ ɔ ha Bi ɔ he blɔ kaa e kojo nihi, ejakaa lɛ ji Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ mi kó pee nyɛ yaa kaa be maa su nɛ gbogboehi tsuo maa nu Mawu Bi ɔ gbi,

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
