english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa he ye, nɛ wa na le hulɔ kaa mo ji Mawu Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Anɛ pi imi nɛ i hla nyɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ lo? Lɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ kake peeɔ Abosiami ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Blɔɔ, Simon Iskariot bi Yuda e ngɛ dee ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa Yuda a, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji lɛ. Se pee se ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ba tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kpa si ngɛ Galilea pɛ, se e sume nɛ e ya Yudea zugba a mi, ejakaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ngɛ sue ɔ,

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: Yesu nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jee hiɛ ɔ, nɛ o ya Yudea, konɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a na níhi nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa ma nɛ le lɛ saminya a, níhi nɛ e peeɔ ɔ, e laa we nɔ. Ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, ha nɛ je ɔ tsuo nɛ nu he.”

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: E nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ tete he we lɛ yi.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ye be ɔ sui lolo; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ be tsuaa be hi ha nyɛ.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Je ɔ be nyɛ nyɛe, se a nyɛɔ mi, ejakaa a yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mɛ ngɛ ní yayamihi nɛ a peeɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ye nyami be ɔ. Imi lɛɛ i be yae, ejakaa be nɛ maa da mi ɔ na we nɛ e su.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Nɛ e de jã a, e tlɔ Galilea. Yesu ya Gbasisihimi nyami ɔ

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ hla lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a bi si ke, “Jije e ngɛ?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Ma a tsuo tu Yesu he munyu kusikusi. Benɛ ni komɛ de ke, “Nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ” ɔ, ni komɛ hu de ke, “Dɛbi, e ngɛ ma a nane tɔtɔe”.

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e tu Yesu he munyu ngɛ ma a hɛ mi paa, ejakaa a ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbeye yee.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Benɛ nyami ɔ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ya hia si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e bɔni ní tsɔɔmi.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa, nɛ a bi ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ kase we ní ɔ, kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ e le ní kikɛ nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji imi nitsɛ ye yi mi; nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ ngɔ ha mi.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e maa pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, e maa na kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ je Mawu ngɔ, se pi imi nitsɛ ye he wami nya.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko tuɔ munyu ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami nya a, e ngɛ hɛ mi nyami hlae ha e he. Se anɔkualetsɛ lɛɛ e hlaa kaa e maa wo nɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ mohu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ sisimi be e mi.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Pi Mose nɛ wo nyɛ mlaa a? Nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko yi nɔ ɔ? Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ gbe mi ɔ?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Ma a tsuo he nɔ ke, “Mo nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, mumi yayami ngɛ o mi! Mɛnɔ ngɛ mo hlae nɛ e gbe?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyakpɛ nɔ́ kake pɛ i pee nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi pee nyɛ yaa.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Mose nɛ fa ke nyɛɛ po nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ poɔ bimwɔyo.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Ke Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ poɔ nɔ, konɛ a ko tɔ Mose mlaa a, mɛni he je nyɛ mi mi fuɔ mi kaa i tsa hiɔtsɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ bi ke, “Anɛ pi nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Hyɛ kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ e daa si paa ngɛ ní tsɔɔe nɛ a de we lɛ nɔ́ ko. Eko piɔ a na kaa lɛ ji Kristo ɔ niinɛ.

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Kristo ɔ nɛɛ, anɛ nɔ ko maa le he nɛ e maa je lo? Tse wɔ tsuo wa le he nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ je.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, benɛ Yesu ngɛ ní ɔ tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e kpa ngmlaa kɛ bi ke, “Anɛ nyɛ le mi tutuutu? He nɛ i je ɔ, nyɛ le? Pi imi nitsɛ ye he wami nya nɛ i ba. Nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nyɛɛ nyɛ li lɛ.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i le lɛ, ejakaa e ngɔ nɛ i je, nɛ lɛ ji nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a pee kaa a maa nu Yesu amlɔ nɔuu, se nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ta e he, ejakaa e be ɔ sui lolo.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Ma mi bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu he Yesu ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi ke, “Anɛ Mesia a nɛ maa ba a ma nyɛ to okadi pe nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ lo?” A tsɔ nihi nɛ́ a ya nu Yesu

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ngɛ Yesu he munyu tue kusikusi ɔ, a kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɔ nihi ke a ya nu lɛ kɛ ba.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “E piɛ be bɔɔ pɛ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si, kɛkɛ ma kpale kɛ ho nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ngɔ ya.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma hla mi, se nyɛ be mi nae; ejakaa he nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ba lejɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ bi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ke, “Jije po e yaa nɛ wa be lɛ nae hu ɔ? Anɛ e maa ho Hela ma nguaa amɛ a mi ya ngɛ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ Hela bi ɔmɛ ní lo?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: E de ke, wa ma hla lɛ, se wa be lɛ nae; nɛ he nɛ e yaa hu, wa be nyɛe maa ya. Kɛ e ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ?” Pa nɛ haa nɔ nyu nɛ wami ngɛ mi

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɛ ji nyami ligbi nguaa pe kulaa a, Yesu te da si, nɛ e de kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, e ba ye ngɔ nɛ e ba nu nyu.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: A ngma ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, pa nɛ baa nyu babaaba nɛ wami ngɛ mi maa fo dɔ kɛ je e tsui mi.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Blɔɔ, Mumi ɔ he Yesu de enɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ nine maa su Mumi ɔ nɔ. Se jamɛ a be ɔ, Mumi ɔ bɛ lolo, ejakaa a na we nɛ a wo Yesu hɛ mi nyami. Ni ɔmɛ a mi gba

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Benɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Niinɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ji gbalɔ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ni komɛ hu de ke, “Lɛ ji Mesia a nɛ.” Se ni kpa komɛ lɛɛ a bi ke, “Mesia a, Galilea nɛ e maa je lo?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Ejakaa a ngma ke Mesia a maa pee Matsɛ David nina; nɛ jehanɛ hu, Betlehem, he nɛ Matsɛ David hi ɔ, lejɛ ɔ a ma fɔ lɛ ngɛ.”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Benɛ a de nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ a mi gba enyɔ ngɛ Yesu he.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Ni komɛ pee kaa a maa nu Yesu, se nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ta e he. Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ he we yi

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba a, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ bɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Tsɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ tuɔ munyu ɔ, nɔ ko tu we munyu ja gblee.”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ e pee nyɛ hu kuasia lo?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ nu hyɛ kaa ma nimeli ɔmɛ, aloo Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po he lɛ ye lo?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ mɛ pɛ, ejakaa a li Mose mlaa a.”

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nikodemo, nɛ́ be ko ɔ e ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E de ma a ke,

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Wa mlaa a nya a, e sɛ kaa wa buɔ nɔ ko fɔ be mi nɛ wa bi we e nya mi kaa mɛni e pee lo.”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: A he nɔ ke, “Saminya! Tse mo hu Galilea no ji mo! Yaa kpa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi kaa o maa na gbalɔ ko nɛ je Galilea lo!”

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: E nɔ jena mɔtu mla a, e kpale e se kɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ. Ni ɔmɛ tsuo ba bu e nɔ, nɛ e hi si, nɛ e bɔni mɛ ní tsɔɔmi.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ yo ko nɛ ya ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba da ma a tsuo hɛ mi.

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: A de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, yo nɛ ɔ ya ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Wa mlaa a nya a, Mose fa ke, ‘Yo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.’ Moo lɛɛ kɛ o ngɛ dee kɛɛ?”

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ, a de kɛ da lɛ, konɛ a na nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ ya po e nya. Se Yesu sɔ̃ si, nɛ e kɛ e nine nguɛ ngma ní ngɛ zugba.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ nɔ ngɛ Yesu munyu bie ɔ, e wo e yi nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ti nɔ nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ, lɛ kekle e fia yo ɔ tɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: Yesu kpale sɔ̃ si, nɛ e tsa ní ngmami ɔ nɔ ngɛ zugba.

english_verse: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
translation_verse: Se mɛɛ lɛɛ benɛ a nu munyu nɛ ɔ, a bɔni jemi kakaaka, kɛ je nɔkɔtɔma a nɔ kɛ ya si e piɛ Yesu, kɛ yo ɔ pɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko bui mi fɔ.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Saminya, imi hu i bui mo fɔ. Yaa, se mohu kpa yayami peemi.”] Yesu ji la kɛ ha je ɔ

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Yesu, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Imi ji je ɔ la a nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ ye se ɔ, e naa la a nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ; nɛ e be diblii mi nyɛɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Farisi bi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ o ngɛ mo nitsɛ o he odase yee. Nɔ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ be mi fɛɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “E ngɛ mi mohu kaa imi nitsɛ i ngɛ ye he odase yee lɛɛ, se ye odase ɔ ngɛ mi, ejakaa i le he nɛ i je, kɛ he nɛ i yaa. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ li he nɛ i je kɛ ba; nɛ he nɛ i yaa hu nyɛ li.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kojoɔ he lo nya, se imi lɛɛ, i kojo we nɔ ko.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Se ke i kojo tete po ɔ, e da, ejakaa pi imi nɔ kake nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee. Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ piɛ ye he.

english_verse: Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true.
translation_verse: A ngma ngɛ nyɛ mlaa a mi ke, ke ni enyɔ ye odase nɛ kɔɔ ɔ, e peeɔ anɔkuale.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i yeɔ imi nitsɛ ye he odase, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hu yeɔ ye he odase.”

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: A bi lɛ ke, “O Tsɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ li mi, nɛ Tsaatsɛ hu nyɛ li lɛ. Kaa nyɛ le mi jinɛ nyɛ maa le Tsaatsɛ hulɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, be mi nɛ e ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ tsu mi he nɛ a kɛ tó tsumi daka amɛ to ɔ. Se a nui lɛ, ejakaa e be ɔ sui. He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ya

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Yesu kpale de ni ɔmɛ ke, “Imi lɛɛ i yaa! Nyɛ ma hla mi, se nyɛ ma gbo kɛ nyɛ he yayami. He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ba.”

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ bi ke, “Ke e de ke he nɛ e yaa a, wa be nyɛe maa ya a, kɛ e ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ? E yaa gbe e he lo?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ je nɛ ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ; se imi lɛɛ hiɔwe i je. Je nɛ ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ i ji je nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ma gbo kɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔ nɛ. Niinɛ, nyɛ ma gbo kɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ke nyɛ he we yi kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ i ji ɔ.”

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: A bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Sisije ɔ, mɛni i de nyɛ ɔ?

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: I le nyɛ he sanehi babauu nɛ ma kɛ kojo nyɛ. Se nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ i nu kɛ je e nya a, lɔ ɔ i deɔ je ɔ.”

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a li kaa Tsɛ ɔ he munyu Yesu kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ná wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ i ji ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa i to we imi nitsɛ ye yi mi kɛ tsu we nɔ́ ko gblegbleegble. Mohu nɔ́ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ i deɔ.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ; e si we imi nɔ kake too, ejakaa i peeɔ e suɔmi nya ní.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nihi babauu nɛ nu ɔ he lɛ ye. Odehehi kɛ nyɔguɛhi

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.
translation_verse: Yesu de Yuda bi nɛ he lɛ ye ɔ ke, “Ke nyɛ pɛtɛ ye munyu ɔ he ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa pee ye kaseli nitsɛnitsɛmɛ.

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le anɔkuale ɔ; nɛ anɔkuale ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he.”

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: A he nɔ ke, “Abraham nina ji wɔ, nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa yi nyɔguɛ ha nɔ ko hyɛ. Ke o de ke, ‘Nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he’ ɔ, kɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, yayami ɔ nyɔguɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family.
translation_verse: Nyɔguɛ hí we mi kɛ yɛ neneene, se bi lɛɛ e hii si kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts.
translation_verse: I le kaa Abraham nina ji nyɛ! Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɛ ye tsɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nyɛɛ gbe mohu ɔ.

english_verse: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you. Your Father Is the Devil
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ níhi nɛ Tsaatsɛ tsɔɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ i deɔ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ tsɛ ɔ de nyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ peeɔ.”

english_verse: The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!” Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.
translation_verse: A he nɔ ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa tsɛ ji Abraham.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Abraham nina ji nyɛ jinɛ nyɛ maa pee níhi nɛ Abraham pee ɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ i nu kɛ je Tsaatsɛ Mawu nya a, lɔ ɔ i deɔ nyɛ; se nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ nyɛɛ gbe. Abraham pee we nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But you are doing exactly what your father does.” “Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father!” they said. “We just have one father, and he is God.”
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ nyɛ tsɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ peeɔ ɔ nɛ.” A he nɔ ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ pi ajuama mi bimɛ ji wɔ. Wa ngɛ tsɛ kake. Wa tsɛ ji Mawu.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “Mawu ji nyɛ Tsɛ niinɛ jinɛ nyɛ maa suɔ mi, ejakaa Mawu nɛ tsɔ mi; se pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ ba. Mawu ngɔ nɛ i je kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, nyɛ nɛ nya, ejakaa nyɛ bui ye munyu ɔ.

english_verse: Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsɛ nɛ fɔ nyɛ ji Abosiami; nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa pee e suɔmi nya ní. Kɛ je sisije ɔ, nɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e kɛ anɔkuale yi gblegbleegble, ejakaa anɔkuale be e mi. Ke e ye lakpa a, e tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ e su ngɛ, ejakaa lakpatsɛ kpanaku ji lɛ.

english_verse: Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ, i tuɔ anɔkuale; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he we mi yi.

english_verse: Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ ma nyɛ tsɔɔ kaa i pee yayami. Ke anɔkuale i tuɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je nyɛ he we mi yi ɔ?

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to God will listen to his message. But you refuse to listen, because you don't belong to God. Jesus and Abraham
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, e nuɔ Mawu munyu. Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nui, ejakaa pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ nyɛ je.” Yesu kɛ Abraham

english_verse: The people told Jesus, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you!”
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Ke wa de ke Samaria no ji mo, nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ o mi ɔ, wa tɔ lo?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Mumi yayami be ye mi. Imi lɛɛ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi nyami i woɔ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye he guɛ gbee.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.”
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buu ye tsɔɔmi ɔ tue ɔ, e be gboe gblegbleegble.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die?
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa ná nɔ mi mami kaa mumi yayami ngɛ o mi. Abraham gbo, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ hu gbo, se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ dee ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buu o tsɔɔmi tue ɔ be gboe gblegbleegble.

english_verse: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
translation_verse: Tsaatsɛ Abraham nɛ gbo ɔ, o pe lɛ lo? Jehanɛ ɔ hu, gbali ɔmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ nɛɛ? Kɛ moo lɛɛ o buɔ o he kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If I honored myself, it would mean nothing. My Father is the one who honors me. You claim that he is your God,
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Kaa imi nitsɛ nɛ i woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, lɛɛ lɔ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko; se hyɛ, Tsaatsɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ ke nyɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɔuu nɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says.
translation_verse: Imi le lɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ li lɛ. Ke i de ke i li lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ lakpatsɛ ji mi kaa nyɛ nɔuu. Se i le lɛ, nɛ i buɔ lɛ tue.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that even before Abraham was, I was, and I am.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke i ngɛ loko a fɔ Abraham.”

english_verse: The people picked up stones to kill Jesus, but he hid and left the temple.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a kukuɔ tɛ nɛ a maa fia Yesu, se e laa e he, nɛ e je sɔlemi we ɔ.

english_verse: As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who had been blind since birth.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu nyɛɛ kɛ yaa a, e na nyumu ko nɛ hɛ yu kɛ je be nɛ a fɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples asked, “Teacher, why was this man born blind? Was it because he or his parents sinned?”
translation_verse: Kaseli ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ pee yayami nɛ a fɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ? Lɛ nitsɛ, aloo e fɔli?”

english_verse: As long as it is day, we must do what the one who sent me wants me to do. When night comes, no one can work.
translation_verse: Nɛ je na nɛ ɔ, ja wa tsu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ní tsumi ɔmɛ. Je maa jɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma tsu ní.

english_verse: While I am in the world, I am the light for the world.”
translation_verse: Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ ɔ, imi ji je ɔ la a nɛ.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ, e la lada pue zugba, nɛ e kɛ lada a pɔtɔ zu. E ngɔ zu ɔ kɛ ha hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Then he said, “Go wash off the mud in Siloam Pool.” The man went and washed in Siloam, which means “One Who Is Sent.” When he had washed off the mud, he could see.
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yaa Siloam pa a mi nɛ o ya fɔ o he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e ya fɔ e he; nɛ benɛ e kpale kɛ ma a, e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi.

english_verse: The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man.
translation_verse: E kpɔ mi bi, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ sa a, a naa lɛ nɛ e hii nɔ bae ɔ bi ke, “Anɛ pi nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ hiɔ si, nɛ e hii nɔ bae be ko ɔ?”

english_verse: Some of them said he was the same beggar, while others said he only looked like him. But he told them, “I am that man.”
translation_verse: Ni komɛ de ke, “Nyumu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Se ni komɛ hu de ke, “Dɛbi, pi lɛ; e je lɛ kɛkɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ nitsɛ de mɛ ke, “Imi ji lɛ.”

english_verse: He answered, “Someone named Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. He told me to go and wash it off in Siloam Pool. When I did, I could see.”
translation_verse: E de mɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yesu ɔ nɛ pɔtɔ zu, nɛ e ngɔ ha ye hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de mi ke ma ya fɔ ye he ngɛ Siloam pa a mi. Benɛ i ya fɔ ye he pɛ nɛ i bɔni nɔ hyɛmi.”

english_verse: “Where is he now?” they asked. “I don't know,” he answered. The Pharisees Try To Find Out What Happened
translation_verse: A bi lɛ ke, “Jije e ngɛ.” E he nɔ ke, “I li.” Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi nɔ tsami ɔ he munyu

english_verse: The day when Jesus made the mud and healed the man was a Sabbath. So the people took the man to the Pharisees.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ Yesu pɔtɔ zu ɔ nɛ e kɛ tsa nyumu hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ,

english_verse: They asked him how he was able to see, and he answered, “Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. Then after I washed it off, I could see.”
translation_verse: Farisi bi ɔmɛ kpale bi nyumu ɔ ekohu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na tsami ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “E pɔtɔ zu kɛ ha ye hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ i ya fɔ ye he, kɛkɛ nɛ i bɔni nɔ hyɛmi.”

english_verse: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man Jesus doesn't come from God. If he did, he would not break the law of the Sabbath.” Others asked, “How could someone who is a sinner work such a miracle?” Since the Pharisees could not agree among themselves,
translation_verse: Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je; ejakaa e bui Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.” Se a ti ni komɛ lɛɛ a de ke, “Kɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ma plɛ kɛ to okadihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ a mi gba.

english_verse: they asked the man, “What do you say about this one who healed your eyes?” “He is a prophet!” the man told them.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ kpale bi nyumu ɔ ekohu ke, “Tse o de wɔ ke e bli o hɛngmɛ! Saminya, kɛ moo o deɔ ngɛ e he kɛɛ?” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Gbalɔ ji lɛ.”

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders would not believe that the man had once been blind. They sent for his parents
translation_verse: Se loloolo ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ he we yi kaa be ko nɛ be ɔ nyumu ɔ hyɛ we nɔ́. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ,

english_verse: and asked them, “Is this the son that you said was born blind? How can he now see?”
translation_verse: nɛ a bi mɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ bi ji nɛ ɔ? Nyɛ ke a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ? Kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe ɔ?”

english_verse: The man's parents answered, “We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.
translation_verse: E fɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, wa le kaa wa bi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ wa le hulɔ kaa a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ.

english_verse: But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.”
translation_verse: Se bɔ nɛ ba nɛ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe amlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ wa li; nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ha nɛ e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi ɔ hu wa li lɛ. Nyɛ bi lɛ; e wa nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma nyɛ je munyu nya.”

english_verse: The man's parents said this because they were afraid of their leaders. The leaders had already agreed that no one was to have anything to do with anyone who said Jesus was the Messiah.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he nɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ de ke, “E wa, nyɛ bi lɛ nitsɛ” ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
translation_verse: Se nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Yayami peelɔ ji lɛ oo, pi yayami peelɔ ji lɛ oo; imi lɛɛ i li! Nɔ́ kake pɛ i le; be ko nɛ be ɔ, hɛ yuyuilɔ ji mi; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ nɔ hyɛe.”

english_verse: “What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he heal your eyes?”
translation_verse: A bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Kɛ e pee mo kɛɛ? Kɛ e pee kɛɛ nɛ e bli o hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
translation_verse: E he nɔ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ enɛ ɔ momo nɛ nyɛ bui mi tue. Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ nu ekohu. Nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa pee e kaseli lo?”

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a gbiɛ nyumu ɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Mo ji jamɛatsɛ ɔ kaselɔ; wɔɔ lɛɛ Mose kaseli ji wɔ.

english_verse: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Mawu kɛ Mose tu munyu, se kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, he nɛ e je po wa li.”

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ de mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyakpɛ sane ji nɛ ɔ! Nɔmlɔ nɛ bli ye hɛngmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ li he nɛ e je!

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Mawu bui yayami peeli tue, se nɔ nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye, nɛ e peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, Mawu buɔ lɛ tue.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.
translation_verse: Kɛ je benɛ a bɔ je ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nui hyɛ kaa a bli nɔ ko nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ hɛngmɛ?

english_verse: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, ke pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je ɔ, jinɛ e ko nyɛ we nɔ́ ko peemi.”

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
translation_verse: A he nɔ ke, “Mo nɛ a fɔ mo, nɛ a tsɔse mo ngɛ yayami mi ɔ, o ngɛ hlae nɛ o tsɔɔ wɔ ní?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a fie lɛ kɛ je a jami ɔ mi. Mumi mi hɛ yuyui

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Yesu nu kaa a fie lɛ kɛ je jami ɔ mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, pee se benɛ e na nyumu ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “O heɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ yeɔ lo?”

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mɛnɔ ji lɛ, konɛ ma he lɛ ma ye?”

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “O na lɛ momo. Lɛ ji nɔmlɔ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i heɔ yeɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpla si ngɛ Yesu hɛ mi.

english_verse: Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
translation_verse: Yesu de ke, “I ba je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ma ba kojo, konɛ hɛ yuyuili nɛ hyɛ nɔ; nɛ nihi nɛ susuɔ kaa a ngɛ nɔ hyɛe ɔ, a hɛ nɛ yu.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.”
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “Kaa nyɛ hɛ yu mohu ɔ, jinɛ yayami be nyɛ he; se jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Wa ngɛ nɔ hyɛe,’ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he yayami ɔ ngɛ nyɛ he kɛ mwɔɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain only thieves and robbers climb over the fence instead of going in through the gate to the sheep pen.
translation_verse: Yesu de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke to tsu ngɛ, nɛ nɔ ko ya kuɔ kɛ gu he kpa kɛ sɛ mi, se e gui to tsu ɔ nya a, jamɛatsɛ ɔ, julɔ kɛ ojo fialɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
translation_verse: nɛ agbo ɔ nya bulɔ ɔ bliɔ haa lɛ. To ɔmɛ le e gbi, ejakaa e kɛ a biɛ tsɛɔ mɛ, nɛ e tsɔ́ɔ́ mɛ kɛ jeɔ kpo.

english_verse: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.
translation_verse: Ke e je to ɔmɛ kpo ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛɛɔ hɛ mi, nɛ to ɔmɛ nyɛɛɔ e se, ejakaa a le e gbi.

english_verse: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ kpa ko tsɛ to ɔmɛ ɔ, a nyɛɛ we e se, se a tuu fo kɛ jeɔ e he, ejakaa a li nɔ kpa gbi.”

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about. Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Yesu tu mɛ munyu nɛ ɔ ngɛ abɛ gbi mi, se a nui sisi. Yesu ji agbo ɔ

translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu kpale de ekohu ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke imi ji to tsu ɔ nya agbo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ sɛ ye hlami kɛ ba a, juli, kɛ ojo fiali ji mɛ; nɛ to ɔmɛ bui mɛ tue.

english_verse: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
translation_verse: Imi ji agbo ɔ nɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba guu agbo ɔ mi kɛ sɛɔ mi ɔ, e yi ma na wami. E maa sɛ mi, nɛ e maa kpale je kpo ya na niye ní.

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Se julɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke e ba a, e ba juɔ; e gbeɔ to ɔmɛ, nɛ e kpataa a hɛ mi. Imi lɛɛ i ba, konɛ nyɛ na wami, nɛ nyɛ na kɛ be nɔ. Yesu, to hyɛlɔ kpakpa a

english_verse: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.
translation_verse: “Imi ji to hyɛlɔ kpakpa a nɛ. I suɔ kaa ma gbo ngɛ to ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
translation_verse: Apaa yelɔ ɔ, pi to hyɛlɔ ji lɛ, ejakaa to ɔmɛ pi e níhi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e na ogbetee nɛ ma a, e siɔ to ɔmɛ, nɛ e tuu fo kɛ jeɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ogbetee ɔ ba nuɔ to ɔmɛ, nɛ a gbɛɛ fĩaa.

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
translation_verse: Apaa yelɔ ɔ tuɔ fo, ejakaa apaa yelɔ kɛkɛ ji lɛ, nɛ to ɔmɛ a he nɔ dɔɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
translation_verse: I ngɛ to kpa komɛ hulɔ, se mɛɛ a piɛ we kuu nɛ ɔ he. Ma ngɔ mɛ hu kɛ ba; a maa nu ye gbi, nɛ a maa pee to kuu kake, kɛ hyɛlɔ kake.

english_verse: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.
translation_verse: “Tsɛ ɔ suɔ mi, ejakaa i suɔ kaa ma ngɔ ye wami kɛ fɔ si, konɛ ma kpale ngɔ.

english_verse: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ ye wami ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ. Imi nitsɛ ye tsui mi faa nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ ha. I ngɛ he wami nɛ ma nyɛ ma ngɔ ye wami ɔ ngɔ ha, nɛ ma nyɛ ma kpale ngɔ lɛ ekohu. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Tsaatsɛ ke ma pee.”

english_verse: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ hu ha nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a mi gba ekohu.

english_verse: Many of them said, “He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him?”
translation_verse: A ti nihi fuu de ke, “Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ godo nue ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ lɛ tue bue ɔ?”

english_verse: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
translation_verse: Se ni komɛ hu de ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi be nyɛe maa tu munyu kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Kɛ mumi yayami ma nyɛ bli hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ kɛɛ?” Yuda bi ɔmɛ kua Yesu

english_verse: and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ba bu e nɔ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ yaa su mɛni be nɛ o ma ha wa yi mi maa pee wɔ sikɔsikɔ ngɛ o he? Anɛ mo ji Kristo ɔ? De wɔ anɔkuale ɔ koo!”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ momo nɛ nyɛ he we yi! Tsaatsɛ he wami nya nɛ i tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ níhi nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ yeɔ ye he odase.

english_verse: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he we yi, ejakaa pi ye tohi ji nyɛ.

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: Ye to ɔmɛ buɔ mi tue; i le mɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛɔ ye se.

english_verse: and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.
translation_verse: I haa mɛ neneene wami, nɛ a be gboe gblegbleegble. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ mɛ ngɛ ye dɛ.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: Tsaatsɛ ha mi nɔ́ ko nɛ pe níhi tsuo, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ dɛ.

english_verse: and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: I kɛ Tsɛ ɔ ni kake ji wɔ.”

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kukuɔ tɛ ekohu nɛ a maa fia Yesu.

english_verse: But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
translation_verse: Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “I pee ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ nyɛ na. Níhi nɛ i pee ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ mi. Te nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ fia mi tɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Tsa pi kpakpa nɛ o pee ɔ he nɛ wa maa fia mo tɛ ɔ, se mohu musu nɛ o bɔ ɔ he. Nɔmlɔ adesa kɛkɛ ji mo, se o peeɔ o he Mawu.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: In your Scriptures doesn't God say, “You are gods”?
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “A ngma ngɛ nyɛ mlaa a mi ke, Mawu de ke, ‘Mawuhi ji nyɛ.’

english_verse: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ imi nɛ Tsɛ ɔ hla mi, nɛ e tsɔ mi je ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ ke i de ke Mawu Bi ji mi nɛ́ nyɛ deɔ ke i bɔ musu ɔ?

english_verse: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
translation_verse: Ke i tsu we níhi nɛ Tsaatsɛ ke ma tsu ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ko he mi nyɛɛ ye.

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Se ke jamɛ a ní tsumi ɔmɛ i tsuɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke nyɛ he we imi nitsɛ yi po ɔ, níhi nɛ i peeɔ ɔ, nyɛ he nyɛɛ ye mɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le si kake nyɔngloo kaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi, nɛ imi hu i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi.”

english_verse: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kpale e se kɛ ho Yordan pa a se ya ngɛ he nɛ Yohane sɔle nihi ngɛ be ko ɔ, nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.”
translation_verse: Nihi babauu ba e ngɔ, nɛ a de ke, “Yohane pee we okadi ko lɛɛ, se níhi tsuo nɛ e de ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi.”

english_verse: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ nihi babauu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he lɛ ye.

english_verse: The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ kɛ sɛ mane Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, o huɛ nɛ o suɔ lɛ ɔ ngɛ gboe.”

english_verse: But he stayed where he was for two more days.
translation_verse: Se benɛ e nu Lazaro hiɔ he ɔ, e kpale ye ligbi enyɔ sɔuu ngɛ he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha waa kpale wa se kɛ ho Yudea ya.”

english_verse: “Teacher,” they said, “the people there want to stone you to death! Why do you want to go back?”
translation_verse: Kaseli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, pi lingmi pɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ka mo tɛ fiami, nɛ o yaa lejɛ ɔ ekohu?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Anɛ pi ngmlɛfia nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ peeɔ ligbi kake? Ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ piani ɔ, e tɛ we si, mɛni he je ɔ, e naa je nɛ ɔ mi la a.

english_verse: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.”
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, e tɛɔ si, ejakaa la be.”

english_verse: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Yesu de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Wa huɛ Lazaro hwɔ mahe, se i yaa nɛ ma ya tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ.”

english_verse: They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.”
translation_verse: Kaseli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mahe e ngɛ hwɔe ɔ, lɛɛ e maa hi ha lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
translation_verse: Yesu ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa Lazaro gbo momo, se mɛɛ lɛɛ a susu kaa mahe nitsɛ nɛ e ke Lazaro ngɛ hwɔe.

english_verse: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
translation_verse: se e ngɔ ye nya kaa i be lejɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ he ye. Nyɛ ha waa ya e ngɔ.”

english_verse: Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.” Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
translation_verse: Toma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hayo hulɔ ɔ, de e nyɛmimɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha wɔ hu waa kɛ Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ya, nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ya gbo.” Yesu ji si temi ɔ kɛ wami ɔ

english_verse: When Jesus got to Bethany, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu ba su Betania a, e na kaa Lazaro ye ligbi eywiɛ momo ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Bethany was less than three kilometers from Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Betania kɛ Yerusalem a kpɛti kɛmi maa pee kaa si tomi enyɔ;

english_verse: and many people had come from the city to comfort Martha and Mary because their brother had died.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda bi babauu ba Marta kɛ Maria a ngɔ, konɛ a ba ye mɛ kɔmɔ ngɛ a nyɛminyumu ɔ gbenɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: When Martha heard that Jesus had arrived, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house.
translation_verse: Benɛ Marta nu kaa Yesu ma a, e je kpo nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe, se Maria lɛɛ e hii si ngɛ we ɔ mi.

english_verse: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
translation_verse: Marta de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ jinɛ ye nyɛminyumu ɔ ko gbo we.

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Your brother will live again!”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “O nyɛminyumu ɔ maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.”

english_verse: Martha answered, “I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.”
translation_verse: Marta he nɔ ke, “I le kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɛ ni gbogboehi maa te si ɔ, e maa te si kɛ ba wami mi.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “I am the one who raises the dead to life! Everyone who has faith in me will live, even if they die.
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “Imi ji si temi ɔ, kɛ wami ɔ nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, ke e gbo tete po, e maa hi hɛ ngmengmle;

english_verse: “Yes, Lord!” she replied. “I believe you are the Christ, the Son of God. You are the one we hoped would come into the world.”
translation_verse: Marta he nɔ ke, “Ee Nyɔmtsɛ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa mo ji Kristo ɔ nɛ! Mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.” Yesu fo ya

english_verse: After Martha said this, she went and privately said to her sister Mary, “The Teacher is here, and he wants to see you.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Marta de enɛ ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ho nɛ e ya tsɛ e nyɛmiyo Maria zaa. E de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ba, nɛ e ngɛ o si bie.”

english_verse: As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went out to Jesus.
translation_verse: Benɛ Maria nu enɛ ɔ, e te si pam, nɛ e je kpo esɔ, nɛ e kɛ Yesu ya kpe.

english_verse: Many people had come to comfort Mary, and when they saw her quickly leave the house, they thought she was going out to the tomb to cry. So they followed her.
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ Maria ngɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ kɔmɔ yee ɔ na bɔ nɛ e te si nɛ e sá e he kɛ je kpo, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se. A susu kaa e yaa yɔkɔ ɔ he nɛ e ya fo ya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Mary went to where Jesus was. Then as soon as she saw him, she knelt at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
translation_verse: Maria ya su he nɛ Yesu ngɛ ɔ, nɛ amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e na Yesu ɔ, e kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ jinɛ ye nyɛminyumu ɔ ko gbo we.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw that Mary and the people with her were crying, he was terribly upset
translation_verse: Yesu na kaa Maria ngɛ ya foe; nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ Maria he ɔ hu ngɛ ya foe ɔ ha Yesu hao ngɛ mumi mi.

english_verse: and asked, “Where have you put his body?” They replied, “Lord, come and you will see.”
translation_verse: E bi mɛ ke, “Jije nyɛ to lɛ ngɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ba nɛ o ba hyɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus started crying,
translation_verse: Yesu fo ya.

english_verse: and the people said, “See how much he loved Lazarus.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ ha!”

english_verse: Jesus was still terribly upset. So he went to the tomb, which was a cave with a stone rolled against the entrance.
translation_verse: Yesu hao ngɛ mumi mi ekohu, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho yɔkɔ ɔ he ya. Tɛ puɔ nɛ a ngɔ tɛ kɛ tsi nya ji yɔkɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Then he told the people to roll the stone away. But Martha said, “Lord, you know that Lazarus has been dead four days, and there will be a bad smell.”
translation_verse: Yesu fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ je tɛ ɔ.” Marta, nyumu ɔ nɛ gbo ɔ nyɛmiyo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ ɔ puɛ, ejakaa ligbi eywiɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ e gbo.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Didn't I tell you that if you had faith, you would see the glory of God?”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “Anɛ i de we mo ke, ke o he ye ɔ, o maa na Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ lo?”

english_verse: After the stone had been rolled aside, Jesus looked up toward heaven and prayed, “Father, I thank you for answering my prayer.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ a je tɛ ɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu wo e hɛ nɔ nɛ e hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e de ke, “Tsaatsɛ, i naa mo si kaa o buɔ mi tue.

english_verse: I know that you always answer my prayers. But I said this, so the people here would believe you sent me.”
translation_verse: I le kaa o buɔ mi tue be tsuaa be; se i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee ngɛ nihi nɛ pueɔ si nɛ ɔ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he ye kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.”

english_verse: When Jesus had finished praying, he shouted, “Lazarus, come out!”
translation_verse: Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɛ lɛ kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Lazaro lee-ee, jee kpo!”

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbogboe ɔ je kpo. Bo nɛ a kɛ pu lɛ ɔ blaa e nine kɛ e nane, nɛ duku fi e hɛ mi. Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ pɛne lɛ nɛ nyɛ ha e ya.” A so Yesu yi nɔ (Mateo

english_verse: Many of the people who had come to visit Mary saw the things Jesus did, and they put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ ba Maria ngɔ ɔ, a ti nihi babauu na nɔ nɛ Yesu pee ɔ, nɛ a he lɛ ye.

english_verse: Others went to the Pharisees and told what Jesus had done.
translation_verse: Se a ti ni komɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya sɛɛ níhi nɛ Yesu pee ɔ ha Farisi bi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called the council together and said, “What should we do? This man is working a lot of miracles.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tsɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ a de ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ? Nyɛɛ hyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ okadi toe.

english_verse: If we don't stop him now, everyone will put their faith in him. Then the Romans will come and destroy our temple and our nation.”
translation_verse: Ke wa ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ya nɔ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, ma a tsuo ma he lɛ maa ye. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Roma bi ɔmɛ maa ba ba kpata wa sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ wa ma a tsuo hɛ mi.”

english_verse: One of the council members was Caiaphas, who was also high priest that year. He spoke up and said, “You people don't have any sense at all!
translation_verse: A ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kayafa, nɛ ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa yee jamɛ a jeha a de ke, “Nyɛ biɛ pɛ!

english_verse: Don't you know it is better for one person to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed?”
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nyɛ ha nɔ kake mohu gbo ngɛ ma a tsuo nane mi ɔ, e hi pe nɛ a ma kpata ma a tsuo hɛ mi lo?”

english_verse: Yet Jesus would not die just for the Jewish nation. He would die to bring together all of God's scattered people.
translation_verse: Pohu pi ma a nane mi kɛkɛ, se e ma bua Mawu bimɛ tsuo nɛ gbɛ fĩa hu a nya kɛ pee kake.

english_verse: From that day on, the council started making plans to put Jesus to death.

english_verse: Because of this plot against him, Jesus stopped going around in public. He went to the town of Ephraim, which was near the desert, and he stayed there with his disciples.

translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ bɔni Yesu hlami, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a ya bua a he nya ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, a bi a he ke, “Anɛ e maa ba Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ, loo e be bae?”

english_verse: “The Lord has blinded the eyes of the people, and he has made the people stubborn. He did this so that they could not see or understand, and so that they would not turn to the Lord and be healed.”
translation_verse: “Mawu ma a hɛngmɛ, nɛ e tsi a juɛmi nya hulɔ, konɛ a hɛngmɛ ko hyɛ nɔ́, nɛ a ko nu nɔ́ sisi. Mawu pee mɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ a ko kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a tsa mɛ.”

english_verse: The next day a large crowd was in Jerusalem for Passover. When they heard that Jesus was coming for the festival,
translation_verse: E nɔ jena a, nimli kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ba nɛ a ba ye Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ nu kaa Yesu ma Yerusalem.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that a grain of wheat that falls on the ground will never be more than one grain unless it dies. But if it dies, it will produce lots of wheat.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke a du we ngma ngu ngɛ zu mi, nɛ e gbo ɔ, lɛɛ ngma ngu kake ngmelu ji lɛ daa. Se ke e gbo ɔ, e woɔ yiblii babauu.

english_verse: If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ suɔ e wami ɔ, e wami ɔ maa laa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e wami ngɔ haa ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e maa to e wami ɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer.
translation_verse: Yesu de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ye mumi ngɛ haoe ngɛ ye mi, nɛ i li nɔ nɛ ma de. Anɛ ma de Tsaatsɛ nɛ e tsi amanehlu nɛ ɔ nya nɛ e ko ba ye nɔ lo? Dɛbi! Lɔ ɔ nɔuu he nɛ i ba, konɛ ma ba gblee be nɛ ɔ kɛ e mi nɔ́ nami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
translation_verse: Benɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nu gbi ɔ, a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Hiɔwe si”; nɛ ni komɛ hu de ke, “Hiɔwe bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ tu munyu.”

english_verse: Then Jesus told the crowd, “That voice spoke to help you, not me.
translation_verse: Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Gbi nɛ ɔ, pi imi ye he nɛ e pɛ, nyɛ mohu nyɛ he.

english_verse: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, be ɔ su nɛ a maa kojo je ɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ nɔ matsɛ yee ɔ, a ma kpa lɛ.

english_verse: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.”
translation_verse: Ke a wo ye nɔ kɛ je zugba a nɔ ɔ, ma gbla nihi tsuo kɛ ba ye ngɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ e tu nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ nɔ gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo.

english_verse: The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Ma kpekpemi ɔ he nɔ ke, “Wa mlaa a de ke Kristo ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene. Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ moo lɛɛ o deɔ ke a ma wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ? Mɛnɔ ji kikɛmɛ a Nɔmlɔ Bi nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Be bɔɔ ko pɛ nɛ e piɛ nɛ la a kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si. Be mi nɛ la a ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, konɛ diblii ɔ nɛ ko ba na nyɛ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ diblii mi ɔ, e li he nɛ e yaa.

english_verse: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.” The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.

english_verse: He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him.

english_verse: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.

translation_verse: A suɔ kaa a sa nimli a hɛ mi pe nɛ a maa pee nɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi. Yesu munyu kojoɔ nɔ

english_verse: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yesu de kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, pi imi nɛ e he ye, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ e he ye ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na mi ɔ, e na nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i ba je ɔ mi kaa la, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, e ko hi diblii ɔ mi.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko nu ye munyu ɔ, se e yi nɔ ɔ, pi imi nɛ ma kojo lɛ. I bɛ nɛ ma ba kojo je ɔ; se mohu i ba nɛ ma ba he je ɔ yi wami.

english_verse: But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kua mi, nɛ e ngɔɛ munyu nɛ i fiɛ ɔ hulɔ ɔ, nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ maa kojo lɛ. Nyagbe ligbi ɔ, munyu ɔmɛ nɛ i tu ɔ maa kojo lɛ.

english_verse: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ i de ɔ, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ de ekoeko. Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ fa ke ma de.

english_verse: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_verse: I le kaa nɔ́ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ fa ke e ba mi ɔ haa neneene wami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e de mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ i deɔ.”

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Benɛ e piɛ ligbi kake loko a maa ye Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ, Yesu na kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su nɛ e ma si je ɔ mi kɛ ho Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya. Yesu suɔ nihi tsuo nɛ he lɛ ye ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ saminya kɛ ya si e gbenɔ mi po.

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: Yesu nitsɛ le kaa Tsɛ ɔ ha lɛ he wami tsuo nɛ e kɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́. E le hu kaa Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je kɛ ba, nɛ Mawu ngɔ nɔuu e kpale kɛ yaa.

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu te si ngɛ niye ní ɔ he; nɛ e je e tade klɔii ɔ ngɔ fɔ si, nɛ e ngɔ papahu kɛ muɔ e mlɛ mi.

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ e plɛ nyu ngɔ wo tsɛ̃si mi, nɛ e bɔni kaseli ɔmɛ a nane he fɔmi; nɛ e kɛ papahu nɛ e kɛ muɔ e mlɛ mi ɔ tsu a nane ɔ he.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: Benɛ e ba su Simon Petro ngɔ ɔ, Simon bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo lɛ o ma fɔ ye nane he ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o nui sisi; se pee se ɔ, o ma ba le.”

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Petro de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, ko fɔ ye nane he kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke i fɔ we o nane he ɔ lɛɛ o pi ye kaselɔ hu.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, lɛɛ tsa pi ye nane he kɛkɛ nɛ sa kaa o fɔ mɔ; fɔ ye nine he, kɛ ye yi mi tsuo.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ du e he ɔ, e he tsɔ kɛ pi si momo; nɛ e hia we kaa e fɔ lɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he pe e nane he pɛ. Nyɛ he tsɔ, se pi nyɛ tsuo.”

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yesu le nɔmlɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ momo, lɔ ɔ he nɛ e de ke a he tsɔ se pi mɛ tsuo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Tse nyɛ tsɛɔ mi Tsɔɔlɔ, nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ mi Nyɔmtsɛ hulɔ! Saminya, e ngɛ mi jã.

translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ i pee enɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ pee ha nyɛ sibi.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: “Pi nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee; ejakaa nihi nɛ i hla a, i le bɔ nɛ a ngɛ. Se e sa kaa ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke, ‘Nɔmlɔ nɛ kɛ mi dla ye abolo ɔ te si ngɔ si mi,’ ɔ nɛ ba mi.

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a, i ngɛ nyɛ dee loko e ba mi, konɛ ke e ba mi ɔ, nyɛ he ye kaa ‘Imi ji nɔ nɛ i ji ɔ nɛ.’

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jamɛ a kaselɔ ɔ hɛ lɛ kɛ su Yesu he haa, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛnɔ?”

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hao wawɛɛ ngɛ mumi mi; nɛ e gba mi kpoo nɛ e de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nyɛ ti nɔ kake maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Simon Petro ma lɛ hɛngmɛ ke e bi Yesu nɔ nɛ he munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Yuda nɛ hɛɛɔ sika kpɛɛ ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ekomɛ susu kaa alini Yesu tsɔ lɛ ke e ya he ní nɛ hia nɛ a kɛ maa ye nyami be ɔ, aloo e ngɔ nɔ́ ko ya ha ohiatsɛmɛ.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Yuda sɔle abolo popoe ɔ, nɛ e je kpo amlɔ nɔuu. Jamɛ a be ɔ, je jɔ. Mlaa he ɔ

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke a gu Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ hu maa wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami. E ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ amlɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Ye bimɛ, be nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si ɔ pi saasaa. Nyɛ ma hla mi, se kaa bɔ nɛ i de Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ɔ, ‘He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ba.’

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, jije po o yaa?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “He nɛ i yaa a, amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ o be ye se nyɛe maa nyɛɛ; se pee se ɔ, o ma ba nyɛɛ ye se.”

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Petro de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni ma ha nɛ i be nyɛe ma nyɛɛ o se amlɔ nɛ ɔ? Gbenɔ tete po ma gbo ngɛ o he.”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ei! O ma gbo ngɛ imi ye he? I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke, loko kungwɔ ma kpa nɔ hwɔɔ ɔ, o ma de si etɛ ke o li mi.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he Mawu nyɛɛ ye; nɛ imi hu nyɛ he mi nyɛɛ ye.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Sihi hehi babauu ngɛ Tsaatsɛ we ɔ; ke pi ja a, jinɛ i de nyɛ momo, ejakaa i yaa nɛ ma ya dla he ko ngɔ to nyɛ.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ le he nɛ i yaa, nɛ blɔ ɔ hu nyɛ le.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Toma bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, he nɛ o yaa a po wa li, nɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛ le blɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ kɛɛ?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Imi ji blɔ ɔ, imi ji anɔkuale ɔ, nɛ imi ji wami ɔ hulɔ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kaa ja e gu ye nɔ.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Kaa nyɛ le mi jinɛ nyɛ ko le Tsaatsɛ hulɔ. Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ le lɛ, ejakaa nyɛ na lɛ.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Filipo de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, tsɔɔ wɔ Tsɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɔ ko be wɔ hiae hu.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Filipo, be babauu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ hi si nɛ ɔ, kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o li mi ɔ? Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na mi ɔ, e na Tsɛ ɔ. Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o deɔ ke ma tsɔɔ nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Filipo, anɛ o he we yi kaa i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi lo? Munyuhi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ de. Mohu Tsɛ ɔ nɛ guu ye nɔ kɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Ke i de ke i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi ɔ, nyɛ he ye munyu ɔ nyɛɛ ye. Ke nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ nɛ nyɛ he we yi pohu ɔ, lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i tsu ɔ a he ɔ, nyɛ he ye mɔ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, níhi nɛ i tsuɔ kɛ toɔ okadi ɔ, lɛ hu e ma tsu. Ee, e maa pee níhi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ tete po, ejakaa i je kɛ yaa Tsaatsɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ kpa nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, ma pee; kɛkɛ ɔ, kɛ gu Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, a maa wo Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, ma pee. Yesu wo Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he si

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: “Ke nyɛ suɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ pɛɛ, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ Hepiɛlɔ kpa nɛ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si daa.

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji anɔkuale mumi nɛ tsɔɔ nihi bɔ nɛ tutuutu nɛ Mawu ngɛ ɔ. Je mi bi ɔmɛ ngɔɛ lɛ, ejakaa a nɛ́ lɛ, nɛ a li lɛ hulɔ. Se nyɛɛ lɛ nyɛ le lɛ, ejakaa e kɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ e ngɛ nyɛ mi.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: “I be nyɛ sie awusa; ma kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: E piɛ bɔɔ pɛ nɛ je ɔ be mi nae hu; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa na mi. Nɛ akɛnɛ i ngɛ wami mi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ maa hi wami mi.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa i ngɛ Tsaatsɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ ye mi kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ e yeɔ a nɔ ɔ, e suɔ mi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa suɔ lɛ. Jehanɛ imi hu ma suɔ lɛ, nɛ ma ha nɛ e le mi saminya.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Yuda bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ wɔ pɛ nɛ o ma ha nɛ waa le mo, se pi je ɔ tsuo ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke nɔ ko suɔ mi ɔ, e maa ye ye munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa suɔ lɛ, nɛ wa maa ba e ngɔ, nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ma ba hi si.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ sume mi ɔ, e yi ye munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ. Munyuhi nɛ nyɛ nu ngɛ ye nya a, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi tomi, se mohu Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ ha mi sɛ gbi ɔ.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: “I de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ be mi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Tsɛ ɔ maa wo Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. Hepiɛlɔ nɛ ɔ maa ba ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia kaa nyɛɛ le ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ; nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ, e ma kai nyɛ.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: “I ngɛ nyɛ sie kɛ he jɔmi. Imi nitsɛ ye he jɔmi i ngɛ sie ha nyɛ. Pi bɔ nɛ je ɔ haa a nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ. Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui; nɛ nyɛ ko je fɔ̃ hulɔ.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: I de nyɛ momo ke, ‘I yaa, se ma kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.’ Nyɛ nu! Kaa nyɛ suɔ mi ɔ, jinɛ nyɛ ko na bua jɔmi kaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, ejakaa e pe mi.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee ngɔ to loko a ba mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke a ba mi ɔ, nyɛ he ye.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: I kɛ nyɛ be munyu tue be kɛkɛ hu, ejakaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ je nɛ ɔ nɔ matsɛ ɔ ma. E be he wami ko ngɛ imi ye nɔ;

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: se e sa kaa je ɔ tsuo nɛ le kaa i suɔ Tsɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e fa a, i peeɔ. “Nyɛɛ te nɛ waa je hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: “Imi ji wai tso nitsɛ ɔ, nɛ Tsaatsɛ ji ngmɔtsɛ.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Ye kɔni tsuaa kɔni nɛ wui yiblii ɔ, e poɔ; se nɔ́ nɛ woɔ yiblii ɔ, e sãã he, konɛ e he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ e wo yiblii pe kekle ɔ.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ munyuhi nɛ i tu nyɛ ɔ tsu nyɛ he momo.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hi ye mi nɛ imi hu ma hi nyɛ mi. Kaa bɔ nɛ tso kɔni be nyɛe maa wo yiblii ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e dɛ he, se ja e mɛtɛ wai tso ɔ he ɔ, jã kɛ̃ nyɛ hu ke nyɛ hi ye mi ɔ, nyɛ be yiblii woe.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: “Imi ji wai tso ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ji kɔni ɔmɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hii ye mi, nɛ imi hu i hii e mi ɔ, e maa wo yiblii babauu, ejakaa ke ye he be mi ɔ, nyɛ be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nyɛe ma tsu.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ mɛtɛ we ye he ɔ, a sakee lɛ fɔɔ he kaa tso kɔni, nɛ e gbliɔ. Jamɛ a kɔni ɔmɛ ɔ, a buaa nya kɛ woɔ la mi nɛ a sãã.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ mɛtɛ ye he, nɛ nyɛ he ye munyu ɔmɛ ye ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ ɔ, ke nyɛ bi ɔ, a ma ha nyɛ.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Yiblii babauu nɛ nyɛ woɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ woɔ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ye kaseli.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: I suɔ nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ hi si daa.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: “I de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ kaa bɔ nɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ ye mi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ na bua jɔmi babauu.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi kaa bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Suɔmi nɛ se be ji kaa nɔ ko maa ngɔ e wami ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ e huɛmɛ a he.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ i tsɛ we nyɛ tsɔli hu, ejakaa tsɔlɔ li nɔ́ nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ tsuɔ. I tsɛɔ nyɛ ye huɛmɛ mohu, ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ i nu kɛ je Tsaatsɛ nya a, i de nyɛ.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hla mi. Imi mohu nɛ i hla nyɛ nɛ i tsɔ nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ ya wo yiblii nɛ maa hi si daa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ ma ha nyɛ.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ji nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi. Je ɔ nyɛɔ Kristo se nyɛɛli

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: “Ke je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi a nyɛ kekle.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Kaa je ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ ɔ, jinɛ a ko suɔ nyɛ sane saminya, ejakaa nyɛ piɛ a he. Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ pi je ɔ mi bi hu; lɔ ɔ he nɛ je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai kaa i de nyɛ momo ke, ‘Nyɔguɛ pã we e nyɔmtsɛ.’ Nɛ́ a wa mi yi mi ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ a maa pee nyɛ kɛɛ? Ke a bu mi tue ɔ, nyɛ hu a maa bu nyɛ tue.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
