translation_verse: Ye he ɔ, a maa pee nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, a li lɛ.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Kaa i bɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ba tu munyu ɔ, jinɛ a ko yi fɔ kaa a pee yayami. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ a be nya jemi ko kulaa ngɛ yayami nɛ a pee ɔ he.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɔ mi ɔ, e nyɛɔ Tsaatsɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Kaa i ba tsu we ní nguanguahi nɛ nɔ ko tsu we hyɛ ɔ ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, jinɛ a ko yi fɔ kaa a pee yayami. Jehanɛ ɔ, i tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na paa; se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ngɛ i kɛ Tsaatsɛ tsuo nyɛe.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa nɛ e ba jã, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ a mlaa a mi ke, ‘A nyɛ mi yaka gu’ ɔ nɛ ba mi.

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: “Se Hepiɛlɔ ɔ maa ba. Lɛ ji Mumi ɔ nɛ haa a leɔ anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ nɛ. Ma tsɔ lɛ kɛ je Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ e ma ba ye ye he odase.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu nyɛ maa ye ye he odase, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ hi si kɛ je sisije.

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: “I ngɛ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: A maa fie nyɛ kɛ je kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ be maa ba nɛ ke nihi ngɛ nyɛ gbee ɔ, a ma susu kaa Mawu lɛ a ngɛ jae.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Nihi maa pee nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa a li Tsɛ ɔ; nɛ a li imi hulɔ.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee, konɛ ke be ɔ su ɔ, nyɛ kai kaa i wo nɔ ta de nyɛ. Bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsuɔ ní “Sisije ɔ, i de we nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ i yaa nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ngɔ, se nyɛ ti nɔ ko bi we mi he nɛ i yaa.

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: Se nɛ i de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ tsui yee.

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke e hi kɛ ha nyɛ mohu kaa ma je, ejakaa ke i ji ɔ, Hepiɛlɔ ɔ be nyɛ ngɔ bae. Ke i je ɔ lɛɛ ma wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: Ke e ba a, e maa tsɔɔ je ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a susuɔ ngɛ yayami, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ Mawu kojomi he ɔ dɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
translation_verse: A juɛmi ngɛ yayami he ɔ dɛ, ejakaa a he we mi yi;

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: nɛ a juɛmi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da he ɔ dɛ, ejakaa i yaa Tsaatsɛ ngɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu.

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: Nɛ a juɛmi ngɛ Mawu kojomi he ɔ hu dɛ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ matsɛ ɔ, a bu lɛ fɔ momo.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: “I ngɛ níhi fuu nɛ piɛ nɛ ma de nyɛ, se nyɛ be nyɛe he maa pɛtɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Se ke Mumi ɔ nɛ haa a leɔ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ ba a, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ anɔkuale ɔ tsuo. Ejakaa Mumi ɔ be lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi toe kɛ de nɔ́ ko; mohu níhi nɛ e nu ɔ, a he munyu e maa tu; nɛ e ma de nyɛ níhi nɛ maa ba.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: E maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami, ejakaa níhi nɛ i wo nɔ ta a, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɛ ɔ, ye nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ i de nyɛ ke, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de Mumi ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ nɛ. Bua jɔmi maa ba ngɛ kɔmɔ yemi se

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: “E piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu; kɛkɛ ɔ, bɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛ maa na mi ekohu.”

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: E kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ bi a sibi ke, “Nɔ nɛ e de wɔ nɛ ɔ sisi nɛɛ? E ke e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ wa be lɛ nae hu; kɛkɛ ɔ, bɔɔ se ɔ, wa maa na lɛ ekohu. Jehanɛ hu e de ke wa be lɛ nae hu, ejakaa e yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: ‘Be bɔɔ’ nɛ ɔ, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ? Nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ, wa nui sisi!”

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Yesu na kaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a bi lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ sisi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “I ke, ‘E piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu; kɛkɛ bɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛ maa na mi ekohu.’ Anɛ enɛ ɔ he munyu nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he bie ɔ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma kpa ngmlaa; nyɛ maa wo yana, se je ɔ ma nya. Nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ, se nyɛ kɔmɔ yemi ɔ ma plɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Ke yo ngɛ kɔe nɛ e ma fɔ ɔ, e haoɔ, ejakaa e dengme gbomi be ɔ su; se ke e fɔ pɛ, dengme tsuo nɛ e gbo ɔ, e hɛ jeɔ nɔ; ejakaa e naa bua jɔmi kaa e fɔ bi kɛ wo je ɔ mi.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu, nyɛ hu amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee, se ma na nyɛ ekohu. Nyɛ tsui maa nɔ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ, nɔ ko be hee ngɛ nyɛ dɛ.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: “Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, e be hiae kaa nyɛ bi mi nɔ́ ko hu. I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, e maa pee ha nyɛ.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba si piɔ ɔ, nyɛ bi we nɔ́ ko hyɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi. Nyɛ bi, nɛ a maa pee ha nyɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi babauu. I ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: “Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, abɛ gbi mi i de nyɛ ngɛ. Se jehanɛ ɔ, be maa ba nɛ i be munyu tue ngɛ abɛ gbi mi hu. Mohu ma jaje Tsɛ ɔ he sanehi kpookpoo ha nyɛ.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi. I de we ke ma kpa pɛɛ ha nyɛ,

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ngɛ nyɛ he suɔmi. Tsɛ ɔ suɔ nyɛ, ejakaa nyɛ suɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Mawu ngɔ nɛ i je kɛ ba.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i je Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba je ɔ mi, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ je ɔ mi jee kɛ yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.”

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ o ngɛ munyu tue paa nɛ pi abɛ gbi mi hu.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa na kaa o le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e hia we nɛ nɔ ko nɛ bi mo sane ko. Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa he ye kaa Mawu ngɔ nɛ o je kɛ ba.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he ye lo?

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Be ma, nɛ e su ta; nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa gbɛ fĩa. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ya lɛ nitsɛ e we mi, nɛ e maa piɛ imi nɔ kake too. Se pohu pi imi nɔ kake nɛ maa piɛ, ejakaa i kɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: I de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ hi si, konɛ nyɛ na he jɔmi. Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, haomi maa ba nyɛ nɔ; se nyɛ tsui nɛ nɔ nyɛ mi, ejakaa i ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi.”

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ se ɔ, e wo hɛ nɔ kɛ hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e ke, “Tsaatsɛ, be ɔ su. Ha nɛ a wo o Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami, konɛ Bi ɔ hu nɛ wo o hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o ha mi he wami nɛ ma ye adesahi tsuo a nɔ, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, ma ha nɛ a na neneene wami.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Ke a na le kaa mo ji anɔkuale Mawu ɔ, nɛ a le Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ o tsɔ ɔ, a ma na neneene wami.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: I wo o hɛ mi nyami ngɛ je ɔ mi; ní tsumi nɛ o tu kɛ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, i gbe nya.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Tsaatsɛ, ha nɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami amlɔ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ momo ngɛ o hɛ mi benɛ a na we nɛ a bɔ je ɔ.

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: “Nihi tsuo nɛ o hla kɛ je je ɔ mi nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, i ha nɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ. O nihi ji mɛ, nɛ o tu mɛ ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi. O munyu ɔ nɛ i kɛ ba ha mɛ ɔ, a ye nɔ.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ a le kaa níhi tsuo nɛ o ha mi ɔ je o ngɔ.

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ o ha mi ɔ, i kɛ ha mɛ nɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a le kaa niinɛ i je o ngɔ, nɛ mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: “I kpa we pɛɛ ha je ɔ; mohu ni nɛmɛ nɛ o ha mi ɔ, mɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ha; ejakaa o nihi ji mɛ.

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, o nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, imi hu ye nɔ; nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo woɔ o hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i be je ɔ mi hu. Mɛɛ a ngɛ je ɔ mi, se imi lɛɛ i ma o ngɔ. Tsaatsɛ klɔuklɔu! Bu a he kɛ mo nitsɛ o he wami nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, konɛ a pee kake kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ mo wa ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Benɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ, i bu a he kɛ he wami nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ. A ti nɔ kake ngmelu hɛ mi kpataa we, lɛɛ ja nɔ nɛ a to kaa e hɛ mi nɛ kpata a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ ba mi.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i ma o ngɔ, nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee be mi nɛ i ngɛ je ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ, konɛ bua jɔmi nɛ i na a, mɛ hu a na.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: I ngɔ o munyu ɔ ha mɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je ɔ ngɛ mɛ nyɛe. Ejakaa a kɛ je ɔ bɔɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i kɛ mɛ bɔɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: I kpa we pɛɛ ke o je mɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi; se mohu i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ o bu a he kɛ je nɔ yayami ɔ dɛ mi.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Pi je ɔ mi bi ji mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu pi je ɔ mi nɛ i je ɔ.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ o we anɔkuale munyu ɔ kɛ tsu a he.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ o tsɔ mi je ɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ mɛ tsɔe.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: A he ɔ, i peeɔ ye he klɔuklɔu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ mɛ hu a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ anɔkuale mi.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: “Pi ni nɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ha, se mohu kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ maa nu sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ a maa fiɛ ɔ nɛ a ma he mi maa ye ɔ.

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: I ngɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ mɛ tsuo a pee kake. Tsaatsɛ! Bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ye mi, nɛ i ngɛ o mi ɔ, mɛ hu a hi wa mi jã nɔuu. Pee mɛ kake, konɛ je ɔ nɛ he ye kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: O wo ye hɛ mi nyami, nɛ i ha mɛ hu a hɛ mi ba nyami ja nɔuu, konɛ a pee kake kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: I ngɛ a mi, nɛ mo hu o ngɛ ye mi, konɛ a pee kake kɛ pi si; kɛkɛ ɔ, je ɔ maa na kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi; nɛ bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi ɔ, o suɔ mɛ hu ja nɔuu.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: “Tsaatsɛ! Nihi nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, i suɔ kaa mɛ hu a hi lejɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ. O ha ye hɛ mi ba nyami, ejakaa benɛ o na we nɛ o bɔ je ɔ tete po o suɔ mi.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Tsaatsɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da! Je ɔ li mo, se imi lɛɛ i le mo; nɛ ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ le kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: I ha nɛ a le mo, nɛ ma ya nɔ ma pee jã, konɛ á suɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi ɔ, nɛ imi hu ma hi a mi.”

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɔ nɛ Petro po e tue ɔ weku no bi Petro ke, “Anɛ i nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi lo?”

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: Yesu kpale bi mɛ ekohu ke, “Mɛnɔ nyɛ ngɛ hlae?” A he nɔ ke, “Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ.”

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Yesu kpale de mɛ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ momo ke, ‘Imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke imi nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngmɛ ye se nyɛɛli nɛ ɔmɛ blɔ nɛ a ya.”

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon Petro nyla klaate nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ po osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nyɔguɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue. Nyɔguɛ ɔ biɛ ji Malko.

english_verse: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Roma asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtama a, kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda ta buli ɔmɛ nu Yesu, nɛ a fi lɛ,

english_verse: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,
translation_verse: se Petro lɛɛ e tlɔ sinya a nya. Pee se ɔ, jamɛ a kaselɔ kpa a kpale je kpo, nɛ e kɛ yiheyo ɔ nɛ ngɛ sinya a nya bue ɔ ya tu munyu, kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ Petro kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Yiheyo ɔ nɛ ngɛ sinya a nya bue ɔ de Petro ke, “Tse mo hu jamɛ a nyumu ɔ kaselɔ ji mo?” Petro he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi.”

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, fĩɛ ngɛ yee, nɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ hã kɛ slɛ la, nɛ a daa si ngɛ la a hlue. Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro hu ya piɛ a he nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ la a hlue. Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa ta Yesu nya mi (Mateo

english_verse: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a bi Yesu e kaseli ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɔɔmi ɔ he sane.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Mɛni he je o ngɛ imi mohu munyu bie ɔ Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba buɔ mi tue ɔ, bi mɛ nɔ́ nɛ i deɔ mɛ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ le níhi nɛ i de ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest. Peter Again Denies that He Knows Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu ngɛ pã a mi, nɛ Hana ha a kɛ lɛ ya ha Kayafa, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a. Petro de ekohu ke e li Yesu (Mateo

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Jena mɔtu mla a, a ngɔ Yesu kɛ je Kayafa ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya amlaalo ɔ mɔ ɔ mi. Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a sɛ we mi, ejakaa a sume nɛ a ble a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ.

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: A he nɔ ke, “E pee we yayami ko jinɛ waa kɛ lɛ ba be mo hae.”

english_verse: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
translation_verse: A de enɛ ɔ, konɛ Yesu munyu nɛ e tu kɛ tsɔɔ gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ nɛ ba mi.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato kpale e se kɛ sɛ mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e tsɛ Yesu, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mo ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o yi mi nɛ o to kɛ ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, aloo ni komɛ lɛ a de mo ja ngɛ ye he?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Pilato bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ Yuda no ji mi? Mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ a ngɔ mo ba ha mi. Mɛni o pee?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ye matsɛ yemi ɔ, pi je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ́. Kaa je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ, jinɛ ye se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ maa plee ye he, konɛ a ko ngɔ mi ngɔ ha Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ. Se enɛ ɔ, ye matsɛ yemi ɔ, pi je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ́.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Pilato bi lɛ ke, “Se matsɛ ji mo kɛ̃?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “O ngɛ dee ke matsɛ ji mi. Imi lɛɛ enɛ ɔ he nɛ a fɔ mi kɛ ba je ɔ mi, konɛ ma tsɔɔ anɔkuale ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ buɔ mi tue.”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Pilato bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni ji anɔkuale?” Pilato bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ (Mateo

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Se ngɛ kusumi nya a, daa Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ, i ngmɛɛ pã mi no kake he haa nyɛ. Anɛ nyɛ suɔ nɛ ma ngmɛɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ he ha nyɛ lo?”

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: A he nɔ kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Dɛbi! Pi nɔ nɛ ɔ; ngmɛɛ Baraba mohu he ha wɔ.” Kpahu Baraba a, ojo fialɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato ngɔ Yesu, nɛ e ha a fia lɛ kpa;

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ ngɔ mio kɛ pee jlasi, nɛ a kɛ fi e yi. A wo lɛ tade he jua wawɛ tsutsuutsu;

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: nɛ a kplã si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ a ye e he fɛu ke, “Yuda bi a matsɛ, manye oo manye!” Nɛ a gba e hɛ mi ma.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Pilato kpale je kpo ekohu, nɛ e de ma kpekpemi ɔ ke, “I kɛ lɛ ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ma nyɛ ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa imi lɛɛ i nɛ sane yobu ko ngɛ e he nɛ ma da nɔ kɛ bu lɛ fɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu je kpo kɛ e yi jlasi nɛ a kɛ mio pee ɔ, kɛ e he tade he jua wawɛ tsutsuutsu ɔ. Pilato de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nɛ nɔmlɔ ɔ!”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Benɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ na Yesu ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ke, “Sɛu lɛ! Sɛu lɛ!” Pilato de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ nɛ nyɛ ya sɛu mɔ; ejakaa imi lɛɛ i nɛ sane yobu ko ngɛ e he nɛ ma da nɔ kɛ bu lɛ fɔ.”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ngɛ mlaa, nɛ wa mlaa a nya a, e sa gbenɔ, ejakaa e pee e he Mawu Bi.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Benɛ Pilato nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e ye gbeye pe kekle ɔ po.

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpale sɛ mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e bi Yesu ke, “Jije o je?” Se Yesu pui e nya mi.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Pilato de lɛ ke, “O be ye nya mi poe? O li kaa i ngɛ he blɔ kaa i sɛuɔ mo, nɛ i ngɛ he blɔ hulɔ kaa i ngmɛɛ o he lo?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke pi Mawu nɛ ha mo he wami ɔ, o be he wami ko ngɛ ye nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ je mi kɛ wo o dɛ mi ɔ, e he yayami ɔ kle pe o nɔ́ ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Kɛ je enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Pilato hla kaa e maa ngmɛɛ Yesu he. Se Yuda bi ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa ke, “Ke o ngmɛɛ e he ɔ, o pi Kaisare ɔ huɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ e he matsɛ ɔ, Kaisare ɔ e te si ngɔ si ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Pilato nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ, e kɛ Yesu je kpo, nɛ e ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ he nɛ a ka tɛ ngɛ, nɛ Hebri mi ɔ, a tsɛɛ “Gabata” a.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ a dlaa he kɛ toɔ Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ; nɛ maa pee piani ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, Pilato de ma a ke, “Ne nyɛ matsɛ ɔ!”

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato ngɔ Yesu kɛ ha mɛ nɛ a ya sɛu lɛ. Ta buli ɔmɛ sɛu Yesu (Mateo

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ ba de Pilato ke, “Koo ngma ke, ‘Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ.’ Se mohu ngmaa ke, ‘Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ de ke lɛ ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu na e nyɛ ɔ, kɛ kaselɔ ɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ ɔ daa si ɔ, e de e nyɛ ɔ ke, “Maa, o bi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”

english_verse: ) Jesus was taken away,
translation_verse: ) A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho,

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tloo e sɛumi tso ɔ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ya he nɛ a tsɛɛ “Yikoklodonya”, nɛ Hebri mi ɔ a tsɛɛ lɛ “Golgata” a.

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: A sɛu Yesu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a sɛu ni kpahi enyɔ hulɔ; nɔ kake ngɛ e hiɛ, kɛ nɔ kake hu ngɛ e hiɛ; nɛ Yesu ngɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Pilato ngma kɛ mɛtɛ Yesu sɛumi tso ɔ yi mi ke, “Yesu nɛ je Nazaret, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu kane nɔ nɛ a ngma a, ejakaa he nɛ a sɛu Yesu ngɛ ɔ kɛ ma a mi kɛ we; nɛ a ngma nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ Hebri, kɛ Roma, kɛ Hela gbi mi.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Se Pilato he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ i ngma a, i ngma.”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ta buli ɔmɛ de a he ke, “Wa ko gba enɛ ɔ; mohu nyɛ ha waa fɔ̃ nɔ sɔ, konɛ waa na nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee.” Kɛkɛ ɔ, ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke, “A dla ye tade ɔmɛ ngɔ ha a he; nɛ ye tade klɔii ɔ, a fɔ̃ nɔ sɔ” ɔ maa ba mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ pee ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Yesu nyɛ, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ nyɛmiyo Maria, Klopa yo ɔ, kɛ Maria Magdalena daa si ngɛ Yesu sɛumi tso ɔ kasa nya.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Se benɛ a su Yesu nɔ ɔ, a na kaa e gbo momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ku we e nane.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: He nɛ a sɛu Yesu ngɛ ɔ, abɔɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ e mi yɔkɔ he nɛ a to we nɔ ngɛ mi hyɛ.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu na kaa a gbe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ ba mi ɔ, e de ke, “Kuma ngɛ mi yee!”

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Kplu ko maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ e mi dã tɔtɔɔtɔ nɛ kuã. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ wo mi kutsa ngɔ sɔ dã a mi, nɛ a ngɔ ma tso nya, nɛ a kɛ to e nya he.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu he dã nɛ kuã a, e de ke, “A gbe nya!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ma e yi si, nɛ e ngɔ e nya. A gbɔ Yesu kasa mi nɔ́

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya na Pilato kaa e ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a ku nihi nɛ a gbe ɔ a nanehi, nɛ a je mɛ kɛ je sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ a dlaa he kɛ haa Hetsɔmi ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sume nɛ gbogboe ɔmɛ nɛ a hi sɛumi tso nɔ kɛ yaa si Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, ejakaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi nguaa nitsɛ lɛ ngɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Mohu ta buli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake kɛ e we akplɔ ɔ gbɔ Yesu kasa mi; nɛ amlɔ ɔ, muɔ kɛ nyu je mi kɛ be.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ lɛ ye odase nɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ he ye; ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e le kaa anɔkuale nɛ e tu.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: A pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ nɛ a ngma ke, “A be e wu ko kue” ɔ, nɛ ba mi.

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, ngmami kpa hu deɔ ke, “A maa hyɛ nɔ nɛ a gbɔ lɛ nɔ́ ɔ.” Yesu pumi (Mateo

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya to Yesu gbogboe ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa yɔkɔ ɔ he kɛ we, nɛ jehanɛ ɔ hu, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ a dlaa he kɛ haa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Yosef nɛ je Arimatia ya bi Pilato nɛ́ e ha lɛ blɔ, nɛ e ya ngɔ Yesu gbogboe ɔ. Yosef ɔ, Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ ji lɛ, se Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he gbeye he je ɔ, e je we e he si paa. Pilato ha lɛ blɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yosef ho nɛ e ya je gbogboe ɔ.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a ya ngɔ Yesu gbogboe ɔ, nɛ a wo lɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a, nɛ a kɛ kploba bla lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yuda bi peeɔ kɛ puɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Toma he nɔ ke, “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ! Ye Mawu!”

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Otsi ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ makɛ mla, benɛ je mi tsɔ we lolo ɔ, Maria Magdalena ba yɔkɔ ɔ he, nɛ e na kaa a je tɛ ɔ kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ nya.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, kaselɔ kaketsɛ ɔ nɛ su lejɛ ɔ kekle ɔ hu sɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi; nɛ benɛ e na ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e he ye.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu ba je e he kpo ɔ, Toma, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hayo hulɔ ɔ be lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: nɛ e na hiɔwe bɔfohi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A wo ní hiɔ, nɛ a hii si ngɛ he nɛ a kɛ Yesu gbogboe ɔ fɔ si ngɛ ɔ; nɔ kake ngɛ e yi je, kɛ nɔ kake hu ngɛ e nane si je.

english_verse: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo fo kɛ ya na Simon Petro, kɛ kaselɔ kpa a nɛ Yesu suɔ lɛ ɔ ngɛ he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “A wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbogboe kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ mi, nɛ wa li he nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ.”

english_verse: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
translation_verse: Petro kɛ kaselɔ kpa a pue nɔ kɛ ho yɔkɔ ɔ he ya.

english_verse: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.
translation_verse: Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a kɛ fo wo mi, se nɔ kake ɔ be Petro he, nɛ lɛ kekle e su yɔkɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: He bent over and saw the strips of linen cloth lying inside the tomb, but he did not go in.
translation_verse: E ya kɔkɔ e yi si, nɛ e na kploba amɛ nɛ a kɛ bla Yesu gbogboe ɔ, se e sɛ we yɔkɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: kɛ duku nɛ a kɛ fi e yi ɔ hulɔ. Duku ɔ be kploba amɛ a kasa nya; se mohu a ku mi kɛ fɔ si ngɛ he ko banee.

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: A bi Maria ke, “Maa, mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ ya foe ɔ?” E de mɛ ke, “A wo ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ je, nɛ i li he nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Maa, mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ ya foe ɔ? Mɛnɔ o ngɛ hlae?” Maria susu kaa eko ɔ, abɔɔ ɔ mi dlalɔ ji lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mo nɛ o ba wo lɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ, lɛɛ tsɔɔ mi he nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya fɔ nɛ ma ya wo lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “Koo ta ye he, ejakaa i na we ma ya hiɔwe ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ lolo. Se yaa ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ o ya de mɛ ke, ‘I yaa hiɔwe ngɛ Tsaatsɛ, kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ Tsɛ; ye Mawu, kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ.’ ”

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ e dɛ mi ɔ, kɛ e kasa mi ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ. Kaseli ɔmɛ ná bua jɔmi babauu kaa a na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ ji otsi ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a he gbeye nya a, kaseli ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ he ko, nɛ a nga sinya amɛ. Tlukaa a, Yesu ba da si ngɛ a kpɛti. E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ he manye!”

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kpale de mɛ ekohu ke, “Nyɛ he manye! Bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔe.”

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e mu ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ he Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ngɔ nɔ ko he yayami kɛ pa lɛ ɔ, a kɛ pa; nɛ ke nyɛ ngɔ nɔ ko he yayami kɛ to ɔ, a ngɔ to.” Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ Toma

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli kpa amɛ de lɛ pee se ke, “Wa na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ!” Se Toma de mɛ ke, “Ja i na e dɛ mi plɛɛko pa amɛ nɛ i kɛ ye nine nguɛ slaa a nya, nɛ i ngɔ ye nine hɔ e kasa mi ɔ hulɔ loko ma he ye.”

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: Ligbi kpaanyɔ se ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ bua a he nya ekohu ngɛ tsu mi, nɛ Toma piɛ a he. A nga sinya amɛ, se Yesu ba nɛ e ba da si ngɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ he manye!”

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e de Toma ke, “Ngɔɔ o nine nguɛ ba slaa ye dɛ mi nɛ o hyɛ; nɛ o kɛ o nine ba hɔ ye kasa mi. Kpa nɔ jemi, nɛ o he ye!”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Toma, nɛ o na mi ɔ, tse o he ye? A gbaa nihi nɛ nɛ́, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a heɔ yeɔ!” Nɔ nɛ he nɛ a ngma womi nɛ ɔ

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Yesu pee okadi kpahi fuu ngɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ a ngmɛ́ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: Se enɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngma, konɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Yesu ji Kristo, Mawu Bi ɔ. Nɛ ke nyɛ he lɛ ye ɔ, nyɛ yi ma na wami.

english_verse: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.
translation_verse: Simon Petro, kɛ Toma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hayo hulɔ ɔ, Natanael nɛ je Kana ngɛ Galilea a, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni kpahi enyɔ hu ya bua ngɛ he ko.

english_verse: Simon Peter said, “I'm going fishing!” The others said, “We will go with you.” They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon Petro de mɛ ke, “I yaa wo.” A he nɔ ke, “Wɔ tsuo waa kɛ mo maa ya.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho. Se jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a gbi lo kake ngmelu po.

english_verse: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.
translation_verse: Makɛ benɛ je mi ngɛ tsɔe ɔ, Yesu ba da si ngɛ wo ɔ nya, se kaseli ɔmɛ yo we lɛ.

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ fɔ ya a ngɛ lɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa gbe lo.” A fɔ ya a, nɛ lo nɛ a gbe ɔ hiɛ babauu, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a gbla ya a.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Kaselɔ nɛ Yesu suɔ lɛ ɔ de Petro ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ɔ nɛ.” Benɛ Simon Petro nu nɛ a de ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ daa si ɔ, e wo e tade ɔ ngɔ muɔ e mlɛ mi, nɛ e tu ma pa a mi, ejakaa e hɛɛ e he gu.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ba kple ɔ, a na kaa a ngɔ hã kɛ slɛ la ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ lo pueɔ si ngɛ nɔ, kɛ abolo hulɔ.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ lo nɛ nyɛ gbe ɔ eko kɛ ba.”

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ba kɛ̃ abolo ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ. Nɛ e ha mɛ lo ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji si etɛ nɛ Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ kaseli ɔmɛ benɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ se. Yesu kɛ Petro gba sane

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ye ní ɔ gbe nya a, Yesu bi Simon Petro ke, “Simon, Yohane bi, anɛ o suɔ mi pe bɔ nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ suɔ mi lo?” Simon he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, o le kaa i suɔ mo!” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ ye to bi ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: Yesu kpale bi lɛ si enyɔne ke, “Simon, Yohane bi, o suɔ mi lo?” Petro he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, o le kaa i suɔ mo!” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ ye to ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Yesu kpale bi lɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji si etɛ ke, “Simon, Yohane bi, o suɔ mi lo?” E dɔ Petro kaa Yesu bi lɛ si etɛ sɔuu ke e suɔ lɛ lo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo nitsɛ o le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; mo nitsɛ o le kaa i suɔ mo!” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ ye to ɔmɛ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke o nihe mi ɔ, mo nitsɛ o miaa, nɛ o yaa he tsuaa he nɛ o suɔ. Se ke o ba bwɔ ɔ, o ma wo o nine nɔ, nɛ nɔ kpa maa mia mo; nɛ e kɛ mo maa ya he nɛ o sume kaa o maa ya.”

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Yesu de enɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Petro ma gbo kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami. Jehanɛ e de Petro ke, “Nyɛɛ ye se.” Yesu tu kaselɔ ɔ nɛ e suɔ ɔ he munyu

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Petro po e he, nɛ e na kaa kaselɔ kaketsɛ ɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ ma ngɛ e se. Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ lɛ hi si ngɛ Yesu kasa nya be nɛ a ngɛ nyagbe ní ɔ yee ɔ nɛ. Lɛ nɛ bi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke mɛnɔ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Benɛ Petro na lɛ ɔ, e bi Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ke i suɔ kaa e hi si kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma kpale kɛ ba a, mɛni lɔ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ o he? Moo lɛɛ nyɛɛ ye se!”

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ ɔ ba pɛ ngɛ Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a tue mi kaa kaselɔ nɛ ɔ be gboe gblegbleegble. Kpahu Yesu de we ke e be gboe; se mohu e ke, “Ke i suɔ kaa e hi si kɛ yaa si ma kpale kɛ ba a, mɛni lɔ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ o he?”

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a kaselɔ ɔ nya mi munyu ji enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Lɛ nɔuu lɛ ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ wa le kaa nɔ nɛ e de ɔ ngɛ mi. Nyagbe

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Yesu pee ní kpahi babauu, nɛ ke a ngma lɛ tsuo kakaaka a, womihi nɛ a ko ná a, e peeɔ mi kaa, a ko na we a to he ngɛ je ɔ mi.

english_verse: Theophilus, I first wrote to you about all that Jesus did and taught from the very first
translation_verse: Ye suɔlɔ Teofilo: Ngɛ ye kekle womi ɔ mi ɔ, i ngma níhi tsuo nɛ Yesu ba pee, kɛ ní nɛ e tsɔɔ kɛ je be nɛ e bɔni e ní tsumi,

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya. Loko a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a, e gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ bɔfohi nɛ e hla a mlaa nɛ a ye nɔ.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: Benɛ a nya ba bua ngɛ he kake ɔ, e fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko je Yerusalem; se mohu nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si be nɛ si nɛ Tsaatsɛ wo ɔ maa ba mi kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momo ɔ.

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: Yohane ngɔ nyu kɛ sɔle nihi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e be kɛe nɛ a kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa sɔle nyɛ.” A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho hiɔwe ya

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Benɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ Yesu ba bua ngɛ he kake ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, anɛ kikɛmɛ a be nɛ ɔ mi nɛ o maa kpale ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ ha Israel ɔ lo?”

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Yesu de mɛ ke, “Be nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi ɔ, Tsaatsɛ pɛ lɛ to, nɛ e pi nyɛ blɔ nya kaa nyɛ maa le;

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: se ke Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ na ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma na he wami kɛ fiɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye odase ha mi ngɛ Yerusalem, Yudea, kɛ Samaria tsuo kɛ yaa su je ɔ nyagbe he tɔɔ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɛ lɛ hyɛe nɔuu nɛ a wo lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, nɛ bɔku ba sa lɛ kɛ ho nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: Benɛ e yaa nɛ a ngɛ hiɔwe hyɛe too kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tlukaa a, ne nyumuhi enyɔ nɛ wo tade hiɔ, nɛ daa si ngɛ a kasa nya.

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔmɛ bi ke, “Nyɛ Galilea bi mɛni he je nyɛ daa si ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi hyɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Yesu ɔ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya nɛ ɔ, e maa kpale kɛ ba ja nɔuu kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ na lɛ nɛ e yaa a.” Yuda nane mi malɔ

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
translation_verse: A ba sɛ ma a mi, nɛ a kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe tsu mi he nɛ a ba to ɔ. Mɛ ji Petro, Yohane, Yakobo, Andrea, Filipo, Toma, Bartolomeo, Mateo, Alfeo bi Yakobo, Simon ma he doolɔ ɔ, kɛ Yuda, Yakobo bi ɔ.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: A kɛ yi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yesu nyɛ Maria, kɛ Yesu nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ pɔɔ a he nya buami kɛ ha sɔlemi.

english_verse: He said: My friends, long ago by the power of the Holy Spirit, David said something about Judas, and what he said has now happened. Judas was one of us and had worked with us, but he brought the mob to arrest Jesus.
translation_verse: Yuda a, jinɛ e piɛ wa he; a hla lɛ, nɛ a ha lɛ blɔ nya, konɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ tsu sɔmɔmi ní tsumi nɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: (Se Yuda tsu yi wu tso ní; nɛ sika nɛ e na ngɛ mi ɔ, e ngɔ ya he abɔɔ. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e gbo ngɛ, nɛ e mi ni pã pue si.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ na le enɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɛɛ jamɛ a abɔɔ ɔ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbi mi ke Akeldama. E sisi ji “Muɔ Abɔɔ.”)

english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: “Bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ La womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ‘E we ɔ nɛ pee we doku, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó hi mi.’ A ngma hu ke, ‘E sɔmɔmi blɔ nya a, nɔ kpa nɛ he.’

english_verse: So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa nɔ ko nɛ ba piɛ wa he kɛ ye odase kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, e sa kaa e pee nihi nɛ piɛ wa he benɛ waa kɛ Yesu nyɛɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa a a ti nɔ kake. E pee nɔ ko nɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ kɛ je be nɛ Yohane bɔni fiɛmi ke e sa kaa a sɔle nɔ ɔ, kɛ ba si be nɛ a ngɔ Yesu kɛ je wa he kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a.”

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hla ni enyɔ ngɔ da si, Yosef nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Barsaba hulɔ, nɛ e biɛ kpa ji Yusto ɔ, kɛ Matia.

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a sɔle ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo nɛ o le nimli tsuo a tsui mi, tsɔɔ wɔ ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ nɛ o hla,

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: konɛ e sɔmɔ kaa bɔfo ngɛ Yuda nane mi. Yuda je wa he kɛ ho he nɛ sa kaa e hi ɔ ya.”

english_verse: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.
translation_verse: Benɛ Pentekoste ligbi ɔ su ɔ, nihi nɛ heɔ yeɔ tsuo a nya ba bua ngɛ he kake.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Si kake too ɔ, a nu nɔ́ ko nɛ pɛ kɛ je hiɔwe kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa lɛ ngɛ fiae; nɛ e ba hyi we ɔ mi he nɛ a hii si ngɛ ɔ tɔ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba mɛ tsuo a nɔ saminya, nɛ a bɔni gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi tumi ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami nya.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yuda bi komɛ nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ngɛ Yerusalem jamɛ a be ɔ mi. A je je ma amɛ tsuo a mi.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Benɛ a nu nɛ nɔ́ ɔ pɛ ɔ, nihi babauu ba bua a he nya. Mɛ tsuo a he mi po; ejakaa a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nu kaa a ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi gbi tue.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa. A de ke, “Nihi nɛ ngɛ munyu tue nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, Galilea bi ji mɛ!

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Wa je Partia, kɛ Media, kɛ Elam; wa ti ni komɛ je Mesopotamia, Yudea, Kapadokia, Ponto, kɛ Asia;

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: Wɔ tsuo ɔ, Yuda bi kɛ ma je li nɛ ba sɛ Yuda bi jami ɔ mi ji wɔ; nɛ wa ti ni komɛ hu je Kreta, kɛ Arabia; se wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ nue nɛ a ngɛ Mawu ní nguangua amɛ jajee ngɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa je gbi mi!”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a dɛ yaa. A bi a sibi ke, “Kɛ ji enɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Se ni komɛ hu ye fɛu ke, “Wai he nɛ a nu nɛ a de.” Munyu nɛ Petro tu

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Petro kɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ te da si; Petro wo e nya nɔ nɛ e tu munyu tsɔɔ ni kpekpemi ɔ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi, kɛ nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nyɛɛ bu mi tue, konɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Tsa pi dã nɛ ni mli nɛ ɔmɛ de kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ susue ɔ, ejakaa mɔtu ngmlɛ nɛɛ kɛkɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Se mohu enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ Yoel tu he munyu ɔ nɛ:

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: ‘Mawu ke, Nyagbe be ɔ, ma ngɔ ye Mumi ɔ kɛ wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi. Nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ maa fiɛ ye sɛ gbi ɔ; nihewi maa na nina, nɛ nikɔtɔmahi maa nla.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Ye tsɔli nyumu ɔmɛ kɛ yi ɔmɛ hu, ma ha mɛ ye Mumi ɔ jamɛ a be ɔ mi, nɛ a maa fiɛ ye sɛ gbi ɔ.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Ma pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ okadihi ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Muɔ, kɛ la, kɛ la su ku maa ba.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Pu maa tsɔ diblii, nɛ nyɔhiɔ ma pee tsutsuutsu kaa muɔ loko Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi nguaa nɛ ngɛ gbeye ɔ maa ba.

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: “Ye nyɛmimɛ Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu munyu nɛ ɔ tue saminya! Nyakpɛ níhi, kɛ okadihi nɛ Mawu pee kɛ gu Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ nɔ ɔ yeɔ odase paa kaa Mawu nitsɛ lɛ tsɔ lɛ. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le enɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ kpɛti a pee ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Mawu nitsɛ to e yi mi momo kaa e maa ngɔ Yesu ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ. Nyɛ ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha yayami peeli nɛ a sɛu lɛ ngɛ sɛumi tso nɔ, nɛ e gbo.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje; e kpɔ lɛ ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi, ejakaa gbenɔ be e nya nyɛe maa tsi kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ David de ngɛ e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘I naa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ daa; e ngɛ ye hiɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa wo ye he gbeye.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye tsui nɔ ye mi, nɛ i kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ munyu tue; se imi nɛ adesa kɛkɛ ji mi ɔ, ma ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ kulaa.

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Ejakaa o be mi sie ngɛ gbeje; o be hae nɛ o nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ puɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ mi.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: O ha nɛ i le blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi ɔ. O ma ha ye tsui maa nɔ ye mi fuaa ngɛ o hɛ mi.’

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: “Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ha ma tu munyu paa ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ wa nɛ̃ Matsɛ David he. E gbo nɛ a pu lɛ, nɛ e yɔkɔ ngɛ wa kpɛti kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ ji lɛ, nɛ si nɛ Mawu wo lɛ ɔ, e le. Mawu wo David si kaa e ma ha e nina ma ba ye tsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ David ɔ ye tsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: David na nɔ́ nɛ Mawu maa pee ɔ momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tu Kristo si temi ɔ he munyu, nɛ e de ke, ‘A si we lɛ ngɛ gbeje, nɛ e he lo hu puɛ we ngɛ yɔkɔ mi.’

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: Mawu tle kikɛmɛ a Yesu nɛ ɔ nɔuu si kɛ je gbeje; lɔ ɔ he odase yeli ji wɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: A wo e nɔ kɛ ho e Tsɛ Mawu ɔ hiɔ nɔ ya, nɛ e ná Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ a wo he si ɔ kɛ je e dɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ, Yesu lɛ ha nɛ e ba.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Ejakaa tsa pi David nɛ ya hiɔwe ɔ, se David nɔuu lɛ de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, Hii si ngɛ ye hiɔ nɔ,

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: nɛ ma pee o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ o nane maa nɔ.’

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi tsuo nɛ́ a na nɛ a le kaa Yesu ɔ nɛ nyɛ sɛu ɔ, Mawu ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ nɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hla!”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Benɛ ni ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e hao mɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ a bi Petro kɛ bɔfo kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ke, “Wa nyɛmimɛ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Petro de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha nɛ a sɔle lɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, kɛkɛ, a maa ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma na Mawu nɔke nɔ́ nɛ ji Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa si nɛ Mawu wo ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nihi abɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ se lokoo nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ma tsɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ ɔ nyɛ he ngɛ mi.”

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Petro tu munyu kpahi fuu kɛ ye odase, nɛ e kɛ wo mɛ ga ke, “Tue gblami nɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi yayami peeli ma na a, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ e kó ba nyɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kaseɔ ní be tsuaa be ngɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a ngɔ; a kɛ mɛ peeɔ kake kɛ yeɔ ní, nɛ a kɛ peeɔ sɔlemi hulɔ. Nihi nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ a si himi

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Kɛ gu bɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a pee nyakpɛ níhi, kɛ okadihi babauu, nɛ gbeye nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ tsuo kake peemi saminya ngɛ mɛ tsuo a kpɛti, nɛ a gba we nɔ ko mi ngɛ nɔ ko he.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: A jua a zugba amɛ, kɛ a weto ní tsuo, nɛ a dla sika a ngɔ ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo bɔ nɛ he hia nɔ tsuaa nɔ.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Daa ligbi ɔ, a ya kpee ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ a buaa a he nya kɛ ya kuɔ abolo ngɛ a sibi a we mi, nɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ je tsui mi faa yeɔ ní.

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: A jeɔ Mawu yi be tsuaa be, nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo ná a he bua jɔmi babauu. Daa ligbi ɔ, nihi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he a yi wami ba piɛɔ asafo ɔ he.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko piani ngmlɛ etɛ sɔlemi be ɔ, Petro kɛ Yohane nyɛɛ kɛ yaa sɔlemi we ɔ.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Nyumu ko nɛ kplɔ kɛ je e fɔmi mi hii si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ we agbo nɛ a tsɛɛ Agbo Saminyayoo ɔ nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Daa ligbi ɔ, a woɔ nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ baa agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e ba baa ní ngɛ nihi nɛ yaa sɔlemi we ɔ a dɛ.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Benɛ e na Petro kɛ Yohane nɛ a yaa sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e ba mɛ ní.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Se Petro kɛ Yohane hyɛ lɛ too; nɛ Petro de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ wa hɛ mi!”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ glɔtsɛ ɔ hyɛ mɛ gaa, nɛ e hyɛ blɔ kaa e ma ná nɔ́ ko kɛ je a dɛ.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Se Petro de lɛ ke, “I be sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu, se nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ i ngɛ mo hae nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ngɛ Yesu Kristo, Nazaret no ɔ biɛ mi ɔ, tee si nɛ o nyɛɛ!”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro nu glɔtsɛ ɔ hiɔ nine, nɛ e wo e nɔ da si. Amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, glɔtsɛ ɔ nane kɛ e kpɔji nya amɛ a mi wa lɛ;

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: e hlu da si, nɛ e bɔni nyɛɛmi. Jehanɛ e nyɛɛ a se kɛ ya sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo ɔ, e ngɛ hlue nɛ e ngɛ Mawu yi jee.

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: Benɛ a kpá si kaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ jinɛ e hii si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ Agbo Saminyayoo ɔ nya, nɛ e hii nɔ́ bae ɔ, a he mi po, nɛ a nya kpɛ a he saminya ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba a he. Munyu nɛ Petro tu ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ mɛtɛ Petro kɛ Yohane a he kɛ mwɔɔ ngɛ ablanaa nɛ a tsɛɛ Salomo Ablanaa a nɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee ni ɔmɛ nyakpɛ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a bu kɛ ba e ngɔ.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Benɛ Petro na ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛhi, mɛni he je nyɛ hɛ mi pee nyɛ yaa? Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ wɔ hyɛe gaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Nyɛ susu kaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wami, aloo wa Mawu nɛ wa jaa saminya he je nɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Wa nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu ɔ wo e tsɔlɔ Yesu hɛ mi nyami. Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ je lɛ ngɔ ha, nɛ nyɛ kua lɛ ngɛ Pilato hɛ mi, be mi nɛ lɛɛ e pee e juɛmi kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e he ɔ.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kua nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ dami sane pɛ e yeɔ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ke a ngmɛɛ awi yelɔ mohu he ngɔ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: Wami matsɛ ɔ, nyɛ gbe lɛ. Se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje; lɔ ɔ nɔuu he odase yeli ji wɔ.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: E he wami nya nɛ a tsa glɔtsɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ná le nɛ ɔ, a nyɛ́ pee akɛnɛ a heɔ lɛ yeɔ. E he Yesu ye, lɔ ɔ he nɛ e na he wami kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: “Jehanɛ ye nyɛmimɛ, i le kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ pee Yesu ɔ, pe nyɛ li nɛ nyɛ pee.

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: Se nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de to momo kɛ gu e gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kaa Kristo maa na amanehlu ɔ, ha e ba mi ja niinɛ.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, mumi mi he wami maa je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba; e maa tsɔ Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ e hla ngɔ to ha nyɛ momo ɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: E sa kaa e ya hi hiɔwe kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa pee níhi tsuo ehe. Mawu tu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he munyu kɛ gu e gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ blema lokoo.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mose de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma tle gbalɔ ko si kaa imi kɛ maa je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɔ ha nyɛ. Nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Si nɛ Mawu wo kɛ gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ nɔ́, nɛ somi nɛ Mawu kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ, nyɛ piɛ he. Bɔ nɛ e de Abraham ji, ‘Ma gu o nina nɔ nɛ ma gbaa nimli tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ.’

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu hla e tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e maa tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ kekle, konɛ e ba gbaa nyɛ, nɛ e kpale nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ je e blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Petro kɛ Yohane ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ ngɛ ma a tsɔɔe kɛ mwɔɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo komɛ, sɔlemi we ɔ asafoatsɛ ɔ, kɛ Saduki bi komɛ ba pue a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: A mi mi fu wawɛɛ, ejakaa bɔfo enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a ní tsɔɔe ke Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ lɔ ɔ maa nɔ mi kaa gbogboehi maa te si kɛ ba wami mi.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a nu Petro kɛ Yohane; nɛ a ya wo mɛ tsu kɛ yaa su be nɛ je maa na, ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ du bu.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ ba bu sɛ gbi ɔ tue ɔ, a ti nihi babauu nɛ maa su akpe enuɔ he ye.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: E nɔ jena a, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Hana, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, Kayafa, Yohane, Aleksandro, kɛ nihi abɔ nɛ je osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a weku ɔ mi ba kpe ɔ.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: A ha bɔfo ɔmɛ ba da a hɛ mi, nɛ a bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ nyɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ tsa glɔtsɛ ɔ? Mɛnɔ he wami nya, aloo mɛnɔ biɛ mi nyɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hyi lɛ tɔ ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ Israel ma hɛ mi nyɛɛli, kɛ ma nimeli,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: ke a kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu yee mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpakpa nɛ a pee kikɛmɛ a glɔtsɛ nɛ ɔ he, kaa kɛ a pee kɛ tsa lɛ kɛɛ ɔ,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ le, nɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo hu nɛ na nɛ a le ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ɔ, Yesu Kristo, Nazaret no ɔ he wami nya nɛ a tsa lɛ. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ sɛu Yesu ɔ, se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Yesu nɛ ɔ nɔuu he ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ ke, ‘Tɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ nyɛ sake fɔ he ɔ plɛ kɔ nya tɛ.’

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔ kake too pɛ lɛ ma nyɛ ma he nimli a yi wami. E se ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be je ɔ mi nɛ Mawu ha lɛ kikɛmɛ a he wami nɛ ma nyɛ he wa yi wami.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Benɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ na kã nɛ Petro kɛ Yohane pee, nɛ a ná le hu kaa nimli gu kɛkɛ ji mɛ, se pi womi mi leli ɔ, a he mi po. A kɔ se kaa a kɛ Yesu hi si.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: A nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ a ma de, ejakaa nɔmlɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ kɛ Petro, kɛ Yohane daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: Nyakpɛ nɔ́ nguaa nɛ Mawu tsu kɛ gu nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, nihi tsuo ngɛ Yerusalem nu he; nɛ wa be nyɛe ma de ke e be mi.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ munyu ɔ ko gbɛ fĩa fuu ko hu ngɛ ma a mi he je ɔ, nyɛ ha waa bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko ngɔ Yesu biɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ní hu.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɛ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a fia a tue mi wawɛɛ ke a ko wo Yesu biɛ ta, nɛ a ko ngɔ Yesu biɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ní kulaa hu.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Se Petro kɛ Yohane he nɔ nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Ke e da blɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa a bu nyɛ mohu tue pe Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ kojo.

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ a gu kikɛmɛ a nyakpɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ tsa lɛ ɔ ye pe jeha nyingmi eywiɛ. Asafo ɔ kpa pɛɛ kɛ bi he wami womi

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngmɛɛ Petro kɛ Yohane he nɔuu nɛ a ba nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ, a ba sɛɛ níhi tsuo nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ de mɛ ɔ ha mɛ.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nu ɔ, a kɛ juɛmi kake fa kue ha Mawu ke, “Mo Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ o bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba, kɛ wo, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ a mi.

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: O ha nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ wo wa nɛ̃ David, o tsɔlɔ ɔ he wami, nɛ e tu munyu ke, ‘Mɛni he je ma je li ɔmɛ ngɛ hoo pee, nɛ a ngɛ nihi a yi nɔ soe yaka gu?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya; nɛ a te si ngɔ wo e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, Herode, Pontio Pilato, ma je li ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma amɛ hu ba bua a he nya ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi ngɔ wo Yesu, o tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ he.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: A ba bua a he nya, konɛ a pee níhi tsuo ngɛ o he wami nya kaa bɔ nɛ o to ngɔ fɔ si kaa a pee ɔ.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu Nyɔmtsɛ, hyɛ wa he gbeye nɛ a ngɛ woe ɔ, nɛ o wo wɔ, o sɔmɔli ɔmɛ kã nɛ waa jaje o munyu ɔ.
