english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Je o he wami kpo, nɛ o ha a tsa nihi, nɛ a ngɔ Yesu, o tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ biɛ kɛ pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi.”

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Benɛ a sɔle kikɛ ɔ, he nɛ a bua ngɛ ɔ mimiɛ, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba mɛ tsuo a nɔ saminya, nɛ a ngɔ kã kɛ jaje Mawu munyu ɔ. Nihi nɛ he ye ɔ pee a níhi tsuo kake

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Nihi babauu nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ tsuo hɛɛ juɛmi kake, kɛ mumi kake. Nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko tsɛ we e níhi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ mi eko ke lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ́, se mohu, nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ ɔ peeɔ ma tsuo nɔ́.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: He wami kpetekpleenyɛ lɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si temi ɔ he odase, nɛ Mawu dloo mɛ babauu.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be a kpɛti nɛ nɔ́ ko he hia lɛ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ we, loo zugba a juaa, nɛ a kɛ sika a baa.

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: A kɛ ba haa bɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ a dlaa kɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ he hia lɛ.

english_verse: Joseph was one of the followers who had sold a piece of property and brought the money to the apostles. He was a Levite from Cyprus, and the apostles called him Barnabas, which means “one who encourages others.”
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ ba loko Yosef ya jua e zugba nɛ e ngɔ sika a ba ha bɔfo ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yosef nɛ ɔ, Levi no ji lɛ; a fɔ lɛ ngɛ Kipro. Biɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ji Barnaba. E sisi ji nɔmlɔ nɛ woɔ nɔ he wami.

english_verse: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.
translation_verse: Se nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania, kɛ e yo Safira ya jua a weto ní ko.

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: Anania kɛ sika nɛ a na a mi fa ko to, nɛ e yo ɔ hu le he nɔ ko. Nɛ e kɛ sika a mi fa nɛ piɛ ba ha bɔfo ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de lɛ ke, “Anania, mɛni he je Satan ba sɛ o mi nɛ o ye Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lakpa kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Sika nɛ o na benɛ o jua zugba a, o ngɔ fa ngɔ to, pi jã?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Benɛ zugba a ngɛ ɔ, o nɔ́; nɛ benɛ o jua a hu sika a mo nitsɛ o nɔ́. Mɛni he je o to o yi mi, nɛ o pee yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ, pi adesa nɛ o ye lakpa, se Mawu!”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Benɛ Anania nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e tsɔ fia si, nɛ e gbo. Nihi tsuo nɛ nu sane nɛ ba a ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ba, nɛ a ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ blaa e gbogboe ɔ, nɛ a ya pu lɛ.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Maa pee ngmlɛfia etɛ se ɔ, e yo ɔ hu ba lejɛ ɔ; lɛɛ e li sane nɛ ba.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Petro bi lɛ ke, “De mi anɔkuale ɔ; anɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ o huno ɔ nyɛ jua zugba a ha ji nɛ ɔ?” Safira he nɔ ke, “Ee, sika a tsuo ji ja a nɛ.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Petro bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ pee nyɛ nya kake kɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ lakpa a, nyɛ susu kaa nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he lo? Hyɛ, nihi nɛ ya pu o huno ɔ, mɛ lɛ a kpale kɛ ma a nɛ; a ma wo mo hu kɛ ho!”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, e tsɔ fia si ngɛ Petro nane nya, nɛ e gbo. Benɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ba su we ɔ mi ɔ, a na kaa e gbo; kɛkɛ nɛ a wo lɛ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya pu lɛ ngɛ e huno ɔ kasa nya.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Asafo ɔ, kɛ ni kpahi tsuo nɛ nu sane nɛ ɔ ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Mawu pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi babauu kɛ gu bɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti. He nɛ a pɔɔ kpemi ngɛ ji Salomo Ablanaa a nɔ.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa nihi tuɔ a he munyu kpakpa mohu, se e bɛ nɔ kpa ko yi mi kaa e ya piɛ a he.

english_verse: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyumuhi, kɛ yihi babauu nɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yeɔ ɔ ba piɛ asafo ɔ he.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: Nyakpɛ níhi nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ pee he je ɔ, ke pee ɔ, nihi ngɔɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ kɛ a sa kɛ baa gbɛjegbɛ tue, konɛ ke Petro bee ɔ, e nini kɛkɛ po nɛ nɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Nihi jeɔ mahi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ a mi kɛ baa. A kɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ mɛ haoe ɔ baa, nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ tsaa hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ hulɔ. A wa bɔfo ɔmɛ yi mi

english_verse: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, kɛ e nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ nɛ hunga sa mɛ ɔ te si kɛ hɛdɔ wawɛɛ

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: kɛ wo bɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ a ya wo mɛ tsu.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Se nyɔ mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ba bli tsu ɔ nya sinya amɛ, nɛ e je mɛ; nɛ e de mɛ ke,

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛɛ ya sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ nyɛ ya jaje kikɛmɛ a si himi he nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a.”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ pee bɔ nɛ a de mɛ ɔ. A pue nɔ mɔtu kɛ ho sɔlemi we ɔ ya ya tsɔɔ ní. Jehanɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, kɛ e nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ kpe ngua a mi ɔ kpe. A tsɔ nihi kɛ ya he nɛ a wo bɔfo ɔmɛ tsu ngɛ ɔ, konɛ a ya ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Se benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ su lejɛ ɔ, a nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpale a se nɛ a ba bɔ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ amaniɛ ke,

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “Benɛ wa ya a, tsu ɔ nya ngɛ ngangɛ. A ngmɛ mi kpɛii, nɛ buli ɔmɛ hu pee klaalo kɛ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya. Se benɛ wa bli ɔ, wa nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko!”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Benɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ asafoatsɛ ɔ nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa, nɛ a li nɔ nɛ a ma de.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ ko ba de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ le nɔ́ ko! Ni ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ nuu wo tsu ɔ, a daa si ngɛ ma a ní tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ya ngɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba. A pee we mɛ soisoi, ejakaa a ngɛ gbeye yee kaa ma a maa fia mɛ tɛ.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: A ngɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba da kpe ngua a hɛ mi, nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ta a nya mi.

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: E bi mɛ ke, “Tse wa fia nyɛ tue mi veveeve ke nyɛ ko ngɔ Yesu biɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ní hu? Se nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ pee! Nyɛ ha nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ nu nyumu nɛ ɔ he sane nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ kaa wɔ nɛ wa gbe lɛ!”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Petro, kɛ bɔfo kpa amɛ he nɔ ke, “E sa kaa waa bu Mawu mohu tue, se pi nimli.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Yesu nɛ nyɛ sɛu ngɛ tso nɔ nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ ɔ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ tle lɛ si.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Mawu wo e nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ kɛ to e hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e pee lɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ, kɛ kpɔlɔ, konɛ Israel bi nɛ a ná he blɔ nɛ a tsake a tsui, nɛ a ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase yee; nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ ngɛ odase yee ja nɔuu.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Benɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e wo a mi mi la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e pee mɛ kaa a gbe bɔfo ɔmɛ.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Se a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gamaliel ɔ te da si. Farisi no, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ ma a buu saminya ji lɛ. Gamaliel fa ke a je bɔfo ɔmɛ kpo bɔɔ;

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: nɛ e de sihi he ɔ ke, “Sane nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ yee nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: E se ɔ, Yuda, Galilea no ɔ hu ba benɛ a ngɛ nihi kanee ɔ. E ba gbla nihi kɛ nyɛɛ e se, se lɛ hu e hɛ mi kpata, nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛ fĩa.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Se ke Mawu dɛ mi nɛ e je ɔ, nyɛ be Mawu nɔ nyɛe maa ye. Nyɛ ko ba pee nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ a kɛ Mawu ngɛ ta hwue!” Kpe ngua a ngɔ Gamaliel ga womi ɔ.

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: A tsɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a ha nɛ a fia mɛ kpa. A bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ hulɔ ke a ko fiɛ kɛ Yesu biɛ hu; kɛkɛ nɛ a ngmɛɛ a he.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ je kpe ngua a hɛ mi kɛ ho kɛ bua jɔmi kaa Yesu biɛ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu bu mɛ nihi nɛ sa kaa a bɔ mɛ ahlua.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Daa ligbi ɔ, a tsɔɔ ní, nɛ a fiɛɔ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Yesu Kristo he ɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ nihi a wehi a mi.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Jamɛ be ɔ mi benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a he ba bɔni hiɛmi ɔ, a kpɛti nihi nɛ tuɔ Hela gbi ɔ ba te si kɛ wo ni nɛmɛ nɛ tuɔ Hebri gbi ɔ ke a hyɛ we mɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ Hela gbi ɔ a yalɔyi ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ sa; sika nɛ a haa yalɔyihi daa ligbi nɛ a kɛ hyɛɛ a he nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nine sui a nɔ́ nɔ.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔfo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsɛ nihi nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “E sɛ kaa wa siɔ Mawu munyu ɔ fiɛmi se, nɛ wa ya yeɔ niye ní sane.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ hla nyɛ kpɛti ni kpaago, nihi nɛ ngɛ biɛ kpakpa; nihi nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hyi mɛ tɔ, nɛ a le ní hulɔ, konɛ waa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to ní tsumi nɛ ɔ nya.

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa ngɔ wa be tsuo kɛ pee sɔlemi, nɛ waa fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ de ɔ, asafo ɔ kplɛɛ nɔ, nɛ a hla Stefano, nyumu ko nɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ e mi saminya a, kɛ Filipo, kɛ Prokoro, kɛ Nikanor, kɛ Timon, kɛ Parmena, kɛ Nikolao, ma je no nɛ je Antiokia nɛ tsake ba sɛ Yuda bi a jami ɔ mi be ko ɔ.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: A kɛ mɛ ba da bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ sɔle, nɛ a kɛ a nine pue a nɔ.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Mawu munyu ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e gbɛ fĩa saminya. Nihi nɛ he ye ɔ a he ba hiɛ babauu ngɛ Yeruslem, nɛ Yuda osɔfo ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi saii nitsɛ he Mawu munyu ɔ ye. A nu Stefano

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Mawu dloo Stefano saminya, nɛ e ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ pee nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi ngɛ ma a mi.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Kirene kɛ Aleksandria bi komɛ nɛ je kpe he nɛ a tsɛɛ “Nihi nɛ ye a he” ɔ te si wo Stefano. Yuda bi komɛ hu nɛ je Kilikia, kɛ Asia a, ba piɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a kɛ lɛ sã nya.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Se Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ha Stefano nile, nɛ benɛ e tu munyu ɔ, a nyɛ we nya nɛ a da.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ ya wo ni komɛ a yi mi, nɛ a ba de ke, “Wa nu nɛ e tu munyu kɛ bɔ musu kɛ si Mose kɛ Mawu.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɔ nɛ ni ɔmɛ gu kɛ sú ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ wo Stefano he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ni ɔmɛ bu kɛ ba pue Stefano nɔ, nɛ a nu lɛ kɛ ho kpe ngua a hɛ mi ya.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ a kɛ lakpa odase yeli komɛ ba, nɛ a ba de ke, “Daa nɛ ɔ, kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ wa sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ Mose mlaa a.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: Wa nu nɛ e de ke, Yesu, Nazaret no ɔ, maa ku sɔlemi we nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma tsake blɔ nyahi nɛ Mose ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo dɔ a hɛ ngmɛ ngɔ to Stefano nɔ, nɛ a na kaa e hɛ mi pee kaa Mawu bɔfo hɛ mi.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a bi Stefano ke, “Anɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ja lo?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Stefano he nɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue. Benɛ wa nɛ̃ Abraham ngɛ Mesopotamia nɛ e na we nɛ e ba hi Haran lolo ɔ, Mawu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ,

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: nɛ e de lɛ ke, ‘Jee o weku li ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kɛ o zugba a nɔ kɛ ya zugba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ!’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abraham je Kaldea bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ya hi Haran. Benɛ e tsɛ gbo se ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba zugba nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: Mawu ha we Abraham nitsɛ zugba a kpɔ nɛ maa su nane ma he kake tete po. Se Mawu wo lɛ si kaa e ma ha nɛ zugba a ma ba pee e kɛ e nina a nɔ́. Benɛ Mawu wo si nɛ ɔ, Abraham be bi po.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mawu de lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘O nina ma ya to nibwɔ ngɛ ma se zugba ko nɔ, nɛ a maa ye mɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ a maa wa mɛ yi mi jeha lafa eywiɛ sɔuu.

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ma a nɛ a ma ya sɔmɔ ɔ, ma gbla a tue; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o nina a maa je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma ba ja mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ so, nɛ e tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ pomi okadi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a fɔ Isak ɔ, Abraham po lɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ. Isak fɔ Yakob, nɛ Yakob po e bimɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ji wa blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: “Yakob bimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ ya kɔ̃ a nyɛmi Yosef nɔ, nɛ a jua lɛ kɛ ho Egipt ya. Se Mawu kɛ lɛ ngɛ,

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: nɛ e je lɛ kɛ je dengmehi tsuo a mi. Yosef hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. Matsɛ ɔ na kaa e nɔ bɔ tsɔ, nɛ Mawu dloo lɛ nile nɛ mi kuɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tu Egipt zugba a, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo Yosef dɛ mi.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, hwɔ ba Egipt kɛ Kanaan zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ a na nɔ́ saminya. Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ́ ní nɛ a ye.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yakob nu kaa blɛfo ngɛ Egipt ɔ, e tsɔ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Benɛ a kpale ya lejɛ ɔ si enyɔne ɔ, Yosef je e he si ngɔ ha e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ hu ba le Yosef weku ɔ.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob pue nɔ kɛ ho Egipt ya. Nɛ lejɛ ɔ e kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ya gbo ngɛ.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: A ngɔ a gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ ba Shekem ba pu ngɛ yɔkɔ ko mi. Yɔkɔ nɛ ɔ, Abraham lɛ je sika kɛ he ngɛ Hamor bi ɔmɛ a dɛ.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: “Benɛ be ɔ nɛ Mawu maa ye si nɛ e wo Abraham ɔ nɔ ɔ su ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he ba hiɛ babauu.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ko ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ nɛ lɛɛ e li Yosef.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: Matsɛ nɛ ɔ sisi wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e wa mɛ yi mi. E ha nɛ a sake a bimwɔwi ngɔ pue he, konɛ a gbo.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ a fɔ Mose, binyumuyo kɛ e he fɛu. A hyɛ e nɔ ngɛ e tsɛ we ɔ nyɔhiɔ etɛ;

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: lɔ ɔ se, benɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ he ɔ, Farao ɔ biyo ya wo lɛ, nɛ e lɛ lɛ; nɛ e kɛ lɛ pee e bi.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: A tsɔɔ Mose Egipt nile tsuo, nɛ e na biɛ kpanaa; e he biɛ ngɛ munyu tumi kɛ e ní peepee tsuo mi.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: Jinɛ e susu kaa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ maa na kaa Mawu ngɛ e nɔ gue nɛ e kɛ kpɔ mɛ, se e ya bɛ mi ja.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: E nɔ jena a, e ba na Israel bi enyɔ nɛ a ngɛ kunɔ nɔe. E ya kpata mɛ, nɛ e de ke, ‘Tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛmimɛ ji nyɛ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ kunɔ nɔe?’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ nɔ́ dɛ ɔ tsɛ̃ Mose kɛ ya se, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ wo mo wa nɔ matsɛ kɛ kojolɔ?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o gbe mi kaa bɔ nɛ o gbe jamɛ a Egipt no ɔ hiɛ ɔ?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mose nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e tu fo kɛ je Egipt, nɛ e ya to nibwɔ ngɛ Midian zugba a nɔ. E ya fɔ binyumuhi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ se ɔ, Mawu bɔfo ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ Mose ngɛ la lilɛ mi ngɛ pu mi ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Benɛ Mose na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa. E hɛ lɛ kɛ yaa su he, konɛ e hyɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ e nu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbi nɛ de lɛ ke,

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‘Imi ji o nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ, Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu ɔ.’ Gbeye ha Mose he do blibliibli, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ hu.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Je tokota amɛ, ejakaa zugba klɔuklɔu nɔ nɛ o daa si ngɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: Amanehlu nɛ ye ma a ngɛ nae ngɛ Egipt ɔ, i le; nɛ i nu a kɛmɛmi ɔ hulɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpale se kɛ ma ma ba je mɛ. Hyɛ, ma tsɔ mo Egipt.’

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: “Kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɛ Israel ma a ke a hla we lɛ, nɛ a bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ wo mo wa nɔ matsɛ kɛ kojolɔ?’ ɔ, Mawu gu bɔfo ɔ nɛ je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ pú ɔ mi ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tsɔ lɛ kaa e ba ye a nɔ nɛ e kpɔ mɛ.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ je Egipt, nɛ e pee nyakpɛ níhi, kɛ okadihi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ Wo Tsu ɔ mi, kɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa tsɔ gbalɔ ko kɛ je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ.’

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ji wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi nga a nɔ ɔ nɛ. Lɛ nɛ e kɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ tu munyu ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he; nɛ lɛ nɔuu nɛ e ngɔ Mawu sɛ gbi nɛ wami ngɛ mi ɔ ba ha wɔ.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: “Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bui lɛ, mohu a hɛɛ lɛ soisoi, nɛ a hla kaa a maa kpale a se kɛ ho Egipt ya ekohu.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a pee na bi, nɛ a sã bɔ ngɔ ha amaga nɛ ɔ; nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nine nya ní tsumi ɔ, a na he bua jɔmi babauu.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ. Mawu je e hɛ ngɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ngmɛɛ a he kaa a ja dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔ mi ke, ‘Nyɛ Israel ma, anɛ imi nɛ nyɛ sã lohwehi, kɛ niye ni bɔ ngɔ ha ngɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Molok bo tsu mohu nyɛ wo tloo, kɛ nyɛ mawu Renfan ɔ dodoe ɔ; enɛ ɔmɛ ji amagahi nɛ nyɛ puɛ nɛ nyɛ ja. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Babilon se lokoo ma ha a maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ho.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: “Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛ bo tsu nɛ tsɔɔ Mawu sihi he ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ. A pee bo tsu ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu de Mose ke e pee ɔ.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Benɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nine su nɔ ɔ, a kɛ Yoshua hɛɛ lɛ kɛ ba je ma amɛ a zugba a nɔ. Zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu fie je ma amɛ kɛ je ha wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ. Hiɛ ɔ bo tsu ɔ hi kɛ ba su David be ɔ mi.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: David hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi; nɛ e kpa Mawu pɛɛ ke e ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e pee sihi he ko ha lɛ, Yakob Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Se Salomo mohu lɛ ba ma tsu ha lɛ.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: “Pohu Hiɔwe No ɔ tsa hi tsu nɛ a kɛ adesa nine pee mi kaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ hu de ɔ.

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: E ke, ‘Hiɔwe ɔ, ye matsɛ sɛ, nɛ zugba a, nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ye nane maa nɔ. Mɛni tsu nyɛ maa ma ha mi mɔ? Nɛ jije ma jɔɔ ye he ngɛ?

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ hi si sa a, nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ wa mɛ yi mi. A gbe ni nɛmɛ nɛ de to ke dalɔ ɔ maa ba a. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ hu nyɛ tsɔɔ e se blɔ, nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ.

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: Nyɛ ná Mawu mlaa a kɛ gu Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ, se nyɛ yi nɔ.” A fia Stefano tɛ

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba Stefano nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. E hyɛ hiɔwe too; e na Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, nɛ e na Yesu nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, i na hiɔwe nya nɛ bli nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ daa si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ!”

english_verse: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen
translation_verse: Se kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, nɛ a kɛ a nine tsi a tue. A tu kɛ ba yu e nɔ.

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: A tsitsɛɛ e yi se kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a ya fia lɛ tɛ. Nihi nɛ fia Stefano tɛ ɔ nɛ peeɔ odase ɔ, je a tade ɔmɛ ngɔ ha niheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Saulo, nɛ e hyɛ nɔ ha mɛ.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ Stefano tɛ ɔ fiae ɔ, e sɔle, nɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu, he ye mumi ɔ!”

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: E kpla si, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ngɔɔ yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ pa mɛ!” Benɛ e de kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ e nya.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Se Saulo lɛɛ e ka kaa e ma kpata asafo ɔ hɛ mi. E yaa wehi a mi, nɛ e ya nuɔ nyumuhi kɛ yihi, nɛ e ya woɔ mɛ tsu. A fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ Samaria

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ gbɛ fĩa a ya kpa si nɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Filipo ya Samaria ma nguaa amɛ eko mi, nɛ e ya fiɛ Kristo he sane ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Benɛ nimli babauu ɔ bu Filipo tue, nɛ a na okadihi nɛ e pee ɔ, mɛ tsuo a ngɔ e munyu ɔ.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: Nihi fuu nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi ɔ, mumi ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ kɛ je a mi. A tsa nihi nɛ hule pue si, kɛ glɔtsɛmɛ babauu.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bua jɔmi babauu ba ma a mi.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simon ngɛ ma a mi lejɛ ɔ. E tsuɔ kunya kɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ peeɔ Samaria bi ɔmɛ nyakpɛ nitsɛnitsɛ. E peeɔ e he kaa nɔmlɔ nguaa ji lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni wawi, kɛ ni nguahi tsuo buɔ lɛ, nɛ a deɔ ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ hɛɛ Mawu a he wami nɛ tsɛɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, kunya yemi nɛ ɔ nɛ haa ni ɔmɛ a nya kpɛɛ a he ɔ, Simon je sisi kɛ.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Filipo fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ Yesu Kristo he ɔ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ ɔ, a sɔle, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo nɛ he ye ɔ.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Simon nitsɛ hu he ye, nɛ a sɔle lɛ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ Filipo bɔni nyɛɛmi. Benɛ Simon na okadihi, kɛ he wami ní nguanguahi nɛ a pee ɔ, e nya kpɛ e he.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ na le kaa Samaria bi ɔmɛ pɛtɛ Mawu munyu ɔ he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ ya a ngɔ.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ba lejɛ ɔ, a ba sɔle ha nihi nɛ he ye ɔ, konɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mumi ɔ bɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ lolo; se a sɔle mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Petro kɛ Yohane ngɔ a nine pue ni ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Simon na kaa bɔfo ɔmɛ a nine nɛ a ngɔ pue nihi nɛ he ye ɔ a nɔ ɔ ha nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e je sika kɛ ha Petro kɛ Yohane,

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: nɛ e ke, “Nyɛ ha imi hu kikɛmɛ a he wami nɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɔ ye nine kɛ pue e nɔ ɔ, e na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.”

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Se Petro de lɛ ke, “O kɛ o sika a tsuo hɛ mi nɛ kpata, ejakaa o susuu kaa Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ, sika a kɛ heɔ!

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: O be blɔ nya, loo blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ko ngɛ wa ní tsumi nɛ ɔ mi; ejakaa o tsui mi dɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa i na kaa hɛkɔ hyi mo tɔ kaa bɔ nɛ duɔ kuɔɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ yayami bɔ mo pã.”

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon de Petro kɛ Yohane ke, “I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ kpa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pɛɛ ha mi, konɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ de nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko ko ba ye nɔ.”

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Benɛ Petro kɛ Yohane ye odase, nɛ a fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ se ɔ, a kpale a se kɛ ho Yerusalem ya. Benɛ a kpale kɛ yaa a, a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ Samaria kɔpehi fuu a mi. Filipo kɛ Etiopia sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba de Filipo ke, “Dla o he nɛ o ya leneyi je, nɛ o nyɛɛ blɔ nɛ je Yerusalem kɛ yaa Gaza a nɔ.”

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de Filipo ke, “Nyɛɛ kɛ ya lɛ nɛ ɔ he haa.”

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Filipo sa fo kɛ ya na lɛ ɔ, nɛ e nu nɛ nyumu ɔ ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaya womi ɔ kanee. Filipo bi lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ kanee ɔ, anɛ o ngɛ sisi nue?”

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a he nɔ ke, “Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma nu sisi kaa ja nɔ ko tsɔɔ mi?” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de Filipo ke e kuɔ lɛ ɔ nɛ e ba hi si ngɛ e kasa nya.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ mi he nɛ e ngɛ kanee ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho kaa jijɔ nɛ a yaa gbe! Nɛ bɔ nɛ jijɔ bi peeɔ kpoo ngɛ e he bwɔmi sãlɔ hɛ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu e pee. nɛ e kpɛ we e kuɔ si.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: A wa lɛ yi mi; a ye lɛ sane yaya. Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa gba e nina he sane? Ejakaa a po e wami nɔ kpiti ngɛ je ɔ mi.”

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a bi Filipo ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mɛnɔ he munyu gbalɔ ɔ ngɛ tue ɔ? Lɛ nitsɛ e he, loo nɔ kpa?”

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: Filipo de lɛ ke, “Ke o heɔ yeɔ kɛ o tsui tsuo ɔ, lɛɛ blɔ ngɛ he faa.” E he nɔ ke, “I heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu Krsito ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ.”]

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a fa nɛ zugba lɛ ɔ da si. E kɛ Filipo tsuo kple si, nɛ a ho nyu ɔ mi ya; nɛ Filipo sɔle lɛ.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Benɛ a je nyu ɔ mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ ngɔ Filipo kɛ je. Sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a nɛ́ lɛ hu; se e pue nɔ kɛ ho kɛ nyami babauu.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Filipo ya je Azoto. E fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo a mi hluu kɛ ya su Kaisarea.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Se Saulo ya nɔ nɛ e fiɛ kɛ he wami pe kekle ɔ po kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ ha Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a nya mi jɔ.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Tee si ngɛ zugba, nɛ o ya ma a mi, nɛ a maa tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa o pee!”

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ma tsɔɔ lɛ bɔ nɛ e ma gbo dengme wawɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he.”

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Benɛ Saulo ba Yerusalem ɔ, e hla kaa e kɛ e he maa bɔ kaseli ɔmɛ a he, se mɛ tsuo a ye lɛ gbeye kaa a kɛ lɛ maa bɔ; ejakaa a he we yi kaa e tsake pee Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: nɛ a je tsɔɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania a ma e ngɔ nɛ e kɛ e nine ba pue e nɔ konɛ e hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu.”

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, ní komɛ kaa lo toto je Saulo hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ pue si, nɛ e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi ekohu. E te si, nɛ a sɔle lɛ.

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: nɛ e ya bi nɛ a ha lɛ womi nɛ e kɛ ya Damasko kpe he ɔmɛ, konɛ ke e na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se nyɛɛli komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nyumuhi jio, yihi jio, e nuu mɛ kɛ ba Yerusalem.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: Benɛ Saulo nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ e su Damasko haa a, tlukaa a, la ko kpɛ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba bɔle lɛ.

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: Saulo tsɔ fia si, nɛ e nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ lɛ bie ke, “Saulo, Saulo, mɛni he je o ngɛ mi yi mi wae?”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Saulo bi ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo mɛnɔ?” Gbi ɔ de lɛ ke “Imi ji Yesu, nɔ nɛ o ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae ɔ nɛ!

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ Saulo kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ ɔ tɔ mu kɛ daa si; a nu gbi ɔ mohu, se a nɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Saulo te si, nɛ e bli e hɛngmɛ, se e hyɛ we nɔ́. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nu e nine si kɛ ya Damasko.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: E hyɛ we nɔ ligbi etɛ sɔuu; nɛ e yi ní, nɛ e nui nɔ́ ko hulɔ.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania ngɛ Damasko. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ nina mi, nɛ e de ke, “Anania!” Anania he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ne mi!”

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Dla o he nɛ o ya Yuda we ɔ mi ngɛ he nɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ Tlɔmɔɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Ke o su lejɛ ɔ, bi nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Saulo nɛ je Tarso ɔ si. E ngɛ sɔlee,

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Se Anania he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nihi fuu tu kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ he munyu yaya. A tsɔɔ kaa Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, e ha nɛ a na amanehlu babauu nitsɛnitsɛ.

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: Hiɛ ɔ nɛ e ba nɛ ɔ hu, he wami e ya bi kɛ je osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ, konɛ e ba nuu nihi tsuo nɛ jaa mo ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Yaa, ejakaa nɔ nɛ ɔ, imi nɛ i hla lɛ nɛ e sɔmɔ mi, nɛ e ya fiɛ ye he sane ha ma je li, matsɛmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo.

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Anania pue nɔ kɛ ho we mi he nɛ Saulo ngɛ ɔ ya. E kɛ e nine ya pue e nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmi Saulo, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi o ngɔ. Lɛ ji Yesu nɛ je e he kpo tsɔɔ mo benɛ o ma ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ. E tsɔ mi, konɛ ma ba ha nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu, nɛ́ o na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.”

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ye ní ɔ, e na he wami. Saulo fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ Damasko Saulo kɛ Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Damasko ɔ hi si ligbi bɔɔ ko.

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: E bɔni fiɛmi jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ nu nɛ e ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a de ke, “Anɛ pi nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ gbe Yesu se nyɛɛli basabasa ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ? Hiɛ ɔ tete nɛ e ba nɛ ɔ, anɛ pi jamɛ a nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔuu nɔ nɛ e ngɛ, konɛ e ba nuu mɛ nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ya ha osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ lo?”

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Be saii se ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ ya so Saulo yi nɔ kaa a maa gbe lɛ.

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: Se Saulo nu a somi ɔ he. Daa nyɔ kɛ pia a, nihi ngɛ ma agbo ɔmɛ a nya bue, konɛ a gbe lɛ.

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Se Barnaba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya bɔfo ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba a ha mɛ. E de mɛ bɔ nɛ Saulo na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ Damasko blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ tu munyu, kɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na he wami ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Saulo kɛ mɛ hi si, nɛ e kɛ he wami fiɛ sane kpakpa a kɛ kpa Yerusalem tsuo.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: Ke pee ɔ, e kɛ Helene bi hu hlaa níhi a mi, nɛ a sãã nya; se mɛɛ lɛɛ a hla kaa a maa gbe lɛ.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nu he ɔ, a kɛ Saulo ya Kaisarea, nɛ a wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ho Tarso ya.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ asafo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea, Galilea, kɛ Samaria tsuo na tue mi jɔmi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye yemi ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ wo asafo ɔmɛ he wami, nɛ a ya nɔ, nɛ nihi babauu ba piɛ a he. Petro ngɛ Lida kɛ Yopa

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Petro ya kpa si kɛ slaa asafo ɔmɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he kɛ ya si e ba su ni klɔuklɔu nɛ ngɛ Lida a hu a ngɔ.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: E ba na nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Aenea. Nyumu nɛ ɔ hule pue si jeha kpaanyɔ sɔuu nɛ e nyɛɛ we.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de lɛ ke, “Aenea, Yesu Kristo tsa mo; tee si nɛ o hluɛ o sa a!” Aenea te si amlɔ.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Lida, kɛ Saron ɔ na lɛ, nɛ a ngɔ a he kɛ ba ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Yo ko hu ngɛ Yopa nɛ ji Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ. A tsɛɛ lɛ Tabita, aloo ngɛ Hela gbi mi ɔ, Dorka. Biɛ nɛ ɔ sisi ji Odabɔ. Daa nɛ ɔ, kpakpa sɔuu e peeɔ, titli ɔ, e hyɛɔ dɛgutsɛmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Yo nɛ ɔ ba nu hiɔ, nɛ e gbo. A du ha lɛ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ sa nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe tsu ko mi.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Yopa kɛ Lida kɛ we. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Yesu se nyɛɛli nɛ ngɛ Yopa a nu kaa Petro ngɛ Lida a, a tsɔ ni enyɔ kɛ ya de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ba su wa ngɔ nɔuu; koo to tsle.”

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Petro dla nɛ e kɛ mɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɔuu. Benɛ e su lejɛ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ ya hiɔwe tsu ɔ mi. Yalɔyihi babauu ba pue e nɔ kɛ ya. A kɛ yi nɔ tadehi, kɛ tade kpahi nɛ Dorka kpɛ benɛ e ngɛ je mi ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Se Petro je mɛ kpo. Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpla si nɛ e sɔle; nɛ e plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ kpee gbogboe ɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Tabita, tee si!” Tabita bli e hɛngmɛ; nɛ benɛ e na Petro ɔ, e wo e he nɔ, nɛ e hi si.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Petro nu e nine si, nɛ e wo e nɔ da si. Jehanɛ e tsɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ a kpɛti yalɔyi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba. E kɛ Dorka ba da a hɛ mi hɛ ngmengmle.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Sane nɛ ɔ gbɛ fia Yopa tsuo; nɛ nihi babauu he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Petro hi Yopa be saii ngɛ lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simon ngɔ.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Nyumu ko ngɛ Kaisarea nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kornelio. Kornelio nɛ ɔ, Roma tabo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Italia tabo ɔ we asafoatsɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: Mawu jalɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e kɛ e we ɔ tsuo yee Mawu gbeye. E peeɔ mami bi dɛgutsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kpakpa hulɔ, nɛ e kpaa Mawu pɛɛ daa.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko piani maa pee ngmlɛ etɛ ɔ, a je tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ nina mi kaa Mawu bɔfo ba e ngɔ ba tsɛ lɛ ke, “Kornelio!”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Kornelio hyɛ lɛ too; gbeye nu lɛ, nɛ e bi ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni sane?” Bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Kue nɛ o ngɛ fae, kɛ kpakpa nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, Mawu na he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa, nɛ o ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: E ya to Simon, lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ɔ ngɔ ngɛ wo ɔ nya.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ je. Jehanɛ Kornelio tsɛ e sɔmɔli enyɔ, kɛ ta bulɔ kake kɛ ba e ngɔ. Ta bulɔ nɛ ɔ, Kornelio he buli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ji lɛ.

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: E sɛɛ níhi nɛ ba e nɔ ɔ tsuo ha mɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɔ mɛ Yopa.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: E nɔ jena benɛ a ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa nɛ a miɔ nɛ a maa su Yopa, maa pee ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, Petro ho tsu ɔ yi mi ya, konɛ e ya sɔle.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Hwɔ bɔni lɛ yemi, nɛ e hla kaa e na nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye. Se benɛ a ngɛ niye ní ɔ pee ɔ, nɔ́ nɔ e nɔ.

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: E na nɛ hiɔwe nya bli, nɛ nɔ́ ko kaa bo nguaa ko je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ma zugba kaa nɔ nɛ pe a hɛɛ e kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, lohwehi nɛ waa, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ slɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo eko ngɛ mi.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Gbi ko de lɛ ke, “Petro, tee si; gbee eko nɛ o ye!”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Se Petro ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, dɛbi; nɔ́ ko nɛ a buu kaa e he tsɔ we, loo e sɛ nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, i yi hyɛ.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Gbi ɔ de lɛ ekohu ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu tsu he ɔ, koo bu lɛ kaa e sɛ nɛ a yeɔ!”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ya nɔ si etɛ, kɛkɛ nɛ a kpale nɔ́ ɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Benɛ Petro dɛ yaa, nɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he susue ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ni ɔmɛ nɛ Kornelio tsɔ ɔ ya bi si, nɛ a ba we mi he nɛ Simon ngɛ ɔ; nɛ a daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya.

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Petro ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a je tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ he susue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Mumi ɔ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, nyumuhi ni etɛ ngɛ mo hlae.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: Dla o he nɛ o kple si esɔ, nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ ho; ejakaa imi lɛ i tsɔ mɛ.”

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Petro kple si, nɛ e ya de nyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Imi ji nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ nɛ. Sane ko lo?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: A he nɔ ke, “Asafoatsɛ Kornelio lɛ tsɔ wɔ. Nyumu nɛ ɔ yeɔ dami sane; e yee Mawu gbeye wawɛɛ, nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa. Mawu bɔfo ko de lɛ ke e tsɔ nɛ a ba kpee mo kɛ ba e we ɔ mi, konɛ e bu o nya mi munyu tue.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Petro kɛ mɛ ya we ɔ mi, nɛ a ya hwɔ e ngɔ. E nɔ jena a, e kɛ mɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho; nɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Yopa a a ti ni komɛ piɛ e he.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: E nɔ jena ekohu ɔ, a ya su Kaisarea. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Kornelio ngɛ mɛ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ e tsɛ e weku li, kɛ e huɛmɛ kpakpahi kɛ ba kpe.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Benɛ Petro ngɛ we ɔ mi sɛe ɔ, Kornelio kɛ lɛ ba kpe, nɛ e ba kpla si ngɛ Petro nane nya.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Se Petro wo e nɔ, nɛ e ke, “Tee si! Imi nitsɛ hu adesa kɛkɛ ji mi.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Petro kɛ Kornelio sɛɛ ní hluu kɛ ya sɛ we ɔ mi. Petro na kaa nihi babauu ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa Yuda no be he blɔ nɛ e kɛ ma kpa ko mi no bɔɔ, aloo e baa e ngɔ. Se imi lɛɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ mi ke ma ko bu nɔ ko yaka nɔmlɔ, loo nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we.

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Kornelio he nɔ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ ji ligbi eywiɛ, maa pee gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ etɛ ɔ, i ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ ye we ɔ mi. Tlukaa a, nyumu ko nɛ wo tade nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klãiklãi ba da ye hɛ mi,

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: nɛ e de ke, ‘Kornelio, Mawu nu o kue fami ɔ, nɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ o pee ɔ hu, e ná he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Moo tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa, nɛ o ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba. E ya to Simon, lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ɔ ngɔ ngɛ wo ɔ nya.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, i tsɔ nihi o ngɔ; nɛ o pee saminya kaa o ba. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ wɔ tsuo wa ba bua ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ko nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de mo ɔ, wa suɔ nɛ waa maa nu.” Petro fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha Kornelio kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I kpa si anɔkuale mi kaa Mawu hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Se mohu ma tsuaa ma mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ yee Mawu gbeye, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ saa e hɛ mi.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔ nɛ a kɛ munyu ɔ ya ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ jaje sane kpakpa a nɛ kɛ tue mi jɔmi baa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ. Lɛ, Yesu Kristo ɔ ji nimli adesahi tsuo a Nyɔmtsɛ.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le sane ɔ nɛ ba ngɛ Yudea a tsuo momo; e je sisi kɛ je Galilea, kɛ je benɛ Yohane, nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ fiɛ ɔ se.

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ he sane, bɔ nɛ Mawu hla lɛ, nɛ e ha nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami ɔ ba e nɔ. Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ e kpa si kɛ ya he tsuaa he kɛ kpakpa peemi. E tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ, nɛ e hia mumi yayamihi hulɔ; ejakaa Mawu kɛ lɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, kɛ Yerusalem tsuo ɔ, wa yeɔ he odase. A sɛu lɛ ngɛ sɛumi tso nɔ, nɛ e gbo.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Se Mawu tle lɛ si ligbi etɛne ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ e je e he kpo tsɔɔ

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: wɔ nihi nɛ Mawu hla ngɔ to momo kaa odase yeli ɔ, se pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ. Wɔ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ e kɛ wɔ ye ní nɛ wa nu ní, benɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje se ɔ.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, e fa wɔ ke waa fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a, nɛ waa ye odase kaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ Mawu hla nɛ e kojo nihi nɛ hɛ ngɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ye Yesu he odase, nɛ a de ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma he lɛ maa ye ɔ, a maa ngɔ e he yayami kɛ pa lɛ ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi.” Ma je li ɔmɛ ná Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Benɛ Petro ngɛ munyu tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue bue ɔ a nɔ.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ha Yuda bi nɛ he ye, nɛ a kɛ Petro je Yopa kɛ ba a a nya kpɛ a he kaa Mawu ha nɛ nɔke nɔ́ nɛ ji Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba ma je li ɔmɛ hu a nɔ.

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ná Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa na a. Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa tsi nya nɛ a ko ngɔ nyu kɛ sɔle mɛ lo?”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e fa ke a sɔle ni ɔmɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kpa Petro pɛɛ ke e kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si be bɔɔ ko.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ he Yesu ye, nɛ a ngɛ Yudea a tsuo nu kaa ma je li ɔmɛ hu pɛtɛ Mawu munyu ɔ he.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Petro ba Yerusalem ɔ, nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ a ti ni komɛ kɛ lɛ na nya sami.

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: A ke, “O ya ma je li nɛ a pui mɛ ɔ a ngɔ, nɛ o kɛ mɛ ya ye ní!”

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Petro bɔ mɛ amaniɛ ɔ tsuo fitsofitso ke,

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: “Benɛ i ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ Yopa ma a mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɔ ye nɔ, nɛ a je nɔ́ ko tsɔɔ mi. I na nɔ́ ko kaa bo nguaa ko nɛ je hiɔwe. A hɛɛ nɔ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a ngɛ siue kɛ ma zugba kɛ ba su ye ngɔ haa.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i nu gbi ko nɛ de mi ke, ‘Petro, tee si, gbee eko nɛ o ye!’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Se i de lɛ ke, ‘Dɛbi Nyɔmtsɛ, i yi yakayaka nɔ́ ko, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we hyɛ.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Se gbi nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ he nɔ ekohu ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu tsu he ɔ, koo bu lɛ kaa e sɛ kaa a ye.’

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: A pee jã si etɛ, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, a wo nɔ́ ɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ekohu.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ de mi ke i kɛ mɛ nɛ ya, nɛ ma ko to tsle. I kɛ nyɛmimɛ ekpa nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ je Yopa a ya Kornelio we ɔ mi.

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: Ke e ba a, e ma de mo níhi nɛ a maa gu nɔ kɛ he mo nitsɛ, kɛ o we ɔ tsuo nyɛ yi wami.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: Benɛ i bɔni munyu ɔ tumi nɔuu kɛkɛ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ba wɔ hu wa nɔ kekleekle Pentekoste ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i kai kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tu munyu nɛ ɔ ke, ‘Yohane ɔ, nyu e kɛ sɔle ni ɔmɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu maa ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu kɛ sɔle nyɛ.’

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: E fɔɔ si paa kaa nike ní ɔ nɛ wa ná benɛ wa he Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ye ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ Mawu ha jamɛ a ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ. Mɛnɔ ji mi mɔ nɛ ma de ke i ngɛ Mawu nya tsie!”

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Benɛ a nu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a nya mi jɔ, nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami mohu, nɛ a de ke, “Lɛɛ ma je li ɔmɛ hu Mawu ha mɛ he blɔ kaa a tsake a tsui, konɛ a he a yi wami!” Antiokia asafo ɔ

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Stefano gbenɔ se ɔ, a bɔni nihi nɛ he Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ye ɔ yi mi wami wawɛɛ. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a ti ni komɛ tu fo kɛ ho Foinike, Kipro, kɛ Antiokia tɔɔ ya. A fiɛ we munyu ɔ kɛ ha we nɔ ko nɔ ko pe Yuda bi kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Se a ti ni komɛ nɛ je Kipro kɛ Kirene lɛɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Antiokia ya ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu he ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ Hela bi hulɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ a he, nɛ nihi babauu he ye, nɛ a tsake.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ nu sane nɛ ba nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ Barnaba Antiokia.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ya su lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e na bɔ nɛ Mawu gbaa ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e bua jɔ e he, nɛ e tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ tsuo ke a ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ anɔkuale kɛ a tsui tsuo.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Barnaba a, nɔmlɔ kpakpa nɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ saminya ji lɛ, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hyi lɛ tɔ. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a na nihi babauu kɛ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Barnaba pue nɔ kɛ ho Tarso ya ya hla Saulo.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: Benɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ ba Antiokia ekohu. A kɛ asafo ɔ hi si jeha mluku, nɛ a tsɔɔ nihi babauu ní. Antiokia ji he nɛ a wo nihi nɛ he ye ɔ biɛ ngɛ ke Kristo we bi.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Maa pee jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, gbali komɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ba Antiokia.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: A ti nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Agabo ɔ te da si, nɛ Mumi ɔ ha nɛ e gba nɛ e de ke hwɔ nguaa ko ma ba te si ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo. Hwɔ ba niinɛ ngɛ Kaisare Klaudio yi nɔ.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: A pee ja niinɛ, nɛ a ngɔ sika a kɛ mane asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ gu Barnaba kɛ Saulo a nine nɔ.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Matsɛ Herode bɔni asafo ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ yi mi wami.

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: E ha nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe Yohane nyɛmi Yakobo.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Benɛ e na kaa e ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nya a, e ya nɔ nɛ e ha nɛ a nu Petro. .

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e tsi Petro nya ngɛ tsu ɔ mi; se Kristo asafo ɔ kpa Mawu pɛɛ wawɛɛ kɛ ha Petro. A je Petro ngɛ tsu mi

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Nyɔ ɔ mi, loko je maa na nɛ Herode maa ngɔ Petro kɛ ba ma a hɛ mi, konɛ a kojo lɛ ɔ, Petro hwɔɔ si ngɛ ta buli enyɔ a kpɛti. A kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ bɔ lɛ pã, nɛ buli daa si ngɛ sinya a nya nɛ a ngɛ tsu ɔ he bue.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba da e kasa nya, nɛ la kpɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi. Bɔfo ɔ gba Petro konɔ ma nɛ e tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ ke, “Tee si esɔ!” Amlɔ ɔ, kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kplɔ ngɛ e nine.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Dla o he nɛ o wo o tokota a!” Petro pee ja, nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Wo o yi nɔ tade ɔ, nɛ o nyɛɛ ye se!”

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: A be kekle buli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni enyɔne ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a ba su dade agbo nɛ a kɛ yaa ma a mi ɔ he. Agbo ɔ nitsɛ bli ha mɛ, nɛ a je kpo kɛ po gbɛjegbɛ ko. Tlukaa a, Mawu bɔfo ɔ si Petro.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Petro hɛ mi pee lɛ paa, nɛ e de ke, “Kpaako i na le! Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ e ba je mi kɛ je Herode dɛ mi, kɛ je níhi nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ to kaa a maa pee mi ɔ a mi.”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Benɛ e na bɔ nɛ níhi ya nɔ ha a, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ nyɛ Maria we ɔ mi ya. Nihi fuu ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ momo nɛ a ngɛ sɔlee.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Petro si agbo ɔ, nɛ yiheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Roda a tu fo kɛ ba.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: Benɛ e yó Petro gbi ɔ, bua jɔmi sɔuu nɛ e na he je ɔ, e bli we agbo ɔ, se mohu e tu fo kɛ ho ya de ke Petro daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ se.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: A de lɛ ke, “O yi mi ngɛ puɛe.” Se e ma nɔ mi ke anɔkuale nɛ e ngɛ tue. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ke, “Lɛɛ e bɔfo mɔ!”

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Se Petro ya nɔ nɛ e ngɛ agbo ɔ sie kɛ mwɔɔ. Benɛ a bli ɔ, ne Petro; nɛ a nya kpɛ a he.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: E wo mɛ nine ke a pee kɔ; nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba je lɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi. E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Yakobo kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho he kpa ya.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Benɛ je na a, gbeye nu ta buli ɔmɛ, nɛ a pee basaa; ejakaa a li nɔ́ nɛ ba Petro nɔ.

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Herode ha nɛ a hla Petro, se a nɛ lɛ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e ha nɛ a ta ta buli ɔmɛ a nya mi, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ha nɛ a gbe mɛ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Herode je Yudea kɛ ho Kaisarea ya, nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Herode gbenɔ

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Herode mi mi fu Tiro, kɛ Sidon bi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bua a he nya, nɛ a ba na lɛ ngɛ Kaisarea. Benɛ a ba a, a ba na Blasto, tsɔlɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ a kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ. Nɛ a ya na Herode, nɛ a kɛ lɛ kpata, ejakaa matsɛ ɔ zugba nɔ ní a yeɔ.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Ligbi pɔtɛɛ ko nɛ Herode nitsɛ to ɔ, e wo e we ablade tade ɔ, nɛ e ya hi matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ ma a tu munyu.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa ke, “Mawu ko gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; enɛ ɔ lɛɛ pi nɔmlɔ gbi!”

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ɔ fia Herode nɔ́. Gɔgɔ ye lɛ, nɛ e gbo; ejakaa e wui Mawu hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Benɛ Barnaba kɛ Saul ya gbe ní tsumi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo a dɛ ɔ nya a, a kpale kɛ je Yerusalem, a ngɔ Yohane, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ ngɔ piɛ a he kɛ ba.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Gbali, kɛ tsɔɔli komɛ ngɛ Antiokia asafo ɔ mi. Mɛ ji Barnaba, Simeon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yumu hulɔ ɔ, kɛ Lusio, Kirene no ɔ, Manahen nɛ a tsɔse e kɛ amlaalo Herode ɔ, kɛ Saulo.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ jae, nɛ a ngɛ hwɔ hae ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hla Barnaba kɛ Saulo ngɔ ha mi, konɛ a tsu ní tsumi nɛ i tsɛ mɛ ngɛ he ɔ.”
