english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Kaseli ɔmɛ ha hwɔ, nɛ a sɔle, nɛ a kɛ a nine pue Barnaba kɛ Saulo a nɔ, nɛ a wo mɛ blɔ. Saulo kɛ Barnaba ngɛ Kipro

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ tsɔ mɛ ɔ, Barnaba, kɛ Saulo pue nɔ kɛ ho Seleukia ya. A wó lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Kipro ya. Kipro ji zugba kpɔ nɛ nyu bɔle lɛ.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Benɛ a su Salami ɔ, a fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ. Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ kɛ mɛ ho, nɛ e ya ye bua mɛ.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: A nyɛɛ nane kɛ gu zugba kpɔ ɔ tsuo nɔ kɛ ba su Pafo. A na Yuda no kunya yelɔ lakpa gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Bar-Yesu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: Nyumu nɛ ɔ huɛ ji Sergio Paulo, zugba a nɔ amlaalo ɔ. Sergio Paulo ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ hɛ mi ka si ji lɛ. Amlaalo ɔ tsɛ Barnaba, kɛ Saulo kɛ ba e ngɔ; ejakaa e suɔ kaa e maa bu Mawu munyu ɔ tue.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Se Elima, kunya yelɔ ɔ ka a nya tsimi. . E ka kaa e ma puɛ amlaalo ɔ juɛmi, konɛ e ngmɛɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba Saulo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Paulo hulɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e hyɛ kunya yelɔ ɔ too,

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: nɛ e de ke, “Abosiami nitsɛnitsɛ ji mo! Nɔ́ kpakpa tsuaa nɔ́ kpakpa he nyɛlɔ! Ní yayamihi pɛ a he o susuu! Be tsuaa be ɔ, o bɔɔ mɔde kaa o ma tsake Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ anɔkuale munyu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ pee lakpa!

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma je e he wami kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo jehanɛ; o hɛ ma yu; o be pu la nae kɛ maa su be ko!” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Elima hɛngmɛ nɔ wo afua, nɛ e pee kpii. Kɛkɛ nɛ e bɔni si tataami ngɛ nɔ ko hlae nɛ maa ta e dɛ mi nɛ e tsɔɔ lɛ blɔ.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Benɛ amlaalo ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, e he ye. Nɔ́ nɛ e kase ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ pee lɛ nyakpɛ saminya. Paulo ba Antiokia nɛ ngɛ Pisidia a

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ Paulo kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ wó lɛ kɛ je Pafo kɛ ba Perga ngɛ Pamfilia. Benɛ a su hiɛ ɔ, Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ kpale ngɛ a se kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a je Perga, nɛ a po mi kɛ ba Antiokia ngɛ Pisidia. Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a ya kpe he ɔ, nɛ a ya hi si.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Benɛ a kane Mose mlaa a, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔ se ɔ, kpe he ɔ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɔ ba de Paulo kɛ Barnaba ke, “Nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ ngɛ munyu ko nɛ maa wo ni ɔmɛ he wami ɔ, nyɛɛ tu.”

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Israel Mawu ɔ hla wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e pee mɛ ma kpetekpleenyɛ benɛ a ya to nibwɔ ngɛ Egipt ɔ. Mawu ngɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ je mɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbali ɔmɛ de ɔ kó ba nyɛ nɔ. A ke,

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: E kpata je ma kpaago a hɛ mi ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ, nɛ e dla zugba a ngɔ ha e ma a, konɛ e pee a nɔ́.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Mawu kpa Saulo, nɛ e wo David matsɛ ngɛ e nane mi. Odase nɛ Mawu ye ngɛ e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘I ná Ishai bi David he bua jɔmi kaa nɔ ko nɛ maa pee ye suɔmi nya ní.’

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: David nina ji Yesu, nɔ nɛ Mawu hla nɛ e ba he Israel ma a yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ.

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: Loko Yesu bɔni e ní tsumi ɔ, Yohane ba fiɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a tsuo ke a kpa yayami peemi, nɛ a sɔle mɛ.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Benɛ Yohane miɔ nɛ e maa gbe e ní tsumi nya a, e bi ke, ‘Kɛ nyɛ susu ngɛ ye he kɛɛ? Mɛnɔ ji mi? Tsa pi imi ji nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ. Se nɔ ko ma ngɛ ye se, nɛ i sɛ́ nɔ nɛ pɛneɔ e tokota nya kpa tete.’

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: “Ye nyɛmimɛ Abraham nina Israel bi, kɛ nyɛ ma je li nɛ nyɛ jaa Mawu, nɛ nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, wɔ a kɛ kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi munyu nɛ ɔ ba ha.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ li Yesu, nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔmɛ nɛ a kaneɔ daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ hu a nui sisi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bu lɛ fɔ; enɛ ɔ ha gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔ ba mi.

english_verse: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
translation_verse: Benɛ a pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ gbe nya kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ e he ɔ, a je lɛ kɛ je tso ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ya to lɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ ko mi.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje,

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: nɛ e je e he kpo si abɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ e kɛ mɛ je Galilea kɛ ba Yerusalem ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, mɛ lɛ a ngɛ e he odase yee kɛ ngɛ Israel ma a tsɔɔe.

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, bɔ nɛ Mawu de ngɛ si nɛ e ma tle Yesu kɛ je gbeje nɛ e be puɛe ngɛ yɔkɔ mi gblegbleegble ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Se moo lɛɛ ma gbaa mo kɛ ní klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ daa kaa bɔ nɛ i wo David hu si ɔ.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he hu nɛ e de ngɛ La womi ɔ he kpa ke, ‘O be hae nɛ o Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ puɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ mi gblegbleegble’ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: David ɔ, benɛ e tsu nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to ha lɛ ke e ba tsu ngɛ e be ɔ mi gbe nya a, e gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ he nɛ a pu e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e puɛ.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ Mawu tle si ɔ lɛɛ e puɛ we.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: ‘Nyɛ Mawu munyu he guɛ gbeli, nyɛɛ bu tue. Nyɛ ha nɛ e pee nyɛ nyakpɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ kpata! Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee ngɛ nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ, ke nɔ ko tsɔɔ nyɛ sisi po nyɛ be hee maa ye kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ ”

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Benɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba maa je Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ kpa mɛ pɛɛ ke a kpale kɛ ba Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ ma a, nɛ a ba fiɛ munyu nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ ekohu.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Benɛ kpe ɔ kpa a, Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li nɛ ba sɛ Yuda bi a jami ɔ mi nɛ a yee Mawu gbeye ɔ, a ti nihi babauu nyɛɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba a se! Bɔfo ɔmɛ tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ a wo mɛ ga ke a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu dloomi ɔ nɔ daa.

english_verse: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
translation_verse: Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ, ma a tsuo tu kɛ ba, nɛ a ba bu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ tue.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ na ma kpekpemi ɔ, hunga jemi sɛ a mi. A tu munyu yaya kɛ bɔ musu kɛ si Paulo, kɛ níhi nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Se Paulo kɛ Barnaba tu munyu kɛ kã ke, “Nyɛ kekle e sa kaa a jajeɔ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ. Se akɛnɛ nyɛ kua munyu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ bui nyɛ he kaa nyɛ sa neneene wami ɔ he je ɔ, wa dɔ wa yi kɛ yaa ma je li ɔmɛ a ngɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ja ji mlaa nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo wɔ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, ‘I hla mo ngɔ to kaa ma je li ɔmɛ a la, nɛ o nɔ Mawu maa gu kɛ he je ɔ tsuo yi wami.’ ”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Benɛ ma je li ɔmɛ nu enɛ ɔ, a na bua jɔmi, nɛ a wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ Mawu hla ngɔ to neneene wami ɔ he ye.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: A fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kpokpa amɛ a nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Se Yuda bi ɔmɛ wo ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma je li yihi Mawu jali nɛ ngɛ biɛ ɔ a yi mi, nɛ a te si kɛ wo Paulo kɛ Barnaba. A wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je a kpokpa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ blɛ a nane si bunyuku ngɔ pue ni ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a je kɛ ho Ikoniom ya.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ he Kristo ye ngɛ Antiokia a na bua jɔmi saminya, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba a nɔ babauu.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ya nɔ ngɛ Ikoniom hulɔ. Paulo kɛ Barnaba ya Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔ, nɛ bɔ nɛ a tu munyu tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ ɔ ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Se Yuda bi nɛ he we Yesu yi ɔ puɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a tue, nɛ a sú mɛ ngɔ wo nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ he ye ɔ a he.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, bɔfo ɔmɛ a se kɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a kɛ kã fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu he munyu ɔ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hu piɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a pee nyakpɛ níhi, kɛ okadihi babauu kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a munyu ɔ ngɛ mi niinɛ.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a mi gba enyɔ; ni fa ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a se, nɛ fa hu ngɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a se.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ma je li ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ to a yi mi kaa a maa pee bɔfo ɔmɛ soisoi, nɛ a fia mɛ tɛ.

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Nyumu ko ngɛ Listra nɛ a fɔ lɛ libɔɔ; e nyɛɛ we gblee.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Benɛ Paulo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, nyumu ɔ bu lɛ tue saminya. Paulo hyɛ lɛ too, nɛ e na kaa nyumu ɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kaa a ma tsa lɛ.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Benɛ ni ɔmɛ na nɔ́ nɛ Paulo pee ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ngɛ Likaonia gbi mi ke, “Mawu ɔmɛ plɛ a he nimli, nɛ a kple si kɛ ba wa ngɔ.”

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: A wo Barnaba biɛ ke Zeus, nɛ Paulo lɛɛ a tsɛ lɛ Herme; ejakaa lɛ titli lɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue. Hela bi a jemɛ a wɔ nguaa ji Zeus; nɛ jemɛ a wɔ ɔmɛ a tsɔlɔ ji Herme.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Zeus osɔfo ɔ nɛ e jami he ngɛ a ma a we agbo ɔ nya a, ngɔ nakuhi, kɛ nyinyla kɛ ba agbo ɔ nya nɛ e kɛ maa sã bɔ ha bɔfo ɔmɛ.

english_verse: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:
translation_verse: Benɛ Barnaba kɛ Paulo nu he ɔ, a hía a tade ngɛ a he, nɛ a sa fo kɛ ya sɛ ni kpekpemi a kpɛti kɛ ngmlaa ke,

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: Blema be ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu ngmɛ je ma amɛ blɔ nɛ a nyɛɛ bɔ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ.

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e peeɔ kpakpa nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ kaa lɛ ji Mawu niinɛ; e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ kɛ jee hiɔwe kɛ haa nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ kpaa ní babauu ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. E haa nyɛ niye ní, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔɔ saminya.”

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Dengme kpakpa nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ gbo loko a nyɛ nɛ a kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsi bɔ ɔ nɛ jinɛ ni ɔmɛ maa sã ha mɛ ɔ nya.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Yuda bi komɛ je Antiokia ngɛ Pisidia, kɛ Ikoniom kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ ba wo ni ɔmɛ a yi mi, nɛ a fia Paulo tɛ; a sã lɛ si kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a susu kaa e gbo.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Se benɛ nihi nɛ he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye ɔ ba bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, e te si, nɛ e ho ma a mi ya. E nɔ jena a, e kɛ Barnaba pue nɔ kɛ ho Derbe ya. Paulo kɛ Barnaba kpale kɛ ba Antiokia ngɛ Siria

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Barnaba fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ Derbe ma a mi, nɛ nihi babauu ba he Yesu ye. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Paulo kɛ Barnaba kpale kɛ ho Listra, kɛ Ikoniom, kɛ Antiokia ngɛ Pisidia ya.

english_verse: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, “We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: A wo nihi nɛ he ye ɔ he wami, konɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa. A tsɔɔ mɛ hulɔ kaa, “E sa kaa waa gblee amanehlu babauu mi kɛ sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: A ha hwɔ, nɛ a sɔle kɛ hla nikɔtɔmahi, nɛ a tu mɛ ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ a he ye ɔ dɛ mi.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: A po mi ngɛ Pisidia, nɛ a ya Pamfilia.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: A fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ Perga, kɛkɛ nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ba Atalia.

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: Kɛ je Atalia a, a wó lɛ kɛ kpale a se kɛ ba Antiokia ngɛ Siria. Ní tsumi nɛ a gbe nya nɛ ɔ, hiɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a tu mɛ ngɔ wo Mawu dɛ mi ngɛ loko a je sisi.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ba su Antiokia a, a bua asafo ɔ nya, nɛ a sɛɛ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu kɛ mɛ ya tsu ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e bli blɔ ngɔ ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ mɛ hu a he ye.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ he ye ɔ hi si be saii.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ je Yudea kɛ ba Antiokia, nɛ a ba bɔni nihi nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ ní tsɔɔmi ke, “Ke a pui nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Mose mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ, a be nyɛe ma he nyɛ yi wami.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Paulo, kɛ Barnaba kɛ mɛ sã nya wawɛɛ; nɛ a kɛ mɛ je nɔ́ hluu ngɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a to kaa Paulo, kɛ Barnaba, kɛ a ti ni komɛ hu nɛ a ya bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ngɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Asafo ɔ wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho. Benɛ a gu Foinike kɛ Samaria kɛ yaa a, a sɛɛ ha nihi ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ bɔ nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ hu tsake a tsui. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo na bua jɔmi babauu.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Benɛ a su Yerusalem ɔ, asafo ɔ, kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo he mɛ kɛ hɛmuɔ, nɛ mɛ hu a bɔ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu ngɔ mɛ kɛ tsu ɔ.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Se Farisi bi komɛ nɛ he ye ɔ, a ti ni komɛ te si nɛ a de ke, “Ja a po ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ a ha a ye Mose mlaa a nɔ.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ba bua a he nya, konɛ a hla kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Benɛ a sã nya hluu ɔ, Petro te da si, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa be saii ji nɛ ɔ nɛ Mawu hla mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ma je li ɔmɛ, konɛ mɛ hu a he ye.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ le adesahi tsuo a juɛmi ɔ kplɛɛ nɔ kaa a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ hulɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha mɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ha wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: E tsɔɔ we slɔɔto ko ngɛ waa kɛ mɛ wa kpɛti; akɛnɛ a he ye ɔ, e ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ jehanɛ mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ Mawu kae, nɛ tlomi nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ po wa nyɛ we waa tloo ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ he ye ɔ tlooe mɔ?

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ mohu nɔ a maa gu kɛ he waa kɛ mɛ tsuo wa yi wami.”

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ kpe ɔ tsuo pee dii, konɛ a bu Barnaba kɛ Paulo tue. A bɔ kpe ɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu gu a nɔ kɛ tsu nyakpɛ níhi babauu ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Benɛ a bɔ amaniɛ ɔ ta a, Yakobo wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Simon sɛɛ bɔ nɛ kekle ɔ, Mawu ba slaa ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ e hla a kpɛti ma ko ngɔ ha e he.

english_verse: This agrees with what the prophets wrote,
translation_verse: Amaniɛ nɛ ɔ maa gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔ nɔ mi ke,

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, pee se ɔ, ma kpale kɛ ba; nɛ ma ngɔ David matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ma si kaa sá a. Ma dla e ma doku ɔmɛ, nɛ e tsɛ yemi ɔ maa ma si kpɛii ekohu.

english_verse: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, adesahi nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo maa ba ye ngɔ; nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i tsɛ ɔ maa ba ma ba pee ye ma.

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: Yakobo tsa e munyu ɔ nɔ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji, ma je li nɛ ba he Mawu ye ɔ, wa ko doo a nya.

english_verse: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, waa ngma mɛ womi ke a ko ye niye ní nɛ he tsɔ we, a ko ye wɔ nya lo, a hyɛ a he nɔ saminya, nɛ a ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi. A nyɛ lohwehi nɛ a kika a kuɛ kɛ gbe mɛ, nɛ a ko ye lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ejakaa kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a kaneɔ Mose mlaa a, nɛ a fiɛɔ e munyu ɔ ngɛ kpe he ɔ ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi.” Womi nɛ a ngma mane ma je li nɛ he ye ɔ

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ asafo mluku ɔ tsuo ma nya si kaa a hia mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ kɛ piɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba a he, nɛ a tsɔ mɛ Antiokia. A hla Yuda, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Barsaba hulɔ ɔ, kɛ Sila, ni enyɔ nɛ asafo ɔ tsuo buu mɛ saminya.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: A ngma womi ngɔ ha mɛ ke, “Wɔ, nyɛ nyɛmimɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ, wa biɔ nyɛ wa nyɛmimɛ ma je li a fɔfɔɛhi nɛ ngɛ Antiokia, Siria, kɛ Kilikia a saminya.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: Wa nu kaa wa ti ni komɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ba doo nyɛ nya kɛ munyu komɛ, nɛ a kɛ puɛ nyɛ juɛmi, pohu wa ha we mɛ mlaa ko ke a ba wo nyɛ.

english_verse: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa pee kpe, nɛ wɔ tsuo wa ma nya si kaa waa hia ni komɛ pɔtɛɛ nɛ waa tsɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ. A maa piɛ Barnaba kɛ Paulo nɛ wa suɔ mɛ saminya a a he kɛ ba.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tsɔ Yuda, kɛ Sila, konɛ mɛ hu a ba jaje ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wa ngma a nɔuu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ nyɛ wɔ nya lo; nyɛ ko ye lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ, loo lohwe nɛ a kika e kuɛ; nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya, nɛ nyɛ ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo kayakaya fiɛmi. Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ yu nyɛ he kɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he. Nyɛɛ hi si saminya.”

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: A wo tsɔli ɔmɛ blɔ kɛ ho Antiokia ya; nɛ benɛ a ya su ɔ, a bua asafo ɔ nya, nɛ a je womi ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Benɛ a kane ɔ, a bua jɔ womi ɔ mi munyu ɔ he.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Yuda, kɛ Sila nɛ a nya mi tsɔ kɛ Mawu munyu fiɛmi ɔ, tu munyu babauu kɛ wo nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ bua kɛ he wami.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: Benɛ a kɛ mɛ hi si be bɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ wo mɛ blɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi kɛ ho nihi nɛ tsɔ mɛ ɔ a ngɔ ya. [

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Barnaba hi Antiokia, nɛ a kɛ ni kpahi babauu tsɔɔ ní, nɛ a fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ. Paulo kɛ Barnaba a mi gba

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, Paulo de Barnaba ke, “Ha waa kpale wa se kɛ ya mahi tsuo nɛ wa fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ. Wa ya slaa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ waa hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ nɔ yae ha.”

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Barnaba hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa a maa ngɔ Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ ngɔ piɛ a he.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ pee mɛ nya sami babauu, nɛ a mi gba; Barnaba ngɔ Marko ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ a ya wo lɛ kɛ ho Kipro ya.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Paulo ba su Derbe, nɛ e tsa nɔ kɛ ya Listra. Benɛ e su Listra a, e ba na nɔ ko nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A tsɛɛ lɛ Timoteo. E nyɛ ɔ, Yuda yo nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ji lɛ; se e tsɛ lɛɛ Hela no.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Listra, kɛ Ikoniom ɔ yeɔ Timoteo he odase kpakpa.

english_verse: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.
translation_verse: Paulo hla kaa e kɛ Timoteo nɛ ya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e po lɛ. E pee ja ejakaa Yuda bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kpokpa a nɔ ɔ le kaa Timoteo tsɛ ɔ Hela no ji lɛ.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ ma amɛ a nɔ kpae ɔ, mlaahi nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ wo ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, a tsɔɔ mɛ, konɛ a ye nɔ.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ha asafo ɔmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mi ba wa, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, nihi babauu ba piɛɔ a he. A je nina ha Paulo ngɛ Troya

english_verse: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.
translation_verse: A po mi ngɛ Frigia, kɛ Galatia zugba a nɔ, ejakaa Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ha we mɛ blɔ kaa a fiɛ munyu ɔ ngɛ Asia.

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ba su Misia huzu ɔ nya a, a ka kaa a maa ya Bitinia, se Yesu Mumi ɔ ha we mɛ blɔ.

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ Misia he kɛ be, nɛ a po mi tɛɛ kɛ ya su Troya.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
translation_verse: Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, a je nina ko kɛ tsɔɔ Paulo. E na Makedonia no ko nɛ daa si ngɛ lɛ pɛɛ kpae ke, “Ba Makedonia nɛ o ba ye bua wɔ!”

english_verse: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there. Lydia Becomes a Follower of the Lord
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ Paulo na nina nɛ ɔ, wa dla wa he, konɛ waa ya Makedonia, ejakaa wa kpa si kaa Mawu lɛ ngɛ wɔ tsɔe ke wa ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lidia tsake pee Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ ngɛ Filipi

english_verse: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.
translation_verse: Wa wó lɛ kɛ je Troya tɛɛ kɛ ya Samotrake, nɛ e nɔ jena a, wa ya su Neapoli.

english_verse: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.
translation_verse: Benɛ wa je lejɛ ɔ, wa tsa nɔ kɛ ya su Filipi, Makedonia zugba a nɔ ma nguaa ko nɛ ji Roma bi a nɔ yemi he. Wa hi ma nɛ ɔ mi be saii.

english_verse: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.
translation_verse: Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, wa je ma a mi kɛ ya pa nya he nɛ wa susu kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ peeɔ sɔlemi ngɛ ɔ. Wa ya hi si, nɛ wa fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ yihi nɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: One of them was Lydia, who was from the city of Thyatira and sold expensive purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the Lord God, and he made her willing to accept what Paul was saying.
translation_verse: A ti nɔ kake ji Lidia. Yo nɛ ɔ je Tiatira ma a mi, nɛ e juaa bo tsu he jua wawɛ. Mawu jalɔ ji lɛ; nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bli e juɛmi nya nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ Paulo ngɛ dee ɔ, e bu tue saminya.

english_verse: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, “If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home.” Finally, we accepted her invitation. Paul and Silas Are Put in Jail
translation_verse: E ha nɛ a sɔle lɛ kɛ e we ɔ tsuo. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de wɔ ke, “I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, ke nyɛ na mi kaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yeɔ anɔkuale mi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ba hi ye ngɔ.” E hɛɛ munyu nɛ ɔ mi hluu kɛ ya si wa kplɛɛ nɛ wa ya to lɛ. A wo Paulo kɛ Sila tsu ngɛ Filipi

english_verse: One day on our way to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell the future. By doing this she made a lot of money for her owners.
translation_verse: Ligbi ko benɛ wa yaa he nɛ a sɔlee ngɛ ɔ, waa kɛ nyɔguɛ yiheyo ko nɛ klaami mumi ngɛ e mi kpe. E kɛ mumi nɛ ɔ peeɔ sika kɛ haa e nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The girl followed Paul and the rest of us, and she kept yelling, “These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how to be saved.”
translation_verse: Yiheyo nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ waa kɛ Paulo wa se kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu, Hiɔwe No ɔ tsɔli ji mɛ; nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami.”

english_verse: This went on for several days. Finally, Paul got so upset that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ, I order you to leave this girl alone!” At once the evil spirit left her.
translation_verse: E pee enɛ ɔ hluu kɛ ya si Paulo mi mi wo la, nɛ e plɛ e he nɛ e de mumi ɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo fae ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi ke o je e mi.” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, mumi ɔ je yiheyo ɔ mi.

english_verse: When the girl's owners realized they had lost all chances for making more money, they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them into court.
translation_verse: Benɛ e nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ na kaa blɔ nɔ nɛ a guu kɛ naa sika a se po ɔ, a nu Paulo kɛ Sila kã nya, nɛ a gbla mɛ ya ha ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ he nɛ ma a kpee ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The crowd joined in the attack on Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off the two men and ordered them to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Nɛ a de ja a, kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo te kɛ wo Paulo kɛ Sila. Jehanɛ Roma kojoli ɔmɛ hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ Paulo kɛ Sila a he, nɛ a fa ke a fia mɛ kpa.

english_verse: After they had been badly beaten, they were put in jail, and the jailer was told to guard them carefully.
translation_verse: Benɛ a fia mɛ kpa gbegbelii se ɔ, a wo mɛ tsu, nɛ a fa pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ke e ngmɛ a yi saminya.

english_verse: The jailer did as he was told. He put them deep inside the jail and chained their feet to heavy blocks of wood.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ a de lɛ he je ɔ, e kɛ mɛ ya wo kpɛtikpɛti tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ tso kpoku kɛ bɔ a nane pã.

english_verse: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing praises to God, while the other prisoners listened.
translation_verse: Maa pee nyɔ mi kpɛti ɔ, Paulo kɛ Sila ngɛ sɔlee, nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ Mawu yi jee nɛ pamitsɛmɛ kpa amɛ ngɛ a he nue.

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the jail to its foundations. The doors opened, and the chains fell from all the prisoners.
translation_verse: Tlukaa a, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ tsu ɔ, kɛ e sisi tomi ɔ tsuo mimiɛ. Amlɔ ɔ, sinya amɛ tsuo bli, nɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kplɔ ngɛ pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: When the jailer woke up and saw that the doors were open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped. He pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.
translation_verse: Benɛ pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ hɛli si kɛ je mahe mi ɔ, e na kaa sinya amɛ tsuo a nya fɔɔ si. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia klaate nɛ jinɛ e maa gbe e he; ejakaa e susu kaa pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu fo.

english_verse: But Paul shouted, “Don't harm yourself! No one has escaped.”
translation_verse: Se Paulo kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Koo ye o he awi; wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!”

english_verse: The jailer asked for a torch and went into the jail. He was shaking all over as he knelt down in front of Paul and Silas.
translation_verse: Pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ de kɛ ngmlaa ke a ba ha lɛ kane; nɛ e sa fo kɛ sɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya kpla si ngɛ Paulo kɛ Sila a nane nya kɛ he domi blibliibli.

english_verse: After he had led them out of the jail, he asked, “What must I do to be saved?”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ mɛ je kpo, nɛ e bi ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ́ a he ye yi wami?”

english_verse: They replied, “Have faith in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved! This is also true for everyone who lives in your home.”
translation_verse: A he nɔ ke, “Mo he Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu nɛ o ye, nɛ a ma he o kɛ o we ɔ tsuo nyɛ yi wami.”

english_verse: Then Paul and Silas told him and everyone else in his house about the Lord.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ a fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ e kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi.

english_verse: While it was still night, the jailer took them to a place where he could wash their cuts and bruises. Then he and everyone in his home were baptized.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu ɔ, pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ngɔ mɛ nɛ e ya fɔ a pa amɛ a nɔ ha mɛ; nɛ a sɔle lɛ, kɛ e we ɔ tsuo amlɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: They were very glad they had put their faith in God. After this, the jailer took Paul and Silas to his home and gave them something to eat.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ Paulo kɛ Sila kɛ ya e we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya ha mɛ ní nɛ a ye. E kɛ e we ɔ tsuo nya kaa jehanɛ ɔ e he Mawu ye.

english_verse: The next morning the officials sent some police with orders for the jailer to let Paul and Silas go.
translation_verse: Benɛ je na a, Roma kojoli ɔmɛ tsɔ ma he buli ɔmɛ kɛ ba de pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ke, “Ngmɛɛ ni ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ho.”

english_verse: But Paul told the police, “We are Roman citizens, and the Roman officials had us beaten in public without giving us a trial. They threw us into jail. Now do they think they can secretly send us away? No, they cannot! They will have to come here themselves and let us out.”
translation_verse: Se Paulo de ma he buli ɔmɛ ke, “Hyɛ, nɔ ko bui wɔ fɔ, se wɔ Roma bi ɔ, a fia wɔ kpa ngɛ ma hɛ mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a wo wɔ tsu, nɛ jehanɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a ngmɛɛ wa he nigii nɛ waa ho lo? Dɛbi! Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ba nɛ a ba je wɔ.”

english_verse: When the police told the officials that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, the officials were afraid.
translation_verse: Ma he buli ɔmɛ ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Roma kojoli ɔmɛ. Nɛ benɛ a nu kaa Paulo kɛ Sila a, Roma bi ji mɛ ɔ, a ye gbeye.

english_verse: But Paul and Silas went straight to the home of Lydia, where they saw the Lord's followers and encouraged them. Then they left.
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Sila je kpo, nɛ a ho Lidia we ɔ mi ya. A ya na nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a tu munyu kɛ wo mɛ he wami; kɛkɛ nɛ a pue blɔ, nɛ a je.

english_verse: After Paul and his friends had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they went on to Thessalonica. A synagogue was in that city.
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Sila pue nɔ kɛ ya gu Amfipoli kɛ Apolonia, nɛ a ba Tesalonika, he nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpe he ko ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: So as usual, Paul went there to worship, and on three Sabbaths he spoke to the people. He used the Scriptures
translation_verse: Paulo ya kpe he ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pɔɔ peemi ɔ. E kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ya hla ngmami ɔmɛ a mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi etɛ sɔuu.

english_verse: to show them that the Messiah had to suffer, but that he would rise from death. Paul also told them that Jesus is the Messiah he was preaching about.
translation_verse: E tsɔɔ mɛ níhi a mi faii kaa e sa kaa Kristo ɔ nɛ na amanehlu, nɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje. Paulo de mɛ hulɔ ke, “Yesu, nɛ i ngɛ e he sane jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ, lɛ ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Some of them believed what Paul had said, and they became followers with Paul and Silas. Some Gentiles and many important women also believed the message.
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ he ye kaa Paulo munyu ɔ ngɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ a he ya bɔ Paulo kɛ Sila a he. Hela bi Mawu gbeye yeli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu, kɛ yi komɛ nɛ a buu mɛ hu ya piɛ a he ja nɔuu.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders were jealous and got some troublemakers who hung around the marketplace to start a riot in the city. They wanted to drag Paul and Silas out to the mob, and so they went straight to Jason's home.
translation_verse: Se Yuda bi ɔmɛ je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he hunga, nɛ a ya ngɔ yakayaka nimli dikali komɛ ngɔ piɛ a he. Benɛ a nya ba bua fuu ɔ, a ha ma a mi tsuo pee hliihlii. A ya tua nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Yason e we ɔ kaa a maa ngɔ Paulo kɛ Sila ya ha ma a.

english_verse: But when they did not find them there, they dragged out Jason and some of the Lord's followers. They took them to the city authorities and shouted, “Paul and Silas have been upsetting things everywhere. Now they have come here,
translation_verse: Se benɛ a nɛ mɛ ɔ, a gbla Yason, kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ kɛ ya ha ma a mi nikɔtɔma amɛ pani nya kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, he tsuaa he nɛ a ya a, basabasa sɔuu. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ba su wa ma mi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ,

english_verse: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. All of them break the laws of the Roman Emperor by claiming that someone named Jesus is king.”
translation_verse: nɛ Yason he mɛ ngɔ to we. A ngɛ Kaisare ɔ mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ tɔe; nɛ a ngɛ dee ke matsɛ kpa ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yesu.”

english_verse: The officials and the people were upset when they heard this.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ basabasa ba ma a, kɛ ma nikɔtɔma ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: So they made Jason and the other followers pay bail before letting them go. People in Berea Welcome the Message
translation_verse: Ma nikɔtɔma amɛ ha nɛ Yason, kɛ ni kpa amɛ wo sika kɛ kpɔ̃ a he; nɛ a ngmɛɛ a he. Paulo kɛ Sila ngɛ Beroya

english_verse: That same night the Lord's followers sent Paul and Silas on to Berea, and after they arrived, they went to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Benɛ je jɔ pɛ nɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ wo Paulo kɛ Sila blɔ kɛ ho Beroya ya. Benɛ a su lejɛ ɔ, a be kɛ ho kpe he ɔ ya.

english_verse: The people in Berea were much nicer than those in Thessalonica, and they gladly accepted the message. Day after day they studied the Scriptures to see if these things were true.
translation_verse: Beroya bi ɔmɛ a tue wɛ kaa Tesalonika bi ɔmɛ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a he munyu ɔ ye kɛ a tsui tsuo, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, a kpaa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi kaa níhi nɛ Paulo de a ngɛ mi ja lo.

english_verse: Many of them put their faith in the Lord, including some important Greek women and several men.
translation_verse: A ti nihi babauu he ye, nɛ Hela yihi nɛ ngɛ biɛ, kɛ Hela nyumuhi hu babauu he ye.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders in Thessalonica heard that Paul had been preaching God's message in Berea, they went there and caused trouble by turning the crowds against Paul.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ Tesalonika a nu kaa Paulo ya fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ Beroya hulɔ ɔ, a ba lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba bɔni ni ɔmɛ a yi mi womi, konɛ a pee basabasa.

english_verse: At once the followers sent Paul down to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ wo Paulo blɔ kɛ ho wo kpo ɔ ya; se Sila kɛ Timoteo lɛɛ a tlɔ Beroya.

english_verse: Some men went with Paul as far as Athens, and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible. Paul in Athens
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ya je Paulo blɔ ɔ kɛ lɛ ya su Atene tɔɔ loko a kpale kɛ ba Beroya. Paulo kɛ sɛ mane ke Sila kɛ Timoteo nɛ ba ná lɛ be kpiti mi. Paulo ngɛ Atene

english_verse: While Paul was waiting in Athens, he was upset to see all the idols in the city.
translation_verse: Benɛ Paulo ngɛ Atene, nɛ e ngɛ Sila kɛ Timoteo blɔ hyɛe ɔ, e na amaga babauu ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao lɛ.

english_verse: He went to the synagogue to speak to the Jews and to anyone who worshiped with them. Day after day he also spoke to everyone he met in the market.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, daa ligbi ɔ, e kɛ Yuda bi, kɛ Hela bi nɛ ba he Mawu ye ɔ ba hlaa ní a mi ngɛ kpe he ɔ. E kɛ nihi ya buaa ngɛ ma nɔ hulɔ kɛ hlaa ní a mi ja nɔuu.

english_verse: Some of them were Epicureans and some were Stoics, and they started arguing with him. People were asking, “What is this know-it-all trying to say?” Some even said, “Paul must be preaching about foreign gods! That's what he means when he talks about Jesus and about people rising from death.”
translation_verse: E kɛ ní leli a kuu nɛ ɔmɛ: Epikuro kɛ Stoike hu sãã nya. Ni komɛ bi ke, “Mɛni nyapuutsɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ tsuae ɔ?” Ni komɛ hu de ke “E ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ tuɔ ma se jemɛ a wɔhi a he munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nihi.” A de jã, ejakaa Paulo ngɛ Yesu he sane fiɛe, nɛ e ngɛ dee ke Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ kaa ni gbogboehi maa te si kɛ je gbeje.

english_verse: We have heard you say some strange things, and we want to know what you mean.”
translation_verse: Ní komɛ nɛ o de ɔ, wa nui hyɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa maa suɔ nɛ o blɛke mi bɔɔ ha wɔ.”

english_verse: So Paul stood up in front of the council and said: People of Athens, I see that you are very religious.
translation_verse: Paulo ya da ma kpe ngua a hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Atene bi, i na kaa blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ nyaa jami he saminya.

english_verse: As I was going through your city and looking at the things you worship, I found an altar with the words, “To an Unknown God.” You worship this God, but you don't really know him. So I want to tell you about him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa benɛ i nyɛɛ nyɛ ma a mi kɛ bee ɔ, i hyɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ jaa a. I na bɔ sami la tɛ ko nɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ke, ‘Mawu nɛ a li lɛ ɔ nɔ́.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ nyɛ li lɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e he sane i ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: This God made the world and everything in it. He is Lord of heaven and earth, and he doesn't live in temples built by human hands.
translation_verse: Mawu, nɔ nɛ bɔ je ɔ, kɛ e mi níhi tsuo ɔ, lɛ ji hiɔwe kɛ zugba Nyɔmtsɛ; nɛ e hí sɔlemi tsu nɛ a kɛ nine pee mi.

english_verse: God has done all this, so that we will look for him and reach out and find him. He isn't far from any of us,
translation_verse: E pee jã, konɛ a hla lɛ Mawu ɔ, kaa alini ke a kpa kɛ ya kɛ ba a, a maa na lɛ lo. Pohu, niinɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpɛti kɛ we kulaa.

english_verse: and he gives us the power to live, to move, and to be who we are. “We are his children,” just as some of your poets have said.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ ko de ɔ, ‘Mawu lɛ haa wa hii je mi, nɛ e haa wa yaa nɛ wa baa kaa adesahi.’ Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ la poli ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu de ɔ, ‘Wɔ hu e bimɛ ji wɔ.’

english_verse: Since we are God's children, we must not think that he is like an idol made out of gold or silver or stone. He isn't like anything that humans have thought up and made.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ ɔ, e sɛ kaa wa susuu kaa Mawu su ngɛ kaa sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ, loo tɛ ko nɛ nɔmlɔ kɛ e ga, kɛ e juɛmi pee.

english_verse: In the past, God forgave all this because people did not know what they were doing. But now he says that everyone everywhere must turn to him.
translation_verse: Benɛ adesa li ɔ, Mawu ku e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ nimli tsuo ngɛ he tsuaa he fae ke a tsake a tsui.

english_verse: He has set a day when he will judge the world's people with fairness. And he has chosen the man Jesus to do the judging for him. God has given proof of this to all of us by raising Jesus from death.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e to be pɔtɛɛ ko, nɛ e hla nɔ ko nɛ e maa gu e nɔ kɛ kojo je ɔ tsuo ngɛ dami sane yemi nya, ejakaa e tle jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ si kɛ je gbeje kɛ ma enɛ ɔ nɔ mi.”

english_verse: As soon as the people heard Paul say a man had been raised from death, some of them started laughing. Others said, “We will hear you talk about this some other time.”
translation_verse: Benɛ a nu nɛ Paulo tu gbogboehi a si temi he munyu ɔ, ni komɛ ye e he fɛu, se ni komɛ hu de lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o de nɛ ɔ, wa suɔ nɛ waa bu mo tue ekohu.”

english_verse: When Paul left the council meeting,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo si mɛ.

english_verse: some of the men put their faith in the Lord and went with Paul. One of them was a council member named Dionysius. A woman named Damaris and several others also put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Se nyumu komɛ he ye. A ti nɔ kake ji Dionisio; ma kpe ngua a nɛ a tsɛɛ Areopago ɔ mi no ji lɛ. Yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Damari, kɛ ni kpa komɛ hu he ye.

english_verse: where he met Aquila, a Jewish man from Pontus. Not long before this, Aquila had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Emperor Claudius had ordered the Jewish people to leave Rome. Paul went to see Aquila and Priscilla
translation_verse: E ya na Yuda no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Akuila ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A fɔ Akuila ngɛ Ponto. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, kɛ e yo Priskila je Italia kɛ ba we; ejakaa Kaisare Klaudio fa Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo ke a je Roma. Paulo ya a ngɔ,

english_verse: and found out they were tent makers. Paul was also a tent maker, so he stayed with them, and they worked together.
translation_verse: nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya hi si kɛ tsu ní; ejakaa bo tsu peemi ji a ní tsumi.

english_verse: Every Sabbath, Paul went to the synagogue. He spoke to Jews and Gentiles and tried to win them over.
translation_verse: Daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, e ya fiɛɔ Mawu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi ngɛ kpe he ɔ, nɛ e bɔɔ mɔde kaa e ma tsake Yuda bi, kɛ Hela bi tsuo.

english_verse: But after Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, he spent all his time preaching to the Jews about Jesus the Messiah.
translation_verse: Benɛ Sila kɛ Timoteo je Makedonia kɛ ba a, jehanɛ Paulo tsu we nɔ kpa ko hu pe munyu ɔ fiɛmi kɛkɛ; nɛ e yeɔ odase veveeve ngɔ tsɔɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, they turned against him and insulted him. So he shook the dust from his clothes and told them, “Whatever happens to you will be your own fault! I am not to blame. From now on I am going to preach to the Gentiles.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a te si wo lɛ, nɛ a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si lɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e huanya e tade mi mu kɛ pue a nɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ musu tloo nyɛ! Imi lɛɛ ye nya be mi. Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, ma je li ɔmɛ a ngɔ ma ya.”

english_verse: Paul then moved into the house of a man named Titius Justus, who worshiped God and lived next door to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e si lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ho ya to ma je no Mawu jalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Titio Yusto ɔ we mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ hi si. E we ɔ tsa kpe he ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Crispus was the leader of the synagogue. He and everyone in his family put their faith in the Lord. Many others in Corinth also heard the message, and all the people who had faith in the Lord were baptized.
translation_verse: Kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Krispo ɔ, kɛ e we tsuo he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye. Nihi babauu hu nɛ ngɛ Korinto ɔ nu sɛ gbi ɔ, nɛ a he ye; nɛ a sɔle mɛ.

english_verse: One night, Paul had a vision, and in it the Lord said, “Don't be afraid to keep on preaching. Don't stop!
translation_verse: Ligbi ko nyɔ mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de Paulo ngɛ nina mi ke, “Koo ye gbeye, se mohu fiɛ munyu ɔ. Ko ma o nya,

english_verse: I am with you, and you won't be harmed. Many people in this city belong to me.”
translation_verse: ejakaa i kɛ mo ngɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa pee mo yayami ko; ejakaa i ngɛ we bi babauu ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi.”

english_verse: Paul stayed on in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching God's message to the people.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Paulo ye jeha, kɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ Mawu munyu ɔ.

english_verse: While Gallio was governor of Achaia, some of the Jewish leaders got together and grabbed Paul. They brought him into court
translation_verse: Benɛ Roma nɔ yemi ɔ wo Galio amlaalo ngɛ Akaya a, Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee a nya kake nɛ a te si wo Paulo, nɛ a nu lɛ kɛ ho kojomi he ɔ ya.

english_verse: and said, “This man is trying to make our people worship God in a way that is against our Law!”
translation_verse: A ya po e nya ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ ma a yi mi woe nɛ a ja Mawu ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ nɛ kɛ wa mlaa a yɛ!”

english_verse: Even before Paul could speak, Gallio said, “If you were charging this man with a crime or some other wrong, I would have to listen to you.
translation_verse: Benɛ Paulo miɔ nɛ e ma je e nya a, kɛkɛ nɛ Galio po e nya nɔ, nɛ e de Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke, “Yuda bi, ju kɛ fɔ̃ sane ko nyɛ kɛ ba jinɛ ma na tsui kɛ bu nyɛ tue.

english_verse: But since this concerns only words, names, and your own law, you will have to take care of it yourselves. I refuse to judge such matters.”
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ munyunguhi, kɛ biɛhi, kɛ nyɛ mlaa a he nyɛ ngɛ sane yee ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ya hyɛ mi. Sanehi nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i be kojoe.”

english_verse: Then he sent them out of the court.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e fie mɛ kɛ je kojomi he ɔ.

english_verse: The crowd grabbed Sosthenes, the Jewish leader, and beat him up in front of the court. But none of this mattered to Gallio. Paul Returns to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo a ya nu kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sostene ɔ ngɛ kojomi he ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a fia lɛ ní. Se nɔ́ nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ si we Galio kpu. Paulo kpale kɛ ba Antiokia

english_verse: After Paul had stayed for a while with the Lord's followers in Corinth, he told them goodbye and sailed on to Syria with Aquila and Priscilla. But before he left, he had his head shaved at Cenchreae because he had made a promise to God.
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ hi si ngɛ Korinto be saii. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ mɛ ye sɛ, nɛ e ngɔ Priskila, kɛ Akuila kɛ piɛ e he, nɛ a ya wó lɛ kɛ ba Siria. Loko lɛ ɔ maa hia ngɛ Kenkrea a, Paulo ha a sɛ e yi ha lɛ, ejakaa be ko ɔ, e wo Mawu si ko.

english_verse: The three of them arrived in Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He then went into the synagogue to talk with the people there.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ba su Efeso ɔ, Paulo si Priskila kɛ Akuila ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; se loko e je ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e ya kpe he ɔ, nɛ e kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ya hla ní a nya.

english_verse: They asked him to stay longer, but he refused.
translation_verse: A kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e ye be bɔɔ ngɛ a ngɔ, se e kplɛɛ we.

english_verse: Paul sailed to Caesarea, where he greeted the church. Then he went on to Antioch.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ya kple ngɛ Kaisarea a, e ya Yerusalem, nɛ e ya nga asafo ɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Antiokia ya.

english_verse: After staying there for a while, he left and visited several places in Galatia and Phrygia. He helped the followers there to become stronger in their faith. Apollos in Ephesus
translation_verse: E hi lejɛ ɔ be bɔɔ ko; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e pue nɔ ekohu, nɛ e ya kpa Galatia, kɛ Frigia ní ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e wo nihi nɛ he ye ɔ tsuo he wami. Apolo ngɛ Efeso kɛ Korinto

english_verse: A Jewish man named Apollos came to Ephesus. Apollos had been born in the city of Alexandria. He was a very good speaker and knew a lot about the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yuda no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Apolo, nɛ e se je Aleksandria a ba Efeso. Nyumu nɛ ɔ nya mi tsɔ saminya, nɛ e le ngmami ɔmɛ a mi fitsofitso.

english_verse: He also knew much about the Lord's Way, and he spoke about it with great excitement. What he taught about Jesus was right, but all he knew was John's message about baptism.
translation_verse: A tsɔɔ nyumu nɛ ɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kã, kɛ mumi nɛ nya wa fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ; nɛ e tsɔɔ Yesu he ní fitsofitso. Pohu Yohane nɔ sɔlemi ɔ pɛ nɛ e le.

english_verse: Apollos started speaking bravely in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him to their home and helped him understand God's Way even better.
translation_verse: E kɛ kã bɔni munyu tumi ngɛ kpe he ɔ. Benɛ Priskila kɛ Akuila nu nɛ e ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba a ngɔ, nɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ fitsofitso.

english_verse: Apollos decided to travel through Achaia. So the Lord's followers wrote letters, encouraging the followers there to welcome him. After Apollos arrived in Achaia, he was a great help to everyone who had put their faith in the Lord Jesus because of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, Apolo to e yi mi kaa e maa po mi kɛ ya Akaya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ susu he, nɛ a ngma womi ya ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Akaya a kɛ wo mɛ ga ke a he lɛ hɛmuɔ. Benɛ e ba su lejɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ Mawu dloomi nya a, a ba he Kristo ye ɔ na e he se saminya.

english_verse: He got into fierce arguments with the Jewish people, and in public he used the Scriptures to prove that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e tu munyu kɛ he wami kɛ ku Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nya la; nɛ e je ngmami ɔmɛ a mi kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ faii kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul traveled across the hill country to Ephesus, where he met some of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Benɛ Apolo ngɛ Korinto ɔ, Paulo ya kpa ni ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ba su Efeso. E ba na nihi nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ a ti ni komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,

english_verse: He asked them, “When you put your faith in Jesus, were you given the Holy Spirit?” “No!” they answered. “We have never even heard of the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Benɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ, anɛ nyɛ na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lo?” A de lɛ ke, “Wa nui hyɛ tete kaa Mumi Klɔuklɔu ko ngɛ.”

english_verse: “Then why were you baptized?” Paul asked. They answered, “Because of what John taught.”
translation_verse: Paulo bi mɛ ekohu ke, “Lɛɛ kɛ a pee kɛ sɔle nyɛ kɛɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ Yohane tsɔɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Paul replied, “John baptized people so they would turn to God. But he also told them someone else was coming, and they should put their faith in him. Jesus is the one that John was talking about.”
translation_verse: Paulo ya nɔ ke, “Yohane tsɔɔ kaa nihi nɛ tsake a tsui loko a sɔle mɛ. Nɛ e de Israel ma a ke, ‘Nyɛ he nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ ye se ɔ nyɛɛ ye. Lɛ ji Yesu ɔ nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: After the people heard Paul say this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ, a sɔle mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi.

english_verse: Then Paul placed his hands on them. The Holy Spirit was given to them, and they spoke unknown languages and prophesied.
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ e nine pue a nɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. A tu munyu ngɛ gbihi nɛ a nui mi, nɛ a fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ.

english_verse: There were about twelve men in this group.
translation_verse: Nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a yibɔ maa su nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.

english_verse: For three months Paul went to the synagogue and talked bravely with the people about God's kingdom. He tried to win them over,
translation_verse: Paulo ye nyɔhiɔ etɛ sɔuu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kã tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔ. E bɔ mɔde kaa e ma ha nɛ a le Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ.

english_verse: but some of them were stubborn and refused to believe. In front of everyone they said terrible things about God's Way. Paul left and took the followers with him to the lecture hall of Tyrannus. He spoke there every day
translation_verse: Se ni komɛ wa tue, nɛ a he we yi; nɛ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, a tu munyu yaya kɛ si Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Paulo je a he nɛ e je kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ je a kpɛti; nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e kɛ nihi ya hlaa níhi a mi ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tirano ɔ ni kasemi he.

english_verse: for two years, until every Jew and Gentile in Asia had heard the Lord's message. The Sons of Sceva
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ya nɔ jeha enyɔ sɔuu, nɛ Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo nɛ a ngɛ Asia a nu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ. Skeva bimɛ ɔmɛ

english_verse: God gave Paul the power to work great miracles.
translation_verse: Mawu tsu nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ nɔ be kɛ gu Paulo nine nɔ.

english_verse: People even took handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched Paul's body, and they carried them to everyone who was sick. All of the sick people were healed, and the evil spirits went out.
translation_verse: A ngɔɔ dukuhi, kɛ tade hɛ mi hami bohi tete nɛ Paulo he sa he kɛ ya haa hiɔtsɛmɛ a nɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, hiɔ taa; nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ jee a mi.

english_verse: Some Jewish men started going around trying to force out evil spirits by using the name of the Lord Jesus. They said to the spirits, “Come out in the name of that same Jesus that Paul preaches about!”
translation_verse: Yuda bi klaali komɛ nɛ ngɛ si kpae hu ka kaa a kɛ Yesu biɛ ma tsa nihi nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ a mi. A deɔ mumi yayami ɔmɛ ke, “Ngɛ Yesu nɛ Paulo ngɛ fiɛe ɔ biɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ mo fae ke jee kpo kɛ je nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ mi.”

english_verse: when an evil spirit said to them, “I know Jesus! And I have heard about Paul. But who are you?”
translation_verse: Se mumi yayami ɔ he nɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Yesu ɔ, i le lɛ, nɛ Paulo hu i le lɛ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ mɛnɔmɛ ji nyɛ?”

english_verse: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and beat them up. They ran out of the house, naked and bruised.
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔ nɛ mumi yayami ɔ ngɛ e mi ɔ sá fɔ̃ a nɔ kitikiti, nɛ e plaa mɛ tsuo; nɛ a tu fo kɛ je jamɛ a we ɔ mi kɛ a he pahi, kɛ tadehi nɛ hía.

english_verse: When the Jews and Gentiles in Ephesus heard about this, they were so frightened that they praised the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo nɛ ngɛ Efeso nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, gbeye nu mɛ, nɛ a wo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu hɛ mi nyami wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: Many who were followers now started telling everyone about the evil things they had been doing.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ he ye ɔ, a ti nihi babauu hu ba, nɛ ní yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ, a ba jaje paa ngɛ ma a hɛ mi.

english_verse: After all this had happened, Paul decided to visit Macedonia and Achaia on his way to Jerusalem. Paul had said, “From there I will go on to Rome.”
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ha Paulo to e yi mi kaa e ma ya gu Makedonia, kɛ Akaya kɛ ya su Yerusalem. E de ke, “Ke i su lejɛ ɔ, ma ya slaa Roma hulɔ.”

english_verse: So he sent his two helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia. But he stayed on in Asia for a while.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ e he piɛli enyɔ Makedonia. Mɛ ji Timoteo, kɛ Erasto; se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e hi Asia be bɔɔ.

english_verse: At that time there was serious trouble because of the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: Be nɛ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, basabasa peemi wawɛɛ ko ba te si ngɛ Efeso ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: A silversmith named Demetrius had a business that made silver models of the temple of the goddess Artemis. Those who worked for him earned a lot of money.
translation_verse: Sika hiɔ galɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Demetrio ɔ kɛ sika hiɔ pee yo mawu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Artemi ɔ jami he ɔ henɔhi. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ e ní tsuli ɔmɛ na ní kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Demetrius brought together everyone who was in the same business and said: Friends, you know we make a good living at this.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ e ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpahi nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ní ɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛ le kaa kikɛmɛ a ga ní tsumi nɛ ɔ mi wa naa ní ngɛ.

english_verse: But you have surely seen and heard how this man Paul is upsetting a lot of people, not only in Ephesus, but almost everywhere in Asia. He claims that the gods we humans make are not really gods at all.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nu, nɛ nyɛ na níhi nɛ kikɛmɛ a Paulo nɛ ɔ ngɛ pee. E deɔ ke mawuhi nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa kɛ e nine pee ɔ pi mawu. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e plɛ nihi babauu a yi mi ngɛ Efeso hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ Asia kpokpa tsuo nɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will start saying terrible things about our business. They will stop respecting the temple of the goddess Artemis, who is worshiped in Asia and all over the world. Our great goddess will be forgotten!
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si paa ji, wa ní tsumi ɔ he guɛ ma gbo. Pi lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu a maa ye yo mawu Artemi jami he ɔ he fɛu, nɛ bɔ nɛ a nyaa e he ngɛ Asia, kɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ se maa po!”

english_verse: When the workers heard this, they got angry and started shouting, “Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians!”
translation_verse: Benɛ ni kpekpemi ɔ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, a mi mi wo la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a bɔni ngmlaa kpami ke, “Efeso bi a we Artemi ɔ ngɛ he wami saminya!”

english_verse: Soon the whole city was in a riot, and some men grabbed Gaius and Aristarchus, who had come from Macedonia with Paul. Then everyone in the crowd rushed to the place where the town meetings were held.
translation_verse: Ma a mi tsuo pee hoo kɛ ngmlaa. Kɛkɛ nɛ basabasa peeli ɔmɛ ya nu Gayo kɛ Aristarko, Makedonia bi nɛ piɛ Paulo he kɛ hia blɔ ɔ, nɛ a tsɛ̃ a yi se kɛ fo kɛ ho he nɛ ma a kpee ngɛ ɔ ya.

english_verse: Paul wanted to go out and speak to the people, but the Lord's followers would not let him.
translation_verse: Jinɛ Paulo nitsɛ hla kaa e maa ya lejɛ ɔ, se nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we.

english_verse: A few of the local officials were friendly to Paul, and they sent someone to warn him not to go.
translation_verse: Asia ma ní tsuli komɛ nɛ ji Paulo huɛmɛ tsɔ ba wo lɛ ga ke e ko ka kaa e ma ya je e hɛ mi kpo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Some of the people in the meeting were shouting one thing, and others were shouting something else. Everyone was completely confused, and most of them did not even know why they were there.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, benɛ ni komɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kikɛ ɔ, ni komɛ hu ngɛ nɔ́ kpa dee; ejakaa ni ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ gidigidi pee, se a ti nihi fuu li nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ a ba kpe ɔ tete.

english_verse: Several of the Jewish leaders pushed a man named Alexander to the front of the crowd and started telling him what to say. He motioned with his hand and tried to explain what was going on.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ha Aleksandro ba da ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi he je ɔ, ni komɛ susu kaa Aleksandro le basabasa nɛ ba a he nɔ́ ko. Aleksandro suɔ kaa e ma je e nya kɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e wo e nine nɔ ha ma a kaa a pee dii.

english_verse: But when the crowd saw that he was Jewish, they all shouted for two hours, “Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians!”
translation_verse: Se benɛ a kpa si kaa Yuda no ji lɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa maa pee ngmlɛfia enyɔ sɔuu ke, “Efeso bi a we Artemi ɔ ngɛ he wami saminya!”

english_verse: Finally, a town official made the crowd be quiet. Then he said: People of Ephesus, who in the world doesn't know that our city is the center for worshiping the great goddess Artemis? Who doesn't know that her image which fell from heaven is right here?
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, ma womi ngmalɔ ɔ ha ni ɔmɛ pee dii, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ Efeso bi, nɔ tsuaa nɔ le kaa yo mawu Artemi nguaa a jami he, kɛ tɛ nɛ kple si kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ, Efeso ma nɛ ɔ mi ji he nɛ a ngɛ.

english_verse: No one can deny this, and so you should calm down and not do anything foolish.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa je he nɔ́; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛɛ pee dii, nɛ nyɛ ko pee gidigidi ko kulaa.

english_verse: You have brought men in here who have not robbed temples or spoken against our goddess.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, pohu pi kaa a ya ju ní ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, loo a bɔ wa yo mawu ɔ ahlua ko.

english_verse: But if you want to do more than that, the matter will have to be brought before the city council.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ́ kpa ko pa ngɛ enɛ ɔ se nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ, lɛɛ a kɛ ya ma kpe ɔ hɛ mi nɛ a hla nya.

english_verse: We could easily be accused of starting a riot today. There is no excuse for it! We cannot even give a reason for this uproar.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ ba mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, gbeye ngɛ he kaa a ma nyɛ maa po wa nya ke wa ngɛ ma a mi hliihlii woe. Ke e ba ja a, mɛni nya jemi wa ngɛ?”

english_verse: After saying this, he told the people to leave.
translation_verse: Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa kpe ɔ.

english_verse: When the riot was over, Paul sent for the followers and encouraged them. He then told them goodbye and left for Macedonia.
translation_verse: Benɛ basabasa a se po ɔ, Paulo tsɔ ya tsɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba. E kɛ mɛ tu munyu, nɛ e wo mɛ he wami. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e sɛ mɛ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Makedonia ya.

english_verse: As he traveled from place to place, he encouraged the followers with many messages. Finally, he went to Greece
translation_verse: E kpa si kɛ gu lejɛ ɔ kpokpa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ e tu munyuhi saminya kɛ wo ni ɔmɛ he wami. Jehanɛ ɔ, e ba su Akaya,

english_verse: and stayed there for three months. Paul was about to sail to Syria. But some of the Jewish leaders plotted against him, so he decided to return by way of Macedonia.
translation_verse: nɛ e ye nyɔhiɔ etɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Se benɛ e ngɛ e he dlae nɛ e maa ya Siria a, e na le kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ e yi nɔ soe; Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e to e yi mi kaa e maa kpale e se kɛ ya gu Makedonia ekohu.

english_verse: With him were Sopater, son of Pyrrhus from Berea, and Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica. Gaius from Derbe was also with him, and so were Timothy and the two Asians, Tychicus and Trophimus.
translation_verse: E kɛ Piro nɛ je Beroya a e bi Sopater ho. Nihi hu nɛ piɛ e he ji Aristarko, kɛ Sekundo nɛ a je Tesalonika a, Gayo nɛ je Derbe ɔ, Tihiko kɛ Trofimo nɛ a je Asia a, kɛ Timoteo.

english_verse: They went on ahead to Troas and waited for us there.
translation_verse: Ni nɛ ɔmɛ sɛ hlami, nɛ a ya mlɛ wɔ ngɛ Troya.

english_verse: After the Festival of Thin Bread, we sailed from Philippi. Five days later we met them in Troas and stayed there for a week. Paul's Last Visit to Troas
translation_verse: Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ se ɔ, wa wó lɛ kɛ je Filipi, nɛ ligbi enuɔ se ɔ, wa ya na mɛ ngɛ Troya, nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hi lejɛ ɔ otsi. Paulo kɛ Troya asafo ɔ ye sɛ

english_verse: On the first day of the week we met to break bread together. Paul spoke to the people until midnight because he was leaving the next morning.
translation_verse: Otsi ɔ mi kekleekle ligbi ɔ, wa bua wa he nya, konɛ waa ye suɔmi niye ní ɔ. Paulo tu munyu tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ, nɛ e tsa fiɛmi ɔ nɔ kɛ ya su nyɔ mi kɔ̃kɔ̃ɔ̃kɔ̃; ejakaa e nɔ jena nɔuu e maa je.

english_verse: In the upstairs room where we were meeting, there were a lot of lamps.
translation_verse: A su kane fuu ngɛ hiɔwe tsu mi he nɛ a kpe ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: A young man by the name of Eutychus was sitting on a window sill. While Paul was speaking, the young man got very sleepy. Finally, he went to sleep and fell three floors all the way down to the ground. When they picked him up, he was dead.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, niheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yutiko hii si ngɛ saflɛ ɔ nya. E bɔni mahe hwɔmi kɛ ya su be nɛ e sɛ mi vii, ejakaa Paulo munyu ɔ se kɛ. Tlukaa a, Yutiko tsɔ kɛ je siaudo etɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ba nɔ zugba tim! Benɛ a ke a yaa wo e nɔ ɔ, e gbo momo.

english_verse: Paul went down and bent over Eutychus. He took him in his arms and said, “Don't worry! He's alive.”
translation_verse: Se Paulo kple si, nɛ e ya bu e nɔ, nɛ e fua lɛ. E de ni ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko jé ngmlaa; wami ngɛ e mi kɛ mwɔɔ!”

english_verse: After Paul had gone back upstairs, he broke bread, and ate with us. He then spoke until dawn and left.
translation_verse: Benɛ Paulo kpale e se kɛ ya mɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ku abolo, nɛ e ye. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ ni ɔmɛ sɛɛ ní hluu kɛ ya si je mi tsɔ wɛsɛɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ e si mɛ.

english_verse: Then the followers took the young man home alive and were very happy. The Voyage from Troas to Miletus
translation_verse: A kɛ niheyo ɔ ho we mi ya hɛ ngmengmle; nɛ a bua jɔ a he saminya. Paulo je Troya kɛ ya Mileto

english_verse: Paul decided to travel by land to Assos. The rest of us went on ahead by ship, and we were to take him aboard there.
translation_verse: Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa sɛ hlami ya wó lɛ kɛ yaa Aso, nɛ́ wa ya ngɔ Paulo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa e kɛ wɔ ye sɛ momo kaa e maa gu nane blɔ.

english_verse: When he met us in Assos, he came aboard, and we sailed on to Mitylene.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ba ná wɔ ngɛ Aso ɔ, e ba sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo wa tsa nɔ kɛ ho Mitilene ya.

english_verse: The next day we came to a place near Chios, and the following day we reached Samos. The day after that we sailed to Miletus.
translation_verse: Wa hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e nɔ jena a, wa ba su Kio hanɔ. E nɔ jena ekohu ɔ, wa ba su Samo, nɛ jena nɔ ekohu ɔ, wa ba Mileto.

english_verse: Paul had decided to sail on past Ephesus, because he did not want to spend too much time in Asia. He was in a hurry and wanted to be in Jerusalem in time for Pentecost. Paul Says Goodbye to the Church Leaders of Ephesus
translation_verse: Paulo pee e yi mi kaa e maa tsɔ Efeso he, konɛ e ko ya Asia. E ngɛ esɔ yee, konɛ ke e ma nyɛ ɔ, e ya ye Pentekoste ligbi ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. Paulo kɛ Efeso nikɔtɔma amɛ ye sɛ

english_verse: From Miletus, Paul sent a message for the church leaders at Ephesus to come and meet with him.
translation_verse: Paulo tsɔ kɛ je Mileto nɛ a ya tsɛ asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: When they got there, he said: You know everything I did during the time I was with you when I first came to Asia.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ba a, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le bɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ hi si be nɛ be ɔ tsuo, kɛ je kekleekle ligbi nɛ i ba Asia a.

english_verse: Some of the Jews plotted against me and caused me a lot of sorrow and trouble. But I served the Lord and was humble.
translation_verse: I ba ye he si saminya kɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ soɔ ye yi nɔ, nɛ a haa nɛ i naa nɔ́ wawɛɛ, nɛ i foɔ ya tete po.

english_verse: When I preached in public or taught in your homes, I didn't hold back from telling anything that would help you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le hu kaa níhi nɛ a he ngɛ se nami ha nyɛ ɔ, i laa we nyɛ ekoeko nɔ; se mohu i fiɛ, nɛ i tsɔɔ nyɛ ní faii ngɛ ma nɔ, kɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi tsuo.

english_verse: I told Jews and Gentiles to turn to God and have faith in our Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: I tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo ke a kpa yayami peemi, nɛ a ba Mawu ngɔ, nɛ a he wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ a ye.

english_verse: I don't know what will happen to me in Jerusalem, but I must obey God's Spirit and go there.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de mi ke ma pee ɔ, i yaa Yerusalem, nɛ i li nɔ́ nɛ ma ya ba ye nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In every city I visit, I am told by the Holy Spirit that I will be put in jail and will be in trouble in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i le kɛkɛ ji kaa ma tsuaa ma mi ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ jeɔ tsɔɔ mi kaa a maa wo mi tsu, nɛ ma na amanehlu babauu.

english_verse: But I don't care what happens to me, as long as I finish the work the Lord Jesus gave me to do. And this work is to tell the good news about God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ ye wami tete he hia we mi. Nɔ́ nɛ he hia mohu ji kaa ní tsumi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ha mi ɔ, ma tsu kɛ gbe nya. Lɔ ɔ ji kaa ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu mi mi hi ha adesahi tsuo ɔ.

english_verse: I have gone from place to place, preaching to you about God's kingdom, but now I know that none of you will ever see me again.
translation_verse: “I kpa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nɔ, nɛ i fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i le kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko be mi nae hu.

english_verse: I have told you everything God wants you to know.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i jaje Mawu yi mi tomi ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ i laa we nyɛ ba.

english_verse: Look after yourselves and everyone the Holy Spirit has placed in your care. Be like shepherds to God's church. It is the flock he bought with the blood of his own Son.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya. Asafo ɔ tsuo nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tu ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ bɔ nɛ sa. Mawu ngɔ e Bi ɔ kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ e kɛ dani asafo ɔ kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ saminya.

english_verse: I know that after I am gone, others will come like fierce wolves to attack you.
translation_verse: I le kaa ke i je ɔ, nihi ma ba sɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ a maa pee a ní kaa ogbetee ní hali; a be asafo ɔ yi bae.

english_verse: Some of your own people will tell lies to win over the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpɛti hu nihi maa ye lakpa kɛ puɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a tue kɛ ya nyɛɛ a se.

english_verse: Be on your guard! Remember how day and night for three years I kept warning you with tears in my eyes.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ be tsuaa be, nɛ nyɛ kai kaa i nga vo nyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ní nyɔ kɛ pia jeha etɛ sɔuu.

english_verse: I now place you in God's care. Remember the message about his gift of undeserved grace! This message can help you and give you what belongs to you as God's people.
translation_verse: “Nyagbe ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ tue kɛ ngɛ Mawu kɛ e dloomi munyu ɔ dɛ mi woe. Munyu ɔ maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛ maa da si kpikpitii; nɛ gbaami nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha e we bi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ nine maa su nɔ.

english_verse: I have never wanted anyone's money or clothes.
translation_verse: Ye hɛ kɔɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu, loo tade nɔ.

english_verse: You know how I have worked with my own hands to make a living for myself and my friends.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia mi ɔ, ye nine nguɛ nɛ ɔmɛ i kɛ tsu loko i na; ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a hiami níhi po, imi lɛ i ha mɛ.

english_verse: By everything I did, I showed how you should work to help everyone who is weak. Remember that our Lord Jesus said, “More blessings come from giving than from receiving.”
translation_verse: I ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ to nyɛ okadi kaa jã nɛ e sa kaa a tsu ní nɛ a kɛ ye bua nihi nɛ be he wami ɔ, konɛ nyɛ kai Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu munyu nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tu ɔ. E de ke, ‘Gbaami ngɛ nɔ́ hami mi pe nɔ́ sɔlemi mi.’ ”

english_verse: After Paul had finished speaking, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.
translation_verse: Benɛ Paulo gbe munyu ɔ nya a, e kɛ mɛ tsuo kplã si, nɛ a sɔle.

english_verse: They were especially sad because Paul had told them, “You will never see me again.” Then they went with him to the ship.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ dɔ mɛ pe kulaa ji munyu nɛ je e nya ke, “Nyɛ be ye hɛ mi nae gblegbleegble hu ɔ.” Jehanɛ a ya je lɛ blɔ kɛ ya su lɛ ɔ he tɔɔ.
