english_verse: God let them follow their own evil desires. Women no longer wanted to have sex in a natural way, and they did things with each other that were not natural.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mawu ngmɛɛ a he, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ ní yayahi nɛ ngɛ zo a se. A yi ɔmɛ tete po kɛ a sibi peeɔ níhi nɛ pi ja nɛ Mawu to.

english_verse: Men behaved in the same way. They stopped wanting to have sex with women and had strong desires for sex with other men. They did shameful things with each other, and what has happened to them is punishment for their foolish deeds.
translation_verse: Nyumu ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu, a hla we yihi a se blɔ. Se ke akɔnɔ yaya te si ngɛ a mi ɔ, a kɛ a sibi nyumuhi mohu ya naa bɔmi. Nyumuhi kɛ a sibi nyumuhi tsu zo níhi, nɛ tue gblami nɛ sa mɛ kaa nihi nɛ bɔ musu ɔ, a ná ngɔ wo a he mi.

english_verse: Since these people refused even to think about God, he let their useless minds rule over them. That's why they do all sorts of indecent things.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ hu, akɛnɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ bui a he kaa e sa mɛ kaa a leɔ Mawu ɔ, Mawu hu ngmɛɛ a he ngɔ ha juɛmi nɛ sɛ́, konɛ a pee níhi nɛ sɛ́.

english_verse: They are evil, wicked, and greedy, as well as mean in every possible way. They want what others have, and they murder, argue, cheat, and are hard to get along with. They gossip,
translation_verse: A peeɔ yi wu tso ní, kɛ yayami slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi. A jeɔ hunga, a pueɔ muɔ si, a pɛɔ, a sisiɔ nɔ, nɛ a toɔ a sibi a he ga yaya;

english_verse: say cruel things about others, and hate God. They are proud, conceited, and boastful, always thinking up new ways to do evil. These people don't respect their parents.
translation_verse: a yeɔ sieku, nɛ a sume Mawu sane; a bui nɔ, a woɔ a he nɔ, a fĩaa, a toɔ nɔ́ yaya he ga, nɛ a bui a fɔli;

english_verse: They are stupid, unreliable, and don't have any love or pity for others.
translation_verse: a he nile gbo; ke a wo si ɔ, a yi nɔ, nɛ a nɛ́ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: They know God has said that anyone who acts this way deserves to die. But they keep on doing evil things, and they even encourage others to do them.
translation_verse: A le kaa Mawu de ke nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a sa gbenɔ, se kɛ̃ pi kaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a peeɔ yayami nɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu a jeɔ nihi nɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ a yi.

english_verse: Some of you accuse others of doing wrong. But there is no excuse for what you do. When you judge others, you condemn yourselves, because you are guilty of doing the very same things.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmi, anɛ o kojoɔ nihi, nɛ o buɔ mɛ fɔ lo? Ke o peeɔ ja a, lɛɛ o be nya jemi ko kulaa. Ejakaa ke o kojoɔ ni kpahi, nɛ o buu mɛ fɔ, nɛ mo hu o peeɔ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ nɔuu ɔ, na nɛ o le kaa mo nitsɛ o he fɔ o ngɛ bue ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We know that God is right to judge everyone who behaves in this way.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Mawu buɔ nihi nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ fɔ ɔ le da pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: You surely don't think much of God's wonderful goodness or of his patience and willingness to put up with you. Don't you know that the reason God is good to you is because he wants you to turn to him?
translation_verse: O bui nɔ́! Mɛni he je ɔ, Mawu mi mi jɔ, e naa nɔ he tsui, nɛ e toɔ e tsui si. Blɔɔ o li kaa Mawu mi mi jɔ ha mo konɛ o tsake o tsui lo?

english_verse: But you are stubborn and refuse to turn to God. So you are making things even worse for yourselves on that day when he will show how angry he is and will judge the world with fairness.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ o kplii o tsui, nɛ o pia we o he ɔ, kojomi ligbi ɔ nɛ Mawu mi mi ma fu, nɛ e maa kojo kɛ dami sane yemi ɔ, o tue gblami ɔ maa pe nine.

english_verse: God will reward each of us for what we have done.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa lɛ ngɛ e ní tsumi ɔ nya.

english_verse: He will give eternal life to everyone who has patiently done what is good in the hope of receiving glory, honor, and life that lasts forever.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ toɔ a tsui si kɛ peeɔ kpakpa daa, nɛ a kɛ hlaa hɛ mi nyami, kɛ bu ha a he konɛ a ko gbo ɔ, Mawu ma ha mɛ neneene wami.

english_verse: But he will show how angry and furious he can be with every selfish person who rejects the truth and wants to do evil.
translation_verse: Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ mi pɛ a foɔ, nɛ a bui anɔkuale, nɛ nɔ́ yayami se pɛ a dii ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi mi la, kɛ mi mi fumi ma kple a nɔ.

english_verse: All who are wicked will be punished with trouble and suffering. It doesn't matter if they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Mawu ma ha nɛ haomi, kɛ nɔ́ nami maa ba yayami peeli tsuo a nɔ, Yuda bi kekle, kɛ ma je li hulɔ.

english_verse: But all who do right will be rewarded with glory, honor, and peace, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, Mawu maa wo a hɛ mi nyami; bu maa ba a he, nɛ e ma ha mɛ he jɔmi, Yuda bi kekle, kɛ jehanɛ ɔ, ma je li hulɔ.

english_verse: God doesn't have any favorites!
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Those people who don't know about God's Law will still be punished for what they do wrong. And the Law will be used to judge everyone who knows what it says.
translation_verse: Nihi abɔ nɛ mlaa a kpakaa we mɛ, nɛ a peeɔ yayami ɔ, a hɛ mi kpataa kaa nihi nɛ mlaa a kpakaa we mɛ; nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ guu mlaa a nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ, mlaa a nɔuu nɔ a daa kɛ kojoɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Some of you call yourselves Jews. You trust in the Law and take pride in God.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sane ngɛ kɛɛ? Nyɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ he Yuda bi, nɛ nyɛ daa mlaa a nɔ kɛ fĩaa kaa Mawu nihi ji nyɛ.

english_verse: By reading the Scriptures you learn how God wants you to behave, and you discover what is right.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee, nɛ a gu mlaa a nɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ hi.

english_verse: You are sure that you are a guide for the blind and a light for all who are in the dark.
translation_verse: Nyɛ buu nyɛ he nihi nɛ tsɔɔ hɛ yuyuili blɔ, aloo la kɛ ha nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi.

english_verse: And since there is knowledge and truth in God's Law, you think you can instruct fools and teach young people.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ buu nyɛ he kuasiahi a tsɔseli, kɛ nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko ɔ a ní tsɔɔli; ejakaa nyɛ le kaa niinɛ, nile kɛ anɔkuale tsuo ngɛ mlaa a mi.

english_verse: But how can you teach others when you refuse to learn? You preach it is wrong to steal. But do you steal?
translation_verse: Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi ní ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ tsɔɔ we nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he ní mɔ? Nyɛ fiɛɔ ke a ko ju; se tse nyɛ juɔ?

english_verse: You say people should be faithful in marriage. But are you faithful? You hate idols, yet you rob their temples.
translation_verse: Nyɛ deɔ ke a ko puɛ gba; se nyɛ puɛ we gba lo? Amagahi a he peeɔ nyɛ tai, se tse nyɛ ya juɔ ngɛ wɔ piɛhi a mi?

english_verse: You take pride in the Law, but you disobey the Law and bring shame to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ fĩaa ke nyɛ le mlaa a, se tse nyɛ tɔɔ mlaa a kɛ pueɔ Mawu hɛ mi si?

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures tell us, “You have made foreigners say insulting things about God.”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nyɛ Yuda bi nyɛ he ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ tuɔ musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ siɔ Mawu.”

english_verse: Being circumcised is worthwhile, if you obey the Law. But if you don't obey the Law, you are no better off than people who are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ jinɛ pomi nɛ a po nyɛ ɔ, se nami ngɛ he. Se nyɛ yi nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ a pui mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In fact, if they obey the Law, they are as good as anyone who is circumcised.
translation_verse: Ke ma je no nɛ a pui lɛ ɔ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ, anɛ Mawu be lɛ bue kaa nɔ ko nɛ a po lɛ lo?

english_verse: So everyone who obeys the Law, but has never been circumcised, will condemn you. Even though you are circumcised and have the Law, you still don't obey its teachings.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ Yuda bi, ma je li ɔmɛ maa kojo nyɛ, ejakaa nyɛ nɛ a ngma mlaa a ngɔ ha, nɛ́ mlaa a nya a poɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ tɔɔ mlaa a. Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a yeɔ mlaa a nɔ, pohu a pui mɛ.

english_verse: Just because you live like a Jew and are circumcised doesn't make you a real Jew.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji Yuda no nitsɛnitsɛ mɔ? Pi okadi nɛ a to ngɛ nɔ he lo mi kaa nɔ pomi kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ Yuda no.

english_verse: To be a real Jew you must obey the Law. True circumcision is something that happens deep in your heart, not something done to your body. And besides, you should want praise from God and not from humans.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, Yuda no nitsɛnitsɛ peemi ɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nitsɛ e mi, nɛ nɔ pomi ɔ hu ngɛ e tsui mi. Mawu mumi ɔ pɛ lɛ tsuɔ enɛ ɔ, pi mlaa nɛ a ngma a. Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ lɛ jeɔ e yi, pi nɔmlɔ adesa.

english_verse: What good is it to be a Jew? What good is it to be circumcised?
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛni Yuda no kɛ pe ma je no mɔ? Aloo mɛni se nami ngɛ nɔ pomi he?

english_verse: It is good in a lot of ways! First of all, God's messages were spoken to the Jews.
translation_verse: Ee, nɔ pomi he ngɛ se nami babauu ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ. Kekleekle nɔ́ ji kaa a tu Mawu munyu ɔ ngɔ wo Yuda bi ɔmɛ a dɛ.

english_verse: It is true that some of them did not believe the message. But does this mean that God cannot be trusted, just because they did not have faith?
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa ni komɛ he we yi lɛɛ, se anɛ lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu be anɔkuale yee lo?

english_verse: No, indeed! God tells the truth, even if everyone else is a liar. The Scriptures say about God, “Your words will be proven true, and in court you will win your case.”
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Mawu ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; pohu nimli adesahi tsuo lɛɛ lakpa a yeɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a na kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o deɔ ɔ ngɛ mi; Nɛ ke a kojo mo hu, o yeɔ nguɔ.”

english_verse: If our evil deeds show how right God is, then what can we say? Is it wrong for God to become angry and punish us? What a foolish thing to ask.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ́ nɛ dɛ nɛ wa peeɔ ɔ, haa nɛ a naa paa kaa nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ Mawu peeɔ ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Anɛ ke Mawu kɛ mi mi fumi gbla wa tue ɔ, e tɔ lo?

english_verse: But the answer is, “No.” Otherwise, how could God judge the world?
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Ke Mawu yi dami sane ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e maa kojo je ɔ?

english_verse: Since your lies bring great honor to God by showing how truthful he is, you may ask why God still says you are a sinner.
translation_verse: Se nɔ ko ma bi ke, “Ke ye lakpa a haa nɛ a naa Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ saminya, nɛ lɔ ɔ woɔ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a buu mi fɔ kaa yayami peelɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: You might as well say, “Let's do something evil, so that something good will come of it!” Some people even claim that we are saying this. But God is fair and will judge them as well. No One Is Good
translation_verse: Mɛni he je nɛ e sɛ́ kaa wa deɔ ke, “Wa maa pee yayami konɛ kpakpa nɛ je mi kɛ ba,” kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ poo ngɔ fɔɔ wa nɔ ke wa deɔ ɔ? Jamɛtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, fɔ nɛ a bu mɛ ɔ sa mɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean that we Jews are better off than the Gentiles? No, it doesn't! Jews, as well as Gentiles, are ruled by sin, just as I have said.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ? Anɛ wɔ Yuda bi wa nɔ́ mi hi pee ni kpa amɛ lo? Dɛbi, pi ja kulaa! Kaa bɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ nya momo ɔ, Yuda bi kɛ Hela bi tsuo sɔ; mɛ tsuo a ngɛ yayami he wami sisi.

english_verse: The Scriptures tell us, “No one is acceptable to God!
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ da; nɔ kake ngmelu po be.

english_verse: Not one of them understands or even searches for God.
translation_verse: Ní lelɔ ko be ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ hlaa Mawu se blɔ.

english_verse: They have all turned away and are worthless. There isn't one person who does right.
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo a tla blɔ; mɛ tsuo a puɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ kpakpa, nɔ kake ngmelu po be.

english_verse: Their words are like an open pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies. Each word is as deadly as the fangs of a snake,
translation_verse: A tuɔ munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ; se lɛ tsuo gbenɔ lɛ e kɛ baa. A munyu ngɛ kaa sanga duɔ.

english_verse: and they say nothing but bitter curses.
translation_verse: Gbiɛmi munyu nɛ kɛ nɔ woɔ haomi mi nɛ jeɔ a nya mi.

english_verse: These people quickly become violent.
translation_verse: A he sɔɔ kɛ muɔ si puemi.

english_verse: Wherever they go, they leave ruin and destruction.
translation_verse: He tsuaa he nɛ a be ngɛ ɔ, hɛ mi kpatami, kɛ kɔmɔ yemi a naa.

english_verse: They don't know how to live in peace.
translation_verse: A ha we nɛ nihi a he mi jɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: They don't even fear God.”
translation_verse: Mawu gbeye yemi ko kulaa be a hɛ mi.”

english_verse: We know that everything in the Law was written for those who are under its power. The Law says these things to stop anyone from making excuses and to let God show that the whole world is guilty.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, wa le kaa níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mlaa a mi ɔ, nihi nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ a he nɛ e kɔɔ. Lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nya jemi; je ɔ tsuo yeɔ fɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: God doesn't accept people simply because they obey the Law. No, indeed! All the Law does is to point out our sin. God's Way of Accepting People
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nɔ ko ye mlaa a nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa Mawu buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da; nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a tsuɔ ji kaa e haa nɔ leɔ kaa e pee yayami. Nɔ́ nɛ haa Mawu buu nɔ nɔ nɛ da

english_verse: Now we see how God does make us acceptable to him. The Law and the Prophets tell how we become acceptable, and it isn't by obeying the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu guu kɛ buu nɔ nɔ nɛ da a, e je tsɔɔ wɔ. Pi mlaa sane ji nɛ ɔ. Mose mlaa a, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ ye he odase.

english_verse: All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi tsuo pee yayami, nɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ bɔ mɛ.

english_verse: But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Se Mawu gu dloomi nɛ e kɛ haa je ɔ yaka a nɔ kɛ wo nihi tsuo nguɔ. E pee enɛ ɔ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɛ ha a ye a he ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: God sent Christ to be our sacrifice. Christ offered his life's blood, so by faith in him we could come to God. And God did this to show that in the past he was right to be patient and forgive sinners. This also shows that God is right when he accepts people who have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ Kristo ngɔ ha, konɛ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu nɛ ngɔ nihi nɛ he ye ɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ. Mawu pee enɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa dalɔ ji lɛ. Sa a, e to e tsui si ha nimli tsuo, nɛ e ku e hɛ fɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ; konɛ jehanɛ ɔ a na kaa nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ e peeɔ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ, Mawu woɔ lɛ nguɔ.

english_verse: What is left for us to brag about? Not a thing! Is it because we obeyed some law? No! It is because of faith.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛni nɔ wa maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ mɔ? Nɔ́ ko kulaa be kaa ja. Lɛɛ mɛni mɔ? Ní tsumi ngɛ mlaa a nya lo? Dɛbi! Yesu Kristo nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ mohu.

english_verse: We see that people are acceptable to God because they have faith, and not because they obey the Law.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa yɔse kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɔ a guu kɛ woɔ nɔ nguɔ, se pi ní tsumi nɛ a tsu ngɛ mlaa a nya.

english_verse: Does God belong only to the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is!
translation_verse: Anɛ Mawu ɔ, Yuda bi kɛkɛ a Mawu lo? Anɛ pi ma je li ɔmɛ hu a Mawu ji lɛ lo? Ee, ma je li ɔmɛ hu a Mawu ji lɛ.

english_verse: Do we destroy the Law by our faith? Not at all! We make it even more powerful.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ waa pɛtɛ hemi ke yemi he, nɛ waa ngmɛɛ mlaa a he lo? Pi ja kulaa! Mohu ɔ, wa gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ kɛ ngɛ nɔ mi mae kaa mlaa a hi.

english_verse: If he became acceptable to God because of what he did, then he would have something to brag about. But he would never be able to brag about it to God.
translation_verse: Ke ní nɛ e tsu nɔ a da kɛ wo lɛ nguɔ ɔ, lɛɛ jinɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ. Se ngɛ Mawu blɔ fa mi ɔ, Abraham be nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ e ma nyɛ maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.”
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Abraham he Mawu ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da.”

english_verse: Money paid to workers isn't a gift. It is something they earn by working.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko tsu ní ɔ, a woɔ lɛ hiɔ; hiɔwo ɔ, e gbo he dengme; pi dloomi nya nɛ e na lɛ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ nɔuu David hu ngɛ tsɔɔe be nɛ e tu nɔ nɛ Mawu buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da, nɛ pohu pi nɔ́ ko nɛ e tsu he je ɔ e gbaami he munyu ɔ nɛ. E de ke,

english_verse: “What a blessing when God forgives our sins and our evil deeds. What a blessing when the Lord erases our sins from his book.”
translation_verse: A gbaa nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ́ yayami ko ngɛ e he!”

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: Gbaami nɛ David tu he munyu ɔ, anɛ nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ kɛkɛ a nɔ lo? Dɛbi! Ni nɛmɛ a pui mɛ ɔ hu e kɔɔ a he. Ejakaa wa ngɛ dee ke, “Abraham he Mawu ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da.”

english_verse: But when did this happen? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? Of course, it was before.
translation_verse: Mɛni be mi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi? Loko a po Abraham, aloo benɛ a po lɛ ɔ se? Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi loko a po lɛ.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Pomi nɛ a po lɛ ɔ ji okadi ko kɛkɛ nɛ maa nɔ mi kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Abraham ngɛ he je ɔ, Mawu he lɛ momo kaa nɔ nɛ da, be mi nɛ a na we nɛ a po lɛ tete. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ, nɛ pohu a pui mɛ, nɛ Mawu buu mɛ dali ɔ, Abraham peeɔ a tsɛ.

english_verse: This also makes Abraham the father of everyone who is circumcised and has faith in God, as Abraham did before he was circumcised. The Promise Is for All Who Have Faith
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔuu kɛ̃ e peeɔ nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ a tsɛ; pi ngɛ pomi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ kɛkɛ he, se mohu kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa tsɛ Abraham hɛɛ mi benɛ a na we nɛ a po lɛ tete ɔ, a hɛɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔuu mi. Abraham he Mawu siwo ɔ ye

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Pi mlaa a nɔ nɛ Abraham ye ɔ he nɛ Mawu wo lɛ si kaa e kɛ e nina maa ye je ɔ nɔ ɔ, se mohu akɛnɛ e he Mawu ye, nɛ Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da a he.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nihi nɛ mlaa a nɔ pɛ a yeɔ ɔ, mɛ hu gbosi ní yeli ji mɛ ɔ, lɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ peeɔ yaka, nɛ siwo ɔ hu se nami be he.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mlaa a kɛ Mawu mi mi la baa; he nɛ mlaa be ɔ, nɔ ko tɔ we mlaa hulɔ.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abraham hemi kɛ yemi nɔ Mawu da kɛ wo si ɔ. Mawu pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ siwo ɔ nɛ ba pee dloomi nɔ́ ko nɛ a fi kɛ fɔ nɔ kpɛii kɛ ha Abraham nina tsuo. Pi kɛ ha nihi nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ mɛ hu a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi kpɛii kaa bɔ nɛ Abraham he ye ɔ, ejakaa Abraham ji wɔ tsuo wa tsɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Ma pee mo je mahi babauu a tsɛ.” Mawu ɔ nɛ Abraham he ye ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ si nɛ e wo ɔ maa ba mi. Lɛ ji Mawu nɛ tleɔ ni gbogboehi si kɛ baa wami mi ekohu; nɔ́ nɛ bɛ je mi hyɛ po, e haa e baa.

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: E yi mi pee we lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ ngɛ si nɛ Mawu wo lɛ ɔ he; se mohu e hemi kɛ yemi ha lɛ he wami he, nɛ e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Abraham he ye wawɛɛ kaa si nɛ Mawu wo lɛ ɔ, e maa ye nɔ.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: Munyu “A bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da” a, pi lɛ nɔ kake e he nɛ a ngma ngɛ.

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: Se mohu e kɔɔ wɔ hu wa he, wɔ nihi nɛ a maa wo wɔ nguɔ ja nɔuu ɔ; ejakaa nɔ nɛ tle wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, wa heɔ lɛ yeɔ.

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ Kristo kɛ ha nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he; nɛ a tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu, konɛ e kɛ wo wɔ nguɔ.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ɔ, Mawu wo wɔ nguɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, he jɔmi ba waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: Si himi nɛ wa ngɛ mi amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu dloomi nya nɛ wa na kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ ɔ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa fĩaa, ejakaa wa nine maa su Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ ha we nɛ zo gbeɔ wɔ, ejakaa kɛ gu Mumi klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ha wa tsui hyi tɔ kɛ e suɔmi ɔ.

english_verse: Christ died for us at a time when we were helpless and sinful.
translation_verse: Ejakaa be nɛ sa mi, be mi nɛ peepee ta wa he ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ yayami peeli a he.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e maa wa kaa nɔ ko maa suɔ nɛ e gbo ngɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ he; pohu nɔmlɔ kpakpa he ɔ, e maa ba mi kaa nɔ ko ma si gugue kaa e ma gbo.

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: Se suɔmi kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ Mawu je kpo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa be nɛ wa ji yayami peeli ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ wa he.

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ ɔ nɛ a gu Kristo muɔ nɛ pue si ɔ nɔ wo wɔ nguɔ ɔ, a maa gu e nɔ hluu tsɔ kɛ kpɔ wɔ kɛ je Mawu mi mi la a mi.

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: Jinɛ sa a, Mawu he nyɛli ji wɔ, se kɛ gu e Bi ɔ gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a kpata waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ a kpata waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti ɔ, e ma he wa yi wami hluu tsɔ ngɛ e Bi ɔ wami ɔ mi.

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se wa fĩaa fɔɔ Mawu nɔ kaa kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e ha nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, a kpata waa kɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ wa kpɛti. Slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ Adam kɛ Kristo a kpɛti

english_verse: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.
translation_verse: Nɔ kake lɛ pee yayami, nɛ yayami kɛ gbenɔ ba. Enɛ ɔ ha gbenɔ sã nimli tsuo, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ pee yayami.

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Yayami ngɛ je ɔ mi loko mlaa a ba; se be nɛ mlaa be ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko pee we yayami he akɔtaa.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: Se kɛ je Adam yi nɔ kɛ ba si Mose yi nɔ ɔ, gbenɔ kpata nimli adesahi a hɛ mi wawɛɛ; pohu nimli nɛ ɔmɛ pee we yayami kaa Adam nɛ lɛɛ e tɔ mlaa a nɛ a wo lɛ ɔ tete ɔ. Adam ji nɔ nɛ maa ba a he okadi.

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: Se Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ slo kulaa ngɛ yayami nɛ Adam pee ɔ he. Ejakaa yayami nɛ Adam pee ɔ ha nihi babauu gbo lɛɛ, se Mawu dloomi ɔ, kɛ nɔke nɔ́ nɛ a gu Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nɔ ha wɔ ɔ hiɛ hluu tsɔ kɛ ha nihi tsuo.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ slo kulaa ngɛ si gbeemi nɛ yayami nɛ Adam pee ɔ kɛ ba a he. Ejakaa nɛ Adam pee yayami ɔ, a kojo lɛ, nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ; se lɔ ɔ se ɔ, yayami babauu nɛ nihi pee ɔ, nɔke nɔ́ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu wo nihi tsuo nguɔ.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke yayami nɛ nɔ kake pee ɔ, ha gbenɔ kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a nine su Mawu dloomi ɔ nɔ, nɛ Mawu gu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ nɔ bu mɛ nihi nɛ da a, Kristo ma ha a na neneene wami hluu tsɔ.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ yayami kake he ɔ, a bu nihi tsuo fɔ ɔ, jã nɔuu kpakpa kake he ɔ, Mawu maa wo nihi tsuo nguɔ, nɛ a ma he a yi wami.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ nihi babauu ba pee yayami peeli ngɛ nɔ kake tue gbomi he ɔ, jã kɛ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ kake e tue nɛ e bu ɔ he ɔ, Mawu maa bu nihi tsuo dali.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: A wo mlaa a hulɔ, konɛ wa yɔse yayami ɔmɛ babauu; se he nɛ yayami hiɛ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ Mawu dloomi ɔ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ babauu.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ yayami ye tsɛ kɛ gu gbenɔ nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu Mawu dloomi ɔ ngɛ tsɛ yee kɛ gu dami nɔ; nɛ kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, wa ma na neneene wami.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Anɛ waa ya nɔ waa hi yayami pee, konɛ Mawu nɛ hi wɔ mɔbɔ nae daa lo?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ yayami be a nɔ he wami hu. Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ wa maa hi yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa le kaa wɔ nihi abɔ nɛ a sɔle wɔ kɛ wo Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, wa gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo ɔ gbo ɔ.

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛ a sɔle wɔ ɔ, wa gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, nɛ a pu waa kɛ lɛ tsuo, konɛ bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tle Kristo si ngɛ nyami mi ɔ, wɔ hu wa na wami he.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke wa gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, jã kɛ̃ a ma tle wɔ si kaa bɔ nɛ a tle Kristo si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Wa le enɛ ɔ, kaa a sɛu wa nɔmlɔ tso momo ɔ ngɔ piɛ Kristo he, konɛ nɔmlɔ tso su nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ hɛ mi nɛ kpata, nɛ wa ko ye nyɔguɛ ha yayami hu.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, e kɛ yayami gba mi.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Ke waa kɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa waa kɛ lɛ ma na wami hulɔ.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa le kaa a tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e be gboe hu; niinɛ, gbenɔ be e nɔ he wami ko kulaa hu.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Kristo gbo ngɛ adesa he yayami he si kake nyɔngloo. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ, nɛ e kɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu nyɛɛ bu nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ gbo ngɛ yayami peemi blɔ fa mi; se ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ nyɛ hɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ gboɔ ɔ nɔ hu. Nyɛ ko di nɔmlɔ tso ɔ we akɔnɔ níhi a se.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní komɛ kɛ pee yayami hu. Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Mawu. Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa nihi nɛ a tle mɛ si kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi. Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Mawu, konɛ e ngɔ nyɛ kɛ tsu níhi nɛ da.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ hu; ejakaa mlaa nɛ fiɔ nɔ ɔ, be nyɛ nɔ he wami hu; Mawu dloomi ɔ mohu lɛ hɛɛ nyɛ. E sa kaa wa pee nɔ́ nɛ da

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ? Ke mlaa ko fí wɔ, se Mawu dloomi ɔ lɛ hɛɛ wɔ ɔ, lɛɛ waa ya nɔ waa pee yayami lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ha nɔ ko nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ, yayami nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi ɔ jio, Mawu tue bumi nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a jio, nyɛ peeɔ nyɔguɛ kɛ ha lɛ lo?

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Se wa naa Mawu si! Jinɛ sa a, yayami ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ Mawu sɔmɔe. Ní nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Mawu ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ nyɛ ba bɔni nɔ́ nɛ da peemi.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: I ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ to nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ je mi bami he, ejakaa gbɔjɔmi ngɛ nyɛ he. Sa a, yayami ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní ɔmɛ kɛ tsu mu ní kɛ pee yayami gbegbeegbe; jã kɛ̃ jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee níhi nɛ da, konɛ nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ yayami ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, nyɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ da.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ nyɛ pee, nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ a he ngɛ nyɛ zo pee ɔ, mɛni se nyɛ na kɛ je mi? Nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ mi ji gbenɔ!

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je yayami dɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ba pee e nyɔguɛhi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ba pee nihi nɛ a he tsɔ, nɛ neneene wami fɔɔ si ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Ejakaa yayami he hiɔwo ji gbenɔ; se Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ ji neneene wami nɛ wa naa ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ le mlaa a; nɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔmlɔ adesa wami be mi nɛ mlaa fiɔ lɛ lo?

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Waa ngɔ gba si himi kaa nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́; yogbayo ɔ, mlaa fiɔ lɛ kɛ mɛtɛɛ e huno he be mi nɛ nyumu ɔ ngɛ je mi; se ke nyumu ɔ gbo ɔ, gba sihi mi mlaa ko be nɛ fiɔ yo ɔ kɛ mɛtɛɔ nyumu ɔ he hu.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e huno ɔ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ e ya gba nɔ kpa a, e puɛ gba. Se ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, lɛɛ mlaa fi we lɛ; nɛ ke e ya gba nyumu kpa a, e puɛ we gba.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ sane ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ mlaa fi we nyɛ hu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ a tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ nihi, konɛ wɔ tsuo waa wo yiblii ha Mawu.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Ejakaa be nɛ wa hi si ngɛ he lo nya a, waa kɛ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsu akɔnɔ ní yayamihi nɛ mlaa a tleɔ si ngɛ wa mi ɔ, nɛ waa kɛ wo yiblii ha gbenɔ.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ lɛɛ wa ye wa he kɛ je mlaa a dɛ mi. Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ mlaa nɛ fiɔ wɔ ɔ be wa nɔ he wami hu. Wa tsu we mlaa momo ɔ nɛ a ngma a nya ní hu. Se mohu blɔ he nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nya wa sɔmɔɔ ngɛ. Mlaa kɛ nɔ woɔ yayami peemi mi

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de ngɛ mlaa a he kɛɛ? Mlaa a, nɔ́ yayami ji lɛ lo? Dɛbi! Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ke pi mlaa a he ɔ, i ko li nɔ́ nɛ ji yayami. Ejakaa jinɛ i li nɔ́ nɛ ji hɛkɔ, ke pi mlaa a nɛ de ke, “O hɛ ko kɔ̃ o nyɛmi nɔ.”

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Se mlaa a nɛ a wo ɔ na he blɔ gu yayami nɔ nɛ e kɛ tle akɔnɔ ní yayamihi si ngɛ ye mi. Ejakaa ke mlaa a be ɔ, yayami hu gbo.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ hu, i hi si hyɛ nɛ i li mlaa; se benɛ mlaa a ba a, e tle yayami si wawɛɛ ngɛ ye mi, nɛ e ba pee gbenɔ ha mi.

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: Mlaa a nɛ jinɛ e sa kaa e ko ngɔ wami kɛ ba a, e ba pee gbenɔ mohu ha mi.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Yayami ná he blɔ, nɛ e gu mlaa nɔ kɛ sisi mi, nɛ e gbe mi.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mlaa a ngɛ klɔuklɔu, kita a hu ngɛ klɔuklɔu; e da, nɛ e hi hulɔ.

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa mlaa a mumi mi nɔ, se imi lɛɛ nɔmlɔ adesa kɛkɛ ji mi, nɛ yayami he mi nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ, i li. Nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ kaa ma pee ɔ, i pee we lɔ ɔ; se nɔ́ nɛ i sume ɔ, lɔ ɔ mohu i peeɔ.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ́ nɛ i sume ɔ nɔuu mohu i peeɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e tsɔɔ kaa imi hu i kplɛɛ kaa mlaa a hi.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Ke jã a, lɛɛ pi imi nitsɛ nɛ i tsuɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ hu, se mohu yayami su nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ lɛ ngɛ ní tsue.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: I le kaa nɔ́ kpakpa ko be ye he lo su ɔ mi. Ejakaa nɔ́ kpakpa jloɔ mi nɛ ma pee, se i nyɛ we.

english_verse: Instead of doing what I know is right, I do wrong.
translation_verse: Kpakpa nɛ i suɔ kaa ma pee ɔ, i pee we; se yayami nɛ i sume ɔ, lɔ ɔ mohu i peeɔ.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ́ nɛ imi nitsɛ i sume ɔ nɔuu i peeɔ ɔ, lɛɛ pi imi nitsɛ nɛ i ngɛ yayami ɔ pee mɔ, se yayami su nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ mohu lɛ haa nɛ i peeɔ yayami ɔ.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɛ i naa nɛ ngɛ ní tsue kaa mlaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ke i to kaa ma pee kpakpa a, kɛkɛ i ya pee yayami mohu.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Ngɛ ye tsui mi ɔ, i suɔ Mawu mlaa a saminya.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, fɔ bumi ko be ha mɛ hu.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa ngɛ Kristo mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ, haa wa yeɔ wa he; nɛ yayami, kɛ gbenɔ be wa nɔ he wami hu.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Yayami nɛ adesa peeɔ ɔ, Mawu sume kulaa, se nɔmlɔ adesa gbɔjɔmi ɔ he je ɔ, mlaa a nyɛ we nɛ e pee he nɔ ko. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e Bi ɔ kɛ ba ngɛ he lo su nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ mi, konɛ e ba je wɔ kɛ je yayami dɛ mi.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ baa a je mi ngɛ he lo nya a, he lo mi níhi a he a susuu. Se nihi nɛ baa a je mi ngɛ mumi ɔ blɔ tsɔɔmi nya a, mumi mi níhi a he a susuu.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: He lo nya níhi a he juɛmi ɔ kɛ gbenɔ baa, se mumi mi níhi a he juɛmi ɔ haa nɔ wami, kɛ he jɔmi.

english_verse: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ susuɔ he lo mi níhi a he ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu nyɛe, ejakaa e bui Mawu mlaa a; pohu e be nɔ nyɛe maa ye tete.

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ he lo nya ní ɔ, a be nyɛe maa sa Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, he lo ɔ be nyɛ nɔ he wami; mumi ɔ mohu lɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ. Ke nɔ ko be Kristo mumi ɔ, pi Kristo nɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Se ke Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, yayami nɛ nyɛ peeɔ he ɔ, nyɛ gbo ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi, se mumi mi lɛɛ nyɛ hɛ ngɛ, ejakaa Mawu buu nyɛ nihi nɛ da.

english_verse: Yet God raised Jesus to life! God's Spirit now lives in you, and he will raise you to life by his Spirit.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu nɛ tle Yesu si kɛ je gbeje ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ mumi ɔ nɛ e kɛ tle Kristo si ɔ ma ha nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ gboɔ ɔ ma na wami.

english_verse: My dear friends, we must not live to satisfy our desires.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, sane tloo wɔ, se pi he lo nya nɔ́ ko nɛ wa maa hi si ja.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nyɛ peeɔ he lo nya níhi ɔ, nyɛ ma gbo; se ke Mawu mumi ɔ ha nyɛ kpa níhi nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔ ɔ tsumi ɔ, nyɛ yi ma na wami.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ ɔ, mɛ ji Mawu bimɛ.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Mawu ha we nyɛ mumi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nyɔguɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma pa hi gbeye yee; se mohu e peeɔ nyɛ Mawu bimɛ. Mumi ɔ lɛ woɔ wɔ he wami, nɛ wa nyɛɔ faa kue kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Tsaatsɛ! Tsaatsɛ!”

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Mawu mumi ɔ nitsɛ kɛ wɔ hu wa mumi ɔ yeɔ odase kaa Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ ɔ, wa peeɔ Mawu we ní yeli hulɔ, nihi nɛ a kɛ Kristo maa dla ní. Ee, ke waa kɛ Kristo na nɔ́ ɔ, a maa wo waa kɛ lɛ tsuo wa hɛ mi nyami. Hɛ mi nyami nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: I le anɔkuale mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ nae amlɔ nɛ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ a kɛ maa to wa hɛ mi nyami nɛ Mawu maa wo hwɔɔ se ɔ he.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Adebɔ níhi tsuo to a tsui si kɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ kaa Mawu ma ha nɛ a na e bimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, adebɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kɛmɛmi nɔ kaa yo nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃e nɛ e ma fɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Se pi mɛ kɛkɛ, mohu wɔ nitsɛmɛ tete nɛ wa ná mumi ɔ yiblii ɔ, wɔ hu ja nɔuu wa hii kɛmɛmi nɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ wa mi, be mi nɛ wa ngɛ Mawu blɔ hyɛe kaa e pee wɔ e bimɛ kɛ pi si, konɛ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ ye e he kulaa.

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Se ke wa ngɛ nɔ́ ko blɔ hyɛe, nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ kaa wa nine maa su nɔ ɔ, wa toɔ wa tsui si.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu, ke wa gbede ɔ, mumi ɔ piɛɔ wa he. Ejakaa ke wa ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, wa li nɔ́ tutuutu nɛ sa kaa wa deɔ. Mumi ɔ nitsɛ daa mi ha wɔ kɛ kɔmɔ yemi nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ le adesahi tsuo a yi mi ɔ lɛ le nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ deɔ, ejakaa pɛɛ nɛ mumi ɔ kpaa ha ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ saa Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Wa le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, Mawu piɛɔ nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ a he, konɛ e hi ha mɛ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ nɛ to e yi mi, nɛ e tsɛ mɛ.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ Mawu hla ngɔ to momo ɔ, e pee mɛ klɔuklɔu, konɛ a subai nɛ hi kaa Bi ɔ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Bi ɔ maa pee nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ babauu a kpɛti.

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he mɔ? Ke Mawu ngɛ wa se ɔ, mɛnɔ maa te si ngɔ wo wɔ?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ klɔɛ e Bi ɔ he, se mohu e ngɔ lɛ kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ wɔ nimli adesahi tsuo wa he ɔ, anɛ e be níhi tsuo ngɔe kɛ piɛ he ha wɔ lo?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, mɛnɔ maa po a nya? Mawu nitsɛ lɛ woɔ nɔ nguɔ.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɛnɔ lɛ buɔ nɔ fɔ mɔ? Yesu Kristo loo? Yesu Kristo lɛɛ e gbo; se nɔ́ nɛ pe lɔ ɔ, Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi; nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ mi dae ha wɔ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ma gba wɔ kɛ maa je suɔmi nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi? Haomi loo, nɔ nami loo, yi mi wami loo, hwɔ loo, oslã loo, aloo klaate?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “O he ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ ɔ, wa ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi; a buɔ wɔ kaa tohi nɛ a yaa gbe.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ haa wa yeɔ kunimi babauu.

english_verse: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future,
translation_verse: Ejakaa i ngɛ nɔ mi mami kaa gbenɔ jio, wami jio, hiɔwe bɔfohi jio, nɔ yeli kpa komɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe jio, níhi nɛ ngɛ jio, níhi nɛ maa ba jio, he wami kpa ko jio,

english_verse: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!
translation_verse: hiɔwe lokoo jio, zugba sisi jio, níhi nɛ a bɔ ɔ a mi eko jio, Mawu suɔmi nɛ wa na ngɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko be nyɛe ma gba wɔ kɛ maa je mi.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Anɔkuale i ngɛ tue ngɛ Kristo mi, nɛ ye he nile maa nɔ mi ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, i yi lakpa.

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.
translation_verse: I yeɔ tsui, nɛ i yeɔ kɔmɔ hu babauu

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: ngɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he. Ye weku li ji mɛ ngɛ he lo nya, nɛ i ko suɔ kaa ngɛ mɛɛ a he ɔ, a bu mi musutsɛ, nɛ a po mi kɛ je Kristo he.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Mɛ ji Israel bi; nɛ Mawu nitsɛ nɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ pee e ma; e wo a hɛ mi nyami, e kɛ mɛ so, nɛ e ha mɛ mlaa a; e tsɔɔ mɛ jami blɔ nya tomi, nɛ mɛ nɔuu nɛ e wo si ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: A mi nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je, nɛ Kristo ɔ tete a nina ji lɛ ngɛ he lo nya. Kristo ɔ ji Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ yeɔ nihi tsuo a nɔ ɔ nɛ. A je e yi kɛ ya neneene! Amen.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: I tsɔɔ we kaa Mawu siwo ɔ peeɔ yaka. Ejakaa pi Israel ma a tsuo ji Israel bi anɔkuale mi.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa pi Abraham bimɛ nɛ e fɔ ngɛ he lo nya a ji Mawu bimɛ. Se mohu si nɛ a wo Abraham ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, mɛ ji Abraham nina.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Mawu wo Abraham si ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha a, ma kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu, nɛ o yo Sara ma fɔ binyumu.”

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, Rebeka bimɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, e kɛ wa tsɛ Isak kake ɔ nɔuu nɛ fɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.
translation_verse: e de Rebeka ke, “Nɔkɔtɔma a ma sɔmɔ jokuɛ ɔ,” konɛ e ko ba mi kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ e tsu he, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɛ mɛ ɔ lɛ pee.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “I je suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Yakob, se Esau lɛɛ i nyɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Are we saying God is unfair? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Mawu yeɔ sane kpɛkpɛɛ lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke Mawu de Egipt matsɛ ɔ ke, “I wo mo tsɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma je ye he wami kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mo, konɛ o wo ye biɛ ta ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa e maa na lɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, e naa lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ e suɔ kaa e wa tue ɔ, e haa e waa tue. Mawu gblaa nɔ tue, nɛ e naa nɔ mɔbɔ hulɔ

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti nɔ ko ma bi mi ke, “Mɛni he je Mawu piaa wɔ mɔ? Nɔ́ nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e maa pee ɔ, anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ tsi nya lo?”

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Se mo nɔmlɔ adesa, mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o ma de Mawu ke nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ dɛ? Anɛ buɛ ma de nɔ nɛ puɛ lɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni he je o puɛ mi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Anɛ kaa Mawu suɔ nɛ a le bɔ nɛ e mi mi la ngɛ, kɛ e he wami ɔ, jinɛ e ko kpata nihi nɛ woɔ e mi mi la a a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Se e to e tsui si babauu ha mɛ.

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nihi nɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ ɔ nɛ a le bɔ nɛ e to momo kaa e maa wo a hɛ mi nyami babauu ha.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mawu de ngɛ Hosea womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nihi nɛ a tsɛɔ mɛ ‘Piyemajinyɛ’ ɔ, ma de mɛ ke ‘Ye ma ji nyɛ.’ Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɔ lɛ ‘Asumemo’ ɔ ma je suɔmi kpo ha lɛ.”

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: “Nɛ e maa ba mi kaa he nɛ a ma de mɛ ngɛ ke, ‘Pi ye ma ji nyɛ’ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ma tsɛ mɛ ngɛ ke, ‘Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ bimɛ.’ ”

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Yesaya hu kpa ngmlaa kɛ de ngɛ Israel he ke, “Ke Israel bi hiɛ kaa wo nya zia tete po ɔ, nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ pɛ a yi wami a ma he.

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he maa sɔ kɛ kojo je ɔ tsuo.”

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ Yesaya de to momo ɔ, “Ke pi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Ope ɔ nɛ ha wa nina a eko piɛ ɔ, jinɛ wa ní ko pee kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora pɛ.” Sane kpakpa a ngɛ kɛ ha Israel hulɔ

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ jinɛ a, kaa a bu mɛ nihi nɛ da a, a bu mɛ ni nɛ da ejakaa a he Mawu ye.

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: Kɛ ba kɛɛ? A nine sui nɔ, ejakaa a hla we lɛ kɛ hemi kɛ yemi. A susu kaa kɛ gu ní tsumihi a nɔ nɛ a ma na lɛ. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a pee kaa nihi nɛ a ngɔ tɛ ngɔ fɔ blɔ mi ha mɛ nɛ a tɛ.

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Hyɛ, i ngɔ tɛ kɛ ngɛ si mae ngɛ Zion; e ma ha nihi ma tɛ si; e ji tɛ sa nɛ maa tsɛ̃ mɛ ngɔ fia si. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ tɛ nɛ ɔ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, pɛɛ nɛ i kpaa Mawu daa kɛ jeɔ ye tsui mi kɛ haa Israel bi ji kaa a he a yi wami.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Blɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu guu kɛ buu nɔ nɔ nɛ da a, a li, nɛ a hlaa kaa a ma wo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a blɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔɛ a he ngɔ ha we Mawu, konɛ e bu mɛ nihi nɛ da.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo po mlaa a mi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, Mawu wo lɛ nguɔ. Yi wami hemi ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ Mose ngma ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ a buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da ngɛ mlaa a nɔ nɛ e yeɔ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ fitsofitso ɔ, e yi ma na wami.”

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Se kaa nɔmlɔ adesa ma he Mawu ye nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da a, nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ he ji, “Ko de ngɛ o tsui mi ke, Mɛnɔ maa kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe?”

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Se kɛ e deɔ kɛɛ? “Munyu nɛ Mawu tu ɔ ngɛ o ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; o le, nɛ e ngɛ o tsui mi.” Jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Ke o kɛ o nya jaje ke “Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔmtsɛ,” nɛ o he ye ngɛ o tsui mi kaa Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, a ma he o yi wami.

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.
translation_verse: Ejakaa tsui a kɛ heɔ yeɔ loko Mawu woɔ nɔ nguɔ; nɛ ke waa kɛ wa nya jaje ɔ, a ma he wa yi wami.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Slɔɔto ko be Yuda no kɛ ma je no a kpɛti, ejakaa a ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ kake, nɛ e mi hi saminya ha nihi tsuo nɛ kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Se kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ nɔ nɛ a he we lɛ yi ɔ? Nɛ kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma he nɔ nɛ a nui e he sane ɔ ye? Jehanɛ hu kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a maa nu, ke nɔ ko fiɛ we ha mɛ?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Nɛ kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nihi maa fiɛ, ke a tsɔ we mɛ? Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ he jɔmi sane kpakpa a fiɛli a nanehi ngɛ fɛu ha.”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, pi Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ he sane kpakpa a. Ejakaa Yesaya de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa sane ɔ, mɛnɔ he ye?”

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Se i ngɛ bie ke, Anɛ a nui sɛ gbi ɔ lo? Anɔkuale, a nu, ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “A gbi jije kɛ ho zugba a tsuo nɔ ya; Nɛ a sɛ gbi ɔ ya su je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: I ngɛ bie ekohu ke anɛ Israel li lo? Mose ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ he nɔ ke, “Ma ha nyɛ maa je je ma ko nɛ a bui lɛ kulaa he hunga; Nɛ i kɛ ma kɛ e mi kuasiahi sɔuu maa wo nyɛ mi mi la.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Yesaya hu kɛ kã de ke, “I ha nihi nɛ hla we mi ɔ na mi, Nɛ nihi nɛ bi we ye si ɔ, i je ye he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ.”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Se Israel lɛɛ Yesaya de ngɛ e he ke, “Daa nɛ ɔ, i gbɛ ye gugue mi nɛ ma he nyɛ atuu; Ma tue gboli nɛ a tsui kplii!”

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ bie ke anɛ Mawu kua lɛ nitsɛ e ma a lo? Dɛbi! Mawu kua we e ma a. Imi nitsɛ hu Israel no ji mi; Abraham nina ji mi, nɛ i je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Mawu kua we e ma nɛ e hla blema lokoo ɔ. Tse nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ Eliya yi nɔ benɛ Eliya po Israel nya ha Mawu ke,

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: “Nyɔmtsɛ, a gbe o gbali ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a ywia o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ imi nɔ kake nɛ piɛ, nɛ a ngɛ imi hu hlae nɛ a gbe” ɔ.

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ? Israel nine sui nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ nɔ. Nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nine su nɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ a wa tue.

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nihi bɔɔ piɛ nɛ Mawu hla mɛ ngɛ dloomi nya.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke dloomi nya a, lɛɛ pi ní tsumi ko nɛ a tsu he hu. Kaa ní tsumi ko nɛ a tsu he ɔ, jinɛ dloomi ɔ pi dloomi hu.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mawu ha nɛ a pee kaa nihi nɛ lu; kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ hɛngmɛ ji nɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́; nɛ a ngɛ tue hulɔ, se a kɛ nui nɔ́.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: David hu de ke, “Ke a tsɛ ní yemi ɔ, ha nɛ e pee klama nɛ du mɛ; a nɔɔ si nɛ a gbla a tue.

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: A hɛngmɛ nɛ ma, nɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ́; a se tso nɛ kpɛ daa.”

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i ngɛ bie ke, nɛ a tɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔ si ɔ, a nɔ gbidii nɛ a ti hu lo? Dɛbi! A si gbeemi ɔ bli blɔ ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ a he a yi wami. Enɛ ɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ je mɛ hunga.

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Ma je li, jehanɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu. Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ ní tsue kaa bɔfo ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, ma tsu kɛ gɛjɛmi.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke Mawu kua Yuda bi ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he a dla Mawu kɛ je ɔ a kpɛti ɔ, lɛɛ ke e kpale he mɛ ekohu ɔ, kɛ níhi maa hi kɛɛ? E maa pee kaa nɔ nɛ gbo, nɛ a kpale tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Ke má bɔbɔyoo nɛ a ti kɛ sã bɔ ha Mawu ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, lɛɛ má a tsuo ngɛ klɔuklɔu. Jã kɛ̃ ke tso sipoku ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, tso kɔni ɔmɛ hu peeɔ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Oliv tso nɛ a je blɔ du ɔ, ke a kplɔ e kɔni ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nɛ a ya ngɔ mo oliv tso nɛ mo nitsɛ lo puɛ ngɛ nga mi ba ta tso ɔ he, nɛ o naa oliv tso sipoku ɔ mi niye ní ɔ eko ɔ,

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: koo fĩa kaa o pe jamɛ a kɔni ɔmɛ nɛ a kplɔɔ ɔ. Ke o maa fĩa a, o hɛ nɛ hi o he nɔ kaa pi mo nɛ o hɛɛ sipoku ɔ, se mohu sipoku ɔ nɛ hɛɛ mo.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ eko ɔ, o ma de ke, “A kplɔ kɔnihi, konɛ a ngɔ mi ngɔ ta tso ɔ he.”

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Saminya! Hemi nɛ a he we yi he je nɛ a po mɛ; nɛ moo lɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi o kɛ daa si ɔ nɛ. O yi ko fu, se mohu o hɛ nɛ hi o he nɔ.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke Mawu baa we tso ɔ nitsɛ kɔni ɔmɛ a yi ɔ, eko ɔ, mohu e be o yi baae.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ kaa Mawu mi mi hi, se e sane wa hulɔ. Nihi nɛ gbee si ɔ, e kɛ mɛ to ní; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e mi mi jɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ ya nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ke pi jaa, a ma kplɔ nyɛ kɛ pue si ja nɔuu.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ hu, ke a tsake nɛ a ba he ye jehanɛ ɔ, a maa kpale mɛ kɛ ta tso ɔ he ekohu, ejakaa Mawu ma nyɛ pee enɛ ɔ hluu tsɔ.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Nɛ pohu hyɛ kaa oliv tso nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e puɛ ngɛ nga nɔ, nɛ a po mo ngɛ he, nɛ a kɛ ba ta oliv tso nɛ a je blɔ du ɔ he ɔ, e pee pɛ. Kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pɔɛ he. Lɛɛ oliv tso ɔ nɛ a je blɔ du ɔ nitsɛ e kɔnihi nɛ a kplɔ ɔ, e be wae kulaa kaa a maa kpale ngɔ mɛ kɛ ta tso ɔ he ekohu. Mawu naa nihi tsuo mɔbɔ

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, anɔkuale laami sane ko ngɛ nɛ i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko susu kaa nyɛ hɛ mi lɛ tɛ̃. Sane ɔ ji kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, pe a ha a wa tue be kuku kɛkɛ kɛ yaa si ma je li ɔmɛ tsuo ma ba le Mawu.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma he Israel tsuo yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke, “Yi wami helɔ ɔ maa je Zion kɛ ba; e ma ha Yakob nina a ma kpa musu bɔmi.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Nɛ somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa so ji kaa a ma kpa yayami tsuo peemi.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Ngɛ sane kpakpa a blɔ fa mi ɔ, nyɛ he ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ peeɔ Mawu he nyɛli. Se akɛnɛ e hla a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ momo he je ɔ, Mawu suɔ mɛ.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke Mawu tsɛ nɔ ko nɛ e gbaa lɛ ɔ, e tsakee we e yi mi hu.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ma je li, sa a, nyɛ bui Mawu, se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu na nyɛ mɔbɔ, ejakaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ hu ba gbo tue.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Mawu ha nɛ nihi tsuo pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ngɛ tue gbomi he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na mɛ tsuo mɔbɔ. Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu yi

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Niatsɛ mi niatsɛ ji Mawu! Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e nile, kɛ juɛmi hiɛ ha! Mɛnɔ le bɔ nɛ e toɔ e yi mi ha? Blɔ nɔ nɛ e guu kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, mɛnɔ le?

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mɛnɔ lɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ juɛmi, aloo mɛnɔ lɛ wo lɛ ga hyɛ?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ha lɛ nɔ ko hyɛ, nɛ e hia kaa e to lɛ nane mi?”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu lɛ bɔ níhi tsuo; lɛ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ; nɛ mɛ tsuo a woɔ e hɛ mi nyami kɛ yaa neneene! Amen!

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ ye nyɛmimɛ, Mawu na nyɛ mɔbɔ babauu, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha kaa bɔ nɛ a sã, se kɛ̃ e hɛ ngɛ, nɛ e he tsɔ, nɛ e saa Mawu hɛ mi; nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ wami tsuo nɛ sɔmɔ Mawu, konɛ nyɛ jami ɔ nɛ pee ngɛ mumi mi.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ba nyɛ je mi kaa je mi bi ɔmɛ hu; se mohu nyɛ ha Mawu nɛ tsake nyɛ juɛmi, konɛ nyɛ yɔse níhi nɛ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ní kpakpahi nɛ sa e hɛ mi saminya, nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: I kɛ dloomi nɛ Mawu dloo mi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsuo dee ke, nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó bu lɛ nitsɛ e he tsɔ pe bɔ nɛ sa kaa e buu e he. Se mohu e pee e he humi kaa bɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e pee ɔ.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ e he níhi fuu, se e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo tsuɔ ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he.

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃ wɔ nimli babauu nɛ ɔ, wa peeɔ nɔmlɔ tso kake ngɛ Kristo mi, nɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nike ní slɔɔtohi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo wɔ ɔ, e sa kaa wa tsu a he ní saminya. Ke gbami ji wa nike ní ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ngɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ kɛ tsu he ní.

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: Ke a ha wɔ he wami nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔ, wa sɔmɔ; ke ní tsɔɔmi ɔ, wa tsɔɔ.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Ke wa nɔ́ ji kaa waa tu munyu kɛ wo nyɛmimɛ he wami ɔ, waa wo mɛ he wami. Nɔ nɛ maa ke ní ɔ, e pee kɛ bua jɔmi. Hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ, e tsu ní ɔ wawɛɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ naa mɔbɔ ɔ, e pee kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Suɔmi ɔ, e je nyɛ tsui mi tɔɔ. Nyɛɛ nyɛ yayami kulaa; nɛ nyɛɛ pɛtɛ nɔ́ kpakpa he.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he saminya kaa nyɛmimɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bu e nyɛmi pe lɛ nitsɛ e he.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko pee hejɔ, mohu nyɛɛ kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ tsu ní. Nyɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ. Ke haomi ba a, nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si nɛ nyɛɛ hi sɔlee daa.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye bua mɛ; nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nibwɔ peemi he mɔde.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ, nyɛ kpa Mawu pɛɛ ha mɛ; nyɛ ko gbiɛ mɛ.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ nɛ nya; nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ya foe ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ nɛ fo.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko pee nɔ ko yayami kɛ to yayami nane mi. Nyɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ a na kaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da pee.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: Ye huɛmɛ, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he lue, se mohu nyɛɛ ngmɛ Mawu blɔ nɛ e kɛ e mi mi la nɛ pee. Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Ye nɔ ji lue yemi; Imi ma pee kɛ to nane mi. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ ya nɔ de ɔ, “Ke hwɔ ngɛ o he nyɛlɔ yee ɔ, ha lɛ ní nɛ e ye; nɛ ke kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, ha lɛ nyu nɛ e nu. Ke o pee jã a, o ma ha zo kpɔtɔɔ maa gbe lɛ.”

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ ngɔ kpakpa peemi kɛ ye yayami nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba e he si ha ma nɔ yeli, ejakaa blɔ nya tsuaa blɔ nya a, Mawu lɛ haa nɔ; nɛ nɔ yeli nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ hu he wami nɛ a hɛɛ ɔ, Mawu lɛ ha mɛ.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ yeli nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, e sɛ kaa nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa yeɔ mɛ gbeye, se mohu nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ yaya. Anɛ o suɔ nɛ o ko ye nɔ yelɔ ɔ gbeye lo? Ke ja a, lɛɛ pee nɔ́ kpakpa; nɛ nɔ yelɔ ɔ ma je o yi.

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔlɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e ní tsumi ji kaa e hyɛ nɛ e hi ha mo. Se ke o pee yayami ɔ, lɛɛ o ye nɔ yelɔ ɔ gbeye; ejakaa a ha we lɛ blɔ nya nɛ ɔ yaka. Mawu tsɔlɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e kɛ mi mi la gblaa a tue ngɛ Mawu nane mi.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nɔ yeli; pi kaa nyɛ tue kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu maa gbla ke nyɛ pee we ja, se nyɛ he nile hu maa bu nyɛ fɔ.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ nyɛ woɔ tó ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu tsɔli ji mɛ; nɛ ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ a tsuɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Mlaa a nɛ deɔ ke, “Koo bɔ ajuama; koo gbe nɔmlɔ; koo ju; o hɛ ko kɔ̃ nɔ́ ko nɔ,” kɛ ekpa komɛ nɛ piɛ he ɔ, lɛ tsuo kpiti pomi ji nɔ́ nɛ deɔ ke, “Suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he” ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Ke o suɔ nɔ ko ɔ, o be lɛ yayami ko yayami ko pee. Ke o suɔ o nyɛmi ɔ, kɛkɛ pe o ye mlaa a tsuo nɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
