translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ le be nɔ nɛ mi nɛ wa ngɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa e sa nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ tsɛ kɛ je mahe nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hwɔe ɔ mi. Ejakaa be ɔ nɛ Mawu ma he wa yi wami ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e na wɔ haa pe kekleekle nɛ wa he ye ɔ.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Nyɔ ɔ be ta kulaa, nɛ je mi miɔ nɛ e ma tsɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha wa kpa níhi nɛ wa peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ; wa ní peemi ɔmɛ nɛ a kpɛ́ kaa níhi nɛ ta bulɔ kɛ mia.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha waa ba wa je mi saminya kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe piani, se pi kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi. Wa ko fiɛ fiɛmi yaya; wa ko de dã; wa ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi; wa ko tsu mu ní; wa ko pɛ, nɛ wa ko je hunga.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu nɛ pee kaa tade nɛ nyɛ wo; nyɛ ko susu he lo nya níhi a he, ke pi ja a, e ma jlo nyɛ kaa nyɛ pee.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko sã nya ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e susuɔ kaa e sa nɛ e pee, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ko pee he. Se mohu nyɛ he lɛ atuu kɛ ba nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; se nɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ, lɛɛ pui pɛ e yeɔ.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o kojoɔ nɔ kpa tsɔlɔ? Ke tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɔ, loo e maa gbee si ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ maa na. Ee, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e ya nɔ, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ he wami nɛ haa nɔ yaa nɔ saminya.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: E peeɔ ni komɛ kaa ligbi ɔmɛ ekomɛ a he hia pe ekomɛ, be mi nɛ ni komɛ susuɔ kaa ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee e juɛmi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ susuɔ kaa ligbi komɛ a he hia pe ekomɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami e ngɛ woe; nɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ saisaa a, lɛ hu e ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami woe, ejakaa e naa Mawu si ngɛ he. Nɔ nɛ yi nɔ́ saisaa a, lɛ hu e kɛ woɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ lɛ hu e naa Mawu si.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Wa ti nɔ ko nɔ ko hɛ ka we kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ́ nɔ ko ma gbo ha lɛ nitsɛ e he.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke wa hɛ ngɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ wa hɛ ngɛ kɛ ha, nɛ ke wa gbo hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wa gbo kɛ ha. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nihi ji wɔ.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo gbo, nɛ e kpale ba wami mi ekohu, konɛ e pee Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ ngɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛni he je moo o kojoɔ o nyɛmi? Aloo pohu mɛni he je nɛ o gbeɔ o nyɛmi he guɛ ɔ? Mawu hɛ mi wɔ tsuo wa maa da si ngɛ nɛ e maa kojo wɔ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ kita kae ke Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma kpla si ha mi Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma gba mi ma de paa ke imi ji Mawu.”

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Lɛɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu lɛ nitsɛ e he akɔtaa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. Ko ha nɛ o nyɛmi Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ pee yayami

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Nɛ i ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, i kpá si, nɛ i le kaa niye ní ko niye ní ko be nɛ he tsɔ we. Se ke nɔ ko buu niye ní ko kaa e he tsɔ we ɔ, lɛ nɛ niye ní ɔ he tsɔ we ha.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Ke o ye niye ní ko, nɛ lɔ ɔ kɛ haomi ba o nyɛmi nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ o sume o nyɛmi ɔ. Ko ha ní nɛ o maa ye ɔ nɛ kpata o nyɛmi nɛ Kristo gbo ngɛ e he ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko nɛ nyɛ buu nɔ́ kpakpa a, nyɛ ko ha nɛ a tu he munyu yaya.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, pi nɔ́ nɛ a maa ye, loo nɔ́ nɛ a maa nu; se mohu kaa a pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ a na bua jɔmi. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ haa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo sɔmɔe ngɛ kikɛmɛ a blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya ní pee, nɛ e saa nimli adesahi hu a hɛ mi.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa di níhi nɛ kɛ he jɔɔmi baa, nɛ waa kɛ maa wo wa sibi he wami ɔ a se daa.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Ko ya di niye ní se, nɛ o kpata nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu pee hɛ mi. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, e he tsɔ. Se nɔ́ ko nɛ o maa ye, nɛ ma ha o nyɛmi maa pee yayami ɔ, e sɛ kaa o ye.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hi kaa o ko ye lo, nɛ o ko nu wai, nɛ jehanɛ hu, o ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha o nyɛmi nane ma kpata.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Se ke e yi mi peeɔ lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ ngɛ niye ní ko he nɛ e ye ɔ, Mawu maa bu lɛ fɔ, ejakaa e be hemi kɛ yemi; nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ o peeɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi be mi ɔ, e ji yayami.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Wɔ nihi nɛ wa hemi kɛ yemi mi wa a, e sa kaa waa ye bua ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ. Wa ko susu wɔ nitsɛmɛ pɛ wa he.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ hi nɛ maa sa e nyɛmi hɛ mi, konɛ e nyɛmi ɔ nɛ na hemi kɛ yemi nɛ pi si.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo hu pee we lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya ní; se mohu ngmami ɔ ke, “Níhi nɛ a de kɛ bɔ mo ahlua a, imi mohu ye hɛ mi si a pue.”

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Mawu ɔ nɛ haa nɔ toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e woɔ nɔ he wami nɛ ha nɛ nyɛ wo Kristo Yesu nane, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ hi si saminya.

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa pee kake, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbi kake nɛ wo Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami. A ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ hulɔ

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Kristo ba sɔmɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa Mawu yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ e kɛ ma si nɛ Mawu wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ mi.

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: E pee ja, konɛ ma je li ɔmɛ tete nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami, ejakaa e na mɛ hu mɔbɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ma je o yi ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti, Nɛ ma wo o biɛ ta kɛ la.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ kpale deɔ ke, “Nyɛ ma je li, nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu ma a nɛ nya.”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e deɔ ekohu ke, “Nyɛ ma je li tsuo, nyɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi; Je mahi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi wawɛɛ!”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Yesaya hu de ke, “Ishai nina ko maa ba; E maa te si nɛ e ba ye ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ, Nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa nihi tsuo hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ, e ha nyɛ hyi tɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi tsuo ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nya, konɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ daa. Paulo tsɔɔ nɔ́ he je nɛ e ngma womi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, imi nitsɛ i le tsɔ kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ tete nyɛ mi mi hi; nyɛ le ní bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ nyɛ nyɛɔ woɔ nyɛ sibi ga.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃, i ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ a nɔ ta woe kaa a he hia. I kɛ hɛdɔ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae kɛ kai nyɛ kaa Mawu dloomi ɔ nya a,

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: i ba pee Kristo Yesu tsɔlɔ nɛ ma tsu ma je li ɔmɛ a he ní. Ma tsu ní kaa osɔfo kɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, konɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ tsu ma je li ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a pee kaa bɔ nɛ a sã, nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma nyɛ ma fĩa ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi kaa i ngɛ Mawu ní tsue.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i be nɔ́ kpa ko he munyu nyɛe ma tu pe kaa Kristo gu ye munyu tumi, kɛ ní tsumi nɔ nɛ e ha ma je li ɔmɛ ba le Mawu.

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: Okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ i pee ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ tsu enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye sikpa a tsuo, kɛ je Yerusalem hluu kɛ ya su Ilirikum ɔ, sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ sɔuu i fiɛ.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ i kɛ ma ye hɛ mi ji kaa he nɛ a fiɛ we sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ ngɛ lolo ɔ, ma ya fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi be dee ke i ngɛ tsu fiae kɛ ngɛ nɔ kpa sisi tomi nɔ mae.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nihi nɛ a jaje we e he sane ko kɛ tsɔɔ we mɛ hyɛ ɔ maa na lɛ; Nɛ nihi nɛ nui e he hyɛ ɔ maa nu sisi.” Paulo to kaa e maa ya Roma

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: I ka si abɔ kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ, se enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i nyɛ we.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ i be nɔ́ ko peemi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi hu nɛ ɔ, ma ba su nyɛ ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i hla nɛ ma pee be babauu ji nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: I heɔ yeɔ kaa ke kaa ma be kɛ ya Spania, ma ba gba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si be bɔɔ, konɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛ ya je mi blɔ kɛ ho.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia, kɛ Akaya a kɛ bua jɔmi bua nɔ́ ko nya nɛ a kɛ ya ye bua ohiatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Ke i ngɔ nike ní tsuo nɛ a bua nya a ya su mɛ ɔ, ma pue blɔ kɛ ba gu nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ho Spania ya.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: I le kaa ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, Kristo maa gbaa nyɛ babauu.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, i ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo, kɛ suɔmi nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ haa nɔ ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ nyɛɛ piɛ ye he kɛ sɔle wawɛɛ nɛ Mawu nɛ ye bua mi.

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sɔle konɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Yudea nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ nɛ a ko doo ye nya, nɛ jehanɛ hu, ní nɛ i yaa tsu ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke Mawu suɔ ɔ, i kɛ bua jɔmi maa ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ma ba jɔɔ ye he bɔɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: He jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si. Amen!

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Wa nyɛmiyo Foibe nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Kenkrea asafo ɔ mi ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ ma wo e ta kɛ je e yi.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi bɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa hia lɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ, ejakaa e pee kpakpa ha nihi babauu, kɛ imi nitsɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: I biɔ Priskila kɛ Akuila, nyɛmimɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ní ha Yesu Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: Ye he ɔ, e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ a sake a he lo ngɔ fɔ he. I ngɛ mɛ si nae saminya; ee, pi imi kɛkɛ, se ma je li ɔmɛ asafo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ mɛ si nae.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: I biɔ asafo ɔ nɛ kpeɔ ngɛ a we ɔ mi ɔ hulɔ. I biɔ Epeneto, kekleekle nɔ nɛ he Kristo ye ngɛ Asia a; ye huɛ saminya ji lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: I biɔ Maria; lɛ hu e gbo nyɛ he dengme wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: I biɔ Androniko kɛ Yunia, ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi nɛ a wo i kɛ mɛ tsuo tsu ɔ. A he biɛ saminya ngɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɛ a sɛ ye hlami ngɛ Kristo mi.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: I biɔ Ampliato nɛ i suɔ lɛ saminya ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: I biɔ Urbano nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo tsuɔ ní ha Kristo ɔ, kɛ jehanɛ hu ye huɛ Staki nɛ i suɔ lɛ saminya a.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: I biɔ Apele; a yeɔ e he odase kaa e sɔmɔɔ Kristo saminya. I biɔ Aristobulo weku ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: I biɔ Herodion, ye nyɛmi Yuda no ɔ, kɛ nyɛmimɛ Kristo we bi nɛ je Narkiso weku ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: I biɔ Trifaina kɛ Trifosa nɛ a tsuɔ ní ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. I biɔ Persi, ye huɛ nɛ i suɔ lɛ saminya a; lɛ hu e tsu ní wawɛɛ kɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: I biɔ Rufo, nɔ nɛ je e he si kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsulɔ kpanaa a, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ imi hu kaa e bi ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: I biɔ Asinkrito, Felgon, Herma, Patroba, Herme, kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: I biɔ Filologo, kɛ Yulia, kɛ Nerea, kɛ e nyɛmiyo ɔ, kɛ Olimpas, kɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ fua nyɛ sibi kɛ nga nyɛ he. Kristo asafo tsuo biɔ nyɛ. Nyagbe munyu

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ níhi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ, nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe, nɛ a kɛ mi gbami ngɛ asafo ɔ mi bae ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he ngɛ a he, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko bɔ.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: A nu nyɛ he ngɛ he tsuaa he kaa nyɛ pɛtɛ sane kpakpa a he wawɛɛ; nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ i na nyɛ he bua jɔmi saminya. I suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ pee; se yayami blɔ fa mi lɛɛ a ko nu nyɛ he kulaa.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: E be kɛe kulaa nɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ ma kpata Abosiami hɛ mi, nɛ wa maa ye e nɔ. Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Timoteo nɛ i kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsumi kake tsue ɔ ke e biɔ nyɛ. Ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi, Lukio, Yason, kɛ Sosipatre hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Imi Tertio nɛ i ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, i biɔ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi.

english_verse: Gaius welcomes me and the whole church into his home, and he sends his greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, and our dear friend Quartus send their greetings too. Paul's Closing Prayer
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo kulaa nɛ hi si! Amen!] Nyagbe yi jemi sɔlemi

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu yi. Lɛ nɛ e ma ha nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi maa wa ngɛ Yesu Kristo he sane kpakpa a nɛ i fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ mi. Kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko li anɔkuale nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngma a ha nihi babauu ba na anɔkuale ɔ paa kaa bɔ nɛ neneene Mawu ɔ nitsɛ to nɛ a fiɛ ha je mahi tsuo, konɛ a he Mawu ye, nɛ a bu lɛ tue ɔ.

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: A je Mawu kake too ɔ nɛ le ní tsuo ɔ yi ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi kɛ ya neneene. Amen!

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo, nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, e tsɛ mi nɛ ma ba pee Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ, i kɛ wa nyɛmi Sostene lɛ wa ngma womi nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ yaa ha Mawu we asafo nɛ ngɛ Korinto ɔ, nihi nɛ a tsu a he, nɛ a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ha Yesu Kristo, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ a jaa Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ mɛ hu a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ. Gbaami ngɛ Kristo mi

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: I naa Mawu si daa kɛ haa nyɛ ngɛ dloomi nɛ e ngɔ ha nyɛ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: who helps you speak and understand so well.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ ya hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, munyu tumi jio, nile jio.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Kristo he odase nɛ nyɛ ngɛ yee ɔ ba he si wawɛɛ nɛ nihi na.

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ blɔ hyɛe nɛ ɔ, mumi mi nike ní ko kulaa be nyɛ hiae.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Mawu, nɔ nɛ kpee nyɛ ke nyɛɛ kɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba bɔ huɛ ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ. Mi gbami ngɛ asafo ɔ mi

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nya nɛ pee kake, nɛ mi gbami kó ba nyɛ kpɛti. Nyɛ yi mi, kɛ nyɛ juɛmi nɛ pee kake.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa ni komɛ je Kloe we ɔ mi ba wo ye tue nɔ ke pɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Anɛ a gba Kristo mi lo? Anɛ Paulo nɛ a sɛu ha nyɛ lo? Anɛ Paulo biɛ mi a sɔle nyɛ kɛ wo lo?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: I naa Mawu si kaa i sɔle we nɔ ko nɔ ko kaa ja Krispo kɛ Gayo pɛ.

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko be nyɛe ma de ke a sɔle nyɛ kɛ wo ye biɛ mi.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, i sɔle Stefana kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ hulɔ. Se i kaii we kaa i pa sɔle nɔ kpa ko hu.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Kristo tsɔ we mi ke ma ba sɔle nihi. E tsɔ mi ke ma ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a; pi kɛ nya mi dɔkɔɔ, kɛ adesa nile, konɛ gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ kó pee yaka. Kristo ji Mawu he wami, kɛ e nile

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi nɛ a hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata a, buɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ sɛumi tso ɔ he ɔ kaa kuasiahi a sane ko kɛkɛ. Se wɔ nɛ a ngɛ wa yi wami hee ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ e ji Mawu he wami ha wɔ.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ ke, “Ma ha nɛ ní leli a nile ma puɛ, nɛ ga leli a ga tsuo maa pee yaka.”

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Jije ní leli ɔmɛ ngɛ? Jije ga leli ɔmɛ ngɛ? Jije je nɛ ɔ mi sane mi hlali ɔmɛ ngɛ? Ee, Mawu ha nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nile ɔ plɛ pee kuasiahi a sane.

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ e nile ɔ kɛ tsi adesa blɔ, konɛ adesa kó nyɛ nɛ e gu lɛɛ e ní lemi nɔ kɛ le Mawu. Se mohu ɔ, sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ wa ngɛ fiɛe nɛ nihi buu kaa kuasiahi a sane ɔ, Mawu to kaa e kɛ ma he ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a yi wami.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Kristo nɛ a sɛu ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe. Enɛ ɔ peeɔ blɔ tsimi nɔ ha Yuda bi, nɛ Hela bi hu buu lɛ kaa kuasiahi a sane.

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: Ee, nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, Yuda bi jio, Hela bi jio, mɛɛ a le kaa Kristo ji Mawu he wami, kɛ e nile.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke Mawu je kuasia tete po, adesa kɛ e nile nɛ nya wa a na we lɛ; ke Mawu gbɔjɔ tete po, adesa kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ na we lɛ saasaa.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ha loko Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ɔ. Ngɛ he lo blɔ fa mi ɔ, nyɛ ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ ji ní leli, nihi bɔɔ pɛ ji nihi nɛ a he wa, nɛ bɔɔ pɛ ji odehehi.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Mawu je blɔ hla je ɔ mi kuasia níhi, konɛ e kɛ gbe ní leli zo. Mawu hla je ɔ mi níhi nɛ gbɔjɔ, konɛ e kɛ gbe níhi nɛ a he wa a zo.

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: E hla níhi nɛ je ɔ bui, níhi nɛ a hiee, kɛ níhi nɛ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa a, konɛ e kɛ gbe níhi nɛ je ɔ buu saminya a a he guɛ.

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó fĩa ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e maa fĩa a, e fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, benɛ i ba slaa nyɛ, nɛ i kɛ Mawu laami sane ɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, i fiɛ we kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ, loo nile.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Ejakaa benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, i to ye yi mi kaa i be nɔ́ kpa ko tsɔɔe pe sane ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yesu Kristo, kɛ e sɛumi ɔ he ɔ.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ i tsɔɔ, kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ i fiɛ ɔ hu, pi nile munyu nɛ plɛɔ nɔ yi mi nɛ i tu. Se mohu Mawu Mumi ɔ, kɛ he wami ɔ lɛ tsu ní nɛ ɔ,

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ngɔ fɔ adesa nile nɔ, se mohu Mawu he wami nɔ. Mawu nile

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa ngɛ mumi mi ɔ, i fiɛɔ nile sɛ gbi ko kɛ̃ kɛ haa mɛ; pi nile nɛ adesa tsɔɔ, nɛ pi je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ yeli a nɔ́. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa be kɛ ho.

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: Nile nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ ji nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ laa adesa. Loko a bɔ je ɔ, Mawu hla nile nɛ ɔ ngɔ to momo nɛ e kɛ wo wa hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ yeli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li nile nɛ ɔ, a le jinɛ a ko sɛu we Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Se, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a, “Nɔ́ nɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ́ hyɛ, Nɔ́ nɛ tue nui hyɛ, Nɔ́ nɛ adesa ko juɛmi sui he ɔ, Lɔ ɔ nɔuu Mawu dla ngɔ to nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu gu e mumi ɔ nɔ je laami sane ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ. Mumi ɔ hlaa níhi tsuo a mi; Mawu juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ tete po, e hlaa mi.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Adesa nitsɛ e mumi nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ pɛ lɛ le bɔ nɛ lɛ adesa a ngɛ ha. Jã kɛ̃, Mawu mumi ɔ pɛ lɛ le bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ ha.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Wɔɔ lɛɛ pi je nɛ ɔ mi mumi ɔ nɛ wa ná, se mohu mumi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, konɛ waa le níhi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo wɔ ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ, ke waa kɛ mɛ ngɛ mumi mi níhi a he ní sɛɛe ɔ, munyu nɛ mumi ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa tuɔ; wa tu we adesa nile munyu.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ be mumi ɔ na we Mawu mumi ɔ nike níhi. Nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nui mumi ɔ nike níhi a sisi saminya. Enɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ kuasiahi a sane kɛ haa lɛ; ejakaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mumi mi hɛngmɛ a kɛ naa.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ e mi ɔ naa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; se lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko li lɛ kɛ pi si.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a, “Mɛnɔ lɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ juɛmi, nɛ e maa wo lɛ ga?” Wɔɔ lɛɛ bɔ nɛ Kristo susuu e yi mi ɔ, jã wɔ hu wa susuu wa yi mi.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, anɔkuale mi ɔ, i nyɛ we nɛ i kɛ nyɛ nɛ tu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ nihi nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ tuɔ munyu. Se mohu, i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kaa je mi bi, aloo bimwɔwi ngɛ Kristo jami mi.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: I ha nyɛ nyɔ nyu, se pi niye ní nɛ jiɔ; ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ ye niye ní nɛ jiɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete po nyɛ nyɛ we kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ke, “Paulo nɔ ji mi”, nɛ nɔ ko hu ke, “Imi lɛɛ Apolo nɔ ji mi” ɔ, anɛ pi nɔ́ nɛ je mi bi peeɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ji Apolo ɔ? Imi Paulo hu, mɛnɔ ji mi? Mawu tsɔli kɛkɛ ji wɔ, nɛ wa nɔ lɛ nyɛ gu kɛ he Kristo ye. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ wa tsu.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Imi lɛ i ba ma tso ɔ. Apolo ba pue nɔ nyu, se Mawu lɛ ha nɛ tso ɔ wa.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ duɔ tso, kɛ nɔ nɛ pueɔ nɔ nyu ɔ, slɔɔto be a kpɛti; Mawu maa wo a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ kpakpa ngɛ ní tsumi nɛ e tsu ɔ he.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu tsɔli nɛ pee kake kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ji wɔ. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa ngmɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ mi. Nyɛ ngɛ kaa tsu nɛ Mawu ngɛ fiae.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: I ngɔ Mawu dloomi nɛ e ha mi ɔ, nɛ i kɛ to tsu ɔ sisi kaa tsu fialɔ kpanaa nɛ le ga tsuɔ ní; nɛ nɔ kpa ba ngɛ nɔ fiae. Se e hia kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ kaa e ngɛ tsu ɔ fiae saminya ngɛ sisi tomi ɔ nɔ lo.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: Se ligbi ɔ nɛ Kristo maa ba a, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní nɛ e tsu ɔ maa je kpo paa. Ejakaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a kɛ la ma je nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi kpo. La a maa tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi ngɛ ha.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ɔ tsu ɔ sã a, nɔ́ laa lɛ; se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ a ma he e yi wami kaa nɔ ko nɛ a gbla lɛ kɛ je la mi.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa Mawu sɔlemi we ji nyɛ, nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi lo?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko puɛ Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ, Mawu ma kpata e hɛ mi. Ejakaa Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ nyɛ ji sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó sisi e he. Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko susuu kaa lɛɛ e le ní pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, é pee e he kuasia. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee ní lelɔ nitsɛnitsɛ.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ je ɔ buu kaa nile ɔ ji kuasia nɔ́ ko ngɛ Mawu lɛɛ e hɛ mi. Ngmami ɔ ke, “Mawu ngɔɔ nile kɛ tsɔɔ ní leli klama.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ kpa hu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le kaa ní leli a yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Paulo jio, Apolo jio, Petro jio, je nɛ ɔ jio, wami jio, gbenɔ jio, amlɔ nɛ ɔ jio, hwɔɔ se jio, ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu Kristo níhi ji nyɛ, nɛ Kristo ɔ, Mawu nɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu wɔ kaa Kristo tsɔli nɛ Mawu ngɔ laami sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ ke waa fiɛ.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ngɛ tsɔli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ a dɛ ji kaa a ye anɔkuale ha a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ, aloo ni kpahi susuɔ ngɛ ye he ɔ hɛwi mi; imi nitsɛ po, i kojo we ye he.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Ye he nile tete bui mi fɔ, se enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yeɔ nguɔ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ kojoɔ mi.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko kojo nɔ ko loko be ɔ nɛ su. Nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba. Ke e ba a, e ma je diblii mi níhi, kɛ tsui mi ní yayahi nɛ a kɛ laa a tsuo kpo. Jamɛ a be ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na yi jemi nɛ sa lɛ ɔ kɛ je Mawu dɛ mi.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ he ɔ, i ngɔ imi, kɛ Apolo ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kase wɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko je nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a se ya pee nɔ́ kpa ko. Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó wó e he nɔ; nɔ ko kó bu nɔ ko nɔmlɔ ngua pe nɔ ko.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ lɛ pee mo slɔɔto pe ni kpahi? Mɛni ngɛ o dɛ nɛ pi Mawu nɛ ha mo? Ke Mawu lɛ ha mo ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o fĩaa kaa nɔ́ nɛ pi nɛ a kɛ ke mo ɔ?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Tse nyɛ ná nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia nyɛ! Tse nyɛ ná ní momo! Nyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee, be mi nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be nɔ́ ko mi; pi jã? I na nɛ nyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee niinɛ, konɛ waa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ ye.

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e peeɔ mi kaa Mawu ngɔ wɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ pee sekpɛli. Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ a bu mɛ gbenɔ fɔ, konɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi, nɛ je ɔ, hiɔwe bɔfohi, kɛ adesahi tsuo nɛ na mɛ.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Kristo he ɔ, wa plɛ kuasiahi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ba pee ní leli! Wa gbɔjɔ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he mi ba wa nyɛ! Nyɛ hɛ mi ba nyami, se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hɛ mi pue si.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete po hwɔ kɛ kuma yee wɔ; wa heha níhi híaa ngɛ wa he; a kongoɔ wɔ, nɛ wa hii kpae kɛ hii bee.

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: Waa kɛ wa nine nguɛ nyɔngma tsuɔ ní. Ke nihi ngɛ wɔ jɛe ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa gbaa mɛ; ke a ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae ɔ, wa toɔ wa tsui si.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Ke a ngɛ wa biɛ puɛe ɔ, wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa tu he jɔmi munyu. Je ɔ buu wɔ kaa kuku kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: I ngmɛ́ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ma kɛ pue nyɛ hɛ mi si, se mohu nɛ ma kɛ tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa imi nitsɛ ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ wo ye nane.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: I ngɛ Timoteo nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe ngɛ enɛ ɔ he. E ngɛ kaa imi nitsɛ ye bi fɔfɔɛ; e yeɔ mi anɔkuale, nɛ i suɔ lɛ, ejakaa e le Kristo. Ke Timoteo ba a, e ma kai nyɛ bɔ nɛ i plɛ kɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo se nyɛɛe ha, kaa bɔ nɛ a naa ngɛ ye ní tsɔɔmi mi ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi he tsuaa he ɔ.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti ni komɛ susu kaa i be bae ba slaa nyɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bɔni a he nɔ womi.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ ma ba slaa nyɛ. Ke i ba a, pi munyu nɛ kikɛmɛ a he nɔ woli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ tue ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ ma ba nu, se he wami nɛ a kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, ma ba na paa.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ jeɔ e he kpo ngɛ adesa ní tsumi mi, se pi munyu tumi mi.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Te nɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ nɛɛ? Ke i ma nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, ma hɛɛ kpa kɛ ba, aloo ma ba ngɛ suɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: A ngɛ dee ke yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi sanehi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ba nɛ ɔ, wɔ jali tete po pee we. I nu kaa nɔ ko kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tsɛ yo ngɛ si hwɔe.

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ woe ngɔ piɛ he! Niinɛ, e sa kaa nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ mohu. Nyumu nɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ fie lɛ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: I am with you only in my thoughts. But in the name of our Lord Jesus I have already judged this man, as though I were with you in person. So when you meet together and the power of the Lord Jesus is with you, I will be there too.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa i be nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi mohu, se mumi mi lɛɛ i kɛ nyɛ lɛ ngɛ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ahlua ní nɛ ɔ ɔ, i bu lɛ fɔ momo ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. Ke nyɛ kpe nɛ ye mumi piɛ nyɛ he ngɛ Yesu Kristo he wami nya a,

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ tu nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Satan dɛ mi, nɛ e kpata e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ, Kristo nɛ he e susuma yi wami.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: E sɛ kaa nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ. Blema abɛ ɔ nɛ deɔ ke, “Masa bɔbɔyoo haa nɛ ma a tsuo fuɔ” ɔ, tse nyɛ le?

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je yayami nɛ ngɛ kaa masa a kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ pee kaa ma kplolo nɛ masa be mi kaa bɔ nɛ i le nɛ nyɛ ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Ejakaa a ngɔ Kristo ngɔ sã bɔ ha wɔ kaa to bi nɛ a gbeɔ Hetsɔmi nyami be.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa ngɛ wa Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ yee ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ waa ngɔ ma momo kɛ ye. Ma momo nɛ ɔ ji yayami, kɛ yi wu tso níhi. Nyɛ ha waa ye lɛ ngɛ anɔkuale yemi mi.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: I de ngɛ womi nɛ i ngma nyɛ ɔ mi ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ fiɛɔ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi kó bɔ.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Pi je mi bi yaholi, loo hɛ tsuli, loo juli, loo wɔ jali a he munyu nɛ i ngɛ tue kulaa; kaa mɛ ɔ, jinɛ e ko hia kaa nyɛɛ je je ɔ mi.

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi asafo mi no na sane ɔ, e be he blɔ nɛ e kɛ sane ɔ ya haa nihi nɛ ja we Mawu nɛ a hyɛ mi ha mɛ. E sa nɛ e kɛ ya ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ lɛ maa kojo je ɔ lo? Saminya! Ke nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa kojo je ɔ, lɛɛ sane wawi kojomi pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Tse nyɛ le kaa nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa kojo hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ! Nɛ daa ligbi munyu tsɔwitsɔwi ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa kojo?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Anɛ juɛmitsɛ kake too be nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ma nyɛ maa hyɛ nyɛmimɛ a kpɛti sane mi ha mɛ lo?

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: Se mohu, nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi yaa kojomi he, nɛ nihi nɛ li Kristo ɔ ya hyɛɛ a sane mi ha mɛ.

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa yayami peeli be blɔ nya ko ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi lo? Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he! Yaholi, loo amaga jali, loo gba puɛli, loo nyumuhi kɛ yihi sɔuu nɛ kɛ a sibi peeɔ yakayaka ní,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: loo juli, loo hɛ tsuli, loo dã tɔli, loo nihi a biɛ puɛli, loo ojo fiali a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Be ko ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ ti ni komɛ ba a je mi. Se jehanɛ ɔ, a du nyɛ he, nɛ a kpale tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ a wo nyɛ nguɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ ɔ, kɛ wa Mawu ɔ mumi ɔ mi. Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nimli tso ɔmɛ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko hu ma de ke, “Ngma ngɛ ha muklii, nɛ muklii hu ngɛ ha ngma.” Ee, se Mawu ma kpata nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, pi nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka ní peemi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha; se mohu e ngɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he. Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ ha nɔmlɔ tso ɔ.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Mawu tle Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e kɛ e he wami ɔ ma tle wɔ hu si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi ji mɛ lo? Lɛɛ ma ngɔ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní komɛ kɛ ya pee yaholɔ hu e nɔmlɔ tso he níhi lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔ nɛ kɛ yaholɔ ya naa bɔmi ɔ, e kɛ lɛ plɛ pee nɔmlɔ tso kake lo? Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ma plɛ pee nɔmlɔ tso kake.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ lɛ pee kake ngɛ mumi mi.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ tu yahomi nya fo. Yayami tsuaa yayami nɛ adesa peeɔ ɔ, pee we nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɔ́ ko tsɔ. Se nɔ nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi ɔ, yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ awi.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ, nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, anɛ nyɛ li kaa e sɔlemi tsu ji nɔmlɔ tso ɔ lo? Nyɛ be nyɛ dɛ he; Mawu níhi ji nyɛ.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Mawu hé nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, níhi nɛ nyɛ ngma ba ha mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ngɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. E hi ha nyumu kaa e ko ta yo he.

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: Se ajuama bɔmi he ɔ, nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ná lɛ nitsɛ e yo, nɛ yo tsuaa yo nɛ ná lɛ nitsɛ e huno.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Nyumu kɛ e yo kó tsi a he nya kaa a kɛ a sibi be bɔmi nae. Lɛɛ ja eko ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a kplɛɛ kaa a maa pee jã be kuku kɛkɛ, konɛ a na deka kɛ sɔle. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, á bɔni bɔmi ekohu. Ke pi jã a, a be a he nɔ nyɛe maa ye hu, nɛ Satan maa ka mɛ.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, ga kɛkɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe; pi mlaa.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nyɛ nyumu kuyo ɔmɛ, kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke e maa hi ha nyɛ ke nyɛ maa ya nɔ maa hi si kikɛ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ nyɛ́ we nyɛ he nɔ nyɛɛ ye ɔ, e hia kaa nyɛɛ sɛ gba si himi mi. Ejakaa lɔ ɔ hi pe nɔ́ nɛ akɔnɔ ma ba hao nyɛ.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ gba si himi mi ɔ, mlaa nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ woe ji yo kó je gba! Enɛ ɔ, pi imi nɛ i de.

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: Se ke e na je gba kɛ̃ ɔ, e hi si jã, nɛ e ko gba, aloo e ya nɛ e kɛ e huno ɔ ya dla. Jehanɛ hu, nyumu ko ngmɛɛ e yo he.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ imi, se pi Kristo, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ke nyumu nɛ le Kristo ngɛ yo nɛ lɛɛ e li Kristo, se kɛ̃ ɔ, yo ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hi si ɔ, nyumu ɔ ko ngmɛɛ e he.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Ke yo nɛ le Kristo ngɛ huno nɛ lɛɛ e li Kristo, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyumu ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hi si ɔ, yo ɔ kó kua lɛ gbami.

english_verse: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyumu nɛ li Kristo ɔ, e yo ɔ he ɔ, a tsukɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu. Yo nɛ li Kristo ɔ, lɛ hu e huno ɔ he ɔ, a tsukɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu. Ke pi jã a, jinɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ a he tsɔ we. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ba pee bimɛ nɛ a tsukɔ a he ha Mawu.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Se ke nyumu nɛ li Kristo ɔ suɔ kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e yo nɛ le Kristo ɔ he, aloo yo nɛ li Kristo ɔ suɔ kaa e ma kua e huno nɛ le Kristo ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ faa. Ke e ba mi jã a, mlaa ko mlaa ko nui nɔ nɛ le Kristo ɔ, nyumu ɔ jio, yo ɔ jio. Mawu tsɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Nike ní nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ha nɔ ko loko Mawu ba tsɛ lɛ ɔ, é ya nɔ nɛ e tsu he ní kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a po mo jio, a pui mo jio, pi nɔ́ ko; nɔ́ nɛ he hia ji kaa o ye Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ loko Mawu tsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɔguɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɛ lɛ ɔ ba peeɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ ye e he. Jã kɛ̃ ke nɔ ko ye e he, nɛ Kristo tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e ba peeɔ Kristo nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Kristo hé nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ; nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he nimli a nyɔguɛhi.

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngma ngɛ yihewi nɛ gba we lolo a he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha we mi mlaa pɔtɛɛ ko. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, juɛmi nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ ga nɛ ɔ woe ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ dloo mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, he hiami be ɔ je sisi momo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i susuu kaa mo nɔ, bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, o hi si jã kɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Ke yo ngɛ o dɛ ɔ, kó de ke o ngɛ e he ngmɛɛe. Ke yo be o dɛ ɔ, ko ya hla eko.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Se ke o ná ngɔ yo ɔ, o pee we yayami. Jã kɛ̃ ke yo nɛ gba we lolo hu gba a, e pee we yayami. Se dengme nɛ ngɛ gba si himi mi he je ɔ, i na nɛ nyɛ je nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ si mohu amlɔ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛkɛ ji kaa be ɔ pi hu. Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, yitsɛmɛ nɛ a hi si kaa nɔ́ nɛ yo be a dɛ.

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ a kɛ je ɔ ngɛ bɔe ɔ, a pee a ní kaa nihi nɛ puɛ we a be ngɛ je ɔ mi. Ejakaa je ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nɛ ɔ, e se be kɛe.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo ɔ lɛɛ e haoɔ e he ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi níhi a he, ejakaa e bɔɔ mɔde kaa e maa sa e yo ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Ke e ba mi jã a, e juɛmi peeɔ lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ. Yo nɛ be huno, aloo yiheyo kɛ e he haa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsumi, ejakaa e suɔ kaa e ngɔ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, kɛ e mumi tsuo ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Yogbayo lɛɛ e haoɔ e he ngɛ je ɔ mi níhi a he, ejakaa e suɔ kaa e sa e huno hɛ mi.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpakpa he nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, se pi kaa i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma tsi nyɛ nya ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ. Niinɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya. I suɔ kaa nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he tsuo ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsumi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛ ko ya se.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ nyumu, kɛ e yo nɛ e bi si, se e ngɔɛ lɛ lolo ɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ke nyumu ɔ na kaa e pee we yo ɔ saminya, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e nyɛ we e he nɔ nɛ e hyɛ ɔ, e ngɔ yo ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ. Yayami ko be enɛ ɔ mi. Ee, a sɛ gba si himi mi.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ yo ɔ, pee saminya. Se nɔ nɛ be yo ngɔe ɔ, e nɔ́ ɔ hi kulaa pe nɔ kaketsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yogbayo ɔ, be abɔ nɛ e huno ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, mlaa fi lɛ. Ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e suɔ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e sa kaa nyumu ɔ nɛ pee nɔ ko nɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ma suɔ nɛ ma de nɔ́ ko ngɛ kusumi lo nɛ a kɛ haa amaga he. E ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa “wɔ tsuo wa le ní,” kaa bɔ nɛ a deɔ ɔ. Se nile haa nɔ woɔ e he nɔ, nɛ suɔmi lɛɛ e woɔ nɔ he wami.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko susu kaa e le ní ɔ, he nɛ sa kaa e su loko a tsɛ lɛ ní lelɔ ɔ, e sui lejɛ ɔ saasaa.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Se nɔmlɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu ɔ, Mawu le lɛ.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ ma de nɔ́ ko ngɛ kusumi lo nɛ a kɛ haa amaga a yemi he. Wa le kaa amaga daa si ha nɔ́ ko nɛ be je nɛ ɔ mi. Wa le hu kaa mawu kpa ko be ngɛ anɔkuale Mawu kake ɔ se.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ deɔ ke ní komɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba a nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ “mawuhi.” Yoo, ke “mawu” nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ “nyɔmtsɛmɛ” nɛ ɔmɛ pɔ he tete po,

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: kɛ̃ ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu kake too nɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ, lɛ pɛ wa ngɛ. Lɛ nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ wa ngɛ wami mi. Wa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ kake hulɔ; lɛ ji Yesu Kristo. E nɔ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ wa ngɛ wami mi.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Se pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le anɔkuale nɛ ɔ. Kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, ni komɛ susuɔ kaa amagahi ngɛ wami mi; a susuɔ kaa ke a ha amagahi ní ɔ, mawuhi nɛ a ha ní ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ke a ye kikɛmɛ a ní ɔ, a he nile haoɔ mɛ, ejakaa a susuɔ kaa niye ní ɔ ma ble mɛ.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Ngma kɛkɛ be hae nɛ waa hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu he haa pe bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ. Ke wa yi ɔ, wa laa we nɔ́ ko; ke wa ye hu, wa na we he se tsɔ.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e he nile deɔ lɛ ke e sɛ kaa a yeɔ ní ngɛ amaga jami he ɔ na mo “ní lelɔ” nɛ o ngɛ ní yee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Anɛ enɛ ɔ be lɛ he wami woe nɛ lɛ hu e ya ye ní nɛ a kɛ ha amagahi lo?

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ngma ma ha ye nyɛmi nane ma kpata a, i be lo yee hu gblegbleegble, konɛ ma ko ha nɛ ye nyɛmi ɔ nɛ pee yayami.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Anɛ i be ye dɛ he lo? Anɛ pi bɔfo ji mi lo? Anɛ i nɛ Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lo? Nɛ nyɛ nɛɛ? Ní nɛ i tsu ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, anɛ pi nyɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba lo?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Ke ni kpahi bui kaa bɔfo ji mi ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he mi kaa bɔfo; ejakaa ní tsumi nɛ i ngɛ tsue ɔ, nyɛ ji okadi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ji mi.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Anɛ wa be he blɔ kaa wa naa niye ní kɛ jeɔ nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ ní nɛ wa ngɛ tsue ɔ he lo?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Ke wa yaa he ko ɔ, anɛ wa be he blɔ kaa wa yihi nɛ le Kristo ɔ, waa kɛ mɛ nyɛɛɔ kaa bɔ nɛ bɔfo kpa amɛ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Petro peeɔ ɔ lo?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Aloo i kɛ Barnaba kɛkɛ nɛ e sa kaa wa tsu ní loko waa ye ní?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Ta bulɔ te nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e woɔ e he hiɔ nɛɛ? Mɛnɔ lɛ peeɔ wai ngmɔ, nɛ e yi e mi yiblii ɔ eko? Mɛnɔ nɛ lɛɛ to, nɛ e nui to nyɔ nyu ɔ eko?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: A ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi ke, “Na nɛ ngɛ blɛfo gblɛe ɔ, koo fi e nya.” Mawu ɔ, anɛ nahi a he nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ dɔe?

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ e tu ɔ, anɛ pi wɔ tutuutu wa he nɛ e kɔɔ lo? Nihi nɛ gbaa ní, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ kpaa ní ɔ, e sa kaa a tsu ní kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa mɛ hu a maa ye niba ní ɔ eko.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Ke wa ba du mumi mi níhi ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ɔ, anɛ e ji nɔ́ ko nɛ he wa tsɔ kaa wɔ hu wa na he lo ɔ hiami níhi kɛ je nyɛ dɛ lo?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Ke ni kpahi ngɛ he blɔ kaa a hyɛɔ níhi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ blɔ kɛ jeɔ nyɛ dɛ ɔ, anɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be he blɔ kulaa pe mɛ lo? Se waa kɛ he blɔ nɛ ɔ tsu we ní. Mohu ɔ, wa to wa tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, konɛ wa ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ maa tsi Kristo he sane kpakpa a fiɛmi ɔ nya.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: I heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ le kaa nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, sɔlemi we ɔ a naa a nya mi ngma kɛ jeɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu níhi nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ eko a yeɔ.

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo mlaa ke, nihi nɛ fiɛɔ sane kpakpa a, a na a nya mi ngma kɛ je munyu ɔ fiɛmi mi.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: He blɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mohu, se imi lɛɛ i bi we nyɛ nɔ́ ko hyɛ. Womi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ hu, pi ye juɛmi ji kaa ma kɛ kai nyɛ kaa jehanɛ e sa kaa nyɛ bɔni mi nɔ́ hami. Afani nɛ ma gbo mohu, pe nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ nɔ nɛ ma da kɛ fĩa a ba bɔ mi!

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, sane kpakpa a nɛ i fiɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ ha we mi he blɔ kaa ma fĩa, ejakaa Mawu nitsɛ nɛ fa mi ke ma pee jã. Kaa i fiɛ we sane kpakpa a, jinɛ musu tloo mi pɛ!

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ i ngɛ tsue ɔ, imi nitsɛ nɛ i suɔ kaa ma tsu jinɛ i ko hyɛ hiɔwo blɔ. Se Mawu nitsɛ nɛ hla mi, nɛ e ngɔ ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ wo ye dɛ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: I ngɛ ye dɛ he; pi nɔ ko nyɔguɛ ji mi. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i pee ye he nihi tsuo a nyɔguɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su nihi babauu a nɔ.

english_verse: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
translation_verse: I peeɔ ye ní kaa Yuda no ngɛ Yuda bi a kpɛti, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su a nɔ. Ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ a kpɛti ɔ, i peeɔ ye ní kaa nɔ nɛ sa kaa lɛ hu e yeɔ mlaa a nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su a nɔ.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃ ngɛ ma je li a kpɛti ɔ, i peeɔ ye ní kaa ma je no, nɛ i yi Yuda mlaa a nɔ. I peeɔ enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ. Se enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa i kɛ Mawu mlaa a be nɔ́ ko peemi. Dɛbi! Kristo mlaa a nɔ i yeɔ.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: I peeɔ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ ma kɛ ha nɛ Yesu he sane kpakpa a nɛ gbɛ fĩa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ní kpakpahi nɛ maa je sɛ gbi ɔ mi kɛ ba a, imi hu ma na eko.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nihi babauu tu fo ɔ, nɔ kake too lɛ naa ayekoo ní ɔ lo? Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ tu fo ɔ jã nɔuu, konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ nine nɛ su ayekoo ní ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fo nɛ i ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ tue tɛɛ kɛ yaa nyagbe; kunɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɔe ɔ, i nɔɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ gbee.

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: Se mohu ɔ, i waa ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ yi mi, nɛ i haa nɛ e peeɔ ye suɔmi nya ní. I peeɔ jã, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke i fiɛ ha ni kpahi se ɔ, imi nitsɛ lɛɛ Mawu ko sake mi ngɔ fɔ he.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, i suɔ kaa ma kai nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ Mose se ɔ a nɔ. Mɛ tsuo a hi bɔku ɔ sisi, nɛ mɛ tsuo a po Wo Tsu ɔ.

english_verse: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ bɔku ɔ sisi, kɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ, a sɔle mɛ kaa Mose se nyɛɛli.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo a ye mumi mi ní kake,

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: nɛ mɛ tsuo a nu mumi mi nyu kake ɔ nɛ je mumi mi tɛ sa nɛ nyɛɛ a se ɔ mi. Jamɛ a tɛ sa a ji Kristo.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Se enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Mawu na we a ti nihi fuu a he tsui. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi kaa okadihi nɛ a to wɔ, konɛ wa ko ha yayami nɛ pee wɔ akɔnɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee mɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ja amaga kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Ma a pue si, nɛ a ye ní, nɛ a nu ní, nɛ a fiɛ yakayaka fiɛmihi.”

english_verse: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
translation_verse: Wa ko fiɛ yakayaka fiɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee, nɛ nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ gbo ligbi kake ɔ.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Wa ko ka Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee, nɛ sinɔ kpata a hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Wa ko tu munyu huitihuiti kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee, nɛ bɔfo nɔ́ puɛlɔ ɔ kpata a hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ ba a nɔ ɔ peeɔ okadi kɛ ha ni kpahi. A ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ wɔ kɔkɔ bɔe, ejakaa be nɛ wa ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ kɛ nyagbe be ɔ kɛ we kulaa.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ susuɔ kaa e daa si ɔ, e hyɛ e he nɛ hi, konɛ e ko nɔ si.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Kahi nɛ baa nyɛ nɔ ɔ, ekoeko be nɛ bɛ adesa nɔ hyɛ. Se Mawu yeɔ e siwo nɔ, nɛ e be hae nɛ a ka nyɛ pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ. Ke ka ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ kɛ da nya, konɛ nyɛɛ je mi.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue kaa a kɛ juɛmitsɛmɛ tuɔ munyu; nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kɔ se.

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ niye ní kplu ɔ nɛ wa naa Mawu si ngɛ he ɔ, anɛ e ha we nɛ wɔ tsuo wa naa gbaami nɛ jeɔ Kristo muɔ mi ɔ eko lo? Jã kɛ̃ ke wa ku abolo ɔ nɛɛ, anɛ wɔ tsuo wa na we gbaami nɛ jeɔ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi ɔ eko lo?

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ wa hiɛmi ngɛ ɔ, wɔ tsuo wa yeɔ abolo kake ɔ eko. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi ji wɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Yuda bi a kusumi, kɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ko tsɔɔ kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, guu enɛ ɔ peemi mi nɛ a kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ naa huɛ bɔmi.

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Lɛɛ kɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ? Kaa amaga, loo niye ní nɛ a haa amaga a he hia lo?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛkɛ ji, bɔ nɛ wɔ jali sãã a, mumi yayamihi a sãã ngɔ haa, se pi Mawu. Nɛ i sume kaa nyɛɛ kɛ mumi yayamihi nɛ bɔ huɛ.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Nyɛ be nyɛe maa nu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kplu ɔ, nɛ́ nyɛ ma ya nu mumi yayamihi hu a kplu. Nyɛ be nyɛe maa ye ní ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we okplɔɔ ɔ he, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mumi yayamihi hu ma ya ye ní.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Pe wa ngɛ hlae nɛ waa wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi la nɛ e je hunga lo? Anɛ wa he wa pe lɛ lo?

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Lo tsuaa lo nɛ a ngɛ juae ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ ye faa; enɛ ɔ peemi kó hao nyɛ he nile.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke, “Je ɔ, kɛ e mi níhi tsuo ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ́.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Ke nihi nɛ he we yi ɔ a ti nɔ ko tsɛ nyɛ ní yemi, nɛ nyɛ ya a, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa ma nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɛ nyɛ he nile ko hao nyɛ kulaa.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Ee, nɔ ɔ he nile nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ; pi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he nile. Nɔ ko ma bi ke, “He blɔ nɛ i ngɛ kaa i peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, mɛni he je nɔ kpa he nile maa tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ imi ma plɛ kɛ tsu jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ he ní ha?

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ sɛ kɛ si Yuda no ko, loo ma je no ko, loo Mawu we asafo ɔ.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ mi ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɔ Kristo ngɔ pee ye nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ɔ. A ha yi nɔ ngɛ sɔlemi

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Se i suɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nu sisi kaa Kristo ngɛ he wami ngɛ nyumuhi tsuo a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nyumu ji yi kɛ ha e yo, nɛ Mawu hu ji yi kɛ ha Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyumu ngɛ sɔlee, aloo e ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe, nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ ha e yi nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ Kristo nɛ ji yi ɔ he guɛ gbee.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃, yo tsuaa yo nɛ ngɛ sɔlee, aloo e ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe, nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ hɛ́ e yi nɔ ɔ, e huno nɛ ji e yi ɔ hɛ mi si e ngɛ puee ɔ nɛ. Slɔɔto be e kɛ yo nɛ sɛ e yi nɔ a kpɛti.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Ke yo kɛ nɔ́ hɛ́ e yi nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e sã e yi nɔ mɔ. Se ke zo ngɛ lɛ pee kaa e ma sã e yi nɔ, loo e maa sɛ e yi ɔ, lɛɛ e kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ha e yi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: E sɛ kaa nyumu kɛ nɔ́ haa e yi nɔ, ejakaa Mawu subai mi a bɔ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e woɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami. Se yo lɛɛ nyumu hɛ mi nyami womi nɔ́ ji lɛ;
