english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: ejakaa a bɔɛ nyumu kɛ ji yo mi, se yo mohu nɛ a bɔ kɛ je nyumu mi.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, a bɔɛ nyumu ha we yo, se yo mohu nɛ a bɔ ha nyumu.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa yo nɛ ha e yi nɔ kaa okadi ha hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ha lɛ he blɔ ke e sɔle, loo e fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Se ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, yo be e dɛ he, nɛ nyumu hu be e dɛ he.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: A je yo kɛ je nyumu mi, nɛ nyumu tsuaa nyumu hu yo lɛ fɔ lɛ. Niinɛ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ je Mawu ngɔ.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ susuɔ kɛɛ? Anɛ e da kaa yo maa sɔle ha Mawu ngɛ ma hɛ mi, nɛ e hɛ́ e yi nɔ lo?

english_verse: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
translation_verse: Yo lɛɛ e yi bwɔmi fuu ɔ ji e hɛ mi nyami. Mawu ha yo yi bwɔmi nɛ e kɛ ha e he.

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko susuɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ i de ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ɔ be mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ma de kɛkɛ ji kaa i kɛ Mawu asafo ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be jami blɔ nya tomi kpa ko ngɛ enɛ ɔ se. Nyɔmtsɛ niye ní ɔ (Mateo

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma de nyɛ nɛ ɔ, pi kaa ma je nyɛ yi. Ejakaa ke nyɛ kpe ɔ, nɔ́ kpakpa ko ji mi; ní yayahi mohu nyɛ peeɔ.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Kekleekle ɔ, i na le kaa ke nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kaa Kristo asafo ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ gba nyɛ mi kɛ wo kuu slɔɔtohi a mi. I heɔ yeɔ kaa anɔkuale ko kɛ̃ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ i nu nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, e he hia kaa mi gbami ko kɛ̃ nɛ hi nyɛ kpɛti, konɛ a na Kristo se nyɛɛli kpakpa amɛ paa.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nyɛ ngɛ ní ɔ yee ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ he sɔɔ kɛ yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e niye ní. Nɛ benɛ hwɔ ngɛ ni komɛ yee ɔ, ni komɛ hu tɔ dã.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa ye abolo nɛ ɔ eko, nɛ nyɛ maa nu wai ngɛ kplu nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbenɔ sane ɔ fiɛe kɛ yaa su be nɛ e maa ba.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ abolo ɔ, nɛ e nuɔ wai ngɛ kplu ɔ mi kɛkɛ, nɛ e susuu we Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ji ɔ, Mawu maa gbla e tue.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu e wo kplu ɔ hu benɛ a ye ní ɔ ta a, nɛ e de ke, “Kplu nɛ ɔ ji Mawu somi he ɔ nɛ a kɛ ye muɔ sɔu nya. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa nu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ná kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɛ i kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ɔ, jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ a tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ, e kɛ̃ abolo,

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e de ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a ku ngɛ nyɛ he. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we abolo ɔ, nɛ́ e nuu wai nɛ ngɛ kplu ɔ mi bɔ nɛ sɛ ɔ, e peeɔ yayami kɛ siɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, kɛ e muɔ ɔ.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ e tsui mi kekle loko e ye abolo ɔ, nɛ e nu wai nɛ ngɛ kplu ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he nɛ nyɛ ti nihi fuu gbɔjɔ, nɛ a be he wami, nɛ nihi babauu hu gbo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Se ke wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa maa kojo wa he anɔkuale mi kekle ɔ, Mawu be wa tue gblae.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kojoɔ wɔ, nɛ e gblaa wa tue, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyagbe ɔ, Mawu nɛ ko bu wɔ fɔ kɛ piɛ je ɔ he.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ nya ba bua, nɛ nyɛ maa ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ niye ní ɔ, nyɛɛ mlɛ nyɛ sibi.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Se ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee ɔ, e ye ní ngɛ we mi lolo, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ he nya buami ɔ kó ba pee tue gblami mohu ha nyɛ. Níhi nɛ piɛ ɔ, ke i ba su kɛkɛ ma to blɔ nya.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le kaa benɛ nyɛ ji wɔ jali ɔ, amagahi nɛ wami be a mi ɔ a se a gblaa nyɛ ya nyɛɛɔ.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: I ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ e mi ɔ, e de we ke, “A gbiɛ Yesu.” Jã kɛ̃ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma de ke, “Yesu ji Nyɔmtsɛ” hulɔ kaa ja Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ blɔ.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Mumi mi nike ní slɔɔtohi lɛ ngɛ, se mumi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: Blɔ slɔɔtohi a nɔ a guɔ kɛ sɔmɔɔ, se Nyɔmtsɛ kake ɔ nɔuu a sɔmɔɔ.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Ní tsumi slɔɔtohi ngɛ, se Mawu kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ he wami nɛ hia lɛ nɛ e kɛ tsuɔ ní.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Mawu mumi ɔ haa nɔ ko he wami nɛ e kɛ tuɔ munyu nɛ juɛmi ngɛ mi. Jamɛ a mumi ɔ nɔuu haa nɔ kpa hu he wami nɛ e kɛ tuɔ munyu nɛ sisi numi ngɛ mi.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Mumi kake too ɔ haa nɔ ko hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ e haa nɔ kpa he wami nɛ e kɛ tsaa hiɔ.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Se mumi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; e haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nike ní pɔtɛɛ ko kaa bɔ nɛ lɛɛ e suɔ. Nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ e he ní slɔɔtohi

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ mumi kake ɔ nɔuu ngɔ wo wa tsui mi, nɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ba plɛ pee Kristo he nɔ́ ko, Yuda no jio, ma je no jio, nyɔguɛ jio, nɔ nɛ ye e he jio.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nitsɛ ɔ, pi he nɔ́ kake ji lɛ, se mohu he níhi babauu.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Ke nane ma de ke, “Akɛnɛ i pi nine he je ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ ko ji mi” ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsa tsɔɔ we kaa pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní ɔmɛ eko ji lɛ niinɛ.

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Nɛ ke tue hu ma de ke, “Akɛnɛ i pi hɛngmɛ he je ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ ko ji mi” ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsa tsɔɔ we kaa pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní ɔmɛ eko ji lɛ niinɛ.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Ke nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo ji hɛngmɛ ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛ nu nɔ́ kɛɛ? Nɛ ke lɛ tsuo ji tue ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛ nu nɔ́ he fu kɛɛ?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Se kaa bɔ nɛ wa le ɔ, Mawu to nɔmlɔ tso he ní ɔmɛ tsuo kakaaka ngɔ ma nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ e to nɛ a hi ɔ.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Ke he ní ɔmɛ tsuo peeɔ he nɔ́ kake too ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔmlɔ tso ko tsa be si hie!

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hɛngmɛ be nyɛe ma de nine ke, “O he hia we mi!” Yi hu be nyɛe ma de nane ke, “O he hia we mi.”

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Dɛbi! Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi nɛ peeɔ wɔ kaa a he wɛ pe kulaa a, mɛ mohu a he hia wɔ titli.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Ní nɛmɛ nɛ wa naa daa nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e hia we kaa a pee mɛ jã. Nɛ́ Mawu pee nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, e he ní komɛ nɛ wa susuɔ kaa a he be se nami tsɔ ko ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a hɛ mi nyami nɛ e wo pe kulaa.

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: Mawu pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ mi gbami nɛ ko ba nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi, se mohu nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní slɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo suɔ a he, nɛ a nuɔ nɔ he ha a sibi.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Ke nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ kake ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, he ní kpa amɛ tsuo kɛ lɛ naa nɔ́. Nɛ ke he nɔ́ kake hɛ mi ba nyami ɔ, he ní kpa amɛ tsuo kɛ lɛ naa bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ji Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Pi ni ɔmɛ tsuo ji bɔfohi, loo Mawu sɛ gbi fiɛli, loo tsɔɔli. Pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ peeɔ nyakpɛ ní.

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ tsaa hiɔ, loo a kɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi. Pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ ko hu nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ gbi sisi.

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ nike níhi nɛ a he jua wa a a he mɔde. Se nɔ́ nɛ hi pe lɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Ke i nyɛɔ nɛ i tuɔ adesahi a gbihi, loo hiɔwe bɔfohi po a gbihi, se i be suɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ i ngɛ kaa gɔ̃gɔ̃, loo ngmlɛ nɛ ngɛ pɛe gegeege kɛkɛ.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Ke a dloo mi he wami nɛ a kɛ fiɛɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ, ke i le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ i nuɔ laami sanehi tsuo a sisi, ke i ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nya wa ngɛ Mawu mi, nɛ ma nyɛ ma hia yohi, se i be suɔmi ɔ, ye he be se nami ko kulaa.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Ke i ngɔ ye níhi tsuo ngɔ ke, nɛ i ngɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso tete ngɔ ha nɛ a sã mi, se i be suɔmi ɔ, i na we he se ko kulaa.

english_verse: Love is patient and kind, never jealous, boastful, proud, or
translation_verse: Suɔmi toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e mi mi hi. Suɔmi hɛ kɔɛ; e fĩɛ, nɛ e pee we pupuupu.

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Suɔmi pee we níhi nɛ sɛ́; e fo we lɛ nɔ kake too e nɔ́ mi; e mi mi wui la, nɛ e kɛ nɔ ko tɔmi wui e mi.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: Suɔmi nya we nɔ́ yayami he; anɔkuale mohu he nɛ e nyaa.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Suɔmi se pui gblegbleegble. Se mumi mi nike níhi kaa Mawu munyu ɔ fiɛmi, kɛ gbi slɔɔtohi tumi, kɛ nile lɛɛ a se maa po ligbi ko.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ní nɛ wa le ɔ, wa li kɛ pi si; fiɛmi nɛ wa fiɛɔ hu, fa kɛ fa kɛkɛ.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ́ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ ba a, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji fa kɛ fa a maa laa.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ji jokuɛyo ɔ, i tuɔ munyu kaa jokuɛyo, i juɛɔ kaa jokuɛyo, nɛ i susuɔ kaa jokuɛyo. Se benɛ i ba wa a, i kpa jokuɛwi a ní peemi.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa ngɛ kaa ni komɛ nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe tsuu kɛkɛ ngɛ ahuhuɛ mi. Se hwɔɔ se ɔ, wa maa na nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ paa. Piɔ lɛɛ ní nɛ i le ɔ, fa kɛ fa kɛkɛ. Se jamɛ a be ɔ lɛɛ ma le ní kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu le mi kɛ pi si ɔ.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ní etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ: hemi kɛ yemi, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi, kɛ suɔmi. Se nɔ́ nɛ pe mɛ tsuo ji suɔmi.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ suɔmi he mɔde pe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́. Nyɛɛ di mumi mi nike níhi a se, titli ɔ, Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛmi.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi ɔ, pi adesa nɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue, se Mawu, ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko nui sisi. Mumi ɔ he wami nɛ e kɛ ngɛ laami munyu ɔmɛ tue ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe ɔ lɛɛ nimli nɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue; e piɛɔ a he, e woɔ mɛ he wami, nɛ e haa mɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: I ná nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi, se nɔ́ nɛ i ko suɔ pe kulaa mohu ji kaa nyɛɛ fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ. Nɔ nɛ fiɛɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ, e he ngɛ se nami pe nɔ nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi; lɛɛ ja nɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ ma nyɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ sisi, konɛ asafo ɔ tsuo nɛ na he se.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ i ba ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi tue ɔ, nyɛ ma na he se ko lo? Dɛbi! Ja i ngɔ nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ mi ba ha nyɛ; ja i ngɔ nile, loo sɛ gbi pɔtɛɛ, loo tsɔɔmi ko ba ha nyɛ.

english_verse: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
translation_verse: Ní komɛ kaa bɛ, aloo saku nɛ wami be a mi po ke a ngɛ pɛe ɔ, ja e mi tsɔ loko nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ tue bue ɔ maa le la a mi tso.

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Nɛ ke titimati kpalɔ ɔ bɛ ɔ mi tsɔ we ɔ, mɛnɔ maa mia kɛ ha ta?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ hu ke nyɛ ha sɛ gbi ngɛ gbihi nɛ a nui mi ɔ, kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛ nu sisi kɛɛ? Ke nyɛ pee jã a, lɛɛ kɔɔhiɔ nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ munyu tue.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko ngɛ gbi tue nɛ i nui sisi ɔ, ma plɛ nubwɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ lɛ hu e ma plɛ nubwɔ ngɛ ye hɛ mi.

english_verse: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ mumi mi níhi a he ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ma ha asafo ɔ maa ya nɔ ɔ a he mɔde wawɛ.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi ɔ, é sɔle, nɛ a ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ sisi.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke i ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a mi ɔ, ye mumi ɔ ngɛ sɔlee mohu, se imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i li nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ ma pee kɛɛ? I kɛ mumi maa sɔle, se i kɛ juɛmi hu maa sɔle; i kɛ mumi ma la, se i kɛ juɛmi hu ma la.

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Moo o ngɛ Mawu si nae saminya mohu, se nɔ kpa a lɛɛ o ha we nɛ e na he se ko kulaa.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: I naa Mawu si kaa i pe nyɛ tsuo ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi mi.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ke asafo ɔ ba bua a, imi lɛɛ i ko suɔ nɛ ma tu munyungu kakaaka enuɔ nɛ sisi numi ngɛ he nɛ ma kɛ tsɔɔ ní pe kaa ma tu munyungu akpeakpe ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a mi.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: A ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi ke, “Ma gu nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi a nɔ, Nɛ ma tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ ye ma a; Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de. Ma tu munyu kɛ gu nibwɔhi a nɔ, se kɛ̃ ye ma a be mi tue bue.”

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi ji okadi kɛ ha nihi nɛ he we yi, pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ. Sane kpakpa a fiɛmi lɛɛ nihi nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a we okadi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ, pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke asafo ɔ tsuo nya ba bua, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ bɔni gbi slɔɔtohi tumi, nɛ ni komɛ nɛ mɛɛ a li mi eko, aloo a he we yi ba lejɛ ɔ, anɛ a be dee ke nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ godo nue lo?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe, nɛ nɔ ko nɛ lɛɛ e he we yi, aloo e li mi eko ba lejɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ ma ha nɛ e maa na e he yayami. Níhi nɛ e nu ɔ tsuo maa kojo lɛ.

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: E tsui mi laami sanehi tsuo maa je kpo paa; e ma kpla si ma ja Mawu, nɛ e maa jaje ke, “Niinɛ, Mawu kɛ nyɛ ngɛ!” Blɔ nya tomi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji, ke nyɛ nya ba bua kɛ ha Mawu jami ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ kake nɛ je la, nɔ ko nɛ tsɔɔ ní, nɛ nɔ ko hu nɛ ha sɛ gbi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ. Nɔ kpa nɛ tu gbi slɔɔtohi, konɛ nɔ kpa ko hu nɛ tsɔɔ sisi. Nyɛɛ pee níhi tsuo ngɛ a blɔ nɔ kɛ ha asafo ɔ nɔ yami.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Ke a ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi tue ɔ, nɔ kake nɛ tu nɛ e gbe nya loko nɔ kpa hu nɛ ba. Ke munyu tuli ɔmɛ a he hiɛ hluu ɔ, e pee ni etɛ pɛ, konɛ nɔ ko nɛ je nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ sisi.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ sisi ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi tue ɔ nɛ pee dii; e tu munyu ha lɛ nɔ kake e he, kɛ Mawu.

english_verse: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
translation_verse: Ni enyɔ, loo etɛ nɛ ná Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ a tu munyu, konɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ nɛ a susu he.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Se ke nɔ ko hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ Mawu je nɔ́ ko tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ kpa.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma nyɛ maa fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ kakaaka, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kase ní, nɛ e ya nɔ.

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: Mawu sume basabasa, se mohu tue mi jɔmi e suɔ. Bɔ nɛ níhi ngɛ ngɛ Mawu we asafo ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ kpe nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Mawu jae ɔ, yi ɔmɛ nɛ a pee dii. A ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a tu munyu, mohu a ba a he si kaa bɔ nɛ Mose mlaa a hu tsɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a le ɔ, a bi a hunomɛ ngɛ we mi. Ke asafo ɔ ba bua nɛ a ngɛ Mawu jae ɔ, e ji zo kaa yo maa tu munyu.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Mawu munyu ɔ, nyɛ ngɔ nɛ e puɛ kɛ je? Aloo nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛ ngɔ nɛ e ba su?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ke e peeɔ nɔ ko kaa gbalɔ ji lɛ, aloo kaa e ngɛ mumi mi nike ní ko ɔ, e na nɛ e le kaa níhi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi i ngɛ ngmae ngɛ.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko bui enɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ ko pee nɔ ɔ he akɔtaa.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛmi he, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ ko tsi gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi nya.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Á pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ blɔ nya tomi nya.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ pɛtɛ sane kpakpa a he wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fiɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, a ma he nyɛ yi wami. Ke pi jã lɛɛ nyɛ he ye yaka gu.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ he hia pe kulaa nɛ imi hu i na a, i ngɔ ba ha nyɛ. Lɔ ɔ ji kaa Kristo gbo ngɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔmɛ ke a pu lɛ, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ, a tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, e jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ e se nyɛɛli maa pee lafa enuɔ kɛ se si kake. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni babauu ngɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, se ni komɛ hu gbo.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Nyagbe kulaa a, e jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ imi hulɔ, imi nɛ i ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ a kpatu fɔ lɛ ɔ!

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Imi ji bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti nɔ nɛ sɛ́ pe kulaa; i sɛ́ kaa a tsɛɛ mi bɔfo po, ejakaa i wa Mawu we asafo ɔ yi mi.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Se Mawu dloomi lɛ pee mi nɔ́ nɛ i ji mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ dloomi nɛ e dloo mi ɔ pee we yaka. Ee, i tsu ní wawɛɛ pe bɔfo kpa amɛ tsuo kulaa, se pi imi; Mawu dloomi ɔ mohu lɛ tsu ní ɔ.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi jio, mɛ jio, e hia we kulaa; nɔ́ nɛ he hia kɛkɛ ji kaa wɔ tsuo wa fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ he ye. Kristo se nyɛɛli maa te si

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ wa sɛ gbi ɔ ji kaa Mawu tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ ti ni komɛ deɔ ke a be ni gbogboehi si tlee kɛ ba wami mi ɔ?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ke a be ni gbogboehi si tlee kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ a tle we Kristo hu si mɔ.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Ke a tle we Kristo si kɛ bɛ wami mi ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ wa fiɛmi ɔ pee yaka; nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ hu pee yaka.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ! E tsɔɔ kaa wa ye Mawu he lakpa, ejakaa wa de ke e tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje. Se ke e ngɛ mi kaa a tle we ni gbogboehi si kɛ bɛ wami mi ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ Mawu tsa tle we Kristo si mɔ.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke a tle we ni gbogboehi si ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo hu a tle we lɛ si.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu tle we Kristo si ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ pee yaka, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ yayami he wami ɔ sisi kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ he Kristo ye nɛ a gbo ɔ, mɛ hu a hɛ mi kpata.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ke wami nɛ ɔ mi kɛkɛ he nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Kristo nɔ ngɛ ɔ, lɛɛ wa ní ngɛ mɔbɔ pe nihi tsuo.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Se anɔkuale ɔ ji kaa Mawu tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje nɛ e kɛ ye odase kaa e ma tle ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo si.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ gbenɔ gu adesa nɔ kɛ ba a, jã nɔuu kɛ̃ adesa nɔ gbogboehi a si temi ɔ gu kɛ ba.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ nihi tsuo ngɛ Adam mi gboɔ ɔ, jã nɔuu kɛ̃ a ma tle nihi tsuo si ngɛ Kristo mi.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Se Mawu ma tle nɔ tsuaa nɔ si ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. Kekleekle nɔ ji Kristo, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ke Kristo ma a, a ma tle e we bi ɔmɛ hu si.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, je mi nyagbe maa ba. Kristo maa ye mumi mi nɔ yeli, kɛ blɔ nyahi, kɛ he wami tsuo a nɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha Mawu nɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Ejakaa ja Kristo ye matsɛ kɛ maa su be nɛ Mawu maa ngɔ e he nyɛli tsuo ngɔ wo e nane si.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Nyagbe he nyɛlɔ nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi ji gbenɔ.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ ke, “Mawu ngɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ wo e nane si.” Se e fɔɔ si paa kaa munyu “níhi tsuo” ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa lɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ nɛ e ngɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ wo Kristo nane si ɔ hu piɛ he.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Se ke a ngɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ wo Kristo nɔ yemi sisi ɔ, lɛɛ Bi ɔ nitsɛ hu maa ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ ngɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ wo e nɔ yemi sisi ɔ. Nɛ Mawu maa ye ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, daa ligbi ɔ, i ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi! Fiami nɛ i fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ji kaa wa le Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a sisi nyɛ. “Huɛ yaya bɔmi puɛɔ je mi bami kpakpa.”

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Nyɛ susu nyɛ yi mi saminya nɛ nyɛ kpa yayami peemi. I ngɛ dee nɛ zo nɛ gbe nyɛ kaa nyɛ ti ni komɛ li Mawu. Nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a kɛ maa te si

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Se nɔ ko ma bi ke, “Kɛ a maa pee kɛ tle ni gbogboehi si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu kɛɛ? Nɛ mɛni nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a maa hɛɛ?”

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Kuasia! Ke o du ní ɔ, ja wu ɔ gbo ngɛ zu mi loko e maa puɛ.

english_verse: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ hu, wu ngmelu kɛkɛ kaa ngma, loo e henɔ ko nɛ o du ɔ nɛ; pi tso nɛ maa puɛ ɔ.

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Se Mawu haa jamɛ a wu ɔ tso nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ suɔ; e haa wu tsuaa wu tso pɛ nɛ hi ha lɛ.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Hiɔwe nɔmlɔ tsohi ngɛ, nɛ zugba nɔ nɔmlɔ tsohi hu ngɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, slo hiɔwe ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyami, kɛ a he fɛu ngɛ zugba nɔ ní ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Slo pu hɛ mi nyami kɛ afɛu, nɛ slo nyɔhiɔ hu nɔ́. Slo dodoehi hu a hɛ mi nyami kɛ afɛu; dodoe kake nɔ́ je ekpa ngɛ kake nɔ́ he.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: E ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a ma tle ni gbogboehi si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ a pu kaa wu ɔ ma puɛ, se nɔ́ nɛ a ma tle si ɔ lɛɛ e be puɛe.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ ke, “A bɔ kekleekle Adam ɔ nɔmlɔ hɛngmengmletsɛ,” nɛ nyagbe Adam ɔ ba pee mumi nɛ haa nɔ wami.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Se he lo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he hia we kaa mumi nɔ́ ɔ; ejakaa he lo nɔ́ ɔ ba kekle loko mumi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ he hia pe lɔ ɔ ba.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Kekleekle Adam ɔ, zugba zu a kɛ bɔ lɛ; Adam enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ hiɔwe nɛ e je.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ kaa Adam, nɔ nɛ a kɛ zu pee ɔ. Se ni nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a maa hi kaa Kristo, nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a nɔuu.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛ wɔ nɛ a bɔ wɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi no ɔ subai nɔ ɔ, wa ma ba hɛɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ subai.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ji kaa he lo kɛ muɔ nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue; nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ nine be nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we nɔ sue.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu tue! Anɔkuale laami sane nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee nɛ ɔ nɛ. Wɔ tsuo wa be gboe! Se ke nyagbe titimati ɔ pɛ ɔ, a ma tsake wɔ tsuo amlɔ kaa a fiaa hɛngmɛ. Ejakaa ke titimati ɔ pɛ ɔ, ni gbogboe ɔmɛ maa te si, nɛ a be gboe hu gblegbleegble. Nɛ a ma tsake wɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ja nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ nɛ ɔ tsake pee nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ gboɔ nɛ ɔ tsake pee nɔ́ nɛ gbo we.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Ke nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ ɔ tsake pee nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ gboɔ ɔ tsake pee nɔ́ nɛ gbo we ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ngmami ɔ maa ba mi: “A mi gbenɔ kɛ ye kunimi!”

english_verse: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
translation_verse: Mo gbenɔ, jije o kɛɛ ɔ ngɛ? Mo gbeje, jije o kunimi yemi ɔ ngɛ?

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Gbenɔ kɛɛ ɔ ji yayami, nɛ yayami he wami ɔ ji mlaa a.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Se sina ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa wa yeɔ kunimi kɛ guu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ!

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Daa otsi mi kekleekle ligbi ɔ, sika nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ naa ngɛ otsi ɔ mi ɔ, e je eko ngɔ to, nɛ e hi nya buae. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke i ba a, e be hiae kaa a tsu sika hu.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Ke i ba a, ma tsɔ nihi nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ buu mɛ kɛ womi, konɛ a ngɔ nyɛ nike ní ɔ kɛ ya Yerusalem.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Nɛ ke e hia kaa imi hu ma ya a, i kɛ mɛ maa ya. Paulo yi mi tomi

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: Ma ya gu Makedonia loko ma ba nyɛ ngɔ, ejakaa i to ye yi mi kaa ma ya gu lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Eko ɔ, ma hi nyɛ ngɔ be saii, nɛ ma ye fĩɛ be ɔ po ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛ maa wo mi blɔ kɛ ya he tsuaa he nɛ ma yaa.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ i sume kaa ma ba na nyɛ kpiti kɛkɛ nɛ ma je. Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ngmɛ blɔ ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa ma kɛ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Ma hi Efeso hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si Pentekoste ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Blɔ bli ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsu ní saminya, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ mi ɔ, mɛ hu a ngɛ hiɛ ɔ babauu.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Ke Timoteo ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ nɛ e ko ye gbeye, ejakaa lɛ hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsumi ɔ nɔuu nɛ e ngɛ tsue kaa imi.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɛ ko bu lɛ kaa pi nɔ ko ji lɛ. Se mohu nyɛɛ hyɛ, konɛ e tsa e blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. I ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa e kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ maa kpale kɛ ba.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ wa nyɛmi Apolo ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. I kpa lɛ pɛɛ hluu kaa e kɛ nyɛmimɛ kpa amɛ nɛ a ba slaa nyɛ ngɛ Korinto, se e to kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e be nyɛe maa ba. Pee se ke e ba na blɔ hu e maa ba. Nyagbe munyuhi

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ huɔ; nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ; nyɛɛ pee kã, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ wa.

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ suɔmi nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Tse nyɛ le Stefana, kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ. Mɛ ji kekleekle nihi nɛ tsake pee Kristo se nyɛɛli ngɛ Akaya, nɛ a ngɔ a he ngɔ ha kaa a ma sɔmɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. Ye nyɛmimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ,

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ i kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: A ba wo mi bua kaa bɔ nɛ a wo nyɛ hu bua a. E hia kaa nyɛɛ le nihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ saminya.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asafo ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ Asia a ke a biɔ nyɛ. Akuila, kɛ Priskila, kɛ asafo ɔ nɛ kpee ngɛ a we ɔ mi ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ saminya ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nitsɛ nɛ́ i ngma nyɛ enɛ ɔ, i biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sume Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ! Wa Nyɔmtsɛ, ba!

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ye suɔmi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si ngɛ Kristo Yesu biɛ mi! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ɔ, i kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo lɛ ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Mawu asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Korinto, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Akaya a.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ. Paulo na Mawu si

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ yi. Tsɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e ji Mawu nɛ woɔ wɔ bua ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi hulɔ.

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: E woɔ wa bua ngɛ haomihi tsuo a mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke haomi ba ni kpahi a nɔ ɔ, bua womi nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa na kɛ je Mawu dɛ mi ɔ, wa ma nyɛ kɛ wo mɛ hu bua.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa ngɛ amanehlu babauu nae kaa Kristo se nyɛɛ li. Se bɔ nɛ Mawu wo Kristo bua a, ja nɔuu kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu woɔ wɔ hu wa bua.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Ke wa ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, e baa konɛ Mawu nɛ wo nyɛ bua nɛ e he nyɛ yi wami. Be tsuaa be nɛ Mawu maa wo wɔ bua a, nyɛ hu nyɛ naa jamɛ a bua womi ɔ eko. Enɛ ɔ haa nɛ ke nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu nae kaa wɔ ɔ, nyɛ toɔ nyɛ tsui si.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ wawɛɛ, ejakaa wa le kaa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae kaa wɔ nɛ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ a maa wo nyɛ bua kaa wɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, amanehlu nɛ wa na ngɛ Asia a, wa sume kaa wa maa laa nyɛ nɔ́ ko. Wa na nɔ́ tsɔ pe bɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ, nɛ wa hɛ be nɔ kaa wa maa hi je mi tete.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Wa na paa kaa peepee ta wa he, nɛ gbenɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si ha wɔ. Se nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi, konɛ wa ko ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nɔ, se mohu waa ngɔ wa he kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ. Ejakaa lɛ nɛ e tleɔ ni gbogboehi si.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ́ je wɔ kɛ je gbenɔ muɔ nya kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ wɔ jee kɛ mwɔɔ; nɛ e ma je wɔ ekohu. Wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ kaa e maa kpale je wɔ kulaa.

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ piɛ wa he kɛ kpa pɛɛ, konɛ nihi babauu nɛ na Mawu si ha wɔ kaa nihi babauu a pɛɛ kpami nya a, wa na dloomi nike níhi. Paulo tsake e yi mi tomi

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ kake nɛ wa fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ nɔ, nɛ wa he nile hu yeɔ he odase ji kaa wa baa wa je mi saminya ngɛ he tsuaa he, titli ngɛ waa kɛ nyɛ wa bɔmi mi kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ hlae ɔ. Wa yeɔ anɔkuale nɛ mu ko mu ko be wa he. Pi wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nile nɛ waa kɛ peeɔ enɛ ɔ, se mohu Mawu dloomi ɔ nya.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i le saminya a a he je nɛ i to ye yi mi kekle ɔ kaa ma ba slaa nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ na gbaami ɔ si enyɔ.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: Ejakaa i to kaa ke i yaa Makedonia a, ma ba gu nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ ke i kpale ye se kɛ ma hu ma ba gu nyɛ ngɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ wo mi blɔ kɛ ya Yudea.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Blɔɔ nɛ i tsake ye yi mi tomi ɔ, anɛ yi mi flɛflɛ i kɛ pee lo? Ke i ngɛ ye yi mi toe ɔ, anɛ i peeɔ ye ní kaa yaka nɔ ko kɛkɛ nɛ deɔ “Ee” kɛ “Dɛbi” be kake too lo?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Mawu yeɔ anɔkuale, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wa de nyɛ ɔ, pi “Ee” kɛ “Dɛbi” nɛ a deɔ be kake too ji lɔ ɔ.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Ejakaa sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Mawu Bi, Yesu Kristo ɔ he nɛ i kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo fiɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ tsakee we kɛ je “Ee” ba pee “Dɛbi” be kake too. Mohu ɔ, lɛ ji “Ee” Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu woɔ he si ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ kɛ guu Yesu Kristo nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ wa deɔ “Amen” ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi kɛ woɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Mawu ji nɔ nɛ peeɔ waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo anɔkuale Kristo se nyɛɛli. Mawu nitsɛ lɛ hla wɔ ngɔ to,

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: I na Mawu kaa pe i sume nɛ ma hao nyɛ, lɔ ɔ he loko i tsake ye yi mi tomi ɔ, nɛ i bɛ Korinto ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Wa sume kaa wa maa nyɛ nyɛ nɔ nɛ waa tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ he ye; wa le kaa nyɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ. Mohu ɔ, waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní tsue, konɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke i ha nɛ nyɛ ní pee mɔbɔ ɔ, mɛnɔ maa wo mi bua? Pi nyɛ nihi nɛ i ha nyɛ ní pee mɔbɔ ɔ kɛ̃ lo?

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he nɛ i ngma nyɛ womi ɔ nɛ. I sume kaa ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nihi nɛ ma ha mi bua jɔmi ɔ, ma ha nɛ mɛ mohu a ní nɛ pee mɔbɔ. Ejakaa i le kaa ke ye bua jɔ kɛkɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ bua jɔ.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi ɔ ngmae ɔ, he hiami sɔuu ha nɛ ye tsui kpa miɔ nɛ e ma tsɔ, nɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ vo nyu ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi jee kɛ ngɛ si puee. Pi ye yi mi tomi ji kaa ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ, se mohu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ na bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ha. Paulo ngɔ nɔ ko nɛ tɔ ɔ he yayami kɛ pa lɛ

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ha nɛ nyɛ ye kɔmɔ ɔ, pi imi nɔ́ nɛ e pee; ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nɔ́ lɛ e pee ɔ nɛ. .

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Jamɛatsɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ti ni komɛ gbla e tue kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ e hiɛ.

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ e he yayami kɛ pa lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo lɛ bua, konɛ e ko ba ye kɔmɔ tsɔ, nɛ e kɔni mi ba jɔ̃.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ e le kaa nyɛ suɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: I ngma nyɛ jamɛ a womi ɔ nɛ ma kɛ ka nyɛ ma hyɛ kaa ke i de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, nyɛ maa pee lo.

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: I peeɔ enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Abosiami nɛ ko na he wami ngɛ wa nɔ, ejakaa wa le gahi nɛ e toɔ. Paulo hi Troya be kpiti pɛ

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ba Troya nɛ ma ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ, i na kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dla blɔ ngɔ to mi nɛ ma tsu ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: Se i hao, ejakaa i nɛ wa nyɛmi Tito. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ mɛ ye sɛ, nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ ho Makedonia ya. Kristo ha wa ye kunimi

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Se sina ha Mawu! Mawu haa Kristo yeɔ yayami he wami ɔ nɔ kunimi daa, nɛ kikɛmɛ a kunimi yemi nɛ ɔ peeɔ wɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ hu wa nɔ́. Mawu guu wa nɔ kɛ fiɛɔ sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ kɛ yaa he tsuaa he kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko he via yaa tsitsaa a.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ yaa hɛ mi kpatami mi ɔ, Kristo sɛ gbi ɔ ji gbenɔ ha mɛ. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ yaa neneene wami mi ɔ lɛɛ sɛ gbi ɔ ji wami ha mɛ. Ní tsumi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be kaa ni kpa komɛ nɛ mɛɛ a ngɔ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɔ pee je juami nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ngɛ si kpae ɔ. Se mohu kaa nihi nɛ le Kristo ɔ, wa tuɔ anɔkuale ɔ sisi kaa nihi nɛ a tsɔ mɛ kɛ je Mawu nitsɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Ke wa de jã a, anɛ lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa wa ngɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa yi jee ekohu lo? Anɛ yi jemi womi nɛ ni kpahi maa ngma kɛ ba je wa yi ha nyɛ, aloo nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ngma kɛ ya je wa yi ha ni kpahi he hia wɔ lo? Dɛbi!

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ji yi jemi womi nɛ a ngma ha wɔ ngɛ wa tsui mi, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kane nɛ e nu sisi.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ngɛ kaa womi nɛ Kristo nitsɛ ngma nɛ e kɛ tsɔ wɔ; pi womi nɛ a kɛ ní ngmami nyu ngmaa ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛhi a nɔ ɔ. Se mohu, enɛ ɔ ji womi nɛ Kristo ngma kɛ gu Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ mumi ɔ nɔ ngɛ adesa tsui mi.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, wa ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ Mawu mi.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Ní tsumi nɛ ɔ, wa be dee ke wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa ngɛ he wami nɛ wa ma nyɛ tsu. He wami nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ, Mawu lɛ ha wɔ.

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: Mawu nɛ ha nɛ wa nyɛ nɛ wa ngɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ sɔmɔe kaa bɔ nɛ somi he ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ. Pi mlaa nɛ a ngma nɛ waa ye nɔ ji somi he ɔ, se mohu Mawu mumi. Mlaa nɛ a ngma a, gbenɔ nɛ e kɛ baa, se mumi ɔ haa nɔ wami.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Mlaa a nɛ a kpɛ́ ngɛ tɛhi a nɔ nɛ kɛ gbenɔ ba a, benɛ a ngɔ ha a, Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ je kpo. Hɛ mi nyami ɔ ha nɛ Mose hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe. Ke jamɛ a be ɔ mi po nɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ miɔ nɛ e maa ta a, e ha nɛ Mose hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛ we Mose hɛ mi hyɛmi ɔ,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: lɛɛ be nɛ ɔ mi nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, anɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ be kpɛe kulaa pe kekle ɔ lo?

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Ke hɛ mi nyami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ je kpo somi momo be ɔ mi ɔ, somi he be nɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ma kpɛ kɛ be nɔ pe kekle ɔ po.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ́ nɛ hi si be kpiti kɛkɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami je kpo ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ daa a hɛ mi nyami ɔ pe lɔ ɔ hluu.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Wa be kaa Mose nɛ ngɔ hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ngɔ ha e hɛ mi, konɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a kó na kaa e hɛ mi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ɔ se miɔ nɛ e maa po ɔ.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, a nga a juɛmi nya! Kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ jamɛ a hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ ha a hɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ; ejakaa ke a kane somi momo ɔ, a nui sisi. Kristo pɛ lɛ ma nyɛ ma je hɛ mi hami nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
translation_verse: Ee, kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ a ngɛ Mose mlaa a kanee ɔ, hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ ha a juɛmi nɔ.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Se ke a kpale kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛkɛ a ma je hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ ha mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji mumi ɔ nɛ, nɛ he nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ he yemi ngɛ.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Mawu naa mɔbɔ he je ɔ, e ha wɔ ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ke wa tsu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kɔni mi jɔ̃ we.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Wa kpa laami mi zo ní tsumi; wa yi kutupɔ, nɛ Mawu munyu ɔ hu wa tsakee we hɛ mi. Wa fiɛɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ paa ngɛ ma hɛ mi, nɛ wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa nihi nɛ a ná wa he juɛmi kpakpa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, sane kpakpa a nɛ wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, ni komɛ nui sisi; mɛ ji nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: A he we sane kpakpa a yi, ejakaa je nɛ ɔ mi mawu ɔ yu a mumi mi hɛngmɛ; nɛ la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, a nɛ. Sane kpakpa a nɛ woɔ Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ, la nɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ gbɛe kɛ ngɛ fĩae. Kristo ɔ, e kɛ Mawu hɛɛ su kake.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa de we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he; se mohu wa ngɛ fiɛe ke Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔmtsɛ. Wɔɔ lɛɛ Yesu he ɔ, nyɛ tsɔli ji wɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Mawu lɛ de ke, “La nɛ tso kɛ je diblii mi.” Lɛ Mawu ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa la kpɛɔ ngɛ wa tsui mi. Nɛ la nɛ ɔ haa wa leɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami nɛ kpɛɔ ngɛ Kristo hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: Wɔ nɛ wa ná kikɛmɛ a mumi mi juetli nɛ ɔ, wa ngɛ kaa zu buɛhi. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ, Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je, pi wɔɔ wa ngɔ.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Nihi haoɔ wɔ be tsuaa be, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a yi wa nɔ; be komɛ ɔ, wa yi mi peeɔ wɔ enyɔɔnyɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa nine mi wui nyu;

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: a waa wɔ yi mi, se kɛ̃ ɔ, Mawu lɛɛ e kua we wɔ; be komɛ hu a kongoɔ wɔ basabasa, se wa gbo we.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Wa wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ, Yesu he ɔ, nihi ngɛ wɔ dae nɛ a gbe wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na Kristo wami ɔ ngɛ wa he lo nɛ ma gbo nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔɔ wa ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ ke, “I he Mawu ye, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i tu munyu.” Wɔ hu wa ngɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔuu; wɔ hu wa heɔ yeɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ngɛ fiɛe.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa le kaa Mawu tle Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu. Wa le kaa e ma tle wɔ hu si kaa bɔ nɛ e tle Yesu si ɔ. Nɛ e maa ngɔ waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo kɛ ya Yesu ngɔ.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Nyɛ he nɛ a ngɛ enɛ ɔ tsuo pee ngɛ. Nɛ ke Mawu dloomi nya a, a ba he nihi fuu a yi wami ɔ, jã kɛ̃ sina sɔlemi ɔ maa hiɛ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami. Si himi ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nya

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wa kɔni mi jɔ̃ we gblegbleegble. E ngɛ mi kaa wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ngɛ puɛe bɔɔbɔɔbɔɔ mohu, se mumi mi ɔ, wa ngɛ wae daa ligbi.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Amanehlu nɛ nya wa, nɛ se be kɛe kulaa nɛ ɔ ma ha wa hɛ mi maa ba nyami babauu kɛ be nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ níhi nɛ a nɛ́ nɔ, se pi níhi nɛ a naa. Ejakaa níhi nɛ a naa a, hii si be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ; se níhi nɛ a nɛ́ ɔ, hii si kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa le kaa ke a puɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bo tsu nɛ wa ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha wɔ we ngɛ hiɔwe. We nɛ ɔ, pi nine nɛ a kɛ ma, nɛ e maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ wa ngɛ bo tsu nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, wa hɛ jaa, nɛ wa faa huu kaa a ngɔ wa tsu nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ ngɔ wo wɔ.

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: Ke wa ngɔ lɔ ɔ kɛ ha wa he ɔ, nɔ ko be nae kaa wa hɛɛ wa he gu.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ wa ngɛ bo tsu nɛ ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, wa he hiaa wɔ, nɛ wa faa huu. Pi kaa wa suɔ kaa waa ngmɛɛ wa zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bo tsu ɔ he, se mohu kaa waa ngɔ hiɔwe nɔ́ ɔ hu kɛ ha wa he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ wami ɔ ma tsake nɔ́ nɛ gboɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Mawu lɛ je blɔ dla wɔ kɛ ha tsakemi nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha wɔ e mumi ɔ kɛ ma nɔ mi.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wa nɔ gbagba teɔ. Ejakaa wa le kaa be abɔ nɛ wa ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he kɛ.

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: Ejakaa he mi kɛ yemi nya wa baa wa je mi ngɛ, se pi níhi nɛ wa na a he.

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: Wa nɔ gbagba te, nɛ wa na nɛ wa je wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi, nɛ wa ho nɛ waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ya hi si.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ tso nɛ ɔ mi wa ngɛ jio, pe wa je mi nɛ wa ho ya piɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he jio, nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ ma wa hɛ mi ji kaa waa sa e hɛ mi.

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: Ejakaa ja wɔ tsuo wa pue ngɛ Kristo hɛ mi, nɛ e kojo wɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na nɔ́ nɛ e tsu ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he hiɔwo, kpakpa jio, yayami jio. Mawu kɛ huɛ bɔmi ngɛ Kristo mi

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nɛ waa kɛ bu yee Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye ɔ, wa bɔɔ mɔde tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi. Wɔ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ, Mawu le bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ha. Nɛ i heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ le wɔ kɛ pi si jã nɔuu.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko susu kaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa yi wa pa ngɛ jee ha nyɛ ekohu. Dɛbi! Waa kɛ enɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ blɔ hae, konɛ nyɛ kɛ fĩa ngɔ fɔ wa nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ hyɛɛ nihi a hɛ mi, se pi a tsui mi, nɛ a fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma ná nɔ́ ko ma de mɛ.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Anɛ wa ngɛ godo nue niinɛ lo? Lɛɛ Mawu he wa ngɛ godo nue ngɛ mɔ! Se ke wa ngɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e hi ha nyɛ kaa wa ngɛ jã.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Suɔmi nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ woɔ wɔ he wami. Kristo gbo ha wɔ tsuo. Nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ kaa gbenɔ nɛ nɔ kake gbo ha nihi tsuo nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa ni ɔmɛ tsuo gbo.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Kristo gbo ha nihi tsuo, konɛ nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ, a ko pee mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya ní hu; se mohu a pee Kristo suɔmi nya ní. Ejakaa Kristo gbo, nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ngɛ mɛɛ a he.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ba pee Kristo nɔ́ kɛkɛ e plɛ bɔ nɔ́ he; blema ní ɔmɛ tsuo be kɛ ho. Hyɛ, níhi tsuo pee e he.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Mawu lɛ pee enɛ ɔ tsuo. Kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e dla waa kɛ lɛ wa kpɛti. Nɛ ní tsumi nɛ e ngɔ wo wa dɛ ji kaa wa ha nɛ a dla e kɛ nihi tsuo a kpɛti.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ji kaa kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu ngɔ je ɔ tsuo he yayami kɛ pa mɛ, nɛ e ngɛ e kɛ je ɔ tsuo a kpɛti dlae; nɛ sɛ gbi nɛ e tu ngɔ wo wa dɛ mi ji kaa e suɔ nɛ a dla e kɛ je ɔ tsuo a kpɛti.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ji bɔfohi ngɛ Kristo biɛ mi ejakaa Mawu gu wa nɔ nɛ e kɛ nihi ngɛ munyu tue. Waa kɛ Kristo biɛ ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae ke nyɛ ha nɛ a dla nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Kristo pee we yayami, se wa he ɔ, Mawu bu lɛ yayami peelɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛ wa ba pee Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ, wa peeɔ níhi nɛ da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ waa kɛ Mawu ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, dloomi nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je Mawu dɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ e pee yaka.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Mawu ke, “Be nɛ sa mi ɔ, i bu mo tue; Nɛ yi wami hemi ligbi nɔ i ye bua mo ngɛ.” Hyɛ, be nɛ sa saminya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; hyɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ ji yi wami hemi ligbi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa wa ko ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ tsi nɔ ko blɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko gbe sɔmɔmi ní tsumi nɛ wa hɛɛ mi ɔ he guɛ.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Se mohu ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa wa maa tsɔɔ kaa Mawu tsɔli ji wɔ niinɛ. Wa toɔ wa tsui si ngɛ haomi, kɛ fimi, kɛ he hiami mi.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: A fia wɔ ní; a wo wɔ tsu, nɛ nihi pee basabasa kɛ wo wɔ; wa gbo dengme kɛ tsu ní; wa hwɔ we mahe be komɛ, nɛ be komɛ hu hwɔ yee wɔ.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: Waa kɛ subai kpakpa, nile nɛ mi kuɔ, tsui si tomi, mi mi himi, klɔuklɔu peemi ngɛ mumi mi, anɔkuale suɔmi,

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: anɔkuale munyu tumi, kɛ Mawu he wami nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ wa mi ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu tsɔli ji wɔ. Wa peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ lɔ ɔ ji wa ta hwumi ní nɛ waa hɛɛ hiɔ kɛ muɔ nɛ wa kɛ faa wa he.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ woɔ wa hɛ mi nyami, se ni komɛ gbeɔ wa he guɛ; ni komɛ jɛɔ wɔ, se ni komɛ hu jeɔ wa yi. A tsɛɔ wɔ nɔ sisili, se anɔkuale wa tuɔ.

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ a li mɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ le wɔ; wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, se kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ, wa hɛ ngɛ. A gblaa wa tue, se wa gbo we.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: A naa wɔ kaa kɔmɔ yeli, se daa nɛ ɔ, wa bua jɔ; wa ngɛ kaa ohiatsɛmɛ, se wa haa nɛ nihi babauu peeɔ niatsɛmɛ; wa ngɛ kaa dɛgutsɛmɛ, se wa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Wa nyɛmimɛ Korinto bi! Waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ je wa tsui mi faa.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa je wa suɔmi kpo ha nyɛ; nyɛ lɛ nyɛ gbo we wa nɔ.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ, i kɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ imi nitsɛ ye bimɛ maa tu munyu ɔ. Nyɛ hu nyɛ bli nyɛ tsui nya gbajaa ha wɔ. Nihi nɛ li Kristo ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko bɔ

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ kó bɔ. Dami sane yemi kɛ mlaa tɔmi ɔ, mɛni kake peemi ngɛ a kpɛti? Aloo mɛni bɔmi lɛ ngɛ la kɛ diblii a kpɛti?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Kɛ Kristo kɛ Abosiami maa ye kɛɛ? Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ, mɛni mi e kɛ nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ ngɛ?

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Mɛni kake peemi ngɛ Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ amagahi a kpɛti? Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ sɔlemi we ji wɔ! Mawu de ke, “I kɛ ye ma a maa hi si; ma pee a Mawu, nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.”

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ je a kpɛti, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ he kɛ je a he. Nyɛ ko ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he; nɛ ma he nyɛ atuu.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Ma pee nyɛ tsɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa pee ye binyumuhi kɛ ye biyihi. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Ope ɔ, lɛ i de.”

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: Siwohi nɛ wa na kɛ je Mawu dɛ mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ nyɛ ha wa je níhi tsuo nɛ woɔ wa nɔmlɔ tso, kɛ mumi he mu kɛ ya se, konɛ wa he nɛ tsɔ kulaa kɛ hi si ngɛ Mawu gbeye yemi nya. Paulo na bua jɔmi

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Nyɛ je nyɛ suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ! Wa pee we nɔ ko yayami; wa kpataa we nɔ ko nane, nɛ wa sisi we nɔ ko hulɔ.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: I de we enɛ ɔ nɛ ma kɛ bu nyɛ fɔ. Se kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momo ɔ, suɔmi nɛ wa ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nya wa bɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe ma gba waa kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti, gbenɔ jio, wami nɛ ɔ mi jio.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: I fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ, ejakaa i ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi babauu ngɛ nyɛ mi. Ngɛ wa haomi ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, ye nine mi ji wu; ye bua jɔmi mohu lɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Benɛ wa ba su Makedonia tete po wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ na we he jɔmi kulaa; he tsuaa he ɔ, haomi sɔuu. Be mi nɛ ni kpahi kɛ wɔ ngɛ pɛ nɔ daa nɛ ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu gbeye sɔuu wa ngɛ yee.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Tito ba a, Mawu, nɔ nɛ woɔ nihi nɛ a nine mi jɔ̃ he wami ɔ ha nɛ wa nɔ gbagba te.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a womi ɔ nɛ i ngma nyɛ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ hao mohu lɛɛ, se i pia we ye he kaa i ngma. I pia ye he kaa womi ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ hao, pohu be kpiti ko kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ ye bua jɔ ye he kaa i ngma womi ɔ. Ye bua jɔɛ ye he kaa i ha nɛ nyɛ hao, se mohu ye bua jɔ kaa lɔ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ tsake nyɛ blɔhi. Ejakaa e hao nyɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa pee we nyɛ nɔ́ ko yeyee.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke o hao bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ, e haa o tsakeɔ o tsui, nɛ a heɔ o yi wami. Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ he piami ko be mi! Se ke o hao ngɛ níhi nɛ sa je ɔ hɛ mi he ɔ, gbenɔ lɛ jeɔ mi.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Nɛ́ e pee nyɛ kaa nyɛ hao ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba! Nyɛ nɔ gbagba te, nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ pee we yayami ko. Nɔ́ nɛ ba a dɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye gbeye kaa nɔ́ ko pa ngɛ se kɛ ma. E pee nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ na mi, konɛ nyɛ fa ye he, nɛ nyɛɛ gbla yayami peelɔ ɔ tue. Ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ tsɔɔ kaa sane nɛ ba a, nyɛ li he nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, womi ɔ nɛ i ngma nyɛ ɔ, tsa pi nɔ ɔ, aloo nɔ nɛ a tɔ̃ e nɔ ɔ he titli nɛ e kɔɔ. I ngma womi ɔ konɛ dengme nɛ nyɛ ngɛ gboe ngɛ wa he ɔ nɛ je kpo paa ha nyɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ lɛ ha nɛ wa nɔ gbagba te ɔ nɛ. Wa nɔ gbagba te niinɛ. Se bua jɔmi nɛ Tito na a ha nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu wa bua jɔ kɛ be nɔ. Ejakaa e bɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ e tsui nɔ e mi ha.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: I je nyɛ yi ha Tito, nɛ nyɛ gbi mi zo. Wa tuɔ nyɛ anɔkuale daa. Jã kɛ̃ ɔ, fiami nɛ wa fĩa fɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ Tito ɔ hu ya pee we lakpa.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: Tito kaiɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ he si bami, kɛ bu he lɛ atuu, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ pee klaalo nɛ ke e de nyɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e na suɔmi babauu kɛ ha nyɛ pe kekle ɔ po.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Ye bua jɔ kaa ma nyɛ ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ nyɛ nɔ kulaa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ! Wa ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ le nɔ́ nɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ tsu ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Makedonia.
