english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: I ngɛ odase yee kaa a ha bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ kɛ je a tsui mi faa; ee, a ha pe bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ po.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: A kɛ hɛdɔ babauu kpa wɔ pɛɛ ke wa ha nɛ mɛ hu a pee a blɔ nya kɛ ye bua ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɛ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ, wa hɛ be nɔ kulaa! Kekleekle ɔ, a ngɔ a he ngɔ ha kaa a ma sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ. Jehanɛ hu, a wo wɔ si ke a maa bu wɔ tue kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu hlaa nɛ a pee ɔ.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa Tito pɛɛ kaa tsui mi faa ní tsumi nɛ ɔ nɛ e je sisi momo ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, e tsa nɔ kɛ yaa si e maa gbe nya.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ngɛ ni kpa amɛ a hɛ mi kulaa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ Kristo mi, munyu tumi, anɔkuale ɔ lemi, hɛdɔ kɛ ha sɔmɔmi, kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kikɛmɛ a ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi ɔ hu, nyɛɛ hyɛ konɛ nyɛɛ be ni kpa amɛ a he jã nɔuu.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Pi mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe. Dɛbi! Hɛdɔ nɛ Makedonia asafo ɔmɛ kɛ tsu ní ɔ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ suɔmi ɔ he toe kaa e je tsui klɔuu mi lo.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le suɔmi agbo nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ. Niatsɛ mi niatsɛ ji lɛ. Se nyɛ he ɔ, e pee e he ohiatsɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee niatsɛmɛ.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Ga nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe kɛkɛ ji kaa tsumi nɛ ɔ sa nyɛ. Ejakaa nyɛ juɛmi a kɛ to he ga, nɛ nyɛ ji kekleekle nihi nɛ bɔni tsumi jeha ji nɛ.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ gbe tsumi ɔ nya. Hɛdɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ to he ga a, nyɛɛ kɛ jamɛ a hɛdɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ gbe nya. Nyɛ ha bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ!

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Ke o ha bɔ nɛ o ma nyɛ kɛ o tsui faa a, Mawu ma ná o nike ní ɔ he bua jɔmi. Mawu hyɛ we blɔ kaa o ha nɔ́ ko be mi nɛ nɔ́ ko be o dɛ.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: I tsɔɔ we kaa ni komɛ nɛ a na gbɔjɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ na nɔ́. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ he hi saii, nɛ e hia kaa nyɛɛ ye bua ni nɛmɛ nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ. Hwɔɔ se ke nyɛ yi ba fi, nɛ mɛɛ níhi a mi ba hi ha mɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a maa ye bua nyɛ jã nɔuu; kɛkɛ lɛ tsuo pee pɛ.

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Wa naa Mawu si kaa e ha Tito suɔmi kɛ gɛjɛmi nɛ e kɛ maa ye bua nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ pee ɔ.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: Nɛ́ i de lɛ ke e ba slaa nyɛ ɔ, e kplɛɛ. Niinɛ, e pee e yi mi momo kaa e maa ba; ejakaa e hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa na nyɛ ekohu.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Nyɛmi nɛ wa tsɔ piɛ e he ɔ, a buu lɛ saminya ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kaa nɔ ko nɛ bɔɔ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi he mɔde.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ wa ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha nihi maa tu munyu yaya ngɛ nike ní nguaa nɛ ɔ nɔ hyɛmi he.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Wa yi mi tomi ji kaa waa pee nɔ́ nɛ da, pi ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu hɛ mi kɛkɛ, se ngɛ ni kpahi a hɛ mi hulɔ.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tsɔ wa nyɛmi ɔ hu kɛ piɛ a he. Wa ka lɛ si abɔ ngɛ níhi fuu a mi, nɛ wa na kaa e bɔɔ mɔde saminya. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ e hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ pe daa.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Tito ɔ, ye he piɛlɔ ji lɛ, nɛ i kɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ ní tsue konɛ e hi ha nyɛ. Nyɛmimɛ enyɔ kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ lɛɛ asafo ɔmɛ a tsɔli ji mɛ, nɛ a ní tsumi woɔ Kristo hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kaa nyɛ suɔ mɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, enɛ ɔ maa ye odase kaa fiami nɛ wa fĩa fɔ nyɛ nɔ ɔ pee we yaka.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: E he hia we kaa ma hi nyɛ womi ngmae kpamisa ngɛ yemi kɛ buami nɛ wa ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hae ɔ he.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: I le mɔde nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bɔe ɔ, nɛ i fĩa fɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ enɛ ɔ he ha Makedonia bi ɔmɛ. I de mɛ ke, “Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Akaya a dla a he ngɔ to jeha lokoo ji nɛ kaa a maa ye bua nyɛ.” Niinɛ, nyɛ mɔde bɔmi ɔ wo a ti nihi fuu kã.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛmimɛ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe, konɛ fiami nɛ wa fĩa fɔ nyɛ nɔ ɔ kó pee yaka ngɛ enɛ ɔ blɔ fa mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ i de to ɔ, nyɛ dla nyɛ he.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Se ke i kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ je Makedonia a ekomɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, i be suɔe nɛ a ba na kaa mamoo nyɛ dla we nyɛ he saasaa. Ke e ba mi jã a, waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo wa hɛ mi ma pue si kaa wa fĩa fɔ nyɛ nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i susu kaa e hia kaa ma kpa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ pɛɛ nɛ a sɛ ye hlami kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. A ma ba dla nike ní nɛ nyɛ wo si momo ɔ ngɔ to loko ma ba. Enɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ bua nya a je nyɛ tsui mi, se pi kaa a nyɛ nyɛ nɔ loko nyɛ tsu.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai kaa ke nɔ ko du wu bɔbɔyoo ɔ, e ma kpa ní bɔbɔyoo; ke nɔ ko du wu fuu ɔ, e ma kpa ní babauu jã kɛ̃.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha bɔ nɛ e to kaa e ma ha. E ha kɛ bua jɔmi, se pi kaa a ngɛ e nɔ nyɛe ke e pee; ejakaa Mawu suɔ nɔ nɛ haa nɔ́ kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia nyɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ fuu kɛ be nɔ; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛ hiae, nɛ nyɛ ma na fuu kɛ be nɔ kɛ tsu ní tsumi kpakpa slɔɔtohi.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “E haa ohiatsɛmɛ ní babauu; e mɔbɔ nami ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.”

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: Ee, Mawu maa wo nyɛ ní babauu, konɛ nyɛ kɛ pee kpakpa be tsuaa be. Enɛ ɔ ma ha nihi fuu maa na Mawu si ngɛ nike ní nɛ a naa ngɛ nyɛ dɛ kɛ guu wa nɔ ɔ he.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue ɔ, pi kaa wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a hiami níhi kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ha mɛ. Nihi babauu hu ngɛ Mawu si nae kɛ gu sɔlemi mi.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue nɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ kaa Kristo sɔmɔli ji nyɛ niinɛ. Nɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ ma je Mawu yi ngɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a fiɛmi, kɛ tue bumi he. A ma je Mawu yi hulɔ ngɛ nike níhi nɛ nyɛ je nyɛ tsui mi faa ha a kɛ ni kpahi tsuo ɔ he.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: A kɛ suɔmi nɛ nya wa ma kpa Mawu pɛɛ ha nyɛ, ejakaa Mawu hu je suɔmi agbo nɛ hí kalemi kpo ha nyɛ.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha waa na Mawu si ngɛ e nike ní nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kale ɔ he.

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nitsɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae! Ni komɛ deɔ ke ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, i peeɔ kpoo, se ke i be nyɛ kasa nya kɛkɛ i hia kã. I suɔ nɛ ma pee kpoo, nɛ ye mi mi nɛ jɔ kaa Kristo.

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko nɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa i ngɛ nyɛ nɔ yee tsɔ. Nihi nɛ ngɛ ye he munyu tue ke i ngɛ ní tsue kaa je mi no ɔ, i le kaa ma nyɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa to ní saminya.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa wa ngɛ he lo mi mohu, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa pee we he lo nya ní.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Ta hwumi níhi nɛ wa hɛɛ ɔ, pi he lo mi níhi; se mohu Mawu nitsɛ e ta hwumi ní kpakpahi nɛ a kɛ kuɔ mɔ nguahi. Wa tsiɔ yi mi susumi yayami nya,

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: nɛ wa teɔ si woɔ ní yayamihi nɛ he nɔ woli deɔ kɛ siɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Wa tsakeɔ adesa juɛmi, konɛ e susumi nɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo ngɛ hlae ɔ.

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nyɛ tsake pee anɔkuale tue buli ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa pee klaalo nɛ wa maa gbla ni nɛmɛ nɛ tsakee we ɔ a tue.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Nyɛ juɛmi mi kuɔ we kulaa! Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ heɔ e he yeɔ kaa Kristo nɔ́ ji lɛ lo? Saminya! Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ susu e yi mi ekohu; ejakaa wɔ hu Kristo níhi ji wɔ kaa lɛ nɔuu.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ha wɔ he wami ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, pi nɛ wa kɛ kpata nyɛ hɛ mi, se mohu nɛ wa kɛ ye bua nyɛ. Nɛ e ngɛ mi kaa he blɔ nɛ wa hɛɛ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ i fĩa tsɔ mohu, se kɛ̃ enɛ ɔ pee we mi zo.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Nihi deɔ ke, “Paulo womi ɔmɛ a mi munyuhi jiɔ, nɛ a mi wa hulɔ; se ke o na lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ pi nɔ ko kulaa ji lɛ; munyu nitsɛ tete e li tumi.”

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ná nɛ a le kaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngmaa ngɔ woɔ womi mi kɛ maneɔ nyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu wa peeɔ ke wa ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ; slɔɔto be mi.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa fĩa kɛ ya ta he ko pɛ; ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ha wɔ nɛ wa ngɛ tsue kɛ ba su nyɛ ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he wa maa fĩa ngɛ.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Ní tsumi nɛ ni kpahi tsu ɔ, wa fĩɛ ngɛ he. Niinɛ, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ma ba wa, nɛ wa ma tsu ní nguahi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti pe bɔ nɛ wa ko nyɛ.

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, wa ma nyɛ maa fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ ma kpahi a nɔ ngɛ Korinto se je lokoo. Kɛkɛ ɔ, he ko nɛ nɔ ko ya tsu ní ngɛ momo ɔ, wɔɔ wa be yae, konɛ wɔ mohu wa ko ba na yi jemi.

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ jeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e yi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hla we lɛ; nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ jeɔ e yi ɔ, lɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa nɔ́ nɛ ba Hawa nɔ be ko ɔ maa ba nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ. Sinɔ ya sisi Hawa, nɛ Hawa pee yayami. Jã kɛ̃ lɛ a ma puɛ nyɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ be Kristo anɔkuale yee kɛ pi si hu.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Ke i li munyu tumi tete po, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le, ejakaa wa ye he odase si abɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ e fi mi tete ɔ, i hɛwi nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko; nyɛmimɛ nɛ je Makedonia kɛ ba a ba ha mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia mi. I pee we tlomi ngɛ nyɛ kuɛ nɔ. Nɛ kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a hu i hyɛ we nyɛ yemi kɛ buami ko blɔ.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Kristo ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ lɛ i kase. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji kaa nɔ ko kulaa be Akaya ní ɔmɛ a mi nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsi ye nya kaa ma ko fĩa.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Mɛni he je nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee? Pe i sume nyɛ lo? Dɛbi, Mawu le kaa i suɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ be nyakpɛ tete! Satan nitsɛ nyɛɔ tsakeɔ e he peeɔ bɔfo nɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa la!

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Satan tsɔli tsake a he pee kaa Mawu nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a tsɔli ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be nyakpɛ kulaa. A nyagbe ɔ maa ba ha mɛ bɔ nɛ sa mɛ kaa yiwutsotsɛmɛ. Paulo na amanehlu kaa bɔfo

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: I ngɛ dee ekohu ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko bu mi kuasia. Se ke nyɛ maa bu mi kuasia tete po ɔ, nyɛɛ ngmɛ mi blɔ nɛ imi hu ma fĩa bɔɔ ko.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ nihi babauu fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ je nɛ ɔ mi níhi a nɔ ɔ, imi hu ma fĩa.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le ní kɛ be nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ naa tsui ha kuasiahi.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ba ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ, loo adufude, loo e ba pee nyɛ kuasia, loo e ba wo e he nɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, loo e ba gba nyɛ hɛ mi ma po, nyɛ de we nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: E peeɔ mi zo kaa ma de ke wɔɔ lɛɛ fɔ̃li ji wɔ, nɛ wa nyɛ we nɛ waa pee nɔ́ ko kaa jã! Jehanɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ munyu tue kaa kuasia! Níhi nɛ ni kpa amɛ ngɛ fĩae ngɛ he ɔ, imi hu ma fĩa ngɛ he jã nɔuu.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: A fĩaa ke Hebri bi ji mɛ, pi jã? Saminya, imi hu Hebri no ji mi. Nɛ a deɔ ke Israel bi ji mɛ, pi jã lo? Ee, imi hu Israel no ji mi. Pi Abraham nina ji mɛ? Ee, imi hu eko ji mi.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Kristo sɔmɔli ji mɛ lo? I ngɛ munyu tue kaa nɔ nɛ yi mi puɛ; tsia, i pe mɛ tsuo! I tsu ní wawɛɛ pe mɛ; a wo mi tsu si abɔ pe mɛ; a fia mi kpa si abɔ pe mɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, i ya gbenɔ muɔ nya ba si abɔ pe mɛ.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Roma nikɔtɔma amɛ fia mi kpa si etɛ; a fia mi tɛ si kake. I kɛ lɛ butu si etɛ, nɛ i ye ligbi kake, nyɔ kɛ pia ngɛ wo mi.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: I hia blɔ kpitikpiti. I na amanehlu babauu ngɛ pa hɛ mi, kɛ ojo fiali a dɛ mi; i na nɔ́ ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye weku li a dɛ mi; i na nɔ́ ngɛ ma je li a dɛ mi. I na nɔ́ ngɛ ma mi, kɛ nga nɔ. I na nɔ́ ngɛ wo hɛ mi, kɛ nyɛmimɛ lakpatsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: I gbo dengme kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ nɛ be komɛ mahe hwɔmi be mi. Hwɔ kɛ kuma yeɔ mi; be komɛ po i haa hwɔ; fĩɛ yeɔ mi, nɛ he hami nɔ́ hiaa mi.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Se enɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ní kpa komɛ tsuo a se ɔ, asafo ɔmɛ a he susumi ngɛ kaa tlomi ngɛ ye kuɛ nɔ daa ligbi.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko mumi gbo, kɛkɛ imi hu ye nɔ́ ɔ gbo; ke nɔ ko nane kpata, kɛkɛ ye mi mi sã mi ha lɛ.

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Ke e hia kaa ma fĩa kɛ̃ ɔ, lɛɛ níhi nɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ i gbɔjɔ ha a, lɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ma fĩa ngɔ fɔ.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ le kaa i yi lakpa. A je e yi kɛ ya neneene.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ Damasko ɔ, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Matsɛ Areta sisi ɔ ha a huɔ ngɛ Damasko ma a mi, konɛ a nu mi.

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: Se nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ mi wo kusii mi, nɛ a siu mi kɛ gu gli puɔ mi kɛ kple si. Nɛ i tu fo kɛ je e dɛ mi.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Ma ya nɔ ma fĩa kɛ̃, pohu se nami ko be he. Jehanɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ he munyu nɛ ma tu ji bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo je e he kpo tsɔɔ mi, kɛ e suɔmi nya níhi nɛ e tsɔɔ ke ma pee.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i dla ye he nɛ ma ba slaa nyɛ si etɛne. I bɛ nɛ ma ba pee tlomi ngɛ nyɛ kuɛ nɔ; nyɛ he i ma ngɛ, se pi nyɛ sika he. Pi bimɛ nɛ sa kaa a hyɛɛ a fɔli a nɔ; e sa kaa fɔli mohu nɛ hyɛ a bimɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Ke i ke ma fĩa a, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa i ngɛ kuasia jee; ejakaa anɔkuale ɔ i ngɛ dee ɔ nɛ. Se i be fĩae. I hla we nɛ nihi nɛ bu mi ngɛ ye nina amɛ a he; nɔ́ nɛ a na nɛ i pee, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nu kɛ je ye nya a, a bu mi ngɛ lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a he.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ a je tsɔɔ mi ɔ ma ha ma wó ye he nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ko ba mi ja he je ɔ, Mawu ngɔ mio ko ngɔ wo ye he womi mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa Satan bɔfo, nɛ e kongoɔ mi, konɛ ma ko wó ye he nɔ.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: I kpa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pɛɛ si etɛ sɔuu ke e je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ je ye nɔ.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Se e he nɔ ke, “Dloomi nɛ i kɛ ha mo ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ ha mo; ejakaa ye he wami ɔ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ a mi.” I suɔ saminya nɛ ma fĩa kaa i gbɔjɔ, konɛ ma na kaa Kristo he wami ɔ ngɛ ye he bue.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i suɔ kaa ma na nɔ́ ngɛ Kristo he. E hɛwi mi kaa ma nu hiɔ; e hɛwi mi kaa a maa pee mi nisɛ ní, loo ye yi ma fi, loo a maa wa mi yi mi, loo ma na amanehlu. Ejakaa ke i pee gbedee ɔ, Kristo woɔ mi he wami. Paulo ye Korinto bi ɔmɛ a he kɔmɔ

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: I ngɛ ye ní pee kaa kuasia; se nyɛ lɛ nyɛ pee mi jã. Nyɛ lɛ nyɛ ko je ye yi; ejakaa ke i pi nɔ ko tete po, jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ buu mɛ bɔfo nguahi ɔ, a pi mi ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko mi.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Mawu pee nyakpɛ ní nguahi, kɛ okadihi kɛ gu ye nɔ benɛ i ngɛ ní tsue kɛ tsui si tomi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ. Nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ kaa niinɛ, bɔfo ji mi.

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Ma suɔ kaa ma ngɔ níhi tsuo nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, kɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tete ngɔ ha nɛ ma kɛ ye bua nyɛ. Ke i suɔ nyɛ babauu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e sɛ kaa nyɛ hu nyɛɛ suɔ mi jã lo?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maa na kaa niinɛ, i pee we tlomi ngɛ nyɛ kuɛ nɔ. Se nɔ ko ma de ke, ye hɛ mi tɛ̃, nɛ i gu ga blɔ nɔ kɛ sisi nyɛ.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛɛ? Nihi nɛ i tsɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, anɛ i gu a ti nɔ ko nɔ kɛ sisi nyɛ lo?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Pe i kpa Tito pɛɛ nɛ i tsɔ wa nyɛmi kake ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he loko e ba slaa nyɛ. Anɛ Tito ba sisi nyɛ lo? Dɛbi! Anɛ nyɛ li kaa i kɛ lɛ tsuo wa hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ wa peeɔ wa ní fiee lo?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko susu kaa pe wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ wa fa wa he ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛkɛ. Mawu ji wa we odase kaa wa ngɛ anɔkuale tue kaa Kristo tsɔli. Nyɛmimɛ nɛ wa suɔ! Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ pee ɔ, wa ngɛ pee nɛ wa kɛ ye bua nyɛ.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa ke i ba nyɛ slaami ɔ, i ba be nyɛ nae bɔ nɛ i ko suɔ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ be mi nae bɔ nɛ nyɛ ko suɔ. Eko piɔ ɔ, níhi nɛ ma ba na kɛkɛ ji pɛ, hunga jemi, mi mi la, mi gbami, nɔ biɛ puɛmi, sieku yemi, he nɔ womi, kɛ basabasa peemi.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa ke i ba ekohu ɔ, ye Mawu ɔ maa ba mi si ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi. Nihi nɛ pee yayami sa a, nɛ a tsakee we a tsui, nɛ a ngɛ yayami ɔ pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, ma fo ya ngɛ a he. Mɛ ji mu ní tsuli, ajuama bɔli, kɛ zo ní tsuli.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji si etɛne nɛ i ma nyɛ slaami. Ngmami ɔ ke, “Ni enyɔ, loo etɛ nɛ a ye odase loko a buá sane tsuaa sane he.”

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ pee yayami sa a, i bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ momo benɛ i ba slaa nyɛ si enyɔne ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i be nyɛ ngɔ, se i ngɛ mɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ tsuo kɔkɔ bɔe ekohu. Jehanɛ lɛɛ ke i ba a, ma gbla a tue wawɛɛ.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa benɛ a sɛu Kristo ɔ, e gbɔjɔ lɛɛ, se Mawu he wami ɔ nya a, e ba wami mi ekohu. Wɔ hu akɛnɛ waa kɛ Kristo pee kake ɔ, waa gbɔjɔɔ, se Mawu he wami nya a, wa ma nyɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ nɛ tsu ɔ.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ka nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa nyɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ niinɛ lo. Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he nɛ hi. Anɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ li kaa Yesu Kristo he wami ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi lo? Ee, ke nyɛ sɛ́ ɔ, nyɛ be enɛ ɔ lee.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ sɛ́. Waa kɛ enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hi; se mohu nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ sa; pohu e maa pee nihi kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nyɛ we kulaa.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa blɔ nya ji kaa waa hyɛ nɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ gbɛ fĩa; se pi kaa wa maa pee nɔ́ ko kɛ si anɔkuale ɔ.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Ke wa gbɔjɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ, wa naa bua jɔmi. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ wa ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he hu lɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae benɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke i ba a, e be hiae kaa i kɛ nyɛ nɛ ye wawɛɛ. He wami nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha mi ɔ, pi nɛ ma kɛ kpata nyɛ hɛ mi, se mohu nɛ ma kɛ ye bua nyɛ.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, i biɔ nyɛ! Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya; nyɛɛ bu ye ga womi ɔ tue; nyɛ juɛmi nɛ pee kake, nɛ nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi. Nɛ Mawu nɛ suɔ wɔ, nɛ haa wɔ tue mi jɔmi ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ fua nyɛ sibi atuu nɛ nyɛ kɛ nga nyɛ he. Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ, kɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ, kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu huɛ bɔmi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.

english_verse: From the apostle Paul and from all the Lord's followers with me. I was chosen to be an apostle by Jesus Christ and by God the Father, who raised him from death. No mere human chose or appointed me to this work. To the churches in Galatia:
translation_verse: Imi bɔfo Paulo, kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Galatia asafo ɔmɛ. Pi nɔmlɔ nɛ pee mi bɔfo, nɛ pi adesa hu nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ hla mi ke ma ba pee bɔfo, se mohu Yesu Kristo, kɛ Tsɛ Mawu nɛ tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ a nɔ i gu kɛ na blɔ nya nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: A wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene. Amen. Sane kpakpa kake ɔ

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Nyɛ he pee mi nyakpɛ. Hyɛ kaa e yi be ko kulaa nɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ gu Kristo dloomi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kua lɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya ngɛ sane kpakpa kpa se nyɛɛe.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛ bu kaa sane kpakpa kpa ko ngɛ he ko! Pe i de ja kɛkɛ; ejakaa ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe; a ngɛ hlae kaa a ma tsake sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Se ke e maa ba mi kaa wɔ, loo hiɔwe bɔfo ko po ma ba fiɛ sane kpakpa muno ko ha nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa fiɛ momo ɔ se ɔ, musu tloo lɛ!

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Wa de enɛ ɔ momo, se i ngɛ mi tie ekohu. I ngɛ dee ke, ke nɔ ko ba fiɛ sane kpakpa muno ko ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ he ye momo ɔ se ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, musu tloo lɛ!

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, anɛ e tsɔɔ kaa i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma sa adesa hɛ mi lo? Dɛbi! Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae kɛkɛ ji kaa ma sa Mawu hɛ mi. Anɛ pe i ngɛ hlae nɛ nimli nɛ suɔ mi lo? Ke ja ji sane ɔ lɛɛ pi Kristo tsɔlɔ ji mi. Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Paulo plɛ bɔfo

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa sane kpakpa a nɛ i fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, pi nimli a nya mi munyu.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Pi adesa ko dɛ mi nɛ i na kɛ je, nɛ pi nɔmlɔ ko nɛ tsɔɔ mi hulɔ; Yesu Kristo nitsɛ nɛ je tsɔɔ mi.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nu bɔ nɛ i ba ye je mi sa a ngɛ Yuda bi a jami ɔ nya. Nyɛ nu bɔ nɛ i wa Mawu asafo ɔ yi mi wawɛɛ, nɛ i bɔ mɔde kaa ma kpata asafo ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: I tsu Yuda bi a jami ɔ he ní wawɛɛ pe wa juami bi Yuda fɔfɔɛhi babauu. I kɛ hɛdɔ tsu wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kusumi ɔmɛ a he ní saminya.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: e ma je e Bi ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mi, konɛ ma ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ, i ya bi we ga womi ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔ.

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ sɛ ye hlami kɛ ngɛ ní tsue kaa bɔfohi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, mɛ tete po i yɛ nɛ ma ya na mɛ. Mohu ɔ, i pue nɔ amlɔ nɔuu kɛ ho Arabia ya. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i kpale kɛ ba Damasko.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Jeha etɛ se loko i ya Yerusalem ya na Petro, nɛ i ye ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ngɛ e ngɔ.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: Bɔfo kpa amɛ lɛɛ i nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko, pe Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛmi Yakobo pɛ.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, Mawu ji ye we odase kaa i yi lakpa.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Pee se ɔ, i ya Siria, kɛ Kilikia kpokpa amɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Se kɛ ba si be nɛ ɔ tsuo Kristo asafo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a li mi hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Nihi a nya kɛkɛ a nuɔ ngɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ wa wɔ yi mi sa a, hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ e ka kaa e ma kpata hɛ mi ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ e ngɛ fiɛe.”

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Nɛ ye he ɔ, a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ se ɔ, i kɛ Barnaba kpale kɛ ya Yerusalem ekohu, nɛ i ngɔ Tito hu ngɔ piɛ ye he.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Mawu lɛ je tsɔɔ mi kaa ma ya Yerusalem, nɛ i ya. I kɛ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ kɔklɔɔ ya kpe, nɛ sɛ gbi nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ mɛ nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ní tsumi nɛ i tsu kɛ sɛ hlami, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsue amlɔ nɛ ɔ pee yaka.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Tito nɛ i kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, nɔ ko nyɛ́ e nɔ doo ke a po lɛ, pohu Hela no ji lɛ.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Se nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti lakpatsɛmɛ komɛ gu ga blɔ nɔ kɛ sɛ asafo ɔ mi nigii kɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a hyɛ bɔ nɛ a maa pee kɛ puɛ he yemi nɛ Kristo ha wɔ ɔ, konɛ a ye wɔ nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ wa suɔ kaa nyɛ nine nɛ su anɔkuale ɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a mi ɔ nɔ sisiisi he je ɔ, wa ngɔɛ a munyu ɔ.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ a buu mɛ kaa a ngɛ biɛ ɔ, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ sa a, pi ye he sane ko. Mawu hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi; ejakaa imi lɛɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we mi nɔ́ ko ngɔ piɛ he.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, a na paa kaa ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ Mawu ha mi ji kaa ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li kaa bɔ nɛ a hla Petro kaa e fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha Yuda bi ɔ.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu nɛ́ gu Petro nɔ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ Yuda bi a kpɛti ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ gu ye nɔ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Yakobo, Petro, kɛ Yohane nɛ a buu mɛ kaa asafo ɔ mi titimahi ɔ na paa kaa Mawu dloo mi babauu, nɛ e tu ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ ɔ ngɔ wo ye dɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ hu a sa i kɛ Barnaba wa dɛ mi kɛ he wɔ atuu kaa nihi nɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ní tsumi kake tsue. Wa ma nya si kaa i kɛ Barnaba maa ya ma je li ɔmɛ a ngɔ, konɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ya Yuda bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Nɔ́ kake nɛ a kai wɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ he ji kaa wa hɛ ko je ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ enɛ ɔ hu ji nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ ye tsui nɔ kaa ma pee. Paulo ka Petro hɛ mi ngɛ Antiokia

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Benɛ Petro ba Antiokia a, i ka e hɛ mi ngɛ ma hɛ mi; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ dɛ kulaa.

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Yuda bi nɛ piɛ ɔ hu pee jamɛ a osato ɔ, nɛ Barnaba tete po a gbla lɛ kɛ wo osato peemi nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Benɛ i na kaa a nyɛɛ we ngɛ sane kpakpa a nya anɔkuale mi ɔ, i ka Petro hɛ mi ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. I de lɛ ke, “Mo Yuda no ɔ, o peeɔ o ní kaa ma je no, se pi Yuda no! Kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ o nyɛɔ ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a pee a ní kaa Yuda bi ɔ?” Hemi kɛ yemi a kɛ heɔ Yuda bi kɛ ma je li a yi wami

english_verse: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
translation_verse: Wɔ nitsɛmɛ ɔ, Yuda fɔfɔɛhi ji wɔ; wa pi ma je li yayami peeli.

english_verse: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa le kaa loko a ma dla nɔ ko kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ, ja nɔ ɔ he Yesu Kristo ye, se pi mlaa a nɔ yemi. Wɔ nitsɛmɛ po wa heɔ Kristo Yesu yeɔ, konɛ a dla waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti kɛ gu wa hemi kɛ yemi nɔ, se pi mlaa a nɔ yemi. Ejakaa pi mlaa a nɔ yemi nɔ nɛ a guu kɛ dlaa nɔ ko kɛ Mawu a kpɛti.

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa waa kɛ Yesu ngɛ bɔe, nɛ wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ a gu lɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ a dla waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti. Ke wa ngɛ yayami pee kaa ma je li ɔmɛ nɔuu ɔ, anɛ enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Kristo náá yayami he bua jɔmi lo? Dɛbi.

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ i kpa peemi ɔ, ke i kpale ya ngɛ pee ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ i tsɔɔ paa kaa tɔlɔ ji mi.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Ngɛ mlaa a blɔ fa mi ɔ, i plɛ pee nɔ gbogboe, konɛ ma hi wami mi ha Mawu mohu. I kɛ Kristo a sɛu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: I kplɛɛ kaa Mawu dloomi ji lɛ ha mi. Ke mlaa a nɔ a guu kɛ dlaa nɔ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo gbo yaka gu.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Nyɛ Galatia bi nɛ nyɛ be yi! Mɛnɔ gbiɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ ko bu anɔkuale ɔ tue? Yesu gbenɔ nɛ e gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso nɔ ɔ, a tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ na paa.

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha ma bi nyɛ nɔ́ kake. Mlaa a nɔ nɛ nyɛ ye, aloo sane kpakpa a nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ be yi! Nɛ nyɛ ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ je sisi ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ he lo maa gbe nya.

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Amanehlu babauu nɛ nyɛ na a, anɛ e maa pee yaka? Dɛbi! I he we yi!

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ nɛ Mawu haa nyɛ, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsuɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, anɛ mlaa a nɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ ɔ he je, aloo sane kpakpa a nɛ nyɛ nuɔ nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith.
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ ke, “A bu Abraham nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, ejakaa e he Mawu ye.”

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ná nyɛɛ le kaa nihi nɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ ɔ, mɛ ji Abraham nina.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ de to ke Mawu ma dla e kɛ ma je li nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a kpɛti. E de Abraham sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ ke, “Mawu maa gu o nɔ kɛ maa gbaa ma je li ɔmɛ tsuo.”

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Abraham he Mawu ye, nɛ Mawu gbaa lɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a gbaa Abraham ɔ, jã a maa gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ susuu kaa ja a ye Yuda bi a mlaa a nɔ doo loko a ma he a yi wami ɔ, a gbiɛ mɛ. Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Mlaahi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mawu mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ ma tɔ kake ngmelu nɔ ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
translation_verse: Se mlaa a kɔ we hemi kɛ yemi he; ejakaa a ngma ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ sisiisi ɔ yi ma na wami ngɛ mlaa a nya.”

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Wa he ɔ, Kristo ba plɛ nɔ nɛ a gbiɛ lɛ, konɛ gbiɛmi nɛ ko ba wa nɔ ngɛ mlaa a nya a, e je wɔ kɛ je mi. Ejakaa a ngma ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a sɛu lɛ ngɛ sɛumi tso nɔ ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: Kristo pee enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gbaami nɛ Mawu wo Abraham si ngɛ he ɔ, kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ a nine nɛ su nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ɔ, Mumi ɔ nɛ Mawu wo he si ɔ, wa nine maa su nɔ. Mlaa a kɛ si womi ɔ

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Abraham, kɛ e nina Mawu wo si ɔ nɛ. Ngmami ɔ de we ke, “Kɛ e nina amɛ”, kaa nɔ́ nɛ a he hiɛ, se mohu e de ke, “Kɛ o nina”, nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nɔ kake pɛ; nɛ lɛ ji Kristo.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Gbosi ni ɔ nɛ Mawu wo Abraham e he si ɔ, Mawu ngɔ kɛ ha lɛ faa; pi mlaa a nɔ nɛ Abraham ye ɔ he je nɛ e ba mi. Kaa jã ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ e pi si womi hu.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ jehanɛ ɔ, mɛni ji mlaa a he se nami mɔ? A ha wɔ mlaa a, konɛ wa kɛ le wa tɔmi ɔmɛ hluu kɛ yaa su be nɛ Abraham bi ɔ nɛ a wo lɛ si ngɛ he ɔ maa ba. Jehanɛ hu, hiɔwe bɔfohi lɛ ngɔ mlaa a kɛ ba ha je ɔ kɛ gu adesa nɔ.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Se Mawu lɛɛ lɛ nɔ kake too lɛ wo Abraham si ɔ nɛ; e gui nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ. Nɔ́ he nɛ a wo mlaa a

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Anɛ enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa mlaa a, kɛ si nɛ Mawu wo ɔ yɛ lo? Dɛbi! Mlaa a ma nyɛ ha nɔ wami jinɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ, Mawu ma dla e kɛ lɛ a kpɛti.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Se ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Je ɔ tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ yayami sɔuu.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nike ní nɛ a wo he si ɔ, nihi nɛ heɔ Yesu Kristo yeɔ ɔ, mɛ pɛ lɛ a nine maa su nɔ.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mlaa a hɛɛ wɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ Kristo ba nɛ wa he lɛ ye, konɛ a dla waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ Kristo ba, nɛ wa he lɛ ye ɔ, pi mlaa a nɛ hɛɛ wɔ hu.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ he Kristo Yesu ye, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ peeɔ Mawu bimɛ.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a sɔle nyɛ ngɔ wo Kristo mi ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Kristo pee kaa tade nɛ nyɛ wo.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, slɔɔto ko kulaa be nyɛ kpɛti hu: Yuda no be ɔ, Hela no be; nyɔguɛ be ɔ, odehe be; nyumu be ɔ, yo be. Nɛ́ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ peeɔ nɔ kake.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Ke Kristo we bi ji nyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Abraham nina ji nyɛ, nɛ si nɛ Mawu wo ɔ nya a, nyɛ peeɔ gbosi ní yeli.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji kaa bi nɛ maa ye e tsɛ ní hwɔɔ se ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ e wɛ lolo ɔ, slɔɔto ko be e kɛ nyɔguɛ a kpɛti, pohu lɛ ji gbosi ní ɔ tsuo yelɔ.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: E jokuɛwi a si ɔ, nihi hyɛɛ e kɛ gbosi ní ɔ tsuo nɔ hluu kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ e tsɛ to ɔ loko a ngɔɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ woɔ e dɛ.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃ wɔ hu benɛ wa wɛ lolo ɔ, wa ngɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi; nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi kusumihi, kɛ mlaahi nɛ hɛɛ wɔ.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Se Mawu tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e bi ɔ kɛ ba ngɛ be nɛ sa mi; yo nɛ fɔ lɛ, nɛ e ye Yuda bi a mlaa a hu nɔ.

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: E ba, konɛ e ba kpɔ nihi nɛ Yuda mlaa a ye mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, konɛ e pee mɛ Mawu bimɛ.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Mawu suɔ kaa e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa e bimɛ ji nyɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ e bi ɔ mumi ɔ kɛ ba wa tsui mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, wa ma nyɛ ma de anɔkuale mi ke, “Mawu, wa tsɛ ji mo.”

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Lɛɛ Mawu he ɔ, o pi nyɔguɛ hu, se mohu bi ji mo. Nɛ akɛnɛ bi ji mo ɔ, blɔ nya nɛ Mawu to ha e bimɛ ɔ, o nine maa su mo hu o nɔ́ nɔ. Paulo ye tsui ngɛ Galatia bi ɔmɛ a he

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Sa a nɛ nyɛ li Mawu ɔ, nibɔ níhi nɛ pi mawuhi ji mɛ ngɛ a bɔmi su nya a ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ.

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Nyɛ toɔ be titli komɛ, ligbi komɛ, nyɔhiɔ komɛ, kɛ jeha komɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ peeɔ kusumi.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: E peeɔ mi kaa dengme tsuo nɛ i gbo ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ miɔ nɛ e pee yaka.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛɛ kase mi. Nyɛ le, sa a, i ngɛ kaa nyɛ. Nyɛ pee we mi yayami ko.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, kekleekle ɔ nɛ i ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha nyɛ ɔ, i be he wami.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa ye hiɔ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ gbo dengme babauu ngɛ ye he, se ye he pee we nyɛ tai, nɛ nyɛ kua we mi hulɔ; mohu ɔ, nyɛ he mi atuu kaa Mawu bɔfo. Ee, nyɛ he mi kaa Kristo Yesu nitsɛ.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Bua jɔmi nɛ nyɛ kɛ nya ye he jamɛ a be ɔ, jije e ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ? Imi nitsɛ ma nyɛ ma ye odase kaa jamɛ a be ɔ, kaa e hi peemi ɔ, jinɛ nyɛ ko ta nyɛ hɛngmɛ tete po ngɔ ha mi.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ha i ba pee nyɛ he nyɛlɔ; pi jã?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi hae ɔ, nyɛ bu kaa a suɔ nyɛ; a be nyɛ he juɛmi kpakpa. A ngɛ hlae nɛ a puɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti, konɛ nyɛ gbo mɛ mohu a he dengme.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, ke nɔ ko hɛɛ yi mi tomi kpakpa a, e sa kaa e gboɔ he dengme. E hia kaa nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ be tsuaa be, se pi ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: I na nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kasa nya amlɔ nɛ ɔ, jinɛ i kɛ nyɛ ko tu munyu bɔ nɛ sa, ejakaa i ngɛ haoe wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ he. Hagar kɛ Sara kaa nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae kaa mlaa a nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha ma bi nyɛ nɔ́ ko. Nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a deɔ ɔ be mi lo?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: A ngma ke Abraham ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ; e kɛ yo nyɔguɛ fɔ nɔ kake, nɛ nɔ enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ yo odehe ɔ nɛ fɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Bi nɛ e kɛ yo nyɔguɛ ɔ fɔ ɔ, a fɔ lɛ kɛkɛ; se bi nɛ yo odehe ɔ fɔ ɔ, Mawu wo e he si.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ a nane mi. Yi enyɔ ɔmɛ daa si ha somi enyɔ. A kpɛti nɔ kake ji Hagar. E je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ; nɛ bimɛ nɛ e fɔ ɔ, nyɔguɛhi ji mɛ.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: Hagar ngɛ kaa Sinai yo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Arabia a. Lɔ ɔ ji Yerusalem ma nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa e kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Se Yerusalem kaketsɛ ɔ nɛ lɛɛ a kɛ lɛ to hiɔwe he ɔ, lɛɛ e ji odehe. Lɛ ji wɔ tsuo wa nyɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ de ke, “Mo yosa nɛ o fɔ we, mo nya! Mo nɛ o nui kɔɔmi hyɛ, hwɔ lele, nɛ o nya! Ejakaa yo nɛ e huno kua lɛ ɔ mohu e bimɛ hiɛ pe yogbayo nɛ ngɛ gba we daa a bimɛ.”

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ kaa a fɔɔ adesa kɛkɛ ɔ wa nɔ nɛ a wo e he si loko a fɔ lɛ ɔ yi mi. Ja nɔuu e ngɛ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Se kɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ kɛɛ? E deɔ ke, “Wo yo nyɔguɛ ɔ kɛ e bi ɔ blɔ nɛ a ho, ejakaa yo nyɔguɛ ɔ bi ɔ be he blɔ nɛ e kɛ yo odehe ɔ bi ɔ yeɔ gbosi ní.”

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, pi yo nyɔguɛ ɔ bimɛ ji wɔ; odehe mohu ɔ bimɛ ji wi.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Wa ye wa he. Ee, Kristo ha wa ye wa he. Nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii, konɛ nɔ ko kó ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ hu.

english_verse: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Paulo, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ ha a po nyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo he be se nami ko kulaa kɛ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nyɛ maa ye mlaa a nɔ, konɛ a dla nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, pe nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ he kɛ je Kristo he ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ kua Mawu dloomi ɔ.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, a po lɛ jio, a pui lɛ jio, lɔ ɔ tsu we nɔ́ ko. Nɔ́ nɛ he hia wawɛɛ mohu ji hemi kɛ yemi nɛ jeɔ kpo ngɛ suɔmi nɛ wa ngɛ kɛ ha wa nyɛmimɛ ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Jinɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he mɔde bɔe saminya. Se mɛnɔ po lɛ ba puɛ nyɛ tue nɛ nyɛ he we anɔkuale ɔ yi hu ɔ?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a yi mi tsakemi ɔ, Mawu, nɔ nɛ hla nyɛ ɔ, pi lɛ nɛ pee.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: “Masa bɔbɔyoo pɛ lɛ haa ma a tsuo fuɔ.”

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ. I le kaa nyɛ be nɔ kpa ko munyu nue. Nɔ tutuutu nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe ɔ, Mawu maa gbla e tue kokooko!

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke i ngɛ fiɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ke e hia nɛ a po nɔ doo ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kpamisa mɔ? Ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ he sane ɔ nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, e sɛ́ kaa e haoɔ nɔ ko.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i na nɛ a puɛ mɛ, loo a ta mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he kɛkɛ nɛ e jɔ!

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ pe a hla nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ ba ye nyɛ he. Nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ ye nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ lɛ kaa blɔ nya nɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee níhi nɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ suɔmi ɔ nɛ je kpo ngɛ nyɛmimɛ a sɔmɔmi mi.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mlaa a tsuo nɔ yemi ɔ kpiti pomi ji, “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.”

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ pee nyɛ he lohwe dikali nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ́ yeyee pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ma kpata nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Mawu mumi ɔ kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa su

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Se ke mumi ɔ lɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mlaa a yi nyɛ nɔ hu.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko peeɔ he lo ɔ nya ní ɔ, níhi nɛ jeɔ mi kɛ baa ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: gba puɛmi, mu ní tsumi, yahomi,

english_verse: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
translation_verse: amaga jami, kunya tsumi, ninyɛ, pɛ hlami, hunga jemi, mi mi la womi, pɛ, mi gbami, nya hiɔmi,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: hɛkɔ, dã demi, fiɛmi yaya, kɛ ní yaya peemi kpahi fuu kaa níhi nɛ i tsi a ta nɛ ɔ. I ka nyɛ hɛ mi momo ngɛ kikɛmɛ a je mi bami nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kɔkɔ bɔe ekohu ke nihi nɛ peeɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue gblegbleegble.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful,
translation_verse: Se Mawu mumi ɔ yiblii ji suɔmi, bua jɔmi, he jɔmi, tsui si tomi, mi mi himi, kpakpa peemi, hemi kɛ yemi,

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: he si bami, kɛ he nɔ yemi. Enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mlaa ko mlaa ko tsi nya.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Ke mumi ɔ lɛ haa wɔ wami ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Wa ko wó wa he nɔ; wa ko wo wa sibi a mi mi la, nɛ wa hɛ ko kɔ wa sibi a nɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko tɔ ɔ, nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba blɔ dadɛ nɔ. Nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si blɛuu kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, konɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ ko ya sɛ jamɛ a ka a eko mi.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kpee nyɛ sibi kɛ tloo nyɛ tlomi ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo mlaa a tsɔɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee ɔ.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Ke e peeɔ nɔ ko kaa nɔ ko ji lɛ, se pohu pi nɔ ko kulaa ji lɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he nɛ e ngɛ sisie.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ní peepee. Ke e hi ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ, nɛ e be hiae kaa e maa ngɔ e he ngɔ to nɔ kpa he;

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa tloo lɛ nitsɛ e tlomi.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ a ngɛ lɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, kɛ e tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nɛ dla ní kpakpahi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he. Mawu ɔ, a yi e he fɛu. Nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ du ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu e ma kpa.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ko ha nɛ kpakpa peemi nɛ gbe wa nya; ejakaa ke wa kɔni mi wui nyu ɔ, ní kpami be ɔ, wa ma na he se.

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Lɛɛ ke e maa hi ɔ, waa pee nihi tsuo kpakpa daa, titli ɔ, nihi nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ. Nyagbe kɔkɔ bɔmi kɛ sɛ yemi

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ i kɛ imi nitsɛ ye nine ngma ní agboagbo kɛ mane nyɛ!

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa nyɛ nyɛ nɔ kaa ja a po nyɛ doo ɔ, nihi a hɛ mi kɛkɛ lɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a sa. Ejakaa a le kaa ke a de ke loko a ma he nɔ ko yi wami ɔ, ja nɔ ɔ na amanehlu kaa Kristo ɔ, nihi maa wa mɛ yi mi.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a kusumi ji kaa a po mɛ ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ po a yi mlaa a nɔ. A ngɛ hlae kɛkɛ nɛ a fĩa kaa mɛ lɛ a pee lɛ nyɛ kplɛɛ nɛ a po nyɛ.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Se imi lɛɛ i be fĩae ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ kaa ja wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ pɛ. Gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a sɛu je ɔ kɛ ha mi, nɛ a sɛu imi hu kɛ ha je ɔ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: A po nɔ ko jio, a pui nɔ ko jio, e he hia we kulaa. Nɔ́ nɛ he hia kɛkɛ ji kaa nɔ ko ma tsake kɛ pee bɔ nɔ he.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ maa ba a je mi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Mawu nɛ na mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ he jɔmi. Ee, Mawu nɛ pee enɛ ɔ ha mɛ kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma, Israel ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nɔ ko kó doo ye nya hu. Yesu nɔ́ nami okadihi ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si. Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo, nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nɛ i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ɔ, imi lɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Efeso, nihi nɛ kɛ je be nɛ a ba le Kristo Yesu ɔ, a ngmɛɛ we a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he kulaa a.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! Kristo haa wɔ mumi mi ní kpakpahi

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Sina ha Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Mawu ɔ, kɛ e Tsɛ ɔ! Ejakaa nɛ wa ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, Mawu dloo wɔ mumi mi ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: E sa kaa wa je Mawu yi kaa e gu e dloomi nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɔ ngɔ e bi nɛ e suɔ ɔ ngɔ ke wɔ yaka gu!

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to nɛ e maa pee ke be ɔ su ɔ ji kaa e ma ha nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo maa pee kake, níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Nɛ Kristo maa ye matsɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nɛ wa ji kekleekle nihi nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Kristo nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha wa je Mawu yi kaa e hɛ mi ngɛ nyami.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu, benɛ nyɛ nu anɔkuale sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ ji sane kpakpa a nɛ ma ha nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami ɔ, nyɛ he Kristo ye, nɛ Mawu ha nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ e wo he si ɔ ba nyɛ nɔ. Mawu pee enɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kadi nyɛ kaa e nihi ji nyɛ niinɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: Si nɛ Mawu wo e ni ɔmɛ ɔ, mumi ɔ e kɛ ma nɔ mi kaa wa nine maa su nɔ. Nɛ enɛ ɔ woɔ wɔ he wami kaa Mawu ma ha e we bi maa ye a he kulaa. Nyɛ ha wa je e yi kɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami. Paulo kpa Mawu pɛɛ

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, kɛ je benɛ i nu kaa nyɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo yeɔ saminya, nɛ Mawu we bi ɔmɛ hu nyɛ suɔ mɛ ja nɔuu ɔ,

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: i kpa we Mawu si nami ha nyɛ. Ke i ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, i kaiɔ nyɛ,

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: nɛ i kpaa pɛɛ kaa wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa Tsɛ nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Mumi ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa le bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ anɔkuale mi, nɛ e ma je Mawu kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa le lɛ saminya.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: I kpaa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ e bli nyɛ mumi mi hɛngmɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ Mawu wo si kaa e ma ha nyɛ benɛ e tsɛ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa na. Nyɛ maa le hu kaa níhi nɛ Mawu wo si kaa e ma ha e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami babauu.

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ hu nyɛ ma yɔse kaa Mawu he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ wɔ nihi nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ ɔ wa mi ɔ,

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: jamɛ a he wami ɔ nɔuu nɛ Mawu kɛ tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ hi e hiɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ Kristo ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ pã nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ hiɔwe a he wami. Biɛ nɛ Kristo hɛɛ ɔ hu pã biɛhi tsuo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ, kɛ je nɛ maa ba a tsuo mi.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Mawu ha Kristo he wami ngɛ níhi tsuo a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee tsɛ ha asafo ɔ, konɛ e ye níhi tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: Asafo ɔ ji Kristo nɔmlɔ tso nɛ haa níhi tsuo a he suu. Kristo haa níhi tsuo a he suu ngɛ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Sa a, nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, ejakaa nyɛ gbo Mawu tue, nɛ nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si lɛ.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ je nɛ ɔ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ peeɔ. Nyɛ ya nyɛɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ mumi yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi ɔ se. Nihi nɛ gboɔ Mawu tue ɔ, mumi nɛ ɔ lɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ a mi amlɔ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be mi nɛ wa gbo tue, nɛ wa pee kaa nihi nɛ gbo ɔ, e ha wa ba wami mi ekohu benɛ e tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje ɔ. Dloomi nya nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Mawu tle waa kɛ Kristo si, konɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ejakaa wa ngɛ e mi.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ yi nɔhi tsuo nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ kaa Kristo Yesu he ɔ, e suɔ wɔ saminya, nɛ e dloo wɔ babauu.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Mawu nitsɛ lɛ pee wɔ bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ nɛ ɔ. E ha waa kɛ Kristo Yesu ba nu huɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa ngɔ wa wami be ɔ tsuo kɛ pee nihi kpakpa. E to blɔ nya nɛ ɔ blema lokoo konɛ waa nyɛɛ ngɛ nya. Waa kɛ Kristo pee kake

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ li Kristo. Nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, nyɛ be a kpɛti; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nibwɔhi ji nyɛ. Somi nɛ Mawu kɛ e ni ɔmɛ so, kɛ si nɛ e wo mɛ ɔ, nyɛ piɛ we he. Nyɛ hi si ngɛ je ɔ mi kɛkɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ hɛ fɔ we nɔ́ ko nɔ; Mawu nitsɛ tete nyɛ li lɛ.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo nitsɛ ba pee Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li kake, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ he jɔmi ba. Ninyɛ nɛ pee kaa gbogbo ngɛ Yuda bi kɛ ma je li a kpɛti ɔ, Kristo ha nɛ jamɛ a ninyɛ ɔ se po gbidigbidi.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: Kristo gbo nɛ e kɛ po Yuda bi a mlaa a, kɛ a kɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e pee Yuda bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ kake ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi; nɛ enɛ ɔ kɛ he jɔmi ba.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Kristo gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ e kɛ dla ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti kaa nɔmlɔ tso kake; nɛ e ha niyɛ nɛ ngɛ a kɛti ɔ se po ninyɛ nɛ ngɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ se po.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Yuda bi jio, ma je li jio, Kristo nɔ lɛ wɔ tsuo wa maa gu kɛ ba Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ. Mumi Klɔuklɔu kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ maa piɛ wa he.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ma je li, jehanɛ ɔ nyɛ pi nibwɔhi, loo ma se bi hu, se mohu nyɛɛ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo peeɔ ma mi bi, kɛ Mawu we bi.

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: Sisi tomi nɛ a fia nyɛ ngɔ ma nɔ ji sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ fiɛ ɔ; nɛ Kristo Yesu nitsɛ ngɛ kaa tsu ɔ kɔ nya tɛ.

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu mumi ɔ ngɔ nyɛɛ kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ tsuo ngɔ mɛtɛ Kristo he, nɛ nyɛ ba pee Mawu sihi he.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: I heɔ yeɔ kaa ní tsumi nɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma je li ɔmɛ nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛ maa nu he.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Yi mi nɛ Mawu to ngɛ laami mi ɔ, e je ngɔ tsɔɔ mi. I ngma enɛ ɔ he nɔ́ ko bɔɔ momo.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ kane nɔ́ nɛ i ngma a saminya a, yi mi nɛ Mawu to ngɛ laami mi, nɛ Kristo ha nɛ e ba mi ɔ, nyɛ maa na bɔ nɛ i nu sisi ha.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Yi nɔhi nɛ be ɔ, adesa li laami sane nɛ ɔ. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɔ je kpo kɛ tsɔɔ e bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Laami sane ɔ ji kaa sane kpakpa a he ɔ, gbaami nɛ Mawu gbaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ hu ba na eko. Mɛ tsuo a ba pee kaa nɔmlɔ tso kake ɔ he níhi; nɛ si nɛ Mawu wo kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ ɔ, a ná mɛ hu a blɔ nya nɔ.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Mawu dloo mi nike ní pɔtɛɛ ko kaa sane kpakpa a fiɛlɔ, nɛ ma kɛ sɔmɔ lɛ. E he wami ɔ nɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
