translation_verse: Jinɛ i pi nɔ ko kulaa ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Se Mawu ha mi dloomi nɛ ɔ kaa ma ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ a ma na ke a ba nyɛɛ Kristo se.

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: Mawu ke ma fiɛ, konɛ je ɔ tsuo nɛ nu bɔ nɛ laami sane nguaa nɛ ɔ ma plɛ kɛ ba mi ha. Mawu nɛ́ bɔ níhi tsuo ɔ, ngɔ laami sane nɛ ɔ kɛ laa yi nɔhi nɛ be ɔ.

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ nɔ yeli tsuo, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ a na bɔ nɛ Mawu juɛmi mi kuɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ asafo ɔ ngɛ ní tsue nɛ Mawu yi mi tomi ɔ nɛ ba mi.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Blema lokoo nɛ Mawu to e yi mi kaa e ma tsu nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu nɔ nɛ e ha nɛ e ba mi.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ wa heɔ Kristo Yesu yeɔ, nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ he je ɔ, wa yi gbeye kaa wa maa ya Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui kaa i ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ nyɛ he. I ngɛ nɔ́ nae, konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami. Kristo suɔmi

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he i kplaa si ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ haa mɛ biɛ.

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: I kpaa Mawu pɛɛ, konɛ kɛ gu e ní babauu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ha nɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ mumi mi he wami.

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: I kpaa pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ he ye, nɛ Kristo nɛ hi nyɛ tsui mi, konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kɛ suɔmi nɛ mi wa.

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ ma yɔse suɔmi nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ mi blimi, e kami, kɛ e mi kuɔmi.

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: Ee, nyɛ ma ba yɔse Kristo suɔmi nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa juɛmi sui he ɔ, nɛ nyɛ su maa hi kaa Mawu nitsɛ su.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: Á gu Kristo Yesu nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami yi nɔhi tsuo ngɛ asafo ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene. Amen.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya, bɔ nɛ maa sa ní tsumi nɛ Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ ba tsu ɔ.

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ pee kake kɛ hi si. He jɔmi ɔ nɛ haa nyɛ peeɔ kake ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ lɛ haa.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ mumi kake lɛ ngɛ. Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nɔ́ kake too nɔ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ kake, hemi kɛ yemi kake, kɛ nɔ sɔlemi kake lɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Mawu kake lɛ ngɛ; lɛ ji adesahi tsuo a tsɛ. E tsuɔ ní kɛ guu adesahi tsuo a nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ adesahi tsuo a mi.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ ke, “Benɛ e yaa hiɔwe lokoo ɔ, e ngɔ nihi nɛ e nuu nyɔguɛ ɔ kɛ ho; e ha nimli adesahi nike níhi.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Munyu nɛ ɔ sisi ji, loko e ho hiɔwe ya a, e ba zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ya su zugba a sisi tɔɔ.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ba zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu nɛ e kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, konɛ a na lɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he.

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: Wɔ tsuo wa ma ba hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ mi, nɛ wa maa le Mawu Bi ɔ saminya. Wa maa wa ngɛ mumi mi hluu kɛ yaa si wa maa pee kaa Kristo ɔ nitsɛ.

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, wa be si hie hu kaa jokuɛwi nɛ heɔ tsɔɔmi yeɔ kaa kɔɔhiɔ mimiɛɔ nɔ́ kɛ yaa kɛ baa, konɛ nihi nɛ toɔ ga yaya, nɛ a yeɔ kutupɔ kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ a nine ko su wa nɔ.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, e hia kaa waa kɛ anɔkuale yemi nɛ suɔ wa sibi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, wa maa wa ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ wa maa hi kaa Kristo nɛ lɛ ji asafo ɔ yi ɔ.

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: se sisi numi be he. Wami he ɔ nɛ Mawu haa nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a blɔ nya be mi; ejakaa a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, nɛ a tsui hu kplii.

english_verse: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
translation_verse: A zo tɔ ywia! Yahomi he mɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ a hɛ tsuɔ kɛ tsuɔ mu níhi babauu nɛ he peeɔ tai.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, nyɛ nu Kristo he, nɛ nyɛ ba pee e se nyɛɛli; nɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ e he ɔ, a tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ ba nyɛ je mi saa ngɛ nɔmlɔ su momo ɔ nya, nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ yayahi nɛ puɛɔ nɔ a se ɔ, nyɛ kpa!

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa ni hehi nɛ a bɔ mɛ ehe ngɛ Mawu subai nɔ; konɛ a na nyɛ kaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ nyɛ he hu tsɔ.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa lakpa yemi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tu e nyɛmi anɔkuale sisiisi. Ejakaa wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ wa ngɛ kaa Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní munomunohi.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha Abosiami blɔ nɛ e ba sɛ nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ juɔ ɔ, e ko ju hu. Se mohu e ngɔ e nguɛ nyɔngma kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ konɛ e ná nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ye bua nihi nɛ e fi mɛ.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko wo Mawu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi mi la. Ejakaa mumi ɔ ngɛ kaa so ko nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ kadi nyɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa be ma nɛ Mawu ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ mi mi doomi, hɛdɔ, mi mi la, kɛ muklii mi fumi se nɛ po ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ pɛ, kɛ nɔ jɛmi basabasa, kɛ ninyɛ tsuo he.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Mawu bimɛ nɛ e suɔ ji nyɛ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kase lɛ.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ ní klɔuklɔuhi ji nyɛ he je ɔ, e sɛ kaa a woɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, loo mu ní tsumi, loo hɛkɔ ta tete ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nihi nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, loo a tsuɔ mu ní, loo a hɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃ ɔ, a be blɔ nya ngɛ he nɛ Kristo kɛ Mawu ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ. .

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ pee nyɛ kuasia; ejakaa nihi nɛ gboɔ tue, nɛ a peeɔ yayamihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi mi la gblaa a tue wawɛɛ.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko bɔ.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Jinɛ sa a, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ diblii mi, se nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ba mɛtɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, he ɔ, nyɛ ba plɛ la. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa nihi nɛ kɛ la ngɛ nyɛɛe.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Ejakaa la kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ he okadihi nɛ a naa ji kpakpa peemi, dami sane yemi, kɛ anɔkuale tumi.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kase Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya ní.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Diblii mi níhi nɛ se nami be he ɔ, nyɛ ko pee. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ je mɛ kpo nɛ nihi nɛ a na.

english_verse: But the light will show what these things are really like.
translation_verse: Ke a je nɔ́ ko kpo kɛ ba la nya a, a naa lɛ paa;

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: ejakaa la lɛ haa nɛ a naa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a de ke, “Mo nɔ nɛ o ngɛ mahe hwɔe, o hɛ nɛ tsɛ, nɛ o te si kɛ je gbeje. Kɛkɛ Kristo ma kpɛ ha mo ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko je kuasia; se mohu nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛ yo níhi nɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya ní.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko de dã, ejakaa e kɛ sakasaka peemi lɛ nyɛɛɔ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ mumi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛɛ na Tsɛ Mawu si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he. Yigbayihi kɛ a hunomɛ

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yigbayi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ hunomɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Ejakaa huno ɔ ngɛ e yo ɔ nɔ he wami kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ngɛ asafo ɔ nɔ he wami ɔ. Kristo ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha, nɛ e kɛ he asafo ɔ yi wami; ee, asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa Kristo nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hunomɛ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu suɔ asafo ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e wami ngɔ ha ngɛ e he ɔ.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: Kristo ngɔ sane kpakpa a, nɛ e kɛ tsu asafo ɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ nyu fɔɔ nɔ he ha lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ pee lɛ klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu kɛ̃, e sa kaa nyumu nɛ suɔ e yo kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he. Ke nyumu ko suɔ e yo ɔ, ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: (Nɔ ko nyɛ́ lɛ nitsɛ e he lo, se mohu e lɛɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, nɛ e baa e yi saminya kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu hyɛɛ asafo ɔ.

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ kaa Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi.)

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Enɛ ɔ he nɛ nyumu ma si e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e maa mɛtɛ e yo he, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee he lo kake.”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale laami munyu komɛ nɛ a he hia saminya jeɔ kpo ngɛ ngmami nɛ ɔ mi; nɛ imi lɛɛ i kɛ ngɛ Kristo kɛ asafo ɔ he toe.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ji, e sa kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ e yo kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ yogbayo tsuaa yogbayo nɛ bu e huno.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ fɔli tue kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔmɔe, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa nyɛ peemi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: and you will have a long and happy life.”
translation_verse: konɛ e hi ha mo, nɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi.”

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Fɔli, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a mi mi la; se mohu nyɛ tsɔse mɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo mɛ ga kpakpa nɛ maa sa Kristo hɛ mi. Nyɔmtsɛmɛ kɛ a nyɔguɛhi

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nyɔguɛhi, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ he domi, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ha Kristo ɔ;

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi nɛ ma ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa suɔ nyɛ sane. Se mohu nyɛɛ je nyɛ tsui mi tɔɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ, ejakaa Kristo nyɔguɛhi ji nyɛ.

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsu ní kɛ bua jɔmi kaa nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe, se pi adesa.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai kaa ke mo nɔ ko o pee kpakpa a, nyɔguɛ ji mo jio, odehe ji mo jio Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa to mo nane mi ja nɔuu ekohu.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ nɛ hi si ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ a susuma he gbeye womi. Nyɛ kai kaa nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ kake lɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi. Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ mia, nɛ a kɛ mumi yayamihi nɛ hwu ta

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ nɛ waje nyɛ.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kpla tahwu ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ Abosiami ga tsɔmi ɔmɛ a nya nɛ nyɛɛ da.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpla ta hwumi níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke ligbi yobu ɔ ba a, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa da nya, nɛ́ ke nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ to ní gbe nya a, nyɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ da si kpɛii.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ da si nɛ nyɛ ha anɔkuale nɛ miaa nyɛ kaa mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́, nɛ dami sane yemi nɛ pee kaa dama ngɛ nyɛ gugue mi.

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ pee klaalo kɛ fiɛ he jɔmi sane kpakpa a, nyɛ kɛ pee tokota nɛ nyɛɛ wo.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ nyɛ dɛ kaa tsɛi nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ kɛ gbe nɔ yayami ɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi kɛ a he la a tsuo.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Yi wami hemi nɛ pee dade pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ bu. Nyɛɛ pɛtɛ Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ ji mumi ɔ klaate ɔ he.

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sɔle kɛ kpa Mawu pɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ mumi ɔ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mumi ɔ tue, konɛ nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ kpa pɛɛ ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ daa.

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sɔle ha imi hulɔ, konɛ be tsuaa be nɛ ma tu munyu ɔ, Mawu nɛ ha mi e sɛ gbi, nɛ e ha mi kã nɛ ma kɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a mi laami sane ɔ.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ he nɛ, i ba pee Yesu Kristo bɔfo, pohu amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a wo mi kɔsɔkɔsɔ. Nyɛ kpa pɛɛ konɛ ma fiɛ kɛ kã kaa bɔ nɛ sa nɛ ma tu munyu ɔ. Nyagbe sɛ yemi

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ, Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ ha nɛ a hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi; a suɔ a sibi, nɛ a pɛtɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ, Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo kɛ Timoteo, Kristo Yesu sɔmɔli ɔ, ngma womi nɛ ɔ mane Kristo Yesu ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, asafo nya dali ɔmɛ, kɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Filipi ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! Paulo kpa pɛɛ kɛ ha nihi nɛ maa kane e womi ɔ

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Be tsuaa be nɛ ye juɛmi maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, i naa Mawu si ha nyɛ.

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: Daa nɛ ɔ, i kɛ bua jɔmi faa kue ha Mawu ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he;

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: ejakaa nyɛ sa sina kaa nyɛ piɛ ye he wawɛɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi mi kɛ je sisije kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: I heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu, nɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ je ní tsumi kpakpa nɛ ɔ sisi ɔ maa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ yaa si nyɛ maa gbe nya ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba a.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: I suɔ nyɛ saminya, nɛ e sa kaa ma susu nyɛ he wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ejakaa Mawu dloomi ɔ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛe kɛ hɛdɔ, kɛ je sisije nɛ i ngɛ ye nane nɔ kɛ bee, kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ a wo mi tsu ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ wa ná kikɛmɛ a dloomi ɔ, nɛ wa ngɛ he ní tsue.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Kristo Yesu mi mi sãã lɛ ngɛ wa he ɔ, jã ye hɛ ngɛ jae wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ he; Mawu ji ye odase kaa i yi lakpa.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: I ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae kaa suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ sibi ɔ mi nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛ ná nile nɛ ma ha nyɛ nɔ́ se kɔmi mumi,

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛɛ le kpakpa mi tso. Kɛkɛ ɔ, mu ko mu ko, kɛ piami ko piami ko be nyɛ he sae kɛ yaa su ligbi ɔ nɛ Kristo maa ba.

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: Kristo Yesu nitsɛ ma ha nyɛ ma na subai nɛ hi saminya ngɛ nyɛ wami si himi mi, konɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ a je e yi. Kristo lɛ haa nɔ wami

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le kaa sanehi nɛ ba ye nɔ ɔ mohu ha nɛ sane kpakpa a ya su nihi babauu.

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mɔ mi buli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ tsuo ba na le kaa Kristo nɛ i ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ he nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, sane kpakpa a nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a ti ni komɛ a hɛ kɔɔ ye nɔ, nɛ a jeɔ mi hunga, se ni komɛ hu kɛ juɛmi kpakpa fiɛɔ.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Kuu enyɔne ɔ kɛ suɔmi fiɛɔ, ejakaa a le kaa ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha mi ji kaa ma fa sane kpakpa a he.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Ni kpa amɛ fiɛ we sɛ gbi ɔ anɔkuale mi. Ke a ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a woɔ pɛ; a susuu kaa ke a pee ja kɛkɛ a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kɛ piɛ tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ he.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Ja he ɔ mɛni? E haa mi bua jɔmi mohu kaa lakpa tomi nya jio, anɔkuale mi jio, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, Kristo nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na bua jɔmi. Ee, ye bua maa jɔ,

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: ejakaa i le kaa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kpae, kɛ he wami nɛ Yesu Kristo mumi ɔ haa a, ma kpɔ mi.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ, nɛ i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ ji kaa zo be mi gbee; se mohu be tsuaa be ɔ, ma pee kã saminya, konɛ wami mi jio, gbenɔ mi jio, titli ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ wo Kristo hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Ejakaa imi lɛɛ Kristo ji ye wami, nɛ gbenɔ ɔ, ye se nami.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Se ke e ba mi kaa ke i ngɛ wami mi nɛ ma nyɛ ma tsu ní pe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ i li e mi nɔ́ nɛ ma hla.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti i ngɛ. Imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i suɔ kaa ma si wami nɛ ɔ, nɛ i kɛ Kristo ya hi si, ejakaa lɔ ɔ hi kulaa pe.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: I heɔ enɛ ɔ yeɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i le kaa i kɛ nyɛ tsuo maa hi si, konɛ ma piɛ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke wa ba bua ekohu ɔ, nyɛ ma na he blɔ hluu tsɔ kɛ fĩa kaa i ha nɛ nyɛ ba le Kristo Yesu.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ hia pe kulaa ji, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa bɔ nɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ, konɛ i nyɛ ba na nyɛ jio, i bɛ́ jio, ma nu nyɛ he kaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi kake hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi kpɛii kɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a he plee.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ nyɛ ɔ a ní peepee nɛ wo nyɛ he gbeye. Nyɛɛ pee kã be tsuaa be. Lɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ a maa na paa kaa a hɛ mi ma kpata, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ a ma he nyɛ yi wami. Ejakaa enɛ ɔ lɛɛ Mawu dɛ mi e je.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Blɔ nya nɛ a ha nyɛ kaa Kristo we bi ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ pi kaa nyɛ ma he ye kɛkɛ, se mohu kaa e he ɔ, nyɛ maa na amanehlu hulɔ.

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ pee nyɛ yi mi kake; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi, nɛ nyɛ we oti, kɛ juɛmi hu nɛ pee kake. Kɛkɛ ɔ, imi hu ma na bua jɔmi babauu.

english_verse: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ fo e nyɛmi nɔ́ mi; e ko fo lɛ nitsɛ pɛ e nɔ́ mi.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Kristo Yesu juɛmi ɔ nɛ pee nyɛ hu nyɛ juɛmi.

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: E hɛɛ Mawu su lɛɛ, se e pee we lɛ kaa doo ɔ, a na lɛ kaa e kɛ Mawu sɔ.

english_verse: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
translation_verse: E ba e he si, nɛ e bu tue hluu kɛ ya su gbeje tete; e gbo sɛumi tso nɔ gbenɔ.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Mawu wo e nɔ gojoo, nɛ e ha lɛ biɛ nɛ kle pe biɛhi tsuo.

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: nɛ a maa jaje paa ke, Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔmtsɛ; a maa pee ja kɛ wo Tsɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami. Nyɛɛ pee kaa la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ je ɔ mi

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! E he hia wawɛɛ kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete nɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue wawɛɛ pe kekle ɔ po. Nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi, kɛ he domi blibliibli nɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami.

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa be tsuaa be ɔ, Mawu ngɛ nyɛ he ní tsue, konɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi nɛ nyɛ kɛ pee e suɔmi nya ní.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ he ma tsɔ, nɛ piami ko piami ko be nyɛ he hie; nyɛ maa pee Mawu bimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ngɛ yayami peeli, kɛ nihi nɛ a tue wa a a kpɛti. Ejakaa nyɛ je mi bami he tsɔ kaa bɔ nɛ dodoe kpɛɔ.

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ hɛɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ mi wawɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ Kristo maa ba a, ma nyɛ ma fĩa kaa fo nɛ i tu, aloo dengme nɛ i gbo kɛ tsu nyɛ he ní ɔ pee we yaka.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Ke e maa ba mi kaa a ma plɛ ye muɔ kɛ pue nyɛ he bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sãe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi he ní tsue ɔ nɔ po ɔ, ye bua maa jɔ, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ma nya.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ hu nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ nya. Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito a blɔ hiami blɔ nya tomi

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa suɔ ɔ, e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma tsɔ Timoteo kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke i nu nyɛ he ɔ, ye nɔ gbagba maa te.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Timoteo pɛ ji nɔ nɛ susuu nyɛ he, nɛ e hlaa kaa e hi ha nyɛ; i li nɔ kpa ko hu kaa lɛ.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ kulaa a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ko ngɛ lɛ nɔ kake pɛ e nɔ mi foe. Yesu Kristo he sane ɔ pi a kɔmɔ.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le Timoteo mɔde bɔmi! Nyɛ le kaa e tsu ní nɛ se bé; e kɛ mi tsu sane kpakpa a he ní kaa bi kɛ e tsɛ.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i na ye níhi a nya pɛ ma tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Imi nitsɛ hu, ye hɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ kaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma ba su nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Wa nyɛmi Epafrodito nɛ nyɛ tsɔ lɛ ye ngɔ ɔ, e kɛ mi ba tsu ní saminya kaa ta bulɔ kpakpa. E sɔmɔ mi bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye juɛmi nya a, e hia kaa ma wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: E hɛ ngɛ jae wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he, nɛ akɛnɛ nyɛ nu kaa e be he wami ɔ, e ngɛ tsui yee.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, e nu hiɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ e gbo. Se Mawu na lɛ mɔbɔ; pi lɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu imi hulɔ; e je mi kɛ je kɔmɔ yemi babauu mi.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he nɛ e be sɔe ha mi kulaa kaa ma wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ. Ke nyɛ na lɛ ekohu ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi; kɛkɛ imi hu ma kpa tsui yemi.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Nyɛ he lɛ atuu kɛ bua jɔmi babauu kaa nyɛ nyɛmi nɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mɛ.

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo ní tsumi ɔ he ɔ, e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ e sake e he lo ngɔ fɔ he. Se e pee enɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ sɔmɔ mi ngɛ nyɛ nane mi.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ. Pɔ tɔɛ ye he kaa ma ngma nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekohu; ejakaa lɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa le nyɛ he nɔ hyɛmi.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ gbee ɔmɛ a he, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ ní tsuli yaya amɛ a he, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ nihi nɛ woɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he pa ke a po nɔ ɔ a he.

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Wɔ mohu ji nihi nɛ a po mɛ anɔkuale mi. Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa jaa Mawu kɛ guu e mumi ɔ nɔ, nɛ wa fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ Kristo Yesu nɔ. Wa ngɔɛ wa hɛ kɛ fɔɛ he lo nya ní peemi níhi a nɔ.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: I ye otsi pɛ nɛ a po mi. Israel fɔfɔɛ ji mi; i je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi; Hebri no mi Hebri no ji mi; mlaa a nya a, Farisi no kpanaa hulɔ.

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: Ye hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ kɛ wa asafo ɔ yi mi. Ke mlaa a nɔ yemi nɔ a guu kɛ dlaa nɔ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ, lɛɛ piami ko piami ko be ye he.

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: I kɛ lɛ pee kake kulaa. Jehanɛ lɛɛ pi mlaa nɔ nɛ i yeɔ nɔ nɛ a maa da kɛ wo mi nguɔ hu; mohu ɔ, Kristo nɛ i he ye ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu maa wo mi nguɔ ejakaa i he Kristo ye.

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae kɛkɛ ji kaa ma le Kristo, nɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ha e ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, ma na nya. Ma na nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ e na nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ e gbo ɔ.

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: I de we ke ye nine su jlasi ɔ nɔ momo, loo i hi kɛ pi si. Se mohu, i ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa ye nine maa su nɔ, ejakaa enɛ ɔ he nɛ Kristo Yesu ngɔ mi kɛ pee e nɔ́ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ hɛ kɛ pi oti ɔ, konɛ ye nine nɛ su jlasi ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu tsɛ wɔ kɛ je hiɔwe tɔɔ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Wɔ nihi tsuo nɛ wa wa ngɛ mumi mi ɔ, juɛmi nɛ ɔ lɛ sa kaa waa hɛɛ. Se ke nyɛ ti ni komɛ ngɛ nɔ́ kpa susue ɔ, Mawu ma je lɔ ɔ hu kpo paa kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ wo ye nane. Okadi kpakpa nɛ wa to nyɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ ja a, nyɛɛ kase mɛ.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: I de nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ si abɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu i kɛ vo nyu ngɛ nyɛ dee ekohu ke gbenɔ nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ, nihi babauu a je mi bami peeɔ mɛ e he nyɛli.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ma kpata a hɛ mi kɛ maa ya neneene. Ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a muklii ji a mawu nɛ a jaa. A nyaa zo níhi a he, nɛ je mi níhi pɛ a he a susuu.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma a, hiɔwe e ngɛ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ wa ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa wa kpɔlɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa je kɛ ba.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛmiyo Evodia, kɛ nyɛmiyo Sintika pɛɛ kpae kaa a pee kake ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Nɛ mo, ye nyɛmi sɔmɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ, i ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae nɛ o ye bua yi nɛ ɔmɛ. Ejakaa a kɛ Klemente, kɛ nyɛmimɛ kpahi nɛ waa kɛ mɛ sɔmɔ ɔ, piɛ ye he kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ kɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a. A ngma nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a biɛ ngɛ Mawu wami womi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ daa! I ngɛ dee ekohu ke, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ!

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ná nɔ tsuaa nɔ he tsui. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ su si ta.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko hao ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he; se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ sɔlemi, kɛ pɛɛ kpami, kɛ sina nɛ wo nyɛ hiami ní ɔmɛ a ta ha Mawu.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu he jɔmi nɛ pã adesa juɛmi tsuo ɔ maa bu nyɛ tsui, kɛ nyɛ juɛmi he ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, nihi nɛ ji anɔkuale, nihi nɛ sa bu, níhi nɛ da, níhi nɛ he tsɔ, níhi nɛ ngɛ fɛu, níhi nɛ woɔ nɔ hɛ mi nyami, ke je mi bami kpakpa ko ngɛ, ke yi jemi ko hu ngɛ ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ nyɛ kase kɛ je ye nya, kɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ nu, nɛ nyɛ na ngɛ ye he ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ pee; nɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si. Nike ní he sina

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: I na bua jɔmi babauu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kaa be saii ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i nui nyɛ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ na he blɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ suɔmi kpo jee kɛ tsɔɔ mi ekohu. I tsɔɔ we kaa nyɛ susuu we ye he hu, se he blɔ nɛ nyɛ ya na we kɛ pee nɔ́ ko ha mi.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: I le ohia mi si himi, nɛ i le ní kpɔtɔɔ mi si himi hulɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ i kase ji be tsuaa be ɔ, ye bua nɛ jɔ nɔ́ he; i tɔ jio, hwɔ ngɛ mi yee jio, ye bua nɛ jɔ; kpɔtɔɔ be mi jio, hiami mi jio, ye bua nɛ jɔ.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: Kristo lɛ woɔ mi he wami, nɛ e haa nɛ i nyɛɔ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ pee saminya kaa nyɛ ba ye bua mi ngɛ ye nɔ́ nami be ɔ mi.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Filipi bi, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa sisije ɔ, benɛ a bɔni sane kpakpa fiɛmi, nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ je Makedonia a, asafo ko asafo ko kɛ mi bɔɛ huɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hami kɛ hemi mi, ja nyɛ pɛ ji asafo nɛ ye bua mi.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ngɛ Tesalonika a po, pi si kake kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ mane mi ní.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Pi kaa nike ní nɛ i ngɛ hlae doo, se mohu kaa nyɛ maa gu lɔ ɔ peemi nɔ kɛ na biɛ kaa kpakpa peeli.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Níhi tsuo nɛ nyɛ mane ɔ ba su mi; a hiɛ kulaa pe bɔ nɛ i susu! Epafrodito ngɔ nyɛ manemi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi hu. Nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa bɔ ko nɛ a sã ha Mawu. Bɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ jeɔ via liliili; e saa Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ e naa he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Ye Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ hia nyɛ ɔ kɛ maa je e ní babauu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ mi kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: A je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ yi kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene. Amen. Nyagbe sɛ yemi

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: I biɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɔ a he kɛ ha Kristo Yesu ɔ. Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ, titli ɔ, Kaisare ɔ we ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nɛ i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ɔ, i kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ngma womi nɛ ɔ

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: mane ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ji wa nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Kolose, nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ a kɛ Kristo pee kake ɔ. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! Sina sɔlemi

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ke wa ngɛ sɔlee ha nyɛ ɔ, wa naa Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ si daa.

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: Ejakaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, wa nu he.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: Sane kpakpa a ngɛ nɔ yae, nɛ e ngɛ yiblii woe ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu e ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ mi kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nu Mawu dloomi ɔ he nɛ nyɛ nu sisi kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kase Mawu dloomi sane nɛ ɔ kɛ je wa suɔlɔ Epafra nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsumi kake tsue ɔ nya. Lɛ hu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nɛ e ngɛ ní tsue ha wɔ.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: Suɔmi nɛ mumi ɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, Epafra ba bɔ wɔ he sane.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ wa nu nyɛ he ɔ kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa jɔɔ we Mawu pɛɛ kpami ha nyɛ. Wa biɔ ke Mawu nɛ ha nɛ nyɛɛ le e suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nyɛ ná nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi nɛ mumi ɔ haa nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ maa sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. Nyɛ ma tsu ní kpakpa sɔuu, nɛ nyɛ maa le Mawu saminya pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ le lɛ daa.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: E kpɔ wɔ kɛ je diblii he wami ɔ sisi, nɛ e kɛ wɔ ba e Bi nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya a matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Kristo ji Mawu nɛ a nɛ́ lɛ ɔ subai nɛ a naa. Lɛ ji nibɔ níhi tsuo a kpɛti tɛte.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e nɔ lɛ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba, níhi nɛ a naa, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a nɛ́. Ekomɛ ji nihi nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kojoɔ nihi, nihi a nɔ yeli, kɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛ he wami kpahi. Mawu gu Kristo nɔ kɛ bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ Kristo nɔuu a bɔ mɛ ha.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Kristo ngɛ loko a bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ níhi tsuo ngɛ a hanɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji yi kɛ ha asafo ɔ nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ. E mi asafo ɔ puɛ kɛ je. Lɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ a tle si kɛ je gbeje, konɛ e ye kekleekle blɔ he ngɛ níhi tsuo a mi.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu nitsɛ lɛ suɔ kaa lɛ Mawu ɔ su pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ hi Bi ɔ mi.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Sa a, nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti kɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛ pee nyɛ he e he nyɛli. Nyɛ peeɔ ní yayamihi, nɛ nyɛ susuɔ ní yayamihi hulɔ.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɛ ba ngɛ he lo mi ɔ gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e kɛ nyɛ ba kpata. E pee enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu, nɛ piami, loo sé ko kó hi nyɛ he ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi; nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii, nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ nyɛ ná benɛ nyɛ nu sane kpakpa a, nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ he. Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ a fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ bɔ níhi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ he lɛ imi Paulo i ba pee sɔmɔlɔ ngɛ. Paulo ní tsumi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e peeɔ mi bua jɔmi kaa nyɛ he ɔ, i ngɛ nɔ́ nae, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ngɛ dengme nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ asafo ɔ nɛ ji e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ɔ, ma gbe nya ngɛ ye he lo nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: Mawu je mi nɛ e tsɔ mi nɛ ma ba sɔmɔ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ ma fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ saminya kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ ji laami sane nɛ Mawu ngɔ laa yi nɔhi kɛ je blema lokoo, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e je ngɔ tsɔɔ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: Mawu suɔ kaa e ha mɛɛ a le kaa kikɛmɛ a laami sane nɛ he jua wa, nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami nɛ ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ hu a kpɛti. Nɛ laami sane ɔ ji, Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa Mawu maa wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ Kristo he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ gboɔ dengme wawɛɛ kɛ tsuɔ ní.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: Dengme babauu nɛ i gbo ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Laodikea, kɛ jehanɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ li mi hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi po ɔ tsuo nyɛ he ɔ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: I ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee nɛ ma kɛ wo mɛ bua, konɛ suɔmi nɛ ha a pee kake. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa nu ní kpakpahi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ tsuo a sisi saminya nɛ nɔ jemi be mi, nɛ a maa le Mawu laami sane ɔ. Mawu laami sane ɔ ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: Nile, kɛ juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ, Kristo mi a naa ngɛ.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, konɛ nɔ ko kɛ nyami ngɔngɔɛ munyu ko kó ba sisi nyɛ.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa he lo mi ɔ, i be nyɛ ngɔ lɛɛ, se mumi mi ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Ke i hyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ toɔ níhi blɔ nya saminya, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ fi si kpɛii ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ mi ɔ, e peeɔ mi bua jɔmi. Wami he ngɛ Kristo mi

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ nyɛ he Kristo Yesu kaa nyɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ pee kake.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ mɛtɛ lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ ha lɛ kulaa. Nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ wa kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ na Mawu si daa.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ nɔ ko kó ngɔ je mi nile, loo yaka sisimi kɛ ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ. Blema tsɔɔmihi, kɛ mumihi nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ ɔ, a ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ je, se pi Kristo ngɔ.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo pee kake, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kristo nɛ ji yi ha nɔ yeli tsuo ɔ su ngɛ nyɛ mi.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Nɛ a sɔle nyɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa a pu nyɛ ngɔ piɛ Kristo he; nɛ Mawu tle nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo si ekohu. Ejakaa nyɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, nɛ e tle Kristo si hulɔ.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Sa a, nyɛ ngɛ kaa ni komɛ nɛ gbo, ejakaa nyɛ peeɔ yayami, nɛ he lo nya a, a pui nyɛ. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo ba wami mi ekohu; ee, Mawu ngɔ wɔ tsuo wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa wɔ.

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: Wa he níhi nɛ a ngma kɛ si wɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ sa wɔ ngɛ mlaa a nya a, e gbe lɛ tsuo. E je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se; ee, e ka ngɔ mɛtɛ sɛumi tso ɔ he.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: Kristo kpɔ he wami ngɛ mumi mi nɔ yeli, kɛ he wami ɔmɛ a dɛ. E bɔ mɛ ahlua paa, nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ je ɔ kaa niinɛ e ye kunimi.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɔ ko nɛ wo nyɛ mlaa ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ye, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa nu he, aloo ngɛ nyami be, Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be, kɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi he.

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kaa níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ a nini kɛkɛ; nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ ji Kristo.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nihi nɛ buu a he kaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a hi pe nihi tsuo ɔ nɛ a bu nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be nɔ́ ko mi. A deɔ ke mɛɛ a naa nina pɔtɛɛ komɛ, nɛ a nyɛɔ nyɛ nɔ ke nyɛɛ kɛ he si bami nɛ ja bɔfohi. Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ woɔ a he nɔ yaka gu.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a mɛtɛ we Kristo nɛ ji yi ɔ he. Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo ɔ, yi ɔ mi e naa níhi tsuo nɛ hia lɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ. Niye ní nɛ ɔ guɔ kpɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ pani ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e haa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ waa bɔ nɛ Mawu to ɔ. Ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, wa gbo lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ wa hɛ ngɛ

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Nɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ gbo, nɛ a kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je mumihi nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ ɔ a dɛ mi. Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ nyɛ ní kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ je ɔ ngɛ bɔe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ? Mɛni he je nyɛ haa a pa woɔ nyɛ mlaa ke,

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: “Koo pɛtɛ he, koo sa o nya, nɛ koo ta he tete po” ɔ?

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɔɔ níhi nɛ ke a tsu a he ní pɛ a hɛ mi kpata a a he. Adesa mlaahi, kɛ tsɔɔmihi kɛkɛ ji enɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, ni komɛ susuɔ kaa kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ nile nɛ haa nɔ nitsɛ fiiɔ si ngɛ jami mi. A buá peeɔ a he humi, nɛ a waa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ yi mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu lɛ a ngɛ jae. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a tsiɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ we akɔnɔ nya.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: A tle nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo si, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hla níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, he nɛ Kristo hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu; pi nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ wami ɔ kɛ Kristo tsuo ngɔ laa ngɛ Mawu mi.

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ níhi nɛ haoɔ nyɛ, yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, mu ní tsumi, mi mi la, akɔnɔ yaya, kɛ hɛ tsumi nɛ ngɛ kaa amaga jami ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ gboɔ tue, nɛ a peeɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi mi fumi ma kple a nɔ.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Sa a, be nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ ba nyɛ je mi ja a, kikɛmɛ a akɔnɔ nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu a se nyɛ ya nyɛɛ.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Se jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ kpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo: mi mi la, mimi fumi, kɛ yi wu tso ní peemi. Nyɛ ko gbe nɔ he guɛ, nɛ munyu yaya ko kó je nyɛ nya.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi lakpa; nyɛ sake nɔmlɔ su momo ɔ, kɛ e ní tsumi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue.

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ wo nɔmlɔ su he. Nɔmlɔ su he nɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu, e bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ mɔde bɔe daa nɛ kaa e maa hi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ maa le lɛ fitsofitso.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi ɔ, slɔɔto ko be Hela no kɛ Yuda no a kpɛti; slɔɔto be nɔ nɛ a po lɛ, kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ a kpɛti. Kɔpe no be ɔ, futufutu no be; nyɔguɛ be ɔ, odehe ko hu be. Nɔ nɛ he hia ji Kristo; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ, Kristo ngɛ e mi.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi ngɛ sane ko ɔ, nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi, nɛ nyɛ kɛ pa nyɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hu ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ngɔ pa nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: He jɔmi nɛ Kristo haa a, nyɛ ha nɛ a na kaa e ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi. Ejakaa nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake ɔ mi ɔ, ní tsumi nɛ Mawu kpee nyɛ ke nyɛ ba tsu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. E sa nɛ nyɛɛ na Mawu si.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ Kristo sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ fuu. Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ní, nɛ nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi ga kɛ juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ. Nyɛ la La womi ɔ mi lahi, yi jemi lahi, kɛ mumi mi lahi kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi nɛ nyɛ kɛ na Mawu si.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ mumi lahi kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee; munyu lɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue jio, ní nyɛ ngɛ tsue jio, nyɛɛ pee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi. Nɛ nyɛɛ gu e nɔ kɛ na Tsɛ Mawu ɔ si. Wami he ɔ mi si himi

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yigbayi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ hunomɛ, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa nyɛ peemi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se nyɛɛli ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hunomɛ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko wa mɛ yi mi.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ fɔli ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, ejakaa enɛ ɔ saa Mawu hɛ mi saminya.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Tsɛmɛ, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bimɛ a mi mi la; ke nyɛ pee ja a, a nine mi maa wo nyu.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Nyɔguɛhi, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi nɛ ma ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa suɔ nyɛ sane. Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mɛ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kɛ pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ pee ha, se pi adesa.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nike ní nɛ Mawu ngɔ to ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ́ nɔ kaa nyɛ hiɔwo, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ɔ ma na e yayami ɔ he hiɔwo, ejakaa Mawu hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ saminya ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ. Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe. Ga womi

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nyɛɛ sɔle daa, nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ na Mawu si.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ hulɔ, konɛ Mawu nɛ bli blɔ ha wɔ nɛ waa fiɛ e sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ. Ejakaa Kristo laami sane nɛ ɔ he nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ.

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɔle nɛ ma gba laami sane nɛ ɔ mi saminya bɔ nɛ sa kaa ma gba mi.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi ngɛ ní sɛɛe ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ munyu nɛ maa je nyɛ nya a nɛ ngɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a wo lɛ ngo, nɛ nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ munyu heto bɔ nɛ sa. Nyagbe sɛ yemi

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Wa nyɛmi Tihiko nɛ wa suɔ lɛ saminya, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ tsue ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma ba bɔ nyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ kɔɔ ye he.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he i ngɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe, konɛ nyɛɛ nu wa he, bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ha, konɛ nyɛ hu e ba wo nyɛ bua.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: Onesimo piɛ e he kɛ ma. Lɛ hu wa nyɛmi nɛ wa suɔ saminya, nɛ yeɔ Kristo anɔkuale ji lɛ; nɛ e je nyɛ asafo ɔ mi. A ma ba bɔ nyɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ amaniɛ tsuo.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Aristarko nɛ a wo i kɛ lɛ tsuo tsu ɔ ke e biɔ nyɛ. Barnaba nyɛmi Marko hu ke e biɔ nyɛ. Nyɛ nine su womi nɔ momo kaa ke Marko ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ atuu.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Yoshua nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yusto hulɔ ɔ ke lɛ hu e biɔ nyɛ. Ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ ji Yuda bi nɛ ba he Kristo ye, nɛ a kɛ mi ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he. Niinɛ, a ngɛ mi wae wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: I ngɛ e he odase yee kaa e gbo dengme saminya ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Laodikea, kɛ Hierapoli ɔ nyɛ he.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luka, tsopatsɛ ɔ nɛ wa suɔ lɛ saminya a, kɛ Dema ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Nyɛ de nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea ke wa biɔ mɛ. Wa biɔ Nimfa, kɛ asafo ɔ nɛ kpee ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ kane womi nɛ ɔ gbe nya a, nyɛ ha nɛ a kane ngɔ ha Laodikea asafo ɔ hulɔ. Womi nɛ i sɛ hlami ngma mane Laodikea asafo ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kane.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya womi nɛ i ngma kaa i biɔ nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ kaa i ngɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ. Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Imi Paulo, Sila, kɛ Timoteo, wa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ya ha asafo mi bi nɛ ngɛ Tesalonika, nɛ ngɛ Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi ha nyɛ! Tesalonika bi a si himi, kɛ a hemi kɛ yemi

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Wa naa Mawu si daa kɛ haa nyɛ tsuo, nɛ daa ke wa ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, wa woɔ nyɛ ta.

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: Wa kaiɔ nyɛ ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu hɛ mi bɔ nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ jeɔ kpo ngɛ nyɛ ní tsumi mi, bɔ nɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, wa le kaa Mawu suɔ nyɛ, nɛ e hla nyɛ kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e nihi.

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: Sane kpakpa a nɛ wa ngɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, pi munyu kɛkɛ nɛ wa ba tu. Nɔ́ nɛ wa ba de nyɛ ɔ wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ bli nyɛ juɛmi nya, nɛ nyɛ na kaa munyu ɔ nɛ wa kɛ ba a, anɔkuale sɔuu. Benɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ le bɔ nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ hi si ha. Wa pee ja, konɛ e hi ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kase waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsuo, ejakaa benɛ a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ɔ, Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi he sɛ gbi ɔ.

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ba pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nihi nɛ he ye ngɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaya tsuo.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Pi Makedonia kɛ Akaya kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ fiɛ ɔ gbɛ fĩa a, se he tsuaa he ɔ, a nu nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Mawu mi ɔ hu he. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e hia we kaa wɔɔ wa deɔ nɔ́ ko hu.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ tsuo yeɔ nyɛ he odase kpakpa kaa benɛ wa ba slaa nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he wɔ atuu. Jehanɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ kpale kɛ je amagahi a se kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, konɛ nyɛ ba sɔmɔ anɔkuale Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ.

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: Mawu Bi Yesu ɔ nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, a tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa e maa je hiɔwe kɛ ba ekohu. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma je wɔ kɛ je tue gblami nɛ ma a mi.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa slaami nɛ wa ba slaa nyɛ ɔ pee we yaka.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ a wa wɔ yi mi, nɛ a jɛ wɔ kɛ pue wa hɛ mi si ngɛ Filipi loko wa ba nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ Tesalonika a. E ngɛ mi kaa níhi fuu ka wɔ blɔ tsimi, se wa Mawu ɔ wo wɔ kã kaa wa ba fiɛ e sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ maa na kaa munyu nɛ wa kɛ ba fɔ nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, pi mu ní tsumi, loo juɛmi yayami mi nɛ e je; wa bɛ nɛ wa ba sisi nyɛ.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, wa bɛ nyɛ ngɔ kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyuhi; jehanɛ hu, wa ba sisi we nyɛ nɛ wa kɛ na nyɛ he se. Mawu ji wa we odase!

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: Wa bɛ, konɛ nimli ba wo wa hɛ mi nyami, nyɛ jio, ni kpahi jio.

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: Pohu wa ngɛ he blɔ kaa wa biɔ enɛ kɛ enɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, ejakaa Kristo bɔfohi ji wɔ. Se benɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, wa pee nyɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ kaa bɔ nɛ bimɛanyɛ hɛɛɔ lɛ nitsɛ e bimɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ wa suɔ nyɛ saminya a, wa na he tsui kaa pi Mawu sane kpakpa a kɛkɛ nɛ wa maa ngɔ ba ha nyɛ; se wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa wami tete wa ma ngɔ fɔ si ha nyɛ. Suɔmi nɛ wa ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nya wa!

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ma kai bɔ nɛ wa tsu ní kɛ pɔtɔ! Benɛ wa ngɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ, wa ngɛ ní tsue nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ wa ko pee tlomi ngɔ ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu ji wa we odase kaa wa ba wa je mi saminya ngɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ nyɛ kpɛti. Wa peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da blɔ nɛ piami ko be wa he.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hi si kaa tsɛ kɛ e bi.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: Wa wo nyɛ he wami; wa wo nyɛ bua, nɛ wa wo nyɛ ga kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi. Lɛ nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ ke nyɛɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ e nyami ɔ mi.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ kake he hu nɛ wa naa Mawu si ngɛ daa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Benɛ wa ngɔ Mawu munyu ɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bu tue, nɛ nyɛ he lɛ atuu, pi kaa nɔmlɔ adesa sɛ gbi, se mohu kaa Mawu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Niinɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ mi.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ pee nyɛ nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ pee Mawu asafo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a mi bi nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha Kristo Yesu ɔ. Nyɛ na amanehlu ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma mi bi a dɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ mɛ hu a na amanehlu ngɛ Yuda bi a dɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ. Mɛ lɛ a wa wɔ yi mi. Mawu na we a he bua jɔmi; a te si wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ!

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Ma je li tete po a ke wa ko fiɛ ha mɛ, konɛ a ko he a yi wami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami ɔ, pe a ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ nɔ toe babauu daa ligbi. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu kɛ e mi mi fumi ɔ kple a nɔ! Paulo suɔ nɛ e ya slaa Tesalonika bi ɔmɛ ekohu

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, e ngɛ mi kaa wa si nyɛ, nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ mi gba be kpiti ko ngɛ he lo mi, se wa hɛ ji nyɛ nɔ. Hɛja sɔuu ha nɛ wa bɔ mɔde wawɛɛ kaa waa na nyɛ hɛ mi ekohu.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Wa hla kaa waa kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ; ee, imi Paulo nitsɛ, i ka si abɔ kaa ma ba. Se Abosiami tsi wɔ blɔ.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ba, nɛ wa ba pue ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ, mɛni nɔ wa maa fĩa kɛ fɔ? Mɛni ma ha wɔ bua jɔmi? Nɛ mɛni jlasi waa kɛ maa fĩa kaa wa ye kunimi? Anɛ pi nyɛ lo?

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: Benɛ wa nyɛ we hu ɔ, wa kplɛɛ kaa wa maa tlɔ Atene kɛkɛ.

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tsɔ Timoteo, wa nyɛmi nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuɔ ní kaa Mawu sɔmɔlɔ kɛ fiɛɔ Kristo he sane kpakpa a. Wa tsɔ lɛ, konɛ e ba wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e ha nyɛ fi si ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi,

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: bɔ nɛ pee nɛ amanehlu nɛ ngɛ bae ɔ ko wo nyɛ ti nɔ ko he gbeye. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha wɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa de nyɛ ngɔ to kaa wa maa na amanehlu. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ lɛ ba mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, benɛ i nyɛ we tsui tomi hu ɔ, e hia kaa ma tsɔ Timoteo nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ́ e ba hyɛ kaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wa kɛ mwɔɔ lo. I ya ye gbeye kaa alini Abosiami ba ka nyɛ, nɛ e ha nɛ wa dengme nɛ wa gbo ɔ maa pee yaka.

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Timoteo kpale kɛ ba, nɛ e ba bɔ wɔ amaniɛ saminyayoo nɛ kɔɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ nyɛ suɔmi ɔ he. E ba de wɔ ke nyɛ susuɔ wa he daa nɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ jaa ngɛ wa he kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa hɛ jaa ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ woɔ wɔ he wami ngɛ amanehlu, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
