translation_verse: Ke nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ mɛtɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kulaa a, wɔ hu wa ma na he wami he.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Nyɛ he ɔ, Mawu haa wɔ bua jɔmi babauu nɛ wa be nyɛe maa na lɛ si saasaa.

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Daa nyɔ kɛ pia a, wa kpaa lɛ pɛɛ kɛ wa tsui tsuo kaa waa na nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, konɛ waa wo nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi he wami.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu nɛ a bli blɔ ha wɔ nɛ waa ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ suɔmi ɔ mi nɛ wa, konɛ nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa suɔ nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: Nɛ e wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tsui nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ piami ko be nyɛ he hie ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi be mi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba a.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ kase kɛ je wa ngɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ba nyɛ je mi nɛ e sa Mawu hɛ mi; nɛ jã nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ. Se kɛ̃, ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ɔ, wa ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae, nɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ga woe kaa nyɛɛ pee kɛ ya nɔ pe jã po.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mlaa nɛ wa wo nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ le.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Mawu suɔmi nya ji kaa nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi.

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko di akɔnɔ se kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ peeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko kó ya pee e nyɛmi yayami kaa e ma ya ngɔ e nyɛmi e yo. Wa de nyɛ enɛ ɔ momo, nɛ wa bɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ wawɛɛ kaa nihi nɛ peeɔ jã a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa gbla a tue.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Mawu tsɛ we wɔ nɛ wa ba tsu mu ní, se mohu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa he nɛ tsɔ.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ e bui, se mohu Mawu, nɔ nɛ ha nyɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, suɔmi nɛ sa kaa e hi nyɛmimɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a kpɛti ɔ, e hia we kaa ma ngma nyɛ womi ngɛ lɔ ɔ he hu. Mawu tsɔɔ nyɛ momo kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he,

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: nɛ niinɛ ɔ, nyɛ suɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia a saminya. Se wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee pe ja po.

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he kpoo, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ko wo ni kpahi a sane mi. Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nine nɛ tsu ní kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ pee jã a, nihi nɛ li Kristo lolo ɔ maa bu nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛ he ngɔe kɛ fɔ nɔ ko nɔ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, wa suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le anɔkuale sane nɛ kɔɔ nihi nɛ gbo ɔ a he, konɛ nyɛ ko ye kɔmɔ kaa nihi nɛ be hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu gbo, nɛ e te si ekohu. Jã kɛ̃, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa ke Yesu ma a, Mawu maa ngɔ nihi nɛ gbo ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ba.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma kple si kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba kɛ ose nɛ nya wa. Bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a maa wo gbi, nɛ Mawu titimati ɔ maa pɛ. Nihi nɛ he Yesu ye loko a gbo ɔ maa te si kekle.

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɛ maa hi wami mi jamɛ a be ɔ, a ma sa waa kɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ya kɔɔhiɔ mi ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya kpee Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Nɛ waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa hi si daa.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, be tutuutu nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi ɔ, e hia we kaa waa ngma nyɛ.

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le tsɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ julɔ baa nyɔ mi.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ nihi ma de ke, “Wa he mi jɔ wɔ, nɛ wa tue mi hu jɔ wɔ” ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ yo nɛ mi wa nuɔ kɔɔmi si kake too ɔ; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be e he yee.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Se nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ pi diblii mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ligbi ɔ ma ba ti nyɛ si kaa julɔ.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ la bimɛ ji nyɛ; ee, piani bimɛ ji nyɛ; wa pi nyɔ, loo diblii bimɛ.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nyɔ mi nɛ a hwɔɔ mahe, nɛ nyɔ mi dã deli deɔ dã.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ piani bimɛ ji wɔ, nɛ e hia kaa wa hɛ mi nɛ ka si. Wa hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ suɔmi ɔ mi nɛ wa kaa dama, nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa a ma he wa yi wami ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu mi nɛ wa kaa dade pɛɛ.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Mawu hla we wɔ kɛ to, nɛ e na wa he abofu. Se mohu, e wo wɔ kɛ to, konɛ e he wa yi wami kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ.

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: Kristo ba gbo ha wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, waa kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ ye bua nyɛ sibi kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Nyagbe ga womi kɛ sɛ yemi

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛmimɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu nihi nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ asafo ɔ hɛ mi nyɛɛli nɛ tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu mɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ suɔ mɛ ngɛ ní tsumi nɛ a ngɛ tsue ɔ he. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu, nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ! Nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ hejɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ wo ni nɛmɛ nɛ be tsui ɔ he wami; nyɛɛ ye bua ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó pee yayami kɛ to yayami nane mi. Se mohu daa nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde kaa nyɛ maa pee kpakpa ha nyɛ sibi, kɛ nihi tsuo.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Nyɛ na bua jɔmi daa;

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ sɔle be tsuaa be;

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: nyɛɛ na Mawu si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he. Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko gbe Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ka nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hyɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he nɛ wa;

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ji yayami ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ je he.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa wɔ he jɔmi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ nɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he kulaa kɛ pi si. E hyɛ nyɛ mumi, nyɛ klaa, kɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa nɔ nɛ piami ko kó hi he be mi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba a.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nɛ e maa pee hulɔ.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nga nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ha wɔ kɛ suɔmi nɛ mi wa.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ fae ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi kaa nyɛɛ kane womi nɛ ɔ ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Paulo, Sila, kɛ Timoteo ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Tesalonika asafo ɔ, nɛ a kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo pee kake ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! A maa gbla nihi a tue

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Wa nyɛmimɛ! E hia kaa waa na Mawu si daa ha nyɛ. E sa kaa waa pee jã, ejakaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ngɛ wae wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ kɛ ha e nyɛmi ɔ ngɛ nɔ yae bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa fĩaa fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Mawu asafo ɔmɛ a mi kaa nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ mi wa. Ejakaa be mi nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, nyɛ to nyɛ tsui si, nɛ nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi gblee.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ paa kaa Mawu yeɔ dami sane; e ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ dlae kɛ ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Niinɛ, Mawu maa ye dami sane; nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ɔ, Mawu maa hao mɛ ngɔ to nane mi.

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: Nɛ nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, e ma ha waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo he jɔmi. E maa pee enɛ ɔ, be mi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu maa hia kpo kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ e bɔfo katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ,

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam. Nihi nɛ li Mawu, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ bui Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu sane kpakpa a, e kɛ mɛ maa to ní.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: A maa gbla a tue, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene. A ma je mɛ kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. A be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, kɛ e he wami ɔ nae

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: ligbi ɔ nɛ e maa ba nɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ma je e yi, nɛ nihi nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa piɛ a he, ejakaa sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ wa ngɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he ye.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, wa kpaa Mawu pɛɛ ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ je mi bami nɛ sa nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa wo nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi he wami, nɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ to kaa nyɛ maa pee ɔ, nyɛ maa pee.

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ní peepee he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma je Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu yi. Nɛ e he ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ hɛ mi maa ba nyami ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nya.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ a ma bua wa nya nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ya kpe ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛmimɛ,

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: ke nyɛ nu kaa mumi mi sɛ gbi ko je kpo, aloo munyu ko ngɛ pɛe, aloo kaa a ngɛ dee ke womi ko je wa ngɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ ba momo ɔ, nyɛ juɛmi mi ko pee nyɛ enyɔɔnyɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko hao hulɔ.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ sisi nyɛ ngɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko nɔ. Ja nyagbe atuã tsɔmi ɔ ba kekle loko ligbi ɔ maa ba. Dikalɔ ɔ nɛ hɛ mi ma kpata a maa je kpo.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ kaii we kaa benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, i de nyɛ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo lo?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ tsi e nya nɛ e ba je we e he kpo lolo ɔ? Ke be ɔ su ɔ, dikalɔ ɔ ma ba hia kpo kɛ̃.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Yi wu tso ní nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ, a je sisi momo. Se nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a be bae, ja a je nɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ tsie ɔ ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi lolo.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma je dikalɔ ɔ kpo paa. Se ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ba a, e kɛ mumi nɛ maa je e nya mi ɔ maa gbe lɛ, nɛ e hɛ mi kpɛmi ɔ ma kpata dikalɔ ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Dikalɔ ɔ maa ba kɛ Abosiami he wami, nɛ e ma ba pee lakpa nyakpɛ ní, kɛ okadi slɔɔtohi.

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: E maa gu yi wu tso ga blɔ nɔ kɛ sisi nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata a. Ee, a hɛ mi ma kpata, ejakaa a sume nɛ a ngɔ anɔkuale ɔ, konɛ a he a yi wami.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu ma tsaka a juɛmi, nɛ a ma he lakpa munyu maa ye.

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ he we anɔkuale ɔ yi, se yayami mohu he a bua jɔɔ ɔ, a maa bu mɛ fɔ. A hla nyɛ, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Se nyɛmimɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ, e hia kaa waa na Mawu si daa ha nyɛ. Ejakaa kɛ je sisije lokoo ɔ, Mawu hla nyɛ, nɛ e he nyɛ yi wami kɛ gu mumi ɔ nɛ maa tsu nyɛ he ɔ, kɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Mawu tsɛ nyɛ kɛ gu sane kpakpa a nɛ wa fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ, konɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ na nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ da si kpɛii! Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ wa de nyɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ wa ngma nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nitsɛ, kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu, nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e gu e dloomi ɔ nɔ, nɛ e wo wɔ he wami, nɛ e ha wɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ nya wa a,

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: e wo nyɛ bua, nɛ e ha nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ tsu ní kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ tu munyu kpakpa daa.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ, konɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ nɛ ya nɔ nɛ e gbɛ fĩa, nɛ a he lɛ kɛ manye ngɛ he tsuaa he kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ pee ɔ.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ Mawu nɛ je wɔ kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi; ejakaa pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yeɔ anɔkuale. E maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e maa bu nyɛ he, nɛ dikalɔ ɔ be nyɛe maa pee nyɛ nɔ́ ko.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha wa he nyɛ ye saminya. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, wa ngɛ nɔ mi mami kaa nɔ́ nɛ wa de ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ pee, nɛ nyɛ maa ya nɔ maa pee.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha nɛ nyɛɛ nu Mawu suɔmi ɔ, kɛ Kristo tsui si tomi ɔ sisi saminya. E hia kaa a tsu ní

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, wa ngɛ nyɛ fae ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ tsu we ní, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ bɛ a je mi saminya kaa bɔ nɛ wa tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ kó bɔ.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le veveeve kaa e hia kaa nyɛɛ kase wɔ. Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa pee we hejɔ.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: Wa yi nɔ ko ní yaka nɛ́ wa wui he hiɔ; mohu ɔ, wa tsu ní kɛ pɔtɔ. Wa tsu ní nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ wa ko pee tlomi ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: Wa pee enɛ ɔ, pi kaa wa be jamɛ a blɔ nya a, se mohu, konɛ waa ngɔ wa he ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kase wɔ.

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa wa nu kaa ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ peeɔ hejɔ; a tsu we ní, se mohu a ngɔɔ a nya ngɔ woɔ nihi a sanehi a mi.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ mlaa woe, nɛ wa ngɛ mɛ kɔkɔ bɔe ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa a ba a je mi saminya, nɛ a kɛ a nine nguɛ nyɔngma nɛ tsu ní nɛ a ye.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko ha pɔ nɛ tɔ nyɛ kɛ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko sume kaa e maa ye nɔ́ nɛ wa ngma nyɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kadi lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko bɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, zo maa gbe lɛ.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko bu lɛ he nyɛlɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa nyɛmi. Nyagbe munyuhi

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ nɛ haa wɔ he jɔmi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ nɛ ha nyɛ he jɔmi daa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee mi. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nɛ ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ngɛ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ Kristo Yesu, nɔ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ ɔ fami nya a,

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Timoteo, ye bi nitsɛnitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi. Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha mo! Tsɔɔli nɛ ngɛ tsɔɔmi yaya tsɔɔe ɔ, bɔɔ mɛ kɔkɔ

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: De jamɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ke, sanehi nɛ be mi, kɛ weku kpa tslalaa se dimi ɔ, a jɔɔ be puɛmi ngɛ he. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nya sami nɛ se nami be he nɛ a kɛ baa; blɔ nya nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha wɔ ɔ lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɔ we he kulaa; hemi kɛ yemi kɛkɛ a kɛ leɔ.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ, ni komɛ ngmɛɛ he, nɛ nya sami nɛ he be se nami ha nɛ a tla blɔ.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: A hlaa kaa a maa pee a he Mawu mlaa tsɔɔli, se mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nya mi munyu, aloo níhi a he munyu nɛ a ngɛ tue kɛ kã a, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nui sisi.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Mose mlaa a, wɔ tsuo wa le kaa e hi; se e sa kaa a ye nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: E sa kaa wa kai kaa mlaa he hia we nimli kpakpahi. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a woɔ mlaa ha ji mlaa tɔli, awi yeli, nihi nɛ li Mawu, yayami peeli, nihi nɛ Mawu mumi be a mi, nihi nɛ gbee mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsɛmɛ kɛ a nyɛmɛ, kɛ muɔ si pueli kpahi.

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: Ni kpahi hu nɛ a woɔ mlaa ha mɛ ji nihi nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, nyumuhi nɛ kɛ nyumuhi hwɔɔ, nɔmlɔ juli, nihi nɛ ngɔɔ nya, nihi nɛ kaa kita kɛ yeɔ lakpa odase, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ kɛ tsɔɔmi kpakpa a yɛ́.

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: I naa wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu si kaa e ha mi he wami nɛ ma kɛ tsu ní. I naa lɛ si kaa e sa e hɛ mi kaa e hla mi nɛ ma ba sɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa sa a, i tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu; i wa lɛ yi mi, nɛ i pee níhi basabasa. Se Mawu na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ, i he we yi lolo; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee ɔ hu i li.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Se wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dloomi babauu ɔ nya a, suɔmi, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu haa nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, imi hu i ná.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Kristo Yesu ba je ɔ mi, konɛ e ba he yayami peeli a yi wami. Anɔkuale munyu nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ sa kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Imi nitsɛ ɔ, yayami peelɔ kpanaku ji mi pe nihi tsuo.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Se Mawu na mi mɔbɔ. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ ngɔ mi ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ kɛ ha yayami peeli tsuo, kaa e toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e peeɔ kpakpa, konɛ ni kpahi hu nɛ a na kaa neneene wami ɔ, mɛ hu a nine maa su nɔ.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Mawu kake too, Neneene Matsɛ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa nɛ a nɛ lɛ ɔ, a je e yi, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ ya neneene! Amen.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Ye bi Timoteo, munyuhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tu blema ngɛ o he ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ imi hu i ngɛ mo fae ke o pee. Ha munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee kaa ta hwumi níhi ngɛ o dɛ nɛ o kɛ tsu ní saminya.

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: O hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa, nɛ o he nile nɛ hi hɛ ngmengmle. Ni komɛ ya bui a he nile tue, nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ta.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: A ti ni komɛ ji Himeneo, kɛ Aleksandro. I tu mɛ ngɔ wo Abosiami dɛ mi, konɛ a gbla a tue. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ a ma kpa musu bɔmi munyu tumi.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ pee ji kaa daa ligbi ɔ, nyɛ kpa Mawu pɛɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, nɛ nyɛɛ da mi ha nihi, konɛ nyɛɛ na lɛ si ha nihi tsuo.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Sɔlemi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hi, nɛ e saa Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu suɔ kaa nimli tsuo nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ, konɛ a he a yi wami.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Mawu kake kɛkɛ lɛ ngɛ, kɛ nɔ kake nɛ dlaa Mawu kɛ adesa a kpɛti. Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ji Kristo Yesu.

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he hu nɛ Mawu tsɔ mi kaa bɔfo, konɛ ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ a he Kristo nɛ a ye anɔkuale mi. Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi; i yi lakpa.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃ i suɔ kaa yihi hu nɛ a ngɔ juɛmi kɛ to a he dlami he. A dla a he bɔ nɛ sa kɛkɛ kaa humi. A gbɔ a yi ngɛ hɛngmɛ nɔ. A ko ngɔ sika tsu, loo adiagba kɛ hɔɔ a yi mi; nɛ a ko wo tade nɛ he jua wa tsɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: Se mohu a tsu ní tsumi kpakpa nɛ sa yihi nɛ ngɔ a he kɛ ha Mawu kulaa a.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: E sa kaa yo nɛ ba e he si, nɛ e pee kpoo kɛ kase ní.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: I ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa yo nɛ tsɔɔ ní, loo e ye nyumu nɔ; e pee dii.

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: Ejakaa Adam nɛ a bɔ kekle loko a bɔ Hawa.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, pi Adam nɛ a sisi; yo ɔ mohu nɛ a sisi, nɛ e tɔ Mawu mlaa a.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale sane ji kaa ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa hyɛ Mawu asafo nɔ ɔ, e na ní tsumi kpakpa.

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, sé kó hi e he. É hi yo kake; é le e he nɔ hyɛmi; e hɛ mi nɛ ka si, nɛ bu nɛ hi e he. É le nubwɔ peemi, nɛ e nyɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ ní hulɔ.

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: E ko pee e he dã delɔ; nɛ e ko pee nɔ nɛ hɛ mi jɔɛ, loo nɔ nɛ suɔ pɛ. E ko pee e he sika suɔlɔ.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: E pee nɔ ko nɛ le lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ hyɛmi saminya, nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ nɛ e bimɛ maa ba a he si, nɛ a bu nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e hyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ hyɛ Mawu asafo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: E ko pee nɔ ko nɛ tsake e tsui kɛ we. Ke pi ja a, e ma wo e he nɔ, nɛ Mawu maa gbla e tue kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Abosiami ɔ.

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ ɔ he ɔ, á hɛɛ mi bɔ nɛ a he nile be mɛ fɔ bue.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: A ka mɛ hu nɛ a hyɛ a subai kekle, nɛ ke sane ko be a he ɔ, a sɔmɔ.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Sɔmɔli yi ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu a pee nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ a ko ye sieku. A pee nihi nɛ a hɛ ka si, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Asafo mi sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, é hi yo kake pɛ, nɛ e nyɛ nɛ e hyɛ e we, kɛ e bimɛ a nɔ saminya.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Sɔmɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ tsuɔ ní saminya a, a naa biɛ kpakpa. Nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ a ngɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, a tuɔ he munyu kɛ kã. Laami sane nguaa

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae, se e be kɛe nɛ ma ba o ngɔ.

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: Se ke ye se ya kɛ ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ sa nɛ wɔ Kristo we bi waa ba wa je mi ha. Mawu weku ɔ mi bi ji wɔ, nɛ wɔ ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ we asafo. Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ, asafo ɔ nɔ nɛ a fia ngɔ fɔ, nɛ asafo ɔ nɛ faa he.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ wa jami ɔ he ɔ ji laami sane nguaa; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa je he nɔ́. Kristo ba je nɛ ɔ mi kaa nɔmlɔ adesa; E ye nguɔ ngɛ mumi mi; E je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Mawu bɔfohi. A fiɛ lɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti; A he lɛ ye ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo. A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ nyami mi.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Mawu mumi ɔ deɔ paa ke, nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ni komɛ ma kua Kristo, nɔ nɛ a he ye ɔ, nɛ a ma ya nyɛɛ mumi yayamihi mohu a se; a maa bu lakpa munyuhi, kɛ tsɔɔmi yayamihi tue.

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: A maa pee a he lakpatsɛmɛ, kɛ nɔ sisili nɛ a he nile gbo pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ hi. Wa ko kua ekoeko; mohu ɔ, wa sɔ́le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ waa na Mawu si ngɛ he.

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu munyu ɔ, kɛ si nɛ wa naa Mawu ɔ haa niye ní ɔ he tsɔɔ. Kristo Yesu tsɔlɔ kpakpa

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Mawu munyu ɔ kasemi, kɛ Kristo hemi kɛ yemi nɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛɛ mi kpɛii ɔ ma ha mo mumi mi he wami. Ke o tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ hu a le ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo Yesu tsɔlɔ kpakpa ji mo.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Se yimowi a yakayaka nyaziahi nɛ se nami be he ɔ, koo di se. Bɔɔ Mawu jami he mɔde mohu.

english_verse: As the saying goes, “Exercise is good for your body, but religion helps you in every way. It promises life now and forever.” These words are worthwhile and should not be forgotten.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a pɛtɛ he kulaa, nɛ a he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Wa gboɔ dengme kɛ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ, ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ. Lɛ ji nihi tsuo a yi wami helɔ, titli ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o wo mɛ a he kita.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ gbe o he guɛ kaa niheyo kɛkɛ ji mo. Se mohu bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o munyu tumi, o je mi bami, suɔmi nɛ o ngɛ, o hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ bɔ nɛ o he tsɔ ɔ nɛ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Yaa nɔ nɛ o hi ngmami ɔ kanee ha asafo ɔ; hii munyu ɔ fiɛe, nɛ o hi mɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔe kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma ba.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Mumi mi níhi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo mo kɛ gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ benɛ asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɔ a nine kɛ pue o yi mi ɔ, yaa nɔ nɛ o tsu a he ní daa.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Ngɔɔ o he wami tsuo kɛ tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ be tsuaa be, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a na o mɔde bɔmi.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Timoteo, hyɛ mo nitsɛ o he nɔ saminya; nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ hu hyɛ nɔ bɔ nɛ sa. Ejakaa ke o pee ja a, o ma he mo nitsɛ o yi wami, kɛ nihi nɛ buɔ mo tue ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Ko ka nyumu nɔkɔtɔma hɛ mi; se mohu tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ o tsɛ maa tu munyu. Nihewi hu o kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ mo nitsɛ o nyɛminyumuhi maa hi si.

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: Yi nikɔtɔma amɛ ɔ, o kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si kaa mo nitsɛ o nyɛmɛ, nɛ o kɛ yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ hi si kaa o nyɛmiyihi; se hyɛ nɛ yakayaka fiɛmi kó ba je mi.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Yalɔyihi nɛ be nɔ ko ɔ, moo bu mɛ bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Se ke yalɔyo ko ngɛ bimɛ, loo bibimɛ ɔ, bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ bibimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a le kaa ngɛ Mawu jami blɔ nya tomi nya a, kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ a peeɔ ha a fɔli ji a hyɛ a nɔ. A pee enɛ ɔ kɛ to fɔli ɔmɛ nane mi, ejakaa enɛ ɔ saa Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Yalɔyo nɛ lɛ nɔ kake too e ngɛ, nɛ e be nɔ ko nɛ maa hyɛ e nɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Mawu nɔ. E sɔlee nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ kpaa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ e ye bua lɛ.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Se yalɔyo nɛ fiɛɔ e yi nɔ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ lɛɛ, se e gbo momo.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Tsɔɔ yalɔyi ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó tu a he munyu yaya.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ hyɛ we e nyɛmimɛ a nɔ, titli ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e we mi bimɛ ɔ, blɔɔ e ngmɛɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he. Afani nɔ nɛ he we Kristo yi ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: A ko ngma yalɔyo ko biɛ, lɛɛ ja nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi ekpa, nɛ e gba si kake pɛ.

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: É pee yo nɛ he biɛ kaa e peeɔ kpakpa, yo nɛ nyɛ tsɔse bimɛ saminya, yo nɛ nyɛ hyɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to lɛ, yo nɛ sɔmɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ he si bami, yo nɛ je nihi kɛ je haomi mi, nɛ ngɔ e be tsuo kɛ tsu ní kpakpahi.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Se yalɔyi nɛ wɛ ɔ, koo ngma a biɛ, ejakaa ke gba ngɛ mɛ jloe ɔ, a maa ngmɛɛ Kristo he ma ya gba.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se hu a puɛɔ be kɛ hii nihi a we mi kpae. Nɔ́ nɛ pe enɛ ɔ po ji kaa a yeɔ sieku; a jeɔ si, nɛ a ngɔɔ a nya kɛ woɔ nihi a munyu mi; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ sɛ́ kaa a deɔ hu, a maa hi dee putɛputɛɛ.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma suɔ mohu kaa yalɔyihi nɛ wɛ lolo ɔ, a gba nɛ a fɔ bimɛ; nɛ a hyɛ a we nɔ saminya, konɛ wa he nyɛli ko na he blɔ ko kulaa kɛ tu munyu yaya kɛ si wɔ.

english_verse: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
translation_verse: I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa yalɔyi komɛ kpale ya nyɛɛ Satan se momo.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Se ke yo Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ko ngɛ yalɔyihi nɛ peeɔ e weku li ɔ, e hyɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ko ngɔ tlomi ngɔ fɔ asafo ɔ nɔ. Yalɔyihi nɛ be nɔ ko nɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ ɔ, asafo ɔ nɛ bɔ a he mɔde.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Asafo nikɔtɔmahi nɛ tsuɔ ní saminya, titli ni nɛmɛ nɛ fiɛɔ, nɛ a tsɔɔ ní hulɔ ɔ, a hyɛ nɛ a wo a hɛ mi nyami totoe enyɔ.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Na nɛ ngɛ blɛfo gblɛe ha mo ɔ, koo fi e nya.” Ngmami kpa hu deɔ ke, “Ní tsulɔ ɔ, e hiɔwo sa lɛ.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ba po asafo nɔkɔtɔma ko nya ha mo ɔ, koo nu, ja nihi enyɔ, loo etɛ ba ye odase kɛ si lɛ.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, ka a hɛ mi ngɛ asafo ɔ tsuo hɛ mi, kɛkɛ ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ maa ye gbeye.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Koo ye esɔ kaa o maa ngɔ o nine kɛ pue nɔ ko nɔ kɛ wo lɛ asafo nɔkɔtɔma nɛ e tsu ní ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Ke nɔ ko ngɛ yayami pee ɔ, ko ya piɛ e he. Pee o he klɔuklɔu.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ o muklii mi haoɔ mo, nɛ o pɔɔ hiɔ numi kpitikpiti he je ɔ, koo nu nyu sɔuu hu, se mohu nuu wai bɔɔ.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ a yayami jeɔ kpo paa, nɛ a kɛ buu mɛ fɔ nɔuu, se ni komɛ lɛɛ pee se loko a nɔ́ jeɔ kpo.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃ nɔ́ kpakpa hu jeɔ kpo paa nɛ a naa; nɛ níhi nɛ ji kpo paa hu, a nyɛ we nɛ a laa nɔ.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Sɔmɔli tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ, ha nɛ a bu a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ saminya, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ná he blɔ nɛ e tu munyu yaya kɛ si Mawu, loo Kristo jami ɔ.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Nyɔguɛhi nɛ le Kristo, nɛ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu le Kristo ɔ, a ko susu kaa akɛnɛ mɛ tsuo Kristo we bi ji mɛ he je ɔ, e hia we kaa a buɔ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tue. Mɛ mohu nɛ e sa kaa a bu a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ saminya; ejakaa a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ naa a he se ɔ, mɛ hu wa nyɛmimɛ Kristo we bi ji mɛ. Lakpa tsɔɔmi kɛ sika suɔmi Tsɔɔ mɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a tsu he ní bɔ nɛ sa.

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ni komɛ ngɛ tsɔɔmi kpa komɛ tsɔɔe nɛ pi wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sane kpakpa a nitsɛ, loo Mawu jami tsɔɔmi tutuutu.

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a he nɔ kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɛ woe; a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ. A suɔ nɛ a wo pɛ, nɛ a sã nya babauu ngɛ níhi a he. Enɛ ɔ haa nɛ a hɛ kɔɔ a sibi a nɔ; a nɔɔ kunɔ, nɛ a jɛɔ a he basabasa; yayami sɔuu a susuu ngɛ a sibi a he;

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: nɛ a sãã nya be tsuaa be. A juɛmi be tutuutu, nɛ a li nɔ nɛ ji anɔkuale hu. E peeɔ mɛ kaa Mawu jami ji blɔ ko nɛ a guu nɔ kɛ naa ní kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Se niinɛ, ní nami agbo ji Mawu jami, ke nɔ ko bua jɔ e níhi a he ɔ.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Ejakaa waa kɛ nɔ́ ko bɛ je nɛ ɔ mi; nɛ e fɔɔ si paa kaa wa be nyɛe waa kɛ nɔ́ ko maa ya hulɔ.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa ngɛ nya mi ngma, kɛ heha ní kɛkɛ ɔ, e hiɛ ha wɔ hluu.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a na ní ɔ, a sɛɛ ka mi. A ya dii kuasia níhi, kɛ akɔnɔ yayami se. Enɛ ɔ haa nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi taa, nɛ a hɛ mi kpataa.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Ejakaa sika suɔmi ji yayamihi tsuo a sipoku. Ni komɛ kɛ hɛdɔ ya di sika se, nɛ a ngmɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he. Nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba kɛkɛ ji tsui yemi babauu. Paulo wo Timoteo ga

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ji mo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he mɔde: dami sane yemi, Mawu suɔmi nya ní peemi, hemi kɛ yemi, suɔmi, tsui si tomi, kɛ he si bami.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Hwuu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he ta kpakpa a, konɛ o nine nɛ su neneene wami ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu tsɛ mo nɛ o ba ye Kristo he odase wawɛɛ ngɛ nihi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Mawu pɛ ji je ɔ tsuo nɔ yelɔ nɛ pe kulaa. Lɛ ji matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, kɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ tsuo a nyɔmtsɛ. E ma je Kristo kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e be nɛ e to nɛ sa a mi.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa nɛ e be gboe gblegbleegble; nɛ la nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su he ɔ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. Nɔmlɔ adesa ko adesa ko nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ, nɛ adesa ko be nyɛe maa na lɛ hulɔ. A je e yi daa; e maa ye tsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene! Amen.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, nyɛɛ a nɔ nɛ a ko wo a he nɔ. Á ko ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ní nɛ a na a nɔ, ejakaa ní nami se maa po. Á ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu mohu nɔ. Lɛ nɛ e haa wɔ ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ wa yeɔ faa.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Ke a pee ja a, a maa to juetli kpakpa si ha a he kɛ ha hwɔɔ se; nɛ a nine maa su wami nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Timoteo, níhi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ mi ɔ, baa yi saminya. Yakayaka ní sɛɛmi nɛ tsɔɔ we Mawu gbeye yemi, kɛ nya sami tslalaa nɛ juɛmi be mi ɔ, yu o he ngɛ he. Kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ lɛ ni komɛ buu ke nile.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ni komɛ susu kaa a nine su nɔ ɔ ha nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ bɔ mɛ. Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si!

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nɛ i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ngɛ wami nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi nɛ a wo he si ɔ he ɔ,

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Timoteo, ye bi nɛ i suɔ mo saminya. Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha mo! Paulo na Mawu si, nɛ e wo Timoteo he wami

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Mawu ɔ nɛ i ngɛ sɔmɔe kɛ ye tsui tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, i naa lɛ si. Daa nyɔ kɛ pia ke i ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, i kaiɔ mo.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: Ke i kai o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ, i hlaa wawɛɛ kaa ma na mo, konɛ ye bua nɛ jɔ.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: I kaiɔ o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o hɛɛ mi anɔkuale mi kaa bɔ nɛ o nã Loise, kɛ o nyɛ Eunike hu hɛɛ mi ɔ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa o hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ngɛ mo kaie kaa Mawu nike ní nɛ e kɛ dloo mo benɛ i ngɔ ye nine kɛ pue o nɔ ɔ, o tsu he ní saminya.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko ha nɛ odase nɛ o maa ye ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ nɛ pee mo zo. Imi hu nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ Kristo he ɔ, ye he ko pee mo zo. Mohu ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o na nɔ́ ngɛ sane kpakpa a he kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nae ɔ, nɛ Mawu ma ha mo he wami nɛ o kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Mawu he wa yi wami, nɛ e tsɛ wɔ, konɛ wa ba pee e nihi. Pi nɔ́ kpakpa ko nɛ wa pee he je, se mohu lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi nya nɛ e dloo wɔ. Wa ná kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ blema lokoo loko a bɔ je ɔ.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ, e jé e dloomi ɔ kpo paa ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ kɛ gu wa yi wami helɔ Kristo Yesu bami nɔ. Kristo Yesu gu sane kpakpa a nɔ nɛ e ha gbenɔ se po; nɛ e ngɔ wami ba ha wɔ, konɛ wa ko gbo gblegbleegble.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Mawu pee mi bɔfo kɛ tsɔɔlɔ, konɛ ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a,

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae nɛ ɔ nɛ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, ye nine mi wui nyu; ejakaa nɔ nɛ i he ye ɔ, i le lɛ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa sane kpakpa a fiɛmi ɔ nɛ e tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, e maa bu he kɛ yaa su nyagbe ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ɔ, pɛtɛ he kaa nɔhyɛ nɔ́, nɛ hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ suɔmi nɛ wa na kɛ gu Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, koo ngmɛɛ he.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ ngɛ wa mi ɔ, é wo mo he wami, konɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ mi ɔ, o bu he.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ o le ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Asia a tsuo kpa ngɛ ye se; a ti ni komɛ ji Figelo kɛ Hermogene.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ na Onesiforo kɛ e we ɔ mɔbɔ; ejakaa ke e ngɛ mi hluu ɔ, e ba woɔ mi bua. Tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ pee we lɛ zo.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: Benɛ e ná ba su Roma pɛ nɛ e bɔni mi hlami hluu kɛ ya si e ba na mi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ na lɛ mɔbɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e sɔmɔ mi saminya ngɛ Efeso ɔ, o hɛ ji nɔ.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bi, nɛ Mawu dloo wɔ nɛ wa ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, o he nɛ wa.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ o nu nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ngɛ nihi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ, tsɔɔ nihi nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu, konɛ mɛ hu a tsɔɔ ni kpahi.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Mia o hɛ mi kɛ na nɔ́ kaa Kristo Yesu ta bulɔ kpakpa.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ gboɔ dengme kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, lɛ kekle e yeɔ ngmɔ niba ní ɔ eko.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Susuu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ he, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma ha nɛ o nu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ sisi.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Kai kaa Yesu Kristo, Matsɛ David nina nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ he sane kpakpa a ji nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: Sane nɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae; a wo mi kɔsɔkɔsɔ tete po kaa nɔ́ nɛ awi yelɔ ji mi. Se Mawu munyu ɔ fiɛmi lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe maa tsi nya.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke waa kɛ lɛ gbo ɔ, waa kɛ lɛ maa hi wami mi hulɔ.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Ke wa mia wa hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ nami mi ɔ, waa kɛ lɛ maa ye matsɛ hulɔ. Ke wa kua lɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e ma kua wɔ.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Ke wa yi anɔkuale ɔ, lɛɛ anɔkuale pɛ e yeɔ daa, ejakaa e be nyɛe maa ye lakpa kɛ si lɛ nitsɛ e he.” Ní tsulɔ kpakpa

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Kaii mɛ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ. Bɔɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ke a ko pɛ ngɛ munyuhi a he, ejakaa nɔ́ kpakpa ko ji mi kɛ bɛ, se mohu jamɛ a munyu ɔmɛ gbeɔ e nuli ɔmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔde wawɛɛ kaa ní tsulɔ kpakpa, konɛ Mawu nɛ ná o he bua jɔmi. E ko pee mo zo kulaa kaa o maa tsɔɔ anɔkuale munyu ɔ saminya.

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: A tla blɔ kɛ je anɔkuale ɔ he, nɛ a ngɛ dee ke be ɔ nɛ gbogboehi maa te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ be momo. A ngɔ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ Kristo we bi babauu a hemi kɛ yemi hɛ mi kpatae.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Se tsu sisi tomi tɛ nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ ma si ha hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he wa, nɛ e be mimiɛe. Munyu nɛ a kɛ sɔu tɛ ɔ nya ji, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le lɛ nitsɛ e nihi.” Ekpa hu deɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ deɔ ke Mawu nɔ́ ji lɛ ɔ, é kpa yayami peemi.”

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Pi sika tsu níhi, kɛ sika hiɔ níhi kɛkɛ nɛ a naa ngɛ we ngua mi, se mohu nyu yɛmi níhi nɛ a gbɔ, kɛ ekomɛ hu nɛ a puɛ hii mi. A kɛ ekomɛ tsuɔ ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ nɛ a buu, nɛ ekpa komɛ lɛɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní be saisaa.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko tsu e he, nɛ e kpa yayami peemi ɔ, a maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ be titli ko nɛ a buu mi, ejakaa e tsu e he saminya, nɛ e plɛ pee nyu yɛmi nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma nyɛ maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ tsu ní tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ní tsumi kpakpa be tsuaa be.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, e sɛ́ kaa e pɛɔ, mohu ɔ, e mi nɛ jɔ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ; e pee ní tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa nɛ toɔ e tsui si.

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, e sa kaa e pee nɔ nɛ kɛ mi mi jɔmi tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi nɛ tee si kɛ siɔ lɛ ɔ. Alini Mawu maa na jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ nɛ a tsake a tsui, konɛ a ba le anɔkuale ɔ.

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa hɛli a he si, nɛ klama nɛ Abosiami tsɔ ha mɛ kaa a pee e suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a ya nɔ mi ɔ, a ya be mi nɔe.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: O hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, je mi maa wa.

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: Nihi ma hla kaa a ma fo mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a nɔ mi; a maa pee a he sika suɔli, fĩali, he woli, kɛ lilɛtsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ bui a fɔli, nihi nɛ li sina, kɛ nihi nɛ Mawu jami pi a he sane ko.

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: Nihi maa pee a ní kaa nɔ́ nɛ pi adesahi kulaa ji mɛ, nihi nɛ mɔbɔ nami ko be a mi, nihi a biɛ puɛli, nihi nɛ peeɔ basabasa nɛ a li zo, awi yeli, kɛ nihi nɛ sume nɔ́ kpakpa.

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: Nimli maa pee a he nɔ se blɔ tsɔɔli, nihi nɛ bui nɔ́, he nɔ woli, kɛ nihi nɛ suɔ je mi akɔnɔ pe bɔ nɛ a suɔ Mawu,

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: nihi nɛ tsɛɔ a he Mawu jali, se anɔkuale mi ɔ, a bui e mi he wami ɔ kulaa. Nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, yu o he kɛ je a he.

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ yaa nihi a we mi, nɛ a ya puɛɔ yihi juɛmi flɛflɛtsɛmɛ a yi mi. Yi nɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami plɛ tlomi ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ ngɛ akɔnɔ ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ mɛ gblae ɔ a he.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: Daa nɛ ɔ, yi nɛ ɔmɛ bɔɔ mɔde kaa a maa kase ní, se anɔkuale ɔ lɛɛ a be lee gblegbleegble.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Se a be he ko sue, ejakaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ nihi maa na kaa kuasia kɛkɛ a ngɛ jee. Nɔ́ nɛ ba Yane kɛ Yambre a nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu maa ba mɛ hu a nɔ. Nyagbe slɔmi

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: Se Timoteo, moo lɛɛ, ní nɛ i tsɔɔ, bɔ nɛ i baa ye je mi, oti nɛ i kɛ fɔ ye hɛ mi ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i heɔ yeɔ ɔ, o le. O le bɔ nɛ i toɔ ye tsui si, bɔ nɛ i suɔ nɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ ye hɛ mi ka si.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e pee e he Mawu jalɔ nɛ le Kristo Yesu ɔ, a maa wa lɛ yi mi.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Nimli yayamihi, kɛ nɔ sisili maa ya nɔ maa pee yayami kɛ be nɔ; a maa sisi nihi hluu kɛ yaa si a maa sisi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ mo nɛ o he ye ɔ, yaa nɔ nɛ o pɛtɛ he. Nihi nɛ tsɔɔ mo ní ɔ, o le mɛ.

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: O kai kaa kɛ je o jokuɛ mi tɔɔ o le ngmami klɔuklɔu ɔ. Ngmami klɔuklɔu ɔ ma ha nɛ o maa le ní, nɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ o heɔ yeɔ ɔ ma he o yi wami.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Ngmami tsuaa ngmami ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ lɛ ha nɛ nihi ngma; nɛ e hi kɛ ha ní tsɔɔmi, kɛ ha hɛ mi kami, kɛ ha nɔ dlami, kɛ tsɔsemi nɛ ma ha nɔ nɛ ba e je mi saminya.

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu tsɔlɔ ɔ maa hi kɛ pi si, nɛ e he maa su kɛ tsu nɔ́ kpakpa.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: I ngɛ Mawu, kɛ Kristo Yesu odase tsɛe kɛ ngɛ mo ga woe. Kristo ma ba ye matsɛ; e ma ba kojo nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yaa nɔ nɛ o fiɛ sɛ gbi ɔ be tsuaa be nɛ o ko kpa. Ke o ngɛ munyu ɔ fiɛe ɔ, ná tsui kɛ tsɔɔ tue buli ɔmɛ nɔ́ nya konɛ a na nya saminya. Ka ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ o wo mɛ ga ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Be ma nɛ nihi be suɔe kaa a maa bu tsɔɔmi kpakpa tue. Mohu ɔ, a ma hla ní tsɔɔli ha a he; a ma hla nihi nɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ níhi nɛ maa ngɔ ngɛ a tue mi.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: A be suɔe kulaa kaa a maa nu anɔkuale ɔ; a ma hla kaa a maa bu nyazia mohu tue.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Se moo lɛɛ, o hɛ nɛ ka si be tsuaa be. Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, to o tsui si. Bɔɔ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi he mɔde wawɛɛ, konɛ o pee Mawu sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Imi lɛɛ a miɔ nɛ a ngɔ mi kɛ sã bɔ. Ee, be ɔ nɛ ma je je ɔ mi ɔ su.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: Ta kpakpa a, i hwu; i tu fo ɔ tsuo gbe nya. I pɛtɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu ngɔ ye hiɔwo nɛ ji jlasi nɛ e kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a ngɔ to ha mi. Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ maa ngɔ ye jlasi ɔ ngɔ ha mi. Pi imi nɔ kake pɛ nɛ e ma ha, se mohu e ma ha nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ lɛ, nɛ a ngɛ e bami ɔ blɔ hyɛe ɔ. Paulo nitsɛ he sane

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba ye ngɔ ngɛ be kpiti mi;

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: ejakaa Dema lɛɛ e ya suɔ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ je nɛ ɔ, nɛ e je ye he kɛ ho Tesalonika ya. Kreske ho Galatia ya, nɛ Tito hu ho Dalmatia ya.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luka pɛ lɛ ngɛ ye ngɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Hla Marko nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba, ejakaa e he hia saminya ngɛ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi ɔ he.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: Tihiko lɛɛ i tsɔ lɛ Efeso.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: I si ye tade klɔii ɔ kɛ ha Karpo ngɛ Troya; ke o ma a, ngɔɔ kɛ ba. Ngɔɔ womi ɔmɛ hu kɛ ba, titli ɔ, ní nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɔ lohwe he womi kɛ pee ɔ.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Aleksandro, sɔlɔ ɔ ye mi sane yaya ko; nɔ́ yeyee nɛ e pee mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ wo lɛ hiɔ.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Moo hyɛ o he ngɛ e he, ejakaa e te si wawɛɛ ngɔ si munyu ɔ nɛ wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Kekleekle nɛ i ya fa ye he ngɛ kojomi he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ mi yɛ. Mɛ tsuo a si mi; Mawu kó gbla a tue ngɛ enɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ ye he, nɛ e wo mi he wami, nɛ i nyɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a kɛ ha ma je li ɔmɛ tsuo. Bɔ nɛ Mawu je mi kɛ je gbenɔ nya mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ee, e je mi kɛ je gbenɔ mi.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma je mi kɛ maa je ní yayamihi tsuo a mi, nɛ e kɛ mi maa ya hiɔwe he nɛ e ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ ɔ fiafiaafia. A maa wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ maa ya neneene. Amen. Nyagbe sɛ yemi

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: I biɔ Priskila, Akuila, kɛ Onesiforo kɛ e we ɔ tsuo saminya.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Erasto tlɔ Korinto, se Trofimo lɛɛ i si lɛ ngɛ Mileto, ejakaa e be he wami.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba loko fĩɛ be ɔ nɛ su. Eubulo, Pude, Lino, kɛ Klaudia ke a biɔ mo. Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ke mɛ hu a biɔ mo.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ gbaa mo. Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Imi Paulo, Mawu tsɔlɔ, kɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ lɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ. Mawu hla mi, nɛ e tsɔ mi, konɛ ma ya wo nihi nɛ Mawu hla mɛ ɔ a hemi kɛ yemi mi he wami, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu jami mi.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: I ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae ha mo Tito, ye bi nitsɛnitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ nɛ i kɛ mo tsuo wa hɛɛ mi ɔ mi. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Kristo Yesu dɛ mi ɔ ha mo! Tito ní tsumi ngɛ Kreta

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: I si mo ngɛ Kreta, konɛ níhi nɛ piɛ ɔ, o to blɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ o wo asafo nya dali ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi. Mo kai níhi nɛ i de mo ɔ.

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, e pee nɔ ko nɛ piami be e he, nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo kake pɛ, nɛ e bimɛ le Kristo. Bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nihi nɛ a yeɔ a he odase kpakpa; pi yaholi, loo nihi nɛ tsɔɔ atuã.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, akɛnɛ Mawu ní tsumi nɔ e ngɛ hyɛe he je ɔ, e sɛ kaa piami ko hii e he. E ko pee nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ, loo nɔ nɛ tsui fiaa mlamlaamla, loo dã tɔlɔ, loo kunɔ nɔlɔ, loo nɔ ko nɛ dii sika se tsɔ.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, e pee nɔ nɛ peeɔ nibwɔ, nɛ e suɔ nɔ́ nɛ hi, nɔ nɛ juɛmi ka si, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; nɔ nɛ ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu kulaa, nɛ e yeɔ e he nɔ.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nihi babauu tsɔ atuã, nɛ a ngɛ yakayaka munyu tue kɛ ngɛ nihi sisie. Nihi nɛ deɔ ke ja a po nɔ ɔ, mɛ titli lɛ a ngɛ ní nɛ ɔ tsue.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Kreta fɔfɔɛ, nɛ ji mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbalɔ ko lɛ de ke, “Daa nɛ ɔ, Kreta bi ngɛ lakpa yee; a ngɛ kaa lohwe awi yeli pɛ! Daa nɛ ɔ, hejɔ peemi, kɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ pɛ ji a ní tsumi.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ka a hɛ mi wawɛɛ, konɛ a hɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ya be Yuda bi a nyaziahi tue bue, nɛ mlaahi nɛ nihi nɛ kua anɔkuale ɔ wo mɛ ɔ hu a be nɔ yee.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he tsɔ ha mɛ. Se nihi nɛ ble a he, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he tsɔ we ha mɛ; ejakaa a ble a juɛmi, kɛ a he nile tsuo.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: A deɔ ke a le Mawu, se a ní peepee tsɔɔ we jã. Yakayaka nimli, kɛ atuã tsɔli ji mɛ; a tsu we nɔ́ kpakpa ko gblee.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Yi nikɔtɔma amɛ hu o kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu jã nɔuu, konɛ a ba a je mi saminya kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye. A ko pee a he sieku yeli, nɛ a ko ngɔ dã numi ngɔ pee a ní tsumi. Mohu ɔ, a tsɔɔ nɔ́ kpakpa,

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: konɛ a tsɔse yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ a suɔ a hunomɛ, kɛ a bimɛ.

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: A tsɔse mɛ, nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a ye a he nɔ saminya, nɛ a he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ a pee a he yigbayi kpakpahi nɛ le a we yi baami, nihi nɛ a mi mi jɔ, nɛ baa a he si ha a hunomɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be Mawu munyu ɔ he munyu yaya tue.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ba a he si ha a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a sa a hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi. A ko je munyu nya,

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: nɛ a ko ju mɛ hulɔ. Se mohu á ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, konɛ anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi nɛ a na nya saminya.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu je e dloomi ɔ nɛ e kɛ ma he adesahi tsuo a yi wami ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ.

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: Dloomi nɛ ɔ bɔɔ wɔ kɔkɔ kaa wa kpa yayami peemi, nɛ wa ko di je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ níhi a se. E tsɔɔ wɔ kaa waa hyɛ wa he nɔ saminya; waa pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ waa ye Mawu gbeye,

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
