translation_verse: be mi nɛ wa ngɛ gbaami nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ fɔ nɔ ɔ blɔ hyɛe ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, wa Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa je kpo.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he. E kpɔ wɔ kɛ je yi wu tso níhi a peemi mi, nɛ e ngɔ wɔ ngɔ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma klɔuklɔu, nihi nɛ a hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi he.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Mo kai o we bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a ba a he si ngɔ ha ma nɔ yeli, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya. Á bu mɛ, nɛ a pee klaalo kaa a ma tsu ní tsumi kpakpa be tsuaa be.

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: A ko tu nihi a he munyu yaya, nɛ a ko pɛ; se mohu a he nɛ jɔ, nɛ a tsɔ a hɛ mi ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Ejakaa sa a, wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu wa je kuasia; wa gbo tue, nɛ wa tla blɔ. Wa ya di akɔnɔ yaya, kɛ he lo mi níhi nɛ haa wɔ bua jɔmi a se. Wa susuu nihi a he yayami, nɛ wa hɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃; nɔ́ peeɔ wɔ tai, nɛ wa nyɛɛ wa sibi.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ je e mi mi himi, kɛ e suɔmi ɔ kpo ɔ,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: e he wa yi wami. Pi nɔ́ nɛ da nɛ wa pee he nɛ e he wa yi wami ngɛ; mɔbɔ kɛkɛ lɛ e na wɔ kɛ gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ du wa he, nɛ wa pee kaa nihi nɛ a fɔ mɛ ehe, nɛ́ a na wami he.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: Kɛ gu wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu plɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ pue wa nɔ babauu.

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ wɔ nɛ a wo wɔ nguɔ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nɔ ɔ, neneene wami ɔ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, wa nine nɛ su nɔ.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale munyu sisiisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. I suɔ kaa o di ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se wawɛɛ, konɛ nihi nɛ ba he Mawu ye ɔ nɛ a ngɔ a be kɛ tsu ní kpakpahi. Enɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ hi, nɛ a he ngɛ se nami ha nihi tsuo.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Se nya sami yaka gu, weku kpa se jami, pɛ, kɛ mlaa a he nɔ́ jemi ɔ lɛɛ je o he kɛ je mi. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he be se nami, nɛ a he hia we hulɔ.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Na nɛ o le kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji yayami peelɔ nɛ je e glɛ nɔ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he yayami ɔ buu lɛ fɔ. Nyagbe sɛ yemi

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Ke i tsɔ Artema, loo Tihiko kɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba ye ngɔ ngɛ Nikopoli, ejakaa i to kaa ma ya ye fĩɛ be ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Moo bɔ mɔde nɛ o wo Zena, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ Apolo blɔ saminya; hyɛ nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa hia mɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a nine nɛ su nɔ.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ. De wa suɔli ɔmɛ nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ ke wa biɔ mɛ. Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si!

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Imi Paulo nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ Kristo Yesu he ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya ha Filemon, wa suɔlɔ, kɛ wa huɛ nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ,

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: kɛ asafo ɔ nɛ kpee ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmiyo Apia, kɛ wa huɛ ta bulɔ Arkipo.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ! Filemon suɔmi kɛ e hemi kɛ yemi

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmi Filemon, be tsuaa be nɛ ma sɔle ɔ, i woɔ o ta, nɛ i naa Mawu si.

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa suɔmi nɛ o jeɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o ngɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ, i nu he.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: Ye sɔlemi ji kaa hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ waa kɛ mo wa hɛɛ mi ɔ ma ha waa nu ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ wa naa ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ a sisi saminya.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmi, o suɔmi ɔ wo mi he wami, nɛ e ha mi bua jɔmi babauu. O ha nɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ a tsui nɔ a mi. Paulo kpa pɛɛ ha Filemon

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: I ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae ngɛ Onesimo nɛ peeɔ ye bi ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ he. Tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ ha i ba pee e tsɛ.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: Jinɛ sa a, e he be se nami kɛ ha mo, se jehanɛ lɛɛ e he ba se nami kɛ ha imi kɛ mo tsuo.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: I ko suɔ kaa e kɛ mi nɛ hi si, konɛ e sɔmɔ mi ngɛ o nane mi, be mi nɛ sane kpakpa a he ɔ, a wo mi tsu ɔ.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Se i sume kaa ma je o se kɛ pee nɔ́ ko, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ o ko je o tsui mi faa pee ɔ, e ko ba pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a nyɛ o nɔ.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Eko ɔ, o kɛ Onesimo nyɛ kpɛti gbɛ be bɔɔ kɛkɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ e ba hi si ngɛ o ngɔ daa.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, e pi nɔ ko nɛ a maa bu lɛ nyɔguɛ hu, se mohu nɔ nɛ pe nyɔguɛ. O nyɛmi saminya ji lɛ ngɛ Kristo mi nɛ imi po i fiɛ we e he, hluu nɛ mo nɛ he lo mi jio, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi jio, o nɔ ji lɛ kulaa a.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ke o buu mi o huɛ tutuutu nɛ o kɛ lɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, he Onesimo atuu kaa bɔ nɛ o ma he mi.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Ke ji e ye mo sane yaya ko, aloo e hɛɛ mo hiɔ ko ɔ, buu jamɛ a akɔtaa tsuo ha mi.

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafra, nɛ lɛ hu Kristo Yesu he ɔ, a wo i kɛ lɛ tsu ɔ ke e biɔ mo.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: Marko, Aristarko, Dɛma, kɛ Luka, ye huɛmɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, mɛ hu a ke a biɔ mo.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Blema a, Mawu kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu munyu si abɔ kɛ gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ blɔ slɔɔtohi babauu a nɔ;

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: se mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ lɛɛ e Bi ɔ nɔ e gu nɛ e kɛ wɔ tu munyu. Lɛ nɔuu e nɔ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi ní tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ Mawu hla kaa e ye e ní tsuo.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ, jã nɔuu Bi ɔ hu hɛ mi ngɛ nyami. Bi ɔ ngɛ kaa Mawu pɛpɛɛpɛ. E kɛ e munyu ɔ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hɛɛ je ɔ tsuo. Benɛ e ngɔ je ɔ he yayami tsuo kɛ ho ɔ, e ya hi si ngɛ hiɔwe ngɛ matsɛ ngua a hiɔ nɔ. Mawu Bi ɔ ji ngua

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Mawu ha nɛ e Bi ɔ pe hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ biɛ nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ hu he jua wa pe a nɔ́ ɔ.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu de we e bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti eko hyɛ gblee ke, “Ye Bi ji mo; mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fɔ mo.” Nɛ Mawu tu we hiɔwe bɔfo ko he munyu hyɛ ke, “Ma pee e Tsɛ, nɛ e maa pee ye Bi.”

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Se benɛ Mawu miɔ nɛ e maa tsɔ e bitɛte ɔ je ɔ mi ɔ, e de ekohu ke, “Ha nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ja lɛ.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de ngɛ a he ji, “Mawu haa e bɔfo ɔmɛ peeɔ kaa kɔɔhiɔ, nɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ peeɔ kaa la lilɛhi.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Bi ɔ lɛɛ Mawu de ngɛ e he ke, “Mawu ji mo; o maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene! Nɛ dami sane yemi maa pee o matsɛ tso.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: O suɔ dami sane yemi; se mlaa nɔ tɔmi lɛɛ o nyɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je Mawu nɛ ji o Mawu ɔ pɔ mo nu, nɛ o na bua jɔmi kulaa pe o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Mawu de hulɔ ke, “Mo Nyɔmtsɛ, blema lokoo ɔ, mo lɛ o bɔ je ɔ; mo nitsɛ lɛ o bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: A hɛ mi ma kpata, se moo lɛɛ o maa hi si daa.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: O maa ku a mi kaa a kuɔ tade mi; nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpa kaa bo kpaa. Se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ kɛ̃; o be gboe gblegbleegble.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Mawu de we Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko hyɛ ke, “Hii ye hiɔ nɔ kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ o nane maa nɔ.”

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa waa pɛtɛ níhi nɛ wa nu ɔ a he saminya, konɛ wa ko gba kɛ je he.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba a ngɛ mi sisiisi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbo tue, loo e bui ɔ, a gbla e tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ.

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: Ke wɔɔ lɛɛ wa bui yi wami hemi kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛ ye wa he kɛɛ? Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ tu yi wami hemi nɛ ɔ he munyu kekle; nɛ nihi nɛ nu ɔ, mɛ hu a ma nɔ mi ha wɔ.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Mawu nitsɛ pee okadi kɛ nyakpɛ ní slɔɔtohi babauu kɛ ye yi wami hemi nɛ ɔ he odase. Jehanɛ hu, e dla Mumi Klɔuklɔu nike ní ɔmɛ ngɔ ha kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔ kɛ ma nɔ mi. Nɔ nɛ haa nɛ wa yi naa wami

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Je nɛ maa ba nɛ wa ngɛ he munyu tue ɔ, Mawu ha we Mawu bɔfohi he blɔ nɛ a ye tsɛ ngɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Odase nɛ nɔ ko ye ngɛ ngmami ɔ he ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ adesa, nɛ o susuɔ e he? Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ bi, nɛ o hyɛɛ e nɔ?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Nɛ o bɔ lɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ o ha bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ pe lɛ. O wo e hɛ mi nyami, nɛ o ha bu ba e he.

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: O pee lɛ níhi tsuo a nɔ yelɔ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, ke kaa Mawu pee adesa níhi tsuo a nɔ yelɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ ko be nɛ adesa be he wami ngɛ nɔ. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa nɛ́ kaa adesa ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ níhi tsuo a nɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Se Yesu lɛɛ wa na kaa gbenɔ mi amanehlu ɔ nɛ e na a ha nɛ a kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu fi lɛ jlasi. Nɛ Mawu bɔ lɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ e ha bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ pe lɛ. Mawu pee lɛ jã, konɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ dloomi ɔ nya a, Yesu nɛ ba gbo kɛ ha nihi tsuo.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Nɛ e sa hu kaa Mawu nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ́ lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ha nɛ ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ ɔ, e ha a yi wami hemi sisi jelɔ ɔ nɛ ba na amanehlu, nɛ e kɛ dla lɛ kɛ pi si, konɛ e wo bimɛ babauu a hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ nihi a he, kɛ ni nɛmɛ e tsu a he ɔ tsuo a tsɛ kake. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e pee we Yesu zo kaa e ma tsɛ mɛ nyɛmimɛ.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: E deɔ Mawu ke, “Ma wo o biɛ ta ha ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ i kɛ asafo ɔ ma la kɛ je o yi.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: E deɔ hu ke, “Ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ.” E kpale deɔ hu ke, “Ne mi kɛ bimɛ nɛ Mawu ha mi ɔ.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ he lo kɛ muɔ ji bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ hu e pee he lo kɛ muɔ. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ kɛ gu e gbenɔ mi ɔ, e kpata Abosiami, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ gbenɔ he wami ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma ha nihi nɛ a wami be tsuo a ngɛ gbenɔ gbeye yee, nɛ a pee yoyooyo kaa nyɔguɛhi ɔ maa ye a he.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa tsa pi Mawu bɔfohi a he nɛ e ba ngɛ, se mohu Abraham nina a he.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ ɔ, e hia kaa Yesu nɛ pee kaa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa anɔkualetsɛ, kɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu sɔmɔe, nɛ e kɛ e he nɛ sã kpatami bɔ, konɛ Mawu nɛ ngɔ a he yayamihi kɛ pa mɛ.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ, nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ ka mi ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa wo mɛ he wami; ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ ɔ, a ka lɛ, nɛ e na amanehlu.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he tsɔ, nɛ Mawu tsɛ waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo, nyɛɛ hyɛ Yesu, hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa jajeɔ ɔ he bɔfo, kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: E ye Mawu nɛ hla lɛ ke e tsu ní nɛ ɔ anɔkuale kaa bɔ nɛ Mose hu ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we ɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ a buɔ nɔ nɛ maa tsu pe tsu ɔ nɛ e maa a, jã kɛ̃ bu ngɛ Yesu hu he hluu pe Mose.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Tsu tsuaa tsu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ fiaa; se Mawu lɛ bɔ níhi tsuo.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Mose ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we ɔ kulaa nɔ kaa sɔmɔlɔ, nɛ e ye odase ngɛ níhi nɛ a ma de hwɔɔ se ɔ a he.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Se Kristo lɛɛ e ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we ɔ kaa Mawu bi. Ke waa kɛ kã kɛ gɛjɛmi hɛɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ mi kpɛii ɔ, wa peeɔ Mawu we bi. Mawu we bi maa jɔɔ a he

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: nyɛ ko wa tue kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ngɛ nga a nɔ benɛ a tsɔ atuã, nɛ a ka Mawu ɔ.

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Lejɛ ɔ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ka mi ngɛ, pohu a na níhi nɛ i tsu jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye mi mi fu jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ, nɛ i de ke, ‘Daa nɛ ɔ, a dɔ a tsui kɛ je ye he, nɛ a li ye blɔ ɔmɛ.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Ye mi mi fu mɛ, nɛ i ka kita ke, ‘Ke a nane ma he nɛ i to nɛ a jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ fii!’ ”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, konɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó hɛɛ juɛmi yaya nɛ be hae nɛ e he ye, nɛ e ko ba tsɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ hɛ mi atuã.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ tu he wami womi munyu daa ligbi nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ ma de ke “mwɔnɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ ɔ, yayami be nyɛ ti nɔ ko sisie nɛ e gbo Mawu tue.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa hɛ nɛ wa kɛ fɔ Kristo nɔ kɛ je sisije ɔ, ke wa hɛɛ mi kpɛii hluu kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, lɛɛ wa peeɔ nihi nɛ a kɛ Kristo pee kake.

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Mɛnɔmɛ lɛ a nu Mawu gbi, nɛ a tsɔ atuã a? Anɛ pi nihi nɛ Mose kɛ mɛ je Egipt ɔ tsuo lo?

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu ka kita ke, “He nɛ i to kaa a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ, ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii” ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ e ngɛ dee? Anɛ pi nihi nɛ gbo tue ɔ lo?

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa naa kaa a nyɛ we nɛ a ya su lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa a he we Mawu yi.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Wɔ nɛ wa he ye ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma ya jɔɔ wa he kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ. Mawu de ke, “Ye mi mi wo la nɛ i ka kita ke, ‘He nɛ i to nɛ a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ, ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii!’ ” Mawu de enɛ ɔ, pohu níhi nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e maa pee ɔ, be nɛ e bɔ je ɔ tɔɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ tsuo nya.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ he ko deɔ ngɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ he ji, “Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, Mawu jɔɔ e he, nɛ e tsu we nɔ́ ko.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ he ko hu ke, “He nɛ i to nɛ a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ, ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii!”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: E fɔɔ si paa kaa ni komɛ kɛ̃ maa sɛ mi, pohu ni nɛmɛ nɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ kekle ɔ na we jamɛ a he jɔɔmi ɔ; ejakaa a he we Mawu yi.

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Ejakaa kaa Yoshua ha mɛ he jɔɔmi ɔ, jinɛ Mawu ko tu we ligbi kpa ko he munyu hu pee se.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa he jɔɔmi be ko ngɛ ha Mawu ma a nɛ a maa ye.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma na he jɔɔmi nɛ Mawu wo he si ɔ, e maa jɔɔ e he kaa Mawu, nɛ e be ní tsue.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa bɔ mɔde, konɛ wa nine nɛ su he jɔɔmi nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko kó gbo tue kaa mɛ, nɛ e ba laa blɔ.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu munyu hɛ ngɛ, e ngɛ he wami, nɛ e nya ba pe klaate nya enyɔtsɛ. E gbuu kɛ sɛɛ nɔ mi kɛ ya siɔ e gbaa klaa, kɛ mumi ɔ mi, kɛ jehanɛ hu kpɔji nya amɛ, kɛ wu mi zɔ ɔmɛ a mi. Mawu munyu ɔ jeɔ adesa tsui mi níhi, kɛ e yi mi tomi kpo.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ laa Mawu. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi fɔɔ si paa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu lɛ nitsɛ e we akɔtaa ngɛ e hɛ mi. Yesu ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kpetekpleenyɛ

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa jajeɔ ɔ mi wawɛɛ. Ejakaa wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ po mi kɛ ho hiɔwe ya tɔɔ. Lɛ ji Yesu, Mawu Bi ɔ.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa kɛ kã nɛ hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu dloomi sɛ ɔ he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ wa na dloomi nɛ maa ye bua wɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nitsɛ ɔ, sé ngɛ e he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e taa bua si ha nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko mi, kɛ nihi nɛ tlaa blɔ ɔ.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ ɔ sé ngɛ e he ɔ, e hia kaa e sã bɔ, pi kɛ ha ma a kɛkɛ, se ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e yayami ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Hɛ mi nyami nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko ngɔɛ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he. Mawu pɛ lɛ hlaa nɔ, nɛ e woɔ lɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ e hla Aaron ɔ.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu kɛ̃, hɛ mi nyami nɛ Kristo ná kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, pi lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e ngɔ kɛ fɔ e nɔ. Mawu lɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye Bi ji mo, mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fɔ mo.”

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Mawu de ngɛ ngmami ɔ he kpa hu ke, “Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, ngmlaa, kɛ hɛ mi vo nyu nɛ e kɛ kpa Mawu, nɔ pɛ nɛ ma nyɛ je lɛ kɛ je gbenɔ mi ɔ pɛɛ. Akɛnɛ e yeɔ Mawu gbeye he je ɔ, Mawu hu bu lɛ tue.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Mawu Bi ji lɛ mohu, se kɛ gu amanehlu nɛ e na a mi ɔ, e kase tue bumi.

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu ha nɛ e hi kɛ pi si ɔ, e ba pee nɔ nɛ haa nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ naa neneene yi wami hemi.

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: Nɛ Mawu wo lɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kaa Melkizedek pɛ. Nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ munyuhi fuu nɛ wa maa tu ngɛ enɛ ɔ he, se e sisi tsɔɔmi wa, nɛ nyɛ nɔ́ sisi numi yee.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Jinɛ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛ pee tsɔɔli, se hyɛ nyɛ mohu nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hia kaa a tsɔɔ nyɛ Mawu munyu ɔ mi sisije ní ɔmɛ ekohu. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɔ nyu lɛ hi ha nyɛ, pi niye ní nitsɛ.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɔ pupɔe ɔ, bimwɔyo ji lɛ kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ e li nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da he.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Se nihi nɛ wa a, a nɔ ji niye ní nitsɛ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a tsɔse a juɛmi, nɛ a le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha wa si sisije níhi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ, nɛ waa ya wa hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ sa nihi nɛ wa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi. Sisije níhi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, e hia we kaa wa pa hi lɔ ɔmɛ tsɔɔe kpamisa. Wa de nyɛ ke je mi bami yaya nɛ he be se nami ɔ, nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ he, konɛ nyɛ he Mawu nyɛɛ ye.

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ kɔɔ nɔ sɔlemi, nine nɛ a kɛ pueɔ nɔ nɔ, gbogboehi a si temi, kɛ nyagbe kojomi he ɔ, e hia we kaa waa hi lɔ ɔmɛ tsɔɔe kpamisa.

english_verse: Let's grow up, if God is willing.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu suɔ ɔ, wa maa ya wa hɛ mi.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Zugba nɛ hiɔmi nɛɔ pueɔ nɔ babaaba, nɛ nyu ɔ sɛɔ zu mi, nɛ ní nɛ a duɔ ɔ baa saminya kɛ ha nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nɔ ɔ Mawu gbaa zugba a lɛ.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Se ke mio, kɛ hu lɛ puɛɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ se nami ko be he kulaa. Mawu maa gbiɛ zugba a, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, a kɛ la maa sã lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Wa huɛmɛ nɛ wa suɔ, ke wa ngɛ munyu tue kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ po, nyɛɛ lɛɛ wa heɔ nyɛ yeɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa pee, nɛ lɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ Mawu ma he nyɛ yi wami.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Mawu yi tue gbogboe sane. Ní nɛ nyɛ tsu, kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ je kpo ha lɛ ɔ, e hɛ be nɔ jee gblegbleegble. Nyɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ sɔmɔ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko pee hejɔ; se mohu nihi nɛ he Mawu ye, nɛ a to a tsui si, nɛ lɔ ɔ he a nine su nɔ́ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kase mɛ. Mawu ma e munyu ɔ nɔ mi

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Benɛ Mawu wo Abraham si ɔ, e ka lɛ kita kɛ ma nɔ mi. Akɛnɛ nɔ ko be nɛ pe lɛ Mawu ɔ he je ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ kɛ ka kita.

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Abraham to e tsui si, nɛ e nine su nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke e ma ha lɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ma ka kita a, e ngɔɔ nɔ ko nɛ pe lɛ biɛ kɛ kaa, nɛ e kɛ maa munyu nɛ e tu ɔ nɔ mi.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nihi nɛ Mawu wo mɛ si ɔ, a yi mi nɛ tɛ mɛ kaa Mawu tsakee we e yi mi tomi ɔ, e ka kita kɛ ma nɔ mi.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: E tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ be tsakee gblegbleegble, nɛ Mawu hu be a he lakpa yee. Kɛkɛ ɔ, kɛ gu a nɔ ɔ, wɔ nihi nɛ wa ba sa we ngɛ Mawu ngɔ ɔ, e maa wo wɔ he wami, konɛ waa pɛtɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ he nɛ wa.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa osɛkɛ nɛ nu wɔ kɛ da si kpɛii, nɛ e kɛ wɔ ya su sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi pomi bo ɔ se tɔɔ.

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Wa he ɔ, Yesu sɛ wa hɛ mi kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya, nɛ e ya pee osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Melkizedek ɔ, Salem matsɛ, kɛ Mawu Ope ɔ we osɔfo ji lɛ. Be ko ɔ, Abraham kɛ matsɛmɛ komɛ ya hwu ta, nɛ e ye a nɔ. Benɛ e kpale kɛ ma a, e kɛ Melkizedek ba kpe, nɛ Melkizedek gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Abraham hu ha lɛ ta yibu ní tsuo nɛ e na a mi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake. Kekleekle ɔ, e biɛ Melkizedek ɔ sisi ji, “Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ dami sane.” Jehanɛ hu, Salem matsɛ ji lɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e biɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e ji, “Matsɛ nɛ e kɛ tue mi jɔmi baa.”

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: A wui Melkizedek tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ta; e weku kpa ko be ɔ, be nɛ a fɔ lɛ, kɛ be nɛ e gbo hu nɔ ko li. E ngɛ kaa Mawu Bi ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ osɔfo yee kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ we agboje! Abraham, wa nɛ̃ nɛ he biɛ ɔ po ha lɛ ta yibu ní ɔ nɛ e na ngɛ ta mi ɔ tsuo mi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Levi nina a, ni nɛmɛ nɛ hɛɛ osɔfo blɔ nya a, mlaa tsɔɔ kaa a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kakaaka ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ, pohu a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛ hu Abraham nina ji mɛ.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Melkizedek ɔ, pi Levi nina ji lɛ, se e he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ ngɛ Abraham, nɔ nɛ lɛɛ Mawu wo lɛ si ɔ dɛ, nɛ e gbaa lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: E fɔɔ si paa kaa nɔ nɛ nɔ kuɔ lɛ gbaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ e sisi.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Hiɛ ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a, nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a gboɔ. Se ngɛ he ko lɛɛ nɔ nɛ a ye e he odase kaa e maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ, lɛ nɛ he.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ wa ma de ke kɛ gu Abraham nɔ ɔ, a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ ngɛ Levi nɛ jinɛ lɛ nɛ heɔ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a hu e dɛ.

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Ejakaa benɛ Abraham kɛ Melkizedek kpe ɔ, Levi ngɛ e nɛ̃ Abraham mi mi kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Kaa Levi, nɛ e yi nɔ a wo mlaa a, e nina nɛ yeɔ osɔfo ɔ tsu ní bɔ nɛ sa a, jinɛ e he be hiae kaa osɔfo kpa ko kaa Melkizedek nɛ pi Aaron nina ji lɛ kulaa a nɛ ba.

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke a tsake osɔfo yemi blɔ nya tomi ɔ, lɛɛ e hia kaa a tsake mlaa a hulɔ.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ a de ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e he ɔ, wɛtso kpa kulaa mi no ji lɛ; nɛ nɔ ko ji jamɛ a wɛtso ɔ mi nɛ e ba sɔmɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he gblee.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, wa le kaa Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi nɛ e je; nɛ Mose de we nɔ́ ko kɛ kɔ Yuda wɛtso ɔ osɔfo yemi he. Osɔfo nɛ ngɛ kaa Melkizedek

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ dee ɔ mi tsɔ paa, ejakaa osɔfo kpa ba nɛ ngɛ kaa Melkizedek.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.”

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mlaa momo ɔ nɛ he wami be mi, nɛ he be se nami hulɔ ɔ, a po mi.

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mose mlaa a nyɛ we nɛ e pee nɔ́ ko nɛ hi kɛ pi si. Se nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ jehanɛ ɔ hi saminya; nɛ wa nyɛɔ wa hɛɛ kɛ suu Mawu he.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Se Yesu lɛɛ, Mawu ka kita nɛ e kɛ wo lɛ osɔfo. Mawu de lɛ ke, “I ngɛ mo kita kae, nɛ i be ye nya se kpalee. ‘Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene.’ ”

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: Slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ mi ji Yesu ba pee nɔ nɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ so somi nɛ hi pe kulaa.

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Se Yesu lɛɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ e we osɔfo yemi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ maa gu e nɔ kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ jio, hwɔɔ se jio, e ma he a yi wami. Ejakaa e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ e ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae ha mɛ.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Lɛɛ Yesu ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ sa wɔ. E ngɛ klɔuklɔu; sé ko be e he ɔ, e pee we yayami hulɔ. E je e he kɛ je yayami peeli a he, nɛ a wo e nɔ kɛ po mi kɛ ho hiɔwe tɔɔ ya.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Osɔfo kpahi nɛ ye osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, e be kaa mɛ. E hia we kaa daa ligbi ɔ, e sã yayami pami bɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yayami he kekle, loko e ba sã ngɛ ma a tsuo nɔ́ ɔ he. Benɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, blɔɔ e sã bɔ ɔ tsuo si kake nyɔngloo.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ dee ɔ we oti ɔ tsɔɔ kaa wa ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ hii si ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: E sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa nɛ ji bo tsu nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma, se pi nɔmlɔ adesa ko nɛ ma a.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ngɛ jinɛ e be osɔfo yee kulaa. Ejakaa osɔfohi ngɛ nɛ ngɔɔ nike ní kɛ haa Mawu kaa bɔ nɛ Yuda mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Ní nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa ní tsumi nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ henɔ, loo e nini kɛkɛ. Mose hu kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu e tsu ní. Benɛ e maa ma bo tsu ɔ, Mawu de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ nɛ o pee ní ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa henɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Kaa tɔmi ko be kekleekle somi ɔ he ɔ, jinɛ somi enyɔne he hia we.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Se Mawu na kaa a tɔ̃; enɛ ɔ he je nɛ e de ke, “Be ma nɛ i kɛ Israel, kɛ Yuda maa so somi he.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Somi he nɛ ɔ maa slo kulaa ngɛ somi nɛ i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so blema benɛ i je mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ he. Somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ, a yi nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngmɛɛ a he.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ lɛɛ somi nɛ i kɛ Israel maa so hwɔɔ se ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ma ngɔ ye mlaa a kɛ wo a juɛmi mi, nɛ ma ngma ngɔ to a tsui nɔ. Ma pee a Mawu, nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko be e huɛ, loo e nyɛmi dee ke, ‘Moo le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.’ Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le mi kɛ maa je nɔ nyafii pe kulaa nɔ kɛ yaa si nɔ nguaa pe kulaa nɔ.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Ma na mɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ a tɔmi ɔmɛ a he; nɛ i be a he yayami ɔmɛ kaie hu gblegbleegble. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu ngɛ somi he he munyu tue ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa kekleekle somi ɔ wo momo. Jehanɛ hu, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wo momo, loo e bwɔ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ e maa laa.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Kekleekle somi ɔ hɛɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ a kɛ ma ja Mawu, kɛ he ko hulɔ nɛ adesa pee nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu nɛ a ma ja Mawu ngɛ.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: A ma bo tsu, nɛ a po mi enyɔ. A tsɛɛ bo tsu ɔ he nɛ a guu kɛ sɛɛ mi ɔ he klɔuklɔu. Kane tso, kɛ okplɔɔ kɛ e nɔ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Behind the curtain was the most holy place.
translation_verse: A tsɛɛ tsu mi pomi bo enyɔne ɔ se bo tsu ɔ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ ngɛ tsu nɛ ɔ mi ji tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ, somi daka a nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ha he ɔ kɛ e mi sika tsu kplu ɔ nɛ mana a ngɛ mi ɔ, Aaron dɛma tso ɔ nɛ tsɛ̃ ba be ko ɔ, kɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Kerubhi nɛ tsɔɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ daa si ngɛ somi daka nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi ngɛ he nɛ a kɛ tɔmi paa ngɛ ɔ. Se wa be nyɛe ma gba níhi a mi fitsofitso amlɔ nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Ke a to níhi blɔ nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ yaa kekleekle bo tsu ɔ mi daa ligbi ya tsuɔ a jami blɔ nya ní.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Se bo tsu enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a pɛ lɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ si kake ngɛ jeha mi. Pohu ja e hɛɛ lohwe muɔ kɛ ya ngɛ yayami nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e pee, kɛ yayamihi nɛ ma a li a he be nɛ a pee ɔ a he.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe ngɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ji kaa be abɔ nɛ kekleekle bo tsu ɔ maa si kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ a na we nɛ a bli blɔ nɛ a guu kɛ yaa he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a lolo.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: ejakaa niye ní, kɛ dã, kɛ he tsumi kusumihi pɛ a he nɛ e kɔɔ. Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, he lo blɔ fa mi níhi nɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si be nɛ Mawu maa pee níhi tsuo ehe kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Se Kristo ba kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kɛ ha blɔ nya tomi kpakpa nɛ wa na nɛ ɔ. Bo tsu nɛ e sɔmɔɔ ngɛ mi ɔ kle, nɛ e hi kɛ pi si. Pi adesa nɛ pee, nɛ tsɔɔ kaa pi je nɛ ɔ mi níhi nɛ a bɔ ɔ eko.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: Benɛ Kristo gu bo tsu ɔ mi kɛ ya sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, e pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ si kake nyɔngloo. Pi to, loo na muɔ nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ɔ; mohu ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ ngɔ ha, konɛ e kɛ he wa yi wami kɛ ya neneene.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: To kɛ na muɔ, kɛ na bi nɛ a sã a la zu ji níhi nɛ a kɛ fĩaa nihi nɛ ble a he ɔ a nɔ, nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ a nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ngɛ he lo blɔ fa mi.

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: Ke enɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo muɔ nɛ e gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ ngɛ daa a nɔ nɛ e kɛ pue si ɔ tsu ní kulaa pe jã. Bɔ ɔ nɛ Kristo nɛ sé ko be e he ɔ ngɔ e he kɛ sã, nɛ e gbo ngɛ wa he ɔ ma ha nɛ wa ma je wa hɛ kɛ je kusumihi nɛ a he be se nami ɔ a he, nɛ wa ma sɔmɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Loko a maa ngɔ nɔ ko gbosi ní yemi he blɔ nya tomi womi kɛ tsu ní ɔ, e hia kaa a ye odase kaa niinɛ nɔ ɔ be je mi hu.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke nɔ ko ngɛ je mi ɔ, gbosi ní yemi blɔ nya tomi womi nɛ e pee ɔ, a kɛ tsu we ní; ja e gbo.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ kekleekle somi ɔ po muɔ a kɛ ma nɔ mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Kekleekle ɔ, Mose tsɔɔ ma a mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Mawu wo ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a nitsɛ tsɔɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ, kɛ jijɔ he bwɔmi tsutsuu kɛ sɔ na kɛ to muɔ, kɛ nyu, nɛ e kɛ fĩa womi kpo ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ ma mluku ɔ tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Bo tsu ɔ, kɛ kplu ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ jaa Mawu ɔ, Mose ngɔ muɔ kɛ fĩa mɛ tsuo a nɔ jã nɔuu.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Niinɛ, ngɛ mlaa a nya a, muɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ tsuɔ níhi tsuo a he; nɛ ke a pue we muɔ si ɔ, a kɛ yayami pɛ. Kristo ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ kɛ je wa he yayami

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je nɛ ɔ mi níhi nɛ ji hiɔwe ní ɔmɛ a henɔ ɔ lɛ e sa kaa a peeɔ kusumi kaa jã kɛ tsuɔ a he. Se hiɔwe ní nitsɛnitsɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ e hia kaa a pee kusumi nɛ hi pe ja kulaa nɛ a kɛ tsu a he.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo ɔ, pi he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa nɛ a kɛ nine pee, nɛ ji nɔ́ nitsɛ ɔ henɔ kɛkɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ya. Mohu ɔ, hiɔwe nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ e ho; nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ wa he.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Yuda osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a yaa he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a daa jeha kɛ muɔ nɛ pi lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ. Se Kristo ya lejɛ ɔ, pi nɛ e ngɔ e he ya sã bɔ si abɔ.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Kaa jã a, jinɛ kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ je ɔ, amanehlu sɔuu Kristo maa hi nae kpitikpiti. Mohu ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ je mi nyagbe miɔ nɛ e maa su ɔ, Yesu ba je e he kpo si kake nyɔngloo. E ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ kɛ je wa he yayami.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Mawu to kaa adesa nɛ gbo si kake, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kojo lɛ.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu Kristo hu a ngɔ lɛ kɛ sã bɔ si kake pɛ, konɛ e kɛ je adesa he yayami. E maa ba si enyɔne ɔ, pi nɛ e ba tsu yayamihi a he ní hu, se mohu e ma ba he nihi nɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ ɔ a yi wami.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Yuda bi ɔmɛ a mlaa a ngɛ kaa ní kpakpahi nɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ a nini kɛkɛ, pi ní ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ. Lɛɛ kɛ a maa pee kɛ gu kikɛmɛ a bɔ kake too nɛ a hii sãe nɔtonɔto daa jeha a nɔ kɛ tsu nihi nɛ baa Mawu ngɔ ɔ a he nɛ a hi kɛ pi si kɛɛ?

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ jaa Mawu ɔ, kaa a je a he yayami ɔmɛ niinɛ ɔ, a he nile be mɛ fɔ bue ngɛ a he yayami he hu, nɛ e be hiae kaa a sã bɔ hu.

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: Ejakaa na muɔ, kɛ to muɔ be nyɛe ma je yayami gblegbleegble.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, benɛ Kristo ma je ɔ mi ɔ, e de Mawu ke, “Bɔ nɛ a sãã, kɛ nike ní ɔ, o hla we, se o ha mi nɔmlɔ tso.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Sami bɔ, kɛ yayami pami bɔ ɔ, o bua jɔɛ he.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, ‘Mawu, ne mi! I ba konɛ ma ba pee o suɔmi nya ní kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ ye he ngɛ mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Kekleekle ɔ, Kristo de Mawu ke, “Bɔ, kɛ nike ní ɔ, o hla we; sami bɔ, kɛ yayami pami bɔ ɔ, o na we he bua jɔmi.” E de enɛ ɔ, pohu bɔhi nɛ a sãã a, mlaa a nya a sãã ngɛ.

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, e de ke, “Mawu, ne mi! I ba, konɛ ma ba pee o suɔmi nya ní.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔhi tsuo nɛ a sãã blema a, Mawu po mi, nɛ e ngɔ Kristo nɔ́ ɔ kɛ to nane mi.

english_verse: So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní; e ngɔ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ sã bɔ si kake too nyɔngloo, nɛ e kɛ je wɔ tsuo wa he yayami.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Yuda osɔfo tsuaa Yuda osɔfo ɔ, e ní tsumi ji kaa e sã bɔ kake too ɔ si abɔ daa ligbi; se bɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a jeɔ yayami gblegbleegble.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Se Kristo lɛɛ bɔ kake too e ngɔ e he kɛ sã kɛ je yayami kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa bɔ kake too ɔ nɛ Kristo ngɔ e he kɛ sã a ha nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ Mawu tsu a he ɔ hi kɛ pi si kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu yeɔ enɛ ɔ he odase. Kekleekle ɔ, e de ke,

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Be ma nɛ i kɛ ye ma a maa so somi nɛ ɔ: Ma ngɔ ye mlaa kɛ to a tsui mi, nɛ ma ngma kɛ wo a juɛmi mi.”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: E de hu ke, “A he yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa nɔ tɔmihi nɛ a pee ɔ, i be kaie hu.” Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, kɛ gu Kristo gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa ngɛ he blɔ faa nɛ wa yaa he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: Yesu gu tsu mi pomi bo nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ e bli blɔ he nɛ yaa wami mi ha wɔ.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ hyɛɔ Mawu we ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa ngɔ tsui nɛ mi tsɔ, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ pi si kɛ hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu he. Nyɛ ha a tsu wa tsui he bɔ nɛ wa he nile be wɔ fɔ bue, nɛ́ waa pee kaa nihi nɛ a kɛ nyu nɛ mi tsɔ heii du a he.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ, nɛ wa yeɔ he odase ɔ, nyɛ ha waa pɛtɛ he nɛ wa nɛ wa ko mimiɛ, ejakaa Mawu nɛ wo si ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha waa kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ susu he bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi, nɛ waa pee wa sibi kpakpa.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha wa jɔɔ wa he nya buami kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ hlaa peemi ɔ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ya nɔ nɛ waa wo wa sibi he wami wawɛɛ, titli ɔ, akɛnɛ nyɛ le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami be ɔ su ta a.

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, waa kɛ gbeye yemi nɛ hyɛ kojomi nɛ ma a, kɛ la gegeege nɛ ma kpata nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ Mawu a hɛ mi ɔ blɔ.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko tɔ Mose mlaa a, nɛ a da ni enyɔ, loo etɛ a we odase nɔ kɛ bu lɛ fɔ ɔ, a nɛ́ lɛ mɔbɔ; pe a gbeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ nɔ ko nɛ hia nane kɛ si Mawu Bi ɔ, nɛ Kristo muɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu somi ɔ nya kɛ tsu e he ɔ, e buu lɛ kaa yaka nɔ́ ko kɛkɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, e wo Mawu mumi ɔ mi mi la a, kɛ a maa pee lɛ kɛɛ? Anɛ e sɛ́ kaa a gblaa e tue wawɛɛ pe jã lo?

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de ke, “Ma ye ye he lue! Ma gbla a tue ngɛ yayami nɛ e pee ɔ he.” Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e de ke, “Ma kojo ye ma a.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nine maa gbe lɛ ɔ, musu tloo lɛ!

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ hi si sa a. Benɛ nyɛ ba le Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ hɛ mi miami na amanehlu babauu.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Be komɛ ɔ, a jɛɔ nyɛ, nɛ a peeɔ nyɛ nisɛ ní ngɛ ma hɛ mi; nɛ be komɛ hu, a buu nyɛ kɛ piɛɔ nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ a he.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: E hia kaa nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si, nɛ nyɛɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ e wo he si ɔ, nyɛ nine nɛ su nɔ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ke, “E piɛ bɔɔ pɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ ma a ma ba su si; e be kɛe kulaa.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Ye ma a, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a yi ma na wami. Se nɔ nɛ kpaleɔ e se ɔ, i be e he bua jɔmi nae.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ kpaleɔ ngɛ Mawu se, nɛ a hɛ mi kpataa a, pi mɛ ji wɔ. Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa piɛɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ a he, nɛ a he wa yi wami.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi ji níhi nɛ wa ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ a nɔ mi mami. Hemi kɛ yemi tsɔɔ wɔ kaa níhi nɛ wa nɛ́ kɛ wa hɛngmɛ ɔ, a ngɛ niinɛ.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Mawu ná nihi nɛ hi si blema a a he bua jɔmi.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha wa nu sisi kaa Mawu munyu a kɛ bɔ je ɔ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa níhi nɛ wa nɛ́ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ pee níhi nɛ wa naa a.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi he ɔ, a ngɔ Henok kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, konɛ e ko gbo. A nɛ́ lɛ, ejakaa Mawu ngɔ lɛ kɛ je. Ngmami ɔ ye odase kaa loko a maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho ɔ, e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Noa bu Mawu tue, benɛ e de lɛ ke nɔ́ ko ma nɛ bɛ hyɛ ɔ. E kpɛ lɛ nɛ a kɛ he e kɛ e yo kɛ e bimɛ a yi wami. Kɛ gu enɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, je ɔ yeɔ fɔ kaa a pee yayami; se Noa lɛɛ Mawu wo lɛ nguɔ kaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nya.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Abraham bu Mawu tue, benɛ a tsɛ lɛ nɛ a de lɛ ke e je he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ kɛ ya zugba nɛ ma ba pee e weto ní ɔ nɔ. Abraham pue nɔ kɛ ho, pohu e li he nɛ e yaa.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Abraham ya to nubwɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ Mawu wo lɛ si ke e ma ha lɛ ɔ nɔ be saii. E kɛ Isak, kɛ Yakob nɛ siwo ɔ kɔɔ a he ɔ hi bo tsuhi a mi.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ma nɛ Abraham ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ji ma nɛ Mawu nitsɛ to sisi, nɛ lɛ nɔuu e fia.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha Abraham na he wami nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ bi be mi nɛ e bwɔ, nɛ Sara nitsɛ hu pee yosa, ejakaa e bu nɔ nɛ wo lɛ si ɔ anɔkualetsɛ.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Abraham nɔ kake too nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ yi ta a, e nina ba hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe, loo wo nya zia nɛ hi kanemi.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ he Mawu ye ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a wo mɛ he si ɔ, a nine sui nɔ loko a gbo. A na ní ɔmɛ ngɛ lokoo kɛkɛ nɛ a nya he, nɛ a ye odase ngɛ ma hɛ mi kaa nibwɔhi, kɛ ma se bi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma hlae.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Ma mi he nɛ a je ɔ, a ngɛ he susue jinɛ a ko na he blɔ nɛ a kpale kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, ma ko nɛ hi kulaa pe lɔ ɔ, nɛ ji ma nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ji nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee we Mawu zo kaa a ma tsɛ lɛ ke a Mawu; ejakaa e dla ma ko ngɔ to mɛ.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: Mawu de Abraham ke, “O bi Isak lɛ ma ba wo nina ha mo.”

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Abraham he ye kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ma tle Isak si kɛ je gbeje tete. Nɛ ke a ma de ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ ɔ, Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ha Abraham niinɛ.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ Isak kɛ gbaa Yakob kɛ Esau kɛ ha hwɔɔ se je mi si himi.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ benɛ Yakob miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ, e ma e yi si ngɛ e dɛma tso ɔ nɔ, nɛ e sɔle nɛ e gbaa Yosef bimɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ benɛ Yosef gbenɔ be su ta a, e tsɔɔ Isarel bi ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ a ma plɛ kɛ je Egipt ha, nɛ e de mɛ bɔ nɛ a pee e gbogboe ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Mose fɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ laa nyɔhiɔ etɛ benɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ. A na kaa e he ngɛ fɛu saminya, nɛ mlaa a nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ wo ɔ, a yi mlaa a he gbeye.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ benɛ Mose ba wa a, e kplɛɛ we kaa a tsɛ lɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ biyo ɔ bi.

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: E suɔ mohu kaa e kɛ Mawu ma a nɛ na amanehlu pe nɔ́ nɛ e maa ye ngɔɔmi ngɛ yayami peemi mi be bɔɔ ko.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: Ngɛ Mose susumi nya a, ke a bɔ nɔ ko ahlua ngɛ Kristo ɔ he ɔ, juetli babauu nɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ po he jua wɛ kaa lɔ ɔ, ejakaa e hɛ ngɛ hiɔwo nɛ e ma na hwɔɔ se ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ Mose kɛ to Hetsɔmi ɔ sisi, nɛ e fã Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ muɔ kɛ fĩa a sinya tso ɔmɛ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ bɔfo nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ ko ba gbe Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha Israel ma a po Wo Tsu ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe. Se benɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ka kaa mɛ hu a maa pee ja a, a tlɔ wo ɔ mi, nɛ a gbo.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi nya nɛ Yeriko gbogbo ɔmɛ hule pue si benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ bɔle ma a ligbi kpaago ɔ.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Rahab, yaholɔ ɔ gbo we kɛ piɛ we tue gboli nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ a he, ejakaa nihi nɛ ya slaa zugba a, e he mɛ kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Anɛ e hia kaa ma pa de nɔ́ ko lo? Be ngɛ jinɛ i ko sɛɛ nyɛ Gideon, Barak, Samson, Yefta, David, Samuel, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a he ní.

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mahi hwu ta, nɛ a ye kunimi; a ha nɛ jatahi ma a nya.

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi a kɛ gbe la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ngɛ hehi, hemi kɛ yemi ha a je klaate nya, e ha ni wudɔwudɔhi ba pee katsɛmɛ; a kɛ ta buli nɛ je ma se hwu ta, nɛ a ye kunimi.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: A ye ni komɛ a he fɛu; a fia ni komɛ kpa, nɛ ni komɛ lɛɛ a bɔ mɛ pã, nɛ a wo mɛ tsu.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: A fia ni komɛ tɛ nɛ a gbo; a kɛ sau poo ni komɛ a mi enyɔɔnyɔ; nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe ni komɛ. A bu jijɔ he womi, kɛ apletsi he womi kaa heha ní. A ye ohia, a wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Je ɔ sɛ́ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ! A wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ, kɛ yohi a nɔ. A hi tɛ puɔhi, kɛ muɔhi a mi.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Hyɛ nihi abɔ nɛ he Mawu ye, nɛ a ngɛ odase kpakpa nɛ ɔ yee ngɛ a he! Se nɔ́ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nine sui nɔ.

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu to blɔ nya kpakpa ha waa kɛ mɛ tsuo, nɛ ja wa piɛ he loko níhi maa hi kɛ pi si.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nimli kpekpemi nitsɛnitsɛ kaa bɔku nɛ tsu a hemi kɛ yemi he ní nɛ bɔle wɔ kɛ kpe. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, níhi tsuo nɛ tsiɔ wɔ blɔ, titli ɔ, yayami peemi nɛ gblaa wɔ se ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ngmɛɛ he, konɛ waa kɛ hɛ mi miami nɛ tu fo nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ wa hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha waa hyɛ Yesu, ejakaa e nɔ wa hemi kɛ yemi ɔ daa si ngɛ. Akɛnɛ e le bua jɔmi nɛ e ma na pee se he je ɔ, gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ pi zo nɔ́ ko kulaa kɛ ha lɛ. Mohu ɔ, e to e tsui si kɛ na amanehlu ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hii si ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Nyɛ susu si nɛ yayami peeli te ngɔ wo lɛ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e to e tsui si kɛ na nɔ́ wawɛɛ ɔ he, konɛ pɔ ko tɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ kɔni mi ba jɔ̃.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ hɛ je bua womi munyu nɛ kɛ nyɛ tuɔ munyu kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ bimɛ tuɔ munyu ɔ nɔ lo? “Ye bi, koo ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi ɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nyafii; nɛ jehanɛ ke e gbla o tue ɔ, ko ha o nine mi nɛ wo nyu.

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ lɛ e tsɔseɔ, nɛ e fiaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e ngɔ peeɔ e bi ɔ kpa.”

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae ɔ mi kaa Mawu lɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔsee kaa e bimɛ ji nyɛ. Te bi nɛ ngɛ nɛ e fɔli tsɔse we lɛ nɛɛ?

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Tsɔsemi nɛ a haa nihi tsuo ɔ, ke nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ na we ɔ, lɛɛ ajuama mi bimɛ ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ pi e bimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, adesa blɔ fa mi ɔ, wa ngɛ tsɛmɛ nɛ tsɔseɔ wɔ, nɛ wa buɔ mɛ. Anɛ e sɛ kaa wa baa wa he si ha Tsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ mumihi a nɔ he wami ɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami lo?

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔseɔ wɔ be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ bɔ nɛ sa mɛɛ a hɛ mi; se Mawu lɛɛ e tsɔseɔ wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e hi ha wɔ, nɛ wɔ hu waa pee klɔuklɔu kaa lɛ.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ a ngɛ nɔ ko tsɔsee ɔ, bua jɔmi be mi; e dɔɔ lɛ wawɛɛ. Nihi nɛ a tsɔse mɛ ɔ, pee se ɔ, a naa he se; a yeɔ dami sane, nɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a hii si ngɛ he jɔmi mi. Ga womi kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ, konɛ glɔ̃ nane ɔ kó to kpa, se mohu a tsa lɛ.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu, ejakaa nɔ nɛ be klɔuklɔu ɔ, e be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nae.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ kó bɔ nɔ ko. Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nɔ ko nɔ́ ko ko dɔ nyɛ kadikadi nɛ ba ble níhi babauu kɛ puɛ ní.

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko kó pee e he yaholɔ, loo mu ní tsulɔ kaa Esau, nɔ nɛ jua e tɛte blɔ nya kɛ he niye ní nya mi bɔ kake ɔ.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le kaa pee se benɛ e hla kaa e tsɛ nɛ gbaa lɛ ɔ, e tsɛ ɔ kplɛɛ we. Esau kɛ hɛdɔ fo ya kaa e ma kpale e nya se, se e na we he blɔ.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Pi Sinai yo ɔ nɛ a be nyɛe maa ta he ɔ he nɛ nyɛ ba. Be ko benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya lejɛ ɔ, diblii, kɛ bɔku wo kpii, kɔɔhiɔ hia huu, nɛ la ngɛ tsoe plamplam ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: Titimati ngɛ pɛe, nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ munyu tue. Benɛ a nu gbi ɔ, a kpa pɛɛ ke a ko de nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ he hu.

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: Ejakaa mlaa a nɛ a wo mɛ ke, “Ke lohwe tete nane sa yo ɔ he ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ a gbe” ɔ, a be nyɛe nɔ nɛ a ye.

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ba su Zion yo ɔ, nɛ ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ ma a he. Nyɛ ba su hiɔwe Yerusalem ngɛ Mawu kɛ e bɔfohi babauu nɛ a be nyɛe kanemi, nɛ a bua kɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ a ngɔ.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ba sɛ bitɛtehi nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ a kpɛti. Mawu nɛ ji adesahi tsuo a kojolɔ ɔ, kɛ mumihi nɛ hɛɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a ha a hi kɛ pi si ɔ, a hɛ mi nyɛ ba nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Yesu, nɔ nɛ ha a so somi he ɔ, e ngɔ nyɛ ba nɛ ɔ nɛ. Muɔ nɛ a fĩa, nɛ tsuɔ ní kpakpahi nɛ pe Habel nɔ́ ɔ he nyɛ ba a nɛ.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
