translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue. Nihi nɛ bui nɔ nɛ bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tue ɔ, a yi a he. Nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ ke nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu tue nɛ wa bui lɛ tue ɔ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛ ye wa he kɛɛ?

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, gbi nɛ Mawu wo ɔ ha nɛ zugba a mimiɛ; se jehanɛ lɛɛ e wo si ke, “Pi zugba a kɛkɛ nɛ ma mimiɛ si kake ekohu, se mohu ma ha nɛ hiɔwe hu ma mimiɛ kɛ piɛ he.”

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: Munyu, “Si kake ekohu” ɔ, tsɔɔ paa kaa níhi nɛ a bɔ nɛ a mimiɛ ɔ maa je a hi he, konɛ níhi nɛ a be nyɛe ma mimiɛ ɔ nɛ a hi si daa.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa na Mawu si, ejakaa e ha wɔ blɔ nya nɛ waa ye tsɛ nɛ be tsakee gblegbleegble. Nyɛ ha waa ngɔ bu, kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ ba ja lɛ kɛ wa tsui tsuo bɔ nɛ maa sa e hɛ mi;

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: ejakaa wa Mawu ɔ, la nɛ kpataa nɔ́ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi daa kaa nyɛmimɛ.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko jɔɔ nibwɔ peemi hulɔ, ejakaa nibwɔ peemi nɔ nɛ ni komɛ gu kɛ he hiɔwe bɔfohi atuu nɛ a li tete.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo lɛ a wo tsu. Nyɛ kai nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ mohu nɛ a ngɛ yi mi wae.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha gba si himi he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ nyumu kɛ yo nɛ a ye a sibi anɔkuale. Ejakaa Mawu maa kojo yaholi, kɛ gba puɛli.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko di sika se; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ he. Ejakaa Mawu de ke, “I be mo sie, nɛ i be mo kuae gblegbleegble.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Lɛɛ nyɛ ha waa kɛ kã nɛ de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji ye he piɛlɔ, i be gbeye yee. Mɛni adesa ma nyɛ maa pee mi?”

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ kai mɛ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a hi si saminya hluu kɛ ya si a gbenɔ be; nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a he Mawu ye ha, nɛ nyɛɛ kase mɛ.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu e ngɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ; nɛ e ngɛ ja nɔuu kɛ yaa neneene.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ha ni komɛ nɛ ngɔ tsɔɔmi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ kɛ sane kpakpa a kɔ we nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je blɔ kpakpa a nɔ. Mawu dloomi ɔ lɛ woɔ wa mumi mi he wami; se mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ niye ní he ɔ, se nami ko kulaa be he kɛ ha nihi nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ko nɛ nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ be he blɔ kaa a yeɔ e nɔ ní.

english_verse: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
translation_verse: Jã kɛ̃ Yesu hu na amahehlu ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ se, konɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ ɔ kɛ je ma a he yayami.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa ya e ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se, nɛ a bɔ wɔ ahlua ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a pee lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Ejakaa wa be ma nɛ ngɛ daa ngɛ zugba a nɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, se ma nɛ maa ba a mohu se blɔ wa ngɛ hlae.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ ko je kpakpa peemi nɔ; nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ dla níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. Ejakaa jamɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ saa Mawu hɛ mi saminya.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha mɛ. Mɛ lɛ a hyɛɔ nyɛ nɔ daa, nɛ a maa bu akɔtaa ha Mawu. Nyɛ ha nɛ a pee enɛ ɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, se pi kɛ mi mi la, ejakaa lɔ ɔ maa ye nyɛ awi.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ a ha nɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ be kpiti mi.

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: He jɔmi Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ gu muɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu neneene somi ɔ nya a nɔ, nɛ e je to ɔmɛ a hyɛlɔ ngua a nɛ ji wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ,

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: e dla nyɛ kɛ pi si kɛ ní tsumi kpakpa sɔuu, konɛ nyɛɛ pee e sɔumi nya ní; nɛ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e ha nyɛ tsu níhi nɛ maa sa e hɛ mi, konɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene. Amen. Nyagbe munyuhi

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, womi nɛ i ngma nyɛ nɛ ɔ nya kɛ we kulaa, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye slɔmi ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: I ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa wa nyɛmi Timoteo nɛ a wo lɛ tsu ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ a ngmɛɛ e he. Ke e ba su ye ngɔ mla a, i kɛ lɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ ngɔ.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Wa biɔ nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ je Italia a hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si. Amen.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Imi Yakobo, Mawu kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ ɔ lɛ i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ya ha wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo. Nyɛ he manye! Hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ nile

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛɛ kɛ ka slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ kpee ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ wawɛɛ mohu;

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si saminya kɛ gblee kahi tsuo a mi kɛ manye, konɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si kulaa, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kó hia nyɛ.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ nile hlae ɔ, e kpa Mawu pɛɛ, nɛ e ma ha lɛ; ejakaa Mawu haa nɔ nɔ́ faa nɛ mi mi gbigblimi be mi.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Se ke o ngɛ Mawu nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ kpae ɔ, he ye, nɛ o ko je nɔ́ kulaa kaa Mawu ma ha mo nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ bie ɔ. Nɔ nɛ jeɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa wo mi oslɔke nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ fiae kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae.

english_verse: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all. Poor People and Rich People
translation_verse: Nɔmlɔ nɛ jeɔ nɔ́ nɛ e juɛmi peeɔ lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ, nɛ e nyɛ we nɔ́ ko nya si mami ɔ, e ko susu kaa e ma na nɔ́ ko kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi. Ohia kɛ ní nami

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ohiatsɛ ɔ, ke Mawu wo e nɔ ɔ, e fĩa;

english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: nɛ Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ niatsɛ ɔ, lɛ hu ke Mawu ba lɛ si ɔ, e fĩa, ejakaa niatsɛmɛ hɛ mi ma kpata kaa mɔmɔ nglaa ngɛ nga nɔ.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Ke pu je, nɛ je mi dɔ la a, mɔmɔ nglaa, nɛ e wɔleɔ pueɔ si, nɛ afɛu ko be e he hu. Ja nɔuu niatsɛ ɔ hu benɛ e hɛ dɔ kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, e hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa. Ka

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ke a ngɛ lɛ kae ɔ, e toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e ngmɛɛ we e hemi kɛ yemi he ɔ, á gbaa lɛ. Ejakaa ke e nyɛ gblee ka a mi ɔ, neneene wami nɛ Mawu wo si kaa a ma ha nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Ke a ka nɔ ko ɔ, e ko de ke Mawu lɛ ka lɛ. Ejakaa nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ka Mawu kaa e maa pee yayami lo. Pohu Mawu nitsɛ kɛ́ nɔ.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e we akɔnɔ nɛ gblaa lɛ, nɛ́ sisiɔ lɛ ɔ nɛ kaa lɛ.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Nɛ akɔnɔ ɔ, ke e ngɔ hɔ ɔ, e fɔɔ yayami, nɛ yayami hu ke e wa a, e fɔɔ gbenɔ.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ a sisi nyɛ.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Nike ní kpakpa, kɛ níhi nɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ wa naa yaka a, lɛ tsuo Mawu lɛ haa wɔ. Mawu lɛ bɔ pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. E haa nɛ a haa wɔ la daa, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e tsakee we gblegbleegble.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Mawu gu sane kpakpa a nɔ kɛ ha wɔ mumi mi wami. Lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya nɛ e pee enɛ ɔ. Ejakaa e suɔ kaa e pee wɔ nihi nɛ a he hia pe nibɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo. Sane kpakpa a tue bumi kɛ e nɔ yemi

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: Mi mi fumi ha we nɛ nɔ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he kaa nyɛ maa bu munyu ɔ tue kɛkɛ; mohu nyɛɛ pee munyu ɔ nɔ yeli.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buu munyu ɔ tue kɛkɛ, se e yi nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ya hyɛɛ e he ngɛ ahuhuɛ mi, nɛ e naa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tutuutu.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Sane kpakpa a ji Mawu mlaa nɛ hi kɛ pi si, nɛ haa nɔ yeɔ e he. Ke nɔ ko kase sane kpakpa a mi tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ saminya, nɛ e mia e hɛ mi nɛ e hɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ e kase ɔ nɔ, se mohu e ye nɔ ɔ, a maa gbaa lɛ saminya ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ tsue ɔ mi.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ nɔ ko ma ja Mawu nɛ maa sa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: awusahi kɛ yalɔyihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, e hyɛ a nɔ. Jehanɛ e hyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he nɔ saminya, konɛ je mi akɔnɔ yaya ko tɔtɔ e nane.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ yeɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ko bu ni komɛ pe ni komɛ.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛ ya kpe ngɛ jami he ɔ, nɛ ni enyɔ ba. Nɔ kake ha ablade bo, nɛ e wo sika tsu nguɛ ní. Nɔ kake ɔ lɛɛ ohiatsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ e ha bo gbagbɛ, loo bo sɛmusɛmu.

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ dla e he saminya a, nyɛ he lɛ atuu kɛ bu, nɛ nyɛ de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ba hi hiɛ!” Se ohiatsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ de lɛ ke, “Dá si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he ko!” aloo “Ba sɔ̃ si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!”

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: Tse nyɛ na nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ! Mi gbami nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti bae ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi a he ga yaya toe.

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue. Tse nyɛ le kaa nihi nɛ je ɔ buu mɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔ, mɛ Mawu hla a. Akɛnɛ a heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba pee mumi mi niatsɛmɛ, nɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ Mawu wo si ha nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ ba pee a nɔ.

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Se nyɛ pueɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si. Anɛ pi niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ? Anɛ pi mɛ nɛ a ngɔɔ nyɛ kɛ yaa kojomi he ɔ?

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Biɛ kpakpa nɛ a wo nyɛ ɔ, anɛ pi mɛ nɛ a gbeɔ he guɛ ɔ?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: E ngɛ ngmami ɔ mi ke, “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.” Matsɛ yemi ɔ mi mlaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ke o ye nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ o pee saminya.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ hyɛɔ nihi a hɛ mi ɔ, yayami nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ fɔ kaa nyɛ tɔ mlaa.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, se e ma tɔ mlaa a kake ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ kaa e tɔ mlaa amɛ tsuo.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Mawu ɔ nɛ wo mlaa ke a ko puɛ gba a, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e wo mlaa ke a ko gbe nɔmlɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o puɛ we gba, se o gbeɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, o tɔ mlaa a tsuo.

english_verse: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
translation_verse: Nyɛ munyu tumi, kɛ nyɛ ní peepee tsuo nɛ tsɔɔ kaa mlaa nɛ haa wa yeɔ wa he ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa kojo wɔ.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ nɛ nɛ́ mɔbɔ ɔ, benɛ a maa kojo lɛ ɔ, Mawu be lɛ mɔbɔ nae; se ke o naa mɔbɔ ɔ, Mawu be mo fɔ bue. Hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ e he ní tsumi

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nɔ ko ke e ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi, se e ní peepee tsɔɔ we ja a, mɛni se nami ngɛ he? Anɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ma nyɛ he e yi wami lo?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛmimɛ komɛ be heha ní, loo niye ní.

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ha we mɛ níhi nɛ hia mɛ nɛ ɔ, mɛni se nami ngɛ he kaa nyɛ ma de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya ngɛ he jɔmi mi! Nyɛ ya hlue la; nyɛɛ ye ní nɛ nyɛɛ tɔ?”

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Hemi kɛ yemi hu ja nɔuu e ngɛ; ke ní tsumi piɛ we he ɔ, e ji hemi kɛ yemi nɛ gbo.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Se nɔ ko ma de ke, “Moo lɛɛ o hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ imi lɛɛ i tsuɔ ní” Yoo, tsɔɔ mi o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o tsu we he ní ɔ, nɛ imi hu i kɛ níhi nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo kaa i heɔ yeɔ.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Nyɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu kake pɛ lɛ ngɛ! Saminya! Mumi yayami ɔmɛ po heɔ yeɔ ja nɔuu. Nɛ lɔ ɔ haa a nuɔ sawale, nɛ a he doɔ blibliibli.

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Tse nyɛ na! Abraham he ye, nɛ e tsu he ní hulɔ. Ní nɛ e tsu ɔ ha nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ba wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ ba mi ke, “Abraham he Mawu ye, nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ha nɛ Mawu bu lɛ dalɔ.” Enɛ ɔ he nɛ a tsɛɛ Abraham ke Mawu huɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ tse nyɛ na kaa ní tsumi nɔ Mawu guu kɛ buɔ nɔ dalɔ, se pi hemi kɛ yemi pɛ nɔ.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ti nihi fuu kó pee nyɛ he tsɔɔli. Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, wɔ tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, wa tue gblami nya maa wa pe ni kpa amɛ.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Wɔ tsuo wa pɔɔ tɔmi peemi babauu. Se ke nɔ ko tɔ we ngɛ munyu tumi mi ɔ, lɛɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ji lɛ, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa ye e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo nɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Ke wa ngɛ hlae nɛ okpɔngɔ nɛ bu wɔ tue ɔ, waa kɛ dade woɔ e nya mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, he tsuaa he nɛ wa suɔ kaa e ya a, e yaa.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Aloo waa ngɔ lɛ nɛ ngɛ pa nɔ. Ke e kle kaa mɛni, nɛ ja kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa nɛ ma nyɛ tsɛ̃ e yi se po, kudɔɔ nyafii ko kɛkɛ kudɔɔtsɛ ɔ kɛ plɛɔ lɛ ɔ kɛ yaa he nɛ e suɔ.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu lilɛ ngɛ; lilɛ ngɛ nyafii lɛɛ, se e fĩaa ní nguahi. Hyɛ kaa la bɔbɔyoo pɛ maa sã hue tso!

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Ee, lilɛ ngɛ kaa la. Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ kake nɛ ji lilɛ ɔ, yi wu tso ní sɔuu e tsuɔ. E kɛ yayami bleɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo. La nɛ je Abosiami a je nitsɛnitsɛ lɛ e kɛ mɛɛ wɔ kɛ kpataa wa hɛ mi pɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Adesa nyɛɔ jɔɔ adebɔ ní kpahi tsuo a he, nga mi lohwehi jio, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ jio, níhi nɛ sãã si jio, pa mi lohi jio.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Se lilɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e jɔɔ he gblegbleegble. E ji nɔ́ yayami nɛ jɔɛ nɔ he mi; duɔ nɛ gbee nɔ hyi lɛ tɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Adesa lilɛ kake ɔ, e kɛ gbaa, nɛ e kɛ gbiɛɔ nɔ hulɔ. Ye nyɛmimɛ, e sɛ́ kaa e baa jã.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Anɛ nyu hɛngmɛ baa nyu mua, kɛ nyu doodooe kɛ jee hɛngmɛ kake ɔ nɔuu mi lo?

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, anɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ma nyɛ wo oliv tso yiblii lo? Anɛ wai tso ma nyɛ wo ngmɔkɔ lo? Jã nɔuu ngo nyu be nyɛe maa pee nyu mua. Nile nɛ je hiɔwe

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Anɛ ní lelɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti lo? Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi lo? Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, e ba e je mi saminya. E ngɔ he si bami kɛ tsu ní kpakpa kɛ ye e nile ɔ he odase.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Se ke hunga jemi yaya, kɛ pɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ hlae kaa e hi ha lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko fĩa, nɛ́ nyɛ ba ye lakpa ngɔ si anɔkuale ɔ.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a nile nɛ ɔ, pi hiɔwe nɛ e je; zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɔ́; Mawu mumi be mi, mumi yayami sɔuu.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: He nɛ hunga jemi ngɛ, nɛ nihi suɔ kaa e hi ha mɛ pɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɛ a naa sakasaka peemi, kɛ awi yemi slɔɔtohi babauu ngɛ.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Ta kɛ pɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, mɛni kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ baa? Anɛ pi nyɛ he lo mi akɔnɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ mi lo?

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ́ ko pee nyɛ akɔnɔ nɛ nyɛ nine sui nɔ ɔ, nyɛ pueɔ muɔ si. Jã kɛ̃ ke nyɛ hɛ kɔ̃ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ a níhi a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ nine sui nɔ ɔ, nyɛ woɔ pɛ, nɛ nyɛ gbaa ta kɛ woɔ nyɛ sibi. Níhi nɛ hia nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ nine sui nɔ; ejakaa nyɛ bi we Mawu.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ kpa pɛɛ hu, nyɛ nine sui nɔ, ejakaa nyɛ yi mi tomi ɔmɛ hí; níhi nɛ ma ha nyɛ bua jɔmi pɛ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ kpaa.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ gba puɛli nɛ nyɛ yi Mawu anɔkuale! Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nɔ ko suɔ je ɔ, nɔ ɔ ngɛ Mawu nyɛe lo? Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ je ɔ bɔɔ ɔ, e peeɔ Mawu he nyɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Anɛ nyɛ susuu kaa yaka gu nɛ a ngma ke, “Mumi nɛ Mawu ngɔ wo wa mi ɔ, e jeɔ he hunga wawɛɛ” ɔ?

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Se mɔbɔ nɛ Mawu naa wɔ ɔ nya wa kulaa pe lɔ ɔ po. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, Mawu baa mɛ si; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ baa a he si ɔ lɛɛ e dlooɔ mɛ.”

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha Mawu. Nyɛɛ te si kɛ wo Abosiami, nɛ e maa tu nyɛ nya fo.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ su Mawu he, nɛ e maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su nyɛ he. Yayami peeli, nyɛ fɔ nyɛ dɛ! Nyɛ yi mi enyɔɔnyɔtsɛmɛ, nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui.

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ; nyɛɛ wo yana, nɛ nyɛ nya awe. Nyɛ kpa muɔmi, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yana. Nyɛ kpa nyami, nɛ nyɛɛ nu sawale!

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e ma wo nyɛ nɔ. Nyɛ ko tu nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he munyu yaya

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko tu nyɛ sibi a he munyu yaya. Nɔ nɛ tuɔ e nyɛmi he nyumu yaya a, mlaa a e ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ sie ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kojoɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ mlaa a kojoe. Ke nɔ ko tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ mlaa a, pi mlaa a nɔ yelɔ ji lɛ, se mohu e peeɔ mlaa a kojolɔ.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Mawu pɛ ji mlaa wolɔ kɛ kojolɔ. Lɛ nɔ kake nɔuu pɛ lɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami, nɛ e kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi hulɔ. Se moo lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji mo, nɛ o kojoɔ o nyɛmi adesa? Nyɛ ko fĩa ngɔ fɔ hwɔɔ se nɔ

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, nyɛ ti ni komɛ deɔ ke, “Hwɔɔ, loo hwɔɔ se ɔ, ma hia blɔ kɛ ya ma ko mi, nɛ ma ya ye jeha ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma ya ye jua nɛ ma na ní.”

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ deɔ ja a, nyɛɛ bu tue. Anɛ nyɛ le hwɔɔ se je nami mi sane? Nyɛ ngɛ kaa afua nɛ woɔ be kpiti, kɛkɛ a nɛ́ lɛ hu.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ mohu nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ deɔ ji, “Ke Mawu suɔ nɛ wa yi na wami ɔ, wa maa pee enɛ ɔ, loo enɛ.”

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛ fĩaa. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ji yayami peemi.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ le nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ e pee we ɔ, yayami e pee ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ nyɛ niatsɛmɛ hu nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛɛ wo yana, nɛ nyɛ nya awe; ejakaa aywilɛho sanehi maa ba nyɛ nɔ!

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Ní babauu nɛ nyɛ na a plɛ pee kɔɔhiɔ, nɛ wɔyewɔye ye nyɛ heha ní kpakpahi.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ bua nya a maa nɔ kana. Jamɛ a kana a maa ye odase kɛ si nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpe nyɛ he lo kaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ la sã. Nyɛ ngɛ juetli babanu buae kɛ ngɛ toe nyagbe be nɛ ɔ mi.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Apaa yeli nɛ hu nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ wui mɛ hiɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae boboobo ha! Ní kpali nɛ bua nyɛ ngmɔ ní nya a a ngmlaa a ya su Nyɔmtsɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tue mi tɔɔ.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Nyɛ na ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔ nyɛ he saminya ngɛ je ɔ mi. Ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ ye ɔ ha nyɛ wo zɔ saminya kɛ ha ligbi nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, se a be he wami nɛ a kɛ ma fa a he ɔ, nyɛ bu mɛ fɔ, nɛ nyɛ gbe mɛ. Tsui si tomi kɛ sɔlemi

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ja. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ, nyɛ lua nyɛ, ejakaa be ɔ na wɔ haa.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko pia nyɛ sibi, konɛ Mawu ko kojo nyɛ. Hyɛ, kojolɔ ɔ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, gbali ɔmɛ nɛ fiɛ munyu ɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ to a tsui si wawɛɛ kɛ na amanehlu. Nyɛ ha nɛ a pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Niinɛ, nihi nɛ to a tsui si wawɛɛ ɔ, wa buu mɛ nihi nɛ a gbaa mɛ. Nyɛ nu bɔ nɛ Hiob to e tsui si, nɛ́ nyagbe ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha e na ní babauu. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛ ko ka kita. Nyɛ ko ka hiɔwe; nyɛ ko ka zugba, nɛ nyɛ ko ka nɔ́ kpa ko hulɔ. Ke nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ mi anɔkuale ɔ, nyɛ de ke “Ee”; se ke e be mi ɔ, nyɛ de ke, “Dɛbi.” Kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu be nyɛ fɔ bue.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Ke amanehlu ba nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e sɔle. Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko bua jɔ ɔ, e la yi jemi la.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko be he wami ɔ, e ha nɛ a tsɛ asafo ɔ mi nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ba; a sɔle ha lɛ, nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Ke a sɔle kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ha lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, hiɔtsɛ ɔ ma na he wami. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma tsa lɛ kulaa, nɛ e maa ngɔ yayami tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ he ɔ kɛ pa lɛ.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ jaje nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ sibi; nyɛɛ sɔle ha nyɛ sibi konɛ a tsa nyɛ. Ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da fa kue ha Mawu ɔ, e tsuɔ ní saminya.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Eliya a, nɔmlɔ adesa ji lɛ kaa wɔ nɔuu. E sɔle kɛ hɛdɔ ke hiɔmi kó nɛ; nɛ hiɔmi nɛ́ ngɛ zugba a nɔ jeha etɛ kɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa sɔuu.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale sɔle, nɛ Mawu ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ saminya, nɛ zugba a ba ní.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko tla kɛ je anɔkuale ɔ he, nɛ nɔ ko kpale lɛ kɛ ba ekohu ɔ,

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsake yayami peelɔ ko ɔ, e ma he yayami peelɔ ɔ yi wami, nɛ a maa ngɔ e he yayami babauu ɔ kɛ pa lɛ.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Imi Petro, Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ngɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ Mawu hla, nɛ nyɛ gbɛ fĩa Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia, kɛ Bitinia zugba amɛ a nɔ ɔ manee.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Tsɛ Mawu hla nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e to ke e maa pee ɔ, nɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ pee nyɛ ma klɔuklɔu, konɛ nyɛɛ bu Yesu Kristo tue, nɛ e muɔ ɔ nɛ tsu nyɛ he. Mawu dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ fuu ha nyɛ. Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ mi wa

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ yi. E na wɔ mɔbɔ babauu kaa e tle Yesu Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e kɛ ha wɔ wami he; ejakaa suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ be nyagbe. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ haa wɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ mi wa.

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa Mawu ngɔ gbosi ní nɛ puɛ we, nɛ mu be he, nɛ kpa we hulɔ ɔ ngɔ to ha nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ lɛ Mawu ɔ yeɔ, nɛ́ e kɛ e he wami ɔ ngɛ nyɛ he bue ɔ. Mawu pee klaalo kaa e ma he nyɛ yi wami nyagbe be ɔ mi.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu slɔɔtohi nae be bɔɔ ko lɛɛ, se nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu pee ɔ he.

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: A kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ kae kaa nyɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ niinɛ lo. Sika tsu po nɛ puɛɔ ɔ, a kaa ngɛ la mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ he jua wa kulaa pe sika tsu ɔ, ja a ka lɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e mi nɛ wa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba ekohu ɔ, a ma je nyɛ yi, nɛ a maa bu nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi maa ba nyami.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ, se nyɛ suɔ lɛ; amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ, se nyɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ, nɛ nyɛ naa bua jɔmi nɛ nyɛ nyaa bɔ nɛ e be hie kalemi,

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: ejakaa nyɛ yi wami hemi ɔ nɛ e he nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su nɔ.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ gba, nɛ a de ke dloomi ko ngɛ ha nyɛ hwɔɔ se ɔ, hla kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi sane ɔ mi fitsofitso.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: A bɔ mɔde kaa a maa na be nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e ma plɛ kɛ ba ha. Be ɔ nɛ Kristo mumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. Mumi ɔ de to ke Kristo maa na amanehlu, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hɛ mi maa ba nyami.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Mawu je tsɔɔ gbali nɛ ɔmɛ kaa ní tsumi nɛ a ngɛ tsue ɔ, pi mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ma na he se, se nyɛ mohu. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a fiɛ sane kpakpa ngɔ ha nyɛ tsuo. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ a tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e he wami a kɛ fiɛ ha nyɛ. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ tete ko suɔ kaa a maa nu sisi. Si himi klɔuklɔu

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ juɛmi klaalo kɛ ha ní tsumi. Nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ dloomi nɛ Mawu ma ha nyɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba ekohu ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu Mawu tue. Akɔnɔhi nɛ hao nyɛ benɛ nyɛ li anɔkuale ɔ lolo ɔ, nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ se hu.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Se mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ je mi bami he nɛ tsɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, ejakaa i ngɛ klɔuklɔu.”

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ ngɛ kue fae ha Mawu ɔ, nyɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ke Tsaatsɛ. Ee, Mawu hyɛ we nihi a hɛ mi, se mohu e kojoɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e ní peemi níhi a nya. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ bu kɛ ha lɛ nyɛ wami be nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ tsuo.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Ejakaa yakayaka si himi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ le hĩɔ nɛ Mawu wo loko e kɛ kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je mi nɛ nyɛ ye nyɛ he. Pi nɔ́ ko nɛ puɛɔ kaa sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Mawu hla lɛ momo loko a to je ɔ sisi, nɛ a je lɛ kpo ngɛ nyagbe be nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ nyɛ he.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ gu e nɔ kɛ he Mawu ye; Mawu nɛ tle lɛ si, nɛ e wo e hɛ mi nyami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he Mawu nyɛɛ ye, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ lɛ nɔuu e nɔ.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, anɔkuale tsɔɔmi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yesu Kristo he ɔ, nyɛ ye nɔ. Nyɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ ba na suɔmi kpakpa kɛ ha nyɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha Yesu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi saminya kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.

english_verse: Do this because God has given you new birth by his message that lives on forever.
translation_verse: Kɛ gu Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ daa a nɔ ɔ, a fɔ nyɛ ehe. Nyɛ ba pee Tsɛ nɛ gbo we, se pi nɔ nɛ gboɔ ɔ bimɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ ke, “Nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ kaa nga; Nɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa nga mɔmɔ, Nga gbliɔ, nɛ mɔmɔ wɔleɔ,

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.” Munyu ɔ ji sane kpakpa a nɛ a fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa yayami tsuaa yayami peemi, lakpa, osato, ninyɛ, kɛ nihi a he munyu tumi.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ ní kaa bimwɔwi, nihi nɛ a fɔ mɛ ehe. Nyɛ ha nɛ mumi mi nyɔ nyu nɛ mi tsɔ ɔ nɛ jlo nyɛ. Nyɛ hla nɛ nyɛɛ nu, nɛ nyɛɛ wa, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami.

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpa si, nɛ nyɛ na kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi jɔ.”

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ. Lɛ ji tɛ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ adesa kua lɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ he be se nami ɔ nɛ. Se Mawu lɛɛ e hla lɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa saminya.

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba kaa tɛhi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ, nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ a fia nyɛ kɛ ma si kaa mumi mi we. Nyɛ maa pee osɔfo klɔuklɔuhi, nɛ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa sã mumi mi bɔ nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke, “I hla tɛ ko nɛ he jua wa saminya, nɛ i kɛ ngɛ si mae ngɛ Zion kaa kɔ nya tɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ, e he jua wa ha nyɛ saminya; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ, “Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ kua a, lɔ ɔ tutuutu ba plɛ pee kɔ nya tɛ.”

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, wɛtso nɛ Mawu hla ji nyɛ, odehe osɔfohi, je ma klɔuklɔu, kɛ Mawu nitsɛ e ma. E hla nyɛ nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ kɛ je diblii mi kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e la nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ ɔ he, konɛ nyɛ ba fiɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Sa a, pi Mawu e ma ji nyɛ; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ma ji nyɛ. Sa a, Mawu nɛ́ nyɛ mɔbɔ; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e na nyɛ mɔbɔ. Mawu nyɔguɛhi

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! I ngɔ sane nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe kaa nibwɔhi, kɛ blɔ hiali ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi. Nyɛ ko ya di he lo mi níhi a se, ejakaa a kɛ nyɛ klaa ngɛ ta hwue daa.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Ke nyɛ pee jã, nɛ a po nyɛ nya kaa yayami peeli ji nyɛ po, kpakpa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, a maa na. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ Mawu ma ba kojo je ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nɔ yemi tsuaa nɔ yemi ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, matsɛ nɛ ngɛ blɔ nya pe nihi tsuo,

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: aloo amlaalohi nɛ e hla nɛ a gbla yayami peeli a tue, nɛ a je nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a yi ɔ.

english_verse: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee kpakpa, konɛ kuasia amɛ nɛ hii ní tsuae putɛputɛɛ ɔ, a kpa munyu tumi kɛ si nyɛ.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hi si kaa nihi nɛ ye a he, se nyɛ ko ngɔ he yemi nɛ ɔ kɛ pee yayami nɛ nyɛɛ laa nɔ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ hi si kaa Mawu tsɔli.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ bu nɔ tsuaa nɔ; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha Kristo ɔ; nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ bu matsɛ ɔ. Kristo amanehlu nɛ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Sɔmɔli, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu mɛ saminya; pi nihi nɛ a mi mi hi, nɛ a he jɔ kɛkɛ, se ni nɛmɛ nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi tete.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Ke o na amanehlu nɛ sɛ́, nɛ o le kaa lɔ ɔ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, Mawu maa gbaa mo.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Ke o pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ, nɛ a ngɛ mo kpa fiae ngɛ he, nɛ o to o tsui si ɔ, mɛni se nami ngɛ he? Se ke o pee kpakpa, nɛ o ngɛ he amanehlu nae, nɛ o to o tsui si ɔ, Mawu maa gbaa mo.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa Kristo nitsɛ na amanehlu, nɛ e kɛ lɔ ɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: E pee we yayami ko ɔ, lakpa ko hu ji e nya.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Benɛ a ngɛ lɛ jɛe ɔ, lɛɛ e jɛ we nɔ ngɔ to we nane mi. Benɛ e ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, e gbíɛ nɔ ko; se mohu e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu, kojolɔ ɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Kristo nitsɛ tloo wa he yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ na nɔ́ ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ wa ko ngɔ wa he ngɔ ha yayami hu, se mohu waa ba wa je mi bɔ nɛ sa. E pa amɛ lɛ tsa nyɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Jinɛ nyɛ laa blɔ kaa tohi. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ kpale kɛ ba nyɛ hyɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ he bulɔ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu kɛ̃, nyɛ yigbayihi hu, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ hunomɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke a ti ni komɛ he we Mawu munyu ɔ yi ɔ, nyɛ je mi bami nɛ tsake mɛ. E be hiae kaa a kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu po,

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: ejakaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a maa na kaa nyɛ je mi bami he tsɔ, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ngɔ níhi kaa yi gbɔmi, loo sika tsu ní womi, loo bo nɛ ngɛ fɛu bumi kɛ dla nyɛ he.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Ejakaa yi klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ blema a ba a he si ha a hunomɛ. Nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a he pee fɛu.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Sara nitsɛ pee jã; e bu Abraham, nɛ e tsɛ lɛ e nyɔmtsɛ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ Sara bimɛ, ke nyɛ peeɔ kpakpa nɛ nyɛ yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko gbeye ɔ.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Nyɛ hunomɛ ɔmɛ hu, ke nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ na nya ha mɛ saminya kaa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso blɔ fa mi ɔ, yo he wɛ tsɔ. Nyɛɛ bu mɛ, ejakaa Mawu ma ha nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo ma na wami kaa dloomi ní nɛ je lɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ ko kó tsi nyɛ sɔlemi blɔ. Nɔ́ nami ngɛ kpakpa peemi he

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi. Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he kaa nyɛmimɛ. Nyɛɛ na nyɛ sibi mɔbɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko ngɔ yayami kɛ ma yayami nane mi, aloo jɛmi kɛ ma jɛmi nane mi. Ke nihi pee nyɛ yayami, loo a jɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ de Mawu nɛ e gbaa mɛ mohu. Ejakaa gbaami Mawu wo si ke e maa gbaa nyɛ benɛ e tsɛ nyɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Ngmami ɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e na bua jɔmi, nɛ e se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi ɔ, e kpa lakpa yemi, kɛ nɔ he munyu yaya tumi.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: E jɔɔ yayami peemi, nɛ e pee kpakpa. E bɔ mɔde wawɛɛ, nɛ e kɛ e nyɛmimɛ nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ buu dali a he, nɛ ke a fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e nuɔ. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ yayami lɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ yi.”

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Ke nyɛ hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi he ɔ, mɛnɔ maa pee nyɛ yayami?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke nyɛ naa amanehlu tete po ngɛ kpakpa nɛ nyɛ peeɔ he ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ pɛ! Nyɛ ko ye nihi nɛ maa pee nyɛ yayami ɔ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he hulɔ.

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ bu, nɛ nyɛ ko nyɛ a nɔ. Nyɛɛ hi si saminya, nɛ nyɛ he nile ko bu nyɛ fɔ. Ke nyɛ pee jã a, nyɛ je mi bami kpakpa kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ ma ha zo maa gbe nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu yaya kɛ siɔ nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ejakaa e hi kaa nɔ ko maa pee kpakpa nɛ e na amanehlu, ke lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ ɔ, pe nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee yayami.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Ejakaa Kristo gbo kekleekle nɔ́ kɛ nyagbe nɔ́ ngɛ ní yayamihi a he. Lɛ dalɔ ɔ, e gbo ngɛ yayami peeli a nane mi, konɛ e ngɔ wɔ kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ. Benɛ a gbe Kristo ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, e hɛɛ nɔmlɔ adesa su. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ Mawu ha nɛ e ba wami mi ɔ, mumi ji lɛ.

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: Nɛ kaa mumi ɔ, e ya mumihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya fiɛ ha mɛ.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ sɔlemi okadi ɔ nɛ. Ke a sɔle wɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa a fɔ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he, nɛ wa he tsɔ. Mohu ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa waa kɛ Mawu so kaa wa maa hi si saminya nɛ wa he nile ko bu wɔ fɔ, nɛ kɛ gu si nɛ Yesu Kristo te ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ma he wa yi wami.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo ho hiɔwe ya; e ya hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ bɔfohi, kɛ mumi mi níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ he wami a nɔ yee.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ Kristo na nɔ́ ngɛ he lo mi he je ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ dla nyɛ he kɛ jamɛ a juɛmi ɔ nɔuu. Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ naa nɔ́ ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, e kɛ yayami be sane ko hu.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Sa a, nyɛ puɛ be babauu kɛ pee níhi nɛ ma je li suɔ peemi, yahomi, akɔnɔ níhi a se dimi, dã demi, fiɛmi sakasaka, jiklɔɔ peemi, kɛ wɔ jami ní kpɔtɔkpɔtɔ peemi.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e peeɔ mɛ nyakpɛ kaa nyɛ piɛ we a he kɛ pee we jamɛ a yakayaka ní ɔmɛ hu; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tuɔ nyɛ he munyu yaya.

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Se a maa bu akɔtaa ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ dla e he ngɔ to nɛ e maa kojo hɛ kali, kɛ ni gbogboehi tsuo ɔ.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ni gbogboehi tete po ɔ nɛ. A kojo mɛ ngɛ he lo blɔ fa mi kaa nimli adesahi mohu lɛɛ, se a ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, konɛ a kɛ Mawu nɛ hi si ngɛ mumi mi. Mawu nike níhi a nɔ hyɛli kpakpahi

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Níhi tsuo a nyagbe ɔ su ta. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ́ nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa ji kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he saminya; ejakaa suɔmi haa yayami babauu nɔ.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Nike ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ sibi kaa Mawu dloomi nike ní slɔɔto ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli kpakpahi.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, e fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ; ke nɔ ko ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, e ngɔ he wami nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ kɛ sɔmɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, e ha nɛ nihi nɛ a je Mawu yi kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ. Mawu nɔ́ ji hɛ mi nyami, kɛ he wami kɛ yaa neneene. Amen. Nɔ́ nami kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, bɔ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kae, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, e ko pee nyɛ nyakpɛ. Nyɛ ko susu kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ bɛ hyɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae ɔ.

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Se mohu, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ kaa amanehlu nɛ Kristo na a, nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ nae. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke e ba ekohu kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi babauu.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Ke nihi jɛ nyɛ kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ji nyɛ ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ pɛ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa mumi nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, nɛ ji mumi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó na amanehlu kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ, aloo julɔ, aloo yayami peelɔ, aloo nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ e he woɔ ni kpahi a sanehi a mi.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: Se ke nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu nae kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ, zo ko pee nyɛ. Se mohu nyɛɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami kaa a tsɛɛ nyɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Be ɔ nɛ a maa je kojomi sisi ɔ su ta, nɛ Mawu maa kojo lɛ nitsɛ e ni ɔmɛ kekle. Ke a kɛ wɔ je sisi ɔ, nihi nɛ he we sane kpakpa a nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ yi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛ a nyagbe maa pee gbeye!

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Ke dengme loko a ma he nimli kpakpahi a yi wami ɔ, lɛɛ yayami peeli nɛ li Mawu ɔ, mɛɛ kɛ a nyagbe maa hi kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: I ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ asafo mi nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ tsɔɔe kɛ je ye tsui mi tɔɔ kaa nyɛ nyɛmi asafo mi nɔkɔtɔma. Amanehlu nɛ Kristo na a, i yeɔ he odase, nɛ Kristo hɛ mi nyami nɛ Mawu ma je tsɔɔ nihi ɔ, imi hu ma na. I ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kaa

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: Mawu asafo ɔ nɛ e ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ saminya kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ lɛɔ e to kuu ɔ. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi, se pi kaa a nyɛ nyɛ nɔ kɛ pee. Nyɛ tsu ní, pi ngɛ hiɔwo nɛ nyɛ ma na a he, se mohu kaa nyɛ ná nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ he bua jɔmi. Bɔ nɛ Mawu to kaa nyɛɛ pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha nyɛ ke nyɛɛ hyɛ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko ye a nɔ; se mohu nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha Mawu asafo ɔ.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Nɛ ke to hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ba a, nyɛ nine maa su hɛ mi nyami jlasi nɛ maa hi kpɛe nylamnylam daa a nɔ.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu, nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ hu, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nikɔtɔma amɛ. Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ sibi kɛ he si bami. Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke, “Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, Mawu kɛ mɛ toɔ ní; se nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ, Mawu dlooɔ mɛ.”

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ haomi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ fɔ e nɔ; ejakaa lɛ nɛ e hyɛɛ nyɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si; nyɛɛ pee klaalo! Nyɛ he nyɛlɔ, Abosiami ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae, nɛ ngɛ nɔ ko hlae nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ e mi.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛɛ tsi lɛ blɔ. Ejakaa nyɛ le kaa nihi nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, mɛ hu kikɛmɛ a amanehlu nɛ ɔ nɔuu a ngɛ nae.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Mawu maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene. Amen. Nyagbe sɛ yemi

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ womi kpiti nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ gu Silvano nɔ. I buu wa nyɛmi nɛ ɔ saminya kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale. I ngɛ nyɛ he wami woe, nɛ i ngɛ nɔ mi mae ngɛ dee ke Mawu dloomi nitsɛnitsɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Babilon, nɛ lɛ hu Mawu hla mɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ. Ye bi Marko hu ke e biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ fua nyɛ sibi kɛ nga nyɛ he kaa nyɛmimɛ nɛ le Kristo. Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, nyɛ he manye!

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Imi Simon Petro, Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ, kɛ e bɔfo ɔ, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ yaa ha nihi nɛ a nine su hemi kɛ yemi nɛ he jua wa saminya kaa wɔ hu wa nɔ́ ɔ nɔ. Wa Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɛ ha mɛ kikɛmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ babauu ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ le Mawu, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo saminya. Mawu tsɛ wɔ, nɛ e hla wɔ

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Mawu ha wɔ níhi tsuo nɛ maa hia wɔ ɔ, konɛ waa ba wa jemi kaa Mawu jali nitsɛnitsɛmɛ. E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa wa le lɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ tsɛ wɔ kɛ gu lɛ nitsɛ e nyami, kɛ e mi mi himi ɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: E ha wɔ nike ní nguanguahi nɛ a he jua wa, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. Kɛ gu nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa tu je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ níhi nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ a nya fo, konɛ nyɛ na lɛ Mawu ɔ e su ɔ eko.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Kikɛmɛ a su nɛ ɔmɛ a he hia nyɛ, nɛ ke nyɛ na mɛ bɔ nɛ sa a, nyɛ ma tsu ní nɛ maa wo yiblii saminya, nɛ nyɛ he maa ba se nami, akɛnɛ nyɛ le wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ be ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ kɛ yɛ tsitsaa; e hɛ je nɔ kaa a tsukɔ e he kɛ je e sá yayami ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde, konɛ nyɛɛ ma nɔ mi kaa niinɛ, nihi nɛ Mawu tsɛ, nɛ e hla ji nyɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ be si gbee ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ nyɛ na a mi gblegbleegble.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ blɔ nɛ nyɛ maa sɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: E ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ le kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ momo, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ hu nyɛ pɛtɛ he lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ i to kaa ma ya nɔ ma hi nyɛ kaie ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, i susu kaa e sa kaa ma ya nɔ ma hɛli nyɛ si ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: I le kaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo je tsɔɔ mi ɔ.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Se ma bɔ mɔde ma to blɔ nya ha nyɛ, konɛ ye gbenɔ se ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ be tsuaa be. Nihi nɛ na Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Nɛ wa fiɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ke wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba ekohu kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, pi sanehi nɛ a po de nɔ nɛ wa da. Se wa na e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa hɛngmɛ.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ benɛ Tsɛ Mawu wo e hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, gbi pɛ kɛ je hɛ mi nyami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji ye Bi nɛ i suɔ, nɛ i naa e he tsui!”

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe, benɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa na kaa munyuhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tu ɔ ba mi niinɛ. Nyɛ hu ke nyɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛ bu tue ɔ, e maa hi ha nyɛ; ejakaa e ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ diblii mi kɛ yaa si je maa na, nɛ nɔkɔ la a ma kpɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Se enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e juɛmi kɛ tsɔɔ gbami ko sisi ngɛ ngmami ɔ mi.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Ejakaa gbami sɛ gbi ko bɛ hyɛ nɛ adesa po de kɛkɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya. Se mohu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ baa nihi a nɔ nɛ a tuɔ munyu kɛ jeɔ Mawu ngɔ.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Lakpa gbali te si ngɛ ma a mi be ko nɛ be ɔ, nɛ ja nɔuu lakpa tsɔɔli maa te si ngɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ kpɛti. A kɛ lakpa tsɔɔmihi nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi maa ba ngɛ laami mi. Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nitsɛ nɛ kpɔ mɛ ɔ po a ma kua lɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ a ma kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi si kake too.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Nihi babauu maa nyɛɛ a se kɛ yakayaka je mi bami, nɛ a he ɔ, nihi maa tu munyu kɛ si Kristo, kɛ e blɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Bɔfohi nɛ pee yayami ɔ, Mawu ngɔɛ a he ngɔ ki mɛ, se mohu e tsitsɛɛ mɛ ngɔ wo gbeje muɔ mi. A fi mɛ ngɔ wo diblii mi, nɛ a maa hi mlɛe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si kojomi ligbi ɔ.

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔɛ blema bi ɔmɛ a he ngɔ ki mɛ, se mohu e ngɔ nyu kpekpemi kɛ kpata yayami peeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Noa nɛ fiɛ ke a ye dami sane ɔ, e kɛ ni kpaago kpa komɛ pɛ lɛ Mawu he a yi wami.

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: Mawu gbla Sodom kɛ Gomora ma amɛ a tue. E ngɔ la kɛ kpata ma nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ to okadi kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba yayami peeli a nɔ.

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: Benɛ nɔmlɔ kpakpa nɛ ɔ ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, e naa, nɛ e nuɔ ní yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ a he; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao e tsui.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le bɔ nɛ e peeɔ nɛ e jeɔ nimli kpakpahi kɛ jeɔ ka mi. E le bɔ nɛ e peeɔ kɛ hii nimli yayamihi a tue gblae hluu kɛ yaa su kojomi ligbi ɔ tɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nihi pɔtɛɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya nyɛɛɔ he lo mi akɔnɔ yaya se, se Mawu mlaa a lɛɛ a bui. Kikɛmɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsui wa; a woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ nibɔ ní kpakpahi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe po a bui; se mohu a jɛɔ mɛ.

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a he wa, nɛ a hiɛ kulaa pe lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ tete po pui a nya, nɛ a jɛ we mɛ hulɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Se kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa pu mi lohwehi; a be juɛmi. A bɔ mɛ nɛ a nuu mɛ nɛ a gbe kɛkɛ; nɔ́ ko nɛ a nui sisi ɔ, a tuɔ he munyu yaya. A ma kpata a hɛ mi kaa pu mi lohwehi,

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: nɛ ní yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ, a maa na nɔ́ kɛ to nya. Piani ke a ngɛ yakayaka fiɛmihi fiɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ a bua jɔ; zotsɛmɛ kɛ ahluatsɛmɛ ji mɛ. Benɛ a futu nyɛ kɛ ngɛ ní yee ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo a ngɛ a yakayaka nyɛɛmi ɔmɛ nyɛɛe.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: A hɛngmɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ kpa ko kaa ja yihi yaholi pɛ. Pɔ tɔɛ mɛ kɛ yayami peemi. A sisiɔ nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ, nɛ a naa a he blɔ. A kase jiklɔɔ peemi, nɛ a le saminya. Mawu gbiɛ mɛ pɛ!

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: A je blɔ tlɔmɔɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a laa blɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Beor bi Balaam pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Balaam ya di se nami se, nɛ e kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ;

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: se a ka e hɛ mi ngɛ yayami nɛ e pee ɔ he. Gbalɔ ɔ teji ɔ pã e nya mi, nɛ e tu munyu kaa nɔmlɔ, nɛ e tsi godo ní tsumi nɛ gbalɔ ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma tsu ɔ nya.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa nyu vuhi nɛ nyu be a mi; a ngɛ kaa bɔkuhi nɛ ahumi ngɔ kɛ yaa. Mawu dla he ko ngɔ to mɛ ngɛ diblii nɛ mi ti mi.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Akɛnɛ nya puu munyu nguahi jeɔ a nya he je ɔ, a guu he lo akɔnɔ níhi a nɔ nɛ a kɛ ya sisiɔ nihi nɛ je si himi yaya nɛ dɛ blɔ mi kɛ́ we.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nihi na le wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tu je nɛ ɔ mi mu níhi a nya fo. Pee se, ke a ngɔ a he ya wo yayami mi ekohu, nɛ yayami ɔ ye a nɔ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nyagbe si himi ba peeɔ mɔbɔ kulaa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ po.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Afani nɔ́ nɛ a na we nɛ a le Kristo, pe nɛ a le lɛ, nɛ pee se ɔ, a je mlaa klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ a ha mɛ ɔ he.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ ba a nɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi niinɛ: “Gbe kpaleɔ kɛ yaa lɛ nitsɛ e vie he,” kɛ “Kpotoo nɛ a du ha lɛ ɔ kpaleɔ ya wuɔ mɔsɔ ekohu.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai munyuhi nɛ gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tu blema lokoo ɔ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wa kpɔlɔ ɔ mlaa nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha nyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Kekleekle ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nɔ he fɛu yeli komɛ maa ba, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a we akɔnɔ de mɛ ke a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ a maa pee.

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: A jeɔ blɔ peeɔ kaa a li kaa blema lokoo ɔ, munyu kɛkɛ lɛ Mawu tu, nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba ba, kaa a je zugba kɛ je nyu mi, nɛ nyu a kɛ bɔ zugba a.

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Nɛ nyu nɔuu, nyu kpekpemi ɔ a kɛ kpata jamɛ a be ɔ mi je ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Se hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, munyu nɛ je Mawu nya a nɔuu lɛ hɛɛ mɛ, konɛ a kɛ la nɛ ba kpata a hɛ mi hwɔɔ se. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a maa kojo nihi tsuo nɛ li Mawu, nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo si ke e maa pee ɔ, pi tsle nɛ e ngɛ toe ngɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ ngɛ susue ɔ; e tsui si kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ toe ha nyɛ. Ejakaa e sume nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hɛ mi nɛ kpata, se mohu nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsake e tsui.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ maa ba kaa bɔ nɛ julɔ baa a. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, hiɔwe maa be kɛ ho kɛ kemi nɛ nya wa. Níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ tsuo maa sã, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ je ɔ, kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa laa.

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: konɛ nyɛɛ hi Mawu ligbi ɔ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ nyɛɛ hi sɔlee nɛ e su mla. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, hiɔwe ma mle kɛ la, nɛ e maa sã, nɛ la a ma ha níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ tsuo maa sile.
