english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Se wa ngɛ hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he blɔ hyɛe kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a yeɔ dami sane ngɛ.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsui si tomi ɔ kaa he blɔ nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ nɛ a kɛ he nyɛ yi wami. Enɛ ɔ nɔuu wa suɔlɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Paulo hu ngma nyɛ kɛ nile nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: E tuɔ enɛ ɔmɛ a he munyu ngɛ womihi tsuo nɛ e ngma a a mi. Ní komɛ nɛ e de ɔ, a sisi numi yee, nɛ nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, kɛ ni komɛ hu nɛ a yi mi peeɔ mɛ enyɔɔnyɔ ɔ, tsɔɔ sisi ngɛ blɔ kpa nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ngmami kpa amɛ ɔ. Blɔ nɔ nɛ a guu kɛ kpataa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Se ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ le enɛ ɔ momo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi saminya, nɛ nihi nɛ bui mlaa a, a ní peemi ní yayami ɔmɛ kó gbla nyɛ se, nɛ nyɛ si nɛ nyɛ da a ko bɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ wa ngɛ dloomi ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ le wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo ɔ saminya. Á wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene! Amen.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ nyɛ munyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ ngmae. Munyu ɔ ngɛ kɛ je sisije. Wa nu, nɛ wa na kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa hɛngmɛ; ee, wa na lɛ, nɛ wa nine ta he.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Benɛ wami ɔ jé e he kpo ɔ, wa na lɛ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wa ngɛ odase yee, nɛ wa ngɛ jajee ke lɛ ji neneene wami ɔ nɛ. E kɛ Tsɛ ɔ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ wa na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa nu ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae. Wa ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee, konɛ nyɛ ba piɛ wa he, nɛ waa kɛ Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo ɔ nɛ bɔ huɛ.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Wa ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ ngmae, konɛ wa bua nɛ jɔ kɛ pi si. Mawu ji la

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, sɛ gbi nɛ wa nu kɛ je e Bi ɔ nya, nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ ji kaa Mawu su ngɛ kaa la, nɛ diblii ko kulaa be e mi.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa de ke waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ huɛ bɔe, se kɛ̃ wa ngɛ diblii ɔ mi ɔ, wa ngɛ lakpa yee; munyu nɛ jeɔ wa nya, kɛ wa ní peemi tsuo anɔkuale be mi.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Se ke wa ba wa je mi saminya ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ e su ngɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ waa kɛ wa sibi ngɛ huɛ bɔe. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e Bi Yesu Kristo muɔ ɔ maa tsukɔ wa he, nɛ e ma je wa he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ke wa de ke yayami ko be wa he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wa ngɛ sisie; nɛ Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ be wa mi.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ke wa ke wa pee we yayami ɔ, lɛɛ wa ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa Mawu mohu ji lakpatsɛ; nɛ Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ be wa mi.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, konɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami. Se ke nɔ ko pee yayami pohu ɔ, wa ngɛ nɔ nɛ daa mi kɛ haa wɔ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ. Lɛ ji Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Nɛ Kristo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ a kɛ pee kpatami kɛ je wa he yayami ɔmɛ; pi wɔ kɛkɛ, se je ɔ tsuo he yayami.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Ke wa yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ waa kɛ naa anɔkuale mi kaa wa le lɛ.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ke e le Mawu, se e yi e mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ; e tu we anɔkuale.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu anɔkuale mi. Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ maa le kaa niinɛ, waa kɛ Mawu ngɛ huɛ bɔe.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ deɔ ke e ngɛ Mawu mi ɔ, e ba e je mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo ba e je mi ɔ. Mlaa he ɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, mlaa nɛ i ngɛ ngmae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, pi mlaa he; mlaa momo ɔ nɛ nyɛ ná kɛ je sisije ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu. Sɛ gbi nɛ nyɛ nu momo ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji mlaa momo ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, mlaa nɛ i ngɛ ngmae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, mlaa he, ejakaa a naa e we anɔkuale ɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ e tsu ní ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ. Diblii ɔ ngɛ bee kɛ yaa, nɛ la nitsɛ ɔ bɔni kpɛmi momo.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko de ke e ngɛ Kristo mi, se e sume e nyɛmi ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi, kɛ mwɔɔ.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ Kristo mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e he nɛ ma ha nɔ ko nane ma kpata.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi nyɛɛe nɛ́ e li he nɛ e yaa. Ejakaa diblii ɔ yu e hɛ.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa Kristo he ɔ, a ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Tsaatsɛmɛ! I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. Nihewi! I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ le Tsɛ ɔ. Tsaatsɛmɛ! I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. Nihewi! I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ he wa; Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ko suɔ je ɔ, loo níhi nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ. Ke nɔ ko suɔ je ɔ, lɛɛ e sume Tsɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, je ɔ mi e je. Níhi nɛ he lo ɔ dii se, níhi nɛ hɛngmɛ dii se, kɛ níhi nɛ nihi fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ tsuo je je nɛ ɔ mi; ekoeko ji Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Je ɔ, kɛ e mi níhi nɛ peeɔ nɔ akɔnɔ ɔ ngɛ bee kɛ yaa. Se nɔ nɛ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene. Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, nyagbe be ɔ su ta! A de nyɛ ke Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ ma; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Kristo he nyɛli fuu ba momo. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wa le kaa nyagbe ɔ su ta.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Anɔkuale mi ɔ, pi wa kpɛti nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je; nɛ lɔ ɔ he je nɛ a si wɔ ɔ nɛ. Kaa wa kpɛti nɛ a je jinɛ a kɛ wɔ ko hi si. Se a si wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e fɔ si paa kaa a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ wɔ bɔɛ.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, Kristo ha nyɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ le anɔkuale ɔ.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Pi kaa anɔkuale ɔ nɛ nyɛ li nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae. Dɛbi! Akɛnɛ nyɛ le anɔkuale ɔ, lɔ ɔ he mohu nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi ɔ ngmae ɔ nɛ; nɛ nyɛ le hu kaa anɔkuale ɔ, lakpa be mi.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji lakpatsɛ? Ee, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ deɔ ke pi Yesu ji Kristo ɔ, lɛ ji lakpatsɛ ɔ nɛ. Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ji Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ; e kua Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Bi ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kua Bi ɔ, e kua Tsɛ ɔ hulɔ. Se nɔ nɛ ma he Bi ɔ, e he Tsɛ ɔ hulɔ.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je sisije ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ. Ke nyɛ pɛtɛ jamɛ a sɛ gbi ɔ he wawɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ maa hi Bi ɔ, kɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi daa.

english_verse: The Son has promised us eternal life.
translation_verse: Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ Kristo nitsɛ wo wɔ he si ɔ ji neneene wami.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae ngɛ nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a puɛ nyɛ tue ɔ a he.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ Kristo ha e mumi ɔ ba nyɛ nɔ. Be abɔ nɛ e mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ɔ, e hia we nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ba tsɔɔ nyɛ ní. Ejakaa mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ tsɔɔe; nɛ anɔkuale ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ, pi lakpa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue, konɛ nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi Kristo mi.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi Kristo mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke e je e he kpo ɔ, wa nɔ gbagba nɛ te. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ e maa ba a, zo be wɔ gbee ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Tse nyɛ le kaa Kristo ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ da e peeɔ. Lɛɛ e hia kaa nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu bi ji lɛ.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ hyɛ suɔmi sɔuu nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ, kaa e ma tsɛ wɔ e bimɛ; niinɛ Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, je ɔ li wɔ, ejakaa lɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ hu je ɔ li lɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ, se bɔ nɛ wa ma plɛ hwɔɔ se ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ wa li lolo. Nɔ́ nɛ wa le kɛkɛ ji kaa ke Kristo je e he kpo ɔ, wa maa hi kaa lɛ; ejakaa wa maa na lɛ paa kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tutuutu.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ kaa e ngɛ Mawu mlaa nɔ tɔe, ejakaa yayami ji mlaa nɔ tɔmi.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, e pee we yayami hu. Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e nɛ Kristo, nɛ e li lɛ hulɔ.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami lɛɛ Abosiami bi ji lɛ, ejakaa kɛ je sisije tɔɔ nɛ Abosiami bɔni yayami peemi. Enɛ ɔ he tutuutu nɛ Mawu Bi ɔ ba a nɛ, konɛ níhi nɛ Abosiami tsu ɔ, e ba kpata lɛ tsuo hɛ mi.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e yɛ nɔ nɛ e hii yayami pee, ejakaa e hɛɛ Mawu su nitsɛnitsɛ. Nɛ akɛnɛ Mawu bi ji lɛ he je ɔ, e be nyɛe maa pee yayami.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Slɔɔto titli nɛ ngɛ Mawu bimɛ, kɛ Abosiami bimɛ a kpɛti ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ da, aloo nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi ɔ, pi Mawu bi ji lɛ. Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ ji kaa waa suɔ wa sibi.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Wa ko pee kaa bɔ nɛ Kain pee ɔ; ejakaa Abosiami mumi ngɛ e mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi Habel. Mɛni he je Kain gbe e nyɛmi ɔ? Ejakaa níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ, ní ɔmɛ dɛ, se e nyɛmi ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ da.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi ko pee nyɛ yaa.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa wa be kaa ni gbogboehi hu, se wa je gbenɔ mi kɛ ba wami mi, ejakaa wa suɔ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ gbenɔ mi.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko be neneene wami nae.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Kristo ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he. Kɛ gu enɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa na bɔ nɛ suɔmi tsuɔ ní ha. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa wɔ hu waa ngɔ wa wami ngɔ ha ngɛ wa nyɛmimɛ a he.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ní, nɛ e na e nyɛmi nɛ e fi lɛ, se e mi mi sãã we lɛ ngɛ e nyɛmi ɔ he nɛ e ye bua lɛ ɔ, anɛ e ma nyɛ de ke e suɔ Mawu lo?

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ maa le kaa wa ngɛ Mawu anɔkualetsɛ ɔ blɔ fa mi, nɛ wa he nile be wɔ fɔ bue ngɛ e hɛ mi.

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: Se ke wa he nile buɔ wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa le kaa Mawu kle pe wa he nile ɔ, nɛ e le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hulɔ.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa he nile bui wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa yi gbeye kaa wa maa ya Mawu hɛ mi.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa bi lɛ ɔ, e haa wɔ, ejakaa wa yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ wa peeɔ níhi nɛ sa e hɛ mi.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ e fa wɔ ke waa pee ji kaa wa he e Bi Yesu Kristo waa ye, nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo fa wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, e hii Mawu mi, nɛ Mawu hu hii e mi. Nɛ mumi ɔ nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ he je ɔ, wa le kaa Mawu ngɛ wa mi.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ ko he nɔ tsuaa nɔ ko kɛkɛ nɛ deɔ ke e ná Mawu mumi ɔ nyɛɛ ye. Se mohu nyɛɛ ka nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa mumi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ je Mawu ngɔ lo. Ejakaa je ɔ hyi tɔ kɛ lakpa gbali sɔuu.

english_verse: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma yo Mawu mumi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa jaje kaa Yesu Kristo ba je ɔ mi kaa adesa a, mumi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ ngɛ e mi.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Se nɔ nɛ jajeɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a de ngɛ Yesu he nɛ ɔ be mi ɔ, e mumi ɔ ji Mawu ngɔ. Mumi nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ je Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ ngɔ. Nyɛ nu kaa e ma, pi jã? Ee, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ná ba je ɔ mi momo.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu níhi ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye lakpa gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi. Ejakaa mumi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, e he wa kulaa pe mumi nɛ ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kɛ je ɔ ngɛ bɔe ɔ a mi.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a lakpa gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, munyu nɛ kɔɔ je nɛ ɔ mi níhi a he nɛ a tuɔ. Nɛ je ɔ buɔ mɛ tue, ejakaa je ɔ mi nɛ a je.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu níhi ji wɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le Mawu ɔ, e buɔ wɔ tue; nihi nɛ kɛ Mawu be ɔ, mɛɛ a bui wɔ tue. Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ naa slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ anɔkuale mumi ɔ, kɛ lakpa mumi ɔ a kpɛti. Mawu ɔ suɔmi ji lɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Nyɛ ha waa suɔ wa sibi, ejakaa suɔmi ɔ, Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ, nɛ e le Mawu.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sume nɔmlɔ ɔ, e li Mawu; ejakaa Mawu ɔ, suɔmi ji lɛ.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ suɔmi ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: pi wɔ nɛ wa sɛ hlami kɛ suɔ Mawu; Mawu mohu lɛ suɔ wɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ e Bi ɔ kɛ ba, konɛ e ba dla waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti, nɛ a ngɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa wɔ.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ Mawu suɔ wɔ ɔ, wɔ hu e sa kaa waa suɔ wa sibi.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ lɛ hyɛ. Se ke wa suɔ wa sibi ɔ, Mawu hii wa mi, nɛ suɔmi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi waa.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Mawu ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e mumi ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ. Nɛ enɛ ɔ waa kɛ na kaa niinɛ, Mawu ngɛ wa mi; nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ e mi.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Wa na enɛ ɔ, nɛ wa ngɛ odase yee kaa Tsɛ ɔ tsɔ e Bi ɔ kɛ ba kaa je ɔ yi wami helɔ.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jajeɔ paa kaa Yesu ɔ, Mawu Bi ji lɛ ɔ, Mawu hii e mi, nɛ lɛ hu e hii Mawu mi.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Suɔmi nɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa le, nɛ wa ji he nɔ́. Mawu ɔ, suɔmi ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔmlɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo ɔ, e hii Mawu mi, nɛ Mawu hu hii e mi.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Suɔmi nɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi wa wawɛɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ, wa ko ye gbeye. Ejakaa wa je mi bami ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo nitsɛ ba e je mi.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: He nɛ suɔmi ngɛ ɔ, gbeye yemi be lejɛ ɔ; suɔmi nɛ mi wa a fieɔ gbeye tsuo kɛ yaa se. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ gbeye ɔ, Mawu suɔmi nɛ mi wa a be e mi. Ejakaa gbeye yemi, kɛ tue gblami lɛ nyɛɛɔ.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Wa suɔ Mawu, ejakaa lɛ nɛ suɔ wɔ kekle.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ke e suɔ Mawu, se e nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ. Ejakaa nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi nɛ e naa kɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e maa suɔ Mawu nɛ e nɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Mlaa nɛ Kristo wo wɔ ji nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu ɔ, e sa kaa e suɔ e nyɛmi hulɔ.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔ ko tsɛ ɔ, e suɔ nɔ ɔ bi hulɔ.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Ejakaa ke wa suɔ Mawu ɔ, wa yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Nɛ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi wɛ kulaa,

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: ejakaa Mawu bimɛ tsuo ma nyɛ maa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi; ee, wa hemi kɛ yemi waa kɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ kunimi.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi? Ja nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ɔ, Mawu Bi ji lɛ. Yesu Kristo he odase

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Benɛ Yesu Kristo ba a, a sɔle lɛ kɛ nyu, nɛ e plɛ e muɔ ngɔ pue si, nɛ e gbo. Pi nyu ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ ba, se nyu kɛ muɔ tsuo. Nɛ mumi ɔ nitsɛ yeɔ odase kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ mi, ejakaa mumi ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Odase yeli etɛ lɛ ngɛ;

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: mumi ɔ, kɛ nyu ɔ, kɛ muɔ ɔ; nɛ nɔ́ etɛ ɔmɛ tsuo yeɔ odase kake too ɔ.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Wa heɔ adesa we odase yeɔ, se Mawu we odase ɔ mi jiɔ kulaa pe adesa nɔ́. Nɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ lɛ ye odase nɛ ɔ ngɛ e Bi ɔ he.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ ngɔɔ odase nɛ ɔ kɛ toɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tsui mi, nɛ e hii he susue. Se nɔ nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ ha nɛ Mawu plɛ lakpatsɛ; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de ngɛ e Bi ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ɔ he we yi.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Odase ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Mawu ha wɔ neneene wami kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Bi ɔ, e ngɛ wami; nɔ nɛ be Mawu Bi ɔ, e be wami hulɔ. Neneene wami

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, konɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ ngɛ neneene wami.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Wa yi gbeye ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, ejakaa wa le kaa ke waa kɛ juɛmi kpakpa bi lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, e buɔ wɔ tue.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔ, e ji yayami; se yayami ngɛ nɛ ha we nɛ nɔ hɛ mi kpataa.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e bua jɔɛ yayami peemi he. Ejakaa Mawu Bi ɔ baa e yi, nɛ Abosiami na we e he blɔ.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Mawu níhi ji wɔ, pohu je ɔ, Abosiami lɛ ngɛ nɔ yee.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Wa le kaa Mawu Bi ɔ ba, nɛ e ba bli wa juɛmi nya, konɛ waa le anɔkuale Mawu ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, waa kɛ anɔkuale Mawu ɔ ngɛ, ejakaa wa ngɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo ɔ mi. Lɛ ji anɔkuale Mawu ɔ nɛ, nɛ enɛ ɔ ji neneene wami.

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: Imi nɔkɔtɔma a, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo awenyɛ nɛ a hla mo ɔ, kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ akɛnɛ nyɛ hɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi ɔ. Pi imi nɔ kake too nɛ i suɔ nyɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ suɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: Ejakaa anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ wa mi, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ kɛ wɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Tsɛ ɔ Bi Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si ngɛ anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi mi. Anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: I na bua jɔmi babauu, benɛ i nu kaa o bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ baa a je mi ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ nya kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ fa wɔ ke waa pee ɔ.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, awenyɛ nɛ i suɔ! I kpa mo pɛɛ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi. Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, pi mlaa he, se mohu mlaa a nɛ a wo wɔ kɛ je sisije ɔ.

english_verse: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
translation_verse: Suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ he munyu tue ɔ tsɔɔ kaa waa ye Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ, mlaa a ji kaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Sisili fuu ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he. Mɛ ji nihi nɛ kplɛɛ we kaa Yesu Kristo ba je ɔ mi kaa nɔmlɔ adesa. Nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji sisili, kɛ Kristo he nyɛli ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he saminya, konɛ ní nɛ wa tsu ɔ, nyɛ ko je mi dɛ gu; se mohu nyɛ ná hiɔwo nɛ sa.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa je Kristo sane kpakpa a se ya tsɔɔ nɔ́ kpa a, e li Mawu. Nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ sane kpakpa a pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ le Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Bi ɔ tsuo.

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ke nɔ ko ha lɛ hɛ mi ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa e kɛ lɛ peeɔ kake kɛ tsuɔ ní yayamihi. Nyagbe sɛ yemi

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: I ngɛ níhi fuu nɛ ma ngma nyɛ mohu, se i sume kaa i kɛ ningma nyu ngmaa ngɔ fɔ womi hɛ mi. Mohu ɔ, i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa ma ba slaa nyɛ. Ke i ba a, i kɛ nyɛ maa sɛɛ ní hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, nɛ wa ma na bua jɔmi babauu.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ nyɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ ke a biɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Imi nɔkɔtɔma a, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Gayo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya kɛ ye tsui tsuo ɔ.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmi nɛ i suɔ, i ngɛ kue fae ha Mawu, nɛ o ya nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi. O hi gblagblaagbla ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi kaa bɔ nɛ i le nɛ o ngɛ mumi mi he wami ɔ.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: I na bua jɔmi babauu benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ba bɔ mi amaniɛ ngɛ o he ɔ. A tsɔɔ kaa o ngɔ o he ngɔ ha Mawu kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Nɔ́ nɛ peeɔ mi bua jɔmi pe kulaa ji kaa ma nu kaa ye bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ nya. A jé Gayo yi

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmi nɛ i suɔ saminya! Dengme nɛ o ngɛ gboe ngɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he, titli nibwɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, o tsui tsuo o kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔ tsue.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: A ba ye suɔmi nɛ o ngɛ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ he odase ha asafo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o wo mɛ blɔ saminya bɔ nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi nɛ a kɛ tsa a blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Ejakaa blɔ nɛ a hia nɛ ɔ, Kristo ní tsumi a ngɛ tsue, nɛ a he we nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ a dɛ mi yemi kɛ buami ko kulaa.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nɛ wa le Kristo ɔ, e hia kaa waa ye kɛ bua nimli nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ waa piɛ a he kɛ tsu anɔkuale ɔ he ní tsumi ɔ. Diotrefe kɛ Demetrio

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: I ngma womi kpiti ko ngɔ mane asafo ɔ. Se Diotrefe, nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e pee e he nɔkɔtɔma a bui mi kulaa.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i ba a, lakpa munyuhi nɛ e ngɛ tue ngɛ wa he ɔ, ma wo nɔ ta, konɛ nyɛɛ na nihi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ. Se enɛ ɔ tete pi ha lɛ. Ke nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ɔ, e he we mɛ atuu. Asafo ɔ mi bi komɛ nɛ mɛɛ a suɔ kaa a ma he nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ atuu po, e tsiɔ a nya; nɛ e hlaa kaa e fie mɛ kɛ je asafo ɔ mi!

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Ye nyɛmi nɛ i suɔ! Ko ya wo nihi nɛ peeɔ ní yayamihi a nane; moo kase nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa mohu. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, Mawu nɔ́ ji lɛ; nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e li Mawu.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Demetrio lɛɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa; nɛ jã nɔuu nɛ anɔkuale ɔ nitsɛ hu tsɔɔ. Wɔ hu wa ngɛ e he odase yee ja nɔuu, nɛ nyɛ le kaa anɔkuale wa ngɛ tue. Nyagbe sɛ yemi

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: I ngɛ níhi fuu nɛ ma ngma mo, se i sume kaa i kɛ ningma tso kɛ ningma nyu ngmaa.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: Mohu ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma na mo, nɛ wa maa sɛɛ ní hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: I ngɛ he jɔmi bae ha mo. O huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ke a biɔ mo. Nga wa huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kakaaka ha wɔ.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Imi Yuda, Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ, kɛ Yakobo nyɛminyumu ɔ, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ya ha Kristo se nyɛɛli tsuo, nihi nɛ Tsɛ Mawu suɔ, nɛ e hla mɛ, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to ha Yesu Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Mɔbɔ nami, suɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ babauu ha nyɛ. Lakpa tsɔɔli

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa ni komɛ nɛ li Mawu ju si ba sɛ wa kpɛti. Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ dloomi nɛ Mawu dloo wɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ plɛ hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kɛ laa a yakayaka ní peemi ɔmɛ a nɔ. Yesu Kristo, wa Tsɔɔlɔ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kake too ɔ hu a kua lɛ. Blema lokoo lɛ ngmami ɔmɛ de to kaa a ma kpata nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: Nyɛ le enɛ ɔ momo lɛɛ, se i suɔ kaa ma kai nyɛ. Benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ jé Israel bi ɔmɛ si kake nyɔngloo kɛ je Egipt se ɔ, e kpata ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ a hɛ mi.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai Mawu bɔfohi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya sa a, nɛ pee se ɔ, a tsɔ atuã kɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a si himi he ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ fi mɛ, nɛ Mawu ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to gbogboehi a je ngɛ diblii nɛ mi ti mi. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ a maa hi hluu kɛ yaa si ligbi ngua a maa su, nɛ a maa kojo mɛ.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kai Sodom kɛ Gomora, kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe ɔ. Ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ fiɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ yayahi a se kaa bɔ nɛ jamɛ a bɔfo ɔmɛ pee ɔ nɔuu. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tue gblami ji kaa a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo la nɛ gbo we mi, konɛ a pee okadi kɛ ha nihi tsuo.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Jã nɔuu lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ hu bleɔ he lo ɔ; a teɔ si kɛ siɔ Mawu nɔ yemi ɔ, nɛ a jɛɔ ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ po.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Mawu bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Mikael tete po pee we enɛ ɔ. Benɛ e kɛ Abosiami pɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ sã nya kaa mɛnɔ lɛ sa kaa e ngɔ Mose flɔ̃ ɔ, Mikael jɛ we Abosiami; e yi e he fɛu hulɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ e de lɛ ji, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ka o hɛ mi!”

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Se nimli nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a nui sisi ɔ, a tuɔ he munyu yaya. Se níhi nɛ a nuɔ he kaa pu mi lohwehi nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a susuu we yi mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu ji níhi nɛ kpataa a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Musu tloo mɛ pɛ! A ya ngɔ Kain blɔ ɔ. Yayami nɛ Balaam pee ɔ, a ngɔ a he ya wo jamɛ a yayami ɔ mi ngɛ se nami he. A tsɔ atuã kaa bɔ nɛ Kora tsɔ atuã a, nɛ a hɛ mi kpata kaa lɛ.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba futu nyɛ kɛ ngɛ suɔmi niye ní yee ɔ, a woɔ ní ɔ he mu. A yeɔ ní tsuatsuaatsua nɛ a susuu we ni kpahi a he. A ngɛ kaa bɔku nɛ nyu be mi nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ fiae kɛ bee. A ngɛ kaa tsohi nɛ ní kpami be po a nɛ yiblii ngɛ a nɔ; tsohi nɛ gbo, nɛ a hia mɛ kɛ sipoku tsuo ngɔ fɔ si.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Henok, Adam nina tutuutu ekpane ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e gba blema lokoo ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma kɛ e bɔfo klɔuklɔuhi akpeakpe abɔ.

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: E maa kojo nimli tsuo; nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ, e maa gbla a tue bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ musu bɔmi munyuhi nɛ a tu kɛ si Mawu ɔ a he.”

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kai níhi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔmɛ de to ɔ.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: A de ke, “Nyagbe be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi maa ba nɛ a maa ye nyɛ he fɛu; a maa pee ní yayamihi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsui suɔ.”

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nimli nɛ kɛ mi gbami baa a nɛ. A he lo ɔ lɛ yeɔ a nɔ; a be mumi ɔ.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Se nyɛ ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi klɔuklɔu ɔ mi wawɛɛ nɛ nyɛ nane nɛ pi si ngɛ mi. Nyɛɛ sɔle ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami ɔ nya.

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo blɔ hyɛe nɛ e ba na nyɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ha nyɛ neneene wami ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya. Kɛkɛ ɔ, suɔmi nɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ maa hi si daa.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi mi peeɔ mɛ sikɔsikɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ na mɛ mɔbɔ;

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: nyɛ je ni komɛ hu kɛ je la a mi; nyɛɛ na ni kpa komɛ hu mɔbɔ nɛ gbeye yemi ngɛ mi. Se tadehi nɛ a wo ɔ tete po nyɛɛ hie; ejakaa a kɛ he lo akɔnɔ wo he mu. Yi jemi sɔlemi

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: lɛ Mawu kake too, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ, a gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami. E nɔ́ ji agboje, kɛ he wami, kɛ he blɔ kɛ je blema lokoo kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ yaa neneene tɔɔ! Amen.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Níhi nɛ Yohane na a, e ye lɛ tsuo he odase ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Enɛ ɔ ji sɛ gbi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, kɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo je tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Imi Yohane nɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha asafo kpaago ɔmɛ ngɛ Asia. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Mawu, nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je blema, nɔ nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa ba a dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ. Jehanɛ ɔ, mumi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ,

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: kɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale odase ɔ, nɛ lɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ Mawu tle si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ lɛ nɛ e yeɔ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ dloo nyɛ, nɛ e ha nyɛ he jɔmi ja nɔuu. Nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ kpɔ wɔ kɛ je wa he yayami ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.

translation_verse: Imi nyɛ nyɛmi Yohane lɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ. Kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ɔ, a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kaa nyɛ nɔuu. english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ, mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe wawɛɛ kaa titimati ngɛ ye se.

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: Gbi ɔ de ke, “Ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ o na a ngɔ wo womi mi, nɛ o kɛ mane asafohi nɛ ngɛ ma kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ a mi: Efeso, Smirna, Pergamo, Tiatira, Sarde, Filadelfia, kɛ Laodikea.”

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Benɛ i na lɛ ɔ, i nɔ si ngɛ e nane nya kaa nɔ gbogboe. Se e ngɔ e hiɔ nine ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, “Koo ye gbeye! Imi ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no.

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ o na nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ o na ngɛ ye hiɔ nine mi, kɛ sika tsu kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, laami sane nɛ kɔɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ daa si ha asafo kpaago ɔmɛ a bɔfohi, nɛ kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ daa si ha asafo kpaago ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Nɛ e de ke, “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Efeso asafo ɔ nya a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Nɔ nɛ hɛɛ dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi, nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ sika tsu kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, sɛ gbi nɛ je e ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ, dengme nɛ o gboɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ o toɔ o tsui si. I le hu kaa o ha we yayami peeli hɛ mi. Nihi nɛ tsɛɔ a he bɔfohi, se pi bɔfohi ji mɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ o ka mɛ, nɛ o na kaa lakpatsɛmɛ ji mɛ ɔ, i le lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: O toɔ tsui si; o naa amanehlu ngɛ ye he nɛ pɔ tɔɛ mo.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane ko. O sume mi hu kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi sa a.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hɛli o he si ngɛ nɔ nɛ mi nɛ o gbee si ngɛ ɔ he. Mo tsake o tsui, nɛ o hi si kaa kekle ɔ. Ke o tsakee we o tsui ɔ, ma ba o ngɔ, nɛ ma ba je o kane tso ɔ kɛ je e ma he ɔ.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ́ kake nɛ o pee nɛ hi ji kaa ní nɛ Nikolai bi ɔmɛ ngɛ tsue ɔ, o nyɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i nyɛɛ ɔ nɔuu.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue! “Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ha mɛ blɔ nɛ a maa ye tso nɛ haa nɔ wami nɛ ngɛ Mawu abɔɔ ɔ mi ɔ yiblii.” Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Smirna a

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Nɛ e de ke, “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Smirna a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Sɛ gbi nɛ je nɔ nɛ ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no ɔ ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; e gbo, nɛ e kpale ba wami mi ekohu.

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: I le o haomi ɔmɛ! I le kaa nɔ́ ko be o dɛ lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, niatsɛ ji mo. Nihi nɛ deɔ ke Yuda bi ji mɛ, pohu e be mi ja a, ní yayahi nɛ a deɔ ngɛ o he ɔ, i le lɛ tsuo. Abosiami jali a kuu ji mɛ!

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Koo ye amanehlu nɛ ma o nɔ ɔ gbeye! Hyɛ! Abosiami miɔ nɛ e maa wo nyɛ ti ni komɛ tsu, konɛ a kɛ ka nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ maa na nɔ́ ligbi nyɔngma. Ye mi anɔkuale kɛ yaa si gbenɔ mi tete po, nɛ ma ha mo wami kaa kunimi nɛ o ye ɔ he jlasi.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue. “Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ be mɛ nae. Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Pergamo ɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Pergamo ɔ, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Sɛ gbi nɛ je nɔ nɛ ngɛ klaate nya enyɔtsɛ nɛ nya ba a ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: I le o hi he ɔ kaa Abosiami matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Se o pɛtɛ ye biɛ he. Nɛ benɛ a gbe Antipa tete po ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o ngɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ, o ngmɛɛ we he. Niinɛ, Antipa ye ye he odase nɛ e ye mi anɔkuale. Nɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ e ngɛ fiɛe ɔ he je ɔ, a gbe lɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ he nɛ Abosiami ngɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane bɔɔ ko. Ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ya wo Balaam tsɔɔmi ɔ. Balam lɛ tsɔɔ Balak kaa e tsɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ klama nɛ a ye wɔ nya lo, nɛ a fiɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Ja nɔuu ni komɛ hu ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ a hɛɛ Nikolai bi ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ mi.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo tsake o tsui! Ke pi ja a, ma ba o ngɔ be kpiti. Ma ngɔ klaate nɛ ngɛ ye nya mi ɔ, nɛ i kɛ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ maa hwu ta.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue! “Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ha mɛ mana nɛ a kɛ laa a eko. english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Tiatira a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Mawu Bi ɔ, nɔ nɛ e hɛngmɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa la, nɛ e nane hu ngɛ kpɛe kaa ayawa nɛ a tsu he ɔ, sɛ gbi nɛ je e ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ; i le o suɔmi, o hemi kɛ yemi, bɔ nɛ o sɔmɔɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ o toɔ o tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ nami mi. I le kaa o ngɛ ní tsue amlɔ nɛ ɔ kulaa pe kekle ɔ po.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane. O ngmɛ blɔ nɛ Yezebel, jamɛ a yo ɔ nɛ tsɛɔ e he gbalɔ ɔ ngɛ ye ma a ní tsɔɔe. E kɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ sisi mɛ, nɛ a ya ngɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi fiɛe; nɛ a ngɛ wɔ nya ní hu yee.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: I ha lɛ be, konɛ e kɛ tsake e tsui, se e sume kaa e ma kpa e yakayaka nyɛɛmi ɔ.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ma gbe e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ hulɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, asafo ɔmɛ tsuo maa na kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ le adesahi tsuo a juɛmi, kɛ a tsui mi. Ma wo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu ɔ he.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: “Se nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ Tiatira a, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛ we tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ se; nɔ́ nɛ ni kpa amɛ tsɛɔ Abosiami laami sanehi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ hu, nyɛ kase we. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, i hla we nɔ́ kpa ko ngɛ nyɛ dɛ

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: kaa nyɛɛ pɛtɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ he wawɛɛ kɛ yaa si ma ba.

english_verse: I will give each of them the same power my Father has given me. They will rule the nations with an iron rod and smash those nations to pieces like clay pots. I will also give them the morning star.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi, ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ya nɔ maa pee ye suɔmi nya ní kɛ yaa si nyagbe ɔ, he blɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɔ ha mi ɔ, imi hu ma ha mɛ. Ma ha nɛ a maa ye je ma amɛ a nɔ kɛ kɔni si wami, nɛ a ma tsɔtslɔɔ a mi kaa buɛ nɛ ywia tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ. Nɛ ma ha mɛ dodoe nɛ a tsɛɛ nɔkɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Sarde ɔ, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mumi kpaago ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e hɛɛ dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, sɛ gbi nɛ je e ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. I le ní nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ. I le kaa o he biɛ kaa nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ, pohu o gbo.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tee si, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o dɛ kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ, wo lɛ he wami. Ejakaa ní nɛ o tsu ɔ, i nɛ kaa e hi kɛ pi si lolo ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaii nɔ́ nɛ a tsɔɔ mo, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ o nu ɔ. Bu tue, nɛ o tsake o tsui. Ke o pee we ja a, ma ba na mo tlukaa kaa julɔ be mi nɛ o hɛ be o he nɔ.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o ngɛ nihi bɔɔ ko ngɛ Sarde, nihi nɛ wui a tade ɔmɛ mu. Mɛɛ a maa wo nɔ́ hiɔ, nɛ a kɛ mi maa nyɛɛ, ejakaa a sa ja.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, a maa wo ní hiɔ ha mɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ i be a biɛ gbee ngɛ hɛ kali a womi ɔ mi. Nɛ ma jaje ngɛ Tsaatsɛ kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi paa kaa ye nihi ji mɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue! Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Filadelfia a

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Filadelfia a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Sɛ gbi nɛ je nɔ klɔuklɔu nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Lɛ nɛ e hɛɛ David safe ɔ nɛ. Ke e bli sinya a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga; nɛ ke e nga a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma bli.

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ. I le kaa o he wɛ tsɔ; se o yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ o yeɔ mi anɔkuale. Hyɛ, i bli sinya ko ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Hyɛ! Ni ɔmɛ nɛ je Abosiami jali a kuu ɔ mi ɔ, lakpatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ deɔ ke Yuda bi ji mɛ, pohu e be mi ja a, nɔ́ nɛ ma pee mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ma ha nɛ a maa ba nɛ a ma ba kpla si ngɛ o nane nya. Nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma na le kaa i suɔ mo.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: I ma nɔuu! Nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o dɛ ɔ, pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ, konɛ jlasi nɛ o ma na, ke o ye kunimi ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ ko kpɔ ngɛ o dɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee titima ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e be lejɛ ɔ jee gblegbleegble. Ma ngma ye Mawu ɔ biɛ, kɛ ye Mawu ɔ ma, Yerusalem he ɔ biɛ ngɛ e he. Ma he nɛ ɔ maa je ye Mawu ɔ ngɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ba. Jehanɛ, ma ngma ye biɛ he ɔ hu ngɛ e he.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!” Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea a

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Laodikea a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Sɛ gbi nɛ je Amen, odase ɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Lɛ ji níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ sisije.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ. I le kaa o be yluduu, nɛ o be kalakala hulɔ. I ná nɛ o ngɛ yluduu, loo kalakala!

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Se akɛnɛ o ngɛ kulɔkulɔ, akɛnɛ o be yluduu, nɛ o be kalakala hu he je ɔ, ma sú mo ngɔ pue he kaa a suɔ lada.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: O deɔ ke, ‘I na ní kpɔtɔɔ; i plɔke, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi!’ Se o li tete kaa o ngɛ dengme mi, nɛ o ní ngɛ mɔbɔ! O li kaa ohiatsɛ ji mo! O li kaa o hɛɛ o he gu, nɛ o hɛngmɛ hu yu!

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo ga woe nɛ o ba he sika tsu ngɛ ye dɛ; ee, ba he sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ngɛ ye dɛ, konɛ o na ní. He ní hiɔ hu nɛ o wo, nɛ a ko na kaa o hɛɛ o he gu, ejakaa e ngɛ zo. Jehanɛ, he tsopa nɛ o nga ngɔ pue o hɛngmɛ nɔ, konɛ o hyɛ nɔ́.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ i suɔ mɛ ɔ, i kaa a hɛ mi, nɛ i gblaa a tue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o hɛ nɛ dɔ, nɛ o tsake o tsui.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Hyɛ, i daa si ngɛ sinya a se, nɛ i ngɛ sie. Ke nɔ ko nu ye gbi nɛ e bli sinya a, ma sɛ mi, nɛ i kɛ lɛ maa ye ní, nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ mi maa ye ní.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ha mɛ blɔ nɛ a maa hi ye kasa nya ngɛ ye matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ye kunimi, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i hii si ngɛ Tsaatsɛ kasa nya ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue.”

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na nina kpa. I na nɛ a bli sinya ko ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ hiɔwe. Nɛ gbi ɔ nɛ i nu nɛ pɛ kaa titimati, nɛ e kɛ mi ba tu munyu be ko ɔ de ke, “Ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo níhi nɛ maa ba mi be kpiti mi.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Amlɔ ɔ, mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ. Nɛ hyɛ, matsɛ sɛ ko ji nɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ nɔ ko hii si ngɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Nɔ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa yaspi kɛ sardi tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa. Alale nɛ e su ngɛ kaa emerald tɛ nɛ he jua wa po kɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Matsɛ sɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ kpa komɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ kpe, nɛ nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ hii si ngɛ a nɔ. A wo ní hiɔ, nɛ sika tsu jlasi fi a yi.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: I na nɛ oslabai gba, nɛ i nu gbihi, nɛ hiɔwe hu si kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ mi. Jatɛ kpaago nɛ a su, ngɛ tsoe ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi; lɔ ɔ ɔmɛ ji mumi slɔɔto kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Mawu ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko hu nɛ ngɛ kaa wo, nɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa ahuhuɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ kristolo ɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi. Hɛ kali eywiɛ daa si kɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɔ nya amɛ tsuo a he kɛ kpe, nɛ a hɛ mi, kɛ a se tsuo hɛngmɛ sɔuu.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ kaa jata, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa na ku. Hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kaa adesa hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa kɔle nɛ te kɛ bee.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ pɛli ekpa, nɛ a mi mi je kɛ kpo nɔ je tsuo hɛngmɛ sɔuu. Nɛ nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo ɔ, a hii lae nɛ a kpa we ke, “Klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu ji Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, nɔ nɛ ngɛ sa a, nɛ e ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ́ e maa ba a.”

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ laa yi jemi la, kɛ sina la, nɛ a kɛ woɔ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ngɛ daa a hɛ mi nyami. Ke a wo la a nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “Wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa Mawu! Mo ji nɔ nɛ sa kaa a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami, bu, kɛ he wami kɛ ha. Mo lɛ o bɔ níhi tsuo; o bɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ o suɔ kaa a hi. Nɛ a ngɛ ja pɛ!”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: I na womi kpo ko ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hiɔ nine mi. A ngma ní ngɛ womi ɔ hɛ mi kɛ se tsuo, nɛ a sɔu nya kɛ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaago.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Nɛ i na bɔfo kpetekpleenyɛ ko nɛ ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ sa kaa e tsɔ womi nya sɔumi ní ɔmɛ, nɛ e bli womi kpo ɔ nya?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Se nɔ ko nɔ ko be hiɔwe, loo zugba, loo zugba a sisi nɛ ma nyɛ ma bli womi ɔ nya, loo e ma nyɛ maa hyɛ mi.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: I wo ya wawɛɛ, ejakaa a nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ sa nɛ ma bli womi kpo ɔ nya, loo e maa kane.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake de mi ke, “Ko fo ya. Hyɛ! Jata a nɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ ji David nina a ye kunimi. Nɛ lɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ tsɔ womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaago ɔmɛ, nɛ e ma nyɛ bli womi kpo ɔ nya.”

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ, i na To bi ko nɛ daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a kpɛti. To bi ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a gbe. E ngɛ koli kpaago, kɛ hɛngmɛ kpaago. Hɛngmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ji Mawu mumi slɔɔto kpaago nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya je ɔ mi tsuo.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: To bi ɔ ya he womi kpo ɔ ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hiɔ nine mi.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Hɛ kali ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ la la he kɛ ha To bi ɔ ke, “Mo nɛ o sa kaa o heɔ womi kpo ɔ, nɛ o tsɔɔ nya sɔumi ní ɔmɛ. Ejakaa a gbe mo, nɛ o kɛ o muɔ ɔ he adesahi tsuo, wɛtsohi, gbihi, mahi, kɛ je mahi kɛ ha Mawu.

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: O to matsɛ yemi sisi ha mɛ, nɛ o wo mɛ osɔfohi, konɛ a sɔmɔ wa Mawu ɔ; nɛ a maa ye matsɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.”

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, ngɛ nina a mi ɔ, i nu bɔfohi babauu akpeakpe abɔ a gbi nɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ kpe.

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: Nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ ngmlaa boboobo ke, “To bi nɛ a gbe ɔ, e sa kaa a ngɔ he wami, ní nami, nile, agboje, bu, hɛ mi nyami, kɛ yi jemi kɛ ha lɛ.”

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Nɛ i nu nɛ nibɔ níhi tsuo ngɛ hiɔwe, zugba a, kɛ zugba a sisi, kɛ wo mi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ nɛ wa maa ngɔ yi jemi, agboje, kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ ha kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene.”

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ i na nɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaago ɔmɛ a kpɛti kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ. I nu nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake wo gbi kaa nɔ́ nɛ hiɔwe lɛ ngɛ sie, nɛ e de ke, “Ba!”

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: Benɛ i ke i hyɛɛ ɔ, nyumu ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ hiɔ ko nɔ kɛ e dɛ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃. A ha lɛ jlasi, nɛ e je kpo kaa kunimi yelɔ nɛ yaa nɛ e ya ye kunimi.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Benɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ enyɔne ɔ, i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ enyɔne ɔ de ke, “Ba.”

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ okpɔngɔ kpa ba, nɛ lɛɛ e tsuɔ. Mawu ha okpɔngɔ nɔ hilɔ ɔ he blɔ nɛ e kɛ ta nɛ ba je ɔ mi, konɛ nimli nɛ gbe a he. A ha lɛ klaate gagaa ko.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ etɛne ɔ, nɛ i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ etɛne ɔ de ke, “Ba!” Nɛ́ i ke i hyɛɛ ɔ, okpɔngɔ yumu ko ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ hɛɛ sɛni ngɛ e dɛ mi.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: I nu nɛ nɔ́ ko pɛ kaa adesa gbi kɛ je hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Gbi ɔ de ke, “Ngma susumi nɔ́ kake ligbi kake hiɔwo, blɛfo susumi nɔ́ etɛ ligbi kake hiɔwo; se nu tso ɔmɛ, kɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ ko kpata a hɛ mi.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ enuɔne ɔ. Nɛ i na nihi nɛ ye Mawu munyu ɔ he odase nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ he ɔ a klaahi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: A kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Ope, mo nɛ o ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale! Mɛni be o maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si? Ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ a gbe wɔ ɔ, kojo mɛ nɔuu nɛ o gbla a tue!”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: A ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ tade hiɔ klɔii, nɛ a de mɛ ke a jɔɔ a he be bɔɔ ko lolo kɛ yaa si a maa gbe a nyɛmimɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a gbe mɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hu sɔmɔɔ Mawu kaa mɛ kɛ̃.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Benɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ekpane ɔ, i nu nɛ zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ. Pu kpa tsomi; diblii wo kpii, nɛ nyɔhiɔ pee tsutsuu kaa muɔ.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Dodoe ɔmɛ tsɔ fia si kaa bɔ nɛ ngmɔkɔ tso yiblii kplɔɔ pueɔ si ke kɔɔhiɔ nguaa fia a.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Hiɔwe hɛ lɛ kɛ ho kaa womi kpo nɛ a hluɛ̃, nɛ yohi, kɛ zugba kpɔhi nɛ wo bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe tsuo hia kɛ je a blɔ hehi.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, niatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ hɛɛ biɛ, odehehi, nyɔguɛhi, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ya laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi, kɛ tɛ sahi a sisi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: A de yo ɔmɛ, kɛ tɛ sa amɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba ha wa nɔ, konɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ko na wɔ, nɛ́ To bi ɔ hu ko gbla wa tue!

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Ejakaa ligbi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye nɛ a maa gbla wa tue ɔ, ligbi ɔ su. Nɛ mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nya maa da?”

english_verse: from Benjamin. People from Every Nation
translation_verse: . A je Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi;

english_verse: After this I saw four angels. Each one was standing on one of the earth's four corners. The angels held back the four winds, so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree. These angels had also been given the power to harm the earth and the sea. Then I saw another angel come up from where the sun rises in the east, and he was ready to put the mark of the living God on people. He shouted to the four angels,
translation_verse: I na bɔfo kpa ko hu nɛ ngɛ kuɔe kɛ je pu site he kɛ ma, nɛ e hɛɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́. E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, nɛ e de bɔfo eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Mawu ha mɛ he wami ke a kpata zugba a, kɛ wo ɔ a hɛ mi ɔ ke,

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛ ko kpata zugba a, loo wo ɔ, loo tso ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si wa maa ngɔ nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kɛ kadi wa Mawu ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ a hɛ nya lolo.”

english_verse: Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were
translation_verse: Nɛ a de mi ke nihi nɛ a ngɔ Mawu nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ kɛ kadi a hɛ nya a, a yibɔ ji

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se nɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, nimli asafo nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane ji nɛ. A je je ma amɛ tsuo a mi, wɛtso munomuno, nimli munomuno, kɛ gbi munomuno. A daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ hɛ mi kɛ a he tade hiɔ klɔiiklɔii; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ tã kũɔmi ngɛ e dɛ.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Nɛ mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Wa Mawu ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami.”

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo daa si kɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a ja Mawu,

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
