translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake bi mi ke, “Nihi nɛ wo tade hiɔ klɔiiklɔii nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ jije a je?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: I de lɛ ke, “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ, i li; mo lɛ o le!” E de mi ke, “Haomi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ gblee mi kɛ be slɔkee. A fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a ha nɛ a hiɛ futaa ngɛ To bi ɔ muɔ ɔ mi.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a jaa lɛ nyɔ kɛ pia ngɛ e sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ. Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ maa baa a yi.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Hwɔ be mɛ yee hu; kuma be mɛ yee hu. Pu, loo pu la nɛ nya wa hu be mɛ sããe,

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: ejakaa To bi ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kpɛti ɔ maa lɛ mɛ; nɛ e ma tsɔ̃ mɛ kɛ maa ya nyu vuhi nɛ haa nɔ wami a he. Nɛ Mawu ma tsu a hɛ mi vo nyu tsuo.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Benɛ bɔfo ɔ tsɔ nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaagone ɔ, hiɔwe jɔ dii maa pee ngmlɛfia fa.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ, nɛ a ha mɛ titimati kpaago.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Bɔfo kpa ba ba da si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e hɛɛ tsopa kɛ e he via sami nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee. A ha lɛ tsopa kɛ e he via fuu nɛ e kɛ piɛ Mawu we bi ɔmɛ tsuo a sɔlemi ɔ he, konɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ nɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Tsopa kɛ e he via la su ku ɔ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ je bɔfo ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ dɛ mi kɛ ho hiɔwe ya.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via sami nɔ́ ɔ; e je la ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɔ wo mi tɔ, nɛ e hɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ. Hiɔwe si, gbihi pɛ, oslabai gba, nɛ zugba mimiɛ. Titimati kpaago ɔmɛ

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ titimati kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ pee klaalo, konɛ a kpa titimati ɔmɛ.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Kekleekle bɔfo ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu, kɛ la nɛ muɔ futu mi ba pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ zugba a mi dlami etɛ mi kake, tsohi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake, kɛ ba mumu tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ sã.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo enyɔne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ a sake nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa yo nguaa ko nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɔ fɔ wo ɔ mi. Wo ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake plɛ muɔ.

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: Wo ɔ mi nibɔ ní hɛ ngmengmlehi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake gbo, nɛ lɛhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ ɔ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake hɛ mi kpata.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Bɔfo etɛne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ dodoe nguaa ko nɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa jatɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ pahi, kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake a mi.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Dodoe ɔ biɛ ji Doomi. Nyu ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake plɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ dooɔ. Nɛ nihi babauu nɛ nu nyu ɔ gbo, ejakaa nyu ɔ dooɔ.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo eywiɛne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko sa pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo a he, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a tsu ní bɔ nɛ sa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, piani ɔ, pu nyɛ we nɛ e tso piani be ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake; nyɔ mi hu nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a kpɛ nyɔ mi be ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i hyɛ, nɛ i nu kɔle ko he nɛ te kɛ bee ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo. Kɔle ɔ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Musu oo musu! Musu oo musu! Nihi tsuo nɛ maa hi je ɔ mi be mi nɛ bɔfo etɛ ɔmɛ ma kpa titimati ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, musu tloo mɛ!”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo enuɔne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i na dodoe ko nɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ zugba, nɛ a ha lɛ muɔ voo ɔ nya safe ɔ.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Dodoe ɔ bli muɔ voo ɔ nya, nɛ la su ku kpii je mi kaa flɔɔnɔɔ nguaa mi la su ku; la su ku nɛ je muɔ ɔ mi ɔ ha nɛ pu, kɛ kɔɔhiɔ pee yumuu.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Baalɛhi je la su ku ɔ mi pue zugba, nɛ Mawu ha mɛ he wami kaa nyingmogblakotohi pɛ.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: A de mɛ ke a ko ta nga, loo ba mumu, loo tso ko tso ko he; nimli adesahi nɛ Mawu nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ he okadi be a hɛ nya a, á ye mɛ pɛ awi.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: A ngmɛ́ baalɛ ɔmɛ blɔ kaa a gbe nimli nɛ ɔmɛ, se mohu kaa a pii mɛ nyɔhiɔ enuɔ sɔuu. A maa nu piimi nɛ a pii mɛ ɔ he wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ke nyingmogblakoto tsɛ̃ nɔ nɛ e yee nɔ ɔ.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a nyɔhiɔ enuɔ ɔ mi ɔ, nimli ma hla gbenɔ se blɔ, se a be nae; a maa suɔ kaa a gbo, se gbenɔ maa tu a nya fo.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Baalɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa okpɔngɔhi nɛ a mia mɛ kɛ ha ta; ní komɛ fi a yi kaa sika tsu jlasi, nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ kaa nimli a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: A yi bwɔmi ngɛ kaa yihi a yi bwɔmi, nɛ a lunguhi ngɛ kaa jata nɔ́.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: A wo ní komɛ ha mɛ ngɛ a gugue mi kaa dade damahi, nɛ ke a fia a pɛlihi a mi ɔ, e pɛɛ wawɛɛ kaa ta zugba lɛhi fuu nɛ okpɔngɔhi gbla kɛ yaa ta.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: A ngɛ hlemi kɛ e nya duɔ kaa nyingmogblakoto hlemi. Nɛ hlemi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi lɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ ma pii nimli nyɔhiɔ enuɔ ɔ ngɛ.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ a nɔ ji bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ muɔ voo ɔ nya a. Hebri gbi mi ɔ, e biɛ ji Abadon, se Hela gbi mi lɛɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Apolion.

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Kekleekle musu ɔ se po; se hyɛ, musu enyɔ pa ngɛ se kɛ ma!

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo ekpane ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe kɛ je sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ maa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ koli ɔmɛ a mi.

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: Gbi ɔ de bɔfo ekpane ɔ nɛ hɛɛ titimati ɔ ke, “Bɔfo eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a fi mɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa nguaa a nya a, yaa pɛne mɛ!”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ekpane ɔ ya pɛne bɔfo eywiɛ ɔmɛ. Blɔɔ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to nɛ a pee mɛ klaalo, konɛ jeha nɛ ɔ tutuutu we nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ɔ tutuutu we ngmlɛfia nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a gbe adesahi tsuo a mi dlami etɛ mi kake.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: A tsɔɔ mi okpɔngɔ ta buli ɔmɛ a yibɔ; a hiɛmi ji ayɔ lafa enyɔ.

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ i na okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ wo dama; ekomɛ tsu tsutsuu kaa la; ekomɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, nɛ ekomɛ hu ngɛ kaa kungwɔ zɔ. Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a yi ngɛ kaa jata yi, nɛ la, kɛ la su ku, kɛ la hɛuu ngɛ a nya mi jee.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nya mi jee ɔ gbe adesahi tsuo a mi dlami etɛ mi kake.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ piɛ, nɛ mɛɛ haomi nɛ ɔmɛ gbi mɛ ɔ, a tsakee we a tsui, nɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nine pee ɔ, a ngmɛɛ we he. A kpa we mumi yayamihi jami. Amagahi nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ, loo ayawa, loo tɛ, loo tso pee ɔ, pi kaa a kpa mɛ jami; pohu amaga amɛ hyɛ we nɔ́, a nui nɔ́, nɛ a nyɛɛ we hulɔ.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ hu, a tsakee we a tsui, konɛ a jɔɔ muɔ si puemi, loo nyuami, loo nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi, loo jumi.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i na Mawu bɔfo kpetekpleenyɛ kpa nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ma. Bɔku bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ alale ngɛ e yi je; e hɛ mi ngɛ kaa pu, nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa la titimahi.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: E hɛɛ womi kpo wayoo ko nɛ a bli mi ngɛ e dɛ mi. E kɛ e hiɔ nane ma wo nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e muɔ nane ma zugba nɔ;

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huãe. Benɛ e pee ja a, hiɔwe wo gbi, nɛ e si si kpaago.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Benɛ hiɔwe si si kpaago ɔ, jinɛ i miɔ nɛ ma ngma nɔ́ nɛ a de ɔ. Se i nu nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ hiɔwe simi kpaago ɔ de ɔ, kɛ to o yi mi; koo ngma!”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo ɔ nɛ i na nɛ daa si, nɛ e nane kake ngɛ wo nɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ zugba nɔ ɔ, wo e hiɔ nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe,

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: nɛ e ka kita ngɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ biɛ mi. Lɛ nɛ e bɔ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba, kɛ wo, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ a mi. Bɔfo ɔ de ke, “Mawu be tsle toe hu!

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Se ke bɔfo kpaagone ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, yi mi nɛ Mawu to ngɔ laa, nɛ e de e tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nɛ e ba mi.”

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi nɛ i nu nɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. E ke, “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ daa si, nɛ e nane kake ngɛ wo nɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ zugba nɔ ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya he womi kpo nɛ a bli mi ɔ ngɛ e dɛ.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: I ya bɔfo ɔ ngɔ, nɛ i ya de lɛ ke e ha mi womi kpo wayoo ɔ. E de mi ke, “Ngɔɔ nɛ o ye; e maa ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kaa hwo ngɛ o nya mi, se e maa doo ngɛ o mi mi.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i sɔle womi kpo wayoo ɔ ngɛ bɔfo ɔ dɛ nɛ i ye. E ngɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kaa hwo ngɛ ye nya mi; se benɛ i mi ɔ, e doo ngɛ ye mi mi.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Nɛ a de mi ke, “Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ mahi, je mahi, gbihi, kɛ matsɛmɛ babauu a he ɔ, e sa kaa o fiɛ ekohu.”

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Se kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ we agbo ɔ nya a lɛɛ ko susu. Si lɔ ɔ, ejakaa a ngɔ kɛ ha je ma amɛ, nɛ a ma si ako ngɛ ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi nyɔhiɔ nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ.

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Odase yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ ji oliv tso enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ kane tso enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu, je ɔ tsuo nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Mawu ha mɛ he wami nɛ a ma nyɛ nga hiɔwe nya nɛ hiɔmi be nɛe be mi nɛ a ngɛ gbae ɔ. A ngɛ he wami ngɛ nyu nɔ kaa a ma ha nɛ nyu nɛ plɛ pee muɔ; a ngɛ he wami hulɔ kaa a kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ slɔɔtohi baa zugba a nɔ si abɔ nɛ a suɔ.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Ke a gbe odase yemi ɔ nya a, lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ jeɔ muɔ voo ɔ mi ɔ kɛ mɛ ma ba hwu ta. E maa ye a nɔ, nɛ e maa gbe mɛ,

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ma pue si ngɛ magbɛ nɔ, ngɛ ma nguaa a nɛ a sɛu a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ mi. A tsɛɛ jamɛ a ma a ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ke Sodom, loo Egipt.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma amɛ, wɛtso ɔmɛ, gbi slɔɔto ɔmɛ, kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa hi a gbogboe ɔmɛ hyɛe gaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ kɛ fa nɛ a be kplɛɛe nɛ a pu mɛ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma nya kaa nimli enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ gbo. A tsui maa nɔ a mi, nɛ a maa ke a sibi ní, ejakaa jamɛ a gbali enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ haomi babauu kɛ ba je ɔ mi.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Ligbi etɛ kɛ fa a se ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ a kpale ba wami mi ekohu. A te si da a nane nɔ, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ na mɛ ɔ ye gbeye wawɛɛ.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, gbali enyɔ ɔmɛ nu gbi ko nɛ pɛ wawɛɛ kɛ je hiɔwe. Gbi ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!” Nɛ benɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ hyɛe ɔ, a ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ bɔku mi.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ; ma a mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake hɛ mi kpata, nimli akpe kpaago gbo, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ a wo Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Musu enyɔne ɔ se po; se hyɛ, musu etɛne ɔ ngɛ se kɛ ma! Titimati kpaagone ɔ

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpaagone ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i nu gbihi nɛ ngɛ pɛe wawɛɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ke, “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e Kristo ɔ nɛ a ngɛ je ɔ nɔ yee. Nɛ a maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene!”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: nɛ a de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, Mo nɛ o ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ o hi si hyɛ hulɔ ɔ, Wa naa mo si kaa o tsu o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ he ní, nɛ o bɔni matsɛ yemi!

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Je ma amɛ a mi mi fu mo, se jehanɛ ɔ, be su nɛ mo hu o mi mi ma fu mɛ. Be su nɛ o maa kojo nihi tsuo nɛ gbo ɔ, nɛ o tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ, ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ nimli wawihi kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ, be su nɛ o maa wo mɛ hiɔ. Nihi nɛ kpataa zugba a hɛ mi ɔ, be su nɛ o ma kpata mɛ hu a hɛ mi.”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nya bli, nɛ a na e somi daka a nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ oslabai gba; hiɔwe si, zugba mimiɛ, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu agboagbo nɛ pue zugba a nɔ.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ fɔmi be su, nɛ e nu kɔɔmi nɛ nya wa. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ e bɔni ngmlaa kpami.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Nyakpɛ okadi nguaa kpa ko hu je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe. I na wo mi sinɔ nguaa ko. E ngɛ yi kpaago, kɛ koli nyɔngma, nɛ jlasi fi yi tsuaa yi.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Sinɔ ɔ ngɔ e hlemi kɛ gbla dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake, nɛ e hɛ mɛ ngɔ pue zugba. Kɛkɛ nɛ e ya da yo nɛ miɔ nɛ e ma fɔ ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ ke e fɔ pɛ nɛ lɛ sinɔ ɔ nɛ ye bi ɔ.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ ba fɔ binyumu, nɔ nɛ maa ye je ɔ tsuo nɔ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ. Se bɔfo ko ba ngɔ bi nɛ ɔ kɛ ho Mawu ngɔ ya ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Yo ɔ tu fo kɛ ho nga nɔ ya ngɛ he ko nɛ Mawu dla ngɔ to lɛ, nɛ a ya hyɛ e nɔ ligbi akpe kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi ekpa.

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: Se a ye sinɔ nguaa a, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a hi hiɔwe hu.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: A sake sinɔ nguaa a ngɔ fɔ he. Ee, jamɛ a blema sinɔ nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abosiami, loo Satan nɛ sisi nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, a sake lɛ kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ fɔ je ɔ mi.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe kɛ ngmlaa ngɛ hiɔwe ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ yi wami hemi ba! Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ Mawu maa ngɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ ye matsɛ! Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ e Kristo he wami ɔ je kpo. Ejakaa Abosiami nɛ daa si ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ e poɔ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nya haa lɛ ɔ be lejɛ ɔ hu. A sake Abosiami kɛ je hiɔwe ngɔ fɔ si.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ! Se je ɔ, kɛ wo, nyɛɛ lɛɛ musu tloo nyɛ! Abosiami kple si kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. E mi mi fu wawɛɛ, ejakaa e le kaa be bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ piɛ ha lɛ.”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Benɛ sinɔ nguaa a na kaa a sake lɛ ba fɔ zugba a nɔ ɔ, e nyɛɛ yo ɔ nɛ fɔ binyumu ɔ se kɛ fo.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Se a ha yo ɔ kɔle nguaa a pɛli enyɔ ɔmɛ, konɛ e kɛ tu fo kɛ ya e hi he ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ. A maa hyɛ e nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ jeha etɛ kɛ fa, nɛ sinɔ nguaa a nine be e nɔ sue.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ sinɔ nguaa a sú nyu kaa pa kɛ je e nya mi kɛ pue yo ɔ se, konɛ nyu ɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Se zugba a ye bua yo ɔ; zugba a bli e nya mi, nɛ e mii nyu nɛ sinɔ nguaa a sú kɛ je e nya mi pue si ɔ.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Sinɔ nguaa a mi mi fu yo ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho, konɛ e kɛ yo ɔ nina nɛ piɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ hu nɛ fiɛɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yesu he ɔ ya hwu ta.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Nɛ sinɔ nguaa a ya da si ngɛ wo ɔ nya.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i na lohwe awi yelɔ ko nɛ je wo ɔ mi kɛ ma. E ngɛ koli nyɔngma, kɛ yi kpaago. Jlasi ngɛ koli tsuaa koli he, nɛ a ngma biɛ nɛ ji musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu ngɛ yi tsuaa yi he.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ i na a ngɛ kaa ogbetee; e nane ngɛ kaa osisiblisi nane, nɛ e nya ngɛ kaa jata nya. Sinɔ nguaa a ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ he blɔ nɛ e ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ matsɛ ɔ eko.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Sinɔ nguaa a yi kake ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ plaa wawɛɛ; se pa a gbo. Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a nyɛɛ lohwe ɔ se.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Ni ɔmɛ tsuo ja sinɔ nguaa a, ejakaa e ngɔ e blɔ nya a kɛ ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ. A ja lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ hulɔ, nɛ a de ke, “Mɛnɔ kɛ lohwe nɛ ɔ sɔ? Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ maa hwu ta?”

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: E bɔni musu bɔmi munyuhi tumi kɛ si Mawu, Mawu biɛ ɔ, Mawu hi he ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: A ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hwu ta, nɛ e ye a nɔ. A ha lɛ he wami ngɛ wɛtso munomuno, nimli munomuno, kɛ gbi munomuno tsuo a nɔ.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu tue!

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Ke a to ke a nu nɔ ko nyɔguɛ ɔ, ja a nu lɛ nyɔguɛ. Ke nɔ ko kɛ klaate gbe nɔ ɔ, ja a kɛ klaate gbe lɛ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e hia kaa Mawu we bi nɛ to a tsui si, nɛ a pɛtɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he wawɛɛ.”

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i na lohwe awi yelɔ kpa ko nɛ je zugba a mi. E ngɛ koli enyɔ; koli ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa to bi kolihi, nɛ lohwe ɔ tu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ sinɔ nguaa a tuɔ munyu.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: E ngɔ jamɛ a he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ lohwe awi yelɔ kake ɔ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tsu ní ja nɔuu ngɛ kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ nane mi. E nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a nɔ nɛ a ja kekleekle lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ e pa a gbo ɔ.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ peeɔ nyakpɛ ní nguahi; e haa nɛ la po jeɔ hiɔwe kɛ baa zugba nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ naa.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Mawu ngmɛ lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ blɔ nɛ e pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ kekleekle lohwe ɔ hɛ mi. Kɛ gu nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, e sisiɔ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ e haa a peeɔ yayami. E nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a puɛ amaga nɛ ngɛ kaa lohwe awi yelɔ kake ɔ nɛ a kɛ klaate plaa lɛ wawɛɛ se e gbo we ɔ.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Mawu ha lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ blɔ kaa e mu mumi kɛ wo amaga a mi, konɛ amaga a nɛ na wami, nɛ e tu munyu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma ha nɛ a gbe nihi tsuo nɛ ja we lɛ ɔ.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Jehanɛ se hu, lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ nyɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ, nimli wawihi kɛ nimli nguahi, niatsɛmɛ kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ, odehehi kɛ nyɔguɛhi tsuo; nɛ a kadi a hiɔ nine, loo a hɛ nya.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma he ní, loo e maa jua ní, kaa ja a kadi lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ kekleekle lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ biɛ, loo yibɔ nɛ daa si ha biɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Ja ní lelɔ ji mo loko o maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, e tsɔɔ yibɔ ɔ nɛ daa si ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ sisi, ejakaa yibɔ ɔ daa si ha nɔmlɔ biɛ. Yibɔ ɔ ji

english_verse: who had been rescued from the earth.
translation_verse: ɔ nɛ Mawu he a yi wami ɔ.

english_verse: I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion! With him were
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i hyɛ, nɛ i na To bi ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ nimli

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ hiɔwe kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee, loo hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ sie wawɛɛ. Gbi nɛ i nu ɔ ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ke kpa saku fiali ngɛ saku fiae nɛ e pɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: A yi lakpa hyɛ; sé ko be a he. Mawu bɔfo etɛ ɔmɛ

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo kpa nɛ te ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo kɛ bee. E hɛɛ sɛ gbi ko nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene. Sɛ gbi ɔ kɔɔ sane kpakpa a he, nɛ e yaa nɛ e ya fiɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ha nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, mahi kɛ wɛtsohi, kɛ gbihi kɛ nimli tsuo.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ de kɛ gbi nɛ wa ke, “Nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami! Ejakaa be ɔ su nɛ e maa kojo nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi. Nyɛ ja nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba, kɛ wo kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi nɛ baa a!”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Bɔfo enyɔne ba ngɛ kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ se, nɛ e ngɛ dee ke, “Babilon hɛ mi kpata! Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hɛ mi kpata! Babilon yakayaka ní peemi ɔmɛ ha nɛ je ɔ tsuo puɛ; e ngɛ kaa dã nɛ nya wa nɛ e ha mɛ nɛ a nu.”

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: La a nɛ a ma pii mɛ ngɛ mi ɔ maa tso gegeege kɛ maa ya neneene. He jɔmi ko be ha nihi nɛ jaa lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ kɛ e we amaga a, loo ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kɛ e biɛ kadi mɛ ɔ; a maa na nɔ́ nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo.”

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e hia kaa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ a heɔ Yesu yeɔ anɔkuale mi ɔ nɛ a to a tsui si daa.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Nɛ i nu gbi ko kɛ je hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Ngmaa: A gbaa gbogboehi nɛ gboɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ.” “Ee!” Mumi ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “A maa jɔɔ a he kɛ je a dengme gbomi ɔ mi; se a ní tsumi ɔmɛ nyɛɛɔ a se.” Nyagbe kojomi ɔ he nina

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i hyɛ nɛ i na bɔku hiɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hii si ngɛ nɔ kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ. Sika tsu jlasi fi e yi, nɛ e hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba ngɛ e dɛ mi.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo kpa nɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ma. Lɛ hu e hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Bɔfo kpa hu nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ la nɔ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ ba. E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ nɛ e de bɔfo ɔ nɛ hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba a ke, “Ngɔɔ o ha nɛ nya ba a kɛ poo wai yiblii ɔmɛ, nɛ o bua nya. Wai yiblii ɔmɛ fu ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ bɔni ní tsumi ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ e ngma kpami ha a. E poo wai yiblii ɔ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e sake ngɔ pue wai ngami nɔ́ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu maa gbla yayami peeli a tue.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: A nga wai yiblii ɔ ngɛ wai ngami nɔ́ ɔ mi ngɛ ma a nya. Nɛ muɔ je wai ngami nɔ́ ɔ mi be kaa pa; e kami maa pee si tomi lafa enyɔ, nɛ e mi kuɔmi hu maa pee nane enuɔ.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i na okadi kpa ngɛ hiɔwe; okadi nɛ ɔ kle nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ. I na bɔfohi kpaago nɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a ngɔ nyagbe haomi kpaago ɔmɛ kɛ ba je ɔ mi. Haomi kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ daa si ha nyagbe tue gblami nɛ Mawu maa ngɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Nɛ a ngɛ Mawu tsɔlɔ Mose la a, kɛ To bi ɔ la a lae ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, O ní tsumi ɔmɛ kle, nɛ a ngɛ nyakpɛ! Je ma amɛ a matsɛ, o ní peemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo da, anɔkuale sɔuu!

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ, nihi tsuo maa wo o hɛ mi nyami! Nihi tsuo ma de ke o kle; ejakaa mo pɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu. Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ maa ba nɛ a ma ba ja mo; ejakaa dami sane nɛ o ngɛ yee ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ na paa!”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na nɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nya bli, nɛ bo tsu klɔuklɔu ɔ maa si ngɛ mi.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ haomi kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ je kpo kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ. A wo tade nɛ a kɛ kploba ngmingmiingmi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klaiklai pee; nɛ a ngɔ kpa nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee kɛ fi a gugue.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ha bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika tsu kplu kake nɛ wai hyi lɛ tɔ. Wai kɛ kplu nɛ ɔ daa si ha Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Mawu hɛ mi nyami, kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ha nɛ la su ku hyi sɔlemi we ɔ tɔ. Nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e je sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ ya si haomi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ kɛ ba a a se po.

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Kekleekle bɔfo ɔ ho nɛ e ya plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue zugba. Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ we okadi ɔ ngɛ a he, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ jaa amaga a tsuo hia pa yaya nɛ yee nɔ.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Bɔfo enyɔne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue wo mi. Nyu ɔ pee kaa nɔ gbogboe muɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ gbo.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Bɔfo etɛne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ wo pahi, kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi a mi, nɛ a pee kaa muɔ.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Nɛ i nu nɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ nyu nɔ ɔ ngɛ Mawu dee ke, “Mo ji Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ. Mo ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ hi si sa a. O ye dami sane ngɛ o kojomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi!

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: Ejakaa adesa pue o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a muɔ si. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o ha mɛ muɔ ke a nu. Ee, nɔ́ pɛ nɛ sa mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ gbi ko pɛ kɛ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope! O yeɔ dami sane, nɛ o gblaa nɔ tue bɔ nɛ sa!”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo eywiɛne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue pu nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ pu ɔ dɔ la wawɛɛ, nɛ e sãã nimli adesahi.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Pu la nɛ nya wa a sãã mɛ saminya, nɛ a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu, nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ kikɛmɛ a haomi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ. Se a tsakee we a tsui, konɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Bɔfo enuɔne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ. Diblii wo ngɛ lohwe ɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi, nɛ nihi a he hia mɛ, nɛ a ta a lilɛ.

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: A tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ nae, kɛ pa nɛ a hia a he. Se ní yayahi nɛ a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a tsakee we a tsui ngɛ he.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo ekpane ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue Yufrate pa nguaa a mi. Nyu ɔ mii ngɛ pa a mi, nɛ e kɛ je blɔ ha matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ maa je beleku je kɛ ba a.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i na mumi yayami etɛ nɛ a ngɛ kaa ovɔnɔhi. A je sinɔ nguaa a, kɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ a nya mi kɛ ma.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Abosiami mumi nɛ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ní ji mɛ. Mumi yayami etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ yaa je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a ngɔ, konɛ a ya bua a nya kɛ ha ta nɛ maa ba ligbi nguaa a nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ maa kojo je ɔ.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Hyɛ! I ma kaa julɔ! Nɔ nɛ huɔɔ, nɛ e peeɔ e tade klaalo ɔ, a gbaa lɛ! E be e he gu hɛɛe nɛ e zo ba je kpo!”

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, mumi yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke Harmagedon ɔ.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo kpaagone ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue kɔɔhiɔ mi. Nɛ gbi ko pɛ wawɛɛ kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ he ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ de ke, “A gbe nya!”

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Ma nguaa a mi gba etɛ, nɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi kpata. Mawu kai Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ e nu wai kɛ je e kplu ɔ mi. Wai nɛ ɔ daa si ha Mawu mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Zugba kpɔhi tsuo nɛ wo bɔle mɛ ɔ laa, nɛ a nɛ yokuhi hu.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ kplu kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ba de mi ke, “Ba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ Mawu maa gbla ajuama kpanaku ɔ tue ha. Jamɛ a ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ a ma ngɔ fɔ pahi babauu a tue ɔ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama; nɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ pee kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã, benɛ e kɛ mɛ fiɛ yakayaka fiɛmi ɔ.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ho nga nɔ ya. Kɛkɛ nɛ i na yo ko nɛ hii si ngɛ lohwe awi yelɔ tsutsuu ko nɔ. A ngma biɛhi fuu kɛ tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu ngɛ lohwe ɔ he tsuo. Lohwe ɔ ngɛ yi kpaago, kɛ koli nyɔngma.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Yo ɔ wo tade he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, nɛ tsuɔ hulɔ; nɛ a kɛ sika tsu june, kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa, kɛ adiagba dla e he ha lɛ. E hɛɛ sika tsu kplu nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ zo ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e we ajuama bɔmi níhi nɛ a hiee ɔ.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: A ngma biɛ ko nɛ ji laami sane ngɛ e hɛ nya ke, “Babilon kpetekpleenyɛ, ajuamahi a nyɛ, kɛ níhi nɛ a hiee tsuo a je he.”

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: I na kaa yo ɔ tɔ dã; ee, e nu ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ Yesu he ɔ a muɔ, nɛ e pee kaa nɔ nɛ tɔ dã. Benɛ i na lɛ ɔ, ye nya kpɛ ye he wawɛɛ.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ bi mi ke “Mɛni he je nɛ o nya kpɛ o he ɔ?” E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Yo ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ yi kpaago kɛ koli nyɔngma a nɔ ɔ, laami sane ɔ nɛ kɔɔ e he ɔ, ma je tsɔɔ mo.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Lohwe ɔ nɛ o na a, be ko ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ, se piɔ lɛɛ e be je mi hu. E be kɛe nɛ e maa je muɔ voo ɔ mi kɛ ba, nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ a ngmɛ a biɛ ngɛ wami womi ɔ mi loko a bɔ je ɔ, ke a na lohwe ɔ, a nya maa kpɛ a he saminya. E hi si be ko; amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e be je mi, se e maa kpale ba ekohu.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: “Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hia juɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi. Yi kpaago ɔmɛ daa si ha yoku kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ yo ɔ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ. A daa si ha matsɛmɛ kpaago hulɔ.

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: Ni enuɔ gbo momo; nɔ kake ngɛ tsɛ yee kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ nɔ kake na we nɛ e ba lolo. Ke e ba a, e maa ye tsɛ be bɔɔ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ sa a, nɛ piɔ lɛɛ e be je mi hu ɔ, e maa pee matsɛ kpaanyɔne; e ye tsɛ momo kaa matsɛmɛ kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: “Koli nyɔngma amɛ nɛ o na a daa si ha matsɛmɛ nyɔngma nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a yi tsɛ lolo. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ma ha mɛ blɔ nya nɛ a kɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ maa ye tsɛ ngmlɛfia kake.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Mɛ tsuo a maa hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ a maa ngɔ a he wami, kɛ a blɔ nya a kɛ ha lohwe ɔ.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Lohwe ɔ, kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma ya tua To bi ɔ. Se To bi ɔ, kɛ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ maa ye a nɔ kunimi. Lɛ ji nyɔmtsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, nɛ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ Mawu tsɛ, nɛ e hla mɛ ngɔ to, nɛ a yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale.”

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Koli nyɔngma amɛ nɛ o na a, kɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ maa te si ngɔ wo yo ajuama a; a maa ngɔ e níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa hɛɛ e he gu. A maa ye e he lo ɔ, nɛ a kɛ la ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: “Yo ɔ nɛ o na a daa si ha ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ e matsɛ ɔ yeɔ ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na bɔfo kpa nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ma. E hɛɛ blɔ nya nguaa, nɛ la nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ ha nɛ je ɔ mi tsuo tsɔ heii.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Babilon hɛ mi kpata! Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hɛ mi kpata! Piɔ lɛɛ e plɛ mumi yayamihi tsuo a si himi he; e plɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ lohwe awi yeli nɛ a hiee tsuo a si himi he.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Ejakaa Babilon yakayaka ní peemi ɔmɛ ha nɛ je ɔ tsuo puɛ; ee, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ wai nɛ nya wa nɛ e ha mɛ nɛ a nu. Je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama, nɛ jua yeli tsuo gu e ní babauu ɔ nɔ nɛ a pee niatsɛmɛ.”

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Ejakaa a to e yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ya si hiɔwe tɔɔ. Nɛ Mawu miɔ nɛ e maa gbla ma a tue ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ e pee mo ɔ, pee lɛ ja nɔuu ngɔ to nane mi. Níhi nɛ e pee ɔ, pee lɛ ja totoe enyɔ ngɔ to nane mi. Dã nɛ e futu ha mo ɔ, mo futu dã nɛ nya wa kaa ja totoe enyɔ ngɔ wo e kplu ɔ mi ha lɛ.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Bɔ nɛ e pee ní nguahi, nɛ e fiɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, pii lɛ, nɛ e ye aywilɛho ja nɔuu. Ejakaa e pɔɔ e he demi ke, ‘Manyɛ ji mi, nɛ i hii si ngɛ ye sɛ ɔ nɔ! Pi yalɔyo ji mi; i be aywilɛho yee gblegbleegble!’

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, haomi nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba e nɔ ligbi kake too: gbenɔ hiɔ, aywilɛho, kɛ hwɔ. Nɛ a kɛ la maa sã lɛ, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ maa kojo lɛ ɔ, e kle.”

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ Babilon bɔ ajuama, nɛ a fiɛ a yi nɔ ɔ, ke be nɛ a sã ma a, nɛ a na la su ku nɛ ngɛ jee ɔ, a maa wo yana, nɛ a ma nya awe ha ma a.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: A maa da si ngɛ se lokoo, ejakaa a maa ye gbeye kaa a maa gbla a kɛ Babilon tsuo a tue. A ma de ke, “Tsaoo! Akuanyɛ! Babilon, ma nguaa! Ma kpetekpleenyɛ! Ngmlɛfia kake too mi ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ gbla o tue ha!”

english_verse: There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be ní nɛ ɔmɛ hee hu: sika tsu, sika hiɔ, tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa, adiagba, kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, seda, bo tsu, tso slɔɔtohi nɛ a he wa, suɔ wu níhi tsuo, tso slɔɔtohi nɛ a he jua wa saminya, akɔblee, dade, marble,

english_verse: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
translation_verse: sinamon, tsopa kɛ e he via, mire, mimɛ, dã, nu, mamu, ngma, na, to, okpɔngɔ, zugba lɛ, nyɔguɛ, kɛ nimli nɛ a hɛ ngɛ tete.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: Jua yeli ɔmɛ ma de ke, “Ní kpakpahi nɛ e jlo mo kaa o ná a, lɛ tsuo se po; ní babauu nɛ o ná, kɛ o yi nɔ nɛ o fiɛ saminya a, lɛ tsuo bɔ mo, nɛ o be nae hu gblegbleegble.”

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Jua yeli nɛ ye jua ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi, nɛ ba pee niatsɛmɛ ɔ, a maa da se lokoo, ejakaa a maa ye gbeye kaa a maa gbla a kɛ Babilon tsuo a tue. A maa wo yana, nɛ a ma nya awe boboobo;

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: nɛ a ma de ke, “Tsaoo! Akuanyɛ! Babilon, ma nguaa! Ma kpetekpleenyɛ! Sa a, kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ bo tsu lɛ e buɔ, nɛ sika tsu, june, kɛ adiagba e kɛ dlaa e he!

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
translation_verse: Nɛ ngmlɛfia kake too mi ɔ, ní babauu nɛ e na a tsuo bɔ lɛ!” Lɛ kudɔɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ sɛ lɛ kɛ yaa he, lɛ mi bi, kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ jua ngɛ wo nɔ tsuo ya da se lokoo.

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: A kɛ zu wo a yi mi, nɛ a wo yana, nɛ a nya awe. A kpa ngmlaa, nɛ a de ke, “Tsaoo! Akuanyɛ ha ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ! Lɛtsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ yeɔ jua ngɛ wo hɛ mi ɔ gu ní babauu nɛ e na a nɔ ba plɛ niatsɛmɛ. Nɛ ngmlɛfia kake too mi ɔ, ní babauu nɛ e na a tsuo bɔ lɛ!”

english_verse: The heavens should be happy with God's people and apostles and prophets. God has punished her for them.”
translation_verse: Hiɔwe! Mo nya kaa a kpata Babilon hɛ mi! Nyɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi, bɔfohi, kɛ gbali, nyɛ nya! Ejakaa Mawu bu lɛ fɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee nyɛ ɔ he!

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpetekpleenyɛ ko wo tɛ nɛ ngɛ kaa wɛ nguaa ko, nɛ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ wo mi, nɛ e de ke, “Kikɛ nɛ ɔ a maa hɛ Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ he, nɛ a be lɛ nae hu gblegbleegble.

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Babilon, la be pɛe gblegbleegble ngɛ ma a mi hu! A be kpa saku, loo adesa gbi, loo bɛ, loo titimati he nue hu gblegbleegble ngɛ ma a mi! A be ga ní tsulɔ ko ga ní tsulɔ ko kulaa nae ngɛ ma a mi hu; wɛ tɛ hu a be e nya nue hu!

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: Kane be tsoe ngɛ ma a mi hu; nɛ a be ayɛflo huno, kɛ ayɛflo nya nue hu. O jua yeli ɔmɛ ji nimli nguahi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ o ngɔ kunya yemi kɛ sisi nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi!”

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Babilon yeɔ fɔ kaa e gbe gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. Ee, Babilon pue ni kpahi babauu hu a muɔ si ngɛ je ɔ mi.

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i nu nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ pɛe ngɛ hiɔwe boboobo kaa nihi babauu a gbi ke, “A je Mawu yi! Mawu ji wa yi wami helɔ! E je agbo, nɛ e ngɛ he wami!

english_verse: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
translation_verse: E yeɔ dami sane; e gblaa nɔ tue bɔ nɛ sa! Yo ajuama kpanaku ɔ nɛ ngɔ yahomi kɛ ngɛ je ɔ puɛe ɔ, e bu lɛ fɔ. Mawu gbla e tue, ejakaa e gbe lɛ Mawu ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
translation_verse: Nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ekohu nɛ a de ke, “A je Mawu yi! La nɛ maa sã ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ be gboe gblegbleegble!”

english_verse: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, gbi ko pɛ kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ he, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi, nyɛ e tsɔli tsuo! Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye, nimli wawi, kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!”

english_verse: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i nu nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ pɛe ngɛ hiɔwe kaa nihi babauu a gbi, loo pa nɛ hia kɛ bee, loo hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ sie wawɛɛ. I nu nɛ a ngɛ dee ke, “A je Mawu yi! Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu Ope ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yee!

english_verse: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ha nɛ wa bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ wa nya! Nyɛ ha nɛ wa je e yi, ejakaa e kle! Ejakaa be ɔ su nɛ To bi ɔ maa kpee yo, nɛ ayɛflo ɔ dla e he ngɔ to.

english_verse: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.”
translation_verse: Mawu ha lɛ tade nɛ a kɛ kploba ngmingmiingmi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klaiklai pee.” Ní kpakpahi nɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji kploba a nɛ.

english_verse: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ de mi ke, “Ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ a kpee mɛ kɛ ba To bi ɔ yo kpeemi okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbaa mɛ!” Bɔfo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Anɔkuale munyu nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ i bu si ngɛ e nane nya konɛ ma ja lɛ. Nɛ e de mi ke, “Ko ja mi! Imi hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔlɔ ji mi kaa mo, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Odase ɔ nɛ Yesu ye ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ tsuo lɛ wa he ye. Já Mawu mohu!” Ejakaa odase ɔ nɛ Yesu ye ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ woɔ gbali ɔmɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ gbaa. Okpɔngɔ hiɔ nɔ hilɔ ɔ

english_verse: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i na nɛ a bli hiɔwe nya, kɛkɛ nɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, okpɔngɔ hiɔ ko ji nɛ. Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ biɛ ji Anɔkualetsɛ kɛ Dalɔ; dami nya e kojoɔ, nɛ e hwuɔ ta.

english_verse: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
translation_verse: E hɛngmɛ ngɛ kaa la lilɛ, nɛ jlasi babauu fi e yi. A ngma biɛ ko ngɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ko; se nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ ji, ja lɛ pɛ.

english_verse: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
translation_verse: E wo tade klɔii ko nɛ a kɛ tsɔ muɔ mi. Nɛ biɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ji “Mawu munyu.”

english_verse: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
translation_verse: Hiɔwe ta buli ɔmɛ wo tade nɛ a kɛ kploba hiɔ ngmingmiingmi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klaiklai kpɛ, nɛ a hi okpɔngɔ hiɔhi a nɔ kɛ nyɛɛ e se.

english_verse: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
translation_verse: Klaate nɛ nya ba je e nya mi, nɛ lɔ ɔ e kɛ maa fia je ma amɛ ní, nɛ e maa ye a nɔ kunimi. E maa ye tsɛ ngɛ a nɔ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ. E kɛ Mawu Ope ɔ we abofu, kɛ mi mi la ma kple a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngaa wai mi ngɛ wai ngami nɔ́ mi ɔ.

english_verse: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
translation_verse: Nɛ a ngma biɛ ko ngɛ e tade klɔii ɔ, kɛ e fiɔ he ke, “Matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, kɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ.”

english_verse: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo ko nɛ daa si ngɛ pu ɔ nɔ. E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, nɛ e tsɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ teɔ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi ɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bua ngɛ Mawu we okplɔɔ nguaa a he!

english_verse: You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba ye matsɛmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ, ta buli, kɛ okpɔngɔhi kɛ a nɔ hili a lo. Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba ye nimli tsuo a lo, nyɔguɛ, kɛ odehe, nimli wawi, kɛ nimli nguahi!”

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a tabo ɔmɛ nɛ a bua a he nya, konɛ a gba ta ngɔ wo nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, kɛ lɛ hu e tabo ɔ.

english_verse: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
translation_verse: A nu lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ nɛ pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ tsuo. E pee nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ kɛ sisi nihi nɛ a kɛ lohwe ɔ kadi mɛ ɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ jaa lohwe ɔ we amaga a. A hɛ lohwe ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ tsuo ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi hɛ ngmengmle.

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: A kɛ klaate nɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ nya mi ɔ gbe a ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo. Nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ye a lo ɔ bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ.

english_verse: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na matsɛ sɛ komɛ nɛ nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, a ha mɛ he blɔ kaa a kojo. Jehanɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ye Yesu he odase, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a he nɛ a gbe mɛ ɔ, i na mɛ hu a klaahi. Mɛɛ a ja we lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, loo e we amaga a; a kɛ lohwe ɔ kadi we a hɛ nya, loo a nine he. A kpale ba wami mi ekohu, nɛ a kɛ Yesu ye matsɛ jeha akpe.

english_verse: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
translation_verse: Nihi nɛ a bu mɛ ngɔ piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ma tle mɛ si be nɛ ɔ mi a he ɔ, Mawu gbaa mɛ, nɛ e pee mɛ klɔuklɔu. Gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ be he wami ngɛ a nɔ, se mohu a maa ye osɔfo, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ Mawu kɛ Kristo; nɛ a kɛ Kristo maa ye matsɛ jeha akpe. A ye Satan nɔ

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: nɛ e ma ya sisi je ma amɛ nɛ gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ. A tsɛɛ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ ke Gog, kɛ Magog. Satan ma bua mɛ tsuo a nya kɛ ba nɛ a ba hwu ta. A hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia.

english_verse: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
translation_verse: A gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo. Nɛ ma nɛ Mawu suɔ, nɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ pueɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a ya sa e yi. Se la je hiɔwe ba kpata a hɛ mi.

english_verse: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ a hɛ Abosiami ɔ nɛ sisi mɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi he nɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ a ma pii mɛ nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ ya neneene. Nyagbe kojomi ɔ

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na Mawu nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ hiɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ko nɔ. Tlukaa a, hiɔwe kɛ zugba laa, nɛ a nɛ mɛ hu.

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i na nihi nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo nɛ daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, ni nguahi, kɛ ni wawihi. A bli womihi a nya; womi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ nimlihi tsuo pee ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a ngma kɛ wo mi. A bli womi kpa hu nya; nɛ enɛ ɔ lɛɛ nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ a biɛ nɛ a ngma kɛ wo mi. A kojo ni gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɛ níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ wo jé ni gbogboehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ ngɔ ha. Gbenɔ, kɛ gbeje hu jé ni gbogboehi tsuo nɛ a kɛ to ɔ ngɔ ha. Nɛ a kojo mɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ pee ɔ he.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: A hɛ gbenɔ, kɛ gbeje ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi. Lɔ ɔ ji gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, i na hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he, ejakaa kekleekle hiɔwe, kɛ kekleekle zugba a be kɛ ho. Nɛ wo be hu.

english_verse: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
translation_verse: I nu nɛ gbi ko pɛ wawɛɛ kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ he kɛ de ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ Mawu hi he ji nimli a kpɛti! E kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ a maa pee e ma. Mawu nitsɛ kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ e maa pee a Mawu.

english_verse: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
translation_verse: Mawu ma tsu a hɛ mi vo nyu tsuo. Nɔ ko be gboe hu; nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee hu; nɔ ko be ya foe hu, nɛ nɔ ko be nɔ́ nae hu. Ejakaa ní momo ɔmɛ a se po.”

english_verse: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ de ke, “Hyɛ, i ngɛ níhi tsuo pee ehe!” E de imi hulɔ ke, “Ngmaa enɛ ɔ, ejakaa anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Nihi tsuo nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ ma na nike ní nɛ ɔ kɛ maa je ye dɛ mi; ma pee a Mawu, nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.

english_verse: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Se fɔ̃li, nihi nɛ he we yi, nihi nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ a hiee, nɔmlɔ gbeli, yaholi, nyuali, wɔ jali, kɛ lakpatsɛmɛ tsuo lɛɛ he nɛ fɔɔ si ha mɛ ji taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ. Lɔ ɔ ji gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ nɛ.” Yerusalem ma he ɔ

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ kplu kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ nyagbe haomi kpaago ɔmɛ hyi mɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ, a ti nɔ kake ba ye ngɔ, nɛ e ba de mi ke, “Ba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ayɛflo ɔ nɛ ji To bi ɔ yo ɔ.”

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ho yo gagaa ko yi mi ya. E tsɔɔ mi Yerusalem, ma klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ngɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ ma zugba a;

english_verse: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
translation_verse: nɛ e hɛɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ kpɛe. Ma a ngɛ kpɛe kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa nitsɛnitsɛ, aloo yaspi tɛ; e mi hu tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ.

english_verse: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Gbogbo nɛ ti, nɛ ya hiɔwe saminya bɔle ma a kɛ kpe. Agbo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ he, nɛ bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ daa si ngɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya. A ngma Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a biɛ ngɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: Agbo etɛ ngɛ beleku je, etɛ ngɛ omleyi je, etɛ ngɛ leneyi je, nɛ etɛ hu ngɛ bonyoku je.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Gbogbo nɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe ɔ, a fia ngɔ fɔ sisi tomi tɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngma To bi ɔ bɔfo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a biɛ ngɛ a nɔ.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ hɛɛ sika tsu tso nɛ a kɛ susuɔ nɔ́ ngɛ e dɛ mi nɛ e kɛ ma susu ma a, kɛ agbo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbogbo ɔ.

english_verse: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about
translation_verse: Ma a fɔɔ si kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami kɛ e blimi sɔ. Bɔfo ɔ kɛ nɔ́ susumi tso ɔ susu ma a, nɛ e pee kilomita akpe enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ; e kami, e blimi, kɛ e hiɔwe yami tsuo sɔ.

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: A kɛ yaspi tɛ fia gbogbo ɔ, nɛ ma a nitsɛ lɛɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ mi tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ a kɛ fia.

english_verse: Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald,
translation_verse: Sisi tomi nɛ a fia ma a gbogbo ɔ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, a kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa slɔɔtohi hɔɔ mi. Kekleekle tɛ nɛ he jua wa a ji yaspi; enyɔne ɔ, safiro; etɛne ɔ, agate; eywiɛne ɔ, emerald;

english_verse: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
translation_verse: enuɔne ɔ, sardoniki; ekpane ɔ, sadio; kpaagone ɔ, krisolito; kpaanyɔne ɔ, berilo; nɛɛne ɔ, topasi; nyɔngmane ɔ, krisopraso; nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ, hiakinto, nɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ biɛ ji ametisto.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Agbo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, adiagba nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ sɔuu, agbo tsuaa agbo ɔ, adiagba kake a kɛ pee. Gbɛjegbɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, sika tsu ngmingmiingmi a kɛ pee; e mi tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: I nɛ sɔlemi we ko ngɛ ma a mi. Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ ji e sɔlemi we.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: Pu, loo nyɔhiɔ nɛ ma kpɛ he hia we ngɛ ma a mi; ejakaa Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ ji la nɛ kpɛɔ ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ To bi ɔ ji e kane.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Agbohi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a be ngae ligbi ko ligbi ko, ejakaa diblii be woe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: Nɛ je ma amɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ mi nyami, kɛ agboje kɛ ba ma a mi.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we be ma a mi bae. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ a hiee, loo e yeɔ lakpa hu be mi bae. Nihi nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ To bi ɔ hɛ kali a womi ɔ mi ɔ, mɛ pɛ lɛ a maa ba ma a mi.

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo ɔ tsɔɔ mi pa kɛ e mi nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ; e mi tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ. Pa a hia kɛ je Mawu, kɛ To bi ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ he

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: kɛ ba be ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ kpɛti. Tso nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ ngɛ pa a tue hiɛ kɛ hiɛ. E woɔ yiblii si nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ jeha mi; nyɔhiɔ tsuaa nyɔhiɔ ɔ, e woɔ si kake, nɛ a kɛ e ba a tsaa nihi ngɛ je ɔ mi.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu gbiɛ be ma a mi hie hu. Mawu, kɛ To bi ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ maa hi ma a mi, nɛ Mawu tsɔli ɔmɛ ma sɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.
translation_verse: A maa na e hɛ mi, nɛ a maa ngma e biɛ ngɛ a hɛ nya.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Diblii be si hie hu, nɛ kane, loo pu la he be mɛ hiae, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ma ha mɛ la, nɛ a maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene. Yesu bami

english_verse: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ de mi ke, “Anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa e mumi ɔ baa gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔmɛ, konɛ a ba tsɔɔ e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ be kpiti mi.”

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: Yesu ke, “Hyɛ! I ma nɔuu! A gbaa nɔ nɛ pɛtɛɔ munyuhi nɛ a gba ngɔ to nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he!”

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Imi Yohane lɛ i nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ i na hulɔ. Benɛ i nu, nɛ i na a, i bu si ngɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ mi ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nane nya, konɛ ma ja lɛ.

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: Se e de mi ke, “Ko ja mi! Imi hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔlɔ ji mi kaa mo, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ pɛtɛɔ munyuhi nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he ɔ. Já Mawu mohu!”

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami peelɔ ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e pee yayami; mutsɛ ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e wo e he mu; nɔmlɔ kpakpa a, e ya nɔ nɛ e pee kpakpa, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: Yesu ke, “Bu tue! I ma nɔuu! I hɛɛ ye hiɔwo ɔ kɛ ma, nɛ ma wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ ní nɛ e tsu ɔ nya.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Imi ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no, sisije kɛ nyagbe!”

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: A gbaa nihi nɛ fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he ɔ. Ee, a maa ye tso nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ yiblii ɔ eko, nɛ a maa gu agbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya ma a mi.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a be mɛ blɔ hae nɛ a sɛ ma a mi: gbe ɔmɛ, nyuali ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbeli ɔmɛ, amaga jali ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ suɔ lakpa yemi ɔ.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: “Imi Yesu lɛ i tsɔ ye bɔfo ɔ, konɛ e ba fiɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi. Imi ji David nina a nɛ. Imi ji nɔkɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Mumi ɔ, kɛ ayɛflo ɔ ke, “Ba!” Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu enɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e de ke, “Ba!” Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, e ba; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ ɔ, e ba ngɔ nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ kaa nike ní. Nyagbe

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he odase yee ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “Ee, i ma nɔuu!” Amen. Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu, ba!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu dloomi ɔ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ hi si. Amen.
